/****** Object:  UserDefinedFunction [dbo].[fn_StripCharacters]    Script Date: 02/11/2026 17:47:22 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[fn_StripCharacters]
(
    @String NVARCHAR(MAX), 
    @MatchExpression VARCHAR(255)
)
RETURNS NVARCHAR(MAX)
AS
BEGIN
    SET @MatchExpression =  '%['+@MatchExpression+']%'

    WHILE PatIndex(@MatchExpression, @String) > 0
        SET @String = Stuff(@String, PatIndex(@MatchExpression, @String), 1, '')

    RETURN @String

END
GO
/****** Object:  UserDefinedFunction [dbo].[fnAddNightlineCheckDigit]    Script Date: 02/11/2026 17:47:22 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[fnAddNightlineCheckDigit]
(
	@inTrackingNumber AS varchar(16)
)
RETURNS varchar(16)
AS
BEGIN
	DECLARE @strTrackingNumber AS varchar(16), @strReturnTrackingNumber AS varchar(16)
	DECLARE @DigitWeighting0 int, @DigitWeighting1 int, @DigitWeighting2 int,
	@DigitWeighting3 int, @DigitWeighting4 integer, @DigitWeighting5 int,
	@DigitWeighting6 int, @WeightingTotal bigint,
	@ModValue int, @ChkDigit int

	IF (LEN(@inTrackingNumber) = 11) -- Value Passed has a Prefix Code
		SET @strTrackingNumber = SUBSTRING(LTrim(@inTrackingNumber), 5, 7)
	ELSE
		SET @strTrackingNumber = LTrim(@inTrackingNumber)

	-- Trim any spaces that have been added by the conversion to string
	-- Starting at the left-most digit extract each one at a time
	-- and multiple it by its weighting.
	SET @DigitWeighting0 = SubString(LTrim(@strTrackingNumber),1,1) * 6
	SET @DigitWeighting1 = SubString(LTrim(@strTrackingNumber),2,1) * 4
	SET @DigitWeighting2 = SubString(LTrim(@strTrackingNumber),3,1) * 2
	SET @DigitWeighting3 = SubString(LTrim(@strTrackingNumber),4,1) * 3
	SET @DigitWeighting4 = SubString(LTrim(@strTrackingNumber),5,1) * 7
	SET @DigitWeighting5 = SubString(LTrim(@strTrackingNumber),6,1) * 5
	SET @DigitWeighting6 = SubString(LTrim(@strTrackingNumber),7,1) * 8
	-- Add all the weighted numbers together
	SET @WeightingTotal = @DigitWeighting0 + @DigitWeighting1 + @DigitWeighting2 +
	@DigitWeighting3 + @DigitWeighting4 + @DigitWeighting5 +
	@DigitWeighting6
	-- Modulus 11 on the total weighted number
	SET @ModValue = @WeightingTotal % 11
	IF @ModValue = 0
	SET @ChkDigit = 5
	ELSE
	IF @ModValue = 1
	SET @ChkDigit = 0
	ELSE
	SET @ChkDigit = 11 - @ModValue
	-- Multiple the passed tracking (sequence) number by 10 and add the check digit
	-- This creates an 8 digit tracking number from a seven digit sequence number
	SET @strReturnTrackingNumber = @inTrackingNumber + CAST(@ChkDigit as CHAR(1))
	RETURN @strReturnTrackingNumber
END
GO
/****** Object:  UserDefinedFunction [dbo].[fnAsciiSumOfCharacters]    Script Date: 02/11/2026 17:47:22 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO


-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date, ,>
-- Description:	<Description, ,>
-- =============================================
create FUNCTION [dbo].[fnAsciiSumOfCharacters]
(
	-- Add the parameters for the function here
	@StringValue varchar(36)
)
RETURNS int
AS
BEGIN
	-- Declare the return variable here
	DECLARE @Result int

;WITH recCTE AS
(
    SELECT REVERSE(@StringValue) AS OriginalReversed
          ,1 AS Position
          ,SUBSTRING(REVERSE(@StringValue),1,1) AS CharAtPos
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.OriginalReversed
          ,r.Position +1
          ,SUBSTRING(r.OriginalReversed,r.Position+1,1)
    FROM recCTE AS r
    WHERE Position<6 --specify the character count here
)
/*
--Use this to see the intermediate result
SELECT * 
FROM recCTE
*/
SELECT @Result =  SUM(ASCII(CharAtPos)) FROM recCTE;

RETURN @Result

END

GO
/****** Object:  UserDefinedFunction [dbo].[fnAutoPickRuleFactory]    Script Date: 02/11/2026 17:47:22 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO

CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[fnAutoPickRuleFactory]
(
@paramStockItemFK int
)
RETURNS VARCHAR(100)
AS
	/* DEBUG Settings */
	/*
		DECLARE @paramStockItemFK int
		set @paramStockItemFK = 53379
	*/
BEGIN
	/* Declare variables */
	DECLARE @RuleOrder INT
	DECLARE @CustomerFK INT
	DECLARE @DivisionFK INT
	DECLARE @OrderBy VARCHAR(100)
	DECLARE @AutoPickRuleReceiverTypeFK INT
	DECLARE @AutoPickRuleReceiverFK INT
	DECLARE @FieldName NVARCHAR(100)
	DECLARE @FieldSortDirection NVARCHAR(4)
	
	/* Initialise variables */
	SET @RuleOrder = -1
	SET @CustomerFK = -1
	SET @DivisionFK = -1
	SET @OrderBy =''
	SET @AutoPickRuleReceiverTypeFK = -1
	SET @AutoPickRuleReceiverFK = -1
	SET @FieldName = '';
	SET @FieldSortDirection = '';
	
	/* Retrieve variables from database */
	SELECT 
		@CustomerFK=si.CustomerFK,
		@DivisionFK = si.DivisionFK
	FROM 
		tblStockItems si 
	WHERE
		si.StockItemPK = @paramStockItemFK

	SELECT
		@RuleOrder=apr.RuleOrder,
		@FieldName=aprt.FieldName,
		@FieldSortDirection=aprt.FieldSortDirection,
		@AutoPickRuleReceiverFK=apr.AutoPickRuleReceiverFK,
		@AutoPickRuleReceiverTypeFK=apr.AutoPickRuleReceiverTypeFK
	FROM
		tblAutoPickRules apr
		INNER JOIN tblAutoPickRuleTypes aprt on apr.AutoPickRuleTypeFK = aprt.AutoPickRuleTypePK
	WHERE
		(
			(apr.AutoPickRuleReceiverFK = @CustomerFK)
				or
			(apr.AutoPickRuleReceiverFK = @DivisionFK)
				or
			(apr.AutoPickRuleReceiverFK = @paramStockItemFK)
		)
		AND
		(aprt.RuleTypeFK = 2 ) 
	ORDER BY apr.RuleOrder DESC

	IF ((@AutoPickRuleReceiverTypeFK=3) and (@AutoPickRuleReceiverFK=@paramStockItemFK))
	OR
	((@AutoPickRuleReceiverTypeFK=2) and (@AutoPickRuleReceiverFK=@DivisionFK))
	OR
	((@AutoPickRuleReceiverTypeFK=1) and (@AutoPickRuleReceiverFK=@CustomerFK))
	BEGIN
	SET @OrderBy = ' ORDER BY '+@FieldName+ ' ' +@FieldSortDirection
	END
return @OrderBy
END
GO
/****** Object:  UserDefinedFunction [dbo].[fnBase64Encode]    Script Date: 02/11/2026 17:47:22 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date, ,>
-- Description:	<Description, ,>
-- =============================================
create FUNCTION [dbo].[fnBase64Encode]
(
	-- Add the parameters for the function here
	@toEncode varchar(36)
)
RETURNS varchar(1000)
AS
BEGIN
	-- Declare the return variable here
	DECLARE @encoded varchar(1000)

SELECT @encoded = 
    CAST(N'' AS XML).value(
          'xs:base64Binary(xs:hexBinary(sql:column("bin")))'
        , 'VARCHAR(MAX)'
    )
FROM (
    SELECT CAST(CAST(@toEncode AS UNIQUEIDENTIFIER) AS VARBINARY(MAX)) AS bin
) AS bin_sql_server_temp;

RETURN left(replace(replace(@encoded, '+','-'), '/','_'), 22)

END
GO
/****** Object:  UserDefinedFunction [dbo].[fnCanTransportUserEditDelivery]    Script Date: 02/11/2026 17:47:22 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[fnCanTransportUserEditDelivery]
(
    @ScheduleDeliveryPK INT
)
RETURNS BIT
AS
BEGIN
    DECLARE @CanEdit BIT = 0;

    SELECT
        @CanEdit =
            CASE
                WHEN co.ContainerOutStageFK = 1 THEN 1
                ELSE 0
            END
    FROM tblContainerOuts co
    INNER JOIN tblScheduleDeliveries sd
        ON co.ContainerOutPK = sd.ContainerOutFK
    WHERE sd.ScheduleDeliveryPK = @ScheduleDeliveryPK;

    RETURN ISNULL(@CanEdit, 0);
END
GO
/****** Object:  UserDefinedFunction [dbo].[fnContainerOutLinePalletContent]    Script Date: 02/11/2026 17:47:22 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO

CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[fnContainerOutLinePalletContent]
(
	@inContainerOutLineFK AS int
)
RETURNS nvarchar(max)
AS
BEGIN
	DECLARE @outPalletContent as nvarchar(max)
	DECLARE @palletContentPK as int
	DECLARE pcCursor CURSOR FAST_FORWARD FOR
	Select PalletContentFK from tblContainerOutLinePalletContent
	Where ContainerOutLineFK = @inContainerOutLineFK
	Order By PalletContentFK ASC

	OPEN pcCursor
	FETCH NEXT FROM pcCursor INTO @palletContentPK

	Set @outPalletContent = ''
	WHILE (@@FETCH_STATUS = 0)
	BEGIN 
		Set @outPalletContent = @outPalletContent + cast(@palletContentPK as nvarchar(100)) + ','
		FETCH NEXT FROM pcCursor INTO @palletContentPK
	END
	CLOSE pcCursor
	DEALLOCATE pcCursor

	-- Cathal OCuirrin 17 July 2018
	IF LEN(@outPalletContent) < 1 RETURN @outPalletContent

	RETURN LEFT(@outPalletContent, LEN(@outPalletContent) - 1) 
END
GO

CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[fnContainerOutLinePalletContentUnits]
(
	@inContainerOutLineFK AS int
)
RETURNS nvarchar(max)
AS
BEGIN
	DECLARE @outPalletContentUnits as nvarchar(max)
	DECLARE @palletContentUnits as decimal(18,3)
	DECLARE pcCursor CURSOR FAST_FORWARD FOR
	Select Units from tblContainerOutLinePalletContent
	Where ContainerOutLineFK = @inContainerOutLineFK
	Order By PalletContentFK ASC

	OPEN pcCursor
	FETCH NEXT FROM pcCursor INTO @palletContentUnits

	Set @outPalletContentUnits = ''
	WHILE (@@FETCH_STATUS = 0)
	BEGIN 
		Set @outPalletContentUnits = @outPalletContentUnits + cast(@palletContentUnits as nvarchar(100)) + ','
		FETCH NEXT FROM pcCursor INTO @palletContentUnits
	END
	CLOSE pcCursor
	DEALLOCATE pcCursor

	-- Cathal OCuirrin 17 July 2018
	IF LEN(@outPalletContentUnits) < 1 RETURN @outPalletContentUnits

	RETURN LEFT(@outPalletContentUnits, LEN(@outPalletContentUnits) - 1) 
END
GO

-- =============================================      
-- Author:  <Jamie Clerkin>      
-- Create date: <13/12/2023>      
-- Description: <Description,,>      
-- ============================================= 
CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[fnGetBuildingsWithNameForCustomer]
(      
  @customerfk INT  
)
RETURNS @BuildingsWithName TABLE 
(
    BuildingPK INT,
    BuildingName NVARCHAR(MAX)
)
AS
BEGIN
		INSERT INTO @BuildingsWithName
			select distinct buildingpk, buildingname 
			from tblbuildings
			inner join tblbuildingunits on buildingfk = buildingpk
			inner join tblDivisionBuildingUnits db on BuildingUnitFK = BuildingUnitPK and db.IsArchived=0
			inner join tbldivisions on divisionpk = DivisionFK
			where CustomerFK = @customerFK
	RETURN;
END;

-- SELECT * FROM [dbo].[fnGetBuildingsWithName]()

-- =============================================      
-- Author:  <Archana Singh>      
-- Create date: <13/12/2023>      
-- Description: <Description,,>      
-- ============================================= 
CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[fnGetBuildingsWithNameForUser]
(      
  @userfk INT  
)
RETURNS @BuildingsWithName TABLE 
(
    BuildingPK INT,
    BuildingName NVARCHAR(MAX)
)
AS
BEGIN

	declare @usertypefk int=1
	declare @customerFK int=1
	select @usertypefk = usertypefk,@customerFK=DistributionCustomerFK from tblusers where userpk=  @userfk
--select @usertypefk, @customerFK

	if(@usertypefk = 1)
	begin -- client buildings
		INSERT INTO @BuildingsWithName
			select distinct buildingpk, buildingname 
			from tblbuildings
			inner join tblbuildingunits on buildingfk = buildingpk
			inner join tblUserBuildingUnits on BuildingUnitFK = BuildingUnitPK
			where userfk = @userfk
	end
	else
	begin
		INSERT INTO @BuildingsWithName
			select distinct buildingpk, buildingname 
			from tblbuildings
			inner join tblbuildingunits on buildingfk = buildingpk
			inner join tblDivisionBuildingUnits on BuildingUnitFK = BuildingUnitPK
			inner join tbldivisions on divisionpk = DivisionFK
			where CustomerFK = @customerFK
	end

	RETURN;
END;



GO

/****** Object:  UserDefinedFunction [dbo].[fnGetCustomersWithNameForBuilding]    Script Date: 02/11/2026 17:47:22 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
  
  
-- SELECT * FROM [dbo].[fnGetCustomersWithName]()  
  
-- =============================================        
-- Author:  <Archana Singh>        
-- Create date: <02/04/2023>        
-- Description: <Description,,>        
-- =============================================   
Create FUNCTION [dbo].[fnGetCustomersWithNameForBuilding]
(        
  @BuildingFK INT =-1         
)  
RETURNS @CustomersWithName TABLE   
(  
    CustomerPK INT,  
    CustomerName NVARCHAR(MAX)  
)  
AS  
BEGIN  
    INSERT INTO @CustomersWithName  
      SELECT distinct CustomerPK, CustomerName 
        FROM tblCustomers c
        inner join tbldivisions d on d.customerfk = c.CustomerPK
        inner join tblDivisionBuildingUnits dbu on dbu.DivisionFK = d.DivisionPK 
        inner join tblBuildingUnits bu on dbu.BuildingUnitFK = bu.BuildingUnitPK
        WHERE c.IsArchived = 0 and d.IsArchived=0  and dbu.IsArchived = 0 AND CustomerName !=''
        and (@buildingfk = -1 or bu.BuildingFK = @buildingfk)
    RETURN;  
END;  
  
  
  
GO
/****** Object:  UserDefinedFunction [dbo].[fnGetDurationInMinutesBetweenTMSShiftStartAndEndTimes]    Script Date: 02/11/2026 17:47:22 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO





-- 17 April 2019 Created by Cathal OCuirrin
-- See [Shift] column data in the dbo.tblTMSEmployeeClockCardDetails table for more information
-- and the code in the ImportEmployeeTMSFile function in the importer.
CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[fnGetDurationInMinutesBetweenTMSShiftStartAndEndTimes]
(
	@shiftTimesString NVARCHAR(MAX)
)
RETURNS INT
AS
BEGIN	
	DECLARE 
		@varCounter int = 1, 
		@varShiftTimesString NVARCHAR(MAX) = REPLACE(ISNULL(@shiftTimesString,'0000-0000'),' ', ''), 
		@varNewShiftTimesString NVARCHAR(MAX) = ''

	IF LEN(@varShiftTimesString) < 1 SET @varShiftTimesString = '0000-0000'

	WHILE @varCounter <= LEN(@varShiftTimesString)
	BEGIN
		IF ISNUMERIC(SUBSTRING(@varShiftTimesString, @varCounter, 1)) = 1 OR SUBSTRING(@varShiftTimesString, @varCounter, 1) = '-'
			SET @varNewShiftTimesString = @varNewShiftTimesString + SUBSTRING(@varShiftTimesString, @varCounter, 1)

		SET @varCounter = @varCounter + 1
	END
	
	IF ISNUMERIC(REPLACE(@varNewShiftTimesString, '-','')) = 0 SET @varNewShiftTimesString = '0000-0000'
	
	IF LEFT(@varNewShiftTimesString,4) LIKE '%-%' SET @varNewShiftTimesString = '0' + @varNewShiftTimesString

	IF RIGHT(@varNewShiftTimesString,4) LIKE '%-%' SET @varNewShiftTimesString = REPLACE(@varNewShiftTimesString,'-','-0')

	DECLARE @ShiftStartTime TIME(7) = LEFT(@varNewShiftTimesString,2) + ':' + RIGHT(LEFT(@varNewShiftTimesString,4),2)
	DECLARE @ShiftEndTime TIME(7) = LEFT(RIGHT(@varNewShiftTimesString,4),2) + ':' + RIGHT(@varNewShiftTimesString,2)
	
	RETURN (SELECT dbo.fnGetTimeInMinutes(@ShiftEndTime) - dbo.fnGetTimeInMinutes(@ShiftStartTime))
END
GO

-- 17 April 2019 Created by Cathal OCuirrin
-- See [Shift] column data in the dbo.tblTMSEmployeeClockCardDetails table for more information
-- and the code in the ImportEmployeeTMSFile function in the importer.
CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[fnGetDurationInTimeBetweenTMSShiftStartAndEndTimes]
(
	@shiftTimesString NVARCHAR(MAX),
	@shiftBreakTimesInMinutes INT
)
RETURNS NVARCHAR(10)
AS
BEGIN	
	DECLARE 
		@varCounter int = 1, 
		@varShiftTimesString NVARCHAR(MAX) = REPLACE(ISNULL(@shiftTimesString,'0000-0000'),' ', ''), 
		@varNewShiftTimesString NVARCHAR(MAX) = '',
		@varShiftBreakTimesInMinutes INT = ISNULL(@shiftBreakTimesInMinutes,0)

	IF LEN(@varShiftTimesString) < 1 SET @varShiftTimesString = '0000-0000'

	WHILE @varCounter <= LEN(@varShiftTimesString)
	BEGIN
		IF ISNUMERIC(SUBSTRING(@varShiftTimesString, @varCounter, 1)) = 1 OR SUBSTRING(@varShiftTimesString, @varCounter, 1) = '-'
			SET @varNewShiftTimesString = @varNewShiftTimesString + SUBSTRING(@varShiftTimesString, @varCounter, 1)

		SET @varCounter = @varCounter + 1
	END
	
	IF ISNUMERIC(REPLACE(@varNewShiftTimesString, '-','')) = 0 SET @varNewShiftTimesString = '0000-0000'
	
	IF LEFT(@varNewShiftTimesString,4) LIKE '%-%' SET @varNewShiftTimesString = '0' + @varNewShiftTimesString

	IF RIGHT(@varNewShiftTimesString,4) LIKE '%-%' SET @varNewShiftTimesString = REPLACE(@varNewShiftTimesString,'-','-0')

	DECLARE @ShiftStartTime TIME(7) = LEFT(@varNewShiftTimesString,2) + ':' + RIGHT(LEFT(@varNewShiftTimesString,4),2)
	DECLARE @ShiftEndTime TIME(7) = LEFT(RIGHT(@varNewShiftTimesString,4),2) + ':' + RIGHT(@varNewShiftTimesString,2)
	
	RETURN (SELECT dbo.fnGetHoursAndMinutesTimeFormatForMinutes(dbo.fnGetTimeInMinutes(@ShiftEndTime) - dbo.fnGetTimeInMinutes(@ShiftStartTime) - @varShiftBreakTimesInMinutes))
END
GO
/****** Object:  UserDefinedFunction [dbo].[fnGetHoursAndMinutesTimeFormatForMinutes]    Script Date: 02/11/2026 17:47:22 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO




-- 02 April 2019 Created by Cathal OCuirrin
CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[fnGetHoursAndMinutesTimeFormatForMinutes]
(
	@minutes INT
)
RETURNS NVARCHAR(50)
AS
BEGIN
	DECLARE 
		@varStringHours nvarchar(50) = '00',
		@varStringMinutes nvarchar(2) = '00',
		@varHours INT = 0,
		@varMinutes INT = 0,
		@varDuration NVARCHAR(50) = '00:00'

	SELECT @varMinutes = ISNULL(@minutes, 0)

	IF @varMinutes < 1 SELECT @varDuration = @varStringHours + ':' + @varStringMinutes
	ELSE IF @varMinutes < 10 SELECT @varDuration =  @varStringHours + ':0' + CAST(@varMinutes AS CHAR(1))
	ELSE IF @varMinutes < 60 SELECT @varDuration =  @varStringHours + ':' + CAST(@varMinutes AS CHAR(2))
	ELSE IF @varMinutes > 59
	BEGIN
		SELECT @varHours = (@varMinutes / 60)
		SELECT @varMinutes = @varMinutes - (@varHours * 60)

		IF @varHours < 10  SELECT @varStringHours = '0' + CAST(@varHours AS NVARCHAR(1)) 
		ELSE SELECT @varStringHours = CAST(@varHours AS NVARCHAR(10))

		IF @varMinutes < 10 SELECT @varStringMinutes = '0' + CAST(@varMinutes AS NVARCHAR(1)) ELSE SELECT @varStringMinutes = CAST(@varMinutes AS NVARCHAR(2))

		SELECT @varDuration =  @varStringHours + ':' + @varStringMinutes
	END		
		
	RETURN @varDuration		
END
GO
/****** Object:  UserDefinedFunction [dbo].[fnGetLastSpecificDayOfWeekInPreviousMonth]    Script Date: 02/11/2026 17:47:22 ******/

SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON

-- ==================================================================================================
-- Author:      Cathal O Cuirrin
-- Create Date: 19 Jan 2018
-- Description: Returns the last instance of a specific day, based on the @invoiceFrequencyFK value 
-- (query the tblInvoiceFrequencies table), in the month previous to the month in @date.
-- ==================================================================================================
CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[fnGetLastSpecificDayOfWeekInPreviousMonth]
(
    -- Add the parameters for the function here
    @date datetime,
	@invoiceFrequencyFK int
)
RETURNS datetime
AS
BEGIN
	IF (NOT ISNULL(@invoiceFrequencyFK,0) BETWEEN 8 AND 14) OR @date IS NULL RETURN -99

	SET @invoiceFrequencyFK = @invoiceFrequencyFK - 7

	DECLARE @rtn int = -11

	SELECT @date = DATEADD(MONTH, DATEDIFF(MONTH, 0, @date), -1) --AS LastDayOfThePreviousMonth

	-- Find the last day in question in the previous month
	WHILE (SELECT DATEPART(DW,@date)) <> @invoiceFrequencyFK
		SET @date = DATEADD(DAY,-1,@date)

	RETURN @date
END
GO

CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[fnGetLatestUpdatedScheduleWeekPKForBuilding]
(
    @BuildingFK INT,
    @Year INT,
    @WeekNumber INT
)
RETURNS INT
AS
BEGIN
    DECLARE @ScheduleWeekPK INT;

    SELECT TOP 1 @ScheduleWeekPK = ScheduleWeekPK
    FROM dbo.tblScheduleWeeks
    WHERE BuildingFK = @BuildingFK
      AND Year = @Year
      AND WeekNumber = @WeekNumber
      AND IsArchived = 0
    ORDER BY UpdatedDate DESC;

    RETURN @ScheduleWeekPK;
END

-- 13 Sep 2018 Created by Cathal OCuirrin
CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[fnGetLocationName]
(
	@LocationTypeFK INT, 
	@LocationFK INT,
	@BayPosition INT
)
RETURNS NVARCHAR(500)
AS
BEGIN			
	DECLARE @LocationName NVARCHAR(500) = ''
	
	IF @LocationTypeFK = 1 SELECT TOP 1 @LocationName = /*BuildingName + ' - ' + BuildingUnit + ' - ' +*/ BuildingUnitBayLocation FROM dbo.viewBuildingUnitBays WHERE BuildingUnitBayPK = @LocationFK and IsArchived=0
	ELSE IF @LocationTypeFK = 2 SELECT TOP 1 @LocationName = LoadingBay FROM dbo.tblLoadingBays WHERE loadingBayPK = @LocationFK
	ELSE IF @LocationTypeFK = 3 SELECT TOP 1 @LocationName = SetDownArea FROM dbo.tblSetDownAreas WHERE SetdownareaPK = @LocationFK
	ELSE IF @LocationTypeFK = 6 SELECT TOP 1 @LocationName = SampleLocation FROM dbo.tblSampleLocations WHERE SampleLocationPK = @LocationFK
	ELSE IF @LocationTypeFK = 8 SELECT TOP 1 @LocationName = FloorLocation FROM dbo.tblFloorLocations WHERE FloorLocationPK = @LocationFK

	IF @BayPosition > 0 AND @BayPosition < 10 SET @LocationName = @LocationName + '0' + CAST(@BayPosition AS NVARCHAR(50))
	ELSE IF @BayPosition > 0 AND @BayPosition > 9 SET @LocationName = @LocationName + CAST(@BayPosition AS NVARCHAR(50))

	RETURN @LocationName
END

-- 18 Feb 2021 Created by Damien Gannon
CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[fnGetNextInvoiceDate]
(
	@InvoiceFrequency int,
	@MostRecentInvoiceDate Date
)
RETURNS Date
AS
BEGIN

	DECLARE @NextInvoiceDate As Date

	--Get day of week
	DECLARE @lastInvoiceDayOfWeek As int
	-- -1, because SQL days start at 1, Not 0
	SET @lastInvoiceDayOfWeek = DATEPART(WEEKDAY, @MostRecentInvoiceDate) -1

	--Get number of Days to add
	DECLARE @daystoAdd As int
	SET @daystoAdd =  (7 - (@lastInvoiceDayOfWeek - (@InvoiceFrequency -1)))

	--- Next Months End Date
	DECLARE @lastDayOfMonth As Date
	SET @lastDayOfMonth = EOMONTH(@MostRecentInvoiceDate, 1)

	--Get day of week of next months end date -1, because SQL days start at 1, Not 0
	DECLARE @lastDOMDayOfWeek As int
	SET @lastDOMDayOfWeek = DATEPART(WEEKDAY, @lastDayOfMonth) - 1

	--Get number of days to subtract from last day of month (frequency - 8 (frequencyfk starts at 8 for
	--month end options) - 7 (take away a week to make it minus number) - last day of week
	DECLARE @dayDiff As Integer
	SET @dayDiff = (@InvoiceFrequency - 8) - (7) - (@lastDOMDayOfWeek)
	If(@dayDiff < -7)
		Set @dayDiff = @dayDiff + 7

	
	SELECT @NextInvoiceDate  = CASE --@InvoiceFrequency
			WHEN  @InvoiceFrequency = 1 OR
				  @InvoiceFrequency = 2 OR
				  @InvoiceFrequency = 3 OR
				  @InvoiceFrequency = 4 OR 
				  @InvoiceFrequency = 5 OR
				  @InvoiceFrequency = 6 OR
				  @InvoiceFrequency = 7 THEN
					DATEADD(DAY, @daystoAdd,@MostRecentInvoiceDate)
					--DATEADD(DAY, (7 - (DATEPART(WEEKDAY, @MostRecentInvoiceDate) - (@InvoiceFrequency -1))), 
					--		(@MostRecentInvoiceDate))
			WHEN  @InvoiceFrequency = 8 OR
				  @InvoiceFrequency = 9 OR
				  @InvoiceFrequency = 10 OR
				  @InvoiceFrequency = 11 OR 
				  @InvoiceFrequency = 12 OR
				  @InvoiceFrequency = 13 OR
				  @InvoiceFrequency = 14 THEN --InvoiceFrequency.MontlyLastSunday
					DATEADD(DAY, (@dayDiff), @lastDayOfMonth)
			--ELSE 
			--	@MostRecentInvoiceDate 
			END


	return @NextInvoiceDate 
END
GO

-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[FnPalletAdditionalFields] 
(	
	-- Add the parameters for the function here

)
RETURNS @tmpPalletAdditionalFields TABLE (palletFK int, AdditionalValues nvarchar(max))
AS
BEGIN


      Insert into  @tmpPalletAdditionalFields
      Select PalletFK, max(paf1) + case when max(paf2) = '' then '' else ', ' + max(paf2) end + case when max(paf3) = '' then '' else ', ' + max(paf3) end + case when max(paf4) = '' then '' else ', ' + max(paf4) end + case when max(paf5) = '' then '' else ', ' + max(paf5) end from (      
            Select PalletFK, 
            case when pafs1.PalletAdditionalFieldPK is null then '' else pafs1.PalletAdditionalFieldDescription + ':' + pafvs.PalletAdditionalFieldValue end paf1,
            case when pafs2.PalletAdditionalFieldPK is null then '' else pafs2.PalletAdditionalFieldDescription + ':' + pafvs.PalletAdditionalFieldValue end paf2,
            case when pafs3.PalletAdditionalFieldPK is null then '' else pafs3.PalletAdditionalFieldDescription + ':' + pafvs.PalletAdditionalFieldValue end paf3,
            case when pafs4.PalletAdditionalFieldPK is null then '' else pafs4.PalletAdditionalFieldDescription + ':' + pafvs.PalletAdditionalFieldValue end paf4,
            case when pafs5.PalletAdditionalFieldPK is null then '' else pafs5.PalletAdditionalFieldDescription + ':' + pafvs.PalletAdditionalFieldValue end paf5
            From tblPalletAdditionalFieldValues pafvs
            left outer join tblPalletAdditionalFields pafs1 on
            pafs1.PalletAdditionalFieldPK = pafvs.PalletAdditionalFieldFK
            AND pafs1.FieldNumber=1

            left outer join tblPalletAdditionalFields pafs2 on
            pafs2.PalletAdditionalFieldPK = pafvs.PalletAdditionalFieldFK
            AND pafs2.FieldNumber=2

            left outer join tblPalletAdditionalFields pafs3 on
            pafs3.PalletAdditionalFieldPK = pafvs.PalletAdditionalFieldFK
            AND pafs3.FieldNumber=3

            left outer join tblPalletAdditionalFields pafs4 on
            pafs4.PalletAdditionalFieldPK = pafvs.PalletAdditionalFieldFK
            AND pafs4.FieldNumber=4

            left outer join tblPalletAdditionalFields pafs5 on
            pafs5.PalletAdditionalFieldPK = pafvs.PalletAdditionalFieldFK
            AND pafs5.FieldNumber=5
      )subQ
      Group By PalletFK
	-- Add the SELECT statement with parameter references here
--	SELECT * from  @tmpPalletAdditionalFields
RETURN 
END
GO

/****** Object:  UserDefinedFunction [dbo].[fnRemoveNonAlphaCharactersFromString]    Script Date: 02/11/2026 17:47:22 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[fnRemoveNonAlphaCharactersFromString](@Temp NVARCHAR(MAX))
RETURNS NVARCHAR(MAX)
AS
BEGIN
    DECLARE @KeepValues NVARCHAR(MAX)

    SET @KeepValues = '%[^a-z]%'

    WHILE PATINDEX(@KeepValues, @Temp) > 0
        SET @Temp = STUFF(@Temp, PATINDEX(@KeepValues, @Temp), 1, '')

    RETURN LOWER(REPLACE(@Temp, ' ', '')) /*Also remove spaces and change to lowercase*/
END
GO
/****** Object:  UserDefinedFunction [dbo].[fnSplitStringToArray]    Script Date: 02/11/2026 17:47:22 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[fnSplitStringToArray] 
    (   
    @DelimitedString    varchar(8000),
    @Delimiter              varchar(100) 
    )
RETURNS @tblArray TABLE
    (
    ElementID   int IDENTITY(1,1),  -- Array index
    Element     varchar(1000)               -- Array element contents
    )
AS
BEGIN

    -- Local Variable Declarations
    -- ---------------------------
    DECLARE @Index      smallint,
                    @Start      smallint,
                    @DelSize    smallint

    SET @DelSize = LEN(@Delimiter)

    -- Loop through source string and add elements to destination table array
    -- ----------------------------------------------------------------------
    WHILE LEN(@DelimitedString) > 0
    BEGIN

        SET @Index = CHARINDEX(@Delimiter, @DelimitedString)

        IF @Index = 0
            BEGIN

                INSERT INTO
                    @tblArray 
                    (Element)
                VALUES
                    (LTRIM(RTRIM(@DelimitedString)))

                BREAK
            END
        ELSE
            BEGIN

                INSERT INTO
                    @tblArray 
                    (Element)
                VALUES
                    (LTRIM(RTRIM(SUBSTRING(@DelimitedString, 1,@Index - 1))))

                SET @Start = @Index + @DelSize
                SET @DelimitedString = SUBSTRING(@DelimitedString, @Start , LEN(@DelimitedString) - @Start + 1)

            END
    END

    RETURN
END
GO
/****** Object:  UserDefinedFunction [dbo].[fnSplitStringToList]    Script Date: 02/11/2026 17:47:22 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[fnSplitStringToList]
(
    @in_string VARCHAR(MAX),
    @delimiter VARCHAR(1)
)
RETURNS @list TABLE(tuple VARCHAR(100))
AS
BEGIN
        WHILE LEN(@in_string) > 0
        BEGIN
            INSERT INTO @list(tuple)
            SELECT left(@in_string, charindex(@delimiter, @in_string+',') -1) as tuple
    
            SET @in_string = stuff(@in_string, 1, charindex(@delimiter, @in_string + @delimiter), '')
        end
    RETURN 
END
GO
/****** Object:  UserDefinedFunction [dbo].[fnStockReturnSubSumSet]    Script Date: 02/11/2026 17:47:22 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE function [dbo].[fnStockReturnSubSumSet](@StockItemFK INT, @Batch NVARCHAR(300),@RequestedPallets INT, @RequiredStatusFK INT = -1)     
RETURNS @tblSubSumSet TABLE (SubSumSetPK INT,BuildingUnitFK INT, UnitsFulfillable INT, BuildingName NVARCHAR(200))    
AS BEGIN    

		/* Declarations */
		DECLARE @BuildingUnitFK_OUTER INT
		DECLARE @Units_OUTER INT
		DECLARE @BuildingName_OUTER NVARCHAR(200)
		DECLARE @INNER_BuildingUnitFK INT
		DECLARE @INNER_Units INT
		DECLARE @INNER_BuildingName NVARCHAR(200)
		DECLARE @counter INT
		DECLARE @exist INT
		DECLARE @sum INT

		/* Initialization */
		SET @counter = 1
		/* OUTER CURSOR ITERATION */
		DECLARE OuterLoop CURSOR FAST_FORWARD FOR
					SELECT pa1.BuildingUnitFK, count(pc1.StockItemFK), b1.BuildingName FROM tblPallets pa1 inner join tblPalletContent pc1 on pa1.PalletPK = pc1.PalletFK
						inner join tblBuildingUnits bu1 ON bu1.BuildingUnitPK=BuildingUnitFK
						inner join tblBuildings b1 ON b1.BuildingPK=bu1.BuildingFK
			
					WHERE pc1.stockItemFK = @stockItemFK
					and 
						pc1.Batch = @batch
					and 
						(pa1.PalletStatusFK = @requiredStatusFK  or @requiredStatusFK=-1)
					GROUP BY pa1.BuildingUnitFK,b1.BuildingName,pc1.StockItemFK
					ORDER BY pa1.BuildingUnitFK,b1.BuildingName DESC
		OPEN OuterLoop
		FETCH NEXT FROM OuterLoop INTO @BuildingUnitFK_OUTER, @Units_OUTER,@BuildingName_OUTER
		WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS=0
		BEGIN
		INSERT INTO @tblSubSumSet(SubSumSetPK,BuildingUnitFK,UnitsFulfillable,BuildingName) VALUES(@counter,@BuildingUnitFK_OUTER,@Units_OUTER,@BuildingName_OUTER)

		DECLARE InnerLoop CURSOR FAST_FORWARD FOR
					SELECT pa.BuildingUnitFK, count(pc.StockItemFK), b.BuildingName FROM tblPallets pa inner join tblPalletContent pc on pa.PalletPK = pc.PalletFK
						inner join tblBuildingUnits bu ON bu.BuildingUnitPK=BuildingUnitFK
						inner join tblBuildings b ON b.BuildingPK=bu.BuildingFK
			
					WHERE pc.stockItemFK = @stockItemFK
					and 
						pc.Batch = @batch
					and 
						(pa.PalletStatusFK = @requiredStatusFK  or @requiredStatusFK=-1)
					GROUP BY pa.BuildingUnitFK,b.BuildingName,pc.StockItemFK
					ORDER BY pa.BuildingUnitFK,b.BuildingName DESC
		OPEN InnerLoop
		FETCH NEXT FROM InnerLoop INTO @INNER_BuildingUnitFK, @INNER_Units,@INNER_BuildingName
		WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS=0
		BEGIN
				IF (@BuildingUnitFK_OUTER <> @INNER_BuildingUnitFK) 
					BEGIN
					SELECT @sum=isnull(sum(UnitsFulfillable),0) FROM @tblSubSumSet WHERE SubSumSetPK = @counter
					IF (@sum<	@RequestedPallets) 
					BEGIN
						INSERT INTO @tblSubSumSet(SubSumSetPK, BuildingUnitFK, UnitsFulfillable,BuildingName) VALUES(@counter,@INNER_BuildingUnitFK,@INNER_Units,@INNER_BuildingName)
					END
				END
		FETCH NEXT FROM InnerLoop INTO @INNER_BuildingUnitFK, @INNER_Units,@INNER_BuildingName
		END
		CLOSE InnerLoop
		DEALLOCATE InnerLoop
		SET @counter = @counter + 1
	FETCH NEXT FROM OuterLoop INTO @BuildingUnitFK_OUTER, @Units_OUTER,@BuildingName_OUTER
	END
	CLOSE OuterLoop
	DEALLOCATE OuterLoop
RETURN;    
END
GO

SET ANSI_NULLS OFF
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER OFF

-- =============================================

CREATE FUNCTION  [dbo].[fnWarehouseOccupancy] 
(
	@buildingUnitFK int = -1,
	@divisionBuildingUnitFK int = -1
)
RETURNS int
AS
BEGIN
	-- Declare the return variable here
	DECLARE @percentOccupancy int

	DECLARE @tblBayPalletTypePercents TABLE
	(
	  PalletTypeFK int,
	  BayWidth int,
	  SpacePercent decimal(10,5)
	)
	

    IF(@divisionBuildingUnitFK <> -1) BEGIN
		Declare @divisionFK int
		Declare @bayCount int
		Select @divisionFK = DivisionFK, @buildingUnitFK = BuildingUnitFK 
		from tblDivisionBuildingUnits where DivisionBuildingUnitPK = @divisionBuildingUnitFK

		Insert into @tblBayPalletTypePercents 
		Select DISTINCT palletTypes.PalletTypeFK, buBays.Width BayWidth, cast(1.0/floor(buBays.Width/palletTypes.Width) * 100.0 as decimal(18,3)) 
		from tblDivisionBuildingUnitBays dbuBays 
		inner join tblBuildingUnitBays buBays on
		buBays.BuildingUnitBayPK = dbuBays.BuildingUnitBayFK
		inner join (
			Select DISTINCT pallets.PalletTypeFK, palletTypes.Width from tblPallets pallets
			inner join tblPalletTypes palletTypes on
			palletTypes.PalletTypePK = pallets.PalletTypeFK
			inner join tblDivisionBuildingUnitBays dbuBays on
			dbuBays.DivisionFK = @divisionFK AND
			dbuBays.BuildingUnitFK = @buildingUnitFK AND
			dbuBays.BuildingUnitBayFK = pallets.LocationFK
			Where pallets.LocationTypeFK = 1 /*In Racking ONLY! - BuildingUnitBays */
		) palletTypes on
		1=1
		Where dbuBays.DivisionFK = @divisionFK AND dbuBays.BuildingUnitFK = @buildingUnitFK
		 
		Select @bayCount = count(*) 
		from tblDivisionBuildingUnitBays dbuBays 
		inner join tblBuildingUnitBays buBays on
		buBays.BuildingUnitBayPK = dbuBays.BuildingUnitBayFK
		Where dbuBays.DivisionFK = @divisionFK AND dbuBays.BuildingUnitFK = @buildingUnitFK

		--Select * from 		@tblBayPalletTypePercents

		Select @percentOccupancy = sum(SpacePercent)/@bayCount
		from tblPallets pallets
			inner join tblDivisionBuildingUnitBays dbuBays on
			dbuBays.DivisionFK = @divisionFK AND
			dbuBays.BuildingUnitFK = @buildingUnitFK AND
			dbuBays.BuildingUnitBayFK = pallets.LocationFK
			inner join tblBuildingUnitBays buBays on
			buBays.BuildingUnitBayPK = pallets.LocationFK
			inner join @tblBayPalletTypePercents palletPercentages on
			palletPercentages.PalletTypeFK = pallets.PalletTypeFK
			AND palletPercentages.BayWidth = buBays.Width
			Where pallets.LocationTypeFK = 1 /*In Racking ONLY! - BuildingUnitBays */
		
		--Select @bayCount
	END

	-- Return the result of the function
	RETURN @percentOccupancy

END
GO
/****** Object:  UserDefinedFunction [dbo].[fProperCase]    Script Date: 02/11/2026 17:47:22 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[fProperCase](@Value varchar(8000), @Exceptions varchar(8000),@UCASEWordLength tinyint)
returns varchar(8000)
as
/* ~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
Function Purpose: To convert text to Proper Case.
Created By:             David Wiseman
Website:                http://www.wisesoft.co.uk
Created:                2005-10-03
Updated:                2006-06-22
~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
INPUTS:

@Value :                This is the text to be converted to Proper Case
@Exceptions:            A list of exceptions to the default Proper Case rules. e.g. |RAM|CPU|HDD|TFT|
                              Without exception list they would display as Ram, Cpu, Hdd and Tft
                              Note the use of the Pipe "|" symbol to separate exceptions.
                              (You can change the @sep variable to something else if you prefer)
@UCASEWordLength: You can specify that words less than a certain length are automatically displayed in UPPERCASE

USAGE1:

Convert text to ProperCase, without any exceptions

select dbo.fProperCase('THIS FUNCTION WAS CREATED BY DAVID WISEMAN',null,null)
>> This Function Was Created By David Wiseman

USAGE2:

Convert text to Proper Case, with exception for WiseSoft

select dbo.fProperCase('THIS FUNCTION WAS CREATED BY DAVID WISEMAN @ WISESOFT','|WiseSoft|',null)
>> This Function Was Created By David Wiseman @ WiseSoft

USAGE3:

Convert text to Proper Case and default words less than 3 chars to UPPERCASE

select dbo.fProperCase('SIMPSON, HJ',null,3)
>> Simpson, HJ

~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~ */
begin
      declare @sep char(1) -- Seperator character for exceptions
      declare @i int -- counter
      declare @ProperCaseText varchar(5000) -- Used to build our Proper Case string for Function return
      declare @Word varchar(1000) -- Temporary storage for each word
      declare @IsWhiteSpace as bit -- Used to indicate whitespace character/start of new word
      declare @c char(1) -- Temp storage location for each character

      set @Word = ''
      set @i = 1
      set @IsWhiteSpace = 1
      set @ProperCaseText = ''
      set @sep = '|'

      -- Set default UPPERCASEWord Length
      if @UCASEWordLength is null set @UCASEWordLength = 1
      -- Convert user input to lower case (This function will UPPERCASE words as required)
      set @Value = LOWER(@Value)

      -- Loop while counter is less than text lenth (for each character in...)
      while (@i <= len(@Value)+1)
      begin

            -- Get the current character
            set @c = SUBSTRING(@Value,@i,1)

            -- If start of new word, UPPERCASE character
            if @IsWhiteSpace = 1 set @c = UPPER(@c)

            -- Check if character is white space/symbol (using ascii values)
            set @IsWhiteSpace = case when (ASCII(@c) between 48 and 58) then 0
                                          when (ASCII(@c) between 64 and 90) then 0
                                          when (ASCII(@c) between 96 and 123) then 0
                                          else 1 end

            if @IsWhiteSpace = 0
            begin
                  -- Append character to temp @Word variable if not whitespace
                  set @Word = @Word + @c
            end
            else
            begin
                  -- Character is white space/punctuation/symbol which marks the end of our current word.
                  -- If word length is less than or equal to the UPPERCASE word length, convert to upper case.
                  -- e.g. you can specify a @UCASEWordLength of 3 to automatically UPPERCASE all 3 letter words.
                  set @Word = case when len(@Word) <= @UCASEWordLength then UPPER(@Word) else @Word end

                  -- Check word against user exceptions list. If exception is found, use the case specified in the exception.
                  -- e.g. WiseSoft, RAM, CPU.
                  -- If word isn't in user exceptions list, check for "known" exceptions.
                  set @Word = case when charindex(@sep + @Word + @sep,@exceptions collate Latin1_General_CI_AS) > 0
                                    then substring(@exceptions,charindex(@sep + @Word + @sep,@exceptions collate Latin1_General_CI_AS)+1,len(@Word))
                                    when @Word = 's' and substring(@Value,@i-2,1) = '''' then 's' -- e.g. Who's
                                    when @Word = 't' and substring(@Value,@i-2,1) = '''' then 't' -- e.g. Don't
                                    when @Word = 'm' and substring(@Value,@i-2,1) = '''' then 'm' -- e.g. I'm
                                    when @Word = 'll' and substring(@Value,@i-3,1) = '''' then 'll' -- e.g. He'll
                                    when @Word = 've' and substring(@Value,@i-3,1) = '''' then 've' -- e.g. Could've
                                    else @Word end

                  -- Append the word to the @ProperCaseText along with the whitespace character
                  set @ProperCaseText = @ProperCaseText + @Word + @c
                  -- Reset the Temp @Word variable, ready for a new word
                  set @Word = ''
            end
            -- Increment the counter
            set @i = @i + 1
      end
      return @ProperCaseText
end
GO

CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[GetBSTDate] ()
RETURNS DateTime
AS
    BEGIN

        DECLARE @rtn DATETIME
        DECLARE @bst_start DATETIME
        DECLARE @bst_end DATETIME
        DECLARE @date_first INT
        DECLARE @offset INT

        SET @date_first = @@DATEFIRST

		DECLARE @date DATETIME = GETDATE()

-- clocks move forward an hour on the last Sunday of March
-- and move back again on the last Sunday of October
        SET @bst_start = CAST(CAST(YEAR(@date) AS VARCHAR(4)) + '-03' + '-31' AS DATETIME)
        SET @offset = ( DATEPART(dw, @bst_start) + @date_first - 1 ) % 7
        SET @bst_start = DATEADD(dd, -@offset, @bst_start)

        SET @bst_end = CAST(CAST(YEAR(@date) AS VARCHAR(4)) + '-10'
            + '-31 23:59:59' AS DATETIME)
        SET @offset = ( DATEPART(dw, @bst_end) + @date_first - 1 ) % 7
        SET @bst_end = DATEADD(dd, -@offset, @bst_end)

        IF @date >= @bst_start
            AND @date < @bst_end
            SET @rtn = dateadd(HOUR, 1, @date)
        ELSE
            SET @rtn = @date

        RETURN (@rtn)

    END
GO

CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[ISOweek]  (@DATE datetime)
RETURNS int
AS
BEGIN
   DECLARE @ISOweek int
   SET @ISOweek= DATEPART(wk,@DATE)+1
      -DATEPART(wk,CAST(DATEPART(yy,@DATE) as CHAR(4))+'0104')
   --Special cases: Jan 1-3 may belong to the previous year
   IF (@ISOweek=0) 
      SET @ISOweek=dbo.ISOweek(CAST(DATEPART(yy,@DATE)-1 
         AS CHAR(4))+'12'+ CAST(24+DATEPART(DAY,@DATE) AS CHAR(2)))+1
   --Special case: Dec 29-31 may belong to the next year
   IF ((DATEPART(mm,@DATE)=12) AND 
      ((DATEPART(dd,@DATE)-DATEPART(dw,@DATE))>= 28))
      SET @ISOweek=1
   RETURN(@ISOweek)
END
GO

SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE  FUNCTION [dbo].[MinutesToDuration]
(
    @minutes int 
)
RETURNS nvarchar(30)

AS
BEGIN
declare @hours  nvarchar(20)

SET @hours = 
    CASE WHEN @minutes >= 60 THEN
        (SELECT CAST((@minutes / 60) AS VARCHAR(2)) + 'h ' +  
                CASE WHEN (@minutes % 60) > 0 THEN
                    CAST((@minutes % 60) AS VARCHAR(2)) + 'm'
                ELSE
                    ''
                END)
    ELSE 
        CAST((@minutes % 60) AS VARCHAR(2)) + 'm'
    END

return @hours
END
GO
/****** Object:  UserDefinedFunction [dbo].[ProperCase]    Script Date: 02/11/2026 17:47:22 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
create function [dbo].[ProperCase](@Text as varchar(8000))
returns varchar(8000)
as
begin
  declare @Reset bit;
  declare @Ret varchar(8000);
  declare @i int;
  declare @c char(1);

  if @Text is null
    return null;

  select @Reset = 1, @i = 1, @Ret = '';

  while (@i <= len(@Text))
    select @c = substring(@Text, @i, 1),
      @Ret = @Ret + case when @Reset = 1 then UPPER(@c) else LOWER(@c) end,
      @Reset = case when @c like '[a-zA-Z]' then 0 else 1 end,
      @i = @i + 1
  return @Ret
end
GO

CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[SplitString] ( @stringToSplit VARCHAR(MAX) )
RETURNS
 @returnList TABLE ([Name] [nvarchar] (500))
AS
BEGIN

 DECLARE @name NVARCHAR(255)
 DECLARE @pos INT

 WHILE CHARINDEX(',', @stringToSplit) > 0 BEGIN
	SELECT @pos  = CHARINDEX(',', @stringToSplit)  
	SELECT @name = SUBSTRING(@stringToSplit, 1, @pos-1)

	INSERT INTO @returnList 
	SELECT @name

	SELECT @stringToSplit = SUBSTRING(@stringToSplit, @pos+1, LEN(@stringToSplit)-@pos)
 END

 INSERT INTO @returnList
 SELECT @stringToSplit

 RETURN
END
GO

CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[SplitStringByChar] ( @stringToSplit VARCHAR(MAX), @Delimiter CHAR(1) )
RETURNS
@returnList TABLE ([Name] [nvarchar] (500))
AS
BEGIN

DECLARE @name NVARCHAR(255)
DECLARE @pos INT

WHILE CHARINDEX(@Delimiter, @stringToSplit) > 0 BEGIN
      SELECT @pos  = CHARINDEX(@Delimiter, @stringToSplit)  
      SELECT @name = SUBSTRING(@stringToSplit, 1, @pos-1)

      INSERT INTO @returnList 
      SELECT @name

      SELECT @stringToSplit = SUBSTRING(@stringToSplit, @pos+1, LEN(@stringToSplit)-@pos)
END

INSERT INTO @returnList
SELECT @stringToSplit

RETURN
END
GO

/****** Object:  View [dbo].[viewPalletAuditKeyColumns]    Script Date: 02/11/2026 17:47:22 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE VIEW [dbo].[viewPalletAuditKeyColumns]
AS
	SELECT DISTINCT 
		PA.PalletAuditPK, 
		PA.StockItemFK, 
		PA.Batch, 
		PA.EventTypeFK, 
		PA.EventDate, 
		PA.EventFK, 
		PA.PalletFK,
		D.DivisionPK AS DivisionFK,
		C.CustomerPK AS CustomerFK
	FROM 
		tblPalletAudit AS PA 
	LEFT OUTER JOIN tblStockItems AS SI 
		ON PA.StockItemFK = SI.StockItemPK		
	LEFT OUTER JOIN tblDivisions AS D
		ON SI.DivisionFK = D.DivisionPK
	LEFT OUTER JOIN tblCustomers AS C
		ON D.CustomerFK = C.CustomerPK
GO

/****** Object:  View [dbo].[viewBuildingUnitBays]    Script Date: 02/11/2026 17:47:22 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO

create VIEW [dbo].[viewBuildingUnitBays]
WITH SCHEMABINDING 
AS
SELECT     
	buBays.BuildingUnitBayPK,1 as locationTypeFK, 
	CASE WHEN buRows.Translate = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ THEN 
		CASE WHEN buRows.ReverseTranslate = 1 THEN 
			buRows.TranslatedRow + RIGHT('0' + CAST((buRows.TranslateColumn - buCols.BuildingUnitColumn) AS nvarchar(10)), 2) + 
			CASE WHEN buRows.RackingTypeFK = 1 THEN 
				lower(buBays.BayLevel) 
            ELSE 
				'' 
			END 
		ELSE 
						buRows.TranslatedRow + CASE WHEN ((buCols.BuildingUnitColumn + buRows.TranslateColumn) >= 100) then
					RIGHT('0' +  CAST((buCols.BuildingUnitColumn + buRows.TranslateColumn) AS nvarchar(10)), 3)
				else RIGHT('0' +  CAST((buCols.BuildingUnitColumn + buRows.TranslateColumn) AS nvarchar(10)), 2)  end + 
			
			CASE WHEN buRows.RackingTypeFK = 1 THEN 
				lower(buBays.BayLevel) 
			ELSE 
				'' 
			END 
		END 
	ELSE buRows.Row + RIGHT('0' + CAST(buCols.BuildingUnitColumnName AS nvarchar(10)), 2) + 
		CASE WHEN buRows.RackingTypeFK = 1 THEN 
			lower(buBays.BayLevel)
		ELSE 
			''
		END 
	END AS BuildingUnitBayLocation, 
	buRows.BuildingUnitFK,  buRows.RackingTypeFK, 
	CASE WHEN buRows.Translate = 1 THEN buRows.TranslatedRow ELSE buRows.Row END AS Row, 
    CASE WHEN buRows.Translate = 1 THEN 
		CASE WHEN buRows.ReverseTranslate = 1 THEN 
			buRows.TranslateColumn - buCols.BuildingUnitColumn 
		ELSE 
			buCols.BuildingUnitColumn + buRows.TranslateColumn 
		END 
	ELSE 
		buCols.BuildingUnitColumnName
    END AS ColumnNo, 
	buBays.BayLevel, buBays.Barcode, bus.BuildingUnit, bu.BuildingName,
	CASE WHEN BuildingUnitColumnPK is NOT NULL THEN 
		BuildingUnitColumnPK 
	ELSE 
		0 
	END AS BuildingUnitCOlumnFK,
	width, Height, LocateFromLeft, BuildingPK, bus.BuildingUnitPK, buBays.IsArchived
FROM         dbo.tblBuildingUnitBays AS buBays INNER JOIN
                      dbo.tblBuildingUnitColumns AS buCols ON buCols.BuildingUnitColumnPK = buBays.BuildingUnitColumnFK INNER JOIN
                      dbo.tblBuildingUnitRows AS buRows ON buRows.BuildingUnitRowPK = buCols.BuildingUnitRowFK INNER JOIN
                      dbo.tblBuildingUnits AS bus ON bus.BuildingUnitPK = buRows.BuildingUnitFK INNER JOIN
                      dbo.tblBuildings AS bu ON bu.BuildingPK = bus.BuildingFK 
					  where bu.IsArchived=0 and bus.IsArchived=0 and buRows.IsArchived=0 and buCols.IsArchived=0 and buBays.IsArchived=0
					  
UNION
SELECT     loadingBayPK as BuildingUnitBayPK, 2 as locationTypeFK,  loadingBay AS BuildingUnitBayLocation, BuildingUnitFK, 
                      0 as RackingTypeFK, '' AS Row, -1 AS ColumnNo, '' as BayLevel, Barcode, BuildingUnit, BuildingName,
					  0  AS BuildingUnitCOlumnFK, 0 as width ,0  as height, 0 as locateFromLeft , BuildingPK, BuildingUnitPK, lb.IsArchived as IsArchived 
FROM dbo.tblLoadingBays lb INNER JOIN dbo.tblBuildingUnits ON buildingUnitPK = BuildingUnitFK
					INNER JOIN dbo.tblBuildings on BuildingFK = BuildingPK
UNION
SELECT     SetDownAreaPK as BuildingUnitBayPK,3 as locationTypeFK, SetDownArea AS BuildingUnitBayLocation, BuildingUnitFK, 
                      0 as RackingTypeFK, '' AS Row, -1 AS ColumnNo, '' as BayLevel, Barcode, BuildingUnit, BuildingName,
					  0  AS BuildingUnitCOlumnFK , 0 as width ,0  as height, 0 as locateFromLeft, BuildingPK, BuildingUnitPK, sd.IsArchived as IsArchived 
FROM dbo.tblSetDownAreas sd INNER JOIN dbo.tblBuildingUnits ON buildingUnitPK = BuildingUnitFK
					INNER JOIN dbo.tblBuildings on BuildingFK = BuildingPK
UNION
SELECT     SampleLocationPK as BuildingUnitBayPK,6 as locationTypeFK, SampleLocation AS BuildingUnitBayLocation, BuildingUnitFK, 
                      0 as RackingTypeFK, '' AS Row, -1 AS ColumnNo, '' as BayLevel, Barcode, BuildingUnit, BuildingName,
					  0  AS BuildingUnitCOlumnFK,  0 as width ,0  as height, 0 as locateFromLeft, BuildingPK, BuildingUnitPK, sl.IsArchived  as IsArchived 
FROM dbo.tblSampleLocations sl INNER JOIN dbo.tblBuildingUnits ON buildingUnitPK = BuildingUnitFK
					INNER JOIN dbo.tblBuildings on BuildingFK = BuildingPK
UNION
SELECT     FloorLocationPK as BuildingUnitBayPK, 8 as locationTypeFK,FloorLocation AS BuildingUnitBayLocation, BuildingUnitFK, 
                      0 as RackingTypeFK, '' AS Row, -1 AS ColumnNo, '' as BayLevel, Barcode, BuildingUnit, BuildingName,
					  0  AS BuildingUnitCOlumnFK,  0 as width ,0  as height, 0 as locateFromLeft, BuildingPK, BuildingUnitPK, fl.IsArchived as IsArchived 
FROM dbo.tblFloorLocations fl INNER JOIN dbo.tblBuildingUnits ON buildingUnitPK = BuildingUnitFK
					INNER JOIN dbo.tblBuildings on BuildingFK = BuildingPK
GO
/****** Object:  View [dbo].[viewpalletLooseLocations]    Script Date: 02/11/2026 17:47:22 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE VIEW [dbo].[viewpalletLooseLocations]
AS
SELECT     tpal.PalletContentPK, tpal.LooseLocationTypeFK, tpal.LooseLocationFK, CASE WHEN LooseLocationTypeFK = 1 THEN Row ELSE 'A' END AS Row, 
                      CASE WHEN LooseLocationTypeFK = 1 THEN ColumnNo ELSE 0 END AS ColumnNo, 
                      CASE WHEN LooseLocationTypeFK = 1 THEN BayLevel ELSE 'a' END AS BayLevel, 
                      CASE WHEN LooseLocationTypeFK = 1 THEN CASE WHEN vBuBay.BuildingUnitBayLocation IS NOT NULL 
                      THEN CASE WHEN rackingTypeFK = 1 THEN vBuBay.BuildingUnitBayLocation ELSE vBuBay.BuildingUnitBayLocation END ELSE 'Invalid Location' END WHEN LooseLocationTypeFK
                       = 2 THEN CASE WHEN loadingBay.LoadingBay IS NOT NULL 
                      THEN loadingBay.LoadingBay ELSE 'Invalid Location' END WHEN LooseLocationTypeFK = 3 THEN CASE WHEN SetDownArea.SetDownArea IS NOT NULL 
                      THEN SetDownArea.SetDownArea ELSE 'Invalid Location' END WHEN LooseLocationTypeFK = 6 THEN CASE WHEN SampleLocation.SampleLocation IS NOT NULL 
                      THEN SampleLocation.SampleLocation ELSE 'Invalid Location' END WHEN LooseLocationTypeFK = 8 THEN CASE WHEN FloorLocation.FloorLocation IS NOT NULL 
                      THEN FloorLocation.FloorLocation ELSE 'Invalid Location' END ELSE 'Invalid Location' END AS Location, 
                      CASE WHEN LooseLocationTypeFK = 1 THEN vBBu.BuildingName + ' ' + vBuBus.BuildingUnit WHEN LooseLocationTypeFK = 2 THEN LoadingBayBu.BuildingName + ' '
                       + LoadingBayBus.BuildingUnit WHEN LooseLocationTypeFK = 3 THEN SetDownAreaBu.BuildingName + ' ' + SetDownAreaBus.BuildingUnit WHEN LooseLocationTypeFK
                       = 6 THEN SampleLocationBu.BuildingName + ' ' + SampleLocationBus.BuildingUnit WHEN LooseLocationTypeFK = 8 THEN FloorLocationBu.BuildingName + ' ' + FloorLocationBus.BuildingUnit
                       END AS Building, CASE WHEN LooseLocationTypeFK = 1 THEN vBuBay.RackingTypeFK ELSE 0 END AS rackingTypeFK, 
                      CASE WHEN LooseLocationTypeFK = 1 THEN vBuBay.Barcode WHEN LooseLocationTypeFK = 2 THEN loadingBay.barcode WHEN LooseLocationTypeFK = 3 THEN setDownArea.barcode
                       WHEN LooseLocationTypeFK = 6 THEN sampleLocation.Barcode WHEN LooseLocationTypeFK = 8 THEN floorLocation.Barcode END AS barcode, 
                      CASE WHEN LooseLocationTypeFK = 1 THEN vBuBus.buildingunitpk WHEN LooseLocationTypeFK = 2 THEN loadingBayBus.buildingunitpk WHEN LooseLocationTypeFK
                       = 3 THEN SetDownAreaBus.buildingunitpk WHEN LooseLocationTypeFK = 6 THEN SampleLocationBus.buildingunitpk WHEN LooseLocationTypeFK = 8 THEN FloorLocationBus.buildingunitpk
                       END AS BuildingUnitFK, CASE WHEN BuildingUnitColumnFK IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE buildingUnitColumnFK END AS buildingUnitColumnFK
FROM         dbo.tblPalletContent AS tpal LEFT OUTER JOIN
                      dbo.viewBuildingUnitBays AS vBuBay ON vBuBay.BuildingUnitBayPK = tpal.LooseLocationFK LEFT OUTER JOIN
                      dbo.tblBuildingUnits AS vBuBus ON vBuBus.BuildingUnitPK = vBuBay.BuildingUnitFK LEFT OUTER JOIN
                      dbo.tblBuildings AS vBBu ON vBBu.BuildingPK = vBuBus.BuildingFK LEFT OUTER JOIN
                      dbo.tblLoadingBays AS loadingBay ON loadingBay.LoadingBayPK = tpal.LooseLocationFK LEFT OUTER JOIN
                      dbo.tblBuildingUnits AS loadingBayBus ON loadingBayBus.BuildingUnitPK = loadingBay.BuildingUnitFK LEFT OUTER JOIN
                      dbo.tblBuildings AS loadingBayBu ON loadingBayBu.BuildingPK = loadingBayBus.BuildingFK LEFT OUTER JOIN
                      dbo.tblSetDownAreas AS SetDownArea ON SetDownArea.SetDownAreaPK = tpal.LooseLocationFK LEFT OUTER JOIN
                      dbo.tblBuildingUnits AS SetDownAreaBus ON SetDownAreaBus.BuildingUnitPK = SetDownArea.BuildingUnitFK LEFT OUTER JOIN
                      dbo.tblBuildings AS SetDownAreaBu ON SetDownAreaBu.BuildingPK = SetDownAreaBus.BuildingFK LEFT OUTER JOIN
                      dbo.tblSampleLocations AS SampleLocation ON SampleLocation.SampleLocationPK = tpal.LooseLocationFK LEFT OUTER JOIN
                      dbo.tblBuildingUnits AS SampleLocationBus ON SampleLocationBus.BuildingUnitPK = SampleLocation.BuildingUnitFK LEFT OUTER JOIN
                      dbo.tblBuildings AS SampleLocationBu ON SampleLocationBu.BuildingPK = SampleLocationBus.BuildingFK LEFT OUTER JOIN
                      dbo.tblFloorLocations AS FloorLocation ON FloorLocation.FloorLocationPK = tpal.LooseLocationFK LEFT OUTER JOIN
                      dbo.tblBuildingUnits AS FloorLocationBus ON FloorLocationBus.BuildingUnitPK = FloorLocation.BuildingUnitFK LEFT OUTER JOIN
                      dbo.tblBuildings AS FloorLocationBu ON FloorLocationBu.BuildingPK = FloorLocationBus.BuildingFK
WHERE     (tpal.LooseLocationFK > 0) AND (tpal.LooseLocationTypeFK > 0)
GO

CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[fnGetContainerInGoodsNumberByContainerInPK]    
(      
  @ContainerInPK INT  
)
RETURNS TABLE
AS    
RETURN
(
   SELECT GoodsInNumber FROM tblContainerIns 
   WHERE ContainerInPk=@ContainerInPK
);

/****** Object:  View [dbo].[viewDistributionOrderLines]    Script Date: 02/11/2026 17:47:22 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE VIEW [dbo].[viewDistributionOrderLines]
AS
	SELECT Distinct DistributionOrderPK,
		StockItemCode,  
		stockItems.Description,    
		dpoi.Quantity as [UnitsOrdered],  
		Cast(COALESCE(cols.Units, 0) AS DECIMAL(6, 2)) AS [UnitsFulfilled]  
	from tblDistributionOrders do 
	inner join tblDistributionPendingOrders dpo on do.OrderReference = dpo.OrderReference
	inner join tblDistributionPendingOrderItems dpoi on dpo.DistributionPendingOrderPK = dpoi.DistributionPendingOrderFK
	inner join tblContainerOuts contOuts on contOuts.DistributionOrderFK = do.DistributionOrderPK  
	left join tblContainerOutLines cols on cols.ContainerOutFK = contOuts.ContainerOutPK and cols.StockItemFK = dpoi.StockItemFK
	left join tblStockItems stockItems on stockItems.StockItemPK = dpoi.StockItemFK
GO

/****** Object:  UserDefinedFunction [dbo].[fnGetScheduleWeekTemplatesForBuildingWithWeekTemplatePKAndWeekNumberAndYear]    Script Date: 02/11/2026 17:47:22 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO

-- SELECT * FROM fnGetScheduleWeekTemplatesForBuildingWithWeekTemplatePKAndWeekNumberAndYear(11,27,5,2026)  
  
       
-- =============================================        
-- Author:  <Archana Singh>        
-- Create date: <08/01/2024>        
-- Description: <Description,,>        
-- =============================================   
  
  
CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[fnGetScheduleWeekTemplatesForBuildingWithWeekTemplatePKAndWeekNumberAndYear](  
    @BuildingFK INT,  
    @WeekTemplatePK INT,      
    @WeekNumber INT,  
    @Year INT  
)  
RETURNS TABLE  
AS  
RETURN  
(  
   SELECT Distinct swt.BuildingFK,swt.ScheduleWeekTemplatePK, swt.[Name][ScheduleName],   
 sct.ScheduleChannelTemplatePK, sct.[Name][ChannelName], sct.ColorCode[ChannelColorCode], sct.FreeMode[ChannelFreeMode], sct.AllowInbound[ChannelInbound] , sct.AllowOutbound[ChannelOutbound],
 ISNULL(sct.ContainerOutLoadingTypeFK,-1) AS ContainerOutLoadingTypeFK,  
ISNULL(colt.ContainerOutLoadingType,'No Restriction') AS ContainerOutLoadingType,
sct.DeliveryCount[SlotDeliveryCount],        
    sdt.ScheduleDayTemplatePK, CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), sdt.[DayDate], 103) As [DayDate],sdt.DayNumber,  sdt.StartTime[DayStartTime], sdt.EndTime[DayEndTime],sdt.MaxDuration[DayDuration],      
    sst.ScheduleSlotTemplatePK, sst.StartTime[SlotStart], sst.EndTime[SlotEnd],sst.ActualDuration[SlotDuration],  
 NULL [SchedulePlaceholderTemplatePK],'' [PlaceholderComment], '' [PlaceholderColorCode],     
    NULL [CustomerFK], NULL[SupplierFK]    
 FROM TblScheduleWeekTemplates swt  
    INNER JOIN TblScheduleChannelTemplates sct ON sct.ScheduleWeekTemplateFK = swt.ScheduleWeekTemplatePK  
    INNER JOIN TblScheduleDayTemplates sdt ON sdt.ScheduleChannelTemplateFK = sct.ScheduleChannelTemplatePK  
    LEFT JOIN TblScheduleSlotTemplates sst ON sst.ScheduleDayTemplateFK = sdt.ScheduleDayTemplatePK      
   LEFT JOIN appContainerOutLoadingTypes colt ON colt.ContainerOutLoadingTypePK = sct.ContainerOutLoadingTypeFK  
   WHERE swt.ScheduleWeekTemplatePK =@WeekTemplatePK  
      AND swt.BuildingFK =@BuildingFK  
      AND swt.WeekNumber =@WeekNumber  
      AND swt.[Year] =@Year               
      AND (sct.IsArchived = 0 OR sct.IsArchived is NULL)       
      AND (swt.IsArchived = 0 OR swt.IsArchived is NULL)    
   AND (sdt.IsArchived = 0 OR sdt.IsArchived is NULL)  
  
UNION  
SELECT Distinct swt.BuildingFK,swt.ScheduleWeekTemplatePK, swt.[Name][ScheduleName],   
 sct.ScheduleChannelTemplatePK, sct.[Name][ChannelName], sct.ColorCode[ChannelColorCode], sct.FreeMode[ChannelFreeMode], sct.AllowInbound[ChannelInbound] , sct.AllowOutbound[ChannelOutbound],
ISNULL(sct.ContainerOutLoadingTypeFK,-1) AS ContainerOutLoadingTypeFK,  
ISNULL(colt.ContainerOutLoadingType,'No Restriction') AS ContainerOutLoadingType,
sct.DeliveryCount[SlotDeliveryCount],      
    sdt.ScheduleDayTemplatePK, CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), sdt.[DayDate], 103) As [DayDate],sdt.DayNumber, sdt.StartTime[DayStartTime], sdt.EndTime[DayEndTime],sdt.MaxDuration[DayDuration],     
    NULL[ScheduleSlotTemplatePK], spt.StartTime[SlotStart],spt.EndTime[SlotEnd],spt.ActualDuration[SlotDuration],  
 spt.SchedulePlaceholderTemplatePK,spt.[Description][PlaceholderComment], spt.ColorCode[PlaceholderColorCode],     
    spt.CustomerFK, spt.SupplierFK     
    FROM TblScheduleWeekTemplates swt  
    INNER JOIN TblScheduleChannelTemplates sct ON sct.ScheduleWeekTemplateFK = swt.ScheduleWeekTemplatePK  
    INNER JOIN TblScheduleDayTemplates sdt ON sdt.ScheduleChannelTemplateFK = sct.ScheduleChannelTemplatePK  
    INNER JOIN TblSchedulePlaceholderTemplates spt ON sdt.ScheduleDayTemplatePK = spt.ScheduleDayTemplateFK  
    LEFT JOIN appContainerOutLoadingTypes colt ON colt.ContainerOutLoadingTypePK = sct.ContainerOutLoadingTypeFK  
    LEFT JOIN TblCustomers c ON spt.CustomerFK = c.CustomerPK  
    LEFT JOIN TblSuppliers s ON spt.SupplierFK = s.SupplierPK  
    WHERE swt.ScheduleWeekTemplatePK =@WeekTemplatePK  
      AND swt.BuildingFK =@BuildingFK  
      AND swt.WeekNumber =@WeekNumber  
      AND swt.[Year] =@Year               
      AND (sct.IsArchived = 0 OR sct.IsArchived is NULL)       
      AND (swt.IsArchived = 0 OR swt.IsArchived is NULL)    
   AND (sdt.IsArchived = 0 OR sdt.IsArchived is NULL)  
  
);  
GO

/****** Object:  UserDefinedFunction [dbo].[fnGetScheduleClientActivitiesForTransportUser]    Script Date: 02/11/2026 17:47:22 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
-- Select * from fnGetScheduleClientActivitiesForTransportUser(11,712)  
  
-- =============================================  
-- Author: <Archana Singh>  
-- Create date: <21/05/2026>  
-- Description:  
-- Returns outbound and inbound schedule activity history visible to Transport Users.  
-- The function retrieves all  delivery activities for the selected  
-- building that belong to the logged-in transport user's transport company.  
--  
-- Transport users can view:  
--   - activities created by transport users  
--   - activities/comments created by internal users  
--   - activities/comments created by client users  
--   - outbound and inbound delivery adds, edits, removals and comments  
--  
-- Transport users cannot view:  
--   - activities belonging to other transport companies  
--   - unrelated building activities  
--  
-- Access is restricted using the transport company assigned to the  
-- logged-in transport user.  
-- =============================================  
  
CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[fnGetScheduleClientActivitiesForTransportUser]  
(  
    @BuildingFK INT,  
    @UserId INT  
)  
RETURNS TABLE  
AS  
RETURN  
(  
    WITH TransportUser AS  
    (  
        SELECT TransportCompanyFK  
        FROM tblUsers  
        WHERE UserPK = @UserId  
    ),  
  
    BaseData AS  
    (  
           SELECT DISTINCT    
            sa.ScheduleActivityPK,    
            sa.BuildingFK,      
            ap.FirstName + ' ' + ap.LastName AS Person,    
            sa.Comments,    
            sat.ScheduleActivityType,  
            sa.InsertedDate,   
            sd.ScheduleDeliveryPK,    
            sd.ContainerInFK,    
            sd.ContainerOutFK,     
            co.TransportCompanyFK     
           -- sp.SchedulePlaceholderPK   
  
        FROM tblScheduleActivities sa  
        INNER JOIN appScheduleActivityTypes sat  
            ON sa.ScheduleActivityTypeFK = sat.ScheduleActivityTypePK  
        INNER JOIN tblUsers au  
            ON sa.InsertedBy = au.UserPK  
        INNER JOIN tblPeople ap  
            ON au.PersonFK = ap.PersonPK  
        INNER JOIN tblScheduleDeliveries sd  
            ON sd.ScheduleDeliveryPK = sa.ScheduleDeliveryFK  
        LEFT JOIN tblContainerIns ci    
            ON ci.ContainerInPK = sd.ContainerInFK    
         
        LEFT JOIN tblContainerOuts co  
            ON co.ContainerOutPK = sd.ContainerOutFK  
  
        CROSS JOIN TransportUser tu     
        WHERE sa.BuildingFK = @BuildingFK  
          AND (  
             co.TransportCompanyFK = tu.TransportCompanyFK  
           OR ci.TransportCompanyFK = tu.TransportCompanyFK  
         )  
    )  
  
    SELECT  
        b.ScheduleActivityPK,  
        b.BuildingFK,  
        b.Person,  
        b.Comments,  
        b.ScheduleActivityType,  
  
        CONVERT(VARCHAR(16), b.InsertedDate, 120) AS InsertedDate,  
  
        CASE    
            -- TRANSPORT RULE    
            WHEN b.ContainerOutFK IS NOT NULL OR 
             b.ContainerInFK IS NOT NULL
             THEN 0    
            ELSE 1    
        END AS IsClientRestricted    
  
    FROM BaseData b  
);  
GO

/****** Object:  UserDefinedFunction [dbo].[fnSearchScheduleDeliveryForBuildingWithUserFk]    Script Date: 02/11/2026 17:47:22 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
                   
-- SELECT * FROM [dbo].[fnSearchScheduleDeliveryForBuildingWithUserFk](3,663) Order by ScheduleDeliveryPK desc
-- =============================================                    
-- Author:  <Archana Singh>                    
-- Create date: <09/10/2024>                    
-- Description: <Description,,>                    
-- =============================================                    
              
CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[fnSearchScheduleDeliveryForBuildingWithUserFk]                  
(                    
  @BuildingFK INT, 
  @UserFK INT    
)              
RETURNS TABLE              
AS                  
RETURN   
( 
 
 
 Select IsClientRestricted, ScheduleDeliveryPK,DeliverySlotFK ,
	 case when isClientRestricted=1 then 'Hidden Info' ELSE DeliveryDescription end as DeliveryDescription, 
	 DeliveryDate,
	 DeliveryStartTime,     
	 DeliveryEndTime,     
	 DeliveryDuration,              
	 DeliveryType,                  
	 DeliveryContainerFK,          
	 case when isClientRestricted=1 then 'Hidden Info' ELSE DocketNumber end as DocketNumber,      
	 case when IsClientRestricted=1 then 'Hidden Info' ELSE DocketSupplier end as DocketSupplier,      
	 case when IsClientRestricted=1 then 'Hidden Info' ELSE DocketDivision end as DocketDivision,     
	 LoadingBay,               
	 DocketDate,       
	 case when IsClientRestricted=1 then 'Hidden Info' ELSE CustomerRef end as CustomerRef,      
	 case when IsClientRestricted=1 then 'Hidden Info' ELSE ContainerNumber end as ContainerNumber,        
	 case when IsClientRestricted=1 then 'Hidden Info' ELSE LorryNumber end as LorryNumber,        
	 case when IsClientRestricted=1 then 'Hidden Info' ELSE SealNumber end as SealNumber,      
	 DeliveryIsArchived ,DeliveryStatus  
   FROM    
   (    
	   SELECT DISTINCT d.DivisionPK Indiv, d2.DivisionPK OutDiv, ud.DivisionFK,    
		 case when ScheduleDeliveryPK IS NULL or u.UserTypeFK = 1 then      
		  0--empty slot - show    
		  ELSE--we have a scheduled delivery - check if user should see it    
		   case when ud.DivisionFK IS NULL then     
		   1--schdeuled delivery not matching this user division - restrict       
		   ELSE    
		   0--matches - let them see this info        
		  end    
		 end as IsClientRestricted, sdel.ScheduleDeliveryPK,sdel.ScheduleSlotFK[DeliverySlotFK],
		 sdel.[Description][DeliveryDescription], CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), sd.DayDate, 103) As [DeliveryDate], sdel.StartTime[DeliveryStartTime], sdel.EndTime[DeliveryEndTime], sdel.ActualDuration[DeliveryDuration],              
			  case when sdel.ContainerInFK > 0 then 'Inbound' when sdel.ContainerOutFK > 0 then 'Outbound' ELSE NULL end as DeliveryType,              
			  case when sdel.ContainerInFK > 0 then sdel.ContainerInFK when sdel.ContainerOutFK > 0 then sdel.ContainerOutFK ELSE -1 end as DeliveryContainerFK,              
			  case when sdel.ContainerInFK > 0 then ci.GoodsInNumber ELSE co.GoodsOrderNumber end as DocketNumber,                      
			  case when sdel.ContainerInFK > 0 then InboundSup.Supplier ELSE '' end as DocketSupplier,               
			  case when sdel.ContainerInFK > 0 then d.DivisionCode ELSE d2.DivisionCode end as DocketDivision,               
			  case when sdel.ContainerInFK > 0 then Inboundlb.LoadingBay ELSE Outboundlb.LoadingBay end as LoadingBay,               
			  case when sdel.ContainerInFK > 0 then CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), cast(ci.datein as Date), 103) ELSE CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), cast(co.CollectionDate as Date), 103) end as DocketDate,              
			  case when sdel.ContainerInFK > 0 then case when cdis.CustomerDocketIdentificationPK IS NOT NULL then               
			  case cdis.FieldFK                 
					  when 1 then ci.Free1                
					  when 2 then ci.Free2                
					  when 3 then ci.Free3                
					  when 4 then ci.Free4                
					  when 5 then ci.Free5                
					  ELSE ' ' end                
					 + ' '  + case  cdis.Field2FK                 
					  when 1 then ci.Free1                
					  when 2 then ci.Free2                
					  when 3 then ci.Free3                
					  when 4 then ci.Free4                
					  when 5 then ci.Free5                
					  ELSE ' ' end                
					 + ' '  + case  cdis.Field3FK                 
					  when 1 then ci.Free1                
					  when 2 then ci.Free2                
					  when 3 then ci.Free3                
					  when 4 then ci.Free4                
					  when 5 then ci.Free5                
					  ELSE  ' ' end               
				   ELSE ' ' end               
					  + ' '  +              
					  CASE WHEN  ci.ExternalReference <> '' THEN ci.ExternalReference ELSE ' ' end               
				  ELSE              
					  case when cdis2.CustomerDocketIdentificationPK IS NULL then               
				   case when co.Docketlabel1 <> '' THEN               
					co.Docketlabel1 + ': ' + co.DocketValue1 ELSE '' end + ' ' +              
				   case when co.Docketlabel2 <> '''' THEN               
					co.Docketlabel2 + ': ' + co.DocketValue2 ELSE '' end + ' ' +              
				   case when co.Docketlabel3 <> '' THEN               
					co.Docketlabel3 + ': ' + co.DocketValue3 ELSE '' end + ''               
				   ELSE              
				   case cdis2.FieldFK when 40 then              
					 cdis2.Prefix + ' ' + co.DocketValue1              
				   when 41 then              
					 cdis2.Prefix + ' ' + co.DocketValue2              
				   when 42 then              
					 cdis2.Prefix + ' ' + co.DocketValue3              
				   end            
				   + ' ' +              
				   case cdis2.Field2FK when 40 then              
					 cdis2.Prefix2 + ' ' + co.DocketValue1              
				   when 41 then              
					 cdis2.Prefix2 + ' ' + co.DocketValue2              
				   when 42 then              
					 cdis2.Prefix2 + ' ' + co.DocketValue3              
				   ELSE ''              
				   END              
				  End              
				  END as CustomerRef,
	     case when sdel.ContainerInFK > 0 then ci.[ContainerNumber] when sdel.ContainerOutFK > 0 then co.[ContainerNumber] ELSE '' end as ContainerNumber,              
		 case when sdel.ContainerInFK > 0 then ci.[LorryNumber] when sdel.ContainerOutFK > 0 then co.[LorryNumber] ELSE '' end as LorryNumber,              
		 case when sdel.ContainerInFK > 0 then ci.[SealNumber] when sdel.ContainerOutFK > 0 then co.[SealNumber] ELSE '' end as SealNumber,              
		 Cast(sdel.IsArchived as INT)[DeliveryIsArchived],  
		  case when sdel.ContainerInFK > 0 then   
		 sist.StockInStatus   
		   when sdel.ContainerOutFK > 0 then   
			case when co.ContainerOutStageFK in (1,2) then 'Pending'   
		 when co.ContainerOutStageFK in (3,4,5,6,7) then 'InProgress'  
		 ELSE 'Completed' end  
		   ELSE '' end as DeliveryStatus     
	  FROM  [dbo].[tblScheduleWeeks] sw           
	  INNER JOIN [dbo].[tblScheduleChannels] sc ON sw.ScheduleWeekPK = sc.ScheduleWeekFK          
	  INNER JOIN [dbo].[tblScheduleDays] sd ON sc.ScheduleChannelPK = sd.ScheduleChannelFK           
	  INNER JOIN [dbo].[tblScheduleSlots] ss ON sd.ScheduleDayPK = ss.ScheduleDayFK            
	  LEFT JOIN tblScheduleDeliveries sdel ON sdel.ScheduleSlotFK = ss.ScheduleSlotPK  AND sdel.IsArchived=0               
	  LEFT JOIN tblContainerIns ci ON sdel.ContainerInFK = ci.ContainerInPK                
	  LEFT JOIN tblStockIns si ON ci.ContainerInPK = si.ContainerInFK        
	  left join appStockInStatus sist on sist.StockInStatusPK = si.StockInStatusFK  
	  LEFT JOIN tbldivisions d ON si.DivisionFK = d.DivisionPK              
	  LEft Join tblcustomers c on d.CustomerFK = c.CustomerPK  
	  LEFT JOIN tblSuppliers InboundSup ON ci.SupplierFK = InboundSup.SupplierPK              
	  LEFT JOIN tblloadingbays Inboundlb ON ci.LoadingBayFK = Inboundlb.LoadingBayPK              
	  LEFT OUTER JOIN tblCustomerDocketIdentifications cdis ON cdis.CustomerFK = d.CustomerFK AND cdis.DocketTypeFK = 1              
	  LEFT JOIN tblContainerOuts co ON sdel.ContainerOutFk = co.ContainerOutPK              
	  LEFT JOIN tblContainerOutLines col ON col.ContainerOutFK = co.ContainerOutPK              
	  LEFT JOIN tblDivisions d2 ON d2.DivisionPK = col.DivisionFK        
	  LEft Join tblcustomers c2 on d2.CustomerFK = c2.CustomerPK           
	  LEFT JOIN tblStockOrders so ON co.ContainerOutPK = so.ContainerOutFK              
	  LEFT JOIN tblloadingbays Outboundlb ON so.PickupLoadingBayFK = Outboundlb.LoadingBayPK              
	  LEFT OUTER JOIN tblCustomerDocketIdentifications cdis2 ON cdis2.CustomerFK = d2.CustomerFK AND cdis2.DocketTypeFK = 2      
	  LEFT JOIN tblusers u on u.UserPK = @userfk    
	  LEFT JOIN tblUserDivisions ud on ud.UserFK = @userfk and (d.DivisionPK = ud.DivisionFK or d2.DivisionPK = ud.DivisionFK)    
	  WHERE sw.BuildingFK =@BuildingFK 
	  AND sdel.ScheduleDeliveryPK IS NOT NULL   
	  AND (sdel.IsArchived = 0 OR sdel.IsArchived IS NULL)     
	  )SD
)
GO
