/****** Object:  View [dbo].[viewStockLevels]    Script Date: 02/11/2026 17:47:22 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
/*exec spStockLevelsSync*/
CREATE VIEW [dbo].[viewStockLevels]
AS
SELECT s.StockItemCode + (case when s.isarchived = 1 then '_Archived' else '' end) as StockItemCode, s.StockItemPK, COALESCE (sl.Batch, 'NA') AS Batch, 
d.DivisionCode, d.DivisionPK, c.CustomerCode, c.CustomerPK, 
COALESCE (SUM(sl.AvailableUnits), 0) AS AvailableUnits, 
COALESCE (SUM(sl.ActualUnits), 0) AS ActualUnits, 
--COALESCE (SUM(sl.AvailableUnits) - 
--CASE WHEN pendingOrders.stockitemfk IS NULL THEN 0
--ELSE SUM(pendingOrders.Quantity) END, 0) AS AvailableUnitsExcludingPending
COALESCE (SUM(sl.AvailableUnits) 
	- CASE WHEN pendingOrders.stockitemfk IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE SUM(pendingOrders.Quantity) END, 0) 
	- CASE WHEN unavailableStock.ActualUnits IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE unavailableStock.ActualUnits END 
	AS AvailableUnitsExcludingPending
FROM dbo.tblStockItems AS s 
LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.tblStockLevels AS sl 
ON sl.StockItemFK = s.StockItemPK 
INNER JOIN dbo.tblDivisions AS d 
ON d.DivisionPK = s.DivisionFK 
INNER JOIN  dbo.tblCustomers AS c 
ON c.CustomerPK = d.CustomerFK 
LEFT OUTER JOIN
(SELECT DISTINCT dpoi.StockItemFK, SUM(dpoi.Quantity) AS Quantity
     FROM dbo.tblDistributionPendingOrderItems AS dpoi 
	 INNER JOIN dbo.tblDistributionPendingOrders AS dpo 
	 ON dpo.DistributionPendingOrderPK = dpoi.DistributionPendingOrderFK
     WHERE   (dpo.Imported = 0)
     GROUP BY dpoi.StockItemFK) AS pendingOrders 
	 ON pendingOrders.StockItemFK = sl.StockItemFK
LEFT OUTER JOIN (
	SELECT 
	stockitemfk, sum(pc.actualunits) ActualUnits
   from tblpalletcontent AS pc   
   inner join tblpallets p on pc.palletfk = p.palletpk
   WHERE  p.IsArchived = 0  AND p.stockinstatusfk = 3  and p.PalletStatusFK <> 1 
   group by stockitemfk
) AS unavailableStock ON unavailableStock.StockItemFK = sl.StockItemFK
GROUP BY s.StockItemCode, s.isarchived, s.StockItemPK, sl.Batch, pendingOrders.StockItemFK, d.DivisionCode, d.DivisionPK, c.CustomerCode, c.CustomerPK, unavailableStock.ActualUnits
GO
/****** Object:  UserDefinedFunction [dbo].[fnMobileGetBuildingUnitBayDetails]    Script Date: 02/11/2026 17:47:22 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
-- Retireve the following fields
-- BuildingUnitBays - BuildingUnitBayPK (locationFK for Pallet)
--                  - width
--                  - height
-- Location         - caluclated from a range of tables
-- BuildingUnitRow  - lefttoright
--                  - racking type  (conventional / drive through)
--
-- Modify:	Damien Gannon #dev-910 Exclude Archived Bays/Columns/Rows

CREATE  FUNCTION [dbo].[fnMobileGetBuildingUnitBayDetails] (@barcode varchar(30))
RETURNS TABLE AS
RETURN (SELECT tbuB.buildingunitbayPK as locationFK,
			tbuB.width, 
			tbuB.height,
			case when tbuR.Translate = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ then 
				tbuR.TranslatedRow 
			else 
				tbuR.Row
			end 
			 + right('0' + cast(case when tbuR.Translate = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ then 
									case when tbuR.ReverseTranslate = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ then 
										tbuR.TranslateColumn - tbuC.BuildingUnitColumn 
									else 
										tbuC.BuildingUnitColumn + tbuR.TranslateColumn 
									end 
								else tbuC.BuildingUnitColumn 
								end as nvarchar(10)),2) + 
			case when tbuR.rackingtypeFK = 1 then LOWER(tbuB.BayLevel) else ''end  as Location,
			tbuB.BuildingUnitColumnFK as ColumnFK,
			tbuR.LocateFromLeft,
			tbuR.rackingtypeFK as RackingType
 from tblBuildingUnitBays tbuB 
      inner join tblBuildingUnitColumns tbuC on tbuC.BuildingUnitColumnPK = tbuB.BuildingUnitColumnFK
      inner join tblBuildingUnitRows tbuR on tbuR.BuildingUnitRowPK = tbuC.BuildingUnitRowFK
 where tbuB.Barcode = @barcode And tbuB.IsArchived = 0) /* #dev-910 Exclude Archived Bays */
GO
/****** Object:  UserDefinedFunction [dbo].[fnSearchScheduleDeliveryForBuildingForTransportUser]    Script Date: 02/11/2026 17:47:22 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
                     
-- SELECT * FROM [dbo].[fnSearchScheduleDeliveryForBuildingForTransportUser](11,712) Order by ScheduleDeliveryPK desc  
-- =============================================                      
-- Author:  <Archana Singh>                      
-- Create date: <12/06/2026>                      
-- Description: <Description,,>                      
-- =============================================                      
                
CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[fnSearchScheduleDeliveryForBuildingForTransportUser]                    
(                      
  @BuildingFK INT,   
  @UserFK INT      
)                
RETURNS TABLE                
AS                    
RETURN     
(   
 Select IsClientRestricted, ScheduleDeliveryPK,DeliverySlotFK ,  
  case when isClientRestricted=1 then 'Hidden Info' ELSE DeliveryDescription end as DeliveryDescription,   
  DeliveryDate,  
  DeliveryStartTime,       
  DeliveryEndTime,       
  DeliveryDuration,                
  DeliveryType,                    
  DeliveryContainerFK,            
  case when isClientRestricted=1 then 'Hidden Info' ELSE DocketNumber end as DocketNumber,        
  case when IsClientRestricted=1 then 'Hidden Info' ELSE DocketSupplier end as DocketSupplier,        
  case when IsClientRestricted=1 then 'Hidden Info' ELSE DocketDivision end as DocketDivision,       
  LoadingBay,                 
  DocketDate,         
  case when IsClientRestricted=1 then 'Hidden Info' ELSE CustomerRef end as CustomerRef,        
  case when IsClientRestricted=1 then 'Hidden Info' ELSE ContainerNumber end as ContainerNumber,          
  case when IsClientRestricted=1 then 'Hidden Info' ELSE LorryNumber end as LorryNumber,          
  case when IsClientRestricted=1 then 'Hidden Info' ELSE SealNumber end as SealNumber,        
  DeliveryIsArchived ,DeliveryStatus    
   FROM      
   (      
    SELECT DISTINCT d.DivisionPK Indiv, d2.DivisionPK OutDiv, ud.DivisionFK,      
    CASE     
        WHEN u.TransportCompanyFK = co.TransportCompanyFK THEN 0 -- scheduled delivery matching this user  
        ELSE 1                        
     END AS IsClientRestricted,     
    sdel.ScheduleDeliveryPK,sdel.ScheduleSlotFK[DeliverySlotFK],  
   sdel.[Description][DeliveryDescription], CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), sd.DayDate, 103) As [DeliveryDate], sdel.StartTime[DeliveryStartTime], sdel.EndTime[DeliveryEndTime], sdel.ActualDuration[DeliveryDuration],                
     case when sdel.ContainerInFK > 0 then 'Inbound' when sdel.ContainerOutFK > 0 then 'Outbound' ELSE NULL end as DeliveryType,                
     case when sdel.ContainerInFK > 0 then sdel.ContainerInFK when sdel.ContainerOutFK > 0 then sdel.ContainerOutFK ELSE -1 end as DeliveryContainerFK,                
     case when sdel.ContainerInFK > 0 then ci.GoodsInNumber ELSE co.GoodsOrderNumber end as DocketNumber,                        
     case when sdel.ContainerInFK > 0 then InboundSup.Supplier ELSE '' end as DocketSupplier,                 
     case when sdel.ContainerInFK > 0 then d.DivisionCode ELSE d2.DivisionCode end as DocketDivision,                 
     case when sdel.ContainerInFK > 0 then Inboundlb.LoadingBay ELSE Outboundlb.LoadingBay end as LoadingBay,                 
     case when sdel.ContainerInFK > 0 then CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), cast(ci.datein as Date), 103) ELSE CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), cast(co.CollectionDate as Date), 103) end as DocketDate,                
     case when sdel.ContainerInFK > 0 then case when cdis.CustomerDocketIdentificationPK IS NOT NULL then                 
     case cdis.FieldFK                   
       when 1 then ci.Free1                  
       when 2 then ci.Free2                  
       when 3 then ci.Free3                  
       when 4 then ci.Free4                  
       when 5 then ci.Free5                  
       ELSE ' ' end                  
      + ' '  + case  cdis.Field2FK                   
       when 1 then ci.Free1                  
       when 2 then ci.Free2                  
       when 3 then ci.Free3                  
       when 4 then ci.Free4                  
       when 5 then ci.Free5                  
       ELSE ' ' end                  
      + ' '  + case  cdis.Field3FK                   
       when 1 then ci.Free1                  
       when 2 then ci.Free2                  
       when 3 then ci.Free3                  
       when 4 then ci.Free4                  
       when 5 then ci.Free5                  
       ELSE  ' ' end                 
       ELSE ' ' end                 
       + ' '  +                
       CASE WHEN  ci.ExternalReference <> '' THEN ci.ExternalReference ELSE ' ' end                 
      ELSE                
       case when cdis2.CustomerDocketIdentificationPK IS NULL then                 
       case when co.Docketlabel1 <> '' THEN                 
     co.Docketlabel1 + ': ' + co.DocketValue1 ELSE '' end + ' ' +                
       case when co.Docketlabel2 <> '''' THEN                 
     co.Docketlabel2 + ': ' + co.DocketValue2 ELSE '' end + ' ' +                
       case when co.Docketlabel3 <> '' THEN                 
     co.Docketlabel3 + ': ' + co.DocketValue3 ELSE '' end + ''                 
       ELSE                
       case cdis2.FieldFK when 40 then                
      cdis2.Prefix + ' ' + co.DocketValue1                
       when 41 then                
      cdis2.Prefix + ' ' + co.DocketValue2                
       when 42 then                
      cdis2.Prefix + ' ' + co.DocketValue3                
       end              
       + ' ' +                
       case cdis2.Field2FK when 40 then                
      cdis2.Prefix2 + ' ' + co.DocketValue1                
       when 41 then                
      cdis2.Prefix2 + ' ' + co.DocketValue2                
       when 42 then                
      cdis2.Prefix2 + ' ' + co.DocketValue3                
       ELSE ''                
       END                
      End                
      END as CustomerRef,  
      case when sdel.ContainerInFK > 0 then ci.[ContainerNumber] when sdel.ContainerOutFK > 0 then co.[ContainerNumber] ELSE '' end as ContainerNumber,                
   case when sdel.ContainerInFK > 0 then ci.[LorryNumber] when sdel.ContainerOutFK > 0 then co.[LorryNumber] ELSE '' end as LorryNumber,                
   case when sdel.ContainerInFK > 0 then ci.[SealNumber] when sdel.ContainerOutFK > 0 then co.[SealNumber] ELSE '' end as SealNumber,                
   Cast(sdel.IsArchived as INT)[DeliveryIsArchived],    
    case when sdel.ContainerInFK > 0 then     
   sist.StockInStatus     
     when sdel.ContainerOutFK > 0 then     
   case when co.ContainerOutStageFK in (1,2) then 'Pending'     
   when co.ContainerOutStageFK in (3,4,5,6,7) then 'InProgress'    
   ELSE 'Completed' end    
     ELSE '' end as DeliveryStatus       
   FROM  [dbo].[tblScheduleWeeks] sw             
   INNER JOIN [dbo].[tblScheduleChannels] sc ON sw.ScheduleWeekPK = sc.ScheduleWeekFK            
   INNER JOIN [dbo].[tblScheduleDays] sd ON sc.ScheduleChannelPK = sd.ScheduleChannelFK             
   INNER JOIN [dbo].[tblScheduleSlots] ss ON sd.ScheduleDayPK = ss.ScheduleDayFK              
   LEFT JOIN tblScheduleDeliveries sdel ON sdel.ScheduleSlotFK = ss.ScheduleSlotPK  AND sdel.IsArchived=0                 
   LEFT JOIN tblContainerIns ci ON sdel.ContainerInFK = ci.ContainerInPK                  
   LEFT JOIN tblStockIns si ON ci.ContainerInPK = si.ContainerInFK          
   left join appStockInStatus sist on sist.StockInStatusPK = si.StockInStatusFK    
   LEFT JOIN tbldivisions d ON si.DivisionFK = d.DivisionPK                
   LEft Join tblcustomers c on d.CustomerFK = c.CustomerPK    
   LEFT JOIN tblSuppliers InboundSup ON ci.SupplierFK = InboundSup.SupplierPK                
   LEFT JOIN tblloadingbays Inboundlb ON ci.LoadingBayFK = Inboundlb.LoadingBayPK                
   LEFT OUTER JOIN tblCustomerDocketIdentifications cdis ON cdis.CustomerFK = d.CustomerFK AND cdis.DocketTypeFK = 1                
   LEFT JOIN tblContainerOuts co ON sdel.ContainerOutFk = co.ContainerOutPK                
   LEFT JOIN tblContainerOutLines col ON col.ContainerOutFK = co.ContainerOutPK                
   LEFT JOIN tblDivisions d2 ON d2.DivisionPK = col.DivisionFK          
   LEft Join tblcustomers c2 on d2.CustomerFK = c2.CustomerPK             
   LEFT JOIN tblStockOrders so ON co.ContainerOutPK = so.ContainerOutFK                
   LEFT JOIN tblloadingbays Outboundlb ON so.PickupLoadingBayFK = Outboundlb.LoadingBayPK                
   LEFT OUTER JOIN tblCustomerDocketIdentifications cdis2 ON cdis2.CustomerFK = d2.CustomerFK AND cdis2.DocketTypeFK = 2        
   LEFT JOIN tblusers u on u.UserPK = @userfk      
   LEFT JOIN tblUserDivisions ud on ud.UserFK = @userfk and (d.DivisionPK = ud.DivisionFK or d2.DivisionPK = ud.DivisionFK)      
   WHERE sw.BuildingFK =@BuildingFK   
   AND sdel.ScheduleDeliveryPK IS NOT NULL     
   AND (sdel.IsArchived = 0 OR sdel.IsArchived IS NULL)       
   )SD  
   WHERE IsClientRestricted = 0
)  
GO
/****** Object:  UserDefinedFunction [dbo].[fnMobileGetPalletDetails]    Script Date: 02/11/2026 17:47:22 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON

-- If LocationFK is passed in - Gets a list of all the pallets in the Bay
-- If barcode is passed in - gets the relevant pallet and returns its details 
-- BuildingUnitBays - PalletPK 
--                  - bayPosition
--                  - palletStart
--                  - palletEnd
--					- batch
--                  - StockItemPK
--                  - Stackable
--                  - MinimumStockLevel
--                  - MaximumStockLevel
-- Location         - caluclated from a range of tables
-- BuildingUnitRow  - lefttoright
--                  - racking type  (conventional / drive through)
CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[fnMobileGetPalletDetails] (@LocationFK INT, @barcode varchar(30))
RETURNS TABLE AS
RETURN (SELECT palletPk, bayposition, palletstart, palletend, 
                batch, StockItemPK as Stockitem, isstackable as Stackable  ,
                tSoi.MinimumStockLevel , tSoi.MaximumStockLevel 
	FROM tblPallets tPal
    inner join tblPalletContent tPac on tPac.palletFK = tPal.palletPK
	inner join tblStockItems tSoi on tSoi.stockItemPK = tPac.stockItemFK 
    inner join tblBuildingUnitBays tBub on tBub.buildingUnitBayPK = tPal.locationFK
	where tPal.locationFK = @locationFK OR tPal.Barcode = @Barcode)
GO

/****** Object:  UserDefinedFunction [dbo].[fnGetScheduleWeekByScheduleWeekTemplateFK]    Script Date: 02/11/2026 17:47:22 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON

-- SELECT * FROM [dbo].[fnGetScheduleWeekByScheduleWeekTemplateFK](33,663)   
-- SELECT * FROM [dbo].[fnGetScheduleWeekByScheduleWeekTemplateFK](32,663) 
-- SELECT * FROM [dbo].[fnGetScheduleWeekByScheduleWeekTemplateFK](7,180)     
-- SELECT * FROM [dbo].[fnGetScheduleWeekByScheduleWeekTemplateFK](7,271)     
                                   
-- =============================================                      
-- Author:  <Archana Singh>                      
-- Create date: <08/03/2024>                      
-- Description: <Description,,>                      
-- =============================================                      
                
CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[fnGetScheduleWeekByScheduleWeekTemplateFK]                    
(                      
  @ScheduleWeekTemplateFK INT,    
  @UserFK INT      
)                
RETURNS TABLE                
AS                    
RETURN     
( 
 SELECT  IsClientRestricted,      
 ScheduleWeekPK,     
 ScheduleName,    
 ScheduleChannelPK,      
 ChannelName,       
 ChannelColorCode,       
 ChannelFreeMode,      
 ChannelInbound,      
 ChannelOutbound,   
 ContainerOutLoadingTypeFK,
 ContainerOutLoadingType,
 DeliveryContainerOutLoadingTypeFK,
 DeliveryContainerOutLoadingType,
 SlotDeliveryCount,      
 ScheduleDayPK,       
 DayDate,      
 DayNumber,    
 DayStartTime,       
 DayEndTime,        
 DayDuration,      
 ScheduleSlotPK,      
 SchedulePlaceholderPK,       
 SlotStart,       
 SlotEnd,       
 SlotDuration,      
 PlaceholderTitle,      
 PlaceholderColorCode,      
 ScheduleDeliveryPK,      
 case when isClientRestricted=1 then 'Hidden Info' else DeliveryDescription end as DeliveryDescription,       
 DeliveryStartTime,       
 DeliveryEndTime,       
 DeliveryDuration,                
 DeliveryType,                    
 DeliveryContainerFK,             
 case when isClientRestricted=1 then 'Hidden Info' else DocketNumber end as DocketNumber,        
 case when IsClientRestricted=1 then 'Hidden Info' else DocketSupplier end as DocketSupplier,        
 case when IsClientRestricted=1 then 'Hidden Info' else DocketDivision end as DocketDivision,       
 LoadingBay,                 
 DocketDate,         
 case when IsClientRestricted=1 then 'Hidden Info' else CustomerRef end as CustomerRef,        
 case when IsClientRestricted=1 then 'Hidden Info' else ContainerNumber end as ContainerNumber,          
 case when IsClientRestricted=1 then 'Hidden Info' else LorryNumber end as LorryNumber,          
 case when IsClientRestricted=1 then 'Hidden Info' else SealNumber end as SealNumber,        
 case when IsClientRestricted=1 then 'Hidden Info' ELSE ShippingCompany end as ShippingCompany,   
  case when IsClientRestricted=1 then 'Hidden Info' ELSE TransportCompany end as TransportCompany,   
 DeliveryIsArchived ,DeliveryStatus, CustomerCutoff, DeliveryPastCutOff    
 FROM      
 (      
   SELECT DISTINCT d.DivisionPK Indiv, d2.DivisionPK OutDiv, ud.DivisionFK,      
  case when ScheduleDeliveryPK IS NULL or u.UserTypeFK = 1 then        
  0--empty slot - show      
  else--we have a scheduled delivery - check if user should see it      
   case when ud.DivisionFK IS NULL then       
   1--schdeuled delivery not matching this user division - restrict         
   else      
   0--matches - let them see this info          
  end      
 end as IsClientRestricted, sw.ScheduleWeekPK,sw.Name[ScheduleName], sc.ScheduleChannelPK, sc.[Name][ChannelName], sc.ColorCode[ChannelColorCode],   
 sc.FreeMode[ChannelFreeMode],sc.AllowInbound[ChannelInbound] , sc.AllowOutbound[ChannelOutbound],
 
    -- Channel delivery type
    ISNULL(sc.ContainerOutLoadingTypeFK,-1) AS ContainerOutLoadingTypeFK,  
    ISNULL(colt.ContainerOutLoadingType,'No Restriction') AS ContainerOutLoadingType,
    
    -- Actual delivery/container-out type
    CASE 
      WHEN sdel.ContainerOutFK > 0 
        THEN ISNULL(coloading.ContainerOutLoadingTypeFK, -1)
       ELSE -1
     END AS DeliveryContainerOutLoadingTypeFK,

    CASE 
      WHEN sdel.ContainerOutFK > 0 
        THEN ISNULL(dcolt.ContainerOutLoadingType, 'No Restriction')
      ELSE 'No Restriction'
   END AS DeliveryContainerOutLoadingType,   

 sc.DeliveryCount[SlotDeliveryCount],                 
 sd.ScheduleDayPK, CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), sd.DayDate, 103) As [DayDate],sd.DayNumber,sd.StartTime[DayStartTime], sd.EndTime[DayEndTime],  sd.MaxDuration[DayDuration]           
 ,ss.ScheduleSlotPK,-1 SchedulePlaceholderPK, ss.StartTime[SlotStart], ss.EndTime[SlotEnd], ss.ActualDuration[SlotDuration]              
 ,''[PlaceholderTitle], ''[PlaceholderColorCode],               
    sdel.ScheduleDeliveryPK, sdel.[Description][DeliveryDescription], sdel.StartTime[DeliveryStartTime], sdel.EndTime[DeliveryEndTime], sdel.ActualDuration[DeliveryDuration],                
      case when sdel.ContainerInFK > 0 then 'Inbound' when sdel.ContainerOutFK > 0 then 'Outbound' else NULL end as DeliveryType,                
      case when sdel.ContainerInFK > 0 then sdel.ContainerInFK when sdel.ContainerOutFK > 0 then sdel.ContainerOutFK else -1 end as DeliveryContainerFK,                
      case when sdel.ContainerInFK > 0 then ci.GoodsInNumber else co.GoodsOrderNumber end as DocketNumber,                        
    case when sdel.ContainerInFK > 0 then InboundSup.Supplier else '' end as DocketSupplier,                 
      case when sdel.ContainerInFK > 0 then d.DivisionCode else d2.DivisionCode end as DocketDivision,                 
      case when sdel.ContainerInFK > 0 then Inboundlb.LoadingBay else Outboundlb.LoadingBay end as LoadingBay,                 
      case when sdel.ContainerInFK > 0 then CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), cast(ci.datein as Date), 103) else CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), cast(co.CollectionDate as Date), 103) end as DocketDate,                
      case when sdel.ContainerInFK > 0 then case when cdis.CustomerDocketIdentificationPK IS NOT NULL then                 
      case cdis.FieldFK                   
              when 1 then ci.Free1                  
              when 2 then ci.Free2                  
              when 3 then ci.Free3                  
              when 4 then ci.Free4                  
              when 5 then ci.Free5                  
              ELSE ' ' end                  
             + ' '  + case  cdis.Field2FK                   
              when 1 then ci.Free1                  
              when 2 then ci.Free2                  
              when 3 then ci.Free3                  
              when 4 then ci.Free4                  
              when 5 then ci.Free5                  
              else ' ' end                  
             + ' '  + case  cdis.Field3FK                   
              when 1 then ci.Free1                  
              when 2 then ci.Free2                  
              when 3 then ci.Free3                  
              when 4 then ci.Free4                  
              when 5 then ci.Free5                  
              else  ' ' end                 
           else ' ' end                 
              + ' '  +                
              CASE WHEN  ci.ExternalReference <> '' THEN ci.ExternalReference ELSE ' ' end                 
          else                
              case when cdis2.CustomerDocketIdentificationPK IS NULL then                 
           case when co.Docketlabel1 <> '' THEN                 
            co.Docketlabel1 + ': ' + co.DocketValue1 else '' end + ' ' +                
           case when co.Docketlabel2 <> '''' THEN                 
            co.Docketlabel2 + ': ' + co.DocketValue2 else '' end + ' ' +                
           case when co.Docketlabel3 <> '' THEN                 
            co.Docketlabel3 + ': ' + co.DocketValue3 else '' end + ''                 
           else                
           case cdis2.FieldFK when 40 then                
             cdis2.Prefix + ' ' + co.DocketValue1                
           when 41 then                
             cdis2.Prefix + ' ' + co.DocketValue2                
           when 42 then                
             cdis2.Prefix + ' ' + co.DocketValue3                
           end              
           + ' ' +                
           case cdis2.Field2FK when 40 then                
             cdis2.Prefix2 + ' ' + co.DocketValue1                
           when 41 then                
             cdis2.Prefix2 + ' ' + co.DocketValue2                
           when 42 then                
             cdis2.Prefix2 + ' ' + co.DocketValue3                
           else ''                
           END                
          End                
          END as CustomerRef,               
 case when sdel.ContainerInFK > 0 then ci.[ContainerNumber] when sdel.ContainerOutFK > 0 then co.[ContainerNumber] else '' end as ContainerNumber,                
 case when sdel.ContainerInFK > 0 then ci.[LorryNumber] when sdel.ContainerOutFK > 0 then co.[LorryNumber] else '' end as LorryNumber,                
 case when sdel.ContainerInFK > 0 then ci.[SealNumber] when sdel.ContainerOutFK > 0 then co.[SealNumber] else '' end as SealNumber,                
 CASE   
    WHEN sdel.ContainerInFK > 0 THEN   
        CASE WHEN scs.ShippingCompany IS NULL THEN '' ELSE scs.ShippingCompany END  
    WHEN sdel.ContainerOutFK > 0 THEN   
        CASE WHEN shp.ShippingCompany IS NULL THEN '' ELSE shp.ShippingCompany END  
    ELSE ''  
   END AS ShippingCompany,  
   CASE   
    WHEN sdel.ContainerInFK > 0 THEN   
        CASE WHEN tc.TransportCompany IS NULL THEN '' ELSE tc.TransportCompany END  
    WHEN sdel.ContainerOutFK > 0 THEN   
        CASE WHEN tsp.TransportCompany IS NULL THEN '' ELSE tsp.TransportCompany END  
    ELSE ''  
  END AS TransportCompany,  
  Cast(sdel.IsArchived as INT)[DeliveryIsArchived],  
  case when sdel.ContainerInFK > 0 then sist.StockInStatus           
        when sdel.ContainerOutFK > 0 then           
   case when co.ContainerOutStageFK in (1,2) then 'Pending'           
   when co.ContainerOutStageFK in (3,4,5,6,7) then 'InProgress'          
   ELSE 'Completed' end          
     ELSE '' end as DeliveryStatus,          
        
  CASE         
   WHEN sdel.ContainerInFK > 0 THEN            
    DATEADD(dd, c.DayCutOff,        
     CONVERT(DATETIME, FORMAT(sd.DayDate, 'yyyy-MM-dd'))) + CAST(c.TimeCutOff AS DATETIME)        
   WHEN sdel.ContainerOutFK > 0 THEN           
    DATEADD(dd, c2.DayCutOff,         
     CONVERT(DATETIME, FORMAT(sd.DayDate, 'yyyy-MM-dd'))) + CAST(c2.TimeCutOff AS DATETIME)        
   ELSE         
    CAST(GETDATE() AS DATETIME)         
  END AS CustomerCutoff,            
        
  CASE         
   WHEN sdel.ContainerInFK > 0 OR sdel.ContainerOutFK > 0 THEN           
    CASE         
     WHEN CONVERT(DATETIME, FORMAT(sd.DayDate, 'yyyy-MM-dd')) + CAST(sd.StartTime AS DATETIME) <=         
       DATEADD(dd, c.DayCutOff,         
       CONVERT(DATETIME, FORMAT(sd.DayDate, 'yyyy-MM-dd'))) + CAST(c.TimeCutOff AS DATETIME)         
     THEN 1         
     ELSE 0         
    END         
   ELSE         
    0         
  END AS DeliveryPastCutOff       
   FROM  [dbo].[tblScheduleWeeks] sw                   
   INNER JOIN [dbo].[tblScheduleChannels] sc ON sw.ScheduleWeekPK = sc.ScheduleWeekFK                  
   INNER JOIN [dbo].[tblScheduleDays] sd ON sc.ScheduleChannelPK = sd.ScheduleChannelFK                   
   INNER JOIN [dbo].[tblScheduleSlots] ss ON sd.ScheduleDayPK = ss.ScheduleDayFK                    
   LEFT JOIN tblScheduleDeliveries sdel ON sdel.ScheduleSlotFK = ss.ScheduleSlotPK  AND sdel.IsArchived=0                       
   LEFT JOIN tblContainerOutLoading coloading ON coloading.ContainerOutFK = sdel.ContainerOutFK AND coloading.IsArchived = 0
   LEFT JOIN appContainerOutLoadingTypes dcolt ON dcolt.ContainerOutLoadingTypePK = coloading.ContainerOutLoadingTypeFK
   LEFT JOIN appContainerOutLoadingTypes colt ON colt.ContainerOutLoadingTypePK = sc.ContainerOutLoadingTypeFK  
   LEFT JOIN tblContainerIns ci ON sdel.ContainerInFK = ci.ContainerInPK    
   LEFT JOIN tblTransportCompanies tc ON ci.TransportCompanyFK = tc.TransportCompanyPK        
   LEFT JOIN tblShippingCompanies scs ON ci.ShippingCompanyFK = scs.ShippingCompanyPK     
   LEFT JOIN tblStockIns si ON ci.ContainerInPK = si.ContainerInFK                
   left join appStockInStatus sist on sist.StockInStatusPK = si.StockInStatusFK          
   LEFT JOIN tbldivisions d ON si.DivisionFK = d.DivisionPK                      
   LEft Join tblcustomers c on d.CustomerFK = c.CustomerPK          
   LEFT JOIN tblSuppliers InboundSup ON ci.SupplierFK = InboundSup.SupplierPK                      
   LEFT JOIN tblloadingbays Inboundlb ON ci.LoadingBayFK = Inboundlb.LoadingBayPK                      
   LEFT OUTER JOIN tblCustomerDocketIdentifications cdis ON cdis.CustomerFK = d.CustomerFK AND cdis.DocketTypeFK = 1                      
   LEFT JOIN tblContainerOuts co ON sdel.ContainerOutFk = co.ContainerOutPK                      
   LEFT JOIN tblContainerOutLines col ON col.ContainerOutFK = co.ContainerOutPK    
   LEFT JOIN tblStockOrders so ON co.ContainerOutPK = so.ContainerOutFK    
   INNER JOIN tblBuildingUnits bu ON so.ResponsibleBuildingUnitFK =bu.BuildingUnitPK    
   LEFT JOIN tblDivisions d2 ON d2.DivisionPK = col.DivisionFK                
   LEFT Join tblcustomers c2 on d2.CustomerFK = c2.CustomerPK     
   LEFT JOIN tblTransportCompanies tsp ON co.TransportCompanyFK = tsp.TransportCompanyPK  
   LEFT JOIN tblShippingCompanies shp ON co.ShippingCompanyFK = shp.ShippingCompanyPK      
   LEFT JOIN tblloadingbays Outboundlb ON so.PickupLoadingBayFK = Outboundlb.LoadingBayPK                      
   LEFT OUTER JOIN tblCustomerDocketIdentifications cdis2 ON cdis2.CustomerFK = d2.CustomerFK AND cdis2.DocketTypeFK = 2              
   LEFT JOIN tblusers u on u.UserPK = @userfk            
   LEFT JOIN tblUserDivisions ud on ud.UserFK = @userfk and (d.DivisionPK = ud.DivisionFK or d2.DivisionPK = ud.DivisionFK)   WHERE sw.ScheduleWeekTemplateFK=@ScheduleWeekTemplateFK            
  AND (sc.IsArchived = 0 OR sc.IsArchived IS NULL)            
  AND (sw.IsArchived = 0 OR sw.IsArchived IS NULL)                
  AND (sd.IsArchived = 0 OR sd.IsArchived IS NULL)             
  AND (ss.IsArchived = 0 OR ss.IsArchived IS NULL)              
  AND (sdel.IsArchived = 0 OR sdel.IsArchived = 1 OR sdel.IsArchived IS NULL)          
  )SD              

UNION       
SELECT IsClientRestricted,      
 ScheduleWeekPK,    
 ScheduleName,    
 ScheduleChannelPK,      
 ChannelName,       
 ChannelColorCode,       
 ChannelFreeMode,      
 ChannelInbound,      
 ChannelOutbound, 
 ContainerOutLoadingTypeFK,
 ContainerOutLoadingType,
  DeliveryContainerOutLoadingTypeFK,
  DeliveryContainerOutLoadingType,
 SlotDeliveryCount,      
 ScheduleDayPK,       
 DayDate,      
 DayNumber,    
 DayStartTime,       
 DayEndTime,        
 DayDuration,      
 ScheduleSlotPK,      
 SchedulePlaceholderPK,       
 SlotStart,       
 SlotEnd,       
 SlotDuration,       
 case when IsClientRestricted=1 then 'Hidden Info' else PlaceholderTitle end as PlaceholderTitle,     
 PlaceholderColorCode,       
 ScheduleDeliveryPK,      
 case when IsClientRestricted=1 then 'Hidden Info' else DeliveryDescription end as DeliveryDescription,       
 DeliveryStartTime,       
 DeliveryEndTime,       
 DeliveryDuration,                
 DeliveryType,                    
 DeliveryContainerFK,             
 case when IsClientRestricted=1 then 'Hidden Info' else DocketNumber end as DocketNumber,        
 case when IsClientRestricted=1 then 'Hidden Info' else DocketSupplier end as DocketSupplier,        
 case when IsClientRestricted=1 then 'Hidden Info' else DocketDivision end as DocketDivision,       
 LoadingBay,                 
 DocketDate,         
 case when IsClientRestricted=1 then 'Hidden Info' else CustomerRef end as CustomerRef,        
 case when IsClientRestricted=1 then 'Hidden Info' else ContainerNumber end as ContainerNumber,          
 case when IsClientRestricted=1 then 'Hidden Info' else LorryNumber end as LorryNumber,          
 case when IsClientRestricted=1 then 'Hidden Info' else SealNumber end as SealNumber,        
 case when IsClientRestricted=1 then 'Hidden Info' ELSE ShippingCompany end as ShippingCompany,   
   case when IsClientRestricted=1 then 'Hidden Info' ELSE TransportCompany end as TransportCompany,   
   DeliveryIsArchived ,DeliveryStatus, CustomerCutoff, DeliveryPastCutOff    
 FROM(       
   SELECT DISTINCT       
   case when u.UserTypeFK = 4 then       
         1--schdeuled placeholder not matching this user division - restrict         
         else      
         0--matches - let them see this info        
      end as IsClientRestricted, sw.ScheduleWeekPK,sw.Name[ScheduleName],sc.ScheduleChannelPK, sc.[Name][ChannelName], sc.ColorCode[ChannelColorCode], sc.FreeMode[ChannelFreeMode],  
   sc.AllowInbound[ChannelInbound] , sc.AllowOutbound[ChannelOutbound],
   ISNULL(sc.ContainerOutLoadingTypeFK,-1) AS ContainerOutLoadingTypeFK,  
   ISNULL(colt.ContainerOutLoadingType,'No Restriction') AS ContainerOutLoadingType,
    -1 AS DeliveryContainerOutLoadingTypeFK,
  'No Restriction' AS DeliveryContainerOutLoadingType,
   sc.DeliveryCount[SlotDeliveryCount]                  
  ,sd.ScheduleDayPK, CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), sd.DayDate, 103) As [DayDate],sd.DayNumber, sd.StartTime[DayStartTime], sd.EndTime[DayEndTime], sd.MaxDuration[DayDuration],           
  -1 ScheduleSlotPK, sph.SchedulePlaceholderPK, sph.StartTime[SlotStart], sph.EndTime[SlotEnd],sph.ActualDuration[SlotDuration],          
  case when sph.Title = '' then                 
  case when sph.customerfk > 0 then c.CustomerName else su.Supplier end             
  else sph.Title end as PlaceholderTitle,             
  sph.ColorCode as PlaceholderColorCode,                
  -1 ScheduleDeliveryPK,     
   CASE     
      WHEN sph.[Description] = '' OR sph.[Description] IS NULL     
          THEN sph.Title    
      ELSE CONCAT(sph.Title, ' ', sph.[Description])     
    END AS [DeliveryDescription],      
  sph.StartTime[DeliveryStartTime], sph.EndTime[DeliveryEndTime], sph.ActualDuration[DeliveryDuration],                
  'Placeholder' as DeliveryType,          
  -1 as DeliveryContainerFK,                
  '' as DocketNumber,                
  case when sph.SupplierFK > 0 then su.Supplier else '' end as DocketSupplier,                 
  case when sph.CustomerFK > 0 then c.CustomerCode else '' end as DocketDivision,                 
  '' as LoadingBay,                 
  CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), sd.[DayDate], 103) as DocketDate,                
  '' as CustomerRef,                
  ''[ContainerNumber],         
  ''[LorryNumber],         
  ''[SealNumber],   
  ''[ShippingCompany],  
  ''[TransportCompany],       
  0 as [DeliveryIsArchived],  
    '' as DeliveryStatus,             
   DATEADD(dd,         
   case when c.customerpk IS NULL then 2 ELSE c.DayCutOff end,         
   CAST(GETDATE() AS DATETIME)) + case when c.TimeCutOff IS NULL then '10:00:00' ELSE CAST(c.TimeCutOff AS DATETIME) end as CustomerCutoff,        
  case         
   when CAST(sd.DayDate AS DATETIME) + CAST(sd.StartTime AS DATETIME) <=          
     DATEADD(dd, case when c.customerpk IS NULL then 2 ELSE c.DayCutOff end,         
     CAST(GETDATE() AS DATETIME)) + CAST(c.TimeCutOff AS DATETIME)         
   then 1         
   ELSE 0         
   end as DeliveryPastCutOff    
  FROM [dbo].[tblScheduleWeeks] sw             
  INNER JOIN [dbo].[tblScheduleChannels] sc ON sw.ScheduleWeekPK = sc.ScheduleWeekFK            
  INNER JOIN [dbo].[tblScheduleDays] sd ON sc.ScheduleChannelPK = sd.ScheduleChannelFK                
  INNER JOIN tblSchedulePlaceholders sph on sph.ScheduleDayFK = sd.ScheduleDayPK               
  LEFT JOIN appContainerOutLoadingTypes colt ON colt.ContainerOutLoadingTypePK = sc.ContainerOutLoadingTypeFK  
  LEFT JOIN tblcustomers c on sph.CustomerFK = c.CustomerPK         
  LEFT JOIN tblDivisions d ON d.CustomerFK = c.CustomerPK           
  LEFT JOIN tblUserDivisions ud on ud.UserFK=@UserFK AND (d.DivisionPK=ud.DivisionFK OR ud.UserFK=@Userfk)      
  LEFT JOIN [dbo].[tblusers] u on u.UserPK = @UserFK     
  LEFT JOIN tblSuppliers su on sph.SupplierFK = su.SupplierPK                           
  WHERE sw.ScheduleWeekTemplateFK=@ScheduleWeekTemplateFK             
  AND (sc.IsArchived = 0 OR sc.IsArchived IS NULL)            
  AND (sw.IsArchived = 0 OR sw.IsArchived IS NULL)                
  AND (sd.IsArchived = 0 OR sd.IsArchived IS NULL)              
  AND (sph.IsArchived = 0 OR sph.IsArchived IS NULL)      
  )SPH       
); 
GO

/****** Object:  View [dbo].[vw_FleetCurrentLocation]    Script Date: 02/11/2026 17:47:22 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
-- View: vw_FleetCurrentLocation
-- Derives the current building of each machine from WMS movement records.
-- Replaces the manual fleetmaintenance_MachineWarehouse table assignment.
--
-- Logic mirrors RecentWarehouseMachineLocation.sql:
--   When the source location type is NOT 4 â†’ machine is at the source building.
--   When the source location type IS 4      â†’ machine is at the destination building.
--
-- The 2-year date filter keeps the CTE lean; any active machine will have a
-- recent movement. Machines with no movement in 2 years return no row (NULL on join).

CREATE   VIEW [dbo].[vw_FleetCurrentLocation] AS
WITH LastMove AS (
    SELECT
        warehousemachinefk,
        sourcelocationtypefk,
        sourcelocationfk,
        destinationlocationtypefk,
        destinationfk,
        updateddate,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY warehousemachinefk
            ORDER BY worksordermovementpk DESC
        ) AS rn
    FROM dbo.tblworksordermovements
    WHERE updateddate >= DATEADD(YEAR, -2, GETDATE())
)
SELECT
    wm.WarehouseMachinePK AS MachineId,
    CASE
        WHEN lm.sourcelocationtypefk <> 4 THEN ISNULL(src.BuildingName, '')
        ELSE                                    ISNULL(dst.BuildingName, '')
    END AS WarehouseCode,
    CASE
        WHEN lm.sourcelocationtypefk <> 4 THEN ISNULL(src.BuildingName, '')
        ELSE                                    ISNULL(dst.BuildingName, '')
    END AS WarehouseName,
    lm.updateddate AS LastMovement
FROM LastMove lm
INNER JOIN dbo.tblwarehousemachines wm
       ON  lm.warehousemachinefk = wm.WarehouseMachinePK
LEFT  JOIN dbo.viewbuildingunitbays src
       ON  lm.sourcelocationtypefk <> 4
       AND lm.sourcelocationtypefk  = src.locationtypefk
       AND lm.sourcelocationfk      = src.buildingunitbaypk
LEFT  JOIN dbo.viewbuildingunitbays dst
       ON  lm.sourcelocationtypefk  = 4
       AND lm.destinationlocationtypefk = dst.locationtypefk
       AND lm.destinationfk             = dst.buildingunitbaypk
WHERE lm.rn = 1;

GO

CREATE VIEW [dbo].[viewPalletLocations]
WITH SCHEMABINDING 
AS
  SELECT     tpal.PalletPK , tpal.LocationTypeFK, tpal.LocationFK, CASE WHEN tpal.LocationTypeFK = 1 THEN Row ELSE 'A' END AS Row, 
                      CASE WHEN tpal.LocationTypeFK = 1 THEN ColumnNo ELSE 0 END AS ColumnNo, CASE WHEN tpal.LocationTypeFK = 1 THEN BayLevel ELSE 'a' END AS BayLevel, 
                       CASE WHEN tpal.LocationTypeFK = 4 THEN 'Container' ELSE
						CASE WHEN vBuBay.BuildingUnitBayLocation IS NOT NULL THEN 
							
							CASE WHEN RackingTypeFK = 1 THEN vBuBay.BuildingUnitBayLocation + RIGHT('0' + CAST(tpal.BayPosition AS nvarchar(10)), 2) 
							ELSE 
							vBuBay.BuildingUnitBayLocation 
							END
					   ELSE 'Invalid Location' END END AS Location, 
                     BuildingName + ' ' + vBuBay.BuildingUnit  AS Building,
					  vBuBay.BuildingUnit as BuildingUnit, 
                      CASE WHEN tpal.LocationTypeFK = 1 THEN vBuBay.RackingTypeFK ELSE 0 END AS RackingTypeFK, 
                       vBuBay.Barcode  AS Barcode, tpal.BuildingUnitFK, vBuBay.BuildingPK, --case when vBuBay.BuildingPK is null then Bu.BuildingFK end as BuildingPK,
                      CASE WHEN BuildingUnitColumnFK IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE BuildingUnitColumnFK END AS BuildingUnitColumnFK,
					  tpal.PalletStatusFK
					  FROM         dbo.tblPallets AS tpal
					   LEFT OUTER JOIN
                      dbo.viewBuildingUnitBays AS vBuBay ON vBuBay.BuildingUnitBayPK = tpal.LocationFK AND tpal.locationtypeFK = vBuBay.LocationTypeFK
					--  left join tblbuildingunits bu on tpal.BuildingUnitFK = bu.BuildingUnitPK
GO
/****** Object:  UserDefinedFunction [dbo].[fnGetScheduleWeekTemplatesForBuildingByScheduleWeekPK]    Script Date: 02/11/2026 17:47:22 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO

-- SELECT * FROM [dbo].[fnGetScheduleWeekTemplatesForBuildingByScheduleWeekPK](1)
         
-- =============================================          
-- Author:  <Archana Singh>          
-- Create date: <19/12/2023>          
-- Description: <Description,,>          
-- =============================================          
        
CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[fnGetScheduleWeekTemplatesForBuildingByScheduleWeekPK]        
(      
  @ScheduleWeekPK INT        
)    
RETURNS TABLE    
AS        
RETURN    
(      
  SELECT swt.ScheduleWeekTemplatePK, swt.[Name][TemplateName],    
    sct.ScheduleChannelTemplatePK, sct.[Name][ChannelName], sct.ColorCode[ChannelColorCode], sct.AllowInbound, sct.AllowOutbound, sct.FreeMode[ChannelFreeMode],
    ISNULL(sct.ContainerOutLoadingTypeFK,-1) AS ContainerOutLoadingTypeFK,  
    ISNULL(colt.ContainerOutLoadingType,'No Restriction') AS ContainerOutLoadingType,
    sct.DeliveryCount[SlotDeliveryCount],   
    sdt.ScheduleDayTemplatePK, CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), sdt.[DayDate], 103) As [DayDate],sdt.DayNumber, sdt.StartTime[DayStartTime], sdt.EndTime[DayEndTime],sdt.MaxDuration[DayDuration],    
    sst.ScheduleSlotTemplatePK, sst.StartTime[SlotStart], sst.EndTime[SlotEnd],sst.ActualDuration[SlotDuration]    
 FROM tblScheduleWeeks sw    
    INNER JOIN tblScheduleWeekTemplates swt ON swt.ScheduleWeekTemplatePK=sw.ScheduleWeekTemplateFK    
    LEFT JOIN  tblScheduleChannelTemplates sct ON sct.ScheduleWeekTemplateFK = swt.ScheduleWeekTemplatePK    
    LEFT JOIN tblScheduleDayTemplates sdt ON sdt.ScheduleChannelTemplateFK = sct.ScheduleChannelTemplatePK    
    LEFT JOIN tblScheduleSlotTemplates sst ON sst.ScheduleDayTemplateFK = sdt.ScheduleDayTemplatePK     
 AND sst.ScheduleDayTemplateFK = sdt.ScheduleDayTemplatePK    
    LEFT JOIN appContainerOutLoadingTypes colt ON colt.ContainerOutLoadingTypePK = sct.ContainerOutLoadingTypeFK  
 WHERE sw.ScheduleWeekPK=@ScheduleWeekPK AND sw.BuildingFK=swt.BuildingFK    
 AND (sw.IsArchived = 0 or sw.IsArchived is null)     
 AND (swt.IsArchived = 0 or swt.IsArchived is null)     
 AND (sct.IsArchived = 0 or sct.IsArchived is null)     
 AND (sdt.IsArchived = 0 or sdt.IsArchived is null)     
 AND (sst.IsArchived = 0 or sst.IsArchived is null)    
  );    
GO
/****** Object:  UserDefinedFunction [dbo].[fnGetScheduleClientActivitiesForBuilding]    Script Date: 02/11/2026 17:47:22 ******/

GO
-- SELECT * FROM [dbo].[fnGetScheduleClientActivitiesForBuilding](30,663)ORDER BY ScheduleActivityPK DESC                
-- SELECT * FROM [dbo].[fnGetScheduleClientActivitiesForBuilding](11,690)ORDER BY ScheduleActivityPK DESC             
         
-- =============================================                      
-- Author:  <Archana Singh>                      
-- Create date: <13/12/2023>                      
-- Description: <Description,,>                      
-- =============================================                 
                
CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[fnGetScheduleClientActivitiesForBuilding]                
(                  
  @BuildingFK INT,          
  @UserId INT          
)                
RETURNS TABLE                
AS                
RETURN                 
(
   SELECT DISTINCT           
      sa.ScheduleActivityPK,
      sa.BuildingFK,
      ap.FirstName + ' ' + ap.LastName AS Person,
      sa.Comments,                
      sat.ScheduleActivityType,
      FORMAT(sa.InsertedDate, 'dd/MM/yy HH:mm:ss') AS InsertedDate
   FROM tblUsers u  
   INNER JOIN tblPeople p 
       ON u.PersonFK = p.PersonPK        
   INNER JOIN TBLDivisions d 
       ON u.DistributionCustomerFK = d.CustomerFK
   INNER JOIN tblUserDivisions ud 
       ON ud.DivisionFK = d.DivisionPK 
      AND u.UserPK = ud.UserFK
   -- Activity feed
   INNER JOIN tblScheduleActivities sa 
       ON sa.BuildingFK = @BuildingFK        
   INNER JOIN appScheduleActivityTypes sat 
       ON sa.ScheduleActivityTypeFK = sat.ScheduleActivityTypePK 
   INNER JOIN tblUsers au 
       ON sa.InsertedBy = au.UserPK	
   INNER JOIN tblPeople ap 
       ON au.PersonFK = ap.PersonPK                       
   -- Deliveries & containers
   LEFT JOIN tblScheduleDeliveries sd 
       ON sd.ScheduleDeliveryPK = sa.ScheduleDeliveryFK      
   LEFT JOIN tblContainerIns ci 
       ON ci.ContainerInPK = sd.ContainerInFK  
   LEFT JOIN tblStockIns si 
       ON ci.ContainerInPk = si.ContainerInFK  	
   LEFT JOIN (
       SELECT DISTINCT 
           containeroutfk, 
           divisionfk, 
           GoodsOrderNumber
       FROM tblcontainerouts co
       INNER JOIN tblContainerOutLines col 
           ON containeroutfk = ContainerOutPK
   ) Couts 
       ON couts.ContainerOutFK = sd.ContainerOutFK
   -- Placeholder link
   LEFT JOIN tblSchedulePlaceholders sp 
       ON sp.SchedulePlaceholderPK = sa.SchedulePlaceholderFK 
   WHERE u.UserPK = @UserId
     AND (
           (sd.ContainerOutFK IS NOT NULL AND Couts.DivisionFK = ud.DivisionFK) -- container out
        OR (sd.ContainerInFK  IS NOT NULL AND si.DivisionFK = ud.DivisionFK)    -- container in
        OR (sp.SchedulePlaceholderPK IS NOT NULL AND sp.CustomerFK = u.DistributionCustomerFK) -- placeholder
         )

);
GO
/****** Object:  UserDefinedFunction [dbo].[fnGetContainerInsForBuildingWeekSchedule]    Script Date: 02/11/2026 17:47:23 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
  
       
-- SELECT * FROM [dbo].[fnGetContainerInsForBuildingWeekSchedule](11,663)              
-- SELECT * FROM [dbo].[fnGetContainerInsForBuildingWeekSchedule](11,690)               
      
      
-- =============================================                  
-- Author:  <Archana Singh>                  
-- Create date: <19/12/2023>                  
-- Description: <Description,,>                  
-- =============================================                  
                
CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[fnGetContainerInsForBuildingWeekSchedule]      
(              
  @BuildingFK INT,      
  @UserFK INT      
)            
RETURNS TABLE            
AS                
RETURN            
(       
    SELECT DISTINCT   
 [ContainerInPK][IdentifierPK],   
 'ContainerIn'[Type],             
     CAST(ci.GoodsInNumber AS nvarchar(50)) GoodsInNumber,    
     ISNULL(sup.Supplier, '') AS Supplier,   
  ISNULL(ci.ContainerNumber, '') AS ContainerNumber,   
  ISNULL(ci.SealNumber,'') AS SealNumber,  
  ISNULL(ci.LorryNumber,'') AS LorryNumber,  
  ISNULL(shp.ShippingCompany, '') AS ShippingCompany,  
     ISNULL(tsp.TransportCompany, '') AS TransportCompany,  
  d.DivisionCode,   
  d.DivisionName,             
     cus.CustomerPK,  
  cus.CustomerCode,  
  cus.CustomerName,            
     COALESCE(lb.LoadingBay, 'Unassigned') AS LoadingBay,  
  FORMAT(ci.datein, 'dd/MM/yy HH:mm:ss') AS [DateIn],              
     CASE WHEN cdis.CustomerDocketIdentificationPK IS NOT NULL THEN               
      CASE cdis.FieldFK                 
       WHEN 1 THEN ci.Free1                
       WHEN 2 THEN ci.Free2                
       WHEN 3 THEN ci.Free3                
       WHEN 4 THEN ci.Free4                
       WHEN 5 THEN ci.Free5                
      ELSE ' '   
     END + ' '  +   
   CASE  cdis.Field2FK                 
    WHEN 1 THEN ci.Free1                
    WHEN 2 THEN ci.Free2                
    WHEN 3 THEN ci.Free3                
    WHEN 4 THEN ci.Free4                
    WHEN 5 THEN ci.Free5                
    ELSE ' '   
  END + ' '  +   
  CASE  cdis.Field3FK                 
    WHEN 1 THEN ci.Free1                
    WHEN 2 THEN ci.Free2                
    WHEN 3 THEN ci.Free3                
    WHEN 4 THEN ci.Free4                
    WHEN 5 THEN ci.Free5                
    ELSE ' '   
 END               
ELSE ' '   
END + ' '  +              
CASE WHEN  ci.ExternalReference <> ''   
 THEN ci.ExternalReference   
 ELSE ' '   
END AS CustomerRef,  
-1 AS ContainerOutLoadingTypeFK,  
'No Restriction' AS  ContainerOutLoadingType   
 --, SUM(sil.pallets) as NoPallets                   
    FROM tblContainerIns ci               
    INNER JOIN tblStockIns si on ci.ContainerInPK = si.ContainerInFK              
    --LEFT JOIN  tblStockInLines sil on si.StockInPK  =sil.StockInFK            
    INNER JOIN tblBuildingUnits bu on ci.BuildingUnitFK = bu.BuildingUnitPK              
    INNER JOIN tblDivisions d on si.DivisionFK = d.DivisionPK              
    INNER JOIN tblCustomers cus on d.CustomerFK = cus.CustomerPK            
    LEFT JOIN  tblSuppliers sup on ci.SupplierFK = sup.SupplierPK    
 LEFT JOIN tblTransportCompanies tsp ON ci.TransportCompanyFK = tsp.TransportCompanyPK     
    LEFT JOIN tblShippingCompanies shp ON ci.ShippingCompanyFK = shp.ShippingCompanyPK         
 LEFT JOIN  tblScheduleDeliveries sd on sd.ContainerInFK = ci.ContainerInPK              
    LEFT JOIN tblLoadingBays lb on ci.LoadingBayFK = lb.LoadingBayPK              
    LEFT JOIN tblCustomerDocketIdentifications as cdis on cdis.CustomerFK = d.CustomerFK AND cdis.DocketTypeFK = 1    
 INNER JOIN tblUsers u ON u.UserPK=@UserFK       
    LEFT JOIN tblUserDivisions ud ON ud.divisionfk = si.divisionfk AND ud.UserFK =  u.UserPK  
     WHERE bu.BuildingFK = @BuildingFK           
       AND ci.StockInStatusFK = 1              
       AND (sd.ContainerInFK IS NULL   OR sd.IsArchived=1)          
       AND StockInGroupFK = -1            
       --AND (@UserFK = -1 or ud.divisionfk = si.divisionfk)          
  AND ((u.UserTypeFK = 4 AND ud.DivisionFK IS NOT NULL) or (u.UserTypeFK <> 4 AND ud.DivisionFK IS NULL))  
      GROUP BY ContainerInPK, ci.GoodsInNumber, sup.Supplier, d.DivisionCode, d.DivisionName, customerpk, cus.CustomerCode, cus.CustomerName,            
       lb.LoadingBay, ci.datein, CustomerDocketIdentificationPK, cdis.FieldFK,Field2FK, Field3FK, ci.Free1,ci.Free2,ci.Free3,ci.Free4,ci.Free5, ExternalReference,ci.ContainerNumber, ci.SealNumber,ci.LorryNumber                
    ,shp.ShippingCompany, tsp.TransportCompany   
  
UNION            
SELECT DISTINCT   
 [ContainerInPK][IdentifierPK],  
 'Group'[Type],             
 CAST(ci.GoodsInNumber AS nvarchar(50)) GoodsInNumber,    
     ISNULL(sup.Supplier, '') AS Supplier,   
  ISNULL(ci.ContainerNumber, '') AS ContainerNumber,   
  ISNULL(ci.SealNumber,'') AS SealNumber,  
  ISNULL(ci.LorryNumber,'') AS LorryNumber,  
  ISNULL(shp.ShippingCompany, '') AS ShippingCompany,  
     ISNULL(tsp.TransportCompany, '') AS TransportCompany,  
  d.DivisionCode,   
  d.DivisionName,             
     cus.CustomerPK,  
  cus.CustomerCode,  
  cus.CustomerName,            
     COALESCE(lb.LoadingBay, 'Unassigned') AS LoadingBay,  
  FORMAT(ci.datein, 'dd/MM/yy HH:mm:ss') AS [DateIn],  
  '' AS CustomerRef,  
     -1 AS ContainerOutLoadingTypeFK,  
     'Not Applicable' AS  ContainerOutLoadingType   
   --,SUM(sil.pallets) as NoPallets            
   FROM tblContainerIns ci               
    INNER JOIN tblStockIns si on ci.ContainerInPK = si.ContainerInFK              
    --LEFT JOIN  tblStockInLines sil on si.StockInPK  =sil.StockInFK            
    INNER JOIN tblBuildingUnits bu on ci.BuildingUnitFK = bu.BuildingUnitPK              
    INNER JOIN tblDivisions d on si.DivisionFK = d.DivisionPK              
    INNER JOIN tblCustomers cus on d.CustomerFK = cus.CustomerPK            
    LEFT JOIN  tblSuppliers sup on ci.SupplierFK = sup.SupplierPK    
 LEFT JOIN tblTransportCompanies tsp ON ci.TransportCompanyFK = tsp.TransportCompanyPK     
    LEFT JOIN tblShippingCompanies shp ON ci.ShippingCompanyFK = shp.ShippingCompanyPK         
 LEFT JOIN  tblScheduleDeliveries sd on sd.ContainerInFK = ci.ContainerInPK              
    LEFT JOIN tblLoadingBays lb on ci.LoadingBayFK = lb.LoadingBayPK              
    LEFT JOIN tblCustomerDocketIdentifications as cdis on cdis.CustomerFK = d.CustomerFK AND cdis.DocketTypeFK = 1    
 INNER JOIN tblUsers u ON u.UserPK=@UserFK       
    LEFT JOIN tblUserDivisions ud ON ud.divisionfk = si.divisionfk AND ud.UserFK =  u.UserPK  
     WHERE bu.BuildingFK = @BuildingFK           
       AND ci.StockInStatusFK = 1              
       AND (sd.ContainerInFK IS NULL   OR sd.IsArchived=1)          
       AND StockInGroupFK > 0            
       --AND (@UserFK = -1 or ud.divisionfk = si.divisionfk)          
    AND ((u.UserTypeFK = 4 AND ud.DivisionFK IS NOT NULL) OR (u.UserTypeFK <> 4 AND ud.DivisionFK IS NULL))  
      GROUP BY ContainerInPK, ci.GoodsInNumber, sup.Supplier, d.DivisionCode, d.DivisionName, customerpk, cus.CustomerCode, cus.CustomerName,            
       lb.LoadingBay, ci.datein, CustomerDocketIdentificationPK, cdis.FieldFK,Field2FK, Field3FK, ci.Free1,ci.Free2,ci.Free3,ci.Free4,ci.Free5, ExternalReference,ci.ContainerNumber, ci.SealNumber,ci.LorryNumber                
    ,shp.ShippingCompany, tsp.TransportCompany     
);   
GO

CREATE VIEW [dbo].[ViewMobstaWorksOrdersAdhocList]  
AS  
	Select WorksOrderPK, WorksorderTypeFK, WorksOrderType, wo.BuildingUnitFK, wo.InsertedDate, wo.ResponsibleUserFK, coalesce(p.FirstName + ' ' + p.LastName, '') as AssignedTo
	from tblworksorders wo
	inner join appWorksOrderTypes wot on wo.WorksOrderTypeFK = wot.WorksOrderTypePK
	left join tblusers u on userpk=  wo.ResponsibleUserFK
	left join tblPeople p on p.PersonPK = u.PersonFK
	where WorksOrderStatusFK < 3 and wot.WorksOrderOriginFK = 5 /*adhoc*/
GO

SET ANSI_NULLS ON

CREATE VIEW [dbo].[ViewPalletDetail]      
AS      
SELECT p.PalletPK, p.Barcode, COALESCE (p.CustomerBarcode, 'NA') AS CustomerBarcode, COALESCE (p.CustomerPalletNumber, 'NA') AS CustomerPalletNumber, pt.PalletType, ps.PalletStatus, pc.StockItemFK, s.StockItemCode, d.DivisionPK,       
                  d.DivisionName, d.DivisionCode, c.CustomerPK, c.CustomerName, c.CustomerCode, pc.Batch, COALESCE (pc.SupplierBatch, 'NA') AS SupplierBatch, pc.ExpiryDate, pc.DateOfManufacture, pc.BestBefore, pc.DateOfReceipt,       
                  SUM(pc.ActualUnits) AS ActualUnits, SUM(pc.AvailableUnits) AS AvailableUnits, s.IsStackable, s.RequireBatch, s.RequireSupplierBatch,       
                  CASE WHEN s.RequireExpiryDate = 1 THEN s.RequireExpiryDate ELSE CASE WHEN d .RequireExpiryDate = 1 THEN d .RequireExpiryDate ELSE c.RequireExpiryDate END END AS RequireExpiryDate,       
                  CASE WHEN s.RequireManufactureDate = 1 THEN s.RequireManufactureDate ELSE CASE WHEN d .RequireManufactureDate = 1 THEN d .RequireManufactureDate ELSE c.RequireManufactureDate END END AS RequireManufactureDate,       
                  CASE WHEN s.RequireBestBefore = 1 THEN s.RequireBestBefore ELSE CASE WHEN d .RequireBestBefore = 1 THEN d .RequireBestBefore ELSE c.RequireBestBefore END END AS RequireBestBefore,       
                  CASE WHEN s.RequireDateOfReceipt = 1 THEN s.RequireDateOfReceipt ELSE CASE WHEN d .RequireDateOfReceipt = 1 THEN d .RequireDateOfReceipt ELSE c.RequireDateOfReceipt END END AS RequireDateOfReceipt,       
                  CASE WHEN s.RequirePalletNumber = 1 THEN s.RequirePalletNumber ELSE CASE WHEN d .RequirePalletNumber = 1 THEN d .RequirePalletNumber ELSE c.RequirePalletNumber END END AS RequirePalletNumber,       
                  CASE WHEN (d .GenerateCustomerPalletBarcodes = 1 OR      
                  d .AllowCustomerPalletBarcodeManualEntry = 1) THEN CAST(1 AS bit) ELSE CAST(0 AS bit) END AS RequireCustomerBarcode, vpl.Location, Coalesce(vpl.Building, StockInInfo.BuildingName) as Building, Coalesce(vpl.barcode, '') AS LocationBarcode
, vpl.BuildingUnitFK, case when vpl.BuildingPK is null then StockInInfo.BuildingPK else vpl.BuildingPK end as BuildingPK, p.BayPosition,       
                  p.StackPosition,vpl.locationTypeFk,vpl.LocationFk,    
      COALESCE (StockOutInfo.GoodsOrderNumber, '') AS GoodsOrderNumber, COALESCE (StockOutInfo.ContainerBarcode, '') AS ContainerBarcode, COALESCE (StockInInfo.GoodsInNumber, '') AS GoodsInNumber ,    
     
   case when StockInInfo.StockInPK Is NULL then -1 else StockInInfo.StockInPK end as StockInPK ,
   pt.Grouping
FROM     dbo.tblPallets AS p INNER JOIN      
                  dbo.tblPalletContent AS pc ON p.PalletPK = pc.PalletFK INNER JOIN      
                  dbo.tblStockItems AS s ON pc.StockItemFK = s.StockItemPK INNER JOIN      
                  dbo.tblDivisions AS d ON s.DivisionFK = d.DivisionPK INNER JOIN      
                  dbo.tblCustomers AS c ON d.CustomerFK = c.CustomerPK INNER JOIN      
                  dbo.tblPalletTypes AS pt ON p.PalletTypeFK = pt.PalletTypePK INNER JOIN      
                  dbo.appPalletStatus AS ps ON ps.PalletStatusPK = p.PalletStatusFK INNER JOIN      
                  dbo.viewPalletLocations AS vpl ON p.PalletPK = vpl.PalletPK LEFT OUTER JOIN      
                      (SELECT distinct PalletFK, GoodsOrderNumber, 'STACO-' + CONVERT(nvarchar(200), ContainerOutPK) AS ContainerBarcode      
                       FROM      dbo.viewContainerOutPalletList      
                       WHERE   (ContainerOutStatusFK IN (1, 2))) AS StockOutInfo ON StockOutInfo.PalletFK = p.PalletPK LEFT OUTER JOIN      
                      (SELECT distinct tStPal.PalletFK, tStk.GoodsInNumber, tStk.StockInPK, BuildingPK , BuildingName + ' ' + BuildingUnit as BuildingName, bu.BuildingUnit    
                       FROM      dbo.tblStockIns AS tStk INNER JOIN      
          dbo.tblContainerIns ci on tStk.containerinfk = ci.containerinpk inner join  
          tblbuildingunits bu on ci.BuildingUnitFK = bu.BuildingUnitPK inner join   
          tblbuildings b on b.buildingpk = bu.buildingfk inner join  
                                         dbo.tblStockInLines AS tStkL ON tStkL.StockInFK = tStk.StockInPK INNER JOIN      
                                         dbo.tblStockInLinePallets AS tStPal ON tStPal.StockInLineFK = tStkL.StockInLinePK      
                       WHERE   (tStk.StockInStatusFK IN (1, 2))) AS StockInInfo ON StockInInfo.PalletFK = p.PalletPK      
GROUP BY p.PalletPK, p.Barcode, p.CustomerBarcode, p.CustomerPalletNumber, pt.PalletType, ps.PalletStatus, pc.StockItemFK, s.StockItemCode, d.DivisionPK, d.DivisionName, d.DivisionCode, c.CustomerPK, c.CustomerName, c.CustomerCode,       
            pc.Batch, pc.SupplierBatch, pc.ExpiryDate, pc.DateOfManufacture, pc.BestBefore, pc.DateOfReceipt, s.IsStackable, s.RequireBatch, s.RequireSupplierBatch, s.RequireExpiryDate, d.RequireExpiryDate, c.RequireExpiryDate,       
                  s.RequireManufactureDate, d.RequireManufactureDate, c.RequireManufactureDate, s.RequireBestBefore, d.RequireBestBefore, c.RequireBestBefore, s.RequireDateOfReceipt, d.RequireDateOfReceipt, c.RequireDateOfReceipt,       
                  s.RequirePalletNumber, d.RequirePalletNumber, c.RequirePalletNumber, d.GenerateCustomerPalletBarcodes, d.AllowCustomerPalletBarcodeManualEntry, vpl.Location, vpl.Building, StockInInfo.BuildingName, vpl.barcode, vpl.BuildingUnitFK, vpl.BuildingPK,  StockInInfo.BuildingPK,     
                  p.BayPosition, p.StackPosition, StockOutInfo.GoodsOrderNumber, StockOutInfo.ContainerBarcode, StockInInfo.GoodsInNumber, vpl.locationTypeFk,vpl.LocationFk, StockInInfo.StockInPK  , pt.Grouping
GO
/****** Object:  UserDefinedFunction [dbo].[fnGetContainerOutsForBuildingWeekSchedule]    Script Date: 02/11/2026 17:47:23 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
    
-- SELECT * FROM [dbo].[fnGetContainerOutsForBuildingWeekSchedule](11, 690)       
-- SELECT * FROM [dbo].[fnGetContainerOutsForBuildingWeekSchedule](11, 663)          
       
            
               
-- =============================================                
-- Author:  <Archana Singh>                
-- Create date: <22/12/2023>                
-- Description: <Description,,>                
-- =============================================                
              
CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[fnGetContainerOutsForBuildingWeekSchedule]              
(            
  @BuildingFK INT,        
  @UserFK INT               
)          
RETURNS TABLE          
AS              
RETURN          
(         
    WITH cte AS        
    (     
   SELECT co.ContainerOutPK[IdentifierPK],        
                   'ContainerOut' AS [Type],        
                   CAST(co.GoodsOrderNumber AS nvarchar(50)) AS GoodsOrderNumber,      
       co.ContainerNumber,     
       co.SealNumber,    
       co.LorryNumber,     
                   ISNULL(shp.ShippingCompany, '') AS ShippingCompany,    
                   ISNULL(tsp.TransportCompany, '') AS TransportCompany,    
          div.DivisionCode,        
                   div.DivisionName,           
                   cus.CustomerPK,        
                   cus.CustomerCode,        
                   cus.CustomerName,          
                   COALESCE(lb.LoadingBay, 'Unassigned') AS LoadingBay,         
                   FORMAT(co.CollectionDate, 'dd/MM/yy HH:mm:ss') AS [CollectionDate],               
                   CASE         
                       WHEN cdis.CustomerDocketIdentificationPK IS NULL THEN             
                           CASE         
                               WHEN co.Docketlabel1 <> '' THEN co.DocketValue1 ELSE ''         
                           END + ' ' +            
                           CASE         
                               WHEN co.Docketlabel2 <> '' THEN co.DocketValue2 ELSE ''         
                           END + ' ' +            
                           CASE         
                               WHEN co.Docketlabel3 <> '' THEN co.DocketValue3 ELSE ''         
                           END        
                       ELSE            
                           CASE cdis.FieldFK         
                               WHEN 40 THEN co.DocketValue1            
                               WHEN 41 THEN co.DocketValue2            
                               WHEN 42 THEN co.DocketValue3            
                           END            
                           + ' ' +            
                           CASE cdis.Field2FK         
                               WHEN 40 THEN co.DocketValue1            
                               WHEN 41 THEN co.DocketValue2            
                               WHEN 42 THEN co.DocketValue3            
                               ELSE ''            
                           END            
                   END AS CustomerRef,   
                   ISNULL(coload.ContainerOutLoadingTypeFK,-1) AS ContainerOutLoadingTypeFK,  
                   ISNULL(colt.ContainerOutLoadingType,'No Restriction') AS ContainerOutLoadingType,  
  
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY co.ContainerOutPK ORDER BY lb.LoadingBay DESC) AS rn    
            FROM tblContainerOuts co            
            INNER JOIN tblContainerOutLines col ON col.ContainerOutFK = co.ContainerOutPK            
            INNER JOIN tblStockOrders so ON co.ContainerOutPK = so.ContainerOutFK            
            INNER JOIN tblBuildingUnits bu ON so.ResponsibleBuildingUnitFK = bu.BuildingUnitPK            
            INNER JOIN tblDivisions div ON div.DivisionPK = col.DivisionFK             
            INNER JOIN tblCustomers cus ON cus.CustomerPK = div.CustomerFK          
            LEFT JOIN tblScheduleDeliveries sd ON sd.ContainerOutFK = co.ContainerOutPK    and sd.IsArchived=0    
            LEFT JOIN tblloadingbays lb ON so.PickupLoadingBayFK = lb.LoadingBayPK     
            LEFT JOIN tblTransportCompanies tsp ON co.TransportCompanyFK = tsp.TransportCompanyPK            
            LEFT JOIN tblShippingCompanies shp ON co.ShippingCompanyFK = shp.ShippingCompanyPK               
            LEFT JOIN tblContainerOutLoading coload ON coload.ContainerOutFK = co.ContainerOutPK  
            LEFT JOIN appContainerOutLoadingTypes colt ON colt.ContainerOutLoadingTypePK = coload.ContainerOutLoadingTypeFK  
            LEFT JOIN tblCustomerDocketIdentifications AS cdis ON cdis.CustomerFK = div.CustomerFK AND cdis.DocketTypeFK = 2            
            INNER JOIN tblUsers u ON u.UserPK = @UserFK    
            LEFT JOIN tblUserDivisions ud ON ud.divisionfk = col.divisionfk AND ud.UserFK =  u.UserPK    
            WHERE bu.BuildingFK = @BuildingFK      
   AND ((u.UserTypeFK = 4 AND ud.DivisionFK IS NOT NULL) OR (u.UserTypeFK <> 4 AND ud.DivisionFK IS NULL))    
            AND co.ContainerOutStatusFK < 5        
            AND co.DistributionOrderFK = -1       
   AND (sd.ContainerOutFK IS NULL /*OR sd.IsArchived=1*/)     
   )        
    SELECT     
        IdentifierPK,    
        [Type],    
        GoodsOrderNumber,    
        ContainerNumber,    
        SealNumber,    
        LorryNumber,    
        ShippingCompany,    
        TransportCompany,    
        DivisionCode,    
        DivisionName,    
        CustomerPK,    
        CustomerCode,    
        CustomerName,    
        LoadingBay,    
        CollectionDate,    
        CustomerRef,  
        ContainerOutLoadingTypeFK,  
        ContainerOutLoadingType          
    FROM cte        
    WHERE rn = 1          
 ); 
GO

/****** Object:  UserDefinedFunction [dbo].[fnGetTransportUserScopeForBuildings]    Script Date: 02/11/2026 17:47:23 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO

-- SELECT * from fnGetTransportUserScopeForBuildings(712)        
        
-- =============================================                      
-- Author: <Archana Singh>                      
-- Create date: <19/05/2026>                      
-- Description:         
-- Returns the security and access scope for Transport Users (UserTypeFK = 5).        
-- This function resolves which Transport Company, Customers, Divisions, and Buildings        
-- a transport user is authorized to access based on user-to-customer mappings        
-- (tblUserCustomer) and building assignment rules.        
-- =============================================        
        
CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[fnGetTransportUserScopeForBuildings]        
(        
    @UserFK INT        
)        
RETURNS TABLE        
AS        
RETURN        
(        
   SELECT  bu.BuildingFK, uc.CustomerFK, uc.UserFK, u.AspNetUserID 
   FROM tblUsers u  
   INNER JOIN tblUserCustomer uc ON uc.UserFK = u.UserPK   
   INNER JOIN tblDivisions d ON d.CustomerFK = uc.CustomerFK  
   INNER JOIN tblDivisionBuildingUnits dbu ON dbu.DivisionFK = d.DivisionPK  
   INNER JOIN tblBuildingUnits bu ON bu.BuildingUnitPK = dbu.BuildingUnitFK  
   WHERE u.UserPK = @UserFK  
     AND dbu.IsArchived = 0  
     AND bu.IsArchived = 0    
     GROUP BY  bu.BuildingFK, uc.CustomerFK,uc.UserFK, u.AspNetUserID 
);
GO
