/****** Object:  View [dbo].[viewStockLevelsOld]    Script Date: 02/11/2026 17:47:23 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE VIEW [dbo].[viewStockLevelsOld]
AS
SELECT     StockItemFK, Batch, SpecialStockTypeFK, SUM(ActualPallets) AS ActualPallets, SUM(AvailablePallets) AS AvailablePallets, CASE WHEN SUM(ActualEaches) 
                      < 0 THEN - 1 ELSE SUM(ActualEaches) END AS ActualEaches, SUM(ActualUnits) AS ActualUnits, CASE WHEN SUM(AvailableEaches) 
                      < 0 THEN - 1 ELSE SUM(AvailableEaches) END AS AvailableEaches, SUM(AvailableUnits) AS AvailableUnits, CAST(0 AS bit) AS Expr1, 1 AS Expr2, dbo.GetBSTDate()
                      AS Expr3, 1 AS Expr4, dbo.GetBSTDate() AS Expr5
FROM         (SELECT     StockItemFK, Batch, SpecialStockTypeFK, 0 AS ActualPallets, 0 AS AvailablePallets, SUM(ActualEaches) AS ActualEaches, SUM(ActualUnits) AS ActualUnits, 
                                              SUM(AvailableEaches) AS AvailableEaches, SUM(AvailableUnits) AS AvailableUnits
                       FROM          dbo.tblPalletContent 
                       WHERE      (PalletFK = - 1) AND (IsArchived = 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/)
                       GROUP BY StockItemFK, Batch, SpecialStockTypeFK
                       UNION
                       SELECT     pc.StockItemFK, pc.Batch, pc.SpecialStockTypeFK, ISNULL(palletCount.Pallets, 0) AS ActualPallets, ISNULL(availablePalletCount.Pallets, 0) 
                                             AS AvailablePallets, SUM(pc.ActualEaches) AS ActualEaches, SUM(pc.ActualUnits) AS ActualUnits, SUM(pc.AvailableEaches) AS AvailableEaches, 
                                             SUM(pc.AvailableUnits) AS AvailableUnits
                       FROM         dbo.tblPalletContent AS pc INNER JOIN
                                                 (SELECT     COUNT(DISTINCT pc2.PalletFK) AS Pallets, pc2.StockItemFK, pc2.Batch, pc2.SpecialStockTypeFK
                                                   FROM          dbo.tblPalletContent AS pc2  INNER JOIN
                                                                          dbo.tblPallets AS pallets2  ON pallets2.PalletPK = pc2.PalletFK AND pallets2.PalletStatusFK <> 10
                                                   WHERE      (pc2.PalletFK <> - 1) AND (pc2.ActualUnits > 0) AND (pc2.IsArchived = 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/)
                                                   GROUP BY pc2.StockItemFK, pc2.Batch, pc2.SpecialStockTypeFK) AS palletCount ON palletCount.StockItemFK = pc.StockItemFK AND 
                                             palletCount.Batch = pc.Batch AND palletCount.SpecialStockTypeFK = pc.SpecialStockTypeFK LEFT OUTER JOIN
                                                 (SELECT     COUNT(DISTINCT pc2.PalletFK) AS Pallets, pc2.StockItemFK, pc2.Batch, pc2.SpecialStockTypeFK
                                                   FROM          dbo.tblPalletContent AS pc2  INNER JOIN
                                                                          dbo.tblPallets AS pallets2  ON pallets2.PalletPK = pc2.PalletFK AND pallets2.PalletStatusFK <> 10
                                                   WHERE      (pc2.PalletFK <> - 1) AND (pc2.AvailableUnits > 0) AND (pc2.IsArchived = 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/) AND (pallets2.IsArchived = 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/)
                                                   GROUP BY pc2.StockItemFK, pc2.Batch, pc2.SpecialStockTypeFK) AS availablePalletCount ON availablePalletCount.StockItemFK = pc.StockItemFK AND 
                                             availablePalletCount.Batch = pc.Batch AND availablePalletCount.SpecialStockTypeFK = pc.SpecialStockTypeFK INNER JOIN
                                             dbo.tblPallets AS pallets  ON pallets.PalletPK = pc.PalletFK AND pallets.PalletStatusFK <> 10 AND pallets.IsArchived = 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/
                       WHERE     (pc.PalletFK <> - 1) AND (pc.IsArchived = 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/)
                       GROUP BY pc.StockItemFK, pc.Batch, pc.SpecialStockTypeFK, palletCount.Pallets, availablePalletCount.Pallets) AS subQ
GROUP BY StockItemFK, Batch, SpecialStockTypeFK
GO
/****** Object:  UserDefinedFunction [dbo].[fnGetScheduleWeekForTransportUser]    Script Date: 02/11/2026 17:47:23 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO

-- SELECT * FROM dbo.fnGetScheduleWeekForTransportUser(11,23,2026,712) ORDER BY ChannelName ASC, DayDate ASC;            
-- SELECT * FROM fnGetScheduleWeekForTransportUser(11,24,2026,180) ORDER BY ChannelName ASC, DayDate ASC;            
  
-- ==========================================================            
-- Author:      Archana Singh            
-- Create date: 14/05/2026            
-- Description: External Transport Users schedule calendar            
-- Security:            
-- Transport users can ONLY view deliveries linked            
-- to customers mapped in tblUserCustomer.            
-- ==========================================================                                       
                                  
CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[fnGetScheduleWeekForTransportUser]                                      
(                                        
  @BuildingFK INT,                                  
  @WeekNumber INT,                                  
  @Year INT,                        
  @UserFK INT                        
)                                  
RETURNS TABLE                                  
AS                                      
RETURN                       
(                     
   WITH distinctResults AS                
   (                
    SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY DeliveryContainerFK ORDER BY LoadingBay ASC) AS rn                
    FROM                 
    (                   
     SELECT DISTINCT d2.DivisionPK AS OutDiv,  ud.DivisionFK,                        
     CASE             
        WHEN u.TransportCompanyFK = co.TransportCompanyFK THEN 0 -- scheduled delivery matching this user          
        ELSE 1                                
     END AS IsClientRestricted,            
    sw.ScheduleWeekPK,              
    sw.[Name] AS [ScheduleName],               
    ScheduleChannelPK,              
    sc.[Name] AS [ChannelName],               
    sc.ColorCode AS [ChannelColorCode],              
    sc.FreeMode AS [ChannelFreeMode],               
    sc.AllowInbound AS [ChannelInbound],               
    sc.AllowOutbound AS [ChannelOutbound],  
     -- Channel delivery type
    ISNULL(sc.ContainerOutLoadingTypeFK,-1) AS ContainerOutLoadingTypeFK,  
    ISNULL(colt.ContainerOutLoadingType,'No Restriction') AS ContainerOutLoadingType,
    
    -- Actual delivery/container-out type
    CASE 
      WHEN sdel.ContainerOutFK > 0 
        THEN ISNULL(coloading.ContainerOutLoadingTypeFK, -1)
       ELSE -1
     END AS DeliveryContainerOutLoadingTypeFK,

    CASE 
      WHEN sdel.ContainerOutFK > 0 
        THEN ISNULL(dcolt.ContainerOutLoadingType, 'No Restriction')
      ELSE 'No Restriction'
   END AS DeliveryContainerOutLoadingType,  
   sc.DeliveryCount AS [SlotDeliveryCount],                   
    sd.ScheduleDayPK,               
    CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), sd.DayDate, 103) AS [DayDate],              
    sd.DayNumber,              
    sd.StartTime AS [DayStartTime],               
    sd.EndTime AS [DayEndTime],               
    sd.MaxDuration AS [DayDuration],                             
              
    ss.ScheduleSlotPK,              
    -1 AS SchedulePlaceholderPK,               
    ss.StartTime AS [SlotStart],               
    ss.EndTime AS [SlotEnd],              
    ss.ActualDuration AS [SlotDuration],                                
              
    '' AS [PlaceholderTitle],              
    '' AS [PlaceholderColorCode],                                 
              
    sdel.ScheduleDeliveryPK,              
    sdel.[Description] AS [DeliveryDescription],              
    sdel.StartTime AS [DeliveryStartTime],               
    sdel.EndTime AS [DeliveryEndTime],              
    sdel.ActualDuration AS [DeliveryDuration],                                  
              
    CASE               
   WHEN sdel.ContainerInFK > 0 THEN 'Inbound'               
      WHEN sdel.ContainerOutFK > 0 THEN 'Outbound'               
   ELSE NULL               
 END AS DeliveryType,                 
               
    CASE               
   WHEN sdel.ContainerInFK > 0 THEN sdel.ContainerInFK              
   WHEN sdel.ContainerOutFK > 0 THEN sdel.ContainerOutFK               
   ELSE NULL               
 END AS DeliveryContainerFK,                                  
    CASE WHEN sdel.ContainerOutFK > 0 THEN co.GoodsOrderNumber END AS DocketNumber,                                          
    '' AS DocketSupplier,                                   
    CASE WHEN sdel.ContainerOutFK > 0 THEN d2.DivisionCode END AS DocketDivision,       
    CASE WHEN sdel.ContainerOutFK > 0 THEN Outboundlb.LoadingBay END AS LoadingBay,                                   
CASE WHEN sdel.ContainerOutFK > 0 THEN               
 CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), CAST(co.CollectionDate AS DATE), 103) END AS DocketDate,                                 
             
    CASE WHEN sdel.ContainerOutFK > 0 THEN              
        CASE WHEN cdis2.CustomerDocketIdentificationPK IS NULL THEN                                   
            (CASE WHEN co.Docketlabel1 <> '' THEN co.Docketlabel1 + ': ' + co.DocketValue1 ELSE '' END) + ' ' +                                  
            (CASE WHEN co.Docketlabel2 <> '' THEN co.Docketlabel2 + ': ' + co.DocketValue2 ELSE '' END) + ' ' +                                  
            (CASE WHEN co.Docketlabel3 <> '' THEN co.Docketlabel3 + ': ' + co.DocketValue3 ELSE '' END)                                   
        ELSE                                  
            CASE cdis2.FieldFK               
                WHEN 40 THEN cdis2.Prefix + ' ' + co.DocketValue1                                  
                WHEN 41 THEN cdis2.Prefix + ' ' + co.DocketValue2                                  
                WHEN 42 THEN cdis2.Prefix + ' ' + co.DocketValue3                                  
            END + ' ' +                                  
            CASE cdis2.Field2FK               
                WHEN 40 THEN cdis2.Prefix2 + ' ' + co.DocketValue1                                  
                WHEN 41 THEN cdis2.Prefix2 + ' ' + co.DocketValue2                                  
                WHEN 42 THEN cdis2.Prefix2 + ' ' + co.DocketValue3                                  
                ELSE ''                                  
            END                                  
        END               
    ELSE ''              
    END AS CustomerRef,                                 
              
    CASE WHEN sdel.ContainerOutFK > 0 THEN ISNULL(co.ContainerNumber,'') ELSE '' END AS ContainerNumber,                                  
    CASE WHEN sdel.ContainerOutFK > 0 THEN ISNULL(co.LorryNumber,'') ELSE '' END AS LorryNumber,                                  
    CASE WHEN sdel.ContainerOutFK > 0 THEN ISNULL(co.SealNumber,'') ELSE '' END AS SealNumber,              
    CASE WHEN sdel.ContainerOutFK > 0 THEN ISNULL(shp.ShippingCompany,'') ELSE '' END AS ShippingCompany,              
    CASE WHEN sdel.ContainerOutFK > 0 THEN ISNULL(tsp.TransportCompany,'') ELSE '' END AS TransportCompany,              
              
    CAST(sdel.IsArchived AS INT) AS [DeliveryIsArchived],                   
              
    CASE               
        WHEN sdel.ContainerOutFK > 0 THEN                       
            CASE               
                WHEN co.ContainerOutStageFK IN (1,2) THEN 'Pending'                       
                WHEN co.ContainerOutStageFK IN (3,4,5,6,7) THEN 'InProgress'                      
                ELSE 'Completed'               
            END              
    ELSE ''              
    END AS DeliveryStatus,                      
              
 CASE                     
    WHEN sdel.ContainerInFK > 0 OR sdel.ContainerOutFK > 0 THEN                       
    DATEADD(dd, c2.DayCutOff,                     
     CONVERT(DATETIME, FORMAT(sd.DayDate, 'yyyy-MM-dd'))) + CAST(c2.TimeCutOff AS DATETIME)                    
   ELSE                     
    CAST(GETDATE() AS DATETIME)                     
  END AS CustomerCutoff,                        
                    
  CASE                     
   WHEN sdel.ContainerInFK > 0 OR sdel.ContainerOutFK > 0 THEN                       
    CASE                     
     WHEN CONVERT(DATETIME, FORMAT(sd.DayDate, 'yyyy-MM-dd')) + CAST(sd.StartTime AS DATETIME) <=                     
       DATEADD(dd, c2.DayCutOff,                     
       CONVERT(DATETIME, FORMAT(sd.DayDate, 'yyyy-MM-dd'))) + CAST(c2.TimeCutOff AS DATETIME)                     
     THEN 1                     
     ELSE 0      
    END                     
   ELSE                     
    0                     
  END AS DeliveryPastCutOff,                  
 CASE      
    WHEN sdel.ContainerInFK > 0 THEN CAST(1 AS BIT)      
      
    WHEN sdel.ContainerOutFK > 0      
         AND co.ContainerOutStageFK = 1      
  THEN CAST(1 AS BIT)      
       ELSE CAST(0 AS BIT)      
 END AS ContainerOutEditStatus,      
c2.CustomerPK,            
   c2.CustomerCode,            
   c2.CustomerName,            
   d2.DivisionPK,    
   d2.DivisionCode,            
   d2.DivisionName,        
   ISNULL(c2.DefaultDeliveryDurationMinutes,120) As CustomerDeliveryDurationMinutes      
FROM  [dbo].[tblScheduleWeeks] sw                               
INNER JOIN [dbo].[tblScheduleChannels] sc ON sw.ScheduleWeekPK = sc.ScheduleWeekFK                              
INNER JOIN [dbo].[tblScheduleDays] sd ON sc.ScheduleChannelPK = sd.ScheduleChannelFK                               
INNER JOIN [dbo].[tblScheduleSlots] ss ON sd.ScheduleDayPK = ss.ScheduleDayFK                                
LEFT JOIN tblScheduleDeliveries sdel ON sdel.ScheduleSlotFK = ss.ScheduleSlotPK  AND sdel.IsArchived = 0 AND sdel.ContainerOutFK is NOT NULL              
LEFT JOIN tblContainerOutLoading coloading ON coloading.ContainerOutFK = sdel.ContainerOutFK AND coloading.IsArchived = 0
LEFT JOIN appContainerOutLoadingTypes dcolt ON dcolt.ContainerOutLoadingTypePK = coloading.ContainerOutLoadingTypeFK
LEFT JOIN appContainerOutLoadingTypes colt ON colt.ContainerOutLoadingTypePK = sc.ContainerOutLoadingTypeFK  
LEFT JOIN tblContainerOuts co ON sdel.ContainerOutFk = co.ContainerOutPK                
LEFT JOIN tblTransportCompanies tsp ON co.TransportCompanyFK = tsp.TransportCompanyPK              
LEFT JOIN tblShippingCompanies shp ON co.ShippingCompanyFK = shp.ShippingCompanyPK               
LEFT JOIN tblContainerOutLines col ON col.ContainerOutFK = co.ContainerOutPK                
LEFT JOIN tblStockOrders so ON co.ContainerOutPK = so.ContainerOutFK                
INNER JOIN tblBuildingUnits bu ON so.ResponsibleBuildingUnitFK = bu.BuildingUnitPK                
LEFT JOIN tblDivisions d2 ON d2.DivisionPK = col.DivisionFK                            
LEFT JOIN tblCustomers c2 ON d2.CustomerFK = c2.CustomerPK                 
LEFT JOIN tblLoadingBays Outboundlb ON so.PickupLoadingBayFK = Outboundlb.LoadingBayPK                                  
LEFT OUTER JOIN tblCustomerDocketIdentifications cdis2 ON cdis2.CustomerFK = d2.CustomerFK               
      AND cdis2.DocketTypeFK = 2                          
LEFT JOIN tblUsers u ON u.UserPK = @UserFK                        
LEFT JOIN tblUserDivisions ud ON ud.UserFK = @UserFK AND d2.DivisionPK = ud.DivisionFK                        
WHERE sw.BuildingFK = @BuildingFK                              
  AND sw.WeekNumber = @WeekNumber               
  AND sw.Year = @Year                               
  AND (sc.IsArchived = 0 OR sc.IsArchived IS NULL)                              
  AND (sw.IsArchived = 0 OR sw.IsArchived IS NULL)                                  
  AND (sd.IsArchived = 0 OR sd.IsArchived IS NULL)                               
  AND (ss.IsArchived = 0 OR ss.IsArchived IS NULL)                                
  AND (sdel.IsArchived = 0 OR sdel.IsArchived IS NULL)               
  )OutBound                
 )              
  SELECT  IsClientRestricted,                        
  ScheduleWeekPK,                     
  ScheduleName,                
  ScheduleChannelPK,                        
  ChannelName,                         
  ChannelColorCode,                         
  ChannelFreeMode,                        
  ChannelInbound,

  ContainerOutLoadingTypeFK,

   DeliveryContainerOutLoadingTypeFK,

  SlotDeliveryCount,

  CASE WHEN isClientRestricted=1 THEN 'Hidden Info' ELSE DeliveryDescription END AS DeliveryDescription,                         
  DeliveryStartTime,                         
  DeliveryEndTime,                         
  DeliveryDuration,                                  
  DeliveryType,                        
  DeliveryContainerFK,                               
  CASE WHEN isClientRestricted=1 THEN 'Hidden Info' ELSE DocketNumber END AS DocketNumber,                          
  CASE WHEN IsClientRestricted=1 THEN 'Hidden Info' ELSE DocketSupplier END AS DocketSupplier,                          
  CASE WHEN IsClientRestricted=1 THEN 'Hidden Info' ELSE DocketDivision END AS DocketDivision,                         
  LoadingBay,                                   
  DocketDate,                           
  CASE WHEN IsClientRestricted=1 THEN 'Hidden Info' ELSE CustomerRef END AS CustomerRef,              
  CASE WHEN IsClientRestricted=1 THEN 'Hidden Info' ELSE ContainerNumber END AS ContainerNumber,                            
  CASE WHEN IsClientRestricted=1 THEN 'Hidden Info' ELSE LorryNumber END AS LorryNumber,                            
  CASE WHEN IsClientRestricted=1 THEN 'Hidden Info' ELSE SealNumber END AS SealNumber,               
  CASE WHEN IsClientRestricted=1 THEN 'Hidden Info' ELSE ShippingCompany END AS ShippingCompany,               
  CASE WHEN IsClientRestricted=1 THEN 'Hidden Info' ELSE TransportCompany END AS TransportCompany,               
  DeliveryIsArchived ,DeliveryStatus, CustomerCutoff, DeliveryPastCutOff,               
  CustomerPK,            
  CASE WHEN IsClientRestricted=1 THEN 'Hidden Info' ELSE CustomerCode END AS CustomerCode,               
  CASE WHEN IsClientRestricted=1 THEN 'Hidden Info' ELSE CustomerName END AS CustomerName,               
  DivisionPK,    
  CASE WHEN IsClientRestricted=1 THEN 'Hidden Info' ELSE DivisionCode END AS DivisionCode,               
  CASE WHEN IsClientRestricted=1 THEN 'Hidden Info' ELSE DivisionName END AS DivisionName,               
       
   ContainerOutEditStatus,         
   CustomerDeliveryDurationMinutes       
  FROM distinctResults                
  WHERE rn = 1                
               
 UNION                 
  SELECT  IsClientRestricted,             
  ScheduleWeekPK,                     
  ScheduleName,                
  ScheduleChannelPK,                        
  ChannelName,               
  ChannelColorCode,                         
  ChannelFreeMode,                        
  ChannelInbound,                        
  ChannelOutbound,      
  ContainerOutLoadingTypeFK,
  ContainerOutLoadingType,
   DeliveryContainerOutLoadingTypeFK,
  DeliveryContainerOutLoadingType,
  SlotDeliveryCount,                      
  ScheduleDayPK,                         
  DayDate,                 
  DayNumber,                
  DayStartTime,                         
  DayEndTime,                          
  DayDuration,                        
  ScheduleSlotPK,                        
  SchedulePlaceholderPK,                         
  SlotStart,                         
  SlotEnd,                         
  SlotDuration,                        
  PlaceholderTitle,                        
  PlaceholderColorCode,                       
  ScheduleDeliveryPK,                        
  CASE WHEN isClientRestricted=1 THEN 'Hidden Info' ELSE DeliveryDescription END AS DeliveryDescription,                         
  DeliveryStartTime,                         
  DeliveryEndTime,                         
  DeliveryDuration,                                  
  DeliveryType,                                      
  DeliveryContainerFK,                               
  CASE WHEN isClientRestricted=1 THEN 'Hidden Info' ELSE DocketNumber END AS DocketNumber,                          
  CASE WHEN IsClientRestricted=1 THEN 'Hidden Info' ELSE DocketSupplier END AS DocketSupplier,                          
  CASE WHEN IsClientRestricted=1 THEN 'Hidden Info' ELSE DocketDivision END AS DocketDivision,                         
  LoadingBay,                                   
  DocketDate,                           
  CASE WHEN IsClientRestricted=1 THEN 'Hidden Info' ELSE CustomerRef END AS CustomerRef,                        
  CASE WHEN IsClientRestricted=1 THEN 'Hidden Info' ELSE ContainerNumber END AS ContainerNumber,                            
  CASE WHEN IsClientRestricted=1 THEN 'Hidden Info' ELSE LorryNumber END AS LorryNumber,                            
  CASE WHEN IsClientRestricted=1 THEN 'Hidden Info' ELSE SealNumber END AS SealNumber,               
  CASE WHEN IsClientRestricted=1 THEN 'Hidden Info' ELSE ShippingCompany END AS ShippingCompany,               
  CASE WHEN IsClientRestricted=1 THEN 'Hidden Info' ELSE TransportCompany END AS TransportCompany,               
  DeliveryIsArchived ,DeliveryStatus, CustomerCutoff, DeliveryPastCutOff                      
 ,CustomerPK,            
   CASE WHEN IsClientRestricted=1 THEN 'Hidden Info' ELSE CustomerCode END AS CustomerCode,               
  CASE WHEN IsClientRestricted=1 THEN 'Hidden Info' ELSE CustomerName END AS CustomerName,               
  DivisionPK,    
  CASE WHEN IsClientRestricted=1 THEN 'Hidden Info' ELSE DivisionCode END AS DivisionCode,               
  CASE WHEN IsClientRestricted=1 THEN 'Hidden Info' ELSE DivisionName END AS DivisionName,               
     
   ContainerOutEditStatus,         
   CustomerDeliveryDurationMinutes         
  FROM                        
   (                        
     SELECT DISTINCT               
    d.DivisionPK AS Indiv, ud.DivisionFK,                        
       CASE             
        WHEN u.TransportCompanyFK = ci.TransportCompanyFK THEN 0 -- scheduled delivery matching this user          
        ELSE 1                                
     END AS IsClientRestricted,                
              
   sw.ScheduleWeekPK,              
   sw.[Name] AS [ScheduleName],              
   ScheduleChannelPK,               
   sc.[Name] AS [ChannelName],               
   sc.ColorCode AS [ChannelColorCode],              
   sc.FreeMode AS [ChannelFreeMode],               
   sc.AllowInbound AS [ChannelInbound],              
   sc.AllowOutbound AS [ChannelOutbound],  
  ISNULL(sc.ContainerOutLoadingTypeFK,-1) AS ContainerOutLoadingTypeFK,  
  ISNULL(colt.ContainerOutLoadingType,'No Restriction') AS ContainerOutLoadingType,
 -1 AS DeliveryContainerOutLoadingTypeFK,
  'No Restriction' AS DeliveryContainerOutLoadingType,
 sc.DeliveryCount AS [SlotDeliveryCount],               
   sd.ScheduleDayPK,               
   CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), sd.DayDate, 103) AS [DayDate],              
   sd.DayNumber,               
   sd.StartTime AS [DayStartTime],              
   sd.EndTime AS [DayEndTime],              
   sd.MaxDuration AS [DayDuration],                             
              
   ss.ScheduleSlotPK,              
   -1 AS SchedulePlaceholderPK,              
   ss.StartTime AS [SlotStart],              
   ss.EndTime AS [SlotEnd],              
   ss.ActualDuration AS [SlotDuration],                                
              
   '' AS [PlaceholderTitle],              
   '' AS [PlaceholderColorCode],                                 
              
   sdel.ScheduleDeliveryPK,              
   sdel.[Description] AS [DeliveryDescription],              
   sdel.StartTime AS [DeliveryStartTime],              
   sdel.EndTime AS [DeliveryEndTime],              
   sdel.ActualDuration AS [DeliveryDuration],              
              
    CASE               
   WHEN sdel.ContainerInFK > 0 THEN 'Inbound'               
      WHEN sdel.ContainerOutFK > 0 THEN 'Outbound'               
   ELSE NULL               
 END AS DeliveryType,                 
               
    CASE               
   WHEN sdel.ContainerInFK > 0 THEN sdel.ContainerInFK              
   WHEN sdel.ContainerOutFK > 0 THEN sdel.ContainerOutFK               
   ELSE NULL               
 END AS DeliveryContainerFK,                   
   CASE WHEN sdel.ContainerInFK > 0 THEN ci.GoodsInNumber ELSE ' ' END AS DocketNumber,               
   CASE WHEN sdel.ContainerInFK > 0 THEN InboundSup.Supplier ELSE '' END AS DocketSupplier,                                   
   CASE WHEN sdel.ContainerInFK > 0 THEN d.DivisionCode ELSE ' ' END AS DocketDivision,                                   
   CASE WHEN sdel.ContainerInFK > 0 THEN Inboundlb.LoadingBay END AS LoadingBay,                                   
   CASE WHEN sdel.ContainerInFK > 0 THEN               
   CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), CAST(ci.DateIn AS DATE), 103) END AS DocketDate,              
              
   CASE WHEN sdel.ContainerInFK > 0 THEN               
       CASE WHEN cdis.CustomerDocketIdentificationPK IS NOT NULL THEN                                   
            (CASE cdis.FieldFK WHEN 1 THEN ci.Free1 WHEN 2 THEN ci.Free2 WHEN 3 THEN ci.Free3               
                                WHEN 4 THEN ci.Free4 WHEN 5 THEN ci.Free5 ELSE ' ' END)              
            + ' ' +              
            (CASE cdis.Field2FK WHEN 1 THEN ci.Free1 WHEN 2 THEN ci.Free2 WHEN 3 THEN ci.Free3               
                                WHEN 4 THEN ci.Free4 WHEN 5 THEN ci.Free5 ELSE ' ' END)              
            + ' ' +              
            (CASE cdis.Field3FK WHEN 1 THEN ci.Free1 WHEN 2 THEN ci.Free2 WHEN 3 THEN ci.Free3               
                                WHEN 4 THEN ci.Free4 WHEN 5 THEN ci.Free5 ELSE ' ' END)              
       ELSE ' ' END              
       + ' ' + COALESCE(NULLIF(ci.ExternalReference,''),' ')              
   ELSE ' '               
   END AS CustomerRef,              
              
   CASE WHEN sdel.ContainerInFK > 0 THEN ISNULL(ci.[ContainerNumber],'') ELSE '' END AS ContainerNumber,                                  
   CASE WHEN sdel.ContainerInFK > 0 THEN ISNULL(ci.[LorryNumber],'') ELSE '' END AS LorryNumber,                                  
   CASE WHEN sdel.ContainerInFK > 0 THEN ISNULL(ci.[SealNumber],'') ELSE '' END AS SealNumber,              
   CASE WHEN sdel.ContainerInFK > 0 THEN ISNULL(shp.ShippingCompany,'') ELSE '' END AS ShippingCompany,              
   CASE WHEN sdel.ContainerInFK > 0 THEN ISNULL(tsp.TransportCompany,'') ELSE '' END AS TransportCompany,              
   CAST(sdel.IsArchived AS INT) AS [DeliveryIsArchived],                      
   CASE WHEN sdel.ContainerInFK > 0 THEN sist.StockInStatus ELSE '' END AS DeliveryStatus,                      
              
  CASE                     
    WHEN sdel.ContainerInFK > 0 OR sdel.ContainerOutFK > 0 THEN                       
    DATEADD(dd, c.DayCutOff,                     
     CONVERT(DATETIME, FORMAT(sd.DayDate, 'yyyy-MM-dd'))) + CAST(c.TimeCutOff AS DATETIME)                    
   ELSE                     
    CAST(GETDATE() AS DATETIME)                     
  END AS CustomerCutoff,                        
                    
  CASE                     
   WHEN sdel.ContainerInFK > 0 OR sdel.ContainerOutFK > 0 THEN                       
    CASE                     
     WHEN CONVERT(DATETIME, FORMAT(sd.DayDate, 'yyyy-MM-dd')) + CAST(sd.StartTime AS DATETIME) <=                     
       DATEADD(dd, c.DayCutOff,                     
       CONVERT(DATETIME, FORMAT(sd.DayDate, 'yyyy-MM-dd'))) + CAST(c.TimeCutOff AS DATETIME)                     
     THEN 1                     
     ELSE 0                     
    END                     
   ELSE                     
    0                     
  END AS DeliveryPastCutOff,               
    CASE      
    WHEN sdel.ContainerInFK > 0 THEN CAST(1 AS BIT)      
    ELSE CAST(0 AS BIT)      
 END AS ContainerOutEditStatus,      
   c.CustomerPK,            
   c.CustomerCode,            
   c.CustomerName,            
   d.DivisionPK,    
   d.DivisionCode,            
   d.DivisionName,        
   ISNULL(c.DefaultDeliveryDurationMinutes,120) As CustomerDeliveryDurationMinutes      
          
FROM [dbo].[tblScheduleWeeks] sw                               
INNER JOIN [dbo].[tblScheduleChannels] sc ON sw.ScheduleWeekPK = sc.ScheduleWeekFK                              
INNER JOIN [dbo].[tblScheduleDays] sd ON sc.ScheduleChannelPK = sd.ScheduleChannelFK     
INNER JOIN [dbo].[tblScheduleSlots] ss ON sd.ScheduleDayPK = ss.ScheduleDayFK                                
LEFT JOIN tblScheduleDeliveries sdel ON sdel.ScheduleSlotFK = ss.ScheduleSlotPK               
AND sdel.IsArchived = 0 AND sdel.ContainerInFK is NOT NULL     
LEFT JOIN appContainerOutLoadingTypes colt ON colt.ContainerOutLoadingTypePK = sc.ContainerOutLoadingTypeFK  
LEFT JOIN tblContainerIns ci ON sdel.ContainerInFK = ci.ContainerInPK                
LEFT JOIN tblTransportCompanies tsp ON ci.TransportCompanyFK = tsp.TransportCompanyPK                    
LEFT JOIN tblShippingCompanies shp ON ci.ShippingCompanyFK = shp.ShippingCompanyPK                 
LEFT JOIN tblStockIns si ON ci.ContainerInPK = si.ContainerInFK                            
LEFT JOIN appStockInStatus sist ON sist.StockInStatusPK = si.StockInStatusFK                      
LEFT JOIN tblDivisions d ON si.DivisionFK = d.DivisionPK                                  
LEFT JOIN tblCustomers c ON d.CustomerFK = c.CustomerPK                      
LEFT JOIN tblSuppliers InboundSup ON ci.SupplierFK = InboundSup.SupplierPK                                  
LEFT JOIN tblLoadingBays Inboundlb ON ci.LoadingBayFK = Inboundlb.LoadingBayPK                                  
LEFT JOIN tblCustomerDocketIdentifications cdis ON cdis.CustomerFK = d.CustomerFK AND cdis.DocketTypeFK = 1                                  
LEFT JOIN tblUsers u ON u.UserPK = @UserFK                        
LEFT JOIN tblUserDivisions ud ON ud.UserFK = @UserFK AND d.DivisionPK = ud.DivisionFK                        
WHERE sw.BuildingFK = @BuildingFK                              
  AND sw.WeekNumber = @WeekNumber               
  AND sw.Year = @Year                               
  AND (sc.IsArchived = 0 OR sc.IsArchived IS NULL)                              
  AND (sw.IsArchived = 0 OR sw.IsArchived IS NULL)                                  
  AND (sd.IsArchived = 0 OR sd.IsArchived IS NULL)                               
  AND (ss.IsArchived = 0 OR ss.IsArchived IS NULL)                                
  AND (sdel.IsArchived = 0 OR sdel.IsArchived IS NULL)                
 )Inbound              
             
 UNION                      
 --PLACEHOLDER QUERY                    
 SELECT IsClientRestricted,                        
   ScheduleWeekPK,                 
   ScheduleName,                       
   ScheduleChannelPK,                        
   ChannelName,                         
   ChannelColorCode,                         
   ChannelFreeMode,                        
   ChannelInbound,                        
   ChannelOutbound,      
   ContainerOutLoadingTypeFK,
   ContainerOutLoadingType,
   DeliveryContainerOutLoadingTypeFK,
   DeliveryContainerOutLoadingType,
   SlotDeliveryCount,                      
   ScheduleDayPK,                         
   DayDate,                 
   DayNumber,

   SchedulePlaceholderPK,

   CASE WHEN IsClientRestricted=1 THEN 'Hidden Info' ELSE PlaceholderTitle END AS PlaceholderTitle,                       
   PlaceholderColorCode,

   CASE WHEN IsClientRestricted=1 THEN 'Hidden Info' ELSE DeliveryDescription END AS DeliveryDescription,                         
   DeliveryStartTime,                         
   DeliveryEndTime,                         
   DeliveryDuration,                                  
   DeliveryType,                                      
   DeliveryContainerFK,                               
   CASE WHEN IsClientRestricted=1 THEN 'Hidden Info' ELSE DocketNumber END AS DocketNumber,                          
   CASE WHEN IsClientRestricted=1 THEN 'Hidden Info' ELSE DocketSupplier END AS DocketSupplier,                          
   CASE WHEN IsClientRestricted=1 THEN 'Hidden Info' ELSE DocketDivision END AS DocketDivision,                         
   LoadingBay,                                   
   DocketDate,                           
   CASE WHEN IsClientRestricted=1 THEN 'Hidden Info' ELSE CustomerRef END AS CustomerRef,                          
   CASE WHEN IsClientRestricted=1 THEN 'Hidden Info' ELSE ContainerNumber END AS ContainerNumber,                            
   CASE WHEN IsClientRestricted=1 THEN 'Hidden Info' ELSE LorryNumber END AS LorryNumber,                            
   CASE WHEN IsClientRestricted=1 THEN 'Hidden Info' ELSE SealNumber END AS SealNumber,                 
   CASE WHEN IsClientRestricted=1 THEN 'Hidden Info' ELSE ShippingCompany END AS ShippingCompany,               
   CASE WHEN IsClientRestricted=1 THEN 'Hidden Info' ELSE TransportCompany END AS TransportCompany,               
   DeliveryIsArchived ,DeliveryStatus, CustomerCutoff, DeliveryPastCutOff,                      
   CustomerPK,            
  CASE WHEN IsClientRestricted=1 THEN 'Hidden Info' ELSE CustomerCode END AS CustomerCode,               
  CASE WHEN IsClientRestricted=1 THEN 'Hidden Info' ELSE CustomerName END AS CustomerName,               
  DivisionPK,    
  CASE WHEN IsClientRestricted=1 THEN 'Hidden Info' ELSE DivisionCode END AS DivisionCode,               
  CASE WHEN IsClientRestricted=1 THEN 'Hidden Info' ELSE DivisionName END AS DivisionName,               
      
   ContainerOutEditStatus,         
   CustomerDeliveryDurationMinutes      
 FROM(                    
  SELECT DISTINCT                         
     CASE         
      WHEN u.UserTypeFK = 5 THEN 1                  
      ELSE 0      --matches - let them see this info                   
     END AS IsClientRestricted,                          
     sw.ScheduleWeekPK,sw.[Name][ScheduleName], sc.ScheduleChannelPK, sc.[Name][ChannelName], sc.ColorCode[ChannelColorCode], sc.FreeMode[ChannelFreeMode],               
  sc.AllowInbound[ChannelInbound] , sc.AllowOutbound[ChannelOutbound],
  ISNULL(sc.ContainerOutLoadingTypeFK,-1) AS ContainerOutLoadingTypeFK,  
  ISNULL(colt.ContainerOutLoadingType,'No Restriction') AS ContainerOutLoadingType,
  -1 AS DeliveryContainerOutLoadingTypeFK,
  'No Restriction' AS DeliveryContainerOutLoadingType,
  sc.DeliveryCount[SlotDeliveryCount],                                 
     sd.ScheduleDayPK, CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), sd.DayDate, 103) As [DayDate],sd.DayNumber, sd.StartTime[DayStartTime], sd.EndTime[DayEndTime], sd.MaxDuration[DayDuration],                        
    -1 ScheduleSlotPK, sph.SchedulePlaceholderPK, sph.StartTime[SlotStart], sph.EndTime[SlotEnd],sph.ActualDuration[SlotDuration],                            
    CASE WHEN sph.Title = '' THEN                                   
    CASE WHEN sph.customerfk > 0 THEN c.CustomerName ELSE su.Supplier end                               
    ELSE sph.Title END AS PlaceholderTitle,                               
    sph.ColorCode as PlaceholderColorCode,                                  
    -1 ScheduleDeliveryPK,                    
 CASE WHEN sph.[Description] = '' OR sph.[Description] IS NULL THEN sph.Title                
 ELSE CONCAT(sph.Title, ' ', sph.[Description])  END AS [DeliveryDescription],                  
                  
 sph.StartTime[DeliveryStartTime], sph.EndTime[DeliveryEndTime], sph.ActualDuration[DeliveryDuration],                                  
    'Placeholder' as DeliveryType,                            
    -1 as DeliveryContainerFK,                                  
    '' as DocketNumber,                                  
    CASE WHEN sph.SupplierFK > 0 THEN su.Supplier ELSE '' END AS DocketSupplier,                                   
    CASE WHEN sph.CustomerFK > 0 THEN c.CustomerCode ELSE '' END AS DocketDivision,                                   
    '' as LoadingBay,                                   
    CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), sd.[DayDate], 103) as DocketDate,                                  
    '' as CustomerRef,                                  
    ''[ContainerNumber],                           
    ''[LorryNumber],                           
    ''[SealNumber],                
    ''[ShippingCompany],              
    ''[TransportCompany],               
    0 as [DeliveryIsArchived],                      
    '' as DeliveryStatus,                         
   DATEADD(dd,                     
   CASE WHEN c.customerpk IS NULL THEN 2 ELSE c.DayCutOff end,                     
   CAST(GETDATE() AS DATETIME)) + CASE WHEN c.TimeCutOff IS NULL THEN '10:00:00' ELSE CAST(c.TimeCutOff AS DATETIME) END AS CustomerCutoff,                    
  CASE                     
   when CAST(sd.DayDate AS DATETIME) + CAST(sd.StartTime AS DATETIME) <=                      
DATEADD(dd, CASE WHEN c.customerpk IS NULL THEN 2 ELSE c.DayCutOff end,                     
     CAST(GETDATE() AS DATETIME)) + CAST(c.TimeCutOff AS DATETIME)                     
   THEN 1                     
   ELSE 0                     
   END AS DeliveryPastCutOff ,      
  CAST(1 AS BIT) AS ContainerOutEditStatus,      
  c.CustomerPK,            
   c.CustomerCode,            
   c.CustomerName,            
   d.DivisionPK,    
   d.DivisionCode,            
   d.DivisionName,   
   ISNULL(c.DefaultDeliveryDurationMinutes,120) As CustomerDeliveryDurationMinutes      
   FROM [dbo].[tblScheduleWeeks] sw                               
  INNER JOIN [dbo].[tblScheduleChannels] sc ON sw.ScheduleWeekPK = sc.ScheduleWeekFK                              
  INNER JOIN [dbo].[tblScheduleDays] sd ON sc.ScheduleChannelPK = sd.ScheduleChannelFK                                  
  INNER JOIN tblSchedulePlaceholders sph on sph.ScheduleDayFK = sd.ScheduleDayPK                                 
  LEFT JOIN appContainerOutLoadingTypes colt ON colt.ContainerOutLoadingTypePK = sc.ContainerOutLoadingTypeFK  
  LEFT JOIN tblcustomers c on sph.CustomerFK = c.CustomerPK                           
  LEFT JOIN tblDivisions d ON d.CustomerFK = c.CustomerPK                             
  LEFT JOIN tblUserDivisions ud on ud.UserFK=@userfk AND (d.DivisionPK=ud.DivisionFK OR ud.UserFK=@Userfk)                        
  LEFT JOIN [dbo].[tblusers] u on u.UserPK = @userfk                        
  LEFT JOIN tblSuppliers su on sph.SupplierFK = su.SupplierPK   
  WHERE sw.BuildingFK =@BuildingFK                              
  AND sw.WeekNumber=@WeekNumber                       
  AND sw.Year=@Year                               
  AND (sc.IsArchived = 0 OR sc.IsArchived IS NULL)                              
  AND (sw.IsArchived = 0 OR sw.IsArchived IS NULL)                                  
  AND (sd.IsArchived = 0 OR sd.IsArchived IS NULL)                                
  AND (sph.IsArchived = 0 or sph.IsArchived IS NULL)                        
  )SPH              
);

CREATE  VIEW [dbo].[viewCustomers]  
AS  
SELECT    
CustomerPK AS PK,
'/images/Customer.png' AS ImagePath, 
0 AS IsFiltered, 
c.IsArchived, 
c.CustomerName AS [Customer Name], 
CustomerCode, 
c.TelephoneNumber AS [Telephone Number], 
CustomerType, 
CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), c.ContractRenewalDate, 103) AS [Contract Renewal Date],
c.RenewalReminderInterval AS [Renewal Reminder Interval],
c.RenewalAlertEmail AS [Renewal Alert Email]  
FROM  dbo.tblCustomers c  
INNER JOIN appCustomerTypes ct on c.CustomerTypeFK = ct.CustomerTypePK  
GO

CREATE VIEW [dbo].[viewPalletTypes]

SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO

GO
CREATE VIEW [dbo].[viewCustomersDetail]
AS
SELECT     CustomerPK AS PK, '/images/Customer.png' AS ImagePath, 0 AS IsFiltered, cust.IsArchived, CustomerName [Customer Name], CustomerCode [Customer Code], TelephoneNumber [Telephone Number], 
DivisionCounter [Divisions], StockItemCategoryCounter [Categories], ContactCounter [Contacts]
FROM         dbo.tblCustomers cust
LEFT JOIN (SELECT CustomerFK, count(DivisionPK) AS DivisionCounter FROM tbldivisions GROUP BY CustomerFK) divs ON divs.CustomerFK = cust.CustomerPK
LEFT JOIN (SELECT CustomerFK, count(StockItemCategoryPK) AS StockItemCategoryCounter FROM tblStockItemCategories GROUP BY CustomerFK) sic ON sic.CustomerFK = cust.CustomerPK
LEFT JOIN (SELECT FK as CustomerFK, count(ContactPK) AS ContactCounter FROM tblContacts WHERE ContactTypeFK = 1 GROUP BY FK) con ON con.CustomerFK = cust.CustomerPK

--SELECT TOP 100 * FROM tblContacts
GO
/****** Object:  View [dbo].[viewRackingLocations]    Script Date: 02/11/2026 17:47:23 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO



CREATE VIEW [dbo].[viewRackingLocations]
AS
SELECT      
	BuildingUnitBayPK,	
		case when buRows.Translate = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ then
			buRows.TranslatedRow
		else buRows.Row END +
		Right('0' + case when buRows.Translate = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ then
			case when buRows.ReverseTranslate = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ then
				cast(buRows.TranslateColumn - buCols.BuildingUnitColumn as nvarchar(50))
			else
				cast(buCols.BuildingUnitColumn + buRows.TranslateColumn as nvarchar(50))
			end
		else
			cast(buCols.BuildingUnitColumn as nvarchar(50))
		End, 2) +
		lower(buBays.BayLevel) as Location,
	buRows.BuildingUnitFK,
	buRows.Row,
	buCols.BuildingUnitColumn,
	buBays.BayLevel,
	buRows.RackingTypeFK

FROM         dbo.tblBuildingUnitBays buBays
inner join tblBuildingUnitColumns buCols on
buCols.BuildingUnitColumnPK = buBays.BuildingUnitColumnFK
inner join tblBuildingUnitRows buRows on
buRows.BuildingUnitRowPK = buCols.BuildingUnitRowFK


GO

-- SELECT * FROM [dbo].[fnGetScheduleActivitiesForBuilding](30) ORDER BY ScheduleActivityPK DESC
            
-- SELECT * FROM [dbo].[fnGetScheduleActivitiesForBuilding](8)ORDER BY ScheduleActivityPK DESC         
     
-- =============================================                  
-- Author:  <Archana Singh>                  
-- Create date: <13/12/2023>                  
-- Description: <Description,,>                  
-- =============================================             
            
CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[fnGetScheduleActivitiesForBuilding]            
(              
  @BuildingFK INT  
)            
RETURNS TABLE            
AS            
RETURN             
(            
   SELECT            
     sa.ScheduleActivityPK,sa.BuildingFK, p.FirstName + ' ' + p.LastName AS Person,sa.Comments,            
        sat.ScheduleActivityType, FORMAT(sa.InsertedDate, 'dd/MM/yy HH:mm:ss') AS [InsertedDate]             
    FROM  tblScheduleActivities sa            
    INNER JOIN tblUsers u ON sa.InsertedBy = u.UserPK            
    INNER JOIN tblPeople p ON u.PersonFK = p.PersonPK            
    INNER JOIN appScheduleActivityTypes sat ON sa.ScheduleActivityTypeFK = sat.ScheduleActivityTypePK            
    LEFT JOIN tblScheduleDeliveries sd ON sd.ScheduleDeliveryPK = sa.ScheduleDeliveryFK            
    LEFT JOIN tblSchedulePlaceholders sp ON sp.SchedulePlaceholderPK = sa.SchedulePlaceholderFK            
    WHERE sa.BuildingFK=@BuildingFK   
 ); 
GO

/****** Object:  UserDefinedFunction [dbo].[fnGetValuesForAddStockInLine]    Script Date: 02/11/2026 17:47:23 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
-- SELECT * FROM dbo.fnGetValuesForAddStockInLine(189136, '7332565016879',630);    
      
-- =============================================          
-- Author:  <Archana Singh>          
-- Create date: <15/02/2023>          
-- Description: <Description,,>          
-- =============================================      
    
CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[fnGetValuesForAddStockInLine]    
(      
      @ContainerInPK int,  
      @StockItemEANCode nvarchar(300),  
   @DivisionFK int  
)    
RETURNS TABLE    
AS    
RETURN(  
     
SELECT si.StockInPK[StockInFK] ,sit.StockItemPK [StockItemFK], sty.SpecialStockTypeFK, div.CustomerFK, 
ci.BuildingUnitFK, ci.StockInStatusFK, ci.LoadingBayFK, sit.EANCode [StockEanCode]  
 FROM   tblContainerIns ci  
 INNER JOIN tblContainerInHeaders cih ON cih.ContainerInFK = ci.ContainerInPK   
    INNER JOIN tblStockIns si ON cih.ContainerInFK = si.ContainerInFK   
    INNER JOIN tblStockItems sit ON cih.StockItemFK = sit.StockItemPK    
 INNER JOIN tblStockItemSpecialStockTypes sty ON sty.StockItemFK = sit.StockItemPK  
 LEFT JOIN tblDivisions div ON div.DivisionPK=@DivisionFK  
   WHERE cih.ContainerInFK = @ContainerInPK    
    AND (sit.EANCode = @StockItemEANCode OR sit.EANCode2 = @StockItemEANCode)   
 ) ;  
  
GO
/****** Object:  View [dbo].[viewPalletContent]    Script Date: 02/11/2026 17:47:23 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO


CREATE VIEW [dbo].[viewPalletContent]  
AS
SELECT     PalletFK, 
			sis.DivisionFK, 
			divs.CustomerFK, 
			pals.PalletStatusFK,
			pals.PalletTypeFK, 
			pals.Barcode,
			pals.CustomerBarcode,
			StockItemFK, 
			StockItemCode, 
			Batch, 
			sum(ActualUnits) ActualUnits, 
			sum(AvailableUnits) AvailableUnits,
			COUNT_BIG(*) AS COUNT,			
			pc.SupplierBatch
FROM dbo.tblPalletContent pc
inner join dbo.tblPallets pals on
pals.PalletPK = pc.PalletFK
inner join dbo.tblStockItems sis on
sis.StockItemPK = pc.StockItemFK
inner join dbo.tblDivisions divs on
divs.DivisionPK = sis.DivisionFK
Where pc.IsArchived = 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/
AND pals.IsMixedPallet = 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/
AND PalletFK <> -1
Group By PalletFK, PalletTypeFK, pals.Barcode, pals.CustomerBarcode, StockItemFK, StockItemCode, Batch, pals.PalletStatusFK, sis.DivisionFK, divs.CustomerFK, pc.SupplierBatch
GO
/****** Object:  UserDefinedFunction [dbo].[fnGetScheduleChannelTemplatesForBuildingWithWeekTemplatePK]    Script Date: 02/11/2026 17:47:23 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
  
  
-- SELECT * FROM [dbo].[fnGetScheduleChannelTemplatesForBuildingWithWeekTemplatePK](11, 1)    
    
-- =============================================      
-- Author:  <Archana Singh>      
-- Create date: <14/12/2023>      
-- Description: <Description,,>      
-- =============================================      
    
CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[fnGetScheduleChannelTemplatesForBuildingWithWeekTemplatePK]    
(      
  @BuildingFK INT,   
  @WeekTemplatePK INT      
)    
RETURNS TABLE   
AS    
RETURN   
(       
 SELECT swt.BuildingFK,swt.ScheduleWeekTemplatePK, swt.[Name][ScheduleName],   
 sct.ScheduleChannelTemplatePK,   
 sct.[Name][ChannelName],   
 sct.FreeMode, sct.AllowOutbound,     
 sct.AllowInbound, sct.ColorCode,  
 ISNULL(sct.ContainerOutLoadingTypeFK,-1) AS ContainerOutLoadingTypeFK,  
 ISNULL(colt.ContainerOutLoadingType,'No Restriction') AS ContainerOutLoadingType
 FROM tblScheduleWeekTemplates swt  
 INNER JOIN tblScheduleChannelTemplates sct ON swt.ScheduleWeekTemplatePK = @WeekTemplatePK  
 LEFT JOIN appContainerOutLoadingTypes colt ON colt.ContainerOutLoadingTypePK = sct.ContainerOutLoadingTypeFK  
   WHERE swt.BuildingFK= @BuildingFK    
    AND (sct.IsArchived = 0 OR sct.IsArchived is NULL)    
    AND (swt.IsArchived = 0 OR swt.IsArchived is NULL)      
    
 );  
GO

CREATE VIEW [dbo].[tmpViewDanoneSFG_Upload]
AS
Select * FROM (
SELECT   
	Field2 as location,
	Field3 as MaterialLegacy,  
	Field4 as BatchLegacy,
	Field5 as PalletNumber,
	Field6 as QuantityLegacy,
	Field35 as BestBefore,
	Field58 as MaterialSAP,
	Field59 as BatchSAP,
	Field63 as VendorBatch,
	Field68 as SSCC,
	Field69 as QuantitySAP,
	Field70 as UOM,
	Field71 as GuardianStatus,
	Field72 as PositiveRelease,
	Field73 as SAPStatus,
	Field74 as Grading,
	Field60 as DateOfManufacture
FROM         dbo.tmpDanoneSFG_Upload
UNION ALL
SELECT   
	Field2 as location,
	Field43 as MaterialLegacy,  
	Field4 as BatchLegacy,
	Field5 as PalletNumber,
	Field6 as QuantityLegacy,
	Field35 as BestBefore,
	Field57 as MaterialSAP,
	Field58 as BatchSAP,
	Field62 as VendorBatch,
	Field67 as SSCC,
	Field68 as QuantitySAP,
	Field69 as UOM,
	Field70 as GuardianStatus,
	Field71 as PositiveRelease,
	Field72 as SAPStatus,
	Field73 as Grading,
	Field59 as DateOfManufacture
FROM         dbo.tmpDanoneSFG2_Upload
UNION ALL
SELECT   
	Field2 as location,
	Field44 as MaterialLegacy,  
	Field4 as BatchLegacy,
	Field5 as PalletNumber,
	Field6 as QuantityLegacy,
	--Field35 as BestBefore,
	convert(DATETIME, Field35, 104) BestBefore,
	Field43 as MaterialSAP,
	Field51 as BatchSAP,
	Field55 as VendorBatch,
	Field60 as SSCC,
	Field61 as QuantitySAP,
	Field62 as UOM,
	Field63 as GuardianStatus,
	Field64 as PositiveRelease,
	Field65 as SAPStatus,
	Field66 as Grading,
	Field52 as DateOfManufacture
FROM         dbo.tmpDanoneSFG3_Upload
)subQ
Where Location = 8
GO
/****** Object:  UserDefinedFunction [dbo].[fnGetScheduleWeekTemplatesForBuilding]    Script Date: 02/11/2026 17:47:23 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
  
   
-- SELECT * FROM [dbo].[fnGetScheduleWeekTemplatesForBuilding](30) ORDER BY Name
    
       
-- =============================================        
-- Author:  <Archana Singh>        
-- Create date: <13/12/2023>        
-- Description: <Description,,>        
-- =============================================        
      
CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[fnGetScheduleWeekTemplatesForBuilding]      
(        
  @BuildingFK INT      
)  
RETURNS TABLE  
AS      
RETURN  
(    
  SELECT Distinct s.ScheduleWeekTemplatePK, s.[Name][Name]  
  FROM [dbo].[tblScheduleWeekTemplates] s                        
  WHERE s.BuildingFK = @BuildingFK    
    AND (s.IsArchived = 0 OR s.IsArchived is NULL)   
  );  
GO

CREATE VIEW [dbo].[tmpViewPallets]
AS
SELECT     
pals.PalletPK,
sis.StockItemCode,
pc.PalletContentPK,
pc.Batch,
pc.ActualUnits,
pafvsPalletNumber.PalletAdditionalFieldValue PalletNumber,
pafvsTransferNumber.PalletAdditionalFieldValue TransferNumber,
sis.StockItemPK,
sis.DivisionFK,
pa.EventDate DateIn,
pals.Barcode,
pals.CustomerBArcode,
CASE WHEN pals.PalletStatusFK = 10 
	THEN cast(1 as bit)
	ELSE cast(0 as bit)
END as InTransit,
pals.PalletStatusFK
FROM         dbo.tblPallets pals
inner join tblPalletContent pc on
pc.PalletFK = pals.PalletPK
inner join tblStockItems sis on
sis.StockItemPK = pc.StockItemFK
left outer join tblPalletAudit pa on
pa.PalletFK = pals.PalletPK
AND
pa.EventTypeFK = 1 /*Date IN*/
left outer join tblPalletAdditionalFieldValues pafvsPalletNumber on
pafvsPalletNumber.PalletFK = pals.PalletPK
AND
pafvsPalletNumber.PalletAdditionalFieldFK = 3771/*3769*/

left outer join tblPalletAdditionalFieldValues pafvsTransferNumber on
pafvsTransferNumber.PalletFK = pals.PalletPK
AND
pafvsTransferNumber.PalletAdditionalFieldFK = 3772/*3770*/

Where pals.IsArchived = 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/
--AND pals.PalletStatusFK <> 10 /*Not on route*/

Group by pals.PalletPK,
sis.StockItemCode,
pc.PalletContentPK,
pc.Batch,
pc.ActualUnits,
pafvsPalletNumber.PalletAdditionalFieldValue,
pafvsTransferNumber.PalletAdditionalFieldValue,
sis.StockItemPK,
sis.DivisionFK,
pa.EventDate,
pals.PalletStatusFK,
pals.Barcode,
pals.CustomerBarcode
GO
/****** Object:  View [dbo].[viewBuildings]    Script Date: 02/11/2026 17:47:23 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON

CREATE VIEW [dbo].[viewBuildings]  
AS  
SELECT     BuildingPK AS PK, '/images/Building.png' AS ImagePath, 0 AS IsFiltered, IsArchived, BuildingName, case len(Address1) when 0 Then '' Else Address1 + ', ' end + case len(Address2) when 0 Then '' Else Address2 + ', ' end + case len(Address3) when 
0 Then '' Else Address3 + ', ' end + case len(Address4) when 0 Then '' Else Address4 + ', ' end + case len(Address5) when 0 Then '' Else Address5 + ', ' end as Address, TelephoneNumber, FaxNumber  
FROM         dbo.tblBuildings where IsArchived=0
GO
/****** Object:  UserDefinedFunction [dbo].[fnGetScheduleWeekForEditByScheduleWeekPK]    Script Date: 02/11/2026 17:47:23 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
    
-- SELECT * FROM [dbo].[fnGetScheduleWeekForEditByScheduleWeekPK](3) ORDER BY ChannelName ASC, DayDate ASC              
                
                   
-- =============================================                    
-- Author:  <Archana Singh>                    
-- Create date: <14/07/2025>                    
-- Description: <Description,,>                    
-- =============================================                    
              
CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[fnGetScheduleWeekForEditByScheduleWeekPK]                  
(                    
  @ScheduleWeekPK INT                
)              
RETURNS TABLE              
AS                  
RETURN              
(          
 WITH distinctResults AS        
 (        
    SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY DeliveryContainerFK ORDER BY LoadingBay ASC) AS rn        
    FROM         
    (            
      SELECT DISTINCT   
  sw.ScheduleWeekPK,  
    sw.[Name] AS [ScheduleName],   
    ScheduleChannelPK,  
    sc.[Name] AS [ChannelName],   
    sc.ColorCode AS [ChannelColorCode],  
    sc.FreeMode AS [ChannelFreeMode],   
    sc.AllowInbound AS [ChannelInbound],   
    sc.AllowOutbound AS [ChannelOutbound],  
    -- Channel delivery type
    ISNULL(sc.ContainerOutLoadingTypeFK,-1) AS ContainerOutLoadingTypeFK,  
    ISNULL(colt.ContainerOutLoadingType,'No Restriction') AS ContainerOutLoadingType,
    
    -- Actual delivery/container-out type
    CASE 
      WHEN sdel.ContainerOutFK > 0 
        THEN ISNULL(coloading.ContainerOutLoadingTypeFK, -1)
       ELSE -1
     END AS DeliveryContainerOutLoadingTypeFK,

    CASE 
      WHEN sdel.ContainerOutFK > 0 
        THEN ISNULL(dcolt.ContainerOutLoadingType, 'No Restriction')
      ELSE 'No Restriction'
   END AS DeliveryContainerOutLoadingType, 

    sc.DeliveryCount AS [SlotDeliveryCount],   
  
    sd.ScheduleDayPK,   
    CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), sd.DayDate, 103) AS [DayDate],  
    sd.DayNumber,  
    sd.StartTime AS [DayStartTime],   
    sd.EndTime AS [DayEndTime],   
    sd.MaxDuration AS [DayDuration],                 
  
    ss.ScheduleSlotPK,  
    -1 AS SchedulePlaceholderPK,   
    ss.StartTime AS [SlotStart],   
    ss.EndTime AS [SlotEnd],  
    ss.ActualDuration AS [SlotDuration],                    
  
    '' AS [PlaceholderTitle],  
    '' AS [PlaceholderColorCode],                     
  
    sdel.ScheduleDeliveryPK,  
    sdel.[Description] AS [DeliveryDescription],  
    sdel.StartTime AS [DeliveryStartTime],   
    sdel.EndTime AS [DeliveryEndTime],  
    sdel.ActualDuration AS [DeliveryDuration],                      
  
    CASE   
   WHEN sdel.ContainerInFK > 0 THEN 'Inbound'   
      WHEN sdel.ContainerOutFK > 0 THEN 'Outbound'   
   ELSE NULL   
 END AS DeliveryType,     
   
    CASE   
   WHEN sdel.ContainerInFK > 0 THEN sdel.ContainerInFK  
   WHEN sdel.ContainerOutFK > 0 THEN sdel.ContainerOutFK   
   ELSE NULL   
 END AS DeliveryContainerFK,                      
    CASE WHEN sdel.ContainerOutFK > 0 THEN co.GoodsOrderNumber END AS DocketNumber,                              
    '' AS DocketSupplier,                       
    CASE WHEN sdel.ContainerOutFK > 0 THEN d2.DivisionCode END AS DocketDivision,                       
    CASE WHEN sdel.ContainerOutFK > 0 THEN Outboundlb.LoadingBay END AS LoadingBay,                       
    CASE WHEN sdel.ContainerOutFK > 0 THEN   
 CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), CAST(co.CollectionDate AS DATE), 103) END AS DocketDate,                     
  
    CASE WHEN sdel.ContainerOutFK > 0 THEN  
        CASE WHEN cdis2.CustomerDocketIdentificationPK IS NULL THEN                       
            (CASE WHEN co.Docketlabel1 <> '' THEN co.Docketlabel1 + ': ' + co.DocketValue1 ELSE '' END) + ' ' +                      
            (CASE WHEN co.Docketlabel2 <> '' THEN co.Docketlabel2 + ': ' + co.DocketValue2 ELSE '' END) + ' ' +                      
            (CASE WHEN co.Docketlabel3 <> '' THEN co.Docketlabel3 + ': ' + co.DocketValue3 ELSE '' END)                       
        ELSE                      
            CASE cdis2.FieldFK   
                WHEN 40 THEN cdis2.Prefix + ' ' + co.DocketValue1                      
                WHEN 41 THEN cdis2.Prefix + ' ' + co.DocketValue2                      
                WHEN 42 THEN cdis2.Prefix + ' ' + co.DocketValue3                      
            END + ' ' +                      
            CASE cdis2.Field2FK   
                WHEN 40 THEN cdis2.Prefix2 + ' ' + co.DocketValue1                      
                WHEN 41 THEN cdis2.Prefix2 + ' ' + co.DocketValue2                      
                WHEN 42 THEN cdis2.Prefix2 + ' ' + co.DocketValue3                      
                ELSE ''                      
            END                      
        END   
    ELSE ''  
    END AS CustomerRef,                     
  
    CASE WHEN sdel.ContainerOutFK > 0 THEN ISNULL(co.ContainerNumber,'') ELSE '' END AS ContainerNumber,                      
    CASE WHEN sdel.ContainerOutFK > 0 THEN ISNULL(co.LorryNumber,'') ELSE '' END AS LorryNumber,                      
    CASE WHEN sdel.ContainerOutFK > 0 THEN ISNULL(co.SealNumber,'') ELSE '' END AS SealNumber,  
    CASE WHEN sdel.ContainerOutFK > 0 THEN ISNULL(shp.ShippingCompany,'') ELSE '' END AS ShippingCompany,  
    CASE WHEN sdel.ContainerOutFK > 0 THEN ISNULL(tsp.TransportCompany,'') ELSE '' END AS TransportCompany,  
  
    CAST(sdel.IsArchived AS INT) AS [DeliveryIsArchived],       
  
    CASE   
        WHEN sdel.ContainerOutFK > 0 THEN           
            CASE   
                WHEN co.ContainerOutStageFK IN (1,2) THEN 'Pending'           
                WHEN co.ContainerOutStageFK IN (3,4,5,6,7) THEN 'InProgress'          
                ELSE 'Completed'   
            END  
    ELSE ''  
    END AS DeliveryStatus,          
  
 CASE         
    WHEN sdel.ContainerInFK > 0 OR sdel.ContainerOutFK > 0 THEN           
    DATEADD(dd, c2.DayCutOff,         
     CONVERT(DATETIME, FORMAT(sd.DayDate, 'yyyy-MM-dd'))) + CAST(c2.TimeCutOff AS DATETIME)        
   ELSE         
    CAST(GETDATE() AS DATETIME)         
  END AS CustomerCutoff,            
        
  CASE         
   WHEN sdel.ContainerInFK > 0 OR sdel.ContainerOutFK > 0 THEN           
    CASE         
     WHEN CONVERT(DATETIME, FORMAT(sd.DayDate, 'yyyy-MM-dd')) + CAST(sd.StartTime AS DATETIME) <=         
       DATEADD(dd, c2.DayCutOff,         
       CONVERT(DATETIME, FORMAT(sd.DayDate, 'yyyy-MM-dd'))) + CAST(c2.TimeCutOff AS DATETIME)         
     THEN 1         
     ELSE 0         
    END         
   ELSE         
    0         
  END AS DeliveryPastCutOff                              
   FROM  [dbo].[tblScheduleWeeks] sw               
      INNER JOIN [dbo].[tblScheduleChannels] sc ON sw.ScheduleWeekPK = sc.ScheduleWeekFK                  
      INNER JOIN [dbo].[tblScheduleDays] sd ON sc.ScheduleChannelPK = sd.ScheduleChannelFK                   
      INNER JOIN [dbo].[tblScheduleSlots] ss ON sd.ScheduleDayPK = ss.ScheduleDayFK                    
      LEFT JOIN tblScheduleDeliveries sdel ON sdel.ScheduleSlotFK = ss.ScheduleSlotPK  AND sdel.IsArchived = 0 AND sdel.ContainerOutFK is NOT NULL  
      LEFT JOIN tblContainerOutLoading coloading ON coloading.ContainerOutFK = sdel.ContainerOutFK AND coloading.IsArchived = 0
      LEFT JOIN appContainerOutLoadingTypes dcolt ON dcolt.ContainerOutLoadingTypePK = coloading.ContainerOutLoadingTypeFK
      LEFT JOIN appContainerOutLoadingTypes colt ON colt.ContainerOutLoadingTypePK = sc.ContainerOutLoadingTypeFK  
      LEFT JOIN tblContainerOuts co ON sdel.ContainerOutFk = co.ContainerOutPK    
      LEFT JOIN tblTransportCompanies tsp ON co.TransportCompanyFK = tsp.TransportCompanyPK  
      LEFT JOIN tblShippingCompanies shp ON co.ShippingCompanyFK = shp.ShippingCompanyPK   
      LEFT JOIN tblContainerOutLines col ON col.ContainerOutFK = co.ContainerOutPK    
      LEFT JOIN tblStockOrders so ON co.ContainerOutPK = so.ContainerOutFK    
      INNER JOIN tblBuildingUnits bu ON so.ResponsibleBuildingUnitFK = bu.BuildingUnitPK    
      LEFT JOIN tblDivisions d2 ON d2.DivisionPK = col.DivisionFK                
      LEFT JOIN tblCustomers c2 ON d2.CustomerFK = c2.CustomerPK     
      LEFT JOIN tblLoadingBays Outboundlb ON so.PickupLoadingBayFK = Outboundlb.LoadingBayPK                      
      LEFT OUTER JOIN tblCustomerDocketIdentifications cdis2 ON cdis2.CustomerFK = d2.CustomerFK   
      AND cdis2.DocketTypeFK = 2  WHERE sw.ScheduleWeekPK =@ScheduleWeekPK              
      AND (sc.IsArchived = 0 OR sc.IsArchived is null)              
      AND (sw.IsArchived = 0 OR sw.IsArchived is null)                  
      AND (sd.IsArchived = 0 OR sd.IsArchived is null)               
      AND (ss.IsArchived = 0 OR ss.IsArchived is null)                
     AND (sdel.IsArchived = 0 OR sdel.IsArchived is null)         
 )OutBound        
)        
SELECT ScheduleWeekPK,         
  ScheduleName,    
  ScheduleChannelPK,            
  ChannelName,             
  ChannelColorCode,             
  ChannelFreeMode,     
  ChannelInbound,            
  ChannelOutbound,   
  ContainerOutLoadingTypeFK,
  ContainerOutLoadingType,
  DeliveryContainerOutLoadingTypeFK,
  DeliveryContainerOutLoadingType,
  SlotDeliveryCount,          
  ScheduleDayPK,             
  DayDate,     
  DayNumber,    
  DayStartTime,             
  DayEndTime,              
  DayDuration,            
  ScheduleSlotPK,            
  SchedulePlaceholderPK,             
  SlotStart,             
  SlotEnd,             
  SlotDuration,            
  PlaceholderTitle,            
  PlaceholderColorCode,            
  ScheduleDeliveryPK,            
   DeliveryDescription,             
  DeliveryStartTime,             
  DeliveryEndTime,             
  DeliveryDuration,                      
  DeliveryType,                          
  DeliveryContainerFK,                   
  DocketNumber,              
  DocketSupplier,              
  DocketDivision,             
  LoadingBay,                       
  DocketDate,               
  CustomerRef,              
  ContainerNumber,                
  LorryNumber,                
  SealNumber,   
  ShippingCompany,   
  TransportCompany,   
  DeliveryIsArchived ,DeliveryStatus, CustomerCutoff, DeliveryPastCutOff   
FROM distinctResults        
WHERE rn = 1        
        
UNION        
        
SELECT Distinct  sw.ScheduleWeekPK,  
   sw.[Name] AS [ScheduleName],  
   ScheduleChannelPK,   
   sc.[Name] AS [ChannelName],   
   sc.ColorCode AS [ChannelColorCode],  
   sc.FreeMode AS [ChannelFreeMode],   
   sc.AllowInbound AS [ChannelInbound],  
   sc.AllowOutbound AS [ChannelOutbound],
    ISNULL(sc.ContainerOutLoadingTypeFK,-1) AS ContainerOutLoadingTypeFK,  
    ISNULL(colt.ContainerOutLoadingType,'No Restriction') AS ContainerOutLoadingType,
     -1 AS DeliveryContainerOutLoadingTypeFK,
   'No Restriction' AS DeliveryContainerOutLoadingType,
   sc.DeliveryCount AS [SlotDeliveryCount],  
  
   sd.ScheduleDayPK,   
   CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), sd.DayDate, 103) AS [DayDate],  
   sd.DayNumber,   
   sd.StartTime AS [DayStartTime],  
   sd.EndTime AS [DayEndTime],  
   sd.MaxDuration AS [DayDuration],                 
  
   ss.ScheduleSlotPK,  
   -1 AS SchedulePlaceholderPK,  
   ss.StartTime AS [SlotStart],  
   ss.EndTime AS [SlotEnd],  
   ss.ActualDuration AS [SlotDuration],                    
  
   '' AS [PlaceholderTitle],  
   '' AS [PlaceholderColorCode],                     
  
   sdel.ScheduleDeliveryPK,  
   sdel.[Description] AS [DeliveryDescription],  
   sdel.StartTime AS [DeliveryStartTime],  
   sdel.EndTime AS [DeliveryEndTime],  
   sdel.ActualDuration AS [DeliveryDuration],  
  
    CASE   
   WHEN sdel.ContainerInFK > 0 THEN 'Inbound'   
      WHEN sdel.ContainerOutFK > 0 THEN 'Outbound'   
   ELSE NULL   
 END AS DeliveryType,     
   
    CASE   
   WHEN sdel.ContainerInFK > 0 THEN sdel.ContainerInFK  
   WHEN sdel.ContainerOutFK > 0 THEN sdel.ContainerOutFK   
   ELSE NULL   
 END AS DeliveryContainerFK,       
   CASE WHEN sdel.ContainerInFK > 0 THEN ci.GoodsInNumber ELSE ' ' END AS DocketNumber,   
   CASE WHEN sdel.ContainerInFK > 0 THEN InboundSup.Supplier ELSE '' END AS DocketSupplier,                       
   CASE WHEN sdel.ContainerInFK > 0 THEN d.DivisionCode ELSE ' ' END AS DocketDivision,                       
   CASE WHEN sdel.ContainerInFK > 0 THEN Inboundlb.LoadingBay END AS LoadingBay,                       
   CASE WHEN sdel.ContainerInFK > 0 THEN   
   CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), CAST(ci.DateIn AS DATE), 103) END AS DocketDate,  
  
   CASE WHEN sdel.ContainerInFK > 0 THEN   
       CASE WHEN cdis.CustomerDocketIdentificationPK IS NOT NULL THEN                       
            (CASE cdis.FieldFK WHEN 1 THEN ci.Free1 WHEN 2 THEN ci.Free2 WHEN 3 THEN ci.Free3   
                                WHEN 4 THEN ci.Free4 WHEN 5 THEN ci.Free5 ELSE ' ' END)  
            + ' ' +  
            (CASE cdis.Field2FK WHEN 1 THEN ci.Free1 WHEN 2 THEN ci.Free2 WHEN 3 THEN ci.Free3   
                                WHEN 4 THEN ci.Free4 WHEN 5 THEN ci.Free5 ELSE ' ' END)  
            + ' ' +  
            (CASE cdis.Field3FK WHEN 1 THEN ci.Free1 WHEN 2 THEN ci.Free2 WHEN 3 THEN ci.Free3   
                                WHEN 4 THEN ci.Free4 WHEN 5 THEN ci.Free5 ELSE ' ' END)  
       ELSE ' ' END  
       + ' ' + COALESCE(NULLIF(ci.ExternalReference,''),' ')  
   ELSE ' '   
   END AS CustomerRef,  
  
   CASE WHEN sdel.ContainerInFK > 0 THEN ISNULL(ci.[ContainerNumber],'') ELSE '' END AS ContainerNumber,                      
   CASE WHEN sdel.ContainerInFK > 0 THEN ISNULL(ci.[LorryNumber],'') ELSE '' END AS LorryNumber,                      
   CASE WHEN sdel.ContainerInFK > 0 THEN ISNULL(ci.[SealNumber],'') ELSE '' END AS SealNumber,  
   CASE WHEN sdel.ContainerInFK > 0 THEN ISNULL(shp.ShippingCompany,'') ELSE '' END AS ShippingCompany,  
   CASE WHEN sdel.ContainerInFK > 0 THEN ISNULL(tsp.TransportCompany,'') ELSE '' END AS TransportCompany,  
   CAST(sdel.IsArchived AS INT) AS [DeliveryIsArchived],          
   CASE WHEN sdel.ContainerInFK > 0 THEN sist.StockInStatus ELSE '' END AS DeliveryStatus,          
  
  CASE         
    WHEN sdel.ContainerInFK > 0 OR sdel.ContainerOutFK > 0 THEN           
    DATEADD(dd, c.DayCutOff,         
     CONVERT(DATETIME, FORMAT(sd.DayDate, 'yyyy-MM-dd'))) + CAST(c.TimeCutOff AS DATETIME)        
   ELSE         
    CAST(GETDATE() AS DATETIME)         
  END AS CustomerCutoff,            
        
  CASE         
   WHEN sdel.ContainerInFK > 0 OR sdel.ContainerOutFK > 0 THEN           
    CASE         
     WHEN CONVERT(DATETIME, FORMAT(sd.DayDate, 'yyyy-MM-dd')) + CAST(sd.StartTime AS DATETIME) <=         
       DATEADD(dd, c.DayCutOff,         
       CONVERT(DATETIME, FORMAT(sd.DayDate, 'yyyy-MM-dd'))) + CAST(c.TimeCutOff AS DATETIME)         
     THEN 1         
     ELSE 0         
    END         
   ELSE         
    0         
  END AS DeliveryPastCutOff   
  
   FROM [dbo].[tblScheduleWeeks] sw                   
   INNER JOIN [dbo].[tblScheduleChannels] sc ON sw.ScheduleWeekPK = sc.ScheduleWeekFK                  
   INNER JOIN [dbo].[tblScheduleDays] sd ON sc.ScheduleChannelPK = sd.ScheduleChannelFK                   
   INNER JOIN [dbo].[tblScheduleSlots] ss ON sd.ScheduleDayPK = ss.ScheduleDayFK                    
   LEFT JOIN tblScheduleDeliveries sdel ON sdel.ScheduleSlotFK = ss.ScheduleSlotPK   
   AND sdel.IsArchived = 0 AND sdel.ContainerInFK is NOT NULL                      
   LEFT JOIN appContainerOutLoadingTypes colt ON colt.ContainerOutLoadingTypePK = sc.ContainerOutLoadingTypeFK  
   LEFT JOIN tblContainerIns ci ON sdel.ContainerInFK = ci.ContainerInPK    
   LEFT JOIN tblTransportCompanies tsp ON ci.TransportCompanyFK = tsp.TransportCompanyPK        
   LEFT JOIN tblShippingCompanies shp ON ci.ShippingCompanyFK = shp.ShippingCompanyPK     
   LEFT JOIN tblStockIns si ON ci.ContainerInPK = si.ContainerInFK                
   LEFT JOIN appStockInStatus sist ON sist.StockInStatusPK = si.StockInStatusFK          
   LEFT JOIN tblDivisions d ON si.DivisionFK = d.DivisionPK                      
   LEFT JOIN tblCustomers c ON d.CustomerFK = c.CustomerPK          
   LEFT JOIN tblSuppliers InboundSup ON ci.SupplierFK = InboundSup.SupplierPK                      
   LEFT JOIN tblLoadingBays Inboundlb ON ci.LoadingBayFK = Inboundlb.LoadingBayPK                      
   LEFT JOIN tblCustomerDocketIdentifications cdis ON cdis.CustomerFK = d.CustomerFK AND cdis.DocketTypeFK = 1    
    WHERE sw.ScheduleWeekPK =@ScheduleWeekPK              
     AND (sc.IsArchived = 0 OR sc.IsArchived is null)              
     AND (sw.IsArchived = 0 OR sw.IsArchived is null)                  
     AND (sd.IsArchived = 0 OR sd.IsArchived is null)               
     AND (ss.IsArchived = 0 OR ss.IsArchived is null)                
     AND (sdel.IsArchived = 0 OR sdel.IsArchived is null)         
     and sdel.ContainerOutFK is null        
        
  UNION              
              
  SELECT DISTINCT             
   sw.ScheduleWeekPK,sw.[Name][ScheduleName], sc.ScheduleChannelPK, sc.[Name][ChannelName], sc.ColorCode[ChannelColorCode], sc.FreeMode[ChannelFreeMode],   
  sc.AllowInbound[ChannelInbound] , sc.AllowOutbound[ChannelOutbound],
   ISNULL(sc.ContainerOutLoadingTypeFK,-1) AS ContainerOutLoadingTypeFK,  
    ISNULL(colt.ContainerOutLoadingType,'No Restriction') AS ContainerOutLoadingType,
   -1 AS DeliveryContainerOutLoadingTypeFK,
  'No Restriction' AS DeliveryContainerOutLoadingType,
  sc.DeliveryCount[SlotDeliveryCount],                     
     sd.ScheduleDayPK, CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), sd.DayDate, 103) As [DayDate],sd.DayNumber, sd.StartTime[DayStartTime], sd.EndTime[DayEndTime], sd.MaxDuration[DayDuration],                 
    -1 ScheduleSlotPK, sph.SchedulePlaceholderPK, sph.StartTime[SlotStart], sph.EndTime[SlotEnd],sph.ActualDuration[SlotDuration],                
    case when sph.Title = '' then                       
    case when sph.customerfk > 0 then c.CustomerName ELSE su.Supplier end                   
    ELSE sph.Title end as PlaceholderTitle,                   
    sph.ColorCode as PlaceholderColorCode,                      
    -1 ScheduleDeliveryPK,        
 CASE WHEN sph.[Description] = '' OR sph.[Description] IS NULL THEN sph.Title    
 ELSE CONCAT(sph.Title, ' ', sph.[Description])  END AS [DeliveryDescription],      
      
 sph.StartTime[DeliveryStartTime], sph.EndTime[DeliveryEndTime], sph.ActualDuration[DeliveryDuration],                      
    'Placeholder' as DeliveryType,                
    -1 as DeliveryContainerFK,                      
    '' as DocketNumber,                      
    case when sph.SupplierFK > 0 then su.Supplier ELSE '' end as DocketSupplier,                       
    case when sph.CustomerFK > 0 then c.CustomerCode ELSE '' end as DocketDivision,                       
    '' as LoadingBay,                       
    CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), sd.[DayDate], 103) as DocketDate,                      
    '' as CustomerRef,                      
    ''[ContainerNumber],               
    ''[LorryNumber],               
    ''[SealNumber],    
    ''[ShippingCompany],  
    ''[TransportCompany],   
    0 as [DeliveryIsArchived],          
    '' as DeliveryStatus,             
   DATEADD(dd,         
   case when c.customerpk IS NULL then 2 ELSE c.DayCutOff end,         
   CAST(GETDATE() AS DATETIME)) + case when c.TimeCutOff IS NULL then '10:00:00' ELSE CAST(c.TimeCutOff AS DATETIME) end as CustomerCutoff,        
  case         
   when CAST(sd.DayDate AS DATETIME) + CAST(sd.StartTime AS DATETIME) <=          
     DATEADD(dd, case when c.customerpk IS NULL then 2 ELSE c.DayCutOff end,         
     CAST(GETDATE() AS DATETIME)) + CAST(c.TimeCutOff AS DATETIME)         
   then 1         
   ELSE 0         
   end as DeliveryPastCutOff          
  FROM [dbo].[tblScheduleWeeks] sw                   
  INNER JOIN [dbo].[tblScheduleChannels] sc ON sw.ScheduleWeekPK = sc.ScheduleWeekFK                  
  INNER JOIN [dbo].[tblScheduleDays] sd ON sc.ScheduleChannelPK = sd.ScheduleChannelFK                      
  INNER JOIN tblSchedulePlaceholders sph on sph.ScheduleDayFK = sd.ScheduleDayPK                     
  LEFT JOIN appContainerOutLoadingTypes colt ON colt.ContainerOutLoadingTypePK = sc.ContainerOutLoadingTypeFK  
  LEFT JOIN tblcustomers c on sph.CustomerFK = c.CustomerPK               
  LEFT JOIN tblDivisions d ON d.CustomerFK = c.CustomerPK   
  LEFT JOIN tblSuppliers su on sph.SupplierFK = su.SupplierPK                                 
  WHERE sw.ScheduleWeekPK =@ScheduleWeekPK               
    AND (sc.IsArchived = 0 OR sc.IsArchived is null)              
    AND (sw.IsArchived = 0 OR sw.IsArchived is null)                  
    AND (sd.IsArchived = 0 OR sd.IsArchived is null)                
    AND (sph.IsArchived = 0 or sph.IsArchived is null)        
       
 ); 
GO

/****** Object:  UserDefinedFunction [dbo].[fnSearchScheduleDeliveriesByOrderRef]    Script Date: 02/11/2026 17:47:23 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
