-- SELECT * FROM [dbo].[fnSearchScheduleDeliveryForBuildingWithUserFk](11,663) Order by ScheduleDeliveryPK desc  
-- SELECT * FROM [dbo].[fnSearchScheduleDeliveryForBuildingWithUserFk](11,713) Order by ScheduleDeliveryPK desc

-- SELECT * FROM [dbo].[fnSearchScheduleDeliveriesByOrderRef]('',11,712) Order by ScheduleDeliveryPK desc 
-- SELECT * FROM [dbo].[fnSearchScheduleDeliveriesByOrderRef]('4503946400',11,712) Order by ScheduleDeliveryPK desc  

-- =============================================                      
-- Author:  <Archana Singh>                      
-- Create date: <09/10/2024>                      
-- Description: <Description,,>                      
-- =============================================                      
                
CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[fnSearchScheduleDeliveriesByOrderRef]                    
(                      
  @OrderRef NVARCHAR(100)= NULL,
  @BuildingFK INT,  
  @UserFK INT      
)                
RETURNS TABLE                
AS                    
RETURN     
(      
  Select IsClientRestricted, ScheduleDeliveryPK,DeliverySlotFK ,  
  case when isClientRestricted=1 then 'Hidden Info' ELSE DeliveryDescription end as DeliveryDescription,   
  DeliveryDate,  
  DeliveryStartTime,       
  DeliveryEndTime,       
  DeliveryDuration,                
  DeliveryType,                    
  DeliveryContainerFK,            
  case when isClientRestricted=1 then 'Hidden Info' ELSE DocketNumber end as DocketNumber,        
  case when IsClientRestricted=1 then 'Hidden Info' ELSE DocketSupplier end as DocketSupplier,        
  case when IsClientRestricted=1 then 'Hidden Info' ELSE DocketDivision end as DocketDivision,       
  LoadingBay,                 
  DocketDate,         
  case when IsClientRestricted=1 then 'Hidden Info' ELSE CustomerRef end as CustomerRef,        
  case when IsClientRestricted=1 then 'Hidden Info' ELSE ContainerNumber end as ContainerNumber,          
  case when IsClientRestricted=1 then 'Hidden Info' ELSE LorryNumber end as LorryNumber,          
  case when IsClientRestricted=1 then 'Hidden Info' ELSE SealNumber end as SealNumber,        
  DeliveryIsArchived ,DeliveryStatus    
   FROM      
   (      
    SELECT DISTINCT d.DivisionPK Indiv, d2.DivisionPK OutDiv, ud.DivisionFK,      
    CASE  when co.TransportCompanyFK = u.TransportCompanyFk
       -- WHEN EXISTS
       -- (
       --   SELECT  1
       --   FROM tblUsers u 
       --   INNER JOIN tblUserCustomer uc on u.UserPK = uc.UserFK
       --   INNER JOIN tbldivisions d on uc.CustomerFK=d.CustomerFK  
       --   INNER JOIN tblDivisionBuildingUnits dbu on dbu.DivisionFK=d.DivisionPK  
       --   INNER JOIN tblbuildingunits bu on dbu.BuildingUnitFK=bu.BuildingUnitPK 
       --   WHERE uc.UserFK = @UserFK
       --   AND uc.CustomerFK = d.CustomerFK
       --   AND u.UserTypeFK = 5
       --)
      THEN 0 -- matches - let them see this info 
      ELSE 1
      END AS IsClientRestricted,
      sdel.ScheduleDeliveryPK,sdel.ScheduleSlotFK[DeliverySlotFK],  
      sdel.[Description][DeliveryDescription], CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), sd.DayDate, 103) As [DeliveryDate], sdel.StartTime[DeliveryStartTime], sdel.EndTime[DeliveryEndTime], sdel.ActualDuration[DeliveryDuration],                
     case when sdel.ContainerInFK > 0 then 'Inbound' when sdel.ContainerOutFK > 0 then 'Outbound' ELSE NULL end as DeliveryType,                
     case when sdel.ContainerInFK > 0 then sdel.ContainerInFK when sdel.ContainerOutFK > 0 then sdel.ContainerOutFK ELSE -1 end as DeliveryContainerFK,                
     case when sdel.ContainerInFK > 0 then ci.GoodsInNumber ELSE co.GoodsOrderNumber end as DocketNumber,                        
     case when sdel.ContainerInFK > 0 then InboundSup.Supplier ELSE '' end as DocketSupplier,                 
     case when sdel.ContainerInFK > 0 then d.DivisionCode ELSE d2.DivisionCode end as DocketDivision,                 
     case when sdel.ContainerInFK > 0 then Inboundlb.LoadingBay ELSE Outboundlb.LoadingBay end as LoadingBay,                 
     case when sdel.ContainerInFK > 0 then CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), cast(ci.datein as Date), 103) ELSE CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), cast(co.CollectionDate as Date), 103) end as DocketDate,                
     case when sdel.ContainerInFK > 0 then case when cdis.CustomerDocketIdentificationPK IS NOT NULL then                 
     case cdis.FieldFK                   
       when 1 then ci.Free1                  
       when 2 then ci.Free2                  
       when 3 then ci.Free3                  
       when 4 then ci.Free4                  
       when 5 then ci.Free5                  
       ELSE ' ' end                  
      + ' '  + case  cdis.Field2FK                   
       when 1 then ci.Free1                  
       when 2 then ci.Free2                  
       when 3 then ci.Free3                  
       when 4 then ci.Free4                  
       when 5 then ci.Free5                  
       ELSE ' ' end                  
      + ' '  + case  cdis.Field3FK                   
       when 1 then ci.Free1                  
       when 2 then ci.Free2                  
       when 3 then ci.Free3                  
       when 4 then ci.Free4                  
       when 5 then ci.Free5                  
       ELSE  ' ' end                 
       ELSE ' ' end                 
       + ' '  +                
       CASE WHEN  ci.ExternalReference <> '' THEN ci.ExternalReference ELSE ' ' end                 
      ELSE                
       case when cdis2.CustomerDocketIdentificationPK IS NULL then                 
       case when co.Docketlabel1 <> '' THEN                 
     co.Docketlabel1 + ': ' + co.DocketValue1 ELSE '' end + ' ' +                
       case when co.Docketlabel2 <> '''' THEN                 
     co.Docketlabel2 + ': ' + co.DocketValue2 ELSE '' end + ' ' +                
       case when co.Docketlabel3 <> '' THEN                 
     co.Docketlabel3 + ': ' + co.DocketValue3 ELSE '' end + ''                 
       ELSE                
       case cdis2.FieldFK when 40 then                
      cdis2.Prefix + ' ' + co.DocketValue1                
       when 41 then                
      cdis2.Prefix + ' ' + co.DocketValue2                
       when 42 then                
      cdis2.Prefix + ' ' + co.DocketValue3                
       end              
       + ' ' +                
       case cdis2.Field2FK when 40 then                
      cdis2.Prefix2 + ' ' + co.DocketValue1                
       when 41 then                
      cdis2.Prefix2 + ' ' + co.DocketValue2                
       when 42 then                
      cdis2.Prefix2 + ' ' + co.DocketValue3                
       ELSE ''                
       END                
      End                
      END as CustomerRef,  
      case when sdel.ContainerInFK > 0 then ci.[ContainerNumber] when sdel.ContainerOutFK > 0 then co.[ContainerNumber] ELSE '' end as ContainerNumber,                
   case when sdel.ContainerInFK > 0 then ci.[LorryNumber] when sdel.ContainerOutFK > 0 then co.[LorryNumber] ELSE '' end as LorryNumber,                
   case when sdel.ContainerInFK > 0 then ci.[SealNumber] when sdel.ContainerOutFK > 0 then co.[SealNumber] ELSE '' end as SealNumber,                
   Cast(sdel.IsArchived as INT)[DeliveryIsArchived],    
    case when sdel.ContainerInFK > 0 then     
   sist.StockInStatus     
     when sdel.ContainerOutFK > 0 then     
   case when co.ContainerOutStageFK in (1,2) then 'Pending'     
   when co.ContainerOutStageFK in (3,4,5,6,7) then 'InProgress'    
   ELSE 'Completed' end    
     ELSE '' end as DeliveryStatus       
   FROM  [dbo].[tblScheduleWeeks] sw             
   INNER JOIN [dbo].[tblScheduleChannels] sc ON sw.ScheduleWeekPK = sc.ScheduleWeekFK            
   INNER JOIN [dbo].[tblScheduleDays] sd ON sc.ScheduleChannelPK = sd.ScheduleChannelFK             
   INNER JOIN [dbo].[tblScheduleSlots] ss ON sd.ScheduleDayPK = ss.ScheduleDayFK              
   LEFT JOIN tblScheduleDeliveries sdel ON sdel.ScheduleSlotFK = ss.ScheduleSlotPK  AND sdel.IsArchived=0                 
   LEFT JOIN tblContainerIns ci ON sdel.ContainerInFK = ci.ContainerInPK                  
   LEFT JOIN tblStockIns si ON ci.ContainerInPK = si.ContainerInFK          
   left join appStockInStatus sist on sist.StockInStatusPK = si.StockInStatusFK    
   LEFT JOIN tbldivisions d ON si.DivisionFK = d.DivisionPK                
   LEft Join tblcustomers c on d.CustomerFK = c.CustomerPK    
   LEFT JOIN tblSuppliers InboundSup ON ci.SupplierFK = InboundSup.SupplierPK                
   LEFT JOIN tblloadingbays Inboundlb ON ci.LoadingBayFK = Inboundlb.LoadingBayPK                
   LEFT OUTER JOIN tblCustomerDocketIdentifications cdis ON cdis.CustomerFK = d.CustomerFK AND cdis.DocketTypeFK = 1                
   LEFT JOIN tblContainerOuts co ON sdel.ContainerOutFk = co.ContainerOutPK                
   LEFT JOIN tblContainerOutLines col ON col.ContainerOutFK = co.ContainerOutPK                
   LEFT JOIN tblDivisions d2 ON d2.DivisionPK = col.DivisionFK          
   LEft Join tblcustomers c2 on d2.CustomerFK = c2.CustomerPK             
   LEFT JOIN tblStockOrders so ON co.ContainerOutPK = so.ContainerOutFK                
   LEFT JOIN tblloadingbays Outboundlb ON so.PickupLoadingBayFK = Outboundlb.LoadingBayPK                
   LEFT OUTER JOIN tblCustomerDocketIdentifications cdis2 ON cdis2.CustomerFK = d2.CustomerFK AND cdis2.DocketTypeFK = 2        
   LEFT JOIN tblusers u on u.UserPK = @UserFK      
   LEFT JOIN tblUserDivisions ud on ud.UserFK = @UserFK and (d.DivisionPK = ud.DivisionFK or d2.DivisionPK = ud.DivisionFK)      
   WHERE sw.BuildingFK =@BuildingFK   
   AND sdel.ScheduleDeliveryPK IS NOT NULL     
   AND (sdel.IsArchived = 0 OR sdel.IsArchived IS NULL)   
   AND 
   (     
       @OrderRef IS NULL OR @OrderRef = ''
       OR ci.GoodsInNumber LIKE '%' + @OrderRef + '%'
       OR co.GoodsOrderNumber LIKE '%' + @OrderRef + '%'

         -- containerins
       OR ci.ExternalReference LIKE '%' + @OrderRef + '%'
       OR ci.Free1 LIKE '%' + @OrderRef + '%'
       OR ci.Free2 LIKE '%' + @OrderRef + '%'
       OR ci.Free3 LIKE '%' + @OrderRef + '%'
       OR ci.Free4 LIKE '%' + @OrderRef + '%'
       OR ci.Free5 LIKE '%' + @OrderRef + '%'

       -- containerouts
       OR co.Free1 LIKE '%' + @OrderRef + '%'
       OR co.Free2 LIKE '%' + @OrderRef + '%'
       OR co.Free3 LIKE '%' + @OrderRef + '%'
       OR co.Free4 LIKE '%' + @OrderRef + '%'
       OR co.Free5 LIKE '%' + @OrderRef + '%'
       OR co.DocketValue1 LIKE '%' + @OrderRef + '%'
       OR co.DocketValue2 LIKE '%' + @OrderRef + '%'
       OR co.DocketValue3 LIKE '%' + @OrderRef + '%'
)
   )SD  
)  
GO
/****** Object:  View [dbo].[viewBuildingUnitStagingAreas]    Script Date: 02/11/2026 17:47:23 ******/

CREATE VIEW [dbo].[viewBuildingUnitStagingAreas]
AS
SELECT     dbo.tblLoadingBays.LoadingBayPK AS LocationPK, 2 AS LocationTypeFK, dbo.tblLoadingBays.LoadingBay AS LocationName, 
                      dbo.tblLoadingBays.Barcode AS LocationBarcode, dbo.tblLoadingBays.BuildingUnitFK, dbo.tblBuildingUnits.BuildingUnit AS BuildingUnitName, 
                      dbo.tblBuildings.BuildingName
FROM         dbo.tblLoadingBays INNER JOIN
                      dbo.tblBuildingUnits ON dbo.tblBuildingUnits.BuildingUnitPK = dbo.tblLoadingBays.BuildingUnitFK INNER JOIN
                      dbo.tblBuildings ON dbo.tblBuildingUnits.BuildingFK = dbo.tblBuildings.BuildingPK
UNION
SELECT     dbo.tblSetDownAreas.SetDownAreaPK AS LocationPK, 3 AS locationTypeFK, dbo.tblSetDownAreas.SetDownArea AS LocationName, 
                      dbo.tblSetDownAreas.Barcode AS LocationBarcode, dbo.tblSetDownAreas.BuildingUnitFK, tblBuildingUnits_3.BuildingUnit AS BuildingUnitName, 
                      tblBuildings_3.BuildingName
FROM         dbo.tblSetDownAreas INNER JOIN
                      dbo.tblBuildingUnits AS tblBuildingUnits_3 ON tblBuildingUnits_3.BuildingUnitPK = dbo.tblSetDownAreas.BuildingUnitFK INNER JOIN
                      dbo.tblBuildings AS tblBuildings_3 ON tblBuildingUnits_3.BuildingFK = tblBuildings_3.BuildingPK
UNION
SELECT     dbo.tblSampleLocations.SampleLocationPK AS LocationPK, 6 AS locationTypeFK, dbo.tblSampleLocations.SampleLocation AS LocationName, 
                      dbo.tblSampleLocations.Barcode AS LocationBarcode, dbo.tblSampleLocations.BuildingUnitFK, tblBuildingUnits_2.BuildingUnit AS BuildingUnitName, 
                      tblBuildings_2.BuildingName
FROM         dbo.tblSampleLocations INNER JOIN
                      dbo.tblBuildingUnits AS tblBuildingUnits_2 ON tblBuildingUnits_2.BuildingUnitPK = dbo.tblSampleLocations.BuildingUnitFK INNER JOIN
                      dbo.tblBuildings AS tblBuildings_2 ON tblBuildingUnits_2.BuildingFK = tblBuildings_2.BuildingPK
UNION
SELECT     dbo.tblFloorLocations.FloorLocationPK AS LocationPK, 8 AS locationTypeFK, dbo.tblFloorLocations.FloorLocation AS LocationName, 
                      dbo.tblFloorLocations.Barcode AS LocationBarcode, dbo.tblFloorLocations.BuildingUnitFK, tblBuildingUnits_1.BuildingUnit AS BuildingUnitName, 
                      tblBuildings_1.BuildingName
FROM         dbo.tblFloorLocations INNER JOIN
                      dbo.tblBuildingUnits AS tblBuildingUnits_1 ON tblBuildingUnits_1.BuildingUnitPK = dbo.tblFloorLocations.BuildingUnitFK INNER JOIN
                      dbo.tblBuildings AS tblBuildings_1 ON tblBuildingUnits_1.BuildingFK = tblBuildings_1.BuildingPK
GO

/****** Object:  UserDefinedFunction [dbo].[fnGetScheduleWeekByScheduleWeekPK]    Script Date: 02/11/2026 17:47:23 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO

-- SELECT * FROM [dbo].[fnGetScheduleWeekByScheduleWeekPK](39) ORDER BY ChannelName ASC, DayDate ASC        
          
             
-- =============================================              
-- Author:  <Archana Singh>              
-- Create date: <04/01/2024>              
-- Description: <Description,,>              
-- =============================================              
        
CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[fnGetScheduleWeekByScheduleWeekPK]            
(              
  @ScheduleWeekPK INT          
)        
RETURNS TABLE        
AS            
RETURN        
(    
 WITH distinctResults AS  
 (  
    SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY DeliveryContainerFK ORDER BY LoadingBay ASC) AS rn  
    FROM   
    (  
     SELECT DISTINCT sw.ScheduleWeekPK,
    sw.[Name] AS [ScheduleName], 
    ScheduleChannelPK,
    sc.[Name] AS [ChannelName], 
    sc.ColorCode AS [ChannelColorCode],
    sc.FreeMode AS [ChannelFreeMode], 
    sc.AllowInbound AS [ChannelInbound], 
    sc.AllowOutbound AS [ChannelOutbound],
    -- Channel delivery type
    ISNULL(sc.ContainerOutLoadingTypeFK,-1) AS ContainerOutLoadingTypeFK,  
    ISNULL(colt.ContainerOutLoadingType,'No Restriction') AS ContainerOutLoadingType,
    
    -- Actual delivery/container-out type
    CASE 
      WHEN sdel.ContainerOutFK > 0 
        THEN ISNULL(coloading.ContainerOutLoadingTypeFK, -1)
       ELSE -1
     END AS DeliveryContainerOutLoadingTypeFK,

    CASE 
      WHEN sdel.ContainerOutFK > 0 
        THEN ISNULL(dcolt.ContainerOutLoadingType, 'No Restriction')
      ELSE 'No Restriction'
   END AS DeliveryContainerOutLoadingType,
    sc.DeliveryCount AS [SlotDeliveryCount], 

    sd.ScheduleDayPK, 
    CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), sd.DayDate, 103) AS [DayDate],
    sd.DayNumber,
    sd.StartTime AS [DayStartTime], 
    sd.EndTime AS [DayEndTime], 
    sd.MaxDuration AS [DayDuration],               

    ss.ScheduleSlotPK,
    -1 AS SchedulePlaceholderPK, 
    ss.StartTime AS [SlotStart], 
    ss.EndTime AS [SlotEnd],
    ss.ActualDuration AS [SlotDuration],                  

    '' AS [PlaceholderTitle],
    '' AS [PlaceholderColorCode],                   

    sdel.ScheduleDeliveryPK,
    sdel.[Description] AS [DeliveryDescription],
    sdel.StartTime AS [DeliveryStartTime], 
    sdel.EndTime AS [DeliveryEndTime],
    sdel.ActualDuration AS [DeliveryDuration],                    

   CASE 
	  WHEN sdel.ContainerInFK > 0 THEN 'Inbound' 
      WHEN sdel.ContainerOutFK > 0 THEN 'Outbound' 
	  ELSE NULL 
	END AS DeliveryType,   
	
    CASE 
	  WHEN sdel.ContainerInFK > 0 THEN sdel.ContainerInFK
	  WHEN sdel.ContainerOutFK > 0 THEN sdel.ContainerOutFK 
	  ELSE NULL 
	END AS DeliveryContainerFK,   
	
	CASE WHEN sdel.ContainerOutFK > 0 THEN co.GoodsOrderNumber END AS DocketNumber,                            
    '' AS DocketSupplier,                     
    CASE WHEN sdel.ContainerOutFK > 0 THEN d2.DivisionCode END AS DocketDivision,                     
    CASE WHEN sdel.ContainerOutFK > 0 THEN Outboundlb.LoadingBay END AS LoadingBay,                     
    CASE WHEN sdel.ContainerOutFK > 0 THEN CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), CAST(co.CollectionDate AS DATE), 103) END AS DocketDate,                   

    CASE WHEN sdel.ContainerOutFK > 0 THEN
        CASE WHEN cdis2.CustomerDocketIdentificationPK IS NULL THEN                     
            (CASE WHEN co.Docketlabel1 <> '' THEN co.Docketlabel1 + ': ' + co.DocketValue1 ELSE '' END) + ' ' +                    
            (CASE WHEN co.Docketlabel2 <> '' THEN co.Docketlabel2 + ': ' + co.DocketValue2 ELSE '' END) + ' ' +                    
            (CASE WHEN co.Docketlabel3 <> '' THEN co.Docketlabel3 + ': ' + co.DocketValue3 ELSE '' END)                     
        ELSE                    
            CASE cdis2.FieldFK 
                WHEN 40 THEN cdis2.Prefix + ' ' + co.DocketValue1                    
                WHEN 41 THEN cdis2.Prefix + ' ' + co.DocketValue2                    
                WHEN 42 THEN cdis2.Prefix + ' ' + co.DocketValue3                    
            END + ' ' +                    
            CASE cdis2.Field2FK 
                WHEN 40 THEN cdis2.Prefix2 + ' ' + co.DocketValue1                    
                WHEN 41 THEN cdis2.Prefix2 + ' ' + co.DocketValue2                    
                WHEN 42 THEN cdis2.Prefix2 + ' ' + co.DocketValue3                    
                ELSE ''                    
            END                    
        END 
    ELSE ''
    END AS CustomerRef,                   

    CASE WHEN sdel.ContainerOutFK > 0 THEN ISNULL(co.ContainerNumber,'') ELSE '' END AS ContainerNumber,                    
    CASE WHEN sdel.ContainerOutFK > 0 THEN ISNULL(co.LorryNumber,'') ELSE '' END AS LorryNumber,                    
    CASE WHEN sdel.ContainerOutFK > 0 THEN ISNULL(co.SealNumber,'') ELSE '' END AS SealNumber,
    CASE WHEN sdel.ContainerOutFK > 0 THEN ISNULL(shp.ShippingCompany,'') ELSE '' END AS ShippingCompany,
    CASE WHEN sdel.ContainerOutFK > 0 THEN ISNULL(tsp.TransportCompany,'') ELSE '' END AS TransportCompany,

    CAST(sdel.IsArchived AS INT) AS [DeliveryIsArchived],     

    CASE 
        WHEN sdel.ContainerOutFK > 0 THEN         
            CASE 
                WHEN co.ContainerOutStageFK IN (1,2) THEN 'Pending'         
                WHEN co.ContainerOutStageFK IN (3,4,5,6,7) THEN 'InProgress'        
                ELSE 'Completed' 
            END        
        ELSE '' 
    END AS DeliveryStatus,        

    CASE 
        WHEN sdel.ContainerOutFK > 0 THEN         
            DATEADD(dd, c2.DayCutOff, CAST(sd.DayDate AS DATETIME)) + CAST(c2.TimeCutOff AS DATETIME)      
        ELSE       
            CAST(GETDATE() AS DATETIME)  
    END AS CustomerCutoff,          

    CASE 
        WHEN sdel.ContainerInFK > 0 OR sdel.ContainerOutFK > 0 THEN         
            CASE 
                WHEN CAST(sd.DayDate AS DATETIME) + CAST(sd.StartTime AS DATETIME) <=       
                     DATEADD(dd, c2.DayCutOff, CAST(sd.DayDate AS DATETIME)) + CAST(c2.TimeCutOff AS DATETIME)       
                THEN 1       
                ELSE 0       
            END       
        ELSE 0       
    END AS DeliveryPastCutOff  
	
    FROM  [dbo].[tblScheduleWeeks] sw                 
     INNER JOIN [dbo].[tblScheduleChannels] sc ON sw.ScheduleWeekPK = sc.ScheduleWeekFK                
     INNER JOIN [dbo].[tblScheduleDays] sd ON sc.ScheduleChannelPK = sd.ScheduleChannelFK                 
     INNER JOIN [dbo].[tblScheduleSlots] ss ON sd.ScheduleDayPK = ss.ScheduleDayFK                  
     LEFT JOIN tblScheduleDeliveries sdel ON sdel.ScheduleSlotFK = ss.ScheduleSlotPK  AND sdel.IsArchived = 0  AND sdel.ContainerOutFK is NOT NULL
     LEFT JOIN tblContainerOutLoading coloading ON coloading.ContainerOutFK = sdel.ContainerOutFK AND coloading.IsArchived = 0
     LEFT JOIN appContainerOutLoadingTypes dcolt ON dcolt.ContainerOutLoadingTypePK = coloading.ContainerOutLoadingTypeFK
     LEFT JOIN appContainerOutLoadingTypes colt ON colt.ContainerOutLoadingTypePK = sc.ContainerOutLoadingTypeFK  
     LEFT JOIN tblContainerOuts co ON sdel.ContainerOutFk = co.ContainerOutPK  
     LEFT JOIN tblTransportCompanies tsp ON co.TransportCompanyFK = tsp.TransportCompanyPK
     LEFT JOIN tblShippingCompanies shp ON co.ShippingCompanyFK = shp.ShippingCompanyPK 
     LEFT JOIN tblContainerOutLines col ON col.ContainerOutFK = co.ContainerOutPK  
     LEFT JOIN tblStockOrders so ON co.ContainerOutPK = so.ContainerOutFK  
     INNER JOIN tblBuildingUnits bu ON so.ResponsibleBuildingUnitFK = bu.BuildingUnitPK  
     LEFT JOIN tblDivisions d2 ON d2.DivisionPK = col.DivisionFK              
     LEFT JOIN tblCustomers c2 ON d2.CustomerFK = c2.CustomerPK   
     LEFT JOIN tblLoadingBays Outboundlb ON so.PickupLoadingBayFK = Outboundlb.LoadingBayPK                    
     LEFT OUTER JOIN tblCustomerDocketIdentifications cdis2 
       ON cdis2.CustomerFK = d2.CustomerFK 
      AND cdis2.DocketTypeFK = 2  
     WHERE sw.ScheduleWeekPK =@ScheduleWeekPK        
     AND (sc.IsArchived = 0 OR sc.IsArchived is null)        
     AND (sw.IsArchived = 0 OR sw.IsArchived is null)            
     AND (sd.IsArchived = 0 OR sd.IsArchived is null)         
     AND (ss.IsArchived = 0 OR ss.IsArchived is null)          
     AND (sdel.IsArchived = 0 OR sdel.IsArchived is null)   
)OutBound   
)  
SELECT ScheduleWeekPK, ScheduleName, ScheduleChannelPK, ChannelName, ChannelColorCode, ChannelFreeMode,  ChannelInbound , ChannelOutbound,
ContainerOutLoadingTypeFK,ContainerOutLoadingType,
 DeliveryContainerOutLoadingTypeFK,
  DeliveryContainerOutLoadingType,
SlotDeliveryCount,ScheduleDayPK             
   ,DayDate,DayNumber, DayStartTime, DayEndTime,  DayDuration, ScheduleSlotPK, SchedulePlaceholderPK, SlotStart, SlotEnd, SlotDuration,           
   PlaceholderTitle, PlaceholderColorCode, ScheduleDeliveryPK, DeliveryDescription, DeliveryStartTime, DeliveryEndTime, DeliveryDuration,            
   DeliveryType, DeliveryContainerFK,    DocketNumber,  DocketSupplier, DocketDivision, LoadingBay, DocketDate, CustomerRef,              
   ContainerNumber,  LorryNumber, SealNumber,ShippingCompany,TransportCompany, DeliveryIsArchived,DeliveryStatus,CustomerCutoff, DeliveryPastCutOff  
FROM distinctResults  
WHERE rn = 1  


UNION  
  
 SELECT DISTINCT 
   sw.ScheduleWeekPK,
   sw.[Name] AS [ScheduleName],
   ScheduleChannelPK, 
   sc.[Name] AS [ChannelName], 
   sc.ColorCode AS [ChannelColorCode],
   sc.FreeMode AS [ChannelFreeMode], 
   sc.AllowInbound AS [ChannelInbound],
   sc.AllowOutbound AS [ChannelOutbound],
   ISNULL(sc.ContainerOutLoadingTypeFK,-1) AS ContainerOutLoadingTypeFK,  
    ISNULL(colt.ContainerOutLoadingType,'No Restriction') AS ContainerOutLoadingType,
  -1 AS DeliveryContainerOutLoadingTypeFK,
  'No Restriction' AS DeliveryContainerOutLoadingType,
   sc.DeliveryCount AS [SlotDeliveryCount],

   sd.ScheduleDayPK, 
   CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), sd.DayDate, 103) AS [DayDate],
   sd.DayNumber, 
   sd.StartTime AS [DayStartTime],
   sd.EndTime AS [DayEndTime],
   sd.MaxDuration AS [DayDuration],               

   ss.ScheduleSlotPK,
   -1 AS SchedulePlaceholderPK,
   ss.StartTime AS [SlotStart],
   ss.EndTime AS [SlotEnd],
   ss.ActualDuration AS [SlotDuration],                  

   '' AS [PlaceholderTitle],
   '' AS [PlaceholderColorCode],                   

   sdel.ScheduleDeliveryPK,
   sdel.[Description] AS [DeliveryDescription],
   sdel.StartTime AS [DeliveryStartTime],
   sdel.EndTime AS [DeliveryEndTime],
   sdel.ActualDuration AS [DeliveryDuration],

   CASE 
	  WHEN sdel.ContainerInFK > 0 THEN 'Inbound' 
      WHEN sdel.ContainerOutFK > 0 THEN 'Outbound' 
	  ELSE NULL 
	END AS DeliveryType,   
	
    CASE 
	  WHEN sdel.ContainerInFK > 0 THEN sdel.ContainerInFK
	  WHEN sdel.ContainerOutFK > 0 THEN sdel.ContainerOutFK 
	  ELSE NULL 
	END AS DeliveryContainerFK,   
	
	CASE WHEN sdel.ContainerInFK > 0 THEN ci.GoodsInNumber ELSE ' ' END AS DocketNumber, 
   CASE WHEN sdel.ContainerInFK > 0 THEN InboundSup.Supplier ELSE '' END AS DocketSupplier,                     
   CASE WHEN sdel.ContainerInFK > 0 THEN d.DivisionCode ELSE ' ' END AS DocketDivision,                     
   CASE WHEN sdel.ContainerInFK > 0 THEN Inboundlb.LoadingBay ELSE ' ' END AS LoadingBay,                     
   CASE WHEN sdel.ContainerInFK > 0 THEN CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), CAST(ci.DateIn AS DATE), 103) ELSE ' ' END AS DocketDate,

   CASE WHEN sdel.ContainerInFK > 0 THEN 
       CASE WHEN cdis.CustomerDocketIdentificationPK IS NOT NULL THEN                     
            (CASE cdis.FieldFK WHEN 1 THEN ci.Free1 WHEN 2 THEN ci.Free2 WHEN 3 THEN ci.Free3 
                                WHEN 4 THEN ci.Free4 WHEN 5 THEN ci.Free5 ELSE ' ' END)
            + ' ' +
            (CASE cdis.Field2FK WHEN 1 THEN ci.Free1 WHEN 2 THEN ci.Free2 WHEN 3 THEN ci.Free3 
                                WHEN 4 THEN ci.Free4 WHEN 5 THEN ci.Free5 ELSE ' ' END)
            + ' ' +
            (CASE cdis.Field3FK WHEN 1 THEN ci.Free1 WHEN 2 THEN ci.Free2 WHEN 3 THEN ci.Free3 
                                WHEN 4 THEN ci.Free4 WHEN 5 THEN ci.Free5 ELSE ' ' END)
       ELSE ' ' END
       + ' ' + COALESCE(NULLIF(ci.ExternalReference,''),' ')
   ELSE ' ' 
   END AS CustomerRef,

   CASE WHEN sdel.ContainerInFK > 0 THEN ISNULL(ci.[ContainerNumber],'') ELSE '' END AS ContainerNumber,                    
   CASE WHEN sdel.ContainerInFK > 0 THEN ISNULL(ci.[LorryNumber],'') ELSE '' END AS LorryNumber,                    
   CASE WHEN sdel.ContainerInFK > 0 THEN ISNULL(ci.[SealNumber],'') ELSE '' END AS SealNumber,
   CASE WHEN sdel.ContainerInFK > 0 THEN ISNULL(shp.ShippingCompany,'') ELSE '' END AS ShippingCompany,
   CASE WHEN sdel.ContainerInFK > 0 THEN ISNULL(tsp.TransportCompany,'') ELSE '' END AS TransportCompany,
   CAST(sdel.IsArchived AS INT) AS [DeliveryIsArchived],        
   CASE WHEN sdel.ContainerInFK > 0 THEN sist.StockInStatus ELSE '' END AS DeliveryStatus,        

   CASE       
    WHEN sdel.ContainerInFK > 0 OR sdel.ContainerOutFK > 0 THEN         
    DATEADD(dd, c.DayCutOff,       
     CONVERT(DATETIME, FORMAT(sd.DayDate, 'yyyy-MM-dd'))) + CAST(c.TimeCutOff AS DATETIME)      
   ELSE       
    CAST(GETDATE() AS DATETIME)       
  END AS CustomerCutoff,          
      
  CASE       
   WHEN sdel.ContainerInFK > 0 OR sdel.ContainerOutFK > 0 THEN         
    CASE       
     WHEN CONVERT(DATETIME, FORMAT(sd.DayDate, 'yyyy-MM-dd')) + CAST(sd.StartTime AS DATETIME) <=       
       DATEADD(dd, c.DayCutOff,       
       CONVERT(DATETIME, FORMAT(sd.DayDate, 'yyyy-MM-dd'))) + CAST(c.TimeCutOff AS DATETIME)       
     THEN 1       
     ELSE 0       
    END       
   ELSE       
    0       
  END AS DeliveryPastCutOff 

   FROM  [dbo].[tblScheduleWeeks] sw         
    INNER JOIN [dbo].[tblScheduleChannels] sc ON sw.ScheduleWeekPK = sc.ScheduleWeekFK                
    INNER JOIN [dbo].[tblScheduleDays] sd ON sc.ScheduleChannelPK = sd.ScheduleChannelFK                 
    INNER JOIN [dbo].[tblScheduleSlots] ss ON sd.ScheduleDayPK = ss.ScheduleDayFK                  
    LEFT JOIN tblScheduleDeliveries sdel ON sdel.ScheduleSlotFK = ss.ScheduleSlotPK 
	 AND sdel.IsArchived = 0   AND sdel.ContainerInFK is NOT NULL                  
    LEFT JOIN appContainerOutLoadingTypes colt ON colt.ContainerOutLoadingTypePK = sc.ContainerOutLoadingTypeFK  
    LEFT JOIN tblContainerIns ci ON sdel.ContainerInFK = ci.ContainerInPK  
    LEFT JOIN tblTransportCompanies tsp ON ci.TransportCompanyFK = tsp.TransportCompanyPK      
    LEFT JOIN tblShippingCompanies shp ON ci.ShippingCompanyFK = shp.ShippingCompanyPK   
    LEFT JOIN tblStockIns si ON ci.ContainerInPK = si.ContainerInFK              
    LEFT JOIN appStockInStatus sist ON sist.StockInStatusPK = si.StockInStatusFK        
    LEFT JOIN tblDivisions d ON si.DivisionFK = d.DivisionPK                    
    LEFT JOIN tblCustomers c ON d.CustomerFK = c.CustomerPK        
    LEFT JOIN tblSuppliers InboundSup ON ci.SupplierFK = InboundSup.SupplierPK                    
    LEFT JOIN tblLoadingBays Inboundlb ON ci.LoadingBayFK = Inboundlb.LoadingBayPK                    
    LEFT OUTER JOIN tblCustomerDocketIdentifications cdis ON cdis.CustomerFK = d.CustomerFK AND cdis.DocketTypeFK = 1   
    WHERE sw.ScheduleWeekPK =@ScheduleWeekPK        
     AND (sc.IsArchived = 0 OR sc.IsArchived is null)        
     AND (sw.IsArchived = 0 OR sw.IsArchived is null)            
     AND (sd.IsArchived = 0 OR sd.IsArchived is null)         
     AND (ss.IsArchived = 0 OR ss.IsArchived is null)          
     AND (sdel.IsArchived = 0 OR sdel.IsArchived = 1 OR sdel.IsArchived IS NULL)  
	
  UNION        
        
  SELECT DISTINCT       
   sw.ScheduleWeekPK,
   sw.Name[ScheduleName],
   sc.ScheduleChannelPK,
   sc.[Name][ChannelName],
   sc.ColorCode[ChannelColorCode],
   sc.FreeMode[ChannelFreeMode] ,
   sc.AllowInbound[ChannelInbound] ,
   sc.AllowOutbound[ChannelOutbound],
   ISNULL(sc.ContainerOutLoadingTypeFK,-1) AS ContainerOutLoadingTypeFK,  
    ISNULL(colt.ContainerOutLoadingType,'No Restriction') AS ContainerOutLoadingType,
  -1 AS DeliveryContainerOutLoadingTypeFK,
  'No Restriction' AS DeliveryContainerOutLoadingType,
   sc.DeliveryCount[SlotDeliveryCount]           
   ,sd.ScheduleDayPK,CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), sd.[DayDate], 103) As [DayDate],
   sd.DayNumber,
   sd.StartTime[DayStart],
   sd.EndTime[DayEnd], 
   sd.MaxDuration[DayDuration],         
   -1 ScheduleSlotPK,
   sph.SchedulePlaceholderPK,
   sph.StartTime[SlotStart],
   sph.EndTime[SlotEnd],
   sph.ActualDuration[SlotDuration],           
   case when sph.Title = '' then             
    case when sph.customerfk > 0 then cus.CustomerName else su.Supplier end         
    else sph.Title end as PlaceholderTitle,         
   sph.ColorCode as PlaceholderColorCode,            
   -1 ScheduleDeliveryPK,   
    CASE   
      WHEN sph.[Description] = '' OR sph.[Description] IS NULL   
          THEN sph.Title  
      ELSE CONCAT(sph.Title, ' ', sph.[Description])   
    END AS [DeliveryDescription],
    '' [DeliveryStartTime],
	'' [DeliveryEndTime],
	'' [DeliveryDuration],            
   'Placeholder' as DeliveryType,            
   -1 as DeliveryContainerFK,            
   '' as DocketNumber,            
   case when sph.SupplierFK > 0 then su.Supplier else '' end as DocketSupplier,             
   case when sph.CustomerFK > 0 then cus.CustomerCode else '' end as DocketDivision,             
   '' as LoadingBay,             
   CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), sd.[DayDate], 103) as DocketDate,            
   '' as CustomerRef,              
   ''[ContainerNumber],       
   ''[LorryNumber],       
   ''[SealNumber],  
   '' AS ShippingCompany,
   '' AS TransportCompany,
   0 as [DeliveryIsArchived],             
  '' AS DeliveryStatus,
   DATEADD(dd,       
       CASE WHEN cus.customerpk IS NULL THEN 2 ELSE cus.DayCutOff END,       
    CAST(GETDATE() AS DATETIME)) + CASE WHEN cus.TimeCutOff IS NULL THEN '10:00:00' 
    ELSE CAST(cus.TimeCutOff AS DATETIME) 
    END AS CustomerCutoff,      
  CASE       
   WHEN CAST(sd.DayDate AS DATETIME) + CAST(sd.StartTime AS DATETIME) <=        
     DATEADD(dd, case when cus.customerpk IS NULL THEN 2 ELSE cus.DayCutOff END,       
     CAST(GETDATE() AS DATETIME)) + CAST(cus.TimeCutOff AS DATETIME)       
   THEN 1       
   ELSE 0       
   END AS DeliveryPastCutOff 
  FROM [dbo].[tblScheduleWeeks] sw         
  INNER JOIN [dbo].[tblScheduleChannels] sc ON sw.ScheduleWeekPK = sc.ScheduleWeekFK        
  INNER JOIN [dbo].[tblScheduleDays] sd ON sc.ScheduleChannelPK = sd.ScheduleChannelFK            
  INNER JOIN tblSchedulePlaceholders sph on sph.ScheduleDayFK = sd.ScheduleDayPK           
  LEFT JOIN appContainerOutLoadingTypes colt ON colt.ContainerOutLoadingTypePK = sc.ContainerOutLoadingTypeFK  
  LEFT JOIN tblCustomers cus on sph.CustomerFK = cus.CustomerPK           
  LEFT JOIN tblSuppliers su on sph.SupplierFK = su.SupplierPK                       
  WHERE sw.ScheduleWeekPK =@ScheduleWeekPK         
    AND (sc.IsArchived = 0 OR sc.IsArchived is null)        
    AND (sw.IsArchived = 0 OR sw.IsArchived is null)            
    AND (sd.IsArchived = 0 OR sd.IsArchived is null)          
    AND (sph.IsArchived = 0 or sph.IsArchived is null) 
 );   
GO

/****** Object:  UserDefinedFunction [dbo].[fnGetScheduleWeekTemplatesForBuildingWithWeekTemplatePK]    Script Date: 02/11/2026 17:47:23 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO

-- SELECT * FROM fnGetScheduleWeekTemplatesForBuildingWithWeekTemplatePK(11,1)  
  
       
-- =============================================        
-- Author:  <Archana Singh>        
-- Create date: <08/01/2024>        
-- Description: <Description,,>        
-- =============================================   
  
  
CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[fnGetScheduleWeekTemplatesForBuildingWithWeekTemplatePK](  
   @BuildingFK INT,  
   @WeekTemplatePK INT  
)  
RETURNS TABLE  
AS  
RETURN  
(  
   SELECT Distinct swt.BuildingFK,swt.ScheduleWeekTemplatePK, swt.[Name][ScheduleName],   
 sct.ScheduleChannelTemplatePK, sct.[Name][ChannelName], sct.ColorCode[ChannelColorCode], sct.FreeMode[ChannelFreeMode],sct.AllowInbound[ChannelInbound] , sct.AllowOutbound[ChannelOutbound],
ISNULL(sct.ContainerOutLoadingTypeFK,-1) AS ContainerOutLoadingTypeFK,  
ISNULL(colt.ContainerOutLoadingType,'No Restriction') AS ContainerOutLoadingType,
sct.DeliveryCount[SlotDeliveryCount],        
    sdt.ScheduleDayTemplatePK,CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), sdt.[DayDate], 103) As [DayDate],sdt.DayNumber, sdt.StartTime[DayStartTime], sdt.EndTime[DayEndTime], sdt.MaxDuration[DayDuration],    
    sst.ScheduleSlotTemplatePK, sst.StartTime[SlotStart], sst.EndTime[SlotEnd],sst.ActualDuration[SlotDuration],  
 NULL [SchedulePlaceholderTemplatePK],'' [PlaceholderComment], '' [PlaceholderColorCode],     
    NULL [CustomerFK], NULL[SupplierFK]    
 FROM TblScheduleWeekTemplates swt  
    INNER JOIN TblScheduleChannelTemplates sct ON sct.ScheduleWeekTemplateFK = swt.ScheduleWeekTemplatePK  
    INNER JOIN TblScheduleDayTemplates sdt ON sdt.ScheduleChannelTemplateFK = sct.ScheduleChannelTemplatePK  
    LEFT JOIN TblScheduleSlotTemplates sst ON sst.ScheduleDayTemplateFK = sdt.ScheduleDayTemplatePK      
   LEFT JOIN appContainerOutLoadingTypes colt ON colt.ContainerOutLoadingTypePK = sct.ContainerOutLoadingTypeFK  
   WHERE swt.ScheduleWeekTemplatePK =@WeekTemplatePK  
      AND swt.BuildingFK =@BuildingFK    
      AND (sct.IsArchived = 0 OR sct.IsArchived is NULL)       
      AND (swt.IsArchived = 0 OR swt.IsArchived is NULL)    
   AND (sdt.IsArchived = 0 OR sdt.IsArchived is NULL)  
  
UNION  
SELECT Distinct swt.BuildingFK,swt.ScheduleWeekTemplatePK, swt.[Name][ScheduleName],   
 sct.ScheduleChannelTemplatePK, sct.[Name][ChannelName], sct.ColorCode[ChannelColorCode], sct.FreeMode[ChannelFreeMode], sct.AllowInbound[ChannelInbound] , sct.AllowOutbound[ChannelOutbound],
 ISNULL(sct.ContainerOutLoadingTypeFK,-1) AS ContainerOutLoadingTypeFK,  
ISNULL(colt.ContainerOutLoadingType,'No Restriction') AS ContainerOutLoadingType,
sct.DeliveryCount[SlotDeliveryCount],        
    sdt.ScheduleDayTemplatePK, CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), sdt.[DayDate], 103) As [DayDate], sdt.DayNumber,  sdt.StartTime[DayStartTime], sdt.EndTime[DayEndTime], sdt.MaxDuration[DayDuration],     
    NULL[ScheduleSlotTemplatePK], spt.StartTime[SlotStart],spt.EndTime[SlotEnd],spt.ActualDuration[SlotDuration],  
 spt.SchedulePlaceholderTemplatePK,spt.[Description][PlaceholderComment], spt.ColorCode[PlaceholderColorCode],     
    spt.CustomerFK, spt.SupplierFK     
    FROM TblScheduleWeekTemplates swt  
    INNER JOIN TblScheduleChannelTemplates sct ON sct.ScheduleWeekTemplateFK = swt.ScheduleWeekTemplatePK  
    INNER JOIN TblScheduleDayTemplates sdt ON sdt.ScheduleChannelTemplateFK = sct.ScheduleChannelTemplatePK  
    INNER JOIN TblSchedulePlaceholderTemplates spt ON sdt.ScheduleDayTemplatePK = spt.ScheduleDayTemplateFK  
   LEFT JOIN appContainerOutLoadingTypes colt ON colt.ContainerOutLoadingTypePK = sct.ContainerOutLoadingTypeFK  
   LEFT JOIN TblCustomers c ON spt.CustomerFK = c.CustomerPK  
    LEFT JOIN TblSuppliers s ON spt.SupplierFK = s.SupplierPK  
    WHERE swt.ScheduleWeekTemplatePK =@WeekTemplatePK  
      AND swt.BuildingFK =@BuildingFK    
      AND (sct.IsArchived = 0 OR sct.IsArchived is NULL)       
      AND (swt.IsArchived = 0 OR swt.IsArchived is NULL)    
   AND (sdt.IsArchived = 0 OR sdt.IsArchived is NULL)  
  
);  
GO
/****** Object:  UserDefinedFunction [dbo].[fnGetScheduleWeekForBuildingWithYearAndWeekNumber]    Script Date: 02/11/2026 17:47:23 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
  
          
-- SELECT * FROM [dbo].[fnGetScheduleWeekForBuildingWithYearAndWeekNumber](11,33,2026,663)ORDER BY ChannelName ASC, DayDate ASC;               
-- SELECT * FROM [dbo].[fnGetScheduleWeekForBuildingWithYearAndWeekNumber](11,24,2026,272)ORDER BY ChannelName ASC, DayDate ASC;               
                                  
-- =============================================                                    
-- Author:  <Archana Singh>                                    
-- Create date: <04/11/2024>                                    
-- Description: <Description,,>                                    
-- =============================================                                    
                              
CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[fnGetScheduleWeekForBuildingWithYearAndWeekNumber]                                  
(                                    
  @BuildingFK INT,                              
  @WeekNumber INT,                              
  @Year INT,                    
  @UserFK INT                    
)                              
RETURNS TABLE                              
AS                                  
RETURN                   
(                 
   WITH distinctResults AS            
   (            
    SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY DeliveryContainerFK ORDER BY LoadingBay ASC) AS rn            
    FROM             
    (               
  SELECT DISTINCT d2.DivisionPK AS OutDiv,  ud.DivisionFK,                    
    CASE           
        WHEN ScheduleDeliveryPK IS NULL OR u.UserTypeFK = 1 THEN 0 -- empty slot - show          
        ELSE           
            CASE           
                WHEN ud.DivisionFK IS NULL THEN 1 -- scheduled delivery not matching this user division - restrict          
                ELSE 0 -- matches - let them see this info          
            END                    
    END AS IsClientRestricted,                         
          
    sw.ScheduleWeekPK,          
    sw.[Name] AS [ScheduleName],           
    ScheduleChannelPK,          
    sc.[Name] AS [ChannelName],           
    sc.ColorCode AS [ChannelColorCode],          
    sc.FreeMode AS [ChannelFreeMode],           
    sc.AllowInbound AS [ChannelInbound],           
    sc.AllowOutbound AS [ChannelOutbound], 
    -- Channel delivery type
    ISNULL(sc.ContainerOutLoadingTypeFK,-1) AS ContainerOutLoadingTypeFK,  
    ISNULL(colt.ContainerOutLoadingType,'No Restriction') AS ContainerOutLoadingType,
    
    -- Actual delivery/container-out type
    CASE 
      WHEN sdel.ContainerOutFK > 0 
        THEN ISNULL(coloading.ContainerOutLoadingTypeFK, -1)
       ELSE -1
     END AS DeliveryContainerOutLoadingTypeFK,

    CASE 
      WHEN sdel.ContainerOutFK > 0 
        THEN ISNULL(dcolt.ContainerOutLoadingType, 'No Restriction')
      ELSE 'No Restriction'
   END AS DeliveryContainerOutLoadingType,    
    
    sc.DeliveryCount AS [SlotDeliveryCount],           
          
    sd.ScheduleDayPK,           
    CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), sd.DayDate, 103) AS [DayDate],          
    sd.DayNumber,          
    sd.StartTime AS [DayStartTime],           
    sd.EndTime AS [DayEndTime],           
    sd.MaxDuration AS [DayDuration],                         
          
    ss.ScheduleSlotPK,          
    -1 AS SchedulePlaceholderPK,           
    ss.StartTime AS [SlotStart],           
    ss.EndTime AS [SlotEnd],          
    ss.ActualDuration AS [SlotDuration],                            
          
    '' AS [PlaceholderTitle],          
    '' AS [PlaceholderColorCode],                             
          
    sdel.ScheduleDeliveryPK,          
    sdel.[Description] AS [DeliveryDescription],          
    sdel.StartTime AS [DeliveryStartTime],           
    sdel.EndTime AS [DeliveryEndTime],          
    sdel.ActualDuration AS [DeliveryDuration],                              
          
    CASE           
   WHEN sdel.ContainerInFK > 0 THEN 'Inbound'           
      WHEN sdel.ContainerOutFK > 0 THEN 'Outbound'           
   ELSE NULL           
 END AS DeliveryType,             
           
    CASE           
   WHEN sdel.ContainerInFK > 0 THEN sdel.ContainerInFK          
   WHEN sdel.ContainerOutFK > 0 THEN sdel.ContainerOutFK           
   ELSE NULL           
 END AS DeliveryContainerFK,                              
    CASE WHEN sdel.ContainerOutFK > 0 THEN co.GoodsOrderNumber END AS DocketNumber,                                      
    '' AS DocketSupplier,                               
    CASE WHEN sdel.ContainerOutFK > 0 THEN d2.DivisionCode END AS DocketDivision,                               
    CASE WHEN sdel.ContainerOutFK > 0 THEN Outboundlb.LoadingBay END AS LoadingBay,                               
CASE WHEN sdel.ContainerOutFK > 0 THEN           
 CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), CAST(co.CollectionDate AS DATE), 103) END AS DocketDate,                             
          
    CASE WHEN sdel.ContainerOutFK > 0 THEN          
        CASE WHEN cdis2.CustomerDocketIdentificationPK IS NULL THEN                               
            (CASE WHEN co.Docketlabel1 <> '' THEN co.Docketlabel1 + ': ' + co.DocketValue1 ELSE '' END) + ' ' +                              
            (CASE WHEN co.Docketlabel2 <> '' THEN co.Docketlabel2 + ': ' + co.DocketValue2 ELSE '' END) + ' ' +                              
            (CASE WHEN co.Docketlabel3 <> '' THEN co.Docketlabel3 + ': ' + co.DocketValue3 ELSE '' END)                               
        ELSE                              
            CASE cdis2.FieldFK           
                WHEN 40 THEN cdis2.Prefix + ' ' + co.DocketValue1                              
                WHEN 41 THEN cdis2.Prefix + ' ' + co.DocketValue2                              
                WHEN 42 THEN cdis2.Prefix + ' ' + co.DocketValue3                              
            END + ' ' +                              
            CASE cdis2.Field2FK           
                WHEN 40 THEN cdis2.Prefix2 + ' ' + co.DocketValue1                              
                WHEN 41 THEN cdis2.Prefix2 + ' ' + co.DocketValue2                              
                WHEN 42 THEN cdis2.Prefix2 + ' ' + co.DocketValue3                              
                ELSE ''                              
            END                              
        END           
    ELSE ''          
    END AS CustomerRef,                             
          
    CASE WHEN sdel.ContainerOutFK > 0 THEN ISNULL(co.ContainerNumber,'') ELSE '' END AS ContainerNumber,                              
    CASE WHEN sdel.ContainerOutFK > 0 THEN ISNULL(co.LorryNumber,'') ELSE '' END AS LorryNumber,                              
    CASE WHEN sdel.ContainerOutFK > 0 THEN ISNULL(co.SealNumber,'') ELSE '' END AS SealNumber,          
    CASE WHEN sdel.ContainerOutFK > 0 THEN ISNULL(shp.ShippingCompany,'') ELSE '' END AS ShippingCompany,          
    CASE WHEN sdel.ContainerOutFK > 0 THEN ISNULL(tsp.TransportCompany,'') ELSE '' END AS TransportCompany,          
          
    CAST(sdel.IsArchived AS INT) AS [DeliveryIsArchived],               
          
    CASE           
        WHEN sdel.ContainerOutFK > 0 THEN                   
            CASE           
                WHEN co.ContainerOutStageFK IN (1,2) THEN 'Pending'                   
                WHEN co.ContainerOutStageFK IN (3,4,5,6,7) THEN 'InProgress'                  
                ELSE 'Completed'           
            END          
    ELSE ''          
    END AS DeliveryStatus,                  
          
 CASE                 
    WHEN sdel.ContainerInFK > 0 OR sdel.ContainerOutFK > 0 THEN                   
    DATEADD(dd, c2.DayCutOff,                 
     CONVERT(DATETIME, FORMAT(sd.DayDate, 'yyyy-MM-dd'))) + CAST(c2.TimeCutOff AS DATETIME)                
   ELSE                 
    CAST(GETDATE() AS DATETIME)                 
  END AS CustomerCutoff,                    
                
  CASE                 
   WHEN sdel.ContainerInFK > 0 OR sdel.ContainerOutFK > 0 THEN                   
    CASE                 
     WHEN CONVERT(DATETIME, FORMAT(sd.DayDate, 'yyyy-MM-dd')) + CAST(sd.StartTime AS DATETIME) <=                 
       DATEADD(dd, c2.DayCutOff,                 
       CONVERT(DATETIME, FORMAT(sd.DayDate, 'yyyy-MM-dd'))) + CAST(c2.TimeCutOff AS DATETIME)                 
     THEN 1                 
     ELSE 0                 
    END                 
   ELSE                 
    0                 
  END AS DeliveryPastCutOff,     
   CAST(1 AS BIT) AS ContainerOutEditStatus,     
   c2.CustomerPK,            
   c2.CustomerCode,            
   c2.CustomerName,            
   d2.DivisionPK,    
   d2.DivisionCode,            
   d2.DivisionName,     
   ISNULL(c2.DefaultDeliveryDurationMinutes,120) As CustomerDeliveryDurationMinutes      
FROM  [dbo].[tblScheduleWeeks] sw                        
INNER JOIN [dbo].[tblScheduleChannels] sc ON sw.ScheduleWeekPK = sc.ScheduleWeekFK                          
INNER JOIN [dbo].[tblScheduleDays] sd ON sc.ScheduleChannelPK = sd.ScheduleChannelFK                           
INNER JOIN [dbo].[tblScheduleSlots] ss ON sd.ScheduleDayPK = ss.ScheduleDayFK                            
LEFT JOIN tblScheduleDeliveries sdel ON sdel.ScheduleSlotFK = ss.ScheduleSlotPK  AND sdel.IsArchived = 0 AND sdel.ContainerOutFK is NOT NULL 
LEFT JOIN tblContainerOutLoading coloading ON coloading.ContainerOutFK = sdel.ContainerOutFK AND coloading.IsArchived = 0
LEFT JOIN appContainerOutLoadingTypes dcolt ON dcolt.ContainerOutLoadingTypePK = coloading.ContainerOutLoadingTypeFK
LEFT JOIN appContainerOutLoadingTypes colt ON colt.ContainerOutLoadingTypePK = sc.ContainerOutLoadingTypeFK  
LEFT JOIN tblContainerOuts co ON sdel.ContainerOutFk = co.ContainerOutPK            
LEFT JOIN tblTransportCompanies tsp ON co.TransportCompanyFK = tsp.TransportCompanyPK          
LEFT JOIN tblShippingCompanies shp ON co.ShippingCompanyFK = shp.ShippingCompanyPK           
LEFT JOIN tblContainerOutLines col ON col.ContainerOutFK = co.ContainerOutPK            
LEFT JOIN tblStockOrders so ON co.ContainerOutPK = so.ContainerOutFK            
INNER JOIN tblBuildingUnits bu ON so.ResponsibleBuildingUnitFK = bu.BuildingUnitPK            
LEFT JOIN tblDivisions d2 ON d2.DivisionPK = col.DivisionFK                        
LEFT JOIN tblCustomers c2 ON d2.CustomerFK = c2.CustomerPK             
LEFT JOIN tblLoadingBays Outboundlb ON so.PickupLoadingBayFK = Outboundlb.LoadingBayPK                              
LEFT OUTER JOIN tblCustomerDocketIdentifications cdis2 ON cdis2.CustomerFK = d2.CustomerFK           
      AND cdis2.DocketTypeFK = 2                      
LEFT JOIN tblUsers u ON u.UserPK = @UserFK                    
LEFT JOIN tblUserDivisions ud ON ud.UserFK = @UserFK AND d2.DivisionPK = ud.DivisionFK                    
WHERE sw.BuildingFK = @BuildingFK                          
  AND sw.WeekNumber = @WeekNumber           
  AND sw.Year = @Year                           
  AND (sc.IsArchived = 0 OR sc.IsArchived IS NULL)                          
  AND (sw.IsArchived = 0 OR sw.IsArchived IS NULL)                              
  AND (sd.IsArchived = 0 OR sd.IsArchived IS NULL)                           
  AND (ss.IsArchived = 0 OR ss.IsArchived IS NULL)                            
  AND (sdel.IsArchived = 0 OR sdel.IsArchived IS NULL)           
  )OutBound            
 )          
  SELECT  IsClientRestricted,                    
  ScheduleWeekPK,                 
  ScheduleName,            
  ScheduleChannelPK,                    
  ChannelName,                     
  ChannelColorCode,                     
  ChannelFreeMode,                    
  ChannelInbound,                    
  ChannelOutbound, 
  ContainerOutLoadingTypeFK,
  ContainerOutLoadingType,
  DeliveryContainerOutLoadingTypeFK,
  DeliveryContainerOutLoadingType,
  SlotDeliveryCount,                  
  ScheduleDayPK,                     
  DayDate,             
  DayNumber,            
  DayStartTime,                     
  DayEndTime,                      
  DayDuration,                    
  ScheduleSlotPK,                    
  SchedulePlaceholderPK,                     
  SlotStart,                     
  SlotEnd,                     
  SlotDuration,                    
  PlaceholderTitle,                    
  PlaceholderColorCode,                    
  ScheduleDeliveryPK,                    
  case when isClientRestricted=1 then 'Hidden Info' ELSE DeliveryDescription end as DeliveryDescription,                     
  DeliveryStartTime,                     
  DeliveryEndTime,                     
  DeliveryDuration,                              
  DeliveryType,                                  
  DeliveryContainerFK,                           
  case when isClientRestricted=1 then 'Hidden Info' ELSE DocketNumber end as DocketNumber,                      
  case when IsClientRestricted=1 then 'Hidden Info' ELSE DocketSupplier end as DocketSupplier,                      
  case when IsClientRestricted=1 then 'Hidden Info' ELSE DocketDivision end as DocketDivision,                     
  LoadingBay,                               
  DocketDate,             
  case when IsClientRestricted=1 then 'Hidden Info' ELSE CustomerRef end as CustomerRef,                      
  case when IsClientRestricted=1 then 'Hidden Info' ELSE ContainerNumber end as ContainerNumber,                        
  case when IsClientRestricted=1 then 'Hidden Info' ELSE LorryNumber end as LorryNumber,                        
  case when IsClientRestricted=1 then 'Hidden Info' ELSE SealNumber end as SealNumber,           
  case when IsClientRestricted=1 then 'Hidden Info' ELSE ShippingCompany end as ShippingCompany,           
  case when IsClientRestricted=1 then 'Hidden Info' ELSE TransportCompany end as TransportCompany,           
  DeliveryIsArchived ,DeliveryStatus, CustomerCutoff, DeliveryPastCutOff,      
   CustomerPK,            
   CASE WHEN IsClientRestricted=1 THEN 'Hidden Info' ELSE CustomerCode END AS CustomerCode,               
  CASE WHEN IsClientRestricted=1 THEN 'Hidden Info' ELSE CustomerName END AS CustomerName,               
  DivisionPK,    
  CASE WHEN IsClientRestricted=1 THEN 'Hidden Info' ELSE DivisionCode END AS DivisionCode,               
  CASE WHEN IsClientRestricted=1 THEN 'Hidden Info' ELSE DivisionName END AS DivisionName,               
    
   ContainerOutEditStatus,         
   CustomerDeliveryDurationMinutes     
   FROM distinctResults            
  WHERE rn = 1            
           
 UNION             
  SELECT  IsClientRestricted,                    
  ScheduleWeekPK,                 
  ScheduleName,            
  ScheduleChannelPK,                    
  ChannelName,                     
  ChannelColorCode,             
  ChannelFreeMode,                    
  ChannelInbound,                    
  ChannelOutbound, 
  ContainerOutLoadingTypeFK,
  ContainerOutLoadingType,
  DeliveryContainerOutLoadingTypeFK,
  DeliveryContainerOutLoadingType,
  SlotDeliveryCount,                  
  ScheduleDayPK,                     
  DayDate,             
  DayNumber,            
  DayStartTime,                     
  DayEndTime,                      
  DayDuration,                    
  ScheduleSlotPK,                    
  SchedulePlaceholderPK,                     
  SlotStart,                     
  SlotEnd,                     
  SlotDuration,                    
  PlaceholderTitle,                    
  PlaceholderColorCode,                   
  ScheduleDeliveryPK,                    
  case when isClientRestricted=1 then 'Hidden Info' ELSE DeliveryDescription end as DeliveryDescription,                     
  DeliveryStartTime,                     
  DeliveryEndTime,                     
  DeliveryDuration,                              
  DeliveryType,                                  
  DeliveryContainerFK,                           
  case when isClientRestricted=1 then 'Hidden Info' ELSE DocketNumber end as DocketNumber,                      
  case when IsClientRestricted=1 then 'Hidden Info' ELSE DocketSupplier end as DocketSupplier,                      
  case when IsClientRestricted=1 then 'Hidden Info' ELSE DocketDivision end as DocketDivision,                     
  LoadingBay,                               
  DocketDate,                       
  case when IsClientRestricted=1 then 'Hidden Info' ELSE CustomerRef end as CustomerRef,                      
  case when IsClientRestricted=1 then 'Hidden Info' ELSE ContainerNumber end as ContainerNumber,                        
  case when IsClientRestricted=1 then 'Hidden Info' ELSE LorryNumber end as LorryNumber,                        
  case when IsClientRestricted=1 then 'Hidden Info' ELSE SealNumber end as SealNumber,           
  case when IsClientRestricted=1 then 'Hidden Info' ELSE ShippingCompany end as ShippingCompany,           
  case when IsClientRestricted=1 then 'Hidden Info' ELSE TransportCompany end as TransportCompany,           
  DeliveryIsArchived ,DeliveryStatus, CustomerCutoff, DeliveryPastCutOff,      
  CustomerPK,            
  CASE WHEN IsClientRestricted=1 THEN 'Hidden Info' ELSE CustomerCode END AS CustomerCode,               
  CASE WHEN IsClientRestricted=1 THEN 'Hidden Info' ELSE CustomerName END AS CustomerName,               
 DivisionPK,    
  CASE WHEN IsClientRestricted=1 THEN 'Hidden Info' ELSE DivisionCode END AS DivisionCode,               
  CASE WHEN IsClientRestricted=1 THEN 'Hidden Info' ELSE DivisionName END AS DivisionName,               
     
   ContainerOutEditStatus,         
   CustomerDeliveryDurationMinutes      
   FROM                    
   (                    
     SELECT DISTINCT           
    d.DivisionPK AS Indiv, ud.DivisionFK,                    
     CASE           
        WHEN ScheduleDeliveryPK IS NULL OR u.UserTypeFK = 1 THEN 0 -- empty slot - show          
        ELSE           
            CASE           
                WHEN ud.DivisionFK IS NULL THEN 1 -- scheduled delivery not matching this user division - restrict          
                ELSE 0 -- matches - let them see this info          
            END                    
    END AS IsClientRestricted,           
          
   sw.ScheduleWeekPK,          
   sw.[Name] AS [ScheduleName],          
   ScheduleChannelPK,           
   sc.[Name] AS [ChannelName],           
   sc.ColorCode AS [ChannelColorCode],          
   sc.FreeMode AS [ChannelFreeMode],           
   sc.AllowInbound AS [ChannelInbound],          
   sc.AllowOutbound AS [ChannelOutbound], 
   ISNULL(sc.ContainerOutLoadingTypeFK,-1) AS ContainerOutLoadingTypeFK,  
   ISNULL(colt.ContainerOutLoadingType,'No Restriction') AS ContainerOutLoadingType,
   
   -1 AS DeliveryContainerOutLoadingTypeFK,
  'No Restriction' AS DeliveryContainerOutLoadingType,

   sc.DeliveryCount AS [SlotDeliveryCount],          
          
   sd.ScheduleDayPK,           
   CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), sd.DayDate, 103) AS [DayDate],          
   sd.DayNumber,           
   sd.StartTime AS [DayStartTime],          
   sd.EndTime AS [DayEndTime],          
   sd.MaxDuration AS [DayDuration],                         
          
   ss.ScheduleSlotPK,          
   -1 AS SchedulePlaceholderPK,          
   ss.StartTime AS [SlotStart],          
   ss.EndTime AS [SlotEnd],          
   ss.ActualDuration AS [SlotDuration],                            
          
   '' AS [PlaceholderTitle],          
   '' AS [PlaceholderColorCode],                             
          
   sdel.ScheduleDeliveryPK,          
   sdel.[Description] AS [DeliveryDescription],          
   sdel.StartTime AS [DeliveryStartTime],          
   sdel.EndTime AS [DeliveryEndTime],          
   sdel.ActualDuration AS [DeliveryDuration],          
          
    CASE           
   WHEN sdel.ContainerInFK > 0 THEN 'Inbound'           
      WHEN sdel.ContainerOutFK > 0 THEN 'Outbound'           
   ELSE NULL           
 END AS DeliveryType,             
           
    CASE           
   WHEN sdel.ContainerInFK > 0 THEN sdel.ContainerInFK          
   WHEN sdel.ContainerOutFK > 0 THEN sdel.ContainerOutFK           
   ELSE NULL           
 END AS DeliveryContainerFK,               
   CASE WHEN sdel.ContainerInFK > 0 THEN ci.GoodsInNumber ELSE ' ' END AS DocketNumber,           
   CASE WHEN sdel.ContainerInFK > 0 THEN InboundSup.Supplier ELSE '' END AS DocketSupplier,                               
   CASE WHEN sdel.ContainerInFK > 0 THEN d.DivisionCode ELSE ' ' END AS DocketDivision,                               
   CASE WHEN sdel.ContainerInFK > 0 THEN Inboundlb.LoadingBay END AS LoadingBay,                               
   CASE WHEN sdel.ContainerInFK > 0 THEN           
   CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), CAST(ci.DateIn AS DATE), 103) END AS DocketDate,          
          
   CASE WHEN sdel.ContainerInFK > 0 THEN           
       CASE WHEN cdis.CustomerDocketIdentificationPK IS NOT NULL THEN                               
            (CASE cdis.FieldFK WHEN 1 THEN ci.Free1 WHEN 2 THEN ci.Free2 WHEN 3 THEN ci.Free3           
                                WHEN 4 THEN ci.Free4 WHEN 5 THEN ci.Free5 ELSE ' ' END)          
            + ' ' +          
            (CASE cdis.Field2FK WHEN 1 THEN ci.Free1 WHEN 2 THEN ci.Free2 WHEN 3 THEN ci.Free3           
                                WHEN 4 THEN ci.Free4 WHEN 5 THEN ci.Free5 ELSE ' ' END)          
            + ' ' +          
            (CASE cdis.Field3FK WHEN 1 THEN ci.Free1 WHEN 2 THEN ci.Free2 WHEN 3 THEN ci.Free3           
                                WHEN 4 THEN ci.Free4 WHEN 5 THEN ci.Free5 ELSE ' ' END)          
       ELSE ' ' END          
       + ' ' + COALESCE(NULLIF(ci.ExternalReference,''),' ')          
   ELSE ' '           
   END AS CustomerRef,          
          
   CASE WHEN sdel.ContainerInFK > 0 THEN ISNULL(ci.[ContainerNumber],'') ELSE '' END AS ContainerNumber,                              
   CASE WHEN sdel.ContainerInFK > 0 THEN ISNULL(ci.[LorryNumber],'') ELSE '' END AS LorryNumber,                              
   CASE WHEN sdel.ContainerInFK > 0 THEN ISNULL(ci.[SealNumber],'') ELSE '' END AS SealNumber,          
   CASE WHEN sdel.ContainerInFK > 0 THEN ISNULL(shp.ShippingCompany,'') ELSE '' END AS ShippingCompany,          
   CASE WHEN sdel.ContainerInFK > 0 THEN ISNULL(tsp.TransportCompany,'') ELSE '' END AS TransportCompany,          
   CAST(sdel.IsArchived AS INT) AS [DeliveryIsArchived],                  
   CASE WHEN sdel.ContainerInFK > 0 THEN sist.StockInStatus ELSE '' END AS DeliveryStatus,                  
          
  CASE                 
    WHEN sdel.ContainerInFK > 0 OR sdel.ContainerOutFK > 0 THEN                   
    DATEADD(dd, c.DayCutOff,                 
     CONVERT(DATETIME, FORMAT(sd.DayDate, 'yyyy-MM-dd'))) + CAST(c.TimeCutOff AS DATETIME)                
   ELSE                 
    CAST(GETDATE() AS DATETIME)                 
  END AS CustomerCutoff,                    
                
  CASE                 
   WHEN sdel.ContainerInFK > 0 OR sdel.ContainerOutFK > 0 THEN                   
    CASE                 
     WHEN CONVERT(DATETIME, FORMAT(sd.DayDate, 'yyyy-MM-dd')) + CAST(sd.StartTime AS DATETIME) <=                 
       DATEADD(dd, c.DayCutOff,                 
       CONVERT(DATETIME, FORMAT(sd.DayDate, 'yyyy-MM-dd'))) + CAST(c.TimeCutOff AS DATETIME)                 
     THEN 1                 
     ELSE 0                 
    END                 
   ELSE                 
    0                 
  END AS DeliveryPastCutOff,     
  CAST(1 AS BIT) AS ContainerOutEditStatus,     
  c.CustomerPK,            
   c.CustomerCode,            
   c.CustomerName,            
   d.DivisionPK,    
   d.DivisionCode,            
   d.DivisionName,     
   ISNULL(c.DefaultDeliveryDurationMinutes,120) As CustomerDeliveryDurationMinutes      
FROM [dbo].[tblScheduleWeeks] sw                           
INNER JOIN [dbo].[tblScheduleChannels] sc ON sw.ScheduleWeekPK = sc.ScheduleWeekFK                          
INNER JOIN [dbo].[tblScheduleDays] sd ON sc.ScheduleChannelPK = sd.ScheduleChannelFK                           
INNER JOIN [dbo].[tblScheduleSlots] ss ON sd.ScheduleDayPK = ss.ScheduleDayFK                            
LEFT JOIN tblScheduleDeliveries sdel ON sdel.ScheduleSlotFK = ss.ScheduleSlotPK           
AND sdel.IsArchived = 0 AND sdel.ContainerInFK is NOT NULL                              
LEFT JOIN appContainerOutLoadingTypes colt ON colt.ContainerOutLoadingTypePK = sc.ContainerOutLoadingTypeFK  
LEFT JOIN tblContainerIns ci ON sdel.ContainerInFK = ci.ContainerInPK            
LEFT JOIN tblTransportCompanies tsp ON ci.TransportCompanyFK = tsp.TransportCompanyPK                
LEFT JOIN tblShippingCompanies shp ON ci.ShippingCompanyFK = shp.ShippingCompanyPK             
LEFT JOIN tblStockIns si ON ci.ContainerInPK = si.ContainerInFK                        
LEFT JOIN appStockInStatus sist ON sist.StockInStatusPK = si.StockInStatusFK                  
LEFT JOIN tblDivisions d ON si.DivisionFK = d.DivisionPK                              
LEFT JOIN tblCustomers c ON d.CustomerFK = c.CustomerPK          
LEFT JOIN tblSuppliers InboundSup ON ci.SupplierFK = InboundSup.SupplierPK                              
LEFT JOIN tblLoadingBays Inboundlb ON ci.LoadingBayFK = Inboundlb.LoadingBayPK                              
LEFT JOIN tblCustomerDocketIdentifications cdis ON cdis.CustomerFK = d.CustomerFK AND cdis.DocketTypeFK = 1                              
LEFT JOIN tblUsers u ON u.UserPK = @UserFK               
LEFT JOIN tblUserDivisions ud ON ud.UserFK = @UserFK AND d.DivisionPK = ud.DivisionFK                    
WHERE sw.BuildingFK = @BuildingFK                          
  AND sw.WeekNumber = @WeekNumber           
  AND sw.Year = @Year                           
  AND (sc.IsArchived = 0 OR sc.IsArchived IS NULL)                          
  AND (sw.IsArchived = 0 OR sw.IsArchived IS NULL)                              
  AND (sd.IsArchived = 0 OR sd.IsArchived IS NULL)                           
  AND (ss.IsArchived = 0 OR ss.IsArchived IS NULL)                            
  AND (sdel.IsArchived = 0 OR sdel.IsArchived IS NULL)            
 )Inbound          
          
                
UNION                  
 --PLACEHOLDER QUERY                
 SELECT IsClientRestricted,                    
   ScheduleWeekPK,             
   ScheduleName,                   
   ScheduleChannelPK,                    
   ChannelName,                     
   ChannelColorCode,                     
   ChannelFreeMode,                    
   ChannelInbound,                    
   ChannelOutbound,  
   ContainerOutLoadingTypeFK,
   ContainerOutLoadingType,
   DeliveryContainerOutLoadingTypeFK,
   DeliveryContainerOutLoadingType,
   SlotDeliveryCount,                  
   ScheduleDayPK,                     
   DayDate,             
   DayNumber,            
   DayStartTime,                     
   DayEndTime,                      
   DayDuration,                    
   ScheduleSlotPK,                    
   SchedulePlaceholderPK,                     
   SlotStart,                     
   SlotEnd,                     
   SlotDuration,                     
   case when IsClientRestricted=1 then 'Hidden Info' ELSE PlaceholderTitle end as PlaceholderTitle,                   
   PlaceholderColorCode,                     
   ScheduleDeliveryPK,                    
   case when IsClientRestricted=1 then 'Hidden Info' ELSE DeliveryDescription end as DeliveryDescription,                     
   DeliveryStartTime,                     
   DeliveryEndTime,                     
   DeliveryDuration,                              
   DeliveryType,                                  
   DeliveryContainerFK,                           
   case when IsClientRestricted=1 then 'Hidden Info' ELSE DocketNumber end as DocketNumber,                      
   case when IsClientRestricted=1 then 'Hidden Info' ELSE DocketSupplier end as DocketSupplier,                      
   case when IsClientRestricted=1 then 'Hidden Info' ELSE DocketDivision end as DocketDivision,                     
   LoadingBay,                               
   DocketDate,                       
   case when IsClientRestricted=1 then 'Hidden Info' ELSE CustomerRef end as CustomerRef,                      
   case when IsClientRestricted=1 then 'Hidden Info' ELSE ContainerNumber end as ContainerNumber,                        
   case when IsClientRestricted=1 then 'Hidden Info' ELSE LorryNumber end as LorryNumber,                        
   case when IsClientRestricted=1 then 'Hidden Info' ELSE SealNumber end as SealNumber,             
   case when IsClientRestricted=1 then 'Hidden Info' ELSE ShippingCompany end as ShippingCompany,           
   case when IsClientRestricted=1 then 'Hidden Info' ELSE TransportCompany end as TransportCompany,           
   DeliveryIsArchived ,DeliveryStatus, CustomerCutoff, DeliveryPastCutOff,      
   CustomerPK,            
   CASE WHEN IsClientRestricted=1 THEN 'Hidden Info' ELSE CustomerCode END AS CustomerCode,               
  CASE WHEN IsClientRestricted=1 THEN 'Hidden Info' ELSE CustomerName END AS CustomerName,               
  DivisionPK,    
  CASE WHEN IsClientRestricted=1 THEN 'Hidden Info' ELSE DivisionCode END AS DivisionCode,               
  CASE WHEN IsClientRestricted=1 THEN 'Hidden Info' ELSE DivisionName END AS DivisionName,               
    
   ContainerOutEditStatus,         
   CustomerDeliveryDurationMinutes       
 FROM(                     
  SELECT DISTINCT                     
     case when u.UserTypeFK = 4 then                     
     1--schdeuled placeholder not matching this user division - restrict                       
     ELSE                    
     0--matches - let them see this info                      
     end as IsClientRestricted,                      
     sw.ScheduleWeekPK,sw.[Name][ScheduleName], sc.ScheduleChannelPK, sc.[Name][ChannelName], sc.ColorCode[ChannelColorCode], sc.FreeMode[ChannelFreeMode],           
  sc.AllowInbound[ChannelInbound], sc.AllowOutbound[ChannelOutbound],
  ISNULL(sc.ContainerOutLoadingTypeFK,-1) AS ContainerOutLoadingTypeFK,  
  ISNULL(colt.ContainerOutLoadingType,'No Restriction') AS ContainerOutLoadingType,
  -1 AS DeliveryContainerOutLoadingTypeFK,
 'No Restriction' AS DeliveryContainerOutLoadingType,
  sc.DeliveryCount[SlotDeliveryCount],                             
     sd.ScheduleDayPK, CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), sd.DayDate, 103) As [DayDate],sd.DayNumber, sd.StartTime[DayStartTime], sd.EndTime[DayEndTime], sd.MaxDuration[DayDuration],                         
    -1 ScheduleSlotPK, sph.SchedulePlaceholderPK, sph.StartTime[SlotStart], sph.EndTime[SlotEnd],sph.ActualDuration[SlotDuration],                        
    case when sph.Title = '' then                               
    case when sph.customerfk > 0 then c.CustomerName ELSE su.Supplier end                           
    ELSE sph.Title end as PlaceholderTitle,                           
    sph.ColorCode as PlaceholderColorCode,                              
    -1 ScheduleDeliveryPK,                
 CASE WHEN sph.[Description] = '' OR sph.[Description] IS NULL THEN sph.Title            
 ELSE CONCAT(sph.Title, ' ', sph.[Description])  END AS [DeliveryDescription],              
              
 sph.StartTime[DeliveryStartTime], sph.EndTime[DeliveryEndTime], sph.ActualDuration[DeliveryDuration],                              
    'Placeholder' as DeliveryType,                        
    -1 as DeliveryContainerFK,                              
    '' as DocketNumber,                              
    case when sph.SupplierFK > 0 then su.Supplier ELSE '' end as DocketSupplier,                               
    case when sph.CustomerFK > 0 then c.CustomerCode ELSE '' end as DocketDivision,                               
    '' as LoadingBay,                               
    CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), sd.[DayDate], 103) as DocketDate,                              
    '' as CustomerRef,                              
    ''[ContainerNumber],                       
    ''[LorryNumber],                       
    ''[SealNumber],            
    ''[ShippingCompany],          
    ''[TransportCompany],           
    0 as [DeliveryIsArchived],                  
    '' as DeliveryStatus,                     
   DATEADD(dd,                 
   case when c.customerpk IS NULL then 2 ELSE c.DayCutOff end,                 
   CAST(GETDATE() AS DATETIME)) + case when c.TimeCutOff IS NULL then '10:00:00' ELSE CAST(c.TimeCutOff AS DATETIME) end as CustomerCutoff,                
  case                 
   when CAST(sd.DayDate AS DATETIME) + CAST(sd.StartTime AS DATETIME) <=                  
     DATEADD(dd, case when c.customerpk IS NULL then 2 ELSE c.DayCutOff end,                 
     CAST(GETDATE() AS DATETIME)) + CAST(c.TimeCutOff AS DATETIME)                 
   then 1                 
   ELSE 0                 
   end as DeliveryPastCutOff,      
    CAST(1 AS BIT) AS ContainerOutEditStatus,    
   c.CustomerPK,            
   c.CustomerCode,            
   c.CustomerName,            
   d.DivisionPK,    
   d.DivisionCode,            
   d.DivisionName,   
   ISNULL(c.DefaultDeliveryDurationMinutes,120) As CustomerDeliveryDurationMinutes      
  FROM [dbo].[tblScheduleWeeks] sw                           
  INNER JOIN [dbo].[tblScheduleChannels] sc ON sw.ScheduleWeekPK = sc.ScheduleWeekFK                          
  INNER JOIN [dbo].[tblScheduleDays] sd ON sc.ScheduleChannelPK = sd.ScheduleChannelFK                              
  INNER JOIN tblSchedulePlaceholders sph on sph.ScheduleDayFK = sd.ScheduleDayPK                     
  LEFT JOIN appContainerOutLoadingTypes colt ON colt.ContainerOutLoadingTypePK = sc.ContainerOutLoadingTypeFK  
  LEFT JOIN tblcustomers c on sph.CustomerFK = c.CustomerPK                       
  LEFT JOIN tblDivisions d ON d.CustomerFK = c.CustomerPK                         
  LEFT JOIN tblUserDivisions ud on ud.UserFK=@UserFK AND (d.DivisionPK=ud.DivisionFK OR ud.UserFK=@UserFK)                    
  LEFT JOIN [dbo].[tblusers] u on u.UserPK = @UserFK                    
  LEFT JOIN tblSuppliers su on sph.SupplierFK = su.SupplierPK    
  WHERE sw.BuildingFK =@BuildingFK                          
  AND sw.WeekNumber=@WeekNumber                   
  AND sw.Year=@Year                           
  AND (sc.IsArchived = 0 OR sc.IsArchived IS NULL)                          
  AND (sw.IsArchived = 0 OR sw.IsArchived IS NULL)                              
  AND (sd.IsArchived = 0 OR sd.IsArchived IS NULL)                            
  AND (sph.IsArchived = 0 or sph.IsArchived IS NULL)                    
  )SPH              
); 
GO

/****** Object:  UserDefinedFunction [dbo].[fnScheduleActivityCommentsForDeliveryAndPlaceholder]    Script Date: 02/11/2026 17:47:23 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
  
-- SELECT * FROM dbo.fnScheduleActivityCommentsForDeliveryAndPlaceholder(11,-1,151) ORDER BY ScheduleActivityPK DESC;  
-- SELECT * FROM dbo.fnScheduleActivityCommentsForDeliveryAndPlaceholder(11,142,-1) ORDER BY ScheduleActivityPK DESC;  
-- SELECT * FROM dbo.fnScheduleActivityCommentsForDeliveryAndPlaceholder(11,232,-1) ORDER BY ScheduleActivityPK DESC;

   CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[fnScheduleActivityCommentsForDeliveryAndPlaceholder]    
   (    
     @BuildingFK INT,     
     @ScheduleDeliveryFK INT ,  
     @schedulePlaceholderFK INT  
   )     
   RETURNS TABLE      
   AS   
   RETURN     
   (           
    SELECT sa.ScheduleActivityPK, p.FirstName + ' ' + p.LastName AS [Person],  
    sa.Comments AS [Comment], sat.ScheduleActivityType[ActType],   
    FORMAT(sa.InsertedDate, 'dd/MM/yy HH:mm:ss') AS [ActivityDate]        
    FROM  tblScheduleActivities sa        
    INNER JOIN tblUsers u ON sa.InsertedBy = u.UserPK        
    INNER JOIN tblPeople p ON u.PersonFK = p.PersonPK        
    INNER JOIN appScheduleActivityTypes sat ON sa.ScheduleActivityTypeFK = sat.ScheduleActivityTypePK        
    LEFT JOIN tblScheduleDeliveries sd ON sd.ScheduleDeliveryPK = sa.ScheduleDeliveryFK        
    LEFT JOIN tblSchedulePlaceholders sp ON sp.SchedulePlaceholderPK = sa.SchedulePlaceholderFK        
    WHERE sa.BuildingFK = @BuildingFK    
   AND 
   ( 
     (sa.ScheduleDeliveryFK = @ScheduleDeliveryFK AND 
     (@ScheduleDeliveryFK > 0 AND (@SchedulePlaceholderFK = -1 OR @SchedulePlaceholderFK IS NULL)))   
     OR   
     (sa.SchedulePlaceholderFK = @SchedulePlaceholderFK AND (@SchedulePlaceholderFK > 0 AND (@ScheduleDeliveryFK = -1 OR @ScheduleDeliveryFK IS NULL)))  
     )      
   );   
GO
/****** Object:  View [dbo].[viewGoodsInReference]    Script Date: 02/11/2026 17:47:23 ******/

SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE VIEW [dbo].[viewGoodsInReference]
AS
select 
	case when cdis.CustomerDocketIdentificationPK = null then 
		'' 
	else
		case cdis.FieldFK 
		when 1 then
			cdis.Prefix + ' ' + containerIns.Free1
		when 2 then
			cdis.Prefix + ' ' + containerIns.Free2
		when 3 then
			cdis.Prefix + ' ' + containerIns.Free3
		when 4 then
			cdis.Prefix + ' ' + containerIns.Free4
		when 5 then
			cdis.Prefix + ' ' + containerIns.Free5
		when 64 then
			cdis.Prefix + ' ' + containerIns.ExternalReference
		ELSE
			''
		END
		+ ' ' +
		case cdis.Field2FK 
		when 1 then
			cdis.Prefix2 + ' ' + containerIns.Free1
		when 2 then
			cdis.Prefix2 + ' ' + containerIns.Free2
		when 3 then
			cdis.Prefix2 + ' ' + containerIns.Free3
		when 4 then
			cdis.Prefix2 + ' ' + containerIns.Free4
		when 5 then
			cdis.Prefix2 + ' ' + containerIns.Free5
		when 64 then
			cdis.Prefix2 + ' ' + containerIns.ExternalReference
		ELSE
			''
		end
	End as ID,
    divs.customerFK ,
containerInPK


from tblContainerIns containerIns
inner join tblstockins on containerinPK = containerinFK
inner join tbldivisions divs on divisionfk = divisionpk 
left outer join tblCustomerDocketIdentifications cdis on
cdis.CustomerFK = divs.CustomerFK
GO

/****** Object:  View [dbo].[viewIntegrationChecks]    Script Date: 02/11/2026 17:47:23 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO

CREATE VIEW [dbo].[viewIntegrationChecks]  
AS  
SELECT     ICTs.IntegrationCheckTypePK, ICTs.IntegrationCheckTypeDescription, divs.CustomerFK, ICDs.DivisionFK, isnull(coalesce(mem.Email collate SQL_Latin1_General_CP1_CI_AS, ICDUs.EmailAddress), '')EmailAddress   
FROM         dbo.tblIntegrationCheckDivisions ICDs  
inner join tblDivisions divs on  
divs.DivisionPK = ICDs.DivisionFK  
inner join appIntegrationCheckTypes ICTs on  
ICTs.IntegrationCheckTypePK = ICDs.IntegrationCheckTypeFK  
left outer join tblIntegrationCheckDivisionUsers ICDUs on  
ICDUs.IntegrationCheckDivisionFK = ICDs.IntegrationCheckDivisionPK  
left outer join tblUsers Users on  
Users.UserPK = ICDUs.UserFK  
left outer join aspnetusers mem on mem.Id = users.AspNetUserID
--left outer join dbo.aspnet_Membership mem on mem.UserId = Users.AspNetUserID   
  
Where ICTs.Enabled = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/  
AND ICDs.Enabled = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/
GO
/****** Object:  UserDefinedFunction [dbo].[cust747funtblDanoneStatusFromStawmsStatus]    Script Date: 02/11/2026 17:47:23 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[cust747funtblDanoneStatusFromStawmsStatus]
(	
	-- Add the parameters for the function here
	@palletStatusFK int
)
RETURNS TABLE 
AS
RETURN 
(
	Select 
	CASE 
		WHEN @palletStatusFK in (1, 15, 3) THEN 'N'
		WHEN @palletStatusFK in (9, 4, 7, 16) THEN 'Y'
		ELSE 'Y' --Jamie added default encase pallet status does not match
	End RequiresPositiveRelease,

	CASE 
		WHEN @palletStatusFK in (1, 9) THEN 'U'
		WHEN @palletStatusFK in (15, 4) THEN 'Q'
		WHEN @palletStatusFK in (3, 7, 16) THEN 'B'
		ELSE 'U' --Jamie added default encase pallet status does not match
	END GuardianStatus,

	CASE 
		WHEN @palletStatusFK in (1) THEN 'U'
		WHEN @palletStatusFK in (15, 9, 4) THEN 'Q'
		WHEN @palletStatusFK in (3, 7, 16) THEN 'B'
		ELSE 'Q' --Jamie added default encase pallet status does not match
	END SapStatus

	
)
GO
/****** Object:  UserDefinedFunction [dbo].[fnSplitStrings_XML]    Script Date: 02/11/2026 17:47:23 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
Create FUNCTION [dbo].[fnSplitStrings_XML]
(
   @List       NVARCHAR(MAX),
   @Delimiter  NVARCHAR(255)
)
RETURNS TABLE
WITH SCHEMABINDING
AS
   RETURN 
   (  
      SELECT Item = y.i.value('(./text())[1]', 'nvarchar(4000)')
      FROM 
      ( 
        SELECT x = CONVERT(XML, '<i>' 
          + REPLACE(@List, @Delimiter, '</i><i>') 
          + '</i>').query('.')
      ) AS a CROSS APPLY x.nodes('i') AS y(i)
   );
GO
