CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[aspnet_AnyDataInTables]
(
    @TablesToCheck INT
)
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT
	,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;
	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	DECLARE @var_TablesToCheck INT

	SET @var_TablesToCheck = @TablesToCheck

	SET @ParameterDetails = '@TablesToCheck = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_TablesToCheck AS NVARCHAR(20)),'')

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    --BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

		SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END

	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY			

			-- This stored procedures main code, excluding error handling - start

			-- Check Membership table if (@var_TablesToCheck & 1) is set
			IF ((@var_TablesToCheck & 1) <> 0 AND
				(EXISTS (SELECT name FROM sys.objects WHERE (name = N'vw_aspnet_MembershipUsers') AND (type = 'V'))))
			BEGIN
				IF (EXISTS(SELECT TOP 1 UserId FROM dbo.aspnet_Membership))
				BEGIN
					SELECT N'aspnet_Membership'
					RETURN
				END
			END

			-- Check aspnet_Roles table if (@var_TablesToCheck & 2) is set
			IF ((@var_TablesToCheck & 2) <> 0  AND
				(EXISTS (SELECT name FROM sys.objects WHERE (name = N'vw_aspnet_Roles') AND (type = 'V'))) )
			BEGIN
				IF (EXISTS(SELECT TOP 1 RoleId FROM dbo.aspnet_Roles))
				BEGIN
					SELECT N'aspnet_Roles'
					RETURN
				END
			END

			-- Check aspnet_Profile table if (@var_TablesToCheck & 4) is set
			IF ((@var_TablesToCheck & 4) <> 0  AND
				(EXISTS (SELECT name FROM sys.objects WHERE (name = N'vw_aspnet_Profiles') AND (type = 'V'))) )
			BEGIN
				IF (EXISTS(SELECT TOP 1 UserId FROM dbo.aspnet_Profile))
				BEGIN
					SELECT N'aspnet_Profile'
					RETURN
				END
			END

			-- Check aspnet_PersonalizationPerUser table if (@var_TablesToCheck & 8) is set
			IF ((@var_TablesToCheck & 8) <> 0  AND
				(EXISTS (SELECT name FROM sys.objects WHERE (name = N'vw_aspnet_WebPartState_User') AND (type = 'V'))) )
			BEGIN
				IF (EXISTS(SELECT TOP 1 UserId FROM dbo.aspnet_PersonalizationPerUser))
				BEGIN
					SELECT N'aspnet_PersonalizationPerUser'
					RETURN
				END
			END

			-- Check aspnet_PersonalizationPerUser table if (@var_TablesToCheck & 16) is set
			IF ((@var_TablesToCheck & 16) <> 0  AND
				(EXISTS (SELECT name FROM sys.objects WHERE (name = N'aspnet_WebEvent_LogEvent') AND (type = 'P'))) )
			BEGIN
				IF (EXISTS(SELECT TOP 1 * FROM dbo.aspnet_WebEvent_Events))
				BEGIN
					SELECT N'aspnet_WebEvent_Events'
					RETURN
				END
			END

			-- Check aspnet_Users table if (@var_TablesToCheck & 1,2,4 & 8) are all set
			IF ((@var_TablesToCheck & 1) <> 0 AND
				(@var_TablesToCheck & 2) <> 0 AND
				(@var_TablesToCheck & 4) <> 0 AND
				(@var_TablesToCheck & 8) <> 0 AND
				(@var_TablesToCheck & 32) <> 0 AND
				(@var_TablesToCheck & 128) <> 0 AND
				(@var_TablesToCheck & 256) <> 0 AND
				(@var_TablesToCheck & 512) <> 0 AND
				(@var_TablesToCheck & 1024) <> 0)
			BEGIN
				IF (EXISTS(SELECT TOP 1 UserId FROM dbo.aspnet_Users))
				BEGIN
					SELECT N'aspnet_Users'
					RETURN
				END
				IF (EXISTS(SELECT TOP 1 ApplicationId FROM dbo.aspnet_Applications))
				BEGIN
					SELECT N'aspnet_Applications'
					RETURN
				END
			END

			-- This stored procedures main code, excluding error handling - end
						
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT

    --BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC

				SET @TranStarted = 0

				BEGIN
					BEGIN TRANSACTION
					SET @TranStarted = 1
				END
				ELSE
    				SET @TranStarted = 0

				SELECT  @ApplicationId = ApplicationId
				FROM dbo.aspnet_Applications WITH (UPDLOCK, HOLDLOCK)
				WHERE LOWER(@var_ApplicationName) = LoweredApplicationName

				IF(@ApplicationId IS NULL)
				BEGIN
					SELECT  @ApplicationId = NEWID()
					INSERT  dbo.aspnet_Applications (ApplicationId, ApplicationName, LoweredApplicationName)
					VALUES  (@ApplicationId, @var_ApplicationName, LOWER(@var_ApplicationName))
				END


				IF( @TranStarted = 1 )
				BEGIN
					IF(@@ERROR = 0)
					BEGIN
					SET @TranStarted = 0
					COMMIT TRANSACTION
					END
					ELSE
					BEGIN
						SET @TranStarted = 0
						ROLLBACK TRANSACTION
					END
				END
			END

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end

			
			
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */

			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[aspnet_CheckIfPasswordPreviouslyUsed]
(
    @ApplicationName             nvarchar(256),
    @UserName                    nvarchar(256),
    @NewPassword                 nvarchar(128)
)
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT
	,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;
	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	DECLARE @var_ApplicationName NVARCHAR(256), @var_UserName NVARCHAR(256), @var_NewPassword NVARCHAR(128)

	SET @var_ApplicationName = @ApplicationName; SET @var_UserName = @UserName; SET @var_NewPassword = @NewPassword
	
	SET @ParameterDetails = '@ApplicationName = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_ApplicationName AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@UserName = ' 
			+ ISNULL(CAST(@var_UserName AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@NewPassword = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_NewPassword AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'')

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
		CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    --BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

		SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END

	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY
			DECLARE @ApplicationId NVARCHAR(256), @UserId NVARCHAR(256)

			SELECT @ApplicationId = a.ApplicationId, @UserId = u.UserId 
			FROM [dbo].[aspnet_UserS] AS u
			INNER JOIN [dbo].[aspnet_Membership] AS m
			ON u.ApplicationId = m.ApplicationId
			AND u.UserId = m.UserId
			INNER JOIN [dbo].[aspnet_Applications] AS a
			ON m.ApplicationId = a.ApplicationId
			WHERE a.ApplicationName = @var_ApplicationName 
			AND u.UserName = @var_UserName
			AND ISNULL(m.Comment, '') <> 'Password change required'

			IF NOT(ISNULL(@ApplicationId,'') <> '' AND ISNULL(@UserId,'') <> '')
				RETURN

			IF EXISTS(	
						SELECT * FROM [dbo].[aspnet_UserPasswords]
						WHERE ApplicationId = @ApplicationId 
						AND UserId = @UserId
						AND [Password] = @var_NewPassword
					)
				RAISERROR ('Password previously used', 16, 1)				
												
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;
			--BEGIN TRY ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH END CATCH		
			IF @CatchErrorMessage NOT LIKE '%Password previously used%'
				EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT 
			
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 
			BEGIN 
				SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; 

				IF @CatchErrorMessage LIKE '%Password previously used%' RAISERROR ('Password previously used', 16, 1)
				ELSE RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState)

				RETURN 
			END
			ELSE 
				WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END
GO

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[aspnet_CheckSchemaVersion]
(
    @Feature                   nvarchar(128),
    @CompatibleSchemaVersion   nvarchar(128)
)
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT

	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	DECLARE @var_Feature nvarchar(128), @var_CompatibleSchemaVersion nvarchar(128)

	SET @var_Feature = @Feature; SET @var_CompatibleSchemaVersion = @CompatibleSchemaVersion

	SET @ParameterDetails = '@Feature = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_Feature AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@CompatibleSchemaVersion = '

	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY
			
			-- This stored procedures main code, excluding error handling - start

			IF (EXISTS( SELECT  *
						FROM    dbo.aspnet_SchemaVersions
						WHERE   Feature = LOWER( @var_Feature ) AND
								CompatibleSchemaVersion = @var_CompatibleSchemaVersion ))
				RETURN 0

			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[aspnet_Membership_ChangePasswordQuestionAndAnswer]
(
    @ApplicationName       nvarchar(256),
    @UserName              nvarchar(256),
    @NewPasswordQuestion   nvarchar(256),
    @NewPasswordAnswer     nvarchar(128)
)
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT
 ,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;
	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	DECLARE @var_ApplicationName nvarchar(256), @var_UserName nvarchar(256), @var_NewPasswordQuestion nvarchar(256), @var_NewPasswordAnswer nvarchar(128)

	SET @var_ApplicationName = @ApplicationName; SET @var_UserName = @UserName; SET @var_NewPasswordQuestion = @NewPasswordQuestion; SET @var_NewPasswordAnswer = @NewPasswordAnswer

	SET @ParameterDetails = ',@ApplicationName = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_ApplicationName AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@UserName = ' 
		+ ISNULL(CAST(@var_UserName AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@NewPasswordQuestion = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_NewPasswordQuestion AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') 
			+ ',@NewPasswordAnswer = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_NewPasswordAnswer AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'')

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
		CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    --BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

		SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END


	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY
			
			-- This stored procedures main code, excluding error handling - start

			DECLARE @UserId uniqueidentifier

			SELECT  @UserId = NULL

			SELECT  @UserId = u.UserId
			FROM    
				dbo.aspnet_Membership m
			INNER JOIN dbo.aspnet_Users u
				ON u.UserId = m.UserId
			INNER JOIN dbo.aspnet_Applications a
				ON u.ApplicationId = a.ApplicationId
			WHERE   
				LoweredUserName = LOWER(@var_UserName) AND
				LOWER(@var_ApplicationName) = a.LoweredApplicationName
				
			IF (@UserId IS NULL) RETURN(1)

			IF XACT_STATE() = 0 AND @@TRANCOUNT < 1 BEGIN TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName

				UPDATE dbo.aspnet_Membership WITH (ROWLOCK)
				SET    PasswordQuestion = @var_NewPasswordQuestion, PasswordAnswer = @var_NewPasswordAnswer
				WHERE  UserId=@UserId

			BEGIN TRY IF XACT_STATE() = 1 AND @@TRANCOUNT = 1 AND @OpeningTranCount < 1 COMMIT TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH

			RETURN(0)

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end
						
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[aspnet_Membership_CreateUser]
(
    @ApplicationName                        nvarchar(256),
    @UserName                               nvarchar(256),
    @Password                               nvarchar(128),
    @PasswordSalt                           nvarchar(128),
    @Email                                  nvarchar(256),
    @PasswordQuestion                       nvarchar(256),
    @PasswordAnswer                         nvarchar(128),
    @IsApproved                             bit,
    @CurrentTimeUtc                         datetime,
    @CreateDate                             datetime = NULL,
    @UniqueEmail                            int      = 0,
    @PasswordFormat                         int      = 0,
    @UserId                                 uniqueidentifier OUTPUT
)
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT
 ,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;
	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	DECLARE @var_ApplicationName nvarchar(256), @var_UserName nvarchar(256), @var_Password nvarchar(128), @var_PasswordSalt nvarchar(128), 
		@var_Email nvarchar(256), @var_PasswordQuestion nvarchar(256), @var_PasswordAnswer nvarchar(128), @var_IsApproved bit, @var_CurrentTimeUtc datetime, 
			@var_CreateDate datetime, @var_UniqueEmail int, @var_PasswordFormat int

	SET @var_ApplicationName = @ApplicationName; SET @var_UserName = @UserName; SET @var_Password = @Password; SET @var_PasswordSalt = @PasswordSalt
	SET @var_Email = @Email; SET @var_PasswordQuestion = @PasswordQuestion; SET @var_PasswordAnswer = @PasswordAnswer; SET @var_IsApproved = @IsApproved
	SET @var_CurrentTimeUtc = @CurrentTimeUtc; SET @var_CreateDate = @CreateDate; SET @var_UniqueEmail = @UniqueEmail; SET @var_PasswordFormat = @PasswordFormat

	SET @ParameterDetails = '@ApplicationName = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_ApplicationName AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@UserName = ' 
		+ ISNULL(CAST(@var_UserName AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@Password = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_Password AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') 
			+ ',@PasswordSalt = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_PasswordSalt AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@Email = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_Email AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') 
				+ ',@PasswordQuestion = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_PasswordQuestion AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@PasswordAnswer = ' 
					+ ISNULL(CAST(@var_PasswordAnswer AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@IsApproved = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_IsApproved AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') 
						+ ',@CurrentTimeUtc = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_CurrentTimeUtc AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@CreateDate = ' 
							+ ISNULL(CAST(@var_CreateDate AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@UniqueEmail = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_UniqueEmail AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') 
								+ ',@PasswordFormat = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_PasswordFormat AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'')

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
		CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    --BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

		SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END


	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY
			
			-- This stored procedures main code, excluding error handling - start

			DECLARE @ApplicationId uniqueidentifier
			SELECT  @ApplicationId = NULL

			DECLARE @NewUserId uniqueidentifier
			SELECT @NewUserId = NULL

			DECLARE @IsLockedOut bit
			SET @IsLockedOut = 0

			DECLARE @LastLockoutDate  datetime
			SET @LastLockoutDate = CONVERT( datetime, '17540101', 112 )

			DECLARE @FailedPasswordAttemptCount int
			SET @FailedPasswordAttemptCount = 0

			DECLARE @FailedPasswordAttemptWindowStart  datetime
			SET @FailedPasswordAttemptWindowStart = CONVERT( datetime, '17540101', 112 )

			DECLARE @FailedPasswordAnswerAttemptCount int
			SET @FailedPasswordAnswerAttemptCount = 0

			DECLARE @FailedPasswordAnswerAttemptWindowStart  datetime
			SET @FailedPasswordAnswerAttemptWindowStart = CONVERT( datetime, '17540101', 112 )

			DECLARE @NewUserCreated bit
			DECLARE @ReturnValue   int
			SET @ReturnValue = 0

			DECLARE @ErrorCode     int
			SET @ErrorCode = 0

			DECLARE @TranStarted   bit
			SET @TranStarted = 0

			IF( @@TRANCOUNT = 0 )
			BEGIN
				BEGIN TRANSACTION
				SET @TranStarted = 1
			END
			ELSE
    			SET @TranStarted = 0

			EXEC dbo.aspnet_Applications_CreateApplication @var_ApplicationName, @ApplicationId OUTPUT

			IF( @@ERROR <> 0 )
			BEGIN
				SET @ErrorCode = -1
				GOTO Cleanup
			END

			SET @var_CreateDate = @var_CurrentTimeUtc

			SELECT  @NewUserId = UserId FROM dbo.aspnet_Users WHERE LOWER(@var_UserName) = LoweredUserName AND @ApplicationId = ApplicationId
			IF ( @NewUserId IS NULL )
			BEGIN
				SET @NewUserId = @UserId
				EXEC @ReturnValue = dbo.aspnet_Users_CreateUser @ApplicationId, @var_UserName, 0, @var_CreateDate, @NewUserId OUTPUT
				SET @NewUserCreated = 1
			END
			ELSE
			BEGIN
				SET @NewUserCreated = 0
				IF( @NewUserId <> @UserId AND @UserId IS NOT NULL )
				BEGIN
					SET @ErrorCode = 6
					GOTO Cleanup
				END
			END

			IF( @@ERROR <> 0 )
			BEGIN
				SET @ErrorCode = -1
				GOTO Cleanup
			END

			IF( @ReturnValue = -1 )
			BEGIN
				SET @ErrorCode = 10
				GOTO Cleanup
			END

			IF ( EXISTS ( SELECT UserId
						  FROM   dbo.aspnet_Membership
						  WHERE  @NewUserId = UserId ) )
			BEGIN
				SET @ErrorCode = 6
				GOTO Cleanup
			END

			SET @UserId = @NewUserId

			IF (@var_UniqueEmail = 1)
			BEGIN
				IF (EXISTS (SELECT *
							FROM  dbo.aspnet_Membership m WITH ( UPDLOCK, HOLDLOCK )
							WHERE ApplicationId = @ApplicationId AND LoweredEmail = LOWER(@var_Email)))
				BEGIN
					SET @ErrorCode = 7
					GOTO Cleanup
				END
			END

			IF (@NewUserCreated = 0)
			BEGIN
				UPDATE dbo.aspnet_Users WITH (ROWLOCK)
				SET    LastActivityDate = @var_CreateDate
				WHERE  @UserId = UserId
				IF( @@ERROR <> 0 )
				BEGIN
					SET @ErrorCode = -1
					GOTO Cleanup
				END
			END

			INSERT INTO dbo.aspnet_Membership
						( ApplicationId,
						  UserId,
						  Password,
						  PasswordSalt,
						  Email,
						  LoweredEmail,
						  PasswordQuestion,
						  PasswordAnswer,
						  PasswordFormat,
						  IsApproved,
						  IsLockedOut,
						  CreateDate,
						  LastLoginDate,
						  LastPasswordChangedDate,
						  LastLockoutDate,
						  FailedPasswordAttemptCount,
						  FailedPasswordAttemptWindowStart,
						  FailedPasswordAnswerAttemptCount,
						  FailedPasswordAnswerAttemptWindowStart )
				 VALUES ( @ApplicationId,
						  @UserId,
						  @var_Password,
						  @var_PasswordSalt,
						  @var_Email,
						  LOWER(@var_Email),
						  @var_PasswordQuestion,
						  @var_PasswordAnswer,
						  @var_PasswordFormat,
						  @var_IsApproved,
						  @IsLockedOut,
						  @var_CreateDate,
						  @var_CreateDate,
						  @var_CreateDate,
						  @LastLockoutDate,
						  @FailedPasswordAttemptCount,
						  @FailedPasswordAttemptWindowStart,
						  @FailedPasswordAnswerAttemptCount,
						  @FailedPasswordAnswerAttemptWindowStart )

			IF( @@ERROR <> 0 )
			BEGIN
				SET @ErrorCode = -1
				GOTO Cleanup
			END

			IF( @TranStarted = 1 )
			BEGIN
				SET @TranStarted = 0
				COMMIT TRANSACTION
			END

			RETURN 0

		Cleanup:

			IF( @TranStarted = 1 )
			BEGIN
				SET @TranStarted = 0
    			ROLLBACK TRANSACTION
			END

			RETURN @ErrorCode

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end
						
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[aspnet_Membership_FindUsersByEmail]
(
    @ApplicationName       nvarchar(256),
    @EmailToMatch          nvarchar(256),
    @PageIndex             int,
    @PageSize              int
)
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT
 ,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;
	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	DECLARE @var_ApplicationName nvarchar(256), @var_EmailToMatch nvarchar(256), @var_PageIndex int, @var_PageSize int

	SET @var_ApplicationName = @ApplicationName; SET @var_EmailToMatch = @EmailToMatch; SET @var_PageIndex = @PageIndex; SET @var_PageSize = @PageSize

	SET @ParameterDetails = '@ApplicationName = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_ApplicationName AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@EmailToMatch = ' 
		+ ISNULL(CAST(@var_EmailToMatch AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@PageIndex = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_PageIndex AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@PageSize = ' 
			+ ISNULL(CAST(@var_PageSize AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'')

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
		CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    --BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

		SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END


	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY
			
			-- This stored procedures main code, excluding error handling - start

			DECLARE @ApplicationId uniqueidentifier; SELECT  @ApplicationId = NULL

			SELECT  @ApplicationId = ApplicationId FROM dbo.aspnet_Applications WHERE LOWER(@var_ApplicationName) = LoweredApplicationName

			IF (@ApplicationId IS NULL) RETURN 0

			-- Set the page bounds
			DECLARE @PageLowerBound int
			DECLARE @PageUpperBound int
			DECLARE @TotalRecords   int

			SET @PageLowerBound = @var_PageSize * @var_PageIndex
			SET @PageUpperBound = @var_PageSize - 1 + @PageLowerBound

			IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#PageIndexForUsers') IS NOT NULL
				DROP TABLE #PageIndexForUsers

			-- Create a temp table TO store the select results
			CREATE TABLE #PageIndexForUsers
			(
				IndexId int IDENTITY (0, 1) NOT NULL,
				UserId uniqueidentifier
			)

			-- Insert into our temp table
			IF( @var_EmailToMatch IS NULL )
				INSERT INTO #PageIndexForUsers (UserId)
				SELECT 
					u.UserId
				FROM   
					dbo.aspnet_Users u
				INNER JOIN dbo.aspnet_Membership m
					ON m.UserId = u.UserId
				WHERE  
					u.ApplicationId = @ApplicationId 
					AND m.Email IS NULL
				ORDER BY 
					m.LoweredEmail
			ELSE
				INSERT INTO #PageIndexForUsers (UserId)
				SELECT 
					u.UserId
				FROM   
					dbo.aspnet_Users u
				INNER JOIN dbo.aspnet_Membership m
					ON m.UserId = u.UserId
				WHERE  
					u.ApplicationId = @ApplicationId 
					AND m.LoweredEmail LIKE LOWER(@var_EmailToMatch)
				ORDER BY 
					m.LoweredEmail

			SELECT  
				u.UserName, m.Email, m.PasswordQuestion, m.Comment, m.IsApproved,
				m.CreateDate,
				m.LastLoginDate,
				u.LastActivityDate,
				m.LastPasswordChangedDate,
				u.UserId, m.IsLockedOut,
				m.LastLockoutDate
			FROM   
				dbo.aspnet_Membership m
			INNER JOIN dbo.aspnet_Users u
				ON u.UserId = m.UserId
			INNER JOIN #PageIndexForUsers p
				ON u.UserId = p.UserId
			WHERE  
				p.IndexId >= @PageLowerBound 
				AND p.IndexId <= @PageUpperBound
			ORDER BY 
				m.LoweredEmail

			SELECT @TotalRecords = COUNT(*) FROM #PageIndexForUsers

			RETURN @TotalRecords

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end
						
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END

				UserId uniqueidentifier
			)

			-- Insert into our temp table
			INSERT INTO #PageIndexForUsers (UserId)
			SELECT 
				u.UserId
			FROM   
				dbo.aspnet_Users u
			INNER JOIN dbo.aspnet_Membership m
				ON m.UserId = u.UserId
			WHERE  
				u.ApplicationId = @ApplicationId 
				AND u.LoweredUserName LIKE LOWER(@var_UserNameToMatch)
			ORDER BY 
				u.UserName

			SELECT  
				u.UserName, m.Email, m.PasswordQuestion, m.Comment, m.IsApproved,
				m.CreateDate,
				m.LastLoginDate,
				u.LastActivityDate,
				m.LastPasswordChangedDate,
				u.UserId, m.IsLockedOut,
				m.LastLockoutDate
			FROM   
				dbo.aspnet_Membership m
			INNER JOIN dbo.aspnet_Users u
				ON u.UserId = m.UserId
			INNER JOIN #PageIndexForUsers p
				ON u.UserId = p.UserId
			WHERE   
				p.IndexId >= @PageLowerBound 
				AND p.IndexId <= @PageUpperBound
			ORDER BY 
				u.UserName

			SELECT @TotalRecords = COUNT(*) FROM #PageIndexForUsers

			RETURN @TotalRecords

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end
						
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END

		+ ISNULL(CAST(@var_PageIndex AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@PageSize = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_PageSize AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'')

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

			INNER JOIN dbo.aspnet_Users u

			INNER JOIN #PageIndexForUsers p
				ON u.UserId = p.UserId
			WHERE  				 
				p.IndexId >= @PageLowerBound 
				AND p.IndexId <= @PageUpperBound
			ORDER BY 
				u.UserName

			RETURN @TotalRecords

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end
			
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;

			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[aspnet_Membership_GetPassword]
(
    @ApplicationName                nvarchar(256),
    @UserName                       nvarchar(256),
    @MaxInvalidPasswordAttempts     int,
    @PasswordAttemptWindow          int,
    @CurrentTimeUtc                 datetime,
    @PasswordAnswer                 nvarchar(128) = NULL
)
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT
 ,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;
	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	DECLARE @var_ApplicationName nvarchar(256), @var_UserName nvarchar(256), @var_MaxInvalidPasswordAttempts int, @var_PasswordAttemptWindow int, 
		@var_CurrentTimeUtc datetime, @var_PasswordAnswer nvarchar(128)

	SET @var_ApplicationName = @ApplicationName; SET @var_UserName = @UserName; SET @var_MaxInvalidPasswordAttempts = @MaxInvalidPasswordAttempts
	SET @var_PasswordAttemptWindow = @PasswordAttemptWindow; SET @var_CurrentTimeUtc = @CurrentTimeUtc; SET @var_PasswordAnswer = @PasswordAnswer

	SET @ParameterDetails = '@ApplicationName = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_ApplicationName AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@UserName = ' 
		+ ISNULL(CAST(@var_UserName AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@MaxInvalidPasswordAttempts = ' 
			+ ISNULL(CAST(@var_MaxInvalidPasswordAttempts AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@PasswordAttemptWindow = ' 
				+ ISNULL(CAST(@var_PasswordAttemptWindow AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@CurrentTimeUtc = ' 
					+ ISNULL(CAST(@var_CurrentTimeUtc AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@PasswordAnswer = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_PasswordAnswer AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'')

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    --BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

		SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END


	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY
			
			-- This stored procedures main code, excluding error handling - start

			DECLARE @UserId                                 uniqueidentifier
			DECLARE @PasswordFormat                         int
			DECLARE @Password                               nvarchar(128)
			DECLARE @passAns                                nvarchar(128)
			DECLARE @IsLockedOut                            bit
			DECLARE @LastLockoutDate                        datetime
			DECLARE @FailedPasswordAttemptCount             int
			DECLARE @FailedPasswordAttemptWindowStart       datetime
			DECLARE @FailedPasswordAnswerAttemptCount       int
			DECLARE @FailedPasswordAnswerAttemptWindowStart datetime

			DECLARE @ErrorCode     int
			SET @ErrorCode = 0

			DECLARE @TranStarted   bit
			SET @TranStarted = 0

			IF( @@TRANCOUNT = 0 )
			BEGIN
				BEGIN TRANSACTION
				SET @TranStarted = 1
			END
			ELSE
    			SET @TranStarted = 0

			SELECT  
				@UserId = u.UserId,
				@Password = m.Password,
				@passAns = m.PasswordAnswer,
				@PasswordFormat = m.PasswordFormat,
				@IsLockedOut = m.IsLockedOut,
				@LastLockoutDate = m.LastLockoutDate,
				@FailedPasswordAttemptCount = m.FailedPasswordAttemptCount,
				@FailedPasswordAttemptWindowStart = m.FailedPasswordAttemptWindowStart,
				@FailedPasswordAnswerAttemptCount = m.FailedPasswordAnswerAttemptCount,
				@FailedPasswordAnswerAttemptWindowStart = m.FailedPasswordAnswerAttemptWindowStart
			FROM    
				dbo.aspnet_Applications a
			INNER JOIN dbo.aspnet_Users u
				ON u.ApplicationId = a.ApplicationId
			INNER JOIN dbo.aspnet_Membership m WITH ( UPDLOCK )
				ON u.UserId = m.UserId
			WHERE   
				LOWER(@var_ApplicationName) = a.LoweredApplicationName AND				
				LOWER(@var_UserName) = u.LoweredUserName

			IF ( @@rowcount = 0 )
			BEGIN
				SET @ErrorCode = 1
				GOTO Cleanup
			END

			IF( @IsLockedOut = 1 )
			BEGIN
				SET @ErrorCode = 99
				GOTO Cleanup
			END

			IF ( NOT( @var_PasswordAnswer IS NULL ) )
			BEGIN
				IF( ( @passAns IS NULL ) OR ( LOWER( @passAns ) <> LOWER( @var_PasswordAnswer ) ) )
				BEGIN
					IF( @var_CurrentTimeUtc > DATEADD( minute, @var_PasswordAttemptWindow, @FailedPasswordAnswerAttemptWindowStart ) )
					BEGIN
						SET @FailedPasswordAnswerAttemptWindowStart = @var_CurrentTimeUtc
						SET @FailedPasswordAnswerAttemptCount = 1
					END
					ELSE
					BEGIN
						SET @FailedPasswordAnswerAttemptCount = @FailedPasswordAnswerAttemptCount + 1
						SET @FailedPasswordAnswerAttemptWindowStart = @var_CurrentTimeUtc
					END

					BEGIN
						IF( @FailedPasswordAnswerAttemptCount >= @var_MaxInvalidPasswordAttempts )
						BEGIN
							SET @IsLockedOut = 1
							SET @LastLockoutDate = @var_CurrentTimeUtc
						END
					END

					SET @ErrorCode = 3
				END
				ELSE
				BEGIN
					IF( @FailedPasswordAnswerAttemptCount > 0 )
					BEGIN
						SET @FailedPasswordAnswerAttemptCount = 0
						SET @FailedPasswordAnswerAttemptWindowStart = CONVERT( datetime, '17540101', 112 )
					END
				END

				UPDATE dbo.aspnet_Membership WITH (ROWLOCK)
				SET IsLockedOut = @IsLockedOut, LastLockoutDate = @LastLockoutDate,
					FailedPasswordAttemptCount = @FailedPasswordAttemptCount,
					FailedPasswordAttemptWindowStart = @FailedPasswordAttemptWindowStart,
					FailedPasswordAnswerAttemptCount = @FailedPasswordAnswerAttemptCount,
					FailedPasswordAnswerAttemptWindowStart = @FailedPasswordAnswerAttemptWindowStart
				WHERE @UserId = UserId

				IF( @@ERROR <> 0 )
				BEGIN
					SET @ErrorCode = -1
					GOTO Cleanup
				END
			END

			IF( @TranStarted = 1 )
			BEGIN
			SET @TranStarted = 0
			COMMIT TRANSACTION
			END

			IF( @ErrorCode = 0 )
				SELECT @Password, @PasswordFormat

			RETURN @ErrorCode

		Cleanup:

			IF( @TranStarted = 1 )
			BEGIN
				SET @TranStarted = 0
    			ROLLBACK TRANSACTION
			END

			RETURN @ErrorCode

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end
						
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END
GO

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[aspnet_Membership_GetPasswordWithFormat]
(
    @ApplicationName                nvarchar(256),
    @UserName                       nvarchar(256),
    @UpdateLastLoginActivityDate    bit,
    @CurrentTimeUtc                 datetime
)
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT
 ,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;
	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	DECLARE @var_ApplicationName NVARCHAR(256), @var_UserName NVARCHAR(256), @var_UpdateLastLoginActivityDate BIT, @var_CurrentTimeUtc DATETIME

	SET @var_ApplicationName = @ApplicationName; SET @var_UserName = @UserName; SET @var_UpdateLastLoginActivityDate = @UpdateLastLoginActivityDate
	SET @var_CurrentTimeUtc = @CurrentTimeUtc

	SET @ParameterDetails = '@ApplicationName = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_ApplicationName AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@UserName = ' 
		+ ISNULL(CAST(@var_UserName AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@UpdateLastLoginActivityDate = ' 
			+ ISNULL(CAST(@var_UpdateLastLoginActivityDate AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@CurrentTimeUtc = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_CurrentTimeUtc AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'')

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    --BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

		SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END


	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY
			
			-- This stored procedures main code, excluding error handling - start

			DECLARE @IsLockedOut                        bit
			DECLARE @UserId                             uniqueidentifier
			DECLARE @Password                           nvarchar(128)
			DECLARE @PasswordSalt                       nvarchar(128)
			DECLARE @PasswordFormat                     int
			DECLARE @FailedPasswordAttemptCount         int
			DECLARE @FailedPasswordAnswerAttemptCount   int
			DECLARE @IsApproved                         bit
			DECLARE @LastActivityDate                   datetime
			DECLARE @LastLoginDate                      datetime

			SELECT  @UserId = NULL

			SELECT  
				@UserId = u.UserId, @IsLockedOut = m.IsLockedOut, @Password=Password, @PasswordFormat=PasswordFormat,
				@PasswordSalt=PasswordSalt, @FailedPasswordAttemptCount=FailedPasswordAttemptCount,
				@FailedPasswordAnswerAttemptCount=FailedPasswordAnswerAttemptCount, @IsApproved=IsApproved,
				@LastActivityDate = LastActivityDate, @LastLoginDate = LastLoginDate
			FROM    
				dbo.aspnet_Applications a
			INNER JOIN dbo.aspnet_Users u
				ON u.ApplicationId = a.ApplicationId
			INNER JOIN dbo.aspnet_Membership m
				ON u.UserId = m.UserId
			WHERE   
				LOWER(@var_ApplicationName) = a.LoweredApplicationName AND				
				LOWER(@var_UserName) = u.LoweredUserName

			IF (@UserId IS NULL) RETURN 1

			IF (@IsLockedOut = 1) RETURN 99

			SELECT   @Password, @PasswordFormat, @PasswordSalt, @FailedPasswordAttemptCount,
					 @FailedPasswordAnswerAttemptCount, @IsApproved, @LastLoginDate, @LastActivityDate

			IF (@var_UpdateLastLoginActivityDate = 1 AND @IsApproved = 1)
			BEGIN
				IF XACT_STATE() = 0 AND @@TRANCOUNT < 1 BEGIN TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName

					UPDATE  dbo.aspnet_Membership WITH (ROWLOCK)
					SET     LastLoginDate = @var_CurrentTimeUtc
					WHERE   UserId = @UserId

					UPDATE  dbo.aspnet_Users WITH (ROWLOCK)
					SET     LastActivityDate = @var_CurrentTimeUtc
					WHERE   @UserId = UserId

				BEGIN TRY IF XACT_STATE() = 1 AND @@TRANCOUNT = 1 AND @OpeningTranCount < 1 COMMIT TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH
			END

			RETURN 0

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end
						
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END

)
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT

	SET @ParameterDetails = '@ApplicationName = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_ApplicationName AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@Email = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_Email AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'')

				INNER JOIN dbo.aspnet_Users u
					ON u.ApplicationId = a.ApplicationId
				INNER JOIN dbo.aspnet_Membership m
					ON u.UserId = m.UserId
				WHERE   
					LOWER(@var_ApplicationName) = a.LoweredApplicationName AND					
					LOWER(@var_Email) = m.LoweredEmail

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[aspnet_Membership_GetUserByName]
(
    @ApplicationName      nvarchar(256),
    @UserName             nvarchar(256),
    @CurrentTimeUtc       datetime,
    @UpdateLastActivity   bit = 0
)
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT
 ,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;
	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	DECLARE @var_ApplicationName NVARCHAR(256), @var_UserName NVARCHAR(256), @var_CurrentTimeUtc DATETIME, @var_UpdateLastActivity BIT

	SET @var_ApplicationName = @ApplicationName; SET @var_UserName = @UserName; SET @var_CurrentTimeUtc = @CurrentTimeUtc; SET @var_UpdateLastActivity = @UpdateLastActivity

	SET @ParameterDetails = '@ApplicationName = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_ApplicationName AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@UserName = ' 
		+ ISNULL(CAST(@var_UserName AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@CurrentTimeUtc = ' 
			+ ISNULL(CAST(@var_CurrentTimeUtc AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@UpdateLastActivity = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_UpdateLastActivity AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'')

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    --BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

		SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END

	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY
			
			-- This stored procedures main code, excluding error handling - start

			DECLARE @UserId uniqueidentifier

			IF (@var_UpdateLastActivity = 1)
			BEGIN
				-- select user ID from aspnet_users table
				SELECT TOP 1 
					@UserId = u.UserId
				FROM    
					dbo.aspnet_Applications a
				INNER JOIN dbo.aspnet_Users u
					ON u.ApplicationId = a.ApplicationId
				INNER JOIN dbo.aspnet_Membership m
					ON u.UserId = m.UserId
				WHERE    
					LOWER(@var_ApplicationName) = a.LoweredApplicationName AND					
					LOWER(@var_UserName) = u.LoweredUserName 

				IF (@@ROWCOUNT = 0) -- Username not found
					RETURN -1

				IF XACT_STATE() = 0 AND @@TRANCOUNT < 1 BEGIN TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName

					UPDATE   dbo.aspnet_Users WITH (ROWLOCK)
					SET      LastActivityDate = @var_CurrentTimeUtc
					WHERE    @UserId = UserId

				BEGIN TRY IF XACT_STATE() = 1 AND @@TRANCOUNT = 1 AND @OpeningTranCount < 1 COMMIT TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH

				SELECT 
					m.Email, m.PasswordQuestion, m.Comment, m.IsApproved,
					m.CreateDate, m.LastLoginDate, u.LastActivityDate, m.LastPasswordChangedDate,
					u.UserId, m.IsLockedOut, m.LastLockoutDate
				FROM    
					dbo.aspnet_Applications a
				INNER JOIN dbo.aspnet_Users u
					ON u.ApplicationId = a.ApplicationId
				INNER JOIN dbo.aspnet_Membership m
					ON u.UserId = m.UserId 
				WHERE  
					@UserId = u.UserId 
			END
			ELSE
			BEGIN
				SELECT TOP 1 
					m.Email, m.PasswordQuestion, m.Comment, m.IsApproved,
					m.CreateDate, m.LastLoginDate, u.LastActivityDate, m.LastPasswordChangedDate,
					u.UserId, m.IsLockedOut,m.LastLockoutDate
				FROM    
					dbo.aspnet_Applications a
				INNER JOIN dbo.aspnet_Users u
					ON u.ApplicationId = a.ApplicationId
				INNER JOIN dbo.aspnet_Membership m
					ON u.UserId = m.UserId
				WHERE    
					LOWER(@var_ApplicationName) = a.LoweredApplicationName AND					
					LOWER(@var_UserName) = u.LoweredUserName

				IF (@@ROWCOUNT = 0) -- Username not found
					RETURN -1
			END

			RETURN 0

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end
						
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */

					FROM     dbo.aspnet_Users
					WHERE    @var_UserId = UserId

				BEGIN TRY IF XACT_STATE() = 1 AND @@TRANCOUNT = 1 AND @OpeningTranCount < 1 COMMIT TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH

				IF ( @@ROWCOUNT = 0 ) -- User ID not found
					RETURN -1
			END

			SELECT  
				m.Email, m.PasswordQuestion, m.Comment, m.IsApproved,
				m.CreateDate, m.LastLoginDate, u.LastActivityDate,

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END
