CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[aspnet_Membership_ResetPassword]
(
    @ApplicationName             nvarchar(256),
    @UserName                    nvarchar(256),
    @NewPassword                 nvarchar(128),
    @MaxInvalidPasswordAttempts  int,
    @PasswordAttemptWindow       int,
    @PasswordSalt                nvarchar(128),
    @CurrentTimeUtc              datetime,
    @PasswordFormat              int = 0,
    @PasswordAnswer              nvarchar(128) = NULL
)
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT
	,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;
	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	DECLARE @var_ApplicationName NVARCHAR(256), @var_UserName NVARCHAR(256), @var_NewPassword NVARCHAR(128), @var_MaxInvalidPasswordAttempts INT, @var_PasswordAttemptWindow INT, 
		@var_PasswordSalt NVARCHAR(128), @var_CurrentTimeUtc DATETIME, @var_PasswordFormat INT, @var_PasswordAnswer NVARCHAR(128)

	SET @var_ApplicationName = @ApplicationName; SET @var_UserName = @UserName; SET @var_NewPassword = @NewPassword; SET @var_MaxInvalidPasswordAttempts = @MaxInvalidPasswordAttempts 
	SET @var_PasswordAttemptWindow = @PasswordAttemptWindow; SET @var_PasswordSalt = @PasswordSalt; SET @var_CurrentTimeUtc = @CurrentTimeUtc; 
	SET @var_PasswordFormat = @PasswordFormat; SET @var_PasswordAnswer = @PasswordAnswer

	SET @ParameterDetails = '@ApplicationName = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_ApplicationName AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@UserName = ' 
		+ ISNULL(CAST(@var_UserName AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@NewPassword = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_NewPassword AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@MaxInvalidPasswordAttempts = ' 
			+ ISNULL(CAST(@var_MaxInvalidPasswordAttempts AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@PasswordAttemptWindow = ' 
				+ ISNULL(CAST(@var_PasswordAttemptWindow AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@PasswordSalt = ' 
					+ ISNULL(CAST(@var_PasswordSalt AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@CurrentTimeUtc = ' 
						+ ISNULL(CAST(@var_CurrentTimeUtc AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@PasswordFormat = ' 
							+ ISNULL(CAST(@var_PasswordFormat AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@PasswordAnswer = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_PasswordAnswer AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'')

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    --BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

		SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK,-1)

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END

	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY		

			-- This stored procedures main code, excluding error handling - start

			EXEC dbo.aspnet_CheckIfPasswordPreviouslyUsed @var_ApplicationName, @var_UserName, @var_NewPassword

			DECLARE @IsLockedOut                            bit
			DECLARE @LastLockoutDate                        datetime
			DECLARE @FailedPasswordAttemptCount             int
			DECLARE @FailedPasswordAttemptWindowStart       datetime
			DECLARE @FailedPasswordAnswerAttemptCount       int
			DECLARE @FailedPasswordAnswerAttemptWindowStart datetime

			DECLARE @UserId                                 uniqueidentifier
			SET     @UserId = NULL

			DECLARE @ErrorCode     int
			SET @ErrorCode = 0

			DECLARE @TranStarted   bit
			SET @TranStarted = 0

			IF( @@TRANCOUNT = 0 )
			BEGIN
				BEGIN TRANSACTION
				SET @TranStarted = 1
			END
			ELSE
    			SET @TranStarted = 0

			SELECT  
				@UserId = u.UserId
			FROM    
				dbo.aspnet_Users u
			INNER JOIN dbo.aspnet_Applications a
				ON u.ApplicationId = a.ApplicationId
			INNER JOIN dbo.aspnet_Membership m
				ON u.UserId = m.UserId
			WHERE   
				LoweredUserName = LOWER(@var_UserName) AND				
				LOWER(@var_ApplicationName) = a.LoweredApplicationName				

			IF ( @UserId IS NULL )
			BEGIN
				SET @ErrorCode = 1
				GOTO Cleanup
			END

			SELECT @IsLockedOut = IsLockedOut,
				   @LastLockoutDate = LastLockoutDate,
				   @FailedPasswordAttemptCount = FailedPasswordAttemptCount,
				   @FailedPasswordAttemptWindowStart = FailedPasswordAttemptWindowStart,
				   @FailedPasswordAnswerAttemptCount = FailedPasswordAnswerAttemptCount,
				   @FailedPasswordAnswerAttemptWindowStart = FailedPasswordAnswerAttemptWindowStart
			FROM dbo.aspnet_Membership WITH ( UPDLOCK )
			WHERE @UserId = UserId

			IF( @IsLockedOut = 1 )
			BEGIN
				SET @ErrorCode = 99
				GOTO Cleanup
			END

			UPDATE dbo.aspnet_Membership WITH (ROWLOCK)
			SET    [Password] = @var_NewPassword,
				   LastPasswordChangedDate = @var_CurrentTimeUtc,
				   PasswordFormat = @var_PasswordFormat,
				   PasswordSalt = @var_PasswordSalt
			WHERE  @UserId = UserId AND
				   ( ( @var_PasswordAnswer IS NULL ) OR ( LOWER( PasswordAnswer ) = LOWER( @var_PasswordAnswer ) ) )

			IF ( @@ROWCOUNT = 0 )
				BEGIN
					IF( @var_CurrentTimeUtc > DATEADD( minute, @var_PasswordAttemptWindow, @FailedPasswordAnswerAttemptWindowStart ) )
					BEGIN
						SET @FailedPasswordAnswerAttemptWindowStart = @var_CurrentTimeUtc
						SET @FailedPasswordAnswerAttemptCount = 1
					END
					ELSE
					BEGIN
						SET @FailedPasswordAnswerAttemptWindowStart = @var_CurrentTimeUtc
						SET @FailedPasswordAnswerAttemptCount = @FailedPasswordAnswerAttemptCount + 1
					END

					BEGIN
						IF( @FailedPasswordAnswerAttemptCount >= @var_MaxInvalidPasswordAttempts )
						BEGIN
							SET @IsLockedOut = 1
							SET @LastLockoutDate = @var_CurrentTimeUtc
						END
					END

					SET @ErrorCode = 3
				END
			ELSE
				BEGIN
					IF( @FailedPasswordAnswerAttemptCount > 0 )
					BEGIN
						SET @FailedPasswordAnswerAttemptCount = 0
						SET @FailedPasswordAnswerAttemptWindowStart = CONVERT( datetime, '17540101', 112 )
					END
				END

			IF( NOT ( @var_PasswordAnswer IS NULL ) )
			BEGIN
				UPDATE dbo.aspnet_Membership WITH (ROWLOCK)
				SET IsLockedOut = @IsLockedOut, LastLockoutDate = @LastLockoutDate,
					FailedPasswordAttemptCount = @FailedPasswordAttemptCount,
					FailedPasswordAttemptWindowStart = @FailedPasswordAttemptWindowStart,
					FailedPasswordAnswerAttemptCount = @FailedPasswordAnswerAttemptCount,
					FailedPasswordAnswerAttemptWindowStart = @FailedPasswordAnswerAttemptWindowStart
				WHERE @UserId = UserId

				IF( @@ERROR <> 0 )
				BEGIN
					SET @ErrorCode = -1
					GOTO Cleanup
				END
			END

			IF( @TranStarted = 1 )
			BEGIN
			SET @TranStarted = 0
			COMMIT TRANSACTION
			END

			RETURN @ErrorCode

		Cleanup:

			IF( @TranStarted = 1 )
			BEGIN
				SET @TranStarted = 0
    			ROLLBACK TRANSACTION
			END

			RETURN @ErrorCode

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end
						
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 
			BEGIN 
				SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; 

				IF @CatchErrorMessage LIKE '%Password previously used%' RAISERROR ('Password previously used', 16, 1)
				ELSE RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState)

				RETURN 
			END
			ELSE 
				WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END

				LoweredUserName = LOWER(@var_UserName) AND				
				LOWER(@var_ApplicationName) = a.LoweredApplicationName

				RETURN 1

				UPDATE dbo.aspnet_Membership WITH (ROWLOCK)
				SET IsLockedOut = 0,
					FailedPasswordAttemptCount = 0,
					FailedPasswordAttemptWindowStart = CONVERT( datetime, '17540101', 112 ),
					FailedPasswordAnswerAttemptCount = 0,
					FailedPasswordAnswerAttemptWindowStart = CONVERT( datetime, '17540101', 112 ),
					LastLockoutDate = CONVERT( datetime, '17540101', 112 )

			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[aspnet_Membership_UpdateUser]

    @Comment              nvarchar(max),

    @UniqueEmail          int,

	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT
 ,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;
	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	DECLARE @var_ApplicationName NVARCHAR(256), @var_UserName NVARCHAR(256), @var_Email NVARCHAR(256), @var_Comment nvarchar(max), @var_IsApproved BIT, @var_LastLoginDate DATETIME, 
		@var_LastActivityDate DATETIME, @var_UniqueEmail INT, @var_CurrentTimeUtc DATETIME

	SET @var_ApplicationName = @ApplicationName; SET @var_UserName = @UserName; SET @var_Email = @Email; SET @var_Comment = @Comment; SET @var_IsApproved = @IsApproved
	SET @var_LastLoginDate = @LastLoginDate; SET @var_LastActivityDate = @LastActivityDate; SET @var_UniqueEmail = @UniqueEmail; SET @var_CurrentTimeUtc = @CurrentTimeUtc

	SET @ParameterDetails = ',@ApplicationName = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_ApplicationName AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@UserName = ' 
		+ ISNULL(CAST(@var_UserName AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@Email = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_Email AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@Comment = ' 
			+ ISNULL(CAST(@var_Comment AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@IsApproved = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_IsApproved AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@LastLoginDate = ' 
				+ ISNULL(CAST(@var_LastLoginDate AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@LastActivityDate = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_LastActivityDate AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@UniqueEmail = ' 
					+ ISNULL(CAST(@var_UniqueEmail AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@CurrentTimeUtc = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_CurrentTimeUtc AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'')

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    --BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

		SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END


	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY
			
			-- This stored procedures main code, excluding error handling - start

			DECLARE @UserId uniqueidentifier
			DECLARE @ApplicationId uniqueidentifier
			SELECT  @UserId = NULL

			SELECT  
				@UserId = u.UserId, @ApplicationId = a.ApplicationId
			FROM    
				dbo.aspnet_Users u
			INNER JOIN dbo.aspnet_Applications a
				ON u.ApplicationId = a.ApplicationId
			INNER JOIN dbo.aspnet_Membership m
				ON u.UserId = m.UserId
			WHERE   
				LoweredUserName = LOWER(@var_UserName) AND				
				LOWER(@var_ApplicationName) = a.LoweredApplicationName				

			IF (@UserId IS NULL)
				RETURN(1)

			IF (@var_UniqueEmail = 1)
			BEGIN
				IF (EXISTS (SELECT *
							FROM  dbo.aspnet_Membership WITH (UPDLOCK, HOLDLOCK)
							WHERE ApplicationId = @ApplicationId  AND @UserId <> UserId AND LoweredEmail = LOWER(@var_Email)))
				BEGIN
					RETURN(7)
				END
			END

			DECLARE @TranStarted   bit
			SET @TranStarted = 0

			IF( @@TRANCOUNT = 0 )
			BEGIN
				BEGIN TRANSACTION
				SET @TranStarted = 1
			END
			ELSE
			SET @TranStarted = 0

			UPDATE dbo.aspnet_Users WITH (ROWLOCK)
			SET
				 LastActivityDate = @var_LastActivityDate
			WHERE
			   @UserId = UserId

			IF( @@ERROR <> 0 )
				GOTO Cleanup

			UPDATE dbo.aspnet_Membership WITH (ROWLOCK)
			SET
				 Email            = @var_Email,
				 LoweredEmail     = LOWER(@var_Email),
				 Comment          = @var_Comment,
				 IsApproved       = @var_IsApproved,
				 LastLoginDate    = @var_LastLoginDate
			WHERE
			   @UserId = UserId

			IF( @@ERROR <> 0 )
				GOTO Cleanup

			IF( @TranStarted = 1 )
			BEGIN
			SET @TranStarted = 0
			COMMIT TRANSACTION
			END

			RETURN 0

		Cleanup:

			IF( @TranStarted = 1 )
			BEGIN
				SET @TranStarted = 0
    			ROLLBACK TRANSACTION
			END

			RETURN -1

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end
						
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END
GO

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[aspnet_Membership_UpdateUserInfo]
(
    @ApplicationName                nvarchar(256),
    @UserName                       nvarchar(256),
    @IsPasswordCorrect              bit,
    @UpdateLastLoginActivityDate    bit,
    @MaxInvalidPasswordAttempts     int,
    @PasswordAttemptWindow          int,
    @CurrentTimeUtc                 datetime,
    @LastLoginDate                  datetime,
    @LastActivityDate               datetime
)
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT
 ,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;
	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	DECLARE @var_ApplicationName NVARCHAR(256), @var_UserName NVARCHAR(256), @var_IsPasswordCorrect BIT, @var_UpdateLastLoginActivityDate BIT, @var_MaxInvalidPasswordAttempts INT, 
		@var_PasswordAttemptWindow INT, @var_CurrentTimeUtc DATETIME, @var_LastLoginDate DATETIME, @var_LastActivityDate DATETIME

	SET @var_ApplicationName = @ApplicationName; SET @var_UserName = @UserName; SET @var_IsPasswordCorrect = @IsPasswordCorrect
	SET @var_UpdateLastLoginActivityDate = @UpdateLastLoginActivityDate; SET @var_MaxInvalidPasswordAttempts = @MaxInvalidPasswordAttempts
	SET @var_PasswordAttemptWindow = @PasswordAttemptWindow; SET @var_CurrentTimeUtc = @CurrentTimeUtc; SET @var_LastLoginDate = @LastLoginDate
	SET @var_LastActivityDate = @LastActivityDate

	SET @ParameterDetails = '@ApplicationName = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_ApplicationName AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@UserName = ' 
		+ ISNULL(CAST(@var_UserName AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@IsPasswordCorrect = ' 
			+ ISNULL(CAST(@var_IsPasswordCorrect AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@UpdateLastLoginActivityDate = ' 
				+ ISNULL(CAST(@var_UpdateLastLoginActivityDate AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@MaxInvalidPasswordAttempts = ' 
					+ ISNULL(CAST(@var_MaxInvalidPasswordAttempts AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@PasswordAttemptWindow = ' 
						+ ISNULL(CAST(@var_PasswordAttemptWindow AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@CurrentTimeUtc = ' 
							+ ISNULL(CAST(@var_CurrentTimeUtc AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@LastLoginDate = ' 
								+ ISNULL(CAST(@var_LastLoginDate AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@LastActivityDate = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_LastActivityDate AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'')

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    --BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

		SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END


	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY
			
			-- This stored procedures main code, excluding error handling - start

			DECLARE @UserId                                 uniqueidentifier
			DECLARE @IsApproved                             bit
			DECLARE @IsLockedOut                            bit
			DECLARE @LastLockoutDate                        datetime
			DECLARE @FailedPasswordAttemptCount             int
			DECLARE @FailedPasswordAttemptWindowStart       datetime
			DECLARE @FailedPasswordAnswerAttemptCount       int
			DECLARE @FailedPasswordAnswerAttemptWindowStart datetime

			DECLARE @ErrorCode     int
			SET @ErrorCode = 0

			DECLARE @TranStarted   bit
			SET @TranStarted = 0

			IF( @@TRANCOUNT = 0 )
			BEGIN
				BEGIN TRANSACTION
				SET @TranStarted = 1
			END
			ELSE
    			SET @TranStarted = 0

			SELECT  
				@UserId = u.UserId,
				@IsApproved = m.IsApproved,
				@IsLockedOut = m.IsLockedOut,
				@LastLockoutDate = m.LastLockoutDate,
				@FailedPasswordAttemptCount = m.FailedPasswordAttemptCount,
				@FailedPasswordAttemptWindowStart = m.FailedPasswordAttemptWindowStart,
				@FailedPasswordAnswerAttemptCount = m.FailedPasswordAnswerAttemptCount,
				@FailedPasswordAnswerAttemptWindowStart = m.FailedPasswordAnswerAttemptWindowStart
			FROM    
				dbo.aspnet_Applications a
			INNER JOIN dbo.aspnet_Users u
				ON u.ApplicationId = a.ApplicationId
			INNER JOIN dbo.aspnet_Membership m WITH ( UPDLOCK )
				ON u.UserId = m.UserId
			WHERE   
				LOWER(@var_ApplicationName) = a.LoweredApplicationName AND								
				LOWER(@var_UserName) = u.LoweredUserName

			IF ( @@rowcount = 0 )
			BEGIN
				SET @ErrorCode = 1
				GOTO Cleanup
			END

			IF( @IsLockedOut = 1 )
			BEGIN
				GOTO Cleanup
			END

			IF( @var_IsPasswordCorrect = 0 )
			BEGIN
				IF( @var_CurrentTimeUtc > DATEADD( minute, @var_PasswordAttemptWindow, @FailedPasswordAttemptWindowStart ) )
				BEGIN
					SET @FailedPasswordAttemptWindowStart = @var_CurrentTimeUtc
					SET @FailedPasswordAttemptCount = 1
				END
				ELSE
				BEGIN
					SET @FailedPasswordAttemptWindowStart = @var_CurrentTimeUtc
					SET @FailedPasswordAttemptCount = @FailedPasswordAttemptCount + 1
				END

				BEGIN
					IF( @FailedPasswordAttemptCount >= @var_MaxInvalidPasswordAttempts )
					BEGIN
						SET @IsLockedOut = 1
						SET @LastLockoutDate = @var_CurrentTimeUtc

						--log audit of user locked out
						INSERT INTO tbluseraudit
						SELECT PersonFK, 4 /*locked out*/, 'Account locked (Wrong password)', 0, tu.UserPK, dbo.GetBSTDate(),tu.UserPK, dbo.GetBSTDate()
						FROM tblusers tu
						INNER JOIN dbo.aspnet_Users au ON tu.AspNetUserID = au.UserId
						WHERE au.UserId = @UserId
					END
				END
			END
			ELSE
			BEGIN
				IF( @FailedPasswordAttemptCount > 0 OR @FailedPasswordAnswerAttemptCount > 0 )
				BEGIN
					SET @FailedPasswordAttemptCount = 0
					SET @FailedPasswordAttemptWindowStart = CONVERT( datetime, '17540101', 112 )
					SET @FailedPasswordAnswerAttemptCount = 0
					SET @FailedPasswordAnswerAttemptWindowStart = CONVERT( datetime, '17540101', 112 )
					SET @LastLockoutDate = CONVERT( datetime, '17540101', 112 )
				END
			END

			IF( @var_UpdateLastLoginActivityDate = 1 )
			BEGIN
				UPDATE  dbo.aspnet_Users WITH (ROWLOCK)
				SET     LastActivityDate = @var_LastActivityDate
				WHERE   @UserId = UserId

				IF( @@ERROR <> 0 )
				BEGIN
					SET @ErrorCode = -1
					GOTO Cleanup
				END

				UPDATE  dbo.aspnet_Membership WITH (ROWLOCK)
				SET     LastLoginDate = @var_LastLoginDate
				WHERE   UserId = @UserId

				IF( @@ERROR <> 0 )
				BEGIN
					SET @ErrorCode = -1
					GOTO Cleanup
				END
			END

			UPDATE dbo.aspnet_Membership WITH (ROWLOCK)
			SET IsLockedOut = @IsLockedOut, LastLockoutDate = @LastLockoutDate,
				FailedPasswordAttemptCount = @FailedPasswordAttemptCount,
				FailedPasswordAttemptWindowStart = @FailedPasswordAttemptWindowStart,
				FailedPasswordAnswerAttemptCount = @FailedPasswordAnswerAttemptCount,
				FailedPasswordAnswerAttemptWindowStart = @FailedPasswordAnswerAttemptWindowStart
			WHERE @UserId = UserId

			IF( @@ERROR <> 0 )
			BEGIN
				SET @ErrorCode = -1
				GOTO Cleanup
			END

			IF( @TranStarted = 1 )
			BEGIN
			SET @TranStarted = 0
			COMMIT TRANSACTION
			END

			RETURN @ErrorCode

		Cleanup:

			IF( @TranStarted = 1 )
			BEGIN
				SET @TranStarted = 0
    			ROLLBACK TRANSACTION
			END

			RETURN @ErrorCode

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end
						
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end

			BEGIN TRY IF XACT_STATE() = 1 AND @@TRANCOUNT = 1 AND @OpeningTranCount < 1 COMMIT TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH

			SELECT @PathId = PathId FROM dbo.aspnet_Paths WHERE LOWER(@var_Path) = LoweredPath AND ApplicationId = @var_ApplicationId
			
			BREAK

            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;

			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[aspnet_Personalization_GetApplicationId] 
(
    @ApplicationName NVARCHAR(256),
    @ApplicationId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER OUT
)
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT
 ,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;

	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	DECLARE @var_ApplicationName NVARCHAR(256)

	SET @var_ApplicationName = @ApplicationName

	SET @ParameterDetails = '@ApplicationName = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_ApplicationName AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'')

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    --BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

		SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END


	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY
			

			-- This stored procedures main code, excluding error handling - start

			SELECT @ApplicationId = ApplicationId 
			FROM dbo.aspnet_Applications 
			WHERE LOWER(@var_ApplicationName) = LoweredApplicationName

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end

			
			
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[aspnet_PersonalizationAdministration_FindState] 
(
    @AllUsersScope bit,
    @ApplicationName NVARCHAR(256),
    @PageIndex              INT,
    @PageSize               INT,
    @Path NVARCHAR(256) = NULL,
    @UserName NVARCHAR(256) = NULL,
    @InactiveSinceDate DATETIME = NULL
)
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT
 ,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;
	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	DECLARE @var_AllUsersScope BIT, @var_ApplicationName NVARCHAR(256), @var_PageIndex INT, @var_PageSize INT, @var_Path NVARCHAR(256), @var_UserName NVARCHAR(256), 
		@var_InactiveSinceDate DATETIME

	SET @var_AllUsersScope = @AllUsersScope; SET @var_ApplicationName = @ApplicationName; SET @var_PageIndex = @PageIndex; SET @var_PageSize = @PageSize; SET @var_Path = @Path
	SET @var_UserName = @UserName; SET @var_InactiveSinceDate = @InactiveSinceDate

	SET @ParameterDetails = '@AllUsersScope = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_AllUsersScope AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@ApplicationName = ' 
		+ ISNULL(CAST(@var_ApplicationName AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@PageIndex = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_PageIndex AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@PageSize = ' 
			+ ISNULL(CAST(@var_PageSize AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@Path = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_Path AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@UserName = ' 
				+ ISNULL(CAST(@var_UserName AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@InactiveSinceDate = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_InactiveSinceDate AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'')

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    --BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

		SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END


	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY
			
			-- This stored procedures main code, excluding error handling - start

			DECLARE @ApplicationId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER

			EXEC dbo.aspnet_Personalization_GetApplicationId @var_ApplicationName, @ApplicationId OUTPUT

			IF (@ApplicationId IS NULL) RETURN

			-- Set the page bounds
			DECLARE @PageLowerBound INT
			DECLARE @PageUpperBound INT
			DECLARE @TotalRecords   INT

			SET @PageLowerBound = @var_PageSize * @var_PageIndex
			SET @PageUpperBound = @var_PageSize - 1 + @PageLowerBound

			IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#PageIndex') IS NOT NULL
				DROP TABLE #PageIndex

			-- Create a temp table to store the selected results
			CREATE TABLE #PageIndex 
			(
				IndexId int IDENTITY (0, 1) NOT NULL,
				ItemId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER
			)

			IF (@var_AllUsersScope = 1)
			BEGIN
				-- Insert into our temp table
				INSERT INTO #PageIndex (ItemId)
				SELECT Paths.PathId
				FROM dbo.aspnet_Paths Paths,
					 ((SELECT 
						Paths.PathId
					   FROM 
						dbo.aspnet_PersonalizationAllUsers AllUsers
					   INNER JOIN dbo.aspnet_Paths Paths
						ON AllUsers.PathId = Paths.PathId
					   WHERE 
						Paths.ApplicationId = @ApplicationId							  
						AND (@var_Path IS NULL OR Paths.LoweredPath LIKE LOWER(@var_Path))
					  ) AS SharedDataPerPath
					  FULL OUTER JOIN
					  (SELECT DISTINCT 
						Paths.PathId
					   FROM 
						dbo.aspnet_PersonalizationPerUser PerUser
					   INNER JOIN dbo.aspnet_Paths Paths
						ON PerUser.PathId = Paths.PathId
					   WHERE 
						Paths.ApplicationId = @ApplicationId						
						AND (@var_Path IS NULL OR Paths.LoweredPath LIKE LOWER(@var_Path))
					  ) AS UserDataPerPath
					  ON SharedDataPerPath.PathId = UserDataPerPath.PathId
					 )
				WHERE Paths.PathId = SharedDataPerPath.PathId OR Paths.PathId = UserDataPerPath.PathId
				ORDER BY Paths.Path ASC

				SELECT @TotalRecords = @@ROWCOUNT

				SELECT Paths.Path,
					   SharedDataPerPath.LastUpdatedDate,
					   SharedDataPerPath.SharedDataLength,
					   UserDataPerPath.UserDataLength,
					   UserDataPerPath.UserCount
				FROM dbo.aspnet_Paths Paths,
					 ((SELECT PageIndex.ItemId AS PathId,
							  AllUsers.LastUpdatedDate AS LastUpdatedDate,
							  DATALENGTH(AllUsers.PageSettings) AS SharedDataLength
					   FROM 
						dbo.aspnet_PersonalizationAllUsers AllUsers
					   INNER JOIN #PageIndex PageIndex
						ON AllUsers.PathId = PageIndex.ItemId
					   WHERE 
							 PageIndex.IndexId >= @PageLowerBound 
							 AND PageIndex.IndexId <= @PageUpperBound
					  ) AS SharedDataPerPath
					  FULL OUTER JOIN
					  (SELECT PageIndex.ItemId AS PathId,
							  SUM(DATALENGTH(PerUser.PageSettings)) AS UserDataLength,
							  COUNT(*) AS UserCount
					   FROM 
						aspnet_PersonalizationPerUser PerUser
					   INNER JOIN #PageIndex PageIndex
						ON PerUser.PathId = PageIndex.ItemId
					   WHERE 
							 PageIndex.IndexId >= @PageLowerBound 
							 AND PageIndex.IndexId <= @PageUpperBound
					   GROUP BY PageIndex.ItemId
					  ) AS UserDataPerPath
					  ON SharedDataPerPath.PathId = UserDataPerPath.PathId
					 )
				WHERE Paths.PathId = SharedDataPerPath.PathId OR Paths.PathId = UserDataPerPath.PathId
				ORDER BY Paths.Path ASC
			END
			ELSE
			BEGIN
				-- Insert into our temp table
				INSERT INTO #PageIndex (ItemId)
				SELECT PerUser.Id
				FROM 
					dbo.aspnet_PersonalizationPerUser PerUser
				INNER JOIN dbo.aspnet_Users Users
					ON PerUser.UserId = Users.UserId
				INNER JOIN dbo.aspnet_Paths Paths
					ON PerUser.PathId = Paths.PathId
				WHERE 
					Paths.ApplicationId = @ApplicationId					  					  
					AND (@var_Path IS NULL OR Paths.LoweredPath LIKE LOWER(@var_Path))
					AND (@var_UserName IS NULL OR Users.LoweredUserName LIKE LOWER(@var_UserName))
					AND (@var_InactiveSinceDate IS NULL OR Users.LastActivityDate <= @var_InactiveSinceDate)
				ORDER BY Paths.Path ASC, Users.UserName ASC

				SELECT @TotalRecords = @@ROWCOUNT

				SELECT 
					Paths.[Path], PerUser.LastUpdatedDate, DATALENGTH(PerUser.PageSettings), Users.UserName, Users.LastActivityDate
				FROM 
					dbo.aspnet_PersonalizationPerUser PerUser
				INNER JOIN dbo.aspnet_Users Users
					ON PerUser.UserId = Users.UserID
				INNER JOIN dbo.aspnet_Paths Paths
					ON PerUser.PathId = Paths.PathId
				INNER JOIN #PageIndex PageIndex
					ON PerUser.Id = PageIndex.ItemId
				WHERE 
					PageIndex.IndexId >= @PageLowerBound AND PageIndex.IndexId <= @PageUpperBound
				ORDER BY Paths.Path ASC, Users.UserName ASC
			END

			RETURN @TotalRecords

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end
						
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END

	SET @var_InactiveSinceDate = @InactiveSinceDate

         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

							AllUsers.PathId

							dbo.aspnet_PersonalizationAllUsers AllUsers

							Paths.ApplicationId = @ApplicationId

					WHERE Id IN (SELECT 
									PerUser.Id
								 FROM 
									dbo.aspnet_PersonalizationPerUser PerUser
								 INNER JOIN dbo.aspnet_Users Users
									ON PerUser.UserId = Users.UserId
								INNER JOIN dbo.aspnet_Paths Paths

BEGIN

	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters

	SET @ParameterDetails = '@ApplicationName = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_ApplicationName AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@Path = ' 
		+ ISNULL(CAST(@var_Path AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@PageSettings = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_PageSettings AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@CurrentTimeUtc = ' 
			+ ISNULL(CAST(@var_CurrentTimeUtc AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'')

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    --BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

		SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)

        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END


	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY			

			-- This stored procedures main code, excluding error handling - start

			DECLARE @ApplicationId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER
			DECLARE @PathId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER

			SELECT @ApplicationId = NULL
			SELECT @PathId = NULL

			EXEC dbo.aspnet_Applications_CreateApplication @var_ApplicationName, @ApplicationId OUTPUT

			SELECT @PathId = u.PathId FROM dbo.aspnet_Paths u WHERE u.ApplicationId = @ApplicationId AND u.LoweredPath = LOWER(@var_Path)

			IF (@PathId IS NULL)
				EXEC dbo.aspnet_Paths_CreatePath @ApplicationId, @var_Path, @PathId OUTPUT

			IF XACT_STATE() = 0 AND @@TRANCOUNT < 1 BEGIN TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName

				IF (EXISTS(SELECT PathId FROM dbo.aspnet_PersonalizationAllUsers WHERE PathId = @PathId))
					UPDATE dbo.aspnet_PersonalizationAllUsers WITH (ROWLOCK) SET PageSettings = @var_PageSettings, LastUpdatedDate = @var_CurrentTimeUtc WHERE PathId = @PathId
				ELSE
					INSERT INTO dbo.aspnet_PersonalizationAllUsers(PathId, PageSettings, LastUpdatedDate) VALUES (@PathId, @var_PageSettings, @var_CurrentTimeUtc)

			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END

			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END

	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

		SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END


	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);

	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

			-- This stored procedures main code, excluding error handling - start

			DECLARE @ApplicationId uniqueidentifier

			SELECT  @ApplicationId = NULL

			SELECT  @ApplicationId = ApplicationId FROM aspnet_Applications WHERE LOWER(@var_ApplicationName) = LoweredApplicationName

			BEGIN
				SELECT  0
				RETURN
			END

			IF XACT_STATE() = 0 AND @@TRANCOUNT < 1 BEGIN TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName

				DELETE
				FROM    dbo.aspnet_Profile
				WHERE   UserId IN
						(   SELECT  UserId
							FROM    dbo.aspnet_Users u
							WHERE   ApplicationId = @ApplicationId
									AND (LastActivityDate <= @var_InactiveSinceDate)
									AND (
											(@var_ProfileAuthOptions = 2)
										 OR (@var_ProfileAuthOptions = 0 AND IsAnonymous = 1)
										 OR (@var_ProfileAuthOptions = 1 AND IsAnonymous = 0)
										)
						)

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end

			BEGIN TRY IF XACT_STATE() = 1 AND @@TRANCOUNT = 1 AND @OpeningTranCount < 1 COMMIT TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH
			
			BREAK
		END TRY

			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[aspnet_Profile_DeleteProfiles]
(
    @ApplicationName        nvarchar(256),
    @UserNames              nvarchar(4000)
)
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT
 ,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;
	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	DECLARE @var_ApplicationName NVARCHAR(256), @var_UserNames NVARCHAR(4000)

	SET @var_ApplicationName = @ApplicationName; SET @var_UserNames = @UserNames

	SET @ParameterDetails = '@ApplicationName = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_ApplicationName AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@UserNames = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_UserNames AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'')

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    --BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

		SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END


	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY
			

			-- This stored procedures main code, excluding error handling - start

			DECLARE @UserName     nvarchar(256)
			DECLARE @CurrentPos   int
			DECLARE @NextPos      int
			DECLARE @NumDeleted   int
			DECLARE @DeletedUser  int
			DECLARE @TranStarted  bit
			DECLARE @ErrorCode    int

			SET @ErrorCode = 0
			SET @CurrentPos = 1
			SET @NumDeleted = 0
			SET @TranStarted = 0

			IF( @@TRANCOUNT = 0 )
			BEGIN
				BEGIN TRANSACTION
				SET @TranStarted = 1
			END
			ELSE
    			SET @TranStarted = 0

			WHILE (@CurrentPos <= LEN(@var_UserNames))
			BEGIN
				SELECT @NextPos = CHARINDEX(N',', @var_UserNames,  @CurrentPos)
				IF (@NextPos = 0 OR @NextPos IS NULL)
					SELECT @NextPos = LEN(@var_UserNames) + 1

				SELECT @UserName = SUBSTRING(@var_UserNames, @CurrentPos, @NextPos - @CurrentPos)
				SELECT @CurrentPos = @NextPos+1

				IF (LEN(@UserName) > 0)
				BEGIN
					SELECT @DeletedUser = 0
					EXEC dbo.aspnet_Users_DeleteUser @var_ApplicationName, @UserName, 4, @DeletedUser OUTPUT
					IF( @@ERROR <> 0 )
					BEGIN
						SET @ErrorCode = -1
						GOTO Cleanup
					END
					IF (@DeletedUser <> 0)
						SELECT @NumDeleted = @NumDeleted + 1
				END
			END
			SELECT @NumDeleted
			IF (@TranStarted = 1)
			BEGIN
    			SET @TranStarted = 0
    			COMMIT TRANSACTION
			END
			SET @TranStarted = 0

			RETURN 0

		Cleanup:
			IF (@TranStarted = 1 )
			BEGIN
				SET @TranStarted = 0
    			ROLLBACK TRANSACTION
			END
			RETURN @ErrorCode

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end
						
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END
GO

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[aspnet_Profile_GetProfiles]
(
    @ApplicationName        nvarchar(256),
    @ProfileAuthOptions     int,
    @PageIndex              int,
    @PageSize               int,
    @UserNameToMatch        nvarchar(256) = NULL,
    @InactiveSinceDate      datetime      = NULL
)
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT
 ,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;
	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	DECLARE @var_ApplicationName NVARCHAR(256), @var_ProfileAuthOptions INT, @var_PageIndex INT, @var_PageSize INT, @var_UserNameToMatch NVARCHAR(256), @var_InactiveSinceDate DATETIME

	SET @var_ApplicationName = @ApplicationName; SET @var_ProfileAuthOptions = @ProfileAuthOptions; SET @var_PageIndex = @PageIndex; SET @var_PageSize = @PageSize
	SET @var_UserNameToMatch = @UserNameToMatch; SET @var_InactiveSinceDate = @InactiveSinceDate

	SET @ParameterDetails = '@ApplicationName = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_ApplicationName AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@ProfileAuthOptions = ' 
		+ ISNULL(CAST(@var_ProfileAuthOptions AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@PageIndex = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_PageIndex AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@PageSize = ' 
			+ ISNULL(CAST(@var_PageSize AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@UserNameToMatch = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_UserNameToMatch AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@InactiveSinceDate = ' 
				+ ISNULL(CAST(@var_InactiveSinceDate AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'')

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    --BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

		SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END


	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY
			
			-- This stored procedures main code, excluding error handling - start

			DECLARE @ApplicationId uniqueidentifier
			SELECT  @ApplicationId = NULL

			SELECT  @ApplicationId = ApplicationId FROM aspnet_Applications WHERE LOWER(@var_ApplicationName) = LoweredApplicationName

			IF (@ApplicationId IS NULL) RETURN

			-- Set the page bounds
			DECLARE @PageLowerBound int
			DECLARE @PageUpperBound int
			DECLARE @TotalRecords   int

			SET @PageLowerBound = @var_PageSize * @var_PageIndex
			SET @PageUpperBound = @var_PageSize - 1 + @PageLowerBound

			IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#PageIndexForUsers') IS NOT NULL
				DROP TABLE #PageIndexForUsers

			-- Create a temp table TO store the select results
			CREATE TABLE #PageIndexForUsers
			(
				IndexId int IDENTITY (0, 1) NOT NULL,
				UserId uniqueidentifier
			)

			-- Insert into our temp table
			INSERT INTO #PageIndexForUsers (UserId)
			SELECT  
				u.UserId
			FROM    
				dbo.aspnet_Users u
			INNER JOIN dbo.aspnet_Profile p
				ON u.UserId = p.UserId
			WHERE   
				ApplicationId = @ApplicationId				
				AND (@var_InactiveSinceDate IS NULL OR LastActivityDate <= @var_InactiveSinceDate)
				AND (     (@var_ProfileAuthOptions = 2)
						OR (@var_ProfileAuthOptions = 0 AND IsAnonymous = 1)
						OR (@var_ProfileAuthOptions = 1 AND IsAnonymous = 0)
						)
				AND (@var_UserNameToMatch IS NULL OR LoweredUserName LIKE LOWER(@var_UserNameToMatch))
			ORDER BY 
				UserName

			SELECT  
				u.UserName, u.IsAnonymous, u.LastActivityDate, p.LastUpdatedDate,
				DATALENGTH(p.PropertyNames) + DATALENGTH(p.PropertyValuesString) + DATALENGTH(p.PropertyValuesBinary)
			FROM    
				dbo.aspnet_Users u
			INNER JOIN dbo.aspnet_Profile p
				ON u.UserId = p.UserId
			INNER JOIN #PageIndexForUsers i
				ON p.UserId = i.UserId
			WHERE   				 				 
				i.IndexId >= @PageLowerBound 
				AND i.IndexId <= @PageUpperBound

			SELECT COUNT(*)
			FROM   #PageIndexForUsers

			--DROP TABLE #PageIndexForUsers

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end
						
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[aspnet_Profile_GetProperties]
(
    @ApplicationName      nvarchar(256),
    @UserName             nvarchar(256),
    @CurrentTimeUtc       datetime
)
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT
 ,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;
	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	DECLARE @var_ApplicationName NVARCHAR(256), @var_UserName NVARCHAR(256), @var_CurrentTimeUtc DATETIME

	SET @var_ApplicationName = @ApplicationName; SET @var_UserName = @UserName; SET @var_CurrentTimeUtc = @CurrentTimeUtc

	SET @ParameterDetails = '@ApplicationName = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_ApplicationName AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@UserName = ' 
		+ ISNULL(CAST(@var_UserName AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@CurrentTimeUtc = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_CurrentTimeUtc AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'')

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    --BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

		SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END


	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY
			
			-- This stored procedures main code, excluding error handling - start

			DECLARE @ApplicationId uniqueidentifier
			SELECT  @ApplicationId = NULL

			SELECT  @ApplicationId = ApplicationId FROM dbo.aspnet_Applications WHERE LOWER(@var_ApplicationName) = LoweredApplicationName

			IF (@ApplicationId IS NULL) RETURN

			DECLARE @UserId uniqueidentifier
			SELECT  @UserId = NULL

			SELECT @UserId = UserId
			FROM   dbo.aspnet_Users
			WHERE  ApplicationId = @ApplicationId AND LoweredUserName = LOWER(@var_UserName)

			IF (@UserId IS NULL) RETURN

			SELECT TOP 1 PropertyNames, PropertyValuesString, PropertyValuesBinary
			FROM         dbo.aspnet_Profile
			WHERE        UserId = @UserId

			IF (@@ROWCOUNT > 0)
			BEGIN
				IF XACT_STATE() = 0 AND @@TRANCOUNT < 1 BEGIN TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName

					UPDATE dbo.aspnet_Users WITH (ROWLOCK)
					SET    LastActivityDate=@var_CurrentTimeUtc
					WHERE  UserId = @UserId

				BEGIN TRY IF XACT_STATE() = 1 AND @@TRANCOUNT = 1 AND @OpeningTranCount < 1 COMMIT TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH
			END

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end
						
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[aspnet_Profile_SetProperties]
(
    @ApplicationName        nvarchar(256),
    @PropertyNames          nvarchar(max),
    @PropertyValuesString   nvarchar(max),
    @PropertyValuesBinary   varbinary(max),
    @UserName               nvarchar(256),
    @IsUserAnonymous        bit,
    @CurrentTimeUtc         datetime
)
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT
 ,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;
	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	DECLARE @var_ApplicationName NVARCHAR(256), @var_PropertyNames nvarchar(max), @var_PropertyValuesString nvarchar(max), @var_PropertyValuesBinary varbinary(max), @var_UserName NVARCHAR(256), 
		@var_IsUserAnonymous BIT, @var_CurrentTimeUtc DATETIME

	SET @var_ApplicationName = @ApplicationName; SET @var_PropertyNames = @PropertyNames; SET @var_PropertyValuesString = @PropertyValuesString
	SET @var_PropertyValuesBinary = @PropertyValuesBinary; SET @var_UserName = @UserName; SET @var_IsUserAnonymous = @IsUserAnonymous; SET @var_CurrentTimeUtc = @CurrentTimeUtc

	SET @ParameterDetails = '@ApplicationName = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_ApplicationName AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@PropertyNames = ' 
		+ ISNULL(CAST(@var_PropertyNames AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@PropertyValuesString = ' 
			+ ISNULL(CAST(@var_PropertyValuesString AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@PropertyValuesBinary = ' 
				+ ISNULL(CAST(@var_PropertyValuesBinary AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@UserName = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_UserName AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@IsUserAnonymous = ' 
					+ ISNULL(CAST(@var_IsUserAnonymous AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@CurrentTimeUtc = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_CurrentTimeUtc AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'')

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    --BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

		SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END


	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY
			
			-- This stored procedures main code, excluding error handling - start

			DECLARE @ApplicationId uniqueidentifier
			SELECT  @ApplicationId = NULL

			DECLARE @ErrorCode     int
			SET @ErrorCode = 0

			DECLARE @TranStarted   bit
			SET @TranStarted = 0

			IF( @@TRANCOUNT = 0 )
			BEGIN
			   BEGIN TRANSACTION
			   SET @TranStarted = 1
			END
			ELSE
    			SET @TranStarted = 0

			EXEC dbo.aspnet_Applications_CreateApplication @var_ApplicationName, @ApplicationId OUTPUT

			IF( @@ERROR <> 0 )
			BEGIN
				SET @ErrorCode = -1
				GOTO Cleanup
			END

			DECLARE @UserId uniqueidentifier
			DECLARE @LastActivityDate datetime

			SELECT  @UserId = NULL
			SELECT  @LastActivityDate = @var_CurrentTimeUtc

			SELECT @UserId = UserId
			FROM   dbo.aspnet_Users
			WHERE  ApplicationId = @ApplicationId AND LoweredUserName = LOWER(@var_UserName)

			IF (@UserId IS NULL)
				EXEC dbo.aspnet_Users_CreateUser @ApplicationId, @var_UserName, @var_IsUserAnonymous, @LastActivityDate, @UserId OUTPUT

			IF( @@ERROR <> 0 )
			BEGIN
				SET @ErrorCode = -1
				GOTO Cleanup
			END

			UPDATE dbo.aspnet_Users WITH (ROWLOCK)
			SET    LastActivityDate=@var_CurrentTimeUtc
			WHERE  UserId = @UserId

			IF( @@ERROR <> 0 )
			BEGIN
				SET @ErrorCode = -1
				GOTO Cleanup
			END

			IF (EXISTS( SELECT *
					   FROM   dbo.aspnet_Profile
					   WHERE  UserId = @UserId))
				UPDATE dbo.aspnet_Profile WITH (ROWLOCK)
				SET    PropertyNames=@var_PropertyNames, PropertyValuesString = @var_PropertyValuesString,
					   PropertyValuesBinary = @var_PropertyValuesBinary, LastUpdatedDate=@var_CurrentTimeUtc
				WHERE  UserId = @UserId
			ELSE
				INSERT INTO dbo.aspnet_Profile(UserId, PropertyNames, PropertyValuesString, PropertyValuesBinary, LastUpdatedDate)
					 VALUES (@UserId, @var_PropertyNames, @var_PropertyValuesString, @var_PropertyValuesBinary, @var_CurrentTimeUtc)

			IF( @@ERROR <> 0 )
			BEGIN
				SET @ErrorCode = -1
				GOTO Cleanup
			END

			IF( @TranStarted = 1 )
			BEGIN
    			SET @TranStarted = 0
    			COMMIT TRANSACTION
			END

			RETURN 0

		Cleanup:

			IF( @TranStarted = 1 )
			BEGIN
				SET @TranStarted = 0
    			ROLLBACK TRANSACTION
			END

			RETURN @ErrorCode

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end
						
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END
