CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[aspnet_RegisterSchemaVersion]
(
    @Feature                   nvarchar(128),
    @CompatibleSchemaVersion   nvarchar(128),
    @IsCurrentVersion          bit,
    @RemoveIncompatibleSchema  bit
)
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT
 ,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;
	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	DECLARE @var_Feature NVARCHAR(128), @var_CompatibleSchemaVersion NVARCHAR(128), @var_IsCurrentVersion BIT, @var_RemoveIncompatibleSchema BIT

	SET @var_Feature = @Feature; SET @var_CompatibleSchemaVersion = @CompatibleSchemaVersion; SET @var_IsCurrentVersion = @IsCurrentVersion
	SET @var_RemoveIncompatibleSchema = @RemoveIncompatibleSchema

	SET @ParameterDetails = '@Feature = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_Feature AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@CompatibleSchemaVersion = ' 
		+ ISNULL(CAST(@var_CompatibleSchemaVersion AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@IsCurrentVersion = ' 
			+ ISNULL(CAST(@var_IsCurrentVersion AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@RemoveIncompatibleSchema = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_RemoveIncompatibleSchema AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'')

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    --BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

		SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END


	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY
			IF XACT_STATE() = 0 AND @@TRANCOUNT < 1 BEGIN TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName

				-- This stored procedures main code, excluding error handling - start

				IF( @var_RemoveIncompatibleSchema = 1 )
				BEGIN
					DELETE FROM dbo.aspnet_SchemaVersions WHERE Feature = LOWER( @var_Feature )
				END
				ELSE
				BEGIN
					IF( @var_IsCurrentVersion = 1 )
					BEGIN
						UPDATE dbo.aspnet_SchemaVersions WITH (ROWLOCK)
						SET IsCurrentVersion = 0
						WHERE Feature = LOWER( @var_Feature )
					END
				END

				INSERT  dbo.aspnet_SchemaVersions( Feature, CompatibleSchemaVersion, IsCurrentVersion )
				VALUES( LOWER( @var_Feature ), @var_CompatibleSchemaVersion, @var_IsCurrentVersion )

				-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end

			BEGIN TRY IF XACT_STATE() = 1 AND @@TRANCOUNT = 1 AND @OpeningTranCount < 1 COMMIT TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH
			
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END

			BEGIN
				BEGIN TRANSACTION
				SET @TranStarted = 1
			END
			ELSE
				SET @TranStarted = 0

			EXEC dbo.aspnet_Applications_CreateApplication @var_ApplicationName, @ApplicationId OUTPUT

			IF( @@ERROR <> 0 )
			BEGIN
				SET @ErrorCode = -1
				GOTO Cleanup
			END

			IF (EXISTS(SELECT RoleId FROM dbo.aspnet_Roles WHERE LoweredRoleName = LOWER(@var_RoleName) AND ApplicationId = @ApplicationId))
			BEGIN
				SET @ErrorCode = 1
				GOTO Cleanup
			END

			INSERT INTO dbo.aspnet_Roles
						(ApplicationId, RoleName, LoweredRoleName)
				 VALUES (@ApplicationId, @var_RoleName, LOWER(@var_RoleName))

			IF( @@ERROR <> 0 )
			BEGIN
				SET @ErrorCode = -1
				GOTO Cleanup
			END

			IF( @TranStarted = 1 )
			BEGIN
				SET @TranStarted = 0
				COMMIT TRANSACTION
			END

			RETURN(0)

		Cleanup:

			IF( @TranStarted = 1 )
			BEGIN
				SET @TranStarted = 0
				ROLLBACK TRANSACTION
			END

			RETURN @ErrorCode

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end
						
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[aspnet_Roles_DeleteRole]
(
    @ApplicationName            nvarchar(256),
    @RoleName                   nvarchar(256),
    @DeleteOnlyIfRoleIsEmpty    bit
)
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT
 ,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;
	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	DECLARE @var_ApplicationName NVARCHAR(256), @var_RoleName NVARCHAR(256), @var_DeleteOnlyIfRoleIsEmpty BIT

	SET @var_ApplicationName = @ApplicationName; SET @var_RoleName = @RoleName; SET @var_DeleteOnlyIfRoleIsEmpty = @DeleteOnlyIfRoleIsEmpty

	SET @ParameterDetails = '@ApplicationName = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_ApplicationName AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@RoleName = ' 
		+ ISNULL(CAST(@var_RoleName AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@DeleteOnlyIfRoleIsEmpty = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_DeleteOnlyIfRoleIsEmpty AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'')

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    --BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

		SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END


	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY
			
			-- This stored procedures main code, excluding error handling - start

			DECLARE @ApplicationId uniqueidentifier
			SELECT  @ApplicationId = NULL

			SELECT  @ApplicationId = ApplicationId FROM aspnet_Applications WHERE LOWER(@var_ApplicationName) = LoweredApplicationName

			IF (@ApplicationId IS NULL) RETURN(1)

			DECLARE @ErrorCode     int
			SET @ErrorCode = 0

			DECLARE @TranStarted   bit
			SET @TranStarted = 0

			IF( @@TRANCOUNT = 0 )
			BEGIN
				BEGIN TRANSACTION
				SET @TranStarted = 1
			END
			ELSE
				SET @TranStarted = 0

			DECLARE @RoleId   uniqueidentifier
			SELECT  @RoleId = NULL
			SELECT  @RoleId = RoleId FROM dbo.aspnet_Roles WHERE LoweredRoleName = LOWER(@var_RoleName) AND ApplicationId = @ApplicationId

			IF (@RoleId IS NULL)
			BEGIN
				SELECT @ErrorCode = 1
				GOTO Cleanup
			END
			IF (@var_DeleteOnlyIfRoleIsEmpty <> 0)
			BEGIN
				IF (EXISTS (SELECT RoleId FROM dbo.aspnet_UsersInRoles  WHERE @RoleId = RoleId))
				BEGIN
					SELECT @ErrorCode = 2
					GOTO Cleanup
				END
			END

			DELETE FROM dbo.aspnet_UsersInRoles  WHERE @RoleId = RoleId

			IF( @@ERROR <> 0 )
			BEGIN
				SET @ErrorCode = -1
				GOTO Cleanup
			END

			DELETE FROM dbo.aspnet_Roles WHERE @RoleId = RoleId  AND ApplicationId = @ApplicationId

			IF( @@ERROR <> 0 )
			BEGIN
				SET @ErrorCode = -1
				GOTO Cleanup
			END

			IF( @TranStarted = 1 )
			BEGIN
				SET @TranStarted = 0
				COMMIT TRANSACTION
			END

			RETURN(0)

		Cleanup:

			IF( @TranStarted = 1 )
			BEGIN
				SET @TranStarted = 0
				ROLLBACK TRANSACTION
			END

			RETURN @ErrorCode

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end
					
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END

         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    --BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

		SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END


	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY
			IF XACT_STATE() = 0 AND @@TRANCOUNT < 1 BEGIN TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName

				-- This stored procedures main code, excluding error handling - start

				IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#aspnet_RoleMembers') IS NOT NULL
					DROP TABLE #aspnet_RoleMembers

				CREATE TABLE #aspnet_RoleMembers
				(
					Group_name      sysname,
					Group_id        smallint,
					Users_in_group  sysname,
					[User_id]       smallint
				)

				INSERT INTO #aspnet_RoleMembers
				EXEC sp_helpuser @var_name

				DECLARE @user_id smallint
				DECLARE @cmd nvarchar(500)

				DECLARE c1 cursor FORWARD_ONLY FOR SELECT [User_id] FROM #aspnet_RoleMembers

				OPEN c1

				FETCH c1 INTO @user_id
				WHILE (@@fetch_status = 0)
				BEGIN
					SET @cmd = 'EXEC sp_droprolemember ' + '''' + @var_name + ''', ''' + USER_NAME(@user_id) + ''''
					EXEC (@cmd)
					FETCH c1 INTO @user_id
				END

				CLOSE c1
				DEALLOCATE c1

				-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end

			BEGIN TRY IF XACT_STATE() = 1 AND @@TRANCOUNT = 1 AND @OpeningTranCount < 1 COMMIT TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH
			
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[aspnet_UnRegisterSchemaVersion]
(
    @Feature                   nvarchar(128),
    @CompatibleSchemaVersion   nvarchar(128)
)
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT

	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	DECLARE @var_Feature NVARCHAR(128), @var_CompatibleSchemaVersion NVARCHAR(128)

	SET @var_Feature = @Feature; SET @var_CompatibleSchemaVersion = @CompatibleSchemaVersion

	SET @ParameterDetails = '@Feature = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_Feature AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@CompatibleSchemaVersion = ' 
		+ ISNULL(CAST(@var_CompatibleSchemaVersion AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'')

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[aspnet_UpdateUserPasswords]
(
    @ApplicationName  nvarchar(256),
    @UserName         nvarchar(256)
)
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT
 ,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;
	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	DECLARE @var_ApplicationName NVARCHAR(256), @var_UserName NVARCHAR(256)

	SET @var_ApplicationName = @ApplicationName; SET @var_UserName = @UserName

	SET @ParameterDetails = '@ApplicationName = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_ApplicationName AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@UserName = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_UserName AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'')

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    --BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

		SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END


	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY			

			-- This stored procedures main code, excluding error handling - start

			DECLARE @UserId NVARCHAR(256), @ApplicationId NVARCHAR(256), @Password NVARCHAR(256), @Comment NVARCHAR(MAX)

			SELECT TOP 1 @UserId = u.UserId, @ApplicationId = a.ApplicationId, @Password = m.[Password], @Comment = m.Comment
			FROM [dbo].[aspnet_Users] AS u
			INNER JOIN [dbo].[aspnet_Membership] AS m
			ON u.ApplicationId = m.ApplicationId
			AND u.UserId = m.UserId
			INNER JOIN [dbo].[aspnet_Applications] AS a
			ON m.ApplicationId = a.ApplicationId
			WHERE a.[ApplicationName] = @var_ApplicationName
			AND u.[UserName] = @var_UserName

			IF NOT(ISNULL(@UserId,'') <> '' AND ISNULL(@ApplicationId,'') <> '' AND ISNULL(@Password,'') <> '' AND ISNULL(@Comment,'') <> 'Password change required')
				RETURN

			EXEC dbo.aspnet_CheckIfPasswordPreviouslyUsed @var_ApplicationName, @var_UserName, @Password				

			IF XACT_STATE() = 0 AND @@TRANCOUNT < 1 BEGIN TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName

				INSERT INTO aspnet_UserPasswords
				(
					UserId, ApplicationId, [Password], DateChanged
				)
				SELECT DISTINCT
					m.UserId,
					m.ApplicationId,
					m.[Password],
					m.LastPasswordChangedDate
				FROM 
					[dbo].[aspnet_Users] AS u
				INNER JOIN [dbo].[aspnet_Membership] AS m
					ON u.ApplicationId = m.ApplicationId
					AND u.UserId = m.UserId
				INNER JOIN [dbo].[aspnet_Applications] AS a
					ON m.ApplicationId = a.ApplicationId
				WHERE
					a.[ApplicationName] = @var_ApplicationName
					AND u.[UserName] = @var_UserName			

				-- Delete the oldest user password records until there are only 5 records remaining
				WHILE (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM aspnet_UserPasswords WHERE UserId = @UserId AND ApplicationId = @ApplicationId) > 5
				BEGIN
					DELETE FROM aspnet_UserPasswords
					WHERE UserId = @UserId AND ApplicationId = @ApplicationId
					AND DateChanged = (SELECT MIN(DateChanged) FROM aspnet_UserPasswords WHERE UserId = @UserId AND ApplicationId = @ApplicationId)								
				END

			BEGIN TRY IF XACT_STATE() = 1 AND @@TRANCOUNT = 1 AND @OpeningTranCount < 1 COMMIT TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end
						
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END
GO

	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY
			
			-- This stored procedures main code, excluding error handling - start

			IF( @UserId IS NULL )
				SELECT @UserId = NEWID()
			ELSE
			BEGIN
				IF( EXISTS( SELECT UserId FROM dbo.aspnet_Users WHERE @UserId = UserId ) )
					RETURN -1
			END

			IF XACT_STATE() = 0 AND @@TRANCOUNT < 1 BEGIN TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName

				INSERT dbo.aspnet_Users (ApplicationId, UserId, UserName, LoweredUserName, IsAnonymous, LastActivityDate)
				VALUES (@var_ApplicationId, @UserId, @var_UserName, LOWER(@var_UserName), @var_IsUserAnonymous, @var_LastActivityDate)

			BEGIN TRY IF XACT_STATE() = 1 AND @@TRANCOUNT = 1 AND @OpeningTranCount < 1 COMMIT TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH

			RETURN 0

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end
						
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[aspnet_Users_DeleteUser]
(
    @ApplicationName  nvarchar(256),
    @UserName         nvarchar(256),
    @TablesToDeleteFrom int,
    @NumTablesDeletedFrom int OUTPUT
)
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT
 ,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;
	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	DECLARE @var_ApplicationName NVARCHAR(256), @var_UserName NVARCHAR(256), @var_TablesToDeleteFrom INT

	SET @var_ApplicationName = @ApplicationName; SET @var_UserName = @UserName; SET @var_TablesToDeleteFrom = @TablesToDeleteFrom

	SET @ParameterDetails = '@ApplicationName = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_ApplicationName AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@UserName = ' 
		+ ISNULL(CAST(@var_UserName AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@TablesToDeleteFrom = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_TablesToDeleteFrom AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'')

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    --BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

		SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END


	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY			

			-- This stored procedures main code, excluding error handling - start

			DECLARE @UserId               uniqueidentifier
			SELECT  @UserId               = NULL
			SELECT  @NumTablesDeletedFrom = 0

			DECLARE @TranStarted   bit
			SET @TranStarted = 0

			IF( @@TRANCOUNT = 0 )
			BEGIN
				BEGIN TRANSACTION
				SET @TranStarted = 1
			END
			ELSE
			SET @TranStarted = 0

			DECLARE @ErrorCode   int
			DECLARE @RowCount    int

			SET @ErrorCode = 0
			SET @RowCount  = 0

			SELECT  
				@UserId = u.UserId
			FROM    
				dbo.aspnet_Users u
			INNER JOIN dbo.aspnet_Applications a
				ON u.ApplicationId = a.ApplicationId
			WHERE   
				u.LoweredUserName = LOWER(@var_UserName)				
				AND LOWER(@var_ApplicationName) = a.LoweredApplicationName

			IF (@UserId IS NULL) GOTO Cleanup

			-- Delete from Membership table if (@var_TablesToDeleteFrom & 1) is set
			IF ((@var_TablesToDeleteFrom & 1) <> 0 AND
				(EXISTS (SELECT name FROM sys.objects WHERE (name = N'vw_aspnet_MembershipUsers') AND (type = 'V'))))
			BEGIN
				DELETE FROM dbo.aspnet_Membership WHERE @UserId = UserId

				SELECT @ErrorCode = @@ERROR, @RowCount = @@ROWCOUNT

				IF( @ErrorCode <> 0 ) GOTO Cleanup

				IF (@RowCount <> 0) SELECT  @NumTablesDeletedFrom = @NumTablesDeletedFrom + 1
			END

			-- Delete from aspnet_UsersInRoles table if (@var_TablesToDeleteFrom & 2) is set
			IF ((@var_TablesToDeleteFrom & 2) <> 0  AND
				(EXISTS (SELECT name FROM sys.objects WHERE (name = N'vw_aspnet_UsersInRoles') AND (type = 'V'))) )
			BEGIN
				DELETE FROM dbo.aspnet_UsersInRoles WHERE @UserId = UserId

				SELECT @ErrorCode = @@ERROR, @RowCount = @@ROWCOUNT

				IF( @ErrorCode <> 0 ) GOTO Cleanup

				IF (@RowCount <> 0) SELECT  @NumTablesDeletedFrom = @NumTablesDeletedFrom + 1
			END

			-- Delete from aspnet_Profile table if (@var_TablesToDeleteFrom & 4) is set
			IF ((@var_TablesToDeleteFrom & 4) <> 0  AND
				(EXISTS (SELECT name FROM sys.objects WHERE (name = N'vw_aspnet_Profiles') AND (type = 'V'))) )
			BEGIN
				DELETE FROM dbo.aspnet_Profile WHERE @UserId = UserId

				SELECT @ErrorCode = @@ERROR, @RowCount = @@ROWCOUNT

				IF( @ErrorCode <> 0 ) GOTO Cleanup

				IF (@RowCount <> 0) SELECT  @NumTablesDeletedFrom = @NumTablesDeletedFrom + 1
			END

			-- Delete from aspnet_PersonalizationPerUser table if (@var_TablesToDeleteFrom & 8) is set
			IF ((@var_TablesToDeleteFrom & 8) <> 0  AND
				(EXISTS (SELECT name FROM sys.objects WHERE (name = N'vw_aspnet_WebPartState_User') AND (type = 'V'))) )
			BEGIN
				DELETE FROM dbo.aspnet_PersonalizationPerUser WHERE @UserId = UserId

				SELECT @ErrorCode = @@ERROR, @RowCount = @@ROWCOUNT

				IF( @ErrorCode <> 0 ) GOTO Cleanup

				IF (@RowCount <> 0) SELECT  @NumTablesDeletedFrom = @NumTablesDeletedFrom + 1
			END

			-- Delete from aspnet_Users table if (@var_TablesToDeleteFrom & 1,2,4 & 8) are all set
			IF ((@var_TablesToDeleteFrom & 1) <> 0 AND
				(@var_TablesToDeleteFrom & 2) <> 0 AND
				(@var_TablesToDeleteFrom & 4) <> 0 AND
				(@var_TablesToDeleteFrom & 8) <> 0 AND
				(EXISTS (SELECT UserId FROM dbo.aspnet_Users WHERE @UserId = UserId)))
			BEGIN
				DELETE FROM dbo.aspnet_Users WHERE @UserId = UserId

				SELECT @ErrorCode = @@ERROR, @RowCount = @@ROWCOUNT

				IF( @ErrorCode <> 0 ) GOTO Cleanup

				IF (@RowCount <> 0) SELECT  @NumTablesDeletedFrom = @NumTablesDeletedFrom + 1
			END

			IF( @TranStarted = 1 )
			BEGIN
				SET @TranStarted = 0
				COMMIT TRANSACTION
			END

			RETURN 0

		Cleanup:
			SET @NumTablesDeletedFrom = 0

			IF( @TranStarted = 1 )
			BEGIN
				SET @TranStarted = 0
				ROLLBACK TRANSACTION
			END

			RETURN @ErrorCode

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end
						
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[aspnet_Users_Inactive]  
(  
    @LockOutTimeFrame int  
)  
AS  
BEGIN  
 /* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */  
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED  
  
    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT

 SET @ParameterDetails = ''

         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

 ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;  
 INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()  
  
 WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3  
 BEGIN   
  BEGIN TRY  
     
   -- This stored procedures main code, excluding error handling - start  
   declare @lockoutdate datetime = dateadd(dd, -@LockOutTimeFrame, dbo.GetBSTDate())   
   select distinct UserPK   
   --from aspnet_Membership aspM   
   from AspNetUsers aspM   
   Inner join tblUsers tu on tu.AspNetUserID = aspm.Id   
   where EmailConfirmed = 1 and LastLoginDate < @lockoutdate  
  
   -- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end  
        
   BREAK  
  END TRY  
  BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */  
   DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;  
   SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;  
   SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;  
  
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY   
   BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;  
         
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;  
  
            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID  
              
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;  
              
   IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)  
   BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END  
   ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */  
  END CATCH  
  SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1  
 END

	@RoleNames		  nvarchar(4000),
	@CurrentTimeUtc   datetime
)
AS

	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT
	,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;
	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

	DECLARE @var_ApplicationName NVARCHAR(256), @var_UserNames NVARCHAR(4000), @var_RoleNames NVARCHAR(4000), @var_CurrentTimeUtc DATETIME

	SET @var_ApplicationName = @ApplicationName; SET @var_UserNames = @UserNames; SET @var_RoleNames = @RoleNames; SET @var_CurrentTimeUtc = @CurrentTimeUtc

	SET @ParameterDetails = '@ApplicationName = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_ApplicationName AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@UserNames = ' 
		+ ISNULL(CAST(@var_UserNames AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@RoleNames = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_RoleNames AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@CurrentTimeUtc = ' 
			+ ISNULL(CAST(@var_CurrentTimeUtc AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'')

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    --BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

		SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END

	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY			

			-- This stored procedures main code, excluding error handling - start

			DECLARE @AppId uniqueidentifier
			SELECT  @AppId = NULL

			SELECT  @AppId = ApplicationId FROM aspnet_Applications WHERE LOWER(@var_ApplicationName) = LoweredApplicationName

			IF (@AppId IS NULL) RETURN(2)

			DECLARE @TranStarted   bit
			SET @TranStarted = 0

			IF( @@TRANCOUNT = 0 )
			BEGIN
				BEGIN TRANSACTION
				SET @TranStarted = 1
			END

			IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#tbNames') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #tbNames

			CREATE TABLE #tbNames([Name] nvarchar(256) NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY)

			IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#tbRoles') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #tbRoles

			CREATE TABLE #tbRoles(RoleId uniqueidentifier NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY)

			IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#tbUsers') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #tbUsers

			CREATE TABLE #tbUsers(UserId uniqueidentifier NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY)


			DECLARE @Num		int
			DECLARE @Pos		int
			DECLARE @NextPos	int
			DECLARE @Name		nvarchar(256)

			SET @Num = 0
			SET @Pos = 1
			WHILE(@Pos <= LEN(@var_RoleNames))
			BEGIN
				SELECT @NextPos = CHARINDEX(N',', @var_RoleNames,  @Pos)
				IF (@NextPos = 0 OR @NextPos IS NULL)
					SELECT @NextPos = LEN(@var_RoleNames) + 1
				SELECT @Name = RTRIM(LTRIM(SUBSTRING(@var_RoleNames, @Pos, @NextPos - @Pos)))
				SELECT @Pos = @NextPos+1

				INSERT INTO #tbNames VALUES (@Name)
				SET @Num = @Num + 1
			END

			INSERT INTO #tbRoles
			SELECT 
				RoleId
			FROM   
				dbo.aspnet_Roles ar
			INNER JOIN #tbNames t
				ON LOWER(t.Name) = ar.LoweredRoleName
			WHERE 
				ar.ApplicationId = @AppId

			IF (@@ROWCOUNT <> @Num)
			BEGIN
				SELECT TOP 1 Name
				FROM   #tbNames
				WHERE  LOWER(Name) NOT IN (SELECT 
												ar.LoweredRoleName 
											FROM 
												dbo.aspnet_Roles ar
											INNER JOIN #tbRoles r
												ON r.RoleId = ar.RoleId)
				IF( @TranStarted = 1 )
					ROLLBACK TRANSACTION
				RETURN(2)
			END

			DELETE FROM #tbNames WHERE 1=1
			SET @Num = 0
			SET @Pos = 1

			WHILE(@Pos <= LEN(@var_UserNames))
			BEGIN
				SELECT @NextPos = CHARINDEX(N',', @var_UserNames,  @Pos)
				IF (@NextPos = 0 OR @NextPos IS NULL)
					SELECT @NextPos = LEN(@var_UserNames) + 1
				SELECT @Name = RTRIM(LTRIM(SUBSTRING(@var_UserNames, @Pos, @NextPos - @Pos)))
				SELECT @Pos = @NextPos+1

				INSERT INTO #tbNames VALUES (@Name)
				SET @Num = @Num + 1
			END

			INSERT INTO #tbUsers
			SELECT 
				UserId
			FROM   
				dbo.aspnet_Users ar
			INNER JOIN #tbNames t
				ON LOWER(t.Name) = ar.LoweredUserName
			WHERE  
				 ar.ApplicationId = @AppId

			IF (@@ROWCOUNT <> @Num)
			BEGIN
				DELETE FROM #tbNames
				WHERE LOWER(Name) IN (SELECT 
											LoweredUserName 
										FROM 
											dbo.aspnet_Users au
										INNER JOIN #tbUsers u 
											ON au.UserId = u.UserId)

				INSERT dbo.aspnet_Users (ApplicationId, UserId, UserName, LoweredUserName, IsAnonymous, LastActivityDate)
				  SELECT @AppId, NEWID(), Name, LOWER(Name), 0, @var_CurrentTimeUtc
				  FROM   #tbNames

				INSERT INTO #tbUsers
				SELECT  
					UserId
				FROM	
					dbo.aspnet_Users au
				INNER JOIN #tbNames t
					ON LOWER(t.Name) = au.LoweredUserName 
				WHERE 
					au.ApplicationId = @AppId
			END

			IF (EXISTS (
							SELECT 
								* 
							FROM 
								dbo.aspnet_UsersInRoles ur
							INNER JOIN #tbUsers tu
								ON tu.UserId = ur.UserId
							INNER JOIN #tbRoles tr 
								ON tr.RoleId = ur.RoleId
						)
				)
			BEGIN
				SELECT TOP 1 
					UserName, RoleName
				FROM		 
					dbo.aspnet_UsersInRoles ur
					INNER JOIN #tbUsers tu
						ON tu.UserId = ur.UserId
					INNER JOIN #tbRoles tr
						ON tr.RoleId = ur.RoleId
					INNER JOIN aspnet_Users u
						ON u.UserId = tu.UserId
					INNER JOIN aspnet_Roles r
						ON r.RoleId = tr.RoleId		
					 
				IF( @TranStarted = 1 )
					ROLLBACK TRANSACTION
				RETURN(3)
			END

			INSERT INTO dbo.aspnet_UsersInRoles (UserId, RoleId)
			SELECT UserId, RoleId
			FROM #tbUsers, #tbRoles

			IF( @TranStarted = 1 )
				COMMIT TRANSACTION

			RETURN(0)

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end
						
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END
GO

		+ ISNULL(CAST(@var_UserName AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@RoleName = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_RoleName AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'')

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    --BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

		SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END


	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY
		
			-- This stored procedures main code, excluding error handling - start

			DECLARE @ApplicationId uniqueidentifier
			SELECT  @ApplicationId = NULL

			SELECT  @ApplicationId = ApplicationId FROM aspnet_Applications WHERE LOWER(@var_ApplicationName) = LoweredApplicationName

			IF (@ApplicationId IS NULL) RETURN(2)

			DECLARE @UserId uniqueidentifier
			SELECT  @UserId = NULL

			DECLARE @RoleId uniqueidentifier
			SELECT  @RoleId = NULL

			SELECT  @UserId = UserId
			FROM    dbo.aspnet_Users
			WHERE   LoweredUserName = LOWER(@var_UserName) 
			AND ApplicationId = @ApplicationId

			IF (@UserId IS NULL) RETURN(2)

			SELECT  @RoleId = RoleId
			FROM    dbo.aspnet_Roles
			WHERE   LoweredRoleName = LOWER(@var_RoleName) 
			AND ApplicationId = @ApplicationId

			IF (@RoleId IS NULL) RETURN(3)

			IF (EXISTS( SELECT * FROM dbo.aspnet_UsersInRoles WHERE  UserId = @UserId AND RoleId = @RoleId))
				RETURN(1)
			ELSE
				RETURN(0)

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end
			
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[aspnet_UsersInRoles_RemoveUsersFromRoles]
(
	@ApplicationName  nvarchar(256),
	@UserNames		  nvarchar(4000),
	@RoleNames		  nvarchar(4000)
)
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT
	,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;
	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	DECLARE @var_ApplicationName NVARCHAR(256), @var_UserNames NVARCHAR(4000), @var_RoleNames NVARCHAR(4000)

	SET @var_ApplicationName = @ApplicationName; SET @var_UserNames = @UserNames; SET @var_RoleNames = @RoleNames

	SET @ParameterDetails = '@ApplicationName = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_ApplicationName AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@UserNames = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_UserNames AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@RoleNames = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_RoleNames AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'')

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    --BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

		SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END

	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY
		
			-- This stored procedures main code, excluding error handling - start

			DECLARE @AppId uniqueidentifier
			SELECT  @AppId = NULL

			SELECT  @AppId = ApplicationId 
			FROM aspnet_Applications 
			WHERE LOWER(@var_ApplicationName) = LoweredApplicationName

			IF (@AppId IS NULL) RETURN(2)

			DECLARE @TranStarted   bit
			SET @TranStarted = 0

			IF( @@TRANCOUNT = 0 )
			BEGIN
				BEGIN TRANSACTION
				SET @TranStarted = 1
			END

			IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#tbNames') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #tbNames

			CREATE TABLE #tbNames([Name] nvarchar(256) NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY)

			IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#tbRoles') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #tbRoles

			CREATE TABLE #tbRoles(RoleId uniqueidentifier NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY)

			IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#tbUsers') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #tbUsers

			CREATE TABLE #tbUsers(UserId uniqueidentifier NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY)

			DECLARE @Num	  int
			DECLARE @Pos	  int
			DECLARE @NextPos  int
			DECLARE @Name	  nvarchar(256)
			DECLARE @CountAll int
			DECLARE @CountU	  int
			DECLARE @CountR	  int

			SET @Num = 0
			SET @Pos = 1
			WHILE(@Pos <= LEN(@var_RoleNames))
			BEGIN
				SELECT @NextPos = CHARINDEX(N',', @var_RoleNames,  @Pos)
				IF (@NextPos = 0 OR @NextPos IS NULL)
					SELECT @NextPos = LEN(@var_RoleNames) + 1
				SELECT @Name = RTRIM(LTRIM(SUBSTRING(@var_RoleNames, @Pos, @NextPos - @Pos)))
				SELECT @Pos = @NextPos+1

				INSERT INTO #tbNames VALUES (@Name)
				SET @Num = @Num + 1
			END

			INSERT INTO #tbRoles
			SELECT 
				RoleId
			FROM   
				dbo.aspnet_Roles ar
			INNER JOIN #tbNames t
				ON LOWER(t.Name) = ar.LoweredRoleName
			WHERE 
				ar.ApplicationId = @AppId

			SELECT @CountR = @@ROWCOUNT

			IF (@CountR <> @Num)
			BEGIN
				SELECT TOP 1 N'', Name
				FROM   #tbNames
				WHERE  LOWER(Name) NOT IN (
											SELECT 
												ar.LoweredRoleName 
											FROM 
												dbo.aspnet_Roles ar
											INNER JOIN #tbRoles r 
												ON r.RoleId = ar.RoleId
											)
				IF( @TranStarted = 1 )
					ROLLBACK TRANSACTION
				RETURN(2)
			END


			DELETE FROM #tbNames WHERE 1=1
			SET @Num = 0
			SET @Pos = 1


			WHILE(@Pos <= LEN(@var_UserNames))
			BEGIN
				SELECT @NextPos = CHARINDEX(N',', @var_UserNames,  @Pos)
				IF (@NextPos = 0 OR @NextPos IS NULL)
					SELECT @NextPos = LEN(@var_UserNames) + 1
				SELECT @Name = RTRIM(LTRIM(SUBSTRING(@var_UserNames, @Pos, @NextPos - @Pos)))
				SELECT @Pos = @NextPos+1

				INSERT INTO #tbNames VALUES (@Name)
				SET @Num = @Num + 1
			END

			INSERT INTO #tbUsers
			SELECT 
				UserId
			FROM   
				dbo.aspnet_Users ar
			INNER JOIN #tbNames t
				ON LOWER(t.Name) = ar.LoweredUserName
			WHERE
				ar.ApplicationId = @AppId

			SELECT @CountU = @@ROWCOUNT
			IF (@CountU <> @Num)
			BEGIN
				SELECT TOP 1 Name, N''
				FROM   #tbNames
				WHERE  LOWER(Name) NOT IN (
											SELECT 
												au.LoweredUserName 
											FROM 
												dbo.aspnet_Users au
											INNER JOIN #tbUsers u
												ON u.UserId = au.UserId
											)

				IF( @TranStarted = 1 )
					ROLLBACK TRANSACTION
				RETURN(1)
			END

			SELECT  
				@CountAll = COUNT(*)
			FROM	
				dbo.aspnet_UsersInRoles ur
			INNER JOIN #tbUsers u
				ON ur.UserId = u.UserId
			INNER JOIN #tbRoles r
				ON ur.RoleId = r.RoleId

			IF (@CountAll <> @CountU * @CountR)
			BEGIN
				SELECT TOP 1 UserName, RoleName
				FROM		 #tbUsers tu, #tbRoles tr, dbo.aspnet_Users u, dbo.aspnet_Roles r
				WHERE		 u.UserId = tu.UserId AND r.RoleId = tr.RoleId AND
							 tu.UserId NOT IN (SELECT ur.UserId FROM dbo.aspnet_UsersInRoles ur WHERE ur.RoleId = tr.RoleId) AND
							 tr.RoleId NOT IN (SELECT ur.RoleId FROM dbo.aspnet_UsersInRoles ur WHERE ur.UserId = tu.UserId)

				IF( @TranStarted = 1 )
					ROLLBACK TRANSACTION
				RETURN(3)
			END

			DELETE FROM dbo.aspnet_UsersInRoles
			WHERE UserId IN (SELECT UserId FROM #tbUsers)
			  AND RoleId IN (SELECT RoleId FROM #tbRoles)
			IF( @TranStarted = 1 )
				COMMIT TRANSACTION

			RETURN(0)

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end
						
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END

 -- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters

 SET @var_divisionFK = @divisionFK; SET @var_weekEnding = @weekEnding  ;set @var_weekStarting =  @weekStarting

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL         
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)        
        
    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
