  SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)        
        
        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)        
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK        
        
        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()        
    --END        
         
 SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);        
 SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails        
 ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;        
 INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()        
         
 WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3        
 BEGIN         
  BEGIN TRY           
        
   -- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start        
        
      
   IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#tblDivisions') IS NOT NULL        
    DROP TABLE #tblDivisions        
        
   SELECT DISTINCT         
   DivisionPK,        
   CustomerFK,        
   DivisionName        
   INTO #tblDivisions        
   FROM tblDivisions        
   WHERE DivisionPK = @var_divisionFK        
        
   Declare @divisionName nvarchar(200)        
        
   Select @divisionName = DivisionName from #tblDivisions        
        
   IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#tmpPalletAudit') IS NOT NULL        
    DROP TABLE #tmpPalletAudit                    
            
   --pallet audit        
   SELECT EventTypeFK, StockItemFK, EventFK, PalletFK, EventDate, BuildingunitFK, DivisionFK,
   cat.StockItemCategory
   INTO #tmpPalletAudit         
   FROM tblPalletAudit AS PA        
   INNER JOIN tblStockItems AS SIS on SIS.StockItemPK = PA.StockItemFK AND DivisionFK = @var_divisionFK        
   left Join tblstockitemcategories as cat on cat.StockItemCategoryPK=SIS.StockItemCategoryFK
   WHERE eventTypeFk in (1,2,3,16)        
   --and EventDate between dateadd(day, -6, @var_weekEnding) and dateadd(day, 1, @var_weekEnding)        
   and (EventDate >= ( @var_weekStarting) and EventDate <= (@var_weekEnding)  )    
  -- select * from #tmpPalletAudit        
        
   IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#TmpContainerOutLines') IS NOT NULL        
    DROP TABLE #TmpContainerOutLines         
        
   --container out lines        
   SELECT distinct ContainerOutLinePK, ContainerOutFK         INTO #TmpContainerOutLines        
   FROM tblContainerOutLines        
   INNER JOIN tblContainerOuts ON containeroutfk = containeroutpk and ContainerOutStatusFK = 5 /*Complete*/--    
   and (CollectionDate >= ( @var_weekStarting) and CollectionDate <= (@var_weekEnding))    
   WHERE divisionfk = @var_divisionFK        
  -- select * from #TmpContainerOutLines        
        
   IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#TmpContainerOuts') IS NOT NULL        
    DROP TABLE #TmpContainerOuts        
        
   --container outs        
   SELECT distinct ContainerOutPK, GoodsOrderNumber, Address1, DocketValue1, DocketValue2, DocketValue3, Docketlabel1, Docketlabel2, Docketlabel3        
   INTO #TmpContainerOuts        
   FROM tblContainerOuts        
   WHERE containeroutPK in (select containeroutfk from #TmpContainerOutLines) and (CollectionDate >= ( @var_weekStarting) and CollectionDate <= (@var_weekEnding)  )    
   --select * from #TmpContainerOuts        
        
   IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#tblcontaineroutlinepalletcontent') IS NOT NULL        
    DROP TABLE #tblcontaineroutlinepalletcontent        
        
   SELECT DISTINCT        
   containeroutlinepalletcontentpk,        
   Units,        
   containeroutlinefk,        
   palletfk        
   INTO #tblcontaineroutlinepalletcontent        
   FROM #TmpContainerOutLines AS cOLi         
   Inner Join tblcontaineroutlinepalletcontent AS colpc         
   on cOLi.containeroutlinepk = colpc.containeroutlinefk         
        
   IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#tblWorksOrderMovements') IS NOT NULL        
    DROP TABLE #tblWorksOrderMovements        
        
   SELECT DISTINCT woms.ContainerOutLinePalletContentFK, WorksOrderStatusFK, SourcelocationFK, sourceLocationTypeFK        
   INTO #tblWorksOrderMovements        
   FROM #tblContainerOutLinePalletContent AS cOPal         
   INNER JOIN tblWorksOrderMovements AS woms         
   ON woms.ContainerOutLinePalletContentFK = cOPal.ContainerOutLinePalletContentPK        
   WHERE woms.WorksOrderStatusFK NOT IN (5,6)        
        
   IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#tblWorksOrders') IS NOT NULL        
    DROP TABLE #tblWorksOrders        
        
   select distinct        
   wos.WorksOrderPK,        
   wos.FK        
   into #tblWorksOrders        
   from #tmpPalletAudit AS pa        
   inner join tblWorksOrders AS wos         
   on wos.WorksOrderPK = pa.EventFK        
   Where pa.EventTypeFK = 16        
        
   IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#tblStockInLines') IS NOT NULL        
    DROP TABLE #tblStockInLines         
           
   select distinct        
   sils.StockInLinePK,        
   sils.StockInFK,        
   sils.StockItemFK,        
   sils.units,        
   silp.palletfk        
   into #tblStockInLines        
   from #tmpPalletAudit as pa        
   inner join tblstockinlinepallets silp on pa.palletfk = silp.palletfk and pa.eventtypefk = 1        
   inner join tblStockInLines AS sils on sils.StockInLinePK = silp.StockInLineFK              
        
   IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#tblStockItems') IS NOT NULL        
    DROP TABLE #tblStockItems        
        
   SELECT DISTINCT SI.StockItemPK, SI.DivisionFK ,cat.StockItemCategory        
   INTO #tblStockItems        
   from tblStockItems AS SI        
   INNER JOIN #tmpPalletAudit AS PA    

   ON SI.StockItemPK = PA.StockItemFK        
    left Join tblstockitemcategories as cat on cat.StockItemCategoryPK=SI.StockItemCategoryFK    
   IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#days') IS NOT NULL        
    DROP TABLE #days         
        
   Select        
   Convert(varchar(50), @var_weekStarting) AS [StartDate],   
   ( @var_weekStarting) AS [StartDisplayDate],        
   datename(weekday,dateadd(dd,-6,@var_weekStarting)) AS [StartDayName] ,    
   Convert(varchar(50), @var_weekEnding) AS [EndDate],        
  ( @var_weekEnding) AS [EndDisplayDate],        
   datename(weekday,dateadd(dd,-6,@var_weekEnding)) AS [EndDayName]        
 INTO #days        
   UNION        
   Select       
     Convert(varchar(50),  @var_weekStarting)AS [StartDate],        
  (@var_weekStarting) AS [StartDisplayDate],        
   datename(weekday,dateadd(dd,-5,@var_weekStarting)) AS [StartDayName]   ,    
   Convert(varchar(50),  @var_weekEnding) AS [EndDate],        
   ( @var_weekEnding) AS [EndDisplayDate],        
   datename(weekday,dateadd(dd,-5,@var_weekEnding)) AS [EndDayName]        
         
   IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#Bunit') IS NOT NULL        
    DROP TABLE #Bunit        
        
   Select DISTINCT        
   CASE WHEN sourceLocationTypeFK = 1 THEN         
   vbus.BuildingUnitFK        
   WHEN sourceLocationTypeFK = 2 THEN         
   lBay.BuildingUnitFK        
   WHEN sourceLocationTypeFK = 3 THEN        
   lset.BuildingUnitFK        
   WHEN sourceLocationTypeFK = 6 THEN        
   lSam.BuildingUnitFK        
   WHEN sourceLocationTypeFK = 8 THEN        
   lFloor.BuildingUnitFK        
   END as BuildingUnitFK,        
   ContainerOutLineFK        
   INTO #Bunit        
   from         
   #TmpContainerOuts AS cOuts        
   INNER JOIN #TmpContainerOutLines AS cOLi         
   on ContainerOutPK  = ContainerOutFK        
   INNER JOIN #tblContainerOutLinePalletContent AS cOPal         
   on ContainerOutLineFK = ContainerOutLinePK         
   INNER JOIN #tblWorksOrderMovements AS woms         
   ON woms.ContainerOutLinePalletContentFK = cOPal.ContainerOutLinePalletContentPK        
   LEFT OUTER JOIN viewBuildingUnitBays AS vbus         
   on vbus.BuildingUnitBayPK = SourcelocationFK         
   LEFT OUTER JOIN tblLoadingBays AS lBay         
   ON lBay.loadingBayPK = SourceLocationFK         
   LEFT OUTER JOIN tblSetDownAreas AS lSet         
   ON lSEt.SetdownareaPK = SourceLocationFK         
   LEFT OUTER JOIN tblSampleLocations AS lSam         
   ON lSam.SampleLocationPK = sourceLocationFK        
   LEFT OUTER JOIN tblFloorLocations AS lFloor         
   on  lFloor.Floorlocationpk = sourceLocationFK        
   where         
   WorksOrderStatusFK not in (5,6)        
        
   IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#buildings') IS NOT NULL        
    DROP TABLE #buildings        
        
   Select distinct        
   BuildingName + ' - ' + BuildingUnit as Building,        
   BuildingUnitPK        
   into #buildings        
   FROM tblBuildingUnits         
   INNER JOIN tblBuildings         
   on BuildingPK = BuildingFK        
        
   IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#BuildingUnitCount') IS NOT NULL        
    DROP TABLE #BuildingUnitCount        
        
   select Count(*) as detailsCount, containerOutFK         
   into #BuildingUnitCount        
   from #TmpContainerOuts        
   INNER JOIN tblStockOrders         
   ON containerOutFK = ContainerOutPK         
   Group by containeroutfk        
        
   IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#palletsOutPA') IS NOT NULL        
    DROP TABLE #palletsOutPA        
           
   Select 1 AS PalletsOut,buildingunitfk, PalletFK, EventFK        
   into #palletsOutPA        
   from #tmpPalletAudit AS PA        
   INNER JOIN #TmpContainerOutLines AS TCOL        
   ON PA.EventFK = TCOL.ContainerOutLinePK        
   Where EventTypeFK = 2        
   Group By buildingunitfk, EventFK, PalletFK        
        
   IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#tblstockorders') IS NOT NULL        
    DROP TABLE #tblstockorders        
        
   SELECT DISTINCT        
   responsibleBuildingUnitFK, containerOutFK        
   INTO #tblstockorders        
   from tblstockorders AS SO        
   INNER JOIN #TmpContainerOuts AS TCO        
   ON SO.containerOutFK = TCO.containeroutPk        
        
   IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#tblStockIns') IS NOT NULL        
    DROP TABLE #tblStockIns        
        
   SELECT DISTINCT        
  sins.StockInPK,        
   sins.ContainerInFK        
   INTO #tblStockIns        
   FROM tblStockIns AS sins        
   INNER JOIN #tblStockInLines AS sils        
   ON sins.StockInPK = sils.StockInFK        
           
   IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#tblContainerIns') IS NOT NULL        
    DROP TABLE #tblContainerIns        
        
   SELECT DISTINCT         
   cIns.ContainerInPK,        
   cIns.SupplierFK,        
   cIns.BuildingUnitFK,        
   cIns.StockInStatusFK,        
   cIns.GoodsInNumber,        
   cIns.Free1,        
   cIns.Free2,        
 cIns.Free3,        
   cIns.Free4,        
   cIns.ExternalReference,        
   CASE WHEN ISNULL(cIns.StockInGroupFK, -1) > 0 THEN 'G-' + CAST(cIns.StockInGroupFK AS NVARCHAR(50)) ELSE '' END AS StockInGroupNumber        
   INTO #tblContainerIns        
   FROM tblContainerIns as cIns         
   INNER JOIN #tblStockIns AS sins        
   on  cIns.ContainerInPK = sins.ContainerInFK        
        
   IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#palletsabsorbed') IS NOT NULL        
    DROP TABLE #palletsabsorbed        
                     
   Select count(*) AS pallets, pa.PalletFK, pa.StockItemFK, wos.FK         
   into #palletsabsorbed        
   from #tmpPalletAudit AS pa         
   inner join #tblWorksOrders AS wos         
   on wos.WorksOrderPK = EventFK        
   inner join #tblStockInLines as sils        
   on pa.StockItemFK = sils.StockItemFK        
   inner join #tblStockIns as sins        
   on wos.FK = sins.StockInPK         
   Where EventTypeFK = 16        
   Group By pa.PalletFK, pa.StockItemFK, wos.FK              
        
   IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#cdis') IS NOT NULL        
    DROP TABLE #cdis        
        
   select DISTINCT cdis.Customerfk, cdis.CustomerDocketIdentificationPK, cdis.FieldFK, cdis.Prefix, cdis.Field2FK, cdis.Prefix2         
   into #cdis        
   from tblCustomerDocketIdentifications as cdis        
   inner join #tblDivisions as div        
   on cdis.CustomerFK = div.CustomerFK        
   where DocketTypeFK = 1        
        
   IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#tmpPalletAuditEventTypeFK1') IS NOT NULL        
    DROP TABLE #tmpPalletAuditEventTypeFK1        
        
   Select         
   *         
   INTO #tmpPalletAuditEventTypeFK1        
   from #tmpPalletAudit         
   Where EventTypeFK = 1        
        
   IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#subq') IS NOT NULL        
    DROP TABLE #subq        
        
   select         
    tbus.Building, cIns.GoodsInNumber, suppliers.Supplier AS Party3, sum(sils.units) AS UnitsIn,         
    count(distinct sils.palletfk) - isnull(sum(PalletsAbsorbed.pallets), 0) AS PalletsIn, 1 as DetailsCount, Convert(varchar(50), EventDate ,111) AS EventDate,        
    case when cdis.CustomerDocketIdentificationPK is null then         
     CASE WHEN  cins.ExternalReference <> '' THEN 'External Reference: '  + cins.ExternalReference ELSE ' ' end          
    else        
     case cdis.FieldFK when 1 then        
      case when LEN(cins.Free1) > 0 THEN         
      cdis.Prefix + ' ' + cins.Free1 END        
     when 2 then        
      case WHEN LEN(cins.Free2) > 0 THEN         
      cdis.Prefix + ' ' + cins.Free2 END         
     when 3 then        
      CASE WHEN LEN(cins.Free3) > 0 THEN         
      cdis.Prefix + ' ' + cins.Free3 END        
     when 4 then        
      CASE WHEN LEN(cins.Free4) > 0 THEN         
      cdis.Prefix + ' ' + cins.Free4 END        
     end        
     + ' ' +        
     case cdis.Field2FK when 1 then        
      cdis.Prefix2 + ' ' + cins.Free1        
     when 2 then        
      cdis.Prefix2 + ' ' + cins.Free2        
     when 3 then        
      cdis.Prefix2 + ' ' + cins.Free3        
     when 4 then        
      cdis.Prefix2 + ' ' + cins.Free4        
     else        
      ''        
     end        
    End as ID,        
    cIns.StockInGroupNumber,
	sis.StockItemCategory
   INTO         
    #subq        
   from         
    #tmpPalletAuditEventTypeFK1 as pa        
   inner join #tblStockItems sis         
    on sis.StockItemPK = pa.StockItemFK         
    AND sis.DivisionFK = @var_divisionFK        
   inner join #tblStockInLines sils         
    on sils.palletfk = pa.palletfk        
   inner join #tblDivisions div         
    ON div.DivisionPK = sis.DivisionFK        
   left outer join #cdis as cdis        
    on cdis.CustomerFK = div.CustomerFK        
   inner join #tblStockIns as sins        
    on  sins.StockInPK = sils.StockInFK        
   inner join #tblContainerIns as cIns         
    on  cIns.ContainerInPK = sins.ContainerInFK        
   left outer join tblSuppliers as suppliers         
    on suppliers.SupplierPK = cIns.SupplierFK        
   left outer join #buildings as tbus         
    on tbus.BuildingUnitPK = cIns.BuildingUnitFK        
   left outer join #palletsabsorbed as palletsabsorbed         
    on palletsabsorbed.StockItemFK = sils.StockItemFK         
    AND palletsabsorbed.FK = sins.StockInPK         
    AND palletsabsorbed.PalletFK = pa.PalletFK 

   WHERE         
    cins.StockInStatusFK <> 1 /*Not OnRoute*/     
    and      (EventDate >= ( @var_weekStarting) or EventDate <= (@var_weekEnding)   )  
   group by         
    tbus.Building, cIns.GoodsInNumber, EventDate, suppliers.Supplier, cdis.FieldFK, cdis.Prefix,         
    cIns.Free1, cIns.Free3, cIns.Free2, cIns.Free4, cdis.Field2FK, cdis.Prefix2, CustomerDocketIdentificationPK, cIns.ExternalReference, cIns.StockInGroupNumber        
       , sis.StockItemCategory
   IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#palletsIn') IS NOT NULL        
    DROP TABLE #palletsIn        
        
   select         
    Building, GoodsInNumber, Party3, sum(UnitsIn) AS UnitsIn, sum(palletsin) AS PalletsIn, DetailsCount, EventDate, ID, StockInGroupNumber        
   ,StockItemCategory
   INTO        
    #palletsIn         
   from         
    #subq AS subq        
    --INNER JOIN #days AS [days]        
   -- on subq.EventDate = [days].[StartDate]  and   subq.EventDate = [days].[EndDate]    
    where  EventDate >= ( @var_weekStarting) or EventDate <= (@var_weekEnding)     
   group by         
    Building, GoodsInNumber, Party3, DetailsCount, EventDate, ID, StockInGroupNumber,StockItemCategory        
            
   IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#pta') IS NOT NULL        
    DROP TABLE #pta             
                     
   select distinct pa.PalletFK, pa.EventFK, pa.EventDate, pa.StockItemFK         
   into #pta        
   from #tmpPalletAudit AS pa         
   inner join #TmpContainerOutLines AS cOutLines        
   on pa.EventFK = cOutLines.ContainerOutLinePK        
   where pa.EventTypeFK = 3        
           
   IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#palAu') IS NOT NULL        
    DROP TABLE #palAu         
        
   Select DISTINCT pa.EventFK, pa.BuildingunitFK, pa.palletfk         
   INTO #palAu        
   FROM #TmpContainerOutLines as cOLi         
   Inner Join #tblcontaineroutlinepalletcontent AS colpc         
   on cOLi.containeroutlinepk = colpc.containeroutlinefk                                           
   INNER JOIN #tmpPalletAudit as pa         
   on pa.EventFK = ContainerOutLinePK         
   and pa.palletfk = colpc.palletfk                    
   Where pa.EventTypeFK = 3          
          
   IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#docketOut') IS NOT NULL        
    DROP TABLE #docketOut        
        
   Select  distinct         
    colpc.containeroutlinepalletcontentpk,         
    colpc.Units,        
    ContainerOutPK,         
    CASE WHEN bEvent.BuildingUnitPK is null THEN BuWoms.Building ELSE bEvent.Building END as Building,        
    CASE WHEN bEvent.BuildingUnitPK is null THEN BuWoms.BuildingUnitPK ELSE bEvent.BuildingUnitPK END as BuildingUnitFK        
   into        
    #docketOut        
   from         
    #TmpContainerOuts as cOuts        
   INNER JOIN #TmpContainerOutLines as cOLi         
    on ContaineroutPK  = ContainerOutFK        
   Inner Join #tblcontaineroutlinepalletcontent AS colpc         
    on cOLi.containeroutlinepk = colpc.containeroutlinefk                                           
   INNER JOIN #palAu as palAu         
    on palAu.EventFK = ContainerOutLinePK         
    and palau.palletfk = colpc.palletfk           LEFT OUTER JOIN #buildings as bEvent        
    ON bEvent.BuildingUnitPK = palAu.BuildingUnitFK        
   -- Get the building unitthrough the WorksOrderMovement         
   LEFT OUTER JOIN #Bunit AS Bunit        
    ON Bunit.ContaineroutLineFK = cOLi.containerOutLinePK        
   -- Get The BuildingName and Unit for the WOMS        
   LEFT OUTER JOIN #buildings as buWoms        
    ON buWoms.BuildingUnitPK = Bunit.BuildingUnitFK          
                  
   IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#UnitsOut') IS NOT NULL        
    DROP TABLE #UnitsOut         
        
   select sum (Units) as UnitsOut, docketOut.ContainerOutPK, Building, BuildingUnitFK        
   INTO #UnitsOut        
   FROM #docketOut as docketOut        
   inner join #TmpContainerOuts as cOuts         
   ON docketOut.ContainerOutPK = cOuts.ContainerOutPK        
   INNER JOIN #tblStockOrders as stkOr         
   ON stkOr.ContainerOutFK = cOuts.ContainerOutPK      
   AND docketOut.BuildingUnitFK = stkOr.responsibleBuildingUnitFK --zxc        
   group by docketOut.ContainerOutPK , Building, BuildingUnitFK        
           
   IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#palletBuilding') IS NOT NULL        
    DROP TABLE #palletBuilding        
           
   select         
    containerOutPK , sum(palletsOut) as PalletsOut ,        
    case         
     when buildingunitfk = -1 then (select TOP 1         
              responsibleBuildingUnitFK         
             from         
              #tblstockorders         
             where         
              containeroutPk = containerOutFK)         
     ELSE         
      BuildingUnitFK         
    END as buildingUnitFK        
   into        
    #palletBuilding        
   from         
    #TmpContainerOuts                
   inner join #TmpContainerOutLines cOutLines         
    ON cOutLines.ContaineroutFK = ContainerOutPK        
   left outer join #palletsOutPA AS palletsOutPA        
    on palletsOutPA.EventFK = cOutLines.ContainerOutLinePK        
   group by         
    containerOutPK, buildingunitfk         
           
   IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#palletsOut') IS NOT NULL        
    DROP TABLE #palletsOut             
              
   SELECT         
    palletBuilding.containerOutPK , palletBuilding.BuildingUnitFK, sum(palletBuilding.palletsOut) as PalletsOut         
   INTO        
    #palletsOut        
   FROM         
    #palletBuilding as palletBuilding        
   inner join #TmpContainerOuts as cOuts         
    ON palletBuilding.ContainerOutPK = cOuts.ContainerOutPK        
   INNER JOIN #tblStockOrders as stkOr         
    ON stkOr.ContainerOutFK = cOuts.ContainerOutPK         
    AND palletBuilding.BuildingUnitFK = stkOr.responsibleBuildingUnitFK                         
   group by         
    palletBuilding.containeroutPK , BuildingUnitFK         
             
   IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#palletsOut2') IS NOT NULL        
    DROP TABLE #palletsOut2              
            
   select         
    Building ,cOuts.GoodsOrderNumber as GoodsOrderNumber, cOuts.Address1 as Party3, UnitsOut,         
    CASE WHEN PalletsOut is null then 0 ELSE PalletsOut END as PalletsOut, DetailsCount,         
    Convert(varchar(50), pta.EventDate ,111) as EventDate,        
    case when cdis.CustomerDocketIdentificationPK is null then         
     (case when cOuts.Docketlabel1 <> '' THEN cOuts.Docketlabel1 + ': ' + cOuts.DocketValue1 else ''end + ' ' +        
     case when cOuts.Docketlabel2 <> '' THEN cOuts.Docketlabel2 + ': ' + cOuts.DocketValue2  else '' end + ' ' +        
     case when cOuts.Docketlabel3 <> '' THEN cOuts.Docketlabel3 + ': ' + cOuts.DocketValue3 else '' end )         
    else        
     case cdis.FieldFK when 40 then        
      cdis.Prefix + ' ' + cOuts.DocketValue1        
     when 2 then        
      cdis.Prefix + ' ' + cOuts.DocketValue2        
     when 2 then        
      cdis.Prefix + ' ' + cOuts.DocketValue3        
     end        
    End as ID ,
	si.StockItemCategory
   into        
    #palletsOut2        
   from        
    #TmpContainerOutLines AS cOutLines     
   inner join #pta as pta         
    on pta.EventFK = cOutLines.ContainerOutLinePK        
   inner join #TmpContainerOuts as cOuts         
    on cOuts.ContainerOutPK = cOutLines.ContainerOutFK        
   INNER JOIN #tblStockOrders as stkOr         
    ON stkOr.ContainerOutFK = cOuts.ContainerOutPK              
   inner join #tblDivisions as div         
    ON div.DivisionPK = @var_divisionFK        
   inner join #tblStockItems as si         
    on si.StockItemPK = pta.StockItemfK        
   -- Retrieve the Units for Goods Out per buildingUnit        
   LEFT OUTER JOIN #UnitsOut AS UnitsOut        
    ON UnitsOut.ContainerOutPK = cOuts.ContainerOutPK        
    AND UnitsOut.BuildingUnitFK = stkOr.responsibleBuildingUnitFK --zxc        
   -- Retrieve the Pallet Count for Goods Out per buildingUnit        
   LEFT OUTER JOIN #palletsOut As palletsOut         
    ON palletsOut.ContainerOutPK = cOuts.ContainerOutPK        
    AND palletsOut.BuildingUnitFK = stkOr.responsibleBuildingUnitFK                 
   -- Count how many building Units the GoodsOrder is spread over        
   LEFT OUTER JOIN #BuildingUnitCount as BuildingUnitCount        
    ON BuildingUnitCount.ContainerOutFK = cOuts.ContainerOutPK        
   left outer join tblCustomerDocketIdentifications cdis         
    on cdis.CustomerFK = div.CustomerFK        
    AND cdis.DocketTypeFK = 2 /*ContainerOut*/ 
	   --Left Join tblstockitemcategories as cat on cat.CustomerFK=si.CustomerFK
   group by         
    cOuts.GoodsOrderNumber, Building , cOuts.Address1, EventDate, palletsOut, unitsout, detailsCount, CustomerDocketIdentificationPK, docketvalue1,         
    docketValue2, docketvalue3, Docketlabel1, Docketlabel2,Docketlabel3, FieldFK,Prefix,StockItemCategory         
                                                                                                           
   ------------------------------------------        
   -- Return the final results to the report        
   ------------------------------------------         
        
   Select         
   -- Building,[days].*, 'Receipts' AS [Type], 'Supplier' AS Party3Type,       
   Building, 'Receipts' AS [Type], 'Supplier' AS Party3Type,       
 case when palletsIn.StockInGroupNumber !=''       
 then      
 palletsIn.GoodsInNumber +' ( '+ palletsIn.StockInGroupNumber +' )'      
 else      
 palletsIn.GoodsInNumber       
 end AS [DocketNumber],      
       
 Party3,palletsIn.UnitsIn AS Units,         
    palletsIn.PalletsIn AS PalletsIn, 0 as PalletsOut, DetailsCount, ID, EventDate AS Eventdate, @divisionName AS DivisionName, palletsIn.StockInGroupNumber        
  , DATEADD(DAY, 7 - DATEPART(WEEKDAY, EventDate), CAST(EventDate AS DATE)) [WeekEnd]    
  ,DATENAME(WEEKDAY, EventDate) AS [ Day Name ]  
 ,StockItemCategory
  from         
   -- #days as [days]        
   --left outer join     
   #palletsIn as palletsIn         
    --on palletsIn.EventDate = [days].[StartDate]     
    --and   palletsIn.EventDate = [days].[EndDate]    
             --where [days].[StartDate] >= ( @var_weekStarting) or [days].[EndDate] <= (@var_weekEnding)     
   UNION         
            
        
    
   Select         
    --Building, [days].*, 'Dispatches', 'Consignee' Party3Type, palletsOut.GoodsOrderNumber, Party3,palletsOut.UnitsOut,         
    Building, 'Dispatches', 'Consignee' Party3Type, palletsOut.GoodsOrderNumber, Party3,palletsOut.UnitsOut,         
    0 as PalletsIn, palletsOut.PalletsOut as PalletsOut, DetailsCount, ID, EventDate AS WeekEnding, @divisionName AS DivisionName, '' as StockInGroupNumber        
  , DATEADD(DAY, 7 - DATEPART(WEEKDAY, EventDate), CAST(EventDate AS DATE)) [WeekEnd]    
  ,DATENAME(WEEKDAY, EventDate) AS [ Day Name ]
   ,StockItemCategory
  from         
  --  #days as [days]        
 --  left outer join    
   #palletsOut2 AS palletsOut         
   -- on palletsOut.EventDate = [days].[StartDate]  and    palletsOut.EventDate = [days].[EndDate]    
    --where [days].[StartDate] >= ( @var_weekStarting) or [days].[EndDate] <= (@var_weekEnding)     
    
   ORDER BY         
     [Type] DESC, DocketNumber ASC        
    
           
   -- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end        
        
   BREAK        
  END TRY        
  BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */        
   DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;        
   SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;        
   SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;        
        
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY         
   BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;        
               
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;        
        
            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID        
     
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;        
                    
   IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)        
   BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END        
   ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */        
  END CATCH        
  SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1        
 END        
END 
GO

 SET @var_divisionFK = @divisionFK; SET @var_weekEnding = @weekEnding  ;set @var_weekStarting =  @weekStarting  
 SET @ParameterDetails = '@divisionFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_divisionFK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@weekEnding = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_weekEnding AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'')  + ',@weekStarting = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_weekStarting AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'')      
       
    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL       
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)      
      
    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)      
    --BEGIN      
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC       
      
  SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)      
      
        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)      
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK      
      
        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()      
    --END      
       
 SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);      
 SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails      
 ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;      
 INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()      
       
 WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3      
 BEGIN       
  BEGIN TRY         
      
   -- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start      
      
    
   IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#tblDivisions') IS NOT NULL

   CustomerFK,      
   DivisionName      
   INTO #tblDivisions      
   FROM tblDivisions      
   WHERE DivisionPK = @var_divisionFK      
      
   Declare @divisionName nvarchar(200)      
      
   Select @divisionName = DivisionName from #tblDivisions      
      
   IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#tmpPalletAudit') IS NOT NULL

   --pallet audit      
   SELECT EventTypeFK, StockItemFK, EventFK, PalletFK, EventDate, BuildingunitFK, DivisionFK      
   INTO #tmpPalletAudit

   INNER JOIN tblStockItems AS SIS on SIS.StockItemPK = PA.StockItemFK AND DivisionFK = @var_divisionFK

   --and EventDate between dateadd(day, -6, @var_weekEnding) and dateadd(day, 1, @var_weekEnding)

   INNER JOIN tblContainerOuts ON containeroutfk = containeroutpk and ContainerOutStatusFK = 5 /*Complete*/--

  ( @var_weekEnding) AS [EndDisplayDate],      
   datename(weekday,dateadd(dd,-6,@var_weekEnding)) AS [EndDayName]      
 INTO #days      
   UNION      
   Select     
     Convert(varchar(50),  @var_weekStarting)AS [StartDate],      
  (@var_weekStarting) AS [StartDisplayDate],      
   datename(weekday,dateadd(dd,-5,@var_weekStarting)) AS [StartDayName]   ,  
   Convert(varchar(50),  @var_weekEnding) AS [EndDate],      
   ( @var_weekEnding) AS [EndDisplayDate],      
   datename(weekday,dateadd(dd,-5,@var_weekEnding)) AS [EndDayName]      
       
   IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#Bunit') IS NOT NULL

   vbus.BuildingUnitFK      
   WHEN sourceLocationTypeFK = 2 THEN       
   lBay.BuildingUnitFK      
   WHEN sourceLocationTypeFK = 3 THEN      
   lset.BuildingUnitFK      
   WHEN sourceLocationTypeFK = 6 THEN      
   lSam.BuildingUnitFK      
   WHEN sourceLocationTypeFK = 8 THEN

   END as BuildingUnitFK,      
   ContainerOutLineFK      
   INTO #Bunit      
   from

   INNER JOIN #TmpContainerOutLines AS cOLi       
   on ContainerOutPK  = ContainerOutFK      
   INNER JOIN #tblContainerOutLinePalletContent AS cOPal       
   on ContainerOutLineFK = ContainerOutLinePK       
   INNER JOIN #tblWorksOrderMovements AS woms       
   ON woms.ContainerOutLinePalletContentFK = cOPal.ContainerOutLinePalletContentPK

   LEFT OUTER JOIN tblSetDownAreas AS lSet

   LEFT OUTER JOIN tblSampleLocations AS lSam       
   ON lSam.SampleLocationPK = sourceLocationFK      
   LEFT OUTER JOIN tblFloorLocations AS lFloor       
   on  lFloor.Floorlocationpk = sourceLocationFK      
   where       
   WorksOrderStatusFK not in (5,6)      
      
   IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#buildings') IS NOT NULL      
    DROP TABLE #buildings      
      
   Select distinct      
   BuildingName + ' - ' + BuildingUnit as Building,      
   BuildingUnitPK      
   into #buildings      
   FROM tblBuildingUnits       
   INNER JOIN tblBuildings       
   on BuildingPK = BuildingFK      
      
   IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#BuildingUnitCount') IS NOT NULL      
    DROP TABLE #BuildingUnitCount      
      
   select Count(*) as detailsCount, containerOutFK       
   into #BuildingUnitCount

   IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#palletsOutPA') IS NOT NULL

   Where EventTypeFK = 2

   IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#tblStockIns') IS NOT NULL

   FROM tblStockIns AS sins

   ON sins.StockInPK = sils.StockInFK      
         
   IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#tblContainerIns') IS NOT NULL

 cIns.Free3,

   from #tmpPalletAudit AS pa       
   inner join #tblWorksOrders AS wos

   Where EventTypeFK = 16      
   Group By pa.PalletFK, pa.StockItemFK, wos.FK            
      
   IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#cdis') IS NOT NULL

     end

   INTO

   WHERE

    and      (EventDate >= ( @var_weekStarting) or EventDate <= (@var_weekEnding)   )
   group by

    cIns.Free1, cIns.Free3, cIns.Free2, cIns.Free4, cdis.Field2FK, cdis.Prefix2, CustomerDocketIdentificationPK, cIns.ExternalReference, cIns.StockInGroupNumber      
      
   IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#palletsIn') IS NOT NULL      
    DROP TABLE #palletsIn      
      
   select       
    Building, GoodsInNumber, Party3, sum(UnitsIn) AS UnitsIn, sum(palletsin) AS PalletsIn, DetailsCount, EventDate, ID, StockInGroupNumber      
   INTO      
    #palletsIn       
   from       
    #subq AS subq      
    --INNER JOIN #days AS [days]      
   -- on subq.EventDate = [days].[StartDate]  and   subq.EventDate = [days].[EndDate]  
    where  EventDate >= ( @var_weekStarting) or EventDate <= (@var_weekEnding)   
   group by       
    Building, GoodsInNumber, Party3, DetailsCount, EventDate, ID, StockInGroupNumber      
          
   IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#pta') IS NOT NULL      
    DROP TABLE #pta           
                   
   select distinct pa.PalletFK, pa.EventFK, pa.EventDate, pa.StockItemFK       
   into #pta      
   from #tmpPalletAudit AS pa       
   inner join #TmpContainerOutLines AS cOutLines      
   on pa.EventFK = cOutLines.ContainerOutLinePK      
   where pa.EventTypeFK = 3      
         
   IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#palAu') IS NOT NULL      
    DROP TABLE #palAu       
      
   Select DISTINCT pa.EventFK, pa.BuildingunitFK, pa.palletfk       
   INTO #palAu      
   FROM #TmpContainerOutLines as cOLi       
   Inner Join #tblcontaineroutlinepalletcontent AS colpc       
   on cOLi.containeroutlinepk = colpc.containeroutlinefk                                         
   INNER JOIN #tmpPalletAudit as pa       
   on pa.EventFK = ContainerOutLinePK       
   and pa.palletfk = colpc.palletfk                  
   Where pa.EventTypeFK = 3        
        
   IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#docketOut') IS NOT NULL      
    DROP TABLE #docketOut      
      
   Select  distinct       
    colpc.containeroutlinepalletcontentpk,       
    colpc.Units,      
    ContainerOutPK,       
    CASE WHEN bEvent.BuildingUnitPK is null THEN BuWoms.Building ELSE bEvent.Building END as Building,      
    CASE WHEN bEvent.BuildingUnitPK is null THEN BuWoms.BuildingUnitPK ELSE bEvent.BuildingUnitPK END as BuildingUnitFK      
   into      
    #docketOut      
   from       
    #TmpContainerOuts as cOuts      
   INNER JOIN #TmpContainerOutLines as cOLi       
    on ContaineroutPK  = ContainerOutFK      
   Inner Join #tblcontaineroutlinepalletcontent AS colpc       
    on cOLi.containeroutlinepk = colpc.containeroutlinefk                                         
   INNER JOIN #palAu as palAu       
    on palAu.EventFK = ContainerOutLinePK       
    and palau.palletfk = colpc.palletfk      
   LEFT OUTER JOIN #buildings as bEvent      
    ON bEvent.BuildingUnitPK = palAu.BuildingUnitFK      
   -- Get the building unitthrough the WorksOrderMovement       
   LEFT OUTER JOIN #Bunit AS Bunit      
    ON Bunit.ContaineroutLineFK = cOLi.containerOutLinePK      
   -- Get The BuildingName and Unit for the WOMS      
   LEFT OUTER JOIN #buildings as buWoms      
    ON buWoms.BuildingUnitPK = Bunit.BuildingUnitFK        
                
   IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#UnitsOut') IS NOT NULL      
    DROP TABLE #UnitsOut       
      
   select sum (Units) as UnitsOut, docketOut.ContainerOutPK, Building, BuildingUnitFK      
   INTO #UnitsOut      
   FROM #docketOut as docketOut      
   inner join #TmpContainerOuts as cOuts       
   ON docketOut.ContainerOutPK = cOuts.ContainerOutPK      
   INNER JOIN #tblStockOrders as stkOr       
   ON stkOr.ContainerOutFK = cOuts.ContainerOutPK    
   AND docketOut.BuildingUnitFK = stkOr.responsibleBuildingUnitFK --zxc      
   group by docketOut.ContainerOutPK , Building, BuildingUnitFK      
         
   IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#palletBuilding') IS NOT NULL      
    DROP TABLE #palletBuilding      
         
   select       
    containerOutPK , sum(palletsOut) as PalletsOut ,      
    case       
     when buildingunitfk = -1 then (select TOP 1       
              responsibleBuildingUnitFK       
             from       
              #tblstockorders       
             where       
              containeroutPk = containerOutFK)       
     ELSE       
      BuildingUnitFK       
    END as buildingUnitFK      
   into      
    #palletBuilding      
   from       
    #TmpContainerOuts              
   inner join #TmpContainerOutLines cOutLines       
    ON cOutLines.ContaineroutFK = ContainerOutPK      
   left outer join #palletsOutPA AS palletsOutPA      
    on palletsOutPA.EventFK = cOutLines.ContainerOutLinePK      
   group by       
    containerOutPK, buildingunitfk       
         
   IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#palletsOut') IS NOT NULL      
    DROP TABLE #palletsOut           
            
   SELECT       
    palletBuilding.containerOutPK , palletBuilding.BuildingUnitFK, sum(palletBuilding.palletsOut) as PalletsOut       
   INTO      
    #palletsOut      
   FROM       
    #palletBuilding as palletBuilding      
   inner join #TmpContainerOuts as cOuts       
    ON palletBuilding.ContainerOutPK = cOuts.ContainerOutPK      
   INNER JOIN #tblStockOrders as stkOr       
    ON stkOr.ContainerOutFK = cOuts.ContainerOutPK       
    AND palletBuilding.BuildingUnitFK = stkOr.responsibleBuildingUnitFK                       
   group by       
    palletBuilding.containeroutPK , BuildingUnitFK       
           
   IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#palletsOut2') IS NOT NULL      
    DROP TABLE #palletsOut2            
          
   select       
    Building ,cOuts.GoodsOrderNumber as GoodsOrderNumber, cOuts.Address1 as Party3, UnitsOut,       
    CASE WHEN PalletsOut is null then 0 ELSE PalletsOut END as PalletsOut, DetailsCount,       
    Convert(varchar(50), pta.EventDate ,111) as EventDate,      
    case when cdis.CustomerDocketIdentificationPK is null then       
     (case when cOuts.Docketlabel1 <> '' THEN cOuts.Docketlabel1 + ': ' + cOuts.DocketValue1 else ''end + ' ' +      
     case when cOuts.Docketlabel2 <> '' THEN cOuts.Docketlabel2 + ': ' + cOuts.DocketValue2  else '' end + ' ' +      
     case when cOuts.Docketlabel3 <> '' THEN cOuts.Docketlabel3 + ': ' + cOuts.DocketValue3 else '' end )       
    else      
     case cdis.FieldFK when 40 then      
      cdis.Prefix + ' ' + cOuts.DocketValue1      
     when 2 then      
      cdis.Prefix + ' ' + cOuts.DocketValue2      
     when 2 then      
      cdis.Prefix + ' ' + cOuts.DocketValue3      
     end      
    End as ID      
   into      
    #palletsOut2      
   from      
    #TmpContainerOutLines AS cOutLines      
   inner join #pta as pta       
    on pta.EventFK = cOutLines.ContainerOutLinePK      
   inner join #TmpContainerOuts as cOuts       
    on cOuts.ContainerOutPK = cOutLines.ContainerOutFK      
   INNER JOIN #tblStockOrders as stkOr       
    ON stkOr.ContainerOutFK = cOuts.ContainerOutPK            
   inner join #tblDivisions as div       
    ON div.DivisionPK = @var_divisionFK      
   inner join #tblStockItems as si       
    on si.StockItemPK = pta.StockItemfK      
   -- Retrieve the Units for Goods Out per buildingUnit      
   LEFT OUTER JOIN #UnitsOut AS UnitsOut      
    ON UnitsOut.ContainerOutPK = cOuts.ContainerOutPK      
    AND UnitsOut.BuildingUnitFK = stkOr.responsibleBuildingUnitFK --zxc      
   -- Retrieve the Pallet Count for Goods Out per buildingUnit      
   LEFT OUTER JOIN #palletsOut As palletsOut       
    ON palletsOut.ContainerOutPK = cOuts.ContainerOutPK      
    AND palletsOut.BuildingUnitFK = stkOr.responsibleBuildingUnitFK               
   -- Count how many building Units the GoodsOrder is spread over      
   LEFT OUTER JOIN #BuildingUnitCount as BuildingUnitCount      
    ON BuildingUnitCount.ContainerOutFK = cOuts.ContainerOutPK      
   left outer join tblCustomerDocketIdentifications cdis       
    on cdis.CustomerFK = div.CustomerFK      
    AND cdis.DocketTypeFK = 2 /*ContainerOut*/      
   group by       
    cOuts.GoodsOrderNumber, Building , cOuts.Address1, EventDate, palletsOut, unitsout, detailsCount, CustomerDocketIdentificationPK, docketvalue1,       
    docketValue2, docketvalue3, Docketlabel1, Docketlabel2,Docketlabel3, FieldFK,Prefix       
                                                                                                         
   ------------------------------------------      
   -- Return the final results to the report      
   ------------------------------------------       
      
   Select       
   -- Building,[days].*, 'Receipts' AS [Type], 'Supplier' AS Party3Type,     
   Building, 'Receipts' AS [Type], 'Supplier' AS Party3Type,     
 case when palletsIn.StockInGroupNumber !=''     
 then    
 palletsIn.GoodsInNumber +' ( '+ palletsIn.StockInGroupNumber +' )'    
 else    
 palletsIn.GoodsInNumber     
 end AS [DocketNumber],    
     
 Party3,palletsIn.UnitsIn AS Units,       
    palletsIn.PalletsIn AS PalletsIn, 0 as PalletsOut, DetailsCount, ID, EventDate AS Eventdate, @divisionName AS DivisionName, palletsIn.StockInGroupNumber      
  , DATEADD(DAY, 7 - DATEPART(WEEKDAY, EventDate), CAST(EventDate AS DATE)) [WeekEnd]  
  ,DATENAME(WEEKDAY, EventDate) AS [ Day Name ]  
  from       
   -- #days as [days]      
   --left outer join   
   #palletsIn as palletsIn       
    --on palletsIn.EventDate = [days].[StartDate]   
    --and   palletsIn.EventDate = [days].[EndDate]  
             --where [days].[StartDate] >= ( @var_weekStarting) or [days].[EndDate] <= (@var_weekEnding)   
   UNION       
          
      
  
   Select       
    --Building, [days].*, 'Dispatches', 'Consignee' Party3Type, palletsOut.GoodsOrderNumber, Party3,palletsOut.UnitsOut,       
    Building, 'Dispatches', 'Consignee' Party3Type, palletsOut.GoodsOrderNumber, Party3,palletsOut.UnitsOut,       
    0 as PalletsIn, palletsOut.PalletsOut as PalletsOut, DetailsCount, ID, EventDate AS WeekEnding, @divisionName AS DivisionName, '' as StockInGroupNumber      
  , DATEADD(DAY, 7 - DATEPART(WEEKDAY, EventDate), CAST(EventDate AS DATE)) [WeekEnd]  
  ,DATENAME(WEEKDAY, EventDate) AS [ Day Name ]  
  from       
  --  #days as [days]      
 --  left outer join  
   #palletsOut2 AS palletsOut       
   -- on palletsOut.EventDate = [days].[StartDate]  and    palletsOut.EventDate = [days].[EndDate]  
    --where [days].[StartDate] >= ( @var_weekStarting) or [days].[EndDate] <= (@var_weekEnding)   
  
   ORDER BY       
     [Type] DESC, DocketNumber ASC      
  
         
   -- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end      
      
   BREAK      
  END TRY      
  BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */      
   DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;      
   SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;      
   SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;      
      
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY       
   BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;      
             
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;      
      
            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID      
   
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;      
                  
   IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)      
   BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END      
   ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */      
  END CATCH      
  SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1      
 END      
END 
GO

 SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

 SET @var_divisionFK = @divisionFK; SET @var_customerFK = @customerFK; SET @var_FK = @FK  
  
 SET @ParameterDetails = '@divisionFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_divisionFK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@customerFK = '

    --END  
  
  
 SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);  
 SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails  
 ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;

 BEGIN   
  BEGIN TRY     
  
   -- This stored procedures main code, excluding error handling - start  
  --declare @var_FK nvarchar(50) = '123_456'
  declare @containeroutfk int 
  declare @stockitemfk int 
  --split container out and stock item from parent layer
  select @containeroutfk = LEFT(@var_FK, CHARINDEX('_',@var_FK) - 1), @stockitemfk = RIGHT(@var_FK, CHARINDEX('_',REVERSE(@var_FK))-1)
  --select @containeroutfk, @stockitemfk
  
  --DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #divisions  
  -- SELECT td.DivisionPK , IntegratedStorageLocation  
  -- INTO #divisions   
  -- FROM dbo.tblDivisions td   
  -- WHERE  
  --   DivisionPK in (129)--only 1 division for this  
 -- select * from #divisions

      DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #tmpcontaineroutline  
   SELECT distinct colp.ContainerOutLinePK, colp.DivisionFK , con.Free2 , con.free3 , colp.free1,colp.batch,con.containernumber, con.SealNumber,colp.StockItemFK
   INTO #tmpcontaineroutline  
   FROM tblcontaineroutlines colp   
   INNER JOIN tblcontainerouts con ON con.containeroutpk = colp.containeroutfk  
   WHERE colp.containeroutfk =@containeroutfk and StockItemFK = @stockitemfk

--select * from #tmpcontaineroutline

   DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #tmpContainerOutLinePalletContent
   SELECT distinct colp.palletfk, colp.containeroutlinefk,colp.Units, palletcontentfk
   INTO #tmpContainerOutLinePalletContent  
   FROM tblContainerOutLinePalletContent colp   
   INNER JOIN #tmpcontaineroutline con ON con.containeroutlinepk = colp.containeroutlinefk  
  -- WHERE colp.containeroutfk =250906 
  --select * from #tmpContainerOutLinePalletContent

   --DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #stockitems  
   --SELECT distinct s.*   
   --INTO #stockitems  
   --FROM tblstockitems s  
   --INNER JOIN #tmpcontaineroutline d ON s.divisionfk = d.DivisionFK 
   --and  s.StockItemPK = d.StockItemFK
    
--select * from #stockitems 


   DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #currStock  
   Select distinct palletcontentpk, pc.PalletFK, pc.SupplierBatch ,StockItemFK--, sum(ActualUnits) ActualUnits--, CustomerBarcode  
   INTO #currStock  
   from dbo.tblPalletContent pc  
   inner join #tmpContainerOutLinePalletContent colp on colp.PalletContentFK = pc.PalletContentPK
   --  inner join #stockitems sis on sis.StockItemPK = pc.StockItemFK  

 --select * from #currStock
   
   DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #currPals  
   SELECT distinct p.PalletPK, p.PalletStatusFK, /*p.CustomerBarcode,*/ p.IsArchived, p.CustomerPalletNumber, p.Barcode  
   INTO #currPals  
   FROM tblpallets p   
   INNER JOIN #tmpContainerOutLinePalletContent pc ON pc.PalletFK = p.PalletPK  
   WHERE p.IsArchived = 0 --AND p.PalletStatusFK not in (10 /*On Route*/, 11 /*Loaded to go out*/)  

  --select * from #currPals
  
    Select distinct pals.Barcode, colp.units, pc.supplierBatch, col.batch, pals.CustomerPalletNumber PalletBarcode  
  FROM #tmpcontaineroutline col 
  inner join #tmpContainerOutLinePalletContent colp on col.containeroutlinepk = colp.containeroutlinefk 
  inner join #currStock pc on pc.PalletContentPK = colp.PalletContentFK 
  inner join tblpallets pals on pals.PalletPK = colp.palletfk 
  --Where col.ContainerOutfK = 250935-- **REPLACE**
 
   
   -- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end  
     
   BREAK  
  END TRY  
  BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */  
   DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;  
   SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;  
   SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;  
  
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY   
   BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;  
         
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;  
  
            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID  
              
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;  
              
   IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)  
   BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END  
   ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */  
  END CATCH  
  SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1  
 END  
END

-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[cust462spInventoryReconciliation] 
(
	@divisionFK int = -1,
	@customerFK int = -1,
	@FK int = -1
)
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT
 ,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;
	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	DECLARE @var_divisionFK INT, @var_customerFK INT, @var_FK INT

	SET @var_divisionFK = @divisionFK; SET @var_customerFK = @customerFK; SET @var_FK = @FK

	SET @ParameterDetails = '@divisionFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_divisionFK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@customerFK = ' 
		+ ISNULL(CAST(@var_customerFK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@FK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_FK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'')

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    --BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

		SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END


	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY			

			-- This stored procedures main code, excluding error handling - start

			DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #divisions
			SELECT td.DivisionPK , IntegratedStorageLocation
			INTO #divisions 
			FROM dbo.tblDivisions td 
			WHERE ((@var_divisionFK > 0 AND td.DivisionPK = @var_divisionFK)
				OR (@var_customerFK > 0 AND td.CustomerFK = @var_customerFK))
				AND DivisionPK in (129)--only 1 division for this

			DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #stockitems
			SELECT s.* 
			INTO #stockitems
			FROM tblstockitems s
			INNER JOIN #divisions d ON s.divisionfk = d.DivisionPK
		
			DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #currStock
			Select distinct PalletFK, StockItemFK, Batch, SupplierBatch, sum(ActualUnits) ActualUnits--, CustomerBarcode
			INTO #currStock
			from dbo.tblPalletContent pc
			inner join #stockitems sis on sis.StockItemPK = pc.StockItemFK
			Where (pc.ActualEaches > 0 OR pc.ActualUnits > 0) AND pc.IsArchived = 0
			group by PalletFK, StockItemFK, Batch, SupplierBatch-- CustomerBarcode
	
			DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #currPals
			SELECT distinct p.PalletPK, p.PalletStatusFK, /*p.CustomerBarcode,*/ p.IsArchived, p.CustomerPalletNumber, p.Barcode
			INTO #currPals
			FROM tblpallets p 
			INNER JOIN #currStock pc ON pc.PalletFK = p.PalletPK
			WHERE p.IsArchived = 0 AND p.PalletStatusFK not in (10 /*On Route*/, 11 /*Loaded to go out*/)
	
			Select distinct divs.integratedstorageLocation, --<IDB_WAREHOUSE>010</IDB_WAREHOUSE>
				format(getdate(), 'ddMMyyyy') as ReportDate, --<REPORT_DATE>07082023</REPORT_DATE>
				format(getdate(), 'HHmmss') as ReportTime, --<REPORT_TIME>010804</REPORT_TIME>
				--<LINE>
				sis.StockItemCode, --<ITEM_NUMBER>494878</ITEM_NUMBER>
				pals.Barcode,--<SERIAL_NUMBER>2695988</SERIAL_NUMBER>
				pc.supplierBatch,--<HEALTHMARK>IE1024EC</HEALTHMARK>
				pc.Batch, --<PRODUCTION_CODE>N112050</PRODUCTION_CODE>
				pc.actualunits,--<CATCH_WEIGHT>1250.00</CATCH_WEIGHT>
				case when sis.unittypefk = 8 /*bags*/ then pc.ActualUnits / case when sis.DefaultUnitsPerEach > 0 then sis.DefaultUnitsPerEach else 25 end else 1 /*bulk bag*/ end as Eaches, --<ONHAND_BALANCE>50</ONHAND_BALANCE>
				case when sis.unittypefk = 8 /*bags*/ then 'BG' else 'PAL' end as UOM,  --<UNIT_OF_MEASURE>CA</UNIT_OF_MEASURE>
				pals.CustomerPalletNumber PalletBarcode --<ORNUA_PALLET_ID>494878308523112050</ORNUA_PALLET_ID>				
			FROM #currPals pals
			inner join #currStock pc on pc.PalletFK = pals.PalletPK
			inner join #stockitems sis on sis.StockItemPK = pc.StockItemFK
			inner join #divisions divs on divs.DivisionPK = sis.DivisionFK
			ORDER BY sis.StockItemCode, pc.Batch, pals.CustomerPalletNumber
			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end
			
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END

GO

			CREATE TABLE #ResultSet(SelectedValue varchar(50))

			DECLARE @Param int

			Select @Param = StockOrderPK from tblStockOrders where ContainerOutFK = @var_containerOutPK

			INSERT INTO #ResultSet (SelectedValue)
			EXEC spStockOrderGetDeliveryNumber @Param

			SELECT @DeliveryNumber = ISNULL(SelectedValue,'') FROM #ResultSet 

			declare @_ConsigneeNo varchar(50)
			declare @ConsigneeNo varchar(50)

			--declare @Var_SupplierBatch varchar(50)
			select @_ConsigneeNo = ISNULL(CustomerFK,'-1') from tblDeliveryAddresses where DeliveryAddressPK=(select DeliveryAddressFK 
			from tblContainerOuts where ContainerOutPK=@var_containerOutPK)

			if (@_ConsigneeNo = '-1' ) 
			begin
				select @ConsigneeNo = isnull(CustomerCode,'') from tblCustomers where CustomerPK = @_ConsigneeNo
			end

			--select @Var_SupplierBatch = isnull(SupplierBatch, '') from tblPalletContent where SupplierBatch = @Var_SupplierBatch
			 Declare @customerFK int
			   
			 Select top 1 @customerFK = CustomerFK from tblContainerOutLines cols inner join tblDivisions divs on divs.DivisionPK = cols.DivisionFK 
			 Where cols.ContainerOutFK = @var_containerOutPK  

			Select  cOuts.GoodsOrderNumber,couts.InsertedDate as InceptionDate,cOuts.DeliveryDate,cOuts.CollectionDate,sis.StockItemCode,cols.Batch, 
	case when PalletsOut is null then 0 else count(distinct co_ol_pc.palletfk) end as pallets,  count(distinct co_ol_pc.palletcontentfk)eaches, sum(co_ol_pc.units) units,
		isnull(TransportCompany, '') TransportCompany,
			isnull(ShippingCompany , '') ShippingCompany, 
			cOuts.Address1,SupplierBatch,cOuts.Address2,cOuts.Address3,cOuts.Address4,cOuts.Address5,counties.County,countries.Country,edps.Parameter1,edps.Parameter2,
			edps.Parameter3,edps.Parameter4,edps.Parameter5,edps.Parameter6,edps.Parameter7,edps.Parameter8,edps.Parameter9,edps.Parameter10,edps.Parameter11,edps.Parameter12,
			edps.Parameter13,edps.Parameter14,edps.Parameter15,edps.Parameter16,edps.Parameter17,edps.Parameter18,edps.Parameter19,edps.Parameter20,divisions.DivisionName,
			divisions.Address1 DivisionAddress1,divisions.Address2 DivisionAddress2, divisions.Address3 DivisionAddress3,divisions.Address4 DivisionAddress4,divisions.Address5 DivisionAddress5,
			cOuts.ContainerNumber,cOuts.SealNumber,@DeliveryNumber as DeliveryNumber,ISNULL(customers.CustomerCode,'') as CustomerCode,@ConsigneeNo as ConsigneeNo,
			sis.Description,cOuts.Free1 coutFree1,cOuts.Free2 coutFree2,cOuts.Free4 coutFree4,cOuts.Free5 coutFree5,cols.Free1 colsFree1,cols.Free2 colsFree2,
			cols.Free3 colsFree3,cols.Free4 colsFree4,cols.Free5 colsFree5,cOuts.DocketValue2,cOuts.DocketValue1,cols.Free4 CommodityCode,cOuts.SoldToName,cOuts.SoldToAddress1, 
			cOuts.SoldToAddress2,cOuts.SoldToAddress3,cOuts.SoldToAddress4,cOuts.SoldToAddress5,
			case when cols.Units = 0 then cast(1 as decimal(18,3)) else cols.Units end  / (case when cols.Free3 = '' then 
			cast(1 as decimal(18,3)) else cols.Free3 end) as UnitCount,
			Cast( 
					(Cols.Units / 
						(case when cols.Units = 0 then cast(1 as decimal(18,3)) else cols.Units end / (case when cols.Free3 = '' then 
						cast(1 as decimal(18,3)) else cols.Free3 end))
					)
				as Decimal(18,3)
			) as UnitWeight,ut.Abbreviation,--case pa_co.DateOfManufacture when '1900-01-01 00:00:00.000' then '' when null then '' end as ProductionDate
			case pa_co.DateOfManufacture when '1900-01-01 00:00:00.000' then '' else pa_co.DateOfManufacture end as ProductionDate,
			cOuts.Comments,pa_co.supplierbatch,CAST(cOuts.Weight AS INT) Weight
   			 From 
				tblContainerOuts cOuts  
				inner join tblContainerOutLines cols 
					on  
				cols.ContainerOutFK = cOuts.ContainerOutPK  
					inner join 
							dbo.tblContainerOutLinePalletContent co_ol_pc
								on
									cols.ContainerOutLinePK = co_ol_pc.ContainerOutLineFK
					inner join 
							dbo.tblPalletContent pa_co
								on
									co_ol_pc.PalletContentFK = pa_co.PalletContentPK
					inner join 
							tblDivisions divisions 
								on  
									divisions.DivisionPK = cols.DivisionFK  
					inner join 
							tblStockItems sis 
								on   
									sis.StockItemPK = cols.StockItemFK  
					left outer join 
							tblCustomers customers 
								on
									divisions.CustomerFK = customers.CustomerPK
					left outer join 
							tblCounties counties 
								on  
									counties.CountyPK = cOuts.CountyFK  
					left outer join 
							tblCountries countries 
								on  
									countries.CountryPK = cOuts.CountryFK  
					left outer join 
							tblTransportCompanies transport 
								on  
									transport.TransportCompanyPK = cOuts.TransportCompanyFK  

					left outer join
							tblShippingCompanies shippingComp
								on 
									shippingComp.ShippingCompanyPK = cOuts.ShippingCompanyFK
					left outer join 
							tblExtraDockets eds 
								on  
									eds.ExtraDocketTypeFK = 3 /*Stock Out Packing List*/  
										AND eds.CustomerFK = @customerFK  
				
					left outer join 
							tblExtraDocketParameterSets edps 
								on  
									edps.ExtraDocketFK = eds.ExtraDocketPK 
					inner join 
							tblUnitTypes ut 
								on 
									ut.UnitTypePK = sis.UnitTypeFK 
				left outer join (
						Select 1 PalletsOut, PalletFK, EventFK
						from tblPalletAudit 
						Where EventTypeFK = 2
						Group By EventFK, PalletFK
					)palletsOutPA on
					palletsOutPA.EventFK = cols.ContainerOutLinePK
					AND palletsOutPA.PalletFK = co_ol_pc.PalletFK	
			Where 
					ContainerOutPK = @var_containerOutPK 
					group by cOuts.GoodsOrderNumber,couts.InsertedDate,cOuts.DeliveryDate,cOuts.CollectionDate,sis.StockItemCode,cols.Batch, 
			--case when cols.Pallets > 0 then 1 end Pallets, 
		
						divisions.Address1 ,divisions.Address2 , divisions.Address3 ,divisions.Address4 ,divisions.Address5 ,
		
			 TransportCompany,
			 ShippingCompany, 
			cOuts.Address1,SupplierBatch,cOuts.Address2,cOuts.Address3,cOuts.Address4,cOuts.Address5,counties.County,countries.Country,edps.Parameter1,edps.Parameter2,
			edps.Parameter3,edps.Parameter4,edps.Parameter5,edps.Parameter6,edps.Parameter7,edps.Parameter8,edps.Parameter9,edps.Parameter10,edps.Parameter11,edps.Parameter12,
			edps.Parameter13,edps.Parameter14,edps.Parameter15,edps.Parameter16,edps.Parameter17,edps.Parameter18,edps.Parameter19,edps.Parameter20,divisions.DivisionName,
			cOuts.Free1 ,cOuts.Free2 ,cOuts.Free4 ,cOuts.Free5 ,cols.Free1 ,cols.Free2 ,
			cols.Free3 ,cols.Free4 ,cols.Free5 ,cOuts.DocketValue2,cols.Free4 ,cOuts.DocketValue1,
			cOuts.ContainerNumber,cOuts.SealNumber,customers.CustomerCode,
			sis.Description,cOuts.SoldToName,cOuts.SoldToAddress1, 
			cOuts.SoldToAddress2,cOuts.SoldToAddress3,cOuts.SoldToAddress4,cOuts.SoldToAddress5,
			 cols.Units,
			ut.Abbreviation,--case pa_co.DateOfManufacture when '1900-01-01 00:00:00.000' then '' when null then '' end as ProductionDate
			 pa_co.DateOfManufacture ,
			cOuts.Comments,pa_co.supplierbatch,cOuts.Weight, PalletsOut
				Order By sis.StockItemCode, cols.Batch
			
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT
	,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;
	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	DECLARE @var_containerOutPK int, @var_userFK int
	SET @var_containerOutPK = @containerOutPK; SET @var_userFK = @userFK
	SET @ParameterDetails = '@containerOutPK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_containerOutPK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@userFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_userFK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'')

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    --BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

		SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK,-1)

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END

	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY
			
			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start 
			select 'Docket No: ' + goodsordernumber as goodsordernumber, co.Address1, co.Address2, co.Address3, co.Address4,
				isnull(ShippingCompany, '')ShippingCompany,  isnull(TransportCompany, '')TransportCompany, ContainerNumber, LorryNumber,
				stockitemcode, s.description, pc.batch, sum(colpc.pallets) pallets,  CONVERT(INT, colpc.units) Units,  CONVERT(INT, sum(colpc.units)) totalUnits, 
				CONVERT (varchar(10), dateofmanufacture, 103) AS dateofmanufacture, co.Comments,
				(case when Docketlabel1 <> '' THEN Docketlabel1 + ': ' + DocketValue1 else ''end + ' ' +
				case when Docketlabel2 <> '' THEN Docketlabel2 + ': ' + DocketValue2  else '' end + ' ' +
				case when Docketlabel3 <> '' THEN Docketlabel3 + ': ' + DocketValue3 else '' end	) as CustomerReference
			from tblcontainerouts co
			inner join tblcontaineroutlines col on containeroutfk = containeroutpk
			inner join tblcontaineroutlinepalletcontent colpc on containeroutlinepk = containeroutlinefk
			inner join tblpalletcontent pc on colpc.palletfk = pc.palletfk
			left join tblshippingcompanies on shippingcompanyfk = shippingcompanypk
			left join tbltransportcompanies on TransportCompanyfk = TransportCompanypk
			inner join tblstockitems s on stockitempk = pc.stockitemfk
			where containeroutpk = @var_containerOutPK
			group by goodsordernumber, co.Address1, co.Address2, co.Address3, co.Address4,
				ShippingCompany, TransportCompany, ContainerNumber, LorryNumber,
				stockitemcode, s.description, pc.batch, colpc.pallets, colpc.units, pc.dateofmanufacture, co.Comments, 
				Docketlabel1, Docketlabel2, Docketlabel3, DocketValue1, DocketValue2, DocketValue3
			order by stockitemcode, pc.batch, colpc.units 

			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
