		SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END


	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY
			IF XACT_STATE() = 0 AND @@TRANCOUNT < 1 BEGIN TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName

			-- This stored procedures main code, excluding error handling - start

			update CurrentLine WITH (ROWLOCK) 
			Set CurrentLine.Free1 = ISNULL(colV.Free1, CurrentLine.Free1), CurrentLine.Free2 = ISNULL(colV.Free2, CurrentLine.Free2), CurrentLine.Free3 = ISNULL(colV.Free3, CurrentLine.Free3), CurrentLine.Free4 = ISNULL(colV.Free4, CurrentLine.Free4), CurrentLine.Free5 = ISNULL(colV.Free5, CurrentLine.Free5)
			from dbo.tblContainerOutLines as CurrentLine
			--inner join dbo.tblcontainerOuts co on CurrentLine.containeroutfk = co.ContainerOutPK
			inner join dbo.tblcontaineroutversions coV on coV.containerOutFK = CurrentLine.ContainerOutFk and coV.versionNumber = 1 AND coV.VersionNumberMinor = 0 /*jamie:  11 Sept 2020 : added minor versin check as later version may not have info*/
			inner join dbo.tblcontaineroutLineVersions colV on colV.ContainerOutVersionFK = coV.ContainerOutVersionPK and colV.StockItemFK = CurrentLine.StockItemFK
			where CurrentLine.containerOutFK = @var_ContainerOutFK and CurrentLine.insertedby > 0

			--is this needed? page should always be setting the customer barcode
			update colpc WITH (ROWLOCK)
			set colpc.customerbarcode = p.customerbarcode
			from dbo.tblContainerOutLinepalletContent as colpc
			Inner Join dbo.tblContainerOutLines col on colpc.ContainerOutLineFk = col.ContainerOutLinePK and col.containerOutFK = @var_ContainerOutFK
			inner join dbo.tblPallets p on p.PalletPk = colpc.PalletFk

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end

			BEGIN TRY IF XACT_STATE() = 1 AND @@TRANCOUNT = 1 AND @OpeningTranCount < 1 COMMIT TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH
			
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

		END TRY

         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

		BEGIN TRY
			

			-- This stored procedures main code, excluding error handling - start

			--ensure lines are set correctly (Jamie: danone reported some files going across with duplicate pallet details, because line batch not set correctly)
			exec spContainerOutMatchContentToLines @containerOutPK=@var_FK

			--check if any lines added by user
			if((select count(containeroutlinepk) from dbo.tblcontaineroutlines where containeroutfk = @var_FK and insertedby > 0) > 0)		
				exec cust747spContainerOutFixIntegratedEdits @ContainerOutFK= @var_FK --call fix up sp

				cols.Free2, 
				cols.Free3, 
				cols.Free4,
				cols.Free5,
				case when BaseUoM.StawmsUnitTypeFK = OrderedUoM.StawmsUnitTypeFK then 
					cast(cols.Units - cols.UnitsPickedDifference as integer)
				else 
					cast((cols.Units - cols.UnitsPickedDifference) / isnull(sics.ConversionFactor, 1)  as integer)
					--isnull(OrderedUoM.StawmsUnitTypeFK, 99)
				end as OrderedUnits, 
				case when BaseUoM.StawmsUnitTypeFK = OrderedUoM.StawmsUnitTypeFK then 
					cast(sum(isnull(colpc.Units, 0)) as integer)
				else 
					cast(sum(isnull(colpc.Units, 0)) / isnull(sics.ConversionFactor, 1) as integer)
				end as PickedUnits,
				sis.StockItemCode,
				sis.EANCode, 
				sis.Description,
				cols.Batch as LineBatch, 
				count(*) PalletCount,
				case when sis.RequireBatch = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ then pc.Batch else '' end as PickedBatch, 
				--CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), pc.BestBefore, 112) as ExpiryDate,
				--CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), MIN(pc.DateOfManufacture),112) as DateOfManufacture,
				BaseUoM.Abbreviation, 
				isnull(sics.ConversionFactor, 1) as BaseUnitOfMeasureConversionFactor
			from 
				dbo.tblContainerOuts cOuts 
		--	inner join dbo.tblContainerOutLines cols on cols.ContainerOutFK = cOuts.ContainerOutPK 
		--	inner join dbo.tblContainerOutLinePalletContent colpc on cols.ContainerOutLinePK = colpc.ContainerOutLineFK 
		--	inner join dbo.tblPalletContent pc on pc.PalletContentPK = colpc.PalletContentFK 
			left outer join dbo.tblContainerOutLines cols on cols.ContainerOutFK = cOuts.ContainerOutPK 
			left outer join dbo.tblContainerOutLinePalletContent colpc on cols.ContainerOutLinePK = colpc.ContainerOutLineFK 
			left outer join dbo.tblPalletContent pc on pc.PalletContentPK = colpc.PalletContentFK 
			inner join dbo.tblStockItems sis on sis.StockItemPK = cols.StockItemFK 
			left outer join dbo.cust747tblUnitOfMeasure BaseUoM on 
				BaseUoM.StawmsUnitTypeFK = sis.UnitTypeFK AND BaseUoM.StawmsUnitTypeFK <> -1 
			left outer join dbo.cust747tblUnitOfMeasure OrderedUoM on 
				(OrderedUoM.Abbreviation = cols.Free2 OR OrderedUoM.ISOCode = cols.Free2) AND OrderedUoM.StawmsUnitTypeFK <> -1 
			left outer join dbo.tblStockItemConversions sics on 
				sics.StockItemFK = cols.StockItemFK AND sics.UnitTypeFK = OrderedUoM.StawmsUnitTypeFK 
			Where 
				cOuts.ContainerOutPK = @var_FK 
			Group By 
				ContainerOutLinePK, cols.Free1,cols.Free2,cols.Free3,cols.Free4,cols.Free5, cols.Units, sis.StockItemCode, 
				sis.EANCode, sis.Description, cols.Batch, pc.Batch, --CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), pc.BestBefore, 112), 
				/*CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), pc.DateOfManufacture,112),*/ BaseUoM.Abbreviation, BaseUoM.StawmsUnitTypeFK, 
				OrderedUoM.StawmsUnitTypeFK, sics.ConversionFactor, cols.UnitsPickedDifference, sis.RequireBatch
	
			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end

			
			
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END

)
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */

				sis.StockItemPK = cols.StockItemFK

				divs.DivisionPK = sis.divisionFK

			Order By 
				ContainerOutPK Desc

		END TRY

	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY
			

			-- This stored procedures main code, excluding error handling - start

			Select Top 1
				CASE WHEN sds.IsScrap = 1/*CAST(1 as bit)*/ THEN
					'Scrap'
				WHEN sds.DiscrepencyTypeFK = 1 /*Over - PalletFound*/ THEN
					'PalletFound'
				WHEN sds.DiscrepencyTypeFK = 2 /*Under - Pallet Missing*/ THEN
					'PalletMissing'
				END	as MessageType		
			from 
				(Select * from dbo.tblWorksOrders Where WorksOrderPK = @var_FK) wos
			inner join dbo.tblStockDiscrepencies sds on
				sds.StockDiscrepencyPK = wos.FK
			inner join dbo.tblStockDiscrepencyPallets sdps on
				sdps.StockDiscrepencyFK = sds.StockDiscrepencyPK
			inner join dbo.tblPallets pals on
				pals.PalletPK = sdps.PalletFK

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end

			
			
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END
GO

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[cust747spDiscrepenciesToExport]
(
	@divisionFK int = -1,
	@customerFK int = -1,
	@FK int = -1
)
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT
 ,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;
	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	DECLARE @var_divisionFK INT, @var_customerFK INT, @var_FK INT

	SET @var_divisionFK = @divisionFK; SET @var_customerFK = @customerFK; SET @var_FK = @FK

	SET @ParameterDetails = '@divisionFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_divisionFK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@customerFK = ' 
		+ ISNULL(CAST(@var_customerFK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@FK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_FK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'')

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    --BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

		SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END


	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY
			

			-- This stored procedures main code, excluding error handling - start

			Select 
				WorksOrderPK, sds.ContainerOutLineFK, sds.StockInLineFK 
			From 
				dbo.tblWorksOrders wos
			inner join dbo.tblStockDiscrepencies sds	on
				sds.StockDiscrepencyPK = wos.FK
			inner join dbo.tblStockDiscrepencyPallets sdps on
				sdps.StockDiscrepencyFK = sds.StockDiscrepencyPK
			inner join dbo.tblStockItems sis on
				sis.StockItemPK = sdps.StockItemFK
			Where 
				wos.WorksOrderOriginFK = 11 /*Discrepency*/AND 
				(
					(
						(sds.StockInFK > 0 OR sds.ContainerOutLineFK > 0) AND
						sds.ReconcileStarted = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/
						AND sds.ReconcileComplete = 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/
						AND wos.IntegrationStage1Flag = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/--C21A Sent
						AND wos.IntegrationStage2Flag = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/--C76Received
						AND wos.IntegrationStage3Flag = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/--C76 has been acknoledged
						AND wos.IntegrationStage4Flag = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/--M52 sent
						AND wos.IntegrationStage5Flag = 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/--C21 A for Discrepency Not sent
					)
					OR
					(
						wos.WorksOrderTypeFK = 12 /*Discrepency*/
						AND wos.IntegrationStage1Flag = 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/--C21 A for Discrepency Not sent))
					)
				)
				AND sis.DivisionFK = @var_divisionFK
			Group By 
				WorksOrderPK, sds.ContainerOutLineFK, sds.StockInLineFK 

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end

			
			
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[cust747spDiscrepencyOneShots]
(
	@divisionFK int = -1,
	@customerFK int = -1,
	@FK int = -1 --WorksOrderPK
)
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT
 ,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;
	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	DECLARE @var_divisionFK INT, @var_customerFK INT, @var_FK INT
	SET @var_divisionFK = @divisionFK; SET @var_customerFK = @customerFK; SET @var_FK = @FK
	SET @ParameterDetails = '@divisionFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_divisionFK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@customerFK = ' 
		+ ISNULL(CAST(@var_customerFK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@FK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_FK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'')

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    --BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

		SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END


	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY
			
			-- This stored procedures main code, excluding error handling - start

			Select distinct
			sis.StockItemCode,
			sis.EanCode,
			sdps.Batch,
		--	FLOOR(ROUND(sum(colpc.Units), 0)) as Quantity,
			CASE when sds.DiscrepencyTypeFK = 1 THEN /*Over/Extra/PalletFound/Positive Adjustment*/
				pc.ActualUnits + (SELECT isnull(pc2.ActualUnits, 0) from dbo.tblPallets pals3 INNER JOIN dbo.tblPalletContent pc2 ON pc2.PalletFK = pals3.PalletPK 
				WHERE pals3.CustomerBarcode = pals.CustomerBarcode AND pals3.PalletPK <> pals.PalletPK AND pals3.IsArchived = 0/*CAST(0 as bit)*/)
			ELSE
				pc.AvailableUnits 
			END as QuantityRemaining,
			sdps.Units as QuantityDiscrepped,
			CASE when sds.DiscrepencyTypeFK = 1 THEN /*Over/Extra/PalletFound/Positive Adjustment*/
				CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT * FROM dbo.tblPallets pals2 Where pals2.CustomerBarcode = pals.CustomerBarcode AND pals2.PalletPK <> pals.PalletPK 
				AND pals2.IsArchived = 0/*CAST(0 as bit)*/) THEN
					0
				ELSE
					1
				END
			ELSE
				 case when cols.Pallets = 0 then 
					case when palletsOutPA.PalletsOut is null then 
						case when actualPallets.Pallets > 0 then
							1
						else
							0
						End	
					else 
						case when palletsOutPA.PalletsOut > 0 then
							1
						else
							0
						End
					end 
				else 
					case when colpc.CustomerPalletNumber = '' then 
						1 
					else 
						case when colpc.Pallets > 0 then
							1
						else
							0
						end
					end
				END  
		 
			END as EntirePallet,
			CASE WHEN sds.IsScrap = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ THEN
				CASE WHEN pals.PalletStatusFK IN (1) THEN /*Available*/
					CASE WHEN sds.StockDiscrepencyReasonFK = 1 THEN /*Damaged In Transit*/
						'9511'
						WHEN sds.StockDiscrepencyReasonFK = 2 THEN /*Warehouse Damage*/
						'9522'
						WHEN sds.StockDiscrepencyReasonFK = 3 THEN /*Short Dates/Expiry*/
						'9513'
						WHEN sds.StockDiscrepencyReasonFK = 4 THEN /*Discrepancy - Jamie added this as default because mapping was missing*/
						'9518'
						WHEN sds.StockDiscrepencyReasonFK = 5 THEN /*Quality Issue*/
						'9517'
						WHEN sds.StockDiscrepencyReasonFK = 7 THEN /*Found In Warehouse*/
						'9514'
						WHEN sds.StockDiscrepencyReasonFK = 8 THEN /*Lost In Warehouse*/
						'9515'
						WHEN sds.StockDiscrepencyReasonFK = 9 THEN /*Obsolete*/
						'9516'
						WHEN sds.StockDiscrepencyReasonFK = 10 THEN /*Recall*/
						'9518'
						WHEN sds.StockDiscrepencyReasonFK = 11 THEN /*Stock Adjustment*/
						'9520'
						WHEN sds.StockDiscrepencyReasonFK = 12 THEN /*Supplier Damage*/
						'9521'
						WHEN sds.StockDiscrepencyReasonFK = 13 THEN /*Damage On Arrival*/
						'9512'
						WHEN sds.StockDiscrepencyReasonFK = 14 THEN /*Cycle Count*/
						'9523'
						/*LJF: The 2 options below are not possible by the matrix, however I will leave them here, rather than a blank value being sent*/
						WHEN sds.StockDiscrepencyReasonFK = 15 THEN /*Stock Feed*/
						'9526'
						WHEN sds.StockDiscrepencyReasonFK = 16 THEN /*Landfill*/
						'9527'
					END
				WHEN pals.PalletStatusFK IN (4, 9, 15)THEN /*Quality*/
					CASE 
						WHEN sds.StockDiscrepencyReasonFK = 1 THEN /*Damaged In Transit*/
						'9511'
						WHEN sds.StockDiscrepencyReasonFK = 2 THEN /*Warehouse Damage*/
						'9522'
						WHEN sds.StockDiscrepencyReasonFK = 3 THEN /*Short Dates/Expiry*/
						'9513'
						WHEN sds.StockDiscrepencyReasonFK = 4 THEN /*Discrepancy - Jamie added this as default because mapping was missing*/
						'9518'
						WHEN sds.StockDiscrepencyReasonFK = 5 THEN /*Quality Issue*/
						'9517'
						WHEN sds.StockDiscrepencyReasonFK = 7 THEN /*Found In Warehouse*/
						'9514'
						WHEN sds.StockDiscrepencyReasonFK = 8 THEN /*Lost In Warehouse*/
						'9515'
						WHEN sds.StockDiscrepencyReasonFK = 9 THEN /*Obsolete*/
						'9516'
						WHEN sds.StockDiscrepencyReasonFK = 10 THEN /*Recall*/
						'9518'
						WHEN sds.StockDiscrepencyReasonFK = 11 THEN /*Stock Adjustment*/
						'9520'
						WHEN sds.StockDiscrepencyReasonFK = 12 THEN /*Supplier Damage*/
						'9521'
						WHEN sds.StockDiscrepencyReasonFK = 13 THEN /*Damage On Arrival*/
						'9512'
						WHEN sds.StockDiscrepencyReasonFK = 14 THEN /*Cycle Count*/
						'9523'
						/*LJF: The 2 options below are not possible by the matrix, however I will leave them here, rather than a blank value being sent*/
						WHEN sds.StockDiscrepencyReasonFK = 15 THEN /*Stock Feed*/
						'9526'
						WHEN sds.StockDiscrepencyReasonFK = 16 THEN /*Landfill*/
						'9527'
					END
				WHEN pals.PalletStatusFK IN(3, 7)THEN /*Blocked*/
					CASE 
						WHEN sds.StockDiscrepencyReasonFK = 1 THEN /*Damaged In Transit*/
						'9513'
						WHEN sds.StockDiscrepencyReasonFK = 2 THEN /*Warehouse Damage*/
						'9524'
						WHEN sds.StockDiscrepencyReasonFK = 3 THEN /*Short Dates/Expiry*/
						'9515'
						WHEN sds.StockDiscrepencyReasonFK = 4 THEN /*Discrepancy - Jamie added this as default because mapping was missing*/
						'9518'
						WHEN sds.StockDiscrepencyReasonFK = 5 THEN /*Quality Issue*/
						'9519'
						WHEN sds.StockDiscrepencyReasonFK = 7 THEN /*Found In Warehouse*/
						'9516'
						WHEN sds.StockDiscrepencyReasonFK = 8 THEN /*Lost In Warehouse*/
						'9517'
						WHEN sds.StockDiscrepencyReasonFK = 9 THEN /*Obsolete*/
						'9518'
						WHEN sds.StockDiscrepencyReasonFK = 10 THEN /*Recall*/
						'9520'
						WHEN sds.StockDiscrepencyReasonFK = 11 THEN /*Stock Adjustment*/
						'9522'
						WHEN sds.StockDiscrepencyReasonFK = 12 THEN /*Supplier Damage*/
						'9523'
						WHEN sds.StockDiscrepencyReasonFK = 13 THEN /*Damage On Arrival*/
						'9514'
						WHEN sds.StockDiscrepencyReasonFK = 14 THEN /*Cycle Count*/
						'9525'
						WHEN sds.StockDiscrepencyReasonFK = 15 THEN /*Stock Feed*/
						'9526'
						WHEN sds.StockDiscrepencyReasonFK = 16 THEN /*Landfill*/
						'9527'
					END
				END
			WHEN sds.DiscrepencyTypeFK = 1 THEN /*Over/Extra/PalletFound/Positive Adjustment*/ 
				CASE 
					WHEN pals.PalletStatusFK IN (1) THEN /*Available*/
						'0033'
					WHEN pals.PalletStatusFK IN (4, 9, 15)THEN /*Quality*/
						'0033'
					WHEN pals.PalletStatusFK IN(3, 7)THEN /*Blocked*/
						'0002'
				END
			WHEN sds.DiscrepencyTypeFK = 2 THEN /*Under/PalletMissing/Negative Adjustment*/
				CASE 
					WHEN pals.PalletStatusFK IN (1) THEN /*Available*/
						'0033'
					WHEN pals.PalletStatusFK IN (4, 9, 15)THEN /*Quality*/
						'0033'
					WHEN pals.PalletStatusFK IN(3, 7)THEN /*Blocked*/
						'0002'
				END
			END as ReasonCode,
			sds.Free1,
			sds.Free2,
			uom.ISOCode UnitOfMeasure,
			/*LJF - Both of these are 555 as right now, I dont beleive we will use this process for adding extra pallets for Danone*/
			CASE WHEN sds.IsScrap = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ THEN
				CASE 
					WHEN pals.PalletStatusFK IN (1) THEN /*Available*/
						551
					WHEN pals.PalletStatusFK IN (4, 9, 15)THEN /*Quality*/
						553
					WHEN pals.PalletStatusFK IN(3, 7)THEN /*Blocked*/
						555
				END
			ELSE 
				CASE when sds.DiscrepencyTypeFK = 1 /*Over/Extra/PalletFound/Positive Adjustment*/ then
					CASE 
						WHEN pals.PalletStatusFK IN (1) THEN /*Available*/
							343
						WHEN pals.PalletStatusFK IN (4, 9, 15)THEN /*Quality*/
							349
						WHEN pals.PalletStatusFK IN(3, 7)THEN /*Blocked*/
							325
					END
				WHEN sds.DiscrepencyTypeFK = 2 /*Under/PalletMissing/Negative Adjustment*/ THEN
					CASE 
						WHEN pals.PalletStatusFK IN (1) THEN /*Available*/
							344
						WHEN pals.PalletStatusFK IN (4, 9, 15)THEN /*Quality*/
							350
						WHEN pals.PalletStatusFK IN (3, 7)THEN /*Blocked*/
							325
					END
				END
			end MovementType,
			CASE WHEN sds.IsScrap = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ AND inScrapMovs.PalletFK IS NOT NULL THEN
				'0002'
			ELSE
				case when sis.DivisionFK = 630 then 
					'0100' 
				when sis.DivisionFK = 631 then 
					'0001' 
				when sis.DivisionFK = 632 then 
					'0100' 
				end
			END as StorageLocation,
			danStat.GuardianStatus, 
			danStat.SapStatus LocalStatus,
			danStat.RequiresPositiveRelease,
			--'B' GuardianStatus,
			--'B' LocalStatus,
			--'N' RequiresPositiveRelease,
			pals.CustomerBarcode,
			CASE WHEN sds.IsScrap = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ THEN
				'Scrap'
			WHEN sds.DiscrepencyTypeFK = 1 /*Over - PalletFound*/ THEN
				'PalletFound'
			WHEN sds.DiscrepencyTypeFK = 2 /*Under - Pallet Missing*/ THEN
				'PalletMissing'
			END	as MessageType,
			isnull(css.CustomerReference, '') as SupplierReference,
			pc.ExpiryDate,
			CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), sdps.BestBefore, 112) as BestBefore,
			CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), sdps.DateOfManufacture, 112) as DateOfManufacture
			from dbo.tblWorksOrders wos
			inner join dbo.tblStockDiscrepencies sds on
			sds.StockDiscrepencyPK = wos.FK
			inner join dbo.tblStockDiscrepencyPallets sdps on
			sdps.StockDiscrepencyFK = sds.StockDiscrepencyPK
			inner join dbo.tblPallets pals on
			pals.PalletPK = sdps.PalletFK
			CROSS APPLY dbo.cust747funtblDanoneStatusFromStawmsStatus(pals.PalletStatusFK) danStat
			left outer join (
				Select PalletFK, sum(ActualUnits) as ActualUnits, sum(AvailableUnits) AvailableUnits, ExpiryDate, BestBefore, DateOfManufacture
				From dbo.tblPalletContent
				Group By PalletFK, ExpiryDate, BestBefore, DateOfManufacture
			)pc on
			pc.PalletFK = pals.PalletPK

		--	left outer join dbo.tblScrapLocations inScrap on
		--	inScrap.LocationTypeFK = 1
		--	AND inScrap.LocationFK = pals.LocationFK

			left OUTER JOIN (
				SELECT DISTINCT PalletFK
				FROM dbo.tblWorksOrderMovements woms
				Where woms.WorksOrderStatusFK = 3 /*Complete*/
				AND
				DestinationLocationTypeFK=1/*Racking*/
				AND
				DestinationFK IN (SELECT LocationFK from dbo.tblScrapLocations Where tblScrapLocations.LocationTypeFK = 1/*Racking*/)
			)inScrapMovs ON
			inScrapMovs.PalletFK = pals.PalletPK

			left outer join dbo.tblContainerOutLines cols on
			cols.ContainerOutLinePK = sds.ContainerOutLineFK
			left outer JOIN dbo.tblContainerOutLinePalletContent colpc on
			colpc.ContainerOutLineFK = cols.ContainerOutLinePK
			left outer join dbo.tblStockItems sis on 
			sis.StockItemPK = sdps.StockItemFK
			left outer join cust747tblUnitOfMeasure uom on
			uom.StawmsUnitTypeFK = sis.UnitTypeFK

			left outer join (
				Select 1 PalletsOut, PalletFK, EventFK
				from dbo.tblPalletAudit 
				Where EventTypeFK = 2
				Group By EventFK, PalletFK
			)palletsOutPA on
			palletsOutPA.EventFK = cols.ContainerOutLinePK
			AND palletsOutPA.PalletFK = colpc.PalletFK

			left outer join (
				Select ContainerOutLineFK, 1 Pallets, pallets.PalletPK 
				from dbo.tblPallets pallets
				inner join (
					Select PalletFK, sum(ActualUnits) ActualUnits from dbo.tblPalletContent
					group By PalletFK
				) pc on
				pc.PalletFK = pallets.PalletPK
				inner join (
					Select PalletFK, sum(Units) OrderedUnits 
					from dbo.tblContainerOutLinePalletContent
					Group By PalletFK,containeroutlinefk
				)colPallets on colPallets.PalletFK = pallets.PalletPK
				inner join (
					Select ContainerOutLineFK, PalletFK from dbo.tblContainerOutLinePalletContent
					Group By ContainerOutLineFK, PalletFK
				)colpc on colpc.PalletFK = pallets.PalletPK
				inner join dbo.tblContainerOutLines cols on
				cols.ContainerOutLinePK = colpc.ContainerOutLineFK
				inner join dbo.tblContainerOuts cOuts on
				cOuts.ContainerOutPK = cols.ContainerOutFK
				AND cOuts.ContainerOutStatusFK in (1,2,3) /*pending*/
				where ActualUnits = OrderedUnits
				Group By ContainerOutLineFK, PalletPK
			)actualPallets on 
			actualPallets.ContainerOutLineFK = cols.ContainerOutLinePK
			AND actualPallets.PalletPK = colpc.PalletFK
	
			left outer join dbo.tblStockInLinePallets silps on
			silps.PalletFK = pals.PalletPK
	
			left outer join dbo.tblStockInLines sils on
			sils.StockInLinePK = silps.StockInLineFK

			left outer join dbo.tblStockIns sins on
			sins.StockInPK = sils.StockInFK

			left outer join dbo.tblContainerIns cins on
			cins.ContainerInPK = sins.ContainerInFK

			left outer join dbo.tblCustomerSuppliers css on
			css.SupplierFK = cins.SupplierFK

			Where wos.WorksOrderPK = @var_FK

			Group By sis.StockItemCode, sis.DivisionFK, sdps.Batch, sdps.Units, uom.ISOCode, 
				sds.StockDiscrepencyReasonFK, sds.Free1, sds.Free2, pals.PalletStatusFK, 
				DiscrepencyTypeFK, pals.CustomerBarcode, css.CustomerReference, pc.ExpiryDate, 
				sdps.BestBefore, sdps.DateOfManufacture, sis.EanCode, sds.IsScrap, cols.Pallets, 
				palletsOutPA.PalletsOut, actualPallets.Pallets, colpc.CustomerPalletNumber, 
				colpc.Pallets, danStat.RequiresPositiveRelease, danStat.GuardianStatus, danStat.SapStatus,
				inScrapMovs.PalletFK, pc.ActualUnits, pc.AvailableUnits, pals.PalletPK

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end

			
			
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END
GO

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[cust747spGoodsReceiptMessageType]
(
	@FK int,--ContainerInPK
	@divisionFK int = -1,
	@customerFK int = -1,
	@freeString nvarchar(200) = ''
)
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT
 ,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;
	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	DECLARE @var_FK INT, @var_divisionFK INT, @var_customerFK INT, @var_freeString NVARCHAR(200)

	SET @var_FK = @FK; SET @var_divisionFK = @divisionFK; SET @var_customerFK = @customerFK; SET @var_freeString = @freeString

	SET @ParameterDetails = '@FK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_FK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@divisionFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_divisionFK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@customerFK = ' 
		+ ISNULL(CAST(@var_customerFK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@freeString = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_freeString AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'')

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    --BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

		SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END


	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY
			

			-- This stored procedures main code, excluding error handling - start

			Declare @containerInHeaderFree5 nvarchar(200)

			Select Top 1 @containerInHeaderFree5 = Free5
			From dbo.tblContainerInHeaders 
			Where ContainerInFK = @var_FK 

			IF(@containerInHeaderFree5 = 'RTRN') 
				Select 'ReceptionWithoutReference' as GoodsReceiptMessageType	
			ELSE 
				Select 'PalletCreationForReceipt' as GoodsReceiptMessageType		

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end

			
			
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END

-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[cust747spGoodsReceiptStockInLines]
(
	@divisionFK int = -1,
	@customerFK int = -1,
	@FK int = -1,
	@freeString nvarchar(200) = ''
)
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT
 ,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;
	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	DECLARE @var_divisionFK INT, @var_customerFK INT, @var_FK INT, @var_freeString NVARCHAR(200)

	SET @var_divisionFK = @divisionFK; SET @var_customerFK = @customerFK; SET @var_FK = @FK; SET @var_freeString = @freeString

	SET @ParameterDetails = '@divisionFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_divisionFK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@customerFK = ' 
		+ ISNULL(CAST(@var_customerFK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@FK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_FK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@freeString = ' 
			+ ISNULL(CAST(@var_freeString AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'')

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    --BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

		SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END


	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY
			

			-- This stored procedures main code, excluding error handling - start

			Select 
				MIN(sils.StockInLinePK) StockInLinePK, 
				sis.StockItemPK, 
				sis.StockItemCode,
				sis.EANCode, 
				CASE when sins.DivisionFK = 631 then
					CASE when CHARINDEX('.', sils.Batch) > 0 then
						sils.Batch
					ELSE
						substring(sils.Batch, 0, 5) + '.' + substring(sils.Batch, 5, 2) + '.' + substring(sils.Batch, 7, 2)
					END
				ELSE
					sils.Batch
					--substring(sils.Batch, 0, 4) + '.' + substring(sils.Batch, 4, 2) + '.' + substring(sils.Batch, 6, 2)
				END as Batch, 
				sils.SupplierBatch,
				case when cihs.ContainerInHeaderPK is null then sils.Free1 else cihs.Free1 end LineNumber,
				--case when cihs.ContainerInHeaderPK is null then sils.Free5 else cihs.Free3 end UnitOfMeasure,
				uom.ISOCode as UnitOfMeasure,
				CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), sils.ExpiryDate, 112) as ExpiryDate, 
				CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), sils.BestBefore, 112) as BestBefore,
				CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), sils.DateOfManufacture, 112) + '0000' as DateOfManufacture, 
				cast(sum(sils.Units * sils.Pallets) AS integer) Units, 
				sils.PalletTypeFK 
			from 
				dbo.tblStockInLines sils 
			inner join dbo.tblStockItems sis on 
				sis.StockItemPK = sils.StockItemFK 
			inner join cust747tblUnitOfMeasure uom on
				uom.StawmsUnitTypeFK = sis.UnitTypeFK
			inner join dbo.tblStockIns sins on
				sins.StockInPK = sils.StockInFK
			left outer join dbo.tblContainerInHeaders cihs on
				cihs.ContainerInFK = sins.ContainerInFK
				AND cihs.StockItemFK = sils.StockItemFK
			Where 
				StockInFK = @var_FK 
			Group By 
				StockItemPK, StockItemCode, EANCode, sins.DivisionFK, sils.Batch, sils.SupplierBatch, ExpiryDate, BestBefore, DateOfManufacture, 
				sils.Free1, sils.Free5, sils.PalletTypeFK, cihs.ContainerInHeaderPK, cihs.Free1, cihs.Free3, uom.ISOCode

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end

			
			
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END

			+ ISNULL(CAST(@var_freeString AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'')

         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END


	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY
			

			-- This stored procedures main code, excluding error handling - start

			Select 
			sis.StockItemCode,
			sis.EANCode, 
			CASE when sins.DivisionFK = 631 then
				CASE when CHARINDEX('.', sils.Batch) > 0 then
					sils.Batch
				ELSE
					substring(sils.Batch, 0, 5) + '.' + substring(sils.Batch, 5, 2) + '.' + substring(sils.Batch, 7, 2)
				END
			ELSE
				sils.Batch
				--substring(sils.Batch, 0, 4) + '.' + substring(sils.Batch, 4, 2) + '.' + substring(sils.Batch, 6, 2)
			END as Batch, 
			sils.SupplierBatch,
			uom.ISOCode as UnitOfMeasure,
			CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), max(sils.BestBefore), 112) as BestBefore, 
			CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), sils.DateOfManufacture, 112) + '0000' as DateOfManufacture, 
			cast(sum(sils.Units * sils.Pallets) AS integer) Units,
			danStat.SAPStatus PalletStatus,
			danStat.GuardianStatus GuardianPalletStatus,
			danStat.RequiresPositiveRelease,
			/*Conversions*/
			case when sics1.StockItemConversionPK is null then '' else
				cUom1.ISOCode
			End as Conversion1UOM,
			case when sics1.StockItemConversionPK is null then '' else
				cast(cast(sum(sils.Units * sils.Pallets) / sics1.ConversionFactor as int) as nvarchar(100))
			End as Conversion1Quantity,
			case when sics2.StockItemConversionPK is null then '' else
				cUom2.ISOCode
			End as Conversion2UOM,
			case when sics2.StockItemConversionPK is null then '' else
				cast(cast(sum(sils.Units * sils.Pallets) / sics2.ConversionFactor as int) as nvarchar(100))
			End as Conversion2Quantity,
			case when sics3.StockItemConversionPK is null then '' else
				cUom3.ISOCode
			End as Conversion3UOM,
			case when sics3.StockItemConversionPK is null then '' else
				cast(cast(sum(sils.Units * sils.Pallets) / sics3.ConversionFactor as int) as nvarchar(100))
			End as Conversion3Quantity,
			case when sics4.StockItemConversionPK is null then '' else
				cUom4.ISOCode
			End as Conversion4UOM,
			case when sics4.StockItemConversionPK is null then '' else
				cast(cast(sum(sils.Units * sils.Pallets) / sics4.ConversionFactor as int) as nvarchar(100))
			End as Conversion4Quantity,
			case when sics5.StockItemConversionPK is null then '' else
				cUom5.ISOCode
			End as Conversion5UOM,
			case when sics5.StockItemConversionPK is null then '' else
				cast(cast(sum(sils.Units * sils.Pallets) / sics5.ConversionFactor as int) as nvarchar(100))
			End as Conversion5Quantity
			/*End Of Conversions*/
			from 
				dbo.tblStockInLines sils 
			inner join dbo.tblStockItems sis on 
				sis.StockItemPK = sils.StockItemFK 
			inner join cust747tblUnitOfMeasure uom on
				uom.StawmsUnitTypeFK = sis.UnitTypeFK
			inner join dbo.tblStockIns sins on
				sins.StockInPK = sils.StockInFK
			left outer join dbo.tblContainerInHeaders cihs on
				cihs.ContainerInFK = sins.ContainerInFK
				AND cihs.StockItemFK = sils.StockItemFK
			CROSS APPLY dbo.cust747funtblDanoneStatusFromStawmsStatus(sils.PalletStatusFK) danStat
			/*Conversions*/
			left outer join dbo.tblStockItemConversions sics1 on
				sics1.StockItemFK = sis.StockItemPK
				AND sics1.ConversionOrder = 1
				AND sics1.AlwaysShowInGoodsReceipt = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/

			left outer join cust747tblUnitOfMeasure cUom1 on
			cUom1.StawmsUnitTypeFK = sics1.UnitTypeFK

			left outer join dbo.tblStockItemConversions sics2 on
				sics2.StockItemFK = sis.StockItemPK
				AND sics2.ConversionOrder = 2
				AND sics2.AlwaysShowInGoodsReceipt = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/

			left outer join cust747tblUnitOfMeasure cUom2 on
				cUom2.StawmsUnitTypeFK = sics2.UnitTypeFK

			left outer join dbo.tblStockItemConversions sics3 on
				sics3.StockItemFK = sis.StockItemPK
				AND sics3.ConversionOrder = 3
				AND sics3.AlwaysShowInGoodsReceipt = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/

			left outer join cust747tblUnitOfMeasure cUom3 on
				cUom3.StawmsUnitTypeFK = sics3.UnitTypeFK

			left outer join dbo.tblStockItemConversions sics4 on
				sics4.StockItemFK = sis.StockItemPK
				AND sics4.ConversionOrder = 4
				AND sics4.AlwaysShowInGoodsReceipt = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/

			left outer join cust747tblUnitOfMeasure cUom4 on
				cUom4.StawmsUnitTypeFK = sics4.UnitTypeFK

			left outer join dbo.tblStockItemConversions sics5 on
				sics5.StockItemFK = sis.StockItemPK
				AND sics5.ConversionOrder = 5
				AND sics5.AlwaysShowInGoodsReceipt = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/

			left outer join cust747tblUnitOfMeasure cUom5 on
				cUom5.StawmsUnitTypeFK = sics5.UnitTypeFK
			/*End Of Conversions*/
			Where 
				StockInFK = @var_FK 
			Group By 
				StockItemCode, EANCode, sins.DivisionFK, sils.Batch, sils.SupplierBatch, sils.PalletStatusFK, DateOfManufacture, 
				cihs.ContainerInHeaderPK, uom.ISOCode, danStat.SAPStatus, danStat.GuardianStatus, danStat.RequiresPositiveRelease,
				sics1.StockItemConversionPK, cUom1.ISOCode, sics1.ConversionFactor,
				sics2.StockItemConversionPK, cUom2.ISOCode, sics2.ConversionFactor,
				sics3.StockItemConversionPK, cUom3.ISOCode, sics3.ConversionFactor,
				sics4.StockItemConversionPK, cUom4.ISOCode, sics4.ConversionFactor,
				sics5.StockItemConversionPK, cUom5.ISOCode, sics5.ConversionFactor

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end

			
			
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY

			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END

-- =============================================

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[cust747spGoodsReceiptStockInLineUnits]
(
	@FK int,--StockInLineFK
	@divisionFK int = -1,
	@customerFK int = -1,
	@freeString nvarchar(200) = ''
)
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT
 ,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;
	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	DECLARE @var_FK INT, @var_divisionFK INT, @var_customerFK INT, @var_freeString NVARCHAR(200)

	SET @var_FK = @FK; SET @var_divisionFK = @divisionFK; SET @var_customerFK = @customerFK; SET @var_freeString = @freeString

	SET @ParameterDetails = '@FK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_FK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@divisionFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_divisionFK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@customerFK = ' 
		+ ISNULL(CAST(@var_customerFK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@freeString = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_freeString AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'')

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    --BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

		SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END


	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY
			

			-- This stored procedures main code, excluding error handling - start

			Declare @containerInPK int, @stockItemFK int, @batch nvarchar(300)

			Select @containerInPK = ContainerInFK from dbo.tblStockIns Where StockInPK = (Select StockInFK from dbo.tblStockInLines Where StockInLinePK = @var_FK)

			Select @stockItemFK = StockItemFK, @batch = Batch from dbo.tblStockInLines where StockInLinePK = @var_FK

			if((Select HeadersOnly from dbo.tblContainerIns Where ContainerInPK = @containerInPK) = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/) 
			BEGIN
				Select 
					--Free4 is the conversion factor to be multiplied by to get the units back glanbia is expecting
					sum(cast((sils.Pallets * sils.Units) / cast(cihs.Free4 as decimal(18,3)) as Integer))
				From 
					dbo.tblStockInLines sils
				inner join dbo.tblStockIns sins on
					sins.StockInPK = sils.StockInFK
				inner join dbo.tblContainerInHeaders cihs on
					cihs.ContainerInFK = sins.ContainerInFK
					AND cihs.StockItemFK = sils.StockItemFK
				Where 
					sins.ContainerInFK = @containerInPK
					AND sils.StockItemFK = @stockItemFK
					AND sils.Batch = @batch
			END 
			ELSE 
				Select Top 1 
					--Free4 is the conversion factor to be multiplied by to get the units back glanbia is expecting
					cast((sils.Pallets * sils.Units) * cast(sils.Free4 as decimal(18,3)) as Integer)
				From 
					dbo.tblStockInLines as sils
				Where 
					StockInLinePK = @var_FK

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end

			
			
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[cust747spInventoryReconciliation] 
(
	@divisionFK int = -1,
	@customerFK int = -1,
	@FK int = -1
)
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT
 ,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;
	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	DECLARE @var_divisionFK INT, @var_customerFK INT, @var_FK INT

	SET @var_divisionFK = @divisionFK; SET @var_customerFK = @customerFK; SET @var_FK = @FK

	SET @ParameterDetails = '@divisionFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_divisionFK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@customerFK = ' 
		+ ISNULL(CAST(@var_customerFK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@FK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_FK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'')

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    --BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

		SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END


	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY
			

			-- This stored procedures main code, excluding error handling - start

			DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #divisions
			SELECT td.DivisionPK 
			INTO #divisions 
			FROM dbo.tblDivisions td 
			WHERE ((@var_divisionFK > 0 AND td.DivisionPK = @var_divisionFK)
				OR (@var_customerFK > 0 AND td.CustomerFK = @var_customerFK))

			DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #stockitems
			SELECT s.* 
			INTO #stockitems
			FROM tblstockitems s
			INNER JOIN #divisions d ON s.divisionfk = d.DivisionPK
		
			DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #currStock
			Select PalletFK, StockItemFK, Batch, ActualUnits, CustomerBarcode, pc.ExpiryDate, pc.BestBefore, pc.SpecialStockTypeFK
			INTO #currStock
			from dbo.tblPalletContent pc
			inner join #stockitems sis on sis.StockItemPK = pc.StockItemFK
			Where (pc.ActualEaches > 0 OR pc.ActualUnits > 0) AND pc.IsArchived = 0
	
			DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #currPals
			SELECT p.PalletPK, p.PalletStatusFK, p.CustomerBarcode, p.IsArchived
			INTO #currPals
			FROM tblpallets p 
			INNER JOIN #currStock pc ON pc.PalletFK = p.PalletPK
			WHERE p.IsArchived = 0 AND p.PalletStatusFK not in (10 /*On Route*/, 11 /*Loaded to go out*/)
			
			Select StorageLocation,
				SAPStatus,
				StockItemCode,
				EANCode,
				Batch,
				BaseUoM,
				Sum(Quantity) Quantity,
				ExpiryDate,
				BestBefore
			from (
				Select 
				CASE 
					WHEN pc.PalletStatusFK in (16, 17) THEN '0002'
					WHEN pc.SpecialStockTypeFK IN (4,5,6,12) THEN '0101'
					WHEN sis.DivisionFK in (630, 632) THEN '0100' 
					WHEN sis.DivisionFK = 631 THEN '0001' 
				END as StorageLocation, 
				danStat.SAPStatus,
				sis.StockItemCode, 
				sis.EANCode,
				pc.Batch, 
				isnull(uom.ISOCode, 'UNIT UNKNOWN') BaseUoM,
				cast(isnull(pc.ActualUnits, 0) as int) as Quantity,			
				convert(varchar(10), pc.ExpiryDate, 112) ExpiryDate,
				convert(varchar(10), pc.BestBefore, 112) BestBefore
				From 
				(
					Select StockItemFK, Batch, ExpiryDate, BestBefore, pals.PalletStatusFK, sum(ActualUnits) ActualUnits, SpecialStockTypeFK
					from #currStock pc1
					inner join #currPals pals on pals.PalletPK = pc1.PalletFK
					Group By StockItemFK, Batch, ExpiryDate, BestBefore, pals.PalletStatusFK, pc1.SpecialStockTypeFK
				) pc 
				inner join #stockitems sis on sis.StockItemPK = pc.StockItemFK
				inner join #divisions divs on divs.DivisionPK = sis.DivisionFK
				CROSS APPLY dbo.cust747funtblDanoneStatusFromStawmsStatus(pc.PalletStatusFK) danStat
				left outer join cust747tblUnitOfMeasure uom on  sis.UnitTypeFK > 0 AND uom.StawmsUnitTypeFK = sis.UnitTypeFK
			)subQ
			Where Quantity > 0 
			Group By StorageLocation, SAPStatus, StockItemCode,	EANCode, Batch,	BaseUoM, ExpiryDate, BestBefore

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end

			
			
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END

(
	@FK int,--StockInLinePK
	@divisionFK int = -1,
	@customerFK int = -1,
	@freeString nvarchar(200) = '' --Batch
)
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT
 ,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;
	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	DECLARE @var_FK INT, @var_divisionFK INT, @var_customerFK INT, @var_freeString NVARCHAR(200)

	SET @var_FK = @FK; SET @var_divisionFK = @divisionFK; SET @var_customerFK = @customerFK; SET @var_freeString = @freeString

	SET @ParameterDetails = '@FK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_FK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@divisionFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_divisionFK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@customerFK = ' 
		+ ISNULL(CAST(@var_customerFK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@freeString = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_freeString AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'')

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    --BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

		SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END


	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY
			

			-- This stored procedures main code, excluding error handling - start

			/*Select All the pallets that moved into a monitored location from the supplied worksorder PK*/
			Select sis.StockItemCode,
			sis.EANCode, 
			pc.Batch, 
			CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), pc.ExpiryDate, 112) as ExpiryDate,
			CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), pc.BestBefore, 112) as BestBefore,
			FLOOR(ROUND(pc.ActualUnits, 0)) ActualUnits,
			uom.ISOCode as UnitOfMeasure,
			pals.CustomerBarcode,
			CONVERT(VARCHAR(10),dbo.GetBSTDate(),112) as DateStatusChange,

			/*LocalStatus*/
			danStat.SAPStatus as LocalStatus,

			/*StorageLocationBefore*/
			CASE WHEN outScrap.ScrapLocationPK is NOT null THEN
				'0002'
			ELSE 
				CASE sis.DivisionFK WHEN 630 THEN
					'0100'	
				WHEN 631 THEN
					'0001'
				WHEN 632 THEN
					'0100'
				END
			END as StorageLocationBefore,

			/*StorageLocationAfter*/
			CASE WHEN inScrap.ScrapLocationPK is NOT null THEN
				'0002'
			ELSE
				CASE sis.DivisionFK WHEN 630 THEN
					'0100'	
				WHEN 631 THEN
					'0001'
				WHEN 632 THEN
					'0100'
				END
			END as StorageLocationAfter,
	

			/*RequiresPositiveRelease*/
			danStat.RequiresPositiveRelease as RequiresPositiveRelease,

			/*ReasonCode*/
			CASE WHEN inScrap.ScrapLocationPK is NOT null THEN
				'5900' 
			ELSE
				'9522'--Jamie : changed from instrustions from danone
				--'9999' --TBC
			END as ReasonCode,

			/*MovementType*/
			CASE WHEN inScrap.ScrapLocationPK is NOT null THEN
				'325' 
			ELSE
				'555' --Jamie : changed from instrustions from danone
				/*CASE danStat.SAPStatus WHEN 'U' THEN
					'333'
				WHEN 'B' THEN
					'335'
				WHEN 'Q' THEN
					'331'
				END*/
			END as MovementType,
	
			css.CustomerReference as SupplierReference
	
			From dbo.tblWorksOrders wos

			inner join dbo.tblWorksOrderMovements woms on
			woms.WorksOrderFK = wos.WorksOrderPK

			inner join dbo.tblPallets pals on
			pals.PalletPK = woms.PalletFK

			inner join (
				Select PalletFK, StockItemFK, Batch, ExpiryDate, BestBefore, sum(ActualUnits) ActualUnits
				From dbo.tblPalletContent
				Group By PalletFK, StockItemFK, Batch, ExpiryDate, BestBefore
			)pc on
			pc.PalletFK = pals.PalletPK

			inner join dbo.tblStockItems sis on
			sis.StockItemPK = pc.StockItemFK

			inner join dbo.cust747tblUnitOfMeasure uom on
			uom.StawmsUnitTypeFK = sis.UnitTypeFK

			left outer join dbo.tblScrapLocations inScrap on
			inScrap.LocationTypeFK = woms.DestinationLocationTypeFK
			AND inScrap.LocationFK = woms.DestinationFK

			left outer join dbo.tblScrapLocations outScrap on
			outScrap.LocationTypeFK = woms.SourceLocationTypeFK
			AND outScrap.LocationFK = woms.SourceLocationFK

			left outer join dbo.tblSampleLocations inSampling on
			woms.DestinationLocationTypeFK = 6 /*SamplingLocation*/
			AND inSampling.SampleLocationPK = woms.DestinationFK

			left outer join dbo.tblSampleLocations outSampling on
			woms.SourceLocationTypeFK = 6 /*SamplingLocation*/
			AND outSampling.SampleLocationPK = woms.SourceLocationFK

			left outer join dbo.tblStockInLinePallets silps on
			silps.PalletFK = pals.PalletPK

			left outer join dbo.tblStockInLines sils on
			sils.StockInLinePK = silps.StockInLineFK

			left outer join dbo.tblStockIns sins on
			sins.StockInPK = sils.StockInFK

			left outer join dbo.tblContainerIns cins on
			cins.ContainerInPK = sins.ContainerInFK

			left outer join dbo.tblCustomerSuppliers css on
			css.SupplierFK = cins.SupplierFK

			CROSS APPLY dbo.cust747funtblDanoneStatusFromStawmsStatus(pals.PalletStatusFK) danStat
	
			Where wos.WorksOrderPK = @var_FK
			AND 
			(inScrap.ScrapLocationPK is NOT null 
			OR (outScrap.ScrapLocationPK is NOT null AND (wos.WorksOrderOriginFK <> 2))
			Or inSampling.SampleLocationPK is NOT null
			OR outSampling.SampleLocationPK is NOT null)
	
			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end

			
			
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[cust747spPalletBarcodeGetNext]
--(
	--@barcode nvarchar(200) OUTPUT
--)
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT

	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	--DECLARE 

	SET @ParameterDetails = ''

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    --BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

		SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
