CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[cust747spStockDiscrepencyDetailToExport]
(
	@divisionFK int = -1,
	@customerFK int = -1,
	@FK int = -1
)
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT
 ,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;
	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	DECLARE @var_divisionFK INT, @var_customerFK INT, @var_FK INT

	SET @var_divisionFK = @divisionFK; SET @var_customerFK = @customerFK; SET @var_FK = @FK

	SET @ParameterDetails = '@divisionFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_divisionFK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@customerFK = ' 
		+ ISNULL(CAST(@var_customerFK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@FK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_FK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'')

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    --BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

		SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END


	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY
			

			-- This stored procedures main code, excluding error handling - start

			Select wos.WorksOrderPK, sds.StockDiscrepencyPK, sds.StockInFk, sds.StockInLineFK, sds.ContainerOutLineFK
			From dbo.tblWorksOrders wos
			inner join dbo.tblStockDiscrepencies sds	on
			sds.StockDiscrepencyPK = wos.FK
			inner join dbo.tblStockDiscrepencyPallets sdps on
			sdps.StockDiscrepencyFK = sds.StockDiscrepencyPK
			inner join dbo.tblStockItems sis on
			sis.StockItemPK = sdps.StockItemFK
			Where wos.WorksOrderOriginFK = 11 /*Discrepency*/
			AND sds.ReconcileStarted = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/
			AND sds.ReconcileComplete = 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/
			AND wos.IntegrationStage1Flag = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/--C21A Sent for Status Change
			AND wos.IntegrationStage2Flag = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/--C76 Received
			AND wos.IntegrationStage3Flag = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/--C76 has been acknoledged
			AND wos.IntegrationStage4Flag = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/--M52 sent for status change
			AND wos.IntegrationStage5Flag = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/--C21 A Sent for Discrepency
			AND wos.IntegrationStage6Flag = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/--C76 received (for discrep)
			AND wos.IntegrationStage7Flag = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/--C16 sent
			AND wos.IntegrationStage8Flag = 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/--M52 Not Sent	
			AND sis.DivisionFK = @var_divisionFK

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end

			
			
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */

-- =============================================

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[cust747spStockInLineUpdateFromBatchStatus]
(
	@FK int,
	@divisionFK int = -1,
	@customerFK int = -1,
	@freeString nvarchar(200) = ''
)
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT
 ,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;
	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	DECLARE @var_FK INT, @var_divisionFK INT, @var_customerFK INT, @var_freeString NVARCHAR(200)

	SET @var_FK = @FK; SET @var_divisionFK = @divisionFK; SET @var_customerFK = @customerFK; SET @var_freeString = @freeString

	SET @ParameterDetails = '@FK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_FK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@divisionFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_divisionFK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@customerFK = ' 
		+ ISNULL(CAST(@var_customerFK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@freeString = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_freeString AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'')

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    --BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

		SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END


	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY
			IF XACT_STATE() = 0 AND @@TRANCOUNT < 1 BEGIN TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName

			-- This stored procedures main code, excluding error handling - start

			--Check if batch status exists
			Declare @stockInLinePalletStatusFK int
			Declare @stockItemBatchPalletStatusFK int
			Declare @stockItemFK int
			Declare @batch nvarchar(200)

			Select @stockItemFK = StockItemFK, @batch = Batch 
			from dbo.tblStockInLines 
			where StockInLinePK = @var_FK

			if(not exists(Select * from dbo.tblStockItemBatchStatus Where StockItemFK = @stockItemFK AND Batch = @batch))
			BEGIN
				ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName
				return
			END

			Select @stockItemBatchPalletStatusFK = StatusFK 
			from dbo.tblStockItemBatchStatus 
			Where StockItemFK = @stockItemFK AND Batch = @batch

			if(@stockItemBatchPalletStatusFK = 1 /*Available*/) 
			BEGIN  --BatchStatus Available
				update dbo.tblStockInLines WITH (ROWLOCK)
				set PalletStatusFK = 1 /*Available*/
				Where StockInLinePK = @var_FK AND PalletStatusFK = 14 /*BatchRestricted*/		

				update pals WITH (ROWLOCK)
				Set PalletStatusFK = 1 /*Available*/
				from dbo.tblPallets pals
				inner join dbo.tblStockInLinePallets silps on
				silps.PalletFK = pals.PalletPK
				Where silps.StockInLineFK = @var_FK AND pals.PalletStatusFK = 14 /*BatchRestricted*/
			END 
			ELSE if(@stockItemBatchPalletStatusFK = 14 /*BatchRestricted*/) 
			BEGIN --Batch Status Restricted
				update dbo.tblStockInLines WITH (ROWLOCK)
				set PalletStatusFK = 14 /*BatchRestricted*/
				Where StockInLinePK = @var_FK AND PalletStatusFK = 1 /*Available*/

				update pals WITH (ROWLOCK)
				Set PalletStatusFK = 14 /*BatchRestricted*/
				from dbo.tblPallets pals
				inner join dbo.tblStockInLinePallets silps on
				silps.PalletFK = pals.PalletPK
				Where silps.StockInLineFK = @var_FK AND pals.PalletStatusFK = 1 /*Available*/
			END

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end

			BEGIN TRY IF XACT_STATE() = 1 AND @@TRANCOUNT = 1 AND @OpeningTranCount < 1 COMMIT TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH
			
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END

	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY
			IF XACT_STATE() = 0 AND @@TRANCOUNT < 1 BEGIN TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName

			-- This stored procedures main code, excluding error handling - start

			IF(EXISTS(Select * from dbo.tblPalletStatusQueue Where CustomerFK = @var_customerFK and CustomerBarcode = @var_freeString)) 
			BEGIN
				--We have a queued pallet staus.. Change the StockInLine
				DECLARE @palletStatusFK int
				DECLARE @specialStockTypeFK int
				DECLARE @statusInstruction nvarchar(100)

				SELECT Top 1 
				@palletStatusFK = ToPalletStatusFK,
				@specialStockTypeFK = ToSpecialStockTypeFK,
				@statusInstruction = StatusInstruction 
				FROM dbo.tblPalletStatusQueue 
				WHERE CustomerFK = @var_customerFK AND CustomerBarcode = @var_freeString
				ORDER BY InsertedDate DESC
 
				--We now have the data we need from the PalletStatusQueue
				--Make decision how to carry out instruction(s)
				IF (@statusInstruction <> '') 
				BEGIN
					--We have a status instruction
					DECLARE @currentStatusFK int

					Select @currentStatusFK = PalletStatusFK from dbo.tblStockInLines where StockInLinePK = @var_FK

					Declare @tempPalletStatusFK table
					(
						PalletStatusFK int
					)

					Insert @tempPalletStatusFK EXEC spPalletStatusFromReference -1, @var_customerFK, @currentStatusFK, @statusInstruction

					UPDATE dbo.tblStockInLines WITH (ROWLOCK)
					SET PalletStatusFK = (Select Top 1 PalletStatusFK from @tempPalletStatusFK)
					WHERE StockInLinePK = @var_FK
				END 
				ELSE IF(@palletStatusFK > 0) 
				BEGIN
					--We have a pallet status FK, go ahead and change
					UPDATE dbo.tblStockInLines WITH (ROWLOCK)
					SET PalletStatusFK = @palletStatusFK
					WHERE StockInLinePK = @var_FK
				END 
				ELSE IF (@specialStockTypeFK > 0) 
				BEGIN
					UPDATE dbo.tblStockInLines WITH (ROWLOCK)
					SET SpecialStockTypeFK = @specialStockTypeFK
					WHERE StockInLinePK = @var_FK
				END

			END 
	
			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end

			BEGIN TRY IF XACT_STATE() = 1 AND @@TRANCOUNT = 1 AND @OpeningTranCount < 1 COMMIT TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH
			
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END
GO

			Declare @stockItemFK int
			Declare @batch nvarchar(200)

			from dbo.tblStockItemBatchStatus 
			Where StockItemBatchStatusPK = @var_FK

			if(@palletStatusFK = 1 /*Available*/) 
			BEGIN
				update pals WITH (ROWLOCK)
				Set PalletStatusFK = 1 /*Available*/
				from dbo.tblPallets pals
				inner join (
					Select PalletFK, StockItemFK, Batch from dbo.tblPalletContent
					Group By PalletFK, StockItemFK, Batch
				) pc on
				pc.PalletFK = pals.PalletPK
				Where pc.StockItemFK = @stockItemFK AND pc.Batch = @batch AND (pals.PalletStatusFK = 14 /*BatchRestricted*/ OR pals.PalletStatusFK = 7)
			END ELSE if(@palletStatusFK = 14 /*BatchRestricted*/) 
			BEGIN
				update pals WITH (ROWLOCK)
				Set PalletStatusFK = 14 /*BatchRestricted*/
				from dbo.tblPallets pals
				inner join (
					Select PalletFK, StockItemFK, Batch from dbo.tblPalletContent
					Group By PalletFK, StockItemFK, Batch
				) pc on
				pc.PalletFK = pals.PalletPK
				Where pc.StockItemFK = @stockItemFK AND pc.Batch = @batch AND pals.PalletStatusFK = 1 /*Available*/
			END

			BEGIN TRY IF XACT_STATE() = 1 AND @@TRANCOUNT = 1 AND @OpeningTranCount < 1 COMMIT TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH
			
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;

(
	@containerOutPK int,
	@userFK int
)	
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT
	,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;
	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	DECLARE @var_containerOutPK int, @var_userFK int
	SET @var_containerOutPK = @containerOutPK; SET @var_userFK = @userFK
	SET @ParameterDetails = '@containerOutPK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_containerOutPK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@userFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_userFK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'')

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    --BEGIN

		SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END

	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY
			
			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start

			select p.barcode, '' as BoxNum, s.stockitemcode, s.description, pc.batch, colpc.Units, 'EA' as UOM, co.GoodsOrderNumber
			from tblcontainerouts co
			inner join tblcontaineroutlines col on containeroutfk = containeroutpk
			inner join tblcontaineroutlinepalletcontent colpc on containeroutlinefk = containeroutlinepk
			inner join tblpalletcontent pc on palletcontentfk = palletcontentpk
			inner join tblpallets p on colpc.palletfk= palletpk
			inner join tblstockitems s on pc.stockitemfk = s.stockitempk
			where containeroutfk = @var_containerOutPK
			order by s.stockitemcode ASC, pc.batch ASC, BoxNum ASC

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end
						
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[cust783spReportsPackingList]
(
    -- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here
    @ContainerOutPK int = 0,
    @UserFK int = 0
)
AS
BEGIN  
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT

	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	DECLARE @var_containerOutPK int, @var_userFK int
	SET @var_containerOutPK = @containerOutPK; SET @var_userFK = @userFK
	SET @ParameterDetails = '@containerOutPK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_containerOutPK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@userFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_userFK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'')

         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --BEGIN

		SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK,-1)

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END

	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY
			
			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start 

			DECLARE @DeliveryNumber varchar(50)

			IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ResultSet') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #ResultSet

			CREATE TABLE #ResultSet(SelectedValue varchar(50))

			DECLARE @Param int

			Select @Param = StockOrderPK from tblStockOrders where ContainerOutFK = @var_containerOutPK

			INSERT INTO #ResultSet (SelectedValue)
			EXEC spStockOrderGetDeliveryNumber @Param

			SELECT @DeliveryNumber = ISNULL(SelectedValue,'') FROM #ResultSet 

			declare @_ConsigneeNo varchar(50)
			declare @ConsigneeNo varchar(50)

			--declare @Var_SupplierBatch varchar(50)
			select @_ConsigneeNo = ISNULL(CustomerFK,'-1') from tblDeliveryAddresses where DeliveryAddressPK=(select DeliveryAddressFK 
			from tblContainerOuts where ContainerOutPK=@var_containerOutPK)

			if (@_ConsigneeNo = '-1' )

				select @ConsigneeNo = isnull(CustomerCode,'') from tblCustomers where CustomerPK = @_ConsigneeNo

			 Where cols.ContainerOutFK = @var_containerOutPK  

			Select  cOuts.GoodsOrderNumber,couts.InsertedDate as InceptionDate,cOuts.DeliveryDate,cOuts.CollectionDate,sis.StockItemCode,cols.Batch, 
			case when PalletsOut is null then 0 else count(distinct co_ol_pc.palletfk) end as pallets,  count(distinct co_ol_pc.palletcontentfk)eaches, sum(co_ol_pc.units) units,
		isnull(TransportCompany, '') TransportCompany,
			isnull(ShippingCompany , '') ShippingCompany, 
			cOuts.Address1,SupplierBatch,cOuts.Address2,cOuts.Address3,cOuts.Address4,cOuts.Address5,counties.County,countries.Country,edps.Parameter1,edps.Parameter2,
			edps.Parameter3,edps.Parameter4,edps.Parameter5,edps.Parameter6,edps.Parameter7,edps.Parameter8,edps.Parameter9,edps.Parameter10,edps.Parameter11,edps.Parameter12,

			sis.Description,cOuts.Free1 coutFree1,cOuts.Free2 coutFree2,cOuts.Free4 coutFree4,cOuts.Free5 coutFree5,cols.Free1 colsFree1,cols.Free2 colsFree2,
			cols.Free3 colsFree3,cols.Free4 colsFree4,cols.Free5 colsFree5,cOuts.DocketValue2,cOuts.DocketValue1, DocketLabel1, DocketLabel2,cOuts.DocketValue3, DocketLabel3,cols.Free4 CommodityCode,cOuts.SoldToName,cOuts.SoldToAddress1, 
			cOuts.SoldToAddress2,cOuts.SoldToAddress3,cOuts.SoldToAddress4,cOuts.SoldToAddress5, CASE WHEN p.customerbarcode = '' THEN p.barcode ELSE p.customerbarcode END AS PalletBarcode, p.customerpalletnumber,
			case when cols.Units = 0 then cast(1 as decimal(18,3)) else cols.Units end  / (case when cols.Free3 = '' then 
			cast(1 as decimal(18,3)) else cols.Free3 end) as UnitCount,
			Cast( 
					(Cols.Units / 
						(case when cols.Units = 0 then cast(1 as decimal(18,3)) else cols.Units end / (case when cols.Free3 = '' then 
						cast(1 as decimal(18,3)) else cols.Free3 end))
					)
				as Decimal(18,3)
			) as UnitWeight,ut.Abbreviation,--case pa_co.DateOfManufacture when '1900-01-01 00:00:00.000' then '' when null then '' end as ProductionDate
			case pa_co.DateOfManufacture when '1900-01-01 00:00:00.000' then '' else pa_co.DateOfManufacture end as ProductionDate,
			cOuts.Comments,pa_co.supplierbatch,CAST(cOuts.Weight AS INT) Weight
   			 From 
				tblContainerOuts cOuts  
				inner join tblContainerOutLines cols  on  cols.ContainerOutFK = cOuts.ContainerOutPK  
				inner join tblContainerOutLinePalletContent co_ol_pc on cols.ContainerOutLinePK = co_ol_pc.ContainerOutLineFK
				inner JOIN dbo.tblPalletContent pa_co on co_ol_pc.PalletContentFK = pa_co.PalletContentPK
				INNER JOIN tblpallets p ON p.palletpk = pa_co.palletfk
				inner join tblDivisions divisions on divisions.DivisionPK = cols.DivisionFK  
				inner join tblStockItems sis on sis.StockItemPK = cols.StockItemFK  
				left outer JOIN tblCustomers customers on divisions.CustomerFK = customers.CustomerPK
				left outer join  tblCounties counties  on   counties.CountyPK = cOuts.CountyFK  
				left outer join  tblCountries countries  on countries.CountryPK = cOuts.CountryFK  
				left outer join  tblTransportCompanies transport  on  transport.TransportCompanyPK = cOuts.TransportCompanyFK  
				left outer join tblShippingCompanies shippingComp on  shippingComp.ShippingCompanyPK = cOuts.ShippingCompanyFK
				left outer join  tblExtraDockets eds  on  eds.ExtraDocketTypeFK = 3 /*Stock Out Packing List*/ AND eds.CustomerFK = @customerFK  				
				left outer join  tblExtraDocketParameterSets edps  on   edps.ExtraDocketFK = eds.ExtraDocketPK 
				inner join  tblUnitTypes ut  on  ut.UnitTypePK = sis.UnitTypeFK 
				left outer join (
						Select 1 PalletsOut, PalletFK, EventFK
						from tblPalletAudit 
						Where EventTypeFK = 2
						Group By EventFK, PalletFK
					)palletsOutPA on palletsOutPA.EventFK = cols.ContainerOutLinePK AND palletsOutPA.PalletFK = co_ol_pc.PalletFK	
			Where  ContainerOutPK = @var_containerOutPK 
			group by cOuts.GoodsOrderNumber,couts.InsertedDate,cOuts.DeliveryDate,cOuts.CollectionDate,sis.StockItemCode,cols.Batch, 
			--case when cols.Pallets > 0 then 1 end Pallets, 		
			divisions.Address1 ,divisions.Address2 , divisions.Address3 ,divisions.Address4 ,divisions.Address5 ,		
			 TransportCompany, ShippingCompany, 
			cOuts.Address1,SupplierBatch,cOuts.Address2,cOuts.Address3,cOuts.Address4,cOuts.Address5,counties.County,countries.Country,edps.Parameter1,edps.Parameter2,
			edps.Parameter3,edps.Parameter4,edps.Parameter5,edps.Parameter6,edps.Parameter7,edps.Parameter8,edps.Parameter9,edps.Parameter10,edps.Parameter11,edps.Parameter12,
			edps.Parameter13,edps.Parameter14,edps.Parameter15,edps.Parameter16,edps.Parameter17,edps.Parameter18,edps.Parameter19,edps.Parameter20,divisions.DivisionName,
			cOuts.Free1 ,cOuts.Free2 ,cOuts.Free4 ,cOuts.Free5 ,cols.Free1 ,cols.Free2 ,
			cols.Free3 ,cols.Free4 ,cols.Free5 ,cOuts.DocketValue2,cols.Free4 ,cOuts.DocketValue1,DocketLabel1, DocketLabel2,cOuts.DocketValue3, DocketLabel3,
			cOuts.ContainerNumber,cOuts.SealNumber,customers.CustomerCode,
			sis.Description,cOuts.SoldToName,cOuts.SoldToAddress1, 
			cOuts.SoldToAddress2,cOuts.SoldToAddress3,cOuts.SoldToAddress4,cOuts.SoldToAddress5,
			 cols.Units,
			ut.Abbreviation,--case pa_co.DateOfManufacture when '1900-01-01 00:00:00.000' then '' when null then '' end as ProductionDate
			 pa_co.DateOfManufacture ,
			cOuts.Comments,pa_co.supplierbatch,cOuts.Weight, PalletsOut, p.customerbarcode, p.barcode, p.customerpalletnumber
				Order By sis.StockItemCode, cols.Batch
			
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;

			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END

				case cOuts.Free2 when 'TRSF' then 'To:' when 'RTSR' then 'To:' else 'Ship To:' end as DeliverToTitle,
				cOuts.Free2 as DeliveryType    

			from tblContainerOuts cOuts
			inner join tblContainerOutLines cOutLines ON cOutLines.ContainerOutFK = cOuts.ContainerOutPK
			inner join tblContainerOutLinePalletContent colpc ON colpc.ContainerOutLineFK = cOutLines.ContainerOutLinePK

			left outer join (
				Select 1 PalletsOut, PalletFK, EventFK
				from tblPalletAudit 
				Where EventTypeFK = 2
				Group By EventFK, PalletFK
			)palletsOutPA ON palletsOutPA.EventFK = cOutLines.ContainerOutLinePK AND palletsOutPA.PalletFK = colpc.PalletFK

			left outer join tblShippingCompanies shippingCompanies ON shippingCompanies.ShippingCompanyPK = cOuts.ShippingCompanyFK
			inner join tblDivisions divisions ON divisions.DivisionPK = cOutLines.DivisionFK
			inner join tblStockItems stockItems on stockItems.StockItemPK = cOutLines.StockItemFK
			left outer join tblUnitTypes unitTypes on unitTypes.UnitTypePK = stockItems.UnitTypeFK
			left outer join tblTransportCompanies transportCompanies on transportCompanies.TransportCompanyPK = cOuts.TransportCompanyFK
		    inner join tblPallets ps on ps.Palletpk = colpc.PalletFK
			inner join tblPalletTypes pt on ps.PalletTypeFK = pt.PalletTypePK
			inner join appSystem system ON 1=1 --only one record in the system.. join it
			left outer join tblPalletContent pc ON pc.PalletContentPK = colpc.PalletContentFK			
			where cOuts.ContainerOutPK = @var_containerOutPK
			Order By StockItemCode, Batch

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end
						
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */

			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID

			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END

		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END

			Declare @batchPrefix nvarchar(50), @nextBatch int, @generatedBatch nvarchar(200)

			SELECT @batchPrefix = '32'

			Select @nextBatch = 70
			Select @nextBatch = isnull(max(SequentialNumber), 70) + 1
			FROM cust747tblGeneratedBatches gbs
			Where convert(varchar(10), gbs.GeneratedDate, 103) = convert(varchar(10), dbo.GetBSTDate(), 103)

			Set @generatedBatch = right(DATEPART(yy,dbo.GetBSTDate()),2) + right('0' + cast(DATEPART(mm,dbo.GetBSTDate()) as varchar(10)),2) + right('0' + cast(DATEPART(dd,dbo.GetBSTDate()) as varchar(2)), 2) + @batchPrefix + right('000000000000000000' + cast(@nextBatch as nvarchar(50)), 2)
				
			Insert into cust747tblGeneratedBatches values (

			)

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID

			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */

-- =============================================
-- Author:      <Author, , Name>
-- Create Date: <09/04/2024 >
-- Description: <Query on pallet locations placed in a warehouse at a time >
-- =============================================
Create PROCEDURE  [dbo].[sp.WOMLocationsCG]

    -- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here
--    <@Param1, sysname, @p1> <Datatype_For_Param1, , int> = <Default_Value_For_Param1, , 0>,
   -- <@Param2, sysname, @p2> <Datatype_For_Param2, , int> = <Default_Value_For_Param2, , 0>

AS
BEGIN
    -- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from
    -- interfering with SELECT statements.
    SET NOCOUNT ON

 drop table if exists #tmpkilmovements
select * into #tmpkilmovements from tblWorksOrderMovements where worksordermovementpk > 12507500 /*this is as close to 1st Jan 2023 as I could find*/

drop table if exists #alllocations
select * into #alllocations from viewBuildingUnitBays
--select top 10 * from #tmpkilmovements order by UpdatedDate asc

 --select * from tblworksordermovements where worksordermovementpk = 14553411

--out off location
select top 100000000 worksordermovementpk, u.UserName, woms.MovementDescription, woms.UpdatedDate, vw.BuildingName, vw.BuildingUnit, HandheldDeviceFK, WarehouseMachineFK, vw.BuildingUnitBayLocation as FromLocation,  vwto.BuildingUnitBayLocation as ToLocation,
lt.LocationType as FromLocationType, 'Into' as Direction
from #tmpkilmovements woms 
inner join #alllocations vw on woms.SourceLocationTypeFK = vw.locationTypeFK and woms.SourceLocationFK = vw.BuildingUnitBayPK
inner join #alllocations vwTo on woms.DestinationLocationTypeFK = vwTo.locationTypeFK and woms.DestinationFK = vwto.BuildingUnitBayPK
inner join tblUsers u on woms.UpdatedBy = u.userpk
left join appLocationTypes lt on lt.LocationTypePK = vw.locationTypeFK
where (vw.BuildingName = 'BV4' or vw.BuildingName = 'BV5') and ((SourceLocationFK <> DestinationFK and SourceLocationTypeFK = DestinationLocationTypeFK) or SourceLocationTypeFK <> DestinationLocationTypeFK)
--order by woms.UpdatedDate
union
--into location 
select top 10 worksordermovementpk, u.UserName, woms.MovementDescription, woms.UpdatedDate, vw.BuildingName, vw.BuildingUnit, HandheldDeviceFK, WarehouseMachineFK, vw.BuildingUnitBayLocation as FromLocation,  vwto.BuildingUnitBayLocation as ToLocation,
lt.LocationType as FromLocationType, 'OutOff' as Direction
from #tmpkilmovements woms 
inner join #alllocations vw on woms.DestinationLocationTypeFK = vw.locationTypeFK and woms.DestinationFK = vw.BuildingUnitBayPK
inner join #alllocations vwTo on woms.SourceLocationTypeFK = vwTo.locationTypeFK and woms.SourceLocationFK = vwTo.BuildingUnitBayPK
inner join tblUsers u on woms.UpdatedBy = u.userpk
left join appLocationTypes lt on lt.LocationTypePK = vw.locationTypeFK
where (vw.BuildingName = 'BV4' or vw.BuildingName = 'BV5')  and ((SourceLocationFK <> DestinationFK and SourceLocationTypeFK = DestinationLocationTypeFK) or SourceLocationTypeFK <> DestinationLocationTypeFK)
order by woms.UpdatedDate
    --SELECT <@Param1, sysname, @p1>, <@Param2, sysname, @p2>
END

-- =============================================      
-- Author:  <Charlene Gordon created, script wrote by Jamie Clerkin>      
-- Create date: <08/07/2022,>      
-- Description: <Pallet Movements between builidings and building units>      
-- =============================================      
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_CG_MovmentsBetweenBuildings]      
(      
 @datetocheck2 Date      
)       
AS      
BEGIN      
 /* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */      
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED      
      
    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT      
 ,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;      
 SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();      
      
 -- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters      
 DECLARE @datetocheck Date      
      
 SET @datetocheck = @datetocheck2      
      
 SET @ParameterDetails = '@datetocheck2 = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@datetocheck AS NVARCHAR(20)),'')      
      
    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL       
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)      
      
    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)      
    --BEGIN      
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC       
      
  SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)      
      
        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)      
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK      
      
        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()      
    --END      
      
      
 SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);      
 SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails      
 ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;      
 INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()      
      
 WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3      
 BEGIN       
  BEGIN TRY      
         
      
   -- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start      
      
  print 'get max move pk'    
print CONVERT(varchar, SYSDATETIME(), 121)    
  declare @Maxmovementpk int    
  SET @Maxmovementpk = (select top 1 worksordermovementpk from tblworksordermovements order by worksordermovementpk desc)    
  
 --get top 25k movements based of most recent  
print 'get top 25k moves'    
print CONVERT(varchar, SYSDATETIME(), 121)    
  drop table if exists #totalMovements    
  select *    
  into #totalMovements    
  from tblworksordermovements    
  where worksordermovementpk >= (@Maxmovementpk - 25000)    
  
--remove any of these 25 that dont match given date  
print 'get all relevant moves'    
delete from #totalMovements where cast(updateddate as date) <> @datetocheck  
  
--load up all locations  
drop table if exists #tmpAllLocations  
select * into #tmpAllLocations from viewBuildingUnitBays   
  
--check which movements building units dont match based of source & destination fks  
drop table if exists #tmpMovementsDifferentBuildingUnits  
select worksordermovementpk, palletfk, SourceLoc.BuildingName SourceBuilding, SourceLoc.BuildingUnit SourceBuildingunit, 
sourceloc.BuildingUnitBayLocation SourceLocation, destLoc.BuildingName DestBuilding, destLoc.BuildingUnit DestBuildingUnit,
destLoc.BuildingUnitBayLocation DestLocation, woms.UpdatedDate  
into #tmpMovementsDifferentBuildingUnits  
from #totalMovements woms  
inner join #tmpAllLocations SourceLoc on SourceLoc.locationTypeFK = woms.sourcelocationtypefk and woms.SourceLocationFK = SourceLoc.BuildingUnitBayPK  
inner join #tmpAllLocations destLoc on destLoc.locationTypeFK = woms.DestinationLocationTypeFK and woms.DestinationFK = destLoc.BuildingUnitBayPK  
where SourceLoc.BuildingUnit <> destLoc.BuildingUnit  
  
--movements between building units  
select distinct moves.*, case when pallets.customerbarcode = '' then pallets.barcode else pallets.CustomerBarcode end as PalletBarcode, DivisionCode, StockItemCode, Batch  
from #tmpMovementsDifferentBuildingUnits moves  
inner join tblpallets pallets on pallets.palletpk = moves.palletfk  
inner join tblpalletcontent pc on pc.palletfk = pallets.palletpk  
inner join tblstockitems stock on stock.stockitempk = pc.stockitemfk  
inner join tbldivisions divs on divs.divisionpk = stock.divisionfk  
  
--movements between buildings  
select distinct moves.*, case when pallets.customerbarcode = '' then pallets.barcode else pallets.CustomerBarcode end as PalletBarcode, DivisionCode, StockItemCode, Batch  
from #tmpMovementsDifferentBuildingUnits moves  
inner join tblpallets pallets on pallets.palletpk = moves.palletfk  
inner join tblpalletcontent pc on pc.palletfk = pallets.palletpk  
inner join tblstockitems stock on stock.stockitempk = pc.stockitemfk  
inner join tbldivisions divs on divs.divisionpk = stock.divisionfk  
where DestBuilding <> SourceBuilding   
   -- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end         
   BREAK      
  END TRY      
  BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */      
   DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;      
   SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;      
   SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;      
      
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY       
   BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;      
             
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;      
      
            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID      
                  
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;      
                  
   IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)      
   BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END      
   ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */      
  END CATCH      
  SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1      
 END      
END 
GO

from #totalMovements woms    
inner join #tmpAllLocations SourceLoc on SourceLoc.locationTypeFK = woms.sourcelocationtypefk and woms.SourceLocationFK = SourceLoc.BuildingUnitBayPK    
inner join #tmpAllLocations destLoc on destLoc.locationTypeFK = woms.DestinationLocationTypeFK and woms.DestinationFK = destLoc.BuildingUnitBayPK 
Inner JOIN tblUsers tu ON woms.UpdatedBy = tu.UserPK
inner join tblPeople tp ON tu.PersonFK = tp.PersonPK
where SourceLoc.BuildingUnit <> destLoc.BuildingUnit    
and( (woms.UpdatedDate > @dateFromcheck2) AND (woms.UpdatedDate < @datetocheck2))  
    
--movements between building units    
--select distinct moves.*, case when pallets.customerbarcode = '' then pallets.barcode else pallets.CustomerBarcode end as PalletBarcode, DivisionCode, StockItemCode, Batch    
--from #tmpMovementsDifferentBuildingUnits moves    
--inner join tblpallets pallets on pallets.palletpk = moves.palletfk    
--inner join tblpalletcontent pc on pc.palletfk = pallets.palletpk    
--inner join tblstockitems stock on stock.stockitempk = pc.stockitemfk    
--inner join tbldivisions divs on divs.divisionpk = stock.divisionfk   
--where ( (moves.UpdatedDate > @dateFromcheck2) AND (moves.UpdatedDate < @datetocheck2))  
    
--movements between buildings    
select distinct moves.*, case when pallets.customerbarcode = '' then pallets.barcode else pallets.CustomerBarcode end as PalletBarcode, DivisionCode, StockItemCode, Batch    
from #tmpMovementsDifferentBuildingUnits moves    
inner join tblpallets pallets on pallets.palletpk = moves.palletfk    
inner join tblpalletcontent pc on pc.palletfk = pallets.palletpk    
inner join tblstockitems stock on stock.stockitempk = pc.stockitemfk    
inner join tbldivisions divs on divs.divisionpk = stock.divisionfk  
where DestinationBuilding <> SourceBuilding     
and( (moves.UpdatedDate > @dateFromcheck2) AND (moves.UpdatedDate < @datetocheck2))  
   -- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end           
   BREAK        
  END TRY        
  BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */        
   DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;        
   SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;        
   SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;        
        
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY         
   BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;        
               
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;        
        
            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID        
                    
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;        
                    
   IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)        
   BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END        
   ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */        
  END CATCH        
  SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1        
 END

		end

		else

			select case when COUNT(silp.palletfk) > 0 then CAST(0 as bit) else CAST(1 as bit) end as CompareRequired  
			from tblStockInLines sil  
			inner join tblStockInLinePallets silp on StockInLineFK = StockInLinePK  
			left join tblMobstaBarcodecompareHistory ch on silp.palletfk = ch.PalletFK  
			where ch.MobstaBarcodecompareHistoryPK is null and StockInFK = @var_StockinPK 
		end

  SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)              
              
        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)              
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK              
              
        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()              
    --END              
              
              
 SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);              
 SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails              
 ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;              
 INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()              
              
 WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3              
 BEGIN               
  BEGIN TRY              
                 
              
   -- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start              
     select   BuildingUnitBayPK,ccb.CycleCountBayPK ,BuildingUnitBayLocation,  
  --RackingTypeFK,Row,ColumnNo ,BayLevel,BuildingUnitCOlumnFK ,  
  case when ccb.CycleCountBayStatusFk IS NULL then 'Pending' else ccs.CycleCountBayStatus end as Status         
        ,  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE 
        WHEN ccr.Resolved = 1 
        THEN ccr.CycleCountBayResultPk 
    END) AS NoOfResolved,
   -- SUM(CASE WHEN ccr.Resolved = null then 0  WHEN ccr.Resolved = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS NoOfUnresolved,
   COUNT(DISTINCT CASE 
        WHEN ccr.Resolved = 0 
        THEN ccr.CycleCountBayResultPk 
    END) AS NoOfUnresolved,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ccp.CycleCountPalletPk) AS NoOfPalletChecked
from viewbuildingunitbays vwb          
left join tblCycleCountBays ccb on ccb.BuildingUnitBayFK = vwb.BuildingUnitBayPK          
left join AppCycleCountBayStatus ccs  on ccs.CycleCountBayStatusPK = ccb.CycleCountBayStatusFk 
LEFT JOIN tblCycleCountBayResult ccr 
    ON ccr.CycleCountBayFk = ccb.CycleCountBayPK
LEFT JOIN tblCycleCountPallets ccp 
    ON ccp.CycleCountBayFk = ccb.CycleCountBayPK
where buildingunitfk = @var_BuildingUnitFk and row = @var_Row           
 --and (( rackingtypefk = 2 and baylevel = 'A') or (rackingtypefk = 1))       
 and CycleCountFK = @var_CycleCountPk  
  Group By BuildingUnitBayPK,ccb.CycleCountBayPK ,BuildingUnitBayLocation,ccb.CycleCountBayStatusFk ,ccs.CycleCountBayStatus
 --order by CycleCountBayStatusFk, case when @var_direction = 1 then BayLevel else cast(ColumnNo as nvarchar(10)) end           
   -- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end              
              
                 
                 
   BREAK              
  END TRY              
  BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */              
   DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;              
   SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;              
   SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;              
              
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY               
   BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;              
                     
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;              
              
            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID              
                          
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;              
                          
   IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)              
   BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END              
   ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */              
  END CATCH              
  SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1              
 END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_GetCycleCountForBuilding]

 --@Columns int = -1,  
 @CycleCountStatus int = -1,  
 @FromDate datetime= '19000101',      
 @ToDate datetime= '19000101'  
)              
AS

 --DECLARE

 ,@var_CycleCountStatus int= @CycleCountStatus  
            ,@var_FromDate datetime =@FromDate, @var_ToDate datetime =@ToDate   
  
  
  
 SET @ParameterDetails ='@BuildingPk = ' + ISNULL(cast(@var_BuildingPk AS nvarchar(50)) ,'') +      '@BuildingUnitFk = ' + ISNULL(cast(@var_BuildingUnitFk AS nvarchar(50)) ,'')  --+ ', @isMobsta = ' + ISNULL(cast(@varIsMobsta AS nvarchar(50)) ,'')        
       
          +  '@Row = ' + ISNULL(cast(@var_Row AS nvarchar(50)) ,'')    
    --+  '@Columns = ' + ISNULL(cast(@var_Columns AS nvarchar(50)) ,'')  
    +  '@CycleCountStatus = ' + ISNULL(cast(@var_CycleCountStatus AS nvarchar(50)) ,'')  
     + ',@FromDate = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_FromDate AS NVARCHAR(20)),'')     
  + ',@ToDate = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_ToDate AS NVARCHAR(20)),'')    
    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL               
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

  SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)              
              
        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)              
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

 SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails              
 ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;              
 INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()              
              
 WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3              
 BEGIN               
  BEGIN TRY              
                 
              
   -- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start       
     select distinct  CycleCountPk--,bldg.BuildingPK  
 ,cc.BuildingUnitFk , bur.Row , ccs.CycleCountStatus,Cast(cc.DueDate as Date) As DueDate  
  ,bldg.BuildingName + ' - ' +  bu.BuildingUnit as BuildingName    
 -- case when ccs.CycleCountStatus = 'Pending' then 'Red'  when ccs.CycleCountStatus = 'Active' then 'Orange'  else 'Black' End as Color    
  , COUNT(DISTINCT CASE 
        WHEN ccr.Resolved = 1 
        THEN ccr.CycleCountBayResultPk 
    END) AS NoOfResolved,
   -- SUM(CASE WHEN ccr.Resolved = null then 0  WHEN ccr.Resolved = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS NoOfUnresolved,
   COUNT(DISTINCT CASE 
        WHEN ccr.Resolved = 0 
        THEN ccr.CycleCountBayResultPk 
    END) AS NoOfUnresolved,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ccp.CycleCountPalletPk) AS NoOfPalletChecked
  
  from tblCycleCount cc   
    
  left join tblbuildingUnits bu on cc.BuildingUnitFk = bu.BuildingUnitPK  
  inner join tblbuildings bldg on bu.BuildingFK = bldg.BuildingPK  
  inner join tblbuildingUnitRows bur on bur.BuildingUnitRowPk = cc.BuildingUnitRowFk        
  inner join AppCycleCountStatus ccs on cc.CycleCountStatusFk =ccs.CycleCountStatusPK  
  inner join viewbuildingunitbays vwb on cc.BuildingUnitFK = vwb.BuildingUnitPK 
  
  LEFT JOIN tblCycleCountBays ccb 
    ON cc.CycleCountPk = ccb.CycleCountFK
LEFT JOIN tblCycleCountBayResult ccr 
    ON ccr.CycleCountBayFk = ccb.CycleCountBayPK
LEFT JOIN tblCycleCountPallets ccp 
    ON ccp.CycleCountBayFk = ccb.CycleCountBayPK
  where  
 -- bldg.BuildingPK = @var_BuildingPk OR cc.BuildingUnitFk = @var_BuildingUnitFk  and CycleCountStatusFk !=4    
 -- and bur.Row = @var_Row  
   (@var_BuildingUnitFk = -1 OR cc.BuildingUnitFk = @var_BuildingUnitFk)  
AND (@var_BuildingPk = -1 OR bldg.BuildingPK = @var_BuildingPk)  
AND (@var_Row = '' OR bur.Row = @var_Row)  
--And (@var_Columns=-1 OR vwb.BuildingUnitBayPK =@var_Columns   )  
AND (@var_CycleCountStatus=-1 OR cc.CycleCountStatusFk =@var_CycleCountStatus   )    
And (cc.DueDate > @var_FromDate AND cc.DueDate < @var_ToDate)  
--AND cc.CycleCountStatusFk != 4  
 GROUP BY 
    cc.CycleCountPk,
    cc.BuildingUnitFk
	, bur.Row
	,ccs.CycleCountStatus
	,cc.DueDate,bldg.BuildingName ,  bu.BuildingUnit
 order by BuildingName, DueDate ,bur.Row        
   -- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end              
              
                 
                 
   BREAK              
  END TRY              
  BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */              
   DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;

   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY               
   BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;              
                     
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;              
              
            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID              
                          
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;              
                          
   IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)              
   BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END              
   ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */              
  END CATCH              
  SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1              
 END              
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_GetCycleCountPallets]

 --@UserFK int  , 
 @CycleCountBayPk int= -1,
 @CycleCountPk int =-1,
 @Resolved bit ,
 @Unresolved bit,
 @Showall bit,
 @Showcorrect bit


)            
AS            
BEGIN            
 /* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */            
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED            
            
    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT            
 ,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;            
 SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();            
            
 -- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters            
 --DECLARE             
            
 DECLARE   @var_CycleCountBayPk int = @CycleCountBayPk ,
 @var_CycleCountPk int = @CycleCountPk   , @var_Resolved bit= @Resolved , @var_Unresolved bit =@Unresolved ,
 @var_Showall bit =@Showall ,
 @var_showcorrect bit = @Showcorrect 


 SET @ParameterDetails ='@CycleCountBayPk = ' + ISNULL(cast(@var_CycleCountBayPk AS nvarchar(50)) ,'')
  + '@CycleCountPk = ' + ISNULL(cast(@var_CycleCountPk AS nvarchar(50)) ,'')
  + ', @Resolved = ' + ISNULL(cast(@var_Resolved AS nvarchar(50)) ,'') 
    + ', @Unresolved = ' + ISNULL(cast(@var_Unresolved AS nvarchar(50)) ,'') 
	  + ', @Showall = ' + ISNULL(cast(@var_Showall AS nvarchar(50)) ,'') 
	    + ', @Showcorrect = ' + ISNULL(cast(@var_showcorrect AS nvarchar(50)) ,'') 

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL             
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)            
            
    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)            
    --BEGIN            
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC             
            
  SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)            
            
        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)            
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK            
            
        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()            
    --END            
            
            
 SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);            
 SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails            
 ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;            
 INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()            
            
 WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3            
 BEGIN             
  BEGIN TRY            
               
   -- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start   

      IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#TempCycleCountAllResults1') IS NOT NULL  
   DROP TABLE #TempCycleCountResults1

    select distinct Case when ccr.CycleCountBayResultPk Is NULL then -1 else ccr.CycleCountBayResultPk end as CycleCountBayResultPk ,
	Case when ccr.CycleCountBayFk is null then ccp.CycleCountBayFk else ccr.CycleCountBayFk end as CycleCountBayFk ,
   Case when ccr.PalletFk Is NULL then ccp.palletfk else ccr.PalletFk end as PalletFk ,	ccr.ProblemTypeFk,	ccr.ProblemDescription,	ccr.Resolved
   ,Case when ccr.InsertedDate Is NULL then ccp.InsertedDate else ccr.InsertedDate end as InsertedDate
   
   ,ccp.PalletDetailsAllCorrect
      into #TempCycleCountResults1
   from tblCycleCOuntBayResult ccr 
Full Outer Join  tblCycleCountPallets ccp on ccp.CycleCountBayFk = ccr.CycleCountBayFk and ccr.palletfk = ccp.palletfk
left join tblCycleCountBays ccb on  ccb.CycleCountBayPK = ccr.CycleCountBayFK or ccb.CycleCountBayPK = ccp.CycleCountBayFK
left join tblcycleCount cc on  cc.CycleCountPk = ccb.CycleCountfk 
where COALESCE(ccr.CycleCountBayFk, ccp.CycleCountBayFk) = @var_CycleCountBayPk and cc.CycleCountPk = @var_CycleCountPk


    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#TempCycleCountResults2') IS NOT NULL  
   DROP TABLE #TempCycleCountResults2

 select distinct Case when ccr.CycleCountBayResultPk Is NULL then -1 else ccr.CycleCountBayResultPk end as CycleCountBayResultPk ,
 Case when ccr.CycleCountBayFk is null then ccp.CycleCountBayFk else ccr.CycleCountBayFk end as CycleCountBayFk ,
   Case when ccr.PalletFk Is NULL then ccp.palletfk else ccr.PalletFk end as PalletFk ,	ccr.ProblemTypeFk,	ccr.ProblemDescription,	ccr.Resolved
   ,Case when ccr.InsertedDate Is NULL then ccp.InsertedDate else ccr.InsertedDate end as InsertedDate
   
   ,ccp.PalletDetailsAllCorrect
	into #TempCycleCountResults2
	from tblCycleCOuntBayResult ccr 
Full Outer join tblCycleCountPallets ccp on ccp.CycleCountBayFk = ccr.CycleCountBayFk and ccr.palletfk = ccp.palletfk
left join tblCycleCountBays ccb on  ccb.CycleCountBayPK = ccr.CycleCountBayFK or ccb.CycleCountBayPK = ccp.CycleCountBayFK
left join tblcycleCount cc on  cc.CycleCountPk = ccb.CycleCountfk 
where COALESCE(ccr.CycleCountBayFk, ccp.CycleCountBayFk) = @var_CycleCountBayPk  and ccr.PalletFk = -1 and cc.CycleCountPk = @var_CycleCountPk
  

     IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#TempCycleCountAllResults') IS NOT NULL  
   DROP TABLE #TempCycleCountAllResults
   
   SELECT *  
   INTO #TempCycleCountAllResults 
   From 
   
   (Select * from #TempCycleCountResults1
   UNION 
   Select * from #TempCycleCountResults2) a

   if (@var_Resolved = 1)
   begin
   select res.ProblemDescription,res.Resolved , res.Inserteddate, res.PalletDetailsAllCorrect, pt.CycleCountProblemType , Case when pal.CustomerBarcode = null then pal.Barcode else pal.CustomerBarcode end as Barcode  
   from #TempCycleCountAllResults res
   left join [dbo].[appCycleCountProblemType] pt on pt.CycleCountProblemTypePK = res.ProblemTypeFk
   left join tblpallets pal on pal.palletpk = res.palletfk
   where res.Resolved=1 order by  res.Inserteddate desc
         end
  if (@var_Unresolved = 1)
  begin
     select res.ProblemDescription,res.Resolved , res.Inserteddate, res.PalletDetailsAllCorrect, pt.CycleCountProblemType , Case when pal.CustomerBarcode = null then pal.Barcode else pal.CustomerBarcode end as Barcode  
   from #TempCycleCountAllResults res
   left join [dbo].[appCycleCountProblemType] pt on pt.CycleCountProblemTypePK = res.ProblemTypeFk
   left join tblpallets pal on pal.palletpk = res.palletfk
   where res.Resolved=0 order by  res.Inserteddate desc
  end

   if (@var_showcorrect = 1)
  begin
     select res.ProblemDescription,res.Resolved , res.Inserteddate, res.PalletDetailsAllCorrect, pt.CycleCountProblemType , Case when pal.CustomerBarcode = null then pal.Barcode else pal.CustomerBarcode end as Barcode  
   from #TempCycleCountAllResults res
   left join [dbo].[appCycleCountProblemType] pt on pt.CycleCountProblemTypePK = res.ProblemTypeFk
   left join tblpallets pal on pal.palletpk = res.palletfk
   where res.PalletDetailsAllCorrect =1 order by  res.Inserteddate desc
  end

   if (@var_Showall = 1)
  begin
     select res.CycleCountBayResultPk, res.ProblemDescription,res.Resolved , res.Inserteddate, res.PalletDetailsAllCorrect, pt.CycleCountProblemType , Case when pal.CustomerBarcode = null then pal.Barcode else pal.CustomerBarcode end as Barcode  
   from #TempCycleCountAllResults res
   left join [dbo].[appCycleCountProblemType] pt on pt.CycleCountProblemTypePK = res.ProblemTypeFk
   left join tblpallets pal on pal.palletpk = res.palletfk
    order by  res.Inserteddate desc
  end
   
   -- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end            
            
               
               
   BREAK            
  END TRY            
  BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */            
   DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;            
   SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;            
   SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;            
            
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY             
   BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;            
                   
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;            
            
            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID            
                        
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;            
                        
   IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)            
   BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END            
   ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */            
  END CATCH            
  SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1            
 END            
END
