 SET @var_groupstockInFK = @GroupStockInFK; SET @var_stockInFK = @stockInFK; SET @var_palletFKs = @palletFKs; SET @var_buildingUnitBayFKs = @buildingUnitBayFKs        
 SET @var_containerOutFK = @containerOutFK; SET @var_UserFK = @UserFK        
        
 SET @ParameterDetails = '@containerInFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_groupstockInFK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@stockInFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_stockInFK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'')         
  + ',@palletFKs = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_palletFKs AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@buildingUnitBayFKs = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_buildingUnitBayFKs AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'')         
   + ',@containerOutFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_containerOutFK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@UserFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_UserFK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'')        
        
    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL         
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)        
        
    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)        
    --BEGIN        
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC         
        
  SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)        
        
        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)        
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK        
        
        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()        
    --END        
        
        
 SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);        
 SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails        
 ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;        
 INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()        
        
 WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3        
 BEGIN         
  BEGIN TRY        
           
   --Get pallets from filters        
   CREATE TABLE #tmpPallets (        
    Palletpk INT,         
    Barcode nvarchar(50),        
    CustomerBarcode nvarchar(50),         
    CustomerPalletNumber nvarchar(50),        
    LocationFK INT,        
    LocationTypeFK INT,       
    BayPosition INT        
)        
    
    
    
    
   IF(@var_groupstockInFK <> -1)         
   BEGIN        
    INSERT INTO #tmpPallets         
    SELECT distinct p.PalletPk, p.Barcode, p.CustomerBarcode, p.CustomerPalletNumber, p.LocationFK,  p.LocationTypeFK, p.BayPosition        
    FROM tblStockIns sins        
    INNER JOIN tblStockInLines sils on sins.StockInPK = sils.StockInFK        
    INNER JOIN tblStockInLinePallets silps on sils.StockInLinePK = silps.StockInLineFK        
    INNER JOIN tblpallets p on silps.palletfk = p.palletpk        
    LEFT JOIN dbo.fnSplitStringToArray(@var_palletFKs, ',') palletfilter ON DATALENGTH(@var_palletFKs) > 0 and palletfilter.element = p.palletpk        
    inner join tblContainerIns cin on sins.ContainerInFK = cin.ContainerInPK
	
	Where 
	--sins.ContainerInFK = @var_containerInFK 
	cin.StockInGroupFK = @var_groupstockInFK 
	and PalletPK in (case when @var_palletFKs <> '' then palletfilter.element else PalletPK end)        
   END         
   else if (@var_containerOutFK <> -1)        
   BEGIN        
    INSERT INTO #tmpPallets         
    SELECT p.PalletPk, p.Barcode,  p.CustomerBarcode, p.CustomerPalletNumber, p.LocationFK,  p.LocationTypeFK, p.BayPosition        
    FROM tblContainerOutLinePalletContent colpc        
    INNER JOIN tblPallets p on p.Palletpk = colpc.PalletFK        
    INNER JOIN tblContainerOutLines cols on cols.ContainerOutLinePK = colpc.ContainerOutLineFK        
    LEFT JOIN dbo.fnSplitStringToArray(@var_palletFKs, ',') palletfilter ON DATALENGTH(@var_palletFKs) > 0 and palletfilter.element = p.palletpk        
    where cols.ContainerOutFK = @var_containerOutFK and PalletPK in (case when @var_palletFKs <> '' then palletfilter.element else PalletPK end)        
   END         
   ELSE IF(@var_buildingUnitBayFKs <> '')         
   BEGIN        
    INSERT INTO #tmpPallets         
    SELECT Palletpk, Barcode,  CustomerBarcode, CustomerPalletNumber, LocationFK,  LocationTypeFK, p.BayPosition        
    FROM tblPallets p        
    LEFT JOIN dbo.fnSplitStringToArray(@var_palletFKs, ',') palletfilter ON DATALENGTH(@var_palletFKs) > 0 and palletfilter.element = palletpk        
    Where LocationTypeFK = 1/*Racking*/ AND (',' + @var_buildingUnitBayFKs + ',' LIKE '%,' + CONVERT(VARCHAR, LocationFK) + ',%') and PalletPK in (case when @var_palletFKs <> '' then palletfilter.element else PalletPK end)        
   END         
   ELSE IF(@var_palletFKs <> '')         
   BEGIN        
    INSERT INTO #tmpPallets         
    SELECT Palletpk, Barcode,  CustomerBarcode, CustomerPalletNumber, LocationFK,  LocationTypeFK, p.BayPosition        
    FROM tblPallets p        
    LEFT JOIN dbo.fnSplitStringToArray(@var_palletFKs, ',') palletfilter ON DATALENGTH(@var_palletFKs) > 0 and palletfilter.element = palletpk        
    Where (',' + @var_palletFKs + ',' LIKE '%,' + CONVERT(VARCHAR, PalletPK) + ',%')  and PalletPK in (case when @var_palletFKs <> '' then palletfilter.element else PalletPK end)        
   END        
   --select * from #tmpPallets        
        
  --drop table if exists #tmpstockitemallergencode          
     IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#tmpstockitemallergencode') IS NOT NULL        
    DROP TABLE #tmpstockitemallergencode       
   
 SELECT distinct tsi.StockItemPK ,         
       
   left(          
   STUFF((SELECT distinct ',' +  pk.AllergenCode  from tblstockItemAllergenCodes cih       
   inner join tblAllergenCodes pk      
   on  pk.AllergenCodePK =cih.AllergenCodeFK       
     --where StockitemFK=57052      
  where cih.StockitemFK =tsi.StockItemPK and cih.IsArchived=0        
   FOR XML PATH(''), TYPE).value('.', 'NVARCHAR(MAX)')  ,1,1,'') --'HeaderbatchList',                               
   ,100)      
   as [allergencode]        
  INTO #tmpstockitemallergencode       
    FROM tblStockItems tsi           
  inner join tblstockItemAllergenCodes stock      
   on tsi.StockItemPK =stock.StockitemFK       
   INNER JOIN tblDivisions division ON division.DivisionPK = tsi.DivisionFK    
   WHERE  tsi.IsArchived = 0         
      
    
    
    
   IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#TempResults') IS NOT NULL        
DROP TABLE #TempResults        
              
 DECLARE @printDate datetime        
   SET @printDate = dbo.GetBSTDate()        
        
   --get all details of selected pallets        
   SELECT subQ.*, vpl.Row, vpl.BayLevel, vpl.ColumnNo        
   into #TempResults        
    FROM (        
    SELECT DISTINCT        
     --pallet details        
     CONVERT(VARCHAR, pallets.PalletPK)[PalletPK],        
      case when division.PrintCustomerBarcodeOnLabel =0  then pallets.Barcode else          
              
        case when pallets.CustomerBarcode=''  then pallets.Barcode else pallets.CustomerBarcode  end        
              
      end as Barcode,         
      --pallets.CustomerBarcode as Barcode,        
      pallets.CustomerBarcode,        
     pallets.CustomerPalletNumber,         
     CASE WHEN pafvs1.PalletAdditionalFieldValuePK IS NULL THEN '' ELSE pafvs1.PalletAdditionalFieldValue END AS PalletAdditionalFieldValue1,        
     CASE WHEN pafvs2.PalletAdditionalFieldValuePK IS NULL THEN '' ELSE pafvs2.PalletAdditionalFieldValue END AS PalletAdditionalFieldValue2,        
     --pallet content details        
     palletContent.Batch,        
     palletContent.SupplierBatch,        
     CASE WHEN palsLeg.Batch IS NULL THEN '' ELSE palsLeg.Batch END AS BatchLegacy,         
     CASE WHEN specialStockType.SpecialStockTypePK IS NULL THEN '' ELSE specialStockType.SpecialStockType + CASE WHEN palletContent.SpecialStockTypeFK = 3 /*Consigned*/ THEN ': ' + conSupps.Supplier ELSE '' END END AS SpecialStockType,        
     CASE WHEN cast(palletContent.ExpiryDate as nvarchar(50)) = 'Jan  1 1900 12:00AM' then '' else convert(nvarchar(10),palletContent.ExpiryDate, 103) End ExpiryDate,         
     palletContent.ExpiryDate as ExpiryDate_DateTime,        
     CASE WHEN cast(palletContent.DateOfManuFacture as nvarchar(50)) = 'Jan  1 1900 12:00AM' then '' else convert(nvarchar(10),palletContent.DateOfManuFacture, 103) End DateOfManuFacture,         
     palletContent.DateOfManufacture as DateOfManufacture_DateTime,        
     CASE WHEN cast(palletContent.BestBefore as nvarchar(50)) = 'Jan  1 1900 12:00AM' then '' else convert(nvarchar(10),palletContent.BestBefore, 103) End BestBefore,         
     palletContent.BestBefore as BestBefore_DateTime,        
     CASE WHEN cast(palletContent.DateOfReceipt as nvarchar(50)) = 'Jan  1 1900 12:00AM' then pAudit.EventDate else palletContent.DateOfReceipt End DateOfReceipt,        
     --stock details        
     stockItem.StockItemCode,        
     stockItem.Description,        
     stockItem.EANCode,        
     CASE WHEN palsLeg.StockItemCode IS NULL THEN '' ELSE palsLeg.StockItemCode END AS StockItemCodeLegacy,        
     stockItem.DivisionFK,       
  -----Pritesh------      
 Case when stockitem.ShowDivisionCodeOnLabel = 0 then '' else division.Divisioncode End AS DivisionCode,      
 Case when stockitem.ShowCustomerCodeOnLabel = 0 then '' else cust.CustomerCode End As CustomerCode,      
       
 -----Pritesh-----------      
     --container in details        
     CASE WHEN ContainerIn.ContainerInPK IS NULL THEN '' ELSE ContainerIn.GoodsInNumber END AS GoodsInNumber,        
     CASE WHEN ContainerIn.ContainerInPK IS NULL THEN '' ELSE ContainerIn.Free1 END AS inFree1,        
     CASE WHEN ContainerIn.ContainerInPK IS NULL THEN '' ELSE ContainerIn.Free2 END AS inFree2,        
     CASE WHEN ContainerIn.ContainerInPK IS NULL THEN '' ELSE ContainerIn.Free3 END AS inFree3,        
     CASE WHEN ContainerIn.ContainerInPK IS NULL THEN '' ELSE ContainerIn.Free4 END AS inFree4,        
     CASE WHEN ContainerIn.ContainerInPK IS NULL THEN '' ELSE ContainerIn.Free5 END AS inFree5,        
     CASE WHEN inCusSuppliers.CustomerSupplierPK IS NULL THEN '' ELSE inCusSuppliers.CustomerReference END AS InSupplierReference,        
     CASE WHEN inSuppliers.SupplierPK  IS NULL THEN '' ELSE inSuppliers.Supplier END AS InSupplier,        
     --pallet quantity details        
     CASE WHEN stockItem.ShowQuantityOnPalletBarcode = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ THEN cast(CASE WHEN palletContent.Units = 0 THEN containerOut.Units ELSE palletContent.Units END AS nvarchar(50)) + ' ' + CASE WHEN unitTypes.UnitTypePK IS NOT NULL THEN unitTypes
.  
    
      
Abbreviation WHEN eachUnitTypes.EachesUnitTypePK is not null THEN eachUnitTypes.Abbrieviation ELSE '' END ELSE '' END Units,        
     CASE WHEN stockItem.ShowQuantityOnPalletBarcode = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ THEN cast(CASE WHEN palletContent.Units = 0 THEN containerOut.Units ELSE palletContent.Units END AS nvarchar(50)) ELSE '' END UnitsOnly,        
     CASE WHEN stockItem.ShowQuantityOnPalletBarcode = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ THEN unitTypes.Abbreviation ELSE '' END UnitType,        
     --pallet audit date in        
     pAudit.EventDate as DateIn,        
     --label details        
     division.BarcodeLogo,        
     @printDate as PrintedDate,         
     CASE WHEN users.Name IS NOT NULL THEN users.Name ELSE '' END AS PrintedUser,        
     division.StockInLabelOrderFK,        
     BayPosition,        
     StockItemCodeAlias1 ,     
      
   isnull(tsi.allergencode,'') as allergencode--Jamie: set default to be blank as per danone (Nora's change of requirement)  
  
  , division.PrintSupplierBatchOnLabel  As SupplierBatchSetting  
    FROM        
     --PALLET        
     #tmpPallets pallets        
     LEFT OUTER JOIN tblPalletsLegacy palsLeg ON palsLeg.PalletFK = pallets.PalletPK        
     left outer join tblPalletAudit pAudit on pAudit.PalletFK = pallets.PalletPK and pAudit.EventTypeFK = 1        
         
      
     --PALLET CONTENT        
     INNER JOIN (        
      SELECT PalletFK, StockItemFK, Batch, SupplierBatch, sum(ActualUnits) Units, ExpiryDate, DateOfManuFacture, BestBefore, DateOfReceipt, SpecialStockTypeFK        
      FROM tblPalletContent        
      GROUP BY PalletFK, StockItemFK, Batch, SupplierBatch, ExpiryDate, DateOfManuFacture, BestBefore, DateOfReceipt, SpecialStockTypeFK        
     ) palletContent ON palletContent.PalletFK = pallets.PalletPK          
             
     --STOCK ITEM        
     INNER JOIN tblStockItems stockItem ON stockItem.StockItemPK = palletContent.StockItemFK        
     INNER JOIN tblDivisions division ON division.DivisionPK = stockItem.DivisionFK    
  left join #tmpstockitemallergencode tsi on  tsi.StockitemPk = stockitem.StockItemPK    
    
  ------Pritesh-----------      
     inner join tblcustomers cust on cust.CustomerPK = division.CustomerFK      
  ------Pritesh--------      
     LEFT OUTER JOIN appSpecialStockTypes specialStockType ON specialStockType.SpecialStockTypePK = palletContent.SpecialStockTypeFK        
     LEFT OUTER JOIN (        
      SELECT PalletFK, SpecialStockTypeFK, IntParam1         
      FROM tblPalletContentSpecialStockTypes        
      GROUP BY PalletFK, SpecialStockTypeFK, IntParam1        
     ) pcSpecialStock ON pcSpecialStock.PalletFK = palletContent.PalletFK        
     LEFT OUTER JOIN tblUnitTypes unitTypes ON unitTypes.UnitTypePK = stockItem.UnitTypeFK        
     LEFT OUTER JOIN tblEachesUnitTypes eachUnitTypes ON eachUnitTypes.EachesUnitTypePK = stockItem.EachesUnitTypeFK        
          
     --SUPPLIER INFO        
     left outer join tblSuppliers conSupps on conSupps.SupplierPK = pcSpecialStock.IntParam1        
        
     --ADDITIONAL PALLET INFO        
     LEFT OUTER JOIN tblPalletAdditionalFields paf1 ON        
      paf1.PalletAdditionalFieldTypeFK = 1 /*Customer*/ AND paf1.FK = division.CustomerFK AND paf1.FieldNumber = 1        
     LEFT OUTER JOIN tblPalletAdditionalFieldValues pafvs1 ON        
      pafvs1.PalletAdditionalFieldFK = paf1.PalletAdditionalFieldPK AND pafvs1.PalletFK = pallets.PalletPK        
     LEFT OUTER JOIN tblPalletAdditionalFields paf2 ON        
      paf2.PalletAdditionalFieldTypeFK = 1 /*Customer*/ AND paf2.FK = division.CustomerFK AND paf2.FieldNumber = 2        
     LEFT OUTER JOIN tblPalletAdditionalFieldValues pafvs2 ON         
      pafvs2.PalletAdditionalFieldFK = paf2.PalletAdditionalFieldPK AND pafvs2.PalletFK = pallets.PalletPK        
        
     --CONTAINER IN        
     LEFT OUTER JOIN tblStockInLinePallets silps ON (@var_groupstockInFK > 0) AND silps.PalletFK = pallets.PalletPK        
     LEFT OUTER JOIN tblStockInLines sils ON (@var_groupstockInFK > 0) AND sils.StockInLinePK = silps.StockInLineFK        
     LEFT OUTER JOIN tblStockIns sins ON (@var_groupstockInFK > 0) AND sins.StockInPK = sils.StockInFK        
     LEFT OUTER JOIN tblContainerIns ContainerIn ON (@var_groupstockInFK > 0) AND ContainerIn.StockInGroupFK = @var_groupstockInFK and ContainerIn.ContainerInPK = sins.ContainerInFK        
     LEFT OUTER JOIN tblSuppliers inSuppliers ON inSuppliers.SupplierPK = ContainerIn.SupplierFK        
     LEFT OUTER JOIN tblCustomerSuppliers inCusSuppliers ON inCusSuppliers.SupplierFK = inSuppliers.SupplierPK        
        
     --CONTAINER OUT        
     LEFT OUTER JOIN (        
      SELECT cols.containerOutFK, colpc.PalletFK, colpc.Units        
      FROM tblContainerOutLinePalletContent colpc        
      INNER JOIN tblContainerOutLines cols ON cols.ContainerOutLinePK = colpc.ContainerOutLineFK        
     )containerOut ON containerOut.containerOutFK = @var_containerOutFK        
        
     --Racking Details        
     LEFT OUTER JOIN tblBuildingUnitBays buBays ON buBays.BuildingUnitBayPK = pallets.LocationFK AND pallets.LocationTypeFK = 1 /*Racking*/        
     LEFT OUTER JOIN tblBuildingUnitColumns buCols ON buCols.BuildingUnitColumnPK = buBays.BuildingUnitColumnFK        
        
     --User        
     LEFT OUTER JOIN viewUsers users on users.userpk = @var_UserFK        
    )subQ        
    LEFT JOIN ViewPalletLocations vpl on vpl.palletpk = subQ.PalletPK        
      
       
      
   /*ORDER BY        
    CASE         
     WHEN @var_containerInFK <> -1 THEN        
      CASE         
       WHEN StockInLabelOrderFK = 1 THEN         
        Batch         
       ELSE         
        CONVERT(VARCHAR, PalletPK)         
      END        
     ELSE        
      CASE         
       WHEN vpl.PalletPK is not null THEN        
        [Row],         
        BayLevel,         
        ColumnNumber        
       ELSE        
        Batch         
      END        
    END*/        
        
   if(@var_groupstockInFK <> -1)        
   begin        
    select * from #TempResults        
    order by         
     CASE         
      WHEN StockInLabelOrderFK = 1 THEN         
       Batch         
      ELSE         
       CONVERT(VARCHAR, PalletPK)         
     END        
   end        
   else        
   begin        
    select * from #TempResults        
    order by [Row], BayLevel, ColumnNo, BayPosition        
   end        
        
   IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#tmpPallets') IS NOT NULL        
   DROP TABLE #tmpPallets        
        
   BREAK        
  END TRY        
  BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */        
   DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;        
   SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;        
   SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;        
        
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY         
   BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;        
               
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;        
        
            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID        
                    
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;        
                    
   IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)        
   BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END        
   ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */        
  END CATCH        
  SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1        
 END        
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_InsertCycleCountBays]      
(      
@BuildingUnitRowFK int ,      
     
 @CycleCountFK int  ,
 @userfk int
)       
AS      
BEGIN      
 /* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */      
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED      
      
    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT      
 ,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;      
 SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();      
      
 -- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters      
 DECLARE @buildingunitrowfk2 int, @cyclecountfk2 int,@userfk2 int
      
 SET @buildingunitrowfk2 = @BuildingUnitRowFK; SET @cyclecountfk2 = @CycleCountFK; Set @userfk2 =@userfk
      
 SET @ParameterDetails = '@BuildingUnitRowFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@buildingunitrowfk2 AS NVARCHAR(20)),'') + ',@CycleCountFK = ' + ISNULL(Cast (@cyclecountfk2 as nvarchar(20)),'')      
 + ',@userfk = ' + ISNULL(Cast (@userfk2 as nvarchar(20)),'')      
    
      
    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL       
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)      
      
    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)      
    --BEGIN      
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC       
      
  SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)      
      
        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)      
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK      
      
        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()      
    --END      
      
      
 SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);      
 SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails      
 ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;      
 INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()      
      
 WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3      
 BEGIN       
  BEGIN TRY      
         
      
   -- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start      
   insert into tblCycleCountBays (CycleCountFK,BuildingUnitColoumnFK,BuildingUnitBayFK,CycleCountBayStatusFk,CompletedDate,IsArchived,InsertedBy,InsertedDate,UpdatedBy,UpdatedDate)  
   (
		select  @cyclecountfk2, BuildingUnitColumnFK, BuildingUnitBayPK, 2, Cast('19000101' as datetime) ,0,@userfk2,GetDate(),@userfk2,GetDate()
		from tblBuildingUnitRows Bur
		inner join tblBuildingUnitColumns buc on Bur.BuildingUnitRowPK = buc.BuildingUnitRowFK
		inner join tblBuildingUnitBays bub on buc.BuildingUnitColumnPK = bub.BuildingUnitColumnFK
		where bur.BuildingUnitRowPK = @buildingunitrowfk2 --one row at a time
		and bub.IsArchived=0 and buc.IsArchived=0 and Bur.IsArchived=0 -- ignore archived
		and (Bur.RackingTypeFK=1 or (Bur.RackingTypeFK=2 and bub.BayLevel = 'A' ))--conventional or drivethru
	)
   -- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end      
      
         
         
   BREAK      
  END TRY      
  BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */      
   DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;      
   SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;      
   SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;      
      
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY       
   BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;      
             
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;      
      
            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID      
                  
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;      
                  
   IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)      
   BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END      
   ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */      
  END CATCH      
  SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1      
 END      
END

/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[sp_InsertStockItemVersionHistory]    Script Date: 02/11/2026 17:47:25 ******/

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_InsertStockItemVersionHistory] 
(  
  @StockItemPK INT ,
  @userfk int
)  
AS  
BEGIN  
 /* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */  
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED

 ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;            
 INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()            
            
 WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3            
 BEGIN             
  BEGIN TRY            
               
   -- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start   
   
Select ccr.CycleCountBayResultPk,ccr.PalletFk,ccr.Resolved as Resolve  from tblCycleCOuntBayResult ccr
inner join tblcyclecountbays ccb on ccb.CycleCountBayPK = ccr.CycleCountBayFK
inner join viewbuildingunitbays vwb on  vwb.BuildingUnitBayPK = ccb.BuildingUnitBayFK
where  vwb.BuildingUnitBayPK =@var_BuildingUnitBayPK and ccr.Palletfk = @var_Palletfk
   -- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end            
            
               
               
   BREAK            
  END TRY            
  BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */            
   DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;            
   SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;            
   SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;            
            
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY             
   BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;            
                   
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;            
            
            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID            
                        
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;            
                        
   IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)            
   BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END            
   ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */            
  END CATCH            
  SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1            
 END            
END

   BEGIN      
    -- The Goods In is being Built from scratch but does not have headers       
    select  0 as ReturnStatus ,
	'' as ReturnMessage,
        StockItemFK as StockInHeaderPK,      
        stockItemCode,      
        eancode as stockItemEanCode,      
        eancode2 as stockItemEanCode2,      
        0 as ExpectedQty,

     from tblstockins

     RETURN      
    END

    SELECT eancode , count(*) as NoOfEanCodes      
    INTO #tmpEanCodes      
    FROM #tmpStockItems      
    GROUP BY EANCode      
      
    -- count the number of duplicate eancode2's on the header file      
    SELECT EANCode2 , count(*) as NoOfEanCodes      
    INTO #tmpEancode2      
    FROM #tmpStockItems

    GROUP BY  EANCode2

      -- Trim the eancode

      SELECT 2 as ReturnStatus,      
       'Multiple Stock Items setup for EanCode(s) ' + @Eancode + ' Contact Stock Controller' as ReturnMessage,
	     	 -1 as StockInHeaderPK,      
        '' as stockItemCode,      
        ''  as stockItemEanCode,      
        '' as stockItemEanCode2,      
         cast (0.00 as decimal (18,3)) as ExpectedQty,      
          cast (0.00 as decimal (18,3)) as ScannedQty,      
       -1 as palletTypeFK,      
        -1 as divisionFK 
      RETURN      
      END       
      
     -- check if there duplicate eancode2s      
    IF exists (SELECT * from #tmpEancode2 where NoOfEanCodes > 1)      
    BEGIN       
     SELECT 2 as ReturnStatus,      
      'Multiple EanCodes setup for this Goods In, Contact Stock Controller' as ReturnMessage  ,
	    	 -1 as StockInHeaderPK,      
        '' as stockItemCode,      
        ''  as stockItemEanCode,      
        '' as stockItemEanCode2,      
         cast (0.00 as decimal (18,3)) as ExpectedQty,      
         cast (0.00 as decimal (18,3)) as ScannedQty,      
       -1 as palletTypeFK,      
        -1 as divisionFK 
     RETURN      
    END       
        
    -- check if there are matching eancode and eancode2      
    IF exists (select * from #tmpEAncode2 where eancode2 in (Select eancode from #tmpEancodes))      
    BEGIN      
     SELECT 2 as ReturnStatus,      
      'Multiple EanCodes setup for this Goods In, Contact Stock Controller' as ReturnMessage,
	  	 -1 as StockInHeaderPK,      
        '' as stockItemCode,      
        ''  as stockItemEanCode,      
        '' as stockItemEanCode2,      
         cast (0.00 as decimal (18,3)) as ExpectedQty,      
        cast (0.00 as decimal (18,3)) as ScannedQty,      
       -1 as palletTypeFK,

    where cin.StockInGroupFK = @var_GroupStockInInFK    
   -- WHERE ContainerInFK = @var_GroupStockInInFK

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID

   --print 'racking'  
    if((Select RackingTypeFK from tblBuildingUnitBays buBays inner join tblBuildingUnitColumns buCols on buCols.BuildingUnitColumnPK = buBays.BuildingUnitColumnFK   
    inner join tblBuildingUnitRows buRows on buRows.BuildingUnitRowPK = buCols.BuildingUnitRowFK where BuildingUnitBayPK = @locationFK2) = 2/*DriveThru*/)   
    BEGIN  
    print 'drive throu'  
      Select @buildingUnitColumnFK = BuildingUnitColumnFK from tblBuildingUnitBays where BuildingUnitBayPK = @locationFK2  
    END  
   END  
  
   print @buildingUnitColumnFK  
  
   --temp table for required pallets  
   CREATE TABLE #tmpPallets (  
    Palletpk INT,   
    Barcode nvarchar(50),  
    CustomerBarcode nvarchar(50),   
    CustomerPalletNumber nvarchar(50),  
    LocationFK INT,  
    LocationTypeFK INT,  
    PalletTypeFK INT,  
    IsArchived BIT,  
    COActualUnits decimal(18,3),  
    COAvailableUnits decimal(18,3),   
    BayPosition INT,   
    PalletStart INT,   
    PalletEnd INT,   
    StackPosition INT  
   )  
  
   --are we filtering by goods in?  
  
   --are we filtering by goods out  

  
   --nothing selected yet, check location filters  
   IF NOT EXISTS(select 1 from #tmpPallets)  
   BEGIN  
    if(@locationFK2 > 0)  
    BEGIN  
    --print 'racking'  
     INSERT INTO #tmpPallets   
     SELECT distinct p.PalletPk, p.Barcode, p.CustomerBarcode, p.CustomerPalletNumber, p.LocationFK,  p.LocationTypeFK, p.PalletTypeFK, p.IsArchived,0,0, P.BayPosition, P.PalletStart, P.PalletEnd, P.StackPosition  
    -- ,vwbuild.LocateFromLeft
	 FROM TblPallets P  
     INNER JOIN viewpalletLocations palletLocation on palletlocation.PalletPK = p.palletPk  
     LEFT JOIN #tmpPallets TMP on P.PALLETPK = TMP.PALLETPK  
	-- inner join viewBuildingUnitBays vwbuild on vwbuild.BuildingUnitBayPK = TMP.LocationFK
     WHERE TMP.PALLETPK IS NULL AND p.PalletStatusFK <> 10 /*On Route*/ AND   
      ((p.locationtypefk = 1 and p.locationfk = @locationFK2) OR (palletlocation.BuildingUnitColumnFK = @buildingUnitColumnFK))   
      and ( p.isarchived = 0)  
    END  

   END  
  --select * from #tmpPallets
   --now remove anything we dont need  
   IF EXISTS(select 1 from #tmpPallets)  
   BEGIN  
    if(@locationFK2 > 0)  
    BEGIN  
     DELETE P  
     FROM #tmpPallets P  
     INNER JOIN viewpalletLocations palletLocation on palletlocation.PalletPK = p.palletPk  
     WHERE (@buildingUnitColumnFK < 0 and (p.locationtypefk <> 1 or (p.locationtypefk = 1 and p.locationfk <> @locationFK2)) )  
      OR (@buildingUnitColumnFK > 0 and palletlocation.BuildingUnitColumnFK <> @buildingUnitColumnFK)   
    END   
    --select * from #tmpPallets  
  
   END  
  
   ;WITH cte AS   
   (  
    SELECT pallets.PalletPK AS PK,   
     sis.StockItemCode as [StockCode],   
     sis.IsStackable  as Stackable ,
     pc.Batch,   
     case when pallets.CustomerBarcode = '' then pallets.Barcode else pallets.CustomerBarcode end as Barcode,   
     pallets.CustomerPalletNumber [PalletNumber],   
     case when COActualUnits > 0 then COActualUnits else ActualUnits end as ActualUnits,   
     case when COAvailableUnits > 0 then COAvailableUnits else AvailableUnits end as AvailableUnits,  
     Location, BayPosition, PalletStart, PalletEnd, StackPosition, PalletType, StockonOrder AS [StockOnOrder], 
	   ExpiryDate
,DateOfManufacture
,BestBefore
,DateOfReceipt
,vwbuild.LocateFromLeft,
vwbuild.Width as BayWidth,
     ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY case when pallets.CustomerBarcode = '' then pallets.Barcode else pallets.CustomerBarcode end ORDER BY (CASE when pallets.IsArchived = 1 then 'a' else 'b' end) desc, pallets.PalletPK DESC) AS rn  
    FROM #tmpPallets pallets  
    LEFT OUTER JOIN tblPalletTypes palletTypes on palletTypes.PalletTypePK = pallets.PalletTypeFK 
	 inner join viewBuildingUnitBays vwbuild on vwbuild.BuildingUnitBayPK = pallets.LocationFK
    INNER JOIN (  
     SELECT PalletFK, StockItemFK, Batch, sum(ActualUnits) ActualUnits, sum(AvailableUnits) AvailableUnits,case when (SUM(ActualUnits)>Sum(AvailableUnits)) then 'YES' else 'NO' end as StockonOrder  
       ,ExpiryDate
,DateOfManufacture
,BestBefore
,DateOfReceipt
	 FROM tblPalletContent  
     GROUP BY PalletFK, StockItemFK, Batch  ,ExpiryDate
,DateOfManufacture
,BestBefore
,DateOfReceipt 
    ) pc on pc.PalletFK = pallets.PalletPK  
    INNER JOIN tblStockItems sis on sis.StockItemPK = pc.StockItemFK  
    INNER JOIN viewpalletLocations palletLocation on palletlocation.PalletPK = pallets.palletPk  
   )  
   SELECT PK,  [StockCode], Stackable, Batch, Barcode, [PalletNumber], ActualUnits, AvailableUnits,Location, BayPosition, PalletStart, PalletEnd, StackPosition, PalletType,[StockOnOrder]  
   ,ExpiryDate
,DateOfManufacture
,BestBefore
,DateOfReceipt
,LocateFromLeft,BayWidth
   
   FROM cte   
   WHERE rn = 1   
   Order by Location ASC, [StockCode] ASC, Batch ASC, Barcode ASC  
     
   IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#tmpPallets') IS NOT NULL  
    DROP TABLE #tmpPallets  
  
   IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#tmpPallets') IS NOT NULL  
    DROP TABLE #tmpPallets  
  
  BREAK  
  END TRY  
  BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */  
   DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;  
   SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;  
   SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;  
  
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY   
   BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;  
         
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;  
  
            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID  
              
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;  
              
   IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)  
   BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END  
   ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */  
  END CATCH  
  SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1  
 END  
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_MOBSTAStockInHeaders]

 SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

 DECLARE @var_ContainerInFK int          
 SET @var_ContainerInFK = @ContainerInFK          
 SET @ParameterDetails = '@ContainerInFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_ContainerInFK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'')          
          
    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL           
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)          
          
    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)

        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC           
          
  SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)

   BEGIN          
    -- The Goods In is being Built from scratch but does not have headers           
    select  0 as ReturnStatus , '' as returnMessage,          
        StockItemFK as StockInHeaderPK,          
        stockItemCode,          
        eancode as stockItemEanCode,          
        eancode2 as stockItemEanCode2,          
        cast (0 as decimal (18,3)) as ExpectedQty,

        case when stk.DefaultPalletTypeFK < 1 THEN div.DefaultPalletTypeFK ELSE stk.DefaultPalletTypeFK end as palletTypeFK,          
        --DefaultPalletTypeFK as palletTypeFK,

     from tblstockins           
     inner join tblstockinlines on stockinpk = stockinfk           
     inner join tblstockitems stk on stockitemfk = stockitempk           
     INNER JOIN tbldivisions div ON divisionpk = stk.divisionfk           
     where containerInFK = @var_ContainerInFK          
     group by stockitemfk, stockitemcode, EANCode, eancode2, case when stk.DefaultPalletTypeFK < 1 THEN div.DefaultPalletTypeFK ELSE stk.DefaultPalletTypeFK end, stk.divisionFK          
     order by StockItemCode          
   END          
   ELSE          
   BEGIN          
   -- check if there is no eancode assigned to one of the stock Items          
   -- Check if there are duplicate EanCodes on the Stock In         
      -- Rule 1: same stock item having EAN in both fields is NOT a duplicate
      -- Rule 2: different stock items sharing same EAN => error
  
  -- get the list of stockitems,stockitemcode,eancode and eancode2          
    Select stockitempk, stockitemcode, eancode, eancode2          
    INTO #tmpStockItems          
    FROM tblContainerInHeaders           
    INNER JOIN tblstockitems on stockitempk = stockitemfk           
    where containerinfk = @var_Containerinfk          
  
-- Build a unified EAN list (EANCode + EANCode2) for items on this ContainerIn
IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#AllEans') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #AllEans;

;WITH Eans AS
(
    -- EANCode
    SELECT 
        SI.StockItemPK,
        LTRIM(RTRIM(SI.EanCode)) AS EAN
    FROM tblContainerInHeaders H
    INNER JOIN tblStockItems SI ON SI.StockItemPK = H.StockItemFK
    WHERE H.ContainerInFK = @var_ContainerInFK
          AND LTRIM(RTRIM(SI.EanCode)) <> ''

    UNION

    -- EanCode2
    SELECT 
        SI.StockItemPK,
        LTRIM(RTRIM(SI.EanCode2)) AS EAN
    FROM tblContainerInHeaders H
    INNER JOIN tblStockItems SI ON SI.StockItemPK = H.StockItemFK
    WHERE H.ContainerInFK = @var_ContainerInFK
          AND LTRIM(RTRIM(SI.EanCode2)) <> ''
)
SELECT * 
INTO #AllEans
FROM Eans;

-- ERROR CASE: Stock Items WITH NO EANs (both fields empty)
IF EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 
    FROM tblContainerInHeaders H
    INNER JOIN tblStockItems SI ON SI.StockItemPK = H.StockItemFK
    WHERE ContainerInFK = @var_ContainerInFK
      AND (LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(EanCode,''))) = '' 
           AND LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(EanCode2,''))) = '')
)
BEGIN
    DECLARE @MissingCodes nvarchar(max) = '';

    SELECT @MissingCodes = @MissingCodes + SI.StockItemCode + ', '
    FROM tblContainerInHeaders H
    INNER JOIN tblStockItems SI ON SI.StockItemPK = H.StockItemFK
    WHERE ContainerInFK = @var_ContainerInFK
      AND (LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(EanCode,''))) = '' 
           AND LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(EanCode2,''))) = '');

    SET @MissingCodes = LEFT(@MissingCodes, LEN(@MissingCodes) - 1);

    SELECT 2 AS ReturnStatus,
           'Stock Item(s) ' + @MissingCodes +
           ' do not have an EAN code setup. Contact Stock Controller' AS ReturnMessage,
           -1 AS StockInHeaderPK, -1 AS stockitemfk, '' AS stockitemcode,
           '' AS stockItemEanCode, '' AS stockItemEanCode2,
           0 AS ExpectedQty, 0 AS ScannedQty,
           -1 AS palletTypeFK, -1 AS divisionfk;
    RETURN;
END

-- ERROR CASE: TRUE duplicate EANs used by MULTIPLE stock items
-- (after flattening EANCode + EANCode2 and treating same StockItemPK duplicates as one)
IF EXISTS (
    SELECT EAN
    FROM #AllEans
    GROUP BY EAN
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT StockItemPK) > 1   -- TRUE DUPLICATE
)
BEGIN
    DECLARE @BadEans nvarchar(max) = '';

    SELECT @BadEans = @BadEans + EAN + ', '
    FROM (
        SELECT EAN
        FROM #AllEans
        GROUP BY EAN
        HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT StockItemPK) > 1
    ) X;

    SET @BadEans = LEFT(@BadEans, LEN(@BadEans) - 1);

    SELECT 2 AS ReturnStatus,
           'Multiple Stock Items are using EAN(s): ' + @BadEans +
           '. Contact Stock Controller.' AS ReturnMessage,
           -1 AS stockitemfk, '' AS stockitemcode, '' AS stockItemEanCode,
           '' AS stockItemEanCode2, 0 AS ExpectedQty, 0 AS ScannedQty,
           -1 AS palletTypeFK, -1 AS divisionfk;
    RETURN;
  END
   
 -- If no problems, return the container header rows (same as original)
 BEGIN
     select 0 as ReturnStatus , '' as returnMessage,
        StockItemFK as StockInHeaderPK,
        stockItemCode,
        eancode as stockItemEanCode,
        eancode2 as stockItemEanCode2,
        Units as ExpectedQty,
        UnitsScanned as ScannedQty,
        case when si.DefaultPalletTypeFK < 1 THEN div.DefaultPalletTypeFK 
        ELSE si.DefaultPalletTypeFK end as palletTypeFK,
        divisionFK

       FROM tblcontainerInheaders
       INNER JOIN tblstockitems si ON StockItemPK = StockItemFK
       INNER JOIN tbldivisions div ON divisionpk = divisionfk
     WHERE ContainerInFK = @var_ContainerInFK
    END
 END

   -- Return the list of pallets scanned for the bottom grid
   -- select palletNumber=COUNT(*), stkit.StockItemCode, palcon.SupplierBatch, pal.customerBarcode, availableunits from tblstockins stk

   --select ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY pal.CustomerBarcode) as 'palletNumber', stkit.StockItemCode,
   --    CASE WHEN (palcon.SupplierBatch = '') THEN palcon.batch ELSE palcon.supplierbatch END as SupplierBatch,
   --     pal.customerBarcode, availableunits, pal.CustomerPalletNumber
   --from tblstockins stk
   --left outer join tblstockinlines stkl on  stkl.stockinfk = stockinpk
   --left outer join tblstockinlinepallets stkpal on stkpal.stockinlinefk = stkl.stockinlinepk
   --left outer join tblpallets pal on pal.palletpk = stkpal.palletfk
   --left outer join tblpalletcontent palcon on palcon.palletfk = pal.palletpk
   --LEFT OUTER JOIN tblStockItems stkit ON stkit.StockItemPK = palcon.StockItemFK
   --where containerinfk = @var_ContainerInFK
   --GROUP BY stkit.StockItemCode,palcon.SupplierBatch, pal.CustomerBarcode, palcon.AvailableUnits, palcon.batch, pal.CustomerPalletNumber
   --order by stockitemcode, SupplierBatch

  -- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end          
   BREAK          
  END TRY          
  BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */          
   DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;          
   SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;          
   SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;          
      
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY           
   BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;          
                 
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;          
          
            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID          
                      
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;          
                      
   IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)          
   BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END          
   ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */          
  END CATCH          
  SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1          
 END          
END

      ,@palletLocationTypeFK int

      ,@sourcePalletStart int              
      ,@palletEnd int              
      ,@sourcePalletEnd int              
      ,@entirePallet bit              
      ,@movementEaches decimal(18,3)              
      ,@movementUnits decimal(18,3)              
      ,@palletContentActualEaches decimal(18,3)              
      ,@palletContentActualUnits decimal(18,3)              
      ,@palletActualUnits decimal(18,3)              
      ,@palletContentFK int              
      ,@containerOutLinePalletContentFK int              
      ,@targetPalletContentFK int --for moving units onto an existing pallet              
      ,@targetPalletFK int --for moving units onto an existing pallet              
      ,@stockItemFK int --for adding onto the pallet audit              
      ,@batch nvarchar(200) --for adding onto the pallet audit              
      ,@NewBuildingUnitFK int              
      ,@currentWorksOrderStatusFK int              
      ,@newPalletContentPK int                
      ,@ErrorMessage nvarchar(200)              
      ,@ContaineroutFK int              
      ,@StockOrderPK int            
      ,@TotalPallet int              
      ,@TotalBatchPallet int              
      ,@TotalEaches int               
      ,@TotalActualEaches int              
      ,@TotalUnits int              
      ,@TotalBatchUnits int        
      ,@worksOrderOriginFK int   
      ,@sourceRackingTypeFK INT = NULL
      ,@destinationRackingTypeFK INT = NULL
      ,@IsSourceDriveThrough BIT = 0    
      ,@IsDestinationDriveThrough BIT = 0 
      ,@isSourceFixedLocation bit = 0
      ,@isDestinationFixedLocation bit = 0  
    
      SELECT @TotalPallet = 0, @TotalBatchPallet = 0, @TotalEaches = 0,  @TotalActualEaches = 0, @TotalUnits  = 0,  @TotalBatchUnits = 0                 
              
     /********** COMPLETE CODE ****/

    --update the pallet audit to show stock received instead of a pallet received              
    --as we dont want this pallet to be invoiced for as the stock has been absorded into another pallet              
    Declare @palletAuditPK int              
              
    Select @palletAuditPK = PalletAuditPK from tblPalletAudit Where PalletFK = @palletFK AND EventTypeFK = 1/*PalletCreated*/              
              
    -- Always attempt to begin a transaction before updating, inserting or deleting records in a permanent table              
    IF XACT_STATE() = 0 AND @@TRANCOUNT < 1 BEGIN TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName              
              
    update tblPalletAudit WITH (ROWLOCK)              
    Set EventTypeFK = 9              
    Where PalletAuditPK = @palletAuditPK              
              
    -- Always attempt to begin a transaction before updating, inserting or deleting records in a permanent table              
    IF XACT_STATE() = 0 AND @@TRANCOUNT < 1 BEGIN TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName              
    PRINT 'stockitem 3'         
    PRINT @stockItemFK              
    --insert a record on the pallet audit to show stock being added to an existing pallet              
    insert into tblPalletAudit (              
     BuildingUnitFK, PalletFK, EventTypeFK, EventFK, EventDate, StockItemFK, Batch, TotalPallets, TotalBatchPallets, TotalEaches, TotalBatchEaches, TotalUnits, TotalBatchUnits,              
     BuildingUnitTotalPallets, BuildingUnitTotalBatchPallets, BuildingUnitTotalEaches, BuildingUnitTotalBatchEaches, BuildingUnitTotalUnits, BuildingUnitTotalBatchUnits,              
     IsArchived, InsertedBy, InsertedDate, UpdatedBy, UpdatedDate)              
    Select @buildingUnitFK, @targetPalletFK, 10/*StockAdded*/, @worksOrderMovementPK2, dbo.GetBSTDate(), @stockItemFK, @batch,              
     0,0,0,0,0,0,/*stock levels, no longer used (never were)*/0,0,0,0,0,0,/*these are building unit stock levels*/0 /*bit value*/, @currentUserFK2, dbo.GetBSTDate(), @currentUserFK2, dbo.GetBSTDate()                
      END                        
     ENd               
     ELSE               
     BEGIN              
      Select @stockItemFK = pc.StockItemFK, @batch = pc.Batch              
      From tblPallets AS pallets               
      inner JOIN (              
    Select PalletFK, StockItemFK, Batch, palletcontentpk              
    from tblPalletContent               
    Group By PalletFK, StockItemFK, Batch, palletcontentpk              
      ) pc ON pc.PalletFK = pallets.PalletPK              
      Where pallets.PalletPK = @palletFK and pc.palletcontentpk = @palletContentFK              
              
      -- Cathal OCuirrin 20/07/2020 SIT-2375.              
      if isnull(@stockItemFK, -1) < 1              
      begin              
    Select distinct @stockItemFK = pc.StockItemFK, @batch = pc.Batch              
    From tblPallets AS pallets               
    inner JOIN (              
Select PalletFK, StockItemFK, Batch, palletcontentpk              
     from tblPalletContent               
     Group By PalletFK, StockItemFK, Batch, palletcontentpk              
    ) pc ON pc.PalletFK = pallets.PalletPK              
    Where pallets.PalletPK = @palletFK --and pc.palletcontentpk = @palletContentFK              
      end              
              
      IF(@movementUnits = @palletContentActualUnits)               
      BEGIN -- move the entire palletContent            
    -- Always attempt to begin a transaction before updating, inserting or deleting records in a permanent table              
    IF XACT_STATE() = 0 AND @@TRANCOUNT < 1 BEGIN TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName                      
              
    update tblPalletContent WITH (ROWLOCK)              
    Set PalletFK = -1, LooseLocationTypeFK = @locationTypeFK, LooseLocationFK = @locationFK              
    Where PalletContentPK = @palletContentFK              
      END               
      ELSE               
      BEGIN -- only part content movement              
    -- Always attempt to begin a transaction before updating, inserting or deleting records in a permanent table              
     if (@splitPalletNow2 =1)          
   begin          
            
    IF XACT_STATE() = 0 AND @@TRANCOUNT < 1 BEGIN TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName              
              
    update tblPalletContent WITH (ROWLOCK) --update the original pallet content              
    Set ActualUnits = ActualUnits - @movementUnits              
    Where PalletContentPK = @palletContentFK              
              
    -- Always attempt to begin a transaction before updating, inserting or deleting records in a permanent table              
    IF XACT_STATE() = 0 AND @@TRANCOUNT < 1 BEGIN TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName              
            
    /*Create new pallet content*/              
    INSERT INTO tblPalletContent (              
     PalletFK, LooseLocationTypeFK, LooseLocationFK, StockItemFK, SpecialStockTypeFK, Batch, EachUnits, ActualEaches, ActualUnits, AvailableEaches, AvailableUnits,               
     ExpiryDate, DateOfManufacture, BestBefore, DateOfReceipt, Barcode, IsArchived, InsertedBy, InsertedDate, UpdatedBy, UpdatedDate )              
    SELECT -1, @locationTypeFK, @locationFK, StockItemFK, SpecialStockTypeFK, Batch, EachUnits, ActualEaches, @movementUnits, 0/*AvailableEaches*/,0/*AvailableUnits*/,ExpiryDate,DateOfManufacture,BestBefore,              
    DateOfReceipt,Barcode,0 /*bit value*/, @currentUserFK2, dbo.GetBSTDate(), @currentUserFK2, dbo.GetBSTDate()              
    FROM tblPalletContent  Where PalletContentPK = @palletContentFK               
              
    Set @newPalletContentPK = scope_identity()              
              
    --if this is a container out movement, we have just made a split so we need to update the line              
    IF(@containerOutLinePalletContentFK <> -1)               
    BEGIN              
     -- Always attempt to begin a transaction before updating, inserting or deleting records in a permanent table              
     IF XACT_STATE() = 0 AND @@TRANCOUNT < 1 BEGIN TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName              
              
     update tblContainerOutLinePalletContent WITH (ROWLOCK)              
     Set SplitPalletContentFK = @newPalletContentPK              
     Where ContainerOutLinePalletContentPK = @containerOutLinePalletContentFK              
    END          
    End          
    Else          
    Begin          
            
    Declare @splipalletcontentfk int          
            
    select @splipalletcontentfk = SplitPalletContentFK from tblContainerOutLinePalletContent          
    Where ContainerOutLinePalletContentPK = @containerOutLinePalletContentFK              
             
     update tblPalletContent WITH (ROWLOCK)              
    Set LooseLocationTypeFK = @locationTypeFK, LooseLocationFK = @locationFK              
    Where PalletContentPK = @splipalletcontentfk            
    END          
     END            
                     
      -- Always attempt to begin a transaction before updating, inserting or deleting records in a permanent table              
      IF XACT_STATE() = 0 AND @@TRANCOUNT < 1 BEGIN TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName              
      PRINT 'stockitem 4'              
    PRINT @stockItemFK              
      --insert a record on the pallet audit to show movement              
      insert into tblPalletAudit (              
    BuildingUnitFK, PalletFK, EventTypeFK, EventFK, EventDate, StockItemFK, Batch, TotalPallets, TotalBatchPallets, TotalEaches, TotalBatchEaches, TotalUnits, TotalBatchUnits, BuildingUnitTotalPallets,               
    BuildingUnitTotalBatchPallets, BuildingUnitTotalEaches, BuildingUnitTotalBatchEaches, BuildingUnitTotalUnits, BuildingUnitTotalBatchUnits, IsArchived, InsertedBy, InsertedDate, UpdatedBy, UpdatedDate)              
      Select @buildingUnitFK, @palletFK, 17/*Movement*/, @worksOrderMovementPK2, dbo.GetBSTDate(), @stockItemFK, @batch, 0,0,0,0,0,0,--stock levels, no longer used              
      0,0,0,0,0,0,/*these are building unit stock levels*/ 0 /*bit value*/, @currentUserFK2, dbo.GetBSTDate(), @currentUserFK2, dbo.GetBSTDate()               
     END --End of bay racking movement              
    END              
   END              
              
   -- Always attempt to begin a transaction before updating, inserting or deleting records in a permanent table              
   IF XACT_STATE() = 0 AND @@TRANCOUNT < 1 BEGIN TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName              
      
   --Update the Pallet BuildingUnitFK              
   Update pals WITH (ROWLOCK)              
   SET pals.BuildingUnitFK = vbays.BuildingUnitFK              
   from tblPallets pals              
   INNER JOIN viewBuildingUnitBays vbays on pals.LocationFK = BuildingUnitBayPK and pals.LocationTypefk = vbays.locationtypefk AND vbays.IsArchived = 0 /* DG #DEV-910 Exclude Archived Bays */              
   Where pals.PalletPK = @palletFK              
      
   -- Retrieve the BuildingUnit the pallet is moved to               
   SELECT @NewBuildingUnitFK = buildingUnitFK FROM tblPallets  WHERE PalletPK = @PalletFK              
              
   --jamie : check if building unit has changed and works order is part of a stock out              
   IF(@NewBuildingUnitFK <> @buildingUnitFK)-- AND @worksOrderOriginFK = 2)              
   BEGIN              
    PRINT 'building has changed ... check if pallet on order'              
    IF(EXISTS(SELECT palletFk FROM dbo.viewContainerOutPalletList vcopl WHERE vcopl.PalletFK = @PalletFK AND vcopl.ContainerOutStatusFK NOT in(5,6)))              
    BEGIN              
     PRINT 'pallet on order ... tidy up records'              
     EXEC spWorksOrderMovementBuildingUnitChange @WorksOrderMovementPK2, @PalletFK ,@NewBuildingUnitFK, @CurrentUserFK2              
     PRINT 'wo tidy up complete'              
    END              
   END              
 END              
 
 /********** END OF COMPLETE CODE ***/              
              
  COMPLETEMOVEMENT:      
      -- Always attempt to begin a transaction before updating, inserting or deleting records in a permanent table              
      IF XACT_STATE() = 0 AND @@TRANCOUNT < 1 BEGIN TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName              
      PRINT 'update this movement'            
        
    --EXEC spMobileWriteToLogFile @ErrorNo, @ErrorMessage, @Procedure              
     UPDATE tblWorksOrderMovements WITH (ROWLOCK)               
     SET WorksOrderStatusFK = @worksOrderStatusFK2,    
         UpdatedBy = @currentUserFK2,     
         UpdatedDate = dbo.GetBSTDate(),    
         HandheldDeviceFK = @HandheldDeviceFK2,    
         WarehouseMachineFK = @WarehouseMachineFK2            
     WHERE WorksOrderMovementPK = @worksOrderMovementPK2              
               
     PRINT 'update this works order if needed'              
      
    IF( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tblWorksOrderMovements              
        WHERE WorksOrderFK = @WorksOrderPK              
        AND WorksOrderStatusFK NOT IN (3,4) /*Complete or Cancelled*/    
      ) = 0              
         
   BEGIN  /*All pallet movements are complete, set the works order to complete*/              
     -- Always attempt to begin a transaction before updating, inserting or deleting records in a permanent table              
     IF XACT_STATE() = 0 AND @@TRANCOUNT < 1 BEGIN TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName              
     PRINT 'updating wo'              
     UPDATE tblWorksOrders WITH (ROWLOCK)              
     SET WorksOrderStatusFK = 3/*Complete*/,     
         UpdatedBy = @currentUserFK2,     
         UpdatedDate = dbo.GetBSTDate()              
     WHERE WorksOrderPK = @worksOrderPK              
              
     --jamie: record to container out log              
     IF @ContainerOutFK IS NOT NULL             
      BEGIN              
       -- Always attempt to begin a transaction before updating, inserting or deleting records in a permanent table              
       IF XACT_STATE() = 0 AND @@TRANCOUNT < 1 BEGIN TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName                   
                
        INSERT INTO tblcontaineroutaudit               
        VALUES (@ContainerOutFK, 4, 'All movements completed', 0 /*bit value*/, 0 /*bit value*/, @currentUserFK2, dbo.GetBSTDate(), @currentUserFK2, dbo.GetBSTDate(),0)              
      END              
   END              
              
  FINISH:                
    SELECT CAST(1 as bit) -- Cast required for the front end C# code                 
             
     -- Always attempt to commit before returning              
     BEGIN TRY IF XACT_STATE() = 1 AND @@TRANCOUNT = 1 AND @OpeningTranCount < 1 COMMIT TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH              
              
     --DECLARE @RuntimeInSecondsText NVARCHAR(100) = (SELECT CAST( (SELECT ABS(DATEDIFF(ss, [Date], dbo.GetBSTDate()))) AS NVARCHAR(100)) FROM [dbo].[tblEventLog] WHERE EventLogPK = @EventLogPK)              
              
     ---- Record how long it took to run/execute this stored procedure.              
     --UPDATE [dbo].[tblEventLog] WITH (ROWLOCK)              
     --SET [State] = [State] + ', Runtime (Seconds) ' + @RuntimeInSecondsText              
     --WHERE EventLogPK = @EventLogPK AND @EventLogPK > 0              
              
     Return 1                
              
   -- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end                 
          
   BREAK              
  END TRY              
  BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */              
              
   DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;              
              
   SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;              
   SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;              
              
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY               
   BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;              
                     
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;              
              
            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID              
                          
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;              
                          
   IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)              
   BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END              
   ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */              
  END CATCH              
  SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1              
 END              
END 
GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[spAccountsExport]    Script Date: 02/11/2026 17:47:25 ******/
