CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spAccountsExport]       
AS      
BEGIN      
 /* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */      
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED      
      
    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT      
 ,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;      
 SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();      
      
 SET @ParameterDetails = ''      
      
    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL       
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)      
      
    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)      
    --BEGIN      
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC       
      
  SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)      
      
        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)      
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK      
      
        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()      
    --END      
      
 SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);      
 SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails      
 ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;      
 INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()      
      
 WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3      
 BEGIN       
  BEGIN TRY      
         
   -- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start      
      
   Select            
    ExportType,       
    Case When CustomerCode = 'DAN07' Then 'NUT02' Else CustomerCode End As CustomerCode,      
    NominalCode,      
    DepartmentCode,       
    InvoiceDate,      
    InvoiceNumber,       
    ChargeText,       
    Charge,       
    [Description],       
    Tax      
   From       
   (      
    Select       
     'SI' as ExportType,       
     --customers.CustomerCode as CustomerCode,       
     CASE WHEN invoices.DivisionFK > 0 and customers.InvoiceExportWithCustomerCode = 0 then   
   CASE   
     WHEN divisions.CustomSageCode IS NOT NULL AND divisions.CustomSageCode <> ''   THEN divisions.CustomSageCode   
      ELSE divisions.DivisionCode   
      END      
  Else   
  CASE   
        WHEN customers.CustomSageCode IS NOT NULL AND  customers.CustomSageCode <> '' THEN customers.CustomSageCode   
        ELSE customers.CustomerCode   
     END  
     End AS CustomerCode,      
     Case When invoiceLines.NominalCode = '' Then invoiceLineTypes.NominalCode Else invoiceLines.NominalCode End NominalCode,      
      
     Case When invoiceLines.DepartmentFK > 0 AND Departments.DepartmentCode IS NOT NULL THEN      
       Departments.DepartmentCode       
      When invoiceLines.buildingunitfk > 0 AND BUDepartments.DepartmentCode IS NOT NULL Then       
       BUDepartments.DepartmentCode      
      When DivDepartments.DepartmentCode IS NOT NULL THEN       
       DivDepartments.DepartmentCode      
      When CustDepartments.DepartmentCode IS NOT NULL THEN       
       CustDepartments.DepartmentCode      
     End As DepartmentCode,       
      
     Right('0' + Cast(DatePart(dd, invoices.InvoiceToDate) As Varchar(2)), 2) + Right('0' + Cast(DatePart(mm, invoices.InvoiceToDate) As Varchar(2)),2) + Right(Cast(DatePart(yy, invoices.InvoiceToDate) As Varchar(4)), 2) As InvoiceDate,      
     invoices.InvoiceNumber, invoiceLines.ChargeText, invoiceLines.Charge,       
     vatCodes.[Description], invoiceLines.Tax      
    From      
     tblInvoiceExports invoiceExports      
   Inner Join tblInvoices As invoices      
     On invoices.InvoicePK = invoiceExports.InvoiceFK      
    Inner Join tblInvoiceLines As invoiceLines      
     On invoiceLines.InvoiceFK = invoices.InvoicePK      
    Inner Join tblVatCodes As vatCodes      
     On vatCodes.VatCodePK = invoiceLines.VatCodeFK      
    Inner Join appInvoiceLineTypes As invoiceLineTypes      
     On invoiceLineTypes.InvoiceLineTypePK = invoiceLines.InvoiceLineTypeFK      
    Left Outer Join tblDivisions As divisions      
     On divisions.DivisionPK = invoices.DivisionFK and invoices.DivisionFK > 0      
    Left Outer Join tblCustomers As customers      
     On (customers.CustomerPK = invoices.CustomerFK and invoices.CustomerFK > 0)      
     Or (customers.CustomerPK = divisions.CustomerFK and divisions.CustomerFK > 0)      
    Left Outer Join tblDepartments As DivDepartments      
     On DivDepartments.DepartmentPK = divisions.DepartmentFK and divisions.DepartmentFK > 0      
    Left Outer Join tblDepartments As CustDepartments      
     On CustDepartments.DepartmentPK = customers.DepartmentFK and customers.DepartmentFK > 0      
      
    -- LJF - HAve remmed this out as it was causing duplicates as the department could be different      
    -- So now the department comes from the customer only      
    -- OR      
    -- DivDepartments.DepartmentPK = divisions.DepartmentFK       
      
    Left Outer Join tblbuildingunits As bu       
     On bu.buildingunitpk = invoicelines.buildingunitfk      
    Left Outer Join tblDepartments As buDepartments      
     On buDepartments.DepartmentPK = bu.DepartmentFK and bu.DepartmentFK > 0      
    Left Outer Join tblDepartments As Departments      
     On Departments.DepartmentPK = invoicelines.DepartmentFK      
    Where       
     invoices.Exported=0/*cast(0 as bit)*/      
     AND  invoiceLines.Charge > 0 /*We do not export Zero charges into sage*/      
      
    --Select       
    -- 'SI' as ExportType,       
    -- customers.CustomerCode as CustomerCode,       
    -- Case When invoiceLines.NominalCode = '' Then invoiceLineTypes.NominalCode Else invoiceLines.NominalCode End NominalCode,      
    -- Case When invoiceLines.buildingunitfk > 0 Then BuildingDepartments.DepartmentCode Else DivDepartments.DepartmentCode End As DepartmentCode,       
    -- Right('0' + Cast(DatePart(dd, invoices.InvoiceToDate) As Varchar(2)), 2) + Right('0' + Cast(DatePart(mm, invoices.InvoiceToDate) As Varchar(2)),2) + Right(Cast(DatePart(yy, invoices.InvoiceToDate) As Varchar(4)), 2) As InvoiceDate,      
    -- invoices.InvoiceNumber, invoiceLines.ChargeText, invoiceLines.Charge,       
    -- vatCodes.[Description], invoiceLines.Tax      
    --From      
    -- tblInvoiceExports invoiceExports      
    --Inner Join tblInvoices As invoices      
    -- On invoices.InvoicePK = invoiceExports.InvoiceFK      
    --Inner Join tblInvoiceLines As invoiceLines      
    -- On invoiceLines.InvoiceFK = invoices.InvoicePK      
    --Inner Join tblVatCodes As vatCodes      
    -- On vatCodes.VatCodePK = invoiceLines.VatCodeFK      
    --Inner Join appInvoiceLineTypes As invoiceLineTypes      
    -- On invoiceLineTypes.InvoiceLineTypePK = invoiceLines.InvoiceLineTypeFK      
    --Left Outer Join tblDivisions As divisions      
    -- On divisions.DivisionPK = invoices.DivisionFK      
    --Left Outer Join tblCustomers As customers      
    -- On customers.CustomerPK = invoices.CustomerFK      
    -- Or customers.CustomerPK = divisions.CustomerFK      
    --Left Outer Join tblDepartments As DivDepartments      
    -- On DivDepartments.DepartmentPK = customers.DepartmentFK      
      
    ---- LJF - HAve remmed this out as it was causing duplicates as the department could be different      
    ---- So now the department comes from the customer only      
    ---- OR      
    ---- DivDepartments.DepartmentPK = divisions.DepartmentFK       
      
    --Left Outer Join tblbuildingunits As bu       
    -- On bu.buildingunitpk = invoicelines.buildingunitfk      
    --Left Outer Join tblDepartments As BuildingDepartments       
    -- On BuildingDepartments.DepartmentPK = bu.DepartmentFK      
   --Where       
    -- invoices.Exported=0/*cast(0 as bit)*/      
    -- AND invoiceLines.Charge > 0 /*We do not export Zero charges into sage*/      
           
    UNION ALL      
      
    Select       
     'SC' As ExportType,       
     Case When creditNotes.DivisionFK > 0 and customers.InvoiceExportWithCustomerCode = 0 Then   
  CASE   
     WHEN divisions.CustomSageCode IS NOT NULL AND divisions.CustomSageCode <> ''   THEN divisions.CustomSageCode   
      ELSE divisions.DivisionCode   
      END      
  Else   
  CASE   
        WHEN customers.CustomSageCode IS NOT NULL AND  customers.CustomSageCode <> '' THEN customers.CustomSageCode   
        ELSE customers.CustomerCode   
     END  
      END AS CustomerCode,   
     invoiceLineTypes.NominalCode,      
     departments.DepartmentCode,       
     Right('0' + Cast(DATEPART(dd, creditNotes.CreditToDate) As Varchar(2)), 2) + Right('0' + Cast(DatePart(mm, creditNotes.CreditToDate) As Varchar(2)),2) + Right(Cast(DatePart(yy, creditNotes.CreditToDate) As Varchar(4)), 2) As InvoiceDate,      
     creditNotes.CreditNoteNumber As InvoiceNumber,       
     creditNoteLines.CreditNoteLineText As ChargeText,       
     creditNoteLines.CreditNoteLineValue As Charge,       
     vatCodes.[Description],       
     creditNoteLines.Tax      
    from      
     tblInvoiceExports AS invoiceExports      
    Inner Join tblCreditNotes AS creditNotes      
     On creditNotes.CreditNotePK = invoiceExports.CreditNoteFK      
    Inner Join tblCreditNoteLines AS creditNoteLines      
     On creditNoteLines.CreditNoteFK = creditNotes.CreditNotePK      
    Inner Join tblVatCodes AS vatCodes      
     On vatCodes.VatCodePK = creditNoteLines.VatCodeFK      
    Inner Join appInvoiceLineTypes AS invoiceLineTypes      
     On invoiceLineTypes.InvoiceLineTypePK = creditNoteLines.CreditNoteLineTypeFK      
    Left Outer Join tblDivisions AS divisions      
     On divisions.DivisionPK = creditNotes.DivisionFK      
    Left Outer Join tblCustomers AS customers      
     On customers.CustomerPK = creditNotes.CustomerFK      
    Left Outer Join tblDepartments AS departments      
     On (departments.DepartmentPK = divisions.DepartmentFK and  creditNotes.DivisionFK > 0)    
     Or (departments.DepartmentPK = customers.DepartmentFK  and  creditNotes.DivisionFK = -1)    
    Where       
     creditNotes.Exported = 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/      
   ) AS subQ       
   Order By       
    Cast(InvoiceNumber As Int)      
      
   -- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end      
            
   BREAK      
  END TRY      
  BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */      
   DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;      
   SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;      
   SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;      
      
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY       
   BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;   
             
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;      
      
            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID      
                  
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;      
                  
   IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)      
   BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END      
   ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */      
  END CATCH      
  SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1      
 END      
END 
GO

-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spAccountsSetQueuedToExported]	
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT
 ,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;
	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

	SET @ParameterDetails = ''

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    --BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

		SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END


	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY
			IF XACT_STATE() = 0 AND @@TRANCOUNT < 1 BEGIN TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start

			update tblInvoices WITH (ROWLOCK)
			Set Exported = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/,
			ExportedDate = dbo.GetBSTDate(),
			QueuedForExport = 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/
			Where QueuedForExport = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/

			update tblCreditNotes WITH (ROWLOCK)
			Set Exported = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/,
			ExportedDate = dbo.GetBSTDate(),
			QueuedForExport = 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/
			Where QueuedForExport = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/

			TRUNCATE TABLE tblInvoiceExports --Clear the table

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end

			BEGIN TRY IF XACT_STATE() = 1 AND @@TRANCOUNT = 1 AND @OpeningTranCount < 1 COMMIT TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH
			
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END
GO

-- =============================================
-- Author:		DeVille
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	Gets all email addresses to send docket to
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spActivityEmailAddresses]
(
	@docketTypeFK int,
	@fK int
)
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT
 ,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;
	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	DECLARE @docketTypeFK2 int, @fK2 int
	SET @docketTypeFK2 = @docketTypeFK; SET @fK2 = @fK

	SET @ParameterDetails = '@docketTypeFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@docketTypeFK2 AS NVARCHAR(100)),'')
								+ ',@fK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@fK2 AS NVARCHAR(100)),'')

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    --BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

		SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END


	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY
			

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start

			if(@docketTypeFK2 = 1) 
			BEGIN --In
				Select AutoStockInEmailAddress as EmailAddress
				from tblDivisions
				Where AutoEmailStockIn = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/
				AND DivisionPK in (Select DivisionFK from tblStockIns where StockInPK = @fK2)
			End	
			Else if(@docketTypeFK2 = 2) 
			BEGIN --Out    
				Select AutoStockOutEmailAddress as EmailAddress
				from tblDivisions
				Where AutoEmailStockOut = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/
				AND DivisionPK in (Select DivisionFK from tblContainerOutLines where ContainerOutFK = @fK2)
			End 
			--Else if(@docketTypeFK2 = 3) 
			--Begin --Invoice
			--	Print 'TODO'
			--End 
			Else if(@docketTypeFK2 = 4) 
			Begin --transfer In
				Select AutoStockTransferInEmailAddress as EmailAddress
				from tblDivisions
				Where AutoEmailStockTransferIn = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/
				AND DivisionPK in (Select DivisionFK from tblStockIns si inner join tblstocktransfers st on st.ContainerInFK = si.ContainerInFK where StockInPK = @fK2)
			End 
			Else if(@docketTypeFK2 = 5) 
			Begin --transfer Out
				Select AutoStockTransferOutEmailAddress as EmailAddress
				from tblDivisions
				Where AutoEmailStockTransferOut = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/
				AND DivisionPK in (Select DivisionFK from tblContainerOutLines col inner join tblstocktransfers st on st.ContainerOutFK = col.ContainerOutFK where col.ContainerOutFK = @fK2)
			End
			Else if(@docketTypeFK2 = 6) 
			Begin --EndOfDayInventory
				Select AutoEmailEndOfDayInventoryEmailAddress as EmailAddress
				from tblDivisions
				Where AutoEmailEndOfDayInventory = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/
				AND DivisionPK= @fK2
			End

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end

			
			
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END

-- =============================================
-- Author:		DeVille
-- Create date: 15/05/2013
-- Description:	Get any extra dockets
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spActivityExtraDockets]
(
	@docketTypeFK int,
	@fK int,
	@email bit
)
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT
 ,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;
	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	DECLARE @docketTypeFK2 int, @fK2 int, @email2 bit
	SET @docketTypeFK2 = @docketTypeFK; SET @fK2 = @fK; SET @email2 = @email

	SET @ParameterDetails = '@docketTypeFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@docketTypeFK2 AS NVARCHAR(100)),'')  
		+ ',@fK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@fK2 AS NVARCHAR(100)),'') + ',@email = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@email2 AS NVARCHAR(1)),'')

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    --BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

		SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END


	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY
			

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start

			if(@email2 = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/) 
			BEGIN
				if(@docketTypeFK2 = 1) 
				BEGIN --In
					Select ExtraDocketTypeFK, ExtraDocketRPX, ExtraDocketStoredProcedure
					from tblExtraDockets
					Where 
						ExtraDocketTypeFK in (5 /*Stock In XML*/)
						AND
						(
						DivisionFK in (Select DivisionFK from tblStockIns where StockInPK = @fK2)
						OR
						CustomerFK in (Select divs.CustomerFK from tblStockIns sins inner join tblDivisions divs on divs.DivisionPK = sins.DivisionFK where StockInPK = @fK2)
						)
						AND Email = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/
				End	
				Else if(@docketTypeFK2 = 2) 
				BEGIN --Out    
					Select ExtraDocketTypeFK, ExtraDocketRPX, ExtraDocketStoredProcedure
					from tblExtraDockets
					Where
						ExtraDocketTypeFK in (6 /*Stock Out XML*/)
						AND
						(
						DivisionFK in (Select DivisionFK from tblContainerOutLines where ContainerOutFK = @fK2)
						OR
						CustomerFK in (Select divs.CustomerFK from tblContainerOutLines cols inner join tblDivisions divs on divs.DivisionPK = cols.DivisionFK where ContainerOutFK = @fK2)
						)
						AND Email = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/
				End 
				--Else if(@docketTypeFK = 3) --Invoice
				--	Print 'TODO'  
			END 
			ELSE 
			BEGIN
				if(@docketTypeFK2 = 1) 
				BEGIN --In
					Select ExtraDocketTypeFK, ExtraDocketRPX, ExtraDocketStoredProcedure
					from tblExtraDockets
					Where 
						ExtraDocketTypeFK in (1,2)
						AND
						(
						DivisionFK in (Select DivisionFK from tblStockIns where StockInPK = @fK2)
						OR
						CustomerFK in (Select divs.CustomerFK from tblStockIns sins inner join tblDivisions divs on divs.DivisionPK = sins.DivisionFK where StockInPK = @fK2)
						)
				End	
				Else if(@docketTypeFK2 = 2) 
				BEGIN --Out    
					Select ExtraDocketTypeFK, ExtraDocketRPX, ExtraDocketStoredProcedure
					from tblExtraDockets
					Where
						ExtraDocketTypeFK in (3,4)
						AND
						(
						DivisionFK in (Select DivisionFK from tblContainerOutLines where ContainerOutFK = @fK2)
						OR
						CustomerFK in (Select divs.CustomerFK from tblContainerOutLines cols inner join tblDivisions divs on divs.DivisionPK = cols.DivisionFK where ContainerOutFK = @fK2)
						)
				End 
				--Else if(@docketTypeFK = 3) --Invoice
				--	Print 'TODO'   
			END 

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end

			
			
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END
GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[spAddEmployeeTMSDetailsRecord]    Script Date: 02/11/2026 17:47:25 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spAddEmployeeTMSDetailsRecord]
(
--declare
	@employeeScannedPalletMovementDetailPK INT,
	@clockedTime TIME(5),
	@department NVARCHAR(50),
	@userFK INT 

	--select @employeeScannedPalletMovementDetailPK = 1, @clockedTime = '09:00', @department = 'BV1', @userFK = 287
)
AS
BEGIN		
	IF ISNULL(@EmployeeScannedPalletMovementDetailPK, -1) < 1 OR @clockedTime IS NULL OR ISNULL(@department, '') = '' OR ISNULL(@userFK, -1) < 1 GOTO EXIT_PROC
	
	DECLARE 
		@varEmployeeScannedPalletMovementDetailPK int = @employeeScannedPalletMovementDetailPK, 
		@varClockedTime TIME(5) = @clockedTime,
		@varDepartment NVARCHAR(50) = @department,
		@varUserFK INT = @userFK,
		@varTMSEmployeeClockCardDetailFK INT,
		@varEmployeeNumber NVARCHAR(50),
		@varEmployeeName NVARCHAR(200),
		@varClockCardDate NVARCHAR(10)
	
	SELECT DISTINCT 
		@varTMSEmployeeClockCardDetailFK = ttct.TMSEmployeeClockCardDetailFK,
		@varEmployeeNumber = ppl.EmployeeNumber,
		@varEmployeeName = RTRIM(ppl.FirstName) + ' ' + RTRIM(ppl.LastName),
		@varClockCardDate = CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), tespmd.ClockCardDate, 23)
	FROM 
		dbo.tblEmployeeScannedPalletMovementDetails tespmd
	LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.tblTMSEmployeeClockedTimes ttct
		ON ttct.TMSEmployeeClockCardDetailFK = tespmd.TMSEmployeeClockCardDetailPK
	LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.tblUsers usr
		ON tespmd.UserFK = usr.UserPK
	LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.tblPeople ppl
		ON usr.PersonFK = ppl.PersonPK
	WHERE 
		tespmd.EmployeeScannedPalletMovementDetailPK = @varEmployeeScannedPalletMovementDetailPK

	DECLARE @transaction NVARCHAR(32) = REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(CAST(@@SPID AS NVARCHAR(50)) + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(50), dbo.GetBSTDate(), 21), ' - ', ''), ' ', ''), ':', ''), '.', '')

	BEGIN TRY
		BEGIN TRANSACTION @transaction

		IF ISNULL(@varTMSEmployeeClockCardDetailFK, -1) < 1
		BEGIN
			EXEC @varTMSEmployeeClockCardDetailFK = dbo.spAddMSEmployeeClockCardDetailRecord @employeeNumber = @varEmployeeNumber, @employeeName = @varEmployeeName, @clockCardDate = @varClockCardDate, @baseDepartment = @varDepartment, @userFK = @userFK 

			IF ISNULL(@varTMSEmployeeClockCardDetailFK, -1) < 1 
			BEGIN
				ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @transaction
				RETURN
			END

			UPDATE dbo.tblEmployeeScannedPalletMovementDetails WITH (ROWLOCK)
			SET TMSEmployeeClockCardDetailPK = @varTMSEmployeeClockCardDetailFK
			WHERE EmployeeScannedPalletMovementDetailPK = @varEmployeeScannedPalletMovementDetailPK
		END

		INSERT INTO dbo.tblTMSEmployeeClockedTimes
		(
			TMSEmployeeClockCardDetailFK, ClockedTime, InsertedBy, InsertedDate, UpdatedBy, UpdatedDate, Department, CreatedByFile
		)
		SELECT 
			@varTMSEmployeeClockCardDetailFK, 
			@clockedTime,
			@varUserFK,
			dbo.GetBSTDate(),
			@varUserFK,
			dbo.GetBSTDate(),
			@varDepartment,
			0

		COMMIT TRANSACTION @transaction
	END TRY
	BEGIN CATCH
		DECLARE @ErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX) = ERROR_MESSAGE(), @ErrorSeverity INT = ERROR_SEVERITY(), @ErrorState INT = ERROR_STATE()

		BEGIN TRY
			ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @transaction 
		END TRY 
		BEGIN CATCH /*do nothing*/ END CATCH

		RAISERROR (@ErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState)
	END CATCH

EXIT_PROC:

END
GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[spAddJiraTicketDetailRecordsToReportingDb]    Script Date: 02/11/2026 17:47:25 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spAddJiraTicketDetailRecordsToReportingDb]
(
	@sQLCommand NVARCHAR(MAX)
)
AS
BEGIN
	DECLARE @varStoredProcedureName NVARCHAR(500) = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID), @varSQLCommand NVARCHAR(MAX) = @sQLCommand

	IF ISNULL(@varSQLCommand, '') = '' RETURN

	BEGIN TRY		
		DELETE FROM dbo.tblStoredProcedureLogging WHERE StoredProcedureName = @varStoredProcedureName

		INSERT INTO dbo.tblStoredProcedureLogging SELECT @varStoredProcedureName, 'Proc execution started', dbo.GetBSTDate()
	
		INSERT INTO dbo.tblStoredProcedureLogging SELECT @varStoredProcedureName, 'EXEC sp_execute_remote StawmsReportingDataSource, EXEC dbo.spAddJiraTicketDetailsRecords started', dbo.GetBSTDate()
		
		-- Add the Jira ticket detail records into the Stawms Reporting database table.
		EXEC sp_execute_remote	@data_source_name  = N'StawmsReportingDataSource', 
								@stmt = N'EXEC dbo.spAddJiraTicketDetailRecords @sQLCommand', 
								@params = N'@sQLCommand NVARCHAR(MAX)',
								@sQLCommand = @varSQLCommand

		INSERT INTO dbo.tblStoredProcedureLogging SELECT @varStoredProcedureName, 'EXEC sp_execute_remote StawmsReportingDataSource, EXEC dbo.spAddJiraTicketDetailsRecords completed', dbo.GetBSTDate()

		INSERT INTO dbo.tblStoredProcedureLogging SELECT @varStoredProcedureName, 'Proc execution completed', dbo.GetBSTDate()
	END TRY
	BEGIN CATCH
		DECLARE @ErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX) = ERROR_MESSAGE(), @ErrorSeverity INT = ERROR_SEVERITY(), @ErrorState INT = ERROR_STATE()

		INSERT INTO dbo.tblStoredProcedureLogging SELECT @varStoredProcedureName, 'ERROR_MESSAGE = ' + @ErrorMessage + ', ERROR_SEVERITY = ' + CAST(@ErrorSeverity AS NVARCHAR(50)) + ', ERROR_STATE = ' + CAST(@ErrorState AS NVARCHAR(50)), dbo.GetBSTDate()

		RAISERROR (@ErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState)
	END CATCH
END

-- ==================================================================================================================
-- Author:      Cathal OCuirrin
-- Create Date: 14 November 2019
-- Description: Add a new record into the tblTMSEmployeeClockCardDetails table. 
-- Needed when adding TMS times on the WMS where the employee has no existing tblTMSEmployeeClockCardDetails record. 
-- ==================================================================================================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spAddMSEmployeeClockCardDetailRecord]
(
	@employeeNumber NVARCHAR(50), 
	@employeeName NVARCHAR(200), 
	@clockCardDate NVARCHAR(10), 
	@baseDepartment NVARCHAR(50),
	@userFK INT
)
AS
BEGIN
	DECLARE 
		@varEmployeeNumber NVARCHAR(50) = @employeeNumber, 
		@varEmployeeName NVARCHAR(200) = @employeeName, 
		@varClockCardDate NVARCHAR(10) = @clockCardDate, 
		@varBaseDepartment NVARCHAR(50) = @baseDepartment, 
		@varUserFK INT = @userFK,
		@varTMSEmployeeClockCardDetailPK INT

	DECLARE @transaction NVARCHAR(32) = REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(CAST(@@SPID AS NVARCHAR(50)) + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(50), dbo.GetBSTDate(), 21), ' - ', ''), ' ', ''), ':', ''), '.', '')

	BEGIN TRY
		BEGIN TRANSACTION @transaction

		INSERT INTO dbo.tblTMSEmployeeClockCardDetails
		(
			EmployeeNumber, EmployeeName, ClockCardDate, ClockCardTimes, BaseDepartment, BasicHours, Overtime, DoubleTime, Basic20Percent, OT1_20Percent, OT2_20Percent, Basic25Percent, 
			OT1_25Percent, OT2_25Percent, AbsenceCodes, AbsenceHours, Reason, [Shift], IsArchived, InsertedBy, InsertedDate, UpdatedBy, UpdatedDate, TimeWorkedInMinutes
		)
		SELECT @varEmployeeNumber, @varEmployeeName, @varClockCardDate, '' /*ClockCardTimes*/, @varBaseDepartment, '00:00:00.0000000' /*BasicHours*/, '00:00:00.0000000' /*Overtime*/,	'00:00:00.0000000' /*DoubleTime*/, '00:00:00.0000000' /*Basic20Percent*/,	
		'00:00:00.0000000' /*OT1_20Percent*/,  '00:00:00.0000000' /*OT2_20Percent*/, '00:00:00.0000000' /*Basic25Percent*/,	
		'00:00:00.0000000' /*OT1_25Percent*/, '00:00:00.0000000' /*OT2_25Percent*/, '' /*AbsenceCodes*/, '00:00:00.0000000' /*AbsenceHours*/,
		'' /*Reason*/, '' /*Shift*/, 0, @varUserFK, dbo.GetBSTDate(), @varUserFK, dbo.GetBSTDate(), 0 /*TimeWorkedInMinutes*/

		-- Need to return this so tblTMSEmployeeClockedTimes records can be created.
		SET @varTMSEmployeeClockCardDetailPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY() 	

		COMMIT TRANSACTION @transaction

		RETURN @varTMSEmployeeClockCardDetailPK
	END TRY
	BEGIN CATCH
		DECLARE @ErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX) = ERROR_MESSAGE(), @ErrorSeverity INT = ERROR_SEVERITY(), @ErrorState INT = ERROR_STATE()

		BEGIN TRY
			ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @transaction 
		END TRY 
		BEGIN CATCH /*do nothing*/ END CATCH

		RAISERROR (@ErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState)
	END CATCH
END
GO

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spAddNewColumnAndValueToTable]
(
	@DatabaseName NVARCHAR(100)			-- Required parameter
	,@TableName NVARCHAR(100)			-- Required parameter
	,@ColumnName NVARCHAR(100)			-- Required parameter
	,@ColumnAttributes NVARCHAR(100)	-- Required parameter, i.e. data type, size, allows NULL and/or default value
	,@ColumnValue NVARCHAR(MAX) = ''	-- Optional parameter
)
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT
 ,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;
	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	DECLARE @DatabaseName2 NVARCHAR(100)
	,@TableName2 NVARCHAR(100)
	,@ColumnName2 NVARCHAR(100)
	,@ColumnAttributes2 NVARCHAR(100)
	,@ColumnValue2 NVARCHAR(MAX)

	SET @DatabaseName2 = @DatabaseName; SET @TableName2 = @TableName; SET @ColumnName2 = @ColumnName; SET @ColumnAttributes2 = @ColumnAttributes; SET @ColumnValue2 = @ColumnValue

	SET @ParameterDetails = '@DatabaseName = ' + ISNULL(@DatabaseName2,'') + '@TableName = ' + ISNULL(@TableName2,'')
		+ '@ColumnName = ' + ISNULL(@ColumnName2,'') + '@ColumnAttributes = ' + ISNULL(@ColumnAttributes2,'')
			+ '@ColumnValue = ' + ISNULL(@ColumnValue2,'')

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    --BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

		SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END


	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY
			IF XACT_STATE() = 0 AND @@TRANCOUNT < 1 BEGIN TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start

			-- Validate values of required parameters
			IF ISNULL(@DatabaseName2,'') = '' OR ISNULL(@TableName2,'') = '' OR ISNULL(@ColumnName2,'') = '' OR ISNULL(@ColumnName2,'') = ''
			BEGIN
				ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName

				PRINT 'Cannot proceed as 1 or more of the following parameters are blank/null: @DatabaseName,@TableName,@ColumnName, @ColumnAttributes'
				RETURN
			END

			-- Build alter table SQL code
			DECLARE @SQL NVARCHAR(MAX)
		
			SET @SQL = N'ALTER TABLE ' + @DatabaseName2 + '.dbo.' + @TableName2 +  ' ADD ' + @ColumnName2 + ' ' + @ColumnAttributes2

			-- Add the column if it does not already exist in the table
			IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM sys.columns WHERE object_id = OBJECT_ID(N'' + @DatabaseName2 + '.dbo.' + @TableName2) AND [name] = @ColumnName2)
			BEGIN
				PRINT @SQL
				EXEC(@SQL)
				PRINT 'Column ' + @ColumnName2 + ' successfully added into table ' + @DatabaseName2 + '.dbo.' + @TableName2
			END
			ELSE
			BEGIN
				ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName

				PRINT 'Column ' + @ColumnName2 + ' not added into table ' + @DatabaseName2 + '.dbo.' + @TableName2 + ' as it already exists in the table'
				RETURN
			END

			-- Find out if the table contains records

			SET @SQL = 'IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM ' + @TableName2 + ') SELECT 1 ELSE SELECT 0'

			IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#T') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #T
			
			CREATE TABLE #T([Result] INT)

			INSERT INTO #T EXEC(@SQL)

			-- Do not update the column value if there are no records
			IF (SELECT [Result] FROM #T) = 0 
			BEGIN
				ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName

				PRINT 'No records in table ' + @DatabaseName2 + '.dbo.' + @TableName2 + ' so cannot add a value for column ' + @ColumnName2
				RETURN
			END

			-- Do not update the column value if the parameter is null
			IF @ColumnValue2 IS NOT NULL
			BEGIN
				SET @SQL = 'UPDATE ' + @DatabaseName2 + '.dbo.' + @TableName2 + ' WITH (ROWLOCK) SET ' + @ColumnName2 + ' = ' + '''' + @ColumnValue2 + ''''
				PRINT @SQL
				EXEC(@SQL)
				PRINT 'Column ' + @ColumnName2 + ' value updated in all records in the ' + @DatabaseName2 + '.dbo.' + @TableName2 + ' table'
			END
			ELSE
				PRINT 'Column ' + @ColumnName2 + ' value not updated in table ' + @DatabaseName2 + '.dbo.' + @TableName2 + ' as parameter @ColumnValue is NULL'

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end

			BEGIN TRY IF XACT_STATE() = 1 AND @@TRANCOUNT = 1 AND @OpeningTranCount < 1 COMMIT TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH
			
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END
GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[spAddUpdateSlowSQLCommandLogRecord]    Script Date: 02/11/2026 17:47:25 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spAddUpdateSlowSQLCommandLogRecord]
(
	@SQLCommandText NVARCHAR(MAX),
	@ExecutionTimeInSeconds DECIMAL(18,3)
)
AS
BEGIN	
	-- Add a new record
	IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.tblSlowSQLCommandLog WHERE SQLCommandText = @SQLCommandText)
	BEGIN
		INSERT INTO dbo.tblSlowSQLCommandLog
		(
			SQLCommandText,ExecutionTimeInSeconds,InsertedDate
		)
		SELECT @SQLCommandText, @ExecutionTimeInSeconds, dbo.GetBSTDate()
		
		RETURN
	END

	-- Update an existing record where the new execution time is greater than the saved execution time.
	UPDATE dbo.tblSlowSQLCommandLog
	SET ExecutionTimeInSeconds = @ExecutionTimeInSeconds,InsertedDate = dbo.GetBSTDate()
	WHERE SQLCommandText = @SQLCommandText
	AND ExecutionTimeInSeconds < @ExecutionTimeInSeconds
END

--IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM sys.objects WHERE object_id = OBJECT_ID(N'[dbo].[spSQLTextScalar]') AND type in (N'P', N'PC'))

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spAppExecuteSQLCode]
(
	@SQLCode NVARCHAR(MAX),
	@EventLogPK INT = -1,
	@UserFK INT = -1
)
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT
		,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@var_EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT,@var_UserFK INT

	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();
	SELECT @var_EventLogPK = ISNULL(@EventLogPK, -1); SELECT @var_UserFK = ISNULL(@UserFK, -1); 

	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	DECLARE @var_SQLCode NVARCHAR(MAX) = LTRIM(ISNULL(@SQLCode,'')); IF @var_SQLCode = '' RETURN

	SET @ParameterDetails = '@SQLCode = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_SQLCode AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@EventLogPK = ' + CAST(@var_EventLogPK AS NVARCHAR(20))

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,UserFK INT,HasException BIT)
	
	-- This is not required as this stored procedure will only be executed by the web application 
	-- code & therefore it will never be executed within another stored procedure.
    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    --BEGIN
    --    SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

    --    INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
    --    SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

    --    SET @var_EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END

	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK,UserFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@var_EventLogPK,@var_UserFK;
	SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY			

			-- This stored procedures main code, excluding error handling - start

			-- Prevent the "The conversion of a varchar data type to a datetime data type resulted in an out-of-range value." error.
			-- Often happens in C:\Work_GSKImporterLive\STAWMSImporter\Imports\ImportBatchMaster.cs 
			IF @var_SQLCode LIKE '%01/01/0001%' SET @var_SQLCode = REPLACE(@var_SQLCode, '01/01/0001', '01/01/1900')

			IF @var_SQLCode LIKE '%insert%' OR @var_SQLCode LIKE '%DELETE%' OR @var_SQLCode LIKE '%UPDATE%'
				IF XACT_STATE() = 0 AND @@TRANCOUNT < 1 BEGIN TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName			

			IF @var_SQLCode LIKE 'UPDATE%' AND @var_SQLCode NOT LIKE '%ROWLOCK%' AND @var_SQLCode NOT LIKE '%TABLOCK%'
				SET @var_SQLCode = REPLACE(@var_SQLCode, ' SET ', ' WITH (ROWLOCK) SET ')

			DECLARE @StoredProcedureName NVARCHAR(500) = LTRIM(RTRIM(@var_SQLCode))

			-- Record stored procedure executions via this stored procedure (spAppExecuteSQLCode) in the dbo.tblAppExecuteSQLCodeStoredProcedureStats table.
			IF (@StoredProcedureName LIKE 'EXEC%')
			BEGIN
				BEGIN TRY								
					SET @StoredProcedureName = REPLACE(@StoredProcedureName, 'dbo.','')
					SET @StoredProcedureName = REPLACE(LTRIM(RTRIM(@StoredProcedureName)), 'EXECUTE ', '')
					SET @StoredProcedureName = REPLACE(LTRIM(RTRIM(@StoredProcedureName)), 'EXEC ', '')
					SET @StoredProcedureName = LTRIM(RTRIM(LEFT(@StoredProcedureName, CHARINDEX(' ', @StoredProcedureName))))

					IF LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(@StoredProcedureName,''))) <> ''
					BEGIN
						DECLARE @SQLCommand NVARCHAR(MAX) = 'SELECT TimesRun FROM dbo.tblAppExecuteSQLCodeStoredProcedureStats WHERE StoredProcedureName = ''' + @StoredProcedureName + ''''

						IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#TimesRun') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #TimesRun

						CREATE TABLE #TimesRun (TimesRun INT)

						INSERT INTO #TimesRun EXEC(@SQLCommand)

						IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #TimesRun)
							SET @SQLCommand = 'INSERT INTO dbo.tblAppExecuteSQLCodeStoredProcedureStats SELECT ''' + @StoredProcedureName + '''' + ',1,0,' + '0,''' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(100), dbo.GetBSTDate(), 121) + ''',0,''' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(100), dbo.GetBSTDate(), 121) + ''''					
						ELSE
						BEGIN
							DECLARE @TimesRun INT = (SELECT TOP 1 TimesRun FROM #TimesRun); SET @TimesRun = @TimesRun + 1

							SET @SQLCommand = 'UPDATE dbo.tblAppExecuteSQLCodeStoredProcedureStats WITH (ROWLOCK) '
								+ 'SET TimesRun = ' + CAST(@TimesRun AS NVARCHAR(50))
									+ ', UpdatedDate = ''' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(100), dbo.GetBSTDate(), 121) + ''''
										+ ' WHERE StoredProcedureName = ''' + @StoredProcedureName + ''''
						END					
									
						EXEC(@SQLCommand)
					END
				END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH /* Ignore any errors within the above tblAppExecuteSQLCodeStoredProcedureStats section of code */
			END

			EXEC(@var_SQLCode)

			IF @var_SQLCode LIKE '%insert%' OR @var_SQLCode LIKE '%DELETE%' OR @var_SQLCode LIKE '%UPDATE%'
				BEGIN TRY IF XACT_STATE() = 1 AND @@TRANCOUNT = 1 AND @OpeningTranCount < 1 COMMIT TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH

			-- This stored procedures main code, excluding error handling - end
						
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spArchiveBuilding]  
(  
 @buildingPk int  
)  
AS  
BEGIN  
 /* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */  
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED  
  
    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT  
 ,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;  
 SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();  
  
 -- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters  
 DECLARE @var_buildingPK int  
  
 SET @var_buildingPK = @buildingPk  
  
 SET @ParameterDetails = '@buildingPk = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_buildingPK AS NVARCHAR(20)),'')  
  
    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL   
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)  
  
    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)  
    --BEGIN  
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC   
  
  SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)  
  
        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)  
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK  
  
        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()  
    --END  
  
  
 SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);  
 SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails  
 ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;  
 INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()  
  
 WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3  
 BEGIN   
  BEGIN TRY  
     
  
   -- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start  
  update tblBuildings set IsArchived = 1 where BuildingPK=@var_buildingPK
update tblbuildingunits set IsArchived = 1 where BuildingFk=@var_buildingPK

update buildingunitrows set buildingunitrows.IsArchived = 1 from tblbuildingunitrows buildingunitrows
inner join tblbuildingunits bu on bu.BuildingunitPk=buildingunitrows.BuildingUnitFK
where bu.BuildingFk = @var_buildingPK

update buildingunitcolumns set buildingunitcolumns.IsArchived = 1 from tblbuildingunitcolumns buildingunitcolumns
--where buildingunitcolumns.BuildingUnitRowFK in (select BuildingUnitRowPK from dbo.tblbuildingunitrows unitrow inner join tblbuildingunits bu on bu.BuildingunitPk=unitrow.BuildingUnitFK where bu.BuildingFk = @var_buildingPK)
inner join tblbuildingunitrows rowa on rowa.BuildingUnitRowPK = buildingunitcolumns.BuildingUnitRowFK
 inner join tblbuildingunits bu on bu.BuildingunitPk=rowa.BuildingunitFk
 where bu.BuildingFk =@var_buildingPK


update buildingUnitBays set buildingUnitBays.IsArchived = 1 from tblbuildingUnitBays buildingUnitBays
inner join tblbuildingunitcolumns col on col.BuildingUnitColumnPK=buildingUnitBays.BuildingUnitColumnFK
inner join tblbuildingunitrows rowa on rowa.BuildingUnitRowPK = col.BuildingUnitRowFK
 inner join tblbuildingunits bu on bu.BuildingunitPk=rowa.BuildingunitFk
 where bu.BuildingFk =@var_buildingPK

update loadingbays set loadingbays.IsArchived = 1 from tblLoadingBays loadingbays
inner join tblbuildingunits bu on bu.BuildingunitPk=loadingbays.BuildingUnitFK
where bu.BuildingFk = @var_buildingPK

update setdownarea set setdownarea.IsArchived = 1 from tblSetDownAreas setdownarea
inner join tblbuildingunits bu on bu.BuildingunitPk=setdownarea.BuildingUnitFK
where bu.BuildingFk = @var_buildingPK

update FloorLocations set FloorLocations.IsArchived = 1 from tblFloorLocations FloorLocations
inner join tblbuildingunits bu on bu.BuildingunitPk=FloorLocations.BuildingUnitFK
where bu.BuildingFk = @var_buildingPK

update userbuildingunits set userbuildingunits.IsArchived = 1 from tbluserbuildingunits userbuildingunits
inner join tblbuildingunits bu on bu.BuildingunitPk=userbuildingunits.BuildingUnitFK
where bu.BuildingFk = @var_buildingPK
  
   -- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end  
  
     
     
   BREAK  
  END TRY  
  BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */  
   DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;  
   SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;  
   SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;  
  
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY   
   BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;  
         
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;  
  
            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID  
              
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;  
              
   IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)  
   BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END  
   ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */  
  END CATCH  
  SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1  
 END

-- ============================================= 

/*
EXEC [dbo].[spArchiveScheduleDayTemplate]
    @ScheduleDayTemplatePK = 5,
    @UserId = 663;
*/


CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spArchiveScheduleDayTemplate]
    @ScheduleDayTemplatePK INT,
    @UserId INT
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED;

    DECLARE 
        @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),
        @CurrentDate DATETIME,
        @DeadlockErrorRetries INT = 1,
        @ErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX),
        @ErrorProcedure NVARCHAR(MAX),
        @ErrorLine NVARCHAR(10),
        @ErrorSeverity NVARCHAR(10),
        @ErrorState NVARCHAR(10),
        @ErrorNumber NVARCHAR(10);

    SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID);
    SET @CurrentDate = dbo.GetBSTDate(); -- Replace dbo.GetBSTDate() with GETDATE() if unavailable

    WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
    BEGIN
        BEGIN TRY
            BEGIN TRANSACTION;

            -- Check if the record exists before updating
            IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM [dbo].[tblScheduleDayTemplates] WHERE ScheduleDayTemplatePK = @ScheduleDayTemplatePK)
            BEGIN
                -- Update IsArchived to 1 (soft delete the record)
                UPDATE [dbo].[tblScheduleDayTemplates]
                SET 
                    [IsArchived] = 1,
                    [UpdatedBy] = @UserId,
                    [UpdatedDate] = @CurrentDate
                WHERE 
                    [ScheduleDayTemplatePK] = @ScheduleDayTemplatePK;

                PRINT 'Day template archived successfully.';
            END
            ELSE
            BEGIN
                PRINT 'Record not found.';
            END

            COMMIT TRANSACTION;
            BREAK; -- Exit retry loop on success
        END TRY
        BEGIN CATCH
            -- Capture error details
            SET @ErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();
            SET @ErrorProcedure = ERROR_PROCEDURE();
            SET @ErrorLine = CAST(ERROR_LINE() AS NVARCHAR(10));
            SET @ErrorSeverity = CAST(ERROR_SEVERITY() AS NVARCHAR(10));
            SET @ErrorState = CAST(ERROR_STATE() AS NVARCHAR(10));
            SET @ErrorNumber = CAST(ERROR_NUMBER() AS NVARCHAR(10));

            -- Log the error into tblErrorLog_MobstaAPI
            INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblErrorLog_MobstaAPI] (
                [Message],
                [Type],
                [LogDate],
                [Category],
                [Exception],
                [ActionName],
                [ErrorMessage],
                [ApplicationName]
            )
            VALUES (
                'Error occurred in stored procedure ' + @ThisProcedureName,
                'Stored Procedure',
                GETDATE(),
                'Database Operation',
                'Procedure: ' + ISNULL(@ErrorProcedure, '') + ', Line: ' + @ErrorLine,
                @ThisProcedureName,
                'Error Number: ' + @ErrorNumber + ', Severity: ' + @ErrorSeverity + ', State: ' + @ErrorState + ' - ' + @ErrorMessage,
                'MobStaAPI' 
            );

            -- Handle deadlock error (1205)
            IF ERROR_NUMBER() = 1205 AND @DeadlockErrorRetries < 3
            BEGIN
                ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;
                SET @DeadlockErrorRetries += 1;
                WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00.500'; -- Wait 500 ms before retrying
            END
            ELSE
            BEGIN
                -- Rollback transaction for unrecoverable errors
                ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;
                RAISERROR('An error occurred. Please check the error log.', 16, 1);
                RETURN;
            END
        END CATCH
    END
END;
GO

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spAutoCompleteAddDivisionBuildingUnits]
(
	@q nvarchar(100) = '',
	@PK int = -1,
	@divisionFK int = -1
)
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT
 ,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;
	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	DECLARE @q2 nvarchar(100), @PK2 int, @divisionFK2 int
	SET @q2 = @q; SET @PK2 = @PK; SET @divisionFK2 = @divisionFK

	SET @ParameterDetails = '@q = ' + ISNULL(@q2,'') + ',@PK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@PK2 AS NVARCHAR(100)),'')
		+ ',@divisionFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@divisionFK2 AS NVARCHAR(100)),'')

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    --BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

		SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END


	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY
			

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start

			IF(@PK2 = -1)
			BEGIN
				Select Top 10 bu.BuildingUnitPK, BuildingName + ' - ' + BuildingUnit as SearchField
		
				from tblBuildingUnits bu 
				inner join tblBuildings buildings
				on
				buildings.BuildingPK = bu.BuildingFK

				where BuildingName + ' - ' + BuildingUnit like @q2 + '%'
				AND BuildingUnitPK NOT IN (Select BuildingUnitFK 
										   From tblDivisionBuildingUnits 
										   Where DivisionFK = @divisionFK2 AND IsArchived = 0) /* #DEV-543 Exclude Archived tblDivisionBuildingUnits  */
				Order by bu.BuildingUnit        
			END
			ELSE
			BEGIN
				Select bu.BuildingUnitPK, BuildingName + ' - ' + BuildingUnit as SearchField
		    	from tblBuildingUnits bu 
				inner join tblBuildings buildings
				on
				buildings.BuildingPK = bu.BuildingFK
				where BuildingUnitPK = @PK2
			END

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end
			
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID  
              
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;  
              
   IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)  
   BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END  
   ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */  
  END CATCH  
  SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1  
 END

/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[spAutoCompleteBuildingUnitLocations]    Script Date: 02/11/2026 17:47:25 ******/
