-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
--
-- Modify: Damien Gannon #Dev-910. Exclude Archived Building Unit Bays
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spAutoCompleteBuildingUnitLocations]
(
	@q nvarchar(100) = '',
	@PK int = -1,
	@buildingUnitFK int = -1,
	@prohibitTopLevelRacking bit = 0,
	@unstable3 bit = 0,
	@unstable2 bit = 0,
	@unstable1 bit = 0
)
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT
 ,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;
	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	DECLARE @q2 nvarchar(100), @PK2 int, @buildingUnitFK2 int, @prohibitTopLevelRacking2 bit, @unstable3_2 bit, @unstable2_2 bit, @unstable1_2 bit
	SET @q2 = @q; SET @PK2 = @PK; SET @buildingUnitFK2 = @buildingUnitFK; SET @prohibitTopLevelRacking2 = @prohibitTopLevelRacking; SET @unstable3_2 = @unstable3
	SET @unstable2_2 = @unstable2; SET @unstable1_2 = @unstable1

	SET @ParameterDetails = '@q = ' + ISNULL(@q2,'')  + ',@PK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@PK2 AS NVARCHAR(100)),'')
		+ ',@buildingUnitFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@buildingUnitFK2 AS NVARCHAR(100)),'')
			+ ',@prohibitTopLevelRacking = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@prohibitTopLevelRacking2 AS NVARCHAR(100)),'')
				+ ',@unstable3 = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@unstable3_2 AS NVARCHAR(100)),'')
					+ ',@unstable2 = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@unstable2_2 AS NVARCHAR(100)),'')
						+ ',@unstable1 = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@unstable1_2 AS NVARCHAR(100)),'')

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    --BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

		SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END


	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY
			

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start

			if (@PK2 = -1)
			BEGIN		
				Select Top 10 
					buBays.BuildingUnitBayPK, 
					--bus.BuildingUnit + ' - ' + buRows.Row + right('0' + cast(buColumns.BuildingUnitColumnName as nvarchar(10)), 2) + buBays.BayLevel as SearchField
					bus.BuildingUnit + ' ' + case when buRows.Translate = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ then
					case when buRows.ReverseTranslate = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ then
						buRows.TranslatedRow + right('0' + cast((buRows.TranslateColumn - buColumns.BuildingUnitColumn) as nvarchar(10)),2) + lower(buBays.BayLevel) 
					else
						buRows.TranslatedRow + right('0' + cast((buColumns.BuildingUnitColumn + buRows.TranslateColumn) as nvarchar(10)),2) + lower(buBays.BayLevel) 
					End Else 
						buRows.Row + right('0' + cast(buColumns.BuildingUnitColumnName as nvarchar(10)),2) + lower(buBays.BayLevel) 
					End as SearchField		
				from 
					tblBuildingUnitBays buBays 
				inner join tblBuildingUnitColumns buColumns
					on buColumns.BuildingUnitColumnPK = buBays.BuildingUnitColumnFK and buColumns.IsArchived = 0 /* #Dev-910. Exclude Archived Building Unit Bays */
				inner join tblBuildingUnitRows buRows
					on buRows.BuildingUnitRowPK = buColumns.BuildingUnitRowFK And buRows.IsArchived = 0	/* #Dev-910. Exclude Archived Building Unit Columns */
				inner join tblBuildingUnits bus 
					on bus.BuildingUnitPK = buRows.BuildingUnitFK
				where 
					buRows.BuildingUnitFK = @buildingUnitFK2
					--AND bus.BuildingUnit + ' - ' + buRows.Row + right('0' + cast(buColumns.BuildingUnitColumnName as nvarchar(10)), 2) + buBays.BayLevel like '%' + @q + '%'
					AND bus.BuildingUnit + ' ' + case when buRows.Translate = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ then
					case when buRows.ReverseTranslate = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ then
						buRows.TranslatedRow + right('0' + cast((buRows.TranslateColumn - buColumns.BuildingUnitColumn) as nvarchar(10)),2) + lower(buBays.BayLevel) 
					else
						buRows.TranslatedRow + right('0' + cast((buColumns.BuildingUnitColumn + buRows.TranslateColumn) as nvarchar(10)),2) + lower(buBays.BayLevel) 
					End Else 
						buRows.Row + right('0' + cast(buColumns.BuildingUnitColumnName as nvarchar(10)),2) + lower(buBays.BayLevel) 
					End like '%' + @q2 + '%'
					AND ASCII(buBays.BayLevel) - 64 < CASE 
						WHEN @prohibitTopLevelRacking2 = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ THEN
							buColumns.Levels
						ELSE
							9999 --This will include all bays as they are all less than 9999 levels high!
						END
					AND ASCII(buBays.BayLevel) <= CASE
						WHEN @unstable1_2 = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ THEN
							67
						WHEN @unstable2_2 = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ THEN
							66
						WHEN @unstable3_2 = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ THEN
							65
						ELSE
							9999
						END
					And buBays.IsArchived = 0		/* Damien Gannon #Dev-910. Exclude Archived Building Unit Rows */
			
					--	if @prohibitTopLevelRacking = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/
					--	BEGIN
					--		set @sql = @sql + ' AND ASCII(buBays.BayLevel) - 64 < buColumns.Levels ' 
					--	END

					--	if @unstable1 = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ --Only Bay Levels A, B, C
					--	BEGIN
					--		set @sql = @sql + ' AND ASCII(buBays.BayLevel) <= 67  ' 
					--	END
					--
					--	if @unstable2 = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ --Only Bay Levels A, B
					--	BEGIN
					--		set @sql = @sql + ' AND ASCII(buBays.BayLevel) <= 66  ' 
					--	END
					--
					--	if @unstable3 = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ --Only Bay Levels A
					--	BEGIN
					--		set @sql = @sql + ' AND ASCII(buBays.BayLevel) = 65  ' 
					--	END
				Order by buRows.Row, buColumns.BuildingUnitColumn, buBays.BayLevel		          
			END
			ELSE
			BEGIN
				Select 
					buBays.BuildingUnitBayPK, 
					--bus.BuildingUnit + ' - ' + buRows.Row + right('0' + cast(buColumns.BuildingUnitColumnName as nvarchar(10)), 2) + buBays.BayLevel as SearchField
					bus.BuildingUnit + ' ' + case when buRows.Translate = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ then
					case when buRows.ReverseTranslate = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ then
						buRows.TranslatedRow + right('0' + cast((buRows.TranslateColumn - buColumns.BuildingUnitColumn) as nvarchar(10)),2) + lower(buBays.BayLevel) 
					else
						buRows.TranslatedRow + right('0' + cast((buColumns.BuildingUnitColumn + buRows.TranslateColumn) as nvarchar(10)),2) + lower(buBays.BayLevel) 
					End Else 
						buRows.Row + right('0' + cast(buColumns.BuildingUnitColumnName as nvarchar(10)),2) + lower(buBays.BayLevel) 
					End as SearchField		
				from 
					tblBuildingUnitBays buBays 
				inner join tblBuildingUnitColumns buColumns
					on buColumns.BuildingUnitColumnPK = buBays.BuildingUnitColumnFK --And buColumns.IsArchived = 0	/* #Dev-910. Exclude Archived Building Unit Columns */
				inner join tblBuildingUnitRows buRows
					on buRows.BuildingUnitRowPK = buColumns.BuildingUnitRowFK --And buRows.IsArchived = 0				/* #Dev-910. Exclude Archived Building Unit Rows */
				inner join tblBuildingUnits bus 
					on bus.BuildingUnitPK = buRows.BuildingUnitFK
				where 
					buBays.BuildingUnitBayPK = @PK2 --and buBays.IsArchived = 0 JC: dont need to exclude archived when searching on PK
			END

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end

			
			
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END

-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
--
-- Modify: Damien Gannon #dev-910 Exclude Archive BuildingUnitRows
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spAutoCompleteBuildingUnitRows]
(
	@q nvarchar(100) = '',
	@PK int = -1,
	@buildingUnitFK int = -1
)		
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT
 ,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;
	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	DECLARE @q2 nvarchar(100), @PK2 int, @buildingUnitFK2 int
	SET @q2 = @q; SET @PK2 = @PK; SET @buildingUnitFK2 = @buildingUnitFK

	SET @ParameterDetails = '@q = ' + ISNULL(@q2,'') + ',@PK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@PK2 AS NVARCHAR(100)),'')
		+ ',@buildingUnitFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@buildingUnitFK2 AS NVARCHAR(100)),'')

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    --BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

		SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END


	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY
			if(@PK2 = -1) 
			BEGIN
				if @buildingUnitFK2 = -1 return

				IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#col ') IS NOT NULL
					DROP TABLE #col 

				create table #col 
				(
					buildingunitrowpk int,
					endcol nvarchar (20)
				)

				Insert into #col
				select buildingunitrowpk, 
				case when translate = 0 then 
					[Row] 
				else 
					CASE when reversetranslate=1 then 
						Convert ( nvarchar, translatecolumn-Columns) + '-' + Convert(nvarchar,(translatecolumn-1)  )
					when reversetranslate=0 then  
						Convert ( nvarchar, ((translatecolumn)+1) ) + '-' + Convert ( nvarchar, (translatecolumn)+Columns)
					end 
				end as encol 
				from tblBuildingUnitRows 
				where buildingunitfk = @buildingUnitFK  
					and ((translate=1 and TranslatedRow like @q2 + '%') or ([Row] like @q2 + '%'))
					And IsArchived = 0  /* Damien #dev-910 Ignore Archived Rows */
 

 				Select buRows.BuildingUnitRowPK, 
				Case when buRows.Translate = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ then 
					RTRIM(LTRIM(buRows.TranslatedRow)) +  ' (' + CONVERT(nvarchar, col.endcol) + ')' 
				else 
					RTRIM(LTRIM(buRows.Row))
				end as SearchField 
				from tblBuildingUnitRows buRows 
				inner join #col col on col.buildingunitrowpk=buRows.BuildingUnitRowPK 
				where buRows.BuildingUnitFK = @buildingUnitFK 
					AND Case when buRows.Translate = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ then 
						RTRIM(LTRIM(buRows.TranslatedRow)) 
					ELSE
						RTRIM(LTRIM(buRows.Row)) 
					end like @q2 + '%'
					And buRows.IsArchived = 0  /* Damien #dev-910 Ignore Archived Rows */
				Order by SearchField
			END	
			ELSE 
			BEGIN
				Select buRows.BuildingUnitRowPK, 
				Case when buRows.Translate = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ then 
					RTRIM(LTRIM(buRows.TranslatedRow)) 
				else 
					RTRIM(LTRIM(buRows.Row)) end as SearchField
				from tblBuildingUnitRows buRows 
				where buRows.BuildingUnitRowPK =  @PK2
			END
			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END

/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[spAutoCompleteBuildingUnits]    Script Date: 02/11/2026 17:47:25 ******/

-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
--
-- Modify: Damien Gannon
--		   Exclude Archived tblDivisionBuildingUnits #DEV-543
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spAutoCompleteBuildingUnits]
(
	@q nvarchar(100) = '',
	@PK int = -1,
	@divisionFK int = -1,
	@UserFK int= -1
)
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT
 ,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;
	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	DECLARE @q2 nvarchar(100), @PK2 int, @divisionFK2 int
	SET @q2 = @q; SET @PK2 = @PK; SET @divisionFK2 = @divisionFK

	SET @ParameterDetails = '@q = ' + ISNULL(@q2,'') + ',@PK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@PK2 AS NVARCHAR(100)),'')
		+ ',@divisionFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@divisionFK2 AS NVARCHAR(100)),'')

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    --BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

		SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END


	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY
			

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start

			if (@PK2 = -1)
			BEGIN
				if (@divisionFK2 = -1)
				BEGIN
				if(@UserFK<>-1)
					BEGIN
						Select Top 10 bu.BuildingUnitPK, BuildingName + ' - ' + BuildingUnit as SearchField
						from tblBuildingUnits bu 
						inner join tblBuildings buildings
						on
						buildings.BuildingPK = bu.BuildingFK
							inner join tblUserBuildingUnits userbunits
							 on userbunits.BuildingUnitFK=bu.BuildingUnitPK
						where BuildingName + ' - ' + BuildingUnit like @q2 + '%'
						and bu.isarchived = 0 
						and UserFK =@UserFK 
						Order by bu.BuildingUnit
						END
					else
					BEGIN
						Select Top 10 bu.BuildingUnitPK, BuildingName + ' - ' + BuildingUnit as SearchField
						from tblBuildingUnits bu 
						inner join tblBuildings buildings
						on
						buildings.BuildingPK = bu.BuildingFK
						where BuildingName + ' - ' + BuildingUnit like @q2 + '%'
						and bu.isarchived = 0 
						Order by bu.BuildingUnit
					END
				END
				ELSE
				BEGIN
					Select Top 10 bu.BuildingUnitPK, BuildingName + ' - ' + BuildingUnit as SearchField,
						isnull(divisionBuildingUnits.DivisionBuildingUnitPK, 0) as DivisionBuildingUnitPK				
					from tblBuildingUnits bu 
					inner join tblBuildings buildings
					on
					buildings.BuildingPK = bu.BuildingFK

					inner join tblDivisionBuildingUnits divisionBuildingUnits
					on
					divisionBuildingUnits.BuildingUnitFK = bu.BuildingUnitPK
					AND divisionBuildingUnits.DivisionFK = @divisionFK
					AND divisionBuildingUnits.IsArchived = 0		/* Exclude Archived tblDivisionBuildingUnits #DEV-543 */

					where BuildingName + ' - ' + BuildingUnit like @q2 + '%'
					and bu.isarchived = 0 
					Order by bu.BuildingUnit
				END            
			END
			ELSE
			BEGIN
				Select bu.BuildingUnitPK, BuildingName + ' - ' + BuildingUnit as SearchField
				from tblBuildingUnits bu 
				inner join tblBuildings buildings
				on
				buildings.BuildingPK = bu.BuildingFK
				where BuildingUnitPK = @PK2
				--and bu.isarchived = 0 JC: need to be able to access it via its PK (encase its historical building unit on an old stock in / out)
			END

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end

			
			
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spAutoCompleteBuildingUnitsByBuildings]  
(  
 @q nvarchar(100) = '',  
 --@PK int = -1,  
-- @divisionFK int = -1,  
 @UserFK int= -1  ,
 @BuildingFk int = -1
)  
AS  
BEGIN  
 /* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */  
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED  
  
    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT  
 ,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;  
 SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();  
  
 -- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters  
 DECLARE @q2 nvarchar(100)--, @PK2 int, @divisionFK2 int  
 ,@var_BuildingFk int
 SET @q2 = @q; --SET @PK2 = @PK; SET @divisionFK2 = @divisionFK  
  ;SET @var_BuildingFk = @BuildingFk

 SET @ParameterDetails = '@q = ' + ISNULL(@q2,'') --+ ',@PK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@PK2 AS NVARCHAR(100)),'')  
--  + ',@divisionFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@divisionFK2 AS NVARCHAR(100)),'')  
  + ',@BuildingFk = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_BuildingFk AS NVARCHAR(100)),'')  
  
    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL   
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)  
  
    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)  
    --BEGIN  
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC   
  
  SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)  
  
        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)  
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK  
  
        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()  
    --END  
  
  
 SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);  
 SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails  
 ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;  
 INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()  
  
 WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3  
 BEGIN   
  BEGIN TRY  
     
  
   -- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start  
  
 Select   Top 10 bu.BuildingUnitPK, BuildingName + ' - ' + BuildingUnit as SearchField  
      from tblBuildingUnits bu   
      inner join tblBuildings buildings  on buildings.BuildingPK = bu.BuildingFK  
      inner join tblUserBuildingUnits userbunits on userbunits.BuildingUnitFK=bu.BuildingUnitPK  
      where BuildingName + ' - ' + BuildingUnit like @q2 + '%'  
      and bu.isarchived = 0   
      and UserFK =@UserFK
	 -- OR BuildingPK=@var_BuildingFk
	AND (
        (@var_BuildingFk = -1)
        OR 
		(@var_BuildingFk <> -1 AND BuildingPK = @var_BuildingFk)
      )
      Order by bu.BuildingUnit 
  
   -- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end  
  
     
     
   BREAK  
  END TRY  
  BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */  
   DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;  
   SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;  
   SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;  
  
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY   
   BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;  
         
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;  
  
            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID  
              
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;  
              
   IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)  
   BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END  
   ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */  
  END CATCH  
  SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1  
 END  
END

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END


	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY
			

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start

			IF(@PK2 = -1)
			BEGIN
				Select Top 10 customers.CustomerPK, RTRIM(LTRIM(customers.CustomerCode + ' - ' + customers.CustomerName )) as SearchField
				from tblCustomers customers 
				where RTRIM(LTRIM(customers.CustomerCode + ' - ' + customers.CustomerName )) like @q2 + '%'
				Order by customers.CustomerCode            
			END
			ELSE
			BEGIN
				Select customers.CustomerPK, RTRIM(LTRIM(customers.CustomerCode + ' - ' + customers.CustomerName )) as SearchField
				from tblCustomers customers 
				where CustomerPK = @PK2
			END

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end

			
			
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spAutoCompleteDeliveryAddresses]  
(  
 @q nvarchar(100) = '',  
 @PK int = -1,  
 @CurrentAddressFK int = -1,  
 @StockOutDeliveryTypeFK int = -1  
)   
AS  
BEGIN  
 /* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */  
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED  
  
    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT  
 ,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;  
 SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();  
  
 -- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters  
 DECLARE @q2 nvarchar(100), @PK2 int, @CurrentAddressFK2 int, @StockOutDeliveryTypeFK2 int  
 SET @q2 = @q; SET @PK2 = @PK; set @CurrentAddressFK2 = @CurrentAddressFK; SET @StockOutDeliveryTypeFK2 = @StockOutDeliveryTypeFK  
  
 SET @ParameterDetails = '@q = ' + ISNULL(@q2,'') + ',@PK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@PK2 AS NVARCHAR(100)),'') + ',@CurrentAddressFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@CurrentAddressFK AS NVARCHAR(100)),'')  
  
    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL   
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)  
  
    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)  
    --BEGIN  
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC   
  
  SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)  
  
        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)  
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK  
  
        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()  
    --END  
  
  
 SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);  
 SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails  
 ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;  
 INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()  
  
 WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3  
 BEGIN   
  BEGIN TRY  
     
  
   -- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start  
  
		 IF (@StockOutDeliveryTypeFK2 > 0)
		BEGIN
			SELECT TOP 10 addresses.DeliveryAddressPK, RTRIM(LTRIM(addresses.Address1 + ', ' + addresses.Address2 + ', ' + Address3)) AS SearchField
			FROM tblDeliveryAddresses addresses
			WHERE RTRIM(LTRIM(addresses.Address1)) LIKE @q2 + '%' AND ((DeliveryAddressTypeFK = @StockOutDeliveryTypeFK2) OR (@StockOutDeliveryTypeFK2 = 1 AND DeliveryAddressTypeFK IN (1, 2)))
				AND IsArchived = 0
			ORDER BY addresses.Address1
		END
		ELSE IF (@CurrentAddressFK2 > 0)
		BEGIN
			DECLARE @ADDRESSTYPE INT
			SELECT @ADDRESSTYPE = DeliveryAddressTypeFK FROM tblDeliveryAddresses WHERE deliveryaddresspk = @CurrentAddressFK2

			SELECT TOP 10 addresses.DeliveryAddressPK, RTRIM(LTRIM(addresses.Address1 + ', ' + addresses.Address2 + ', ' + Address3)) AS SearchField
			FROM tblDeliveryAddresses addresses
			WHERE RTRIM(LTRIM(addresses.Address1)) LIKE @q2 + '%' AND ((DeliveryAddressTypeFK = @ADDRESSTYPE) OR (@ADDRESSTYPE = 1 AND DeliveryAddressTypeFK IN (1, 2)))
			-- address type must match, unless changing market to factory
			ORDER BY addresses.Address1
		END
		ELSE IF (@PK2 = -1)
		BEGIN
			SELECT TOP 10 addresses.DeliveryAddressPK, RTRIM(LTRIM(addresses.Address1 + ', ' + addresses.Address2 + ', ' + Address3)) AS SearchField
			FROM tblDeliveryAddresses addresses
			WHERE RTRIM(LTRIM(addresses.Address1)) LIKE @q2 + '%'
			ORDER BY addresses.Address1
		END
		ELSE
		BEGIN
			SELECT TOP 10 addresses.DeliveryAddressPK, RTRIM(LTRIM(addresses.Address1 + ', ' + addresses.Address2 + ', ' + Address3)) AS SearchField
			FROM tblDeliveryAddresses addresses
			WHERE DeliveryAddressPK = @PK2
			ORDER BY addresses.Address1
		END





  
   -- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end  
  
     
     
   BREAK  
  END TRY  
  BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */  
   DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;  
   SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;  
   SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;  
  
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY   
   BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;  
         
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;  
  
            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID  
              
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;  
              
   IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)  
   BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END  
   ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */  
  END CATCH  
  SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1  
 END  
END

/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[spAutoCompleteDivisions]    Script Date: 02/11/2026 17:47:25 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON

SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spAutoCompleteDivisions]
(
	@q nvarchar(100) = '',
	@PK int = -1,
	@buildingUnitFK int = -1,
	@customerFK int = -1,
	@deliveryAddressFK int = -1,
	@userTypeFK int = -1, --1=Warehousing, 4=WarehousingClient
	@PKs nvarchar(2000) = '',
	@division nvarchar(1000) = ''
)	
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT
	,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;
	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	DECLARE @q2 nvarchar(100), @PK2 int, @buildingUnitFK2 int, @customerFK2 int, @deliveryAddressFK2 int, @userTypeFK2 int, @PKs2 NVARCHAR(2000)
	SET @q2 = @q; SET @PK2 = @PK; SET @buildingUnitFK2 = @buildingUnitFK; SET @customerFK2 = @customerFK; SET @deliveryAddressFK2 = @deliveryAddressFK
	SET @userTypeFK2 = @userTypeFK; SET @PKs2 = ISNULL(@PKs,'')

	SET @ParameterDetails = '@q = ' + ISNULL(@q2,'') + ',@PK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@PK2 AS NVARCHAR(100)),'')
		+ ',@buildingUnitFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@buildingUnitFK2 AS NVARCHAR(100)),'') + ',@customerFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@customerFK2 AS NVARCHAR(100)),'')
			+ ',@deliveryAddressFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@deliveryAddressFK2 AS NVARCHAR(100)),'') + ',@userTypeFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@userTypeFK2 AS NVARCHAR(100)),'')
				+ ',@PKs=' + @PKs2

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    --BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

		SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END

	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY
		
			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start

			IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#PKs') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #PKs

			SELECT CAST(Name AS INT) AS PK INTO #PKs FROM [dbo].[SplitString](@PKs2)			

			IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#Results') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #Results

			CREATE TABLE #Results
			(
				DivisionPK INT,
				SearchField NVARCHAR(303)
			)

			IF(@PK2 = -1)
			BEGIN
				if (@buildingUnitFK2 <> -1) 
				BEGIN
					IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#Division') IS NOT NULL 
					DROP TABLE #Division
					SELECT Name AS DivisionName 
					INTO #Division 
					FROM [dbo].[SplitString](@division)
						
					IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #Division WHERE DivisionName = '') AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM #Division) = 1
					begin
						INSERT INTO #Results
						Select Top 10 divisions.DivisionPK, RTRIM(LTRIM(divisions.DivisionCode + ' - ' + divisions.DivisionName )) as SearchField					
						from tblDivisions divisions
						inner join tblDivisionBuildingUnits divisionBuildingUnits on divisionBuildingUnits.DivisionFK = divisions.DivisionPK
							AND divisionBuildingUnits.BuildingUnitFK = @buildingUnitFK2 
						where divisionBuildingUnits.IsArchived = 0 and RTRIM(LTRIM(divisions.DivisionCode + ' - ' + divisions.DivisionName )) like @q2 + '%'
						Order by divisions.DivisionCode  
					end
					ELSE
					begin
						INSERT INTO #Results
						Select Top 10 divisions.DivisionPK, RTRIM(LTRIM(divisions.DivisionCode + ' - ' + divisions.DivisionName )) as SearchField					
						from tblDivisions divisions
						inner join tblDivisionBuildingUnits divisionBuildingUnits on divisionBuildingUnits.DivisionFK = divisions.DivisionPK
							AND divisionBuildingUnits.BuildingUnitFK = @buildingUnitFK2 
						inner join #Division divi on divi.DivisionName=divisions.DivisionName
						where divisionBuildingUnits.IsArchived=0 and RTRIM(LTRIM(divisions.DivisionCode + ' - ' + divisions.DivisionName )) like @q2 + '%'
						Order by divisions.DivisionCode  
					end
				END 
				ELSE IF (@customerFK2 <> -1) 
				BEGIN
					INSERT INTO #Results
					Select Top 10 divisions.DivisionPK, RTRIM(LTRIM(divisions.DivisionCode + ' - ' + divisions.DivisionName )) as SearchField
					from tblDivisions divisions 
					where CustomerFK = @customerFK2 AND  RTRIM(LTRIM(divisions.DivisionCode + ' - ' + divisions.DivisionName )) like @q2 + '%'
					Order by divisions.DivisionCode 
				END 
				ELSE IF (@deliveryAddressFK2 <> -1) 
				BEGIN
					if(@userTypeFK2 = 1 AND exists(Select * from tblDivisionDeliveryAddresses where DeliveryAddressFK = @deliveryAddressFK2 AND WarehousingLocked=1/*cast(1 as bit)*/)) 
					BEGIN --Warehousing
						INSERT INTO #Results
						Select Top 10 divisions.DivisionPK, RTRIM(LTRIM(divisions.DivisionCode + ' - ' + divisions.DivisionName )) as SearchField
						from tblDivisions divisions 
						inner join tblDivisionDeliveryAddresses ddas on ddas.DivisionFK = divisions.DivisionPK AND ddas.DeliveryAddressFK = @deliveryAddressFK2
						AND WarehousingLocked = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/
						where RTRIM(LTRIM(divisions.DivisionCode + ' - ' + divisions.DivisionName )) like @q2 + '%'
						Order by divisions.DivisionCode 
					END 
					ELSE IF(@userTypeFK2 = 4 AND exists(Select * from tblDivisionDeliveryAddresses where DeliveryAddressFK = @deliveryAddressFK2 AND WarehousingClientLocked=1/*cast(1 as bit)*/)) 
					BEGIN --WarehousingClient
						INSERT INTO #Results
						Select Top 10 divisions.DivisionPK, RTRIM(LTRIM(divisions.DivisionCode + ' - ' + divisions.DivisionName )) as SearchField
						from tblDivisions divisions 
						inner join tblDivisionDeliveryAddresses ddas on
						ddas.DivisionFK = divisions.DivisionPK AND ddas.DeliveryAddressFK = @deliveryAddressFK2
						AND WarehousingClientLocked = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/
						where RTRIM(LTRIM(divisions.DivisionCode + ' - ' + divisions.DivisionName )) like @q2 + '%'
						Order by divisions.DivisionCode 
					END 
					ELSE 
					BEGIN
						INSERT INTO #Results
						Select Top 10 divisions.DivisionPK, RTRIM(LTRIM(divisions.DivisionCode + ' - ' + divisions.DivisionName )) as SearchField
						from tblDivisions divisions 
						where RTRIM(LTRIM(divisions.DivisionCode + ' - ' + divisions.DivisionName )) like @q2 + '%'
						Order by divisions.DivisionCode  
					END
				END 
				ELSE 
				BEGIN
					INSERT INTO #Results
					Select Top 10 divisions.DivisionPK, RTRIM(LTRIM(divisions.DivisionCode + ' - ' + divisions.DivisionName )) as SearchField
					from tblDivisions divisions 
					where RTRIM(LTRIM(divisions.DivisionCode + ' - ' + divisions.DivisionName )) like @q2 + '%'
					Order by divisions.DivisionCode            
				END			
			END
			ELSE
			BEGIN
				INSERT INTO #Results
				Select divisions.DivisionPK, RTRIM(LTRIM(divisions.DivisionCode + ' - ' + divisions.DivisionName )) as SearchField
				from tblDivisions divisions 
				where DivisionPK = @PK2
			END

			IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #PKs WHERE PK = 0) AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM #PKs) = 1
				SELECT * FROM #Results ORDER BY SearchField
			ELSE
				SELECT * FROM #Results AS R
				INNER JOIN #PKs AS P
				ON R.DivisionPK = P.PK
				ORDER BY SearchField

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end
					
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END

-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spAutoCompleteGoodsInNumberForOrder]
(
	@q nvarchar(100) = '',
	@PK int = -1,
	@stockItemFK int = -1,
	@batch nvarchar(200)
)	
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT
 ,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;
	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	DECLARE @q2 nvarchar(100), @PK2 int, @stockItemFK2 int, @batch2 nvarchar(200)
	SET @q2 = @q; SET @PK2 = @PK; SET @stockItemFK2 = @stockItemFK; SET @batch2 = @batch

	SET @ParameterDetails = '@q = ' + ISNULL(@q2,'') + ',@PK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@PK2 AS NVARCHAR(100)),'') + ',@stockItemFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@stockItemFK2 AS NVARCHAR(100)),'')
		+ '@batch = ' + ISNULL(@batch2,'')

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    --BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

		SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END


	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY
			

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start

			Select Distinct Top 10 
				cins.GoodsInNumber, cins.GoodsInNumber as SearchField
			from 
				tblContainerIns cins 
			inner join tblStockIns sins on
				sins.ContainerInFK = cins.ContainerInPK
			inner join tblStockInLines sinls on
				sinls.StockInFK = sins.StockInPK
			inner join tblStockInLinePallets sinlps on
				sinlps.StockInLineFK = sinls.StockInLinePK
			inner join tblPallets pallets on
				pallets.PalletPK = sinlps.PalletFK
				AND pallets.IsArchived = 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/
			inner join tblPalletContent pc on
				pc.PalletFK = pallets.PalletPK
				AND pc.IsArchived = 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/
			where 
				pc.StockItemFK = @stockItemFK2 
				AND pc.Batch = @batch2
				AND RTRIM(LTRIM(cins.GoodsInNumber)) like @q2 + '%'
			Order by 
				cins.GoodsInNumber 
			
			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end

			
			
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spAutoCompleteLoadingBays]
(
	@q nvarchar(100) = ''
)
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT
 ,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;
	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	DECLARE @q2 nvarchar(100)
	SET @q2 = @q

	SET @ParameterDetails = '@q = ' + ISNULL(@q2,'')

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    --BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

		SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END


	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY
			

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start

			Select Top 10 LoadingBayPK, BuildingName + ' - ' + BuildingUnit + ' - ' + LoadingBay as SearchField		
			from dbo.tblLoadingBays tlb 
			INNER JOIN dbo.tblBuildingUnits tbu ON tlb.BuildingUnitFK = tbu.BuildingUnitPK
			INNER JOIN tblbuildings tb ON tb.BuildingPK = tbu.BuildingFK
			where BuildingName + ' - ' + BuildingUnit + ' - ' + LoadingBay like @q2 + '%'
			and tlb.isarchived = 0 
			Order by tlb.LoadingBay			

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end

			
			
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spAutoCompleteLocations]
(
	@q nvarchar(100) = '',
	@PK int = -1,
	@buildingUnitFK int = -1
)		
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT

	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	DECLARE @q2 nvarchar(100), @PK2 int, @buildingUnitFK2 int
	SET @q2 = @q; SET @PK2 = @PK; SET @buildingUnitFK2 = @buildingUnitFK

	SET @ParameterDetails = '@q = ' + ISNULL(@q2,'') + ',@PK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@PK2 AS NVARCHAR(100)),'') + ',@buildingUnitFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@buildingUnitFK2 AS NVARCHAR(100)),'')

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    --BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

		SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END


	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY
			

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start

			if(@PK2 = -1) 
			BEGIN
				if @buildingUnitFK2 = -1 return
		
				Select Top 10 BuildingUnitBayPK, BuildingUnitBayLocation as SearchField 
				from 
				(
					SELECT vBuBays.BuildingUnitBayPK,
					vBuBays.BuildingUnitBayLocation
					from viewBuildingUnitBays vBuBays
					Where vBuBays.BayLevel = case when vBuBays.RackingTypeFK = 2/*DriveThru*/ then 'A' else vBuBays.BayLevel end
					AND vBuBays.BuildingUnitFK = @buildingUnitFK2
					AND vBuBays.BuildingUnitBayLocation like @q2 + '%'
					AND vBuBays.IsArchived = 0  /* DEV-910 Only Select Non Archived Building Unit Bays */
				) AS subQ						
				Order by 
					SearchField

		--		Select Top 10 BuildingUnitBayPK, SearchField from (
		--		Select buBays.BuildingUnitBayPK, 
		--		RTRIM(LTRIM(case when buRows.Translate = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ then buRows.TranslatedRow else buRows.Row end + right('0' + cast(case when buRows.Translate = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ then case when buRows.ReverseTranslate = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ then buRows.TranslateColumn - buCols.BuildingUnitColumn else buCols.BuildingUnitColumn + buRows.TranslateColumn end else buCols.BuildingUnitColumn end as nvarchar(10)),2) + case when buRows.RackingTypeFK = 1/*Conventional*/ then lower(buBays.BayLevel) else '' end  )) as SearchField,
		--		buBays.BayLevel
		--		from tblBuildingUnitBays buBays 
		--		inner join tblBuildingUnitColumns buCols on
		--		buCols.BuildingUnitColumnPK = buBays.BuildingUnitColumnFK
		--		inner join tblBuildingUnitRows buRows on
		--		buRows.BuildingUnitRowPK = buCols.BuildingUnitRowFK
		--		where buRows.BuildingUnitFK = @buildingUnitFK AND
		--		RTRIM(LTRIM(case when buRows.Translate = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ then buRows.TranslatedRow else buRows.Row end + right('0' + cast(case when buRows.Translate = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ then case when buRows.ReverseTranslate = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ then buRows.TranslateColumn - buCols.BuildingUnitColumn else buCols.BuildingUnitColumn + buRows.TranslateColumn end else buCols.BuildingUnitColumn end as nvarchar(10)),2) + case when buRows.RackingTypeFK = 1/*Conventional*/ then lower(buBays.BayLevel) else '' end  )) like @q + '%'
		--		AND buBays.BayLevel = case when buRows.RackingTypeFK = 2/*DriveThru*/ then 'A' else buBays.BayLevel end
		--		)subQ
		--		Order by SearchField

			END	
			ELSE 
			BEGIN
				Select Top 10 buBays.BuildingUnitBayPK, 
				RTRIM(LTRIM(case when buRows.Translate = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ then buRows.TranslatedRow else buRows.Row end + right('0' + cast(case when buRows.Translate = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ then case when buRows.ReverseTranslate = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ then buRows.TranslateColumn - buCols.BuildingUnitColumn else buCols.BuildingUnitColumn + buRows.TranslateColumn end else buCols.BuildingUnitColumn end as nvarchar(10)),2) + case when buRows.RackingTypeFK = 1/*Conventional*/ then lower(buBays.BayLevel) else '' end  )) as SearchField
				from tblBuildingUnitBays buBays 
				inner join tblBuildingUnitColumns buCols on
				buCols.BuildingUnitColumnPK = buBays.BuildingUnitColumnFK
				inner join tblBuildingUnitRows buRows on
				buRows.BuildingUnitRowPK = buCols.BuildingUnitRowFK
				where buBays.BuildingUnitBayPK = @PK2
				--AND buBays.IsArchived = 0  JC: if PK is supplied, then dont check arhived
			END
		
			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end

			
			
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END

			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spAutoCompleteSeals]      
(      
 @q nvarchar(100) = '',      
 @PK int = -1,      
 --@buildingUnitFK int = -1,      
 @customerFK int = -1,      
-- @deliveryAddressFK int = -1,      
-- @userTypeFK int = -1, --1=Warehousing, 4=WarehousingClient      
 @PKs nvarchar(2000) = ''      
-- @division nvarchar(1000) = ''      
)       
AS      
BEGIN      
 /* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */      
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED      
      
    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT      
 ,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;      
 SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();      
      
 -- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters      
 DECLARE @q2 nvarchar(100), @PK2 int, @buildingUnitFK2 int, @customerFK2 int, @deliveryAddressFK2 int, @userTypeFK2 int, @PKs2 NVARCHAR(2000)      
 SET @q2 = @q; SET @PK2 = @PK;  SET @customerFK2 = @customerFK;    
  SET @PKs2 = ISNULL(@PKs,'')      
      
 SET @ParameterDetails = '@q = ' + ISNULL(@q2,'') + ',@PK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@PK2 AS NVARCHAR(100)),'')      
  + ',@customerFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@customerFK2 AS NVARCHAR(100)),'')      
    + ',@PKs=' + @PKs2      
      
    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL       
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)      
      
    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)      
    --BEGIN      
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC       
      
  SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)      
      
        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)      
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK      
      
        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()      
    --END      
      
 SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);      
 SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails      
 ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;      
 INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()      
      
 WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3      
 BEGIN       
  BEGIN TRY      
        
   -- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start      
      
   IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#PKs') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #PKs      
      
   SELECT CAST(Name AS INT) AS PK INTO #PKs FROM [dbo].[SplitString](@PKs2)         
      
   IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#Results') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #Results      
      
   CREATE TABLE #Results      
   (      
    ContainerOutSealPK INT,      
    SearchField NVARCHAR(303)      
   )      
      
   IF(@PK2 = -1)      
   BEGIN      
        
     IF (@customerFK2 <> -1)       
    BEGIN      
     INSERT INTO #Results      
     Select  seal.ContainerOutSealPK, SealNumber as SearchField      
     from tblContainerOutSeals seal       
     where (CustomerFK = @customerFK2 or CustomerFK = -1 ) and seal.SealStatusFK = 1 --AND  RTRIM(LTRIM(SealNumber)) like @q2 + '%'      
     Order by SealNumber     
    END     
      
    ELSE       
    BEGIN      
     INSERT INTO #Results      
    Select  seal.ContainerOutSealPK, SealNumber as SearchField      
     from tblContainerOutSeals seal       
     where  RTRIM(LTRIM(SealNumber)) like @q2 + '%'      
     Order by SealNumber                 
    END         
   END      
   ELSE      
   BEGIN      
    INSERT INTO #Results      
    Select  seal.ContainerOutSealPK, SealNumber as SearchField      
    from tblContainerOutSeals seal        
    where ContainerOutSealPK = @PK2      
   END      
      
   IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #PKs WHERE PK = 0) AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM #PKs) = 1      
    SELECT * FROM #Results ORDER BY SearchField      
   ELSE      
    SELECT * FROM #Results AS R      
    INNER JOIN #PKs AS P      
    ON R.ContainerOutSealPK = P.PK      
    ORDER BY SearchField      
      
   -- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end      
           
   BREAK      
  END TRY      
  BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */      
   DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;      
   SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;      
   SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;      
      
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY       
   BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;      
             
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;      
      
            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID      
                  
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;      
                  
   IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)      
   BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END      
   ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */      
  END CATCH      
  SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1      
 END      
END

(
	@q nvarchar(100) = '',
	@PK int = -1
)	
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT
 ,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;
	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	DECLARE @q2 nvarchar(100), @PK2 int
	SET @q2 = @q; SET @PK2 = @PK

	SET @ParameterDetails = '@q = ' + ISNULL(@q2,'') + ',@PK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@PK2 AS NVARCHAR(100)),'')

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    --BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

		SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END


	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY
			

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start

			IF(@PK2 = -1)
			BEGIN
				Select Top 10 shippingCompanies.ShippingCompanyPK, RTRIM(LTRIM(shippingCompanies.ShippingCompany)) as SearchField
				from tblShippingCompanies shippingCompanies 
				where RTRIM(LTRIM(shippingCompanies.ShippingCompany)) like @q2 + '%'
				Order by shippingCompanies.ShippingCompany         
			END
			ELSE
			BEGIN
				Select shippingCompanies.ShippingCompanyPK, RTRIM(LTRIM(shippingCompanies.ShippingCompany)) as SearchField
				from tblShippingCompanies shippingCompanies 
				where ShippingCompanyPK = @PK2
			END

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end

			
			
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
