CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spAutoCompleteStockItems]
(
	@q nvarchar(100) = '',	--stock code search criteria
	@PK int = -1,			--an exact stock item
	@divisionFK int = -1,
	@userFK int = -1,
	@mixedPalletHandlingInCharge nvarchar(20) = '-1',
	@deliveryAddressFK int = -1,
	@userTypeFK int = -1,
	@stockCodes nvarchar(2000) = '',
	@GroupStockInPK int = -1
)	
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT
 ,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;
	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	DECLARE @q2 nvarchar(100), @PK2 int, @divisionFK2 int, @userFK2 int, @mixedPalletHandlingInCharge2 nvarchar(20), @deliveryAddressFK2 int, @userTypeFK2 int, @var_GroupStockInPK INT, @var_stockCodes nvarchar(2000) = ISNULL(@stockCodes,'')
	SET @q2 = @q; SET @PK2 = @PK; SET @divisionFK2 = @divisionFK; SET @userFK2 = @userFK; SET @mixedPalletHandlingInCharge2 = @mixedPalletHandlingInCharge
	SET @deliveryAddressFK2 = @deliveryAddressFK; SET @userTypeFK2 = @userTypeFK; SET @var_GroupStockInPK = @GroupStockInPK

	SET @ParameterDetails = '@q = ' + ISNULL(@q2,'') + ',@PK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@PK2 AS NVARCHAR(100)),'') + ',@divisionFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@divisionFK2 AS NVARCHAR(100)),'')
		+ ',@userFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@userFK2 AS NVARCHAR(100)),'') + ',@mixedPalletHandlingInCharge = ' + ISNULL(@mixedPalletHandlingInCharge2,'')
			+ ',@deliveryAddressFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@deliveryAddressFK2 AS NVARCHAR(100)),'') + ',@userTypeFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@userTypeFK2 AS NVARCHAR(100)),'') + ',@stockCodes = ' + @var_stockCodes + ',@GroupStockInPK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@GroupStockInPK AS NVARCHAR(100)),'')     

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    --BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

		SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END


	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY
			

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start
			
			IF(@PK = -1)
			BEGIN
				print '1'

				IF (@deliveryAddressFK2 <> -1) 
				BEGIN
					print '2'

					if(@userTypeFK2 = 1 AND exists(Select * from tblDivisionDeliveryAddresses where DeliveryAddressFK = @deliveryAddressFK2 AND WarehousingLocked=1/*cast(1 as bit)*/)) 
					BEGIN --Warehousing
						Select Top 10 stockItems.StockItemPK, RTRIM(LTRIM(stockItems.StockItemCode + ' ' + isnull(sivs.VersionText, ''))) as SearchField
						from tblDivisions divisions 
						inner join tblDivisionDeliveryAddresses ddas on
						ddas.DivisionFK = divisions.DivisionPK AND ddas.DeliveryAddressFK = @deliveryAddressFK2
						AND WarehousingLocked = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/
						inner join tblStockItems stockItems on
						stockItems.DivisionFK = divisions.DivisionPK
						left outer join tblStockItemVersions sivs on
						sivs.StockItemFK = stockItems.StockItemPK AND sivs.IsCurrent = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/
						where RTRIM(LTRIM(stockItems.StockItemCode)) like @q2 + '%' 
						AND stockItems.IsArchived = 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/
						Order by stockItems.StockItemCode 
					END 
					ELSE IF(@userTypeFK2 = 4 AND exists(Select * from tblDivisionDeliveryAddresses where DeliveryAddressFK = @deliveryAddressFK2 AND WarehousingClientLocked=1/*cast(1 as bit)*/)) 
					BEGIN --WarehousingClient
						Select Top 10 stockItems.StockItemPK, RTRIM(LTRIM(stockItems.StockItemCode + ' ' + isnull(sivs.VersionText, ''))) as SearchField
						from tblDivisions divisions
						inner join tblDivisionDeliveryAddresses ddas on
						ddas.DivisionFK = divisions.DivisionPK AND ddas.DeliveryAddressFK = @deliveryAddressFK2
						AND WarehousingClientLocked = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/
						inner join tblStockItems stockItems on
						stockItems.DivisionFK = divisions.DivisionPK
						left outer join tblStockItemVersions sivs on
						sivs.StockItemFK = stockItems.StockItemPK AND sivs.IsCurrent = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/
						where RTRIM(LTRIM(stockItems.StockItemCode)) like @q2 + '%' 
						AND stockItems.IsArchived = 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/
						Order by stockItems.StockItemCode 
					END 
					ELSE 
					BEGIN
						Select Top 10 stockItems.StockItemPK, RTRIM(LTRIM(stockItems.StockItemCode + ' ' + isnull(sivs.VersionText, ''))) as SearchField
						from tblStockItems stockItems 
						left outer join tblStockItemVersions sivs on
						sivs.StockItemFK = stockItems.StockItemPK AND sivs.IsCurrent = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/
						where RTRIM(LTRIM(stockItems.StockItemCode)) like @q2 + '%' AND DivisionFK = @divisionFK2
						AND stockItems.IsArchived = 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/
						Order by stockItems.StockItemCode  
					END
				END ELSE IF(@userFK2 <> -1) 
				BEGIN
					print '3'

					Select Top 10 stockItems.StockItemPK, RTRIM(LTRIM(stockItems.StockItemCode + ' ' + isnull(sivs.VersionText, ''))) as SearchField
					from tblStockItems stockItems 
					left outer join tblStockItemVersions sivs on
					sivs.StockItemFK = stockItems.StockItemPK AND sivs.IsCurrent = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/
					where RTRIM(LTRIM(stockItems.StockItemCode)) like @q2 + '%' AND DivisionFK in (Select DivisionFK from tblUserDivisions where UserFK = @userFK2 )
					AND stockItems.IsArchived = 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/
					Order by stockItems.StockItemCode    
				END 
				ELSE IF(@divisionFK2 <> -1)
				BEGIN
					print '4'
					
					--get list of stock item codes that can be filtered from (stock item header)
					IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#StockItemCodes') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #StockItemCodes
					SELECT Name AS StockItemCode INTO #StockItemCodes FROM [dbo].[SplitString](@var_stockCodes)
					--select * from #StockItemCodes

					IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#Results') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #Results

					CREATE TABLE #Results
					(
						StockItemPK INT,
						SearchField NVARCHAR(500),
						StockItemCode NVARCHAR(200)
					)

					insert into #Results
					Select stockItems.StockItemPK, RTRIM(LTRIM(stockItems.StockItemCode + ' ' + isnull(sivs.VersionText, ''))) as SearchField, StockItemCode
					from tblStockItems stockItems 
					inner join tblDivisions divs on
					divs.DivisionPK = stockItems.DivisionFK
					left outer join (
						Select StockItemFK from tblStockItemFixedLocations
						Group By StockItemFK
					) sifls on
					sifls.StockItemFK = stockItems.StockItemPK
					left outer join tblStockItemVersions sivs on
					sivs.StockItemFK = stockItems.StockItemPK AND sivs.IsCurrent = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/
					where RTRIM(LTRIM(stockItems.StockItemCode)) like @q2 + '%' AND DivisionFK = @divisionFK2
					--AND (divs.DivisionTypeFK <> 2 OR sifls.StockItemFK is not null)
					AND stockItems.IsArchived = 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/
					Order by stockItems.StockItemCode    

					IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #StockItemCodes WHERE StockItemCode = '') AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM #StockItemCodes) = 1
					begin
						print 'in here'
						SELECT Top 10 StockItemPK, SearchField FROM #Results ORDER BY StockItemCode
					end
					ELSE
					begin
						print 'or in here'
						SELECT Top 10 R.StockItemPK, R.SearchField 
						FROM #Results AS R
						INNER JOIN #StockItemCodes AS SIC
						ON R.StockItemCode = SIC.StockItemCode
						ORDER BY R.StockItemCode
					end


				END 
				ELSE IF(@mixedPalletHandlingInCharge2 <> '-1')
				BEGIN
					Select Top 10 stockItems.StockItemPK, RTRIM(LTRIM(stockItems.StockItemCode + ' ' + isnull(sivs.VersionText, ''))) as SearchField
					from tblStockItems stockItems 
					left outer join tblStockItemVersions sivs on
					sivs.StockItemFK = stockItems.StockItemPK AND sivs.IsCurrent = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/
					where RTRIM(LTRIM(stockItems.StockItemCode)) like @q2 + '%' AND DivisionFK = @divisionFK2
					AND (HandlingInEachesTypeFK <> -1 OR HandlingInUnitTypeFK <> -1
					OR (HandlingInEachesTypeFK = -1 AND HandlingInUnitTypeFK = -1 AND HandlingInCharge = cast(@mixedPalletHandlingInCharge2 as decimal(18,3)))) 
					AND stockItems.IsArchived = 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/
					Order by stockItems.StockItemCode      
				END
				ELSE IF(@var_GroupStockInPK <> -1)
				BEGIN
					drop table if exists #tmpGroupedContainerIns
					select containerinpk into #tmpGroupedContainerIns from tblcontainerins where StockInGroupFK = @var_GroupStockInPK

					Select Top 10 stockItems.StockItemPK, RTRIM(LTRIM(stockItems.StockItemCode + ' ' + isnull(sivs.VersionText, ''))) as SearchField
					FROM #tmpGroupedContainerIns cin
					INNER JOIN tblContainerInHeaders cihs on cin.ContainerInPK = cihs.ContainerInFK   
					inner join tblStockItems stockItems on stockItems.StockItemPK = cihs.StockItemFK
					left outer join tblStockItemVersions sivs on sivs.StockItemFK = stockItems.StockItemPK AND sivs.IsCurrent = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/
					WHERE RTRIM(LTRIM(stockItems.StockItemCode)) like @q2 + '%'
					Order by stockItems.StockItemCode   
				END
			END
			ELSE 
			BEGIN
			--find exact stock item
				Select stockItems.StockItemPK, RTRIM(LTRIM(stockItems.StockItemCode + ' ' + isnull(sivs.VersionText, ''))) as SearchField
				from tblStockItems stockItems 
				left outer join tblStockItemVersions sivs on
				sivs.StockItemFK = stockItems.StockItemPK AND sivs.IsCurrent = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/
				where StockItemPK = @PK2
				AND stockItems.IsArchived = 0
			END

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end

			
			
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END

)	
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT
 ,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;
	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	DECLARE @q2 nvarchar(100), @PK2 int, @divisionFK2 int, @userFK2 int, @mixedPalletHandlingInCharge2 nvarchar(20)
	SET @q2 = @q; SET @PK2 = @PK; SET @divisionFK2 = @divisionFK; SET @userFK2 = @userFK; SET @mixedPalletHandlingInCharge2 = @mixedPalletHandlingInCharge

	SET @ParameterDetails = '@q = ' + ISNULL(@q2,'') + ',@PK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@PK2 AS NVARCHAR(100)),'') + ',@divisionFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@divisionFK2 AS NVARCHAR(100)),'')
		+ ',@userFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@userFK2 AS NVARCHAR(100)),'') + ',@mixedPalletHandlingInCharge = ' + ISNULL(@mixedPalletHandlingInCharge2,'')

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --BEGIN

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END


	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY
			

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start

			IF(@PK2 = -1)
			BEGIN
				if(@userFK2 <> -1)
				BEGIN
					Select Top 10 stockItems.StockItemPK, RTRIM(LTRIM(stockItems.StockItemCode + ' ' + isnull(sivs.VersionText, ''))) as SearchField
					from tblStockItems stockItems 
					inner join tblDivisions divs on
					divs.DivisionPK = stockItems.DivisionFK
					left outer join tblStockItemVersions sivs on
					sivs.StockItemFK = stockItems.StockItemPK AND sivs.IsCurrent = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/
					where RTRIM(LTRIM(stockItems.StockItemCode)) + ' ' + isnull(sivs.VersionText, '') like @q2 + '%' AND DivisionFK in (Select DivisionFK from tblUserDivisions where UserFK = @userFK2)
					AND stockItems.IsArchived = 0
					--AND AllowClientStockIns = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/

				END

					left outer join tblStockItemVersions sivs on
					sivs.StockItemFK = stockItems.StockItemPK AND sivs.IsCurrent = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/
					where RTRIM(LTRIM(stockItems.StockItemCode)) + ' ' + isnull(sivs.VersionText, '') like @q2 + '%' AND DivisionFK = @divisionFK2
					AND stockItems.IsArchived = 0
					Order by stockItems.StockItemCode    
				END  
				ELSE if (@mixedPalletHandlingInCharge2 <> '-1')
				BEGIN
					Select Top 10 stockItems.StockItemPK, RTRIM(LTRIM(stockItems.StockItemCode + ' ' + isnull(sivs.VersionText, ''))) as SearchField
					from tblStockItems stockItems 
					left outer join tblStockItemVersions sivs on
					sivs.StockItemFK = stockItems.StockItemPK AND sivs.IsCurrent = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/
					where RTRIM(LTRIM(stockItems.StockItemCode)) + ' ' + isnull(sivs.VersionText, '') like @q2 + '%' AND DivisionFK = @divisionFK2
					AND (HandlingInEachesTypeFK <> -1 OR HandlingInUnitTypeFK <> -1
					OR (HandlingInEachesTypeFK = -1 AND HandlingInUnitTypeFK = -1 AND HandlingInCharge = cast(@mixedPalletHandlingInCharge2 as decimal(18,3)))) 
					AND stockItems.IsArchived = 0
					Order by stockItems.StockItemCode      
				END
			END
			ELSE
			BEGIN
				Select stockItems.StockItemPK, RTRIM(LTRIM(stockItems.StockItemCode + ' ' + isnull(sivs.VersionText, ''))) as SearchField
				from tblStockItems stockItems 
				left outer join tblStockItemVersions sivs on
				sivs.StockItemFK = stockItems.StockItemPK AND sivs.IsCurrent = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/
				where StockItemPK = @PK2
				AND stockItems.IsArchived = 0
			END

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end

			
			
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */

			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;

			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spAutoCompleteStockItemsWithStock]
(
	@q nvarchar(100) = '',
	@PK int = -1,
	@divisionFK int = -1,
	@stockCodes nvarchar(2000) = ''
)	
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT
	,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;
	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	DECLARE @q2 nvarchar(100), @PK2 int, @divisionFK2 int, @var_stockCodes nvarchar(2000) = ISNULL(@stockCodes,'')
	SET @q2 = @q; SET @PK2 = @PK; SET @divisionFK2 = @divisionFK

	SET @ParameterDetails = '@q = ' + ISNULL(@q2,'') + ',@PK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@PK2 AS NVARCHAR(100)),'') 
		+ ',@divisionFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@divisionFK2 AS NVARCHAR(100)),'')
			 + ',@stockCodes = ' + @var_stockCodes

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    --BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

		SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END

	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY		

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start

			IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#StockItemCodes') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #StockItemCodes

			SELECT Name AS StockItemCode INTO #StockItemCodes FROM [dbo].[SplitString](@var_stockCodes)
			--select * from #StockItemCodes

			IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#Results') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #Results

			CREATE TABLE #Results
			(
				StockItemPK INT,
				SearchField NVARCHAR(500),
				StockItemCode NVARCHAR(200)
			)

			IF(@PK2 = -1)
			BEGIN
				INSERT INTO #Results
				Select stockItems.StockItemPK, 
				RTRIM(LTRIM(stockItems.StockItemCode)) + ', ' 
					+	case 
							when EachesTypePK is not null then 
								cast(sum(stockLevels.AvailableEaches) as nvarchar(100)) + ' ' +  EachesType 
							else 
								cast(sum(stockLevels.AvailableUnits) as nvarchar(100)) + ' ' +  Abbreviation 
						end as SearchField,
				stockItems.StockItemCode
				from tblStockItems stockItems 
				inner join tblStockLevels stockLevels  on
				stockLevels.StockItemFK = stockItems.StockItemPK
				left outer join tblEachesTypes eachesTypes on
				eachesTypes.EachesTypePK = stockItems.EachesTypeFK
				left outer join tblUnitTypes unitTypes on
				unitTypes.UnitTypePK = stockItems.UnitTypeFK
				where RTRIM(LTRIM(stockItems.StockItemCode)) like @q2 + '%' AND DivisionFK = @divisionFK2
				AND stockItems.IsArchived = 0
				group by StockItemPK, StockItemCode, EachesTypePK, EachesType, Abbreviation		
				Order by stockItems.StockItemCode    		
			END
			ELSE
			BEGIN
				INSERT INTO #Results
				Select stockItems.StockItemPK, RTRIM(LTRIM(stockItems.StockItemCode)) as SearchField, stockItems.StockItemCode
				from tblStockItems stockItems 
				where StockItemPK = @PK2
				AND stockItems.IsArchived = 0
			END

			--select * from #Results

			IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #StockItemCodes WHERE StockItemCode = '') AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM #StockItemCodes) = 1
			begin
				print 'in here'
				SELECT Top 10 StockItemPK, SearchField FROM #Results ORDER BY SearchField
			end
			ELSE
			begin
				print 'or in here'
				SELECT Top 10 R.StockItemPK, R.SearchField 
				FROM #Results AS R
				INNER JOIN #StockItemCodes AS SIC
				ON R.StockItemCode = SIC.StockItemCode
				ORDER BY R.SearchField
			end

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end

			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END

 SET @ParameterDetails = '@q = ' + ISNULL(@q2,'') + ',@PK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@PK2 AS NVARCHAR(100)),'')  
  
    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL

    --BEGIN

  SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()  
    --END  
  
  
 SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);  
 SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails  
 ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;  
 INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()  
  
 WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3  
 BEGIN   
  BEGIN TRY  
     
  
   -- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start  
  
   IF(@PK2 = -1)  
   BEGIN  
    Select Top 10 suppliers.SupplierPK, RTRIM(LTRIM(suppliers.Supplier)) as SearchField  
    from tblSuppliers suppliers   
    where RTRIM(LTRIM(suppliers.Supplier)) like @q2 + '%' 
	and IsArchived=0
    Order by suppliers.Supplier        
   END  
   ELSE  
   BEGIN  
    Select suppliers.SupplierPK, RTRIM(LTRIM(suppliers.Supplier)) as SearchField  
    from tblSuppliers suppliers   
    where SupplierPK = @PK2  
   END  
  
   -- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end  
  
     
     
   BREAK  
  END TRY  
  BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */

   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY   
   BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;  
         
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;  
  
            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID  
              
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;  
              
   IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)  
   BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END  
   ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */  
  END CATCH  
  SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1  
 END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spAutoCompleteUsers]
(
	@q nvarchar(100) = '',
	@PK int = -1	
)
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT
 ,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;
	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	DECLARE @q2 nvarchar(100), @PK2 int
	SET @q2 = @q; SET @PK2 = @PK

	SET @ParameterDetails = '@q = ' + ISNULL(@q2,'') + ',@PK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@PK2 AS NVARCHAR(100)),'')

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    --BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

		SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END


	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY
			

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start

			IF(@PK2 = -1)
			BEGIN
				Select Top 10 users.UserPK, RTRIM(LTRIM(people.FirstName + ' ' + people.LastName )) as SearchField
				from tblUsers users 
				inner join tblPeople people on 
				people.PersonPK = users.PersonFK			
				WHERE users.UserTypeFK = 1 and users.isarchived = 0 and RTRIM(LTRIM(people.FirstName + ' ' + people.LastName )) like @q2 + '%'
				Order by SearchField
			END

				Select users.UserPK, RTRIM(LTRIM(people.FirstName + ' ' + people.LastName )) as SearchField

				where users.UserPK = @PK2;

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end

		END TRY

			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
