		BEGIN TRY
			
			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start

			Declare @sql nvarchar(MAX), @eachSql nvarchar(MAX), @2ndStageSql nvarchar(MAX), @ruleSql nvarchar(MAX), @extraFieldSql nvarchar(MAX), @groupRuleSql nvarchar(MAX), @2ndStageRuleSql nvarchar(MAX)
			Declare @isEachesType int
			Declare @divisionFK int, @customerFK int
			Declare @receiverTypeFK int, @receiverFK int
			Declare @checkAgainstSplitEaches int, @checkAgainstSplitPallets int

			Declare @palletPK int, @palletContentPK int, @availableUnits decimal(18,3)
			Declare @runningTotal decimal(18,3), @sectionResetRunningTotal decimal(18,3), @sectionResetSql nvarchar(MAX), @resetRunningTotal decimal(18,3), @numberOfCursorRows int, @skippedContent int
			Declare @isDistinctQuantitiesRemaining int, @distinctQuantities int
			Declare @quantityCounter int, @resetQuantityCounterTo int, @currentQuantity decimal(18,3)
			Declare @pickNumber int, @resetTo int, @lastReset int, @cursorCounter int, @onRun int, @possibilitiesExhausted int
			Declare @inTheSameQuantity int

			Declare @autoPickDateRuleTypeFK int, @isExplicitDateSearch int
			Declare @palletIsEaches int

			Declare @autoPickRuleTypeFK int, @valueFK int
			Declare @date datetime, @currentDate datetime
			Declare @havePallets int

			Select @customerFK = divisions.CustomerFK, 
			@divisionFK = divisions.DivisionPK,
			@checkAgainstSplitEaches = 
				case when sis.AllowSplitEaches = 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/ AND EachesTypeFK > 0 AND AllowSplitPallets = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ then 
					1
				else 
					0 
				end,
			@checkAgainstSplitPallets = 
				case when sis.AllowSplitPallets = 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/ then 1 when sis.AllowSplitEaches = 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/ AND EachesTypeFK > 0 then 
					1 
				else 
					0 
				end,
			@palletIsEaches = case when EachesTypeFK > 0 then 1 else 0 end
			From tblStockItems sis 
			inner join tblDivisions divisions on
			divisions.DivisionPK = sis.DivisionFK
			inner join tblCustomers customers on
			customers.CustomerPK = divisions.customerFK
			Where sis.StockItemPK = @stockItemFK2

			Select @receiverTypeFK = MAX(AutoPickRuleReceiverTypeFK) from tblAutoPickRules aprs 
			Where (AutoPickRuleReceiverTypeFK = 1 AND AutoPickRuleReceiverFK = @customerFK)
			OR (AutoPickRuleReceiverTypeFK = 2 AND AutoPickRuleReceiverFK = @divisionFK)
			OR (AutoPickRuleReceiverTypeFK = 3 AND AutoPickRuleReceiverFK = @stockItemFK2)

			Set @pickNumber = 1

			Print @customerFK
			Print @divisionFK
			Print @receiverTypeFK

			IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#contentPicks') IS NOT NULL
				DROP TABLE #contentPicks

			CREATE TABLE #contentPicks 
			(
				PickNumber int,
				PalletContentPK int,
				Units Decimal(18,3), 
				Perfect Bit,
				Work Int
			)

			Set @autoPickDateRuleTypeFK = 0
			Set @isExplicitDateSearch = 0

			Select @autoPickDateRuleTypeFK = AutoPickRuleTypeFK, @valueFK = ValueFK
			From tblAutoPickRules
			Where AutoPickRuleReceiverTypeFK = @receiverTypeFK
			AND AutoPickRuleReceiverFK = 
				(case @receiverTypeFK when 1 then @customerFK 
					when 2 then @divisionFK
					when 3 then @stockItemFK2 end)
			AND AutoPickRuleTypeFK in (6,7,8,9) /*DateTypesOnly*/
			AND IsExplicit = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/
	
			Print 'AutoRuleDateType'
			Print @autoPickDateRuleTypeFK

			If(@autoPickDateRuleTypeFK > 0) Set @isExplicitDateSearch = 1
			Select @ruleSql = '', @groupRuleSql = ''

			Select @ruleSql = 
			case @autoPickDateRuleTypeFK when 0 then
				case when @pallets2 <> 0 then '' else '' end
			when 6 then
				' ExpiryDate ' + case @valueFK when 1 then ' ASC ' when 2 then ' DESC ' else ' ASC ' end + case when @pallets2 <> 0 then '' else ', AvailableUnits DESC ' end
			when 7 then
				' DateOfManufacture ' + case @valueFK when 1 then ' ASC ' when 2 then ' DESC ' else ' ASC ' end + case when @pallets2 <> 0 then '' else ', AvailableUnits DESC ' end
			when 8 then
				' BestBefore ' + case @valueFK when 1 then ' ASC ' when 2 then ' DESC ' else ' ASC ' end + case when @pallets2 <> 0 then '' else ', AvailableUnits DESC ' end
			when 9 then
				' case when DateOfReceipt <> ''01/01/1900'' then DateOfReceipt else pa.EventDate end ' + case @valueFK when 1 then ' ASC ' when 2 then ' DESC ' else ' ASC ' end + case when @pallets2 <> 0 then '' else', AvailableUnits DESC ' end
			else
				case when @pallets2 <> 0 then '' else ' AvailableUnits DESC ' end
			End,
			@groupRuleSql = 
			case @autoPickDateRuleTypeFK when 0 then
				' ExpiryDate '
			when 6 then
				' ExpiryDate ' 
			when 7 then
				' DateOfManufacture '
			when 8 then
				' BestBefore ' 
			when 9 then
				' case when DateOfReceipt <> ''01/01/1900'' then DateOfReceipt else pa.EventDate end '
			else
				''
			End,
			@extraFieldSql = 
			case @autoPickDateRuleTypeFK when 0 then
				' ExpiryDate '
			when 6 then
				' ExpiryDate '
			when 7 then
				' DateOfManufacture '
			when 8 then
				' BestBefore ' 
			when 9 then
				' case when DateOfReceipt <> ''01/01/1900'' then DateOfReceipt else pa.EventDate end DateOfReceipt ' 
			else
				' ExpiryDate '
			End
			print 'RULES'
			print @ruleSql
			Print @extraFieldSql
			Set @2ndStageRuleSql = ''

			DECLARE RuleCursor SCROLL CURSOR FOR
				Select AutoPickRuleTypeFK, ValueFK
				From tblAutoPickRules
				Where AutoPickRuleReceiverTypeFK = @receiverTypeFK
				AND AutoPickRuleReceiverFK = 
					(case @receiverTypeFK when 1 then @customerFK 
						when 2 then @divisionFK
						when 3 then @stockItemFK2 end)
				AND IsExplicit = 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/ /*We dont want explicit rules here as we have dealt with them already*/
				Order by RuleOrder asc
		
			OPEN RuleCursor
			If(@@CURSOR_ROWS > 0) Select @groupRuleSql = ', ' + @groupRuleSql
	
			Print 'Cursor Rows ' + cast( @@CURSOR_ROWS as nvarchar(50))
			FETCH NEXT FROM RuleCursor INTO @autoPickRuleTypeFK, @valueFK

			WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 BEGIN   
				Select @ruleSql = @ruleSql +
				case @autoPickRuleTypeFK
					when 2 then --Row
						', buRows.Row ' + case @valueFK when 1 then ' ASC ' else ' DESC ' end
					when 3 then --Column
						', buCols.BuildingUnitColumn ' + case @valueFK when 1 then ' ASC ' else ' DESC ' end
					when 4 then --BayLevel
						', buBays.BayLevel ' + case @valueFK when 1 then ' DESC ' else ' ASC ' end
					when 5 then --Quantity
						', pc.AvailableUnits ' + case @valueFK when 1 then ' ASC ' else ' DESC ' end
					when 6 then --Expiry
						', pc.ExpiryDate ASC ' --oldest first
					when 7 then --Date Of manufacture
						', pc.DateOfManufacture ASC '
					when 8 then -- BestBefore
						', pc.BestBefore ASC '
					when 9 then --DateOfReceipt
						', pc.DateOfReceipt ' + case @valueFK when 1 then ' ASC ' else ' DESC ' end
					when 10 then --Customer Pallet Number
						', pallets.CustomerPalletNumber ' + case @valueFK when 1 then ' ASC ' else ' DESC ' end
					else ''
				end,
				@groupRuleSql = @groupRuleSql +
				case @autoPickRuleTypeFK
					when 2 then --Row
						',buRows.Row ' 
					when 3 then --Column
						',buCols.BuildingUnitColumn ' 
					when 4 then --BayLevel
						',buBays.BayLevel ' 
					when 5 then --Quantity
						',pc.AvailableUnits ' 
					when 6 then --Expiry
						',pc.ExpiryDate ' --oldest first
					when 7 then --Date Of manufacture
						',pc.DateOfManufacture '
					when 8 then -- BestBefore
						',pc.BestBefore '
					when 9 then --DateOfReceipt
						',pc.DateOfReceipt ' 
					when 10 then --Customer Pallet Number
						',pallets.CustomerPalletNumber ' 
					else ''
				end
				Select @2ndStageRuleSql = @2ndStageRuleSql +
				case @autoPickRuleTypeFK
					when 11 then --number of
						' numberOf.NumberOf ' + case @valueFK when 1 then ' ASC,' else ' DESC,' end
					when 12 then -- uniform preference
						' quantities.Quantities ' + case @valueFK when 1 then ' ASC,' else ' DESC,' end
					else ''
				end
		print 'RULE CURSOR'
		print @ruleSql
				FETCH NEXT FROM RuleCursor INTO @autoPickRuleTypeFK, @valueFK   
			END   
			CLOSE RuleCursor   
			DEALLOCATE RuleCursor
	
			if(@ruleSQL <> '') Select @ruleSql = @ruleSql + ', pallets.BayPosition DESC', @groupRuleSql = @groupRuleSql + ', pallets.BayPosition'
			if(@2ndStageRuleSql <> '') Set @2ndStageRuleSql = substring(@2ndStageRuleSql, 0, LEN(@2ndStageRuleSql)) 

			Select @isEachesType = case when EachesTypeFK > 0 then 1 else 0 end from tblStockItems Where StockItemPK = @stockItemFK2
		
			IF @pallets2 <> 0 BEGIN --PALLETS
				IF @isEachesType = 1 BEGIN
					Print 'TagA'
					if(SUBSTRING(@ruleSql, 1,1) = ',') Set @ruleSql = SUBSTRING(@ruleSql, 2, LEN(@ruleSql) - 1)
					Set @havePallets = 1 /*We have PalletPKs.. Take Note so to pick our PalletContentPKs later*/
					Set @sql = 
					'Select pc.PalletContentPK as SuggestedPK, pc.AvailableUnits Units from (' +
					'Select top ' + cast(@pallets2 as nvarchar(50)) + ' PalletPK
					from tblPalletContent pc
					inner join tblPallets pallets on
					pallets.PalletPK = pc.PalletFK
					AND pallets.IsArchived = 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/
					inner join (
						Select EventDate, PalletFK from tblPalletAudit
						Where EventTypeFK = 1 /*Created*/
						Group By EventDate, PalletFK
					) pa on
					pa.PalletFK = pallets.PalletPK
					inner join tblBuildingUnitBays buBays on
					buBays.BuildingUnitBayPK = pallets.LocationFK AND pallets.LocationTypeFK = 1
					inner join tblBuildingUnitColumns buCols on
					buCols.BuildingUnitColumnPK = buBays.BuildingUnitColumnFK
					inner join tblBuildingUnitRows buRows on
					buRows.BuildingUnitRowPK = buCols.BuildingUnitRowFK
					Where pc.IsArchived = 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/ AND pc.StockItemFK=' + cast(@stockItemFK2 as nvarchar(50)) + ' AND Batch = ''' + @batch2 + '''' +
					' AND pallets.PalletStatusFK = ' + cast(@palletStatusFK2 as nvarchar(50)) + 
					case when @groupRuleSql = '' then ' GROUP BY PalletPK ' else ' GROUP BY PalletPK ' + case when @groupRuleSql <> '' then case when substring(@groupRuleSql,1,1) = ',' then @groupRuleSql else ',' + @groupRuleSql end else '' end end + 
					case when @ruleSql = '' then '' else ' Order by ' + @ruleSql end +
					' )subQ inner join tblPalletContent pc on pc.PalletFK = subQ.PalletPK'
					Print 'TagANow'
					--Print 'SQL ' + @sql
					----Print isnull(@groupRuleSql, 'NULL')
				END ELSE BEGIN
					Print 'TagB'
					Set @havePallets = 0 /*We have PalletContentPKs*/
					Set @sql = 
					'Select top ' + cast(@pallets2 as nvarchar(50)) + ' PalletContentPK as SuggestedPK, pc.AvailableUnits Units 
					from tblPalletContent pc
					inner join tblPallets pallets on
					pallets.PalletPK = pc.PalletFK
					AND pallets.IsArchived = 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/
					inner join (
						Select EventDate, PalletFK from tblPalletAudit
						Where EventTypeFK = 1 /*Created*/
						Group By EventDate, PalletFK
					) pa on
					pa.PalletFK = pallets.PalletPK
					inner join tblBuildingUnitBays buBays on
					buBays.BuildingUnitBayPK = pallets.LocationFK AND pallets.LocationTypeFK = 1
					inner join tblBuildingUnitColumns buCols on
					buCols.BuildingUnitColumnPK = buBays.BuildingUnitColumnFK
					inner join tblBuildingUnitRows buRows on
					buRows.BuildingUnitRowPK = buCols.BuildingUnitRowFK
					Where pc.StockItemFK=' + cast(@stockItemFK2 as nvarchar(50)) + ' AND Batch = ''' + @batch2 + '''' +
					' AND pc.IsArchived = 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/ AND pallets.PalletStatusFK = ' + cast(@palletStatusFK2 as nvarchar(50)) + 
					case when @ruleSql = '' then '' else ' Order by ' + @ruleSql end
				END
			END
			ELSE IF (@units2 <> 0 OR @eaches2 <> 0) --UNITS OR EACHES
			BEGIN /*With units and eaches we have the ability to choose which pallets we can empty:-
				Determine which pick mode we are in
				For efficient mode, try for a perfect match with least amount of movements
					Forfil order with leaset amount of work
				For clear racking mode, try for perfect match, most amount of movements
					Clear as many pallets as possible, follow location rules regardless of work
					Deplete smaller pallets*/	
				IF(@checkAgainstSplitEaches = 1) BEGIN --NO SPLIT EACHES
					IF(@palletIsEaches = 1) BEGIN
						IF(@eaches2 > 0) BEGIN
							Print 'Tag1'
							Set @havePallets = 0 /*We have PalletContentPKs*/
							Set @sql = 
							'DECLARE pallet_cursor SCROLL CURSOR FOR
					Select PalletContentPK as SuggestedPK, pc.AvailableUnits Units 
					from tblPalletContent pc
					inner join tblPallets pallets on
					pallets.PalletPK = pc.PalletFK
					AND pallets.IsArchived = 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/
					inner join (
						Select EventDate, PalletFK from tblPalletAudit
						Where EventTypeFK = 1 /*Created*/
						Group By EventDate, PalletFK
					) pa on
					pa.PalletFK = pallets.PalletPK
					inner join tblBuildingUnitBays buBays on
					buBays.BuildingUnitBayPK = pallets.LocationFK AND pallets.LocationTypeFK = 1
					inner join tblBuildingUnitColumns buCols on
					buCols.BuildingUnitColumnPK = buBays.BuildingUnitColumnFK
					inner join tblBuildingUnitRows buRows on
					buRows.BuildingUnitRowPK = buCols.BuildingUnitRowFK
					Where pc.StockItemFK=' + cast(@stockItemFK2 as nvarchar(50)) + ' AND Batch = ''' + @batch2 + '''' +
					' AND pc.IsArchived = 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/ AND pallets.PalletStatusFK = ' + CAST(@palletStatusFK2 as nvarchar(50)) + 
					case when @ruleSql = '' then '' else ' Order by ' + @ruleSql end
							--Print @sql
						END ELSE BEGIN
							Print 'Tag2'

							/************** NEW CODE FROM HERE **********************/
							/* Get pick mode */
							Declare @pickModeFK int /* 1=auto, 2=efficient, 3=clear racking*/
					
							Declare @buildingUnitFK int
							Declare @divisionBuildingUnitFK int
							Declare @currentOccupancy int
							Declare @occupancyThreshold int
							Declare @unitsPerEach decimal(18,3)
							Declare @searchedForEaches bit
							Declare @forceEachesOnlyRun bit
				
							Select Top 1 @buildingUnitFK = BuildingUnitFK 
							from tblPallets pallets
							inner join tblPalletContent pc on
							pc.PalletFK = pallets.PalletPK
							Where StockItemFK = @stockItemFK2 AND Batch = @batch2 

							Select @divisionBuildingUnitFK = DivisionBuildingUnitPK, @pickModeFK = PickModeFK, @occupancyThreshold = PickModeOccupancyThreshold
							from tblDivisionBuildingUnits Where DivisionFK = @divisionFK AND BuildingUnitFK = @buildingUnitFK

							Select @unitsPerEach = DefaultUnitsPerEach from tblStockItems where StockItemPK = @stockItemFK2

							if(@pickModeFK = 1) BEGIN --if pick mode is auto we need to look at division building unit occupancy to decide pick mode
								EXEC @currentOccupancy = dbo.fnWarehouseOccupancy @divisionBuildingUnitFK
								if(@currentOccupancy > @occupancyThreshold) BEGIN
									Set @pickModeFK = 3 --Occupancy has gone over our threshold, we need to save space, clear racking
								END ELSE BEGIN
									Set @pickModeFK = 2 --Occupancy is below our threshold, pick efficiently
								END
							END 

							IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#tblAllowedPartialEaches') IS NOT NULL
								DROP TABLE #tblAllowedPartialEaches

							Create TABLE #tblAllowedPartialEaches
							(
								PartialEachPK int identity(1,1),
								PalletContentFK int,
								Units decimal(18,3),
								Picked bit
								PRIMARY KEY (PartialEachPK)
							)

							IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#tblPalletQuantities') IS NOT NULL
								DROP TABLE #tblPalletQuantities					

							Create TABLE #tblPalletQuantities
							(
								PalletQuantityPK int identity(1,1),
								PalletFK int,
								Units decimal(18,3),
								Eaches decimal(18,3),
								PRIMARY KEY (PalletQuantityPK)
							)

							------Print @ruleSQL

							Set @sql = 'Insert into #tblPalletQuantities
							Select pc.PalletFK, sum(AvailableUnits) AvailableUnits, count(*)
							from tblPalletContent pc
							inner join tblPallets pallets on
							pallets.PalletPK = pc.PalletFK
							AND pallets.IsArchived = 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/
							inner join (
								Select EventDate, PalletFK from tblPalletAudit
								Where EventTypeFK = 1 /*Created*/
								Group By EventDate, PalletFK
							) pa on
							pa.PalletFK = pallets.PalletPK
							inner join tblBuildingUnitBays buBays on
							buBays.BuildingUnitBayPK = pallets.LocationFK AND pallets.LocationTypeFK = 1
							inner join tblBuildingUnitColumns buCols on
							buCols.BuildingUnitColumnPK = buBays.BuildingUnitColumnFK
							inner join tblBuildingUnitRows buRows on
							buRows.BuildingUnitRowPK = buCols.BuildingUnitRowFK		
							Where pc.IsArchived = 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/ AND pc.StockItemFK = ' + cast(@stockItemFK2 as nvarchar(50)) + ' AND pc.Batch = ''' + @batch2 + ''' and pallets.PalletStatusFK = ' + cast(@palletStatusFK2 as nvarchar(50)) + ' AND pc.AvailableEaches = 1 ' +
							case when @groupRuleSql = '' then 
								' GROUP BY pc.PalletFK ' 
							else 
								' GROUP BY pc.PalletFK ' + 
								case when substring(@groupRuleSql,1,1) = ',' then 
									@groupRuleSql 
								else 
									',' + @groupRuleSql 
								end 
							end + 

							case when @isExplicitDateSearch = 0 then
								' Order By sum(ActualUnits) DESC ' + 
								case when @ruleSQL = '' then 
									'' 
								else 
									case when substring(@ruleSQL,1,1) = ',' then 
										@ruleSQL 
									else 
										',' + @ruleSQL 
									end
								end
							else 
								case when @ruleSQL = '' then 
									' Order By sum(ActualUnits) DESC ' 
								else  
									' Order By ' + @ruleSQL + ', sum(ActualUnits) DESC '  
								end
							end
					
							Print @sql
							exec sp_executesql @sql
							print 'executed'

							IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#tblEachQuantities') IS NOT NULL
								DROP TABLE #tblEachQuantities	

							Create TABLE #tblEachQuantities
							(
								EachQuantityPK int identity(1,1),
								PalletContentFK int,
								Units decimal(18,3),
								PRIMARY KEY (EachQuantityPK)
							)
							Set @eachSql = 'TRUNCATE TABLE #tblEachQuantities;
											SET IDENTITY_INSERT #tblEachQuantities ON
											INSERT INTO #tblEachQuantities (EachQuantityPK, PalletContentFK, Units)
											VALUES (0, 0, 0)
											SET IDENTITY_INSERT #tblEachQuantities OFF
											TRUNCATE TABLE #tblEachQuantities;
										Insert into #tblEachQuantities
										Select PalletContentPK, ActualUnits
										from tblPalletContent pc
										inner join tblPallets pallets on
										pallets.PalletPK = pc.PalletFK
										AND pallets.IsArchived = 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/
										inner join (
											Select EventDate, PalletFK from tblPalletAudit
											Where EventTypeFK = 1 /*Created*/
											Group By EventDate, PalletFK
										) pa on
										pa.PalletFK = pallets.PalletPK
										inner join tblBuildingUnitBays buBays on
										buBays.BuildingUnitBayPK = pallets.LocationFK AND pallets.LocationTypeFK = 1
										inner join tblBuildingUnitColumns buCols on
										buCols.BuildingUnitColumnPK = buBays.BuildingUnitColumnFK
										inner join tblBuildingUnitRows buRows on
										buRows.BuildingUnitRowPK = buCols.BuildingUnitRowFK	
										inner join (
											Select PalletFK, sum(AvailableUnits)TotalUnits from tblPalletContent
											Group By PalletFK
										)palletTotals on palletTotals.PalletFK = pc.PalletFK	
										Where pc.StockItemFK = ' + cast(@stockItemFK2 as nvarchar(50)) + ' AND pc.Batch = ''' + @batch2 + ''' and pallets.PalletStatusFK = ' + cast(@palletStatusFK2 as nvarchar(50))  
										+ ' AND pc.IsArchived = 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/ AND pc.AvailableEaches = 1
										AND pc.PalletFK not in (Select PalletFK from #tblPossiblePerfectMatch)
										AND pc.PalletContentPK not in (Select PalletContentFK from #tblPossibleEachesMatch)'
								
							if(@pickModeFK = 2) BEGIN --Efficient
								IF(@isExplicitDateSearch = 0) BEGIN
									Set @eachSql = @eachSql + ' Order By ActualUnits DESC ' + @ruleSQL			
								END ELSE BEGIN 
									Set @eachSql = @eachSql + ' Order By ' + @ruleSQL + ', ActualUnits DESC '			
								END
							END ELSE BEGIN --Clear Racking
								IF(@isExplicitDateSearch = 0) BEGIN
									Set @eachSql = @eachSql + ' Order By TotalUnits ASC ' + @ruleSQL			
								END ELSE BEGIN 
									Set @eachSql = @eachSql + ' Order By ' + @ruleSQL + ',TotalUnits ASC '			
								END
							END
					
							IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#tblPossiblePerfectMatch') IS NOT NULL
								DROP TABLE #tblPossiblePerfectMatch	

							Create TABLE #tblPossiblePerfectMatch(PalletFK int, HaveAnEachesPick Bit)

							IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#tblPossibleEachesMatch') IS NOT NULL
								DROP TABLE #tblPossibleEachesMatch

							Create TABLE #tblPossibleEachesMatch(PalletContentFK int)
					
							Declare @searchingForPerfectMatch bit, @startingPosition int, @currentPosition int, @currentUnits decimal(18,3), @currentPalletFK int, @numberOfPallets int
							Set @searchingForPerfectMatch = 1
							Select @startingPosition = 1, @currentPosition = 1
							Select @runningTotal = 0, @onRun = 0, @forceEachesOnlyRun = 0
							Select @numberOfPallets = count(*) from #tblPalletQuantities
							--Print 'Number Of Pallets ' + cast(@numberOfPallets as nvarchar(20))
							--DEBUG
							--Select * from #tblPalletQuantities
							WHILE(@searchingForPerfectMatch = 1) BEGIN
								--Print 'Started Pallet Loop'
								if(@onRun = 0) BEGIN
									--Print 'Looking for new Run'
									Set @searchedForEaches = 0
									TRUNCATE TABLE #tblPossiblePerfectMatch
									Select @currentUnits = Units, @currentPalletFK = PalletFK from #tblPalletQuantities where PalletQuantityPK = @startingPosition
									--Print @startingPosition
									if(@currentUnits <= @units2 AND @forceEachesOnlyRun = 0) BEGIN
										--Print 'Found new Run'
										--Print @currentUnits
										----Print @startingPosition
										Set @runningTotal = @currentUnits
										Select @onRun = 1
										Set @currentPosition = @startingPosition + 1
										Insert into #tblPossiblePerfectMatch values(@currentPalletFK, 0)	
									END ELSE BEGIN
										--Print 'Still Looking for a new Run'
										Set @startingPosition = @startingPosition + 1
										--Print 'Starting Position ' + cast(@startingPosition as nvarchar(50)) + ' - Number Of Pallets ' + cast(@numberOfPallets as nvarchar(50))
										if((@startingPosition > @numberOfPallets) AND @pickNumber > 1) BEGIN
											Set @searchingForPerfectMatch = 0
										END ELSE IF ((@startingPosition > @numberOfPallets) AND @pickNumber = 1) BEGIN
											--Ok, we have no pick and we have gone through whole pallets, we need to pick individual eaches, set on run with a running total of zero
											--Print 'Just set run for eaches only'
											Select @runningTotal = 0, @onRun = 1
											Select @startingPosition = 1, @currentPosition = 1
										END ELSE IF (@forceEachesOnlyRun = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/) BEGIN
											--Ok, we have no pick and we have gone through whole pallets, we need to pick individual eaches, set on run with a running total of zero
											--Print 'Forced run for eaches only'
											Select @runningTotal = 0, @onRun = 1
											Select @startingPosition = 1, @currentPosition = 1
										END
									END
								END ELSE BEGIN
									--Print 'OnRun'
									Select @currentUnits = Units, @currentPalletFK = PalletFK from #tblPalletQuantities where PalletQuantityPK = @currentPosition
									if(@runningTotal + @currentUnits <= @units2 AND @currentPosition < @numberOfPallets) BEGIN
										--Print 'Adding To Run 1'
										--Print @currentUnits
										Set @runningTotal = @runningTotal + @currentUnits
										Update #tblPossiblePerfectMatch WITH (ROWLOCK) Set HaveAnEachesPick = 0
										Insert into #tblPossiblePerfectMatch values(@currentPalletFK, 0)
										Set @currentPosition = @currentPosition + 1
									END ELSE BEGIN
										--We have either BUST or at the last pallet. Make up the rest with eaches, save possible pick
										if(@currentPosition >= @numberOfPallets AND @startingPosition < @numberOfPallets) BEGIN
											--Print 'Adding To Run 2'
											--Print @currentUnits
											if(@runningTotal + @currentUnits <= @units2) BEGIN
												Set @runningTotal = @runningTotal + @currentUnits
												Insert into #tblPossiblePerfectMatch values(@currentPalletFK, 0)
											END
											Update #tblPossiblePerfectMatch WITH (ROWLOCK) Set HaveAnEachesPick = 0
										END
										Set @currentPosition = @currentPosition + 1
										--Print 'Pallets run has bust or is last pallet/pallet content'
										--Print @currentUnits
										--Print @runningTotal
										if(@runningTotal < @units2 AND not exists(Select * from #tblPossiblePerfectMatch Where HaveAnEachesPick = 1)) BEGIN
											--Print 'No Eaches run for this combination of pallets so will run'
											Declare @searchingForEaches bit, @onEachesRun bit, @numberOfPartials int, @eachesRunningTotal decimal(18,3), @eachesStartingPosition int, @eachesCurrentPosition int, @eachesCurrentUnits decimal(18,3), @currentPalletContentFK int
											Select @searchingForEaches = 1, @onEachesRun = 0, @eachesRunningTotal = 0
											if(((@units2 - @runningTotal)%@unitsPerEach)>0) BEGIN	
												--Print 'There are partials'
												--There are partials in this pick, find the partial(s)
												Declare @partialTarget decimal(18,3)
												If(@runningTotal = 0) BEGIN
													Set @partialTarget = @units2 
												END ELSE BEGIN
													Set @partialTarget = (@units2 - @runningTotal)%@unitsPerEach
												END
												--Print @partialTarget
												TRUNCATE TABLE #tblEachQuantities;
												SET IDENTITY_INSERT #tblEachQuantities ON
												INSERT INTO #tblEachQuantities (EachQuantityPK, PalletContentFK, Units)
												VALUES (0, 0, 0)
												SET IDENTITY_INSERT #tblEachQuantities OFF
												TRUNCATE TABLE #tblEachQuantities;
												Insert into #tblEachQuantities
												Select PalletContentPK, ActualUnits
												from tblPalletContent pc
												inner join tblPallets pallets on
												pallets.PalletPK = pc.PalletFK
												inner join tblBuildingUnitBays buBays on
												buBays.BuildingUnitBayPK = pallets.LocationFK AND pallets.LocationTypeFK = 1
												inner join tblBuildingUnitColumns buCols on
												buCols.BuildingUnitColumnPK = buBays.BuildingUnitColumnFK
												inner join tblBuildingUnitRows buRows on
												buRows.BuildingUnitRowPK = buCols.BuildingUnitRowFK	
												inner join (
													Select PalletFK, sum(ActualUnits)TotalUnits from tblPalletContent
													Group By PalletFK
												)palletTotals on palletTotals.PalletFK = pc.PalletFK	
												Where pc.StockItemFK = @stockItemFK2 AND pc.Batch = @batch2 and pallets.PalletStatusFK = @palletStatusFK2
												AND pc.AvailableEaches = 1
												AND not exists (Select * from #tblPossiblePerfectMatch Where PalletFK = pc.PalletFK) 
												AND ActualUnits <> @unitsPerEach
												Order by ActualUnits DESC
												Select @eachesStartingPosition = 1, @eachesCurrentPosition = 1
												Select @eachesRunningTotal = 0, @onEachesRun = 0
												Select @numberOfPartials = count(*) from #tblEachQuantities 
												--Select * from #tblEachQuantities
												--Print 'Number of Partials ' + cast(@numberOfPartials as nvarchar(50))
												WHILE(@searchingForEaches = 1) BEGIN
													--Print 'Started Partial Loop'
													--Print 'Running Total ' + cast(@eachesRunningTotal as nvarchar(50))
													if(@onEachesRun = 0) BEGIN
														--Print 'Not On Eaches Run'
														TRUNCATE TABLE #tblPossibleEachesMatch
														Select @eachesCurrentUnits = Units, @currentPalletContentFK = PalletContentFK from #tblEachQuantities where EachQuantityPK = @eachesStartingPosition
														--Print @eachesCurrentUnits
														if(@eachesCurrentUnits <= @partialTarget) BEGIN
															--Print 'On Eaches Run2'
															Select @onEachesRun = 1, @eachesRunningTotal = @eachesCurrentUnits
															Set @eachesCurrentPosition = @eachesStartingPosition + 1
															Insert into #tblPossibleEachesMatch values(@currentPalletContentFK)	
														END ELSE BEGIN
															--Print 'We have bust or found our match'
															Set @eachesStartingPosition = @eachesStartingPosition + 1
															if(@eachesStartingPosition > @numberOfPartials) Set @searchingForEaches = 0
														END
													END ELSE BEGIN
														--Print 'On Eaches run = 1'
														Select @eachesCurrentUnits = Units, @currentPalletContentFK = PalletContentFK from #tblEachQuantities where EachQuantityPK = @eachesCurrentPosition
														--Print @eachesCurrentUnits
														if(@eachesRunningTotal + @eachesCurrentUnits <= @partialTarget) BEGIN
															--Print 'Adding to possible eaches match'
															Set @eachesRunningTotal = @eachesRunningTotal + @eachesCurrentUnits
															Insert into #tblPossibleEachesMatch values(@currentPalletContentFK)
														END ELSE BEGIN
															--Print 'We have bust'
															Set @eachesCurrentPosition = @eachesCurrentPosition + 1
															IF(@eachesCurrentPosition > @numberOfPartials) BEGIN
																Set @eachesStartingPosition = @eachesStartingPosition + 1
																Set @eachesCurrentPosition = @eachesStartingPosition + 1
																Select @eachesRunningTotal = 0, @onEachesRun = 0
																--Print 'Have just rest partial loop'
																IF(@eachesStartingPosition > @numberOfPartials) Set @searchingForEaches = 0
															END
														END
													END
													----Print @partialTarget
													----Print @eachesRunningTotal
													if(@eachesRunningTotal = @partialTarget) BEGIN
														--We have matched the partials target
														----Print 'We have a partial match'
														Set @searchingForEaches = 0
													END
												END --While End
											END
									
											--We have dealt with the partials, pick remaining boxes if any by location
											--Check if we still need more boxes
											--Print 'Checking if we need more boxes'
											--Print @runningTotal
											--Print @eachesRunningTotal
											--Print @units2
											if((@runningTotal + @eachesRunningTotal) < @units2) BEGIN
												--Print 'We need more boxes'
												--We still need more boxes, pick by location
												Set @eachesRunningTotal = @runningTotal + @eachesRunningTotal 
												----Print @eachSql
												exec sp_executesql  @eachSql
												--Select * from #tblEachQuantities
												Select @onEachesRun = 0, @searchingForEaches = 1, @eachesCurrentPosition = 1
												While(@searchingForEaches = 1) BEGIN
													--Print 'Started Full Eaches loop'
													--Select * from #tblEachQuantities
													Select @eachesCurrentUnits = Units, @currentPalletContentFK = PalletContentFK from #tblEachQuantities where EachQuantityPK = @eachesCurrentPosition
													Insert into #tblPossibleEachesMatch values(@currentPalletContentFK)
													Set @eachesRunningTotal = @eachesRunningTotal + @eachesCurrentUnits
													--Print @eachesRunningTotal
													Set @eachesCurrentPosition = @eachesCurrentPosition + 1
													if(@eachesRunningTotal = @units2) BEGIN
														--Print 'We have all boxes Writing Pick ' + cast(@pickNumber as nvarchar(50))
														--We have all the boxes we need, write to contentpick
														Set @searchedForEaches = 1
														insert into #contentPicks
															Select @pickNumber, PalletContentPK, ActualUnits, 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/, 0
															from #tblPossiblePerfectMatch ppm
															inner join tblPalletContent pc on
															pc.PalletFK = ppm.PalletFK
															UNION
															Select @pickNumber, PalletContentFK, ActualUnits, 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/, 1
															from #tblPossibleEachesMatch pem
															inner join tblPalletContent pc on
															pc.PalletContentPK = pem.PalletContentFK
															Set @pickNumber = @pickNumber + 1
															TRUNCATE TABLE #tblPossibleEachesMatch
														Update #tblPossiblePerfectMatch WITH (ROWLOCK) Set HaveAnEachesPick = 1
														Set @searchingForEaches = 0
													END ELSE IF (@eachesRunningTotal > @units2) BEGIN
														----Print 'We have Bust Adding Eaches'
														--So we have bust with the eaches, set HaveanEachesPick to 1 so that it doesnt try again, exit loop
														Update #tblPossiblePerfectMatch WITH (ROWLOCK) Set HaveAnEachesPick = 1
														Set @searchingForEaches = 0
														Set @searchedForEaches = 1
													END
												END
											END ELSE if (@eachesRunningTotal > 0) BEGIN
												--Print 'Filled order with partials, write pick'
												insert into #contentPicks
													Select @pickNumber, PalletContentPK, ActualUnits, 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/, 0
													from #tblPossiblePerfectMatch ppm
													inner join tblPalletContent pc on
													pc.PalletFK = ppm.PalletFK
													UNION
													Select @pickNumber, PalletContentFK, ActualUnits, 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/, 1
													from #tblPossibleEachesMatch pem
													inner join tblPalletContent pc on
													pc.PalletContentPK = pem.PalletContentFK
													Set @pickNumber = @pickNumber + 1
													TRUNCATE TABLE #tblPossibleEachesMatch
											END
											IF(@runningTotal = 0) BEGIN	
												--This pick has been done with eaches only, set the current position over the number of pallets, we are done
												Set @searchingForPerfectMatch = 0
											END
										--END ELSE BEGIN
											----Print 'We already have a pick with this pallet OR BUST'
										END --Check if has had an eaches run already
									END
								END
								--Print 'Checking Pallet Run Total'
								if(@runningTotal = @units2 AND @searchedForEaches = 0) BEGIN
									--Print 'Found Perfect match'
									insert into #contentPicks
										Select @pickNumber, PalletContentPK, AvailableUnits, 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/, 0
										from #tblPossiblePerfectMatch ppm
										inner join tblPalletContent pc on
										pc.PalletFK = ppm.PalletFK
										Where pc.AvailableUnits > 0
									Set @pickNumber = @pickNumber + 1
									if(@currentPosition > @numberOfPallets) BEGIN
										Set @onRun = 0
										Set @startingPosition = @startingPosition + 1
										if(@startingPosition > @numberOfPallets) Set @searchingForPerfectMatch = 0
									END ELSE BEGIN
										Delete #tblPossiblePerfectMatch Where PalletFK = @currentPalletFK
									END
								END ELSE BEGIN
									--Print 'Still Searching For Perfect match'
									--Set @currentPosition = @currentPosition + 1
									if(@searchedForEaches = 1) BEGIN
										If(@onRun = 1 AND @runningTotal > 0) BEGIN
											--You have had a run and started with at least something, this run has failed, else it might be time to go after individual eaches
											if(@currentPosition > @numberOfPallets) BEGIN
												--Print 'Hit the end of this pallet run'
												Set @onRun = 0
												Set @startingPosition = @startingPosition + 1
												----Print 'Starting Position ' + cast(@startingPosition as nvarchar(50)) 
												if(@startingPosition > @numberOfPallets) BEGIN
													if(@pickNumber > 1) BEGIN --if we have a pick
													----Print 'No More possible runs'
														Set @searchingForPerfectMatch = 0
													END ELSE BEGIN --if we still dont have a pick, force eaches only run
														--Print 'Forcing Eaches Only Run'
														TRUNCATE TABLE #tblPossibleEachesMatch --Clear this to be sure
														Select @forceEachesOnlyRun = 1, @onRun = 0
													END
												END
											END
										END
						
									END
									Set @searchedForEaches = 0 --Reset searched for eaches
								END
							END

							if(@pickModeFK = 2) BEGIN
								/***** EFFICIENT PICKING *****/
								--Print 'Efficient Picking'
								if(exists(Select * from #contentPicks where Perfect = 1)) BEGIN
									Select Top 1 @pickNumber = picks.PickNumber 
									from #contentPicks picks
									inner join (
										Select PickNumber, count(*) PalletsCleared from (
											Select PickNumber, PalletFK from #contentPicks cps
											inner join tblPalletContent pc on
											pc.PalletContentPK = cps.PalletContentPK
											Group By PickNumber, PalletFK
										) subQ Group By PickNumber
									) palletsCleared on
									palletsCleared.PickNumber = picks.PickNumber
									Order By Perfect DESC, PalletsCleared ASC, picks.PickNumber ASC
								END ELSE BEGIN
									Select Top 1 @pickNumber = picks.PickNumber 
									from #contentPicks picks
									inner join (
										Select PickNumber, sum(Work) WorkAmount from #contentPicks
										Group By PickNumber
									) work on
									work.PickNumber = picks.PickNumber

									inner join (
										Select PickNumber, count(*) PalletsInvolved from (
											Select PickNumber, PalletFK from #contentPicks cps
											inner join tblPalletContent pc on
											pc.PalletContentPK = cps.PalletContentPK
											Group By PickNumber, PalletFK
										) subQ Group By PickNumber
									) palletsInvolved on
									palletsInvolved.PickNumber = picks.PickNumber
							
									Order By work.WorkAmount ASC, palletsInvolved.PalletsInvolved ASC, picks.PickNumber ASC
							
							
								END
								--Print 'Pick ' + cast(@pickNumber as nvarchar(50))
						
								--Select * from #contentPicks 
								if((Select sum(Units) from #contentPicks 
								where PickNumber = @pickNumber) = @units2) BEGIN
									Select PalletContentPK as SuggestedPK, Units from #contentPicks 
									where PickNumber = @pickNumber
								END ELSE BEGIN
									Select 'Could Not Make This Pick 1' as [Error]
								END

								return
							END ELSE BEGIN
								/***** CLEAR RACKING *****/
								----Print 'Clear Racking'
								if(exists(Select * from #contentPicks where Perfect = 1)) BEGIN
									----Print 'Clear racking - perfect'
							
									Select Top 1 @pickNumber = picks.PickNumber 
									from #contentPicks picks
									inner join (
										Select PickNumber, Count(*) PalletsCleared from (
										Select PickNumber, PalletFK 
										from #contentPicks cps
										inner join tblPalletContent pc on
										pc.PalletContentPK = cps.PalletContentPK
										Group By PickNumber, PalletFK
										)subQ Group By PickNumber
									) PalletsCleared on
									PalletsCleared.PickNumber = picks.PickNumber
									Order By Perfect DESC, PalletsCleared DESC, picks.PickNumber ASC
								END ELSE BEGIN
									----Print 'Clear racking - non perfect'
									Select Top 1 @pickNumber = picks.PickNumber 
									from #contentPicks picks
									inner join (
										Select PickNumber, PalletFK, count(*) PalletsCleared
										from #contentPicks cps
										inner join tblPalletContent pc on
										pc.PalletContentPK = cps.PalletContentPK
										Group By PickNumber, PalletFK
									) PalletsCleared on
									PalletsCleared.PickNumber = picks.PickNumber
									inner join (
										Select PickNumber,sum(Work) WorkAmount from #contentPicks
										Group By PickNumber
									) work on
									work.PickNumber = picks.PickNumber
									Order By PalletsCleared DESC, work.WorkAmount ASC, picks.PickNumber ASC
								END
								----Print 'Pick ' + cast(@pickNumber as nvarchar(50))

								if((Select sum(Units) from #contentPicks 
								where PickNumber = @pickNumber) = @units2) 
								BEGIN

									IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#tblLocationCheck') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #tblLocationCheck

									--Check if any pallets do not comply with locations rules
									CREATE TABLE #tblLocationCheck(
										PalletQuantityPK int,
										PalletFK int,
										Units decimal(18,3),
										PickedPalletOfThisUnits Bit,
										PickedThisPallet Bit
									)

									Insert into #tblLocationCheck
									Select PalletQuantityPK, pqs.PalletFK, pqs.Units, case when cpsPalletQuantities.Units is not null then 1 else 0 end,case when cps.PalletFK is not null then 1 else 0 end 
									from #tblPalletQuantities pqs
									left outer join (
										Select PalletFK from #contentPicks cps
										inner join tblPalletContent pc on
										pc.PalletContentPK = cps.PalletContentPK
										Where PickNumber = @pickNumber AND Work = 0 --Entire Pallet
										Group By PalletFK
									)cps on
									cps.PalletFK = pqs.PalletFK
									left outer join (
										Select Units from (
										Select sum(Units) Units from #contentPicks cps
										inner join tblPalletContent pc on
										pc.PalletContentPK = cps.PalletContentPK
										Where PickNumber = @pickNumber AND Work = 0 --Entire Pallet
										Group By PalletFK
										) subQ Group By Units
									)cpsPalletQuantities on
									cpsPalletQuantities.Units = pqs.Units
									--DEBUG
									--Select * from @tblLocationCheck 
									if(exists(
										Select * from #tblLocationCheck locCheck
										inner join #tblLocationCheck betterPallet on
										betterPallet.Units = locCheck.Units
										AND betterPallet.PalletQuantityPK < locCheck.PalletQuantityPK
										Where locCheck.PickedPalletOfThisUnits = 1
										AND locCheck.PickedThisPallet = 1)) 
									BEGIN
										--Ok there is a better pallet that could have been picked, change it/them
										Declare @fixingPalletLocations bit
										Set @fixingPalletLocations = 1
										While(@fixingPalletLocations = 1) BEGIN
									
											if(exists(
												Select * from #tblLocationCheck locCheck
												inner join #tblLocationCheck betterPallet on
												betterPallet.Units = locCheck.Units
												AND betterPallet.PalletQuantityPK < locCheck.PalletQuantityPK
												AND betterPallet.PickedThisPallet = 0
												Where locCheck.PickedPalletOfThisUnits = 1
												AND locCheck.PickedThisPallet = 1)) 
											BEGIN
												Declare @wrongPalletFK int, @rightPalletFK int
												Select Top 1 @wrongPalletFK = locCheck.PalletFK, @rightPalletFK = betterPallet.PalletFK  from #tblLocationCheck locCheck
												inner join #tblLocationCheck betterPallet on
												betterPallet.Units = locCheck.Units
												AND betterPallet.PalletQuantityPK < locCheck.PalletQuantityPK
												AND betterPallet.PickedThisPallet = 0
												Where locCheck.PickedPalletOfThisUnits = 1
												AND locCheck.PickedThisPallet = 1
												Order By betterPallet.PalletQuantityPK ASC

												Delete cps										
												from #contentPicks cps
												inner join tblPalletContent pc on
												pc.PalletContentPK = cps.PalletContentPK
												Where cps.PickNumber = @pickNumber
												AND pc.PalletFK = @wrongPalletFK

												--Print 'Inserting into content pick as part of location check'
												Insert into #contentPicks
												Select @pickNumber, PalletContentPK, AvailableUnits, 1/*I think its perfect now so there.. may not actually be perfect pick but it doesnt matter at this point*/, 0 /*No work*/
												From tblPalletContent Where PalletFK = @rightPalletFK

												TRUNCATE TABLE #tblLocationCheck

												Insert into #tblLocationCheck
												Select PalletQuantityPK, pqs.PalletFK, pqs.Units, case when cpsPalletQuantities.Units is not null then 1 else 0 end,case when cps.PalletFK is not null then 1 else 0 end 
												from #tblPalletQuantities pqs
												left outer join (
													Select PalletFK from #contentPicks cps
													inner join tblPalletContent pc on
													pc.PalletContentPK = cps.PalletContentPK
													Where PickNumber = @pickNumber AND Work = 0 --Entire Pallet
													Group By PalletFK
												)cps on
												cps.PalletFK = pqs.PalletFK
												left outer join (
													Select Units from (
													Select sum(Units) Units from #contentPicks cps
													inner join tblPalletContent pc on
													pc.PalletContentPK = cps.PalletContentPK
													Where PickNumber = @pickNumber AND Work = 0 --Entire Pallet
													Group By PalletFK
													) subQ Group By Units
												)cpsPalletQuantities on
												cpsPalletQuantities.Units = pqs.Units
											END ELSE BEGIN
												--No wrong pallets founf, exit
												Set @fixingPalletLocations = 0
											END
										END
									END
							
							
							
									if((Select sum(Units) from #contentPicks 
									where PickNumber = @pickNumber) = @units2) BEGIN
										Select PalletContentPK as SuggestedPK, Units from #contentPicks 
										where PickNumber = @pickNumber
									END ELSE BEGIN
										Select 'Could Not Make This Pick' as [Error]
									END
								END ELSE BEGIN
									Select 'Could Not Make This Pick' as [Error]
								END
								return
							END
		--					Set @havePallets = 0 /*We have PalletPKs.. Take Note so to pick our PalletContentPKs later*/
		--					Set @sql = 
		--					'DECLARE pallet_cursor SCROLL CURSOR FOR
		--					SELECT PalletContentPK, AvailableUnits,' + @extraFieldSql + '
		--					FROM tblPalletContent pc
		--					inner join tblPallets pallets on
		--					pallets.PalletPK = pc.PalletFK
		--					inner join (Select PalletFK, sum(AvailableUnits) PalletTotal
		--						from tblPalletContent
		--						Group By PalletFK) palletTotals on
		--					palletTotals.PalletFK = pallets.PalletPK
		--					inner join tblBuildingUnitBays buBays on
		--					buBays.BuildingUnitBayPK = pallets.LocationFK AND pallets.LocationTypeFK = 1
		--					inner join tblBuildingUnitColumns buCols on
		--					buCols.BuildingUnitColumnPK = buBays.BuildingUnitColumnFK
		--					inner join tblBuildingUnitRows buRows on
		--					buRows.BuildingUnitRowPK = buCols.BuildingUnitRowFK
		--					Where pc.StockItemFK=' + cast(@stockItemFK2 as nvarchar(50)) + ' AND Batch = ''' + @batch2 + '''' +
		--					' AND pallets.PalletStatusFK = 1'/*OK*/ +
		--					' Order By PalletTotal DESC,' + @ruleSql /* THIS PalletTotal IS A TEMPORARY FIX !!!!!!*/
						END
					END ELSE BEGIN
						Print 'Tag3 - GSK1'
						IF(SUBSTRING(@ruleSql, 1,1) = ',') Set @ruleSql = SUBSTRING(@ruleSql, 2, LEN(@ruleSql) - 1)
						Set @havePallets = 0 /*We have PalletPKs.. Take Note so to pick our PalletContentPKs later*/
						Set @sql = 
						'DECLARE pallet_cursor SCROLL CURSOR FOR
						SELECT PalletContentPK, AvailableUnits,' + @extraFieldSql + '
						FROM tblPalletContent pc
						inner join tblPallets pallets on
						pallets.PalletPK = pc.PalletFK
						AND pallets.IsArchived = 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/
						inner join tblBuildingUnitBays buBays on
						buBays.BuildingUnitBayPK = pallets.LocationFK AND pallets.LocationTypeFK = 1
						inner join tblBuildingUnitColumns buCols on
						buCols.BuildingUnitColumnPK = buBays.BuildingUnitColumnFK
						inner join tblBuildingUnitRows buRows on
						buRows.BuildingUnitRowPK = buCols.BuildingUnitRowFK
						Where pc.StockItemFK=' + cast(@stockItemFK2 as nvarchar(50)) + ' AND Batch = ''' + @batch2 + '''' +
						' AND pc.IsArchived = 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/ AND AvailableEaches=1 AND pallets.PalletStatusFK = ' + cast(@palletStatusFK2 as nvarchar(50)) +
						' Order By ' + @ruleSql
					END
				END ELSE IF(@checkAgainstSplitPallets = 1) BEGIN --NO SPLIT PALLETS 
					Print 'Tag4 - GSK Tag4'
					Select @distinctQuantities = count(*) from ( Select Distinct StockItemFK, Batch, AvailableUnits from tblPalletContent
					Where StockItemFK = @stockItemFK2 AND Batch = @batch2 AND AvailableUnits <> 0
					Group By StockItemFK, Batch, AvailableUnits ) subQ
			
					Print @palletIsEaches
					IF(@palletIsEaches = 1) BEGIN
						IF(@eaches2 > 0) BEGIN
							----Print 'Tag1'
							IF(SUBSTRING(@ruleSql, 1,1) = ',') Set @ruleSql = SUBSTRING(@ruleSql, 2, LEN(@ruleSql) - 1)
							Set @havePallets = 1 /*We have PalletPKs.. Take Note so to pick our PalletContentPKs later*/
							Set @sql = 
							'DECLARE pallet_cursor SCROLL CURSOR FOR
							SELECT PalletPK, Count(*) as AvailableUnits,' + @extraFieldSql + '
							FROM tblPalletContent pc
							inner join tblPallets pallets on
							pallets.PalletPK = pc.PalletFK
							AND pallets.IsArchived = 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/
							inner join tblBuildingUnitBays buBays on
							buBays.BuildingUnitBayPK = pallets.LocationFK AND pallets.LocationTypeFK = 1
							inner join tblBuildingUnitColumns buCols on
							buCols.BuildingUnitColumnPK = buBays.BuildingUnitColumnFK
							inner join tblBuildingUnitRows buRows on

							' GROUP BY PalletPK ' + @groupRuleSql + 
							' Order By ' + @ruleSql
							Set @units2 = @eaches2 --I know this is ugly but set the units to the eaches so following code will work as if units
						END ELSE BEGIN
							Print 'GSK 5'
							Print @extraFieldSql
							IF(SUBSTRING(@ruleSql, 1,1) = ',') Set @ruleSql = SUBSTRING(@ruleSql, 2, LEN(@ruleSql) - 1)
							Set @havePallets = 1 /*We have PalletPKs.. Take Note so to pick our PalletContentPKs later*/
							Set @sql =

							SELECT PalletPK, AvailableUnits ' + -- + @extraFieldSql + '

						Print 'This is for GSK, whole pallets with eaches on'
						IF(SUBSTRING(@ruleSql, 1,1) = ',') Set @ruleSql = SUBSTRING(@ruleSql, 2, LEN(@ruleSql) - 1)
						Set @havePallets = 0 /*We have PalletPKs.. Take Note so to pick our PalletContentPKs later*/
						Set @sql = 
						'DECLARE pallet_cursor SCROLL CURSOR FOR
						SELECT PalletContentPK, AvailableUnits' /*' + @extraFieldSql*/ + '

						buRows.BuildingUnitRowPK = buCols.BuildingUnitRowFK

						' AND pc.IsArchived = 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/ AND pallets.PalletStatusFK = ' + cast(@palletStatusFK2 as nvarchar(50)) + ' AND pc.AvailableUnits > 0 ' +
						' Order By ' + @ruleSql
						Print @sql
					END

				END

				--Print @sql
				exec sp_executesql @sql
				OPEN pallet_cursor
				Set @numberOfCursorRows = @@CURSOR_ROWS
				FETCH NEXT FROM pallet_cursor
				INTO @palletContentPK, @availableUnits
				Print isnull(@availableUnits, -1)		

				/*INITIALIZE*/
				Select @sql = '', @sectionResetSql = '', @cursorCounter = 0, @quantityCounter = 0, @onRun = 0, @pickNumber = 1
				Select @possibilitiesExhausted = 0, @resetTo = 0, @resetQuantityCounterTo = 1, @lastReset = 0, @currentQuantity = 0
				Select @runningTotal = 0, @sectionResetRunningTotal  = 0, @resetRunningTotal = 0 --For Explicit Date Rules Only
				----
				Print 'About to start cursor'
				WHILE (@possibilitiesExhausted = 0)
				BEGIN
					Print 'Top of Cursor Loop'
					set @cursorCounter = @cursorCounter + 1
					IF(@currentQuantity <> @availableUnits AND @isExplicitDateSearch = 0) BEGIN
						Select @currentQuantity = @availableUnits, @quantityCounter = @quantityCounter + 1

						END

						END

							Print 'START/RESET RUN'

							Print 'RESET RUNNING TOTAL ' + cast(@resetRunningTotal as nvarchar(100))
						END

					Print 'Hello'

						Print 'FOUND PICK quantity' + cast(@quantityCounter as nvarchar(50))

							Select @sql = '', @cursorCounter = @resetTo - 1, @onRun = 0, @currentQuantity = 0, @quantityCounter = @resetQuantityCounterTo, @runningTotal = 0

								Set @inTheSameQuantity = 1

						Print 'Running Total: ' + cast(@runningTotal as nvarchar(50))

						Print 'Running Total: ' + cast(@runningTotal as nvarchar(50))
		--				if(@isExplicitDateSearch = 1) Set @skippedContent = 0

						FETCH NEXT FROM pallet_cursor --have to fetch again within loop
						INTO @palletContentPK, @availableUnits
		--				IF(@isExplicitDateSearch = 1) BEGIN
		--					IF(@currentDate <> @date) BEGIN
		--						----Print 'MOVED DATE WHILE BUILDING'
		--						Select @currentDate = @date, @onRun = 0

		--				END
						IF(@@FETCH_STATUS <> 0 AND @resetQuantityCounterTo + 1 = @distinctQuantities  AND @isExplicitDateSearch = 0) Set @possibilitiesExhausted = 1
					END
					ELSE --BUST
					BEGIN  --So we have bust, if there are no lesser quantities to make our total then exit
						Print 'BUST AvUnits ' + cast(@availableUnits as nvarchar(50)) 
						IF(@isExplicitDateSearch = 0) BEGIN
							IF(@quantityCounter >= @distinctQuantities) BEGIN
								----Print 'NO MORE SMALLER QUANTITIES'
								if(@lastReset <> @resetTo )	BEGIN
									----Print 'HAVE TRIED ALL QUANTITIES'
									Select @sql = '', @cursorCounter = @resetTo - 1, @onRun = 0
									Select @currentQuantity = 0, @quantityCounter = @resetQuantityCounterTo, @runningTotal = 0
									FETCH ABSOLUTE @resetTo FROM pallet_cursor --have to fetch again within loop

								END
							END
							ELSE
							BEGIN
								----Print 'May find smaller quantity - Get next Quantity'
								FETCH NEXT FROM pallet_cursor --have to fetch again within loop
								INTO @palletContentPK, @availableUnits
							END
						END
						ELSE BEGIN	
							----Print 'May find smaller quantity - Get next Quantity'
							FETCH NEXT FROM pallet_cursor --have to fetch again within loop
							INTO @palletContentPK, @availableUnits
		--					----Print @currentDate
		--					----Print @date
							IF(@currentDate <> @date) BEGIN --We have bust and the date has changed
								----Print 'EXIT 6'
								Set @possibilitiesExhausted = 1
							END
							ELSE BEGIN
								Print 'Doing This'
								Select @cursorCounter = @resetTo, @onRun = 0
						
								IF(@@FETCH_STATUS <> 0) BEGIN
									FETCH ABSOLUTE @resetTo FROM pallet_cursor --have to fetch again within loop
									INTO @palletContentPK, @availableUnits, @date
									Set @lastReset = @resetTo
									----Print @resetTo
									FETCH ABSOLUTE @resetTo FROM pallet_cursor --have to fetch again within loop
									INTO @palletContentPK, @availableUnits
									Set @resetTo = @resetTo + 1
									Set @currentDate = @date

									----Print @resetTo
									IF(@numberOfCursorRows = @resetTo) Set @possibilitiesExhausted = 1
								END
							END
							Set @skippedContent = 1
						END
					END

					IF(@inTheSameQuantity = 1)
					BEGIN
						Print 'SKIP SAME QUANTITY PALLETS'
						WHILE(@currentQuantity = @availableUnits AND @@FETCH_STATUS = 0)
						BEGIN
							FETCH NEXT FROM pallet_cursor --have to fetch again within loop
							INTO @palletContentPK, @availableUnits
							Set @cursorCounter = @cursorCounter + 1
						END
						IF(@@FETCH_STATUS <> 0)
						BEGIN
							Set @possibilitiesExhausted = 1

						BEGIN
							Set @runningTotal = 0
							WHILE (@runningTotal < @units2)

								FETCH PRIOR FROM pallet_cursor --have to fetch again within loop
								INTO @palletContentPK, @availableUnits
								Set @runningTotal = @runningTotal + @availableUnits
								Set @cursorCounter = @cursorCounter - 1
							END
							FETCH NEXT FROM pallet_cursor --have to fetch again within loop
							INTO @palletContentPK, @availableUnits
							Set @runningTotal = 0
							Set @inTheSameQuantity = 0
						END
				
					END
			

				END
				CLOSE pallet_cursor
				DEALLOCATE pallet_cursor
		

				Set @2ndStageSql = '
				Select Top 1 picks.PickNumber from #contentPicks picks
				inner join (
					Select PickNumber, Count(*) NumberOf from #contentPicks
					Group By PickNumber
				) numberOf on
				numberOf.PickNumber = picks.PickNumber
				inner join (
					Select PickNumber, Count(*) Quantities from (
						Select PickNumber, Units from #contentPicks 
						Group By PickNumber, Units
					)subQ Group By subQ.PickNumber
				) quantities on
				quantities.PickNumber = picks.PickNumber
				Order by ' + case when @2ndStageRuleSql = '' then ' NumberOf.numberOf ASC, quantities.Quantities ASC' else @2ndStageRuleSql end

				IF(@havePallets = 0) BEGIN
					Print 'here1'
					Set @sql = 'Select cps.PalletContentPK as SuggestedPK, pc.PalletFK, Units, pals.CustomerPalletNumber, pals.CustomerBarcode
					from #contentPicks cps 
					left outer join tblPalletContent pc on pc.PalletContentPK = cps.PalletContentPK 
					left outer join tblPallets pals on pals.PalletPK = pc.PalletFK
					where PickNumber = (' + @2ndStageSql + ')'
				END ELSE BEGIN /*WE HAVE PALLET PKS!!*/
					/* THE FOLLOWING SQL READS STRANGE - IN THIS INSTANCE THE contentPicks.PalletContentFK IS ACTUALLY THE PalletPK*/
					Print 'here2'
					Set @sql = 'Select pc.PalletContentPK as SuggestedPK, pc.PalletFK, Units, pals.CustomerPalletNumber, pals.CustomerBarcode
					from #contentPicks contentPicks
					inner join tblPalletContent pc on pc.PalletFK = contentPicks.PalletContentPK

			Print @sql
			------Print 'hello'
			exec sp_executesql @sql

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end
			
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spAutoPickRuleFactory]
(
	@StockItemFK int,
	@BuildingUnitFK int,
	@Clause VARCHAR(100) OUT,
	@RuleLevelFK int = -1,
	@Filter VARCHAR(500) = '' OUT,
	@FilterDesc VARCHAR(500) = '' OUT
)
	/* DEBUG Settings
	
		DECLARE @paramStockItemFK int
		set @paramStockItemFK = 33769
	*/
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT
 ,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;
	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();
	print 'start'
	print @StockItemFK
	print 'end'
	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	DECLARE @paramStockItemFK2 int, @paramBuildingUnitFK2 int, @RuleLevelFK2 int
	SET @paramStockItemFK2 = @StockItemFK; SET @paramBuildingUnitFK2 = @BuildingUnitFK; SET @RuleLevelFK2 = @RuleLevelFK

	SET @ParameterDetails = '@paramStockItemFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@paramStockItemFK2 AS NVARCHAR(100)),'') + ',@paramBuildingUnitFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@paramBuildingUnitFK2 AS NVARCHAR(100)),'')
		+ ',@RuleLevelFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@RuleLevelFK2 AS NVARCHAR(100)),'')

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    --BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

		SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END


	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY
			

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start

			/* Declare variables */
			DECLARE @RuleOrder INT
			DECLARE @CustomerFK INT
			DECLARE @DivisionFK INT
			DECLARE @OrderBy VARCHAR(100)
			DECLARE @OrderByDesc VARCHAR(500)
			DECLARE @Where VARCHAR(500)
			DECLARE @WhereDesc VARCHAR(500)
			DECLARE @AutoPickRuleReceiverTypeFK INT
			DECLARE @AutoPickRuleReceiverFK INT
			DECLARE @FieldName VARCHAR(50)
			DECLARE @DaysFromDate INT
			DECLARE @FieldSortDirection VARCHAR(100)

			/* Initialise variables */
			SET @RuleOrder = -1
			SET @CustomerFK = -1
			SET @DivisionFK = -1
			SET @OrderBy =''
			SET @OrderByDesc =''
			SET @Where =''
			SET @WhereDesc = ''
			SET @AutoPickRuleReceiverTypeFK = -1
			SET @AutoPickRuleReceiverFK = -1
			SET @FieldName = '';
			SET @DaysFromDate = -1
			SET @FieldSortDirection = '';

			DECLARE @tblActiveRules TABLE
										(
											RowID int Identity(1,1),
											RuleOrder int,
											FieldName nvarchar(100),
											FieldSortDirection nvarchar(200),
											AutoPickRuleReceiverFK int,
											AutoPickRuleReceiverTypeFK int,
											DaysFromDate int
										)

			/* Retrieve variables from database */
			SELECT 
				@CustomerFK=divs.CustomerFK,
				@DivisionFK = si.DivisionFK
			FROM 
				tblStockItems si 
				inner join tblDivisions divs on
				divs.DivisionPK = si.DivisionFK
			WHERE
				si.StockItemPK = @paramStockItemFK2

			Insert INTO @tblActiveRules (RuleOrder, FieldName, FieldSortDirection,AutoPickRuleReceiverFK,AutoPickRuleReceiverTypeFK,DaysFromDate)
			SELECT
				apr.RuleOrder,
				aprt.FieldName,
				CASE WHEN aprt.FieldSortDirection = '-1' THEN
					CASE apr.ValueFK WHEN 1 THEN
						'ASC'
					WHEN 2 THEN
						'DESC'
					ELSE
						'ASC'
					END
				ELSE
					aprt.FieldSortDirection
				END FieldSortDirection,
				apr.AutoPickRuleReceiverFK,
				apr.AutoPickRuleReceiverTypeFK, 
				apr.DaysFromDate
			FROM
				tblAutoPickRules apr
				INNER JOIN tblAutoPickRuleTypes aprt on apr.AutoPickRuleTypeFK = aprt.AutoPickRuleTypePK
			WHERE
				(
					((apr.AutoPickRuleReceiverFK = @CustomerFK) or (@CustomerFK = -1))
						or
					((apr.AutoPickRuleReceiverFK = @DivisionFK) or (@DivisionFK = -1))
						or
					(apr.AutoPickRuleReceiverFK = @paramStockItemFK2)
				)
		-- LJF Have had to add a clause here as that useless fuck Geir ignored the building unit the rule was set up for
				AND (apr.BuildingUnitFK=@paramBuildingUnitFK2)
		-- LJF That useless fuck Geir Lie had the below clause enabled, the code would never find any pick rules other than order by bu which is useless
		--		AND
		--		(aprt.RuleTypeFK = 1 )
		--Jamie : added extra filter to split rules by stock / building, or ignore with default -1 value
				AND (	
					@RuleLevelFK2 = -1
					or
					aprt.RuleLevelFK = @RuleLevelFK2
				) 
			ORDER BY apr.RuleOrder ASC
	
			/* DEBUG
				select * from @tblActiveRules
			*/

			DECLARE @RuleCounter int
			DECLARE @RuleCounterMax int
			SELECT @RuleCounterMax = count(*) from @tblActiveRules
			SET @RuleCounter = 1
			SET @OrderBy= 'ORDER BY '
			SET @OrderByDesc= 'ordered by '
			SET @Where= 'WHERE '
			SET @WhereDesc = 'where '
			WHILE (@RuleCounter <= @RuleCounterMax)
			BEGIN
				/* DEBUG 
					select @RuleCounter
				*/
				SELECT 		
					@RuleOrder = RuleOrder,
					@FieldName = FieldName,
					@FieldSortDirection = FieldSortDirection,
					@AutoPickRuleReceiverFK = AutoPickRuleReceiverFK,
					@AutoPickRuleReceiverTypeFK = AutoPickRuleReceiverTypeFK,
					@DaysFromDate = DaysFromDate
				FROM
					@tblActiveRules where RowID=@RuleCounter

					/* Processing information properly */
					IF ((@AutoPickRuleReceiverTypeFK=3) and (@AutoPickRuleReceiverFK=@paramStockItemFK2)) OR
					((@AutoPickRuleReceiverTypeFK=2) and (@AutoPickRuleReceiverFK=@DivisionFK)) OR
					((@AutoPickRuleReceiverTypeFK=1) and (@AutoPickRuleReceiverFK=@CustomerFK))
					BEGIN
						IF (@OrderBy= 'ORDER BY ')
						BEGIN
							SET @OrderBy = @OrderBy + @FieldName+' ' +@FieldSortDirection
							SET @OrderByDesc = @OrderByDesc + @FieldName+' '+ case when @FieldSortDirection = 'ASC' then 'Ascending' else 'Descending' end
						END
						ELSE
						BEGIN
							SET @OrderBy = @OrderBy +', '+ @FieldName+' '+@FieldSortDirection
							SET @OrderByDesc = @OrderByDesc +' and '+ @FieldName+' '+case when @FieldSortDirection = 'ASC' then 'Ascending' else 'Descending' end
						END

						IF(@DaysFromDate > 0)
						BEGIN
							IF(@Where= 'WHERE ')
							BEGIN
								SET @Where = @Where + @FieldName+' >= DATEADD(DAY, '+ CONVERT(varchar(10), @DaysFromDate)+', CAST(dbo.GetBSTDate() AS Date))'
								SET @WhereDesc = @WhereDesc + @FieldName+' is more than ' + CONVERT(varchar(10), @DaysFromDate)+' days from now'
							END
							ELSE
							BEGIN
								SET @Where = @Where + ' and ' + @FieldName+' >= DATEADD(DAY, '+ CONVERT(varchar(10), @DaysFromDate)+', CAST(dbo.GetBSTDate() AS Date))'
								SET @WhereDesc = @WhereDesc + ' and ' + @FieldName+' is more than ' + CONVERT(varchar(10), @DaysFromDate)+' days from now'
							END
						END
					END
				SET @RuleCounter = @RuleCounter + 1
			END
			/*
			IF ((@AutoPickRuleReceiverTypeFK=3) and (@AutoPickRuleReceiverFK=@paramStockItemFK2))
			OR
			((@AutoPickRuleReceiverTypeFK=2) and (@AutoPickRuleReceiverFK=@DivisionFK))
			OR
			((@AutoPickRuleReceiverTypeFK=1) and (@AutoPickRuleReceiverFK=@CustomerFK))
			BEGIN
			SET @OrderBy = ' ORDER BY '+@FieldName+ ' ' +@FieldSortDirection
			END
			*/
			--if @OrderBy='ORDER BY ' 
			--BEGIN
			--	SET @OrderBy = case when @RuleLevelFK2 = -1 then 'ORDER BY BayPosition Desc' + case when CHARINDEX('Batch', @OrderBy) > 0 then '' else ', Batch ASC' end else '' end
			--END
			--ELSE
			--BEGIN
			--	Set @OrderBy = @OrderBy + case when @RuleLevelFK2 = -1 then ', BayPosition Desc' + case when CHARINDEX('Batch', @OrderBy) > 0 then '' else ', Batch ASC' end else '' end
			--END
			if @OrderBy='ORDER BY '   
			BEGIN  
				SET @OrderBy = case when @RuleLevelFK2 = -1 then 'ORDER BY BayPosition Desc' + case when CHARINDEX('Batch', @OrderBy) > 0 then '' else ', Batch ASC' end else case when @RuleLevelFK2 = 2 then ', BayPosition Desc' else '' end end  
			END  
			ELSE  
			BEGIN  
				Set @OrderBy = @OrderBy + case when @RuleLevelFK2 = -1 then ', BayPosition Desc' + case when CHARINDEX('Batch', @OrderBy) > 0 then '' else ', Batch ASC' end else case when @RuleLevelFK2 = 2 then ', BayPosition Desc' else '' end end  
			END  

			SET @Clause = @OrderBy

			if(@Where<>'WHERE ')
			BEGIN
				SET @Filter = @Where				
			END
			ELSE 
			BEGIN
				SET @Filter = ''
			END

			--spit out rules in text format for user to read
			SET @FilterDesc = case when @OrderByDesc = 'ordered by ' then ' ' else @OrderByDesc end + case when @WhereDesc = 'where ' then '. ' else ', ' + @WhereDesc + '.' end
				

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end

			--BEGIN TRY IF XACT_STATE() = 1 AND @@TRANCOUNT = 1 AND @OpeningTranCount < 1 COMMIT TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH
			
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spAutoPickRuleOrderChange]

	@autoPickRuleFK int,
	@direction int
)
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT
 ,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;
	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	DECLARE @autoPickRuleFK2 int, @direction2 int
	SET @autoPickRuleFK2 = @autoPickRuleFK; SET @direction2 = @direction

	SET @ParameterDetails = '@autoPickRuleFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@autoPickRuleFK2 AS NVARCHAR(100)),'') + ',@direction = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@direction2 AS NVARCHAR(100)),'')

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    --BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

		SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END


	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY
			IF XACT_STATE() = 0 AND @@TRANCOUNT < 1 BEGIN TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start

			Declare @receiverTypeFK int, @receiverFK int, @currentOrder int
			Select @receiverTypeFK = AutoPickRuleReceiverTypeFK, @receiverFK = AutoPickRuleReceiverFK, @currentOrder = RuleOrder
			From tblAutoPickRules where AutoPickRulePK = @autoPickRuleFK2

			if(@direction2 = 1) --UP
			BEGIN
				if(@currentOrder > 1)
				BEGIN
					update tblAutoPickRules WITH (ROWLOCK)
					Set RuleOrder = RuleOrder + 1
					Where AutoPickRulePK = 
						(
							Select Top 1 AutoPickRulePK
							From tblAutoPickRules
							Where AutoPickRuleReceiverTypeFK = @receiverTypeFK
							AND AutoPickRuleReceiverFK = @receiverFK
							AND RuleOrder < @currentOrder
							Order By RuleOrder Desc
						)

					update tblAutoPickRules WITH (ROWLOCK)
					Set RuleOrder = RuleOrder - 1
					Where AutoPickRulePK = @autoPickRuleFK2
				END		
			END
			ELSE 
			BEGIN --DOWN
				update tblAutoPickRules WITH (ROWLOCK)
				Set RuleOrder = RuleOrder - 1
				Where AutoPickRulePK = 
					(
						Select Top 1 AutoPickRulePK
						From tblAutoPickRules
						Where AutoPickRuleReceiverTypeFK = @receiverTypeFK
						AND AutoPickRuleReceiverFK = @receiverFK
						AND RuleOrder > @currentOrder
						Order By RuleOrder Asc
					)

				update tblAutoPickRules WITH (ROWLOCK)
					Set RuleOrder = RuleOrder + 1
					Where AutoPickRulePK = @autoPickRuleFK2
			END

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end

			BEGIN TRY IF XACT_STATE() = 1 AND @@TRANCOUNT = 1 AND @OpeningTranCount < 1 COMMIT TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH
			
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END

-- =============================================
