-- Modify: Damien Gannon #DEV-910 Exclude Archived Bays
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spBuildingUnitBarcodesConventionalRacking]
(
	@BuildingUnitFK int
)
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED
	 
	DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT
	,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;
	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();


    -- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	DECLARE @var_BuildingUnitFK INT

	SET @var_BuildingUnitFK = @BuildingUnitFK

	SET @ParameterDetails = '@BuildingUnitFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_BuildingUnitFK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'')

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    --BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

		SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END


	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY
			

			-- This stored procedures main code, excluding error handling - start
	
			SELECT
				BuildingUnitBayLocation as Bay, Barcode 
			FROM 
				viewbuildingunitbays 
			WHERE 
				buildingunitfk =  @var_BuildingUnitFK 
				AND IsArchived = 0		/* Damien #DEV-910 Exclude Archived Bays*/
				--AND baylevel not in ('A', 'B')
				--and row in ('i', 'j')
				--AND locationTypeFK = 1 
			ORDER BY 
				/*[Row],*/ baylevel, [row], case when locatefromleft = 0 then ColumnNo*-1 else ColumnNo end

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end

			
			
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END

-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spBuildingUnitForStockItemCodesThatExist]
(
	@divisionFK int,
	@stockItemCodes nvarchar(max)
)
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT
 ,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;
	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	DECLARE @divisionFK2 int, @stockItemCodes2 nvarchar(max)
	SET @divisionFK2 = @divisionFK; SET @stockItemCodes2 = @stockItemCodes

	SET @ParameterDetails = '@divisionFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@divisionFK2 AS NVARCHAR(100)),'') + ',@stockItemCodes = ' + ISNULL(@stockItemCodes2,'')

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

     --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    --BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

		SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END


	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY
			

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start

			/*Check if all stock items exist*/
			DECLARE @tblStockItems TABLE
			(
				StockItemCode nvarchar(200)
			)

			Insert Into @tblStockItems
			Select Item
			from dbo.fnSplitStrings_XML(@stockItemCodes2, N',')

			IF EXISTS(	
							Select * 
							from @tblStockItems tsis
							Left outer join tblStockItems sis on
							sis.StockItemCode = tsis.StockItemCode
							AND sis.DivisionFK = @divisionFK2
							WHERE sis.StockItemPK is NULL
						)							
			BEGIN
				/*We have a non existent stock item(s)*/
				Print 'Non existent stock codes'

				DECLARE @nonExistentStockItems nvarchar(max), @nonExistentStockItem nvarchar(200), @done bit

				SELECT @done = 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/, @nonExistentStockItems = '', @nonExistentStockItem = ''

				WHILE(@done = 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/) 
				BEGIN
					Select Top 1 @nonExistentStockItem = tsis.StockItemCode 
					from @tblStockItems tsis
					left outer join tblStockItems sis on
					sis.StockItemCode = tsis.StockItemCode
					AND sis.DivisionFK = @divisionFK2
					AND sis.IsArchived = 0
					WHERE sis.StockItemPK is null

					Print 'NonExistent StockItem: ' + @nonExistentStockItem

					Select @nonExistentStockItems = @nonExistentStockItems + ' ' + @nonExistentStockItem

					Delete @tblStockItems Where StockItemCode = @nonExistentStockItem

		--			Select * from @tblStockItems
		--			Return
					IF(NOT EXISTS(Select * 
									from @tblStockItems tsis
									Left outer join tblStockItems sis on
									sis.StockItemCode = tsis.StockItemCode
									AND sis.DivisionFK = @divisionFK2
									AND sis.IsArchived = 0
									WHERE sis.StockItemPK is null)) 
					BEGIN
						Print 'No more non existent stock items'
						Select @done = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/
					END
				END
		
				Select -1 BuildingUnitFK, -1 LoadingBayFK, cast(0 as bit) as AllStockItemsExist, @nonExistentStockItems AS NonExistentStockItems
				RETURN
			END

			DECLARE @stockBuildingUnits TABLE
			(
				BuildingUnitFK int,
				RuleType nvarchar(50)
			)

			INSERT into @stockBuildingUnits
			Select  
			case when sibus.StockItemFK is null then dbus.BuildingUnitFK else sibus.BuildingUnitFK end BuildingUnitFK ,
			case when sibus.StockItemFK is null then 'Division' else 'StockItem' end RuleType 
			FROM
			(Select StockItemPK, StockItemCode from tblStockItems where DivisionFK = @divisionFK2 AND IsArchived = 0) sis
			LEFT OUTER join tblStockItemBuildingUnits sibus on sibus.StockItemFK = sis.StockItemPK and sibus.IsArchived = 0
			INNER JOIN tblDivisionBuildingUnits dbus on dbus.DivisionFK = @divisionFK2 and dbus.IsArchived = 0
			--AND IsDefault=1/*cast(1 as bit)*/

			Where StockItemCode in (Select StockItemCode From @tblStockItems)

			IF((Select count(*) from (
				Select Distinct BuildingUnitFK from @stockBuildingUnits
			) subQ) = 1) BEGIN
				--Only one building unit, easy
				Print 'A1 - Only building unit listed, easy'
				Select Top 1 sBUs.BuildingUnitFK, LoadingBayPK LoadingBayFK, cast(1 as bit) as AllStockItemsExist, '' NonExistentStockItems
				From @stockBuildingUnits sBUs 
				INNER JOIN tblLoadingBays lBays on
				lBays.BuildingUnitFK = sBUs.BuildingUnitFK
			END ELSE BEGIN
				--we have more than one building unit, check if one of them uses the division BU, if an item does then we have to go with the Division BU
				IF (EXISTS(Select * from @stockBuildingUnits Where RuleType = 'Division')) BEGIN
					--OK, we have a division rule which takes precedent
					Print 'B1 - Multiple BUs but we have a division rule'
					Select Top 1 BuildingUnitFK, DefaultLoadingBayFK LoadingBayFK, cast(1 as bit) as AllStockItemsExist, '' NonExistentStockItems
					from tblDivisionBuildingUnits
					Where DivisionFK = @divisionFK2 and IsArchived=0
					Order By IsDefault desc
				END ELSE BEGIN
					--So we have more than one BU listed and no division BUs, select the BU with the most entries
					Print 'C1 - No Division BUs picked the most common StockItem BU'
					Select Top 1 subQ.BuildingUnitFK, LoadingBayPK LoadingBayFK, cast(1 as bit) as AllStockItemsExist, '' NonExistentStockItems
					From
					(
						Select BuildingUnitFK, count(*) Entries
						From @stockBuildingUnits
						Group By BuildingUnitFK
					)subQ
					INNER JOIN tblLoadingBays lBays on
					lBays.BuildingUnitFK = subQ.BuildingUnitFK
					Order By Entries DESC, BuildingUnitFK
				END
			END
			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end

			
			
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END

	@RowPK Int
)

BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data; Ensure this proc has a low impact when executed */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; 
	SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED; 
	SET DEADLOCK_PRIORITY LOW

	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data; Ensure this proc has a low impact when executed */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED; SET DEADLOCK_PRIORITY LOW

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),
			@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),
			@ParameterDetails 
			NVARCHAR(MAX),
			@ID INT,
			@DeadlockErrorRetries INT,
			@PEDID INT,
			@OpeningTranCount INT,
			@OpeningXactState INT,
			@EventLogPK INT,
			@ParentEventLogPK INT;
	
	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); 
	SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; 
	SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL

    SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

	SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)

    INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
    SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

     SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()


	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY
			BEGIN

				DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #tempBuildingUnits
				SELECT BuildingUnitPK, BuildingFK 
				INTO #tempBuildingUnits 
				FROM tblBuildingUnits tbu 
					INNER Join tblbuildingunitrows tblRows on tblRows.BuildingUnitFK = tbu.BuildingUnitPK
				WHERE tbu.IsArchived = 0 and tblRows.BuildingUnitRowPK = @RowPK

				--select * from #tempBuildingUnits
	
				--Load all Pallets To Start
				DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #TempAllPallets

				SELECT	PalletPK, palletstatusfk, palletTypeFK, pallets.BuildingUnitFK, LocationTypeFK, LocationFK, StackPosition,
						tblRows.BuildingUnitRowPK, tblBays.BuildingUnitBayPK
				INTO #TempAllPallets			
				FROM tblPallets pallets
					Inner Join tblBuildingUnits tbu on pallets.BuildingUnitFK = tbu.BuildingUnitPK
					INNER Join tblbuildingunitrows tblRows on tblRows.BuildingUnitFK = tbu.BuildingUnitPK
					inner join tblBuildingUnitColumns tblcols on tblRows.BuildingUnitRowPK = tblcols.BuildingUnitRowFK
					Inner Join tblBuildingUnitBays tblBays on tblBays.BuildingUnitBayPK = pallets.LocationFK and tblcols.BuildingUnitColumnPK = tblBays.BuildingUnitColumnFK
				WHERE	pallets.isarchived = 0 AND 
						pallets.palletstatusfk <> 10 AND 
						pallets.LocationFK = tblBays.BuildingUnitBayPK AND
						tblRows.BuildingUnitRowPK = @RowPK and tbu.IsArchived = 0 

				--select * from #TempAllPallets

				--get distinct stock item widths
				drop table if exists #tmpstockitemmargins
				select distinct palletpk, stockitempk, widthmargin into #tmpstockitemmargins
				from #TempAllPallets p
				inner join tblpalletcontent pc on p.palletpk = pc.palletfk
				inner join tblstockitems s on pc.StockItemFK = s.StockItemPK 
				where s.WidthMargin > 0
			
				--Get Unstacked pallets - these represent a single pallet location in relation to bay width
				DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #TempUnstackedPallets

				select p.palletpk, locationFK, palletTypeFK, Width+(case when swm.WidthMargin is null then pt.WidthMargin*2 else swm.WidthMargin*2 end) as Width
				into #TempUnstackedPallets
				from #TempAllPallets p
				left join #tmpstockitemmargins swm on p.PalletPK = swm.palletpk
				INNER JOIN tblpallettypes pt on pallettypefk = pallettypepk
				where locationtypefk = 1 AND stackposition = 0 
				--AND locationfk NOT IN ((SELECT tblBays.BuildingUnitBayPK
				--						  From tblScrapLocations tbScrap, 
				--							   tblBuildingUnitBays tblBays, tblBuildingUnitColumns tblColumns, tblBuildingUnitRows tblRows
				--						  Where tblBays.BuildingUnitColumnFK = tblColumns.BuildingUnitColumnPK AND
				--								tblColumns.BuildingUnitRowFK = tblRows.BuildingUnitRowPK AND
				--								tblBays.BuildingUnitBayPK = tbScrap.LocationFK AND
				--								tblRows.BuildingUnitRowPK = @RowPK)) --*ignore scrap locations*
					--select * from #TempUnstackedPallets

					--get totals of racked pallets per building unit
					DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #TempRackedPallets

					select count(distinct palletpk) NumPallets, tbu.BuildingUnitPK
					into #TempRackedPallets
					from #TempAllPallets p
						INNER JOIN tblpallettypes on pallettypefk = pallettypepk
						INNER JOIN tblBuildingUnits tbu ON p.BuildingUnitFK = tbu.BuildingUnitPK
					Where locationtypefk = 1 
					--AND locationfk NOT IN ((SELECT tblBays.BuildingUnitBayPK
					--												From tblScrapLocations tbScrap, 
					--													 tblBuildingUnitBays tblBays, tblBuildingUnitColumns tblColumns, 
					--													 tblBuildingUnitRows tblRows
					--												Where tblBays.BuildingUnitColumnFK = tblColumns.BuildingUnitColumnPK AND
					--													  tblColumns.BuildingUnitRowFK = tblRows.BuildingUnitRowPK AND
					--												      tblBays.BuildingUnitBayPK = tbScrap.LocationFK AND
					--													  tblRows.BuildingUnitRowPK = @RowPK))/*ignore scrap locations*/
					GROUP BY tbu.BuildingUnitPK
				
					--select * from #TempRackedPallets

					DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #TempBuildingUnitRowPallets
		
					SELECT  tblbuildings.BuildingPK, 
						tblUnits.BuildingUnitPK, 
						count(palletpk) as CurrentPallets, 
						Coalesce(sum(tp.Width), 0) as TotalPalletWidth, 
						tblBays.width - Coalesce(sum(tp.Width), 0) as RemainingSpace,
						case when tblBays.width - Coalesce(sum(tp.Width), 0) <= 0 then 0 else (tblBays.width - Coalesce(sum(tp.Width), 0)) / 830 end as PotentialEuroPallets,
						case when tblBays.width - Coalesce(sum(tp.Width), 0) <= 0 then 0 else (tblBays.width - Coalesce(sum(tp.Width), 0)) / 1040 end as PotentialStandardPallets,
						case when tblBays.width <= 0 then 0 else tblBays.width / 1040 end as PotentialTotalStandardPallets,
						case when tblBays.width <= 0 then 0 else tblBays.width / 830 end as PotentialTotalEuroPallets,
						tblBays.BuildingUnitBayPK 
						--tblBays.stackposition
						--tblBays.BayLevel
					into #TempBuildingUnitRowPallets
					FROM tblbuildingunitbays tblBays
						INNER JOIN tblbuildingunitcolumns tblColumns on tblBays.buildingunitcolumnfk = tblColumns.buildingunitcolumnpk
						INNER JOIN tblbuildingunitrows tblRows on tblColumns.BuildingUnitRowFK = tblRows.BuildingUnitRowPK
						INNER Join tblBuildingUnits tblUnits on tblRows.BuildingUnitFK = tblUnits.BuildingUnitPK
						INNER JOIN tblbuildings on tblbuildings.BuildingPK = tblUnits.BuildingFK
						LEFT JOIN #TempUnstackedPallets tp on tblBays.BuildingUnitBayPK = locationfk
					WHERE tblBays.width > 0 and 
						buildingpk not in (20,29, 34, 35)  AND 
						tblBays.BuildingUnitBayPK NOT IN (25143,25144,25145,25146) and
						tblBays.isarchived = 0 
						-- and tblBays.BuildingUnitBayPK NOT IN (SELECT LocationFK 
						--								From tblScrapLocations tbScrap, 
						--									 tblBuildingUnitBays tblBays, 
						--									 tblBuildingUnitColumns tblColumns,  
						--									 tblBuildingUnitRows tblRows
						--								Where tblBays.BuildingUnitColumnFK = tblColumns.BuildingUnitColumnPK AND
						--									  tblColumns.BuildingUnitRowFK = tblRows.BuildingUnitRowPK AND
						--									  tblBays.BuildingUnitBayPK = tbScrap.LocationFK AND
						--									  tblRows.BuildingUnitRowPK = @RowPK) 
						AND tblRows.BuildingUnitRowPK = @RowPK
					GROUP BY tblbuildings.BuildingPK, 
							tblUnits.BuildingUnitPK, 
							tblColumns.BuildingUnitColumnPK,
							tblRows.BuildingUnitRowPK,
							tblBays.BuildingUnitBayPK, 
							tblBays.Width


					--select * from #TempBuildingUnitRowPallets

				select	Sum(rowPallets.PotentialTotalStandardPallets) As 'StandardPalletCapacity', 
					Sum(rowPallets.PotentialTotalEuroPallets) As 'EuroPalletCapacity', 
					SUM(rowPallets.CurrentPallets) As 'CurrentNumberPalletsInRow', 
 					--(100 * SUM(rowPallets.CurrentPallets) / sum(rowPallets.PotentialTotalStandardPallets)) As 'UsedCapacity',
					cast(100.00-((CAST(sum(PotentialStandardPallets)AS float) / cast(SUM(PotentialTotalStandardPallets)AS float) )*100.00) as int)   As 'UsedCapacity',
					ISNULL(trp.NumPallets , 0) As AllPalletsInRow
				from #TempBuildingUnitRowPallets rowPallets
				left join #TempRackedPallets trp on rowPallets.BuildingUnitPK = trp.BuildingUnitPK
				group by trp.NumPallets

					BEGIN TRY IF XACT_STATE() = 1 AND @@TRANCOUNT = 1 AND @OpeningTranCount < 1 COMMIT TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName 
					END TRY 
					BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ 
					END CATCH
			END
					
			BREAK
		
		END TRY

		-- 
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END
GO

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spBuildingUnitsFromPalletContent]
(
	@palletContentPKs varchar(max)
)	
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT
 ,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;
	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	DECLARE @palletContentPKs2 varchar(max)

	SET @palletContentPKs2 = @palletContentPKs

	SET @ParameterDetails = '@palletContentPKs = ' + ISNULL(@palletContentPKs2,'')

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    --BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

		SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END


	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY
			

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start	

			/* Split the FKs and store in temp table*/
			DECLARE @palletContentFKs TABLE
			(
			  PalletContentFK int
			)
			Insert into @palletContentFKs
			Select * from dbo.SplitString(@palletContentPKs2)


			SELECT * from (
							SELECT pallets.BuildingUnitFK BuildingUnitPK,
							buildings.BuildingName + ' - ' + buildingUnits.BuildingUnit AS BuildingUnit			 
							FROM 
							(Select * from @palletContentFKs 
							where PalletContentFK > 0) AS selPc /*Selected PalletContent*/
							INNER JOIN tblPalletContent AS pc on
							pc.PalletContentPK = selPc.PalletContentFK

							inner join tblPallets AS pallets on
							pallets.PalletPK = pc.PalletFK
							--AND pallets.IsArchived = 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/

							inner join tblBuildingUnits AS buildingUnits on
							buildingUnits.BuildingUnitPK = pallets.BuildingUnitFK

							inner join tblBuildings AS buildings on
							buildings.BuildingPK = buildingUnits.BuildingFK

						) AS subQ
			Group By 
				BuildingUnitPK, BuildingUnit
	
			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end

			
			
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spBuildingUnitUsers]  
(  
 @BuildingUnitFK int  
)  
AS  
BEGIN  
 /* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */  
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED  
  
    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT  
 ,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;  
 SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();  
  
 -- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters  
 DECLARE @BuildingUnitFK2 INT  
  
 SET @BuildingUnitFK2 = @BuildingUnitFK  
  
 SET @ParameterDetails = '@BuildingUnitFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@BuildingUnitFK2 AS NVARCHAR(20)),'')  
  
    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL   
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)  
  
    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)  
    --BEGIN  
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC   
  
  SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)  
  
        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)  
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK  
  
        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()  
    --END  
  
  
 SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);  
 SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails  
 ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;  
 INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()  
  
 WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3  
 BEGIN   
  BEGIN TRY  
     
  
   -- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start  
  
   -- Insert statements for procedure here  
   Select userpk, userbuildingunitpk,  
   case when ubus.userbuildingunitpk is null then cast(0 as bit) else cast(1 as bit) end as isChecked,  
   p.firstname + ' ' + p.lastname as [User]  
   from tblusers u   
   inner join tblpeople p on p.personpk = u.personfk  
   left outer join tbluserbuildingunits ubus on u.userpk = ubus.userfk and uBus.BuildingUnitFK = @BuildingUnitFK2  
   inner join AspNetUsers mem on u.AspNetUserID = mem.Id  
   where u.IsArchived = 0 and u.UserTypeFK=1 and mem.EmailConfirmed = 1 
   --inner join aspnet_Membership mem on u.AspNetUserID = mem.UserId  
   --where u.IsArchived = 0 and u.UserTypeFK=1 and mem.IsApproved = 1  
   Order By [User]  
  
   -- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end  
  
     
     
   BREAK  
  END TRY  
  BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */  
   DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;  
   SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;  
   SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;  
  
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY   
   BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;  
         
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;  
  
            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID  
              
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;  
              
   IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)  
   BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END  
   ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */  
  END CATCH  
  SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1  
 END  
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spCanArchiveTMSData] --EXEC dbo.spCanArchiveTMSData '20190201', 11
(
	@workDate DATE,
	@buildingPK INT
)
AS
BEGIN
	DECLARE @varWorkDate DATETIME = @WorkDate, @varBuildingPK INT = @BuildingPK

	DECLARE @varArchivedWorkDate DATETIME, @varArchivedWorkDay CHAR(3), @varDuration INT = 1, @varDiff INT

	IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#Date') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #Date

	CREATE TABLE #Date(LastArchivedWorkDate DATE)

	INSERT INTO #Date
	EXEC dbo.spGetTMSWorkDateOfMostRecentArchivedBuildingData @varBuildingPK

	IF (NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #Date) OR (SELECT LastArchivedWorkDate FROM #Date) = '')
	BEGIN
		SELECT 1 AS CanArchive, 0 AS NoOfDaysFromLastArchive
		RETURN 0
	END

	SELECT @varArchivedWorkDate = CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), LastArchivedWorkDate, 103) FROM #Date

	SELECT @varArchivedWorkDay = FORMAT(@varArchivedWorkDate, 'ddd')

	IF @varArchivedWorkDay = 'Sat' SET @varDuration = 2

	SELECT @varDiff = DATEDIFF(DAY, @varArchivedWorkDate, @varWorkDate)

	IF @varDiff <> @varDuration
		SELECT 0 AS CanArchive, @varDiff AS NoOfDaysFromLastArchive
	ELSE
		SELECT 1 AS CanArchive, @varDiff AS NoOfDaysFromLastArchive
END


GO

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spChargesCreateHandlingCharge]
(
	@stockInPK int, @stockOrderPK int, @stockItemPK int, @handlingInCharge decimal(18,3), @handlingInEachesTypeFK int, @handlingInUnitTypeFK int, 
	@handlingInEachesNumber decimal(18,3), @handlingInUnitsNumber decimal(18,3),
	@pallets decimal(18,3), @eaches decimal(18,3), @units decimal(18,3), @eachesTypeFK int, @unitTypeFK int, @eachesType nvarchar(200), @unitType nvarchar(200)
)
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT
 ,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;
	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	DECLARE @stockInPK2 int, @stockOrderPK2 int, @stockItemPK2 int, @handlingInCharge2 decimal(18,3), @handlingInEachesTypeFK2 int, @handlingInUnitTypeFK2 int, 
	@handlingInEachesNumber2 decimal(18,3), @handlingInUnitsNumber2 decimal(18,3),
	@pallets2 decimal(18,3), @eaches2 decimal(18,3), @units2 decimal(18,3), @eachesTypeFK2 int, @unitTypeFK2 int, @eachesType2 nvarchar(200), @unitType2 nvarchar(200)

	SET @stockInPK2 = @stockInPK; SET @stockOrderPK2 = @stockOrderPK; SET @stockItemPK2 = @stockItemPK; SET @handlingInCharge2 = @handlingInCharge
	SET @handlingInEachesTypeFK2 = @handlingInEachesTypeFK; SET @handlingInUnitTypeFK2 = @handlingInUnitTypeFK; SET @handlingInEachesNumber2 = @handlingInEachesNumber
	SET @handlingInUnitsNumber2 = @handlingInUnitsNumber; SET @pallets2 = @pallets; SET @eaches2 = @eaches; SET @units2 = @units; SET @eachesTypeFK2 = @eachesTypeFK
	SET @unitTypeFK2 = @unitTypeFK; SET @eachesType2 = @eachesType; SET @unitType2 = @unitType

	SET @ParameterDetails = '@stockInPK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@stockInPK2 AS NVARCHAR(20)),'')
		+ ',@stockOrderPK, = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@stockOrderPK2 AS NVARCHAR(20)),'') + ',@stockItemPK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@stockItemPK2 AS NVARCHAR(20)),'')
				+ ',@handlingInCharge, = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@handlingInCharge2 AS NVARCHAR(20)),'')
					+ ',@handlingInEachesTypeFK, = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@handlingInEachesTypeFK2 AS NVARCHAR(20)),'')
						+ ',@handlingInUnitTypeFK, = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@handlingInUnitTypeFK2 AS NVARCHAR(20)),'')
							+ ',@handlingInEachesNumber, = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@handlingInEachesNumber2 AS NVARCHAR(20)),'')
								+ ',@handlingInUnitsNumber, = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@handlingInUnitsNumber2 AS NVARCHAR(20)),'')
									+ ',@pallets, = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@pallets2 AS NVARCHAR(20)),'') + ',@eaches = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@eaches2 AS NVARCHAR(20)),'')
										+ ',@units, = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@units2 AS NVARCHAR(20)),'') + ',@eachesTypeFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@eachesTypeFK2 AS NVARCHAR(20)),'')
											+ ',@unitTypeFK, = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@unitTypeFK2 AS NVARCHAR(20)),'') + ',@eachesType = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@eachesType2 AS NVARCHAR(20)),'')
												+ ',@unitType, = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@unitType2 AS NVARCHAR(20)),'')

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    --BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

		SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END


	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY
			IF XACT_STATE() = 0 AND @@TRANCOUNT < 1 BEGIN TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start

			Declare @divisionFK int

			Set @divisionFK = (Select DivisionFK from tblStockItems where StockItemPK = @stockItemPK2)

			-- Insert statements for procedure here
			Declare @charge decimal(18,3), @description nvarchar(1000)

			IF @handlingInEachesTypeFK2 > 0
			BEGIN
				Set @charge = (@eaches2 / @handlingInEachesNumber2) * @handlingInCharge2 
				Set @description = 'Handling for ' + cast(@eaches2 as nvarchar(50)) + ' ' + @eachesType2
			END
			ELSE IF @handlingInUnitTypeFK2 > 0
			BEGIN
				Print @units2
				Print @handlingInUnitsNumber2
				Print @handlingInCharge2

				Set @charge = (@units2 / @handlingInUnitsNumber2) * @handlingInCharge2 
				Set @description = 'Handling for ' + cast(@units2 as nvarchar(50)) + ' ' + @unitType2
			END
			ELSE
			BEGIN
				Set @charge = @pallets2 * @handlingInCharge2
				Set @description = 'Handling for ' + cast(@pallets2 as nvarchar(50)) + ' Pallets'
			END

			if @charge = 0 
			BEGIN
				ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName
				return
			END

			insert into tblCharges
			values
			(-1/*this has not come from a works order*/, @stockInPK2, @stockOrderPK2, @divisionFK, @stockItemPK2, @charge, @description,
			0/*cast(0 as bit)*/, 1, dbo.GetBSTDate(), 1, dbo.GetBSTDate())

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end

			BEGIN TRY IF XACT_STATE() = 1 AND @@TRANCOUNT = 1 AND @OpeningTranCount < 1 COMMIT TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH
			
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END

/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[spCheckDuplicateBarcodeForStockIn]    Script Date: 02/11/2026 17:47:26 ******/

-- =============================================
-- Author:  <Archana>
-- Create date: <04-12-2025>
-- Description:
--  Checks if any pallet barcode from the incoming StockIn exists on other active pallets in WMS.
--  Returns:
--    ResultSet 1: HasDuplicate (1 or 0)
--    ResultSet 2: DuplicateBarcode (one row per offending barcode)
-- =============================================

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spCheckDuplicateBarcodeForStockIn]
(
    @StockInFK INT
)
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON; 
    SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED;

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),
            @ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),
            @ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),
            @ID INT,
            @DeadlockErrorRetries INT,
            @PEDID INT,
            @OpeningTranCount INT,
            @OpeningXactState INT,
            @EventLogPK INT,
            @ParentEventLogPK INT;

    SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID);
    SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; 
    SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; 
    SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

    -- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
    DECLARE @var_stockInFK INT;
    SET @var_stockInFK = @StockInFK;

    SET @ParameterDetails = '@StockInFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_stockInFK AS NVARCHAR(20)),'');

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL
        CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(
            [ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),
            ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),
            ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),
            EventLogFK INT,
            HasException BIT
        );

    SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK 
    FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC;

    SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1);

    INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog](
        [EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],
        [Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],
        [State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK
    )
    SELECT 'Database', dbo.GetBSTDate(), @@SERVERNAME, UPPER(DB_NAME()), -1, '', 'Azure', 'dbo', 
           @ThisProcedureName, 'Exec', 'Success', 
           'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, 
           @ParentEventLogPK;

    SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY();

    SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);    
    SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails    
    ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;    
    INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()    

    WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
    BEGIN
        BEGIN TRY
            
             -- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start    
            -- Main duplicate check logic
            -- - Build #NewPallets (incoming pallets + barcodes)
            -- - Build #Conflicts: union of
            --     a) barcodes duplicated within the incoming StockIn
            --     b) barcodes present on other active pallets (OnRoute = 0)
           
           IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#NewPallets') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #NewPallets;
           IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#Conflicts') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #Conflicts;

            SELECT DISTINCT
                silps.PalletFK,
                pals.CustomerBarcode
            INTO #NewPallets
            FROM dbo.tblStockInLines sils
            INNER JOIN dbo.tblStockInLinePallets silps ON silps.StockInLineFK = sils.StockInLinePK
            INNER JOIN dbo.tblPallets pals ON pals.PalletPK = silps.PalletFK
            WHERE sils.StockInFK = @var_stockInFK
              AND ISNULL(pals.CustomerBarcode, '') <> '';

            CREATE TABLE #Conflicts (DuplicateBarcode NVARCHAR(200) NOT NULL);
           
           -- Duplicates inside the same StockIn
            INSERT INTO #Conflicts(DuplicateBarcode)
            SELECT DISTINCT CustomerBarcode
            FROM #NewPallets
            GROUP BY CustomerBarcode
            HAVING COUNT(*) > 1;

            -- Duplicates against other active pallets in WMS
            INSERT INTO #Conflicts(DuplicateBarcode)
            SELECT DISTINCT p.CustomerBarcode
            FROM dbo.tblPallets p
            INNER JOIN #NewPallets np ON np.CustomerBarcode = p.CustomerBarcode
            WHERE p.PalletPK NOT IN (SELECT PalletFK FROM #NewPallets)
              AND ISNULL(p.OnRoute, 0) = 0
              AND ISNULL(p.CustomerBarcode, '') <> '';
           
          -- Remove potential duplicates in #Conflicts (if inserted twice)
            ;WITH cte AS (
                SELECT DuplicateBarcode, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY DuplicateBarcode ORDER BY DuplicateBarcode) AS rn
                FROM #Conflicts
            )
            DELETE FROM cte WHERE rn > 1;

            DECLARE @confCount INT = (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM #Conflicts);

            -- Result set 1: HasDuplicate
            SELECT CASE WHEN @confCount > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS HasDuplicate;

            -- Result set 2: list of offending barcodes (may be empty)
            SELECT DuplicateBarcode FROM #Conflicts ORDER BY DuplicateBarcode;

            BREAK; -- exit retry loop after successful execution

        END TRY
        BEGIN CATCH           
            DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME,
                    @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX),
                    @ErrorSeverity INT,
                    @ErrorState INT,
                    @XactState INT,
                    @TranCount INT,
                    @FullRollBackDone BIT;

            SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();
            SET @ErrorDateTime = dbo.GetBSTDate();
            SET @ErrorSeverity = ERROR_SEVERITY();
            SET @ErrorState = ERROR_STATE();
            SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
            SET @XactState = XACT_STATE();
            SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

            BEGIN TRY
                IF @XactState = -1 
                BEGIN 
                    ROLLBACK; 
                    SET @FullRollBackDone = 1; 
                END
                ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 
                    ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName
            END TRY
            BEGIN CATCH
                -- ignore
            END CATCH

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) 
                UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) 
                SET HasException = 1 
                WHERE [ID] = @PEDID;

            IF @PEDID = 1 
                EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails, @ErrorDateTime, @ExecutionPath, @ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;

            IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 
                OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
            BEGIN 
                SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; 
                RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); 
                RETURN; 
            END
            ELSE 
                WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00.500'; -- Retry after deadlock
        END CATCH;

        SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1;
    END
END
GO

 @ContainerInFK int ,        
 @StockItemFK int ,

AS        
BEGIN        
 /* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */        
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED        
        
    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT

 -- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters        
 DECLARE @var_ContainerInFK nvarchar(200), @var_StockItemFK int, @var_SupplierBatch nvarchar(20)

  SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)

 SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);

 INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()        
        
 WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3        
 BEGIN         
  BEGIN TRY        
          
   -- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start      
   
   Declare @divisionfk int
 --  @divisionfk = (select top 1 divisionfk from tblstockins where containerinfk = @var_ContainerInFK);
 set @divisionfk =   (select divisionfk from tblstockins where containerinfk = @var_ContainerInFK)
 print @divisionfk
   if (@divisionfk = 811) ---BalleyRagget
   begin
   select '0' as batch
   end

   else
   begin 
    IF (EXISTS(select batch from tblstockins       
  inner join tblstockinlines stl on stockinpk = stockinfk       
  where containerinfk = @var_ContainerInFK and stockitemfk = @var_StockItemFK       
  and supplierBatch = @var_SupplierBatch and batch <>  '0'))       
  BEGIN

  WHERE containerinfk = @var_ContainerInFK and stockitemfk = @var_StockItemFK       
  and supplierBatch = @var_SupplierBatch and batch <>  '0'       
  order by stl.inserteddate END ELSE BEGIN Select 0 END 
   end
      
        
   -- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end           
           
   BREAK        
  END TRY        
  BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */        
   DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;        
   SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;       SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;        
        
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY         
   BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;        
               
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;        
        
            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID        
                    
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;        
                    
   IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)        
   BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END        
   ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */        
  END CATCH        
  SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1        
 END

-- =============================================
-- Author:      <Author, , Name>
-- Create Date: <Create Date, , >
-- Description: <Description, , >
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spCheckStockOutsAndOrdersByContainer]
(	
	@ContainerInFK int
)
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data; Ensure this proc has a low impact when executed */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED; SET DEADLOCK_PRIORITY LOW

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT
	,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;
	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	DECLARE @ContainerInFK2 int
	--DECLARE @invoiceTypeFK2 int

	SET @ContainerInFK2 = @ContainerInFK
	--SET @invoiceTypeFK2 = @invoiceTypeFK

	SET @ParameterDetails = '@ContainerInFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@ContainerInFK2 AS NVARCHAR(20)),'')

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    --BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

		SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK,-1)

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END

	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY
			

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start
				drop table if exists #tmpstockinpallets
				Select PalletFK into #tmpstockinpallets
				from tblStockInLinePallets silps 
				inner join tblStockInLines sils on sils.StockInLinePK = silps.StockInLineFK 
				inner join tblStockIns sins on sins.StockInPK = sils.StockInFK 
				Where sins.ContainerInFK = @ContainerInFK2

			if((
				Select count(*) 
				from tblPalletAudit pa 
				inner join #tmpstockinpallets silp on pa.palletfk= silp.palletfk
				where EventTypeFK in (2, 3)) > 0)
			begin
				select 1
			end
			else 
			begin
				if((
					SELECT COUNT(*)
					FROM tblContainerOutLinePalletContent colpc
					INNER JOIN tblContainerOutLines cols ON cols.ContainerOutLinePK = colpc.ContainerOutLineFK
					INNER JOIN tblContainerOuts cOuts ON cOuts.ContainerOutPK = cols.ContainerOutFK
					inner join #tmpstockinpallets silp on colpc.palletfk= silp.palletfk
					WHERE cOuts.ContainerOutStatusFK <> 6 ) > 0)
				begin
					select 1
				end
				else
				begin
					select 0
				end
			end
		
		
			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end



			
			
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END

-- =============================================
-- Author:		DeVille
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	Make a complete copy/version of a container in
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spContainerInChangeBuildingUnit]
(
	@containerInFK int = -1,
	@buildingUnitFK int = -1,
    @loadingBayBarcode nvarchar (100) = '',
    @stockInFK int = -1
) 
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT
	,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;
	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	DECLARE @containerInFK2 int, @buildingUnitFK2 int, @loadingBayBarcode2 nvarchar (100), @stockInFK2 int
	SET @containerInFK2 = @containerInFK; SET @buildingUnitFK2 = @buildingUnitFK; SET @loadingBayBarcode2 = @loadingBayBarcode; SET @stockInFK2 = @stockInFK

	SET @ParameterDetails = '@containerInFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@containerInFK2 AS NVARCHAR(20)),'') + ',@buildingUnitFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@buildingUnitFK2 AS NVARCHAR(20)),'')
		+ ',@loadingBayBarcode = ' + ISNULL(@loadingBayBarcode2,'') + ',@stockInFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@stockInFK2 AS NVARCHAR(20)),'')

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    --BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

		SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END

	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start

			DECLARE @LoadingBayFK int

			-- Get the containerFK if the stockInFK has been sent in
			if (@containerInFK2 = -1)
			BEGIN
				SELECT @containerInFK2 = containerInFK 
				FROM tblStockIns 
				WHERE stockInPK = @stockInFK

				If (@containerInFK2 is null)
				BEGIN 
					SELECT returnstatus = 2
					RETURN 
				END
			END 

			-- check if a loading baybarcode has been sent in
			IF (LEN(@loadingBayBarcode2) > 0)
			BEGIN
				SELECT @LoadingBayFK = loadingBayPk,
					   @BuildingUnitFK2 = buildingUnitFK
				  FROM tblLoadingBays
				 WHERE barcode = @LoadingBayBarcode2

			   -- check if the barcode is assigned to a loading bay
				if (@LoadingBayFK is null)
				BEGIN
					SELECT returnstatus = 2
					RETURN 
				END
				ELSE
				BEGIN
					IF XACT_STATE() = 0 AND @@TRANCOUNT < 1 BEGIN TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName

					-- Update the Container table to the new loadingbay and building unit
					UPDATE tblContainerIns WITH (ROWLOCK)
					   SET BuildingUnitFK = @buildingUnitFK2,
						   LoadingBayFK = @loadingBayFK
					  WHERE ContainerInPK = @containerInFk2
				END 
			END

			IF(NOT EXISTS(Select * 
					from tblWorksOrderMovements 
					where PalletFK in (
						Select PalletFK 
						from tblStockInLinePallets silps 
						inner join tblStockInLines sils on 
						sils.StockInLinePK = silps.StockInLineFK 
						inner join tblStockIns sins on 
						sins.StockInPK = sils.StockInFK 
						Where sins.ContainerInFK = @containerInFK2))) 
			BEGIN
				/*********** ACTION TO BE TAKEN *************/
				--Declare @loadingBayFK int 

				if (@LoadingBayFK is null)
				BEGIN
        			Select Top 1 @loadingBayFK = LoadingBayPK
					from tblLoadingBays
					Where BuildingUnitFK = @buildingUnitFK2
					Order By LoadingBayPK ASC
				END
         
		--		Set BuildingUnitFK = @buildingUnitFK,
		--		LocationTypeFK = 2/*LoadingBay*/,
		--		LocationFK = @loadingBayFK
		--		Where PalletPK in (
		--			Select pals.PalletPK
		--			from tblPallets pals 
		--			inner join tblPalletContent pc on
		--			pc.PalletFK = pals.PalletPK
		--			where
		--			PalletPK in (
		--				Select PalletFK from tblStockInLinePallets
		--				Where StockInLineFK in (
		--					Select StockInLinePK from tblStockInLines
		--					Where StockInFK in (
		--						Select StockInPK from tblStockIns
		--						Where ContainerInFK = @containerInFK
		--					)
		--				)
		--			)

				if exists (Select PalletFK from tblStockIns stk 
						INNER JOIN tblStockInLines stkL ON stkL.stockInFK = stk.StockInPk
						INNER JOIN tblStockInLinePallets stPl ON stPl.stockInLineFK = stkL.STockInLinePK
						INNER JOIN tblPallets tPal ON tPal.palletpk = stPl.palletFK
						WHERE stk.ContainerInFK = @ContainerInFK2
						  AND tpal.palletStatusFK <> 10)
				-- pallets in the warehouse
				BEGIN 
					IF XACT_STATE() = 0 AND @@TRANCOUNT < 1 BEGIN TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName

					UPDATE tblPallets WITH (ROWLOCK)
					Set BuildingUnitFK = @buildingUnitFK2,
					LocationTypeFK = 2/*LoadingBay*/,
					LocationFK = @loadingBayFK
					where
						PalletPK in (
							Select PalletFK from tblStockIns stk 
								INNER JOIN tblStockInLines stkL ON stkL.stockInFK = stk.StockInPk
								INNER JOIN tblStockInLinePallets stPl ON stPl.stockInLineFK = stkL.STockInLinePK
								INNER JOIN tblPallets tPal ON tPal.palletpk = stPl.palletFK
							WHERE stk.ContainerInFK = @ContainerInFK2
							  AND tpal.palletStatusFK = 10	)
				END
				ELSE
				BEGIN
					IF XACT_STATE() = 0 AND @@TRANCOUNT < 1 BEGIN TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName

					-- pallets in the container - only change the buildingunit
					UPDATE tblPallets WITH (ROWLOCK)
					Set BuildingUnitFK = @buildingUnitFK2			
					where
						PalletPK in (
							Select PalletFK from tblStockIns stk 
								INNER JOIN tblStockInLines stkL ON stkL.stockInFK = stk.StockInPk
								INNER JOIN tblStockInLinePallets stPl ON stPl.stockInLineFK = stkL.STockInLinePK
								INNER JOIN tblPallets tPal ON tPal.palletpk = stPl.palletFK
							WHERE stk.ContainerInFK = @ContainerInFK2
							  AND tpal.palletStatusFK = 10	)
				END
			
	   			SELECT returnstatus = 1
			END

			BEGIN TRY IF XACT_STATE() = 1 AND @@TRANCOUNT = 1 AND @OpeningTranCount < 1 COMMIT TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH

			RETURN 

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end
						
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END

			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END

	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY
			IF XACT_STATE() = 0 AND @@TRANCOUNT < 1 BEGIN TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start

			Declare @containerInVersionPK int

			--ContainerIn
			insert into tblContainerInVersions
			Select ContainerInPK, 
			dbo.GetBSTDate(),
			StockInStatusFK, SupplierFK, BuildingUnitFK, LoadingBayFK, TransportCompanyFK,
			ShippingCompanyFK, VersionNumber, DateIn, EstimatedArrivalDate, ShippedDate, InceptionDate,
			GoodsInNumber, LorryNumber, SealNumber, ContainerNumber, ExternalReference,
			Free1, Free2, Free3, Free4, Free5,
			IsArchived, InsertedBy, InsertedDate, UpdatedBy, UpdatedDate
			From tblContainerIns where ContainerInPK = @containerInFK2

			Set @containerInVersionPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY() 
			--StockIn

			Declare @stockInFK int
			Declare @stockInVersionPK int
			DECLARE sins CURSOR FAST_FORWARD FOR
			SELECT StockInPK from tblStockIns where ContainerInFK = @containerInFK2
			OPEN sins
			FETCH NEXT FROM sins INTO @stockInFK
			
			WHILE(@@FETCH_STATUS = 0) 
			BEGIN
				Insert into tblStockInVersions
				Select @containerInVersionPK,
				StockInStatusFK, DivisionFK, GoodsInNumber, CheckedAndReceivedBy, CheckedAndReceivedDate,
				IsArchived, InsertedBy, InsertedDate, UpdatedBy, UpdatedDate, ArrivalRecordedBy, ArrivalDate, GoodsReceiptSent
				from tblStockIns where StockInPK = @stockInFK

				Set @stockInVersionPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY() 

				Insert into tblStockInLineVersions
				Select @stockInVersionPK, StockItemFK, PalletTypeFK, SetDownAreaFK, SpecialStockTypeFK,
				Batch, Pallets, EachUnits, Eaches, Units, ExpiryDate, DateOfManufacture, BestBefore,
				DateOfReceipt, ExtraDetails, IsMixedPallet, 
				Free1, Free2, Free3, Free4, Free5,
				IsArchived, InsertedBy, InsertedDate, UpdatedBy, UpdatedDate, PalletStatusFK, SupplierBatch, CustomerPalletNumber, CustomerBarcode
				From tblStockInLines where StockInFK = @stockInFK

				FETCH NEXT FROM sins INTO @stockInFK
			END

			CLOSE sins
			DEALLOCATE sins

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end

			BEGIN TRY IF XACT_STATE() = 1 AND @@TRANCOUNT = 1 AND @OpeningTranCount < 1 COMMIT TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH
			
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END
