CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spContainerOutDistributionCharges]
(
	@containerOutFK int
)
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT
 ,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;
	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	DECLARE @containerOutFK2 INT
	
	SET  @containerOutFK2 = @containerOutFK

	SET @ParameterDetails = '@containerOutFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@containerOutFK2 AS NVARCHAR(20)),'')

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    --BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

		SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END


	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY
			

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start

			Declare @divisionFK int
			Set @divisionFK = (Select top 1 DivisionFK from tblContainerOutLines where ContainerOutFK = @containerOutFK2)

			Declare @totalUnits int
			Set @totalUnits = (Select sum(Units) from tblContainerOutLines where ContainerOutFK = @containerOutFK2)

			Select 'Order Charges' as ChargeType, 1 as DistributionChargeTypeFK, DistributionOrderChargeTypePK as DistributionChargeFK, 
			divOrderCharges.DivisionDistributionOrderChargePK ChargeNameID, DistributionOrderChargeType as ChargeName, Charge, cast(0 as bit) as IsVariableCharge, orderCharges.IsDefaulted
			From tblDivisionDistributionOrderCharges divOrderCharges
			inner join tblDistributionOrderChargeTypes orderCharges on
			orderCharges.DistributionOrderChargeTypePK = divOrderCharges.DistributionOrderChargeTypeFK
			Where divOrderCharges.DivisionFK = @divisionFK
			AND (divOrderCharges.DivisionDistributionOrderChargePK = (Select top 1 DivisionDistributionOrderChargePK 
			from tblDivisionDistributionOrderCharges subDivOrderCharges2 where subDivOrderCharges2.DivisionFK = @divisionFK 
			AND subDivOrderCharges2.DistributionOrderChargeTypeFK = divOrderCharges.DistributionOrderChargeTypeFK and subDivOrderCharges2.BreakQuantity <= @totalUnits 
			Order By subDivOrderCharges2.BreakQuantity desc ))
			union
			Select 'Packaging Charges' as ChargeType, 2 as DistributionChargeTypeFK, DistributionPackagingTypePK as DistributionChargeFK, 
			divPackagingCharges.DivisionDistributionPackagingTypePK ChargeNameID, DistributionPackagingType as ChargeName, Charge, cast(0 as bit) as IsVariableCharge, 
			cast(0 as bit) as IsDefaulted
			From tblDivisionDistributionPackagingTypes divPackagingCharges
			inner join tblDistributionPackagingTypes packagingTypes on
			packagingTypes.DistributionPackagingTypePK = divPackagingCharges.DistributionPackagingTypeFK
			Where divPackagingCharges.DivisionFK = @divisionFK
			union
			Select 'Shipping Charges' as ChargeType, 3 as DistributionChargeTypeFK, DistributionShippingChargeTypePK as DistributionChargeFK, 
			divShippingCharges.DivisionDistributionShippingChargePK ChargeNameID, DistributionShippingChargeType as ChargeName, Charge, shippingChargeTypes.IsVariableCharge, 
			cast(0 as bit) as IsDefaulted
			From tblDivisionDistributionShippingCharges divShippingCharges
			inner join tblDistributionShippingChargeTypes shippingChargeTypes on
			shippingChargeTypes.DistributionShippingChargeTypePK = divShippingCharges.DistributionShippingChargeTypeFK
			Where divShippingCharges.DivisionFK = @divisionFK
			union
			Select 'Timed Delivery Charges' as ChargeType, 4 as DistributionChargeTypeFK, DistributionTimedDeliveryTypePK as DistributionChargeFK, 
			divTimedDeliveryCharges.DivisionDistributionTimedDeliveryChargePK ChargeNameID, DistributionTimedDeliveryType as ChargeName, Charge, 
			timedDeliveryTypes.IsVariableCharge, cast(0 as bit) as IsDefaulted
			From tblDivisionDistributionTimedDeliveryCharges divTimedDeliveryCharges
			inner join tblDistributionTimedDeliveryTypes timedDeliveryTypes on
			timedDeliveryTypes.DistributionTimedDeliveryTypePK = divTimedDeliveryCharges.DistributionTimedDeliveryTypeFK
			Where divTimedDeliveryCharges.DivisionFK = @divisionFK

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end

			
			
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END

-- =============================================  
-- Author:  <Jamie Clerkin>  
-- Create date: <19/07/2016>  
-- Description: <Get all completed stock ins that contain stock for list of given stock items, where stock is still present in warehouse>  
-- =============================================  
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spContainerOutGetDocketReference]  
(  
 @ContainerOutPk int  
)  
AS  
BEGIN  
 /* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */  
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED  
  
    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT  
 ,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;  
 SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();  
  
 DECLARE @containerOutPK2 INT  
  
 SET @containerOutPK2 = @ContainerOutPk  
  
 SET @ParameterDetails = '@ContainerOutPk = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@containerOutPK2 AS NVARCHAR(20)),'')  
  
    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL   
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)  
  
    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)  
    --BEGIN  
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC   
  
  SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)  
  
        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)  
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK  
  
        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()  
    --END  
  
  
 SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);  
 SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails  
 ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;  
 INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()  
  
 WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3  
 BEGIN   
  BEGIN TRY  
     
  
   -- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start  
  
   select  top 1 
     case when cdis.CustomerDocketIdentificationPK is null or divs.Integrated = 0 THEN
        CASE 
            WHEN containerOuts.DocketLabel1 IS NOT NULL 
                THEN containerOuts.DocketLabel1 + ' ' + containerOuts.DocketValue1
            
            WHEN containerOuts.DocketLabel2 IS NOT NULL 
                THEN containerOuts.DocketLabel2 + ' ' + containerOuts.DocketValue2
            
            WHEN containerOuts.DocketLabel3 IS NOT NULL 
                THEN containerOuts.DocketLabel3 + ' ' + containerOuts.DocketValue3
            
            ELSE ''
        END
    else  
     case cdis.FieldFK when 1 then  
      cdis.Prefix + ' ' + containerOuts.Free1  
     when 2 then  
      cdis.Prefix + ' ' + containerOuts.Free2  
     when 3 then  
      cdis.Prefix + ' ' + containerOuts.Free3  
     end  
     + ' ' +  
     case cdis.Field2FK when 1 then  
      cdis.Prefix2 + ' ' + containerOuts.Free1  
     when 2 then  
      cdis.Prefix2 + ' ' + containerOuts.Free2  
     when 3 then  
      cdis.Prefix2 + ' ' + containerOuts.Free3  
     else   
      ''  
     end  
    End as Reference  
  
   FROM dbo.tblContainerOuts containerOuts  
  inner join tblContainerOutLines col on col.ContainerOutFK = containerOuts.ContainerOutPK  
   inner join tblDivisions divs on divs.DivisionPK = col.DivisionFK  
   left outer join tblCustomerDocketIdentifications cdis on cdis.CustomerFK = divs.CustomerFK AND cdis.DocketTypeFK = 2 /*ContainerOut*/  
   where containerOuts.ContainerOutPK = @containerOutPK2  
  
   -- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end  
  
     
     
   BREAK  
  END TRY  
  BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */  
   DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;  
   SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;  
   SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;  
  
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY   
   BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;  
         
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;  
  
            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID  
              
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;  
              
   IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)  
   BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END  
   ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */  
  END CATCH  
  SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1  
 END  
END

-- =============================================

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spContainerOutLinesForEdit] 
(
	@containerOutFK int
)
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT
 ,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;
	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	DECLARE @containerOutFK2 INT
	
	SET  @containerOutFK2 = @containerOutFK

	SET @ParameterDetails = '@containerOutFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@containerOutFK2 AS NVARCHAR(20)),'')

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    --BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

		SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END


	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY
			

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start

			-- Insert statements for procedure here
			Select ContainerOutLinePK, 
			cols.DivisionFK, 
			divs.DivisionCode + ' - ' + divs.DivisionName Division, 
			cols.StockItemFK, 
			sis.StockItemCode, 
			cols.Batch, 
			cols.Pallets, 
			case when cols.Eaches = 0 then '' else cast(cols.Eaches as nvarchar(100)) End as Eaches, 
			case when cols.Units = 0 then '' else cast(cols.Units as nvarchar(100)) End as Units ,
			dbo.fnContainerOutLinePalletContent(ContainerOutLinePK) as PalletContent,
			dbo.fnContainerOutLinePalletContentUnits(ContainerOutLinePK) as PalletContentUnits
			from tblContainerOutLines cols 
			inner join tblDivisions divs on 
			divs.DivisionPK = cols.DivisionFK 
			inner join tblStockItems sis on 
			sis.StockItemPK = cols.StockItemFK 
			Where ContainerOutFK = @containerOutFK2

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end

			
			
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spContainerOutLinesForStockOrderBuildingUnit]
(
	@buildingUnitFK int,
	@containerOutFK int
)	
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT
 ,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;
	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	DECLARE @buildingUnitFK2 int, @containerOutFK2 int

	SET @buildingUnitFK2 = @buildingUnitFK; SET @containerOutFK2 = @containerOutFK

	SET @ParameterDetails = '@buildingUnitFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@buildingUnitFK2 AS NVARCHAR(20)),'') + ',@containerOutFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@containerOutFK2 AS NVARCHAR(20)),'')

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    --BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

		SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END


	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY			
			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start
			SELECT distinct ContainerOutLinePK 
			FROM dbo.tblContainerOutLines cols
			inner join tblContainerOuts cOuts ON cOuts.ContainerOutPK = cols.ContainerOutFK
			inner join tblContainerOutLinePalletContent colpc on colpc.ContainerOutLineFK = cols.ContainerOutLinePK
			left outer join tblPalletContent palletContent ON palletContent.PalletContentPK = colpc.PalletContentFK
			left outer join tblPallets pallets ON pallets.PalletPK = palletContent.PalletFK 
			left OUTER JOIN viewPalletLocations palletLocation ON palletLocation.palletPK = Pallets.palletPk
			where cols.ContainerOutFK = @containerOutFK2 and
				(palletLocation.BuildingUnitFK = @BuildingUnitFK2
				OR
				(palletContent.LooseLocationTypeFK = 2 /*LB*/ AND palletContent.LooseLocationFK in (Select LoadingBayPK from tblLoadingBays where BuildingUnitFK = @buildingUnitFK2))
				OR
				palletContent.PalletContentPK is null)		 

			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END

-- =============================================
-- Author:		DeVille
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	Create a copy/version of the container out
-- =============================================
Create PROCEDURE [dbo].[spContainerOutLoadingTypeAssigned]
(
	@containerOutFK int
)
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT
 ,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;
	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	DECLARE @containerOutFK2 INT
	
	SET  @containerOutFK2 = @containerOutFK

	SET @ParameterDetails = '@containerOutFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@containerOutFK2 AS NVARCHAR(20)),'') 

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    --BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

		SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END


	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY
			IF XACT_STATE() = 0 AND @@TRANCOUNT < 1 BEGIN TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start
			
			declare @divisionfk int = 0
			select @divisionfk = divisionfk from tblcontaineroutlines where containeroutfk = @containerOutFK2
			

			if(@divisionfk = 625)
			begin--for tirlan only (for now)
				declare @alreadyassigned bit = 0
				select @alreadyassigned = (case when containeroutfk is null then 0 else 1 end) from tblContainerOutLoading where containeroutfk = @containerOutFK2

				if(@alreadyassigned = 0)
				begin--only execute once

					--get container info
					drop table if exists #tmpcontainerOutCategories
					select containeroutpk, s.Description, sum(units) as quantity
					into #tmpcontainerOutCategories
					from viewContainerOutPalletList v
					left join tblContainerOutLoading ct on ct.containeroutfk = v.containeroutpk
					inner join tblstockitems s on stockitemfk = stockitempk
					where v.containeroutpk = @containerOutFK2 and v.DivisionFK = 625 --and containeroutpk = '409258'
					group by ContainerOutPK,GoodsORderNumber, s.Description
					order by containeroutpk desc

					--variables for insert
					declare @curdate datetime = getdate()
					declare @insertedby int = -1

					insert into tblContainerOutLoading ([ContainerOutFK], [ContainerOutLoadingTypeFK], [IsArchived], [InsertedBy], [InsertedDate], [UpdatedBy], [UpdatedDate])
					select containeroutpk, [Classification], 0, @insertedby,@curdate  , @insertedby,@curdate  from(
					select  containeroutpk, 
					stuff((select ', ' + s.Description from #tmpcontainerOutCategories s where v.containeroutpk = s.containeroutpk FOR XML PATH(''), TYPE).value('.[1]', 'nvarchar(max)'), 1, 2, '') as StockItemDescription,
					sum(quantity) quantity,
					case 
						when stuff((select ', ' + s.Description from #tmpcontainerOutCategories s where v.containeroutpk = s.containeroutpk FOR XML PATH(''), TYPE).value('.[1]', 'nvarchar(max)'), 1, 2, '') like '%animal%' then 1				--animal feed palletized
						when sum(quantity) <= 22000 then 1																																														--22T or less palletized
						when sum(quantity) > 25000 then 3																																															--more than 25T loose loads
						when sum(quantity) > 22000 and sum(quantity) < 25000 then 2																																									--22T-25T topups
						when sum(quantity) = 25000 then																																																		--exactly 25T, check description for FFMP / FFDP / SMP / WPC
							case when stuff((select ', ' + s.Description from #tmpcontainerOutCategories s where v.containeroutpk = s.containeroutpk FOR XML PATH(''), TYPE).value('.[1]', 'nvarchar(max)'), 1, 2, '') like '%FFMP%' 
							or stuff((select ', ' + s.Description from #tmpcontainerOutCategories s where v.containeroutpk = s.containeroutpk FOR XML PATH(''), TYPE).value('.[1]', 'nvarchar(max)'), 1, 2, '') like '%FFDP%' then 3 else 2 end
						else 4																																																						-- other?
					end as [Classification]	
					from #tmpcontainerOutCategories v
					group by ContainerOutPK
					)subq
				end
			end
			
			
			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end

			BEGIN TRY IF XACT_STATE() = 1 AND @@TRANCOUNT = 1 AND @OpeningTranCount < 1 COMMIT TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH
			
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END

/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[spContainerOutMatchContentToLines]    Script Date: 02/11/2026 17:47:26 ******/

-- =============================================  
-- Author:  <Author,,Name>  
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>  
-- Description: <Description,,>  
-- =============================================  
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spContainerOutMatchContentToLines]   
(  
 @containerOutPK int  
)  
AS  
BEGIN  
 /* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */  
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED  
  
    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT  
 ,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;  
 SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();  
  
 -- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters  
 DECLARE @containerOutPK2 INT  
   
 SET  @containerOutPK2 = @containerOutPK  
  
 SET @ParameterDetails = '@containerOutPK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@containerOutPK2 AS NVARCHAR(20)),'')  
  
    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL   
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)  
  
    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)  
    --BEGIN  
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC   
  
  SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)  
  
        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)  
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK  
  
        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()  
    --END  
  
  
 SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);  
 SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails  
 ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;  
 INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()  
  
 WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3  
 BEGIN   
  BEGIN TRY  
   IF XACT_STATE() = 0 AND @@TRANCOUNT < 1 BEGIN TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName  
  
   -- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start  
  
   --BEGIN TRANSACTION  

	drop table if exists #TmpStartingColpc
	select colpc.ContainerOutLinePalletContentPK, containeroutlinefk, PalletContentFK 
	into #TmpStartingColpc
	from tblContainerOutLines col
	inner join tblContainerOutLinePalletContent colpc on containeroutlinepk = containeroutlinefk   
	Where col.ContainerOutFK = @containerOutPK2 

	drop table if exists #tmpPalletContentOnOrder
	select pc.PalletContentPK, pc.StockItemFK, pc.Batch
	into #tmpPalletContentOnOrder
	from #TmpStartingColpc colpc   
	inner join tblPalletContent pc on colpc.PalletContentFK = pc.PalletContentPK
  
    DECLARE @containerOutLineProblems TABLE  
    (  
     ContainerOutLinePK int,   
     ProblemTypeFK int /*1=Batch Mismatch, 2=MultipleBatches*/  
    )  
  
    --********************* BATCH MISMATCH  
    INSERT into @containerOutLineProblems  
    Select ContainerOutLinePK, 1/*ProblemType - Batch Mismatch*/  
    From tblContainerOutLines cols  
    inner join (  
      Select ContainerOutLineFK, pc.Batch  
      From #TmpStartingColpc colpc  
      inner join #tmpPalletContentOnOrder pc on pc.PalletContentPK = colpc.PalletContentFK  
      Group By ContainerOutLineFK, pc.Batch  
    ) colBatches on colBatches.ContainerOutLineFK = cols.ContainerOutLinePK AND colBatches.Batch <> cols.Batch  
    Where cols.ContainerOutFK = @containerOutPK2  
    Group By ContainerOutLinePK    
  
	IF(EXISTS(Select * from @containerOutLineProblems Where ProblemTypeFK = 1/*Go at Batch Mismatch*/))   
	BEGIN  
		--We have a line that does not match its content, set the line to the first pallet content we find.  
		--If there are more than one batch for the line we've fixed here, the section below will find these  
		--BEGIN TRANSACTION  
		UPDATE cols WITH (ROWLOCK)  
		SET cols.Batch = pc.Batch  
		FROM tblContainerOutLines AS cols  
		INNER JOIN @containerOutLineProblems colps on colps.ContainerOutLinePK = cols.ContainerOutLinePK AND colps.ProblemTypeFK = 1 /*Batch Mismatch*/  
		INNER JOIN (  
			Select MAX(PalletContentPK) PalletContentPK, ContainerOutLineFK, Batch  
			From #TmpStartingColpc colpc  
			INNER JOIN #tmpPalletContentOnOrder subPC on subPC.PalletContentPK = colpc.PalletContentFK  
			Group By ContainerOutLineFK, Batch    
		)pc on pc.ContainerOutLineFK = colps.ContainerOutLinePK  
	END  
   
   --********************* MULTIPLE BATCH TO ONE LINE  
   --BEGIN TRANSACTION  
    INSERT into @containerOutLineProblems  
    Select ContainerOutLinePK, 2/*ProblemType - MultipleBatches*/  
    From tblContainerOutLines cols  
    inner join (  
		Select ContainerOutLineFK, count(*) NumberOfBatches from (  
			Select ContainerOutLineFK, pc.Batch  
			From tblContainerOutLinePalletContent colpc  
			inner join #tmpPalletContentOnOrder pc on pc.PalletContentPK = colpc.PalletContentFK  
			Group By ContainerOutLineFK, pc.Batch  
		)subQ  
     Group By ContainerOutLineFK  
    )colBatches on colBatches.ContainerOutLineFK = cols.ContainerOutLinePK  
    Where cols.ContainerOutFK = @containerOutPK2  AND colBatches.NumberOfBatches > 1  
  
  
   DECLARE @containerOutLinePK int  
   WHILE (EXISTS(Select * from @containerOutLineProblems Where ProblemTypeFK = 2/*Go at Multiple Batches*/))   
   BEGIN  

		Select Top 1 @containerOutLinePK = ContainerOutLinePK  
		From @containerOutLineProblems 
		Where ProblemTypeFK = 2  
  
		DECLARE @batch nvarchar(200)  
		DECLARE @newContainerOutLinePK int  
		WHILE(EXISTS(  
			Select *   
			from tblContainerOutLines cols  
			inner join tblContainerOutLinePalletContent colpc on colpc.ContainerOutLineFK = cols.ContainerOutLinePK  
			left outer join #tmpPalletContentOnOrder pc on pc.PalletContentPK = colpc.PalletContentFK AND pc.Batch = cols.Batch  
			WHERE cols.ContainerOutLinePK = @containerOutLinePK AND pc.PalletContentPK is null  )) 
		BEGIN  
     
			Select Top 1 @batch = pcForBatch.Batch  
			From tblContainerOutLines cols  
			inner join tblContainerOutLinePalletContent colpc on colpc.ContainerOutLineFK = cols.ContainerOutLinePK  
			left outer join #tmpPalletContentOnOrder pcForBatch on pcForBatch.PalletContentPK = colpc.PalletContentFK  
			left outer join #tmpPalletContentOnOrder pc on pc.PalletContentPK = colpc.PalletContentFK AND pc.Batch = cols.Batch  
			WHERE cols.ContainerOutLinePK = @containerOutLinePK AND pc.PalletContentPK is null  
  
     
			INSERT into tblContainerOutLines (ContainerOutFK, DivisionFK, StockItemFK, Batch, Pallets, Eaches, Units, Free1, Free2, Free3, Free4, Free5, IsArchived, InsertedBy,   
			  InsertedDate, UpdatedBy, UpdatedDate, PalletsPickedDifference, EachesPickedDifference, UnitsPickedDifference)  
			Select ContainerOutFK, DivisionFK, StockItemFK, Batch, Pallets, Eaches, Units, Free1, Free2, Free3, Free4, Free5,  IsArchived, InsertedBy,   
				InsertedDate, UpdatedBy, UpdatedDate, PalletsPickedDifference, EachesPickedDifference, UnitsPickedDifference  
			from tblContainerOutLines 
			where ContainerOutLinePK = @containerOutLinePK  
  
			Set @newContainerOutLinePK = scope_identity()  
			--Change the batch of this new line  
			Update tblContainerOutLines WITH (ROWLOCK)   
			Set Batch = @batch  
			Where ContainerOutLinePK = @newContainerOutLinePK  
			--Now update the ContainerOutLinePalletContent to point at this new line  
			Update colpc WITH (ROWLOCK)  
			Set ContainerOutLineFK = @newContainerOutLinePK  
			From tblContainerOutLinePalletContent colpc  
			inner join #tmpPalletContentOnOrder pc on pc.PalletContentPK = colpc.PalletContentFK  
			Where colpc.ContainerOutLineFK = @containerOutLinePK AND pc.Batch = @batch  
  
			--Update the line units  
			UPDATE cols WITH (ROWLOCK)  
			SET cols.Units = colpc.Units  
			FROM tblContainerOutLines AS cols  
			INNER JOIN (  
				Select ContainerOutLineFK, sum(Units) Units  
				From tblContainerOutLinePalletContent colpc   
				Group By ContainerOutLineFK  
			)colpc on colpc.ContainerOutLineFK = cols.ContainerOutLinePK  
			Where cols.ContainerOutLinePK in (@containerOutLinePK, @newContainerOutLinePK) 
		END  
		
		Delete @containerOutLineProblems Where ContainerOutLinePK = @containerOutLinePK  
	END  
   
   -- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end  
  
   BEGIN TRY IF XACT_STATE() = 1 AND @@TRANCOUNT = 1 AND @OpeningTranCount < 1 COMMIT TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH  
     
   BREAK  
  END TRY  
  BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */  
   DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;  
   SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;  
   SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;  
  
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY   
   BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;  
         
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;  
  
            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID  
              
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;  
              
   IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)  
   BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END  
   ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */  
  END CATCH  
  SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1  
 END  
END  
GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[spContainerOutMatchContentToLines2]    Script Date: 02/11/2026 17:47:26 ******/

SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON

-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spContainerOutMatchContentToLines2] 
(
	@containerOutPK int
)
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT
 ,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;
	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();


-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	DECLARE @containerOutPK2 INT	
	SET  @containerOutPK2 = @containerOutPK

	SET @ParameterDetails = '@containerOutPK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@containerOutPK2 AS NVARCHAR(20)),'')

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    --BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

		SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END


	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY
			IF XACT_STATE() = 0 AND @@TRANCOUNT < 1 BEGIN TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start


			--load current info
			IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#TempContainerOutLines') IS NOT NULL
				DROP TABLE #TempContainerOutLines
			SELECT * INTO #TempContainerOutLines FROM tblcontaineroutlines WHERE containeroutfk = @containerOutPK2

			IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#TempContainerOutLinepalletContent') IS NOT NULL
				DROP TABLE #TempContainerOutLinepalletContent
			SELECT colpc.* INTO #TempContainerOutLinepalletContent FROM tblcontaineroutlinepalletcontent colpc INNER JOIN #TempContainerOutLines ON colpc.ContainerOutLineFK = ContainerOutLinePK

			IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#TempPalletContent') IS NOT NULL
				DROP TABLE #TempPalletContent
			SELECT pc.* INTO #TempPalletContent FROM tblpalletcontent pc INNER JOIN #TempContainerOutLinepalletContent ON pc.PalletContentPK = PalletContentFK

			IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#containerOutLineProblems') IS NOT NULL
				DROP TABLE #containerOutLineProblems

			--********************* BATCH MISMATCH
			Select ContainerOutLinePK--, 1/*ProblemType - Batch Mismatch*/
			INTO #containerOutLineProblems
			From #TempContainerOutLines cols
			inner join (
					Select ContainerOutLineFK, pc.Batch
					From #TempContainerOutLinepalletContent colpc
					inner join #TempPalletContent pc ON pc.PalletContentPK = colpc.PalletContentFK
					Group By ContainerOutLineFK, pc.Batch
			) colBatches ON colBatches.ContainerOutLineFK = cols.ContainerOutLinePK AND colBatches.Batch <> cols.Batch
			Group By ContainerOutLinePK

			IF(EXISTS(Select * from #containerOutLineProblems))
			BEGIN
				--We have a line that does not match its content, set the line to the first pallet content we find.
				--If there are more than one batch for the line we've fixed here, the section below will find these
				UPDATE cols WITH (ROWLOCK)
				SET cols.Batch = pc.Batch
				FROM tblContainerOutLines AS cols
				INNER JOIN #containerOutLineProblems colps ON colps.ContainerOutLinePK = cols.ContainerOutLinePK AND colps.ProblemTypeFK = 1 /*Batch Mismatch*/
				INNER JOIN (
					Select MAX(PalletContentPK) PalletContentPK, ContainerOutLineFK, Batch
					From #TempContainerOutLinepalletContent colpc
					INNER JOIN #TempPalletContent subPC ON subPC.PalletContentPK = colpc.PalletContentFK
					Group By ContainerOutLineFK, Batch  
				)pc ON pc.ContainerOutLineFK = colps.ContainerOutLinePK
			END

			--start again for second issue type
			IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#containerOutLineProblems2') IS NOT NULL
				DROP TABLE #containerOutLineProblems2

			--********************* MULTIPLE BATCH TO ONE LINE
			--BEGIN TRANSACTION
			--INSERT into @containerOutLineProblems
			Select ContainerOutLinePK
			INTO #containerOutLineProblems2
			From tblcontaineroutlines cols
			inner join (
				Select ContainerOutLineFK, count(*) NumberOfBatches 
				from (
					Select ContainerOutLineFK, pc.Batch
					FROM #TempContainerOutLinepalletContent colpc
					inner JOIN #TempPalletContent pc ON pc.PalletContentPK = colpc.PalletContentFK
					Group By ContainerOutLineFK, pc.Batch
				)subQ
				Group By ContainerOutLineFK
			) colBatches ON colBatches.ContainerOutLineFK = cols.ContainerOutLinePK
			WHERE containeroutfk = @containerOutPK2 and colBatches.NumberOfBatches > 1

			DECLARE @containerOutLinePK int
			DECLARE @batch nvarchar(200)
			DECLARE @newContainerOutLinePK int

			WHILE (EXISTS(Select * from #containerOutLineProblems2)) 
			BEGIN
				Select Top 1 @containerOutLinePK = ContainerOutLinePK
				From #containerOutLineProblems2

				WHILE(EXISTS(
					Select * 
					from tblContainerOutLines cols
					inner join tblContainerOutLinePalletContent colpc ON colpc.ContainerOutLineFK = cols.ContainerOutLinePK
					left outer join #TempPalletContent pc ON pc.PalletContentPK = colpc.PalletContentFK AND pc.Batch = cols.Batch
					WHERE cols.ContainerOutLinePK = @containerOutLinePK
					AND pc.PalletContentPK is null
				)) BEGIN
					--Print 'Here2'
					--Get the batch that we are missing
					Select Top 1 @batch = pcForBatch.Batch
					From tblContainerOutLines cols
					inner join tblContainerOutLinePalletContent colpc ON colpc.ContainerOutLineFK = cols.ContainerOutLinePK
					left outer join #TempPalletContent pcForBatch ON pcForBatch.PalletContentPK = colpc.PalletContentFK
					left outer join #TempPalletContent pc ON pc.PalletContentPK = colpc.PalletContentFK AND pc.Batch = cols.Batch
					WHERE cols.ContainerOutLinePK = @containerOutLinePK AND pc.PalletContentPK is null

					--Create a new line
					INSERT into tblContainerOutLines (ContainerOutFK, DivisionFK, StockItemFK, Batch, Pallets, Eaches, Units, Free1, Free2, Free3, Free4, Free5,
					IsArchived, InsertedBy, InsertedDate, UpdatedBy, UpdatedDate, PalletsPickedDifference, EachesPickedDifference, UnitsPickedDifference)
					Select ContainerOutFK, DivisionFK, StockItemFK, @batch, Pallets, Eaches, Units, Free1, Free2, Free3, Free4, Free5, IsArchived, InsertedBy, 
					InsertedDate, UpdatedBy, UpdatedDate, PalletsPickedDifference, EachesPickedDifference, UnitsPickedDifference
					from tblContainerOutLines where ContainerOutLinePK = @containerOutLinePK

					Set @newContainerOutLinePK = scope_identity()
		
					--Now update the ContainerOutLinePalletContent to point at this new line
					Update colpc WITH (ROWLOCK)
					Set ContainerOutLineFK = @newContainerOutLinePK
					From tblContainerOutLinePalletContent colpc
					inner join #TempPalletContent pc on pc.PalletContentPK = colpc.PalletContentFK
					Where colpc.ContainerOutLineFK = @containerOutLinePK AND pc.Batch = @batch

					--Update the line units
					UPDATE cols WITH (ROWLOCK)
					SET cols.Units = colpc.Units
					FROM tblContainerOutLines AS cols
					INNER JOIN (
						Select ContainerOutLineFK, sum(Units) Units
						From tblContainerOutLinePalletContent colpc 
						Group By ContainerOutLineFK
					)colpc ON colpc.ContainerOutLineFK = cols.ContainerOutLinePK
					Where cols.ContainerOutLinePK in (@containerOutLinePK, @newContainerOutLinePK)				
				END			
				 --delete this temp record and go again if there is more
				DELETE FROM #containerOutLineProblems2 Where ContainerOutLinePK = @containerOutLinePK
			END
	
			BEGIN TRY IF XACT_STATE() = 1 AND @@TRANCOUNT = 1 AND @OpeningTranCount < 1 COMMIT TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH
			
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END
GO

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spContainerOutPalletLocationTypes]        
(        
 @buildingUnitFK int,        
 @containerOutFK int        
)         
AS        
BEGIN        
 /* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */        
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED        
        
    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT        
 ,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;        
 SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();        
        
 -- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters        
 DECLARE @buildingUnitFK2 int, @containerOutFK2 int        
        
 SET @buildingUnitFK2 = @buildingUnitFK; SET @containerOutFK2 = @containerOutFK        
        
 SET @ParameterDetails = '@buildingUnitFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@buildingUnitFK2 AS NVARCHAR(20)),'') + ',@containerOutFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@containerOutFK2 AS NVARCHAR(20)),'')        
        
    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL         
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)        
        
    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)        
    --BEGIN        
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC         
        
  SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)        
        
        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)        
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK        
        
        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()        
    --END        
        
        
 SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);        
 SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails        
 ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;        
 INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()        
        
 WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3        
 BEGIN         
  BEGIN TRY           
   -- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start        
    
    SELECT tp.PalletPK, tp.LocationTypeFK, -1 as [BuildingUnitRowFK], -1 as SetDownAreaPK, tlb.loadingbaypk, divisionFK,  tp.BuildingUnitFK,     
     case when tp.CustomerBarcode <> '' then tp.CustomerBarcode else tp.Barcode end Barcode, ContainerOutLinePalletContentPK, tcolpc.Units     
    FROM tblContainerOutLines tcol    
    INNER JOIN dbo.tblContainerOutLinePalletContent tcolpc on containeroutlinefk = tcol.ContainerOutLinePK       
    inner join tblPallets tp ON palletfk = tp.palletpk    
   -- LEFT JOIN dbo.tblSetDownAreas tsda  ON tsda.SetDownAreaPK = tp.LocationFK AND tp.LocationTypeFK = 3      
    LEFT JOIN dbo.tblLoadingbays tlb ON tlb.loadingbaypk = tp.LocationFK AND tp.LocationTypeFK = 2      
    WHERE containeroutfk = @containerOutFK2 and tp.BuildingUnitFK = @buildingUnitFK2    
        
   BREAK        
  END TRY        
  BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */        
   DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;        
   SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;        
   SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;        
        
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY         
   BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;        
               
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;        
        
            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID        
                    
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;        
                    
   IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)        
   BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END        
   ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */        
  END CATCH        
  SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1        
 END

--sp_helptext [spContainerOutPalletSetUnLoaded] 2428203,170536,180,2,24

--select * from tblcontainerouts where GoodsOrderNumber = 467214
    
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spContainerOutPalletSetUnLoaded]      
(       
 @palletFK int,      
 @containerOutFK int,      
 @UserFK int,      
 @ToLocationTypeFk int,      
 @ToLocationFK int      
)       
AS      
BEGIN      
 /* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */      
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED      
    
	  DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT
 ,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;
	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

    
 -- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters      
 DECLARE @var_palletFK int, @var_containerOutFK int, @var_UserFK int, @var_ToLocationTypeFk int, @var_ToLocationFK int      
      
 SET @var_palletFK = @palletFK; SET @var_containerOutFK = @containerOutFK; SET @var_UserFK =@UserFK;       
 SET @var_ToLocationTypeFk =@ToLocationTypeFk; SET @var_ToLocationFK =@ToLocationFK      
 

 SET @ParameterDetails = '@palletFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_palletFK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + '@containerOutFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_containerOutFK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'')

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    BEGIN
            SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

            INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
            SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

            SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    END

	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY
			IF XACT_STATE() = 0 AND @@TRANCOUNT < 1 BEGIN TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName

      
   if(exists(select palletauditpk from tblPalletAudit where palletfk = @var_palletFK and EventFK = @var_containerOutFK and EventTypeFK in (25,27)))      
   begin      
      
  print 'get existing loading movement'    
    drop table if exists #tmpexistingloadedMovement       
    select top 1 * into #tmpexistingloadedMovement from tblWorksOrderMovements where palletfk = @var_palletFK and DestinationLocationTypeFK = 5 and DestinationFK = @var_containerOutFK order by UpdatedDate desc      
          
  print 'get wo pk'    
    declare @worksorderfk int      
    select @worksorderfk = worksorderfk from #tmpexistingloadedMovement      
         print @worksorderfk
      
  print 'physical'    
    drop table if exists #tmpphysicalcheck      
    select top 1 wopr.* into #tmpphysicalcheck       
    from tblworksorderpalletresult wopr      
    inner join tblworksorderpallets on worksorderpalletpk = worksorderpalletfk       
    where palletfk = @var_palletFK           
    order by WorksOrderPalletResultPK desc      
      
    declare @newDate datetime = dbo.GetBSTDate()      
      
    --IF XACT_STATE() = 0 AND @@TRANCOUNT < 1 BEGIN TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName      
   
  print 'insert audit'    
     --add unload audit event      
 insert into tblPalletAudit     
 select top 1 PalletFK, BuildingUnitFk, 26, EventFK,@newDate,StockItemFK,Batch,    
    TotalPallets,TotalBatchPallets,TotalEaches,TotalBatchEaches,TotalUnits,TotalBatchUnits,BuildingUnitTotalPallets,    
    BuildingUnitTotalBatchPallets,BuildingUnitTotalEaches,BuildingUnitTotalBatchEaches,BuildingUnitTotalUnits,BuildingUnitTotalBatchUnits,    
    IsArchived,@var_UserFK,@newDate,@var_UserFK,@newDate     
 from tblPalletAudit   
 where palletfk = @var_palletFK and EventFK = @var_containerOutFK and EventTypeFK in (25,27)  
       
  print 'insert wom unload'    
     --add unload movement record      
 insert into tblWorksOrderMovements      
 select top 1 WorksOrderFK,WorksOrderStatusFK,PalletFK,PalletContentFK,ContainerOutLinePalletContentFK,EntirePallet,Eaches,Units,    
    5,@var_containerOutFK,SourceBayPosition,SourceStackPosition,@var_ToLocationTypeFk,@var_ToLocationFK,    
    DestinationBayPosition,DestinationStackPosition,DestinationPalletStart,DestinationPalletEnd,'Unload Pallet from container',    
    IsArchived,@var_UserFK,@newDate,@var_UserFK,@newDate,@var_UserFK,HandheldDeviceFK,WarehouseMachineFK     
 from #tmpexistingloadedMovement      
      
  print 'update wo'    
     --ensure works order is not completed as there is now a reload   
 if((select worksorderstatusfk from tblworksorders where worksorderpk = @worksorderfk) = 3)  
 begin  
  update tblworksorders set WorksOrderStatusFK = 1 where worksorderpk = @worksorderfk      
 end  
      
  print 'update pal'    
     --update pallet record with new location      
     update tblpallets set locationfk = @var_ToLocationFK, LocationTypeFK = @var_ToLocationTypeFk where PalletPK = @var_palletFK      
      
  print 'insert wom reload'    
     --add reload movement record      
 insert into tblWorksOrderMovements      
    select top 1 WorksOrderFK,1,PalletFK,PalletContentFK,ContainerOutLinePalletContentFK,EntirePallet,Eaches,Units,    
  SourceLocationTypeFK,SourceLocationFK,SourceBayPosition,SourceStackPosition,DestinationLocationTypeFK,DestinationFK,    
  DestinationBayPosition,DestinationStackPosition,DestinationPalletStart,DestinationPalletEnd,'Load Pallet on container',    
  IsArchived,@var_UserFK,@newDate,@var_UserFK,@newDate,-1,HandheldDeviceFK,WarehouseMachineFK     
 from #tmpexistingloadedMovement      
      
     --update physical checkrecord      
     if(exists(select * from #tmpphysicalcheck))      
     begin      
	  update #tmpphysicalcheck set PalletAccepted = -1      
	  insert into tblWorksOrderPalletResult      
	  select top 1 WorksOrderPalletFK,PalletAccepted,IsArchived,@var_UserFK,InsertedDate,@var_UserFK,UpdatedDate    
	  from #tmpphysicalcheck      
        
	  declare @worksorderpallet int      
	  select @worksorderpallet = worksorderpalletfk from #tmpphysicalcheck      
	  update tblWorksOrderPallets set WorksOrderStatusFK = 5 where WorksOrderPalletPK = @worksorderpallet             
     end      
      
  print 'co audit'    
     --add containeroutaudit      
     declare @barcode nvarchar(50)      
     select @barcode = (case when customerbarcode = '' then barcode else customerbarcode end) from tblpallets where palletpk = @var_palletFK      
     insert into tblContainerOutAudit      
      values( @var_containerOutFK, 17, 'Pallet unloaded from container, barcode: '+@barcode, 0 , 0, @var_UserFK, @newDate, @var_UserFK, @newDate, 0)      
      
  print 'colpc unload'    
     --set colpc as unloaded      
     update colpc  set colpc.loaded = 0       
     from tblContainerOutLinePalletContent colpc        
     inner join tblcontaineroutlines col on col.ContainerOutLinePK = colpc.ContainerOutLineFK AND containeroutfk = @var_containerOutFK       
     where palletfk = @var_palletFK      
    
      
   select 1  as Result   
      
  -- BEGIN TRY IF XACT_STATE() = 1 AND @@TRANCOUNT = 1 AND @OpeningTranCount < 1 COMMIT TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH      
   end 
   else
   begin
	select 0  as Result    
	end
      BEGIN TRY IF XACT_STATE() = 1 AND @@TRANCOUNT = 1 AND @OpeningTranCount < 1 COMMIT TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH
			
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END
