-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spContainerOutsPickLoaded] 
(
	@divisionFK int
)
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT
 ,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;
	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	DECLARE @divisionFK2 INT

	SET @divisionFK2 = @divisionFK

	SET @ParameterDetails = '@divisionFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@divisionFK2 AS NVARCHAR(20)),'')

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    --BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

		SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END


	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY
			

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start

			Declare @customerFK int
			Declare @DelayPickLoaded bit
			Select @customerFK = CustomerFK, @DelayPickLoaded = DelayContainerOutPickLoaded from tblDivisions where DivisionPK = @divisionFK2

			IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#tblContainerOutLines') IS NOT NULL
			DROP TABLE #tblContainerOutLines			
			Select distinct ContainerOutLinePK, cols.ContainerOutFK, DocketValue1, DocketValue2, DocketValue3, Pallets, Eaches, Units--, so.pickloaded
			INTO #tblContainerOutLines
			from tblContainerOutLines cols
			inner join tblContainerOuts cOuts on cOuts.ContainerOutPK = cols.ContainerOutFK
			inner join tblStockOrders so on so.containeroutfk = cOuts.containeroutpk and so.pickloaded = 0
			--inner join tbldivisions divs on divs.DivisionPK = cols.DivisionFK
			Where cols.DivisionFK = @divisionFK2 
			AND cOuts.InsertedBy = 0/*Make sure this is an integrated pick*/
			AND cOuts.ContainerOutStatusFK <> 6 --we dont want to GI cancelled picks
			AND (--delay pick loaded
				(@DelayPickLoaded = 1 and cOuts.ContainerOutStatusFK = 5)
				or
				(@DelayPickLoaded = 0)
			)
			--select * from #tblContainerOutLines
			
			--CHECK HAVE WE ANY LOADS TO EXPORT
			DECLARE @retVal int
			SELECT @retVal = COUNT(*)  FROM #tblContainerOutLines
			PRINT @retVal
			IF (@retVal < 1)
			BEGIN
				PRINT 'NO LOADS TO EXPORT'
				select top 1 ContainerOutFK as ContainerOutPK, DocketValue1 as ID from #tblContainerOutLines
			END
			ELSE
			BEGIN
				PRINT 'LOADS TO EXPORT'
			
				IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#tblContainerOutLinePalletContent') IS NOT NULL
					DROP TABLE #tblContainerOutLinePalletContent			
				SELECT ContainerOutLinePalletContentPK, ContainerOutLineFK, PalletFK, PalletContentFK, Loaded
				INTO #tblContainerOutLinePalletContent
				FROM tblContainerOutLinePalletContent
				INNER JOIN #tblContainerOutLines ON ContainerOutLineFK = ContainerOutLinePK
				--select * from #tblContainerOutLinePalletContent

				IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#tblpallets') IS NOT NULL
					DROP TABLE #tblpallets
				SELECT pals.PalletPk into #tblpallets
				FROM tblpallets pals
				INNER JOIN #tblContainerOutLinePalletContent ON pals.PalletPK = PalletFK
				where palletstatusfk = 11 /*On Container/Loaded*/

				-- Insert statements for procedure here
				Select cOuts.ContainerOutFK as ContainerOutPK,
					case when cdis.CustomerDocketIdentificationPK = null then 
						'' 
					else
						case cdis.FieldFK 
						when 40 then
							cdis.Prefix + ' ' + cOuts.DocketValue1
						when 2 then
							cdis.Prefix + ' ' + cOuts.DocketValue2
						when 2 then
							cdis.Prefix + ' ' + cOuts.DocketValue3
						end
					End as ID
				FROM (
					Select Distinct cols.ContainerOutFK, PickLoaded, DocketValue1, DocketValue2, DocketValue3
					from (Select * from #tblContainerOutLines) cols
					inner join (
						Select ContainerOutFK, cast(MAX(cast(PickLoaded as int)) as bit) PickLoaded
						from tblStockOrders 
						Where PickLoaded = 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/
						Group By ContainerOutFK
					)sos on 
					sos.ContainerOutFK = cols.ContainerOutFK
		
				)cOuts

				inner join  (
					Select ContainerOutFK, sum(PalletsOrdered) PalletsOrdered 
					from (select * from #tblContainerOutLines) cols
					inner join (
						Select count(*) PalletsOrdered, ContainerOutLineFK from (
							Select Distinct PalletFK, ContainerOutLineFK
							from #tblContainerOutLinePalletContent
							Where PalletContentFK > 0 
						)subQ
						Group By PalletFK, ContainerOutLineFK
					)pcOrdered on
					pcOrdered.ContainerOutLineFK = cols.ContainerOutLinePK
		
					group By ContainerOutFK
				) palletsOrdered on 
				palletsOrdered.ContainerOutFK = cOuts.ContainerOutFK 

				left outer join (
					Select ContainerOutFK, count(*) PalletsInContainer
					from (select * from #tblContainerOutLines) cols
					inner join (
						Select Distinct PalletFK, ContainerOutLineFK
						from #tblContainerOutLinePalletContent 
					)pcPicked on
					pcPicked.ContainerOutLineFK = cols.ContainerOutLinePK

					inner join #tblpallets pals  on pals.PalletPK = pcPicked.PalletFK  
		
					group By ContainerOutFK
				) palletsInContainer on 
				palletsInContainer.ContainerOutFK = cOuts.ContainerOutFK 
 
				inner join (
					Select cols.ContainerOutFK, sum(isnull(ContentNotLoaded, 0)) NotLoaded
					from #tblContainerOutLines cols
					left outer join (
						Select ContainerOutLineFK, count(*) ContentNotLoaded
						from #tblContainerOutLinePalletContent 
						Where
						Loaded = 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/
						Group By ContainerOutLineFK
					) colpc on
					colpc.ContainerOutLineFK = cols.ContainerOutLinePK
					Where (cols.Pallets > 0 OR cols.Eaches > 0 OR cols.Units > 0)--We only want to look for non loaded pallets where we have actually picked something
					Group By cols.ContainerOutFK
				) colpcNotLoaded on
				colpcNotLoaded.ContainerOutFK = cOuts.ContainerOutFK 

			/**********FOR IDENTIFICATION***********/
				left outer join tblCustomerDocketIdentifications cdis on
				cdis.CustomerFK = @customerFK
				AND cdis.DocketTypeFK = 2 /*ContainerOut*/
			/***************************************/
				where 
				/*PickLoaded = 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/ 
				AND*/ (
					PalletsOrdered = PalletsInContainer
					OR
					colpcNotLoaded.NotLoaded = 0
				)
				AND (--MAKE SURE THIS IS NOT A DICREPENCY
					NOT EXISTS(
						Select * 
						from #tblContainerOutLines cols
						INNER JOIN tblStockDiscrepencies ON cols.ContainerOutLinePK = dbo.tblStockDiscrepencies.ContainerOutLineFK
					)
				)
			END
			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end

			
			
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spContainerOutsPickLoadedOverview]

)
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT

	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	DECLARE @divisionFKs2 nvarchar(100)

	SET @divisionFKs2 = @divisionFKs

	SET @ParameterDetails = '@divisionFKs2 = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@divisionFKs2 AS NVARCHAR(20)),'')

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)

		SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END


	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);

	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY	
			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start	
			Select distinct DivisionPK
			from tblContainerOutLines cols
			inner join dbo.fnSplitStringToArray(@divisionFKs2, ',') selectedDivs on selectedDivs.element = cols.divisionFK
			inner join tblContainerOuts cOuts on cOuts.ContainerOutPK = cols.ContainerOutFK

			AND (--delay pick loaded
				(divs.DelayContainerOutPickLoaded = 1 and cOuts.ContainerOutStatusFK = 5)
				or
				(divs.DelayContainerOutPickLoaded = 0)
			)			
			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end		
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spContainerOutsPickStarted] 
(
	@divisionFK int
)
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT
 ,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;
	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	DECLARE @var_divisionFK INT

	SET @var_divisionFK = @divisionFK

	SET @ParameterDetails = '@divisionFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_divisionFK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'')

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    --BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

		SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END


	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY
			
			-- This stored procedures main code, excluding error handling - start

			SELECT DISTINCT 
				cOuts.ContainerOutPK, cOuts.GoodsOrderNumber, cOuts.Inserteddate, sos.stockorderstatusfk, cOuts.Insertedby
			FROM 
				tblContainerOuts AS cOuts
			INNER JOIN tblContainerOutLines AS cols 
				ON cols.ContainerOutFk = cOuts.ContainerOutPk
			--INNER JOIN tblDivisions AS Div 
				--ON Div.DivisionPk = cols.DivisionFK
			/*get first stock order, as multiple stock orders across building units may only have one set as started, but we dont want to send another file for other stock order*/
			CROSS APPLY (
							SELECT top 1 stockOrderPK, stockOrderStatusFK, containerOutFk, PickStarted
							FROM tblStockOrders 
							WHERE ContainerOutFK = cOuts.ContainerOutPK
							ORDER BY PickStarted DESC
						) AS sos --ON sos.ContainerOutFK = cOuts.ContainerOutPK  
			INNER JOIN tblWorksOrders AS wos 
				ON sos.StockOrderPK = wos.FK 
				AND wos.WorksOrderOriginFK = 2 /*StockOut*/ AND wos.WorksOrderTypeFK = 3 /*Movement*/
		--	INNER JOIN tblWorksOrderMovements AS woms 
			--	ON woms.WorksOrderFK = wos.WorksOrderPK
			WHERE 
				sos.PickStarted = 0 /*not set as started yet*/ 
				AND sos.StockOrderStatusFk <> 6 /*not cancelled*/      
				AND DivisionFk = @var_divisionFK --AND Div.ExportContainerOutPickStarted = 1  /*division setting to export*/
				AND cOuts.Insertedby = 0 /*integrated pick*/
			ORDER BY 
				cOuts.Inserteddate

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end
						
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END

-- =============================================

-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spContainerOutsSamplesLoaded] 
(
	@divisionFK int
)
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT
 ,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;
	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	DECLARE @divisionFK2 INT

	SET @divisionFK2 = @divisionFK

	SET @ParameterDetails = '@divisionFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@divisionFK2 AS NVARCHAR(20)),'')

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    --BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

		SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END


	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY
			

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start

			Declare @customerFK int
			Select @customerFK = CustomerFK from tblDivisions where DivisionPK = @divisionFK2

			/*DECLARE @tblContainerOutLines TABLE
			(
				ContainerOutLinePK int,
				ContainerOutFK int,
				Pallets int,
				Eaches decimal(18,3),
				Units decimal(18,3)
			)
			INSERT into @tblContainerOutLines*/

			IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#tblContainerOutLines') IS NOT NULL
			DROP TABLE #tblContainerOutLines
						
			SELECT distinct ContainerOutLinePK, cols.ContainerOutFK, Pallets, Eaches, Units, cOuts.DocketValue1
			INTO #tblContainerOutLines
			FROM tblContainerOutLines cols
			inner join tblContainerOuts cOuts on cOuts.ContainerOutPK = cols.ContainerOutFK
			inner join tblStockOrders so on so.containeroutfk = cOuts.containeroutpk and so.pickloaded = 0
			inner join tblSamples smps on smps.ContainerOutFK = cols.ContainerOutFK			
			WHERE DivisionFK in (631) 
			and cOuts.ContainerOutStatusFK <> 6 /*not cancelled*/ 
			and cols.insertedby > 0 /*created by user, samples don't originate from integration*/

			--CHECK HAVE WE ANY LOADS TO EXPORT
			DECLARE @retVal int
			SELECT @retVal = COUNT(*)  FROM #tblContainerOutLines
			PRINT @retVal
			IF (@retVal < 1)
			BEGIN
				PRINT 'NO LOADS TO EXPORT'
				select top 1 ContainerOutFK as ContainerOutPK, DocketValue1 as ID from #tblContainerOutLines
			END
			ELSE
			BEGIN
				PRINT 'LOADS TO EXPORT'

				-- Insert statements for procedure here
				Select cOuts.ContainerOutPK,
				case when cdis.CustomerDocketIdentificationPK = null then 
					'' 
				else
					case cdis.FieldFK 
					when 40 then
						cdis.Prefix + ' ' + cOuts.DocketValue1
					when 41 then
						cdis.Prefix + ' ' + cOuts.DocketValue2
					when 42 then
						cdis.Prefix + ' ' + cOuts.DocketValue3
					end
				End as ID
				FROM (
					Select Distinct ContainerOutPK, PickLoaded, cols.DocketValue1, DocketValue2, DocketValue3
					from (Select * from #tblContainerOutLines) cols
					inner join (
						Select ContainerOutFK, cast(MAX(cast(PickLoaded as int)) as bit) PickLoaded
						from tblStockOrders 
						Group By ContainerOutFK
					)sos on sos.ContainerOutFK = cols.ContainerOutFK
					AND sos.PickLoaded = 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/
		
					inner join tblContainerOuts containerOuts
					on containerOuts.ContainerOutPK = sos.ContainerOutFK
		
				)cOuts
		 
				inner join  (
					Select ContainerOutFK, sum(PalletsOrdered) PalletsOrdered 
					from (select * from #tblContainerOutLines) cols
					inner join (
						Select count(*) PalletsOrdered, ContainerOutLineFK from (
							Select Distinct PalletFK, ContainerOutLineFK
							from tblContainerOutLinePalletContent
							Where PalletContentFK > 0 
						)subQ
						Group By PalletFK, ContainerOutLineFK
					)pcOrdered on
					pcOrdered.ContainerOutLineFK = cols.ContainerOutLinePK
		
					group By ContainerOutFK
				) palletsOrdered on 
				palletsOrdered.ContainerOutFK = cOuts.ContainerOutPK 

				left outer join (
					Select ContainerOutFK, count(*) PalletsInContainer
					from (select * from #tblContainerOutLines) cols
					inner join (
						Select Distinct PalletFK, ContainerOutLineFK
						from tblContainerOutLinePalletContent 
					)pcPicked on
					pcPicked.ContainerOutLineFK = cols.ContainerOutLinePK

					inner join tblPallets pals  on
					pals.PalletPK = pcPicked.PalletFK AND pals.PalletStatusFK = 11 /*On Container/Loaded*/
		
					group By ContainerOutFK
				) palletsInContainer on 
				palletsInContainer.ContainerOutFK = cOuts.ContainerOutPK 
 
			--	inner join (
			--		Select ContainerOutFK, cast(MAX(cast(PickLoaded as int)) as bit) PickLoaded
			--		from tblStockOrders 
			--		Group By ContainerOutFK
			--	)sos on sos.ContainerOutFK = cOuts.ContainerOutPK  

				inner join (
					Select cols.ContainerOutFK, sum(isnull(ContentNotLoaded, 0)) NotLoaded
					from #tblContainerOutLines cols
					left outer join (
						Select ContainerOutLineFK, count(*) ContentNotLoaded
						from tblContainerOutLinePalletContent 
						Where
						Loaded = 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/
						Group By ContainerOutLineFK
					) colpc on
					colpc.ContainerOutLineFK = cols.ContainerOutLinePK
					Where (cols.Pallets > 0 OR cols.Eaches > 0 OR cols.Units > 0)--We only want to look for non loaded pallets where we have actually picked something
					Group By cols.ContainerOutFK
				) colpcNotLoaded on
				colpcNotLoaded.ContainerOutFK = cOuts.ContainerOutPK 

			/**********FOR IDENTIFICATION***********/
				left outer join tblCustomerDocketIdentifications cdis on
				cdis.CustomerFK = @customerFK
				AND cdis.DocketTypeFK = 2 /*ContainerOut*/
			/***************************************/
				where 
				/*PickLoaded = 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/ 
				AND*/ (
					PalletsOrdered = PalletsInContainer
					OR
					colpcNotLoaded.NotLoaded = 0
				)
				AND (--MAKE SURE THIS IS NOT A DISCREPENCY
					NOT EXISTS(
						Select * 
						from #tblContainerOutLines cols
						Where ContainerOutFK = cOuts.ContainerOutPK 
						AND ContainerOutLinePK in (Select ContainerOutLineFK from tblStockDiscrepencies)
					)
				)
				AND (--MAKE SURE THIS IS A SAMPLE
					EXISTS(
						Select * 
						from tblSamples smps
						Where ContainerOutFK = cOuts.ContainerOutPK 
					)
				)
	
				-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end
			END

			
			
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END

-- =============================================                
-- Author:  <Archana Singh>                
-- Create date: <17/12/2024>                
-- Description: <Description,,>                
-- =============================================    

 /*EXEC [dbo].[spCreateScheduleChannelTemplate]
    @ScheduleWeekTemplateFK = 5,
    @Name = 'New Channel Template',
    @FreeMode = 1,
    @AllowInbound = 1,
    @AllowOutbound = 0,
    @ColorCode = '#FF5733',
    @DeliveryCount = 10,
    @UserId = 123;
*/

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spCreateScheduleChannelTemplate]
    @ScheduleWeekTemplateFK INT,
    @Name NVARCHAR(100),
    @FreeMode BIT,
    @AllowInbound BIT,
    @AllowOutbound BIT,
    @ColorCode NVARCHAR(10),
    @DeliveryCount INT,
    @UserId INT
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED;

    DECLARE 
        @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),
        @CurrentDate DATETIME,
        @DeadlockErrorRetries INT = 1,
        @ErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX),
        @ErrorProcedure NVARCHAR(MAX),
        @ErrorLine NVARCHAR(10),
        @ErrorSeverity NVARCHAR(10),
        @ErrorState NVARCHAR(10),
        @ErrorNumber NVARCHAR(10),
        @NewIdentity INT;

    SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID);
    SET @CurrentDate = dbo.GetBSTDate(); -- Replace dbo.GetBSTDate() with GETDATE() if unavailable

    WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
    BEGIN
        BEGIN TRY
            BEGIN TRANSACTION;

            -- Insert a new record
            INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblScheduleChannelTemplates] (
                [ScheduleWeekTemplateFK],
                [Name],
                [FreeMode],
                [AllowInbound],
                [AllowOutbound],
                [ColorCode],
                [DeliveryCount],
                [IsArchived],
                [InsertedBy],
                [InsertedDate],
                [UpdatedBy],
                [UpdatedDate]
            )
            VALUES (
                @ScheduleWeekTemplateFK,
                @Name,
                @FreeMode,
                @AllowInbound,
                @AllowOutbound,
                @ColorCode,
                @DeliveryCount,
                0, -- IsArchived: Default value as FALSE
                @UserId,
                @CurrentDate,
                @UserId,
                @CurrentDate
            );

            -- Retrieve the new record's ID
            SET @NewIdentity = SCOPE_IDENTITY();

            PRINT 'New channel template created successfully. New ID: ' + CAST(@NewIdentity AS NVARCHAR(10));

            COMMIT TRANSACTION;
            BREAK; -- Exit retry loop on success
        END TRY
        BEGIN CATCH
            -- Capture error details
            SET @ErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();
            SET @ErrorProcedure = ERROR_PROCEDURE();
            SET @ErrorLine = CAST(ERROR_LINE() AS NVARCHAR(10));
            SET @ErrorSeverity = CAST(ERROR_SEVERITY() AS NVARCHAR(10));
            SET @ErrorState = CAST(ERROR_STATE() AS NVARCHAR(10));
            SET @ErrorNumber = CAST(ERROR_NUMBER() AS NVARCHAR(10));

            -- Log the error into tblErrorLog_MobstaAPI
            INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblErrorLog_MobstaAPI] (
                [Message],
                [Type],
                [LogDate],
                [Category],
                [Exception],
                [ActionName],
                [ErrorMessage],
                [ApplicationName]
            )
            VALUES (
                'Error occurred in stored procedure ' + @ThisProcedureName,
                'Stored Procedure',
                GETDATE(),
                'Database Operation',
                'Procedure: ' + ISNULL(@ErrorProcedure, '') + ', Line: ' + @ErrorLine,
                @ThisProcedureName,
                'Error Number: ' + @ErrorNumber + ', Severity: ' + @ErrorSeverity + ', State: ' + @ErrorState + ' - ' + @ErrorMessage,
                'MobStaAPI' 
            );

            -- Handle deadlock error (1205)
            IF ERROR_NUMBER() = 1205 AND @DeadlockErrorRetries < 3
            BEGIN
                ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;
                SET @DeadlockErrorRetries += 1;
                WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00.500'; -- Wait 500 ms before retrying
            END
            ELSE
            BEGIN
                -- Rollback transaction for unrecoverable errors
                ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;
                RAISERROR('An error occurred. Please check the error log.', 16, 1);
                RETURN;
            END
        END CATCH
    END
END;

/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[spCust609ReportsStockOutPackingList]    Script Date: 02/11/2026 17:47:26 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON

SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
-- =============================================    
-- Author:  <Author,,Name>    
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>    
-- Description: <Description,,>    
-- =============================================    
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spCust609ReportsStockOutPackingList]    
(   
 @containerOutPK int  ,
 @userFK int = -1
)   
AS  
BEGIN    
 /* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data; Ensure this proc has a low impact when executed */  
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED; SET DEADLOCK_PRIORITY LOW  
  
    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT  
 ,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;  
 SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();  
  
 -- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters  
 DECLARE @var_containerOutPK int  
 SET @var_containerOutPK = @containerOutPK;  
 SET @ParameterDetails = '@containerOutPK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_containerOutPK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'')  
  
    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL   
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)  
  
    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)  
    --BEGIN  
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC   
  
  SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)  
  
        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)  
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK  
  
        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()  
    --END  
  
 SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);  
 SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails  
 ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;  
 INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()  
  
 WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3  
 BEGIN   
  BEGIN TRY     
  
   -- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start   
     
   DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #tmpPackingListContainerOut  
   SELECT * INTO #tmpPackingListContainerOut   
   FROM tblcontainerouts   
   WHERE ContainerOutPK=@var_containerOutPK  
  
   DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #tmpPackingListContainerOutLines  
   SELECT col.*   
   INTO #tmpPackingListContainerOutLines   
   FROM tblcontaineroutLines col   
   INNER JOIN #tmpPackingListContainerOut ON containeroutfk = containeroutpk  
     
   DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #tmpPackingListCOLPC  
   Select colpc.ContainerOutLineFK, colpc.PalletFK, pc.DateOfManufacture, sum(colpc.Units) Units 
   --,col.Free1 as UnitsOrdered ----Pritesh
   INTO #tmpPackingListCOLPC  
   From tblContainerOutLinePalletContent colpc  
   inner join tblPalletContent pc ON pc.PalletContentPK = colpc.PalletContentFK  
   INNER JOIN #tmpPackingListContainerOutLines col ON colpc.ContainerOutLineFK = col.ContainerOutLinePK  
   Group By ContainerOutLineFK, colpc.PalletFK, pc.DateOfManufacture --,col.Free1---Pritesh 
  
   DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #tmpPackingListPA  
   Select 1 PalletsOut, pa.PalletFK, EventFK  
   INTO #tmpPackingListPA  
   from tblPalletAudit pa  
   INNER JOIN #tmpPackingListCOLPC colpc on pa.EventFK = colpc.ContainerOutLineFK AND pa.PalletFK = colpc.PalletFK  
   Where EventTypeFK = 2  
   Group By EventFK, pa.PalletFK  
  
   select GoodsOrderNumber, CollectionDate, StockItemCode, 
   Free1  ,---PRitesh
   sum(Units)Units,
  
   Address1, Address2, Address3, Address4, Address5, County, Country, Description,   
   DocketLabel1, DocketValue1, DocketLabel2, DocketValue2, DocketLabel3, DocketValue3  ,	OrderReference,	DeliveryReference
   from (  
    Select GoodsOrderNumber,   
    cOuts.CollectionDate,   
    sis.StockItemCode,  
    colpc.Units, 
	cols.Free1,----PRitesh
    dbo.propercase(cOuts.Address1) Address1,   
    dbo.propercase(cOuts.Address2) Address2,   
    dbo.propercase(cOuts.Address3) Address3,   
    dbo.propercase(cOuts.Address4) Address4,   
    dbo.propercase(cOuts.Address5) Address5,   
    dbo.propercase(counties.County) County,   
    dbo.propercase(countries.Country) Country,  
    dbo.propercase(case when sis.StockItemCodeAlias1 = '' then sis.Description else sis.StockItemCodeAlias1 end) [Description],   
    cOuts.DocketLabel1, cOuts.DocketValue1,  
    cOuts.DocketLabel2, cOuts.DocketValue2,  
    cOuts.DocketLabel3, cOuts.DocketValue3,
	coalesce(do.OrderReference, GoodsOrderNumber) as OrderReference,
	do.DeliveryReference
     
    FROM #tmpPackingListContainerOut cOuts    
    inner join #tmpPackingListContainerOutLines cols ON cols.ContainerOutFK = cOuts.ContainerOutPK     
    inner join tblStockItems sis on sis.StockItemPK = cols.StockItemFK    
    left outer join tblCounties counties on counties.CountyPK = cOuts.CountyFK    
    left outer join tblCountries countries on countries.CountryPK = cOuts.CountryFK    
    left outer join #tmpPackingListCOLPC colpc on colpc.ContainerOutLineFK = cols.ContainerOutLinePK  
    left outer join #tmpPackingListPA palletsOutPA on palletsOutPA.EventFK = cols.ContainerOutLinePK AND palletsOutPA.PalletFK = colpc.PalletFK 
	left join tblDistributionOrders do on do.DistributionOrderPK = cOuts.DistributionOrderFK
    Where ContainerOutPK = @var_containerOutPK   
   )subquery  
   group by GoodsOrderNumber, CollectionDate, StockItemCode,  
   Address1, Address2, Address3, Address4, Address5, County, Country, Description,      
   DocketLabel1, DocketValue1, DocketLabel2, DocketValue2,DocketLabel3, DocketValue3,Free1  ,
	OrderReference,
	DeliveryReference
   Order By StockItemCode  
  
   -- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end  
   BREAK  
  END TRY  
  BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */  
   DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;  
   SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;  
   SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;  
  
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY   
   BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;  
         
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;  
  
            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID  
              
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;  
              
   IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)  
   BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END  
   ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */  
  END CATCH  
  SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1  
 END  
END
GO

				from tblStockItemLayerHeights where StockItemFK = @stockItemPK2
				Set @height = (CEILING(@units2 / @layerUnits) * @layerHeight) + (@systemStandardPalletHeight) + @heightMargin
			END

			if(EXISTS(Select * from tblStockItemHeights where StockItemFK = @stockItemPK2)) 
			BEGIN
				--We have height records.. note this will over write any heights calculated previously as these records are more exact
				Select Top 1 @height = Height + @heightMargin from tblStockItemHeights
				Where StockItemFK = @stockItemPK2 AND Units >= @units2
				Order By Units ASC
			END

			Print 'Height ' + cast(@height as nvarchar(300))

			IF @height < 1
			BEGIN
				SET @height = 1
				Print 'Height value reset to ' + cast(@height as nvarchar(300))
			END	

			--Get the order by information - DETERMINES LOCATIONS PICKED
			Select Top 1 @orderBy1 = cast(AutoPlaceRuleType as nvarchar(300)) + cast(ValueFK as nvarchar(300))
			From tblAutoPlaceRules aprs
			inner join tblAutoPlaceRuleTypes aprts on
			aprts.AutoPlaceRuleTypePK = aprs.AutoPlaceRuleTypeFK
			Where (RuleReceiverTypeFK = 1 /*Customer*/ AND AutoPlaceRuleReceiverFK = @customerFK AND RuleOrder = 1)
			OR (RuleReceiverTypeFK = 2 /*Division*/ AND AutoPlaceRuleReceiverFK = @divisionFK AND RuleOrder = 1)
			OR (RuleReceiverTypeFK = 3 /*Stock*/ AND AutoPlaceRuleReceiverFK = @stockItemPK2 AND RuleOrder = 1)
			Order By RuleReceiverTypeFK DESC

			Select Top 1 @orderBy2 = cast(AutoPlaceRuleType as nvarchar(300)) + cast(ValueFK as nvarchar(300))
			From tblAutoPlaceRules aprs
			inner join tblAutoPlaceRuleTypes aprts on
			aprts.AutoPlaceRuleTypePK = aprs.AutoPlaceRuleTypeFK
			Where (RuleReceiverTypeFK = 1 /*Customer*/ AND AutoPlaceRuleReceiverFK = @customerFK AND RuleOrder = 2)
			OR (RuleReceiverTypeFK = 2 /*Division*/ AND AutoPlaceRuleReceiverFK = @divisionFK AND RuleOrder = 2)
			OR (RuleReceiverTypeFK = 3 /*Stock*/ AND AutoPlaceRuleReceiverFK = @stockItemPK2 AND RuleOrder = 2)
			Order By RuleReceiverTypeFK DESC

			Select Top 1 @orderBy3 = cast(AutoPlaceRuleType as nvarchar(300)) + cast(ValueFK as nvarchar(300))
			From tblAutoPlaceRules aprs
			inner join tblAutoPlaceRuleTypes aprts on
			aprts.AutoPlaceRuleTypePK = aprs.AutoPlaceRuleTypeFK
			Where (RuleReceiverTypeFK = 1 /*Customer*/ AND AutoPlaceRuleReceiverFK = @customerFK AND RuleOrder = 3)
			OR (RuleReceiverTypeFK = 2 /*Division*/ AND AutoPlaceRuleReceiverFK = @divisionFK AND RuleOrder = 3)
			OR (RuleReceiverTypeFK = 3 /*Stock*/ AND AutoPlaceRuleReceiverFK = @stockItemPK2 AND RuleOrder = 3)
			Order By RuleReceiverTypeFK DESC

			Select Top 1 @orderBy4 = cast(AutoPlaceRuleType as nvarchar(300)) + cast(ValueFK as nvarchar(300))
			From tblAutoPlaceRules aprs
			inner join tblAutoPlaceRuleTypes aprts on
			aprts.AutoPlaceRuleTypePK = aprs.AutoPlaceRuleTypeFK
			Where (RuleReceiverTypeFK = 1 /*Customer*/ AND AutoPlaceRuleReceiverFK = @customerFK AND RuleOrder = 4)
			OR (RuleReceiverTypeFK = 2 /*Division*/ AND AutoPlaceRuleReceiverFK = @divisionFK AND RuleOrder = 4)
			OR (RuleReceiverTypeFK = 3 /*Stock*/ AND AutoPlaceRuleReceiverFK = @stockItemPK2 AND RuleOrder = 4)
			Order By RuleReceiverTypeFK DESC

		--	Print @orderBy1

			if(@customWidth > 0 AND @customDepth > 0) 
			BEGIN
				Select @width = @customWidth + (@widthMargin * 2), @depth = @customDepth + (@depthMargin * 2)
			END 
			ELSE

				from tblPalletTypes
				Where PalletTypePK = @palletTypePK2
			END

			print 'width ' + cast(@width as nvarchar(50))
			print 'depth ' + cast(@depth as nvarchar(50))

			Select @autoRackingTypeFK = AutomatedRackingTypeFK, @buildingUnitDisperseBatch = DisperseBatch, @buildingUnitRows = Count(*), @buildingUnit = BuildingUnit 
			from tblBuildingUnits bus
			Inner join tblBuildingUnitRows buRows
			on
			buRows.BuildingUnitFK = bus.BuildingUnitPK
			AND buRows.RackingtypeFK = bus.AutomatedRackingTypeFK
			AND buRows.IsArchived = 0		/* DG #DEV-910 Exclude Archived Bays (Rows)*/
			where BuildingUnitPK = @buildingUnitPK2
			Group By AutomatedRackingTypeFK, DisperseBatch, BuildingUnit
