-- Locations FOR THERABEL
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spCustomer706PalletLocationsGetRackingLocations]
(
	@palletPK int, --if PalletPK is supplied, this indicates a mixed pallet, extra code to run to get other stock restrictions, margins etc
	@stockItemPK int,
	@palletTypePK int,
	@buildingUnitPK int,
	@numberOfLocations int,
	@batch nvarchar(200),
	@units decimal(18,3),
	@previousFirstBuildingUnitColumn int,
	@previousLastBuildingUnitColumn int,
	@previousFirstBuildingUnitRow nvarchar(50),
	@previousLastBuildingUnitRow nvarchar(50)
)
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT
 ,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;
	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	DECLARE @palletPK2 int,
	@stockItemPK2 int,
	@palletTypePK2 int,
	@buildingUnitPK2 int,
	@numberOfLocations2 int,
	@batch2 nvarchar(200),
	@units2 decimal(18,3),
	@previousFirstBuildingUnitColumn2 int,
	@previousLastBuildingUnitColumn2 int,
	@previousFirstBuildingUnitRow2 nvarchar(50),
	@previousLastBuildingUnitRow2 nvarchar(50)

	SET @palletPK2 = @palletPK;SET @stockItemPK2 = @stockItemPK; SET @palletTypePK2 = @palletTypePK; SET @buildingUnitPK2 = @buildingUnitPK
	SET @numberOfLocations2 = @numberOfLocations; SET @batch2 = @batch; SET @units2 = @units; SET @previousFirstBuildingUnitColumn2 = @previousFirstBuildingUnitColumn
	SET @previousLastBuildingUnitColumn2 = @previousLastBuildingUnitColumn; SET @previousFirstBuildingUnitRow2 = @previousFirstBuildingUnitRow
	SET @previousLastBuildingUnitRow2 = @previousLastBuildingUnitRow

	SET @ParameterDetails = '@palletPK =  = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@palletPK2 AS NVARCHAR(20)),'') + ',@stockItemPK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@stockItemPK2 AS NVARCHAR(20)),'')
		+ ',@palletTypePK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@palletTypePK2 AS NVARCHAR(20)),'') + ',@buildingUnitPK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@buildingUnitPK2 AS NVARCHAR(20)),'')
			+ ',@numberOfLocations = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@numberOfLocations2 AS NVARCHAR(20)),'') + ',@batch = ' + ISNULL(@batch2,'') + ',@units = ' + ISNULL(@units2,'')
				+ ',@previousFirstBuildingUnitColumn = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@previousFirstBuildingUnitColumn2 AS NVARCHAR(20)),'')
					+ ',@previousLastBuildingUnitColumn = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@previousLastBuildingUnitColumn2 AS NVARCHAR(20)),'')
						+ ',@previousFirstBuildingUnitRow = ' + ISNULL(@previousFirstBuildingUnitRow2,'')
							+ ',@previousLastBuildingUnitRow = ' + ISNULL(@previousLastBuildingUnitRow2,'')

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    --BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

		SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END


	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY
			IF XACT_STATE() = 0 AND @@TRANCOUNT < 1 BEGIN TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start

			Declare @restrictSql nvarchar(MAX)
			Declare @sql nvarchar(MAX)
			Declare @thisLineSql nvarchar(MAX)
			Set @sql = '' --initialize
			Set @thisLineSql = '' --initialize

			Declare @prohibitTopLevelRacking as bit
			Declare @unstable3 as bit
			Declare @unstable2 as bit
			Declare @unstable1 as bit
			Declare @widthMargin int
			Declare @depthMargin int
			Declare @width int
			Declare @depth int
			Declare @height int
			Declare @defaultUnits decimal(18,3)
			--Declare @systemStandardPalletHeight int
			Declare @overrideBuildingUnitRules bit
			Declare @stockDisperseBatch bit
			Declare @keepBatchTogetherLevel1 bit
			Declare @keepBatchTogetherLevel2 bit
			Declare @keepBatchTogetherLevel3 bit
			Declare @keepBatchTogetherLevel4 bit
			Declare @divisionFK int

			Declare @disperseBatch bit

			Declare @buildingUnit nvarchar(200)
			Declare @buildingUnitDisperseBatch bit

			Declare @autoRackingTypeFK int, @buildingUnitRows int

			Declare @originalNumberOfLocations int

			if(@palletPK2 = -1) --no mixed pallet
			BEGIN
				Select @prohibitTopLevelRacking = ProhibitTopLevelRacking,
				@unstable3 = Unstable3,
				@unstable2 = Unstable2,
				@unstable1 = Unstable1,
				@widthMargin = WidthMargin,
				@depthMargin = DepthMargin,
				@overrideBuildingUnitRules = OverrideBuildingUnitRules,
				@stockDisperseBatch = DisperseBatch,
				@keepBatchTogetherLevel1 = KeepBatchTogetherLevel1,
				@keepBatchTogetherLevel2 = KeepBatchTogetherLevel2,
				@keepBatchTogetherLevel3 = KeepBatchTogetherLevel3,
				@keepBatchTogetherLevel4 = KeepBatchTogetherLevel4,
				@divisionFK = DivisionFK
				From tblStockItems stockItems
				Where StockItemPK = @stockItemPK2

				--Get the height is available
				if(EXISTS(Select * from tblStockItemHeights where StockItemFK = @stockItemPK2)) --if we have some height records
				BEGIN
					Select Top 1 @height = Height from tblStockItemHeights
					Where StockItemFK = @stockItemPK2 AND Units >= @units2
					Order By Units ASC
				END ELSE BEGIN
					Set @height = 0
				END
			END
			ELSE
			BEGIN
				Select 
				@prohibitTopLevelRacking = case when sum(cast(ProhibitTopLevelRacking as int)) > 0
				then 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/ else 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ End,
				@unstable3 = case when sum(cast(Unstable3 as int)) > 0
				then 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/ else 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ End,
				@unstable2 = case when sum(cast(Unstable2 as int)) > 0
				then 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/ else 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ End,
				@unstable1 = case when sum(cast(Unstable1 as int)) > 0
				then 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/ else 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ End,
				@widthMargin = Max(WidthMargin),
				@depthMargin = Max(DepthMargin),
				@overrideBuildingUnitRules = case when sum(cast(OverrideBuildingUnitRules as int)) > 0
				then 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/ else 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ End,
				@stockDisperseBatch = case when sum(cast(OverrideBuildingUnitRules as int)) = count(*)
				then 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ else 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/ End,
				@keepBatchTogetherLevel1 = case when sum(cast(KeepBatchTogetherLevel1 as int)) = count(*)
				then 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ else 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/ End,
				@keepBatchTogetherLevel2 = case when sum(cast(KeepBatchTogetherLevel2 as int)) = count(*)
				then 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ else 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/ End,
				@keepBatchTogetherLevel3 = case when sum(cast(KeepBatchTogetherLevel3 as int)) = count(*)
				then 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ else 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/ End,
				@keepBatchTogetherLevel4 = case when sum(cast(KeepBatchTogetherLevel4 as int)) = count(*)
				then 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ else 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/ End
				From tblPallets pallets
				inner join tblPalletContent palletContent
				on palletContent.PalletFK = pallets.PalletPK
				inner join tblStockItems stockItems
				on stockItems.StockItemPK = palletContent.StockItemFK
		
				Where PalletPK = @palletPK2
			END
		--  /*TESTING*/
		--	Print @prohibitTopLevelRacking
		--	Print @unstable3
		--	Print @unstable2
		--	Print @unstable1
		--	Print @depthMargin
		--	Print @height
		--	Print @overrideBuildingUnitRules

			Select @width = Width + (case when @widthMargin > 0 then (@widthMargin * 2) else (WidthMargin*2) end), 
				@depth = Depth + (case when @depthMargin > 0 then (@depthMargin * 2) else (DepthMargin*2) end)
			from tblPalletTypes
			Where PalletTypePK = @palletTypePK2

			print 'width ' + cast(@width as nvarchar(50))
			print 'depth ' + cast(@depth as nvarchar(50))

			Select @autoRackingTypeFK = AutomatedRackingTypeFK, @buildingUnitDisperseBatch = DisperseBatch, @buildingUnitRows = Count(*), @buildingUnit = BuildingUnit 
			from tblBuildingUnits bus
			Inner join tblBuildingUnitRows buRows
			on
			buRows.BuildingUnitFK = bus.BuildingUnitPK
			AND buRows.RackingtypeFK = bus.AutomatedRackingTypeFK 
			AND buRows.IsArchived = 0		/* DG #DEV-910 Exclude Archived Bays (Rows)*/
			where BuildingUnitPK = @buildingUnitPK2
			Group By AutomatedRackingTypeFK, DisperseBatch, BuildingUnit

			if (@autoRackingTypeFK = 1/*Conventional*/)
			BEGIN
		
				DECLARE BayCursor CURSOR FAST_FORWARD FOR 
				Select Distinct BuildingUnitBayPK, Row, subQ.BuildingUnitColumn, BuildingUnitColumnName, BayLevel, GapBetweenPallets, GapBetweenPalletsBayPosition, 
				GapBetweenPalletsPalletStart, 
				GapToEndOfBay, EndBayPosition, EndBayPalletStart, 
				GapToStartOfBay, StartBayPosition, StartBayPalletStart, 
				GapWholeBay, WholeBayPosition, WholeBayPalletStart, 
				Height as LocationOrder, sifls.BayPosition as FixedBayPosition, sifls.LocationStart, sifls.LocationEnd  from (
				Select buBays.BuildingUnitBayPK, 
					buRows.Row,
					buCols.BuildingUnitColumn,
					buCols.BuildingUnitColumnName,
					buBays.BayLevel,
					buBays.Width,
					buBays.MinimumDepth,
					buBays.MaximumDepth,
					buBays.Height,
					pallets.PalletPK, 
					pallets.PalletStart, 
					pallets.PalletEnd,
					pallets.BayPosition, 
					isnull(gapRight.PalletStart - pallets.PalletEnd,0) as GapBetweenPallets, 
					case isnull(gapRight.PalletStart,0) when 0 then null else pallets.BayPosition + 1 END as GapBetweenPalletsBayPosition,
					case isnull(gapRight.PalletStart,0) when 0 then null else pallets.PalletEnd END as GapBetweenPalletsPalletStart,
					case when pallets.BayPosition = lastPallet.BayPosition then (buBays.Width - lastPallet.PalletEnd) else 0 End as GapToEndOfBay, /*Only Show this for last pallet*/
					case isnull(lastPallet.PalletEnd, 0) when 0 then null else lastPallet.BayPosition + 1 END as EndBayPosition,
					case isnull(lastPallet.PalletEnd, 0) when 0 then null else lastPallet.PalletEnd END as EndBayPalletStart,
					case when pallets.BayPosition = firstPallet.BayPosition then firstPallet.PalletStart else 0 End as GapToStartOfBay,
					case isnull(firstPallet.PalletStart, 0) when 0 then null else 1 END as StartBayPosition,
					0 as StartBayPalletStart,
					case isnull(pallets.PalletPK,0) when 0 then buBays.Width else 0 End as GapWholeBay,
					case isnull(pallets.PalletPK, 0) when 0 then 1 else 0 END as WholeBayPosition,
					0 as WholeBayPalletStart
				from tblBuildingUnitBays buBays
				inner join tblBuildingUnitColumns buCols on
				buCols.BuildingUnitColumnPK = buBays.BuildingUnitColumnFK

				inner join tblBuildingUnitRows buRows on
				buRows.BuildingUnitRowPK = buCols.BuildingUnitRowFK

				left outer join (
					Select PalletPK, LocationTypeFK, LocationFK, PalletTypeFK, BayPosition, PalletStart, PalletEnd, StackPosition
					From tblPallets 
					Union
					Select PalletFK, DestinationLocationTypeFK, DestinationFK, palletsUnion.PalletTypeFK, DestinationBayPosition, DestinationPalletStart, 
					DestinationPalletEnd, 0 as StackPosition
					From tblWorksOrderMovements woms
						inner join tblPallets palletsUnion on
						palletsUnion.PalletPK = woms.PalletFK
						Where woms.WorksOrderStatusFK < 3 /*Not complete or cancelled*/
					) pallets on
					pallets.LocationTypeFK = 1
					AND pallets.StackPosition <= 0
					AND pallets.LocationFK = buBays.BuildingUnitBayPK

				left outer join (
					Select PalletPK, LocationTypeFK, LocationFK, PalletTypeFK, BayPosition, PalletStart, PalletEnd, StackPosition
					From tblPallets 
					Union
					Select PalletFK, DestinationLocationTypeFK, DestinationFK, palletsUnion.PalletTypeFK, DestinationBayPosition, DestinationPalletStart, 
					DestinationPalletEnd, 0 as StackPosition
					From tblWorksOrderMovements woms
						inner join tblPallets palletsUnion on
						palletsUnion.PalletPK = woms.PalletFK
						Where woms.WorksOrderStatusFK < 3 /*Not complete or cancelled*/
					) gapRight on
					gapRight.LocationTypeFK = 1
					AND gapRight.StackPosition <= 0
					AND gapRight.LocationFK = pallets.LocationFK
					AND gapRight.PalletStart = (Select Top 1 PalletStart From (Select PalletStart, LocationFK From tblPallets union Select DestinationPalletStart, 
					DestinationFK from tblWorksOrderMovements where WorksOrderStatusFK < 3)subQNoName where LocationFK = pallets.LocationFK AND PalletStart >= pallets.PalletEnd 
					order by PalletStart ASC)
					AND gapRight.PalletStart <> pallets.PalletEnd

				left outer join (Select Max(BayPosition) BayPosition, LocationTypeFK, LocationFK, StackPosition, Max(PalletEnd) as PalletEnd
				from (
					Select PalletPK, LocationTypeFK, LocationFK, PalletTypeFK, BayPosition, PalletStart, PalletEnd, StackPosition
					From tblPallets 
					Union
					Select PalletFK, DestinationLocationTypeFK, DestinationFK, palletsUnion.PalletTypeFK, DestinationBayPosition, DestinationPalletStart, 
					DestinationPalletEnd, 0 as StackPosition
					From tblWorksOrderMovements woms
						inner join tblPallets palletsUnion on
						palletsUnion.PalletPK = woms.PalletFK
						Where woms.WorksOrderStatusFK < 3 /*Not complete or cancelled*/
					) subQLastPallets
						Group By LocationTypeFK, LocationFK, StackPosition) lastPallet on
					lastPallet.LocationTypeFK = 1
					AND lastPallet.StackPosition <= 0
					AND lastPallet.LocationFK = pallets.LocationFK
					AND lastPallet.PalletEnd <> buBays.Width

				left outer join (Select Min(BayPosition) BayPosition, LocationTypeFK, LocationFK, StackPosition, Min(PalletStart) as PalletStart 
					from (
					Select PalletPK, LocationTypeFK, LocationFK, PalletTypeFK, BayPosition, PalletStart, PalletEnd, StackPosition
					From tblPallets 
					Union
					Select PalletFK, DestinationLocationTypeFK, DestinationFK, palletsUnion.PalletTypeFK, DestinationBayPosition, DestinationPalletStart, 
					DestinationPalletEnd, 0 as StackPosition
					From tblWorksOrderMovements woms
						inner join tblPallets palletsUnion on
						palletsUnion.PalletPK = woms.PalletFK
						Where woms.WorksOrderStatusFK < 3 /*Not complete or cancelled*/
					) subQfirstPallet 
						Group By LocationTypeFK, LocationFK, StackPosition) firstPallet on
					firstPallet.LocationTypeFK = 1
					AND firstPallet.StackPosition <= 0
					AND firstPallet.PalletStart <> 0
					AND firstPallet.LocationFK = pallets.LocationFK

				Where buRows.BuildingUnitFK = @buildingUnitPK2
				AND buRows.RackingTypeFK = @autoRackingTypeFK
				AND ASCII(buBays.BayLevel) - 64 < /*Not Top Level*/
					Case when @prohibitTopLevelRacking = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ Then buCols.Levels Else 99999 End
				AND ASCII(buBays.BayLevel) <= 
					Case when @unstable1 = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ Then 67 /*Less than or equal to Level C*/
					Else 99999 End
				AND ASCII(buBays.BayLevel) <= 
					Case when @unstable2 = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ Then 66 /*Less than or equal to Level B*/
					Else 99999 End
				AND ASCII(buBays.BayLevel) <= 
					Case when @unstable3 = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ Then 65 /*Level A Only*/
					Else 99999 End
				AND buBays.IsArchived = 0 /* DG #DEV-910 Exclude Archived Bays*/
		--		AND BuildingUnitBayPK not in ( 
		--				Select woms.DestinationFK from tblWorksOrderMovements woms
		--					Where woms.DestinationLocationTypeFK = 1/*BuildingUnitBay*/
		--					AND woms.WorksOrderStatusFK < 3 /*Not complete or cancelled*/
		--				)

				) subQ

				--**FIXED LOCATIONS
				left outer join tblStockItemFixedLocations sifls on
				sifls.StockItemFK = @stockItemPK2
				AND (sifls.BuildingUnitBayFK = BuildingUnitBayPK)
				AND (LocationEnd >= (LocationStart + @width))
				AND (isnull(GapWholeBay, 0) > 0 
					OR (LocationStart >= GapBetweenPalletsPalletStart AND LocationEnd <= (GapBetweenPalletsPalletStart + GapBetweenPallets))
					OR (LocationEnd <= GapToStartOfBay) 
					OR (LocationStart >= isnull(EndBayPalletStart, -1) AND LocationEnd <= (EndBayPalletStart + GapToEndOfBay))
				)

				--FixedLocation Column Restraint.. only use this fixed column and greater
				left outer join 
				(
					Select Top 1 subSifls.*, subBuCols.BuildingUnitColumn from tblStockItemFixedLocations subSifls
					inner join tblBuildingUnitColumns subBuCols on
					subBuCols.BuildingUnitColumnPK = subSifls.BuildingUnitColumnFK
					Where StockItemFK = @stockItemPK2
				)
				siflColumnRestraint on 1=1
		
				Where /*Check for this divisions assigned bays*/
						(BuildingUnitBayPK in 
							(Select dbuBays.BuildingUnitBayFK 
							 From tblDivisionBuildingUnitBays dbuBays
							 Where DivisionFK = @divisionFK AND dbuBays.BuildingUnitFK = @buildingUnitPK2 AND dbuBays.IsArchived = 0)  /* DG #DEV-543 Exclude Archived Bays*/
						 OR (0 = (Select count(*) 
								  From tblDivisionBuildingUnitBays
								  Where DivisionFK = @divisionFK AND BuildingUnitFK = @buildingUnitPK2 AND IsArchived = 0)))	/* DG #DEV-543 Exclude Archived Bays*/
					  /*Check this bay is not exclusively assigned to any other division*/
					AND BuildingUnitBayPK not in 
						(Select dbuBays.BuildingUnitBayFK 
						 From tblDivisionBuildingUnitBays dbuBays
						 Where DivisionFK <> @divisionFK AND IsExclusive = 1 /*cast(1 as bit)*/ 
						       AND dbuBays.BuildingUnitFK = @buildingUnitPK2 AND dbuBays.IsArchived = 0)	/* DG #DEV-543 Exclude Archived Bays*/
					AND (GapBetweenPallets >=@width
					OR GapToEndOfBay >= @width
					OR GapToStartOfBay >= @width
					OR GapWholeBay >= @width)
				AND (MaximumDepth >= @depth /*Maximum Depth*/
				AND MinimumDepth <= @depth) /*Minimum Depth*/
				AND Height >= @height
		--		AND (sifls.StockItemFixedLocationPK is not null
		--			OR BayLevel in ('C')
		--		)
				AND isnull(siflColumnRestraint.BuildingUnitColumn, 0) <= subQ.BuildingUnitColumn

				ORDER BY
					LocationOrder ASC, BuildingUnitColumn DESC, BayLevel ASC

				Declare @buildingUnitBayPK int,
				@buildingUnitRow nvarchar(10), @buildingUnitColumn int, @buildingUnitColumnName nvarchar(50), @buildingUnitBayLevel nvarchar(10), 
				@gapBetweenPallets int, @gapBetweenPalletsBayPosition int, @gapBetweenPalletsPalletStart int, 
				@gapToEndOfBay int, @endBayPosition int, @endBayPalletStart int, 
				@gapToStartOfBay int, @startBayPosition int, @startBayPalletStart int, 
				@gapWholeBay int, @wholeBayPosition int, @wholeBayPalletStart int, 
				@locationOrder int, @fixedBayPosition int, @locationStart int, @locationEnd int

				Declare @previousBuildingUnitColumn int

				OPEN BayCursor
			
				FETCH NEXT FROM BayCursor INTO 
				@buildingUnitBayPK, 
				@buildingUnitRow, @buildingUnitColumn, @buildingUnitColumnName, @buildingUnitBayLevel, 
				@gapBetweenPallets, @gapBetweenPalletsBayPosition, @gapBetweenPalletsPalletStart, 
				@gapToEndOfBay, @endBayPosition, @endBayPalletStart, 
				@gapToStartOfBay, @startBayPosition, @startBayPalletStart, 
				@gapWholeBay, @wholeBayPosition, @wholeBayPalletStart, 
				@locationOrder, @fixedBayPosition, @locationStart, @locationEnd

				Declare @availableSpace bit
				Declare @availableGap int
				Declare @bayPosition int
				Declare @palletStart int
				Declare @gapType as nvarchar(50)/* whole, between, start, end*/
				Declare @firstRun int
				Set @firstRun = 1
				Set @availableSpace = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/
				--Print @@FETCH_STATUS
				Set @originalNumberOfLocations = @numberOfLocations2
				Set @previousBuildingUnitColumn = -1
		
				WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 AND @numberOfLocations2 > 0
				BEGIN
					Print 'Began Loop'
					Print isnull(@gapWholeBay, -1)
					Print isnull(@gapBetweenPalletsPalletStart, -1)
					Print isnull(@gapBetweenPallets, -1)
					Print isnull(@gapToStartOfBay, -1)
					Print isnull(@endBayPalletStart, -1)
					Print isnull(@gapToEndOfBay, -1)
					Print isnull(@fixedBayPosition, -1)

					Set @availableSpace = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ 
					if(@fixedBayPosition is null)
					BEGIN
						IF (@gapWholeBay > 0)
						BEGIN
							Set @bayPosition = 1
							Set @palletStart = 0
							Set @availableGap = @gapWholeBay
							Set @gapType = 'whole'
						END
						ELSE IF @gapBetweenPallets >= @width
						BEGIN
							Set @bayPosition = @gapBetweenPalletsBayPosition
							Set @palletStart = @gapBetweenPalletsPalletStart
							Set @availableGap = @gapBetweenPallets
							Set @gapType = 'between'
						END
						ELSE IF (@gapToStartOfBay >= @width)
						BEGIN
							Set @bayPosition = @startBayPosition
							Set @palletStart = 0
							Set @availableGap = @gapToStartOfBay
							Set @gapType = 'start'
						END
						ELSE IF (@gapToEndOfBay >= @width)
						BEGIN
							Set @bayPosition = @endBayPosition
							Set @palletStart = @endBayPalletStart
							Set @availableGap = @gapToEndOfBay
							Set @gapType = 'end'
						END
					END ELSE
					BEGIN --FIXED LOCATION
						IF (@gapWholeBay > 0)
						BEGIN
							Set @bayPosition = @fixedBayPosition
							Set @palletStart = @locationStart
							Set @availableGap = @width
							Set @gapType = 'whole' --the gap type is not neccessarily whole but this ensures the code will not attempt to place another pallet in this bay
						END
						ELSE IF ((@gapToEndOfBay >= @width) OR (@gapToStartOfBay >= @width) OR (@gapBetweenPallets >= @width))
						BEGIN
							if((@locationStart >= @endBayPalletStart AND @locationEnd <= (@endBayPalletStart + @gapToEndOfBay))
								OR (@locationEnd <= @gapToStartOfBay)
								OR (@locationStart >= @gapBetweenPalletsPalletStart AND @locationEnd <= (@gapBetweenPalletsPalletStart + @gapBetweenPallets)))
							BEGIN
								Set @bayPosition = @fixedBayPosition
								Set @palletStart = @locationStart
								Set @availableGap = @width
								Set @gapType = 'whole' --the gap type is not neccessarily whole but this ensures the code will not attempt to place another pallet in this bay
							END
							ELSE
							BEGIN
								Print 'Set3'
								Set @availableSpace = 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/ 
							END
						END
					END			

					WHILE @availableSpace = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ AND @numberOfLocations2 > 0
					BEGIN
						Print 'Began 2nd Loop'				
				
						if @firstRun = 0 
							Set @sql = @sql + ' UNION ALL '

						Set @thisLineSql = ' Select ''' + @buildingUnit + ''' BuildingUnit,''' + @buildingUnitRow + ''' Row,''' + cast(@buildingUnitColumn as nvarchar(10)) 
							+ ''' BuildingUnitColumn,''' + cast(@buildingUnitColumnName as nvarchar(10)) + ''' BuildingUnitColumnName,''' + @buildingUnitBayLevel 
							+ ''' BayLevel,' + cast(@bayPosition as nvarchar(50))	+ ' BayPosition,' + cast(@palletStart as nvarchar(50)) + ' PalletStart,' 
							+ cast((@palletStart + @width) as nvarchar(50)) + ' PalletEnd,' + cast(@buildingUnitBayPK as nvarchar(100)) + ' LocationFK'	
						
						Set @sql = @sql	+ @thisLineSql
						--Print @sql
				
						Set @availableGap = @availableGap - @width
						if (@availableGap < @width) 
						BEGIN
							IF (@gapType = 'whole')
								Set @availableSpace = 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/				
							ELSE IF (@gapType = 'between')
							BEGIN
								IF (@gapToStartOfBay >= @width)
								BEGIN
									Set @bayPosition = @startBayPosition
									Set @palletStart = 0
									Set @availableGap = @gapToStartOfBay
									Set @gapType = 'start'
								END
								ELSE IF (@gapToEndOfBay >= @width)
								BEGIN
									Set @bayPosition = @endBayPosition
									Set @palletStart = @endBayPalletStart
									Set @availableGap = @gapToEndOfBay
									Set @gapType = 'end'
								END
								ELSE Set @availableSpace = 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/	
							END
							ELSE IF (@gapType = 'start')
							BEGIN
								IF (@gapToEndOfBay >= @width)
								BEGIN
									Set @bayPosition = @endBayPosition
									Set @palletStart = @endBayPalletStart
									Set @availableGap = @gapToEndOfBay
									Set @gapType = 'end'
								END
								ELSE Set @availableSpace = 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/	
							END
							ELSE IF (@gapType = 'end')
							BEGIN
								Set @availableSpace = 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/	
							END
				
						END
						ELSE
						BEGIN
							Set @bayPosition = @bayPosition + 1
							Set @palletStart = @palletStart + @width
						END

				
						Set @numberOfLocations2 = @numberOfLocations2 - 1
						Set @firstRun = 0

						/*KEEP BATCH TOGETHER**************/
						if(@overrideBuildingUnitRules = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/)
						BEGIN
							/*Keep batch in one or more adjoining columns*/
							if(@keepBatchTogetherLevel2 = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/)
							BEGIN
								if(@previousBuildingUnitColumn = -1)
								BEGIN
									Set @previousBuildingUnitColumn = @buildingUnitColumn
								END
								ELSE
								BEGIN 
									/* This next 'if' statement is complex */
									/* Explanation*/
									/* If we have skipped a column since the last location 
										AND we have also moved more than one column from
										the columns used for a previous batch location
										AND we havent moved just one column since we were last here then
										we need to start again*/
									if(
										((ABS(@previousBuildingUnitColumn - @buildingUnitColumn) > 1 
										AND @previousFirstBuildingUnitColumn2 = -1)
								
										OR 
											(
											(@previousFirstBuildingUnitColumn2 > 0) AND
											((@buildingUnitColumn > (@previousFirstBuildingUnitColumn2 + 1)
											OR
											(@buildingUnitColumn < (@previousLastBuildingUnitColumn2 - 1)))
											)
										))
										AND ABS(@previousBuildingUnitColumn - @buildingUnitColumn) <> 1
									)
									BEGIN /*If selection has jumped a column, reset and start again*/
										Print 'Starting Again'
										Select @previousBuildingUnitColumn = @buildingUnitColumn,
										@numberOfLocations2 = @originalNumberOfLocations - 1,
										@firstRun = 0,
										@sql = @thisLineSql
									END
								END
							END
						END
					END

					FETCH NEXT FROM BayCursor INTO 
					@buildingUnitBayPK, 
					@buildingUnitRow, @buildingUnitColumn, @buildingUnitColumnName, @buildingUnitBayLevel, 
					@gapBetweenPallets, @gapBetweenPalletsBayPosition, @gapBetweenPalletsPalletStart, 
					@gapToEndOfBay, @endBayPosition, @endBayPalletStart, 
					@gapToStartOfBay, @startBayPosition, @startBayPalletStart, 
					@gapWholeBay, @wholeBayPosition, @wholeBayPalletStart,
					@locationOrder, @fixedBayPosition, @locationStart, @locationEnd
				END
				CLOSE BayCursor 
				DEALLOCATE BayCursor 
			END
			ELSE IF (@autoRackingTypeFK = 2 /*DriveThrough*/)
			BEGIN
				/*Figure Out Batch Disperse Rules*/
				Set @disperseBatch =  @buildingUnitDisperseBatch
				IF @overrideBuildingUnitRules = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ Set @disperseBatch = @stockDisperseBatch	
		
				If @disperseBatch = 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/ AND Exists(SELECT * from (
					Select BuildingUnit, BuildingUnitRowPK, Row, BuildingUnitColumnPK, BuildingUnitColumn, LastBayPosition, Sum(AvailablePallets)AvailablePallets, 
						Rank() over (Partition By Row order by Sum(AvailablePallets) Desc, BuildingUnitColumn) as Rank from (
					Select 
					bus.BuildingUnit,
					buRows.BuildingUnitRowPK,
					buRows.Row,
					buCols.BuildingUnitColumnPK,
					BuildingUnitColumn,
					BayLevel,
					buBays.BuildingUnitBayPK as LocationFK,
					Width - sum(isnull(PalletEnd,0)-isnull(PalletStart,0)) AvailableSpace,
					isnull(bayPositions.LastBayPosition, 0) LastBayPosition,
					Floor((Width - sum(isnull(PalletEnd,0)-isnull(PalletStart,0))) / @width) as AvailablePallets 

					from tblBuildingUnits bus
					inner join tblBuildingUnitRows buRows on
					buRows.BuildingUnitFK = bus.BuildingUnitPK

					inner join tblBuildingUnitColumns buCols on
					buCols.BuildingUnitRowFK = buRows.BuildingUnitRowPK

					inner join tblBuildingUnitBays buBays on
					buBays.BuildingUnitColumnFK = buCols.BuildingUnitColumnPK and bubays.IsArchived = 0

					left outer join 
					(Select Max(BayPosition) LastBayPosition, buCols.BuildingUnitColumnPK from tblBuildingUnitColumns buCols
					inner join tblBuildingUnitBays buBays on
					buBays.BuildingUnitColumnFK = buCols.BuildingUnitColumnPK
					inner join tblPallets pallets on
					pallets.LocationTypeFK = 1/*BuildingUnitBay*/
					AND
					pallets.LocationFK = buBays.BuildingUnitBayPK
					Group By BuildingUnitColumnPK) bayPositions on
					bayPositions.BuildingUnitColumnPK = buCols.BuildingUnitColumnPK

					left outer join tblPallets pallets on
					pallets.LocationTypeFK = 1/*BuildingUnitBay*/
					AND
					LocationFK = buBays.BuildingUnitBayPK

					Where buRows.BuildingUnitFK = @buildingUnitPK2
					AND buBays.MaximumDepth >= @depth
					AND buBays.MinimumDepth <= @depth
					AND buRows.RackingTypeFK = @autoRackingTypeFK
					AND buBays.IsArchived = 0	/* DG #DEV-910 Exclude Archived Bays*/

					group by bus.BuildingUnit,
					buRows.BuildingUnitRowPK,
					buRows.Row,
					buCols.BuildingUnitColumnPK,
					BuildingUnitColumn,
					BayLevel,
					Width,
					buBays.BuildingUnitBayPK,
					bayPositions.LastBayPosition

					) subQuery

					Group By BuildingUnit, BuildingUnitRowPK, Row, BuildingUnitColumnPK, BuildingUnitColumn, LastBayPosition

					) mainQuery

					Where mainQuery.AvailablePallets >= @numberOfLocations2
					AND BuildingUnitColumnPK in (

						Select buCols.BuildingUnitColumnPK from tblPallets pallets 
						inner join tblPAlletContent palletContent
						on palletContent.PalletFK = pallets.PalletPK
						inner join tblBuildingUnitBays buBays
						on
						buBays.BuildingUnitBayPK = pallets.LocationFK
						AND pallets.LocationTypeFK = 1/*Racking*/
						inner join tblBuildingUnitColumns buCols
						on
						buCols.BuildingUnitColumnPK = buBays.BuildingUnitColumnFK
						inner join tblBuildingUnitRows buRows
						on
						buRows.BuildingUnitRowPK = buCols.BuildingUnitRowFK
						Where
						palletContent.Batch = @batch2 AND buRows.BuildingUnitFK = @buildingUnitPK2
						AND palletContent.StockItemFK = @stockItemPK2

						Group By BuildingUnitColumnPK
					)
					/****** DO NOT PICK LOCATION WITH PENDING MOVEMENTS *****/
					AND mainQuery.BuildingUnitColumnPK not in (
					Select buBays.BuildingUnitColumnFK from tblWorksOrderMovements woms
					inner join tblBuildingUnitBays buBays
					on
					buBays.BuildingUnitBayPK = woms.DestinationFK AND buBays.IsArchived = 0	/* DG #DEV-910 Exclude Archived Bays*/
					Where woms.DestinationLocationTypeFK = 1/*BuildingUnitBay*/
					AND woms.WorksOrderStatusFK < 3 /*Not complete or cancelled*/ 
					)
				) 
				BEGIN
					Print 'Found Batch'
					DECLARE ColumnCursor CURSOR FAST_FORWARD FOR 
					Select mainQuery.BuildingUnit, mainQuery.BuildingUnitRowPK, mainQuery.Row, mainQuery.BuildingUnitColumnPK, mainQuery.BuildingUnitColumn, 
					mainQuery.LastBayPosition, mainQuery.AvailablePallets, Rank from (
					Select BuildingUnit, BuildingUnitRowPK, Row, BuildingUnitColumnPK, BuildingUnitColumn, LastBayPosition, Sum(AvailablePallets)AvailablePallets, 
					Rank() over (Partition By Row order by Sum(AvailablePallets) Desc, BuildingUnitColumn) as Rank from (
					Select 
					bus.BuildingUnit,
					buRows.BuildingUnitRowPK,
					buRows.Row,
					buCols.BuildingUnitColumnPK,
					BuildingUnitColumn,
					BayLevel,
					buBays.BuildingUnitBayPK as LocationFK,
					Width - sum(isnull(PalletEnd,0)-isnull(PalletStart,0)) AvailableSpace,
					isnull(bayPositions.LastBayPosition, 0) LastBayPosition,
					Floor((Width - sum(isnull(PalletEnd,0)-isnull(PalletStart,0))) / @width) as AvailablePallets 


					from tblBuildingUnits bus
					inner join tblBuildingUnitRows buRows
					on
					buRows.BuildingUnitFK = bus.BuildingUnitPK

					inner join tblBuildingUnitColumns buCols
					on
					buCols.BuildingUnitRowFK = buRows.BuildingUnitRowPK

					inner join tblBuildingUnitBays buBays
					on
					buBays.BuildingUnitColumnFK = buCols.BuildingUnitColumnPK and buBays.IsArchived=0

					left outer join 
					(Select Max(BayPosition) LastBayPosition, buCols.BuildingUnitColumnPK from tblBuildingUnitColumns buCols
					inner join tblBuildingUnitBays buBays on
					buBays.BuildingUnitColumnFK = buCols.BuildingUnitColumnPK and buBays.IsArchived=0
					inner join tblPallets pallets on
					pallets.LocationTypeFK = 1/*BuildingUnitBay*/
					AND
					pallets.LocationFK = buBays.BuildingUnitBayPK
					Group By BuildingUnitColumnPK) bayPositions on
					bayPositions.BuildingUnitColumnPK = buCols.BuildingUnitColumnPK

					left outer join tblPallets pallets
					on
					pallets.LocationTypeFK = 1/*BuildingUnitBay*/
					AND
					LocationFK = buBays.BuildingUnitBayPK

					Where buRows.BuildingUnitFK = @buildingUnitPK2
					AND buBays.MaximumDepth >= @depth
					AND buBays.MinimumDepth <= @depth
					AND buRows.RackingTypeFK = @autoRackingTypeFK
					AND buBays.IsArchived = 0				/* DG #DEV-910 Exclude Archived Bays*/

					group by bus.BuildingUnit,
					buRows.BuildingUnitRowPK,
					buRows.Row,
					buCols.BuildingUnitColumnPK,
					BuildingUnitColumn,
					BayLevel,
					Width,
					buBays.BuildingUnitBayPK,
					bayPositions.LastBayPosition

					) subQuery

					Group By BuildingUnit, BuildingUnitRowPK, Row, BuildingUnitColumnPK, BuildingUnitColumn, LastBayPosition

					) mainQuery

					Where mainQuery.AvailablePallets >= @numberOfLocations2
					AND BuildingUnitColumnPK in (

						Select buCols.BuildingUnitColumnPK from tblPallets pallets
						inner join tblPAlletContent palletContent
						on palletContent.PalletFK = pallets.PalletPK
 
						inner join tblBuildingUnitBays buBays
						on
						buBays.BuildingUnitBayPK = pallets.LocationFK
						AND pallets.LocationTypeFK = 1/*Racking*/
						inner join tblBuildingUnitColumns buCols
						on
						buCols.BuildingUnitColumnPK = buBays.BuildingUnitColumnFK
						inner join tblBuildingUnitRows buRows
						on
						buRows.BuildingUnitRowPK = buCols.BuildingUnitRowFK
						Where
						palletContent.Batch = @batch2 AND buRows.BuildingUnitFK = @buildingUnitPK2
						AND palletContent.StockItemFK = @stockItemPK2


						Group By BuildingUnitColumnPK
					)
					/****** DO NOT PICK LOCATION WITH PENDING MOVEMENTS *****/
					AND mainQuery.BuildingUnitColumnPK not in (
					Select buBays.BuildingUnitColumnFK from tblWorksOrderMovements woms
					inner join tblBuildingUnitBays buBays
					on
					buBays.BuildingUnitBayPK = woms.DestinationFK  AND buBays.IsArchived = 0 /*DG #DEV-910 Exclude Archived BuildingUnitBay*/
					Where woms.DestinationLocationTypeFK = 1/*BuildingUnitBay*/
					AND woms.WorksOrderStatusFK < 3 /*Not complete or cancelled*/ 
					)

			
				END
				ELSE /*Select any space in building unit, bigger spaces first*/
				BEGIN
					Print 'No Batch Found'
					DECLARE ColumnCursor CURSOR FAST_FORWARD FOR 
					SELECT
					mainQuery.BuildingUnit, mainQuery.BuildingUnitRowPK, mainQuery.Row, mainQuery.BuildingUnitColumnPK, mainQuery.BuildingUnitColumn, 
					mainQuery.LastBayPosition, mainQuery.AvailablePallets, Rank from (
					Select BuildingUnit, BuildingUnitRowPK, Row, BuildingUnitColumnPK, BuildingUnitColumn, LastBayPosition, Sum(AvailablePallets)AvailablePallets, 
					Rank() over (Partition By Row order by Sum(AvailablePallets) Desc, BuildingUnitColumn) as Rank from (
					Select 
					bus.BuildingUnit,
					buRows.BuildingUnitRowPK,
					buRows.Row,
					buCols.BuildingUnitColumnPK,
					BuildingUnitColumn,
					BayLevel,
					buBays.BuildingUnitBayPK as LocationFK,
					Width - sum(isnull(PalletEnd,0)-isnull(PalletStart,0)) AvailableSpace,
					isnull(bayPositions.LastBayPosition, 0) LastBayPosition,
					Floor((Width - sum(isnull(PalletEnd,0)-isnull(PalletStart,0))) / @width) as AvailablePallets 


					from tblBuildingUnits bus
					inner join tblBuildingUnitRows buRows
					on
					buRows.BuildingUnitFK = bus.BuildingUnitPK

					inner join tblBuildingUnitColumns buCols
					on
					buCols.BuildingUnitRowFK = buRows.BuildingUnitRowPK

					inner join tblBuildingUnitBays buBays
					on
					buBays.BuildingUnitColumnFK = buCols.BuildingUnitColumnPK and buBays.IsArchived=0

					left outer join 
					(Select Max(BayPosition) LastBayPosition, buCols.BuildingUnitColumnPK from tblBuildingUnitColumns buCols
					inner join tblBuildingUnitBays buBays on
					buBays.BuildingUnitColumnFK = buCols.BuildingUnitColumnPK AND buBays.IsArchived = 0 /*DG #DEV-910 ExcluDe Archived BuildingUnitBay*/
					inner join tblPallets pallets on
					pallets.LocationTypeFK = 1/*BuildingUnitBay*/
					AND
					pallets.LocationFK = buBays.BuildingUnitBayPK
					Group By BuildingUnitColumnPK) bayPositions on
					bayPositions.BuildingUnitColumnPK = buCols.BuildingUnitColumnPK

					left outer join tblPallets pallets
					on
					pallets.LocationTypeFK = 1/*BuildingUnitBay*/
					AND
					LocationFK = buBays.BuildingUnitBayPK

					Where buRows.BuildingUnitFK = @buildingUnitPK2
					AND buBays.MaximumDepth >= @depth
					AND buBays.MinimumDepth <= @depth
					AND buRows.RackingTypeFK = @autoRackingTypeFK
					AND buBays.IsArchived = 0 /*DG #DEV-910 ExcluDe Archived BuildingUnitBay*/

					group by bus.BuildingUnit,
					buRows.BuildingUnitRowPK,
					buRows.Row,
					buCols.BuildingUnitColumnPK,
					BuildingUnitColumn,
					BayLevel,
					Width,
					buBays.BuildingUnitBayPK,
					bayPositions.LastBayPosition

					) mainQuery

					Group By BuildingUnit, BuildingUnitRowPK, Row, BuildingUnitColumnPK, BuildingUnitColumn, LastBayPosition

					) mainQuery

					Where AvailablePallets > 0
					/****** DO NOT PICK LOCATION WITH PENDING MOVEMENTS *****/
					AND mainQuery.BuildingUnitColumnPK not in (
					Select buBays.BuildingUnitColumnFK from tblWorksOrderMovements woms
					inner join tblBuildingUnitBays buBays
					on
					buBays.BuildingUnitBayPK = woms.DestinationFK  AND buBays.IsArchived = 0 /*DG #DEV-910 ExcluDe Archived BuildingUnitBay*/
					Where woms.DestinationLocationTypeFK = 1/*BuildingUnitBay*/
					AND woms.WorksOrderStatusFK < 3 /*Not complete or cancelled*/ 
					)

					Order By Rank, LastBayPosition
				END --End of batch IF
				
				OPEN ColumnCursor
				Declare @buildingUnitRowPK int, @buildingUnitColumnPK int, 
				@lastBayPosition int, @availablePallets int, @runningAvailability int/*we dont actually need this but to keep the cursor happy*/

				Declare @levels int

				Declare @movesOut int
		
				Declare @locationFK int, @startLevel int, @bayLevel int

				Set @firstRun = 1

				FETCH NEXT FROM ColumnCursor INTO 
				@buildingUnit, @buildingUnitRowPK, @buildingUnitRow, @buildingUnitColumnPK, 
				@buildingUnitColumn, @lastBayPosition, @availablePallets, @runningAvailability
		
				WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
				BEGIN
					Print 'Began Loop'
					Set @movesOut = 0 --initialize moves out
					Select @levels = Levels from tblBuildingUnitColumns where BuildingUnitColumnPK = @buildingUnitColumnPK
					Select Top 1 @locationFK = BuildingUnitBayPK, @palletStart = sum(isnull(PalletEnd,0)-isnull(PalletStart,0)), @startLevel = (ascii(BayLevel) - 64) 
					from tblBuildingUnitBays buBays
					left outer join tblPallets pallets on
					pallets.LocationTypeFK = 1
					AND pallets.LocationFK = buBays.BuildingUnitBayPK
					Where buBays.BuildingUnitColumnFK = @buildingUnitColumnPK
					Group By BuildingUnitBayPK, Width, BayLevel
					Order By buBays.Width - sum(isnull(PalletEnd,0)-isnull(PalletStart,0)) Desc, buBays.BayLevel Desc

					Set @bayLevel = @startLevel

					WHILE @availablePallets > 0 AND @numberOfLocations2 > 0
					BEGIN
						Print 'Began 2nd Loop'
						Set @lastBayPosition = @lastBayPosition + 1
				
						if @firstRun = 0 Set @sql = @sql + ' UNION ALL '
						Set @sql = @sql	+ ' Select ''' + @buildingUnit + ''' BuildingUnit,''' + @buildingUnitRow + ''' Row,''' + @buildingUnitColumn 
						+ ''' BuildingUnitColumn,''' + char(64 + @bayLevel) + ''' BayLevel,' + cast(@lastBayPosition as nvarchar(50))	+ ' BayPosition,' 
						+ cast(@palletStart as nvarchar(50)) + ' PalletStart,' + cast((@palletStart + @width) as nvarchar(50)) + ' PalletEnd,' 
						+ cast(@locationFK as nvarchar(100)) + ' LocationFK'	
						Print @sql
						if @bayLevel = 1
						BEGIN
							Set @bayLevel = @levels
							Set @movesOut = @movesOut + 1
						END
						ELSE
						BEGIN
							Set @bayLevel = @bayLevel - 1
						END
						Select @locationFK = BuildingUnitBayPK, @palletStart = sum(isnull(PalletEnd,0)-isnull(PalletStart,0)), @bayLevel = (ascii(BayLevel) - 64) 
						from tblBuildingUnitBays buBays
						left outer join tblPallets pallets on
						pallets.LocationTypeFK = 1
						AND pallets.LocationFK = buBays.BuildingUnitBayPK
						Where buBays.BuildingUnitColumnFK = @buildingUnitColumnPK
						AND buBays.BayLevel = char(64 + @bayLevel)
						Group By BuildingUnitBayPK, Width, BayLevel
				
						IF @startLevel < @levels --if we started locating below the top level
						BEGIN
							IF @bayLevel > @startLevel
							BEGIN
								Set @palletStart = @palletStart + ((@movesOut - 1) * @width)
							END
							ELSE
							BEGIN
								Set @palletStart = @palletStart + (@movesOut * @width)
							END
						END
						ELSE
						BEGIN
							Set @palletStart = @palletStart + (@movesOut * @width)
						END
					
						Set @availablePallets = @availablePallets - 1 
						Set @numberOfLocations2 = @numberOfLocations2 - 1
						Set @firstRun = 0
					END

					FETCH NEXT FROM ColumnCursor INTO 
					@buildingUnit, @buildingUnitRowPK, @buildingUnitRow, @buildingUnitColumnPK, 
					@buildingUnitColumn, @lastBayPosition, @availablePallets, @runningAvailability
				END
				Print 'Finished Loop'
				CLOSE ColumnCursor 
				DEALLOCATE ColumnCursor 
			END

			Print 'here'
			Print @sql
			Print(len(@sql))

			Exec(@sql)
	
			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end

			
			
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END
GO

	@previousLastBuildingUnitColumn int,

	@previousLastBuildingUnitRow nvarchar(50)
)
AS
BEGIN
