	@units2 decimal(18,3),
	@previousFirstBuildingUnitColumn2 int,
	@previousLastBuildingUnitColumn2 int,
	@previousFirstBuildingUnitRow2 nvarchar(50),
	@previousLastBuildingUnitRow2 nvarchar(50)

	SET @palletPK2 = @palletPK;SET @stockItemPK2 = @stockItemPK; SET @palletTypePK2 = @palletTypePK; SET @buildingUnitPK2 = @buildingUnitPK
	SET @numberOfLocations2 = @numberOfLocations; SET @batch2 = @batch; SET @units2 = @units; SET @previousFirstBuildingUnitColumn2 = @previousFirstBuildingUnitColumn
	SET @previousLastBuildingUnitColumn2 = @previousLastBuildingUnitColumn; SET @previousFirstBuildingUnitRow2 = @previousFirstBuildingUnitRow
	SET @previousLastBuildingUnitRow2 = @previousLastBuildingUnitRow

	SET @ParameterDetails = '@palletPK =  = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@palletPK2 AS NVARCHAR(20)),'') + ',@stockItemPK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@stockItemPK2 AS NVARCHAR(20)),'')
		+ ',@palletTypePK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@palletTypePK2 AS NVARCHAR(20)),'') + ',@buildingUnitPK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@buildingUnitPK2 AS NVARCHAR(20)),'')
			+ ',@numberOfLocations = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@numberOfLocations2 AS NVARCHAR(20)),'') + ',@batch = ' + ISNULL(@batch2,'') + ',@units = ' + ISNULL(@units2,'')
				+ ',@previousFirstBuildingUnitColumn = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@previousFirstBuildingUnitColumn2 AS NVARCHAR(20)),'')
					+ ',@previousLastBuildingUnitColumn = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@previousLastBuildingUnitColumn2 AS NVARCHAR(20)),'')
						+ ',@previousFirstBuildingUnitRow = ' + ISNULL(@previousFirstBuildingUnitRow2,'')
							+ ',@previousLastBuildingUnitRow = ' + ISNULL(@previousLastBuildingUnitRow2,'')

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    --BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

		SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END


	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY
			

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start

			Declare @restrictSql nvarchar(MAX)
			Declare @sql nvarchar(MAX)
			Declare @thisLineSql nvarchar(MAX)
			Set @sql = '' --initialize
			Set @thisLineSql = '' --initialize

			Declare @allowFloorStorage as bit
			Declare @prohibitTopLevelRacking as bit
			Declare @unstable3 as bit
			Declare @unstable2 as bit
			Declare @unstable1 as bit
			Declare @widthMargin int
			Declare @depthMargin int
			Declare @width int
			Declare @depth int
			Declare @height int
			Declare @defaultUnits decimal(18,3)
			--Declare @systemStandardPalletHeight int
			Declare @overrideBuildingUnitRules bit
			Declare @stockDisperseBatch bit
			Declare @keepBatchTogetherLevel1 bit
			Declare @keepBatchTogetherLevel2 bit
			Declare @keepBatchTogetherLevel3 bit
			Declare @keepBatchTogetherLevel4 bit
			Declare @divisionFK int
			Declare @restrictStockWeight bit

			Declare @disperseBatch bit

			Declare @buildingUnit nvarchar(200)
			Declare @buildingUnitDisperseBatch bit

			Declare @autoRackingTypeFK int, @buildingUnitRows int

			Declare @originalNumberOfLocations int
	
			Declare @numberOfRows int
			Declare @currentRow int
			Declare @startColumn int --start column for run of location
			Select @numberOfRows = count(*) from tblBuildingUnitRows where BuildingUnitFK = @buildingUnitPK2 and isarchived=0

		--  The following If has been removed
		--	as the rule for mixed pallets is they have to be the same stock and batch- only the each conent is mixed, so no need for different code
		--	if(@palletPK2 = -1) --no mixed pallet
		--	BEGIN
			Select @allowFloorStorage = AllowFloorStorage, 
			@prohibitTopLevelRacking = ProhibitTopLevelRacking,
			@unstable3 = Unstable3,
			@unstable2 = Unstable2,
			@unstable1 = Unstable1,
			@widthMargin = WidthMargin,
			@depthMargin = DepthMargin,
			@overrideBuildingUnitRules = OverrideBuildingUnitRules,
			@stockDisperseBatch = DisperseBatch,
			@keepBatchTogetherLevel1 = KeepBatchTogetherLevel1,
			@keepBatchTogetherLevel2 = KeepBatchTogetherLevel2,
			@keepBatchTogetherLevel3 = KeepBatchTogetherLevel3,
			@keepBatchTogetherLevel4 = KeepBatchTogetherLevel4,
			@divisionFK = DivisionFK,
			@restrictStockWeight = case when UnitTypeFK in (2/*KGs*/) then 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ else 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/ End
			From tblStockItems stockItems
			Where StockItemPK = @stockItemPK2

			--Get the height is available
			if(EXISTS(Select * from tblStockItemHeights where StockItemFK = @stockItemPK2)) --if we have some height records
			BEGIN
				Select Top 1 @height = Height from tblStockItemHeights
				Where StockItemFK = @stockItemPK2 AND Units >= @units2
				Order By Units ASC
			END ELSE BEGIN
				Set @height = 0
			END
		--	END
		--	ELSE
		--	BEGIN
		--		Select 
		--		@prohibitTopLevelRacking = case when sum(cast(ProhibitTopLevelRacking as int)) > 0
		--		then 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/ else 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ End,
		--		@unstable3 = case when sum(cast(Unstable3 as int)) > 0
		--		then 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/ else 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ End,
		--		@unstable2 = case when sum(cast(Unstable2 as int)) > 0
		--		then 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/ else 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ End,
		--		@unstable1 = case when sum(cast(Unstable1 as int)) > 0
		--		then 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/ else 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ End,
		--		@widthMargin = Max(WidthMargin),
		--		@depthMargin = Max(DepthMargin),
		--		@height = Max(DefaultHeight),
		--		@overrideBuildingUnitRules = case when sum(cast(OverrideBuildingUnitRules as int)) > 0
		--		then 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/ else 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ End,
		--		@stockDisperseBatch = case when sum(cast(OverrideBuildingUnitRules as int)) = count(*)
		--		then 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ else 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/ End,
		--		@keepBatchTogetherLevel1 = case when sum(cast(KeepBatchTogetherLevel1 as int)) = count(*)
		--		then 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ else 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/ End,
		--		@keepBatchTogetherLevel2 = case when sum(cast(KeepBatchTogetherLevel2 as int)) = count(*)
		--		then 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ else 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/ End,
		--		@keepBatchTogetherLevel3 = case when sum(cast(KeepBatchTogetherLevel3 as int)) = count(*)
		--		then 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ else 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/ End,
		--		@keepBatchTogetherLevel4 = case when sum(cast(KeepBatchTogetherLevel4 as int)) = count(*)
		--		then 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ else 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/ End
		--		From tblPallets pallets
		--		inner join tblPalletContent palletContent
		--		on palletContent.PalletFK = pallets.PalletPK
		--		inner join tblStockItems stockItems
		--		on stockItems.StockItemPK = palletContent.StockItemFK
		--		
		--		Where PalletPK = @palletPK2
		--	END
		--  /*TESTING*/
		--	Print @prohibitTopLevelRacking
		--	Print @unstable3
		--	Print @unstable2
		--	Print @unstable1
		--	Print @depthMargin
		--	Print @height
		--	Print @overrideBuildingUnitRules

			Select @width = Width + (case when @widthMargin > 0 then (@widthMargin * 2) else (WidthMargin*2) end), 				
				@depth = Depth + (case when @depthMargin > 0 then (@depthMargin * 2) else (DepthMargin*2) end)
			from tblPalletTypes
			Where PalletTypePK = @palletTypePK2

			print 'width ' + cast(@width as nvarchar(50))
			print 'depth ' + cast(@depth as nvarchar(50))

			Select @autoRackingTypeFK = AutomatedRackingTypeFK, @buildingUnitDisperseBatch = DisperseBatch, @buildingUnitRows = Count(*), @buildingUnit = BuildingUnit 
			from tblBuildingUnits bus
			Inner join tblBuildingUnitRows buRows
			on
			buRows.BuildingUnitFK = bus.BuildingUnitPK
			AND buRows.RackingtypeFK = bus.AutomatedRackingTypeFK
			AND buRows.IsArchived = 0		/* DG #DEV-910 Exclude Archived Bays (Rows)*/
			where BuildingUnitPK = @buildingUnitPK2
			Group By AutomatedRackingTypeFK, DisperseBatch, BuildingUnit

		
			DECLARE BayCursor CURSOR FAST_FORWARD FOR 
			Select Distinct BuildingUnitBayPK, MaximumBayWeight, BayWeight, Row, RowNumber, 
			Translate, TranslatedRow, ReverseTranslate, TranslateColumn,
			subQ.BuildingUnitColumn, BuildingUnitColumnName, MaximumColumnWeight, ColumnWeight, BayLevel, GapBetweenPallets, GapBetweenPalletsBayPosition, 
			GapBetweenPalletsPalletStart, 
			GapToEndOfBay, EndBayPosition, EndBayPalletStart, 
			GapToStartOfBay, StartBayPosition, StartBayPalletStart, 
			GapWholeBay, WholeBayPosition, WholeBayPalletStart, 
			Height as LocationOrder from (
			Select buBays.BuildingUnitBayPK,
				buBays.MaximumWeight as MaximumBayWeight,
				isnull(bayWeight.BayWeight, 0) BayWeight, 
				buRows.Row,
				buRows.RowNumber,
				buRows.Translate,
				buRows.TranslatedRow,
				buRows.ReverseTranslate,
				buRows.TranslateColumn,
				buCols.BuildingUnitColumn,
				buCols.BuildingUnitColumnName,
				buCols.MaximumWeight as MaximumColumnWeight,
				isnull(columnWeight.ColumnWeight, 0) ColumnWeight,
				buBays.BayLevel,
				buBays.Width,
				buBays.MinimumDepth,
				buBays.MaximumDepth,
				buBays.Height,
				pallets.PalletPK, 
				pallets.PalletStart, 
				pallets.PalletEnd,
				pallets.BayPosition, 
				isnull(gapRight.PalletStart - pallets.PalletEnd,0) as GapBetweenPallets, 
				case isnull(gapRight.PalletStart,0) when 0 then null else pallets.BayPosition + 1 END as GapBetweenPalletsBayPosition,
				case isnull(gapRight.PalletStart,0) when 0 then null else pallets.PalletEnd END as GapBetweenPalletsPalletStart,
				case when pallets.BayPosition = lastPallet.BayPosition then (buBays.Width - lastPallet.PalletEnd) else 0 End as GapToEndOfBay, /*Only Show this for last pallet*/
				case isnull(lastPallet.PalletEnd, 0) when 0 then null else lastPallet.BayPosition + 1 END as EndBayPosition,
				case isnull(lastPallet.PalletEnd, 0) when 0 then null else lastPallet.PalletEnd END as EndBayPalletStart,
				case when pallets.BayPosition = firstPallet.BayPosition then firstPallet.PalletStart else 0 End as GapToStartOfBay,
				case isnull(firstPallet.PalletStart, 0) when 0 then null else 1 END as StartBayPosition,
				0 as StartBayPalletStart,
				case isnull(pallets.PalletPK,0) when 0 then buBays.Width else 0 End as GapWholeBay,
				case isnull(pallets.PalletPK, 0) when 0 then 1 else 0 END as WholeBayPosition,
				0 as WholeBayPalletStart
			from tblBuildingUnitBays buBays
			inner join tblBuildingUnitColumns buCols on
			buCols.BuildingUnitColumnPK = buBays.BuildingUnitColumnFK
			inner join tblBuildingUnitRows buRows on
			buRows.BuildingUnitRowPK = buCols.BuildingUnitRowFK
	
			left outer join (
				Select buBays.BuildingUnitColumnFK, sum(isnull(ActualUnits, 0)) ColumnWeight
				from tblPallets pallets
				inner join tblPalletContent pc on
				pc.PalletFK = pallets.PalletPK
				inner join tblStockItems sis on
				sis.StockItemPK = pc.StockItemFK
				inner join tblBuildingUnitBays buBays on
				buBays.BuildingUnitBayPK = pallets.LocationFK
				where pallets.BuildingUnitFK = @buildingUnitPK2 AND sis.UnitTypeFK = 2 /*Kilograms*/
				AND buBays.BayLevel <> 'A' /*Dont add ground sitting pallets to the weight!*/
				group by buBays.BuildingUnitColumnFK
			) columnWeight on
			buCols.BuildingUnitColumnPK = columnWeight.BuildingUnitColumnFK

			left outer join (
				Select buBays.BuildingUnitBayPK, sum(isnull(ActualUnits, 0)) BayWeight
				from tblPallets pallets
				inner join tblPalletContent pc on
				pc.PalletFK = pallets.PalletPK
				inner join tblStockItems sis on
				sis.StockItemPK = pc.StockItemFK
				inner join tblBuildingUnitBays buBays on
				buBays.BuildingUnitBayPK = pallets.LocationFK
				where pallets.BuildingUnitFK = @buildingUnitPK2 AND sis.UnitTypeFK = 2 /*Kilograms*/
				AND buBays.BayLevel <> 'A'
				group by buBays.BuildingUnitBayPK
			) bayWeight on
			buBays.BuildingUnitBayPK = bayWeight.BuildingUnitBayPK

			left outer join (
				Select PalletPK, LocationTypeFK, LocationFK, PalletTypeFK, BayPosition, PalletStart, PalletEnd, StackPosition
				From tblPallets 
				Union
				Select PalletFK, DestinationLocationTypeFK, DestinationFK, palletsUnion.PalletTypeFK, DestinationBayPosition, DestinationPalletStart, 
				DestinationPalletEnd, 0 as StackPosition
				From tblWorksOrderMovements woms
					inner join tblPallets palletsUnion on
					palletsUnion.PalletPK = woms.PalletFK
					Where woms.WorksOrderStatusFK < 3 /*Not complete or cancelled*/
				) pallets on
				pallets.LocationTypeFK = 1
				AND pallets.StackPosition <= 0
				AND pallets.LocationFK = buBays.BuildingUnitBayPK

			left outer join (
				Select PalletPK, LocationTypeFK, LocationFK, PalletTypeFK, BayPosition, PalletStart, PalletEnd, StackPosition
				From tblPallets 
				Union
				Select PalletFK, DestinationLocationTypeFK, DestinationFK, palletsUnion.PalletTypeFK, DestinationBayPosition, DestinationPalletStart, 
				DestinationPalletEnd, 0 as StackPosition
				From tblWorksOrderMovements woms
					inner join tblPallets palletsUnion on
					palletsUnion.PalletPK = woms.PalletFK
					Where woms.WorksOrderStatusFK < 3 /*Not complete or cancelled*/
				) gapRight on
				gapRight.LocationTypeFK = 1
				AND gapRight.StackPosition <= 0
				AND gapRight.LocationFK = pallets.LocationFK
				AND gapRight.PalletStart = (Select Top 1 PalletStart From (Select PalletStart, LocationFK From tblPallets union Select DestinationPalletStart, 
				DestinationFK from tblWorksOrderMovements where WorksOrderStatusFK < 3)subQNoName where LocationFK = pallets.LocationFK 
				AND PalletStart >= pallets.PalletEnd order by PalletStart ASC)
				AND gapRight.PalletStart <> pallets.PalletEnd

			left outer join (Select Max(BayPosition) BayPosition, LocationTypeFK, LocationFK, StackPosition, Max(PalletEnd) as PalletEnd
			from (
				Select PalletPK, LocationTypeFK, LocationFK, PalletTypeFK, BayPosition, PalletStart, PalletEnd, StackPosition
				From tblPallets 
				Union
				Select PalletFK, DestinationLocationTypeFK, DestinationFK, palletsUnion.PalletTypeFK, DestinationBayPosition, DestinationPalletStart, 
				DestinationPalletEnd, 0 as StackPosition
				From tblWorksOrderMovements woms
					inner join tblPallets palletsUnion on
					palletsUnion.PalletPK = woms.PalletFK
					Where woms.WorksOrderStatusFK < 3 /*Not complete or cancelled*/
				) subQLastPallets
					Group By LocationTypeFK, LocationFK, StackPosition) lastPallet on
				lastPallet.LocationTypeFK = 1
				AND lastPallet.StackPosition <= 0
				AND lastPallet.LocationFK = pallets.LocationFK
				AND lastPallet.PalletEnd <> buBays.Width

			left outer join (Select Min(BayPosition) BayPosition, LocationTypeFK, LocationFK, StackPosition, Min(PalletStart) as PalletStart 
				from (
				Select PalletPK, LocationTypeFK, LocationFK, PalletTypeFK, BayPosition, PalletStart, PalletEnd, StackPosition
				From tblPallets 
				Union
				Select PalletFK, DestinationLocationTypeFK, DestinationFK, palletsUnion.PalletTypeFK, DestinationBayPosition, DestinationPalletStart, 
				DestinationPalletEnd, 0 as StackPosition
				From tblWorksOrderMovements woms
					inner join tblPallets palletsUnion on
					palletsUnion.PalletPK = woms.PalletFK
					Where woms.WorksOrderStatusFK < 3 /*Not complete or cancelled*/
				) subQfirstPallet 
					Group By LocationTypeFK, LocationFK, StackPosition) firstPallet on
				firstPallet.LocationTypeFK = 1
				AND firstPallet.StackPosition <= 0
				AND firstPallet.PalletStart <> 0
				AND firstPallet.LocationFK = pallets.LocationFK

			Where buRows.BuildingUnitFK = @buildingUnitPK2
			AND buRows.RackingTypeFK = @autoRackingTypeFK
			AND ASCII(buBays.BayLevel) - 64 < /*Not Top Level*/
				Case when @prohibitTopLevelRacking = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ Then buCols.Levels Else 99999 End
			AND ASCII(buBays.BayLevel) <= 
				Case when @unstable1 = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ Then 67 /*Less than or equal to Level C*/
				Else 99999 End
			AND ASCII(buBays.BayLevel) <= 
				Case when @unstable2 = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ Then 66 /*Less than or equal to Level B*/
				Else 99999 End
			AND ASCII(buBays.BayLevel) <= 
				Case when @unstable3 = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ Then 65 /*Level A Only*/
				Else 99999 End
			AND ASCII(buBays.BayLevel) > /*Not Ground Level*/
				Case when @allowFloorStorage = 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/ Then 65 /*A*/ Else 0 End
			And buBays.IsArchived = 0	/* DG #DEV-910 Exclude Archived Bays*/
			) subQ

			Where /*Check for this divisions assigned bays*/
					(BuildingUnitBayPK in 
					(Select dbuBays.BuildingUnitBayFK from tblDivisionBuildingUnitBays dbuBays
						Where DivisionFK = @divisionFK AND dbuBays.BuildingUnitFK = @buildingUnitPK2 And dbuBays.IsArchived = 0))	/* DG #DEV-910 Exclude Archived Bays*/
				  /*Check this bay is not assigned to any other division*/
				AND BuildingUnitBayPK not in 
					(Select dbuBays.BuildingUnitBayFK from tblDivisionBuildingUnitBays dbuBays
					 Where DivisionFK <> @divisionFK AND 
						   dbuBays.BuildingUnitFK = @buildingUnitPK2 AND dbuBays.IsExclusive = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ And dbuBays.IsArchived = 0) /* DG #DEV-910 Exclude Archived Bays*/
				AND (GapBetweenPallets >=@width
				OR GapToEndOfBay >= @width
				OR GapToStartOfBay >= @width
				OR GapWholeBay >= @width)
			AND (MaximumDepth >= @depth /*Maximum Depth*/
			AND MinimumDepth <= @depth) /*Minimum Depth*/
			AND Height >= @height
			AND (BayWeight < MaximumBayWeight OR MaximumBayWeight = 0)
			AND (ColumnWeight < MaximumColumnWeight OR MaximumColumnWeight = 0)

			ORDER BY
				Row ASC, BuildingUnitColumn ASC, BayLevel ASC

			Declare @buildingUnitBayPK int, @maximumBayWeight decimal(18,3), @bayWeight decimal(18,3),
			@buildingUnitRow nvarchar(10), @buildingUnitRowNumber int, 
			@translateRow bit, @translatedRow nvarchar(50), @reverseTranslate bit, @translateColumn int,
			@buildingUnitColumn int, @buildingUnitColumnName nvarchar(50), @maximumColumnWeight decimal(18,3), @columnWeight decimal(18,3), @buildingUnitBayLevel nvarchar(10), 
			@gapBetweenPallets int, @gapBetweenPalletsBayPosition int, @gapBetweenPalletsPalletStart int, 
			@gapToEndOfBay int, @endBayPosition int, @endBayPalletStart int, 
			@gapToStartOfBay int, @startBayPosition int, @startBayPalletStart int, 
			@gapWholeBay int, @wholeBayPosition int, @wholeBayPalletStart int, 
			@locationOrder int

			Declare @previousBuildingUnitColumn int -- for keeping batches together
			Declare @previousBuildingUnitColumnForWeight int
			Declare @previousBuildingUnitBayPK int
			Declare @runningColumnWeight decimal(18,3), @runningBayWeight decimal(18,3)

			OPEN BayCursor
		
			FETCH NEXT FROM BayCursor INTO 
			@buildingUnitBayPK, @maximumBayWeight, @bayWeight,
			@buildingUnitRow, @buildingUnitRowNumber, 
			@translateRow, @translatedRow, @reverseTranslate, @translateColumn,
			@buildingUnitColumn, @buildingUnitColumnName, @maximumColumnWeight, @columnWeight, @buildingUnitBayLevel, 
			@gapBetweenPallets, @gapBetweenPalletsBayPosition, @gapBetweenPalletsPalletStart, 
			@gapToEndOfBay, @endBayPosition, @endBayPalletStart, 
			@gapToStartOfBay, @startBayPosition, @startBayPalletStart, 
			@gapWholeBay, @wholeBayPosition, @wholeBayPalletStart, 
			@locationOrder

			Declare @availableSpace bit
			Declare @availableGap int
			Declare @bayPosition int
			Declare @palletStart int
			Declare @gapType as nvarchar(50)/* whole, between, start, end*/
			Declare @firstRun int
			Set @firstRun = 1
			Set @availableSpace = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/
			--Print @@FETCH_STATUS
			Set @originalNumberOfLocations = @numberOfLocations2
			Set @previousBuildingUnitColumn = -1
			Set @previousBuildingUnitColumnForWeight = -1
			Set @previousBuildingUnitBayPK = -1
	
			Set @currentRow = -1

			DECLARE @myLocations TABLE 
			( 
				RowNumber INT, 
				RowLetter nvarchar(50),
				ColumnNumber INT,
				Sql text 
			)
	
			WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 AND @numberOfLocations2 > 0
			BEGIN
				Print 'Began Loop'
				if (@currentRow = -1) Set @currentRow = @buildingUnitRowNumber
				--if the row has moved on and we still have pallets to locate, we must reset as we dont want a run of stock/batch in different rows
				if (@buildingUnitRowNumber > @currentRow)
				BEGIN
					Select @sql = '', @numberOfLocations2 = @originalNumberOfLocations, @currentRow = @buildingUnitRowNumber, @firstRun = 1
				END
				if (@currentRow > @buildingUnitRowNumber) 
				BEGIN
					goto Skip --if we are looking for a different row, skip
				END
				ELSE
				BEGIN --we have moved on to the row we were looking for or the row has moved past the row we were looking for (either no gaps or row is not assigned to division), so set the row
					Set @currentRow = @buildingUnitRowNumber
				END
			
				Print isnull(@gapWholeBay, -1)
				Print isnull(@gapBetweenPalletsPalletStart, -1)
				Print isnull(@gapBetweenPallets, -1)
				Print isnull(@gapToStartOfBay, -1)
				Print isnull(@endBayPalletStart, -1)
				Print isnull(@gapToEndOfBay, -1)

				Set @availableSpace = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ 
		
				IF (@gapWholeBay > 0)
				BEGIN
					Set @bayPosition = 1
					Set @palletStart = 0
					Set @availableGap = @gapWholeBay
					Set @gapType = 'whole'
				END
				ELSE IF @gapBetweenPallets >= @width
				BEGIN
					Set @bayPosition = @gapBetweenPalletsBayPosition
					Set @palletStart = @gapBetweenPalletsPalletStart
					Set @availableGap = @gapBetweenPallets
					Set @gapType = 'between'
				END
				ELSE IF (@gapToStartOfBay >= @width)
				BEGIN
					Set @bayPosition = @startBayPosition
					Set @palletStart = 0
					Set @availableGap = @gapToStartOfBay
					Set @gapType = 'start'
				END
				ELSE IF (@gapToEndOfBay >= @width)
				BEGIN
					Set @bayPosition = @endBayPosition
					Set @palletStart = @endBayPalletStart
					Set @availableGap = @gapToEndOfBay
					Set @gapType = 'end'
				END
		
		
				WHILE @availableSpace = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ AND @numberOfLocations2 > 0
				BEGIN
		--			Print 'Began 2nd Loop'
		--			Print @buildingUnitRow
					--******* WEIGHT CODE ************
					IF(@restrictStockWeight = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ AND @maximumColumnWeight > 0 AND @buildingUnitBayLevel <> 'A')
					BEGIN
						Print 'weight1'
						IF(@previousBuildingUnitColumnForWeight <> @buildingUnitColumn)
						BEGIN
							Set @runningColumnWeight = @units2
						END ELSE
						BEGIN
							Set @runningColumnWeight = @runningColumnWeight + @units2
						END
						Set @previousBuildingUnitColumnForWeight = @buildingUnitColumn
						if(@previousBuildingUnitBayPK <> @buildingUnitBayPK)
						BEGIN
							Set @runningBayWeight = @units2
						END ELSE
						BEGIN
							Set @runningBayWeight = @runningBayWeight + @units2
						END
						Set @previousBuildingUnitBayPK = @buildingUnitBayPK
						--If the current located weight + what we have added already + what we want to add is greater than the limit, skip the location
						IF((@columnWeight + @runningColumnWeight) > @maximumColumnWeight
							OR
							(@bayWeight + @runningBayWeight) > @maximumBayWeight)
						BEGIN
							print 'weight too much!'
							goto Skip --we have gone over the weight limit for this column or bay, skip it
						END
					END
					--****** END OF WEIGHT CODE ************
		--			Print 'Column Weight ' + cast(@columnWeight as nvarchar(50))
		--			Print 'Running Column Weight ' + cast(@runningColumnWeight as nvarchar(50))
			
					if @firstRun = 0 
					BEGIN
						Set @sql = @sql + ' UNION ALL '
					END
					ELSE
					BEGIN
						Set @startColumn = @buildingUnitColumn
					END
					Set @thisLineSql = ' Select ''' + @buildingUnit + ''' BuildingUnit,''' + case when @translateRow = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ then @translatedRow 
					else @buildingUnitRow end + ''' Row,''' + case when @translateRow = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ then case when @reverseTranslate = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ 
					then cast(@translateColumn - @buildingUnitColumn as nvarchar(10)) else cast(@buildingUnitColumn + @translateColumn as nvarchar(10)) end 
					else cast(@buildingUnitColumn as nvarchar(10)) end + ''' BuildingUnitColumn,''' + case when @translateRow = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ then 
					case when @reverseTranslate = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ then cast(@translateColumn - @buildingUnitColumn as nvarchar(10)) else 
					cast(@buildingUnitColumn + @translateColumn as nvarchar(10)) end else cast(@buildingUnitColumn as nvarchar(10)) end + ''' BuildingUnitColumnName,''' 
					+ @buildingUnitBayLevel + ''' BayLevel,' + cast(@bayPosition as nvarchar(50))	+ ' BayPosition,' + cast(@palletStart as nvarchar(50)) 
					+ ' PalletStart,' + cast((@palletStart + @width) as nvarchar(50)) + ' PalletEnd,' + cast(@buildingUnitBayPK as nvarchar(100)) + ' LocationFK'	
					Set @sql = @sql	+ @thisLineSql
					--Print @sql
			
					Set @availableGap = @availableGap - @width
					if (@availableGap < @width) 
					BEGIN
						IF (@gapType = 'whole')
							Set @availableSpace = 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/				
						ELSE IF (@gapType = 'between')
						BEGIN
							IF (@gapToStartOfBay >= @width)
							BEGIN
								Set @bayPosition = @startBayPosition
								Set @palletStart = 0
								Set @availableGap = @gapToStartOfBay
								Set @gapType = 'start'
							END
							ELSE IF (@gapToEndOfBay >= @width)
							BEGIN
								Set @bayPosition = @endBayPosition
								Set @palletStart = @endBayPalletStart
								Set @availableGap = @gapToEndOfBay
								Set @gapType = 'end'
							END
							ELSE Set @availableSpace = 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/	
						END
						ELSE IF (@gapType = 'start')
						BEGIN
							IF (@gapToEndOfBay >= @width)
							BEGIN
								Set @bayPosition = @endBayPosition
								Set @palletStart = @endBayPalletStart
								Set @availableGap = @gapToEndOfBay
								Set @gapType = 'end'
							END
							ELSE Set @availableSpace = 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/	
						END
						ELSE IF (@gapType = 'end')
						BEGIN
							Set @availableSpace = 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/	
						END
			
					END
					ELSE
					BEGIN
						Set @bayPosition = @bayPosition + 1
						Set @palletStart = @palletStart + @width
					END

			
					Set @numberOfLocations2 = @numberOfLocations2 - 1
					Set @firstRun = 0

					/*KEEP BATCH TOGETHER**************/
					if(@overrideBuildingUnitRules = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/)
					BEGIN
						/*Keep batch in one or more adjoining columns*/
						if(@keepBatchTogetherLevel2 = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/)
						BEGIN
							if(@previousBuildingUnitColumn = -1)
							BEGIN
								Set @previousBuildingUnitColumn = @buildingUnitColumn
							END
							ELSE
							BEGIN 
								/* This next 'if' statement is complex */
								/* Explanation*/
								/* If we have skipped a column since the last location 
									AND we have also moved more than one column from
									the columns used for a previous batch location
									AND we havent moved just one column since we were last here then
									we need to start again*/
								if(
									((ABS(@previousBuildingUnitColumn - @buildingUnitColumn) > 1 
									AND @previousFirstBuildingUnitColumn2 = -1)
							
									OR 
										(
										(@previousFirstBuildingUnitColumn2 > 0) AND
										((@buildingUnitColumn > (@previousFirstBuildingUnitColumn2 + 1)
										OR
										(@buildingUnitColumn < (@previousLastBuildingUnitColumn2 - 1)))
										)
									))
									AND ABS(@previousBuildingUnitColumn - @buildingUnitColumn) <> 1
								)
								BEGIN /*If selection has jumped a column, reset and start again*/
									Print 'Starting Again'
									Select @previousBuildingUnitColumn = @buildingUnitColumn,
									@numberOfLocations2 = @originalNumberOfLocations - 1,
									@firstRun = 0,
									@sql = @thisLineSql,
									@startColumn = @buildingUnitColumn
								END
							END
						END
					END
				END

				If (@numberOfLocations2 = 0)
				BEGIN
					Insert into @myLocations
					values (@buildingUnitRowNumber, 
						@buildingUnitRow,
						@startColumn,
						@sql) 
					If (@currentRow < @numberOfRows AND @previousLastBuildingUnitRow2 <> @buildingUnitRow) 
					BEGIN
						Set @currentRow = @currentRow + 1
						Set @numberOfLocations2 = @originalNumberOfLocations
						Set @firstRun = 1
						Set @sql = ''
					END
				END
		
		Skip:
				FETCH NEXT FROM BayCursor INTO 
				@buildingUnitBayPK, @maximumBayWeight, @bayWeight,
				@buildingUnitRow, @buildingUnitRowNumber,
				@translateRow, @translatedRow, @reverseTranslate, @translateColumn,
				@buildingUnitColumn, @buildingUnitColumnName, @maximumColumnWeight, @columnWeight, @buildingUnitBayLevel, 
				@gapBetweenPallets, @gapBetweenPalletsBayPosition, @gapBetweenPalletsPalletStart, 
				@gapToEndOfBay, @endBayPosition, @endBayPalletStart, 
				@gapToStartOfBay, @startBayPosition, @startBayPalletStart, 
				@gapWholeBay, @wholeBayPosition, @wholeBayPalletStart,
				@locationOrder
			END
			CLOSE BayCursor 
			DEALLOCATE BayCursor 
	
	
			Print 'here'
			Set @sql = ''
			IF (@previousLastBuildingUnitRow2 <> '')
			BEGIN
				Select @sql = Sql from @myLocations where RowLetter = @previousLastBuildingUnitRow2
			END 
	
			IF(@sql = '') --if we had no previous row OR there was no available locations for the previous row, do regular selection
			BEGIN
				Select Top 1 @sql = Sql from @myLocations
				Order by ColumnNumber Desc, RowNumber Asc
			END
			--Print @sql
			--Print(len(@sql))
			Exec(@sql)
			--Select * from @myLocations
	
			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end

			
			
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END
GO

-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
--
--Modify: DG #DEV-910 Exclude Archived Bays
-- =============================================
-- Locations FOR PAN01
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spCustomer739PalletLocationsGetRackingLocations]
(
	@palletPK int, --if PalletPK is supplied, this indicates a mixed pallet, extra code to run to get other stock restrictions, margins etc
	@stockItemPK int,
	@palletTypePK int,
	@buildingUnitPK int,
	@numberOfLocations int,
	@batch nvarchar(200),
	@units decimal(18,3),
	@previousFirstBuildingUnitColumn int,
	@previousLastBuildingUnitColumn int,
	@previousFirstBuildingUnitRow nvarchar(50),
	@previousLastBuildingUnitRow nvarchar(50)
)
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT
 ,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;
	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	DECLARE @palletPK2 int,
	@stockItemPK2 int,
	@palletTypePK2 int,
	@buildingUnitPK2 int,
	@numberOfLocations2 int,
	@batch2 nvarchar(200),
	@units2 decimal(18,3),
	@previousFirstBuildingUnitColumn2 int,
	@previousLastBuildingUnitColumn2 int,
	@previousFirstBuildingUnitRow2 nvarchar(50),
	@previousLastBuildingUnitRow2 nvarchar(50)

	SET @palletPK2 = @palletPK;SET @stockItemPK2 = @stockItemPK; SET @palletTypePK2 = @palletTypePK; SET @buildingUnitPK2 = @buildingUnitPK
	SET @numberOfLocations2 = @numberOfLocations; SET @batch2 = @batch; SET @units2 = @units; SET @previousFirstBuildingUnitColumn2 = @previousFirstBuildingUnitColumn
	SET @previousLastBuildingUnitColumn2 = @previousLastBuildingUnitColumn; SET @previousFirstBuildingUnitRow2 = @previousFirstBuildingUnitRow
	SET @previousLastBuildingUnitRow2 = @previousLastBuildingUnitRow

	SET @ParameterDetails = '@palletPK =  = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@palletPK2 AS NVARCHAR(20)),'') + ',@stockItemPK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@stockItemPK2 AS NVARCHAR(20)),'')
		+ ',@palletTypePK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@palletTypePK2 AS NVARCHAR(20)),'') + ',@buildingUnitPK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@buildingUnitPK2 AS NVARCHAR(20)),'')
			+ ',@numberOfLocations = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@numberOfLocations2 AS NVARCHAR(20)),'') + ',@batch = ' + ISNULL(@batch2,'') + ',@units = ' + ISNULL(@units2,'')
				+ ',@previousFirstBuildingUnitColumn = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@previousFirstBuildingUnitColumn2 AS NVARCHAR(20)),'')
					+ ',@previousLastBuildingUnitColumn = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@previousLastBuildingUnitColumn2 AS NVARCHAR(20)),'')
						+ ',@previousFirstBuildingUnitRow = ' + ISNULL(@previousFirstBuildingUnitRow2,'')
							+ ',@previousLastBuildingUnitRow = ' + ISNULL(@previousLastBuildingUnitRow2,'')

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    --BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

		SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END


	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY
			

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start

			Declare @restrictSql nvarchar(MAX)
			Declare @sql nvarchar(MAX)
			Declare @thisLineSql nvarchar(MAX)
			Set @sql = '' --initialize
			Set @thisLineSql = '' --initialize

			Declare @prohibitTopLevelRacking as bit
			Declare @unstable3 as bit
			Declare @unstable2 as bit
			Declare @unstable1 as bit
			Declare @widthMargin int
			Declare @depthMargin int
			Declare @width int
			Declare @depth int
			Declare @height int
			Declare @defaultUnits decimal(18,3)
			--Declare @systemStandardPalletHeight int
			Declare @overrideBuildingUnitRules bit
			Declare @stockDisperseBatch bit
			Declare @keepBatchTogetherLevel1 bit
			Declare @keepBatchTogetherLevel2 bit
			Declare @keepBatchTogetherLevel3 bit
			Declare @keepBatchTogetherLevel4 bit
			Declare @divisionFK int
			Declare @restrictStockWeight bit

			Declare @disperseBatch bit

			Declare @buildingUnit nvarchar(200)
			Declare @buildingUnitDisperseBatch bit

			Declare @autoRackingTypeFK int, @buildingUnitRows int

			Declare @originalNumberOfLocations int
	
			Declare @numberOfRows int
			Declare @currentRow int
			Declare @startColumn int --start column for run of location
			Select @numberOfRows = count(*) from tblBuildingUnitRows where BuildingUnitFK = @buildingUnitPK2 and IsArchived = 0

		--  The following If has been removed
		--	as the rule for mixed pallets is they have to be the same stock and batch- only the each conent is mixed, so no need for different code
		--	if(@palletPK2 = -1) --no mixed pallet
		--	BEGIN
			Select @prohibitTopLevelRacking = ProhibitTopLevelRacking,
			@unstable3 = Unstable3,
			@unstable2 = Unstable2,
			@unstable1 = Unstable1,
			@widthMargin = WidthMargin,
			@depthMargin = DepthMargin,
			@overrideBuildingUnitRules = OverrideBuildingUnitRules,
			@stockDisperseBatch = DisperseBatch,
			@keepBatchTogetherLevel1 = KeepBatchTogetherLevel1,
			@keepBatchTogetherLevel2 = KeepBatchTogetherLevel2,
			@keepBatchTogetherLevel3 = KeepBatchTogetherLevel3,
			@keepBatchTogetherLevel4 = KeepBatchTogetherLevel4,
			@divisionFK = DivisionFK,
			@restrictStockWeight = case when UnitTypeFK in (2/*KGs*/) then 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ else 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/ End
			From tblStockItems stockItems
			Where StockItemPK = @stockItemPK2

			--Get the height is available
			if(EXISTS(Select * from tblStockItemHeights where StockItemFK = @stockItemPK2)) --if we have some height records
			BEGIN
				Select Top 1 @height = Height from tblStockItemHeights
				Where StockItemFK = @stockItemPK2 AND Units >= @units2
				Order By Units ASC
			END ELSE BEGIN
				Set @height = 0
			END
		--	END
		--	ELSE
		--	BEGIN
		--		Select 
		--		@prohibitTopLevelRacking = case when sum(cast(ProhibitTopLevelRacking as int)) > 0
		--		then 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/ else 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ End,
		--		@unstable3 = case when sum(cast(Unstable3 as int)) > 0
		--		then 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/ else 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ End,
		--		@unstable2 = case when sum(cast(Unstable2 as int)) > 0
		--		then 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/ else 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ End,
		--		@unstable1 = case when sum(cast(Unstable1 as int)) > 0
		--		then 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/ else 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ End,
		--		@widthMargin = Max(WidthMargin),
		--		@depthMargin = Max(DepthMargin),
		--		@height = Max(DefaultHeight),
		--		@overrideBuildingUnitRules = case when sum(cast(OverrideBuildingUnitRules as int)) > 0
		--		then 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/ else 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ End,
		--		@stockDisperseBatch = case when sum(cast(OverrideBuildingUnitRules as int)) = count(*)
		--		then 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ else 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/ End,
		--		@keepBatchTogetherLevel1 = case when sum(cast(KeepBatchTogetherLevel1 as int)) = count(*)
		--		then 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ else 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/ End,
		--		@keepBatchTogetherLevel2 = case when sum(cast(KeepBatchTogetherLevel2 as int)) = count(*)
		--		then 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ else 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/ End,
		--		@keepBatchTogetherLevel3 = case when sum(cast(KeepBatchTogetherLevel3 as int)) = count(*)
		--		then 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ else 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/ End,
		--		@keepBatchTogetherLevel4 = case when sum(cast(KeepBatchTogetherLevel4 as int)) = count(*)
		--		then 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ else 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/ End
		--		From tblPallets pallets
		--		inner join tblPalletContent palletContent
		--		on palletContent.PalletFK = pallets.PalletPK
		--		inner join tblStockItems stockItems
		--		on stockItems.StockItemPK = palletContent.StockItemFK
		--		
		--		Where PalletPK = @palletPK2
		--	END
		--  /*TESTING*/
		--	Print @prohibitTopLevelRacking
		--	Print @unstable3
		--	Print @unstable2
		--	Print @unstable1
		--	Print @depthMargin
		--	Print @height
		--	Print @overrideBuildingUnitRules

			Select @width = Width + (case when @widthMargin > 0 then (@widthMargin * 2) else (WidthMargin*2) end), 
				@depth = Depth + (case when @depthMargin > 0 then (@depthMargin*2) else (DepthMargin*2) end)
			from tblPalletTypes
			Where PalletTypePK = @palletTypePK2

			print 'width ' + cast(@width as nvarchar(50))
			print 'depth ' + cast(@depth as nvarchar(50))

			Select @autoRackingTypeFK = AutomatedRackingTypeFK, @buildingUnitDisperseBatch = DisperseBatch, @buildingUnitRows = Count(*), @buildingUnit = BuildingUnit 
			from tblBuildingUnits bus
			Inner join tblBuildingUnitRows buRows
			on
			buRows.BuildingUnitFK = bus.BuildingUnitPK  
			AND buRows.RackingtypeFK = bus.AutomatedRackingTypeFK 
			And buRows.IsArchived = 0		/* DG #DEV-910 Exclude Archived Bays (Rows)*/
			where BuildingUnitPK = @buildingUnitPK2
			Group By AutomatedRackingTypeFK, DisperseBatch, BuildingUnit

		
			DECLARE BayCursor CURSOR FAST_FORWARD FOR 
			Select Distinct BuildingUnitBayPK, MaximumBayWeight, BayWeight, Row, RowNumber, 
			Translate, TranslatedRow, ReverseTranslate, TranslateColumn,
			subQ.BuildingUnitColumn, BuildingUnitColumnName, MaximumColumnWeight, ColumnWeight, BayLevel, GapBetweenPallets, GapBetweenPalletsBayPosition, 
			GapBetweenPalletsPalletStart, 
			GapToEndOfBay, EndBayPosition, EndBayPalletStart, 
			GapToStartOfBay, StartBayPosition, StartBayPalletStart, 
			GapWholeBay, WholeBayPosition, WholeBayPalletStart, 
			Height as LocationOrder from (
			Select buBays.BuildingUnitBayPK,
				buBays.MaximumWeight as MaximumBayWeight,
				isnull(bayWeight.BayWeight, 0) BayWeight, 
				buRows.Row,
				buRows.RowNumber,
				buRows.Translate,
				buRows.TranslatedRow,
				buRows.ReverseTranslate,
				buRows.TranslateColumn,
				buCols.BuildingUnitColumn,
				buCols.BuildingUnitColumnName,
				buCols.MaximumWeight as MaximumColumnWeight,
				isnull(columnWeight.ColumnWeight, 0) ColumnWeight,
				buBays.BayLevel,
				buBays.Width,
				buBays.MinimumDepth,
				buBays.MaximumDepth,
				buBays.Height,
				pallets.PalletPK, 
				pallets.PalletStart, 
				pallets.PalletEnd,
				pallets.BayPosition, 
				isnull(gapRight.PalletStart - pallets.PalletEnd,0) as GapBetweenPallets, 
				case isnull(gapRight.PalletStart,0) when 0 then null else pallets.BayPosition + 1 END as GapBetweenPalletsBayPosition,
				case isnull(gapRight.PalletStart,0) when 0 then null else pallets.PalletEnd END as GapBetweenPalletsPalletStart,
				case when pallets.BayPosition = lastPallet.BayPosition then (buBays.Width - lastPallet.PalletEnd) else 0 End as GapToEndOfBay, /*Only Show this for last pallet*/
				case isnull(lastPallet.PalletEnd, 0) when 0 then null else lastPallet.BayPosition + 1 END as EndBayPosition,
				case isnull(lastPallet.PalletEnd, 0) when 0 then null else lastPallet.PalletEnd END as EndBayPalletStart,
				case when pallets.BayPosition = firstPallet.BayPosition then firstPallet.PalletStart else 0 End as GapToStartOfBay,
				case isnull(firstPallet.PalletStart, 0) when 0 then null else 1 END as StartBayPosition,
				0 as StartBayPalletStart,
				case isnull(pallets.PalletPK,0) when 0 then buBays.Width else 0 End as GapWholeBay,
				case isnull(pallets.PalletPK, 0) when 0 then 1 else 0 END as WholeBayPosition,
				0 as WholeBayPalletStart
			from tblBuildingUnitBays buBays
			inner join tblBuildingUnitColumns buCols on
			buCols.BuildingUnitColumnPK = buBays.BuildingUnitColumnFK
			inner join tblBuildingUnitRows buRows on
			buRows.BuildingUnitRowPK = buCols.BuildingUnitRowFK
	
			left outer join (
				Select buBays.BuildingUnitColumnFK, sum(isnull(ActualUnits, 0)) ColumnWeight
				from tblPallets pallets
				inner join tblPalletContent pc on
				pc.PalletFK = pallets.PalletPK
				inner join tblStockItems sis on
				sis.StockItemPK = pc.StockItemFK
				inner join tblBuildingUnitBays buBays on
				buBays.BuildingUnitBayPK = pallets.LocationFK
				where pallets.BuildingUnitFK = @buildingUnitPK2 AND sis.UnitTypeFK = 2 /*Kilograms*/
				AND buBays.BayLevel <> 'A' /*Dont add ground sitting pallets to the weight!*/
				group by buBays.BuildingUnitColumnFK
			) columnWeight on
			buCols.BuildingUnitColumnPK = columnWeight.BuildingUnitColumnFK

			left outer join (
				Select buBays.BuildingUnitBayPK, sum(isnull(ActualUnits, 0)) BayWeight
				from tblPallets pallets
				inner join tblPalletContent pc on
				pc.PalletFK = pallets.PalletPK
				inner join tblStockItems sis on
				sis.StockItemPK = pc.StockItemFK
				inner join tblBuildingUnitBays buBays on
				buBays.BuildingUnitBayPK = pallets.LocationFK
				where pallets.BuildingUnitFK = @buildingUnitPK2 AND sis.UnitTypeFK = 2 /*Kilograms*/
				AND buBays.BayLevel <> 'A'
				group by buBays.BuildingUnitBayPK
			) bayWeight on
			buBays.BuildingUnitBayPK = bayWeight.BuildingUnitBayPK

			left outer join (
				Select PalletPK, LocationTypeFK, LocationFK, PalletTypeFK, BayPosition, PalletStart, PalletEnd, StackPosition
				From tblPallets 
				Union
				Select PalletFK, DestinationLocationTypeFK, DestinationFK, palletsUnion.PalletTypeFK, DestinationBayPosition, DestinationPalletStart, DestinationPalletEnd, 
				0 as StackPosition
				From tblWorksOrderMovements woms
					inner join tblPallets palletsUnion on
					palletsUnion.PalletPK = woms.PalletFK
					Where woms.WorksOrderStatusFK < 3 /*Not complete or cancelled*/
				) pallets on
				pallets.LocationTypeFK = 1
				AND pallets.StackPosition <= 0
				AND pallets.LocationFK = buBays.BuildingUnitBayPK

			left outer join (
				Select PalletPK, LocationTypeFK, LocationFK, PalletTypeFK, BayPosition, PalletStart, PalletEnd, StackPosition
				From tblPallets 
				Union
				Select PalletFK, DestinationLocationTypeFK, DestinationFK, palletsUnion.PalletTypeFK, DestinationBayPosition, DestinationPalletStart, 
				DestinationPalletEnd, 0 as StackPosition
				From tblWorksOrderMovements woms
					inner join tblPallets palletsUnion on
					palletsUnion.PalletPK = woms.PalletFK
					Where woms.WorksOrderStatusFK < 3 /*Not complete or cancelled*/
				) gapRight on
				gapRight.LocationTypeFK = 1
				AND gapRight.StackPosition <= 0
				AND gapRight.LocationFK = pallets.LocationFK
				AND gapRight.PalletStart = (Select Top 1 PalletStart From (Select PalletStart, LocationFK From tblPallets union Select DestinationPalletStart, 
				DestinationFK from tblWorksOrderMovements where WorksOrderStatusFK < 3)subQNoName where LocationFK = pallets.LocationFK AND PalletStart >= pallets.PalletEnd 
				order by PalletStart ASC)
				AND gapRight.PalletStart <> pallets.PalletEnd

			left outer join (Select Max(BayPosition) BayPosition, LocationTypeFK, LocationFK, StackPosition, Max(PalletEnd) as PalletEnd
			from (
				Select PalletPK, LocationTypeFK, LocationFK, PalletTypeFK, BayPosition, PalletStart, PalletEnd, StackPosition
				From tblPallets 
				Union
				Select PalletFK, DestinationLocationTypeFK, DestinationFK, palletsUnion.PalletTypeFK, DestinationBayPosition, DestinationPalletStart, 
				DestinationPalletEnd, 0 as StackPosition
				From tblWorksOrderMovements woms
					inner join tblPallets palletsUnion on
					palletsUnion.PalletPK = woms.PalletFK
					Where woms.WorksOrderStatusFK < 3 /*Not complete or cancelled*/
				) subQLastPallets
					Group By LocationTypeFK, LocationFK, StackPosition) lastPallet on
				lastPallet.LocationTypeFK = 1
				AND lastPallet.StackPosition <= 0
				AND lastPallet.LocationFK = pallets.LocationFK
				AND lastPallet.PalletEnd <> buBays.Width

			left outer join (Select Min(BayPosition) BayPosition, LocationTypeFK, LocationFK, StackPosition, Min(PalletStart) as PalletStart 
				from (
				Select PalletPK, LocationTypeFK, LocationFK, PalletTypeFK, BayPosition, PalletStart, PalletEnd, StackPosition
				From tblPallets 
				Union
				Select PalletFK, DestinationLocationTypeFK, DestinationFK, palletsUnion.PalletTypeFK, DestinationBayPosition, DestinationPalletStart, 
				DestinationPalletEnd, 0 as StackPosition
				From tblWorksOrderMovements woms
					inner join tblPallets palletsUnion on
					palletsUnion.PalletPK = woms.PalletFK
					Where woms.WorksOrderStatusFK < 3 /*Not complete or cancelled*/
				) subQfirstPallet 
					Group By LocationTypeFK, LocationFK, StackPosition) firstPallet on
				firstPallet.LocationTypeFK = 1
				AND firstPallet.StackPosition <= 0
				AND firstPallet.PalletStart <> 0
				AND firstPallet.LocationFK = pallets.LocationFK

			Where buRows.BuildingUnitFK = @buildingUnitPK2
			AND buRows.RackingTypeFK = @autoRackingTypeFK
			AND ASCII(buBays.BayLevel) - 64 < /*Not Top Level*/
				Case when @prohibitTopLevelRacking = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ Then buCols.Levels Else 99999 End
			AND ASCII(buBays.BayLevel) <= 
				Case when @unstable1 = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ Then 67 /*Less than or equal to Level C*/
				Else 99999 End
			AND ASCII(buBays.BayLevel) <= 
				Case when @unstable2 = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ Then 66 /*Less than or equal to Level B*/
				Else 99999 End
			AND ASCII(buBays.BayLevel) <= 
				Case when @unstable3 = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ Then 65 /*Level A Only*/
				Else 99999 End
			AND buBays.IsArchived = 0	/* DG #DEV-910 Exclude Archived Bays*/

			) subQ

			Where /*Check for this divisions assigned bays*/
					(BuildingUnitBayPK in 
					(Select dbuBays.BuildingUnitBayFK 
					 From tblDivisionBuildingUnitBays dbuBays
					 Where DivisionFK = @divisionFK AND dbuBays.BuildingUnitFK = @buildingUnitPK2 And dbuBays.IsArchived = 0))  /* DG #DEV-910 Exclude Archived Bays*/
				  /*Check this bay is not assigned to any other division*/
				AND BuildingUnitBayPK not in 
					(Select dbuBays.BuildingUnitBayFK 
					 From tblDivisionBuildingUnitBays dbuBays
					 Where DivisionFK <> @divisionFK AND dbuBays.BuildingUnitFK = @buildingUnitPK2 AND dbuBays.IsExclusive = 1 /*cast(1 as bit)*/ And dbuBays.IsArchived = 0)
				AND (GapBetweenPallets >=@width
				OR GapToEndOfBay >= @width
				OR GapToStartOfBay >= @width
				OR GapWholeBay >= @width)
			AND (MaximumDepth >= @depth /*Maximum Depth*/
			AND MinimumDepth <= @depth) /*Minimum Depth*/
			AND Height >= @height
			AND (BayWeight < MaximumBayWeight OR MaximumBayWeight = 0)
			AND (ColumnWeight < MaximumColumnWeight OR MaximumColumnWeight = 0)

			ORDER BY
				Row ASC, BuildingUnitColumn ASC, BayLevel ASC

			Declare @buildingUnitBayPK int, @maximumBayWeight decimal(18,3), @bayWeight decimal(18,3),
			@buildingUnitRow nvarchar(10), @buildingUnitRowNumber int, 
			@translateRow bit, @translatedRow nvarchar(50), @reverseTranslate bit, @translateColumn int,
			@buildingUnitColumn int, @buildingUnitColumnName nvarchar(50), @maximumColumnWeight decimal(18,3), @columnWeight decimal(18,3), 
			@buildingUnitBayLevel nvarchar(10), 
			@gapBetweenPallets int, @gapBetweenPalletsBayPosition int, @gapBetweenPalletsPalletStart int, 
			@gapToEndOfBay int, @endBayPosition int, @endBayPalletStart int, 
			@gapToStartOfBay int, @startBayPosition int, @startBayPalletStart int, 
			@gapWholeBay int, @wholeBayPosition int, @wholeBayPalletStart int, 
			@locationOrder int

			Declare @previousBuildingUnitColumn int -- for keeping batches together
			Declare @previousBuildingUnitColumnForWeight int
			Declare @previousBuildingUnitBayPK int
			Declare @runningColumnWeight decimal(18,3), @runningBayWeight decimal(18,3)

			OPEN BayCursor
		
			FETCH NEXT FROM BayCursor INTO 
			@buildingUnitBayPK, @maximumBayWeight, @bayWeight,
			@buildingUnitRow, @buildingUnitRowNumber, 
			@translateRow, @translatedRow, @reverseTranslate, @translateColumn,
			@buildingUnitColumn, @buildingUnitColumnName, @maximumColumnWeight, @columnWeight, @buildingUnitBayLevel, 
			@gapBetweenPallets, @gapBetweenPalletsBayPosition, @gapBetweenPalletsPalletStart, 
			@gapToEndOfBay, @endBayPosition, @endBayPalletStart, 
			@gapToStartOfBay, @startBayPosition, @startBayPalletStart, 
			@gapWholeBay, @wholeBayPosition, @wholeBayPalletStart, 
			@locationOrder

			Declare @availableSpace bit
			Declare @availableGap int
			Declare @bayPosition int
			Declare @palletStart int
			Declare @gapType as nvarchar(50)/* whole, between, start, end*/
			Declare @firstRun int
			Set @firstRun = 1
			Set @availableSpace = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/
			--Print @@FETCH_STATUS
			Set @originalNumberOfLocations = @numberOfLocations2
			Set @previousBuildingUnitColumn = -1
			Set @previousBuildingUnitColumnForWeight = -1
			Set @previousBuildingUnitBayPK = -1
	
			Set @currentRow = -1

			DECLARE @myLocations TABLE 
			( 
				RowNumber INT, 
				RowLetter nvarchar(50),
				ColumnNumber INT,
				Sql text 
			)
	
			WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 AND @numberOfLocations2 > 0
			BEGIN
				Print 'Began Loop'
				if (@currentRow = -1) Set @currentRow = @buildingUnitRowNumber
				--if the row has moved on and we still have pallets to locate, we must reset as we dont want a run of stock/batch in different rows
				if (@buildingUnitRowNumber > @currentRow)
				BEGIN
					Select @sql = '', @numberOfLocations2 = @originalNumberOfLocations, @currentRow = @buildingUnitRowNumber, @firstRun = 1
				END
				if (@currentRow > @buildingUnitRowNumber) 
				BEGIN
					goto Skip --if we are looking for a different row, skip
				END
				ELSE
				BEGIN --we have moved on to the row we were looking for or the row has moved past the row we were looking for (either no gaps or row is not assigned to division), so set the row
					Set @currentRow = @buildingUnitRowNumber
				END
			
				Print isnull(@gapWholeBay, -1)
				Print isnull(@gapBetweenPalletsPalletStart, -1)
				Print isnull(@gapBetweenPallets, -1)
				Print isnull(@gapToStartOfBay, -1)
				Print isnull(@endBayPalletStart, -1)
				Print isnull(@gapToEndOfBay, -1)

				Set @availableSpace = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ 
		
				IF (@gapWholeBay > 0)
				BEGIN
					Set @bayPosition = 1
					Set @palletStart = 0
					Set @availableGap = @gapWholeBay
					Set @gapType = 'whole'
				END
				ELSE IF @gapBetweenPallets >= @width
				BEGIN
					Set @bayPosition = @gapBetweenPalletsBayPosition
					Set @palletStart = @gapBetweenPalletsPalletStart
					Set @availableGap = @gapBetweenPallets
					Set @gapType = 'between'
				END
				ELSE IF (@gapToStartOfBay >= @width)
				BEGIN
					Set @bayPosition = @startBayPosition
					Set @palletStart = 0
					Set @availableGap = @gapToStartOfBay
					Set @gapType = 'start'
				END
				ELSE IF (@gapToEndOfBay >= @width)
				BEGIN
					Set @bayPosition = @endBayPosition
					Set @palletStart = @endBayPalletStart
					Set @availableGap = @gapToEndOfBay
					Set @gapType = 'end'
				END
		
		
				WHILE @availableSpace = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ AND @numberOfLocations2 > 0
				BEGIN
		--			Print 'Began 2nd Loop'
		--			Print @buildingUnitRow
					--******* WEIGHT CODE ************
					IF(@restrictStockWeight = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ AND @maximumColumnWeight > 0 AND @buildingUnitBayLevel <> 'A')
					BEGIN
						Print 'weight1'
						IF(@previousBuildingUnitColumnForWeight <> @buildingUnitColumn)
						BEGIN
							Set @runningColumnWeight = @units2
						END ELSE
						BEGIN
							Set @runningColumnWeight = @runningColumnWeight + @units2
						END
						Set @previousBuildingUnitColumnForWeight = @buildingUnitColumn
						if(@previousBuildingUnitBayPK <> @buildingUnitBayPK)
						BEGIN
							Set @runningBayWeight = @units2
						END ELSE
						BEGIN
							Set @runningBayWeight = @runningBayWeight + @units2
						END
						Set @previousBuildingUnitBayPK = @buildingUnitBayPK
						--If the current located weight + what we have added already + what we want to add is greater than the limit, skip the location
						IF((@columnWeight + @runningColumnWeight) > @maximumColumnWeight
							OR
							(@bayWeight + @runningBayWeight) > @maximumBayWeight)
						BEGIN
							print 'weight too much!'
							goto Skip --we have gone over the weight limit for this column or bay, skip it
						END
					END
					--****** END OF WEIGHT CODE ************
		--			Print 'Column Weight ' + cast(@columnWeight as nvarchar(50))
		--			Print 'Running Column Weight ' + cast(@runningColumnWeight as nvarchar(50))
			
					if @firstRun = 0 
					BEGIN
						Set @sql = @sql + ' UNION ALL '
					END
					ELSE
					BEGIN
						Set @startColumn = @buildingUnitColumn
					END
					Set @thisLineSql = ' Select ''' + @buildingUnit + ''' BuildingUnit,''' + case when @translateRow = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ then @translatedRow 
					else @buildingUnitRow end + ''' Row,''' + case when @translateRow = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ then case when @reverseTranslate = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ then 
					cast(@translateColumn - @buildingUnitColumn as nvarchar(10)) else cast(@buildingUnitColumn + @translateColumn as nvarchar(10)) end else 
					cast(@buildingUnitColumn as nvarchar(10)) end + ''' BuildingUnitColumn,''' + case when @translateRow = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ then 
					case when @reverseTranslate = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ then cast(@translateColumn - @buildingUnitColumn as nvarchar(10)) else 
					cast(@buildingUnitColumn + @translateColumn as nvarchar(10)) end else cast(@buildingUnitColumn as nvarchar(10)) end 
					+ ''' BuildingUnitColumnName,''' + @buildingUnitBayLevel + ''' BayLevel,' + cast(@bayPosition as nvarchar(50))	+ ' BayPosition,' 
					+ cast(@palletStart as nvarchar(50)) + ' PalletStart,' + cast((@palletStart + @width) as nvarchar(50)) + ' PalletEnd,' 
					+ cast(@buildingUnitBayPK as nvarchar(100)) + ' LocationFK'	
					Set @sql = @sql	+ @thisLineSql
					--Print @sql
			
					Set @availableGap = @availableGap - @width
					if (@availableGap < @width) 
					BEGIN
						IF (@gapType = 'whole')
							Set @availableSpace = 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/				
						ELSE IF (@gapType = 'between')
						BEGIN
							IF (@gapToStartOfBay >= @width)
							BEGIN
								Set @bayPosition = @startBayPosition
								Set @palletStart = 0
								Set @availableGap = @gapToStartOfBay
								Set @gapType = 'start'
							END
							ELSE IF (@gapToEndOfBay >= @width)
							BEGIN
								Set @bayPosition = @endBayPosition
								Set @palletStart = @endBayPalletStart
								Set @availableGap = @gapToEndOfBay
								Set @gapType = 'end'
							END
							ELSE Set @availableSpace = 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/	
						END
						ELSE IF (@gapType = 'start')
						BEGIN
							IF (@gapToEndOfBay >= @width)
							BEGIN
								Set @bayPosition = @endBayPosition
								Set @palletStart = @endBayPalletStart
								Set @availableGap = @gapToEndOfBay
								Set @gapType = 'end'
							END
							ELSE Set @availableSpace = 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/	
						END
						ELSE IF (@gapType = 'end')
						BEGIN
							Set @availableSpace = 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/	
						END
			
					END
					ELSE
					BEGIN
						Set @bayPosition = @bayPosition + 1
						Set @palletStart = @palletStart + @width
					END

			
					Set @numberOfLocations2 = @numberOfLocations2 - 1
					Set @firstRun = 0

					/*KEEP BATCH TOGETHER**************/
					if(@overrideBuildingUnitRules = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/)
					BEGIN
						/*Keep batch in one or more adjoining columns*/
						if(@keepBatchTogetherLevel2 = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/)
						BEGIN
							if(@previousBuildingUnitColumn = -1)
							BEGIN
								Set @previousBuildingUnitColumn = @buildingUnitColumn
							END
							ELSE
							BEGIN 
								/* This next 'if' statement is complex */
								/* Explanation*/
								/* If we have skipped a column since the last location 
									AND we have also moved more than one column from
									the columns used for a previous batch location
									AND we havent moved just one column since we were last here then
									we need to start again*/
								if(
									((ABS(@previousBuildingUnitColumn - @buildingUnitColumn) > 1 
									AND @previousFirstBuildingUnitColumn2 = -1)
							
									OR 
										(
										(@previousFirstBuildingUnitColumn2 > 0) AND
										((@buildingUnitColumn > (@previousFirstBuildingUnitColumn2 + 1)
										OR
										(@buildingUnitColumn < (@previousLastBuildingUnitColumn2 - 1)))
										)
									))
									AND ABS(@previousBuildingUnitColumn - @buildingUnitColumn) <> 1
								)
								BEGIN /*If selection has jumped a column, reset and start again*/
									Print 'Starting Again'
									Select @previousBuildingUnitColumn = @buildingUnitColumn,
									@numberOfLocations2 = @originalNumberOfLocations - 1,
									@firstRun = 0,
									@sql = @thisLineSql,
									@startColumn = @buildingUnitColumn
								END
							END
						END
					END
				END

				If (@numberOfLocations2 = 0)
				BEGIN
					Insert into @myLocations
					values (@buildingUnitRowNumber, 
						@buildingUnitRow,
						@startColumn,
						@sql) 
					If (@currentRow < @numberOfRows AND @previousLastBuildingUnitRow2 <> @buildingUnitRow) 
					BEGIN
						Set @currentRow = @currentRow + 1
						Set @numberOfLocations2 = @originalNumberOfLocations
						Set @firstRun = 1
						Set @sql = ''
					END
				END
		
		Skip:
				FETCH NEXT FROM BayCursor INTO 
				@buildingUnitBayPK, @maximumBayWeight, @bayWeight,
				@buildingUnitRow, @buildingUnitRowNumber,
				@translateRow, @translatedRow, @reverseTranslate, @translateColumn,
				@buildingUnitColumn, @buildingUnitColumnName, @maximumColumnWeight, @columnWeight, @buildingUnitBayLevel, 
				@gapBetweenPallets, @gapBetweenPalletsBayPosition, @gapBetweenPalletsPalletStart, 
				@gapToEndOfBay, @endBayPosition, @endBayPalletStart, 
				@gapToStartOfBay, @startBayPosition, @startBayPalletStart, 
				@gapWholeBay, @wholeBayPosition, @wholeBayPalletStart,
				@locationOrder
			END
			CLOSE BayCursor 
			DEALLOCATE BayCursor 
	
	
			Print 'here'
			Set @sql = ''
			IF (@previousLastBuildingUnitRow2 <> '')
			BEGIN
				Select @sql = Sql from @myLocations where RowLetter = @previousLastBuildingUnitRow2
			END 
	
			IF(@sql = '') --if we had no previous row OR there was no available locations for the previous row, do regular selection
			BEGIN
				Select Top 1 @sql = Sql from @myLocations
				Order by ColumnNumber Desc, RowNumber Asc
			END
			--Print @sql
			--Print(len(@sql))
			Exec(@sql)
			--Select * from @myLocations
	
			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end

			
			
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END
GO

-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spCycleCountsGetBuildingUnitLocations]
(
	@buildingUnitFK int,
	@worksOrderFK int
)
AS
BEGIN
	/* 12/06/2017 Cathal ࡃuirr® This stored procedure is not used by any other STAWMS database stored procedure 
	   or the STAWMS web application and will be removed in future, hence the RETURN on the next line */
	RETURN
	/*
	-- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from
	-- interfering with SELECT statements.
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

	Declare @lastWeekNumber int
	Declare @lastFrequency int
	Declare @lastLocation nvarchar(200)
	Declare @lastLocationFK int
	Declare @lastLocationTypeFK int
	Declare @lastRowNumber int
	Declare @lastColumnNumber int
	Declare @cycleCountDividerFK int

	Declare @thisFrequency int

	Select @cycleCountDividerFK = CycleCountDividerFK from tblBuildingUnits
	Where BuildingUnitPK = @buildingUnitFK

	Select Top 1 @lastWeekNumber = WeekNumber, @lastFrequency = OfWeeks, 
	@lastLocation = CASE WHEN cycleCountLocations.LocationTypeFK = 1/*Racking*/ THEN buRows.Row + buCols.BuildingUnitColumnName + buBAys.BayLevel
						 WHEN cycleCountLocations.LocationTypeFK = 6/*Floor Location*/ THEN floorLocations.FloorLocation END,
	@lastLocationFK = cycleCountLocations.LocationFK,
	@lastLocationTypeFK = cycleCountLocations.LocationTypeFK,
	@lastRowNumber = cycleCountLocations.RowNumber,
	@lastColumnNumber = cycleCountLocations.BuildingUnitColumn
	from tblCycleCounts cycleCounts

	left outer join tblCycleCountLocations cycleCountLocations on
	cycleCountLocations.CycleCountFK = cycleCounts.CycleCountPK

	left outer join tblFloorLocations floorLocations on
	floorLocations.FloorLocationPK = cycleCountLocations.LocationFK

	left outer join tblBuildingUnitBays buBays on
	buBays.BuildingUnitBayPK = cycleCountLocations.LocationFK
	
	left outer join tblBuildingUnitColumns buCols on
	buCols.BuildingUnitColumnPK = buBays.BuildingUnitColumnFK

	left outer join tblBuildingUnitRows buRows on
	buRows.BuildingUnitRowPK = buCols.BuildingUnitRowFK

	Where cycleCounts.BuildingUnitFK = @buildingUnitFK
	Order by convert(varchar, cycleCountLocations.InsertedDate, 111) desc,
	cycleCountLocations.LocationTypeFK asc,
	CASE WHEN cycleCountLocations.LocationTypeFK = 1/*Racking*/ THEN buRows.Row + buCols.BuildingUnitColumnName + buBays.BayLevel
         WHEN cycleCountLocations.LocationTypeFK = 6/*FloorLocations*/ THEN floorLocations.FloorLocation
    END Desc

	if (@lastWeekNumber = @lastFrequency OR @lastWeekNumber is null) --if finished cycle
	BEGIN
		--get the frequency from the building unit if it has changed
		Set @thisFrequency = (Select CycleCountFrequency from tblBuildingUnits where BuildingUnitPK = @buildingUnitFK)
		--set weeknumber to 0
		Set @lastWeekNumber = 0
		Set @lastRowNumber = 0
		Set @lastColumnNumber = 0
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		Set @thisFrequency = @lastFrequency
	END

	--Create the cycle count
	insert into tblCycleCounts
	Select @worksOrderFK, @buildingUnitFK, -1/*StockItem*/, @lastWeekNumber + 1/*WeekNumber*/, @thisFrequency/*OfWeeks*/,0/*cast(0 as bit)*/,
	0/*cast(0 as bit)*/, 1, dbo.GetBSTDate(), 1, dbo.GetBSTDate()
	
	Declare @cycleCountFK int
	Set @cycleCountFK = @@identity
	/*3 Methods of cycle count*/
	/*1- Divide building unit into rows, count x rows every week*/
	/*2- Divide building unit into columns, count all bays in x columns every week*/
	/*3- Divide building unit into bays, count x bays every week*/


IF (@cycleCountDividerFK = 1)
BEGIN
/***** DIVIDER 1, By ROW **********/
	Declare @rows int
	Declare @rowsToCount int

	Declare @remainingRows int
	Declare @additionalRow int

	Set @rows = (Select count(*) from tblBuildingUnitRows where BuildingUnitFK = @buildingUnitFK)
	Set @remainingRows = (@rows % @thisFrequency)
	if(@remainingRows = 0 OR @lastWeekNumber >= @remainingRows)
		Set @additionalRow = 0
	ELSE
		Set @additionalRow = 1



	Set @rowsToCount = floor(@rows/@thisFrequency)
	insert into tblCycleCountLocations
	Select @cycleCountFK, 1/*Racking*/, buBays.BuildingUnitBayPK,
	buRows.Row + right('0' + buCols.BuildingUnitColumnName, 2) + lower(buBays.BayLevel),
	buRows.RowNumber, buCols.BuildingUnitColumn, 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/, 
	0/*cast(0 as bit)*/, 1, dbo.GetBSTDate(), 1, dbo.GetBSTDate()
	From tblBuildingUnitBays buBays
	inner join tblBuildingUnitColumns buCols on
	buCols.BuildingUnitColumnPK = buBays.BuildingUnitColumnFK
	inner join tblBuildingUnitRows buRows on
	buRows.BuildingUnitRowPK = buCols.BuildingUnitRowFK

	where buRows.BuildingUnitFK = @buildingUnitFK 
	AND buRows.RowNumber between @lastRowNumber + 1 AND @lastRowNumber + @rowsToCount + @additionalRow

END
ELSE IF (@cycleCountDividerFK = 2)
BEGIN
	/***** DIVIDER 2, By COLUMN **********/
	Declare @columns int
	Declare @columnsToCount int

	Declare @remainingColumns int
	Declare @additionalColumn int

	Set @columns = (Select count(*) from tblBuildingUnitColumns  buCols
	inner join tblBuildingUnitRows buRows on
	buRows.BuildingUnitRowPK = buCols.BuildingUnitRowFK
	where BuildingUnitFK = @buildingUnitFK)
	Set @remainingColumns = (@columns % @thisFrequency)
	if(@remainingColumns = 0 OR @lastWeekNumber >= @remainingColumns)
		Set @additionalColumn = 0
	ELSE
		Set @additionalColumn = 1

	
	Set @columnsToCount = floor(@columns/@thisFrequency)
--	print @remainingColumns
--	print @lastWeekNumber
--	print @lastColumnNumber
--	print @columnsToCount
--	print @additionalColumn
	insert into tblCycleCountLocations
	Select @cycleCountFK, 1/*Racking*/, buBays.BuildingUnitBayPK,
	buRows.Row + right('0' + buCols.BuildingUnitColumnName, 2) + lower(buBays.BayLevel),
	buRows.RowNumber, buCols.BuildingUnitColumn, 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/, 
	0/*cast(0 as bit)*/, 1, dbo.GetBSTDate(), 1, dbo.GetBSTDate()
	From tblBuildingUnitBays buBays
	inner join tblBuildingUnitColumns buCols on
	buCols.BuildingUnitColumnPK = buBays.BuildingUnitColumnFK
	inner join tblBuildingUnitRows buRows on
	buRows.BuildingUnitRowPK = buCols.BuildingUnitRowFK

	where buRows.BuildingUnitFK = @buildingUnitFK 
	AND buCols.BuildingUnitColumn between @lastColumnNumber + 1 AND @lastColumnNumber + @columnsToCount + @additionalColumn
END

Select @cycleCountFK
*/

END
GO

-- Description: <Description,,>                            
-- =============================================       
      
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spDdBuildingsForExternalTransportUser]          
(          
 @UserFK int = -1           
)          
AS          
BEGIN          
SELECT   
b.BuildingPK,  
b.BuildingName[TextField],uc.CustomerFK  
FROM tblUserCustomer uc   
LEFT JOIN tblCustomers c ON uc.CustomerFK=c.CustomerPK  
LEFT JOIN tblDivisions d ON c.CustomerPK=d.CustomerFK  
LEFT JOIN tblDivisionBuildingUnits db ON d.DivisionPK=db.DivisionFK  
LEFT JOIN tblBuildingUnits bu ON db.BuildingUnitFK=bu.BuildingUnitPK  
LEFT JOIN tblBuildings b ON bu.BuildingFK=b.BuildingPK  
LEFT JOIN tblUsers u ON uc.UserFK=u.UserPK  
WHERE uc.UserFK=@UserFK   AND db.IsArchived=0 AND bu.IsArchived=0
GROUP BY b.BuildingPK, b.BuildingName,uc.CustomerFK      
ORDER BY b.BuildingName        
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spDdBuildingsForWarehouseClientUser]  
(  
 @UserFK int = -1   
)  
AS  
BEGIN  
SELECT DISTINCT b.BuildingPK, b.BuildingName[TextField]
FROM tblUsers u
INNER JoIN tblUserDivisions ud on ud.UserFK=u.UserPK
INNER JoIN tbldivisions d on ud.DivisionFK=d.DivisionPK
INNER JoIN tblDivisionBuildingUnits dbu on dbu.DivisionFK=d.DivisionPK
INNER JoIN tblbuildingunits bu on dbu.BuildingUnitFK=bu.BuildingUnitPK
--inner join tblUserBuildingUnits ubu on ubu.BuildingUnitFK = bu.BuildingUnitPK 
INNER JoIN tblbuildings b on bu.BuildingFK=b.BuildingPK

/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[spDdBuildingUnitBays]    Script Date: 02/11/2026 17:47:26 ******/

-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
--
-- Modify: Damie Gannon 
--		   Exclude Archive BuildingUnitBays (Column & Rows)
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spDdBuildingUnitBays]
(
	@buildingUnitColumnPK int = -1,
	@buildingUnitBayFK int = -1
)
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT
 ,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;
	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	DECLARE @buildingUnitColumnPK2 int, @buildingUnitBayFK2 int
	SET @buildingUnitColumnPK2 = @buildingUnitColumnPK; SET @buildingUnitBayFK2 = @buildingUnitBayFK

	SET @ParameterDetails = '@buildingUnitColumnPK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@buildingUnitColumnPK2 AS NVARCHAR(20)),'') 
		+ ',@buildingUnitBayFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@buildingUnitBayFK2 AS NVARCHAR(20)),'')

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    --BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

		SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END


	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY
			

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start

			if(@buildingUnitBayFK2 <> -1)
				Set @buildingUnitColumnPK2 = (Select BuildingUnitColumnFK from tblBuildingUnitBays where BuildingUnitBayPK = @buildingUnitBayFK2 And IsArchived = 0)	/* DG Excluse Archived Bays */

			Select -1 as BuildingUnitBayPK, '-Select-' as TextField
			 
			UNION
			 
			Select BuildingUnitBayPK, BayLevel 
			FROM dbo.tblBuildingUnitBays
			where BuildingUnitColumnFK = @buildingUnitColumnPK2 And IsArchived = 0 /* DG Excluse Archived Bays */
		
			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end

			
			
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)
