			INNER JOIN tblbuildingunits ON buildingunitpk = tso.ResponsibleBuildingUnitFK
			INNER JOIN dbo.tblBuildings tb ON buildingfk = tb.BuildingPK
			GROUP BY BuildingName + ' - ' + BuildingUnit, BuildingUnitPk, PickupLoadingBayFK, StockOrderPK

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end

			
			
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END

-- Create date: <12/08/2026>          
-- Description: <Description,,>          
-- =============================================     
    
    
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spDdContainerOutLoadingTypeForChannel]    
AS    
BEGIN    
    SET NOCOUNT ON;    
    
    SELECT    
        ContainerOutLoadingTypePK,    
        ContainerOutLoadingType AS TextField   
    FROM dbo.appContainerOutLoadingTypes    
    WHERE IsArchived = 0    
     
   UNION ALL  
  
    SELECT  
        -1 AS ContainerOutLoadingTypePK,  
        'No Restriction' AS TextField  
  
    ORDER BY ContainerOutLoadingTypePK;  
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spDdCustomerDeliveryAddresses]
(
	@ClientUserFK int
)
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT
 ,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;
	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	DECLARE @ClientUserFK2 INT
	SET @ClientUserFK2 = @ClientUserFK;

	SET @ParameterDetails = '@ClientUserFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@ClientUserFK2 AS NVARCHAR(20)),'')

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    --BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

		SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY
			

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start			
			Select -1 as DeliveryAddressPK, '-Select-' as TextField 

			UNION 

			SELECT DeliveryAddressPK, replace(da.Address1     
				 + case when da.Address2 = '' then '' else ', ' + da.Address2 end    
				 + case when da.Address3 = '' then '' else ', ' + da.Address3 end    
				 + case when da.Address4 = '' then '' else ', ' + da.Address4 end    
				 + case when da.Address5 = '' then '' else ', ' + da.Address5 end     
				 + case when da.CountryFK < 0 then '' else ', ' + Country end     
				 + case when CountyFK < 0 then '' else ', ' + County end, ',,', ',')
			FROM         dbo.tblDeliveryAddresses da
			inner join dbo.tblDivisions divs on da.customerfk = divs.CustomerFK
			inner join tblUserDivisions uds on uds.DivisionFK = divs.DivisionPK			
			left outer join tblCounties on CountyPK = da.CountyFK
			left outer join tblCountries on CountryPK = da.CountryFK
			where uds.UserFK = @ClientUserFK2 and da.IsArchived = 0

		
			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end

			
			
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */

			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */

   UNION     
   Select DepartmentPK as DepartmentPK,  
    -- Department: DepartmentName[DepartmentCode] or BuildingName[DepartmentCode] if no DepartmentName    
    ISNULL(NULLIF(DepartmentName, ''), buildings.BuildingName)   
        + ' [' + ISNULL(DepartmentCode, 'NO CODE') + ']' as TextField  
   -- DepartmentCode + ' - ' + case when DepartmentName = '' then buildings.BuildingName else DepartmentName end    
   FROM tblDepartments deps    
   left outer join tblBuildingUnits bus on    
   bus.BuildingUnitPK = deps.BuildingUnitFK    
   left outer join tblBuildings buildings on    
   buildings.BuildingPK = bus.BuildingFK    
      
   -- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end    
    
       
       
   BREAK    
  END TRY    
  BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */    
   DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;    
   SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;    
   SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;    
    
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY     
   BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;    
           
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;    
    
           IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID    
                
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;    
                
   IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)    
   BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END    
   ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */    
  END CATCH    
  SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1    
 END    
END

	@divisionFK int

AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT

            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;

			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END

				countries.CountryPK = countryRules.CountryFK
				inner join appWorksOrderTypes wots on
				wots.WorksOrderTypePK = countryRules.WorksOrderTypeFK
				left outer join tblDivisionWorksOrderCountryRules dwocrs on
				dwocrs.CountryRuleFK = countryRules.CountryRulePK
				AND dwocrs.DivisionFK = @divisionFK2
				where dwocrs.DivisionWorksOrderCountryRulePK is null
			END
			ELSE
			BEGIN
				Select -1 as CountryRulePK, '-Select-' as TextField 

				UNION

				Select CountryRulePK, countries.Country + ' - ' + wots.WorksOrderType as TextField
				from tblCountryRules countryRules
				inner join tblCountries countries on
				countries.CountryPK = countryRules.CountryFK
				inner join appWorksOrderTypes wots on
				wots.WorksOrderTypePK = countryRules.WorksOrderTypeFK
				left outer join tblDivisionWorksOrderCountryRules dwocrs on
				dwocrs.CountryRuleFK = countryRules.CountryRulePK
				AND dwocrs.DivisionFK = @divisionFK2
				where dwocrs.DivisionWorksOrderCountryRulePK is null
		
				UNION

				Select CountryRulePK, countries.Country + ' - ' + wots.WorksOrderType as TextField
				from tblCountryRules countryRules
				inner join tblCountries countries on
				countries.CountryPK = countryRules.CountryFK
				inner join appWorksOrderTypes wots on
				wots.WorksOrderTypePK = countryRules.WorksOrderTypeFK
				Where CountryRulePK = @PK2
			END
	
			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end

			
			
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END

 INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()  
  
 WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3  
 BEGIN   
  BEGIN TRY  
     
  
   -- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start  
  
   Select * from   
   (      
    Select -1 as PK, '-Select-' as TextField   
  
    --UNION   
  
    --Select 0 as PK, 'AdHoc' as TextField   
  
    UNION  
  
    Select   
     DivisionExtraServicePK as PK, [Name] + ' - ' + cast(Charge as nvarchar(50)) + ' per ' + isnull(ChargeSubject, '') as TextField  
    FROM   
     dbo.tblDivisionExtraServices dess

     on css.ChargeSubjectPK = dess.ChargeSubjectFK  
    Where   
     DivisionFK = @divisionFK2  
   ) AS subQ   
   Order By   
    PK  
    
   -- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end  
  
     
     
   BREAK  
  END TRY  
  BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */

   BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;  
         
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;  
  
            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID  
              
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;

   BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END  
   ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */

	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;

			--Select -1 as DivisionPK, '-Select-' as TextField 

			--UNION 

			SELECT DivisionPK, DivisionName  + ' (' + DivisionCode + ')' as TextField  
			FROM         dbo.tblDivisions divs
			inner join tblUserDivisions uds on
			uds.DivisionFK = divs.DivisionPK
			where uds.UserFK = @ClientUserFK2

		END TRY

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spDdEmployeeActivityTypes]
AS
BEGIN
	IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#T') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #T

	CREATE TABLE #T
	(
		EmployeeActivityTypePK INT,
		EmployeeActivityType NVARCHAR(200)
	)

	INSERT INTO #T
	SELECT 0 AS EmployeeActivityTypePK, '<Please select>' AS EmployeeActivityType
	UNION
	SELECT EmployeeActivityTypePK, EmployeeActivityType 
	FROM dbo.appEmployeeActivityTypes 
	ORDER BY EmployeeActivityType ASC

	SELECT * FROM #T
	ORDER BY EmployeeActivityType ASC
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spDdExtraServiceStockItems]
(
	@stockOrderFK int = -1,
	@stockInFK int = -1,
	@isEdit bit = 0
)
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT

	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	DECLARE @stockOrderFK2 int, @stockInFK2 int, @isEdit2 bit

	SET @stockOrderFK2 = @stockOrderFK; SET @stockInFK2 = @stockInFK; SET @isEdit2 = @isEdit

	SET @ParameterDetails = '@stockOrderFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@stockOrderFK2 AS NVARCHAR(20)),'') + ',@stockInFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@stockInFK2 AS NVARCHAR(20)),'')
		+ ',@isEdit = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@isEdit2 AS NVARCHAR(20)),'')

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    --BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

		SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END


	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY
			

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start

			IF(@isEdit2 = 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/) 
			BEGIN
				IF(@stockOrderFK2 <> -1) 
				BEGIN
					Select -1 as StockItemPK, '-All-' as  TextField
					UNION
					Select sis.StockItemPK, sis.StockItemCode as TextField
					From (Select * from tblStockOrders where StockOrderPK = @stockOrderFK2) sos
					inner join tblContainerOutLines cols on
					cols.ContainerOutFK = sos.ContainerOutFK
					inner join tblStockItems sis on
					sis.StockItemPK = cols.StockItemFK
					Group By sis.StockItemPK, sis.StockItemCode  
				END 
				ELSE IF (@stockInFK2 <> -1) 
				BEGIN
					Select -1 as StockItemPK, '-All-' as  TextField
					UNION
					Select sis.StockItemPK, sis.StockItemCode as TextField 
					From (Select * from tblStockIns where StockInPK = @stockInFK2) sins
					inner join tblStockInLines sils on
					sils.StockInFK = sins.StockInPK
					inner join tblStockItems sis on
					sis.StockItemPK = sils.StockItemFK
					Group By sis.StockItemPK, sis.StockItemCode 
				END 
				ELSE
					Select -1 as StockItemPK, '-All-' as  TextField
			END 
			ELSE 
			BEGIN
				IF(@stockOrderFK2 <> -1) 
				BEGIN
					Select -1 as StockItemPK, '-All-' as  TextField
					UNION
					Select sis.StockItemPK, sis.StockItemCode as TextField
					From (Select * from tblStockOrders where StockOrderPK = @stockOrderFK2) sos
					inner join tblContainerOutLines cols on
					cols.ContainerOutFK = sos.ContainerOutFK
					inner join tblStockItems sis on
					sis.StockItemPK = cols.StockItemFK
					Group By sis.StockItemPK, sis.StockItemCode  	
				END 
				ELSE IF (@stockInFK2 <> -1) 
				BEGIN
					Select -1 as StockItemPK, '-All-' as  TextField
					UNION
					Select sis.StockItemPK, sis.StockItemCode as TextField 
					From (Select * from tblStockIns where StockInPK = @stockInFK2) sins
					inner join tblStockInLines sils on
					sils.StockInFK = sins.StockInPK
					inner join tblStockItems sis on
					sis.StockItemPK = sils.StockItemFK
					Group By sis.StockItemPK, sis.StockItemCode 
				END 
				ELSE 
					Select -1 as StockItemPK, '-All-' as  TextField
			END

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end

			
			
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;

			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spDdPalletBatches]

	@palletFK int
)
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED

	SET @ParameterDetails = '@palletFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@palletFK2 AS NVARCHAR(20)),'')

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spDdPalletPers]
(
	@palletFK int,
	@stockItemFK int,
	@batch nvarchar(100)
)
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT
 ,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;
	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	DECLARE @palletFK2 int, @stockItemFK2 int, @batch2 nvarchar(100)

	SET @palletFK2 = @palletFK; SET @stockItemFK2 = @stockItemFK; SET @batch2 = @batch

	SET @ParameterDetails = '@palletFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@palletFK2 AS NVARCHAR(20)),'') + ',@stockItemFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@stockItemFK2 AS NVARCHAR(20)),'')
		+ ',@batch = ' + ISNULL(@batch2,'')

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY
			

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start

			Select -1 as DamagedPerPK, '-Select-' as TextField 
			
			UNION 

			Select 
				ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY ActualUnits ASC) AS DamagedPerPK, 
				Cast(ActualUnits as nvarchar(50)) AS TextField
			from 
				tblPalletContent AS pc 
			where 
				pc.PalletFK = @palletFK2 
				AND pc.StockItemFK = @stockItemFK2
				AND pc.Batch = @batch2
				AND pc.IsArchived = 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/
			Group By 
				ActualUnits
			Order by 
				DamagedPerPK

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end

			
			
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID

			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END

CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[spDdPalletTypes]
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;  
    Select -1 as PalletTypePK, '-Select-' as TextField  
     
  UNION All 
  
  SELECT Distinct
        PalletTypePK,
        PalletType AS TextField
    FROM dbo.tblPalletTypes

		BEGIN TRY
			

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start

			Declare @customerFK int

			Select @customerFK = CustomerFK 
			from tblDivisions 
			where DivisionPK = (Select DivisionFK from tblStockItems where StockItemPK = @stockItemFK2)

			Select * from 
			(    
				Select -1 as PK, 'No Special Type' as TextField 

				UNION 

				Select 
					SpecialStockTypePK as PK, SpecialStockType as TextField

					dbo.tblCustomerSpecialStockTypes cssts 
				inner join appSpecialStockTypes ssts 
					on ssts.SpecialStockTypePK = cssts.SpecialStockTypeFK
				Where 
					CustomerFK = @customerFK
			) AS subQ 
			Order By 
				PK ASC
		
			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end

			
			
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END

 WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3  
 BEGIN   
  BEGIN TRY  
     
  
   -- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start  
      
   Select -1 as FieldPK, '-Select-' as TextField   
     
   UNION   
  
   Select 14, 'Batch'  
     
   UNION  
  
   Select 102, 'Supplier Batch'  
     
   UNION

			BREAK

			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spDdStockOrderPossibleMoveToPallets]
(
	@stockOrderFK int
)
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT
 ,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;
	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	DECLARE @stockOrderFK2 int

	SET @stockOrderFK2 = @stockOrderFK

	SET @ParameterDetails = '@stockOrderFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@stockOrderFK2 AS NVARCHAR(20)),'')

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    --BEGIN

        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END


	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY
			

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start

			Declare @containerOutFK int
			Select @containerOutFK = ContainerOutFK from tblStockOrders where StockOrderPK = @stockOrderFK2 

			Select '-1' as PalletBarcode, '-Select-' as PalletBarcode2 

			UNION

			Select 
			DestinationBarcode as PalletBarcode,
			'** ' + case when DestinationCustomerBarcode <> '' then DestinationCustomerBarcode else DestinationBarcode end as PalletBarcode2 	
			from tblWorksOrderPalletInstructions wopis
			inner join tblWorksOrderPallets wops on
			wops.WorksOrderPalletPK = wopis.WorksOrderPalletFK
			inner join tblWorksOrders wos on
			wos.WorksOrderPK = wops.WorksOrderFK
			Where wos.WorksOrderOriginFK = 2/*StockOrder*/ AND FK = @stockOrderFK2  
			AND wopis.InstructionTypeFK = 1 /*Create Pallet*/
	
			UNION

			Select Barcode as PalletBarcode, Barcode2 as PalletBarcode2 from 
			(
				Select 
				pals.Barcode as Barcode,
				case when pals.CustomerBarcode <> '' then pals.CustomerBarcode else pals.Barcode end as Barcode2
		
				From tblPallets pals
				inner join tblContainerOutLinePalletContent colpc on
				colpc.PalletFK = pals.PalletPK
				inner join tblContainerOutLines cols on
				cols.ContainerOutLinePK = colpc.ContainerOutLineFK
				Where cols.ContainerOutFK = @containerOutFK
				--AND pals.PalletPK not in (Select PalletFK from tblWorksOrderPallets wops inner join tblWorksOrders wos on wos.WorksOrderPK = wops.WorksOrderFK where wos.WorksOrderOriginFK = 2/*StockOrder*/ AND FK = @stockOrderFK)
			) AS subQ

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end

			
			
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spDdTMSDepartments]
AS
BEGIN
	SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY Department ASC) AS DepartmentPK, 
		*
	FROM
		(
			SELECT '<Please select>' AS Department
			UNION
			SELECT DISTINCT
			vbd.DepartmentTMS AS Department
			FROM dbo.viewBuildingDetails vbd
			WHERE isnull(vbd.DepartmentTMS, '') <> ''
		) subQuery
END

/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[spDdUserBuildings]    Script Date: 02/11/2026 17:47:26 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spDdUserBuildings] -- spGetUserBuildings 287  
(  
 @userFK INT  
)  
AS  
BEGIN  
 DECLARE @varUserFK INT = @userFK  
  
 DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #results  
  
 SELECT DISTINCT  
  b.BuildingPK AS BuildingPK,   
  
  --CASE WHEN ISNULL(b.DepartmentTMS, '') <> '' THEN b.DepartmentTMS ELSE b.BuildingName END AS BuildingName  
  
  CASE   
   WHEN b.BuildingName = '6CR1' THEN 'Six Cross Roads'  
   WHEN ISNULL(b.DepartmentTMS, '') = '' THEN b.BuildingName  
   ELSE b.DepartmentTMS  
  END AS BuildingName  
 INTO  
  #results  
 FROM   
  dbo.tblBuildings AS b   
 INNER JOIN dbo.tblBuildingUnits AS bu  
  ON b.buildingpk = bu.BuildingFK  
 INNER JOIN dbo.tblUserBuildingUnits AS ubu  
  ON BU.BuildingUnitPK = ubu.BuildingUnitFK  
 INNER JOIN dbo.tblUsers AS USR  
  ON UBU.UserFK = USR.UserPK  
 WHERE   
  ubu.UserFK = @varUserFK  
  AND bu.IsArchived = 0    
  AND b.BuildingName IN ('BV1', 'BV2', 'BV4', 'BV5', '6CR1', 'CR1', 'Dun1', 'KIL1', 'KIL2', 'NEX1', 'SR1', 'BV3', 'CAR1')  
  AND b.BuildingName NOT IN ('6CR11C')  
 UNION  
 SELECT 1 AS BuildingPK, 'Transport' AS BuildingName  
 UNION  
 SELECT 9999 AS BuildingPK, 'Quality' AS BuildingName  
  
 IF EXISTS(  
	select 1   
    from dbo.AspNetUserRoles t1  
    inner join dbo.AspNetUsers t2   on t1.UserId = t2.Id  
    inner join dbo.AspNetRoles t3   on t1.RoleId = t3.Id  
    inner join dbo.tblUsers t4   on t2.UserName = t4.UserName  
    where t4.UserPK = @varUserFK  AND t3.NormalizedName = 'ADMINISTRATOR'  

 
    --select 1   
    --from dbo.aspnet_UsersInRoles t1  
    --inner join dbo.aspnet_users t2   on t1.UserId = t2.UserId  
    --inner join dbo.aspnet_Roles t3   on t1.RoleId = t3.RoleId  
    --inner join dbo.tblUsers t4   on t2.UserName = t4.UserName  
    --where t4.UserPK = @varUserFK  AND t3.RoleName = 'Administrator'  
    )  
 BEGIN  
  INSERT INTO #results  
  SELECT 8888 AS BuildingPK, 'IT' AS BuildingName  
 END  
  
 SELECT  
  MAX(BuildingPK) AS BuildingPK,  
  BuildingName  
 FROM  
  #results  
 GROUP BY  
  BuildingName  
 ORDER BY   
  BuildingName ASC  
END
GO

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spDdUserTMSDepartments] -- spGetTMSDepartmentsForUser 287
(
	@UserPK INT
)
AS
BEGIN
	DECLARE @varUserPK INT = @UserPK

	IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#TMSDepartments') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #TMSDepartments

	CREATE TABLE #TMSDepartments
	(
		TMSDepartmentPK INT IDENTITY(1,1),
		TMSDepartmentName NVARCHAR(200)
	)

	INSERT INTO #TMSDepartments
	SELECT DISTINCT b.DepartmentTMS AS TMSDepartmentName
	FROM dbo.tblBuildings AS b 
	INNER JOIN dbo.tblBuildingUnits AS bu
	ON b.buildingpk = bu.BuildingFK
	INNER JOIN dbo.tblUserBuildingUnits AS ubu
	ON BU.BuildingUnitPK = ubu.BuildingUnitFK
	INNER JOIN dbo.tblUsers AS USR
	ON UBU.UserFK = USR.UserPK
	WHERE ubu.UserFK = @varUserPK 
	AND bu.IsArchived = 0  
	AND LTRIM(b.DepartmentTMS) <> ''
	ORDER BY TMSDepartmentName ASC

	SELECT * FROM #TMSDepartments ORDER BY TMSDepartmentPK ASC
END
GO

		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spDeleteEmployeeTMSDetailsRecord]
(
	@tMSEmployeeClockedTimePK INT 
)
AS
BEGIN		
	IF ISNULL(@tMSEmployeeClockedTimePK, -1) < 1 GOTO EXIT_PROC
	
	DECLARE 
		@varTMSEmployeeClockedTimePK INT = @tMSEmployeeClockedTimePK

	BEGIN TRY
		UPDATE dbo.tblTMSEmployeeClockedTimes
		SET DeletedByWMSUser = 1
		WHERE TMSEmployeeClockedTimePK = @varTMSEmployeeClockedTimePK
		AND CreatedByFile = 0
	END TRY
	BEGIN CATCH
		DECLARE @ErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX) = ERROR_MESSAGE(), @ErrorSeverity INT = ERROR_SEVERITY(), @ErrorState INT = ERROR_STATE()

		RAISERROR (@ErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState)
	END CATCH

EXIT_PROC:

END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spDeleteEmployeeTMSDetailsRecords]
(
	@employeeScannedPalletMovementDetailPK INT,
	@userFK INT 
)
AS
BEGIN		
	IF ISNULL(@EmployeeScannedPalletMovementDetailPK, -1) < 1 OR ISNULL(@userFK, -1) < 1 GOTO EXIT_PROC
	
	DECLARE 
		@varEmployeeScannedPalletMovementDetailPK int = @employeeScannedPalletMovementDetailPK, 
		@varUserFK INT = @userFK,
		@varTMSEmployeeClockCardDetailFK INT,
		@varRowCount INT
		
	SELECT DISTINCT 
		@varTMSEmployeeClockCardDetailFK = ttct.TMSEmployeeClockCardDetailFK
	FROM 
		dbo.tblTMSEmployeeClockedTimes ttct
	INNER JOIN dbo.tblEmployeeScannedPalletMovementDetails tespmd
		ON ttct.TMSEmployeeClockCardDetailFK = tespmd.TMSEmployeeClockCardDetailPK
	WHERE 
		tespmd.EmployeeScannedPalletMovementDetailPK = @varEmployeeScannedPalletMovementDetailPK

	IF ISNULL(@varTMSEmployeeClockCardDetailFK, -1) < 1 GOTO EXIT_PROC

	BEGIN TRY
		DELETE FROM dbo.tblTMSEmployeeClockedTimes
		WHERE TMSEmployeeClockCardDetailFK = @varTMSEmployeeClockCardDetailFK
		AND CreatedByFile = 0
		AND DeletedByWMSUser = 1
	END TRY
	BEGIN CATCH
		DECLARE @ErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX) = ERROR_MESSAGE(), @ErrorSeverity INT = ERROR_SEVERITY(), @ErrorState INT = ERROR_STATE()

		RAISERROR (@ErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState)
	END CATCH

EXIT_PROC:

END

 ',@WeekNumber = '+ ISNULL(CAST( @var_weekNumber AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'')+    
 ',@Year = '+ ISNULL(CAST( @var_year AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'')+    
 ',@ScheduleDeliveryPK = '+ ISNULL(CAST( @var_scheduleDeliveryPK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'')+

    UPDATE TblScheduleDeliveries            
    SET IsArchived=1,        
        UpdatedBy=@var_userId,            
        UpdatedDate=@var_updateDate             
    WHERE ScheduleDeliveryPK=@var_scheduleDeliveryPK;

    'Removed ', @var_comment,

   );

        @BuildingFK = @var_buildingFK,    
        @UserId = @var_userId,    
        @CurrentDate = @var_updateDate,    
        @ScheduleWeekPK = @ScheduleWeekPK OUTPUT;     
     
   -- Final output        
       
       DECLARE @var_containerOutFK INT;  
       DECLARE @var_containerInFK INT;          
  
       SELECT @var_containerOutFK = ContainerOutFK  
       FROM tblScheduleDeliveries  
       WHERE ScheduleDeliveryPK = @var_scheduleDeliveryPK;  
  
       SELECT @var_containerInFK = ContainerInFK  
       FROM tblScheduleDeliveries  
       WHERE ScheduleDeliveryPK = @var_scheduleDeliveryPK;  
         
       DECLARE @UserType NVARCHAR(100)=dbo.fnGetUserType(@var_userId);  
       DECLARE @IsExternal BIT = CASE WHEN ISNULL(@UserType, '') = 'ExternalTransportUser' THEN 1
       ELSE 0 END;  
       IF(@IsExternal=1 )        
       BEGIN  
        UPDATE tblContainerOuts  
        SET TransportCompanyFK = -1  
        WHERE ContainerOutPK = @var_containerOutFK
             AND @var_containerOutFK > 0
             AND @var_containerOutFK IS NOT NULL;  
            
  
        UPDATE tblContainerIns  
        SET TransportCompanyFK = -1  
        WHERE ContainerInPK = @var_containerInFK 
              AND @var_containerInFK > 0 
              AND @var_containerInFK IS NOT NULL;   
           
         
           SELECT *  
           FROM dbo.fnGetScheduleWeekForTransportUser  
           (  
               @var_buildingFK,  
               @var_weekNumber,  
               @var_year,  
               @var_userId  
           )  
           ORDER BY ChannelName ASC, DayDate ASC;  
       END  
       ELSE  
        BEGIN  
           SELECT *  
           FROM dbo.fnGetScheduleWeekForBuildingWithYearAndWeekNumber  
           (  
               @var_buildingFK,  
               @var_weekNumber,  
               @var_year,  
               @var_userId  
           )  
           ORDER BY ChannelName ASC, DayDate ASC;  
       END;       
        
  BREAK            
  END TRY         
          
  BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */

   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;            
            
            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID            
                        
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;

  END CATCH        
  SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1;

  BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */            
   DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;            
   SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;            
   SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;            
            
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY             
   BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;            
                   
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;            
            
            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID            
                        
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;            
                        
   IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)            
   BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END            
   ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */            
  END CATCH            
  SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1            
 END            
END

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END

 SET @OrderFK2 = @OrderFK;

 INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()  
  
 WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3  
 BEGIN   
  BEGIN TRY     
   -- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start  
  
   SELECT Distinct DistributionOrderPK AS PK,  
    Orderreference [Order Number],

    --contOuts.Address1 + ', ' + contOuts.Address2 + ', ' + contOuts.Address3 as [Address],

   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;  
  
            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID  
              
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;  
              
   IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)

         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)  
  
    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)  
    --BEGIN  
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC   
  
  SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)  
  
        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)  
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK  
  
        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()  
    --END  
  
  
 SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);  
 SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails  
 ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;  
 INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()  
  
 WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3  
 BEGIN   
  BEGIN TRY     
   -- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start  
  
   SELECT -1 as PK,  
	   ess.Description,
	   cast(ess.NumberOf as int) NumberOf,      
	   sum(CONVERT(DECIMAL(10,2),ess.Charge))   as Charge    
   FROM dbo.tblExtraServices ess      
   LEFT JOIN tblstockitems si  ON ess.StockItemFK = si.StockItemPK      
   LEFT JOIN dbo.tblDivisionExtraServices tdes ON ess.DivisionExtraServiceFK = tdes.DivisionExtraServicePK      
   left outer join appChargeSubjects css on css.ChargeSubjectPK = tdes.ChargeSubjectFK      
   Where StockOrderFK in (select stockorderpk from tblstockorders inner join tblcontainerouts on containeroutpk = containeroutfk where DistributionOrderFK = @OrderFK2)     
   group by ess.Description, ess.NumberOf
   -- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end    
     
   BREAK  
  END TRY  
  BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */  
   DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;  
   SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;  
   SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;  
  
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY   
   BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;  
         
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;  
  
            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID  
              
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;  
              
   IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)  
   BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END  
   ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */  
  END CATCH  
  SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1  
 END

 ,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;    
 SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();    
    
 -- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters    
 DECLARE @OrderFK2 int, @CustomerFK2 int    
 SET @OrderFK2 = @OrderFK; SET @CustomerFK2 = @CustomerFK    
    
 SET @ParameterDetails = '@OrderFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@OrderFK2 AS NVARCHAR(20)),'') + ', @CustomerFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@CustomerFK2 AS NVARCHAR(20)),'')     
    
    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL     
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)    
    
    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)    
    --BEGIN    
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC     
    
  SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)    
    
        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)    
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK    
    
        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()    
    --END    
    
    
 SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);    
 SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails    
 ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;    
 INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()    
    
 WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3    
 BEGIN     
  BEGIN TRY       
   -- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start    
  
   drop table if exists #tmpdistcontainers  
   select * into #tmpdistcontainers from tblcontainerouts where DistributionOrderFK = @OrderFK2  
  
  
    
   select distinct '3_' + cast(DistributionDeliveryMethodShippingChargePK as nvarchar(10)) as PK, ShippingChargeDescription as [Description],     
    dsc.Charge as basecharge, CONVERT(DECIMAL(10,2),dsc.Charge) as Charge , BreakQuantity,     
    --cast(sum(case when NumberOf is null and BreakQuantity > 0 then BreakQuantity else NumberOf end) as int) as NumberOf    
 cast(case when codc.NumberOf is null and BreakQuantity > 0 then BreakQuantity else codc.NumberOf end as int) as NumberOf--, codc.*    
   from tblDistributionOrders do    
   inner join #tmpdistcontainers co on co.DistributionOrderFK =do.DistributionOrderPK    
   inner join tblDistributionDeliveryMethodShippingCharges dsc on do.DeliveryMethodFK = dsc.DistributionDeliveryMethodFK and dsc.customerfk = @CustomerFK2 and dsc.IsArchived = 0    
  -- left join tblContainerOutDistributionCharges codc on co.ContainerOutPK = codc.ContainerOutFK and DistributionChargeTypeFK = 3 /*shipping*/ and  codc.DistributionChargeFK = DistributionDeliveryMethodShippingChargePK    
  left join (  
  select distinct distributionchargetypefk, distributionchargefk, round(sum(numberof), 0,0) NumberOf, Charge, Sum(totalCharge) TotalCharge  
  from tblContainerOutDistributionCharges codc  
  where  ContainerOutFK in (select containeroutpk from #tmpdistcontainers)and DistributionChargeTypeFK = 3 /*shipping*/      
   group by distributionchargetypefk, distributionchargefk, Charge  
 )codc on codc.DistributionChargeFK = DistributionDeliveryMethodShippingChargePK  
   where do.DistributionOrderPK = @OrderFK2    
   group by DistributionDeliveryMethodShippingChargePK, ShippingChargeDescription, dsc.Charge, BreakQuantity  , NumberOf  
   order by dsc.Charge desc     
   -- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end      
       
   BREAK    
  END TRY    
  BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */    
   DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;    
   SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;    
   SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;    
    
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY     
   BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;    
           
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;    
    
            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID    
                
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;    
                
   IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)    
   BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END    
   ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */    
  END CATCH    
  SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1    
 END    
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spDistributionDeliveryAddressCheck]    
(    
 @customerFK int,  
 @Name nvarchar(200),    
 @address1 nvarchar(200),    
 @address2 nvarchar(200),    
 @Town nvarchar(200),    
 @County nvarchar(200),   
 @PostalCode nvarchar(50),  
 @Email nvarchar(200),  
 @Telephone nvarchar(200)   
)     
AS    
BEGIN    
 /* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */    
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED    
    
    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT    
 ,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;    
 SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();    
    
  print 'setting params'  
 -- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters    
 DECLARE @customerFK_2 int, @address1_2 nvarchar(200), @address2_2 nvarchar(200), @Name_2 nvarchar(200), @Town_2 nvarchar(200),   
 @County_2 nvarchar(200), @PostalCode_2 nvarchar(50), @Email_2 nvarchar(200), @Telephone_2 nvarchar(200)  
      
 SET @customerFK_2 = @customerFK; SET @address1_2 = TRIM(@address1); SET @address2_2 = TRIM(@address2); SET @Name_2 = TRIM(@Name); SET @Town_2 = TRIM(@Town); SET @County_2 = TRIM(@County); SET @PostalCode_2 = TRIM(@PostalCode);  
 SET @Email_2 = TRIM(@Email); SET @Telephone_2 = TRIM(@Telephone);  
  print 'params set'  
  
 SET @ParameterDetails = '@address1 = ' + ISNULL(@address1_2,'') + '@address2 = ' + ISNULL(@address2_2,'') + '@Name = ' + ISNULL(@Name_2,'')    
  + '@Town = ' + ISNULL(@Town_2,'') + '@County_2 = ' + ISNULL(@County_2,'')+ '@PostalCode = ' + ISNULL(@PostalCode_2,'')  
  + '@Email = ' + ISNULL(@Email_2,'')+ '@Telephone = ' + ISNULL(@Telephone_2,'')+ '@customerFK = ' + ISNULL(cast(@customerFK_2 as nvarchar(200)),'')  
  
print 'param string set'  
  
    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL     
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)    
    
    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)    
    --BEGIN    
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC     
    
  SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)    
  print 'recroding event'  
        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)    
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK    
    
        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()    
  print 'event recorded'  
    --END    
    
    
 SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);    
 SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails    
 ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;    
 INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

  BEGIN TRY    
   IF XACT_STATE() = 0 AND @@TRANCOUNT < 1 BEGIN TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName    
    
   -- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start    
    
   Declare @deliveryAddressFK int    
    
 IF(EXISTS(  
  Select *   
  from tblDistributionDeliveryAddresses das    
  WHERE CustomerFK = @customerFK_2 AND  
   TRIM(Address1) = @Name_2 AND    
   TRIM(Address2) = @address1_2 AND    
   TRIM(Address3) = @address2_2 AND    
   TRIM(Address4) = @Town_2 AND    
   TRIM(Address5) = @County_2 AND    
   TRIM(PostalCode) = @PostalCode_2 AND    
   TRIM(EmailAddress) = @Email_2 AND    
   TRIM(TelephoneNumber) = @Telephone_2 ))     
 BEGIN    
  --The address exists, select it    
  Select top 1 DistributionDeliveryAddressPK   
  from tblDistributionDeliveryAddresses das    
  WHERE CustomerFK = @customerFK_2 AND  
   TRIM(Address1) = @Name_2 AND    
   TRIM(Address2) = @address1_2 AND    
   TRIM(Address3) = @address2_2 AND    
   TRIM(Address4) = @Town_2 AND    
   TRIM(Address5) = @County_2 AND    
   TRIM(PostalCode) = @PostalCode_2 AND    
   TRIM(EmailAddress) = @Email_2 AND    
   TRIM(TelephoneNumber) = @Telephone_2   
 END     
 ELSE     
 BEGIN --The delivery address does not exists insert and then select    
  print 'new address'    
  declare @countryFK int = -1    
  declare @countyfk int = -1    
  if(@county_2 <> '')    
  begin    
   select @countyfk=CountyPK, @countryFK=CountryFK from tblCounties where County = @county_2   
   
   if(@countyfk = -1)
   begin
	select top 1 @countyfk=CountyPK, @countryFK=CountryFK from tblCounties where @county_2 like '%' + County+ '%' -- County = @county_2    
   end

  end    
    
  print 'got county'    
  print @countyfk    
  print @countryFK    
    
  INSERT into tblDistributionDeliveryAddresses     
  VALUES(    
  -1, @customerFK_2, @Name_2, @address1_2, @address2_2, @Town_2, @County_2, @countyfk, @countryFK, @Telephone_2,    
  0/*cast(0 as bit)*/, 0, dbo.GetBSTDate(), 0, dbo.GetBSTDate(), @PostalCode_2, @Email_2  
  )    
     
  Set @deliveryAddressFK = scope_identity()    
      
  Select @deliveryAddressFK    
    END    
        
   -- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end    
    
   BEGIN TRY IF XACT_STATE() = 1 AND @@TRANCOUNT = 1 AND @OpeningTranCount < 1 COMMIT TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH    
       
   BREAK    
  END TRY    
  BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */    
   DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;    
   SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;    
   SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;    
    
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY     
   BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;    
           
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;    
    
            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID    
                
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;    
                
   IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)    
   BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END    
   ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */    
  END CATCH    
  SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1    
 END    
END

 @divisionFK int,

)        
AS        
BEGIN        
 /* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data; Ensure this proc has a low impact when executed */        
     SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED; SET DEADLOCK_PRIORITY LOW        
        
    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT        
 ,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;        
 SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

 SET @var_divisionFK = @divisionFK; SET @var_invoiceTo = @invoiceTo; SET @var_invoiceFrom = @invoiceFrom;         
      
 --SET @var_InvoiceStorageCharge2 = @invoiceStorageCharge;         
 --SET @var_InvoiceExtraServicesCharge2 = @invoiceExtraServicesCharge;         
 --SET @var_InvoiceDistributionCharge2 = @invoiceDistributionCharge;        
 --SET @var_InvoiceRecurringCharge2 = @invoiceRecurringCharge;

  + ',@invoiceTo = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_invoiceTo AS NVARCHAR(30)),'')        
  + ',@invoiceFrom = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_invoiceFrom AS NVARCHAR(30)),'')        
        
    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL         
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

 --BEGIN

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)        
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK        
        
        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

 SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName)        
 IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails        
 ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;        
 INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK        
 SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()        
         
 WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3        
 BEGIN         
  BEGIN TRY           
        
   -- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start        
        
   -- Ensure the temporary invoice number always has a valid value.        
       
  Drop table if exists #tmpdistExtraServicecharges      
  SELECT  
  co.ContainerOutPK ,   ess.Charge     
  into #tmpdistExtraServicecharges      
  FROM    tblExtraServices AS ess          
  LEFT OUTER JOIN tblDivisionExtraServices AS dess ON  dess.DivisionExtraServicePK = ess.DivisionExtraServiceFK        
  LEFT OUTER JOIN appChargeSubjects AS chargeSubjects ON  chargeSubjects.ChargeSubjectPK = dess.ChargeSubjectFK        
  LEFT OUTER JOIN tblExtraServiceCodes AS escs ON   escs.ExtraServiceCodePK = dess.ExtraServiceCodeFK        
  inner join tblStockOrders so on so.StockOrderPK = ess.StockOrderFK      
  inner join tblContainerOuts co on so.ContainerOutFK = co.ContainerOutPK      
  inner join tblDistributionOrders do on do.DistributionOrderPK = co.DistributionOrderFK      
  WHERE CONVERT(VARCHAR(50), ess.ExtraServiceDate, 112) > CONVERT(VARCHAR(50), @invoiceFrom, 112)        
   AND CONVERT(VARCHAR(50), ess.ExtraServiceDate, 112) <= CONVERT(VARCHAR(50), @var_invoiceTo, 112)        
   AND ess.DivisionFK = @var_divisionFK         
   AND ess.Charge > 0 AND ess.NumberOf > 0 -- ignore zero's      
    and ContainerOutStatusFK = 5    
      
     
  drop table if exists #tmpAllDistCharges               
  select DistributionOrderPK, containeroutpk, do.orderdate, codc.distributionchargetypefk, distributionchargefk, totalcharge                  
  into #tmpAllDistCharges                  
  from tblContainerOutDistributionCharges codc                  
  inner join tblcontainerouts co on codc.containeroutfk = co.ContainerOutPK                  
  inner join tblDistributionOrders do on do.DistributionOrderPK = co.DistributionOrderFK                  
  -- inner join (select containeroutfk, divisionfk from tblcontaineroutlines)                  
  where codc.InsertedDate >= @invoiceFrom and codc.InsertedDate <= @var_invoiceTo and do.OrderStatusFK in (4,5,6,7) /*Dispatched / Hubbed / Delivered / Returned*/      
      
    drop table if exists #tmpcontainers    
  select distinct containeroutpk into #tmpcontainers from #tmpAllDistCharges    
  union     
  select distinct containeroutpk from #tmpdistExtraServicecharges    
      
  Drop table if exists #tmpdistOrders        
  SELECT distinct 
  co.containeroutpk,
  diso.OrderReference as OnlineOrderNo, 
  diso.DistributionOrderPK as WMSOrderNumber, 
  co.GoodsOrderNumber as GoodsOutNumber, 
  count(cols.stockitemfk) as stockitems,          
   Sum(cols.units) as units,  County.county, 
   dm.DistributionDeliveryMethod,  
   diso.DeliveryReference,
   co.CollectionDate
  into #tmpdistorders        
  from tblContainerOutLines AS cols      
  inner join #tmpcontainers tco on tco.ContainerOutPK = cols.ContainerOutFK    
  inner join tblcontainerouts as co on tco.ContainerOutPK = co.ContainerOutPK --and co.ContainerOutStatusFK = 5 /*Completed*/        
  inner join tblDistributionDeliveryAddresses da on da.DistributionDeliveryAddressPK = co.deliveryaddressfk      
  left join tblCounties county on county.CountyPK = da.CountyFK      
  inner join tbldistributionorders diso on co.DistributionOrderFK = diso.DistributionOrderPK      
  left join tblDistributionDeliveryMethods dm on dm.DistributionDeliveryMethodPK = diso.DeliveryMethodFK      
  where cols.DivisionFK = @var_divisionFK       
  group by co.containeroutpk,  diso.OrderReference ,      
   diso.DistributionOrderPK,  co.GoodsOrderNumber,  County.county,  dm.DistributionDeliveryMethod,  diso.DeliveryReference ,co.CollectionDate     
    
      
   --select * from #tmpcontainers order by ContainerOutPK    
   --select * from #tmpdistorders where containeroutpk = 289848 order by ContainerOutPK     
   --select * from tblContainerOutDistributionCharges where containeroutfk = 289848    
   --select * from #tmpdistExtraServicecharges order by ContainerOutPK    
   -- select * from #tmpdistorders
    select --do.*, 
	do.OnlineOrderNo,do.stockitems , do.units,do.county,do.DistributionDeliveryMethod,DeliveryReference,do.CollectionDate,
	
	case when (ex.charge is not NULL) then coalesce(Sum(codcs.TotalCharge), 0) + ex.Charge else coalesce(Sum(codcs.TotalCharge), 0) end  as TotalBUCharge      
    from #tmpdistorders do      
    left join tblContainerOutDistributionCharges AS codcs on do.containeroutpk = codcs.containeroutfk      
    left join #tmpdistExtraServicecharges ex on do.ContainerOutPK = ex.ContainerOutPK       
   --   where do.containeroutpk = 289848    
    group by --do.containeroutpk,
	onlineorderno, 
	--wmsordernumber, goodsoutnumber, 
	stockitems, units, county, distributiondeliverymethod, deliveryreference, ex.charge  ,do.CollectionDate    
      
       
        
        -- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end        
        
      
        
   BEGIN TRY IF XACT_STATE() = 1 AND @@TRANCOUNT = 1 AND @OpeningTranCount < 1 COMMIT TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH        
        
   BREAK        
  END TRY        
  BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */         
   DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;        
        
   SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE();        
   SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;        
        
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY        
        
   BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;        
               
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;        
        
            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID        
                    
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;        
                    
   IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)        
   BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END        
   ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */           
  END CATCH        
  SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1        
 END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spDistributionPackagingTypeSort]
(
	@distributionPackagingTypeFK int,
	@newOrder int,
	@oldOrder int,
	@isNew bit
)
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT
