		+ '@newOrder = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@newOrder2 AS NVARCHAR(20)),'') + '@oldOrder = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@oldOrder2 AS NVARCHAR(20)),'')
			+ '@isNew = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@isNew2 AS NVARCHAR(20)),'')

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    --BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

		SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END


	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY
			IF XACT_STATE() = 0 AND @@TRANCOUNT < 1 BEGIN TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start

			IF(@isNew2 = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/)
			BEGIN --This is a new Location, update as necessary
				update tblDistributionPackagingTypes WITH (ROWLOCK)
				Set DistributionPackagingOrder = DistributionPackagingOrder + 1
				Where DistributionPackagingTypePK <> @distributionPackagingTypeFK2
				AND DistributionPackagingOrder >= @newOrder2
			END 
			ELSE
			BEGIN
				IF(@newOrder2 < @oldOrder2)
				BEGIN --Move up 
					update tblDistributionPackagingTypes WITH (ROWLOCK)
					Set DistributionPackagingOrder = DistributionPackagingOrder + 1
					Where DistributionPackagingOrder < @oldOrder2
					AND DistributionPackagingOrder >= @newOrder2
					AND DistributionPackagingTypePK <> @distributionPackagingTypeFK2
				END 
				ELSE IF(@newOrder2 > @oldOrder2)
				BEGIN --Move Down
					update tblDistributionPackagingTypes WITH (ROWLOCK)
					Set DistributionPackagingOrder = DistributionPackagingOrder - 1
					Where DistributionPackagingOrder > @oldOrder2
					AND DistributionPackagingOrder <= @newOrder2
					AND DistributionPackagingTypePK <> @distributionPackagingTypeFK2
				END		
			END  

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end

			BEGIN TRY IF XACT_STATE() = 1 AND @@TRANCOUNT = 1 AND @OpeningTranCount < 1 COMMIT TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH
			
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END
GO

   From

   Group By         
    EntirePallet, [row], ColumnNo, baylevel, bayposition, WorksOrderPK, MovementDescription, EachesTypeFK,         
    /*EachesTypeSingular,*/ UnitTypeFK, Abbreviation, /*SourceLocationFK,*/ Units, StockItemCode, Batch, SupplierBatch, Barcode,

   -- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end               
              
   BREAK        
  END TRY        
  BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */        
   DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;        
   SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;        
   SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;        
        
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY         
   BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;        
               
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;        
        
            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID        
                    
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;        
                    
   IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)        
   BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END        
   ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */        
  END CATCH        
  SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1        
 END        
END

	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY
			

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start

			Declare @divisionFK int

			Set @divisionFK = (Select Top 1 DivisionFK from tblContainerOutLines where ContainerOutFK = @containerOutFK2)

			Declare @userFK int

			Set @userFK = (Select Top 1 UserPK 
							from 
								tblUsers AS users 
							left outer join (
												Select count(*) OpenOrders, ResponsibleUserFK 
												from 
													tblStockOrders AS stockOrders
												where 
													StockOrderStatusFK <= 5 /*Still in Progress*/
												Group By 
													ResponsibleUserFK
											) AS orders 
								on orders.ResponsibleUserFK = users.UserPK
							where 
								users.UserTypeFK = 3/*DistributionController*/
							Order By 
								OpenOrders ASC
							)

			Select isnull(@userFK, -1) AS UserPK

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end

			
			
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END

Create PROCEDURE [dbo].[spDivision_GetDivisionByCustomerFKAndDivisionCode]
   -- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here
    @customerFK int,	
	@divisionCode nvarchar(200)
	
AS
BEGIN
    -- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from
    -- interfering with SELECT statements.
    SET NOCOUNT ON
	
     SELECT TOP 1 d.*, s.CustomerFK AS CustomerId  FROM [dbo].[tblDivisions] d
     INNER JOIN [dbo].[tblStockItems] s 
     ON s.DivisionFK=d.DivisionPK
     WHERE d.CustomerFK = @customerFK AND Left(d.DivisionCode,3) = LEFT(@divisionCode, 3)
	 ORDER  BY s.UpdatedDate desc
END
GO

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spDivision_GetDivisionCodeByCustomerFKAndOrderCode]
   -- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here
    @customerFK int,	
	@orderCode nvarchar(200),
	@divisioncode nvarchar(200) output
	
AS
BEGIN
    -- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from
    -- interfering with SELECT statements.
    SET NOCOUNT ON	
	DECLARE @divcode nvarchar(200)
	SET @divcode = ( SELECT TOP 1 d.DivisionCode  FROM [dbo].[tblDivisions] d
     INNER JOIN [dbo].[tblStockItems] s 
     ON s.DivisionFK=d.DivisionPK
     WHERE d.CustomerFK = @customerFK AND d.DivisionCode = LEFT(@orderCode, LEN(@orderCode)-3)
	 ORDER  BY s.UpdatedDate desc
	)
	SELECT  @divcode 
	
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spDivisionBatchGeneration]
(
	@divisionFK int
)
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT
 ,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;
	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	DECLARE @divisionFK2 int

	SET @divisionFK2 = @divisionFK

	SET @ParameterDetails = '@divisionFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@divisionFK2 AS NVARCHAR(20)),'')

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    --BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

		SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END


	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY
			IF XACT_STATE() = 0 AND @@TRANCOUNT < 1 BEGIN TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start

			Declare @batchPrefix nvarchar(50), @nextBatch int, @batchLength int, @generatedBatch nvarchar(200)

			SELECT @batchPrefix = divs.GeneratedBatchPrefix, @nextBatch = cus.NextBatch, @batchLength = divs.GeneratedBatchLength 
			from tblDivisions divs
			inner join tblCustomers cus on
			cus.CustomerPK = divs.CustomerFK
			Where DivisionPK = @divisionFK2

			Update tblCustomers WITH (ROWLOCK) 
			Set NextBatch = (@nextBatch + 1 )
			where CustomerPK = (Select CustomerFK from tblDivisions where DivisionPK = @divisionFK2)

			Set @generatedBatch = @batchPrefix + right('000000000000000000' + cast(@nextBatch as nvarchar(50)), @batchLength)
	
			Select @generatedBatch GeneratedBatch

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end

			BEGIN TRY IF XACT_STATE() = 1 AND @@TRANCOUNT = 1 AND @OpeningTranCount < 1 COMMIT TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH
			
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spDpdPreAdviceDetails]  
(  
 @OrderFK int  
)   
AS  
BEGIN  
 /* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */  
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED  
  
    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT  
 ,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;  
 SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();  
  
 -- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters  
 DECLARE @OrderFK2 int  
 SET @OrderFK2 = @OrderFK;   
  
 SET @ParameterDetails = '@OrderFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@OrderFK2 AS NVARCHAR(20)),'')   
  
    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL   
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)  
  
    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)  
    --BEGIN  
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC   
  
  SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)  
  
        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)  
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK  
  
        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()  
    --END  
  
  
 SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);  
 SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails  
 ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;  
 INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()  
  
 WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3  
 BEGIN   
  BEGIN TRY     
   -- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start  
  
   DROP TABLE IF exists #tmpDpdPreAdviceInfo  
   SELECT DISTINCT do.DistributionOrderPK as RecordID, do.PackageWeight, sum(codc.numberof) as TotalParcels, do.OrderReference,do.DeliveryMethodFK, 
   -- Delivery Address
   dda.Address1 as DContact, dda.TelephoneNumber as DContactTelephone,dda.EmailAddress as DContactEmail, 
   dda.Address1 as DAddressLine1, dda.Address2 as DAddressLine2, dda.Address3 as DAddressLine3, dda.Address4 as DAddressLine4,

  -- Collection Address
   a.DocketFooterPart2Line4 as CContact, a.DocketFooterPart2Line4 as CContactTelephone,a.DocketFooterPart2Line4 as CContactEmail, 
   a.DocketFooterPart2Line4 as CAddressLine1, a.DocketFooterPart2Line4 as CAddressLine2, a.DocketFooterPart2Line4 as CAddressLine3, a.DocketFooterPart2Line4 as CAddressLine4,

  -- Billing Address
   a.DocketHeaderLine1 as BContact, a.DocketHeaderLine2 as BContactTelephone,a.DocketHeaderLine3 as BContactEmail, 
   a.DocketHeaderLine1 as BAddressLine1, a.DocketHeaderLine1 as BAddressLine2, a.DocketHeaderLine1 as BAddressLine3, a.DocketHeaderLine1 as BAddressLine4, 
   a.DocketHeaderLine1 as BPostCode, a.DocketHeaderLine1 as BCountryCode 
   
   INTO #tmpDpdPreAdviceInfo  
   FROM tblDistributionOrders do  
   Left join appSystem a on a.SystemPK=1
   inner join tblcontainerouts co on co.DistributionOrderFK =do.DistributionOrderPK  
   inner join tblDistributionDeliveryAddresses dda on dda.DistributionDeliveryAddressPK = co.DeliveryAddressFK  
   left join tblCounties cnt on cnt.CountyPK = dda.CountyFK  
   left join tblCountries cr on cr.CountryPK = cnt.CountryFK 
   inner join tblDistributionDeliveryMethodPackagingCharges dsc on dsc.customerfk = 609 and dsc.IsArchived = 0 and dsc.DistributionDeliveryMethodFK = do.DeliveryMethodFK  
   inner join tblDistributionPackagingTypes pt on dsc.DistributionPackagingTypeFK = pt.DistributionPackagingTypePK  
   inner join tblContainerOutDistributionCharges codc on co.ContainerOutPK = codc.ContainerOutFK and codc.DistributionChargeTypeFK = 2 /*packaging*/ and  codc.DistributionChargeFK = dsc.DistributionDeliveryMethodPackagingChargePK  
   WHERE do.DistributionOrderPK= @OrderFK2 
   GROUP BY do.DistributionOrderPK, a.DocketFooterPart2Line4, dda.Address1,a.DocketHeaderLine1, a.DocketHeaderLine2,a.DocketHeaderLine3, dda.TelephoneNumber, dda.EmailAddress, dda.Address1, dda.Address2, dda.Address3, dda.Address4,
   dda.Postalcode, cr.CountryCode, do.DeliveryMethodFK, do.PackageWeight,do.OrderReference

   Declare @Quantity int = (SELECT TotalParcels FROM #tmpDpdPreAdviceInfo)  
  
   IF((SELECT Top 1 DeliveryMethodFK FROM #tmpDpdPreAdviceInfo) = 4)
   BEGIN
		SELECT t1.RecordID,  		       
			   t1.PackageWeight, 
			   t1.TotalParcels,
			   t1.DeliveryMethodFK, 
			   t1.OrderReference,
			   t1.DContact,		     
			   t1.DAddressLine1,
			   t1.DAddressLine2,
			   t1.DAddressLine3,	
			   t1.DAddressLine4,
			   t1.DPostCode,			
			   t1.DCountryCode,	
			   t1.DContactTelephone,
			   t1.DContactEmail,
			 
			   case when t1.CContact ='' then 'Store-All' end as CContact,
			   case when t1.CAddressLine1 ='' then 'Store-All Warehousing' end as CAddressLine1,
			   case when t1.CAddressLine2 ='' then 'Industrial Complex Kilcohan'  end as CAddressLine2,
			   case when t1.CAddressLine3 ='' then 'Ballytruckle'  end as CAddressLine3,	
			   case when t1.CAddressLine4 ='' then 'Waterford' end as CAddressLine4,			   			   
			   case when t1.CPostCode ='' then 'X91W0XW' end as CPostCode,			
			   case when t1.CCountryCode = '' then 'IE'end as CCountryCode,	
			   case when t1.CContactTelephone = '' then '(051)831200' end as CContactTelephone,			   
			   case when t1.CContactEmail ='' then 'info@store-all.ie' end as CContactEmail,
			 
			   case when t1.BContact !='' then 'Store-All' end as BContact,
			   case when t1.BAddressLine1 !='' then '2ND Floor'end as BAddressLine1,
			   case when t1.BAddressLine2 !='' then 'Marine Point'  end as BAddressLine2,
			   case when t1.BAddressLine3 !='' then 'Belview Port'  end as BAddressLine3,	
			   case when t1.BAddressLine4 !='' then 'Slieverue,Co. Kilkenny'  end as BAddressLine4,			   			   
			   case when t1.BPostCode !='' then 'X91W0XW' end as BPostCode,			
			   case when t1.BCountryCode != '' then 'IE'  end as BCountryCode,	
			   case when t1.BContactTelephone != '' then '(051)831200'  end as BContactTelephone,			   
			   case when t1.BContactEmail !='' then 'info@store-all.ie'  end as BContactEmail
			   		  
		FROM #tmpDpdPreAdviceInfo t1
	   CROSS JOIN  
	   (  
		SELECT TOP (@Quantity)* FROM  sysobjects
	   ) [BigTable]  
   END 
   ELSE
   BEGIN  
	   SELECT  t1.*  
	   FROM   #tmpDpdPreAdviceInfo t1  
	   CROSS JOIN  
	   (  
		SELECT TOP (@Quantity)  *  FROM  sysobjects  
	   ) [BigTable]  
	END 
  
   -- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end    
     
   BREAK  
  END TRY  
  BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */  
   DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;  
   SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;  
   SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;  
  
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY   
   BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;  
         
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;  
  
            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID  
              
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;  
              
   IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)  
   BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END  
   ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */  
  END CATCH  
  SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1  
 END  
END

		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END

-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spEditGetNewVersionNumber] 
(
	@editTypeFK int,
	@fK int
)
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT
 ,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;
	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	DECLARE @editTypeFK2 int, @fK2 int

	SET @editTypeFK2 = @editTypeFK; SET @fK2 = @fK

	SET @ParameterDetails = '@editTypeFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@editTypeFK2 AS NVARCHAR(20)),'') + '@fK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@fK2 AS NVARCHAR(20)),'')

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    --BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

		SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END


	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY
			

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start

			Declare @version int
			Set @version = -1
    
			Select @version = Max(Version) + 1
			From tblEdits 
			where EditTypeFK = @editTypeFK2 AND FK = @fk2

			Select isnull(@version, 2) Version

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end

			
			
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1

-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spEditStockInChangeContainerOuts] 
(
	@stockInLineFK int = -1,
	@fieldName nvarchar(200),
	@newIntValue int = null,
	@oldIntValue int = null,
	@newDecimalValue decimal(18,3) = null,
	@oldDecimalValue decimal(18,3) = null,
	@newStringValue nvarchar(500) = null,
	@oldStringValue nvarchar(500) = null,
	@newDateValue DateTime = NULL,
	@oldDateValue DateTime = NULL
)
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT
 ,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;
	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	DECLARE @stockInLineFK2 int, @fieldName2 nvarchar(200), @newIntValue2 int, @oldIntValue2 int, @newDecimalValue2 decimal(18,3),
	@oldDecimalValue2 decimal(18,3), @newStringValue2 nvarchar(500), @oldStringValue2 nvarchar(500), @newDateValue2 DateTime, @oldDateValue2 DateTime

	SET @stockInLineFK2 = @stockInLineFK; SET @fieldName2 = @fieldName; SET @newIntValue2 = @newIntValue
	SET @oldIntValue2 = @oldIntValue; SET @newDecimalValue2 = @newDecimalValue; SET @oldDecimalValue2 = @oldDecimalValue; SET @newStringValue2 = @newStringValue
	SET @oldStringValue2 = @oldStringValue; SET @newDateValue2 = @newDateValue; SET @oldDateValue2 = @oldDateValue

	SET @ParameterDetails = '@stockInLineFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@stockInLineFK2 AS NVARCHAR(20)),'')
		+ ',@fieldName = ' + ISNULL(@fieldName2,'') + ',@newIntValue = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@newIntValue2 AS NVARCHAR(20)),'')
			+ ',@oldIntValue = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@oldIntValue2 AS NVARCHAR(20)),'') + ',@newDecimalValue = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@newDecimalValue2 AS NVARCHAR(30)),'')
				+ ',@oldDecimalValue = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@oldDecimalValue2 AS NVARCHAR(30)),'') + ',@newStringValue = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@newStringValue2 AS NVARCHAR(30)),'')
					+ ',@oldStringValue = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@oldStringValue2 AS NVARCHAR(30)),'') + ',@newDateValue = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@newDateValue2 AS NVARCHAR(30)),'')
						+ ',@oldDateValue = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@oldDateValue2 AS NVARCHAR(30)),'')

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    --BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

		SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END


	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY
			IF XACT_STATE() = 0 AND @@TRANCOUNT < 1 BEGIN TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start

			IF(@stockInLineFK2 > 0)
			BEGIN --We are dealing with a StockInLine change
				Declare @divisionFK int
				If(@newIntValue2 > 0) BEGIN
					Select @divisionFK = DivisionFK from tblStockItems where StockItemPK = @newIntValue2
				End Else Begin
					Set @divisionFK = -1
				End

				Declare @containerOutLineFK int, @pallets int, @stockInPallets int
				DECLARE myContainerOutCursor CURSOR FAST_FORWARD FOR
				SELECT colpc.ContainerOutLineFK, cols.Pallets, stockInPallets.StockInPallets FROM tblContainerOutLinePalletContent colpc
				inner join tblContainerOutLines cols on
				cols.ContainerOutLinePK = colpc.ContainerOutLineFK
				inner join (
					Select count(*) StockInPallets, ContainerOutLineFK from tblContainerOutLinePalletContent colpc2
					Where colpc2.PalletFK in (Select PalletFK from tblStockInLinePallets where StockInLineFK = @stockInLineFK2)
					Group By ContainerOutLineFK
				) stockInPallets on
				stockInPallets.ContainerOutLineFK = cols.ContainerOutLinePK
				WHERE PalletFK in (Select PalletFK from tblStockInLinePallets where StockInLineFK = @stockInLineFK2)
				Group By colpc.ContainerOutLineFK, cols.Pallets, stockInPallets.StockInPallets
				OPEN myContainerOutCursor
				FETCH NEXT FROM myContainerOutCursor INTO @containerOutLineFK, @pallets, @stockInPallets

				WHILE (@@FETCH_STATUS = 0)
				BEGIN	
					IF(@pallets < 2) BEGIN --Easy, just change the ContainerInLine
						update tblContainerOutLines WITH (ROWLOCK)
						Set StockItemFK = (Case when @fieldName2 = 'StockItemFK' then @newIntValue2 else StockItemFK end),
						Batch = (Case when @fieldName2 = 'Batch' then @newStringValue2 else Batch end),
						DivisionFK = (case when @divisionFK > 0 then @divisionFK else DivisionFK end)
						Where ContainerOutLinePK = @containerOutLineFK
					END ELSE BEGIN --Check how many pallets are from our stock in, if all then easy change if not, create another line
						IF(@pallets = @stockInPallets) BEGIN --Easy, All of the pallets are from our stock in, just change ContainerOutLine
							update tblContainerOutLines WITH (ROWLOCK)
							Set StockItemFK = (Case when @fieldName2 = 'StockItemFK' then @newIntValue2 else StockItemFK end),
							Batch = (Case when @fieldName2 = 'Batch' then @newStringValue2 else Batch end),
							DivisionFK = (case when @divisionFK > 0 then @divisionFK else DivisionFK end)
							Where ContainerOutLinePK = @containerOutLineFK
						END ELSE BEGIN --Hard, we have a difference of pallets (some from our StockIn, others from elsewhere). Adjust existing ContainerOut and create another for our changed StockItem
							Declare @newContainerOutLineFK int
							Update tblContainerOutLines WITH (ROWLOCK)
							Set Pallets = Pallets - @stockInPallets
							Where ContainerOutLinePK = @containerOutLineFK
							INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblContainerOutLines]
							([ContainerOutFK],[DivisionFK],[StockItemFK],[Batch],[Pallets],[Eaches],[Units],[IsArchived]
							,[InsertedBy],[InsertedDate],[UpdatedBy],[UpdatedDate])
							Select ContainerOutFK,DivisionFK,StockItemFK,Batch,Pallets,Eaches,Units,IsArchived,
							InsertedBy,InsertedDate,UpdatedBy,UpdatedDate From tblContainerOutLines Where ContainerOutLinePK = @containerOutLineFK
					
							--Set @newContainerOutLineFK = @@identity
							Set @newContainerOutLineFK =SCOPE_IDENTITY()

							update tblContainerOutLines WITH (ROWLOCK)
							Set StockItemFK = (Case when @fieldName2 = 'StockItemFK' then @newIntValue2 else StockItemFK end),
							Batch = (Case when @fieldName2 = 'Batch' then @newStringValue2 else Batch end),
							DivisionFK = (case when @divisionFK > 0 then @divisionFK else DivisionFK end),
							Pallets = @stockInPallets
							Where ContainerOutLinePK = @newContainerOutLineFK

							update tblContainerOutLinePalletContent WITH (ROWLOCK)
							Set ContainerOutLineFK = @newContainerOutLineFK
							Where ContainerOutLineFK = @containerOutLineFK
							AND PalletFK in (Select PalletFK from tblStockInLinePallets where StockInLineFK = @stockInLineFK2)
						END
					END
					FETCH NEXT FROM myContainerOutCursor INTO @containerOutLineFK, @pallets, @stockInPallets
				END
				CLOSE myContainerOutCursor
				DEALLOCATE myContainerOutCursor
			END
	
			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end

			BEGIN TRY IF XACT_STATE() = 1 AND @@TRANCOUNT = 1 AND @OpeningTranCount < 1 COMMIT TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH
			
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END
GO

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spEmployeeActivityGetDailySummary] --spGetEmployeeDailyActivitySummary @buildingName='BV1',@workDate='20190923',@employeeType=2
(
--declare
	@buildingName NVARCHAR(500), 
	@workDate DATE,
	@employeeType INT = 2 /* 1 = Supervisors & Stock Controllers, 2 = Team Lead & Operatives, anything else = all employee types */

	--select @buildingName = 'BV1', @workDate = '20190725', @employeeType = 2
)
AS
BEGIN
	DECLARE @varBuildingName NVARCHAR(500) = @buildingName, @varWorkDate DATE = @workDate, @varEmployeeType INT = @EmployeeType

	IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#employeeScannedPalletMovementDetails') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #employeeScannedPalletMovementDetails

	CREATE TABLE #employeeScannedPalletMovementDetails
	(
		JobTitleOrder NVARCHAR(500), 
		EmployeeScannedPalletMovementDetailPK INT, 
		EmployeeName NVARCHAR(500), 
		JobTitle NVARCHAR(500), 
		FirstAndLastTMSTimesForUserAndBuilding NVARCHAR(500), 
		TMSTimesForUserAndBuilding NVARCHAR(500), 
		[Shift] NVARCHAR(500), 
		TimeWorkedMinutes INT, 
		IsArchived BIT, 
		ShiftDurationLessBreaksMinutes INT, 
		StockInMinutes INT, 
		StockOutMinutes INT, 
		MovementMinutes INT, 
		AllScannedMinutes INT, 
		OddTMSClockTimes BIT, 
		OvertimeMinutes INT, 
		IsBankHoliday BIT, 
		OtherActivityMinutes INT, 
		ActiveMinutes INT, 
		InactiveMinutes INT, 
		TotalTimeWorkedMinutes INT, 
		TotalOvertimeMinutes INT, 
		TotalShiftDurationLessBreaksMinutes INT, 
		TotalStockInMinutes INT, 
		TotalStockOutMinutes INT, 
		TotalMovementMinutes INT, 
		TotalAllScannedMinutes INT, 
		TotalOtherActivityMinutes INT, 
		TotalActiveMinutes INT, 
		TotalInactiveMinutes INT, 
		TimeWorkedMinutesCalculated BIT, 
		ShiftBreakTimesInMinutes INT, 
		AbsenceCodes NVARCHAR(500), 
		UserFK INT, 
		IssueDescription NVARCHAR(500), 
		AllTMSTimesInSameBuilding NVARCHAR(500), 
		AllTMSTimesWithBuildingsForUser NVARCHAR(500), 
		NoOfTMSTimesForUserAndBuilding INT, 
		ClockCardTimesRawData NVARCHAR(500), 
		IsMissingClockTimes BIT,

		StockInUnloadedDurationInMinutes INT,
		StockInMovementDurationInMinutes INT,
		StockInPutAwayDurationInMinutes INT,

		StockOutPickedDurationInMinutes INT,
		StockOutMovementDurationInMinutes INT,
		StockOutLoadedDurationInMinutes INT,

		StockInUnloadedNoOfPalletMovements INT,
		StockInMovementNoOfPalletMovements INT,
		StockInPutAwayNoOfPalletMovements INT,
		StockInNoOfPalletMovements INT,
			
		StockOutPickedNoOfPalletMovements INT,
		StockOutMovementNoOfPalletMovements INT,
		StockOutLoadedNoOfPalletMovements INT,
		StockOutNoOfPalletMovements INT,

		MovementNoOfPalletMovements INT
	)

	INSERT INTO #employeeScannedPalletMovementDetails
	--EXEC dbo.spGetEmployeeScannedPalletMovementDetailsForDateAndBuilding @varWorkDate, @varBuildingName
	EXEC dbo.spEmployeeActivityGetScannedPalletMovementDetailsForDateAndBuilding @varWorkDate, @varBuildingName

	/*Duration*/
	SELECT 
		CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT EmployeeName) AS NVARCHAR(50)) AS People,  
		CAST(dbo.fnGetHoursAndMinutesTimeFormatForMinutes(SUM(TimeWorkedMinutes)) AS NVARCHAR(50)) AS [Worked], 
		CAST(dbo.fnGetHoursAndMinutesTimeFormatForMinutes(SUM(OvertimeMinutes)) AS NVARCHAR(50)) AS [Overtime],
		CAST(dbo.fnGetHoursAndMinutesTimeFormatForMinutes(SUM(ShiftDurationLessBreaksMinutes)) AS NVARCHAR(50)) AS [Shift], 

		'Duration:' AS Activity,

		dbo.fnGetHoursAndMinutesTimeFormatForMinutes(SUM(StockInUnloadedDurationInMinutes)) AS [SI Unloaded],
		dbo.fnGetHoursAndMinutesTimeFormatForMinutes(SUM(StockInMovementDurationInMinutes)) AS [SI Movement],
		dbo.fnGetHoursAndMinutesTimeFormatForMinutes(SUM(StockInPutAwayDurationInMinutes)) AS [SI PutAway],
		dbo.fnGetHoursAndMinutesTimeFormatForMinutes(SUM(StockInMinutes)) AS [StockIn (SI)],

		dbo.fnGetHoursAndMinutesTimeFormatForMinutes(SUM(StockOutPickedDurationInMinutes)) AS [SO Picked],
		dbo.fnGetHoursAndMinutesTimeFormatForMinutes(SUM(StockOutMovementDurationInMinutes)) AS [SO Movement],
		dbo.fnGetHoursAndMinutesTimeFormatForMinutes(SUM(StockOutLoadedDurationInMinutes)) AS [SO Loaded],
		dbo.fnGetHoursAndMinutesTimeFormatForMinutes(SUM(StockOutMinutes)) AS [StockOut (SO)],

		dbo.fnGetHoursAndMinutesTimeFormatForMinutes(SUM(MovementMinutes)) AS [Movement],

		dbo.fnGetHoursAndMinutesTimeFormatForMinutes(SUM(AllScannedMinutes)) AS [Scanned], 
		dbo.fnGetHoursAndMinutesTimeFormatForMinutes(SUM(OtherActivityMinutes)) AS [OtherActivity], 
		dbo.fnGetHoursAndMinutesTimeFormatForMinutes(SUM(ActiveMinutes)) AS [Active],
		dbo.fnGetHoursAndMinutesTimeFormatForMinutes(SUM(InactiveMinutes)) AS [Inactive]

		--CAST(
		--	CAST(ROUND(CAST(SUM(CAST(ActiveMinutes AS DECIMAL(18,2))) / SUM(CAST(ShiftDurationLessBreaksMinutes AS DECIMAL(18,2))) AS DECIMAL(18,2)) * 100, 0) AS INT) 
		--		AS NVARCHAR(50)) + '%' AS Efficiency			
	FROM 
		#employeeScannedPalletMovementDetails t1	
	WHERE 
		IsArchived = 1
		AND
		(
			(@varEmployeeType = 1 AND t1.JobTitle IN ('Sup', 'SC'))
			OR (@varEmployeeType = 2 AND t1.JobTitle IN ('TL', 'Op'))
			OR (@varEmployeeType NOT IN (1, 2) AND t1.JobTitle IN ('Sup', 'SC', 'TL', 'Op'))
		)

	UNION

	/*Number of pallet movements*/

	SELECT 
		'' AS People,  
		'' AS Worked, 
		'' AS Overtime,
		'' AS [Shift], 

		'Pallets:' AS Activity,

		CAST(SUM(StockInUnloadedNoOfPalletMovements) AS NVARCHAR(50)) AS [SI Unloaded],
		CAST(SUM(StockInMovementNoOfPalletMovements) AS NVARCHAR(50)) AS [SI Movement],
		CAST(SUM(StockInPutAwayNoOfPalletMovements) AS NVARCHAR(50)) AS [SI PutAway],
		CAST(SUM(StockInNoOfPalletMovements) AS NVARCHAR(50)) AS [StockIn (SI)],

		CAST(SUM(StockOutPickedNoOfPalletMovements) AS NVARCHAR(50)) AS [SO Picked],
		CAST(SUM(StockOutMovementNoOfPalletMovements) AS NVARCHAR(50)) AS [SO Movement],
		CAST(SUM(StockOutLoadedNoOfPalletMovements) AS NVARCHAR(50)) AS [SO Loaded],
		CAST(SUM(StockOutNoOfPalletMovements) AS NVARCHAR(50)) AS [StockOut (SO)],

		CAST(SUM(MovementNoOfPalletMovements) AS NVARCHAR(50)) AS [Movement],

		'' AS Scanned,
		'' AS OtherActivity,
		'' AS Active,
		'' AS Inactive
	FROM 
		#employeeScannedPalletMovementDetails t1	
	WHERE 
		IsArchived = 1
		AND
		(
			(@varEmployeeType = 1 AND t1.JobTitle IN ('Sup', 'SC'))
			OR (@varEmployeeType = 2 AND t1.JobTitle IN ('TL', 'Op'))
			OR (@varEmployeeType NOT IN (1, 2) AND t1.JobTitle IN ('Sup', 'SC', 'TL', 'Op'))
		)
	ORDER BY People DESC
END
--ec:

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spEmployeeActivityGetScannedPalletMovementDetailsForDateAndBuilding] --spGetEmployeeScannedPalletMovementDetailsForDateAndBuilding '2019-07-09', 'Kilcohan'
(
--declare
	@clockCardDate DATE,-- = '2019-08-13', 
	@buildingName NVARCHAR(200)-- = 'BV4'

	--select @clockCardDate = '2019-07-25', @buildingName = 'BV1'
)
AS
BEGIN
	-- SET NOCOUNT ON = Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements.
	-- SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ UNCOMMITTED = In this procedure always reads past   
	-- (at least 2 days previous) records and/or records which will not be updated so can read 
	-- uncommitted which is faster.
	-- SET DEADLOCK_PRIORITY LOW = Ensure this proc has a low impact when executed.
	SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ UNCOMMITTED; SET DEADLOCK_PRIORITY LOW;

	-- Variables

	DECLARE 
		@varClockCardDate DATETIME = CAST(@clockCardDate AS DATETIME)

	DECLARE
		@varEndDate DATETIME = DATEADD(DAY, 1, @varClockCardDate),
		@varBuildingName NVARCHAR(200) = ISNULL(@buildingName,'None'),
		@varMovementStartDateTime DATETIME,
		@varProcedureName NVARCHAR(200) = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID)

	SET @varProcedureName = CASE WHEN ISNULL(@varProcedureName,'') = '' THEN 'spGetEmployeeScannedPalletMovementDetailsForDateAndBuilding' END 

	IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#otherActivityDetails') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #otherActivityDetails

	-- Get employee other activity details

	SELECT DISTINCT 
	tta.TMSEmployeeActivityPK AS TMSEmployeeActivityFK, 
	tta.EmployeeScannedPalletMovementDetailFK,
	tta.ActivityTime,
	LEFT(tta.ActivityTime,2) AS Hrs, right(left(tta.ActivityTime, 5),2) AS Mins, 
	LEFT(tta.ActivityTime,2)*60 AS HrsToMins,
	LEFT(tta.ActivityTime,2)*60 + right(left(tta.ActivityTime, 5),2) AS TotalMins,	
	tta.EmployeeActivityTypeFK,
	aeat.EmployeeActivityType,
	tesa.JobTitle
	INTO #otherActivityDetails
	FROM dbo.tblEmployeeScannedPalletMovementDetails tesa
	INNER JOIN dbo.tblTMSEmployeeActivites tta
	ON tesa.EmployeeScannedPalletMovementDetailPK = tta.EmployeeScannedPalletMovementDetailFK
	INNER JOIN dbo.appEmployeeActivityTypes aeat
	ON tta.EmployeeActivityTypeFK = aeat.EmployeeActivityTypePK
	WHERE tesa.DataForBuilding = @varBuildingName
	AND tesa.ClockCardDate = @varClockCardDate

	IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#otherActivityTotals') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #otherActivityTotals

	SELECT EmployeeScannedPalletMovementDetailFK, SUM(TotalMins) AS OtherActivityMinutes
	INTO #otherActivityTotals
	FROM #otherActivityDetails
	GROUP BY EmployeeScannedPalletMovementDetailFK

	IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#resultsWithOtherActivities') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #resultsWithOtherActivities

	SELECT DISTINCT
	tesa.*,
	ISNULL(oat.OtherActivityMinutes, 0) AS OtherActivityMinutes,
	(tesa.AllScannedMinutes + ISNULL(oat.OtherActivityMinutes, 0)) AS ActiveMinutes,
	(tesa.TimeWorkedMinutes - (tesa.AllScannedMinutes + ISNULL(oat.OtherActivityMinutes, 0))) AS InactiveMinutes
	INTO #resultsWithOtherActivities
	FROM dbo.tblEmployeeScannedPalletMovementDetails tesa
	LEFT OUTER JOIN #otherActivityTotals oat
	ON tesa.EmployeeScannedPalletMovementDetailPK = oat.EmployeeScannedPalletMovementDetailFK
	WHERE tesa.DataForBuilding = @varBuildingName
	AND tesa.ClockCardDate = @varClockCardDate

	-- ------------------------------------
	-- Get the final stock in & out totals
	-- -------------------------------------

	IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#resultsTotals') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #resultsTotals

	SELECT
		SUM(CASE WHEN FirstAndLastTMSTimesForUserAndBuilding = 'Hover mouse for information' THEN 0 ELSE TimeWorkedMinutes END) AS TimeWorkedMinutes,
		SUM(StockInMinutes) AS StockInMinutes,
		SUM(StockOutMinutes) AS StockOutMinutes,
		SUM(MovementMinutes) AS MovementMinutes,
		SUM(AllScannedMinutes) AS AllScannedMinutes,
		SUM(CASE WHEN ShiftDurationLessBreaksMinutes < 0 THEN 0 ELSE ShiftDurationLessBreaksMinutes END) AS ShiftDurationLessBreaksMinutes,
		SUM(OtherActivityMinutes) AS OtherActivityMinutes,
		SUM(ActiveMinutes) AS ActiveMinutes,
		SUM(CASE WHEN FirstAndLastTMSTimesForUserAndBuilding = 'Hover mouse for information' THEN 0 ELSE InactiveMinutes END) AS InactiveMinutes,
		SUM(OvertimeMinutes) AS OvertimeMinutes
	INTO
		#resultsTotals
	FROM
		#resultsWithOtherActivities

	DECLARE @MissingClockTimes BIT = (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM #resultsWithOtherActivities WHERE IssueDescription = 'Clock in/out time(s) missing for building(s).')

	SET @MissingClockTimes = ISNULL(@MissingClockTimes, 0)

	SELECT DISTINCT
		rwoa.JobTitleOrder,	
		rwoa.EmployeeScannedPalletMovementDetailPK,	
		rwoa.EmployeeName,	
		rwoa.JobTitle,	
		rwoa.FirstAndLastTMSTimesForUserAndBuilding,	
		rwoa.TMSTimesForUserAndBuilding,	
		rwoa.[Shift],	
		rwoa.TimeWorkedMinutes,	
		rwoa.IsArchived,	

		CASE WHEN rwoa.ShiftDurationLessBreaksMinutes < 0 THEN 0 ELSE rwoa.ShiftDurationLessBreaksMinutes END AS ShiftDurationLessBreaksMinutes,

		rwoa.StockInMinutes,	
		rwoa.StockOutMinutes,	
		rwoa.MovementMinutes,	
		rwoa.AllScannedMinutes,	
		rwoa.OddTMSClockTimes,	
		rwoa.OvertimeMinutes,	
		rwoa.IsBankHoliday,	
		rwoa.OtherActivityMinutes,	
		rwoa.ActiveMinutes,
		
		CASE WHEN rwoa.FirstAndLastTMSTimesForUserAndBuilding = 'Hover mouse for information' THEN 0 ELSE rwoa.InactiveMinutes END AS InactiveMinutes,

		-- GridView footer row column values - start.

		rt.TimeWorkedMinutes AS TotalTimeWorkedMinutes, -- TMS Times column.
		rt.OvertimeMinutes AS TotalOvertimeMinutes, -- Overtime column.
		rt.ShiftDurationLessBreaksMinutes AS TotalShiftDurationLessBreaksMinutes, -- Scheduled column.
		rt.StockInMinutes AS TotalStockInMinutes, -- StockIn column.
		rt.StockOutMinutes AS TotalStockOutMinutes, -- StockOut column.
		rt.MovementMinutes AS TotalMovementMinutes, -- Movement column.
		(rt.StockInMinutes + rt.StockOutMinutes + rt.MovementMinutes) AS TotalAllScannedMinutes, -- AllScanned column.		
		rt.OtherActivityMinutes AS TotalOtherActivityMinutes, -- OtherActivity column
		rt.ActiveMinutes AS TotalActiveMinutes, -- Active column
		rt.InactiveMinutes AS TotalInactiveMinutes, -- Inactive column
		-- GridView footer row column values - end.

		-- Other columns

		rwoa.TimeWorkedMinutesCalculated,
		rwoa.ShiftBreakTimesInMinutes,
		rwoa.AbsenceCodes,
		rwoa.UserFK,
		rwoa.IssueDescription,
		rwoa.AllTMSTimesInSameBuilding,
		REPLACE(rwoa.AllTMSTimesWithBuildingsForUser, '  ', ' ') AS AllTMSTimesWithBuildingsForUser,
		rwoa.NoOfTMSTimesForUserAndBuilding,
		rwoa.ClockCardTimes AS ClockCardTimesRawData,
		@MissingClockTimes AS IsMissingClockTimes,

		rwoa.StockInUnloadedDurationInMinutes,
		rwoa.StockInMovementDurationInMinutes,
		rwoa.StockInPutAwayDurationInMinutes,

		rwoa.StockOutPickedDurationInMinutes,
		rwoa.StockOutMovementDurationInMinutes,
		rwoa.StockOutLoadedDurationInMinutes,

		rwoa.StockInUnloadedNoOfPalletMovements,
		rwoa.StockInMovementNoOfPalletMovements,
		rwoa.StockInPutAwayNoOfPalletMovements,
		rwoa.StockInNoOfPalletMovements,
			
		rwoa.StockOutPickedNoOfPalletMovements,
		rwoa.StockOutMovementNoOfPalletMovements,
		rwoa.StockOutLoadedNoOfPalletMovements,
		rwoa.StockOutNoOfPalletMovements,

		rwoa.MovementNoOfPalletMovements

		--rwoa.TotalStockInUnloadedDurationInMinutes,
		--rwoa.TotalStockInMovementDurationInMinutes,
		--rwoa.TotalStockInPutAwayDurationInMinutes,

		--rwoa.TotalStockOutPickedDurationInMinutes,
		--rwoa.TotalStockOutMovementDurationInMinutes,
		--rwoa.TotalStockOutLoadedDurationInMinutes,

		--rwoa.TotalStockInUnloadedNoOfPalletMovements,
		--rwoa.TotalStockInMovementNoOfPalletMovements,
		--rwoa.TotalStockInPutAwayNoOfPalletMovements,
		--rwoa.TotalStockInNoOfPalletMovements,
			
		--rwoa.TotalStockOutPickedNoOfPalletMovements,
		--rwoa.TotalStockOutMovementNoOfPalletMovements,
		--rwoa.TotalStockOutLoadedNoOfPalletMovements,
		--rwoa.TotalStockOutNoOfPalletMovements
	FROM 
		#resultsWithOtherActivities AS rwoa
	LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.tblTMSEmployeeClockCardDetails ttccd
		ON rwoa.TMSEmployeeClockCardDetailPK = ttccd.TMSEmployeeClockCardDetailPK
	CROSS JOIN 
		#resultsTotals AS rt
	ORDER BY
		rwoa.JobTitleOrder ASC,
		rwoa.[Shift] ASC, 
		rwoa.EmployeeName ASC
END
--ec:
GO

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spEmployeeActivityGetTMSDetails] -- [dbo].[spGetEmployeeTMSDetails] @employeeScannedPalletMovementDetailPK = 2936, @initalSessionRun = 0
(
	@employeeScannedPalletMovementDetailPK INT,
	@initalSessionRun BIT = 0
)
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ UNCOMMITTED; SET DEADLOCK_PRIORITY LOW
	BEGIN TRY
		IF ISNULL(@employeeScannedPalletMovementDetailPK, -1) < 1 
			RAISERROR ('Employee record not found (spGetEmployeeTMSDetails).', 16, /*Severity*/ 1 /*State*/)	-- RAISERROR with severity 11-19 will cause execution to jump to the CATCH block.

		DECLARE @varEmployeeScannedPalletMovementDetailPK INT = @employeeScannedPalletMovementDetailPK, @varInitalSessionRun BIT = ISNULL(@initalSessionRun, 0)	

		IF @varInitalSessionRun = 1
		BEGIN
			-- Remove temporary (not saved) TMS records created by a WMS user on the Employee Activity screen.

			DELETE ttct 
			FROM dbo.tblTMSEmployeeClockedTimes ttct
			INNER JOIN dbo.tblEmployeeScannedPalletMovementDetails tespmd
			ON ttct.TMSEmployeeClockCardDetailFK = tespmd.TMSEmployeeClockCardDetailPK
			WHERE tespmd.EmployeeScannedPalletMovementDetailPK = @varEmployeeScannedPalletMovementDetailPK
			AND ttct.CreatedByFile = 0
			AND ttct.SavedByWMSUser = 0

			UPDATE ttct
			SET DeletedByWMSUser = 0
			FROM dbo.tblTMSEmployeeClockedTimes ttct
			INNER JOIN dbo.tblEmployeeScannedPalletMovementDetails tespmd
			ON ttct.TMSEmployeeClockCardDetailFK = tespmd.TMSEmployeeClockCardDetailPK
			WHERE tespmd.EmployeeScannedPalletMovementDetailPK = @varEmployeeScannedPalletMovementDetailPK
			AND ttct.CreatedByFile = 0
			AND ttct.DeletedByWMSUser = 1
		END

		DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #results

		SELECT DISTINCT
		tespmd.EmployeeScannedPalletMovementDetailPK,
		ttct.TMSEmployeeClockedTimePK,
		ttct.TMSEmployeeClockCardDetailFK, 
		ttct.Department,
		ttct.ClockedTime,
		LEFT(ttct.ClockedTime, 2) AS TMSHours,
		RIGHT(LEFT(ttct.ClockedTime, 5), 2) AS TMSMinutes,
		LEFT(ttct.ClockedTime, 2) + ':' + RIGHT(LEFT(ttct.ClockedTime, 5), 2) AS TMSTime,
		CASE WHEN ttct.CreatedByFile = 1 THEN 'No' ELSE 'Yes' END AS CreatedOnWMS,
		CASE WHEN ttct.DeletedByWMSUser = 1 THEN 'No' ELSE 'Yes' END AS DeletedByWMSUser,
		CASE WHEN ttct.SavedByWMSUser = 1 THEN 'No' ELSE 'Yes' END AS SavedByWMSUser
		INTO #results
		FROM dbo.tblTMSEmployeeClockedTimes ttct
		INNER JOIN dbo.tblEmployeeScannedPalletMovementDetails tespmd
		ON ttct.TMSEmployeeClockCardDetailFK = tespmd.TMSEmployeeClockCardDetailPK
		WHERE tespmd.EmployeeScannedPalletMovementDetailPK = @varEmployeeScannedPalletMovementDetailPK
		AND ttct.DeletedByWMSUser = 0

		DECLARE @varCreatedByWMSExists BIT = 0

		IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #results WHERE CreatedOnWMS = 'Yes') SET @varCreatedByWMSExists = 1

		SELECT t1.*, CASE WHEN t2.DisplayDeleteColumn = 1 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS DisplayDeleteColumn
		FROM #results t1
		CROSS JOIN (SELECT @varCreatedByWMSExists AS DisplayDeleteColumn) AS t2
		ORDER BY ClockedTime ASC 
	END TRY
	BEGIN CATCH
		DECLARE @ErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX) = ERROR_MESSAGE(), @ErrorSeverity INT = ERROR_SEVERITY(), @ErrorState INT = ERROR_STATE()
		RAISERROR (@ErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState)
	END CATCH
END
GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[spEmployeeActivityGetWeeklySummary]    Script Date: 02/11/2026 17:47:26 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spEmployeeActivityGetWeeklySummary] --spGetEmployeeWeeklyActivitySummary @BuildingName = 'BV1', @WeekStartingDate = '20190715'
(
--declare
	@buildingName NVARCHAR(500),
	@weekStartingDate DATE,
	@employeeType INT = 2 /* 1 = Supervisors & Stock Controllers, 2 = Team Lead & Operatives, anything else = all employee types */

	--select @BuildingName = 'BV1', @WeekStartingDate = '20190715'
)
AS
BEGIN
	DECLARE @varBuildingName NVARCHAR(500) = @buildingName, @varWeekStartingDate DATE = @weekStartingDate, @varEmployeeType INT = @EmployeeType

	SELECT @varWeekStartingDate = CASE 
							WHEN LEFT(DATENAME(dw, @varWeekStartingDate), 3) = 'Sun' THEN DATEADD(DAY, -6, @varWeekStartingDate)
							WHEN LEFT(DATENAME(dw, @varWeekStartingDate), 3) = 'Mon' THEN DATEADD(DAY, -7, @varWeekStartingDate)
							WHEN LEFT(DATENAME(dw, @varWeekStartingDate), 3) = 'Tue' THEN DATEADD(DAY, -8, @varWeekStartingDate)
							WHEN LEFT(DATENAME(dw, @varWeekStartingDate), 3) = 'Wed' THEN DATEADD(DAY, -9, @varWeekStartingDate)
							WHEN LEFT(DATENAME(dw, @varWeekStartingDate), 3) = 'Thu' THEN DATEADD(DAY, -10, @varWeekStartingDate)
							WHEN LEFT(DATENAME(dw, @varWeekStartingDate), 3) = 'Fri' THEN DATEADD(DAY, -11, @varWeekStartingDate)
							WHEN LEFT(DATENAME(dw, @varWeekStartingDate), 3) = 'Sat' THEN DATEADD(DAY, -12, @varWeekStartingDate)
							ELSE @varWeekStartingDate							
						END

	DECLARE @varCounter INT = 1

	IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#employeeScannedPalletMovementDetailsWithWeekStartingDate') IS NOT NULL 
		DROP TABLE #employeeScannedPalletMovementDetailsWithWeekStartingDate

INSERT_DATA:

	IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#employeeScannedPalletMovementDetails') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #employeeScannedPalletMovementDetails

	CREATE TABLE #employeeScannedPalletMovementDetails
	(
		JobTitleOrder NVARCHAR(500), 
		EmployeeScannedPalletMovementDetailPK INT, 
		EmployeeName NVARCHAR(500), 
		JobTitle NVARCHAR(500), 
		FirstAndLastTMSTimesForUserAndBuilding NVARCHAR(500), 
		TMSTimesForUserAndBuilding NVARCHAR(500), 
		[Shift] NVARCHAR(500), 
		TimeWorkedMinutes INT, 
		IsArchived BIT, 
		ShiftDurationLessBreaksMinutes INT, 
		StockInMinutes INT, 
		StockOutMinutes INT, 
		MovementMinutes INT, 
		AllScannedMinutes INT, 
		OddTMSClockTimes BIT, 
		OvertimeMinutes INT, 
		IsBankHoliday BIT, 
		OtherActivityMinutes INT, 
		ActiveMinutes INT, 
		InactiveMinutes INT, 
		TotalTimeWorkedMinutes INT, 
		TotalOvertimeMinutes INT, 
		TotalShiftDurationLessBreaksMinutes INT, 
		TotalStockInMinutes INT, 
		TotalStockOutMinutes INT, 
		TotalMovementMinutes INT, 
		TotalAllScannedMinutes INT, 
		TotalOtherActivityMinutes INT, 
		TotalActiveMinutes INT, 
		TotalInactiveMinutes INT, 
		TimeWorkedMinutesCalculated BIT, 
		ShiftBreakTimesInMinutes INT, 
		AbsenceCodes NVARCHAR(500), 
		UserFK INT, 
		IssueDescription NVARCHAR(500), 
		AllTMSTimesInSameBuilding NVARCHAR(500), 
		AllTMSTimesWithBuildingsForUser NVARCHAR(500), 
		NoOfTMSTimesForUserAndBuilding INT, 
		ClockCardTimesRawData NVARCHAR(500), 
		IsMissingClockTimes BIT,

		StockInUnloadedDurationInMinutes INT,
		StockInMovementDurationInMinutes INT,
		StockInPutAwayDurationInMinutes INT,

		StockOutPickedDurationInMinutes INT,
		StockOutMovementDurationInMinutes INT,
		StockOutLoadedDurationInMinutes INT,

		StockInUnloadedNoOfPalletMovements INT,
		StockInMovementNoOfPalletMovements INT,
		StockInPutAwayNoOfPalletMovements INT,
		StockInNoOfPalletMovements INT,
			
		StockOutPickedNoOfPalletMovements INT,
		StockOutMovementNoOfPalletMovements INT,
		StockOutLoadedNoOfPalletMovements INT,
		StockOutNoOfPalletMovements INT,

		MovementNoOfPalletMovements INT
	)

	INSERT INTO #employeeScannedPalletMovementDetails
	--EXEC dbo.spGetEmployeeScannedPalletMovementDetailsForDateAndBuilding @varWeekStartingDate, @varBuildingName
	EXEC dbo.spEmployeeActivityGetScannedPalletMovementDetailsForDateAndBuilding @varWeekStartingDate, @varBuildingName

	IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#employeeScannedPalletMovementDetailsWithWeekStartingDate') IS NULL 
		SELECT *, @varWeekStartingDate AS WeekStartingDate INTO #employeeScannedPalletMovementDetailsWithWeekStartingDate FROM #employeeScannedPalletMovementDetails
	ELSE
		INSERT INTO #employeeScannedPalletMovementDetailsWithWeekStartingDate
		SELECT *, @varWeekStartingDate AS WeekStartingDate FROM #employeeScannedPalletMovementDetails

	SET @varCounter = @varCounter + 1

	SET @varWeekStartingDate = DATEADD(DAY, 1, @varWeekStartingDate)

	IF @varCounter < 8 GOTO INSERT_DATA /*Mon to Sun*/

	SET @varWeekStartingDate = DATEADD(DAY, -7, @varWeekStartingDate) /*Mon to Sun*/

	/*Duration*/
	SELECT 
		CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT EmployeeName) AS NVARCHAR(50)) AS People,  
		CAST(dbo.fnGetHoursAndMinutesTimeFormatForMinutes(SUM(TimeWorkedMinutes)) AS NVARCHAR(50)) AS [Worked], 
		CAST(dbo.fnGetHoursAndMinutesTimeFormatForMinutes(SUM(OvertimeMinutes)) AS NVARCHAR(50)) AS [Overtime],
		CAST(dbo.fnGetHoursAndMinutesTimeFormatForMinutes(SUM(ShiftDurationLessBreaksMinutes)) AS NVARCHAR(50)) AS [Shift], 

		'Duration:' AS Activity,

		dbo.fnGetHoursAndMinutesTimeFormatForMinutes(SUM(StockInUnloadedDurationInMinutes)) AS [SI Unloaded],
		dbo.fnGetHoursAndMinutesTimeFormatForMinutes(SUM(StockInMovementDurationInMinutes)) AS [SI Movement],
		dbo.fnGetHoursAndMinutesTimeFormatForMinutes(SUM(StockInPutAwayDurationInMinutes)) AS [SI PutAway],
		dbo.fnGetHoursAndMinutesTimeFormatForMinutes(SUM(StockInMinutes)) AS [StockIn (SI)],

		dbo.fnGetHoursAndMinutesTimeFormatForMinutes(SUM(StockOutPickedDurationInMinutes)) AS [SO Picked],
		dbo.fnGetHoursAndMinutesTimeFormatForMinutes(SUM(StockOutMovementDurationInMinutes)) AS [SO Movement],
		dbo.fnGetHoursAndMinutesTimeFormatForMinutes(SUM(StockOutLoadedDurationInMinutes)) AS [SO Loaded],
		dbo.fnGetHoursAndMinutesTimeFormatForMinutes(SUM(StockOutMinutes)) AS [StockOut (SO)],

		dbo.fnGetHoursAndMinutesTimeFormatForMinutes(SUM(MovementMinutes)) AS [Movement],

		dbo.fnGetHoursAndMinutesTimeFormatForMinutes(SUM(AllScannedMinutes)) AS [Scanned], 
		dbo.fnGetHoursAndMinutesTimeFormatForMinutes(SUM(OtherActivityMinutes)) AS [OtherActivity], 
		dbo.fnGetHoursAndMinutesTimeFormatForMinutes(SUM(ActiveMinutes)) AS [Active],
		dbo.fnGetHoursAndMinutesTimeFormatForMinutes(SUM(InactiveMinutes)) AS [Inactive]

		--CAST(
		--	CAST(ROUND(CAST(SUM(CAST(ActiveMinutes AS DECIMAL(18,2))) / SUM(CAST(ShiftDurationLessBreaksMinutes AS DECIMAL(18,2))) AS DECIMAL(18,2)) * 100, 0) AS INT) 
		--		AS NVARCHAR(50)) + '%' AS Efficiency				
	FROM 
		#employeeScannedPalletMovementDetailsWithWeekStartingDate t1	
	WHERE 
		IsArchived = 1
		AND
		(
			(@varEmployeeType = 1 AND t1.JobTitle IN ('Sup', 'SC'))
			OR (@varEmployeeType = 2 AND t1.JobTitle IN ('TL', 'Op'))
			OR (@varEmployeeType NOT IN (1, 2) AND t1.JobTitle IN ('Sup', 'SC', 'TL', 'Op'))
		)

	UNION

	/*Number of pallet movements*/

	SELECT 
		'' AS People,  
		'' AS Worked, 
		'' AS Overtime,
		'' AS [Shift], 

		'Pallets:' AS Activity,

		CAST(SUM(StockInUnloadedNoOfPalletMovements) AS NVARCHAR(50)) AS [SI Unloaded],
		CAST(SUM(StockInMovementNoOfPalletMovements) AS NVARCHAR(50)) AS [SI Movement],
		CAST(SUM(StockInPutAwayNoOfPalletMovements) AS NVARCHAR(50)) AS [SI PutAway],
		CAST(SUM(StockInNoOfPalletMovements) AS NVARCHAR(50)) AS [StockIn (SI)],

		CAST(SUM(StockOutPickedNoOfPalletMovements) AS NVARCHAR(50)) AS [SO Picked],
		CAST(SUM(StockOutMovementNoOfPalletMovements) AS NVARCHAR(50)) AS [SO Movement],
		CAST(SUM(StockOutLoadedNoOfPalletMovements) AS NVARCHAR(50)) AS [SO Loaded],
		CAST(SUM(StockOutNoOfPalletMovements) AS NVARCHAR(50)) AS [StockOut (SO)],

		CAST(SUM(MovementNoOfPalletMovements) AS NVARCHAR(50)) AS [Movement],

		'' AS Scanned,
		'' AS OtherActivity,
		'' AS Active,
		'' AS Inactive
	FROM 
		#employeeScannedPalletMovementDetailsWithWeekStartingDate t1	
	WHERE 
		IsArchived = 1
		AND
		(
			(@varEmployeeType = 1 AND t1.JobTitle IN ('Sup', 'SC'))
			OR (@varEmployeeType = 2 AND t1.JobTitle IN ('TL', 'Op'))
			OR (@varEmployeeType NOT IN (1, 2) AND t1.JobTitle IN ('Sup', 'SC', 'TL', 'Op'))
		)
	ORDER BY
		People DESC
END
--ec:

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spErrorHandler]
(
	@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(1000),@ErrorDateTime DATETIME,@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ErrorMessageOut NVARCHAR(MAX) OUTPUT
)
AS
BEGIN
	BEGIN TRY
		IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL RETURN

		DECLARE @ErrorNumber INT,@ErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX),@XactState INT,@ErrorSeverity INT,@ErrorState INT,@ErrorLine INT,@ErrorLogPK INT,@TransactionCount INT,
		@ErrorProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400), @EventLogFK INT, @UserFK INT;
		
		SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @TransactionCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @EventLogFK = -1; SET @UserFK = 0;

		SELECT @ErrorNumber = ERROR_NUMBER(),@ErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE(),@XactState = XACT_STATE(),@ErrorSeverity = ERROR_SEVERITY(),@ErrorState = ERROR_STATE(),
					@ErrorLine = ERROR_LINE(), @ErrorProcedureName = ERROR_PROCEDURE()	

		IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
			 CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,UserFK INT,HasException BIT)

		IF ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,'') = '' BEGIN SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
		SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
		ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails; END

		IF LEFT(@ErrorMessage,15) <> 'Error Log Id = ' /* Only add non code raised errors */ 
		BEGIN
			--IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM TempDB.INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS WHERE COLUMN_NAME = 'UserFK' and TABLE_NAME LIKE '#ProcedureAndErrorDetails%')
			--	SELECT TOP 1 @UserFK = ISNULL(UserFK,0) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails  WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);

			SET @UserFK = ISNULL(@UserFK,0)

			INSERT INTO dbo.tblErrorLog(SQLErrorNumber,SQLErrorSeverity,SQLErrorState,SQLExecutionPath,SQLErrorLineNo,ErrorMessage,IsArchived,InsertedBy,InsertedDate,UpdatedBy,UpdatedDate)
			SELECT @ErrorNumber,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorLine,@ErrorMessage,0,@UserFK,@ErrorDateTime,@UserFK,@ErrorDateTime; SET @ErrorLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

			IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) 
			BEGIN
				SELECT TOP 1 @EventLogFK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1 ORDER BY [ID] DESC

				UPDATE [dbo].[tblEventLog] WITH (ROWLOCK) SET ErrorLogFK = @ErrorLogPK, [State] = 'Failure' WHERE EventLogPK = @EventLogFK
			END

			-- Concatenate the error record primary key value and all of the other error details to be used to raise/return a custom error message to the front end application
			SET @ErrorMessage = 'Error Log Id = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@ErrorLogPK AS NVARCHAR(100)),0) + '|Error Type|SQL|SQL Error Number|' 
								+ ISNULL(CAST(@ErrorNumber AS NVARCHAR(10)),'0') + '|SQL Error Message|' + ISNULL(@ErrorMessage,'')
		END    

		SET @ErrorMessageOut = @ErrorMessage
	END TRY
	BEGIN CATCH
		SET @ErrorMessage = 'ERROR in ' + @ThisProcedureName + ', Error Message = ' + ERROR_MESSAGE(); SET @ErrorSeverity = ERROR_SEVERITY(); SET @ErrorState = ERROR_STATE()
		RAISERROR (@ErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN
	END CATCH
END
GO

-- Exec spGetBuildingDetails @BuildingPK=11

-- =============================================                      
-- Author:      Archana Singh                      
-- Create date: 13/05/2026                      
-- Description: Returns building address and contact details 
--              for the selected building used in the 
--              External Transport schedule screen.
-- =============================================

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spGetBuildingDetails]
(
    @BuildingPK INT
)
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT
 ,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;
	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	DECLARE @var_buildingPK INT = @BuildingPK; 

	SET @ParameterDetails = '@BuildingPK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_buildingPK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'');
    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    --BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

		SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END


	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY
		
		-- This stored procedures main code, excluding error handling - start
      
	      SELECT b.BuildingName,
            CONCAT_WS(', ',
            NULLIF(b.Address1, ''),
            NULLIF(b.Address2, ''),
            NULLIF(b.Address3, ''),
            NULLIF(b.Address4, ''),
            NULLIF(b.Address5, '')
        ) AS BuildingAddress,		   
               b.TelephoneNumber
           FROM tblBuildings b
           WHERE b.BuildingPK = @BuildingPK

		-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end
			
	    BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END
GO
