CREATE PROC [dbo].[spGetBuildingPKByWeekTemplatePK]
(  
  @ScheduleWeekTemplatePK INT  
 
)
 AS
BEGIN
 /* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */  
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED  
  
    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,  
 @DeadlockErrorRetries INT, @PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT,  
 @startRecord INT = 1,@totalRecords INT, @endRecord INT, @NoResultsFound INT  
  
 SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();  
  
  
 -- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters  
 DECLARE @var_ScheduleWeekTemplatePK int  
  
 SET @var_ScheduleWeekTemplatePK = @ScheduleWeekTemplatePK  
   
 SET @ParameterDetails = '@ScheduleWeekTemplatePK = ' + CAST(@var_ScheduleWeekTemplatePK AS NVARCHAR(20))  
  
 IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL   
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)  
  
    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)  
    --BEGIN   
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC   
  
        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)  
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK  
  
        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()  
    --END  
  
 SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);  
 SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails  
 ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;  
 INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()  
  
 WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3  
 BEGIN   
  BEGIN TRY  

 SELECT  b.BuildingPK
  FROM tblbuildings b
    LEFT JOIN tblScheduleTemplates st
    ON st.BuildingFK = b.BuildingPK 
      LEFT JOIN tblScheduleChannelTemplates sct
      ON sct.ScheduleTemplateFK = st.ScheduleTemplatePK 
        LEFT JOIN tblScheduleWeekTemplates swt
        ON swt.ScheduleChannelTemplateFK = sct.ScheduleChannelTemplatePK
            
  where swt.ScheduleWeekTemplatePK = @var_ScheduleWeekTemplatePK
   AND (b.IsArchived = 0 OR b.IsArchived is NULL)
   AND (st.IsArchived = 0 OR st.IsArchived is NULL)
   AND (sct.IsArchived = 0 OR sct.IsArchived is NULL)
   AND (swt.IsArchived = 0 OR swt.IsArchived is NULL)
 
 -- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end     
        
   BREAK  
  END TRY  
  BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */  
   DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;  
   SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;  
   SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;  
  
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY   
   BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;  
         
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;  
  
            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID  
              
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;  
              
   IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)  
   BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END  
   ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */  
  END CATCH  
  SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1  
 END  
END

-- Exec spGetClientCutOffsForSchedular 271   
-- Exec spGetClientCutOffsForSchedular 712 --transport user
-- =============================================  
-- Author:  <Archana Singh>  
-- Create date: <28.08.2024>  
-- Description: <Get CutOffs For Client to schedule delivery in calendar>  
-- =============================================   

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spGetClientCutOffsForSchedular] (     
  @UserId INT  
)  
AS  
BEGIN  
 /* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */  
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED  
  
    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT  
 ,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;  
 SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();  
  
 -- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters  
 DECLARE @var_userId INT  
 SET @var_userId = @UserId  
  
 SET @ParameterDetails = '@UserId = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_userId AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'')  
      
 IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL   
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)  
  
    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)  
    --BEGIN  
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC   
  
  SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK,-1)  
  
        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)  
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK  
  
        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()  
    --END  
  
 SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);  
 SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails  
 ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;  
 INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()  
  
 WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3  
 BEGIN   
  BEGIN TRY    
  
   -- This stored procedures main code, excluding error handling - start  
      IF EXISTS
     (
        SELECT 1
        FROM tblUsers
        WHERE UserPK = @UserId
          AND UserTypeFK = 5
      )
    BEGIN    
        -- External Transport User Logic
        SELECT DISTINCT
            c.DayCutOff,
            c.TimeCutOff
        FROM tblUserCustomer uc
        INNER JOIN tblCustomers c
            ON c.CustomerPK = uc.CustomerFK
        WHERE uc.UserFK = @UserId    
    END
   ELSE
  BEGIN  
  SELECT c.DayCutOff, c.TimeCutOff  
	FROM tblCustomers c              
	INNER JOIN tblDivisions d ON d.CustomerFK = c.CustomerPK    
	INNER JOIN tblUserDivisions ud ON ud.DivisionFK = d.DivisionPK  
	INNER JOIN tblUsers u ON ud.UserFK = u.UserPK      
	WHERE u.UserPK = @UserId;  
   END
   -- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end  
        
    BREAK  
  END TRY  
  BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */  
   DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;  
   SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;  
   SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;  
  
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY   
   BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;  
         
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;  
  
            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID  
              
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;  
              
   IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2   
   BEGIN   
    SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100;   
  
    IF @CatchErrorMessage LIKE '%Password previously used%' RAISERROR ('Password previously used', 16, 1)  
    ELSE RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState)  
  
    RETURN   
   END  
   ELSE   
    WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */  
  END CATCH

 END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spGetClientsButton]    
@userfk int   
AS    
BEGIN     
 SET NOCOUNT ON;    
  Select ButtonText, Redirect, ImagePath, case when ucbs.UserClientButtonPK is null then 0 else 1 end as ButtonEnabled  
from tblClientButtons  cbs   
left join tblUserClientButtons  ucbs on cbs.ClientButtonPK = ucbs.ClientButtonFK  and ucbs.IsArchived = 0 and UserFK = @userfk  
--where  cbs.ClientButtonPK <> 4   
where cbs.IsArchived=0
order by ucbs.UserFK desc, ListOrder asc  
END

/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[spGetContainerOutCurrentBasketPalletsDetails]    Script Date: 02/11/2026 17:47:26 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
           
-- EXEC dbo.spGetContainerOutCurrentBasketPalletsDetails @ContainerOutFK = 251785, @BuildingUnitFK = 52;            

-- =============================================            
-- Author:      <Archana Singh>            
-- Create date: <31/10/2025>            
-- Description: Get pallet details with total selected units, actual units and EntirePallet flag            
-- =============================================            
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spGetContainerOutCurrentBasketPalletsDetails]            
(            
    @ContainerOutFK INT,            
    @BuildingUnitFK INT            
)            
AS            
BEGIN            
    /* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */                  
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED                  
                  
    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT                  
 ,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;                  
 SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();                  
                  
 -- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters              
 DECLARE @var_containerOutFK INT = @ContainerOutFK;              
 DECLARE @var_buildingUnitFK  int  = @BuildingUnitFK                  
 SET @ParameterDetails = '@ContainerOutFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_containerOutFK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') +              
  ',@BuildingUnitFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_buildingUnitFK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'');              
              
                  
    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL                   
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)                  
                  
    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)                  
    --BEGIN                  
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC                   
                  
  SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)                  
                  
        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)                  
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK                  
                  
        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()                  
    --END                  
                  
                  
 SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);                  
 SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails                  
 ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;                  
 INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()                  
                  
 WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3                  
 BEGIN                   
  BEGIN TRY                  
   IF XACT_STATE() = 0 AND @@TRANCOUNT < 1 BEGIN TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName                  
                  
 -- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start             
  ;WITH ActualUnitsPerPallet AS        
(        
SELECT PalletFK, SUM(ActualUnits) AS TotalActualUnits        
    FROM dbo.tblPalletContent        
    GROUP BY PalletFK      
),        
SelectedUnitsPerPallet AS        
(        
    SELECT PalletFK, SUM(tcolpc.Units) AS TotalSelectedUnits        
    FROM dbo.tblContainerOutLinePalletContent tcolpc        
    INNER JOIN dbo.tblContainerOutLines tcol ON tcolpc.ContainerOutLineFK = tcol.ContainerOutLinePK        
    WHERE tcol.ContainerOutFK = @var_containerOutFK        
    GROUP BY PalletFK        
)        
SELECT          
    tcol.ContainerOutFK,        
    tcolpc.ContainerOutLinePalletContentPK,        
    tp.PalletPK,        
   CASE       
        -- If EntirePallet is 1 and this pallet only has one content row, set PalletContentFK = -1      
        WHEN ISNULL(sup.TotalSelectedUnits, 0) >= ISNULL(aup.TotalActualUnits, 0)      
             AND ISNULL(aup.TotalActualUnits, 0) > 0      
             AND tcolpc.PalletContentFK IS NOT NULL      
             AND NOT EXISTS (      
                 SELECT 1       
                 FROM dbo.tblContainerOutLinePalletContent t2      
                 INNER JOIN dbo.tblContainerOutLines t2col ON t2.ContainerOutLineFK = t2col.ContainerOutLinePK      
                 WHERE t2.PalletFK = tcolpc.PalletFK       
                   AND t2.ContainerOutLinePalletContentPK <> tcolpc.ContainerOutLinePalletContentPK      
                   AND t2col.ContainerOutFK = @var_containerOutFK      
             )      
        THEN -1      
        ELSE ISNULL(tcolpc.PalletContentFK, -1)      
    END AS PalletContentFK,        
 tcolpc.Eaches,  
    CASE WHEN tp.CustomerBarcode <> '' THEN tp.CustomerBarcode ELSE tp.Barcode END AS Barcode,        
    tcolpc.Units,        
    ISNULL(sup.TotalSelectedUnits, 0) AS TotalSelectedPalletUnits,        
    ISNULL(aup.TotalActualUnits, 0) AS TotalActualPalletUnits,        
    CASE         
        WHEN ISNULL(sup.TotalSelectedUnits, 0) >= ISNULL(aup.TotalActualUnits, 0)        
             AND ISNULL(aup.TotalActualUnits, 0) > 0 THEN 1        
        ELSE 0        
    END AS EntirePallet,        
    tcol.DivisionFK,        
    tp.BuildingUnitFK,        
    tbuc.BuildingUnitRowFK,        
    vpl.LocationTypeFK,        
    tsda.SetDownAreaPK,        
    tlb.LoadingBay,     
 tlb.LoadingBayPK,          
    vpl.LocationFK,     
    tcolpc.InsertedDate,        
    tcolpc.UpdatedDate        
FROM dbo.tblPallets tp        
INNER JOIN viewpalletlocations vpl ON tp.PalletPK = vpl.PalletPK        
INNER JOIN dbo.tblContainerOutLinePalletContent tcolpc ON tcolpc.PalletFK = tp.PalletPK        
INNER JOIN dbo.tblContainerOutLines tcol ON tcolpc.ContainerOutLineFK = tcol.ContainerOutLinePK        
    AND tcol.ContainerOutFK = @var_containerOutFK        
LEFT JOIN ActualUnitsPerPallet aup ON tp.PalletPK = aup.PalletFK        
LEFT JOIN SelectedUnitsPerPallet sup ON tp.PalletPK = sup.PalletFK        
LEFT JOIN dbo.tblBuildingUnitColumns tbuc         
    ON tbuc.BuildingUnitColumnPK = vpl.BuildingUnitColumnFK AND vpl.LocationTypeFK = 1        
LEFT JOIN dbo.tblSetDownAreas tsda         
    ON tsda.SetDownAreaPK = vpl.LocationFK AND vpl.LocationTypeFK = 3        
LEFT JOIN dbo.tblLoadingBays tlb         
    ON tlb.LoadingBayPK = vpl.LocationFK AND vpl.LocationTypeFK = 2        
WHERE tp.BuildingUnitFK = @var_buildingUnitFK        
ORDER BY tp.PalletPK;        
          
            
-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end                  
                 
   BEGIN TRY IF XACT_STATE() = 1 AND @@TRANCOUNT = 1 AND @OpeningTranCount < 1 COMMIT TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH                  
                     
   BREAK                  
  END TRY                  
  BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */                  
   DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;                  
   SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;                  
   SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;                  
                  
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY                   
   BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;                  
                         
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;                  
                  
            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID                  
                              
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;                  
                              
   IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)                  
   BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END                  
   ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */                  
  END CATCH                  
  SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1                  
 END                  
END 
GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[spGetCustomersForContractRenewalAlert]    Script Date: 02/11/2026 17:47:26 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spGetCustomersForContractRenewalAlert]
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    SELECT 
        CustomerName,
        ContractRenewalDate,
        RenewalReminderInterval,
        RenewalAlertEmail,
        DATEDIFF(DAY, GETDATE(), ContractRenewalDate) AS DaysRemaining
    FROM tblCustomers
    WHERE ContractRenewalDate IS NOT NULL
      AND CustomerName IS NOT NULL
      AND RenewalAlertEmail IS NOT NULL
      AND LTRIM(RTRIM(CustomerName)) <> ''
      AND LTRIM(RTRIM(RenewalAlertEmail)) <> ''
      AND DATEDIFF(DAY, GETDATE(), ContractRenewalDate) BETWEEN 0 AND RenewalReminderInterval
    ORDER BY DaysRemaining ASC;
END
GO

)  
AS  
BEGIN  
    SET NOCOUNT ON;  
   
        ------------------------------------------------  
        -- Pickup Movements (WorksOrderTypeFK = 3)  
        ------------------------------------------------  
        SELECT   
  wom.WorksOrderMovementPK,   
  wom.WorksOrderFK,   
  wom.WorksOrderStatusFK,   
  wom.PalletFK,   
  wom.PalletContentFK,   
  wom.ContainerOutLinePalletContentFK,  
  wom.EntirePallet,   
  wom.Eaches,   
  wom.Units,   
  wom.SourceLocationTypeFK,   
  wom.SourceLocationFK,   
  wom.SourceBayPosition,   
  wom.SourceStackPosition,   
  wom.DestinationLocationTypeFK,   
  wom.DestinationFK,  
  wom.DestinationBayPosition,   
  wom.DestinationStackPosition,   
  wom.DestinationPalletStart,  
  wom.DestinationPalletEnd,  
  wom.MovementDescription,  
  wom.IsArchived,  
  wom.InsertedBy,  
  wom.InsertedDate,  
  wom.UpdatedBy,   
  wom.UpdatedDate,  
  wom.ResponsibleUserFK,   
  wom.HandheldDeviceFK,   
  wom.WarehouseMachineFK,          
        'PickupMovements' AS MovementType  
        FROM tblWorksOrderMovements wom  
        INNER JOIN tblWorksOrders wo ON wom.WorksOrderFK = wo.WorksOrderPK  
        WHERE wom.worksorderstatusfk <> 3  
          AND wo.WorksOrderTypeFK = 3    
          AND wo.FK = @StockOrderFK  
          AND wom.PalletFK = @PalletFK  
          AND (@PalletContentFK <= 0 OR wom.PalletContentFK = @PalletContentFK)  
        ORDER BY wom.WorksOrderMovementPK ASC;  
  
        ------------------------------------------------  
        -- Loading Movements (WorksOrderTypeFK = 16)  
        ------------------------------------------------  
        SELECT   
            wom.WorksOrderMovementPK,   
  wom.WorksOrderFK,   
  wom.WorksOrderStatusFK,   
  wom.PalletFK,   
  wom.PalletContentFK,   
  wom.ContainerOutLinePalletContentFK,  
  wom.EntirePallet,   
  wom.Eaches,   
  wom.Units,   
  wom.SourceLocationTypeFK,   
  wom.SourceLocationFK,   
  wom.SourceBayPosition,   
  wom.SourceStackPosition,   
  wom.DestinationLocationTypeFK,   
  wom.DestinationFK,  
  wom.DestinationBayPosition,   
  wom.DestinationStackPosition,   
  wom.DestinationPalletStart,  
  wom.DestinationPalletEnd,  
  wom.MovementDescription,  
  wom.IsArchived,  
  wom.InsertedBy,  
  wom.InsertedDate,  
  wom.UpdatedBy,   
  wom.UpdatedDate,  
  wom.ResponsibleUserFK,   
  wom.HandheldDeviceFK,   
  wom.WarehouseMachineFK,   
            'LoadingMovements' AS MovementType  
        FROM tblWorksOrderMovements wom  
        INNER JOIN tblWorksOrders wo ON wom.WorksOrderFK = wo.WorksOrderPK  
        WHERE /*wom.IsArchived = 0  
          AND*/ wo.WorksOrderTypeFK = 16     
          AND wo.FK = @StockOrderFK  
          AND wom.PalletFK = @PalletFK  
          AND (@PalletContentFK <= 0 OR wom.PalletContentFK = @PalletContentFK)  
        ORDER BY wom.WorksOrderMovementPK ASC;  
  
      
END  
  
GO

-- =============================================  
-- Author:      Archana  
-- Create date: 11/12/2025  
-- Description: Get pallets for a location, supporting both conventional and drive-through racking  
-- =============================================  
  
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spGetPalletsForLocation]  
(  
  @LocationPK INT,  
  @IsDriveThrough BIT         -- 1 = Drive-Through, 0 = Conventional Racking  
)  
AS  
BEGIN  
 /* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */  
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED  
  
    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT  
 ,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;  
 SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();  
  
 -- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters  
 DECLARE @var_locationPK INT, @var_isDriveThrough BIT  
 SET @var_locationPK = @LocationPK; SET @var_isDriveThrough = @IsDriveThrough;   
 SET @ParameterDetails = '@LocationPK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@LocationPK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)), '')   
                          + ', @IsDriveThrough = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@IsDriveThrough AS NVARCHAR(MAX)), '');  
  
    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL   
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)  
  
    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)  
    --BEGIN  
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC   
  
  SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)  
  
        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)  
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK  
  
        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()  
    --END  
  
  
 SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);  
 SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails  
 ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;  
 INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()  
  
 WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3  
 BEGIN   
  BEGIN TRY  
    -- This stored procedures main code, excluding error handling - start      
      
  
-- Conventional RACKING
IF @var_isDriveThrough = 0
BEGIN
    SELECT
        p.PalletPK,
        p.BayPosition,
        pt.Description AS PalletType,
        pt.Width AS PalletWidth,
        CASE WHEN pt.WidthMargin >= 0 THEN pt.WidthMargin ELSE 20 END AS Margin,
        p.PalletStart,
        p.PalletEnd,
        p.StackPosition,
        bu.BayLevel
    FROM tblPallets p
    INNER JOIN tblPalletTypes pt
        ON p.PalletTypeFK = pt.PalletTypePK
    INNER JOIN tblBuildingUnitBays bu
        ON bu.BuildingUnitBayPK = p.LocationFK
    WHERE p.LocationFK = @var_locationPK
    ORDER BY p.BayPosition;

    RETURN;
END;

-- DRIVE-THROUGH RACKING
;WITH ColumnBays AS
(
    SELECT BuildingUnitBayPK
    FROM tblBuildingUnitBays
    WHERE BuildingUnitColumnFK =
    (
        SELECT BuildingUnitColumnFK
        FROM tblBuildingUnitBays
        WHERE BuildingUnitBayPK = @var_locationPK
    )
)
SELECT
    p.PalletPK,
    p.BayPosition,
    pt.Description AS PalletType,
    pt.Width AS PalletWidth,
    CASE WHEN pt.WidthMargin >= 0 THEN pt.WidthMargin ELSE 20 END AS Margin,
    p.PalletStart,
    p.PalletEnd,
    p.StackPosition,
    bu.BayLevel
FROM tblPallets p
INNER JOIN tblPalletTypes pt
    ON p.PalletTypeFK = pt.PalletTypePK
INNER JOIN tblBuildingUnitBays bu
    ON bu.BuildingUnitBayPK = p.LocationFK
INNER JOIN ColumnBays cb
    ON cb.BuildingUnitBayPK = bu.BuildingUnitBayPK
ORDER BY bu.BayLevel, p.BayPosition;

    
   -- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end  
 BREAK  
  END TRY  
  BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */  
   DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;  
   SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;  
   SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;  
  
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY   
   BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;  
         
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;  
  
            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID  
              
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;  
              
   IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)  
   BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END  
   ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */  
  END CATCH  
  SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1  
 END  
END

-- exec spGetScheduleDeliveryNotificationData @ScheduleDeliveryPK=232, @BuildingPK=11      
-- exec spGetScheduleDeliveryNotificationData @ScheduleDeliveryPK=231, @BuildingPK=11      
     
-- =============================================                            
-- Author:      Archana Singh                            
-- Create date: 11/06/2026                            
-- Description:  Retrieves schedule delivery notification data for a given ScheduleDeliveryPK.    
--               Returns consolidated information for inbound/outbound deliveries including:    
--               - Building details (name, address, telephone)    
--               - Customer details (code, name)    
--               - Division details including stock controller email    
--               - Transport company information    
--               - External transport user mapped via tblUserCustomer    
--               - Delivery type (Inbound/Outbound)    
--    
--               Data is derived by separating inbound and outbound flows using CTEs to avoid    
--               duplication and improve performance. External transport users are resolved    
--               using tblUserCustomer mapping to ensure correct customer-based assignment.    
--    
--               Designed to return a single, deduplicated record per ScheduleDeliveryPK.    
-- =============================================      
    
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spGetScheduleDeliveryNotificationData]    
(       
   @ScheduleDeliveryPK INT,    
    @BuildingPK INT      
)      
AS      
BEGIN      
 /* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */      
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED      
      
    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT      
 ,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;      
 SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();      
      
 -- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters      
 DECLARE @var_buildingPK INT = @BuildingPK;       
 DECLARE @var_scheduleDeliveryPK INT = @ScheduleDeliveryPK;       
    
 SET @ParameterDetails = '@BuildingPK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_buildingPK AS NVARCHAR(20)),'')     
  + ',@ScheduleDeliveryPK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_scheduleDeliveryPK AS NVARCHAR(20)),'')    
     
    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL       
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)      
      
    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)      
    --BEGIN      
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC       
      
  SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)      
      
        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)      
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK      
      
        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()      
    --END      
      
      
 SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);      
 SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails      
 ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;      
 INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()      
      
 WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3      
 BEGIN       
  BEGIN TRY      
        
  -- This stored procedures main code, excluding error handling - start      
    ;WITH BaseDelivery AS    
    (    
        SELECT    
            sdel.ScheduleDeliveryPK,    
            sdel.ContainerInFK,    
            sdel.ContainerOutFK,    
            sdel.IsArchived    
        FROM tblScheduleDeliveries sdel    
        WHERE sdel.ScheduleDeliveryPK = @var_scheduleDeliveryPK    
          AND sdel.IsArchived = 0    
    ),    
    
    BuildingCTE AS    
    (    
        SELECT    
            b.BuildingPK,    
            b.BuildingName,    
            CONCAT_WS(', ',    
                NULLIF(b.Address1, ''),    
                NULLIF(b.Address2, ''),    
                NULLIF(b.Address3, ''),    
                NULLIF(b.Address4, ''),    
                NULLIF(b.Address5, '')    
            ) AS BuildingAddress,    
            b.TelephoneNumber    
        FROM tblBuildings b    
        WHERE b.BuildingPK = @var_buildingPK    
    ),    
    
    InboundCTE AS    
    (    
        SELECT    
            ci.ContainerInPK,    
            si.DivisionFK,    
            d.DivisionPK,    
            d.DivisionCode,    
            d.DivisionName,    
            c.CustomerPK,    
            c.CustomerCode,    
            c.CustomerName,    
            tc.TransportCompanyPK,    
            tc.TransportCompany,    
             d.ScheduleStockControllerEmail    
        FROM tblContainerIns ci    
        LEFT JOIN tblStockIns si ON ci.ContainerInPK = si.ContainerInFK    
        LEFT JOIN tblDivisions d ON si.DivisionFK = d.DivisionPK    
        LEFT JOIN tblCustomers c ON d.CustomerFK = c.CustomerPK    
        LEFT JOIN tblTransportCompanies tc ON ci.TransportCompanyFK = tc.TransportCompanyPK    
    ),    
    
    OutboundCTE AS    
    (    
        SELECT    
            co.ContainerOutPK,    
            col.DivisionFK,    
            d.DivisionPK,    
            d.DivisionCode,    
            d.DivisionName,    
            c.CustomerPK,    
            c.CustomerCode,    
            c.CustomerName,    
            tc.TransportCompanyPK,    
            tc.TransportCompany,    
            d.ScheduleStockControllerEmail    
        FROM tblContainerOuts co    
        LEFT JOIN tblContainerOutLines col ON col.ContainerOutFK = co.ContainerOutPK    
        LEFT JOIN tblDivisions d ON col.DivisionFK = d.DivisionPK    
        LEFT JOIN tblCustomers c ON d.CustomerFK = c.CustomerPK    
        LEFT JOIN tblTransportCompanies tc ON co.TransportCompanyFK = tc.TransportCompanyPK    
    )    
    
    SELECT    
        b.BuildingName,    
        b.BuildingAddress,    
        b.TelephoneNumber,    
    
        bd.ScheduleDeliveryPK,    
    
        -- CUSTOMER    
        COALESCE(ci.CustomerPK, co.CustomerPK) AS CustomerPK,    
        COALESCE(ci.CustomerCode, co.CustomerCode) AS CustomerCode,    
        COALESCE(ci.CustomerName, co.CustomerName) AS CustomerName,    
    
        -- DIVISION    
        COALESCE(ci.DivisionPK, co.DivisionPK) AS DivisionPK,    
        COALESCE(ci.DivisionCode, co.DivisionCode) AS DivisionCode,    
        COALESCE(ci.DivisionName, co.DivisionName) AS DivisionName,    
    
        -- STOCK CONTROLLER EMAIL  
         -- multiple STOCK CONTROLLER user/email as string
        COALESCE(ci.ScheduleStockControllerEmail, co.ScheduleStockControllerEmail)    
        AS ScheduleStockControllerEmail,    
    
        -- TRANSPORT COMPANY    
        COALESCE(ci.TransportCompanyPK, co.TransportCompanyPK) AS TransportCompanyPK,    
        COALESCE(ci.TransportCompany, co.TransportCompany) AS TransportCompany,    
    
        -- DELIVERY TYPE    
        CASE    
            WHEN bd.ContainerInFK IS NOT NULL THEN 'Inbound'    
            WHEN bd.ContainerOutFK IS NOT NULL THEN 'Outbound'    
            ELSE ''    
        END AS DeliveryType,    
    
        -- Need customer=> transportComapany(tbluser.TransportCompayPK) -> All Users of this transport company    
        u.TransportUserPK,    
        u.TransportUserName,    
        u.TransportUserEmail    
    
    FROM BaseDelivery bd    
    CROSS JOIN BuildingCTE b    
    
    LEFT JOIN InboundCTE ci    
        ON bd.ContainerInFK = ci.ContainerInPK    
    
    LEFT JOIN OutboundCTE co    
        ON bd.ContainerOutFK = co.ContainerOutPK    
    
    OUTER APPLY     
    (    --Need customer=> transportComapany(tbluser.TransportCompayPK) -> All Users of this transport company 
         -- multiple user/email as string
        SELECT TOP 1    
            tu.UserPK AS TransportUserPK,    
            tu.UserName AS TransportUserName,    
            au.Email AS TransportUserEmail    
        FROM tblUserCustomer uc    
        INNER JOIN tblUsers tu ON tu.UserPK = uc.UserFK    
        INNER JOIN AspNetUsers au ON au.Id = tu.AspNetUserID    
        WHERE uc.CustomerFK = COALESCE(ci.CustomerPK, co.CustomerPK)    
          AND tu.UserTypeFK = 5    
          AND tu.TransportCompanyFK = COALESCE(ci.TransportCompanyPK, co.TransportCompanyPK)    
        ORDER BY tu.UserPK DESC    
    ) u;    
      
  -- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end      
         
     BREAK      
  END TRY      
  BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */      
   DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;      
   SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;      
   SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;      
      
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY       
   BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;      
             
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;      
      
            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID      
                  
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;      
                  
   IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)      
   BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END      
   ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */      
  END CATCH      
  SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1      
 END      
END

/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[spGetStockOrderWorksOrders]    Script Date: 02/11/2026 17:47:26 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spGetStockOrderWorksOrders]  
    @StockOrderFK INT  
AS  
BEGIN  
    SET NOCOUNT ON;  
  
    DECLARE @MovementPK INT;  
    DECLARE @LoadingPK INT;  
  
    -- Get existing Movement works order PK  
    SELECT TOP 1 @MovementPK = WorksOrderPK  
    FROM tblWorksOrders  
    WHERE WorksOrderStatusFK != 3 -- Not Complete  
      AND WorksOrderOriginFK = 2 -- StockOut  
      AND FK = @StockOrderFK  
      AND WorksOrderTypeFK = 3; -- Movement  
  
    -- Get existing LoadPallet works order PK  
    SELECT TOP 1 @LoadingPK = WorksOrderPK  
    FROM tblWorksOrders  
    WHERE WorksOrderStatusFK != 3  
      AND WorksOrderOriginFK = 2  
      AND FK = @StockOrderFK  
      AND WorksOrderTypeFK = 16; -- LoadPallet  
  
    -- Return both PKs  
    SELECT @MovementPK AS MovementPK, @LoadingPK AS LoadingPK;  
END  
GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[spGetTransportUserContainerOutBYOrderRefSearch]    Script Date: 02/11/2026 17:47:26 ******/

/*          
================================================================================          
Author:        <Archana Singh>          
Create Date:   <20/05/2026>          
Description: This stored procedure is used to retrieve transport-related stock           
(inbound and outbound) based on a given Order Reference for a specific transport          
user within a week schedule context.          
          
Business Use Case:          
------------------          
Used in Transport Week Schedule screen to allow users to search and view all          
relevant stock movements linked to a specific order reference, ensuring          
visibility is restricted to authorized buildings only. 


================================================================================          
*/          
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spGetTransportUserContainerOutBYOrderRefSearch]          
(          
    @UserFK INT,          
    @OrderRef NVARCHAR(100)          
)          
AS          
BEGIN          
 /* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */

 INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

--USER SCOPE
SELECT DISTINCT u.UserPK,
    u.TransportCompanyFK,
    uc.CustomerFK,
    bu.BuildingFK,   
    u.AspNetUserID
INTO #UserScope
FROM tblUsers u
JOIN tblUserCustomer uc ON uc.UserFK = u.UserPK
JOIN tblDivisions d ON d.CustomerFK = uc.CustomerFK
JOIN tblDivisionBuildingUnits dbu ON dbu.DivisionFK = d.DivisionPK
JOIN tblBuildingUnits bu ON bu.BuildingUnitPK = dbu.BuildingUnitFK
WHERE u.UserPK = @var_UserFK
  AND dbu.IsArchived = 0

CREATE CLUSTERED INDEX IX_UserScope ON #UserScope(CustomerFK, BuildingFK);

  SELECT DISTINCT
    v.IdentifierPK,
    v.Type,
    v.TransportCompanyFK,
    v.ShippingCompanyFK
INTO #Match
FROM tblContainerOuts co
CROSS APPLY (VALUES
    (co.ContainerOutPK, 'ContainerOut', co.TransportCompanyFK, co.ShippingCompanyFK, co.GoodsOrderNumber),

UNION ALL

SELECT DISTINCT
    v.IdentifierPK,
    v.Type,
    v.TransportCompanyFK,
    v.ShippingCompanyFK
FROM tblContainerIns ci
CROSS APPLY (VALUES
    (ci.ContainerInPK, CASE WHEN ci.StockInGroupFK > 0 THEN 'ContainerIn' ELSE 'Group' END, ci.TransportCompanyFK, ci.ShippingCompanyFK, ci.ContainerNumber),
    (ci.ContainerInPK, CASE WHEN ci.StockInGroupFK > 0 THEN 'ContainerIn' ELSE 'Group' END, ci.TransportCompanyFK, ci.ShippingCompanyFK, ci.SealNumber),
    (ci.ContainerInPK, CASE WHEN ci.StockInGroupFK > 0 THEN 'ContainerIn' ELSE 'Group' END, ci.TransportCompanyFK, ci.ShippingCompanyFK, ci.LorryNumber),
    (ci.ContainerInPK, CASE WHEN ci.StockInGroupFK > 0 THEN 'ContainerIn' ELSE 'Group' END, ci.TransportCompanyFK, ci.ShippingCompanyFK, ci.ExternalReference),
    (ci.ContainerInPK, CASE WHEN ci.StockInGroupFK > 0 THEN 'ContainerIn' ELSE 'Group' END, ci.TransportCompanyFK, ci.ShippingCompanyFK, ci.Free1),
    (ci.ContainerInPK, CASE WHEN ci.StockInGroupFK > 0 THEN 'ContainerIn' ELSE 'Group' END, ci.TransportCompanyFK, ci.ShippingCompanyFK, ci.Free2),
    (ci.ContainerInPK, CASE WHEN ci.StockInGroupFK > 0 THEN 'ContainerIn' ELSE 'Group' END, ci.TransportCompanyFK, ci.ShippingCompanyFK, ci.Free3),
    (ci.ContainerInPK, CASE WHEN ci.StockInGroupFK > 0 THEN 'ContainerIn' ELSE 'Group' END, ci.TransportCompanyFK, ci.ShippingCompanyFK, ci.Free4),
    (ci.ContainerInPK, CASE WHEN ci.StockInGroupFK > 0 THEN 'ContainerIn' ELSE 'Group' END, ci.TransportCompanyFK, ci.ShippingCompanyFK, ci.Free5)
) v(IdentifierPK, Type, TransportCompanyFK, ShippingCompanyFK, Value)
WHERE ci.StockInStatusFK = 1 
    -- AND (ci.StockInGroupFK = -1 OR ci.StockInGroupFK > 0 OR ci.StockInGroupFK IS NULL)   
     AND ci.IsArchived = 0
     AND v.Value = @var_OrderRef;

 CREATE CLUSTERED INDEX IX_Match ON #Match(IdentifierPK, Type);

SELECT *
INTO #ScheduleIn
FROM (
    SELECT
        sd.ContainerInFK,
        sd.ScheduleDeliveryPK,
        schd.DayDate,
        ss.StartTime,
        ss.EndTime,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY sd.ContainerInFK
            ORDER BY sd.ScheduleDeliveryPK DESC
        ) rn
    FROM tblScheduleDeliveries sd
    JOIN #Match m ON m.IdentifierPK = sd.ContainerInFK
       AND m.Type IN ('ContainerIn','Group')
    JOIN tblScheduleSlots ss ON ss.ScheduleSlotPK = sd.ScheduleSlotFK
    JOIN tblScheduleDays schd ON schd.ScheduleDayPK = ss.ScheduleDayFK
    WHERE sd.IsArchived = 0
      AND sd.ContainerInFK IS NOT NULL
) x
WHERE rn = 1;

CREATE CLUSTERED INDEX IX_ScheduleIn ON #ScheduleIn(ContainerInFK);

SELECT *
INTO #ScheduleOut
FROM (
    SELECT
        sd.ContainerOutFK,
        sd.ScheduleDeliveryPK,
        schd.DayDate,
        ss.StartTime,
        ss.EndTime,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY sd.ContainerOutFK
            ORDER BY sd.ScheduleDeliveryPK DESC
        ) rn
    FROM tblScheduleDeliveries sd
    JOIN #Match m ON m.IdentifierPK = sd.ContainerOutFK
       AND m.Type = 'ContainerOut'
    JOIN tblScheduleSlots ss ON ss.ScheduleSlotPK = sd.ScheduleSlotFK
    JOIN tblScheduleDays schd ON schd.ScheduleDayPK = ss.ScheduleDayFK
    WHERE sd.IsArchived = 0
      AND sd.ContainerOutFK IS NOT NULL
) x
WHERE rn = 1;

CREATE CLUSTERED INDEX IX_ScheduleOut ON #ScheduleOut(ContainerOutFK);

    --SELECT * FROM #UserScope
    --SELECT * FROM #Match
    --SELECT * FROM #ScheduleIn
    --SELECT * FROM #ScheduleOut

     /* STOCK IN */        
      SELECT DISTINCT          
      us.BuildingFK,        
      m.IdentifierPK,           
      m.Type,           
      
      -- loginUser
      nu.UserName AS CurrentUser,
      nu.Email AS CurrentUserEmail,
      CAST(1 AS BIT) AS ContainerOutEditStatus,
      scIn.ScheduleDeliveryPK,      
      FORMAT(scIn.DayDate, 'dd/MM/yy') AS [ScheduledDayDate],      
      scIn.StartTime AS ScheduledStartTime,      
      scIn.EndTime AS ScheduledEndTime,      
      CASE WHEN scIn.ScheduleDeliveryPK IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS IsScheduled,      
      
      CAST(ci.GoodsInNumber AS nvarchar(50)) GoodsOrderNumber,            
      ISNULL(sup.Supplier, '') AS Supplier,           
      ISNULL(ci.ContainerNumber, '') AS ContainerNumber,           
      ISNULL(ci.SealNumber,'') AS SealNumber,          
      ISNULL(ci.LorryNumber,'') AS LorryNumber,          
      ISNULL(shp.ShippingCompany, '') AS ShippingCompany,          
      ISNULL(tsp.TransportCompany, '') AS TransportCompany, 
      d1.DivisionPK,
      d1.DivisionCode,           
      d1.DivisionName,   
      --Building StockController
      d1.ScheduleStockControllerEmail,
      c1.CustomerPK,          
      c1.CustomerCode,          
      c1.CustomerName,         
      ISNULL(c1.DefaultDeliveryDurationMinutes,120)  As CustomerDeliveryDurationMinutes,             
        DATEADD(dd,               
          CASE 
            WHEN c1.CustomerPK IS NULL THEN 2 ELSE c1.DayCutOff END,               
            CAST(GETDATE() AS DATETIME)) + CASE WHEN c1.TimeCutOff IS NULL THEN '10:00:00' ELSE CAST(c1.TimeCutOff AS DATETIME) END AS CustomerCutoff,              
         
         CASE               
          WHEN CAST(scIn.DayDate AS DATETIME) + CAST(scIn.StartTime AS DATETIME) <=                
            DATEADD(dd, CASE WHEN c1.CustomerPK IS NULL THEN 2 ELSE c1.DayCutOff END,               
            CAST(GETDATE() AS DATETIME)) + CAST(c1.TimeCutOff AS DATETIME)               
          THEN 1               
          ELSE 0               
          END AS DeliveryPastCutOff,        
      COALESCE(inboundlb.LoadingBay, 'Unassigned') AS LoadingBay,          
      FORMAT(ci.datein, 'dd/MM/yy HH:mm:ss') AS [EventDate], 
      
      CASE WHEN ci.GoodsInNumber <> '' THEN ci.GoodsInNumber ELSE '' END + ' ' +                  
      CASE WHEN cdis.CustomerDocketIdentificationPK IS NOT NULL THEN                       
         CASE cdis.FieldFK                         
           WHEN 1 THEN ci.Free1                        
           WHEN 2 THEN ci.Free2                        
           WHEN 3 THEN ci.Free3                        
           WHEN 4 THEN ci.Free4                        
           WHEN 5 THEN ci.Free5                        
          ELSE ' '           
        END + ' '  +           
      CASE  cdis.Field2FK                         
        WHEN 1 THEN ci.Free1                        
        WHEN 2 THEN ci.Free2                        
        WHEN 3 THEN ci.Free3                        
        WHEN 4 THEN ci.Free4                        
        WHEN 5 THEN ci.Free5                        
       ELSE ' '           
      END + ' '  +           
      CASE  cdis.Field3FK                         
        WHEN 1 THEN ci.Free1                        
        WHEN 2 THEN ci.Free2                        
        WHEN 3 THEN ci.Free3                        
        WHEN 4 THEN ci.Free4                        
        WHEN 5 THEN ci.Free5                        
        ELSE ' '           
     END                       
    ELSE ' '           
    END + ' '  +                      
    CASE WHEN  ci.ExternalReference <> ''           
     THEN ci.ExternalReference           
     ELSE ' '           
    END AS CustomerRef          
    FROM #Match m        
    LEFT JOIN tblContainerIns ci ON ci.ContainerInPK = m.IdentifierPK  AND m.Type IN ('ContainerIn', 'Group')       
    LEFT JOIN #ScheduleIn scIn  ON scIn.ContainerInFK = ci.ContainerInPK    
    LEFT JOIN tblStockIns si ON ci.ContainerInPK = si.ContainerInFK 
    LEFT JOIN tblDivisions d1 ON si.DivisionFK = d1.DivisionPK        
    LEFT JOIN tblCustomers c1 ON d1.CustomerFK = c1.CustomerPK  
    INNER JOIN #UserScope us ON us.CustomerFK= c1.CustomerPK 
    LEFT JOIN AspNetUsers nu ON us.AspNetUserID=nu.Id
    LEFT JOIN tblSuppliers sup ON ci.SupplierFK = sup.SupplierPK        
    LEFT JOIN tblTransportCompanies tsp ON ci.TransportCompanyFK = tsp.TransportCompanyPK        
    LEFT JOIN tblShippingCompanies shp ON ci.ShippingCompanyFK = shp.ShippingCompanyPK        
    LEFT JOIN tblLoadingBays inboundlb ON ci.LoadingBayFK = inboundlb.LoadingBayPK            
    LEFT JOIN tblCustomerDocketIdentifications as cdis on cdis.CustomerFK = us.CustomerFK AND cdis.DocketTypeFK = 1          
   
    UNION ALL        
        
    /* STOCK OUT */        
    SELECT DISTINCT               
        s.BuildingFK,        
        m.IdentifierPK,        
        m.Type,   
        
        -- loginUser
        nu.UserName AS CurrentUser,
        nu.Email AS CurrentUserEmail,
        CASE WHEN co.ContainerOutStageFK=1 THEN CAST(1 AS BIT)
              ELSE CAST(0 AS BIT)
         END AS ContainerOutEditStatus,       
        scOut.ScheduleDeliveryPK,        
        FORMAT(scOut.DayDate, 'dd/MM/yy') AS [ScheduledDayDate],        
        scOut.StartTime AS ScheduledStartTime,        
        scOut.EndTime AS ScheduledEndTime,        
        CASE WHEN scOut.ScheduleDeliveryPK IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS IsScheduled,        
        CAST(co.GoodsOrderNumber AS NVARCHAR(50))AS GoodsOrderNumber,        
        '' AS Supplier,        
        ISNULL(co.ContainerNumber, '') AS ContainerNumber,           
        ISNULL(co.SealNumber,'') AS SealNumber,          
        ISNULL(co.LorryNumber,'') AS LorryNumber,          
        ISNULL(shp.ShippingCompany, '') AS ShippingCompany,          
        ISNULL(tsp.TransportCompany, '') AS TransportCompany,        
        d2.DivisionPK,
        d2.DivisionCode,        
        d2.DivisionName, 
         --Building StockController
        d2.ScheduleStockControllerEmail,
        c2.CustomerPK,        
        c2.CustomerCode,        
        c2.CustomerName,        
        ISNULL(c2.DefaultDeliveryDurationMinutes,120)  As CustomerDeliveryDurationMinutes,             
        DATEADD(dd,               
          CASE 
            WHEN c2.CustomerPK IS NULL THEN 2 ELSE c2.DayCutOff END,               
            CAST(GETDATE() AS DATETIME)) + CASE WHEN c2.TimeCutOff IS NULL THEN '10:00:00' ELSE CAST(c2.TimeCutOff AS DATETIME) END AS CustomerCutoff,              
         
         CASE               
          WHEN CAST(scOut.DayDate AS DATETIME) + CAST(scOut.StartTime AS DATETIME) <=                
            DATEADD(dd, CASE WHEN c2.CustomerPK IS NULL THEN 2 ELSE c2.DayCutOff END,               
            CAST(GETDATE() AS DATETIME)) + CAST(c2.TimeCutOff AS DATETIME)               
          THEN 1               
          ELSE 0               
          END AS DeliveryPastCutOff,        
        COALESCE(outboundlb.LoadingBay, 'Unassigned') AS LoadingBay,         
        FORMAT(co.CollectionDate, 'dd/MM/yy HH:mm:ss') AS [EventDate], 
       
        CASE WHEN co.GoodsOrderNumber <> '' THEN co.GoodsOrderNumber ELSE '' END + ' ' +                  
        CASE               
            WHEN cdis.CustomerDocketIdentificationPK IS NULL THEN                   
                 CASE               
                     WHEN co.Docketlabel1 <> '' THEN co.DocketValue1 ELSE ''               
                 END + ' ' +                  
                 CASE               
                     WHEN co.Docketlabel2 <> '' THEN co.DocketValue2 ELSE ''               
                 END + ' ' +                  
                 CASE               
                     WHEN co.Docketlabel3 <> '' THEN co.DocketValue3 ELSE ''               
                 END              
             ELSE                  
                 CASE cdis.FieldFK               
                     WHEN 40 THEN co.DocketValue1                  
                     WHEN 41 THEN co.DocketValue2                  
                     WHEN 42 THEN co.DocketValue3                  
            END                  
                 + ' ' +                  
                 CASE cdis.Field2FK               
                     WHEN 40 THEN co.DocketValue1                  
                  WHEN 41 THEN co.DocketValue2                  
                     WHEN 42 THEN co.DocketValue3                  
                     ELSE ''                  
                 END                  
         END AS CustomerRef        
    FROM #Match m        
    LEFT JOIN tblContainerOuts co ON co.ContainerOutPK = m.IdentifierPK AND m.Type='ContainerOut'   
    LEFT JOIN #ScheduleOut scOut  ON scOut.ContainerOutFK = co.ContainerOutPK 
    LEFT JOIN tblContainerOutLines col ON col.ContainerOutFK = co.ContainerOutPK                  
    LEFT JOIN tblStockOrders so ON co.ContainerOutPK = so.ContainerOutFK                  
    LEFT JOIN tblBuildingUnits bu ON so.ResponsibleBuildingUnitFK = bu.BuildingUnitPK                  
    INNER JOIN #UserScope s ON s.BuildingFK = bu.BuildingFK AND s.UserPK=@var_UserFK 
    LEFT JOIN AspNetUsers nu ON s.AspNetUserID=nu.Id
    LEFT JOIN tblDivisions d2 ON d2.DivisionPK = col.DivisionFK                   
    LEFT JOIN tblCustomers c2 ON c2.CustomerPK = d2.CustomerFK            
    LEFT JOIN tblloadingbays outboundlb ON so.PickupLoadingBayFK = outboundlb.LoadingBayPK           
    LEFT JOIN tblTransportCompanies tsp ON co.TransportCompanyFK = tsp.TransportCompanyPK                  
    LEFT JOIN tblShippingCompanies shp ON co.ShippingCompanyFK = shp.ShippingCompanyPK                     
    LEFT JOIN tblCustomerDocketIdentifications AS cdis ON cdis.CustomerFK = s.CustomerFK AND cdis.DocketTypeFK = 2                  
             
    
  -- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end          
             
     BREAK          
  END TRY          
  BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */          
   DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;          
   SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;          
   SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;          
          
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY           
   BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;          
                 
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;          
          
            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID          
                      
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;          
                      
   IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)          
   BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END          
   ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */          
  END CATCH          
  SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1          
 END          
END

Description: This stored procedure is used to retrieve transport-related stock

user within a week schedule context.          
================================================================================                  
*/

 DECLARE @var_userFK INT = @UserFK;

 SET @ParameterDetails = '@UserFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_userFK AS NVARCHAR(20)),'')

  SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)

        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK                  
                  
        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()                  
    --END                  
                  
                  
 SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);                  
 SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails                  
 ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;                  
 INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

 BEGIN                   
  BEGIN TRY                  
                    
IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#UserScope') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #UserScope;        
IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#Match') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #Match;        
IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#ScheduleOut') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #ScheduleOut;        
IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#ScheduleIn') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #ScheduleIn;        
      
--USER SCOPE        
SELECT        
    uc.UserFK AS UserPK,       
    uc.CustomerFK,        
    u.TransportCompanyFK,       
    u.AspNetUserID,          
    b.BuildingPK       
INTO #UserScope      
FROM tblUsers u        
INNER JOIN tblUserCustomer uc ON uc.UserFK = u.UserPK        
INNER JOIN tblDivisions d ON d.CustomerFK = uc.CustomerFK        
INNER JOIN tblDivisionBuildingUnits db ON db.DivisionFK = d.DivisionPK        
INNER JOIN tblBuildingUnits bu ON bu.BuildingUnitPK = db.BuildingUnitFK        
INNER JOIN tblBuildings b ON bu.BuildingFK = b.BuildingPK       
WHERE uc.UserFK = @var_userFK        
  AND db.IsArchived = 0        
  AND bu.IsArchived = 0      
GROUP BY      
    uc.UserFK,        
    u.TransportCompanyFK,       
    u.AspNetUserID,      
    uc.CustomerFK,        
    b.BuildingPK;        
        
CREATE CLUSTERED INDEX IX_UserScope ON #UserScope(CustomerFK, BuildingPK);      
        
-- Matching Records         
  SELECT         
    v.IdentifierPK,        
    v.Type,        
    v.TransportCompanyFK,        
    v.ShippingCompanyFK        
INTO #Match        
FROM tblContainerOuts co        
CROSS APPLY (VALUES        
    (co.ContainerOutPK, 'ContainerOut', co.TransportCompanyFK, co.ShippingCompanyFK, co.GoodsOrderNumber),        
    (co.ContainerOutPK, 'ContainerOut', co.TransportCompanyFK, co.ShippingCompanyFK, co.ContainerNumber),        
    (co.ContainerOutPK, 'ContainerOut', co.TransportCompanyFK, co.ShippingCompanyFK, co.SealNumber),
