    (co.ContainerOutPK, 'ContainerOut', co.TransportCompanyFK, co.ShippingCompanyFK, co.DocketValue3),        
    (co.ContainerOutPK, 'ContainerOut', co.TransportCompanyFK, co.ShippingCompanyFK, co.DocketLabel1),        
    (co.ContainerOutPK, 'ContainerOut', co.TransportCompanyFK, co.ShippingCompanyFK, co.DocketLabel2),        
    (co.ContainerOutPK, 'ContainerOut', co.TransportCompanyFK, co.ShippingCompanyFK, co.DocketLabel3)        
) v(IdentifierPK, Type, TransportCompanyFK, ShippingCompanyFK, Value)        
WHERE co.DistributionOrderFK = -1         
      AND co.ContainerOutStatusFK < 5                    
      AND co.IsArchived = 0        
      AND v.Value = @var_orderRef       
      
        
UNION ALL        
        
SELECT         
    v.IdentifierPK,        
    v.Type,        
    v.TransportCompanyFK,        
    v.ShippingCompanyFK        
FROM tblContainerIns ci        
CROSS APPLY (VALUES        
    (ci.ContainerInPK, CASE WHEN ci.StockInGroupFK > 0 THEN 'Group' ELSE 'ContainerIn' END, ci.TransportCompanyFK, ci.ShippingCompanyFK, ci.ContainerNumber),        
    (ci.ContainerInPK, CASE WHEN ci.StockInGroupFK > 0 THEN 'Group' ELSE 'ContainerIn' END, ci.TransportCompanyFK, ci.ShippingCompanyFK, ci.SealNumber),        
    (ci.ContainerInPK, CASE WHEN ci.StockInGroupFK > 0 THEN 'Group' ELSE 'ContainerIn' END, ci.TransportCompanyFK, ci.ShippingCompanyFK, ci.LorryNumber),        
    (ci.ContainerInPK, CASE WHEN ci.StockInGroupFK > 0 THEN 'Group' ELSE 'ContainerIn' END, ci.TransportCompanyFK, ci.ShippingCompanyFK, ci.ExternalReference),        
    (ci.ContainerInPK, CASE WHEN ci.StockInGroupFK > 0 THEN 'Group' ELSE 'ContainerIn' END, ci.TransportCompanyFK, ci.ShippingCompanyFK, ci.Free1),        
    (ci.ContainerInPK, CASE WHEN ci.StockInGroupFK > 0 THEN 'Group' ELSE 'ContainerIn' END, ci.TransportCompanyFK, ci.ShippingCompanyFK, ci.Free2),        
   (ci.ContainerInPK, CASE WHEN ci.StockInGroupFK > 0 THEN 'Group' ELSE 'ContainerIn' END, ci.TransportCompanyFK, ci.ShippingCompanyFK, ci.Free3),        
    (ci.ContainerInPK, CASE WHEN ci.StockInGroupFK > 0 THEN 'Group' ELSE 'ContainerIn' END, ci.TransportCompanyFK, ci.ShippingCompanyFK, ci.Free4),        
    (ci.ContainerInPK, CASE WHEN ci.StockInGroupFK > 0 THEN 'Group' ELSE 'ContainerIn' END, ci.TransportCompanyFK, ci.ShippingCompanyFK, ci.Free5)        
) v(IdentifierPK, Type, TransportCompanyFK, ShippingCompanyFK, Value)        
WHERE ci.StockInStatusFK = 1               
     AND ci.IsArchived = 0        
     AND v.Value = @var_orderRef;        
        
 CREATE CLUSTERED INDEX IX_Match ON #Match(IdentifierPK, Type);        

 -- ScheduleContainerIn      
SELECT *        
INTO #ScheduleIn        
FROM (        
    SELECT        
        sd.ContainerInFK,      
        sd.ScheduleDeliveryPK,        
        schd.DayDate,        
        sd.StartTime,        
        sd.EndTime,        
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (        
            PARTITION BY sd.ContainerInFK        
            ORDER BY sd.ScheduleDeliveryPK DESC        
        ) rn        
    FROM tblScheduleDeliveries sd        
    INNER JOIN #Match m ON m.IdentifierPK = sd.ContainerInFK        
       AND m.Type IN ('ContainerIn','Group')        
   INNER JOIN tblScheduleSlots ss ON ss.ScheduleSlotPK = sd.ScheduleSlotFK        
   INNER JOIN tblScheduleDays schd ON schd.ScheduleDayPK = ss.ScheduleDayFK        
    WHERE sd.IsArchived = 0 AND sd.ContainerInFK IS NOT NULL        
) x        
WHERE rn = 1;        
        
CREATE CLUSTERED INDEX IX_ScheduleIn ON #ScheduleIn(ContainerInFK);        
       
        
-- ScheduledContainerOut      
SELECT *        
INTO #ScheduleOut        
FROM (        
    SELECT        
        sd.ContainerOutFK,              
        sd.ScheduleDeliveryPK,       
        schd.DayDate,        
        sd.StartTime,        
        sd.EndTime,              
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (        
            PARTITION BY sd.ContainerOutFK        
            ORDER BY sd.ScheduleDeliveryPK DESC        
        ) rn        
    FROM tblScheduleDeliveries sd        
    INNER JOIN #Match m ON m.IdentifierPK = sd.ContainerOutFK  AND m.Type = 'ContainerOut'        
    INNER JOIN tblScheduleSlots ss ON ss.ScheduleSlotPK = sd.ScheduleSlotFK        
    INNER JOIN tblScheduleDays schd ON schd.ScheduleDayPK = ss.ScheduleDayFK        
    WHERE sd.IsArchived = 0 AND sd.ContainerOutFK IS NOT NULL        
) x        
WHERE rn = 1;        
        
CREATE CLUSTERED INDEX IX_ScheduleOut ON #ScheduleOut(ContainerOutFK);        
        
    --SELECT * FROM #UserScope        
    --SELECT * FROM #Match        
    --SELECT * FROM #ScheduleIn        
    --SELECT * FROM #ScheduleOut        
        
     /* STOCK IN */                
      SELECT DISTINCT                  
      b.BuildingPK,                
      m.IdentifierPK,                   
      m.Type,         
            
      CAST(1 AS BIT) AS ContainerOutEditStatus,        
      --schedule delivery           
      scIn.ScheduleDeliveryPK,              
      FORMAT(scIn.DayDate, 'dd/MM/yy') AS [ScheduledDayDate],              
      scIn.StartTime AS ScheduledStartTime,              
      scIn.EndTime AS ScheduledEndTime,              
      CASE WHEN scIn.ScheduleDeliveryPK IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS IsScheduled,              
              
      CAST(ci.GoodsInNumber AS nvarchar(50)) GoodsOrderNumber,                    
      ISNULL(sup.Supplier, '') AS Supplier,                   
      ISNULL(ci.ContainerNumber, '') AS ContainerNumber,                   
      ISNULL(ci.SealNumber,'') AS SealNumber,                  
      ISNULL(ci.LorryNumber,'') AS LorryNumber,      
      ISNULL(shp.ShippingCompany, '') AS ShippingCompany,                  
      ISNULL(tsp.TransportCompany, '') AS TransportCompany,         
      d1.DivisionPK,        
      d1.DivisionCode,                   
      d1.DivisionName,        
      c1.CustomerPK,                  
      c1.CustomerCode,                  
      c1.CustomerName,                 
      ISNULL(c1.DefaultDeliveryDurationMinutes,120)  As CustomerDeliveryDurationMinutes,                 
        CONVERT(      
          VARCHAR(19),       
          DATEADD(dd,                       
            CASE         
              WHEN c1.CustomerPK IS NULL THEN 2 ELSE c1.DayCutOff END,                       
              CAST(GETDATE() AS DATETIME))       
               + CAST(      
                   CASE      
                       WHEN c1.TimeCutOff IS NULL THEN '10:00:00'      
                       ELSE c1.TimeCutOff      
                   END AS DATETIME      
      ),      
               120      
         )AS CustomerCutoff,                     
         CASE                       
          WHEN CAST(scIn.DayDate AS DATETIME) + CAST(scIn.StartTime AS DATETIME) <=                        
            DATEADD(dd, CASE WHEN c1.CustomerPK IS NULL THEN 2 ELSE c1.DayCutOff END,                       
            CAST(GETDATE() AS DATETIME)) + CAST(c1.TimeCutOff AS DATETIME)                       
          THEN 1                       
          ELSE 0                       
          END AS DeliveryPastCutOff,                
      COALESCE(inboundlb.LoadingBay, 'Unassigned') AS LoadingBay,                  
      FORMAT(ci.datein, 'dd/MM/yy HH:mm:ss') AS [EventDate],         
              
      CASE WHEN ci.GoodsInNumber <> '' THEN ci.GoodsInNumber ELSE '' END + ' ' +                          
      CASE WHEN cdis.CustomerDocketIdentificationPK IS NOT NULL THEN                               
         CASE cdis.FieldFK                                 
           WHEN 1 THEN ci.Free1                                
           WHEN 2 THEN ci.Free2                                
           WHEN 3 THEN ci.Free3                                
           WHEN 4 THEN ci.Free4                                
           WHEN 5 THEN ci.Free5                                
          ELSE ' '                   
        END + ' '  +                   
      CASE  cdis.Field2FK                                 
        WHEN 1 THEN ci.Free1                                
        WHEN 2 THEN ci.Free2                                
        WHEN 3 THEN ci.Free3                                
        WHEN 4 THEN ci.Free4                                
        WHEN 5 THEN ci.Free5                                
       ELSE ' '                   
      END + ' '  +                   
      CASE  cdis.Field3FK                                 
        WHEN 1 THEN ci.Free1                                
        WHEN 2 THEN ci.Free2                                
        WHEN 3 THEN ci.Free3                                
        WHEN 4 THEN ci.Free4                                
        WHEN 5 THEN ci.Free5                                
        ELSE ' '                   
     END                               
    ELSE ' '                   
    END + ' '  +                              
    CASE WHEN  ci.ExternalReference <> ''                   
     THEN ci.ExternalReference                   
     ELSE ' '                   
    END AS CustomerRef,
    -1 AS ContainerOutLoadingTypeFK,
    'No Restriction' AS  ContainerOutLoadingType 
    FROM #Match m                
    INNER JOIN tblContainerIns ci ON m.IdentifierPK =ci.ContainerInPK AND m.Type IN ('ContainerIn', 'Group')        
    INNER JOIN tblStockIns si ON ci.ContainerInPK= si.ContainerInFK        
    LEFT JOIN tblBuildingUnits bu ON ci.BuildingUnitFK= bu.BuildingUnitPK       
    LEFT JOIN tblBuildings b ON bu.BuildingFK=b.BuildingPK      
    LEFT JOIN tblDivisions d1 ON si.DivisionFK = d1.DivisionPK            
    LEFT JOIN tblCustomers c1 ON d1.CustomerFK=c1.CustomerPK      
    INNER JOIN  #UserScope s ON c1.CustomerPK = s.CustomerFK       
    LEFT JOIN tblSuppliers sup ON ci.SupplierFK = sup.SupplierPK                
    LEFT JOIN tblTransportCompanies tsp ON ci.TransportCompanyFK = tsp.TransportCompanyPK                
    LEFT JOIN tblShippingCompanies shp ON ci.ShippingCompanyFK = shp.ShippingCompanyPK                
    LEFT JOIN tblLoadingBays inboundlb ON ci.LoadingBayFK = inboundlb.LoadingBayPK                    
    LEFT JOIN tblCustomerDocketIdentifications as cdis on cdis.CustomerFK = s.CustomerFK AND cdis.DocketTypeFK = 1                  
    LEFT JOIN #ScheduleIn scIn  ON scIn.ContainerInFK = ci.ContainerInPK        
    WHERE s.UserPK=@var_userFK      
        
        
  UNION ALL                
                
    /* STOCK OUT */                
    SELECT DISTINCT                       
        b.BuildingPK,                
        m.IdentifierPK,                
        m.Type,      
              
        CASE WHEN co.ContainerOutStageFK=1 THEN CAST(1 AS BIT)        
              ELSE CAST(0 AS BIT)        
         END AS ContainerOutEditStatus,        
         --schedule delivery             
        scOut.ScheduleDeliveryPK,                
        FORMAT(scOut.DayDate, 'dd/MM/yy') AS [ScheduledDayDate],                
        scOut.StartTime AS ScheduledStartTime,                
        scOut.EndTime AS ScheduledEndTime,                
        CASE WHEN scOut.ScheduleDeliveryPK IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS IsScheduled,                
        CAST(co.GoodsOrderNumber AS NVARCHAR(50))AS GoodsOrderNumber,                
        '' AS Supplier,                
        ISNULL(co.ContainerNumber, '') AS ContainerNumber,                   
        ISNULL(co.SealNumber,'') AS SealNumber,                  
        ISNULL(co.LorryNumber,'') AS LorryNumber,                  
        ISNULL(shp.ShippingCompany, '') AS ShippingCompany,                  
        ISNULL(tsp.TransportCompany, '') AS TransportCompany,                
        d2.DivisionPK,        
        d2.DivisionCode,                
        d2.DivisionName,         
               
        c2.CustomerPK,                
        c2.CustomerCode,                
        c2.CustomerName,                
        ISNULL(c2.DefaultDeliveryDurationMinutes,120)  As CustomerDeliveryDurationMinutes,                     
        CONVERT(      
          VARCHAR(19),       
          DATEADD(dd,                       
            CASE         
              WHEN c2.CustomerPK IS NULL THEN 2 ELSE c2.DayCutOff END,                       
              CAST(GETDATE() AS DATETIME))       
               + CAST(      
                   CASE      
                       WHEN c2.TimeCutOff IS NULL THEN '10:00:00'      
                       ELSE c2.TimeCutOff      
                   END AS DATETIME      
               ),      
               120      
         )AS CustomerCutoff,                      
                 
         CASE                       
          WHEN CAST(scOut.DayDate AS DATETIME) + CAST(scOut.StartTime AS DATETIME) <=                        
            DATEADD(dd, CASE WHEN c2.CustomerPK IS NULL THEN 2 ELSE c2.DayCutOff END,                       
            CAST(GETDATE() AS DATETIME)) + CAST(c2.TimeCutOff AS DATETIME)                       
          THEN 1                       
          ELSE 0                       
          END AS DeliveryPastCutOff,                
        COALESCE(outboundlb.LoadingBay, 'Unassigned') AS LoadingBay,                 
        FORMAT(co.CollectionDate, 'dd/MM/yy HH:mm:ss') AS [EventDate],         
               
        CASE WHEN co.GoodsOrderNumber <> '' THEN co.GoodsOrderNumber ELSE '' END + ' ' +                          
        CASE                       
            WHEN cdis.CustomerDocketIdentificationPK IS NULL THEN                           
                 CASE                       
                     WHEN co.Docketlabel1 <> '' THEN co.DocketValue1 ELSE ''                       
                 END + ' ' +                          
                 CASE                       
                     WHEN co.Docketlabel2 <> '' THEN co.DocketValue2 ELSE ''                       
                 END + ' ' +                          
                 CASE                       
                     WHEN co.Docketlabel3 <> '' THEN co.DocketValue3 ELSE ''                       
                 END                      
             ELSE                          
                 CASE cdis.FieldFK                       
                     WHEN 40 THEN co.DocketValue1                          
                     WHEN 41 THEN co.DocketValue2                          
                     WHEN 42 THEN co.DocketValue3                          
            END                          
                 + ' ' +                          
                 CASE cdis.Field2FK                       
                     WHEN 40 THEN co.DocketValue1                          
                  WHEN 41 THEN co.DocketValue2                          
                     WHEN 42 THEN co.DocketValue3                          
                     ELSE ''                          
                 END                          
         END AS CustomerRef,
         ISNULL(coload.ContainerOutLoadingTypeFK,-1) AS ContainerOutLoadingTypeFK,
         ISNULL(colt.ContainerOutLoadingType, 'No Restriction') AS ContainerOutLoadingType
    FROM #Match m                
    INNER JOIN tblContainerOuts co ON m.IdentifierPK= co.ContainerOutPK  AND m.Type='ContainerOut'           
    INNER JOIN tblContainerOutLines col ON co.ContainerOutPK=col.ContainerOutFK  
    LEFT JOIN tblContainerOutLoading coload ON coload.ContainerOutFK = co.ContainerOutPK AND coload.IsArchived = 0
    LEFT JOIN appContainerOutLoadingTypes colt ON colt.ContainerOutLoadingTypePK = coload.ContainerOutLoadingTypeFK
    LEFT JOIN tblStockOrders so ON co.ContainerOutPK = so.ContainerOutFK                          
    LEFT JOIN tblBuildingUnits bu ON so.ResponsibleBuildingUnitFK = bu.BuildingUnitPK       
    LEFT JOIN tblBuildings b ON bu.BuildingFK=b.BuildingPK      
    LEFT JOIN tblDivisions d2 ON col.DivisionFK = d2.DivisionPK      
    INNER JOIN #UserScope us ON d2.CustomerFK=us.CustomerFK           
    LEFT JOIN tblCustomers c2 ON c2.CustomerPK = us.CustomerFK                     
    LEFT JOIN tblloadingbays outboundlb ON so.PickupLoadingBayFK = outboundlb.LoadingBayPK                   
    LEFT JOIN tblTransportCompanies tsp ON co.TransportCompanyFK = tsp.TransportCompanyPK                          
    LEFT JOIN tblShippingCompanies shp ON co.ShippingCompanyFK = shp.ShippingCompanyPK                             
    LEFT JOIN tblCustomerDocketIdentifications AS cdis ON cdis.CustomerFK = us.CustomerFK AND cdis.DocketTypeFK = 2                          
    LEFT JOIN #ScheduleOut scOut  ON scOut.ContainerOutFK = co.ContainerOutPK         
    WHERE us.UserPK=@var_userFK      
                   
            
  -- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end                  
                     
     BREAK                  
  END TRY                  
BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */                  
   DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;                  
   SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;                  
   SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;                  
                  
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY                   
   BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;                  
                         
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;                  
                  
            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID                  
                              
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;                  
                              
   IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)                  
   BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END                  
   ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */                  
  END CATCH                  
  SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1                  
 END                  
END

-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spGroupStockInCheckForDuplicateBarcodes]
(	
	@GroupStockInFK int
)	
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT
 ,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;
	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	DECLARE @GroupStockInFK2 int

	SET @GroupStockInFK2 = @GroupStockInFK

	SET @ParameterDetails = '@GroupStockInFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@GroupStockInFK2 AS NVARCHAR(20)),'')

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    --BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

		SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END


	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY
			

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start

			--get all pallets on stock in

			Drop table if exists #tmpstockinpallets

			select distinct p.palletpk, p.barcode, p.customerbarcode into #tmpstockinpallets
			from tblpallets p
			inner join tblstockinlinepallets silp on p.PalletPK = silp.palletfk
			inner join tblstockinlines sil on sil.StockInLinePK = silp.stockinlinefk
			inner join tblstockins si on sil.StockInFK = si.StockInPK
			inner join tblcontainerins ci on si.ContainerInFK = ci.ContainerInPK
			where ci.StockInGroupFK = @GroupStockInFK2

			--select * from #tmpstockinpallets order by Barcode


			--check all barcodes on the stock in are unique

			declare @StockInPalletsOK bit
			declare @STACheck bit

			If(exists(select palletpk from #tmpstockinpallets where customerbarcode <> ''))
			begin--check customer barcodes
				   SELECT @STACheck = 0, @StockInPalletsOK =( CASE WHEN count(distinct customerbarcode)= count(customerbarcode) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
				   FROM #tmpstockinpallets
			end
			else
			begin--check sta barcodes
				   SELECT @STACheck = 1, @StockInPalletsOK =( CASE WHEN count(distinct barcode)= count(barcode)THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
				   FROM #tmpstockinpallets
			end 

			--select @StockInPalletsOK as PalletsOK, @STACheck as STACheck 

			--check all barcodes on the stock in are not already in stock

			if(@StockInPalletsOK = 0)
			begin--something wrong - get out
				   Select @StockInPalletsOK as Result, 'Barcodes on stock in must be unique' as ErrorMessage
			end
			else
			begin
				declare	@nopalletsonthisstockin int
				declare @nopalletsmatchingbarcodes int
				select @nopalletsonthisstockin = count(PalletPK) from #tmpstockinpallets
				   --check customer barcodes or sta barcodes
				   if(@STACheck = 0)
				   begin
						 select @nopalletsmatchingbarcodes = count(p.palletpk)
						 from tblpallets p
						 inner join #tmpstockinpallets sp on p.CustomerBarcode = sp.CustomerBarcode
						 where PalletStatusFK <> 10 and IsArchived = 0
				   end
				   else
				   begin
						 select @nopalletsmatchingbarcodes = count(p.palletpk)
						 from tblpallets p
						 inner join #tmpstockinpallets sp on p.Barcode = sp.Barcode
						 where PalletStatusFK <> 10 and IsArchived = 0
				   end

				   if(@nopalletsmatchingbarcodes > 0)
				   begin
					Select 0 as Result, 'Pallets with same barcodes already in stock' as ErrorMessage
				   end
				   else
				   begin
					Select 1 as Result, 'No duplicate barcodes' as ErrorMessage
				   end
			end

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end

			
			
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spGroupStockInGetBatch]                      
(                      
--declare                      
      @ContainerinFK int                      
   
)                       
AS                      
BEGIN                      
 /* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */                      
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED                      
                      
    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,                      
 @DeadlockErrorRetries INT, @PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT,                      
 @startRecord INT = 1,@totalRecords INT, @endRecord INT, @NoResultsFound INT                      
                      
 SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();                      
                      
 -- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters                      
 DECLARE @var_ContainerinFK int                  
                      
 SET @var_ContainerinFK = (@ContainerinFK)                      
                 
                      
 SET @ParameterDetails = '@ContainerinFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_ContainerinFK AS NVARCHAR(20)),'')   
   
 IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL                       
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)                      
                      
    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)                      
    --BEGIN                       
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC                       
                      
        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)                      
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK                      
                      
        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()                      
    --END                      
                      
 SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);                      
 SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails                      
 ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;                      
 INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()                      
                      
 WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3                      
 BEGIN                       
  BEGIN TRY                      
                  
   -- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start                      
                        
                      
   drop table if exists #tmpgroupbatches  
   select distinct                 
   case when sils.stockinlinepk is null then                      
   STUFF((SELECT distinct ',' +  cih.Batch  from tblcontainerinheaders cih where cih.Batch !='' and cih.ContainerInFK = si.ContainerInFK FOR XML PATH(''), TYPE).value('.', 'NVARCHAR(MAX)')  ,1,1,'') --'HeaderbatchList',                   
   else         
   STUFF((SELECT distinct ',' +  sils.batch  from tblstockinlines sils where sils.batch !='' and si.StockInPK = sils.StockInFK FOR XML PATH(''), TYPE).value('.', 'NVARCHAR(MAX)') ,1,1,'') --'LinesBatchList'                
   end as [Batches] ,
   
    case when sils.stockinlinepk is null then                      
   STUFF((SELECT distinct ',' +  s.stockitemcode  from tblcontainerinheaders cih inner join tblstockitems s on cih.stockitemfk = s.stockitempk where cih.ContainerInFK = si.ContainerInFK FOR XML PATH(''), TYPE).value('.', 'NVARCHAR(MAX)')  ,1,1,'')            
   else                    
   STUFF((SELECT distinct ',' +  si.StockItemCode  from tblstockitems si where si.Stockitempk=sils.StockItemfK FOR XML PATH(''), TYPE).value('.', 'NVARCHAR(MAX)')  ,1,1,'')                
   end as [Stock Code]     
      into #tmpgroupbatches  
  
   --into #tmpstockinBatch                 
   FROM tblstockins si                 
   left join tblstockinlines sils on si.StockInPK = sils.StockInFK       
   where ContainerInfk = (@ContainerinFK)   
     
    declare @batches nvarchar(max)
	declare @stockcodes nvarchar(max)
   select @batches = coalesce(@batches + ', ', '') + isnull([Batches], 'N/A'),
   @stockcodes= coalesce(@stockcodes + ', ', '') + isnull([Stock Code], 'N/A')
   from #tmpgroupbatches  
   select @batches as Batches  
      ,@stockcodes as StockCodes                   
   -- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end                         
                            
   BREAK                      
  END TRY                      
  BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */                      
   DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;                      
   SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;                      
   SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;                      
                      
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY                       
   BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;                      
                             
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;                      
                      
            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID                      
                
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;                      
                                  
   IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)                      
   BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END                      
   ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */                      
  END CATCH                      
  SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1                      
 END                      
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spgvAllergenCodeStockItems]

 @divisionFK int

AS        
BEGIN        
 /* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */        
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED        
        
    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT        
 ,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;        
 SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();        
        
 -- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters        
 DECLARE @divisionFK2 int        
        
 SET @divisionFK2 = @divisionFK        
        
 SET @ParameterDetails = '@divisionFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@divisionFK2 AS NVARCHAR(20)),'')        
        
    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL         
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)        
        
    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)        
    --BEGIN        
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC         
        
  SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)        
        
        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)        
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK        
        
        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()        
    --END        
        
        
 SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);        
 SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails        
 ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;        
 INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()        
        
 WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3        
 BEGIN         
  BEGIN TRY        
           
        
   -- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start        
        
 drop table if exists #tmpstockitemallergencode        
     
 SELECT distinct tsi.StockItemPK ,       
     
   left(        
   STUFF((SELECT distinct ',' +  pk.AllergenCode  from tblstockItemAllergenCodes cih     
   inner join tblAllergenCodes pk    
   on  pk.AllergenCodePK =cih.AllergenCodeFK     
     --where StockitemFK=57052    
  where cih.StockitemFK =tsi.StockItemPK and cih.IsArchived=0      
   FOR XML PATH(''), TYPE).value('.', 'NVARCHAR(MAX)')  ,1,1,'') --'HeaderbatchList',                             
   ,100)    
   as [allergencode]      
  INTO #tmpstockitemallergencode     
    FROM tblStockItems tsi         
  inner join tblstockItemAllergenCodes stock    
   on tsi.StockItemPK =stock.StockitemFK     
   INNER JOIN tblDivisions division ON division.DivisionPK = tsi.DivisionFK  
   WHERE DivisionFK = @divisionFK2 and tsi.IsArchived = 0       
   
    --get all stock items        
   IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#TempStockItems') IS NOT NULL        
     DROP TABLE #TempStockItems        
        
      SELECT tsi.* ,     
 isnull(stcod.allergencode,'') as allergencode    
 INTO #TempStockItems         
    FROM tblStockItems tsi    
 left join  #tmpstockitemallergencode stcod    
 on stcod.stockitempk = tsi.stockitempk    
    WHERE DivisionFK = @divisionFK2 and isarchived = 0        
       
       
       
       
       
       
       
   --SELECT count(*) FROM #TempStockItems        
 -- select * from #TempStockItems      
    --get all fixed locations        
         
        
    --group together        
   -- IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#TempResults') IS NOT NULL        
    -- DROP TABLE #TempResults        
        
 --   SELECT      
 --tfl.Counter [Fixed Locations],       
 --tbu.Counter [Building Units],       
 --th.Counter [Heights],       
 --tc.Counter [Unit Costs],       
 --tcode.Counter [Commodity Codes],      
 --tv.Counter [Versions],       
 --tds.Counter [Delivery Status],       
 --sic.StockItemCategory,  tsi.*         
 --   INTO #TempResults        
 --   FROM #TempStockItems tsi        
          
      
 --select * from #TempResults      
      
      
  IF NOT EXISTS(        
     SELECT *        
     FROM #TempStockItems        
     WHERE DivisionFK = @divisionFK2        
      AND rtrim(('Alias: ' + isnull(StockItemCodeAlias1, 'na') + ', EAN Code(s): ' +  EANCode + ' ' + EANCode2 + ' ' + EANCode3 + ' ' + EANCode4 + ' ' + EANCode5)) <> 'Alias: , EAN Code(s):')        
     BEGIN        
      SELECT StockItemPK AS PK, '/images/StockItem.png' AS ImagePath, cast(0 as bit) as IsArchived, cast(0 as bit) AS IsFiltered,         
 StockItemCode as [Stock Code], Description ,'' as   allergencode---Pritesh   
         
      FROM #TempStockItems        
      Order By StockItemCode ASC        
     END        
    ELSE        
     BEGIN        
      SELECT StockItemPK AS PK, '/images/StockItem.png' AS ImagePath, cast(0 as bit) as IsArchived, cast(0 as bit) AS IsFiltered,         
       StockItemCode as [Stock Code], Description, 'Alias: ' + isnull(StockItemCodeAlias1, 'na') + ', EAN Code(s): ' +  EANCode + ' ' + EANCode2 + ' ' + EANCode3 + ' ' + EANCode4 + ' ' + EANCode5 as [Alias / EAN]     
    ,allergencode       
             
      FROM #TempStockItems        
      Order By StockItemCode ASC        
     END         
         
        
   -- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end        
        
           
           
   BREAK        
  END TRY        
  BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */        
   DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;        
   SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;        
   SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;        
        
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY         
   BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;        
               
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;        
        
            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID        
                    
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;        
                    
   IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)        
   BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END        
   ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */        
  END CATCH        
  SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1        
 END        
END

-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spGvAvailableStock]
(
	@DivisionFK int
)
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT
 ,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;
	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	DECLARE @DivisionFK2 int

	SET @DivisionFK2 = @DivisionFK; 

	SET @ParameterDetails = '@DivisionFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@DivisionFK2 AS NVARCHAR(20)),'')

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    --BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

		SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END


	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY
			

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start
			IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#tblPalletContent') IS NOT NULL
				DROP TABLE #tblPalletContent

			SELECT DISTINCT
				PalletPK, PalletContentPK, StockItemPK, Description, StockItemCode, pc.Batch, pc.EachUnits, AvailableEaches, AvailableUnits
			INTO
				#tblPalletContent
			FROM
				tblPalletContent pc
			INNER JOIN 
				tblPallets P on PalletFK = PalletPK
			INNER JOIN 
				tblStockItems s on stockitemfk = stockitempk and divisionfk = @DivisionFK2
			INNER JOIN
				dbo.tblStockInLinePallets tsilp	 ON P.PalletPK = tsilp.PalletFK
			INNER JOIN 
				dbo.tblStockInLines tsil ON tsil.StockInLinePK = tsilp.StockInLineFK
			INNER JOIN 
				dbo.tblStockIns tsi ON tsil.StockInFK = tsi.StockInPK AND tsi.StockInStatusFK = 3
			WHERE
				P.IsArchived = 0 
				AND PC.IsArchived = 0
				AND p.PalletStatusFK = 1
				AND PC.AvailableUnits > 0

			IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ContentSummary') IS NOT NULL
				DROP TABLE #ContentSummary

			SELECT StockItemPK, cast(cast(sum(quantity) as int) as nvarchar(10)) + '*' + cast(cast(units as int) as nvarchar(10)) as Summaryquantity
			INTO #ContentSummary
			FROM (
				SELECT StockItemPK, 
					case when availableeaches < 0 then 1 else availableeaches end as quantity, 
					case when eachunits < 0 then availableunits ELSE eachunits end AS UNITS
				FROM #tblPalletContent
			)SUBQ
			GROUP BY  StockItemPK, UNITS

			IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#BatchSummary') IS NOT NULL
				DROP TABLE #BatchSummary

			SELECT StockItemPK, batch
			INTO #BatchSummary
			FROM (
				SELECT StockItemPK, batch
				FROM #tblPalletContent
			)SUBQ
			GROUP BY  StockItemPK, batch

			--select * from #tblPalletContent WHERE STOCKITEMPK = 30379
			--select * from #ContentSummary WHERE STOCKITEMPK = 30379

			--temporary : lake region account hard coded batch value, to allow batches to be displayed for other customers
			select distinct pc1.StockItemPK, StockItemCode,Description, Sum(availableUnits) [AvailableUnits], RIGHT(QuantityBreakdown, LEN(QuantityBreakdown) - 2) as QuantityBreakdown, case when @DivisionFK2 = 439 then 'FIFO' else RIGHT(AllBatches, LEN(AllBatches) - 2) END AS AllBatches, '' as RequestedQuantity
			FROM #tblPalletContent pc1
			inner join (
					select distinct wo2.StockItemPK, substring(
						(
							Select ' / '+ Summaryquantity AS [text()]
							From #ContentSummary cs
							Where cs.StockItemPK = wo2.StockItemPK
							For XML PATH ('')
						), 2, 1000) QuantityBreakdown
						from #tblPalletContent wo2
			) quantities on quantities.StockItemPK = pc1.StockItemPK
			inner join (
					select distinct wo2.StockItemPK, substring(
						(
							Select ' / '+ batch AS [text()]
							From #BatchSummary cs
							Where cs.StockItemPK = wo2.StockItemPK
							For XML PATH ('')
						), 2, 1000) AllBatches
						from #tblPalletContent wo2
			) batches on batches.StockItemPK = pc1.StockItemPK
			group by pc1.StockItemPK, StockItemCode,Description, QuantityBreakdown,AllBatches

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end		
			
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spGvAvailableStockBreakdown]
(
	@DivisionFK int,
	@ContaineroutPK int = -1,
	@Search nvarchar(max) = ''
)
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT
 ,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;
	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	DECLARE @DivisionFK2 int
	DECLARE @ContaineroutPK2 int
	DECLARE @Search2 nvarchar(max)

	SET @DivisionFK2 = @DivisionFK; 
	set @ContaineroutPK2 = @ContaineroutPK;
	set @Search2 = @Search;

	SET @ParameterDetails = '@DivisionFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@DivisionFK2 AS NVARCHAR(20)),'') + ', @ContaineroutPK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@ContaineroutPK2 AS NVARCHAR(20)),'') + ', @Search = ' + ISNULL(@Search2 ,'')
    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    --BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

		SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END


	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY
			

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start

			DROP TABLE if exists #tmpAllPalletContent
			DROP TABLE if exists #tmpCoPalletContent

			--get all content
			SELECT DISTINCT
				PalletPK, PalletContentPK, StockItemPK, Description, StockItemCode, AvailableEaches, AvailableUnits, pc.EachUnits, pc.Batch, pc.SupplierBatch, convert(nvarchar(10), pc.BestBefore, 103) BestBefore, convert(nvarchar(10), pc.DateOfManufacture, 103) DateOfManufacture,  convert(nvarchar(10), pc.ExpiryDate, 103) ExpiryDate, convert(nvarchar(10), pc.DateOfReceipt, 103) DateOfReceipt,
				 s.RequireBatch, s.RequireSupplierBatch,
				case when s.RequireBestBefore=1 then s.RequireBestBefore else case when d.RequireBestBefore=1 then d.RequireBestBefore else c.RequireBestBefore end end as RequireBestBefore,
				case when s.RequireExpiryDate=1 then s.RequireExpiryDate else case when d.RequireExpiryDate=1 then d.RequireExpiryDate else c.RequireExpiryDate end end as RequireExpiryDate,
				case when s.RequireManufactureDate=1 then s.RequireManufactureDate else case when d.RequireManufactureDate=1 then d.RequireManufactureDate else c.RequireManufactureDate end end as RequireManufactureDate,
				case when s.RequireDateOfReceipt=1 then s.RequireDateOfReceipt else case when d.RequireDateOfReceipt=1 then d.RequireDateOfReceipt else c.RequireDateOfReceipt end end as RequireDateOfReceipt,
				s.AllowSplitPallets, s.AllowSplitEaches, /*case when apRules.AutoPickRulePK is not null then cast(1 as bit) else cast(0 as bit) end*/ cast(0 as bit) as AutoPickBatch,
				case when ((d.GenerateCustomerPalletBarcodes = 1 or d.AllowCustomerPalletBarcodeManualEntry = 1) and p.CustomerBarcode <> '') then p.CustomerBarcode else p.Barcode end as Barcode,
				case when (c.RequirePalletNumber = 1 or d.RequirePalletNumber = 1 or s.RequirePalletNumber = 1) then p.CustomerPalletNumber else '' end as PalletNumber,
				d.AllowClientToPickbyPallet

			INTO #tmpAllPalletContent
			FROM tblPalletContent pc
			INNER JOIN tblPallets P on PalletFK = PalletPK
			INNER JOIN tblStockItems s on stockitemfk = stockitempk and divisionfk = @DivisionFK2
			inner join tbldivisions d on d.DivisionPK = s.DivisionFK
			inner join tblCustomers c on c.CustomerPK = d.CustomerFK
			--left join tblAutoPickRules apRules on AutoPickRuleTypeFK = 16 and 
			--	((apRules.AutoPickRuleReceiverTypeFK = 1 and apRules.AutoPickRuleReceiverFK = c.CustomerPK)
			--	or
			--	(apRules.AutoPickRuleReceiverTypeFK = 2 and apRules.AutoPickRuleReceiverFK = d.DivisionPK)
			--	or (apRules.AutoPickRuleReceiverTypeFK = 3 and apRules.AutoPickRuleReceiverFK = s.StockItemPK))
			WHERE P.IsArchived = 0 
				AND PC.IsArchived = 0
				AND p.PalletStatusFK = 1
				AND PC.AvailableUnits > 0
				AND p.StockInStatusFK = 3
				and (@Search2 = '' or 
					(					
						stockitemcode like ('%' + @Search2  + '%')
						or 
						s.Description  like ('%' + @Search2 + '%')
						or 
						batch like ('%' + @Search2 + '%')
						or 
						convert(nvarchar(10), pc.BestBefore, 103) like ('%' + @Search2 + '%')
						or 
						convert(nvarchar(10), pc.DateOfManufacture, 103) like ('%' + @Search2 + '%') 
						or 
						convert(nvarchar(10), pc.ExpiryDate, 103) like ('%' + @Search2 + '%')
						or 
						convert(nvarchar(10), pc.DateOfReceipt, 103) like ('%' + @Search2 + '%')
					)
				)

			declare @totalCount int
			declare @RequireBatchCount int
			declare @RequireSupplierBatchCount int
			declare @RequireBestBeforeCount int
			declare @RequireExpiryDateCount int
			declare @RequireManufactureDateCount int
			declare @RequireDateOfReceiptCount int
			select @totalCount = count(*) from #tmpAllPalletContent
			select @RequireBatchCount = count(*) from #tmpAllPalletContent where RequireBatch = 1
			select @RequireSupplierBatchCount = count(*) from #tmpAllPalletContent where RequireSupplierBatch = 1
			select @RequireBestBeforeCount = count(*) from #tmpAllPalletContent where RequireBestBefore = 1
			select @RequireExpiryDateCount = count(*) from #tmpAllPalletContent where RequireExpiryDate = 1
			select @RequireManufactureDateCount = count(*) from #tmpAllPalletContent where RequireManufactureDate = 1
			select @RequireDateOfReceiptCount = count(*) from #tmpAllPalletContent where RequireDateOfReceipt = 1
			
			--if any require batch, then all should
			if(@RequireBatchCount > 0 and @RequireBatchCount <> @totalCount)
			BEGIN
				update #tmpAllPalletContent set RequireBatch = 1
			END

			--if any require supplier batch, then all should
			if(@RequireSupplierBatchCount > 0 and @RequireSupplierBatchCount <> @totalCount)
			BEGIN
				update #tmpAllPalletContent set RequireSupplierBatch = 1
			END
			
			--if any require best before, then all should
			if(@RequireBestBeforeCount > 0 and @RequireBestBeforeCount <> @totalCount)
			begin
				update #tmpAllPalletContent set RequireBestBefore = 1
			end
			
			--if any require expiry, then all should
			if(@RequireExpiryDateCount > 0 and @RequireExpiryDateCount <> @totalCount)
			begin
				update #tmpAllPalletContent set RequireExpiryDate = 1
			end
			
			--if any require manufacturer, then all should
			if(@RequireManufactureDateCount > 0 and @RequireManufactureDateCount <> @totalCount)
			begin
				update #tmpAllPalletContent set RequireManufactureDate = 1
			end
			
			--if any require date of receipt, then all should
			if(@RequireDateOfReceiptCount > 0 and @RequireDateOfReceiptCount <> @totalCount)
			begin
				update #tmpAllPalletContent set RequireDateOfReceipt = 1
			end
										   
			--get content on this order
			select palletcontentfk 
			into #tmpCoPalletContent
			from tblcontaineroutlines col 
			inner join tblContainerOutLinePalletContent colpc on ContainerOutLineFK = ContainerOutLinePK
			inner join #tmpAllPalletContent tpc on colpc.PalletContentFK = tpc.PalletContentPK
			where containeroutfk = @ContaineroutPK

			--delete content on order
			--delete apc
			--from #tmpAllPalletContent apc
			--inner join #tmpCoPalletContent cpc on apc.PalletContentPK = cpc.PalletContentFK

			DROP TABLE if Exists #ContentBatchSummary
			DROP TABLE if Exists #ContentSummary

			SELECT StockItemPK, Batch, SupplierBatch, BestBefore, DateOfManufacture, ExpiryDate, DateOfReceipt,
				cast(cast(sum(quantity) as int) as nvarchar(10)) + '*' + cast(cast(units as int) as nvarchar(10)) as Summaryquantity
			INTO #ContentBatchSummary
			FROM (
				SELECT StockItemPK, Batch, SupplierBatch, BestBefore, DateOfManufacture, ExpiryDate, DateOfReceipt,
					case when availableeaches < 0 then 1 else availableeaches end as quantity, 
					case when eachunits < 0 then availableunits ELSE eachunits end AS UNITS
				FROM #tmpAllPalletContent
			)SUBQ
			GROUP BY  StockItemPK, Batch, SupplierBatch, BestBefore, DateOfManufacture, ExpiryDate, DateOfReceipt, UNITS
			
			SELECT StockItemPK, cast(cast(sum(quantity) as int) as nvarchar(10)) + '*' + cast(cast(units as int) as nvarchar(10)) as Summaryquantity
			INTO #ContentSummary
			FROM (
				SELECT StockItemPK, 
					case when availableeaches < 0 then 1 else availableeaches end as quantity, 
					case when eachunits < 0 then availableunits ELSE eachunits end AS UNITS
				FROM #tmpAllPalletContent
			)SUBQ
			GROUP BY  StockItemPK, UNITS

			DROP TABLE if exists #BatchSummary

			SELECT StockItemPK, batch
			INTO #BatchSummary
			FROM (
				SELECT StockItemPK, batch
				FROM #tmpAllPalletContent
			)SUBQ
			GROUP BY  StockItemPK, batch

			--return remaining list
			select  pc1.StockItemPK, Description, StockItemCode, sum(AvailableEaches) AvailableEaches, sum(AvailableUnits) AvailableUnits, pc1.Batch, pc1.SupplierBatch, 
				pc1.BestBefore, pc1.DateOfManufacture, pc1.ExpiryDate, 
				pc1.DateOfReceipt, RequireBatch, RequireSupplierBatch, RequireBestBefore, RequireExpiryDate,RequireManufactureDate,RequireDateOfReceipt, 
				case when sum(AvailableEaches) > 0 then AllowSplitEaches else AllowSplitPallets end as AllowSplitPallets,
				RIGHT(StockQuantityBreakdown, LEN(StockQuantityBreakdown) - 2) as StockQuantityBreakdown, 
				RIGHT(BatchQuantityBreakdown, LEN(BatchQuantityBreakdown) - 2) as BatchQuantityBreakdown, 
				case when AutoPickBatch = 2 then 'FIFO' else RIGHT(AllBatches, LEN(AllBatches) - 2) END AS AllBatches, AutoPickBatch,
				'' as RequestedQuantity,
				AllowClientToPickByPallet
			from #tmpAllPalletContent pc1
			inner join (
					select distinct wo2.StockItemPK, substring(
						(
							Select '  |  '+ Summaryquantity AS [text()]
							From #ContentSummary cs
							Where cs.StockItemPK = wo2.StockItemPK
							For XML PATH ('')
						), 2, 1000) StockQuantityBreakdown
						from #tmpAllPalletContent wo2
			) SQuantities on SQuantities.StockItemPK = pc1.StockItemPK
			inner join (
					select distinct wo2.StockItemPK, Batch, SupplierBatch, BestBefore, DateOfManufacture, ExpiryDate, DateOfReceipt, substring(
						(
							Select '  |  '+ Summaryquantity AS [text()]
							From #ContentBatchSummary cs
							Where cs.StockItemPK = wo2.StockItemPK and cs.Batch = wo2.Batch and cs.SupplierBatch = wo2.SupplierBatch 
								and cs.BestBefore = wo2.BestBefore and cs.DateOfManufacture = wo2.DateOfManufacture and cs.ExpiryDate = wo2.ExpiryDate and cs.DateOfReceipt = wo2.DateOfReceipt
							For XML PATH ('')
						), 2, 1000) BatchQuantityBreakdown
						from #tmpAllPalletContent wo2
			) BQuantities on BQuantities.StockItemPK = pc1.StockItemPK and BQuantities.Batch = pc1.Batch and BQuantities.SupplierBatch = pc1.SupplierBatch and BQuantities.BestBefore = pc1.BestBefore 
				and BQuantities.DateOfManufacture = pc1.DateOfManufacture and BQuantities.ExpiryDate = pc1.ExpiryDate and BQuantities.DateOfReceipt = pc1.DateOfReceipt
			inner join (
					select distinct wo2.StockItemPK, substring(
						(
							Select '  |  '+ batch AS [text()]
							From #BatchSummary cs
							Where cs.StockItemPK = wo2.StockItemPK
							For XML PATH ('')
						), 2, 1000) AllBatches
						from #tmpAllPalletContent wo2
			) batches on batches.StockItemPK = pc1.StockItemPK
			--where stockitemcode = '147019'
			group by pc1.StockItemPK, Description, StockItemCode, pc1.Batch, pc1.SupplierBatch, pc1.BestBefore, pc1.DateOfManufacture, pc1.ExpiryDate, 
				pc1.DateOfReceipt, RequireBatch, RequireSupplierBatch, RequireBestBefore, RequireExpiryDate,RequireManufactureDate,RequireDateOfReceipt, 
				StockQuantityBreakdown, BatchQuantityBreakdown, AllBatches, AllowSplitPallets, AllowSplitEaches, AutoPickBatch, AllowClientToPickByPallet
				order by stockitemcode, batch

			--return full pallet list as second table
			select PalletContentPK, AvailableUnits, AvailableEaches, Barcode, PalletNumber, pc1.StockItemPK,
				pc1.Batch, pc1.SupplierBatch, pc1.BestBefore, pc1.DateOfManufacture, pc1.ExpiryDate, pc1.DateOfReceipt, case when AvailableEaches > 0 then AllowSplitEaches else AllowSplitPallets end as AllowSplitPallets			
			from #tmpAllPalletContent pc1			

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end		
			
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END
GO
