CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spGvAvailableStockBreakdown2]    
(    
 @DivisionFK int,    
 @ContaineroutPK int = -1,    
 @Search nvarchar(max) = ''    
)    
AS    
BEGIN    
 /* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */    
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED    
    
    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT    
 ,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;    
 SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();    
    
 -- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters    
 DECLARE @DivisionFK2 int    
 DECLARE @ContaineroutPK2 int    
 DECLARE @Search2 nvarchar(max)    
    
 SET @DivisionFK2 = @DivisionFK;     
 set @ContaineroutPK2 = @ContaineroutPK;    
 set @Search2 = @Search;    
    
 SET @ParameterDetails = '@DivisionFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@DivisionFK2 AS NVARCHAR(20)),'') + ', @ContaineroutPK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@ContaineroutPK2 AS NVARCHAR(20)),'') + ', @Search = ' + ISNULL(@Search2 ,'')    
    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL     
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)    
    
    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)    
    --BEGIN    
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC     
    
  SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)    
    
        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)    
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK    
    
        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()    
    --END    
    
    
 SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);    
 SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails    
 ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;    
 INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()    
    
 WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3    
 BEGIN     
  BEGIN TRY    
       
    
   -- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start    
   
    
    
   -- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start    
    
   DROP TABLE if exists #tmpAllPalletContent    
   DROP TABLE if exists #tmpCoPalletContent    
    
   --get all content    
   SELECT DISTINCT    
    PalletPK, PalletContentPK, StockItemPK, Description, StockItemCode, AvailableEaches, AvailableUnits, pc.EachUnits, pc.Batch, pc.SupplierBatch, convert(nvarchar(10), pc.BestBefore, 103) BestBefore, convert(nvarchar(10), pc.DateOfManufacture, 103) DateOfManufacture,  convert(nvarchar(10), pc.ExpiryDate, 103) ExpiryDate, convert(nvarchar(10), pc.DateOfReceipt, 103) DateOfReceipt,    
     s.RequireBatch, s.RequireSupplierBatch,    
    case when s.RequireBestBefore=1 then s.RequireBestBefore else case when d.RequireBestBefore=1 then d.RequireBestBefore else c.RequireBestBefore end end as RequireBestBefore,    
    case when s.RequireExpiryDate=1 then s.RequireExpiryDate else case when d.RequireExpiryDate=1 then d.RequireExpiryDate else c.RequireExpiryDate end end as RequireExpiryDate,    
    case when s.RequireManufactureDate=1 then s.RequireManufactureDate else case when d.RequireManufactureDate=1 then d.RequireManufactureDate else c.RequireManufactureDate end end as RequireManufactureDate,    
    case when s.RequireDateOfReceipt=1 then s.RequireDateOfReceipt else case when d.RequireDateOfReceipt=1 then d.RequireDateOfReceipt else c.RequireDateOfReceipt end end as RequireDateOfReceipt,    
    s.AllowSplitPallets, s.AllowSplitEaches, /*case when apRules.AutoPickRulePK is not null then cast(1 as bit) else cast(0 as bit) end*/ cast(0 as bit) as AutoPickBatch,    
    case when ((d.GenerateCustomerPalletBarcodes = 1 or d.AllowCustomerPalletBarcodeManualEntry = 1) and p.CustomerBarcode <> '') then p.CustomerBarcode else p.Barcode end as Barcode,    
    case when (c.RequirePalletNumber = 1 or d.RequirePalletNumber = 1 or s.RequirePalletNumber = 1) then p.CustomerPalletNumber else '' end as PalletNumber,    
    d.AllowClientToPickbyPallet,  
 coalesce(StockItemCategory, 'Undefined') As StockCategory,  
 d.OrderBySequence,s.StockSequence  
    
   INTO #tmpAllPalletContent    
   FROM tblPalletContent pc    
   INNER JOIN tblPallets P on PalletFK = PalletPK    
   INNER JOIN tblStockItems s on stockitemfk = stockitempk and divisionfk = @DivisionFK2    
   left join tblstockitemcategories sc on s.stockitemcategoryfk = sc.stockitemcategorypk  
   inner join tbldivisions d on d.DivisionPK = s.DivisionFK    
   inner join tblCustomers c on c.CustomerPK = d.CustomerFK    
   --left join tblAutoPickRules apRules on AutoPickRuleTypeFK = 16 and     
   -- ((apRules.AutoPickRuleReceiverTypeFK = 1 and apRules.AutoPickRuleReceiverFK = c.CustomerPK)    
   -- or    
   -- (apRules.AutoPickRuleReceiverTypeFK = 2 and apRules.AutoPickRuleReceiverFK = d.DivisionPK)    
   -- or (apRules.AutoPickRuleReceiverTypeFK = 3 and apRules.AutoPickRuleReceiverFK = s.StockItemPK))    
   WHERE P.IsArchived = 0     
    AND PC.IsArchived = 0    
    AND p.PalletStatusFK = 1    
    AND PC.AvailableUnits > 0    
    AND p.StockInStatusFK = 3    
    and (@Search2 = '' or     
     (         
      stockitemcode like ('%' + @Search2  + '%')    
      or     
      s.Description  like ('%' + @Search2 + '%')    
      or     
      batch like ('%' + @Search2 + '%')    
      or     
      convert(nvarchar(10), pc.BestBefore, 103) like ('%' + @Search2 + '%')    
      or     
      convert(nvarchar(10), pc.DateOfManufacture, 103) like ('%' + @Search2 + '%')     
      or     
      convert(nvarchar(10), pc.ExpiryDate, 103) like ('%' + @Search2 + '%')    
      or     
      convert(nvarchar(10), pc.DateOfReceipt, 103) like ('%' + @Search2 + '%')    
     )    
    )    
    
   declare @totalCount int    
   declare @RequireBatchCount int    
   declare @RequireSupplierBatchCount int    
   declare @RequireBestBeforeCount int    
   declare @RequireExpiryDateCount int    
   declare @RequireManufactureDateCount int    
   declare @RequireDateOfReceiptCount int    
   declare @TotalCategories int    
   select @totalCount = count(*) from #tmpAllPalletContent    
   select @RequireBatchCount = count(*) from #tmpAllPalletContent where RequireBatch = 1    
   select @RequireSupplierBatchCount = count(*) from #tmpAllPalletContent where RequireSupplierBatch = 1    
   select @RequireBestBeforeCount = count(*) from #tmpAllPalletContent where RequireBestBefore = 1    
   select @RequireExpiryDateCount = count(*) from #tmpAllPalletContent where RequireExpiryDate = 1    
   select @RequireManufactureDateCount = count(*) from #tmpAllPalletContent where RequireManufactureDate = 1    
   select @RequireDateOfReceiptCount = count(*) from #tmpAllPalletContent where RequireDateOfReceipt = 1    
   select @TotalCategories = count(distinct stockcategory) from #tmpAllPalletContent where stockcategory <> 'Undefined'   
       
   --if any require batch, then all should    
   if(@RequireBatchCount > 0 and @RequireBatchCount <> @totalCount)    
   BEGIN    
    update #tmpAllPalletContent set RequireBatch = 1    
   END    
    
   --if any require supplier batch, then all should    
   if(@RequireSupplierBatchCount > 0 and @RequireSupplierBatchCount <> @totalCount)    
   BEGIN    
    update #tmpAllPalletContent set RequireSupplierBatch = 1    
   END    
       
   --if any require best before, then all should    
   if(@RequireBestBeforeCount > 0 and @RequireBestBeforeCount <> @totalCount)    
   begin    
    update #tmpAllPalletContent set RequireBestBefore = 1    
   end    
       
   --if any require expiry, then all should    
   if(@RequireExpiryDateCount > 0 and @RequireExpiryDateCount <> @totalCount)    
   begin    
    update #tmpAllPalletContent set RequireExpiryDate = 1    
   end    
       
   --if any require manufacturer, then all should    
   if(@RequireManufactureDateCount > 0 and @RequireManufactureDateCount <> @totalCount)    
   begin    
    update #tmpAllPalletContent set RequireManufactureDate = 1    
   end    
       
   --if any require date of receipt, then all should    
   if(@RequireDateOfReceiptCount > 0 and @RequireDateOfReceiptCount <> @totalCount)    
   begin    
    update #tmpAllPalletContent set RequireDateOfReceipt = 1    
   end    
  
   --if we only have 1 category, then set as 'All'  
   if(@TotalCategories < 1)  
   begin  
 update #tmpAllPalletContent set StockCategory = 'All Stock'  
   end  
     
  
   --get content on this order    
   select palletcontentfk     
   into #tmpCoPalletContent    
   from tblcontaineroutlines col     
   inner join tblContainerOutLinePalletContent colpc on ContainerOutLineFK = ContainerOutLinePK    
   inner join #tmpAllPalletContent tpc on colpc.PalletContentFK = tpc.PalletContentPK    
   where containeroutfk = @ContaineroutPK    
    
   --delete content on order    
   --delete apc    
   --from #tmpAllPalletContent apc    
   --inner join #tmpCoPalletContent cpc on apc.PalletContentPK = cpc.PalletContentFK    
    
   DROP TABLE if Exists #ContentBatchSummary    
   DROP TABLE if Exists #ContentSummary    
    
   SELECT StockItemPK, Batch, SupplierBatch, BestBefore, DateOfManufacture, ExpiryDate, DateOfReceipt,    
    cast(cast(sum(quantity) as int) as nvarchar(10)) + '*' + cast(cast(units as DECIMAL(18,3)) as nvarchar(20)) as Summaryquantity    
   INTO #ContentBatchSummary    
   FROM (    
    SELECT StockItemPK, Batch, SupplierBatch, BestBefore, DateOfManufacture, ExpiryDate, DateOfReceipt,    
     case when availableeaches < 0 then 1 else availableeaches end as quantity,     
     case when eachunits < 0 then availableunits ELSE eachunits end AS UNITS    
    FROM #tmpAllPalletContent    
   )SUBQ    
   GROUP BY  StockItemPK, Batch, SupplierBatch, BestBefore, DateOfManufacture, ExpiryDate, DateOfReceipt, UNITS    
       
   SELECT StockItemPK,
   cast(cast(sum(quantity) as int) as nvarchar(10)) + '*' + cast(cast(units as DECIMAL(18,3)) as nvarchar(20)) as Summaryquantity    
   INTO #ContentSummary    
   FROM (    
    SELECT StockItemPK,     
     case when availableeaches < 0 then 1 else availableeaches end as quantity,     
     case when eachunits < 0 then availableunits ELSE eachunits end AS UNITS    
    FROM #tmpAllPalletContent    
   )SUBQ    
   GROUP BY  StockItemPK, UNITS    
    
   DROP TABLE if exists #BatchSummary    
    
   SELECT StockItemPK, batch    
   INTO #BatchSummary    
   FROM (    
    SELECT StockItemPK, batch    
    FROM #tmpAllPalletContent    
   )SUBQ    
   GROUP BY  StockItemPK, batch    
    
   --return remaining list    
   select  pc1.StockItemPK, Description, StockItemCode, sum(AvailableEaches) AvailableEaches, sum(AvailableUnits) AvailableUnits, pc1.Batch, pc1.SupplierBatch,     
    pc1.BestBefore, pc1.DateOfManufacture, pc1.ExpiryDate,     
    pc1.DateOfReceipt, RequireBatch, RequireSupplierBatch, RequireBestBefore, RequireExpiryDate,RequireManufactureDate,RequireDateOfReceipt,     
    case when sum(AvailableEaches) > 0 then AllowSplitEaches else AllowSplitPallets end as AllowSplitPallets,    
    RIGHT(StockQuantityBreakdown, LEN(StockQuantityBreakdown) - 2) as StockQuantityBreakdown,     
    RIGHT(BatchQuantityBreakdown, LEN(BatchQuantityBreakdown) - 2) as BatchQuantityBreakdown,     
    case when AutoPickBatch = 2 then 'FIFO' else RIGHT(AllBatches, LEN(AllBatches) - 2) END AS AllBatches, AutoPickBatch,    
    '' as RequestedQuantity,    
    AllowClientToPickByPallet,StockCategory,  
 OrderBySequence,StockSequence  
   from #tmpAllPalletContent pc1    
   inner join (    
     select distinct wo2.StockItemPK, substring(    
      (    
       Select '  |  '+ Summaryquantity AS [text()]    
       From #ContentSummary cs    
       Where cs.StockItemPK = wo2.StockItemPK    
       For XML PATH ('')    
      ), 2, 1000) StockQuantityBreakdown    
      from #tmpAllPalletContent wo2    
   ) SQuantities on SQuantities.StockItemPK = pc1.StockItemPK    
   inner join (    
     select distinct wo2.StockItemPK, Batch, SupplierBatch, BestBefore, DateOfManufacture, ExpiryDate, DateOfReceipt, substring(    
      (    
       Select '  |  '+ Summaryquantity AS [text()]    
       From #ContentBatchSummary cs    
       Where cs.StockItemPK = wo2.StockItemPK and cs.Batch = wo2.Batch and cs.SupplierBatch = wo2.SupplierBatch     
        and cs.BestBefore = wo2.BestBefore and cs.DateOfManufacture = wo2.DateOfManufacture and cs.ExpiryDate = wo2.ExpiryDate and cs.DateOfReceipt = wo2.DateOfReceipt    
       For XML PATH ('')    
      ), 2, 1000) BatchQuantityBreakdown    
      from #tmpAllPalletContent wo2    
   ) BQuantities on BQuantities.StockItemPK = pc1.StockItemPK and BQuantities.Batch = pc1.Batch and BQuantities.SupplierBatch = pc1.SupplierBatch and BQuantities.BestBefore = pc1.BestBefore     
    and BQuantities.DateOfManufacture = pc1.DateOfManufacture and BQuantities.ExpiryDate = pc1.ExpiryDate and BQuantities.DateOfReceipt = pc1.DateOfReceipt    
   inner join (    
     select distinct wo2.StockItemPK, substring(    
      (    
       Select '  |  '+ batch AS [text()]    
       From #BatchSummary cs    
       Where cs.StockItemPK = wo2.StockItemPK    
       For XML PATH ('')    
      ), 2, 1000) AllBatches    
      from #tmpAllPalletContent wo2    
   ) batches on batches.StockItemPK = pc1.StockItemPK    
   --where stockitemcode = '147019'    
   group by pc1.StockItemPK, Description, StockItemCode, pc1.Batch, pc1.SupplierBatch, pc1.BestBefore, pc1.DateOfManufacture, pc1.ExpiryDate,     
    pc1.DateOfReceipt, RequireBatch, RequireSupplierBatch, RequireBestBefore, RequireExpiryDate,RequireManufactureDate,RequireDateOfReceipt,     
    StockQuantityBreakdown, BatchQuantityBreakdown, AllBatches, AllowSplitPallets, AllowSplitEaches, AutoPickBatch, AllowClientToPickByPallet  , StockCategory,  
 OrderBySequence,StockSequence  
    order by stockitemcode, batch   
    
   --return full pallet list as second table    
   select PalletContentPK, AvailableUnits, AvailableEaches, Barcode, PalletNumber, pc1.StockItemPK,    
    pc1.Batch, pc1.SupplierBatch, pc1.BestBefore, pc1.DateOfManufacture, pc1.ExpiryDate, pc1.DateOfReceipt, case when AvailableEaches > 0 then AllowSplitEaches else AllowSplitPallets end as AllowSplitPallets       
   from #tmpAllPalletContent pc1       
    -- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end      
       
   BREAK    
  END TRY    
  BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */    
   DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;    
   SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;    
   SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;    
    
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY     
   BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;    
           
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;    
    
            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID    
                
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;    
                
   IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)    
   BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END    
   ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */    
  END CATCH    
  SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1    
 END    
END 
GO

			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;

			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spGvBuildingUnitObstructions]
(
	@buildingUnitFK int
)
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT
 ,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;
	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters

	SET @ParameterDetails = '@buildingUnitFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@buildingUnitFK2 AS NVARCHAR(20)),'')

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    --BEGIN

		SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END


	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY
			

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start

			Select * from (
				SELECT 
					BuildingUnitBayObstructionPK AS PK, '/images/Obstruction.png' AS ImagePath, bubos.IsArchived, cast(0 as bit) AS IsFiltered, 
					case when buRows.Translate = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ then
						case when buRows.ReverseTranslate = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ then
							buRows.TranslatedRow + right('0' + cast((buRows.TranslateColumn - buCols.BuildingUnitColumn) as nvarchar(10)),2) + lower(buBays.BayLevel) 
						else
							buRows.TranslatedRow + right('0' + cast((buCols.BuildingUnitColumn + buRows.TranslateColumn) as nvarchar(10)),2) + lower(buBays.BayLevel) 
						End
					else 
						buRows.Row + right('0' + cast(buCols.BuildingUnitColumnName as nvarchar(10)),2) + lower(buBays.BayLevel) 
					End Location,
					ObstructionStart,
					ObstructionEnd
				FROM 
					dbo.tblBuildingUnitBayObstructions bubos
				inner join tblBuildingUnitBays buBays on
					buBays.BuildingUnitBayPK = bubos.BuildingUnitBayFK
				inner join tblBuildingUnitColumns buCols on
					buCols.BuildingUnitColumnPK = buBays.BuildingUnitColumnFK
				inner join tblBuildingUnitRows buRows on
					buRows.BuildingUnitRowPK = buCols.BuildingUnitRowFK
				where 
					buRows.BuildingUnitFK = @buildingUnitFK2 and buBays.isarchived=0 and bubos.IsArchived=0
			) AS subQ
			Order By 
				Location, ObstructionStart

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end

			
			
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END

	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY
			

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start

			SELECT BuildingUnitRowPK AS PK, '/images/BuildingUnitRow.png' AS ImagePath, buRows.IsArchived, cast(0 as bit) AS IsFiltered, 
			Row,
			Columns,
			RackingType,
			case when LocateFromLeft = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ then '$imgLocateFromLeft.png'
			else '$imgLocateFromRight.png' end as [Locate From]
	
			FROM         dbo.tblBuildingUnitRows buRows
			inner join appRackingTypes rackingTypes
			on
			rackingTypes.RackingTypePK = buRows.RackingTypeFK
			where BuildingUnitFK = @buildingUnitFK2 and buRows.IsArchived=0
			Order By buRows.RowNumber

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end

			
			
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */

			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spGvBuildingUnitRowsSimple]
(
	@buildingUnitFK int,
	@DivisionFK int,
	@StockItemFK int
)
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED

	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	DECLARE @buildingUnitFK2 int, @DivisionFK2 int, @StockItemFK2 int

	SET @buildingUnitFK2 = @buildingUnitFK; SET @DivisionFK2 = @DivisionFK; SET @StockItemFK2 = @StockItemFK

	SET @ParameterDetails = '@buildingUnitFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@buildingUnitFK2 AS NVARCHAR(20)),'') + ',@DivisionFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@DivisionFK2 AS NVARCHAR(20)),'')
		+ ',@StockItemFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@StockItemFK2 AS NVARCHAR(20)),'')

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    --BEGIN

        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END


	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY
			

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start

			/*SELECT BuildingUnitRowPK AS PK, '/images/BuildingUnitRow.png' AS ImagePath, buRows.IsArchived, cast(0 as bit) AS IsFiltered, Row
			FROM         dbo.tblBuildingUnitRows buRows
			inner join appRackingTypes rackingTypes on rackingTypes.RackingTypePK = buRows.RackingTypeFK
			where BuildingUnitFK = @buildingUnitFK2*/

			select  BuildingUnitRowPK AS PK, '/images/BuildingUnitRow.png' AS ImagePath, buRows.IsArchived, cast(0 as bit) AS IsFiltered, 
			buRows.Row + ' (' + CASE WHEN buRows.Translate = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ THEN buRows.TranslatedRow ELSE buRows.Row END + ')' AS 'Row (Translation)',
				CASE WHEN @DivisionFK2 > 1 THEN count (dbuBays.DivisionBuildingUnitBayPK) ELSE count(sibuBays.StockItemBuildingUnitBayPK) END as 'Selected Cells'
			from tblBuildingUnitRows buRows
				inner join tblBuildingUnitColumns buCols on buCols.BuildingUnitRowFK = buRows.BuildingUnitRowPK and buCols.IsArchived = 0
				inner join tblBuildingUnitBays buBays on buBays.BuildingUnitColumnFK = buCols.BuildingUnitColumnPK and buBays.IsArchived = 0
				left join tblDivisionBuildingUnitBays dbuBays on dbuBays.DivisionFK = @DivisionFK2 AND dbuBays.BuildingUnitBayFK = buBays.BuildingUnitBayPK and dbuBays.IsArchived = 0
				left join tblStockItemBuildingUnitBays sibuBays on sibuBays.StockItemFK = @StockItemFK2 AND sibuBays.BuildingUnitBayFK = buBays.BuildingUnitBayPK and sibuBays.IsArchived = 0
			where buRows.BuildingUnitFK = @buildingUnitFK2 and buRows.IsArchived = 0
			group by buRows.buildingunitrowpk, buRows.IsArchived, buRows.Row, buRows.TranslatedRow, buRows.Translate

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end

			
			
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END

-- =============================================
-- Author:		Jack Dalton
-- Create date: 19/06/2018
-- Description:	
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spGvClientAvailableStockWithImages] 
	(
	@DivisionFK INT,
	@PageNumber INT = 1,
	@MaxRowsPerPage INT = 20,
	@Search NVARCHAR (MAX) = NULL,
	@SortField int = 1,
	@ContainerOutFK int = -1,
	@AvailableStockOnly bit = 0
	--@SearchWildcard NVARCHAR (MAX) = NULL

)	
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT
 ,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;
	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	DECLARE @var_DivisionFK int, @var_PageNumber int, @var_MaxRowsPerPage int, @var_Search nvarchar(MAX), @var_SortOrder NVARCHAR (4), 
		@var_SortField int, @var_SortFieldText NVARCHAR(MAX), @NoResultsFound INT = 0, @var_ContainerOutFK int, @var_AvailableStockOnly bit--, @var_SearchWildcard NVARCHAR(MAX)

	SET @var_DivisionFK = @DivisionFK
	SET @var_PageNumber = @PageNumber
	SET @var_MaxRowsPerPage = @MaxRowsPerPage
	SET @var_Search = ISNULL(@Search,'')
	SET	@var_SortOrder = 'ASC'
	SET @var_SortField = @SortField
	SET @var_SortFieldText = ISNULL(@SortField,'StockCode')	
	SET @var_ContainerOutFK = @ContainerOutFK
	--SET @var_SearchWildcard = @SearchWildcard
	set @var_AvailableStockOnly = @AvailableStockOnly
	

	SET @ParameterDetails = '@DivisionFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_DivisionFK AS NVARCHAR(20)),'') + ',@PageNumber = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_PageNumber AS NVARCHAR(20)),'') + ',@MaxRowsPerPage = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_MaxRowsPerPage AS NVARCHAR(20)),'') 
				+ ',@Search = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_Search AS NVARCHAR(20)),'') + ',@SortField = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_SortField AS NVARCHAR(20)),'')  + ',@SortOrder = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_SortOrder AS NVARCHAR(4)),'')

	DECLARE @SQLInsertIntoTable NVARCHAR(MAX), @SQLSelect NVARCHAR(MAX), @SQLFromPart1 NVARCHAR(MAX), @SQLFromPart2 NVARCHAR(MAX),
		@SQLFromCombined NVARCHAR(MAX), @SQLWhere NVARCHAR(MAX), @SQLOrderBy NVARCHAR(MAX), @currentSearchKeyword NVARCHAR(MAX), 
			@RowNumber INT = 1, @StartRow INT = 1, @EndRow INT = 20, @totalRecords INT, @UserTypeFK INT

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    --BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

		SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END


	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY			

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start
			print 'start' 		
		--order by
		SET @var_SortFieldText = CASE WHEN @var_SortField = 1 THEN 'StockCode'
										WHEN @var_SortField = 2 THEN 'StockCode'
										WHEN @var_SortField = 3 THEN 'ManufacturerPartNo'
										WHEN @var_SortField = 4 THEN 'ManufacturerPartNo'
										WHEN @var_SortField = 5 THEN 'Manufacturer'
										WHEN @var_SortField = 6 THEN 'Manufacturer'
										WHEN @var_SortField = 7 THEN 'AvailableUnits'
										WHEN @var_SortField = 8 THEN 'AvailableUnits'
								END

		SET @var_SortOrder = CASE WHEN @var_SortField = 1 THEN 'ASC'
										WHEN @var_SortField = 2 THEN 'DESC'
										WHEN @var_SortField = 3 THEN 'ASC'
										WHEN @var_SortField = 4 THEN 'DESC'
										WHEN @var_SortField = 5 THEN 'ASC'
										WHEN @var_SortField = 6 THEN 'DESC'
										WHEN @var_SortField = 7 THEN 'ASC'
										WHEN @var_SortField = 8 THEN 'DESC'
								END
												
		print 'sorting'
		print @var_SortFieldText
	
		SET @SQLOrderBy = 'ORDER BY  '+@var_SortFieldText+' '+@var_SortOrder

		--wrap search string with quotes / like %
		set @var_Search = '(''%' + @var_Search + '%'')'
		set @var_Search = replace(@var_Search, ',', '%''),(''%')

			
			IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#Results') IS NOT NULL
				DROP TABLE #Results

			CREATE TABLE #Results
			(
				RowNumber INT IDENTITY(1,1),
				PK INT,
				ImagePath NVARCHAR (MAX), 
				StockCode NVARCHAR(MAX),
				[Description] NVARCHAR(MAX),
				ManufacturerPartNo NVARCHAR(MAX),
				Manufacturer NVARCHAR(MAX),
				AvailableUnits decimal(18,3),
				CurrentDataSet bit,
				OnOrder bit
			)			

			SET @SQLInsertIntoTable = 
			'INSERT INTO #Results (PK, ImagePath, [StockCode], [Description], ManufacturerPartNo, Manufacturer, AvailableUnits, CurrentDataSet, OnOrder)'
			
			SET @SQLSelect =
				' SELECT distinct x.*  
				FROM ( VALUES '+ @var_Search +' ) AS v (pattern) 
				CROSS APPLY (  -- your query 
					SELECT pk, ImagePath, [StockCode], Description, ManufacturerPartNo, Manufacturer, ISNULL(AvailableUnits, 0) AS AvailableUnits, 1 as CurrentDataSet, 0 as OnOrder ' 

			--print @SQLInsertIntoTable
			--print @SQLSelect
			--print @var_DivisionFK 
			SET @SQLFromPart1 = 
				'	FROM (--Start of finalSubquery 
						SELECT DISTINCT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY '+ cast(@var_SortFieldText as nvarchar(max)) + ' '+ cast(@var_SortOrder as nvarchar(max)) +') AS rowNumber, *, COUNT(*) OVER() AS TotalRecords 
						FROM (--Start of subquery
							SELECT distinct tsi.StockItemPK as PK, ''../images/CustomerImages/Div'' + cast(tsi.divisionfk as nvarchar(max)) + ''/'' + tsi.StockItemCode + ''.jpg'' AS ImagePath, tsi.StockItemCode as [StockCode], dbo.propercase(tsi.Description) as [Description], tsi.ManufacturerPartNo, tm.Manufacturer, case when  tsi.AllowSplitPallets = 1 then tsl.AvailableUnits else tsl.AvailablePallets end as AvailableUnits  
							FROM tblstockitems tsi
							LEFT JOIN dbo.tblStockLevels tsl ON stockitemfk = stockitempk 
							left join tblManufacturers tm on tm.ManufacturerPK = tsi.ManufacturerFK 
							WHERE (' + cast(@var_AvailableStockOnly as nvarchar(10)) + '=0 or (' + cast(@var_AvailableStockOnly as nvarchar(10)) + '=1 and tsl.AvailableUnits > 0)) and tsi.DivisionFK = ' + cast(@var_DivisionFK as nvarchar(4)) + '												
						) AS subquery
					)AS finalSubquery '
					
			--set where clause 			
			IF @var_Search <> ''
			BEGIN				
				SET @SQLWhere = 'WHERE [StockCode] like v.pattern or [Description] like v.pattern or [ManufacturerPartNo] like v.pattern or [Manufacturer] like v.pattern )'-- or dbo.fn_StripCharacters([StockCode], ''^a-z0-9'') like v.pattern or dbo.fn_StripCharacters([Description], ''^a-z0-9'') like v.pattern or dbo.fn_StripCharacters([ManufacturerPartNo], ''^a-z0-9'') like v.pattern or dbo.fn_StripCharacters([Manufacturer], ''^a-z0-9'') like v.pattern ) '
			END
			SET @SQLWhere = @SQLWhere + 'as x '

			DECLARE @MaxRowNumber INT
			SELECT @MaxRowNumber = MAX(RowNumber) FROM #Results
			print @MaxRowNumber
			
			print @SQLInsertIntoTable + @SQLSelect + @SQLFromPart1 + @SQLWhere + @SQLOrderBy
			EXEC(@SQLInsertIntoTable + @SQLSelect + @SQLFromPart1 + @SQLWhere + @SQLOrderBy)


			UPDATE #Results WITH (ROWLOCK)
			SET CurrentDataSet = 0
			WHERE RowNumber <= @MaxRowNumber

			SELECT @totalRecords = COUNT(*)
			FROM #Results WHERE CurrentDataSet = 1		

			if(@var_MaxRowsPerPage = -1)
			begin
				set @var_MaxRowsPerPage = @totalRecords
			end

			if(@var_PageNumber > 0)
			BEGIN
				SELECT @EndRow = (@var_PageNumber*@var_MaxRowsPerPage) + (SELECT MIN(RowNumber) FROM #Results WHERE CurrentDataSet = 1) -1
				SELECT @StartRow = @EndRow - @var_MaxRowsPerPage + 1
			END

			if(@var_ContainerOutFK > 0)
			begin
				drop table if exists #tmpCurrentStockOnOrder
				select distinct stockitemfk 
				into #tmpCurrentStockOnOrder
				from tblcontaineroutlines 
				where containeroutfk = @var_ContainerOutFK

				update r
				set OnOrder = 1
				from #Results r
				inner join #tmpCurrentStockOnOrder c on r.PK = c.stockitemfk
			end

			SELECT PK, ImagePath, [StockCode], [Description],ManufacturerPartNo,Manufacturer,AvailableUnits, @totalRecords as totalRecords, OnOrder
			FROM
			#Results as SR
			WHERE SR.CurrentDataSet = 1
				AND (@var_PageNumber <= 0 or SR.RowNumber BETWEEN @StartRow AND @EndRow)
			ORDER BY SR.RowNumber ASC
		

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end		
			
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END
GO

)
AS
BEGIN

    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT

         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY
			

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start

			SELECT   DISTINCT  ContainerInPK AS PK, '/images/StockIn.png' AS ImagePath, cast(0 as bit) AS IsFiltered, cins.IsArchived, 
			cins.GoodsInNumber [Stock In],cins.Free4 [Reference], convert(varchar, DateIn, 106) [Received], sups.Supplier, totals.Pallets, 
			totals.Units, StockInStatus [Status]	
			FROM         dbo.tblContainerIns cins
			inner join tblStockIns sins on
			sins.ContainerInFK = cins.ContainerInPK
			inner join (
				Select sins.ContainerInFK, sum(Pallets) Pallets, sum(case when Pallets = 0 THEN 1 ELSE pallets END * Units) Units
				from tblStockInLines sils
				inner join tblStockIns sins on
				sins.StockInPK = sils.StockInFK
				Group By sins.ContainerInFK
			)totals on
			totals.ContainerInFK = cins.ContainerInPK

			siStatus.StockInStatusPK = cins.StockInStatusFK

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END

	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT
 ,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;
	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	DECLARE @userFK2 int

	SET @userFK2 = @userFK

	SET @ParameterDetails = '@userFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@userFK2 AS NVARCHAR(20)),'')

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    --BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

		SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END

	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY
			

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start

			SELECT   DISTINCT  ContainerOutPK AS PK, '/images/StockOut.png' AS ImagePath, cast(0 as bit) AS IsFiltered, couts.IsArchived, 
			GoodsOrderNumber [Stock Out],
			--DocketValue2 [Delivery Number], 
			case when cdis.CustomerDocketIdentificationPK is null then 
				case when couts.Docketlabel1 <> '' THEN 
					couts.Docketlabel1 + ': ' + couts.DocketValue1 else '' end + ' ' +
				case when couts.Docketlabel2 <> '' THEN 
					couts.Docketlabel2 + ': ' + couts.DocketValue2 else '' end + ' ' +
				case when couts.Docketlabel3 <> '' THEN 
					couts.Docketlabel3 + ': ' + couts.DocketValue3 else '' end + '' 
			else
				case cdis.FieldFK when 40 then
						cdis.Prefix + ' ' + couts.DocketValue1
				when 41 then
						cdis.Prefix + ' ' + couts.DocketValue2
				when 42 then
						cdis.Prefix + ' ' + couts.DocketValue3
				end
				+ ' ' +
				case cdis.Field2FK when 40 then
						cdis.Prefix2 + ' ' + couts.DocketValue1
				when 41 then
						cdis.Prefix2 + ' ' + couts.DocketValue2
				when 42 then
						cdis.Prefix2 + ' ' + couts.DocketValue3
				else
						''
				end
			End as [Reference],
			convert(varchar, couts.InsertedDate, 106) [Order Date], 
			--convert(varchar, couts.DeliveryDate, 106) [Delivery Date],

			totals.Pallets, 
			totals.Units, 
			case when couts.ContainerOutStatusFK in (1,2,3,4) and couts.OrderedContentConfirmed = 1 then 'In Progress' when couts.ContainerOutStatusFK = 0 then 'Pending (Unconfirmed)' else status.ContainerOutStatus end as [Status],
			case when couts.InsertedBy < 1 then 'Integration' else FirstName + ' ' + LastName end as [Created By]
			FROM dbo.tblContainerOuts couts
			inner join tblContainerOutLines cols on cols.ContainerOutFK = couts.ContainerOutPK
			left join appContainerOutStatus status on status.ContainerOutStatusPK = couts.ContainerOutStatusFK
			INNER JOIN tbldivisions divs on cols.divisionfk = divs.divisionpk
			left outer join tblCustomerDocketIdentifications cdis on cdis.CustomerFK = divs.CustomerFK AND cdis.DocketTypeFK = 2 /*ContainerOut*/
			inner join (
				Select ContainerOutFK, sum(Pallets) Pallets, sum(Units) Units
				from tblContainerOutLines cols
				Group By ContainerOutFK
			)totals on
			totals.ContainerOutFK = couts.ContainerOutPK
			left join tblusers tu on tu.userpk = couts.InsertedBy
			left join tblpeople tp on tu.PersonFK = tp.PersonPK

			Where cols.DivisionFK in (Select DivisionFK from tblUserDivisions where UserFK = @userFK2)

			order by /*couts.GoodsOrderNumber*/ ContainerOutPK Desc      

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end

			
			
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */

			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END

    end  
   End as [Reference],  
   convert(varchar, couts.InsertedDate, 106) [Order Date],   
   --convert(varchar, couts.DeliveryDate, 106) [Delivery Date],   
   couts.Address1 [Address],   
   totals.Pallets,   
   totals.Units,   
   --case when couts.ContainerOutStatusFK in (1,2,3,4) and couts.OrderedContentConfirmed = 1 then 'In Progress' when couts.ContainerOutStatusFK = 0 then 'Pending (Unconfirmed)' else status.ContainerOutStatus end as [Status],  
  --case when couts.ContainerOutStatusFK = 1 and couts.OrderedContentConfirmed = 0 then 'Pending'   when couts.ContainerOutStatusFK = 0 then 'Pending (Unconfirmed)' else status.ContainerOutStatus end as [Status], 
    case when couts.ContainerOutStatusFK = 0 then 'Pending (Unconfirmed)' else status.ContainerOutStatus end as [Status],
   
   case when couts.InsertedBy < 1 then 'Integration' else FirstName + ' ' + LastName end as [Created By]  
   FROM dbo.tblContainerOuts couts  
   inner join tblContainerOutLines cols on cols.ContainerOutFK = couts.ContainerOutPK  
   left join appContainerOutStatus status on status.ContainerOutStatusPK = couts.ContainerOutStatusFK  
   INNER JOIN tbldivisions divs on cols.divisionfk = divs.divisionpk  
   left outer join tblCustomerDocketIdentifications cdis on cdis.CustomerFK = divs.CustomerFK AND cdis.DocketTypeFK = 2 /*ContainerOut*/  
   inner join (  
    Select ContainerOutFK, sum(Pallets) Pallets, sum(Units) Units  
    from tblContainerOutLines cols  
    Group By ContainerOutFK  
   )totals on  
   totals.ContainerOutFK = couts.ContainerOutPK  
   left join tblusers tu on tu.userpk = couts.InsertedBy  
   left join tblpeople tp on tu.PersonFK = tp.PersonPK  
  
   Where cols.DivisionFK in (Select DivisionFK from tblUserDivisions where UserFK = @userFK2)  
  and couts.ContainerOutStatusFK in(0, 1)
   and couts.OrderedContentConfirmed = 0
   order by /*couts.GoodsOrderNumber*/ ContainerOutPK Desc        
  
   -- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end  
  
     
     
   BREAK  
  END TRY  
  BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */  
   DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;  
   SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;  
   SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;  
  
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY   
   BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;  
         
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;  
  
            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID  
              
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;  
              
   IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)  
   BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END  
   ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */  
  END CATCH  
  SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1  
 END  
END

	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;

			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END

)

    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED          
          
    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT

 SET @ParameterDetails = '@containerInFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@ContainerInFK2 AS NVARCHAR(20)),'') + ', @ForPrinting = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@ForPrinting2 AS NVARCHAR(20)),'') + ', @ClientUserView = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@ClientUserView2 AS NVARCHAR(20)),'')

  BEGIN TRY          
             
   -- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start          
          
IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#results') IS NOT NULL
DROP TABLE #results;
SELECT
CIA.ContainerInAuditPK AS PK,
ContainerInFK,
'' AS ImagePath,
CAST(0 AS bit) AS IsFiltered,
CAST(0 AS bit) AS IsArchived,
CASE
WHEN cia.IsArchived = 1 THEN '[removed] ' + REPLACE(REPLACE(CIA.Description, CHAR(13), ' '), CHAR(10), ' ') + ' [removed]'
ELSE REPLACE(REPLACE(CIA.Description, CHAR(13), ' '), CHAR(10), ' ')
END AS 'Audit Details',
CONVERT(VARCHAR(50), CIA.InsertedDate, 121) AS [Date],
ISNULL(p.Firstname + ' ' + p.LastName, 'System') AS 'User'
INTO
#results
FROM
tblContainerInAudit AS CIA
LEFT OUTER JOIN tblusers AS u ON u.userpk = CIA.UpdatedBy
LEFT OUTER JOIN tblpeople AS p ON u.personfk = p.personpk
WHERE
ContainerInFK = @ContainerInFK2
AND (@ClientUserView2 = 0 OR (@ClientUserView2 = 1 AND cia.ContainerInAuditTypeFK <> 5));
IF (@ForPrinting2 = 1)
BEGIN
SELECT [Audit Details] AS Detail, [Date], [User], tci.GoodsInNumber
FROM #results
INNER JOIN dbo.tblContainerIns tci ON tci.ContainerInPK = ContainerInFK
ORDER BY CAST(#results.[Date] AS datetime);
END
ELSE
BEGIN
SELECT PK, ImagePath, IsFiltered, IsArchived, [Audit Details], [Date], [User]
FROM #results
ORDER BY CAST([Date] AS datetime);
END      
           
                
   BREAK          
  END TRY          
  BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */          
   DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;

   BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;          
                 
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;          
          
            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID          
                      
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;

   BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END          
   ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */          
  END CATCH

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT

 SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();  
  
 -- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters  
 DECLARE @containerInFK2 int  
  
 SET @containerInFK2 = @containerInFK  
  
 SET @ParameterDetails = '@containerInFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@containerInFK2 AS NVARCHAR(20)),'')  
  
    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL   
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)  
  
    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)  
    --BEGIN  
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC   
  
  SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)  
  
        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)  
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK  
  
        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()  
    --END  
  
  
 SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);  
 SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails  
 ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;  
 INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()  
  
 WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3  
 BEGIN   
  BEGIN TRY  
     
  
   -- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start  
  
   SELECT cihs.ContainerInHeaderPK AS PK, '/images/Pallet.png' AS ImagePath, cast(0 as bit) AS IsFiltered, 0 as IsArchived,   
   sis.StockItemCode as [Stock Code], '$inf' + sis.Description [Description], cihs.Units, cihs.Batch   
   FROM tblContainerInHeaders cihs  
   inner join tblStockItems sis on  
   sis.StockItemPK = cihs.StockItemFK   
   where cihs.ContainerInFK = @containerInFK2  
   order by sis.StockItemCode  
  
   -- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end  
  
     
     
   BREAK  
  END TRY  
  BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */  
   DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;  
   SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;  
   SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;  
  
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY   
   BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;  
         
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;  
  
            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID  
              
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;  
              
   IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)  
   BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END  
   ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */  
  END CATCH  
  SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1  
 END  
END

AS
BEGIN

    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT

         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

				when containerIns.IsBeingBuilt = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ and containerins.headersonly = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ then 'Building' 
				when containerIns.HeadersOnly = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ then 'Headers' else 'Ready'

					case cdis.FieldFK 
					when 1 then
						cdis.Prefix + ' ' + containerIns.Free1
					when 2 then
						cdis.Prefix + ' ' + containerIns.Free2
					when 3 then
						cdis.Prefix + ' ' + containerIns.Free3
					when 4 then
						cdis.Prefix + ' ' + containerIns.Free4
					when 5 then
						cdis.Prefix + ' ' + containerIns.Free5
					ELSE
						''
					end
					+ ' ' +
					case cdis.Field2FK 
					when 1 then
						cdis.Prefix2 + ' ' + containerIns.Free1
					when 2 then
						cdis.Prefix2 + ' ' + containerIns.Free2
					when 3 then
						cdis.Prefix2 + ' ' + containerIns.Free3
					when 4 then
						cdis.Prefix2 + ' ' + containerIns.Free4
					when 5 then
						cdis.Prefix2 + ' ' + containerIns.Free5
					else
						''
					END
					+ ' ' +
					case cdis.Field3FK 
					when 1 then
						cdis.Prefix3 + ' ' + containerIns.Free1
					when 2 then
						cdis.Prefix3 + ' ' + containerIns.Free2
					when 3 then
						cdis.Prefix3 + ' ' + containerIns.Free3
					when 4 then
						cdis.Prefix3 + ' ' + containerIns.Free4
					when 5 then
						cdis.Prefix3 + ' ' + containerIns.Free5
					else
						''
					END
			  End as Reference,

			  case when sins.ArrivalRecordedBy>0 
			  then '$imgArrived.png'    
			  end as Arrived

			  FROM dbo.tblContainerIns AS containerIns

			  inner join tblBuildingUnits AS buildingUnits
			  on
			  buildingUnits.BuildingUnitPK = containerIns.BuildingUnitFK

			  /*inner join tblUserBuildingUnits uBus on
			  uBus.BuildingUnitFK = buildingUnits.BuildingUnitPK 
			  AND uBus.UserFK = @userFK2*/

			  inner join (
			  select UserFK, BuildingUnitFK  from tblUserBuildingUnits group by userfk, BuildingUnitFK) uBus 
			  on uBus.BuildingUnitFK = buildingUnits.BuildingUnitPK AND uBus.UserFK = @userFK2
			
			  inner join tblBuildings buildings 
			  on
			  buildings.BuildingPK = buildingUnits.BuildingFK

			  left outer join tblSuppliers suppliers
			  on
			  suppliers.SupplierPK = containerIns.SupplierFK

			  left outer join tblTransportCompanies transportCompanies
			  on
			  transportCompanies.TransportCompanyPK = containerIns.TransportCompanyFK  

			  left outer join tblLoadingBays loadingBays
			  on
			  loadingBays.LoadingBayPK = containerIns.LoadingBayFK  

			  inner join (
					Select ContainerInFK, MAX(DivisionFK) DivisionFK,ArrivalRecordedBy from tblStockIns
					Group By ContainerInFK,ArrivalRecordedBy
			  ) sins on sins.ContainerInFK = containerIns.ContainerInPK

			  inner join tblDivisions divs on divs.DivisionPK = sins.DivisionFK

			  inner join tblCustomers custs on custs.CustomerPK = divs.CustomerFK
      

			  left outer join tblCustomerDocketIdentifications cdis on
			  cdis.CustomerFK = divs.CustomerFK
			  AND cdis.DocketTypeFK = 1 /*ContainerIn*/

			  Where StockInStatusFK <= 2
			  order by DateIn asc     

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end

			
			
			
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END
GO

				inner join tblCustomers as custs  on custs.CustomerPK = divs.CustomerFK
				left outer join tblCustomerDocketIdentifications as cdis  on cdis.CustomerFK = divs.CustomerFK 	AND cdis.DocketTypeFK = 1 /*ContainerIn*/ 
				inner join #StockIns AS si ON ContainerIns.ContainerInPK = si.ContainerInPK
				WHERE si.CurrentDataSet = 1 AND si.rec_num between ' + cast(@startrecord as nvarchar(50)) + ' and ' + cast(@endrecord as nvarchar(50)) 

			SET @SQL = @SQL + ' ORDER BY si.rec_num ASC '

			EXEC(@SQL)

			IF @totalRecords =0
			BEGIN
				--PRINT 'NO RESULTS REACHED'
				DECLARE @NoResults NVARCHAR(MAX) = 
					'SELECT containerIns.ContainerInPK AS PK,  ''/images/StockIn.png'' AS ImagePath, ' + CAST(@totalRecords AS NVARCHAR(20)) + ' ' + ' as totalRecords,
						cast(0 as bit) AS IsFiltered,  containerIns.IsArchived,  containerIns.GoodsInNumber as [Stock In], 
						CASE WHEN ISNULL(containerIns.StockInGroupFK, -1) < 1 THEN '''' ELSE ''G-'' + CAST(containerIns.StockInGroupFK AS NVARCHAR(50)) END AS [Group],
						CONVERT(VARCHAR(50), containerIns.DateIn, 106) as [Date],  buildings.BuildingName + '' - '' + buildingUnits.BuildingUnit as [Building Unit],ContainerNumber,'
						
				IF @var_isAll = 0
				begin
					set @NoResults = @NoResults + ' '+ ' case 
						when containerIns.IsBeingBuilt = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ and containerins.headersonly = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ then ''Building'' 
						when containerIns.HeadersOnly = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ then ''Headers'' else ''Ready'' 
						end AS LineStatus, 
						'+' '
				end	
						 
				set @NoResults = @NoResults + ' ' + 'status.StockInStatus, custs.CustomerCode as ''Customer'', (divs.DivisionCode + '' '' + divs.DivisionName) as Division, 
						Suppliers.Supplier as ''Suppliers'', (' + @Reference + ') as Reference '

					left outer join tblSuppliers as Suppliers on Suppliers.SupplierPK = containerIns.SupplierFK

					left outer join tblLoadingBays as loadingBays on loadingBays.LoadingBayPK = containerIns.LoadingBayFK

						from tblStockIns
						left join tblstockinlines sil on stockinpk = stockinfk
						Group By ContainerInFK,ArrivalRecordedBy, stockinpk
					) sins on sins.ContainerInFK = containerIns.ContainerInPK
					inner join tblDivisions as divs  on divs.DivisionPK = sins.DivisionFK
					inner join tblCustomers as custs  on custs.CustomerPK = divs.CustomerFK
					left outer join tblCustomerDocketIdentifications as cdis  on cdis.CustomerFK = divs.CustomerFK AND cdis.DocketTypeFK = 1 /*ContainerIn*/ 
					inner join #StockIns AS si ON ContainerIns.ContainerInPK = si.ContainerInPK
					WHERE si.rec_num = -1'

				EXEC(@NoResults)
			END

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end			
						
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END

	and ci.StockInStatusFK = 1
	and (sd.ContainerInFK is null or not exists (select * from tblScheduleDeliveries sd2 where sd2.ContainerInFK = sd.ContainerInFK and sd2.IsArchived = 0))
	and StockInGroupFK  > 1
			
			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end

    '' as ImagePath, cast(0 as bit) AS IsFiltered,     
    cast(0 as bit) AS IsArchived,   
    case when coa.isarchived = 1 then '[removed] ' + REPLACE(REPLACE(COA.Description, CHAR(13), ' '), CHAR(10), ' ')   + ' [removed] ' else REPLACE(REPLACE(COA.Description, CHAR(13), ' '), CHAR(10), ' ') end as 'Audit Details',     
 CONVERT(VARCHAR(50), COA.InsertedDate, 106) + ' ' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(5), COA.InsertedDate, 108) as [Date],       
    users.PersonName as 'User',       
    IncludeInDocketPrintOut as 'Print On Docket',          
    IncludeInPickListPrintOut as 'Print On Pick List'       
   INTO #results      
   from       
    tblContainerOutAudit as COA      
   left outer join(      
        select case when u.userpk > 0 then (p.Firstname + ' ' + p.LastName) else 'System' end as PersonName,   
        u.userpk      
        from tblusers as u       
        inner join tblpeople as p       
        on u.personfk = p.personpk      
       ) as users       
   on users.userpk = COA.UpdatedBy      
   where       
    containeroutfk = @containerOutFK2  --and COA.IsArchived = 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/   
	and (@ClientUserView2 = 0 or (@ClientUserView2=1 and coa.ContainerOutAuditTypeFK <> 5))
   
    if(@ForPrinting2 = 1)      
    BEGIN      
     SELECT [Audit Details] AS Detail, [Date], [User], [Print On Docket] AS DocketPrint, [Print On Pick List] AS PickListPrint, tco.GoodsOrderNumber      
     FROM #results      
     INNER JOIN dbo.tblContainerOuts tco ON tco.ContainerOutPK = containeroutfk      
   
     ORDER BY Cast(#results.[Date] as datetime)       
    END      
    ELSE      
    BEGIN      
     SELECT r.PK, r.ImagePath, r.IsFiltered, r.IsArchived, r.[Audit Details], r.[Date], r.[User],r.[Print On Docket], r.[Print On Pick List]  
   
           
     FROM #results r ORDER BY Cast(r.[Date] as datetime)       
    END      
    -- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end      
            
   BREAK      
  END TRY      
  BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */      
   DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;      
   SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;      
   SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;      
      
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY       
   BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;      
             
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;      
      
            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID      
                  
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;      
                  
   IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)      
   BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END      
   ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */      
  END CATCH      
  SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1      
 END      
END
GO
