CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spGvContainerOutsAll]
(
	@userFK INT,
	@PageNumber INT = 0, --i.e. page number 1
	@MaxRowsPerPage INT = 20,
	@Search NVARCHAR (MAX) = NULL,
	@SortOrder NVARCHAR (4) = 'DESC',
	@SortField NVARCHAR (20) = 'GoodsOrderNumber',
	@ShowCancelled INT = 0,
	@ShowCompleted INT = 0,
	@FromDate datetime,
	@ToDate datetime,
	@DeliveryType int = 0 --0 for all
)	
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED

	DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,
		@DeadlockErrorRetries INT, @PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT

	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; 
	SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	DECLARE @var_userFK int, @var_PageNumber int, @var_MaxRowsPerPage int, @var_Search nvarchar(MAX), @var_SortOrder NVARCHAR (4), 
		@var_SortField NVARCHAR(20), @var_ShowCancelled INT =0,@var_ShowCompleted INT =0, @var_FromDate datetime, @var_ToDate datetime, @var_DeliveryType int

		PRINT 'starting'
		PRINT (CONVERT( VARCHAR(24), dbo.GetBSTDate(), 121))

	SET @var_userFK = ISNULL(@userFK,-1)
	SET @var_PageNumber = @PageNumber +1
	SET @var_MaxRowsPerPage = @MaxRowsPerPage
	SET @var_Search = ISNULL(@Search,'')
	SET	@var_SortOrder = ISNULL(@SortOrder,'DESC')
	SET @var_SortField = ISNULL(@SortField,'GoodsOrderNumber')
	SET @var_ShowCancelled = ISNULL(@ShowCancelled,0)
	SET @var_ShowCompleted = ISNULL(@ShowCompleted,0)
	SET @var_FromDate = ISNULL(@FromDate, DATEADD(day, -7, dbo.GetBSTDate()))
	SET @var_ToDate = ISNULL(@ToDate,DATEADD(day, 7, dbo.GetBSTDate()))
	SET @var_DeliveryType = @DeliveryType

	--setup default sort
	IF @var_SortField = ''
		SET @var_SortField = 'GoodsOrderNumber'

	SELECT @var_SortField = CASE 
								WHEN @var_SortField = 'CollectionDate' THEN 'CollectionDate2'  
								WHEN @var_SortField = 'Stock Out' THEN 'GoodsOrderNumber'  
								WHEN @var_SortField = 'Building Unit' THEN 'BuildingUnit'  
								WHEN @var_SortField = 'Division' THEN 'DivisionTitle'  
								WHEN @var_SortField = 'Cust' THEN 'CustomerCode'  
								WHEN @var_SortField = 'Reference' THEN 'CustRef'  
								WHEN @var_SortField = 'Container No' THEN 'ContainerNumber'  
								WHEN @var_SortField = 'Transport Co' THEN 'TransportCompany'  
								WHEN @var_SortField = 'Seal No' THEN 'SealNumber' 
								WHEN @var_SortField = 'Address' THEN 'Address1'  
								WHEN @var_SortField = 'Status' THEN 'Stage'  
								WHEN @var_SortField = 'Exported' THEN 'FileExported'  
								WHEN @var_SortField = 'No Pallets' THEN 'PalletCount' 
								ELSE @var_SortField 
							END

	
		PRINT 'sort fields set'
		PRINT (CONVERT( VARCHAR(24), dbo.GetBSTDate(), 121))
  
	--setup search fields
	SELECT @var_Search = REPLACE (@var_Search, 'SearchField10', 'SealNumber')
	SELECT @var_Search = REPLACE (@var_Search, 'SearchField11', '[Address1]')
	SELECT @var_Search = REPLACE (@var_Search, 'SearchField12', '[Stage]')
	--SELECT @var_Search = REPLACE (@var_Search, 'SearchField12', '')
	SELECT @var_Search = REPLACE (@var_Search, 'SearchField1', 'CAST(GoodsOrderNumber AS NVARCHAR(50))')
	SELECT @var_Search = REPLACE (@var_Search, 'SearchField2', 'BuildingUnit')
	SELECT @var_Search = REPLACE (@var_Search, 'SearchField3', '[palletCount]')
	SELECT @var_Search = REPLACE (@var_Search, 'SearchField4', 'DivisionTitle')
	SELECT @var_Search = REPLACE (@var_Search, 'SearchField5', 'CustomerCode')
	SELECT @var_Search = REPLACE (@var_Search, 'SearchField6', 'CustRef')
	SELECT @var_Search = REPLACE (@var_Search, 'SearchField7', '[Collection Date]')
	SELECT @var_Search = REPLACE (@var_Search, 'SearchField8', 'ContainerNumber')
	SELECT @var_Search = REPLACE (@var_Search, 'SearchField9', 'TransportCompany')

	
		PRINT 'search fields set'
		PRINT (CONVERT( VARCHAR(24), dbo.GetBSTDate(), 121))
			
	--setup parameters
	SET @ParameterDetails = '@userFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_userFK AS NVARCHAR(20)),'') 
		+ ',@PageNumber = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_PageNumber AS NVARCHAR(20)),'')
		+ ',@MaxRowsPerPage = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_MaxRowsPerPage AS NVARCHAR(20)),'') 
		+ ',@Search = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_Search AS NVARCHAR(500)),'')
		+ ',@SortField = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_SortField AS NVARCHAR(20)),'') 
		+ ',@SortOrder = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_SortOrder AS NVARCHAR(4)),'')
		+ ',@ShowCancelled = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_ShowCancelled AS NVARCHAR(20)),'') 
		+ ',@ShowCompleted = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_ShowCompleted AS NVARCHAR(20)),'') 
		+ ',@FromDate = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_FromDate AS NVARCHAR(20)),'') 
		+ ',@ToDate = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_ToDate AS NVARCHAR(20)),'') 
		+ ',@DeliveryType = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_DeliveryType AS NVARCHAR(20)),'') 
  
	DECLARE @SQLInsertIntoTable NVARCHAR(100), @SQLSelect NVARCHAR(MAX), @SQLFrom1 NVARCHAR(MAX), @SQLFrom2 NVARCHAR(MAX), @SQLWhere NVARCHAR(MAX), @SQLOrderBy NVARCHAR(MAX), @currentSearchKeyword NVARCHAR(MAX), 
			@IsSearching BIT = 0, @RowNumber INT = 1, @StartRow INT = 1, @EndRow INT = 20, @totalRecords INT

	IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
		CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

	--IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
	--BEGIN 
		SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

		INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
		SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

		SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
	--END

	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY

			--dont filter by date on specific search fields
			DECLARE @FilterByDateRange bit = 1
			--SELECT @var_Search AS searchstring			
			if (CHARINDEX('GoodsOrderNumber',@var_Search) > 0)
				set @FilterByDateRange = 0
			if (CHARINDEX('CustRef',@var_Search) > 0)
				set @FilterByDateRange = 0
			if (CHARINDEX('[Collection Date]',@var_Search) > 0)
				set @FilterByDateRange = 0


			--get all orders into temp table
			IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#Tmp_AllStockOrders ') IS NOT NULL       
				DROP TABLE #Tmp_AllStockOrders 
			IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#Tmp_AllContainerOuts ') IS NOT NULL       
				DROP TABLE #Tmp_AllContainerOuts
			IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#Tmp_PalletCount ') IS NOT NULL       
				DROP TABLE #Tmp_PalletCount
			IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#Tmp_UserBuldings ') IS NOT NULL       
				DROP TABLE #Tmp_UserBuldings
			
			
		PRINT 'getting all stock orders'
		PRINT (CONVERT( VARCHAR(24), dbo.GetBSTDate(), 121))

			SELECT *
			INTO  #Tmp_AllStockOrders
			FROM tblStockOrders
			--WHERE inserteddate > DateAdd(yy, -1, dbo.GetBSTDate())
			WHERE inserteddate > DateAdd(month, -48, dbo.GetBSTDate())

			
		PRINT 'getting all containerouts for date range'
		PRINT (CONVERT( VARCHAR(24), dbo.GetBSTDate(), 121))

			SELECT * 
			INTO #Tmp_AllContainerOuts
			FROM tblContainerOuts co
			WHERE 
				((@FilterByDateRange = 1 and (CollectionDate > @var_FromDate AND CollectionDate < @var_ToDate)) OR @FilterByDateRange = 0)
				AND (@var_ShowCancelled = 1 or (@var_ShowCancelled = 0 and co.ContainerOutStatusFK <> 6))--show cancelled dockets?
				AND (@var_ShowCompleted = 1 or (@var_ShowCompleted = 0 and co.ContainerOutStatusFK <> 5))--show completed dockets?
				AND (@var_DeliveryType = 0 OR @var_DeliveryType = co.DeliveryTypeFK)
				and DistributionOrderFK = -1

				drop table if exists #tmpcontainerlines
				select ContainerOutFK, ContainerOutLinePK, DivisionFK
				into #tmpcontainerlines
				from tblcontaineroutLines 
				inner join #Tmp_AllContainerOuts on ContainerOutPK = containeroutfk

				
				drop table if exists #tmpstocktransfers
				select st.* into #tmpstocktransfers
				from tblStockTransfers st 				
				inner join #Tmp_AllContainerOuts on ContainerOutPK = containeroutfk

		PRINT 'getting pallet count'
		PRINT (CONVERT( VARCHAR(24), dbo.GetBSTDate(), 121))
			/*Select cvp.ContainerOutPK, count(distinct PalletFK) NoPallets, BuildingUnitFK
			INTO #Tmp_PalletCount
			from viewContainerOutPalletList cvp
			INNER JOIN #Tmp_AllContainerOuts tco ON cvp.ContainerOutPK = tco.ContainerOutPK
			group by cvp.ContainerOutPK, cvp.buildingUnitFK*/

			Select tco.ContainerOutFK as ContainerOutPK, count(distinct PalletPK) NoPallets, BuildingUnitFK
			INTO #Tmp_PalletCount
			from #tmpcontainerlines tco 
			inner join tblContainerOutLinePalletContent colpc on ContainerOutlinefK = ContainerOutLinePK
			inner join tblPallets p on colpc.palletfk = p.PalletPK
			group by tco.ContainerOutFK, p.buildingUnitFK

		PRINT 'getting user buildings'		
			SELECT distinct UserFK, BuildingUnitFK 
			INTO #Tmp_UserBuldings
			FROM tblUserBuildingUnits ubu
			INNER JOIN #Tmp_AllStockOrders so ON so.ResponsibleBuildingUnitFK = ubu.BuildingUnitFK
			WHERE ubu.UserFK = CAST(@var_UserFK AS NVARCHAR(20))	
			
		print 'linking dontainers to divisions'
		drop table if exists #containerdivs
		 Select distinct ContainerOutFK, MAX(DivisionFK) DivisionFK  
		 into #containerdivs 
		from #tmpcontainerlines 
		inner join #Tmp_AllContainerOuts on ContainerOutPK = containeroutfk
		Group By ContainerOutFK   
			
		PRINT 'creating results table'
		PRINT (CONVERT( VARCHAR(24), dbo.GetBSTDate(), 121))
			
			IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#Results') IS NOT NULL
				DROP TABLE #Results

			CREATE TABLE #Results
			(
				RowNumber INT IDENTITY(1,1),
				PK INT,
				ImagePath NVARCHAR (MAX), 
				IsFiltered INT, 
				IsArchived INT, 
				totalRecords INT,
				[Stock Out] INT, 
				[Building Unit] NVARCHAR(40), 
				[Division] NVARCHAR(max), 
				[Cust] NVARCHAR(10),
				[Type] NVARCHAR(20),
				[Reference] NVARCHAR(max),
				[Collection Date] NVARCHAR(20),
				CollectionDate2 DATETIME,
				[Container No] NVARCHAR(max),
				[Transport Co] NVARCHAR (max),
				[Seal No] NVARCHAR (max),
				Address1 NVARCHAR(max),
				[Status] NVARCHAR(MAX),
				[Stage] NVARCHAR(50),
				FileExported NVARCHAR (MAX), 
				[No Pallets] INT,
				CurrentDataSet BIT
			)				

			SET @SQLInsertIntoTable ='INSERT INTO #Results'
			SET @SQLSelect =
			'SELECT PK, 
				ImagePath, 
				IsFiltered, 
				IsArchived, 
				TotalRecords,
				GoodsOrderNumber, 
				BuildingUnit,
				DivisionTitle,
				CustomerCode, 
				DeliveryAddresstype as DeliveryType, 						
				CustRef,
				[Collection Date],
				CollectionDate2 as [$hideCol%CollectionDate2],  
				ContainerNumber,									
				TransportCompany,
				SealNumber,
				Address1,
				Status,
				Stage,	
				FileExported,
				PalletCount,									
				1 as [$hideCol%CurrentDataSet]'
								
			
			SET @SQLFrom1 = 
			'FROM ( -- Start of finalSubquery
				SELECT 
					ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY ['+CAST(@var_SortField AS NVARCHAR(20))+'] '+CAST(@var_SortOrder as NVARCHAR(4))+') AS rowNumber, *, COUNT(*) OVER () AS TotalRecords                                             
				FROM ( -- Start of subquery
					SELECT DISTINCT so.StockOrderPK AS PK, ''/images/StockOrder.png'' AS ImagePath, cast(0 as bit) AS IsFiltered, containerOuts.IsArchived, 
						CAST(containerOuts.GoodsOrderNumber AS INT) AS GoodsOrderNumber, 
						bs.BuildingName + '' - '' + bus.BuildingUnit as BuildingUnit, 						
						divisions.DivisionCode + '' '' + divisions.DivisionName as DivisionTitle, 
						custs.CustomerCode,
						DeliveryAddresstype,						
						case when cdis.CustomerDocketIdentificationPK is null then 
							case when containerOuts.Docketlabel1 <> '''' THEN 
								containerOuts.Docketlabel1 + '': '' + containerOuts.DocketValue1 else '''' end + '' '' +
							case when containerOuts.Docketlabel2 <> '''' THEN 
								containerOuts.Docketlabel2 + '': '' + containerOuts.DocketValue2 else '''' end + '' '' +
							case when containerOuts.Docketlabel3 <> '''' THEN 
								containerOuts.Docketlabel3 + '': '' + containerOuts.DocketValue3 else '''' end + '''' 
						else
							case cdis.FieldFK when 40 then
									cdis.Prefix + '' '' + containerOuts.DocketValue1
							when 41 then
									cdis.Prefix + '' '' + containerOuts.DocketValue2
							when 42 then
									cdis.Prefix + '' '' + containerOuts.DocketValue3
							end
							+ '' '' +
							case cdis.Field2FK when 40 then
									cdis.Prefix2 + '' '' + containerOuts.DocketValue1
							when 41 then
									cdis.Prefix2 + '' '' + containerOuts.DocketValue2
							when 42 then
									cdis.Prefix2 + '' '' + containerOuts.DocketValue3
							else
									''''
							end
						End as CustRef,
						CONVERT(VARCHAR(50), containerOuts.CollectionDate, 106) AS [Collection Date],
						containerOuts.CollectionDate AS CollectionDate2,
						containerOuts.ContainerNumber,
						TransportCompany,
						SealNumber,
						containerOuts.Address1 + '' '' + containerOuts.TelephoneNumber + case when st.stocktransferpk is null then '''' else  '' (Transfer) '' end as Address1,
						-- status.ContainerOutStatus as ''Status'', --Pritesh
						 case when  containerOuts.ContainerOutStatusFK = 0 then ''Customer Pending'' else status.ContainerOutStatus end as Status,
						  case when containerOuts.ContainerOutStatusFK = 6 then ''Cancelled'' when containerOuts.ContainerOutStatusFK = 5 then ''Completed'' 
						  when  containerOuts.ContainerOutStatusFK = 0 then ''Customer Pending'' else stage.ContainerOutStage end as Stage, ----Pritesh 
						case when so.PickLoaded = 1 then ''$imgExported.png'' else '' '' end as FileExported,
						colpc.NoPallets as PalletCount'
					SET @SQLFrom2 = 
			'	FROM #Tmp_AllContainerOuts AS containerOuts
			left join #tmpstocktransfers ST on ST.containeroutfk = containeroutpk
					INNER JOIN #Tmp_AllStockOrders so on containerOuts.ContainerOutPK = so.ContainerOutFK
					INNER JOIN appContainerOutStatus AS status on status.ContainerOutStatusPK = containerOuts.ContainerOutStatusFK	
					 LEFT JOIN appContainerOutStage AS stage on stage.ContainerOutStagePK = containerOuts.ContainerOutStageFK											
					INNER JOIN dbo.appDeliveryAddressTypes adat ON containerOuts.DeliveryTypeFK = adat.DeliveryAddressTypePK
					INNER JOIN #containerdivs AS cols on cols.ContainerOutFK = containerOuts.ContainerOutPK	
					inner join #Tmp_PalletCount AS colpc on containerOuts.ContainerOutPK = colpc.ContainerOutPK and colpc.BuildingUnitFK = so.ResponsibleBuildingUnitFK
					--inner join (
					--	Select ContainerOutPK, count(distinct PalletFK) NoPallets, BuildingUnitFK
					--	from viewContainerOutPalletList
					--	group by ContainerOutPK, buildingUnitFK
					--) as colpc on containerOuts.ContainerOutPK = colpc.ContainerOutPK and colpc.BuildingUnitFK = so.ResponsibleBuildingUnitFK
					left outer join tblTransportCompanies transportCompanies on transportCompanies.TransportCompanyPK = containerOuts.TransportCompanyFK  
					left outer join tblShippingCompanies shippingCompanies on shippingCompanies.ShippingCompanyPK = containerOuts.ShippingCompanyFK
					INNER JOIN tblDivisions divisions on divisions.DivisionPK = cols.DivisionFK
					INNER JOIN tblCustomers custs on custs.CustomerPK = divisions.CustomerFK
					left outer join tblCustomerDocketIdentifications cdis on cdis.CustomerFK = divisions.CustomerFK AND cdis.DocketTypeFK = 2 /*ContainerOut*/
					INNER JOIN tblBuildingUnits bus on bus.BuildingUnitPK = so.ResponsibleBuildingUnitFK
					--INNER JOIN (
					--	SELECT UserFK, BuildingUnitFK FROM tblUserBuildingUnits ) AS uBus ON uBus.BuildingUnitFK IN (
					--		SELECT ResponsibleBuildingUnitFK FROM #Tmp_AllStockOrders WHERE containeroutfk = containerOuts.ContainerOutPK AND uBus.UserFK = '+CAST(@var_UserFK AS NVARCHAR(20))+'
					--)
					INNER JOIN #Tmp_UserBuldings uBus ON uBus.BuildingUnitFK = bus.BuildingUnitPK					
					left outer join tblBuildings bs on bs.BuildingPK = bus.BuildingFK
				) AS subquery
		) AS finalSubquery '

			IF @var_Search <> ''
			BEGIN
				SET @SQLWHERE = ' WHERE '
				SET @SQLWHERE += @var_Search/*+' AND '*/
			END

			IF ISNULL(@var_SortField,'') <> '' AND ISNULL(@var_SortOrder,'') <> ''
			BEGIN
				SET @SQLOrderBy = ' ORDER BY [' + @var_SortField + '] '+' '+ @var_SortOrder
			END

			DECLARE @MaxRowNumber INT
			SELECT @MaxRowNumber = MAX(RowNumber) FROM #Results
		
			PRINT 'out here'
			PRINT @SQLInsertIntoTable 
			print @SQLSelect 
			print @SQLFrom1 
			print @SQLFrom2 
			print @SQLWhere 
			print @SQLOrderBy

			PRINT 'PREPARING TO INSERT into results'
		PRINT (CONVERT( VARCHAR(24), dbo.GetBSTDate(), 121))
			EXEC(@SQLInsertIntoTable + ' '+ @SQLSelect + ' ' + @SQLFrom1 + ' '+ @SQLFrom2 + ' '+ @SQLWhere + ' '+ @SQLOrderBy)
			PRINT 'inserted into results'
		PRINT (CONVERT( VARCHAR(24), dbo.GetBSTDate(), 121))

			UPDATE #Results WITH (ROWLOCK)
			SET CurrentDataSet = 0
			WHERE RowNumber <= @MaxRowNumber	

			SELECT @totalRecords = COUNT(*) 
			FROM #Results WHERE CurrentDataSet = 1
			
			--Calculate start and end records
			--IF @IsSearching = 1
			--BEGIN
			if(@var_PageNumber > 0)
			BEGIN
				SELECT @EndRow = (@var_PageNumber * @var_MaxRowsPerPage) + (SELECT MIN(RowNumber) FROM #Results WHERE CurrentDataSet = 1) - 1
				SELECT @StartRow = @EndRow - @var_MaxRowsPerPage + 1
			END
				
				-- Return the final records to the gridview.
				SELECT PK as [PK], ImagePath, IsFiltered as [IsFiltered], IsArchived as [IsArchived], @totalRecords AS [TotalRecords], 
					[Stock Out], [Building Unit], [No Pallets],[Division], [Cust], /*[Type],*/ [Reference], [Collection Date], CollectionDate2 as [$hideCol%CollectionDate2],
					[Container No],[Transport Co], [Seal No], Address1 as [Address], /*[Status]*/ [Stage] AS [Status], FileExported AS [Exported], 1 as [$hideCol%CurrentDataSet]	
				FROM  #Results AS SR
				WHERE SR.CurrentDataSet = 1
						AND (@var_PageNumber <= 0 or SR.RowNumber BETWEEN @StartRow AND @EndRow)
				ORDER BY SR.RowNumber ASC 
				PRINT 'done'
		PRINT (CONVERT( VARCHAR(24), dbo.GetBSTDate(), 121))
				RETURN
			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end			
			--end		
			--BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END
GO

	Select cvp.ContainerOutPK, count(distinct PalletFK) NoPallets, BuildingUnitFK

			SET @SQLFrom1 = 
			'FROM ( -- Start of finalSubquery

						bs.BuildingName + '' - '' + bus.BuildingUnit as BuildingUnit, 						
						divisions.DivisionCode + '' '' + divisions.DivisionName as DivisionTitle, 
						custs.CustomerCode,
						DeliveryAddresstype,						
						case when cdis.CustomerDocketIdentificationPK is null then 
							case when containerOuts.Docketlabel1 <> '''' THEN 
								containerOuts.Docketlabel1 + '': '' + containerOuts.DocketValue1 else '''' end + '' '' +
							case when containerOuts.Docketlabel2 <> '''' THEN 
								containerOuts.Docketlabel2 + '': '' + containerOuts.DocketValue2 else '''' end + '' '' +
							case when containerOuts.Docketlabel3 <> '''' THEN 
								containerOuts.Docketlabel3 + '': '' + containerOuts.DocketValue3 else '''' end + '''' 
						else
							case cdis.FieldFK when 40 then
									cdis.Prefix + '' '' + containerOuts.DocketValue1
							when 41 then
									cdis.Prefix + '' '' + containerOuts.DocketValue2
							when 42 then
									cdis.Prefix + '' '' + containerOuts.DocketValue3
							end
							+ '' '' +
							case cdis.Field2FK when 40 then
									cdis.Prefix2 + '' '' + containerOuts.DocketValue1
							when 41 then
									cdis.Prefix2 + '' '' + containerOuts.DocketValue2
							when 42 then
									cdis.Prefix2 + '' '' + containerOuts.DocketValue3
							else
									''''
							end
						End as CustRef,
						CONVERT(VARCHAR(50), containerOuts.CollectionDate, 106) AS [Collection Date],
						containerOuts.CollectionDate AS CollectionDate2,
						containerOuts.ContainerNumber,
						TransportCompany,
						SealNumber,
						containerOuts.Address1 + '' '' + containerOuts.TelephoneNumber as Address1,
						status.ContainerOutStatus as ''Status'',
						case when containerOuts.ContainerOutStatusFK = 6 then ''Cancelled'' when containerOuts.ContainerOutStatusFK = 5 then ''Completed'' else stage.ContainerOutStage end as Stage,
						case when so.PickLoaded = 1 then ''$imgExported.png'' else '' '' end as FileExported,
						colpc.NoPallets as PalletCount'
					SET @SQLFrom2 = 
			'	FROM #Tmp_AllContainerOuts AS containerOuts
					INNER JOIN #Tmp_AllStockOrders so on containerOuts.ContainerOutPK = so.ContainerOutFK
					INNER JOIN appContainerOutStatus AS status on status.ContainerOutStatusPK = containerOuts.ContainerOutStatusFK	
					 LEFT JOIN appContainerOutStage AS stage on stage.ContainerOutStagePK = containerOuts.ContainerOutStageFK											
					INNER JOIN dbo.appDeliveryAddressTypes adat ON containerOuts.DeliveryTypeFK = adat.DeliveryAddressTypePK
					INNER JOIN #containerdivs AS cols on cols.ContainerOutFK = containerOuts.ContainerOutPK	
					inner join #Tmp_PalletCount AS colpc on containerOuts.ContainerOutPK = colpc.ContainerOutPK and colpc.BuildingUnitFK = so.ResponsibleBuildingUnitFK
					--inner join (
					--	Select ContainerOutPK, count(distinct PalletFK) NoPallets, BuildingUnitFK
					--	from viewContainerOutPalletList
					--	group by ContainerOutPK, buildingUnitFK
					--) as colpc on containerOuts.ContainerOutPK = colpc.ContainerOutPK and colpc.BuildingUnitFK = so.ResponsibleBuildingUnitFK
					left outer join tblTransportCompanies transportCompanies on transportCompanies.TransportCompanyPK = containerOuts.TransportCompanyFK  
					left outer join tblShippingCompanies shippingCompanies on shippingCompanies.ShippingCompanyPK = containerOuts.ShippingCompanyFK
					INNER JOIN tblDivisions divisions on divisions.DivisionPK = cols.DivisionFK
					INNER JOIN tblCustomers custs on custs.CustomerPK = divisions.CustomerFK
					left outer join tblCustomerDocketIdentifications cdis on cdis.CustomerFK = divisions.CustomerFK AND cdis.DocketTypeFK = 2 /*ContainerOut*/
					INNER JOIN tblBuildingUnits bus on bus.BuildingUnitPK = so.ResponsibleBuildingUnitFK
					--INNER JOIN (
					--	SELECT UserFK, BuildingUnitFK FROM tblUserBuildingUnits ) AS uBus ON uBus.BuildingUnitFK IN (
					--		SELECT ResponsibleBuildingUnitFK FROM #Tmp_AllStockOrders WHERE containeroutfk = containerOuts.ContainerOutPK AND uBus.UserFK = '+CAST(@var_UserFK AS NVARCHAR(20))+'
					--)
					INNER JOIN #Tmp_UserBuldings uBus ON uBus.BuildingUnitFK = bus.BuildingUnitPK					
					left outer join tblBuildings bs on bs.BuildingPK = bus.BuildingFK
				) AS subquery
		) AS finalSubquery '

			IF @var_endserach <> ''
			BEGIN
				SET @SQLWHERE = ' WHERE '
				SET @SQLWHERE += @var_endserach/*+' AND '*/
			END

			IF ISNULL(@var_SortField,'') <> '' AND ISNULL(@var_SortOrder,'') <> ''
			BEGIN
				SET @SQLOrderBy = ' ORDER BY [' + @var_SortField + '] '+' '+ @var_SortOrder
			END

			DECLARE @MaxRowNumber INT
			SELECT @MaxRowNumber = MAX(RowNumber) FROM #Results
		
			PRINT 'out here'
			PRINT @SQLInsertIntoTable 
			print @SQLSelect 
			print @SQLFrom1 
			print @SQLFrom2 
			print @SQLWhere 
			print @SQLOrderBy

			PRINT 'PREPARING TO INSERT into results'
		PRINT (CONVERT( VARCHAR(24), dbo.GetBSTDate(), 121))
			EXEC(@SQLInsertIntoTable + ' '+ @SQLSelect + ' ' + @SQLFrom1 + ' '+ @SQLFrom2 + ' '+ @SQLWhere + ' '+ @SQLOrderBy)
			PRINT 'inserted into results'
		PRINT (CONVERT( VARCHAR(24), dbo.GetBSTDate(), 121))

			UPDATE #Results WITH (ROWLOCK)
			SET CurrentDataSet = 0
			WHERE RowNumber <= @MaxRowNumber	

			SELECT @totalRecords = COUNT(*) 
			FROM #Results WHERE CurrentDataSet = 1
			
			--Calculate start and end records
			--IF @IsSearching = 1
			--BEGIN
			if(@var_PageNumber > 0)
			BEGIN
				SELECT @EndRow = (@var_PageNumber * @var_MaxRowsPerPage) + (SELECT MIN(RowNumber) FROM #Results WHERE CurrentDataSet = 1) - 1
				SELECT @StartRow = @EndRow - @var_MaxRowsPerPage + 1
			END
				
				-- Return the final records to the gridview.
				SELECT PK as [PK], ImagePath, IsFiltered as [IsFiltered], IsArchived as [IsArchived], @totalRecords AS [TotalRecords], 
					[Stock Out], [Building Unit], [No Pallets],[Division], [Cust], /*[Type],*/ [Reference], [Collection Date], CollectionDate2 as [$hideCol%CollectionDate2],
					[Container No],[Transport Co], [Seal No], Address1 as [Address], /*[Status]*/ [Stage] AS [Status], FileExported AS [Exported], 1 as [$hideCol%CurrentDataSet]	
				FROM  #Results AS SR
				WHERE SR.CurrentDataSet = 1
						AND (@var_PageNumber <= 0 or SR.RowNumber BETWEEN @StartRow AND @EndRow)
				ORDER BY SR.RowNumber ASC 
				PRINT 'done'



		PRINT (CONVERT( VARCHAR(24), dbo.GetBSTDate(), 121))
				RETURN
			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end			
			--end		
			--BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spGvContainerOutsForSchedule] 
(
	@BuildingFK INT 
	)
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,
	@DeadlockErrorRetries INT, @PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT,
	@startRecord INT = 1,@totalRecords INT, @endRecord INT, @NoResultsFound INT

	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();


	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	DECLARE @var_BuildingFK int

	SET @var_BuildingFK = ISNULL(@BuildingFK,-1)

	
	SET @ParameterDetails = '@BuildingFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_BuildingFK AS NVARCHAR(20)),'')

	IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    --BEGIN 
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END

	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY

		
			select distinct Containeroutpk as IdentifierPK,  'ContainerOut' as Type, cast(co.GoodsOrderNumber as nvarchar(50)) GoodsOrderNumber,/* sup.Supplier,*/ div.DivisionCode, coalesce(lb.LoadingBay, 'Unassigned') LoadingBay, cast(co.CollectionDate as Date) CollectionDate,
				case when cdis.CustomerDocketIdentificationPK is null then 
					case when co.Docketlabel1 <> '' THEN 
						co.DocketValue1 else '' end + ' ' +
					case when co.Docketlabel2 <> '''' THEN 
						co.DocketValue2 else '' end + ' ' +
					case when co.Docketlabel3 <> '' THEN 
						co.DocketValue3 else '' end + '' 
				else
					case cdis.FieldFK when 40 then
							co.DocketValue1
					when 41 then
							co.DocketValue2
					when 42 then
							co.DocketValue3
					end
					+ ' ' +
					case cdis.Field2FK when 40 then
							co.DocketValue1
					when 41 then
							co.DocketValue2
					when 42 then
							co.DocketValue3
					else ''
					end
				End as CustRef
			from tblContainerOuts co
			inner join tblContainerOutLines col on ContainerOutFK = ContainerOutPK
			inner join tblStockOrders so on co.ContainerOutPK = so.ContainerOutFK
			inner join tblBuildingUnits bu on so.ResponsibleBuildingUnitFK = bu.BuildingUnitPK
			inner join tblDivisions div on div.DivisionPK = col.DivisionFK
			left join tblScheduleDeliveries sd on sd.ContainerOutFK = co.ContainerOutPK
			left join tblloadingbays lb on so.PickupLoadingBayFK = lb.LoadingBayPK
			left outer join tblCustomerDocketIdentifications as cdis on cdis.CustomerFK = div.CustomerFK AND cdis.DocketTypeFK = 2
			where bu.buildingfk = @var_BuildingFK
				and co.ContainerOutStatusFK < 5
				and (sd.ContainerOutFK is null or not exists (select * from tblScheduleDeliveries sd2 where sd2.ContaineroutFK = sd.ContainerOutFK and sd2.IsArchived = 0))
				and co.DistributionOrderFK = -1


			
			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end			
						
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1

-- =============================================  
-- Author:  <Jamie Clerkin>  
-- Create date: <19/07/2016>  
-- Description: <Get all completed stock ins that contain stock for list of given stock items, where stock is still present in warehouse>  
-- =============================================  
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spGvContainerOutsNotTransfered]  
(  
   @DivisionFk int,  
   @StockItems nvarchar(50)  
)  
AS  
BEGIN  
 /* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */  
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED  
  
    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT  
 ,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;  
 SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();  
  
 -- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters  
 DECLARE @DivisionFk2 int, @StockItems2 nvarchar(50)  
  
 SET @DivisionFk2 = @DivisionFk; SET @StockItems2 = @StockItems  
  
 SET @ParameterDetails = '@DivisionFk = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@DivisionFk2 AS NVARCHAR(20)),'') + ',@StockItems = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@StockItems2 AS NVARCHAR(20)),'')  
  
    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL   
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)  
  
    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)  
    --BEGIN  
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC   
  
  SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)  
  
        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)  
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK  
  
        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()  
    --END  
  
  
 SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);  
 SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails  
 ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;  
 INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()  
  
 WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3  
 BEGIN   
  BEGIN TRY  
     
  
   -- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start  
  
    select * from (  
    SELECT Distinct ContainerOutPK AS PK, '/images/StockIn.png' AS ImagePath, cast(0 as bit) AS IsFiltered, containerOuts.IsArchived,   
    containerOuts.GoodsOrderNumber, CONVERT(VARCHAR(50), containerOuts.CollectionDate, 106) [Date],   
 CASE 
    WHEN cdis.CustomerDocketIdentificationPK IS NULL 
         OR divs.Integrated = 0
    THEN
        CASE 
            WHEN containerOuts.DocketLabel1 IS NOT NULL 
                THEN containerOuts.DocketLabel1 + ' ' + containerOuts.DocketValue1
            
            WHEN containerOuts.DocketLabel2 IS NOT NULL 
                THEN containerOuts.DocketLabel2 + ' ' + containerOuts.DocketValue2
            
            WHEN containerOuts.DocketLabel3 IS NOT NULL 
                THEN containerOuts.DocketLabel3 + ' ' + containerOuts.DocketValue3
            
            ELSE ''
        END
    ELSE   case cdis.FieldFK when 1 then  
      cdis.Prefix + ' ' + containerOuts.Free1  
     when 2 then  
      cdis.Prefix + ' ' + containerOuts.Free2  
     when 3 then  
      cdis.Prefix + ' ' + containerOuts.Free3  
     end  
     + ' ' +  
     case cdis.Field2FK when 1 then  
      cdis.Prefix2 + ' ' + containerOuts.Free1  
     when 2 then  
      cdis.Prefix2 + ' ' + containerOuts.Free2  
     when 3 then  
      cdis.Prefix2 + ' ' + containerOuts.Free3  
     else   
      ''  
     end  
END AS Reference,
	 STUFF((SELECT distinct ',' +  s1.StockItemCode  
          FROM tblstockitems s1 inner join tblContainerOutLines si on s1.StockItemPK= si.StockItemFK  
   inner join tblStockOrders sins on sins.ContainerOutFK=si.ContainerOutFK  
   inner join tblContainerOuts ci on ci.ContainerOutPK = sins.ContainerOutFK  
        WHERE ci.GoodsOrderNumber=containerOuts.GoodsOrderNumber  
            FOR XML PATH(''), TYPE  
            ).value('.', 'NVARCHAR(MAX)')  
        ,1,1,'') 'Stock Code'  
  
    FROM dbo.tblContainerOuts containerOuts  
    inner join tblContainerOutLines col on col.ContainerOutFK = containerOuts.ContainerOutPK  

    inner join tblstockitems s on col.stockitemfk = s.stockitempk  
    inner join tblDivisions divs on divs.DivisionPK = col.DivisionFK  
    left outer join tblCustomerDocketIdentifications cdis on cdis.CustomerFK = divs.CustomerFK AND cdis.DocketTypeFK = 2 /*ContainerOut*/  
    left join dbo.fnSplitStringToArray(@StockItems2, ',') stockitemfilter on stockitemfilter.element = s.stockitemcode  
  
    where col.DivisionFK = @DivisionFk2 and containerOuts.ContainerOutStatusFK in(1,2,3) --and pc.isarchived = 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/   
        and s.stockitemcode in (case when @StockItems2 <> '' then stockitemfilter.element else s.stockitemcode end))subq  
     

   order by subq.Date asc  
  
    
  
   -- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end  
  
     
     
   BREAK  
  END TRY  
  BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */  
   DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;  
   SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;  
   SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;  
  
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY   
   BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;  
         
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;  
  
            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID  
              
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;  
              
   IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)  
   BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END  
   ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */  
  END CATCH  
  SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1  
 END  
END  
GO

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END


	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY
			

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start

			SELECT Distinct CreditNotePK AS PK, '/images/creditnote.png' AS ImagePath, creditNotes.IsArchived, cast(0 as bit) AS IsFiltered, 
			CustomerName as [Customer Name],
			DivisionName as [Division Name], CreditNoteNumber as [Credit Note Number], convert(varchar(50), creditNotes.CreditToDate, 103) as [Date], creditNotes.CreditNoteValue as [Value], creditNotes.Tax, creditNotes.CreditNoteValue + creditNotes.Tax [Total],
			case when creditNotes.Approved = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/
			then '$imgInvoiceApproved.png' else '' End Approved,
			case when creditNotes.Posted = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/
			then '$imgInvoicePosted.png' else '' End as Posted,
			case when creditNotes.Emailed = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/
			then '$imgInvoiceEmailed.png' else '' End as Emailed,
			case when creditNotes.QueuedForExport = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/
			then '$imgInvoiceQueuedForExport.png' else '' End as [Queued For Export],
			case when creditNotes.Exported = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/
			then '$imgInvoiceExported.png' else '' End as Exported	
			FROM         dbo.tblCreditNotes creditNotes
			left outer join tblDivisions divisions on
			divisions.DivisionPK = creditNotes.DivisionFK
			left outer join tblCustomers customers on
			customers.CustomerPK = creditNotes.CustomerFK			
			ORDER BY CreditNotePK DESC

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end

			
			
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END

(
	@cycleCountFK int
)	
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT

	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	DECLARE @cycleCountFK2 int

	SET @cycleCountFK2 = @cycleCountFK

	SET @ParameterDetails = '@cycleCountFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@cycleCountFK2 AS NVARCHAR(20)),'')

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY
			

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start

			SELECT CycleCountResultPK AS PK, '/images/cycleCount22.png' AS ImagePath, ccrs.IsArchived, cast(0 as bit) AS IsFiltered, 
			isnull(cclps.Location, ccls.Location) Location, 
			isnull(sis.StockItemCode, 'EMPTY') StockItem,
			isnull(sis.Description, 'EMPTY') Description,
			isnull(cclps.Batch, 'EMPTY') Batch,
			case cclps.QuantityCheck when 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ then '$txtHello' when 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/ then cast(cclps.Quantity as nvarchar(100)) when null then null end as Quantity
			From tblCycleCountResults ccrs 
			inner join tblCycleCountLocations ccls on
			ccls.CycleCountLocationPK = ccrs.CycleCountLocationFK
			inner join tblCycleCounts ccs on
			ccs.CycleCountPK = ccls.CycleCountFK	
			left outer join tblCycleCountLocationPallets cclps on
			cclps.CycleCountLocationPalletPK = ccrs.CycleCountLocationPalletFK
			left outer join tblStockItems sis on
			sis.StockItemPK = cclps.StockItemFK
			Where ccs.CycleCountPK = @cycleCountFK2
			AND ccrs.Processed = 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/
			Order by isnull(cclps.Location, ccls.Location)

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end

			
			
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spGvDailyInventoryOpenDockets]

)

BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT
 ,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;

	DECLARE @DivisionPK2 int

	SET @DivisionPK2 = @DivisionPK

	SET @ParameterDetails = '@DivisionPK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@DivisionPK2 AS NVARCHAR(20)),'')

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY
			

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start

			SELECT DISTINCT FORMAT (di.InsertedDate, 'MMM dd yyyy') as DateIn, StockInFK as StockInPK, di.ContainerOutFK as ContainerOutPK, isnull(ci.GoodsInNumber, '&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;') AS GoodsInNumber, isnull(co.GoodsOrderNumber, ' ') AS GoodsOrderNumber
			FROM tblDailyInventory di		
			left join tblStockIns si ON si.StockInPK = di.StockInFK
			left JOIN tblcontainerins ci ON si.ContainerInFk = ci.ContainerInPK 			
			left join tblcontainerouts co ON di.containeroutfk = co.containeroutpk 	
			where di.DayComplete = 0 and di.divisionfk = @DivisionPK2
			ORDER by StockInFK, ContainerOutPK

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end

			
			
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH

    --BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

		SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END


	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY
			

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start

			SELECT     StockInDamagePK AS PK, '/images/PalletDamage.png' AS ImagePath, cast(0 as bit) AS IsFiltered, sids.IsArchived, 
			sis.StockItemCode,
			pc.Batch,
			pc.ActualUnits,
			palletStatus.PalletStatus
			FROM         tblStockInDamages sids
			inner join tblPalletContent pc on
			pc.PalletContentPK = sids.PalletContentFK
			inner join tblStockItems sis on
			sis.StockItemPK = pc.StockItemFK   
			inner join appPalletStatus palletStatus on
			palletStatus.PalletStatusPK = sids.PalletStatusFK

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end

			
			
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spGvDeliveryAddresses]      
(      
 @IncludeArchived BIT = 0      
)      
AS      
BEGIN      
 /* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */      
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED      
      
    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT      
 ,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;      
 SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();; SET @ParameterDetails = ''      
      
 DECLARE @var_IncludeArchivedUsers BIT; SET @var_IncludeArchivedUsers = ISNULL(@IncludeArchived,0)      
      
 SET @ParameterDetails = '@IncludeArchived = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@IncludeArchived AS NVARCHAR(10)),'')      
      
    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL       
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)      
      
    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)      
    --BEGIN      
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC       
      
  SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)      
      
        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)      
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK      
      
        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()      
    --END      
      
 SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);      
 SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails      
 ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;      
 INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()       
      
 WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3      
 BEGIN       
  BEGIN TRY      
      
   DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #tmpUsersList      
      
  SELECT       
 das.DeliveryAddressPK AS PK, '/images/DeliveryAddress.png' AS ImagePath, 0 as IsArchived, 0 AS IsFiltered, das.Address1 [Address Line 1], das.Address2 [Address Line 2], das.Address3 [Address Line 3],       
 das.Address4 [Address Line 4], das.Address5 [Address Line 5], CASE WHEN countries.countrypk IS NULL THEN '' ELSE countries.Country END AS Country, DeliveryAddressType as [Type], das.TelephoneNumber, ISNULL(CustomerName, '') [Assigned Customer],das.IsArchived as Archived      
   INTO #tmpUsersList      
   FROM              
   dbo.tblDeliveryAddresses AS das       
LEFT OUTER JOIN       
 dbo.tblCountries AS countries ON countries.CountryPK = das.CountryFK      
INNER JOIN       
 appDeliveryAddressTypes on deliveryaddresstypefk = deliveryaddresstypepk      
LEFT JOIN      
 tblCustomers on CustomerFK = CustomerPK      
   WHERE      
    @var_IncludeArchivedUsers = 1 OR (@var_IncludeArchivedUsers = 0 and das.IsArchived = 0)      
     
      
   if(@var_IncludeArchivedUsers = 1)      
   BEGIN      
    SELECT * FROM #tmpUsersList      
   END      
   ELSE      
   BEGIN      
   SELECT PK, ImagePath, IsArchived, IsFiltered,  [Address Line 1],  [Address Line 2],  [Address Line 3],  [Address Line 4], [Address Line 5], Country, [Type], [TelephoneNumber], [Assigned Customer] FROM #tmpUsersList      
   END      
      
      
   -- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end      
            
   BREAK      
  END TRY      
  BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */      
   DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;      
   SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;      
   SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;      
      
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY       
   BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;      
             
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;      
      
            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID      
                  
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;      
                  
   IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)      
   BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END      
   ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */      
  END CATCH      
  SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1      
 END      
END

PRINT '@EndRow = ' +cast(isnull(@EndRow, 0) AS NVARCHAR(50))
			SELECT
				PK,
				ImagePath, 
				IsFiltered, 
				IsArchived,
				@totalRecords as totalRecords,
				[Created Date],
				[Stock Code],
				Batch,
				Barcode,
				[Pallet Number],
				[Discrepency Type],
				[Reported] as [$NoSearch%Reported],
				[Reported Date],
				[Reconcile Started] as [$NoSearch%Reconcile Started],
				[Reconcile Started Date],
				[Reconcile Completed] as [$NoSearch%Reconcile Completed],
				[Reconcile Complete Date],
				[Docket Number],
				Division,
				CreatedDate2 as [$hideCol%CreatedDate2],
				ReportDate2 as [$hideCol%ReportDate2],
				StartedDate2 as [$hideCol%StartedDate2] ,
				CompleteDate2 as [$hideCol%CompleteDate2],
				1 as [$hideCol%CurrentDataSet]
				FROM
				#Results as SR
					WHERE SR.CurrentDataSet = 1
					AND SR.RowNumber BETWEEN @StartRow AND @EndRow
					ORDER BY 
						SR.RowNumber ASC
			END 
			PRINT'HERE'
			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end

			
			
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start

			SELECT StockItemPK AS PK, '/images/stockitem.png' AS ImagePath, sis.IsArchived, cast(0 as bit) AS IsFiltered, 
			sis.StockItemCode, 
			sis.Description,
			isnull(cast(sum(stockLevels.AvailableUnits) as int), 0) [Available Units],
			case when sis.BundlesOf = 0 then '$hideCell=1' else '$hideCell=0%' + cast(sis.BundlesOf as nvarchar(50)) end as [$hideCol%Pack Quantity],
			case when sis.MaximumUnitsOrder = -1 then '$hideCell=1' else '$hideCell=0%' + cast(sis.MaximumUnitsOrder as nvarchar(50)) end as [$hideCol%Max Order],

			FROM         dbo.tblStockItems sis

			left outer join tblEachesTypes eachesTypes on
			eachesTypes.EachesTypePK = sis.EachesTypeFK
			left outer join tblUnitTypes unitTypes on
			unitTypes.UnitTypePK = sis.UnitTypeFK
			where sis.StockItemCategoryFK = @categoryFK2
			AND sis.IsArchived = 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/
			Group by StockItemPK, sis.IsArchived, sis.StockItemCode, sis.Description, sis.ProductLink, sis.BundlesOf, sis.MaximumUnitsOrder
			order by sis.StockItemCode

			BREAK
		END TRY

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spGvDistributionOrderCategoryStockForEdit]
(
	@containerOutFK int,
	@categoryFK int
)	
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT

	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	DECLARE @containerOutFK2 int, @categoryFK2 int

	SET @containerOutFK2 = @containerOutFK; SET @categoryFK2 = @categoryFK

	SET @ParameterDetails = '@containerOutFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@containerOutFK2 AS NVARCHAR(20)),'') + ',@categoryFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@categoryFK2 AS NVARCHAR(20)),'')

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    --BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

		SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END


	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY
			

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start

			SELECT StockItemPK AS PK, '/images/stockitem.png' AS ImagePath, sis.IsArchived, cast(0 as bit) AS IsFiltered, 
			sis.StockItemCode, 
			sis.Description,
			isnull(cast(sum(stockLevels.AvailableUnits) as int), 0) [Available Units],
			case when (sum(stockLevels.AvailableUnits) is null or sum(stockLevels.AvailableUnits)=0) AND cols.Units is null then '$txt%disUnits%val=' 
			+ isnull(cast(cols.Units as nvarchar(50)), '') + '%' + cast(sis.StockItemPK as nvarchar(50)) + 'Units' else '$txt%lmt=' 
			+ case when isnull(cols.Units, 0) > 0 then cast(sum(isnull(stockLevels.AvailableUnits, 0)) + cols.Units as nvarchar(50)) 
			else cast(sum(isnull(stockLevels.AvailableUnits, 0)) as nvarchar(50)) end + '%val=' + isnull(cast(cols.Units as nvarchar(50)), '') 
			+ '%' + cast(sis.StockItemPK as nvarchar(50)) + 'Units' end as [Order Units],
			case when (sum(stockLevels.AvailableUnits) is null or sum(stockLevels.AvailableUnits)=0) AND cols.Units is null then '$disRow=1' 
			else '$disRow=0' end as [$DisableRow]
			FROM         dbo.tblStockItems sis
			left outer join tblStockLevels stockLevels on
			stockLevels.StockItemFK = sis.StockItemPK
			left outer join tblEachesTypes eachesTypes on
			eachesTypes.EachesTypePK = sis.EachesTypeFK
			left outer join tblUnitTypes unitTypes on
			unitTypes.UnitTypePK = sis.UnitTypeFK
			left outer join tblContainerOutLines cols on
			cols.StockItemFK = sis.StockItemPK
			AND cols.ContainerOutFK = @containerOutFK2
			where sis.StockItemCategoryFK = @categoryFK2
			AND sis.IsArchived = 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/
			Group by StockItemPK, sis.IsArchived, sis.StockItemCode, sis.Description, cols.Units
			order by sis.StockItemCode

			BREAK

			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END
