CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spGvDistributionOrders]      
(      
 @customerFK int,      
 @userFK int,      
 @FromDate date = '19000101',      
 @ToDate date = '19000101',      
 @SearchString nvarchar(max),      
 @OrderStatus int      
)       
AS      
BEGIN      
 /* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */      
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED      
      
    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT      
 ,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;      
 SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();      
      
 -- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters      
 DECLARE @customerFK2 int, @userFK2 int, @OrderStatus2 int, @FromDate2 date, @ToDate2 date, @SearchString2 nvarchar(max)      
      
 SET @customerFK2 = @customerFK; SET @userFK2 = @userFK; SET @OrderStatus2 = @OrderStatus; SET @FromDate2 = @FromDate; SET @ToDate2 = @ToDate; SET @SearchString2 = '%' + @SearchString + '%'      
       
 SET @ParameterDetails = '@customerFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@customerFK2 AS NVARCHAR(20)),'') + ',@userFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@userFK2 AS NVARCHAR(20)),'')      
  + ',@FromDate = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@FromDate2 AS NVARCHAR(20)),'') + ',@FromDate = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@FromDate2 AS NVARCHAR(20)),'')      
  + ',@ToDate = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@ToDate2 AS NVARCHAR(20)),'')      
  + ',@SearchString = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@SearchString2 AS NVARCHAR(20)),'')      
        
 if(@FromDate2 > '19000101')      
 begin      
  SET @FromDate2 = dateadd(d, -1, @FromDate2); SET @ToDate2 = DATEADD(d, 1, @ToDate)      
 end      
      
    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL       
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)      
      
    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)      
    --BEGIN      
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC       
      
  SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)      
      
        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)      
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK      
      
        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()      
    --END      
      
      
 SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);      
 SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails      
 ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;      
 INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()      
      
 WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3      
 BEGIN       
  BEGIN TRY      
         
      
   -- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start      
   drop table if exists #tmpDistributionOrders      
   select DistributionOrderPK, containeroutpk, containeroutlinepk, stockitemcode, cols.Units, do.Orderreference, do.orderdate, divisioncode, dos.DistributionOrderStatus, dos.DistributionOrderStatusPK,      
   contOuts.Address1 + ', ' + contOuts.Address2 + ', ' + contOuts.Address3 as DeliveryAddress, DistributionDeliveryMethod, cust.EnableDistributionOverdueAlert, DeliveryReference      
   into #tmpDistributionOrders      
   FROM tblDistributionOrders do      
   inner join tblContainerOuts contOuts on contOuts.DistributionOrderFK = do.DistributionOrderPK      
   inner join tblContainerOutLines cols on cols.ContainerOutFK = contOuts.ContainerOutPK       
   inner join tblDivisions divisions on divisions.DivisionPK = cols.DivisionFK      
   inner join tblcustomers cust on divisions.customerfk = cust.customerpk      
   inner join tblStockItems stockItems on stockItems.StockItemPK = cols.StockItemFK      
   inner join appDistributionOrderStatus dos on do.OrderStatusFK = dos.DistributionOrderStatusPK      
   inner join tblDistributionDeliveryMethods ddm on do.DeliveryMethodFK = DistributionDeliveryMethodPK      
   Where (@OrderStatus2 = -1 or       
    (@OrderStatus2 = 1 and do.OrderStatusFK in (1,2))      
    or       
    (@OrderStatus2 = 3 and do.OrderStatusFK in (3))      
    or       
    (@OrderStatus2 = 4 and do.OrderStatusFK in (4,5,6))      
    or       
    (@OrderStatus2 = 7 and do.OrderStatusFK in (7,8))      
 or    
 (@OrderStatus2 = 8 and do.OrderStatusFK in (7,8)) ----Pritesh    
    )      
    AND divisions.CustomerFK = @customerFK2      
    and (@FromDate2 = '19000101' or (do.orderdate >= @FromDate2 and do.orderdate <= @ToDate2))      
          
      
   drop table if exists #tmpUnfilterResult      
   SELECT Distinct DistributionOrderPK AS PK, '/images/StockOrder.png' AS ImagePath, cast(0 as bit) AS IsFiltered, cast(0 as bit) as IsArchived,       
    Orderreference [Order Number],      
    convert(varchar, OrderDate, 103) [Order Date],        
    DeliveryAddress as [Address],      
    stuff((select distinct ',' + distdivs.DivisionCode from #tmpDistributionOrders distdivs where distdivs.DistributionOrderPK = do.DistributionOrderPK order by 1 for xml path('')),1,1,'') as Accounts,          
    case when count(stockitemcode) <= 2 then stuff((select distinct ',' + diststocks.stockitemcode from #tmpDistributionOrders diststocks where diststocks.DistributionOrderPK = do.DistributionOrderPK order by 1 for xml path('')),1,1,'') else cast(count(stockitemcode) as nvarchar(10)) end as StockCodes,      
    sum(Units) as Qty,      
    DistributionDeliveryMethod as [Delivery Method],      
    DeliveryReference as [tracking No],      
    DistributionOrderStatus + (case when EnableDistributionOverdueAlert = 1 and DistributionOrderStatusPK in (1,2,3) and DATEDIFF(day, OrderDate, getdate()) > 1 then ' (Overdue)' else '' end) as [Status]      
   into #tmpUnfilterResult        
   from #tmpDistributionOrders do       
   group by DistributionOrderPK, Orderreference, OrderDate, DeliveryAddress, DistributionDeliveryMethod, Orderreference, DistributionOrderStatus, DistributionOrderStatusPK, EnableDistributionOverdueAlert    , DeliveryReference  
      
   select * from #tmpUnfilterResult      
   where @SearchString2 = '' or (      
     [Order Number] like @SearchString2      
     or      
     [Order Date] like @SearchString2      
     or      
     [Address] like @SearchString2      
     or      
     Accounts like @SearchString2      
     or      
     StockCodes like @SearchString2      
     or      
     Qty like @SearchString2      
     or      
     [Delivery Method] like @SearchString2      
     or      
     [tracking No] like @SearchString2      
     or      
     [Status] like @SearchString2      
    )    
	order by PK
         
         
      
         
          
   -- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end      
      
         
         
   BREAK      
  END TRY      
  BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */      
   DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;      
   SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;      
   SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;      
      
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY       
   BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;      
             
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;      
      
            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID      
                  
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;      
                  
   IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)      
   BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END      
   ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */      
  END CATCH      
  SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1      
 END      
END

			FROM tblDistributionDeliveryMethodPackagingCharges dmpts
			inner join tblDistributionPackagingTypes dpts on dpts.DistributionPackagingTypePK = dmpts.DistributionPackagingTypeFK
			where dmpts.CustomerFK = @customerFK2 and DistributionDeliveryMethodFK = @DeliveryMethodFK2 and ((@ShowArchived2 = 0 and dmpts.IsArchived = 0) or (@ShowArchived2 = 1))

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end

			
			
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spgvDistributionPalletsEmptyAfterOrder]  
(  
   @DistributionOrderFK int  
)  
AS  
BEGIN  
 /* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */  
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED  
  
    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT  
 ,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;  
 SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();  
  
 -- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters  
 DECLARE @DistributionOrderFK2 int
  
 SET @DistributionOrderFK2 = @DistributionOrderFK; 
  
 SET @ParameterDetails = '@DistributionOrderFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@DistributionOrderFK2 AS NVARCHAR(20)),'') 
  
    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL   
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)  
  
    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)  
    --BEGIN  
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC   
  
  SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)  
  
        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)  
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK  
  
        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()  
    --END  
  
  
 SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);  
 SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails  
 ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;  
 INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()  
  
 WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3  
 BEGIN   
  BEGIN TRY    
   -- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start  
  
	drop table if exists #tmporderpallets
	select distinct PalletContentFK, colpc.Units, col.free5 as EmptyConfirmed 
	into #tmporderpallets
	from tblcontainerouts co
	inner join tblcontaineroutlines col on containeroutpk = containeroutfk
	inner join tblContainerOutLinePalletContent colpc on colpc.ContainerOutLineFK = col.ContainerOutLinePK
	where co.DistributionOrderFK = @DistributionOrderFK2
		
	select pc.PalletContentPK, StockItemCode, p.Barcode [PalletBarcode], vpl.Location [PalletLocation], cast((pc.ActualUnits - colpc.Units) as int) [RemainingQuantity]
	from tblpalletcontent pc
	inner join #tmporderpallets colpc on pc.palletcontentpk = colpc.PalletContentFK
	inner join tblstockitems s on pc.StockItemFK = s.StockItempk
	inner join tblpallets p on pc.palletfk = p.palletpk
	inner join viewPalletLocations vpl on pc.PalletFK = vpl.PalletPK
	where (pc.ActualUnits - colpc.Units)  = 0 and EmptyConfirmed <> '1'

   -- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end  
   BREAK  
  END TRY  
  BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */  
   DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;  
   SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;  
   SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;  
  
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY   
   BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;  
         
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;  
  
            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID  
              
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;  
              
   IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)  
   BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END  
   ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */  
  END CATCH  
  SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1  
 END  
END

	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

		BEGIN TRY
			

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start

			SELECT DivisionDeliveryAddressPK AS PK, '/images/Division.png' AS ImagePath, ddas.IsArchived, cast(0 as bit) AS IsFiltered, 
			DivisionName, WarehousingLocked, WarehousingClientLocked
			FROM         dbo.tblDivisionDeliveryAddresses ddas
			inner join tblDivisions divs on
			divs.DivisionPK = ddas.DivisionFK
			where DeliveryAddressFK = @customerDeliveryAddressFK2

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end

			
			
			BREAK
		END TRY

			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;

			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END

		END CATCH

 ,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;
	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	DECLARE @divisionFK2 int

	SET @divisionFK2 = @divisionFK

	SET @ParameterDetails = '@divisionFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@divisionFK2 AS NVARCHAR(20)),'')

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    --BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

		SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END


	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY
			

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start

			SELECT dsw.DivisionScheduledTaskPK AS PK, '/images/category.png' AS ImagePath, dsw.IsArchived, cast(0 as bit) AS IsFiltered, 
			swt.ScheduledTaskType [Task Type],  CONVERT(VARCHAR(50), dsw.LastProcessedDate, 106) + ' ' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(5), dsw.LastProcessedDate, 108) [Last Processed], 
			dsw.EmailAddress [Email], dsw.Enabled --swft.ScheduledWorkFixType [Fix Type],
			FROM tblDivisionScheduledTask dsw
			inner join appScheduledTaskTypes swt on swt.ScheduledTaskTypePK = dsw.ScheduledTaskTypeFK
			--inner join appScheduledWorkFixTypes swft on swft.ScheduledWorkFixTypePK = dsw.ScheduledWorkFixTypeFK
			where DivisionFK = @divisionFK2

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end

			
			
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END
GO

-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>

-- Modified:	Damien Gannon #DEV 543 
--				Return Only Non-Archived records in tblStockItemBuildingUnits
--
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spGvDivisionStockItems]
(
	@divisionFK int
)	
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT
 ,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;
	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	DECLARE @divisionFK2 int

	SET @divisionFK2 = @divisionFK

	SET @ParameterDetails = '@divisionFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@divisionFK2 AS NVARCHAR(20)),'')

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    --BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

		SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END


	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY
			

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start

				--get all stock items
				IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#TempStockItems') IS NOT NULL
					DROP TABLE #TempStockItems

				SELECT * INTO #TempStockItems 
				FROM tblStockItems tsi 
				WHERE DivisionFK = @divisionFK2 and isarchived = 0
				--SELECT count(*) FROM #TempStockItems

				--get all fixed locations
				IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#TempFixedLocations') IS NOT NULL
					DROP TABLE #TempFixedLocations

				SELECT tsifl.StockItemFK, count(StockItemFK) AS [Counter] INTO #TempFixedLocations 
				FROM tblStockItemFixedLocations tsifl 
				INNER JOIN #TempStockItems ON stockitempk = tsifl.StockItemFK
				where tsifl.IsArchived=0
				GROUP BY StockItemFK	
				--SELECT * FROM #TempFixedLocations
	
				--get all building units
				IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#TempBuildingUnits') IS NOT NULL
					DROP TABLE #TempBuildingUnits

				SELECT tsibu.StockItemFK, count(StockItemFK) AS [Counter] INTO #TempBuildingUnits 
				FROM dbo.tblStockItemBuildingUnits tsibu 
				INNER JOIN #TempStockItems ON stockitempk = tsibu.StockItemFK
				WHERE tsibu.IsArchived = 0		-- #DEV 543 
				GROUP BY StockItemFK	
				--SELECT * FROM #TempBuildingUnits

				--get all heights
				IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#TempHeights') IS NOT NULL
					DROP TABLE #TempHeights

				SELECT tsih.StockItemFK, count(StockItemFK) AS [Counter] INTO #TempHeights 
				FROM dbo.tblStockItemHeights tsih
				INNER JOIN #TempStockItems ON stockitempk = tsih.StockItemFK	
				GROUP BY StockItemFK	
				--SELECT * FROM #TempHeights

				--get all costs
				IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#TempCosts') IS NOT NULL
					DROP TABLE #TempCosts

				SELECT tsih.StockItemFK, count(StockItemFK) AS [Counter]  INTO #TempCosts 
				FROM dbo.tblStockItemUnitCosts tsih
				INNER JOIN #TempStockItems ON stockitempk = tsih.StockItemFK
				GROUP BY StockItemFK		
				--SELECT * FROM #TempCosts

				--get all commodity Codes
				IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#TempCodes') IS NOT NULL
					DROP TABLE #TempCodes

				SELECT tsih.StockItemFK, count(StockItemFK) AS [Counter]  INTO #TempCodes 
				FROM dbo.tblStockItemCommodityCodes tsih
				INNER JOIN #TempStockItems ON stockitempk = tsih.StockItemFK
				GROUP BY StockItemFK		
				--SELECT * FROM #TempCodes

				--get all versions
				IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#TempVersions') IS NOT NULL
					DROP TABLE #TempVersions

				SELECT tsih.StockItemFK, count(StockItemFK) AS [Counter]  INTO #TempVersions 
				FROM dbo.tblStockItemVersions tsih
				INNER JOIN #TempStockItems ON stockitempk = tsih.StockItemFK
				GROUP BY StockItemFK		
				--SELECT * FROM #TempCodes

				--get all delivery Status's
				IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#TempStatus') IS NOT NULL
					DROP TABLE #TempStatus

				SELECT tsih.StockItemFK, count(StockItemFK) AS [Counter]  INTO #TempStatus 
				FROM dbo.tblStockItemDeliveryStatus tsih
				INNER JOIN #TempStockItems ON stockitempk = tsih.StockItemFK
				WHERE tsih.isarchived = 0
				GROUP BY StockItemFK		
				--SELECT * FROM #TempStatus

				--group together
				IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#TempResults') IS NOT NULL
					DROP TABLE #TempResults

				SELECT tfl.Counter [Fixed Locations], tbu.Counter [Building Units], th.Counter [Heights], tc.Counter [Unit Costs], tcode.Counter [Commodity Codes], tv.Counter [Versions], tds.Counter [Delivery Status], sic.StockItemCategory,  tsi.* 
				INTO #TempResults
				FROM #TempStockItems tsi
				LEFT JOIN #TempFixedLocations tfl ON tsi.stockitempk = tfl.StockItemFK
				LEFT JOIN #TempBuildingUnits tbu ON tsi.StockItemPK = tbu.StockItemFK
				LEFT JOIN #TempHeights th ON tsi.StockItemPK = th.StockItemFK
				LEFT JOIN #TempCosts tc ON tsi.StockItemPK = tc.StockItemFK
				LEFT JOIN #TempCodes tcode ON tsi.StockItemPK = tcode.StockItemFK
				LEFT JOIN #TempVersions tv ON tsi.StockItemPK = tv.StockItemFK
				LEFT JOIN #TempStatus tds ON tsi.StockItemPK = tds.StockItemFK
				LEFT JOIN tblstockitemcategories sic ON tsi.stockitemCategoryFK = sic.stockitemcategorypk
				
		
				--Include Alias / EAN in result?
				IF NOT EXISTS(
					SELECT *
					FROM #TempResults
					WHERE DivisionFK = @divisionFK2
						AND rtrim(('Alias: ' + isnull(StockItemCodeAlias1, 'na') + ', EAN Code(s): ' +  EANCode + ' ' + EANCode2 + ' ' + EANCode3 + ' ' + EANCode4 + ' ' + EANCode5)) <> 'Alias: , EAN Code(s):')
					BEGIN
						SELECT StockItemPK AS PK, '/images/StockItem.png' AS ImagePath, cast(0 as bit) as IsArchived, cast(0 as bit) AS IsFiltered, 
							StockItemCode as [Stock Code], Description, [Fixed Locations], [Building Units], [Heights], [Unit Costs], [Commodity Codes], Versions, [Delivery Status],
							CASE WHEN RequireOutboundSAD = 1 AND RequireInboundSAD = 0 THEN 'Out'
							WHEN RequireOutboundSAD = 0 AND RequireInboundSAD = 1 THEN 'In'
							WHEN RequireOutboundSAD = 1 AND RequireInboundSAD = 1 THEN 'In & Out'
							ELSE '' END AS [Customs Control], StockItemCategory AS Category
						FROM #TempResults
						Order By StockItemCode ASC
					END
				ELSE
					BEGIN
						SELECT StockItemPK AS PK, '/images/StockItem.png' AS ImagePath, cast(0 as bit) as IsArchived, cast(0 as bit) AS IsFiltered, 
							StockItemCode as [Stock Code], Description, 'Alias: ' + isnull(StockItemCodeAlias1, 'na') + ', EAN Code(s): ' +  EANCode + ' ' + EANCode2 + ' ' + EANCode3 + ' ' + EANCode4 + ' ' + EANCode5 as [Alias / EAN]
							, [Fixed Locations], [Building Units], [Heights], [Unit Costs], [Commodity Codes], Versions, [Delivery Status],
							CASE WHEN RequireOutboundSAD = 1 AND RequireInboundSAD = 0 THEN 'Out'
							WHEN RequireOutboundSAD = 0 AND RequireInboundSAD = 1 THEN 'In'
							WHEN RequireOutboundSAD = 0 AND RequireInboundSAD = 1 THEN 'In & Out'
							ELSE '' END AS [Customs Control]
						FROM #TempResults
						Order By StockItemCode ASC
					END	

			--if not exists(SELECT *
			--	FROM         dbo.tblStockItems
			--	where DivisionFK = @divisionFK2
			--	and rtrim(('Alias: ' + isnull(StockItemCodeAlias1, 'na') + ', EAN Code(s): ' +  EANCode + ' ' + EANCode2 + ' ' + EANCode3 + ' ' + EANCode4 + ' ' + EANCode5)) <> 'Alias: , EAN Code(s):')
			
			--SELECT StockItemPK AS PK, '/images/StockItem.png' AS ImagePath, cast(0 as bit) as IsArchived, cast(0 as bit) AS IsFiltered, 
			--	StockItemCode as [Stock Code], Description--, 'Alias: ' + isnull(StockItemCodeAlias1, 'na') + ', EAN Code(s): ' +  EANCode + ' ' + EANCode2 + ' ' + EANCode3 + ' ' + EANCode4 + ' ' + EANCode5 as [Alias / EAN]
			--FROM         dbo.tblStockItems
			--where DivisionFK = @divisionFK2 and isarchived = 0
			--Order By StockItemCode ASC

			--else

			--SELECT dbo.tblStockItems.StockItemPK, dbo.tblStockItems.StockItemCodeockItemPK AS PK, '/images/StockItem.png' AS ImagePath, cast(0 as bit) as IsArchived, cast(0 as bit) AS IsFiltered, 
			--	StockItemCode as [Stock Code], Description, 'Alias: ' + isnull(StockItemCodeAlias1, 'na') + ', EAN Code(s): ' +  EANCode + ' ' + EANCode2 + ' ' + EANCode3 + ' ' + EANCode4 + ' ' + EANCode5 as [Alias / EAN]

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spGvDivisionStockItemWorkOrderRules]

)     
AS    
BEGIN    
 /* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */    
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED    
    
    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT

 SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

 SET @divisionFK2 = @divisionFK

 SET @ParameterDetails = '@divisionFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@divisionFK2 AS NVARCHAR(20)),'')    
 
 +'@IncludeArchived = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@IncludeArchived AS NVARCHAR(10)),'')

  SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)

 SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);    
 SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails    
 ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;    
 INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()    
    
 WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3    
 BEGIN     
  BEGIN TRY    
       
    
   -- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start    
      DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #tmpRuleList  

   SELECT StockItemWorksorderRulePK AS PK, 
     '/images/SplitRule.png' AS ImagePath,
	 0 as IsArchived, 
	  cast(0 as bit) AS IsFiltered,
   stockItems.StockItemCode as [Stock Code],    
   woos.WorksOrderOrigin [Work Origin],   
   wot.WorksOrderType [Work OrderType],  
   workRules.Split [Split],  
   --extra.Charge [Extra Service Charge],
   workRules.ExtraService [Extra Service Charge],
   workRules.IsArchived as Archived
    INTO #tmpRuleList 
   FROM         dbo.tblStockItemWorksorderRules workRules    
   inner join tblStockItems stockItems    
   on    
   stockItems.StockItemPK = workRules.StockItemFK    

   left join tblDivisionExtraServices extra on  
   extra.DivisionExtraServicePK= workRules.DivisionExtraServiceFK  
  
    left outer join appWorksOrderOrigins woos on    
   woos.WorksORderOriginPK = workRules.WorksOrderOriginFK        
     inner join appWorksOrderTypes wot on  
    workRules.WorkOrderTypeFK= wot.WorksOrderTypePK  
  
   where stockItems.DivisionFK = @divisionFK2 
   and
     (@var_IncludeArchivedUsers = 1 OR (@var_IncludeArchivedUsers = 0 and workRules.IsArchived = 0)  )
   Order by StockItemCode ASC    
    

	 if(@var_IncludeArchivedUsers = 1)      
 BEGIN      
  SELECT * FROM #tmpRuleList      
 END      
 ELSE      
 BEGIN

  FROM #tmpRuleList      
 END
   -- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end    
   
   BREAK    
  END TRY    
  BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */    
   DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;    
   SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;    
   SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;    
    
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY     
   BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;    
           
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;    
    
            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID    
                
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;    
                
   IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)    
   BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END    
   ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */    
  END CATCH    
  SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1    
 END

   SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;      
   SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;      
      
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY       
   BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;      
             
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;      
      
            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID      
                  
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;      
                  
   IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)      
   BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END      
   ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */      
  END CATCH      
  SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1      
 END      
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spGvDocketExtraFieldValues]
(
	@docketTypeFK int,
	@fk int
)	
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT
 ,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;
	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	DECLARE @docketTypeFK2 int, @fk2 int

	SET @docketTypeFK2 = @docketTypeFK; SET @fk2 = @fk

	SET @ParameterDetails = '@docketTypeFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@docketTypeFK2 AS NVARCHAR(20)),'') + ',@fk = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@fk2 AS NVARCHAR(20)),'')

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    --BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

		SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END


	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY
			

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start

			Declare @divisionFK int

			IF @docketTypeFK2 = 1 
			BEGIN --STOCK IN
				Select @divisionFK = sins.DivisionFK from tblStockIns sins
				where StockInPK = @fk2 
		
				SELECT isnull(defvs.DocketExtraFieldValuePK, 0) AS PK, '/images/ExtraDocketField.png' AS ImagePath, ddefs.IsArchived, cast(0 as bit) AS IsFiltered, 
					ddefs.ExtraFieldName, '$txt%wth=180%val=' + isnull(defvs.Value, '') + '%' + cast(DivisionDocketExtraFieldPK as nvarchar(50)) as [Value]
				FROM         dbo.tblDivisionDocketExtraFields ddefs
				inner join appDocketTypes docketTypes on
				docketTypes.DocketTypePK = ddefs.DocketTypeFK
				left outer join tblDocketExtraFieldValues defvs on
				defvs.DocketTypeFK = 1 AND DivisionDocketExtraFieldFK = DivisionDocketExtraFieldPK AND FK = @fk2
				where ddefs.DocketTypeFK = 1 AND DivisionFK = @divisionFK
			END ELSE IF @docketTypeFK2 = 2 
			BEGIN --STOCK OUT
				Select Top 1 @divisionFK = cols.DivisionFK from tblContainerOutLines cols
				where ContainerOutFK = @fk2
		
				SELECT isnull(defvs.DocketExtraFieldValuePK, 0) AS PK, '/images/ExtraDocketField.png' AS ImagePath, ddefs.IsArchived, 0 AS IsFiltered, 
					ddefs.ExtraFieldName, '$txt%wth=180%val=' + isnull(defvs.Value, '') + '%' + cast(DivisionDocketExtraFieldPK as nvarchar(50)) as [Value]
				FROM         dbo.tblDivisionDocketExtraFields ddefs
				inner join appDocketTypes docketTypes on
				docketTypes.DocketTypePK = ddefs.DocketTypeFK
				left outer join tblDocketExtraFieldValues defvs on
				defvs.DocketTypeFK = 2 AND DivisionDocketExtraFieldFK = DivisionDocketExtraFieldPK AND FK = @fk2
				where ddefs.DocketTypeFK = 2 AND DivisionFK = @divisionFK
			END    
	
			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end

			
			
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spGvExtraServices]    
(    
 @stockInFK int = -1,    
 @stockOrderFK int = -1,    
 @ContainerOutFK  int = -1,    
 @divisionFK int = -1,
 @GroupStockInFk int =-1
)     
AS    
BEGIN    
 /* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */    
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED    
    
    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT    
 ,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;    
 SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();    
    
 -- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters    
 DECLARE @stockInFK2 int, @stockOrderFK2 int, @divisionFK2 int, @containerOutFK2 int  ,  @GroupStockInFk2 int
    
 SET @stockInFK2 = @stockInFK; SET @stockOrderFK2 = @stockOrderFK; SET @divisionFK2 = @divisionFK; SET @containerOutFK2 = @ContainerOutFK ; Set @GroupStockInFk2=@GroupStockInFk   
    
 SET @ParameterDetails = '@stockInFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@stockInFK2 AS NVARCHAR(20)),'') + ',@stockOrderFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@stockOrderFK2 AS NVARCHAR(20)),'')    
  + ',@divisionFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@divisionFK2 AS NVARCHAR(20)),'') + ',@containerOutFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@containerOutFK2 AS NVARCHAR(20)),'') + ',@GroupStockInFk = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@GroupStockInFk2 AS NVARCHAR(20)),'')   
    
    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL     
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)    
    
    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)    
    --BEGIN    
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC     
    
  SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)    
    
        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)    
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK    
    
        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()    
    --END    
    
    
 SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);    
 SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails    
 ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;    
 INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()    
    
 WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3    
 BEGIN     
  BEGIN TRY    
       
    
   -- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start    
    
   if(@stockInFK2 > 0)     
   BEGIN    
    --SELECT ExtraServicePK AS PK, '/images/ExtraService.png' AS ImagePath,     
    --cast(0 as bit) AS IsFiltered, ess.IsArchived,     
    --[Name] as [Name], Reference, Charge,Numberof as Quantity    
    --FROM dbo.tblExtraServices ess    
    --Where StockInFK = 108230  
     SELECT ExtraServicePK AS PK, '/images/ExtraService.png' AS ImagePath,     
    cast(0 as bit) AS IsFiltered, ess.IsArchived,   
  case when ess.StockItemFK = -1 THEN 'All' ELSE sis.StockItemCode end AS [Stock Code],  
    [Name] as [ExtraService Type], Numberof as Quantity,Charge, Reference  
  
 --sis.StockItemCode as StockCode   
    FROM dbo.tblExtraServices ess    
    LEFT join tblStockItems sis  
 on   
 sis.StockItemPK=ess.StockItemFK  
     Where StockInFK = @stockInFK2    
   END
   
   ELSE IF(@stockOrderFK2 > 0)     
   BEGIN    
    /*SELECT ExtraServicePK AS PK, '/images/ExtraService.png' AS ImagePath, cast(0 as bit) AS IsFiltered, ess.IsArchived,     
    [Name] as [Name], Reference, Charge    
    FROM dbo.tblExtraServices ess    
    Where StockOrderFK = @stockOrderFK2*/    
    --Jamie : updated to get all extra services for the container out the stock order is linked to    
    SELECT ExtraServicePK AS PK, '/images/ExtraService.png' AS ImagePath, cast(0 as bit) AS IsFiltered,     
    ess.IsArchived,   
 case when ess.StockItemFK = -1 THEN 'All' ELSE sis.StockItemCode end AS [Stock Code],  
 [Name] as [ExtraService Type],Numberof as Quantity, Charge, Reference  
   
 --sis.StockItemCode as StockCode    
    FROM dbo.tblExtraServices ess  
  LEFT join tblStockItems sis  
 on   
 sis.StockItemPK=ess.StockItemFK  
    Where StockOrderFK in (select stockorderpk from tblstockorders     
    where containeroutfk = (select containeroutfk from tblstockorders where stockorderpk = @stockOrderFK2))    
  
   END 
   ELSE IF(@containerOutFK2 > 0)     
   BEGIN    
    SELECT ExtraServicePK AS PK, '/images/ExtraService.png' AS ImagePath, cast(0 as bit) AS IsFiltered, ess.IsArchived,          
     case when ess.StockItemFK = -1 THEN 'All' ELSE StockItemCode end AS [Stock Code],     
     case when ess.DivisionExtraServiceFK > 0 then tdes.Name + ' - ' + cast(tdes.Charge as nvarchar(50)) + ' per ' + isnull(css.ChargeSubject, '') ELSE 'Adhoc: ' + ess.Name end AS [Description],    
     ess.NumberOf,    
     ess.Charge,     
      --CONVERT(VARCHAR(50), ess.ExtraServiceDate, 106) [Date],    
     Reference    
    FROM dbo.tblExtraServices ess    
    LEFT JOIN tblstockitems si  ON ess.StockItemFK = si.StockItemPK    
    LEFT JOIN dbo.tblDivisionExtraServices tdes ON ess.DivisionExtraServiceFK = tdes.DivisionExtraServicePK    
    left outer join appChargeSubjects css on css.ChargeSubjectPK = tdes.ChargeSubjectFK    
    Where StockOrderFK in (select stockorderpk from tblstockorders where containeroutfk = @containerOutFK2)    
   END     
    

	Else If (@GroupStockInFk2 > 0)
	begin
	  SELECT ExtraServicePK AS PK, '/images/ExtraService.png' AS ImagePath,     
    cast(0 as bit) AS IsFiltered, ess.IsArchived,   
  case when ess.StockItemFK = -1 THEN 'All' ELSE sis.StockItemCode end AS [Stock Code],  
    [Name] as [ExtraService Type], Numberof as Quantity,Charge, Reference  
  
 --sis.StockItemCode as StockCode   
    FROM dbo.tblExtraServices ess    
    LEFT join tblStockItems sis on sis.StockItemPK=ess.StockItemFK  

	 inner join tblStockIns sin on sin.stockinpk = ess.stockinfk 
 inner join tblcontainerins cin on cin.containerinpk = sin.containerinfk 
 where cin.StockInGroupFK =@GroupStockInFk2
	end




  ELSE     
   BEGIN    
    SELECT ExtraServicePK AS PK, '/images/ExtraService.png' AS ImagePath, cast(0 as bit) AS IsFiltered, ess.IsArchived,     
    DivisionName,  
 case when ess.StockItemFK = -1 THEN 'All' ELSE sis.StockItemCode end AS [Stock Code],  
 [Name] as [Name],Numberof as Quantity, Charge , Reference  
   
 --sis.StockItemCode as StockCode    
    FROM dbo.tblExtraServices ess    
    inner join tblDivisions divisions on    
    divisions.DivisionPK = ess.DivisionFK   
  LEFT join tblStockItems sis  
 on   
 sis.StockItemPK=ess.StockItemFK  
    Where StockInFK = -1 AND StockOrderFK = -1    
   END    
    
   -- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end    
    
       
       
   BREAK    
  END TRY    
  BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */    
   DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;    
   SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;    
   SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;    
    
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY     
   BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;    
           
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;    
    
            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID    
                
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;    
                
   IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)    
   BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END    
   ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */    
  END CATCH    
  SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1    
 END    
END

        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK          
          
        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()          
    --END          
          
          
 SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);          
 SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails          
 ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;          
 INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()          
          
 WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3          
 BEGIN           
  BEGIN TRY          
             
          
   -- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start          
          
   SELECT        
  cihs.ContainerInHeaderPK AS PK,         
   '/images/Pallet.png' AS ImagePath, cast(0 as bit) AS IsFiltered, 0 as IsArchived,           
   cin.GoodsInNumber, StockItemCode as StockCode,     
   cihs.Units,    
    --case when sils.units is null then cihs.units else sils.units end as Units  ,      
       
   cihs.Batch, sis.stockitempk [$hideCol%stockitempk]  , cihs.ContainerInFK [$hideCol%ContainerInFK], sins.stockinpk [$hideCol%StockInPK], cin.DateIn [$hideCol%DateIn]            
   FROM tblContainerInHeaders cihs          
   inner join tblStockItems sis on          
   sis.StockItemPK = cihs.StockItemFK          
     inner join tblcontainerins cin on cihs.ContainerInFK = cin.containerinpk        
  inner join tblstockins sins on cin.containerinpk = sins.ContainerInFK     
  --inner join tblStockInLines sils on sins.StockInPK = sils.StockInFK ---Pritesh     
  
    
   left join (select distinct stockinfk, sum(units) Units from tblStockInLines group by stockinfk) sils on sils.stockinfk = sins.stockinpk       
 left join (select distinct containerinfk, sum(units) Units from tblContainerInHeaders group by containerinfk) cih on cih.containerinfk = cin.containerinpk     
  where cin.StockInGroupFK =@StockInGroupFK2        
   order by sis.StockItemCode          
          
   -- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end          
          
             
             
   BREAK          
  END TRY          
  BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */          
   DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;          
   SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;          
   SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;          
          
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY           
   BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;          
                 
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;          
          
            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID          
                      
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;          
                      
   IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)          
   BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END          
   ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */          
  END CATCH          
  SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1          
 END          
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spgvGroupStockInLines]      
(      
 @GroupStockInPK int      
)      
AS      
BEGIN      
/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */                
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED                
                
 DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,                
  @DeadlockErrorRetries INT, @PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT,                
  @startRecord INT = 1,@totalRecords INT, @endRecord INT, @NoResultsFound INT

 -- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters                
 DECLARE @var_GroupStockInPK int      
                        
 SET @var_GroupStockInPK = @GroupStockInPK              
                
 SET @ParameterDetails = '@GroupStockInPK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_GroupStockInPK AS NVARCHAR(20)),'')      
      
 IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL                 
  CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)                
                
 --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)                
    --BEGIN                 
  SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC                 
                
        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()                
    --END                
                
 SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);                
 SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails                
 ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;                
 INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()                
                
 WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3                
 BEGIN                 
  BEGIN TRY      
  --get containers      
   drop table if exists #tmpcontainerIns      
   select containerinpk, GoodsInNumber       
   into #tmpcontainerIns       
   from tblContainerIns      
   where StockInGroupFK = @var_GroupStockInPK      
      
  --get stock ins      
   drop table if exists #tmpstockIns      
   select StockInPK, ContainerInFK       
   into #tmpstockIns       
   from tblStockIns sins      
   inner join #tmpcontainerIns cin on sins.ContainerInFK = cin.ContainerInPK      
      
  --get lines      
   drop table if exists #tmpstockInLines      
   select sils.*       
   into #tmpstockInLines      
   from tblStockInLines sils      
   inner join #tmpstockIns sins on sins.StockInPK = sils.StockInFK      
      
  --additional fields      
   drop table if exists #tmpStockItemAdditionalFields      
   select PalletAdditionalFields1.*       
   into #tmpStockItemAdditionalFields      
   from #tmpstockInLines sils      
   inner join tblstockitems s on s.stockitempk = sils.stockitemfk      
   inner join tbldivisions d on s.divisionfk = d.divisionpk      
   inner join tblPalletAdditionalFields PalletAdditionalFields1       
    on (PalletAdditionalFields1.PalletAdditionalFieldTypeFK = 3 /*StockItem*/ AND PalletAdditionalFields1.FK = s.StockItemPK)      
    or (PalletAdditionalFields1.PalletAdditionalFieldTypeFK = 2 /*Division*/ AND PalletAdditionalFields1.FK = d.divisionpk)      
    or (PalletAdditionalFields1.PalletAdditionalFieldTypeFK = 1 /*Customer*/ AND PalletAdditionalFields1.FK = d.CustomerFK)      
   where PalletAdditionalFields1.Enabled = 1      
        
  --get stock settings       
  drop table if exists #tmpStockSettings      
  Select distinct stockitempk, stockItemCode, InputByEaches, stockItems.RequireExpiryDate, stockItems.RequireManufactureDate, stockItems.RequireBestBefore, stockItems.RequireDateOfReceipt, stockItems.RequireSupplierBatch,       
   CASE WHEN custs.RequirePalletNumber = 0 THEN CASE WHEN divs.RequirePalletNumber = 0 then stockItems.RequirePalletNumber ELSE divs.RequirePalletNumber END ELSE custs.RequirePalletNumber end as RequirePalletNumber,          
   case when SpecialStockTypes.CustomerFK is not null then cast(1 as bit) else cast(0 as bit) end as RequireSpecialStockType,       
   case when divs.AllowCustomerPalletBarcodeManualEntry = 1 or divs.GenerateCustomerPalletBarcodes = 1 then 1 else 0 end as RequireCustomerBarcode,      
   case when coalesce(sisPalletAdditionalFields1.PalletAdditionalFieldPK, divPalletAdditionalFields1.PalletAdditionalFieldPK, cusPalletAdditionalFields1.PalletAdditionalFieldPK, -1) > 0 then 1 else 0 end as RequirePalletAdditionalField1,      
   case when coalesce(sisPalletAdditionalFields2.PalletAdditionalFieldPK, divPalletAdditionalFields2.PalletAdditionalFieldPK, cusPalletAdditionalFields2.PalletAdditionalFieldPK, -1) > 0 then 1 else 0 end as RequirePalletAdditionalField2      
  INTO #tmpStockSettings      
  FROM tblStockItems stockItems       
  INNER JOIN #tmpstockInLines sils on stockitems.StockItemPK = sils.StockItemFK      
  INNER JOIN tblDivisions divs on divs.DivisionPK = stockItems.DivisionFK      
  INNER JOIN tblcustomers custs ON divs.CustomerFK = custs.customerpk      
  left outer join #tmpStockItemAdditionalFields sisPalletAdditionalFields1 on sisPalletAdditionalFields1.PalletAdditionalFieldTypeFK = 3 /*StockItem*/ AND sisPalletAdditionalFields1.FK = stockItems.StockItemPK AND sisPalletAdditionalFields1.FieldNumber=1 
  
    
     
        left outer join #tmpStockItemAdditionalFields sisPalletAdditionalFields2 on sisPalletAdditionalFields2.PalletAdditionalFieldTypeFK = 3 /*StockItem*/ AND sisPalletAdditionalFields2.FK = stockItems.StockItemPK AND sisPalletAdditionalFields2.FieldNumber=2      
        left outer join #tmpStockItemAdditionalFields divPalletAdditionalFields1 on divPalletAdditionalFields1.PalletAdditionalFieldTypeFK = 2 /*Division*/ AND divPalletAdditionalFields1.FK = stockItems.DivisionFK AND divPalletAdditionalFields1.FieldNumber=1      
        left outer join #tmpStockItemAdditionalFields divPalletAdditionalFields2 on divPalletAdditionalFields2.PalletAdditionalFieldTypeFK = 2 /*Division*/ AND divPalletAdditionalFields2.FK = stockItems.DivisionFK AND divPalletAdditionalFields2.FieldNumber=2      
        left outer join #tmpStockItemAdditionalFields cusPalletAdditionalFields1 on cusPalletAdditionalFields1.PalletAdditionalFieldTypeFK = 1 /*Customer*/ AND cusPalletAdditionalFields1.FK = divs.CustomerFK AND cusPalletAdditionalFields1.FieldNumber=1   
  
   
        left outer join #tmpStockItemAdditionalFields cusPalletAdditionalFields2 on cusPalletAdditionalFields2.PalletAdditionalFieldTypeFK = 1 /*Customer*/ AND cusPalletAdditionalFields2.FK = divs.CustomerFK AND cusPalletAdditionalFields2.FieldNumber=2   
  
   
  left outer join tblPalletTypes palletTypes on palletTypes.PalletTypePK = stockItems.DefaultPalletTypeFK

  select @RequirePalletAdditionalField1 = count(*) from #tmpStockSettings where RequirePalletAdditionalField1 = 1        
  select @RequirePalletAdditionalField2 = count(*) from #tmpStockSettings where RequirePalletAdditionalField2 = 1        
              
  --get all fields into temp results      
   drop table if exists #results      
      
   select distinct        
    --containerIns.ContainerInPK AS [PK],     
 stockInLines.StockInLinePK AS [PK],

    stockInLines.DateOfReceipt,

    stockInLines.CustomerBarcode,      
    stockInLines.CustomerPalletNumber,      
    pt.PalletType,      
    ps.PalletStatus,      
    sst.SpecialStockType,       
 '$jlnk%scr=Edit(' + cast(stockInLines.StockInLinePK as nvarchar(50)) +');%txt=Edit' AS Actions,

  '$jlnk%scr=Delete(' + cast(stockInLines.StockInLinePK as nvarchar(50)) +');%txt=Delete' AS Remove

   into #results      
   from  #tmpcontainerIns containerIns      
   inner join #tmpstockIns stockIns on containerIns.ContainerInPK = stockIns.ContainerInFK      
   inner join #tmpstockInLines stockInLines  on stockIns.StockInPK = stockInLines.StockInFK      
   inner join #tmpStockSettings stockItems on stockInLines.StockItemFK = stockItems.StockItemPK      
   inner join dbo.tblPalletTypes palletTypes on stockInLines.PalletTypeFK = palletTypes.PalletTypePK      
   LEFT OUTER JOIN appSpecialStockTypes AS sst  ON sst.SpecialStockTypePK = stockInLines.SpecialStockTypeFK             
   inner join tblPalletTypes pt on pt.PalletTypePK = stockInLines.PalletTypeFK      
   inner join appPalletStatus ps on ps.PalletStatusPK = stockInLines.PalletStatusFK         
   left outer join dbo.tblContainerInHeaders containerInHeaders on containerIns.ContainerInPK = containerInHeaders.ContainerInFK      
    and stockItems.StockItemPK = containerInHeaders.StockItemFK      
    and (      
     containerInHeaders.Batch = ''      
     or       
     (      
      containerInHeaders.Batch <> ''      
      and containerInHeaders.Batch = stockInLines.Batch      
     )      
    )       
          
  --dynamic results based of field settings      
  declare @query nvarchar(max) = ''      
   set @query = 'select [PK], ImagePath, [IsFiltered], [IsArchived], GoodsInNumber, [StockCode], Batch,'      
   if(@RequireSupplierBatch> 0)      
   begin      
    set @query = @query + 'SupplierBatch,'      
   end      
   set @query = @query + 'Pallets,'      
   if(@InputByEaches > 0)      
   begin      
    set @query = @query + 'Eaches, EachUnits,'      
   end      
   set @query = @query + 'Units,'      
   if(@RequireBestBefore > 0)      
   begin      
    set @query = @query + 'BestBefore,'      
   end      
   if(@RequireManufactureDate > 0)      
   begin      
    set @query = @query + 'DateOfManufacture,'      
   end      
   if(@RequireDateOfReceipt > 0)      
   begin      
    set @query = @query + 'DateOfReceipt,'      
   end      
   if(@RequireExpiryDate > 0)      
   begin

   end      
   if(@RequirePalletNumber > 0)      
   begin      
    set @query = @query + 'CustomerPalletNumber,'      
   end         
   if(@RequireCustomerBarcode > 0)      
   begin      
    set @query = @query + 'CustomerBarcode,'      
   end      
   if(@RequireSpecialStockType > 0)      
   begin      
    set @query = @query + 'SpecialStockType,'      
   end      
   --if(@RequirePalletAdditionalField1 > 0)      
   --begin      
   -- set @query = @query + 'ExpiryDate,'      
   --end      
   --if(@RequirePalletAdditionalField2 > 0)      
   --begin      
   -- set @query = @query + 'ExpiryDate,'      
   --end      
   set @query = @query + 'PalletType, PalletStatus ,Actions, Remove from #results'      
   exec(@query)      
        break;      
  END TRY                
 BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */                
   DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;                
   SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;                
   SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;                
                
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID                
                            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;                
                            
   IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)                
   BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END                
   ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */                
  END CATCH                
  SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1                
 END

 drop table if exists #tmpstockinstogroup

 into #tmpcontainerinstogroup

   ,50)

     ,50)

 case when cdis.CustomerDocketIdentificationPK is null  then CASE WHEN  containerIns.ExternalReference <> '' THEN 'External Reference: '  + containerIns.ExternalReference ELSE ' ' end                               
  else case cdis.FieldFK                              
   when 1 then cdis.Prefix + ' ' + containerIns.Free1                              
   when 2 then cdis.Prefix + ' ' + containerIns.Free2                              
   when 3 then cdis.Prefix + ' ' + containerIns.Free3                              
   when 4 then cdis.Prefix + ' ' + containerIns.Free4                              
   when 5 then cdis.Prefix + ' ' + containerIns.Free5                              
   ELSE '' end

   else '' end

   when 1 then cdis.Prefix3 + ' ' + containerIns.Free1

  End as Reference,                              
  Case when status.StockInStatus = 'PendingRacking' then 'Arrived'  
  else  
 status.StockInStatus end [Status],                              
    case when containerIns.IsBeingBuilt = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ and containerins.headersonly = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ then 'Building'                              
   when containerIns.HeadersOnly = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ then 'Headers' else 'Ready'                                 
    end AS [File Status],

 stc.[Stock Code],                              
 bt.Batches ,                              
-- case when sils.units is null then cih.units else sils.units end as Units                
 case when  cih.units is null then sils.units else cih.units end as Units           
    FROM #tmpcontainerinstogroup as containerIns

 --left join #tmpstockinlines sils on sils.stockinfk = sins.stockinpk                              
 --left join #tmpcontainerinheader cih on cih.containerinfk = containerinpk

)             
AS            
BEGIN            
 /* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */            
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED            
            
    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,

 SET @var_GroupStockInFK = @groupstockinFK           
            
 SET @ParameterDetails = '@groupstockinFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_GroupStockInFK AS NVARCHAR(20)),'')

	 case when  cih.units is null then sils.units else cih.units end as Units 
 into #tmpunits    
 from tblContainerIns ci    
  inner join tblstockins sins on sins.containerinfk=ci.containerinpk

  left join (select distinct containerinfk, sum(units) Units from tblcontainerinheaders group by containerinfk) cih on cih.containerinfk = ci.containerinpk          
     
  where ci.stockingroupfk=@var_GroupStockInFK    
 -- select units  from #tmpunits  
  select sum(Units) as Units from #tmpunits

  END TRY

   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;            
            
            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID            
                        
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;

AS
BEGIN

         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY
			

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start

			select DivisionPK AS PK, '/images/HandlingCharges.png' AS ImagePath, cast(0 as bit) AS IsFiltered, cast(0 as bit) as IsArchived,
			DivisionName as [Division Name],
			DivisionCode as [Division Code],
			case                                                                                           
			when HandlingInEachesTypeFK=-1 and HandlingInUnitTypeFK=-1 then 
			cast(cast( HandlingInCharge  as numeric(10,2))as NVARCHAR(50))+' per  ' +
			--cast(cast(  HandlingInEachesNumber as numeric(10,1))as NVARCHAR(50)) +
			' Pallet' 
 
			when HandlingInEachesTypeFK > 0 and HandlingInUnitTypeFK=-1 then
			cast(cast( HandlingInCharge  as numeric(10,2))as NVARCHAR(50))+' per '+ 
			cast(cast(  HandlingInEachesNumber as numeric(10,1))as NVARCHAR(50))+
			' ' +(select EachesType from tblEachesTypes where EachesTypePK=HandlingInEachesTypeFK)

			when HandlingInEachesTypeFK =-1 and HandlingInUnitTypeFK>0 then
			cast(cast( HandlingInCharge  as numeric(10,2))as NVARCHAR(50))+' per ' +
			cast(cast(  HandlingInUnitsNumber as numeric(10,1))as NVARCHAR(50))+
			'  ' +(select Abbrieviation from tblEachesUnitTypes where HandlingInUnitTypeFK=EachesUnitTypePK)
			end as [Handling In],

			case 
			when HandlingOutEachesTypeFK=-1 and HandlingOutUnitTypeFK=-1 then 
			cast(cast( HandlingOutCharge  as numeric(10,2))as NVARCHAR(50))+' per ' +
			--cast(cast(  HandlingOutEachesNumber as numeric(10,2))as NVARCHAR(50)) +
			' Pallet'   
			when HandlingOutEachesTypeFK > 0 and HandlingOutUnitTypeFK=-1 then
			cast(cast( HandlingOutCharge  as numeric(10,2))as NVARCHAR(50))+' per ' +cast(cast(  HandlingOutEachesNumber as numeric(10,2))as NVARCHAR(50)) +' '+(select EachesTypeSingular from tblEachesTypes where EachesTypePK=HandlingOutEachesTypeFK)
			when HandlingOutEachesTypeFK =-1 and HandlingOutUnitTypeFK>0 then
			cast(cast( HandlingOutCharge  as numeric(10,2))as NVARCHAR(50))+' per ' +cast(cast(  HandlingOutUnitsNumber as numeric(10,2))as NVARCHAR(50))+' '+(select Abbrieviation from tblEachesUnitTypes where EachesUnitTypePK =HandlingOutUnitTypeFK)
			end as[Handling Out] 
			from tbldivisions

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end

			
			
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
