			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID

        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END


	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY
			

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start

			SELECT HealthCheckUserPK AS PK, '/images/User.png' AS ImagePath, cast(0 as bit) AS IsFiltered, cast(0 as bit) as IsArchived,  		
			(select HealthCheckName from tblHealthChecks where healthCheckPK =hcu.healthCheckFK)as [Health Check],
			(select FirstName +' '+ LastName from tblPeople ppl
			inner join tblUsers users on 
			ppl.PersonPK=users.PersonFK 
			where userPK=hcu.UserfK )as Name,
			'Email Sent Today' = CASE WHEN DATEPART(year,EmailSentDate) = DATEPART(year,dbo.GetBSTDate()) and  
			DATEPART(Month,EmailSentDate) = DATEPART(Month,dbo.GetBSTDate()) and 
			DATEPART(Day,EmailSentDate) = DATEPART(Day,dbo.GetBSTDate()) 
			THEN cast(1 as bit)
			ELSE cast(0 as bit)
			end,
			SendMorningEmail as [Send Morning Email],
			SendRealTimeEmail as [Send RealTime Email]
			FROM        dbo.tblHealthCheckUsers hcu 
			inner join tblHealthChecks hc on 
			hc.HealthCheckPK= hcu.HealthCheckFK
			Order by HealthCheckName,UserFK;

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end

			
			
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END

-- =============================================  
-- Author:  Jack Dalton  
-- Create date: 18/06/2018  
-- Description:   
-- =============================================  
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spGvIntegrationCheckEventsAll]   
(  
 @userFK INT,  
 @PageNumber INT = 0, --i.e. page number 1  
 @MaxRowsPerPage INT = 20,  
 @Search NVARCHAR (MAX) = NULL,  
 @SortOrder NVARCHAR (4) = 'DESC',  
 @SortField NVARCHAR (30) = 'Event Date2',  
 @showFailuresOnly bit = 0,
   @FromDate datetime = '19000101',  
  @ToDate datetime = '19000101' 
)   
AS  
BEGIN  
 /* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */  
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED  
  
    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT  
 ,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;  
 SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();  
  
 -- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters  
 DECLARE @var_userFK int, @var_PageNumber int, @var_MaxRowsPerPage int, @var_Search nvarchar(MAX), @var_SortOrder NVARCHAR (4),   
  @var_SortField NVARCHAR(30), @NoResultsFound INT = 0,@var_FromDate datetime, @var_ToDate datetime, @showFailuresOnly2 INT  
  
 SET @var_userFK = ISNULL(@userFK,-1)  
 SET @var_PageNumber = @PageNumber +1  
 SET @var_MaxRowsPerPage = @MaxRowsPerPage  
 SET @var_Search = ISNULL(@Search,'')  
 SET @var_SortOrder = ISNULL(@SortOrder,'DESC')  
 SET @var_SortField = ISNULL(@SortField,'Event Date2')  
 SET @showFailuresOnly2 = @showFailuresOnly
  SET @var_FromDate = @FromDate  
 SET @var_ToDate = @ToDate  
  
 SELECT @var_SortField = CASE WHEN @var_SortField <> 'Event Date' THEN @var_SortField ELSE 'Event Date2' END  
 SELECT @var_SortField = CASE WHEN @var_SortField <> '$NoSearch-Failure' THEN @var_SortField ELSE 'Failure' END  
 SELECT @var_SortField = CASE WHEN @var_SortField <> '$NoSearch-Acknowledged' THEN @var_SortField ELSE 'Acknowledged' END  
 SELECT @var_SortField = CASE WHEN @var_SortField <> '$NoSearch%Resolved' THEN @var_SortField ELSE 'Resolved' END  
 SELECT @var_SortField = CASE WHEN @var_SortField <> '$NoSearch%UnResolved' THEN @var_SortField ELSE 'UnResolved' END  
 SELECT @var_SortField = CASE WHEN @var_SortField <> '$NoSearch%Email' THEN @var_SortField ELSE 'Email' END  
  
 SELECT @var_Search = REPLACE (@var_Search, 'SearchField1', '[Event Date]')  
 SELECT @var_Search = REPLACE (@var_Search, 'SearchField2', 'Description')  
 SELECT @var_Search = REPLACE (@var_Search, 'SearchField3', '[Reference]')  
  
   
   
  
 SET @ParameterDetails = '@userFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_userFK AS NVARCHAR(20)),'')  
 + ',@PageNumber = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_PageNumber AS NVARCHAR(20)),'')  
   + ',@MaxRowsPerPage = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_MaxRowsPerPage AS NVARCHAR(20)),'')   
    + ',@Search = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_Search AS NVARCHAR(20)),'')  
     + ',@SortField = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_SortField AS NVARCHAR(20)),'')   
      + ',@SortOrder = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_SortOrder AS NVARCHAR(4)),'')  
       +',@showFailuresOnly = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@showFailuresOnly2 AS NVARCHAR(20)),'')  
  
 DECLARE @SQLInsertIntoTable NVARCHAR(MAX), @SQLSelect NVARCHAR(MAX), @SQLFromPart1 NVARCHAR(MAX), @SQLFromPart2 NVARCHAR(MAX),  
  @SQLFromCombined NVARCHAR(MAX), @SQLWhere NVARCHAR(MAX), @SQLOrderBy NVARCHAR(MAX), @currentSearchKeyword NVARCHAR(MAX),   
   @IsSearching BIT = 0, @RowNumber INT = 1, @TableAliasName NVARCHAR(50), @StartRow INT = 1, @EndRow INT = 20, @totalRecords INT  
  
    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL   
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)  
  
    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)  
    --BEGIN  
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC   
  
  SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)  
  
        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)  
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK  
  
        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()  
    --END  
  
  
 SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);  
 SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails  
 ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;  
 INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()  
  
 WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3  
 BEGIN   
  BEGIN TRY  
   set @var_Search = @var_Search + CASE WHEN ISNULL(@var_Search, '') = '' THEN' ' ELSE  ' and ' end + ' ([Event Date2] >= ''' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(20),@var_FromDate) + ''' and [Event Date2] <= ''' +  CONVERT(VARCHAR(20),@var_ToDate) + ''')'  
   SELECT @IsSearching = CASE WHEN ISNULL(@var_Search, '') = '' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END  
  
   -- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start  
  
   IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#Results') IS NOT NULL  
    DROP TABLE #Results  
  
   CREATE TABLE #Results  
   (  
    RowNumber INT IDENTITY(1,1),  
    PK INT,  
    ImagePath NVARCHAR (MAX),   
    IsFiltered INT,   
    IsArchived INT,  
    totalRecords INT,  
    [Event Date] NVARCHAR(max),  
    [Description] NVARCHAR(MAX),  
    Reference NVARCHAR(MAX),  
    Failure NVARCHAR(MAX),  
    Acknowledged NVARCHAR(MAX),  
    Resolved NVARCHAR(MAX),  
    UnResolved NVARCHAR(MAX),  
    Email NVARCHAR(MAX),  
    CurrentDataSet BIT,  
    [Event Date2] DATETIME  
   )  
  
   SET @SQLInsertIntoTable = 'INSERT INTO #Results  
          (  
           PK,  
           ImagePath,   
           IsFiltered,   
           IsArchived,  
           totalRecords,  
           [Event Date],  
           [Description],  
           Reference,  
           Failure,  
           Acknowledged,  
           Resolved,  
           UnResolved,  
           Email,  
           CurrentDataSet,  
           [Event Date2]  
          )  
            
          '  
  
print''  
print @SQLInsertIntoTable  
     
   SET @SQLSelect ='SELECT   
         PK,  
         ImagePath,   
         IsFiltered,   
         IsArchived,  
         totalRecords,  
         [Event Date],  
         [Description],  
         Reference,  
         Failure as [$NoSearch-Failure],  
         Acknowledged as [$NoSearch-Acknowledged],  
         Resolved as [$NoSearch%Resolved],  
         UnResolved as [$NoSearch%UnResolved],  
         Email as [$NoSearch%Email],  
         1 as [$hideCol%CurrentDataSet],  
         [Event Date2] as [$hideCol%EventDate2]  
         '  
  
print @SQLSelect  
   IF @var_SortField = ''  
    SET @var_SortField = 'Event Date2'  
   SET @SQLFromPart1 = 'FROM  
        (--Start of finalSubquery  
         SELECT   
          ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY ['+CAST(@var_SortField AS NVARCHAR(20))+'] '+CAST(@var_SortOrder AS NVARCHAR(4))+') AS rowNumber,  
          *, COUNT(*) OVER() AS TotalRecords  
         FROM  
          (--Start of subquery  
           SELECT Distinct IntegrationCheckEventPK AS PK,   
           ''/images/IntegrationEvent.png'' AS ImagePath,   
           ICEs.IsArchived, cast(0 as bit) AS IsFiltered,  
           divs.DivisionName,   
           CONVERT(VARCHAR(11),ICEs.InsertedDate,106) + '' '' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),ICEs.InsertedDate,108) [Event Date],  
           ICEs.InsertedDate as [Event Date2],   
           ICEs.EventDescription [Description],  
           ICEs.Reference,  
           case when ICTs.IsFailure = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/  
            then ''$imgIntegrationFailure.png'' else '''' End as Failure,  
           case when ICEs.Acknowledged = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/  
            then ''$imgAcknowledge.png'' else '''' End Acknowledged,  
           case when ICEs.Resolved = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/  
            then ''$imgComplete.png'' else '''' End Resolved,  
           case when ICEs.UnResolved = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/  
            then ''$imgUnResolve.png'' else '''' End UnResolved,  
           ''$jlnk%scr=window.location=''''mailto:?subject=Store-All Integration&body=Store-All Integration Event Message:%0D%0AEvent Type: ''   
           + ICTs.IntegrationCheckTypeDescription + ''%0D%0AEvent Description: '' + ICEs.EventDescription + ''%0D%0AReference: ''   
           + ICEs.Reference + ''%txt=Email'' as Email   
           from tblIntegrationCheckEvents ICEs  
           inner join appIntegrationCheckTypes ICTs on  
           ICTs.IntegrationCheckTypePK = ICEs.IntegrationCheckTypeFK  
           left outer join tblDivisions divs on  
           divs.DivisionPK = ICEs.DivisionFK  
           left outer join tblCustomers cus on  
           cus.CustomerPK = ICEs.CustomerFK  
           Where ICTs.IsFailure = case when '+CAST(@showFailuresOnly2 AS NVARCHAR(20))+' = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ then 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ else ICTs.IsFailure end  
           --Order By IntegrationCheckEventPK Desc  
          ) AS subquery  
        )AS finalSubquery '  
  
print @SQLFromPart1  
  
   SET @SQLWHERE = 'WHERE '  
   SET @TableAliasName = 'finalSubquery'  
      
   IF @IsSearching = 0   
   BEGIN  
    SET @SQLWhere += 'finalSubquery.rowNumber BETWEEN (((' + CAST(@var_PageNumber AS NVARCHAR(20))+ ' * '+CAST(@var_MaxRowsPerPage AS NVARCHAR (20))+') - '+CAST(@var_MaxRowsPerPage AS NVARCHAR(20))+') + 1) /*start row*/   
          AND ((' + CAST(@var_PageNumber AS NVARCHAR(20)) +' * ' + CAST(@var_MaxRowsPerPage AS NVARCHAR (20))+ ' )) /*end row*/ '   
   END  
   IF @IsSearching = 1  
   BEGIN  
    IF @var_Search <> ''  
    BEGIN  
     SET @SQLWhere += @var_Search  
    END  
   END  
  
PRINT @SQLWhere  
  
   IF ISNULL(@var_SortField,'') <> '' AND ISNULL(@var_SortOrder, '') <> ''  
   BEGIN  
    SET @SQLOrderBy = 'ORDER BY   
         ['+@var_SortField+']'+' '+@var_SortOrder  
   END  
PRINT @SQLOrderBy  
     
   DECLARE @MaxRowNumber INT  
   SELECT @MaxRowNumber = MAX(RowNumber) FROM #Results  
  
   IF @IsSearching = 0  
   BEGIN  
    EXEC(@SQLSelect + @SQLFromPart1 + @SQLWhere + @SQLOrderBy)  
    PRINT 'Exiting this stored procedure after executing non-search'  
    RETURN  
   END  
  
  
   EXEC(@SQLInsertIntoTable + @SQLSelect + @SQLFromPart1 + @SQLWhere + @SQLOrderBy)  
  
   UPDATE #Results WITH (ROWLOCK)  
   SET CurrentDataSet = 0  
   WHERE RowNumber <= @MaxRowNumber  
     
   SELECT @totalRecords = COUNT(*)  
   FROM #Results WHERE CurrentDataSet = 1  
  
--PRINT''  
PRINT '@TotalRecords = ' +cast(isnull(@totalRecords, 0) as NVARCHAR(50))  
  
   --Calculate start and end records  
   IF @IsSearching = 1  
   BEGIN  
    SELECT @EndRow = (@var_PageNumber * @var_MaxRowsPerPage) + (SELECT MIN(RowNumber) FROM #Results WHERE CurrentDataSet = 1) - 1  
    SELECT @StartRow = @EndRow - @var_MaxRowsPerPage + 1  
  
  
   SELECT  
   PK,  
   ImagePath,   
   IsFiltered,   
   IsArchived,  
   @totalRecords as TotalRecords,  
   [Event Date],  
   [Description],  
   Reference,  
   Failure as [$NoSearch-Failure],  
   Acknowledged as [$NoSearch-Acknowledged],  
   Resolved as [$NoSearch%Resolved],  
   UnResolved as [$NoSearch%UnResolved],  
   Email as [$NoSearch%Email],  
   1 as [$hideCol%CurrentDataSet],  
   [Event Date2] as [$hideCol%EventDate2]  
    FROM  
    #Results as SR  
     WHERE SR.CurrentDataSet = 1  
     AND SR.RowNumber BETWEEN @StartRow AND @EndRow  
     ORDER BY   
      SR.RowNumber ASC  
   END   
   PRINT'HERE'  
   PRINT ''  
PRINT '@StartRow = '+cast(isnull(@StartRow, 0) as NVARCHAR(50))  
PRINT '@EndRow = ' +cast(isnull(@EndRow, 0) AS NVARCHAR(50))  
  
   -- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end  
  
  BREAK  
  END TRY  
  BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */  
   DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;  
   SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;  
   SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;  
  
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY   
   BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;  
         
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;  
  
            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID  
              
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;  
              
   IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)  
   BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END  
   ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */  
  END CATCH  
  SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1  
 END  
END
GO

-- =================================================================================================================================================================
-- Author:      Cathal OCuirrin
-- Create Date: 30 July 2018
-- Description: Returns values from associated file stock out line records to the gvFileStockOutLines gridview on ..\STAWMS\StockInOutEdits\StockOrderEditPage.aspx
-- =================================================================================================================================================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spGvIntegrationFileStockOutPickDetails]
(
	@containerOutFK INT --= 67149 --67485
	,@userFK INT = 0
	,@returnResults BIT = 1
)
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT
	,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;
	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

	SET @ParameterDetails = '@containerOutFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@containerOutFK AS NVARCHAR(100)),'') + ',@userFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@userFK AS NVARCHAR(100)),'')
		+ ',@returnResults = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@returnResults AS NVARCHAR(100)),'')

	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	DECLARE @var_ContainerOutFK INT = ISNULL(@containerOutFK, -1), @var_UserFK INT = ISNULL(@userFK, 0), @var_ReturnResults INT = ISNULL(@returnResults, 1)

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    --BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

		SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END

	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY
			
			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start

			IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#FileLinesPreChanges') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #FileLinesPreChanges

			SELECT 
				FileLines.*
			INTO 
				#FileLinesPreChanges
			FROM
				dbo.tblIntegrationFileStockOutLines AS FileLines
			INNER JOIN dbo.tblIntegrationFileStockOuts AS FileHeader
				ON FileLines.IntegrationFileStockOutFK = FileHeader.IntegrationFileStockOutPK
			WHERE
				FileHeader.ContainerOutFK = @var_ContainerOutFK

			-- Get initial details

			IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#FileStockOutPickDetails') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #FileStockOutPickDetails
	
			SELECT DISTINCT
				ROW_NUMBER() OVER(
									ORDER BY PickIsOk ASC, ABS(QuantityOrdered - COLQuantityPicked) DESC, FileLines.SAPLineNumber DESC, FileLines.StockItemCode ASC,		
										(CASE 
											WHEN ISNULL(FileLines.FileBatch,'') IN ('','NOBATCH') THEN 
											(
												CASE WHEN ISNULL(FileLines.COLBatch,'') = '' THEN FileLines.FileBatch ELSE FileLines.COLBatch + '*' END
											) 
											ELSE FileLines.FileBatch 
										END)		
								) AS RowNumber,

				FileHeader.IntegrationFileStockOutPK,
				FileLines.IntegrationFileStockOutLinePK,				
				FileLines.SAPLineNumber AS SAPLineNo, 
				FileLines.StockItemCode AS StockCode,
				FileLines.COLStockItemCode,
				FileLines.FileBatch,
				CASE 
					WHEN ISNULL(FileLines.FileBatch,'') IN ('','NOBATCH') THEN 
					(
						CASE WHEN ISNULL(FileLines.COLBatch,'') = '' THEN FileLines.FileBatch ELSE FileLines.COLBatch END
					) 
					ELSE FileLines.FileBatch 
				END AS ColBatch,
				PS.PalletStatus AS [Status],
				FileLines.QuantityOrdered AS QtyOrdered,	
				FileLines.COLQuantityPicked AS QtyPicked,	
				ABS(FileLines.QuantityOrdered - FileLines.COLQuantityPicked) AS [Diff],
				FileLines.PickIsOk,	
				FileLines.IssueDesc,
				FileLines.ContainerOutLineFK,
				FileLines.COLPalletStatusFK,
				FileHeader.DivisionFK,
				SI.StockItemPK
			INTO
				#FileStockOutPickDetails				
			FROM
				#FileLinesPreChanges AS FileLines
			INNER JOIN dbo.tblIntegrationFileStockOuts AS FileHeader
				ON FileLines.IntegrationFileStockOutFK = FileHeader.IntegrationFileStockOutPK
			LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.tblStockItems AS SI
				ON SI.StockItemCode = FileLines.StockItemCode
				AND FileHeader.DivisionFK = SI.DivisionFK
			LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.appPalletStatus AS PS
				ON FileLines.STAWMSPalletStatusFK = PS.PalletStatusPK
			WHERE
				FileHeader.ContainerOutFK = @var_ContainerOutFK	

			-- Get combined/summed (if applicable) container out details

			DECLARE @RowNumber INT, @ContainerOutLineFK INT, @QuantityPicked DECIMAL(18, 3), @StockItemCode NVARCHAR(200), @Batch NVARCHAR(200), @PalletStatusFK INT, @PalletStatus NVARCHAR(200)

			DECLARE @ContainerOutLineCursor AS CURSOR; SET @ContainerOutLineCursor = CURSOR FAST_FORWARD FOR SELECT RowNumber, ContainerOutLineFK FROM #FileStockOutPickDetails;
			OPEN @ContainerOutLineCursor; FETCH NEXT FROM @ContainerOutLineCursor INTO @RowNumber, @ContainerOutLineFK;

			WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
			BEGIN 
				IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#CombinedResults') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #CombinedResults

				-- Get ContainerOutLines & FileBatch details

				SELECT 
					SUM(ISNULL(COLPC.Units,0)) AS QuantityPicked, 
					SO.StockItemCode, 
					COL.Batch, 
					ISNULL(P.PalletStatusFK, -1) AS PalletStatusFK, 
					CASE 
						WHEN ISNULL(IFSOL.FileBatch,'') IN ('','NOBATCH') THEN 
							'NOBATCH' 
						ELSE 
							IFSOL.FileBatch 
					END AS FileBatch
				INTO
					#CombinedResults
				FROM 
					dbo.tblIntegrationFileStockOutLines AS IFSOL
				INNER JOIN dbo.tblContainerOutLines AS COL
					ON IFSOL.ContainerOutLineFK = COL.ContainerOutLinePK
				LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.tblContainerOutLinePalletContent AS COLPC 
					ON COL.ContainerOutLinePK = COLPC.ContainerOutLineFK 
				LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.tblPallets AS P 
					ON COLPC.palletfk = P.palletpk
				LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.tblStockItems AS SO 
					ON COL.StockItemFK = SO.StockItemPK 
					AND COL.DivisionFK = SO.DivisionFK
				LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.appPalletStatus AS PS 
					ON P.PalletStatusFK = PS.PalletStatusPK
				WHERE	
					COL.ContainerOutLinePK  = @ContainerOutLineFK
				GROUP BY 
					SO.StockItemCode, COL.Batch, P.PalletStatusFK, IFSOL.FileBatch										

				-- Change batch value where there are multiple nobatch lines for the same stock code and pallet status but with different auto picked batch codes.

				UPDATE T
				SET 
					T.BATCH = 'MULTIBATCH'
				FROM 
					#CombinedResults AS T
				INNER JOIN (
								SELECT StockItemCode, PalletStatusFK, COUNT(StockItemCode + CAST(PalletStatusFK AS NVARCHAR(50))) AS SP
								FROM #CombinedResults WHERE FileBatch IN ('','NOBATCH') 
								GROUP BY StockItemCode, PalletStatusFK
								HAVING COUNT(StockItemCode + CAST(PalletStatusFK AS NVARCHAR(50))) > 1
							) AS M
					ON T.StockItemCode = M.StockItemCode
					AND T.PalletStatusFK = M.PalletStatusFK
				WHERE 
					T.FileBatch IN ('','NOBATCH') 	

				-- Get the combined/summed container out line record

				IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ContainerOutLineDetails') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #ContainerOutLineDetails

				SELECT
					SUM(T.QuantityPicked) AS QuantityPicked, T.StockItemCode, T.Batch, T.PalletStatusFK
				INTO
					#ContainerOutLineDetails					
				FROM 
					#CombinedResults AS T
				INNER JOIN dbo.tblIntegrationFileStockOutLines AS IFSOL
					ON T.StockItemCode = IFSOL.StockItemCode
					AND T.PalletStatusFK = IFSOL.STAWMSPalletStatusFK
				WHERE
					IFSOL.ContainerOutLineFK = @ContainerOutLineFK
				GROUP BY 
					T.StockItemCode, T.Batch, T.PalletStatusFK			

				UPDATE #FileStockOutPickDetails
				SET 
					QtyPicked = 0.000,
					ColBatch = '',
					ColStockItemCode = '',
					COLPalletStatusFK = -1
				WHERE 
					RowNumber = @RowNumber

				IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #ContainerOutLineDetails)
				BEGIN
					SELECT TOP 1 
						@QuantityPicked = COLD.QuantityPicked, 
						@StockItemCode = COLD.StockItemCode, 
						@Batch = COLD.Batch, 
						@PalletStatusFK = COLD.PalletStatusFK, 
						@PalletStatus = PS.PalletStatus 
					FROM 
						#ContainerOutLineDetails AS COLD
					LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.appPalletStatus AS PS
						ON COLD.PalletStatusFK = PS.PalletStatusPK		

					-- Add the combined/summed container out details into the results table.

					UPDATE #FileStockOutPickDetails
					SET 
						QtyPicked = @QuantityPicked,
						ColBatch = @Batch,
						ColStockItemCode = @StockItemCode,
						[Status] = @PalletStatus,
						IssueDesc = CASE
										WHEN @QuantityPicked = QtyOrdered THEN NULL
										ELSE IssueDesc
									END,
						PickIsOk = CASE
										WHEN @QuantityPicked = QtyOrdered THEN 1
										ELSE PickIsOk
									END,
						Diff = ABS(QtyOrdered - @QuantityPicked),
						COLPalletStatusFK = @PalletStatusFK	
					WHERE 
						RowNumber = @RowNumber
				END

				FETCH NEXT FROM @ContainerOutLineCursor INTO @RowNumber, @ContainerOutLineFK
			END

			CLOSE @ContainerOutLineCursor
			DEALLOCATE @ContainerOutLineCursor

			-- Update the associated IntegrationFileStockOutLines records with the combined/summed container out details in the results table.

			BEGIN TRANSACTION

				UPDATE FileLines
				SET 
					COLQuantityPicked = FSOPD.QtyPicked,
					COLBatch = CASE WHEN REPLACE(ISNULL(FileLines.COLBatch, 'NOBATCH'), 'NOBATCH', '') = REPLACE(FSOPD.ColBatch, 'NOBATCH', '') THEN FileLines.COLBatch ELSE FSOPD.ColBatch END,
					COLStockItemCode = FSOPD.COLStockItemCode,
					COLPalletStatusFK = FSOPD.COLPalletStatusFK
				FROM
					dbo.tblIntegrationFileStockOutLines AS FileLines
				INNER JOIN #FileStockOutPickDetails AS FSOPD
					ON FileLines.IntegrationFileStockOutLinePK = FSOPD.IntegrationFileStockOutLinePK

				UPDATE FileLines
				SET
					PickIsOk = 1,
					IssueDesc = NULL
				FROM
					dbo.tblIntegrationFileStockOutLines AS FileLines
				INNER JOIN #FileStockOutPickDetails AS FSOPD
					ON FileLines.IntegrationFileStockOutLinePK = FSOPD.IntegrationFileStockOutLinePK
				WHERE
					FileLines.QuantityOrdered = FileLines.COLQuantityPicked

				UPDATE FileLines
				SET
					PickIsOK =	CASE
									WHEN FileLines.QuantityOrdered = FileLines.COLQuantityPicked THEN 1
									WHEN FileLines.QuantityOrdered <> FileLines.COLQuantityPicked AND FileLines.COLQuantityPicked <> T.COLQuantityPicked THEN 0
									ELSE FileLines.PickIsOK
								END,

					IssueDesc = CASE
									WHEN FileLines.QuantityOrdered <> FileLines.COLQuantityPicked THEN 'QtyOrdered/Picked mismatch'
									WHEN FileLines.StockItemCode <> FileLines.COLStockItemCode THEN 'StockCode mismatch'
									WHEN ISNULL(FileLines.FileBatch,'') NOT IN ('', 'NOBATCH') AND FileLines.FileBatch <> FileLines.COLBatch THEN 'Batch mismatch'
									WHEN FileLines.STAWMSPalletStatusFK <> FileLines.COLPalletStatusFK THEN 'Status mismatch'
									ELSE FileLines.IssueDesc
								END
				FROM
					dbo.tblIntegrationFileStockOutLines AS FileLines
				INNER JOIN #FileLinesPreChanges AS T
					ON FileLines.IntegrationFileStockOutLinePK = T.IntegrationFileStockOutLinePK

				UPDATE FileLines 
				SET FileLines.IssueDesc = 'No matching line(s)'
				FROM dbo.tblIntegrationFileStockOutLines FileLines
				INNER JOIN dbo.tblIntegrationFileStockOuts AS FileHeader
					ON FileLines.IntegrationFileStockOutFK = FileHeader.IntegrationFileStockOutPK
				WHERE FileHeader.ContainerOutFK = @var_ContainerOutFK
				AND FileLines.COLPalletStatusFK = -1
				AND FileLines.COLQuantityPicked = 0.000

				UPDATE FileLines
				SET
					UpdatedBy = @var_UserFK,
					UpdatedDate = dbo.GetBSTDate()
				FROM
					dbo.tblIntegrationFileStockOutLines AS FileLines
				INNER JOIN #FileLinesPreChanges AS T
					ON FileLines.IntegrationFileStockOutLinePK = T.IntegrationFileStockOutLinePK
				WHERE
					FileLines.PickIsOk <> T.PickIsOk
					OR FileLines.COLBatch <> T.COLBatch
					OR FileLines.COLPalletStatusFK <> T.COLPalletStatusFK
					OR FileLines.COLQuantityPicked <> T.COLQuantityPicked
					OR FileLines.COLStockItemCode <> T.COLStockItemCode		
					OR FileLines.IssueDesc <> T.IssueDesc /*Jamie : also set updated date if the description changes */

			COMMIT TRANSACTION

			IF @var_ReturnResults = 0 RETURN

			-- Return the results to the gridview.

			SELECT DISTINCT
				FileHeader.IntegrationFileStockOutPK,
				FileLines.IntegrationFileStockOutLinePK,				
				FileLines.SAPLineNumber AS SAPLineNo, 
				FileLines.StockItemCode AS StockCode,
				CASE 
					WHEN ISNULL(FileLines.FileBatch,'') IN ('','NOBATCH') THEN 
					(
						CASE WHEN ISNULL(FileLines.COLBatch,'') = '' THEN FileLines.FileBatch ELSE FileLines.COLBatch + '*' END
					) 
					ELSE FileLines.FileBatch 
				END AS Batch,
				PS.PalletStatus AS [Status],
				FileLines.QuantityOrdered AS QtyOrdered,	
				FileLines.COLQuantityPicked AS QtyPicked,	
				ABS(QuantityOrdered - COLQuantityPicked) AS [Diff],
				FileLines.PickIsOk,	
				FileLines.IssueDesc		
			FROM
				dbo.tblIntegrationFileStockOutLines AS FileLines
			INNER JOIN dbo.tblIntegrationFileStockOuts AS FileHeader
				ON FileLines.IntegrationFileStockOutFK = FileHeader.IntegrationFileStockOutPK
			LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.tblStockItems AS SI
				ON SI.StockItemCode = FileLines.StockItemCode
			LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.appPalletStatus AS PS
				ON FileLines.STAWMSPalletStatusFK = PS.PalletStatusPK
			WHERE
				FileHeader.ContainerOutFK = @var_ContainerOutFK	
			ORDER BY
				PickIsOk ASC, [Diff] DESC, SAPLineNo ASC, StockCode ASC, Batch ASC

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end
			
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END

-- =============================================================================================================================================================================
-- Author:      Cathal OCuirrin
-- Create Date: 30 July 2018
-- Description: Returns total values from associated file stock out line records to the gvFileStockOutLinesTotals gridview on ..\STAWMS\StockInOutEdits\StockOrderEditPage.aspx
-- =============================================================================================================================================================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spGvIntegrationFileStockOutQtyTotals]
(
	@ContainerOutFK INT = -1
)
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT
	,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;
	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	DECLARE @var_ContainerOutFK INT = ISNULL(@ContainerOutFK, -1)

	SET @ParameterDetails = '@ContainerOutFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_ContainerOutFK AS NVARCHAR(100)),'')

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    --BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

		SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END

	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY	

			-- This stored procedures main code, excluding error handling - start		

			DECLARE @var_TotalQtyOrdered DECIMAL(18,3), @var_TotalQtyPicked DECIMAL(18,3), @var_IssuesExist NVARCHAR(3) = 'No'

			SELECT
				@var_TotalQtyOrdered = SUM(ISNULL(FileLines.QuantityOrdered,0))	
			FROM
				tblIntegrationFileStockOutLines AS FileLines
			INNER JOIN tblIntegrationFileStockOuts AS FileHeader
				ON FileLines.IntegrationFileStockOutFK = FileHeader.IntegrationFileStockOutPK
			WHERE
				FileHeader.ContainerOutFK = @var_ContainerOutFK

			SELECT
				@var_IssuesExist = 'Yes'
			FROM
				tblIntegrationFileStockOutLines AS FileLines
			INNER JOIN tblIntegrationFileStockOuts AS FileHeader
				ON FileLines.IntegrationFileStockOutFK = FileHeader.IntegrationFileStockOutPK
			WHERE
				FileHeader.ContainerOutFK = @var_ContainerOutFK
				AND ISNULL(FileLines.IssueDesc,'') <> ''

			-- Note: not joining to the tblIntegrationFileStockOut tables to ensure all lines, including those creaded by the user, are included in the calculation.

			SELECT		
				@var_TotalQtyPicked = SUM(ISNULL(COLPC.Units,0))
			FROM
				tblContainerOuts AS CO
			LEFT OUTER JOIN tblContainerOutLines AS COL
				ON CO.ContainerOutPK = COL.ContainerOutFK
			LEFT OUTER JOIN [dbo].[tblContainerOutLinePalletContent] AS COLPC 
				ON COL.ContainerOutLinePK = COLPC.ContainerOutLineFK
			WHERE
				CO.ContainerOutPK = @var_ContainerOutFK

			IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#OverallPickIsOk') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #OverallPickIsOk

			CREATE TABLE #OverallPickIsOk(OverallPickIsOk BIT)

			INSERT INTO #OverallPickIsOk
			EXEC dbo.spIsIntegrationFileStockOutPickOk @var_ContainerOutFK

			SELECT
				@var_TotalQtyOrdered AS [Total Qty Ordered],
				@var_TotalQtyPicked AS [Total Qty Picked],
				CASE WHEN @var_TotalQtyOrdered = @var_TotalQtyPicked THEN 'Yes'
				ELSE 'No' END AS [Total Qtys Match],
				CASE WHEN OverallPickIsOK = 0 THEN 'No' ELSE 'Yes' END AS [Overall Pick Is OK],
				@var_IssuesExist AS [Issues Exist]
			FROM
				#OverallPickIsOk

			-- This stored procedures main code, excluding error handling - end

			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END

-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spGvInvoiceCheckList]
(
	@CustomerFK int = -1,
	@StartDate datetime = NULL,
	@EndDate datetime = NULL
)
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data; Ensure this proc has a low impact when executed */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED; SET DEADLOCK_PRIORITY LOW

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT
	,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;
	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	DECLARE @CustomerFK2 int, @StartDate2 datetime, @EndDate2 datetime

	SET @customerFK2 = @CustomerFK;

	SET @startDate2 = ISNULL(@StartDate, '01-01-1900')
	--SET @startDate2 = @StartDate;

	SET @endDate2 = ISNULL( @EndDate, GETDATE())
	--SET @EndDate2 = @EndDate;

	SET @ParameterDetails = '@customerFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@customerFK2 AS NVARCHAR(20)),'') +
						    ',@StartDate = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@startDate2 AS NVARCHAR(30)),'') + 
							',@EndDate = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@endDate2 AS NVARCHAR(30)),'')


    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

	SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)

    INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
    SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

    SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()


	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN
		BEGIN TRY
			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end
				BEGIN
					Select 
						InvoicePK AS PK,
						'/images/invoice.png' AS ImagePath,
						invs.IsArchived,
						cast(0 as bit) AS IsFiltered,
						'Invoice' As [Report Type],
						invs.InvoiceNumber As [Invoice Number], 
						convert(varchar(50), invs.InvoiceToDate, 106) as [Date], 
						cus.CustomerName as [Customer Name],
						cus.CustomerCode as [Customer Code],
						invs.Charge As [Charge],
						invs.Tax,
						invs.Tax + invs.Charge as [Total],
						invs.Approved
					From tblInvoices invs
						left outer join tblDivisions divs on divs.DivisionPK = invs.DivisionFK
						left outer join tblCustomers cus on cus.CustomerPK = invs.CustomerFK OR cus.CustomerPK = divs.CustomerFK
					Where
						Approved = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ 
						AND QueuedForExport = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/
						AND Exported = 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/
						AND invs.InvoiceToDate >= @startDate2
						AND invs.InvoiceToDate <= @endDate2 
						AND ((cus.CustomerPK = @customerFK2) Or (@customerFK2 = -1)) 
					UNION
					Select
						crdNote.CreditNotePK AS PK,
						'/images/creditnote.png' AS ImagePath,
						crdNote.IsArchived,
						cast(0 as bit) AS IsFiltered,
						'Credit Note' As [Report Type],
						crdNote.CreditNoteNumber As [Invoice Number], 
						convert(varchar(50), crdNote.CreditToDate, 106) as [Date], 
						cus.CustomerName As [Customer Name],
						cus.CustomerCode As [Customer Code],
						crdNote.CreditNoteValue As [Charge],
						crdNote.Tax,
						crdNote.Tax + crdNote.CreditNoteValue as [Total],
						crdNote.Approved
					From tblCreditNotes crdNote
						left outer join tblDivisions divs on divs.DivisionPK = crdNote.DivisionFK
						left outer join tblCustomers cus on cus.CustomerPK = crdNote.CustomerFK OR cus.CustomerPK = divs.CustomerFK
					Where
						Approved = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ 
						AND QueuedForExport = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/
						AND Exported = 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/
						AND crdNote.CreditToDate >= @startDate2
						AND crdNote.CreditToDate <= @endDate2 
						AND ((cus.CustomerPK = @customerFK2) Or (@customerFK2 = -1))
					Order By Date Desc
				END
			BREAK
			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
				DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
				SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
				SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

				BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
				BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
				BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

				IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
				IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
				IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
				BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
				ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
	
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END
GO

-- exec spGvInvoiceLines 29514  
  
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spGvInvoiceLines]    
(    
 @invoiceFK int    
)     
AS    
BEGIN    
 /* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data; Ensure this proc has a low impact when executed */    
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED; SET DEADLOCK_PRIORITY LOW    
    
    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT    
 ,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;    
 SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();    
    
 -- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters    
 DECLARE @var_invoiceFK int    
 SET @var_invoiceFK = @invoiceFK    
 SET @ParameterDetails = '@invoiceFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_invoiceFK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'')    
    
    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL     
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)    
    
 --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)    
 --BEGIN    
  SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC     
    
  SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)    
    
  INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)    
  SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK    
    
  SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()    
 --END    
    
 SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);    
 SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails    
 ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;    
 INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()    
    
 WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3    
 BEGIN     
  BEGIN TRY       
    
   -- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start    
    
   --Declare @divisionFK int    
   --Select top 1 @divisionFK = DivisionFK from tblInvoices where InvoicePK = @var_invoiceFK    
    
   --DECLARE  @NumberTaxRate int    
   --SET @NumberTaxRate = (SELECT Count(Distinct(TaxRate))     
   --       FROM tblInvoiceLines    
   --       Where InvoiceFK = @var_invoiceFK)    
    
   Select     
    invoiceLines.InvoiceLinePK,    
        
    --Building Unit    
    buildings.BuildingName + ' - ' + bu.BuildingUnit as BuildingUnit,   
   -- Department: DepartmentName[DepartmentCode] or BuildingName[DepartmentCode] if no DepartmentName    
    ISNULL(NULLIF(departments.DepartmentName, ''), buildings.BuildingName)   
        + ' [' + ISNULL(departments.DepartmentCode, 'NO CODE') + ']' as Department,    
           
    invoiceLines.ChargeText,    
    invoiceLines.ChargeText1,    
    invoiceLines.ChargeText2,    
    invoiceLines.ChargeText3,    
    invoiceLines.ChargeText4,    
    
    invoiceLines.Charge,    
    
    -- DG #Dev-740    
    Case when vatCodes.VatCodePK = 5 then 0 else invoiceLines.TaxRate end as TaxRate,    
    Case when vatCodes.VatCodePK = 5 then 0 else invoiceLines.Tax end as Tax,    
    
    --invoices.Charge As TotalCharge,    
    --(invoices.Charge + invoices.Tax) as GrandTotal    
    --@NumberTaxRate  as NumberOfTaxRates  
	ISNULL(invoiceLines.ChargeText, '') + ' [' + ISNULL(invoiceLines.NominalCode, 'NO CODE') + ']' as NominalCode
  from     
    tblInvoices as invoices    
   inner join tblInvoiceLines as invoiceLines    
    on invoiceLines.InvoiceFK = invoices.InvoicePK    
   /*    
   inner join tblDivisions as divisions    
    on divisions.DivisionPK = invoices.DivisionFK    
    
   left outer join tblContacts as invoiceContacts    
    on invoiceContacts.ContactPK = divisions.InvoiceContactFK    
    AND invoiceContacts.IsArchived = 0    
   inner join appSystem as [system]    
    on 1=1    
   inner join tblCurrencies as currencies    
    on currencies.CurrencyPK = [system].InvoiceCurrencyFK    
   left outer join (    
        Select Top 1 InvoiceToDate from tblInvoices    
        Where DivisionFK = @divisionFK    
        AND InvoicePK not in (Select Top 1 InvoicePK from tblInvoices where DivisionFK = @divisionFK order by InvoiceToDate Desc)    
        order by InvoiceToDate Desc    
       ) as lastInvoice    
    on 1=1*/    
   left join tblBuildingUnits as bu     
    on invoiceLines.buildingunitfk = bu.buildingunitpk    
   left join tblBuildings as buildings     
    on bu.buildingfk = buildings.buildingpk    
   left outer join tblVatCodes as vatCodes    
    on invoiceLines.VatCodeFK = vatCodes.VatCodePK    
   left outer join tblDepartments as departments    
    on invoiceLines.DepartmentFK = departments.DepartmentPK    
   --left outer join tblBuildingUnits bus on    
   -- bus.BuildingUnitPK = departments.BuildingUnitFK    
   where     
    invoices.InvoicePK = @var_invoiceFK    
    
   -- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end    
          
   BREAK    
  END TRY    
  BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */    
   DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;    
   SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;    
   SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;    
    
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY     
   BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;    
           
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;    
    
            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID    
                
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;    
                
   IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)    
   BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END    
   ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */    
  END CATCH    
  SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1    
 END    
END 
GO

			into #tmpAllInvoices
			from tblInvoices
			where (@showArchived2=1 or (DATEDIFF(month,InvoiceToDate, dbo.GetBSTDate()) <= 12))

			SELECT Distinct InvoicePK AS PK, '/images/invoice.png' AS ImagePath, invoices.IsArchived, cast(0 as bit) AS IsFiltered,-- InvoicePK,

				case when invoices.Approved = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ then '$imgInvoiceApproved.png' else '' End Approved,

			left outer join tblDivisions divisions ON divisions.DivisionPK = invoices.DivisionFK

			left outer join tblInvoiceLines invoiceLines ON invoiceLines.InvoiceFK = invoices.InvoicePK
			inner join appInvoiceTypes it on it.InvoiceTypeFK = invoices.InvoiceTypeFK
			Where (ChargeText is null or ChargeText <> 'Invoicing Primer') --AND (@showArchived2=1 or (DATEDIFF(month,invoices.InvoiceToDate, dbo.GetBSTDate()) <= 12))

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spGvLocationDrillDownPalletSearch]

 /* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */    
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED    
    
    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT    
 ,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;    
 SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();    
    
 -- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters    
 DECLARE @locationFK2 int, @barcode2 nvarchar(200), @loadingBayFK2 int, @setDownAreaFK2 int     
    
 SET @locationFK2 = @locationFK; SET @barcode2 = @barcode; SET @loadingBayFK2 = @loadingBayFK; SET @setDownAreaFK2 = @setDownAreaFK    
    
 SET @ParameterDetails = '@locationFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@locationFK2 AS NVARCHAR(20)),'') + ',@barcode = ' + ISNULL(@barcode2,'')    
  + ',@loadingBayFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@loadingBayFK2 AS NVARCHAR(20)),'') + ',@setDownAreaFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@setDownAreaFK2 AS NVARCHAR(20)),'')    
    
    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL     
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)    
    
    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)    
    --BEGIN    
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC     
    
  SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)    
    
        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)    
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK    
    
        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()    
    --END    
    
    
 SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);    
 SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails    
 ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;    
 INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()    
    
 WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3    
 BEGIN     
  BEGIN TRY    
       
    
   -- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start    
    
   IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#Tmp_locations') IS NOT NULL     
    drop table #Tmp_locations    
    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#Tmp_Pallets') IS NOT NULL     
     drop table #Tmp_Pallets    
    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#Tmp_PalletContent') IS NOT NULL     
    drop table #Tmp_PalletContent    
    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#Tmp_OnOrder') IS NOT NULL     
    drop table #Tmp_OnOrder    
    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#Tmp_OpenMOvements') IS NOT NULL     
    drop Table #Tmp_OpenMOvements    
    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#Tmp_PendingOnOrder') IS NOT NULL     
    drop Table #Tmp_PendingOnOrder    
    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#Tmp_PendingPalletContent') IS NOT NULL     
    drop Table #Tmp_PendingPalletContent      
    
    
   -- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start    
   -- Get the racking Type    
   Declare @rackingTypeFK int    
   DECLARE @ColumnNo int    
   Select @rackingTypeFK = RackingTypeFK,    
          @ColumnNo = BuildingUnitColumnPK from tblBuildingUnitBays buBays inner join tblBuildingUnitColumns buCols     
   on buCols.BuildingUnitColumnPK = buBays.BuildingUnitColumnFK inner join tblBuildingUnitRows buRows     
   on buRows.BuildingUnitRowPK = buCols.BuildingUnitRowFK where BuildingUnitBayPK = @locationFK2     
       
   select *     
   INTO #Tmp_locations from viewBuildingUnitBays     
   where locationTypefk = 1 and     
     (@rackingTypeFK = 1 and BuildingUnitBayPK = @locationFK2) OR    
     (@rackingTypeFK = 2 and BuildingUnitCOlumnFK = @ColumnNo and IsArchived=0)    
         
   -- get pallet details     
   Select palletpk,     
   p.isarchived ,    
   case when p.CustomerBarcode = '' then p.Barcode else p.CustomerBarcode end as Barcode, p.CustomerPalletNumber,    
   BuildingUnitBayLocation as Location ,    
   LocateFromLeft as FromLeftToRight , PalletTypeFK, palletstatusfk,    
   bayposition, palletstart, palletend, StackPosition,width, Height , BayLevel    
   INTO #Tmp_Pallets     
   from #Tmp_Locations l     
   inner join tblpallets p on p.LocationTypeFK = l.locationTypeFK and p.LocationFK = l.BuildingUnitBayPK       
   and p.IsArchived = 0    
   and p.Barcode = Coalesce(@barcode2, p.Barcode)    
      
            -- Retrieve the pallet content details     
   Select PalletFK, StockItemCode, Batch, count(*) Eaches, sum(ActualUnits) ActualUnits, sum(AvailableUnits) AvailableUnits,    
   EachesType, Abbreviation    
   INTO #Tmp_PalletContent    
   from #Tmp_pallets     
   inner join tblPalletContent on palletfk = palletpk     
   inner join tblstockitems on stockitempk = stockitemfk    
   left outer join tblUnitTypes unitTypes on    
    unitTypes.UnitTypePK = UnitTypeFK    
   left outer join tblEachesTypes eachesTypes on    
    eachesTypes.EachesTypePK = EachesTypeFK    
   group by palletfk , stockitemcode, batch , EAchesType, Abbreviation    
    
        -- Retrieve whats on Order    
      select count(*) OrderContent, PalletFK     
   INTO #Tmp_OnOrder from    
   #Tmp_Pallets p inner join tblContainerOutLinePalletContent colpc on colpc.PalletFK = p.PalletPK    
   inner join tblContainerOutLines cols on colpc.ContainerOutLineFK = cols.ContainerOutLinePK    
   inner join tblContainerOuts cOuts on  cols.ContainerOutFK = cOuts.ContainerOutPK      
   Where cOuts.ContainerOutStatusFK not in (5,6) /*not complete or cancelled*/    
   Group By PalletFK    
    
     -- Conventional Racking - check for Pallets assigned through worksorders     
       
   -- pallets that are assigned to this location through a works orders     
   select palletpk, p.isarchived,  case when p.CustomerBarcode = '' then p.Barcode else p.CustomerBarcode end as Barcode, p.CustomerPalletNumber,    
   BuildingUnitBayLocation as Location , pallettype,    
   LocateFromLeft as FromLeftToRight , PalletTypeFK, palletstatusfk,    
   DestinationBayPosition as BayPosition , DestinationPalletStart as PalletStart, DestinationPalletEnd as PalletEnd,     
   DestinationStackPosition as StackPosition,l.width, l.Height, BayLevel    
   INTO #Tmp_OpenMOvements  from #Tmp_locations l    
   inner join tblWorksOrderMovements woms on DestinationLocationTypeFK = 1 and DestinationFK = BuildingUnitBayPK and WorksOrderStatusFK in (1,2)    
   inner join tblpallets p on p.palletpk = woms.palletfk and p.isarchived = 0     
   inner join tblPalletTypes on PalletTypeFK = PalletTypePK    
   where @rackingTypeFK = 1     
       
     -- Retrieve the pallet content details     
   Select PalletFK, StockItemCode, Batch, count(*) Eaches, sum(ActualUnits) ActualUnits, sum(AvailableUnits) AvailableUnits,    
   EachesType, Abbreviation    
   INTO #Tmp_PendingPalletContent    
   from #Tmp_OpenMOvements    
   inner join tblPalletContent on palletfk = palletpk     
   inner join tblstockitems on stockitempk = stockitemfk    
   left outer join tblUnitTypes unitTypes on    
    unitTypes.UnitTypePK = UnitTypeFK    
   left outer join tblEachesTypes eachesTypes on    
    eachesTypes.EachesTypePK = EachesTypeFK    
   group by palletfk , stockitemcode, batch , EAchesType, Abbreviation    
    
        -- Retrieve whats on Order    
      select count(*) OrderContent, PalletFK     
   INTO #Tmp_PendingOnOrder from    
   #Tmp_OpenMOvements p inner join tblContainerOutLinePalletContent colpc on colpc.PalletFK = p.PalletPK    
   inner join tblContainerOutLines cols on colpc.ContainerOutLineFK = cols.ContainerOutLinePK    
   inner join tblContainerOuts cOuts on  cols.ContainerOutFK = cOuts.ContainerOutPK      
   Where cOuts.ContainerOutStatusFK not in (5,6) /*not complete or cancelled*/    
   Group By PalletFK    
    
   IF (@rackingTypeFK = 1)     
   BEGIN     
    
    SELECT PalletPK AS PK, '/images/Pallet.png' AS ImagePath,pallets.Isarchived, cast(0 as bit) AS IsFiltered,     
     pallets.Barcode, pallets.CustomerPalletNumber,    
     StockItemCode, pc.Batch, Eaches, EachesType, Abbreviation, ActualUnits, AvailableUnits,    
      Location,     
      FromLeftToRight,    
     PalletType,    
     pallets.BayPosition,    
     pallets.PalletStart,    
     pallets.PalletEnd,    
     pallets.StackPosition,    
     pallets.width as BayWidth,    
     pallets.Height  as BayHeight,    
     case when onOrder.OrderContent > 0 then 'On Order' else '' end as OnOrder,    
     palletStatus.PalletStatus,    
     0 as IsRackingInbound,    
     CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), palletAudit.EventDate, 103) as CreatedDate    
      
     FROM        
     #Tmp_Pallets pallets    
     left outer join tblPalletTypes palletTypes on    
     palletTypes.PalletTypePK = pallets.PalletTypeFK    
     inner join     
     #Tmp_PalletContent pc on    
     pc.PalletFK = pallets.PalletPK    
    
        
     inner join appPalletStatus palletStatus on    
     palletStatus.PalletStatusPK = pallets.PalletStatusFK    
     left outer join #Tmp_OnOrder onOrder on    
     onOrder.PalletFK = pallets.PalletPK    
     left outer join tblPalletAudit palletAudit on    
     palletAudit.PalletFK = pallets.PalletPK    
     AND palletAudit.EventTypeFK = 1/*PalletCreated*/    
       
    
    
     UNION ALL    
    
     SELECT -1 AS PK, '/images/Obstruction.png' AS ImagePath, obs.Isarchived,cast(0 as bit) AS IsFiltered,     
      '' as [Barcode], '' AS CustomerPalletNumber, '' 'Obstruction', 'Obstruction', 0, '' EachesType, '' Abbreviation, 0 as [ActualUnits], 0 as [AvailableUnits],    
      BuildingUnitBayLocation as Location,     
       
      case LocateFromLeft when 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ then 1 when 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/ then 0 else -1 end FromLeftToRight,    
      'Obstruction' PalletType,    
      -1 BayPosition,    
      case when LocateFromLeft = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ then ObstructionStart else Width - ObstructionEnd End PalletStart,    
      case when LocateFromLeft = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ then ObstructionEnd else Width - ObstructionStart End PalletEnd,    
      0 StackPosition,    
      Width as BayWidth,    
      Height as  BayHeight,    
      '' as OnOrder,    
      'Obstruction',    
      0 as IsRackingInbound,    
      '1900-01-01' as CreatedDate    
      from #Tmp_locations    
      inner join tblBuildingUnitBayObstructions obs on BuildingUnitBayPK = obs.BuildingUnitBayFK and obs.IsArchived=0    
         
    
     UNION ALL    
     SELECT woms.PalletPK AS PK, '/images/Pallet.png' AS ImagePath, woms.IsArchived, cast(0 as bit) AS IsFiltered,     
       woms.Barcode, woms.CustomerPalletNumber,    
       pc.StockItemCode, pc.Batch, pc.Eaches,EachesType, Abbreviation, ActualUnits, AvailableUnits,    
      Location,     
      woms.FromLeftToRight ,    
      PalletType,    
      woms.BayPosition,    
      woms.PalletStart,    
      woms.PalletEnd,    
      woms.StackPosition,    
      woms.Width as BayWidth,    
      woms.Height as BayHeight,    
      case when onOrder.OrderContent > 0 then 'On Order' else '' end as OnOrder,    
      palletStatus.PalletStatus,    
      1 as IsRackingInbound,    
      CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), palletAudit.EventDate, 103) as CreatedDate       
     FROM       
     #Tmp_OpenMOvements woms      
     inner join     
     #Tmp_PendingPalletContent pc on    
     pc.PalletFK = woms.PalletPK    
        
     inner join appPalletStatus palletStatus on    
     palletStatus.PalletStatusPK = woms.PalletStatusFK    
        
     left outer join #Tmp_PendingOnOrder onOrder on    
     onOrder.PalletFK = woms.PalletPK    
     left outer join tblPalletAudit palletAudit on    
     palletAudit.PalletFK = woms.PalletPK    
     AND palletAudit.EventTypeFK = 1/*PalletCreated*/    
    END    
    ELSE    
    BEGIN    
     SELECT PalletPK AS PK, '/images/Pallet.png' AS ImagePath, pallets.IsArchived, cast(0 as bit) AS IsFiltered, 
	 pallets.Barcode, pallets.CustomerPalletNumber, 
     StockItemCode, pc.Batch, Eaches, EachesType, Abbreviation, ActualUnits,AvailableUnits,    
     Location, FromLeftToRight, PalletType,BayLevel as bayPosition, pallets.PalletStart,pallets.PalletEnd,pallets.StackPosition, 0 as BayWidth, 0 as BayHeight,    
      case when onOrder.OrderContent > 0 then 'On Order' else '' end as OnOrder, palletStatus.PalletStatus ,
      1 as IsRackingInbound, 
      CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), palletAudit.EventDate, 103) as CreatedDate        
              
     FROM        
     #Tmp_Pallets pallets    
     left outer join tblPalletTypes palletTypes on    
     palletTypes.PalletTypePK = pallets.PalletTypeFK    
     inner join     
     #Tmp_PalletContent pc on    
     pc.PalletFK = pallets.PalletPK    
    
        
     inner join appPalletStatus palletStatus on    
     palletStatus.PalletStatusPK = pallets.PalletStatusFK    
     left outer join #Tmp_OnOrder onOrder on    
     onOrder.PalletFK = pallets.PalletPK    
     left outer join tblPalletAudit palletAudit on    
     palletAudit.PalletFK = pallets.PalletPK    
     AND palletAudit.EventTypeFK = 1/*PalletCreated*/     
     Order by  BayPosition ASC    
    END    
    
   -- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end    
    
       
       
   BREAK    
  END TRY    
  BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */    
   DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;    
   SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;    
   SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;    
    
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY     
   BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;    
           
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;    
    
            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID    
                
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;    
                
   IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)    
   BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END    
   ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */    
  END CATCH    
  SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1    
 END    
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spGvManufacturers]  
(  
 @IncludeArchived BIT = 0  
)  
AS  
BEGIN  
 /* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */  
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED  
  
    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT  
 ,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;  
 SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();; SET @ParameterDetails = ''  
  
 DECLARE @var_IncludeArchived BIT; SET @var_IncludeArchived = ISNULL(@IncludeArchived,0)  
  
 SET @ParameterDetails = '@IncludeArchived = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@IncludeArchived AS NVARCHAR(10)),'')  
  
    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL   
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)  
  
    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)  
    --BEGIN  
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC   
  
  SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)  
  
        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)  
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK  
  
        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()  
    --END  
  
 SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);  
 SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails  
 ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;  
 INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()   
  
 WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3  
 BEGIN   
  BEGIN TRY  
  
   -- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start  
  
   DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #tmpManuList  
   
   SELECT ManufacturerPK AS PK, '/images/supplier.png' AS ImagePath, 0 as IsArchived, cast(0 as bit) AS IsFiltered, Manufacturer, IsArchived as Archived   
   INTO #tmpManuList  
   FROM dbo.tblManufacturers  
   WHERE  
    @var_IncludeArchived = 1 OR (@var_IncludeArchived = 0 and IsArchived = 0)  
  
  
   if(@var_IncludeArchived = 1)  
   BEGIN  
    SELECT * FROM #tmpManuList   order by Manufacturer 
   END  
   ELSE  
   BEGIN  
    SELECT PK, ImagePath, IsArchived, IsFiltered, Manufacturer
	FROM #tmpManuList  
	 order by Manufacturer
   END  
  
  
   -- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end  
        
   BREAK  
  END TRY  
  BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */  
   DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;  
   SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;  
   SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;  
  
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY   
   BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;  
         
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;  
  
            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID  
              
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;  
              
   IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)  
   BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END  
   ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */  
  END CATCH  
  SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1  
 END  
END

/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[spGvMobstaGroupStockInContainerInHeaders]    Script Date: 02/11/2026 17:47:26 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
