CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spGvMobstaGroupStockInContainerInHeaders]              
(              
 @StockInGroupFK int            
)              
AS              
BEGIN              
 /* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */              
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED              
              
    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT              
 ,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;              
 SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();              
              
 -- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters              
 DECLARE @StockInGroupFK2 int              
              
 SET @StockInGroupFK2 = @StockInGroupFK              
              
 SET @ParameterDetails = '@StockInGroupFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@StockInGroupFK2 AS NVARCHAR(20)),'')              
              
    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL               
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)              
              
    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)              
    --BEGIN              
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC               
              
  SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)              
              
        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)              
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK              
              
        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()              
    --END              
              
              
 SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);              
 SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails              
 ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;              
 INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()              
              
 WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3              
 BEGIN               
  BEGIN TRY              
                 
              
   -- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start              
              
   SELECT            
  cihs.ContainerInHeaderPK AS PK,             
   '/images/Pallet.png' AS ImagePath, cast(0 as bit) AS IsFiltered,  cast(0 as bit) as IsArchived,               
   cin.GoodsInNumber, StockItemCode as StockCode,         
   cihs.Units,        
    --case when sils.units is null then cihs.units else sils.units end as Units  ,          
           
   cihs.Batch, sis.stockitempk as stockitempk  , cihs.ContainerInFK as ContainerInFK, sins.stockinpk as StockInPK, cin.DateIn as DateIn               
   FROM tblContainerInHeaders cihs              
   inner join tblStockItems sis on              
   sis.StockItemPK = cihs.StockItemFK              
     inner join tblcontainerins cin on cihs.ContainerInFK = cin.containerinpk            
  inner join tblstockins sins on cin.containerinpk = sins.ContainerInFK         
  --inner join tblStockInLines sils on sins.StockInPK = sils.StockInFK ---Pritesh         
      
        
   left join (select distinct stockinfk, sum(units) Units from tblStockInLines group by stockinfk) sils on sils.stockinfk = sins.stockinpk           
 left join (select distinct containerinfk, sum(units) Units from tblContainerInHeaders group by containerinfk) cih on cih.containerinfk = cin.containerinpk         
  where cin.StockInGroupFK =@StockInGroupFK2            
   order by sis.StockItemCode              
              
   -- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end              
              
                 
                 
   BREAK              
  END TRY              
  BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */              
   DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;              
   SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;              
   SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;              
              
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY               
   BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;              
                     
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;              
              
            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID              
                          
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;              
                          
   IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)              
   BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END              
   ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */              
  END CATCH              
  SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1

 @ShowInactive bit = 0,    
 @PagePK int = -1    
)    
AS    
BEGIN    
 /* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */    
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED    
    
    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT

 SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();    
    
 -- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters    
 --DECLARE     
    
 DECLARE @varShowInactive nvarchar(50) = @ShowInactive    
 DECLARE @varPagePK int = @PagePK    
    
 SET @ParameterDetails = '@ShowInactive = ' + ISNULL(@varShowInactive ,'')     
    
    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL     
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

  SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()    
    --END    
    
    
 SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);    
 SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails    
 ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;    
 INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()    
    
 WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3    
 BEGIN     
  BEGIN TRY    
       
    
   -- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start    
    
   SELECT SystemPagePK AS PK, '/images/login.png' AS ImagePath, cast(0 as bit) AS IsArchived, cast(0 as bit) AS IsFiltered,     
   pageTitle, PageURL, Active, CanNavigate AS [Can Navigate],    
   Administrator, SuperUser AS [Super User], Manager, Supervisor, StockController AS [Stock Controller], Quality,  WarehouseOp as [Warehouse Op], Transport, DailyInventoryManagement as [Daily Inventory], Invoicing, [Distribution], WarehousingClientUser AS
  
 [Client User]  ,  ExternalTransport as [External Transport]
   FROM     
   (     
    SELECT sp.SystemPagePK, pageTitle, PageURL, ar.name as RoleName, appl.Description AS PagePermissionLevel, sp.CanNavigate, ~sp.IsArchived AS Active    
    FROM tblSystemPages sp    
    LEFT JOIN tblSystemPagePermissions spp ON spp.SystemPageFK = sp.SystemPagePK    
    --LEFT JOIN dbo.aspnet_Roles ar ON ar.RoleId = spp.RoleId    
 LEFT JOIN AspNetRoles ar on ar.Id = spp.RoleId  
    LEFT JOIN AppPagePermissionLevel appl ON spp.PagePermissionLevelFK = appl.PagePermissionLevelPK    
    WHERE ((@varShowInactive = 0 AND sp.IsArchived = @varShowInactive) OR (@varShowInactive = 1))    
     AND (@varPagePK = -1 OR (@varPagePK > 0 and sp.SystemPagePK = @varPagePK))    
    --order by pagetitle    
   )t    
   PIVOT(    
    max(PagePermissionLevel)    
    FOR RoleName in ([Administrator],[DailyInventoryManagement],[Invoicing],[Manager],[Quality],[StockController],[SuperUser],[Supervisor],[Transport],[WarehouseOp],[WarehousingClientUser], [Distribution],[ExternalTransport])    
   )  as PivotTable    
   ORDER BY PivotTable.pageTitle     
    
   -- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end    
    
       
       
   BREAK    
  END TRY    
  BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */    
   DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;    
   SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;    
   SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;    
    
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY     
   BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;    
           
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;    
    
            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID    
                
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;    
                
   IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)    
   BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END    
   ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */    
  END CATCH    
  SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1    
 END

-- =============================================
-- Author:        <Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:   <Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spGvPalletSearch]
(
      @locationFK int = null,
      @barcode nvarchar(200) = null,
      @loadingBayFK int = null,
      @setDownAreaFK int = null,
      @sampleLocationFK int = null,
      @floorLocationFK  int = null,
      @goodsInNumber nvarchar(200) = '',
      @goodsOutNumber nvarchar(200) = '',
	  @BuildingUnitFK int = null,
	  @ShowArchieved bit =1
)           
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT
	,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;
	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	DECLARE @locationFK2 int,
    @barcode2 nvarchar(200),
    @loadingBayFK2 int,
    @setDownAreaFK2 int,
    @sampleLocationFK2 int,
    @floorLocationFK2 int,
    @goodsInNumber2 nvarchar(200),
    @goodsOutNumber2 nvarchar(200),
	@BuildingUnitFK2 int

	SET @locationFK2 = @locationFK; SET @barcode2 = @barcode; SET @loadingBayFK2 = @loadingBayFK; SET @setDownAreaFK2 = @setDownAreaFK; SET @sampleLocationFK2 = @sampleLocationFK
	SET @floorLocationFK2 = @floorLocationFK; SET @goodsInNumber2 = @goodsInNumber; SET @goodsOutNumber2 = @goodsOutNumber; SET @BuildingUnitFK2 = @BuildingUnitFK

	SET @ParameterDetails = '@locationFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@locationFK2 AS NVARCHAR(100)),'') + ',@barcode = ' + ISNULL(@barcode2,'') 
		+ ',@loadingBayFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@loadingBayFK2 AS NVARCHAR(100)),'') + ',@setDownAreaFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@setDownAreaFK2 AS NVARCHAR(100)),'')
			+ ',@sampleLocationFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@sampleLocationFK2 AS NVARCHAR(100)),'') + ',@floorLocationFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@floorLocationFK2 AS NVARCHAR(100)),'')
				+ ',@goodsInNumber = ' + ISNULL(@goodsInNumber2,'') + ',@goodsOutNumber = ' + ISNULL(@goodsOutNumber2,'') 
					+ ',@BuildingUnitFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@BuildingUnitFK2 AS NVARCHAR(100)),'')

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    --BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

		SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END

	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY			

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start
      
			  Declare @CurrentlocationFK int
			  Declare @locationTypeFK int

			  IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#tblPalletAdditionalFieldValues') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #tblPalletAdditionalFieldValues

			  CREATE TABLE #tblPalletAdditionalFieldValues 
			  (
					PalletPK int,
					PalletAdditionalValues nvarchar(300)
			  )
   
			  Insert into #tblPalletAdditionalFieldValues
			  Select PalletFK, max(paf1) + case when max(paf2) = '' then '' else ', ' + max(paf2) end + case when max(paf3) = '' then '' else ', ' + max(paf3) end 
				+ case when max(paf4) = '' then '' else ', ' + max(paf4) end + case when max(paf5) = '' then '' else ', ' + max(paf5) end from (      
					Select PalletFK, 
					case when pafs1.PalletAdditionalFieldPK is null then '' else pafs1.PalletAdditionalField + ':' + pafvs.PalletAdditionalFieldValue end paf1,
					case when pafs2.PalletAdditionalFieldPK is null then '' else pafs2.PalletAdditionalField + ':' + pafvs.PalletAdditionalFieldValue end paf2,
					case when pafs3.PalletAdditionalFieldPK is null then '' else pafs3.PalletAdditionalField + ':' + pafvs.PalletAdditionalFieldValue end paf3,
					case when pafs4.PalletAdditionalFieldPK is null then '' else pafs4.PalletAdditionalField + ':' + pafvs.PalletAdditionalFieldValue end paf4,
					case when pafs5.PalletAdditionalFieldPK is null then '' else pafs5.PalletAdditionalField + ':' + pafvs.PalletAdditionalFieldValue end paf5
					From tblPalletAdditionalFieldValues pafvs
					left outer join tblPalletAdditionalFields pafs1 on
					pafs1.PalletAdditionalFieldPK = pafvs.PalletAdditionalFieldFK
					AND pafs1.FieldNumber=1

					left outer join tblPalletAdditionalFields pafs2 on
					pafs2.PalletAdditionalFieldPK = pafvs.PalletAdditionalFieldFK
					AND pafs2.FieldNumber=2

					left outer join tblPalletAdditionalFields pafs3 on
					pafs3.PalletAdditionalFieldPK = pafvs.PalletAdditionalFieldFK
					AND pafs3.FieldNumber=3

					left outer join tblPalletAdditionalFields pafs4 on
					pafs4.PalletAdditionalFieldPK = pafvs.PalletAdditionalFieldFK
					AND pafs4.FieldNumber=4

					left outer join tblPalletAdditionalFields pafs5 on
					pafs5.PalletAdditionalFieldPK = pafvs.PalletAdditionalFieldFK
					AND pafs5.FieldNumber=5
			  ) AS subQ
			  Group By PalletFK

			   --IF(@goodsInNumber2 <> ''
			   IF(@goodsInNumber2 <> '' and (@BuildingUnitFK is null or @BuildingUnitFK='' or @BuildingUnitFK=-1) and (@barcode is null or @barcode = '') ) 
			  BEGIN									--jamie: set archived as false - we want to see pallets even if they have gone out
					SELECT pallets.PalletPK AS PK, '/images/Pallet.png' AS ImagePath, 0 as IsArchived, cast(0 as bit) AS IsFiltered, 
					sis.StockItemCode as 'Stock Code', 
					case when sis.IsStackable = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ then '$imgComplete.png' else '$imgCancel.png' end as Stackable,
					pc.Batch, case when pallets.CustomerBarcode = '' then pallets.Barcode else pallets.CustomerBarcode end as Barcode, ActualUnits, AvailableUnits,
					Location, PalletType,
					pafvs.PalletAdditionalValues as [Additional Fields], StockonOrder

					From (Select * from tblContainerIns where GoodsInNumber = @goodsInNumber2 and (@BuildingUnitFK2 is null OR buildingUnitFK = @BuildingUnitFK2 OR @BuildingUnitFK2 = -1)) cins
					inner join tblStockIns sins on
					sins.ContainerInFK = cins.ContainerInPK
					inner join tblStockInLines sils on
					sils.StockInFK = sins.StockInPK
					inner join tblStockInLinePallets silps on
					silps.StockInLineFK = sils.StockInLinePK
					inner join tblPallets pallets on
					pallets.PalletPK = silps.PalletFK
					left outer join tblPalletTypes palletTypes on
					palletTypes.PalletTypePK = pallets.PalletTypeFK
					inner join 
					(Select PalletFK, StockItemFK, Batch, sum(ActualUnits) ActualUnits, sum(AvailableUnits) AvailableUnits,case when (SUM(ActualUnits)>Sum(AvailableUnits)) then 'YES' else 'NO' end as StockonOrder
					from tblPalletContent
					Group By PalletFK, StockItemFK, Batch) pc on
					pc.PalletFK = pallets.PalletPK
					inner join tblStockItems sis on
					sis.StockItemPK = pc.StockItemFK
					inner join viewpalletLocations palletLocation on 
					palletlocation.PalletPK = pallets.palletPk

					left outer join #tblPalletAdditionalFieldValues pafvs on
					pafvs.PalletPK = pallets.PalletPK
					where  sins.StockInStatusFK not in (1,4) and ((@ShowArchieved=0 and  pallets.IsArchived=0)or(@ShowArchieved=1))
			  END 
			  ELSE IF (@goodsOutNumber2 <> '') 
			  BEGIN									--jamie: set archived as false - we want to see pallets even if they have gone out
					SELECT pallets.PalletPK AS PK, '/images/Pallet.png' AS ImagePath, 0 as IsArchived, cast(0 as bit) AS IsFiltered, 
					sis.StockItemCode as 'Stock Code', 
					case when sis.IsStackable = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ then '$imgComplete.png' else '$imgCancel.png' end as Stackable,
					pc.Batch, case when pallets.CustomerBarcode = '' then pallets.Barcode else pallets.CustomerBarcode end as Barcode, 
					case when pallets.IsArchived = 1 then colpc.units else ActualUnits end as ActualUnits,		--jamie : show container out units instead of pallet units when pallet is gone out
					case when pallets.IsArchived = 1 then colpc.units else AvailableUnits end as AvailableUnits,
					Location, PalletType--,            pafvs.PalletAdditionalValues as [Additional Fields]

					From (Select * from tblContainerOuts where GoodsOrderNumber = @goodsOutNumber2 ) couts
					inner join tblContainerOutLines cols on
					cols.ContainerOutFK = couts.ContainerOutPK
					inner join (
						  Select ContainerOutLineFK, PalletFK, units from tblContainerOutLinePalletContent
						  Group By ContainerOutLineFK, PalletFK, units
					) colpc on
					colpc.ContainerOutLineFK = cols.ContainerOutLinePK
					inner join (Select * from tblPallets where @BuildingUnitFK2 is null OR buildingUnitFK = @BuildingUnitFK2 OR @BuildingUnitFK2 = -1) pallets on
					pallets.PalletPK = colpc.PalletFK
					left outer join tblPalletTypes palletTypes on
					palletTypes.PalletTypePK = pallets.PalletTypeFK
					inner join 
					(Select PalletFK, StockItemFK, Batch, sum(ActualUnits) ActualUnits, sum(AvailableUnits) AvailableUnits
					from tblPalletContent
					Group By PalletFK, StockItemFK, Batch) pc on
					pc.PalletFK = pallets.PalletPK
					inner join tblStockItems sis on
					sis.StockItemPK = pc.StockItemFK
					inner join viewpalletLocations palletLocation on 
					palletlocation.PalletPK = pallets.palletPk
					left outer join #tblPalletAdditionalFieldValues pafvs on
					pafvs.PalletPK = pallets.PalletPK
			  END 
			  ELSE 
			  BEGIN
					-- Check what location type has been selected
					IF (@LocationFK2 is not null) BEGIN set @locationtypeFK = 1 set @CurrentlocationFK = @locationFK2 END
					ELSE IF (@loadingBayFK2 is not null) BEGIN SET @locationTypeFK = 2 set @CurrentLocationFK = @loadingBayFK2 END
					ELSE IF (@SetdownAreaFK2 is not null) BEGIN SET @locationTypeFK = 3 set @CurrentLocationFK = @setDownAreaFK2 END
					ELSE IF (@SampleLocationFK2 is not null) BEGIN SET @locationTypeFK = 6 SET @CurrentLocationFK = @SampleLocationFK2 END
					ELSE IF (@FloorLocationFK2 is not null) BEGIN SET @locationTypeFK = 8 SET @CurrentLocationFK = @FloorLocationFK2 END

					--This next couple of lines gets our column if we need to use it for drive thru
					Declare @buildingUnitColumnFK int
					Select @buildingUnitColumnFK = -1

					if((Select RackingTypeFK from tblBuildingUnitBays buBays inner join tblBuildingUnitColumns buCols on buCols.BuildingUnitColumnPK = buBays.BuildingUnitColumnFK 
					inner join tblBuildingUnitRows buRows on buRows.BuildingUnitRowPK = buCols.BuildingUnitRowFK where BuildingUnitBayPK = @locationFK2) = 2/*DriveThru*/) 
					BEGIN
						  Select @buildingUnitColumnFK = BuildingUnitColumnFK from tblBuildingUnitBays where BuildingUnitBayPK = @locationFK2
					END

					SELECT pallets.PalletPK AS PK, '/images/Pallet.png' AS ImagePath, pallets.IsArchived, cast(0 as bit) AS IsFiltered, 
					sis.StockItemCode as 'Stock Code', 
					case when sis.IsStackable = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ then '$imgComplete.png' else '$imgCancel.png' end as Stackable,
					pc.Batch, case when pallets.CustomerBarcode = '' then pallets.Barcode else pallets.CustomerBarcode end as Barcode, ActualUnits, AvailableUnits,
					Location, PalletType,
					pafvs.PalletAdditionalValues as [Additional Fields], StockonOrder
            
					FROM         
						( Select *   from tblContainerIns where (@goodsinnumber <> '' and GoodsInNumber= @goodsInNumber) or (@goodsinnumber = '') ) cins
				 	inner join tblStockIns sins on
					sins.ContainerInFK = cins.ContainerInPK
					inner join tblStockInLines sils on
					sils.StockInFK = sins.StockInPK
					inner join tblStockInLinePallets silps on
					silps.StockInLineFK = sils.StockInLinePK
					inner join        
					tblPallets pallets on 
					pallets.PalletPK = silps.PalletFK
					left outer join tblPalletTypes palletTypes on
					palletTypes.PalletTypePK = pallets.PalletTypeFK
					inner join 
					(Select PalletFK, StockItemFK, Batch, sum(ActualUnits) ActualUnits, sum(AvailableUnits) AvailableUnits,case when (SUM(ActualUnits)>Sum(AvailableUnits)) then 'YES' else 'NO' end as StockonOrder
					from tblPalletContent
					Group By PalletFK, StockItemFK, Batch) pc on
					pc.PalletFK = pallets.PalletPK
					inner join tblStockItems sis on
					sis.StockItemPK = pc.StockItemFK
					inner join viewpalletLocations palletLocation on 
					palletlocation.PalletPK = pallets.palletPk

					left outer join #tblPalletAdditionalFieldValues pafvs on
					pafvs.PalletPK = pallets.PalletPK

					Where pallets.IsArchived = 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/
					AND pallets.PalletStatusFK <> 10 /*On Route*/
					AND (pallets.locationTypeFK = @locationTypeFK OR @barcode2 is not null)
					AND (pallets.locationFK = @CurrentLocationFK OR @barcode2 is not null OR @CurrentLocationFK = -1)
					AND (pallets.buildingUnitFK = @BuildingUnitFK2 OR @BuildingUnitFK2 is null)
					AND (pallets.Barcode = Coalesce(@barcode2, pallets.Barcode) OR pallets.CustomerBarcode = Coalesce(@barcode2, pallets.Barcode))
					OR
					(
					pallets.IsArchived = 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/ AND
					palletlocation.BuildingUnitColumnFK = @buildingUnitColumnFK --Drive Thru condition 
					)
					and sins.StockInStatusFK not in (1,4)
					Order by Location ASC, StockItemCode ASC, Batch ASC, Barcode ASC
			  END

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end

			
			
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END
GO

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spGvPalletSearchNew]
(
	@locationFK int = -1,
    @barcode nvarchar(200) = '',
    @loadingBayFK int = 0,
    @setDownAreaFK int = 0,
    @sampleLocationFK int = 0,
    @floorLocationFK  int = 0,
    @goodsInNumber nvarchar(200) = '',
    @goodsOutNumber nvarchar(200) = '',
	@BuildingUnitFK int = -1,
	@ShowArchived bit =0
)           
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT
 ,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;
	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

    @barcode2 nvarchar(200),
    @loadingBayFK2 int,
    @setDownAreaFK2 int,
    @sampleLocationFK2 int,
    @floorLocationFK2 int,
    @goodsInNumber2 nvarchar(200),
    @goodsOutNumber2 nvarchar(200),
    @BuildingUnitFK2 int,
	@ShowArchived2 bit

	SET @locationFK2 = @locationFK; SET @barcode2 = @barcode; SET @loadingBayFK2 = @loadingBayFK; SET @setDownAreaFK2 = @setDownAreaFK; SET @sampleLocationFK2 = @sampleLocationFK
	SET @floorLocationFK2 = @floorLocationFK; SET @goodsInNumber2 = @goodsInNumber; SET @goodsOutNumber2 = @goodsOutNumber; SET @BuildingUnitFK2 = @BuildingUnitFK; SET @ShowArchived2 = @ShowArchived

	SET @ParameterDetails = '@locationFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@locationFK2 AS NVARCHAR(100)),'') + ',@barcode = ' + ISNULL(@barcode2,'') 
		+ ',@loadingBayFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@loadingBayFK2 AS NVARCHAR(100)),'') + ',@setDownAreaFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@setDownAreaFK2 AS NVARCHAR(100)),'')
			+ ',@sampleLocationFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@sampleLocationFK2 AS NVARCHAR(100)),'') + ',@floorLocationFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@floorLocationFK2 AS NVARCHAR(100)),'')
				+ ',@goodsInNumber = ' + ISNULL(@goodsInNumber2,'') + ',@goodsOutNumber = ' + ISNULL(@goodsOutNumber2,'') 
					+ ',@ShowArchived = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@ShowArchived2 AS NVARCHAR(100)),'')

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    --BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

		SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END


	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY

			--filter by location : get drive throu column if needed
			Declare @buildingUnitColumnFK int
			Select @buildingUnitColumnFK = -1
			if(@locationFK2 > 0)
			BEGIN
			--print 'racking'
				if((Select RackingTypeFK from tblBuildingUnitBays buBays inner join tblBuildingUnitColumns buCols on buCols.BuildingUnitColumnPK = buBays.BuildingUnitColumnFK 
				inner join tblBuildingUnitRows buRows on buRows.BuildingUnitRowPK = buCols.BuildingUnitRowFK where BuildingUnitBayPK = @locationFK2) = 2/*DriveThru*/) 
				BEGIN
				print 'drive throu'
						Select @buildingUnitColumnFK = BuildingUnitColumnFK from tblBuildingUnitBays where BuildingUnitBayPK = @locationFK2
				END
			END

			print @buildingUnitColumnFK

			--temp table for required pallets
			CREATE TABLE #tmpPallets (
				Palletpk INT, 
				Barcode nvarchar(50),
				CustomerBarcode nvarchar(50), 
				CustomerPalletNumber nvarchar(50),
				LocationFK INT,
				LocationTypeFK INT,
				PalletTypeFK INT,
				IsArchived BIT,
				COActualUnits decimal(18,3),
				COAvailableUnits decimal(18,3), 
				BayPosition INT, 
				PalletStart INT, 
				PalletEnd INT, 
				StackPosition INT
			)

			--are we filtering by goods in?
			IF (@goodsInNumber2 <> '')
			BEGIN
				INSERT INTO #tmpPallets 
				SELECT distinct p.PalletPk, p.Barcode, p.CustomerBarcode, p.CustomerPalletNumber, p.LocationFK,  p.LocationTypeFK, p.PalletTypeFK, p.IsArchived,0,0, P.BayPosition, P.PalletStart, P.PalletEnd, P.StackPosition
				FROM (select * from tblStockIns where goodsinnumber like '%'+@goodsInNumber2+'%') si
				INNER JOIN tblstockinlines sil on si.stockinpk = sil.stockinfk 
				INNER JOIN tblStockInLinePallets silp on stockinlinefk = stockinlinepk
				INNER JOIN TblPallets  P on silp.palletfk = p.palletpk
				LEFT JOIN #tmpPallets TMP on P.PALLETPK = TMP.PALLETPK
				WHERE TMP.PALLETPK IS NULL /*AND p.PalletStatusFK <> 10*/ /*On Route*/ AND si.stockinstatusfk not in (4) and (@ShowArchived2 = 1 or p.isarchived = 0)
			END
			--are we filtering by goods out
			IF (@goodsOutNumber2 <> '')
			BEGIN
			print 'goods out'
				INSERT INTO #tmpPallets 
				SELECT distinct p.PalletPk, p.Barcode, p.CustomerBarcode, p.CustomerPalletNumber, p.LocationFK,  p.LocationTypeFK, p.PalletTypeFK, 0, colpc.units, colpc.units, P.BayPosition, P.PalletStart, P.PalletEnd, P.StackPosition
				FROM (select * from tblContainerOuts where GoodsOrderNumber like '%' + @goodsOutNumber2 + '%') co
				INNER JOIN tblContainerOutLines col on co.containeroutpk = col.containeroutfk 
				INNER JOIN (
						  Select ContainerOutLineFK, PalletFK, units from tblContainerOutLinePalletContent
						  Group By ContainerOutLineFK, PalletFK, units
					) colpc on colpc.ContainerOutLineFK = col.ContainerOutLinePK
				--INNER JOIN tblContainerOutLinepalletContent colpc on containeroutlinepk= containeroutlinefk
				INNER JOIN TblPallets  P on colpc.palletfk = p.palletpk
				LEFT JOIN #tmpPallets TMP on P.PALLETPK = TMP.PALLETPK
				WHERE TMP.PALLETPK IS NULL AND (@ShowArchived2 = 1 or p.isarchived = 0)
			END

			--nothing selected yet, check location filters
			IF NOT EXISTS(select 1 from #tmpPallets)
			BEGIN
				if(@locationFK2 > 0)
				BEGIN
				--print 'racking'
					INSERT INTO #tmpPallets 
					SELECT distinct p.PalletPk, p.Barcode, p.CustomerBarcode, p.CustomerPalletNumber, p.LocationFK,  p.LocationTypeFK, p.PalletTypeFK, p.IsArchived,0,0, P.BayPosition, P.PalletStart, P.PalletEnd, P.StackPosition
					FROM TblPallets P
					INNER JOIN viewpalletLocations palletLocation on palletlocation.PalletPK = p.palletPk
					LEFT JOIN #tmpPallets TMP on P.PALLETPK = TMP.PALLETPK
					WHERE TMP.PALLETPK IS NULL AND p.PalletStatusFK <> 10 /*On Route*/ AND 
						((p.locationtypefk = 1 and p.locationfk = @locationFK2) OR (palletlocation.BuildingUnitColumnFK = @buildingUnitColumnFK)) 
						and (@ShowArchived2 = 1 or p.isarchived = 0)
				END
				IF(@barcode2 <> '')
				BEGIN
				print 'barcode'
					INSERT INTO #tmpPallets 
					SELECT distinct p.PalletPk, p.Barcode, p.CustomerBarcode, p.CustomerPalletNumber, p.LocationFK,  p.LocationTypeFK, p.PalletTypeFK, p.IsArchived,0,0, P.BayPosition, P.PalletStart, P.PalletEnd, P.StackPosition
					FROM TblPallets P
					LEFT JOIN #tmpPallets TMP on P.PALLETPK = TMP.PALLETPK
					WHERE TMP.PALLETPK IS NULL AND p.PalletStatusFK <> 10 /*On Route*/ AND ( p.Barcode = @barcode2 or p.CustomerBarcode = @barcode2 and (@ShowArchived2 = 1 or p.isarchived = 0))
				END
				IF (@loadingBayFK2 <> 0)
				BEGIN
				print 'loading bay'
					INSERT INTO #tmpPallets 
					SELECT distinct p.PalletPk, p.Barcode, p.CustomerBarcode, p.CustomerPalletNumber, p.LocationFK,  p.LocationTypeFK, p.PalletTypeFK, p.IsArchived,0,0, P.BayPosition, P.PalletStart, P.PalletEnd, P.StackPosition
					FROM TblPallets P
					LEFT JOIN #tmpPallets TMP on P.PALLETPK = TMP.PALLETPK
					WHERE TMP.PALLETPK IS NULL AND p.PalletStatusFK <> 10 /*On Route*/ and ((p.locationtypefk = 2 and (p.locationfk = @loadingBayFK2 or (@loadingBayFK2 = -1 and p.BuildingUnitFK = @BuildingUnitFK2))) and (@ShowArchived2 = 1 or p.isarchived = 0))
				END
				IF (@setDownAreaFK2 <> 0)
				BEGIN
				print 'set down area'
					INSERT INTO #tmpPallets 
					SELECT distinct p.PalletPk, p.Barcode, p.CustomerBarcode, p.CustomerPalletNumber, p.LocationFK,  p.LocationTypeFK, p.PalletTypeFK, p.IsArchived,0,0, P.BayPosition, P.PalletStart, P.PalletEnd, P.StackPosition
					FROM TblPallets P
					LEFT JOIN #tmpPallets TMP on P.PALLETPK = TMP.PALLETPK
					WHERE TMP.PALLETPK IS NULL AND p.PalletStatusFK <> 10 /*On Route*/ AND ((p.locationtypefk = 3 and (p.locationfk = @setDownAreaFK2 or (@setDownAreaFK2 = -1 and p.BuildingUnitFK = @BuildingUnitFK2))) and (@ShowArchived2 = 1 or p.isarchived = 0))
				END
				IF (@sampleLocationFK2 <> 0)
				BEGIN
				print 'sample area'
					INSERT INTO #tmpPallets 
					SELECT distinct p.PalletPk, p.Barcode, p.CustomerBarcode, p.CustomerPalletNumber, p.LocationFK,  p.LocationTypeFK, p.PalletTypeFK, p.IsArchived,0,0, P.BayPosition, P.PalletStart, P.PalletEnd, P.StackPosition
					FROM TblPallets  P
					LEFT JOIN #tmpPallets TMP on P.PALLETPK = TMP.PALLETPK
					WHERE TMP.PALLETPK IS NULL AND p.PalletStatusFK <> 10 /*On Route*/ AND ((p.locationtypefk = 6 and (p.locationfk = @sampleLocationFK2 or (@sampleLocationFK2 = -1 and p.BuildingUnitFK = @BuildingUnitFK2))) and (@ShowArchived2 = 1 or p.isarchived = 0))
				END
				IF (@floorLocationFK2 <> 0)
				BEGIN
				print 'floor area'
					INSERT INTO #tmpPallets 
					SELECT distinct p.PalletPk, p.Barcode, p.CustomerBarcode, p.CustomerPalletNumber, p.LocationFK,  p.LocationTypeFK, p.PalletTypeFK, p.IsArchived,0,0, P.BayPosition, P.PalletStart, P.PalletEnd, P.StackPosition
					FROM TblPallets  P
					LEFT JOIN #tmpPallets TMP on P.PALLETPK = TMP.PALLETPK
					WHERE TMP.PALLETPK IS NULL AND p.PalletStatusFK <> 10 /*On Route*/ AND ((p.locationtypefk = 8 and (p.locationfk = @floorLocationFK2 or (@floorLocationFK2 = -1 and p.BuildingUnitFK = @BuildingUnitFK2))) and (@ShowArchived2 = 1 or p.isarchived = 0))
				END
			END

			--now remove anything we dont need
			IF EXISTS(select 1 from #tmpPallets)
			BEGIN
				if(@locationFK2 > 0)
				BEGIN
					DELETE P
					FROM #tmpPallets P
					INNER JOIN viewpalletLocations palletLocation on palletlocation.PalletPK = p.palletPk
					WHERE (@buildingUnitColumnFK < 0 and (p.locationtypefk <> 1 or (p.locationtypefk = 1 and p.locationfk <> @locationFK2)) )
						OR (@buildingUnitColumnFK > 0 and palletlocation.BuildingUnitColumnFK <> @buildingUnitColumnFK) 
				END 
				--select * from #tmpPallets
				DELETE FROM #tmpPallets 
				WHERE
					(@barcode2 <> '' and ((CustomerBarcode = '' and Barcode <> @barcode2) or (CustomerBarcode <> '' and CustomerBarcode <> @barcode2)))
					or
					(@loadingBayFK2 > 0 and (locationtypefk <> 2 or (locationtypefk = 2 and locationfk <> @loadingBayFK2)))
					or
					(@setDownAreaFK2 > 0 and (locationtypefk <> 3 or (locationtypefk = 3 and locationfk <> @setDownAreaFK2)))
					or
					(@sampleLocationFK2 > 0 and (locationtypefk <> 6 or (locationtypefk = 6 and locationfk <> @sampleLocationFK2)))
					or
					(@floorLocationFK2 > 0 and (locationtypefk <> 8 or (locationtypefk = 6 and locationfk <> @floorLocationFK2)))
			END

			;WITH cte AS 
			(
				SELECT pallets.PalletPK AS PK, '/images/Pallet.png' AS ImagePath, pallets.IsArchived, cast(0 as bit) AS IsFiltered, 
					sis.StockItemCode as [Stock Code], 
					case when sis.IsStackable = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ then '$imgComplete.png' else '$imgCancel.png' end as Stackable,
					pc.Batch, 
					case when pallets.CustomerBarcode = '' then pallets.Barcode else pallets.CustomerBarcode end as Barcode, 
					pallets.CustomerPalletNumber [Pallet Number], 
					case when COActualUnits > 0 then COActualUnits else ActualUnits end as ActualUnits, 
					case when COAvailableUnits > 0 then COAvailableUnits else AvailableUnits end as AvailableUnits,
					Location, BayPosition, PalletStart, PalletEnd, StackPosition, PalletType, StockonOrder AS [Stock On Order], 
					ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY case when pallets.CustomerBarcode = '' then pallets.Barcode else pallets.CustomerBarcode end ORDER BY (CASE when pallets.IsArchived = 1 then 'a' else 'b' end) desc, pallets.PalletPK DESC) AS rn
				FROM #tmpPallets pallets
				LEFT OUTER JOIN tblPalletTypes palletTypes on palletTypes.PalletTypePK = pallets.PalletTypeFK
				INNER JOIN (
					SELECT PalletFK, StockItemFK, Batch, sum(ActualUnits) ActualUnits, sum(AvailableUnits) AvailableUnits,case when (SUM(ActualUnits)>Sum(AvailableUnits)) then 'YES' else 'NO' end as StockonOrder
					FROM tblPalletContent
					GROUP BY PalletFK, StockItemFK, Batch
				) pc on pc.PalletFK = pallets.PalletPK
				INNER JOIN tblStockItems sis on sis.StockItemPK = pc.StockItemFK
				INNER JOIN viewpalletLocations palletLocation on palletlocation.PalletPK = pallets.palletPk
			)
			SELECT PK, ImagePath, IsArchived, IsFiltered, [Stock Code], Stackable, Batch, Barcode, [Pallet Number], ActualUnits, AvailableUnits,Location, BayPosition, PalletStart, PalletEnd, StackPosition, PalletType,[Stock On Order]
			FROM cte 
			WHERE rn = 1 
			Order by Location ASC, [Stock Code] ASC, Batch ASC, Barcode ASC
			
			IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#tmpPallets') IS NOT NULL
				DROP TABLE #tmpPallets

			IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#tmpPallets') IS NOT NULL
				DROP TABLE #tmpPallets

		BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END

			--buRows.BuildingUnitRowPK = buCols.BuildingUnitRowFK

			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END

-- =============================================      
-- Author:  <Author,,Name>      
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>      
-- Description: <Description,,>      
-- =============================================      
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spGvPalletStatus]      
(      
 @stockItemFK int,      
 @batch nvarchar(200)  = '',    
 @GoodsInNumber nvarchar(200)  = '',    
 @PalletBarcode nvarchar(200)  = ''    
)       
AS      
BEGIN      
 /* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */      
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED      
      
    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT      
 ,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;      
 SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();      
      
 -- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters      
 DECLARE @stockItemFK2 int, @batch2 nvarchar(200) , @GoodsInNumber2 nvarchar(200)  , @PalletBarcode2 nvarchar(200)       
      
 SET @stockItemFK2 = @stockItemFK; SET @batch2 = @batch; SET @GoodsInNumber2 = @GoodsInNumber; SET @PalletBarcode2 = @PalletBarcode;    
      
 SET @ParameterDetails = '@stockItemFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@stockItemFK2 AS NVARCHAR(20)),'') + ',@batch = ' + ISNULL(@batch2,'')    
  + ',@GoodsInNumber = ' + ISNULL(@GoodsInNumber2,'') + ',@PalletBarcode = ' + ISNULL(@PalletBarcode2,'')    
      
    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL       
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)      
      
    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)      
    --BEGIN      
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC       
      
  SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)      
      
        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)      
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK      
      
        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()      
    --END      
      
      
 SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);      
 SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails      
 ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;      
 INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()      
      
 WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3      
 BEGIN       
  BEGIN TRY               
      
   -- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start      
    
 if(@batch2 <> '')    
 begin    
  drop table if exists #tmpBatchContent    
  select  PalletFK, StockItemFK, Batch, SUM(ActualUnits) as ActualUnits, sum(AvailableUnits) AvailableUnits     
  into #tmpBatchContent    
  from tblPalletContent       
  Where IsArchived = 0 and StockItemFK = @stockItemFK2 AND Batch = @batch2    
  Group By PalletFK, StockItemFK, Batch        
      
  SELECT PalletPK AS PK, '/images/Pallet.png' AS ImagePath, pallets.IsArchived, cast(0 as bit) AS IsFiltered,     
   sis.StockItemCode AS 'Stock Code', pc.Batch,     
   case pallets.LocationTypeFK when 1 then    
    case when buRows.Translate = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ then    
     case when buRows.ReverseTranslate = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ then    
      buRows.TranslatedRow + right('0' + cast((buRows.TranslateColumn - buCols.BuildingUnitColumn) as nvarchar(10)),2)     
      + case when buRows.RackingTypeFK = 1/*Conventional*/ then lower(buBays.BayLevel) + right('0' + cast(pallets.BayPosition as nvarchar(10)),2) else '' end    
     else    
      buRows.TranslatedRow + right('0' + cast((buCols.BuildingUnitColumn + buRows.TranslateColumn) as nvarchar(10)),2)     
      + case when buRows.RackingTypeFK = 1/*Conventional*/ then lower(buBays.BayLevel) + right('0' + cast(pallets.BayPosition as nvarchar(10)),2) else '' end    
     End    
    else     
     buRows.Row + right('0' + cast(buCols.BuildingUnitColumnName as nvarchar(10)),2) + case when buRows.RackingTypeFK = 1/*Conventional*/ then     
     lower(buBays.BayLevel) + right('0' + cast(pallets.BayPosition as nvarchar(10)),2) else '' end    
    End    
    when 2 then bus.BuildingUnit + ' ' + loadingBays.LoadingBay    
    when 3 then bus.BuildingUnit + ' ' + setDownAreas.SetDownArea    
   End as Location,
   -- pallets.PalletStatusFK AS PalletStatusFK,
   palletStatus.PalletStatus,    
   case when pallets.CustomerBarcode = '' then pallets.Barcode else pallets.CustomerBarcode end as Barcode,    
   pallets.CustomerPalletNumber, pc.ActualUnits, pc.AvailableUnits
  -- CASE WHEN palletStatus.PalletStatus = 'OnRoute' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS IsOnRoute
  FROM #tmpBatchContent pc    
  inner join dbo.tblPallets pallets  on pc.PalletFK = pallets.PalletPK    
  inner join tblStockItems sis on sis.StockItemPK = pc.StockItemFK    
  inner join appPalletStatus palletStatus on palletStatus.PalletStatusPK = pallets.PalletStatusFK    
  left outer join tblBuildingUnitBays buBays on buBays.BuildingUnitBayPK = pallets.LocationFK AND pallets.LocationTypeFK = 1 /*Racking*/    
  left outer join tblBuildingUnitColumns buCols on buCols.BuildingUnitColumnPK = buBays.BuildingUnitColumnFK    
  left outer join tblBuildingUnitRows buRows on buRows.BuildingUnitRowPK = buCols.BuildingUnitRowFK    
  left outer join tblBuildingUnits bus on bus.BuildingUnitPK = pallets.BuildingUnitFK    
  left outer join tblLoadingBays loadingBays on loadingBays.LoadingBayPK = pallets.LocationFK AND pallets.LocationTypeFK = 2 /*LoadingBay*/    
  left outer join tblSetDownAreas setDownAreas on setDownAreas.SetDownAreaPK = pallets.LocationFK AND pallets.LocationTypeFK = 3 /*SetDownArea*/    
  where pallets.IsArchived = 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/    
 end    
 else if (@GoodsInNumber2 <> '')    
 begin    
  --select 1    
  --temp table - get palletfks from tblstockinlinepallets    
  --similar to above query linking to this temp table   
   drop table if exists #tmpGoodsInNumberContent  
  select silp.PalletFK, pc.StockItemFK, pc.Batch, SUM(ActualUnits) as ActualUnits, sum(AvailableUnits) AvailableUnits   
into #tmpGoodsInNumberContent  
  
 from tblContainerIns cin  
 inner join tblStockIns sti on cin.ContainerInPK=sti.ContainerInFK  
 inner join tblStockInLines sil on sti.StockInPK= sil.StockInFK  
 inner join tblStockInLinePallets silp on sil.StockInLinePK = silp.StockInLineFK  
--inner join tblPallets pal on pal.PalletPK = silp.PalletFK  
 inner join tblPalletContent pc on silp.PalletFK = pc.PalletFK  
  
 where cin.GoodsInNumber= @GoodsInNumber2  
   Group By silp.PalletFK, pc.StockItemFK, pc.Batch  
  
  
    SELECT PalletPK AS PK, '/images/Pallet.png' AS ImagePath, pallets.IsArchived, cast(0 as bit) AS IsFiltered,     
   sis.StockItemCode AS 'Stock Code', pc.Batch,     
   case pallets.LocationTypeFK when 1 then    
    case when buRows.Translate = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ then    
     case when buRows.ReverseTranslate = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ then    
      buRows.TranslatedRow + right('0' + cast((buRows.TranslateColumn - buCols.BuildingUnitColumn) as nvarchar(10)),2)     
      + case when buRows.RackingTypeFK = 1/*Conventional*/ then lower(buBays.BayLevel) + right('0' + cast(pallets.BayPosition as nvarchar(10)),2) else '' end    
     else    
      buRows.TranslatedRow + right('0' + cast((buCols.BuildingUnitColumn + buRows.TranslateColumn) as nvarchar(10)),2)   
      + case when buRows.RackingTypeFK = 1/*Conventional*/ then lower(buBays.BayLevel) + right('0' + cast(pallets.BayPosition as nvarchar(10)),2) else '' end    
     End    
    else     
     buRows.Row + right('0' + cast(buCols.BuildingUnitColumnName as nvarchar(10)),2) + case when buRows.RackingTypeFK = 1/*Conventional*/ then     
     lower(buBays.BayLevel) + right('0' + cast(pallets.BayPosition as nvarchar(10)),2) else '' end    
    End    
    when 2 then bus.BuildingUnit + ' ' + loadingBays.LoadingBay    
    when 3 then bus.BuildingUnit + ' ' + setDownAreas.SetDownArea    
   End as Location, 
   --pallets.PalletStatusFK AS PalletStatusFK,
   palletStatus.PalletStatus,    
   case when pallets.CustomerBarcode = '' then pallets.Barcode else pallets.CustomerBarcode end as Barcode,    
   pallets.CustomerPalletNumber, pc.ActualUnits, pc.AvailableUnits
  -- CASE WHEN palletStatus.PalletStatus = 'OnRoute' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS IsOnRoute
  FROM #tmpGoodsInNumberContent pc    
  inner join dbo.tblPallets pallets  on pc.PalletFK = pallets.PalletPK    
  inner join tblStockItems sis on sis.StockItemPK = pc.StockItemFK    
  inner join appPalletStatus palletStatus on palletStatus.PalletStatusPK = pallets.PalletStatusFK    
  left outer join tblBuildingUnitBays buBays on buBays.BuildingUnitBayPK = pallets.LocationFK AND pallets.LocationTypeFK = 1 /*Racking*/    
  left outer join tblBuildingUnitColumns buCols on buCols.BuildingUnitColumnPK = buBays.BuildingUnitColumnFK    
  left outer join tblBuildingUnitRows buRows on buRows.BuildingUnitRowPK = buCols.BuildingUnitRowFK    
  left outer join tblBuildingUnits bus on bus.BuildingUnitPK = pallets.BuildingUnitFK    
  left outer join tblLoadingBays loadingBays on loadingBays.LoadingBayPK = pallets.LocationFK AND pallets.LocationTypeFK = 2 /*LoadingBay*/    
  left outer join tblSetDownAreas setDownAreas on setDownAreas.SetDownAreaPK = pallets.LocationFK AND pallets.LocationTypeFK = 3 /*SetDownArea*/    
  where pallets.IsArchived = 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/    
  
  
  
 end    
 else if (@PalletBarcode2 <> '')    
 begin    
  --select 1    
  --temp table - get pallet PK where barcode or customer barcode    
  --similar to above query, using this temp table     
  
   drop table if exists #tmpBarcodeContent    
  select  PalletFK, StockItemFK, Batch, SUM(ActualUnits) as ActualUnits, sum(AvailableUnits) AvailableUnits     
  into #tmpBarcodeContent    
  from tblPalletContent       
  Where IsArchived = 0   
  Group By PalletFK, StockItemFK, Batch        
      
  SELECT PalletPK AS PK, '/images/Pallet.png' AS ImagePath, pallets.IsArchived, cast(0 as bit) AS IsFiltered,     
   sis.StockItemCode AS 'Stock Code', pc.Batch,     
   case pallets.LocationTypeFK when 1 then    
    case when buRows.Translate = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ then    
     case when buRows.ReverseTranslate = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ then    
      buRows.TranslatedRow + right('0' + cast((buRows.TranslateColumn - buCols.BuildingUnitColumn) as nvarchar(10)),2)     
      + case when buRows.RackingTypeFK = 1/*Conventional*/ then lower(buBays.BayLevel) + right('0' + cast(pallets.BayPosition as nvarchar(10)),2) else '' end    
     else    
      buRows.TranslatedRow + right('0' + cast((buCols.BuildingUnitColumn + buRows.TranslateColumn) as nvarchar(10)),2)     
      + case when buRows.RackingTypeFK = 1/*Conventional*/ then lower(buBays.BayLevel) + right('0' + cast(pallets.BayPosition as nvarchar(10)),2) else '' end    
     End    
    else     
     buRows.Row + right('0' + cast(buCols.BuildingUnitColumnName as nvarchar(10)),2) + case when buRows.RackingTypeFK = 1/*Conventional*/ then     
     lower(buBays.BayLevel) + right('0' + cast(pallets.BayPosition as nvarchar(10)),2) else '' end    
    End    
    when 2 then bus.BuildingUnit + ' ' + loadingBays.LoadingBay    
    when 3 then bus.BuildingUnit + ' ' + setDownAreas.SetDownArea    
   End as Location,
   --pallets.PalletStatusFK AS PalletStatusFK,
   palletStatus.PalletStatus,    
   case when pallets.CustomerBarcode = '' then pallets.Barcode else pallets.CustomerBarcode end as Barcode,    
   pallets.CustomerPalletNumber, pc.ActualUnits, pc.AvailableUnits
   --CASE WHEN palletStatus.PalletStatus = 'OnRoute' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS IsOnRoute
  FROM #tmpBarcodeContent pc    
  inner join dbo.tblPallets pallets  on pc.PalletFK = pallets.PalletPK    
  inner join tblStockItems sis on sis.StockItemPK = pc.StockItemFK    
  inner join appPalletStatus palletStatus on palletStatus.PalletStatusPK = pallets.PalletStatusFK    
  left outer join tblBuildingUnitBays buBays on buBays.BuildingUnitBayPK = pallets.LocationFK AND pallets.LocationTypeFK = 1 /*Racking*/    
  left outer join tblBuildingUnitColumns buCols on buCols.BuildingUnitColumnPK = buBays.BuildingUnitColumnFK    
  left outer join tblBuildingUnitRows buRows on buRows.BuildingUnitRowPK = buCols.BuildingUnitRowFK    
  left outer join tblBuildingUnits bus on bus.BuildingUnitPK = pallets.BuildingUnitFK    
  left outer join tblLoadingBays loadingBays on loadingBays.LoadingBayPK = pallets.LocationFK AND pallets.LocationTypeFK = 2 /*LoadingBay*/    
  left outer join tblSetDownAreas setDownAreas on setDownAreas.SetDownAreaPK = pallets.LocationFK AND pallets.LocationTypeFK = 3 /*SetDownArea*/    
  where pallets.IsArchived = 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/ 
  AND (pallets.CustomerBarcode = @PalletBarcode2 OR pallets.Barcode=@PalletBarcode2)  
  
 END    
      
   -- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end      
      
         
         
   BREAK      
  END TRY      
  BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */      
   DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;      
   SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;      
   SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;      
      
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY       
   BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;      
             
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;      
      
            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID      
                  
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;      
                  
   IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)      
   BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END      
   ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */      
  END CATCH      
  SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1      
 END      
END  
GO

-- =============================================
-- Author:        <Jamie>
-- Create date: <11/04/2016>
-- Description:   <Get all pallets that match search criteria, excluding the pallets that are already selected>
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spGvPalletsToChangeSearch]
	@StockItemFK int,
    @Batch nvarchar(200) = '',
	@BestBefore datetime = '',
    @Barcode nvarchar(200) = '',
	@XMLSelectedPalletFKS xml = ''
      
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
    SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ UNCOMMITTED
   
	SELECT p.PalletPK AS PK, '/images/Pallet.png' AS ImagePath, p.IsArchived, cast(0 as bit) AS IsFiltered, 
	case when p.CustomerBarcode = '' then  p.Barcode else p.CustomerBarcode end [Barcode], sis.StockItemCode, pc.Batch, convert(nvarchar(50), pc.BestBefore , 106)[BestBefore], pc.ActualUnits, pc.AvailableUnits, pStatus.PalletStatus,
	CASE WHEN pc.AvailableUnits < pc.ActualUnits THEN 'Yes' ELSE ' ' END as [On Order]
	FROM tblPallets p
	inner join (
		Select PalletFK, StockItemFK, Batch, SUM(ActualUnits) as ActualUnits, sum(AvailableUnits) AvailableUnits, BestBefore
		From tblPalletContent 
		Where IsArchived = cast(0 as bit) and StockItemFK = @StockItemFK
		Group By PalletFK, StockItemFK, Batch, BestBefore
	)pc on pc.PalletFK = p.PalletPK
	inner join tblStockItems sis on sis.StockItemPK = pc.StockItemFK
	inner join appPalletStatus pStatus on pStatus.PalletStatusPK = p.PalletStatusFK
	left join @XMLSelectedPalletFKS.nodes('//FK') as ParamValues(PalletPK) on p.palletPK = ParamValues.PalletPK.value('VALUE[1]','INT')
	left join (--no assigned work
		select palletfk, worksorderpalletpk, worksorderpk, wop.worksorderstatusfk
		from tblworksorderpallets wop
		inner join tblworksorders wo on wo.worksorderpk = wop.worksorderfk
		where wop.worksorderstatusfk = 2 and WorksOrderTypeFK = 5
	) wops on wops.PalletFK = p.PalletPK
	LEFT JOIN (--no movements created on order
		SELECT palletfk, worksordermovementpk, worksorderpk, woms.worksorderstatusfk
		FROM tblworksordermovements woms
		INNER JOIN tblworksorders wop ON worksorderfk = worksorderpk 
		INNER JOIN tblstockorders so ON wop.fk = so.stockorderpk
		WHERE wop.WorksOrderOriginFK = 2 AND wop.WorksOrderTypeFK = 3 AND so.StockOrderStatusFK <> 6
	) woms ON woms.palletfk = p.palletpk
	where p.IsArchived = cast(0 as bit) and wops.palletfk is NULL AND woms.palletfk IS NULL
	AND (@batch = '' or pc.Batch = @batch)
	AND (@BestBefore = '' or pc.BestBefore = @BestBefore)
	AND (@Barcode = '' or (p.Barcode = @Barcode or p.CustomerBarcode = @Barcode))
	AND ParamValues.PalletPK IS NULL

	order by pc.BestBefore asc
   
END
GO

-- =============================================
-- Author:        <Jamie>
-- Create date: <11/04/2016>
-- Description:   <Get all pallets that have been selected from search>
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spGvPalletsToChangeSelected]
	@XMLSelectedPalletFKS xml
      
      
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
    SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ UNCOMMITTED
   
	SELECT p.PalletPK AS PK, '/images/Pallet.png' AS ImagePath, p.IsArchived, cast(0 as bit) AS IsFiltered, 
	case when p.CustomerBarcode = '' then  p.Barcode else p.CustomerBarcode end [Barcode], sis.StockItemCode, pc.Batch, convert(nvarchar(50), pc.BestBefore , 106)[BestBefore], pc.ActualUnits, pc.AvailableUnits, pStatus.PalletStatus
	
	FROM @XMLSelectedPalletFKS.nodes('//FK') as ParamValues(PalletPK)
	inner join tblPallets p on p.palletPK = ParamValues.PalletPK.value('VALUE[1]','INT')
	inner join (
		Select PalletFK, StockItemFK, Batch, SUM(ActualUnits) as ActualUnits, sum(AvailableUnits) AvailableUnits, BestBefore
		From tblPalletContent 
		Where IsArchived = cast(0 as bit)
		Group By PalletFK, StockItemFK, Batch, BestBefore
	)pc on pc.PalletFK = p.PalletPK
	inner join tblStockItems sis on sis.StockItemPK = pc.StockItemFK
	inner join appPalletStatus pStatus on pStatus.PalletStatusPK = p.PalletStatusFK
	order by pc.BestBefore asc
	
END
GO

AS
BEGIN

    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT
 ,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;
	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	--DECLARE 

	SET @ParameterDetails = ''

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    --BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

		SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END


	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY
			

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start

			SELECT 
			InvoiceRecurringChargePK as PK, 
			'/images/RecurringCharges.png' AS ImagePath, 
			irc.IsArchived, cast(0 as bit) AS IsFiltered, 	
			Enabled as [Enabled],	
			(select divisionName from tblDivisions where DivisionPK = DivisionFK)as [Division],  
			(select divisionCode from tblDivisions where DivisionPK = DivisionFK)as [Division Code],		
			ChargeText as Description,
			(select [InvoiceLineType] from appInvoiceLineTypes where InvoiceLineTypePK = InvoiceLineTypeFK)as [Invoice Line Type]  ,			
			ChargeText1 as Amount,
			ChargeText2 as [Type],
			ChargeText3 [Type Cost] ,
			ChargeText4 as[Per Type],
			Charge,
			(select description from tblVatCodes where VatCodePK = VatCodeFK)as [VAT Code] ,
			(select [value] from tblVatCodes where VatCodePK = VatCodeFK)as [VAT %] ,
			-- #DEV-926
			RecurringChargeInAdvance As [Charge In Advance],
			--Frequencies.ChargeFrequency,
			[Expiry Date] = CASE
							WHEN ExpiryDate != '01/01/1900' THEN cast((SELECT convert(varchar, ExpiryDate, 103)) as nvarchar(50))
							ELSE 'No Expiry Set'
							END
			FROM tblInvoiceRecurringCharges irc
				 --LEFT JOIN appInvoiceRecurringChargeFrequencies Frequencies on irc.RecurringChargeFrequencyFK = Frequencies.FrequencyPK;

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end

			
			
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END
