CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spGvSelectedGroupStockIns]                
(                 
  @groupstockinFK int               
)                   
AS                  
BEGIN                  
 /* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */                  
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED                  
                  
    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,                  
 @DeadlockErrorRetries INT, @PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT,                  
 @startRecord INT = 1,@totalRecords INT, @endRecord INT, @NoResultsFound INT                  
                  
 SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();                  
                  
 -- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters                  
 DECLARE @var_GroupStockInFK int          
                  
 SET @var_GroupStockInFK = @groupstockinFK                 
                  
 SET @ParameterDetails = '@groupstockinFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_GroupStockInFK AS NVARCHAR(20)),'')           
          
 IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL                   
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)                  
                  
    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)                  
    --BEGIN                   
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC                   
                  
        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)                  
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK                  
                  
        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()                  
    --END                  
                  
 SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);                  
 SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails                  
 ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;                  
 INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()                  
                  
 WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3                  
 BEGIN                   
  BEGIN TRY                  
                     
   -- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start         
   drop table if exists #tmpcontainerinstogroup                  
   select distinct cins.*        
   into #tmpcontainerinstogroup        
   from tblcontainerins cins        
   where cins.StockInGroupFK = @var_groupstockinFK        
           
   drop table if exists #tmpstockinstogroup              
   select s.*           into #tmpstockinstogroup                   
   from tblstockins s                  
   inner join #tmpcontainerinstogroup c on c.containerinpk = s.containerinfk           
           
   Drop table if exists #tmpstockinlines                  
   select sil.*                   
   into #tmpstockinlines                   
   from tblstockinlines sil                    
   inner join #tmpstockinstogroup stg on sil.stockinfk = stg.stockinpk                          
   Drop table if exists #tmpcontainerinheader                 
   select coh.*                  
   into #tmpcontainerinheader                  
   from tblcontainerinheaders coh                  
   inner join #tmpcontainerinstogroup cisg on coh.ContainerInFK = cisg.containerinpk                         
        
          
   drop table if exists #tmpstockinBatch                 
   select distinct StockInPK,                
   case when sils.stockinlinepk is null then  
   left (  
   STUFF((SELECT distinct ',' +  cih.Batch  from #tmpcontainerinheader cih where cih.ContainerInFK = si.ContainerInFK FOR XML PATH(''), TYPE).value('.', 'NVARCHAR(MAX)')  ,1,1,'') --'HeaderbatchList',                   
   ,50)  
   else  
   left (  
   STUFF((SELECT distinct ',' +  sils.batch  from #tmpstockinlines sils where si.StockInPK = sils.StockInFK FOR XML PATH(''), TYPE).value('.', 'NVARCHAR(MAX)') ,1,1,'') --'LinesBatchList'                
   ,50)  
   end as [Batches]            into #tmpstockinBatch           FROM #tmpstockinstogroup si           left join #tmpstockinlines sils on si.StockInPK = sils.StockInFK                        
        
        
           
   drop table if exists #tmpstockinCodes                
   select distinct StockInPK,                   
   case when sils.stockinlinepk is null then    
   left (  
   STUFF((SELECT distinct ',' +  s.stockitemcode  from #tmpcontainerinheader cih inner join tblstockitems s on cih.stockitemfk = s.stockitempk where cih.ContainerInFK = si.ContainerInFK FOR XML PATH(''), TYPE).value('.', 'NVARCHAR(MAX)')  ,1,1,'')        
  
  ,50)  
      
            
   else   
   left (  
   STUFF((SELECT distinct ',' + si2.StockItemCode from tblstockitems si2 inner join tblstockinlines sils2 on si2.StockItemPK = sils2.StockItemFK where si.StockInPK =sils2.stockinfk FOR XML PATH('')),1,1,'')      
   ,50)     
  end as [Stock Code]                   
   into #tmpstockinCodes                   
   FROM #tmpstockinstogroup si                   
   left join #tmpstockinlines sils on si.StockInPK = sils.StockInFK                      
         
         
         
 SELECT containerIns.ContainerInPK AS [PK],                         
   '/images/StockIn.png' AS ImagePath,                        
   cast(0 as bit) AS [IsFiltered],                          
   containerIns.IsArchived as [IsArchived],                          
   containerIns.GoodsInNumber as [Stock In],                          
                       
   CONVERT(VARCHAR(50), containerIns.DateIn, 106) as [Date],                      
   case when cdis.CustomerDocketIdentificationPK is null          
   then CASE WHEN  containerIns.ExternalReference <> '' THEN 'External Reference: '  + containerIns.ExternalReference        
   ELSE ' ' end                  else case cdis.FieldFK                         
   when 1 then cdis.Prefix + ' ' + containerIns.Free1                         
 when 2 then cdis.Prefix + ' ' + containerIns.Free2                         
 when 3 then cdis.Prefix + ' ' + containerIns.Free3                          
 when 4 then cdis.Prefix + ' ' + containerIns.Free4                    
 when 5 then cdis.Prefix + ' ' + containerIns.Free5                        
 ELSE '' end                        
 + ' '  + case  cdis.Field2FK                          
 when 1 then cdis.Prefix2 + ' ' + containerIns.Free1                         
 when 2 then cdis.Prefix2 + ' ' + containerIns.Free2                         
 when 3 then cdis.Prefix2 + ' ' + containerIns.Free3                         
 when 4 then cdis.Prefix2 + ' ' + containerIns.Free4                         
 when 5 then cdis.Prefix2 + ' ' + containerIns.Free5                         
 else '' end             
  + ' '  + case  cdis.Field3FK                           
  when 1 then cdis.Prefix3 + ' ' + containerIns.Free1                         
  when 2 then cdis.Prefix3 + ' ' + containerIns.Free2                          
  when 3 then cdis.Prefix3 + ' ' + containerIns.Free3               
  when 4 then cdis.Prefix3 + ' ' + containerIns.Free4                         
  when 5 then cdis.Prefix3 + ' ' + containerIns.Free5                          
  else  '' end                          
  End as Reference,     
    Case when status.StockInStatus = 'PendingRacking' then 'Arrived'
  else
 status.StockInStatus end [Status], 
 -- status.StockInStatus [Status],                      
 case when containerIns.IsBeingBuilt = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ and containerins.headersonly = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ then 'Building'         
 when containerIns.HeadersOnly = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ then 'Headers' else 'Ready' end AS [File Status],                   
 Suppliers.supplier,                      
 stc.[Stock Code],                       
 bt.Batches,                 
-- case when sils.units is null then cih.units else sils.units end as Units     
 case when  cih.units is null then sils.units else cih.units end as Units     
 FROM #tmpcontainerinstogroup as containerIns                        
 left outer join tblCustomerSuppliers cusSuppliers on cusSuppliers.SupplierFK = containerIns.SupplierFK                         
 left join tblSuppliers as Suppliers on Suppliers.SupplierPK = cusSuppliers.SupplierFK                
 inner join appStockInStatus as [status] on status.StockInStatusPK = containerIns.StockInStatusFK                    
 inner join #tmpstockinstogroup sins on sins.ContainerInFK = containerIns.ContainerInPK                  
 left join (select distinct stockinfk, sum(units) Units from #tmpstockinlines group by stockinfk) sils on sils.stockinfk = sins.stockinpk         
 left join (select distinct containerinfk, sum(units) Units from #tmpcontainerinheader group by containerinfk) cih on cih.containerinfk = containerIns.containerinpk                  
 left join #tmpstockinBatch bt on bt.StockInPK = sins.StockInPK                 
  left join #tmpstockinCodes stc on stc.StockInPK = sins.StockInPK                  
  inner join tblDivisions as divs on divs.DivisionPK = sins.DivisionFK                     
  left outer join tblCustomerDocketIdentifications as cdis  on cdis.CustomerFK = divs.CustomerFK  AND cdis.DocketTypeFK = 1 /*ContainerIn*/        --group by containerIns.ContainerInPK, containerIns.IsArchived , containerIns.GoodsInNumber, CONVERT(VARCHAR(50), containerIns.DateIn, 106),             --    containerIns.ExternalReference, cdis.CustomerDocketIdentificationPK, cdis.FieldFK, cdis.Prefix, containerIns.Free1, containerIns.Free2, containerIns.Free3, containerIns.Free4, containerIns.Free5,        
   
    
      
   --    cdis.Field2FK, cdis.Prefix2, cdis.Field3FK ,cdis.Prefix3, status.StockInStatus, containerIns.IsBeingBuilt, headersonly,           --    Suppliers.supplier,stc.[Stock Code] ,bt.Batches         ORDER BY  Suppliers.supplier ASC                      
  
    
      
   -- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end                                 
                     
   -- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end                     
                        
   BREAK                  
  END TRY                  
  BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */                  
   DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;                  
   SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;                  
   SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;                  
                  
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY                   
   BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;                  
                         
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;           
                  
            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID                  
                              
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;                  
                              
   IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)                  
   BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END                  
   ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */                  
  END CATCH                  
  SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1                  
 END                  
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spGvStockAdjustmentFields]
	-- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here
	@ReceiverTypeFK int,
	@ReceiverFK int
	
AS
BEGIN
	-- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from
	-- interfering with SELECT statements.
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
    SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ UNCOMMITTED

    -- Insert statements for procedure here
	SELECT saf.StockAdjustmentFieldPK AS PK, '/images/AutoPickPalletLocation.png' AS ImagePath, cast(0 as bit) AS IsFiltered, saf.IsArchived, 
		saft.StockAdjustmentFieldType [Field], saf.RequiresPalletRelabelling [Requires New Label], saf.InvoiceCustomerForRelabelling [Invoice Charge], saf.Enabled
	FROM dbo.tblStockAdjustmentFields saf
	INNER JOIN appStockAdjustmentFieldTypes saft on saf.StockAdjustmentFieldTypeFK = saft.StockAdjustmentFieldTypePK
	INNER JOIN appFields af on saft.appFieldFK = af.FieldPK
	WHERE SAF.ReceiverTypeFK = @receiverTypeFK AND saf.ReceiverFK = @ReceiverFK
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spGvStockByLocation]

	@BuildingUnitFK int,
	@OrderBydate bit = 0

 ,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;
	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

	DECLARE @OrderBydate2 bit

	SET @BuildingUnitFK2 = @BuildingUnitFK
	SET @OrderBydate2 = @OrderBydate

	SET @ParameterDetails = '@BuildingUnitFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@BuildingUnitFK2 AS NVARCHAR(20)),'')

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    --BEGIN
			SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

			SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)

			INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
			SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

			SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END

	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY			
		print 'starting'
		print CONVERT(varchar, SYSDATETIME(), 121)

			DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #tempAllLocated
			DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #tempAllLocatedPals
			DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #tempAllLocatedPalContent
			DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #tempFreeSpace
			DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #tempResults

			SELECT BuildingUnitColumnFK, sum (TotalBayWidth) TotalBayWidth, sum (FreeSpace) TotalfreeWidth, 100-(100.0/sum (TotalBayWidth))*sum(FreeSpace) FreeSpace, sum(subq.nopallets) NoPallets
			INTO #tempFreeSpace
			FROM (
				SELECT tbub.buildingunitbaypk, tbub.BuildingUnitColumnFK, tbub.Width as TotalBayWidth,
				CASE WHEN (tbub.Width - isnull(sum(pt.Width + (pt.WidthMargin*2)), 0)) < (isnull(sum(pt.Width + (pt.WidthMargin*2)), 0) / case when count(p.PalletPK) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE count(p.PalletPK) end) THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(tbub.Width - isnull(sum(pt.Width + (pt.WidthMargin*2)), 0), 0, 1) end AS FreeSpace,
				--CASE WHEN (tbub.Width / (case when count(p.PalletPK) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE count(p.PalletPK) end)) < (pt.Width+40) THEN 0 else tbub.Width - isnull(sum(pt.Width + 40), 0) end AS FreeSpace, 
				count(p.PalletPK) nopallets  
				FROM tblbuildingunitbays tbub 
				INNER JOIN dbo.tblBuildingUnitColumns tbuc ON tbub.BuildingUnitColumnFK = tbuc.BuildingUnitColumnPK --AND buildingunitcolumnfk = 41135
				INNER JOIN dbo.tblBuildingUnitRows tbur ON tbuc.BuildingUnitRowFK = tbur.BuildingUnitRowPK AND tbur.BuildingUnitFK = @BuildingUnitFK2
				LEFT JOIN tblpallets p ON p.locationfk = tbub.BuildingUnitBayPK AND p.locationtypefk = 1 
				LEFT JOIN tblpallettypes pt on pallettypefk = pallettypepk 
				WHERE tbub.Isarchived=0 and (p.palletpk is null or(p.isarchived = 0 and p.palletstatusfk <> 10 and p.stackposition = 0))
				GROUP BY tbub.buildingunitbaypk, tbub.BuildingUnitColumnFK, tbub.Width,pt.Width, pt.WidthMargin
			)subq
			GROUP BY BuildingUnitColumnFK

			print 'got free space'
			print CONVERT(varchar, SYSDATETIME(), 121)
			
			SELECT vpl.BuildingUnitColumnFK, vpl.Location AS StockLocation, vpl.palletpk, vpl.[Row], vpl.ColumnNo, PalletStatusFK
			INTO #tempAllLocatedPals
			FROM viewpalletlocations vpl
			INNER JOIN #tempFreeSpace fs ON fs.BuildingUnitColumnFK = vpl.buildingUnitColumnFK
			WHERE buildingunitfk = @BuildingUnitFK2 AND vpl.locationtypefk = 1 --AND vpl.Location = '1.02'

			print 'got located pallets'
			print CONVERT(varchar, SYSDATETIME(), 121)

			select pc.palletcontentpk, pc.palletfk, pc.stockitemfk, pc.inserteddate
			into #tempAllLocatedPalContent
			from tblpalletcontent pc 
			inner join #tempAllLocatedPals vpl on vpl.palletpk = pc.palletfk

			print 'got pallet content'
			print CONVERT(varchar, SYSDATETIME(), 121)

			SELECT vpl.BuildingUnitColumnFK, pc.StockItemFK, StockLocation, StockItemCode, count(vpl.palletpk) as Pallets, PalletStatus AS PalletStatus, 
				cast(day(pc.inserteddate) AS nvarchar(10)) + '\' + cast(month(pc.inserteddate) AS nvarchar(10)) + '\' + cast(year(pc.inserteddate) AS nvarchar(10)) as EarlyReceiptDate, fs.FreeSpace, tpt.Width palWidth, 
				CASE WHEN (count(vpl.palletpk) + (fs.TotalfreeWidth / (tpt.Width+(tpt.WidthMargin*2))))% 2 = 0 THEN (fs.TotalfreeWidth / (tpt.Width+(tpt.WidthMargin*2))) ELSE (fs.TotalfreeWidth / (tpt.Width+(tpt.WidthMargin*2))) end AS PalletSpaces, vpl.[Row], vpl.ColumnNo
			INTO #tempAllLocated
			FROM #tempAllLocatedPals vpl
			INNER JOIN #tempAllLocatedPalContent pc ON vpl.palletpk = pc.palletfk
			INNER JOIN tblstockitems s ON pc.stockitemfk = s.stockitempk
			INNER JOIN dbo.tblPalletTypes tpt ON s.DefaultPalletTypeFK = tpt.PalletTypePK
			INNER JOIN apppalletstatus ps ON vpl.palletstatusfk = ps.palletstatuspk
			INNER JOIN #tempFreeSpace fs ON fs.BuildingUnitColumnFK = vpl.buildingUnitColumnFK
			GROUP BY vpl.buildingunitcolumnfk, pc.StockItemFK, StockLocation, StockItemPK, StockItemCode, PalletStatus, fs.FreeSpace, TotalfreeWidth, tpt.Width, tpt.WidthMargin, cast(day(pc.inserteddate) AS nvarchar(10)) + '\' + cast(month(pc.inserteddate) AS nvarchar(10)) + '\' + cast(year(pc.inserteddate) AS nvarchar(10)), vpl.[Row], vpl.ColumnNo
			ORDER BY StockItemCode, cast(day(pc.inserteddate) AS nvarchar(10)) + '\' + cast(month(pc.inserteddate) AS nvarchar(10)) + '\' + cast(year(pc.inserteddate) AS nvarchar(10)) , StockLocation
				
		print 'got all details'
		print CONVERT(varchar, SYSDATETIME(), 121)		
			--SELECT vpl.BuildingUnitColumnFK, pc.StockItemFK, vpl.Location AS StockLocation, StockItemCode, count(vpl.palletpk) as Pallets, PalletStatus AS PalletStatus, 
			--	cast(day(pc.inserteddate) AS nvarchar(10)) + '\' + cast(month(pc.inserteddate) AS nvarchar(10)) + '\' + cast(year(pc.inserteddate) AS nvarchar(10)) as EarlyReceiptDate, fs.FreeSpace, tpt.Width palWidth, 
			--	CASE WHEN (count(vpl.palletpk) + (fs.TotalfreeWidth / (tpt.Width+(tpt.WidthMargin*2))))% 2 = 0 THEN (fs.TotalfreeWidth / (tpt.Width+(tpt.WidthMargin*2))) ELSE (fs.TotalfreeWidth / (tpt.Width+(tpt.WidthMargin*2))) end AS PalletSpaces, vpl.[Row], vpl.ColumnNo
			--INTO #tempAllLocated
			--FROM viewpalletlocations vpl
			--INNER JOIN tblpalletcontent pc ON vpl.palletpk = pc.palletfk
			--INNER JOIN tblstockitems s ON pc.stockitemfk = s.stockitempk
			--INNER JOIN dbo.tblPalletTypes tpt ON s.DefaultPalletTypeFK = tpt.PalletTypePK
			--INNER JOIN apppalletstatus ps ON vpl.palletstatusfk = ps.palletstatuspk
			--INNER JOIN #tempFreeSpace fs ON fs.BuildingUnitColumnFK = vpl.buildingUnitColumnFK
			--WHERE buildingunitfk = @BuildingUnitFK2 AND vpl.locationtypefk = 1 --AND vpl.Location = '1.02'
			--GROUP BY vpl.buildingunitcolumnfk, pc.StockItemFK, vpl.Location, StockItemPK, StockItemCode, PalletStatus, fs.FreeSpace, TotalfreeWidth, tpt.Width, tpt.WidthMargin, cast(day(pc.inserteddate) AS nvarchar(10)) + '\' + cast(month(pc.inserteddate) AS nvarchar(10)) + '\' + cast(year(pc.inserteddate) AS nvarchar(10)), vpl.[Row], vpl.ColumnNo
			--ORDER BY StockItemCode, cast(day(pc.inserteddate) AS nvarchar(10)) + '\' + cast(month(pc.inserteddate) AS nvarchar(10)) + '\' + cast(year(pc.inserteddate) AS nvarchar(10)) , vpl.Location
			
			--SELECT * FROM #tempFreeSpace
			--SELECT * FROM #tempAllLocated
			
		print 'generating results'
		print CONVERT(varchar, SYSDATETIME(), 121)

			;WITH summary AS (
				SELECT tal.BuildingUnitColumnFK, tal.StockItemFK, tal.StockLocation, tal.StockItemCode, totals.Pallets, tal.PalletStatus, tal.EarlyReceiptDate,tal.FreeSpace, tal.PalletSpaces, tal.[Row], tal.ColumnNo,
						ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY tal.BuildingUnitColumnFK, tal.StockItemFK, tal.PalletStatus
												ORDER BY tal.EarlyReceiptDate asc) AS rk
					FROM #tempAllLocated tal
					INNER JOIN (
					SELECT BuildingUnitColumnFK, StockItemFK, PalletStatus, sum(Pallets) AS pallets 
					FROM #tempAllLocated 
					GROUP BY BuildingUnitColumnFK, StockItemFK, PalletStatus
					)totals ON totals.BuildingUnitColumnFK = tal.BuildingUnitColumnFK AND totals.StockItemFK = tal.StockItemFK AND totals.PalletStatus = tal.PalletStatus
				)
			SELECT CAST(buildingunitcolumnfk AS nvarchar(10)) + '_' + CAST(StockItemFK AS nvarchar(10)) AS PK, StockLocation, StockItemCode, Pallets, PalletStatus, EarlyReceiptDate, FreeSpace, s.PalletSpaces, s.[Row], s.ColumnNo
				into #tempResults
				FROM summary s				
				WHERE s.rk = 1

				if(@OrderBydate2 = 1)
				begin
					SELECT * FROM #tempResults ORDER BY stockitemcode, EarlyReceiptDate 
				END
				else
				BEGIN
					SELECT * FROM #tempResults ORDER BY #tempResults.Row, #tempResults.ColumnNo
				end
		print 'done'
		print CONVERT(varchar, SYSDATETIME(), 121)
			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end			
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END

  SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)

 SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails            
 ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;            
 INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()            
            
 WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3            
 BEGIN             
  BEGIN TRY                          
   -- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start                  
 Select wos.WorksOrderPK AS PK, '/images/WorksOrder.png' AS ImagePath, wos.IsArchived, cast(0 as bit) AS IsFiltered,               
 wokt.WorksOrderType,     AssignedUsers.UserNames,               
 woks.WorksOrderStatus ,        
      
        
  case when wos.worksorderstatusfk=3 and  wos.Worksordertypefk=18 then          
 '$jlnk%scr=CompleteTimeTrackingWorkOrder(' + cast(wos.WorksOrderPK as nvarchar(50)) +');%txt=Restart'           
    when wos.worksorderstatusfk!=3 and wos.Worksordertypefk=18 then       
'$jlnk%scr=CompleteTimeTrackingWorkOrder(' + cast(wos.WorksOrderPK as nvarchar(50)) +');%txt=Complete'       
 else '$jlnk%scr=CompleteContainerWorksOrder(' + cast(wos.WorksOrderPK as nvarchar(50)) +');%txt=Complete' end      
      
  AS Actions    
   
     
          
 from tblWorksOrders wos        
 LEFT OUTER JOIN       
(SELECT wo.WorksOrderPK, ISNULL(STUFF((SELECT ', ' + users.Name FROM viewusers as users inner join [dbo].tblworksorderusers AS WOusers on wousers.UserFk = users.UserPK           
      WHERE wo.WorksOrderPK = WOusers.WorksOrderFK  ORDER BY users.Name  FOR XML PATH('')), 1, 1, ''),'') AS [UserNames]  FROM tblworksorders AS wo           
   ) AS AssignedUsers ON AssignedUsers.WorksOrderPK = wos.WorksOrderPK     
       
   inner join appWorksOrderTypes wokt on wokt.WorksOrderTypePK= wos.WorksOrderTypeFK       
   left outer join appWorksOrderStatus woks on woks.WorksOrderStatusPK = wos.WorKsOrderStatusFK where wos.WorksOrderOriginFK = 1 /*StockIn*/         
 AND FK = @stockInPK    and wokt.WorksOrderSubjectFK=1   
              
   -- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end            
       
   BREAK            
  END TRY            
  BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */            
   DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;            
   SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;            
   SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;            
            
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY             
   BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;            
                   
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;            
            
            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID            
                        
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;            
                        
   IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)            
   BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END            
   ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */            
  END CATCH            
  SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1            
 END

	SET @ParameterDetails = '@stockInFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@stockInFK2 AS NVARCHAR(20)),'')

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY
			

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start

			SELECT sds.StockDiscrepencyPK AS PK, '/images/discrepency.png' AS ImagePath, cast(0 as bit) AS IsFiltered, cast(0 as bit) as IsArchived,
			sis.StockItemCode, sdps.Batch,
			case sds.DiscrepencyTypeFK
				when 1 then 'Extra Pallet'
				when 2 then 'Missing Pallet'
			End as [Discrepency Type],
			Case when Reported = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ then
				'$imgReportDiscrepency.png' 
			else '' End as [Reported],
			case when Reported = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ then cast(sds.ReportedDate as nvarchar(100)) else '' end as [Reported Date],

			Case when Ignored = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ then
				'$imgIgnoreDiscrepency.png' 
			else '' End as [Ignored],
			case when Ignored = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ then cast(sds.IgnoredDate as nvarchar(100)) else '' end as [Ignored Date],

			Case when ReconcileStarted = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ then
				'$imgReconcileDiscrepencyStarted.png' 
			else '' End as [ReconcileStarted],
			case when ReconcileStarted = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ then cast(sds.ReconcileStartedDate as nvarchar(100)) else '' end as [ReconcileStarted Date],

			Case when ReconcileComplete = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ then
				'$imgReconcileDiscrepencyCompleted.png' 
			else '' End as [ReconcileCompleted],
			case when ReconcileComplete = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ then cast(sds.ReconcileCompleteDate as nvarchar(100)) else '' end as [ReconcileComplete Date]

			from tblStockDiscrepencies sds
			inner join tblStockDiscrepencyPallets sdps on
			sdps.StockDiscrepencyFK = sds.StockDiscrepencyPK
			inner join tblStockItems sis on sis.StockItemPK = sdps.StockItemFK
			Where sds.StockInFK = @stockInFK2

			order by sds.InsertedDate   

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end

			
			
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spGvStockInPalletMovements]
(
	@stockInPK int
)	
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT
 ,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;
	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	DECLARE @stockInPK2 int

	SET @stockInPK2 = @stockInPK

	SET @ParameterDetails = '@stockInPK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@stockInPK2 AS NVARCHAR(20)),'')

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    --BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

		SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END


	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY
			

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start

			Select woms.WorksOrderMovementPK AS PK, '/images/PalletMovement.png' AS ImagePath, woms.IsArchived, cast(0 as bit) AS IsFiltered, 
			case when pallets.CustomerBarcode <> '' then pallets.CustomerBarcode else pallets.Barcode end Barcode, 
			pallets.CustomerPalletNumber [Pallet Number],
			stockItems.StockItemCode [Stock Code], pc.Batch,
			woms.Units, 
			--MovementDescription,
			case WHEN woms.SourceLocationTypeFK = 4  THEN 'Unload pallet to ' +  coalesce(vplTo.BuildingUnitBayLocation, 'Invalid Location') else
			 'Move ' + CASE WHEN entirepallet = 1 THEN 'pallet' ELSE 'stock'END + ' from ' 
					+  coalesce(vplFrom.BuildingUnitBayLocation, 'Invalid Location') + ' to '
					+ coalesce(vplTo.BuildingUnitBayLocation + CASE WHEN vplTo.RackingTypefk = 1 THEN RIGHT('00'+CAST(woms.destinationbayposition AS VARCHAR(2)),2) ELSE '' end, 'Invalid Location') end AS Description,
			case woms.WorksOrderStatusFK
				when 1/*AwaitingAssignment*/ then '$imgAwaitingAssignment.png'
				when 2/*Assigned*/ then '$imgAssignWork.png'
				when 3/*Complete*/ then '$imgComplete.png'
				when 4/*Cancelled*/ then '$imgCancelled.png'
			end as Status
			from tblWorksOrderMovements woms
			inner join (
				Select Distinct PalletFK, StockItemFK
				From tblStockInLinePallets subSilps
				inner join tblStockInLines sils on
				sils.StockInLinePK = subSilps.StockInLineFK
				AND sils.StockInFK = @stockInPK2
			)silps on  silps.PalletFK = woms.PalletFK

			inner join tblPallets pallets on
			pallets.PalletPK = silps.PalletFK AND pallets.IsArchived = 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/

			inner join (
				Select PalletFK, StockItemFK, Batch
				from dbo.tblPalletContent
				GROUP BY PalletFK, StockItemFK, Batch
			) pc on pc.PalletFK = pallets.PalletPK

			inner join tblStockItems stockItems on
				stockItems.StockItemPK = silps.StockItemFK

			inner join tblWorksOrders wos on
				wos.WorksOrderPK = woms.WorksOrderFK
				AND wos.WorksOrderStatusFK <> 5 --we dont want to see standby movements
				AND wos.WorksOrderOriginFK = 1 --Jamie: should only show StockIn works orders

			LEFT JOIN viewBuildingUnitBays vplFrom ON 
				woms.sourcelocationtypefk = vplFrom.locationtypefk AND woms.SourceLocationFK = vplFrom.buildingunitbaypk
			LEFT JOIN viewBuildingUnitBays vplTo ON 
				woms.DestinationLocationTypeFK = vplTo.locationtypefk AND woms.DestinationFK = vplTo.buildingunitbaypk

			--jamie : added order by pallet and time, easier for users to read on wms when multiple movements per pallet on stockIn
			order by StockItems.StockItemCode, woms.PalletFK, woms.inserteddate
		
			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end

			
			
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL   
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)  
  
    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)  
    --BEGIN  
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC   
  
  SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)  
  
        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)  
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK  
  
        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()  
    --END  
  
  
 SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);  
 SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails  
 ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;  
 INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()  
  
 WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3  
 BEGIN   
  BEGIN TRY  
     
  
   -- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start  
  
   SELECT     subSilps.PalletFK AS PK, '/images/Pallet.png' AS ImagePath, cast(0 as bit) AS IsFiltered, 0 as IsArchived,   
   isnull(case when pallets.CustomerBarcode <> '' then pallets.CustomerBarcode else pallets.Barcode end, 'Pallet Does Not Exist') Barcode,  
   CustomerPalletNumber [Pallet Number],   
   stockItems.StockItemCode as [Stock Code], subSilps.Batch,    
   isnull(wops.WorksOrders, 0) as WorksOrders,   
   /*case when sids.PalletFK is null then '$jlnk%scr=ShowDamages(' + cast(PalletPK as nvarchar(50)) + ','   
   + cast(stockItems.StockItemPK as nvarchar(50)) + ',' + stockItems.StockItemCode + ',''' + subSilps.Batch + ''');%txt=OK'   
   else '$jlnk%scr=ShowDamages(' + cast(PalletPK as nvarchar(50)) + ',' + cast(stockItems.StockItemPK as nvarchar(50)) + ','   
   + stockItems.StockItemCode + ',''' + subSilps.Batch + ''');%txt=Damaged' end as 'Condition',*/  
   
   --case when pallets.palletstatusfk = 10 then '$imgArrived.png'  
   --else case pallets.LocationTypeFK   
   -- when 1 then '$imgBuilding.png'  
   -- when 2 then '$imgLoadingBay.png'  
   -- when 3 then '$imgSetDownArea.png'  
   -- when 4 then '$imgArrived.png'   
   -- when 6 then '$imgSampleLocation.png'  
   -- when 8 then '$imgFloorLocation.png'  
   -- else '$imgBuilding.png' end end as Location,   ----PRitesh
   vpl.Location as Location,
   
   '$hideCell=1' + cast(Pallets.PalletStatusFK as nvarchar(50)) as [$hideCol%PalletStatus]  
  
   FROM (Select Distinct(PalletFK), sils.StockItemFK, sils.Batch, sils.StockInFK from dbo.tblStockInLines sils  
     inner join tblStockInLinePallets silps on  
     silps.StockInLineFK = sils.StockInLinePK) subSilps  
  
   inner join tblStockItems stockItems on  
   stockItems.StockItemPK = subSilps.StockItemFK  
  
   left outer join tblPallets pallets  on  
   pallets.PalletPK = subSilps.PalletFK  
  
   left outer join (Select count(*) WorksOrders, PalletFK from tblWorksOrderPallets group By PalletFK) wops  
   on  
   wops.PalletFK = subSilps.PalletFK  
  
   left outer join   
   (  
    Select PalletFK from tblStockInDamages  
    Group By PalletFK  
   ) sids on  
   sids.PalletFK = pallets.PalletPK  
   

   left outer join viewPalletLocations vpl on vpl.PalletPK =pallets.PalletPK ----Pritesh
   where subSilps.StockInFK = @stockInPK2  
  
   order by stockItems.StockItemCode, subSilps.Batch, Barcode ASC      
  
   -- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end  
  
     
     
   BREAK  
  END TRY  
  BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */  
   DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;  
   SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;  
   SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;  
  
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY   
   BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;  
         
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;  
  
            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID  
              
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;  
              
   IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)  
   BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END  
   ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */  
  END CATCH  
  SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1  
 END  
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spGvStockInRules]
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT
 ,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;
	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	--DECLARE 

	SET @ParameterDetails = ''

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    --BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

		SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END


	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY
			

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start

			SELECT     StockInRulePK AS PK, '/images/StockInRules.png' AS ImagePath, cast(0 as bit) AS IsFiltered, sirs.IsArchived, 
			--rrts.RuleReceiverType [Rule Receiver Type],
			/*CASE sirs.ReceiverTypeFK
			WHEN 1 THEN 'Customer'
			WHEN 2 THEN 'Division'
			WHEN 3 THEN 'Stock Code'
			END as [Rule Level],*/
			/*CASE sirs.ReceiverTypeFK
			WHEN 1 THEN cus.CustomerName
			WHEN 2 THEN divs.DivisionName
			WHEN 3 THEN sis.StockItemCode
			END as [Applied To],*/
			coalesce(cus.CustomerCode + ' - ' + cus.CustomerName, '') AS Customer,
			coalesce(divs.DivisionCode + ' - ' + divs.DivisionName, '') AS Division,
			coalesce(sis.StockItemCode, '') AS [Stock Code],
			sups.Supplier,
			sirts.StockInRuleType,
			fields.FieldName as [Field],
			case when sirs.IntegerValue >= 0 then cast(sirs.IntegerValue as nvarchar(10)) else '' end as [Numeric Parameter],
			copyfields.FieldName as [Copy From Field]
			FROM         dbo.tblStockInRules sirs
			INNER join appStockInRuleTypes sirts on
			sirts.StockInRuleTypePK = sirs.StockInRuleTypeFK
			INNER join appRuleReceiverTypes rrts on
			rrts.RuleReceiverTypePK = sirs.ReceiverTypeFK
			INNER JOIN appFields fields ON fields.FieldPK = sirs.FieldFK
			left JOIN appFields copyfields ON copyfields.FieldPK = sirs.CopyFromFieldFK
			LEFT OUTER join tblStockItems sis on sis.StockItemPK = sirs.ReceiverFK AND sirs.ReceiverTypeFK = 3
			LEFT OUTER join tblDivisions divs on (divs.DivisionPK = sirs.ReceiverFK and sirs.ReceiverTypeFK = 2) OR (divs.DivisionPK = sis.DivisionFK)
			LEFT OUTER join tblCustomers cus on (cus.CustomerPK = sirs.ReceiverFK and sirs.ReceiverTypeFK = 1) OR (cus.CustomerPK = divs.CustomerFK)
			
			LEFT OUTER join tblSuppliers sups on sups.SupplierPK = sirs.SupplierFK

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end

			
			
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spGvStockInSummary]

    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT
 ,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;
	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    --BEGIN
			SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

			SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)

			INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
			SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

			SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END


	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY
			

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start

			SELECT stockinlinepk AS PK, stockitemcode, PalletStatus, count(PalletPK) NoPallets, CASE WHEN vpl.Location LIKE '%loading%' THEN 'Dispatched' else vpl.Location END AS [Location], sil.Free1 AS LineNumber,  FORMAT (sil.InsertedDate, 'HH : mm') AS InsertedTime, sil.Free2 AS Confirmed
			FROM tblstockinlines sil 
			INNER JOIN tblstockinlinepallets silp ON stockinlinefk = sil.StockInLinePK
			INNER JOIN dbo.viewPalletLocations vpl ON silp.palletfk = vpl.PalletPK
			INNER JOIN appPalletStatus ps ON vpl.palletstatusfk = ps.palletstatuspk
			INNER JOIN tblstockitems si ON sil.stockitemfk = si.stockitempk
			WHERE stockinfk = @stockInPK2
			GROUP BY stockinlinepk, sil.InsertedDate, stockitemcode, PalletStatus, free1, sil.Free2, vpl.Location
			ORDER BY cast(sil.Free1 AS int)

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end

			
			
			BREAK
		END TRY

			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spGvStockItemDeliveryStatus]
(
	@StockItemFK int,
	@IncludeArchived bit = 0
)
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED

	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	DECLARE @StockItemFK2 int
	DECLARE @IncludeArchived2 BIT

	SET @StockItemFK2 = @StockItemFK
	SET @IncludeArchived2 = @IncludeArchived

	SET @ParameterDetails = '@StockItemFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@StockItemFK2 AS NVARCHAR(20)),'')

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

				CONVERT(VARCHAR(50), sids.InsertedDate, 106) AS [Date Added], 
				CASE WHEN sids.IsArchived = 1 THEN CONVERT(VARCHAR(50), sids.UpdatedDate, 106) ELSE '' END AS [Date removed]
			FROM 
				dbo.tblStockItemDeliveryStatus sids
			INNER JOIN 
				dbo.appPalletStatus aps ON sids.PalletStatusfk = aps.PalletStatusPK
			INNER JOIN

			where

    --BEGIN

        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

    --END

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY
			

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start

			SELECT StockItemFixedLocationPK AS PK, '/images/FixedLocation.png' AS ImagePath, fixedLocations.IsArchived, cast(0 as bit) AS IsFiltered, 
			--buildings.BuildingName + ' - ' + bus.BuildingUnit + ' ' + buRows.Row + buCols.BuildingUnitColumnName + buBays.BayLevel + cast(fixedLocations.BayPosition as nvarchar(10)) as Location,
			buildings.BuildingName + ' - ' + bus.BuildingUnit + ' ' + case when buRows.Translate = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ then
			case when buRows.ReverseTranslate = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ then
			buRows.TranslatedRow + right('0' + cast((buRows.TranslateColumn - buCols.BuildingUnitColumn) as nvarchar(10)),2) 
			+ lower(buBays.BayLevel) + right('0' + cast(fixedLocations.BayPosition as nvarchar(10)),2)

			End
			else

			+ right('0' + cast(fixedLocations.BayPosition as nvarchar(10)),2) 
			End as Location,

			fixedLocations.LocationOrder
	
			FROM         dbo.tblStockItemFixedLocations fixedLocations
			inner join tblBuildingUnitBays buBays on
			buBays.BuildingUnitBayPK = fixedLocations.BuildingUnitBayFK

			inner join tblBuildingUnitColumns buCols on
			buCols.BuildingUnitColumnPK = buBays.BuildingUnitColumnFK

			inner join tblBuildingUnitRows buRows on
			buRows.BuildingUnitRowPK = buCols.BuildingUnitRowFK

			inner join tblBuildingUnits bus on
			bus.BuildingUnitPK = buRows.BuildingUnitFK

			inner join tblBuildings buildings on
			buildings.BuildingPK = bus.BuildingFK

			where fixedLocations.StockItemFK = @FK2 and fixedLocations.IsArchived=0 and buBays.IsArchived=0

			order by fixedLocations.LocationOrder

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end

			
			
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;

			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END

			samplingSendTypes.SamplingTypePK = samplingRules.SamplingSendTypeFK

			left outer join appSamplingTypes samplingBreakTypes
			on
			samplingBreakTypes.SamplingTypePK = samplingRules.SamplingBreakTypeFK

			where stockItemFK = @stockItemFK2

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end

			
			
			BREAK
		END TRY

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spGvStockLevelsForUser]
(
	@userFK int
)	
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT
 ,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;
	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	DECLARE @userFK2 int

	SET @userFK2 = @userFK

	SET @ParameterDetails = '@userFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@userFK2 AS NVARCHAR(20)),'')

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    --BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

		SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END


	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY
			

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start

			drop table if exists #tmpUserDivisions
			select distinct DivisionPK, DivisionName, DivisionCode
			into #tmpUserDivisions
			from tbldivisions divs
			inner join tblUserDivisions uds ON uds.DivisionFK = divs.DivisionPK
			where uds.UserFK = @userFK2	

			drop table if exists #tmpdivisionpallets
			select p.palletpk, p.palletstatusfk, StockItemFK, sum(ActualUnits) ActualUnits, sum(AvailableUnits) AvailableUnits
			into #tmpdivisionpallets
			from tblpallets p
			inner join tblpalletcontent pc on palletfk = palletpk
			inner join tblstockitems s on stockitemfk = stockitempk 
			inner join #tmpUserDivisions on DivisionFK = DivisionPK
			where p.IsArchived = 0
			group by p.palletpk, p.palletstatusfk, StockItemFK

			drop table if exists #tmpResults	

			SELECT StockItemPK, DivisionName, isnull(sum(okStock.ActualUnits),0) AS ActualUnits,
			StockItemCode [Stock], sis.Description, isnull(sum(okStock.Pallets), 0) Pallets, unitTypes.Abbreviation [UoM], 
			isnull(sum(okStock.AvailableUnits), 0) AvailableUnits, isnull(sum(okStock.ActualUnits),0) - isnull(sum(okStock.AvailableUnits), 0) UnitsOnOrder, 
			sum(isnull(notOkStock.Pallets, 0)) [PalletsOnHold], sum(isnull(enrouteStock.Pallets, 0)) [PalletsOnRoute],
			'$RowColor=0' as [$hideCol%$RowColor]
			INTO #tmpResults
			from #tmpUserDivisions divs
			inner join tblStockItems sis ON sis.DivisionFK = divs.DivisionPK and sis.isarchived = 0
			left outer join tblUnitTypes unitTypes ON unitTypes.UnitTypePK = sis.UnitTypeFK
			left outer join (
				Select StockItemFK, count(*) Pallets, sum(ActualUnits) ActualUnits, sum(AvailableUnits) AvailableUnits from (
					Select StockItemFK, PalletPK, sum(ActualUnits) ActualUnits, sum(AvailableUnits) AvailableUnits
					from #tmpdivisionpallets p
					Where p.PalletStatusFK <> 10 
					Group By StockItemFK, PalletPK
				) subQ
				Group By StockItemFK
			) okStock ON okStock.StockItemFK = sis.StockItemPK

			left outer join (
				Select StockItemFK, count(*) Pallets, sum(ActualUnits) ActualUnits, sum(AvailableUnits) AvailableUnits from (
					Select StockItemFK, PalletPK, sum(ActualUnits) ActualUnits, sum(AvailableUnits) AvailableUnits
					from #tmpdivisionpallets p
					Where p.PalletStatusFK <> 1 /*Available*/ AND p.PalletStatusFK <> 10
					Group By StockItemFK, PalletPK
				) subQ
				Group By StockItemFK
			) notOkStock ON notOkStock.StockItemFK = sis.StockItemPK

			left outer join (
				Select StockItemFK, count(*) Pallets, sum(ActualUnits) ActualUnits, sum(AvailableUnits) AvailableUnits from (
					Select StockItemFK, PalletPK, sum(ActualUnits) ActualUnits, sum(AvailableUnits) AvailableUnits
					from #tmpdivisionpallets p
					Where p.PalletStatusFK = 10
					Group By StockItemFK, PalletPK
				) subQ
				Group By StockItemFK
			) enrouteStock ON enrouteStock.StockItemFK = sis.StockItemPK
			Group By StockItemPK, StockItemCode, sis.Description,unitTypes.Abbreviation, DivisionName


			Select * from (
				SELECT StockItemPK AS PK, '/images/pallet.png' AS ImagePath, cast(0 as bit) AS IsArchived, cast(0 as bit) AS IsFiltered, 
				[Stock], [Description], [UoM], AvailableUnits [Available Units], UnitsOnOrder [Units On Order], Pallets [Total Pallets], PalletsOnHold [Pallets On Hold], PalletsOnRoute [Pallets On Route],
				'$RowColor=0' as [$hideCol%$RowColor]	
				FROM #tmpResults
				UNION

				SELECT -1 AS PK, '/images/report.png' AS ImagePath, cast(0 as bit) AS IsArchived, cast(0 as bit) AS IsFiltered, 
				'Total','', '' [UoM], sum(AvailableUnits) AvailableUnits,  
				sum(ActualUnits) - sum(AvailableUnits) UnitsOnOrder, sum(Pallets) Pallets, sum(isnull(PalletsOnHold, 0)) [Pallets On Hold], 
				sum(isnull(PalletsOnRoute, 0)) [Pallets On Route],
				'$RowColor=3' as [$RowColor]

				from #tmpResults	
			) subQ
			ORDER BY CASE WHEN PK = -1 THEN -1 ELSE 1 END ASC, Stock ASC

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end

			
			
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spGvStockOrders]
(
	@userFK int
)	
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT

	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	DECLARE @userFK2 int

	SET @userFK2 = @userFK

	SET @ParameterDetails = '@userFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@userFK2 AS NVARCHAR(20)),'')

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    --BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

		SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END


	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY
			
			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start

					-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start
		  IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#Tmp_Orders ') IS NOT NULL       
			DROP TABLE #Tmp_Orders 					-- create temp table to hold all the movements on the pick
		  IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#Tmp_StockOutStatus ') IS NOT NULL       
			DROP TABLE #Tmp_StockOutStatus 					-- create temp table to hold all the movements on the pick
	


				SELECT  Distinct orders.stockOrderPk, orders.PickLoaded, orders.PickCompleted, orders.IsArchived [Archived], orders.ResponsibleBuildingUnitFK, contOuts.*,BuildingName + ' - ' + bus.BuildingUnit as [Building Unit]
				INTO #Tmp_Orders 
				from tblStockOrders orders
				INNER JOIN tblContainerOuts contOuts on contOuts.ContainerOutPK = orders.ContainerOutFK
   			    inner join (select * from tblUserBuildingUnits  where userfk = @userFK2) ubu on orders.ResponsibleBuildingUnitFK = ubu.BuildingUnitFK 
				inner join tblBuildingUnits bus on bus.buildingunitpk = orders.ResponsibleBuildingUnitFK
				inner join tblbuildings bu on bu.BuildingPK = bus.buildingfk
				Where ContainerOutStatusFK = 1 /*Pending*/ OR ContainerOutStatusFK = 2 /*User Assigned*/

				
				-- Retrieves the status of the pick
				select  stockorderpk ,
				 case  
				 when Orders.PickLoaded = 1 then 'Pick Loaded'
				 when Orders.PickCompleted = 1 then 'Pick Finished' 				
				 WHEN MAX(woms.worksorderstatusfk) = 3 THEN 'Pick Started'
				 WHEN MAX(woms.worksorderstatusfk) = 1 THEN 'Pick Issued'
			     when Orders.CollectionDate <> '1900-01-01 00:00:00.000' then 'Collection Scheduled'
				 when Orders.CollectionDate = '1900-01-01 00:00:00.000' then 'New Order'End as 'PickStatus'
				 INTO #Tmp_StockOutStatus
				FROM #Tmp_Orders orders--all inward works orders
			    left outer join tblworksorders wo on wo.worksorderOriginFK =  2 /*outward movements*/ and wo.fk =  Orders.stockorderpk
			    left outer join tblworksordermovements woms on woms.isarchived = 0 and woms.worksorderfk = wo.worksorderpk
				group by StockOrderPK, WorksOrderFK, PickLoaded, CollectionDate, PickCompleted
								
				
			SELECT    distinct Orders.StockOrderPK AS PK, '/images/StockOrder.png' AS ImagePath, cast(0 as bit) AS IsFiltered, Orders.Archived [IsArchived], 
			Orders.GoodsOrderNumber,  [Building Unit], CONVERT(VARCHAR(50), Orders.CollectionDate, 106) 
			+ ' ' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(5), Orders.CollectionDate, 108) CollectionDate, CONVERT(VARCHAR(50), Orders.DeliveryDate, 106) DeliveryDate, TransportCompany,
			custs.CustomerName as [Customer Name],
			Orders.Address1,
			case when cdis.CustomerDocketIdentificationPK is null then 
				case when Docketlabel1 <> '' THEN Docketlabel1 + ': ' + DocketValue1 else ''end + ' ' +
				case when Docketlabel2 <> '' THEN Docketlabel2 + ': ' + DocketValue2  else '' end + ' ' +
				case when Docketlabel3 <> '' THEN Docketlabel3 + ': ' + DocketValue3 else '' end	
			else
				case cdis.FieldFK when 40 then
					cdis.Prefix + ' ' + Orders.DocketValue1
				when 41 then
					cdis.Prefix + ' ' + Orders.DocketValue2
				when 42 then
					cdis.Prefix + ' ' + Orders.DocketValue3
				end
				+ ' ' +
				case cdis.Field2FK when 40 then
					cdis.Prefix2 + ' ' + Orders.DocketValue1
				when 41 then
					cdis.Prefix2 + ' ' + Orders.DocketValue2
				when 42 then
					cdis.Prefix2 + ' ' + Orders.DocketValue3
				else
					''
				end
			End as [ID],
			sStatus.PickStatus as [Status],
			'$jlnk%scr=ShowNotes(' + cast(Orders.StockOrderPK as nvarchar(50)) + ');%txt=Notes' as [Notes]
	
			FROM 
			#Tmp_Orders as Orders 
			inner join #Tmp_StockOutStatus sStatus on sStatus.StockOrderPK = Orders.StockOrderPK
			left outer join tblTransportCompanies transportCompanies
			on
			transportCompanies.TransportCompanyPK = Orders.TransportCompanyFK  

			left outer join tblShippingCompanies shippingCompanies
			on
			shippingCompanies.ShippingCompanyPK = Orders.ShippingCompanyFK  

			left outer join (
				Select ContainerOutFK, MAX(DivisionFK) DivisionFK from tblContainerOutLines
				Group By ContainerOutFK
			)cols on
			cols.ContainerOutFK = Orders.ContainerOutPK

			left outer join tblDivisions divs on
			divs.DivisionPK = cols.DivisionFK

			inner join tblCustomers custs on custs.CustomerPK = divs.CustomerFK

			left outer join tblCustomerDocketIdentifications cdis on
			cdis.CustomerFK = divs.CustomerFK
			AND cdis.DocketTypeFK = 2 /*ContainerOut*/

			left outer join tblBuildingUnits bus on
			bus.BuildingUnitPK = Orders.ResponsibleBuildingUnitFK
			order by Orders.StockOrderPK DESC     
					


			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end
						
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END

/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[spGvStockOrderWorksExistingOrderMovements]    Script Date: 02/11/2026 17:47:26 ******/
