--exec spGvStockOrderWorksExistingOrderMovements @stockOrderFK=296079  
    
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spGvStockOrderWorksExistingOrderMovements]              
(              
 @stockOrderFK int,              
 @Stage int = -1              
)               
AS              
BEGIN              
 /* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */              
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED              
              
    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT              
 ,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;              
 SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();              
              
 -- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters              
 DECLARE @stockOrderFK2 int              
 DECLARE @Stage2 int              
              
 SET @stockOrderFK2 = @stockOrderFK              
 SET @Stage2 = @Stage              
              
 SET @ParameterDetails = '@stockOrderFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@stockOrderFK2 AS NVARCHAR(20)),'')              
              
    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL               
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)              
              
    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)              
    --BEGIN              
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC               
              
  SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)              
              
        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)              
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK              
              
        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()              
    --END              
              
              
 SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);              
 SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails              
 ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;              
 INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()              
              
 WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3              
 BEGIN               
  BEGIN TRY              
                 
              
   -- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start              
              
   --get all works orders              
   IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#TempWorksOrders') IS NOT NULL              
    DROP TABLE #TempWorksOrders              
   SELECT * INTO #TempWorksOrders FROM dbo.tblWorksOrders two WHERE WorksOrderOriginFK = 2/*StockOrder*/ AND FK = @stockOrderFK2 AND IsArchived = 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/              
                
   --get summary of other work by pallet              
   IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#TempOtherWork') IS NOT NULL              
    DROP TABLE #TempOtherWork              
              
              
   SELECT DISTINCT palletfk, STRING_AGG(trim(worksordertypealias), ' / ') AS OtherWork              
   INTO #TempOtherWork               
   FROM(              
    SELECT DISTINCT palletfk, worksordertypealias              
    FROM dbo.tblWorksOrderPallets twop               
    INNER JOIN #TempWorksOrders ON twop.WorksOrderFK = WorksOrderPK              
    INNER JOIN dbo.appWorksOrderTypes awot ON #TempWorksOrders.WorksOrderTypeFK = awot.WorksOrderTypePK where WorksOrderTypeFK NOT IN (3,16)              
 GROUP BY PalletFK, worksordertypealias)subq              
   GROUP BY PalletFK              
              
              
   IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#TempResults') IS NOT NULL              
    DROP TABLE #TempResults              
              
   Select WorksOrderMovementPK,     
    worksOrderMovements.PalletFK,    
    CASE   
        WHEN worksOrderMovements.EntirePallet = 1 AND ISNULL(worksOrderMovements.Eaches,0) = 0   
            THEN -1   
        ELSE worksOrderMovements.PalletContentFK   
    END AS PalletContentFK,      
   worksOrderMovements.Eaches,    
   worksOrderMovements.Units AS Units,    
    worksOrderMovements.EntirePallet,    
    worksOrderMovements.IsArchived,              
   case when pallets.CustomerBarcode <> '' then pallets.CustomerBarcode else pallets.Barcode end Barcode,               
   pallets.CustomerPalletNumber [Pallet Number],               
   stockItems.StockItemCode as 'Stock Code',               
   palletContent.Batch,              
   case when movementdescription like '%HAND HELD%' then 1 else 0 end as scanned,   
   coalesce(vplFrom.BuildingUnitBayLocation, 'Invalid Location') AS FromLocation,              
   coalesce(vplTo.BuildingUnitBayLocation, 'Invalid Location') AS ToLocation,              
   pallets.LocationTypeFK AS CurrentLocationTypeFK,              
   coalesce(vplPalletLocation.BuildingUnitBayLocation, 'Invalid Location') AS CurrentLocation,              
   worksOrderMovements.WorksOrderStatusFK,              
   case when pallets.PalletStatusFK = 11 OR isnull(colpc.Loaded, 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/) = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS PalletLoaded,              
   CASE when worksOrderMovements.ResponsibleUserFK > 0 then AssignedUser.PersonName  end as 'Assigned To',              
   CASE when worksOrderMovements.WorksOrderStatusFK = 3 then CompleteUser.PersonName ELSE '' end as 'Completed By',              
   CASE when worksOrderMovements.WorksOrderStatusFK = 3 then CONVERT(VARCHAR(50), worksOrderMovements.updateddate) ELSE ''  end as 'Completed Date', OW.OtherWork, worksOrderMovements.updateddate              
   INTO #TempResults              
   FROM #TempWorksOrders worksOrders               
   INNER JOIN tblWorksOrderMovements worksOrderMovements ON  worksOrders.WorksOrderPK = worksOrderMovements.WorksOrderFK              
   INNER JOIN tblPallets pallets ON pallets.PalletPK = worksOrderMovements.PalletFK                  
   left outer join (              
    Select PalletFK, StockItemFK, batch, sum(ActualUnits) ActualUnits from tblPalletContent              
    --Where IsArchived = 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/              
    Group by PalletFK, StockItemFK, batch              
   ) palletContent ON palletContent.PalletFK = pallets.PalletPK      
   Left Join tblPalletContent pc ON pc.PalletContentPK=worksOrderMovements.PalletContentFK    
   INNER JOIN tblStockItems stockItems ON stockItems.StockItemPK = palletContent.StockItemFK              
   left outer join tblContainerOutLinePalletContent colpc ON colpc.ContainerOutLinePalletContentPK = worksOrderMovements.ContainerOutLinePalletContentFK              
   left outer join(              
    select (p.Firstname + ' ' + p.LastName) as PersonName, u.userpk              
    from tblusers u               
    inner join tblpeople p on u.personfk = p.personpk              
   ) CompleteUser on CompleteUser.userpk = worksOrderMovements.UpdatedBy              
   left outer join(              
    select (p.Firstname + ' ' + p.LastName) as PersonName, u.userpk              
    from tblusers u               
    inner join tblpeople p on u.personfk = p.personpk              
   ) AssignedUser on AssignedUser.userpk = worksOrderMovements.ResponsibleUserFK              
   LEFT JOIN viewBuildingUnitBays vplFrom ON  worksOrderMovements.sourcelocationtypefk = vplFrom.locationtypefk AND worksOrderMovements.SourceLocationFK = vplFrom.buildingunitbaypk              
   LEFT JOIN viewBuildingUnitBays vplTo ON  worksOrderMovements.DestinationLocationTypeFK = vplTo.locationtypefk AND worksOrderMovements.DestinationFK = vplTo.buildingunitbaypk              
   LEFT JOIN viewBuildingUnitBays vplPalletLocation ON  pallets.LocationTypeFK = vplPalletLocation.locationtypefk AND pallets.LocationFK = vplPalletLocation.buildingunitbaypk              
   LEFT JOIN #TempOtherWork OW ON OW.palletfk = worksOrderMovements.PalletFK              
              
   Where worksOrders.WorksOrderOriginFK = 2/*StockOrder*/              
    AND worksOrders.WorksOrderTypeFK = 3              
    AND worksOrders.FK = @stockOrderFK2              
    AND worksOrders.IsArchived = 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/              
    AND worksOrderMovements.DestinationLocationTypeFK = 2/*only show movements to loading bay (ignore extra scan movements)*/              
    and         worksOrderMovements.isarchived=0  
               
   IF(@Stage2 = 1)              
   BEGIN              
    SELECT WorksOrderMovementPK AS PK,  
 PalletFK,  
 PalletContentFK,   
 Eaches,  
 Units,  
    EntirePallet,      
 '/images/PalletMovement.png' AS ImagePath,   
 cast(0 as bit) AS IsFiltered,   
 IsArchived,              
     [Stock Code],   
  Batch,   
  Barcode,  
  [Pallet Number],   
  CASE WHEN EntirePallet = 1 THEN 'Pallet' ELSE  Cast(units AS nvarchar(10)) END as Quantity,          
    CurrentLocation [Location],           
  --FromLocation [Location],           
  [Assigned To], OtherWork [Other WO]              
     FROM #TempResults               
    WHERE WorksOrderStatusFK <> 3              
    ORDER BY FromLocation, [Stock Code], Batch, Barcode              
   END              
   ELSE IF (@Stage2 = 2)              
   BEGIN              
    --;WITH cte AS              
    -- (              
        SELECT WorksOrderMovementPK AS PK,  
  PalletFK,  
  PalletContentFK,  
  Eaches,    
        Units,  
        EntirePallet,  
    '/images/PalletMovement.png' AS ImagePath,  
    cast(0 as bit) AS IsFiltered,   
    IsArchived,              
       /*[Stock Code], Batch,*/ Barcode, [Pallet Number],  
    CASE WHEN EntirePallet = 1 THEN 'Pallet' ELSE  Cast(units AS nvarchar(10)) END as Quantity,   
    ToLocation [Location],               
      [Assigned To],              
      CASE WHEN WorksOrderStatusFK = 3 then CASE WHEN [Assigned To] = [Completed By] then 'Assignee' else [Completed By] END ELSE 'pending' end as [Actioned By]              
       , case when Scanned = 1 THEN '$imgtrafficlight_green.png' ELSE ' ' END AS Scan, OtherWork [Other WO]--,              
      --ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY Barcode ORDER BY #TempResults.updateddate DESC) AS rn              
        FROM #TempResults               
      WHERE WorksOrderStatusFK = 3              
     -- GROUP BY #TempResults.PalletPK              
    -- )              
    -- SELECT PK, ImagePath, IsFiltered, IsArchived, Barcode, [Pallet Number], Quantity, [Location],[Assigned To],[Actioned By], Scan, [Other WO]              
    -- FROM cte              
    -- WHERE rn = 1              
     ORDER BY [Location], [Pallet Number], Barcode              
   END              
   ELSE              
   BEGIN              
    Select WorksOrderMovementPK AS PK,  
 PalletFK,  
    PalletContentFK,  
    Eaches,    
    Units,  
    EntirePallet,  
 '/images/PalletMovement.png' AS ImagePath,   
 cast(0 as bit) AS IsFiltered,  
 IsArchived,              
    Barcode,  
 [Pallet Number],  
 [Stock Code],  
 Batch,              
   'Move ' +               
         CASE WHEN EntirePallet = 1 THEN 'pallet' ELSE 'stock' END               
         + ' from ' + FromLocation + ' to ' + ToLocation AS Description,              
        case WorksOrderStatusFK              
        when 1/*AwaitingAssignment*/ then '$imgAwaitingAssignment.png'                      when 2/*Assigned*/ then '$imgAssignWork.png'              
        when 3/*Complete*/ then               
           case when PalletLoaded=1 then '$imgLoaded.png'  ELSE '$imgComplete.png'  end              
        when 4/*Cancelled*/ then '$imgCancelled.png'              
        end as Status,                    
        [Completed By]           
    FROM #TempResults              
   END              
              
                 
                 
   BREAK              
  END TRY              
  BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */              
   DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;              
   SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;              
   SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;              
              
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY               
   BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;              
                     
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;              
              
            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID              
                          
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;              
                          
   IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)              
   BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END              
   ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */              
  END CATCH              
  SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1              
 END              
END   
GO

   CASE when worksOrderMovements.ResponsibleUserFK > 0 then AssignedUser.PersonName  end as 'Assigned To',

    inner join tblpeople p on u.personfk = p.personpk

   LEFT JOIN viewBuildingUnitBays vplFrom ON  worksOrderMovements.sourcelocationtypefk = vplFrom.locationtypefk AND worksOrderMovements.SourceLocationFK = vplFrom.buildingunitbaypk

    AND worksOrders.WorksOrderTypeFK = 3

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spGvStockOrderWorksOrders]                  
(                  
 @stockOrderFK int,                  
 @palletBarcode nvarchar(100) = '',                  
 @AirFreightOnly bit = 0,                  
 @ReturnPKListOnly bit = 0                  
)                   
AS                  
BEGIN                  
 /* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */                  
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED                  
                  
    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT                  
 ,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;                  
 SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();                  
                  
 -- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters                  
 DECLARE @stockOrderFK2 int, @palletBarcode2 nvarchar(100), @AirFreightOnly2 bit, @ReturnPKListOnly2 bit                  
                  
 SET @stockOrderFK2 = @stockOrderFK; SET @palletBarcode2 = @palletBarcode; SET @AirFreightOnly2 = @AirFreightOnly; SET @ReturnPKListOnly2 = @ReturnPKListOnly                  
                  
 SET @ParameterDetails = '@stockOrderFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@stockOrderFK2 AS NVARCHAR(20)),'') + ',@palletBarcode = ' + ISNULL(@palletBarcode2,'')                  
  + '@@AirFreightOnly = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@AirFreightOnly2 AS NVARCHAR(20)),'')                  
                  
    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL                   
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)                  
                  
    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)                  
    --BEGIN                  
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC                   
                  
  SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)                  
                  
        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)                  
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK                  
                  
        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()                  
    --END                  
                  
                  
 SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);                  
 SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails                  
 ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;                  
 INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()                  
                  
 WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3                  
 BEGIN                   
  BEGIN TRY               
                  
 -- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start                     
                  
 DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #Tmp_WorksOrders                   
 Select worksOrders.WorksOrderPK, worksOrders.worksorderstatusfk, worksorders.WorksOrderOriginFK, worksorders.worksordertypefk, wots.WorksOrderType, wots.WorksOrderTypeDescription, worksorders.ResponsibleUserFK, worksOrders.IsArchived            
 INTO #Tmp_WorksOrders                  
 From tblWorksOrders worksOrders               
 inner join appWorksOrderTypes wots on wots.WorksOrderTypePK = worksOrders.WorksOrderTypeFK                  
 Where worksOrders.WorksOrderOriginFK = 2                
  AND worksOrders.WorksOrderTypeFK NOT IN (3,16) /*No Movements/loading*/ AND ((@AirFreightOnly2= 0 AND WorksOrderTypeFK<>1) OR (@AirFreightOnly2 = 1 AND WorksOrderTypeFK=1))                  
  AND worksOrders.FK = @stockOrderFK2              
  and wots.WorksOrderSubjectFK <> 1            
            
 --DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #Tmp_WorksOrdersForContainer                   
 --Select worksOrders.WorksOrderPK, worksOrders.worksorderstatusfk, worksorders.WorksOrderOriginFK, worksorders.worksordertypefk, wots.WorksOrderType, wots.WorksOrderTypeDescription, worksorders.ResponsibleUserFK, worksOrders.IsArchived            
 --INTO #Tmp_WorksOrdersForContainer                  
 --From tblWorksOrders worksOrders               
 --inner join appWorksOrderTypes wots on wots.WorksOrderTypePK = worksOrders.WorksOrderTypeFK                  
 --Where worksOrders.WorksOrderOriginFK = 2                     
 -- AND worksOrders.FK = @stockOrderFK2              
 -- and wots.WorksOrderSubjectFK = 1            
    
  DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #Tmp_WorksOrdersForContainer    
 declare @containeroutfk int    
 select @containeroutfk = containeroutfk from tblstockorders where stockorderpk = @stockOrderFK2    
 Select worksOrders.WorksOrderPK, worksOrders.worksorderstatusfk, worksorders.WorksOrderOriginFK, worksorders.worksordertypefk, wots.WorksOrderType, wots.WorksOrderTypeDescription, worksorders.ResponsibleUserFK, worksOrders.IsArchived            
 INTO #Tmp_WorksOrdersForContainer                  
 From tblWorksOrders worksOrders               
 inner join appWorksOrderTypes wots on wots.WorksOrderTypePK = worksOrders.WorksOrderTypeFK          
 inner join tblstockorders so on worksOrders.FK = so.StockOrderPK    
 Where worksOrders.WorksOrderOriginFK = 2                     
  AND so.ContainerOutFK =           @containeroutfk    
  and wots.WorksOrderSubjectFK = 1            
            
            
 IF(@ReturnPKListOnly2 = 1)                  
 BEGIN                  
  SELECT DISTINCT WorksOrderPK as PK FROM #Tmp_WorksOrders            
  union               
  SELECT DISTINCT WorksOrderPK as PK FROM #Tmp_WorksOrdersForContainer            
 END             
 else            
 begin            
              
  DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #Tmp_WorksOrdersAssignedUsers            
  SELECT wo.WorksOrderPK, ISNULL(STUFF((SELECT ', ' + users.Name             
   FROM viewusers as users             
   inner join [dbo].tblworksorderusers AS WOusers on wousers.UserFk = users.UserPK                   
   WHERE wo.WorksOrderPK = WOusers.WorksOrderFK              
   ORDER BY users.Name  FOR XML PATH('')), 1, 1, ''),'') AS [UserNames]             
  into #Tmp_WorksOrdersAssignedUsers            
  FROM #Tmp_WorksOrdersForContainer AS wo   
  WHERE WorksOrderTypeFK IN (18,24)--TIME TRACKING ONLY
            
UNION
SELECT wo.WorksOrderPK, users.Name             
   FROM #Tmp_WorksOrdersForContainer AS wo  
   INNER JOIN viewusers as users    ON wo.ResponsibleUserFK = users.UserPK                          
   WHERE wo.ResponsibleUserFK > 0              
               
            
  DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #Tmp_WorksOrderPals            
  select wop.WorksOrderPalletPK, wop.WorksOrderFK, wop.PalletFK, wop.WorkDescription, wop.WorksOrderStatusFK, wop.responsibleuserfk             
  into #Tmp_WorksOrderPals            
  from tblWorksOrderPallets wop             
  inner join #Tmp_WorksOrders wo on wo.WorksOrderPK = wop.WorksOrderFK            
            
  DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #TMP_WOPalletContent            
  Select pc.PalletFK, pc.StockItemFK, pc.Batch, sum(pc.ActualUnits) ActualUnits, p.CustomerBarcode, p.barcode, stockitems.StockItemCode, stockitems.EachesTypeFK            
  into #TMP_WOPalletContent             
  from #Tmp_WorksOrderPals wop            
  inner join tblPalletContent pc on wop.palletfk = pc.palletfk             
  inner join tblStockItems stockItems on stockItems.StockItemPK = pc.StockItemFK               
  inner join tblpallets p on pc.palletfk = p.palletpk              
  Where pc.IsArchived = 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/     and p.IsArchived=0             
  Group By pc.PalletFK, StockItemFK, Batch,p.CustomerBarcode, p.barcode, stockitems.StockItemCode, stockitems.EachesTypeFK             
             
  IF(@AirFreightOnly2 = 1)                  
  BEGIN             
   DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #TMP_WOPalletInstructions            
   select wopi.*             
   into #TMP_WOPalletInstructions            
   from tblWorksOrderPalletInstructions wopi            
   inner join #Tmp_WorksOrderPals wop on wop.WorksOrderPalletPK = wopi.WorksOrderPalletFK            
            
   Select worksOrders.WorksOrderPK AS PK, worksOrderPallets.WorksOrderPalletPK, '/images/WorksOrder.png' AS ImagePath, cast(0 as bit) AS IsFiltered, worksOrders.IsArchived,                  
    palletContent.StockItemCode [StockCode], Batch, case when palletContent.CustomerBarcode <> '' then palletContent.CustomerBarcode else palletContent.Barcode end Barcode,                  
              
    case worksOrderPallets.WorksOrderStatusFK                  
     when 1/*AwaitingAssignment*/ then '$imgAwaitingAssignment.png'                  
     when 2/*Assigned*/ then '$imguserassigned.png'                  
     when 3/*Complete*/ then '$imgComplete.png'            
     --when 3/*Complete*/ then case when wopR.worksOrderPalletResultPK is null then '$imgComplete.png' else case when wopR.palletaccepted = 1 then '$imgComplete.png' else '$imgAttention.png' end end                   
     when 4/*Cancelled*/ then '$imgCancelled.png'                  
     when 5/*StandBy*/ then '$imgWorksOrderStandBy.png'           
    end as [Status],                  
              
    palletContent.ActualUnits [Qty Before],                  
    case when palletContent.EachesTypeFK = -1 then                  
     '$txt%wth=60%val=' + cast(isnull(wopis.Units, 0) as nvarchar(50)) + '%' + cast(isnull(worksOrderPallets.WorksOrderPalletPK, 0) as nvarchar(50))                   
    else                  
     '$jlnk%scr=ShowWorksOrderPalletContentPicker(' + cast(worksOrderPallets.WorksOrderPalletPK as nvarchar(50)) + cast(worksOrderPallets.WorksOrderPalletPK as nvarchar(50))                      
    end as [Qty to move],             
               
    palletContent.ActualUnits - isnull(wopisFrom.Units, 0) + isnull(wopisTo.Units, 0)  [Qty After],                      
      '$hdn%val={"WorksOrderPalletPK":' + cast(worksOrderPallets.WorksOrderPalletPK as nvarchar(50)) + ', "PalletContentFKs":['+ isnull(PalletContentPKs, '') + ']}%hdnPalletContentFKs' + cast(worksOrderPallets.WorksOrderPalletPK as nvarchar(50)) as [$hid 
  
    
     
e        
          
Col%]--,                  
                     
    From #Tmp_WorksOrders worksOrders                  
    LEFT OUTER JOIN  #Tmp_WorksOrdersAssignedUsers AS AssignedUsers ON AssignedUsers.WorksOrderPK = worksOrders.WorksOrderPK                   
    left outer join #Tmp_WorksOrderPals worksOrderPallets on  worksOrderPallets.WorksOrderFK = worksOrders.WorksOrderPK                
    left join viewUsers WoAssignedUser on worksOrders.responsibleuserfk = WoAssignedUser.userpk --Pritesh                
    left join viewUsers WopAssignedUser on worksOrderPallets.responsibleuserfk = WopAssignedUser.userpk --Pritesh                 
    left outer join #TMP_WOPalletContent palletContent on  palletContent.PalletFK = worksOrderPallets.PalletFK                   
                  
    left outer join (                  
     Select DestinationBarcode, sum(Units) Units                  
     from #TMP_WOPalletInstructions wopis                   
     inner join #Tmp_WorksOrderPals wops on wops.WorksOrderPalletPK = wopis.WorksOrderPalletFK AND wops.WorksOrderStatusFK < 3 /*NotCompleted*/                  
     Where InstructionTypeFK = 3 --Movement                  
     Group By DestinationBarcode                  
    ) wopisTo on wopisTo.DestinationBarcode = palletContent.Barcode                  
                            
    left outer join #TMP_WOPalletInstructions wopis on wopis.WorksOrderPalletFK = worksOrderPallets.WorksOrderPalletPK                  
     AND wopis.InstructionTypeFK = 3 --Movement                  
     AND wopis.EntirePalletContent = 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/                  
     AND (wopis.DestinationBarcode = @palletBarcode2 OR wopis.DestinationCustomerBarcode = @palletBarcode2)             
                  
    left outer join (                  
     Select WorksOrderPalletFK, sum(Units) Units                  
     from #TMP_WOPalletInstructions                   
     Where InstructionTypeFK = 3 --Movement                  
     Group By WorksOrderPalletFK                  
    ) wopisFrom on wopisFrom.WorksOrderPalletFK = worksOrderPallets.WorksOrderPalletPK  AND worksOrderPallets.WorksOrderStatusFK < 3 /*NotCompleted*/                  
                  
    left outer join (                  
     SELECT WorksOrderPalletPK,                  
     STUFF((                  
      SELECT ', ' + cast(PalletContentFK as nvarchar(100))                    
      FROM #TMP_WOPalletInstructions wopis                  
      WHERE wopis.WorksOrderPalletFK = wops.WorksOrderPalletPK                   
       AND wopis.InstructionTypeFK = 3                  
       AND wopis.EntirePalletContent = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ --Eaches                  
       AND (wopis.DestinationBarcode = @palletBarcode2   OR wopis.DestinationCustomerBarcode = @palletBarcode2)                  
      FOR XML PATH ('')),1,2,'') AS PalletContentPKs                  
     FROM #Tmp_WorksOrderPals wops                  
     GROUP BY WorksOrderPalletPK                  
  ) wopispc on wopispc.WorksOrderPalletPK = worksOrderPallets.WorksOrderPalletPK                        
   END                  
   ELSE                  
   BEGIN              
            
    Select worksOrderPallets.WorksOrderPalletPK AS PK, '/images/WorksOrder.png' AS ImagePath, cast(0 as bit) AS IsFiltered, worksOrders.IsArchived,                  
     palletContent.StockItemCode [StockCode], case when palletContent.CustomerBarcode <> '' then palletContent.CustomerBarcode else palletContent.Barcode end Barcode,                  
              
     case             
      when worksordertypefk = 15 then worksOrderPallets.WorkDescription             
      else worksOrders.WorksOrderTypeDescription             
     end as [Description],                  
             
     case worksOrderPallets.WorksOrderStatusFK                  
      when 1/*AwaitingAssignment*/ then '$imgAwaitingAssignment.png'                  
      when 2/*Assigned*/ then '$imguserassigned.png'                  
      when 3/*Complete*/ then case when wopR.worksOrderPalletResultPK is null then '$imgComplete.png' else case when wopR.palletaccepted = 1 then '$imgComplete.png' else '$imgAttention.png' end end                   
      when 4/*Cancelled*/ then '$imgCancelled.png'                  
      when 5/*StandBy*/ then '$imgWorksOrderStandBy.png'                  
     end as [Status],                 
     case            
        when WorksOrderTypeFK in (15,19,20,21,22) then '$jlnk%scr=ConfirmCompletePhysicalCheck(' + cast(worksOrderPallets.WorksOrderPalletPK as nvarchar(50)) + ',' + cast(worksOrders.WorksOrderPK as nvarchar(50)) + ', 1);%txt=Accept | $jlnk%scr=ConfirmCo 
 
mpletePhysicalCheck(' + cast(worksOrderPallets.WorksOrderPalletPK as nvarchar(50)) + ',' + cast(worksOrders.WorksOrderPK as nvarchar(50)) + ', 0);%txt=Reject'                          
        
   --when WorksOrderTypeFK = 15 then '$jlnk%scr=ConfirmCompletePhysicalCheck(' + cast(worksOrderPallets.WorksOrderPalletPK as nvarchar(50)) + ',' + cast(worksOrders.WorksOrderPK as nvarchar(50)) + ', 1);%txt=Accept | $jlnk%scr=ConfirmCompletePhysicalCheck(' + cast(worksOrderPallets.WorksOrderPalletPK as nvarchar(50)) + ',' + cast(worksOrders.WorksOrderPK as nvarchar(50)) + ', 0);%txt=Reject'                        
      --when WorksOrderTypeFK = 18 then '$jlnk%scr=CompleteTimeTrackingWorkOrder(' + cast(worksOrders.WorksOrderPK as nvarchar(50)) +');%txt=Complete'               
      else ''             
     end as [Actions],                  
              
     case             
      when worksOrderPallets.responsibleuserfk <> -1 then WopAssignedUser.Name             
      when worksOrders.worksorderstatusfk <> 1 then WoAssignedUser.Name            
      --when WorksOrderTypeFK = 18  then  AssignedUsers.UserNames            
      else ''             
     end as [Assigned To]   
  ,'true' as [$hideCol%IsWorsOrderPallet]    
                 
    From #Tmp_WorksOrders worksOrders                  
    left outer join #Tmp_WorksOrderPals worksOrderPallets on  worksOrderPallets.WorksOrderFK = worksOrders.WorksOrderPK                
    left join viewUsers WoAssignedUser on worksOrders.responsibleuserfk = WoAssignedUser.userpk --Pritesh                
    left join viewUsers WopAssignedUser on worksOrderPallets.responsibleuserfk = WopAssignedUser.userpk --Pritesh                 
    left outer join #TMP_WOPalletContent palletContent on  palletContent.PalletFK = worksOrderPallets.PalletFK                     
    OUTER APPLY (                  
     SELECT TOP 1 worksOrderPalletResultPK, worksorderpalletFK, palletaccepted, UpdatedDate                  
     FROM tblworksorderpalletresult                  
     WHERE worksorderpalletFK = worksOrderPallets.WorksOrderPalletPK                  
     ORDER BY worksOrderPalletResultPK DESC                  
    ) AS wopR                            
               
    union            
                     
    select CworksOrders.WorksOrderPK, '/images/WorksOrder.png' AS ImagePath, cast(0 as bit) AS IsFiltered, CworksOrders.IsArchived,                  
     '' as [StockCode], '' as Barcode,               
     CworksOrders.WorksOrderTypeDescription as [Description],            
     case CworksOrders.WorksOrderStatusFK                  
      when 1/*AwaitingAssignment*/ then '$imgAwaitingAssignment.png'                  
      when 2/*Assigned*/ then '$imguserassigned.png'                  
      when 3/*Complete*/ then '$imgComplete.png'                    
      when 4/*Cancelled*/ then '$imgCancelled.png'                  
      when 5/*StandBy*/ then '$imgWorksOrderStandBy.png'                  
     end as [Status],                 
     --case            
     -- when WorksOrderTypeFK = 18 then '$jlnk%scr=CompleteTimeTrackingWorkOrder(' + cast(CworksOrders.WorksOrderPK as nvarchar(50)) +');%txt=Complete'               
                
     case when worksorderstatusfk=3 and Worksordertypefk=24 then              
 '$jlnk%scr=CompleteTimeTrackingWorkOrder(' + cast(CworksOrders.WorksOrderPK as nvarchar(50)) +');%txt=Restart'               
    when worksorderstatusfk!=3 and Worksordertypefk=24 then           
'$jlnk%scr=CompleteTimeTrackingWorkOrder(' + cast(CworksOrders.WorksOrderPK as nvarchar(50)) +');%txt=Complete'          
          
   else ''             
     end as [Actions],                   
      AssignedUsers.UserNames as [Assigned To]              
          ,'false' as [$hideCol%IsWorsOrderPallet]  
    From #Tmp_WorksOrdersForContainer as CworksOrders                  
    LEFT OUTER JOIN  #Tmp_WorksOrdersAssignedUsers AS AssignedUsers ON AssignedUsers.WorksOrderPK = CworksOrders.WorksOrderPK                
    ORDER BY [Description], StockCode, Barcode             
   END            
  END            
   -- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end                  
                     
   BREAK                  
  END TRY                  
  BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */                  
   DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;                  
   SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;                  
   SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;                  
                  
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY                   
   BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;                  
                         
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;                  
                  
            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID                  
                              
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;                  
                              
   IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)                  
   BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END                  
   ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */                  
  END CATCH                  
  SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1                  
 END                  
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spGvStockOutPalletGroups]
(
	@ContainerOutFK int = -1
)	
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT
 ,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;
	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	DECLARE @ContainerOutFK2 int

	SET @ContainerOutFK2 = @ContainerOutFK;

	SET @ParameterDetails = '@ContainerOutFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@ContainerOutFK2 AS NVARCHAR(20)),'') 

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    --BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

		SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END


	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY
			

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start

			drop table if exists #coPallets
			select palletfk, palletcontentfk, colpc.Units
			into #coPallets
			from tblcontaineroutlinepalletcontent colpc 
			inner join tblcontaineroutlines col on col.ContainerOutLinePK = colpc.ContainerOutLineFK 
			where col.ContainerOutFK = @ContainerOutFK2

			select distinct case when p.customerbarcode = '' then p.Barcode else p.customerbarcode end as Barcode, s.StockItemCode, pc.Batch, pc.SupplierBatch, colpc.Units, case when ContainerOutPalletGroupPK is null then 1 else GroupNumber end as PackingGroup, colpc.PalletFK
			from #coPallets colpc
			inner join tblpalletcontent pc on colpc.PalletContentFK = pc.PalletContentPK
			inner join tblpallets p on p.palletpk = colpc.PalletFK
			inner join tblstockitems s on s.StockItemPK = pc.StockItemFK
			left join tblContainerOutPalletGroups grps on p.palletpk = grps.palletfk

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end

			
			
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END

/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[spGvStockOutPalletsLoaded]    Script Date: 02/11/2026 17:47:26 ******/

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spGvStockOutPalletsLoaded]
(
	@stockOrderFK int,
	@Stage int = -1
)	
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT
 ,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;
	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	DECLARE @stockOrderFK2 int
	DECLARE @Stage2 int

	SET @stockOrderFK2 = @stockOrderFK
	SET @Stage2 = @Stage

	SET @ParameterDetails = '@stockOrderFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@stockOrderFK2 AS NVARCHAR(20)),'')

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    --BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

		SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END


	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY
			

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start

			IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#TempResults') IS NOT NULL
				DROP TABLE #TempResults

			Select WorksOrderMovementPK,
			worksOrderMovements.IsArchived,
			case when pallets.CustomerBarcode <> '' then pallets.CustomerBarcode else pallets.Barcode end Barcode, 
			pallets.CustomerPalletNumber [Pallet Number], 
			stockItems.StockItemCode as 'Stock Code', 
			palletContent.Batch,
			worksOrderMovements.Units AS Units,
			case when movementdescription like '%HAND HELD%' then 1 else 0 end as scanned,
			entirepallet, 
			colpc.Loaded as PalletLoaded,
			worksOrderMovements.WorksOrderStatusFK,
			CASE when worksOrderMovements.ResponsibleUserFK > 0 then AssignedUser.PersonName  end as 'Assigned To',
			CASE when worksOrderMovements.WorksOrderStatusFK = 3 then CompleteUser.PersonName ELSE '' end as 'Completed By',
			CASE when worksOrderMovements.WorksOrderStatusFK = 3 then CONVERT(VARCHAR(50), worksOrderMovements.updateddate) ELSE ''  end as 'Completed Date',
			worksOrderMovements.ContainerOutLinePalletContentFK
			INTO #TempResults
			FROM tblWorksOrderMovements worksOrderMovements
			INNER JOIN tblWorksOrders worksOrders ON  worksOrders.WorksOrderPK = worksOrderMovements.WorksOrderFK
			INNER JOIN tblPallets pallets ON pallets.PalletPK = worksOrderMovements.PalletFK		  
			left outer join (
				Select PalletFK, StockItemFK, batch, sum(ActualUnits) ActualUnits from tblPalletContent
				--Where IsArchived = 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/
				Group by PalletFK, StockItemFK, batch
			) palletContent ON palletContent.PalletFK = pallets.PalletPK
			INNER JOIN tblStockItems stockItems ON stockItems.StockItemPK = palletContent.StockItemFK
			inner join tblContainerOutLinePalletContent colpc ON colpc.ContainerOutLinePalletContentPK = worksOrderMovements.ContainerOutLinePalletContentFK
			left outer join(
				select (p.Firstname + ' ' + p.LastName) as PersonName, u.userpk
				from tblusers u 
				inner join tblpeople p on u.personfk = p.personpk
			) CompleteUser on CompleteUser.userpk = worksOrderMovements.UpdatedBy
			left outer join(
				select (p.Firstname + ' ' + p.LastName) as PersonName, u.userpk
				from tblusers u 
				inner join tblpeople p on u.personfk = p.personpk
			) AssignedUser on AssignedUser.userpk = worksOrderMovements.ResponsibleUserFK
			
			Where worksOrders.WorksOrderOriginFK = 2/*StockOrder*/
				AND worksOrders.WorksOrderTypeFK = 16 /*load pallet*/
				AND worksOrders.FK = @stockOrderFK2  and @stockOrderFK2 > 0
				AND worksOrders.IsArchived = 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/
				AND worksOrderMovements.DestinationLocationTypeFK = 5/*only show movements to container*/

	
			IF(@Stage2 = 1)
			BEGIN
				SELECT WorksOrderMovementPK AS PK, '/images/PalletMovement.png' AS ImagePath, cast(0 as bit) AS IsFiltered, IsArchived,
				 [Stock Code], Batch, Barcode, [Pallet Number], CASE WHEN entirepallet = 1 THEN 'Pallet' ELSE  Cast(units AS nvarchar(10)) END as Quantity, [Assigned To]
				 FROM #TempResults 
				WHERE PalletLoaded = 0 AND WorksOrderStatusFK <> 3
				ORDER BY [Stock Code], Batch, Barcode, [Pallet Number]
			END
			ELSE IF (@Stage2 = 2)
			BEGIN
				;WITH DistinctRecords AS 
				(
					SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ContainerOutLinePalletContentFK ORDER BY [Completed Date] DESC) AS rn
					FROM #TempResults 
					WHERE PalletLoaded = 1 AND WorksOrderStatusFK = 3
				)
				SELECT WorksOrderMovementPK AS PK, '/images/PalletMovement.png' AS ImagePath, cast(0 as bit) AS IsFiltered, IsArchived,
				 [Stock Code], Batch, Barcode, [Pallet Number], CASE WHEN entirepallet = 1 THEN 'Pallet' ELSE  Cast(units AS nvarchar(10)) END as Quantity, 
				[Assigned To], [Completed By] as [Actioned By],case when Scanned = 1 THEN '$imgtrafficlight_green.png' ELSE '	' END AS Scan
				FROM DistinctRecords
				WHERE rn = 1

			FROM (SELECT * from tblcontaineroutlines WHERE containeroutfk = @ContainerOutPK2 AND (@ContainerOutLineFK2 = -1 OR @ContainerOutLineFK2 = ContainerOutLinePK)) col
			INNER JOIN tblcontaineroutlinepalletcontent colpc ON colpc.containeroutlinefk = col.containeroutlinepk
			INNER JOIN tblpalletcontent pc ON colpc.palletcontentfk = pc.PalletContentPK
			INNER JOIN tblpallets p ON colpc.palletfk = p.PalletPK
			INNER JOIN tblstockitems s ON pc.stockitemfk = s.stockitempk

	@divisionFK int = -1,
	@stockItemFK int = -1
)	
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT
 ,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;
	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	DECLARE @divisionFK2 int, @stockItemFK2 int

	SET @divisionFK2 = @divisionFK; SET @stockItemFK2 = @stockItemFK

	SET @ParameterDetails = '@divisionFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@divisionFK2 AS NVARCHAR(20)),'') + ',@stockItemFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@stockItemFK2 AS NVARCHAR(20)),'') 

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    --BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

		SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END


	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY
			

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start

			if(@divisionFK2 <> -1) 
			BEGIN
				SELECT StorageRatePK AS PK, '/images/storagerate.png' AS ImagePath, srs.IsArchived, cast(0 as bit) AS IsFiltered, 
				DivisionName as [Division Name], DivisionCode as [Division Code],
				StorageRate [Storage Rate],
				case when ChargeByPallet = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ then 'Pallet' when ChargeByEach = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ then 'Each' 
				when ChargeByUnit = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ then 'Unit' end as [Charge Type],  
				Cast(ChargePeriodNumber as nvarchar(10)) + ' x ' + TimePeriod as [Charge Period],
				BreakMethod [Break Method],
				case when BreakByPallet = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ then 'Pallet' when BreakByEach = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ then 'Each' 
				when BreakByUnit = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ then 'Unit' end as [Break By], BreakOver [Break Over],
				SpecialStockType [Special Stock Type],				
				ISNULL(pt.PalletType, '') AS PalletType
				FROM dbo.tblDivisions divs
				inner join tblStorageRates srs on
				srs.StorageRateTypeFK = 1 /*division*/
				AND
				srs.FK = @divisionFK2
				left outer join appBreakMethods bms on
				bms.BreakMethodPK = srs.BreakMethodFK
				left outer join appSpecialStockTypes ssts on
				ssts.SpecialStockTypePK = srs.SpecialStockTypeFK
				left outer join appTimePeriods tps on
				tps.TimePeriodPK = srs.ChargePeriodFK
				left outer Join tblPalletTypes pt ON pt.PalletTypePK=srs.PalletTypeFK
				where DivisionPK = @divisionFK2
		
			END 
			ELSE IF(@stockItemFK2 <> -1) 
			BEGIN
				SELECT StorageRatePK AS PK, '/images/storagerate.png' AS ImagePath, srs.IsArchived, 0 AS IsFiltered, 
				StockItemCode as [Stock], 
				StorageRate [Storage Rate],
				case when ChargeByPallet = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ then 'Pallet' when ChargeByEach = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ then 'Each' 
				when ChargeByUnit = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ then 'Unit' end as [Charge Type],  
				Cast(ChargePeriodNumber as nvarchar(10)) + ' x ' + TimePeriod as [Charge Period],
				BreakMethod [Break Method],
				case when BreakByPallet = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ then 'Pallet' when BreakByEach = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ then 'Each' 
				when BreakByUnit = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ then 'Unit' end as [Break By], BreakOver [Break Over],
				SpecialStockType [Special Stock Type],				
				ISNULL(pt.PalletType, '') AS PalletType
				FROM dbo.tblStockItems sis
				inner join tblStorageRates srs on
				srs.StorageRateTypeFK = 2 /*division*/
				AND
				srs.FK = @stockItemFK2
				left outer join appBreakMethods bms on
				bms.BreakMethodPK = srs.BreakMethodFK
				left outer join appSpecialStockTypes ssts on
				ssts.SpecialStockTypePK = srs.SpecialStockTypeFK
				left outer join appTimePeriods tps on
				tps.TimePeriodPK = srs.ChargePeriodFK
				left outer Join tblPalletTypes pt ON pt.PalletTypePK=srs.PalletTypeFK
				where StockItemPK = @stockItemFK2
			END

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end

			
			
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spGvSuppliers]    
(    
 @IncludeArchived BIT = 0    
)    
AS    
BEGIN    
 /* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */    
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED    
    
    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT    
 ,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;    
 SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();; SET @ParameterDetails = ''    
    
 DECLARE @var_IncludeArchivedUsers BIT; SET @var_IncludeArchivedUsers = ISNULL(@IncludeArchived,0)    
    
 SET @ParameterDetails = '@IncludeArchived = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@IncludeArchived AS NVARCHAR(10)),'')    
    
    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL     
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)    
    
    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)    
    --BEGIN    
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC     
    
  SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)    
    
        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)    
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK    
    
        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()    
    --END    
    
 SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);    
 SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails    
 ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;    
 INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()     
    
 WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3    
 BEGIN     
  BEGIN TRY    
    
   -- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start        
   DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #tmpSuppliersList    
    
	SELECT SupplierPK AS PK, '/images/supplier.png' AS ImagePath, 0 as IsArchived, cast(0 as bit) AS IsFiltered,     
		Supplier,    
		stuff(    
		coalesce(', '+nullif(suppliers.Address1, ''), '')    
		+ coalesce(', '+nullif(suppliers.Address2, ''), '')    
		+ coalesce(', '+nullif(suppliers.Address3, ''), '')    
		+ coalesce(', '+nullif(suppliers.Address4, ''), '')    
		+ coalesce(', '+nullif(suppliers.Address5, ''), '')    
		,1,1,'') AS [Address], contacts.ContactName, contacts.TelephoneNumber1 , suppliers.IsArchived as Archived     
	INTO #tmpSuppliersList    
	FROM dbo.tblSuppliers suppliers    
	left outer join tblContacts contacts on contacts.ContactPK = suppliers.MainContactFK    
	WHERE @var_IncludeArchivedUsers = 1 OR (@var_IncludeArchivedUsers = 0 and suppliers.IsArchived = 0)    
	order by Supplier  
    
	if(@var_IncludeArchivedUsers = 1)    
	BEGIN    
		SELECT * FROM #tmpSuppliersList    
	END    
	ELSE    
	BEGIN    
		SELECT PK, ImagePath, IsArchived, IsFiltered, Supplier, [Address], ContactName, TelephoneNumber1  
		FROM #tmpSuppliersList    
	END    
        
   -- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end    
          
   BREAK    
  END TRY    
  BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */    
   DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;    
   SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;    
   SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;    
    
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY     
   BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;    
           
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;    
    
            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID    
                
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;    
                
   IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)    
   BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END    
   ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */    
  END CATCH    
  SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1    
 END    
END

	DECLARE @IssueTypeFK2 int

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --BEGIN

		SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END


	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY
			

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start

			SELECT SystemIssuePK AS PK, '/images/invoice.png' AS ImagePath, IsArchived, cast(0 as bit) AS IsFiltered, 
			FreeString1 as 'Goods Order Num', FreeInt1 as 'COL PalletContent', Description, convert(varchar(50), inserteddate, 106) as [Date],
			'$jlnk%scr=ShowDetails(' + cast(SystemIssuePK as nvarchar(50)) + ', ' +  cast(SystemIssueTypeFK as nvarchar(50)) + ');%txt=Show Details' as 'Details',	
			'$jlnk%scr=AutoFix(' + cast(SystemIssuePK as nvarchar(50)) + ', ' +  cast(SystemIssueTypeFK as nvarchar(50)) + ');%txt=Fix Now' as 'Fix'
			FROM dbo.tblSystemIssues
			where SystemIssueTypeFK = @IssueTypeFK2 and isfixed = 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/
			Order by inserteddate DESC

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end

			
			
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spGvUserActivities]
(
	@EmployeeScannedPalletMovementDetailPK INT
)
AS
BEGIN
	DECLARE @varEmployeeScannedPalletMovementDetailPK INT = @EmployeeScannedPalletMovementDetailPK

	SELECT DISTINCT
		TEA.TMSEmployeeActivityPK,
		TEA.EmployeeScannedPalletMovementDetailFK,
		TEA.EmployeeActivityTypeFK,
		TEA.ActivityTime,
		CAST(TEA.ActivityTime AS VARCHAR(2)) AS ActivityHours,
		SUBSTRING(CAST(TEA.ActivityTime AS VARCHAR(5)),4,2) AS ActivityMinutes,
		EAT.EmployeeActivityType,
		TECCD.IsArchived
	FROM
		dbo.tblTMSEmployeeActivites AS TEA
	INNER JOIN dbo.appEmployeeActivityTypes AS EAT
		ON TEA.EmployeeActivityTypeFK = EAT.EmployeeActivityTypePK
	CROSS JOIN (SELECT IsArchived FROM dbo.tblEmployeeScannedPalletMovementDetails 
				WHERE EmployeeScannedPalletMovementDetailPK = @varEmployeeScannedPalletMovementDetailPK) AS TECCD
	WHERE
		TEA.EmployeeScannedPalletMovementDetailFK = @varEmployeeScannedPalletMovementDetailPK
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spGvUsers]  
(  
 @IncludeArchivedUsers BIT = 0  
)  
AS  
BEGIN  
 /* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */  
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED  
  
    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT  
 ,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;  
 SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();; SET @ParameterDetails = ''  
  
 DECLARE @var_IncludeArchivedUsers BIT; SET @var_IncludeArchivedUsers = ISNULL(@IncludeArchivedUsers,0)  
  
 SET @ParameterDetails = '@IncludeArchivedUsers = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@IncludeArchivedUsers AS NVARCHAR(10)),'')  
  
    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL   
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)  
  
    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)  
    --BEGIN  
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC   
  
  SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)  
  
        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)  
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK  
  
        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()  
    --END  
  
 SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);  
 SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails  
 ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;  
 INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()   
  
 WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3  
 BEGIN   
  BEGIN TRY  
  
   -- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start  
     
   DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #tmpUsersList  
  
   SELECT    
    people.PersonPK AS PK,   
    '/images/User.png' AS ImagePath,   
    0 AS IsArchived,   
    0 AS IsFiltered,   
    people.FirstName + ' ' + people.LastName AS [Name],   
    mem.UserName AS [User Name],  
    case when userType.[UserType] = 'WarehousingClientUser' then 'Client' else [UserType] end AS [User Type],  
    case when roles.Roles like '%WarehousingClientUser%' then 'Client' else roles.Roles end AS [Assigned Roles],  
    mem.Email,  
    mem.EmailConfirmed AS [Approved],  
    case when mem.EmailConfirmed = 1 then mem.LockOutEnabled ELSE cast(1 AS bit) end AS [Locked Out],  
    CONVERT(VARCHAR(17),mem.LastLoginDate,113) AS [Last Login],
	--mem.LastLoginDate, 
    --Mobmem.IsLockedOut AS [Locked Out (Mob)],  
    --CONVERT(VARCHAR(17),Mobmem.LastLoginDate,113) AS [Last Login (Mob)],  
    --CASE WHEN MobaspnetUsers.UserID IS NULL THEN dbo.fnBase64Encode(aspnetUsers.UserID) ELSE dbo.fnBase64Encode(MobaspnetUsers.UserID) END AS [ID Card Barcode],  
    ClientButtons.[Client Buttons],  
    Clientdivs.[Client Divisions],  
    users.IsArchived AS Archived  
   INTO #tmpUsersList  
   FROM dbo.tblPeople AS people   
   INNER JOIN dbo.tblUsers AS users ON users.PersonFK = people.PersonPK  
   INNER JOIN dbo.AspNetUsers as mem on mem.Id = users.AspNetUserID
   --INNER JOIN dbo.aspnet_Membership AS mem ON mem.UserId = users.AspNetUserID  
   --INNER JOIN dbo.aspnet_Users AS aspnetUsers ON aspnetUsers.UserId = users.AspNetUserID  
   --LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.aspnet_Membership AS Mobmem ON CAST(Mobmem.UserId AS VARCHAR(200)) = users.MobAspNetUserID  
   --LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.aspnet_Users AS MobaspnetUsers ON CAST(MobaspnetUsers.UserId AS VARCHAR(200)) = users.MobAspNetUserID  
   LEFT OUTER JOIN [dbo].[appUserTypes] AS userType ON users.UserTypeFK = userType.UserTypePK  
     
   LEFT OUTER JOIN (   
    SELECT users.[UserName], ISNULL(STUFF((SELECT ', ' + roles.Name   
    FROM AspNetRoles as roles
	--FROM [dbo].[aspnet_Roles] AS roles  
    --inner join [dbo].[aspnet_UsersInRoles] as usersInRoles on roles.roleid = usersInRoles.roleid  
    inner join AspNetUserRoles as usersInRoles on roles.Id = usersInRoles.roleId
	WHERE usersInRoles.userid = users.Id AND roles.[Name] IS NOT NULL AND roles.[Name] NOT LIKE '%Distribution%' AND roles.[Name] NOT LIKE '%purch%'  
    ORDER BY roles.[Name] 
    FOR XML PATH('')), 1, 1, ''),'') AS [Roles]  
    from AspNetUsers as users
	--FROM [dbo].[aspnet_Users] AS users  
    GROUP BY users.Id, users.[UserName]   
   ) AS roles ON mem.username = roles.username  
  
   LEFT OUTER JOIN (  
    SELECT users.UserPK, ISNULL(STUFF((SELECT ', ' + buttons.ButtonText   
    FROM tblClientButtons AS buttons  
    inner join tblUserClientButtons as usersButtons on buttons.ClientButtonPK = usersButtons.ClientButtonFK  
    WHERE usersButtons.UserFK = users.UserPK  
    ORDER BY buttons.ButtonText  
    FOR XML PATH('')), 1, 1, ''),'') AS [Client Buttons]  
    FROM tblUsers users  
    GROUP BY users.UserPK  
   ) as ClientButtons on ClientButtons.UserPK = users.UserPK  
  
   LEFT OUTER JOIN (  
    SELECT users.UserPK, ISNULL(STUFF((SELECT ', ' + Divs.DivisionCode   
    FROM tbldivisions AS divs  
    inner join tblUserDivisions as userdivs on divs.DivisionPK = userdivs.DivisionFK  
    WHERE userdivs.UserFK = users.UserPK  
    ORDER BY DivisionCode  
    FOR XML PATH('')), 1, 1, ''),'') AS [Client Divisions]  
    FROM tblUsers users  
    GROUP BY users.UserPK  
   ) as Clientdivs on Clientdivs.UserPK = users.UserPK  
  
   WHERE @var_IncludeArchivedUsers = 1 OR (@var_IncludeArchivedUsers = 0 and users.IsArchived = 0)  
   --ORDER BY people.FirstName + ' ' + people.LastName  asc
     ORDER BY EmployeeNumber  asc
  
   if(@var_IncludeArchivedUsers = 1)  
   BEGIN  
    SELECT * FROM #tmpUsersList  
   END  
   ELSE  
   BEGIN  
    SELECT PK, ImagePath, IsArchived, IsFiltered, [Name], [User Name], [User Type], [Assigned Roles], Email, [Approved], [Locked Out], [Last Login], [Client Buttons], [Client Divisions] FROM #tmpUsersList  
   END  
  
   -- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end  
        
   BREAK  
  END TRY  
  BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */  
   DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;  
   SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;  
   SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;  
  
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY   
   BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;  
         
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;  
  
            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID  
              
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;  
              
   IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)  
   BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END  
   ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */  
  END CATCH  
  SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1  
 END  
END
