-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spGvWarehousingClientStockSummary]
(
	@userFK int
)	
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT
 ,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;
	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	DECLARE @userFK2 int

	SET @userFK2 = @userFK

	SET @ParameterDetails = '@userFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@userFK2 AS NVARCHAR(20)),'')

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    --BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

		SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END


	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY
			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start
			drop table if exists #tmpUserDivisions
			select distinct DivisionPK, divs.IsArchived, DivisionName, DivisionCode
			into #tmpUserDivisions
			from tbldivisions divs
			inner join tblUserDivisions uds ON uds.DivisionFK = divs.DivisionPK
			where uds.UserFK = @userFK2	

			drop table if exists #tmpdivisionpallets
			select p.palletpk, p.palletstatusfk, StockItemFK, sum(ActualUnits) ActualUnits, sum(AvailableUnits) AvailableUnits
			into #tmpdivisionpallets
			from tblpallets p
			inner join tblpalletcontent pc on palletfk = palletpk
			inner join tblstockitems s on stockitemfk = stockitempk 
			inner join #tmpUserDivisions on DivisionFK = DivisionPK
			where p.IsArchived = 0
			group by p.palletpk, p.palletstatusfk, StockItemFK

			Select * from (
				SELECT DivisionPK AS PK, '/images/pallet.png' AS ImagePath, divs.IsArchived, cast(0 as bit) AS IsFiltered, 
				DivisionName [Division], sum(okStock.AvailableUnits) [Available Units], sum(okStock.ActualUnits) - sum(okStock.AvailableUnits) AS [Units On Order], 
				sum(okStock.Pallets) [Total Pallets],
				sum(isnull(notOkStock.Pallets, 0)) [Pallets On Hold], sum(isnull(enrouteStock.Pallets, 0)) [Pallets On Route],
				'$RowColor=0' as [$hideCol%$RowColor]
				from #tmpUserDivisions divs
				inner join tblStockItems sis on sis.DivisionFK = divs.DivisionPK
				left outer join (
						Select StockItemFK, count(*) Pallets, sum(ActualUnits) ActualUnits, sum(AvailableUnits) AvailableUnits from (
						Select StockItemFK, PalletPK, sum(ActualUnits) ActualUnits, sum(AvailableUnits) AvailableUnits
						from #tmpdivisionpallets pallets 
						Where pallets.PalletStatusFK <> 10
						Group By StockItemFK, PalletPK
					) subQ
					Group By StockItemFK
				) okStock on
				okStock.StockItemFK = sis.StockItemPK

				left outer join (
						Select StockItemFK, count(*) Pallets, sum(ActualUnits) ActualUnits, sum(AvailableUnits) AvailableUnits from (
						Select StockItemFK, PalletPK, sum(ActualUnits) ActualUnits, sum(AvailableUnits) AvailableUnits
						from #tmpdivisionpallets pallets
						Where pallets.PalletStatusFK <> 1 /*Available*/ AND pallets.PalletStatusFK <> 10
						Group By StockItemFK, PalletPK
					) subQ
					Group By StockItemFK
				) notOkStock on
				notOkStock.StockItemFK = sis.StockItemPK

				left outer join (
						Select StockItemFK, count(*) Pallets, sum(ActualUnits) ActualUnits, sum(AvailableUnits) AvailableUnits from (
						Select StockItemFK, PalletPK, sum(ActualUnits) ActualUnits, sum(AvailableUnits) AvailableUnits
						from #tmpdivisionpallets pallets
						Where pallets.PalletStatusFK = 10
						Group By StockItemFK, PalletPK
					) subQ
					Group By StockItemFK
				) enrouteStock on
				enrouteStock.StockItemFK = sis.StockItemPK
				Group By DivisionPK, divs.IsArchived, divs.DivisionName
	
			UNION

				SELECT -1 AS PK, '/images/report.png' AS ImagePath, divs.IsArchived, 0 AS IsFiltered, 
				'Total' [Division], sum(okStock.AvailableUnits) [Available Units], sum(okStock.ActualUnits) - sum(okStock.AvailableUnits) AS [Units On Order], 
				sum(okStock.Pallets) [Total Pallets],
				sum(isnull(notOkStock.Pallets, 0)) [Pallets On Hold], sum(isnull(enrouteStock.Pallets, 0)) [Pallets On Route],
				'$RowColor=2' as [$RowColor]
				from #tmpUserDivisions divs
				inner join tblStockItems sis on sis.DivisionFK = divs.DivisionPK
				left outer join (
						Select StockItemFK, count(*) Pallets, sum(ActualUnits) ActualUnits, sum(AvailableUnits) AvailableUnits from (
						Select StockItemFK, PalletPK, sum(ActualUnits) ActualUnits, sum(AvailableUnits) AvailableUnits
						from #tmpdivisionpallets pallets
						Where pallets.PalletStatusFK <> 10
						Group By StockItemFK, PalletPK
					) subQ
					Group By StockItemFK
				) okStock on
				okStock.StockItemFK = sis.StockItemPK

				left outer join (
						Select StockItemFK, count(*) Pallets, sum(ActualUnits) ActualUnits, sum(AvailableUnits) AvailableUnits from (
						Select StockItemFK, PalletPK, sum(ActualUnits) ActualUnits, sum(AvailableUnits) AvailableUnits
						from #tmpdivisionpallets pallets
						Where pallets.PalletStatusFK <> 1 /*Available*/ AND pallets.PalletStatusFK <> 10
						Group By StockItemFK, PalletPK
					) subQ
					Group By StockItemFK
				) notOkStock on
				notOkStock.StockItemFK = sis.StockItemPK

				left outer join (
						Select StockItemFK, count(*) Pallets, sum(ActualUnits) ActualUnits, sum(AvailableUnits) AvailableUnits from (
						Select StockItemFK, PalletPK, sum(ActualUnits) ActualUnits, sum(AvailableUnits) AvailableUnits
						from #tmpdivisionpallets pallets 
						Where pallets.PalletStatusFK = 10
						Group By StockItemFK, PalletPK
					) subQ
					Group By StockItemFK
				) enrouteStock on
				enrouteStock.StockItemFK = sis.StockItemPK

				Group By divs.IsArchived
			) subQ
			Order By PK DESC

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end

			
			
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END

-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Jamie Clerkin>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Get all pallets for works orders>
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spGvWorksOrderPalletsDetail]
	-- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here
	@WorksOrderFK int
AS
BEGIN
    SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ UNCOMMITTED

    -- Insert statements for procedure here
	Select distinct WorksOrderPalletPK AS PK, '/images/pallet.png' AS ImagePath, wops.IsArchived, cast(0 as bit) AS IsFiltered, 
		case when WorksOrderTypeFk = 5 then 'Relabelling' else 'Physical Check' end as [Work Type], 
		case when WorksOrderTypeFk = 5 then
			'Relabel pallet ' + coalesce(p.customerbarcode, p.barcode) + CASE WHEN p.customerPalletNumber = '' THEN '' ELSE ', Pallet Number ' + p.customerPalletNumber end + ' in ' + vpl.Building + ' ' + vpl.Location 
		else
			'Visually check pallet ' + coalesce(p.customerbarcode, p.barcode) + ' as per outbound SOP'
		end as [Description], 
		CreatorUser.Name [RequestedBy], CONVERT(VARCHAR(50), wops.inserteddate, 106) + ' ' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(5), wops.inserteddate, 108) CreatedDate,
		case when wos.worksorderstatusfk <> 1 then ManagedUser.Name else '' end [AssignedBy], 
		case when wops.responsibleuserfk <> -1 then WopAssignedUser.Name  else case when wos.worksorderstatusfk <> 1 then WoAssignedUser.Name else '' end end [AssignedTo], 
		case when WorksOrderTypeFk = 5 then
			stat.worksorderstatus 
		else
			case when wops.worksorderstatusfk = 3 then case when wopR.palletaccepted = 1 then 'Accepted' else 'Rejected' end else stat.worksorderstatus end
		end as[Status], 			
		--'$txt%wth=160%align=left%jlnk%scr=AddWorksOrderPalletNote(' + cast(wops.WorksOrderPalletPK as nvarchar(50)) + ');%txt=Save%val=' + cast(isnull(wops.Notes, '') as nvarchar(50)) + '%txtWorksOrderPallet' + cast(isnull(wops.WorksOrderPalletPK, 0) as nvarchar(50)) as [Pallet Note],
		CASE WHEN wops.worksorderstatusfk <> 3 THEN '' ELSE completedUser.Name END AS CompletedBy,
		CASE WHEN wops.worksorderstatusfk <> 3 THEN '' ELSE CONVERT(VARCHAR(50), wops.updateddate, 106) + ' ' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(5), wops.updateddate, 108) END AS CompletedDate,
		case when WorksOrderTypeFk = 5 then
			case when wops.worksorderstatusfk = 3 then /*CONVERT(VARCHAR(50), wops.updateddate, 106) + ' ' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(5), wops.updateddate, 108)*/ '' else '$jlnk%scr=CompleteWorksOrderPallet(' + cast(wops.WorksOrderPalletPK as nvarchar(50)) + ');%txt=Complete' end
		else
			'$jlnk%scr=CompletePhysicalCheck(' + cast(wops.WorksOrderPalletPK as nvarchar(50)) + ',' + cast(WorksOrderPK as nvarchar(50)) + ', 1);%txt=Accept | $jlnk%scr=CompletePhysicalCheck(' + cast(wops.WorksOrderPalletPK as nvarchar(50)) + ',' + cast(WorksOrderPK as nvarchar(50)) + ', 0);%txt=Reject' 
		end as Actions,
		wos.Comments, wops.PalletFK
	from tblworksorders wos
	inner join tblWorksOrderPallets wops on wops.worksorderfk = wos.worksorderpk
	INNER JOIN tblPallets p on wops.palletfk = p.palletpk
	inner join viewpalletLocations vpl on p.palletpk = vpl.palletpk
	left join viewUsers WoAssignedUser on wos.responsibleuserfk = WoAssignedUser.userpk
	left join viewUsers WopAssignedUser on wops.responsibleuserfk = WopAssignedUser.userpk
	inner join viewUsers CreatorUser on wops.insertedby = CreatorUser.userpk
	left join viewUsers ManagedUser on wos.updatedby = ManagedUser.userpk
	inner join viewUsers completedUser on wops.updatedby = completedUser.userpk
	inner join appWorksorderStatus stat on stat.worksorderstatuspk = wops.worksorderstatusfk
	OUTER APPLY (
				SELECT TOP 1 worksOrderPalletResultPK, worksorderpalletFK, palletaccepted, UpdatedDate
				FROM tblworksorderpalletresult
				WHERE worksorderpalletFK = wops.WorksOrderPalletPK
				ORDER BY worksOrderPalletResultPK DESC
			) AS wopR		
	Where wops.WorksOrderFK =  @worksOrderFK
END
GO

-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Jamie Clerkin>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Get all works orders for client user, with optional works order type filter>
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spGvWorksOrdersForClient]
	-- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here
	@userFK int,
	@WorksOrderTypeFkFilter int = 0
AS
BEGIN
    SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ UNCOMMITTED

	Declare @UserTypeFK int
	Select @userTypeFK = UserTypeFK from tblUsers where UserPK = @userFK

    -- Insert statements for procedure here
	Select distinct WorksOrderPK AS PK, '/images/worksorder.png' AS ImagePath, wos.IsArchived, cast(0 as bit) AS IsFiltered, 
	WorksOrderPK as [Works Order Number], convert(nvarchar(50), wos.inserteddate , 106)[Created],
	case when scrap.LocationFk is not null then wots.WorksOrderType + ' - Rejects'
		 when wots.WorksOrderTypePK = 5 and users.usertypefk = 4 then wots.WorksOrderType + ' - Client Request'
		 when cins.GoodsInNumber is null and cOuts.GoodsOrderNumber is null then wots.WorksOrderType + ' - Internal'
		 else wots.WorksOrderType end as [Works Order type], status.worksorderstatus as [Works Order Status],
	/*cins.GoodsInNumber as [Goods In Number], stockInStatus.StockInStatus as [Goods In Status],*/ cOuts.GoodsOrderNumber as [Goods Order Number], /*cOutStatus.ContainerOutStatus as [Goods Order Status],*/
	people.FirstName + ' ' + people.LastName as [Created By], responsibleperson.FirstName + ' ' + responsibleperson.LastName as [Assigned To], wopallets.Barcodes--, 
	--case when scrap.LocationFk is not null then '$hideCell=10' else '$hideCell=11' end as [$hideCol%] -- scrap location movements priority 

FROM dbo.tblWorksOrders wos
left outer join tblUsers users on users.UserPK = wos.InsertedBy
left outer join tblPeople people on people.PersonPK = users.PersonFK
left outer join appWorksOrderTypes wots on wots.WorksOrderTypePK = wos.WorksOrderTypeFK
left outer join appworksorderstatus status on wos.worksorderstatusfk = status.worksorderstatuspk
left outer join tblusers responsibleuser on responsibleuser.UserPK = wos.ResponsibleUserFK
left outer join tblPeople responsibleperson on responsibleperson.PersonPK = responsibleuser.PersonFK
/*relabelling*/
left outer join tblworksorderpallets wops on wops.WorksOrderFK = wos.WorksOrderPK
left outer join (
	select wo2.worksorderfk, substring(
        (
            Select ', '+ case when p.CustomerBarcode = '' then p.Barcode else p.CustomerBarcode end AS [text()]
            From tblworksorderpallets wo1
			inner join tblpallets p on palletfk = palletpk
			Where wo1.worksorderfk = wo2.worksorderfk
            For XML PATH ('')
        ), 2, 1000) [Barcodes]
		from tblworksorderpallets wo2
) wopallets on wopallets.worksorderfk = wops.worksorderfk
/*MOVEMENTS*/
left outer join tblWorksOrderMovements woms on woms.WorksOrderFK = wos.WorksOrderPK
left outer join tblPallets pallets on pallets.PalletPK = woms.PalletFK or pallets.PalletPK = wops.palletfk
left outer join tblPalletContent pc on pc.PalletFK = pallets.PalletPK
left outer join tblStockItems mvSis on mvSis.StockItemPK = pc.StockItemFK
/*TOPUPS*/
left outer join tblPalletTopups topups on topups.WorksOrderFK = wos.WorksOrderPK
left outer join tblStockItemFixedLocations sifls on sifls.StockItemFixedLocationPK = topups.TopupFixedLocationFK
left outer join tblStockItems topupSis on topupSis.StockItemPK = sifls.StockItemFK
left outer join tblStockIns sins on sins.StockInPK = wos.FK AND wos.WorksOrderOriginFK = 1
left outer join tblContainerIns cins on cins.ContainerInPK = sins.ContainerInFK
left outer join tblStockOrders sos on sos.StockOrderPK = wos.FK and wos.WorksOrderOriginFK = 2
left outer join tblContainerOuts cOuts on cOuts.ContainerOutPK = sos.ContainerOutFK
left outer join appContainerOutStatus cOutStatus on cOuts.ContainerOutStatusFK = cOutStatus.ContainerOutStatusPK
left outer join appStockInStatus stockInStatus on cIns.StockInStatusFK = stockInStatus.StockInStatusPK
/*reject movements*/
left outer join tblScrapLocations scrap on scrap.LocationFk = woms.DestinationFK
WHERE

wos.Insertedby = @userFK
AND(
	(@WorksOrderTypeFkFilter = 1 and cins.GoodsInNumber is not null) --stock in only
	or
	(@WorksOrderTypeFkFilter = 2 and cOuts.GoodsOrderNumber is not null) --stock out only
	or 
	(@WorksOrderTypeFkFilter = 3 and wots.WorksOrderTypepk = 3 and cins.GoodsInNumber is null and cOuts.GoodsOrderNumber is null) --movements not linked to stock in / out
	or
	(@WorksOrderTypeFkFilter = 4 and wots.WorksOrderTypepk = 10)--topups only
	or
	(@WorksOrderTypeFkFilter = 6 and wots.WorksOrderTypepk = 5)
	or
	(@WorksOrderTypeFkFilter = 0)--all

)
order by PK desc
END
GO

-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spGvWorksOrdersForResponsibleUser]
(
	@userFK int
)	
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT
 ,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;
	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	DECLARE @userFK2 int

	SET @userFK2 = @userFK

	SET @ParameterDetails = '@userFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@userFK2 AS NVARCHAR(20)),'')

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    --BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

		SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END


	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY
			

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start

			SELECT Distinct WorksOrderPK AS PK, '/images/worksorder.png' AS ImagePath, wos.IsArchived, cast(0 as bit) AS IsFiltered, 
			WorksOrderPK as [Works Order Number], wots.WorksOrderType,

			case wos.WorksOrderOriginFK when 1 then stockInStatus.StockInStatus when 2 then cOutStatus.ContainerOutStatus else '' end as 'Status',
			case wos.WorksOrderOriginFK when 1 then 'GI: ' + cins.GoodsInNumber when 2 then 'GO: ' + cOuts.GoodsOrderNumber else '' end as Origin,
			people.FirstName + ' ' + people.LastName as [Created By]
			FROM         dbo.tblWorksOrders wos
			left outer join tblUsers users on
			users.UserPK = wos.InsertedBy
			left outer join tblPeople people on
			people.PersonPK = users.PersonFK
			left outer join appWorksOrderTypes wots on
			wots.WorksOrderTypePK = wos.WorksOrderTypeFK
			/*MOVEMENTS*/
			left outer join tblWorksOrderMovements woms on
			woms.WorksOrderFK = wos.WorksOrderPK
			left outer join tblPallets pallets on
			pallets.PalletPK = woms.PalletFK
			/*TOPUPS*/
			left outer join tblPalletTopups topups on
			topups.WorksOrderFK = wos.WorksOrderPK
			left outer join tblStockItemFixedLocations sifls on
			sifls.StockItemFixedLocationPK = topups.TopupFixedLocationFK
			left outer join tblStockIns sins on
			sins.StockInPK = wos.FK AND wos.WorksOrderOriginFK = 1
			left outer join tblContainerIns cins on
			cins.ContainerInPK = sins.ContainerInFK
			left outer join tblStockOrders sos on
			sos.StockOrderPK = wos.FK and wos.WorksOrderOriginFK = 2
			left outer join tblContainerOuts cOuts on
			cOuts.ContainerOutPK = sos.ContainerOutFK
			left outer join appContainerOutStatus cOutStatus on
			cOutStatus.ContainerOutStatusPK = cOuts.ContainerOutStatusFK
			left outer join appStockInStatus stockInStatus on
			cOuts.ContainerOutStatusFK = stockInStatus.StockInStatusPK
			where wos.ResponsibleUserFK = @userFK2
			AND wos.WorksOrderStatusFK < 3 /*Not Complete*/
			--where CustomerFK = @customerFK

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end

			
			
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END
GO

print @SQLSelect

												cOuts.ContainerOutPK = sos.ContainerOutFK
												left outer join appContainerOutStatus cOutStatus on
												cOuts.ContainerOutStatusFK = cOutStatus.ContainerOutStatusPK
												left outer join appStockInStatus stockInStatus on
												cIns.StockInStatusFK = stockInStatus.StockInStatusPK
												WHERE

										) AS subquery
								)AS finalSubquery '

print @SQLFromPart1

			SET @SQLWHERE = 'WHERE '
			SET @TableAliasName = 'finalSubquery'
			 
			IF @IsSearching = 0 
			BEGIN
				SET @SQLWhere += 'finalSubquery.rowNumber BETWEEN (((' + CAST(@var_PageNumber AS NVARCHAR(20))+ ' * '+CAST(@var_MaxRowsPerPage AS NVARCHAR (20))+') - '+CAST(@var_MaxRowsPerPage AS NVARCHAR(20))+') + 1) /*start row*/ 
										AND ((' + CAST(@var_PageNumber AS NVARCHAR(20)) +' * ' + CAST(@var_MaxRowsPerPage AS NVARCHAR (20))+ ' )) /*end row*/ '	
			END
			IF @IsSearching = 1
			BEGIN
				IF @var_Search <> ''
				BEGIN
					SET @SQLWhere += @var_Search
				END
			END

PRINT @SQLWhere

			IF ISNULL(@var_SortField,'') <> '' AND ISNULL(@var_SortOrder, '') <> ''
			BEGIN
				SET @SQLOrderBy = 'ORDER BY 
									['+@var_SortField+'] '+' '+@var_SortOrder
			END
PRINT @SQLOrderBy
			
			DECLARE @MaxRowNumber INT
			SELECT @MaxRowNumber = MAX(RowNumber) FROM #Results

			IF @IsSearching = 0
			BEGIN
				EXEC(@SQLSelect + @SQLFromPart1 + @SQLWhere + @SQLOrderBy)
				PRINT 'Exiting this stored procedure after executing non-search'
				RETURN
			END

PRINT (@SQLInsertIntoTable + @SQLSelect + @SQLFromPart1 + @SQLWhere + @SQLOrderBy)
			EXEC(@SQLInsertIntoTable + @SQLSelect + @SQLFromPart1 + @SQLWhere + @SQLOrderBy)
			UPDATE #Results WITH (ROWLOCK)
			SET CurrentDataSet = 0
			WHERE RowNumber <= @MaxRowNumber
			SELECT @totalRecords = COUNT(*)
			FROM #Results WHERE CurrentDataSet = 1

PRINT''
PRINT '@TotalRecords = ' +cast(isnull(@totalRecords, 0) as NVARCHAR(50))

			

			IF @IsSearching = 1 
			BEGIN
				SELECT @EndRow = (@var_PageNumber*@var_MaxRowsPerPage) + (SELECT MIN(RowNumber) FROM #Results WHERE CurrentDataSet = 1) -1
				SELECT @StartRow = @EndRow - @var_MaxRowsPerPage + 1

PRINT ''
PRINT '@StartRow = '+cast(isnull(@StartRow, 0) as NVARCHAR(50))
PRINT '@EndRow = ' +cast(isnull(@EndRow, 0) AS NVARCHAR(50))
			SELECT
				PK,
				ImagePath,
				IsFiltered,
				IsArchived,
				@totalRecords as TotalRecords, 
				WorksOrderNumber,
				WorksOrderType,
				[Status],
				Origin,
				[Created By],
				1 AS [$hideCol%CurrentDataSet]
				FROM
				#Results as SR
					WHERE SR.CurrentDataSet = 1
					AND SR.RowNumber BETWEEN @StartRow AND @EndRow
					ORDER BY 
						SR.RowNumber ASC
			END 
			PRINT'HERE'
			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end

			
			
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END
GO

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT

  BEGIN TRY  
     
   -- This stored procedures main code, excluding error handling - start  
   --Select *   
   Select UserPK, Email, HealthCheckPK, SendRealtimeEmail, HealthCheckUserPK  
   from tblHealthChecks hcs   
   inner join tblHealthCheckUsers hcus on hcs.HealthCheckPK = hcus.HealthCheckFK   
   inner join tblUsers users on users.UserPK = hcus.UserFK   
   inner join aspnetusers aspM on aspM.Id = users.AspNetUserID
   --inner join dbo.aspnet_Membership aspM on aspM.UserId = users.AspNetUserID

    AND (SendRealtimeEmail = cast(1 as bit) OR (SendMorningEmail = cast(1 as bit) AND DATEPART(HOUR, GETDATE()) = 9 AND DATEPART(MINUTE, GETDATE()) < 30))

Create Procedure [dbo].[SPHSEStockActivity]
(
 @customerFk int ,
 @divisionfk int  ,
 @fromdate datetime ,
 @todate datetime 
)
As 
Begin
 SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED   

  DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT    
 ,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;    
 SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();    

 DECLARE @customerFk2 int    
 DECLARE @divisionfk2 int    
    
 Declare @fromdate2 datetime    
 Declare @todate2 datetime
 
 set @customerFk2 =@customerFk
 set @divisionfk2 = @divisionfk
 set @fromdate2 = @fromdate
 set @todate2 = @todate2

  SET @ParameterDetails = '@customerFk = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@customerFk2 AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@divisionfk = '     
  + ISNULL(CAST(@divisionfk2 AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@fromdate = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@fromdate2 AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@todate = '     
   + ISNULL(CAST(@todate2 AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') 

     IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL     
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)    
     SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC

	  SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)    
    
        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)    
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK    
    
        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()    

		 SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);    
 SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails    
 ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;    
 INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()  

 WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
 BEGIN  
 BEGIN TRY  
--get all stock
drop table if exists #tmpstockitems
select stockitempk, stockitemcode, divisionpk, divisioncode, divisionname, s.Description,s.StockItemCodeAlias1 as Title
into #tmpstockitems
from tblstockitems s
inner join tbldivisions d on s.DivisionFK = d.DivisionPK
where d.CustomerFK = @customerFk and (@divisionfk = -1 or @divisionfk = DivisionPK) and s.IsArchived=0

 

--get current stock level
drop table if exists #tmpcurrentstock
select s.stockitempk, vs.ActualUnits
into #tmpcurrentstock
from #tmpstockitems s
inner join viewStockLevels vs on s.StockItemPK = vs.StockItemPK

 

--get last stock in
drop table if exists #tmpstockins
select stockitemfk, max(sins.arrivaldate) MostRecentIn
into #tmpstockins
from tblStockIns sins
inner join tblstockinlines sil on sil.StockInFK = sins.StockInPK
inner join #tmpstockitems s on sil.StockItemFK = s.StockItemPK
where sins.StockInStatusFK = 3
group by stockitemfk

 

--get last stock out
drop table if exists #tmpLaststockouts
select stockitemfk, max(co.collectiondate) MostRecentOut
into #tmpLaststockouts
from tblcontainerouts co
inner join tblcontaineroutlines col on containeroutpk = containeroutfk
inner join #tmpstockitems s on col.StockItemFK = s.StockItemPK
where co.ContainerOutStatusFK = 5
group by StockItemFK

 

--get stock out history for date range
drop table if exists #tmpstockoutSummary
select stockitemfk, sum(col.units) TotalUnits, count(col.ContaineroutlinePk) TotalOrders
into #tmpstockoutSummary
from tblcontainerouts co
inner join tblcontaineroutlines col on containeroutpk = containeroutfk
inner join #tmpstockitems s on col.StockItemFK = s.StockItemPK
where co.ContainerOutStatusFK = 5 and co.CollectionDate between @fromdate and @todate
group by StockItemFK

 

--summarise all
select * from (
    select case when actualunits > 0 then 'Yes' else 'No' end as Instock, /*s.StockItemPK,*/ DivisionCode, DivisionName, StockItemCode,  s.Description,s.Title, ActualUnits as CurrentStock, si.MostRecentIn, so.MostRecentOut, sos.TotalOrders, sos.TotalUnits
    from #tmpstockitems s
    left join #tmpcurrentstock cs on s.StockItemPK = cs.StockItemPK
    left join #tmpstockins si on s.StockItemPK = si.StockItemFK
    left join #tmpLaststockouts so on s.StockItemPK = so.StockItemFK
    left join #tmpstockoutSummary sos on s.StockItemPK = sos.StockItemFK
    --where ActualUnits > 0
    --union 
    --select 'No' as InStock, s.StockItemPK, DivisionCode, DivisionName, StockItemCode, ActualUnits as CurrentStock, si.MostRecentIn, so.MostRecentOut, sos.TotalOrders, sos.TotalUnits
    --from #tmpstockitems s
    --left join #tmpcurrentstock cs on s.StockItemPK = cs.StockItemPK
    --left join #tmpstockins si on s.StockItemPK = si.StockItemFK
    --left join #tmpLaststockouts so on s.StockItemPK = so.StockItemFK
    --left join #tmpstockoutSummary sos on s.StockItemPK = sos.StockItemFK
    --where ActualUnits = 0
)subq
order by InStock desc,  DivisionCode, stockitemcode


/*
select col.*
from tblcontainerouts co
inner join tblcontaineroutlines col on containeroutpk = containeroutfk
inner join #tmpstockitems s on col.StockItemFK = s.StockItemPK
where co.ContainerOutStatusFK = 5 and StockItemPK = 72956 and co.CollectionDate between @fromdate and @todate
order by CollectionDate
*/

BREAK    
  END TRY 
   BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */    
   DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;    
   SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;    
   SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;    
    
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY     
   BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;    
           
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;    
    
            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID    
                
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;    
                
   IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)    
   BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END    
   ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */    
  END CATCH    
  SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1    
 END    
END

-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spImportGoodsOutwardDeliveryAddressGet]
(
	@address1 nvarchar(200),
	@address2 nvarchar(200),
	@address3 nvarchar(200),
	@address4 nvarchar(200),
	@divisionFK int,
	@address5 nvarchar(200) = '',
	@County nvarchar(200) = '',
	@Telephone nvarchar(200) = ''
)	
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT
 ,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;
	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	DECLARE @address1_2 nvarchar(200), @address2_2 nvarchar(200), @address3_2 nvarchar(200), @address4_2 nvarchar(200), @address5_2 nvarchar(200), @county_2 nvarchar(200), @telephone_2 nvarchar(200), @divisionFK2 int

	SET @address1_2 = TRIM(@address1); SET @address2_2 = TRIM(@address2); SET @address3_2 = TRIM(@address3); SET @address4_2 = TRIM(@address4); SET @address5_2 = TRIM(@address5); SET @county_2 = TRIM(@county); SET @Telephone_2 = TRIM(@Telephone); SET @divisionFK2 = @divisionFK

	SET @ParameterDetails = '@address1 = ' + ISNULL(@address1_2,'') + '@address2 = ' + ISNULL(@address2_2,'') + '@address3 = ' + ISNULL(@address3_2,'')
		+ '@address4 = ' + ISNULL(@address4_2,'') + '@address5 = ' + ISNULL(@address5_2,'')+ '@county = ' + ISNULL(@county_2,'')+ '@Telephone = ' + ISNULL(@Telephone_2,'')+ '@divisionFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@divisionFK2 AS NVARCHAR(20)),'')

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    --BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

		SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END


	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY
			IF XACT_STATE() = 0 AND @@TRANCOUNT < 1 BEGIN TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start

			Declare @deliveryAddressFK int

			IF(EXISTS(Select * from tblDeliveryAddresses das
						left JOIN tblDivisionDeliveryAddresses ddas on
						ddas.DeliveryAddressFK = das.DeliveryAddressPK
						WHERE TRIM(Address1) = @address1_2 AND
						TRIM(Address2) = @address2_2 AND
						TRIM(Address3) = @address3_2 AND
						TRIM(Address4) = @address4_2 AND
						TRIM(Address5) = @address5_2 AND
						TRIM(TelephoneNumber) = @Telephone_2 AND
						(@divisionFK2 = -1 OR ddas.DivisionFK = @divisionFK2))) 
			BEGIN
				--The address exists, select it
				Select top 1 DeliveryAddressPK from tblDeliveryAddresses das
				left JOIN tblDivisionDeliveryAddresses ddas on
				ddas.DeliveryAddressFK = das.DeliveryAddressPK
				WHERE TRIM(Address1) = @address1_2 AND
				TRIM(Address2) = @address2_2 AND
				TRIM(Address3) = @address3_2 AND
				TRIM(Address4) = @address4_2 AND
				TRIM(Address5) = @address5_2 AND
				TRIM(TelephoneNumber) = @Telephone_2 AND
				(@divisionFK2 = -1 OR ddas.DivisionFK = @divisionFK2)
			END 
			ELSE 
			BEGIN --The delivery address does not exists insert and then select

			print 'new address'
				declare @countryFK int = -1
				declare @countyfk int = -1
				if(@county_2 <> '')
				begin
					select @countyfk=CountyPK, @countryFK=CountryFK from tblCounties where County = @county_2
				end

				print 'got county'
				print @countyfk
				print @countryFK

				INSERT into tblDeliveryAddresses 
				VALUES(
				-1, @address1_2, @address2_2, @address3_2, @address4_2, @address5_2, @countyfk, @countryFK, @Telephone_2,
				0/*cast(0 as bit)*/, 0, dbo.GetBSTDate(), 0, dbo.GetBSTDate(),1 /*DeliveryAddressType defaulted to market*/
				)
					Set @deliveryAddressFK = scope_identity()
		
				IF(@divisionFK2 > 0)
				BEGIN

					Insert into tblDivisionDeliveryAddresses 
					VALUES (
						@divisionFK2,
						@deliveryAddressFK,
						1/*cast(1 as bit)*/,
						1/*cast(1 as bit)*/,
						0/*cast(0 as bit)*/,
						0,
						dbo.GetBSTDate(),
						0,
						dbo.GetBSTDate()
					)
				END
				Select @deliveryAddressFK
			END
				
			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end

			BEGIN TRY IF XACT_STATE() = 1 AND @@TRANCOUNT = 1 AND @OpeningTranCount < 1 COMMIT TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH
			
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END

-- Upsert proc for STAWMS.tblMoveITData, used by CompareExcelService.
-- Updated to carry the Deleted / Deleted_Date / Delete_Reason columns MoveIT's
-- export now provides directly (see MigrateAddDeletedColumns.sql for the schema change).
-- Run against STAWMS to apply.

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spInsertOrUpdateMoveITData]
    @JobNumber NVARCHAR(50),
    @Date DATE,
    @Customer NVARCHAR(100),
    @CollectionDate DATE,
    @CollectionTime time,
    @DeliveryDate DATE,
    @DeliveryTime time,
    @CustomerRef NVARCHAR(50),
    @ContainerNumber NVARCHAR(50),
    @Collection NVARCHAR(100),
    @Delivery NVARCHAR(100),
    @Country NVARCHAR(50),
    @Type NVARCHAR(50),
    @Load_Details NVARCHAR(MAX),
    @DriverApp NVARCHAR(50),
    @POD NVARCHAR(50),
    @Manifest NVARCHAR(50),
    @InvoiceNumber NVARCHAR(50),
    @Driver NVARCHAR(50),
    @Vehicle NVARCHAR(50),
    @Trailer NVARCHAR(50),
    @Revenue DECIMAL(18, 2),
    @Created_EventDate  DATETIME,
    @Created_Ref NVARCHAR(100),
    @POD_EventDate  DATETIME,
    @POD_Ref     NVARCHAR(100),
    @Completed_EventDate DATETIME,
    @Completed_Ref NVARCHAR(100),
    @Deleted BIT,
    @DeletedDate DATETIME,
    @DeleteReason NVARCHAR(255)
AS
BEGIN

    IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM tblMoveITData WHERE Job_Number = @JobNumber)
    BEGIN
        -- If exists, perform an update
        UPDATE tblMoveITData
        SET
        Job_Number=@JobNumber,
            Date = @Date,
            Customer = @Customer,
            Collection_Date = @CollectionDate,
            Collection_Time = @CollectionTime,
            Delivery_Date = @DeliveryDate,
            Delivery_Time=@DeliveryTime,
            Customer_Ref = @CustomerRef,
            Container_Number = @ContainerNumber,
            Collection = @Collection,
            Delivery = @Delivery,
            Country = @Country,
            Type = @Type,
            Load_Details = @Load_Details,
            Driver_App = @DriverApp,
            POD = @POD,
            Manifest = @Manifest,
            Invoice_Number = @InvoiceNumber,
            Driver = @Driver,
            Vehicle = @Vehicle,
            Trailer = @Trailer,
            Revenue = @Revenue,
            Created_EventDate = @Created_EventDate,
            Created_Ref = @Created_Ref,
            POD_EventDate =    @POD_EventDate,
            POD_Ref   =  @POD_Ref,
            Completed_EventDate    = @Completed_EventDate,
            Completed_Ref=@Completed_Ref,
            Deleted = @Deleted,
            Deleted_Date = @DeletedDate,
            Delete_Reason = @DeleteReason

        WHERE Job_Number = @JobNumber;
    END
    ELSE
    BEGIN
        -- If not exists, perform an insert
        INSERT INTO tblMoveITData (
            Job_Number, Date, Customer, Collection_Date,Collection_Time , Delivery_Date, Delivery_Time,
            Customer_Ref, Container_Number, Collection, Delivery, Country,
            Type, Load_Details, Driver_App, POD, Manifest, Invoice_Number,
            Driver, Vehicle, Trailer, Revenue,Created_EventDate,Created_Ref,POD_EventDate ,POD_Ref,Completed_EventDate,Completed_Ref,
            Deleted, Deleted_Date, Delete_Reason )
        VALUES (
            @JobNumber, @Date, @Customer, @CollectionDate, @CollectionTime, @DeliveryDate, @DeliveryTime,
            @CustomerRef, @ContainerNumber, @Collection, @Delivery, @Country,
            @Type, @Load_Details, @DriverApp, @POD, @Manifest, @InvoiceNumber,
            @Driver, @Vehicle, @Trailer, @Revenue,@Created_EventDate,@Created_Ref,@POD_EventDate ,@POD_Ref,@Completed_EventDate,@Completed_Ref,
            @Deleted, @DeletedDate, @DeleteReason);
    END
END;

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spInsertScheduleDeliveryAndLogToActivity]

 @BuildingFK INT,

 @ScheduleSlotFK INT,                
 @ScheduleDeliveryTypeFK INT,                
 @ContainerInFK INT,                
 @ContainerOutFK INT,                    
 @Description NVARCHAR(1000),

 @EndTime VARCHAR(50),                       
 @ScheduleActivityTypeFK INT,                
 @SchedulePlaceholderFK INT,                
 @GoodsInNumber NVARCHAR(max),                
 @GoodsOrderNumber NVARCHAR(max),                
 @Reference NVARCHAR(max),                
 @UserId INT 
)                
AS                
BEGIN                
 /* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */                
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED                
                
    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT                
 ,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;                
 SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();                
                
 -- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters                
                
 DECLARE @var_buildingFK INT,          
  @var_weekNumber INT,             
  @var_year INT,           
 @var_scheduleSlotFK INT,                 
 @var_containerInFK INT,                
 @var_containerOutFK INT,                
 @var_scheduleDeliveryTypeFK INT,                
 @var_description NVARCHAR(1000),                 
 @var_startTime TIME(0),                      
 @var_endTime TIME(0),                
 @var_goodsInNumber NVARCHAR(MAX),                
 @var_goodsOrderNumber NVARCHAR(MAX),                
 @var_reference NVARCHAR(MAX),                     
 @var_scheduleActivityTypeFK INT,                
 @var_schedulePlaceholderFK INT,                
 @var_userId INT,                     
 @var_latestScheduleDeliveryPK INT,      
 @var_scheduleDeliveryFK INT,        
 @var_currentDate DateTime;           
   
  
SET @var_buildingFK=@BuildingFK;            
SET @var_weekNumber=@WeekNumber;              
SET @var_year=@Year;                
 SET @var_scheduleSlotFK=@ScheduleSlotFK;                
 SET @var_containerInFK =@ContainerInFK;                
 SET @var_containerOutFK = @ContainerOutFK;                
 SET @var_scheduleDeliveryTypeFK= @ScheduleDeliveryTypeFK;                
 SET @var_description= @Description;                 
 SET @var_startTime=CAST(@StartTime AS TIME(0));               
 SET @var_endTime=CAST(@EndTime AS TIME(0));          

   
 -- Calculate the duration between start and end time        
    DECLARE @var_duration TIME(0);         
    SET @var_duration = DATEADD(SECOND, DATEDIFF(SECOND, @StartTime, @EndTime), '00:00:00');          
               
 SET @var_goodsInNumber = @GoodsInNumber;                
 SET @var_goodsOrderNumber= @GoodsOrderNumber;                
 SET @var_reference =@Reference;           
 SET @var_scheduleActivityTypeFK=@ScheduleActivityTypeFK;                
 SET @var_schedulePlaceholderFK=@SchedulePlaceholderFK;                
 SET @var_userId= @UserId;                
 SET @var_currentDate= dbo.GetBSTDate()            
               
 SET @ParameterDetails = '@BuildingFK = '+  ISNULL(CAST(@var_buildingFK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)), '')+             
  ',@WeekNumber = '+  ISNULL(CAST(@var_weekNumber AS NVARCHAR(MAX)), '')+              
  ',@Year = '+  ISNULL(CAST(@var_year AS NVARCHAR(MAX)), '')+             
 ',@ScheduleSlotFK = '+ ISNULL(CAST(@var_scheduleSlotFK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') +                 
 ',@ContainerInFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_containerInFK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') +                
 ',@ContainerOutFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_containerOutFK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') +                
 ',@ScheduleDeliveryTypeFK = '+ ISNULL(CAST( @var_scheduleDeliveryTypeFK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'')+                
 ',@Description = '+ ISNULL(CAST( @var_description AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'')+                
 ',@StartTime = '+ ISNULL(CAST( @var_startTime AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'')+                
 ',@EndTime = '+ ISNULL(CAST(  @var_endTime AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'')+                
 ',@Duration = '+ ISNULL(CAST( @var_duration AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'')+                
 ',@GoodsInNumber = '+ ISNULL(CAST( @var_goodsInNumber AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'')+                
 ',@GoodsOrderNumber = '+ ISNULL(CAST(  @var_goodsOrderNumber AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'')+                
 ',@Reference = '+ ISNULL(CAST( @var_reference AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'')+                
 ',@BuildingFK = '+ ISNULL(CAST( @var_buildingFK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'')+                
 ',@ScheduleActivityTypeFK = '+ ISNULL(CAST(  @var_scheduleActivityTypeFK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'')+                
 ',@SchedulePlaceholderFK = '+ ISNULL(CAST(  @var_schedulePlaceholderFK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'')+                
 ',@UserId = '+ ISNULL(CAST(@var_userId AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'')  
                
    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL                 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)                
                
    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)                
    --BEGIN                
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC                 
                
  SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)                
                
        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)                
        SELECT 'Database',@var_currentDate,@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK                
                
        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()                
    --END                
                
                
 SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);                
 SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails                
 ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;                
 INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()                
                
 WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3                
BEGIN                
  BEGIN TRY        
  -- Insert into tblScheduleDeliveries                
    INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblScheduleDeliveries](                
    ScheduleSlotFK,          
 ScheduleDeliveryTypeFK,          
 ContainerInFK,          
 ContainerOutFK,          
 [Description],           
 StartTime,          
 EndTime,          
 ActualDuration,                
 IsArchived,          
 InsertedBy,          
 InsertedDate,          
 UpdatedBy,          
 UpdatedDate)                
    VALUES                 
    (@var_scheduleSlotFK,                
     @var_scheduleDeliveryTypeFK,                  
     CASE WHEN @var_containerInFK = -1 THEN NULL ELSE @var_containerInFK END,                
     CASE WHEN @var_containerOutFK = -1 THEN NULL ELSE @var_containerOutFK END,                
     @var_description,                
     @var_startTime,                 
     @var_endTime,                
     @var_duration,                
     0,                
     @var_userId,                
     @var_currentDate,                
     @var_userId,                
     @var_currentDate);                
                 
 -- Get the primary key of the newly inserted record in TblScheduleDeliveries             
   SET @var_latestScheduleDeliveryPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY();       
   SET @var_scheduleDeliveryFK = @var_latestScheduleDeliveryPK;       
      
   DECLARE @ActivityComments NVARCHAR(MAX);            
                
     -- Determine activity comments based on delivery type                
    SELECT @ActivityComments =                 
        CASE @var_scheduleDeliveryTypeFK                
            WHEN 1 THEN CONCAT('Added Inbound: ', @var_goodsInNumber, CHAR(13) + CHAR(10),             
              ', (ref : ', @var_reference, ')', CHAR(13) + CHAR(10),             
                      ', allotted time interval: ', @var_startTime, ' - ', @var_endTime )                
                       
     WHEN 2 THEN CONCAT('Added Outbound: ', @var_goodsOrderNumber, CHAR(13) + CHAR(10),             
                        ', (ref : ', @var_reference, ')', CHAR(13) + CHAR(10),            
                        ', allotted time interval: ',  @var_startTime, ' - ', @var_endTime )                 
                        
   WHEN 3 THEN CONCAT('Added Group: ', @var_goodsInNumber, CHAR(13) + CHAR(10),             
                      ', (ref : ', @var_reference, ')',CHAR(13) + CHAR(10),            
                      ', allotted time interval:: ', @var_startTime, ' - ', @var_endTime )                
            ELSE ''                
        END;               
                  
    -- Insert into tblScheduleActivities table                
    INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblScheduleActivities](BuildingFK,ScheduleActivityTypeFK, SchedulePlaceholderFK, ScheduleDeliveryFK,Comments,IsArchived, InsertedBy, InsertedDate, UpdatedBy,UpdatedDate)                
    VALUES (@var_buildingFK, @var_scheduleActivityTypeFK, @var_schedulePlaceholderFK, @var_latestScheduleDeliveryPK, @ActivityComments,0, @var_userId, @var_currentDate, @var_userId, @var_currentDate);                          
               
  -- Call spUpdateScheduleWeekAudit      
    DECLARE @ScheduleWeekPK INT;      
    EXEC [dbo].[spUpdateScheduleWeekAudit]      
        @SchedulePlaceholderFK = @var_schedulePlaceholderFK,      
        @ScheduleDeliveryFK = @var_scheduleDeliveryFK,        
        @BuildingFK = @var_buildingFK,      
        @UserId = @var_userId,      
        @CurrentDate = @var_currentDate,      
        @ScheduleWeekPK = @ScheduleWeekPK OUTPUT;      
        
       -- Final output    
       DECLARE @UserType NVARCHAR(100)=dbo.fnGetUserType(@var_userId);   
           
       DECLARE @TransportCompanyFK INT;           
       SELECT @TransportCompanyFK = TransportCompanyFK    
       FROM tblUsers    
       WHERE UserPK = @var_userId;    
           
        DECLARE @IsExternal BIT = CASE WHEN ISNULL(@UserType, '') = 'ExternalTransportUser' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END;    
       IF(@IsExternal=1 )    
        BEGIN    
         UPDATE tblContainerOuts    
        SET TransportCompanyFK = @TransportCompanyFK    
        WHERE (@var_containerOutFK IS NOT NULL AND @var_containerOutFK > 0)    
          AND ContainerOutPK = @var_containerOutFK;    
    
         UPDATE tblContainerIns    
        SET TransportCompanyFK = @TransportCompanyFK    
        WHERE (@var_containerInFK IS NOT NULL AND @var_containerInFK > 0)    
          AND ContainerInPK = @var_containerInFK;    
           
         SELECT *    
         FROM dbo.fnGetScheduleWeekForTransportUser    
         (    
             @var_buildingFK,    
             @var_weekNumber,    
             @var_year,    
             @var_userId    
         )    
         ORDER BY ChannelName ASC, DayDate ASC;    
         END    
       ELSE    
       BEGIN    
         --  PRINT 'Entering default user block';    
           SELECT *    
           FROM dbo.fnGetScheduleWeekForBuildingWithYearAndWeekNumber    
           (    
               @var_buildingFK,    
               @var_weekNumber,    
               @var_year,    
               @var_userId    
           )    
           ORDER BY ChannelName ASC, DayDate ASC;    
       END;    
   BREAK                
  END TRY                
 BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */                
   DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;                
   SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;                
   SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;                
                
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY                 
   BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;                
              
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;                
                
            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID                
                            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;                
                            
   IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)                
   BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END                
   ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */                
  END CATCH                
  SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1                
 END                
END

           ORDER BY ChannelName ASC, DayDate ASC;

 '@Year = ', ISNULL(CAST(@var_year AS NVARCHAR(MAX)), ''), ', ',

 '@SupplierFK = ', ISNULL(CAST(@var_supplierFK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)), ''), ', ',

 '@ColorCode = ', ISNULL(@var_colorCode, ''), ', ',          
 '@CurrentUser = ', ISNULL(CAST(@var_userId AS NVARCHAR(MAX)), ''), ', ',          
 '@WeekFK = ', ISNULL(CAST(@var_weekFK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)), ''), ', ',          
 '@DayFK = ', ISNULL(CAST(@var_dayFK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)), ''), ', ',          
 '@ChannelName = ', ISNULL(@var_channelName, ''), ', ',          
 '@DayDate = ', ISNULL(CAST(@DayDate AS NVARCHAR(MAX)), ''), ', ',          
 '@Description = ', ISNULL(@var_description, ''), ', ',          
  '@StartTime = ', CASE           
            WHEN @var_startTime IS NULL THEN 'NULL'          
            ELSE FORMAT(@var_startTime, 'hh\\:mm')           
        END, ', ',          
    '@EndTime = ', CASE           
            WHEN @var_endTime IS NULL THEN 'NULL'          
            ELSE FORMAT(@var_endTime, 'hh\\:mm')           
        END, ', ',          
     'TimeValidation = ', CASE          
            WHEN @var_startTime IS NULL OR @var_endTime IS NULL THEN 'Invalid: Start or End Time is NULL'          
            WHEN @var_startTime > @var_endTime THEN 'Invalid: StartTime is after EndTime'          
            ELSE 'Valid'          
        END, ', ',          
     'DurationValidation = ', CASE          
            WHEN @var_duration < '00:15:00' THEN 'Invalid: Duration is less than 15 minutes'          
            ELSE 'Valid'          
        END          
    );          
            
    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL           
    CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),          
   ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),          
   ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),          
   EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT          
    )          
          
    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)          
    --BEGIN          
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC           
          
  SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)          
          
        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)          
        SELECT 'Database',@var_currentDate,@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK          
          
        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

 SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);          
 SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails          
 ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;          
 INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()          
          
 WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3          
 BEGIN           
  BEGIN TRY          
   
  -- Insert into tblSchedulePlaceholders                      
    INSERT INTO tblSchedulePlaceholders (                      
        ScheduleDayFK,                      
        CustomerFK,                      
        SupplierFK,                      
        StartTime,                      
        EndTime,                      
        Title,                      
        ColorCode,                      
        IsArchived,                      
        InsertedBy,

        UpdatedBy,                      
        UpdatedDate,                    
        ActualDuration,          
        [Description]

    VALUES (                      
        @var_dayFK,                      
        @var_customerFK,                      
        @var_supplierFK,                      
        @var_startTime,                      
        @var_endTime,                      
        @var_title,                             
        @var_colorCode,

        @var_userId,

    SET @var_latestSchedulePlaceholderPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY();                      
    SET @var_SchedulePlaceholderFK = @var_latestSchedulePlaceholderPK;             
   
 -- If @AddToTemplate is true

 BEGIN                    
   -- Get ScheduleWeekTemplateFK from tblScheduleWeeks                      
    SELECT @var_scheduleWeekTemplateFK = ScheduleWeekTemplateFK                       
    FROM tblScheduleWeeks WHERE ScheduleWeekPK = @var_weekFK;                      
              
 -- Get ScheduleWeekTemplateFK from tblScheduleWeeks                              
    SELECT @var_scheduleChannelTemplatePK = ScheduleChannelTemplatePK                          
    FROM tblScheduleChannelTemplates                       
    WHERE ScheduleWeekTemplateFK = @var_scheduleWeekTemplateFK AND [Name] = @var_channelName;

    SELECT @var_scheduleDayTemplateFK = ScheduleDayTemplatePK          
    FROM tblScheduleDayTemplates                     
    WHERE ScheduleChannelTemplateFK=@var_scheduleChannelTemplatePK AND DayNumber=@var_dayNumber;    
         
 -- Check if @var_scheduleDayTemplateFK is NULL            
    -- This happens when the user has not selected a specific day while configuring & creating the weekly schedule template          
      IF @var_scheduleDayTemplateFK IS NULL          
    BEGIN                  
       RAISERROR('No matching ScheduleDayTemplate found for the provided DayDate and ChannelName', 16, 1);          
        -- Optionally, set a default value (e.g., 0) if needed:          
        -- SET @var_scheduleDayTemplateFK = -1;          
    END          
          
   -- Insert into tblSchedulePlaceholderTemplates                      
    INSERT INTO tblSchedulePlaceholderTemplates (                      
        ScheduleDayTemplateFK,                      
        CustomerFK,                      
        SupplierFK,                      
        WeekFK,                      
        StartTime,                      
        EndTime,                                 
        ColorCode,                      
        IsArchived,                      
        InsertedBy,                      
        InsertedDate,     
        UpdatedBy,                      
        UpdatedDate,                    
        ActualDuration,            
        Title,          
        [Description]         
    )                      
    VALUES (                      
        @var_scheduleDayTemplateFK,                      
        @var_customerFK,                      
        @var_supplierFK,                      
        @var_weekFK,                      
        @var_startTime,                      
        @var_endTime,                       
        @var_colorCode,                      
        0,                      
        @var_userId,                      
        @var_currentDate,                      
        @var_userId,                      
        @var_currentDate,                     
        @var_duration ,          
        @var_title,                       
        @var_description          
    );                      
   END;                      
                  
    DECLARE @ActivityComments NVARCHAR(MAX);                  
                   
  -- Construct Activity Comments          
    SET @ActivityComments = CONCAT(' Added placeholder: ',@var_title, CHAR(13) + CHAR(10),         
    CASE           
        WHEN @CustomerFK IS NOT NULL THEN CONCAT(' for customer: ', @CustomerFK)           
        ELSE ''           
    END,       
 CHAR(13) + CHAR(10),      
    CASE           
        WHEN @SupplierFK IS NOT NULL THEN CONCAT(', supplier: ', @SupplierFK)           
        ELSE ''           
    END,          
    CHAR(13) + CHAR(10),          
    ' allotted time interval: ', @var_startTime, ' - ', @var_endTime);          
               
    -- Insert into tblScheduleActivities table                  
    INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblScheduleActivities](BuildingFK,ScheduleActivityTypeFK, SchedulePlaceholderFK, ScheduleDeliveryFK,Comments,IsArchived, InsertedBy, InsertedDate, UpdatedBy,UpdatedDate)                  
    VALUES (@var_buildingFK, @var_scheduleActivityTypeFK, @var_latestschedulePlaceholderPK, Null, @ActivityComments,0, @var_userId, @var_currentDate, @var_userId, @var_currentDate);                            
                
      -- Call spUpdateScheduleWeekAudit  
    DECLARE @ScheduleWeekPK INT;  
    EXEC [dbo].[spUpdateScheduleWeekAudit]  
        @SchedulePlaceholderFK = @var_schedulePlaceholderFK,  
        @ScheduleDeliveryFK = @var_scheduleDeliveryFK,    
        @BuildingFK = @var_buildingFK,  
        @UserId = @var_userId,  
        @CurrentDate = @var_currentDate,  
        @ScheduleWeekPK = @ScheduleWeekPK OUTPUT;  
    
 -- Final output  
 SELECT * FROM [dbo].[fnGetScheduleWeekForBuildingWithYearAndWeekNumber](@var_buildingFK, @var_weekNumber, @var_year, @var_userId)          
 ORDER BY ChannelName ASC, DayDate ASC;          
     
 BREAK          
  END TRY          
  BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */          
   DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;          
   SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;          
   SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;          
          
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY           
   BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;          
                 
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;          
          
            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID          
                      
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;          
                      
   IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)          
   BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END          
   ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */          
  END CATCH          
  SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1          
 END          
END 
GO
