CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spInsertUpdateErrorRecordWithFrontEndDetails]
(
	@ErrorLogPK INT
	,@UserPK INT
	,@WindowsUsername NVARCHAR(1000)
	,@ApplicationErrorSource NVARCHAR(4000)
	,@ApplicationErrorLocation NVARCHAR(4000) = ' '
	,@ApplicationErrorLineNumber INT
	,@ApplicationUsername NVARCHAR(1000)
	,@ErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX)
)
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT
 ,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;
	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	DECLARE @ErrorLogPK2 INT
	,@UserPK2 INT
	,@WindowsUsername2 NVARCHAR(1000)
	,@ApplicationErrorSource2 NVARCHAR(4000)
	,@ApplicationErrorLocation2 NVARCHAR(4000)
	,@ApplicationErrorLineNumber2 INT
	,@ApplicationUsername2 NVARCHAR(1000)
	,@ErrorMessage2 NVARCHAR(MAX)

	SET @ErrorLogPK2 = @ErrorLogPK; SET @UserPK2 = @UserPK; SET @WindowsUsername2 = @WindowsUsername; SET @ApplicationErrorSource2 = @ApplicationErrorSource
	SET @ApplicationErrorLocation2 = @ApplicationErrorLocation; SET @ApplicationErrorLineNumber2 = @ApplicationErrorLineNumber; SET @ApplicationUsername2 = @ApplicationUsername
	SET  @ErrorMessage2 = @ErrorMessage

	SET @ParameterDetails = '@ErrorLogPK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@ErrorLogPK2 AS NVARCHAR(100)),'0') + ',@UserPK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@UserPK2 AS NVARCHAR(100)),'0') 
		+ ',@WindowsUsername = ' + ISNULL(@WindowsUsername2,'') + ',@ApplicationErrorSource = ' + ISNULL(@ApplicationErrorSource2,'')
			+ ',@ApplicationErrorLocation = ' + ISNULL(@ApplicationErrorLocation2,'') + ',@ApplicationErrorLineNumber = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@ApplicationErrorLineNumber2 AS NVARCHAR(100)),'0')
				+ ',@ApplicationUsername = ' + ISNULL(@ApplicationUsername2,'') + ',@ErrorMessage = ' + ISNULL(@ErrorMessage2,'')

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    --BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

		SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END


	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY
			IF XACT_STATE() = 0 AND @@TRANCOUNT < 1 BEGIN TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start

			IF ISNULL(@ErrorLogPK,0) > 0 /* Update existing record */
			BEGIN
				UPDATE tblErrorLog WITH (ROWLOCK)
				SET 
					[InsertedBy] = @UserPK2
					,[UpdatedBy] = @UserPK2
					,[WindowsUsername] = @WindowsUsername2
					,[ApplicationErrorSource] = @ApplicationErrorSource2
					,[ApplicationErrorLocation] = @ApplicationErrorLocation2
					,[ApplicationErrorLineNumber] = @ApplicationErrorLineNumber2
					,[ApplicationUsername] = @ApplicationUsername2
				WHERE 
					ErrorLogPK = @ErrorLogPK2
			END
			ELSE /* Add new record */
			BEGIN
				DECLARE @CurrentDateTime DATETIME; SET @CurrentDateTime = dbo.GetBSTDate()

				INSERT INTO dbo.tblErrorLog
				(SQLErrorNumber,SQLErrorSeverity,SQLErrorState,SQLExecutionPath,SQLErrorLineNo,ErrorMessage,IsArchived,InsertedBy,InsertedDate,UpdatedBy,UpdatedDate,WindowsUsername,
						ApplicationErrorSource,ApplicationErrorLocation,ApplicationErrorLineNumber,ApplicationUsername)
				SELECT 0,0,0,NULL,NULL,@ErrorMessage2,0,@UserPK2,@CurrentDateTime,@UserPK2,@CurrentDateTime,@WindowsUsername2,@ApplicationErrorSource2,
						@ApplicationErrorLocation2,@ApplicationErrorLineNumber2,@ApplicationUsername2

				SET @ErrorLogPK2 = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
			END

			SELECT 'ErrorLogPK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@ErrorLogPK2 AS NVARCHAR(100)),0) AS [ErrorLogPK]

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end

			BEGIN TRY IF XACT_STATE() = 1 AND @@TRANCOUNT = 1 AND @OpeningTranCount < 1 COMMIT TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH
			
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END

-- =============================================

-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spIntegrationContainerInGoodsReceiptsReadyByArrival] 
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT
	,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;
	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	--DECLARE 

	SET @ParameterDetails = ''

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    --BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

		SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END

	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY
			
			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start

			Select StockInPK
			FROM tblStockIns sins
			inner join tblContainerIns cins on cins.ContainerInPK = sins.ContainerInFK AND cins.StockInStatusFK <> 4 AND cins.InsertedBy = 0
			inner join tblDivisions divs on sins.DivisionFK = divs.DivisionPK AND divs.ExportGoodsReceipt = cast(1 as bit) AND divs.GoodsReceiptExportTypeFK = 1 /*By Enmasse*/
			LEFT OUTER JOIN tblStockDiscrepencies sds ON sds.StockInFK = sins.StockInPK
			Where --sins.CheckedAndReceivedBy = -1 /*add back in after removing goods receipt function from wms*/
			ArrivalRecordedBy > 0
			AND sds.StockDiscrepencyPK is null /*We dont want discrepacies */
			--AND cins.StockInStatusFK <> 4 /*We dont want to goods receipt cancelled Stock Ins*/
			--AND cins.InsertedBy = 0 /*We only want to goods receipt Container Ins that have come from the integration (user 0)*/
			AND sins.GoodsReceiptSent= 0 /*we only want stock ins that dont yet have a goods receipt */
	
			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end
						
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spIntegrationContainerInGoodsReceiptsReadyByScan] 
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT
	,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;
	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	--DECLARE 

	SET @ParameterDetails = ''

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    --BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

		SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END

	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY
			
			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start
			if object_id('tempdb..#tmpDivisions') is not null 
				drop table #tmpDivisions
			if object_id('tempdb..#tmpStockIns') is not null 
				drop table #tmpStockIns
			if object_id('tempdb..#tmpContainerIns') is not null 
					DROP table #tmpContainerIns			

			SELECT * INTO #tmpDivisions 
			FROM tbldivisions 
			WHERE ExportGoodsReceipt = 1 and GoodsReceiptExportTypeFK = 2/*By Scan*/

			SELECT si.* INTO #tmpStockIns 
			FROM tblStockIns si
			INNER JOIN #tmpDivisions ON divisionfk = DivisionPK
			WHERE CheckedAndReceivedBy = -1 AND ArrivalRecordedBy > 0 AND si.InsertedBy = 0 /*integrated only*/
						
			SELECT tci.* INTO #tmpContainerIns 
			FROM dbo.tblContainerIns tci
			INNER JOIN #tmpStockIns ON tci.ContainerInPK = #tmpStockIns.ContainerInFK
			WHERE tci.StockInStatusFK <> 4/*ignore cancelled*/ and tci.InsertedBy = 0 /*integrated only*/
			
			DECLARE @retVal int
			SELECT @retVal = COUNT(*)  FROM #tmpContainerIns
			--SELECT *  FROM #tmpContainerIns
			IF (@retVal > 0)
			BEGIN
				if object_id('tempdb..#tmpStockInLines') is not null 
					drop table #tmpStockInLines					
				if object_id('tempdb..#tmpMovements') is not null 
					DROP table #tmpMovements
					
				SELECT sil.* INTO #tmpStockInLines 
				FROM tblStockInLines sil
				INNER JOIN #tmpStockIns ON stockinfk = stockinpk

				Select FK, Max(WorksOrderMovementPK)WorksOrderMovementPK INTO #tmpMovements
				from tblWorksOrders wos 
				INNER JOIN #tmpStockIns si ON wos.FK = si.StockInPK
				INNER JOIN tblWorksOrderMovements woms ON woms.WorksOrderFK = wos.WorksOrderPK AND woms.SourceLocationTypeFK = 4 /*OnRouteContainerIn*/
				Where wos.WorksOrderOriginFK = 1 /*StockIn*/ AND wos.WorksOrderTypeFK = 3 /*Movement*/ AND wos.WorksOrderStatusFK = 3 /*Complete*/
				Group By wos.FK


				Select StockInPK, isnull(UpdatedBy, 0) LastMovementUserFK from (
					Select StockInPK, case when palsOnContainer.PalletPK is NULL then 0 else 1 end OnContainer, lastWom.UpdatedBy
					from #tmpStockIns sins 
					inner join #tmpContainerIns cins ON cins.ContainerInPK = sins.ContainerInFK
					inner join #tmpStockInLines sils ON sils.StockInFK = sins.StockInPK
					inner join tblStockInLinePallets silps ON silps.StockInLineFK = sils.StockInLinePK
					left outer join tblPallets palsOnContainer  ON palsOnContainer.PalletPK = silps.PalletFK AND palsOnContainer.LocationTypeFK = 4 /*OnRouteContainerIn*/
					left outer join #tmpMovements womsLast ON womsLast.FK = sins.StockInPK
					left outer join tblWorksOrderMovements lastWom ON lastWom.WorksOrderMovementPK = womsLast.WorksOrderMovementPK
					LEFT OUTER JOIN tblStockDiscrepencies sds ON sds.StockInFK = sins.StockInPK
					Where sds.StockDiscrepencyPK is null /*LJF - We dont want discrepacies to be GR'd*/
				)subQ
				Group By StockInPK, UpdatedBy
				Having sum(OnContainer) = 0
			END
			ELSE
			BEGIN
				--return empty select
				Select StockInPK, isnull(UpdatedBy, 0) LastMovementUserFK FROM #tmpStockIns
			END
			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end
			
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spIntegrationCountDistinctNewPallets]
(
	@customerFK int,
	@StockInFK int
)	
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT
	,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;
	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	DECLARE @customerFK2 int, @StockInFK2 int

	SET @customerFK2 = @customerFK; SET @StockInFK2 = @StockInFK

	SET @ParameterDetails = '@customerFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@customerFK2 AS NVARCHAR(20)),'') + ',@StockInFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@StockInFK2 AS NVARCHAR(20)),'')

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    --BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

		SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END

	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY			

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start

			DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #StockInLines;
			SELECT * INTO #StockInLines FROM dbo.tblStockInLines tsil WHERE stockinfk = @StockInFK2
			DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #StockInLinePallets;
			SELECT tsilp.* INTO #StockInLinePallets FROM dbo.tblStockInLinePallets tsilp INNER JOIN #StockInLines sils on tsilp.StockInLineFK = sils.StockInLinePK  
			DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #Pallets;
			SELECT pals.* INTO #Pallets FROM dbo.tblPallets pals INNER JOIN #StockInLinePallets tsilp ON pals.PalletPK = tsilp.PalletFK WHERE pals.CustomerBarcode <> ''
			DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #custbarcodes;
			SELECT cgbs.* INTO #custbarcodes FROM tblCustomerGeneratedBarcodes cgbs INNER JOIN #Pallets pals ON cgbs.Barcode = pals.CustomerBarcode AND cgbs.CustomerFK = @customerFK2
	
			DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #CustDivisions;
			select divisionpk INTO #CustDivisions from tbldivisions where customerfk = @customerFK2

			DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #pStamp;
			Select stmps.CustomerBarcode, Count(*) Stamps 
			INTO #pStamp
			from tblPalletStamp stmps 
			inner join tblStockInLinePallets silps on silps.PalletFK = stmps.PalletFK 
			inner join tblStockInLines sils on sils.StockInLinePK = silps.StockInLineFK 
			inner join tblStockIns sins on sins.StockInPK = sils.StockInFK 
			inner join #CustDivisions divs ON sins.DivisionFK = divs.divisionpk
			INNER JOIN #Pallets pals ON stmps.CustomerBarcode = pals.CustomerBarcode
			INNER JOIN #custbarcodes cgbs ON cgbs.Barcode = pals.CustomerBarcode AND cgbs.CustomerFK = @customerFK2 
			Where sins.InsertedBy = 0 
			Group By stmps.CustomerBarcode
			HAVING Count(*) = 1

			SELECT count(*) FROM #pStamp ps
		
			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end			
			
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END

			--Set @SQL = 'EXEC ' + @externalDatabase + '.dbo.spPalletTypeDesignation @palletTypeFK = ' + cast(@FK2 as nvarchar(100))			
			Set @SQL = 'EXEC ' + @sp + ' @palletTypeFK = ' + cast(@FK2 as nvarchar(100))
			Print @SQL
			EXEC(@SQL)
	
			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end

			
			
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;

			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spIntegrationExport]
(
	@sp nvarchar(200),
	@divisionFK int = -1,
	@customerFK int = -1,
	@FK int = -1
)	
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT
	,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;
	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	DECLARE @sp2 nvarchar(200), @divisionFK2 int, @customerFK2 int, @FK2 int

	SET @sp2 = @sp; SET @divisionFK2 = @divisionFK; SET @customerFK2 = @customerFK; SET @FK2 = @FK

	SET @ParameterDetails = '@sp = ' + ISNULL(@sp2,'') + ',@divisionFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@divisionFK2 AS NVARCHAR(20)),'')  
		+ ',@customerFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@customerFK2 AS NVARCHAR(20)),'') + ',@FK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@FK2 AS NVARCHAR(20)),'')

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END

	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY
			
			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start

			Declare @externalDatabase nvarchar(200)

			From tblCustomers cuss
			inner join tblDivisions divs on divs.CustomerFK = cuss.CustomerPK
			Where ((@divisionFK > 0 AND divs.DivisionPK = @divisionFK) OR (@customerFK > 0 AND cuss.CustomerPK = @customerFK))*/

			IF EXISTS(
						SELECT *
						FROM tblCustomers AS cuss
						INNER JOIN tblDivisions AS divs 
						ON divs.CustomerFK = cuss.CustomerPK
						WHERE ((@customerFK2 < 0 and (@divisionFK2 > 0 AND divs.DivisionPK = @divisionFK2)) OR (@customerFK2 > 0 AND cuss.CustomerPK = @customerFK2))	
						AND ISNULL(cuss.ExternalDatabase,'') NOT IN ('','No Integration')
					) 
				SET @sp2 = 'cust' + 
				(SELECT distinct cast(customerpK AS nvarchar(100))
						FROM tblCustomers AS cuss
						INNER JOIN tblDivisions AS divs 
						ON divs.CustomerFK = cuss.CustomerPK
						WHERE ((@customerFK2 < 0 and (@divisionFK2 > 0 AND divs.DivisionPK = @divisionFK2)) OR (@customerFK2 > 0 AND cuss.CustomerPK = @customerFK2))	)
				
				 + @sp2
				PRINT @sp2
			Declare @SQL nvarchar(1000)

			IF @sp2 <> 'spStockDiscrepencyBlock'
				Set @SQL = 'EXEC ' +/* @externalDatabase + '.dbo.' +*/ @sp2 + ' @divisionFK = ' + cast(@divisionFK2 as nvarchar(100)) + ', @customerFK = ' 
					+ cast(@customerFK2 as nvarchar(100)) + ', @FK = ' + cast(@FK2 as nvarchar(100))
			ELSE
				Set @SQL = 'EXEC ' +/* @externalDatabase + '.dbo.' +*/ @sp2 + ' @stockDiscrepencyFK = ' + cast(@FK2 as nvarchar(100))
				
			Print @SQL
			EXEC(@SQL)

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end

			
			
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spIntegrationFileStockOutGetContainerOutLineDetails]
(
	@ContainerOutLineFK INT = -1
)
AS
BEGIN			
	IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#Results') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #Results

	-- Get non-nobatch line details

	SELECT 
		SUM(ISNULL(COLPC.Units,0)) AS QuantityPicked, SO.StockItemCode, COL.Batch, ISNULL(P.PalletStatusFK, -1) AS PalletStatusFK, IFSOL.FileBatch
	INTO 
		#Results
    FROM 
		dbo.tblIntegrationFileStockOutLines AS IFSOL
	INNER JOIN dbo.tblContainerOutLines AS COL
		ON IFSOL.ContainerOutLineFK = COL.ContainerOutLinePK
    LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.tblContainerOutLinePalletContent AS COLPC 
		ON COL.ContainerOutLinePK = COLPC.ContainerOutLineFK 
    LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.tblPallets AS P 
		ON COLPC.palletfk = P.palletpk
    LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.tblStockItems AS SO 
		ON COL.StockItemFK = SO.StockItemPK AND COL.DivisionFK = SO.DivisionFK
    LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.appPalletStatus AS PS 
		ON P.PalletStatusFK = PS.PalletStatusPK
    WHERE 
		COL.ContainerOutLinePK = @ContainerOutLineFK
		AND  ISNULL(IFSOL.FileBatch,'') NOT IN ('','NOBATCH')
    GROUP BY 
		SO.StockItemCode, COL.Batch, P.PalletStatusFK,IFSOL.FileBatch
				
	-- Get nobatch line details

	INSERT INTO #Results
	SELECT 
		SUM(ISNULL(COLPC.Units,0)) AS QuantityPicked, SO.StockItemCode, COL.Batch, ISNULL(P.PalletStatusFK, -1) AS PalletStatusFK, 'NOBATCH' AS FileBatch
    FROM 
		dbo.tblContainerOutLines AS COL
    LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.tblContainerOutLinePalletContent AS COLPC 
		ON COL.ContainerOutLinePK = COLPC.ContainerOutLineFK 
    LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.tblPallets AS P 
		ON COLPC.palletfk = P.palletpk
    LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.tblStockItems AS SO 
		ON COL.StockItemFK = SO.StockItemPK AND COL.DivisionFK = SO.DivisionFK
    LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.appPalletStatus AS PS 
		ON P.PalletStatusFK = PS.PalletStatusPK
    WHERE	
		COL.ContainerOutFK IN (
									SELECT CO.ContainerOutPK FROM tblContainerOuts AS CO 
									INNER JOIN dbo.tblContainerOutLines AS COL
									ON CO.ContainerOutPK = COL.ContainerOutFK
									WHERE COL.ContainerOutLinePK = @ContainerOutLineFK
								)
		AND NOT EXISTS -- Nobatch records
		(
			SELECT 1 FROM #Results AS T 
			WHERE COL.Batch = T.Batch
		) 
    GROUP BY 
		SO.StockItemCode, COL.Batch, P.PalletStatusFK

	-- Change batch value where there are multiple nobatch lines for the same stock code and pallet status but with different auto picked batch codes.

	UPDATE T
	SET 
		T.BATCH = 'MULTIBATCH'
	FROM 
		#Results AS T
	INNER JOIN (
					SELECT StockItemCode, PalletStatusFK, COUNT(StockItemCode + CAST(PalletStatusFK AS NVARCHAR(50))) AS SP
					FROM #Results WHERE FileBatch IN ('','NOBATCH') 
					GROUP BY StockItemCode, PalletStatusFK
					HAVING COUNT(StockItemCode + CAST(PalletStatusFK AS NVARCHAR(50))) > 1
				) AS M
		ON T.StockItemCode = M.StockItemCode
		AND T.PalletStatusFK = M.PalletStatusFK
	WHERE 
		T.FileBatch IN ('','NOBATCH') 

	-- Return the final results

	SELECT
		SUM(T.QuantityPicked) AS QuantityPicked, T.StockItemCode, T.Batch, T.PalletStatusFK					
	FROM 
		#Results AS T
	INNER JOIN dbo.tblIntegrationFileStockOutLines AS IFSOL
		ON T.StockItemCode = IFSOL.StockItemCode
		AND T.PalletStatusFK = IFSOL.STAWMSPalletStatusFK
	WHERE
		IFSOL.ContainerOutLineFK = @ContainerOutLineFK
	GROUP BY 
		T.StockItemCode, T.Batch, T.PalletStatusFK
END
GO

-- =========================================================================================================
-- Author:      Cathal OCuirrin
-- Create Date: 30 July 2018
-- Description: Returns stock item code, batch and pallet status of associated file stock out line records.
-- =========================================================================================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spIntegrationFileStockOutGetStockBatchPalletStatusDetails]
(
	@ContainerOutFK INT = -1
)
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT
	,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;
	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	DECLARE @var_ContainerOutFK INT = ISNULL(@ContainerOutFK,-1)

	SET @ParameterDetails = '@ContainerOutFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_ContainerOutFK AS NVARCHAR(100)),'')

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    --BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

		SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END

	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY	

			-- This stored procedures main code, excluding error handling - start			

			IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#T') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #T

			CREATE TABLE #T
			(
				IntegrationFileStockOutPK INT,	
				IntegrationFileStockOutLinePK INT,	
				SAPLineNo NVARCHAR(200),
				StockItemCode NVARCHAR(200),
				Batch NVARCHAR(200),
				[Status] NVARCHAR(200),	
				QtyOrdered DECIMAL(18,3),	
				QtyPicked DECIMAL(18,3),	
				Diff DECIMAL(18,3),	
				PickIsOk BIT,
				[Desc] NVARCHAR(500)
			)

			INSERT INTO #T
			EXEC dbo.spGvIntegrationFileStockOutPickDetails @var_ContainerOutFK

			SELECT 
				FL.StockItemCode, 
				FL.StockItemCode + '|' 
									+ (CASE WHEN ISNULL(FL.FileBatch ,'') IN ('', 'NOBATCH') THEN '' ELSE FL.FileBatch END) 
										+ '|' 
											+ CAST(FL.STAWMSPalletStatusFK AS NVARCHAR(50)) 
					AS StockBatchPalletStatusDetails
			FROM 
				#T AS T
			INNER JOIN dbo.tblIntegrationFileStockOutLines AS FL
				ON T.IntegrationFileStockOutLinePK = FL.IntegrationFileStockOutLinePK
			ORDER BY 
				 FL.StockItemCode ASC

			-- This stored procedures main code, excluding error handling - end

			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END

-- Create Date: 30 July 2018
-- Description: Updates FileStockOutLines details based on the associated container out lines details.
-- ====================================================================================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spIntegrationFileStockOutLinesUpdate]
(
	@ContainerOutFK INT,
	@UserFK INT
)
AS
BEGIN
	DECLARE @var_ContainerOutFK INT = ISNULL(@ContainerOutFK,-1), @var_UserFK INT = ISNULL(@UserFK,-1), @var_CurrentDate DATETIME, @var_CurrentDate2 DATETIME, @cnst_True BIT = 1, @cnst_False BIT = 0

	EXEC dbo.spGvIntegrationFileStockOutPickDetails @var_ContainerOutFK, @var_UserFK, 0

	RETURN
/*
	-- Get the xml file stock out line records.

	IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#FileStockOutLines') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #FileStockOutLines

	SELECT DISTINCT
		IFSOL.*,
		@cnst_False AS ExcludeRecord
	INTO
		#FileStockOutLines	
	FROM 
		dbo.tblIntegrationFileStockOuts AS IFSO
	INNER JOIN dbo.tblIntegrationFileStockOutLines AS IFSOL
		ON IFSO.IntegrationFileStockOutPK = IFSOL.IntegrationFileStockOutFK
	WHERE 
		IFSO.ContainerOutFK = @var_ContainerOutFK

	-- Get associated container out lines records.

	IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ContainerOutLines') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #ContainerOutLines

	SELECT 
		SO.StockItemCode, 
		COL.Batch, 
		ISNULL(P.PalletStatusFK, -1) AS PalletStatusFK, 
		SUM(ISNULL(COLPC.Units,0)) AS QuantityPicked,
		CAST(0 AS BIT) AS ExcludeRecord,
		CAST(0 AS BIT) AS NoBatchRecord
	INTO
		#ContainerOutLines
	FROM 
		dbo.tblContainerOuts AS CO
	INNER JOIN dbo.tblContainerOutLines AS COL 
		ON CO.ContainerOutPK = COL.ContainerOutFK
	LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.tblContainerOutLinePalletContent AS COLPC 
		ON COL.ContainerOutLinePK = COLPC.ContainerOutLineFK
	LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.tblPallets AS P 
		ON COLPC.palletfk = P.palletpk
	INNER JOIN dbo.tblStockItems AS SO 
		ON COL.StockItemFK = SO.StockItemPK AND COL.DivisionFK = SO.DivisionFK
	WHERE
		CO.ContainerOutPK = @var_ContainerOutFK
	GROUP BY 
		SO.StockItemCode, COL.Batch, P.PalletStatusFK

	-- Set the NoBatchRecord value where the container out line batches that do not match any of the xml file stock out line batch values.

	UPDATE COL WITH (ROWLOCK)
	SET 
		COL.NoBatchRecord = @cnst_True 
	FROM 
		#ContainerOutLines AS COL
	WHERE 
		NOT EXISTS
		(
			SELECT 1 FROM #FileStockOutLines AS FSOL
			WHERE FSOL.FileBatch NOT IN ('','NOBATCH')
			AND COL.BATCH = FSOL.FileBatch
		)

	-- Check for multiple batches with the same stock code and pallet status for NoBatchRecord records.

	IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ContainerOutLinesNoBatchesCount') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #ContainerOutLinesNoBatchesCount

	SELECT 
		COUNT(DISTINCT Batch) AS [COUNT(DISTINCT Batch)],
		StockItemCode, 
		PalletStatusFK, 
		QuantityPicked,
		ExcludeRecord,
		NoBatchRecord
	INTO
		#ContainerOutLinesNoBatchesCount
	FROM
		#ContainerOutLines
	WHERE
		NoBatchRecord = @cnst_True
	GROUP BY
		StockItemCode, 
		PalletStatusFK, 
		QuantityPicked,
		ExcludeRecord,
		NoBatchRecord
	HAVING
		COUNT(DISTINCT Batch) > 1

	-- If multiple batches with the same stock code and pallet status for NoBatchRecord records are found, sum them and effectively 
	-- "replace", via the values in the ExcludeRecord and NoBatchRecord columns, the exisitng records with the summed records.
	-- This method is faster than deleting records.

	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #ContainerOutLinesNoBatchesCount)
	BEGIN
		INSERT INTO #ContainerOutLines
		SELECT 
			COL.StockItemCode,
			'MULTBATCHES' AS Batch, 
			COL.PalletStatusFK, 
			SUM(COL.QuantityPicked) AS QuantityPicked,
			@cnst_False, --ExcludeRecord
			@cnst_True --NoBatchRecord
		FROM
			#ContainerOutLines AS COL
		INNER JOIN #ContainerOutLinesNoBatchesCount AS COLNBC
			ON COL.StockItemCode = COLNBC.StockItemCode
			AND COL.PalletStatusFK = COLNBC.PalletStatusFK
		WHERE
			COL.NoBatchRecord = @cnst_True
		GROUP BY
			COL.StockItemCode, 
			COL.PalletStatusFK, 
			COL.ExcludeRecord,
			COL.NoBatchRecord	

		UPDATE #ContainerOutLines 
		SET 
			ExcludeRecord = @cnst_True, 
			NoBatchRecord = @cnst_False 
		FROM 
			#ContainerOutLines COL
		INNER JOIN #ContainerOutLinesNoBatchesCount AS COLNBC
			ON COL.StockItemCode = COLNBC.StockItemCode
			AND COL.PalletStatusFK = COLNBC.PalletStatusFK
		WHERE 
			COL.NoBatchRecord = @cnst_True
			AND COL.Batch <> 'MULTBATCHES'								
	END

	-- Exclude where previous container out line values in the file stock out records match the current container out line record values, i.e. nothing has changed since last save.
	-- Again using exclude instead of deleting records as it is faster.

	UPDATE FSOL
	SET FSOL.ExcludeRecord = @cnst_True
	FROM #ContainerOutLines AS COL
	INNER JOIN #FileStockOutLines AS FSOL
	ON COL.StockItemCode = FSOL.COLStockItemCode
	AND ((COL.Batch = FSOL.COLBatch) OR COL.NoBatchRecord = @cnst_True)
	AND COL.PalletStatusFK = FSOL.COLPalletStatusFK
	AND COL.QuantityPicked = FSOL.COLQuantityPicked
	WHERE COL.ExcludeRecord = @cnst_False

	-- If no records left to check, go straight to the UpdatePermanentTable code section and skip over the rest of the code.
	IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #FileStockOutLines WHERE ExcludeRecord = @cnst_False) GOTO UpdatePermanentTable

	UPDATE COL
	SET COL.ExcludeRecord = @cnst_True
	FROM #ContainerOutLines AS COL
	INNER JOIN #FileStockOutLines AS FSOL
	ON COL.StockItemCode = FSOL.COLStockItemCode
	AND ((COL.Batch = FSOL.COLBatch) OR COL.NoBatchRecord = @cnst_True)
	AND COL.PalletStatusFK = FSOL.COLPalletStatusFK
	AND COL.QuantityPicked = FSOL.COLQuantityPicked
	WHERE COL.ExcludeRecord = @cnst_False
	AND FSOL.ExcludeRecord = @cnst_True

	-- Set values where current container out line record values match the file values in the file stock out records.

	UPDATE COL
	SET 
		COL.ExcludeRecord = @cnst_True
	FROM 
		#ContainerOutLines AS COL
	INNER JOIN #FileStockOutLines AS FSOL
		ON COL.StockItemCode = FSOL.StockItemCode		
		AND COL.PalletStatusFK = FSOL.STAWMSPalletStatusFK
	WHERE 
		COL.ExcludeRecord = @cnst_False
		AND
		(
			(
				COL.Batch = FSOL.FileBatch
				AND COL.NoBatchRecord = @cnst_False
				AND FSOL.FileBatch NOT IN ('','NOBATCH')
			)
			OR
			(
				COL.NoBatchRecord = @cnst_True
				AND FSOL.FileBatch IN ('','NOBATCH')
			)
		)

	UPDATE FSOL
	SET 
		FSOL.COLStockItemCode = COL.StockItemCode,
		FSOL.COLBatch = COL.Batch,
		FSOL.COLPalletStatusFK = COL.PalletStatusFK,
		FSOL.COLQuantityPicked = COL.QuantityPicked,
		FSOL.IssueDesc = '',
		FSOL.ExcludeRecord = @cnst_True
	FROM 
		#ContainerOutLines AS COL
	INNER JOIN #FileStockOutLines AS FSOL
		ON COL.StockItemCode = FSOL.StockItemCode		
		AND COL.PalletStatusFK = FSOL.STAWMSPalletStatusFK
	WHERE 
		COL.ExcludeRecord = @cnst_True
		AND
		(
			(
				COL.Batch = FSOL.FileBatch
				AND COL.NoBatchRecord = @cnst_False
				AND FSOL.FileBatch NOT IN ('','NOBATCH')
			)
			OR
			(
				COL.NoBatchRecord = @cnst_True
				AND FSOL.FileBatch IN ('','NOBATCH')
			)
		)

	-- If no records left to check, go straight to the UpdatePermanentTable code section and skip over the rest of the code.
	IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #FileStockOutLines WHERE ExcludeRecord = @cnst_False) GOTO UpdatePermanentTable

	-- Set values where there is no matching container out line record(s), e.g. the user deleted container out line(s).

	UPDATE FSOL WITH (ROWLOCK)
	SET 
		FSOL.ExcludeRecord = @cnst_True,
		FSOL.COLstockitemcode = '',
		FSOL.COLbatch = '',
		FSOL.COLpalletstatusfk = -1,
		FSOL.COLQuantityPicked = 0.000,
		FSOL.IssueDesc = 'No matching line(s)'
	FROM
		#FileStockOutLines AS FSOL
	WHERE 
		FSOL.ExcludeRecord = @cnst_False

UpdatePermanentTable:

	-- Set values for IssueDesc to reflect any changes in the data.

	UPDATE #FileStockOutLines
	SET 
		IssueDesc = CASE 
						WHEN QuantityOrdered <> COLQuantityPicked THEN 'QtyOrdered/Picked mismatch'
						WHEN StockItemCode <> COLStockItemCode THEN 'StockCode mismatch'
						WHEN FileBatch NOT IN ('','NOBATCH') AND FileBatch <> COLBatch THEN 'Batch mismatch'
						WHEN STAWMSPalletStatusFK <> COLPalletStatusFK THEN 'Status mismatch'
					END
	WHERE
		COLpalletstatusfk > 0
		AND COLQuantityPicked > 0.000

	UPDATE #FileStockOutLines
	SET
		IssueDesc = 'No matching line(s)'
	WHERE
		COLpalletstatusfk < 0
		AND COLQuantityPicked <= 0.000
		AND IssueDesc NOT IN ('No matching line(s)','QtyOrdered/Picked mismatch')

	-- Update the permanent integration file stock outs record values.

	BEGIN TRANSACTION

		UPDATE IFSOL WITH (ROWLOCK)
		SET 
			IFSOL.UpdatedDate = CASE 
									WHEN IFSOL.COLStockItemCode <> FSOL.COLStockItemCode OR IFSOL.COLBatch <> FSOL.COLBatch OR IFSOL.COLPalletStatusFK <> FSOL.COLPalletStatusFK OR IFSOL.COLQuantityPicked <> FSOL.COLQuantityPicked
									THEN dbo.GetBSTDate() 
									ELSE IFSOL.UpdatedDate 
								END,

			IFSOL.UpdatedBy = CASE 
								WHEN IFSOL.COLStockItemCode <> FSOL.COLStockItemCode OR IFSOL.COLBatch <> FSOL.COLBatch OR IFSOL.COLPalletStatusFK <> FSOL.COLPalletStatusFK OR IFSOL.COLQuantityPicked <> FSOL.COLQuantityPicked
								THEN @var_UserFK 
								ELSE IFSOL.UpdatedBy 
							END,
			IFSOL.COLstockitemcode = FSOL.COLstockitemcode,
			IFSOL.COLbatch = FSOL.COLbatch,
			IFSOL.COLpalletstatusfk = FSOL.COLpalletstatusfk,
			IFSOL.COLQuantityPicked = FSOL.COLQuantityPicked,
			IFSOL.PickIsOk = CASE 
									WHEN IFSOL.COLStockItemCode <> FSOL.COLStockItemCode OR IFSOL.COLBatch <> FSOL.COLBatch OR IFSOL.COLPalletStatusFK <> FSOL.COLPalletStatusFK OR IFSOL.COLQuantityPicked <> FSOL.COLQuantityPicked
									THEN @cnst_False 
									ELSE IFSOL.PickIsOk 
								END,
			IFSOL.IssueDesc = FSOL.IssueDesc
		FROM 
			dbo.tblIntegrationFileStockOuts AS IFSO
		INNER JOIN dbo.tblIntegrationFileStockOutLines AS IFSOL
			ON IFSO.IntegrationFileStockOutPK = IFSOL.IntegrationFileStockOutFK
		INNER JOIN #FileStockOutLines AS FSOL
			ON IFSOL.IntegrationFileStockOutLinePK = FSOL.IntegrationFileStockOutLinePK
		WHERE 
			IFSO.ContainerOutFK = @var_ContainerOutFK

	COMMIT TRANSACTION
*/
END
GO

-- =========================================================================================================================================
-- Author:      Cathal OCuirrin
-- Create Date: 30 July 2018
-- Description: Keeps the batches in the container out line records in sync with the batches in the associated file stock out line records.
-- =========================================================================================================================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spIntegrationFileStockOutUpdateBatches] 
(
	@ContainerOutFK INT = -1
)
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT
	,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;
	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	DECLARE @var_ContainerOutFK INT = ISNULL(@ContainerOutFK, -1)	

	SET @ParameterDetails = '@ContainerOutFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_ContainerOutFK AS NVARCHAR(100)),'')

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    --BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

		SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END

	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY	

			-- This stored procedures main code, excluding error handling - start	

			-- Check if any records, created by an xml file, have a batch = nobatch & update any found to use the batch 
			-- on the associated containeroutline record which was automatically set during the integration import.

			IF NOT EXISTS(	SELECT 1
							FROM tblIntegrationFileStockOutLines AS FileLines 
							INNER JOIN tblIntegrationFileStockOuts AS FileHeader
							ON FileLines.IntegrationFileStockOutFK = FileHeader.IntegrationFileStockOutPK
							WHERE FileHeader.ContainerOutFK = @var_ContainerOutFK	
							AND ISNULL(FileLines.COLBatch,'') IN ('', 'NOBATCH')
						)
				RETURN

			BEGIN TRANSACTION

				UPDATE FileLines WITH (ROWLOCK)
				SET 
					FileLines.COLBatch = COL.Batch
				FROM 
					tblIntegrationFileStockOutLines AS FileLines 
				INNER JOIN tblIntegrationFileStockOuts AS FileHeader
					ON FileLines.IntegrationFileStockOutFK = FileHeader.IntegrationFileStockOutPK
				INNER JOIN dbo.tblContainerOuts AS CO
					ON FileHeader.ContainerOutFK = CO.ContainerOutPK
				INNER JOIN dbo.tblContainerOutLines AS COL
					ON CO.ContainerOutPK = COL.ContainerOutFK
					AND COL.ContainerOutLinePK = FileLines.ContainerOutLineFK
				WHERE 
					FileHeader.ContainerOutFK = @var_ContainerOutFK
					AND ISNULL(FileLines.COLBatch,'') IN ('', 'NOBATCH')

			COMMIT TRANSACTION

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end

			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END
GO

-- ========================================================================================================
-- Author:      Cathal OCuirrin
-- Create Date: 30 July 2018
-- Description: Sets the PickIsOK value (1 or 0/true or false) in a particular file stock out line record.
-- ========================================================================================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spIntegrationFileStockOutUpdateFileLinesPickIsOk]
(
	@IntegrationFileStockOutPK INT = -1,
	@IntegrationFileStockOutLinePK INT = -1,
	@PickIsOK INT = 0,
	@UserFK INT = -1
)
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT
		,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;

	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	DECLARE @var_IntegrationFileStockOutPK INT = ISNULL(@IntegrationFileStockOutPK,-1), @var_IntegrationFileStockOutLinePK INT = ISNULL(@IntegrationFileStockOutLinePK,-1),
		@var_PickIsOK INT = ISNULL(@PickIsOK,0), @var_UserFK INT = ISNULL(@UserFK, -1)

	SET @ParameterDetails = '@IntegrationFileStockOutPK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_IntegrationFileStockOutPK AS NVARCHAR(100)),'')
		+ ',@IntegrationFileStockOutLinePK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_IntegrationFileStockOutLinePK AS NVARCHAR(100)),'')	
			+ ',@PickIsOK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_PickIsOK AS NVARCHAR(100)),'')	+ ',@UserFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_UserFK AS NVARCHAR(100)),'')	

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    --BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

		SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END

	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY	

			-- This stored procedures main code, excluding error handling - start	

		IF @var_IntegrationFileStockOutPK < 1 AND @var_IntegrationFileStockOutLinePK < 1 RETURN

		UPDATE FileLines WITH (ROWLOCK) 
		SET 
			FileLines.PickIsOk = @var_PickIsOK,
			FileLines.UpdatedBy = @var_UserFK,
			FileLines.UpdatedDate = dbo.GetBSTDate() 
		FROM 
			dbo.tblIntegrationFileStockOutLines AS FileLines
		INNER JOIN dbo.tblIntegrationFileStockOuts AS FileHeader
			ON FileLines.IntegrationFileStockOutFK = FileHeader.IntegrationFileStockOutPK
		WHERE
			(	/* Update a specific line record. */
				FileLines.IntegrationFileStockOutLinePK = @var_IntegrationFileStockOutLinePK 
				AND @var_IntegrationFileStockOutLinePK > 0
			)	
			OR
			(	/* Update all line records for a specific header record if var_IntegrationFileStockOutLinePK is not specified. */
				FileHeader.IntegrationFileStockOutPK = @var_IntegrationFileStockOutPK
				AND @var_IntegrationFileStockOutPK > 0
				AND @var_IntegrationFileStockOutLinePK < 1
			)

			-- This stored procedures main code, excluding error handling - end

			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END
GO

-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spIntegrationMonitoredMovements] 
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT
	,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;
	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	--DECLARE 

	SET @ParameterDetails = ''

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    --BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

		SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END

	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start

		--Jamie: optimised 26/07/2019
		--20 seconds per execution down to 1 second (unless there actually is some movements to export)
		IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#tempScrapMovements') IS NOT NULL
				DROP TABLE #tempScrapMovements

		Select DISTINCT WorksOrderPK, WorksOrderMovementPK, PalletFK
		INTO #tempScrapMovements
		From tblScrapLocations sls
		Inner join tblWorksOrderMovements woms on (woms.DestinationLocationTypeFK = sls.LocationTypeFK AND woms.DestinationFK = sls.LocationFK)
		Inner join tblWorksOrders wos on wos.WorksOrderPK = woms.WorksOrderFK
		WHERE wos.WorksOrderTypeFK = 3 /*Movement*/ AND wos.WorksOrderStatusFK = 3 /*Complete*/ AND wos.IntegrationStage10Flag = 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/

		Inner join tblStockItems sis on sis.StockItemPK = pc.StockItemFK

	--From tblScrapLocations sls
	--Inner join tblWorksOrderMovements woms on (woms.DestinationLocationTypeFK = sls.LocationTypeFK AND woms.DestinationFK = sls.LocationFK)
	--										--OR (woms.SourceLocationTypeFK = sls.LocationTypeFK AND woms.SourceLocationFK = sls.LocationFK)	--jamie : removed outward movement messages
	--Inner join tblWorksOrders wos on wos.WorksOrderPK = woms.WorksOrderFK
	--Inner join tblPallets pals on pals.PalletPK = woms.PalletFK
	--Inner join tblPalletContent pc on pc.PalletFK = pals.PalletPK
	--Inner join tblStockItems sis on sis.StockItemPK = pc.StockItemFK
	--Inner join tblDivisions divs on divs.DivisionPK = sis.DivisionFK

	--Where
	--wos.WorksOrderTypeFK = 3 /*Movement*/
	--AND
	--wos.WorksOrderStatusFK = 3 /*Complete*/
	--AND
	--wos.IntegrationStage10Flag = 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/
	--AND
	--divs.ExportScrapLocationMonitoredMovement = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/

	/*UNION ALL

	Select DISTINCT wos.WorksOrderPK, divs.DivisionPK
	From tblSampleLocations sls

	AND woms.DestinationFK = sls.SampleLocationPK)
	OR
	(woms.SourceLocationTypeFK = 6 /*SampleLocation*/
	AND woms.SourceLocationFK = sls.SampleLocationPK)
	Inner join tblWorksOrders wos on
	wos.WorksOrderPK = woms.WorksOrderFK
	Inner join tblPallets pals on
	pals.PalletPK = woms.PalletFK
	Inner join tblPalletContent pc on
	pc.PalletFK = pals.PalletPK
	Inner join tblStockItems sis on
	sis.StockItemPK = pc.StockItemFK
	Inner join tblDivisions divs on
	divs.DivisionPK = sis.DivisionFK

	Where
	wos.WorksOrderTypeFK = 3 /*Movement*/
	AND
	wos.WorksOrderStatusFK = 3 /*Complete*/
	AND
	wos.IntegrationStage10Flag = 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/
	AND
	divs.ExportSamplingLocationMonitoredMovement = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/*/

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end

			
			
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END

-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spIntegrationPalletAdditionalFieldSave]
(
	@stockItemFK int,
	@fieldNumber int,
	@palletFK int,
	@palletContentFK int,
	@value nvarchar(1000)
)	
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT
	,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;
	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	DECLARE @stockItemFK2 int, @fieldNumber2 int, @palletFK2 int, @palletContentFK2 int, @value2 nvarchar(1000)

	SET @stockItemFK2 = @stockItemFK; SET @fieldNumber2 = @fieldNumber; SET @palletFK2 = @palletFK; SET @palletContentFK2 = @palletContentFK; SET @value2 = @value

	SET @ParameterDetails = '@stockItemFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@stockItemFK2 AS NVARCHAR(20)),'') + ',@fieldNumber = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@fieldNumber2 AS NVARCHAR(20)),'')
		+ ',@palletFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@palletFK2 AS NVARCHAR(20)),'') + ',@palletContentFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@palletContentFK2 AS NVARCHAR(20)),'')
			+ ',@value = ' + ISNULL(@value2,'')

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    --BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

		SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END

	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY
			IF XACT_STATE() = 0 AND @@TRANCOUNT < 1 BEGIN TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start

			DECLARE @palletAdditionalFieldPK int

			Select Top 1 @palletAdditionalFieldPK = 
			CASE WHEN pafsForStockItems.PalletAdditionalFieldPK is not null THEN
				pafsForStockItems.PalletAdditionalFieldPK
			WHEN pafsForDivisions.PalletAdditionalFieldPK is not null THEN
				pafsForDivisions.PalletAdditionalFieldPK
			WHEN pafsForCustomers.PalletAdditionalFieldPK is not null THEN
				pafsForCustomers.PalletAdditionalFieldPK
			END 

			FROM tblStockItems sis 
			Inner join tblDivisions divs on
			divs.DivisionPK = sis.DivisionFK

			left outer join tblPalletAdditionalFields pafsForStockItems on
			pafsForStockItems.PalletAdditionalFieldTypeFK = 3/*StockItem*/
			AND pafsForStockItems.FK = @stockItemFK2 
			AND pafsForStockItems.FieldNumber = @fieldNumber2

			left outer join tblPalletAdditionalFields pafsForDivisions on
			pafsForDivisions.PalletAdditionalFieldTypeFK = 2/*Division*/
			AND pafsForDivisions.FK = sis.DivisionFK
			AND pafsForDivisions.FieldNumber = @fieldNumber2

			left outer join tblPalletAdditionalFields pafsForCustomers on
			pafsForCustomers.PalletAdditionalFieldTypeFK = 1/*Customer*/
			AND pafsForCustomers.FK = divs.CustomerFK
			AND pafsForCustomers.FieldNumber = @fieldNumber2

			Where sis.StockItemPK = @stockItemFK2

			--We have the PalletAdditionalFieldPK, so insert the value
			INSERT into tblPalletAdditionalFieldValues VALUES (
				@palletAdditionalFieldPK, @palletFK2, @palletContentFK2, @value2, 
				0/*cast(0 as bit)*/, 0, dbo.GetBSTDate(), 0, dbo.GetBSTDate()
			)

			select SCOPE_IDENTITY()
	    	
			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end

			BEGIN TRY IF XACT_STATE() = 1 AND @@TRANCOUNT = 1 AND @OpeningTranCount < 1 COMMIT TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH
			
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
