-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spIntegrationPalletStatusMasterQueued]
(
	@divisionFK int,
	@stockInFK int
)	
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT
	,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;
	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	DECLARE @divisionFK2 int, @stockInFK2 int

	SET @divisionFK2 = @divisionFK; SET @stockInFK2 = @stockInFK

	SET @ParameterDetails = '@divisionFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@divisionFK2 AS NVARCHAR(20)),'') + ',@stockInFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@stockInFK2 AS NVARCHAR(20)),'')

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    --BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

		SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END

	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY			

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start

			--Get the customerFK
PRINT 'STARTING '
PRINT (CONVERT( VARCHAR(24), dbo.GetBSTDate(), 121))
			Declare @exportPalletStatusMasterAck bit
			Declare @customerFK int
			Select @exportPalletStatusMasterAck = cus.ExportPalletStatusMasterAcknowledgements, @customerFK = cus.CustomerPK 
			from tblCustomers cus
			Inner join tblDivisions divs ON divs.CustomerFK = cus.CustomerPK
			Where divs.DivisionPK = @divisionFK2

PRINT 'GOT SETTINGS '
PRINT (CONVERT( VARCHAR(24), dbo.GetBSTDate(), 121))

			DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #tempstockinlines
			SELECT *
			INTO #tempstockinlines
			FROM tblStockInLines
			Where StockInFK = @stockInFK2

PRINT 'GOT STOCK IN LINES '
PRINT (CONVERT( VARCHAR(24), dbo.GetBSTDate(), 121))

			DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #tempstockinlinePallets
			SELECT silp.*
			INTO #tempstockinlinePallets
			FROM tblStockInLinePallets silp
			INNER JOIN #tempstockinlines ON StockInLineFK = StockInLinePK
			
PRINT 'GOT LINE PALLETS '
PRINT (CONVERT( VARCHAR(24), dbo.GetBSTDate(), 121))

			DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #tempPallets
			SELECT p.*
			INTO #tempPallets
			FROM tblpallets p
			INNER JOIN #tempstockinlinePallets ON PalletPK = PalletFK			
			WHERE p.CustomerBarcode <> ''

PRINT 'GOT PALLETS '
PRINT (CONVERT( VARCHAR(24), dbo.GetBSTDate(), 121))
						
			DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #tempStatusChanges
			SELECT ps.*
			INTO #tempStatusChanges
			FROM tblPalletStatusChanges ps
			INNER JOIN #tempPallets tp ON ps.CustomerBarcode = tp.CustomerBarcode 
			WHERE ps.Queue = 1
					
PRINT 'GOT STATUS CHANGES '
PRINT (CONVERT( VARCHAR(24), dbo.GetBSTDate(), 121))
	
		--	SELECT * FROM #tempStatusChanges

			DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #tempAdjustments
			SELECT sa.*
			INTO #tempAdjustments
			FROM tblStockAdjustments sa
			INNER JOIN #tempPallets tp ON sa.CustomerBarcodeBefore = tp.CustomerBarcode 
			WHERE sa.Queue = 1
			
PRINT 'GOT adjustments '
PRINT (CONVERT( VARCHAR(24), dbo.GetBSTDate(), 121))
	
		--	SELECT * FROM #tempAdjustments
			
			Select subq.*, @customerFK as CustomerFK, @exportPalletStatusMasterAck as ExportPalletStatusMasterAcknowledgement from (
				Select pscs.Reference, pscs.PalletStatusChangePK RecordPK, silps.PalletFK, pals.PalletStatusFK CurrentPalletStatusFK, 
				pscs.ToPalletStatusFK, pscs.Instruction, pscs.PalletStatusChangePK, -1 as StockAdjustmentPK, -1 as SpecialStockTypeAfterFK
				From #tempstockinlines AS sils
				Inner join #tempstockinlinePallets AS silps on silps.StockInLineFK = sils.StockInLinePK
				Inner join #tempPallets AS pals on pals.PalletPK = silps.PalletFK
				Inner join #tempStatusChanges AS pscs on pscs.CustomerBarcode = pals.CustomerBarcode

				UNION ALL

				Select sas.Reference, sas.StockAdjustmentPK RecordPK, silps.PalletFK, pals.PalletStatusFK as CurrentPalletStatusFK, -1 as ToPalletStatusFK, 
				'' as Instruction, -1 as PalletStatusChangePK, sas.StockAdjustmentPK, sas.SpecialStockTypeAfterFK
				From #tempstockinlines AS sils
				Inner join #tempstockinlinePallets AS silps on silps.StockInLineFK = sils.StockInLinePK
				Inner join #tempPallets AS pals on pals.PalletPK = silps.PalletFK
				Inner join #tempAdjustments AS sas on sas.CustomerBarcodeBefore = pals.CustomerBarcode 
			) AS subQ
	
			Order By

			--	'' as Instruction, -1 as PalletStatusChangePK, sas.StockAdjustmentPK, sas.SpecialStockTypeAfterFK
			--	From
			--	(Select * from tblStockInLines Where StockInFK = @stockInFK2) AS sils
			--	Inner join tblStockInLinePallets AS silps on

			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spIntegrationStockInLineBatch]
(
	@customerFK int,
	@FK int
)	
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT
	,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;
	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	DECLARE @customerFK2 int, @FK2 int

	SET @customerFK2 = @customerFK; SET @FK2 = @FK

	SET @ParameterDetails = '@customerFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@customerFK2 AS NVARCHAR(20)),'') + ',@FK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@FK2 AS NVARCHAR(20)),'')

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    --BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

		SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END

	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY			

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start

			Declare @batch nvarchar(200), @supplierBatch nvarchar(200)

			Select @batch = Batch, @supplierBatch = SupplierBatch from tblStockInLines
			Where StockInLinePK = @FK2

			if(@supplierBatch <> '')
				Select @batch + '|' + @supplierBatch 
			ELSE 
				Select @batch
		
			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end

			
			
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END

-- ====================================================================================================
-- Author:      Cathal OCuirrin
-- Create Date: 30 July 2018
-- Description: Updates FileStockOutLines details based on the associated container out lines details.
-- ====================================================================================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spIntegrationStockOrderSaveLineChanges]
(
	@ContainerOutFK INT,
	@UserFK INT
)
AS
BEGIN
	DECLARE @var_ContainerOutFK INT = ISNULL(@ContainerOutFK,-1), @var_UserFK INT = ISNULL(@UserFK,-1), @var_CurrentDate DATETIME, @var_CurrentDate2 DATETIME, @cnst_True BIT = 1, @cnst_False BIT = 0

	-- Get the xml file stock out line records.

	IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#FileStockOutLines') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #FileStockOutLines

	SELECT DISTINCT
		IFSOL.*,
		@cnst_False AS ExcludeRecord
	INTO
		#FileStockOutLines	
	FROM 
		dbo.tblIntegrationFileStockOuts AS IFSO
	INNER JOIN dbo.tblIntegrationFileStockOutLines AS IFSOL
		ON IFSO.IntegrationFileStockOutPK = IFSOL.IntegrationFileStockOutFK
	WHERE 
		IFSO.ContainerOutFK = @var_ContainerOutFK

	-- Get associated container out lines records.

	IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ContainerOutLines') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #ContainerOutLines

	SELECT 
		SO.StockItemCode, 
		COL.Batch, 
		ISNULL(P.PalletStatusFK, -1) AS PalletStatusFK, 
		SUM(ISNULL(COLPC.Units,0)) AS QuantityPicked,
		CAST(0 AS BIT) AS ExcludeRecord,
		CAST(0 AS BIT) AS NoBatchRecord
	INTO
		#ContainerOutLines
	FROM 
		dbo.tblContainerOuts AS CO
	INNER JOIN dbo.tblContainerOutLines AS COL 
		ON CO.ContainerOutPK = COL.ContainerOutFK
	LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.tblContainerOutLinePalletContent AS COLPC 
		ON COL.ContainerOutLinePK = COLPC.ContainerOutLineFK
	LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.tblPallets AS P 
		ON COLPC.palletfk = P.palletpk
	INNER JOIN dbo.tblStockItems AS SO 
		ON COL.StockItemFK = SO.StockItemPK AND COL.DivisionFK = SO.DivisionFK
	WHERE
		CO.ContainerOutPK = @var_ContainerOutFK
	GROUP BY 
		SO.StockItemCode, COL.Batch, P.PalletStatusFK

	-- Set the NoBatchRecord value where the container out line batches that do not match any of the xml file stock out line batch values.

	UPDATE COL WITH (ROWLOCK)
	SET 
		COL.NoBatchRecord = @cnst_True 
	FROM 
		#ContainerOutLines AS COL
	WHERE 
		NOT EXISTS
		(
			SELECT 1 FROM #FileStockOutLines AS FSOL
			WHERE FSOL.FileBatch NOT IN ('','NOBATCH')
			AND COL.BATCH = FSOL.FileBatch
		)

	-- Check for multiple batches with the same stock code and pallet status for NoBatchRecord records.

	IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ContainerOutLinesNoBatchesCount') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #ContainerOutLinesNoBatchesCount

	SELECT 
		COUNT(DISTINCT Batch) AS [COUNT(DISTINCT Batch)],
		StockItemCode, 
		PalletStatusFK, 
		QuantityPicked,
		ExcludeRecord,
		NoBatchRecord
	INTO
		#ContainerOutLinesNoBatchesCount
	FROM
		#ContainerOutLines
	WHERE
		NoBatchRecord = @cnst_True
	GROUP BY
		StockItemCode, 
		PalletStatusFK, 
		QuantityPicked,
		ExcludeRecord,
		NoBatchRecord
	HAVING
		COUNT(DISTINCT Batch) > 1

	-- If multiple batches with the same stock code and pallet status for NoBatchRecord records are found, sum them and effectively 
	-- "replace", via the values in the ExcludeRecord and NoBatchRecord columns, the exisitng records with the summed records.
	-- This method is faster than deleting records.

	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #ContainerOutLinesNoBatchesCount)
	BEGIN
		INSERT INTO #ContainerOutLines
		SELECT 
			COL.StockItemCode,
			'MULTBATCHES' AS Batch, 
			COL.PalletStatusFK, 
			SUM(COL.QuantityPicked) AS QuantityPicked,
			@cnst_False, --ExcludeRecord
			@cnst_True --NoBatchRecord
		FROM
			#ContainerOutLines AS COL
		INNER JOIN #ContainerOutLinesNoBatchesCount AS COLNBC
			ON COL.StockItemCode = COLNBC.StockItemCode
			AND COL.PalletStatusFK = COLNBC.PalletStatusFK
		WHERE
			COL.NoBatchRecord = @cnst_True
		GROUP BY
			COL.StockItemCode, 
			COL.PalletStatusFK, 
			COL.ExcludeRecord,
			COL.NoBatchRecord	

		UPDATE #ContainerOutLines 
		SET 
			ExcludeRecord = @cnst_True, 
			NoBatchRecord = @cnst_False 
		FROM 
			#ContainerOutLines COL
		INNER JOIN #ContainerOutLinesNoBatchesCount AS COLNBC
			ON COL.StockItemCode = COLNBC.StockItemCode
			AND COL.PalletStatusFK = COLNBC.PalletStatusFK
		WHERE 
			COL.NoBatchRecord = @cnst_True
			AND COL.Batch <> 'MULTBATCHES'								
	END

	-- Exclude where previous container out line values in the file stock out records match the current container out line record values, i.e. nothing has changed since last save.
	-- Again using exclude instead of deleting records as it is faster.

	UPDATE FSOL
	SET FSOL.ExcludeRecord = @cnst_True
	FROM #ContainerOutLines AS COL
	INNER JOIN #FileStockOutLines AS FSOL
	ON COL.StockItemCode = FSOL.COLStockItemCode
	AND COL.Batch = FSOL.COLBatch
	AND COL.PalletStatusFK = FSOL.COLPalletStatusFK
	AND COL.QuantityPicked = FSOL.COLQuantityPicked
	WHERE COL.ExcludeRecord = @cnst_False

	-- If no records left to check, go straight to the UpdatePermanentTable code section and skip over the rest of the code.
	IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #FileStockOutLines WHERE ExcludeRecord = @cnst_False) GOTO UpdatePermanentTable

	UPDATE COL
	SET COL.ExcludeRecord = @cnst_True
	FROM #ContainerOutLines AS COL
	INNER JOIN #FileStockOutLines AS FSOL
	ON COL.StockItemCode = FSOL.COLStockItemCode
	AND COL.Batch = FSOL.COLBatch
	AND COL.PalletStatusFK = FSOL.COLPalletStatusFK
	AND COL.QuantityPicked = FSOL.COLQuantityPicked
	WHERE COL.ExcludeRecord = @cnst_False
	AND FSOL.ExcludeRecord = @cnst_True

	-- Set values where current container out line record values match the file values in the file stock out records.

	UPDATE COL
	SET 
		COL.ExcludeRecord = @cnst_True
	FROM 
		#ContainerOutLines AS COL
	INNER JOIN #FileStockOutLines AS FSOL
		ON COL.StockItemCode = FSOL.StockItemCode		
		AND COL.PalletStatusFK = FSOL.STAWMSPalletStatusFK
	WHERE 
		COL.ExcludeRecord = @cnst_False
		AND
		(
			(
				COL.Batch = FSOL.FileBatch
				AND COL.NoBatchRecord = @cnst_False
				AND FSOL.FileBatch NOT IN ('','NOBATCH')
			)
			OR
			(
				COL.NoBatchRecord = @cnst_True
				AND FSOL.FileBatch IN ('','NOBATCH')
			)
		)

	UPDATE FSOL
	SET 
		FSOL.COLStockItemCode = COL.StockItemCode,
		FSOL.COLBatch = COL.Batch,
		FSOL.COLPalletStatusFK = COL.PalletStatusFK,
		FSOL.COLQuantityPicked = COL.QuantityPicked,
		FSOL.IssueDesc = '',
		FSOL.ExcludeRecord = @cnst_True
	FROM 
		#ContainerOutLines AS COL
	INNER JOIN #FileStockOutLines AS FSOL
		ON COL.StockItemCode = FSOL.StockItemCode		
		AND COL.PalletStatusFK = FSOL.STAWMSPalletStatusFK
	WHERE 
		COL.ExcludeRecord = @cnst_True
		AND
		(
			(
				COL.Batch = FSOL.FileBatch
				AND COL.NoBatchRecord = @cnst_False
				AND FSOL.FileBatch NOT IN ('','NOBATCH')
			)
			OR
			(
				COL.NoBatchRecord = @cnst_True
				AND FSOL.FileBatch IN ('','NOBATCH')
			)
		)

	-- If no records left to check, go straight to the UpdatePermanentTable code section and skip over the rest of the code.
	IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #FileStockOutLines WHERE ExcludeRecord = @cnst_False) GOTO UpdatePermanentTable

	-- Set values where there is no matching container out line record(s), e.g. the user deleted container out line(s).

	UPDATE FSOL WITH (ROWLOCK)
	SET 
		FSOL.ExcludeRecord = @cnst_True,
		FSOL.COLstockitemcode = '',
		FSOL.COLbatch = '',
		FSOL.COLpalletstatusfk = -1,
		FSOL.COLQuantityPicked = 0.000,
		FSOL.IssueDesc = 'No matching line(s)'
	FROM
		#FileStockOutLines AS FSOL
	WHERE 
		FSOL.ExcludeRecord = @cnst_False

UpdatePermanentTable:

	-- Set values for IssueDesc to reflect any changes in the data.

	UPDATE #FileStockOutLines
	SET 
		IssueDesc = CASE 
						WHEN QuantityOrdered <> COLQuantityPicked THEN 'QtyOrdered/Picked mismatch'
						WHEN StockItemCode <> COLStockItemCode THEN 'StockCode mismatch'
						WHEN FileBatch NOT IN ('','NOBATCH') AND FileBatch <> COLBatch THEN 'Batch mismatch'
						WHEN STAWMSPalletStatusFK <> COLPalletStatusFK THEN 'Status mismatch'
					END
	WHERE
		COLpalletstatusfk > 0
		AND COLQuantityPicked > 0.000

	UPDATE #FileStockOutLines
	SET
		IssueDesc = 'No matching line(s)'
	WHERE
		COLpalletstatusfk < 0
		AND COLQuantityPicked <= 0.000
		AND IssueDesc NOT IN ('No matching line(s)','QtyOrdered/Picked mismatch')

	-- Update the permanent integration file stock outs record values.

	BEGIN TRANSACTION

		UPDATE IFSOL WITH (ROWLOCK)
		SET 
			IFSOL.UpdatedDate = CASE 
									WHEN IFSOL.COLStockItemCode <> FSOL.COLStockItemCode OR IFSOL.COLBatch <> FSOL.COLBatch OR IFSOL.COLPalletStatusFK <> FSOL.COLPalletStatusFK OR IFSOL.COLQuantityPicked <> FSOL.COLQuantityPicked
									THEN dbo.GetBSTDate() 
									ELSE IFSOL.UpdatedDate 
								END,

			IFSOL.UpdatedBy = CASE 
								WHEN IFSOL.COLStockItemCode <> FSOL.COLStockItemCode OR IFSOL.COLBatch <> FSOL.COLBatch OR IFSOL.COLPalletStatusFK <> FSOL.COLPalletStatusFK OR IFSOL.COLQuantityPicked <> FSOL.COLQuantityPicked
								THEN @var_UserFK 
								ELSE IFSOL.UpdatedBy 
							END,
			IFSOL.COLstockitemcode = FSOL.COLstockitemcode,
			IFSOL.COLbatch = FSOL.COLbatch,
			IFSOL.COLpalletstatusfk = FSOL.COLpalletstatusfk,
			IFSOL.COLQuantityPicked = FSOL.COLQuantityPicked,
			IFSOL.PickIsOk = CASE 
									WHEN IFSOL.COLStockItemCode <> FSOL.COLStockItemCode OR IFSOL.COLBatch <> FSOL.COLBatch OR IFSOL.COLPalletStatusFK <> FSOL.COLPalletStatusFK OR IFSOL.COLQuantityPicked <> FSOL.COLQuantityPicked
									THEN @cnst_False 
									ELSE IFSOL.PickIsOk 
								END,
			IFSOL.IssueDesc = FSOL.IssueDesc
		FROM 
			dbo.tblIntegrationFileStockOuts AS IFSO
		INNER JOIN dbo.tblIntegrationFileStockOutLines AS IFSOL
			ON IFSO.IntegrationFileStockOutPK = IFSOL.IntegrationFileStockOutFK
		INNER JOIN #FileStockOutLines AS FSOL
			ON IFSOL.IntegrationFileStockOutLinePK = FSOL.IntegrationFileStockOutLinePK
		WHERE 
			IFSO.ContainerOutFK = @var_ContainerOutFK

	COMMIT TRANSACTION
END
GO

-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
--
-- Modify: Damien Gannon
---		   #DEV-990. Add Additional Parameter DeparmentFK

-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spInvoiceAddExtraLine]
(
	@InvoiceFK int,
	@Description nvarchar(500),
	@Units nvarchar(100),
	@UnitType nvarchar(100),
	@rate nvarchar(100),
	@Frequency nvarchar(100),
	@LineTypeFK int,
	@DivisionFK int,
	@BuildingUnitFK int,
	@DeparmentFK int = -1,
	@UserFK int
)	
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data; Ensure this proc has a low impact when executed */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED; SET DEADLOCK_PRIORITY LOW

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT
	,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;
	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	DECLARE @InvoiceFK2 int, @Description2 nvarchar(500), @Units2 nvarchar(100), @UnitType2 nvarchar(100), @rate2 nvarchar(100), @Frequency2 nvarchar(100),
	@LineTypeFK2 int, @DivisionFK2 int, @BuildingUnitFK2 int, @UserFK2 int, @var_DepartmentFK2 int

	SET @InvoiceFK2 = @InvoiceFK;
	SET @Description2 = @Description;
	SET @Units2 = @Units;
	SET @UnitType2 = @UnitType;
	SET @rate2 = @rate;
	SET @Frequency2 = @Frequency;
	SET @LineTypeFK2 = @LineTypeFK;
	SET @DivisionFK2 = @DivisionFK;
	SET @BuildingUnitFK2 = @BuildingUnitFK; 
	SET @var_DepartmentFK2 = @DeparmentFK; 
	SET @UserFK2 = @UserFK;



	SET @ParameterDetails = '@InvoiceFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@InvoiceFK2 AS NVARCHAR(20)),'') + ',@Description = ' + ISNULL(@Description2,'')
		+ ',@Units = ' + ISNULL(@Units2,'') 
		+ ',@UnitType = ' + ISNULL(@UnitType2,'') 
		+ ',@rate = ' + ISNULL(@rate2,'') 
		+ ',@Frequency = ' + ISNULL(@Frequency2,'')
		+ ',@LineTypeFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@LineTypeFK2 AS NVARCHAR(20)),'') 
		+ ',@DivisionFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@DivisionFK2 AS NVARCHAR(20)),'')
		+ ',@buildingUnitFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@BuildingUnitFK2 AS NVARCHAR(20)),'') 
		+ ',@DeparmentFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_DepartmentFK2 AS NVARCHAR(20)),'') 
		+ ',@UserFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@UserFK2 AS NVARCHAR(20)),'')

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    --BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

		SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK,-1)

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END

	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY			

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start

			-- Do not proceed if no division specified
			IF ISNULL(@DivisionFK2,-1) < 1 
			BEGIN
				SELECT -1 AS 'RESULT'
				RETURN
			END

			Declare @NominalCode nvarchar(50)
			Declare @VatCodeFK int
			Declare @TaxRate decimal(18, 3)
			Declare @Charge decimal(18, 3)
			Declare @RateCalc decimal (18, 3)

			--set rate without @ string
			set @RateCalc = REPLACE(@rate2,'@','')

			--calculate charge
			set @Charge = ROUND((CONVERT(decimal(18, 3), @Units2) * CONVERT(decimal(18, 3), @RateCalc)), 2)
	    	
			--get vat rate and divsion of existing invoice
			Select @taxRate = vatCodes.[Value], @vatCodeFK = divisions.VatCodeFK
			from tblDivisions divisions
			inner join tblVatCodes vatCodes on vatCodes.VatCodePK = divisions.VatCodeFK
			Where divisions.DivisionPK = @DivisionFK2				

			SET @VatCodeFK = ISNULL(@VatCodeFK,-1)
			SET @taxRate = ISNULL(@taxRate,0)
			SET @Charge = ISNULL(@Charge,0)

			--get NominalCode from line type
			Select @NominalCode = NominalCode from appInvoiceLineTypes where InvoiceLineTypePK = @LineTypeFK2

			SET @NominalCode = ISNULL(@NominalCode,'')

			-- Always attempt to begin a transaction before updating, inserting or deleting records in a permanent table
			IF XACT_STATE() = 0 AND @@TRANCOUNT < 1 BEGIN TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName

			--add new line
			insert into tblInvoiceLines
			values (@InvoiceFK2, 
					@divisionFK2, 
					@LineTypeFK2, 
					@BuildingUnitFK2,
					1, 
					@NominalCode, 
					@Charge, 
					@Description2, 
					@Units2, 
					@UnitType2, 
					@rate2, 
					@Frequency2, 
					@VatCodeFK, 
					@TaxRate,
					ROUND(((@taxRate/100) * @Charge),2),
					0/*cast(0 as bit)*/, 
					@UserFK2, 
					dbo.GetBSTDate(), 
					@UserFK2, 
					dbo.GetBSTDate(),
					@var_DepartmentFK2)

			--get total of charges and tax
			Declare @NewTotal decimal(18, 3)
			Declare @NewTotalTax decimal(18, 3)

			--Select @NewTotal = sum(Charge), @NewTotalTax = sum(Tax) 
			--from (
			--	Select * from (Select 0.00 as Charge, 0.00 as Tax) zeroStart
			--	UNION ALL
			--	Select Charge, Tax from tblInvoiceLines 
			--	Where InvoiceFK = @InvoiceFK2
			--) as subQ	


			-- #DEV-740
			SELECT @NewTotal = SUM(Charge), @NewTotalTax = SUM(Tax) 
			FROM (	SELECT * FROM (SELECT 0 AS Charge, 0 AS Tax) AS zeroStart
					UNION ALL
					SELECT Sum(Charge) As Charge, (Sum (Charge)*(TaxRate/100)) As Tax
						From tblInvoiceLines
						Where InvoiceFK = @invoiceFK
						Group By TaxRate
				) AS subQ


			SET @NewTotal = ISNULL(@NewTotal,0)
			SET @NewTotalTax = ISNULL(@NewTotalTax,0)

			-- Always attempt to begin a transaction before updating, inserting or deleting records in a permanent table
			IF XACT_STATE() = 0 AND @@TRANCOUNT < 1 BEGIN TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName

			--update invoice with new totals
			UPDATE tblinvoices WITH (ROWLOCK) 
			SET charge = @NewTotal, 
				tax = @NewTotalTax, 
				updatedby = @UserFK2, 
				updateddate = dbo.GetBSTDate() 
			WHERE invoicepk = @InvoiceFK2

			--return 1 if all ok
			select 1 as 'RESULT'

			-- Always attempt to commit before returning/exiting the proc
			BEGIN TRY IF XACT_STATE() = 1 AND @@TRANCOUNT = 1 AND @OpeningTranCount < 1 COMMIT TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH			
			
			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end
			
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END
GO

-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spInvoiceApplyMinimumInvoiceCharge]
(
	@invoicePK int,
	@minimumInvoiceCharge decimal(18,3)
)	
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data; Ensure this proc has a low impact when executed */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED; SET DEADLOCK_PRIORITY LOW

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT
	,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;
	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	DECLARE @invoicePK2 int, @minimumInvoiceCharge2 decimal(18,3)

	SET @invoicePK2 = @invoicePK; SET @minimumInvoiceCharge2 = @minimumInvoiceCharge

	SET @ParameterDetails = '@invoicePK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@invoicePK2 AS NVARCHAR(20)),'') + ',@minimumInvoiceCharge = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@minimumInvoiceCharge2 AS NVARCHAR(30)),'')

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    --BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

		SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK,-1)

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END

	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY
			IF XACT_STATE() = 0 AND @@TRANCOUNT < 1 BEGIN TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start

			DECLARE @firstStorageInvoiceLinePK int
			DECLARE @taxRate decimal(18,3)
			Select Top 1 @firstStorageInvoiceLinePK = InvoiceLinePK,
			@taxRate = TaxRate 
			from tblInvoiceLines 
			where InvoiceFK = @invoicePK2
			AND InvoiceLineTypeFK = 1 /*Storage*/
			Order By InvoiceLinePK asc

			--UPDATE ONE LINE FOR THE CHARGE
			UPDATE tblInvoiceLines WITH (ROWLOCK)
			SET ChargeText3 = cast(@minimumInvoiceCharge2 as nvarchar(100)),
			ChargeText4 = 'Minimum Invoice Charge',
			Charge = @minimumInvoiceCharge2,
			Tax = @minimumInvoiceCharge2 * (@taxRate / 100)
			Where InvoiceLinePK = @firstStorageInvoiceLinePK

			--UPDATE/ZERO ALL OTHER INVOICE CHARGES EXCEPT FOR THE ONE WE CHANGED
			update tblInvoiceLines WITH (ROWLOCK)
			Set Charge = 0,
			Tax = 0,
			ChargeText3 = '@ 0.00'
			Where InvoiceFK = @invoicePK2
			AND InvoiceLinePK <> @firstStorageInvoiceLinePK

			--NOW UPDATE THE INVOICE TO THE NEW TOTALS
			Declare @invoiceTotal decimal(18,3)
			Declare @invoiceTaxTotal decimal(18,3)
			Select @invoiceTotal = sum(Charge), @invoiceTaxTotal = sum(Tax)
			from tblInvoiceLines
			Where InvoiceFK = @invoicePK2

			UPDATE tblInvoices WITH (ROWLOCK)
			Set Charge = @invoiceTotal,
			Tax = @invoiceTaxTotal
			Where InvoicePK = @invoicePK2

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end

			BEGIN TRY IF XACT_STATE() = 1 AND @@TRANCOUNT = 1 AND @OpeningTranCount < 1 COMMIT TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH
			
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END
GO

	@minimumStorageCharge decimal(18,3)
)	
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data; Ensure this proc has a low impact when executed */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED; SET DEADLOCK_PRIORITY LOW

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT
	,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;
	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	DECLARE @invoicePK2 int, @minimumStorageCharge2 decimal(18,3)

	SET @invoicePK2 = @invoicePK; SET @minimumStorageCharge2 = @minimumStorageCharge

	SET @ParameterDetails = '@invoicePK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@invoicePK2 AS NVARCHAR(20)),'') + ',@minimumStorageCharge = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@minimumStorageCharge2 AS NVARCHAR(30)),'')

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    --BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

		SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK,-1)

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END

	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY
			IF XACT_STATE() = 0 AND @@TRANCOUNT < 1 BEGIN TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName

			DECLARE @firstStorageInvoiceLinePK int
			DECLARE @taxRate decimal(18,3)
			Select Top 1 @firstStorageInvoiceLinePK = InvoiceLinePK,
			@taxRate = TaxRate 
			from tblInvoiceLines 
			where InvoiceFK = @invoicePK2
			AND InvoiceLineTypeFK = 1 /*Storage*/
			Order By InvoiceLinePK asc

			--UPDATE ONE LINE FOR THE CHARGE
			UPDATE tblInvoiceLines WITH (ROWLOCK)
			SET ChargeText3 = cast(@minimumStorageCharge2 as nvarchar(100)),
			ChargeText4 = 'Minimum Storage Charge',
			Charge = @minimumStorageCharge2,
			Tax = @minimumStorageCharge2 * (@taxRate / 100)
			Where InvoiceLinePK = @firstStorageInvoiceLinePK

			--UPDATE/ZERO ALL OTHER STORAGE CHARGES EXCEPT FOR THE ONE WE CHANGED
			update tblInvoiceLines WITH (ROWLOCK)
			Set Charge = 0,
			Tax = 0,
			ChargeText3 = '@ 0.00'
			Where InvoiceFK = @invoicePK2
			AND InvoiceLineTypeFK = 1/*Storage*/
			AND InvoiceLinePK <> @firstStorageInvoiceLinePK

			--NOW UPDATE THE INVOICE TO THE NEW TOTALS
			Declare @invoiceTotal decimal(18,3)
			Declare @invoiceTaxTotal decimal(18,3)
			Select @invoiceTotal = sum(Charge), @invoiceTaxTotal = sum(Tax)
			from tblInvoiceLines
			Where InvoiceFK = @invoicePK2

			UPDATE tblInvoices WITH (ROWLOCK)
			Set Charge = @invoiceTotal,
			Tax = @invoiceTaxTotal
			Where InvoicePK = @invoicePK2

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end

			BEGIN TRY IF XACT_STATE() = 1 AND @@TRANCOUNT = 1 AND @OpeningTranCount < 1 COMMIT TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH
			
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END

-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spInvoiceCheck]
(
	@divisionFK int = -1,
	@customerFK int = -1,
	@invoiceTo datetime,
	@options int,
	@divisions VARCHAR(2000) = ''
)
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data; Ensure this proc has a low impact when executed */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED; SET DEADLOCK_PRIORITY LOW

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT
	,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;
	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	DECLARE @divisionFK2 int, @customerFK2 int, @invoiceTo2 datetime, @options2 int, @divisions2 VARCHAR(2000)

	SET @divisionFK2 = @divisionFK; SET @customerFK2 = @customerFK; SET @invoiceTo2 = @invoiceTo; SET @options2 = @options; SET @divisions2 = @divisions

	SET @ParameterDetails = '@divisionFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@divisionFK2 AS NVARCHAR(20)),'') + ',@customerFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@customerFK2 AS NVARCHAR(20)),'')
		+ ',@invoiceTo = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@invoiceTo2 AS NVARCHAR(30)),'') + ',@options = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@options2 AS NVARCHAR(20)),'')
			+ ',@divisions = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@divisions2 AS NVARCHAR(2000)),'')

	IF ISNULL(@divisions2,'-1') NOT IN ('-1','') 
	BEGIN 
		SET @divisionFK = -1
		SELECT @divisions2 = '''' + REPLACE(@divisions2,',',''',''') + ''''
	END

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    --BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

		SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK,-1)

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END

	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY			

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start

			-- Ensure all invoices have valid invoice numbers
			IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM dbo.tblInvoices WHERE ISNULL(InvoiceNumber,'') = '')
			BEGIN			
				DECLARE @InvoicePK INT, @InvoiceNumber NVARCHAR(200) = ''					

				DECLARE InvoiceCursor CURSOR FAST_FORWARD FOR 
					SELECT InvoicePK FROM dbo.tblInvoices WHERE ISNULL(InvoiceNumber,'') = '' ORDER BY InvoicePK ASC
		
				OPEN InvoiceCursor

				FETCH NEXT FROM InvoiceCursor INTO @InvoicePK				

				IF XACT_STATE() = 0 AND @@TRANCOUNT < 1 BEGIN TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName

				WHILE (@@FETCH_STATUS = 0) 
				BEGIN	
					-- Get the temporary invoice number from the appSystem table. 
					-- Lock the table to ensure no other code changes this value until this stored procedure has finished executing.
					SELECT @InvoiceNumber = 'TMP' + CAST(NextInvoiceTempNumber AS NVARCHAR(200)) FROM dbo.appSystem WITH (ROWLOCK)					

					-- Increment the value in the appSystem table.
					UPDATE dbo.appSystem WITH (ROWLOCK)
					SET NextInvoiceTempNumber = NextInvoiceTempNumber + 1

					-- Add the temporary invoice number to the specific row in the tblInvoices table.
					UPDATE dbo.tblInvoices WITH (ROWLOCK)
					SET InvoiceNumber = @InvoiceNumber
					WHERE InvoicePK = @InvoicePK
						
					FETCH NEXT FROM InvoiceCursor INTO @InvoicePK
				END

				CLOSE InvoiceCursor
				DEALLOCATE InvoiceCursor							
			END

			Declare @ret int
			Set @ret = 0

			Declare @lastStorage datetime
			Declare @lastExtraService datetime
			Declare @lastDistributionCharge datetime

			IF(@divisionFK2 <> -1 OR ISNULL(@divisions2,'-1') NOT IN ('-1','')) 
			BEGIN
				IF(@options2 & 2 = 2) 
				BEGIN --STORAGE
					Select Top 1 @lastStorage = InvoiceToDate 
					from tblInvoices invs
					left outer join tblInvoiceLines invls on
					invls.InvoiceFK = invs.InvoicePK
					Where (invls.DivisionFK = @divisionFK2 OR CharIndex('''' + Cast(invls.DivisionFK As Varchar(2000)) + '''', @divisions2) > 0)
					AND Options & 2 = 2
					Order by InvoiceToDate Desc

					IF @lastStorage IS NULL -- Always include in final result if InvoiceToDate is null
						Set @ret = 2 
					ELSE IF(convert(varchar(50), @lastStorage, 112) < convert(varchar(50), dbo.GetBSTDate(), 112))
						Set @ret = 2 
				END

				IF(@options2 & 4 = 4) 
				BEGIN --EXTRA SERVICES
					Select Top 1 @lastExtraService = InvoiceToDate 
					from tblInvoices invs
					left outer join tblInvoiceLines invls on
					invls.InvoiceFK = invs.InvoicePK
					Where (invls.DivisionFK = @divisionFK2 OR CharIndex('''' + Cast(invls.DivisionFK As Varchar(2000)) + '''', @divisions2) > 0)
					AND Options & 4 = 4
					Order by InvoiceToDate Desc

					IF @lastExtraService IS NULL -- Always include in final result if InvoiceToDate is null
						Set @ret = @ret  + 4
					ELSE IF(Select count(*) from tblExtraServices ess
					where convert(varchar(50), ess.ExtraServiceDate, 112) > convert(varchar(50), @lastExtraService, 112)
					AND convert(varchar(50), ess.ExtraServiceDate, 112) <= convert(varchar(50), @invoiceTo2, 112)
					AND (DivisionFK = @divisionFK2 OR CharIndex('''' + Cast(DivisionFK As Varchar(2000)) + '''', @divisions2) > 0)
					) > 0
						Set @ret = @ret  + 4
				END

				IF(@options2 & 8 = 8) 
				BEGIN --DISTRIBUTION CHARGES
					Select Top 1 @lastDistributionCharge = InvoiceToDate 
					from tblInvoices invs
					left outer join tblInvoiceLines invls on
					invls.InvoiceFK = invs.InvoicePK
					Where (invls.DivisionFK = @divisionFK2 OR CharIndex('''' + Cast(invls.DivisionFK As Varchar(2000)) + '''', @divisions2) > 0)
					AND Options & 8 = 8
					Order by InvoiceToDate Desc

					IF @lastDistributionCharge IS NULL -- Always include in final result if InvoiceToDate is null
						SET @ret = @ret + 8
					ELSE
					BEGIN
						-- Cathal OCuirrin 22 Jan 2018 - start.

						IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ContainerDetails') IS NOT NULL
							DROP TABLE #ContainerDetails

						SELECT @lastDistributionCharge = DATEADD(DAY,-1,@lastDistributionCharge)

						Select distinct cols.DivisionFK, CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(50), codcs.InsertedDate, 112) AS DATETIME) AS InsertedDate
						INTO #ContainerDetails
						FROM tblContainerOutDistributionCharges AS codcs
						INNER JOIN tblContainerOutLines AS cols 
						ON cols.ContainerOutFK = codcs.ContainerOutFK
						WHERE codcs.InsertedDate > @lastDistributionCharge
						AND codcs.InsertedDate <=  @invoiceTo2
						AND (cols.DivisionFK = @divisionFK2 OR CharIndex('''' + Cast(cols.DivisionFK As Varchar(2000)) + '''', @divisions2) > 0)

						SELECT @lastDistributionCharge = DATEADD(DAY,1,@lastDistributionCharge)

						IF EXISTS(	SELECT * FROM #ContainerDetails
									WHERE InsertedDate > @lastDistributionCharge
									AND InsertedDate <= @invoiceTo2
								)
							SET @ret = @ret + 8

						-- Cathal OCuirrin 22 Jan 2018 - end.
					END
				END

				IF(@options2 & 16 = 16) --RECURRING CHARGES						
					Set @ret = @ret + 16 --NO CHECK, IF THE USER WANTS THE RECURRING CHARGE, IT WILL BE MADE
			END 
			ELSE IF(@customerFK2 <> -1) 
			BEGIN--End Diviion Code
				IF(@options2 & 2 = 2) 
				BEGIN --STORAGE
					Select Top 1 @lastStorage = InvoiceToDate 
					from tblInvoices
					Where CustomerFK = @customerFK2
					AND Options & 2 = 2
					Order by InvoiceToDate Desc

					IF @lastStorage IS NULL -- Always include in final result if InvoiceToDate is null
						Set @ret = 2
					ELSE if(convert(varchar(50), @lastStorage, 112) < convert(varchar(50), dbo.GetBSTDate(), 112) 
					AND (Select count(*) from tblPallets pallets inner join tblPalletContent pc on pc.PalletFK = pallets.PalletPK
					inner join tblStockItems sis on sis.StockItemPK = pc.StockItemFK
					Where sis.DivisionFK IN (Select DivisionPK from tblDivisions where CustomerFK = @customerFK2)) > 0)
						Set @ret = 2
				END

				if(@options2 & 4 = 4) --EXTRA SERVICES
				BEGIN
					Select Top 1 @lastExtraService = InvoiceToDate 
					from tblInvoices
					Where CustomerFK = @customerFK2
					AND Options & 4 = 4
					Order by InvoiceToDate Desc

					IF @lastExtraService IS NULL -- Always include in final result if InvoiceToDate is null
						Set @ret = @ret  + 4
					ELSE if(Select count(*) from tblExtraServices ess
					where convert(varchar(50), ess.ExtraServiceDate, 112) > convert(varchar(50), @lastExtraService, 112)
					AND convert(varchar(50), ess.ExtraServiceDate, 112) <= convert(varchar(50), @invoiceTo2, 112)
					AND DivisionFK IN (Select DivisionPK from tblDivisions where CustomerFK = @customerFK2)) > 0
						Set @ret = @ret  + 4
				END

				IF(@options2 & 8 = 8) 
				BEGIN --DISTRIBUTION CHARGES	
					Select Top 1 @lastDistributionCharge = InvoiceToDate 
					from tblInvoices
					Where (DivisionFK = @divisionFK2 OR CharIndex('''' + Cast(DivisionFK As Varchar(2000)) + '''', @divisions2) > 0)
					AND Options & 8 = 8
					Order by InvoiceToDate Desc

					IF @lastDistributionCharge IS NULL -- Always include in final result if InvoiceToDate is null
						Set @ret = @ret + 8
					ELSE IF(Select count(*) from tblContainerOutDistributionCharges codcs
					inner join tblContainerOutLines cols on cols.ContainerOutFK = codcs.ContainerOutFK
					Where convert(varchar(50), codcs.InsertedDate, 112) > convert(varchar(50), @lastDistributionCharge, 112)
					AND convert(varchar(50), codcs.InsertedDate, 112) <= convert(varchar(50), @invoiceTo2, 112)
					AND cols.DivisionFK IN (Select DivisionPK from tblDivisions where CustomerFK = @customerFK2)
					) > 0
						Set @ret = @ret + 8
				END

				IF(@options2 & 16 = 16) --RECURRING CHARGES					
					Set @ret = @ret + 16 --NO CHECK, IF THE USER WANTS THE RECURRING CHARGE, IT WILL BE MADE
			END

			Select @ret

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end
						
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END

	@StorageCharge int,
	@ExtraServicesCharge int,
	@DistributionCharge int,
	@RecurringCharge int

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT

	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters

	DECLARE @StorageCharge2 int, @ExtraServicesCharge2 int, @DistributionCharge2 int, @RecurringCharge2 bit

	SET @divisionFK2 = @divisionFK;

	SET @invoiceTo2 = @invoiceTo; 
	SET @StorageCharge2 = @StorageCharge; 
	SET @ExtraServicesCharge2 = @ExtraServicesCharge; 
	SET @DistributionCharge2 = @DistributionCharge; 
	SET @RecurringCharge2 = @RecurringCharge; 


	SET @ParameterDetails = '@divisionFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@divisionFK2 AS NVARCHAR(20)),'') +
							',@customerFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@customerFK2 AS NVARCHAR(20)),'') +
							',@invoiceTo = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@invoiceTo2 AS NVARCHAR(30)),'') +
							',@StorageCharge = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@StorageCharge2 AS NVARCHAR(30)),'') +
							',@ExtraServicesCharge = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@ExtraServicesCharge2 AS NVARCHAR(30)),'') +
							',@DistributionCharge = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@DistributionCharge2 AS NVARCHAR(30)),'') +
							',@RecurringCharge = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@RecurringCharge AS NVARCHAR(30)),'') 

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    --BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

		SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK,-1)

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END

	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY			

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start

			-- Ensure all invoices have valid invoice numbers
			IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM dbo.tblInvoices WHERE ISNULL(InvoiceNumber,'') = '')
			BEGIN			
				DECLARE @InvoicePK INT, @InvoiceNumber NVARCHAR(200) = ''					

				DECLARE InvoiceCursor CURSOR FAST_FORWARD FOR 
					SELECT InvoicePK FROM dbo.tblInvoices WHERE ISNULL(InvoiceNumber,'') = '' ORDER BY InvoicePK ASC
		
				OPEN InvoiceCursor

				FETCH NEXT FROM InvoiceCursor INTO @InvoicePK				

				IF XACT_STATE() = 0 AND @@TRANCOUNT < 1 BEGIN TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName

				WHILE (@@FETCH_STATUS = 0) 
				BEGIN	
					-- Get the temporary invoice number from the appSystem table. 
					-- Lock the table to ensure no other code changes this value until this stored procedure has finished executing.
					SELECT @InvoiceNumber = 'TMP' + CAST(NextInvoiceTempNumber AS NVARCHAR(200)) FROM dbo.appSystem WITH (ROWLOCK)					

					-- Increment the value in the appSystem table.
					UPDATE dbo.appSystem WITH (ROWLOCK)
					SET NextInvoiceTempNumber = NextInvoiceTempNumber + 1

					-- Add the temporary invoice number to the specific row in the tblInvoices table.
					UPDATE dbo.tblInvoices WITH (ROWLOCK)
					SET InvoiceNumber = @InvoiceNumber
					WHERE InvoicePK = @InvoicePK
						
					FETCH NEXT FROM InvoiceCursor INTO @InvoicePK
				END

				CLOSE InvoiceCursor
				DEALLOCATE InvoiceCursor							
			END

			Declare @Storage int = 0
			Declare @ExtraServices int = 0
			Declare @Distribution int = 0
			Declare @Recurring int = 0


			Declare @lastStorage datetime
			Declare @lastExtraService datetime
			Declare @lastDistributionCharge datetime

			IF(@divisionFK2 <> -1) 
			BEGIN
				IF(@StorageCharge2 = 1) 
				BEGIN --STORAGE
					Select Top 1 @lastStorage = InvoiceToDate 
					from tblInvoices invs
					left outer join tblInvoiceLines invls on
					invls.InvoiceFK = invs.InvoicePK
					Where (invls.DivisionFK = @divisionFK2)
					--AND Options & 2 = 2
					AND invs.StorageCharges = 1
					Order by InvoiceToDate Desc

					IF @lastStorage IS NULL -- Always include in final result if InvoiceToDate is null
						Set @Storage = 1 
					ELSE IF(convert(varchar(50), @lastStorage, 112) < convert(varchar(50), dbo.GetBSTDate(), 112))
						Set @Storage = 1 
				END

				IF(@ExtraServicesCharge2 = 1) 
				BEGIN --EXTRA SERVICES
					Select Top 1 @lastExtraService = InvoiceToDate 
					from tblInvoices invs
					left outer join tblInvoiceLines invls on
					invls.InvoiceFK = invs.InvoicePK
					Where (invls.DivisionFK = @divisionFK2)
					--AND Options & 4 = 4
					AND invs.ExtraServicesCharges = 1
					Order by InvoiceToDate Desc

					IF @lastExtraService IS NULL -- Always include in final result if InvoiceToDate is null
						Set @ExtraServices = 1
					ELSE IF(Select count(*) From tblExtraServices ess
							Where convert(varchar(50), ess.ExtraServiceDate, 112) > convert(varchar(50), @lastExtraService, 112)
								  AND convert(varchar(50), ess.ExtraServiceDate, 112) <= convert(varchar(50), @invoiceTo2, 112)
								  AND (DivisionFK = @divisionFK2) ) > 0
						Set @ExtraServices = 1
				END

				IF(@DistributionCharge2 = 1) 
				BEGIN --DISTRIBUTION CHARGES
					Select Top 1 @lastDistributionCharge = InvoiceToDate 
					from tblInvoices invs
					left outer join tblInvoiceLines invls on
					invls.InvoiceFK = invs.InvoicePK
					Where (invls.DivisionFK = @divisionFK2)
					--AND Options & 8 = 8
					AND invs.DistributionCharges = 1
					Order by InvoiceToDate Desc

					IF @lastDistributionCharge IS NULL -- Always include in final result if InvoiceToDate is null
						SET @Distribution = 1
					ELSE
					BEGIN
						-- Cathal OCuirrin 22 Jan 2018 - start.

						IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ContainerDetails') IS NOT NULL
							DROP TABLE #ContainerDetails

						SELECT @lastDistributionCharge = DATEADD(DAY,-1, @lastDistributionCharge)

						Select distinct cols.DivisionFK, CAST(CONVERT(VARCHAR(50), codcs.InsertedDate, 112) AS DATETIME) AS InsertedDate
						INTO #ContainerDetails
						FROM tblContainerOutDistributionCharges AS codcs
						INNER JOIN tblContainerOutLines AS cols 
						ON cols.ContainerOutFK = codcs.ContainerOutFK
						WHERE codcs.InsertedDate > @lastDistributionCharge
						AND codcs.InsertedDate <=  @invoiceTo2
						AND (cols.DivisionFK = @divisionFK2)

						SELECT @lastDistributionCharge = DATEADD(DAY,1,@lastDistributionCharge)

						IF EXISTS(	SELECT * FROM #ContainerDetails
									WHERE InsertedDate > @lastDistributionCharge
									AND InsertedDate <= @invoiceTo2
								)
							SET @Distribution = 1

							-- DISTRIBITION NOT IMPLEMENTED as of 26 Mar 2021
							SET @Distribution = 0

						-- Cathal OCuirrin 22 Jan 2018 - end.
					END
				END

				IF(@RecurringCharge2 = 1) --RECURRING CHARGES						
					Set @Recurring = 1	 --NO CHECK, IF THE USER WANTS THE RECURRING CHARGE, IT WILL BE MADE
			END 
			ELSE IF(@customerFK2 <> -1)
			BEGIN
				IF(@StorageCharge2 = 1) 
				BEGIN --STORAGE
					Select Top 1 @lastStorage = InvoiceToDate 
					From tblInvoices
					Where CustomerFK = @customerFK2
					--AND Options & 2 = 2
					AND tblInvoices.StorageCharges = 1
					Order by tblInvoices.InvoiceToDate Desc

					IF @lastStorage IS NULL -- Always include in final result if InvoiceToDate is null
						Set @Storage = 1
					ELSE IF (convert(varchar(50), @lastStorage, 112) < convert(varchar(50), dbo.GetBSTDate(), 112) 
							AND (Select count(*) 
								 From tblPallets pallets INNER JOIN tblPalletContent pc on pc.PalletFK = pallets.PalletPK
														 INNER JOIN tblStockItems sis on sis.StockItemPK = pc.StockItemFK
								 Where sis.DivisionFK IN (Select DivisionPK From tblDivisions where CustomerFK = @customerFK2)) > 0)
						Set @Storage = 1
				END

				if(@ExtraServicesCharge2 = 1) 
				BEGIN --EXTRA SERVICES
					Select Top 1 @lastExtraService = InvoiceToDate 
					From tblInvoices
					Where CustomerFK = @customerFK2
					--AND Options & 4 = 4
					AND tblInvoices.ExtraServicesCharges = 1
					Order By tblInvoices.InvoiceToDate Desc

					IF @lastExtraService IS NULL -- Always include in final result if InvoiceToDate is null
						Set @ExtraServices = 1
					ELSE IF(Select count(*) From tblExtraServices ess
						    Where convert(varchar(50), ess.ExtraServiceDate, 112) > convert(varchar(50), @lastExtraService, 112)
								  AND convert(varchar(50), ess.ExtraServiceDate, 112) <= convert(varchar(50), @invoiceTo2, 112)
								  AND DivisionFK IN (Select DivisionPK From tblDivisions Where CustomerFK = @customerFK2)) > 0
						Set @ExtraServices = 1
				END

				IF(@DistributionCharge2 = 1) 
					-- DISTRIBITION NOT IMPLEMENTED as of 26 Mar 2021
					SET @Distribution = 0
				
				-- TO LOOK AT SHOULD BE USING @customerFK2
				--BEGIN --DISTRIBUTION CHARGES	
				--	Select Top 1 @lastDistributionCharge = InvoiceToDate 
				--	From tblInvoices
				--	Where (DivisionFK = @divisionFK2 OR CharIndex('''' + Cast(DivisionFK As Varchar(2000)) + '''', @divisions2) > 0)
				--	AND Options & 8 = 8
				--	Order by InvoiceToDate Desc

				--	IF @lastDistributionCharge IS NULL -- Always include in final result if InvoiceToDate is null
				--		Set @ret = @ret + 8
				--	ELSE IF(Select count(*) from tblContainerOutDistributionCharges codcs
				--	inner join tblContainerOutLines cols on cols.ContainerOutFK = codcs.ContainerOutFK
				--	Where convert(varchar(50), codcs.InsertedDate, 112) > convert(varchar(50), @lastDistributionCharge, 112)
				--	AND convert(varchar(50), codcs.InsertedDate, 112) <= convert(varchar(50), @invoiceTo2, 112)
				--	AND cols.DivisionFK IN (Select DivisionPK from tblDivisions where CustomerFK = @customerFK2)
				--	) > 0
				--		Set @ret = @ret + 8
				--END

				IF(@RecurringCharge2 = 1) --RECURRING CHARGES						
					Set @Recurring = 1	 --NO CHECK, IF THE USER WANTS THE RECURRING CHARGE, IT WILL BE MADE
			END 



			Select @Storage As StorageCharge, @ExtraServices As ExtraServicesCharge, @Distribution As DistributionCharge, @Recurring As RecurringCharge

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end
						
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()  
 --END  
  
 SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);  
 SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName)  
 IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails  
 ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;  
 INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK  
 SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()  
   
 WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3  
 BEGIN   
  BEGIN TRY

   IF @var_invoiceFK > 0

    IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM dbo.tblInvoices WHERE InvoicePK = @var_invoiceFK AND ISNULL(InvoiceNumber,'') = '')

     IF XACT_STATE() = 0 AND @@TRANCOUNT < 1 BEGIN TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName  
  
     -- Get the temporary invoice number from the appSystem table.   
     -- Lock the table to ensure no other code changes this value until this stored procedure has finished executing.  
     SELECT @InvoiceNumber = 'TMP' + CAST(NextInvoiceTempNumber AS NVARCHAR(200)) FROM dbo.appSystem WITH (ROWLOCK)       
  
     -- Increment the value in the appSystem table.  
     UPDATE dbo.appSystem WITH (ROWLOCK)  
     SET NextInvoiceTempNumber = NextInvoiceTempNumber + 1  
  
     -- Add the temporary invoice number to the specific row in the tblInvoices table.  
     UPDATE dbo.tblInvoices WITH (ROWLOCK)  
     SET InvoiceNumber = @InvoiceNumber  
     WHERE InvoicePK = @var_invoiceFK   
    END  
   END  
  
   DECLARE @ret INT = 0, @lastStorage DATETIME, @lastExtraService DATETIME, @lastDistributionCharge DATETIME, @lastRecurringCharge DATETIME,

   @storageRate DECIMAL(18,2), @storageRateSubject NVARCHAR(50), @storageRatePeriod NVARCHAR(50), @breakOver DECIMAL(18,3),

   SELECT @storageNominalCode = NominalCode FROM appInvoiceLineTypes WHERE InvoiceLineTypePK = 1/*Storage*/

   SET @invoiceCurrencySymbol = (SELECT TOP 1 currencies.CurrencySymbol FROM appSystem AS [system]

     @invoiceFrequencyFK = InvoiceFrequencyFK

     tblCustomers   
    WHERE   
     CustomerPK = @customerFK
