          -- Last <Frequency Day> of the previous week  
          WHEN @invoiceFrequencyFK BETWEEN 1 AND 7 /*AND (DATEDIFF(DAY, @lastStorage, @invoiceTo) > 7)*/ THEN  
           DATEADD(DAY, -7, @invoiceTo)  
          -- Last <Frequency Day> of the previous month   
          WHEN (@invoiceFrequencyFK BETWEEN 8 AND 14) /*AND (DATEDIFF(DAY,@lastStorage,@invoiceTo) > 31)*/ THEN  
           dbo.fnGetLastSpecificDayOfWeekInPreviousMonth(@invoiceTo,@invoiceFrequencyFK)  
          WHEN @invoiceFrequencyFK = 15 THEN -- Quarterly  
           @lastStorage -- This needs to be coded properly if/when this frequency is ever used  
          ELSE  
           @lastStorage  
         END  
  
    --Set the last storage date plus a day (this makes sure to include the @lastStorage day)  
    SET @lastStorage = DATEADD(day,1,@lastStorage)  
  
    SET @totalPalletsIn = 0  
    SET @totalPalletsOut = 0  
    SET @totalPalletsDepleated = 0  
  
    DECLARE @invoiceSeparation TABLE   
    (   
     SpecialStockTypeFK INT,   
     SpecialStockType NVARCHAR(200),  
     StockItemCategoryFK INT,  
     StockItemCategory NVARCHAR(200)   
    )  
  
    --SET the invoiceSeparation table  
    IF(@invoiceByCategory = 1 /*cast(1 AS BIT)*/)   
    BEGIN  
     INSERT INTO @invoiceSeparation  
     SELECT DISTINCT * FROM (  
      SELECT -1 AS SpecialStockTypeFK, '' AS SpecialStockType, -1 AS StockItemCategoryFK, '' AS StockItemCategory  
      UNION  
      SELECT -1 AS SpecialStockTypeFK, '' AS SpecialStockType, StockItemCategoryPK AS StockItemCategoryFK, StockItemCategory  
      FROM tblStockItemCategories AS sics  
      WHERE sics.CustomerFK = @customerFK      
     ) AS subQ1  
    END   
    ELSE   
    BEGIN  
     INSERT INTO @invoiceSeparation  
     SELECT DISTINCT * FROM (  
      SELECT -1 AS SpecialStockTypeFK, '' AS SpecialStockType, -1 AS StockItemCategoryFK, '' AS StockItemCategory  
      UNION  
      SELECT SpecialStockTypeFK, cssts.CustomText, -1 AS StockItemCategoryFK, '' AS StockItemCategory  
      FROM tblCustomerSpecialStockTypes AS cssts  
      INNER JOIN appSpecialStockTypes AS ssts ON  
      ssts.SpecialStockTypePK = cssts.SpecialStocktypeFK  
      WHERE CustomerFK = @customerFK  
      UNION  
      SELECT sissts.SpecialStockTypeFK, ssts.SpecialStockType, -1 AS StockItemCategoryFK, '' AS StockItemCategory  
      FROM tblStockItemSpecialStockTypes AS sissts  
      INNER JOIN appSpecialStockTypes AS ssts ON  
      ssts.SpecialStockTypePK = sissts.SpecialStockTypeFK  
      WHERE StockItemFK IN (SELECT StockItemPK FROM tblStockItems WHERE DivisionFK = @var_divisionFK)  
     ) AS subQ1  
    END  
  
    DECLARE InvoiceSeparatorCursor CURSOR FAST_FORWARD FOR SELECT * FROM @invoiceSeparation  
    
    OPEN InvoiceSeparatorCursor  
  
    FETCH NEXT FROM InvoiceSeparatorCursor INTO @specialStockTypeFK, @specialStockType, @stockItemCategoryFK, @stockItemCategory  
  
    WHILE (@@FETCH_STATUS = 0)   
    BEGIN   
     -- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------  
     -- Create temporary tables to use instead of subqueries within the main query.  
     -- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------  
  
     IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#StockAdjustmentsAfterEnd') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #StockAdjustmentsAfterEnd  
  
     SELECT count(*) AS Pallets, StockItemAfterFK AS StockItemFK  
     INTO #StockAdjustmentsAfterEnd  
     FROM tblStockAdjustments AS sas  
     INNER JOIN tblstockitems AS si   
     ON si.stockitempk = sas.StockItemAfterFK  
     WHERE sas.InsertedDate >= @var_invoiceTo   
     AND sas.StockItemBeforeFK <> sas.StockItemAfterFK  
     AND si.divisionfk = @var_divisionFK  
     GROUP BY sas.StockItemAfterFK   
  
     IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#StockAdjustmentsBeforeEnd') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #StockAdjustmentsBeforeEnd  
  
     SELECT count(*) AS Pallets, StockItemBeforeFK AS StockItemFK  
     INTO #StockAdjustmentsBeforeEnd  
     FROM tblStockAdjustments AS sas  
     INNER JOIN tblstockitems AS si ON si.stockitempk = sas.stockitembeforefk  
     WHERE sas.InsertedDate >= @var_invoiceTo  
     AND StockItemBeforeFK <> StockItemAfterFK  
     AND si.divisionfk = @var_divisionFK  
     GROUP BY StockItemBeforeFK  
  
     IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#StockAdjustmentsAfterStart') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #StockAdjustmentsAfterStart  
  
     SELECT count(*) AS Pallets, StockItemAfterFK AS StockItemFK  
     INTO #StockAdjustmentsAfterStart  
     FROM tblStockAdjustments AS sas  
     INNER JOIN tblstockitems AS si ON si.stockitempk = sas.StockItemAfterFK  
     WHERE sas.InsertedDate >= @lastStorage --AND @var_invoiceTo   
     AND sas.StockItemBeforeFK <> sas.StockItemAfterFK  
     AND si.divisionfk = @var_divisionFK  
     GROUP BY sas.StockItemAfterFK  
  
     IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#StockAdjustmentsBeforeStart') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #StockAdjustmentsBeforeStart  
  
     SELECT count(*) AS Pallets, StockItemBeforeFK AS StockItemFK  
     INTO #StockAdjustmentsBeforeStart  
     FROM tblStockAdjustments AS sas  
     INNER JOIN tblstockitems AS si ON si.stockitempk = sas.stockitembeforefk  
     WHERE sas.InsertedDate >= @lastStorage --AND @var_invoiceTo  
     AND StockItemBeforeFK <> StockItemAfterFK  
     AND si.divisionfk = @var_divisionFK  
     GROUP BY StockItemBeforeFK   
  
     IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#sis') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #sis  
  
     SELECT *   
     INTO #sis  
     FROM tblStockItems   
     WHERE DivisionFK = @var_divisionFK  
     AND (  
       @invoiceByCategory = 0 /*cast(0 AS BIT)*/   
       OR   
       (@invoiceByCategory = 1 /*cast(1 AS BIT)*/ AND StockItemCategoryFK = @stockItemCategoryFK)  
      )  
  
     -- ------------------------------------------------------  
     -- Create pallets from start of period temporary tables.  
     -- ------------------------------------------------------  
  
     IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#palletInsFromStartOfPeriodTotals') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #palletInsFromStartOfPeriodTotals  
  
     SELECT StockItemFK, SUM(PalletsIn) AS PalletsIn, SUM(UnitsIn) AS UnitsIn  
     INTO #palletInsFromStartOfPeriodTotals  
     FROM (  
     SELECT sils.StockItemFK, pa.PalletFK, 1 - SUM(ISNULL([audit].PalletsAbsorbed, 0)) AS PalletsIn, SUM(sils.Units) AS UnitsIn  
     FROM tblStockInLines AS sils  
     INNER JOIN tblStockIns AS sins ON  
     sins.StockInPK = sils.StockInFK  
     INNER JOIN tblContainerIns AS cins ON  
     cins.ContainerInPK = sins.ContainerInFK   
     AND cins.StockInStatusFK = 3 /*Completed*/  
     --AND cins.StockInStatusFK <> 4 /*Not cancelled*/  
     --AND cins.StockInStatusFK <> 1 /*Not OnRoute*/  
     INNER JOIN tblPalletAudit AS pa ON  
     pa.EventTypeFK = 1 /*PalletCreated*/  
     AND pa.EventFK = sils.StockInLinePK  
     AND pa.StockItemFK = sils.StockItemFK  
     LEFT OUTER JOIN (  
      SELECT count(*) PalletsAbsorbed, pa.PalletFK, StockItemFK, wos.FK   
      FROM tblPalletAudit AS pa  
      INNER JOIN tblWorksOrders AS wos ON  
      wos.WorksOrderPK = EventFK  
      WHERE EventTypeFK = 16/*Topoff DepleatedPallet - Absorbed*/  
      AND EventDate >= @lastStorage  
      GROUP BY pa.PalletFK, StockItemFK, wos.FK  
     ) AS [audit] ON  
     [audit].StockItemFK = sils.StockItemFK  
     AND [audit].FK = sins.StockInPK  
     AND pa.PalletFK = [audit].PalletFK  
     WHERE cins.StockInStatusFK = 3 /*Completed*/  
     --cins.StockInStatusFK <> 4 /*Not Cancelled*/   
     --AND cins.StockInStatusFK <> 1 /*Not OnRoute*/   
     AND cins.DateIn > @lastStorage  
     AND ((@invoiceByCategory = 0 /*cast(0 AS BIT)*/ AND sils.SpecialStockTypeFK = @specialStockTypeFK)  
      OR @invoiceByCategory = 1 /*cast(1 AS BIT)*/)  
     GROUP BY sils.StockItemFK, pa.PalletFK  
     ) AS subQ GROUP BY StockItemFK  
  
     IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#palletDepletionsFromStartOfPeriod') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #palletDepletionsFromStartOfPeriod  
  
     SELECT count(*) AS PalletsDepleated, StockItemFK  
     INTO #palletDepletionsFromStartOfPeriod   
     FROM tblPalletAudit AS [audit]  
     WHERE EventTypeFK = 18 /*Pallet Depleated FROM Movement*/  
     AND EventDate >=@lastStorage   
     AND   
     (  
      [audit].PalletFK in (   
            SELECT PalletFK   
            FROM tblStockInLinePallets AS silps   
            INNER JOIN tblStockInLines AS sils   
            ON sils.StockInLinePK = silps.StockInLineFK  
              
            -- 05 September 2018 Cathal OCuirrin : This code ensure only completed stock ins are included.  
            inner join dbo.tblstockins as si   
            on sils.stockinfk = si.stockinpk  
            inner join dbo.tblcontainerins as ci   
            on ci.containerinpk = si.containerinfk   
            and ci.stockinstatusfk = 3 /*Completed*/  
               
            WHERE ((@invoiceByCategory = 0 /*cast(0 AS BIT)*/ AND SpecialStockTypeFK = @specialStockTypeFK) OR @invoiceByCategory = 1 /*cast(1 AS BIT)*/)  
           )  
     )  
     GROUP BY StockItemFK  
  
     IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#palletOutsFromStartOfPeriod') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #palletOutsFromStartOfPeriod  
  
     SELECT count(*) AS PalletsOut, StockItemFK  
     INTO #palletOutsFromStartOfPeriod  
     FROM tblPalletAudit AS [audit]  
     WHERE EventTypeFK in (2,23) --= 2 /*PalletRemoved*/  
     AND EventDate >= @lastStorage AND   
     (  
      [audit].PalletFK in (  
            SELECT PalletFK   
            FROM tblStockInLinePallets AS silps   
            INNER JOIN tblStockInLines AS sils   
            ON sils.StockInLinePK = silps.StockInLineFK   
  
            -- 05 September 2018 Cathal OCuirrin : This code ensure only completed stock ins are included.  
            inner join dbo.tblstockins as si   
            on sils.stockinfk = si.stockinpk  
            inner join dbo.tblcontainerins as ci   
            on ci.containerinpk = si.containerinfk   
            and ci.stockinstatusfk = 3 /*Completed*/  
  
            WHERE ((@invoiceByCategory = 0 /*cast(0 AS BIT)*/ AND SpecialStockTypeFK = @specialStockTypeFK) OR @invoiceByCategory = 1 /*cast(1 AS BIT)*/)  
           )  
     )  
     GROUP BY StockItemFK  
  
     -- ----------------------------------------------  
     -- Create pallets after period temporary tables.  
     -- ----------------------------------------------  
  
     IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#palletInsAfterPeriodTotals') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #palletInsAfterPeriodTotals  
  
     SELECT StockItemFK, SUM(PalletsIn) AS PalletsIn, SUM(UnitsIn) AS UnitsIn  
     INTO #palletInsAfterPeriodTotals  
     FROM   
     (  
     SELECT sils.StockItemFK, pa.PalletFK, 1 - SUM(ISNULL([audit].PalletsAbsorbed, 0)) AS PalletsIn, SUM(sils.Units) AS UnitsIn  
     FROM tblStockInLines AS sils  
     INNER JOIN tblStockIns AS sins ON  
     sins.StockInPK = sils.StockInFK  
     INNER JOIN tblContainerIns AS cins ON  
     cins.ContainerInPK = sins.ContainerInFK   
     AND cins.StockInStatusFK = 3 /*Completed*/  
     --AND cins.StockInStatusFK <> 4 /*Not cancelled*/  
     --AND cins.StockInStatusFK <> 1 /*Not OnRoute*/  
     INNER JOIN tblPalletAudit AS pa ON  
     pa.EventTypeFK = 1 /*PalletCreated*/  
     AND pa.EventFK = sils.StockInLinePK  
     AND pa.StockItemFK = sils.StockItemFK  
     LEFT OUTER JOIN (  
      SELECT count(*) PalletsAbsorbed, pa.PalletFK,StockItemFK, wos.FK   
      FROM tblPalletAudit AS pa  
      INNER JOIN tblWorksOrders AS wos ON  
      wos.WorksOrderPK = EventFK  
      WHERE EventTypeFK = 16/*Topoff DepleatedPallet - Absorbed*/  
      AND EventDate > @var_invoiceTo  
      GROUP BY pa.PalletFK, StockItemFK, wos.FK  
     ) AS [audit] ON  
     [audit].StockItemFK = sils.StockItemFK  
     AND [audit].FK = sins.StockInPK  
     AND [audit].PalletFK = pa.PalletFK  
     WHERE cins.StockInStatusFK = 3 /*Completed*/  
     --cins.StockInStatusFK <> 4 /*Not Cancelled*/   
     --AND cins.StockInStatusFK <> 1 /*Not OnRoute*/   
     AND cins.DateIn > @var_invoiceTo  
     AND ((@invoiceByCategory = 0 /*cast(0 AS BIT)*/ AND sils.SpecialStockTypeFK = @specialStockTypeFK)   
      OR @invoiceByCategory = 1 /*cast(1 AS BIT)*/)  
     GROUP BY sils.StockItemFK, pa.PalletFK  
     ) AS subQ GROUP BY StockItemFK      
  
     IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#palletDepletionsAfterPeriod') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #palletDepletionsAfterPeriod  
  
     SELECT count(*) AS PalletsDepleated, StockItemFK   
     INTO #palletDepletionsAfterPeriod  
     FROM tblPalletAudit AS [audit]  
     WHERE EventTypeFK = 18 /*Pallet Depleated FROM Movement*/  
     AND EventDate > @var_invoiceTo AND   
     (  
      [audit].PalletFK in (  
            SELECT PalletFK   
            FROM tblStockInLinePallets AS silps   
            INNER JOIN tblStockInLines AS sils   
            ON sils.StockInLinePK = silps.StockInLineFK   
  
            -- 05 September 2018 Cathal OCuirrin : This code ensure only completed stock ins are included.  
            inner join dbo.tblstockins as si   
            on sils.stockinfk = si.stockinpk  
            inner join dbo.tblcontainerins as ci   
            on ci.containerinpk = si.containerinfk   
            and ci.stockinstatusfk = 3 /*Completed*/  
  
            WHERE ((@invoiceByCategory = 0 /*cast(0 AS BIT)*/ AND SpecialStockTypeFK = @specialStockTypeFK) OR @invoiceByCategory = 1 /*cast(1 AS BIT)*/)  
           )  
     )  
     GROUP BY StockItemFK  
  
     IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#palletOutsAfterPeriod') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #palletOutsAfterPeriod  
  
     SELECT count(*) AS PalletsOut, StockItemFK  
     INTO #palletOutsAfterPeriod  
     FROM tblPalletAudit AS [audit]  
     WHERE EventTypeFK in (2, 23) --= 2 /*PalletRemoved*/  
     AND EventDate > @var_invoiceTo AND   
     (  
      [audit].PalletFK in (  
            SELECT PalletFK   
            FROM tblStockInLinePallets AS silps   
            INNER JOIN tblStockInLines AS sils   
            ON sils.StockInLinePK = silps.StockInLineFK   
  
            -- 05 September 2018 Cathal OCuirrin : This code ensure only completed stock ins are included.  
            inner join dbo.tblstockins as si   
            on sils.stockinfk = si.stockinpk  
            inner join dbo.tblcontainerins as ci   
            on ci.containerinpk = si.containerinfk   
            and ci.stockinstatusfk = 3 /*Completed*/  
  
            WHERE ((@invoiceByCategory = 0 /*cast(0 AS BIT)*/   
             AND SpecialStockTypeFK = @specialStockTypeFK) OR @invoiceByCategory = 1 /*cast(1 AS BIT)*/)  
           )  
     )  
     GROUP BY StockItemFK  
  
     -- -------------------------------------------  
     -- Get current level of stock pallet details.  
     -- -------------------------------------------  
  
     IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#currentLevel') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #currentLevel  
  
     SELECT StockItemFK, SpecialStockTypeFK, SUM(ActualPallets) AS ActualPallets  
     INTO #currentLevel  
     FROM (  
       SELECT StockItemFK, SpecialStockTypeFK, SUM(ActualPallets) AS ActualPallets  
       FROM tblStockLevels  
       WHERE MixedContentCount < 2  
       GROUP BY StockItemFK, SpecialStockTypeFK  
  
       UNION   
  
       SELECT StockItemFK, SpecialStockTypeFK,   
       SUM(ActualPallets) - (MixedContentCount-1) AS ActualPallets  
       FROM tblStockLevels  
       WHERE MixedContentCount > 1  
       GROUP BY StockItemFK, SpecialStockTypeFK, MixedContentCount  
      ) AS subq   
     GROUP BY   
      stockitemfk, SpecialStockTypeFK              
  
     -- --------------------------------------  
     -- Get the various stock pallet numbers.  
     -- --------------------------------------  
  
     IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#StockItemPalletNumbers') IS NOT NULL  
      DROP TABLE #StockItemPalletNumbers  
  
     SELECT   
      StockItemPK,        
      -- Columns for OpeningTotalPallets  
      ActualPallets,  
      palletOutsFROMStartOfPeriod.PalletsOut AS 'palletOutsFROMStartOfPeriod.PalletsOut',  
      palletDepletionsFROMStartOfPeriod.PalletsDepleated AS 'palletDepletionsFROMStartOfPeriod.PalletsDepleated',  
      insFROMStartOfPeriod.PalletsIn AS 'insFROMStartOfPeriod.PalletsIn',  
      StockAdjustmentsBeforeStart.Pallets AS 'StockAdjustmentsBeforeStart.Pallets',  
      StockAdjustmentsAfterStart.Pallets AS 'StockAdjustmentsAfterStart.Pallets',  
      -- Columns for ClosingTotalPallets  
      palletOutsAfterPeriod.PalletsOut AS 'palletOutsAfterPeriod.PalletsOut',  
      palletDepletionsAfterPeriod.PalletsDepleated AS 'palletDepletionsAfterPeriod.PalletsDepleated',  
      insAfterPeriod.PalletsIn AS 'insAfterPeriod.PalletsIn',  
      StockAdjustmentsBeforeEnd.Pallets AS 'StockAdjustmentsBeforeEnd.Pallets',  
      StockAdjustmentsAfterEnd.Pallets AS 'StockAdjustmentsAfterEnd.Pallets'  
     INTO  
      #StockItemPalletNumbers  
     FROM   
      #sis AS sis  
     INNER JOIN tblDivisions AS divisions  
      ON divisions.DivisionPK = sis.DivisionFK  
     LEFT OUTER JOIN #currentLevel AS currentLevel        ON currentLevel.StockItemFK = sis.StockItemPK   
      AND (  
        (@invoiceByCategory = 0 /*cast(0 AS BIT)*/ AND currentLevel.SpecialStockTypeFK = @specialStockTypeFK)   
        OR @invoiceByCategory = 1 /*cast(1 AS BIT)*/  
       )  
     LEFT OUTER JOIN #palletOutsAfterPeriod AS palletOutsAfterPeriod  
      ON palletOutsAfterPeriod.StockItemFK = sis.StockItemPK  
     LEFT OUTER JOIN #palletDepletionsAfterPeriod AS palletDepletionsAfterPeriod  
      ON palletDepletionsAfterPeriod.StockItemFK = sis.StockItemPK  
     LEFT OUTER JOIN #palletInsAfterPeriodTotals AS insAfterPeriod  
      ON insAfterPeriod.StockItemFK = sis.StockItemPK  
     LEFT OUTER JOIN #palletOutsFromStartOfPeriod AS palletOutsFROMStartOfPeriod  
      ON palletOutsFROMStartOfPeriod.StockItemFK = sis.StockItemPK  
     LEFT OUTER JOIN #palletDepletionsFromStartOfPeriod AS palletDepletionsFROMStartOfPeriod  
      ON palletDepletionsFROMStartOfPeriod.StockItemFK = sis.StockItemPK  
     LEFT OUTER JOIN #palletInsFromStartOfPeriodTotals AS insFROMStartOfPeriod  
      ON insFROMStartOfPeriod.StockItemFK = sis.StockItemPK    
     LEFT OUTER JOIN #StockAdjustmentsBeforeStart AS StockAdjustmentsBeforeStart   
      ON StockAdjustmentsBeforeStart.StockItemFK = sis.StockItemPK   
     LEFT OUTER JOIN #StockAdjustmentsAfterStart AS StockAdjustmentsAfterStart   
      ON StockAdjustmentsAfterStart.StockItemFK = sis.StockItemPK   
     LEFT OUTER JOIN #StockAdjustmentsBeforeEnd AS StockAdjustmentsBeforeEnd   
      ON StockAdjustmentsBeforeEnd.StockItemFK = sis.StockItemPK   
     LEFT OUTER JOIN #StockAdjustmentsAfterEnd AS StockAdjustmentsAfterEnd   
      ON StockAdjustmentsAfterEnd.StockItemFK = sis.StockItemPK  
  
     -- --------------------------------  
     -- Total the stock pallet numbers.  
     -- --------------------------------  
  
     IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#StockItemPalletTotals') IS NOT NULL  
      DROP TABLE #StockItemPalletTotals  
  
     SELECT   
      StockItemPK,  
      SUM(ISNULL(ActualPallets,0)) AS ActualPallets,  
      [palletOutsFROMStartOfPeriod.PalletsOut],  
      [palletDepletionsFROMStartOfPeriod.PalletsDepleated],  
      [insFROMStartOfPeriod.PalletsIn],  
      [StockAdjustmentsBeforeStart.Pallets],  
      [StockAdjustmentsAfterStart.Pallets],  
      [palletOutsAfterPeriod.PalletsOut],  
      [palletDepletionsAfterPeriod.PalletsDepleated],  
      [insAfterPeriod.PalletsIn],  
      [StockAdjustmentsBeforeEnd.Pallets],  
      [StockAdjustmentsAfterEnd.Pallets]   
     INTO  
      #StockItemPalletTotals  
     FROM   
      #StockItemPalletNumbers   
     GROUP BY   
      StockItemPK,  
      [palletOutsFROMStartOfPeriod.PalletsOut],  
      [palletDepletionsFROMStartOfPeriod.PalletsDepleated],  
      [insFROMStartOfPeriod.PalletsIn],  
      [StockAdjustmentsBeforeStart.Pallets],  
      [StockAdjustmentsAfterStart.Pallets],  
      [palletOutsAfterPeriod.PalletsOut],  
      [palletDepletionsAfterPeriod.PalletsDepleated],  
      [insAfterPeriod.PalletsIn],  
      [StockAdjustmentsBeforeEnd.Pallets],  
      [StockAdjustmentsAfterEnd.Pallets]        
  
     -- --------------------------------------------------  
     -- Calculate the grand totals for the stock pallets.  
     -- --------------------------------------------------  
  
     IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#StockItemPalletGrandTotals') IS NOT NULL  
      DROP TABLE #StockItemPalletGrandTotals  
  
     SELECT  
      StockItemPK,  
      ISNULL(ActualPallets, 0) + ISNULL([palletOutsFROMStartOfPeriod.PalletsOut], 0)   
       + ISNULL([palletDepletionsFROMStartOfPeriod.PalletsDepleated], 0) - ISNULL([insFROMStartOfPeriod.PalletsIn],0)   
        + ISNULL([StockAdjustmentsBeforeStart.Pallets], 0) - ISNULL([StockAdjustmentsAfterStart.Pallets], 0) AS OpeningTotalPallets,  
  
      ISNULL(ActualPallets, 0) + ISNULL([palletOutsAfterPeriod.PalletsOut], 0) + ISNULL([palletDepletionsAfterPeriod.PalletsDepleated], 0)   
       - ISNULL([insAfterPeriod.PalletsIn],0) + ISNULL([StockAdjustmentsBeforeEnd.Pallets], 0)   
        - ISNULL([StockAdjustmentsAfterEnd.Pallets], 0) AS ClosingTotalPallets,  
      ISNULL([insFROMStartOfPeriod.PalletsIn], 0) - ISNULL([insAfterPeriod.PalletsIn], 0) AS PalletsIn,  
      ISNULL([palletOutsFROMStartOfPeriod.PalletsOut], 0) - ISNULL([palletOutsAfterPeriod.PalletsOut], 0) AS PalletsOut,  
      ISNULL([palletDepletionsFROMStartOfPeriod.PalletsDepleated],0) - ISNULL([palletDepletionsAfterPeriod.PalletsDepleated], 0)   
       AS PalletsDepleated   
     INTO  
      #StockItemPalletGrandTotals  
     FROM      
      #StockItemPalletTotals                    
              
     -- ------------------------------------------  
     -- Calculate the final stock pallet numbers.  
     -- ------------------------------------------  
  
     SELECT   
      @openingPallets = SUM(OpeningTotalPallets),  
      @closingPallets = SUM(ClosingTotalPallets),  
      @palletsIn = ISNULL(SUM(PalletsIn), 0),  
      @palletsOut = ISNULL(SUM(PalletsOut), 0),  
      @palletsDepleated = ISNULL(SUM(PalletsDepleated), 0)  
     FROM       
      #StockItemPalletGrandTotals          
  
     SET @totalPalletsIn = @totalPalletsIn + @palletsIn  
     SET @totalPalletsOut = @totalPalletsOut + @palletsOut  
     SET @totalPalletsDepleated = @totalPalletsDepleated + @palletsDepleated  
  
     -- ------------------------------------------------------------------------------  
     -- Calculate the eachesIn value if the division "handling in charge by" is each   
     -- instead of pallet (see invoice details tab in the divsion details screen).  
     -- ------------------------------------------------------------------------------  
  
     IF @HandlingInEachesTypeFK > 0  
     BEGIN  
      --20 July 2018 Jamie Clerkin : get count from stock in dockets   
      select @eachesIn = sum(eaches) from (  
       SELECT DISTINCT sil.stockinlinepk, sil.eaches  
       FROM tblStockIns AS si  
       INNER JOIN tblStockInLines AS sil ON si.stockinPK = sil.stockinFK  
       inner join tblstockinlinepallets on stockinlinefk = stockinlinepk  
       -- 05 September 2018 Cathal OCuirrin : This code ensure only completed stock ins are included.  
       inner join dbo.tblcontainerins as ci   
       on ci.containerinpk = si.containerinfk   
       and ci.stockinstatusfk = 3 /*Completed*/  
  
       INNER JOIN tblPalletContent AS pc ON sil.Batch = pc.Batch AND sil.StockItemFK = pc.StockItemFK        
       LEFT JOIN tblpallets p on pc.palletfk = p.palletpk  AND p.palletpk <> -1 --link back to pallets to check they are actually in warehouse     
       LEFT JOIN tblPalletAudit pa on p.palletpk = pa.palletfk and pa.eventdate < @var_InvoiceTo  
       WHERE si.divisionFK = @var_divisionFK AND si.ArrivalDate >= @lastStorage   AND si.ArrivalDate <  @var_InvoiceTo --AND pc.InsertedDate <  @var_InvoiceTo  
       AND ((pc.palletfk <> -1 and p.palletstatusfk <> 10) or pc.palletfk = -1)  --11 July 2018 Jamie Clerkin  
      )subq   
  
  
      /*  
      SELECT @eachesIn = COUNT(DISTINCT pc.PalletContentPK)  
      FROM tblStockIns AS si  
      INNER JOIN tblStockInLines AS sil  
      ON si.stockinPK = sil.stockinFK  
      INNER JOIN tblPalletContent AS pc  
      ON sil.Batch = pc.Batch  
      AND sil.StockItemFK = pc.StockItemFK        
      LEFT JOIN tblpallets p on pc.palletfk = p.palletpk   
      AND p.palletpk <> -1 --link back to pallets to check they are actually in warehouse     
      WHERE si.divisionFK = @var_divisionFK  
      AND si.ArrivalDate >= @lastStorage   
      AND si.ArrivalDate < @var_InvoiceTo  
      AND pc.InsertedDate < @var_InvoiceTo -- 04 May 2018 Cathal O Cuirrin  
      AND ((pc.palletfk <> -1 and p.palletstatusfk <> 10) or pc.palletfk = -1)  --11 July 2018 Jamie Clerkin*/  
  
      SET @eachesIn = ISNULL(@eachesIn,0)  
     END  
  
     -- -------------------------------------------------------------------------------  
     -- Calculate the eachesOut value if the division "handling out charge by" is each   
     -- instead of pallet (see invoice details tab in the divsion details screen).  
     -- -------------------------------------------------------------------------------  
  
     IF @HandlingOutEachesTypeFK > 0  
     BEGIN  
      IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#eachesOutFromStartOfPeriod') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #eachesOutFromStartOfPeriod                      
  
      SELECT colpc.PalletContentFK, [audit].PalletAuditPK, [audit].EventDate  
      INTO #eachesOutFromStartOfPeriod  
      FROM tblPalletAudit AS [audit]  
      INNER JOIN tblstockitems AS si  
      ON [audit].StockItemFK = si.StockItemPK  
      INNER JOIN tblContainerOutLinePalletContent AS colpc  
      ON colpc.containeroutlinefk = [audit].eventfk  
  
      -- 05 September 2018 Cathal OCuirrin : This code ensure only completed stock outs are included.  
      INNER JOIN tblContainerOutLines as col  
      on colpc.ContainerOutLineFK = col.ContainerOutLinePK  
      inner join tblcontainerouts as co  
      on col.ContainerOutFK = co.ContainerOutPK  
      and co.ContainerOutStatusFK = 5 /*Completed*/  
  
      WHERE si.divisionfk = @var_divisionFK  
      AND [audit].EventTypeFK = 3  
      AND [audit].EventDate >= @lastStorage  
  
      IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#uniqueEachesOutFromStartOfPeriod') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #uniqueEachesOutFromStartOfPeriod  
  
      CREATE TABLE #uniqueEachesOutFromStartOfPeriod  
      (  
       PalletContentFK INT,  
       PalletAuditFK INT  
      )  
  
      DECLARE uniquePalletOutsFROMStartOfPeriod CURSOR FAST_FORWARD FOR   
      SELECT palletcontentfk, PalletAuditPK FROM #eachesOutFromStartOfPeriod  
  
      OPEN uniquePalletOutsFROMStartOfPeriod  
      FETCH NEXT FROM uniquePalletOutsFROMStartOfPeriod INTO @currentPalletContent, @currentPalletAudit  
  
      WHILE (@@FETCH_STATUS = 0)   
      BEGIN  
       IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM #uniqueEachesOutFromStartOfPeriod   
           WHERE PalletContentFK = @currentPalletContent OR PalletAuditFK = @currentPalletAudit)   
        INSERT INTO #uniqueEachesOutFromStartOfPeriod SELECT @currentPalletContent, @currentPalletAudit  
  
       FETCH NEXT FROM uniquePalletOutsFROMStartOfPeriod INTO @currentPalletContent, @currentPalletAudit  
      END    
              
      CLOSE uniquePalletOutsFROMStartOfPeriod  
      DEALLOCATE uniquePalletOutsFROMStartOfPeriod  
  
      IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#eachesOutAfterPeriod') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #eachesOutAfterPeriod  
  
      SELECT palletcontentfk, PalletAuditPK  
      INTO #eachesOutAfterPeriod  
      FROM #eachesOutFromStartOfPeriod  
      WHERE EventDate >= @var_invoiceTo  
  
      IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#UniqueEachesOutAfterPeriod') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #UniqueEachesOutAfterPeriod  
  
      CREATE TABLE #UniqueEachesOutAfterPeriod  
      (  
       PalletContentFK INT,  
       PalletAuditFK INT  
      )  
            
      DECLARE uniquePalletOutsAfterPeriod CURSOR FAST_FORWARD FOR   
      SELECT palletcontentfk, PalletAuditPK FROM #eachesOutAfterPeriod  
  
      OPEN uniquePalletOutsAfterPeriod  
      FETCH NEXT FROM uniquePalletOutsAfterPeriod INTO @currentPalletContent, @currentPalletAudit  
  
      WHILE (@@FETCH_STATUS = 0)   
      BEGIN  
       IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM #UniqueEachesOutAfterPeriod   
           WHERE PalletContentFK = @currentPalletContent or PalletAuditFK = @currentPalletAudit)   
        INSERT INTO #UniqueEachesOutAfterPeriod SELECT @currentPalletContent, @currentPalletAudit  
    
       FETCH NEXT FROM uniquePalletOutsAfterPeriod INTO @currentPalletContent, @currentPalletAudit  
      END    
            
      CLOSE uniquePalletOutsAfterPeriod  
      DEALLOCATE uniquePalletOutsAfterPeriod  
  
      SELECT @eachesOut = COUNT(po.palletcontentfk)  
      FROM #eachesOutFromStartOfPeriod AS po  
      INNER JOIN #uniqueEachesOutFromStartOfPeriod AS upo   
      ON upo.PalletContentFK = po.PalletContentFK   
      AND upo.PalletAuditFK = po.PalletAuditPK  
      WHERE NOT EXISTS  
      (  
       SELECT * FROM #eachesOutAfterPeriod AS po    
       WHERE upo.PalletContentFK = po.PalletContentFK   
       AND upo.PalletAuditFK = po.PalletAuditPK  
      )                
     END  
  
  
     -- #DEV 998  
     -- Get the invoice method, 1 = Opening Pallets + PalletsIn, 2 = Closing Pallets  
     SELECT @invoiceMethodFK = InvoiceMethodFK FROM tblDivisions WHERE DivisionPK = @var_divisionFK  
  
     -- DG Create Temp Table #PalletsToChargeFor  
     IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#PalletsToChargeFor') IS NOT NULL  
      DROP TABLE #PalletsToChargeFor  
  
     CREATE TABLE #PalletsToChargeFor  
     (  
      StockItemPK INT,  
      TotalPallets INT,  
      StorageRateTypeFK INT,  
      StorageRate DECIMAL(18,3),  
      BreakMethodFK INT,  
      BreakOver DECIMAL(18,3),  
      StorageRateSubject VARCHAR(10),  
      TimePeriod VARCHAR(50),  
      RateSet INT  
     )  
       
     -- Invoice Method 1: Use  Opening Pallets && PalletsIn,  
     IF @invoiceMethodFK = 1  
      BEGIN  
       INSERT INTO #PalletsToChargeFor  
       SELECT   
        StockItemPK,   
        SUM(OpeningTotalPallets + PalletsIn) AS TotalPallets,   
        CAST(-1 AS INT) AS StorageRateTypeFK,   
        CAST(0.000 AS DECIMAL(18,3)) AS StorageRate,   
        CAST(-1 AS INT) AS BreakMethodFK,   
        CAST(0.000 AS DECIMAL(18,3)) AS BreakOver,  
        CAST('' AS VARCHAR(10)) AS StorageRateSubject,  
        CAST('' AS VARCHAR(50)) AS TimePeriod,  
        CAST(0 AS INT) AS RateSet  
       FROM   
        #StockItemPalletGrandTotals   
       WHERE   
        (OpeningTotalPallets <> 0) OR (PalletsIn <> 0)  
       GROUP BY   
        StockItemPK  
      END  
     ELSE  
      --Invoice Method 2: Use Closing Pallets  
      BEGIN  
       INSERT INTO #PalletsToChargeFor  
       SELECT   
        StockItemPK,   
        SUM(ClosingTotalPallets) AS TotalPallets,   
        CAST(-1 AS INT) AS StorageRateTypeFK,   
        CAST(0.000 AS DECIMAL(18,3)) AS StorageRate,   
        CAST(-1 AS INT) AS BreakMethodFK,   
        CAST(0.000 AS DECIMAL(18,3)) AS BreakOver,  
        CAST('' AS VARCHAR(10)) AS StorageRateSubject,  
        CAST('' AS VARCHAR(50)) AS TimePeriod,  
        CAST(0 AS INT) AS RateSet  
       FROM   
        #StockItemPalletGrandTotals   
       WHERE   
        (OpeningTotalPallets <> 0) OR (PalletsIn <> 0)  
       GROUP BY   
        StockItemPK  
      END  
  
     -- Declare Variable Here.  
     DECLARE @StockItemPK INT   
     DECLARE @TimePeriod varchar(50)  
     DECLARE @StorageRateTypeFK INT = 0  
  
     DECLARE @StockItemStorageRatesCursor AS CURSOR  
     DECLARE @DivisionStorageRatesCursor AS CURSOR  
  
     DECLARE @CountStorageRates INT = 0  
     DECLARE @RateSet INT = 0  
     DECLARE @RowCounter INT = 0  
     DECLARE @TotalRemainingPallets INT = 0  
     DECLARE @StockItemNumberOfPallets INT = 0  
       
     --BEGIN  
         
     -- Create a Temp Table. StockItems with Storage Rates  
     IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#StockItemStorageRates') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #StockItemStorageRates  
  
     --Insert Into Temp Table  
     Select T.StockItemPK,  
       srs.StorageRateTypeFK,   
       srs.StorageRate,   
       srs.BreakMethodFK,  
       srs.BreakOver,   
       CASE WHEN ChargeByPallet = 1 /*cast(1 AS BIT)*/ THEN 'Pallet'   
         WHEN ChargeByEach = 1 /*cast(1 AS BIT)*/ THEN  'Each'   
         WHEN ChargeByUnit = 1 /*cast(1 AS BIT)*/ THEN  'Unit'   
       END As StorageRateSubject,  
       tps.TimePeriod,  
       0 As RateSet,  
       0 As MutlipleStorageRates,  
       srs.SpecialStockTypeFK  
     Into #StockItemStorageRates  
     From #PalletsToChargeFor As T  
       INNER JOIN tblStorageRates AS srs ON T.StockItemPK = srs.FK  
       INNER JOIN appTimePeriods AS tps ON tps.TimePeriodPK = srs.ChargePeriodFK  
     WHERE srs.StorageRateTypeFK = 2 /*StockItem*/ AND   
        ((@invoiceByCategory = 0 /*cast(0 AS BIT)*/ AND SpecialStockTypeFK = @specialStockTypeFK) OR (@invoiceByCategory = 1) /*cast(1 AS BIT)*/)  
     Group By T.StockItemPK, srs.StorageRateTypeFK, srs.StorageRate, srs.BreakMethodFK, srs.BreakOver,   
        srs.ChargeByPallet, srs.ChargeByEach, srs.ChargeByUnit, tps.TimePeriod, srs.SpecialStockTypeFK  
     Order By T.StockItemPK, srs.StorageRateTypeFK, srs.BreakOver Desc  
  
     -- SET MutlipleStorageRates Flag  
     UPDATE #StockItemStorageRates  
     SET MutlipleStorageRates = 1  
     WHERE StockItemPK IN (Select StockItemPK  
            From  #StockItemStorageRates  
            Group By StockItemPK   
            HAVING Count(StorageRate) > 1)  
  
     -- StorageRateTypeFK = 2 (StockItem) And SINGLE Storage Rate  
     -- Update #PalletsToChargeFor, Get Pallets which Use SINGLE StockItem StorageRate &&  Update #PalletsToChargeFor incl. RateSet  
     UPDATE T  
      SET   
       StorageRateTypeFK = siStorageRates.StorageRateTypeFK,  
       StorageRate = siStorageRates.StorageRate,   
       BreakMethodFK = (CASE WHEN ISNULL(siStorageRates.BreakMethodFK, -1) > 1 THEN -1 ELSE siStorageRates.BreakMethodFK END),  
       BreakOver = siStorageRates.BreakOver,  
       StorageRateSubject = siStorageRates.StorageRateSubject,  
       TimePeriod = siStorageRates.TimePeriod,  
       RateSet = 1  
      FROM   
       #PalletsToChargeFor As T  
       INNER JOIN #StockItemStorageRates As siStorageRates On T.StockItemPK = siStorageRates.StockItemPK  
      WHERE   
       siStorageRates.StorageRateTypeFK = 2 /*StockItem*/  
       AND ((@invoiceByCategory = 0 /*cast(0 AS BIT)*/ AND siStorageRates.SpecialStockTypeFK = @specialStockTypeFK) OR (@invoiceByCategory = 1) /*cast(1 AS BIT)*/)   
       AND siStorageRates.MutlipleStorageRates = 0  
       
    
     -- Declare Cursor to Loop temp Table #StockItemStorageRates  
     SET @StockItemStorageRatesCursor  = CURSOR FAST_FORWARD FOR   
     SELECT StockItemPK, StorageRateTypeFK, StorageRate, BreakMethodFK, BreakOver, StorageRateSubject, TimePeriod  
     FROM #StockItemStorageRates  
     WHERE #StockItemStorageRates.MutlipleStorageRates = 1  
     ORDER BY StockItemPK, StorageRateTypeFK, BreakOver Desc  
         
     -- Loop @StockItemStorageRatesCursor  
     OPEN @StockItemStorageRatesCursor  
     FETCH NEXT FROM @StockItemStorageRatesCursor INTO @StockItemPK, @StorageRateTypeFK, @StorageRate, @BreakMethodFK,   
                   @BreakOver, @StorageRateSubject, @TimePeriod  
     WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0  
      BEGIN  
  
       --Blanket Break Method  
       IF (@BreakMethodFK = 1)  
  
        IF (CONVERT(INT, @BreakOver) = 0)  
        BEGIN  
          --UPDATE Existing Record  
          UPDATE #PalletsToChargeFor    
          SET StorageRateTypeFK = @StorageRateTypeFK,  
           StorageRate = @StorageRate,  
           BreakMethodFK = @BreakMethodFK,  
           StorageRateSubject = @StorageRateSubject,   
           TimePeriod = @TimePeriod,  
           RateSet = 1  
          WHERE #PalletsToChargeFor.StockItemPK = @StockItemPK AND  
             #PalletsToChargeFor.StorageRateTypeFK = -1 AND   
             CONVERT(INT,#PalletsToChargeFor.StorageRate) = 0 AND  
             #PalletsToChargeFor.RateSet = 0  
        END  
        ELSE  
        BEGIN  
          
         Select @StockItemNumberOfPallets = T.TotalPallets   
         From #PalletsToChargeFor T   
         Where T.StockItemPK = @StockItemPK AND   
            T.StorageRateTypeFK = -1 AND  
            CONVERT(INT, T.StorageRate) = 0 AND  
            T.RateSet = 0  
  
         -- Update Record If @StockItemNumberOfPallets Greather than @BreakOver  
         IF (@StockItemNumberOfPallets > CONVERT(INT, @BreakOver))  
  
          -- Update Existing Record  
          UPDATE #PalletsToChargeFor    
          SET StorageRateTypeFK = @StorageRateTypeFK,  
           StorageRate = @StorageRate,  
           BreakMethodFK = @BreakMethodFK,  
           StorageRateSubject = @StorageRateSubject,   
           TimePeriod = @TimePeriod,  
           RateSet = 1  
          WHERE #PalletsToChargeFor.StockItemPK = @StockItemPK AND  
             #PalletsToChargeFor.StorageRateTypeFK = -1 AND   
             CONVERT(INT, #PalletsToChargeFor.StorageRate) = 0 AND  
             #PalletsToChargeFor.RateSet = 0  
  
        END  
  
       ELSE  
        --Gradual Break Method  
         
        -- If @BreakOver = 0.000  
        IF (CONVERT(INT, @BreakOver) = 0)  
        BEGIN  
          --UPDATE Existing Record  
          UPDATE #PalletsToChargeFor    
          SET StorageRateTypeFK = @StorageRateTypeFK,  
           StorageRate = @StorageRate,  
           BreakMethodFK = @BreakMethodFK,  
           StorageRateSubject = @StorageRateSubject,   
           TimePeriod = @TimePeriod,  
           RateSet = 1  
          WHERE #PalletsToChargeFor.StockItemPK = @StockItemPK AND  
             #PalletsToChargeFor.StorageRateTypeFK = -1 AND   
             CONVERT(INT,#PalletsToChargeFor.StorageRate) = 0 AND  
             #PalletsToChargeFor.RateSet = 0  
        END  
        ELSE  
        BEGIN  
          
         Select @StockItemNumberOfPallets = T.TotalPallets   
         From #PalletsToChargeFor T   
         Where T.StockItemPK = @StockItemPK AND   
            T.StorageRateTypeFK = -1 AND  
            CONVERT(INT, T.StorageRate) = 0 AND  
            T.RateSet = 0  
  
         IF (@StockItemNumberOfPallets > @BreakOver)  
         BEGIN  
          
          --Create New Record in #PalletsToChargeFor  
          INSERT INTO #PalletsToChargeFor (StockItemPK, TotalPallets, StorageRateTypeFK, StorageRate,   
                   BreakMethodFK, BreakOver, StorageRateSubject, TimePeriod, RateSet)  
          SELECT  @StockItemPK,   
            (@StockItemNumberOfPallets - @BreakOver),  
            @StorageRateTypeFK,  
            @StorageRate,  
            @BreakMethodFK,  
            @BreakOver,  
            @StorageRateSubject,  
            @TimePeriod,  
            RateSet = 1  
          FROM #PalletsToChargeFor As T  
          WHERE T.StockItemPK = @StockItemPK AND   
            T.StorageRateTypeFK = -1 AND  
            CONVERT(INT, T.StorageRate) = 0 AND  
            T.RateSet = 0  
  
          -- Update Existing Record, TotalPallets Only  
          SET @RateSet = 0  
          UPDATE #PalletsToChargeFor    
          SET TotalPallets = @BreakOver  
          WHERE #PalletsToChargeFor.StockItemPK = @StockItemPK AND  
            #PalletsToChargeFor.StorageRateTypeFK = -1 AND   
            CONVERT(INT, #PalletsToChargeFor.StorageRate) = 0 AND  
            #PalletsToChargeFor.RateSet = 0  
        END  
       END  
  
       FETCH NEXT FROM @StockItemStorageRatesCursor INTO @StockItemPK, @StorageRateTypeFK, @StorageRate, @BreakMethodFK,   
                     @BreakOver, @StorageRateSubject, @TimePeriod  
      END  
        
     CLOSE @StockItemStorageRatesCursor  
     DEALLOCATE @StockItemStorageRatesCursor  
         
          
     IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#PalletsStorageDetails') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #PalletsStorageDetails  
  
     CREATE TABLE #PalletsStorageDetails  
     (  
      StorageRateTypeFK INT,  
      StorageRate DECIMAL(18,3),  
      PalletsToChargeFor INT,  
      BreakMethodFK INT,   
      BreakOver DECIMAL(18,3),  
      StorageRateSubject varchar(10),  
      TimePeriod varchar(50),  
      RateSet INT  
     )  
       
     INSERT INTO #PalletsStorageDetails (StorageRateTypeFK, StorageRate, PalletsToChargeFor, BreakMethodFK,   
              BreakOver, StorageRateSubject, TimePeriod, RateSet)  
      SELECT StorageRateTypeFK,  
        StorageRate,  
        SUM(TotalPallets) AS PalletsToChargeFor,  
        BreakMethodFK,   
        BreakOver,  
        StorageRateSubject,  
        TimePeriod,  
        RateSet  
      FROM #PalletsToChargeFor  
      GROUP BY StorageRateTypeFK,   
         StorageRate,   
         BreakMethodFK,   
         BreakOver,  
         StorageRateSubject,  
         TimePeriod,  
         RateSet  
  
     IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#DivisionMultipleStorageRates') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #DivisionMultipleStorageRates  
  
     --Insert Into Temp Table Records which Do Not have a RateSet  
     Select srs.StorageRateTypeFK,  
       srs.StorageRate,   
       srs.BreakMethodFK,  
       srs.BreakOver,  
       CASE WHEN ChargeByPallet = 1 /*cast(1 AS BIT)*/ THEN 'Pallet'   
         WHEN ChargeByEach = 1 /*cast(1 AS BIT)*/ THEN  'Each'   
         WHEN ChargeByUnit = 1 /*cast(1 AS BIT)*/ THEN  'Unit'   
       END As StorageRateSubject,  
       tps.TimePeriod,  
       0 As RateSet  
     Into #DivisionMultipleStorageRates  
     From            
      tblStorageRates AS srs  
      INNER JOIN appTimePeriods AS tps ON tps.TimePeriodPK = srs.ChargePeriodFK   
     WHERE srs.FK =  @var_divisionFK AND   
        srs.StorageRateTypeFK < 2  AND  
        ((@invoiceByCategory = 0 /*cast(0 AS BIT)*/ AND srs.SpecialStockTypeFK = @specialStockTypeFK) OR (@invoiceByCategory = 1) /*cast(1 AS BIT)*/)  
     Group By srs.StorageRateTypeFK, srs.StorageRate, srs.BreakMethodFK, srs.BreakOver,   
        srs.ChargeByPallet, srs.ChargeByEach, srs.ChargeByUnit, tps.TimePeriod,   
        srs.FK, srs.SpecialStockTypeFK   
     Order By srs.BreakOver Desc;  
  
     Declare @CountDivisionStorageRates INT  
     Select @CountDivisionStorageRates = Count(*) From #DivisionMultipleStorageRates  
   
     if(@CountDivisionStorageRates = 0)  
     begin   
     print '@CountDivisionStorageRates = 0'  
      UPDATE #PalletsStorageDetails  
      SET RateSet = 1  
     end  
     else IF (@CountDivisionStorageRates = 1)  
     BEGIN  
      -- StorageRateTypeFK < 2 (Division) And Single Storage Rate  
      -- Update #PalletsStorageDetails, Get Pallets which Use Single Division Storage Rate &&  Update #PalletsStorageDetails incl. RateSet  
      UPDATE #PalletsStorageDetails  
       SET StorageRateTypeFK = srs.StorageRateTypeFK,  
        StorageRate = srs.StorageRate,   
        BreakMethodFK = SRS.BreakMethodFK,  
        BreakOver = SRS.BreakOver,  
        StorageRateSubject = MultipleRates.StorageRateSubject,  
        TimePeriod = tps.TimePeriod,  
        RateSet = 1  
       FROM   
        tblStorageRates AS srs   
        INNER JOIN appTimePeriods AS tps ON tps.TimePeriodPK = srs.ChargePeriodFK  
        LEFT JOIN #DivisionMultipleStorageRates As MultipleRates On srs.StorageRate = srs.StorageRate  
       WHERE   
        srs.StorageRateTypeFK < 2 /*Division Storage Rate Type */  
        AND srs.FK = @var_divisionFK /* Division Parameter */  
        AND ((@invoiceByCategory = 0 /*cast(0 AS BIT)*/ AND SpecialStockTypeFK = @specialStockTypeFK) OR (@invoiceByCategory = 1) /*cast(1 AS BIT)*/)   
        --AND MultipleRates.StorageRate = NULL  
        --AND T.RateSet = 0  
     END  
     ELSE IF (@CountDivisionStorageRates > 1)  
     BEGIN  
        
      -- Declare Cursor to Loop temp Table #StockItemMultipleStorageRates  
      SET @DivisionStorageRatesCursor = CURSOR FAST_FORWARD FOR   
      SELECT StorageRateTypeFK, StorageRate, BreakMethodFK, BreakOver, StorageRateSubject, TimePeriod  
      FROM #DivisionMultipleStorageRates  
      ORDER BY StorageRateTypeFK, BreakOver Desc  
  
      -- Loop @DivisionStorageRatesCursor  
      OPEN @DivisionStorageRatesCursor  
      FETCH NEXT FROM @DivisionStorageRatesCursor INTO  @StorageRateTypeFK, @StorageRate, @BreakMethodFK,   
                   @BreakOver, @StorageRateSubject, @TimePeriod  
       WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0  
       BEGIN  
  
        --Blanket Break Method  
        IF (@BreakMethodFK = 1)  
            
         IF (CONVERT(INT, @BreakOver) = 0)  
         BEGIN  
           --UPDATE Existing Record  
           UPDATE #PalletsStorageDetails    
           SET StorageRateTypeFK = @StorageRateTypeFK,  
            StorageRate = @StorageRate,  
            BreakMethodFK = @BreakMethodFK,  
            StorageRateSubject = @StorageRateSubject,   
            TimePeriod = @TimePeriod,  
            RateSet = 1  
           WHERE #PalletsStorageDetails.StorageRateTypeFK = -1 AND   
              CONVERT(INT,#PalletsStorageDetails.StorageRate) = 0 AND  
              #PalletsStorageDetails.RateSet = 0  
         END  
         ELSE  
         BEGIN  
          
          Select @StockItemNumberOfPallets = T.PalletsToChargeFor   
          From #PalletsStorageDetails T   
          Where T.StorageRateTypeFK = -1 AND  
             CONVERT(INT, T.StorageRate) = 0 AND  
             T.RateSet = 0  
  
          -- Update Record If @StockItemNumberOfPallets Greather than @BreakOver  
          IF (@StockItemNumberOfPallets > CONVERT(INT, @BreakOver))  
  
           -- Update Existing Record,  
           UPDATE #PalletsStorageDetails    
           SET StorageRateTypeFK = @StorageRateTypeFK,  
            StorageRate = @StorageRate,  
            BreakMethodFK = @BreakMethodFK,  
            StorageRateSubject = @StorageRateSubject,   
            TimePeriod = @TimePeriod,  
            RateSet = 1  
           WHERE  #PalletsStorageDetails.StorageRateTypeFK = -1 AND   
             CONVERT(INT, #PalletsStorageDetails.StorageRate) = 0 AND  
             #PalletsStorageDetails.RateSet = 0  
  
         END  
        ELSE  
         -- Gradual Break Method  
  
         -- If @BreakOver, UPDATE Detail In Existing Record  
         IF (CONVERT(INT, @BreakOver) = 0)  
         BEGIN  
          --UPDATE  RateSet In Existing Record  
          UPDATE #PalletsStorageDetails    
          SET StorageRateTypeFK = @StorageRateTypeFK,  
           StorageRate = @StorageRate,  
           BreakMethodFK = @BreakMethodFK,  
           StorageRateSubject = @StorageRateSubject,   
           TimePeriod = @TimePeriod,  
           RateSet = 1  
          WHERE  #PalletsStorageDetails.StorageRateTypeFK < 2 AND  
            CONVERT(INT, #PalletsStorageDetails.StorageRate) = 0 AND  
            #PalletsStorageDetails.RateSet = 0  
         END  
         ELSE  
         BEGIN  
           
          Select @StockItemNumberOfPallets = T.PalletsToChargeFor   
          From #PalletsStorageDetails T   
          Where T.StorageRateTypeFK = -1 AND  
            CONVERT(INT, T.StorageRate) = 0 AND  
            T.RateSet = 0  
  
          IF (@StockItemNumberOfPallets > @BreakOver)  
          BEGIN  
           --Create New Line(s) in ##PalletsStorageDetails  
           INSERT INTO #PalletsStorageDetails (StorageRateTypeFK, StorageRate, PalletsToChargeFor, BreakMethodFK,   
                    BreakOver, StorageRateSubject, TimePeriod, RateSet)  
            SELECT @StorageRateTypeFK,  
              @StorageRate,  
              (@StockItemNumberOfPallets - @BreakOver),  
              @BreakMethodFK,  
              @BreakOver,  
              @StorageRateSubject,  
              @TimePeriod,  
              RateSet = 1  
            FROM #PalletsStorageDetails As T  
            WHERE T.StorageRateTypeFK < 2 AND  
              CONVERT(INT, T.StorageRate) = 0 AND  
              T.RateSet = 0  
  
           --UPDATE  Detail In Existing Record  
           UPDATE #PalletsStorageDetails    
           SET PalletsToChargeFor = @BreakOver  
           WHERE #PalletsStorageDetails.StorageRateTypeFK < 2 AND  
             CONVERT(INT, #PalletsStorageDetails.StorageRate) = 0 AND  
             #PalletsStorageDetails.RateSet = 0  
          END  
         END  
  
        FETCH NEXT FROM @DivisionStorageRatesCursor INTO @StorageRateTypeFK, @StorageRate, @BreakMethodFK,   
                     @BreakOver, @StorageRateSubject, @TimePeriod  
       END  
        
      CLOSE @DivisionStorageRatesCursor  
      DEALLOCATE @DivisionStorageRatesCursor  
  
     END   
  
     --check are storage rates the same, and combine into one total if they are  
     if((select count(*) from #PalletsStorageDetails) > 1)  
     begin  
      if((select count(*) from(select distinct StorageRateTypeFK, StorageRate, BreakMethodFK, BreakOver, StorageRateSubject, TimePeriod, RateSet from #PalletsStorageDetails)subq) = 1)  
      begin  
       declare @tmptotalPals decimal(18,3)  
       set @tmptotalPals = (select sum(PalletsToChargeFor) from #PalletsStorageDetails)  
  
       ;WITH cte AS  
       (  
       SELECT  *  
       FROM    #PalletsStorageDetails  
       ORDER BY PalletsToChargeFor  
       OFFSET 1 ROWS  
       )  
       DELETE cte ;  
  
       update #PalletsStorageDetails set  PalletsToChargeFor = @tmptotalPals  
      end  
     end  
    
       
     IF XACT_STATE() = 0 AND @@TRANCOUNT < 1 BEGIN TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName  
  
     INSERT INTO tblInvoiceLines (InvoiceFK, DivisionFK, InvoiceLineTypeFK,   
             BuildingUnitFK,   
             InvoiceLineStatusFK, NominalCode,   
             Charge, ChargeText, ChargeText1, ChargeText2, ChargeText3, ChargeText4,  
                VatCodeFK, TaxRate, Tax,   
             IsArchived, InsertedBy, InsertedDate, UpdatedBy, UpdatedDate, DepartmentFK)  
     --INSERT INTO tblInvoiceLines  
     SELECT   
      @var_invoiceFK,  
      @var_divisionFK,  
      1/* Storage Invoice Line Type, appInvoiceLineTypes */,   
      @var_buildingUnitFK,  
      1/*Generated*/,  
      @storageNominalCode,  
      ROUND((Pallets.StorageRate * Pallets.PalletsToChargeFor), 2), --ISNULL(ROUND((StorageRate * PalletsToChargeFor), 2), 0), Pallets.PalletsToChargeFor  
      'Storage Charges ON ' + CASE WHEN (@invoiceByCategory = 0 /*cast(0 AS BIT)*/ AND @specialStockTypeFK <> -1) THEN '(' + @specialStockType + ')'   
              WHEN (@invoiceByCategory = 1 /*cast(1 AS BIT)*/ AND @stockItemCategoryFK <> -1) THEN '(' + @stockItemCategory + ')'   
              ELSE ''   
            END,  
      CAST(Pallets.PalletsToChargeFor AS NVARCHAR(50)),  
      CASE WHEN Pallets.PalletsToChargeFor = 1 THEN 'Pallet' ELSE 'Pallets' END,   
      '@ ' + CAST(ROUND(Pallets.StorageRate, 2) AS VARCHAR(50)),  --'@ ' + CAST(CAST(StorageRate AS DECIMAL(18,3)) AS VARCHAR(50)),  
      'Per ' + ISNULL(Pallets.StorageRateSubject,'') + ' Per ' +  ISNULL(Pallets.TimePeriod,'') ,  
      ISNULL(@vatCodeFK,-1),  
      ISNULL(@taxRate, 0),  
      ROUND(((@taxRate/100) * ROUND((Pallets.StorageRate * Pallets.PalletsToChargeFor), 2)), 2),  
      0,  
      1,   
      dbo.GetBSTDate(),   
      1,   
      dbo.GetBSTDate(),  
      @var_departmentFK  
     FROM #PalletsStorageDetails Pallets  
     WHERE Pallets.RateSet = 1  
  
     
     /******  HANDLING  ******/  
     /*HANDLING IN*/  
     IF(ISNULL(@palletsIn, 0) > 0 AND ISNULL(@HandlingInEachesTypeFK,0) < 1) -- Pallets  
     BEGIN  
      SELECT @handlingInCharge = ISNULL(@palletsIn, 0) * @handlingInRate  
  
      SET @chargeText = 'Handling In Charges ON ' + CASE WHEN (@invoiceByCategory = 0 /*cast(0 AS BIT)*/ AND @specialStockTypeFK <> -1) THEN   
       '(' + @specialStockType + ')' WHEN (@invoiceByCategory = 1 /*cast(1 AS BIT)*/ AND @stockItemCategoryFK <> -1) THEN   
        '(' + @stockItemCategory + ')' ELSE '' END   
  
      SET @chargeText1 = CAST(@palletsIn AS NVARCHAR(50))  
      SET @chargeText2 = CASE WHEN @palletsIn = 1 THEN 'Pallet' ELSE 'Pallets' END  
      SET @chargetext3 = '@ ' +  CAST(CAST(@handlingInRate AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS NVARCHAR(50))  
      SET @chargeText4 = 'Per Pallet'  
  
      --print 'inserting handling in charge'  
      --print @handlingInCharge  
        
      SET @handlingInCharge = ISNULL(@handlingInCharge, 0)  
      SET @vatCodeFK = ISNULL(@vatCodeFK,-1)  
      SET @taxRate = ISNULL(@taxRate,0)  
      SET @chargeText1 = ISNULL(@chargeText1,'')  
      SET @chargeText2 = ISNULL(@chargeText2,'')  
      SET @chargeText3 = ISNULL(@chargeText3,'')  
      SET @chargeText4 = ISNULL(@chargeText4,'')  
  
      IF XACT_STATE() = 0 AND @@TRANCOUNT < 1 BEGIN TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName  
            
      INSERT INTO tblInvoiceLines  
      VALUES(  
         @var_invoiceFK,   
         @var_divisionFK,   
         5/*HandlingInPK*/,   
         @var_buildingUnitFK,   
         1/*Generated*/,   
         @handlingInNominalCode,   
         @handlingInCharge,   
         @chargeText,  
         @chargeText1,  
         @chargeText2,   
         @chargeText3,  
         @chargeText4,   
         @vatCodeFK,  
         @taxRate,  
         ROUND(((@taxRate/100) * @handlingInCharge),2),  
         0 /*cast(1 AS BIT)*/,   
         1,   
         dbo.GetBSTDate(),   
         1,   
         dbo.GetBSTDate(),  
         @var_departmentFK  
        )  
     END  
     ELSE IF(ISNULL(@eachesIN, 0) > 0 AND ISNULL(@HandlingInEachesTypeFK,0) > 0) -- Eaches  
     BEGIN  
      SELECT @handlingInCharge = ISNULL(@eachesIN, 0) * @handlingInRate  
  
      SET @chargeText = 'Handling In Charges ON ' + CASE WHEN (@invoiceByCategory = 0 /*cast(0 AS BIT)*/ AND @specialStockTypeFK <> -1) THEN   
       '(' + @specialStockType + ')' WHEN (@invoiceByCategory = 1 /*cast(1 AS BIT)*/ AND @stockItemCategoryFK <> -1) THEN   
        '(' + @stockItemCategory + ')' ELSE '' END   
  
      SET @chargeText1 = CAST(@eachesIN AS NVARCHAR(200))  
  
      SELECT @chargeText2 = CASE WHEN @eachesIN = 1 THEN EachesTypeSingular ELSE EachesType END   
      FROM tblEachesTypes WHERE EachesType = @handlingInEachesTypeCode  
  
      SET @chargetext3 = '@ ' +  CAST(CAST(@handlingInRate AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS NVARCHAR(50))  
  
      SELECT @chargeText4 = 'Per ' + EachesTypeSingular   
      FROM tblEachesTypes WHERE EachesType = @handlingInEachesTypeCode  
  
      --print 'inserting handling in charge'  
      --print @handlingInCharge  
        
      SET @handlingInCharge = ISNULL(@handlingInCharge, 0)  
      SET @vatCodeFK = ISNULL(@vatCodeFK,-1)  
      SET @taxRate = ISNULL(@taxRate,0)  
      SET @chargeText1 = ISNULL(@chargeText1,'')  
      SET @chargeText2 = ISNULL(@chargeText2,'')  
      SET @chargeText3 = ISNULL(@chargeText3,'')  
      SET @chargeText4 = ISNULL(@chargeText4,'')  
  
      IF XACT_STATE() = 0 AND @@TRANCOUNT < 1 BEGIN TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName  
            
      INSERT INTO tblInvoiceLines  
      VALUES(  
         @var_invoiceFK,   
         @var_divisionFK,   
         5/*HandlingIn*/,   
         @var_buildingUnitFK,  
         1/*Generated*/,  
         @handlingInNominalCode,   
         @handlingInCharge,  
         @chargeText,  
         @chargeText1,   
         @chargeText2,   
         @chargeText3,   
         @chargeText4,   
         @vatCodeFK,   
         @taxRate,  
         ROUND(((@taxRate/100) * @handlingInCharge),2),  
         0 /*cast(1 AS BIT)*/,   
         1,   
         dbo.GetBSTDate(),   
         1,   
         dbo.GetBSTDate(),  
         @var_departmentFK  
        )  
     END  
  
     /*HANDLING OUT*/  
     IF(ISNULL(@palletsOut, 0) > 0 AND ISNULL(@HandlingOutEachesTypeFK,0) < 1) -- Pallets  
     BEGIN  
      SELECT @handlingOutCharge = ISNULL(@palletsOut, 0) * @handlingOutRate  
  
      SET @chargeText = 'Handling Out Charges ON ' + CASE WHEN (@invoiceByCategory = 0 /*cast(0 AS BIT)*/ AND @specialStockTypeFK <> -1) THEN   
       '(' + @specialStockType + ')' WHEN (@invoiceByCategory = 1 /*cast(1 AS BIT)*/ AND @stockItemCategoryFK <> -1) THEN   
        '(' + @stockItemCategory + ')' ELSE '' END   
  
      SET @chargeText1 = CAST(@palletsOut AS NVARCHAR(50))  
      SET @chargeText2 = CASE WHEN @palletsOut = 1 THEN 'Pallet' ELSE 'Pallets' END  
      SET @chargeText3 = '@ ' + CAST(CAST(@handlingOutRate AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS NVARCHAR(50))  
      SET @chargeText4 = 'Per Pallet'  
  
      SET @handlingOutCharge = ISNULL(@handlingOutCharge, 0)  
      SET @vatCodeFK = ISNULL(@vatCodeFK,-1)  
      SET @taxRate = ISNULL(@taxRate,0)  
      SET @chargeText1 = ISNULL(@chargeText1,'')  
      SET @chargeText2 = ISNULL(@chargeText2,'')  
      SET @chargeText3 = ISNULL(@chargeText3,'')  
      SET @chargeText4 = ISNULL(@chargeText4,'')  
  
      --print 'inserting handling out charge'  
      --print @handlingOutCharge    
  
      IF XACT_STATE() = 0 AND @@TRANCOUNT < 1 BEGIN TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName  
  
      INSERT INTO tblInvoiceLines  
      VALUES(  
         @var_invoiceFK,   
         @var_divisionFK,   
         15/*HandlingOut*/,   
         @var_buildingUnitFK,   
         1/*Generated*/,   
         @handlingOutNominalCode,   
         @handlingOutCharge,   
         @chargeText,   
         @chargeText1,   
         @chargeText2,   
         @chargeText3,   
         @chargeText4,   
         @vatCodeFK,   
         @taxRate,  
         ROUND(((@taxRate/100) * @handlingOutCharge),2),  
         0 /*cast(0 AS BIT)*/,   
         1,   
         dbo.GetBSTDate(),   
         1,   
         dbo.GetBSTDate(),   
         @var_departmentFK  
        )  
     END  
     ELSE IF(ISNULL(@eachesOut, 0) > 0 AND ISNULL(@HandlingOutEachesTypeFK,0) > 0) -- Eaches  
     BEGIN  
      SELECT @handlingOutCharge = ISNULL(@eachesOut, 0) * @handlingOutRate  
  
      SET @chargeText = 'Handling Out Charges ON ' + CASE WHEN (@invoiceByCategory = 0 /*cast(0 AS BIT)*/ AND @specialStockTypeFK <> -1) THEN   
       '(' + @specialStockType + ')' WHEN (@invoiceByCategory = 1 /*cast(1 AS BIT)*/ AND @stockItemCategoryFK <> -1) THEN   
        '(' + @stockItemCategory + ')' ELSE '' END   
  
      SET @chargeText1 = CAST(@eachesOut AS NVARCHAR(200))  
  
      SELECT @chargeText2 = CASE WHEN @eachesIN = 1 THEN EachesTypeSingular ELSE EachesType END   
      FROM tblEachesTypes WHERE EachesType = @handlingOutEachesTypeCode  
  
      SET @chargeText3 = '@ ' + CAST(CAST(@handlingOutRate AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS NVARCHAR(50))  
  
      SELECT @chargeText4 = 'Per ' + EachesTypeSingular   
      FROM tblEachesTypes WHERE EachesType = @handlingOutEachesTypeCode  
  
      SET @handlingOutCharge = ISNULL(@handlingOutCharge, 0)  
      SET @vatCodeFK = ISNULL(@vatCodeFK,-1)  
      SET @taxRate = ISNULL(@taxRate,0)  
      SET @chargeText1 = ISNULL(@chargeText1,'')  
      SET @chargeText2 = ISNULL(@chargeText2,'')  
      SET @chargeText3 = ISNULL(@chargeText3,'')  
      SET @chargeText4 = ISNULL(@chargeText4,'')  
  
      --print 'inserting handling out charge'  
      --print @handlingOutCharge   
  
      IF XACT_STATE() = 0 AND @@TRANCOUNT < 1 BEGIN TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName  
  
      INSERT INTO tblInvoiceLines  
      VALUES(  
         @var_invoiceFK,  
         @var_divisionFK,   
         15/*HandlingOut*/,   
         @var_buildingUnitFK,   
         1/*Generated*/,  
         @handlingOutNominalCode,   
         @handlingOutCharge,   
         @chargeText,   
         @chargeText1,   
         @chargeText2,   
         @chargeText3,   
         @chargeText4,   
         @vatCodeFK,   
         @taxRate,  
         ROUND(((@taxRate/100) * @handlingOutCharge),2),  
         0 /*cast(0 AS BIT)*/,   
         1,   
         dbo.GetBSTDate(),  
         1,   
         dbo.GetBSTDate(),  
         @var_departmentFK  
        )  
     END  
  
     FETCH NEXT FROM InvoiceSeparatorCursor INTO @specialStockTypeFK, @specialStockType, @stockItemCategoryFK, @stockItemCategory  
    END /*End of Special Stock Cursor*/  
  
    CLOSE InvoiceSeparatorCursor  
    DEALLOCATE InvoiceSeparatorCursor  
   END  
  
   --IF (@var_InvoiceExtraServicesCharge2 = 1)  
   IF(@var_options & 4 = 4)  
    BEGIN --EXTRA SERVICES  
    SELECT TOP 1 @lastExtraService = InvoiceToDate   
    FROM tblInvoices AS invs  
    INNER JOIN tblInvoiceLines AS invls ON  
    invls.InvoiceFK = invs.InvoicePK  
    WHERE invls.DivisionFK = @var_divisionFK  
    AND invs.Options & 4 = 4  
    --AND invs.ExtraServicesCharges = 1 /* invs.Options Has Been Replaced By Individual Charge Flags. */  
    AND invs.InvoiceTypeFK = 3    /* Scheduled Invoice. */    
    and invoicepk <> @var_invoiceFK  
    ORDER BY InvoiceToDate DESC  
    
    --print 'inserting extra service charge'  
  
    IF XACT_STATE() = 0 AND @@TRANCOUNT < 1 BEGIN TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName  
  
    SET @vatCodeFK = ISNULL(@vatCodeFK,-1)  
    SET @taxRate = ISNULL(@taxRate,0)  
  
    INSERT INTO tblInvoiceLines  
    SELECT   
    DISTINCT @var_invoiceFK,   
    @var_divisionFK,   
    2/*Extra Services*/,   
    @var_buildingUnitFK,   
    1/*Generated*/,   
    ISNULL(escs.NominalCode, @extraServicesNominalCode),   
    ess.Charge,   
    ess.[Name] + ', ' + Reference + CASE WHEN sics.StockItemCategoryPK is null THEN '' ELSE ', ' + sics.StockItemCategory END,   
    CAST(NumberOf AS NVARCHAR(50)),   
    ISNULL(chargeSubjects.ChargeSubject, ''),   
    '@ ' + CAST(CAST((ess.Charge / ess.NumberOf) AS DECIMAL(18,3)) AS NVARCHAR(50)),   
    'Per ' + ISNULL(chargeSubjects.ChargeSubject, ''),  
    @vatCodeFK,   
    @taxRate,   
    ROUND(((@taxRate/100) * ess.Charge),2),  
    0 /*cast(0 AS BIT)*/,   
    1, dbo.GetBSTDate(), 1, dbo.GetBSTDate(),   
    @var_departmentFK  
    FROM   
    tblExtraServices AS ess  
    LEFT OUTER JOIN tblDivisionExtraServices AS dess ON  
    dess.DivisionExtraServicePK = ess.DivisionExtraServiceFK  
    LEFT OUTER JOIN appChargeSubjects AS chargeSubjects ON  
    chargeSubjects.ChargeSubjectPK = dess.ChargeSubjectFK  
    LEFT OUTER JOIN tblExtraServiceCodes AS escs ON  
    escs.ExtraServiceCodePK = dess.ExtraServiceCodeFK  
    LEFT OUTER JOIN tblStockItems AS sis ON  
    sis.StockItemPK = ess.StockItemFK  
    LEFT OUTER JOIN tblStockItemCategories AS sics ON  
    sics.StockItemCategoryPK = sis.StockItemCategoryFK  
    WHERE   
    CONVERT(VARCHAR(50), ess.ExtraServiceDate, 112) > CONVERT(VARCHAR(50), @lastExtraService, 112)  
    AND CONVERT(VARCHAR(50), ess.ExtraServiceDate, 112) <= CONVERT(VARCHAR(50), @var_invoiceTo, 112)  
    AND ess.DivisionFK = @var_divisionFK   
    AND ess.Charge > 0 AND ess.NumberOf > 0 -- ignore zero's  
   END  
  
   --IF (@var_InvoiceDistributionCharge2 = 1)   
   IF (@var_options & 8 = 8)  
   BEGIN --DISTRIBUTION CHARGES  
    SELECT Top 1 @lastDistributionCharge = InvoiceToDate   
    FROM tblInvoices  
    WHERE DivisionFK = @var_divisionFK  
    AND Options & 8 = 8  
    --AND DistributionCharges = 1 /* invs.Options Has Been Replaced By Individual Charge Flags. */  
    AND InvoiceTypeFK = 3    /* Scheduled Invoice. */    
    and invoicepk <> @var_invoiceFK  
    ORDER BY InvoiceToDate Desc  
  
    --SELECT @distributionCharge = SUM(Charge)   
    --FROM tblContainerOutDistributionCharges AS codcs  
    --INNER JOIN tblContainerOutLines AS cols   
    --ON cols.ContainerOutFK = codcs.ContainerOutFK  
  
    ---- 05 September 2018 Cathal OCuirrin : This code ensure only completed stock outs are included.  
    --inner join tblcontainerouts as co  
    --on cols.ContainerOutFK = co.ContainerOutPK  
    --and co.ContainerOutStatusFK = 5 /*Completed*/  
  
    --WHERE CONVERT(VARCHAR(50), codcs.InsertedDate, 112) > CONVERT(VARCHAR(50), @lastDistributionCharge, 112)  
    --AND CONVERT(VARCHAR(50), codcs.InsertedDate, 112) <= CONVERT(VARCHAR(50), @var_invoiceTo, 112)  
    --AND cols.DivisionFK = @var_divisionFK  
  
     SELECT distinct codcs.*-- @distributionCharge = SUM(Charge)      
    into #tmpdistcharges  
    FROM tblContainerOutDistributionCharges AS codcs    
    INNER JOIN tblContainerOutLines AS cols     
    ON cols.ContainerOutFK = codcs.ContainerOutFK      
    -- 05 September 2018 Cathal OCuirrin : This code ensure only completed stock outs are included.    
    inner join tblcontainerouts as co    
    on cols.ContainerOutFK = co.ContainerOutPK    
    and co.ContainerOutStatusFK = 5 /*Completed*/    
    
    WHERE CONVERT(VARCHAR(50), codcs.InsertedDate, 112) > CONVERT(VARCHAR(50), @lastDistributionCharge, 112)    
    AND CONVERT(VARCHAR(50), codcs.InsertedDate, 112) <= CONVERT(VARCHAR(50), @var_invoiceTo, 112)    
    AND cols.DivisionFK = @var_divisionFK    
  
    select @distributionCharge = SUM(totalCharge)   from #tmpdistcharges  
    
    SET @chargeText = 'Order Processing and Distribution Charges'  
  
    --print 'inserting distribution charge'  
    --print @distributionCharge   
      
    SET @distributionCharge = ISNULL(@distributionCharge, 0)  
    SET @vatCodeFK = ISNULL(@vatCodeFK,-1)  
    SET @taxRate = ISNULL(@taxRate,0)  
  
    IF XACT_STATE() = 0 AND @@TRANCOUNT < 1 BEGIN TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName  
  
    INSERT INTO tblInvoiceLines  
    VALUES(  @var_invoiceFK,   
       @var_divisionFK,   
       3/*DistributionCharges*/,  
       @var_buildingUnitFK,  
       1/*Generated*/,   
       @distributionChargeNominalCode,   
       @distributionCharge,   
       @chargeText,   
       '',  
       '',  
       '',  
       '',   
       @taxRate,  
       @vatCodeFK,  
       ROUND(((@taxRate/100) * @distributionCharge),2),  
       0 /*cast(0 AS BIT)*/,   
       1,   
       dbo.GetBSTDate(),   
       1,   
       dbo.GetBSTDate(),  
       @var_departmentFK  
      )  
   END  
  
   --IF(@var_InvoiceRecurringCharge2 = 1)  
   IF (@var_options & 16 = 16)   
   BEGIN --RECURRING CHARGES  
    --print 'inserting recurring charges'  
  
    IF XACT_STATE() = 0 AND @@TRANCOUNT < 1 BEGIN TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName  
  
    INSERT INTO tblInvoiceLines   
    SELECT   
     @var_invoiceFK,   
     @var_divisionFK,   
     1/*InvoiceLineType - Storage*/,   
     -1 /*BuildingUnitFK*/,  
     1 /*LineStatus - Generated*/,  
     ilts.NominalCode,  
     ircs.Charge,  
     ircs.ChargeText,  
     ircs.ChargeText1,   
     ircs.ChargeText2,  
     --ircs.ChargeText3,  
     CASE When SUBSTRING(Trim(ChargeText3), 1, 1) != '@'   
       THEN '@ ' + ChargeText3  
       ELSE Trim(ChargeText3)  
       End As ChargeText3,  
     ircs.ChargeText4,  
     ircs.VatCodeFK,  
     vcs.[Value],  
     ROUND(((vcs.[Value]/100) * ircs.Charge),2),  
     0 /*cast(1 AS BIT)*/,   
     1,   
     dbo.GetBSTDate(),   
     1,   
     dbo.GetBSTDate(),   
     -1 /*DepartmentFK*/  
    FROM   
     tblInvoiceRecurringCharges AS ircs  
    INNER JOIN appInvoiceLineTypes AS ilts ON  
     ilts.InvoiceLineTypePK = ircs.InvoiceLineTypeFK  
    INNER JOIN tblVatCodes AS vcs ON  
     vcs.VatCodePK = ircs.VatCodeFK  
    WHERE   
     DivisionFK = @var_divisionFK  
     AND ircs.[Enabled] = 1 /*cast(1 AS BIT)*/  
     AND ircs.RecurringChargeInAdvance = 0  /* Do Not Charge for Recurring Charges Set To Charge In Advance */  
   END  
  
     
   --SELECT SUM(Charge) AS Charge, SUM(Tax) AS Tax   
   --FROM (  
   -- SELECT * FROM (SELECT 0 AS Charge, 0 AS Tax) AS zeroStart  
   -- UNION ALL  
   -- SELECT Charge, Tax FROM tblInvoiceLines WHERE InvoiceFK = @var_invoiceFK  
   --) AS subQ  
  
EXIT_SP:  
  
   SELECT SUM(Charge) AS Charge, SUM(Tax) AS Tax   
   FROM ( SELECT * FROM (  
     SELECT 0 AS Charge, 0 AS Tax) AS zeroStart  
     UNION ALL  
     SELECT Sum(Charge) As Charge, (Sum (Charge)*(TaxRate/100)) As Tax  
     From tblInvoiceLines  
     Where InvoiceFK = @var_invoiceFK  
     Group By TaxRate  
    ) AS subQ  
  
            -- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end  
  
--EXIT_SP:  
  
   BEGIN TRY IF XACT_STATE() = 1 AND @@TRANCOUNT = 1 AND @OpeningTranCount < 1 COMMIT TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH  
  
   BREAK  
  END TRY  
  BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */   
   DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;  
  
   SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE();  
   SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;  
  
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY  
  
   BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;  
         
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;  
  
            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID  
              
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;  
              
   IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)  
   BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END  
   ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */     
  END CATCH  
  SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1  
 END  
END  
GO

   --  mode is determined by the configured storage rates.

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spInvoiceCreateLines_PalletType]        
(        
 @divisionFK int,        
 @invoiceTo datetime,        
 @options int,        
 --@invoiceStorageCharge bit,        
 --@invoiceExtraServicesCharge bit,        
 --@invoiceDistributionCharge bit,        
 --@invoiceRecurringCharge bit,        
 @invoiceFK int,        
 @buildingUnitFK int = -1,        
 @departmentFK int = -1        
)        
AS        
BEGIN        
 /* Prevent extra result sets FROM interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data; Ensure this proc has a low impact when executed */        
     SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED; SET DEADLOCK_PRIORITY LOW        
        
    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT        
 ,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;        
 SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();        
        
 -- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters        
 DECLARE @var_divisionFK INT, @var_invoiceTo DATETIME, @var_options INT, @var_invoiceFK INT, @var_buildingUnitFK INT, @var_departmentFK INT        
 DECLARE @var_InvoiceStorageCharge2 bit, @var_InvoiceExtraServicesCharge2 bit, @var_InvoiceDistributionCharge2 bit, @var_InvoiceRecurringCharge2 bit         
        
 SET @var_divisionFK = @divisionFK; SET @var_invoiceTo = @invoiceTo; SET @var_invoiceFK = @invoiceFK;         
 SET @var_buildingUnitFK = @buildingUnitFK; SET @var_departmentFK = @departmentFK         
 SET @var_options = @options;        
 --SET @var_InvoiceStorageCharge2 = @invoiceStorageCharge;         
 --SET @var_InvoiceExtraServicesCharge2 = @invoiceExtraServicesCharge;         
 --SET @var_InvoiceDistributionCharge2 = @invoiceDistributionCharge;        
 --SET @var_InvoiceRecurringCharge2 = @invoiceRecurringCharge;        
        
        
 SET @ParameterDetails = '@divisionFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_divisionFK AS NVARCHAR(30)),'')         
  + ',@invoiceTo = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_invoiceTo AS NVARCHAR(30)),'')        
  -- + ',@options = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_options AS NVARCHAR(30)),'')         
  + ',@invoiceFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_invoiceFK AS NVARCHAR(30)),'')        
  + ',@buildingUnitFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_buildingUnitFK AS NVARCHAR(30)),'')        
  + ',@departmentFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_departmentFK AS NVARCHAR(30)),'')        
  --+ ',@invoiceStorageCharge = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_InvoiceStorageCharge2 AS NVARCHAR(1)),'')        
  --+ ',@invoiceExtraServicesCharge = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_InvoiceExtraServicesCharge2 AS NVARCHAR(1)),'')        
  --+ ',@invoiceDistributionCharge = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_InvoiceDistributionCharge2 AS NVARCHAR(1)),'')        
  --+ ',@invoiceRecurringCharge = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_InvoiceRecurringCharge2 AS NVARCHAR(1)),'')        
        
    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL         
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)        
        
    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)        
 --BEGIN        
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC         
        
  SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)        
        
        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)        
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK        
        
        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()        
 --END        
        
 SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);        
 SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName)        
 IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails        
 ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;        
 INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK        
 SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()        
         
 WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3        
 BEGIN         
  BEGIN TRY           
        
   -- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start        
        
   -- Ensure the temporary invoice number always has a valid value.        
   IF @var_invoiceFK > 0        
   BEGIN        
    IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM dbo.tblInvoices WHERE InvoicePK = @var_invoiceFK AND ISNULL(InvoiceNumber,'') = '')        
    BEGIN        
     DECLARE @InvoiceNumber NVARCHAR(200) = ''        
                             
     IF XACT_STATE() = 0 AND @@TRANCOUNT < 1 BEGIN TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName        
        
     -- Get the temporary invoice number FROM the appSystem table.         
     -- Lock the table to ensure no other code changes this value until this stored procedure has finished executing.        
     SELECT @InvoiceNumber = 'TMP' + CAST(NextInvoiceTempNumber AS NVARCHAR(200)) FROM dbo.appSystem WITH (ROWLOCK)             
        
     -- Increment the value in the appSystem table.        
     UPDATE dbo.appSystem WITH (ROWLOCK)        
     SET NextInvoiceTempNumber = NextInvoiceTempNumber + 1        
        
     -- Add the temporary invoice number to the specific row in the tblInvoices table.        
     UPDATE dbo.tblInvoices WITH (ROWLOCK)        
     SET InvoiceNumber = @InvoiceNumber        
     WHERE InvoicePK = @var_invoiceFK         
    END        
   END        
        
   /* LOAD INVOICE CONFIGURATION                    
            -- Load the nominal codes, currency, VAT information and division        
            -- configuration required to create the invoice lines.        
            --        
            -- These settings determine how storage, handling, distribution and        
            -- other charges will be represented on the invoice.        
            */        
        
   DECLARE @ret INT = 0, @lastStorage DATETIME, @lastExtraService DATETIME, @lastDistributionCharge DATETIME, @lastRecurringCharge DATETIME,        
   @openingPallets INT, @closingPallets INT, @palletsIn INT, @palletsOut INT, @totalPalletsIn INT, @totalPalletsOut INT,         
   @totalPalletsDepleated INT, @palletsDepleated INT, @eachesOut INT, @customerFK INT, @specialStockTypeFK INT,         
   @specialStockType NVARCHAR(100), @stockItemCategoryFK INT, @stockItemCategory NVARCHAR(100), @invoiceMethodFK INT,        
   @invoiceByCategory BIT, @taxRate DECIMAL(18,3), @vatCodeFK INT, @storageCharge DECIMAL(18,3), @handlingInCharge DECIMAL(18,3),  @handlingOutCharge DECIMAL(18,3),         
   @handlingInRate DECIMAL(18,3), @handlingOutRate DECIMAL(18,3), @extraServiceCharge DECIMAL(18,3), @distributionCharge DECIMAL(18,3),        
   @taxCharge DECIMAL(18,3), @storageNominalCode NVARCHAR(50), @extraServicesNominalCode NVARCHAR(50),         
   @distributionChargeNominalCode NVARCHAR(50), @transportNominalCode NVARCHAR(50), @handlingInNominalCode NVARCHAR(50), @handlingOutNominalCode NVARCHAR(50),        
   @invoiceCurrencySymbol NVARCHAR(10), @handlingInEachesTypeFK INT = -1, @handlingInUnitTypeFK INT = -1, @handlingOutEachesTypeFK INT = -1,         
   @handlingOutUnitTypeFK INT = -1, @handlingInEachesTypeCode NVARCHAR(200), @handlingInUnitTypeCode NVARCHAR(200),         
   @handlingOutEachesTypeCode NVARCHAR(200), @handlingOutUnitTypeCode NVARCHAR(200), @eachesIn INT = -1, @palletsToChargeForByStorageRateType INT,
