   @storageRate DECIMAL(18,2), @storageRateSubject NVARCHAR(50), @storageRatePeriod NVARCHAR(50), @breakOver DECIMAL(18,3),        
   @chargeText NVARCHAR(1000), @chargeText1 NVARCHAR(100), @chargeText2 NVARCHAR(100), @chargeText3 NVARCHAR(100), @chargeText4 NVARCHAR(100),        
   @invoiceFrequencyFK INT, @currentPalletContent INT, @currentPalletAudit INT, @SQL NVARCHAR(4000), @PalletsToChargeFor INT, @BreakMethodFK INT        
        
   SELECT @storageNominalCode = NominalCode FROM appInvoiceLineTypes WHERE InvoiceLineTypePK = 1/*Storage*/        
   SELECT @extraServicesNominalCode = NominalCode FROM appInvoiceLineTypes WHERE InvoiceLineTypePK = 2/*ExtraServices*/        
   SELECT @distributionChargeNominalCode = NominalCode FROM appInvoiceLineTypes WHERE InvoiceLineTypePK = 3/*DistributionCharge*/        
   SELECT @transportNominalCode = NominalCode FROM appInvoiceLineTypes WHERE InvoiceLineTypePK = 4/*Transport*/        
   SELECT @handlingInNominalCode = NominalCode FROM appInvoiceLineTypes WHERE InvoiceLineTypePK = 5/*HandlingIn*/        
   SELECT @handlingOutNominalCode = NominalCode FROM appInvoiceLineTypes WHERE InvoiceLineTypePK = 15/*HandlingOut*/        
        
   SET @invoiceCurrencySymbol = (SELECT TOP 1 currencies.CurrencySymbol FROM appSystem AS [system]         
   INNER JOIN tblCurrencies currencies ON currencies.CurrencyPK = [system].InvoiceCurrencyFK)        
           
   /* Load division-level invoice settings includes:Customer ,VAT rate/code  ,Invoice-by-category setting        
                ,Handling-in/out rates,Handling-in/out unit/eaches configuration        
             */        
   SELECT         
    @taxRate= vatCodes.[Value],         
    @vatCodeFK = divisions.VatCodeFK,        
    @customerFK = divisions.CustomerFK,        
    @invoiceByCategory = divisions.InvoiceByCategory,        
        
    @handlingInRate = divisions.HandlingInCharge,        
    @handlingOutRate = divisions.HandlingOutCharge,        
        
    @HandlingInEachesTypeFK = divisions.HandlingInEachesTypeFK,            
    @HandlingOutEachesTypeFK = divisions.HandlingOutEachesTypeFK,        
        
    @HandlingInUnitTypeFK = divisions.HandlingInUnitTypeFK,        
    @HandlingOutUnitTypeFK = divisions.HandlingOutUnitTypeFK,        
        
    @HandlingInEachesTypeCode = handlingInEachesTypes.EachesType,        
    @HandlingOutEachesTypeCode = handlingOutEachesTypes.EachesType,        
        
    @HandlingInUnitTypeCode = handlingInUnitTypes.Abbreviation,        
    @HandlingOutUnitTypeCode = handlingOutUnitTypes.Abbreviation        
   FROM       
    tblDivisions AS divisions        
   INNER JOIN tblVatCodes AS vatCodes        
    ON vatCodes.VatCodePK = divisions.VatCodeFK        
   LEFT OUTER JOIN tblEachesTypes AS handlingInEachesTypes        
    ON divisions.HandlingInEachesTypeFK = handlingInEachesTypes.EachesTypePK        
   LEFT OUTER JOIN tblEachesTypes AS handlingOutEachesTypes        
    ON divisions.HandlingOutEachesTypeFK = handlingOutEachesTypes.EachesTypePK        
   LEFT OUTER JOIN tblUnitTypes AS handlingInUnitTypes        
    ON divisions.HandlingInUnitTypeFK = handlingInUnitTypes.UnitTypePK        
   LEFT OUTER JOIN tblUnitTypes AS handlingOutUnitTypes        
    ON divisions.HandlingOutUnitTypeFK = handlingOutUnitTypes.UnitTypePK        
   WHERE         
    divisions.DivisionPK = @var_divisionFK        
        
   IF ISNULL(@HandlingInUnitTypeFK, 0) > 0         
   BEGIN        
    IF XACT_STATE() = 0 AND @@TRANCOUNT < 1 BEGIN TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName            
        
    EXEC dbo.spInvoiceCreateLinesChargeByUnit @var_divisionFK,         
                @var_invoiceTo,         
                @var_options,        
                --@var_InvoiceStorageCharge2,        
                --@var_InvoiceExtraServicesCharge2,        
                --@var_InvoiceDistributionCharge2,        
                --@var_InvoiceRecurringCharge2,        
                @var_invoiceFK,         
                   @var_buildingUnitFK,         
                @var_departmentFK        
    GOTO EXIT_SP        
   END        
        
          
            /* SET INVOICE PERIOD END DATE        
   Add one day to the invoice-to date so that records occurring        
             during the complete invoice-to date are included in the calculations        
            */         
   SET @var_invoiceTo = DATEADD(day,1,@var_invoiceTo)        
        
   /* Determine the start of the storage charging period based on the customer's invoice frequency.                      
              - Weekly   : previous applicable week        
              - Monthly  : previous applicable month        
              - Quarterly: currently retained using the existing procedure logic        
            */        
   --IF (@var_InvoiceStorageCharge2 = 1)        
   IF(@var_options & 2 = 2)         
   BEGIN --STORAGE             
    SELECT TOP 1        
     @invoiceFrequencyFK = InvoiceFrequencyFK        
    FROM         
     tblCustomers         
    WHERE         
     CustomerPK = @customerFK        
        
    SELECT        
     @lastStorage = CASE        
      -- Last <Frequency Day> of the previous week        
      WHEN @invoiceFrequencyFK BETWEEN 1 AND 7 /*AND (DATEDIFF(DAY, @lastStorage, @invoiceTo) > 7)*/ THEN        
       DATEADD(DAY, -7, @invoiceTo)        
      -- Last <Frequency Day> of the previous month         
      WHEN (@invoiceFrequencyFK BETWEEN 8 AND 14) /*AND (DATEDIFF(DAY,@lastStorage,@invoiceTo) > 31)*/ THEN        
       dbo.fnGetLastSpecificDayOfWeekInPreviousMonth(@invoiceTo,@invoiceFrequencyFK)        
      WHEN @invoiceFrequencyFK = 15 THEN -- Quarterly        
       @lastStorage -- This needs to be coded properly if/when this frequency is ever used        
      ELSE        
       @lastStorage        
     END        
        
    --Set the last storage date plus a day (this makes sure to include the @lastStorage day)        
     SET @lastStorage = DATEADD(day,1,@lastStorage)        
        
    SET @totalPalletsIn = 0        
    SET @totalPalletsOut = 0        
    SET @totalPalletsDepleated = 0        
        
              /* DETERMINE INVOICE SEPARATION:        
       Build the list of stock categories/special stock types that need to be processed separately.        
                - If InvoiceByCategory = 1, stock is separated by stock-item category.        
                - Otherwise, stock is separated using special stock types.        
              */        
    DECLARE @invoiceSeparation TABLE         
    (         
     SpecialStockTypeFK INT,         
     SpecialStockType NVARCHAR(200),        
     StockItemCategoryFK INT,        
     StockItemCategory NVARCHAR(200)         
    )        
        
    --SET the invoiceSeparation table        
    IF(@invoiceByCategory = 1 /*cast(1 AS BIT)*/)         
    BEGIN        
     INSERT INTO @invoiceSeparation        
     SELECT DISTINCT * FROM (        
      SELECT -1 AS SpecialStockTypeFK, '' AS SpecialStockType, -1 AS StockItemCategoryFK, '' AS StockItemCategory        
      UNION        
      SELECT -1 AS SpecialStockTypeFK, '' AS SpecialStockType, StockItemCategoryPK AS StockItemCategoryFK, StockItemCategory        
      FROM tblStockItemCategories AS sics        
      WHERE sics.CustomerFK = @customerFK            
     ) AS subQ1        
    END         
    ELSE         
    BEGIN        
     INSERT INTO @invoiceSeparation        
     SELECT DISTINCT * FROM (        
      SELECT -1 AS SpecialStockTypeFK, '' AS SpecialStockType, -1 AS StockItemCategoryFK, '' AS StockItemCategory        
      UNION        
      SELECT SpecialStockTypeFK, cssts.CustomText, -1 AS StockItemCategoryFK, '' AS StockItemCategory        
      FROM tblCustomerSpecialStockTypes AS cssts        
      INNER JOIN appSpecialStockTypes AS ssts ON        
      ssts.SpecialStockTypePK = cssts.SpecialStocktypeFK        
    WHERE CustomerFK = @customerFK        
      UNION        
      SELECT sissts.SpecialStockTypeFK, ssts.SpecialStockType, -1 AS StockItemCategoryFK, '' AS StockItemCategory        
      FROM tblStockItemSpecialStockTypes AS sissts        
      INNER JOIN appSpecialStockTypes AS ssts ON        
      ssts.SpecialStockTypePK = sissts.SpecialStockTypeFK        
      WHERE StockItemFK IN (SELECT StockItemPK FROM tblStockItems WHERE DivisionFK = @var_divisionFK)        
     ) AS subQ1        
    END        
        
                --PRINT '1. @invoiceSeparation';        
                --SELECT * FROM @invoiceSeparation;        
        
    /* Process each invoice separation independently.        
                  The storage calculation below is therefore performed once for        
      each applicable category/special-stock grouping.        
                */        
    DECLARE InvoiceSeparatorCursor CURSOR FAST_FORWARD FOR SELECT * FROM @invoiceSeparation          
    OPEN InvoiceSeparatorCursor        
        
    FETCH NEXT FROM InvoiceSeparatorCursor         
          INTO @specialStockTypeFK, @specialStockType, @stockItemCategoryFK, @stockItemCategory        
        
    WHILE (@@FETCH_STATUS = 0)         
     BEGIN         
             
     /* Create temporary tables As STOCK ITEM ADJUSTMENTS to use instead of subqueries within the main query.        
          Stock adjustments can move pallets from one StockItem to another.        
                         These temporary tables record those movements so that the opening        
                         and closing pallet balances can be calculated correctly.               
                     */        
             
     IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#StockAdjustmentsAfterEnd') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #StockAdjustmentsAfterEnd        
        
     SELECT COUNT(*) AS Pallets, StockItemAfterFK AS StockItemFK,        
     PalletTypeAfterFK AS PalletTypeFK        
     INTO #StockAdjustmentsAfterEnd        
     FROM tblStockAdjustments AS sas        
     INNER JOIN tblstockitems AS si         
     ON si.stockitempk = sas.StockItemAfterFK        
     WHERE sas.InsertedDate >= @var_invoiceTo         
     AND sas.StockItemBeforeFK <> sas.StockItemAfterFK        
     AND si.divisionfk = @var_divisionFK        
     GROUP BY sas.StockItemAfterFK,sas.PalletTypeAfterFK        
        
    CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX IX_StockAdjustmentsAfterEnd_StockItem_PalletType  
    ON #StockAdjustmentsAfterEnd (StockItemFK, PalletTypeFK);  
      
    --PRINT '2. #StockAdjustmentsAfterEnd';       
    --SELECT * FROM #StockAdjustmentsAfterEnd;  
      
    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#StockAdjustmentsBeforeEnd') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #StockAdjustmentsBeforeEnd    
      
     SELECT COUNT(*) AS Pallets, StockItemBeforeFK AS StockItemFK,        
     PalletTypeBeforeFK AS PalletTypeFK        
     INTO #StockAdjustmentsBeforeEnd        
     FROM tblStockAdjustments AS sas        
     INNER JOIN tblstockitems AS si ON si.stockitempk = sas.stockitembeforefk        
     WHERE sas.InsertedDate >= @var_invoiceTo        
     AND StockItemBeforeFK <> StockItemAfterFK        
     AND si.divisionfk = @var_divisionFK        
     GROUP BY sas.StockItemBeforeFK,sas.PalletTypeBeforeFK        
       
     CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX IX_StockAdjustmentsBeforeEnd_StockItem_PalletType  
     ON #StockAdjustmentsBeforeEnd(StockItemFK, PalletTypeFK);   
     --PRINT '3. #StockAdjustmentsBeforeEnd';        
     --SELECT * FROM #StockAdjustmentsBeforeEnd;        
             
     IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#StockAdjustmentsAfterStart') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #StockAdjustmentsAfterStart        
        
     SELECT COUNT(*) AS Pallets, StockItemAfterFK AS StockItemFK,        
     PalletTypeAfterFK AS PalletTypeFK        
     INTO #StockAdjustmentsAfterStart        
     FROM tblStockAdjustments AS sas        
     INNER JOIN tblstockitems AS si ON si.stockitempk = sas.StockItemAfterFK        
     WHERE sas.InsertedDate >= @lastStorage --AND @var_invoiceTo         
     AND sas.StockItemBeforeFK <> sas.StockItemAfterFK        
     AND si.divisionfk = @var_divisionFK        
     GROUP BY sas.StockItemAfterFK,sas.PalletTypeAfterFK        
        
     CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX IX_StockAdjustmentsAfterStart_StockItem_PalletType  
     ON #StockAdjustmentsAfterStart(StockItemFK, PalletTypeFK);  
     --PRINT '4. #StockAdjustmentsAfterStart';        
     --SELECT * FROM #StockAdjustmentsAfterStart;        
             
     IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#StockAdjustmentsBeforeStart') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #StockAdjustmentsBeforeStart        
        
     SELECT COUNT(*) AS Pallets, StockItemBeforeFK AS StockItemFK,PalletTypeBeforeFK AS PalletTypeFK        
     INTO #StockAdjustmentsBeforeStart        
     FROM tblStockAdjustments AS sas        
     INNER JOIN tblstockitems AS si ON si.stockitempk = sas.stockitembeforefk        
     WHERE sas.InsertedDate >= @lastStorage --AND @var_invoiceTo        
     AND StockItemBeforeFK <> StockItemAfterFK        
     AND si.divisionfk = @var_divisionFK        
     GROUP BY sas.StockItemBeforeFK,sas.PalletTypeBeforeFK         
       
     CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX IX_StockAdjustmentsBeforeStart_StockItem_PalletType  
     ON #StockAdjustmentsBeforeStart(StockItemFK, PalletTypeFK);  
      --PRINT '5. #StockAdjustmentsBeforeStart';        
      --SELECT * FROM #StockAdjustmentsBeforeStart;        
      
    /* GET STOCK ITEMS TO BE INVOICED                            
       Select all stock items belonging to the current division.                            
       When InvoiceByCategory is enabled, only stock items belonging        
       to the current invoice category are included.        
     */        
    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#sis') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #sis        
        
     SELECT *         
     INTO #sis        
     FROM tblStockItems         
     WHERE DivisionFK = @var_divisionFK        
     AND (        
       @invoiceByCategory = 0 /*cast(0 AS BIT)*/         
       OR         
       (@invoiceByCategory = 1 /*cast(1 AS BIT)*/ AND StockItemCategoryFK = @stockItemCategoryFK)        
      )        
        
      CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX IX_sis_StockItemPK  
      ON #sis (StockItemPK);                       
      
      --PRINT '6. #sis';        
      --SELECT * FROM #sis;        
        
     /* CALCULATE PALLETS IN FROM START OF STORAGE PERIOD        
      Calculate pallets that entered the warehouse after the previous storage calculation date.        
     -- Only completed stock-ins are included.        
     -- Pallet audit information is also used to account for pallets that        
     -- were absorbed/depleted as part of stock movements.        
     */        
     IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#palletInsFROMStartOfPeriodTotals') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #palletInsFROMStartOfPeriodTotals        
        
     SELECT StockItemFK, PalletTypeFK, SUM(PalletsIn) AS PalletsIn,         
     SUM(UnitsIn) AS UnitsIn        
     INTO #palletInsFROMStartOfPeriodTotals        
     FROM (        
     SELECT sils.StockItemFK,sils.PalletTypeFK, pa.PalletFK, 1 - SUM(ISNULL([audit].PalletsAbsorbed, 0)) AS PalletsIn, SUM(sils.Units) AS UnitsIn        
     FROM tblStockInLines AS sils        
     INNER JOIN tblStockIns AS sins ON        
     sins.StockInPK = sils.StockInFK        
     INNER JOIN tblContainerIns AS cins ON        
     cins.ContainerInPK = sins.ContainerInFK         
     AND cins.StockInStatusFK = 3 /*Completed*/        
     --AND cins.StockInStatusFK <> 4 /*Not cancelled*/        
     --AND cins.StockInStatusFK <> 1 /*Not OnRoute*/        
     INNER JOIN tblPalletAudit AS pa ON        
     pa.EventTypeFK = 1 /*PalletCreated*/        
     AND pa.EventFK = sils.StockInLinePK        
     AND pa.StockItemFK = sils.StockItemFK        
     LEFT OUTER JOIN (        
      SELECT COUNT(*) PalletsAbsorbed, pa.PalletFK, StockItemFK, wos.FK         
      FROM tblPalletAudit AS pa        
      INNER JOIN tblWorksOrders AS wos ON        
      wos.WorksOrderPK = EventFK        
      WHERE EventTypeFK = 16/*Topoff DepleatedPallet - Absorbed*/        
      AND EventDate >= @lastStorage        
      GROUP BY pa.PalletFK, StockItemFK, wos.FK        
     ) AS [audit] ON        
     [audit].StockItemFK = sils.StockItemFK        
     AND [audit].FK = sins.StockInPK        
     AND pa.PalletFK = [audit].PalletFK        
     WHERE cins.StockInStatusFK = 3 /*Completed*/        
     --cins.StockInStatusFK <> 4 /*Not Cancelled*/         
     --AND cins.StockInStatusFK <> 1 /*Not OnRoute*/         
     AND cins.DateIn > @lastStorage        
     AND ((@invoiceByCategory = 0 /*cast(0 AS BIT)*/ AND sils.SpecialStockTypeFK = @specialStockTypeFK)        
      OR @invoiceByCategory = 1 /*cast(1 AS BIT)*/)        
     GROUP BY sils.StockItemFK,sils.PalletTypeFK, pa.PalletFK        
     ) AS subQ GROUP BY StockItemFK,PalletTypeFK        
        
     CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX IX_PalletInsFROMStartOfPeriodTotals_StockItem_PalletType  
     ON #palletInsFROMStartOfPeriodTotals(StockItemFK, PalletTypeFK);  
      
    --PRINT '7. #palletInsFROMStartOfPeriodTotals';        
    --SELECT * FROM #palletInsFROMStartOfPeriodTotals;        
        
     /* CALCULATE PALLET DEPLETIONS        
       - Find pallets that were depleted through warehouse movements during the storage period.                              
       - Only pallets belonging to completed stock-ins are considered.        
     */        
     IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#palletDepletionsFROMStartOfPeriod') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #palletDepletionsFROMStartOfPeriod        
        
     SELECT COUNT(*) AS PalletsDepleated,StockItemFK, PalletTypeFK        
     INTO #palletDepletionsFROMStartOfPeriod         
     FROM tblPalletAudit AS [audit]        
     OUTER APPLY        
     (        
      SELECT TOP 1 sils.PalletTypeFK         
      FROM tblStockInLinePallets AS silps        
      INNER JOIN tblStockInLines AS sils ON sils.StockInLinePK = silps.StockInLineFK        
      INNER JOIN tblStockIns AS si ON si.StockInPK = sils.StockInFK        
      INNER JOIN tblContainerIns AS ci ON ci.ContainerInPK = si.ContainerInFK AND ci.StockInStatusFK = 3        
      WHERE silps.PalletFK = [audit].PalletFK        
      ORDER BY silps.StockInLineFK DESC        
     ) AS palletType        
     WHERE EventTypeFK = 18 /*Pallet Depleated FROM Movement*/        
     AND EventDate >=@lastStorage         
     AND         
     (              
        [audit].PalletFK in (           
                         SELECT PalletFK           
                         FROM tblStockInLinePallets AS silps           
                         INNER JOIN tblStockInLines AS sils           
                         ON sils.StockInLinePK = silps.StockInLineFK          
                             
                         -- 05 September 2018 Cathal OCuirrin : This code ensure only completed stock ins are included.          
                         inner join dbo.tblstockins as si           
                         on sils.stockinfk = si.stockinpk          
                         inner join dbo.tblcontainerins as ci           
                         on ci.containerinpk = si.containerinfk           
                         and ci.stockinstatusfk = 3 /*Completed*/          
                                    
                         WHERE ((@invoiceByCategory = 0 /*cast(0 AS BIT)*/ AND SpecialStockTypeFK = @specialStockTypeFK) OR @invoiceByCategory = 1 /*cast(1 AS BIT)*/)          
                    )          
             )        
     GROUP BY StockItemFK, palletType.PalletTypeFK        
        
      CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX IX_PalletDepletionsFROMStartOfPeriod_StockItem_PalletType  
     ON #palletDepletionsFROMStartOfPeriod(StockItemFK, PalletTypeFK);  
     --PRINT '8. #palletDepletionsFROMStartOfPeriod';        
     --SELECT * FROM #palletDepletionsFROMStartOfPeriod;        
       
     /* CALCULATE PALLETS OUT        
       - Find pallets removed from the warehouse during the storage period.                              
       - Event types 2 and 23 represent the pallet-out/removal events        
         used by the existing storage calculation.        
     */        
     IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#palletOutsFROMStartOfPeriod') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #palletOutsFROMStartOfPeriod        
        
     SELECT COUNT(*) AS PalletsOut,StockItemFK,PalletTypeFK        
     INTO #palletOutsFROMStartOfPeriod        
     FROM tblPalletAudit AS [audit]        
     OUTER APPLY        
     (        
      SELECT TOP 1 sils.PalletTypeFK        
      FROM tblStockInLinePallets AS silps        
      INNER JOIN tblStockInLines AS sils ON sils.StockInLinePK = silps.StockInLineFK        
      INNER JOIN tblStockIns AS si ON si.StockInPK = sils.StockInFK        
      INNER JOIN tblContainerIns AS ci ON ci.ContainerInPK = si.ContainerInFK AND ci.StockInStatusFK = 3        
      WHERE silps.PalletFK = [audit].PalletFK        
      ORDER BY silps.StockInLineFK DESC        
     ) AS palletType        
     WHERE EventTypeFK in (2,23) --= 2 /*PalletRemoved*/        
     AND EventDate >= @lastStorage AND         
     (        
       [audit].PalletFK in (          
                        SELECT PalletFK           
                        FROM tblStockInLinePallets AS silps           
                        INNER JOIN tblStockInLines AS sils           
                        ON sils.StockInLinePK = silps.StockInLineFK           
                           
                        -- 05 September 2018 Cathal OCuirrin : This code ensure only completed stock ins are included.          
                        inner join dbo.tblstockins as si           
                        on sils.stockinfk = si.stockinpk          
                        inner join dbo.tblcontainerins as ci           
                        on ci.containerinpk = si.containerinfk           
                        and ci.stockinstatusfk = 3 /*Completed*/          
                           
                        WHERE ((@invoiceByCategory = 0 /*cast(0 AS BIT)*/ AND SpecialStockTypeFK = @specialStockTypeFK) OR @invoiceByCategory = 1 /*cast(1 AS BIT)*/)          
                       )          
     )        
     GROUP BY StockItemFK, palletType.PalletTypeFK        
       
     CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX IX_PalletOutsFROMStartOfPeriod_StockItem_PalletType  
     ON #palletOutsFROMStartOfPeriod(StockItemFK, PalletTypeFK);  
     --PRINT '9. #palletOutsFROMStartOfPeriod';        
     --SELECT * FROM #palletOutsFROMStartOfPeriod;        
     -- ----------------------------------------------        
     -- Create pallets after period temporary tables.        
     -- ----------------------------------------------        
     IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#palletInsAfterPeriodTotals') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #palletInsAfterPeriodTotals        
        
     SELECT StockItemFK,PalletTypeFK, SUM(PalletsIn) AS PalletsIn, SUM(UnitsIn) AS UnitsIn        
     INTO #palletInsAfterPeriodTotals        
     FROM         
     (        
       SELECT sils.StockItemFK,sils.PalletTypeFK, pa.PalletFK, 1 - SUM(ISNULL([audit].PalletsAbsorbed, 0)) AS PalletsIn, SUM(sils.Units) AS UnitsIn        
       FROM tblStockInLines AS sils        
       INNER JOIN tblStockIns AS sins ON        
       sins.StockInPK = sils.StockInFK        
       INNER JOIN tblContainerIns AS cins ON        
       cins.ContainerInPK = sins.ContainerInFK         
       AND cins.StockInStatusFK = 3 /*Completed*/        
       --AND cins.StockInStatusFK <> 4 /*Not cancelled*/        
       --AND cins.StockInStatusFK <> 1 /*Not OnRoute*/        
       INNER JOIN tblPalletAudit AS pa ON        
       pa.EventTypeFK = 1 /*PalletCreated*/        
       AND pa.EventFK = sils.StockInLinePK        
       AND pa.StockItemFK = sils.StockItemFK             
       INNER JOIN tblStockInLinePallets AS silps ON silps.StockInLineFK = sils.StockInLinePK AND silps.PalletFK = pa.PalletFK        
       LEFT OUTER JOIN (        
        SELECT COUNT(*) PalletsAbsorbed, pa.PalletFK,StockItemFK, wos.FK         
        FROM tblPalletAudit AS pa        
        INNER JOIN tblWorksOrders AS wos ON        
        wos.WorksOrderPK = EventFK        
        WHERE EventTypeFK = 16/*Topoff DepleatedPallet - Absorbed*/        
        AND EventDate > @var_invoiceTo        
        GROUP BY pa.PalletFK, StockItemFK, wos.FK        
       ) AS [audit] ON        
       [audit].StockItemFK = sils.StockItemFK        
       AND [audit].FK = sins.StockInPK        
       AND [audit].PalletFK = pa.PalletFK        
      WHERE cins.StockInStatusFK = 3 /*Completed*/        
      --cins.StockInStatusFK <> 4 /*Not Cancelled*/         
      --AND cins.StockInStatusFK <> 1 /*Not OnRoute*/      
      AND cins.DateIn > @var_invoiceTo        
      AND ((@invoiceByCategory = 0 /*cast(0 AS BIT)*/ AND sils.SpecialStockTypeFK = @specialStockTypeFK)         
      OR @invoiceByCategory = 1 /*cast(1 AS BIT)*/)        
       GROUP BY sils.StockItemFK,sils.PalletTypeFK, pa.PalletFK        
     ) AS subQ         
     GROUP BY StockItemFK, PalletTypeFK            
        
     CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX IX_PalletInsAfterPeriodTotals_StockItem_PalletType  
     ON #palletInsAfterPeriodTotals(StockItemFK, PalletTypeFK);  
     --PRINT '10. #palletInsAfterPeriodTotals';        
     --SELECT * FROM #palletInsAfterPeriodTotals;        
        
     IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#palletDepletionsAfterPeriod') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #palletDepletionsAfterPeriod        
        
     SELECT COUNT(*) AS PalletsDepleated, StockItemFK,PalletTypeFK         
     INTO #palletDepletionsAfterPeriod        
     FROM tblPalletAudit AS [audit]        
     OUTER APPLY        
     (        
      SELECT TOP 1 sils.PalletTypeFK        
      FROM tblStockInLinePallets AS silps        
      INNER JOIN tblStockInLines AS sils ON sils.StockInLinePK = silps.StockInLineFK        
      INNER JOIN tblStockIns AS si ON si.StockInPK = sils.StockInFK        
      INNER JOIN tblContainerIns AS ci ON ci.ContainerInPK = si.ContainerInFK AND ci.StockInStatusFK = 3        
      WHERE silps.PalletFK = [audit].PalletFK        
      ORDER BY silps.StockInLineFK DESC        
     ) AS palletType        
     WHERE EventTypeFK = 18 /*Pallet Depleated FROM Movement*/        
     AND EventDate > @var_invoiceTo AND         
     (        
                       [audit].PalletFK in (          
                       SELECT PalletFK           
                       FROM tblStockInLinePallets AS silps           
                       INNER JOIN tblStockInLines AS sils           
                       ON sils.StockInLinePK = silps.StockInLineFK           
                           
                       -- 05 September 2018 Cathal OCuirrin : This code ensure only completed stock ins are included.          
                       inner join dbo.tblstockins as si           
                       on sils.stockinfk = si.stockinpk          
                       inner join dbo.tblcontainerins as ci           
                       on ci.containerinpk = si.containerinfk           
                       and ci.stockinstatusfk = 3 /*Completed*/          
                           
                       WHERE ((@invoiceByCategory = 0 /*cast(0 AS BIT)*/ AND SpecialStockTypeFK = @specialStockTypeFK) OR @invoiceByCategory = 1 /*cast(1 AS BIT)*/)          
                      )         
     )        
     GROUP BY StockItemFK, palletType.PalletTypeFK        
        
     CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX IX_PalletDepletionsAfterPeriod_StockItem_PalletType  
     ON #palletDepletionsAfterPeriod(StockItemFK, PalletTypeFK);  
     --PRINT '11. #palletDepletionsAfterPeriod';        
     --SELECT * FROM #palletDepletionsAfterPeriod;        
        
     IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#palletOutsAfterPeriod') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #palletOutsAfterPeriod        
        
     SELECT COUNT(*) AS PalletsOut, StockItemFK,PalletTypeFK        
     INTO #palletOutsAfterPeriod        
     FROM tblPalletAudit AS [audit]        
     OUTER APPLY        
     (        
      SELECT TOP 1 sils.PalletTypeFK        
      FROM tblStockInLinePallets AS silps        
      INNER JOIN tblStockInLines AS sils ON sils.StockInLinePK = silps.StockInLineFK        
      INNER JOIN tblStockIns AS si ON si.StockInPK = sils.StockInFK        
      INNER JOIN tblContainerIns AS ci ON ci.ContainerInPK = si.ContainerInFK AND ci.StockInStatusFK = 3        
      WHERE silps.PalletFK = [audit].PalletFK        
      ORDER BY silps.StockInLineFK DESC        
     ) AS palletType        
     WHERE EventTypeFK in (2, 23) --= 2 /*PalletRemoved*/        
     AND EventDate > @var_invoiceTo AND         
     (        
       [audit].PalletFK in (          
                        SELECT PalletFK           
                        FROM tblStockInLinePallets AS silps           
                        INNER JOIN tblStockInLines AS sils           
                        ON sils.StockInLinePK = silps.StockInLineFK           
                         
                        -- 05 September 2018 Cathal OCuirrin : This code ensure only completed stock ins are included.       
                        inner join dbo.tblstockins as si           
                        on sils.stockinfk = si.stockinpk          
                        inner join dbo.tblcontainerins as ci           
                        on ci.containerinpk = si.containerinfk           
                        and ci.stockinstatusfk = 3 /*Completed*/          
                         
                        WHERE ((@invoiceByCategory = 0 /*cast(0 AS BIT)*/           
                         AND SpecialStockTypeFK = @specialStockTypeFK) OR @invoiceByCategory = 1 /*cast(1 AS BIT)*/)          
                       )          
     )        
     GROUP BY StockItemFK,palletType.PalletTypeFK        
       
     CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX IX_PalletOutsAfterPeriod_StockItem_PalletType  
     ON #palletOutsAfterPeriod(StockItemFK, PalletTypeFK);                      
             --PRINT '12. #palletOutsAfterPeriod';        
             --SELECT * FROM #palletOutsAfterPeriod;        
       
         /* Get current level of stock pallet details by pallet type.        
          -- DEV-968 - Current pallets are counted by pallet type.        
          -- Mixed-content calculation follows spStockLevelsSync.        
         */            
         IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#tblTempPallets') IS NOT NULL        
          DROP TABLE #tblTempPallets;        
                
        SELECT p.PalletPK        
        INTO #tblTempPallets        
        FROM dbo.tblPallets AS p        
        WHERE p.IsArchived = 0  AND p.StockInStatusFK = 3;        
                               
        CREATE INDEX #ndx1        
        ON #tblTempPallets(PalletPK);        
               
       --PRINT '13. #tblTempPallets';        
       --SELECT * FROM #tblTempPallets;        
       
         IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#tblAllTempPalletContents') IS NOT NULL        
        DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #tblAllTempPalletContents;                       
        SELECT pc.PalletContentPK, pc.StockItemFK, pc.Batch, pc.SpecialStockTypeFK,        
            pc.ActualEaches, pc.ActualUnits, pc.AvailableEaches, pc.AvailableUnits, pc.PalletFK,         
            ISNULL(p.PalletTypeFK, -1) AS PalletTypeFK                       
        INTO #tblAllTempPalletContents                       
        FROM dbo.tblPalletContent AS pc                       
        INNER JOIN dbo.tblPallets AS p        
            ON p.PalletPK = pc.PalletFK                       
        WHERE pc.IsArchived = 0        
          AND p.IsArchived = 0        
          AND p.StockInStatusFK = 3        
                
                
        UNION                       
           --Stock not currently assigned to a pallet. No physical pallet means no pallet type.          
        SELECT        
            pc2.PalletContentPK, pc2.StockItemFK, pc2.Batch, pc2.SpecialStockTypeFK,        
            pc2.ActualEaches, pc2.ActualUnits, pc2.AvailableEaches, pc2.AvailableUnits,        
            pc2.PalletFK, -1 AS PalletTypeFK                       
        FROM dbo.tblPalletContent AS pc2                       
        WHERE pc2.IsArchived = 0        
          AND pc2.PalletFK = -1        
          AND pc2.ActualUnits > 0;                       
                
        CREATE INDEX #ndx2        
        ON #tblAllTempPalletContents(PalletFK);                       
               
       --PRINT '14. #tblAllTempPalletContents';        
       --SELECT * FROM #tblAllTempPalletContents;        
       
         IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#tblTempPalletContent') IS NOT NULL        
          DROP TABLE #tblTempPalletContent;                       
        SELECT pc.PalletContentPK,pc.StockItemFK,pc.Batch,pc.SpecialStockTypeFK,        
            pc.ActualEaches,pc.ActualUnits, pc.AvailableEaches,pc.AvailableUnits,pc.PalletFK,        
            pc.PalletTypeFK, 1 AS MixedContentCount                       
        INTO #tblTempPalletContent                
        FROM #tblAllTempPalletContents AS pc                       
        WHERE EXISTS        
        (        
            SELECT 1        
            FROM #tblTempPallets AS p        
            WHERE p.PalletPK = pc.PalletFK        
        );        
               
      CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX IX_TblTempPalletContent_StockItem_PalletType  
      ON #tblTempPalletContent(StockItemFK, PalletTypeFK);       
  
        --PRINT '14. #tblAllTempPalletContents';        
        --SELECT * FROM #tblAllTempPalletContents;        
                
                
        /*  STOCK LEVELS FOR CONTENT WITH NO PALLET */           
       IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#tblStockLevelsNoPalletFKs') IS NOT NULL        
                  DROP TABLE #tblStockLevelsNoPalletFKs;                       
               SELECT        
                   StockItemFK, Batch,SpecialStockTypeFK,PalletTypeFK,                       
                   0 AS ActualPallets,        
                   0 AS AvailablePallets,                       
                   SUM(ActualEaches) AS ActualEaches,        
                   SUM(ActualUnits) AS ActualUnits,        
                   SUM(AvailableEaches) AS AvailableEaches,        
                   SUM(AvailableUnits) AS AvailableUnits,                       
                   0 AS MixedContentCount                       
               INTO #tblStockLevelsNoPalletFKs                       
               FROM #tblAllTempPalletContents                       
               WHERE PalletFK = -1                       
               GROUP BY StockItemFK,Batch,SpecialStockTypeFK,PalletTypeFK;                       
                     
              CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX IX_tblStockLevelsNoPalletFKs_StockItem_PalletType  
              ON #tblStockLevelsNoPalletFKs(StockItemFK, PalletTypeFK);        
  
               --PRINT '16. #tblStockLevelsNoPalletFKs';        
               --SELECT * FROM #tblStockLevelsNoPalletFKs;        
        
                IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#tblStockLevels0') IS NOT NULL        
                 DROP TABLE #tblStockLevels0;                       
               SELECT StockItemFK,Batch,SpecialStockTypeFK,PalletTypeFK,ActualPallets, AvailablePallets,        
                   ActualEaches,ActualUnits,AvailableEaches,AvailableUnits, MixedContentCount                       
               INTO #tblStockLevels0                       
               FROM #tblStockLevelsNoPalletFKs                       
                       
               UNION        
                                      
               SELECT StockItemFK,Batch,SpecialStockTypeFK,PalletTypeFK,                       
                   COUNT(DISTINCT        
                       CASE        
                           WHEN ActualUnits > 0        
                           THEN PalletFK        
                       END        
                   ) AS ActualPallets,                       
                   COUNT(DISTINCT        
                       CASE        
                           WHEN AvailableUnits > 0        
                           THEN PalletFK        
                       END        
                   ) AS AvailablePallets,                       
                   SUM(ActualEaches) AS ActualEaches,        
                   SUM(ActualUnits) AS ActualUnits,        
                   SUM(AvailableEaches) AS AvailableEaches,        
                   SUM(AvailableUnits) AS AvailableUnits,                       
                   MixedContentCount                       
               FROM #tblTempPalletContent                       
               GROUP BY StockItemFK,Batch,SpecialStockTypeFK,PalletTypeFK,MixedContentCount;        
                       
               --PRINT '17. #tblTempPalletContent';        
               --SELECT * FROM #tblTempPalletContent;        
                      
              /* GET CURRENT LEVEL BY PALLET TYPE */        
                IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#currentLevelPalletType') IS NOT NULL        
                 DROP TABLE #currentLevelPalletType;        
                       
               SELECT StockItemFK,Batch,SpecialStockTypeFK,PalletTypeFK,                       
                   SUM(ActualPallets) AS ActualPallets,                       
                   CASE        
                       WHEN SUM(MixedContentCount) IS NULL        
                    THEN 0        
                       ELSE SUM(MixedContentCount)        
                   END AS MixedContentCount                       
               INTO #currentLevelPalletType                       
               FROM #tblStockLevels0                       
               GROUP BY StockItemFK,Batch,SpecialStockTypeFK,PalletTypeFK;        
                 
             CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX IX_CurrentLevelPalletType_StockItem_PalletType  
             ON #currentLevelPalletType(StockItemFK, SpecialStockTypeFK, PalletTypeFK);  
              --PRINT '18. #currentLevelPalletType';        
              -- SELECT * FROM #currentLevelPalletType;        
                      
              IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#currentLevelPalletTypeFinal') IS NOT NULL        
              DROP TABLE #currentLevelPalletTypeFinal;                       
                       
      SELECT StockItemFK,SpecialStockTypeFK,PalletTypeFK,SUM(ActualPallets) AS ActualPallets                       
               INTO #currentLevelPalletTypeFinal                       
               FROM        
               (    -- Normal / non-mixed content                       
                   SELECT StockItemFK,SpecialStockTypeFK,PalletTypeFK,                       
                       SUM(ActualPallets) AS ActualPallets                       
                   FROM #currentLevelPalletType                       
                WHERE MixedContentCount < 2                       
                   GROUP BY StockItemFK, SpecialStockTypeFK,PalletTypeFK                       
                       
                   UNION                                     
                  -- Mixed-content                        
                   SELECT StockItemFK,SpecialStockTypeFK, PalletTypeFK,                       
                       SUM(ActualPallets) - (MixedContentCount - 1) AS ActualPallets                       
                   FROM #currentLevelPalletType                       
                   WHERE MixedContentCount > 1                       
                   GROUP BY StockItemFK,SpecialStockTypeFK,PalletTypeFK,MixedContentCount                       
               ) AS subq                       
               GROUP BY StockItemFK, SpecialStockTypeFK,PalletTypeFK;        
        
             CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX IX_currentLevelPalletTypeFinal_StockItem_PalletType_SpecialStockType  
             ON #currentLevelPalletTypeFinal(StockItemFK, PalletTypeFK, SpecialStockTypeFK);  
  
              -- PRINT '19. #currentLevelPalletTypeFinal';        
              --SELECT * FROM #currentLevelPalletTypeFinal;        
        
    -- --------------------------------------        
    -- Get the various stock pallet numbers.              
    -- --------------------------------------        
    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#StockItemPalletNumbers') IS NOT NULL        
        DROP TABLE #StockItemPalletNumbers        
            
                     SELECT         
                         sis.StockItemPK,                             
                         -- Specific pallet type        
                          ISNULL(palletTypes.PalletTypeFK,-1) AS PalletTypeFK,                             
                         -- Pallets belonging to this pallet type        
                         ISNULL(currentLevelPalletType.ActualPallets, 0) AS ActualPallets,                             
                         -- Columns for OpeningTotalPallets        
                         palletOutsFROMStartOfPeriod.PalletsOut AS 'palletOutsFROMStartOfPeriod.PalletsOut',        
                         palletDepletionsFROMStartOfPeriod.PalletsDepleated AS 'palletDepletionsFROMStartOfPeriod.PalletsDepleated',        
                         insFROMStartOfPeriod.PalletsIn AS 'insFROMStartOfPeriod.PalletsIn',        
                         StockAdjustmentsBeforeStart.Pallets AS 'StockAdjustmentsBeforeStart.Pallets',        
                         StockAdjustmentsAfterStart.Pallets AS 'StockAdjustmentsAfterStart.Pallets',                             
                         -- Columns for ClosingTotalPallets        
                         palletOutsAfterPeriod.PalletsOut AS 'palletOutsAfterPeriod.PalletsOut',        
                         palletDepletionsAfterPeriod.PalletsDepleated AS 'palletDepletionsAfterPeriod.PalletsDepleated',        
                         insAfterPeriod.PalletsIn AS 'insAfterPeriod.PalletsIn',        
           StockAdjustmentsBeforeEnd.Pallets AS 'StockAdjustmentsBeforeEnd.Pallets',        
                         StockAdjustmentsAfterEnd.Pallets AS 'StockAdjustmentsAfterEnd.Pallets'                             
                     INTO #StockItemPalletNumbers                             
                     FROM #sis AS sis                             
                     INNER JOIN tblDivisions AS divisions        
                         ON divisions.DivisionPK = sis.DivisionFK                             
                     OUTER APPLY        
                     (        
                         SELECT DISTINCT PalletTypeFK        
                         FROM        
                         (        
                             SELECT PalletTypeFK FROM #currentLevelPalletTypeFinal        
                             WHERE StockItemFK = sis.StockItemPK        
                             
                             UNION        
                        
                             SELECT PalletTypeFK FROM #palletInsFROMStartOfPeriodTotals        
                             WHERE StockItemFK = sis.StockItemPK        
                             
                             UNION        
                             
                             SELECT PalletTypeFK FROM #palletInsAfterPeriodTotals        
                             WHERE StockItemFK = sis.StockItemPK        
                             
                             UNION        
                             
                             SELECT PalletTypeFK FROM #palletDepletionsFROMStartOfPeriod        
                             WHERE StockItemFK = sis.StockItemPK        
                             
                             UNION        
                             
                             SELECT PalletTypeFK FROM #palletOutsFROMStartOfPeriod        
                             WHERE StockItemFK = sis.StockItemPK        
                             
                             UNION        
                             
                             SELECT PalletTypeFK FROM #palletDepletionsAfterPeriod        
                             WHERE StockItemFK = sis.StockItemPK        
                             
                             UNION        
                             
                             SELECT PalletTypeFK FROM #palletOutsAfterPeriod        
                             WHERE StockItemFK = sis.StockItemPK        
                         ) AS pt        
                     ) AS palletTypes        
                             
                     LEFT OUTER JOIN #currentLevelPalletTypeFinal AS currentLevelPalletType        
                         ON currentLevelPalletType.StockItemFK = sis.StockItemPK        
                         AND currentLevelPalletType.PalletTypeFK = palletTypes.PalletTypeFK        
                         AND (          
                             (@invoiceByCategory = 0 /*cast(0 AS BIT)*/ AND currentLevelPalletType.SpecialStockTypeFK = @specialStockTypeFK)           
                             OR @invoiceByCategory = 1 /*cast(1 AS BIT)*/          
                            )         
                             
                     LEFT OUTER JOIN #palletOutsAfterPeriod AS palletOutsAfterPeriod        
                         ON palletOutsAfterPeriod.StockItemFK = sis.StockItemPK        
                         AND palletOutsAfterPeriod.PalletTypeFK = palletTypes.PalletTypeFK        
                             
                     LEFT OUTER JOIN #palletDepletionsAfterPeriod AS palletDepletionsAfterPeriod        
                         ON palletDepletionsAfterPeriod.StockItemFK = sis.StockItemPK        
                         AND palletDepletionsAfterPeriod.PalletTypeFK = palletTypes.PalletTypeFK        
                             
                     LEFT OUTER JOIN #palletInsAfterPeriodTotals AS insAfterPeriod        
                         ON insAfterPeriod.StockItemFK = sis.StockItemPK        
                         AND insAfterPeriod.PalletTypeFK = palletTypes.PalletTypeFK        
                             
               LEFT OUTER JOIN #palletOutsFROMStartOfPeriod AS palletOutsFROMStartOfPeriod        
                         ON palletOutsFROMStartOfPeriod.StockItemFK = sis.StockItemPK        
                         AND palletOutsFROMStartOfPeriod.PalletTypeFK = palletTypes.PalletTypeFK        
                             
                     LEFT OUTER JOIN #palletDepletionsFROMStartOfPeriod AS palletDepletionsFROMStartOfPeriod        
                         ON palletDepletionsFROMStartOfPeriod.StockItemFK = sis.StockItemPK        
                         AND palletDepletionsFROMStartOfPeriod.PalletTypeFK = palletTypes.PalletTypeFK        
                             
                     LEFT OUTER JOIN #palletInsFROMStartOfPeriodTotals AS insFROMStartOfPeriod        
                         ON insFROMStartOfPeriod.StockItemFK = sis.StockItemPK        
                         AND insFROMStartOfPeriod.PalletTypeFK = palletTypes.PalletTypeFK        
                             
                     LEFT OUTER JOIN #StockAdjustmentsBeforeStart AS StockAdjustmentsBeforeStart         
                         ON StockAdjustmentsBeforeStart.StockItemFK = sis.StockItemPK         
                          AND StockAdjustmentsBeforeStart.PalletTypeFK = palletTypes.PalletTypeFK        
        
                     LEFT OUTER JOIN #StockAdjustmentsAfterStart AS StockAdjustmentsAfterStart         
                         ON StockAdjustmentsAfterStart.StockItemFK = sis.StockItemPK         
                         AND StockAdjustmentsAfterStart.PalletTypeFK = palletTypes.PalletTypeFK        
                            
     LEFT OUTER JOIN #StockAdjustmentsBeforeEnd AS StockAdjustmentsBeforeEnd         
                         ON StockAdjustmentsBeforeEnd.StockItemFK = sis.StockItemPK         
                        AND StockAdjustmentsBeforeEnd.PalletTypeFK = palletTypes.PalletTypeFK        
                            
     LEFT OUTER JOIN #StockAdjustmentsAfterEnd AS StockAdjustmentsAfterEnd         
                         ON StockAdjustmentsAfterEnd.StockItemFK = sis.StockItemPK        
         AND StockAdjustmentsAfterEnd.PalletTypeFK = palletTypes.PalletTypeFK        
            
       CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX IX_StockItemPalletNumbers_StockItem_PalletType  
       ON #StockItemPalletNumbers(StockItemPK, PalletTypeFK);  
  
                    --PRINT '20. #StockItemPalletNumbers';        
                    --SELECT * FROM #StockItemPalletNumbers;        
                           
        -- --------------------------------        
     -- Total the stock pallet numbers.        
     -- --------------------------------        
     IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#StockItemPalletTotals') IS NOT NULL        
      DROP TABLE #StockItemPalletTotals        
        
     SELECT         
      StockItemPK,        
      ISNULL(PalletTypeFK,-1) AS PalletTypeFK,        
      SUM(ISNULL(ActualPallets,0)) AS ActualPallets,        
      [palletOutsFROMStartOfPeriod.PalletsOut],        
      [palletDepletionsFROMStartOfPeriod.PalletsDepleated],        
      [insFROMStartOfPeriod.PalletsIn],        
      [StockAdjustmentsBeforeStart.Pallets],        
      [StockAdjustmentsAfterStart.Pallets],        
      [palletOutsAfterPeriod.PalletsOut],        
      [palletDepletionsAfterPeriod.PalletsDepleated],        
      [insAfterPeriod.PalletsIn],        
      [StockAdjustmentsBeforeEnd.Pallets],        
      [StockAdjustmentsAfterEnd.Pallets]         
     INTO        
      #StockItemPalletTotals        
     FROM         
      #StockItemPalletNumbers         
     GROUP BY         
      StockItemPK,        
      ISNULL(PalletTypeFK,-1),        
      [palletOutsFROMStartOfPeriod.PalletsOut],        
      [palletDepletionsFROMStartOfPeriod.PalletsDepleated],        
      [insFROMStartOfPeriod.PalletsIn],        
      [StockAdjustmentsBeforeStart.Pallets],        
      [StockAdjustmentsAfterStart.Pallets],        
      [palletOutsAfterPeriod.PalletsOut],        
      [palletDepletionsAfterPeriod.PalletsDepleated],        
      [insAfterPeriod.PalletsIn],        
      [StockAdjustmentsBeforeEnd.Pallets],        
      [StockAdjustmentsAfterEnd.Pallets]              
        
      CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX IX_StockItemPalletTotals_StockItem_PalletType  
       ON #StockItemPalletTotals(StockItemPK, PalletTypeFK);  
              --PRINT '21. #StockItemPalletTotals';        
              --SELECT * FROM #StockItemPalletTotals;        
                      
     -- --------------------------------------------------        
     -- Calculate the grand totals for the stock pallets.        
     -- --------------------------------------------------        
        
     IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#StockItemPalletGrandTotals') IS NOT NULL        
      DROP TABLE #StockItemPalletGrandTotals        
         
         SELECT          
                         StockItemPK,          
                       ISNULL(PalletTypeFK,-1) AS PalletTypeFK,        
                         ISNULL(ActualPallets, 0) + ISNULL([palletOutsFROMStartOfPeriod.PalletsOut], 0)           
                          + ISNULL([palletDepletionsFROMStartOfPeriod.PalletsDepleated], 0) - ISNULL([insFROMStartOfPeriod.PalletsIn],0)           
                           + ISNULL([StockAdjustmentsBeforeStart.Pallets], 0) - ISNULL([StockAdjustmentsAfterStart.Pallets], 0) AS OpeningTotalPallets,          
                              
                         ISNULL(ActualPallets, 0) + ISNULL([palletOutsAfterPeriod.PalletsOut], 0) + ISNULL([palletDepletionsAfterPeriod.PalletsDepleated], 0)           
                          - ISNULL([insAfterPeriod.PalletsIn],0) + ISNULL([StockAdjustmentsBeforeEnd.Pallets], 0)           
                           - ISNULL([StockAdjustmentsAfterEnd.Pallets], 0) AS ClosingTotalPallets,          
                         ISNULL([insFROMStartOfPeriod.PalletsIn], 0) - ISNULL([insAfterPeriod.PalletsIn], 0) AS PalletsIn,          
                         ISNULL([palletOutsFROMStartOfPeriod.PalletsOut], 0) - ISNULL([palletOutsAfterPeriod.PalletsOut], 0) AS PalletsOut,          
                         ISNULL([palletDepletionsFROMStartOfPeriod.PalletsDepleated],0) - ISNULL([palletDepletionsAfterPeriod.PalletsDepleated], 0)           
                          AS PalletsDepleated           
                        INTO          
                         #StockItemPalletGrandTotals          
                        FROM              
                         #StockItemPalletTotals                
             
       CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX IX_StockItemPalletGrandTotals_StockItem_PalletType  
       ON #StockItemPalletGrandTotals(StockItemPK, PalletTypeFK);  
  
                    --PRINT '22. #StockItemPalletGrandTotals';        
                    --SELECT * FROM #StockItemPalletGrandTotals;        
        
     -- ------------------------------------------        
     -- Calculate the final stock pallet numbers.        
     -- ------------------------------------------        
     SELECT         
      @openingPallets = SUM(OpeningTotalPallets),        
      @closingPallets = SUM(ClosingTotalPallets),        
      @palletsIn = ISNULL(SUM(PalletsIn), 0),        
      @palletsOut = ISNULL(SUM(PalletsOut), 0),        
      @palletsDepleated = ISNULL(SUM(PalletsDepleated), 0)        
     FROM             
      #StockItemPalletGrandTotals                
        
     SET @totalPalletsIn = @totalPalletsIn + @palletsIn        
     SET @totalPalletsOut = @totalPalletsOut + @palletsOut        
     SET @totalPalletsDepleated = @totalPalletsDepleated + @palletsDepleated        
        
                   -- ------------------------------------------          
                   -- Calculate the final stock pallet numbers.          
                   -- ------------------------------------------          
                        
                   SELECT           
                    @openingPallets = SUM(OpeningTotalPallets),          
                    @closingPallets = SUM(ClosingTotalPallets),          
                    @palletsIn = ISNULL(SUM(PalletsIn), 0),          
                    @palletsOut = ISNULL(SUM(PalletsOut), 0),          
                    @palletsDepleated = ISNULL(SUM(PalletsDepleated), 0)          
                   FROM               
                    #StockItemPalletGrandTotals                  
                        
                   SET @totalPalletsIn = @totalPalletsIn + @palletsIn          
                   SET @totalPalletsOut = @totalPalletsOut + @palletsOut          
                   SET @totalPalletsDepleated = @totalPalletsDepleated + @palletsDepleated          
                        
                  -- ------------------------------------------------------------------------------          
                   -- Calculate the eachesIn value if the division "handling in charge by" is each           
                   -- instead of pallet (see invoice details tab in the divsion details screen).          
                   -- ------------------------------------------------------------------------------          
                        
                   IF @HandlingInEachesTypeFK > 0          
                   BEGIN          
                    --20 July 2018 Jamie Clerkin : get count from stock in dockets           
                    select @eachesIn = sum(eaches) from (          
                     SELECT DISTINCT sil.stockinlinepk, sil.eaches          
                     FROM tblStockIns AS si          
                     INNER JOIN tblStockInLines AS sil ON si.stockinPK = sil.stockinFK          
                     inner join tblstockinlinepallets on stockinlinefk = stockinlinepk          
                     -- 05 September 2018 Cathal OCuirrin : This code ensure only completed stock ins are included.          
                     inner join dbo.tblcontainerins as ci           
                     on ci.containerinpk = si.containerinfk           
                     and ci.stockinstatusfk = 3 /*Completed*/          
                        
                     INNER JOIN tblPalletContent AS pc ON sil.Batch = pc.Batch AND sil.StockItemFK = pc.StockItemFK                
                     LEFT JOIN tblpallets p on pc.palletfk = p.palletpk  AND p.palletpk <> -1 --link back to pallets to check they are actually in warehouse             
                     LEFT JOIN tblPalletAudit pa on p.palletpk = pa.palletfk and pa.eventdate < @var_InvoiceTo          
                     WHERE si.divisionFK = @var_divisionFK AND si.ArrivalDate >= @lastStorage   AND si.ArrivalDate <  @var_InvoiceTo --AND pc.InsertedDate <  @var_InvoiceTo          
                     AND ((pc.palletfk <> -1 and p.palletstatusfk <> 10) or pc.palletfk = -1)  --11 July 2018 Jamie Clerkin          
                    )subq           
                        
                        
     /*          
                    SELECT @eachesIn = COUNT(DISTINCT pc.PalletContentPK)          
                    FROM tblStockIns AS si          
                    INNER JOIN tblStockInLines AS sil          
                    ON si.stockinPK = sil.stockinFK          
                    INNER JOIN tblPalletContent AS pc          
                    ON sil.Batch = pc.Batch          
                    AND sil.StockItemFK = pc.StockItemFK                
                    LEFT JOIN tblpallets p on pc.palletfk = p.palletpk           
                    AND p.palletpk <> -1 --link back to pallets to check they are actually in warehouse             
                    WHERE si.divisionFK = @var_divisionFK          
                    AND si.ArrivalDate >= @lastStorage           
                    AND si.ArrivalDate < @var_InvoiceTo          
                    AND pc.InsertedDate < @var_InvoiceTo -- 04 May 2018 Cathal O Cuirrin          
                    AND ((pc.palletfk <> -1 and p.palletstatusfk <> 10) or pc.palletfk = -1)  --11 July 2018 Jamie Clerkin*/          
                        
                    SET @eachesIn = ISNULL(@eachesIn,0)          
                   END          
                        
                   -- -------------------------------------------------------------------------------          
                   -- Calculate the eachesOut value if the division "handling out charge by" is each           
                   -- instead of pallet (see invoice details tab in the divsion details screen).          
                   -- -------------------------------------------------------------------------------          
                        
                   IF @HandlingOutEachesTypeFK > 0          
                   BEGIN          
                    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#eachesOutFromStartOfPeriod') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #eachesOutFromStartOfPeriod                 
                        
                    SELECT colpc.PalletContentFK, [audit].PalletAuditPK, [audit].EventDate          
                    INTO #eachesOutFromStartOfPeriod          
                    FROM tblPalletAudit AS [audit]          
                    INNER JOIN tblstockitems AS si          
                    ON [audit].StockItemFK = si.StockItemPK          
                    INNER JOIN tblContainerOutLinePalletContent AS colpc          
                    ON colpc.containeroutlinefk = [audit].eventfk          
                        
                    -- 05 September 2018 Cathal OCuirrin : This code ensure only completed stock outs are included.          
                    INNER JOIN tblContainerOutLines as col          
                    on colpc.ContainerOutLineFK = col.ContainerOutLinePK          
                    inner join tblcontainerouts as co          
                    on col.ContainerOutFK = co.ContainerOutPK          
                    and co.ContainerOutStatusFK = 5 /*Completed*/          
                        
                    WHERE si.divisionfk = @var_divisionFK          
                    AND [audit].EventTypeFK = 3          
                    AND [audit].EventDate >= @lastStorage          
                    
                         
             CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX IX_EachesOutFromStartOfPeriod_PalletContent_PalletAudit  
             ON #eachesOutFromStartOfPeriod(PalletContentFK, PalletAuditPK);  
  
         
                --PRINT '23. #eachesOutFromStartOfPeriod';        
                --SELECT * FROM #eachesOutFromStartOfPeriod;        
        
                    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#uniqueEachesOutFromStartOfPeriod') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #uniqueEachesOutFromStartOfPeriod          
                        
                    CREATE TABLE #uniqueEachesOutFromStartOfPeriod          
                    (          
                     PalletContentFK INT,          
                     PalletAuditFK INT          
                    )          
                    
                   CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX IX_UniqueEachesOutFromStartOfPeriod_PalletContent_PalletAudit  
                    ON #uniqueEachesOutFromStartOfPeriod(PalletContentFK, PalletAuditFK);  
  
                    DECLARE uniquePalletOutsFROMStartOfPeriod CURSOR FAST_FORWARD FOR           
                    SELECT palletcontentfk, PalletAuditPK FROM #eachesOutFromStartOfPeriod          
                        
                    OPEN uniquePalletOutsFROMStartOfPeriod          
                    FETCH NEXT FROM uniquePalletOutsFROMStartOfPeriod INTO @currentPalletContent, @currentPalletAudit          
                        
                    WHILE (@@FETCH_STATUS = 0)           
                    BEGIN          
                     IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM #uniqueEachesOutFromStartOfPeriod           
                         WHERE PalletContentFK = @currentPalletContent OR PalletAuditFK = @currentPalletAudit)           
                      INSERT INTO #uniqueEachesOutFromStartOfPeriod SELECT @currentPalletContent, @currentPalletAudit          
                        
                     FETCH NEXT FROM uniquePalletOutsFROMStartOfPeriod INTO @currentPalletContent, @currentPalletAudit          
                    END            
                       
               --PRINT '24. #uniqueEachesOutFromStartOfPeriod';        
               --SELECT * FROM #uniqueEachesOutFromStartOfPeriod;         
        
                    CLOSE uniquePalletOutsFROMStartOfPeriod          
                    DEALLOCATE uniquePalletOutsFROMStartOfPeriod          
                       
                      
        
                    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#eachesOutAfterPeriod') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #eachesOutAfterPeriod          
                        
                    SELECT palletcontentfk, PalletAuditPK          
                    INTO #eachesOutAfterPeriod          
                    FROM #eachesOutFromStartOfPeriod          
                    WHERE EventDate >= @var_invoiceTo          
        
                    CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX IX_EachesOutAfterPeriod_PalletContent_PalletAudit  
                    ON #eachesOutAfterPeriod(PalletContentFK, PalletAuditPK);  
                    --PRINT '25. #eachesOutAfterPeriod';        
                    --SELECT * FROM #eachesOutAfterPeriod;        
                        
                    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#UniqueEachesOutAfterPeriod') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #UniqueEachesOutAfterPeriod          
                        
                    CREATE TABLE #UniqueEachesOutAfterPeriod          
                    (       
                     PalletContentFK INT,          
                     PalletAuditFK INT          
                    )          
                      
                    CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX IX_UniqueEachesOutAfterPeriod_PalletContent_PalletAudit  
                    ON #UniqueEachesOutAfterPeriod(PalletContentFK, PalletAuditFK);     
                      
                    DECLARE uniquePalletOutsAfterPeriod CURSOR FAST_FORWARD FOR           
                    SELECT palletcontentfk, PalletAuditPK FROM #eachesOutAfterPeriod          
                        
                    OPEN uniquePalletOutsAfterPeriod          
                    FETCH NEXT FROM uniquePalletOutsAfterPeriod INTO @currentPalletContent, @currentPalletAudit          
                        
                    WHILE (@@FETCH_STATUS = 0)           
                    BEGIN          
                     IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM #UniqueEachesOutAfterPeriod           
                         WHERE PalletContentFK = @currentPalletContent or PalletAuditFK = @currentPalletAudit)           
                      INSERT INTO #UniqueEachesOutAfterPeriod SELECT @currentPalletContent, @currentPalletAudit          
                          
                     FETCH NEXT FROM uniquePalletOutsAfterPeriod INTO @currentPalletContent, @currentPalletAudit          
                    END            
                                  
                  --PRINT '25. #UniqueEachesOutAfterPeriod';        
                  --SELECT * FROM #UniqueEachesOutAfterPeriod;        
        
                    CLOSE uniquePalletOutsAfterPeriod          
                    DEALLOCATE uniquePalletOutsAfterPeriod          
                        
                    SELECT @eachesOut = COUNT(po.palletcontentfk)          
                    FROM #eachesOutFromStartOfPeriod AS po          
                    INNER JOIN #uniqueEachesOutFromStartOfPeriod AS upo           
                    ON upo.PalletContentFK = po.PalletContentFK           
                    AND upo.PalletAuditFK = po.PalletAuditPK          
                    WHERE NOT EXISTS          
                    (          
                     SELECT * FROM #eachesOutAfterPeriod AS po            
                     WHERE upo.PalletContentFK = po.PalletContentFK           
                     AND upo.PalletAuditFK = po.PalletAuditPK          
                    )                        
                   END          
        
        
        
     -- #DEV 998        
     -- Get the invoice method, 1 = Opening Pallets + PalletsIn, 2 = Closing Pallets        
     SELECT @invoiceMethodFK = InvoiceMethodFK FROM tblDivisions WHERE DivisionPK = @var_divisionFK        
         -- DG Create Temp Table #PalletsToChargeFor        
     IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#PalletsToChargeFor') IS NOT NULL        
      DROP TABLE #PalletsToChargeFor        
        
     CREATE TABLE #PalletsToChargeFor        
     (        
      StockItemPK INT,        
      PalletTypeFK INT NOT NULL,        
      TotalPallets INT,        
      StorageRateTypeFK INT,        
      StorageRate DECIMAL(18,3),        
      BreakMethodFK INT,        
      BreakOver DECIMAL(18,3),        
      StorageRateSubject VARCHAR(10),        
      TimePeriod VARCHAR(50),        
      RateSet INT        
     )      
       
     CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX IX_PalletsToChargeFor_StockItem_PalletType_RateType  
    ON #PalletsToChargeFor(StockItemPK, PalletTypeFK, StorageRateTypeFK)  
    INCLUDE (RateSet, BreakMethodFK, BreakOver, TotalPallets);  
      
    -- Invoice Method 1: Use  Opening Pallets && PalletsIn,        
     IF @invoiceMethodFK = 1        
      BEGIN        
       INSERT INTO #PalletsToChargeFor        
       SELECT         
        StockItemPK,         
        ISNULL(PalletTypeFK, -1) AS PalletTypeFK,        
        SUM(OpeningTotalPallets + PalletsIn) AS TotalPallets,         
        CAST(-1 AS INT) AS StorageRateTypeFK,         
        CAST(0.000 AS DECIMAL(18,3)) AS StorageRate,         
        CAST(-1 AS INT) AS BreakMethodFK,         
        CAST(0.000 AS DECIMAL(18,3)) AS BreakOver,        
        CAST('' AS VARCHAR(10)) AS StorageRateSubject,        
        CAST('' AS VARCHAR(50)) AS TimePeriod,        
        CAST(0 AS INT) AS RateSet        
       FROM         
        #StockItemPalletGrandTotals         
       WHERE         
        (OpeningTotalPallets <> 0) OR (PalletsIn <> 0)        
       GROUP BY         
        StockItemPK,ISNULL(PalletTypeFK, -1)        
      END        
     ELSE        
      --Invoice Method 2: Use Closing Pallets      
      BEGIN        
       INSERT INTO #PalletsToChargeFor        
       SELECT         
        StockItemPK,        
        ISNULL(PalletTypeFK, -1) AS PalletTypeFK,        
        SUM(ClosingTotalPallets) AS TotalPallets,         
        CAST(-1 AS INT) AS StorageRateTypeFK,         
        CAST(0.000 AS DECIMAL(18,3)) AS StorageRate,         
        CAST(-1 AS INT) AS BreakMethodFK,         
        CAST(0.000 AS DECIMAL(18,3)) AS BreakOver,        
        CAST('' AS VARCHAR(10)) AS StorageRateSubject,        
        CAST('' AS VARCHAR(50)) AS TimePeriod,        
        CAST(0 AS INT) AS RateSet        
       FROM         
        #StockItemPalletGrandTotals         
       WHERE                 
        --(OpeningTotalPallets <> 0) OR (PalletsIn <> 0)       
        ClosingTotalPallets <> 0  
       GROUP BY         
        StockItemPK,ISNULL(PalletTypeFK, -1)        
      END        
                       
              --PRINT '26. #PalletsToChargeFor';                       
              --SELECT * FROM #PalletsToChargeFor;        
        
      /*  
         Break Method mode is configured as a generic rate. Its break-over must  
         be evaluated against the stock item's total eligible pallets, not once  
         per pallet type. Collapse the quantities to one generic row first.  
      */  
      IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#StockItemsUsingBreakRates') IS NOT NULL  
          DROP TABLE #StockItemsUsingBreakRates;  
  
      SELECT DISTINCT P.StockItemPK  
      INTO #StockItemsUsingBreakRates  
      FROM #PalletsToChargeFor AS P  
      INNER JOIN tblStorageRates AS SR  
          ON SR.FK = P.StockItemPK  
         AND SR.StorageRateTypeFK = 2 /* StockItem */  
         AND SR.IsArchived = 0  
         AND ISNULL(SR.PalletTypeFK, -1) = -1  
         AND SR.BreakMethodFK > 0  
      WHERE  
          (@invoiceByCategory = 0 AND SR.SpecialStockTypeFK = @specialStockTypeFK)  
          OR @invoiceByCategory = 1;  
  
      CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX IX_StockItemsUsingBreakRates_StockItem  
      ON #StockItemsUsingBreakRates(StockItemPK);       
  
      IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM #StockItemsUsingBreakRates)  
      BEGIN  
          IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#StockItemBreakPalletTotals') IS NOT NULL  
              DROP TABLE #StockItemBreakPalletTotals;  
  
          SELECT P.StockItemPK,SUM(ISNULL(P.TotalPallets, 0)) AS TotalPallets  
          INTO #StockItemBreakPalletTotals  
          FROM #PalletsToChargeFor AS P  
          INNER JOIN #StockItemsUsingBreakRates AS B  
              ON B.StockItemPK = P.StockItemPK  
          GROUP BY P.StockItemPK;  
            
          CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX IX_StockItemBreakPalletTotals_StockItem  
          ON #StockItemBreakPalletTotals(StockItemPK);   
  
          DELETE P  
          FROM #PalletsToChargeFor AS P  
          INNER JOIN #StockItemsUsingBreakRates AS B  
              ON B.StockItemPK = P.StockItemPK;  
  
         INSERT INTO #PalletsToChargeFor  
         (  
             StockItemPK, PalletTypeFK, TotalPallets, StorageRateTypeFK,  
             StorageRate, BreakMethodFK, BreakOver, StorageRateSubject,  
             TimePeriod, RateSet  
         )  
         SELECT  
             T.StockItemPK,  
             -1,  -- Keep generic pallet type for consolidated row  
             T.TotalPallets,  
             -1,  -- Keep unassigned so the existing rate logic processes it  
             CAST(0.000 AS DECIMAL(18,3)),  
             ISNULL(SR.BreakMethodFK, -1),  
             ISNULL(SR.BreakOver, CAST(0.000 AS DECIMAL(18,3))),  
             CASE  
                 WHEN SR.ChargeByPallet = 1 THEN 'Pallet'  
                 WHEN SR.ChargeByEach = 1 THEN 'Each'  
                 WHEN SR.ChargeByUnit = 1 THEN 'Unit'  
                 ELSE ''  
             END,  
             ISNULL(TP.TimePeriod, ''),  
             0   -- Keep as unassigned  
         FROM #StockItemBreakPalletTotals AS T  
         OUTER APPLY  
         (  
             SELECT TOP (1)  
                 R.BreakMethodFK,  
                 R.BreakOver,  
                 R.ChargeByPallet,  
                 R.ChargeByEach,  
                 R.ChargeByUnit,  
                 R.ChargePeriodFK  
             FROM tblStorageRates AS R  
             WHERE R.FK = T.StockItemPK  
               AND R.StorageRateTypeFK = 2  
               AND R.IsArchived = 0  
               AND ISNULL(R.PalletTypeFK, -1) = -1  
               AND R.BreakMethodFK > 0  
               AND  
               (  
                   (@invoiceByCategory = 0  
                    AND R.SpecialStockTypeFK = @specialStockTypeFK)  
                   OR @invoiceByCategory = 1  
               )  
             ORDER BY R.BreakOver DESC, R.StorageRate DESC  
         ) AS SR  
         LEFT JOIN appTimePeriods AS TP  
             ON TP.TimePeriodPK = SR.ChargePeriodFK;  
           
           
          DROP TABLE #StockItemBreakPalletTotals;  
      END;  
  
      --PRINT '26. #PalletsToChargeForAfterStockItemGeneic method withBreakmetod';                       
      --SELECT * FROM #PalletsToChargeFor;     
  
     -- Declare Variable Here.        
     DECLARE @StockItemPK INT         
     DECLARE @TimePeriod varchar(50)        
     DECLARE @StorageRateTypeFK INT = 0        
        
     DECLARE @StockItemStorageRatesCursor AS CURSOR        
     DECLARE @DivisionStorageRatesCursor AS CURSOR        
        
     DECLARE @CountStorageRates INT = 0        
     DECLARE @RateSet INT = 0        
     DECLARE @RowCounter INT = 0        
     DECLARE @TotalRemainingPallets INT = 0        
     DECLARE @StockItemNumberOfPallets INT = 0        
               
               
     -- Create a Temp Table. StockItems with Storage Rates        
     IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#StockItemStorageRates') IS NOT NULL         
        DROP TABLE #StockItemStorageRates        
        
     /* #DEV=968 - Storage rates may be specific to PalletTypeFK.        
        A pallet-type-specific rate takes precedence over the generic -1 rate. */        
     SELECT        
      T.StockItemPK,        
      T.PalletTypeFK,        
      srs.StorageRateTypeFK,        
      srs.StorageRate,        
      srs.BreakMethodFK,        
      srs.BreakOver,        
      CASE        
       WHEN ChargeByPallet = 1 /*cast(1 AS BIT)*/ THEN 'Pallet'           
       WHEN ChargeByEach = 1 /*cast(1 AS BIT)*/ THEN  'Each'           
       WHEN ChargeByUnit = 1 /*cast(1 AS BIT)*/ THEN  'Unit'        
      END AS StorageRateSubject,        
      tps.TimePeriod,        
      0 AS RateSet,        
      0 AS MutlipleStorageRates,        
      srs.SpecialStockTypeFK        
     INTO #StockItemStorageRates        
     FROM #PalletsToChargeFor AS T        
     INNER JOIN tblStorageRates AS srs        
      ON srs.FK = T.StockItemPK        
      AND srs.StorageRateTypeFK = 2 /* StockItem */        
      AND srs.IsArchived = 0        
      AND        
      (   -- Specific pallet-type rate        
         ISNULL(srs.PalletTypeFK, -1) = T.PalletTypeFK        
       OR        
       -- Generic rate (-1), only when no specific rate exists        
       (        
         ISNULL(srs.PalletTypeFK, -1) = -1        
        AND NOT EXISTS        
        (        
         SELECT 1        
         FROM tblStorageRates AS specific        
         WHERE specific.FK = T.StockItemPK        
           AND specific.StorageRateTypeFK = 2 /* StockItem */        
           AND specific.IsArchived = 0        
           AND specific.PalletTypeFK = T.PalletTypeFK        
           AND specific.PalletTypeFK <> -1        
           AND        
           (        
            (@invoiceByCategory = 0 AND specific.SpecialStockTypeFK = @specialStockTypeFK)        
            OR @invoiceByCategory = 1        
           )        
         )        
       )        
      )        
     INNER JOIN appTimePeriods AS tps        
      ON tps.TimePeriodPK = srs.ChargePeriodFK        
     WHERE        
      (        
       (@invoiceByCategory = 0 AND srs.SpecialStockTypeFK = @specialStockTypeFK)        
       OR @invoiceByCategory = 1        
      )        
     GROUP BY        
      T.StockItemPK,        
      T.PalletTypeFK,        
      srs.StorageRateTypeFK,        
      srs.StorageRate,        
      srs.BreakMethodFK,        
      srs.BreakOver,        
      srs.ChargeByPallet,        
      srs.ChargeByEach,        
      srs.ChargeByUnit,        
      tps.TimePeriod,        
      srs.SpecialStockTypeFK        
     ORDER BY        
      T.StockItemPK,        
      T.PalletTypeFK,        
      srs.StorageRateTypeFK,        
      srs.BreakOver DESC        
        
    CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX IX_StockItemStorageRates_RateLookup  
    ON #StockItemStorageRates(StockItemPK, PalletTypeFK, StorageRateTypeFK, BreakOver DESC)  
    INCLUDE (SpecialStockTypeFK, MutlipleStorageRates, RateSet, StorageRate);  
  
      --PRINT '27. #StockItemStorageRates';        
      --SELECT * FROM #StockItemStorageRates;        
            
                        
                -- SET MutlipleStorageRates Flag and calculation        
                    UPDATE R        
                      SET MutlipleStorageRates =        
                          CASE        
                              WHEN R.BreakMethodFK > 0 THEN 1  
                              WHEN        
                              (        
                                  SELECT COUNT(*)
