CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spInvoiceCreateLinesChargeByUnit]
(
	@divisionFK int,
	@invoiceTo datetime,
	@options int,
	--@invoiceStorageCharge bit,
	--@invoiceExtraServicesCharge bit,
	--@invoiceDistributionCharge bit,
	--@invoiceRecurringCharge bit,
	@invoiceFK int,
	@buildingUnitFK int = -1,
	@departmentFK int = -1
)
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data; Ensure this proc has a low impact when executed */
     SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED; SET DEADLOCK_PRIORITY LOW

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT
	,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;
	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	DECLARE @var_divisionFK INT, @var_invoiceTo DATETIME, @var_options INT, @var_invoiceFK INT, @var_buildingUnitFK INT, @var_departmentFK INT
	DECLARE @var_InvoiceStorageCharge2 bit, @var_InvoiceExtraServicesCharge2 bit, @var_InvoiceDistributionCharge2 bit, @var_InvoiceRecurringCharge2 bit 

	SET @var_divisionFK = @divisionFK; SET @var_invoiceTo = @invoiceTo; SET @var_invoiceFK = @invoiceFK; 
	SET @var_buildingUnitFK = @buildingUnitFK
	SET @var_departmentFK = @departmentFK
	SET @var_options = @options;
	--SET @var_InvoiceStorageCharge2 = @invoiceStorageCharge; 
	--SET @var_InvoiceExtraServicesCharge2 = @invoiceExtraServicesCharge; 
	--SET @var_InvoiceDistributionCharge2 = @invoiceDistributionCharge;
	--SET @var_InvoiceRecurringCharge2 = @invoiceRecurringCharge;

	SET @ParameterDetails = '@divisionFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_divisionFK AS NVARCHAR(30)),'') 
		+ ',@invoiceTo = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_invoiceTo AS NVARCHAR(30)),'')
		+ ',@options = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_options AS NVARCHAR(30)),'') 
		+ ',@invoiceFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_invoiceFK AS NVARCHAR(30)),'')
		+ ',@buildingUnitFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_buildingUnitFK AS NVARCHAR(30)),'')
		+ ',@departmentFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_departmentFK AS NVARCHAR(30)),'')
		--+ ',@invoiceStorageCharge = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_InvoiceStorageCharge2 AS NVARCHAR(1)),'')
		--+ ',@invoiceExtraServicesCharge = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_InvoiceExtraServicesCharge2 AS NVARCHAR(1)),'')
		--+ ',@invoiceDistributionCharge = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_InvoiceDistributionCharge2 AS NVARCHAR(1)),'')
		--+ ',@invoiceRecurringCharge = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_InvoiceRecurringCharge2 AS NVARCHAR(1)),'')

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
	--BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

		SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
	--END

	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName)
	IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK
	SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
	
	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY			

			-- This stored procedures main code, excluding error handling - start

			-- Ensure the temporary invoice number always has a valid value.
			IF @var_invoiceFK > 0
			BEGIN
				IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM dbo.tblInvoices WHERE InvoicePK = @var_invoiceFK AND ISNULL(InvoiceNumber,'') = '')
				BEGIN
					DECLARE @InvoiceNumber NVARCHAR(200) = ''

					IF XACT_STATE() = 0 AND @@TRANCOUNT < 1 BEGIN TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName

					-- Get the temporary invoice number from the appSystem table. 
					-- Lock the table to ensure no other code changes this value until this stored procedure has finished executing.
					SELECT @InvoiceNumber = 'TMP' + CAST(NextInvoiceTempNumber AS NVARCHAR(200)) FROM dbo.appSystem WITH (ROWLOCK)					

					-- Increment the value in the appSystem table.
					UPDATE dbo.appSystem WITH (ROWLOCK)
					SET NextInvoiceTempNumber = NextInvoiceTempNumber + 1

					-- Add the temporary invoice number to the specific row in the tblInvoices table.
					UPDATE dbo.tblInvoices WITH (ROWLOCK)
					SET InvoiceNumber = @InvoiceNumber
					WHERE InvoicePK = @var_invoiceFK	
				END
			END

			DECLARE @ret INT = 0, @var_startDate DATETIME, @lastExtraService DATETIME, @lastDistributionCharge DATETIME, @lastRecurringCharge DATETIME,
			@unitsIn DECIMAL(18,3), @unitsOut DECIMAL(18,3),
			@totalUnitsDepleated DECIMAL(18,3), @customerFK INT, @specialStockTypeFK INT, @specialStockType NVARCHAR(100), @stockItemCategoryFK INT, 
			@stockItemCategory NVARCHAR(100), @invoiceMethodFK INT, @invoiceByCategory BIT, @taxRate DECIMAL(18,3), @vatCodeFK INT, @storageCharge DECIMAL(18,3), 
			@handlingCharge DECIMAL(18,3), @handlingInRate DECIMAL(18,3), @handlingOutRate DECIMAL(18,3), @extraServiceCharge DECIMAL(18,3), @distributionCharge DECIMAL(18,3),
			@taxCharge DECIMAL(18,3), @storageNominalCode NVARCHAR(50), @extraServicesNominalCode NVARCHAR(50), 
			@distributionChargeNominalCode NVARCHAR(50), @transportNominalCode NVARCHAR(50), @handlingNominalCode NVARCHAR(50),
			@invoiceCurrencySymbol NVARCHAR(10), @handlingInUnitTypeFK INT = -1,
			@handlingOutUnitTypeFK INT = -1, @handlingInUnitTypeCode NVARCHAR(200), 
			@handlingOutUnitTypeCode NVARCHAR(200), @UnitsToChargeForByStorageRateType DECIMAL(18,3),
			@storageRate DECIMAL(18,3), @storageRateSubject NVARCHAR(50), @storageRatePeriod NVARCHAR(50), @breakOver DECIMAL(18,3),
			@chargeText NVARCHAR(1000), @chargeText1 NVARCHAR(100), @chargeText2 NVARCHAR(100), @chargeText3 NVARCHAR(100), @chargeText4 NVARCHAR(100),
			@invoiceFrequencyFK INT, @currentPalletContent INT, @currentPalletAudit INT, @SQL NVARCHAR(4000), @UnitsToChargeFor DECIMAL(18,3), 
			@BreakMethodFK INT, @ChargeByTon BIT = 0, @var_endDate DATETIME

			SET @ChargeByTon = (	SELECT DISTINCT TOP 1 CASE WHEN ChargeByUnitTypeFK = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END 
									FROM dbo.tblStorageRates WHERE StorageRateTypeFK = 1 /*Division*/ AND FK = @var_divisionFK	)

			SELECT @storageNominalCode = NominalCode FROM appInvoiceLineTypes WHERE InvoiceLineTypePK = 1/*Storage*/
			SELECT @extraServicesNominalCode = NominalCode FROM appInvoiceLineTypes WHERE InvoiceLineTypePK = 2/*ExtraServices*/
			SELECT @distributionChargeNominalCode = NominalCode FROM appInvoiceLineTypes WHERE InvoiceLineTypePK = 3/*DistributionCharge*/
			SELECT @transportNominalCode = NominalCode FROM appInvoiceLineTypes WHERE InvoiceLineTypePK = 4/*Transport*/
			SELECT @handlingNominalCode = NominalCode FROM appInvoiceLineTypes WHERE InvoiceLineTypePK = 5/*Handling*/

			SET @invoiceCurrencySymbol = (SELECT TOP 1 currencies.CurrencySymbol FROM appSystem AS [system] 
			INNER JOIN tblCurrencies currencies ON currencies.CurrencyPK = [system].InvoiceCurrencyFK)

			SELECT 
				@taxRate= vatCodes.[Value], 
				@vatCodeFK = divisions.VatCodeFK,
				@customerFK = divisions.CustomerFK,
				@invoiceByCategory = divisions.InvoiceByCategory,
				@handlingInRate = divisions.HandlingInCharge,
				@handlingOutRate = divisions.HandlingOutCharge,
				@HandlingInUnitTypeFK = divisions.HandlingInUnitTypeFK,
				@HandlingOutUnitTypeFK = divisions.HandlingOutUnitTypeFK,
				@HandlingInUnitTypeCode = handlingInUnitTypes.Abbreviation,
				@HandlingOutUnitTypeCode = handlingOutUnitTypes.Abbreviation
			FROM 
				tblDivisions AS divisions
			INNER JOIN tblVatCodes AS vatCodes
				ON vatCodes.VatCodePK = divisions.VatCodeFK
			LEFT OUTER JOIN tblEachesTypes AS handlingInEachesTypes
				ON divisions.HandlingInEachesTypeFK = handlingInEachesTypes.EachesTypePK
			LEFT OUTER JOIN tblEachesTypes AS handlingOutEachesTypes
				ON divisions.HandlingOutEachesTypeFK = handlingOutEachesTypes.EachesTypePK
			LEFT OUTER JOIN tblUnitTypes AS handlingInUnitTypes
				ON divisions.HandlingInUnitTypeFK = handlingInUnitTypes.UnitTypePK
			LEFT OUTER JOIN tblUnitTypes AS handlingOutUnitTypes
				ON divisions.HandlingOutUnitTypeFK = handlingOutUnitTypes.UnitTypePK
			WHERE 
				divisions.DivisionPK = @var_divisionFK

			--IF (@var_InvoiceStorageCharge2 = 1)
			IF (@var_options & 2 = 2) 
			BEGIN --STORAGE					
				SELECT TOP 1
					@invoiceFrequencyFK = InvoiceFrequencyFK
				FROM 
					tblCustomers 
				WHERE 
					CustomerPK = @customerFK

				SELECT
					@var_startDate = CASE
										-- Last <Frequency Day> of the previous week
										WHEN @invoiceFrequencyFK BETWEEN 1 AND 7 /*AND (DATEDIFF(DAY, @var_startDate, @invoiceTo) > 7)*/ THEN
											DATEADD(DAY, -7, @invoiceTo)
										-- Last <Frequency Day> of the previous month 
										WHEN (@invoiceFrequencyFK BETWEEN 8 AND 14) /*AND (DATEDIFF(DAY,@var_startDate,@invoiceTo) > 31)*/ THEN
											dbo.fnGetLastSpecificDayOfWeekInPreviousMonth(@invoiceTo,@invoiceFrequencyFK)
										WHEN @invoiceFrequencyFK = 15 THEN -- Quarterly
											@var_startDate -- This needs to be coded properly if/when this frequency is ever used
										ELSE
											@var_startDate
									END

				SET @var_endDate = DATEADD(day,1,@var_invoiceTo)
				SET @var_startDate = DATEADD(day,1,@var_startDate)

				IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#TempPalletAudit') IS NOT NULL
					DROP TABLE #TempPalletAudit

				select 
					pa.PalletAuditPK, pa.PalletFK, pa.StockItemFK, pa.EventTypeFK, pa.EventFK, pa.EventDate
				into 
					#TempPalletAudit
				from 
					tblpalletaudit as pa
				inner join tblstockitems as s 
					on s.stockitempk = pa.stockitemfk 
				inner join tbldivisions as d 
					on d.divisionpk = s.divisionfk
				where 
					((@var_divisionFK > 0 and d.divisionpk = @var_divisionFK))
					and pa.eventdate >= @var_startDate

				SET @totalUnitsDepleated = 0.000

				DECLARE @invoiceSeparation TABLE 
				( 
					SpecialStockTypeFK INT, 
					SpecialStockType NVARCHAR(200),
					StockItemCategoryFK INT,
					StockItemCategory NVARCHAR(200) 
				)

				--SET the invoiceSeparation table
				IF(@invoiceByCategory = 1 /*cast(1 AS BIT)*/) 
				BEGIN
					INSERT INTO @invoiceSeparation
					SELECT DISTINCT * FROM (
						SELECT -1 AS SpecialStockTypeFK, '' AS SpecialStockType, -1 AS StockItemCategoryFK, '' AS StockItemCategory
						UNION
						SELECT -1 AS SpecialStockTypeFK, '' AS SpecialStockType, StockItemCategoryPK AS StockItemCategoryFK, StockItemCategory
						FROM tblStockItemCategories AS sics
						WHERE sics.CustomerFK = @customerFK				
					) AS subQ1
				END 
				ELSE 
				BEGIN
					INSERT INTO @invoiceSeparation
					SELECT DISTINCT * FROM (
						SELECT -1 AS SpecialStockTypeFK, '' AS SpecialStockType, -1 AS StockItemCategoryFK, '' AS StockItemCategory
						UNION
						SELECT SpecialStockTypeFK, cssts.CustomText, -1 AS StockItemCategoryFK, '' AS StockItemCategory
						FROM tblCustomerSpecialStockTypes AS cssts
						INNER JOIN appSpecialStockTypes AS ssts ON
						ssts.SpecialStockTypePK = cssts.SpecialStocktypeFK
						WHERE CustomerFK = @customerFK
						UNION
						SELECT sissts.SpecialStockTypeFK, ssts.SpecialStockType, -1 AS StockItemCategoryFK, '' AS StockItemCategory
						FROM tblStockItemSpecialStockTypes AS sissts
						INNER JOIN appSpecialStockTypes AS ssts ON
						ssts.SpecialStockTypePK = sissts.SpecialStockTypeFK
						WHERE StockItemFK IN (SELECT StockItemPK FROM tblStockItems WHERE DivisionFK = @var_divisionFK)
					) AS subQ1
				END

				DECLARE InvoiceSeparatorCursor CURSOR FAST_FORWARD FOR SELECT * FROM @invoiceSeparation
		
				OPEN InvoiceSeparatorCursor

				FETCH NEXT FROM InvoiceSeparatorCursor INTO @specialStockTypeFK, @specialStockType, @stockItemCategoryFK, @stockItemCategory

				WHILE (@@FETCH_STATUS = 0) 
				BEGIN	
					IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#currentLevel') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #currentLevel
			
					select 
						StockItemFK, sum(ActualPallets) ActualPallets, sum(AvailablePallets) AvailablePallets,	
						sum(ActualEaches) ActualEaches, sum(AvailableEaches) AvailableEaches, sum(ActualUnits) ActualUnits,
						sum(AvailableUnits) AvailableUnits, SpecialStockTypeFK 
					INTO
						#currentLevel
					from 
						(
							Select StockItemFK, sum(ActualPallets) ActualPallets, sum(AvailablePallets) AvailablePallets,	
							sum(ActualEaches) ActualEaches, sum(AvailableEaches) AvailableEaches, sum(ActualUnits) ActualUnits,
							sum(AvailableUnits) AvailableUnits, SpecialStockTypeFK 
							from tblStockLevels
							where MixedContentCount < 2
							Group By StockItemFK, SpecialStockTypeFK

							union 

							Select StockItemFK, 
							sum(ActualPallets) - (MixedContentCount-1) ActualPallets, 
							sum(AvailablePallets) - (MixedContentCount-1) AvailablePallets,		
							sum(ActualEaches) ActualEaches, sum(AvailableEaches) AvailableEaches, sum(ActualUnits) ActualUnits,
							sum(AvailableUnits) AvailableUnits, SpecialStockTypeFK
							from tblStockLevels
							where MixedContentCount > 1
							Group By StockItemFK, MixedContentCount, SpecialStockTypeFK

						) as subq 
					group by 
						stockitemfk, SpecialStockTypeFK

					IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#regrades') IS NOT NULL
						DROP TABLE #regrades						
				
					SELECT * INTO #regrades FROM
						(
							Select 0 as PalletsIn, 0 as UnitsIn, 0 as PalletsOut, 0 as UnitsOut, -1 as StockItemFK, 0 as LineType

							Union All

							Select 
								sum(PalletsIn) AS PalletsIn, sum(UnitsIn) AS UnitsIn, sum(PalletsOut) AS PalletsOut, sum(UnitsOut) AS UnitsOut, StockItemFK, 1 AS LineType		 
							from 
								(
									Select count(*) PalletsIn, SUM(UnitsAfter) UnitsIn, 0 PalletsOut, 0 UnitsOut, StockItemAfterFK as StockItemFK, 1 LineType
									From tblStockAdjustments sas
									Where InsertedDate BETWEEN @var_startDate AND @var_endDate
									AND StockItemBeforeFK <> StockItemAfterFK
									Group By StockItemAfterFK
									Union All
									Select 0 PalletsIn, 0 UnitsIn, count(*) PalletsOut, SUM(UnitsAfter) UnitsOut, StockItemBeforeFK StockItemFK, 2 LineType
									From tblStockAdjustments sas
									Where InsertedDate BETWEEN @var_startDate AND @var_endDate
									AND StockItemBeforeFK <> StockItemAfterFK
									Group By StockItemBeforeFK
								) as subQ
							Group By 
								StockItemFK
						)as subQ2
					where
						LineType = 0 /*We should always have this line*/
						OR
						LineType = 1 /*We have regrades*/

					IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#unitsOutAfterPeriod') IS NOT NULL
						DROP TABLE #unitsOutAfterPeriod				

					Select 
						sum(colpc.Units) AS UnitsOut, cols.StockItemFK
					INTO
						#unitsOutAfterPeriod
					from 
						tblContainerOutLines as cols
					inner join ( 
									Select ContainerOutLineFK, sum(Units) AS Units 
									from tblContainerOutLinePalletContent
									Group By ContainerOutLineFK
								) AS colpc 
						on colpc.ContainerOutLineFK = cols.ContainerOutLinePK
					inner join tblContainerOuts as cOuts 
						on cOuts.ContainerOutPK = cols.ContainerOutFK
					inner join (
									Select EventFK from #TempPalletAudit
									Where EventTypeFK in (2,3)/*Pallet or StockRemoved*/
									AND EventDate > @var_endDate
									Group By EventFK
								) AS [audit]
						on [audit].EventFK = cols.ContainerOutLinePK
					Where 
						cOuts.ContainerOutStatusFK = 5 /*Complete*/						
					Group By 
						StockItemFK		

					IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#palletOutsAfterPeriod') IS NOT NULL
						DROP TABLE #palletOutsAfterPeriod	

					Select 
						count(*) as PalletsOut, StockItemFK 
					into 
						#palletOutsAfterPeriod
					from 
						#TempPalletAudit
					Where 
						EventTypeFK in(2, 23) --= 2 /*PalletRemoved*/
						AND EventDate > @var_endDate 
					Group By 
						StockItemFK

				IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#audit') IS NOT NULL
					DROP TABLE #audit	

				Select 
					count(*) as PalletsAbsorbed, pa.PalletFK, StockItemFK, wos.FK
				into 
					#audit 
				from 
					#TempPalletAudit as pa
				inner join tblWorksOrders as wos
					on wos.WorksOrderPK = EventFK
				Where 
					EventTypeFK = 16 /*Topoff DepleatedPallet - Absorbed*/
					AND EventDate > @var_endDate
				Group By 
					pa.PalletFK, StockItemFK, wos.FK

				IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#insAfterPeriodDetails') IS NOT NULL
					DROP TABLE #insAfterPeriodDetails

				Select 
					sils.StockItemFK, pa.PalletFK, 1 - sum(isnull([audit].PalletsAbsorbed, 0)) as PalletsIn, sum(sils.Units) as UnitsIn
				into
					#insAfterPeriodDetails
				From 
					tblStockInLines as sils
				inner join tblStockIns as sins on
					sins.StockInPK = sils.StockInFK
				inner join tblContainerIns as cins on
					cins.ContainerInPK = sins.ContainerInFK
					AND cins.StockInStatusFK = 3 /*Completed*/			
				inner join tblstockinlinepallets silp on sils.stockinlinepk = silp.stockinlinefk
				inner join tblpalletaudit as pa on pa.EventTypeFK = 1 /*PalletCreated*/ AND silp.palletfk = pa.palletfk AND pa.StockItemFK = sils.StockItemFK
				left outer join #audit as [audit] 
					on [audit].StockItemFK = sils.StockItemFK
					AND [audit].FK = sins.StockInPK
					AND [audit].PalletFK = pa.PalletFK
				Where 
					cins.DateIn > @var_endDate
				Group By 
					sils.StockItemFK, pa.PalletFK			
				
				IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#insAfterPeriod') IS NOT NULL
					DROP TABLE #insAfterPeriod
							
				Select 
					StockItemFK, sum(PalletsIn) as PalletsIn, sum(UnitsIn) as UnitsIn 
				into 
					#insAfterPeriod
				from 
					#insAfterPeriodDetails 
				Group By 
					StockItemFK				
			
				-- Drop this table as no longer needed
				IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#insAfterPeriodDetails') IS NOT NULL
					DROP TABLE #insAfterPeriodDetails
				
				IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#palletOutsFromStartOfPeriod') IS NOT NULL
					DROP TABLE #palletOutsFromStartOfPeriod				

				Select count(*) as PalletsOut, StockItemFK 
				into #palletOutsFromStartOfPeriod
				from #TempPalletAudit
				Where EventTypeFK in (2,23)-- = 2 /*PalletRemoved*/
				AND EventDate >= @var_startDate
				Group By StockItemFK			

				IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#RegradesFromStartDetails') IS NOT NULL
					DROP TABLE #RegradesFromStartDetails	
										
				Select count(*) * -1 as Pallets, SUM(UnitsAfter) * -1 as Units, StockItemAfterFK as StockItemFK, 1 as LineType
				into #RegradesFromStartDetails
				From tblStockAdjustments as sas
				Where InsertedDate >= @var_startDate 
				AND StockItemBeforeFK <> StockItemAfterFK 
				Group By StockItemAfterFK

				insert into #RegradesFromStartDetails
				Select count(*) as Pallets, SUM(UnitsAfter) as Units, StockItemBeforeFK as StockItemFK, 2 as LineType
				From tblStockAdjustments as sas
				Where InsertedDate >= @var_startDate 
				AND StockItemBeforeFK <> StockItemAfterFK
				Group By StockItemBeforeFK				
				
				IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#RegradesFromStart') IS NOT NULL
					DROP TABLE #RegradesFromStart
								
				Select 
					sum(Pallets) as Pallets, sum(Units) as Units, StockItemFK, 1 as LineType 
				into 
					#RegradesFromStart
				from 
					#RegradesFromStartDetails 
				Group By 
					StockItemFK
			
				-- Drop table as it's no longer needed
				IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#RegradesFromStartDetails') IS NOT NULL
					DROP TABLE #RegradesFromStartDetails						
						
				IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#RegradesAfterPeriod') IS NOT NULL
					DROP TABLE #RegradesAfterPeriod					

				Select 
					sum(Pallets) as Pallets, sum(Units) as Units, StockItemFK, 1 as LineType 
				into
					#RegradesAfterPeriod
				from 
				(
					Select 
						count(*) * -1 as Pallets, SUM(UnitsAfter) * -1 as Units, StockItemAfterFK as StockItemFK, 1 as LineType
					From 
						tblStockAdjustments as sas
					Where 
						InsertedDate > @var_endDate 
						AND StockItemBeforeFK <> StockItemAfterFK
					Group By 
						StockItemAfterFK
				
					Union All

					Select 
						count(*) as Pallets, SUM(UnitsAfter) as Units, StockItemBeforeFK as StockItemFK, 2 as LineType
					From 
						tblStockAdjustments as sas
					Where 
						InsertedDate > @var_endDate 
						AND StockItemBeforeFK <> StockItemAfterFK
					Group By 
						StockItemBeforeFK
				) as subQ
				Group By 
					StockItemFK				

				IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#audit2') IS NOT NULL
					DROP TABLE #audit2	

				Select 
					EventFK
				into 
					#audit2
				from 
					#TempPalletAudit as pa
				Where 
					EventTypeFK in (2,3)/*Pallet or StockRemoved*/
					AND EventDate >= @var_startDate
				Group By 
					EventFK					
				
				IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#unitsOutFromStartOfPeriod') IS NOT NULL
					DROP TABLE #unitsOutFromStartOfPeriod

				Select 
					sum(colpc.Units) AS UnitsOut, cols.StockItemFK 
				INTO
					#unitsOutFromStartOfPeriod
				from 
					tblContainerOutLines AS cols
				inner join ( 
								Select ContainerOutLineFK, sum(Units) AS Units 
								from tblContainerOutLinePalletContent
								Group By ContainerOutLineFK
							) as colpc 
					on colpc.ContainerOutLineFK = cols.ContainerOutLinePK
				inner join tblContainerOuts as cOuts 
					on cOuts.ContainerOutPK = cols.ContainerOutFK
				inner join #audit2 AS [audit] --ZXC
					on [audit].EventFK = cols.ContainerOutLinePK
				Where 
					cOuts.ContainerOutStatusFK = 5 /*Complete*/
				Group By 
					StockItemFK									
				
				IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#audit3') IS NOT NULL
					DROP TABLE #audit3			
				
									Select 
										count(*) as PalletsAbsorbed, pa.PalletFK, StockItemFK, wos.FK 
									into
										#audit3
									from 
										#TempPalletAudit as pa
									inner join tblWorksOrders as wos 
										on wos.WorksOrderPK = EventFK
									Where 
										EventTypeFK = 16 /*Topoff DepleatedPallet - Absorbed*/
										AND EventDate >= @var_startDate
									Group By 
										pa.PalletFK, StockItemFK, wos.FK						
					
				IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#insFromStartOfPeriodDetail') IS NOT NULL
					DROP TABLE #insFromStartOfPeriodDetail	

				Select 
					sils.StockItemFK, pa.PalletFK, 1 - sum(isnull([audit].PalletsAbsorbed, 0)) as PalletsIn, sum(sils.Units) as UnitsIn
				into
					#insFromStartOfPeriodDetail
				From 
					tblStockInLines as sils
				inner join tblStockIns as sins on
					sins.StockInPK = sils.StockInFK
				inner join tblContainerIns as cins on
					cins.ContainerInPK = sins.ContainerInFK 
					AND cins.StockInStatusFK = 3 /*Completed*/			
				inner join tblstockinlinepallets silp 
					on sils.stockinlinepk = silp.stockinlinefk
				inner join tblpalletaudit as pa 
					on pa.EventTypeFK = 1 /*PalletCreated*/ 
					AND silp.palletfk = pa.palletfk 
					AND pa.StockItemFK = sils.StockItemFK
				left outer join #audit3 as [audit]
					on [audit].StockItemFK = sils.StockItemFK
					AND [audit].FK = sins.StockInPK
					AND pa.PalletFK = [audit].PalletFK
				Where 
					cins.DateIn > @var_startDate
				Group By 
					sils.StockItemFK, pa.PalletFK															

				IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#insFromStartOfPeriod') IS NOT NULL
					DROP TABLE #insFromStartOfPeriod
				
				Select 
					StockItemFK, sum(PalletsIn) as PalletsIn, sum(UnitsIn) as UnitsIn 
				into 
					#insFromStartOfPeriod
				from 
					#insFromStartOfPeriodDetail 
				Group By 
					StockItemFK		

				-- Drop table as it's no longer needed
				IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#insFromStartOfPeriodDetail') IS NOT NULL
					DROP TABLE #insFromStartOfPeriodDetail						

				IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#StockItemUnitGrandTotals') IS NOT NULL
					DROP TABLE #StockItemUnitGrandTotals

				CREATE TABLE #StockItemUnitGrandTotals
				(
					StockItemPK int,
					StockItemCode nvarchar(200),
					StockDescription nvarchar(500),
					OpeningTotalUnits decimal(18,3),
					ClosingTotalUnits decimal(18,3),
					UnitsIn decimal(18,3),
					UnitsOut decimal(18,3)
				)

				Insert Into #StockItemUnitGrandTotals
				select * 			
				from
					(
						Select 							
							StockItemPK,
							StockItemCode + case when regrades.LineType = 0 then '' else ' (Regrade)' end as StockItemCode,
							sis.[Description] as StockDescription,
							--Case when regrades.LineType = 0 then
							--	isnull(ActualPallets, 0) + isnull(palletOutsFromStartOfPeriod.PalletsOut, 0) - isnull(insFromStartOfPeriod.PalletsIn,0) + isnull(regradesFromStart.Pallets, 0)/*Regrades from start has the result of ins and outs- It is a total, you will not see RegradesFromStart.PalletsIn*/
							--else 0 end OpeningTotalPallets,

							Case when regrades.LineType = 0 then
								isnull(ActualUnits,0) + isnull(unitsOutFromStartOfPeriod.UnitsOut, 0)  - isnull(insFromStartOfPeriod.UnitsIn,0) + isnull(regradesFromStart.Units, 0)
							else 0 end OpeningTotalUnits,

							--isnull(ActualPallets, 0) + isnull(palletOutsAfterPeriod.PalletsOut, 0) - isnull(insAfterPeriod.PalletsIn,0) + isnull(regradesAfterPeriod.Pallets, 0) 
							--as ClosingTotalPallets,

							isnull(ActualUnits,0) + isnull(unitsOutAfterPeriod.UnitsOut, 0)  - isnull(insAfterPeriod.UnitsIn,0) + isnull(regradesAfterPeriod.Units, 0) 
							as ClosingTotalUnits,

							--Case when regrades.LineType = 0 then
							--	isnull(insFromStartOfPeriod.PalletsIn, 0) - isnull(insAfterPeriod.PalletsIn, 0)
							--else case when regrades.PalletsIn > 0 then regrades.PalletsIn else 0 end end PalletsIn,

							Case when regrades.LineType = 0 then
								isnull(insFromStartOfPeriod.UnitsIn, 0) - isnull(insAfterPeriod.UnitsIn, 0)
							else case when regrades.UnitsIn > 0 then regrades.UnitsIn else 0 end end UnitsIn,

							--Case when regrades.LineType = 0 then
							--	isnull(palletOutsFromStartOfPeriod.PalletsOut, 0) - isnull(palletOutsAfterPeriod.PalletsOut, 0) 
							--else case when regrades.PalletsOut > 0 then regrades.PalletsOut else 0 end end PalletsOut,

							Case when regrades.LineType = 0 then
							isnull(unitsOutFromStartOfPeriod.UnitsOut, 0) - isnull(unitsOutAfterPeriod.UnitsOut, 0) 
							else case when regrades.UnitsOut > 0 then regrades.UnitsOut else 0 end end UnitsOut

							--Case when regrades.LineType = 1 then 'R' else '' end IsRegrade
						from 
							tblStockItems as sis
						inner join tblDivisions as divisions
							on divisions.DivisionPK = sis.DivisionFK
						left outer join #currentLevel as currentLevel 
							on currentLevel.StockItemFK = sis.StockItemPK
						left outer join #palletOutsAfterPeriod as palletOutsAfterPeriod
							on palletOutsAfterPeriod.StockItemFK = sis.StockItemPK
						left outer join #unitsOutAfterPeriod AS unitsOutAfterPeriod
							ON unitsOutAfterPeriod.StockItemFK = sis.StockItemPK
						left outer join #insAfterPeriod as insAfterPeriod
							on insAfterPeriod.StockItemFK = sis.StockItemPK
						left outer join #palletOutsFromStartOfPeriod as palletOutsFromStartOfPeriod
							on palletOutsFromStartOfPeriod.StockItemFK = sis.StockItemPK
						inner join #regrades as regrades 
							on regrades.LineType = 0 /*We should always have this line*/
							OR
							(
								regrades.LineType = 1 /*We have regrades*/ 
								AND regrades.StockItemFK = sis.StockItemPK
							)
						left outer join #RegradesFromStart as RegradesFromStart 
							on RegradesFromStart.StockItemFK = sis.StockItemPK
						left outer join #RegradesAfterPeriod as RegradesAfterPeriod
							on RegradesAfterPeriod.StockItemFK = sis.StockItemPK
						left outer join #unitsOutFromStartOfPeriod as unitsOutFromStartOfPeriod 
							on unitsOutFromStartOfPeriod.StockItemFK = sis.StockItemPK
						left outer join #insFromStartOfPeriod as insFromStartOfPeriod
							ON insFromStartOfPeriod.StockItemFK = sis.StockItemPK
						Where 
							divisions.DivisionPK = @var_divisionFK
					) as subQ
				WHERE
					(OpeningTotalUnits <> 0 OR ClosingTotalUnits <> 0 OR UnitsIn <> 0 OR UnitsOut <> 0)
				
					-- ------------------------------------------
					-- Calculate the final stock pallet numbers.
					-- ------------------------------------------

					SELECT 
						@unitsIn = ISNULL(SUM(UnitsIn), 0),
						@unitsOut = ISNULL(SUM(UnitsOut), 0)
					FROM					
						#StockItemUnitGrandTotals	
						
					--#DEV 998 Rewrite Of How Break Overs Work
					--DECLARE @StockItemPK INT 
					--DECLARE @TimePeriod varchar(50)
					--DECLARE @StorageRateTypeFK INT = 0

					--DECLARE @CountStorageRates INT = 0
					--DECLARE @RateSet INT = 0
					--DECLARE @TotalRemainingUnits INT = 0
					--DECLARE @StockItemNumberOfUnits INT = 0

					--DECLARE @StockItemStorageRatesCursor AS CURSOR
					--DECLARE @DivisionStorageRatesCursor AS CURSOR
	
					--Get the invoice method, 1 = Opening Units + UnitsIn, 2 = Closing Units
					SELECT @invoiceMethodFK = InvoiceMethodFK FROM tblDivisions WHERE DivisionPK = @var_divisionFK

					IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#UnitsToChargeForByStockItem') IS NOT NULL
						DROP TABLE #UnitsToChargeForByStockItem

					CREATE TABLE #UnitsToChargeForByStockItem
					(
						StockItemPK INT, 
						TotalUnits DECIMAL(18,3), 
						DivisionFK INT, 
						StorageRate DECIMAL(18,3), 
						StorageRateTypeFK INT, 
						BreakMethodFK INT, 
						BreakOver DECIMAL(18,3),
						InvoiceMethodFK INT,
						StorageRateSubject VARCHAR(10),
						TimePeriod VARCHAR(50),
						RateSet INT
					)

					-- Invoice Method 1: Use  Opening Pallets && PalletsIn,
					IF @invoiceMethodFK = 1
						BEGIN
							INSERT INTO #UnitsToChargeForByStockItem
							SELECT 
								StockItemPK, 
								SUM(OpeningTotalUnits + UnitsIn) AS TotalUnits,
								@var_divisionFK AS DivisionFK,
								CAST(0.000 AS DECIMAL(18,3)) AS StorageRate, 
								CAST(-1 AS INT) AS StorageRateTypeFK, 
								CAST(-1 AS INT) AS BreakMethodFK, 
								CAST(0.000 AS DECIMAL(18,3)) AS BreakOver,
								1 As InvoiceMethod,
								CAST('' AS VARCHAR(10)) AS StorageRateSubject,
								CAST('' AS VARCHAR(50)) AS TimePeriod,
								CAST(0 AS INT) AS RateSet
							FROM 
								#StockItemUnitGrandTotals  
							WHERE 
								(OpeningTotalUnits <> 0) OR (UnitsIn <> 0)
							GROUP BY 
								StockItemPK
						END
					ELSE
						--Invoice Method 2: Use Closing Pallets
						BEGIN
							INSERT INTO #UnitsToChargeForByStockItem
							SELECT 
								StockItemPK, 	
								SUM(ClosingTotalUnits) AS TotalUnits, 
								@var_divisionFK AS DivisionPK,
								CAST(0.000 AS DECIMAL(18,3)) AS StorageRate, 
								CAST(-1 AS INT) AS StorageRateTypeFK, 
								CAST(-1 AS INT) AS BreakMethodFK, 
								CAST(0.000 AS DECIMAL(18,3)) AS BreakOver,
								0 As InvoiceMethod,
								CAST('' AS VARCHAR(10)) AS StorageRateSubject,
								CAST('' AS VARCHAR(50)) AS TimePeriod,
								CAST(0 AS INT) AS RateSet
							FROM 
								#StockItemUnitGrandTotals 
							WHERE 
								(OpeningTotalUnits <> 0) OR (UnitsIn <> 0)
							GROUP BY 
								StockItemPK
						END

						IF @ChargeByTon = 1 
						begin
							update #UnitsToChargeForByStockItem set TotalUnits = (TotalUnits / 1000.000)
						end


					-- Declare Variable Here.
					DECLARE @StockItemPK INT 
					DECLARE @TimePeriod varchar(50)
					DECLARE @StorageRateTypeFK INT = 0

					DECLARE @StockItemStorageRatesCursor AS CURSOR
					DECLARE @DivisionStorageRatesCursor AS CURSOR

					DECLARE @CountStorageRates INT = 0
					DECLARE @RateSet INT = 0
					--DECLARE @RowCounter INT = 0
					--DECLARE @TotalRemainingPallets INT = 0
					DECLARE @StockItemNumberOfUnits INT = 0


					-- Create a Temp Table. StockItems with Storage Rates
					IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#StockItemStorageRates') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #StockItemStorageRates

					--Insert Into Temp Table
					Select	T.StockItemPK,
							srs.StorageRate, 
							srs.StorageRateTypeFK, 
							srs.BreakMethodFK,
							srs.BreakOver, 
							CASE	WHEN ChargeByPallet = 1 /*cast(1 AS BIT)*/ THEN 'Pallet' 
									WHEN ChargeByEach = 1 /*cast(1 AS BIT)*/ THEN 	'Each' 
									WHEN ChargeByUnit = 1 /*cast(1 AS BIT)*/ THEN 	'Unit' 
							END As StorageRateSubject,
							tps.TimePeriod,
							0 As RateSet,
							0 As MutlipleStorageRates,
							srs.SpecialStockTypeFK
					Into #StockItemStorageRates
					From #UnitsToChargeForByStockItem As T
						 INNER JOIN tblStorageRates AS srs ON T.StockItemPK = srs.FK
						 INNER JOIN appTimePeriods AS tps ON tps.TimePeriodPK = srs.ChargePeriodFK
					WHERE srs.StorageRateTypeFK = 2 /*StockItem*/ AND 
						  ((@invoiceByCategory = 0 /*cast(0 AS BIT)*/ AND SpecialStockTypeFK = @specialStockTypeFK) OR (@invoiceByCategory = 1) /*cast(1 AS BIT)*/)
					Group By T.StockItemPK, srs.StorageRateTypeFK, srs.StorageRate, srs.BreakMethodFK, srs.BreakOver, 
							 srs.ChargeByPallet, srs.ChargeByEach, srs.ChargeByUnit, tps.TimePeriod, srs.SpecialStockTypeFK
					Order By T.StockItemPK, srs.BreakOver Desc


					-- SET MutlipleStorageRates Flag
					UPDATE #StockItemStorageRates
					SET MutlipleStorageRates = 1
					WHERE StockItemPK IN (Select StockItemPK
										  From  #StockItemStorageRates
										  Group By StockItemPK 
										  HAVING Count(StorageRate) > 1)

					-- Update #UnitsToChargeForByStockItem, Get Pallets which Use SINGLE StockItem StorageRate &&  Update #PalletsToChargeFor incl. RateSet
					UPDATE T
						SET 
							StorageRateTypeFK = siStorageRates.StorageRateTypeFK,
							StorageRate = siStorageRates.StorageRate, 
							BreakMethodFK = (CASE WHEN ISNULL(siStorageRates.BreakMethodFK, -1) > 1 THEN -1 ELSE siStorageRates.BreakMethodFK END),
							BreakOver = siStorageRates.BreakOver,
							StorageRateSubject = siStorageRates.StorageRateSubject,
							TimePeriod = siStorageRates.TimePeriod,
							RateSet = 1
						FROM 
							#UnitsToChargeForByStockItem As T
							INNER JOIN #StockItemStorageRates As siStorageRates On T.StockItemPK = siStorageRates.StockItemPK
						WHERE 
							siStorageRates.StorageRateTypeFK = 2 /*StockItem*/
							AND ((@invoiceByCategory = 0 /*cast(0 AS BIT)*/ AND siStorageRates.SpecialStockTypeFK = @specialStockTypeFK) OR (@invoiceByCategory = 1) /*cast(1 AS BIT)*/) 
							AND siStorageRates.MutlipleStorageRates = 0


					-- Declare Cursor to Loop temp Table #StockItemStorageRates
					SET @StockItemStorageRatesCursor  = CURSOR FAST_FORWARD FOR 
					SELECT StockItemPK, StorageRate, StorageRateTypeFK, BreakMethodFK, BreakOver, StorageRateSubject, TimePeriod
					FROM #StockItemStorageRates
					WHERE #StockItemStorageRates.MutlipleStorageRates = 1
					ORDER BY StockItemPK, BreakOver Desc
							
					-- Loop @StockItemStorageRatesCursor
					OPEN @StockItemStorageRatesCursor
					FETCH NEXT FROM @StockItemStorageRatesCursor INTO @StockItemPK, @StorageRate, @StorageRateTypeFK, @BreakMethodFK, 
																	  @BreakOver, @StorageRateSubject, @TimePeriod
					WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
						BEGIN

							--Blanket Break Method
							IF (@BreakMethodFK = 1)
								-- If @BreakOver  = 0.000
								IF (CONVERT(INT, @BreakOver) = 0)
								BEGIN
										--UPDATE Existing Record
										UPDATE #UnitsToChargeForByStockItem  
										SET StorageRateTypeFK = @StorageRateTypeFK,
											BreakMethodFK = @BreakMethodFK,
											StorageRateSubject = @StorageRateSubject, 
											TimePeriod = @TimePeriod,
											RateSet = 1
										WHERE #UnitsToChargeForByStockItem.StockItemPK = @StockItemPK AND
											  #UnitsToChargeForByStockItem.StorageRateTypeFK = -1 AND
											  CONVERT(INT, #UnitsToChargeForByStockItem.StorageRate) = 0 AND
											  #UnitsToChargeForByStockItem.RateSet = 0
								END
								ELSE
								BEGIN

									Select @StockItemNumberOfUnits = T.TotalUnits 
									From #UnitsToChargeForByStockItem T 
									Where T.StockItemPK = @StockItemPK AND 
										  T.StorageRateTypeFK = -1 AND
										  CONVERT(INT, T.StorageRate) = 0 AND
										  T.RateSet = 0

									-- Update Record If @@StockItemNumberOfUnits Greather than @BreakOver
									IF (@StockItemNumberOfUnits > CONVERT(INT, @BreakOver))

										-- Update Existing Record
										UPDATE #UnitsToChargeForByStockItem  
										SET StorageRateTypeFK = @StorageRateTypeFK,
											StorageRate = @StorageRate,
											BreakMethodFK = @BreakMethodFK,
											StorageRateSubject = @StorageRateSubject, 
											TimePeriod = @TimePeriod,
											RateSet = 1
										WHERE #UnitsToChargeForByStockItem.StockItemPK = @StockItemPK AND
											  #UnitsToChargeForByStockItem.StorageRateTypeFK = -1 AND 
											  CONVERT(INT, #UnitsToChargeForByStockItem.StorageRate) = 0 AND
											  #UnitsToChargeForByStockItem.RateSet = 0
								END
							ELSE
								--Gradual Break Method
							
								-- If @BreakOver  = 0.000
								IF (CONVERT(INT, @BreakOver) = 0)
								BEGIN
										--UPDATE Existing Record
										UPDATE #UnitsToChargeForByStockItem  
										SET StorageRateTypeFK = @StorageRateTypeFK,
											BreakMethodFK = @BreakMethodFK,
											StorageRateSubject = @StorageRateSubject, 
											TimePeriod = @TimePeriod,
											RateSet = 1
										WHERE #UnitsToChargeForByStockItem.StockItemPK = @StockItemPK AND
											  #UnitsToChargeForByStockItem.StorageRateTypeFK = -1 AND
											  CONVERT(INT, #UnitsToChargeForByStockItem.StorageRate) = 0 AND
											  #UnitsToChargeForByStockItem.RateSet = 0
								END
								ELSE
								BEGIN
									Select @StockItemNumberOfUnits = T.TotalUnits
									From #UnitsToChargeForByStockItem T 
									Where T.StockItemPK = @StockItemPK AND 
										  T.RateSet = 0 AND
										  T.StorageRate = @StorageRate

									IF (@StockItemNumberOfUnits > @BreakOver)
									BEGIN
								
										--Create New Record in #PalletsToChargeFor
										INSERT INTO #UnitsToChargeForByStockItem (StockItemPK, TotalUnits, DivisionFK, StorageRateTypeFK, StorageRate, 
																				  BreakMethodFK, BreakOver, InvoiceMethodFK, StorageRateSubject, TimePeriod, RateSet)
										SELECT  @StockItemPK, 
												(@StockItemNumberOfUnits - @StockItemNumberOfUnits),
												T.DivisionFK,
												@StorageRateTypeFK,
												@StorageRate,
												@BreakMethodFK,
												@BreakOver,
												T.InvoiceMethodFK,
												@StorageRateSubject,
												@TimePeriod,
												RateSet = 1
										FROM #UnitsToChargeForByStockItem As T
										WHERE T.StockItemPK = @StockItemPK AND 
											  T.StorageRateTypeFK = -1 AND
											  CONVERT(INT, T.StorageRate) = 0 AND 
											  T.RateSet = 0

										--Update TotalUnits in Existing Record
										SET @RateSet = 0
										UPDATE #UnitsToChargeForByStockItem  
										SET TotalUnits = @BreakOver
										WHERE  #UnitsToChargeForByStockItem.StockItemPK = @StockItemPK AND
											   #UnitsToChargeForByStockItem.StorageRateTypeFK = -1 AND
											   CONVERT(INT, #UnitsToChargeForByStockItem.StorageRate) = 0 AND
											   #UnitsToChargeForByStockItem.RateSet = 0
									END
								END

							FETCH NEXT FROM @StockItemStorageRatesCursor INTO @StockItemPK, @StorageRate, @StorageRateTypeFK, @BreakMethodFK, 
																			  @BreakOver, @StorageRateSubject, @TimePeriod
						END
						
					CLOSE @StockItemStorageRatesCursor
					DEALLOCATE @StockItemStorageRatesCursor

						
					IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#UnitsStorageDetails') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #UnitsStorageDetails

					CREATE TABLE #UnitsStorageDetails
					(
						StorageRateTypeFK INT,
						StorageRate DECIMAL(18,3),
						UnitsToChargeFor DECIMAL(18,3),
						BreakMethodFK INT, 
						BreakOver DECIMAL(18,3),
						StorageRateSubject varchar(10),
						TimePeriod varchar(50),
						RateSet INT
					)

					INSERT INTO #UnitsStorageDetails (StorageRateTypeFK, StorageRate, UnitsToChargeFor, BreakMethodFK, 
													  BreakOver, StorageRateSubject, TimePeriod, RateSet)
					SELECT	StorageRateTypeFK, 
							StorageRate, 
							SUM(TotalUnits) AS UnitsToChargeFor, 
							BreakMethodFK, 
							BreakOver,
							StorageRateSubject,
							TimePeriod,
							RateSet
					FROM #UnitsToChargeForByStockItem 
					GROUP BY StorageRateTypeFK, 
							StorageRate, 
							BreakMethodFK, 
							BreakOver,
							StorageRateSubject,
							TimePeriod,
							RateSet

					IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#DivisionMultipleStorageRates') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #DivisionMultipleStorageRates
					
					--Insert Into Temp Table Records which Do Not have a RateSet
					Select	srs.StorageRateTypeFK,
							srs.StorageRate, 
							srs.BreakMethodFK,
							srs.BreakOver,
							CASE WHEN ChargeByPallet = 1 /*cast(1 AS BIT)*/ THEN 'Pallet' 
								 WHEN ChargeByEach = 1 /*cast(1 AS BIT)*/ THEN 	'Each' 
								 WHEN ChargeByUnit = 1 /*cast(1 AS BIT)*/ THEN 	'Unit' 
							END As StorageRateSubject,
							tps.TimePeriod,
							0 As RateSet
					Into #DivisionMultipleStorageRates
					From 									
						tblStorageRates AS srs
						INNER JOIN appTimePeriods AS tps ON tps.TimePeriodPK = srs.ChargePeriodFK	
					WHERE srs.FK =  @var_divisionFK AND 
						  srs.StorageRateTypeFK < 2  AND
						  ((@invoiceByCategory = 0 /*cast(0 AS BIT)*/ AND srs.SpecialStockTypeFK = @specialStockTypeFK) OR (@invoiceByCategory = 1) /*cast(1 AS BIT)*/)
					Group By srs.StorageRateTypeFK, srs.StorageRate, srs.BreakMethodFK, srs.BreakOver, 
							 srs.ChargeByPallet, srs.ChargeByEach, srs.ChargeByUnit, tps.TimePeriod, 
							 srs.FK, srs.SpecialStockTypeFK 
					Order By srs.BreakOver Desc;
					
					Declare @CountDivisionStorageRates INT
					Select @CountDivisionStorageRates = Count(*) From #DivisionMultipleStorageRates
					
					-- Division Has Only One Storage Rate
					if(@CountDivisionStorageRates = 0)
					begin 
					print '@CountDivisionStorageRates = 0'
						UPDATE #UnitsStorageDetails
						SET RateSet = 1
					end
					else IF (@CountDivisionStorageRates = 1)
					BEGIN
						-- StorageRateTypeFK < 2 (Division) And Single Storage Rate
						-- Update #UnitsStorageDetails, Get Pallets which Use Single Division Storage Rate &&  Update #PalletsStorageDetails incl. RateSet
						UPDATE #UnitsStorageDetails
							SET 
								StorageRateTypeFK = srs.StorageRateTypeFK,
								StorageRate = srs.StorageRate, 
								BreakMethodFK = SRS.BreakMethodFK,
								BreakOver = SRS.BreakOver,
								StorageRateSubject = MultipleRates.StorageRateSubject,
								TimePeriod = tps.TimePeriod,
								RateSet = 1
							FROM 
								tblStorageRates AS srs
								INNER JOIN appTimePeriods AS tps ON tps.TimePeriodPK = srs.ChargePeriodFK
								LEFT JOIN #DivisionMultipleStorageRates As MultipleRates On srs.StorageRate = MultipleRates.StorageRate
							WHERE 
								srs.StorageRateTypeFK < 2 /*Division Storage Rate Type */
								AND srs.FK = @var_divisionFK /* Division Parameter */
								AND ((@invoiceByCategory = 0 /*cast(0 AS BIT)*/ AND SpecialStockTypeFK = @specialStockTypeFK) OR (@invoiceByCategory = 1) /*cast(1 AS BIT)*/) 
								--AND MultipleRates.StorageRate = NULL
								--AND T.RateSet = 0
					END
					ELSE IF (@CountDivisionStorageRates > 1)
					BEGIN
						
						-- Declare Cursor to Loop temp Table #StockItemMultipleStorageRates
						SET @DivisionStorageRatesCursor = CURSOR FAST_FORWARD FOR 
						SELECT StorageRateTypeFK, StorageRate, BreakMethodFK, BreakOver, StorageRateSubject, TimePeriod
						FROM #DivisionMultipleStorageRates
						ORDER BY StorageRateTypeFK, BreakOver Desc

						-- Loop @DivisionStorageRatesCursor
						OPEN @DivisionStorageRatesCursor
						FETCH NEXT FROM @DivisionStorageRatesCursor INTO @StorageRateTypeFK, @StorageRate, @BreakMethodFK, 
																		 @BreakOver, @StorageRateSubject, @TimePeriod
							WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
							BEGIN
								--Blanket Break Method
								IF (@BreakMethodFK = 1)

									IF (CONVERT(INT, @BreakOver) = 0)
									BEGIN
										IF (CONVERT(INT, @BreakOver) = 0)
										BEGIN
											--UPDATE Existing Record
											UPDATE #UnitsStorageDetails  
											SET StorageRateTypeFK = @StorageRateTypeFK,
												StorageRate = @StorageRate,
												BreakMethodFK = @BreakMethodFK,
												StorageRateSubject = @StorageRateSubject, 
												TimePeriod = @TimePeriod,
												RateSet = 1
											WHERE #UnitsStorageDetails.StorageRateTypeFK = -1 AND 
												  CONVERT(INT,#UnitsStorageDetails.StorageRate) = 0 AND
												  #UnitsStorageDetails.RateSet = 0
										END
									END
									ELSE
									BEGIN

										Select @StockItemNumberOfUnits = T.UnitsToChargeFor 
										From #UnitsStorageDetails T 
										Where T.StorageRateTypeFK = -1 AND
											  CONVERT(INT, T.StorageRate) = 0 AND
											  T.RateSet = 0

										-- Update Record If @StockItemNumberOfUnits Greather than @BreakOver
										IF (@StockItemNumberOfUnits > CONVERT(INT, @BreakOver))

											-- Update Existing Record,
											UPDATE #UnitsStorageDetails  
											SET StorageRateTypeFK = @StorageRateTypeFK,
												StorageRate = @StorageRate,
												BreakMethodFK = @BreakMethodFK,
												StorageRateSubject = @StorageRateSubject, 
												TimePeriod = @TimePeriod,
												RateSet = 1
											WHERE 	#UnitsStorageDetails.StorageRateTypeFK = -1 AND 
													CONVERT(INT, #UnitsStorageDetails.StorageRate) = 0 AND
													#UnitsStorageDetails.RateSet = 0
									END
								ELSE
									-- Gradual Break Method

									-- If @BreakOver = 0, UPDATE Detail In Existing Record
									IF (CONVERT(INT, @BreakOver) = 0)
									BEGIN
										--UPDATE  RateSet In Existing Record
										UPDATE #UnitsStorageDetails  
										SET StorageRateTypeFK = @StorageRateTypeFK,
											StorageRate = @StorageRate,
											BreakMethodFK = @BreakMethodFK,
											StorageRateSubject = @StorageRateSubject, 
											TimePeriod = @TimePeriod,
											RateSet = 1
										WHERE #UnitsStorageDetails.StorageRateTypeFK < 2 AND 
										      Convert(INT, #UnitsStorageDetails.StorageRate) = 0 AND 
											  #UnitsStorageDetails.RateSet = 0
									END
									ELSE
									BEGIN
									
										Select @StockItemNumberOfUnits = T.UnitsToChargeFor 
										From #UnitsStorageDetails T 
										Where T.StorageRateTypeFK = -1 AND
												CONVERT(INT, T.StorageRate) = 0 AND
												T.RateSet = 0

										IF (@StockItemNumberOfUnits > @BreakOver)
										BEGIN
										--Create New Line(s) in #PalletsStorageDetails
										INSERT INTO #UnitsStorageDetails (StorageRateTypeFK, StorageRate, UnitsToChargeFor, BreakMethodFK, 
																		  BreakOver, StorageRateSubject, TimePeriod, RateSet)
											SELECT	@StorageRate,
													@StorageRateTypeFK,
													(@StockItemNumberOfUnits - @BreakOver),
													@BreakMethodFK,
													@BreakOver,
													@StorageRateSubject,
													@TimePeriod,
													RateSet = 1
											FROM #UnitsStorageDetails As T
											WHERE T.StorageRateTypeFK < 2 AND
												  CONVERT(INT, T.StorageRate) = 0 AND
												  T.RateSet = 0

										--UPDATE  Detail In Existing Record
										UPDATE #UnitsStorageDetails  
										SET UnitsToChargeFor = @BreakOver
										WHERE #UnitsStorageDetails.StorageRateTypeFK < 2 AND 
										      CONVERT(INT, #UnitsStorageDetails.StorageRate) = 0 AND 
											  #UnitsStorageDetails.RateSet = 0
										END
									END

								FETCH NEXT FROM @DivisionStorageRatesCursor INTO @StorageRateTypeFK, @StorageRate, @BreakMethodFK, 
																				 @BreakOver, @StorageRateSubject, @TimePeriod
							END
						
						CLOSE @DivisionStorageRatesCursor
						DEALLOCATE @DivisionStorageRatesCursor

					END 

					--check are storage rates the same, and combine into one total if they are
					if((select count(*) from #UnitsStorageDetails) > 1)
					begin
						if((select count(*) from(select distinct StorageRateTypeFK, StorageRate, BreakMethodFK, BreakOver, StorageRateSubject, TimePeriod, RateSet from #UnitsStorageDetails)subq) = 1)
						begin
							declare @tmptotalUnits decimal(18,3)
							set @tmptotalUnits = (select sum(unitstochargefor) from #UnitsStorageDetails)

							;WITH cte AS
							(
							SELECT  *
							FROM    #UnitsStorageDetails
							ORDER BY unitstochargefor
							OFFSET 1 ROWS
							)
							DELETE cte ;

							update #UnitsStorageDetails set unitstochargefor = @tmptotalUnits
						end
					end
		
					IF XACT_STATE() = 0 AND @@TRANCOUNT < 1 BEGIN TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName

					INSERT INTO tblInvoiceLines (InvoiceFK, DivisionFK, InvoiceLineTypeFK, 
												 BuildingUnitFK, 
												 InvoiceLineStatusFK, NominalCode, 
												 Charge, ChargeText, ChargeText1, ChargeText2, ChargeText3, ChargeText4,
											     VatCodeFK, TaxRate, Tax, 
												 IsArchived, InsertedBy, InsertedDate, UpdatedBy, UpdatedDate,DepartmentFK)

					SELECT 
						@var_invoiceFK,
						@var_divisionFK,
						1/* Storage Invoice Line Type, appInvoiceLineTypes */, 
						@var_buildingUnitFK,
						1/*Generated*/,
						@storageNominalCode,
						ROUND((Units.StorageRate * Units.UnitsToChargeFor), 2), --ISNULL(ROUND((StorageRate * PalletsToChargeFor), 2), 0), Pallets.PalletsToChargeFor
						'Storage Charges ON ' + CASE WHEN (@invoiceByCategory = 0 /*cast(0 AS BIT)*/ AND @specialStockTypeFK <> -1) THEN '(' + @specialStockType + ')' 
													 WHEN (@invoiceByCategory = 1 /*cast(1 AS BIT)*/ AND @stockItemCategoryFK <> -1) THEN '(' + @stockItemCategory + ')' 
													 ELSE '' 
												END,
						CAST(Units.UnitsToChargeFor AS NVARCHAR(50)),
						CASE WHEN Units.UnitsToChargeFor = 1 THEN 'Pallet' ELSE 'Pallets' END, 
						'@ ' + CAST(ROUND(Units.StorageRate, 2) AS VARCHAR(50)),  --'@ ' + CAST(CAST(StorageRate AS DECIMAL(18,3)) AS VARCHAR(50)),
						'Per ' + Units.StorageRateSubject + ' Per ' +  Units.TimePeriod,
						ISNULL(@vatCodeFK,-1),
						ISNULL(@taxRate, 0),
						ROUND(((@taxRate/100) * ROUND((Units.StorageRate * Units.UnitsToChargeFor), 2)), 2),
						0,
						1, 
						dbo.GetBSTDate(), 
						1, 
						dbo.GetBSTDate(),
						@var_departmentFK
					FROM #UnitsStorageDetails Units
					WHERE Units.RateSet = 1

					-- END OF #DEV-998



					IF @ChargeByTon = 1 
					BEGIN
						SET @unitsIn = @unitsIn / 1000.000
						SET @unitsOut = @unitsOut / 1000.000
					END

					/******  HANDLING IN ******/

					IF(ISNULL(@unitsIn, 0.000) > 0 AND ISNULL(@handlingInUnitTypeFK, 0) > 0)
					BEGIN
						SELECT @handlingCharge = ISNULL(@unitsIn, 0.000) * @handlingInRate

						SET @chargeText = 'Handling In Charges ON ' + CASE WHEN (@invoiceByCategory = 0 /*cast(0 AS BIT)*/ AND @specialStockTypeFK <> -1) THEN 
							'(' + @specialStockType + ')' WHEN (@invoiceByCategory = 1 /*cast(1 AS BIT)*/ AND @stockItemCategoryFK <> -1) THEN 
								'(' + @stockItemCategory + ')' ELSE '' END 

						SET @chargeText1 = CAST(@unitsIn AS NVARCHAR(200))

						SELECT @chargeText2 = CASE WHEN @unitsIn = 1.000 THEN UnitTypeSingular ELSE UnitType END 
						FROM tblUnitTypes WHERE UnitType = @handlingInUnitTypeCode

						SET @chargetext3 = '@ ' +  CAST(@handlingInRate AS NVARCHAR(50))

						SELECT @chargeText4 = 'Per ' + UnitTypeSingular 
						FROM tblUnitTypes WHERE UnitType = @handlingInUnitTypeCode

						--print 'inserting handling in charge'
						--print @handlingCharge
						
						SET @handlingCharge = ISNULL(@handlingCharge, 0.000)
						SET @vatCodeFK = ISNULL(@vatCodeFK, -1)
						SET @taxRate = ISNULL(@taxRate, 0.000)
						SET @chargeText1 = ISNULL(@chargeText1,'')
						SET @chargeText2 = ISNULL(@chargeText2,'')
						SET @chargeText3 = ISNULL(@chargeText3,'')
						SET @chargeText4 = ISNULL(@chargeText4,'')

						IF XACT_STATE() = 0 AND @@TRANCOUNT < 1 BEGIN TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName
										
						INSERT INTO tblInvoiceLines
						VALUES(		@var_invoiceFK, 
									@var_divisionFK, 
									5/*Handling*/, 
									@var_buildingUnitFK, 
									1/*Generated*/, 
									@handlingNominalCode, @handlingCharge, 
									@chargeText, @chargeText1, @chargeText2, @chargeText3, @chargeText4, 
									@vatCodeFK, @taxRate, ((@taxRate/100.000) * @handlingCharge),
									0 /*cast(1 AS BIT)*/, 1, dbo.GetBSTDate(), 1, dbo.GetBSTDate(), 
									@var_departmentFK
								)
					END

					/*HANDLING OUT*/

					IF(ISNULL(@unitsOut, 0.000) > 0.000 AND ISNULL(@HandlingOutUnitTypeFK, 0) > 0)
					BEGIN
						SELECT @handlingCharge = ISNULL(@unitsOut, 0.000) * @handlingOutRate

						SET @chargeText = 'Handling Out Charges ON ' + CASE WHEN (@invoiceByCategory = 0 /*cast(0 AS BIT)*/ AND @specialStockTypeFK <> -1) THEN 
							'(' + @specialStockType + ')' WHEN (@invoiceByCategory = 1 /*cast(1 AS BIT)*/ AND @stockItemCategoryFK <> -1) THEN 
								'(' + @stockItemCategory + ')' ELSE '' END 

						SET @chargeText1 = CAST(@unitsOut AS NVARCHAR(200))

						SELECT @chargeText2 = CASE WHEN @unitsOut = 1.000 THEN UnitTypeSingular ELSE UnitType END 
						FROM tblUnitTypes WHERE UnitType = @handlingOutUnitTypeCode

						SET @chargeText3 = '@ ' + CAST(@handlingOutRate AS NVARCHAR(50))

						SELECT @chargeText4 = 'Per ' + UnitTypeSingular 
						FROM tblUnitTypes WHERE UnitType = @handlingOutUnitTypeCode

						SET @handlingCharge = ISNULL(@handlingCharge, 0.000)
						SET @vatCodeFK = ISNULL(@vatCodeFK,-1)
						SET @taxRate = ISNULL(@taxRate,0.000)
						SET @chargeText1 = ISNULL(@chargeText1,'')
						SET @chargeText2 = ISNULL(@chargeText2,'')
						SET @chargeText3 = ISNULL(@chargeText3,'')
						SET @chargeText4 = ISNULL(@chargeText4,'')		

						IF XACT_STATE() = 0 AND @@TRANCOUNT < 1 BEGIN TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName

						INSERT INTO tblInvoiceLines
						VALUES(
									@var_invoiceFK, 
									@var_divisionFK, 
									5/*Handling*/, 
									@var_buildingUnitFK,
									1/*Generated*/, 
									@handlingNominalCode, @handlingCharge, 
									@chargeText, @chargeText1, @chargeText2, @chargeText3, @chargeText4, 
									@vatCodeFK, @taxRate, ((@taxRate/100.000) * @handlingCharge),
									0 /*cast(0 AS BIT)*/, 1, dbo.GetBSTDate(), 1, dbo.GetBSTDate(), 
									@var_departmentFK
								)
					END

					FETCH NEXT FROM InvoiceSeparatorCursor INTO @specialStockTypeFK, @specialStockType, @stockItemCategoryFK, @stockItemCategory
				END /*End of Special Stock Cursor*/

--exit_code2:

				CLOSE InvoiceSeparatorCursor
				DEALLOCATE InvoiceSeparatorCursor
			END

			--IF (@var_InvoiceExtraServicesCharge2 = 1) 
			IF (@var_options & 4 = 4)
			BEGIN --EXTRA SERVICES
				SELECT TOP 1 @lastExtraService = InvoiceToDate 
				FROM tblInvoices AS invs
				INNER JOIN tblInvoiceLines AS invls ON
				invls.InvoiceFK = invs.InvoicePK
				WHERE invls.DivisionFK = @var_divisionFK
				AND invs.Options & 4 = 4
				--AND invs.ExtraServicesCharges = 1	/* invs.Options Has Been Replaced By Individual Charge Flags. */
				AND invs.InvoiceTypeFK = 3			/* Scheduled Invoice. */
				and invoicepk <> @var_invoiceFK --not this invoice
				ORDER BY InvoiceToDate DESC
			
				print 'inserting extra service charge'
				print @lastExtraService
				print @var_invoiceTo

				IF XACT_STATE() = 0 AND @@TRANCOUNT < 1 BEGIN TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName

				SET @vatCodeFK = ISNULL(@vatCodeFK,-1)
				SET @taxRate = ISNULL(@taxRate,0)

				INSERT INTO tblInvoiceLines
				SELECT 
				DISTINCT @var_invoiceFK, 
				@var_divisionFK, 
				2/*Extra Services*/, 
				@var_buildingUnitFK,
				1/*Generated*/, 
				ISNULL(escs.NominalCode, @extraServicesNominalCode), ess.Charge, 
				ess.[Name] + ', ' + Reference + CASE WHEN sics.StockItemCategoryPK is null THEN '' ELSE ', ' + sics.StockItemCategory END, 
				CAST(NumberOf AS NVARCHAR(50)), 
				ISNULL(chargeSubjects.ChargeSubject, ''), '@ ' + CAST(CAST((ess.Charge / ess.NumberOf) AS DECIMAL(18,3)) AS NVARCHAR(50)), 
				'Per ' + ISNULL(chargeSubjects.ChargeSubject, ''),
				@vatCodeFK, 
				@taxRate, 
				ROUND(((@taxRate/100) * ess.Charge),2),
				0 /*cast(0 AS BIT)*/, 
				1, 
				dbo.GetBSTDate(), 
				1, 
				dbo.GetBSTDate(), 
				@var_departmentFK
				FROM tblExtraServices AS ess
				LEFT OUTER JOIN tblDivisionExtraServices AS dess ON
				dess.DivisionExtraServicePK = ess.DivisionExtraServiceFK
				LEFT OUTER JOIN appChargeSubjects AS chargeSubjects ON
				chargeSubjects.ChargeSubjectPK = dess.ChargeSubjectFK
				LEFT OUTER JOIN tblExtraServiceCodes AS escs ON
				escs.ExtraServiceCodePK = dess.ExtraServiceCodeFK
				LEFT OUTER JOIN tblStockItems AS sis ON
				sis.StockItemPK = ess.StockItemFK
				LEFT OUTER JOIN tblStockItemCategories AS sics ON
				sics.StockItemCategoryPK = sis.StockItemCategoryFK
				WHERE cast(ess.ExtraServiceDate as date) > cast(@lastExtraService as date)
				AND cast(ess.ExtraServiceDate as date) <= cast(@var_invoiceTo as date)
				AND ess.DivisionFK = @var_divisionFK 
			END


			--IF (@var_InvoiceDistributionCharge2 = 1)
			IF (@var_options & 8 = 8)
			BEGIN --DISTRIBUTION CHARGES
				SELECT Top 1 @lastDistributionCharge = InvoiceToDate 
				FROM tblInvoices
				WHERE DivisionFK = @var_divisionFK
				AND Options & 8 = 8
				--AND DistributionCharges = 1 /* invs.Options Has Been Replaced By Individual Charge Flags. */
				AND InvoiceTypeFK = 3		  /* Scheduled Invoice. */
				ORDER BY InvoiceToDate Desc

				SELECT @distributionCharge = SUM(Charge) 
				FROM tblContainerOutDistributionCharges AS codcs
				INNER JOIN tblContainerOutLines AS cols 
				ON cols.ContainerOutFK = codcs.ContainerOutFK

				-- 05 September 2018 Cathal OCuirrin :	 This code ensure only completed stock outs are included.
				inner join tblcontainerouts as co
				on cols.ContainerOutFK = co.ContainerOutPK
				and co.ContainerOutStatusFK = 5 /*Completed*/

				WHERE CONVERT(VARCHAR(50), codcs.InsertedDate, 112) > CONVERT(VARCHAR(50), @lastDistributionCharge, 112)
				AND CONVERT(VARCHAR(50), codcs.InsertedDate, 112) <= CONVERT(VARCHAR(50), @var_invoiceTo, 112)
				AND cols.DivisionFK = @var_divisionFK
		
				SET @chargeText = 'Order Processing and Distribution Charges'
				
				SET @distributionCharge = ISNULL(@distributionCharge, 0)
				SET @vatCodeFK = ISNULL(@vatCodeFK,-1)
				SET @taxRate = ISNULL(@taxRate,0)

				IF XACT_STATE() = 0 AND @@TRANCOUNT < 1 BEGIN TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName

				INSERT INTO tblInvoiceLines
				VALUES(		@var_invoiceFK, 
							@var_divisionFK, 
							3/*DistributionCharges*/,
							@var_buildingUnitFK,
							1/*Generated*/, 
							@distributionChargeNominalCode, 
							@distributionCharge, 
							@chargeText, 
							'',
							'',
							'',
							'', 
							@taxRate, 
							@vatCodeFK,
							ROUND(((@taxRate/100) * @distributionCharge),2),
							0 /*cast(0 AS BIT)*/, 
							1, 
							dbo.GetBSTDate(), 
							1, 
							dbo.GetBSTDate(),
							@var_departmentFK
						)
			END
			
			--IF(@var_InvoiceRecurringCharge2 = 1)
			IF (@var_options & 16 = 16) 
 			BEGIN --RECURRING CHARGES
				IF XACT_STATE() = 0 AND @@TRANCOUNT < 1 BEGIN TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName

				INSERT INTO tblInvoiceLines
				SELECT 
					@var_invoiceFK, 
					@var_divisionFK, 
					1 /*InvoiceLineType - Storage*/, 
					-1 /*BuildingUnitFK*/,
					1 /*LineStatus - Generated*/,
					ilts.NominalCode,
					ircs.Charge,
					ircs.ChargeText,
					ircs.ChargeText1, 
					ircs.ChargeText2,
					--ircs.ChargeText3,
					CASE When SUBSTRING(Trim(ChargeText3), 1, 1) != '@'  THEN '@ ' + ChargeText3 ELSE Trim(ChargeText3) End As ChargeText3,
					ircs.ChargeText4,
					ircs.VatCodeFK,
					vcs.[Value],
					ROUND(((vcs.[Value]/100) * ircs.Charge),2),
					0 /*cast(1 AS BIT)*/, 1, dbo.GetBSTDate(), 1, dbo.GetBSTDate(),
					-1 /*@var_departmentFK*/
				FROM tblInvoiceRecurringCharges AS ircs
				INNER JOIN appInvoiceLineTypes AS ilts ON ilts.InvoiceLineTypePK = ircs.InvoiceLineTypeFK
				INNER JOIN tblVatCodes AS vcs ON vcs.VatCodePK = ircs.VatCodeFK
				WHERE DivisionFK = @var_divisionFK
					AND ircs.[Enabled] = 1 /*cast(1 AS BIT)*/
					AND ircs.RecurringChargeInAdvance = 0  /* Do Not Charge for Recurring Charges Set To Advance Charges */
			END

			/*
			This Sub Query Now takes place in spCreateInvoiceLines
			SELECT SUM(Charge) AS Charge, SUM(Tax) AS Tax 
			FROM (
				SELECT * FROM (SELECT 0 AS Charge, 0 AS Tax) AS zeroStart
				UNION ALL
				SELECT Charge, Tax FROM tblInvoiceLines WHERE InvoiceFK = @var_invoiceFK
			) AS subQ
			*/

            -- This stored procedures main code, excluding error handling - end

			BEGIN TRY IF XACT_STATE() = 1 AND @@TRANCOUNT = 1 AND @OpeningTranCount < 1 COMMIT TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH

			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, 
			@TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;

			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE();
			SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 
				ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY

			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH 
				/* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */			
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spInvoiceDeleteCheck]
(
	@invoicePK int,
	@invoiceTypeFK int
)
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data; Ensure this proc has a low impact when executed */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED; SET DEADLOCK_PRIORITY LOW

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT
	,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;
	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	DECLARE @invoicePK2 int
	DECLARE @invoiceTypeFK2 int

	SET @invoicePK2 = @invoicePK
	SET @invoiceTypeFK2 = @invoiceTypeFK

	SET @ParameterDetails = '@invoicePK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@invoicePK2 AS NVARCHAR(20)),'') + ', @invoiceTypeFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@invoiceTypeFK2 AS NVARCHAR(20)),'')

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    --BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

		SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK,-1)

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END

	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY
			

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start

			Declare @ret nvarchar(300)
			Select @ret = ''

			--Check if the invoice exists at all
			IF( not exists(Select * from tblInvoices where InvoicePK = @invoicePK2)) 
			BEGIN
				Select 'You can not delete this invoice as it does not exist'
				return
			END

			--Check if the invoice is approved
			IF((Select Approved from tblInvoices where InvoicePK = @invoicePK2) = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/) 
			BEGIN
				Select 'You can not delete this invoice as it has been approved'
				return
			END

			--Check that this is the last invoice created for customer/division
			Declare @customerFK int, @divisionFK int

			Select @customerFK = CustomerFK, @divisionFK = DivisionFK from tblInvoices where InvoicePK = @invoicePK2

			IF(@customerFK > 0) 
			BEGIN
				--Check this is the latest customer invoice
				IF((Select top 1 InvoicePK from tblInvoices where CustomerFK = @customerFK And InvoiceTypeFK = @invoiceTypeFK2 Order by invoicetodate desc, UpdatedDate desc) <> @invoicePK2) 
				BEGIN
					Select 'You can not delete this invoice as it is not the last invoice generated. You can only delete the last invoice generated for a customer'
					return
				END
			END ELSE IF(@divisionFK > 0) 
			BEGIN
				IF((Select top 1 InvoicePK from tblInvoices where DivisionFK = @divisionFK And InvoiceTypeFK = @invoiceTypeFK2 Order by invoicetodate desc, UpdatedDate desc) <> @invoicePK2) 
				BEGIN
					Select 'You can not delete this invoice as it is not the last invoice generated. You can only delete the last invoice generated for a division'
					return
				END
			END 
			ELSE 
			BEGIN
				Select 'You can not delete this invoice as it is malformed. Please call your administrator'
				return
			END

			Select @ret

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end

			
			
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END

AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data; Ensure this proc has a low impact when executed */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED; SET DEADLOCK_PRIORITY LOW

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT
	,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;
	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	DECLARE @CustomerFK2 int, @DivisionFK2 int

         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)

        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

		SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK,-1)

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY
			

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start

			if (@CustomerFK2 = -1) 
			begin
				select EmailAddress1
				from tblContacts cts 
					inner join tblInvoiceContacts invcon on 
					invcon.ContactFK= cts.ContactPK 
				where invcon.DivisionFK = @DivisionFK2 
			end 

			if (@DivisionFK2 = -1) 
			begin  
				select EmailAddress1
				from tblContacts cts 
					inner join tblInvoiceContacts invcon on 
					invcon.ContactFK= cts.ContactPK 
				where invcon.CustomerFK  = @CustomerFK2  
			END

			--jamie : if both values exist, then combine list of contacts (credit notes can have both)
			if (@DivisionFK2 <> -1 AND @CustomerFK2 <> -1) 
			begin  
			SELECT DISTINCT * FROM (
				select EmailAddress1
				from tblContacts cts 
					inner join tblInvoiceContacts invcon on 
					invcon.ContactFK= cts.ContactPK 
				where invcon.CustomerFK  = @CustomerFK2  
				UNION
				select EmailAddress1
				from tblContacts cts 
					inner join tblInvoiceContacts invcon on 
					invcon.ContactFK= cts.ContactPK 
				where invcon.DivisionFK = @DivisionFK2 )subq
			end

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end

			
			
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
