CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spInvoiceExistsForStockIn]  
    @ContainerInFK INT,  
    @StockInDate DATETIME  
AS  
BEGIN  
 /* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data; Ensure this proc has a low impact when executed */      
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED; SET DEADLOCK_PRIORITY LOW      
      
    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT      
 ,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;      
 SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();      
      
 -- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters      
 DECLARE @var_ContainerInFK int    
 DECLARE @var_StockInDate DATETIME  
 SET @var_ContainerInFK = @ContainerInFK       
 SET @var_StockInDate=@StockInDate  
   
 SET @ParameterDetails = '@ContainerInFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_ContainerInFK AS NVARCHAR(20)),'')      
      
    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL       
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)      
      
    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)      
    --BEGIN      
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC       
      
  SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK,-1)      
      
        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)      
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK      
      
        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()      
    --END      
      
 SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);      
 SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails      
 ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;      
 INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()      
      
 WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3      
 BEGIN       
  BEGIN TRY           
      
   -- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start        
 IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#TempDivisionInvoices') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #TempDivisionInvoices;  
  CREATE TABLE #TempDivisionInvoices
 (
      DivisionPK INT,
      CustomerFK INT,
      LastInvoiceDate DATETIME
 );
  -- Insert divisions for this stock-in and get last invoice date
    INSERT INTO #TempDivisionInvoices (DivisionPK, CustomerFK, LastInvoiceDate)
    SELECT 
        divs.DivisionPK,
        divs.CustomerFK,
        ISNULL(
            (SELECT TOP 1 i.InvoiceToDate
             FROM tblInvoices i
             WHERE (i.DivisionFK = divs.DivisionPK OR i.CustomerFK = divs.CustomerFK)
               AND i.InvoiceTypeFK = 3 -- Storage invoice
             ORDER BY i.InvoiceToDate DESC), '1900-01-01')
    FROM tblStockIns si
    INNER JOIN tblDivisions divs ON divs.DivisionPK = si.DivisionFK
    WHERE si.ContainerInFK = @var_ContainerInFK;

    -- Check if any invoice exist; blocks editing
    DECLARE @InvoiceBlocksEdit BIT = 0;

    IF EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM #TempDivisionInvoices t
        WHERE t.LastInvoiceDate >= @StockInDate
    )
    BEGIN
        SET @InvoiceBlocksEdit = 1;
    END
   
    SELECT @InvoiceBlocksEdit AS CannotEdit;
   
    DROP TABLE #TempDivisionInvoices;  
  BREAK     
 -- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end        
     
  END TRY      
  BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */      
   DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;      
   SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;      
   SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;      
      
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY       
   BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;      
             
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;      
      
            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID      
                  
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;      
                  
   IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)      
   BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END      
   ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */      
  END CATCH      
  SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1      
 END      
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spInvoiceNextInvoiceToDate]
(
	@EndDate datetime
)
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT
           ,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;
	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	DECLARE @EndDate2 datetime
	SET @endDate2 = @EndDate;
	

	SET @ParameterDetails = '@EndDate = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@endDate2 AS NVARCHAR(30)),'')

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    --BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

		SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END


	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	DECLARE @DaystoAdd int
	SET @DaystoAdd = 0;
	DECLARE @NextInvoiceToDate Date
	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY
			
		Select Cust.CustomerPK, Cust.CustomerName, Cust.CustomerCode, Max(InvoiceToDate) AS InvoiceToDate 
		From tblCustomers Cust
		LEFT JOIN tblInvoices Invs ON Cust.CustomerPK = Invs.CustomerFK
		Where Cust.InvoiceByCustomer = 1 AND Cust.Active = 1
		Group By Cust.CustomerPK, Cust.CustomerName, Cust.CustomerCode 
		--Order By InvoiceToDate Desc

		union 

		Select Divs.DivisionPK, Divs.DivisionName, Divs.DivisionCode, Max(InvoiceToDate) AS InvoiceToDate 
		From tblDivisions Divs
		INNER JOIN tblCustomers Cust On Cust.CustomerPK = Divs.CustomerFK
		LEFT JOIN tblInvoices Invs On Invs.DivisionFK = Divs.DivisionPK
		Where Cust.InvoiceByCustomer = 0 AND Cust.Active = 1 
		Group By Divs.DivisionPK, Divs.DivisionName, Divs.DivisionCode 
		--Order By InvoiceToDate Desc

			
			
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spInvoiceRecurringChargeCreateLines]
(
	@divisionFK int,
	@invoiceTo datetime,
	@invoiceFK int,
	@buildingUnitFK int = -1,
	@departmentFK int = -1
)
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data; Ensure this proc has a low impact when executed */
     SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED; SET DEADLOCK_PRIORITY LOW

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT
	,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;
	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	DECLARE @var_divisionFK INT, @var_invoiceTo DATETIME, @var_invoiceFK INT, @var_buildingUnitFK INT, @var_departmentFK INT

	SET @var_divisionFK = @divisionFK; SET @var_invoiceTo = @invoiceTo; SET @var_invoiceFK = @invoiceFK; 
	SET @var_buildingUnitFK = @buildingUnitFK
	SET @var_departmentFK = @departmentFK 

	SET @ParameterDetails = '@divisionFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_divisionFK AS NVARCHAR(30)),'')
		+ ',@invoiceTo = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_invoiceTo AS NVARCHAR(30)),'')
		+ ',@invoiceFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_invoiceFK AS NVARCHAR(30)),'')
		+ ',@buildingUnitFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_buildingUnitFK AS NVARCHAR(30)),'')
		+ ',@departmentFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_departmentFK AS NVARCHAR(30)),'')

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
	--BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

		SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
	--END

	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName)
	IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK
	SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
	
	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY			

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start

			-- Ensure the temporary invoice number always has a valid value.
			IF @var_invoiceFK > 0
			BEGIN
				IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM dbo.tblInvoices WHERE InvoicePK = @var_invoiceFK AND ISNULL(InvoiceNumber,'') = '')
				BEGIN
					DECLARE @InvoiceNumber NVARCHAR(200) = ''

					IF XACT_STATE() = 0 AND @@TRANCOUNT < 1 BEGIN TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName

					-- Get the temporary invoice number from the appSystem table. 
					-- Lock the table to ensure no other code changes this value until this stored procedure has finished executing.
					SELECT @InvoiceNumber = 'TMP' + CAST(NextInvoiceTempNumber AS NVARCHAR(200)) FROM dbo.appSystem WITH (ROWLOCK)					

					-- Increment the value in the appSystem table.
					UPDATE dbo.appSystem WITH (ROWLOCK)
					SET NextInvoiceTempNumber = NextInvoiceTempNumber + 1

					-- Add the temporary invoice number to the specific row in the tblInvoices table.
					UPDATE dbo.tblInvoices WITH (ROWLOCK)
					SET InvoiceNumber = @InvoiceNumber
					WHERE InvoicePK = @var_invoiceFK	
				END
			END

			DECLARE @ret INT = 0, @lastStorage DATETIME, @lastExtraService DATETIME, @lastDistributionCharge DATETIME, @lastRecurringCharge DATETIME,
			@openingPallets INT, @closingPallets INT, @palletsIn INT, @palletsOut INT, @totalPalletsIn INT, @totalPalletsOut INT, 
			@totalPalletsDepleated INT, @palletsDepleated INT, @eachesOut INT, @customerFK INT, @specialStockTypeFK INT, 
			@specialStockType NVARCHAR(100), @stockItemCategoryFK INT, @stockItemCategory NVARCHAR(100), @invoiceMethodFK INT,
			@invoiceByCategory BIT, @taxRate DECIMAL(18,3), @vatCodeFK INT, @storageCharge DECIMAL(18,3), @handlingCharge DECIMAL(18,3), 
			@handlingInRate DECIMAL(18,3), @handlingOutRate DECIMAL(18,3), @extraServiceCharge DECIMAL(18,3), @distributionCharge DECIMAL(18,3),
			@taxCharge DECIMAL(18,3), @storageNominalCode NVARCHAR(50), @extraServicesNominalCode NVARCHAR(50), 
			@distributionChargeNominalCode NVARCHAR(50), @transportNominalCode NVARCHAR(50), @handlingNominalCode NVARCHAR(50),
			@invoiceCurrencySymbol NVARCHAR(10), @handlingInEachesTypeFK INT = -1, @handlingInUnitTypeFK INT = -1, @handlingOutEachesTypeFK INT = -1, 
			@handlingOutUnitTypeFK INT = -1, @handlingInEachesTypeCode NVARCHAR(200), @handlingInUnitTypeCode NVARCHAR(200), 
			@handlingOutEachesTypeCode NVARCHAR(200), @handlingOutUnitTypeCode NVARCHAR(200), @eachesIn INT = -1, @palletsToChargeForByStorageRateType INT,
			@storageRate DECIMAL(18,2), @storageRateSubject NVARCHAR(50), @storageRatePeriod NVARCHAR(50), @breakOver DECIMAL(18,3),
			@chargeText NVARCHAR(1000), @chargeText1 NVARCHAR(100), @chargeText2 NVARCHAR(100), @chargeText3 NVARCHAR(100), @chargeText4 NVARCHAR(100),
			@invoiceFrequencyFK INT, @currentPalletContent INT, @currentPalletAudit INT, @SQL NVARCHAR(4000), @PalletsToChargeFor INT, @BreakMethodFK INT

			SELECT @storageNominalCode = NominalCode FROM appInvoiceLineTypes WHERE InvoiceLineTypePK = 1/*Storage*/
			SELECT @extraServicesNominalCode = NominalCode FROM appInvoiceLineTypes WHERE InvoiceLineTypePK = 2/*ExtraServices*/
			SELECT @distributionChargeNominalCode = NominalCode FROM appInvoiceLineTypes WHERE InvoiceLineTypePK = 3/*DistributionCharge*/
			SELECT @transportNominalCode = NominalCode FROM appInvoiceLineTypes WHERE InvoiceLineTypePK = 4/*Transport*/
			SELECT @handlingNominalCode = NominalCode FROM appInvoiceLineTypes WHERE InvoiceLineTypePK = 5/*Handling*/

			SET @invoiceCurrencySymbol = (SELECT TOP 1 currencies.CurrencySymbol FROM appSystem AS [system] 
			INNER JOIN tblCurrencies currencies ON currencies.CurrencyPK = [system].InvoiceCurrencyFK)

			SELECT 
				@taxRate= vatCodes.[Value], 
				@vatCodeFK = divisions.VatCodeFK,
				@customerFK = divisions.CustomerFK,
				@invoiceByCategory = divisions.InvoiceByCategory

				--@handlingInRate = divisions.HandlingInCharge,
				--@handlingOutRate = divisions.HandlingOutCharge,

				--@HandlingInEachesTypeFK = divisions.HandlingInEachesTypeFK,				
				--@HandlingOutEachesTypeFK = divisions.HandlingOutEachesTypeFK,

				--@HandlingInUnitTypeFK = divisions.HandlingInUnitTypeFK,
				--@HandlingOutUnitTypeFK = divisions.HandlingOutUnitTypeFK,

				--@HandlingInEachesTypeCode = handlingInEachesTypes.EachesType,
				--@HandlingOutEachesTypeCode = handlingOutEachesTypes.EachesType,

				--@HandlingInUnitTypeCode = handlingInUnitTypes.Abbreviation,
				--@HandlingOutUnitTypeCode = handlingOutUnitTypes.Abbreviation
			FROM 
				tblDivisions AS divisions
			INNER JOIN tblVatCodes AS vatCodes
				ON vatCodes.VatCodePK = divisions.VatCodeFK
			LEFT OUTER JOIN tblEachesTypes AS handlingInEachesTypes
				ON divisions.HandlingInEachesTypeFK = handlingInEachesTypes.EachesTypePK
			LEFT OUTER JOIN tblEachesTypes AS handlingOutEachesTypes
				ON divisions.HandlingOutEachesTypeFK = handlingOutEachesTypes.EachesTypePK
			LEFT OUTER JOIN tblUnitTypes AS handlingInUnitTypes
				ON divisions.HandlingInUnitTypeFK = handlingInUnitTypes.UnitTypePK
			LEFT OUTER JOIN tblUnitTypes AS handlingOutUnitTypes
				ON divisions.HandlingOutUnitTypeFK = handlingOutUnitTypes.UnitTypePK
			WHERE 
				divisions.DivisionPK = @var_divisionFK

			-- Redundant in This Context
			--IF ISNULL(@HandlingInUnitTypeFK, 0) > 0 
			--BEGIN
			--	IF XACT_STATE() = 0 AND @@TRANCOUNT < 1 BEGIN TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName				

			--	EXEC dbo.spInvoiceCreateLinesChargeByUnit_998 @var_divisionFK, @var_invoiceTo, @var_options, @var_invoiceFK, @var_buildingUnitFK, @var_departmentFK
			--	GOTO EXIT_SP
			--END

			--SET the invoice to date plus a day (this makes sure to include the @invoiceTo day)
			SET @var_invoiceTo = DATEADD(day,1,@var_invoiceTo)

			BEGIN --RECURRING CHARGES
				--print 'inserting recurring charges'

				IF XACT_STATE() = 0 AND @@TRANCOUNT < 1 BEGIN TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName

				INSERT INTO tblInvoiceLines 
				SELECT 
					@var_invoiceFK, 
					@var_divisionFK, 
					ircs.InvoiceLineTypeFK	/*InvoiceLineType - Storage*/, 
					-1	/*BuildingUnitFK*/,
					1	/*LineStatus - Generated*/,
					ilts.NominalCode,
					ircs.Charge,
					ircs.ChargeText,
					ircs.ChargeText1, 
					ircs.ChargeText2,
					--ircs.ChargeText3,
					CASE When SUBSTRING(Trim(ChargeText3), 1, 1) != '@' 
						 THEN '@ ' + ChargeText3
						 ELSE Trim(ChargeText3)
						 End As ChargeText3,
					ircs.ChargeText4,
					ircs.VatCodeFK,
					vcs.[Value],
					ROUND(((vcs.[Value]/100) * ircs.Charge),2),
					0 /*cast(1 AS BIT)*/, 1, dbo.GetBSTDate(), 1, dbo.GetBSTDate(), 
					-1	/*DepartmentFK*/
				FROM 
					tblInvoiceRecurringCharges AS ircs
				INNER JOIN appInvoiceLineTypes AS ilts ON
					ilts.InvoiceLineTypePK = ircs.InvoiceLineTypeFK
				INNER JOIN tblVatCodes AS vcs ON
					vcs.VatCodePK = ircs.VatCodeFK
				WHERE 
					DivisionFK = @var_divisionFK
					AND ircs.[Enabled] = 1 /*cast(1 AS BIT)*/
					AND ircs.RecurringChargeInAdvance = 1
			END

			
			--SELECT SUM(Charge) AS Charge, SUM(Tax) AS Tax 
			--FROM (
			--	SELECT * FROM (SELECT 0 AS Charge, 0 AS Tax) AS zeroStart
			--	UNION ALL
			--	SELECT Charge, Tax FROM tblInvoiceLines WHERE InvoiceFK = @var_invoiceFK
			--) AS subQ

EXIT_SP:

			SELECT SUM(Charge) AS Charge, SUM(Tax) AS Tax 
			FROM (	SELECT * FROM (SELECT 0 AS Charge, 0 AS Tax) AS zeroStart
					UNION ALL
					SELECT Sum(Charge) As Charge, (Sum (Charge)*(TaxRate/100)) As Tax
						From tblInvoiceLines
						Where InvoiceFK = @var_invoiceFK
						Group By TaxRate
				) AS subQ

            -- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end

--EXIT_SP:

			BEGIN TRY IF XACT_STATE() = 1 AND @@TRANCOUNT = 1 AND @OpeningTranCount < 1 COMMIT TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH

			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */	
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;

			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE();
			SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY

			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */			
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spInvoiceUpdateLine]
(
	@InvoiceFK int,
	@InvoiceLinePK int,
	@Description nvarchar(500),
	@Units nvarchar(100),
	@UnitType nvarchar(100),
	@rate nvarchar(100),
	@Frequency nvarchar(100),
	@UserFK int
)
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data; Ensure this proc has a low impact when executed */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED; SET DEADLOCK_PRIORITY LOW

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT
	,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;
	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	DECLARE @var_InvoiceFK int, @var_InvoiceLinePK int, @var_Description nvarchar(500), @var_Units nvarchar(100), @var_UnitType nvarchar(100), 
	@var_rate nvarchar(100), @var_Frequency nvarchar(100), @var_UserFK int

	SET @var_InvoiceFK = @InvoiceFK; SET @var_InvoiceLinePK = @InvoiceLinePK; SET @var_Description = @Description; SET @var_Units = @Units; 
	SET @var_UnitType = @UnitType; SET @var_rate = @rate; SET @var_Frequency = @Frequency; SET @var_UserFK = @UserFK

	SET @ParameterDetails = '@InvoiceFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_InvoiceFK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@InvoiceLinePK = ' 
		+ ISNULL(CAST(@var_InvoiceLinePK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@Description = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_Description AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') 
			+ ',@Units = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_Units AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@UnitType = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_UnitType AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') 
				+ ',@rate = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_rate AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@Frequency = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_Frequency AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@UserFK = ' 
					+ ISNULL(CAST(@var_UserFK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'')

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    --BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

		SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK,-1)

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END

	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY
			IF XACT_STATE() = 0 AND @@TRANCOUNT < 1 BEGIN TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start

			--BEGIN TRANSACTION [tran1]	
			--BEGIN TRY

				Declare @VatCodeFK int
				Declare @TaxRate Decimal (18, 3)
				Declare @DivisionFK int
				Declare @RateCalc decimal (18, 3)

				--set rate without @ string
				set @RateCalc = REPLACE(@var_rate,'@','')
	    	
				--get vat rate and divsion of existing invoice
				Select @DivisionFK = DivisionPK, @taxRate = vatCodes.[Value], @vatCodeFK = divisions.VatCodeFK
				from tblDivisions divisions
				inner join tblVatCodes vatCodes on vatCodes.VatCodePK = divisions.VatCodeFK
				Where divisions.DivisionPK = (select DivisionFK from tblinvoicelines where invoicelinepk = @var_InvoiceLinePK)

				--add new line
				update tblInvoiceLines WITH (ROWLOCK)
				set ChargeText = @var_Description, 
					ChargeText1 = @var_Units, 
					ChargeText2 = @var_UnitType, 
					ChargeText3 = @var_rate, 
					ChargeText4 = @var_Frequency, 
					charge = ROUND((CONVERT(decimal(18, 3), @var_Units) * CONVERT(decimal(18, 3), @RateCalc)), 2),
					tax = ROUND(((@taxRate/100) * ROUND((CONVERT(decimal(18, 3), @var_Units) * CONVERT(decimal(18, 3), @RateCalc)), 2)),2),
					updatedby = @var_UserFK, updateddate = dbo.GetBSTDate()
				where invoicelinepk = @var_InvoiceLinePK

				--get total of charges and tax
				Declare @NewTotal decimal(18, 3)
				Declare @NewTotalTax decimal(18, 3)
				Select @NewTotal = sum(Charge), @NewTotalTax = sum(Tax) 
				from (
					Select * from (Select 0.00 as Charge, 0.00 as Tax) zeroStart
					UNION ALL
					Select Charge, Tax from tblInvoiceLines 
					Where InvoiceFK = @var_InvoiceFK
				)subQ	
				--update invoice with new totals
				update tblinvoices WITH (ROWLOCK)
				set charge = @NewTotal, tax = @NewTotalTax, updatedby = @var_UserFK, updateddate = dbo.GetBSTDate() 
				where invoicepk = @var_InvoiceFK

				--return 1 if all ok
				select 1 as 'RESULT'

			--COMMIT TRANSACTION [tran1]	
			--END TRY
			--BEGIN CATCH
			--	ROLLBACK TRANSACTION [tran1]
			--	PRINT ERROR_MESSAGE()
			--	select 0
			--END CATCH

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end

			BEGIN TRY IF XACT_STATE() = 1 AND @@TRANCOUNT = 1 AND @OpeningTranCount < 1 COMMIT TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH
			
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END
GO

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spIpAddressIsSafe] 
(
	@ipAddress bigint
)	
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT
 ,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;
	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	DECLARE @var_ipAddress bigint

	SET @var_ipAddress = @ipAddress

	SET @ParameterDetails = '@ipAddress = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_ipAddress AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'')

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    --BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

		SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END


	--IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
	--BEGIN
	--	INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText])
	--	SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','N/A', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	--END

	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY
			

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start

			Select Top 1 LoginGraphic from
			(
				Select 0 SafeIpRangePK, 'UNSAFE' LoginGraphic
				
				UNION
				
				Select Top 1 SafeIpRangePK, LoginGraphic 
				from tblSafeIpRanges
				Where 
					@var_ipAddress >= RangeStart AND @var_ipAddress <= RangeEnd
			) AS tmpTable
			Order By 
				SafeIpRangePK DESC
	
			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end

			
			
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END

-- EXEC dbo.spIsContainerOutCustomerIntegrated 57131

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spIsContainerOutCustomerIntegrated]
(
	@ContainerOutFK INT = -1
)
AS
BEGIN
	DECLARE @var_ContainerOutFK INT = ISNULL(@ContainerOutFK, -1)

	SELECT TOP 1 c.[EnableIntegration] AS ContainerOutCustomerIsIntegrated
	FROM tblcontainerouts AS co
	INNER JOIN tblcontaineroutlines AS col
	ON co.containeroutpk = col.containeroutfk
	INNER JOIN tbldivisions AS d
	ON col.divisionfk = d.divisionpk
	INNER JOIN tblcustomers AS c
	ON d.customerfk = c.customerpk
	WHERE co.containeroutpk = @var_ContainerOutFK
END
GO

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spIsContainerOutDivisionIntegrated]
(
	@ContainerOutFK INT = -1
)
AS
BEGIN
	DECLARE @var_ContainerOutFK INT = ISNULL(@ContainerOutFK, -1)

	SELECT TOP 1 icd.[Enabled] AS ContainerOutDivisionIsIntegrated
	FROM dbo.tblcontainerouts AS co
	INNER JOIN dbo.tblcontaineroutlines AS col
	ON co.containeroutpk = col.containeroutfk
	INNER JOIN dbo.tbldivisions AS d
	ON col.divisionfk = d.divisionpk
	INNER JOIN dbo.tblIntegrationCheckDivisions AS icd
	ON d.divisionpk = icd.divisionfk
	WHERE co.containeroutpk = @var_ContainerOutFK
	AND icd.[Enabled] = 1
END

/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[spIsIntegrationFileStockOutPickOk]    Script Date: 02/11/2026 17:47:27 ******/

-- ===========================================================================================================================
-- Author:      Cathal OCuirrin
-- Create Date: 30 July 2018
-- Description: Returns 1 or 0 (true or false) depending on the PickIsOK value in the associated file stock out line records.
-- ===========================================================================================================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spIsIntegrationFileStockOutPickOk]
(
	@ContainerOutFK INT = -1
)
AS
BEGIN
	DECLARE @var_ContainerOutFK INT = ISNULL(@ContainerOutFK, -1)

	IF EXISTS(		SELECT 1 
					FROM tblIntegrationFileStockOutLines AS FileLines
					INNER JOIN tblIntegrationFileStockOuts AS FileHeader
					ON FileLines.IntegrationFileStockOutFK = FileHeader.IntegrationFileStockOutPK
					INNER JOIN tblContainerOuts AS CO
					ON FileHeader.ContainerOutFK = CO.ContainerOutPK
					WHERE FileHeader.ContainerOutFK = @var_ContainerOutFK 
					AND FileLines.PickIsOk = 0
				) 
		SELECT 0 AS PickIsOk
	ELSE
		SELECT 1 AS PickIsOk
END
GO

/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[spIsStoredProcedureExecuting]    Script Date: 02/11/2026 17:47:27 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spIsStoredProcedureExecuting]
(
	@StoredProcedureName NVARCHAR(MAX)
)
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED

	DECLARE @varStoredProcedureName NVARCHAR(MAX) = ISNULL(@StoredProcedureName, '')

	IF @varStoredProcedureName = '' 
	BEGIN
		SELECT 0 AS [Result]
		RETURN
	END	
	ELSE IF NOT EXISTS(	SELECT 1 FROM sys.dm_exec_requests AS er
					INNER JOIN sys.sysprocesses AS sp 
					ON er.session_id = sp.spid
					CROSS APPLY sys.dm_exec_sql_text(er.sql_handle) AS qt
					WHERE 
					session_Id > 50              -- Ignore system spids.
					AND session_Id NOT IN (@@SPID)     -- Ignore this current statement.
					AND qt.text LIKE '%CREATE%PROCEDURE%' + @varStoredProcedureName + '%'
				)
	BEGIN
		SELECT 0 AS [Result]
		RETURN
	END

	IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#AllRunningSQLCommands') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #AllRunningSQLCommands

    -- What SQL Statements Are Currently Running?
    SELECT 
		RowNumber = ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY session_Id ASC)
		,[Spid] = session_Id
		, ecid
		, [Database] = DB_NAME(sp.dbid)
		, [User] = nt_username
		, [Status] = er.status
		, [Wait] = wait_type
		, [Individual Query] = SUBSTRING (qt.text, 
				 er.statement_start_offset/2,
		(CASE WHEN er.statement_end_offset = -1
			   THEN LEN(CONVERT(NVARCHAR(MAX), qt.text)) * 2
			ELSE er.statement_end_offset END - 
									er.statement_start_offset)/2)
		,[Parent Query] = qt.text
		, Program = program_name
		, Hostname
		, nt_domain
		, start_time
	INTO
		#AllRunningSQLCommands
    FROM 
		sys.dm_exec_requests AS er
    INNER JOIN sys.sysprocesses AS sp 
		ON er.session_id = sp.spid
    CROSS APPLY sys.dm_exec_sql_text(er.sql_handle) AS qt
    WHERE 
		session_Id > 50              -- Ignore system spids.
		AND session_Id NOT IN (@@SPID)     -- Ignore this current statement.
		AND qt.text LIKE '%CREATE%PROCEDURE%' + @varStoredProcedureName + '%'

	UPDATE #AllRunningSQLCommands
	SET [Parent Query] = replace(replace(replace(replace(replace([Parent Query],'dbo',''), '[',''), ']',''), '.',''), ' ','')

	DECLARE @RowNumber INT = 1, @MaxRowNumber INT = (SELECT MAX(RowNumber) FROM #AllRunningSQLCommands)

	WHILE @RowNumber <= @MaxRowNumber
	BEGIN
		DECLARE @ColumnLength INT = (SELECT LEN([Parent Query]) FROM #AllRunningSQLCommands WHERE RowNumber = @RowNumber), @CharacterLength INT = 1, @ParentQuery NVARCHAR(MAX) = ''

		WHILE @CharacterLength <= @ColumnLength
		BEGIN

			IF (SELECT ASCII(SUBSTRING([Parent Query], @CharacterLength, 1)) FROM #AllRunningSQLCommands WHERE RowNumber = @RowNumber) NOT IN (10, 13)
				SET @ParentQuery = @ParentQuery + (SELECT SUBSTRING([Parent Query], @CharacterLength, 1) FROM #AllRunningSQLCommands WHERE RowNumber = @RowNumber)
			ELSE
				SET @ParentQuery = @ParentQuery + ' '

			SET @CharacterLength = @CharacterLength + 1
		END

		UPDATE #AllRunningSQLCommands 
		SET [Parent Query] = @ParentQuery
		WHERE RowNumber = @RowNumber

		SET @RowNumber = @RowNumber + 1
	END	

	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #AllRunningSQLCommands WHERE [Parent Query] LIKE '%CREATEPROCEDURE' + @varStoredProcedureName + ' %')
		SELECT CAST(1 AS BIT) AS [Result]
	ELSE 
		SELECT CAST(0 AS BIT) AS [Result]
END
GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[spLoadEmployeeScannedPalletMovementDetails]    Script Date: 02/11/2026 17:47:27 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spLoadEmployeeScannedPalletMovementDetails]
(
--declare
	@employeeScannedPalletMovementDetailPK INT = -1

	--select @employeeScannedPalletMovementDetailPK = -1
)
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ UNCOMMITTED; SET DEADLOCK_PRIORITY LOW

	DECLARE @varStoredProcedureName NVARCHAR(500) = ISNULL(OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID), 'spLoadEmployeeScannedPalletMovementDetails2')

	BEGIN TRY
		DECLARE 
			@LoadTMSDataCursor AS CURSOR, @ClockCardDate DATE, @Department NVARCHAR(200), @maxTMSInsertedDate DATE,
			@varEmployeeScannedPalletMovementDetailPK INT = ISNULL(@employeeScannedPalletMovementDetailPK, -1),
			@varEmployeeNumber INT, @varUserFK INT, @varClockCardDate DATE, @varCurrentDateTime DATETIME = dbo.GetBSTDate(), @varRowCount INT			

		DELETE FROM dbo.tblStoredProcedureLogging WHERE StoredProcedureName = @varStoredProcedureName AND CAST(InsertedDate AS DATE) <> CAST(dbo.GetBSTDate() AS DATE)

		INSERT INTO dbo.tblStoredProcedureLogging SELECT @varStoredProcedureName, 'Proc execution started', dbo.GetBSTDate()

		SELECT @maxTMSInsertedDate = CAST(MAX(InsertedDate) AS DATE) FROM dbo.tblTMSEmployeeClockCardDetails

		INSERT INTO dbo.tblStoredProcedureLogging SELECT @varStoredProcedureName, '@maxTMSInsertedDate = ' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), @maxTMSInsertedDate, 23), dbo.GetBSTDate()

		IF @maxTMSInsertedDate IS NULL RETURN

		-- Get dates and buildings from the most recently added TMS records.

		DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #tMSDatesAndBuildings

		SELECT DISTINCT teccd.ClockCardDate, bld.DepartmentTMS AS Department 
		INTO #tMSDatesAndBuildings
		FROM dbo.tblBuildings bld 
		CROSS JOIN 	dbo.tblTMSEmployeeClockCardDetails teccd WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE ISNULL(bld.DepartmentTMS, '') <> ''
		AND CAST(teccd.InsertedDate AS DATE) = @maxTMSInsertedDate

		-- Remove archived/confirmed data dates and buildings.

		DELETE t1
		FROM #tMSDatesAndBuildings t1
		INNER JOIN dbo.tblEmployeeScannedPalletMovementDetails t2
		ON t1.ClockCardDate = t2.ClockCardDate
		AND t1.Department = t2.DataForBuilding
		WHERE t2.IsArchived = 1	

		IF @varEmployeeScannedPalletMovementDetailPK < 1 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #tMSDatesAndBuildings) RETURN

		IF @varEmployeeScannedPalletMovementDetailPK > 0
		BEGIN
			SELECT TOP 1 @varClockCardDate = tespmd.ClockCardDate, @varEmployeeNumber = vud.EmployeeNumber, @varUserFK = vud.UserPK
			FROM dbo.tblEmployeeScannedPalletMovementDetails tespmd WITH (NOLOCK)
			INNER JOIN dbo.viewUserDetails vud WITH (NOLOCK)
			ON tespmd.UserFK = vud.UserPK
			WHERE tespmd.EmployeeScannedPalletMovementDetailPK = @varEmployeeScannedPalletMovementDetailPK
		
			SET @varUserFK = ISNULL(@varUserFK, -1)
			SET @varEmployeeNumber = ISNULL(@varEmployeeNumber, -1)

			DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #employeeRecords
		
			SELECT DISTINCT
			EmployeeName, 
			ClockCardDate,
			DataForBuilding
			INTO #employeeRecords
			FROM dbo.tblEmployeeScannedPalletMovementDetails WITH (NOLOCK)
			WHERE ClockCardDate = @varClockCardDate
			AND UserFK = @varUserFK

			UNION

			SELECT DISTINCT
			t1.EmployeeName,
			t1.ClockCardDate,
			t2.Department AS DataForBuilding
			FROM dbo.tblTMSEmployeeClockCardDetails t1 WITH (NOLOCK)
			INNER JOIN dbo.tblTMSEmployeeClockedTimes t2 WITH (NOLOCK)
			ON t1.TMSEmployeeClockCardDetailPK = t2.TMSEmployeeClockCardDetailFK
			WHERE t1.ClockCardDate = @varClockCardDate
			AND CAST(t1.EmployeeNumber AS INT) = @varEmployeeNumber

			TRUNCATE TABLE #tMSDatesAndBuildings

			INSERT INTO #tMSDatesAndBuildings SELECT DISTINCT ClockCardDate, DataForBuilding FROM #employeeRecords
		END 
	
		SET @varUserFK = ISNULL(@varUserFK, -1)
		SET @varEmployeeNumber = ISNULL(@varEmployeeNumber, -1)

		INSERT INTO dbo.tblStoredProcedureLogging SELECT @varStoredProcedureName, '@varEmployeeScannedPalletMovementDetailPK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@varEmployeeScannedPalletMovementDetailPK AS NVARCHAR(50)), ''), dbo.GetBSTDate()
		INSERT INTO dbo.tblStoredProcedureLogging SELECT @varStoredProcedureName, '@varUserFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@varUserFK AS NVARCHAR(50)), ''), dbo.GetBSTDate()
		INSERT INTO dbo.tblStoredProcedureLogging SELECT @varStoredProcedureName, '@varEmployeeNumber = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@varEmployeeNumber AS NVARCHAR(50)), ''), dbo.GetBSTDate()

		-- Remove records from the temporary table that match existing archived/confirmed employee activity screen data.
		-- Do not delete/overwrite confirmed data.

		DELETE t1
		FROM #tMSDatesAndBuildings t1		
		INNER JOIN dbo.tblEmployeeScannedPalletMovementDetails t2
		ON t1.ClockCardDate = t2.ClockCardDate
		AND t1.Department = t2.DataForBuilding
		WHERE 
		(
			@varUserFK < 1
			OR (@varUserFK > 0 AND t2.UserFK = @varUserFK)
		)
		AND t2.IsArchived = 1

		IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #tMSDatesAndBuildings) RETURN

		IF @varEmployeeScannedPalletMovementDetailPK > 0 AND (@varUserFK < 1 OR @varEmployeeNumber < 1 OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #tMSDatesAndBuildings)) 
			RAISERROR ('Employee record not found.', 16, /*Severity*/ 1 /*State*/)	-- RAISERROR with severity 11-19 will cause execution to jump to the CATCH block.

		--BEGIN TRANSACTION ZXCVBNMMMMMMMMMMM

		-- Get other activity details linked to the tblEmployeeScannedPalletMovementDetails records that will be deleted and recreated below.
		-- Need this to correct the tblTMSEmployeeActivites foreign key values after the tblEmployeeScannedPalletMovementDetails records have been recreated.

		DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #otherActivityDetails

		SELECT DISTINCT t2.UserFK, t2.EmployeeName, t2.DataForBuilding, t2.ClockCardDate, t1.TMSEmployeeActivityPK
		INTO #otherActivityDetails
		FROM dbo.tblTMSEmployeeActivites t1
		INNER JOIN dbo.tblEmployeeScannedPalletMovementDetails t2
		ON t1.EmployeeScannedPalletMovementDetailFK = t2.EmployeeScannedPalletMovementDetailPK
		INNER JOIN #tMSDatesAndBuildings t3
		ON t2.ClockCardDate = t3.ClockCardDate
		AND t2.DataForBuilding = t3.Department
		WHERE 
		(
			@varUserFK < 1
			OR (@varUserFK > 0 AND t2.UserFK = @varUserFK)
		)
		AND t2.IsArchived = 0

		INSERT INTO dbo.tblStoredProcedureLogging SELECT @varStoredProcedureName, 'DELETE FROM dbo.tblEmployeeScannedPalletMovementDetails started', dbo.GetBSTDate()

		-- Remove employee activity screen records (non-archived/non-confirmed only).
		-- These will be recreated below by spLoadEmployeeScannedPalletMovementDetailsForDateAndBuilding.

		DELETE t1
		FROM dbo.tblEmployeeScannedPalletMovementDetails t1
		INNER JOIN #tMSDatesAndBuildings t2
		ON t1.ClockCardDate = t2.ClockCardDate
		AND t1.DataForBuilding = t2.Department
		WHERE
		(
			@varUserFK < 1
			OR (@varUserFK > 0 AND t1.UserFK = @varUserFK)
		)
		AND t1.IsArchived = 0

		SET @varRowCount = @@ROWCOUNT

		INSERT INTO dbo.tblStoredProcedureLogging SELECT @varStoredProcedureName, CAST(@varRowCount AS NVARCHAR(50)) + ' rows deleted from dbo.tblEmployeeScannedPalletMovementDetails', dbo.GetBSTDate()

START_INSERT_LOOP:

		SELECT TOP 1 @ClockCardDate = ClockCardDate, @Department = Department FROM #tMSDatesAndBuildings ORDER BY ClockCardDate ASC, Department ASC

		INSERT INTO dbo.tblStoredProcedureLogging SELECT @varStoredProcedureName, 'INSERT INTO dbo.tblEmployeeScannedPalletMovementDetails EXEC dbo.spLoadEmployeeScannedPalletMovementDetailsForDateAndBuilding '
																					 + '@ClockCardDate = ''' + ISNULL(CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), @ClockCardDate, 23), '') 
																					 + ''', @Department = ''' + ISNULL(@Department, '') 
																					 + ''', @varUserFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@varUserFK AS NVARCHAR(50)), '') 
																					 + ' - started', dbo.GetBSTDate()

		-- Add the new records

--PRINT ''
--print 'In spLoadEmployeeScannedPalletMovementDetails2'
--print '@ClockCardDate'
--print @ClockCardDate
--print '@Department = ''' + ISNULL(@Department, '') + ''''
--PRINT '@varUserFK = ''' + ISNULL(CAST(@varUserFK AS NVARCHAR(50)),'') + ''''
--PRINT ''

		INSERT INTO dbo.tblEmployeeScannedPalletMovementDetails
		EXEC dbo.spLoadEmployeeScannedPalletMovementDetailsForDateAndBuilding @ClockCardDate, @Department, @varUserFK

		SET @varRowCount = @@ROWCOUNT

		INSERT INTO dbo.tblStoredProcedureLogging SELECT @varStoredProcedureName, ISNULL(CAST(@varRowCount AS NVARCHAR(50)), '') + ' rows inserted into dbo.tblEmployeeScannedPalletMovementDetails', dbo.GetBSTDate()

		-- Remove the current data and building record

		DELETE FROM #tMSDatesAndBuildings WHERE ClockCardDate = @ClockCardDate AND Department = @Department

		IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #tMSDatesAndBuildings) GOTO START_INSERT_LOOP

		-- Correct the tblTMSEmployeeActivites foreign key values now that the tblEmployeeScannedPalletMovementDetails records have been recreated.

		UPDATE t1
		SET EmployeeScannedPalletMovementDetailFK = t3.EmployeeScannedPalletMovementDetailPK
		FROM dbo.tblTMSEmployeeActivites t1
		INNER JOIN #otherActivityDetails t2
		ON t1.TMSEmployeeActivityPK = t2.TMSEmployeeActivityPK		
		INNER JOIN dbo.tblEmployeeScannedPalletMovementDetails t3
		ON t2.UserFK = t3.UserFK 
		AND t2.DataForBuilding = t3.DataForBuilding
		AND t2.ClockCardDate = t3.ClockCardDate

		DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #EmployeeScannedPalletMovementDetails

		SELECT * 
		INTO #EmployeeScannedPalletMovementDetails
		FROM dbo.tblEmployeeScannedPalletMovementDetails WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE InsertedDate > @varCurrentDateTime

		DROP TABLE IF EXISTS  #userScannedInBuildings

		SELECT DISTINCT t1.UserFK, t1.ClockCardDate, Buildings = LTRIM(STUFF
		(
			(
				SELECT DISTINCT ', ' + t2.DataForBuilding
				FROM #EmployeeScannedPalletMovementDetails t2
				WHERE t2.UserFK = t1.UserFK
				AND t2.ClockCardDate = t1.ClockCardDate
				ORDER BY 1 ASC
				FOR XML PATH (''), TYPE
			).value('.', 'varchar(max)')
		, 1, 1, ''))
		INTO #userScannedInBuildings
		FROM #EmployeeScannedPalletMovementDetails t1
		WHERE t1.AllScannedMinutes > 0
		AND t1.InsertedDate > @varCurrentDateTime
		GROUP BY t1.UserFK, t1.ClockCardDate

		-- Do the following for employees who clocked in/out of multiple buildings - start.

		DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #EmployeeBuildingsAndTimes

		SELECT DISTINCT 
		ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY t1.UserFK ASC, t1.ClockCardDate ASC, t3.TimeWorkedMinutes DESC) AS EmployeeRecordNumber,
		t1.UserFK,
		t1.ClockCardDate,
		LTRIM(t2.[Name]) AS Building,
		t3.TimeWorkedMinutes,
		t3.[Shift],
		t3.ShiftDurationLessBreaksMinutes,
		t3.ShiftBreakTimesInMinutes,
		CAST(0 AS BIT) AS RecordUpdated
		INTO #EmployeeBuildingsAndTimes
		FROM #userScannedInBuildings t1
		CROSS APPLY dbo.SplitStringByChar(t1.Buildings, ',') t2
		INNER JOIN #EmployeeScannedPalletMovementDetails t3
		ON t1.UserFK = t3.UserFK
		AND t1.ClockCardDate = t3.ClockCardDate
		AND LTRIM(t2.[Name]) = t3.DataForBuilding 
		WHERE t1.Buildings LIKE '%,%'

		IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #EmployeeBuildingsAndTimes) GOTO EXIT_MULTI_BUILDING_CODE

		DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #EmployeeBuildingsAndTimesMaxTimeWorked

		SELECT UserFK, ClockCardDate, MAX(TimeWorkedMinutes) AS TimeWorkedMinutes
		INTO #EmployeeBuildingsAndTimesMaxTimeWorked
		FROM #EmployeeBuildingsAndTimes
		GROUP BY UserFK, ClockCardDate

		UPDATE t1
		SET RecordUpdated = 1,
		ShiftDurationLessBreaksMinutes = (t2.TimeWorkedMinutes - t1.ShiftBreakTimesInMinutes)
		FROM #EmployeeBuildingsAndTimes t1
		INNER JOIN #EmployeeBuildingsAndTimesMaxTimeWorked t2
		ON t1.UserFK = t2.UserFK
		AND t1.ClockCardDate = t2.ClockCardDate
		AND t1.TimeWorkedMinutes = t2.TimeWorkedMinutes

		UPDATE #EmployeeBuildingsAndTimes 
		SET ShiftDurationLessBreaksMinutes = TimeWorkedMinutes,
		ShiftBreakTimesInMinutes = 0
		WHERE RecordUpdated = 0 

		UPDATE t1 WITH (ROWLOCK)
		SET TimeWorkedMinutes = t2.TimeWorkedMinutes,
		ShiftDurationLessBreaksMinutes = t2.ShiftDurationLessBreaksMinutes,
		ShiftBreakTimesInMinutes = t2.ShiftBreakTimesInMinutes,
		[Shift] = REPLACE(t1.FirstAndLastTMSTimesForUserAndBuilding, ' ', '-')
		FROM dbo.tblEmployeeScannedPalletMovementDetails t1
		INNER JOIN #EmployeeBuildingsAndTimes t2
		ON t1.UserFK = t2.UserFK
		AND t1.ClockCardDate = t2.ClockCardDate
		AND t1.DataForBuilding = t2.Building
		WHERE InsertedDate > @varCurrentDateTime
		AND ISNULL(t1.IssueDescription, '') = ''

		-- Do the following for employees who clocked in/out of multiple buildings - end.

EXIT_MULTI_BUILDING_CODE:

		UPDATE dbo.tblEmployeeScannedPalletMovementDetails WITH (ROWLOCK)
		SET ShiftDurationLessBreaksMinutes = ShiftDurationLessBreaksMinutes - ShiftBreakTimesInMinutes
		WHERE OddTMSClockTimes = 0
		AND AllTMSTimesInSameBuilding = 1
		AND InsertedDate > @varCurrentDateTime	

		UPDATE t1 WITH (ROWLOCK)
		SET AllTMSTimesWithBuildingsForUser = AllTMSTimesWithBuildingsForUser + CASE WHEN RIGHT(RTRIM(AllTMSTimesWithBuildingsForUser),1) = '.' THEN ' Pallet work in ' + t2.Buildings + '.'
		ELSE '. Pallet work in ' + t2.Buildings + '.' END
		FROM dbo.tblEmployeeScannedPalletMovementDetails t1
		INNER JOIN #userScannedInBuildings t2
		ON t1.UserFK = t2.UserFK
		AND t1.ClockCardDate = t2.ClockCardDate
		WHERE InsertedDate > @varCurrentDateTime

		UPDATE dbo.tblEmployeeScannedPalletMovementDetails WITH (ROWLOCK)
		SET AllTMSTimesWithBuildingsForUser = REPLACE(AllTMSTimesWithBuildingsForUser, '  ', ' ')
		WHERE InsertedDate > @varCurrentDateTime

		-- Get records with issues that are linked to multiple buildings.

		DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #MultipleBuildingsEmployeeRecordsWithTMSIssue

		SELECT t1.UserFK, t1.EmployeeName, t1.ClockCardDate, COUNT(DISTINCT t1.DataForBuilding) AS NoOfBuildings 
		INTO #MultipleBuildingsEmployeeRecordsWithTMSIssue
		FROM #EmployeeScannedPalletMovementDetails t1
		WHERE EXISTS(	SELECT 1 FROM #EmployeeScannedPalletMovementDetails t2
						WHERE t2.UserFK = t1.UserFK 
						AND t2.ClockCardDate = t1.ClockCardDate
						AND t2.FirstAndLastTMSTimesForUserAndBuilding = 'Hover mouse for information'
						AND t2.InsertedDate > @varCurrentDateTime
					)
		AND t1.InsertedDate > @varCurrentDateTime
		GROUP BY t1.UserFK, t1.EmployeeName, t1.ClockCardDate
		HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT t1.DataForBuilding) > 1

		-- Update records to ensure all display 'Hover mouse for information'	

		UPDATE t1 WITH (ROWLOCK)
		SET FirstAndLastTMSTimesForUserAndBuilding = 'Hover mouse for information'
		FROM dbo.tblEmployeeScannedPalletMovementDetails t1
		INNER JOIN #MultipleBuildingsEmployeeRecordsWithTMSIssue t2 
		ON t1.ClockCardDate = t2.ClockCardDate 
		AND t1.UserFK = t2.UserFK
		WHERE T1.FirstAndLastTMSTimesForUserAndBuilding <> 'Hover mouse for information'
		AND t1.InsertedDate > @varCurrentDateTime

		-- Update records to ensure all have an issue description of 'Clock in/out time(s) missing for building(s).'

		UPDATE t1 WITH (ROWLOCK)
		SET t1.IssueDescription = 'Clock in/out time(s) missing for building(s).'
		FROM dbo.tblEmployeeScannedPalletMovementDetails t1
		INNER JOIN #MultipleBuildingsEmployeeRecordsWithTMSIssue t2 
		ON t1.ClockCardDate = t2.ClockCardDate 
		AND t1.UserFK = t2.UserFK
		AND EXISTS(		SELECT 1 FROM dbo.tblEmployeeScannedPalletMovementDetails t2 WITH (NOLOCK) 
						where t2.ClockCardDate = t1.ClockCardDate 
						AND t2.UserFK = t1.UserFK 
						AND t2.IssueDescription = 'Clock in/out time(s) missing for building(s).'
						AND t2.InsertedDate > @varCurrentDateTime
					)
		WHERE t1.InsertedDate > @varCurrentDateTime

		UPDATE dbo.tblEmployeeScannedPalletMovementDetails WITH (ROWLOCK)
		SET [Shift] = [Shift] + '(' + (SELECT [dbo].[fnGetDurationInTimeBetweenTMSShiftStartAndEndTimes]([Shift],ShiftBreakTimesInMinutes)) + ')'
		WHERE [Shift] <> REPLACE(FirstAndLastTMSTimesForUserAndBuilding, ' ', '-')
		AND InsertedDate > @varCurrentDateTime
		AND FirstAndLastTMSTimesForUserAndBuilding <> 'Hover mouse for information'

		UPDATE dbo.tblEmployeeScannedPalletMovementDetails WITH (ROWLOCK)
		SET [Shift] = [Shift] + '(' + (SELECT dbo.fnGetHoursAndMinutesTimeFormatForMinutes(TimeWorkedMinutes)) + ')'
		WHERE [Shift] = REPLACE(FirstAndLastTMSTimesForUserAndBuilding, ' ', '-')
		AND InsertedDate > @varCurrentDateTime
		AND FirstAndLastTMSTimesForUserAndBuilding <> 'Hover mouse for information'

		UPDATE dbo.tblEmployeeScannedPalletMovementDetails WITH (ROWLOCK)
		SET FirstAndLastTMSTimesForUserAndBuilding =	TMSTimesForUserAndBuilding
														+ ' (' 
															+ (SELECT dbo.fnGetHoursAndMinutesTimeFormatForMinutes(TimeWorkedMinutes))
														+ ')'
		WHERE InsertedDate > @varCurrentDateTime
		AND FirstAndLastTMSTimesForUserAndBuilding <> 'Hover mouse for information' 

		UPDATE dbo.tblEmployeeScannedPalletMovementDetails WITH (ROWLOCK)
		SET FirstAndLastTMSTimesForUserAndBuilding =	CASE 
															WHEN ISNULL(FirstAndLastTMSTimesForUserAndBuilding,'') <> '' THEN 
																FirstAndLastTMSTimesForUserAndBuilding + '. Code(s): ' + AbsenceCodes
															ELSE
																'Code(s): ' + AbsenceCodes
														END
		WHERE ISNULL(IssueDescription, '') = ''
		AND ISNULL(AbsenceCodes,'') <> ''
		AND InsertedDate > @varCurrentDateTime
		AND FirstAndLastTMSTimesForUserAndBuilding <> 'Hover mouse for information' 

		DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #totals

		SELECT 	
			t1.DataForBuilding,
			t1.ClockCardDate,
			SUM(t1.TimeWorkedMinutes) AS TotalTimeWorkedMinutes,
			SUM(t1.ShiftDurationLessBreaksMinutes) AS TotalShiftDurationLessBreaksMinutes	
		INTO 
			#totals		
		FROM 
			dbo.tblEmployeeScannedPalletMovementDetails t1 WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE 
			EXISTS
			(
				SELECT 1 FROM dbo.tblEmployeeScannedPalletMovementDetails t2 WITH (NOLOCK)
				WHERE t2.DataForBuilding = t1.DataForBuilding
				AND t2.ClockCardDate = t1.ClockCardDate
				AND t2.InsertedDate > @varCurrentDateTime
			)
		GROUP BY
			t1.DataForBuilding, 
			t1.ClockCardDate

		UPDATE t1 WITH (ROWLOCK)
		SET TotalTimeWorkedMinutes = t2.TotalTimeWorkedMinutes,
		TotalShiftDurationLessBreaksMinutes = t2.TotalShiftDurationLessBreaksMinutes
		FROM dbo.tblEmployeeScannedPalletMovementDetails t1	
		INNER JOIN #totals t2
		ON t1.DataForBuilding = t2.DataForBuilding
		AND t1.ClockCardDate = t2.ClockCardDate

		-- Remove unwanted tms data.

		DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #TMSEmployeeClockCardDetailPKs

		SELECT TMSEmployeeClockCardDetailPK 
		INTO #TMSEmployeeClockCardDetailPKs
		FROM dbo.tblTMSEmployeeClockCardDetails t1
		WHERE BaseDepartment NOT IN ('BV1', 'BV2', 'BV4', 'BV5', 'Slieverue', 'Cork Road', 'Dungarvan', 'Kilcohan', 'Six Cross Roads', 'Carrick-On-Suir', 'Rosbercon', 'Northern Extension', 'BV1U3')

		DELETE t1
		FROM dbo.tblTMSEmployeeClockedTimes t1
		INNER JOIN #TMSEmployeeClockCardDetailPKs t2
		ON t1.TMSEmployeeClockCardDetailFK = t2.TMSEmployeeClockCardDetailPK

		DELETE t1
		FROM dbo.tblTMSEmployeeClockCardDetails t1
		INNER JOIN #TMSEmployeeClockCardDetailPKs t2
		ON t1.TMSEmployeeClockCardDetailPK = t2.TMSEmployeeClockCardDetailPK

		DELETE t1
		FROM dbo.tblEmployeeScannedPalletMovementDetails t1
		INNER JOIN #TMSEmployeeClockCardDetailPKs t2
		ON t1.TMSEmployeeClockCardDetailPK = t2.TMSEmployeeClockCardDetailPK

		IF ISNULL(@varEmployeeScannedPalletMovementDetailPK, -1) > 0 RETURN --Exit proc if updating an employees tblEmployeeScannedPalletMovementDetails record.

		-- Only do the following when importing a TMS file. 

		DECLARE @varPreviousWorkDate DATE = DATEADD(DAY, -1, dbo.GetBSTDate())

		-- Ensure the previous work date is not a Sunday.

		SELECT 
			@varPreviousWorkDate =	CASE 
										WHEN LEFT(DATENAME(dw, @varPreviousWorkDate), 3) = 'Sun' THEN DATEADD(DAY, -1, @varPreviousWorkDate)
									ELSE
										@varPreviousWorkDate
									END

		-- Exit proc if the previous work date is a set (day and month wise) public holiday.

		IF MONTH(@varPreviousWorkDate) = 12 AND DAY(@varPreviousWorkDate) IN (25,26) RETURN /*Ignore Christmas & Stephens days*/
		IF MONTH(@varPreviousWorkDate) = 1 AND DAY(@varPreviousWorkDate) IN (1) RETURN /*Ignore New Years day*/
		IF MONTH(@varPreviousWorkDate) = 3 AND DAY(@varPreviousWorkDate) IN (17) RETURN /*Ignore St Patricks day*/

		DECLARE @tMSDataError NVARCHAR(50) = 'No TMS data for '  + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), @varPreviousWorkDate, 23)

		-- Throw an error if there is no TMS data for the previous work date.

		IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.tblTMSEmployeeClockCardDetails t1 WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE t1.ClockCardDate = @varPreviousWorkDate)
			RAISERROR (@tMSDataError, 16, /*Severity*/ 1 /*State*/)	-- RAISERROR with severity 11-19 will cause execution to jump to the CATCH block.

		--COMMIT TRANSACTION ZXCVBNMMMMMMMMMMM

ec: /*exit proc*/

		INSERT INTO dbo.tblStoredProcedureLogging SELECT @varStoredProcedureName, 'Proc execution completed', dbo.GetBSTDate()
	END TRY
	BEGIN CATCH
		DECLARE @ErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX) = ERROR_MESSAGE(), @ErrorSeverity INT = ERROR_SEVERITY(), @ErrorState INT = ERROR_STATE()

		INSERT INTO dbo.tblStoredProcedureLogging SELECT @varStoredProcedureName, 'ERROR MESSAGE - ' + @ErrorMessage, dbo.GetBSTDate()

		--BEGIN TRY
		--	BEGIN TRANSACTION ZXCVBNMMMMMMMMMMM
		--END TRY
		--BEGIN CATCH

		RAISERROR (@ErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState)
	END CATCH
END
GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[spLoadEmployeeScannedPalletMovementDetailsForDateAndBuilding]    Script Date: 02/11/2026 17:47:27 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO





CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spLoadEmployeeScannedPalletMovementDetailsForDateAndBuilding] /* spLoadEmployeeScannedPalletMovementDetailsForDateAndBuilding '2019-11-20', 'BV5' */
( 
--declare
	@EventDate DATE, @buildingName NVARCHAR(200), @p_userFK INT = -1

	--select @EventDate = '2020-04-15', @BuildingName = 'BV1U3', @p_userFK = -1
)
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ UNCOMMITTED; SET DEADLOCK_PRIORITY LOW

	DECLARE @varStoredProcedureName NVARCHAR(500) = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID)

	BEGIN TRY
		DELETE FROM dbo.tblStoredProcedureLogging WHERE StoredProcedureName = @varStoredProcedureName AND CAST(InsertedDate AS DATE) <> CAST(dbo.GetBSTDate() AS DATE)

		INSERT INTO dbo.tblStoredProcedureLogging SELECT @varStoredProcedureName, 'Proc execution started', dbo.GetBSTDate()

		DECLARE 
			@varStartDate DATE = @EventDate, @varEndDate DATE = DATEADD(DAY, 1, @EventDate), @varBuildingName NVARCHAR(200) = @BuildingName, @varUserFK INT = ISNULL(@p_userFK, -1),
			@varErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @varErrorSeverity INT, @varErrorState INT, @varRowCount INT

		INSERT INTO dbo.tblStoredProcedureLogging SELECT @varStoredProcedureName, '@varStartDate = ' + ISNULL(CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), @varStartDate, 23), ''), dbo.GetBSTDate()
		INSERT INTO dbo.tblStoredProcedureLogging SELECT @varStoredProcedureName, '@varEndDate = ' + ISNULL(CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), @varEndDate, 23), ''), dbo.GetBSTDate()
		INSERT INTO dbo.tblStoredProcedureLogging SELECT @varStoredProcedureName, '@varBuildingName = ' + ISNULL(@varBuildingName, ''), dbo.GetBSTDate()
		INSERT INTO dbo.tblStoredProcedureLogging SELECT @varStoredProcedureName, '@varUserFK = ' + CAST(@varUserFK AS NVARCHAR(50)), dbo.GetBSTDate()

		-- Get all scanner works order movement records for the seleced date and selected building.
	
		DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #WorksOrderMovementDetails0

		SELECT DISTINCT
			wom.*,
			vbd_dest.DepartmentTMS
		INTO 
			#WorksOrderMovementDetails0
		FROM 
			dbo.tblWorksOrderMovements wom WITH (NOLOCK)
		INNER JOIN dbo.viewBuildingUnitBays vbub_dest WITH (NOLOCK)
			ON wom.DestinationLocationTypeFK = vbub_dest.LocationTypeFK
			AND wom.DestinationFK = vbub_dest.BuildingUnitBayPK
		INNER JOIN dbo.viewBuildingDetails vbd_dest WITH (NOLOCK)
			ON vbub_dest.BuildingUnitFK = vbd_dest.BuildingUnitPK
		WHERE 
			wom.UpdatedDate >= @varStartDate
			AND wom.UpdatedDate < @varEndDate
			AND wom.MovementDescription LIKE '%hand%held%'
			AND vbd_dest.DepartmentTMS = @varBuildingName

		DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #WorksOrders

		SELECT DISTINCT wo.* 
		INTO #WorksOrders
		FROM dbo.tblWorksOrders wo WITH (NOLOCK)
		INNER JOIN #WorksOrderMovementDetails0 wom
		ON wo.WorksOrderPK = wom.WorksOrderFK

		-- Get all scanner pallet audit records, created by scanner, for the selected date and building.

		DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #PalletAuditDetailsForSelectedDateAndBuilding

		-- Add pallet loaded scanned records created by a scanner (obviously).
	
		SELECT DISTINCT
		vbd.DepartmentTMS,
		pa.PalletAuditPK,
		pa.PalletFK,
		pa.BuildingUnitFK,
		pa.EventTypeFK,
		pa.EventFK,
		pa.InsertedBy,
		pa.InsertedDate,
		pa.StockItemFK,
		si.StockItemCode,
		si.[Description] AS StockItemName,
		si.DivisionFK,
		div.DivisionCode,
		div.DivisionName,
		div.CustomerFK,
		cus.CustomerCode,
		cus.CustomerName
		INTO #PalletAuditDetailsForSelectedDateAndBuilding
		FROM dbo.tblPalletAudit pa WITH (NOLOCK)
		INNER JOIN dbo.viewBuildingDetails vbd WITH (NOLOCK)
		ON pa.BuildingUnitFK = vbd.BuildingUnitPK
		LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.tblStockItems si WITH (NOLOCK)
		ON pa.StockItemFK = si.StockItemPK
		LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.tblDivisions div WITH (NOLOCK)
		ON si.DivisionFK = div.DivisionPK
		LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.tblCustomers cus WITH (NOLOCK)
		ON div.CustomerFK = cus.CustomerPK
		WHERE pa.InsertedDate >= @varStartDate 
		AND pa.InsertedDate < @varEndDate
		AND pa.EventTypeFK IN (27 /*Pallet Loaded Scanned*/, 37 /*Pallet Created Via Scanning*/)
		AND vbd.DepartmentTMS = @varBuildingName

		-- Add pallet movement records linked to works order movement records by palletfk and userfk

		INSERT INTO #PalletAuditDetailsForSelectedDateAndBuilding
		SELECT DISTINCT
		vbd.DepartmentTMS,
		pa.PalletAuditPK,
		pa.PalletFK,
		pa.BuildingUnitFK,
		pa.EventTypeFK,
		pa.EventFK,
		pa.InsertedBy,
		pa.InsertedDate,
		pa.StockItemFK,
		si.StockItemCode,
		si.[Description] AS StockItemName,
		si.DivisionFK,
		div.DivisionCode,
		div.DivisionName,
		div.CustomerFK,
		cus.CustomerCode,
		cus.CustomerName	
		FROM dbo.tblPalletAudit pa WITH (NOLOCK)
		INNER JOIN #WorksOrderMovementDetails0 wom
		ON pa.PalletFK = wom.PalletFK
		AND pa.InsertedBy = wom.UpdatedBy
		LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.viewBuildingDetails vbd WITH (NOLOCK)
		ON pa.BuildingUnitFK = vbd.BuildingUnitPK
		LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.tblStockItems si WITH (NOLOCK)
		ON pa.StockItemFK = si.StockItemPK
		LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.tblDivisions div WITH (NOLOCK)
		ON si.DivisionFK = div.DivisionPK
		LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.tblCustomers cus WITH (NOLOCK)
		ON div.CustomerFK = cus.CustomerPK
		WHERE pa.InsertedDate >= @varStartDate 
		AND pa.InsertedDate < @varEndDate
		AND pa.EventTypeFK = 17 /*Pallet Movement*/

		-- Ensure all pallet audit records have a BuildingUnitFK value that links to the selected building.
		-- This is required as a work-around for an existing bug (as of 27 Aug 2019) which will be fixed later by Jamie.

		DECLARE @BuildingUnitFK INT = (SELECT MAX(BuildingUnitPK) FROM dbo.viewBuildingDetails WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE DepartmentTMS = @varBuildingName)

		UPDATE pa
		SET BuildingUnitFK = @BuildingUnitFK
		FROM #PalletAuditDetailsForSelectedDateAndBuilding pa
		INNER JOIN dbo.viewBuildingDetails vbd WITH (NOLOCK)
		ON pa.BuildingUnitFK = vbd.BuildingUnitPK
		WHERE vbd.DepartmentTMS <> @varBuildingName	

		-- Get warehousing user details.

		DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #warehouseUserDetails

		SELECT DISTINCT
		UserPK,	PersonFK, UserTypeFK, DistributionCustomerFK, AspNetUserID, MobAspNetUserID, UserName, U_IsArchived, U_InsertedBy, U_InsertedDate, U_UpdatedBy, U_UpdatedDate, 
		PersonPK, FirstName,	LastName, EmployeeName,	P_IsArchived, P_InsertedBy,	P_InsertedDate,	P_UpdatedBy, P_UpdatedDate, EmployeeNumber,	JobTitle	
		INTO #warehouseUserDetails 
		FROM dbo.viewUserDetails WITH (NOLOCK) 
		WHERE UserTypeFK = 1 /*Warehousing*/

		-- Get expanded pallet audit details for the selected date and building.

		DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #PalletAuditUserBuildingDetails

		SELECT DISTINCT 
		CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(50)) AS StockInOutNumber, 
		'PalletAudit' AS RecordType, 
		pa.PalletAuditPK AS PK, 	
		CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(50)) as Origin, 
		paet.PalletAuditEventType AS EventType, 
		pa.PalletFK, 
		pa.InsertedBy AS UserFK,
		vud.EmployeeName AS [EmployeeName],
		vud.EmployeeNumber AS [EmployeeNumber],
		pa.InsertedDate AS EventDateTime, 
		CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(50)) AS FromLocationType,
		CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(50)) AS ToLocationType,
		pa.EventFK,
		pa.EventTypeFK,
		CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(50)) AS MovementType,
		vbd.DepartmentTMS,
		pa.StockItemFK,
		pa.StockItemCode,
		pa.StockItemName,
		pa.DivisionFK,
		pa.DivisionCode,
		pa.DivisionName,
		pa.CustomerFK,
		pa.CustomerCode,
		pa.CustomerName
		INTO #PalletAuditUserBuildingDetails
		FROM #PalletAuditDetailsForSelectedDateAndBuilding pa 
		LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.viewBuildingDetails vbd WITH (NOLOCK)
		ON pa.BuildingUnitFK = vbd.BuildingUnitPK
		LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.appPalletAuditEventTypes paet WITH (NOLOCK)
		ON pa.EventTypeFK = paet.PalletAuditEventTypePK
		LEFT OUTER JOIN #warehouseUserDetails vud
		ON pa.InsertedBy = vud.UserPK

		-- Delete this as no longer needed.
		DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #PalletAuditDetailsForSelectedDateAndBuilding

		-- Get expanded works order details for the selected date and building.

		DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #WorksOrderMovementDetails

		SELECT DISTINCT 
		CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(50)) AS StockInOutNumber, 
		'WorksOrderMovement' AS RecordType, 
		wom.WorksOrderMovementPK AS PK, 
		CASE WHEN woo.WorksOrderOrigin = 'Movement' THEN 'Pallet Movement' ELSE woo.WorksOrderOrigin END AS Origin, 
		CASE WHEN wot.WorksOrderType = 'Movement' THEN 'Pallet Movement' ELSE wot.WorksOrderType END AS EventType,
		wom.PalletFK, 
		wom.UpdatedBy AS UserFK,
		vud.EmployeeName AS [EmployeeName],
		vud.EmployeeNumber AS [EmployeeNumber],
		wom.UpdatedDate AS EventDateTime, 
		slt.LocationType AS FromLocationType, 
		dlt.LocationType AS ToLocationType,
		CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(50)) AS MovementType,
		wo.WorksOrderPK AS WorksOrderFK,
		wom.DepartmentTMS,
		-1 as StockItemFK,
		CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(50)) AS StockItemCode,
		CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(200)) AS StockItemName,
		-1 AS DivisionFK,
		CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(50)) AS DivisionCode,
		CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(200)) AS DivisionName,
		-1 AS CustomerFK,
		CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(50)) AS CustomerCode,
		CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(200)) AS CustomerName
		INTO #WorksOrderMovementDetails
		FROM #WorksOrderMovementDetails0 wom
		LEFT OUTER JOIN #WorksOrders wo
		ON wom.WorksOrderFK = wo.WorksOrderPK
		LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.appWorksOrderTypes wot WITH (NOLOCK)
		ON wo.WorksOrderTypeFK = wot.WorksOrderTypePK
		LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.appWorksOrderOrigins woo WITH (NOLOCK)
		ON wo.WorksOrderOriginFK = woo.WorksOrderOriginPK
		LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.appLocationTypes slt WITH (NOLOCK)
		ON wom.SourceLocationTypeFK = slt.LocationTypePK
		LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.appLocationTypes dlt WITH (NOLOCK)
		ON wom.DestinationLocationTypeFK = dlt.LocationTypePK
		LEFT OUTER JOIN #warehouseUserDetails vud
		ON wom.UpdatedBy = vud.UserPK		

		-- Set works order movement missing values.

		UPDATE womd
		SET 
			StockInOutNumber = co.GoodsOrderNumber
		FROM 
			#WorksOrderMovementDetails womd
		INNER JOIN #WorksOrders wo
			ON womd.WorksOrderFK = wo.WorksOrderPK
		INNER JOIN dbo.tblStockOrders so WITH (NOLOCK)
			ON wo.FK = so.StockOrderPK
			AND wo.WorksOrderOriginFK IN (2/*StockOrder*/, 3/*StockOut*/)
		INNER JOIN dbo.tblContainerOuts co WITH (NOLOCK)
			ON so.ContainerOutFK = co.ContainerOutPK
		INNER JOIN dbo.tblContainerOutLines col WITH (NOLOCK)
			ON co.ContainerOutPK = col.ContainerOutFK
		WHERE
			womd.Origin = 'StockOrder'

		UPDATE womd
		SET 
			StockInOutNumber = co.GoodsOrderNumber
		FROM 
			#WorksOrderMovementDetails womd
		INNER JOIN dbo.tblContainerOutLinePalletContent colpc WITH (NOLOCK)
			ON womd.PalletFK = colpc.PalletFK
		INNER JOIN dbo.tblContainerOutLines col WITH (NOLOCK)
			ON colpc.ContainerOutLineFK = col.ContainerOutLinePK
		INNER JOIN dbo.tblContainerOuts co WITH (NOLOCK)
			ON col.ContainerOutFK = co.ContainerOutPK
		WHERE
			womd.Origin = 'StockOrder'
			AND womd.StockInOutNumber = ''

		UPDATE womd
		SET 
			StockInOutNumber = ci.GoodsInNumber
		FROM 
			#WorksOrderMovementDetails womd
		INNER JOIN #WorksOrders wo
			ON womd.WorksOrderFK = wo.WorksOrderPK
		INNER JOIN dbo.tblStockIns si WITH (NOLOCK)
			ON wo.FK = si.StockInPK
			AND wo.WorksOrderOriginFK = 1 /*StockIn*/
		INNER JOIN dbo.tblContainerIns ci WITH (NOLOCK)
			ON si.ContainerInFK = ci.ContainerInPK
		WHERE
			womd.Origin =  'StockIn'

		UPDATE womd
		SET 
			StockInOutNumber = ci.GoodsInNumber
		FROM 
			#WorksOrderMovementDetails womd
		INNER JOIN dbo.tblStockInLinePallets silp WITH (NOLOCK)
			ON womd.PalletFK = silp.PalletFK
		INNER JOIN dbo.tblStockInLines sil WITH (NOLOCK)
			ON silp.StockInLineFK = sil.StockInLinePK
		INNER JOIN dbo.tblStockIns si WITH (NOLOCK)
			ON sil.StockInFK= si.StockInPK
		INNER JOIN dbo.tblContainerIns ci WITH (NOLOCK)
			ON si.ContainerInFK = ci.ContainerInPK
		WHERE
			womd.Origin =  'StockIn'
			AND womd.StockInOutNumber = ''

		UPDATE #WorksOrderMovementDetails 
		SET MovementType =	CASE
								WHEN Origin = 'Pallet Movement' AND FromLocationType = 'BuildingUnitBay' AND ToLocationType = 'BuildingUnitBay' THEN 'Movement'
								WHEN Origin = 'Pallet Movement' AND FromLocationType = 'BuildingUnitBay' AND ToLocationType = 'FloorLocation' THEN 'Movement'
								WHEN Origin = 'Pallet Movement' AND FromLocationType = 'BuildingUnitBay' AND ToLocationType = 'LoadingBay' THEN 'Movement'
								WHEN Origin = 'Pallet Movement' AND FromLocationType = 'BuildingUnitBay' AND ToLocationType = 'SampleLocation' THEN 'Movement'
								WHEN Origin = 'Pallet Movement' AND FromLocationType = 'BuildingUnitBay' AND ToLocationType = 'SetDownArea' THEN 'Movement'
								WHEN Origin = 'Pallet Movement' AND FromLocationType = 'FloorLocation' AND ToLocationType = 'BuildingUnitBay' THEN 'Putaway'
								WHEN Origin = 'Pallet Movement' AND FromLocationType = 'FloorLocation' AND ToLocationType = 'FloorLocation' THEN 'Movement'
								WHEN Origin = 'Pallet Movement' AND FromLocationType = 'FloorLocation' AND ToLocationType = 'SetDownArea' THEN 'Movement'
								WHEN Origin = 'Pallet Movement' AND FromLocationType = 'LoadingBay' AND ToLocationType = 'BuildingUnitBay' THEN 'Putaway'
								WHEN Origin = 'Pallet Movement' AND FromLocationType = 'LoadingBay' AND ToLocationType = 'FloorLocation' THEN 'Movement'
								WHEN Origin = 'Pallet Movement' AND FromLocationType = 'LoadingBay' AND ToLocationType = 'LoadingBay' THEN 'Movement'
								WHEN Origin = 'Pallet Movement' AND FromLocationType = 'LoadingBay' AND ToLocationType = 'SampleLocation' THEN 'Movement'
								WHEN Origin = 'Pallet Movement' AND FromLocationType = 'LoadingBay' AND ToLocationType = 'SetDownArea' THEN 'Movement'
								WHEN Origin = 'Pallet Movement' AND FromLocationType = 'OnRouteContainerIn' AND ToLocationType = 'BuildingUnitBay' THEN 'Putaway'
								WHEN Origin = 'Pallet Movement' AND FromLocationType = 'SampleLocation' AND ToLocationType = 'BuildingUnitBay' THEN 'Putaway'
								WHEN Origin = 'Pallet Movement' AND FromLocationType = 'SampleLocation' AND ToLocationType = 'LoadingBay' THEN 'Movement'
								WHEN Origin = 'Pallet Movement' AND FromLocationType = 'SampleLocation' AND ToLocationType = 'SetDownArea' THEN 'Movement'
								WHEN Origin = 'Pallet Movement' AND FromLocationType = 'SetDownArea' AND ToLocationType = 'BuildingUnitBay' THEN 'Putaway'
								WHEN Origin = 'Pallet Movement' AND FromLocationType = 'SetDownArea' AND ToLocationType = 'FloorLocation' THEN 'Movement'
								WHEN Origin = 'Pallet Movement' AND FromLocationType = 'SetDownArea' AND ToLocationType = 'LoadingBay' THEN 'Movement'
								WHEN Origin = 'Pallet Movement' AND FromLocationType = 'SetDownArea' AND ToLocationType = 'SampleLocation' THEN 'Movement'
								WHEN Origin = 'Pallet Movement' AND FromLocationType = 'SetDownArea' AND ToLocationType = 'SetDownArea' THEN 'Movement'
								WHEN Origin = 'StockIn' AND FromLocationType = 'BuildingUnitBay' AND ToLocationType = 'BuildingUnitBay' THEN 'Movement'
								WHEN Origin = 'StockIn' AND FromLocationType = 'BuildingUnitBay' AND ToLocationType = 'SetDownArea' THEN 'Movement'
								WHEN Origin = 'StockIn' AND FromLocationType = 'LoadingBay' AND ToLocationType = 'BuildingUnitBay' THEN 'Putaway'
								WHEN Origin = 'StockIn' AND FromLocationType = 'LoadingBay' AND ToLocationType = 'LoadingBay' THEN 'Movement'
								WHEN Origin = 'StockIn' AND FromLocationType = 'LoadingBay' AND ToLocationType = 'MovementLocation' THEN 'Movement'
								WHEN Origin = 'StockIn' AND FromLocationType = 'LoadingBay' AND ToLocationType = 'SampleLocation' THEN 'Putaway'
