								WHEN Origin = 'StockIn' AND FromLocationType = 'LoadingBay' AND ToLocationType = 'SetDownArea' THEN 'Movement'
								WHEN Origin = 'StockIn' AND FromLocationType = 'MovementLocation' AND ToLocationType = 'BuildingUnitBay' THEN 'Putaway'
								WHEN Origin = 'StockIn' AND FromLocationType = 'MovementLocation' AND ToLocationType = 'MovementLocation' THEN 'Movement'
								WHEN Origin = 'StockIn' AND FromLocationType = 'MovementLocation' AND ToLocationType = 'SetDownArea' THEN 'Movement'
								WHEN Origin = 'StockIn' AND FromLocationType = 'OnRouteContainerIn' AND ToLocationType = 'BuildingUnitBay' THEN 'Putaway'
								WHEN Origin = 'StockIn' AND FromLocationType = 'OnRouteContainerIn' AND ToLocationType = 'LoadingBay' THEN 'Unloaded'
								WHEN Origin = 'StockIn' AND FromLocationType = 'OnRouteContainerIn' AND ToLocationType = 'MovementLocation' THEN 'Unloaded'
								WHEN Origin = 'StockIn' AND FromLocationType = 'OnRouteContainerIn' AND ToLocationType = 'SetDownArea' THEN 'Unloaded'

								WHEN Origin = 'StockIn' AND FromLocationType = 'OnRouteContainerIn' AND ToLocationType = 'FloorLocation' THEN 'Unloaded' --NEW

								WHEN Origin = 'StockIn' AND FromLocationType = 'SampleLocation' AND ToLocationType = 'BuildingUnitBay' THEN 'Putaway'
								WHEN Origin = 'StockIn' AND FromLocationType = 'SampleLocation' AND ToLocationType = 'SetDownArea' THEN 'Movement'
								WHEN Origin = 'StockIn' AND FromLocationType = 'SetDownArea' AND ToLocationType = 'BuildingUnitBay' THEN 'Putaway'
								WHEN Origin = 'StockIn' AND FromLocationType = 'SetDownArea' AND ToLocationType = 'LoadingBay' THEN 'Movement'
								WHEN Origin = 'StockIn' AND FromLocationType = 'SetDownArea' AND ToLocationType = 'MovementLocation' THEN 'Movement'
								WHEN Origin = 'StockIn' AND FromLocationType = 'SetDownArea' AND ToLocationType = 'SampleLocation' THEN 'Putaway'
								WHEN Origin = 'StockIn' AND FromLocationType = 'SetDownArea' AND ToLocationType = 'SetDownArea' THEN 'Movement'

								WHEN Origin = 'StockIn' AND FromLocationType = 'FloorLocation' AND ToLocationType = 'BuildingUnitBay' THEN 'Putaway' --NEW
								WHEN Origin = 'StockIn' AND FromLocationType = 'LoadingBay' AND ToLocationType = 'FloorLocation' THEN 'Movement' --NEW
								WHEN Origin = 'StockIn' AND FromLocationType = 'FloorLocation' AND ToLocationType = 'FloorLocation' THEN 'Movement' --NEW
								WHEN Origin = 'StockIn' AND FromLocationType = 'SetDownArea' AND ToLocationType = 'FloorLocation' THEN 'Movement' --NEW

								WHEN Origin = 'StockOrder' AND FromLocationType = 'BuildingUnitBay' AND ToLocationType = 'BuildingUnitBay' THEN 'Movement'
								WHEN Origin = 'StockOrder' AND FromLocationType = 'BuildingUnitBay' AND ToLocationType = 'FloorLocation' THEN 'Picked'
								WHEN Origin = 'StockOrder' AND FromLocationType = 'BuildingUnitBay' AND ToLocationType = 'LoadingBay' THEN 'Loaded'
								WHEN Origin = 'StockOrder' AND FromLocationType = 'BuildingUnitBay' AND ToLocationType = 'SetDownArea' THEN 'Picked'
								WHEN Origin = 'StockOrder' AND FromLocationType = 'FloorLocation' AND ToLocationType = 'FloorLocation' THEN 'Movement'
								WHEN Origin = 'StockOrder' AND FromLocationType = 'FloorLocation' AND ToLocationType = 'LoadingBay' THEN 'Loaded'
								WHEN Origin = 'StockOrder' AND FromLocationType = 'FloorLocation' AND ToLocationType = 'SetDownArea' THEN 'Movement'
								WHEN Origin = 'StockOrder' AND FromLocationType = 'LoadingBay' AND ToLocationType = 'FloorLocation' THEN 'Movement'
								WHEN Origin = 'StockOrder' AND FromLocationType = 'LoadingBay' AND ToLocationType = 'LoadingBay' THEN 'Loaded'
								WHEN Origin = 'StockOrder' AND FromLocationType = 'LoadingBay' AND ToLocationType = 'SampleLocation' THEN 'Movement'
								WHEN Origin = 'StockOrder' AND FromLocationType = 'LoadingBay' AND ToLocationType = 'SetDownArea' THEN 'Movement'
								WHEN Origin = 'StockOrder' AND FromLocationType = 'OnRouteContainerOut' AND ToLocationType = 'LoadingBay' THEN 'Movement'
								WHEN Origin = 'StockOrder' AND FromLocationType = 'SampleLocation' AND ToLocationType = 'LoadingBay' THEN 'Loaded'
								WHEN Origin = 'StockOrder' AND FromLocationType = 'SetDownArea' AND ToLocationType = 'FloorLocation' THEN 'Movement'
								WHEN Origin = 'StockOrder' AND FromLocationType = 'SetDownArea' AND ToLocationType = 'LoadingBay' THEN 'Loaded'
								WHEN Origin = 'StockOrder' AND FromLocationType = 'SetDownArea' AND ToLocationType = 'SetDownArea' THEN 'Movement'
								ELSE 'Movement'
							END
		WHERE Origin IN ('Pallet Movement', 'StockIn', 'StockOrder')

		UPDATE pad
		SET 
			Origin = 'StockOrder',
			StockInOutNumber = co.GoodsOrderNumber,
			MovementType= 'Loaded'
		FROM 
			#PalletAuditUserBuildingDetails pad
		INNER JOIN dbo.tblContainerOuts co WITH (NOLOCK)
			ON Pad.EventFK = co.ContainerOutPK
		WHERE
			pad.EventTypeFK = 27/*Pallet Loaded Scanned*/

		UPDATE pad
		SET 
			Origin = 'StockIn',
			StockInOutNumber = ci.GoodsInNumber,
			MovementType= 'Unloaded'
		FROM 
			#PalletAuditUserBuildingDetails pad
		INNER JOIN dbo.tblStockIns si WITH (NOLOCK)
			ON pad.EventFK = si.StockInPK
		INNER JOIN dbo.tblContainerIns ci
			ON si.ContainerInFK = ci.ContainerInPK
		WHERE
			pad.EventTypeFK = 37 /*Pallet Created Via Scanning*/

	--select * from #PalletAuditUserBuildingDetails where EventTypeFK = 37 /*Pallet Created Via Scanning*/
	--goto ec

		UPDATE pad
		SET 
			Origin = womd.Origin,
			StockInOutNumber = womd.StockInOutNumber,
			MovementType = womd.MovementType
		FROM 
			#PalletAuditUserBuildingDetails pad
		INNER JOIN #WorksOrderMovementDetails womd
			ON pad.PalletFK = womd.PalletFK
			AND pad.EventFK = womd.PK	-- Pallet Audit EventFK = WorksOrderMovement.WorksOrderMovementPK
		WHERE
			pad.EventTypeFK  = 17/*Pallet Movement*/


		UPDATE womd
		SET 
			StockItemFK = pad.StockItemFK,
			StockItemCode = pad.StockItemCode,
			StockItemName = pad.StockItemName,
			DivisionFK = pad.DivisionFK,
			DivisionCode = pad.DivisionCode,
			DivisionName = pad.DivisionName,
			CustomerFK = pad.CustomerFK,
			CustomerCode = pad.CustomerCode,
			CustomerName = pad.CustomerName
		FROM 
			#PalletAuditUserBuildingDetails pad
		INNER JOIN #WorksOrderMovementDetails womd
			ON pad.PalletFK = womd.PalletFK
			AND pad.EventFK = womd.PK	-- Pallet Audit EventFK = WorksOrderMovement.WorksOrderMovementPK
		WHERE
			pad.EventTypeFK  = 17/*Pallet Movement*/

		UPDATE #PalletAuditUserBuildingDetails 
		SET Origin = 'Pallet Movement', 
		MovementType = 'Movement' 
		WHERE Origin = '' 
		AND StockInOutNumber = ''

		DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #PalletAuditWorksOrderMovmentDetails

		SELECT	
			StockInOutNumber, RecordType, PK, Origin, EventType,	PalletFK, UserFK, EmployeeName,	EmployeeNumber, EventDateTime, FromLocationType, ToLocationType, MovementType, DepartmentTMS,
			StockItemFK, StockItemCode, StockItemName, DivisionFK, DivisionCode, DivisionName, CustomerFK, CustomerCode, CustomerName
		INTO 
			#PalletAuditWorksOrderMovmentDetails 
		FROM 
			#PalletAuditUserBuildingDetails
		UNION
		SELECT 
			StockInOutNumber, RecordType, PK, Origin, EventType,	PalletFK, UserFK, EmployeeName,	EmployeeNumber, EventDateTime, FromLocationType, ToLocationType, MovementType, DepartmentTMS,
			StockItemFK, StockItemCode, StockItemName, DivisionFK, DivisionCode, DivisionName, CustomerFK, CustomerCode, CustomerName
		FROM 
			#WorksOrderMovementDetails wom
		WHERE 
			wom.EventDateTime >= @varStartDate
			AND wom.EventDateTime < @varEndDate

		UPDATE #PalletAuditWorksOrderMovmentDetails SET Origin = 'StockOut' WHERE Origin = 'StockOrder'

		DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #TMSEmployeeClockCardDetails

		SELECT * INTO #TMSEmployeeClockCardDetails 
		FROM dbo.tblTMSEmployeeClockCardDetails WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE ClockCardDate = @varStartDate

		DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #TMSEmployeeClockedTimes

		SELECT DISTINCT t1.* 
		INTO #TMSEmployeeClockedTimes
		FROM dbo.tblTMSEmployeeClockedTimes t1 WITH (NOLOCK)
		INNER JOIN #TMSEmployeeClockCardDetails t2
		ON t1.TMSEmployeeClockCardDetailFK = t2.TMSEmployeeClockCardDetailPK
		INNER JOIN #warehouseUserDetails vud
		ON ((CAST(t2.EmployeeNumber AS INT) = vud.EmployeeNumber AND vud.EmployeeNumber > 0)
		OR (t2.EmployeeName = vud.EmployeeName AND vud.EmployeeNumber < 1))
		WHERE 
			t2.ClockCardDate = @varStartDate
			AND
			(
				EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.tblTMSEmployeeClockedTimes t3 WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE t3.TMSEmployeeClockCardDetailFK = t1.TMSEmployeeClockCardDetailFK AND t3.Department = @varBuildingName)
				OR			
				EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #PalletAuditUserBuildingDetails t2 WHERE t2.UserFK = vud.UserPK)
			)

		-- Delete this as no longer needed.
		DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #warehouseUserDetails

		DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #userDetails

		SELECT DISTINCT
			vud.UserPK,	vud.PersonFK, vud.UserTypeFK, vud.DistributionCustomerFK, vud.AspNetUserID, vud.MobAspNetUserID, vud.UserName, vud.U_IsArchived, vud.U_InsertedBy, vud.U_InsertedDate, vud.U_UpdatedBy, vud.U_UpdatedDate, 
			vud.PersonPK, vud.FirstName, vud.LastName, vud.EmployeeName, vud.P_IsArchived, vud.P_InsertedBy, vud.P_InsertedDate, vud.P_UpdatedBy, vud.P_UpdatedDate, vud.EmployeeNumber, vud.JobTitle
		INTO
			#userDetails
		FROM 
			#TMSEmployeeClockCardDetails ttccd
		INNER JOIN #TMSEmployeeClockedTimes ttct
			ON ttccd.TMSEmployeeClockCardDetailPK = ttct.TMSEmployeeClockCardDetailFK
		INNER JOIN dbo.viewUserDetails vud WITH (NOLOCK)
			ON ((CAST(ttccd.EmployeeNumber AS INT) = vud.EmployeeNumber AND vud.EmployeeNumber > 0)
			OR (ttccd.EmployeeName = vud.EmployeeName AND vud.EmployeeNumber < 1))
			AND vud.UserTypeFK = 1 /*Warehousing*/
		WHERE 
			ttccd.ClockCardDate = @varStartDate
			AND (ttct.Department = @varBuildingName OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #PalletAuditUserBuildingDetails t2 WHERE t2.UserFK = vud.UserPK))

		-- Get employee tms records matching on employee name, date, and clock time department. 

		DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #TMSDetails0

		SELECT DISTINCT
			ttccd.TMSEmployeeClockCardDetailPK,
			ttccd.EmployeeName,
			CAST(ttccd.EmployeeNumber AS INT) AS EmployeeNumber,
			vud.UserPK AS UserFK,
			CAST(0 AS BIT) AS UserFKinPalletAuditData
		INTO 
			#TMSDetails0
		FROM 
			#TMSEmployeeClockCardDetails ttccd
		INNER JOIN #TMSEmployeeClockedTimes ttct
			ON ttccd.TMSEmployeeClockCardDetailPK = ttct.TMSEmployeeClockCardDetailFK
		INNER JOIN #userDetails vud
			ON ((CAST(ttccd.EmployeeNumber AS INT) = vud.EmployeeNumber AND vud.EmployeeNumber > 0)
			OR (ttccd.EmployeeName = vud.EmployeeName AND vud.EmployeeNumber < 1))
			AND vud.UserTypeFK = 1 /*Warehousing*/
		WHERE 
			ttccd.ClockCardDate = @varStartDate
			AND (ttct.Department = @varBuildingName OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #PalletAuditUserBuildingDetails t2 WHERE t2.UserFK = vud.UserPK))

		UPDATE t1
		SET UserFKinPalletAuditData = 1
		FROM #TMSDetails0 t1
		INNER JOIN #PalletAuditUserBuildingDetails t2
		ON t1.UserFK = t2.UserFK

		-- Delete this as no longer needed.
		DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #PalletAuditUserBuildingDetails

		-- Add the employee tms records into a new temporary table with user details.

		DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #TMSDetails1

		SELECT distinct vud.U_InsertedDate, vud.U_UpdatedDate, t1.*
		INTO #TMSDetails1
		FROM #TMSDetails0 t1
		INNER JOIN #userDetails vud
		ON t1.UserFK = vud.UserPK
		AND vud.UserTypeFK = 1 /*Warehousing*/

		-- Get duplicate employee names with more than one userfk, i.e. an employee has more than 1 user record.

		DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #employeesWithMultipleUserRecords0

		SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT UserFK) AS NoOfUserFKs, EmployeeName
		INTO #employeesWithMultipleUserRecords0
		FROM #TMSDetails1
		GROUP BY EmployeeName
		HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT UserFK) > 1

		-- Get employee tms records where the employee has more than 1 userfk.

		DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #employeesWithMultipleUserRecords1

		SELECT DISTINCT t1.* 
		INTO #employeesWithMultipleUserRecords1
		FROM #TMSDetails1 t1 
		INNER JOIN #employeesWithMultipleUserRecords0 t2
		ON t1.EmployeeName = t2.EmployeeName

		-- Remove records where userfk not in pallet audit data but it's employee name has another userfk in the pallet audit data.

		DELETE t1
		FROM #employeesWithMultipleUserRecords1 t1
		WHERE t1.UserFKinPalletAuditData = 0
		AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #employeesWithMultipleUserRecords1 t2 WHERE t2.EmployeeName = t1.EmployeeName AND t2.UserFKinPalletAuditData = 1)

		-- Get the correct user based on the closest user inserted date to the parameter @varStartDate value.

		DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #employeesWithMultipleUserRecords2

		SELECT MAX(t1.U_InsertedDate) AS UserInsertedDate, t1.EmployeeName
		INTO #employeesWithMultipleUserRecords2
		FROM #employeesWithMultipleUserRecords1 t1
		WHERE t1.U_InsertedDate < @varStartDate
		GROUP BY t1.EmployeeName

		-- Remove the "incorrect" user records from the duplicates temporary table.

		DELETE t1
		FROM #employeesWithMultipleUserRecords1 t1
		INNER JOIN #employeesWithMultipleUserRecords2 t2
		ON t1.EmployeeName = t2.EmployeeName
		WHERE T1.U_InsertedDate <> t2.UserInsertedDate

		-- Remove the "incorrect" user records from the main tms temporary table.

		DELETE t1
		FROM #TMSDetails1 t1
		INNER JOIN #employeesWithMultipleUserRecords1 t2
		ON t1.EmployeeName = t2.EmployeeName
		WHERE t1.UserFK <> t2.UserFK

		-- Get TMS correction records, i.e. records created by managers to add missing clock times for employees.

		DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #tMSCorrectionRecords

		SELECT DISTINCT 
		ttccd.TMSEmployeeClockCardDetailPK, ttccd.EmployeeNumber, ttccd.ClockCardDate, ttccd.ClockCardTimes, ttccd.[Shift], tct.TMSEmployeeClockedTimePK, tct.ClockedTime
		INTO #tMSCorrectionRecords
		FROM #TMSDetails1 t1
		INNER JOIN #TMSEmployeeClockCardDetails ttccd
		ON t1.TMSEmployeeClockCardDetailPK = ttccd.TMSEmployeeClockCardDetailPK
		LEFT OUTER JOIN #TMSEmployeeClockedTimes tct
		ON ttccd.TMSEmployeeClockCardDetailPK = tct.TMSEmployeeClockCardDetailFK
		WHERE LEN(LTRIM(RTRIM(ClockCardTimes))) = 5 /*Only 1 clock time*/
		AND CHARINDEX(':', ClockCardTimes) > 0 /*Has at least one valid clock time*/
		AND CHARINDEX(':', [Shift]) > 0 /*Has at least one valid clock time*/
		AND CHARINDEX(' - ', [Shift]) > 0 /*Indicates another clock time is present. Generally be 1 minute apart*/
		AND EXISTS( /*Has a linked main record which is missing at least one clock time*/
					SELECT 1 FROM #TMSEmployeeClockCardDetails t2 
					WHERE t2.EmployeeNumber = ttccd.EmployeeNumber 
					AND t2.ClockCardDate = ttccd.ClockCardDate 
					AND t2.ClockCardTimes <> ttccd.ClockCardTimes
					)

		-- Remove the correction records for the tms records.
		DELETE t1
		FROM #TMSEmployeeClockCardDetails t1
		INNER JOIN #tMSCorrectionRecords t2
		ON t1.TMSEmployeeClockCardDetailPK = t2.TMSEmployeeClockCardDetailPK

		-- Remove the correction records from the selected tms records.
		DELETE t1
		FROM #TMSDetails1 t1
		INNER JOIN #tMSCorrectionRecords t2
		ON t1.TMSEmployeeClockCardDetailPK = t2.TMSEmployeeClockCardDetailPK

		-- Update the correction records foreign key values to the main records primary key values.
		UPDATE tct
		SET tct.TMSEmployeeClockCardDetailFK = t3.TMSEmployeeClockCardDetailPK
		FROM #TMSEmployeeClockedTimes tct
		INNER JOIN #tMSCorrectionRecords t2
		ON tct.TMSEmployeeClockCardDetailFK = t2.TMSEmployeeClockCardDetailPK
		INNER JOIN #TMSDetails1 t3
		ON t2.EmployeeNumber = t3.EmployeeNumber

		-- Update the corrected main records to include the missing tms time(s) and in the correct order.

		UPDATE tccd
		SET ClockCardTimes = STUFF
		(
			(
				SELECT ' ' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),tct.ClockedTime, 108)
				FROM #TMSDetails1 As T2
				INNER JOIN #TMSEmployeeClockedTimes tct
				ON t1.TMSEmployeeClockCardDetailPK = tct.TMSEmployeeClockCardDetailFK
				WHERE t2.EmployeeNumber = t1.EmployeeNumber
				ORDER BY CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),tct.ClockedTime, 108) ASC
				FOR XML PATH (''), TYPE
			).value('.', 'varchar(max)')
		, 1, 1, '')
		FROM #TMSDetails1 As T1
		INNER JOIN #TMSEmployeeClockCardDetails tccd
		ON T1.TMSEmployeeClockCardDetailPK = tccd.TMSEmployeeClockCardDetailPK
		INNER JOIN #tMSCorrectionRecords t2
		ON t1.EmployeeNumber = t2.EmployeeNumber

		DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #TMSDetails2

		SELECT DISTINCT
			ttccd.TMSEmployeeClockCardDetailPK,
			ttct.TMSEmployeeClockedTimePK,
			ttct.Department,
			ttccd.EmployeeNumber,
			ttccd.EmployeeName,	
			CAST( CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), CAST(ttccd.ClockCardDate AS DATETIME), 21) + ' ' + LEFT(ttct.ClockedTime, 5) + ':00.000' AS DATETIME) AS EventDateTime,
			vud.UserPK AS UserFK,
			vud.U_InsertedDate AS UserInsertedDate,

			REPLACE(ttccd.[Shift], ' ','') AS [Shift],
			(SELECT [dbo].[fnGetDurationInMinutesBetweenTMSShiftStartAndEndTimes](ttccd.[Shift])) AS ShiftDurationInMinutes,
			CAST(0 AS INT) AS TimeWorkedMinutes,
			CASE WHEN ttccd.AbsenceCodes LIKE '%BHOL%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS IsBankHoliday,

			((LEFT(ttccd.Overtime,2) * 60) + RIGHT(LEFT(ttccd.Overtime, 5),2))
			+
			((LEFT(ttccd.OT1_20Percent,2) * 60) + RIGHT(LEFT(ttccd.OT1_20Percent, 5),2))
			+
			((LEFT(ttccd.OT2_20Percent,2) * 60) + RIGHT(LEFT(ttccd.OT2_20Percent, 5),2))
			+
			((LEFT(ttccd.OT1_25Percent,2) * 60) + RIGHT(LEFT(ttccd.OT1_25Percent, 5),2))
			+
			((LEFT(ttccd.OT2_25Percent,2) * 60) + RIGHT(LEFT(ttccd.OT2_25Percent, 5),2))

			AS OvertimeMinutes,
			CASE 
				WHEN ttccd.AbsenceCodes = 'E' THEN 'early'
				WHEN ttccd.AbsenceCodes = 'L' THEN 'late'
				WHEN ttccd.AbsenceCodes = 'NWD' THEN 'off today'
				WHEN ttccd.AbsenceCodes = 'H' THEN 'holiday'
				WHEN ttccd.AbsenceCodes = 'TR' THEN 'training'
				WHEN ttccd.AbsenceCodes = 'BHOL' THEN 'bank holiday'
				ELSE ttccd.AbsenceCodes
			END AS AbsenceCodes,
			ttccd.ClockCardTimes
		INTO
			#TMSDetails2
		FROM 
			#TMSDetails1 t1
		INNER JOIN #TMSEmployeeClockCardDetails ttccd
			ON t1.TMSEmployeeClockCardDetailPK = ttccd.TMSEmployeeClockCardDetailPK
		INNER JOIN #TMSEmployeeClockedTimes ttct
			ON ttccd.TMSEmployeeClockCardDetailPK = ttct.TMSEmployeeClockCardDetailFK
		INNER JOIN #userDetails vud
			ON t1.UserFK = vud.UserPK
			AND vud.UserTypeFK = 1 /*Warehousing*/

		DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #TMSDetailsFinal

		SELECT DISTINCT
			*,
			CASE
				WHEN CAST(ShiftDurationInMinutes AS DECIMAL(18,2)) / 60.00 IN (7, 8) THEN 30
				WHEN CAST(ShiftDurationInMinutes AS DECIMAL(18,2)) / 60.00 IN (7.5, 8.5, 9) THEN 45
				WHEN CAST(ShiftDurationInMinutes AS DECIMAL(18,2)) / 60.00 = 12 THEN 60
				ELSE 15 /*Under 6 hours*/
			END AS ShiftBreakTimesInMinutes,
			CAST(0 AS INT) AS ShiftDurationLessBreaksMinutes
		INTO 
			#TMSDetailsFinal 
		FROM 
			#TMSDetails2

	--zxc

		UPDATE #TMSDetailsFinal
		SET 
			ShiftDurationLessBreaksMinutes = ISNULL(ShiftDurationInMinutes,0)

		DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #tMSFirstAndLastClockCardTimes

		SELECT TMSEmployeeClockCardDetailPK, Department AS BuildingName, UserFK AS UserFK, EmployeeName,
		MIN(CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),EventDateTime, 108)) AS [1stClockCardTime], MAX(CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),EventDateTime, 108)) AS [LastClockCardTime]
		INTO #tMSFirstAndLastClockCardTimes
		FROM #TMSDetailsFinal 
		WHERE Department = @varBuildingName
		GROUP BY TMSEmployeeClockCardDetailPK, Department, UserFK, EmployeeName

		DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #tMSTimesForUserAndBuilding

		SELECT UserFK AS UserFK, Department AS BuildingName, TMSTimesForUserAndBuilding = STUFF
		(
			(
				SELECT ' ' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),EventDateTime, 108)
				FROM #TMSDetailsFinal As T2
				WHERE t2.UserFK = t1.UserFK
				AND t2.Department = t1.Department
				ORDER BY CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),EventDateTime, 108)
				FOR XML PATH (''), TYPE
			).value('.', 'varchar(max)')
		, 1, 1, '')
		INTO #tMSTimesForUserAndBuilding
		FROM #TMSDetailsFinal As T1
		WHERE Department = @varBuildingName
		GROUP BY UserFK, Department

		DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #tMSTimesForUser0

		SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY UserFK ASC, ClockedTime ASC) AS RowNumber, * 
		INTO #tMSTimesForUser0
		FROM
		(SELECT DISTINCT 
		t1.TMSEmployeeClockedTimePK,
		t1.UserFK,
		ttct.Department AS BuildingName,
		ttct.ClockedTime,
		CAST(0 AS BIT) AS IsMissingClockTimes	
		FROM #TMSDetailsFinal T1
		INNER JOIN #TMSEmployeeClockedTimes ttct
		ON t1.TMSEmployeeClockedTimePK = ttct.TMSEmployeeClockedTimePK) subQ

		DECLARE @rowNumber INT, @userFK INT, @tMSBuildingName NVARCHAR(200), @previousRowNumber INT, @previousUserFK INT, @previousTMSBuildingName NVARCHAR(200)

		DECLARE @userTMSCursor AS CURSOR

		SET @userTMSCursor = CURSOR FAST_FORWARD FOR SELECT DISTINCT UserFK FROM #tMSTimesForUser0 ORDER BY 1 /*RowNumber*/ ASC 
 
		OPEN @userTMSCursor;

		FETCH NEXT FROM @userTMSCursor INTO @UserFK

		WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
		BEGIN		
			DECLARE @timesCursor AS CURSOR

			SET @timesCursor = CURSOR FAST_FORWARD FOR	SELECT DISTINCT 
															ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY RowNumber ASC) AS RowNumber, BuildingName 
														FROM 
															#tMSTimesForUser0 
														WHERE 
															UserFK = @UserFK
 
			OPEN @timesCursor;

			FETCH NEXT FROM @timesCursor INTO @RowNumber, @tMSBuildingName

			WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
			BEGIN		
				IF @previousTMSBuildingName <> @tMSBuildingName AND @rowNumber % 2 = 0 /*Even number*/
					UPDATE #tMSTimesForUser0 SET IsMissingClockTimes = 1 WHERE UserFK = @UserFK AND IsMissingClockTimes = 0

				SELECT @previousRowNumber = @rowNumber, @previousTMSBuildingName = @tMSBuildingName

				FETCH NEXT FROM @timesCursor INTO @RowNumber, @tMSBuildingName
			END

			CLOSE @timesCursor
			DEALLOCATE @timesCursor

			FETCH NEXT FROM @userTMSCursor INTO @UserFK
		END

		CLOSE @userTMSCursor
		DEALLOCATE @userTMSCursor

		DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #tMSTimesForUser

		SELECT UserFK, TMSTimesForUser = STUFF
		(
			(
				SELECT ' ' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),t2.ClockedTime, 108)
				FROM #tMSTimesForUser0 As T2
				WHERE t2.UserFK = t1.UserFK
				ORDER BY CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),t2.ClockedTime, 108)
				FOR XML PATH (''), TYPE
			).value('.', 'varchar(max)')
		, 1, 1, '')
		INTO #tMSTimesForUser
		FROM #tMSTimesForUser0 As T1
		GROUP BY UserFK

		DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #tMSTimesWithBuildingsForUser

		SELECT 
		t1.UserFK, AllTMSTimesWithBuildingsForUser = STUFF
		(
			(
				SELECT ' ' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),t2.ClockedTime, 108) + '(' + BuildingName + ')'
				FROM #tMSTimesForUser0 As T2
				WHERE t2.UserFK = t1.UserFK
				ORDER BY CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),t2.ClockedTime, 108)
				FOR XML PATH (''), TYPE
			).value('.', 'varchar(max)')
		, 1, 1, ''), t2.AbsenceCodes
		INTO #tMSTimesWithBuildingsForUser
		FROM #tMSTimesForUser0 As T1
		INNER JOIN #TMSDetailsFinal t2
		ON t1.UserFK = t2.UserFK
		GROUP BY t1.UserFK, t2.AbsenceCodes

		IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #TMSDetailsFinal) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #PalletAuditWorksOrderMovmentDetails)
		BEGIN
			INSERT INTO #TMSDetailsFinal
			SELECT DISTINCT
			-1 AS TMSEmployeeClockCardDetailPK, 
			-1 AS TMSEmployeeClockedTimePK,
			t1.DepartmentTMS as Department,
			t1.EmployeeNumber,
			t1.EmployeeName,	
			@varStartDate AS EventDateTime,
			t1.UserFK,	
			usr.InsertedDate AS UserInsertedDate,	
			'' AS [Shift],	
			0 AS ShiftDurationInMinutes,
			0 AS TimeWorkedMinutes,	
			0 AS IsBankHoliday,	
			0 AS OvertimeMinutes,
			'' AS AbsenceCodes,	
			'' AS ClockCardTimes,
			0 AS ShiftBreakTimesInMinutes,	
			0 AS ShiftDurationLessBreaksMinutes
			FROM #PalletAuditWorksOrderMovmentDetails t1
			LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.tblUsers usr
			ON t1.UserFK = usr.UserPK
		END

		DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #PalletAuditWorksOrderMovmentTMSDetails0

		select 
		CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(50)) as StockInOutNumber, 
		'TMS' as RecordType, 
		TMSEmployeeClockCardDetailPK AS PK, 
		'TMS' as Origin, 
		'TMS' as EventType, 
		NULL as PalletFK, 
		UserFK, 
		EmployeeName,	
		EmployeeNumber,
		EventDateTime, 
		'n/a' as FromLocationType, 
		'n/a' as ToLocationType,
		'n/a' AS MovementType,
		Department AS DepartmentTMS,
		-1 AS StockItemFK, 
		CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(50)) AS StockItemCode, 
		CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(200)) AS StockItemName, 
		-1 AS DivisionFK, 
		CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(50)) AS DivisionCode, 
		CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(200)) AS DivisionName, 
		-1 AS CustomerFK, 
		CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(50)) AS CustomerCode, 
		CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(200)) AS CustomerName,
		Department AS TMSMachineBuilding
		into #PalletAuditWorksOrderMovmentTMSDetails0
		from #TMSDetailsFinal

		union

		select *, 'n/a' AS TMSMachineBuilding from #PalletAuditWorksOrderMovmentDetails

		DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #PalletAuditWorksOrderMovmentTMSDetails1

		SELECT 
		ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY UserFK ASC, EventDateTime ASC) AS RowNumber,
		* 
		INTO #PalletAuditWorksOrderMovmentTMSDetails1 
		FROM #PalletAuditWorksOrderMovmentTMSDetails0 

		-- Delete this as no longer needed.
		DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #PalletAuditWorksOrderMovmentTMSDetails0

		DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #results

		-- This is required to ensure the temporary table is created as it may not be in the user loop below.
		SELECT TOP 1 
		RowNumber,
		StockInOutNumber, RecordType, PK, Origin, EventType, PalletFK, UserFK, EmployeeName, EmployeeNumber, EventDateTime, 		
		FromLocationType, ToLocationType, MovementType, TMSMachineBuilding,
		CAST(NULL AS DATETIME) AS OriginalStartDateTime,
		CAST(NULL AS DATETIME) AS StartDateTime,
		CAST(NULL AS DATETIME) AS EndDateTime,
		CAST(0 AS INT) AS OriginalDurationInSeconds,
		CAST(0 AS INT) AS DurationInSeconds,
		CAST(0 AS BIT ) AS OriginalDurationIsGreaterThanLimit,
		CAST(0 AS BIT) AS IsStartOfNewTask,
		StockItemFK,
		StockItemCode,
		StockItemName,
		DivisionFK,
		DivisionCode,
		DivisionName,
		CustomerFK,
		CustomerCode,
		CustomerName
		INTO #results 
		FROM #PalletAuditWorksOrderMovmentTMSDetails1

		TRUNCATE TABLE #results

		DECLARE @selectedUser INT, @rowNumber2 INT

	GET_USER_LOOP:

		SELECT TOP 1 @selectedUser = UserFK, @rowNumber2 = RowNumber FROM #PalletAuditWorksOrderMovmentTMSDetails1 ORDER BY RowNumber ASC

		IF @selectedUser IS NULL GOTO EXIT_GET_USER_LOOP

		DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #temp

		SELECT DISTINCT 
		ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY EventDateTime ASC) AS RowNumber,
		RowNumber AS RowNumber2,
		StockInOutNumber, RecordType, PK, Origin, EventType, PalletFK, UserFK, EmployeeName, EmployeeNumber, 
		EventDateTime,
		CAST(NULL AS DATETIME) AS OriginalStartDateTime,
		cast(NULL AS datetime) AS StartDateTime,
		EventDateTime AS EndDateTime,
		FromLocationType, ToLocationType, MovementType, TMSMachineBuilding, CAST(0 AS BIT ) AS OriginalDurationIsGreaterThanLimit,
		CAST(0 AS BIT) AS IsStartOfNewTask,
		StockItemFK,
		StockItemCode,
		StockItemName,
		DivisionFK,
		DivisionCode,
		DivisionName,
		CustomerFK,
		CustomerCode,
		CustomerName
		INTO #temp
		FROM #PalletAuditWorksOrderMovmentTMSDetails1 
		WHERE UserFK = @selectedUser

		UPDATE currentRec
		SET StartDateTime = CASE WHEN prevRec.RecordType <> 'TMS' AND currentRec.RecordType <> 'TMS' THEN prevRec.EndDateTime END
		from #temp currentRec
		INNER JOIN #temp prevRec
		ON prevRec.RowNumber = currentRec.RowNumber - 1

		UPDATE #temp
		SET StartDateTime = EndDateTime
		WHERE StartDateTime IS NULL

		UPDATE #temp
		SET OriginalStartDateTime = StartDateTime

		UPDATE #temp
		SET OriginalDurationIsGreaterThanLimit = 1
		WHERE datediff(second, StartDateTime, EndDateTime) > 600 /* 600 seconds, i.e. 10 minutes*/

		INSERT INTO #results
		SELECT
		RowNumber2 AS RowNumber,
		StockInOutNumber, RecordType, PK, Origin, EventType, PalletFK, UserFK, EmployeeName, EmployeeNumber, EventDateTime, 		
		FromLocationType, ToLocationType, MovementType, TMSMachineBuilding, OriginalStartDateTime, StartDateTime, EndDateTime, 
		CAST(ROUND(CAST(ISNULL(DATEDIFF(MILLISECOND, OriginalStartDateTime, EndDateTime), 0) AS DECIMAL(18,2)) / 1000.00, 0) AS INT) AS OriginalDurationInSeconds,
		CAST(ROUND(CAST(ISNULL(DATEDIFF(MILLISECOND, StartDateTime, EndDateTime), 0) AS DECIMAL(18,2)) / 1000.00, 0) AS INT) AS DurationInSeconds, 
		OriginalDurationIsGreaterThanLimit,
		IsStartOfNewTask,
		StockItemFK,
		StockItemCode,
		StockItemName,
		DivisionFK,
		DivisionCode,
		DivisionName,
		CustomerFK,
		CustomerCode,
		CustomerName
		FROM #temp

		DELETE FROM #PalletAuditWorksOrderMovmentTMSDetails1 WHERE UserFK = @selectedUser

		SET @selectedUser = NULL

		GOTO GET_USER_LOOP

	EXIT_GET_USER_LOOP:

		-- Delete this as no longer needed.
		DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #PalletAuditWorksOrderMovmentTMSDetails1

		DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #results2

		SELECT * INTO #results2 FROM #results

	GET_USER_LOOP2:

		SELECT TOP 1 @selectedUser = UserFK FROM #results2 ORDER BY RowNumber ASC

		IF @selectedUser IS NULL GOTO EXIT_GET_USER_LOOP2

		DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #temp2	

		SELECT DISTINCT 
		ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY EventDateTime ASC) AS RowNumber,
		RowNumber AS RowNumber2,
		StockInOutNumber,
		StartDateTime,
		EndDateTime,
		OriginalDurationIsGreaterThanLimit,
		IsStartOfNewTask,
		StockItemFK,
		StockItemCode,
		StockItemName,
		DivisionFK,
		DivisionCode,
		DivisionName,
		CustomerFK,
		CustomerCode,
		CustomerName
		INTO #temp2
		FROM #results2 
		WHERE UserFK = @selectedUser

		UPDATE currentRec
		SET StartDateTime = currentRec.EndDateTime,
		IsStartOfNewTask = 1
		FROM #temp2 currentRec
		INNER JOIN #temp2 prevRec
		ON prevRec.RowNumber = currentRec.RowNumber - 1
		WHERE currentRec.OriginalDurationIsGreaterThanLimit = 1	
		AND currentRec.StockInOutNumber <> prevRec.StockInOutNumber

		DELETE FROM #temp2 WHERE OriginalDurationIsGreaterThanLimit = 0

		DELETE FROM #temp2 WHERE StartDateTime <> EndDateTime

		UPDATE r1
		SET StartDateTime = r2.EndDateTime,
		DurationInSeconds = 0,
		IsStartOfNewTask = r2.IsStartOfNewTask
		FROM #results r1
		INNER JOIN #temp2 r2
		ON r1.RowNumber = r2.RowNumber2

		DELETE FROM #results2 WHERE UserFK = @selectedUser

		SET @selectedUser = NULL

		GOTO GET_USER_LOOP2

	EXIT_GET_USER_LOOP2:

		DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #employeeActivityDetails

		CREATE TABLE #employeeActivityDetails
		(
			StockInOutNumber NVARCHAR(50),	
			RecordType NVARCHAR(50),	
			PK INT,	
			Origin NVARCHAR(50),	
			EventType NVARCHAR(50),	
			PalletFK INT,	
			UserFK INT,	
			EmployeeName NVARCHAR(200),	
			EmployeeNumber NVARCHAR(50),
			EventDateTime DATETIME,	
			FromLocationType NVARCHAR(50),	
			ToLocationType NVARCHAR(50),
			MovementType NVARCHAR(50),	
			TMSMachineBuilding NVARCHAR(50),	
			OriginalStartDateTime DATETIME,	
			StartDateTime DATETIME,	
			EndDateTime	DATETIME,
			OriginalDurationInSeconds INT,
			DurationInSeconds INT,
			OriginalDurationIsGreaterThanLimit BIT,
			IsStartOfNewTask BIT,
			StockItemFK	INT,	
			DivisionFK INT,	
			CustomerFK INT,
			--[IsArchived] [bit] NOT NULL,
			--[InsertedBy] [int] NOT NULL,
			--[InsertedDate] [datetime] NOT NULL,
			--[UpdatedBy] [int] NOT NULL,
			--[UpdatedDate] [datetime] NOT NULL,
			DataForBuilding NVARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
			[JobTitle] NVARCHAR(200)
		)

		INSERT INTO #employeeActivityDetails
		SELECT DISTINCT
			r1.StockInOutNumber,	
			r1.RecordType,	
			r1.PK,	
			r1.Origin,	
			r1.EventType,	
			r1.PalletFK,	
			r1.UserFK,					
			CASE WHEN ISNULL(tms.EmployeeName, '') <> '' THEN tms.EmployeeName ELSE r1.EmployeeName END AS EmployeeName,
			r1.EmployeeNumber,
			r1.EventDateTime,	
			r1.FromLocationType,	
			r1.ToLocationType,
			r1.MovementType,	
			r1.TMSMachineBuilding,	
			r1.OriginalStartDateTime,	
			r1.StartDateTime,	
			r1.EndDateTime,
			r1.OriginalDurationInSeconds,
			r1.DurationInSeconds,
			r1.OriginalDurationIsGreaterThanLimit,
			r1.IsStartOfNewTask,
			r1.StockItemFK,	
			r1.DivisionFK,	
			r1.CustomerFK,
			--0/*IsArchived*/,
			--0/*InsertedBy*/,
			--dbo.GetBSTDate()/*InsertedDate*/,
			--0/*UpdatedBy*/,
			--dbo.GetBSTDate()/*UpdatedDate*/,
			@varBuildingName,
			PPL.JobTitle
		FROM 
			#results r1
		INNER JOIN dbo.tblUsers usr WITH (NOLOCK)
			ON r1.UserFK = usr.UserPK
		INNER JOIN dbo.tblPeople ppl WITH (NOLOCK)
			ON usr.PersonFK = ppl.PersonPK
		LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.tblTMSEmployeeClockCardDetails tms
			ON ppl.EmployeeNumber = CAST(tms.EmployeeNumber AS INT)
			AND CAST(tms.EmployeeNumber AS INT) > 0
		WHERE
			r1.EventDateTime <> @varStartDate -- ignore dummy records (search for "IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #TMSDetailsFinal) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #PalletAuditWorksOrderMovmentDetails)" above.
			AND
			(
				@varUserFK < 1
				OR
				(@varUserFK > 0 AND r1.UserFK = @varUserFK)
			)

		IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #employeeActivityDetails) GOTO END_EMPLOYEE_ACTIVITY_DETAILS_SECTION

		DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #employeeActivityDetailsScanning

		SELECT
			UserFK,
			ISNULL(Sum(ISNULL(DurationInSeconds,0)),0) AS TotalDurationInSeconds
		INTO
			#employeeActivityDetailsScanning
		FROM
			#employeeActivityDetails
		WHERE
			RecordType <> 'TMS'
		GROUP BY
			UserFK

		DELETE t1
		FROM #employeeActivityDetails t1
		INNER JOIN #employeeActivityDetailsScanning t2
		ON t1.UserFK = t2.UserFK
		WHERE
		(
			t1.JobTitle LIKE '%Admin%'
			OR t1.JobTitle LIKE '%Driver%'
			OR t1.JobTitle LIKE 'IT%'
			OR t1.JobTitle LIKE '%Mechanic%'
			OR t1.JobTitle LIKE '%Quality%'
			OR t1.JobTitle LIKE '%Manager%'
		)
		AND t2.TotalDurationInSeconds < 1

		IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #employeeActivityDetails) GOTO END_EMPLOYEE_ACTIVITY_DETAILS_SECTION

		DECLARE @varSQLCommand NVARCHAR(1000) = 'DELETE t1 FROM dbo.tblEmployeeActivityDetails t1 WHERE CAST(t1.EventDateTime AS DATE) = ''' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), @varStartDate, 23) + ''' AND t1.DataForBuilding = ''' + ISNULL(@varBuildingName,'')

		SET @varSQLCommand = @varSQLCommand + ''' AND (@varUserFK < 1 OR (@varUserFK > 0 AND t1.UserFK = @varUserFK /*@varUserFK=' + CAST(@varUserFK AS NVARCHAR(50)) + '*/));'

		INSERT INTO dbo.tblStoredProcedureLogging SELECT @varStoredProcedureName, @varSQLCommand + ' - started', dbo.GetBSTDate()

		DELETE t1
		FROM dbo.tblEmployeeActivityDetails t1
		WHERE CAST(t1.EventDateTime AS DATE) = @varStartDate
		AND t1.DataForBuilding = @varBuildingName
		AND
		(
			@varUserFK < 1 
			OR (@varUserFK > 0 AND t1.UserFK = @varUserFK)
		)

		SET @varRowCount = @@ROWCOUNT

		INSERT INTO dbo.tblStoredProcedureLogging SELECT @varStoredProcedureName, CAST(@varRowCount AS NVARCHAR(50)) + ' rows deleted from dbo.tblEmployeeActivityDetails', dbo.GetBSTDate()

		DECLARE @varCurrentDateTime DATETIME = dbo.GetBSTDate()

		INSERT INTO dbo.tblStoredProcedureLogging SELECT @varStoredProcedureName, 'INSERT INTO dbo.tblEmployeeActivityDetails - started', dbo.GetBSTDate()

		INSERT INTO dbo.tblEmployeeActivityDetails
		(
			StockInOutNumber,	
			RecordType,	
			PK,	
			Origin,	
			EventType,	
			PalletFK,	
			UserFK,	
			EmployeeName,	
			EmployeeNumber,
			EventDateTime,	
			FromLocationType,	
			ToLocationType,
			MovementType,	
			TMSMachineBuilding,	
			OriginalStartDateTime,	
			StartDateTime,	
			EndDateTime,
			OriginalDurationInSeconds,
			DurationInSeconds,
			OriginalDurationIsGreaterThanLimit,
			IsStartOfNewTask,
			StockItemFK,	
			DivisionFK,	
			CustomerFK,
			IsArchived,
			InsertedBy,
			InsertedDate,
			UpdatedBy,
			UpdatedDate,
			DataForBuilding
		)
		SELECT DISTINCT
			StockInOutNumber,	
			RecordType,	
			PK,	
			Origin,	
			EventType,	
			PalletFK,	
			UserFK,	
			EmployeeName,	
			EmployeeNumber,
			EventDateTime,	
			FromLocationType,	
			ToLocationType,
			MovementType,	
			TMSMachineBuilding,	
			OriginalStartDateTime,	
			StartDateTime,	
			EndDateTime,
			OriginalDurationInSeconds,
			DurationInSeconds,
			OriginalDurationIsGreaterThanLimit,
			IsStartOfNewTask,
			StockItemFK,	
			DivisionFK,	
			CustomerFK,
			--IsArchived,
			--InsertedBy,
			--InsertedDate,
			--UpdatedBy,
			--UpdatedDate,
			0/*IsArchived*/,
			0/*InsertedBy*/,
			@varCurrentDateTime/*InsertedDate*/,
			0/*UpdatedBy*/,
			@varCurrentDateTime/*UpdatedDate*/,
			DataForBuilding
		FROM
			#employeeActivityDetails

		SET @varRowCount = @@ROWCOUNT

		INSERT INTO dbo.tblStoredProcedureLogging SELECT @varStoredProcedureName, CAST(@varRowCount AS NVARCHAR(50)) + ' rows inserted into dbo.tblEmployeeActivityDetails', dbo.GetBSTDate()

		-- Delete the matching existing records in, and add the new records into, the StawmsReporting.dbo.tblEmployeeActivityDetails table. 

		SET @varSQLCommand = 'DECLARE @varUserFK INT = ' + CAST(@varUserFK AS NVARCHAR(50)) + '; ' + @varSQLCommand + ' EXEC dbo.spAddEmployeeActivityDetails ''' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(50), @varCurrentDateTime, 121) + ''';'

		INSERT INTO dbo.tblStoredProcedureLogging SELECT @varStoredProcedureName, 'EXEC sp_execute_remote N''StawmsReportingDataSource'',''' + @varSQLCommand + ''' - started', dbo.GetBSTDate()

		EXEC sp_execute_remote N'StawmsReportingDataSource', @varSQLCommand

		INSERT INTO dbo.tblStoredProcedureLogging SELECT @varStoredProcedureName, 'EXEC sp_execute_remote N''StawmsReportingDataSource'',''' + @varSQLCommand + ''' - completed', dbo.GetBSTDate()

END_EMPLOYEE_ACTIVITY_DETAILS_SECTION:

		DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #userMovementTypeDurations

		SELECT  
			UserFK,	
			Origin,
			MovementType,
			CAST(ROUND(SUM(ISNULL(DurationInSeconds, 0.00)) / 60.00,0) AS INT) AS DurationInMinutes
		INTO
			#userMovementTypeDurations
		FROM 
			#results
		WHERE
			Origin <> 'Pallet Movement'
			AND RecordType <> 'TMS'
		GROUP BY
			UserFK, Origin, MovementType

		DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #userMovementDurations

		SELECT  
			UserFK,	
			Origin,
			CAST(ROUND(SUM(ISNULL(DurationInSeconds, 0.00)) / 60.00,0) AS INT) AS DurationInMinutes
		INTO
			#userMovementDurations
		FROM 
			#results
		WHERE
			Origin = 'Pallet Movement'		
			AND RecordType <> 'TMS'
		GROUP BY
			UserFK, Origin

		DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #userMovementTypePallets

		SELECT t1.UserFK, t1.RecordType, t1.Origin, t1.MovementType, COUNT(t1.PalletFK) AS NoOfPalletMovements
		INTO #userMovementTypePallets
		FROM #results t1
		WHERE RecordType = 'PalletAudit'
		--and EventType <> 'Pallet Scanned'
		GROUP BY t1.UserFK, t1.RecordType, t1.Origin, t1.MovementType

		DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #userMovementPallets

		SELECT t1.UserFK, t1.RecordType, t1.Origin, COUNT(t1.PalletFK) AS NoOfPalletMovements
		INTO #userMovementPallets
		FROM #results t1
		WHERE RecordType = 'PalletAudit'
		AND Origin = 'Pallet Movement' 
		--AND EventType <> 'Pallet Scanned'
		GROUP BY t1.UserFK, t1.RecordType, t1.Origin

		DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #finalResults

		SELECT DISTINCT 

			ppl.JobTitle AS ActualJobTitle,

			CASE 
				WHEN ppl.JobTitle LIKE '%Supervisor%' THEN '1 - Supervisor'
				WHEN ppl.JobTitle LIKE '%Manager%' THEN '2 - Manager'
				WHEN ppl.JobTitle LIKE '%Stock%Controller%' THEN '3 - Stock Controller'
				WHEN ppl.JobTitle LIKE '%Team%Lead%' THEN '4 - Team Leader'
				WHEN ppl.JobTitle LIKE '%Operator%' THEN '5 - Operator'
				ELSE '6 - Other' 
			END AS JobTitleOrder,

			t0.TMSEmployeeClockCardDetailPK, 
			@varBuildingName as BuildingName,
			ISNULL(CAST(t0.EventDateTime AS DATE), @varStartDate) AS ClockCardDate,

			CASE
				WHEN CAST(t0.EmployeeNumber AS INT) > 1 THEN 
					t0.EmployeeName + '(' + CAST(t0.EmployeeNumber AS NVARCHAR(50)) + ')' 
				ELSE t0.EmployeeName + ' - Add no. in WMS'
			END AS EmployeeName, -- EmployeeName&No. column.
		
			CASE 	
				WHEN ppl.JobTitle LIKE '%manager%' THEN 'Mgr'		
				WHEN ppl.JobTitle LIKE '%supervisor%' THEN 'Sup'
				WHEN ppl.JobTitle LIKE '%stock%controller%' THEN 'SC'
				WHEN ppl.JobTitle LIKE '%team%lead%' THEN 'TL'
				WHEN ppl.JobTitle LIKE '%operator%' THEN 'Op'
				WHEN ppl.JobTitle LIKE '%shunter%' THEN 'Shntr'
				ELSE LEFT(ppl.JobTitle,5)
			END AS JobTitle, -- Role column.		
		
			CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(500)) AS IssueDescription,

			CASE 
				WHEN t2.TMSTimesForUserAndBuilding IS NOT NULL THEN
					LEN(t2.TMSTimesForUserAndBuilding) - LEN(REPLACE(t2.TMSTimesForUserAndBuilding, ':','')) 
				ELSE 0
			END AS NoOfTMSTimesForUserAndBuilding,

			CASE 
				WHEN t2.UserFK IS NULL OR (t2.UserFK IS NOT NULL AND (LEN(t2.TMSTimesForUserAndBuilding) - LEN(REPLACE(t2.TMSTimesForUserAndBuilding, ':',''))) % 2 <> 0) THEN
					1
				ELSE
					0
			END AS OddTMSClockTimes,

			CAST(
					(CASE 
						WHEN t1.[1stClockCardTime] IS NOT NULL AND t1.[LastClockCardTime] IS NOT NULL THEN
							RTRIM(t1.[1stClockCardTime] + ' ' + ISNULL(t1.LastClockCardTime,''))
						WHEN t1.[1stClockCardTime] IS NOT NULL AND t1.[LastClockCardTime] IS NULL THEN
							RTRIM(t1.[1stClockCardTime])
						ELSE
							''
					END) 
				AS NVARCHAR(500))
			 AS FirstAndLastTMSTimesForUserAndBuilding,

			ISNULL(t2.TMSTimesForUserAndBuilding,'') AS TMSTimesForUserAndBuilding,
			ISNULL(t3.TMSTimesForUser,'') AS TMSTimesForUser,

			CASE 
				WHEN t2.TMSTimesForUserAndBuilding IS NOT NULL AND t3.TMSTimesForUser IS NOT NULL AND t2.TMSTimesForUserAndBuilding = t3.TMSTimesForUser THEN 
					1 
				ELSE 
					0 
			END AS AllTMSTimesForSelectedBuilding,

			CAST(
					(CASE 
						WHEN ISNULL(t0.AbsenceCodes, '') <> '' AND ISNULL(t4.AllTMSTimesWithBuildingsForUser,'') <> '' THEN 
							ISNULL(t4.AllTMSTimesWithBuildingsForUser,'') + '. Code(s): ' + t4.AbsenceCodes
						WHEN ISNULL(t0.AbsenceCodes, '') <> '' AND ISNULL(t4.AllTMSTimesWithBuildingsForUser,'') = '' THEN
							'Code(s): ' + t4.AbsenceCodes
						ELSE 
							ISNULL(t4.AllTMSTimesWithBuildingsForUser,'') 
					END)
				AS NVARCHAR(500))
			AS AllTMSTimesWithBuildingsForUser,

			t0.[Shift],
			CAST(0 AS BIT) AS TimeWorkedCalculated,
			t0.TimeWorkedMinutes, 
			t0.ShiftDurationLessBreaksMinutes,

			ISNULL(stockInUnloadedDurations.DurationInMinutes, 0) + ISNULL(stockInMovementDurations.DurationInMinutes, 0) 
				+ ISNULL(stockInPutAwayDurations.DurationInMinutes, 0) AS StockInMinutes,

			ISNULL(stockOutPickedDurations.DurationInMinutes, 0) + ISNULL(stockOutMovementDurations.DurationInMinutes, 0) 
				+ ISNULL(stockOutLoadedDurations.DurationInMinutes, 0) AS StockOutMinutes,

			ISNULL(movementDurations.DurationInMinutes, 0) AS MovementMinutes,

			ISNULL(stockInUnloadedDurations.DurationInMinutes, 0) + ISNULL(stockInMovementDurations.DurationInMinutes, 0) + ISNULL(stockInPutAwayDurations.DurationInMinutes, 0)
				+ ISNULL(stockOutPickedDurations.DurationInMinutes, 0) + ISNULL(stockOutMovementDurations.DurationInMinutes, 0) + ISNULL(stockOutLoadedDurations.DurationInMinutes, 0)
					+ ISNULL(movementDurations.DurationInMinutes, 0) AS AllScannedMinutes,

			t0.OvertimeMinutes,
			t0.IsBankHoliday,
			t0.ShiftBreakTimesInMinutes,
			t0.AbsenceCodes,
			t0.UserFK,
			t0.ClockCardTimes,

			-- Stock in durations

			ISNULL(stockInUnloadedDurations.DurationInMinutes, 0) AS StockInUnloadedDurationInMinutes,
			ISNULL(stockInMovementDurations.DurationInMinutes, 0) AS StockInMovementDurationInMinutes,
			ISNULL(stockInPutAwayDurations.DurationInMinutes, 0) AS StockInPutAwayDurationInMinutes,

			-- Stock out durations

			ISNULL(stockOutPickedDurations.DurationInMinutes, 0) AS StockOutPickedDurationInMinutes,
			ISNULL(stockOutMovementDurations.DurationInMinutes, 0) AS StockOutMovementDurationInMinutes,
			ISNULL(stockOutLoadedDurations.DurationInMinutes, 0) AS StockOutLoadedDurationInMinutes,

			-- Stock in pallets

			ISNULL(stockInUnloadedPallets.NoOfPalletMovements, 0) AS StockInUnloadedNoOfPalletMovements,
			ISNULL(stockInMovementPallets.NoOfPalletMovements, 0) AS StockInMovementNoOfPalletMovements,
			ISNULL(stockInPutAwayPallets.NoOfPalletMovements, 0) AS StockInPutAwayNoOfPalletMovements,

			ISNULL(stockInUnloadedPallets.NoOfPalletMovements, 0) + ISNULL(stockInMovementPallets.NoOfPalletMovements, 0) 
				+ ISNULL(stockInPutAwayPallets.NoOfPalletMovements, 0) AS StockInNoOfPalletMovements,
			
			-- Stock out pallets

			ISNULL(stockOutPickedPallets.NoOfPalletMovements, 0) AS StockOutPickedNoOfPalletMovements,
			ISNULL(stockOutMovementPallets.NoOfPalletMovements, 0) AS StockOutMovementNoOfPalletMovements,
			ISNULL(stockOutLoadedPallets.NoOfPalletMovements, 0) AS StockOutLoadedNoOfPalletMovements,

			ISNULL(stockOutPickedPallets.NoOfPalletMovements, 0) + ISNULL(stockOutMovementPallets.NoOfPalletMovements, 0)
				+ ISNULL(stockOutLoadedPallets.NoOfPalletMovements, 0) AS StockOutNoOfPalletMovements,

			ISNULL(movementPallets.NoOfPalletMovements, 0) AS MovementNoOfPalletMovements
		INTO	
			#finalResults
		FROM 
			#TMSDetailsFinal t0
		LEFT OUTER JOIN #tMSFirstAndLastClockCardTimes t1
			ON t0.TMSEmployeeClockCardDetailPK = t1.TMSEmployeeClockCardDetailPK
			AND t1.BuildingName = @varBuildingName
		LEFT OUTER JOIN #tMSTimesForUserAndBuilding t2
			ON t0.UserFK = t2.UserFK
			AND t2.BuildingName = @varBuildingName
		LEFT OUTER JOIN #tMSTimesForUser t3
			ON t0.UserFK = t3.UserFK
		LEFT OUTER JOIN #tMSTimesWithBuildingsForUser t4
			ON t0.UserFK = t4.UserFK	
		
		LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.tblUsers usr
			ON t0.UserFK = usr.UserPK
		LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.tblPeople ppl
			ON usr.PersonFK = PPL.PersonPK

		-- Stock In durations

		LEFT OUTER JOIN #userMovementTypeDurations stockInUnloadedDurations
			ON t0.UserFK = stockInUnloadedDurations.UserFK
			AND stockInUnloadedDurations.Origin = 'StockIn'
			AND stockInUnloadedDurations.MovementType = 'Unloaded'

		LEFT OUTER JOIN #userMovementTypeDurations stockInMovementDurations
			ON t0.UserFK = stockInMovementDurations.UserFK
			AND stockInMovementDurations.Origin = 'StockIn'
			AND stockInMovementDurations.MovementType = 'Movement'

		LEFT OUTER JOIN #userMovementTypeDurations stockInPutAwayDurations
			ON t0.UserFK = stockInPutAwayDurations.UserFK
			AND stockInPutAwayDurations.Origin = 'StockIn'
			AND stockInPutAwayDurations.MovementType = 'PutAway'

		-- Stock in pallets

		LEFT OUTER JOIN #userMovementTypePallets stockInUnloadedPallets
			ON t0.UserFK = stockInUnloadedPallets.UserFK
			AND stockInUnloadedPallets.Origin = 'StockIn'
			AND stockInUnloadedPallets.MovementType = 'Unloaded'

		LEFT OUTER JOIN #userMovementTypePallets stockInMovementPallets
			ON t0.UserFK = stockInMovementPallets.UserFK
			AND stockInMovementPallets.Origin = 'StockIn'
			AND stockInMovementPallets.MovementType = 'Movement'

		LEFT OUTER JOIN #userMovementTypePallets stockInPutAwayPallets
			ON t0.UserFK = stockInPutAwayPallets.UserFK
			AND stockInPutAwayPallets.Origin = 'StockIn'
			AND stockInPutAwayPallets.MovementType = 'PutAway'

		-- Stock Out durations

		LEFT OUTER JOIN #userMovementTypeDurations stockOutPickedDurations
			ON t0.UserFK = stockOutPickedDurations.UserFK
			AND stockOutPickedDurations.Origin = 'StockOut'
			AND stockOutPickedDurations.MovementType = 'Picked'

		LEFT OUTER JOIN #userMovementTypeDurations stockOutMovementDurations
			ON t0.UserFK = stockOutMovementDurations.UserFK
			AND stockOutMovementDurations.Origin = 'StockOut'
			AND stockOutMovementDurations.MovementType = 'Movement'

		LEFT OUTER JOIN #userMovementTypeDurations stockOutLoadedDurations
			ON t0.UserFK = stockOutLoadedDurations.UserFK
			AND stockOutLoadedDurations.Origin = 'StockOut'
			AND stockOutLoadedDurations.MovementType = 'Loaded'

		-- Stock Out pallets

		LEFT OUTER JOIN #userMovementTypePallets stockOutPickedPallets
			ON t0.UserFK = stockOutPickedPallets.UserFK
			AND stockOutPickedPallets.Origin = 'StockOut'
			AND stockOutPickedPallets.MovementType = 'Picked'

		LEFT OUTER JOIN #userMovementTypePallets stockOutMovementPallets
			ON t0.UserFK = stockOutMovementPallets.UserFK
			AND stockOutMovementPallets.Origin = 'StockOut'
			AND stockOutMovementPallets.MovementType = 'Movement'

		LEFT OUTER JOIN #userMovementTypePallets stockOutLoadedPallets
			ON t0.UserFK = stockOutLoadedPallets.UserFK
			AND stockOutLoadedPallets.Origin = 'StockOut'
			AND stockOutLoadedPallets.MovementType = 'Loaded'

		-- Movement durations

		LEFT OUTER JOIN #userMovementDurations movementDurations
			ON t0.UserFK = movementDurations.UserFK

		-- Movement pallets

		LEFT OUTER JOIN #userMovementPallets movementPallets
			ON t0.UserFK = movementPallets.UserFK
		--WHERE
		--	ppl.JobTitle NOT LIKE '%Admin%'
		--	AND ppl.JobTitle NOT LIKE '%Driver%'
		--	AND ppl.JobTitle NOT LIKE 'IT%'
		--	AND ppl.JobTitle NOT LIKE '%Mechanic%'
		--	AND ppl.JobTitle NOT LIKE '%Quality%'
		--	AND ppl.JobTitle NOT LIKE '%Manager%'

		-- Remove employees with particular job titles from the results, but only if they have no scanning time.
		DELETE FROM #finalResults 
		WHERE 
		(
			ActualJobTitle LIKE '%Admin%'
			OR ActualJobTitle LIKE '%Driver%'
			OR ActualJobTitle LIKE 'IT%'
			OR ActualJobTitle LIKE '%Mechanic%'
			OR ActualJobTitle LIKE '%Quality%'
			OR ActualJobTitle LIKE '%Manager%'
		)
		AND ISNULL(AllScannedMinutes, 0) < 1

		DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #TMSTimesForUserAndBuilding2

		SELECT 
		ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY UserFK ASC) AS EmployeeRecordNumber,
		UserFK, EmployeeName, TMSTimesForUserAndBuilding, CAST(0 AS INT) AS DurationInMinutes
		INTO #TMSTimesForUserAndBuilding2
		FROM #finalResults
		WHERE OddTMSClockTimes = 0

		DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #TMSTimesForUserAndBuilding3

		SELECT DISTINCT 
		ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY EmployeeRecordNumber ASC) AS RowNumber,
		t1.EmployeeRecordNumber, 
		t1.UserFK,
		t1.EmployeeName,
		CAST(t2.[Name] AS TIME(5)) AS ClockedTime,
		CAST(0 AS INT) AS DurationInMinutes
		INTO #TMSTimesForUserAndBuilding3
		FROM #TMSTimesForUserAndBuilding2 t1
		CROSS APPLY dbo.SplitStringByChar(t1.TMSTimesForUserAndBuilding, ' ') t2

		DECLARE @varRowNumber INT = 1, @varClockInTime TIME(5), @varClockOutTime TIME(5), @varMaxRowNumber INT

		SELECT @varMaxRowNumber = MAX(RowNumber) FROM #TMSTimesForUserAndBuilding3

		IF ISNULL(@varMaxRowNumber, 0) < 1 GOTO EXIT_CLOCK_TIMES_LOOP

	START_CLOCK_TIMES_LOOP:

		SELECT 
			@varClockInTime =	CASE 
									WHEN (RowNumber % 2) = 1 THEN 
										 ClockedTime 
									ELSE
										@varClockInTime
								END,

			@varClockOutTime =	CASE 
									WHEN (RowNumber % 2) = 0 THEN 
											ClockedTime 
									ELSE
										@varClockOutTime
								END					
		FROM 
			#TMSTimesForUserAndBuilding3 
		WHERE 
			RowNumber = @varRowNumber

		IF @varClockOutTime IS NULL
		BEGIN
			SET @varRowNumber = @varRowNumber + 1
			GOTO START_CLOCK_TIMES_LOOP
		END

	EXIT_CLOCK_TIMES_LOOP:

		UPDATE #TMSTimesForUserAndBuilding3
		SET DurationInMinutes = DATEDIFF(MINUTE, @varClockInTime, @varClockOutTime)
		WHERE RowNumber = @varRowNumber

		IF (@varRowNumber + 1) <= @varMaxRowNumber
		BEGIN
			SET @varClockInTime = NULL
			SET @varClockOutTime = NULL
			SET @varRowNumber = @varRowNumber + 1
			GOTO START_CLOCK_TIMES_LOOP
		END

		DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #TMSTimesForUserAndBuildingTotals

		SELECT EmployeeRecordNumber, SUM(DurationInMinutes) AS DurationInMinutes
		INTO #TMSTimesForUserAndBuildingTotals
		FROM #TMSTimesForUserAndBuilding3
		GROUP BY EmployeeRecordNumber

		UPDATE t1
		SET t1.DurationInMinutes = T2.DurationInMinutes
		FROM #TMSTimesForUserAndBuilding2 t1
		INNER JOIN #TMSTimesForUserAndBuildingTotals t2
		ON t1.EmployeeRecordNumber = t2.EmployeeRecordNumber

		UPDATE t1
		SET TimeWorkedMinutes = t2.DurationInMinutes
		FROM #finalResults t1
		INNER JOIN #TMSTimesForUserAndBuilding2 t2
		ON t1.UserFK = t2.UserFK

		DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #multipleEvenUserBuildingClockRecords

		SELECT DISTINCT 
	
		ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY fr.UserFK ASC, ttct.TMSEmployeeClockedTimePK ASC) AS RowNumber,	
		fr.UserFK, ttct.TMSEmployeeClockedTimePK, ttct.TMSEmployeeClockCardDetailFK, LEFT(ttct.ClockedTime, 5) as ClockedTime, ttct.Department
		INTO #multipleEvenUserBuildingClockRecords
		FROM #TMSEmployeeClockedTimes ttct
		INNER JOIN #finalResults fr
		ON ttct.TMSEmployeeClockCardDetailFK = fr.TMSEmployeeClockCardDetailPK
		WHERE ttct.Department = @varBuildingName
		AND fr.TimeWorkedMinutes < 1 
		AND fr.TimeWorkedCalculated = 0 
		AND fr.NoOfTMSTimesForUserAndBuilding > 0 
		AND fr.NoOfTMSTimesForUserAndBuilding % 2 = 0

		SELECT @rowNumber = NULL, @userFK = NULL, @previousUserFK = NULL

		DECLARE @ClockedTime NVARCHAR(5), @previousClockedTime NVARCHAR(5), @userTimeWorkedInBuildingMinutes INT = 0, @times NVARCHAR(200), @MaxRowNumber INT

		SELECT @MaxRowNumber = MAX(RowNumber) FROM #multipleEvenUserBuildingClockRecords

		DECLARE @userTMSTimesCursor AS CURSOR

		SET @userTMSTimesCursor = CURSOR FAST_FORWARD FOR SELECT DISTINCT RowNumber, UserFK, ClockedTime FROM #multipleEvenUserBuildingClockRecords ORDER BY RowNumber ASC 

		OPEN @userTMSTimesCursor;

		FETCH NEXT FROM @userTMSTimesCursor INTO @RowNumber, @UserFK, @ClockedTime

		WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
		BEGIN		
			IF ISNULL(@times, '') = ''
				SET @times = @ClockedTime
			ELSE
				SET @times = @times + ' ' + @ClockedTime		

			IF @previousUserFK = @UserFK AND @rowNumber > 1 AND @rowNumber % 2 = 0 /*Even number*/
			BEGIN	
				SELECT @userTimeWorkedInBuildingMinutes = isnull(@userTimeWorkedInBuildingMinutes,0) 
					+ [dbo].[fnGetDurationInMinutesBetweenTMSShiftStartAndEndTimes](REPLACE(REPLACE(@times, ':',''), ' ', '-'))

				SET @times = ''
			END
		
			IF (@previousUserFK IS NOT NULL AND @previousUserFK <> @UserFK) OR @rowNumber = @maxRowNumber
			BEGIN
				UPDATE #finalResults 
				SET TimeWorkedMinutes = @userTimeWorkedInBuildingMinutes, TimeWorkedCalculated = 1 
				WHERE UserFK = @previousUserFK

				SET @userTimeWorkedInBuildingMinutes = 0
			END

			SELECT @previousUserFK = @UserFK

			FETCH NEXT FROM @userTMSTimesCursor INTO @RowNumber, @UserFK, @ClockedTime
		END

		CLOSE @userTMSTimesCursor
		DEALLOCATE @userTMSTimesCursor

		UPDATE #finalResults
		SET TimeWorkedMinutes = CASE WHEN TimeWorkedMinutes > 0 THEN TimeWorkedMinutes - ShiftBreakTimesInMinutes ELSE ISNULL(TimeWorkedMinutes,0) END
		WHERE AllTMSTimesForSelectedBuilding = 1
		AND OddTMSClockTimes = 0
		AND TimeWorkedCalculated = 1

		UPDATE fr
		SET IssueDescription = 'Clock in/out time(s) missing for building(s).'
		FROM #finalResults fr
		WHERE fr.OddTMSClockTimes = 1
		OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #tMSTimesForUser0 ttfu WHERE ttfu.UserFK = fr.UserFK AND ttfu.IsMissingClockTimes = 1)

		/*04 Feb 2020 Cathal OCuirrin*/
		UPDATE #finalResults
		SET IssueDescription = 'All Scanned time greater than the time worked.'
		WHERE TimeWorkedMinutes < AllScannedMinutes
		AND ISNULL(IssueDescription, '') = ''

		DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #totals

		SELECT 	
			ClockCardDate,

			-- ** ADD IN PARENT PROC spLoadEmployeeScannedPalletMovementDetails **
			/*SUM(TimeWorkedMinutes)*/ 0 AS TotalTimeWorkedMinutes,

			SUM(OvertimeMinutes) AS TotalOvertimeMinutes,

			-- ** ADD IN PARENT PROC spLoadEmployeeScannedPalletMovementDetails **
			/*SUM(ShiftDurationLessBreaksMinutes)*/ 0 AS TotalShiftDurationLessBreaksMinutes,

			SUM(StockInMinutes) AS TotalStockInMinutes,
			SUM(StockOutMinutes) AS TotalStockOutMinutes,
			SUM(MovementMinutes) AS TotalMovementMinutes,
			SUM(StockInMinutes) + SUM(StockOutMinutes) + SUM(MovementMinutes) AS TotalAllScannedMinutes,

			SUM(StockInUnloadedDurationInMinutes) AS TotalStockInUnloadedDurationInMinutes,
			SUM(StockInMovementDurationInMinutes) AS TotalStockInMovementDurationInMinutes,
			SUM(StockInPutAwayDurationInMinutes) AS TotalStockInPutAwayDurationInMinutes,

			SUM(StockOutPickedDurationInMinutes) AS TotalStockOutPickedDurationInMinutes,
			SUM(StockOutMovementDurationInMinutes) AS TotalStockOutMovementDurationInMinutes,
			SUM(StockOutLoadedDurationInMinutes) AS TotalStockOutLoadedDurationInMinutes,

			SUM(StockInUnloadedNoOfPalletMovements) AS TotalStockInUnloadedNoOfPalletMovements,
			SUM(StockInMovementNoOfPalletMovements) AS TotalStockInMovementNoOfPalletMovements,
			SUM(StockInPutAwayNoOfPalletMovements) AS TotalStockInPutAwayNoOfPalletMovements,
			SUM(StockInNoOfPalletMovements) AS TotalStockInNoOfPalletMovements,
			
			SUM(StockOutPickedNoOfPalletMovements) AS TotalStockOutPickedNoOfPalletMovements,
			SUM(StockOutMovementNoOfPalletMovements) AS TotalStockOutMovementNoOfPalletMovements,
			SUM(StockOutLoadedNoOfPalletMovements) AS TotalStockOutLoadedNoOfPalletMovements,
			SUM(StockOutNoOfPalletMovements) AS TotalStockOutNoOfPalletMovements,

			SUM(MovementNoOfPalletMovements) AS TotalMovementNoOfPalletMovements
		INTO 
			#totals
		FROM 
			#finalResults
		GROUP BY 
			ClockCardDate

		UPDATE #finalResults
		SET FirstAndLastTMSTimesForUserAndBuilding = 'Hover mouse for information'
		WHERE ISNULL(IssueDescription, '') <> ''

		UPDATE #finalResults
		SET AllTMSTimesWithBuildingsForUser = REPLACE(AllTMSTimesWithBuildingsForUser, 'NEX', 'Northern Extension')
		WHERE AllTMSTimesWithBuildingsForUser LIKE '%NEX%'

		SELECT DISTINCT		
			fr3.BuildingName AS DataForBuilding,
			fr3.JobTitleOrder,	
			fr3.TMSEmployeeClockCardDetailPK AS TMSEmployeeClockCardDetailFK,					
			fr3.ClockCardDate,
			fr3.EmployeeName,
			fr3.JobTitle,
			fr3.FirstAndLastTMSTimesForUserAndBuilding,
			fr3.TMSTimesForUserAndBuilding,
			fr3.[Shift], 
			fr3.TimeWorkedMinutes, 
			fr3.ShiftDurationLessBreaksMinutes,
			fr3.StockInMinutes,
			fr3.StockOutMinutes,
			fr3.MovementMinutes,
			fr3.AllScannedMinutes,
			fr3.OddTMSClockTimes,
			fr3.OvertimeMinutes,
			fr3.IsBankHoliday,
			tot.TotalTimeWorkedMinutes,
			tot.TotalOvertimeMinutes,	
			tot.TotalShiftDurationLessBreaksMinutes,
			tot.TotalStockInMinutes,
			tot.TotalStockOutMinutes,
			tot.TotalMovementMinutes,
			tot.TotalAllScannedMinutes,

			fr3.TimeWorkedCalculated,
			fr3.ShiftBreakTimesInMinutes,
			fr3.AbsenceCodes,
			fr3.UserFK,			
			fr3.IssueDescription, 
			fr3.AllTMSTimesForSelectedBuilding,		 		 		 
			fr3.AllTMSTimesWithBuildingsForUser,
			fr3.NoOfTMSTimesForUserAndBuilding,	
			REPLACE(fr3.ClockCardTimes, '  ', ' ') AS ClockCardTimes,

			0 /*bit*/ AS IsArchived,
			0 /*int*/ AS InsertedBy,
			dbo.GetBSTDate() AS InsertedDate,
			0 /*int*/ AS UpdatedBy,
			dbo.GetBSTDate() AS UpdatedDate,

			fr3.StockInUnloadedDurationInMinutes,
			fr3.StockInMovementDurationInMinutes,
			fr3.StockInPutAwayDurationInMinutes,

			fr3.StockOutPickedDurationInMinutes,
			fr3.StockOutMovementDurationInMinutes,
			fr3.StockOutLoadedDurationInMinutes,

			fr3.StockInUnloadedNoOfPalletMovements,
			fr3.StockInMovementNoOfPalletMovements,
			fr3.StockInPutAwayNoOfPalletMovements,
			fr3.StockInNoOfPalletMovements,
			
			fr3.StockOutPickedNoOfPalletMovements,
			fr3.StockOutMovementNoOfPalletMovements,
			fr3.StockOutLoadedNoOfPalletMovements,
			fr3.StockOutNoOfPalletMovements,

			fr3.MovementNoOfPalletMovements,

			tot.TotalStockInUnloadedDurationInMinutes,
			tot.TotalStockInMovementDurationInMinutes,
			tot.TotalStockInPutAwayDurationInMinutes,

			tot.TotalStockOutPickedDurationInMinutes,
			tot.TotalStockOutMovementDurationInMinutes,
			tot.TotalStockOutLoadedDurationInMinutes,

			tot.TotalStockInUnloadedNoOfPalletMovements,
			tot.TotalStockInMovementNoOfPalletMovements,
			tot.TotalStockInPutAwayNoOfPalletMovements,
			tot.TotalStockInNoOfPalletMovements,
			
			tot.TotalStockOutPickedNoOfPalletMovements,
			tot.TotalStockOutMovementNoOfPalletMovements,
			tot.TotalStockOutLoadedNoOfPalletMovements,
			tot.TotalStockOutNoOfPalletMovements,

			tot.TotalMovementNoOfPalletMovements
		FROM 
			#finalResults fr3
		LEFT OUTER JOIN #TMSEmployeeClockCardDetails t1
			ON fr3.TMSEmployeeClockCardDetailPK = t1.TMSEmployeeClockCardDetailPK
		LEFT OUTER JOIN #totals tot
			ON fr3.ClockCardDate = tot.ClockCardDate
		WHERE
			@varUserFK < 1
			OR
			(@varUserFK > 0 AND fr3.UserFK = @varUserFK)

		INSERT INTO dbo.tblStoredProcedureLogging SELECT @varStoredProcedureName, 'Proc execution completed', dbo.GetBSTDate()
	END TRY
	BEGIN CATCH
		SELECT @varErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE(), @varErrorSeverity = ERROR_SEVERITY(), @varErrorState = ERROR_STATE()

		INSERT INTO dbo.tblStoredProcedureLogging SELECT @varStoredProcedureName, 'ERROR MESSAGE - ' + @varErrorMessage, dbo.GetBSTDate()

		RAISERROR (@varErrorMessage,@varErrorSeverity,@varErrorState)
	END CATCH
END

-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spLpContacts]
(
	@contactTypeFK int = null,
	@FK int = null
)	
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT
 ,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;
	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	DECLARE @var_contactTypeFK int, @var_FK int

	SET @var_contactTypeFK = @contactTypeFK; SET @var_FK = @FK

	SET @ParameterDetails = '@contactTypeFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_contactTypeFK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@FK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_FK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'')

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    --BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

		SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END


	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY
			

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start
			print 'contact type'
			print @var_contactTypeFK

			if @var_contactTypeFK is not null 
			begin
				if(@var_contactTypeFK = 1) 
				BEGIN
					SELECT ContactPK AS PK, '/images/contact.png' AS ImagePath, IsArchived, 0 AS IsFiltered, ContactName, EmailAddress1 EmailAddress
					FROM         dbo.tblContacts
					where (ContactTypeFK = 1
					and
					FK = @var_FK)
					OR
					(ContactTypeFK = 2/*Division*/ AND FK in (Select DivisionPK from tblDivisions Where CustomerFK = @var_FK))
				END ELSE IF (@var_contactTypeFK = 2) 
				BEGIN
					SELECT ContactPK AS PK, '/images/contact.png' AS ImagePath, IsArchived, 0 AS IsFiltered, ContactName, EmailAddress1 EmailAddress
					FROM         dbo.tblContacts
					where (ContactTypeFK in (1,2)
					and
					FK = (Select CustomerFK from tblDivisions where DivisionPK = @var_FK))
					OR
					(ContactTypeFK  in (1,2)/*Division*/ AND FK in (Select DivisionPK from tblDivisions 
					Where CustomerFK = (Select CustomerFK from tblDivisions where DivisionPK = @var_FK)))
				END ELSE IF (@var_contactTypeFK = 4) 
				BEGIN
					SELECT ContactPK AS PK, '/images/contact.png' AS ImagePath, IsArchived, 0 AS IsFiltered, ContactName, EmailAddress1 EmailAddress
					FROM         dbo.tblContacts
					where ContactTypeFK = 4
					and
					FK = (Select SupplierPK from tblSuppliers where SupplierPK = @var_FK)
				END ELSE IF (@var_contactTypeFK = 5) 
				BEGIN
					SELECT ContactPK AS PK, '/images/contact.png' AS ImagePath, IsArchived, 0 AS IsFiltered, ContactName, EmailAddress1 EmailAddress
					FROM         dbo.tblContacts
					where ContactTypeFK = 5
					and
					FK = (Select TransportCompanyPK from tblTransportCompanies where TransportCompanyPK = @var_FK)
				END ELSE IF (@var_contactTypeFK = 6) 
				BEGIN
					SELECT ContactPK AS PK, '/images/contact.png' AS ImagePath, IsArchived, 0 AS IsFiltered, ContactName, EmailAddress1 EmailAddress
					FROM         dbo.tblContacts
					where ContactTypeFK = 6
					and
					FK = (Select ShippingCompanyPK from tblShippingCompanies where ShippingCompanyPK = @var_FK)
				END
			end 
			else 
			begin
				SELECT ContactPK AS PK, '/images/contact.png' AS ImagePath, IsArchived, 0 AS IsFiltered, ContactName FROM dbo.tblContacts
			end

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end

			
			
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END
GO

-- Author:		<Author,,Name>

--			#DEV-910 Exclude Archived Bays, Columns Rows
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spLpEmptyDriveThroughColumns]
(
	@BuildingUnitFK int
)	
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT
 ,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;
	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	DECLARE @BuildingUnitFK2 int

	SET @BuildingUnitFK2 = @BuildingUnitFK;

	SET @ParameterDetails = '@BuildingUnitFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@BuildingUnitFK2 AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') 

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    --BEGIN
			SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

			SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)

			INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
			SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

			SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END


	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY
			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start

			--SELECT BuildingUnitBayLocation [Location], count(palletpk) palletCount
			--FROM viewBuildingUnitBays vbub 
			--LEFT JOIN tblpallets p ON vbub.BuildingUnitBayPK = p.LocationFK AND p.LocationTypeFK = 1 AND p.IsArchived = 0
			--WHERE vbub.buildingunitfk = @BuildingUnitFK2
			--	AND vbub.locationtypefk = 1 
			--group by BuildingUnitBayLocation
			--having count(palletpk) < 1
			--ORDER BY cast(vbub.BuildingUnitBayLocation AS int)

			SELECT BuildingUnitBayLocation [Location], count(palletpk) palletCount, vbub.Row, vbub.ColumnNo
			FROM viewBuildingUnitBays vbub 
			LEFT JOIN tblpallets p ON vbub.BuildingUnitBayPK = p.LocationFK AND p.LocationTypeFK = 1 AND p.IsArchived = 0
			WHERE vbub.buildingunitfk = @BuildingUnitFK2
				AND vbub.locationtypefk = 1 
				AND vbub.IsArchived = 0
			group by BuildingUnitBayLocation,vbub.Row, vbub.ColumnNo
			having count(palletpk) < 1
			ORDER BY vbub.Row, vbub.ColumnNo 

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END
GO

	@worksOrderPalletPK int
)	
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT
 ,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;

			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
