-- =============================================  
-- Author:  <Author,,Name>  
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>  
-- Description: <Description,,>  
-- =============================================  
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spLpPalletsByStockCodeBatch]  
(  
	@stockItemFK int,  
	@batch nvarchar(200),  
	@containerOutFK int = -1,  
	--@anyStatus bit = 1  
	@DeliveryAddressFK int = -1,
	@IncludeAlreadySelectedQuantities bit = 1
)	
AS
BEGIN 
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT
 ,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;
	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	DECLARE @var_stockItemFK int, @var_batch nvarchar(200), @var_containerOutFK int,/* @var_anyStatus bit*/ @var_DeliveryAddressFK int, @var_StockOrderFk int, @var_IncludeAlreadySelectedQuantities bit

	SET @var_stockItemFK = @stockItemFK; SET @var_batch = @batch; SET @var_containerOutFK = @containerOutFK; /*SET @var_anyStatus = @anyStatus*/ set @var_DeliveryAddressFK = @DeliveryAddressFK;
	SET @var_IncludeAlreadySelectedQuantities = @IncludeAlreadySelectedQuantities

	SET @ParameterDetails = '@stockItemFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_stockItemFK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + '@batch = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_batch AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') 
		+ '@containerOutFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_containerOutFK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') --+ '@anyStatus = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_anyStatus AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'')
		+ '@@DeliveryAddressFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_DeliveryAddressFK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'')

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

   --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    --BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

		SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END


	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY
			

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start  

			Declare @sql nvarchar(4000)  
			Declare @sql2 nvarchar(4000)  
			Declare @fullsql nvarchar(max)  
			 Declare @eachesUnitTypeFK int  
			 Declare @unitType nvarchar(200)  
			 Declare @eachUnitType nvarchar(200)  
			 Declare @UnitsEachesSQL nvarchar(2000)  
			 Declare @RequiredFieldsSQL nvarchar(2000)  
			 Declare @PalletAdditionalFieldsSQL nvarchar(2000)  
			 Declare @PalletAdditionalFieldJoinsSQL nvarchar(2000)  
			 Declare @requirePalletNumber bit  
			 Declare @requireExpiryDate bit  
			 Declare @requireManufactureDate bit  
			 Declare @requireBestBefore bit  
			 Declare @requireDateOfReceipt bit  

			Declare @divisionFK int, @customerFK int
			Select @divisionFK = sis.DivisionFK, @customerFK = divs.CustomerFK
			from tblStockItems sis
			inner join tblDivisions divs on
			divs.DivisionPK = sis.DivisionFK
			Where sis.StockItemPK = @var_stockItemFK
  
			 DECLARE additionalPalletFields CURSOR FOR   
			 SELECT  
			   PalletAdditionalFieldPK, PalletAdditionalField  
			 FROM tblPalletAdditionalFields  
			 Where enabled = 1 AND 
				((PalletAdditionalFieldTypeFK = 3 /*StockItem*/  
				AND FK = @var_stockItemFK)
				OR  
				(PalletAdditionalFieldTypeFK = 2 /*Division*/  
				AND FK = @divisionFK)
				OR
				(PalletAdditionalFieldTypeFK = 1 /*Customer*/  
				AND FK = @customerFK))
			 Declare @palletAdditionalFieldPK int  
			 Declare @palletAdditionalField nvarchar(200)  
  
			 OPEN additionalPalletFields  
  
			 FETCH NEXT FROM additionalPalletFields INTO   
			 @palletAdditionalFieldPK,  
			 @palletAdditionalField  
  
			 Declare @palletAdditionalFieldCounter int   
			 Set @palletAdditionalFieldCounter = 0  
  
			 Set @PalletAdditionalFieldsSQL = ''  
			 Set @PalletAdditionalFieldJoinsSQL = ''  
			 WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0  
			 BEGIN  
			  Set @palletAdditionalFieldCounter = @palletAdditionalFieldCounter + 1  
			  Set @PalletAdditionalFieldsSQL = @PalletAdditionalFieldsSQL + ' ,pafvs' + cast(@palletAdditionalFieldCounter as nvarchar(10)) 
			  + '.PalletAdditionalFieldValue as [' + @palletAdditionalField + '] '  
  
			  Set @PalletAdditionalFieldJoinsSQL = @PalletAdditionalFieldJoinsSQL + ' left outer join tblPalletAdditionalFieldValues pafvs' 
			  + cast(@palletAdditionalFieldCounter as nvarchar(10)) + ' on '  
			  Set @PalletAdditionalFieldJoinsSQL = @PalletAdditionalFieldJoinsSQL + 'pafvs' + cast(@palletAdditionalFieldCounter as nvarchar(10)) 
			  + '.PalletContentFK = palletContent.PalletContentPK AND ' + 'pafvs' + cast(@palletAdditionalFieldCounter as nvarchar(10)) 
			  + '.PalletAdditionalFieldFK = ' + cast(@palletAdditionalFieldPK as nvarchar(100))
  
			  FETCH NEXT FROM additionalPalletFields INTO   
			  @palletAdditionalFieldPK,  
			  @palletAdditionalField  
			 END  
  
			 CLOSE additionalPalletFields   
			 DEALLOCATE additionalPalletFields   
     
			 Select @eachesUnitTypeFK = sis.EachesUnitTypeFK,  
			  @requirePalletNumber = CASE WHEN custs.RequirePalletNumber = 0 THEN CASE WHEN divs.RequirePalletNumber = 0 then sis.RequirePalletNumber ELSE divs.RequirePalletNumber END ELSE custs.RequirePalletNumber end,
			  @requireExpiryDate = sis.RequireExpiryDate,  
			  @requireManufactureDate = sis.RequireManufactureDate,  
			  @requireBestBefore = sis.RequireBestBefore,  
			  @requireDateOfReceipt = sis.RequireDateOfReceipt,  
			  @unitType = isnull(unitTypes.Abbreviation, 'Units'),  
			  @eachUnitType = isnull(eachUnitTypes.Abbreviation, 'Units')  
			 from tblStockItems sis 
			 INNER JOIN tbldivisions divs ON 
				sis.DivisionFK = divs.DivisionPK
			 INNER JOIN tblcustomers custs ON
				divs.CustomerFK = custs.customerpk  
			 left outer join tblUnitTypes unitTypes on  
			 unitTypes.UnitTypePK = sis.UnitTypeFK  
			 left outer join tblUnitTypes eachUnitTypes on  
			 eachUnitTypes.UnitTypePK = sis.EachesUnitTypeFK  
			 where StockItemPK = @var_stockItemFK  
  
			 if(@eachesUnitTypeFK = -1) 
			 BEGIN  
			  Set @UnitsEachesSQL = 'palletContent.ActualUnits as [Actual ' + @unitType + '], case when @var_IncludeAlreadySelectedQuantities2 = 1 then palletContent.AvailableUnits + isnull(orderedContent.Units, 0)  ELSE palletContent.AvailableUnits end as [Available ' + @unitType  +']'
			  END 
			 ELSE 
			 BEGIN  
			  Set @UnitsEachesSQL = 'palletContent.ActualUnits as [Actual ' + @eachUnitType + '], case when @var_IncludeAlreadySelectedQuantities2 = 1 then palletContent.AvailableUnits + isnull(orderedContent.Units, 0)  ELSE palletContent.AvailableUnits end as [Available ' + @eachUnitType   +']'
			 END  
  
			 Set @RequiredFieldsSQL = ''  
			 if(@requirePalletNumber = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/) Set @RequiredFieldsSQL = ',pallets.CustomerPalletNumber [Pallet Number]'  
			 if(@requireExpiryDate = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/) Set @RequiredFieldsSQL = @RequiredFieldsSQL + ',convert(varchar, palletContent.ExpiryDate, 103) [Expiry Date]'  
			 if(@requireManufactureDate = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/) Set @RequiredFieldsSQL = @RequiredFieldsSQL + ',convert(varchar, palletContent.DateOfManufacture, 103) [Manufacture Date]'  
			 if(@requireBestBefore = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/) Set @RequiredFieldsSQL = @RequiredFieldsSQL + ',convert(varchar, palletContent.BestBefore, 103) [Best Before]'  
			 --if(@requireDateOfReceipt = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/) Set @RequiredFieldsSQL = @RequiredFieldsSQL + ',convert(varchar, palletContent.DateOfReceipt, 103) DateOfReceipt'  
			 
			declare @var_deliveryTypeFK int = 1 --default to market so only available pallets

			--check delivery type if we know the stock order (editing)
			if(@var_containerOutFK > 0) begin
				SELECT @var_deliveryTypeFK = DeliveryTypeFK FROM tblcontainerouts WHERE containeroutpk = @var_containerOutFK
			end
			else
			begin
				--or check delivery type depending on address (first time picking)
				SELECT @var_deliveryTypeFK = DeliveryAddressTypeFK FROM tblDeliveryAddresses where deliveryAddressPK = @var_DeliveryAddressFK
			END
			
			--check if supplier batch needs filtered too
			DECLARE @var_SupplierBatch nvarchar(200) = ''
			DECLARE @filterSupplierBatch bit = 0
			if CHARINDEX('{',@var_batch) > 0   
			BEGIN	
				SET @filterSupplierBatch = 1	
				set @var_SupplierBatch = trim(replace(right(@var_batch, charindex('{', reverse(@var_batch)) - 1), '}', ''))
				SET @var_batch = rtrim(left(@var_batch, CHARINDEX('{', @var_batch) - 1))
			END
  
			 Set @sql = '  
			  DECLARE @var_deliveryTypeFK int; DECLARE @var_IncludeAlreadySelectedQuantities2 bit; DECLARE @filterSupplierBatch2 bit '+

			, 103) End Received, PalletStatus as [Status]

			  inner join tblPalletContent palletContent on  palletContent.PalletFK = pallets.PalletPK

				from tblPalletAudit  
				Where EventTypeFK = 1 /*Pallet Created*/

				'Where ContainerOutFK = ' + cast(@var_containerOutFK as nvarchar(50)) +

			 LEFT JOIN (SELECT count(StockItemDeliveryStatusPK) DeliveryStatusCount from #TempDeliveryStatus) ds ON 1=1'
            + @PalletAdditionalFieldJoinsSQL +   
			 ' where palletContent.StockItemFK = ' + cast(@var_stockItemFK as nvarchar(100)) + ' AND palletContent.Batch = ''' + @var_batch + '''  and ((@filterSupplierBatch2 = 0) or (@filterSupplierBatch2 = 1 and palletcontent.SupplierBatch = ''' + @var_SupplierBatch + '''))

				AND pallets.IsArchived = 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/  
			 AND palletContent.IsArchived = 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/  
			 AND ((DeliveryStatusCount > 0 AND pallets.PalletStatusFK IN (SELECT PalletStatusFK from #TempDeliveryStatus)) 
				OR	((DeliveryStatusCount = 0) and
			  ((@var_deliveryTypeFK = 1 /*market*/ and pallets.PalletStatusFK = 1/*Available*/)
				or
				(@var_deliveryTypeFK in (2,4,5) /*factory or system*/ and pallets.PalletStatusFK <> 10/*anything but on route*/)
				or
				(@var_deliveryTypeFK = 3 /*scrappage*/ and pallets.PalletStatusFK not in (10, 1)/*anything but available or on route*/)
			)))
			 Order By Row ASC, ColumnNO DESC,BayLevel ASC, pallets.BayPosition DESC'  
			--print @fullSQL
			 SET @fullSQL = CAST (@sql AS nvarchar(MAX)) + CAST (@sql2 AS nvarchar(MAX))  
			 Print @fullsql  
  
			 EXEC sp_executesql @fullSQL
   
			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end

			
			
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END

						)

				SELECT DISTINCT
				PK, ImagePath, IsArchived, IsFiltered, Batch, [Stock Code], Pallets, Units, [Status], IncludeSelected
				FROM  #FinalResults

		END CATCH

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spManagementReportsCompleteAuditTrail]
(
	@StartDate DATETIME, 
	@EndDate DATETIME
)	
AS
BEGIN	
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT
	,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;
	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	DECLARE @var_startDate datetime, @var_endDate datetime

	SET @var_startDate = @startDate; SET @var_endDate = @endDate;

	SET @ParameterDetails = '@startDate = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_startDate AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@endDate = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_endDate AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'')

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    --BEGIN
		SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

		INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
		SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','N/A', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

		SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END

	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails

	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY
			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start
		   SELECT
				  @var_startDate as FromDate,
				  @var_endDate as toDate,
				  dbo.GetBSTDate() as RunDate,
				  Evt.[Date],
				  Evt.[Server],
				  Evt.[Database],      
				  case when Evt.[Login] = -1 then 'Integration App' else Ppl.FirstName + ' ' + Ppl.LastName + ' (' + Usr.UserName + ')' end AS [LoginUser],
				  Evt.[Application],
				  Evt.[ClientHost] AS [Client host],
				  Evt.[Schema],
				  Evt.[ObjectName] AS [Object],
				  Evt.[Operation],
				  Evt.[State],
				  Evt.[CommandText],
				  Err.[SQLErrorNumber],
				  Err.[SQLErrorSeverity],
				  Err.[SQLErrorState],
				  Err.[ErrorMessage]
		   FROM
				  tblEventLog AS Evt
		   LEFT OUTER JOIN tblErrorLog AS Err
				  ON Evt.ErrorLogFK = Err.ErrorLogPK
		   LEFT OUTER JOIN tblUsers AS Usr
				  ON Evt.[Login] = Usr.UserPK
		   LEFT OUTER JOIN tblPeople AS Ppl
				  ON Usr.PersonFK = Ppl.PersonPK
		   WHERE
				  [Date] >= @var_startDate AND [Date] < @var_endDate
		   ORDER BY
				  [Date] ASC


			
			
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spManagementReportsDailyStockLevelsBuildingCapacityHistory]
(
	@BuildingFK int,

	@ToDate AS datetime
)	
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT
 ,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;
	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	DECLARE @var_BuildingFK int
	DECLARE @var_FromDate datetime
	DECLARE @var_ToDate datetime

	SET @var_BuildingFK = @BuildingFK
	SET @var_FromDate = @FromDate
	SET @var_ToDate = @ToDate

	SET @ParameterDetails = '@BuildingFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_BuildingFK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ', @FromDate = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_FromDate AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ', @ToDate = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_ToDate AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'')

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    --BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

		SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END


	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY
			
			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start
			IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#TempResults') IS NOT NULL
			DROP TABLE #TempResults

			SELECT CONVERT(INT, dateadd(DAY,0, datediff(day,0,ForDate))) as PK, BuildingName, CONVERT(VARCHAR(50), ForDate, 106) [Date], 
				sum(TotalSpacesEuro) [Total Spaces (E)], sum(TotalSpacesStandard) [Total Spaces (S)], sum(DocketsIn) [Dockets In], sum(PalletsIn) [Pallets In],
                sum(DocketsOut) [Dockets Out], sum(PalletsOut) [Pallets Out], sum(CurrentPallets) [Total Pallets], sum(CurrentRackedPallets) as [Racked Pallets], 
				sum(AvailableSpacesEuro) [Available Spaces (E)], sum(AvailableSpacesStandard) [Available Spaces (S)], 
				--Cast( AVG(CapacityUsed)  AS integer) [Capacity Used] 
				CAST((100.0 / (case when sum(TotalSpacesStandard) = 0 then 1 else sum(TotalSpacesStandard) end ))*(sum(TotalSpacesStandard)-sum(AvailableSpacesStandard))AS integer) AS [Capacity Used] 
            INTO #TempResults
			FROM tblReportsBuildingUnitDailyCapacity 
            INNER JOIN tblBuildings on buildingfk = buildingpk
            WHERE BuildingPK = @var_BuildingFK and ForDate >= @var_FromDate and ForDate <= @var_ToDate
            group by BuildingPK, BuildingName, ForDate 
            order by ForDate Desc

			SELECT PK, subq.BuildingName, [Date], subq.[Total Spaces (E)], subq.[Total Spaces (S)], subq.[Dockets In], subq.[Pallets In], subq.[Dockets Out], subq.[Pallets Out], subq.[Total Pallets], subq.[Racked Pallets], subq.[Available Spaces (E)], subq.[Available Spaces (S)], Cast(subq.[Capacity Used] AS integer) [Capacity Used]
			FROM (
				SELECT *, BuildingName AS OrderField FROM #TempResults

				UNION

				SELECT 1000000 as PK, 'Total','Total', null, null, isnull(sum([Dockets In]), 0), isnull(sum([Pallets In]), 0), isnull(sum([Dockets Out]), 0),isnull(sum([Pallets Out]), 0), null, null, null,null, 
				isnull((100.00 / isnull(sum([Total Spaces (S)]), 1))*(isnull(sum([Total Spaces (S)]), 1)-isnull(sum([Available Spaces (S)]), 1)),0),'zzzzzzzzzzz' AS OrderField
				FROM #TempResults
			)subq
			ORDER BY OrderField
			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end		
			
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spManagementReportsDailyStockLevelsBuildingOverview]
(
	@DayToReport AS datetime,
	@UserFK AS int = -1
)	
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT
 ,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;
	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	DECLARE @var_DayToReport datetime
	DECLARE @var_UserFK AS int

	SET @var_DayToReport = @DayToReport
	SET @var_UserFK = @UserFK

	SET @ParameterDetails = '@DayToReport = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_DayToReport AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ', @UserFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_UserFK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'')

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    --BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

		SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END


	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY
			

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start

			IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#TempResults') IS NOT NULL
			DROP TABLE #TempResults

			SELECT BuildingPK as PK, BuildingName, sum(TotalSpacesEuro) [Total Spaces (E)], sum(TotalSpacesStandard) [Total Spaces (S)], 
				sum(DocketsIn) [Dockets In], sum(PalletsIn) [Pallets In],
				sum(DocketsOut) [Dockets Out],sum(PalletsOut) [Pallets Out], 
				sum(CurrentPallets) [Total Pallets], sum(CurrentRackedPallets) as [Racked Pallets], 
				sum(AvailableSpacesEuro) [Available Spaces (E)], sum(AvailableSpacesStandard) [Available Spaces (S)], 
				AVG(CapacityUsed) [Capacity Used]/*,
				case when sum(TotalSpacesStandard) = 0 then sum(TotalSpacesStandard)
					when sum(CurrentRackedPallets) = 0 then sum(TotalSpacesStandard)
					else (((sum(CurrentRackedPallets) / (case when avg(CapacityUsed) < 1 then 1 else cast(avg(CapacityUsed) as integer) end))*100)) end as [Estimated Capacity]*/
			INTO #TempResults
			FROM tblReportsBuildingUnitDailyCapacity
			INNER JOIN tblBuildings tb on buildingfk = buildingpk
			INNER JOIN (
				select distinct BuildingFK
				FROM tblBuildingUnits tbu
				INNER JOIN dbo.tblUserBuildingUnits tubu ON tbu.BuildingUnitPK = tubu.BuildingUnitFK AND (@var_UserFK=-1 or tubu.UserFK = @var_UserFK)
			)tbu ON tbu.BuildingFK = tb.BuildingPK
			WHERE DateDiff(d, ForDate, @var_DayToReport) = 0
			group by BuildingPK, BuildingName, ForDate
			--order by BuildingName
			if(exists(SELECT TOP 1 pk FROM #TempResults))
			BEGIN
				SELECT PK, subq.BuildingName, subq.[Total Spaces (E)], subq.[Total Spaces (S)], subq.[Dockets In], subq.[Pallets In], subq.[Dockets Out], subq.[Pallets Out], subq.[Total Pallets], subq.[Racked Pallets], subq.[Available Spaces (E)], subq.[Available Spaces (S)], Cast(subq.[Capacity Used] AS integer) [Capacity Used]--, Cast(subq.[Estimated Capacity] AS integer) [Estimated Capacity]
				FROM (
					SELECT *, BuildingName AS OrderField FROM #TempResults

					UNION

					SELECT 1000000 as PK, 'Total', isnull(sum([Total Spaces (E)]), 0), isnull(sum([Total Spaces (S)]), 0), 
					isnull(sum([Dockets In]), 0), isnull(sum([Pallets In]), 0), 
					isnull(sum([Dockets Out]), 0),isnull(sum([Pallets Out]), 0), 
					isnull(sum([Total Pallets]), 0), isnull(sum([Racked Pallets]), 0), 
					isnull(sum([Available Spaces (E)]), 0), isnull(sum([Available Spaces (S)]), 0), 
					isnull((100.00 / isnull(sum([Total Spaces (S)]), 0))*(isnull(sum([Total Spaces (S)]), 0)-isnull(sum([Available Spaces (S)]), 0)),0)
					--,	isnull(sum([Estimated Capacity]), 0),			 
					,'zzzzzzzzzzz' AS OrderField
					FROM #TempResults
				)subq
				ORDER BY OrderField
			END

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end

			
			
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END

	DECLARE @var_BuildingunitFK int
	DECLARE @var_FromDate datetime
	DECLARE @var_ToDate datetime

	SET @var_BuildingUnitFK = @BuildingUnitFK
	SET @var_FromDate = @FromDate
	SET @var_ToDate = @ToDate

	SET @ParameterDetails = '@BuildingUnitFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_BuildingUnitFK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ', @FromDate = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_FromDate AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ', @ToDate = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_ToDate AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'')

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --END

	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start

			DROP TABLE #TempResults

				Cast(CapacityUsed  AS integer) [Capacity Used],
				case when TotalSpacesStandard = 0 then TotalSpacesStandard
					when CurrentRackedPallets = 0 then TotalSpacesStandard
					else (((CurrentRackedPallets / (case when CapacityUsed < 1 then 1 else cast(CapacityUsed as integer) end))*100)) end as [Estimated Capacity]
            INTO #TempResults
			FROM tblReportsBuildingUnitDailyCapacity cap
			INNER JOIN tblBuildingUnits bu on bu.buildingunitpk = cap.buildingunitfk
			INNER JOIN tblBuildings b on bu.buildingfk = b.buildingpk
			WHERE BuildingUnitPK = @var_BuildingUnitFK and ForDate >= @var_FromDate and ForDate <= @var_ToDate
			order by ForDate Desc

			SELECT PK, subq.[Building Unit], [Date], subq.[Total Spaces (E)], subq.[Total Spaces (S)], subq.[Dockets In], subq.[Pallets In], subq.[Dockets Out], subq.[Pallets Out], subq.[Total Pallets], subq.[Racked Pallets], subq.[Available Spaces (E)], subq.[Available Spaces (S)], Cast(subq.[Capacity Used] AS integer) [Capacity Used], CAST(subq.[Estimated Capacity] as integer) [Estimated Capacity]
			FROM (
				SELECT *, [Building Unit] AS OrderField FROM #TempResults

				UNION

				SELECT 1000000 as PK, 'Total','Total', null, null, isnull(sum([Dockets In]), 0), isnull(sum([Pallets In]), 0), isnull(sum([Dockets Out]), 0),isnull(sum([Pallets Out]), 0), null, null, null,null, 
				isnull((100.00 / isnull(sum([Total Spaces (S)]), 1))*(isnull(sum([Total Spaces (S)]), 1)-isnull(sum([Available Spaces (S)]), 1)),0),0,'zzzzzzzzzzz' AS OrderField
				FROM #TempResults
			)subq
			ORDER BY OrderField
			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end		
			
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END

-- =============================================
-- Author:        <Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:   <Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spManagementReportsDailyStockLevelsSync]
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data; Ensure this proc has a low impact when executed */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED; SET DEADLOCK_PRIORITY LOW

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT
	,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;
	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

	SET @ParameterDetails = ''

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    --BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

		SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END


	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY
			--check if anything exists for today
			if(not exists(SELECT TOP 1 * FROM tblReportsDivisionDailyStockOutSummary WHERE fordate = dateadd(DAY,0, datediff(day,0, dbo.GetBSTDate()))))
			BEGIN

				--building units is used repeatedly
				
				DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #tempBuildingUnits
				SELECT BuildingUnitPK, BuildingFK INTO #tempBuildingUnits FROM dbo.tblBuildingUnits tbu WHERE tbu.IsArchived = 0

				--load all current pallets to start
				DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #TempAllPallets

				SELECT PalletPK, palletstatusfk, palletTypeFK, BuildingUnitFK, LocationTypeFK, LocationFK, stackposition
				INTO #TempAllPallets			
				FROM tblPallets p
				WHERE p.isarchived = 0 and p.palletstatusfk <> 10

				--get distinct stock item widths
				drop table if exists #tmpstockitemmargins
				select distinct palletpk, stockitempk, widthmargin into #tmpstockitemmargins
				from #TempAllPallets p
				inner join tblpalletcontent pc on p.palletpk = pc.palletfk
				inner join tblstockitems s on pc.StockItemFK = s.StockItemPK 
				where s.WidthMargin > 0
			
				--getunstacked pallets - these represent a single pallet location in relation to bay width
				DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #TempUnstackedPallets

				select p.palletpk, locationFK, palletTypeFK, Width+(case when swm.WidthMargin is null then pt.WidthMargin*2 else swm.WidthMargin*2 end) as Width, BuildingUnitFK
				into #TempUnstackedPallets
				from #TempAllPallets p
				left join #tmpstockitemmargins swm on p.PalletPK = swm.palletpk
				inner join tblpallettypes pt on pallettypefk = pallettypepk
				where locationtypefk = 1 and stackposition = 0 AND locationfk NOT IN (25143,25144,25145,25146)/*ignore scrap locations*/

				--get totals of racked pallets per building unit
				DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #TempRackedPallets

				select count(distinct palletpk) NumPallets, tbu.BuildingUnitPK
				into #TempRackedPallets
				from #TempAllPallets p
				inner join tblpallettypes on pallettypefk = pallettypepk
				INNER JOIN #tempBuildingUnits tbu ON p.BuildingUnitFK = tbu.BuildingUnitPK
				where locationtypefk = 1 AND locationfk NOT IN (25143,25144,25145,25146)/*ignore scrap locations*/
				GROUP BY tbu.BuildingUnitPK

				--get all inward pallets
				DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #TempContainerIns
				SELECT DISTINCT containerInPk, DateIn, BuildingUnitFK, SupplierFK  INTO #TempContainerIns FROM tblcontainerins where DateDiff(d, dateIn, dbo.GetBSTDate()) = 0
								
				DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #TempStockIns
				SELECT DISTINCT StockInPK, containerInFk, DivisionFK  INTO #TempStockIns FROM tblstockins si INNER JOIN #TempContainerIns ci ON containerinfk = containerinpk WHERE si.stockinstatusfk not in (1,4)
				
				DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #TempDocketsIn
				select count(distinct palletfk) Pallets, count(distinct stockinpk) Dockets, BuildingUnitFK, DivisionFK, dateadd(DAY,0, datediff(day,0, dateIn)) DateIn, CASE when ts.SupplierTypeFK IS NULL THEN 2 ELSE ts.SupplierTypeFK END AS SupplierTypeFK
				into #TempDocketsIn
				from tblstockinlinepallets
				inner join tblstockinlines on stockinlinefk = stockinlinepk
				inner join #TempStockIns si on stockinfk = stockinpk
				inner join #TempContainerIns on containerinfk = containerinpk
				LEFT JOIN tblsuppliers ts ON ts.supplierpk = SupplierFK
				--where DateDiff(d, dateIn, dbo.GetBSTDate()) = 0 and si.stockinstatusfk not in (1,4)
				group by buildingunitfk, divisionfk,SupplierTypeFK, dateadd(DAY,0, datediff(day,0, dateIn))

				
				--get all outward pallets				
				DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #TempContainerOut
				SELECT DISTINCT containeroutpk, CollectionDate, DeliveryTypeFK, containeroutstatusfk INTO #TempContainerOut FROM tblcontainerouts where DateDiff(d, CollectionDate, dbo.GetBSTDate()) = 0 and containeroutstatusfk = 5

				DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #TempContainerOutLines
				SELECT DISTINCT containeroutlinepk, containeroutfk, DivisionFK INTO #TempContainerOutLines FROM tblcontaineroutlines INNER JOIN #TempContainerOut ON containeroutpk = containeroutfk

				DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #TempContainerOutLinePallets
				SELECT DISTINCT ContainerOutLinePalletContentPK, containeroutlineFk, PalletFK INTO #TempContainerOutLinePallets FROM tblcontaineroutlinePalletContent INNER JOIN #TempContainerOutLines ON containeroutlinefk = containeroutlinepk
				
				DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #TempContainerOutPalletAudit
				SELECT DISTINCT pa.palletAuditPK, pa.PalletFK, pa.EventTypeFK INTO #TempContainerOutPalletAudit FROM tblpalletaudit pa INNER JOIN #TempContainerOutLinePallets colpc ON colpc.palletfk = pa.palletfk where pa.eventtypefk = 2
				
				DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #TempDocketsOut
					--SELECT TOP 1000 * FROM tblcontainerouts ORDER BY dbo.tblcontainerouts.ContainerOutPK desc
				select count(distinct palletPk) Pallets, count(distinct containeroutpk) Dockets, p.BuildingUnitFK, DivisionFK, dateadd(DAY,0, datediff(day,0, CollectionDate)) DateOut, co.DeliveryTypeFK
				into #TempDocketsOut
				from #TempContainerOutLinePallets colpc
				inner join #TempContainerOutLines col on containeroutlinefk = containeroutlinepk
				inner join #TempContainerOut co on containeroutpk = containeroutfk
				inner join #TempContainerOutPalletAudit pa on colpc.palletfk = pa.palletfk and pa.eventtypefk = 2
				inner join tblpallets p on colpc.palletfk = p.palletpk
				--inner join tblstockorders so on so.containeroutfk = co.containeroutpk and so.buildingunitfk = p.buildingunitpk
				--where DateDiff(d, CollectionDate, dbo.GetBSTDate()) = 0 and co.containeroutstatusfk = 5
				group by p.buildingunitfk, divisionfk, dateadd(DAY,0, datediff(day,0, CollectionDate)),co.DeliveryTypeFK

				DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #TempDocketsOutBuildingSummary
				DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #TempDocketsOutDivisionSummary
				DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #TempDocketsInBuildingSummary
				DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #TempDocketsInDivisionSummary

				select sum(Dockets) DocketsIn, sum(Pallets) PalletsIn, BuildingUnitFK
				INTO #TempDocketsInBuildingSummary
				from #TempDocketsIn
				group by BuildingUnitFK

				select sum(Dockets) DocketsIn, sum(Pallets) PalletsIn, BuildingUnitFK, DivisionFK
				INTO #TempDocketsInDivisionSummary
				from #TempDocketsIn
				group by BuildingUnitFK, DivisionFK

				select sum(Dockets) DocketsOut, sum(Pallets) PalletsOut, BuildingUnitFK, DivisionFK
				INTO #TempDocketsOutDivisionSummary
				from #TempDocketsOut
				group by BuildingUnitFK, DivisionFK

				select sum(Dockets) DocketsOut, sum(Pallets) PalletsOut, BuildingUnitFK
				INTO #TempDocketsOutBuildingSummary
				from #TempDocketsOut
				group by BuildingUnitFK

				DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #TempUnstackPalletsInRacking

				SELECT BuildingPK, BuildingUnitPk, count(palletpk) CurrentPallets, Coalesce(sum(tp.Width), 0) as TotalPalletWidth, bub.width - Coalesce(sum(tp.Width), 0) as RemainingSpace, 
						case when bub.width - Coalesce(sum(tp.Width), 0) <= 0 then 0 else (bub.width - Coalesce(sum(tp.Width), 0)) / 830 end as PotentialEuroPallets,
						case when bub.width - Coalesce(sum(tp.Width), 0) <= 0 then 0 else (bub.width - Coalesce(sum(tp.Width), 0)) / 1040 end as PotentialStandardPallets,
						case when bub.width <= 0 then 0 else bub.width / 1040 end as PotentialTotalStandardPallets,
						case when bub.width <= 0 then 0 else bub.width / 830 end as PotentialTotalEuroPallets
				INTO #TempUnstackPalletsInRacking
				FROM tblbuildingunitbays bub
				INNER JOIN tblbuildingunitcolumns on buildingunitcolumnfk = buildingunitcolumnpk
				INNER JOIN tblbuildingunitrows on buildingunitrowpk = buildingunitrowfk
				INNER JOIN #tempBuildingUnits bu on buildingunitfk = buildingunitpk
				INNER JOIN tblbuildings on buildingfk = buildingpk
				LEFT JOIN #TempUnstackedPallets tp on buildingunitbaypk = locationfk
				--left join #TempDocketsIn DocketsIn on bu.BuildingUnitPK = DocketsIn.BuildingUnitFK and 
				WHERE bub.width > 0 and buildingpk not in (20,29, 34, 35)  AND bub.BuildingUnitBayPK NOT IN (25143,25144,25145,25146)/*ignore scrap locations*/ /*and buildingunitpk not in (77)*/ --and bu.isarchived = 0
				and bub.IsArchived=0
				GROUP BY BuildingUnitPk, BuildingPK, BuildingUnitColumnName, BayLevel, buildingunitbaypk,bub.width

				DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #TempUnstackPalletsInRackingByDocket

				SELECT BuildingUnitPk, BuildingPK,  
						sum(PotentialTotalEuroPallets) as [TotalSpacesEuro],
						sum(PotentialTotalStandardPallets) as [TotalSpacesStandard],
						Coalesce(DocketsIn.DocketsIn, 0) DocketsIn,
						Coalesce(DocketsIn.PalletsIn, 0) PalletsIn,
						Coalesce(DocketsOut.DocketsOut, 0) DocketsOut,
						Coalesce(DocketsOut.PalletsOut, 0) PalletsOut,
						--sum (currentpallets) [CurrentPallets], 
						sum(PotentialEuroPallets) [AvailableSpacesEuro],
						sum(PotentialStandardPallets) [AvailableSpacesStandard],
						--(100.0 / sum(PotentialTotalStandardPallets))*(sum(PotentialTotalStandardPallets)-sum(PotentialStandardPallets)) as UsedCapacity,
						(100.0 / (case when sum(PotentialTotalStandardPallets) = 0 then 1 else sum(PotentialTotalStandardPallets) end ))*(sum(PotentialTotalStandardPallets)-sum(PotentialStandardPallets)) as UsedCapacity,
						dateadd(DAY,0, datediff(day,0, dbo.GetBSTDate())) ForDate
				INTO #TempUnstackPalletsInRackingByDocket
				FROM #TempUnstackPalletsInRacking sub
				LEFT JOIN #TempDocketsInBuildingSummary DocketsIn on DocketsIn.BuildingUnitFK = sub.buildingunitPK
				LEFT JOIN #TempDocketsOutBuildingSummary DocketsOut on DocketsOut.BuildingUnitFK = sub.buildingunitPK				
				GROUP BY BuildingUnitPk, BuildingPK, DocketsIn, PalletsIn, DocketsOut, PalletsOut

				--pallet content for all pals
				drop table if exists #tmpPalContent
				select distinct palletFk, StockItemFK, Batch, sum(actualunits) actualunits, sum(availableunits) availableunits, s.DivisionFK
				into #tmpPalContent
				from #TempAllPallets p
				inner join tblpalletcontent pc on PalletFK = Palletpk
				inner join tblstockitems s on pc.StockItemFK = s.StockItemPK
				group by palletFk, StockItemFK, Batch, DivisionFK

				--unstacked pallets width by division
				drop table if exists #tmpDivisionUsedSpace
				select DivisionFK, BuildingUnitFK,  sum(p.Width) as TotalPalletWidth, sum(p.Width)/1040 as TotalStandardSpacesUsed, sum(p.Width)/830 as TotalEuroSpacesUsed
				into #tmpDivisionUsedSpace
				from #TempUnstackedPallets p
				INNER JOIN #tmpPalContent pc ON p.PalletPK = pc.PalletFk
				group by DivisionFK, BuildingUnitFK
			

				IF XACT_STATE() = 0 AND @@TRANCOUNT < 1 BEGIN TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName

				INSERT INTO tblReportsDivisionDailyStockOutSummary
				SELECT distinct bu.BuildingUnitPK, bu.buildingfk, DivisionFK, DeliveryTypeFK, Coalesce(sum(Dockets), 0) DocketsOut, Coalesce(sum(Pallets), 0) PalletsOut, DateOut
				from #tempBuildingUnits bu
				inner JOIN #TempDocketsOut ON bu.BuildingUnitPK = BuildingUnitFK
				group by bu.BuildingUnitPK, bu.buildingfk, DeliveryTypeFK, DateOut, DivisionFK
				ORDER BY bu.buildingfk, bu.BuildingUnitPK

				INSERT INTO tblReportsDivisionDailyStockInSummary
				SELECT distinct bu.BuildingUnitPK, bu.buildingfk, DivisionFK, SupplierTypeFK, Coalesce(sum(Dockets), 0) DocketsIn, Coalesce(sum(Pallets), 0) PalletsIn, DateIn
				from #tempBuildingUnits bu
				inner JOIN #TempDocketsIn ON bu.BuildingUnitPK = BuildingUnitFK
				group by bu.BuildingUnitPK, bu.buildingfk, SupplierTypeFK, DateIn, DivisionFK
				ORDER BY bu.buildingfk, bu.BuildingUnitPK
		
				--record division / building daily levels
				INSERT INTO tblReportsDivisionDailyStockLevels
				SELECT distinct p.buildingunitfk, s.divisionFk, palletstatusfk, palletTypeFK, LocationTypeFK, count(palletpk),  dateadd(DAY,0, datediff(day,0, dbo.GetBSTDate())), Coalesce(DocketsIn.PalletsIn, 0), coalesce(DocketsOut.PalletsOut, 0) ,
				dus.TotalPalletWidth, dus.TotalEuroSpacesUsed, dus.TotalStandardSpacesUsed
				FROM #TempAllPallets p
				--INNER JOIN (Select PalletFK, StockItemFK, Batch from tblPalletContent Group By PalletFK, StockItemFK, Batch) pc ON PalletFK = Palletpk
				INNER JOIN #tmpPalContent pc ON p.PalletPK = pc.PalletFk
				INNER JOIN tblstockitems s on stockitemfk = stockitempk
				left JOIN #TempDocketsInDivisionSummary DocketsIn on DocketsIn.BuildingUnitFK = p.buildingunitFK and DocketsIn.DivisionFK = s.DivisionFK
				left join #TempDocketsOutDivisionSummary DocketsOut on DocketsOut.BuildingUnitFK = p.buildingunitFK and DocketsOut.DivisionFK = s.DivisionFK
				left join #tmpDivisionUsedSpace dus on dus.DivisionFK = s.DivisionFK and dus.BuildingUnitFK = p.BuildingUnitFK
				GROUP BY p.buildingunitfk, s.divisionFk, palletstatusfk, pallettypefk, LocationTypeFK, DocketsIn.PalletsIn, DocketsOut.PalletsOut,
				dus.TotalPalletWidth, dus.TotalEuroSpacesUsed, dus.TotalStandardSpacesUsed
		
				--record bulding / building unit daily levels
				INSERT INTO tblReportsBuildingUnitDailyCapacity	
				SELECT distinct subq.BuildingUnitPk, BuildingPK, [TotalSpacesEuro], [TotalSpacesStandard], PalletsIn, PalletsOut,
					COUNT(ALLPALS.PALLETPK), [AvailableSpacesEuro],[AvailableSpacesStandard], UsedCapacity, ForDate, isnull(RackedPALS.NumPallets, 0) AS [RackedPallets], DocketsIn, DocketsOut
				FROM #TempUnstackPalletsInRackingByDocket subQ
				LEFT JOIN #TempAllPallets ALLPALS ON subq. buildingunitPK = ALLPALS.BuildingUnitFK
				left JOIN #TempRackedPallets RackedPALS ON subq.buildingunitPK = RackedPALS.BuildingUnitPK
				GROUP BY subq.BuildingUnitPk, BuildingPK, [TotalSpacesEuro], [TotalSpacesStandard], DocketsIn, PalletsIn, DocketsOut, PalletsOut,
					[AvailableSpacesEuro],[AvailableSpacesStandard], UsedCapacity, ForDate, RackedPALS.NumPallets
				ORDER BY BuildingPK, subq.BuildingUnitPk

				exec spManagementReportsDailyStockLevelsSyncbBackdatedDockets

				BEGIN TRY IF XACT_STATE() = 1 AND @@TRANCOUNT = 1 AND @OpeningTranCount < 1 COMMIT TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH
			END
					
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END
GO

-- =============================================

-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:   <Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spManagementReportsDailyStockLevelsSyncbBackDatedDockets]
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data; Ensure this proc has a low impact when executed */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED; SET DEADLOCK_PRIORITY LOW

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT
	,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;
	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

	SET @ParameterDetails = ''

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    --BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

		SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END


	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY
			/****************************************************************************************************************************************************************************************************/
			--get container out completed audit events set today
			drop table if exists #tmpAllOutAudit
			select top 500 * --get last 500 first, then filter that by date (quicker than filtering entire history by date)
			into #tmpAllOutAudit 
			from tblcontaineroutaudit 
			where containeroutaudittypefk=22--StockOutComplete 
			order by containeroutauditpk desc

			drop table if exists #tmpCompleteOutEventAudit
			select *
			into #tmpCompleteOutEventAudit
			from #tmpAllOutAudit aud
			where cast(dbo.GetBSTDate() as date) = cast(inserteddate as date)   

			--get container out details for any audit events who's date doesnt match today
			drop table if exists #tmpContainerOutsToUpdate
			select ContainerOutPK, aud.InsertedDate [CompletedDate], co.CollectionDate, DATEDIFF(day, aud.InsertedDate, co.CollectionDate) [Days Diff], GoodsOrderNumber
			into #tmpContainerOutsToUpdate
			from #tmpCompleteOutEventAudit aud
			inner join tblcontainerouts co on aud.ContainerOutFK = co.ContainerOutPK
			where CAST(co.CollectionDate AS Date) <> CAST(aud.InsertedDate AS Date ) and DATEDIFF(day, aud.InsertedDate, co.CollectionDate) < 0

			--get docket / pallet count per division / delivery type / building unit / date
			drop table if exists #tmpStockLevelsOutToUpdate
			select IDENTITY(int) AS idcol, cast(tco.CollectionDate as date) as ForDate, count(distinct tco.containeroutpk) as Dockets, count(distinct palletfk) as pallets, buildingunitfk, divisionfk, co.deliverytypefk
			into #tmpStockLevelsOutToUpdate
			from #tmpContainerOutsToUpdate tco 
			inner join tblcontainerouts co on tco.containeroutpk = co.containeroutpk
			inner join viewContainerOutPalletList vcp on co.containeroutpk = vcp.containeroutpk
			group by cast(tco.CollectionDate as date), vcp.Buildingunitfk, divisionfk, co.deliverytypefk

			/****************************************************************************************************************************************************************************************************/
			--get container in completed audit events set today
			drop table if exists #tmpAllInAudit
			select top 500 * --get last 500 first, then filter that by date (quicker than filtering entire history by date)
			into #tmpAllInAudit 
			from tblContainerInAudit 
			where ContainerInAuditTypeFK=3--StockInArrived 
			order by  ContainerInAuditPK desc

			drop table if exists #tmpCompleteInEventAudit
			select *
			into #tmpCompleteInEventAudit
			from #tmpAllInAudit aud
			where cast(dbo.GetBSTDate() as date) = cast(inserteddate as date)   

			--get container in details for any audit events who's date doesnt match today
			drop table if exists #tmpContainerInsToUpdate
			select ContainerInPK, aud.InsertedDate [CompletedDate], Ci.DateIn, DATEDIFF(day, aud.InsertedDate, Ci.DateIn) [Days Diff], GoodsInNumber
			into #tmpContainerInsToUpdate
			from #tmpCompleteInEventAudit aud
			inner join tblcontainerIns ci on aud.ContainerInFK = ci.ContainerInPK
			where CAST(Ci.DateIn AS Date) <> CAST(aud.InsertedDate AS Date )
			
			--get docket / pallet count per division / supplier type / building unit / date
			drop table if exists #tmpStockLevelsInToUpdate
			select IDENTITY(int) AS idcol, cast(tco.DateIn as date) as ForDate, count(distinct tco.containerInpk) as Dockets, count(distinct palletfk) as pallets, ci.buildingunitfk, divisionfk, CASE when SupplierTypeFK IS NULL THEN 2 ELSE SupplierTypeFK END AS SupplierTypeFK
			into #tmpStockLevelsInToUpdate
			from #tmpContainerInsToUpdate tco 
			inner join tblcontainerins ci on tco.containerinpk = ci.containerinpk
			inner join tblstockIns si on ci.containerinpk = si.containerinfk
			inner join tblstockinlines sil on stockinfk = stockinpk
			inner join tblstockinlinepallets silp on stockinlinefk= stockinlinepk
			left join tblSuppliers sup on sup.SupplierPK = ci.SupplierFK
			group by cast(tco.DateIn as date), ci.Buildingunitfk, divisionfk, sup.SupplierTypeFK

			/****************************************************************************************************************************************************************************************************/
			
			
			IF XACT_STATE() = 0 AND @@TRANCOUNT < 1 BEGIN TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName
				if exists(select * from #tmpStockLevelsOutToUpdate)
				begin
					--check we have matching line for this data (are we updating or inserting)
					drop table if exists #tmpStockLevelsOutToInsert
					select sl.* 
					into #tmpStockLevelsOutToInsert
					from #tmpStockLevelsOutToUpdate sl 
					left join tblReportsDivisionDailyStockOutSummary rdso 
						on sl.buildingunitfk = rdso.buildingunitfk and sl.divisionfk = rdso.divisionfk and sl.ForDate = rdso.ForDate and sl.deliverytypefk = rdso.deliverytypefk
					where rdso.DailyStockOutSummaryPK is null

					IF EXISTS (select rdso.* from #tmpStockLevelsOutToUpdate sl inner join tblReportsDivisionDailyStockOutSummary rdso 
						on sl.buildingunitfk = rdso.buildingunitfk and sl.divisionfk = rdso.divisionfk and sl.ForDate = rdso.ForDate and sl.deliverytypefk = rdso.deliverytypefk)
					BEGIN
						update rdso
						set palletsOut = palletsOut+Pallets, DocketsOut= DocketsOut+Dockets 
						from #tmpStockLevelsOutToUpdate sl 
						inner join tblReportsDivisionDailyStockOutSummary rdso 
							on sl.buildingunitfk = rdso.buildingunitfk and sl.divisionfk = rdso.divisionfk and sl.ForDate = rdso.ForDate and sl.deliverytypefk = rdso.deliverytypefk
					END

					if exists(select * from #tmpStockLevelsOutToInsert)
					begin
						insert into tblReportsDivisionDailyStockOutSummary
						select sl.buildingunitfk, bu.BuildingFK, sl.divisionfk, sl.deliverytypefk, Dockets, Pallets, sl.ForDate   
						from #tmpStockLevelsOutToInsert sl 
						inner join tblbuildingunits bu on sl.buildingunitfk = bu.buildingunitpk
					end					

					update rdsl
					set palletsOut = palletsOut+Pallets
					from #tmpStockLevelsOutToUpdate sl 
					inner join tblReportsDivisionDailyStockLevels rdsl 
						on sl.buildingunitfk = rdsl.buildingunitfk and sl.divisionfk = rdsl.divisionfk and sl.ForDate = rdsl.ForDate

					update rdc
					set palletsOut=palletsOut+Pallets, CurrentPallets = CurrentPallets-Pallets, DocketsOut = DocketsOut+Dockets 
					from #tmpStockLevelsOutToUpdate sl 
					inner join tblReportsBuildingUnitDailyCapacity rdc
						on sl.buildingunitfk = rdc.buildingunitfk and sl.ForDate = rdc.ForDate

					drop table if exists #tmpSubsequentDaysOut
					select DailyBuildingUnitCapacityPK, CurrentPallets-sum(Pallets) as NewPalTotal
					into #tmpSubsequentDaysOut
					from #tmpStockLevelsOutToUpdate sl
					inner join tblReportsBuildingUnitDailyCapacity rdc on sl.buildingunitfk = rdc.buildingunitfk and rdc.ForDate> sl.ForDate
					group by DailyBuildingUnitCapacityPK, CurrentPallets
					
					update rdc 
					set CurrentPallets = NewPalTotal
					from #tmpSubsequentDaysOut sl 
					inner join tblReportsBuildingUnitDailyCapacity rdc on sl.DailyBuildingUnitCapacityPK = rdc.DailyBuildingUnitCapacityPK 


				end
							   
				if exists(select * from #tmpStockLevelsInToUpdate)
				begin
					--check we have matching line for this data (are we updating or inserting)
					drop table if exists #tmpStockLevelsInToInsert
					select sl.* 
					into #tmpStockLevelsInToInsert
					from #tmpStockLevelsInToUpdate sl 
					left join tblReportsDivisionDailyStockInSummary rdsi 
						on sl.buildingunitfk = rdsi.buildingunitfk and sl.divisionfk = rdsi.divisionfk and sl.ForDate = rdsi.ForDate and sl.SupplierTypeFK = rdsi.SupplierTypeFK
					where rdsi.DailyStockInSummaryPK is null
										
					if exists(SELECT rdsi.* From #tmpStockLevelsInToUpdate sl inner join tblReportsDivisionDailyStockInSummary rdsi 
						on sl.buildingunitfk = rdsi.buildingunitfk and sl.divisionfk = rdsi.divisionfk and sl.ForDate = rdsi.ForDate and sl.SupplierTypeFK = rdsi.SupplierTypeFK)
					BEGIN
						update rdsi
						set palletsIn = palletsIn+Pallets, DocketsIn = DocketsIn+Dockets 
						from #tmpStockLevelsInToUpdate sl 
						inner join tblReportsDivisionDailyStockInSummary rdsi 
						on sl.buildingunitfk = rdsi.buildingunitfk and sl.divisionfk = rdsi.divisionfk and sl.ForDate = rdsi.ForDate and sl.SupplierTypeFK = rdsi.SupplierTypeFK
					END
					
					if exists(select * from #tmpStockLevelsInToInsert)
					begin
						insert into tblReportsDivisionDailyStockInSummary
						select sl.buildingunitfk, bu.BuildingFK, sl.divisionfk, sl.SupplierTypeFK, Dockets, Pallets, sl.ForDate   
						from #tmpStockLevelsInToInsert sl 
						inner join tblbuildingunits bu on sl.buildingunitfk = bu.buildingunitpk
					end

					update rdsl
					set palletsIn = palletsIn+Pallets 
					from #tmpStockLevelsInToUpdate sl 
					inner join tblReportsDivisionDailyStockLevels rdsl 
						on sl.buildingunitfk = rdsl.buildingunitfk and sl.divisionfk = rdsl.divisionfk and sl.ForDate = rdsl.ForDate

					update rdc 
					set palletsIn = palletsIn+Pallets, CurrentPallets = CurrentPallets+Pallets, DocketsIn = DocketsIn+Dockets 
					from #tmpStockLevelsInToUpdate sl 
					inner join tblReportsBuildingUnitDailyCapacity rdc
						on sl.buildingunitfk = rdc.buildingunitfk and sl.ForDate = rdc.ForDate

					drop table if exists #tmpSubsequentDays
					select DailyBuildingUnitCapacityPK, CurrentPallets+sum(Pallets) as NewPalTotal
					--select * from #tmpStockLevelsInToUpdate order by buildingunitfk, fordate
					--select 'SubsequentBuildingUnitDailyCapacity' as [Table], CurrentPallets+sum(Pallets) as NewPals, rdc.CurrentPallets, rdc.buildingunitfk, rdc.ForDate
					into #tmpSubsequentDays
					from #tmpStockLevelsInToUpdate sl
					inner join tblReportsBuildingUnitDailyCapacity rdc on sl.buildingunitfk = rdc.buildingunitfk and rdc.ForDate> sl.ForDate
					group by DailyBuildingUnitCapacityPK, CurrentPallets
					
					update rdc 
					set CurrentPallets = NewPalTotal
					from #tmpSubsequentDays sl 
					inner join tblReportsBuildingUnitDailyCapacity rdc on sl.DailyBuildingUnitCapacityPK = rdc.DailyBuildingUnitCapacityPK 
				end
				BEGIN TRY IF XACT_STATE() = 1 AND @@TRANCOUNT = 1 AND @OpeningTranCount < 1 COMMIT TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH
					
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END

/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[spMobileBarcodeDetails]    Script Date: 02/11/2026 17:47:27 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON

SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
