-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	Takes in a Barcode and returns its detail
--				STAC - Cell
--				STAS- Setdown
--				STAL- Loading Bay
--				Pallet - Return Status 
--					   - 1 = Success
--					   - 2 = Pallet does not Exist
--					   - 3 = Pallet Is Archived
--					   - 4 = Pallet is OnRoute
--
-- Modify Damien Gannon #DEV-910 Exclude Archived Bays
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spMobileBarcodeDetails]
(
	@Barcode as nvarchar(50)
)	
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT
 ,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;
	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	DECLARE @var_Barcode nvarchar(50)

	SET @var_Barcode = @Barcode

	SET @ParameterDetails = '@Barcode = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_Barcode AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'')

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    --BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

		SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END


	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY
			

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start

			DECLARE @thisbarcode nvarchar  (200)
 
			-- Check if a setdown area has been scanned
			DECLARE @barcodetype nvarchar(50)
			DECLARE @PalletPK int

			IF  CHARINDEX('-', @var_Barcode) > 0 
			   SET @barcodetype =  substring(@var_Barcode,1,charindex('-',@var_Barcode)-1)
			else
			   SET @barcodetype = 'STA'

			-- loading bay
			if (@barcodeType = 'STAL')
			BEGIN
				SELECT 
					   1 as returnStatus,
					   LoadingBay as Customer,
					   0 as LocationFK,
					   0 as LocationTypeFK,
					   0 as PalletPK,
					   BuildingUnit as Batch,
					   0 as customerPalletNumber,
					   '' as StockCode,
					   0 as Units,
					   0 as pallettype,
					   LoadingBay as Location,
					   0 as RackingTypeFK,
					   @var_Barcode as Barcode,
					   BuildingName as Building,
					   2 as BarcodeType,
					   BuildingPK,
					   BuildingUnitPK,
					   BuildingName + ' - ' + BuildingUnit  as BuildingUnit,
					   'LoadingBay' as BarcodeStyle 
				   FROM tblLoadingBays tlb
						INNER JOIN tblBuildingUnits ON BuildingUnitPK = BuildingUnitFK
						INNER JOIN tblBuildings ON BuildingPK = BuildingFK
				WHERE Barcode = @var_Barcode and tlb.IsArchived=0
			return
			END
			ELSE
			if (@barcodeType = 'STAS')
			BEGIN
				   SELECT 
					   1 as returnStatus,		
					   SetDownArea as Customer,
					   0 as LocationFK,
					   0 as LocationTypeFK,
					   0 as PalletPK,
					   BuildingUnit as Batch,
					   0 as customerPalletNumber,
					   '' as StockCode,
					   0 as Units,
					   0 as pallettype,
					   SetDownArea as Location,
					   0 as RackingTypeFK,
					   '' as Location,
					   @var_Barcode as Barcode,
					   BuildingName as Building,
					   3 as BarcodeType,
					   BuildingPK,
					   BuildingUnitPK,
					   BuildingName + ' - ' + BuildingUnit  as BuildingUnit,
					   'SetDownArea' as BarcodeStyle 
				   FROM tblSetDownAreas tsd
						INNER JOIN tblBuildingUnits ON BuildingUnitPK = BuildingUnitFK
						INNER JOIN tblBuildings ON BuildingPK = BuildingFK
				WHERE Barcode = @var_Barcode and tsd.IsArchived=0
				RETURN
			END
			ELSE
			if (@barcodeType = 'STAC')
			BEGIN
				SELECT 1 as returnStatus,
					   0 as LocationFK,
					   0 as LocationTypeFK,
					   0 as PalletPK,
					   BuildingUnit as Batch,
					   0 as customerPalletNumber,
					   '' as StockCode,
					   0 as Units,
					   0 as pallettype,
						BuildingUnitBayLocation as Location,
					   0 as RackingTypeFK,
					   @var_Barcode as Barcode,
					   BuildingName as Building,
					   4 as BarcodeType,
					   BuildingPK,
					   BuildingUnitPK,
					   BuildingName + ' - ' + BuildingUnit  as BuildingUnit,
						'Cell' as BarcodeStyle   
					from
					viewBuildingUnitBays vBub       
				WHERE Barcode = @var_Barcode AND IsArchived = 0		/* Damien #DEV-910 Exclude Archived Bays*/ 
				RETURN
			END
			ELSE
			if (@barcodeType = 'STAF')
			BEGIN
				   SELECT 
					   1 as returnStatus,		
					   FLoorLocation as Customer,
					   0 as LocationFK,
					   0 as LocationTypeFK,
					   0 as PalletPK,
					   BuildingUnit as Batch,
					   0 as customerPalletNumber,
					   '' as StockCode,
					   0 as Units,
					   0 as pallettype,
					   FloorLocation as Location,
					   0 as RackingTypeFK,
					   '' as Location,
					   @var_Barcode as Barcode,
					   BuildingName as Building,
					   3 as BarcodeType,
					   BuildingPK,
					   BuildingUnitPK,
					   BuildingName + ' - ' + BuildingUnit  as BuildingUnit,
						'Floor' as BarcodeStyle  
				   FROM tblFloorLocations tfl
						INNER JOIN tblBuildingUnits ON BuildingUnitPK = BuildingUnitFK
						INNER JOIN tblBuildings ON BuildingPK = BuildingFK
				WHERE Barcode = @var_Barcode and tfl.IsArchived=0
			END
			ELSE IF (@barcodeType = 'STAM')
			BEGIN
				SELECT 1 as returnStatus,
					   0 as LocationFK,
					   0 as LocationTypeFK,
					   0 as PalletPK,
					   Name as Batch,
					   0 as customerPalletNumber,
					   '' as StockCode,
					   0 as Units,
					   0 as pallettype,
						Make + ' ' + Model as Location,
					   0 as RackingTypeFK,
					   @var_Barcode as Barcode,
					   FleetNumber as Building,
					   5 as BarcodeType,
						'Machine' as BarcodeStyle
					from
					tblWarehouseMachines      
				WHERE Barcode = @var_Barcode and IsArchived=0
				RETURN	
			END 
			ELSE
			BEGIN
				-- check to see if the palletexist
				IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#tmpScannedPallet') IS NOT NULL
					DROP TABLE #tmpScannedPallet

				SELECT PalletPK, PalletTypeFK, Barcode, CustomerBarcode, CustomerPalletNumber, BuildingUnitFK, LocationFK, tp.LocationTypeFK, PalletStart, PalletEnd, BayPosition, PalletStatusFK, IsArchived
				INTO #tmpScannedPallet
				FROM dbo.tblPallets tp
				WHERE (Barcode = @var_Barcode OR CustomerBarcode = @var_Barcode)

				if NOT exists (select PalletPK from #tmpScannedPallet where (Barcode= @var_Barcode OR CustomerBarcode= @var_Barcode))
				BEGIN
					select 2 as returnStatus, 'Pallet Not Setup on the System' as ReturnMessage
					return
				END

				-- check to see if the pallet is archived 
				if not exists (select * from #tmpScannedPallet where isarchived = 0)
				BEGIN
					select 3 as returnStatus, 'Pallet is no longer in the warehouse' as ReturnMessage
					return
				END 
					-- check to see if On Route
				if exists (select * from #tmpScannedPallet where  isArchived = 0 AND palletStatusFK = 10)
				BEGIN
					select 4 as returnStatus, 'Pallet ' + @var_Barcode + ' is On Route' as ReturnMessage
					return
				END 
			
				SELECT @PalletPK = palletpk from #tmpScannedPallet where isarchived = 0

				SELECT DISTINCT
					1 as ReturnStatus,
					DivisionName as Customer,
					tpal.LocationFK,
					tpal.LocationTypeFK,
					tpal.PalletPK,
					tpc.Batch,
					tpal.CustomerPalletNumber,
					StockItemCode as StockCode,
					tpc.ActualUnits as Units,
					pt.PalletType,
					case WHEN palletLocation.Building is null then palletLocation.Location ELSE palletLocation.Building + ' '  + palletLocation.Location END as Location,
					palletLocation.RackingTypeFK,
					@var_Barcode  as Barcode,
					1 as BarcodeType,
					tpal.BuildingUnitFK,
					BuildingPK,
					'STAWMS' as BarcodeStyle
				from #tmpScannedPallet tpal 
				inner JOIN (
					select palletfk, sum(ActualUnits) as ActualUnits , stockitemFK, batch
					from tblpalletcontent pc 
					where palletfk = @PalletPk
					group by pc.palletfk , stockitemFK, batch
				) as tpc on tpc.palletfk = tpal.palletpk
				INNER JOIN tblStockItems si on si.StockItemPK = tpc.StockItemFK
				INNER JOIN viewPalletLocations palletLocation ON  palletLocation.palletPK = tpal.palletPK
				LEFT outer join tblDivisions div on div.divisionPk=si.DivisionFk
				LEFT outer JOIN tblPalletTypes pt ON pt.PalletTypePK=tpal.PalletTypeFK
				where tpal.IsArchived = 0 and tpal.PalletStatusFK not in (10)
			END
			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end

			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END
GO

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spMobileBuildingUnits]
(
	@BuildingPK as int = -1,
	@UserFK AS int = -1
)	
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT
 ,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;
	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	DECLARE @var_BuildingPK int, @var_userFK int

	SET @var_BuildingPK = @BuildingPK
	SET @var_userFK = @UserFK

	SET @ParameterDetails = '@BuildingPK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_BuildingPK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + '@UserfK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_userFK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'')

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    --BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

		SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END


	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY
			

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start

			if(@var_BuildingPK > 0)
			begin
				select buildingunitPK, buildingunit
				FROM tblBuildingUnits tbuU 
				where  buildingfk = @var_BuildingPK
			end
			else
			begin
				SELECT BuildingUnitPK, buildings.BuildingName + ' - ' + bus.BuildingUnit as BuildingUnitName	
				FROM dbo.tblBuildingUnits AS bus
				inner join tblBuildings AS buildings on buildings.BuildingPK = bus.BuildingFK
				inner join tblUserBuildingUnits AS uBus on uBus.BuildingUnitFK = bus.BuildingUnitPK AND uBus.UserFK = @var_userFK
				Order By  buildings.BuildingName + ' - ' + bus.BuildingUnit
			end
			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end		
			
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END

   -- RETURN

   -- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end

  BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */  
   DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;  
   SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;  
   SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;  
  
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY   
   BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;  
         
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;  
  
            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID  
              
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;  
              
   IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)  
   BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END  
   ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */  
  END CATCH  
  SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1  
 END

-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spMobileBuildStockInCustomersPerBuilding]
(
	@buildingUnitFK as int
)	
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT
 ,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;
	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	DECLARE @var_buildingUnitFK int

	SET @var_buildingUnitFK = @buildingUnitFK

	SET @ParameterDetails = '@buildingUnitFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_buildingUnitFK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'')

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    --BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

		SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END


	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY
			

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start

			IF exists (
				select distinct buildingunitfk 
				from tblcustomers cus
				inner join tbldivisions div on customerpk = customerfk
				inner join tbldivisionBuildingUnits dbu on divisionfk = divisionpk and dbu.IsArchived = 0 
				where div.AllowNewContainerInsFromHandheld = 1
				  and buildingunitfk = @var_buildingUnitFK)--in (select buildingunitpk from tblbuildingunits where buildingfk = @var_buildingFK)) 
			BEGIN
				select distinct 1 as returnStatus		
				
				RETURN 
			END	
			ELSE
			BEGIN
				select 0 as returnStatus
				RETURN
			END

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end

			
			
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END

-- =============================================
-- Author:		Rachael Sherry
-- Create date: 19/05/2016
-- Description:	checks if the loading bay scanned is assigned to the choosen custoemr

-- Return Status 0 - Success
-- Return Status 1 - Loading Bay does not exist
-- Return Status 2 - BuildingUnit not assigned to customer
-- Return Status 3 - Building Unit not setup on the system
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spMobileBuildStockInLoadingBayDetails]
(
	@barcode nvarchar (200),
	@CustomerFK int
)	
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT
 ,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;
	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	DECLARE @var_barcode nvarchar(200), @var_CustomerFK int

	SET @var_barcode = @barcode; SET @var_CustomerFK = @CustomerFK

	SET @ParameterDetails = '@barcode = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_barcode AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@CustomerFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_CustomerFK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'')

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    --BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

		SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END


	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY
			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start			
			IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#tmpLoadingBay') IS NOT NULL
				DROP TABLE #tmpLoadingBay
			select * INTO #tmpLoadingBay from tblloadingbays where barcode = @var_barcode AND dbo.tblloadingbays.IsArchived = 0

			-- check the loading bay exists
			if not exists (select * from #tmpLoadingBay)
			BEGIN
				SELECT 1 as returnStatus, 'Loading Bay Not Setup' as returnMessage 
				RETURN
			END

			DECLARE @CustomerName nvarchar(200) 
			select @CustomerName  = CustomerName from tblCustomers where customerPK = @var_CustomerFK 

			-- check the building unit is assigned to the Customer
			if exists (
			select buildingunitfk from #tmpLoadingBay where buildingunitfk in (
				select distinct buildingunitfk 
				from tblDivisionBuildingUnits dbu
				INNER JOIN tbldivisions ON divisionfk = divisionpk AND customerFK = @var_CustomerFK
				where dbu.IsArchived=0))
			BEGIN
					select 0 as returnStatus,
						'Success' as returnMessage,
						buildingUnitFK,
						loadingBayPK,
						BuildingName + ' - ' + BuildingUnit + ' - ' + loadingBay as destination 
						from #tmpLoadingBay 
						inner join tblbuildingunits on buildingunitfk = buildingunitpk 
						inner join tblBuildings on buildingpk = buildingfk 
					RETURN
			END
			ELSE
			BEGIN
				-- check if the building unit is setup 
				IF not exists (SELECT * from #tmpLoadingBay INNER JOIN tblBuildingUnits on buildingUnitFK = BuildingUnitPK)
				BEGIN
					SELECT 3 as returnStatus, 'Building Unit not setup for ' + LoadingBay as returnMessage FROM #tmpLoadingBay 
				END
				ELSE
				BEGIN
					SELECT 2 as returnStatus,
							BuildingName + ' - ' + BuildingUnit + ' not assigned to ' + @CustomerName as returnMessage
						from #tmpLoadingBay 
						inner join tblBuildingunits on buildingunitfk = buildingUnitPK
						inner join tblBuildings on buildingfk = buildingpk
				END
			END

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end

			
			
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END

/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[spMobileBuildStockItemDetails]    Script Date: 02/11/2026 17:47:27 ******/

-- =============================================        
-- Author:  Rachael Sherry        
-- Create date: 18/05/2016        
-- Description - Return Stock Code details         
-- called from - Stock In Build a Stock In without headers         
-- -- ReturnValue 0 = success         
--             1 = StockItem Does Not Exist (no EAN code)        
--      2 = StockItem not in Use (stock Code is archived)        
--      3 = Division Not Assigned to Stock Code ( divisionFK  = -1)        
--             4 = Stock Code not setup for customer        
--             5 = division not assigned to building Unit (scanned Loading Bay)        
--      6 = Multiple StockItem assigned to the EAN Code        
--      7 = Division assigned to Stock Code does not Exists        
-- =============================================        
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spMobileBuildStockItemDetails]        
(        
     @customerfk int,        
     @EANCode nvarchar(200),        
     @buildingUnitfk int        
)         
AS        
BEGIN        
 /* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */        
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED        
        
    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT        
 ,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;        
 SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();        
        
 -- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters        
 DECLARE @var_customerfk int, @var_EANCode nvarchar(200), @var_buildingUnitfk int        
 SET @var_customerfk = @customerfk; SET @var_EANCode = @EANCode; SET @var_buildingUnitfk = @buildingUnitfk        
 SET @ParameterDetails = '@customerfk = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_customerfk AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@EANCode = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_EANCode AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'')         
  + ',@buildingUnitfk = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_buildingUnitfk AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'')        
        
    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL         
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)        
        
    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)        
    --BEGIN        
   SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC         
        
   SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)        
        
   INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)        
   SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK        
        
   SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()        
    --END        
        
        
 SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);        
 SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails        
 ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;        
 INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()        
        
 WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3        
 BEGIN         
  BEGIN TRY        
   -- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start        
   DECLARE @StockItemCount int         
   DECLARE @BuildingUnitName nvarchar(200)        
   DECLARE @CustomerName nvarchar(200)        
   DECLARE @StockItemCode nvarchar(200)        
   DECLARE @DivisionFK int        
   DECLARE @DivisionName nvarchar(200)        
           
   SELECT @buildingUnitName = BuildingName + ' ' + BuildingUnit         
  from tblBuildingUnits        
   inner join tblBuildings on buildingpk = buildingFK          
   where buildingUnitPK = @var_buildingUnitfk        
        
   IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#tmpStockItems') IS NOT NULL        
    DROP TABLE #tmpStockItems        

   --Useing DISTINCT so that if the same stock item has the scanned EAN in both EANCode and EANCode2.it will appear only once in #tmpStockItems.
   SELECT DISTINCT
       StockItemPK,
       StockItemCode,
       DivisionFK,
       IsArchived,
       DefaultPalletTypeFK,
       EanCode,
       EanCode2 INTO #tmpStockItems FROM tblstockitems WHERE (EanCode = @var_EANCode OR EANCode2 = @var_EANCode)        
        
   IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#tmpDivision') IS NOT NULL        
    DROP TABLE #tmpDivision        
   SELECT * INTO #tmpDivision FROM dbo.tblDivisions td WHERE CustomerFK = @var_customerfk        
        
   SELECT @CustomerName = CustomerName from tblCustomers where CustomerPK = @var_customerfk         
        
   SELECT @StockItemCode = StockItemCode,        
       @DivisionFK = DivisionFK,        
       @DivisionName = DivisionName         
   from #tmpStockItems         
   left outer JOIN #tmpDivision div on DivisionPK = DivisionFK        
   order by DivisionPK      
                   
   -- check if EAN code exists for a division assigned to the customer selected and is in use        
   if exists (select StockItemCode from #tmpStockItems  where IsArchived = 0 AND DivisionFK in (select DivisionPK from #tmpDivision))        
   BEGIN         
    --check if there are more than one stockitem with the same EAN Code        
    -- SELECT @StockItemCount = count(*)         
    -- from #tmpStockItems         
    -- where isarchived = 0 and divisionFK in (select divisionPK from #tmpDivision)        
    -- group by divisionFK        
        
    -- If (@StockItemCount > 1)         
    -- BEGIN         
    --  select '' as stockitemcode, -1 as divisionFK,         
    --   -1   as DefaultPalletTypeFK,6 as returnStatus, 'Multiple Stock Exists for EANCode ' + @var_EANCode as returnMessage        
    --  Return        
    -- END          
    
    -- Treat duplicates within the same stock code as one.
    -- Only error when the scanned EAN maps to more than one distinct stock code.
     -- Count distinct stock items using this EAN  
      DECLARE @DistinctStockCodeCount INT =  
      (  
          SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT StockItemCode)  
          FROM #tmpStockItems  
          WHERE IsArchived = 0  
            AND DivisionFK IN (SELECT DivisionPK FROM #tmpDivision)  
      );                    
              
      --If scanned EAN is present on more than one different stock code 
      IF (@DistinctStockCodeCount > 1)  
      BEGIN  
          SELECT '' AS stockitemcode,  
                 -1 AS divisionFK,  
                 -1 AS DefaultPalletTypeFK,  
                 6 AS returnStatus,  
                 'Multiple Stock Exists for EANCode ' + @var_EANCode as returnMessage;  
          RETURN;  
      END;  
  
     -- check if division is setup to build from scratch        
     IF NOT EXISTS( SELECT DivisionPK from #tmpDivision WHERE DivisionPK = @DivisionFK AND AllowNewContainerInsFromHandHeld = 1)        
     BEGIN        
      SELECT  '' as stockitemcode, -1 as divisionFK,         
       -1   as DefaultPalletTypeFK, 7 as returnStatus, 'Division ' + @DivisionName + ' not Setup for Creating Goods In' as returnMessage        
      RETURN        
     END        
  
       -- check that the division assigned to the Stock Code is assiged to the building scanned        
     if (@var_buildingUnitfk < 1)         
     BEGIN         
     -- Can go ahead with this stock Code        
      select stockitemcode, divisionFK,         
       CASE WHEN defaultPalletTypeFK = -1 THEN 36 ELSE DefaultPalletTypeFK  END as DefaultPalletTypeFK, 0 as returnStatus, 'Success' as returnMessage         
      from #tmpStockItems        
      return        
     END        
     else if exists (select stk.divisionfk from #tmpStockItems stk inner join tbldivisionBuildingUnits dbu on dbu.divisionfk = stk.divisionfk and dbu.IsArchived=0  where dbu.buildingunitfk = @var_buildingUnitfk)        
     BEGIN        
     -- Can go ahead with this stock Code        
      select stockitemcode, divisionFK,         
       CASE WHEN defaultPalletTypeFK = -1 THEN 36 ELSE DefaultPalletTypeFK END as DefaultPalletTypeFK, 0 as returnStatus, 'Success' as returnMessage         
      from #tmpStockItems where DivisionFK = @DivisionFK        
     END        
     ELSE        
     BEGIN        
      -- division is not assigned to the building unit scanned        
      SELECT  '' as stockitemcode, -1 as divisionFK,         
       -1   as DefaultPalletTypeFK,5 as returnStatus, 'BuildingUnit ' + @BuildingUnitName + ' not assigned to ' + divisionname as returnMessage        
      from #tmpDivision  where DivisionPK = @DivisionFK        
      RETURN        
     END        
   END        
   ELSE        
   BEGIN        
    -- Reasons why stock Code is not available        
    -- Check if EAN code exists        
    if not exists (SELECT * from #tmpStockItems)        
    BEGIN        
     SELECT  '' as stockitemcode, -1 as divisionFK,         
       -1   as DefaultPalletTypeFK,1 as returnStatus, 'Stock Code Does not Exist' as returnMessage         
     RETURN         
    END        
          
    -- check if stockitem is archived        
    ELSE if exists (SELECT * from #tmpStockItems where isArchived = 1)        
    BEGIN            
     SELECT  '' as stockitemcode, -1 as divisionFK,         
       -1   as DefaultPalletTypeFK, 2 as returnStatus, 'Stock Code not in Use' as returnMessage        
     RETURN        
    END            
    -- Division is -1        
    ELSE if (exists (SELECT * from #tmpStockItems where isarchived = 0 and divisionfk = -1))        
    -- check stock Code is not assigned to customer or division         
    BEGIN        
     SELECT   '' as stockitemcode, -1 as divisionFK,         
       -1   as DefaultPalletTypeFK,3 as returnStatus, 'Stock Code not assigned to a Division' as returnMessage        
     RETURN        
    END           
    -- check that the division assigned to the Stock Code exists         
    ELSE if not exists (Select * from #tmpDivision div inner join #tmpStockItems stk on divisionpk = divisionfk)        
    BEGIN        
        IF @StockItemCode is null         
      Select @StockItemCode = stockitemcode from #tmpStockItems        
     SELECT  '' as stockitemcode, -1 as divisionFK,         
       -1   as DefaultPalletTypeFK,7 as returnStatus, ' Division for Stock Code ' + @StockItemCOde + ' is not setup for this customer' as returnMessage        
     Return        
    END          
    -- check that the division assigned to the stock Code is assigned to the selected customer        
    ELSE if not exists (SELECT * from #tmpStockItems where divisionFK in (select divisionPK from #tmpDivision))        
    BEGIN        
     SELECT  '' as stockitemcode, -1 as divisionFK,         
       -1   as DefaultPalletTypeFK, 4 as returnStatus, 'Stock Code not setup for Customer ' + @customerName as returnMessage        
     Return        
    END        
    -- check that the division assigned to the Stock Code is assiged to the building scanned        
    ELSE  if (@var_buildingUnitfk > 0)        
    BEGIN        
     if not exists (select stk.divisionfk from #tmpStockItems stk inner join tbldivisionBuildingUnits dbu on dbu.divisionfk = stk.divisionfk and dbu.IsArchived = 0 where  dbu.buildingunitfk = @var_buildingUnitfk)        
     BEGIN        
      -- division is not assigned to the building unit scanned        
      SELECT  '' as stockitemcode, -1 as divisionFK,         
       -1   as DefaultPalletTypeFK, 5 as returnStatus, @BuildingUnitName + ' not assigned to ' + divisionname as returnMessage        
      from #tmpDivision        
      where DivisionPK = @DivisionFK        
      RETURN        
     END         
    END        
    ELSE         
    BEGIN         
     SELECT  '' as stockitemcode, -1 as divisionFK,         
       -1   as DefaultPalletTypeFK, 4 as returnStatus, 'Stock Code not setup for Customer ' + @customerName as returnMessage        
     Return        
    END        
   END         
   -- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end         
   BREAK        
  END TRY        
  BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */        
   DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;        
   SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;        
   SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;        
        
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY         
   BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;        
               
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;        
        
            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID        
                    
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;        
                    
   IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)        
   BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END        
   ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */        
  END CATCH        
  SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1        
 END        
END

-- =============================================
-- Author:		Rachael Sherry
-- Create date: 8/09/2016
-- Description:	Checks if the Pallet Status of the pallet is allowed on a Pick
--				1 = Allowed
--				0 = Not Allowed
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spMobileCheckPalletStatusForPick]
(
	@barcode as nvarchar(200)
)	
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT
 ,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;
	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	DECLARE @var_barcode nvarchar(200)
	SET @var_barcode = @barcode
	SET @ParameterDetails = '@barcode = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_barcode AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'')

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    --BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

		SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END


	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY
			

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start
	    
			DECLARE @PalletStatusFK int 

			SELECT @PalletStatusFK = palletStatusfk from tblpallets 
			where (barcode = @var_barcode OR CustomerBarcode = @var_barcode)
			AND isarchived = 0 

			-- check if the status is blocked from going out
			IF EXISTS ( SELECT palletStatusFK from tblPalletStatusNotAllowedOut
						where palletSTatusFK = @PalletStatusFK)
			BEGIN
				SELECT 0 as returnStatus
				RETURN 
			END
			ELSE
			BEGIN
				SELECT 1 as returnStatus
				RETURN 
			END

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end

			
			
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END
GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[spMobileCheckStockOut]    Script Date: 02/11/2026 17:47:27 ******/

-- =============================================  
-- Author:  Rachael sherry  
-- Create date: 1/4/2014  
-- Description: Checks if a container Out has one of the following  
--    1. No Works Order Movements Setup  
--    2. Not Stock Orders Assigned to the Container Out  
--    3. Rows Left on Pick  
--              5. Pick Complete- All Pallets Laoded  
--              4. All pallets picked but not all loaded  
-- =============================================  
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spMobileCheckStockOut]  
(  
 @ContainerOutFK int,  
 @BuildingUnitFK int,  
 @UserFK int  
)   
AS  
BEGIN  
 /* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */  
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED  
  
    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT  
 ,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;  
 SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();  
  
 -- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters  
 DECLARE @var_ContainerOutFK int, @var_BuildingUnitFK int, @var_UserFK int  
 SET @var_ContainerOutFK = @ContainerOutFK; SET @var_BuildingUnitFK = @BuildingUnitFK; SET @var_UserFK = @UserFK  
 SET @ParameterDetails = '@ContainerOutFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_ContainerOutFK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@BuildingUnitFK = '   
  + ISNULL(CAST(@var_BuildingUnitFK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@UserFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_UserFK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'')  
  
    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL   
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)  
  
    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)  
    --BEGIN  
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC   
  
  SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)  
  
        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)  
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK  
  
        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()  
    --END  
  
  
 SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);  
 SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails  
 ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;  
 INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()  
  
 WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3  
 BEGIN   
  BEGIN TRY  
     
  
   -- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start  
  
   --IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#tmpReturn') IS NOT NULL        -- Delete  the temporary table if it already exists  
   --     DROP TABLE #tmpReturn  
  
   --    create table #tmpReturn( ReturnStatus  int);  
  
   IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#tmpStockOrders') IS NOT NULL  
    DROP TABLE #tmpStockOrders  
   SELECT * INTO #tmpStockOrders FROM dbo.tblStockOrders tso WHERE containerOutFk = @var_ContainerOutFK  
        
   IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#tmpWorksOrders') IS NOT NULL  
    DROP TABLE #tmpWorksOrders  
   SELECT wo.* INTO #tmpWorksOrders   
   FROM dbo.tblWorksOrders wo  
   INNER JOIN #tmpStockOrders ON FK = StockOrderPK  
   WHERE WorksOrderOriginFK = 2 /*Stock Order*/ AND WorksOrderTypeFK = 3  
  
   --SELECT * FROM #tmpWorksOrders  
  
   -- check if StockOrders are assigned to the ContainerOut  
   if (Not Exists (SELECT stockOrderPk FROM #tmpStockOrders))  
   BEGIN  
    SELECT 1 as returnstatus;  
    RETURN;  
   END  
   else  
   BEGIN  
   -- Check if Works Order Movements have been assigned to the Stock  
    if (NOT EXISTS(SELECT WorksOrderMovementPK FROM #tmpWorksOrders wos INNER JOIN tblWorksOrderMovements woms ON wos.WorksOrderPK = woms.WorksOrderFK))  
    BEGIN     
     SELECT 2 as returnStatus;  
     RETURN;  
    END  
    -- check if there are any rows left on the pick  
    ELSE  if exists (select palletPK FROM tblContainerOutLines tCoL   
        INNER JOIN tblContainerOutLinePalletContent tColP ON tColP.ContainerOutLineFK = tCol.ContainerOutLinePK   
        INNER JOIN (select PalletPK, locationFK FROM tblPallets WHERE LocationTypeFK  = 1 AND buildingUnitFK = @var_BuildingUnitFK ) tPAl   
        ON tPAl.PalletPK = tColP.PalletFK  
        WHERE TCoL.ContainerOutFK = @var_ContainerOutFK )  
     BEGIN  
       SELECT * FROM   
       (SELECT tBuR.buildingunitfk,  
       CASE    
        when tBuR.Translate = 1 then  
         tBuR.TranslatedRow   
        when tBuR.Translate = 0 then  
         tBuR.Row   
       end as 'Row' ,  
       tBud.BuildingUnit ,  
       3 as returnStatus  
       FROM tblContainerOutLines tCoL   
       INNER JOIN tblContainerOutLinePalletContent tColP ON tColP.ContainerOutLineFK = tCol.ContainerOutLinePK   
       INNER JOIN (select PalletPK, locationFK FROM tblPallets WHERE LocationTypeFK  = 1 ) tPAl ON tPAl.PalletPK = tColP.PalletFK  
       INNER JOIN tblBuildingUnitBays tBub ON tBub.BuildingUnitBayPK = tPAl.LocationFK  
       INNER JOIN tblBuildingUnitColumns tBuC ON tBuC.BuildingUnitColumnPK = tBub.BuildingUnitColumnFK  
       INNER JOIN tblBuildingUnitRows tBuR ON tBuR.BuildingUnitRowPK = tBuC.BuildingUnitRowFK   
       INNER JOIN tblBuildingUnits tBud ON tBud.BuildingUnitPK = tBuR.BuildingUnitFK  
       WHERE TCoL.ContainerOutFK = @var_ContainerOutFK  
         AND tBuR.BuildingUnitFK = @var_BuildingUnitFK) as RowsLeft  
         
       GROUP BY BuildingUnitFK, Row, RowsLeft.BuildingUnit,returnStatus  
       ORDER BY BuildingUnitFK, Row  
       RETURN  
     END  
     -- Now check if all the pallets are all loaded  
     if  not exists (select worksordermovementpk, dbo.fnMobileStockOutLoadedStatus(WorksOrderMovementPK) Loaded   
         FROM #tmpWorksOrders wos   
         INNER JOIN  tblWorksOrderMovements woms on woms.WorksOrderFK = wos.WorksOrderPK  
         where dbo.fnMobileStockOutLoadedStatus(WorksOrderMovementPK) = 0)  
      BEGIN  
       -- Check if the worksorders is complete  
  
         if NOT EXISTS (  
            Select worksorderFK  
            from tblWorksOrderMovements wom  
            INNER JOIN #tmpWorksOrders wos ON worksorderfk = worksorderpk  
            Where wom.WorksOrderStatusFK not in (3,4) AND wos.WorksOrderStatusFK < 3) -- Still open  
         BEGIN  
          IF XACT_STATE() = 0 AND @@TRANCOUNT < 1 BEGIN TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName  
  
             -- Complete the WorksOrder as there are no more open worksordermovements  
           UPDATE tblWorksOrders WITH (ROWLOCK)   
             SET WorksOrderStatusFK = 3,  
              UpdatedBy = @var_UserFK,  
              UpdatedDate = dbo.GetBSTDate()  
           WHERE WorksOrderPK IN (SELECT WorksOrderPK FROM #tmpWorksOrders two where WorksOrderStatusFK < 3)  
  
          BEGIN TRY IF XACT_STATE() = 1 AND @@TRANCOUNT = 1 AND @OpeningTranCount < 1 COMMIT TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH  
         END  
         
       IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#tmpContainerInfo') IS NOT NULL  
        DROP TABLE #tmpContainerInfo  
  
       CREATE TABLE #tmpContainerInfo  
       (  
          ContainerOutStatusFK int,   
          LorryNumber nvarchar(50),   
          ContainerNumber nvarchar(50),   
          SealNumber nvarchar(50),   
          ShippingCompany nvarchar(50),   
          TransportCompany nvarchar(50),   
          PickLoaded bit,   
          PickLoadedDate datetime,  
          DivisionReleaseCheck bit,   
          ContainerReleaseCheck bit,   
          ContainerOutReleaseStatusFK int,  
          ExportContainerOutPickLoaded bit,   
          DelayContainerOutPickLoaded bit,   
          LastPalletLoaded datetime  
       )  
  
       INSERT INTO #tmpContainerInfo  
        Exec [spContainerOutCompletionInfo] @var_ContainerOutFK-- '86012'  
  
       --SELECT * FROM #tmpContainerInfo  
  
       if((SELECT ExportContainerOutPickLoaded FROM #tmpContainerInfo) = 1)  
       BEGIN  
        if((SELECT DelayContainerOutPickLoaded FROM #tmpContainerInfo)=1)  
        BEGIN  
         SELECT 5 as returnStatus, 'Pick loaded file will be sent to customer when order is completed' AS returnMessage  
         return  
        END  
        ELSE IF ((SELECT PickLoaded FROM #tmpContainerInfo) =1)  
        begin  
         SELECT 5 as returnStatus, 'Pick loaded file has been sent to customer' AS returnMessage  
         return  
        END  
  
        DECLARE @currentmin int = datepart(minute, dbo.GetBSTDate())  
        DECLARE @sendMin nvarchar(10) = ':00'  
        IF(@currentmin <= 10)  
         SET @sendMin = ':10'  
        ELSE IF (@currentmin > 10 AND @currentmin <= 20)  
         SET @sendMin = ':20'  
        ELSE IF (@currentmin > 20 AND @currentmin <= 30)  
         SET @sendMin = ':30'  
        ELSE IF (@currentmin > 30 AND @currentmin <= 40)  
         SET @sendMin = ':40'  
        ELSE IF (@currentmin > 40 AND @currentmin <= 50)  
         SET @sendMin = ':50'  
  
        DECLARE @currentHour int  
        set @currentHour = datepart(hour, dbo.GetBSTDate())  
        if(@sendMin = ':00')  
         set @currentHour = @currentHour+1  
  
        SELECT 5 as returnStatus, 'Pick loaded file will be sent at approx ' + CAST(@currentHour as varchar(10)) + CAST(@sendMin as varchar(10))  AS returnMessage  
        return  
       END  
  
       SELECT 5 as returnStatus, ' ' AS returnMessage  
       RETURN    
      END  
      ELSE  
       SELECT 4 as returnStatus;  
   END  
  
   -- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end  
  
     
     
   BREAK  
  END TRY  
  BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */  
   DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;  
   SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;  
   SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;  
  
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY   
   BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;  
         
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;  
  
            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID  
              
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;  
              
   IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)  
   BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END  
   ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */  
  END CATCH  
  SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1  
 END  
END  
GO

-- =============================================    
-- Author:  <Author,,Name>    
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>    
-- Description: <Description,,>    
-- =============================================    
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spMobileCompleteGroupStockIn]    
(    
 @GroupStockInPK int ,
 @userfk int
)     
AS    
BEGIN    
 /* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */    
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED    
    
    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT    
 ,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;    
 SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();    
    
 -- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters    
 DECLARE @var_GroupStockInPK int  ,@var_userfk int   
 SET @var_GroupStockInPK = @GroupStockInPK    SET @var_userfk =@userfk
 SET @ParameterDetails = '@GroupStockInPK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_GroupStockInPK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + 
						 '@userfk = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_userfk AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'')  
    
    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL     
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)    
    
    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)    
    --BEGIN    
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC     
    
  SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)    
    
        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)    
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK    
    
        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()    
    --END    
    
    
 SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);    
 SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails    
 ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;    
 INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()    
    
 WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3    
 BEGIN    
  BEGIN TRY    
   --IF XACT_STATE() = 0 AND @@TRANCOUNT < 1 BEGIN TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName    
    
   -- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start    
   IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#tmpGroupStockIns') IS NOT NULL               
    DROP TABLE #tmpGroupStockIns     
    select StockInPK,StockInGroupFK,ContainerInFK  
    into #tmpGroupStockIns  
    from tblStockins st    
    inner join tblcontainerins con on con.ContainerInPk = st.ContainerinFK   
    where con.StockInGroupFK = @var_GroupStockInPK  
  
  
  
   DECLARE @return int    
   DECLARE @Check bit    
   IF(EXISTS(    
    SELECT PalletPK    
    FROM tblPallets tPal    
    INNER JOIN tblStockInLinePallets silps ON tpal.PalletPK = silps.PalletFK    
    inner JOIN tblStockInLines sils ON sils.StockInLinePK = silps.StockInLineFK  
 inner join #tmpGroupStockIns gs on sils.StockInFK = gs.StockInPK  
    WHERE gs.StockInGroupFK = @var_GroupStockInPK     
    AND LocationTypeFK NOT IN ( 1, 6) /*Racking or Sample Location*/    
    AND tPal.IsArchived = 0    
   ))    
   BEGIN    
    SELECT cast(0 as bit) as Complete    
   END    
   ELSE    
   BEGIN    
  --  DECLARE @containerInPK int    
   -- SELECT @containerInPK = ContainerInFK from tblStockIns st  
 --inner join #tmpGroupStockIns gs on gs.StockInPK =st.StockInPK  
   
 --Where gs.StockInGroupFK = @var_GroupStockInPK    
    
    --This section below updates the stock in to complete when all the pallets are put away    
    --This will be done in another part of the system, in the event that there are extra pallets on the     
    If (EXISTS (select sins.StockInPK from tblStockIns sins   
 inner join #tmpGroupStockIns gs on gs.StockInPK = sins.StockInPK  
 WHERE  gs.StockInGroupFK = @var_GroupStockInPK and stockInStatusFK not in (3,4)))    
    BEGIN    
     IF XACT_STATE() = 0 AND @@TRANCOUNT < 1 BEGIN TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName    
    
     update tblStockIns WITH (ROWLOCK) set StockInStatusFK = 3  
  from tblStockIns si  
    inner join #tmpGroupStockIns gs on gs.StockInPK = si.StockInPK  
  where gs.StockInGroupFK=@var_GroupStockInPK    
  
     -- Check if the Container has any all its stock in complete and if so complete it    
     if(NOT Exists(Select sins.StockInPK from tblStockIns sins  
   inner join #tmpGroupStockIns gs on gs.StockInPK = sins.StockInPK  
 WHERE  gs.StockInGroupFK = @var_GroupStockInPK   
  AND sins.StockInStatusFK in (1,2)/*not Complete OR Cancelled*/) )     
     BEGIN    
      update tblContainerIns  WITH (ROWLOCK)    
      Set StockInStatusFK = 3 /*Complete*/    
      Where StockInGroupFK = @var_GroupStockInPK  
	  
	  INSERT INTO tblcontainerinAudit  ( ContainerInFK,  ContainerInAuditTypeFK, Description , IsArchived, InsertedBy, InsertedDate,UpdatedBy,UpdatedDate) 
SELECT co.containerinpk, 4, 'StocKin Completed' , 0, @var_userfk, getdate(),@var_userfk,GetDate()  FROM tblcontainerins co
where co.StockinGroupfk = @var_GroupStockInPK


     END    
    
     BEGIN TRY IF XACT_STATE() = 1 AND @@TRANCOUNT = 1 AND @OpeningTranCount < 1 COMMIT TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH    
    END    
    
    SELECT cast(1 as bit) as Complete      
   END    
    
   -- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end    
    
   --BEGIN TRY IF XACT_STATE() = 1 AND @@TRANCOUNT = 1 AND @OpeningTranCount < 1 COMMIT TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH    
       
   BREAK    
  END TRY    
  BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */    
   DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;    
   SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;    
   SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;    
    
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY     
   BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;    
           
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;    
    
            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID    
                
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;    
                
   IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)    
   BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END    
   ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */    
  END CATCH    
  SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1    
 END    
END

-- =============================================  
-- Author:  <Author,,Name>  
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>  
-- Description: <Description,,>  
-- =============================================  
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spMobileCompleteStockIn]  
(  
 @StockInPK int ,
 @userfk int
)   
AS  
BEGIN  
 /* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */  
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED  
  
    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT  
 ,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;  
 SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();  
  
 -- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters  
 DECLARE @var_StockInPK int ,@var_userfk int 
 SET @var_StockInPK = @StockInPK  
 SET @var_userfk = @userfk
 SET @ParameterDetails = '@StockInPK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_StockInPK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'')  
  
    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL   
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)  
  
    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)  
    --BEGIN  
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC   
  
  SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)  
  
        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)  
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK  
  
        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()  
    --END  
  
  
 SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);  
 SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails  
 ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;  
 INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()  
  
 WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3  
 BEGIN  
  BEGIN TRY  
   --IF XACT_STATE() = 0 AND @@TRANCOUNT < 1 BEGIN TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName  
  
   -- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start  
  
   DECLARE @return int  
   DECLARE @Check bit  
   IF(EXISTS(  
    SELECT PalletPK  
    FROM tblPallets tPal  
    INNER JOIN tblStockInLinePallets silps ON tpal.PalletPK = silps.PalletFK  
    inner JOIN tblStockInLines sils ON sils.StockInLinePK = silps.StockInLineFK  
    WHERE sils.StockInFK = @var_StockInPK   
    AND LocationTypeFK NOT IN ( 1, 6) /*Racking or Sample Location*/  
    AND tPal.IsArchived = 0  
   ))  
   BEGIN  
    SELECT cast(0 as bit) as Complete  
   END  
   ELSE  
   BEGIN  
    DECLARE @containerInPK int  
    SELECT @containerInPK = ContainerInFK from tblStockIns Where StockInPK = @var_StockInPK  
  
    --This section below updates the stock in to complete when all the pallets are put away  
    --This will be done in another part of the system, in the event that there are extra pallets on the   
    If (EXISTS (select StockInPK from tblStockIns WHERE stockInPK = @var_StockInPK and stockInStatusFK not in (3,4)))  
    BEGIN  
     IF XACT_STATE() = 0 AND @@TRANCOUNT < 1 BEGIN TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName  
  
     update tblStockIns WITH (ROWLOCK) set StockInStatusFK = 3 where StockInPK=@var_StockInPK  
     -- Check if the Container has any all its stock in complete and if so complete it  
     if(NOT Exists(Select sins.StockInPK from tblStockIns sins Where ContainerInFK = @containerInPK AND sins.StockInStatusFK in (1,2)/*not Complete OR Cancelled*/) )  
     BEGIN  
      update tblContainerIns WITH (ROWLOCK)  
      Set StockInStatusFK = 3 /*Complete*/  
      Where ContainerInPK = @containerInPK 
	  
	  insert into  tblcontainerInAudit values (@containerInPK ,4 ,'StockIn Completed', 0,@var_userfk,GetDate(),@var_userfk,GetDate())

	 
     END  
  
     BEGIN TRY IF XACT_STATE() = 1 AND @@TRANCOUNT = 1 AND @OpeningTranCount < 1 COMMIT TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH  
    END  
  
    SELECT cast(1 as bit) as Complete    
   END  
  
   -- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end  
  
   --BEGIN TRY IF XACT_STATE() = 1 AND @@TRANCOUNT = 1 AND @OpeningTranCount < 1 COMMIT TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH  
     
   BREAK  
  END TRY  
  BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */  
   DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;  
   SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;  
   SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;  
  
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY   
   BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;  
         
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;  
  
            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID  
              
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;  
              
   IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)  
   BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END  
   ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */  
  END CATCH  
  SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1  
 END  
END  
GO
