/* =============================================
Returns a table of required GS1 fields for a given ContainerIn
=============================================*/
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spMobileContainerInGS1MandatoryFields]
(
	@containerInPK int
)	
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT
 ,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;
	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	DECLARE @var_containerInPK int
	SET @var_containerInPK = @containerInPK
	SET @ParameterDetails = '@containerInPK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_containerInPK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'')

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    --BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

		SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END


	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY
			

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start
	
			DECLARE @divisionFK int

			Select TOP 1 @divisionFK = sis.DivisionFK 
			From tblContainerInHeaders cihs 
			Inner JOIN tblStockItems sis ON
			sis.StockItemPK = cihs.StockItemFK 
			Where ContainerInFK = @var_containerInPK

			print @divisionFK

			Select AI_1, AI_2, AI_3, AI_4, AI_5
			From tblDivisionGS1MandatoryFields
			Where DivisionFK = @divisionFK

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end

			
			
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END

  -- from tblPallets

  -- AND IsArchived = 0 /*AND OnRoute = 0 and loaded = 0 //LJF 22/04/2015 Dont need this in the clause, Loaded in this table is not used*/  
  --    
  -- Get the Stock In details   
  
   IF (@WorksOrderOriginFK2 <> 10   
   AND EXISTS (SELECT * from tblPallets WHERE PalletPK = @PalletFK AND LocationTypeFK = 1 AND LocationFK = @DestinationFK2 AND IsArchived = 0))  
   BEGIN  
    -- Pallet is already in racking  
    IF (@NoSelectPurelyReturns2 = 0)

   if (@WorksOrderOriginFK2 = 1) -- Stock In

    SET @StockInPK = -1

   SELECT   @Eaches = sum(ActualEaches),      -- Total for all pallet contents on the pallet  
      @Units = sum(ActualUnits) ,     -- Total for all pallet contents on the pallet

   if (@PalletStatusFK = 10 AND @SourceLocationTypeFK < 4 AND @WorksOrderOriginFK2 > 1)

   IF (@PalletContentPK is null)

   -- Get the Source barcode  
   -- 1 = Racking  
   -- 2 = Loading Bay  
   -- 3 = Set Down Area  
   IF (@SourceLocationTypeFK = 3)  
    SELECT @SourceBarcode = Barcode, @SourceLocationText = SetDownArea FROM tblSetDownAreas WHERE SetDownAreaPK = @SourceLocationFK  
   ELSE IF (@SourceLocationTypeFK = 2)  
    SELECT @SourceBarcode = Barcode, @SourceLocationText = LoadingBay FROM tblLoadingBays WHERE LoadingBayPK = @SourceLocationFK  
   ELSE IF (@SourceLocationTypeFK = 1)  
    SELECT @SourceBarcode = Barcode, @SourceLocationText = buildingUnitBayLocation FROM viewBuildingUnitBays WHERE BuildingUnitBayPK = @SourceLocationFK and locationtypefk  =1  
   ELSE IF (@sourceLocationTypeFK = 4)  
    SELECT @SourceBarcode = 'Container', @SourceLocationText = 'Container'

     -- check if the source location exists

      SET @WorksOrderFK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()  
     END  
     ELSE  
      SELECT @WorksOrderFK = worksorderPK from tblWorksOrders  WHERE fk = @StockInPK AND WorksOrderOriginFK = 1 AND WorksOrderStatusFK IN(1,2)  
  
    END -- worksorder exists for stock in  
    ELSE  
    BEGIN

     IF XACT_STATE() = 0 AND @@TRANCOUNT < 1 BEGIN TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName

     VALUES (1,-1,@WorksOrderOriginFK2,@StockInPK,3,-1,-1,0,dbo.GetBSTDate(),0,dbo.GetBSTDate(),0,dbo.GetBSTDate(),0,dbo.GetBSTDate(),0,dbo.GetBSTDate(),

     SET @WorksOrderFK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()  
    END -- works order does not exist for stock in   
  
    -- set the message     
    SET @Msg  = (@HandHeldOrStawmsHandheldText+' - Move Pallet Barcode : ' + @Barcode2 + ' FROM ' + @SourceLocationText +  ' - To - ' + @DestinationLocationText)  
    PRINT @Msg  
    -- Always attempt to begin a transaction before updating, inserting or deleting records in a permanent table  
    IF XACT_STATE() = 0 AND @@TRANCOUNT < 1 BEGIN TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName  
  
    PRINT 'creating worksordermovement'  
    -- Create the WorksOrderMovement  
    -- gets the last workOrderPK created for that StockIn  
    INSERT INTO tblWorksOrderMovements   
    VALUES(  
    ISNULL(@WorksOrderFk , -1),   
    1, @PalletFK, -1,-1,1,   
    ISNULL(@Eaches, -1),  
    ISNULL(@Units, -1),  
    ISNULL (@SourceLocationTypeFK, -1),  
    ISNULL (@SourceLocationFK, -1),  
    ISNULL (@SourceBayPosition,-1),  
    ISNULL (@SourceStackPosition, -1),  
    ISNULL (@DestinationLocationType2, -1),   
    ISNULL (@DestinationFK2, -1),   
    ISNULL (@DestinationBayPosition2, -1),  
    ISNULL (@DestinationStackPosition2, -1),  
    ISNULL (@DestinationStart2, -1),  
    ISNULL (@DestinationEnd2, -1) ,      
    @Msg,   
    0, @UserId2, dbo.GetBSTDate(),@UserId2,  
    dbo.GetBSTDate(), -1, @HandheldDeviceFK2 , @WarehouseMachineFK2)
             
  --  set @WorksOrderMovementPK = @@identity  
    set @WorksOrderMovementPK  = SCOPE_IDENTITY()  
    --@WorksOderMovmentFK      
  
    --if (@WorksOrderOriginFK2 = 10 OR @SourceLocationTypeFK = 4 OR @DestinationLocationType2 = 6) -- manual movement  
    --if (@WorksOrderOriginFK2 = 10 OR  @DestinationLocationType2 = 6) -- manual movement  Or going to Sample Location  
    --BEGIN  
     -- complete the worksordermovment  
     PRINT 'exec [spWorksOrderMovementStatusChange]'  
     insert into #tmpReturn EXEC [dbo].[spWorksOrderMovementStatusChange]  
     @worksOrderMovementPK ,  
     @worksOrderStatusFK = 3,  
     @currentUserFK = @UserId2     
  
     --Print 'cell movement'  
     Select @ReturnStatus =  ReturnStatus From #tmpReturn   
     PRINT 'status change result'  
     PRINT @ReturnStatus  
     if (@ReturnStatus = 1)  
     BEGIN  
       -- if coming off a container and not going to sample or racking then reopen the worksordermovements  
  --    if (@SourceLocationTypeFK  = 4 AND (@DestinationLocationType2 <> 1 OR @DestinationLocationType2 <> 6))  
  --    BEGIN  
  --     UPDATE tblWorksOrderMovements WITH (ROWLOCK)  
  --       SET worksorderStatusFK = 2  
  --     WHERE worksOrderMovementPK = @WorksOrderMovementPK  
  --  
  --    END  
  --    UPDATE tblPallets WITH (ROWLOCK)

  --     LocationFK = @DestinationFK2,  
  --     BuildingUnitFK = @BuildingUnitFK,  
  --     BayPosition = @DestinationBayPosition2,

  --     PalletEnd = @DestinationEnd2,

  --     UpdatedDate = dbo.GetBSTDate()  
  --    WHERE PalletPK = @PalletFK   
      -- check if there is a record in tblContainerOutPalletToBeLocated and set it to archived  
  
      -- Always attempt to begin a transaction before updating, inserting or deleting records in a permanent table  
      IF XACT_STATE() = 0 AND @@TRANCOUNT < 1 BEGIN TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName  
  
      UPDATE tblContainerOutPalletToBeLocated WITH (ROWLOCK)

       UpdatedBy = @UserID2,  
       UpdatedDate = dbo.GetBSTDate()  
      Where PalletFK = @PalletFK  
        AND isArchived = 0  
      
     END --returnstatus = 1  
  
     -- Always attempt to commit before returning  
     BEGIN TRY IF XACT_STATE() = 1 AND @@TRANCOUNT = 1 AND @OpeningTranCount < 1 COMMIT TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH  
  
     IF (@NoSelectPurelyReturns2 = 0)  
     BEGIN    
      IF (@ReturnStatus = 1)   
       set @ReturnMessage = 'Success'   
      ELSE   
       set @ReturnMessage = 'Movement Failed - Please Re-Try'   
  
      SELECT @ReturnStatus AS ReturnStatus,@ReturnMessage as ReturnMessage  
  
      RETURN  
     END  
     ELSE  
      RETURN @ReturnStatus  
  
    --END --worksorderStatus = 10  
    PRINT 'now in here'  
    -- if the destination type is racking , check if a works order movement exist  
    IF (@DestinationLocationType2 = 1)   
    BEGIN     
     -- If so then cancel it  
     IF Exists (SELECT * from tblWorksOrderMovements   
      WHERE PalletFK = @PalletFK AND WorksOrderStatusFK IN (1,2)   
      AND DestinationFK <>  @DestinationFK2   
      AND DestinationLocationTypeFK = @DestinationLocationType2)

      UPDATE tblWorksOrderMovements WITH (ROWLOCK)

      AND WorksOrderStatusFK IN (1,2)   
      AND DestinationLocationTypeFK = 1  
     END  
  
     -- complete the new works order movement  
     SELECT @WorksOrderMovementPK = WorksOrderMovementPK  
     FROM tblWorksOrderMovements   
     WHERE PalletFK = @PalletFK   
     AND WorksOrderStatusFK in (1,2)  
     AND destinationFK = @DestinationFK2       
  
     -- no works order movement found  
     IF (@WorksOrderMovementPK < 1 or @WorksOrderMovementPK is null)   
     BEGIN  
      -- Always attempt to commit before returning  
      BEGIN TRY IF XACT_STATE() = 1 AND @@TRANCOUNT = 1 AND @OpeningTranCount < 1 COMMIT TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH

      ELSE  
      BEGIN   
       RETURN 6  
      END  
     END   
     ELSE   
     BEGIN  
 --                    SET @errorMessage = 'New Works Order Movement  ' + CONVERT(nvarchar(50),@WorksOrderMovementPK) + ' will be created now'  
 --           EXEC spMobileWriteToLogFile @errorNo, @errorMessage, @Procedure  
  
      print 'calling spMobileWorksOrderMovement Complete'  
  
             insert into #tmpReturn EXEC [dbo].[spMobileWorksOrderMovementComplete]

      SELECT @ReturnStatus = ReturnStatus from #tmpReturn  
  
      BEGIN TRY IF XACT_STATE() = 1 AND @@TRANCOUNT = 1 AND @OpeningTranCount < 1 COMMIT TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH  
  
      IF (@NoSelectPurelyReturns2 = 0)  
      BEGIN  
       IF (@ReturnStatus = 1)   
        set @ReturnMessage = 'Success'   
       ELSE   
        set @ReturnMessage = 'Movement Failed - Please Re-Try'  
           
       SELECT @ReturnStatus AS ReturnStatus,@ReturnMessage as ReturnMessage

      END

       RETURN 1  
     END  -- end of worksorderMovement has a value

    ELSE   
    BEGIN  
     -- Assign new location to tblpallet  
     print 'assign new location'  
     print @BuildingUnitFK  
  
     -- Always attempt to begin a transaction before updating, inserting or deleting records in a permanent table  
     IF XACT_STATE() = 0 AND @@TRANCOUNT < 1 BEGIN TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName  
  
     UPDATE tblPallets WITH (ROWLOCK)   
     SET LocationTypeFK = @DestinationLocationType2,  
      LocationFK = @DestinationFK2,  
      BuildingUnitFK = @BuildingUnitFK,  
      UpdatedBy = @UserId2,  
      UpdatedDate = dbo.GetBSTDate()  
     WHERE PalletPK = @PalletFK   
     /*AND IsArchived = 0//LJF 22/04/2015 Dont need this in the clause*/  
  
     -- Always attempt to commit before returning  
     BEGIN TRY IF XACT_STATE() = 1 AND @@TRANCOUNT = 1 AND @OpeningTranCount < 1 COMMIT TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH  
  
     IF (@NoSelectPurelyReturns2 = 0)  
     BEGIN  
      SELECT 1 AS ReturnStatus,'Success' as ReturnMessage  
      RETURN  
     END  
     ELSE  
      RETURN 1  
    END -- not racking   
   END   
   ELSE   
   BEGIN -- works order already exists for this pallet and location   
    -- Update the Works Order Movement with the new location  
    -- First get the WorksOrderMovementPK   
    SELECT @WorksOrderMovementPK = WorksOrderMovementPK   
    FROM tblWorksOrderMovements Wms   
    INNER JOIN tblWorksOrders Wos ON  
    Wms.WorksOrderFK = Wos.WorksOrderPK   
    WHERE  PalletFK = @PalletFK   
    AND Wos.WorksOrderTypeFK = 3   
    AND  Wms.WorksOrderStatusFK IN (1,2)  
  
    -- set the message   
    SET @Msg  = (@HandHeldOrStawmsHandheldText+' - Move Pallet Barcode : ' + @Barcode2 + ' FROM ' + @SourceLocationText +  ' - To - ' + @DestinationLocationText)  
  
     -- check if the worksordermovement eixsts  
    IF (@WorksOrderMovementPK is null OR @WorksOrderMovementPK < 1)  
    BEGIN  
     -- Always attempt to commit before returning  
     BEGIN TRY IF XACT_STATE() = 1 AND @@TRANCOUNT = 1 AND @OpeningTranCount < 1 COMMIT TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH       
  
     IF (@NoSelectPurelyReturns2 = 0)  
     BEGIN  
      SELECT 6 AS ReturnStatus,'Movement Failed - Please Re-Try' as ReturnMessage  
      RETURN  
     END  
     ELSE  
      RETURN 6  
    END   
    ELSE   
    BEGIN  
     -- Always attempt to begin a transaction before updating, inserting or deleting records in a permanent table  
     IF XACT_STATE() = 0 AND @@TRANCOUNT < 1 BEGIN TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName  
  
     UPDATE tblWorksOrderMovements WITH (ROWLOCK)  
     SET DestinationLocationTypeFK =  @DestinationLocationType2 ,  
     DestinationFK = @DestinationFK2,  
     DestinationBayPosition = @DestinationBayPosition2 ,  
     DestinationPalletStart = @DestinationStart2,  
     DestinationPalletEnd =  @DestinationEnd2 ,  
     DestinationStackPosition = @DestinationStackPosition2 ,  
     MovementDescription = @Msg,  
     UpdatedBy = @UserId2,  
     UpdatedDate = dbo.GetBSTDate(),
	 HandheldDeviceFK = @HandheldDeviceFK2,
	 WarehouseMachineFK = @WarehouseMachineFK2
     WHERE WorksOrderMovementPK = @WorksOrderMovementPK  
  
     IF (@DestinationLocationType2 = 1)   
     BEGIN      
      -- complete the new works order movement  
      INSERT INTO #TmpReturn EXEC [dbo].[spMobileWorksOrderMovementComplete] @WorksOrderMovementPK, @DestinationBarcode, @UserId2  
  
      SELECT @ReturnStatus = ReturnStatus FROM #TmpReturn  
  
      -- Always attempt to commit before returning  
      BEGIN TRY IF XACT_STATE() = 1 AND @@TRANCOUNT = 1 AND @OpeningTranCount < 1 COMMIT TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH

      BEGIN  
       IF (@ReturnStatus = 1)   
        set @ReturnMessage = 'Success'   
       ELSE   
        set @ReturnMessage = 'Movement Failed - Please Re-Try'   
  
       PRINT @returnStatus  
  
       SELECT @ReturnStatus AS ReturnStatus,@ReturnMessage as ReturnMessage

      print 'in racking'

      BuildingUnitFK = @BuildingUnitFK,

       SELECT 1 AS ReturnStatus  
       RETURN  
      END

   -- Always attempt to commit before returning  
   BEGIN TRY IF XACT_STATE() = 1 AND @@TRANCOUNT = 1 AND @OpeningTranCount < 1 COMMIT TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH  
  
   IF (@NoSelectPurelyReturns2 = 0)  
   BEGIN  
    SELECT 7 AS ReturnStatus,'Movement Failed - Please Re-Try' as ReturnMessage  
    RETURN  
   END  
   ELSE  
    RETURN 7  
  
   -- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end  
        
   BREAK  
  END TRY  
  BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */  
   DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;  
   SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;  
   SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;  
  
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY   
   BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;  
         
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;  
  
            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID  
              
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;  
              
   IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)  
   BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END  
   ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */  
  END CATCH  
  SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1  
 END  
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spMobileCreateWorksOrderMovement]   
(  
 @Barcode nvarchar(100),  
 @UserId int,  
 @DestinationLocationType int,  
 @DestinationFK int,  
 @DestinationBayPosition int ,  
 @DestinationStart int,  
 @DestinationEnd int,

 @NoSelectPurelyReturns int = 0,  
 @IsThisHandHeld int = 1,  
 @WorksOrderOriginFK int = 10 ,         -- 10 = Movement , 1= StockIn , 2 = StockOut

 @WarehouseMachineFK int = -1
)  
AS  
BEGIN  
 /* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */  
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED  
  
    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT  
 ,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;  
 SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();  
  
 -- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters

 @UserId2 int,  
 @DestinationLocationType2 int,

 @DestinationStackPosition2 int,  
 @NoSelectPurelyReturns2 int,  
 @IsThisHandHeld2 int,  
 @WorksOrderOriginFK2 int,      
 @GoodsInNumber2 nvarchar(100)   ,
 @HandheldDeviceFK2 int,
 @WarehouseMachineFK2 int
  
 SET @Barcode2 = @Barcode; SET @UserId2 = @UserId; SET @DestinationLocationType2 = @DestinationLocationType; SET @DestinationFK2 = @DestinationFK  
 SET @DestinationBayPosition2 = @DestinationBayPosition; SET @DestinationStart2 = @DestinationStart; SET @DestinationEnd2 = @DestinationEnd  
 SET @DestinationStackPosition2 = @DestinationStackPosition; SET @NoSelectPurelyReturns2 = @NoSelectPurelyReturns; SET @IsThisHandHeld2 = @IsThisHandHeld  
 SET @WorksOrderOriginFK2 = @WorksOrderOriginFK; SET @GoodsInNumber2 = @GoodsInNumber; SET @HandheldDeviceFK2 = @HandheldDeviceFK; SET @WarehouseMachineFK2 = @WarehouseMachineFK ;
  
 SET @ParameterDetails = '@Barcode = ' + ISNULL(@Barcode2,'') + ',@UserId = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@UserId2 AS NVARCHAR(100)),'0')  
  + ',@DestinationLocationType = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@DestinationLocationType2 AS NVARCHAR(100)),'0') + ',@DestinationFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@DestinationFK2 AS NVARCHAR(100)),'0')  
   + ',@DestinationBayPosition = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@DestinationBayPosition2 AS NVARCHAR(100)),'0') + ',@DestinationStart = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@DestinationStart2 AS NVARCHAR(100)),'0')  
    + ',@DestinationEnd = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@DestinationEnd2 AS NVARCHAR(100)),'0') + ',@DestinationStackPosition = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@DestinationStackPosition2 AS NVARCHAR(100)),'0')

      SELECT @ReturnStatus = ReturnStatus FROM #TmpReturn  
  
      -- Always attempt to commit before returning  
      BEGIN TRY IF XACT_STATE() = 1 AND @@TRANCOUNT = 1 AND @OpeningTranCount < 1 COMMIT TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH  
  
      IF (@NoSelectPurelyReturns2 = 0)  
      BEGIN  
       IF (@ReturnStatus = 1)   
        set @ReturnMessage = 'Success'   
       ELSE   
        set @ReturnMessage = 'Movement Failed - Please Re-Try'   
  
       PRINT @returnStatus  
  
       SELECT @ReturnStatus AS ReturnStatus,@ReturnMessage as ReturnMessage  
       RETURN  
      END  
      ELSE   
       RETURN 1  
     END   
     ELSE   
     BEGIN-- if in racking   
      -- Assign new location to tblpallet  
      print 'in racking'  
      print @BuildingUnitFK  
  
      -- Always attempt to begin a transaction before updating, inserting or deleting records in a permanent table  
      IF XACT_STATE() = 0 AND @@TRANCOUNT < 1 BEGIN TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName  
  
      UPDATE tblPallets WITH (ROWLOCK)   
      SET LocationTypeFK = @DestinationLocationType2,  
      LocationFK = @DestinationFK2,  
      BuildingUnitFK = @BuildingUnitFK,  
      UpdatedBy = @UserId2,  
      UpdatedDate = dbo.GetBSTDate()  
      WHERE PalletPK = @PalletFK  
       
      -- Always attempt to commit before returning  
      BEGIN TRY IF XACT_STATE() = 1 AND @@TRANCOUNT = 1 AND @OpeningTranCount < 1 COMMIT TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH  
  
      IF (@NoSelectPurelyReturns2 = 0)  
      BEGIN  
       SELECT 1 AS ReturnStatus  
       RETURN  
      END  
      ELSE  
       RETURN 1  
     END -- if not in racking  
    END -- works order movement exists  
   END -- works order already exists and just needs to be updated     
   
   -- Always attempt to commit before returning  
   BEGIN TRY IF XACT_STATE() = 1 AND @@TRANCOUNT = 1 AND @OpeningTranCount < 1 COMMIT TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH  
  
   IF (@NoSelectPurelyReturns2 = 0)  
   BEGIN  
    SELECT 7 AS ReturnStatus,'Movement Failed - Please Re-Try' as ReturnMessage  
    RETURN  
   END  
   ELSE  
    RETURN 7  
  
   -- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end  
        
   BREAK  
  END TRY  
  BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */  
   DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;  
   SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;  
   SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;  
  
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY   
   BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;  
         
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;  
  
            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID  
              
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;  
              
   IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)  
   BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END  
   ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */  
  END CATCH  
  SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1  
 END  
END
GO

	SET @ParameterDetails = '@worksOrderMovement = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@worksOrderMovement2 AS NVARCHAR(100)),'0') 

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    --BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

		SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END

	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY
			
			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start

			SELECT 
				@RackingTypeFK = tBuR.RackingTypeFK 
			from 
				tblWorksOrderMovements AS WoMov 
			inner join tblBuildingUnitBays AS tBuB					/*bay*/
				ON tBuB.BuildingUnitBayPK = WoMov.DestinationFK
			inner join tblBuildingUnitColumns AS tBuC				/*column*/
				ON tBuC.buildingUnitColumnPK=tBuB.BuildingUnitColumnFK
			inner join tblbuildingUnitRows AS tBuR 					/*row*/
				ON tBuR.BuildingUnitRowPk=tBuC.buildingUnitRowFK
			where  
				WoMov.WorksOrderMovementPK = @worksOrderMovement2 

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end
						
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END


GO

-- =============================================  
-- Author:  Rachael Sherry  
-- Create date: 19/01/2016  
-- Description: Retrieves the list of Stock Items on a Headers Only Stock In  
-- =============================================  
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spMobileGroupStockInHeaders]  
(  
 @GroupStockInInFK as int  
)   
AS  
BEGIN  
 /* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */  
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED  
  
    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT  
 ,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;  
 SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();  
  
 -- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters  
 DECLARE @var_GroupStockInInFK int  
 SET @var_GroupStockInInFK = @GroupStockInInFK  
 SET @ParameterDetails = '@GroupStockInInFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_GroupStockInInFK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'')  
  
    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL   
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)  
  
    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)  
    --BEGIN  
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC   
  
  SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)  
  
        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)  
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK  
  
        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()  
    --END  
  
  
 SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);  
 SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails  
 ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;  
 INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()  
  
 WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3  
 BEGIN   
  BEGIN TRY  
     
   -- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start  
     
   -- Return the Stock In Header Information for the top grid  
   IF exists (select * from tblContainerIns where stockingroupfk = @var_GroupStockInInFK
              AND isBeingBuilt = 1)  
   BEGIN  
    -- The Goods In is being Built from scratch but does not have headers   
    select  0 as ReturnStatus ,   
        StockItemFK as StockInHeaderPK,  
        stockItemCode,  
        eancode as stockItemEanCode,  
        eancode2 as stockItemEanCode2,  
        0 as ExpectedQty,  
        sum(Units)  as ScannedQty,  
        case when stk.DefaultPalletTypeFK < 1 THEN div.DefaultPalletTypeFK ELSE stk.DefaultPalletTypeFK end as palletTypeFK,  
        --DefaultPalletTypeFK as palletTypeFK,  
        stk.divisionFK  
  
     from tblstockins   
     inner join tblstockinlines on stockinpk = stockinfk   
     inner join tblstockitems stk on stockitemfk = stockitempk   
     INNER JOIN tbldivisions div ON divisionpk = stk.divisionfk 
	 inner join tblContainerIns cin on cin.ContainerInPK=ContainerInFK
     where cin.StockInGroupFK = @var_GroupStockInInFK
     group by stockitemfk, stockitemcode, EANCode, eancode2, case when stk.DefaultPalletTypeFK < 1 THEN div.DefaultPalletTypeFK ELSE stk.DefaultPalletTypeFK end, stk.divisionFK  
     order by StockItemCode  
   END  
   ELSE  
   BEGIN  
       -- check if there is no eancode assigned to one of the stock Items   
  
    -- Check if there are duplicate EanCodes on the Stock In   
    -- This code is no longer needed as the stockitemPK  from the header file will be used.   
    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#tmpEancodes') IS NOT NULL         
     DROP TABLE #tmpEancodes     
    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#tmpEancode2') IS NOT NULL         
     DROP TABLE #tmpEancode2   
    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#tmpStockItems') IS NOT NULL  
     DROP TABLE #tmpStockItems  
  
    -- get the list of stockitems , stockitemcode, eancode and eancode2  
    Select stockitempk, stockitemcode, eancode, eancode2  
    INTO #tmpStockItems  
    FROM tblContainerInHeaders   
    INNER JOIN tblstockitems on stockitempk = stockitemfk 
    inner join tblContainerIns cin on cin.ContainerInPK=ContainerInFK

    where cin.StockInGroupFK = @var_GroupStockInInFK
  
    -- check if there is a stockitem with no EanCodes setup against it   
    IF exists (select * from #tmpStockItems where ltrim(isnull(eancode,'')) = '' )  
    BEGIN  
  
     DECLARE @StockItemCode nvarchar(100)   
     set @Stockitemcode = ''  
     select @StockItemCode = @StockItemCode + StockItemCode+ ', '  from #tmpStockItems where ltrim(isnull(eancode,'')) = ''  
     set @StockItemCode = LEFT(@stockitemcode, len(@stockitemcode)-1)   
     SELECT 2 as ReturnStatus,  
      'Stock Item(s) ' + @stockitemcode + ' does not have an EAN code setup, Contact Stock Controller' as ReturnMessage  
     RETURN  
    END   
     
    -- count the number of duplicate eancodes on the header file  
    SELECT eancode , count(*) as NoOfEanCodes  
    INTO #tmpEanCodes  
    FROM #tmpStockItems  
    GROUP BY EANCode  
  
    -- count the number of duplicate eancode2's on the header file  
    SELECT EANCode2 , count(*) as NoOfEanCodes  
    INTO #tmpEancode2  
    FROM #tmpStockItems  
    WHERE len(eancode2) > 1  
    GROUP BY  EANCode2  
  
    -- check if there are stock items with no ean codes setup   
  
     -- check if there duplicate eancodes  
     IF exists (SELECT * from #tmpEancodes where NoOfEanCodes > 1)  
     BEGIN   
      DECLARE @Eancode nvarchar(200)  
      set @eancode = ''  
      select @Eancode = @Eancode + eancode + ', '    
      from #tmpEancodes   
      where NoofEanCodes > 1 and ltrim(isnull(eancode,'')) <> ''  
    
      -- Trim the eancode  
      set @eancode = LEFT(@eancode, len(@eancode)-1)   
    
      SELECT 2 as ReturnStatus,  
       'Multiple Stock Items setup for EanCode(s) ' + @Eancode + ' Contact Stock Controller' as ReturnMessage  
      RETURN  
      END   
  
     -- check if there duplicate eancode2s  
    IF exists (SELECT * from #tmpEancode2 where NoOfEanCodes > 1)  
    BEGIN   
     SELECT 2 as ReturnStatus,  
      'Multiple EanCodes setup for this Goods In, Contact Stock Controller' as ReturnMessage  
     RETURN  
    END   
    
    -- check if there are matching eancode and eancode2  
    IF exists (select * from #tmpEAncode2 where eancode2 in (Select eancode from #tmpEancodes))  
    BEGIN  
     SELECT 2 as ReturnStatus,  
      'Multiple EanCodes setup for this Goods In, Contact Stock Controller' as ReturnMessage  
     RETURN  
    END  
      
    --if EXISTS (SELECT COUNT(*) as NoOfEANCodes from tblContainerInHeaders  
    --   inner JOIN tblStockItems stk on StockItemFK = StockItemPK  
    --   INNER JOIN tblStockItems stkean ON stkean.EANCode = stk.EANCode  
    --   where ContainerINFK = @var_ContainerInFK  
    --   GROUP BY stkean.EANCode  
    --   HAVING COUNT(*) > 1)  
    --BEGIN  
    -- SELECT 2 as ReturnStatus,  
    --    'Multiple StockItems setup for EANCODE ' + stkEan.EANCODE + ' , Contact IT' as ReturnMessage  
    --   from tblContainerInHeaders  
    --   inner JOIN tblStockItems stk on StockItemFK = StockItemPK  
    --   INNER JOIN tblStockItems stkean ON stkean.EANCode = stk.EANCode  
    --   where ContainerINFK = @var_ContainerInFK  
    --   GROUP BY stkean.EANCode  
    --   HAVING COUNT(*) > 1  
      
    --END  
    --ELSE  
    BEGIN  
    select 0 as ReturnStatus ,   
        StockItemFK as StockInHeaderPK,  
        stockItemCode,  
        eancode as stockItemEanCode,  
        eancode2 as stockItemEanCode2,  
        Units as ExpectedQty,  
        UnitsScanned as ScannedQty,  
        case when si.DefaultPalletTypeFK < 1 THEN div.DefaultPalletTypeFK ELSE si.DefaultPalletTypeFK end as palletTypeFK,  
        divisionFK  
       
       FROM tblcontainerInheaders  
       INNER JOIN tblstockitems si ON StockItemPK = StockItemFK  
       INNER JOIN tbldivisions div ON divisionpk = divisionfk   
	   inner join tblContainerIns cin on cin.ContainerInPK=ContainerInFK

    where cin.StockInGroupFK = @var_GroupStockInInFK
   -- WHERE ContainerInFK = @var_GroupStockInInFK
    END  
   END  
  
   -- Return the list of pallets scanned for the bottom grid  
   -- select palletNumber=COUNT(*), stkit.StockItemCode, palcon.SupplierBatch, pal.customerBarcode, availableunits from tblstockins stk  
    
   select ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY pal.CustomerBarcode) as 'palletNumber', stkit.StockItemCode,   
       CASE WHEN (palcon.SupplierBatch = '') THEN palcon.batch ELSE palcon.supplierbatch END as SupplierBatch,  
        pal.customerBarcode, availableunits, pal.CustomerPalletNumber  
   from tblstockins stk  
   left outer join tblstockinlines stkl on  stkl.stockinfk = stockinpk  
   left outer join tblstockinlinepallets stkpal on stkpal.stockinlinefk = stkl.stockinlinepk  
   left outer join tblpallets pal on pal.palletpk = stkpal.palletfk  
   left outer join tblpalletcontent palcon on palcon.palletfk = pal.palletpk  
   LEFT OUTER JOIN tblStockItems stkit ON stkit.StockItemPK = palcon.StockItemFK  
   inner join tblContainerIns cin on cin.ContainerInPK=ContainerInFK

    where cin.StockInGroupFK = @var_GroupStockInInFK
  -- where containerinfk = @var_GroupStockInInFK 
   GROUP BY stkit.StockItemCode,palcon.SupplierBatch, pal.CustomerBarcode, palcon.AvailableUnits, palcon.batch, pal.CustomerPalletNumber  
   order by stockitemcode, SupplierBatch  
  
   -- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end  
   BREAK  
  END TRY  
  BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */  
   DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;  
   SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;  
   SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;  
  
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY   
   BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;  
         
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;  
  
            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID  
              
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;  
              
   IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)  
   BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END  
   ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */  
  END CATCH  
  SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1  
 END  
END
GO

 /* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */  
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED

 BEGIN   
  BEGIN TRY  
   -- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start  
   IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#tmpStockInPallets') IS NOT NULL         
    DROP TABLE #tmpStockInPallets   
  
   IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#tmpStockInPallets') IS NOT NULL         
    DROP TABLE #tmpStockInPallets   
 SELECT con.StockInGroupFK,stk.StockInPK, stk.StockInStatusFK, tpal.IsArchived, tpal.Loaded, tpal.LocationTypeFK,tpal.PalletPK INTO #tmpStockInPallets  
   from  tblStockIns stk   
   INNER JOIN tblStockInLines stL ON stL.StockInFK = stk.StockInPK  
   INNER JOIN tblStockInLinePallets stlP ON stlP.StockInLineFK = stL.StockInLinePK  
   INNER JOIN tblPallets tpal ON tpal.PalletPK = stlP.PalletFK 

   -- where stk.StockInPK = 135314  
    inner join tblcontainerins con on con.ContainerInPk = stk.ContainerinFK   
    where con.StockInGroupFK = @var_GroupStockInPK
  
    AND tpal.IsArchived = 0  
    and tpal.Loaded = 0  
  

 --select * from #tmpStockInPallets
   if exists (select * from #tmpStockInPallets where StockInStatusFK = 2 AND LocationTypeFK = 4)   
   Begin  
    SELECT tblCon.Container,totalPallets   
    FROM (  
     select StockInGroupFK, count (*) as Container  
     from #tmpStockInPallets  
     where LocationTypeFK = 4  
     GROUP BY StockInGroupFK, LocationTypeFK   
    ) tblCon  
    LEFT OUTER JOIN(  
     select StockInGroupFK, count(*) as totalPallets   
     from #tmpStockInPallets  
     GROUP BY StockInGroupFK  
    ) tbltot ON tbltot.StockInGroupFK = tblCon.StockInGroupFK  
   END  
   ELSE  
     SELECT 0 as Container, 0 as totalPallets  
   
   -- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end  
   BREAK  
  END TRY  
  BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */  
   DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;  
   SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;  
   SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;  
  
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY   
   BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;  
         
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;  
  
            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID  
              
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;  
              
   IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)  
   BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END  
   ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */  
  END CATCH  
  SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1  
 END  
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spMobileGroupStockInMovements]  
(  
 @StockInGroupFK as int  
)   
AS  
BEGIN  
 /* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */  
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED  
  
    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT,  
 @PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;  
 SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();  
  
 -- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters  
 DECLARE @var_StockInGroupFK int  
 SET @var_StockInGroupFK = @StockInGroupFK  
 SET @ParameterDetails = '@StockInGroupFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@StockInGroupFK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'')  
  
    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL   
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)  
  
    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)  
    --BEGIN  
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC   
  
  SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)  
  
        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)  
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK  
  
        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()  
    --END  
  
  
 SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);  
 SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails  
 ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;  
 INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()  
  
 WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3  
 BEGIN   
  BEGIN TRY  
    
   -- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start  
   IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#tmpStockInDetails') IS NOT NULL         
    DROP TABLE #tmpStockInDetails   -- create temp table to hold all the ContainerOutlines on the pick  
   IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#tmpPalletOnPick') IS NOT NULL          
    DROP TABLE #tmpPalletOnPick        -- create temp table to hold all the pallets on the pick  
   IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#tmpPallets') IS NOT NULL         
    DROP TABLE  #tmpPallets    
     
  
   SELECT palletfk ,st.StockInStatusFK  
   INTO #tmpStockInDetails  
   FROM tblStockInLinePallets  
   INNER JOIN tblStockInLines ON StockInLineFK = StockInLinePK  
   INNER JOIN tblStockIns st ON StockInFK = st.StockInPK  
   left join tblContainerIns con on st.ContainerInFK= con.ContainerInPK
   WHERE con.StockInGroupFK = @var_StockInGroupFK  


   --jamie : no longer applies, pallets can't be picked until stock in complete  
   --- PAllet is on another pick  
   --SELECT sid.PalletFK   
   --INTO #tmpPalletOnPick   
   --FROM  #tmpStockInDetails sid  
   --INNER JOIN tblWorksOrderMovements tWom ON tWom.PalletFK = sid.PalletFK  
   --INNER JOIN tblWorksOrders tWos ON tWos.WorksOrderPK = tWom.WorksOrderFK  
   --WHERE StockInStatusFK = 2 /*Pending Racking*/ AND tWom.WorksOrderStatusFK IN (1,2) AND tWos.WorksOrderOriginFK = 2 -- Stock Out  
  
   -- get pallet details   
   Select p.palletpk , p.LocationTypeFK, p.PalletTypeFK,batch, actualunits, width, PalletType ,StockItemFK ,std.stockinstatusfk,p.locationfk,  
    CASE WHEN  p.CustomerBarcode   <> '' THEN p.CustomerBarcode ELSE p.Barcode  END AS Barcode, p.CustomerPalletNumber  
   INTO #tmpPallets  
   FROM tblpallets p  
   INNER JOIN #tmpstockinDetails std ON std.palletfk = palletpk   
   INNER JOIN tblpalletcontent pc ON pc.palletfk = p.palletpk  
   INNER JOIN tblpallettypes pt ON pt.PalletTypePK = p.PalletTypeFK  
   WHERE p.isarchived = 0 --AND p.palletpk NOT IN (SELECT palletfk FROM #tmpPalletOnPick)  
  
  
   ;WITH allmovements AS (  
    SELECT WorksOrderMovementPK, PalletPK, StockItemPK, StockItemCode, Batch, SUM(Quantity) Quantity, Location as CurrentLocation, Barcode, LocationTypeFK,  
     DestinationFK, Destination, 1 RackingTypeFK, PalletTypeFK, SQue.PalletType, IsStackable, SQue.Width, SQue.CustomerPalletNumber, UpdatedDate, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY Barcode ORDER BY UpdatedDate DESC) AS rk  
    FROM (  
     SELECT isnull(WorksOrderMovementPK, -1) as WorksOrderMovementPK, PalletPK, StkIt.StockItemPK, StkIt.StockItemCode, Batch, actualUnits as Quantity,   
     case when p.LocationTypeFK = 4 then 'Container' else vbu.BuildingUnitBayLocation end as Location, isnull(DestinationFK, -1) as DestinationFK, isnull(moves.BuildingUnitBayLocation, '') as Destination,  
      p.LocationTypeFK, PalletTypeFK, PalletType, p.Barcode, CONVERT(int, StkIt.IsStackable) as IsStackable, p.Width, p.CustomerPalletNumber, moves.UpdatedDate  
     FROM #tmpPallets p  
     INNER JOIN tblStockItems StkIt on StkIt.StockItemPK= StockItemFK  
     LEFT JOIN viewbuildingunitbays vbu on vbu.BuildingUnitBayPK = p.LocationFK and vbu.locationTypeFK = p.LocationTypeFK And vbu.IsArchived = 0  /* Exclude Archived Bays */  
     LEFT JOIN (  
      SELECT WorksOrderMovementPK, palletfk, DestinationFK, BuildingUnitBayLocation, wom.UpdatedDate  
      FROM tblWorksOrderMovements wom  
      INNER JOIN tblWorksOrders wos on wos.WorksOrderPK = wom.WorksOrderFK and worksorderoriginfk = 1  
      LEFT JOIN viewbuildingunitbays dest on dest.BuildingUnitBayPK = wom.DestinationFK and dest.locationTypeFK = wom.DestinationLocationTypeFK And dest.IsArchived = 0 /* Exclude Archived Bays */  
      where wom.WorksOrderStatusFK in (1,2,3,5)  and sourcelocationtypefk <> 4  
     ) moves on moves.PalletFK=palletPK  
     --LEFT JOIN tblWorksOrderMovements WoMov on WoMov.PalletFK=palletPK AND WoMov.WorksOrderStatusFK in (1,2,3,5)   
     --LEFT JOIN tblWorksOrders wos on wos.WorksOrderPK = WoMov.WorksOrderFK and worksorderoriginfk = 1  
     WHERE StockInStatusFK = 2    --Pending Racking             
    )SQue  
    Group by WorksOrderMovementPK, PalletPK,StockItemPK,Batch,Barcode , Location, LocationTypeFK, DestinationFK, Destination, StockItemCode, PalletTypeFK, SQue.PalletType, IsStackable, SQue.Width, SQue.CustomerPalletNumber, UpdatedDate  
    --order by CurrentLocation  
    )  
    SELECT s.*  
    FROM allmovements s  
    WHERE s.rk = 1  
    order by CurrentLocation, barcode  
   -- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end  
  
     
     
   BREAK  
  END TRY  
  BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */  
   DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;  
   SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;  
   SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;  
  
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY   
   BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;  
         
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;  
  
            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID  
              
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;  
              
   IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)  
   BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END  
   ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */  
  END CATCH  
  SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1  
 END  
END

			SELECT -1 as BuildingFK
			print '@Result2'
		 end
		 else
		 begin
			SELECT @Result = (select top 1 BuildingFK from #tmprules) 
			SELECT @Result as BuildingFK
			--print @Result
		 end
		 end
   -- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end  
   BREAK  
  END TRY  
  BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */  
   DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;  
   SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;  
   SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;  
  
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY   
   BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;  
         
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;  
  
            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID  
              
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;  
              
   IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)  
   BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END  
   ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */  
  END CATCH  
  SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1  
 END  
END

-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Rachael Sherry>
-- Create date: <12/8/2014>
-- Description:	<Returns a list of the Cycle Counts that are 
--               Pending (2) or Active (3) for the assigned Building >
--
-- Damien Gannon #DEV-910 Exclude Archive Bays
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spMobileManualMovementsDetails]
(
	 @Barcode nvarchar(200),
     @BarcodeType int,    -- 1 = Pallet
						 -- 2 = Loading Bay
						 -- 3 = Setdown Area
	@UserBuildingUnitFK int =  -1
)	
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT
 ,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;
	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	DECLARE @var_Barcode nvarchar(200), @var_BarcodeType int, @var_UserBuildingUnitFK int
	SET @var_Barcode = @Barcode; SET @var_BarcodeType = @BarcodeType; SET @var_UserBuildingUnitFK = @UserBuildingUnitFK
	SET @ParameterDetails = '@Barcode = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_Barcode AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@BarcodeType = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_BarcodeType AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'')

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    --BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

		SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END


	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY
			
			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start

			-- check if the barcode is a pallet
			-- if it is on an open pick 
			-- if it is on an open stock in 
			-- if it has a works order movement

			-- Returns the following : 1 - Pallet not setup on WMS
									-- 2 - Pallet was scanned
									-- 3 - pallets in loading bay
			DECLARE @PalletFK int
			DECLARE @GoodsOrderNumber nvarchar(200)
			dECLARE @GoodsInNumber nvarchar(200)
			DECLARE @WorksOrderMovementFK int 
			DECLARE @StackedTopPallet nvarchar(200)
			DECLARE @LocationFK int
			DECLARE @PalletBuildingUnit int
			DECLARE @PalletStart int
			DECLARE @StackedTopBarcode nvarchar (200)
			DECLARE @BayPosition int
			DECLARE @ExpectedBarcode nvarchar(200)
			DECLARE @Destination nvarchar(200)
			DECLARE @StockInFK int

			-- Pallet Scanned --
			if (@var_BarcodeType = 1)
			BEGIN 			
			
				IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#tmpScannedPallet') IS NOT NULL
					DROP TABLE #tmpScannedPallet

				SELECT PalletPK, Barcode, CustomerBarcode, CustomerPalletNumber, BuildingUnitFK, LocationFK, tp.LocationTypeFK, PalletStart, PalletEnd, BayPosition, PalletStatusFK, IsArchived
				INTO #tmpScannedPallet
				FROM dbo.tblPallets tp
				WHERE (Barcode = @var_Barcode OR CustomerBarcode = @var_Barcode)
				 
				-- Check if the Pallet Exists 
				IF NOT exists (SELECT palletPK FROM #tmpScannedPallet WHERE (Barcode = @var_Barcode OR CustomerBarcode = @var_Barcode))
				BEGIN
					SELECT 1 as ReturnStatus,
						  'Pallet Not Setup in the System' as ReturnMessage
					RETURN
				END

				-- Only Return one Record
				SELECT @PalletFK = palletPK, @LocationFK = locationFK, @PalletBuildingUnit = BuildingUnitFK, @PalletStart = palletstart, @BayPosition = bayPosition
				from #tmpScannedPallet 
				where isarchived = 0
				
				-- check if pallet exists
				if (@PalletFK is null)
				BEGIN 
					SELECT 1 as returnStatus, 'Pallet shipped on Goods Order ' + GoodsOrderNumber as ReturnMessage
					FROM viewContainerOutPalletList Where customerbarcode = @var_Barcode
					RETURN
				END
				
				-- check if pallet is onRoute
				IF exists (SELECT palletpk from #tmpScannedPallet WHERE IsArchived = 0 AND PalletStatusFK = 10)
				BEGIN
					SELECT 1 as ReturnStatus, 'Pallet is OnRoute on Goods In ' + GoodsInNumber as ReturnMessage
					FROM tblStockInLinePallets 
					INNER JOIN tblStockInLines ON StockInLineFK = StockInLinePK
					INNER JOIN tblStockIns ON tblStockIns.StockInPK = StockInFK
					WHERE PalletFK = @PalletFK
					RETURN
				END

				-- check if there is a pallet on top
				IF EXISTS (SELECT customerbarcode from tblpallets where locationfk = @LocationFK AND bayposition = @BayPosition + 1 AND stackPosition = 1)
				BEGIN		
					SELECT @ExpectedBarcode = CASE WHEN  CustomerBarcode <> '' THEN  CustomerBarcode ELSE Barcode END
					FROM tblPallets
					WHERE locationfk = @LocationFK AND bayposition = @BayPosition + 1 AND stackPosition = 1
				END	

				-- Check if on Open Pick
				select  @GoodsOrderNumber =  goodsOrderNumber, @Destination = 'STACO-' + CONVERT (nvarchar(200),ContainerOutPK)
				from viewContainerOutPalletList
				WHERE PalletFK = @PalletFK AND ContainerOutStatusFK in (1,2)

				-- Check if on Open Stock In		
				select @GoodsInNumber = GoodsInNumber, @Destination = CASE WHEN @Destination is null THEN 'Racking' END, @StockInFK = StockInPK
				FROM tblStockIns tStk
				INNER JOIN tblStockInLines tStkL ON tStkL.stockinfk = tStk.stockinPK
				INNER JOIN tblStockInLinePallets tStPal ON tStPal.StockInLineFK = tStkL.StockInLinePK
				WHERE tStPal.palletfk = @PalletFK AND tStk.stockInStatusFK in (1,2) 
		  					
				-- Check if there is an open WorksOrder Movement
				SELECT @Destination = CASE WHEN @Destination is NULL THEN buildingUnitBayLocation ELSE @Destination	END, @WorksOrderMovementFK = worksOrderMovementPK
				FROM tblWOrksOrderMovements
				inner join viewBuildingUnitBays ON destinationFK = buildingUnitBayPK And viewBuildingUnitBays.IsArchived = 0	/* Damien #DEV-910 Exclude Archived Bays */
				WHERE palletfk = @PalletFK AND worksOrderStatusFK IN (1,2)

				-- Check if moving from different building
				if(@var_UserBuildingUnitFK > 0)
				BEGIN
				PRINT 'we have a user building unit'
					if(@var_UserBuildingUnitFK <> @PalletBuildingUnit)
					BEGIN
					PRINT 'user building unit different to pallet building unit'
						--check if building is different, or just different unit
						DECLARE @userBuilding int,  @PalletBuilding int
						SELECT @userBuilding = BuildingFK FROM dbo.tblBuildingUnits tbu WHERE tbu.BuildingUnitPK = @var_UserBuildingUnitFK
						SELECT @PalletBuilding = BuildingFK FROM dbo.tblBuildingUnits tbu WHERE tbu.BuildingUnitPK = @PalletBuildingUnit
						
						PRINT @userBuilding
						PRINT @PalletBuilding
						
						if(@userBuilding <> @PalletBuilding)
						BEGIN
							SELECT @Destination = ' a Loading bay Moving Building'  
						END
					END
				END

			  select 2 as returnStatus,
				tpal.palletpk as PalletFK, stockItemFK, tStk.StockItemCode, batch, 
				CASE WHEN actualUnits = -1 THEN 0 ELSE actualUnits END as Quantity,
				CASE WHEN availableUnits = -1 THEN 0 ELSE availableUnits  END as availableUnits,
				CASE WHEN @GoodsOrderNumber is NULL THEN 'null' ELSE  @GoodsOrderNumber END as goodsOrderNumber ,
				CASE WHEN @GoodsInNumber IS NULL THEN 'null' ELSE @GoodsInNumber END as goodsInNumber ,
				tStk.isStackable, palletLocation.Location as currentlocation, palletLocation.Barcode as currentLocationBarcode,
				CASE WHEN @ExpectedBarcode is null then 'null' ELSE @ExpectedBarcode  END as StackedPallet,
				tbus.buildingUnit, tBs.BuildingPK, tbus.BuildingUnitPK, tbs.buildingName,
				CASE WHEN @WorksOrderMovementFK is null THEN 0 ELSE @WorksOrderMovementFK END as WorksOrderMovementFK,			
				CASE WHEN @Destination IS NULL  THEN  'null' ELSE @Destination  END as Destination,
				CASE WHEN @stockInFK is NULL then 0 ELSE @StockInFK END as stockInFK,
				CASE WHEN tpal.locationTypeFK = 1 THEN palletLocation.rackingTypeFK ELSE 0 END as rackingTypeFK,
				@Barcode as palletBarcode, tPal.LocationFK, tPal.LocationTypeFK, tUty.Abbreviation,				
				CASE WHEN @ExpectedBarcode is NULL THEN 'null' else @ExpectedBarcode END as ExpectedBarcode,
				tPal.CustomerPalletNumber

				from (SELECT * from #tmpScannedPallet WHERE palletPK = @PalletFK) tPal
				inner join(
					SELECT palletfk, sum(ActualUnits) as ActualUnits ,sum(availableUnits) as availableUnits, stockitemFK, batch
					FROM tblpalletcontent pc 
					WHERE palletfk = @PalletFk
					GROUP BY pc.palletfk , stockitemFK, batch
				) as tPalCon on tPalCon.palletfk = tpal.palletpk
				INNER JOIN tblStockItems tStk ON tStk.StockItemPK = tPalCon.StockItemFK
				INNER JOIN viewPalletLocations palletLocation ON palletLocation.palletPK = tPal.palletPk
				INNER JOIN tblBuildingUnits tbus ON tbus.buildingUnitPK = tPal.BuildingUnitfk
				INNER JOIN tblBuildings tBs ON tBs.BuildingPK = tbus.buildingFK
				LEFT OUTER JOIN tblUnitTypes tUty ON tUty.unitTypepk = unittypefk
				--WHERE tpal.palletPK = @palletFK AND tPal.LocationTypeFK not in (4)
				--GROUP BY tpal.palletpk, stockitemfk, stockitemcode, batch,actualunits, availableunits,isstackable,tpal.locationtypefk,location,palletLocation.barcode, 
					--tbus.buildingunit, tbus.BuildingUnitPK, tbs.buildingName,  RackingTypeFK,tpal.CustomerBarcode, tpal.barcode,tpal.locationfk,abbreviation, tPal.CustomerPalletNumber

				END
				if (@var_BarcodeType = 2)
				BEGIN 
					-- Loading Bay Scanned --
					-- Returns all non - archived pallets in the loading bay --
					SELECT 3 as returnStatus,
						   palletpk as PalletFK,
						   stockItemFK , 
						   batch , 
						   actualUnits as Quantity,
						   availableUnits as availableUnits,
						   CASE WHEN tGout.GoodsOrderNumber IS NULL THEN '' ELSE tGout.GoodsOrderNumber END as goodsOrderNumber ,
						   CASE WHEN tGIn.GoodsInNumber IS NULL THEN '' ELSE tGin.GoodsInNumber END as goodsInNumber ,
						   tStk.isStackable,
						   tLbs.LoadingBay as currentlocation,
						   tbus.buildingUnit,
						   tbs.buildingName,
						   BuildingPK,
						   CASE WHEN twoms.worksordermovementPk is null THEN 0 else twoms.worksordermovementPK END as WorksOrderMovementFK,
							CASE WHEN locationTypeFK = 2 THEN
									CASE WHEN tGout.GoodsOrderNumber IS NOT NULL  THEN 'STACO-' + CONVERT (nvarchar(200),tGOut.ContainerOutPK)
										WHEN tGIn.GoodsInNumber IS NOT NULL THEN 
											CASE WHEN twoms.Destination is null then 'Racking' ELSE twoms.Destination END
										ELSE ''
									END
							   ELSE CASE WHEN twoms.Destination is null then '' ELSE twoms.Destination END
							END as Destination,
						    --CASE	WHEN  tPal.CustomerBarcode   <> '' THEN tPal.CustomerBarcode ELSE tPal.Barcode END AS palletBarcode 
						   @Barcode as palletBarcode, tPal.CustomerPalletNumber
					from tblPallets tPal
					INNER JOIN tblPalletContent as tPalCon ON tPalCon.palletFk = tPal.palletPK
					INNER JOIN tblStockItems tStk ON tStk.StockItemPK = tPalCon.StockItemFK
					INNER JOIN tblLoadingBays tLbs ON tLbs.LoadingBayPK = tPal.LocationFK		
					INNER JOIN tblBuildingUnits tbus ON tbus.buildingUnitPK = tPal.BuildingUnitfk
					INNER JOIN tblBuildings tBs ON tBs.BuildingPK = tbus.buildingFK
		
					-- Check if on Open Pick
					left OUTER JOIN 
					(select  tCo.ContainerOutPK, goodsOrderNumber , palletfk from tblcontainerOuts tCo
							INNER JOIN tblContainerOutLines tCoL ON tCol.ContainerOutFK = tCo.ContainerOutPK
							INNER JOIN tblContainerOutLinePalletContent tCoLPal ON tColPal.containerOutLineFK = tCol.ContainerOutLinePK
							WHERE  tCo.ContainerOutStatusFK in (1,2)) 
						tGOut ON tGout.palletfk = tPal.palletPK
		
					-- Check if on Open Stock In
					LEFT OUTER JOIN 
					 (select GoodsInNumber , PalletFK from tblStockIns tStk
							INNER JOIN tblStockInLines tStkL ON tStkL.stockinfk = tStk.stockinPK
							INNER JOIN tblStockInLinePallets tStPal ON tStPal.StockInLineFK = tStkL.StockInLinePK
							WHERE  tStk.stockInStatusFK in (1,2) ) 
						 tGIn ON tGin.palletFK = tPal.palletPK

					-- Check if pallet has open works order movement
					LEFT OUTER JOIN 
					(SELECT  worksOrderMovementPK , palletfk , 
							CASE WHEN destinationLocationTypeFK = 1 THEN vBub.buildingUnitBayLocation
								 WHEN destinationLocationTypeFK = 2 THEN tlbay.LoadingBay
								 WHEN destinationLocationTypeFK = 3 THEN tset.SetdownArea
							END as Destination
						   FROM tblWOrksOrderMovements
							LEFT OUTER JOIN tblLoadingBays tlbay on tlbay.loadingBayPK = destinationfk
							LEFT OUTER JOIN tblSetDownAreas tset on tset.setdownareaPK = destinationfk
							LEFT OUTER JOIN ViewBuildingUnitBays vBub ON vBub.buildingUnitBayPK = destinationfk And vBub.IsArchived = 0 /* Damien #DEV-910 Exclude Archived Bays */
					 WHERE worksOrderStatusFK IN (1,2)) tWoms ON tWoms.palletfk = tpal.palletpk
					WHERE tPal.locationTypeFK = 2 AND tLbs.Barcode = @var_Barcode and tPal.isArchived = 0
				END

				if (@var_BarcodeType = 3)
				BEGIN
					-- SetDown Area Scanned --
					-- Returns all non - archived pallets in the SetDownAea
					SELECT 4 as returnStatus
				END

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end
						
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END
