			--												 -- 7 Drive through racking
			--												 -- 8 Stock Item not setup
			--												 -- 9 Pallet is not current on the system / archived or does not exist   
			--												 -- 10 Pallet  is on a pick
			--												 -- 11 Pallet Type Does not exist
			--												 -- 13 Location Width is Zero
			--												 -- 14 Pallet Already in this location 

			-- Retrieve the Prefixes from the system
			   Select @setDownPrefix = SetDownAreaBarcodePrefix, 
					  @cellPrefix = BuildingUnitCellBarcodePrefix,
					  @loadingbayprefix = LoadingBayBarcodePrefix,
					  @SampleLocationprefix = SampleLocationBarcodePrefix,
					  @FloorLocationprefix = floorLocationBarcodePrefix
					  From appSystem where SystemPK = 1
   
			-- Get the pallet width plus the margins from the pallet width function 
				SELECT @PalletPK = PalletPK from tblPallets Where (barcode = @var_PalletBarcode OR CustomerBarcode = @var_PalletBarcode) 	AND IsArchived = 0
			  -- check if the pallet exists
				if (@PalletPK is null) 
				BEGIN 
					Select 9 as returnStatus,
						'Pallet Not Setup in the System' as returnMessage
					RETURN
				END

			-- Check if the pallet is already in this location 
				select @CurrentLocationBarcode = vbub.barcode,
					   @CurrentLocationName = BuildingName + ' - ' + BuildingUnit + ' - ' + BuildingUnitBayLocation  from tblpallets pal 
				inner join viewbuildingunitbays vbub on BuildingUnitBayPK = LocationFK and 
												vbub.LocationTypeFK = pal.LocationTypeFK
				where palletpk = @PalletPk
				IF (@var_locationBarcode = @CurrentLocationBarcode)
				BEGIN

					SELECT 14 as returnStatus,
						'Pallet is already in ' + @CurrentLocationName as returnMessage
					return
				END 

			-- check if the pallet type exists
				IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT palletType from tblPalletTypes tPaT 
											INNER JOIN tblPallets tpaL ON tPaT.pallettypePK = tpaL.palletTypeFK 
											WHERE palletPK = @PalletPK)
				BEGIN 
					SELECT 11 as returnStatus,			
						'Pallet Type is not Setup' as returnMessage
					RETURN
				END

				SELECT @PalletTotalWidth =  dbo.fnMobileGetPalletWidth(@palletPK)

			-- Check if the pallet is on a pick
			--   if exists (select containerOutPK from 
			--		tblcontainerOutLinePalletContent tColP 
			--		INNER JOIN tblContainerOutLines CoL on coL.containerOutLinePk = tColP.containerOutLineFK
			--		INNER JOIN tblContainerOuts tCo on tCo.containerOutPK = coL.containerOutFK 
			--		where 
			--		tColP.palletFK  = @PalletPK
			--		AND tCo.ContainerOutStatusFK not in (5,6))
			--	BEGIN
			--		-- Pallet is on a current Pick
			--		SELECT 10 as returnstatus,
			--			  GoodsOrderNumber 
			--			 from 
			--				tblcontainerOutLinePalletContent tColP 
			--				INNER JOIN tblContainerOutLines CoL on coL.containerOutLinePk = tColP.containerOutLineFK
			--				INNER JOIN tblContainerOuts tCo on tCo.containerOutPK = coL.containerOutFK 
			--				where 
			--				tColP.palletFK  = @PalletPK
			--				AND tCo.ContainerOutStatusFK not in (5,6)
			--
			--		RETURN
			--	END
			-- Check if the pallet scanned is stackable
				select @IsStackable =  tStoi.IsStackable
					--	 ,
					--   @StockInLinesPK = tSlin.StockInLinePK
					from tblPallets tPal
					inner join tblPalletContent tPaco on tPaco.PalletFK = tPal.PalletPK
					inner join tblStockItems tStoi on tPaco.StockItemFK = tStoi.StockItemPK
					WHERE  tPal.palletPk = @PalletPK
					  AND tPal.IsMixedPallet = 0

			-- check if barcode scanned is a cell , a loading bay or a setdown area

			  -- if setdown area scanned
			   IF(@setDownPrefix = SUBSTRING(@var_locationBarcode, 1, len(@setDownPrefix))) 
			   BEGIN
				  SELECT 1 AS returnstatus,            
						 3 AS locationTypeFK,
						SetDownAreaPK as locationFK,
						@PalletPK as PalletPK
						from tblSetDownAreas where Barcode = @var_locationBarcode 
				  RETURN
			   END

			  -- if loading bay scanned
			   IF(@loadingBayPrefix = SUBSTRING(@var_locationBarcode, 1, len(@loadingBayPrefix))) 
			   BEGIN
       
				  SELECT 1 AS returnstatus,	
						 2 AS locationTypeFK,
						LoadingBayPK as locationFK,
						@PalletPK as PalletPK
						from tblLoadingBays where Barcode = @var_locationBarcode 
				  RETURN
			   END
			  -- if Sample Location scanned
			   IF(@SampleLocationPrefix = SUBSTRING(@var_locationBarcode, 1, len(@SampleLocationPrefix))) 
			   BEGIN
       
				  SELECT 1 AS returnstatus,	
						 6 AS locationTypeFK,
						SampleLocationPK as LocationFK,
						@PalletPK as PalletPK
						from tblSampleLocations where Barcode = @var_locationBarcode 
				  RETURN
			   END

			  -- if Floor Location scanned
			   IF(@floorLocationPrefix = SUBSTRING(@var_locationBarcode, 1, len(@FloorLocationPrefix))) 
			   BEGIN
       
				  SELECT 1 AS returnstatus,	
						 8 AS locationTypeFK,
						FloorLocationPK as LocationFK,
						@PalletPK as PalletPK
						from tblfloorLocations where Barcode = @var_locationBarcode 
				  RETURN
			   END
    
			  --Racking Scanned
			   ELSE IF (@cellprefix = SUBSTRING(@var_locationBarcode, 1, len(@cellprefix)))
			   BEGIN
					-- A cell
  
						-- Get the locationFK , leftToRight and Baywidth from the BuildingUnitBay table  
						-- get building Unit details
						SELECT @ColumnFK = ColumnFK ,
							   @LocationFK = LocationFK,
							   @LocationText = location,
							   @LeftToRight = LocateFromLeft,
							   @BayWidth = width,
							   @RackingType = rackingType
							FROM dbo.fnMobileGetBuildingUnitBayDetails(@var_locationBarcode)   
			
						-- Check if the Bay Width is Zero
						if (@BayWidth =0)
						BEGIN
							SELECT 13 as ReturnStatus,
								'Location is not in Use' as returnStatus
							RETURN
						END     
						print '*** CELL ***'

					-- will do this check after the Location has been selected	
					-- check if a Works Order Movement already exists for this cell and pallet, if it does we will use this  
			--			if  EXISTS( select WorksOrderMovementPK from tblworksordermovements WHERE PalletFK = @PalletPK AND DestinationFK = @LocationFK AND worksOrderStatusFK  IN (1,2))
			--			BEGIN
			--			   SELECT  6 AS ReturnStatus
			--			   RETURN
			--			END
			--			ELSE
						BEGIN
						-- if Racking type is 1 (conventional)
						 if (@RackingType = 1) 
						BEGIN
							-- get the actual width of the pallets in the cell
     						-- check if there is any room
							-- Get the Total width of all pallets assigned to the cell + the obstructions to see if there is any room for the current pallet
							   SELECT @AcutalPalletWidthInCell = SUM(palletend - palletStart)
								FROM tblPallets tPal where locationFK = @LocationFK 
																	and tPal.IsArchived = 0
																	and tPal.loaded = 0
																	and locationTypeFK = 1
																	and palletstatusFK <> 10
							  SELECT @FreeSpace =  tBub.width - sum (palletend - palletStart) 
									  from 
										(
											SELECT palletEnd ,palletStart , locationFK from tblPallets tPal 
															  where locationFK = @LocationFK 
																and tPal.IsArchived = 0
																and tPal.loaded = 0
																and locationTypeFK = 1
																and palletstatusFK <> 10
											Union
											SELECT  DestinationPalletEnd , DestinationPalletStart, destinationFK 
														  from tblworksOrderMovements Woms 
														  INNER JOIN tblpallets tpal ON tpal.palletpk = woms.palletfk
														  where (destinationFK = @locationFK and Woms.PalletFK <> tpal.PalletPK) AND 
														  tpal.isarchived = 0 and 
														  woms.WorksOrderStatusFK < 3 /*Not complete or cancelled*/ 
											--Union 
											--SELECT ObstructionEnd , ObstructionStart , buildingUnitBayFK as palletFK from tblBuildingUnitBayObstructions 
															--  where buildingUnitBayFK = @LocationFK 
										) as tblPositions 
										inner join
										tblBuildingUnitBays tBub on  buildingUnitBayPK = locationFK And tbub.IsArchived = 0		/* Damien #DEV-910 Exclude Archived Bays*/
										group by tBub.width
							  if (@IsStackable = 1)
								 -- check if there is a space on top
							  BEGIN								  
								if EXISTS (select * FROM						             
									(SELECT 2 as returnstatus,
										   tblpallist.PalletStart,
										   tblpallist.bottomwith as PalletWidth,
										   bayposition + 1 as bayposition,
										   @LocationFK as LocationFK,
										   @LeftToRight as LeftToRight, 
										   @BayWidth as BayWidth ,
										   @LocationText  as locationText ,
										   PalletFK = @PalletPK,
										   1 as StackPosition
						       
						       
											FROM (	select * FROM 
									
												(select tpal.PalletPK,
													   tpal.BayPosition , 
													   tpal.palletstart ,
													   (palletend - palletstart) as bottomwith 
												  FROM tblPallets  tpal
												  INNER JOIN tblPalletContent tPalcon ON tPalcon.PalletFK = tpal.PalletPK
												  Where LocationFK = @LocationFK
													AND StackPosition = 0
													--AND tPalcon.StockItemFK = @StockItemFK
													--AND tPalcon.Batch = @batch
													AND tpal.isarchived = 0
													and tPal.loaded = 0
													and locationTypeFK = 1
													and palletstatusFK <> 10) tblbase
												  left outer join
												  (select tpal.PalletPK as stackpal, 
				   										  tpal.BayPosition as stackpos, 
														  tpal.PalletStart as stackstart
													 FROM tblPallets  tpal
													INNER JOIN tblPalletContent tPalcon ON tPalcon.PalletFK = tpal.PalletPK
													Where LocationFK = @LocationFK
													  AND StackPosition = 1
													 -- AND tPalcon.StockItemFK = @StockItemFK
													  AND tpal.isarchived = 0
													  and tPal.loaded = 0
													and locationTypeFK = 1
													and palletstatusFK <> 10
													  --AND tPalcon.Batch = @batch
													 ) tblStack ON tblbase.PalletStart = tblStack.stackstart
										  ) tblpallist
										  where stackpal IS NULL
											AND tblpallist.bottomwith = @PalletTotalWidth) tblStackpos
										  inner JOIN 
										  --  join with the current pallet if it is stackable
										  (	select   tSti.IsStackable ,tPal.PalletPK
											  from tblPallets tPal
											  INNER JOIN tblStockInLinePallets tSPal ON tPal.PalletPK = tsPal.PalletFK
											  INNER JOIN tblStockInLines tSlin ON tSPal.StockInLineFK = tSlin.StockInLinePK
											  INNER JOIN tblStockItems tSti ON tSti.StockItemPK = tSlin.StockItemFK
											  WHERE  tPal.palletPk = @PalletPK
												AND tPal.IsMixedPallet = 0
												AND tpal.isarchived = 0
												and tPal.loaded = 0
												--and locationTypeFK = 1
												and tpal.palletstatusFK <> 10
										   ) tblStackable
										   ON    tblStackable.PalletPK = tblStackpos.PalletFK
										   WHERE tblStackable.IsStackable = 1
										)
									SET @StackPositionExists = 1

								END

							  if @FreeSpace  is null   -- the cell is currently empty
							  BEGIN
							  PRint ' -- Cell is currently empty  '
								 -- The Bay is empty so Put the Pallet in the first position
								 SELECT 2 AS returnstatus, 
										0 AS PalletStart , 
										@PalletTotalWidth as PalletWidth,
										01 AS BayPosition,
										@LocationFK as LocationFK,
                   						@LeftToRight as LeftToRight, 
										@BayWidth as BayWidth ,
										@LocationText  as locationText ,
										PalletFK = @PalletPK,
										0 as StackPosition
		                    
								  RETURN
							  END
							  ELSE If (@FreeSpace < @PalletTotalWidth)  -- There is no space on the base
							  BEGIN		  
								-- check if the pallet can be stacked
								if (@ISStackable = 1 AND @StackPositionExists = 1)
								BEGIN
								PRint ' -- Pallet can be stacked  '
								  -- check if there is space on the bottom first or if it is an assigned pallet 
										if exists 		(select tpal.PalletPK,
																   tpal.BayPosition , 
																   tpal.palletstart ,
																   (palletend - palletstart) as bottomwith 
															  FROM tblPallets  tpal
															  INNER JOIN tblPalletContent tPalcon
															  ON tPalcon.PalletFK = tpal.PalletPK
															  Where LocationFK = @LocationFK
																AND StackPosition = 0
																--AND tPalcon.StockItemFK = @StockItemFK
																AND tpal.isarchived = 0
																and locationTypeFK = 1
																and palletstatusFK <> 10
																--AND tPalcon.Batch = @batch
															  ) 
										BEGIN
										PRint ' -- Another part 1  '
										  select * FROM
								           
											(SELECT 2 as returnstatus,
												   tblpallist.PalletStart,
												   tblpallist.bottomwith as PalletWidth,
												   bayposition + 1 as bayposition,
												   @LocationFK as LocationFK,
												   @LeftToRight as LeftToRight, 
												   @BayWidth as BayWidth ,
												   @LocationText  as locationText ,
												   PalletFK = @PalletPK,
												   1 as StackPosition
								       
								       
													FROM (	select * FROM 									
															(select tpal.PalletPK,
																	tpal.BayPosition , 
																	tpal.palletstart ,
																	(palletend - palletstart) as bottomwith 
															 FROM tblPallets  tpal
															  INNER JOIN tblPalletContent tPalcon ON tPalcon.PalletFK = tpal.PalletPK
															  Where LocationFK = @LocationFK
																AND StackPosition = 0
																--AND tPalcon.StockItemFK = @StockItemFK
																AND tpal.isarchived = 0
																and tPal.loaded = 0
																and locationTypeFK = 1
																and palletstatusFK <> 10
															  --AND tPalcon.Batch = @batch
														  ) tblbase
														  left outer join
														  (select tpal.PalletPK as stackpal, 
				   												  tpal.BayPosition as stackpos, 
																  tpal.PalletStart as stackstart
															 FROM tblPallets  tpal
															  INNER JOIN tblPalletContent tPalcon ON tPalcon.PalletFK = tpal.PalletPK
																Where LocationFK = @LocationFK
																  AND StackPosition = 1
																  --AND tPalcon.StockItemFK = @StockItemFK
																  AND tpal.isarchived = 0
																  AND tPal.loaded = 0
																  and locationTypeFK = 1
																  and palletstatusFK <> 10
																-- AND tPalcon.Batch = @batch
															 ) tblStack ON tblbase.PalletStart = tblStack.stackstart
												  ) tblpallist
												  where stackpal IS NULL
													AND tblpallist.bottomwith >= @PalletTotalWidth) tblStackpos
												  inner JOIN 
												  --  join with the current pallet if it is stackable
												  (	select   tSti.IsStackable ,tPal.PalletPK
													  from tblPallets tPal
													  INNER JOIN tblStockInLinePallets tSPal ON tPal.PalletPK = tsPal.PalletFK
													  INNER JOIN tblStockInLines tSlin ON tSPal.StockInLineFK = tSlin.StockInLinePK
													  INNER JOIN tblStockItems tSti ON tSti.StockItemPK = tSlin.StockItemFK
													  WHERE  tPal.palletPk = @PalletPK
														AND tPal.IsMixedPallet = 0
														AND tpal.isarchived = 0
														AND tPal.loaded = 0
														--and locationTypeFK = 1
														and tpal.palletstatusFK <> 10
												   ) tblStackable
												   ON    tblStackable.PalletPK = tblStackpos.PalletFK
												   WHERE tblStackable.IsStackable = 1
												 END
											END
											ELSE
											SELECT 3   AS returnstatus,
														'Cell Full' as returnMessage,
													   @IsStackable AS IsStackable
									RETURN
							  END
							  ELSE IF (@FreeSpace >= @PalletTotalWidth)  -- There is space  
							  BEGIN
							  PRint ' -- There is space  '
								-- check if there is a gap at the start 
							   SELECT @GapAtStart = case when (palletstart- @PalletTotalWidth >= 0) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END   FROM
								 (SELECT top 1* from (select palletEnd ,palletStart , locationFK, bayposition from tblPallets tPal 
											WHERE locationFK = @locationFK AND tpal.isarchived = 0 AND  tPal.loaded = 0  and locationTypeFK = 1 and palletstatusFK <> 10
											Union
											SELECT  DestinationPalletEnd , DestinationPalletStart, destinationFK , Destinationbayposition
														  from tblworksOrderMovements Woms 
														  INNER JOIN tblpallets tpal ON tpal.palletpk = woms.palletfk
														  where (destinationFK = @locationFK and Woms.PalletFK <> tpal.PalletPK) AND 
														  tpal.isarchived = 0 and 
														  woms.WorksOrderStatusFK < 3 /*Not complete or cancelled*/ 
											Union 
											SELECT ObstructionEnd , ObstructionStart , buildingUnitBayFK, 0 as palletFK from tblBuildingUnitBayObstructions where 
																   buildingUnitBayFK = @locationFK and IsArchived=0
											) as tblfirstposition order by palletStart ) tblGapAtStart
								 if @GapATStart = 1
									BEGIN
									PRint ' -- Gap at Start  '
										-- check if the current pallet is stackable
										if (@IsStackable = 1)
										BEGIN
										PRint ' -- stackable '
											-- the pallet will fit in the first position
											SELECT 2 AS returnstatus, 
												0 AS PalletStart , 
												@PalletTotalWidth as PalletWidth,
												01 AS BayPosition,
												@LocationFK as LocationFK,
                   								@LeftToRight as LeftToRight, 
												@BayWidth as BayWidth ,
												@LocationText  as locationText ,
												PalletFK = @PalletPK,
												0 as StackPosition
											 -- Join the available spaces with stack positions
											UNION
											  select returnstatus,
													 palletstart,
													 palletwidth,
													 bayposition,
													 locationfk,
													 lefttoright,
													 Baywidth,
													 LocationText,
													 PalletFK,
													 StackPosition FROM
												   (SELECT * from 
														(SELECT 2 as returnstatus,
															   tblpallist.PalletStart,
															   tblpallist.bottomwith as PalletWidth,
															   bayposition + 1 as bayposition,
															   @LocationFK as LocationFK,
															   @LeftToRight as LeftToRight, 
															   @BayWidth as BayWidth ,
															   @LocationText  as locationText ,
															   PalletFK = @PalletPK,
															   1 as StackPosition
											       
											       
																FROM (	select * FROM 
																	-- check if they are the same stock and batch 
																	(select tpal.PalletPK,
																		   tpal.BayPosition , 
																		   tpal.palletstart ,
																		   (palletend - palletstart) as bottomwith 
																	  FROM tblPallets  tpal
																	  INNER JOIN tblPalletContent tPalcon
																	  ON tPalcon.PalletFK = tpal.PalletPK
																	  Where LocationFK = @LocationFK
																		AND StackPosition = 0
																		--AND tPalcon.StockItemFK = @StockItemFK
																		AND tpal.isarchived = 0
																		AND tPal.loaded = 0
																		and locationTypeFK = 1
																		and palletstatusFK <> 10
																		--AND tPalcon.Batch = @batch
																		  ) tblbase
																	  left outer join
																	  (select tpal.PalletPK as stackpal, 
				   															  tpal.BayPosition as stackpos, 
																			  tpal.PalletStart as stackstart
																		 FROM tblPallets  tpal
																		  INNER JOIN tblPalletContent tPalcon
																			ON tPalcon.PalletFK = tpal.PalletPK
																			Where LocationFK = @LocationFK
																			  AND StackPosition = 1
																			  --AND tPalcon.StockItemFK = @StockItemFK
																			  AND tpal.isarchived = 0
																			  AND tPal.loaded = 0
																			  and locationTypeFK = 1
																			  and palletstatusFK <> 10
																			  --AND tPalcon.Batch = @batch
																				) tblStack ON tblbase.PalletStart = tblStack.stackstart
															  ) tblpallist
															  where stackpal IS NULL
																AND tblpallist.bottomwith = @PalletTotalWidth) tblStackpos
															  inner JOIN 
															  --  join with the current pallet if it is stackable
															  (	select   tSti.IsStackable ,tPal.PalletPK
																  from tblPallets tPal
																  INNER JOIN tblStockInLinePallets tSPal ON tPal.PalletPK = tsPal.PalletFK
																  INNER JOIN tblStockInLines tSlin ON tSPal.StockInLineFK = tSlin.StockInLinePK
																  INNER JOIN tblStockItems tSti ON tSti.StockItemPK = tSlin.StockItemFK
																  WHERE  tPal.palletPk = @PalletPK
																	AND tPal.IsMixedPallet = 0
																	AND tpal.isarchived = 0
																	AND tPal.loaded = 0
																	--and locationTypeFK = 1
																	and tpal.palletstatusFK <> 10
															   ) tblStackable
															   ON    tblStackable.PalletPK = tblStackpos.PalletFK
															   WHERE tblStackable.IsStackable =	1
															) tblSpaceAvail	
												RETURN
										  END -- IsStackable = 1
										  ELSE
											BEGIN
												PRint ' -- Only show the base  '
												-- Only show space on the base 
											-- the pallet will fit in the first position

												SELECT 2 AS returnstatus, 
													0 AS PalletStart , 
													@PalletTotalWidth as PalletWidth,
													01 AS BayPosition,
													@LocationFK as LocationFK,
                   									@LeftToRight as LeftToRight, 
													@BayWidth as BayWidth ,
													@LocationText  as locationText ,
													PalletFK = @PalletPK,
													0 as StackPosition
												RETURN
											END
										 END -- if gap at the start
								-- End of the Check if there is a gap at the start
								  ELSE
									BEGIN
									PRint ' -- pallet will fit in another location '
									-- check if the pallet will fit in another location
										   SELECT  @SpaceAvailable = SpaceAvailable,
											 @PalletStart = PalletEnd,
											 @BayPosition = BayPosition + 1
										   FROM 
												(select palletStart, palletEnd  , locationFK, tblPalletList.bayposition, 
												 -- check if there is a gap
													 case when NextPalletStart is not null then
															  CASE WHEN (NextPalletStart - palletEnd) >= @PalletTotalWidth then  1 END
														   else
															  -- check if there is space from hte last pallet to the end of the cell
															  CASE WHEN (@BayWidth - palletEnd) >= @PalletTotalWidth then 1 else 0 END
														   end as SpaceAvailable 
												from (select palletStart, palletEnd  , locationFK, bayposition from tblPallets tPal 
																					where locationFK = @locationFK AND tpal.isarchived = 0 	AND tPal.loaded = 0 and locationTypeFK = 1 and palletstatusFK <> 10
																					Union
																					SELECT  DestinationPalletEnd , DestinationPalletStart, destinationFK , destinationBayPosition
																								  from tblworksOrderMovements Woms 
																								  INNER JOIN tblpallets tpal ON tpal.palletpk = woms.palletfk
																								  where (destinationFK = @locationFK and Woms.PalletFK <> tpal.PalletPK) AND 
																								  tpal.isarchived = 0 and 
																								  woms.WorksOrderStatusFK < 3  /*Not complete or cancelled*/ 
																					Union 
																					SELECT ObstructionStart ,ObstructionEnd ,  buildingUnitBayFK, 0 as palletFK from tblBuildingUnitBayObstructions where 
																										   buildingUnitBayFK = @locationFK and IsArchived=0
												) as tblPalletList
												left outer join
												 (select palletstart as NextPalletStart, bayposition  from (select palletStart, palletEnd  , locationFK, bayposition from tblPallets tPal 
																					WHERE locationFK = @locationFK AND tpal.isarchived = 0 AND tPal.loaded = 0 and locationTypeFK = 1 and palletstatusFK <> 10 
																					UNION
																						SELECT  DestinationPalletEnd , DestinationPalletStart, destinationFK ,destinationBayPosition
																									  from tblworksOrderMovements Woms 
																									  INNER JOIN tblpallets tpal ON tpal.palletpk = woms.palletfk
																									  where (destinationFK = @locationFK and Woms.PalletFK <> tpal.PalletPK) AND 
																									  tpal.isarchived = 0 and 
																									  woms.WorksOrderStatusFK < 3  /*Not complete or cancelled*/ 
																					Union 
																					SELECT ObstructionStart ,ObstructionEnd ,  buildingUnitBayFK, 0 as palletFK from tblBuildingUnitBayObstructions where 
																										   buildingUnitBayFK = @locationFK and IsArchived=0
												)  tblpallist) tblNextStart ON tblNextStart.bayposition = (tblPalletList.bayposition + 1)
												) tblSpaceAvailable  where SpaceAvailable = 1 order by palletEnd desc
						
											-- Check if there is space and return status of 2 if there is otherwise return status 3
											IF @SpaceAvailable is null 
											BEGIN                           
											PRint ' -- Space Availabe '    
												if (@IsStackable = 1)
												BEGIN

												   -- check if there are stacked spaces available
													-- Join the available spaces with stack positions
														IF EXISTS (SELECT 2 as returnstatus,
															 tblpallist.PalletStart,
															 tblpallist.bottomwith as PalletWidth,
															 bayposition + 1 as bayposition,
															 @LocationFK as LocationFK,
															 @LeftToRight as LeftToRight, 
															 @BayWidth as BayWidth ,
															 @LocationText  as locationText ,
															 PalletFK = @PalletPK,
															 1 as StackPosition
															 FROM (
																	select * FROM (
																	-- check if they are the same stock and batch 
																	select tpal.PalletPK, tpal.BayPosition , tpal.palletstart 
																	, (palletend - palletstart) as bottomwith FROM tblPallets  tpal
																	INNER JOIN tblPalletContent tPalcon
																	ON tPalcon.PalletFK = tpal.PalletPK
																	Where LocationFK = @LocationFK
																	AND StackPosition = 0
																	--AND tPalcon.StockItemFK = @StockItemFK
																	AND tpal.isarchived = 0
																	AND tPal.loaded = 0
																	and locationTypeFK = 1 
																	and palletstatusFK <> 10 
																	--AND tPalcon.Batch = @batch
																	  ) tblbase
																	left outer join
																	(select tpal.PalletPK as stackpal, 
																			tpal.BayPosition as stackpos, 
																			tpal.PalletStart as stackstart
																	   FROM tblPallets  tpal
																	INNER JOIN tblPalletContent tPalcon
																	ON tPalcon.PalletFK = tpal.PalletPK
																	Where LocationFK = @LocationFK
																	AND StackPosition = 1
																	AND tpal.isarchived = 0
																	--AND tPalcon.StockItemFK = @StockItemFK
																	AND tPal.loaded = 0		
																	and locationTypeFK = 1 
																	and palletstatusFK <> 10 												
																	--AND tPalcon.Batch = @batch
																	) tblStack ON tblbase.PalletStart = tblStack.stackstart
																	) tblpallist
															  where stackpal IS NULL
															  AND tblpallist.bottomwith >= @PalletTotalWidth)
													BEGIN
														SELECT 2 as returnstatus,
															 tblpallist.PalletStart,
															 tblpallist.bottomwith as PalletWidth,
															 bayposition + 1 as bayposition,
															 @LocationFK as LocationFK,
															 @LeftToRight as LeftToRight, 
															 @BayWidth as BayWidth ,
															 @LocationText  as locationText ,
															 PalletFK = @PalletPK,
															 1 as StackPosition
															 FROM (
																	select * FROM (
																	-- check if they are the same stock and batch 
																	select tpal.PalletPK, tpal.BayPosition , tpal.palletstart 
																	, (palletend - palletstart) as bottomwith FROM tblPallets  tpal
																	INNER JOIN tblPalletContent tPalcon
																	ON tPalcon.PalletFK = tpal.PalletPK
																	Where LocationFK = @LocationFK
																	AND StackPosition = 0
																	--AND tPalcon.StockItemFK = @StockItemFK
																	AND tpal.isarchived = 0
																	AND tPal.loaded = 0
																	and locationTypeFK = 1 
																	and palletstatusFK <> 10 
																	--AND tPalcon.Batch = @batch
																	  ) tblbase
																	left outer join
																	(select tpal.PalletPK as stackpal, 
																			tpal.BayPosition as stackpos, 
																			tpal.PalletStart as stackstart
																	   FROM tblPallets  tpal
																	INNER JOIN tblPalletContent tPalcon
																	ON tPalcon.PalletFK = tpal.PalletPK
																	Where LocationFK = @LocationFK
																	AND StackPosition = 1
																	AND tpal.isarchived = 0
																	--AND tPalcon.StockItemFK = @StockItemFK
																	AND tPal.loaded = 0		
																	and locationTypeFK = 1 
																	and palletstatusFK <> 10 												
																	--AND tPalcon.Batch = @batch
																	) tblStack ON tblbase.PalletStart = tblStack.stackstart
																	) tblpallist
															  where stackpal IS NULL
															  AND tblpallist.bottomwith >= @PalletTotalWidth
													END
								
												  ELSE
													SELECT 3 AS returnstatus,
															'Cell Full ' as returnMessage,
															0 AS IsStackable
													RETURN
												 END
												 ELSE
													BEGIN
														SELECT 3 AS returnstatus, 'Cell Full - Shift pallets across ' as returnMessage, 0 AS IsStackable
														RETURN
													END
											END
									   ELSE
										BEGIN
										PRint ' -- Going in here now '
												IF (@IsStackable = 1)
												BEGIN
												PRint ' -- Stack it high '
													SELECT 2 AS returnstatus, 
														@PalletStart AS PalletStart , 
														@PalletTotalWidth as PalletWidth,
														@BayPosition AS BayPosition,
														@LocationFK as LocationFK,
                   										@LeftToRight as LeftToRight, 
														@BayWidth as BayWidth ,
														@LocationText  as locationText ,
														PalletFK = @PalletPK,
														0 as StackPosition
													  -- Join the available spaces with stack positions
													UNION
													SELECT 2 as returnstatus,
														 tblpallist.PalletStart,
														 tblpallist.bottomwith as PalletWidth,
														 bayposition + 1 as bayposition,
														 @LocationFK as LocationFK,
														 @LeftToRight as LeftToRight, 
														 @BayWidth as BayWidth ,
														 @LocationText  as locationText ,
														 PalletFK = @PalletPK,
														 1 as StackPosition
														 FROM (
																select * FROM (
																-- check if they are the same stock and batch 
																select tpal.PalletPK, tpal.BayPosition , tpal.palletstart 
																, (palletend - palletstart) as bottomwith FROM tblPallets  tpal
																INNER JOIN tblPalletContent tPalcon
																ON tPalcon.PalletFK = tpal.PalletPK
																Where LocationFK = @LocationFK
																AND StackPosition = 0
																--AND tPalcon.StockItemFK = @StockItemFK
																AND tpal.isarchived = 0
																AND tPal.loaded = 0
																and locationTypeFK = 1 
																and palletstatusFK <> 10 
																--AND tPalcon.Batch = @batch
																) tblbase
																left outer join
																(select tpal.PalletPK as stackpal, 
																		tpal.BayPosition as stackpos, 
																		tpal.PalletStart as stackstart
																   FROM tblPallets  tpal
																INNER JOIN tblPalletContent tPalcon
																ON tPalcon.PalletFK = tpal.PalletPK
																Where LocationFK = @LocationFK
																AND StackPosition = 1
																--AND tPalcon.StockItemFK = @StockItemFK
																AND tpal.isarchived = 0
																AND tPal.loaded = 0
																and locationTypeFK = 1 
																and palletstatusFK <> 10 
																--AND tPalcon.Batch = @batch
																   ) tblStack ON
																tblbase.PalletStart = tblStack.stackstart
																) tblpallist
														  where stackpal IS NULL
														  AND tblpallist.bottomwith = @PalletTotalWidth
														RETURN
												END
												ELSE
												SELECT 2 AS returnstatus, 
														@PalletStart AS PalletStart , 
														@PalletTotalWidth as PalletWidth,
														@BayPosition AS BayPosition,
														@LocationFK as LocationFK,
                   										@LeftToRight as LeftToRight, 
														@BayWidth as BayWidth ,
														@LocationText  as locationText ,
														PalletFK = @PalletPK,
														0 as StackPosition
											  RETURN
											END  -- if space available
										END  -- gap at the start
									-- check if the pallet will fit in another location
							END  -- there is a space
						END -- of conventional
						ELSE
						BEGIN
							-- check for drivethrough
							-- check if the column is empty 
							-- generates a list of the current pallets and then assigns pallets to the location
     						If (NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM (
									SELECT  palletpk, palletend , locationfk , bayposition 
											from tblpallets  
											WHERE  locationFK IN (SELECT BuildingUnitBayPK 
																	FROM tblBuildingUnitBays 
																	WHERE BuildingUnitColumnFK = @ColumnFK AND IsArchived = 0)	/* Damien #DEV-910 Exclude Archived Bays */
											AND isArchived = 0
											and locationTypeFK = 1 
											and palletstatusFK <> 10 
									UNION
									SELECT	 PalletFK as palletPK, destinationpalletend, destinationFK, destinationBayPosition 
											from tblWorksOrderMovements woms
											INNER JOIN tblpallets tpal ON tpal.palletpk = woms.palletfk
											WHERE destinationFK IN (SELECT BuildingUnitBayPK 
																	FROM tblBuildingUnitBays 
																	WHERE BuildingUnitColumnFK = @ColumnFK AND IsArchived = 0)	/* Damien #DEV-910 Exclude Archived Bays */
													and tpal.isarchived = 0
									) as tblPalletsInColumn ))
									BEGIN
										-- No Pallets assigned to this Column so select the top level and the first position
											SELECT 7 AS returnstatus, 
														0 AS PalletStart , 
														@PalletTotalWidth as PalletWidth,
														01 AS BayPosition,
														(select TOP 1 buildingUnitBayPK 
																FROM tblBuildingUnitBays 
																WHERE BuildingUnitColumnFK = @ColumnFK AND IsArchived = 0	/* Damien #DEV-910 Exclude Archived Bays */
																ORDER BY BayLevel desc) as LocationFK,
                   										@LeftToRight as LeftToRight, 
														@BayWidth as BayWidth ,
														@LocationText as locationText ,
														PalletFK = @PalletPK,
														(select TOP 1 barcode
																FROM tblBuildingUnitBays 
																WHERE BuildingUnitColumnFK = @ColumnFK AND IsArchived = 0	/* Damien #DEV-910 Exclude Archived Bays */
																ORDER BY BayLevel desc) as Barcode
														RETURN
									END 
									ELSE
									BEGIN
									print @palletTotalWidth
									print @var_locationBarcode
										  -- check if the Column is full
										  if (not exists (		
											select top 1 * from (
												select tbubs.buildingunitbaypk, tbubs.baylevel, totalspacefilled, case when spaceleft is null then 1 else spaceleft end as spaceleft
												from tblbuildingunitbays tbubs
												left outer join (
													select tblTotalSpaceFilled.baylevel, totalspacefilled , tbub.buildingunitbaypk , (width - (totalspacefilled + @palletTotalWidth)) as spaceavail,
														case when (width - (totalspacefilled + @palletTotalWidth)) >= 0 then 1 When (width - (totalspacefilled + @palletTotalWidth)) is null then 1 else 0 end as spaceleft 
													from tblbuildingunitbays tbub 
													inner join (
														select  baylevel,buildingunitbaypk,  sum(palletwidth) as totalSpaceFilled 
														from tblbuildingunitbays tbub1
														inner join (
															select palletpk, (palletend-palletstart) as palletwidth , locationfk , bayposition 
															from tblpallets 
															where isarchived = 0 AND loaded = 0 and locationTypeFK = 1 and stackposition = 0 and palletstatusFK <> 10 
														) tblpallets  on locationfk = buildingunitbayPK 
														where tbub1.IsArchived=0 and buildingUnitColumnFK in (select buildingunitcolumnfk from tblbuildingunitbays where barcode = @var_locationBarcode)									  
														group by baylevel, buildingunitbaypk 
													) tblTotalSpaceFilled on tbub.buildingunitbaypk = tblTotalSpaceFilled.buildingunitbaypk 
												) tblspaceleftincell on tbubs.buildingunitbaypk = tblspaceleftincell.buildingunitbaypk
												where tbubs.IsArchived=0 and buildingUnitColumnFK in (select buildingunitcolumnfk from tblbuildingunitbays where barcode = @var_locationBarcode) 
											) tblspacesfree where spaceleft  = 1 order by baylevel desc))
											BEGIN
											print 'this is wrong'
												-- column is full
												SELECT 3 AS returnstatus,
													'Cell Full ' as returnMessage
												RETURN
											END
											else
											BEGIN
												-- get a location in the column
											   select @locationFK = buildingunitbaypk
												FROM (
													SELECT top 1 * from (
														select tbubs.buildingunitbaypk, tbubs.baylevel, totalspacefilled,   case when spaceleft is null then 1 else spaceleft end as spaceleft
														from tblbuildingunitbays tbubs
														left outer join (
															select tblTotalSpaceFilled.baylevel, totalspacefilled , tbub.buildingunitbaypk,
																(width - (totalspacefilled + @palletTotalWidth)) as spaceavail, case when (width - (totalspacefilled + @palletTotalWidth)) >= 0 then 1 When (width - (totalspacefilled + @palletTotalWidth)) is null then 1 else 0  end as spaceleft 
															from tblbuildingunitbays tbub 
															inner join (
																select  baylevel,buildingunitbaypk, sum(palletwidth) as totalSpaceFilled 
																from tblbuildingunitbays tbub1 
																inner join  (
																	select palletpk, (palletend-palletstart) as palletwidth , locationfk , bayposition 
																	from tblpallets 
																	where isarchived = 0 AND loaded = 0 and locationTypeFK = 1 and palletstatusFK <> 10 
																) tblpallets  on locationfk = buildingunitbayPK 
																where tbub1.isarchived=0 and buildingUnitColumnFK in  (select buildingunitcolumnfk from tblbuildingunitbays where barcode = @var_locationBarcode)
																group by baylevel, buildingunitbaypk 
															) tblTotalSpaceFilled on tbub.buildingunitbaypk = tblTotalSpaceFilled.buildingunitbaypk 
														) tblspaceleftincell on tbubs.buildingunitbaypk = tblspaceleftincell.buildingunitbaypk
														 where tbubs.IsArchived=0 and buildingUnitColumnFK in (select buildingunitcolumnfk from tblbuildingunitbays where barcode = @var_locationBarcode) 
													) tblspacesfree where spaceleft  = 1 order by baylevel desc
												) tblFreeLevel
													
												SELECT 7 as returnStatus,
													case when BayPosition IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE PalletEnd END as palletStart, 
													@PalletTotalWidth as PalletWidth,  
													case when BayPosition is null then 1 else(BayPosition + 1) end as BayPosition,
													@LocationText as locationText,
													@LocationFK as LocationFK,
                   									@LeftToRight as LeftToRight, 
													@BayWidth as BayWidth ,
													PalletFK = @PalletPK ,
													Barcode = tbuB.barcode	      
												FROM tblBuildingunitbays tbuB 
												left outer join (
													SELECT top 1 * from (
														select palletEnd ,palletStart , locationFK, BayPosition 
														from tblPallets tPal 
														where locationFK = @locationFK  AND tPal.IsArchived = 0 AND tPal.loaded = 0 and locationTypeFK = 1  and palletstatusFK <> 10 
														Union
														SELECT  DestinationPalletEnd , DestinationPalletStart, destinationFK ,destinationBayPosition
														from tblworksOrderMovements Woms 
														INNER JOIN tblpallets tpal ON tpal.palletpk = woms.palletfk
														where (destinationFK = @locationFK and Woms.PalletFK <> tpal.PalletPK)
															AND tpal.isarchived = 0   and locationTypeFK = 1  and palletstatusFK <> 10  and woms.WorksOrderStatusFK < 3 /*Not complete or cancelled*/ 												 
													) tbllastBayPosition
													order by palletend desc
												) tblBayPosition ON tbuB.BuildingUnitBayPK = tblBayPosition.locationFK 
												WHERE tbuB.BuildingUnitBayPK = @locationFK
											RETURN
			  								  END -- end of get location
										  END -- not empty
								END -- check for drive through
					END
			   END
			   ELSE
			   BEGIN
					-- Not a Set Down area or a Cell
					SELECT 4 AS returnstatus,
						  'Wrong Barcode Scanned' as returnMessage
					RETURN
			   END

				-- if there is no return status assigned then there is a problem
				SELECT 5 as returnstatus
                    
			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end
						
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END
GO

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spMobileManualPlacementFindPlaceInCell]

)         
AS        
BEGIN

 ,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;
