 SET @var_locationBarcode = @locationBarcode; SET @var_PalletBarcode = @PalletBarcode; set @var_palletfk=@palletfk;set @var_Isstackable=@Isstackable      
 SET @ParameterDetails = '@locationBarcode = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_locationBarcode AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@PalletBarcode = '         
  + ISNULL(CAST(@var_PalletBarcode AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@palletfk = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_palletfk AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'')        
    + ',@Isstackable = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_Isstackable AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'')        
    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL         
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)        
        
    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)        
    --BEGIN        
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC         
        
  SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)        
        
        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)        
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK        
        
        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()        
    --END        
        
        
 SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);        
 SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails        
 ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;        
 INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()        
        
 WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3        
 BEGIN         
  BEGIN TRY        
             
   -- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start        
         
   DECLARE @LocationFK   int        
   DECLARE @PalletTotalWidth int        
   DECLARE @PalletStart      int        
   DECLARE @FreeSpace        int     -- used for storing the total width that is free in a cell        
   DECLARE @LeftToRight      bit        
   DECLARE @BayWidth         int        
   DECLARE @LocationText     nvarchar (100)        
   DECLARE @RackingType      int        
   DECLARE @ColumnFK    int         
   --DECLARE @IsStackable int        
   DECLARE @GapAtStart    int        
   DECLARE @BayPosition      int        
   DECLARE @SpaceAvailable   int        
   DECLARE @StockItemFK      int        
   DECLARE @batch        nvarchar(100)        
   DECLARE @StackPositionExists int        
   --DECLARE @AcutalPalletWidthInCell int        
        
    DECLARE @errorNo int        
    DECLARE @errorMessage nvarchar(500)        
    DECLARE @procedure nvarchar (100)        
       
        
    SELECT @PalletTotalWidth =  dbo.fnMobileGetPalletWidth(@var_palletfk)        
        
        
 SELECT @ColumnFK = ColumnFK ,        
  @LocationFK = LocationFK,        
  @LocationText = location,        
  @LeftToRight = LocateFromLeft,        
  @BayWidth = width,        
  @RackingType = rackingType        
 FROM dbo.fnMobileGetBuildingUnitBayDetails(@var_locationBarcode)           
           
    -- Check if the Bay Width is Zero        
    if (@BayWidth =0)        
    BEGIN        
    SELECT 13 as ReturnStatus,        
    'Location is not in Use' as returnMessage,  
    @var_Isstackable AS IsStackable,   
  0 AS PalletStart ,         
          -1 as PalletWidth,        
          01 AS BayPosition,        
          -1 as LocationFK,        
                         cast(0 as bit) as LeftToRight,         
          -1 as BayWidth ,        
          ''  as locationText ,        
          PalletFK = @var_palletfk,        
          0 as StackPosition   
      
    RETURN        
    END                
        
       
      -- if Racking type is 1 (conventional)        
 if (@RackingType = 1)         
    BEGIN        
       -- get the actual width of the pallets in the cell        
           -- check if there is any room        
       -- Get the Total width of all pallets assigned to the cell + the obstructions to see if there is any room for the current pallet        
        --  SELECT @AcutalPalletWidthInCell = SUM(palletend - palletStart)        
        --FROM tblPallets tPal where locationFK = @LocationFK         
        --         and tPal.IsArchived = 0        
        --         and tPal.loaded = 0        
        --         and locationTypeFK = 1        
        --         and palletstatusFK <> 10        
         SELECT @FreeSpace =  tBub.width - sum (palletend - palletStart)         
         from         
         (        
           SELECT palletEnd ,palletStart , locationFK from tblPallets tPal         
                 where locationFK = @LocationFK         
                and tPal.IsArchived = 0        
                and tPal.loaded = 0        
                and locationTypeFK = 1        
                and palletstatusFK <> 10        
           Union        
           SELECT  DestinationPalletEnd , DestinationPalletStart, destinationFK         
                from tblworksOrderMovements Woms         
                INNER JOIN tblpallets tpal ON tpal.palletpk = woms.palletfk        
                where (destinationFK = @locationFK and Woms.PalletFK <> tpal.PalletPK) AND         
                tpal.isarchived = 0 and         
                woms.WorksOrderStatusFK < 3 /*Not complete or cancelled*/         
           --Union         
           --SELECT ObstructionEnd , ObstructionStart , buildingUnitBayFK as palletFK from tblBuildingUnitBayObstructions         
               --  where buildingUnitBayFK = @LocationFK         
          ) as tblPositions         
          inner join   tblBuildingUnitBays tBub on  buildingUnitBayPK = locationFK And tbub.IsArchived = 0  /* Damien #DEV-910 Exclude Archived Bays*/        
          group by tBub.width        
             
    if (@var_Isstackable = 1)        
         -- check if there is a space on top        
          BEGIN                  
   if EXISTS (select * FROM                           
    (SELECT 2 as returnstatus,        
     tblpallist.PalletStart,  tblpallist.bottomwith as PalletWidth, bayposition + 1 as bayposition,  @LocationFK as LocationFK,  @LeftToRight as LeftToRight,         
     @BayWidth as BayWidth ,     @LocationText  as locationText ,     PalletFK = @var_palletfk, 1 as StackPosition        
    FROM ( select * FROM         
     (select tpal.PalletPK,  tpal.BayPosition , tpal.palletstart , (palletend - palletstart) as bottomwith         
     FROM tblPallets  tpal        
     INNER JOIN tblPalletContent tPalcon ON tPalcon.PalletFK = tpal.PalletPK        
     Where LocationFK = @LocationFK        
     AND StackPosition = 0        
      --AND tPalcon.StockItemFK = @StockItemFK        
      --AND tPalcon.Batch = @batch        
      AND tpal.isarchived = 0        
     and tPal.loaded = 0        
     and locationTypeFK = 1        
     and palletstatusFK <> 10) tblbase        
     left outer join        
     (select tpal.PalletPK as stackpal,  tpal.BayPosition as stackpos, tpal.PalletStart as stackstart        
     FROM tblPallets  tpal        
     INNER JOIN tblPalletContent tPalcon ON tPalcon.PalletFK = tpal.PalletPK        
     Where LocationFK = @LocationFK        
     AND StackPosition = 1        
     -- AND tPalcon.StockItemFK = @StockItemFK        
     AND tpal.isarchived = 0        
     and tPal.loaded = 0        
     and locationTypeFK = 1        
     and palletstatusFK <> 10        
     --AND tPalcon.Batch = @batch        
     ) tblStack ON tblbase.PalletStart = tblStack.stackstart        
    ) tblpallist        
    where stackpal IS NULL        
     AND tblpallist.bottomwith = @PalletTotalWidth) tblStackpos        
            inner JOIN         
            --  join with the current pallet if it is stackable        
            ( select   tSti.IsStackable ,tPal.PalletPK        
             from tblPallets tPal        
             INNER JOIN tblStockInLinePallets tSPal ON tPal.PalletPK = tsPal.PalletFK        
             INNER JOIN tblStockInLines tSlin ON tSPal.StockInLineFK = tSlin.StockInLinePK        
             INNER JOIN tblStockItems tSti ON tSti.StockItemPK = tSlin.StockItemFK        
             WHERE  tPal.palletPk = @var_palletfk        
            AND tPal.IsMixedPallet = 0        
            AND tpal.isarchived = 0        
            and tPal.loaded = 0        
            --and locationTypeFK = 1        
            and tpal.palletstatusFK <> 10        
             ) tblStackable        
             ON    tblStackable.PalletPK = tblStackpos.PalletFK        
             WHERE tblStackable.IsStackable = 1        
          )        
         SET @StackPositionExists = 1        
        
        END        
        
         if @FreeSpace  is null   -- the cell is currently empty        
         BEGIN        
         PRint ' -- Cell is currently empty  '        
         -- The Bay is empty so Put the Pallet in the first position   
     
         SELECT 2 AS returnstatus,   
    '' as returnMessage,   
       @var_Isstackable AS IsStackable,   
          0 AS PalletStart ,         
          @PalletTotalWidth as PalletWidth,        
          01 AS BayPosition,        
          @LocationFK as LocationFK,        
                         @LeftToRight as LeftToRight,         
          @BayWidth as BayWidth ,        
          @LocationText  as locationText ,        
          PalletFK = @var_palletfk,        
          0 as StackPosition        
                              
          RETURN        
         END        
         ELSE If (@FreeSpace < @PalletTotalWidth)  -- There is no space on the base        
         BEGIN            
        -- check if the pallet can be stacked        
        if (@ISStackable = 1 AND @StackPositionExists = 1)        
        BEGIN        
        PRint ' -- Pallet can be stacked  '        
          -- check if there is space on the bottom first or if it is an assigned pallet         
          if exists   (select tpal.PalletPK,        
                   tpal.BayPosition ,         
                   tpal.palletstart ,        
                   (palletend - palletstart) as bottomwith         
                 FROM tblPallets  tpal        
                 INNER JOIN tblPalletContent tPalcon ON tPalcon.PalletFK = tpal.PalletPK        
                 Where LocationFK = @LocationFK        
     AND StackPosition = 0        
                --AND tPalcon.StockItemFK = @StockItemFK        
     AND tpal.isarchived = 0        
     and locationTypeFK = 1        
     and palletstatusFK <> 10        
                --AND tPalcon.Batch = @batch        
                 )         
          BEGIN        
          PRint ' -- Another part 1  '        
            select * FROM        
                           
           (SELECT 2 as returnstatus,   
    '' as returnMessage,  
      @var_Isstackable AS IsStackable,   
               tblpallist.PalletStart,        
               tblpallist.bottomwith as PalletWidth,        
               bayposition + 1 as bayposition,        
               @LocationFK as LocationFK,        
               @LeftToRight as LeftToRight,         
               @BayWidth as BayWidth ,        
               @LocationText  as locationText ,        
               PalletFK = @var_palletfk,        
               1 as StackPosition     
             FROM (   
    select * FROM (  
     select tpal.PalletPK,        
      tpal.BayPosition ,         
      tpal.palletstart ,        
      (palletend - palletstart) as bottomwith         
     FROM tblPallets  tpal        
     INNER JOIN tblPalletContent tPalcon ON tPalcon.PalletFK = tpal.PalletPK        
     Where LocationFK = @LocationFK        
      AND StackPosition = 0        
      --AND tPalcon.StockItemFK = @StockItemFK        
      AND tpal.isarchived = 0        
      and tPal.loaded = 0        
      and locationTypeFK = 1        
      and palletstatusFK <> 10        
      --AND tPalcon.Batch = @batch        
    ) tblbase        
                left outer join (  
     select tpal.PalletPK as stackpal, tpal.BayPosition as stackpos, tpal.PalletStart as stackstart        
     FROM tblPallets  tpal        
     INNER JOIN tblPalletContent tPalcon ON tPalcon.PalletFK = tpal.PalletPK        
     Where LocationFK = @LocationFK        
      AND StackPosition = 1        
      --AND tPalcon.StockItemFK = @StockItemFK        
      AND tpal.isarchived = 0        
      AND tPal.loaded = 0        
      and locationTypeFK = 1        
      and palletstatusFK <> 10        
      -- AND tPalcon.Batch = @batch        
    ) tblStack ON tblbase.PalletStart = tblStack.stackstart        
              ) tblpallist        
              where stackpal IS NULL AND tblpallist.bottomwith >= @PalletTotalWidth) tblStackpos        
              --  join with the current pallet if it is stackable   
    -- inner JOIN (   
    --select   tSti.IsStackable ,tPal.PalletPK        
    --from tblPallets tPal        
    --INNER JOIN tblStockInLinePallets tSPal ON tPal.PalletPK = tsPal.PalletFK        
    --INNER JOIN tblStockInLines tSlin ON tSPal.StockInLineFK = tSlin.StockInLinePK        
    --INNER JOIN tblStockItems tSti ON tSti.StockItemPK = tSlin.StockItemFK        
    --WHERE  tPal.palletPk = @var_palletfk        
    -- AND tPal.IsMixedPallet = 0        
    -- AND tpal.isarchived = 0        
    -- AND tPal.loaded = 0        
    -- --and locationTypeFK = 1        
    -- and tpal.palletstatusFK <> 10        
    --           ) tblStackable        
    --           ON    tblStackable.PalletPK = tblStackpos.PalletFK        
    --           WHERE tblStackable.IsStackable = 1        
             END        
           END        
           ELSE        
           SELECT 3   AS returnstatus,        
              'Cell Full' as returnMessage,        
                @var_Isstackable AS IsStackable,   
      
     0 AS PalletStart ,         
          -1 as PalletWidth,        
          01 AS BayPosition,        
          -1 as LocationFK,        
                         cast(0 as bit) as LeftToRight,         
          -1 as BayWidth ,        
          ''  as locationText ,        
          PalletFK = @var_palletfk,        
          0 as StackPosition  
  
         RETURN        
         END        
         ELSE IF (@FreeSpace >= @PalletTotalWidth)  -- There is space          
         BEGIN        
         PRint ' -- There is space  '        
        -- check if there is a gap at the start         
          SELECT @GapAtStart = case when (palletstart- @PalletTotalWidth >= 0) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END   FROM        
         (SELECT top 1* from (select palletEnd ,palletStart , locationFK, bayposition from tblPallets tPal         
           WHERE locationFK = @locationFK AND tpal.isarchived = 0 AND  tPal.loaded = 0  and locationTypeFK = 1 and palletstatusFK <> 10        
           Union        
           SELECT  DestinationPalletEnd , DestinationPalletStart, destinationFK , Destinationbayposition        
                from tblworksOrderMovements Woms         
                INNER JOIN tblpallets tpal ON tpal.palletpk = woms.palletfk        
                where (destinationFK = @locationFK and Woms.PalletFK <> tpal.PalletPK) AND         
                tpal.isarchived = 0 and         
                woms.WorksOrderStatusFK < 3 /*Not complete or cancelled*/         
           Union         
           SELECT ObstructionEnd , ObstructionStart , buildingUnitBayFK, 0 as palletFK from tblBuildingUnitBayObstructions where         
                   buildingUnitBayFK = @locationFK and IsArchived=0        
           ) as tblfirstposition order by palletStart ) tblGapAtStart        
         if @GapATStart = 1        
         BEGIN        
         PRint ' -- Gap at Start  '        
          -- check if the current pallet is stackable        
          if (@var_Isstackable = 1)        
          BEGIN        
          PRint ' -- stackable '        
           -- the pallet will fit in the first position        
           SELECT 2 AS returnstatus,   
      '' as returnMessage,  
      @var_Isstackable AS IsStackable,   
            0 AS PalletStart ,         
            @PalletTotalWidth as PalletWidth,        
            01 AS BayPosition,        
            @LocationFK as LocationFK,        
                           @LeftToRight as LeftToRight,         
            @BayWidth as BayWidth ,        
            @LocationText  as locationText ,        
            PalletFK = @var_palletfk,        
            0 as StackPosition        
            -- Join the available spaces with stack positions        
           UNION        
             select returnstatus,  
    '' as returnMessage,  
       @var_Isstackable AS IsStackable,   
              palletstart,        
              palletwidth,        
              bayposition,        
              locationfk,        
              lefttoright,        
              Baywidth,        
              LocationText,        
              PalletFK,        
              StackPosition FROM        
               (SELECT * from         
              (SELECT 2 as returnstatus,   
     '' as returnMessage,  
  
                  tblpallist.PalletStart,        
                  tblpallist.bottomwith as PalletWidth,        
                  bayposition + 1 as bayposition,        
                  @LocationFK as LocationFK,        
                  @LeftToRight as LeftToRight,         
                  @BayWidth as BayWidth ,        
                  @LocationText  as locationText ,        
                  PalletFK = @var_palletfk,        
                  1 as StackPosition        
                          
                          
                FROM ( select * FROM         
                 -- check if they are the same stock and batch         
                 (select tpal.PalletPK,        
                     tpal.BayPosition ,         
                     tpal.palletstart ,        
                     (palletend - palletstart) as bottomwith         
                   FROM tblPallets  tpal        
                   INNER JOIN tblPalletContent tPalcon        
                   ON tPalcon.PalletFK = tpal.PalletPK        
                   Where LocationFK = @LocationFK        
                  AND StackPosition = 0        
                  --AND tPalcon.StockItemFK = @StockItemFK        
                  AND tpal.isarchived = 0        
                  AND tPal.loaded = 0        
                  and locationTypeFK = 1        
                  and palletstatusFK <> 10        
                  --AND tPalcon.Batch = @batch        
                    ) tblbase        
                   left outer join        
                   (select tpal.PalletPK as stackpal,         
                        tpal.BayPosition as stackpos,         
                     tpal.PalletStart as stackstart        
                   FROM tblPallets  tpal        
                    INNER JOIN tblPalletContent tPalcon        
                   ON tPalcon.PalletFK = tpal.PalletPK        
                   Where LocationFK = @LocationFK        
                     AND StackPosition = 1        
                     --AND tPalcon.StockItemFK = @StockItemFK        
                     AND tpal.isarchived = 0        
                     AND tPal.loaded = 0        
                     and locationTypeFK = 1        
                     and palletstatusFK <> 10        
                     --AND tPalcon.Batch = @batch        
                    ) tblStack ON tblbase.PalletStart = tblStack.stackstart        
                 ) tblpallist        
                 where stackpal IS NULL        
                AND tblpallist.bottomwith = @PalletTotalWidth) tblStackpos        
               --  inner JOIN         
               --  --  join with the current pallet if it is stackable        
               --  ( select   tSti.IsStackable ,tPal.PalletPK        
               --   from tblPallets tPal        
               --   INNER JOIN tblStockInLinePallets tSPal ON tPal.PalletPK = tsPal.PalletFK        
               --   INNER JOIN tblStockInLines tSlin ON tSPal.StockInLineFK = tSlin.StockInLinePK        
               --   INNER JOIN tblStockItems tSti ON tSti.StockItemPK = tSlin.StockItemFK        
               --   WHERE  tPal.palletPk = @var_palletfk        
               --  AND tPal.IsMixedPallet = 0        
               --  AND tpal.isarchived = 0        
               --  AND tPal.loaded = 0        
               --  --and locationTypeFK = 1        
               --  and tpal.palletstatusFK <> 10        
               --   ) tblStackable        
               --   ON    tblStackable.PalletPK = tblStackpos.PalletFK        
               --   WHERE tblStackable.IsStackable = 1        
               ) tblSpaceAvail         
            RETURN        
            END -- IsStackable = 1        
            ELSE        
           BEGIN        
            PRint ' -- Only show the base  '        
            -- Only show space on the base         
           -- the pallet will fit in the first position        
        
            SELECT 2 AS returnstatus,   
   '' as returnMessage,  
      @var_Isstackable AS IsStackable,   
             0 AS PalletStart ,         
             @PalletTotalWidth as PalletWidth,        
             01 AS BayPosition,        
             @LocationFK as LocationFK,        
                            @LeftToRight as LeftToRight,         
             @BayWidth as BayWidth ,        
             @LocationText  as locationText ,        
             PalletFK = @var_palletfk,        
             0 as StackPosition        
            RETURN        
           END        
           END -- if gap at the start        
        -- End of the Check if there is a gap at the start        
          ELSE        
         BEGIN        
         PRint ' -- pallet will fit in another location '        
         -- check if the pallet will fit in another location        
             SELECT  @SpaceAvailable = SpaceAvailable,        
            @PalletStart = PalletEnd,        
            @BayPosition = BayPosition + 1        
             FROM         
            (select palletStart, palletEnd  , locationFK, tblPalletList.bayposition,         
             -- check if there is a gap        
              case when NextPalletStart is not null then        
                CASE WHEN (NextPalletStart - palletEnd) >= @PalletTotalWidth then  1 END        
                 else        
                 -- check if there is space from hte last pallet to the end of the cell        
              CASE WHEN (@BayWidth - palletEnd) >= @PalletTotalWidth then 1 else 0 END        
                 end as SpaceAvailable         
            from (select palletStart, palletEnd  , locationFK, bayposition from tblPallets tPal         
                     where locationFK = @locationFK AND tpal.isarchived = 0  AND tPal.loaded = 0 and locationTypeFK = 1 and palletstatusFK <> 10        
                     Union        
                     SELECT  DestinationPalletEnd , DestinationPalletStart, destinationFK , destinationBayPosition        
                          from tblworksOrderMovements Woms         
                          INNER JOIN tblpallets tpal ON tpal.palletpk = woms.palletfk        
                          where (destinationFK = @locationFK and Woms.PalletFK <> tpal.PalletPK) AND         
                          tpal.isarchived = 0 and         
                          woms.WorksOrderStatusFK < 3  /*Not complete or cancelled*/         
                     Union         
                     SELECT ObstructionStart ,ObstructionEnd ,  buildingUnitBayFK, 0 as palletFK from tblBuildingUnitBayObstructions where         
                             buildingUnitBayFK = @locationFK and IsArchived=0        
            ) as tblPalletList        
            left outer join        
             (select palletstart as NextPalletStart, bayposition  from (select palletStart, palletEnd  , locationFK, bayposition from tblPallets tPal         
                     WHERE locationFK = @locationFK AND tpal.isarchived = 0 AND tPal.loaded = 0 and locationTypeFK = 1 and palletstatusFK <> 10         
                     UNION        
                      SELECT  DestinationPalletEnd , DestinationPalletStart, destinationFK ,destinationBayPosition        
                           from tblworksOrderMovements Woms         
                           INNER JOIN tblpallets tpal ON tpal.palletpk = woms.palletfk        
                           where (destinationFK = @locationFK and Woms.PalletFK <> tpal.PalletPK) AND         
                           tpal.isarchived = 0 and         
                           woms.WorksOrderStatusFK < 3  /*Not complete or cancelled*/         
                     Union         
                     SELECT ObstructionStart ,ObstructionEnd ,  buildingUnitBayFK, 0 as palletFK from tblBuildingUnitBayObstructions where         
                             buildingUnitBayFK = @locationFK and IsArchived=0        
            )  tblpallist) tblNextStart ON tblNextStart.bayposition = (tblPalletList.bayposition + 1)        
            ) tblSpaceAvailable  where SpaceAvailable = 1 order by palletEnd desc        
              
           -- Check if there is space and return status of 2 if there is otherwise return status 3        
           IF @SpaceAvailable is null         
           BEGIN                                   
           PRint ' -- Space Availabe '            
            if (@var_Isstackable = 1)        
            BEGIN        
        
               -- check if there are stacked spaces available        
             -- Join the available spaces with stack positions        
              IF EXISTS (SELECT 2 as returnstatus,  
     '' as returnMessage,  
        @var_Isstackable AS IsStackable,   
                tblpallist.PalletStart,        
                tblpallist.bottomwith as PalletWidth,        
                bayposition + 1 as bayposition,        
                @LocationFK as LocationFK,        
                @LeftToRight as LeftToRight,         
                @BayWidth as BayWidth ,        
                @LocationText  as locationText ,        
                PalletFK = @var_palletfk,        
                1 as StackPosition        
                FROM (        
                 select * FROM (        
                 -- check if they are the same stock and batch         
                 select tpal.PalletPK, tpal.BayPosition , tpal.palletstart         
                 , (palletend - palletstart) as bottomwith FROM tblPallets  tpal        
                 INNER JOIN tblPalletContent tPalcon        
                 ON tPalcon.PalletFK = tpal.PalletPK        
                 Where LocationFK = @LocationFK        
                 AND StackPosition = 0        
                 --AND tPalcon.StockItemFK = @StockItemFK        
                 AND tpal.isarchived = 0        
                 AND tPal.loaded = 0        
                 and locationTypeFK = 1         
                 and palletstatusFK <> 10         
                 --AND tPalcon.Batch = @batch        
                   ) tblbase        
                 left outer join        
                 (select tpal.PalletPK as stackpal,         
                   tpal.BayPosition as stackpos,         
                   tpal.PalletStart as stackstart        
                    FROM tblPallets  tpal        
                 INNER JOIN tblPalletContent tPalcon        
                 ON tPalcon.PalletFK = tpal.PalletPK        
                 Where LocationFK = @LocationFK        
                 AND StackPosition = 1        
                 AND tpal.isarchived = 0        
                 --AND tPalcon.StockItemFK = @StockItemFK        
                 AND tPal.loaded = 0          
                 and locationTypeFK = 1         
                 and palletstatusFK <> 10                     
                 --AND tPalcon.Batch = @batch        
                 ) tblStack ON tblbase.PalletStart = tblStack.stackstart        
                 ) tblpallist        
                 where stackpal IS NULL        
                 AND tblpallist.bottomwith >= @PalletTotalWidth)        
             BEGIN        
              SELECT 2 as returnstatus,  
     '' as returnMessage,  
        @var_Isstackable AS IsStackable,   
                tblpallist.PalletStart,        
                tblpallist.bottomwith as PalletWidth,        
                bayposition + 1 as bayposition,        
                @LocationFK as LocationFK,        
                @LeftToRight as LeftToRight,         
                @BayWidth as BayWidth ,        
                @LocationText  as locationText ,        
                PalletFK = @var_palletfk,        
                1 as StackPosition        
                FROM (        
                 select * FROM (        
                 -- check if they are the same stock and batch         
                 select tpal.PalletPK, tpal.BayPosition , tpal.palletstart         
                 , (palletend - palletstart) as bottomwith FROM tblPallets  tpal        
                 INNER JOIN tblPalletContent tPalcon        
                 ON tPalcon.PalletFK = tpal.PalletPK        
                 Where LocationFK = @LocationFK        
                 AND StackPosition = 0        
                 --AND tPalcon.StockItemFK = @StockItemFK        
                 AND tpal.isarchived = 0        
                 AND tPal.loaded = 0        
                 and locationTypeFK = 1         
                 and palletstatusFK <> 10         
                 --AND tPalcon.Batch = @batch        
                   ) tblbase        
                 left outer join        
                 (select tpal.PalletPK as stackpal,         
                   tpal.BayPosition as stackpos,         
                   tpal.PalletStart as stackstart        
                    FROM tblPallets  tpal        
                 INNER JOIN tblPalletContent tPalcon        
                 ON tPalcon.PalletFK = tpal.PalletPK        
                 Where LocationFK = @LocationFK        
                 AND StackPosition = 1        
                 AND tpal.isarchived = 0        
                 --AND tPalcon.StockItemFK = @StockItemFK        
                 AND tPal.loaded = 0          
                 and locationTypeFK = 1         
                 and palletstatusFK <> 10                     
                 --AND tPalcon.Batch = @batch        
                 ) tblStack ON tblbase.PalletStart = tblStack.stackstart        
                 ) tblpallist        
                 where stackpal IS NULL        
                 AND tblpallist.bottomwith >= @PalletTotalWidth        
             END        
                
              ELSE        
             SELECT 3 AS returnstatus,        
               'Cell Full ' as returnMessage,        
               0 AS IsStackable ,  
       0 AS PalletStart ,         
          -1 as PalletWidth,        
          01 AS BayPosition,        
          -1 as LocationFK,        
                         cast(0 as bit) as LeftToRight,         
          -1 as BayWidth ,        
          ''  as locationText ,        
          PalletFK = @var_palletfk,        
          0 as StackPosition      
             RETURN        
             END        
             ELSE        
             BEGIN        
        SELECT 3 AS returnstatus,   
  'Cell Full - Shift pallets across ' as returnMessage,  
  0 AS IsStackable,  
   0 AS PalletStart ,         
          -1 as PalletWidth,        
          01 AS BayPosition,        
          -1 as LocationFK,        
                         cast(0 as bit) as LeftToRight,         
          -1 as BayWidth ,        
          ''  as locationText ,        
          PalletFK = @var_palletfk,        
          0 as StackPosition      
              RETURN        
             END        
           END        
            ELSE        
          BEGIN        
          PRint ' -- Going in here now '        
            IF (@var_Isstackable = 1)        
            BEGIN        
            PRint ' -- Stack it high '        
             SELECT 2 AS returnstatus,   
    '' as returnMessage,  
       @var_Isstackable AS IsStackable,   
              @PalletStart AS PalletStart ,         
              @PalletTotalWidth as PalletWidth,        
              @BayPosition AS BayPosition,        
              @LocationFK as LocationFK,        
                             @LeftToRight as LeftToRight,         
              @BayWidth as BayWidth ,        
              @LocationText  as locationText ,        
              PalletFK = @var_palletfk,        
              0 as StackPosition        
               -- Join the available spaces with stack positions        
             UNION        
             SELECT 2 as returnstatus,   
     '' as returnMessage,  
        @var_Isstackable AS IsStackable,   
               tblpallist.PalletStart,        
               tblpallist.bottomwith as PalletWidth,        
               bayposition + 1 as bayposition,        
               @LocationFK as LocationFK,        
               @LeftToRight as LeftToRight,         
               @BayWidth as BayWidth ,        
   @LocationText  as locationText ,        
               PalletFK = @var_palletfk,        
               1 as StackPosition        
               FROM (        
                select * FROM (        
                -- check if they are the same stock and batch         
                select tpal.PalletPK, tpal.BayPosition , tpal.palletstart         
                , (palletend - palletstart) as bottomwith FROM tblPallets  tpal        
                INNER JOIN tblPalletContent tPalcon        
                ON tPalcon.PalletFK = tpal.PalletPK        
                Where LocationFK = @LocationFK        
                AND StackPosition = 0        
                --AND tPalcon.StockItemFK = @StockItemFK        
                AND tpal.isarchived = 0        
                AND tPal.loaded = 0        
                and locationTypeFK = 1         
                and palletstatusFK <> 10         
                --AND tPalcon.Batch = @batch        
                ) tblbase        
                left outer join        
                (select tpal.PalletPK as stackpal,         
                  tpal.BayPosition as stackpos,         
                  tpal.PalletStart as stackstart        
                   FROM tblPallets  tpal        
                INNER JOIN tblPalletContent tPalcon        
                ON tPalcon.PalletFK = tpal.PalletPK        
               Where LocationFK = @LocationFK        
                AND StackPosition = 1        
                --AND tPalcon.StockItemFK = @StockItemFK        
                AND tpal.isarchived = 0        
                AND tPal.loaded = 0        
                and locationTypeFK = 1         
                and palletstatusFK <> 10         
                --AND tPalcon.Batch = @batch        
                   ) tblStack ON        
                tblbase.PalletStart = tblStack.stackstart        
                ) tblpallist        
                where stackpal IS NULL        
                AND tblpallist.bottomwith = @PalletTotalWidth        
              RETURN        
            END        
            ELSE        
            SELECT 2 AS returnstatus,    
    '' as returnMessage,  
       @var_Isstackable AS IsStackable,   
              @PalletStart AS PalletStart ,         
              @PalletTotalWidth as PalletWidth,        
              @BayPosition AS BayPosition,        
              @LocationFK as LocationFK,        
                             @LeftToRight as LeftToRight,         
              @BayWidth as BayWidth ,        
              @LocationText  as locationText ,        
              PalletFK = @var_palletfk,        
              0 as StackPosition        
             RETURN        
           END  -- if space available        
          END  -- gap at the start        
         -- check if the pallet will fit in another location        
       END  -- there is a space        
      END -- of conventional        
      ELSE        
      BEGIN        
       -- check for drivethrough        
       -- check if the column is empty         
       -- generates a list of the current pallets and then assigns pallets to the location        
           If (NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM (        
         SELECT  palletpk, palletend , locationfk , bayposition         
           from tblpallets          
           WHERE  locationFK IN (SELECT BuildingUnitBayPK         
                 FROM tblBuildingUnitBays         
                 WHERE BuildingUnitColumnFK = @ColumnFK AND IsArchived = 0) /* Damien #DEV-910 Exclude Archived Bays */        
           AND isArchived = 0        
           and locationTypeFK = 1         
           and palletstatusFK <> 10         
         UNION        
         SELECT  PalletFK as palletPK, destinationpalletend, destinationFK, destinationBayPosition         
           from tblWorksOrderMovements woms        
           INNER JOIN tblpallets tpal ON tpal.palletpk = woms.palletfk        
           WHERE destinationFK IN (SELECT BuildingUnitBayPK         
                 FROM tblBuildingUnitBays         
                 WHERE BuildingUnitColumnFK = @ColumnFK AND IsArchived = 0) /* Damien #DEV-910 Exclude Archived Bays */        
             and tpal.isarchived = 0        
 ) as tblPalletsInColumn ))        
         BEGIN        
          -- No Pallets assigned to this Column so select the top level and the first position        
           SELECT 7 AS returnstatus,  
      '' as returnMessage,  
      @var_Isstackable AS IsStackable,   
              0 AS PalletStart ,         
              @PalletTotalWidth as PalletWidth,        
              01 AS BayPosition,        
              (select TOP 1 buildingUnitBayPK         
                FROM tblBuildingUnitBays         
                WHERE BuildingUnitColumnFK = @ColumnFK AND IsArchived = 0 /* Damien #DEV-910 Exclude Archived Bays */        
                ORDER BY BayLevel desc) as LocationFK,        
                             @LeftToRight as LeftToRight,         
              @BayWidth as BayWidth ,        
              @LocationText as locationText ,        
              PalletFK = @var_palletfk,       
              0 as StackPosition           
             -- (select TOP 1 barcode        
             --   FROM tblBuildingUnitBays

  BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */        
   DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;        
   SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;        
   SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;        
        
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY         
   BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;        
               
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;        
        
            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID        
                    
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;        
                    
   IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)        
   BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END        
   ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */        
  END CATCH        
  SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1        
 END        
END

			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spMobileMovementsDetermineFlashingPallet]
(
	@PalletFK int
)	
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT
 ,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;
	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	DECLARE @var_PalletFK int
	SET @var_PalletFK = @PalletFK
	SET @ParameterDetails = '@PalletFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_PalletFK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'')

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    --BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

		SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END


	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY
			
			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start

			declare @Width int;

			Set @Width = 0

			select 
				@Width = pa_ty.Width 
			from 
				tblPallets pa
				inner join 		
					tblPalletTypes pa_ty 
						on
							pa.PalletTypeFK	 = pa_ty.PalletTypePK
				where pa.PalletPK = @var_PalletFK

			if (@Width <800) begin
				select 1 
				return
			end
			else 
			begin
				select 0
				return
			end

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end
						
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;

			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spMobilePalletBarcodeCheck]
(
	@PalletBarcode nvarchar (200) 	
)	
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT
 ,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;
	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	DECLARE @var_PalletBarcode nvarchar(200)
	SET @var_PalletBarcode = @PalletBarcode
	SET @ParameterDetails = '@PalletBarcode = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_PalletBarcode AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'')

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    --BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

		SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END


	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY
			
			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start

			IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#tmpPallet') IS NOT NULL
				DROP TABLE #tmpPallet
			SELECT * INTO #tmpPallet FROM tblpallets WHERE isarchived = 0 AND (barcode = @var_PalletBarcode OR CustomerBarcode = @var_PalletBarcode)

			-- check if the barcode exists in the system
			if exists (select palletpk from #tmpPallet)
			BEGIN
				SELECT 1 as returnStatus,
					   tPalT.Width,
					   tSti.IsStackable
					from #tmpPallet tPal
					INNER JOIN tblPalletTypes tPty ON tPty.PalletTypePK = tPal.PalletTypeFK
					INNER JOIN tblPalletContent tPalCon ON tPal.PalletPK = tPalCon.PalletFK
					INNER JOIN tblStockItems tSti ON tSti.StockItemPK = tPalCon.StockItemFK
					INNER JOIN tblPalletTypes tPalT ON tPalT.PalletTypePK = tPal.PalletTypeFK
					WHERE  tPal.barcode = @var_PalletBarcode OR tPal.CustomerBarcode = @var_PalletBarcode
					  AND tPal.IsMixedPallet = 0
				   SELECT 1 as returnStatus
				   RETURN
				END 
				ELSE
				BEGIN 
				   SELECT 0 AS returnStatus 
				   return
				END

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end
						
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END
GO

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spMobilePalletDetails]
(
	@Barcode nvarchar(50)
)	
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT
 ,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;
	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	DECLARE @var_Barcode nvarchar(50)
	SET @var_Barcode = @Barcode
	SET @ParameterDetails = '@Barcode = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_Barcode AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'')

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    --BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

		SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END


	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY
			

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start

			DECLARE @thisbarcode nvarchar  (200)
 
			-- Check if a setdown area has been scanned
			DECLARE @barcodetype nvarchar(50)

			IF  CHARINDEX('-', @var_Barcode) > 0 
			   SET @barcodetype =  substring(@var_Barcode,1,charindex('-',@var_Barcode)-1)
			else
			   SET @barcodetype = 'STA'

			-- loading bay
			if (@barcodeType = 'STAL')
			BEGIN
				SELECT LoadingBay as Customer,
					   0 as LocationFK,
					   0 as LocationTypeFK,
					   0 as PalletPK,
					   BuildingUnit as Batch,
					   0 as customerPalletNumber,
					   '' as StockCode,
					   0 as Units,
					   0 as pallettype,
					   '' as Location,
					   @var_Barcode as Barcode,
					   BuildingName as Building
				   FROM tblLoadingBays 
						INNER JOIN tblBuildingUnits ON BuildingUnitPK = BuildingUnitFK
						INNER JOIN tblBuildings ON BuildingPK = BuildingFK
				WHERE Barcode = @var_Barcode
			END
			ELSE
			if (@barcodeType = 'STAS')
			BEGIN
				   SELECT SetDownArea as Customer,
					   0 as LocationFK,
					   0 as LocationTypeFK,
					   0 as PalletPK,
					   BuildingUnit as Batch,
					   0 as customerPalletNumber,
					   '' as StockCode,
					   0 as Units,
					   0 as pallettype,
					   '' as Location,
					   @var_Barcode as Barcode,
					   BuildingName as Building
				   FROM tblSetDownAreas
						INNER JOIN tblBuildingUnits ON BuildingUnitPK = BuildingUnitFK
						INNER JOIN tblBuildings ON BuildingPK = BuildingFK
				WHERE Barcode = @var_Barcode
			END
			ELSE
			BEGIN
			   -- first get the pallet location
				--DECLARE @LocationTypeFK int
				--SELECT @LocationTypeFK = locationTypeFK from tblPallets where Barcode= @var_Barcode OR CustomerBarcode=@var_Barcode 
				
				--print @LocationTypeFK

			   select
					DivisionName as Customer,
					tpal.LocationFK,
					tpal.LocationTypeFK,
					tpal.PalletPK,
					tpc.Batch,
					tpal.CustomerPalletNumber,
					StockItemCode as StockCode,
					tpc.ActualUnits as Units,
					pt.PalletType,
					vpLoc.Building + ' ' +
					vpLoc.Location as Location,
					vpLoc.rackingTypeFK,	
					case when tpal.customerbarcode!='' then tpal.customerbarcode ELSE tpal.Barcode end as Barcode,
					tpal.CustomerPalletNumber
				from tblPallets tpal 
				inner join tblPalletContent tpc on tpal.PalletPK =tpc.PalletFK
				inner join tblStockItems si on si.StockItemPK =tpc.StockItemFK		
				inner join tblDivisions div on div.divisionPk=si.DivisionFk
				inner JOIN tblPalletTypes pt ON pt.PalletTypePK=tpal.PalletTypeFK
				INNER join viewPalletLocations vpLoc ON vpLoc.palletPK = tpal.palletpk
				where (tpal.Barcode= @var_Barcode OR tpal.CustomerBarcode=@var_Barcode) 
					AND tpal.IsArchived = 0 
					AND tpal.PalletStatusFK <> 10
			END

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end

			
			
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END
GO

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spMobilePalletTypes]  
AS  
BEGIN  
 /* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */  
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED  
  
    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT  
 ,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;  
 SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();  
  
 -- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters  
 --DECLARE   
  
 SET @ParameterDetails = ''  
  
    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL   
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)  
  
    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)  
    --BEGIN  
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC   
  
  SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)  
  
        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)  
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK  
  
        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()  
    --END  
  
  
 SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);  
 SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails  
 ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;  
 INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()  
  
 WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3  
 BEGIN   
  BEGIN TRY  
     
  
   -- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start  
   SELECT palletTypePK, PalletType FROM (  
   SELECT palletTypePK, PalletType, CASE WHEN pallettypepk IN (15, 11) THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS Ordering    , IsTruePalletType, [Grouping], width
   fROM tblPalletTypes  
   )sub  
   order BY  Ordering, IsTruePalletType desc, [Grouping] desc, width desc, PalletType desc  
  
   -- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end  
  
     
     
   BREAK  
  END TRY  
  BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */  
   DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;  
   SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;  
   SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;  
  
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY   
   BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;  
         
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;  
  
            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID  
              
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;  
              
   IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)  
   BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END  
   ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */  
  END CATCH  
  SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1  
 END  
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spMobilePalletTypeUpdate]
(
	@Barcode nvarchar(200) = '',
    @PalletTypeFK int,
    @UserFK int,
	@PalletPk int = -1
)	
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED

	DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT
 ,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;
	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	DECLARE @Barcode2 nvarchar(200)
	DECLARE @PalletTypeFK2 int
    DECLARE @UserFK2 int
    DECLARE @PalletPK2 int
	SET @Barcode2 = @Barcode
	SET @PalletTypeFK2 = @PalletTypeFK
	SET @UserFK2 = @UserFK
	SET @PalletPK2 = @PalletPk

	SET @ParameterDetails = '@Barcode = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@Barcode2 AS NVARCHAR(20)),'') + ', @PalletTypeFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@PalletTypeFK2 AS NVARCHAR(20)),'')
		 + ', @UserFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@UserFK2 AS NVARCHAR(20)),'') + ', @PalletPk = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@PalletPK2 AS NVARCHAR(20)),'')

	IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    --BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

		SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END
	
	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY			

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start	
	
			create table #tmpReturn(ReturnStatus int)

			DECLARE @PalletFK int
			DECLARE @LocationTypeFK int
			DECLARE @PalletStart int
			DECLARE @PalletEnd int
			DECLARE @CurrentPalletTypeFK int

			SELECT @PalletFK = palletPK,
			   @LocationTypeFK = locationTypeFK,
			   @PalletEnd = PalletEnd,
			   @PalletStart = palletStart,
			   @CurrentPalletTypeFK = PalletTypeFK
			from tblPallets 
			WHERE (@PalletPK2 > 0 and (PalletPK = @PalletPK2 and IsArchived = 0))--use palletpk
				or ((barcode =@Barcode2 or Customerbarcode = @Barcode2) AND isarchived = 0) -- or use barcode

			if (@PalletFK is null)
			BEGIN 
				-- Pallet not setup or is archived
				SELECT 3 as ReturnStatus
				RETURN
			END

			-- check if the pallet type is still the same 
			if (@palletTypeFK2 = @CurrentPalletTypeFK)
			BEGIN
			  Select 0 as ReturnStatus
			  Return
			END

			-- check that the palletTypeFK exists
			if not exists (select * from tblPalletTypes WHERE palletTypePk = @PalletTypeFK2 and isarchived = 0)
			BEGIN
			  Select 2 as ReturnStatus
			  Return
			END
			ELSE
			BEGIN
				IF XACT_STATE() = 0 AND @@TRANCOUNT < 1 BEGIN TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName

					INSERT INTO tblStockAdjustments
						select -1 as WorksOrderFK,
							PalConDetail.palletContentPK,
							palletPK,
							0 as Queue,
							palletTypeFK as PalletTypeBeforeFK,
							@PalletTypeFK2 as PalletTypeAfterFK,
							-1,--ActualUnits,
							-1,--ActualUnits as UnitsAfter,
							-1,--ActualEaches ,
							-1,--ActualEaches as EachesAfter,
							tpal.barcode,
							tpal.barcode as BarcodeAfter,
							tpal.customerbarcode,
							tpal.customerbarcode as CustomerBarcodeAfter,
							tpal.CustomerPalletNumber,
							tpal.CustomerPalletNumber as CustomerPalletNumberAfter,
							batch as BatchBefore,
							batch as BatchAfter,
							StockItemFK,
							StockItemFK as StockItemAfterFK,
							-1 as SpecialStockTypeBeforeFK,
							-1 as SpecialStockTypeAfterFK,
							'' as Reference,
							'Pallet Type Change from Hand Held Scanner' as Comment,
							bestbefore,
							bestbefore as BestBeforeDateAfter,
							0 as IsArchived,
							@UserFK2 as InsertedBy,
							dbo.GetBSTDate() as InsertedDate,
							@UserFK2 as UpdatedBy,
							dbo.GetBSTDate() as UpdatedBy
						from tblPallets tpal 		
						INNER JOIN (
							select top 1 palletfk, palletContentPK, Batch, StockItemFK , BestBefore from tblpalletcontent where palletfk = @palletFK
						) PalConDetail ON palletfk = palletPK				
						--LEFT OUTER JOIN (
						--	SELECT CASE WHEN actualUnits > 0 THEN sum(actualUnits) ELSE -1 END as ActualUnits, 
						--		CASE WHEN ActualEaches > 0 THEN sum(actualEaches) ELSE -1 END as ActualEaches, palletfk
						--	from tblpalletcontent where palletfk = @palletfk
						--	group by  actualUnits, actualEaches, palletfk 
						--) TotalAmounts ON TotalAmounts.palletFK = palletPK	
						WHERE tpal.palletpk = @palletFK

						--Check if the pallet is in racking - if so change the width
						IF (@locationTypeFK = 1)
						BEGIN
								--DECLARE @widthMargin int
								--SELECT @widthMargin = generalWidthMargin from appSystem
								declare @stockcustomwidthmargin int
								select @stockcustomwidthmargin = s.widthmargin from tblstockitems s inner join tblpalletcontent on stockitemfk = stockitempk where palletfk = @palletFK
								--
								SELECT @PalletEnd = @PalletStart + (width + (case when @stockcustomwidthmargin > 0 then (@stockcustomwidthmargin * 2) else (WidthMargin * 2) end)) 
								from tblPalletTypes 
								where PalletTypePK = @PalletTypeFK
						END
										  
					   Update tblPallets WITH (ROWLOCK)
						SET palletTypeFK = @PalletTypeFK,
							PalletEnd = @PalletEnd,
							UpdatedBy = @UserFK,
							UpdatedDate = dbo.GetBSTDate()
						WHERE palletPK = @PalletFK
						--Jamie .. what about all other pallets in this rack? this may have just over lapped pallets
				
				BEGIN TRY IF XACT_STATE() = 1 AND @@TRANCOUNT = 1 AND @OpeningTranCount < 1 COMMIT TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH
				
				select 1 as ReturnStatus
				return
			END
		
			select 0 as ReturnStatus
			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end			
			
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END
GO
