-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,Rachael Sherry>
-- Create date: <Create Date,14/08/2015>
-- Description:	<Checks if the Pallet to move the Stock Onto is New or on the current Pick>
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spMobileSplitPalletDestinationPalletApproved]
(
	@ScannedBarcode nvarchar(200),  -- The new pallet the stock is being moved to
	@ContainerOutFK int
)	
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT
 ,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;
	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	DECLARE @var_ScannedBarcode nvarchar(200), @var_ContainerOutFK int
	SET @var_ScannedBarcode = @ScannedBarcode; SET @var_ContainerOutFK = @ContainerOutFK
	SET @ParameterDetails = '@ScannedBarcode = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_ScannedBarcode AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@ContainerOutFK = ' 
		+ ISNULL(CAST(@var_ContainerOutFK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'')

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    --BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

		SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END


	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY
			 -- 0 Success - Can move stock onto this pallet													 
			-- 1 Pallet does not exist
			-- 2 Pallet is on a different pick and not on this one
			-- 3 Pallet is on Stock In
			-- 4 Pallet on this pick but it has to be split
			
			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start
			DECLARE @PalletFK int 
			
			IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#tmpPallet') IS NOT NULL
				DROP TABLE #tmpPallet
			SELECT * INTO #tmpPallet FROM tblpallets WHERE isarchived = 0 and palletstatusFK <> 10 AND (barcode = @var_ScannedBarcode OR CustomerBarcode = @var_ScannedBarcode)

													  
			-- check if the barocde scanned is a pallet
			IF EXISTS (SELECT palletPk from #tmpPallet) -- Not on route
			BEGIN
				SELECT @PalletFK = palletPk from #tmpPallet			
			END
			ELSE BEGIN
				SELECT 1 AS ReturnStatus
				RETURN
			END

			IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#tmpColpc') IS NOT NULL
				DROP TABLE #tmpColpc
			SELECT colpc.* INTO #tmpColpc 
			FROM tblcontaineroutlines cOl
			inner join tblContaineroutLinePalletContent colpc ON colpc.containeroutLineFK = cOl.containerOutlinePK
			WHERE cOl.containeroutFK = @var_ContainerOutFK AND  colpc.palletFK = @PalletFK

			-- check if this pallet is on the current pick 
			IF Exists (select * from #tmpColpc)
			BEGIN
				print 'on this pick'
				print @PalletFK

				-- check if the pallet is to be split
				if EXISTS (SELECT * from #tmpColpc as palCon
						inner JOIN tblworksOrderMovements woms ON woms.containerOutLinePalletContentFK = palCon.ContainerOutLinePalletContentPK
						WHERE palCon.palletFK = @PalletFK 
						AND woms.WorksOrderStatusFK in (1,2)
						AND EntirePallet = 0 )
				BEGIN
					print 'pallet is to be split'
					-- Pallet is set to be split
					SELECT 4 as ReturnStatus
					RETURN
				END
				ELSE
				BEGIN
					SELECT 0 as ReturnStatus
					RETURN
				END
			END

			-- check if the pallet is on another pick 
			IF Exists (select * from tblcontaineroutlines cOl
						inner join tblContaineroutLinePalletContent palCon ON palCon.containeroutLineFK = cOl.containerOutlinePK
						WHERE cOl.containeroutFK <> @var_ContainerOutFK
						AND  palCon.palletFK = @PalletFK )
			BEGIN
				SELECT 2 as ReturnStatus
				RETURN
			END						

			--check if the pallet has ever been on a Stock In
			if EXISTS (Select * from tblstockInLinePallets WHERE palletFK = @palletFK)
			BEGIN 
				select 3 as ReturnStatus
				RETURN
			END 

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end
			
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END

-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,Rachael Sherry>
-- Create date: <Create Date,14/08/2015>
-- Description:	<Moves Stock from one pallet to another and records if the original pallet needs to go back into racking>
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spMobileSplitPalletMoveStock]
(
	@worksOrderMovementFK int,
	@destinationBarcode nvarchar(200),
	@ActualUnitsToMove decimal(18,3),
	@UserFK int,
	@GoodsOrderNumber int 
)
AS 
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT
 ,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;
	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	DECLARE @var_worksOrderMovementFK int, @var_destinationBarcode nvarchar(200), @var_ActualUnitsToMove decimal(18,3), @var_UserFK int, @var_GoodsOrderNumber int
	SET @var_worksOrderMovementFK = @worksOrderMovementFK; SET @var_destinationBarcode = @destinationBarcode; SET @var_ActualUnitsToMove = @ActualUnitsToMove; SET @var_UserFK = @UserFK; SET @var_GoodsOrderNumber = @GoodsOrderNumber
	SET @ParameterDetails = '@worksOrderMovementFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_worksOrderMovementFK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@destinationBarcode = ' 
		+ ISNULL(CAST(@var_destinationBarcode AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@ActualUnitsToMove = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_ActualUnitsToMove AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') 
			+ ',@UserFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_UserFK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@GoodsOrderNumber = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_GoodsOrderNumber AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'')

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    --BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

		SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END


	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY			

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start

			DECLARE @SourcePalletOnAnotherPick int   -- 0 = NO, 1 - Yes, 2 - Has open movements 	
			SET @SourcePalletOnAnotherPick = 0
			DECLARE @SourcePalletFK int
			DECLARE @SourcePalletContentFK int
			DECLARE @SourcePalletLocationTypeFK int
			DECLARE @SourcePalletLocationFK int
			DECLARE @SourceWorksOrderFK int

			DECLARE @ContainerOutFK int
			DECLARE @StockItemFK int
			DECLARE @StockItemCode nvarchar(200)
			DECLARE @Batch nvarchar(100)
			DECLARE @SourceContaineroutLinePalletContentFK int
			DECLARE @AvailableUnitsToMove decimal(18,3)

			DECLARE @FinalDestinationFK int
			DECLARE @DestinationPalletFK int
			DECLARE @DestinationPalletContentFK int
			DECLARE @DestinationPalletCurrentLocationFK int
			DECLARE @DestinationContainerOutLinePalletContentFK int
			DECLARE @DestinationPalletAllowed bit
			DECLARE @DestinationPalletOnThisPick bit
			DECLARE @DestinationWorksOrderMovementPK int 
			DECLARE @DestinationPalletIsAlreadyMixed bit
			DECLARE @DestinationPalletCurrentUnits decimal (18,3)
			DECLARE @DestinationPalletCurrentEaches decimal (18,3)

			DECLARE @Msg nvarchar(MAX)
			DECLARE @WorksOrderFK int
			DECLARE @FinalDestinationText nvarchar(200)
			DECLARE @PalletContentUpdated bit


			SET @PalletContentUpdated = 0
			SET @DestinationPalletAllowed = 0

			IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#tmpReturn') IS NOT NULL        -- Delete  the temporary table if it already exists
					DROP TABLE #tmpReturn

			create table #tmpReturn( ReturnStatus int  ) -- 1 Success - Can move stock onto this pallet
															-- 2 worksOrder is not Open
															-- 3 Destination Pallet Not Setup
															-- 4 Destination Pallet is not Empty and not on Pick / or full pallet
															-- 5 Source Pallet Content Not Setup
															-- 6 Mixed Pallets Not allowed on Source Stock
															-- 7 Mixed Pallets Not allowed on destination Stock
			-- Get the details from the works Order movement
			IF EXISTS (	SELECT * FROM tblworksordermovements 
								where worksordermovementPK = @var_worksOrderMovementFK
								  AND worksOrderStatusFK in (1,2))
			BEGIN

					SELECT @SourcePalletFK = woms.palletFK,
						   @SourcePalletContentFK = PalletContentFK,
						   @SourcePalletLocationTypeFK = pallet.locationTypeFK,
						   @SourcePalletLocationFK = CASE WHEN woms.sourceLocationTypeFK = 1 THEN woms.SourceLocationFK ELSE 0 END ,
						   @StockItemCode = StockItemCode,
						   @Batch = batch,
						   @WorksOrderFK = worksOrderFK,
						   @AvailableUnitsToMove = Units,
						   @SourceContaineroutLinePalletContentFK = ContaineroutLinePalletContentFK,
						   @DestinationContainerOutLinePalletContentFK = woms.ContainerOutLinePalletContentFK,
						   @StockItemFK = stockItemFK,	
						   @FinalDestinationFK = woms.destinationFK,
						   @FinalDestinationText = loadingBay
						   FROM tblWorksOrderMovements 	woms		   
							INNER JOIN tblPalletContent ON palletContentPk = palletContentFk
							INNER JOIN tblStockItems ON StockItemPK = StockItemFK
							INNER JOIN tblloadingBays ON loadingBayPK = woms.destinationFK
							INNER JOIN tblPallets pallet on palletpk = woms.palletfk
							WHERE worksOrderMovementPK = @var_worksOrderMovementFK
							 AND worksOrderStatusFK in (1,2)

				END
				ELSE
				BEGIN
					PRINT 'Works Order is not open'
					SELECT 2 as ReturnStatus
					RETURN
				END

				-- Check that the destination pallet is on this pick and not to be split
				SELECT @ContainerOutFK = containeroutPK from tblContainerouts where goodsOrderNumber = @var_GoodsOrderNumber 		
			
				-- Build the message for the WorksOrderMovement (moving stock to New Pallet
				select @Msg = 'Move ' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(50),@var_ActualUnitsToMove) + ' Units, Stock ' 
				+ @STockItemCode + ', Batch ' + @Batch + ' FROM Pallet Barcode ' 
				+ CASE WHEN len(customerBarcode) > 0 THEN customerBarcode ELSE barcode END + ' TO Pallet Barode '
				+ @var_destinationBarcode
				FROM tblPallets
				where palletpk = @SourcePalletFK

				-- Get the details of the Destination Pallet
				IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM tblPallets WHERE (barcode = @var_destinationBarcode OR customerBarcode = @var_destinationBarcode)
													 AND isArchived = 0
													 AND palletStatusFK <> 10)
				BEGIN	   
					SELECT @destinationPalletFK = palletPK, 
						   @destinationPalletCurrentLocationFK = locationFK 
					FROM tblPallets 
					WHERE (barcode = @var_destinationBarcode OR customerBarcode = @var_destinationBarcode)
																			 AND isArchived = 0 
																			 AND palletStatusFK <> 10
				END
				ELSE
				BEGIN
					Print 'Destination Pallet Does Not Exist'
					SELECT 3 AS ReturnStatus
					Return
				END

				-- Destination Pallet Check if new or on pick , if on pick if it is mixed
				select  @DestinationPalletAllowed = CASE WHEN NewPallet = 'New' OR OnPick = 'OnPick' THEN  1 ELSE  0 END,
						@DestinationPalletOnThisPick = CASE WHEN OnPick = 'OnPick' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END  ,
						@DestinationPalletIsAlreadyMixed  = IsAlreadyMixed,
						@DestinationWorksOrderMovementPK  = CASE WHEN worksOrderMovementpk is NOT NULL THEN worksOrderMovementPK else 0 END,
						@DestinationPalletCurrentUnits = CASE WHEN Units IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE palletOnPick.Units END, 
						@DestinationPalletCurrentEaches = CASE WHEN Eaches IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE palletOnPick.Eaches END
							from 
				(select palletpk, CASE WHEN stockInLinePalletPK IS NULL THEN 'New' ELSE 'Old' END as NewPallet 
				from tblpallets pallets LEFT OUTER JOIN tblstockInLinePallets ON palletFK = PalletPK 
				where (barcode = @var_destinationBarcode OR customerBarcode = @var_destinationBarcode)

													AND pallets.isArchived = 0 
													AND pallets.palletStatusFK <> 10
													AND pallets.loaded = 0) NewPallet -- checks if pallet is new (never on a stock In)
				LEFT OUTER  JOIN 
				(Select TOP 1 palletpk, CASE WHEN woms.WorksOrderMovementPK IS NULL THEN 'NotOnPick' ELSE 'OnPick' END as OnPick
							, CASE WHEN woms.PalletContentFK = -1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END as IsAlreadyMixed,
							woms.WorksOrderMovementPK, woms.Units, woms.Eaches  from tblpallets pallets		
				LEFT OUTER  JOIN (Select * from tblworksordermovements WHERE ContainerOutLinePalletContentFK IN (SELECT ContainerOutLinePalletContentFK 
				from viewContaineroutPalletList where GoodsOrderNumber = @var_GoodsOrderNumber) )woms 
						on woms.palletFK = palletpk AND entirepallet = 1
					WHERE (pallets.barcode = @var_destinationBarcode OR pallets.customerBarcode = @var_destinationBarcode)
													AND pallets.isArchived = 0 
													AND palletStatusFK <> 10
													AND pallets.loaded = 0) palletOnPick  -- (Pallet is on this pick and is a whole pallet)
				ON NewPallet.palletPK = palletOnPick.palletPK

				IF (@DestinationPalletAllowed = 0)
				BEGIN
				PRINT ' Destination Pallet is not approved '
					SELECT 4 as ReturnStatus
					RETURN
				END				

				--Check Source PalletContent Exist
				IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM tblPalletContent WHERE palletContentPK = @SourcePalletContentFK)
				BEGIN
					IF XACT_STATE() = 0 AND @@TRANCOUNT < 1 BEGIN TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName

				    -- Check if Destination pallet has stock Already and if it is mixed and if MixedStock its Allowed
					IF exists (Select * from tblpalletContent WHERE palletFK = @DestinationPalletFK)
					BEGIN
					    -- Check if that stock and batch is already on the pallet
						IF exists (select * from tblPalletContent WHERE stockItemFK = @StockItemFK AND batch = @Batch AND palletFK = @destinationPalletFK)
						BEGIN
							Print '2.  Update destination TblPalletContent - Units ' 

							-- Update the existing palletcontent
							UPDATE tblPalletContent WITH (ROWLOCK)
							SET @DestinationPalletContentFK = palletContentPK,
								ActualUnits = actualUnits + @AvailableUnitsToMove,
								updatedby = @var_UserFK, updateddate = dbo.GetBSTDate() 
								WHERE palletContentPK = (Select palletcontentPk  from tblPalletContent WHERE stockItemFK = @StockItemFK AND batch = @Batch 
								AND palletFK = @destinationPalletFK)

								set @PalletContentUpdated = 1

							Print '8. Update Destination - ContainerOutlinePalletContent - Units '

							-- Update the containerOutLinePalletContent to include the new Units
							UPDATE tblContaineroutLinePalletContents WITH (ROWLOCK)
								SET Units = @var_ActualUnitsToMove
							WHERE palletFK = @DestinationPalletFK AND
									palletContentFK = @DestinationPalletContentFK
						END -- End of same stock and batch
						ELSE
						BEGIN

							--check if pallet is mixed (has more than one stock item or the stockitem is different
							IF (exists (SELECT Count(*) NoOfStockItems from tblPalletContent
											WHERE palletFK = @DestinationPalletFK
											group by palletfk, stockitemfk
											HAVING Count(*) > 1) OR 
											exists (Select * from tblPalletContent WHERE stockItemFK <> @StockItemFK AND palletFK = @destinationPalletFK))				                 
							BEGIN
								Print 'Destination pallet Mixed '

								-- Get the Stock Item if there is only one on the new pallet
								DECLARE @DestinationStockItemFK int

								SELECT @DestinationStockItemFK =  stockitemfk from tblPalletContent
											WHERE palletFK = @DestinationPalletFK				
											group by palletfk, stockitemfk
											HAVING Count(*) = 1

								-- Pallet Is Mixed , check if stock being moved is mixable
								IF( dbo.fnAllowMixedPallets(@StockITemFK) = 0)
								BEGIN
									BEGIN TRY IF XACT_STATE() = 1 AND @@TRANCOUNT = 1 AND @OpeningTranCount < 1 COMMIT TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH

								    Print ' Unable to mix stock - Source'

									-- Unable to mix Stock Being moved
									SELECT 6 as REturnStatus
									RETURN
								END
								-- check if only one stock on new pallet and that it is mixable
								ELSE IF (len(@DestinationStockItemFK) > 0 AND dbo.fnAllowMixedPallets(@DestinationStockItemFK) = 0)
								BEGIN
									BEGIN TRY IF XACT_STATE() = 1 AND @@TRANCOUNT = 1 AND @OpeningTranCount < 1 COMMIT TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH

									Print 'Unable to mix stock - destination'
									-- The stock Item on the destination Pallet is not mixable
									SELECT 7 AS returnStatus
									RETURN
								END
							END -- end of pallet is mixed
						END -- different stock and batch
					END -- Stock On the destination Pallet

					if (@PalletContentUpdated <> 1)
					BEGIN
						Print ' 1 - Create New pallet content - '
						-- Create New tblContent Record
						-- If eaches type on Stock Item is > -1 THEN the stock Item uses Eaches
						INSERT INTO tblPalletContent (PalletFK, LooseLocationTypeFK,LooseLocationFK, StockItemFK, SpecialStockTypeFK,
															Batch, SupplierBatch,EachUnits,ActualEaches,ActualUnits,AvailableEaches,AvailableUnits,ExpiryDate, 
															DateOfManufacture, BestBefore,DateOfReceipt, Barcode,CustomerBarcode,IsArchived, InsertedBy, 
															InsertedDate,UpdatedBy, UpdatedDate)
						select @DestinationPalletFK, -1, -1, @StockItemFK, SpecialStockTypeFK, Batch, SupplierBatch,EachUnits,
								case when eachesTypeFK > -1 THEN @var_ActualUnitsToMove ELSE ActualEaches END,
								case when eachesTypeFK = -1 THEN @var_ActualUnitsToMove ELSE ActualUnits END,
								-1,-1,
								ExpiryDate,DateOfManufacture, BestBefore,DateOfREceipt,
								tpal.barcode, tpal.customerBarcode, 0, @var_UserFK,  dbo.GetBSTDate(), @var_UserFK , dbo.GetBSTDate()
						
						from  tblPalletContent INNER JOIN tblStockItems ON stockItemFK = StockItemPK 
										LEFT OUTER JOIN tblPallets tPal ON palletPK = @DestinationPalletFK
																		WHERE palletContentPK = @SourcePalletContentFK

						-- get the new palletcontent Pk 
						--SET @DestinationPalletContentFK = @@IDENTITY
						Set @DestinationPalletContentFK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
					END

					-- Change Original Pallet Content - reduce actual units 	
					Print ' 11 - Update Original tblPalletContent '
					UPDATE tblPalletContent WITH (ROWLOCK) 
					SET actualUnits = CASE WHEN actualUnits - @var_ActualUnitsToMove > 0 THEN actualUnits - @var_ActualUnitsToMove  ELSE -1 END
					WHERE palletContentPK = @SourcePalletContentFK

					 -- Check if the total amount is being removed from the original pallet
					 if (@var_ActualUnitsToMove = @AvailableUnitsToMove)
					 BEGIN
					 -- Change containeroutlinepalletcontent
					  Print ' 6 - Update Source ContaineroutlinePalletContent - Units, PalletFK , PalletCOntentFK ' 
					   UPDATE tblContainerOutLinePalletContent WITH (ROWLOCK)
						SET PalletContentFK = @DestinationPalletContentFK,
							PalletFK = @DestinationPalletFK,
							Units = @var_ActualUnitsToMove                              -- set the units to the new amount
						WHERE ContainerOutLinePalletContentPK = @SourceContaineroutLinePalletContentFK
			
						Print '3 - Update Current tblworksordermovements - Moving stock from pallet to pallet  '
						-- change original worksOrderMovement to go from pallet to pallet and complete it
						UPDATE tblworksOrderMovements WITH (ROWLOCK)
						SET DestinationLocationTypeFK = 9,
							destinationFK = @DestinationPalletFK,
							worksOrderStatusFK = 3,
							DestinationBayPosition = -1,
							DestinationPalletStart = -1,
							DestinationPalletEnd = -1,
							MovementDescription = @Msg
						WHERE worksordermovementpk = @var_worksOrderMovementFK
					 END
					 ELSE
					 BEGIN
						-- Only Part of the amount is being moved
						-- 1. New WorksOrderMovement to move stock to new pallet
						Print ' 4 - Create New tblWorksOrderMovements - Moving Stock from Pallet to Pallet ' 

						INSERT INTO tblWorksOrderMovements
							(worksOrderFK, WorksOrderStatusFK,PalletFK,PalletContentFK,ContainerOutLinePalletContentFK, EntirePallet,
							  Eaches, Units,SourceLocationTypeFK, SourceLocationFK,SourceBayPosition,SourceStackPosition,DestinationLocationTypeFK,
							  DestinationFK, DestinationBayPosition,DestinationStackPosition,DestinationPalletStart,DestinationPalletEnd,MovementDescription,
							  IsArchived,InsertedBy,InsertedDate,UpdatedBy,UpdatedDate, ResponsibleUserFK)

							VALUES( @worksOrderFK, 3, @SourcePalletFK, @SourcePalletContentFK,@SourceContaineroutLinePalletContentFK,
							 1, -1, @var_ActualUnitsToMove, 9, @SourcePalletFK,-1,0, 
							9, @DestinationPalletFK, -1,0,-1,-1, @msg, 0, @var_UserFK,dbo.GetBSTDate(),@var_UserFK,dbo.GetBSTDate(), -1)
							-- Complete the WorksOrderMovement		
						
						  --select sum(1) from tblpalletcontent where palletfk  = @DestinationPalletFK group by stockitemFK

						  if (@PalletContentUpdated <> 1)  -- palletcontent & pallet not already on pick
						  BEGIN    
								Print ' 5  - Create ContaineroutLinePalletContent for stock on new pallet - '

								-- Create a new ContainerOutLinePalletContent
								INSERT INTO tblContainerOutLinePalletContent 
								(ContainerOutLineFK, PalletFK, Loaded,CustomerPalletNumber,CustomerBarcode,PalletContentFK,SplitPalletContentFK,Eaches,
								Units,Pallets,IsArchived,InsertedBy,InsertedDate,UpdatedBy,UpdatedDate)
								select containeroutLineFK, palletPK,0, pallet.customerPalletNumber, pallet.CustomerBarcode, @destinationPalletContentFK, -1,
								-1, @var_ActualUnitsToMove, pallets,0,@var_UserFK, dbo.GetBSTDate(), @var_UserFK, dbo.GetBSTDate()
								FROM tblContainerOutLinePalletContent LEFT OUTER JOIN
									tblPallets pallet ON palletPK = @DestinationPalletFK WHERE ContainerOutLinePalletContentPK = @SourceContaineroutLinePalletContentFK

								--set @DestinationContainerOutLinePalletContentFK = @@IDENTITY	
								set @DestinationContainerOutLinePalletContentFK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()	
						  END 			  			  
		
						  -- Update the Original ContainerOutLinePalletContent
		  					 -- Change / Create containeroutlinepalletcontent
								Print ' 11 - Update Original ContainerOutLinePalletContent - set units ' 
							   UPDATE tblContainerOutLinePalletContent WITH (ROWLOCK)
								SET Units = Units - @var_ActualUnitsToMove                              -- set the units to the new amount
								WHERE ContainerOutLinePalletContentPK = @SourceContaineroutLinePalletContentFK

						  -- Update the Original WorksOrderMovements
							  print '9 - Update Source WorksOrderMovement '
							  Update tblWorksOrderMovements WITH (ROWLOCK)
								SET Units = Units- @var_ActualUnitsToMove
								WHERE containerOutLinePalletContentFK = @SourceContainerOutLinePalletContentFK
			
					 END -- End of partial movement
				

						-- Set Message for the DestinationWorksOrderMovement
						DECLARE @Msg1 nvarchar (100)
						DECLARE @MSg2 nvarchar (200)
				
						set	 @Msg1 =  CONVERT(NVARCHAR(50),@DestinationPalletCurrentUnits + @var_ActualUnitsToMove)  + ' Units, Stock ' 
							+ @STockItemCode + ', Batch ' + @Batch + ', Barcode ' 

						select	@Msg2 =  @var_destinationBarcode + ' From ' + location  +' TO ' + @finalDestinationText
					
							FROM tblPallets pallets 
							INNER JOIN viewPalletLocations palletLoc ON palletLoc.palletPK = pallets.palletpk
							where pallets.palletpk = @DestinationPalletFK


						IF (@DestinationPalletIsAlreadyMixed = 1)
							SET @Msg = 'Move Mixed Pallet ' + @Msg2
						ELSE 
							SET @Msg = 'Move ' + @Msg1 + @Msg2

						-- Check if destination pallet is new / on pick					
						IF (@DestinationPalletOnThisPick = 0) -- New pallet
						  BEGIN
					
								Print ' 10 - Create New WorksOrderMovement move destination pallet to loading bay'
								INSERT INTO tblWorksOrderMovements
								(worksOrderFK, WorksOrderStatusFK,PalletFK,PalletContentFK,ContainerOutLinePalletContentFK, EntirePallet,
								  Eaches, Units,SourceLocationTypeFK, SourceLocationFK,SourceBayPosition,SourceStackPosition,DestinationLocationTypeFK,
								  DestinationFK, DestinationBayPosition,DestinationStackPosition,DestinationPalletStart,DestinationPalletEnd,MovementDescription,
								  IsArchived,InsertedBy,InsertedDate,UpdatedBy,UpdatedDate,ResponsibleUserFK)

								SELECT @worksOrderFK, 1, @DestinationPalletFK, @destinationPalletContentFK,@DestinationContainerOutLinePalletContentFK,
								 1, -1, @var_ActualUnitsToMove, pallets.locationTypeFK, pallets.locationFK,pallets.BayPosition,pallets.stackposition, 
								2, @FinalDestinationFK, -1,0,-1,-1, @msg, 0, @var_UserFK,dbo.GetBSTDate(),@var_UserFK,dbo.GetBSTDate(), -1
								FROM tblPallets pallets WHERE palletPK = @DestinationPalletFK
					
								--SET @DestinationWorksOrderMovementPK = @@IDENTITY
								SET @DestinationWorksOrderMovementPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()	

								-- If the destination Pallet is in the final loading bay then complete this worksordermovement
								if (@destinationPalletCurrentLocationFK = @FinalDestinationFK)
								BEGIN
									-- complete the woms as the pallet is already in the right location
									print '5 - PAllet in loading bay Complete the new destination WOMS'
										insert into #tmpReturn EXEC [dbo].[spWorksOrderMovementStatusChange]
										@worksOrderMovementPK = @DestinationWorksOrderMovementPK,
										@worksOrderStatusFK = 3,
										@currentUserFK = @var_UserFK
										Print 'cell movement'
										Select ReturnStatus From #tmpReturn						
								END
						 END
						 ELSE IF (@DestinationPalletOnThisPick = 1)  -- Pallet is already on pick
						 BEGIN	
								PRINT ' 15 - Update the works order movement for the destination Pallet to go from current location to Loading bay'
								-- If pallet is already mixed , update the units and eaches
							  IF (@DestinationPalletIsAlreadyMixed = 0 )
								BEGIN 									
									-- check if the destination pallet has different stock / Batch 
									IF EXISTS (select * from tblworksordermovements 
											inner join tblpalletcontent on palletcontentpk = palletcontentfk 
											where worksordermovementpk = @DestinationWorksOrderMovementPK
											AND stockItemFK = @StockItemFK
											AND batch = @Batch)  -- The same stock and batch -- update units and message
											BEGIN 
												Print ' Not mixed ' 
												UPDATE tblWorksOrderMovements WITH (ROWLOCK) 
												set units = CONVERT (DECIMAL(20,3), @DestinationPalletCurrentUnits + @var_ActualUnitsToMove)	,
													movementDescription = @msg
												WHERE worksordermovementpk = @DestinationWorksOrderMovementPK
										
											END
											ELSE
											BEGIN
												Print 'mixed'
												UPDATE tblWorksOrderMovements WITH (ROWLOCK) 
												set units = CONVERT (DECIMAL(20,3), @DestinationPalletCurrentUnits + @var_ActualUnitsToMove)	,
													palletContentFK = -1,
													movementDescription = @msg
												WHERE worksordermovementpk = @DestinationWorksOrderMovementPK
											END
								END
								ELSE
								BEGIN
								   PRINT 'Pallet Already Mixded - just change the units ' 
									-- Pallet already mixed -- 
									UPDATE tblworksOrderMovements WITH (ROWLOCK)
									set units = CONVERT(DECIMAL(20,3) , @DestinationPalletCurrentUnits + @var_ActualUnitsToMove)
									WHERE worksordermovementPK = @DestinationWorksOrderMovementPK
								END					
						 END  	

					-- Check if the Original Pallet is finished and if it needs to be moved back into racking
					If (@var_ActualUnitsToMove = @AvailableUnitsToMove)
					BEGIN
						print 'total amount moved'
						-- check if the pallet needs to go into racking
						IF (@SourcePalletLocationTypeFK <> 1 ) -- Pallet needs to go back to racking
						BEGIN
							print 'pallet  needs to go back into racking '
							-- check if pallet is on another pick
							select @SourcePalletOnAnotherPick = CASE WHEN goodsordernumber IS NULL THEN 0
														 WHEN worksOrderMovementPK is null then 1 ELSE 2 END 
														from viewContainerOutPalletList palletList
								LEFT OUTER JOIN 	
								(
									select palletFK ,worksOrderMovementPK , containeroutFK from
									tblStockOrders stk 
									inner Join tblworksorders wos ON wos.FK = stk.StockOrderPK
									inner join tblworksordermovements woms on worksOrderFK = worksOrderPK 
									WHERE wos.worksorderStatusFK in (1,2)  -- worksOrder is open
									  AND woms.WorksOrderStatusFK in (1,2) -- worksordermovement is open
								) OpenMovements ON openMovements.palletfk = palletList.palletfk

								 AND palletList.containeroutPK = openMovements.containeroutFK
								WHERE palletList.palletFK = @SourcePalletFK 
								  AND palletlist.goodsOrderNumber <> @var_GoodsOrderNumber

								print @SourcePalletOnAnotherPick

								if (@SourcePalletOnAnotherPick = 2)
								BEGIN
								   -- Change the Source of the Other WOrksOrdermovements
									print ' 14- Change the WOMS of the open woms on other order'
								END 
								ELSE IF (@SourcePalletOnAnotherPick = 0)
								BEGIN
									PRINT ' 12 - Palletinserted in to ContainerOutLinePalletToBeLocated'
									INSERT INTO tblContaineroutLinePalletToBeMoved
									(ContaineroutFK, PalletFK ,destinationTypeFK, destinationFK,statusFK,IsArchived,InsertedBy,InsertedDate,UpdatedBy,UpdatedDate)
									VALUES (@ContainerOutFK, @SourcePalletFK, @SourcePalletLocationTypeFK, 0,1,0,@var_UserFK,dbo.GetBSTDate(),@var_UserFK,dbo.GetBSTDate())
								END
						END 
					END		
				END
				ELSE
				BEGIN
					SELECT 5 as ReturnStatus
				END

			  SELECT 1 as ReturnStatus

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end

			IF @@TRANCOUNT > 0 AND XACT_STATE() = 1 BEGIN TRY IF XACT_STATE() = 1 AND @@TRANCOUNT = 1 AND @OpeningTranCount < 1 COMMIT TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH
			
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END
GO

-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,Rachael Sherry>
-- Create date: <Create Date,14/08/2015>
-- Description:	<Checks if the Pallet to move the Stock Onto is New or on the current Pick>
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spMobileSplitPalletNewPalletCheck]
(
	@ScannedBarcode nvarchar(200),  -- The new pallet the stock is being moved to
	@ContainerOutFK int
)
AS 
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT
 ,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;
	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	DECLARE @var_ScannedBarcode nvarchar(200), @var_ContainerOutFK int
	SET @var_ScannedBarcode = @ScannedBarcode; SET @var_ContainerOutFK = @ContainerOutFK
	SET @ParameterDetails = '@ScannedBarcode = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_ScannedBarcode AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@ContainerOutFK = ' 
		+ ISNULL(CAST(@var_ContainerOutFK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'')

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    --BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

		SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END


	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY
			
			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start

			DECLARE @PalletFK int 

			--IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#tmpReturn') IS NOT NULL        -- Delete  the temporary table if it already exists
			--	DROP TABLE #tmpReturn

			--create table #tmpReturn( ReturnStatus int  ) -- 0 Success - Can move stock onto this pallet													 
			--												-- 1 Pallet does not exist
			--												-- 2 Pallet is on a different pick and not on this one
			--												-- 3 Pallet is on Stock In
			--												-- 4 Pallet on this pick but it has to be split
													  
				-- check if the barocde scanned is a pallet
				IF EXISTS (SELECT palletPk from tblpallets where 
										( barcode = @var_ScannedBarcode OR CustomerBarcode = @var_ScannedBarcode)
										and isarchived = 0 -- still in the warehouse
										and palletstatusFK <> 10) -- Not on route
				BEGIN
					SELECT @PalletFK = palletPk from tblpallets where 
										( barcode = @var_ScannedBarcode OR CustomerBarcode = @var_ScannedBarcode)
										and isarchived = 0 -- still in the warehouse
										and palletstatusFK <> 10			
				END
				ELSE BEGIN
					SELECT 1 AS ReturnStatus
					RETURN
				END


			-- check if this pallet is on the current pick 
			IF Exists (select * from tblcontaineroutlines cOl
						inner join tblContaineroutLinePalletContent palCon ON palCon.containeroutLineFK = cOl.containerOutlinePK
						WHERE cOl.containeroutFK = @var_ContainerOutFK
						AND  palCon.palletFK = @PalletFK )
			BEGIN
				print 'on this pick'
				print @PalletFK

				-- check if the pallet is to be split
				if EXISTS (SELECT * from tblcontaineroutlines cOl
						inner join tblContaineroutLinePalletContent palCon ON palCon.containeroutLineFK = cOl.containerOutlinePK
						inner JOIN tblworksOrderMovements woms ON woms.containerOutLinePalletContentFK = palCon.ContainerOutLinePalletContentPK
						WHERE cOl.containeroutFK = @var_ContainerOutFK
						AND  palCon.palletFK = @PalletFK 
						AND woms.WorksOrderStatusFK in (1,2)
						AND EntirePallet = 0 )
				BEGIN
					print 'pallet is to be split'
					-- Pallet is set to be split
					SELECT 4 as ReturnStatus
					RETURN
				END
				ELSE
				BEGIN
					SELECT 0 as ReturnStatus
					RETURN
				END
			END


				-- check if the pallet is on another pick 
			IF Exists (select * from tblcontaineroutlines cOl
						inner join tblContaineroutLinePalletContent palCon ON palCon.containeroutLineFK = cOl.containerOutlinePK
						WHERE cOl.containeroutFK <> @var_ContainerOutFK
						AND  palCon.palletFK = @PalletFK )
			BEGIN
				SELECT 2 as ReturnStatus
				RETURN
			END						

			--check if the pallet has ever been on a Stock In
			  if EXISTS (Select * from tblstockInLinePallets WHERE palletFK = @palletFK)
			  BEGIN 
					select 3 as ReturnStatus
					RETURN
			  END 

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end
						
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END

-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,Rachael Sherry>
-- Create date: <Create Date,29/09/2015>
-- Description:	< checks if Pallet is on Pick / To be split and being moved out of Racking>
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spMobileSplitPalletRecordLocation]
(
	@PalletFK int ,
	@DestinationTypeFK int,  -- The new pallet the stock is being moved to
	@UserFK int
)
AS 
BEGIN
    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT,
	@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;
	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	DECLARE @var_PalletFK int, @var_DestinationTypeFK int, @var_UserFK int
	SET @var_PalletFK = @PalletFK; SET @var_DestinationTypeFK = @DestinationTypeFK; SET @var_UserFK = @UserFK
	SET @ParameterDetails = '@PalletFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_PalletFK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@DestinationTypeFK = ' 
		+ ISNULL(CAST(@var_DestinationTypeFK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@UserFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_UserFK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'')

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    --BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

		SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END

	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY			

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start

			DECLARE @SplitPallet bit
			DECLARE @ContainerOutFK int

			-- Check if Pallet is on an open Pick and is in racking
			IF (@var_DestinationTypeFK = 1) -- Finish if pallet is going into racking
				RETURN 

			IF EXISTS(
						SELECT 
							* 
						FROM 
							tblpallets 
						INNER JOIN (
										Select * from viewContainerOutPalletList 
										WHERE ContainerOutStatusFK in (1,2)
									) AS ViewContaineroutPalletList
							ON palletFK = palletPK 	
						where 
							palletpk = @var_PalletFK
							AND locationTypeFK = 1 
						) 
			BEGIN 		
				-- check if pallet is to be split and there is no record in tblContaineroutPalletToBeLocated
				SELECT  
					@SplitPallet = CASE WHEN Units < ActualUnits AND  palLoc.containerOutPalletToBeLocatedPK IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,
					@ContainerOutFK = ContaineroutPK
				FROM 
					tblpalletContent AS palcon
				INNER JOIN (
								Select * from viewContainerOutPalletList 
								WHERE ContainerOutStatusFK in (1,2)
							) AS VCPaL
					ON VCPaL.palletFK = palcon.palletFK 
				LEFT OUTER JOIN tblContainerOutPalletToBeLocated AS palLoc 
					ON palLoc.palletFK = palcon.palletFK
				where 
					palcon.palletFK  = @var_PalletFK
		
				-- If Pallet is to be split then record current location
				IF (@SplitPallet = 1)
				BEGIN
					IF XACT_STATE() = 0 AND @@TRANCOUNT < 1 BEGIN TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName

					INSERT INTO tblContainerOutPalletToBeLocated
					(
						ContainerOutFK, PalletFK, DestinationTypeFK , DestinationFK , ISArchived, InsertedBy, InsertedDate, UpdatedBy, UpdatedDate
					)
					SELECT 
						@ContainerOutFK, palletPK , locationTypeFK, LocationFK , 0, @var_UserFK, dbo.GetBSTDate(), @var_UserFK, dbo.GetBSTDate() 
					FROM 
						tblPallets 
					WHERE 
						palletPK = @var_PalletFK 
						AND IsArchived = 0 

					BEGIN TRY IF XACT_STATE() = 1 AND @@TRANCOUNT = 1 AND @OpeningTranCount < 1 COMMIT TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH
				END
			END
	
			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end
			
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;

			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
							
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spMobileStockInForCustomerSync]              
(              
 @customerFK as int,              
 @SearchValue as nvarchar(200) = ''                
)               
AS              
BEGIN              
 /* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */              
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED              
              
    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT              
 ,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;              
 SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();              
              
 -- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters              
 DECLARE @var_customerFK int, @var_userFK int, @var_SearchValue nvarchar(200)              
 SET @var_customerFK = @customerFK; set @var_SearchValue = @SearchValue              
 SET @ParameterDetails = '@customerFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_customerFK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@SearchValue = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_SearchValue AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'')              
              
    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL               
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)              
              
    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)              
    --BEGIN              
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC               
              
  SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)              
              
        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)              
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK              
              
        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()              
    --END              
              
              
 SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);              
 SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails              
 ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;              
 INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()              
              
 WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3              
 BEGIN               
  BEGIN TRY              
   -- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start              
    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#tmpResults') IS NOT NULL                     
    DROP TABLE #tmpResults               
    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#tmpStockIns') IS NOT NULL                     
    DROP TABLE #tmpStockIns               
    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#tmpContainerIns') IS NOT NULL                     
    DROP TABLE #tmpContainerIns               
    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#tmpDocketIdentifiers') IS NOT NULL       
    DROP TABLE #tmpDocketIdentifiers               
	
	IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#tmpCustomerDivs') IS NOT NULL                     
    DROP TABLE #tmpCustomerDivs               
    
	select divisionpk into #tmpCustomerDivs from tbldivisions where customerfk = @var_customerFK
	SELECT si.* INTO #tmpStockIns FROM tblstockins si inner join #tmpCustomerDivs on DivisionFK = DivisionPK where StockInStatusFK = 1                   
    SELECT ci.* INTO #tmpContainerIns FROM tblContainerIns ci inner join #tmpStockIns on ContainerInPK = ContainerInFK
    SELECT Customerfk, CustomerDocketIdentificationPK, FieldFK, Prefix, Field2FK, Prefix2 INTO #tmpDocketIdentifiers FROM tblCustomerDocketIdentifications where DocketTypeFK = 1    and CustomerFK = @var_customerFK          
                     
            
    SELECT DISTINCT StockInPK,             
     cins.ContainerInPK, 
	 cins.GoodsInNumber + case when cins.ContainerNumber <> '' then ' / ' + cins.ContainerNumber else '' end  as Goods_In_Number, 
	 DivisionName as Division_Name, 
	 0 AS Arrived, 
	 cins.inserteddate,            
     CASE WHEN cdis.prefix = '' THEN '' ELSE cdis.prefix END as ID1,            
     CASE WHEN cdis.prefix2 = '' THEN '' ELSE cdis.prefix2 END as ID2,            
     CASE WHEN cdis.CustomerDocketIdentificationPK = null THEN '' ELSE            
      CASE cdis.FieldFK             
       WHEN 1 THEN CASE WHEN LEN(cins.Free1) > 0 THEN cins.Free1 ELSE '' END            
       WHEN 2 THEN CASE WHEN LEN(cins.Free2) > 0 THEN cins.Free2 ELSE '' END             
       WHEN 3 THEN CASE WHEN LEN(cins.Free3) > 0 THEN cins.Free3 ELSE '' END            
       WHEN 4 THEN cins.Free4            
       WHEN 5 THEN cins.Free5            
       ELSE ''            
      END             
     END as IDValue1,            
     CASE cdis.Field2FK             
      WHEN 1 THEN cins.Free1            
      WHEN 2 THEN cins.Free2            
 WHEN 3 THEN cins.Free3            
      WHEN 4 THEN cins.Free4            
      WHEN 5 THEN cins.Free5            
      ELSE ''            
     END as IDValue2,            
     tLbays.Barcode, 2 as HeadersOnlyStage, @var_customerFK CustomerFK, DateIn  
	 INTO #tmpResults
    FROM #tmpContainerIns cins            
    INNER JOIN #tmpStockIns stkIn ON stkIn.ContainerInFK = cins.ContainerInPK            
    INNER JOIN tblStockInLines StkLine ON stkLine.StockInFK = stkIn.stockinPK            
    INNER JOIN tblStockItems stk ON stk.stockItemPK = stkLine.stockItemFK            
    --INNER JOIN tblBuildingUnits bus ON bus.BuildingUnitPK = cins.BuildingUnitFK            
    INNER JOIN tblDivisions div ON div.DivisionPK = stk.DivisionFK            
    left outer join #tmpDocketIdentifiers as cdis ON cdis.CustomerFK = @var_customerFK            
    INNER JOIN tblLoadingBays tLbays ON tLbays.LoadingBayPK = cins.LoadingBayFK            
         
                    
             
   -- Return the top 10 goods in, ordered by arrival date and datein.           
   -- can also just return the top ten matches for the search               
   IF len(@var_SearchValue) > 0              
   BEGIN               
    Set @var_SearchValue = '%' + @var_SearchValue + '%'              
    select *  from #tmpResults where               
    (Goods_In_Number like @var_SearchValue               
      OR IDValue1 like @var_SearchValue               
      OR IDValue2 like @var_SearchValue)              
    order by Arrived desc ,               
    convert(date, datein) desc ,              
      CONVERT(time, datein)               
   END              
   else              
   BEGIN                     
    select *  from #tmpResults               
    where convert(date, datein) <= convert(date, dbo.GetBSTDate())              
    order by Arrived desc ,               
    convert(date, datein) desc ,              
      CONVERT(time, datein)               
   END              
                    
   -- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end               
   BREAK              
  END TRY              
  BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */              
   DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;              
   SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;              
   SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;              
              
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY               
   BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;              
                     
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;              
              
            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID              
                          
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;              
                          
   IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)              
   BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END              
   ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */              
  END CATCH              
  SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1              
 END              
END  
GO

			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END

-- =============================================
-- Author:		Rachael Sherry
-- Create date: 19/01/2016
-- Description:	Retrieves the list of Stock Items on a Headers Only Stock In
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spMobileStockInHeaders]
(
	@ContainerInFK as int
)	
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT
 ,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;
	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	DECLARE @var_ContainerInFK int
	SET @var_ContainerInFK = @ContainerInFK
	SET @ParameterDetails = '@ContainerInFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_ContainerInFK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'')

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    --BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

		SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END


	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY
			
			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start
			
			-- Return the Stock In Header Information for the top grid
			IF exists (select * from tblContainerIns where containerinPK = @var_ContainerInFK
													 AND isBeingBuilt = 1)
			BEGIN
				-- The Goods In is being Built from scratch but does not have headers 
				select  0 as ReturnStatus , 
								StockItemFK as StockInHeaderPK,
								stockItemCode,
								eancode as stockItemEanCode,
								eancode2 as stockItemEanCode2,
								0 as ExpectedQty,
								sum(Units)  as ScannedQty,
								case when stk.DefaultPalletTypeFK < 1 THEN div.DefaultPalletTypeFK ELSE stk.DefaultPalletTypeFK end as palletTypeFK,
								--DefaultPalletTypeFK as palletTypeFK,
								stk.divisionFK

					from tblstockins 
					inner join tblstockinlines on stockinpk = stockinfk 
					inner join tblstockitems stk on stockitemfk = stockitempk 
					INNER JOIN tbldivisions div ON divisionpk = stk.divisionfk 
					where containerInFK = @var_ContainerInFK
					group by stockitemfk, stockitemcode, EANCode, eancode2, case when stk.DefaultPalletTypeFK < 1 THEN div.DefaultPalletTypeFK ELSE stk.DefaultPalletTypeFK end, stk.divisionFK
					order by StockItemCode
			END
			ELSE
			BEGIN
			    -- check if there is no eancode assigned to one of the stock Items 

				-- Check if there are duplicate EanCodes on the Stock In 
				-- This code is no longer needed as the stockitemPK  from the header file will be used. 
				IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#tmpEancodes') IS NOT NULL       
					DROP TABLE #tmpEancodes 		
				IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#tmpEancode2') IS NOT NULL       
					DROP TABLE #tmpEancode2	
				IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#tmpStockItems') IS NOT NULL
					DROP TABLE #tmpStockItems

				-- get the list of stockitems , stockitemcode, eancode and eancode2
				Select stockitempk, stockitemcode, eancode, eancode2
				INTO #tmpStockItems
				FROM tblContainerInHeaders 
				INNER JOIN tblstockitems on stockitempk = stockitemfk 
				where containerinfk = @var_Containerinfk

				-- check if there is a stockitem with no EanCodes setup against it 
				IF exists (select * from #tmpStockItems where ltrim(isnull(eancode,'')) = '' )
				BEGIN

					DECLARE @StockItemCode nvarchar(100) 
					set @Stockitemcode = ''
					select @StockItemCode = @StockItemCode + StockItemCode+ ', '  from #tmpStockItems where ltrim(isnull(eancode,'')) = ''
					set @StockItemCode = LEFT(@stockitemcode, len(@stockitemcode)-1) 
					SELECT 2 as ReturnStatus,
						'Stock Item(s) ' + @stockitemcode + ' does not have an EAN code setup, Contact Stock Controller' as ReturnMessage
					RETURN
				END 
			
				-- count the number of duplicate eancodes on the header file
				SELECT eancode , count(*) as NoOfEanCodes
				INTO #tmpEanCodes
				FROM #tmpStockItems
				GROUP BY EANCode

				-- count the number of duplicate eancode2's on the header file
				SELECT EANCode2 , count(*) as NoOfEanCodes
				INTO #tmpEancode2
				FROM #tmpStockItems
				WHERE len(eancode2) > 1
				GROUP BY  EANCode2

				-- check if there are stock items with no ean codes setup 

				 -- check if there duplicate eancodes
				 IF exists (SELECT * from #tmpEancodes where NoOfEanCodes > 1)
				 BEGIN 
					 DECLARE @Eancode nvarchar(200)
					 set @eancode = ''
					 select @Eancode = @Eancode + eancode + ', '  
					 from #tmpEancodes 
					 where NoofEanCodes > 1 and ltrim(isnull(eancode,'')) <> ''
	 
					 -- Trim the eancode
					 set @eancode = LEFT(@eancode, len(@eancode)-1) 
	 
					 SELECT 2 as ReturnStatus,
						 'Multiple Stock Items setup for EanCode(s) ' + @Eancode + ' Contact Stock Controller' as ReturnMessage
					 RETURN
				  END 

				 -- check if there duplicate eancode2s
				IF exists (SELECT * from #tmpEancode2 where NoOfEanCodes > 1)
				BEGIN 
					SELECT 2 as ReturnStatus,
						'Multiple EanCodes setup for this Goods In, Contact Stock Controller' as ReturnMessage
					RETURN
				END 
  
				-- check if there are matching eancode and eancode2
				IF exists (select * from #tmpEAncode2 where eancode2 in (Select eancode from #tmpEancodes))
				BEGIN
					SELECT 2 as ReturnStatus,
						'Multiple EanCodes setup for this Goods In, Contact Stock Controller' as ReturnMessage
					RETURN
				END
				
				--if EXISTS (SELECT COUNT(*) as NoOfEANCodes from tblContainerInHeaders
				--			inner JOIN tblStockItems stk on StockItemFK = StockItemPK
				--			INNER JOIN tblStockItems stkean ON stkean.EANCode = stk.EANCode
				--			where ContainerINFK = @var_ContainerInFK
				--			GROUP BY stkean.EANCode
				--			HAVING COUNT(*) > 1)
				--BEGIN
				--	SELECT 2 as ReturnStatus,
				--		  'Multiple StockItems setup for EANCODE ' + stkEan.EANCODE + ' , Contact IT' as ReturnMessage
				--			from tblContainerInHeaders
				--			inner JOIN tblStockItems stk on StockItemFK = StockItemPK
				--			INNER JOIN tblStockItems stkean ON stkean.EANCode = stk.EANCode
				--			where ContainerINFK = @var_ContainerInFK
				--			GROUP BY stkean.EANCode
				--			HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
				
				--END
				--ELSE
				BEGIN
				select	0 as ReturnStatus , 
								StockItemFK as StockInHeaderPK,
								stockItemCode,
								eancode as stockItemEanCode,
								eancode2 as stockItemEanCode2,
								Units as ExpectedQty,
								UnitsScanned as ScannedQty,
								case when si.DefaultPalletTypeFK < 1 THEN div.DefaultPalletTypeFK ELSE si.DefaultPalletTypeFK end as palletTypeFK,
								divisionFK
					
						 FROM tblcontainerInheaders
						 INNER JOIN tblstockitems si ON StockItemPK = StockItemFK
						 INNER JOIN tbldivisions div ON divisionpk = divisionfk 
				WHERE ContainerInFK = @var_ContainerInFK
				END
			END

			-- Return the list of pallets scanned for the bottom grid
			-- select palletNumber=COUNT(*), stkit.StockItemCode, palcon.SupplierBatch, pal.customerBarcode, availableunits from tblstockins stk
		
			select ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY pal.CustomerBarcode) as 'palletNumber', stkit.StockItemCode, 
							CASE WHEN (palcon.SupplierBatch = '') THEN palcon.batch ELSE palcon.supplierbatch END as SupplierBatch,
							 pal.customerBarcode, availableunits, pal.CustomerPalletNumber
			from tblstockins stk
			left outer join tblstockinlines stkl on  stkl.stockinfk = stockinpk
			left outer join tblstockinlinepallets stkpal on stkpal.stockinlinefk = stkl.stockinlinepk
			left outer join tblpallets pal on pal.palletpk = stkpal.palletfk
			left outer join tblpalletcontent palcon on palcon.palletfk = pal.palletpk
			LEFT OUTER JOIN tblStockItems stkit ON stkit.StockItemPK = palcon.StockItemFK
			where containerinfk = @var_ContainerInFK
			GROUP BY stkit.StockItemCode,palcon.SupplierBatch, pal.CustomerBarcode, palcon.AvailableUnits, palcon.batch, pal.CustomerPalletNumber
			order by stockitemcode, SupplierBatch

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END
