CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spMobileStockOutRowSelection]      
(      
 @GoodsOrderNumber as nvarchar(100),      
    @MachineBarcode as nvarchar(100),      
    @BuildingUnitFK as int      
)       
AS      
BEGIN      
 /* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */      
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED      
      
    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT      
 ,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;      
 SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();      
      
 -- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters      
 DECLARE @var_GoodsOrderNumber nvarchar(100), @var_MachineBarcode nvarchar(100), @var_BuildingUnitFK int      
 SET @var_GoodsOrderNumber = @GoodsOrderNumber; SET @var_MachineBarcode = @MachineBarcode; SET @var_BuildingUnitFK = @BuildingUnitFK      
 SET @ParameterDetails = '@GoodsOrderNumber = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_GoodsOrderNumber AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@MachineBarcode = '       
  + ISNULL(CAST(@var_MachineBarcode AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@BuildingUnitFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_BuildingUnitFK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'')      
      
    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL       
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)      
      
    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)      
    --BEGIN      
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC       
      
  SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)      
      
        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)      
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK      
      
        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()      
    --END      
      
      
 SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);      
 SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails      
 ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;      
 INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()      
      
 WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3      
 BEGIN       
  BEGIN TRY      
         
   -- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start      
      
   -- declare the variables for the machine information to see what bay levels can be included      
   DECLARE @IgnoreTopLevel as int      
   DECLARE @TopLevelReached as nvarchar (10)      
   DECLARE @IncludeLevelA as int      
   SET @IncludeLevelA = 0       
      
   -- Assign the information from the warehouse machine table       
   select @TopLevelReached = TopLevelReached      
   FROM tblWareHouseMachines tWhm      
   INNER JOIN appWareHouseMachineTypes aWmt ON aWmt.WareHouseMachineTypePK = tWhm.WareHouseMachineTypeFK      
   WHERE barcode = @var_MachineBarcode       
                                                
   SET @IncludeLevelA = 0      
      
   --IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#TmpContainerOutPalletLocations') IS NOT NULL             
   -- DROP TABLE #TmpContainerOutPalletLocations      
     
   --SELECT distinct tCO.GoodsOrderNumber, palletlocation.rackingTypeFK, palletlocation.LocationTypeFK, palletlocation.row, palletlocation.baylevel, palletlocation.buildingUnitFK, tPal.PalletPK   
   --INTO #TmpContainerOutPalletLocations  
   --FROM tblContainerOuts tCO  
   --inner join tblContainerOutLines col on ContainerOutPK = ContainerOutFK  
   --inner join tblContainerOutLinePalletContent colpc on ContainerOutLineFK = ContainerOutLinePK  
   --INNER JOIN tblPallets tPal ON tPal.PalletPK = colpc.PalletFK  
   --INNER JOIN ViewPalletLocations palletlocation ON palletlocation.PalletPK = tPal.PalletPK   
   --WHERE tCo.GoodsOrderNumber  = @var_GoodsOrderNumber  

   drop table if exists #tmpcontpals
   select distinct GoodsOrderNumber, palletfk 
   into #tmpcontpals
   from tblContainerOuts tCO  
   inner join tblContainerOutLines col on ContainerOutPK = ContainerOutFK  
   inner join tblContainerOutLinePalletContent colpc on ContainerOutLineFK = ContainerOutLinePK
   WHERE tCo.GoodsOrderNumber  =  @var_GoodsOrderNumber 
   
   DROP TABLE if exists #TmpContainerOutPalletLocations
   select distinct GoodsOrderNumber, palletlocation.rackingTypeFK, palletlocation.LocationTypeFK, palletlocation.row, palletlocation.baylevel, palletlocation.buildingUnitFK, p.PalletFK as PalletPK   
   INTO #TmpContainerOutPalletLocations
   from ViewPalletLocations palletlocation
   inner join #tmpcontpals p on palletlocation.PalletPK = p.PalletFK
      
   -- Check if there are pallets in level A in any of the rows      
   if (exists (      
    select  PalletPK      
    from #TmpContainerOutPalletLocations         
    WHERE rackingTypeFK  = 1      -- Conventional Racking      
     AND LocationTypeFK = 1 -- Racking      
     AND baylevel = 'A'      
     AND buildingUnitFK = @var_BuildingUnitFK))      
   BEGIN              
    SET @IncludeLevelA = 1      
   END      
         
   -- Check if there are any pallets in conventional racking        
   if (not exists (      
    select  row        
    from #TmpContainerOutPalletLocations      
    WHERE LocationTypeFK = 1 -- Racking      
     AND BuildingUnitFK = @var_BuildingUnitFK      
    group by row))      
   BEGIN      
    -- NO pallets in conventional racking      
    SELECT 1 AS ReturnStatus , '-1' as Rows, -1 as BuildingUnitFK, @IncludeLevelA as IncludeLevelA      
    RETURN 1      
   END      
   ELSE          
    -- Retrieve the list of Rows that have the pallets in conventional racking   
   
 Print'Pritesh'  
    select  2 as ReturnStatus, row + ' (' +  cast(count(DISTINCT palletPk) AS nvarchar(10)) +')'as Rows, BuildingUnitFK, @IncludeLevelA as IncludeLevelA      
    from  #TmpContainerOutPalletLocations      
    WHERE LocationTypeFK = 1 -- Racking      
     AND baylevel <= @TopLevelReached      
     AND BuildingUnitFK = @var_BuildingUnitFK      
    group by row, BuildingUnitFK      
    ORDER BY len([row]), [row]      
      
   -- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end            
   BREAK      
  END TRY      
  BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */      
   DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;      
   SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;      
   SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;      
      
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY       
   BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;      
             
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;      
      
            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID      
                  
           IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;      
                  
   IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)      
   BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END      
   ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */      
  END CATCH      
  SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1      
 END      
END  
GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[spMobileStockOutScannedPalletCheck]    Script Date: 02/11/2026 17:47:27 ******/

CREATE  PROCEDURE [dbo].[spMobileStockOutScannedPalletCheck]     
(    
 @WorksOrderMovementFK int,    
 @ScannedBarcode nvarchar(100),    
 @FirstPalletExpected int     
)     
AS    
BEGIN    
 /* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */    
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED    
    
    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT    
 ,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;    
 SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();    
    
 -- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters    
 DECLARE @var_WorksOrderMovementFK int, @var_ScannedBarcode nvarchar(100), @var_FirstPalletExpected int    
 SET @var_WorksOrderMovementFK = @WorksOrderMovementFK; SET @var_ScannedBarcode = @ScannedBarcode; SET @var_FirstPalletExpected = @FirstPalletExpected    
 SET @ParameterDetails = '@WorksOrderMovementFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_WorksOrderMovementFK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@ScannedBarcode = '     
  + ISNULL(CAST(@var_ScannedBarcode AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@FirstPalletExpected = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_FirstPalletExpected AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'')    
    
    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL     
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)    
    
    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)    
    --BEGIN    
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC     
    
  SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)    
    
        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)    
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK    
    
        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()    
    --END    
    
    
 SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);    
 SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails    
 ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;    
 INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()    
    
 WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3    
 BEGIN     
  BEGIN TRY    
   -- 1 = Success    
   -- 2 = Pallet is not available    
   -- 3 = Unable to Swap pallet    
   -- 4 = Second Pallet is swapped    
    
   -- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start     
   DECLARE @SourceLocationFK int    
   DECLARE @AlreadyScannedPalletFK int    
      
   -- check if the Pick is for Danone and do not allow pallets to be swapped    
   IF EXISTS (    
    SELECT * FROM (select * from viewContainerOutPalletList where divisionfk in (select divisionpk from tbldivisions where customerfk in (752, 747))) vpl    
    INNER JOIN tblworksOrderMovements woms ON woms.containerOutLinePalletContentFK = vpl.containerOutLinePalletContentPK    
    where WorksOrderMovementPK =  @var_WorksOrderMovementFK)    
   BEGIN     
    SELECT 3 as ReturnStatus,    
      'Pallet Not On Order' as ReturnMessage ,-1 as WorksOrderMovementPK   
    RETURN    
   END         
       
   IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#TmpScannedPallet') IS NOT NULL           
    DROP TABLE #TmpScannedPallet    
   Select * INTO #TmpScannedPallet from tblPallets where (barcode = @var_ScannedBarcode OR customerBarcode = @var_ScannedBarcode) AND IsArchived = 0 AND Loaded = 0    
    
   -- Check if the scannedBarcode is a pallet that is available    
   IF NOT EXISTS (Select * from #TmpScannedPallet where locationTypeFK = 1)    
   BEGIN    
    SELECT 2 as ReturnStatus  , ' ' as ReturnMessage ,-1 as WorksOrderMovementPK   
    RETURN    
   END    
    
   if (@var_FirstPalletExpected = 1)    
   BEGIN    
    SELECT  CASE WHEN ScannedStock = StockItemFK AND ScannedBatch = Batch AND ScannedUnits = Units     
       AND scannedPallet.ScannedPalletStatus = ExpectedPallet.PalletStatusFK     
       AND scannedPallet.ScannedDateOfManufacture = ExpectedPallet.ExpectedDateofManufacture THEN 1 ELSE 3 END as ReturnStatus,    
     CASE WHEN ScannedStock <> stockItemFK THEN 'StockItem Does Not Match'     
      ELSE CASE WHEN scannedBatch <> Batch THEN 'Batches Do Not Match'     
       ELSE CASE WHEN ScannedUnits <> Units THEN 'Quantity Does Not Match'     
        ELSE CASE WHEN scannedPallet.ScannedDateOfManufacture <> ExpectedPallet.ExpectedDateofManufacture THEN 'Manufacture Date Does Not Match'    
         ELSE CASE WHEN scannedPalletStatus <> ExpectedPallet.PalletStatusFK THEN 'Status Does Not Match'    
          ELSE 'Success'     
         END     
        END     
       END     
      END     
     END  as ReturnMessage--,
	 ,-1 as WorksOrderMovementPK
     --1 as ReturnStatus    
    FROM (    
     -- Check if the pallet is in the same location and has the same stock , Batch, QTY and PalletStatus    
     SELECT @var_WorksOrderMovementFK as WorksOrderMovementFK, tpal.locationFK as ScannedLocation, Location as ScannedLocationName,    
      StockitemFK as ScannedStock , Batch as ScannedBatch, AvailableUnits as ScannedUnits, tpal.palletStatusFK as ScannedPalletStatus,    
      stk.StockItemCode as ScannedStockItemCode, tPalCon.DateOfManufacture as ScannedDateOfManufacture    
     from #TmpScannedPallet tpal    
     INNER JOIN tblPalletContent tPalCon ON tPalcon.palletfk = tpal.palletpk     
     INNER JOIN ViewPalletLocations palletLoc ON palletLoc.palletPK = tpal.palletPK    
     INNER JOIN tblstockitems stk on stk.stockItemPK = tPalCon.stockItemFK    
    ) scannedPallet    
    INNER JOIN (-- check the details of the expected pallet    
     SELECT @var_WorksOrderMovementFK as WorksOrderMovementFK,tpal.locationFK, palletLoc.location as ExpectedLocation, tpalCon.stockItemFK,    
      tpalCon.batch , woms.units, tpal.palletStatusFK ,stk.StockItemCode as ExpectedStockItemCode, tpalCon.DateOfManufacture as ExpectedDateofManufacture    
     from tblWorksOrderMovements woms     
     INNER JOIN tblPallets tpal ON tpal.palletPK = woms.palletFK    
     INNER JOIN tblPalletContent tpalCon ON tpalCon.palletFK = tpal.PalletPK    
     INNER JOIN ViewPalletLocations palletLoc ON palletLoc.palletPK = tpal.palletPK    
     INNER JOIN tblstockitems stk on stk.stockItemPK = tPalCon.stockItemFK    
     where woms.WorksOrderMovementPK = @var_WorksOrderMovementFK    
    ) ExpectedPallet ON scannedPallet.WorksOrderMovementFK = ExpectedPallet.WorksOrderMovementFK    
   END    
   ELSE    
   BEGIN    
    -- Second pallet scanned - see if there is a pallet in racking with the same stock, batch ,qty, status that it can be swapped with    
    SELECT @SourceLocationFK = SourceLocationFK, @AlreadyScannedPalletFK = PalletFK FROM tblWorksOrderMovements where WorksOrderMovementPK = @var_WorksOrderMovementFK    
            
    -- ** Declare and Assign values from the Pallet you have scanned **--    
    DECLARE @ScannedStockItemFK int    
    DECLARE @ScannedBatch nvarchar(200)    
    DECLARE @ScannedPalletSatusFK int    
    DECLARE @ScannedQTY decimal (18,3)    
    DECLARE @scannedManufactureDate dateTime    
    
    SELECT @ScannedStockItemFK = StockItemFK,    
      @ScannedBatch = batch,    
      @ScannedPalletSatusFK = palletStatusFK,    
      @ScannedQTY = AvailableUnits,    
      @ScannedManufactureDate = DateOfManufacture    
    FROM #TmpScannedPallet pal    
    INNER JOIN tblPalletContent ON pal.palletPk = palletFK    
    
    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#TmpContainerOutFromWOM') IS NOT NULL           
     DROP TABLE #TmpContainerOutFromWOM    
    select distinct ContainerOutPK INTO #TmpContainerOutFromWOM    
      from viewContainerOutPalletList     
      where ContainerOutLinePalletContentPK = (    
       SELECT ContainerOutLinePalletContentFK     
         from tblWorksOrderMovements     
       where WorksOrderMovementPK = @var_WorksOrderMovementFK)    
    
    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#TmpdriveThroughLocations') IS NOT NULL           
     DROP TABLE #TmpdriveThroughLocations    
    SELECT buildingUnitBayPK INTO #TmpdriveThroughLocations    
       from tblBuildingUnitBays     
       Where buildingUnitColumnFK = (    
        SELECT buildingUnitColumnFK     
        FROM tblBuildingUnitBays     
        Where buildingUnitBayPK = @SourceLocationFK And IsArchived = 0) /* Damien Exclude Archived Bays #Dev-910 */    
    
    IF exists (    
     SELECT top 1 WorksOrderMovementPK, pallet.locationFK as ScannedLocation, pallet.palletpk as scannedpallet, Location as ScannedLocationName,    
      StockitemPK as ScannedStock , palCon.Batch as ScannedBatch, ActualUnits as ScannedUnits, pallet.palletStatusFK as ScannedPalletStatus,    
      stk.StockItemCode as ScannedStockItemCode, palcon.dateOfManufacture as ScannedDateOfManufacture    
     from viewContainerOutPalletList coList    
     INNER JOIN tblPallets pallet on coList.PalletFK = PalletPK    
     INNER JOIN tblWorksOrderMovements woms ON woms.PalletFK = pallet.PalletPK AND woms.ContainerOutLinePalletContentFK = coList.ContainerOutLinePalletContentPK    
     INNER JOIN tblPalletContent palCon ON palCon.PalletFK = pallet.PalletPK    
     INNER JOIN tblStockItems stk ON stockItemPK = palCon.stockItemFK     
     INNER JOIN viewPalletLocations palLoc ON palLoc.palletPk = pallet.palletPK    
     where ContainerOutPK = (SELECT ContainerOutPK FROM #TmpContainerOutFromWOM)    
      AND pallet.LocationTypeFK = 1   -- in racking    
      AND pallet.IsArchived = 0       -- Gone from warehouse    
      and pallet.PalletStatusFK <> 10 -- On Route    
      AND pallet.PalletPK <> @AlreadyScannedPalletFK    
      -- ** compare Values - Stock, Batch , Status , Qty , Manufacture Date    
      AND palcon.stockitemfk = @ScannedStockItemFK    
      AND palcon.batch = @ScannedBatch    
      AND pallet.palletStatusFK = @ScannedPalletSatusFK    
      AND woms.units = @ScannedQTY    
      AND palcon.DateOFManufacture = @ScannedManufactureDate    
      AND pallet.LocationFK IN (SELECT buildingUnitBayPK from #TmpdriveThroughLocations)) -- drivethrough, pallet is in on of the levels in the column                     
    BEGIN    
       --  **  Check there is another pallet on the pick with the same same Stock, Batch, PalletStatus, Qty, Manufacturedate    
       --  **  that is still in racking , we will swap the scanned pallet for this one     
       SELECT top 1 WorksOrderMovementPK, 4 as ReturnStatus,'' as   ReturnMessage     
       from viewContainerOutPalletList coList    
       INNER JOIN tblPallets pallet on coList.PalletFK = PalletPK    
       INNER JOIN tblWorksOrderMovements woms ON woms.PalletFK = pallet.PalletPK AND woms.ContainerOutLinePalletContentFK = coList.ContainerOutLinePalletContentPK    
       INNER JOIN tblPalletContent palCon ON palCon.PalletFK = pallet.PalletPK    
       INNER JOIN tblStockItems stk ON stockItemPK = palCon.stockItemFK     
       INNER JOIN viewPalletLocations palLoc ON palLoc.palletPk = pallet.palletPK    
       where ContainerOutPK = (SELECT ContainerOutPK FROM #TmpContainerOutFromWOM)    
     AND pallet.LocationTypeFK = 1   -- in racking    
     AND pallet.IsArchived = 0       -- Gone from warehouse    
     and pallet.PalletStatusFK <> 10 -- On Route    
     AND pallet.PalletPK <> @AlreadyScannedPalletFK    
     -- ** compare Values - Stock, Batch , Status , Qty , Manufacture Date    
     AND palcon.stockitemfk = @ScannedStockItemFK    
     AND palcon.batch = @ScannedBatch    
     AND pallet.palletStatusFK = @ScannedPalletSatusFK    
     AND woms.units = @ScannedQTY    
     AND palcon.DateOFManufacture = @ScannedManufactureDate    
     AND pallet.LocationFK IN (SELECT buildingUnitBayPK from #TmpdriveThroughLocations) -- drivethrough, pallet is in on of the levels in the column    
    
    END    
    ELSE    
     SELECT 5 as ReturnStatus ,-1 as WorksOrderMovementPK,'' as   ReturnMessage 
     RETURN    
   END    
    
   -- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end          
   BREAK    
  END TRY    
  BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */    
   DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;    
   SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;    
   SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;    
    
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY     
   BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;    
           
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;    
    
            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID    
                
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;    
                
   IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)    
   BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END    
   ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */    
  END CATCH    
  SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1    
 END    
END

-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Rachael Sherry>
-- Create date: <Create 4th July 2014,,>
-- Description:	<When a Stage 2 machine is scanned - checks if there is pallets in level A in racking
--               This will allow the user to be prompted to select a stage
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spMobileStockOutStageSelection] 
(
	@GoodsOrderNumber int,
    @buildingUnitFK int
)	
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT
 ,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;
	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	DECLARE @var_GoodsOrderNumber int, @var_buildingUnitFK int
	SET @var_GoodsOrderNumber = @GoodsOrderNumber; SET @var_buildingUnitFK = @buildingUnitFK
	SET @ParameterDetails = '@GoodsOrderNumber = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_GoodsOrderNumber AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') 
		+ ',@buildingUnitFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_buildingUnitFK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'')

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    --BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

		SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END


	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY
			
			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start

			--IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#tmpReturn') IS NOT NULL        -- Delete  the temporary table if it already exists
			--	DROP TABLE #tmpReturn

			--create table #tmpReturn( ReturnStatus  int)  -- 1 - Pallets in level A in racking
			--												-- 0 - No Stage Selection Required

			IF EXISTS (	SELECT * from viewContainerOutPalletList vCoPL 
						INNER JOIN viewPalletLocations palLoc ON palLoc.palletpk = vCoPl.palletFK
						WHERE vCoPl.goodsOrderNumber = @var_GoodsOrderNumber
						AND palLoc.BuildingPK IN (select BuildingFk from tblbuildingunits where buildingunitpk = @var_buildingUnitFK)
						AND palLoc.LocationTypeFK = 1
						AND bayLevel = 'A')
			BEGIN
				SELECT 1 as ReturnStatus
				RETURN
			END

			SELECT 0 as ReturnStatus
			Return

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end
						
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END

)

	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT

	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	DECLARE @var_EachBarcode nvarchar(50), @var_PalletContentFK int, @var_WorksOrderMovementPK int, @var_Quantity decimal(18,0)
	SET @var_EachBarcode = trim(@EachBarcode); SET @var_PalletContentFK = @PalletContentFK; SET @var_WorksOrderMovementPK = @WorksOrderMovementPK; SET @var_Quantity = @Quantity
	SET @ParameterDetails = '@EachBarcode = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_EachBarcode AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@PalletContentFK = '

		BEGIN TRY

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start

			update tblPalletContent WITH (ROWLOCK) 
			SET AvailableUnits=(SELECT AvailableUnits - @var_Quantity from tblpalletcontent where Barcode=@var_EachBarcode),AvailableEaches=0 
			WHERE @var_EachBarcode <> '' and Barcode = @var_EachBarcode

			update tblWorksOrderMovements WITH (ROWLOCK)

			BREAK
		END TRY

		SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END


	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY
			IF XACT_STATE() = 0 AND @@TRANCOUNT < 1 BEGIN TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start

			update tblWorksOrderMovements WITH (ROWLOCK)
			set 
				DestinationBayPosition=@var_BayPosition,
				destinationFK= @var_LocationFK,
				DestinationPalletStart=@var_PalletStart,
				DestinationPalletEnd=@var_PalletEnd
			where 
				WorksOrderMovementPk =  @var_WorksOrderMovementPk   

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end

			BEGIN TRY IF XACT_STATE() = 1 AND @@TRANCOUNT = 1 AND @OpeningTranCount < 1 COMMIT TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH
			
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END
GO

    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)      
    --BEGIN      
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC       
      
  SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)      
      
        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)      
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK      
      
        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()      
    --END      
      
 SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);      
 SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails      
 ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;      
 INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()      
      
 WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3      
 BEGIN       
  BEGIN TRY

    DROP TABLE #TmpMovement      
   SELECT * INTO #TmpMovement FROM tblworksordermovements WHERE WorksOrderMovementpk = @var_WorksOrderMovementPK

    @sourcePalletEnd = PalletEnd,      
    @PalletPK = palletPK,      
    @ContainerOutLinePalletContentFK = ContainerOutLinePalletContentFK,

    @WorksOrderStatusFK = woms.WorksOrderStatusFK,      
    @MovementDescription = MovementDescription      
   from       
    #TmpMovement woms      
   inner join tblworksorders       
    on worksorderpk = worksorderfk       
   --inner join tblstockorders       
   -- on fk = stockorderpk       
   inner join tblpallets       
    on palletpk = palletfk       
   where       
    WorksOrderMovementpk = @var_WorksOrderMovementPK      
             
    --from tblpallets where palletpk = (SELECT palletfk from tblWorksOrderMovements where WorksOrderMovementPK=@var_WorksOrderMovementPK)      
   IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#tmpReturn') IS NOT NULL      
    DROP TABLE #tmpReturn      
      
   create table #tmpReturn(ReturnStatus int)      
         
   --Jamie : dont scan splits, so skip this         
   -- If moving a pallet out of racking , record its location      
   --if (@SourceLocationTypeFK = 1 AND @var_DestinationTypeFK <> 1)      
   -- EXEC [dbo].[spMobileSplitPalletRecordLocation] @PalletPK, @var_DestinationTypeFK, @var_UserPK      
      
   IF(@var_DestinationTypeFK = 8)/*Floor-*/      
   BEGIN             
    IF(@SourceLocationTypeFK in (1,3,6,8)/*Racking, Sample*/)       
    BEGIN      
     DECLARE @FloorLocationPK int      
     DECLARE @FloorBuildingUnitFK int      
      
     SELECT       
      @FloorLocationName = BuildingUnit + ' ' + FloorLocation ,      
      @FloorLocationPK = FloorLocationPK,      
      @FloorBuildingUnitFK = BuildingUnitFK      
     from       
      tblFloorLocations flr      
     INNER JOIN tblBuildingUnits bus ON bus.buildingUnitPK = flr.buildingUnitFK       
     WHERE       
      barcode = @var_DestinationBarcode      
                    
     if (@SourceLocationTypeFK = 8 and  @var_DestinationTypeFK = 8 and @SourceLocationFK = @FloorLocationPK)      
     BEGIN      
      SELECT 0 as returnStatus,'Pallet is Already in this location' as ReturnMessage      
      GOTO EXIT_PROC           
     END      
           
     IF XACT_STATE() = 0 AND @@TRANCOUNT < 1 BEGIN TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName      
      
     -- Make a copy of the current works order movement, change its destination to the set down and complete it      
     INSERT into tblworksordermovements       
     SELECT       
      WorksOrderFK,1,PalletFK,PalletContentFK,ContainerOutLinePalletContentFK,      
      EntirePallet,Eaches,Units,SourceLocationTypeFK,SourceLocationFK,SourceBayPosition,SourceStackPosition,8,

      ('Hand Held - ' + RTRIM(SUBSTRING(MovementDescription, 0, CHARINDEX('-',MovementDescription))) + ' - TO - ' + @FloorLocationName),

     Set @NewWorksOrderMovementPK = scope_identity()       
      
   -- reposition the positions in the cells either for drive through or conventional      
 -- and complete the works order      
     insert into #tmpReturn       
     EXEC [dbo].[spWorksOrderMovementStatusChange] @WorksOrderMovementPK = @NewWorksOrderMovementPK,@worksOrderStatusFK = 3, @currentUserFK = @var_UserPK, @HandheldDeviceFK = @HandheldDeviceFK2 , @WarehouseMachineFK = @WarehouseMachineFK2--, @splitPalletNow = @splitPalletNow2    
      
     IF XACT_STATE() = 0 AND @@TRANCOUNT < 1 BEGIN TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName                              
      
     -- change the original works order source location to the floor location      
     update tblWorksorderMovements WITH (ROWLOCK)       
     set      
      SourceBayPosition = -1 ,      
      SourceLocationTypeFK =8,      
      SourceLocationFK = @FloorLocationPK,--(select floorLocationPK from tblFloorLocations where barcode=@var_DestinationBarcode ),      
      MovementDescription =  RTRIM(SUBSTRING(MovementDescription, 0,CHARINDEX(' FROM ',MovementDescription)))       
            + ' FROM ' + @FloorLocationName + ' - '        
            + LTRIM(SUBSTRING(MovementDescription, CHARINDEX(' TO ',MovementDescription),LEN(MovementDescription)))      
     where

     Select 1 as ReturnStatus  ,'' as ReturnMessage      
      
     IF XACT_STATE() = 0 AND @@TRANCOUNT < 1 BEGIN TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName      
      
     -- Update tblPallets      
     UPDATE tblPallets WITH (ROWLOCK)      
     SET       
      buildingUnitFK = @FloorBuildingUnitFK,-- (Select buildingUnitFK from tblFloorLocations WHERE barcode = @var_DestinationBarcode),      
      locationtypeFK = 8,      
      locationFK = @FloorLocationPK,--(select FloorLocationPK from tblFloorLocations where barcode = @var_DestinationBarcode),      
      BayPosition = -1,      
      palletstart = -1,      
      PalletEnd = -1,

      UpdatedDate = dbo.GetBSTDate()      
     where

     GOTO EXIT_PROC       
    END      
    ELSE IF @SourceLocationTypeFK = 2

     SELECT 0 as returnStatus,'Invalid Move - Scan to Container' as ReturnMessage      
     GOTO EXIT_PROC      
    END      
          
    Select @returnStatus = 2      
      
    select 0 as ReturnStatus,'' as ReturnMessage      
      
    GOTO EXIT_PROC       
   END       
   ELSE IF(@var_DestinationTypeFK =3)/*STAS-*/      
   BEGIN      
    IF(@SourceLocationTypeFK in (1,3,6,8)/*Racking, Sample , Floor Locations*/)       
    BEGIN                    
     DECLARE @setdownAreaPK int                    
     DECLARE @setdownAreaBuildingUnitFK int      
      
     SELECT       
      @SetDownName = BuildingUnit + ' ' + SetDownArea ,      
      @setdownAreaPK = SetDownAreaPK,      
      @setdownAreaBuildingUnitFK = sda.BuildingUnitFK

     INNER JOIN tblBuildingUnits bus ON bus.buildingUnitPK = sda.buildingUnitFK       
     WHERE       
      barcode = @var_DestinationBarcode             
      
     -- Cannot put pallet into its current location       
     if (@SourceLocationTypeFK = 3 and @DestinationTypeFK = 3 and @SourceLocationFK = @setdownAreaPK)      
     BEGIN      
      SELECT 0 as returnStatus,'Pallet is Already in this location' as ReturnMessage      
      GOTO EXIT_PROC           
     END      
      
     IF XACT_STATE() = 0 AND @@TRANCOUNT < 1 BEGIN TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName      
      
     -- Make a copy of the current works order movement, change its destination to the set down and complete it      
     INSERT into tblworksordermovements       
     SELECT       
      WorksOrderFK,1,PalletFK,PalletContentFK,ContainerOutLinePalletContentFK,      
      EntirePallet,Eaches,Units,SourceLocationTypeFK,SourceLocationFK,SourceBayPosition,SourceStackPosition,3,      
      @setdownAreaPK,--(select setdownareapk from tblSetDownAreas where barcode=@var_DestinationBarcode ),      
      DestinationBayPosition,DestinationStackPosition, DestinationPalletStart,DestinationPalletEnd,('Hand Held - '       
      + RTRIM(SUBSTRING(MovementDescription, 0, CHARINDEX('- T',MovementDescription))) + ' - TO - ' + @SetDownName),IsArchived,InsertedBy,insertedDate,      
      @var_UserPK,dbo.GetBSTDate(), ResponsibleUserFK, @HandheldDeviceFK2 , @WarehouseMachineFK2      
     from       
      #TmpMovement       
     where       
      WorksOrderMovementPK=@var_WorksOrderMovementPK      
      
     Set @NewWorksOrderMovementPK = scope_identity()       
      
     -- reposition the positions in the cells either for drive through or conventional      
     -- and complete the works order

     IF XACT_STATE() = 0 AND @@TRANCOUNT < 1 BEGIN TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName

     set      
      SourceBayPosition = -1 ,      
      SourceLocationTypeFK =3,      
      SourceLocationFK = @setdownAreaPK,-- (select setdownAreaPK from tblSetDownAreas where barcode=@var_DestinationBarcode ),

            + ' FROM ' + @SetDownName + ' - '        
            + LTRIM(SUBSTRING(MovementDescription, CHARINDEX(' TO ',MovementDescription),LEN(MovementDescription)))

      WorksOrderMovementPK=@var_WorksOrderMovementPK      
      
     Select 1 as ReturnStatus  ,'' as ReturnMessage     
      
     IF XACT_STATE() = 0 AND @@TRANCOUNT < 1 BEGIN TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName

     UPDATE tblPallets WITH (ROWLOCK)

      buildingUnitFK = @setdownAreaBuildingUnitFK,-- (Select buildingUnitFK from tblSetDownAreas WHERE barcode= @var_DestinationBarcode),      
      locationtypeFK = 3,

       BayPosition = -1,      
      palletstart = -1,      
      PalletEnd = -1,      
      StackPosition = 0,

   ELSE IF(@var_DestinationTypeFK =2)/*STAL-*/

    -- Cannot put pallet into its current location

   END

    IF (@SourceLocationTypeFK = 2)

     select @SourceLocationName = Buildingunit + ' - ' + loadingBay

     where loadingbaypk = @sourcelocationfk                 
      
     IF XACT_STATE() = 0 AND @@TRANCOUNT < 1 BEGIN TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName      
      
     -- Create the new movement      
     INSERT into tblworksordermovements       
     SELECT

      DestinationBayPosition,DestinationStackPosition, DestinationPalletStart,DestinationPalletEnd,

      IsArchived,InsertedBy,insertedDate,      
      @var_UserPK,dbo.GetBSTDate(), ResponsibleUserFK, @HandheldDeviceFK2 , @WarehouseMachineFK      
     from

     Set @var_WorksOrderMovementPK = scope_identity()       
    END      
    ELSE      
    BEGIN      
     IF XACT_STATE() = 0 AND @@TRANCOUNT < 1 BEGIN TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName      
      
     UPDATE tblWorksOrderMovements WITH (ROWLOCK)       
     SET       
      DestinationLocationTypeFK = @var_DestinationTypeFK,      
      DestinationFK = @DestinationLocationFK,-- (SELECT loadingBayPK from tblLoadingBays WHERE Barcode = @var_DestinationBarcode),      
      worksOrderStatusFK = 1,      
      UpdatedBy = @var_UserPK,      
      UpdatedDate = dbo.GetBSTDate(),      
     -- movementDescription = ('Hand Held - ' + SUBSTRING(@MovementDescription, 1, case when CHARINDEX('TO ', @MovementDescription) = 0 then LEN(@MovementDescription) else CHARINDEX('TO ', @MovementDescription)  - 1 end) + 'TO - ' + @DestinationLocationName)  ,    
   movementDescription = ('Hand Held - ' + SUBSTRING(@MovementDescription, 1,  CHARINDEX('TO ', @MovementDescription)  - 1 ) + 'TO - ' + @DestinationLocationName)  ,    
    
  WarehouseMachineFK = @WarehouseMachineFK2,    
   HandheldDeviceFK = @HandheldDeviceFK2    
     WHERE       
      WorksOrderMovementPK = @var_WorksOrderMovementPK      
    END      
      
    insert into #tmpReturn       
    EXEC [dbo].[spWorksOrderMovementStatusChange] @WorksOrderMovementPK = @var_WorksOrderMovementPK,@worksOrderStatusFK = 3,@currentUserFK = @var_UserPK     , @HandheldDeviceFK = @HandheldDeviceFK2 , @WarehouseMachineFK = @WarehouseMachineFK2--, @splitPalletNow = @splitPalletNow2         
       
    IF XACT_STATE() = 0 AND @@TRANCOUNT < 1 BEGIN TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName      
      
    -- Update tblPallets      
    UPDATE tblPallets WITH (ROWLOCK)      
    SET       
     buildingUnitFK = @LoadingBayBuildingUnitFK,-- (select buildingUnitFK from tblLoadingBays where barcode=@var_DestinationBarcode ),      
     locationtypeFK = 2,      
     locationFK = @DestinationLocationFK,-- (select LoadingBayPK from tblLoadingBays where barcode=@var_DestinationBarcode ),      
     BayPosition = -1,      
     palletstart = -1,      
     PalletEnd = -1,      
     StackPosition = 0,      
     UpdatedBy = @var_UserPK,      
     UpdatedDate = dbo.GetBSTDate()      
    where       
     palletpk = @PalletPK      
      
    Select 1 as ReturnStatus,'' as ReturnMessage         
      
    GOTO EXIT_PROC      
   END       
   ELSE IF(@var_DestinationTypeFK = 4)/*STACO-*/      
   BEGIN      
    -- Check if pallet Status is allowed to be moved      
    DECLARE @palletStatusFK int      
    DECLARE @CustomerFK int      
    DECLARE @DivisionFK int      
 DECLARE @StockItemFK int       
    DECLARE @PalletStatusName nvarchar(200)      
      
    SELECT       
     @palletStatusFK = palletStatusFK ,      
     @StockItemFK = StockItemPk,      
     @DivisionFK = DivisionFK,      
     @CustomerFK = div.CustomerFK,      
     @PalletStatusName = PalletStatus      
    from       
     #TmpMovement       
    INNER JOIN tblPallets       
     ON palletpk = palletFK       
    INNER JOIN appPalletStatus       
     ON palletStatusPK= palletStatusFK      
    INNER JOIN tblPalletContent palCon       
     on palCon.palletFK = palletPK      
    INNER JOIN tblStockItems       
     ON stockITemFK = StockITemPK      
    INNER JOIN tblDivisions div       
     ON divisionFK = divisionPK      
    WHERE       
     worksOrderMovementPK = @var_WorksOrderMovementPK      
      
    -- Check if this Pallet Status is allowed to be picked      
    IF EXISTS (        
SELECT palletStatusfk from tblPalletStatusNotAllowedOut WHERE palletstatusFK = @palletStatusFK      
       AND (customerFK = @CustomerFK OR DivisionFK = @DivisionFK OR @stockItemFK = StockItemFK)      
      )      
    BEGIN      
     SELECT 2 as returnStatus,'Pallet Status ' + @PalletStatusName + ' Not Allowed On Pick. Contact Stock Controller' as returnMessage      
     GOTO EXIT_PROC            
    END           
      
    --Moving to container      
    -- Move pallet to loading bay if not already there      
    IF (@WorksOrderStatusFK <> 3)      
    BEGIN      
     IF XACT_STATE() = 0 AND @@TRANCOUNT < 1 BEGIN TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName      
     
	 -- Add HandHeld message at the beginning of the Movement description       
     Update tblWorksOrderMovements WITH (ROWLOCK)       
     set MovementDescription = 'Hand Held - '  + @MovementDescription, handhelddevicefk = @HandheldDeviceFK2 , WarehouseMachineFK = @WarehouseMachineFK2          
     where WorksOrderMovementPK = @WorksOrderMovementPK      
      
     -- Now complete the movement      
     INSERT INTO #tmpReturn       
     EXEC [dbo].[spWorksOrderMovementStatusChange] @WorksOrderMovementPK = @var_WorksOrderMovementPK,@worksOrderStatusFK = 3,@currentUserFK = @var_UserPK    , @HandheldDeviceFK = @HandheldDeviceFK2 , @WarehouseMachineFK = @WarehouseMachineFK2    --   , @splitPalletNow = @splitPalletNow2    
           
     SELECT @returnStatus = ReturnStatus From #tmpReturn       
    END       
           
    IF (@returnStatus <> 1)       
     GOTO EXIT_PROC      
    --END       
     -- Change tblContainerOutLinesPalletContent Loaded to true      
    -- When the entire pallet is being moved           
      
    DECLARE @EntirePallet bit      
      
    SELECT @EntirePallet = EntirePallet FROM #TmpMovement WHERE WorksOrderMovementPK = @var_WorksOrderMovementPK           
      
    if (@EntirePallet = 1)      
    BEGIN            
     IF XACT_STATE() = 0 AND @@TRANCOUNT < 1 BEGIN TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName      
      
     --jamie: comented out,  exec spPalletsSetLoaded does this again anyway      
     -- check that the pallet is not nested (only one palletcontent record)      
     -- If there is only one ContainerOutLinePalletContent record then it is not nested      
     --UPDATE tblContainerOutLinePalletContent WITH (ROWLOCK)      
     --SET       
     -- Loaded  = 1,      
     -- updatedBy = @var_UserPK,      
     -- updatedDate = dbo.GetBSTDate()      
     --WHERE       
     -- PalletFK = @PalletPK      
     -- AND ContainerOutLinePalletContentPK in (      
     --  select containeroutlinepalletcontentpk       
     --  from viewContainerOutPalletList vcpl      
     --  where vcpl.ContainerOutPK = @ContainerOutFK       
     --  AND vcpl.PalletFK = @PalletPk      
     -- )      
     ---- Create loaded record      
     DECLARE @MovmementXML xml      
      
     set @MovmementXML = '<Movements><Movement><WorksOrderMovementPK>' + convert (nvarchar(100),@var_WorksOrderMovementPK) + '</WorksOrderMovementPK></Movement></Movements>'      
      
     exec spPalletsSetLoaded @MovmementXML,@var_UserPK,1      
    END      
    ELSE       
    BEGIN      
     IF XACT_STATE() = 0 AND @@TRANCOUNT < 1 BEGIN TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName      
      
     -- When taking only an each      
     UPDATE tblContainerOutLinePalletContent WITH (ROWLOCK)         
     SET       
      Loaded  = 1,      
      updatedBy = @var_UserPK,      
      updatedDate = dbo.GetBSTDate()      
     WHERE        
      ContainerOutLinePalletContentPK = @ContainerOutLinePalletContentFK      
    END      
      
    IF XACT_STATE() = 0 AND @@TRANCOUNT < 1 BEGIN TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName      
      
    -- Complete any open movements on this pick for this pallet      
    Update tblWorksOrderMovements WITH (ROWLOCK)      
    set       
     WorksOrderStatusFK = 3      
    where       
     ContainerOutLinePalletContentFK = @ContainerOutLinePalletContentFK      
     and worksorderstatusfk in (1,2)        
        
    Select 1 as ReturnStatus, '' as ReturnMessage          
   END      
      
EXIT_PROC:      
      
   BEGIN TRY IF XACT_STATE() = 1 AND @@TRANCOUNT = 1 AND @OpeningTranCount < 1 COMMIT TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH      
       
   -- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end      
         
   BREAK      
  END TRY      
  BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */      
   DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;      
      
   SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;      
   SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;      
      
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY       
   BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;      
             
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;      
      
            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID      
                  
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;      
                  
   IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)      
   BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END      
   ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */      
  END CATCH      
  SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1      
 END      
END
GO

     -- movementDescription = ('Hand Held - ' + SUBSTRING(@MovementDescription, 1, case when CHARINDEX('TO ', @MovementDescription) = 0 then LEN(@MovementDescription) else CHARINDEX('TO ', @MovementDescription)  - 1 end) + 'TO - ' + @DestinationLocationName)  ,    
   movementDescription = ('Hand Held - ' + SUBSTRING(@MovementDescription, 1,  CHARINDEX('TO ', @MovementDescription)  - 1 ) + 'TO - ' + @DestinationLocationName)  ,    
    
  WarehouseMachineFK = @WarehouseMachineFK2,

    -- Check if pallet Status is allowed to be moved      
    DECLARE @palletStatusFK int

    DECLARE @DivisionFK int      
 DECLARE @StockItemFK int       
    DECLARE @PalletStatusName nvarchar(200)

SELECT palletStatusfk from tblPalletStatusNotAllowedOut WHERE palletstatusFK = @palletStatusFK

    -- Move pallet to loading bay if not already there      
    IF (@WorksOrderStatusFK <> 3)      
    BEGIN      
     IF XACT_STATE() = 0 AND @@TRANCOUNT < 1 BEGIN TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName      
      select top 1 * from tblWorksOrderMovements
        -- Add HandHeld message at the beginning of the Movement description       
     Update tblWorksOrderMovements WITH (ROWLOCK)       
     set MovementDescription = 'Hand Held - '  + @MovementDescription, handhelddevicefk = @HandheldDeviceFK2 , WarehouseMachineFK = @WarehouseMachineFK2          
     where WorksOrderMovementPK = @WorksOrderMovementPK      
      
     -- Now complete the movement      
     INSERT INTO #tmpReturn       
     EXEC [dbo].[spWorksOrderMovementStatusChange] @WorksOrderMovementPK = @var_WorksOrderMovementPK,@worksOrderStatusFK = 3,@currentUserFK = @var_UserPK    , @HandheldDeviceFK = @HandheldDeviceFK2 , @WarehouseMachineFK = @WarehouseMachineFK2    --   , @splitPalletNow = @splitPalletNow2    
           
     SELECT @returnStatus = ReturnStatus From #tmpReturn       
    END       
           
    IF (@returnStatus <> 1)       
     GOTO EXIT_PROC      
    --END       
     -- Change tblContainerOutLinesPalletContent Loaded to true      
    -- When the entire pallet is being moved           
      
    DECLARE @EntirePallet bit      
      
    SELECT @EntirePallet = EntirePallet FROM #TmpMovement WHERE WorksOrderMovementPK = @var_WorksOrderMovementPK           
      
    if (@EntirePallet = 1)      
    BEGIN            
     IF XACT_STATE() = 0 AND @@TRANCOUNT < 1 BEGIN TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName      
      
     --jamie: comented out,  exec spPalletsSetLoaded does this again anyway      
     -- check that the pallet is not nested (only one palletcontent record)      
     -- If there is only one ContainerOutLinePalletContent record then it is not nested      
     --UPDATE tblContainerOutLinePalletContent WITH (ROWLOCK)      
     --SET       
     -- Loaded  = 1,      
     -- updatedBy = @var_UserPK,      
     -- updatedDate = dbo.GetBSTDate()      
     --WHERE       
     -- PalletFK = @PalletPK      
     -- AND ContainerOutLinePalletContentPK in (      
     --  select containeroutlinepalletcontentpk       
     --  from viewContainerOutPalletList vcpl      
     --  where vcpl.ContainerOutPK = @ContainerOutFK       
     --  AND vcpl.PalletFK = @PalletPk      
     -- )      
     ---- Create loaded record      
     DECLARE @MovmementXML xml      
      
     set @MovmementXML = '<Movements><Movement><WorksOrderMovementPK>' + convert (nvarchar(100),@var_WorksOrderMovementPK) + '</WorksOrderMovementPK></Movement></Movements>'      
      
     exec spPalletsSetLoaded @MovmementXML,@var_UserPK,1      
    END      
    ELSE       
    BEGIN      
     IF XACT_STATE() = 0 AND @@TRANCOUNT < 1 BEGIN TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName      
      
     -- When taking only an each      
     UPDATE tblContainerOutLinePalletContent WITH (ROWLOCK)         
     SET       
      Loaded  = 1,      
      updatedBy = @var_UserPK,      
      updatedDate = dbo.GetBSTDate()      
     WHERE        
      ContainerOutLinePalletContentPK = @ContainerOutLinePalletContentFK      
    END      
      
    IF XACT_STATE() = 0 AND @@TRANCOUNT < 1 BEGIN TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName      
      
    -- Complete any open movements on this pick for this pallet      
    Update tblWorksOrderMovements WITH (ROWLOCK)      
    set       
     WorksOrderStatusFK = 3      
    where       
     ContainerOutLinePalletContentFK = @ContainerOutLinePalletContentFK      
     and worksorderstatusfk in (1,2)        
        
    Select 1 as ReturnStatus, '' as ReturnMessage          
   END      
      
EXIT_PROC:      
      
   BEGIN TRY IF XACT_STATE() = 1 AND @@TRANCOUNT = 1 AND @OpeningTranCount < 1 COMMIT TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH      
       
   -- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end      
         
   BREAK      
  END TRY      
  BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */      
   DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;      
      
   SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;      
   SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;      
      
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY       
   BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;      
             
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;      
      
            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID      
                  
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;      
                  
   IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)      
   BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END      
   ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */      
  END CATCH      
  SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1      
 END      
END

 ,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;

	DECLARE @var_worksOrderPK int
	SET @var_worksOrderPK = @worksOrderPK

        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END


	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY
			IF XACT_STATE() = 0 AND @@TRANCOUNT < 1 BEGIN TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start

			update tblWorksOrders WITH (ROWLOCK) SET WorksOrderStatusFK =3
			where WorksOrderPK = @var_worksOrderPK

			select 1 as returnstatus

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end

			BEGIN TRY IF XACT_STATE() = 1 AND @@TRANCOUNT = 1 AND @OpeningTranCount < 1 COMMIT TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH
			
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END

-- =============================================
-- Author:        <Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:   <Description,,>
-- Return Status   0 = success
--				   1 = error
--				   2 = wrong cell scanned
--				   3 = Already complete
--				   4 = Unknown barcode 
--				   5 = Movement does  not exist
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spMobileWorksOrderMovementComplete]
(
    @worksOrderMovementFK int,
    @locationBarcode nvarchar(200),
    @userFK int,
	@NoSelectPurelyReturns int = 0

AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT
	,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;
	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	DECLARE @worksOrderMovementFK2 int,
    @locationBarcode2 nvarchar(200),
	@userFK2 int,
	@NoSelectPurelyReturns2 int

	SET @worksOrderMovementFK2 = @worksOrderMovementFK; SET @locationBarcode2 = @locationBarcode; SET @userFK2 = @userFK; SET @NoSelectPurelyReturns2 = @NoSelectPurelyReturns

		+ ',@userFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@userFK2 AS NVARCHAR(100)),'0') + ',@NoSelectPurelyReturns = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@NoSelectPurelyReturns2 AS NVARCHAR(100)),'0')

         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    --BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY
			
			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start

			  Declare @ret int --return 0 is all ok, 1 for problem, 2 wrong cell 
				-- *** CHANGE return 1 is all ok, 0 for problem, 2 wrong cell 
			  DECLARE @RetSelect int

			  Declare @setDownPrefix nvarchar(50)
			  DECLARE @LoadingBayPrefix nvarchar (50)    -- can scan loading bays as well
			  DECLARE @SampleLocationPrefix nvarchar(50)

			  Declare @locationFK int

			  DECLARE @errorMessage nvarchar(500)

				  if (@worksOrderMovementFK2 is null or @worksOrderMovementFK2  < 1 or @locationBarcode2 is null or @locationBarcode2 = '' or @userFK2 < 1 or @userFK2  is null)
				  BEGIN
					IF (@NoSelectPurelyReturns2 = 0)
					BEGIN
						SELECT 1 AS ReturnStatus
						RETURN
					END
					ELSE
						RETURN 1
				  END

				  --Check if the movement exists at all
				  IF(NOT EXISTS(Select * from tblWorksOrderMovements where WorksOrderMovementPK = @worksOrderMovementFK2)) 
				  BEGIN
					--	Print 'Does not exist'
					IF (@NoSelectPurelyReturns2 = 0)
					BEGIN
						SELECT 5 AS ReturnStatus
						RETURN
					END
					ELSE
						RETURN 5
				  END
				  
				  --Check if the movement is complete, if so, return as we have business here
				  IF(EXISTS(Select * from tblWorksOrderMovements where WorksOrderMovementPK = @worksOrderMovementFK2 AND WorksOrderStatusFK in (3,4/*Complete or Cancelled*/))) 
				  BEGIN
					IF (@NoSelectPurelyReturns2 = 0) 
					BEGIN
						SELECT 3 AS ReturnStatus/*Signifies a movement is complete */
						RETURN
					END
					ELSE
						RETURN 3   
				END
      
				print @locationBarcode2

				Select @setDownPrefix = SetDownAreaBarcodePrefix, 
						@cellPrefix = BuildingUnitCellBarcodePrefix,
						@loadingbayprefix = LoadingBayBarcodePrefix,
						@SampleLocationPrefix = SampleLocationBarcodePrefix,
						@FloorLocationPrefix = FloorLocationBarcodePrefix
				From appSystem 
				where SystemPK = 1
       
				-- Check if a SetDown Area has been scanned
				IF (@setDownPrefix = SUBSTRING(@locationBarcode2, 1, len(@setDownPrefix)) OR
				@loadingBayPrefix = SUBSTRING(@locationBarcode2, 1, len(@loadingbayPrefix))OR
				@SampleLocationPrefix = SUBSTRING(@locationBarcode2, 1, len(@SampleLocationPrefix))OR
				@FloorLocationPrefix = SUBSTRING(@locationBarcode2, 1, len(@FloorLocationPrefix)) )
				BEGIN
					--  print 'setdown area'
					if (@setDownPrefix = SUBSTRING(@locationBarcode2, 1, len(@setDownPrefix)))
					BEGIN
					--      print 'setdown'
						Select @locationFK = SetDownAreaPK ,@BuildingUnitFK = BuildingUnitFK, @locationTypeFK = 3 from tblSetDownAreas where Barcode = @locationBarcode2
						print @locationFK
					END
					ELSE IF (@SampleLocationPrefix = SUBSTRING(@locationBarcode2, 1, len(@SampleLocationPrefix)))
					BEGIN
					--      print 'sample Location'
						Select @locationFK = SampleLocationPK ,@BuildingUnitFK = BuildingUnitFK, @locationTypeFK = 6 from tblSampleLocations where Barcode = @locationBarcode2
						print @locationFK
					END
					ELSE IF (@FloorLocationPrefix = SUBSTRING(@locationBarcode2, 1, len(@FloorLocationPrefix)))
					BEGIN
					--      print 'sample Location'
						Select @locationFK = FloorLocationPK ,@BuildingUnitFK = BuildingUnitFK, @locationTypeFK = 8 from tblFloorLocations where Barcode = @locationBarcode2
						print @locationFK

						  if (@LocationFK is null or @locationFK < 1)

							IF (@NoSelectPurelyReturns2 = 0) 
							BEGIN
								SELECT 1 AS ReturnStatus
								RETURN
							END
							ELSE
								RETURN 1 
						  END

						  if (@LocationTypeFK is null or @locationTypeFK < 1) 
						  BEGIN
							IF (@NoSelectPurelyReturns2 = 0) 
							BEGIN
								SELECT 1 AS ReturnStatus
								RETURN
							END
							ELSE
								RETURN 1    
						  END
						
						-- Always attempt to begin a transaction before updating, inserting or deleting records in a permanent table
						IF XACT_STATE() = 0 AND @@TRANCOUNT < 1 BEGIN TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName

						 update tblWorksOrderMovements WITH (ROWLOCK)
						  Set SourceLocationTypeFK = @locationTypeFK, /*SetdownArea*/
							  SourceLocationFK = @locationFK,
							  UpdatedBy = @userFK2,
							  UpdatedDate = dbo.GetBSTDate()
						 where WorksOrderMovementPK = @worksOrderMovementFK2
					   -- print 'in here 2'

						print 'The final straw'
						print @BuildingUnitFK

						--print 'in here 3'
						EXEC [dbo].[spWorksOrderMovementStatusChange]
							@worksOrderMovementPK = @worksOrderMovementFK2,
							@worksOrderStatusFK = 3,
							@currentUserFK = @userFK2

						-- Always attempt to begin a transaction before updating, inserting or deleting records in a permanent table
						IF XACT_STATE() = 0 AND @@TRANCOUNT < 1 BEGIN TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName

						--Print 'cell movement'
						update tblPallets WITH (ROWLOCK)
						Set LocationTypeFK = @locationTypeFK, /*Set Down Area*/
							LocationFK = @locationFK,
							UpdatedBy = @userFK2,
							UpdatedDate = dbo.GetBSTDate(),
							BuildingUnitFK = @BuildingUnitFK
						Where PalletPK = (Select PalletFK from tblWorksOrderMovements where WorksOrderMovementPK = @worksOrderMovementFK2)
						
						Select 1 as ReturnStatus

						-- Always attempt to commit before returning
						BEGIN TRY IF XACT_STATE() = 1 AND @@TRANCOUNT = 1 AND @OpeningTranCount < 1 COMMIT TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH

						return
					END 
					ELSE IF (@cellPrefix = SUBSTRING(@locationBarcode2, 1, len(@cellPrefix)))
					BEGIN
						-- Check that the right Barcode has been scanned
						-- Retrieve RackingTypeFK - 1 for conventional, 2 - DriveThrough
						EXEC spMobileGetRackingTypeFK @worksOrderMovementFK2, @RackingTypeFK OUTPUT   -- RS 19/2/2014

						-- If conventional Racking, then check that the barcode scanned is the same as the barcode assigned in BuildingUnitBays
						IF @RackingTypeFK <> 2

							BEGIN

								BEGIN TRY IF XACT_STATE() = 1 AND @@TRANCOUNT = 1 AND @OpeningTranCount < 1 COMMIT TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH

								-- Wrong Cell has been scanned
								/*Signifies the wrong cell has been scanned*/
								IF (@NoSelectPurelyReturns2 = 0) 
								BEGIN

									RETURN
								END
								ELSE
									RETURN 2     
							END
						END 
						ELSE
						BEGIN
							-- Drive Through racking is used
							-- The barcode for the first level of the column is scanned
							-- check that the pallet is destination for that column
							-- RS 19/2/2014
							if not exists (

								from tblBuildingUnitBays buBays

																from tblWorksOrderMovements woms left outer join tblBuildingUnitBays buBays 
																on buBays.BuildingUnitBayPK = woms.DestinationFK 
																where woms.WorksOrderMovementPK = @worksOrderMovementFK2)  )

								-- Always attempt to commit before returning
								BEGIN TRY IF XACT_STATE() = 1 AND @@TRANCOUNT = 1 AND @OpeningTranCount < 1 COMMIT TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH

								-- Wrong Column has been scanned

								IF (@NoSelectPurelyReturns2 = 0) 
								BEGIN
									SELECT 4 AS ReturnStatus
									RETURN
								END
								ELSE
									RETURN 4    
							END  -- end of wrong row
						END  -- End of drive through racking

						DECLARE     @return_value int
						--print 'at the end'

						print 'calling here'

						EXEC [dbo].[spWorksOrderMovementStatusChange]
							@worksOrderMovementPK = @worksOrderMovementFK2,
							@worksOrderStatusFK = 3,
							@currentUserFK = @userFK2

						--Print 'cell movement'
						Select 1 as ReturnStatus 

						-- Always attempt to commit before returning
						BEGIN TRY IF XACT_STATE() = 1 AND @@TRANCOUNT = 1 AND @OpeningTranCount < 1 COMMIT TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH

						RETURN
				  END 
				  ELSE 
				  BEGIN
						-- Always attempt to commit before returning
						BEGIN TRY IF XACT_STATE() = 1 AND @@TRANCOUNT = 1 AND @OpeningTranCount < 1 COMMIT TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH

						/*Unknown barcode*/
						--Print 'Unknown barcode'
						IF (@NoSelectPurelyReturns2 = 0) 
						BEGIN
							SELECT 4 AS ReturnStatus
							RETURN
						END
						ELSE
							RETURN 4 
				  END
			END TRY
			BEGIN CATCH
				-- Always attempt to commit before returning
				BEGIN TRY IF XACT_STATE() = 1 AND @@TRANCOUNT = 1 AND @OpeningTranCount < 1 COMMIT TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH

				IF (@NoSelectPurelyReturns2 = 0) 
				BEGIN
					SELECT 4 AS ReturnStatus
					RETURN
				END
				ELSE
					RETURN 4   
			END CATCH 

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end
			
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY

 @ContainerOutFK int,

)

  + ISNULL(CAST(@var_BuildingUnitFK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@UserFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_UserFK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'')
