   into tmpcopallets    
   from tblpallets p    
   inner join #tmpcopallets colpc on p.palletpk = colpc.palletfk    
   WHERE LocationTypeFK  = 1 AND buildingUnitFK = @var_BuildingUnitFK    
    
      
   --SELECT * FROM #tmpWorksOrders      
      
   -- check if StockOrders are assigned to the ContainerOut      
   if (Not Exists (SELECT stockOrderPk FROM #tmpStockOrders))      
   BEGIN      
  SELECT 1 as returnstatus, 'Stock orders not assigned' AS returnMessage;      
  RETURN;      
   END      
   else      
   BEGIN      
    -- Check if Works Order Movements have been assigned to the Stock      
  if (NOT EXISTS(SELECT WorksOrderMovementPK FROM #tmpcomovements))      
  BEGIN         
    SELECT 2 as returnStatus, 'Movements have not been assigned' AS returnMessage;      
    RETURN;      
  END      
  -- check if there are any rows left on the pick      
  ELSE  if exists (select palletPK FROM tmpcopallets )      
  BEGIN      
  --     SELECT * FROM (    
  -- SELECT tBuR.buildingunitfk,      
  --  CASE when tBuR.Translate = 1 then tBuR.TranslatedRow when tBuR.Translate = 0 then tBuR.Row end as 'Row' ,      
  --  tBud.BuildingUnit ,      
  --  3 as returnStatus      
  -- FROM tmpcopallets tPAl       
  -- INNER JOIN tblBuildingUnitBays tBub ON tBub.BuildingUnitBayPK = tPAl.LocationFK      
  -- INNER JOIN tblBuildingUnitColumns tBuC ON tBuC.BuildingUnitColumnPK = tBub.BuildingUnitColumnFK      
  -- INNER JOIN tblBuildingUnitRows tBuR ON tBuR.BuildingUnitRowPK = tBuC.BuildingUnitRowFK       
  -- INNER JOIN tblBuildingUnits tBud ON tBud.BuildingUnitPK = tBuR.BuildingUnitFK    
  --) as RowsLeft               
  --GROUP BY BuildingUnitFK, Row, RowsLeft.BuildingUnit,returnStatus    
  --ORDER BY BuildingUnitFK, Row      
   SELECT 3 as returnStatus, 'Pallets available to pick in other rows, update row filters to continue picking' AS returnMessage      
   RETURN      
   END      
         
   -- Now check if all the pallets are all loaded      
   if  not exists (select worksordermovementpk, dbo.fnMobileStockOutLoadedStatus(WorksOrderMovementPK) Loaded       
    FROM #tmpcomovements    
    where dbo.fnMobileStockOutLoadedStatus(WorksOrderMovementPK) = 0)      
  BEGIN      
  -- Check if the worksorders is complete      
      
   if NOT EXISTS (      
    Select worksorderFK      
    from #tmpcomovements wom      
    INNER JOIN #tmpWorksOrders wos ON worksorderfk = worksorderpk      
    Where wom.WorksOrderStatusFK not in (3,4) AND wos.WorksOrderStatusFK < 3) -- Still open      
   BEGIN      
    IF XACT_STATE() = 0 AND @@TRANCOUNT < 1 BEGIN TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName      
      
     -- Complete the WorksOrder as there are no more open worksordermovements      
    UPDATE tblWorksOrders WITH (ROWLOCK)       
    SET WorksOrderStatusFK = 3,      
     UpdatedBy = @var_UserFK,      
     UpdatedDate = dbo.GetBSTDate()      
    WHERE WorksOrderPK IN (SELECT WorksOrderPK FROM #tmpWorksOrders two where WorksOrderStatusFK < 3)      
      
    BEGIN TRY IF XACT_STATE() = 1 AND @@TRANCOUNT = 1 AND @OpeningTranCount < 1 COMMIT TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH      
   END      
             
   IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#tmpContainerInfo') IS NOT NULL      
   DROP TABLE #tmpContainerInfo      
      
     CREATE TABLE #tmpContainerInfo      
     (      
     ContainerOutStatusFK int,       
     LorryNumber nvarchar(50),

	 [Weight] decimal (18,3),

     )

       --SELECT * FROM #tmpContainerInfo      
      
   if((SELECT ExportContainerOutPickLoaded FROM #tmpContainerInfo) = 1)      
   BEGIN      
    if((SELECT DelayContainerOutPickLoaded FROM #tmpContainerInfo)=1)      
    BEGIN      
      SELECT 5 as returnStatus, 'Pick Complete - Pick loaded file will be sent to customer when order is completed' AS returnMessage      
      return      
    END

    begin      
      SELECT 5 as returnStatus, 'Pick Complete - Pick loaded file has been sent to customer' AS returnMessage      
      return      
    END      
      
    DECLARE @currentmin int = datepart(minute, dbo.GetBSTDate())      
    DECLARE @sendMin nvarchar(10) = ':00'      
    IF(@currentmin <= 10)      
     SET @sendMin = ':10'      
    ELSE IF (@currentmin > 10 AND @currentmin <= 20)      
     SET @sendMin = ':20'      
    ELSE IF (@currentmin > 20 AND @currentmin <= 30)      
     SET @sendMin = ':30'      
    ELSE IF (@currentmin > 30 AND @currentmin <= 40)      
     SET @sendMin = ':40'      
    ELSE IF (@currentmin > 40 AND @currentmin <= 50)      
     SET @sendMin = ':50'      
      
    DECLARE @currentHour int      
    set @currentHour = datepart(hour, dbo.GetBSTDate())      
    if(@sendMin = ':00')      
     set @currentHour = @currentHour+1      
      
    SELECT 5 as returnStatus, 'Pick Complete - Pick loaded file will be sent at approx ' + CAST(@currentHour as varchar(10)) + CAST(@sendMin as varchar(10))  AS returnMessage      
    return      
   END      
      
  SELECT 5 as returnStatus, 'Pick Complete - All Pallets loaded' AS returnMessage      
  RETURN        
      END      
      ELSE      
       SELECT 4 as returnStatus, 'Pick Complete - Pallets not yet loaded' AS returnMessage;      
   END      
      
   -- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end      
      
         
         
   BREAK      
  END TRY      
  BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */      
   DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;      
   SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;      
   SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;      
      
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY       
   BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;      
             
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;      
      
            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID      
                  
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;      
                  
   IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)      
   BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END      
   ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */      
  END CATCH      
  SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1      
 END      
END 
GO

    --END --worksorderStatus = 10        
    PRINT 'now in here'        
    -- if the destination type is racking , check if a works order movement exist        
    IF (@DestinationLocationType2 = 1)         
    BEGIN           
     -- If so then cancel it        
  IF Exists (SELECT * from tblWorksOrderMovements         
    WHERE PalletFK = @PalletFK AND WorksOrderStatusFK IN (1,2)         
    AND DestinationFK <>  @DestinationFK2         
    AND DestinationLocationTypeFK = @DestinationLocationType2)        
  BEGIN

     UPDATE tblWorksOrderMovements WITH (ROWLOCK)         
      SET WorksOrderStatusFK = 4 ,        
    UpdatedBy = @UserId2,        
    UpdatedDate = dbo.GetBSTDate()        
     Where PalletFK = @PalletFK         
     AND WorksOrderStatusFK IN (1,2)         
     AND DestinationLocationTypeFK = 1        
   END        
        
     -- complete the new works order movement        
     SELECT @WorksOrderMovementPK = WorksOrderMovementPK        
     FROM tblWorksOrderMovements         
     WHERE PalletFK = @PalletFK         
     AND WorksOrderStatusFK in (1,2)        
     AND destinationFK = @DestinationFK2             
        
     -- no works order movement found        
     IF (@WorksOrderMovementPK < 1 or @WorksOrderMovementPK is null)         
     BEGIN        
      -- Always attempt to commit before returning        
      BEGIN TRY IF XACT_STATE() = 1 AND @@TRANCOUNT = 1 AND @OpeningTranCount < 1 COMMIT TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH              
        
       SELECT 6 AS ReturnStatus,'Movement Failed - Please Re-Try' as ReturnMessage        
       RETURN        
    
     END         
     ELSE         
     BEGIN        
 --                    SET @errorMessage = 'New Works Order Movement  ' + CONVERT(nvarchar(50),@WorksOrderMovementPK) + ' will be created now'        
 --           EXEC spMobileWriteToLogFile @errorNo, @errorMessage, @Procedure        
          print 'calling spMobileWorksOrderMovement Complete'        
        
  insert into #tmpReturn EXEC [dbo].[spMobileWorksOrderMovementComplete]    @WorksOrderMovementPK, @DestinationBarcode, @UserId2        
        
  SELECT @ReturnStatus = ReturnStatus from #tmpReturn        
        
  BEGIN TRY IF XACT_STATE() = 1 AND @@TRANCOUNT = 1 AND @OpeningTranCount < 1 COMMIT TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH        
         
       IF (@ReturnStatus = 1)         
        set @ReturnMessage = 'Success'         
       ELSE         
        set @ReturnMessage = 'Movement Failed - Please Re-Try'        
                 
       SELECT @ReturnStatus AS ReturnStatus,@ReturnMessage as ReturnMessage        
       RETURN        
     END  -- end of worksorderMovement has a value        
    END -- end of destination type is racking        
    ELSE         
    BEGIN        
     -- Assign new location to tblpallet        
print 'assign new location'        
     print @BuildingUnitFK        
        
     -- Always attempt to begin a transaction before updating, inserting or deleting records in a permanent table        
     IF XACT_STATE() = 0 AND @@TRANCOUNT < 1 BEGIN TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName        
        
     UPDATE tblPallets WITH (ROWLOCK)         
     SET LocationTypeFK = @DestinationLocationType2,        
      LocationFK = @DestinationFK2,        
      BuildingUnitFK = @BuildingUnitFK2,        
      UpdatedBy = @UserId2,

     BEGIN TRY IF XACT_STATE() = 1 AND @@TRANCOUNT = 1 AND @OpeningTranCount < 1 COMMIT TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH        
           
      SELECT 1 AS ReturnStatus,'Success' as ReturnMessage        
      RETURN     
    END -- not racking         
   END         
   ELSE         
   BEGIN -- works order already exists for this pallet and location         
    -- Update the Works Order Movement with the new location        
    -- First get the WorksOrderMovementPK         
    SELECT @WorksOrderMovementPK = WorksOrderMovementPK         
    FROM tblWorksOrderMovements Wms         
    INNER JOIN tblWorksOrders Wos ON  Wms.WorksOrderFK = Wos.WorksOrderPK         
    WHERE  PalletFK = @PalletFK   AND Wos.WorksOrderTypeFK = 3    AND  Wms.WorksOrderStatusFK IN (1,2)        
        
    -- set the message

      RETURN

    ELSE

     SET DestinationLocationTypeFK =  @DestinationLocationType2 ,

   DestinationBayPosition = @DestinationBayPosition2 ,

   DestinationPalletEnd =  @DestinationEnd2 ,

      -- complete the new works order movement        
      INSERT INTO #TmpReturn EXEC [dbo].[spMobileWorksOrderMovementComplete] @WorksOrderMovementPK, @DestinationBarcode, @UserId2        
        
      SELECT @ReturnStatus = ReturnStatus FROM #TmpReturn        
        
      -- Always attempt to commit before returning        
      BEGIN TRY IF XACT_STATE() = 1 AND @@TRANCOUNT = 1 AND @OpeningTranCount < 1 COMMIT TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH

    --  BEGIN        
       IF (@ReturnStatus = 1)         
        set @ReturnMessage = 'Success'         
       ELSE         
        set @ReturnMessage = 'Movement Failed - Please Re-Try'         
        
       PRINT @returnStatus        
        
       SELECT @ReturnStatus AS ReturnStatus,@ReturnMessage as ReturnMessage        
       RETURN        
  --    END        
  --    ELSE     
 --    select -1 AS ReturnStatus,'Something went wrong' as ReturnMessage    
   --    RETURN        
     END         
     ELSE         
     BEGIN-- if in racking         
      -- Assign new location to tblpallet        
      print 'in racking'        
      print @BuildingUnitFK        
        
      -- Always attempt to begin a transaction before updating, inserting or deleting records in a permanent table        
      IF XACT_STATE() = 0 AND @@TRANCOUNT < 1 BEGIN TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName        
        
      UPDATE tblPallets WITH (ROWLOCK)         
      SET LocationTypeFK = @DestinationLocationType2,        
      LocationFK = @DestinationFK2,        
      BuildingUnitFK = @BuildingUnitFK2,        
      UpdatedBy = @UserId2,        
      UpdatedDate = dbo.GetBSTDate()        
      WHERE PalletPK = @PalletFK        
             
      -- Always attempt to commit before returning        
      BEGIN TRY IF XACT_STATE() = 1 AND @@TRANCOUNT = 1 AND @OpeningTranCount < 1 COMMIT TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH        
        
       SELECT 1 AS ReturnStatus,   'OK' as ReturnMessage     
       RETURN     
     END -- if not in racking        
    END -- works order movement exists        
   END -- works order already exists and just needs to be updated           
         
   -- Always attempt to commit before returning        
   BEGIN TRY IF XACT_STATE() = 1 AND @@TRANCOUNT = 1 AND @OpeningTranCount < 1 COMMIT TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH        
         
    SELECT 7 AS ReturnStatus,'Movement Failed - Please Re-Try' as ReturnMessage        
    RETURN     
        
   -- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end        
              
   BREAK        
  END TRY        
  BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */        
   DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;        
   SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;        
   SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;        
        
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY         
   BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;        
               
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;        
        
            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID        
                    
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;        
                    
   IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)        
   BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END        
   ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */        
  END CATCH        
  SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1        
 END        
END

   BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;  
         
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;  
  
            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID  
              
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;  
              
   IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)  
   BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END  
   ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */  
  END CATCH  
  SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1  
 END  
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spMobstaStopTimeTracking]        
(        
 @WorksOrderUserTimePK int,       
 @WorksOrderUsersFK int,     
 -- @UsersFK int,     
 @EndDate datetime,    
 @completeworksorder bit    
       
       
)        
AS        
BEGIN        
 /* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data; Ensure this proc has a low impact when executed */        
     SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED; SET DEADLOCK_PRIORITY LOW        
        
    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT        
 ,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;        
 SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();        
        
 -- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters        
 DECLARE @var_WorksOrderUserTimePK INT, @var_WorksOrderUsersFK int , @var_EndDate DateTime  ,@var_@completeworksorder bit       
        
 SET @var_WorksOrderUserTimePK = @WorksOrderUserTimePK; SET @var_WorksOrderUsersFK = @WorksOrderUsersFK;   SET @var_EndDate=@EndDate        
  ;SET @var_@completeworksorder = @completeworksorder    
 --SET @var_InvoiceStorageCharge2 = @invoiceStorageCharge;         
 --SET @var_InvoiceExtraServicesCharge2 = @invoiceExtraServicesCharge;         
 --SET @var_InvoiceDistributionCharge2 = @invoiceDistributionCharge;        
 --SET @var_InvoiceRecurringCharge2 = @invoiceRecurringCharge;        
        
        
 SET @ParameterDetails = '@WorksOrderUserTimePK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_WorksOrderUserTimePK AS NVARCHAR(30)),'')         
  + ',@WorksOrderUsersFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_WorksOrderUsersFK AS NVARCHAR(30)),'')        
  --+ ',@UsersFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_UsersFK AS NVARCHAR(30)),'')        
  + ',@EndDate = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_EndDate AS NVARCHAR(30)),'')        
        
    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL         
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)        
        
    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)        
 --BEGIN        
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC         
        
  SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)        
        
        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)        
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK        
        
        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()        
 --END        
        
 SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);        
 SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName)        
 IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails        
 ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;        
 INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK        
 SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()        
         
 WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3        
 BEGIN         
  BEGIN TRY           
        
   -- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start  
  

  declare @endtime int

   set @endtime = (select count(*) from tblworksorderusertime where WorksOrderUserTimePK=@var_WorksOrderUserTimePK and EndDate IS NULL )

   if (@endtime > 0)
   BEGIN
        
   Update tblworksorderuserTime Set EndDate = @var_EndDate ,UpdatedDate = @var_EndDate --, UpdatedBy =@var_UsersFK     
   where WorksOrderUserTimePK = @var_WorksOrderUserTimePK and WorksOrderUsersFK= @var_WorksOrderUsersFK    
    
   declare  @Worksorderfk int    
     set @Worksorderfk = (select Worksorderfk from tblworksorderusers where WorksOrderUsersPK=@var_WorksOrderUsersFK)        
    
  if (@var_@completeworksorder = 1)    
  begin    
  update tblworksorders set WorksOrderStatusFK = 3 , UpdatedDate = @EndDate --, UpdatedBy = @var_UsersFK    
  where WorksOrderPK = @Worksorderfk    
  end    
        END
   BEGIN TRY IF XACT_STATE() = 1 AND @@TRANCOUNT = 1 AND @OpeningTranCount < 1 COMMIT TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH        
        
   BREAK        
  END TRY        
  BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */         
   DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;        
        
   SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE();        
   SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;        
        
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY        
        
   BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;        
               
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;        
        
            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID        
                    
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;        
                    
   IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)        
   BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END        
   ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */           
  END CATCH        
  SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1        
 END        
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spMObstaUpdateWorksOrderMovementStockOut]

 @UserPK int,            
 @HandheldDeviceFK int = -1,            
 @WarehouseMachineFK int = -1 ,        
 @splitPalletNow bit = 0 ,  
  @MovingSplitContent bit = 0    
)               
AS              
BEGIN              
 /* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */              
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED              
              
    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT,              
 @PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;

 -- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters

 SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails

   declare @SourceLocationTypeFK int              
   declare @SourceLocationFK int              
   declare @sourcePalletEnd int              
   declare @return_value int              
   DECLARE @DestinationFK int              
   DECLARE @SetDownName nvarchar (50)              
   DECLARE @FloorLocationName nvarchar(100)              
   declare @NewWorksOrderMovementPK int              
   DECLARE @ContainerOutLinePalletContentFK int              
   DECLARE @PalletPK int              
   --DECLARE @ContainerOutFK int              
   DECLARE @WorksOrderStatusFK int              
   DECLARE @MovementDescription nvarchar(500)              
              
                 
   IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#TmpMovement') IS NOT NULL                     
    DROP TABLE #TmpMovement              
   SELECT * INTO #TmpMovement FROM tblworksordermovements WHERE WorksOrderMovementpk = @var_WorksOrderMovementPK

    @SourceLocationFK = LocationFK,              
    @sourcePalletEnd = PalletEnd,

   from

   inner join tblworksorders               
    on worksorderpk = worksorderfk               
   --inner join tblstockorders               
   -- on fk = stockorderpk               
   inner join tblpallets               
    on palletpk = palletfk               
   where               
    WorksOrderMovementpk = @var_WorksOrderMovementPK              
                     
    --from tblpallets where palletpk = (SELECT palletfk from tblWorksOrderMovements where WorksOrderMovementPK=@var_WorksOrderMovementPK)              
   IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#tmpReturn') IS NOT NULL              
    DROP TABLE #tmpReturn              
              
   create table #tmpReturn(ReturnStatus int)              
                 
   --Jamie : dont scan splits, so skip this                 
   -- If moving a pallet out of racking , record its location              
   --if (@SourceLocationTypeFK = 1 AND @var_DestinationTypeFK <> 1)              
   -- EXEC [dbo].[spMobileSplitPalletRecordLocation] @PalletPK, @var_DestinationTypeFK, @var_UserPK

    IF(@SourceLocationTypeFK in (1,3,6,8)/*Racking, Sample*/)               
    BEGIN              
     DECLARE @FloorLocationPK int              
     DECLARE @FloorBuildingUnitFK int              
              
     SELECT               
      @FloorLocationName = BuildingUnit + ' ' + FloorLocation ,              
      @FloorLocationPK = FloorLocationPK,              
      @FloorBuildingUnitFK = BuildingUnitFK              
     from               
      tblFloorLocations flr              
     INNER JOIN tblBuildingUnits bus ON bus.buildingUnitPK = flr.buildingUnitFK

      barcode = @var_DestinationBarcode              
                            
     if (@SourceLocationTypeFK = 8 and  @var_DestinationTypeFK = 8 and @SourceLocationFK = @FloorLocationPK)

      WorksOrderMovementPK = @var_WorksOrderMovementPK

     IF XACT_STATE() = 0 AND @@TRANCOUNT < 1 BEGIN TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName                                      
              
     -- change the original works order source location to the floor location

     set              
      SourceBayPosition = -1 ,              
      SourceLocationTypeFK =8,              
      SourceLocationFK = @FloorLocationPK,--(select floorLocationPK from tblFloorLocations where barcode=@var_DestinationBarcode ),              
      MovementDescription =  RTRIM(SUBSTRING(MovementDescription, 0,CHARINDEX(' FROM ',MovementDescription)))               
            + ' FROM ' + @FloorLocationName + ' - '                
            + LTRIM(SUBSTRING(MovementDescription, CHARINDEX(' TO ',MovementDescription),LEN(MovementDescription)))              
     where               
      WorksOrderMovementPK=@var_WorksOrderMovementPK              
                   
     Select 1 as ReturnStatus  ,'' as ReturnMessage              
              
     IF XACT_STATE() = 0 AND @@TRANCOUNT < 1 BEGIN TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName

 if ((select entirepallet from #TmpMovement) = 1 or @splitPalletNow2 = 0 ) -----Pritesh

             Select 1 as ReturnStatus,'' as ReturnMessage

      GOTO EXIT_PROC

      @var_UserPK,dbo.GetBSTDate(), ResponsibleUserFK, @HandheldDeviceFK2 , @WarehouseMachineFK2

      WorksOrderMovementPK=@var_WorksOrderMovementPK              
              
     Set @NewWorksOrderMovementPK = scope_identity()               
              
     -- reposition the positions in the cells either for drive through or conventional

            + ' FROM ' + @SetDownName + ' - '                
            + LTRIM(SUBSTRING(MovementDescription, CHARINDEX(' TO ',MovementDescription),LEN(MovementDescription)))              
     where               
      WorksOrderMovementPK=@var_WorksOrderMovementPK              
              
     Select 1 as ReturnStatus  ,'' as ReturnMessage             
              
     IF XACT_STATE() = 0 AND @@TRANCOUNT < 1 BEGIN TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName              
              
     -- Update tblPallets     
if ((select entirepallet from #TmpMovement) = 1 or @splitPalletNow2 = 0 )    
  begin-----Pritesh 
   if( @MovingSplitContent2 = 0)

     Select 1 as ReturnStatus,'' as ReturnMessage    
     GOTO EXIT_PROC

    ELSE IF @SourceLocationTypeFK = 2              
    BEGIN              
     SELECT 0 as returnStatus,'Invalid Move - Scan to Container' as ReturnMessage              
     GOTO EXIT_PROC              
    END              
              
    Select @returnStatus = 2              
              
    select 0 as ReturnStatus,'' as ReturnMessage              
              
    GOTO EXIT_PROC               
   END               
   ELSE IF(@var_DestinationTypeFK =2)/*STAL-*/              
   BEGIN                  
    --Moving to loading bay              
    --Because the original works order is to the loading bay we can complete the movement               
    --Change the works Order movement to the choosen loading bay as it may be different from the original              
                   
    -- Cannot put pallet into its current location

     -- movementDescription = ('Hand Held - ' + SUBSTRING(@MovementDescription, 1, case when CHARINDEX('TO ', @MovementDescription) = 0 then LEN(@MovementDescription) else CHARINDEX('TO ', @MovementDescription)  - 1 end) + 'TO - ' + @DestinationLocationName)  ,            
   movementDescription = ('Hand Held - ' + SUBSTRING(@MovementDescription, 1,  CHARINDEX('TO ', @MovementDescription)  - 1 ) + 'TO - ' + @DestinationLocationName)  ,            
            
  WarehouseMachineFK = @WarehouseMachineFK2,            
   HandheldDeviceFK = @HandheldDeviceFK2

    insert into #tmpReturn               
    EXEC [dbo].[sp_MobstaWorksOrderMovementStatusChange] @WorksOrderMovementPK = @var_WorksOrderMovementPK,@worksOrderStatusFK = 3,@currentUserFK = @var_UserPK,   
 @HandheldDeviceFK = @HandheldDeviceFK2 , @WarehouseMachineFK = @WarehouseMachineFK2, @splitPalletNow = @splitPalletNow2 , @MovingSplitContent=@MovingSplitContent2                    
               
    IF XACT_STATE() = 0 AND @@TRANCOUNT < 1 BEGIN TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName              
              
    -- Update tblPallets      
 if ((select entirepallet from #TmpMovement) = 1 or @splitPalletNow2 = 0 ) -----Pritesh    
 begin   
  if( @MovingSplitContent2 = 0)
  begin
    UPDATE tblPallets WITH (ROWLOCK)              
    SET

    where               
     palletpk = @PalletPK              
     end  
	 end
    Select 1 as ReturnStatus,'' as ReturnMessage                 
              
    GOTO EXIT_PROC      
     
   END               
   ELSE IF(@var_DestinationTypeFK = 4)/*STACO-*/              
   BEGIN              
    -- Check if pallet Status is allowed to be moved              
    DECLARE @palletStatusFK int              
    DECLARE @CustomerFK int              
    DECLARE @DivisionFK int              
 DECLARE @StockItemFK int               
    DECLARE @PalletStatusName nvarchar(200)              
              
    SELECT               
     @palletStatusFK = palletStatusFK ,

     @DivisionFK = DivisionFK,              
     @CustomerFK = div.CustomerFK,              
     @PalletStatusName = PalletStatus

SELECT palletStatusfk from tblPalletStatusNotAllowedOut WHERE palletstatusFK = @palletStatusFK              
       AND (customerFK = @CustomerFK OR DivisionFK = @DivisionFK OR @stockItemFK = StockItemFK)              
      )              
    BEGIN

        -- Add HandHeld message at the beginning of the Movement description

     SELECT @returnStatus = ReturnStatus From #tmpReturn               
    END               
                   
    IF (@returnStatus <> 1)               
     GOTO EXIT_PROC              
    --END               
     -- Change tblContainerOutLinesPalletContent Loaded to true              
    -- When the entire pallet is being moved                   
              
    DECLARE @EntirePallet bit              
              
    SELECT @EntirePallet = EntirePallet FROM #TmpMovement WHERE WorksOrderMovementPK = @var_WorksOrderMovementPK                   
              
    if (@EntirePallet = 1)              
    BEGIN                    
     IF XACT_STATE() = 0 AND @@TRANCOUNT < 1 BEGIN TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName              
              
     --jamie: comented out,  exec spPalletsSetLoaded does this again anyway              
     -- check that the pallet is not nested (only one palletcontent record)              
     -- If there is only one ContainerOutLinePalletContent record then it is not nested              
     --UPDATE tblContainerOutLinePalletContent WITH (ROWLOCK)              
     --SET               
     -- Loaded  = 1,              
     -- updatedBy = @var_UserPK,              
     -- updatedDate = dbo.GetBSTDate()              
     --WHERE               
     -- PalletFK = @PalletPK              
     -- AND ContainerOutLinePalletContentPK in (              
     --  select containeroutlinepalletcontentpk               
     --  from viewContainerOutPalletList vcpl              
     --  where vcpl.ContainerOutPK = @ContainerOutFK               
     --  AND vcpl.PalletFK = @PalletPk              
     -- )              
     ---- Create loaded record              
     DECLARE @MovmementXML xml              
              
     set @MovmementXML = '<Movements><Movement><WorksOrderMovementPK>' + convert (nvarchar(100),@var_WorksOrderMovementPK) + '</WorksOrderMovementPK></Movement></Movements>'              
              
     exec spPalletsSetLoaded @MovmementXML,@var_UserPK,1              
    END              
    ELSE               
    BEGIN              
     IF XACT_STATE() = 0 AND @@TRANCOUNT < 1 BEGIN TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName              
              
     -- When taking only an each              
     UPDATE tblContainerOutLinePalletContent WITH (ROWLOCK)                 
     SET               
      Loaded  = 1,              
      updatedBy = @var_UserPK,              
      updatedDate = dbo.GetBSTDate()              
     WHERE                
      ContainerOutLinePalletContentPK = @ContainerOutLinePalletContentFK              
    END              
              
    IF XACT_STATE() = 0 AND @@TRANCOUNT < 1 BEGIN TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName              
              
    -- Complete any open movements on this pick for this pallet              
    Update tblWorksOrderMovements WITH (ROWLOCK)              
    set               
     WorksOrderStatusFK = 3              
    where               
     ContainerOutLinePalletContentFK = @ContainerOutLinePalletContentFK              
     and worksorderstatusfk in (1,2)                
                
    Select 1 as ReturnStatus, '' as ReturnMessage                  
   END              
              
EXIT_PROC:              
              
   BEGIN TRY IF XACT_STATE() = 1 AND @@TRANCOUNT = 1 AND @OpeningTranCount < 1 COMMIT TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH              
               
   -- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end              
                 
   BREAK              
  END TRY              
  BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */              
   DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;              
              
   SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;              
   SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;              
              
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY               
   BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;              
                     
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;              
              
            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID              
                          
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;              
                          
   IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)              
   BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END              
   ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */              
  END CATCH              
  SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1              
 END              
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spMobstCycleCountProblemTypes]    
AS    
BEGIN    
 /* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */    
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED    
    
    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT    
 ,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;    
 SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();    
    
 -- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters    
 --DECLARE     
    
 SET @ParameterDetails = ''    
    
    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL     
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)    
    
    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)    
    --BEGIN    
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC     
    
  SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)    
    
        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)    
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK    
    
        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()    
    --END    
    
    
 SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);    
 SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails    
 ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;    
 INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()    
    
 WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3    
 BEGIN     
  BEGIN TRY    
       
    
   -- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start    
Select * from appCycleCountProblemType 
    
   -- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end    
    
       
       
   BREAK    
  END TRY    
  BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */    
   DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;    
   SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;    
   SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;    
    
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY     
   BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;    
           
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;    
    
            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID    
                
          IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;    
                
   IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)    
   BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END    
   ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */    
  END CATCH    
  SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1    
 END    
END

/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[spMoveEmployeeActivityDetailRecords]    Script Date: 02/11/2026 17:47:27 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spMoveEmployeeActivityDetailRecords]
(
	@userFK INT = -1
)
AS
BEGIN
	DECLARE @varStoredProcedureName NVARCHAR(500) = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID)

	DECLARE @varTransactionName NVARCHAR(32) = REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(CAST(@@SPID AS NVARCHAR(50)) + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(50), GETDATE(), 21), ' - ', ''), ' ', ''), ':', ''), '.', '')

	INSERT INTO dbo.tblStoredProcedureLogging SELECT @varStoredProcedureName, 'Proc execution started', dbo.GetBSTDate()

	BEGIN TRY
		BEGIN TRANSACTION @varTransactionName
			
			DELETE FROM dbo.tblStoredProcedureLogging WHERE StoredProcedureName = @varStoredProcedureName			

			DECLARE @varUserFK NVARCHAR(50) = CAST(ISNULL(@userFK, -1) AS NVARCHAR(50)), @varRowCount INT

			INSERT INTO dbo.tblStoredProcedureLogging SELECT @varStoredProcedureName, '@varUserFK = ' + @varUserFK, dbo.GetBSTDate()

			INSERT INTO dbo.tblStoredProcedureLogging SELECT @varStoredProcedureName, 'starting remote execution of StawmsReporting.dbo.spAddEmployeeActivityDetails @varUserFK = ' + @varUserFK, dbo.GetBSTDate()

			-- Add the latest employee activity detail records into the Stawms Reporting database table.
			EXEC sp_execute_remote	@data_source_name  = N'StawmsReportingDataSource', 
									@stmt = N'EXEC dbo.spAddEmployeeActivityDetails @userFK', 
									@params = N'@userFK NVARCHAR(50)',
									@userFK = @varUserFK

			INSERT INTO dbo.tblStoredProcedureLogging SELECT @varStoredProcedureName, 'Remote execution of StawmsReporting.dbo.spAddEmployeeActivityDetails @varUserFK = ' + @varUserFK + ' completed', dbo.GetBSTDate()

			IF @varUserFK > 0
			BEGIN
				INSERT INTO dbo.tblStoredProcedureLogging SELECT @varStoredProcedureName, 'starting DELETE FROM dbo.tblEmployeeActivityDetails WHERE UserFK = ' + @varUserFK, dbo.GetBSTDate()

				DELETE FROM dbo.tblEmployeeActivityDetails WHERE UserFK = @varUserFK

				SET @varRowCount = @@ROWCOUNT
				INSERT INTO dbo.tblStoredProcedureLogging SELECT @varStoredProcedureName, ISNULL(CAST(@varRowCount AS NVARCHAR(50)), '') + ' rows deleted from dbo.tblEmployeeActivityDetails WHERE UserFK = ' + @varUserFK, dbo.GetBSTDate()
			END
			ELSE -- Empty the Stawms database employee activity detail table.
			BEGIN
				INSERT INTO dbo.tblStoredProcedureLogging SELECT @varStoredProcedureName, 'starting TRUNCATE TABLE dbo.tblEmployeeActivityDetails', dbo.GetBSTDate()

				TRUNCATE TABLE dbo.tblEmployeeActivityDetails

				INSERT INTO dbo.tblStoredProcedureLogging SELECT @varStoredProcedureName, 'TRUNCATE TABLE dbo.tblEmployeeActivityDetails completed', dbo.GetBSTDate()
			END

		COMMIT TRANSACTION @varTransactionName

		INSERT INTO dbo.tblStoredProcedureLogging SELECT @varStoredProcedureName, 'Proc execution completed', dbo.GetBSTDate()
	END TRY
	BEGIN CATCH
		BEGIN TRY
			ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @varTransactionName
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH
			BEGIN TRY
				INSERT INTO dbo.tblStoredProcedureLogging SELECT @varStoredProcedureName, 'Stawms.dbo.spMoveEmployeeActivityDetailRecords: ROLLBACK TRANSACTION ' + @varTransactionName + ' failed', dbo.GetBSTDate()
			END TRY
			BEGIN CATCH
				/*Ignore and continue*/
			END CATCH
		END CATCH

		DECLARE @ErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX) = ERROR_MESSAGE(), @ErrorSeverity INT = ERROR_SEVERITY(), @ErrorState INT = ERROR_STATE()

		INSERT INTO dbo.tblStoredProcedureLogging SELECT @varStoredProcedureName, 'ERROR_MESSAGE = ' + @ErrorMessage + ', ERROR_SEVERITY = ' + CAST(@ErrorSeverity AS NVARCHAR(50)) + ', ERROR_STATE = ' + CAST(@ErrorState AS NVARCHAR(50)), dbo.GetBSTDate()

		RAISERROR (@ErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState)
	END CATCH
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spMoveEventAndErrorLogRecords]
(
	@testingTimeOut BIT = 0
)
AS
BEGIN
	SET XACT_ABORT, NOCOUNT ON

	DECLARE 
		@varStoredProcedureName NVARCHAR(500) = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID)
		,@varTransactionName NVARCHAR(32) = REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(CAST(@@SPID AS NVARCHAR(50)) + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(50), GETDATE(), 21), ' - ', ''), ' ', ''), ':', ''), '.', '')
		,@varTestingTimeOut BIT = ISNULL(@testingTimeOut,0)
		,@varRowCount INT
		,@varMaxEventLogPK INT
		,@varMaxErrorLogPK INT
	
	DECLARE @varSQLCommand NVARCHAR(1000) = 'EXEC dbo.spAddEventAndErrorLogRecords 1, ' + CAST(@varTestingTimeOut AS NVARCHAR(1))
			
	DELETE FROM dbo.tblStoredProcedureLogging WHERE StoredProcedureName = @varStoredProcedureName

	print 'spMoveEventAndErrorLogRecords - Proc execution started' 
	INSERT INTO dbo.tblStoredProcedureLogging SELECT @varStoredProcedureName, 'Proc execution started', dbo.GetBSTDate()	

	print 'spMoveEventAndErrorLogRecords - Starting SQL transaction ' + isnull(@varTransactionName,'')
	INSERT INTO dbo.tblStoredProcedureLogging SELECT @varStoredProcedureName, 'Starting SQL transaction ' + isnull(@varTransactionName,'') , dbo.GetBSTDate()

	BEGIN TRY	
		BEGIN TRANSACTION @varTransactionName

			DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #maxPKs

			CREATE TABLE #maxPKs(MaxEventLogPK INT, MaxErrorLogPK INT, [$ShardName] NVARCHAR(MAX))

			print 'spMoveEventAndErrorLogRecords - EXEC sp_execute_remote StawmsReportingDataSource, ' + isnull(@varSQLCommand,'') + ' - started'
			INSERT INTO dbo.tblStoredProcedureLogging SELECT @varStoredProcedureName, 'EXEC sp_execute_remote StawmsReportingDataSource, ' + isnull(@varSQLCommand,'') + ' - started', dbo.GetBSTDate()	

			-- Add the latest event and error log records into the Stawms Reporting database tables and get the max pks from the Stawms Reporting database tables.
			INSERT INTO #maxPKs EXEC sp_execute_remote @data_source_name=N'StawmsReportingDataSource', @stmt=@varSQLCommand

			print 'spMoveEventAndErrorLogRecords - EXEC sp_execute_remote StawmsReportingDataSource, ' + isnull(@varSQLCommand,'') + ' - completed'
			INSERT INTO dbo.tblStoredProcedureLogging SELECT @varStoredProcedureName, 'EXEC sp_execute_remote StawmsReportingDataSource, ' + isnull(@varSQLCommand,'') + ' - completed', dbo.GetBSTDate()			

			SELECT @varMaxEventLogPK = MaxEventLogPK, @varMaxErrorLogPK = MaxErrorLogPK FROM #maxPKs

			print 'spMoveEventAndErrorLogRecords - MaxEventLogPK = ' + CAST(isnull(@varMaxEventLogPK, -1) AS NVARCHAR(50)) + ' , ' + 'MaxErrorLogPK = ' + CAST(isnull(@varMaxErrorLogPK, -1) AS NVARCHAR(50))
			INSERT INTO dbo.tblStoredProcedureLogging SELECT @varStoredProcedureName, 'MaxEventLogPK = ' + CAST(isnull(@varMaxEventLogPK, -1) AS NVARCHAR(50)) + ' , ' + 'MaxErrorLogPK = ' + CAST(isnull(@varMaxErrorLogPK, -1) AS NVARCHAR(50)), dbo.GetBSTDate()	

			DELETE FROM dbo.tblEventLog WHERE EventLogPK <= @varMaxEventLogPK

			SET @varRowCount = @@ROWCOUNT

			print 'spMoveEventAndErrorLogRecords - ' + CAST(isnull(@varRowCount, -1) AS NVARCHAR(50)) + ' records deleted from dbo.tblEventLog'
			INSERT INTO dbo.tblStoredProcedureLogging SELECT @varStoredProcedureName, CAST(isnull(@varRowCount, -1) AS NVARCHAR(50)) + ' records deleted from dbo.tblEventLog', dbo.GetBSTDate()	

			DELETE FROM dbo.tblErrorLog WHERE ErrorLogPK <= @varMaxErrorLogPK

			SET @varRowCount = @@ROWCOUNT

			print 'spMoveEventAndErrorLogRecords - ' + CAST(isnull(@varRowCount, -1) AS NVARCHAR(50)) + ' records deleted from dbo.tblErrorLog'
			INSERT INTO dbo.tblStoredProcedureLogging SELECT @varStoredProcedureName, CAST(isnull(@varRowCount, -1) AS NVARCHAR(50)) + ' records deleted from dbo.tblErrorLog', dbo.GetBSTDate()	

FINISH_SECTION:

		COMMIT TRANSACTION @varTransactionName
		
		print 'spMoveEventAndErrorLogRecords - SQL transaction ' + isnull(@varTransactionName,'') + ' committed successfully'
		INSERT INTO dbo.tblStoredProcedureLogging SELECT @varStoredProcedureName, ' SQL transaction ' + isnull(@varTransactionName,'') + ' committed successfully', dbo.GetBSTDate()
	END TRY
	BEGIN CATCH
		DECLARE @ErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX) = 'ERROR in ' + DB_NAME() + '.dbo.' + ISNULL(@varStoredProcedureName, '') + ' - ' + ERROR_MESSAGE()
		DECLARE @ErrorMessage2 NVARCHAR(MAX) = ''

		print @ErrorMessage
		INSERT INTO dbo.tblStoredProcedureLogging SELECT @varStoredProcedureName, @ErrorMessage, dbo.GetBSTDate()

		BEGIN TRY
			ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @varTransactionName
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH
			SET @ErrorMessage2 = 'ROLLBACK ERROR in ' + DB_NAME() + '.dbo.' + ISNULL(@varStoredProcedureName, '') + ' - ' + ERROR_MESSAGE()

			print @ErrorMessage2
			INSERT INTO dbo.tblStoredProcedureLogging SELECT @varStoredProcedureName, @ErrorMessage2, dbo.GetBSTDate()
		END CATCH

		IF ISNULL(@ErrorMessage2,'') <> '' SET @ErrorMessage = @ErrorMessage + ' |' + @ErrorMessage2

		RAISERROR (@ErrorMessage,16,1)
		RETURN
	END CATCH

	print 'spMoveEventAndErrorLogRecords - Proc execution completed'
	INSERT INTO dbo.tblStoredProcedureLogging SELECT @varStoredProcedureName, 'Proc execution completed', dbo.GetBSTDate()
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spMoveEventLogRecords]
AS
BEGIN
	DECLARE @varStoredProcedureName NVARCHAR(500) = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID)

	BEGIN TRY		
		DELETE FROM dbo.tblStoredProcedureLogging WHERE StoredProcedureName = @varStoredProcedureName

		INSERT INTO dbo.tblStoredProcedureLogging SELECT @varStoredProcedureName, 'Proc execution started', dbo.GetBSTDate()
	
		INSERT INTO dbo.tblStoredProcedureLogging SELECT @varStoredProcedureName, 'EXEC sp_execute_remote StawmsReportingDataSource, EXEC dbo.spAddEventLogRecords started', dbo.GetBSTDate()
		
		-- Add the latest event log records into the Stawms Reporting database table.
		EXEC sp_execute_remote N'StawmsReportingDataSource', N'EXEC dbo.spAddEventLogRecords'

		INSERT INTO dbo.tblStoredProcedureLogging SELECT @varStoredProcedureName, 'EXEC sp_execute_remote StawmsReportingDataSource, EXEC dbo.spAddEventLogRecords completed', dbo.GetBSTDate()

		INSERT INTO dbo.tblStoredProcedureLogging SELECT @varStoredProcedureName, 'TRUNCATE TABLE dbo.tblEventLog started', dbo.GetBSTDate()

		-- Empty the Stawms database event log table.
		TRUNCATE TABLE dbo.tblEventLog

		INSERT INTO dbo.tblStoredProcedureLogging SELECT @varStoredProcedureName, 'TRUNCATE TABLE dbo.tblEventLog completed', dbo.GetBSTDate()

		INSERT INTO dbo.tblStoredProcedureLogging SELECT @varStoredProcedureName, 'Proc execution completed', dbo.GetBSTDate()
	END TRY
	BEGIN CATCH
		INSERT INTO dbo.tblStoredProcedureLogging SELECT @varStoredProcedureName, 'ERROR MESSAGE - ' + ERROR_MESSAGE(), dbo.GetBSTDate()
	END CATCH
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spPageHitsDeleteOld]
(
	@NumberDays int = -30
)
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED

    DECLARE 
		@varThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400) = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID),@varExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@varParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX) = '',@varDeadlockErrorRetries INT = 1
		,@varProcedureAndErrorDetailsID INT,@EventLogPK INT,@varParentEventLogPK INT, @varSQLTransactionStarted BIT = 0
		,@varSQLTransactionName NVARCHAR(32) = REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(CAST(@@SPID AS NVARCHAR(50)) + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(50), dbo.GetBSTDate(), 21), ' - ', ''), ' ', ''), ':', ''), '.', '')
		
	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	DECLARE 
		@varNumberDays INT = @NumberDays

	SET @varParameterDetails = '@NumberDays = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@varNumberDays AS NVARCHAR(100)),'0') 

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    SELECT TOP 1 @varParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

    INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
    SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@varThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @varThisProcedureName + ' ' + @varParameterDetails, @varParentEventLogPK

    SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	SELECT @varExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @varExecutionPath = ISNULL(@varExecutionPath,@varThisProcedureName); IF @varExecutionPath = @varThisProcedureName SET @varExecutionPath = @varExecutionPath + ' ' + @varParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @varExecutionPath = @varExecutionPath + '\' + @varThisProcedureName + ' ' + @varParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @varThisProcedureName,@varExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @varProcedureAndErrorDetailsID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @varDeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		SET @varSQLTransactionName = REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(CAST(@@SPID AS NVARCHAR(50)) + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(50), dbo.GetBSTDate(), 21), ' - ', ''), ' ', ''), ':', ''), '.', '')
		SET @varSQLTransactionStarted = 0

		BEGIN TRY	

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start

			delete tblPageHits WHERE InsertedDate < DATEADD(day, @varNumberDays, dbo.GetBSTDate()) 

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end			

			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH

			/* Attempt to rollback the SQL transaction if one was started */
			IF @varSQLTransactionStarted = 1
			BEGIN
				BEGIN TRY ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @varSQLTransactionName END TRY BEGIN CATCH /*Ignore and continue*/ END CATCH
			END

			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME = dbo.GetBSTDate(), @ErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX) = ERROR_MESSAGE(), @ErrorSeverity INT = ERROR_SEVERITY(), @ErrorState INT = ERROR_STATE()
            
			IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @varProcedureAndErrorDetailsID
            
            IF @varProcedureAndErrorDetailsID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @varParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@varExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @ErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205/*Deadlock error*/ OR @varDeadlockErrorRetries > 2
			BEGIN 
				SET @varDeadlockErrorRetries = 100
				RAISERROR (@ErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState)
				RETURN 
			END
			ELSE 
				WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH

		SET @varDeadlockErrorRetries = @varDeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	SELECT @varExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @varExecutionPath = ISNULL(@varExecutionPath,@varThisProcedureName); IF @varExecutionPath = @varThisProcedureName SET @varExecutionPath = @varExecutionPath + ' ' + @varParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @varExecutionPath = @varExecutionPath + '\' + @varThisProcedureName + ' ' + @varParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @varThisProcedureName,@varExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @varProcedureAndErrorDetailsID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

		SET @varSQLTransactionName = REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(CAST(@@SPID AS NVARCHAR(50)) + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(50), dbo.GetBSTDate(), 21), ' - ', ''), ' ', ''), ':', ''), '.', '')
		SET @varSQLTransactionStarted = 0

		BEGIN TRY	

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start

			SELECT top (@varNoPages) sp.PageTitle, sp.PageURL, systempagepk, COUNT(PageHitPK) AS Hits
			FROM dbo.tblPageHits ph
			LEFT JOIN tblsystempages sp ON ph.SystemPageFK = sp.SystemPagePK
			WHERE ph.InsertedBy = @varUserFK
				AND sp.IsArchived = 0	
				AND sp.CanNavigate = 1
			GROUP BY PageTitle, sp.PageURL,systempagepk
			ORDER BY Hits DESC

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end			

			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH

			IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @varProcedureAndErrorDetailsID
            
            IF @varProcedureAndErrorDetailsID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @varParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@varExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @ErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205/*Deadlock error*/ OR @varDeadlockErrorRetries > 2
			BEGIN 
				SET @varDeadlockErrorRetries = 100
				RAISERROR (@ErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState)

		END CATCH

		SET @varDeadlockErrorRetries = @varDeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END

        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK    
    
        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()    
    --END    
    
    
 SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);    
 SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails    
 ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;    
 INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()    
    
 WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3    
 BEGIN     
  BEGIN TRY    
       
    
   -- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start    
    
  if(@varIsMobsta = 1)  
  begin  
  ;WITH cte AS    
   (    
      SELECT userpk, auir.RoleId, tsp.PageURL, tspp.PagePermissionLevelFK,    
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY tsp.PageURL ORDER BY PagePermissionLevelFK DESC) AS rn    
      FROM tblusers tu    
	inner join aspnetusers au on tu.AspNetUserID = au.Id
	inner join AspNetUserRoles auir on au.Id = auir.UserId
	--INNER JOIN dbo.aspnet_Users au ON tu.AspNetUserID = au.UserId    
    --INNER JOIN dbo.aspnet_UsersInRoles auir ON au.UserId = auir.UserId    
    INNER JOIN dbo.tblSystemPagePermissions tspp ON auir.RoleId = tspp.RoleID    
    INNER JOIN dbo.tblSystemPages tsp ON tspp.SystemPageFK = tsp.SystemPagePK    
    WHERE  tsp.IsArchived = 0 --nobody should access an archived page    
     and userpk = @varUserFK    
  and PageURL like 'MOBSTA%'  
   )    
   SELECT PageURL, PagePermissionLevelFK AS PermissionLevel    
   FROM cte c    
   WHERE rn = 1 --take top entry for each URL (multiple user roles would mean multiple results for each URL, we want the highest available permission level)    
   ORDER BY PageURL    
  end  
  else  
  begin  
       
   ;WITH cte AS    
   (    
      SELECT userpk, auir.RoleId, tsp.PageURL, tspp.PagePermissionLevelFK,    
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY tsp.PageURL ORDER BY PagePermissionLevelFK DESC) AS rn    
      FROM tblusers tu    
    inner join aspnetusers au on tu.AspNetUserID = au.Id
	inner join AspNetUserRoles auir on au.Id = auir.UserId	
	--INNER JOIN dbo.aspnet_Users au ON tu.AspNetUserID = au.UserId    
    --INNER JOIN dbo.aspnet_UsersInRoles auir ON au.UserId = auir.UserId    
    INNER JOIN dbo.tblSystemPagePermissions tspp ON auir.RoleId = tspp.RoleID    
    INNER JOIN dbo.tblSystemPages tsp ON tspp.SystemPageFK = tsp.SystemPagePK    
    WHERE pagepermissionlevelfk > 1 --all pages user has access too (read only or full access)    
     AND tsp.IsArchived = 0 --nobody should access an archived page    
     and userpk = @varUserFK    
  and PageURL not like 'MOBSTA%'  
   )    
   SELECT PageURL, PagePermissionLevelFK AS PermissionLevel    
   FROM cte c    
   WHERE rn = 1 --take top entry for each URL (multiple user roles would mean multiple results for each URL, we want the highest available permission level)    
   ORDER BY PageURL    
  end  
   -- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end    
    
       
       
   BREAK    
  END TRY    
  BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */    
   DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;    
   SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;    
   SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;    
    
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY     
   BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;    
           
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;    
    
            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID    
                
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;    
                
   IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)    
   BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END    
   ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */    
  END CATCH    
  SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1    
 END    
END

   --into #AllMenuItems     
   FROM (    
    SELECT distinct SystemMenuPK AS MenuFk, ParentSystemMenuFK, -1 AS PageFK, MenuName, MenuName AS LinkText, '' AS MenuLink, MenuPosition, cast(0 AS bit) AS DivideAfter,     cast(0 AS bit) AS OpenNewTab
    FROM tblsystemmenu tsm    
    WHERE (systemmenupk IN (SELECT menuFK FROM #AllMenuPages))    
    OR    
    (systemmenupk IN (SELECT distinct ParentSystemMenuFK FROM #AllMenuPages WHERE ParentSystemMenuFK > 0))    
    
    UNION    
    
    SELECT MenuFk, ParentSystemMenuFK, PageFK, MenuName, LinkText, MenuLink, MenuPosition, DivideAfter, OpenNewTab FROM #AllMenuPages    
   ) subq

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID

	@specialStockTypeFK int
)	
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT
 ,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;
	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

	SET @var_palletContentSpecialStockTypePK = @palletContentSpecialStockTypePK; SET @var_stockInLineFK = @stockInLineFK; SET @var_stockItemFK = @stockItemFK
	SET @var_specialStockTypeFK = @specialStockTypeFK
	SET @ParameterDetails = '@palletContentSpecialStockTypePK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_palletContentSpecialStockTypePK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@stockInLineFK = ' 
		+ ISNULL(CAST(@var_stockInLineFK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@stockItemFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_stockItemFK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@specialStockTypeFK = ' 
			+ ISNULL(CAST(@var_specialStockTypeFK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'')

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    --BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

		SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END


	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY
			IF XACT_STATE() = 0 AND @@TRANCOUNT < 1 BEGIN TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start

			IF(@var_stockInLineFK IS NOT null) 
			BEGIN
				IF(@var_specialStockTypeFK = 1)
				BEGIN --BONDED, SET UNIT COST
					update tblPalletContentSpecialStockTypes WITH (ROWLOCK)
					Set IntParam1 = (Select isnull(StockItemUnitCostPK, -1) from tblStockItems sis left outer join tblStockItemUnitCosts siucs 
					on siucs.StockItemFK = sis.StockItemPK AND siucs.StartDate = (Select MAX(StartDate) from tblStockItemUnitCosts 
					where StockItemFK = @var_stockItemFK) where sis.StockItemPK = @var_stockItemFK)
					Where PalletFK in (Select PalletFK from tblStockInLinePallets where StockInLineFK = @var_stockInLineFK)
				END ELSE IF(@var_specialStockTypeFK = 2)
				BEGIN --GENERAL
					PRINT 'TODO'
				END ELSE IF(@var_specialStockTypeFK = 3)
				BEGIN --CONSIGNED, SET SUPPLIER
					update tblPalletContentSpecialStockTypes WITH (ROWLOCK)
					Set IntParam1 = (Select DefaultSupplierFK from tblStockItems where StockItemPK = @var_stockItemFK)
					Where PalletFK in (Select PalletFK from tblStockInLinePallets where StockInLineFK = @var_stockInLineFK)
				END
			END 
			ELSE 
			BEGIN
				IF(@var_specialStockTypeFK = 1)
				BEGIN --BONDED, SET UNIT COST
					update tblPalletContentSpecialStockTypes WITH (ROWLOCK)
					Set IntParam1 = (Select isnull(StockItemUnitCostPK, -1) from tblStockItems sis left outer join tblStockItemUnitCosts siucs 
					on siucs.StockItemFK = sis.StockItemPK AND siucs.StartDate = (Select MAX(StartDate) from tblStockItemUnitCosts 
					where StockItemFK = @var_stockItemFK) where sis.StockItemPK = @var_stockItemFK)
					Where PalletContentSpecialStockTypePK = @var_palletContentSpecialStockTypePK
				END ELSE IF(@var_specialStockTypeFK = 2)
				BEGIN --GENERAL
					PRINT 'TODO'
				END ELSE IF(@var_specialStockTypeFK = 3)
				BEGIN --CONSIGNED, SET SUPPLIER
					update tblPalletContentSpecialStockTypes WITH (ROWLOCK)
					Set IntParam1 = (Select DefaultSupplierFK from tblStockItems where StockItemPK = @var_stockItemFK)
					Where PalletContentSpecialStockTypePK = @var_palletContentSpecialStockTypePK
				END
			END

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end

			BEGIN TRY IF XACT_STATE() = 1 AND @@TRANCOUNT = 1 AND @OpeningTranCount < 1 COMMIT TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH
			
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END

			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END
GO
