			DECLARE BayCursor CURSOR FAST_FORWARD FOR 
			SELECT * FROM (
			Select Distinct BuildingUnitBayPK, MaximumBayWeight, BayWeight, RackingTypeFK, Row, RowNumber, 
			Translate, TranslatedRow, ReverseTranslate, TranslateColumn,
			subQ.BuildingUnitColumn, BuildingUnitColumnName, MaximumColumnWeight, ColumnWeight, BayLevel, 
			GapBetweenPallets, isnull(GapBetweenPalletsBayPosition, 0)[GapBetweenPalletsBayPosition], isnull(GapBetweenPalletsPalletStart, 0)[GapBetweenPalletsPalletStart], 
			GapToEndOfBay, isnull(EndBayPosition,0) EndBayPosition, isnull(EndBayPalletStart, 0)EndBayPalletStart, 
			GapToStartOfBay, isnull(StartBayPosition, 0) StartBayPosition, StartBayPalletStart, 
			GapWholeBay, WholeBayPosition, WholeBayPalletStart, 
			Height as LocationOrder, isnull(PalletStart, 0) PalletStart, StockItemContentFound, StackedContentFound,
			isnull(StockItemBuildingUnitBayPK, 0) StockItemBuildingUnitBayPK, isnull(IsStockItemLocationExclusive, 0) IsStockItemLocationExclusive from (
			Select buBays.BuildingUnitBayPK,
				buBays.MaximumWeight as MaximumBayWeight,
				isnull(bayWeight.BayWeight, 0) BayWeight,
				buRows.RackingTypeFK, 
				buRows.Row,
				buRows.RowNumber,
				buRows.Translate,
				buRows.TranslatedRow,
				buRows.ReverseTranslate,
				buRows.TranslateColumn,
				buCols.BuildingUnitColumn,
				buCols.BuildingUnitColumnName,
				buCols.MaximumWeight as MaximumColumnWeight,
				isnull(columnWeight.ColumnWeight, 0) ColumnWeight,
				buBays.BayLevel,
				buBays.Width,
				buBays.MinimumDepth,
				buBays.MaximumDepth,
				buBays.Height,
				pallets.PalletPK, 
				pallets.PalletStart, 
				pallets.PalletEnd,
				pallets.BayPosition, 
				isnull(gapRight.PalletStart - pallets.PalletEnd,0) as GapBetweenPallets, 
				case isnull(gapRight.PalletStart,0) when 0 then null else pallets.BayPosition + 1 END as GapBetweenPalletsBayPosition,
				case isnull(gapRight.PalletStart,0) when 0 then null else pallets.PalletEnd END as GapBetweenPalletsPalletStart,
				case when pallets.BayPosition = lastPallet.BayPosition then (buBays.Width - lastPallet.PalletEnd) else 0 End as GapToEndOfBay, /*Only Show this for last pallet*/
				case isnull(lastPallet.PalletEnd, 0) when 0 then null else lastPallet.BayPosition + 1 END as EndBayPosition,
				case isnull(lastPallet.PalletEnd, 0) when 0 then null else lastPallet.PalletEnd END as EndBayPalletStart,
				case when pallets.BayPosition = firstPallet.BayPosition then firstPallet.PalletStart else 0 End as GapToStartOfBay,
				case isnull(firstPallet.PalletStart, 0) when 0 then null else 1 END as StartBayPosition,
				0 as StartBayPalletStart,
				case isnull(pallets.PalletPK,0) when 0 then buBays.Width else 0 End as GapWholeBay,
				case isnull(pallets.PalletPK, 0) when 0 then 1 else 0 END as WholeBayPosition,
				0 as WholeBayPalletStart,
				HasSameStockItem.StockItemContentFound,
				HasStackedStock.StackedContentFound,
				sibubs.StockItemBuildingUnitBayPK, sibubs.IsExclusive as IsStockItemLocationExclusive
			from (Select BuildingUnitBayPK, BuildingUnitColumnFK, BayLevel, case when @isStackable = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ then (floor(Width/@width)*@width) 
			* floor(Height/@height) when @isDepthStackable = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ then (floor(Width/@width)*@width) * floor(Height/@height) 
			* floor(MaximumDepth/@depth) else Width End as Width , MaximumDepth, MinimumDepth, Height, MaximumWeight, Barcode, IsArchived from tblBuildingUnitBays) buBays  /*  Add IsArchived to buBays.  DG #DEV-910 Exclude Archived Bays (Rows) */
			inner join tblBuildingUnitColumns buCols on
			buCols.BuildingUnitColumnPK = buBays.BuildingUnitColumnFK
			inner join tblBuildingUnitRows buRows on
			buRows.BuildingUnitRowPK = buCols.BuildingUnitRowFK
	
			left outer join (
				Select buBays.BuildingUnitColumnFK, sum(isnull(ActualUnits, 0)) ColumnWeight
				from (Select * from tblPallets where IsArchived = 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/) pallets
				inner join tblPalletContent pc on
				pc.PalletFK = pallets.PalletPK
				inner join tblStockItems sis on
				sis.StockItemPK = pc.StockItemFK
				inner join tblBuildingUnitBays buBays on
				buBays.BuildingUnitBayPK = pallets.LocationFK
				where pallets.BuildingUnitFK = @buildingUnitPK2 AND sis.UnitTypeFK = 2 /*Kilograms*/
				AND buBays.BayLevel <> 'A' /*Dont add ground sitting pallets to the weight!*/
				group by buBays.BuildingUnitColumnFK
			) columnWeight on
			buCols.BuildingUnitColumnPK = columnWeight.BuildingUnitColumnFK

			left outer join (
				Select buBays.BuildingUnitBayPK, sum(isnull(ActualUnits, 0)) BayWeight
				from (Select * from tblPallets where IsArchived = 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/)  pallets
				inner join tblPalletContent pc on
				pc.PalletFK = pallets.PalletPK
				inner join tblStockItems sis on
				sis.StockItemPK = pc.StockItemFK
				inner join tblBuildingUnitBays buBays on
				buBays.BuildingUnitBayPK = pallets.LocationFK
				where pallets.BuildingUnitFK = @buildingUnitPK2 AND sis.UnitTypeFK = 2 /*Kilograms*/
				AND buBays.BayLevel <> 'A'
				group by buBays.BuildingUnitBayPK
			) bayWeight on
			buBays.BuildingUnitBayPK = bayWeight.BuildingUnitBayPK

			left outer join tblStockItemBuildingUnitBays sibubs on
			sibubs.BuildingUnitBayFK = buBays.BuildingUnitBayPK
			AND sibubs.StockItemFK = @stockItemPK2

			left outer join tblDivisionBuildingUnitBays dbubs on
			dbubs.BuildingUnitBayFK = buBays.BuildingUnitBayPK
			AND dbubs.DivisionFK = @divisionFK	

			left outer join (
				Select BuildingUnitBayPK, sum(PalletContent) StockItemContentFound  from (
					Select BuildingUnitBayPK, case when pc.PalletContentPK IS NULL then 0 else 1 End as PalletContent
						from tblBuildingUnitBays buBays
						left outer join tblPallets pallets on
						pallets.LocationFK = buBays.BuildingUnitBayPK
						AND pallets.LocationTypeFK = 1/*Racking*/
						AND pallets.IsArchived = 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/
						left outer join tblPalletContent pc on
						pc.PalletFK = pallets.PalletPK
						AND pc.StockItemFK = 33663 AND pc.Batch = @batch2
				) subQ Group By BuildingUnitBayPK
			) HasSameStockItem on
			HasSameStockItem.BuildingUnitBayPK = buBays.BuildingUnitBayPK

			left outer join (
				Select BuildingUnitBayPK, sum(StackedContent) StackedContentFound  from (
					Select BuildingUnitBayPK, case when sis.StockItemPK IS NULL then 0 else 1 End as StackedContent
						from tblBuildingUnitBays buBays
						left outer join tblPallets pallets on
						pallets.LocationFK = buBays.BuildingUnitBayPK
						AND pallets.LocationTypeFK = 1/*Racking*/
						AND pallets.IsArchived = 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/
						left outer join tblPalletContent pc on
						pc.PalletFK = pallets.PalletPK
						left outer join tblStockItems sis on
						sis.StockItemPK = pc.StockItemFK
						AND (IsStackable = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ OR IsDepthStackable = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/) 
				) subQ Group By BuildingUnitBayPK
			) HasStackedStock on
			HasStackedStock.BuildingUnitBayPK = buBays.BuildingUnitBayPK

			left outer join (
				Select plts.PalletPK, LocationTypeFK, LocationFK, PalletTypeFK, BayPosition + isnull(locationMovements.NumberOfMovements, 0) as BayPosition, 
				PalletStart, PalletEnd, StackPosition
				From (Select * from tblPallets  where IsArchived = 0) plts
				left outer join (
					Select PalletPK, count(*) NumberOfMovements from tblPallets subPallets1
					inner join tblWorksOrderMovements subWoms1 on
					subWoms1.WorksOrderStatusFK < 3 /*Not complete or cancelled*/
					AND subWoms1.DestinationLocationTypeFK = 1/*Racking*/
					AND subWoms1.DestinationFK = subPallets1.LocationFK
					AND subWoms1.DestinationPalletEnd <= subPallets1.PalletStart
					Group By PalletPK
				)locationMovements on
				locationMovements.PalletPK = plts.PalletPK

				Union
				Select PalletFK, DestinationLocationTypeFK, DestinationFK, palletsUnion.PalletTypeFK, DestinationBayPosition, DestinationPalletStart, 
				DestinationPalletEnd, 0 as StackPosition
				From tblWorksOrderMovements woms
					inner join tblPallets palletsUnion  on
					palletsUnion.PalletPK = woms.PalletFK
					AND palletsUnion.IsArchived = 0
					Where woms.WorksOrderStatusFK < 3 /*Not complete or cancelled*/
				Union
				Select -1, 1 /*LocationType*/, BuildingUnitBayFK, -1, isnull(max(BayPosition), 0), /*The obstructions have to be mirrored !!*/
				case when buRows.LocateFromLeft = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ then ObstructionStart else buBays.Width - ObstructionEnd End as ObstructionStart, 
				case when buRows.LocateFromLeft = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ then ObstructionEnd else buBays.Width - ObstructionStart end as ObstructionEnd, 0 /*Stack Position*/
				from tblBuildingUnitBayObstructions bubos
				inner join tblBuildingUnitBays buBays on
				buBays.BuildingUnitBayPK = bubos.BuildingUnitBayFK
				inner join tblBuildingUnitColumns buCols on
				buCols.BuildingUnitColumnPK = buBays.BuildingUnitColumnFK
				inner join tblBuildingUnitRows buRows on
				buRows.BuildingUnitRowPK = buCols.BuildingUnitRowFK
				left outer join 
					(
						Select LocationFK, BayPosition, PalletStart, PalletEnd
						From (Select * from tblPallets  where IsArchived = 0) pallets 
						Union
						Select DestinationFK, DestinationBayPosition, DestinationPalletStart, DestinationPalletEnd
						From tblWorksOrderMovements woms
							inner join tblPallets palletsUnion  on
							palletsUnion.PalletPK = woms.PalletFK
							AND palletsUnion.IsArchived = 0
							Where woms.WorksOrderStatusFK < 3 /*Not complete or cancelled*/ 
					) bayPosition on
					bayPosition.LocationFK = bubos.BuildingUnitBayFK
					AND bayPosition.PalletEnd <= case when buRows.LocateFromLeft = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ then ObstructionStart else buBays.Width - ObstructionEnd End
					Group By BuildingUnitBayFK, LocateFromLeft, buBays.Width, ObstructionStart, ObstructionEnd
			) pallets on
			pallets.LocationTypeFK = 1
			AND pallets.StackPosition <= 0
			AND pallets.LocationFK = buBays.BuildingUnitBayPK

			left outer join (
				Select PalletPK, LocationTypeFK, LocationFK, PalletTypeFK, BayPosition, PalletStart, PalletEnd, StackPosition
				From (Select * from tblPallets  where IsArchived = 0) pallets 
				Union
				Select PalletFK, DestinationLocationTypeFK, DestinationFK, palletsUnion.PalletTypeFK, DestinationBayPosition, DestinationPalletStart, 
				DestinationPalletEnd, 0 as StackPosition
				From tblWorksOrderMovements woms
					inner join tblPallets palletsUnion  on
					palletsUnion.PalletPK = woms.PalletFK
					AND palletsUnion.IsArchived = 0
					Where woms.WorksOrderStatusFK < 3 /*Not complete or cancelled*/
				Union
				Select -1, 1 /*LocationType*/, BuildingUnitBayFK, -1, isnull(max(BayPosition), 0), case when buRows.LocateFromLeft = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ 
				then ObstructionStart else buBays.Width - ObstructionEnd End as ObstructionStart, case when buRows.LocateFromLeft = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ 
				then ObstructionEnd else buBays.Width - ObstructionStart end as ObstructionEnd, 0 /*Stack Position*/
				from tblBuildingUnitBayObstructions bubos
				inner join (
					/*Had to augment Width to allow for Stacking*/
					Select BuildingUnitBayPK, BuildingUnitColumnFK, BayLevel, Width + (cast(@isDepthStackable as int) * (Width * floor(MaximumDepth/@depth) 
					* floor(Height/@height))) as Width, MaximumDepth, MinimumDepth, Height, MaximumWeight  from tblBuildingUnitBays
				)buBays on
				buBays.BuildingUnitBayPK = bubos.BuildingUnitBayFK
				inner join tblBuildingUnitColumns buCols on
				buCols.BuildingUnitColumnPK = buBays.BuildingUnitColumnFK
				inner join tblBuildingUnitRows buRows on
				buRows.BuildingUnitRowPK = buCols.BuildingUnitRowFK
				left outer join 
					(
						Select LocationFK, BayPosition, PalletStart, PalletEnd
						From (Select * from tblPallets  where IsArchived = 0) pallets  
						Union
						Select DestinationFK, DestinationBayPosition, DestinationPalletStart, DestinationPalletEnd
						From tblWorksOrderMovements woms
							inner join tblPallets palletsUnion  on
							palletsUnion.PalletPK = woms.PalletFK
							AND palletsUnion.IsArchived = 0
							Where woms.WorksOrderStatusFK < 3 /*Not complete or cancelled*/ 
					) bayPosition on
					bayPosition.LocationFK = bubos.BuildingUnitBayFK
					AND bayPosition.PalletEnd <= case when buRows.LocateFromLeft = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ then ObstructionStart else buBays.Width - ObstructionEnd End
					Group By BuildingUnitBayFK, LocateFromLeft, buBays.Width, ObstructionStart, ObstructionEnd
			) gapRight on
			gapRight.LocationTypeFK = 1
			AND gapRight.StackPosition <= 0
			AND gapRight.LocationFK = pallets.LocationFK
			AND gapRight.PalletStart = (Select Top 1 PalletStart From (Select PalletStart, LocationFK From tblPallets union Select DestinationPalletStart, 
			DestinationFK from tblWorksOrderMovements where WorksOrderStatusFK < 3 union Select ObstructionStart, BuildingUnitBayFK 
			from tblBuildingUnitBayObstructions)subQNoName where LocationFK = pallets.LocationFK AND PalletStart >= pallets.PalletEnd order by PalletStart ASC)
			AND gapRight.PalletStart <> pallets.PalletEnd

			left outer join (Select count(*) BayPosition, LocationTypeFK, LocationFK, case when StackPosition <= 0 then 0 else StackPosition end as StackPosition, 
			case when Max(ObstructionEnd) > Max(PalletEnd) then Max(isnull(ObstructionEnd, 0)) else Max(PalletEnd) end as PalletEnd
			from (
				Select PalletPK, LocationTypeFK, LocationFK, PalletTypeFK, BayPosition, PalletStart, PalletEnd, StackPosition
				From (Select * from tblPallets  where IsArchived = 0) pallets  
				Union
				Select PalletFK, DestinationLocationTypeFK, DestinationFK, palletsUnion.PalletTypeFK, DestinationBayPosition, DestinationPalletStart, 
				DestinationPalletEnd, 0 as StackPosition
				From tblWorksOrderMovements woms
					inner join tblPallets palletsUnion  on
					palletsUnion.PalletPK = woms.PalletFK
					AND palletsUnion.IsArchived = 0
					Where woms.WorksOrderStatusFK < 3 /*Not complete or cancelled*/
				) subQLastPallets
				left outer join (--this join gets obstructions after the last pallet, this change has come about as a cell with movements was not calculating the last bay position correctly, it needed a count instead of max- because of this, obstructions need to be done differently
					Select BuildingUnitBayFK, 
					Max(case when buRows.LocateFromLeft = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ then ObstructionStart else buBays.Width - ObstructionEnd end) as ObstructionStart, 
					Max(case when buRows.LocateFromLeft = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ then ObstructionEnd else buBays.Width - ObstructionStart end) as ObstructionEnd
					from tblBuildingUnitBayObstructions bubos
					inner join tblBuildingUnitBays buBays on
					buBays.BuildingUnitBayPK = bubos.BuildingUnitBayFK
					inner join tblBuildingUnitColumns buCols on
					buCols.BuildingUnitColumnPK = buBays.BuildingUnitColumnFK
					inner join tblBuildingUnitRows buRows on
					buRows.BuildingUnitRowPK = buCols.BuildingUnitRowFK
					Group By BuildingUnitBayFK
				)lastObstruction on
				lastObstruction.BuildingUnitBayFK = subQLastPallets.LocationFK
				AND subQLastPallets.PalletEnd <= lastObstruction.ObstructionStart
				AND subQLastPallets.PalletEnd + @width > lastObstruction.ObstructionStart
				Group By LocationTypeFK, LocationFK, case when StackPosition <= 0 then 0 else StackPosition end) lastPallet on
			lastPallet.LocationTypeFK = 1
			AND lastPallet.StackPosition <= 0
			AND lastPallet.LocationFK = pallets.LocationFK
			AND lastPallet.PalletEnd <> buBays.Width

			left outer join (Select Min(BayPosition) BayPosition, LocationTypeFK, LocationFK, StackPosition, Min(PalletStart) as PalletStart 
				from (
				Select PalletPK, LocationTypeFK, LocationFK, PalletTypeFK, BayPosition, PalletStart, PalletEnd, StackPosition
				From (Select * from tblPallets  where IsArchived = 0) pallets  
				Union
				Select PalletFK, DestinationLocationTypeFK, DestinationFK, palletsUnion.PalletTypeFK, DestinationBayPosition, DestinationPalletStart, 
				DestinationPalletEnd, 0 as StackPosition
				From tblWorksOrderMovements woms
					inner join tblPallets palletsUnion  on
					palletsUnion.PalletPK = woms.PalletFK
					AND palletsUnion.IsArchived = 0
					Where woms.WorksOrderStatusFK < 3 /*Not complete or cancelled*/
				Union
				Select -1, 1 /*LocationType*/, BuildingUnitBayFK, -1, isnull(max(BayPosition), 0), case when buRows.LocateFromLeft = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ 
				then ObstructionStart else buBays.Width - ObstructionEnd End as ObstructionStart, case when buRows.LocateFromLeft = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ 
				then ObstructionEnd else buBays.Width - ObstructionStart end as ObstructionEnd, 0 /*Stack Position*/
				from tblBuildingUnitBayObstructions bubos
				inner join tblBuildingUnitBays buBays on
				buBays.BuildingUnitBayPK = bubos.BuildingUnitBayFK
				inner join tblBuildingUnitColumns buCols on
				buCols.BuildingUnitColumnPK = buBays.BuildingUnitColumnFK
				inner join tblBuildingUnitRows buRows on
				buRows.BuildingUnitRowPK = buCols.BuildingUnitRowFK
				left outer join 
					(
						Select LocationFK, BayPosition, PalletStart, PalletEnd
						From (Select * from tblPallets  where IsArchived = 0) pallets 
						Union
						Select DestinationFK, DestinationBayPosition, DestinationPalletStart, DestinationPalletEnd
						From tblWorksOrderMovements woms
							inner join tblPallets palletsUnion  on
							palletsUnion.PalletPK = woms.PalletFK
							AND palletsUnion.IsArchived = 0
							Where woms.WorksOrderStatusFK < 3 /*Not complete or cancelled*/ 
					) bayPosition on
					bayPosition.LocationFK = bubos.BuildingUnitBayFK
					AND bayPosition.PalletEnd <= case when buRows.LocateFromLeft = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ then ObstructionStart else buBays.Width - ObstructionEnd End
					Group By BuildingUnitBayFK, LocateFromLeft, buBays.Width, ObstructionStart, ObstructionEnd
			) subQfirstPallet 
				Group By LocationTypeFK, LocationFK, StackPosition) firstPallet on
			firstPallet.LocationTypeFK = 1
			AND firstPallet.StackPosition <= 0
			AND firstPallet.PalletStart <> 0
			AND firstPallet.LocationFK = pallets.LocationFK

			Where buRows.BuildingUnitFK = @buildingUnitPK2
			AND buRows.RackingTypeFK = @autoRackingTypeFK
			AND ASCII(buBays.BayLevel) - 64 < /*Not Top Level*/
				Case when @prohibitTopLevelRacking = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ Then buCols.Levels Else 99999 End
			AND ASCII(buBays.BayLevel) <= 
				Case when @unstable1 = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ Then 67 /*Less than or equal to Level C*/
				Else 99999 End
			AND ASCII(buBays.BayLevel) <= 
				Case when @unstable2 = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ Then 66 /*Less than or equal to Level B*/
				Else 99999 End
			AND ASCII(buBays.BayLevel) <= 
				Case when @unstable3 = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ Then 65 /*Level A Only*/
				Else 99999 End
			AND ASCII(buBays.BayLevel) >= 
				Case when @levelC_Above = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ Then 67 /*Greater than or equal to Level C*/
				Else 0 End
			AND ASCII(buBays.BayLevel) > 
				Case when @allowFloorStorage = 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/ Then 65 /*Not on the floor/ Greater than A*/
				Else 0 End
			AND buBays.IsArchived = 0 /* DG #DEV-910 Exclude Archived Bays (Rows)*/
			) subQ

			Where /*Check for this divisions assigned bays*/
					(	
						BuildingUnitBayPK in 
						(Select sibuBays.BuildingUnitBayFK From tblStockItemBuildingUnitBays sibuBays
						 Where StockItemFK = @stockItemPK2 AND sibuBays.BuildingUnitFK = @buildingUnitPK2 AND sibuBays.IsArchived = 0) /* DG #DEV-543 Exclude tblStockItemBuildingUnitBays Archived Bays*/
						OR
						(BuildingUnitBayPK in (Select dbuBays.BuildingUnitBayFK from tblDivisionBuildingUnitBays dbuBays
											   Where DivisionFK = @divisionFK AND dbuBays.BuildingUnitFK = @buildingUnitPK2 AND dbuBays.IsArchived = 0)  /* DG #DEV-543 Exclude tblDivisionBuildingUnitBays Archived Bays*/
						 AND @stockItemBuildingUnitBays = 0)
						OR 
						((0 = (Select count(*) From tblDivisionBuildingUnitBays Where DivisionFK = @divisionFK AND BuildingUnitFK = @buildingUnitPK2 AND IsArchived = 0))  /* DG #DEV-543 Exclude tblDivisionBuildingUnitBays Archived Bays*/
						 AND @stockItemBuildingUnitBays = 0)
					)
				  /*Check this bay is not assigned to any other division*/
				AND BuildingUnitBayPK not in 
					(Select dbuBays.BuildingUnitBayFK 
					 From tblDivisionBuildingUnitBays dbuBays
					 Where DivisionFK <> @divisionFK AND dbuBays.BuildingUnitFK = @buildingUnitPK2 AND dbuBays.IsExclusive = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ AND dbuBays.IsArchived = 0 )	/* DG #DEV-543 Exclude tblDivisionBuildingUnitBays Archived Bays*/
				/*Check this bay is not assigned to any other stock item*/
				AND BuildingUnitBayPK not in 
					(Select sibuBays.BuildingUnitBayFK 
					 From tblStockItemBuildingUnitBays sibuBays
					 Where StockItemFK <> @stockItemPK2 AND sibuBays.BuildingUnitFK = @buildingUnitPK2 AND sibuBays.IsExclusive = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ AND sibuBays.IsArchived = 0)	/* DG #DEV-543 Exclude tblStockItemBuildingUnitBays Archived Bays*/
				/*Check if we are assigning and alternate location and that we havent tried this location already*/
				AND (@worksOrderMovementFK2 = -1 OR (BuildingUnitBayPK not in (Select BuildingUnitBayFK from tblWorksOrderMovementFailures 
				Where WorksOrderMovementFK = @worksOrderMovementFK2)))
				/*Gap Checks*/
				AND (GapBetweenPallets >=@width
				OR GapToEndOfBay >= @width
				OR GapToStartOfBay >= @width
				OR GapWholeBay >= @width)
			AND (MaximumDepth >= @depth /*Maximum Depth*/
			
			AND (
				(@isStackable = 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/ AND @isDepthStackable = 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/ AND MinimumDepth <= @depth)
				OR (
					(@isStackable = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ OR @isDepthStackable = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/) AND MinimumDepth <= @depth) 
					)
				) /*Minimum Depth*/
			
			AND Height >= @height
			AND (BayWeight < MaximumBayWeight OR MaximumBayWeight = 0)
			AND (ColumnWeight < MaximumColumnWeight OR MaximumColumnWeight = 0)
			AND ((@isStackable = 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/ and @isDepthStackable = 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/ AND StackedContentFound = 0)
				OR
				(@isStackable = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ OR @isDepthStackable = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/)
			)
			) mySUBQ
			ORDER BY
				--CHECK EXCLUSIVE STOCK LOCATIONS
				CASE WHEN StockItemBuildingUnitBayPK = 0 then 0 else case when IsStockItemLocationExclusive = 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/ then 2 else 3 end end DESC,
				--CHECK STACKING
				CASE WHEN @isStackable = 1 OR @isDepthStackable = 1 THEN StockItemContentFound END DESC,
				--CLAUSE 1
				CASE WHEN @orderBy1 = 'Row Priority1' THEN Row END ASC,
				CASE WHEN @orderBy1 = 'Row Priority2' THEN Row END DESC,
				CASE WHEN @orderBy1 = 'Column Priority1' THEN BuildingUnitColumn END ASC,
				CASE WHEN @orderBy1 = 'Column Priority2' THEN BuildingUnitColumn END DESC,
				CASE WHEN @orderBy1 = 'Level Priority1' THEN BayLevel END DESC,
				CASE WHEN @orderBy1 = 'Level Priority2' THEN BayLevel END ASC,
				CASE WHEN @orderBy1 = 'Efficient Use Of Height-1' THEN LocationOrder END ASC,
				--CLAUSE 2
				CASE WHEN @orderBy2 = 'Row Priority1' THEN Row END ASC,
				CASE WHEN @orderBy2 = 'Row Priority2' THEN Row END DESC,
				CASE WHEN @orderBy2 = 'Column Priority1' THEN BuildingUnitColumn END ASC,
				CASE WHEN @orderBy2 = 'Column Priority2' THEN BuildingUnitColumn END DESC,
				CASE WHEN @orderBy2 = 'Level Priority1' THEN BayLevel END DESC,
				CASE WHEN @orderBy2 = 'Level Priority2' THEN BayLevel END ASC,
				CASE WHEN @orderBy2 = 'Efficient Use Of Height-1' THEN LocationOrder END ASC,
				--CHECK IF DRIVE THRU
				CASE WHEN RackingTypeFK = 2 /*DRIVETHRU*/ THEN BayLevel END DESC,
				--CLAUSE 3
				CASE WHEN @orderBy3 = 'Row Priority1' THEN Row END ASC,
				CASE WHEN @orderBy3 = 'Row Priority2' THEN Row END DESC,
				CASE WHEN @orderBy3 = 'Column Priority1' THEN BuildingUnitColumn END ASC,
				CASE WHEN @orderBy3 = 'Column Priority2' THEN BuildingUnitColumn END DESC,
				CASE WHEN @orderBy3 = 'Level Priority1' THEN BayLevel END DESC,
				CASE WHEN @orderBy3 = 'Level Priority2' THEN BayLevel END ASC,
				CASE WHEN @orderBy3 = 'Efficient Use Of Height-1' THEN LocationOrder END ASC,
				--CLAUSE 4
				CASE WHEN @orderBy4 = 'Row Priority1' THEN Row END ASC,
				CASE WHEN @orderBy4 = 'Row Priority2' THEN Row END DESC,
				CASE WHEN @orderBy4 = 'Column Priority1' THEN BuildingUnitColumn END ASC,
				CASE WHEN @orderBy4 = 'Column Priority2' THEN BuildingUnitColumn END DESC,
				CASE WHEN @orderBy4 = 'Level Priority1' THEN BayLevel END DESC,
				CASE WHEN @orderBy4 = 'Level Priority2' THEN BayLevel END ASC,
				CASE WHEN @orderBy4 = 'Efficient Use Of Height-1' THEN LocationOrder END ASC,
				PalletStart ASC --This makes sure we look at gaps from left to right
		
				--LocationOrder ASC, BuildingUnitColumn DESC, Row DESC, BayLevel ASC

			Declare @buildingUnitBayPK int, @maximumBayWeight decimal(18,3), @bayWeight decimal(18,3),
			@rackingTypeFK int, @buildingUnitRow nvarchar(10), @buildingUnitRowNumber int, 
			@translateRow bit, @translatedRow nvarchar(50), @reverseTranslate bit, @translateColumn int,
			@buildingUnitColumn int, @buildingUnitColumnName nvarchar(50), @maximumColumnWeight decimal(18,3), @columnWeight decimal(18,3), @buildingUnitBayLevel nvarchar(10), 
			@gapBetweenPallets int, @gapBetweenPalletsBayPosition int, @gapBetweenPalletsPalletStart int, 
			@gapToEndOfBay int, @endBayPosition int, @endBayPalletStart int, 
			@gapToStartOfBay int, @startBayPosition int, @startBayPalletStart int, 
			@gapWholeBay int, @wholeBayPosition int, @wholeBayPalletStart int, 
			@locationOrder int, @palletStartCur int, @stockItemContentFound int, @stackedContentFound int,
			@stockItemBuildingUnitBayPK int, @isStockItemLocationExclusive bit

			Declare @previousBuildingUnitColumn int -- for keeping batches together
			Declare @previousBuildingUnitColumnForWeight int
			Declare @previousBuildingUnitBayPK int
			Declare @runningColumnWeight decimal(18,3), @runningBayWeight decimal(18,3)

			OPEN BayCursor
		
			FETCH NEXT FROM BayCursor INTO 
			@buildingUnitBayPK, @maximumBayWeight, @bayWeight,
			@rackingTypeFK, @buildingUnitRow, @buildingUnitRowNumber, 
			@translateRow, @translatedRow, @reverseTranslate, @translateColumn,
			@buildingUnitColumn, @buildingUnitColumnName, @maximumColumnWeight, @columnWeight, @buildingUnitBayLevel, 
			@gapBetweenPallets, @gapBetweenPalletsBayPosition, @gapBetweenPalletsPalletStart, 
			@gapToEndOfBay, @endBayPosition, @endBayPalletStart, 
			@gapToStartOfBay, @startBayPosition, @startBayPalletStart, 
			@gapWholeBay, @wholeBayPosition, @wholeBayPalletStart, 
			@locationOrder, @palletStartCur, @stockItemContentFound, @stackedContentFound,
			@stockItemBuildingUnitBayPK, @isStockItemLocationExclusive

			Declare @availableSpace bit
			Declare @availableGap int
			Declare @bayPosition int
			Declare @palletStart int
			Declare @gapType as nvarchar(50)/* whole, between, start, end*/
			Declare @firstRun int
			Set @firstRun = 1
			Set @availableSpace = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/
			--Print @@FETCH_STATUS
			Set @originalNumberOfLocations = @numberOfLocations2
			Set @previousBuildingUnitColumn = -1
			Set @previousBuildingUnitColumnForWeight = -1
			Set @previousBuildingUnitBayPK = -1
	
			Set @currentRow = -1

			DECLARE @myLocationBayPositions TABLE
			(
				LocationFK INT,
				BayPosition INT,
				PalletStart INT
			)

			DECLARE @myLocations TABLE 
			( 
				RowNumber INT, 
				RowLetter nvarchar(50),
				ColumnNumber INT,
				Sql text 
			)
	
			WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 AND @numberOfLocations2 > 0
			BEGIN
				Print 'Began Loop'
				Print 'LocationHeight ' + cast(@locationOrder as nvarchar(50))
				if (@currentRow = -1) Set @currentRow = @buildingUnitRowNumber
				--if the row has moved on and we still have pallets to locate, we must reset as we dont want a run of stock/batch in different rows
				if (@keepBatchTogetherLevel3 = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ AND @buildingUnitRowNumber > @currentRow)	BEGIN
					Select @sql = '', @numberOfLocations2 = @originalNumberOfLocations, @currentRow = @buildingUnitRowNumber, @firstRun = 1
				END
		--		Took this section out.. locations may skip rows to adhere to rules!
		--		if (@currentRow > @buildingUnitRowNumber) 
		--		BEGIN
		--			Print 'Row Business 1'
		--			goto Skip --if we are looking for a different row, skip
		--		END
		--		ELSE
		--		BEGIN --we have moved on to the row we were looking for or the row has moved past the row we were looking for (either no gaps or row is not assigned to division), so set the row
		--			Print 'Row Business 2'
		--			Set @currentRow = @buildingUnitRowNumber
		--		END
			
				Print isnull(@gapWholeBay, -1)
				Print isnull(@gapBetweenPalletsPalletStart, -1)
				Print isnull(@gapBetweenPallets, -1)
				Print isnull(@gapToStartOfBay, -1)
				Print isnull(@endBayPalletStart, -1)
				Print isnull(@gapToEndOfBay, -1)

				Set @availableSpace = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ 
		
				IF (@gapWholeBay > 0) 
				BEGIN
					Print 'Whole Bay'
					Set @bayPosition = 1
					Set @palletStart = 0
					Set @availableGap = @gapWholeBay
					Set @gapType = 'whole'
				END	
				ELSE IF (@gapToStartOfBay >= @width) 
				BEGIN
					Print 'Start of bay'

					--If stacking only allow the same stock and batch in the cell. Nothing else will get into this cell
					IF((@isStackable = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ OR @isDepthStackable = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/) AND @stockItemContentFound = 0) 
						SET @availableSpace = 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/ 

					Set @bayPosition = @startBayPosition
					Set @palletStart = 0
					Set @availableGap = @gapToStartOfBay
					Set @gapType = 'start'
					Set @endBayPosition = @endBayPosition + 1
					Set @gapBetweenPalletsBayPosition = @gapBetweenPalletsBayPosition + 1
					Print 'Incremented between and end bay positions'
					Print @endBayPosition
				END 
				ELSE IF @gapBetweenPallets >= @width 
				BEGIN
					Print 'Between'

					--If stacking only allow the same stock and batch in the cell. Nothing else will get into this cell
					IF((@isStackable = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ OR @isDepthStackable = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/) AND @stockItemContentFound = 0) 
						SET @availableSpace = 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/ 

					Set @bayPosition = @gapBetweenPalletsBayPosition
					Set @palletStart = @gapBetweenPalletsPalletStart
					Set @availableGap = @gapBetweenPallets
					Set @gapType = 'between'
					Print 'Bay Position ' + cast(@bayPosition as nvarchar(50))
					Print 'PalletStart ' + cast(@gapBetweenPalletsPalletStart as nvarchar(50))
					Print 'Gap width ' + cast(@gapBetweenPallets as nvarchar(50))
				END	
				ELSE IF (@gapToEndOfBay >= @width) 
				BEGIN
					Print 'End of Bay'

					--If stacking only allow the same stock and batch in the cell. Nothing else will get into this cell
					IF((@isStackable = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ OR @isDepthStackable = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/) AND @stockItemContentFound = 0) 
						SET @availableSpace = 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/ 

					Set @bayPosition = @endBayPosition
					Set @palletStart = @endBayPalletStart
					Set @availableGap = @gapToEndOfBay
					Set @gapType = 'end'
				END
		
		
				WHILE @availableSpace = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ AND @numberOfLocations2 > 0
				BEGIN
					Print 'Began 2nd Loop'
		--			Print @buildingUnitRow
					--******* WEIGHT CODE ************
					IF(@restrictStockWeight = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ AND @maximumColumnWeight > 0 AND @buildingUnitBayLevel <> 'A')
					BEGIN
						Print 'weight1'
						IF(@previousBuildingUnitColumnForWeight <> @buildingUnitColumn)	
						BEGIN
							Set @runningColumnWeight = @units2
						END 
						ELSE 
						BEGIN
							Set @runningColumnWeight = @runningColumnWeight + @units2
						END
						Set @previousBuildingUnitColumnForWeight = @buildingUnitColumn
						if(@previousBuildingUnitBayPK <> @buildingUnitBayPK)
						BEGIN
							Set @runningBayWeight = @units2
						END ELSE
						BEGIN
							Set @runningBayWeight = @runningBayWeight + @units2
						END
						Set @previousBuildingUnitBayPK = @buildingUnitBayPK
						--If the current located weight + what we have added already + what we want to add is greater than the limit, skip the location
						IF((@columnWeight + @runningColumnWeight) > @maximumColumnWeight
							OR
							(@bayWeight + @runningBayWeight) > @maximumBayWeight)
						BEGIN
							print 'weight too much!'
							goto Skip --we have gone over the weight limit for this column or bay, skip it
						END
					END
					--****** END OF WEIGHT CODE ************
		--			Print 'Column Weight ' + cast(@columnWeight as nvarchar(50))
		--			Print 'Running Column Weight ' + cast(@runningColumnWeight as nvarchar(50))
			
			
					--Check for duplicates
					IF(EXISTS(Select * from @myLocationBayPositions where LocationFK = @buildingUnitBayPK AND PalletStart = @palletStart)) 
					BEGIN
						Set @availableSpace = 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/
						goto skipLocation --this location has come into a duplicate pallet location so just skip out of the location
					END ELSE BEGIN
						if @firstRun = 0 
						BEGIN
							Set @sql = @sql + ' UNION ALL '
						END	
						ELSE 
						BEGIN
							Set @startColumn = @buildingUnitColumn
						END
						IF(EXISTS(Select * from @myLocationBayPositions where LocationFK = @buildingUnitBayPK AND BayPosition = @bayPosition)) 
						BEGIN
							IF((Select PalletStart from @myLocationBayPositions where LocationFK = @buildingUnitBayPK AND BayPosition = @bayPosition) < @palletStart) 
							BEGIN
								Set @bayPosition = @bayPosition + 1
							END 
						END

						--New Code to deal with already positioned pallets between this placing pallets
		--				IF(EXISTS(Select * from @myLocationBayPositions where LocationFK = @buildingUnitBayPK AND BayPosition < @bayPosition)) BEGIN
		--					IF((Select Top 1 PalletStart from @myLocationBayPositions where LocationFK = @buildingUnitBayPK AND BayPosition < @bayPosition Order By PalletStart DESC) <> (@palletStart + @width)) BEGIN
		--						Set @bayPosition = @bayPosition + (Select count(*) from @myLocationBayPositions where LocationFK = @buildingUnitBayPK AND BayPosition < @bayPosition)
		--					END 
		--				END				

						--Select @tmpBayPositionAdjust = count(*) from @myLocationBayPositions where DestinationFK=@buildingUnitBayPK AND DestinationBayPosition < @bayPosition)
						Set @thisLineSql = ' Select ''' + @buildingUnit + ''' BuildingUnit,''' + case when @translateRow = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ then @translatedRow 
						else @buildingUnitRow end + ''' Row,''' + case when @translateRow = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ then case when @reverseTranslate = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ 
						then cast(@translateColumn - @buildingUnitColumn as nvarchar(10)) else cast(@buildingUnitColumn + @translateColumn as nvarchar(10)) end else 
						cast(@buildingUnitColumn as nvarchar(10)) end + ''' BuildingUnitColumn,''' + case when @translateRow = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ then 
						case when @reverseTranslate = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ then cast(@translateColumn - @buildingUnitColumn as nvarchar(10)) 
						else cast(@buildingUnitColumn + @translateColumn as nvarchar(10)) end else cast(@buildingUnitColumn as nvarchar(10)) end 
						+ ''' BuildingUnitColumnName,''' + @buildingUnitBayLevel + ''' BayLevel,' + cast(@bayPosition as nvarchar(50))	+ ' BayPosition,' 
						+ cast(@palletStart as nvarchar(50)) + ' PalletStart,' + cast((@palletStart + @width) as nvarchar(50)) + ' PalletEnd,' 
						+ cast(@buildingUnitBayPK as nvarchar(100)) + ' LocationFK'	

						Insert into @myLocationBayPositions values (@buildingUnitBayPK, @bayPosition, @palletStart)
					END
					--Print 'Boom'
					Set @sql = @sql	+ @thisLineSql
					Print @thisLineSql
			
					Set @availableGap = @availableGap - @width
					if (@availableGap < @width) 
					BEGIN
						IF (@gapType = 'whole')
							Set @availableSpace = 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/
						ELSE IF (@gapType = 'start') 
						BEGIN
							IF @gapBetweenPallets >= @width 
							BEGIN
								Print 'Between'
								Set @bayPosition = @gapBetweenPalletsBayPosition
								Set @palletStart = @gapBetweenPalletsPalletStart
								Set @availableGap = @gapBetweenPallets
								Set @gapType = 'between'
							END ELSE IF (@gapToEndOfBay >= @width) 
							BEGIN
								Print 'Gap to end 2'
								Set @bayPosition = @endBayPosition
								Set @palletStart = @endBayPalletStart
								Set @availableGap = @gapToEndOfBay
								Set @gapType = 'end'
							END ELSE BEGIN
								Print 'end 1'
								Set @availableSpace = 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/	
							END
						END	ELSE IF (@gapType = 'between') 
						BEGIN
							IF (@gapToEndOfBay >= @width) 
							BEGIN
								Print 'Gap to end 3'
								Set @bayPosition = @endBayPosition
								Set @palletStart = @endBayPalletStart
								Set @availableGap = @gapToEndOfBay
								Set @gapType = 'end'
								Print @bayPosition
							END	ELSE BEGIN
								Print 'end 2'
								Set @availableSpace = 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/	
							END
						END	ELSE IF (@gapType = 'end') 
						BEGIN
							Print 'end 3'
							Set @availableSpace = 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/	
						END				
		--				ELSE IF (@gapType = 'between')
		--				BEGIN
		--					IF (@gapToStartOfBay >= @width)
		--					BEGIN
		--						Print 'Start of bay 2'
		--						Set @bayPosition = @startBayPosition
		--						Set @palletStart = 0
		--						Set @availableGap = @gapToStartOfBay
		--						Set @gapType = 'start'
		--					END
		--					ELSE IF (@gapToEndOfBay >= @width)
		--					BEGIN
		--						Print 'Gap to end 2'
		--						Set @bayPosition = @endBayPosition
		--						Set @palletStart = @endBayPalletStart
		--						Set @availableGap = @gapToEndOfBay
		--						Set @gapType = 'end'
		--					END
		--					ELSE BEGIN
		--						Print 'end 1'
		--						Set @availableSpace = 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/	
		--					END
		--				END
		--				ELSE IF (@gapType = 'start')
		--				BEGIN
		--					IF (@gapToEndOfBay >= @width)
		--					BEGIN
		--						Print 'Gap to end 3'
		--						Set @bayPosition = @endBayPosition
		--						Set @palletStart = @endBayPalletStart
		--						Set @availableGap = @gapToEndOfBay
		--						Set @gapType = 'end'
		--						Print @bayPosition
		--					END
		--					ELSE BEGIN
		--						Print 'end 2'
		--						Set @availableSpace = 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/	
		--					END
		--				END
		--				ELSE IF (@gapType = 'end')
		--				BEGIN
		--					Print 'end 3'
		--					Set @availableSpace = 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/	
		--				END
			
					END
					ELSE
					BEGIN
						Print 'Increment Bayposition'
						Set @bayPosition = @bayPosition + 1
						Set @endBayPosition = @endBayPosition + 1
						Set @palletStart = @palletStart + @width
						Print @bayPosition
					END
			
					Set @numberOfLocations2 = @numberOfLocations2 - 1
		skipLocation:
					Set @firstRun = 0

					/*KEEP BATCH TOGETHER**************/
					if(@overrideBuildingUnitRules = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/)
					BEGIN
						Print 'Overriding BuildingUnitRules'
						/*Keep batch in one or more adjoining columns*/
						if(@keepBatchTogetherLevel2 = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/)
						BEGIN
							Print 'Batch1'
							if(@previousBuildingUnitColumn = -1)
							BEGIN
								Set @previousBuildingUnitColumn = @buildingUnitColumn
							END
							ELSE
							BEGIN 
								/* This next 'if' statement is complex */
								/* Explanation*/
								/* If we have skipped a column since the last location 
									AND we have also moved more than one column from
									the columns used for a previous batch location
									AND we havent moved just one column since we were last here then
									we need to start again*/
								if(
									((ABS(@previousBuildingUnitColumn - @buildingUnitColumn) > 1 
									AND @previousFirstBuildingUnitColumn2 = -1)
							
									OR 
										(
										(@previousFirstBuildingUnitColumn2 > 0) AND
										((@buildingUnitColumn > (@previousFirstBuildingUnitColumn2 + 1)
										OR
										(@buildingUnitColumn < (@previousLastBuildingUnitColumn2 - 1)))
										)
									))
									AND ABS(@previousBuildingUnitColumn - @buildingUnitColumn) <> 1
								)
								BEGIN /*If selection has jumped a column, reset and start again*/
									Print 'Starting Again'
									Select @previousBuildingUnitColumn = @buildingUnitColumn,
									@numberOfLocations2 = @originalNumberOfLocations - 1,
									@firstRun = 0,
									@sql = @thisLineSql,
									@startColumn = @buildingUnitColumn
								END
							END
						END
					END
				END

				If (@numberOfLocations2 = 0)
				BEGIN
					Print 'Inserting into myLocation'
					Insert into @myLocations
					values (@buildingUnitRowNumber, 
						@buildingUnitRow,
						@startColumn,
						@sql) 
					If (@keepBatchTogetherLevel3 = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ AND @currentRow < @numberOfRows AND @previousLastBuildingUnitRow2 <> @buildingUnitRow) 
					BEGIN
						Print 'Oh dear'
						Set @currentRow = @currentRow + 1
						Set @numberOfLocations2 = @originalNumberOfLocations
						Set @firstRun = 1
						Set @sql = ''
					END
				END
		
		Skip:
				FETCH NEXT FROM BayCursor INTO 
				@buildingUnitBayPK, @maximumBayWeight, @bayWeight,
				@rackingTypeFK, @buildingUnitRow, @buildingUnitRowNumber,
				@translateRow, @translatedRow, @reverseTranslate, @translateColumn,
				@buildingUnitColumn, @buildingUnitColumnName, @maximumColumnWeight, @columnWeight, @buildingUnitBayLevel, 
				@gapBetweenPallets, @gapBetweenPalletsBayPosition, @gapBetweenPalletsPalletStart, 
				@gapToEndOfBay, @endBayPosition, @endBayPalletStart, 
				@gapToStartOfBay, @startBayPosition, @startBayPalletStart, 
				@gapWholeBay, @wholeBayPosition, @wholeBayPalletStart,
				@locationOrder, @palletStartCur, @stockItemContentFound, @stackedContentFound,
				@stockItemBuildingUnitBayPK, @isStockItemLocationExclusive
			END
			CLOSE BayCursor 
			DEALLOCATE BayCursor 
	
	
			Print 'here'
			Set @sql = ''
			IF (@previousLastBuildingUnitRow2 <> '')
			BEGIN
				Print 'here!'
				--Print @previousLastBuildingUnitRow2
				Select @sql = Sql from @myLocations where RowLetter = @previousLastBuildingUnitRow2
			END 
	
			IF(@sql = '') --if we had no previous row OR there was no available locations for the previous row, do regular selection
			BEGIN
				Select Top 1 @sql = Sql from @myLocations
			END
			--Print @sql
			--Print(len(@sql))
			Exec(@sql)
			--Select * from @myLocations
	
			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end
			
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END
GO

(    
 @palletPK int,    
 @toLocationTypeFK int,    
 @locationFK int,    
 @bayPosition int,    
 @stackPosition int = 0    
)     
AS

 SET @var_stackPosition = @stackPosition    
    
 SET @ParameterDetails = '@palletPK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_palletPK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@toLocationTypeFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_toLocationTypeFK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'')     
  + ',@locationFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_locationFK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@bayPosition = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_bayPosition AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'')     
   + ',@stackPosition = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_stackPosition AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'')    
    
    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL     
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)    
    
    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)

            SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC

            SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK    
    
            SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

 SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);    
 SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails    
 ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;    
 INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()    
    
 WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3    
 BEGIN     
  BEGIN TRY    
       
   -- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start    
    
   Declare @divisionFK int, @palletTypeFK int, @width int, @depth int, @height int, @stockItem nvarchar(200), @batch nvarchar(200), @quantity decimal(18,3),     
   @barcode nvarchar(200), @fromLocation nvarchar(200), @fromLocationTypeFK int, @toLocation nvarchar(200)    
   Declare @buildingUnitFK int, @cellLevel nvarchar(10), @buildingUnitColumnPK int, @stockItemPK int    
   --Declare /*@generalWidthMargin int,*/ @heightMargin int, @widthMargin int, @generalDepthMargin int    
   Declare @prohibitTopLevelRacking bit, @allowFloorStorage bit, @levelCAndAbove bit, @buildingUnitBayMaxDepth int, @buildingUnitBayMinDepth int ,@unstable1 bit, @unstable2 bit, @unstable3 bit     
     
   --Select top 1 @heightMargin = GeneralHeightMargin,/* @generalWidthMargin = GeneralWidthMargin,*/ @generalDepthMargin = GeneralDepthMargin    
   --from appSystem    
        
   DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #tmpPalToMove    
   SELECT *    
   INTO #tmpPalToMove    
   FROM tblpallets    
   WHERE PalletPK = @var_palletPK --AND isArchived = 0 AND loaded = 0 and palletStatusFK <> 10    
     
   Select top 1 @divisionFK = sis.DivisionFK,     
    @width = palletTypes.Width + (case when sis.WidthMargin > 0 then (sis.WidthMargin * 2) else (palletTypes.WidthMargin * 2) end),     
    @depth = palletTypes.Depth + (case when sis.DepthMargin > 0 then (sis.DepthMargin * 2) else  (palletTypes.Depthmargin * 2) end),    
    --@height = DefaultHeight,    
    @height = 0,    
    @stockItem = REPLACE(sis.StockItemCode,'"','\"'),    
    @stockItemPK = sis.StockItemPK,    
    /*LJF - Added new variables to make checks*/    
    @prohibitTopLevelRacking = sis.ProhibitTopLevelRacking,    
    @allowFloorStorage = sis.AllowFloorStorage,    
    @levelCAndAbove = sis.LevelC_Above,    
   @unstable1 = sis.Unstable1,    
   @unstable2 = sis.Unstable2,    
   @unstable3 = sis.Unstable3,   
    /*End Of New Variables*/    
    @batch = pc.Batch,    
    @quantity = Quantity,    
    @barcode = pallets.Barcode,    
    @fromLocationTypeFK = pallets.LocationTypeFK,    
    @fromLocation = palletLocation.Location    
   From #tmpPalToMove pallets    
   inner JOIN (    
    Select PalletFK, StockItemFK, Batch, sum(ActualUnits) Quantity    
    From tblPalletContent    
    Group By PalletFK, StockItemFK, Batch    
   ) pc on pc.PalletFK = pallets.PalletPK    
   inner join tblStockItems sis on sis.StockItemPK = pc.StockItemFK    
   inner join tblPallettypes palletTypes on palletTypes.PalletTypePK = pallets.PalletTypeFK    
   INNER JOIN viewPalletLocations palletLocation ON palletLocation.palletPk = pallets.palletPK    
       
   if(@var_toLocationTypeFK = 1 /*Going to Racking*/)     
   BEGIN    
    DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #tmpBuildingUnitBay    
    SELECT *    
    INTO #tmpBuildingUnitBay    
    FROM tblbuildingunitbays    
    WHERE IsArchived = 0 AND buildingunitbaypk = @locationFK    
    
    --Get RackingType    
    Declare @rackingTypeFK int    
    Select     
     @rackingTypeFK = RackingTypeFK,    
     @buildingUnitFK = buRows.BuildingUnitFK,    
     @cellLevel = buBays.BayLevel,    
     @buildingUnitColumnPK = buCols.BuildingUnitColumnPK,    
     @buildingUnitBayMaxDepth = buBays.MaximumDepth,     
     @buildingUnitBayMinDepth = buBays.MinimumDepth    
    From #tmpBuildingUnitBay buBays    
    inner join tblBuildingUnitColumns buCols ON buCols.BuildingUnitColumnPK = buBays.BuildingUnitColumnFK    
    inner join tblBuildingUnitRows buRows ON buRows.BuildingUnitRowPK = buCols.BuildingUnitRowFK    
    Where buBays.BuildingUnitBayPK = @var_locationFK And buBays.IsArchived = 0    
    
    IF(@rackingTypeFK = 1/*Conventional*/)     
    BEGIN    
     /*Make Checks*/    
     /*ProhibitTopLevelRacking*/    
     IF(@prohibitTopLevelRacking = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/)     
     BEGIN    
      /*Top level racking is not allowed*/    
      IF(@cellLevel = (Select MAX(BayLevel) from tblBuildingUnitBays Where BuildingUnitColumnFK = @buildingUnitColumnPK and IsArchived = 0))    
      BEGIN    
       /*User is trying to put a pallet in top level, return EMPTY*/    
       Print 'Top Level Racking Prohibited'    
       RETURN    
      END    
     END    
    
     /*Floor Storage*/    
     IF(@allowFloorStorage = 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/)     
     BEGIN    
      /*Floor Storage is not allowed*/    
      IF(@cellLevel='A')    
      BEGIN    
       /*User is trying to put a pallet at gound level, return empty*/    
       Print 'Floor Storage Prohibited'    
       RETURN    
      END    
     END    
    
     /*Level C And Above*/    
     IF(@levelCAndAbove = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/)     
     BEGIN    
      IF(ASCII(@cellLevel) < 67/*ASCII Code For 'C'*/)     
      BEGIN     
       /*User is trying to put a pallet in a or b levels, return empty*/    
       Print 'Level C and Above Only'    
       RETURN    
      END    
     END   
    
  If (@unstable1 = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/)  
  begin  
    IF(ASCII(@cellLevel) > 67  )     
    BEGIN  
  Print 'This stock code is unstable and should not be placed higher than level C'   
  RETURN  
    END    
  end  
    
     
  If (@unstable2 = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/)  
  begin  
    IF(ASCII(@cellLevel) > 66  )     
    BEGIN--  
  Print 'This stock code is unstable and should not be placed higher than level B'   
  RETURN  
    END    
  end  
   If (@unstable3 = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/)  
  begin  
    IF(ASCII(@cellLevel) > 65  )     
    BEGIN--  
  Print 'This stock code is unstable and should not be placed higher than level B'   
  RETURN  
    END    
  end  
    drop table if exists #tmpdivrules  
     /*DivisionBuildingUnits*/    
     --IF(NOT EXISTS(
	 Select tbu.BuildingFK  
	 into #tmpdivrules 
	 FROM dbo.tblDivisionBuildingUnits tdbu     
  INNER JOIN dbo.tblStockItems tsi ON tdbu.DivisionFK = tsi.DivisionFK     
  INNER JOIN tblpalletcontent pc ON pc.StockItemFK = tsi.StockItemPK     
  INNER JOIN tblpallets tp ON pc.palletfk = tp.palletpk    
  INNER JOIN dbo.tblBuildingUnits tbu ON tdbu.BuildingUnitFK = tbu.BuildingUnitPK    
  WHERE tp.PalletPK = @var_palletPK and tp.IsArchived = 0     
   AND tdbu.BuildingUnitFK = @buildingUnitFK    
   and tdbu.IsArchived=0   
		  union 
		  Select tbu.BuildingFK   FROM dbo.tblStockItemBuildingUnits tdbu     
  INNER JOIN dbo.tblStockItems tsi ON tdbu.StockItemFK = tsi.StockItemPK     
  INNER JOIN tblpalletcontent pc ON pc.StockItemFK = tsi.StockItemPK     
  INNER JOIN tblpallets tp ON pc.palletfk = tp.palletpk    
  INNER JOIN dbo.tblBuildingUnits tbu ON tdbu.BuildingUnitFK = tbu.BuildingUnitPK    
  WHERE tp.PalletPK = @var_palletPK and tp.IsArchived = 0     
   AND tdbu.BuildingUnitFK = @buildingUnitFK    
   and tdbu.IsArchived=0  

		  if((select COUNT(*) from #tmpdivrules) = 0)  
   begin  
  Print 'Stock is not allowed in this building unit'   
   end  
	 --)) /* Damien Exclude Archived  */    
     --BEGIN 
	 
     -- /*Stock is not allowed in this building unit for this division*/    
     -- Print 'Stock is not allowed in this building unit'    
     -- RETURN    
     --END  
	 
	
	
     /*StockItemBuildingUnitCells AND DivisionBuildingUnitCells*/    
     IF(EXISTS(Select * from tblStockItemBuildingUnitBays     
         WHERE StockItemFK = @stockItemPK AND     
         BuildingUnitFK = @buildingUnitFK AND    
         IsArchived = 0)) /* Damien Exclude Archived */    
     BEGIN    
      /*There are stockitem cells set up*/    
      IF (NOT EXISTS(Select * FROM tblStockItemBuildingUnitBays     
               WHERE StockItemFK = @stockItemPK AND     
            BuildingUnitFK = @buildingUnitFK AND     
               BuildingUnitBayFK = @var_locationFK AND    
            IsArchived = 0)) /* Damien Exclude Archived */    
      BEGIN    
       /*There are StockItem Cells set up which do not include this cell, return empty*/    
       Print 'There are cell permissions for this stock code, which do not include this cell'    
       RETURN        
      END    
     END     
     ELSE IF(EXISTS(Select * from tblDivisionBuildingUnitBays     
           WHERE DivisionFK = @divisionFK AND     
           BuildingUnitFK = @buildingUnitFK AND    
           IsArchived = 0)     
       AND NOT EXISTS(Select * from tblDivisionBuildingUnitBays     
             WHERE divisionFK = @divisionFK AND     
             BuildingUnitFK = @BuildingUnitFK AND     
             BuildingUnitBayFK = @var_locationFK AND    
             IsArchived = 0)) /* Damien Exclude Archived */    
     BEGIN    
      /*Division Cells have been set up but they do not include this cell, return empty*/    
      Print 'There are cell permissions for this division, which do not include this cell'    
      RETURN    
     END    
    
     /*Check exclusive cells for Stock Codes and Divisions*/    
     IF(EXISTS(Select * from tblStockItemBuildingUnitBays WHERE StockItemFK <> @stockItemPK     
       AND BuildingUnitBayFK = @var_locationFK AND IsExclusive=1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ And IsArchived = 0)     
      OR EXISTS(Select * from tblDivisionBuildingUnitBays WHERE DivisionFK <> @divisionFK     
      AND BuildingUnitBayFK = @var_locationFK AND IsExclusive=1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ AND IsArchived = 0))     
     BEGIN     
      /*One or more stock Codes or divisions, other than the one we are dealing with, have taken this cell exclusively, return empty*/    
      Print 'This cell has been set exclusively for a different Division or Stock Code'        
      RETURN    
     END       
    
     --jamie : 18/01/2017 : cell depth    
     if(@depth > @buildingUnitBayMaxDepth)     
     BEGIN    
      print 'Pallet Depth (' + cast(@depth as nvarchar) + 'mm) is too deep for the location (Max: '     
      + cast(@buildingUnitBayMaxDepth as nvarchar(50)) + 'mm)'    
      RETURN    
     END     
     ELSE if(@depth < @buildingUnitBayMinDepth)     
     BEGIN    
      print 'Pallet Depth (' + cast(@depth as nvarchar) + 'mm) is too small for the location (Min: '     
      + cast(@buildingUnitBayMinDepth as nvarchar(50)) + 'mm)'    
      RETURN    
     END    
    
     /*EndOfChecks*/    
    
     DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #tmpPalsInLocation    
     SELECT *    
     INTO #tmpPalsInLocation    
     FROM tblpallets p    
     WHERE isArchived = 0 AND p.locationfk =  @var_locationFK AND p.locationtypefk = 1    
    
     if(@var_stackPosition = 0)     
     BEGIN    
       --ALL BayPositions 1->x    
      IF((Select top 1 isnull(palsToRight.PalletStart, isnull(palsCellStart.PalletStart, 999999)) - isnull(palsToLeft.PalletEnd, 0)     
       from #tmpBuildingUnitBay buBays    
       left outer join #tmpPalsInLocation palsToLeft ON palsToLeft.LocationFK = buBays.BuildingUnitBayPK AND palsToLeft.BayPosition = @var_bayPosition - 1    
       left outer join #tmpPalsInLocation palsToRight on palsToRight.LocationFK = buBays.BuildingUnitBayPK AND palsToRight.BayPosition = @var_bayPosition + 1 AND palsToRight.StackPosition = 0    
       left outer join #tmpPalsInLocation palsCellStart on palsCellStart.LocationFK = buBays.BuildingUnitBayPK AND palsCellStart.BayPosition = @var_bayPosition AND palsCellStart.PalletStart = 0 AND palsCellStart.StackPosition = 0    
      ) >= @width)    
      BEGIN    
       Select @var_locationFK as LocationPK, @stockItem StockItem, @batch Batch, @quantity Quantity, @barcode Barcode, @fromLocation FromLocation, isnull(palsToLeft.PalletEnd, 0) PalletStart, isnull(palsToLeft.PalletEnd, 0) + @width PalletEnd,    
        Row + right('0' + cast(BuildingUnitColumnName as nvarchar(50)),2) + lower(BayLevel) + right('0' + cast(@var_bayPosition as nvarchar(5)), 2) ToLocation, @var_bayPosition as BayPosition, 0 as StackPosition    
       from #tmpBuildingUnitBay buBays     
       inner join tblBuildingUnitColumns buCols ON buCols.BuildingUnitColumnPK = buBays.BuildingUnitColumnFK    
       inner join tblBuildingUnitRows buRows ON buRows.BuildingUnitRowPK = buCols.BuildingUnitRowFK    
       left outer join #tmpPalsInLocation palsToLeft ON palsToLeft.LocationFK = buBays.BuildingUnitBayPK AND palsToLeft.BayPosition = @var_bayPosition - 1    
       left outer join #tmpPalsInLocation palsToRight ON palsToRight.LocationFK = buBays.BuildingUnitBayPK AND palsToRight.BayPosition = @var_bayPosition + 1 AND palsToRight.StackPosition = 0           
      END            
     END     
     ELSE     
     BEGIN    
      /*STACKING*/    
      IF(EXISTS(Select * from #tmpPalsInLocation where BayPosition = @var_bayPosition - 1)    
       AND NOT EXISTS(Select * from #tmpPalsInLocation where BayPosition = @var_bayPosition AND StackPosition = 1))    
      BEGIN    
       Select @var_locationFK as LocationPK, @stockItem StockItem,  @batch Batch, @quantity Quantity, @barcode Barcode, @fromLocation FromLocation, PalletStart, PalletEnd,    
        Row + right('0' + cast(BuildingUnitColumnName as nvarchar(50)),2) + lower(BayLevel) + right('0' + cast(@var_bayPosition as nvarchar(5)), 2) ToLocation, @var_bayPosition as BayPosition, @var_stackPosition as StackPosition    
       from #tmpPalsInLocation pals    
       inner join #tmpBuildingUnitBay buBays ON buBays.BuildingUnitBayPK = pals.LocationFK    
       inner join tblBuildingUnitColumns buCols ON buCols.BuildingUnitColumnPK = buBays.BuildingUnitColumnFK    
       inner join tblBuildingUnitRows buRows ON buRows.BuildingUnitRowPK = buCols.BuildingUnitRowFK    
       Where BayPosition = @var_bayPosition - 1    
      END    
     END    
    END     
    ELSE IF (@rackingTypeFK = 2/*Drive Thru*/)     
    BEGIN    
     IF(@var_stackPosition = 1)     
     BEGIN    
    
      DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #tmpPalsInDriveThru    
      SELECT *    
      INTO #tmpPalsInDriveThru    
      FROM tblpallets p    
      WHERE isArchived = 0 AND loaded = 0 and palletStatusFK <> 10 AND p.locationfk =  @var_locationFK AND p.locationtypefk = 1    
    
      /*STACKING*/    
      IF(EXISTS(Select * from #tmpPalsInDriveThru where BayPosition = @var_bayPosition - 1)    
      AND NOT EXISTS(Select * from #tmpPalsInDriveThru where BayPosition = @var_bayPosition AND StackPosition = 1))     
      BEGIN    
       Print 'TAG Driver Thru Stacked'    
    
       Select @var_locationFK as LocationPK, @stockItem StockItem, @batch Batch, @quantity Quantity, @barcode Barcode, @fromLocation FromLocation, PalletStart, PalletEnd,    
        Row + right('0' + cast(BuildingUnitColumnName as nvarchar(50)),2) + lower(BayLevel) + right('0' + cast(@var_bayPosition as nvarchar(5)), 2) ToLocation, @var_bayPosition as BayPosition, @var_locationFK as LocationFK    
       from #tmpPalsInDriveThru pals    
       inner join #tmpBuildingUnitBay buBays on buBays.BuildingUnitBayPK = pals.LocationFK    
       inner join tblBuildingUnitColumns buCols on buCols.BuildingUnitColumnPK = buBays.BuildingUnitColumnFK    
       inner join tblBuildingUnitRows buRows on buRows.BuildingUnitRowPK = buCols.BuildingUnitRowFK    
       Where BayPosition = @var_bayPosition - 1    
      END    
     END     
     ELSE     
     BEGIN    
      --Make a cursor for all cells in the column for the given cell, order by top down    
      --In the cursor, Execute the check, if @@rowcount == 1 then we should be able to return    
      Print 'DriveThru'    
    
      DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #movementcheckresult         
    
      Select BuildingUnitBayPK as LocationPK, @stockItem StockItem, @batch Batch, @quantity Quantity, @barcode Barcode, @fromLocation FromLocation,    
       case when isnull(EndBayPosition, 0) > 0 then EndBayPalletStart when isnull(WholeBayPosition, 0) > 0 THEN WholeBayPalletStart End as PalletStart,    
       case when isnull(EndBayPosition, 0) > 0 then EndBayPalletStart + @width when isnull(WholeBayPosition, 0) > 0 then WholeBayPalletStart + @width End as PalletEnd,    
       Row + right('0' + cast(BuildingUnitColumnName as nvarchar(50)),2) ToLocation,    
       case when isnull(EndBayPosition, 0) > 0 then EndBayPosition when isnull(WholeBayPosition, 0) > 0 then WholeBayPosition End as BayPosition,    
       @var_locationFK LocationFK, subQQ.BayLevel    
      INTO #movementcheckresult    
      from (    
       Select Distinct BuildingUnitBayPK, Row, subQ.BuildingUnitColumn, BuildingUnitColumnName, BayLevel, GapBetweenPallets, case when GapBetweenPallets >= @width then GapBetweenPalletsBayPosition else 0 End as GapBetweenPalletsBayPosition,     
        GapBetweenPalletsPalletStart, GapToEndOfBay, case when GapToEndOfBay >= @width then EndBayPosition else 0 End as EndBayPosition, EndBayPalletStart,  GapToStartOfBay,     
        case when GapToStartOfBay >= @width then StartBayPosition else 0 End as StartBayPosition, StartBayPalletStart, GapWholeBay, case when GapWholeBay >= @width then WholeBayPosition else 0 End as WholeBayPosition, WholeBayPalletStart      
       from     
       (    
        Select buBays.BuildingUnitBayPK, case when buRows.Translate = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ THEN buRows.TranslatedRow ELSE buRows.Row end as Row, buCols.BuildingUnitColumn,    
         case when buRows.Translate = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ then    
          case when buRows.ReverseTranslate = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ then buRows.TranslateColumn - buCols.BuildingUnitColumn else buCols.BuildingUnitColumn + buRows.TranslateColumn end    
         ELSE buCols.BuildingUnitColumn end as BuildingUnitColumnName,    
        buBays.BayLevel, buBays.Width, buBays.MinimumDepth, buBays.MaximumDepth, buBays.Height, pallets.PalletPK,  pallets.PalletStart,  pallets.PalletEnd, pallets.BayPosition,     
        isnull(gapRight.PalletStart - pallets.PalletEnd,0) as GapBetweenPallets,     
        case isnull(gapRight.PalletStart,0) when 0 then null else pallets.BayPosition + 1 END as GapBetweenPalletsBayPosition,    
        case isnull(gapRight.PalletStart,0) when 0 then null else pallets.PalletEnd END as GapBetweenPalletsPalletStart,    
        case when pallets.BayPosition = lastPallet.BayPosition then (buBays.Width - lastPallet.PalletEnd) else 0 End as GapToEndOfBay, /*Only Show this for last pallet*/    
        case isnull(lastPallet.PalletEnd, 0) when 0 then null else lastPallet.BayPosition + 1 END as EndBayPosition,    
        case isnull(lastPallet.PalletEnd, 0) when 0 then null else lastPallet.PalletEnd END as EndBayPalletStart,    
        case when pallets.BayPosition = firstPallet.BayPosition then firstPallet.PalletStart else 0 End as GapToStartOfBay,    
        case isnull(firstPallet.PalletStart, 0) when 0 then null else 1 END as StartBayPosition,    
        0 as StartBayPalletStart,    
        case isnull(pallets.PalletPK,0) when 0 then buBays.Width else 0 End as GapWholeBay,    
        case isnull(pallets.PalletPK, 0) when 0 then 1 else 0 END as WholeBayPosition,    
        0 as WholeBayPalletStart    
       from tblBuildingUnitBays buBays    
       inner join tblBuildingUnitColumns buCols ON buCols.BuildingUnitColumnPK = buBays.BuildingUnitColumnFK    
       inner join tblBuildingUnitRows buRows on buRows.BuildingUnitRowPK = buCols.BuildingUnitRowFK    
    
       -- List of pallets that are in the Column    
       left outer join (    
        Select PalletPK, LocationTypeFK, LocationFK, PalletTypeFK, BayPosition, PalletStart, PalletEnd, StackPosition    
        From tblpallets pals     
        Union    
        Select PalletFK, DestinationLocationTypeFK, DestinationFK, palletsUnion.PalletTypeFK, DestinationBayPosition, DestinationPalletStart, DestinationPalletEnd, -1 as StackPosition    
        From tblworksordermovements woms    
        inner join tblPallets palletsUnion ON palletsUnion.PalletPK = woms.PalletFK    
        Where woms.WorksOrderStatusFK < 3  AND palletsUnion.IsArchived = 0 AND palletsUnion.loaded = 0  and palletsUnion.palletStatusFK <> 10/*Not complete or cancelled*/    
       ) pallets on pallets.LocationTypeFK = 1 AND pallets.LocationFK = buBays.BuildingUnitBayPK    
    
       left outer join (    
        Select PalletPK, LocationTypeFK, LocationFK, PalletTypeFK, BayPosition, PalletStart, PalletEnd, StackPosition    
        From tblpallets pals     
        Union    
        Select PalletFK, DestinationLocationTypeFK, DestinationFK, palletsUnion.PalletTypeFK, DestinationBayPosition, DestinationPalletStart, DestinationPalletEnd, -1 as StackPosition    
        From tblworksordermovements woms    
        inner join tblPallets palletsUnion ON palletsUnion.PalletPK = woms.PalletFK    
        Where woms.WorksOrderStatusFK < 3 AND palletsUnion.IsArchived = 0 AND loaded = 0 and palletStatusFK <> 10/*Not complete or cancelled*/    
       ) gapRight ON gapRight.LocationTypeFK = 1 AND gapRight.LocationFK = pallets.LocationFK AND gapRight.PalletStart = (    
        Select Top 1 PalletStart From (    
         Select PalletStart, LocationFK     
         From tblPallets     
         WHERE isarchived = 0 AND loaded = 0 and palletStatusFK <> 10     
         union     
         Select DestinationPalletStart, DestinationFK     
         from tblworksordermovements where WorksOrderStatusFK < 3    
        )subQNoName where LocationFK = pallets.LocationFK AND PalletStart >= pallets.PalletEnd     
        order by PalletStart ASC    
       ) AND gapRight.PalletStart <> pallets.PalletEnd    
    
       left outer join (    
        Select count(*) BayPosition, LocationTypeFK, LocationFK/*, Case when StackPosition <= 0 then 0 else StackPosition end as StackPosition*/, Max(PalletEnd) as PalletEnd    
        from (    
         Select PalletPK, LocationTypeFK, LocationFK, PalletTypeFK, BayPosition, PalletStart, PalletEnd, StackPosition    
         From tblpallets pals     
         Union    
         Select PalletFK, DestinationLocationTypeFK, DestinationFK, palletsUnion.PalletTypeFK, DestinationBayPosition, DestinationPalletStart, DestinationPalletEnd, -1 as StackPosition    
         From tblworksordermovements woms    
       inner join tblPallets palletsUnion on palletsUnion.PalletPK = woms.PalletFK    
         Where woms.WorksOrderStatusFK < 3 AND palletsUnion.IsArchived = 0 AND loaded = 0 and palletStatusFK <> 10/*Not complete or cancelled*/    
        ) subQLastPallets    
        Group By LocationTypeFK, LocationFK/*, Case when StackPosition <= 0 then 0 else StackPosition end*/    
       ) lastPallet on lastPallet.LocationTypeFK = 1 AND lastPallet.LocationFK = pallets.LocationFK AND lastPallet.PalletEnd <> buBays.Width    
    
       left outer join (    
        Select Min(BayPosition) BayPosition, LocationTypeFK, LocationFK, StackPosition, Min(PalletStart) as PalletStart     
        from (    
         Select PalletPK, LocationTypeFK, LocationFK, PalletTypeFK, BayPosition, PalletStart, PalletEnd, StackPosition    
         From (Select * from tblPallets where IsArchived = 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/AND loaded = 0 and palletStatusFK <> 10) pals    
         Union    
         Select PalletFK, DestinationLocationTypeFK, DestinationFK, palletsUnion.PalletTypeFK, DestinationBayPosition, DestinationPalletStart, DestinationPalletEnd, -1 as StackPosition    
         From tblworksordermovements woms    
         inner join tblPallets palletsUnion on palletsUnion.PalletPK = woms.PalletFK    
         Where woms.WorksOrderStatusFK < 3  AND palletsUnion.IsArchived = 0 AND loaded = 0 and palletStatusFK <> 10/*Not complete or cancelled*/    
        ) subQfirstPallet     
        Group By LocationTypeFK, LocationFK, StackPosition    
       ) firstPallet ON firstPallet.LocationTypeFK = 1 AND firstPallet.PalletStart <> 0 AND firstPallet.LocationFK = pallets.LocationFK    
    
       Where --buBays.BuildingUnitBayPK = @var_locationFK AND buRows.RackingTypeFK = 2/*Drive Thru*/    
        buCols.buildingunitcolumnpk = @buildingUnitColumnPK  And     
        buBays.IsArchived = 0    
        -- Order By BayLevel DESC    
      ) subQ    
    
      WHERE (    
        /*Check for this divisions assigned bays*/    
        BuildingUnitBayPK in     
        (    
         Select sibuBays.BuildingUnitBayFK     
         from tblStockItemBuildingUnitBays sibuBays    
         Where StockItemFK = @stockItemPK AND sibuBays.BuildingUnitFK = @buildingUnitFK And sibuBays.IsArchived = 0    
        )    
        OR    
        (    
         BuildingUnitBayPK in     
         (    
          Select dbuBays.BuildingUnitBayFK     
          from tblDivisionBuildingUnitBays dbuBays    
          Where DivisionFK = @divisionFK AND dbuBays.BuildingUnitFK = @buildingUnitFK And dbuBays.IsArchived = 0    
         )    
         OR     
         (    
          (    
           Select count(*)     
           from tblDivisionBuildingUnitBays    
           Where DivisionFK = @divisionFK AND BuildingUnitFK = @buildingUnitFK And IsArchived = 0    
          ) = 0    
         )    
        )    
       )    
--        /*Check this bay is not exclusively assigned to any other division*/    
       AND    
       BuildingUnitBayPK not in     
       (    
        Select dbuBays.BuildingUnitBayFK     
        from tblDivisionBuildingUnitBays dbuBays    
        Where DivisionFK <> @divisionFK AND dbuBays.BuildingUnitFK = @buildingUnitFK AND dbuBays.IsExclusive = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ And dbuBays.IsArchived = 0    
       )    
       AND     
       (    
        GapToEndOfBay >= @width    
        OR GapWholeBay >= @width    
       )    
       AND     
       (    
        MaximumDepth >= @depth /*Maximum Depth*/    
        AND MinimumDepth <= @depth /*Minimum Depth*/    
       )     
       AND Height >= @height    
      )subQQ    
      --ORDER BY subQQ.BayLevel desc    
    
      if(exists(SELECT * FROM #movementcheckresult m))    
      begin    
       SELECT TOP 1 LocationPK, StockItem, Batch, Quantity, Barcode, FromLocation, PalletStart, PalletEnd, ToLocation, BayPosition, LocationFK     
       FROM #movementcheckresult     
       ORDER BY #movementcheckresult.BayLevel desc    
       --CLOSE LocationCursor    
       --DEALLOCATE LocationCursor    
    
       --RETURN    
      END    
      else    
       PRINT 'not found'    
     END      
    END    
   END    
   ELSE IF(@var_toLocationTypeFK = 2/*LoadingBay*/)    
   BEGIN    
    Select LoadingBayPK as LocationPK, @stockItem StockItem, @batch Batch, @quantity Quantity, @barcode Barcode, @fromLocation FromLocation, -1 as PalletStart, -1 as PalletEnd, loadingBays.LoadingBay ToLocation    
    From tblLoadingBays loadingBays    
    Where LoadingBayPK = @var_locationFK    
      
   END ELSE IF(@var_toLocationTypeFK = 3 /*SetDownArea*/)    
   BEGIN    
    Select SetDownAreaPK as LocationPK, @stockItem StockItem, @batch Batch, @quantity Quantity, @barcode Barcode, @fromLocation FromLocation, -1 as PalletStart, -1 as PalletEnd, setDownAreas.SetDownArea ToLocation    
    From tblSetDownAreas setDownAreas    
    Where SetDownAreaPK = @var_locationFK    
   END    
   ELSE IF(@var_toLocationTypeFK = 6 /*Sample Location*/)    
   BEGIN    
    Select sampleLocationPK as LocationPK, @stockItem StockItem, @batch Batch, @quantity Quantity, @barcode Barcode, @fromLocation FromLocation, -1 as PalletStart, -1 as PalletEnd, sampleLocations.SampleLocation ToLocation    
    From tblSampleLocations sampleLocations    
    Where sampleLocationPK = @var_locationFK    
   END    
   ELSE IF(@var_toLocationTypeFK = 8 /*Floor Location*/)    
   BEGIN    
    Select floorLocationPK as LocationPK, @stockItem StockItem, @batch Batch, @quantity Quantity, @barcode Barcode, @fromLocation FromLocation, -1 as PalletStart, -1 as PalletEnd, floorLocations.floorLocation ToLocation    
    From tblFloorLocations floorLocations    
    Where floorLocationPK = @var_locationFK    
   END    
    
   -- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end    
          
   BREAK    
  END TRY    
  BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */    
   DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;    
   SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;    
   SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;    
    
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY     
   BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;    
           
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;    
    
            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID    
                
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;    
                
   IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)    
   BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END    
   ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */    
  END CATCH    
  SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1    
 END    
END    
GO
