CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spPalletMovementFailureReasons]    
(    
 @palletPK int,    
 @toLocationTypeFK int,    
 @locationFK int,    
 @bayPosition int,    
 @stackPosition int = 0    
)     
AS    
BEGIN    
 /* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */    
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED    
    
    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT    
 ,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;    
 SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();    
    
 -- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters    
 DECLARE @var_palletPK int, @var_toLocationTypeFK int, @var_locationFK int, @var_bayPosition int, @var_stackPosition int    
    
 SET @var_palletPK = @palletPK; SET @var_toLocationTypeFK = @toLocationTypeFK; SET @var_locationFK = @locationFK; SET @var_bayPosition = @bayPosition    
 SET @var_stackPosition = @stackPosition    
    
 SET @ParameterDetails = '@palletPK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_palletPK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@toLocationTypeFK = '     
  + ISNULL(CAST(@var_toLocationTypeFK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@locationFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_locationFK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'')     
   + ',@bayPosition = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_bayPosition AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@stackPosition = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_stackPosition AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'')    
    
    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL     
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)    
    
    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)    
    --BEGIN    
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC     
    
  SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK,-1)    
    
        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)    
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK    
    
        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()    
    --END    
    
 SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);    
 SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails    
 ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;    
 INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()    
    
 WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3    
 BEGIN     
  BEGIN TRY       
    
   -- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start    
    
   --Create temporary Table    
   DECLARE @tblMovementFailureReasons TABLE    
   (    
    TestType nvarchar(100),     
    Passed bit,    
    Reason nvarchar(500)    
   )    
   Declare @CellStockRestricted int   -- > 0 the stock Code has restriced locations    
   Declare @CellDivRestricted int     -- > 0 the division has restriced locations    
Declare @CellStockExclusive int     -- > 0 The location has explicit stockitems for this location    
   Declare @CellDivExclusive int       -- > 0 The location has explicit dvisions for this location    
   Declare @divisionFK int, @palletTypeFK int, @width int, @depth int, @height int, @stockItem nvarchar(200), @batch nvarchar(200), @quantity decimal(18,3),     
   @barcode nvarchar(200), @fromLocation nvarchar(200), @fromLocationTypeFK int, @toLocation nvarchar(200)    
   Declare @buildingUnitFK int, @stockItemPK int    
   --Declare /*@generalWidthMargin int,*/ @heightMargin int, @widthMargin int, @generalDepthMargin int    
   Declare @heightMargin int, @StandardPalletHeight int    
    
   Declare @buildingUnitBayHeight int, @bayLevel nvarchar(50), @topBayLevel nvarchar(50), @buildingUnitBayMaxDepth int, @buildingUnitBayMinDepth int    
   Declare @allowFloorStorage bit, @prohibitTopLevelRacking bit, @cAndAbove bit, @unstable1 bit, @unstable2 bit, @unstable3 bit    
   Declare @isStackable bit, @truePalletType bit, @PalletType nvarchar(50)    
    
   --Select top 1 @heightMargin = GeneralHeightMargin, /*@generalWidthMargin = GeneralWidthMargin,*/ @generalDepthMargin = GeneralDepthMargin    
   --from appSystem    
     
   Select @divisionFK = sis.DivisionFK,     
   --@width = palletTypes.Width + (sis.WidthMargin * 2) + (palletTypes.WidthMargin * 2),        
   @width = palletTypes.Width + (case when sis.WidthMargin > 0 then (sis.WidthMargin * 2) else (palletTypes.WidthMargin * 2) end),     
   --@depth = palletTypes.Depth + (sis.DepthMargin * 2) + (@generalDepthMargin * 2),    
   @depth = palletTypes.Depth + (case when sis.DepthMargin > 0 then (sis.DepthMargin * 2) else (palletTypes.DepthMargin * 2) end),    
   @heightMargin = palletTypes.HeightMargin,    
   @StandardPalletHeight = palletTypes.Height,    
   @truePalletType = palletTypes.IsTruePalletType,    
   @PalletType = palletTypes.PalletType,    
   @stockItem = sis.StockItemCode,    
   @stockItemPK = sis.StockItemPK,    
   @batch = pc.Batch,    
   @quantity = Quantity,    
   @allowFloorStorage = sis.AllowFloorStorage,    
   @prohibitTopLevelRacking = sis.ProhibitTopLevelRacking,    
   @cAndAbove = sis.LevelC_Above,    
   @unstable1 = sis.Unstable1,    
   @unstable2 = sis.Unstable2,    
   @unstable3 = sis.Unstable3,    
   @isStackable = sis.IsStackable--,    
   --@buildingUnitFK = pallets.BuildingUnitFK    
   From tblPallets pallets    
   inner join (    
    Select PalletFK, StockItemFK, Batch, sum(ActualUnits) Quantity    
    From tblPalletContent    
    Group By PalletFK, StockItemFK, Batch    
   ) pc on    
   pc.PalletFK = pallets.PalletPK    
   inner join tblStockItems sis on    
   sis.StockItemPK = pc.StockItemFK    
   inner join tblPallettypes palletTypes on    
   palletTypes.PalletTypePK = pallets.PalletTypeFK    
   left outer join tblBuildingUnitBays buBays on    
   buBays.BuildingUnitBayPK = pallets.LocationFK    
   AND pallets.LocationTypeFK = 1 /*Racking*/    
   left outer join tblBuildingUnitColumns buCols on    
   buCols.BuildingUnitColumnPK = buBays.BuildingUnitColumnFK    
   left outer join tblBuildingUnitRows buRows on    
   buRows.BuildingUnitRowPK = buCols.BuildingUnitRowFK    
   left outer join tblLoadingBays loadingBays on    
   loadingBays.LoadingBayPK = pallets.LocationFK    
   AND pallets.LocationTypeFK = 2 /*LoadingBays*/    
   left outer join tblSetDownAreas setDownAreas on    
   setDownAreas.SetDownAreaPK = pallets.LocationFK    
   AND pallets.LocationTypeFK = 3 /*SetDownArea*/    
    
   Where PalletPK = @var_palletPK    
    
   Set @height = 0    
   --Get the height is available    
   if(EXISTS(Select * from tblStockItemLayerHeights where StockItemFK = @stockItemPK))     
   BEGIN    
    --We have a layer summary, calculate height    
    Declare @layerUnits decimal(18,3), @layerHeight int    
    Select Top 1 @layerUnits = LayerUnits, @layerHeight = LayerHeight    
    from tblStockItemLayerHeights where StockItemFK = @stockItemPK    
    Set @height = (CEILING(@quantity / @layerUnits) * @layerHeight) + /* (Select Top 1 StandardPalletHeight From appSystem)*/ @StandardPalletHeight + @heightMargin    
   END    
    
   if(EXISTS(Select * from tblStockItemHeights where StockItemFK = @stockItemPK))     
   BEGIN    
    --We have height records.. note this will over write any heights calculated previously as these records are more exact    
    Select Top 1 @height = Height + @heightMargin from tblStockItemHeights    
    Where StockItemFK = @stockItemPK AND Units >= @quantity    
    Order By Units ASC    
   END    
    
   IF(@var_toLocationTypeFK = 1 /*Going to Racking*/)     
   BEGIN      
    --jamie : get building unit from @var_locationFK, not from pallets current building unit    
    select @buildingUnitFK = buildingunitfk from tblbuildingunitbays bub    
    inner join tblbuildingunitcolumns buc on buc.buildingunitcolumnpk = bub.buildingunitcolumnfk    
    inner join tblbuildingunitrows bur on bur.buildingunitrowpk = buc.buildingunitrowfk    
    where buildingunitbaypk = @var_locationFK    
      
    SELECT @buildingUnitBayHeight = buBays.Height,    
    @bayLevel = buBays.BayLevel,    
    @topBayLevel = topBayLevel.BayLevel,    
    @buildingUnitBayMaxDepth = MaximumDepth,     
    @buildingUnitBayMinDepth = MinimumDepth    
    FROM tblBuildingUnitBays buBays    
   -- left outer join (    
   cross apply (  
     SELECT Top 1 BuildingUnitColumnFK, max(BayLevel) BayLevel from tblBuildingUnitBays buBays2 where buBays2.IsArchived=0    
  and buBays2.BuildingUnitColumnFK = buBays.BuildingUnitColumnFK    
     Group By BuildingUnitColumnFK    
    ) topBayLevel   
 --on  topBayLevel.BuildingUnitColumnFK = buBays.BuildingUnitColumnFK    
    WHERE buBays.BuildingUnitBayPK = @var_locationFK    
    
    --Height    
    IF(@height > @buildingUnitBayHeight)     
    BEGIN    
     INSERT into @tblMovementFailureReasons VALUES(    
     'Height', 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/, 'Pallet height (' + cast(@height as nvarchar) + 'mm) is too great for the location ('     
     + cast(@buildingUnitBayHeight as nvarchar(50)) + 'mm)')    
    END     
    ELSE     
    BEGIN    
     INSERT into @tblMovementFailureReasons VALUES(    
     'Height', 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/, 'Pallet height is OK '  )    
    END    
    
    --jamie : 18/01/2017 : check pallet type and depth    
    if(@depth > @buildingUnitBayMaxDepth)     
    BEGIN    
     INSERT INTO @tblMovementFailureReasons VALUES(    
      'Depth', 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/, 'Pallet Depth (' + cast(@depth as nvarchar) + 'mm) is too deep for the location (Max: '     
      + cast(@buildingUnitBayMaxDepth as nvarchar(50)) + 'mm)')    
    END ELSE if(@depth < @buildingUnitBayMinDepth)     
    BEGIN    
     INSERT INTO @tblMovementFailureReasons VALUES(    
      'Depth', 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/, 'Pallet Depth (' + cast(@depth as nvarchar) + 'mm) is too small for the location (Min: '     
      + cast(@buildingUnitBayMinDepth as nvarchar(50)) + 'mm)')    
    END     
    ELSE     
    BEGIN    
     INSERT into @tblMovementFailureReasons VALUES(    
      'Depth', 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/, 'Pallet Depth is OK '  )    
    END     
    
    /*if(@truePalletType = 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/) BEGIN    
     INSERT INTO @tblMovementFailureReasons VALUES(    
      'PalletType', 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/, 'Pallet Type (' + @PalletType + ') cannot be put into racking')    
    END ELSE BEGIN    
     INSERT into @tblMovementFailureReasons VALUES(    
      'PalletType', 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/, 'Pallet Type is OK for racking'  )    
    END */    
    
    --Cell Permissions    
    Declare @cellPermissionIssueFound bit    
    Select @cellPermissionIssueFound = 0    
    

	
    /*DivisionBuildingUnits*/    
    --IF(NOT EXISTS(Select * from tblDivisionBuildingUnits     
    --     WHERE DivisionFK = @divisionFK AND BuildingUnitFK = @buildingUnitFK AND IsArchived = 0))    
    --BEGIN    
    -- /*Stock is not allowed in this building unit for this division*/    
    -- --print @divisionFK    
    -- --print @buildingUnitFK    
    
    -- --INSERT into @tblMovementFailureReasons VALUES(    
    -- --'CellPermission', 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/, 'Stock for this division is not allowed in this building unit')    
    -- --Select @cellPermissionIssueFound = 1 /*This will prevent further issues being written to the return table*/     

    --END    
    
	 drop table if exists #tmpdivrules  
     /*DivisionBuildingUnits*/    
     --IF(NOT EXISTS(
	 Select tbu.BuildingFK  
	 into #tmpdivrules 
	 FROM dbo.tblDivisionBuildingUnits tdbu     
  INNER JOIN dbo.tblStockItems tsi ON tdbu.DivisionFK = tsi.DivisionFK     
  INNER JOIN tblpalletcontent pc ON pc.StockItemFK = tsi.StockItemPK     
  INNER JOIN tblpallets tp ON pc.palletfk = tp.palletpk    
  INNER JOIN dbo.tblBuildingUnits tbu ON tdbu.BuildingUnitFK = tbu.BuildingUnitPK    
  WHERE tp.PalletPK = @var_palletPK and tp.IsArchived = 0     
   AND tdbu.BuildingUnitFK = @buildingUnitFK    
   and tdbu.IsArchived=0   
		  union 
		  Select tbu.BuildingFK   FROM dbo.tblStockItemBuildingUnits tdbu     
  INNER JOIN dbo.tblStockItems tsi ON tdbu.StockItemFK = tsi.StockItemPK     
  INNER JOIN tblpalletcontent pc ON pc.StockItemFK = tsi.StockItemPK     
  INNER JOIN tblpallets tp ON pc.palletfk = tp.palletpk    
  INNER JOIN dbo.tblBuildingUnits tbu ON tdbu.BuildingUnitFK = tbu.BuildingUnitPK    
  WHERE tp.PalletPK = @var_palletPK and tp.IsArchived = 0     
   AND tdbu.BuildingUnitFK = @buildingUnitFK    
   and tdbu.IsArchived=0  

		  if((select COUNT(*) from #tmpdivrules) = 0)  
   begin  
  print @divisionFK    
     print @buildingUnitFK    
    
     INSERT into @tblMovementFailureReasons VALUES(    
     'CellPermission', 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/, 'Stock for this division is not allowed in this building unit')    
     Select @cellPermissionIssueFound = 1 /*This will prevent further issues being written to the return table*/   
	 end
  
     

    print @divisionfk    
    
    /*StockItemBuildingUnitCells AND DivisionBuildingUnitCells*/    
    IF(@cellPermissionIssueFound = 0 AND EXISTS(Select * from tblStockItemBuildingUnitBays     
               WHERE StockItemFK = @stockItemPK AND     
                  BuildingUnitFK = @buildingUnitFK AND IsArchived = 0))    
    BEGIN    
     /*There are stockitem cells set up*/    
     IF (NOT EXISTS(Select * from tblStockItemBuildingUnitBays     
           WHERE StockItemFK = @stockItemPK AND     
           BuildingUnitFK = @buildingUnitFK AND     
           BuildingUnitBayFK = @var_locationFK And IsArchived = 0))    
     BEGIN    
      /*There are StockItem Cells set up which do not include this cell, return empty*/    
      INSERT into @tblMovementFailureReasons VALUES(    
      'CellPermission', 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/, 'Stock Code cells have been set up but do not include this location')    
      Select @cellPermissionIssueFound = 1 /*This will prevent further issues being written to the return table*/         
     END    
    END     
    ELSE IF(@cellPermissionIssueFound = 0 AND EXISTS(Select * from tblDivisionBuildingUnitBays     
                 WHERE DivisionFK = @divisionFK AND     
                    BuildingUnitFK = @buildingUnitFK And IsArchived = 0)     
               AND NOT EXISTS(Select * from tblDivisionBuildingUnitBays     
                  WHERE DivisionFK = @divisionFK AND     
                     BuildingUnitFK = @buildingUnitFK AND     
                     BuildingUnitBayFK = @var_locationFK AND IsArchived = 0))     
    BEGIN    
     /*Division Cells have been set up but they do not include this cell, return empty*/    
     INSERT into @tblMovementFailureReasons VALUES(    
     'CellPermission', 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/, 'Division cells have been set up but do not include this location')    
     Select @cellPermissionIssueFound = 1 /*This will prevent further issues being written to the return table*/         
    END    
    
    /*Check exclusive cells for Stock Codes*/    
    IF(@cellPermissionIssueFound = 0 AND EXISTS(Select * from tblStockItemBuildingUnitBays     
               WHERE StockItemFK <> @stockItemPK AND     
               BuildingUnitBayFK = @var_locationFK AND     
               IsExclusive=1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ AND IsArchived = 0))     
    BEGIN     
     /*One or more stock Codes, other than the one we are dealing with, have taken this cell exclusively*/        
     INSERT into @tblMovementFailureReasons VALUES(    
     'CellPermission', 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/, 'A Stock Code has this location exclusively assigned')    
     Select @cellPermissionIssueFound = 1 /*This will prevent further issues being written to the return table*/         
    END     
    
    /*Check exclusive cells for Divisions*/    
    IF(@cellPermissionIssueFound = 0 AND EXISTS(Select * from tblDivisionBuildingUnitBays     
               WHERE DivisionFK <> @divisionFK AND     
                  BuildingUnitBayFK = @var_locationFK AND     
                  IsExclusive=1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ AND IsArchived = 0))     
    BEGIN     
     /*One or more divisions, other than the one we are dealing with, have taken this cell exclusively*/        
     INSERT into @tblMovementFailureReasons VALUES(    
     'CellPermission', 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/, 'A Division has this location exclusively assigned')    
     Select @cellPermissionIssueFound = 1 /*This will prevent further issues being written to the return table*/         
    END     
    
    IF(@cellPermissionIssueFound=0)     
    BEGIN    
     --No Cell Permission issues found    
     INSERT into @tblMovementFailureReasons VALUES(    
     'CellPermission', 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/, 'This Stock Code has permission for this location')    
    END    
    
    --StockRules    
    Declare @stockRuleIssueFound bit    
    Select @stockRuleIssueFound = 0    
    
    /*Floor Storage*/    
    IF(ASCII(@bayLevel) = 65 /*Level A*/ AND @allowFloorStorage = 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/)    
    BEGIN    
     INSERT into @tblMovementFailureReasons VALUES(    
     'StockLocationRules', 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/, 'This stock code is not allowed on the floor')    
     Select @stockRuleIssueFound = 1 /*This will prevent further issues being written to the return table*/         
    END    
      
 print 'top level check'  
 print @stockRuleIssueFound  
 print @bayLevel  
 print @topBayLevel  
 print @prohibitTopLevelRacking  
 print 'top level check'  
    /*Top Level Racking*/    
    IF(@stockRuleIssueFound = 0 AND ASCII(@bayLevel) = ASCII(@topBayLevel) AND @prohibitTopLevelRacking = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/)    
    BEGIN    
     INSERT into @tblMovementFailureReasons VALUES(    
     'StockLocationRules', 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/, 'This stock code is not allowed at the top level of racking')    
     Select @stockRuleIssueFound = 1 /*This will prevent further issues being written to the return table*/         
    END    
    
    /*C And Above Only*/    
    IF(@stockRuleIssueFound = 0 AND ASCII(@bayLevel) < 67 AND @CandAbove = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/)     
    BEGIN--No LOWER THAN C    
     INSERT into @tblMovementFailureReasons VALUES(    
     'StockLocationRules', 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/, 'This stock code is not allowed in levels A and B')    
     Select @stockRuleIssueFound = 1 /*This will prevent further issues being written to the return table*/         
    END    
      
    IF(@stockRuleIssueFound = 0 AND ASCII(@bayLevel) > 67 AND @unstable1 = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/)     
    BEGIN--No HIGHER THAN C    
     INSERT into @tblMovementFailureReasons VALUES(    
     'StockLocationRules', 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/, 'This stock code is unstable and should not be placed higher than level C')    
     Select @stockRuleIssueFound = 1 /*This will prevent further issues being written to the return table*/         
    END    
    
    IF(@stockRuleIssueFound = 0 AND ASCII(@bayLevel) > 66 AND @unstable2 = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/)     
    BEGIN--No HIGHER THAN B    
     INSERT into @tblMovementFailureReasons VALUES(    
     'StockLocationRules', 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/, 'This stock code is unstable and should not be placed higher than level B')    
     Select @stockRuleIssueFound = 1 /*This will prevent further issues being written to the return table*/         
    END    
    
    IF(@stockRuleIssueFound = 0 AND ASCII(@bayLevel) > 65 AND @unstable3 = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/)    
    BEGIN--No HIGHER THAN A    
     INSERT into @tblMovementFailureReasons VALUES(    
     'StockLocationRules', 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/, 'This stock code is unstable and should not be placed higher than level B')    
     Select @stockRuleIssueFound = 1 /*This will prevent further issues being written to the return table*/         
    END    
    
    IF(@stockRuleIssueFound = 0)    
    BEGIN    
     INSERT into @tblMovementFailureReasons VALUES(    
     'StockLocationRules', 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/, 'This stock code has the correct rules to go into this location')    
    END    
    
  --  Print 'Depth ' + cast(@depth as nvarchar(50))    
  --  Print 'Width ' + cast(@width as nvarchar(50))      
  --  print '---'    
  --  print @stockItem    
  --  print @width    
  --  print @var_bayPosition    
  --  print @var_locationFK    
  --  print @batch     
    
    
    print '---'    
    
    IF(@var_stackPosition = 0)     
    BEGIN    
     IF(Exists(    
     Select BuildingUnitBayPK as LocationPK,    
     @stockItem StockItem, @batch Batch, @quantity Quantity, @barcode Barcode, @fromLocation FromLocation,    
     case when isnull(GapBetweenPalletsBayPosition, 0) = @var_bayPosition then    
      GapBetweenPalletsPalletStart    
     when isnull(EndBayPosition, 0) = @var_bayPosition then    
      EndBayPalletStart    
     when isnull(StartBayPosition, 0) = @var_bayPosition then    
      StartBayPalletStart    
     when isnull(WholeBayPosition, 0) = @var_bayPosition then    
      WholeBayPalletStart    
     End as PalletStart,    
     case when isnull(GapBetweenPalletsBayPosition, 0) = @var_bayPosition then    
      GapBetweenPalletsPalletStart + @width    
     when isnull(EndBayPosition, 0) = @var_bayPosition then    
      EndBayPalletStart + @width    
     when isnull(StartBayPosition, 0) = @var_bayPosition then    
      StartBayPalletStart + @width    
     when isnull(WholeBayPosition, 0) = @var_bayPosition then    
      WholeBayPalletStart + @width    
     End as PalletEnd,    
     Row + right('0' + cast(BuildingUnitColumnName as nvarchar(50)),2) + lower(BayLevel) + right('0' + cast(@var_bayPosition as nvarchar(5)), 2) ToLocation    
       
     from (    
     Select Distinct BuildingUnitBayPK, Row, subQ.BuildingUnitColumn, BuildingUnitColumnName, BayLevel,     
      GapBetweenPallets, case when GapBetweenPallets >= @width then GapBetweenPalletsBayPosition else 0 End as GapBetweenPalletsBayPosition,     
      GapBetweenPalletsPalletStart,     
      GapToEndOfBay, case when GapToEndOfBay >= @width then EndBayPosition else 0 End as EndBayPosition, EndBayPalletStart,     
      GapToStartOfBay, case when GapToStartOfBay >= @width then StartBayPosition else 0 End as StartBayPosition, StartBayPalletStart,     
      GapWholeBay, case when GapWholeBay >= @width then WholeBayPosition else 0 End as WholeBayPosition, WholeBayPalletStart  from     
      (Select buBays.BuildingUnitBayPK,     
       case when buRows.Translate = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ then    
        buRows.TranslatedRow    
       else    
        buRows.Row    
       end as Row,    
       buCols.BuildingUnitColumn,    
       case when buRows.Translate = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ then    
        case when buRows.ReverseTranslate = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ then    
         buRows.TranslateColumn - buCols.BuildingUnitColumn    
        else    
         buCols.BuildingUnitColumn + buRows.TranslateColumn    
        end    
       else    
        buCols.BuildingUnitColumn    
       end as BuildingUnitColumnName,    
       buBays.BayLevel,    
       buBays.Width,    
       buBays.MinimumDepth,    
       buBays.MaximumDepth,    
       buBays.Height,    
       pallets.PalletPK,     
       pallets.PalletStart,     
       pallets.PalletEnd,    
       pallets.BayPosition,     
       isnull(gapRight.PalletStart - pallets.PalletEnd,0) as GapBetweenPallets,     
       case isnull(gapRight.PalletStart,0) when 0 then null else pallets.BayPosition + 1 END as GapBetweenPalletsBayPosition,    
       case isnull(gapRight.PalletStart,0) when 0 then null else pallets.PalletEnd END as GapBetweenPalletsPalletStart,    
       case when pallets.BayPosition = lastPallet.BayPosition then (buBays.Width - lastPallet.PalletEnd) else 0 End as GapToEndOfBay, /*Only Show this for last pallet*/    
       case isnull(lastPallet.PalletEnd, 0) when 0 then null else lastPallet.BayPosition + 1 END as EndBayPosition,    
       case isnull(lastPallet.PalletEnd, 0) when 0 then null else lastPallet.PalletEnd END as EndBayPalletStart,    
       case when pallets.BayPosition = firstPallet.BayPosition then firstPallet.PalletStart else 0 End as GapToStartOfBay,    
       case isnull(firstPallet.PalletStart, 0) when 0 then null else 1 END as StartBayPosition,    
       0 as StartBayPalletStart,    
       case isnull(pallets.PalletPK,0) when 0 then buBays.Width else 0 End as GapWholeBay,    
       case isnull(pallets.PalletPK, 0) when 0 then 1 else 0 END as WholeBayPosition,    
       0 as WholeBayPalletStart    
      from tblBuildingUnitBays buBays    
      inner join tblBuildingUnitColumns buCols on    
      buCols.BuildingUnitColumnPK = buBays.BuildingUnitColumnFK    
    
      inner join tblBuildingUnitRows buRows on    
      buRows.BuildingUnitRowPK = buCols.BuildingUnitRowFK    
    
      left outer join (    
       Select PalletPK, LocationTypeFK, LocationFK, PalletTypeFK, BayPosition, PalletStart, PalletEnd, StackPosition    
       From (Select * from tblPallets  Where IsArchived = 0) pallets    
       Union    
       Select PalletFK, DestinationLocationTypeFK, DestinationFK, palletsUnion.PalletTypeFK, DestinationBayPosition,     
       DestinationPalletStart, DestinationPalletEnd, -1 as StackPosition    
       From tblWorksOrderMovements woms    
       inner join tblPallets palletsUnion  on    
       palletsUnion.PalletPK = woms.PalletFK    
       AND palletsUnion.IsArchived = 0    
        Where woms.WorksOrderStatusFK < 3 /*Not complete or cancelled*/    
      ) pallets on    
      pallets.LocationTypeFK = 1    
      --AND pallets.StackPosition <= 0    
      AND pallets.LocationFK = buBays.BuildingUnitBayPK    
    
      left outer join (    
       Select PalletPK, LocationTypeFK, LocationFK, PalletTypeFK, BayPosition, PalletStart, PalletEnd--, StackPosition    
       From (Select * from tblPallets  Where IsArchived = 0) pallets     
       Union    
       Select PalletFK, DestinationLocationTypeFK, DestinationFK, palletsUnion.PalletTypeFK, DestinationBayPosition,     
       DestinationPalletStart, DestinationPalletEnd--, -1 as StackPosition    
       From tblWorksOrderMovements woms    
       inner join tblPallets palletsUnion  on    
       palletsUnion.PalletPK = woms.PalletFK    
       AND palletsUnion.IsArchived = 0    
       Where woms.WorksOrderStatusFK < 3 /*Not complete or cancelled*/    
      ) gapRight on    
      gapRight.LocationTypeFK = 1    
      --AND gapRight.StackPosition <= 0    
      AND gapRight.LocationFK = pallets.LocationFK    
      AND gapRight.PalletStart = (Select Top 1 PalletStart From (Select PalletStart, LocationFK From tblPallets     
      union Select DestinationPalletStart, DestinationFK from tblWorksOrderMovements where WorksOrderStatusFK < 3)subQNoName     
      where LocationFK = pallets.LocationFK AND PalletStart >= pallets.PalletEnd order by PalletStart ASC)    
      AND gapRight.PalletStart <> pallets.PalletEnd    
    
      left outer join (    
       Select count(*) BayPosition, LocationTypeFK, LocationFK, Max(PalletEnd) as PalletEnd    
       from (    
        Select PalletPK, LocationTypeFK, LocationFK, PalletTypeFK, BayPosition, PalletStart, PalletEnd, StackPosition    
        From (Select * from tblPallets  Where IsArchived = 0) pallets      
        Union    
        Select PalletFK, DestinationLocationTypeFK, DestinationFK, palletsUnion.PalletTypeFK, DestinationBayPosition,     
        DestinationPalletStart, DestinationPalletEnd, -1 as StackPosition    
        From tblWorksOrderMovements woms    
        inner join tblPallets palletsUnion  on    
        palletsUnion.PalletPK = woms.PalletFK    
        AND palletsUnion.IsArchived = 0    
        Where woms.WorksOrderStatusFK < 3 /*Not complete or cancelled*/    
       ) subQLastPallets    
       Group By LocationTypeFK, LocationFK    
      ) lastPallet on    
      lastPallet.LocationTypeFK = 1    
      AND lastPallet.LocationFK = pallets.LocationFK    
      AND lastPallet.PalletEnd <> buBays.Width    
    
      left outer join (Select Min(BayPosition) BayPosition, LocationTypeFK, LocationFK, StackPosition, Min(PalletStart) as PalletStart     
       from (    
        Select PalletPK, LocationTypeFK, LocationFK, PalletTypeFK, BayPosition, PalletStart, PalletEnd, StackPosition    
        From (Select * from tblPallets  Where IsArchived = 0) pallets      
        Union    
        Select PalletFK, DestinationLocationTypeFK, DestinationFK, palletsUnion.PalletTypeFK, DestinationBayPosition,     
        DestinationPalletStart, DestinationPalletEnd, -1 as StackPosition    
        From tblWorksOrderMovements woms    
        inner join tblPallets palletsUnion  on    
        palletsUnion.PalletPK = woms.PalletFK    
        AND palletsUnion.IsArchived = 0    
        Where woms.WorksOrderStatusFK < 3 /*Not complete or cancelled*/    
       ) subQfirstPallet     
       Group By LocationTypeFK, LocationFK, StackPosition    
      ) firstPallet on    
      firstPallet.LocationTypeFK = 1    
      --AND firstPallet.StackPosition <= 0    
      AND firstPallet.PalletStart <> 0    
      AND firstPallet.LocationFK = pallets.LocationFK    
    
      Where buBays.IsArchived=0 and buBays.BuildingUnitBayPK = @var_locationFK    
      AND buRows.RackingTypeFK in (1, 2)/*Conventional OR DriveThru*/    
      ) subQ    
    
      Where     
       (GapBetweenPallets >=@width    
       OR GapToEndOfBay >= @width    
       OR GapToStartOfBay >= @width    
       OR GapWholeBay >= @width)    
      )subQQ    
      where     
      isnull(GapBetweenPalletsBayPosition, 0) = @var_bayPosition    
      OR    
      isnull(EndBayPosition, 0) = @var_bayPosition    
      OR    
      isnull(StartBayPosition, 0) = @var_bayPosition    
      OR    
      isnull(WholeBayPosition, 0) = @var_bayPosition    
     )) BEGIN    
      insert into @tblMovementFailureReasons VALUES(    
       'Width', 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/, 'Pallet width is OK')    
     END     
     ELSE     
     BEGIN    
      PRINT @stockItem    
      print @batch    
    
      insert into @tblMovementFailureReasons VALUES(    
       'Width', 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/, 'The pallet will not fit in this location')    
     END    
    END     
    ELSE     
    BEGIN --We are attempting to put this pallet in a stacked position    
     IF(EXISTS(Select * from tblPallets where LocationTypeFK = 1 AND LocationFK = @var_locationFK and BayPosition = @var_bayPosition - 1     
     AND StackPosition=0 AND IsArchived=0/*cast(0 as bit)*/)    
      AND NOT EXISTS(Select * from tblPallets where LocationTypeFK = 1 AND LocationFK = @var_locationFK and BayPosition = @var_bayPosition     
      AND StackPosition = 1  AND IsArchived=0/*cast(0 as bit)*/))     
    BEGIN    
      insert into @tblMovementFailureReasons VALUES(    
       'Width', 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/, 'Pallet width is OK')    
     END ELSE BEGIN    
      insert into @tblMovementFailureReasons VALUES(    
       'Width', 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/, 'There is already a stacked pallet in this position')    
     END    
    END    
   END ELSE IF(@var_toLocationTypeFK = 2/*LoadingBay*/)    
   BEGIN    
    Print 'DO NOTHING, THE REASON TABLE WILL BE BLANK'    
   END ELSE IF(@var_toLocationTypeFK = 3 /*SetDownArea*/)     
   BEGIN    
    Print 'DO NOTHING, THE REASON TABLE WILL BE BLANK'    
   END    
     
   --DECLARE @RuntimeInSecondsText NVARCHAR(100) = (SELECT CAST( (SELECT ABS(DATEDIFF(ss, [Date], dbo.GetBSTDate()))) AS NVARCHAR(100)) FROM [dbo].[tblEventLog] WHERE EventLogPK = @EventLogPK)    
    
   ---- Record how long it took to run/execute this stored procedure.    
   --UPDATE [dbo].[tblEventLog] WITH (ROWLOCK)    
   --SET [State] = [State] + ', Runtime (Seconds) ' + @RuntimeInSecondsText    
   --WHERE EventLogPK = @EventLogPK AND @EventLogPK > 0    
    
   Select * from @tblMovementFailureReasons    
        
   -- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end    
          
   BREAK    
  END TRY    
  BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */    
   DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;    
   SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;    
   SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;    
    
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY     
   BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;    
           
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;    
    
            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID    
                
         IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;    
                
   IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)    
   BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END    
   ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */    
  END 
  CATCH    
  SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1    
 END    
END 
GO

BEGIN

    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED        
        
    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT        
 ,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;        
 SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();        
        
 -- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters      
  DECLARE @dateFromcheck2 Date        
        
 SET @dateFromcheck2 = @dateFromcheck  
   
 DECLARE @datetocheck2 Date        
        
 SET @datetocheck2 = @datetocheck        
        
 SET @ParameterDetails = '@dateFromcheck = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@dateFromcheck2 AS NVARCHAR(20)),'')    
                       + ',@datetocheck = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@datetocheck2 AS NVARCHAR(20)),'')    
        
    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL         
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)        
        
    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)        
    --BEGIN        
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC         
        
  SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)        
        
        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)        
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK        
        
        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()        
    --END        
        
        
 SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);        
 SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails        
 ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;        
 INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()        
        
 WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3        
 BEGIN         
  BEGIN TRY        
           
        
   -- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start        
        
  print 'get max move pk'      
print CONVERT(varchar, SYSDATETIME(), 121)      
  declare @Maxmovementpk int      
  SET @Maxmovementpk = (select top 1 worksordermovementpk from tblworksordermovements where ((UpdatedDate > @dateFromcheck2) AND (UpdatedDate < @datetocheck2)) order by worksordermovementpk desc)      
    
 --get top 25k movements based of most recent    
print 'get top 25k moves'      
print CONVERT(varchar, SYSDATETIME(), 121)      
  drop table if exists #totalMovements      
  select *      
  into #totalMovements      
  from tblworksordermovements      
  where
  --worksordermovementpk >= (@Maxmovementpk - 25000)    
   (UpdatedDate > @dateFromcheck2 AND UpdatedDate < @datetocheck2)
    
--remove any of these 25 that dont match given date    
print 'get all relevant moves'      
--delete from #totalMovements where cast(updateddate as date) <> @datetocheck    
    
--load up all locations    
drop table if exists #tmpAllLocations    
select * into #tmpAllLocations from viewBuildingUnitBays     
    
--check which movements building units dont match based of source & destination fks    
drop table if exists #tmpMovementsDifferentBuildingUnits    
select worksordermovementpk, palletfk, SourceLoc.BuildingName + ' ' + SourceLoc.BuildingUnit  as SourceBuilding,   
sourceloc.BuildingUnitBayLocation SourceLocation, destLoc.BuildingName +' '+ destLoc.BuildingUnit as DestinationBuilding,  
destLoc.BuildingUnitBayLocation DestLocation, woms.UpdatedDate, tp.FirstName + ' ' + tp.LastName as UserName
into #tmpMovementsDifferentBuildingUnits    
from #totalMovements woms    
inner join #tmpAllLocations SourceLoc on SourceLoc.locationTypeFK = woms.sourcelocationtypefk and woms.SourceLocationFK = SourceLoc.BuildingUnitBayPK    
inner join #tmpAllLocations destLoc on destLoc.locationTypeFK = woms.DestinationLocationTypeFK and woms.DestinationFK = destLoc.BuildingUnitBayPK 
Inner JOIN tblUsers tu ON woms.UpdatedBy = tu.UserPK
inner join tblPeople tp ON tu.PersonFK = tp.PersonPK
where SourceLoc.BuildingUnit <> destLoc.BuildingUnit    
and( (woms.UpdatedDate > @dateFromcheck2) AND (woms.UpdatedDate < @datetocheck2))  
    
--movements between building units    
--select distinct moves.*, case when pallets.customerbarcode = '' then pallets.barcode else pallets.CustomerBarcode end as PalletBarcode, DivisionCode, StockItemCode, Batch    
--from #tmpMovementsDifferentBuildingUnits moves    
--inner join tblpallets pallets on pallets.palletpk = moves.palletfk    
--inner join tblpalletcontent pc on pc.palletfk = pallets.palletpk    
--inner join tblstockitems stock on stock.stockitempk = pc.stockitemfk    
--inner join tbldivisions divs on divs.divisionpk = stock.divisionfk   
--where ( (moves.UpdatedDate > @dateFromcheck2) AND (moves.UpdatedDate < @datetocheck2))  
    
--movements between buildings    
select distinct moves.*, case when pallets.customerbarcode = '' then pallets.barcode else pallets.CustomerBarcode end as PalletBarcode, DivisionCode, StockItemCode, Batch    
from #tmpMovementsDifferentBuildingUnits moves    
inner join tblpallets pallets on pallets.palletpk = moves.palletfk    
inner join tblpalletcontent pc on pc.palletfk = pallets.palletpk    
inner join tblstockitems stock on stock.stockitempk = pc.stockitemfk    
inner join tbldivisions divs on divs.divisionpk = stock.divisionfk  
where DestinationBuilding <> SourceBuilding     
and( (moves.UpdatedDate > @dateFromcheck2) AND (moves.UpdatedDate < @datetocheck2))  
   -- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end           
   BREAK        
  END TRY        
  BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */        
   DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;        
   SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;        
   SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;        
        
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY         
   BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;        
               
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;        
        
            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID        
                    
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;        
                    
   IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)        
   BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END        
   ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */        
  END CATCH        
  SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1        
 END        
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spPalletNudge]  
(  
 @palletFK int,  
 @distance int  ,
 @palletFK2 int = -1
)   
AS  
BEGIN  
 /* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */  
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED  
  print 'starting'
    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT  
 ,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;  
 SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();  
  
 -- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters  
 DECLARE @var_palletFK int, @var_distance int , @var_palletFK2 int 
 SET @var_palletFK = @palletFK; SET @var_distance = @distance ; SET @var_palletFK2 =  @palletFK2
 SET @ParameterDetails = '@palletFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_palletFK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@distance = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_distance AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'')  + ',@palletFK2 = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_palletFK2 AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'')  
  
    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL   
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)  
  
    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)  
    --BEGIN  
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC   
  
  SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)  
  
        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)  
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK  
  
        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()  
    --END  
  
  
 SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);  
 SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails  
 ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;  
 INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()  
  
 WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3  
 BEGIN   
  BEGIN TRY     
  
   -- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start  
  print 'getting values'
   Declare @objectLeftPK int  
   Declare @objectLeftEnd int  
   Declare @objectRightStart int  
   Declare @locationFK int  
   Declare @palletStart int  
   Declare @palletEnd int  
   Declare @bayWidth int  
   
   Select @locationFK = LocationFK, @palletStart = PalletStart, @palletEnd = PalletEnd
   from tblPallets where PalletPK = @var_palletFK  
   Select @bayWidth = Width,  
   @var_distance = case when buRows.LocateFromLeft = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ then @var_distance else @var_distance * -1 end  
   from tblBuildingUnitBays buBays  
   inner join tblBuildingUnitColumns buCols on  
   buCols.BuildingUnitColumnPK = buBAys.BuildingUnitColumnFK  
   inner join tblBuildingUnitRows buRows on  
   buRows.BuildingUnitRowPK = buCols.BuildingUnitRowFK  
   where BuildingUnitBayPK = @locationFK  
  
   print '@check left'
   if(@var_distance < 0) --left movement   
   BEGIN  
   print '@var_distance < 0'
    Select top 1 @objectLeftEnd = PalletEnd  
    From tblPallets  
    Where LocationFK = @locationFK  
    AND PalletEnd <= @palletStart AND PalletPK <> @var_palletFK AND IsArchived = 0  
    Order By PalletEnd DESC  
  
    IF(@objectLeftEnd is null)   
    BEGIN --Check end of cell  
     if(@palletStart + @var_distance < 0)   
     BEGIN  
      Set @var_distance = @palletStart  
     END  
    END   
    ELSE   
    BEGIN  
     IF(ABS(@objectLeftEnd - @palletStart) < abs(@var_distance))   
     BEGIN  
      Set @var_distance = ABS(@objectLeftEnd - @palletStart) * -1  
     END  
    END  
  print 'ready'
	print @var_palletFK
	print @var_palletFK2
	print @var_distance
    if(@var_distance = 0) return  
	
  
    IF XACT_STATE() = 0 AND @@TRANCOUNT < 1 BEGIN TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName  
  
  print 'moving pallet'
    update tblPallets WITH (ROWLOCK)  
    Set PalletStart = PalletStart + @var_distance,  
    PalletEnd = PalletEnd + @var_distance  
    Where PalletPK = @var_palletFK  

	if(@var_palletFK2 > 0)
	begin
	print 'moving stacked'
		update tblPallets WITH (ROWLOCK)  
		Set PalletStart = PalletStart + @var_distance,  
		PalletEnd = PalletEnd + @var_distance  
		Where PalletPK = @var_palletFK2  
	end
  
    BEGIN TRY IF XACT_STATE() = 1 AND @@TRANCOUNT = 1 AND @OpeningTranCount < 1 COMMIT TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH  
   END   
   ELSE   
   BEGIN  
    Select top 1 @objectRightStart = PalletStart  
    From tblPallets  
    Where LocationFK = @locationFK  
    AND PalletStart >= @palletEnd AND PalletPK <> @var_palletFK AND IsArchived = 0  
    Order By PalletEnd DESC  
  
    IF(@objectRightStart is null)   
    BEGIN --Check end of cell  
     if(@palletEnd + @var_distance > @bayWidth)   
     BEGIN  
      Set @var_distance = @bayWidth - @palletEnd  
     END  
    END   
    ELSE   
    BEGIN  
     IF(ABS(@objectRightStart - @palletEnd) <= @var_distance)   
     BEGIN  
      Set @var_distance = ABS(@objectRightStart - @palletEnd)   
     END  
    END  
  
    if(@var_distance = 0) return  
  
    IF XACT_STATE() = 0 AND @@TRANCOUNT < 1 BEGIN TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName  
  
    update tblPallets WITH (ROWLOCK)  
    Set PalletStart = PalletStart + @var_distance,  
    PalletEnd = PalletEnd + @var_distance  
    Where PalletPK = @var_palletFK  

	if(@var_palletFK2 > 0)
	begin
	print 'moving stacked'
		update tblPallets WITH (ROWLOCK)  
		Set PalletStart = PalletStart + @var_distance,  
		PalletEnd = PalletEnd + @var_distance  
		Where PalletPK = @var_palletFK2  
	end
  
    BEGIN TRY IF XACT_STATE() = 1 AND @@TRANCOUNT = 1 AND @OpeningTranCount < 1 COMMIT TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH  
   END  
   
   -- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end     
     
   BREAK  
  END TRY  
  BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */  
   DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;  
   SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;  
   SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;  
  
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY   
   BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;  
         
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;  
  
            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID  
              
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;  
              
   IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)  
   BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END  
   ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */  
  END CATCH  
  SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1  
 END  
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spPalletRemove] 
(
	@palletFK int
)	
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT
 ,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;
	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	DECLARE @var_palletFK int
	SET @var_palletFK = @palletFK
	SET @ParameterDetails = '@palletFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_palletFK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'')

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    --BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

		SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END


	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY
			IF XACT_STATE() = 0 AND @@TRANCOUNT < 1 BEGIN TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start

			Declare @locationTypeFK int, @locationFK int, @palletEnd int

			Select
				@locationFK = pallets.LocationFK, 
				@locationTypeFK = pallets.LocationTypeFK,
				@palletEnd = pallets.PalletEnd
		
				From tblPallets pallets
				Where pallets.PalletPK = @var_palletFK

			if @locationTypeFK = 1/*Bay Racking*/
			BEGIN  --if we are moving a pallet from racking, check and adjust bay positions
				--If we have conventional racking, update bay positions as necessary
				if Exists(Select * from tblBuildingUnitRows buRows
					inner join tblBuildingUnitColumns buCols on
					buCols.BuildingUnitRowFK = buRows.BuildingUnitRowPK
					inner join tblBuildingUnitBays buBays on
					buBays.BuildingUnitColumnFK = buCols.BuildingUnitColumnPK
					Where buBays.BuildingUnitBayPK = @locationFK
					AND buRows.RackingTypeFK in (1,2,4,6))
					AND @locationFK not in (Select BuildingUnitBayFK from tblStockItemFixedLocations)
				BEGIN
					Update tblPallets WITH (ROWLOCK)
					Set BayPosition = BayPosition - 1
					Where LocationTypeFK = 1/*Bay Racking*/ AND LocationFK = @locationFK
							AND PalletStart >= @palletEnd
				END
			END

			Delete tblPalletAdditionalFieldValues where PalletContentFK in (Select PalletContentPK from tblPalletContent Where PalletFK = @var_palletFK)
			Delete tblPalletContent where PalletFK = @var_palletFK
			Delete tblPalletContentUnitCosts where PalletFK = @var_palletFK
			Delete tblPalletContentCommodityCodes where PalletFK = @var_palletFK
			Delete tblPalletContentVersions where PalletFK = @var_palletFK
			Delete tblPallets where PalletPK = @var_palletFK

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end

			BEGIN TRY IF XACT_STATE() = 1 AND @@TRANCOUNT = 1 AND @OpeningTranCount < 1 COMMIT TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH
			
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spPalletsCheckPalletAgainstRules]      
(      
 @palletFK int,      
 @stockItemFK int,    
 @locationTypefk int,    
 @locationfk int     
)       
AS      
BEGIN      
 /* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */      
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED      
      
    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT      
 ,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;      
 SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();      
      
 -- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters      
 DECLARE @var_palletFK int, @var_stockItemFK int  ,@var_locationTypefk int ,@var_locationfk int    
 SET @var_palletFK = @palletFK; SET @var_stockItemFK = @stockItemFK ;SET  @var_locationTypefk =@locationTypefk;set @var_locationfk = @locationfk    
 SET @ParameterDetails = '@palletFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_palletFK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@stockItemFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_stockItemFK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'')    
 + ',@locationTypefk = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_locationTypefk AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'')    
 + ',@locationfk = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_locationfk AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'')    
      
    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL       
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

 ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;      
 INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()      
      
 WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3      
 BEGIN       
  BEGIN TRY      
         
      
   -- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start      
      
   /* DEBUG      
   DECLARE @locationexFK int      
   DECLARE @var_palletFK int      
   DECLARE @var_stockItemFK int      
      
   set @var_palletFK = 160627      
   set @var_stockItemFK = 46393      
   set @locationexFK = 6120      
   */      
    
   --select top 10 * from viewRackingLocations    
   --select top 10 * from viewBuildingUnitBays where locationTypeFK=6    
   --select * from appLocationTypes    
 -- , @locationTypeFK int, @locationFK int    
   Declare @ret int      
   Set @ret = 0 --Initialize to Zero (All Clear/Pallet is OK)      
   Declare @divisionFK int, @buildingUnitFK int, @bayLevel nvarchar(50), @columnLevels int,      
   @allowFloorStorage bit, @prohibitTopLevelRacking bit, @unstable1 bit, @unstable2 bit, @unstable3 bit      
   
 Select @divisionFK = DivisionFK, @allowFloorStorage = AllowFloorStorage,      
   @prohibitTopLevelRacking = ProhibitTopLevelRacking, @unstable1 = Unstable1, @unstable2 = @unstable2, @unstable3 = @unstable3      
   from tblStockItems where StockItemPK = @var_stockItemFK      
     
   Select @buildingUnitFK = buBays.BuildingUnitFK,-- @locationTypeFK = LocationTypeFK, @locationFK = LocationFK,       
   --Select @buildingUnitFK = BuildingUnitFK,    
   @bayLevel = isnull(buBays.BayLevel, 'ZZZ'), @columnLevels = isnull(buCols.Levels, -1)       
   from tblPallets pallets       
   left outer join viewBuildingUnitBays buBays on buBays.BuildingUnitBayPK = @var_locationfk    
    --left outer join tblBuildingUnitBays buBays on buBays.BuildingUnitBayPK = @var_locationfk

   where pallets.PalletPK = @var_palletFK and  buBays.locationTypeFk = @var_locationTypefk     
      
   print @var_palletFK      
      
   /*CHECK AGAINST ASSIGNED BUILDING UNITS*/      
   print @divisionfk      
   print @buildingunitfk      
   Declare @value1 int  
   Declare @value2 int  
  
   set @value1 = 0  
   set @value2 = 0  
      
   IF(NOT Exists(Select * from tblDivisionBuildingUnits       
    where DivisionFK = @divisionFK AND BuildingUnitFK = @buildingUnitFK And IsArchived = 0))   
 --Set @ret = @ret + 128     /* DG Exclude Archived tblDivisionBuildingUnits IsArchived = 0 */      
 set @value1 = 1  
      
 print @ret  
    IF(NOT Exists(Select * from tblStockItemBuildingUnits       
    where StockItemFK = @var_stockItemFK AND BuildingUnitFK = @buildingUnitFK And IsArchived = 0))   
 --Set @ret = @ret + 128     /* DG Exclude Archived tblDivisionBuildingUnits IsArchived = 0 */      
    set @value2 = 1  
 --print @ret  
  
 if (@value1 =1)  
 begin   
  if (@value2 = 1)  
  begin  
   Set @ret = @ret + 128  
  end  
  else  
  begin  
   Set @ret = 0  
  end  
 end  
 --else  
 --begin   
 -- if (@value2 = 1)  
 -- begin  
 --  Set @ret = @ret + 128  
 -- end  
 -- else  
 -- begin  
 --  Set @ret = 0  
 -- end  
 --end  
   /* DEBUG       
   set @divisionFK = 622      
   set @buildingUnitFK = 76      
   */      
   /*CHECK AGAINST ASSIGNED BUILDING UNIT BAYS*/      
   IF(@locationTypeFK = 1/*Racking*/)       
   BEGIN      
    IF(NOT EXISTS(Select * from tblDivisionBuildingUnitBays      
     where DivisionFK = @divisionFK AND BuildingUnitBayFK = @locationFK And IsArchived = 0)) /* DG Exclude Archived tblDivisionBuildingUnitsBays IsArchived = 0 */      
    BEGIN      
     --IF(EXISTS(Select * from tblDivisionBuildingUnitBays

     -- Set @ret = @ret  + 256      
     --END      
     --ELSE      
     --BEGIN      
      Set @ret = 0      
     --END      
    END      
   END      
      
   /*CHECK AGAINST BAY LEVEL RULES*/      
   IF(@locationTypeFK = 1/*Racking*/)       
   BEGIN      
    /*FLOOR STORAGE*/      
    IF(@allowFloorStorage = 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/)       
    BEGIN      
     IF(@bayLevel = 'A') Set @ret = @ret + 1      
    END      
      
    /*TOP LEVEL RACKING*/      
    IF(@prohibitTopLevelRacking = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/)       
    BEGIN      
     IF((ASCII(@bayLevel) - 64) = @columnLevels)       
     BEGIN      
      Set @ret = @ret + 2      
     END      
    END      
      
    /*UNSTABLE 3*/      
    IF(@unstable3 = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/)       
    BEGIN      
     IF(@bayLevel <> 'A') Set @ret = @ret + 4      
    END      
      
    /*UNSTABLE 2*/      
    IF(@unstable2 = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/)       
    BEGIN      
     IF(@bayLevel <> 'A' AND @bayLevel <> 'B') Set @ret = @ret + 8      
    END      
      
    /*UNSTABLE 1*/      
    IF(@unstable1 = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/)       
    BEGIN      
     IF(@bayLevel <> 'A' AND @bayLevel <> 'B' AND @bayLevel <> 'C') Set @ret = @ret + 16      
    END      
   END      
      
   Select @ret      
      
   -- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end      
      
         
         
   BREAK      
  END TRY    
  BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */      
   DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;      
   SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;      
   SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;      
      
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY       
   BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;      
             
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;      
      
            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID      
                  
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;      
                  
   IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)      
   BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END      
   ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */      
  END CATCH      
  SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1      
 END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spPalletSetunLoaded]    
(     
 @palletFK int,    
 @containerOutFK int,    
 @UserFK int,    
 @ToLocationTypeFk int,    
 @ToLocationFK int    
)     
AS    
BEGIN    
 /* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */    
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED    
    
    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT,    
 @PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;    
 SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();    
      
 -- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters    
 DECLARE @var_palletFK int, @var_containerOutFK int, @var_UserFK int, @var_ToLocationTypeFk int, @var_ToLocationFK int    
    
 SET @var_palletFK = @palletFK; SET @var_containerOutFK = @containerOutFK; SET @var_UserFK =@UserFK;     
 SET @var_ToLocationTypeFk =@ToLocationTypeFk; SET @var_ToLocationFK =@ToLocationFK    
 SET @ParameterDetails = '@palletFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_palletFK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@containerOutFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_containerOutFK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'')     
   + ',@UserFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_UserFK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + '@ToLocationTypeFk = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_ToLocationTypeFk AS NVARCHAR(5)),'')    
  + '@ToLocationFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_ToLocationFK AS NVARCHAR(5)),'')    
    
    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL     
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)    
    
    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)    
    --BEGIN    
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC     
    
  SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)    
    
        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)    
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK    
    
        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()    
    --END    
    
 SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);    
 SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails    
 ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;    
 INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()    
    
 WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3    
 BEGIN     
  BEGIN TRY       
    
   -- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start    
   --drop table if exists #tmpExistingAudit    
         
    
   if(exists(select palletauditpk from tblPalletAudit where palletfk = @var_palletFK and EventFK = @var_containerOutFK and EventTypeFK in (25,27)))    
   begin    
    
  print 'get existing loading movement'  
    drop table if exists #tmpexistingloadedMovement     
    select top 1 * into #tmpexistingloadedMovement from tblWorksOrderMovements where palletfk = @var_palletFK and DestinationLocationTypeFK = 5 and DestinationFK = @var_containerOutFK order by UpdatedDate desc    
        
  print 'get wo pk'  
    declare @worksorderfk int    
    select @worksorderfk = worksorderfk from #tmpexistingloadedMovement    
        
     
  --print 'new unload movement'  
   -- drop table if exists #tmpNewUnloadMovement    
    --select * into #tmpNewUnloadMovement from #tmpexistingloadedMovement    
        
     
  --print 'new reload movement'  
  --  drop table if exists #tmpNewReloadMovement    
  --  select * into #tmpNewReloadMovement from #tmpexistingloadedMovement    
    
    
  print 'physical'  
    drop table if exists #tmpphysicalcheck    
    select top 1 wopr.* into #tmpphysicalcheck     
    from tblworksorderpalletresult wopr    
    inner join tblworksorderpallets on worksorderpalletpk = worksorderpalletfk     
    where palletfk = @var_palletFK         
    order by WorksOrderPalletResultPK desc    
    
    declare @newDate datetime = dbo.GetBSTDate()    
    
    IF XACT_STATE() = 0 AND @@TRANCOUNT < 1 BEGIN TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName    
        
  --print 'update existing audit'  
     --prep existing record to add as new audit event    
  --   update #tmpExistingAudit     
  --   set EventTypeFK = 26, EventDate = getdate(), InsertedDate = getdate(), UpdatedDate = getdate(), InsertedBy = @var_UserFK, UpdatedBy = @var_UserFK    
    
  --print 'update new unload'  
     --prep unload movement    
   --  update #tmpNewUnloadMovement     
   --  set SourceLocationTypeFK = 5, SourceLocationFK = @var_containerOutFK, ResponsibleUserFK = @var_UserFK, DestinationFK = @var_ToLocationFK,     
  --    DestinationLocationTypeFK = @var_ToLocationTypeFk, MovementDescription = 'Unload Pallet from container', InsertedDate =@newDate, UpdatedDate = @newDate, InsertedBy = @var_UserFK, UpdatedBy = @var_UserFK    
        
  --print 'update new reload'  
     --prep reload movement    
    -- update #tmpNewReloadMovement     
    -- set WorksOrderStatusFK = 1, ResponsibleUserFK = -1, MovementDescription = 'Load Pallet on container', InsertedDate =@newDate, UpdatedDate = @newDate, InsertedBy = @var_UserFK, UpdatedBy = @var_UserFK    
    
  print 'insert audit'  
     --add unload audit event    
	insert into tblPalletAudit   
	select top 1 PalletFK, BuildingUnitFk, 26, EventFK,@newDate,StockItemFK,Batch,  
	   TotalPallets,TotalBatchPallets,TotalEaches,TotalBatchEaches,TotalUnits,TotalBatchUnits,BuildingUnitTotalPallets,  
	   BuildingUnitTotalBatchPallets,BuildingUnitTotalEaches,BuildingUnitTotalBatchEaches,BuildingUnitTotalUnits,BuildingUnitTotalBatchUnits,  
	   IsArchived,InsertedBy,@newDate,UpdatedBy,@newDate   
	from tblPalletAudit 
	where palletfk = @var_palletFK and EventFK = @var_containerOutFK and EventTypeFK in (25,27)
     
  print 'insert wom unload'  
     --add unload movement record    
	insert into tblWorksOrderMovements    
	select top 1 WorksOrderFK,WorksOrderStatusFK,PalletFK,PalletContentFK,ContainerOutLinePalletContentFK,EntirePallet,Eaches,Units,  
	   5,@var_containerOutFK,SourceBayPosition,SourceStackPosition,@var_ToLocationTypeFk,@var_ToLocationFK,  
	   DestinationBayPosition,DestinationStackPosition,DestinationPalletStart,DestinationPalletEnd,'Unload Pallet from container',  
	   IsArchived,InsertedBy,@newDate,@var_UserFK,@newDate,@var_UserFK,HandheldDeviceFK,WarehouseMachineFK   
	from #tmpexistingloadedMovement    
    
  print 'update wo'  
     --ensure works order is not completed as there is now a reload 
	if((select worksorderstatusfk from tblworksorders where worksorderpk = @worksorderfk) = 3)
	begin
		update tblworksorders set WorksOrderStatusFK = 1 where worksorderpk = @worksorderfk    
	end
    
  print 'update pal'  
     --update pallet record with new location    
     update tblpallets set locationfk = @var_ToLocationFK, LocationTypeFK = @var_ToLocationTypeFk where PalletPK = @var_palletFK    
    
  print 'insert wom reload'  
     --add reload movement record    
	insert into tblWorksOrderMovements    
    select top 1 WorksOrderFK,1,PalletFK,PalletContentFK,ContainerOutLinePalletContentFK,EntirePallet,Eaches,Units,  
		SourceLocationTypeFK,SourceLocationFK,SourceBayPosition,SourceStackPosition,DestinationLocationTypeFK,DestinationFK,  
		DestinationBayPosition,DestinationStackPosition,DestinationPalletStart,DestinationPalletEnd,'Load Pallet on container',  
		IsArchived,@var_UserFK,@newDate,@var_UserFK,@newDate,-1,HandheldDeviceFK,WarehouseMachineFK   
	from #tmpexistingloadedMovement    
    
     --update physical checkrecord    
     if(exists(select * from #tmpphysicalcheck))    
     begin    
		update #tmpphysicalcheck set PalletAccepted = -1    
		insert into tblWorksOrderPalletResult    
		select top 1 WorksOrderPalletFK,PalletAccepted,IsArchived,InsertedBy,InsertedDate,UpdatedBy,UpdatedDate  
		from #tmpphysicalcheck    
      
		declare @worksorderpallet int    
		select @worksorderpallet = worksorderpalletfk from #tmpphysicalcheck    
		update tblWorksOrderPallets set WorksOrderStatusFK = 5 where WorksOrderPalletPK = @worksorderpallet           
     end    
    
  print 'co audit'  
     --add containeroutaudit    
     declare @barcode nvarchar(50)    
     select @barcode = (case when customerbarcode = '' then barcode else customerbarcode end) from tblpallets where palletpk = @var_palletFK    
     insert into tblContainerOutAudit    
      values( @var_containerOutFK, 17, 'Pallet unloaded from container, barcode: '+@barcode, 0 , 0, @var_UserFK, @newDate, @var_UserFK, @newDate, 0)    
    
  print 'colpc unload'  
     --set colpc as unloaded    
     update colpc  set colpc.loaded = 0     
     from tblContainerOutLinePalletContent colpc      
     inner join tblcontaineroutlines col on col.ContainerOutLinePK = colpc.ContainerOutLineFK AND containeroutfk = @var_containerOutFK     
     where palletfk = @var_palletFK    
  
    
   select 1  as Result  
   return  
    
    BEGIN TRY IF XACT_STATE() = 1 AND @@TRANCOUNT = 1 AND @OpeningTranCount < 1 COMMIT TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH    
   end    
   select 0  as Result  
    
   -- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end       
       
   BREAK    
  END TRY    
  BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */    
   DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;    
    
   SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;    
   SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;    
    
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY     
   BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;    
           
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;    
    
            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID    
                
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;    
                
   IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)    
   BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END    
   ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */    
  END CATCH    
  SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1    
 END    
END
