-- =============================================
-- Author:        <Jamie>
-- Create date: <02/02/2017>
-- Description:   <Get details of picks a pallet is in, and its current location, for list of proviced pallets>
-- =============================================

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spPalletsGetPickAndLocationDetails] 
	@PalletsXML xml
AS

BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
	SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ UNCOMMITTED

	select ParamValues.PalletPK.value('VALUE[1]','INT')[PalletPK], vpl.BuildingUnitFK, 
		isnull(containerouts.ContainerOutPK, -1) [ContainerOutPK], isnull(containerouts.StockOrderPK, -1) [StockOrderPK],
		case when wops.worksorderpalletpk is null then 0 else 1 end as PalletOnExistingWorksOrder
	FROM @PalletsXML.nodes('//FK') as ParamValues(PalletPK)
	inner join viewpalletlocations vpl on vpl.PalletPK = ParamValues.PalletPK.value('VALUE[1]','INT')
	left join (
		select StockOrderPK,containeroutPK, PalletFK, responsibleBuildingUnitFk
		from tblstockorders so
		inner join tblContainerOuts co on co.containeroutpk = so.containeroutfk
		inner join tblContaineroutLines col on co.containerOutPk = col.containerOutFK
		inner join tblContaineroutLinePalletContent colp on col.containerOutLinePk = colp.containerOutLineFK
		where co.containerOutStatusFK <> 6
	) containerouts on containerouts.palletFK = ParamValues.PalletPK.value('VALUE[1]','INT') and containerouts.responsibleBuildingUnitFk = vpl.buildingunitfk
	left join (
		select palletfk, worksorderpalletpk, worksorderpk, wop.worksorderstatusfk
		from tblworksorderpallets wop
		inner join tblworksorders wo on wo.worksorderpk = wop.worksorderfk
		where wop.worksorderstatusfk = 1 and WorksOrderTypeFK = 5
	) wops on wops.PalletFK = ParamValues.PalletPK.value('VALUE[1]','INT')
END
GO

-- =============================================
-- Author:        <Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:   <Description,,>
-- =============================================

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spPalletsSetLoaded]
( 
	@MovementsXML xml,
	@UserFK int,
	@IsHandHeld bit = 0
)	
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT,
	@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;
	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();
		
	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	DECLARE @var_MovementsXML xml, @var_UserFK int, @var_IsHandHeld int
	SET @var_MovementsXML = @MovementsXML; SET @var_UserFK = @UserFK; SET @var_IsHandHeld = CASE WHEN @IsHandHeld = 1 THEN 27 ELSE 25 END
	SET @ParameterDetails = '@MovementsXML = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_MovementsXML AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@UserFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_UserFK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') 
		+ '@IsHandHeld = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@IsHandHeld AS NVARCHAR(5)),'')

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    --BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

		SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END

	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY			

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start

			IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#TempSelectedMovements') IS NOT NULL
				DROP TABLE #TempSelectedMovements

			IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#TempWorksOrders') IS NOT NULL
				DROP TABLE #TempWorksOrders

			IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#TempEmptyLines') IS NOT NULL
				DROP TABLE #TempEmptyLines

			--/******** DECLARE TEMP TABLES ************/
			--create table #TempSelectedMovements
			--(
			--	TempWorksOrderMovementPK int,
			--	TempPalletFK int,
			--	TempContainerOutLinePalletContentFK int
			--)

			/****INSERT XML VALUES INTO TEMP TABLE***/
			--INSERT INTO #TempSelectedMovements (TempWorksOrderMovementPK, TempPalletFK, TempContainerOutLinePalletContentFK) 
			SELECT 
				ParamValues.Movements.value('WorksOrderMovementPK[1]','INT') as TempWorksOrderMovementPK,  
				woms.WorksOrderFK AS TempWorksOrderFK,
				woms.palletfk as TempPalletFK, 
				woms.containeroutlinepalletcontentFK as TempContainerOutLinePalletContentFK
			INTO
				#TempSelectedMovements
			FROM 
				@var_MovementsXML.nodes('//Movement') as ParamValues(Movements)
			inner join tblworksordermovements AS woms 
				on woms.worksordermovementpk = ParamValues.Movements.value('WorksOrderMovementPK[1]','INT')
			--inner join tblcontaineroutlinepalletcontent colpc on colpc.containeroutlinepalletcontentpk = woms.containeroutlinepalletcontentFK
			--inner join tblcontaineroutlines col on col.containeroutlinepk = colpc.containeroutlinefk
			
			SELECT distinct TempWorksOrderFK as TempWorksorderPK
			INTO #TempWorksOrders
			FROM #TempSelectedMovements

			IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#TempLoadingMovements') IS NOT NULL
				DROP TABLE #TempLoadingMovements
			SELECT wom.WorksOrderMovementPK AS TempWorksOrderMovementPK, wom.WorksOrderFK AS TempWorksorderPK
			INTO #TempLoadingMovements
			FROM tblworksordermovements wom
			INNER JOIN tblworksorders wo ON wom.worksorderfk = wo.WorksOrderPK
			INNER JOIN #TempSelectedMovements tsm ON tsm.TempPalletFK = wom.PalletFK
			--INNER JOIN tblworksorders wo2 ON tsm.TempWorksOrderFK = wo2.WorksOrderPK
			where wo.WorksOrderTypeFK = 16 and wom.ContainerOutLinePalletContentFK = tsm.TempContainerOutLinePalletContentFK/*wo.fk = wo2.fk*/ AND wom.WorksOrderStatusFK <> 3/*loading*/
			
			IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#TempLoadingWorksOrders') IS NOT NULL
				DROP TABLE #TempLoadingWorksOrders
			
			SELECT distinct TempWorksorderPK
			INTO #TempLoadingWorksOrders
			FROM #TempLoadingMovements

			SELECT distinct colpc.containeroutlinepalletcontentPK
			INTO #TempEmptyLines
			FROM tblcontaineroutlinepalletcontent colpc
			INNER JOIN tblcontaineroutlines AllLines on containeroutlinefk = containeroutlinepk
			INNER JOIN (
				select containeroutfk, containeroutlinefk, containeroutlinepalletcontentpk
				from tblcontaineroutlinepalletcontent
				inner join tblcontaineroutlines on containeroutlinefk = containeroutlinepk
				inner join #TempSelectedMovements on TempContainerOutLinePalletContentFK = containeroutlinepalletcontentPK
			) thisLine on thisline.containeroutfk = AllLines.containeroutfk
			where colpc.palletfk = -1 and colpc.palletcontentfk = -1

			IF XACT_STATE() = 0 AND @@TRANCOUNT < 1 BEGIN TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName

			/*****UPDATE COLPC AS LOADED**************/
			Update colpc WITH (ROWLOCK) 
			set 
				Loaded = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/, updatedby = @var_UserFK, updateddate = dbo.GetBSTDate()
			from 
				tblcontaineroutlinepalletcontent AS colpc
			inner join (
							select containeroutlinefk 
							from tblcontaineroutlinepalletcontent AS c
							inner join #TempSelectedMovements AS selMove 
							on c.containeroutlinepalletcontentPK = selMove.TempContainerOutLinePalletContentFK
						) AS col 
				on colpc.containeroutlinefk = col.containeroutlinefk
			inner join #TempSelectedMovements AS pals 
				on colpc.palletfk = pals.TempPalletFK
			
			--delete colpc records where pallet and content are blank
			delete colpc
			from tblcontaineroutlinepalletcontent colpc
			inner join #TempEmptyLines as emptyline on emptyline.containeroutlinepalletcontentPK = colpc.containeroutlinepalletcontentPK
			
			--from tblContainerOutLinePalletContent colpc 
			--inner join #TempSelectedMovements selMove on colpc.containeroutlinepalletcontentPK = selMove.TempContainerOutLinePalletContentFK

			--update movement record
			UPDATE wom WITH (ROWLOCK)
			SET wom.WorksOrderStatusFK =3, updatedby = @var_UserFK, updateddate = dbo.GetBSTDate()
			from dbo.tblWorksOrderMovements wom
			INNER JOIN #TempSelectedMovements twom ON wom.WorksOrderMovementPK = twom.TempWorksOrderMovementPK
			WHERE wom.WorksOrderStatusFK <> 3 /*not already completed*/

			--update parent worksorder record
			IF (Select count(*) from tblWorksOrderMovements wom INNER JOIN #TempWorksOrders two ON wom.WorksOrderFK = two.TempWorksorderPK Where WorksOrderStatusFK not in (3,4)/*Complete or Cancelled*/) = 0
			BEGIN  /*All pallet movements are complete, set the works order to complete*/				
				Update wo WITH (ROWLOCK)
				Set WorksOrderStatusFK = 3/*Complete*/, updatedby = @var_UserFK, updateddate = dbo.GetBSTDate()
				FROM tblworksorders wo 
				INNER JOIN #TempWorksOrders two ON wo.WorksOrderPK = two.TempWorksorderPK
				WHERE wo.WorksOrderStatusFK <> 3 /*not already completed*/
			END
			
			--update loading movement record
			UPDATE wom WITH (ROWLOCK)
			SET wom.WorksOrderStatusFK =3, updatedby = @var_UserFK, updateddate = dbo.GetBSTDate(), movementdescription = case when @var_IsHandHeld = 27 then 'HAND HELD ' + MovementDescription else MovementDescription end  
			from dbo.tblWorksOrderMovements wom
			INNER JOIN #TempLoadingMovements twom ON wom.WorksOrderMovementPK = twom.TempWorksOrderMovementPK
			WHERE wom.WorksOrderStatusFK <> 3 /*not already completed*/

			--update parent worksorder record
			IF (Select count(*) from tblWorksOrderMovements wom INNER JOIN #TempLoadingWorksOrders two ON wom.WorksOrderFK = two.TempWorksorderPK Where WorksOrderStatusFK not in (3,4)/*Complete or Cancelled*/) = 0
			BEGIN  /*All pallet movements are complete, set the works order to complete*/				
				Update wo WITH (ROWLOCK)
				Set WorksOrderStatusFK = 3/*Complete*/, updatedby = @var_UserFK, updateddate = dbo.GetBSTDate()
				FROM tblworksorders wo 
				INNER JOIN #TempLoadingWorksOrders two ON wo.WorksOrderPK = two.TempWorksorderPK
				WHERE wo.WorksOrderStatusFK <> 3 /*not already completed*/
			END

			
			
			/*****add pallet audit record*************/
			IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#TempLoadingEvent') IS NOT NULL
				DROP TABLE #TempLoadingEvent
							
			select 
				p.palletpk, p.buildingUnitFK, @var_IsHandHeld/*pallet loaded*/ AS eventTypeFK, col.ContainerOutFK, dbo.GetBSTDate() AS EventDate, 
				col.stockitemfk, col.batch, 1 AS TotalPallets, 1 AS TotalBatchPallets, colpc.eaches AS TotalEaches, 
				colpc.eaches AS TotalBatchEaches, colpc.units as TotalUnits, colpc.units AS TotalBatchUnits, 1 AS BuildingUnitTotalPallets, 1 AS BuildingUnitTotalBatchPallets, 
				colpc.eaches as BuildingUnitTotalEaches, colpc.eaches BuildingUnitTotalBatchEaches, colpc.units AS BuildingUnitTotalUnits, colpc.units AS BuildingUnitTotalBatchUnits, 
				0/*cast(0 as bit)*/ AS IsArchived, @var_UserFK AS InsertedBy, dbo.GetBSTDate() AS InsertedDate, 
				case WHEN woms.responsibleuserfk > 0 THEN woms.responsibleuserfk else @var_UserFK END AS UpdatedBy, dbo.GetBSTDate() AS UpdatedDate
			INTO #TempLoadingEvent
			from 
				#TempSelectedMovements AS selMove
			inner join tblWorksOrderMovements AS woms 
				on woms.worksordermovementpk = selMove.TempWorksOrderMovementPK
			inner join tblpallets AS p 
				on selMove.TempPalletFK = p.palletpk
			inner join tblcontaineroutlinepalletcontent AS colpc 
				on colpc.containeroutlinepalletcontentPK = selMove.TempContainerOutLinePalletContentFK
			inner join tblcontaineroutlines AS col 
				on col.containeroutlinepk = colpc.containeroutlineFK 
			--can be loaded twice if unloaded, so ignore this
			--left join tblpalletaudit AS pa 
				--on pa.eventfk = col.containeroutfk and pa.eventtypefk = @var_IsHandHeld AND pa.PalletFK = woms.PalletFK
			--where pa.palletauditpk is null

			insert into tblpalletaudit
				SELECT * FROM #TempLoadingEvent

			if(@var_IsHandHeld = 27)
			BEGIN
				DECLARE @containerOutFK int
				DECLARE @ActionedBy int
				SELECT @containerOutFK = ContainerOutFK , @ActionedBy = UpdatedBy FROM #TempLoadingEvent

				IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#TempLoadingProgress') IS NOT NULL
					DROP TABLE #TempLoadingProgress

				SELECT distinct count(worksordermovementpk) MoveCount, wom.WorksOrderStatusFK 
				INTO #TempLoadingProgress
				FROM #TempLoadingWorksOrders two
				INNER JOIN tblworksorders wo ON two.TempWorksorderPK = wo.WorksOrderPK
				INNER JOIN tblworksorders wo2 ON wo.FK = wo2.FK AND wo.WorksOrderTypeFK = wo2.WorksOrderTypeFK
				inner join tblworksordermovements wom ON wo2.worksorderpk = wom.worksorderfk
				GROUP BY wom.WorksOrderStatusFK

				
				if((SELECT MoveCount FROM #TempLoadingProgress WHERE WorksOrderStatusFK = 3) = 1)
				BEGIN
				--this is the first pallet loaded
					INSERT INTO tblContainerOutAudit VALUES (@containerOutFK, 14, 'First pallet loaded ', 0, 0, @var_UserFK, dbo.GetBSTDate(), @ActionedBy, dbo.GetBSTDate(),0)
				END
				ELSE if((SELECT MoveCount FROM #TempLoadingProgress WHERE WorksOrderStatusFK < 3)  IS null)
				BEGIN
				--this is the last pallet loaded
					INSERT INTO tblContainerOutAudit VALUES (@containerOutFK, 15, 'Last pallet loaded ', 0, 0, @var_UserFK, dbo.GetBSTDate(), @ActionedBy, dbo.GetBSTDate(),0)
				END


			END

			BEGIN TRY IF XACT_STATE() = 1 AND @@TRANCOUNT = 1 AND @OpeningTranCount < 1 COMMIT TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH

			return 1

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end			
			
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;

			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
							
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END
GO

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spPalletsToLocate]
( 
	@PalletFKs xml
)	
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT,
	@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;
	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();
		
	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	DECLARE @var_PalletFKs xml
	SET @var_PalletFKs = @PalletFKs;
	SET @ParameterDetails = '@PalletFKs = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_PalletFKs AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') 

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    --BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

		SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END

	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY			

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start

			Select distinct pallets.PalletPK, pallets.PalletTypeFK, palletTypes.IsTruePalletType, pallets.IsMixedPallet, palletContent.Batch, pallets.Barcode, pallets.CustomerPalletNumber, 
				pallets.LocationTypeFK, locationTypes.LocationType, pallets.LocationFK, pallets.BayPosition, StockItemPK, StockItemCode, palletContent.ActualUnits, palletContent.ActualEachUnits, 
				palletContent2.PalletContentPK, StockInLocationStoredProcedure,
				case when LocationTypeFK = 2 then loadingBays.LoadingBay when LocationTypeFK = 3 then setDownAreas.SetDownArea End as Location 
			from
				(Select Distinct(PalletFK) 
				from tblStockInLinePallets) silps
				inner join tblPallets pallets on pallets.PalletPK = silps.PalletFK
				inner join tblPalletTypes palletTypes on palletTypes.PalletTypePK = pallets.PalletTypeFK
				left outer join tblWorksOrderMovements woms on woms.PalletFK = pallets.PalletPK AND woms.WorksOrderStatusFK <> 4 /*Not Cancelled*/  and destinationlocationtypefk <> 2 /*ignore unload movements*/
				inner join (
					Select PalletFK, StockItemFK, Batch, sum(pc.ActualUnits) ActualUnits, sum(pc.EachUnits) ActualEachUnits 
					from tblPalletContent pc 
					Group By pc.PalletFK, pc.StockItemFK, pc.Batch
				) palletContent on palletContent.PalletFK = pallets.PalletPK
				inner join tblPalletContent palletContent2 on palletContent2.PalletContentPK = (
					Select min(PalletContentPK) from tblPalletContent where PalletFK = pallets.PalletPK) 
				inner join appLocationTypes locationTypes on locationTypes.LocationTypePK = pallets.LocationTypeFK
				inner join tblStockItems stockItems on stockItems.StockItemPK = palletContent.StockItemFK
				inner join tblDivisions divisions on divisions.DivisionPK = stockItems.DivisionFK
				inner join tblCustomers customers on customers.CustomerPK = divisions.CustomerFK
				left outer join tblLoadingBays loadingBays on loadingBays.LoadingBayPK = pallets.LocationFK 
				left outer join tblSetDownAreas setDownAreas on setDownAreas.SetDownAreaPK = pallets.LocationFK 
				inner join 	@var_PalletFKs.nodes('//FK') as ParamValues(PalletPK) on pallets.palletPK = ParamValues.PalletPK.value('VALUE[1]','INT')
				left join tblStockItemFixedLocations stfl on stockItems.StockItemPK = stfl.StockItemFK ---- Pritesh
				where woms.WorksOrderMovementPK is null  and  stfl.StockItemFixedLocationPK is null  ----Pritesh 
				Order By pallets.Barcode ASC

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end			
			
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;

			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
							
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spPhysicalCheckResults] 
(
	@FromDate datetime,
	@ToDate datetime = null,
	@DivisionFK int = -1
)
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT
	,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;
	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

	set @ToDate = coalesce( @ToDate , dbo.GetBSTDate()) 

	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	DECLARE @var_FromDate datetime, @var_ToDate datetime, @var_DivisionFK int

	SET @var_FromDate = @FromDate
	set @var_ToDate = @ToDate
	SET @var_DivisionFK = @DivisionFK

	SET @ParameterDetails = '@FromDate = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_FromDate AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ', @ToDate = '+ ISNULL(CAST(@var_ToDate AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'')

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    --BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

		SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END

	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY
			
			-- This stored procedures main code, excluding error handling - start

			--DECLARE @palletfk int
			--SELECT @palletfk = palletpk FROM tblpallets WHERE customerbarcode = '00171020002101677434'

				--get list of pallets booked out within dates
			DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #alleffectedPallets
			SELECT DISTINCT palletfk 
			INTO #alleffectedPallets
			FROM tblcontaineroutlinepalletcontent 
			INNER JOIN dbo.tblContainerOutLines tcol ON containeroutlinefk = containeroutlinepk
			INNER JOIN tblcontainerouts tco ON containeroutfk = containeroutpk
			WHERE (collectiondate > @var_FromDate AND collectiondate <= @var_ToDate)  
				AND ((@var_DivisionFK = -1) or (@var_DivisionFK = tcol.divisionfk))

			DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #TempPhysicalChecks
	
			SELECT twop.palletFk, worksorderpk, worksorderpalletpk, worksorderpalletresultpk, PalletAccepted, twopr.InsertedDate AS PalletAcceptedDate, tp.PersonPK, tp.FirstName + ' ' + tp.LastName AS PalletAcceptedBy, so.ContainerOutFK AS OrderLink
			INTO #TempPhysicalChecks 
			FROM dbo.tblWorksOrderPalletResult twopr
			INNER JOIN dbo.tblWorksOrderPallets twop ON worksorderpalletpk = twopr.WorksOrderPalletFK			
			INNER JOIN #alleffectedPallets pals ON twop.palletfk = pals.palletfk
			INNER JOIN tblworksorders wo ON worksorderfk = worksorderpk
			INNER JOIN tblusers tu ON twopr.InsertedBy = tu.UserPK
			INNER JOIN dbo.tblPeople tp ON tp.PersonPK = tu.PersonFK
			INNER JOIN tblstockorders so ON so.stockorderpk = wo.FK
			WHERE twopr.PalletAccepted >= 0
			--WHERE palletfk = @palletfk
			--WHERE twopr.inserteddate > @var_FromDate and twopr.inserteddate <= @var_ToDate
			--ORDER BY twopr.WorksOrderPalletResultPK
			--SELECT * FROM #TempPhysicalChecks
			IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#TempAllResults') IS NOT NULL
				DROP TABLE #TempAllResults

			SELECT DISTINCT 
				CollectionDate, goodsordernumber, CASE WHEN tst.StockTransferPK IS NOT NULL then 'Stock Transfer : ' ELSE '' END + containeroutstatus AS Status, si.StockItemCode, tcol.Batch, 
				CASE WHEN tp.CustomerBarcode = '' THEN tp.barcode ELSE tp.CustomerBarcode END AS Barcode, PalletAccepted, PalletAcceptedDate, coalesce(pa.eventdate, CollectionDate) AS PalletLoadeddate, tpc.PalletAcceptedBy, tpc.PersonPK AS CheckBy, 
				adat.DeliveryAddressType, si.DivisionFK, 
				-- Cathal OCuirrin 23 Jan 2020.
				vbd.BuildingFK, vbd.BuildingName, tp.PalletPK 
			INTO 
				#TempAllResults
			FROM 
				dbo.tblContainerOutLinePalletContent tcolpc
			INNER JOIN tblpallets tp ON tcolpc.palletfk = palletpk --AND palletpk = @palletfk
			INNER JOIN dbo.tblContainerOutLines tcol ON containeroutlinefk = containeroutlinepk
			INNER JOIN tblstockitems si ON stockitempk = stockitemfk
			INNER JOIN tblcontainerouts tco ON containeroutfk = containeroutpk
			INNER JOIN dbo.appDeliveryAddressTypes adat ON tco.DeliveryTypeFK = adat.DeliveryAddressTypePK
			INNER JOIN tblstockorders so ON so.containeroutfk = containeroutpk AND tp.BuildingUnitFK = so.ResponsibleBuildingUnitFK
			LEFT JOIN dbo.tblStockTransfers tst ON tst.ContainerOutFK = tco.ContainerOutPK
			INNER JOIN dbo.appContainerOutStatus tcos ON tco.ContainerOutStatusFK = tcos.ContainerOutStatusPK
			--INNER JOIN tbldivisions div ON tcol.DivisionFK = div.DivisionPK
			INNER JOIN dbo.tblDivisionWorksOrders AS dwo ON tcol.DivisionFK = dwo.DivisionFK and WorkOrderTypeFK in (15,19,20,21,22) and dwo.IsArchived = 0
			 -- Cathal OCuirrin 23 Jan 2020.
			INNER JOIN dbo.viewBuildingDetails vbd ON tp.BuildingUnitFK = vbd.BuildingUnitPK

			LEFT JOIN #TempPhysicalChecks tpc ON tcolpc.PalletFK = tpc.palletFk AND tpc.OrderLink = tcol.ContainerOutFK
			outer APPLY(SELECT TOP 1 * from tblpalletaudit pa where pa.palletfk= tp.PalletPK AND eventtypefk IN (25,27) AND eventfk = tco.ContainerOutPK)pa
			WHERE 
				--tcol.divisionfk IN (SELECT divisionpk FROM tbldivisions WHERE dbo.tbldivisions.RequirePhysicalCheckDuringStockOrder = 1) 
				(
					(tco.DeliveryTypeFK = 1 and dwo.WorkOrderTypeFK = 15) 
					or (tco.DeliveryTypeFK = 2 and dwo.WorkOrderTypeFK = 22)
					or (tco.DeliveryTypeFK = 3 and dwo.WorkOrderTypeFK = 19)
					or (tco.DeliveryTypeFK = 4 and dwo.WorkOrderTypeFK = 20) 
					or (tco.DeliveryTypeFK = 5 and dwo.WorkOrderTypeFK = 21) 
				)
				AND (collectiondate > @var_FromDate AND collectiondate <= @var_ToDate)  
				AND tco.ContainerOutStatusFK IN (5,6) 
				AND ((@var_DivisionFK = -1) or (@var_DivisionFK = tcol.divisionfk))
				AND (
					(tco.ContainerOutStatusFK = 6 AND tpc.PalletAccepted IS NOT null)--order cancelled but check completed
					OR
					(tco.ContainerOutStatusFK = 5 AND tpc.PalletAccepted IS NOT null) --order completed and check completed
					OR
					(tco.ContainerOutStatusFK = 5 AND tpc.PalletAccepted IS null) -- order completed but check not completed
				)
			
			SELECT * FROM #TempAllResults ORDER BY collectionDate, Barcode, PalletAcceptedDate

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end
						
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spPowerBI_GlanbiaWeekendFileTimes] 
(
	@ReportType int = -1
)
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED

	--select * from tbldivisions where customerfk = 745

	drop table if exists #tmpGlanbiaStockIns
	select * into #tmpGlanbiaStockIns from tblstockins where divisionfk in (624,625) and year(inserteddate) = 2021

	drop table if exists #tmpGlanbiaContainerIns
	select ci.* into #tmpGlanbiaContainerIns from tblcontainerins ci inner join #tmpGlanbiaStockIns si on containerinfk = containerinpk

	drop table if exists #tmpGlanbiaStockInLines
	select sil.* into #tmpGlanbiaStockInLines from tblstockinlines sil inner join #tmpGlanbiaStockIns si on stockinfk = stockinpk

	drop table if exists #tmpGlanbiaStockInFiles
	select * into #tmpGlanbiaStockInFiles from tblIntegrationFiles where IntegrationFileTypeFK = 18 and customerfk = 745 and year(InsertedDate) = 2021

	drop table if exists #tmpFullResults
	select DivisionCode, ci.GoodsInNumber, ci.Free1 as CustomerRef, ci.InsertedDate [StockInCreated], sif.InsertedDate [FileTime], sif.FilePath, ci.DateIn, si.ArrivalDate, b.BuildingName + '-' + bu.BuildingUnit [Building], sum(sil.pallets) NoPallets, DATENAME(WEEKDAY, sif.InsertedDate) [Day Of Week File], DATENAME(WEEKDAY, si.ArrivalDate) [Day Of Week Arrived]
	into #tmpFullResults
	from #tmpGlanbiaContainerIns ci
	inner join #tmpGlanbiaStockIns si on ci.ContainerInPK = si.ContainerInFK
	inner join #tmpGlanbiaStockInLines sil on sil.StockInFK = si.StockInPK
	inner join tblbuildingunits bu on buildingunitpk = ci.BuildingUnitFK
	inner join tblbuildings b on buildingfk = buildingpk
	left join #tmpGlanbiaStockInFiles sif on sif.FK = ci.ContainerInPK
	inner join tbldivisions divs on si.divisionfk = divs.divisionpk
	where ci.stockinstatusfk = 3 or si.stockinstatusfk =3
	group by DivisionCode, ci.GoodsInNumber, ci.Free1, ci.InsertedDate, sif.InsertedDate, sif.FilePath, ci.DateIn, si.ArrivalDate, b.BuildingName, bu.BuildingUnit 

	--select * from #tmpFullResults

	drop table if exists #tmpBankHols
	select cast('20210404' as date) as bankHol into #tmpBankHols
	union
	select cast('20210405' as date)
	union
	select cast('20210406' as date)
	union
	select cast('20210502' as date)
	union
	select cast('20210503' as date)
	union
	select cast('20210504' as date)
	union
	select cast('20210606' as date)
	union
	select cast('20210607' as date)
	union
	select cast('20210608' as date)
	union
	select cast('20210801' as date)
	union
	select cast('20210802' as date)
	union
	select cast('20210803' as date)
	union
	select cast('20211024' as date)
	union
	select cast('20211025' as date)
	union
	select cast('20211026' as date)
	/*
	union
	select cast('20220502' as date)
	union
	select cast('20220605' as date)
	union
	select cast('20220801' as date)
	union
	select cast('20211225' as date)
	union
	select cast('20211226' as date)
	*/
	--select * from tblcontainerins where goodsinnumber = '2117866'

	--Fridays
	if(@ReportType = 1)
	begin
		select * from #tmpFullResults
		where ([Day Of Week File] = 'Friday' and DATEPART(HOUR,FileTime) >= 15)
			or ([Day Of Week File] = 'Saturday' and DATEPART(HOUR,FileTime) <= 15)
		order by filetime
	end
	
	--Saturdays
	if(@ReportType = 2)
	begin
		select * from #tmpFullResults
		where ([Day Of Week File] = 'Saturday' and DATEPART(HOUR,FileTime) >= 15)
			or ([Day Of Week File] = 'Sunday' and DATEPART(HOUR,FileTime) <= 15)
		order by filetime
	end

	--Sundays exclude bank hols
	if(@ReportType = 3)
	begin
		select * from #tmpFullResults
		where (([Day Of Week File] = 'Sunday' and DATEPART(HOUR,FileTime) >= 15)
			or ([Day Of Week File] = 'Monday' and DATEPART(HOUR,FileTime) <= 7))
			and cast(filetime as date) not in (select * from #tmpBankHols)
		order by filetime
	end

	--sunday bank hols
	if(@ReportType = 4)
	begin		
		select * from #tmpFullResults
		where (([Day Of Week File] = 'Sunday' and DATEPART(HOUR,FileTime) >= 15)
			or ([Day Of Week File] = 'Monday' and DATEPART(HOUR,FileTime) <= 15))
			and cast(filetime as date) in (select * from #tmpBankHols)
		order by filetime
	end

	--monday bank hols
	if(@ReportType = 5)
	begin		
		select * from #tmpFullResults
		where (([Day Of Week File] = 'Monday' and DATEPART(HOUR,FileTime) >= 15)
			or ([Day Of Week File] = 'Tuesday' and DATEPART(HOUR,FileTime) <= 7))
			and cast(filetime as date) in (select * from #tmpBankHols)
		order by filetime
	end
end

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spPrintStockoutWorkOrder]  
(  
 @stockorderfk int,
 @selectedworksorders nvarchar(max)
)  
AS  
BEGIN  
 /* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */  
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED  
  
    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT  
 ,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;  
 SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();  
  
 -- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters  
 --DECLARE @divisionFK2 int, @stockItemCodes2 nvarchar(max)  
 --SET @divisionFK2 = @divisionFK; SET @stockItemCodes2 = @stockItemCodes  
  
 SET @ParameterDetails = '@stockorderfk = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@stockorderfk AS NVARCHAR(100)),'') + ',@selectedworksorders = ' + ISNULL(@selectedworksorders,'')  
  
    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL   
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)  
  
     --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)  
    --BEGIN  
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC   
  
  SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)  
  
        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)  
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK  
  
        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()  
    --END  
  
  
 SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);  
 SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails  
 ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;  
 INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()  
  
 WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3  
 BEGIN   
  BEGIN TRY  
     
  
   -- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start  
  --declare @selectedworksorders nvarchar(max) ='4444,3333,44,787,983';
 --declare @selectedworksorders nvarchar(max) 
  
  --set @selectedworksorders= '6674020,6674039'
 
drop table if exists #tmpSelectedWorksOrders
select * 
into #tmpSelectedWorksOrders
from fnSplitStrings_XML (@selectedworksorders, ',')


select distinct worksorderpk, WorksOrderTypeFK 
from tblworksorders wo 
inner join tblworksorderpallets wop on worksorderfk = worksorderpk
inner join appWorksOrderTypes wot on wo.WorksOrderTypeFK = wot.WorksOrderTypePK
inner join #tmpSelectedWorksOrders swo on wop.WorksOrderPalletPK= swo.Item
where wo.WorksOrderOriginFK = 2 /*stock order*/ and wot.WorksOrderSubjectFK <> 1 /*not container*/ and FK =@stockorderfk /*stockorderfk*/
   -- and worksorderpalletpk in (/*list of selected pks from grid*/)
union    
select distinct worksorderpk, WorksOrderTypeFK
from tblworksorders wo
inner join appWorksOrderTypes wot on wo.WorksOrderTypeFK = wot.WorksOrderTypePK
inner join #tmpSelectedWorksOrders swo on worksorderpk= swo.Item
where wo.WorksOrderOriginFK = 2 /*stock order*/ and wot.WorksOrderSubjectFK = 1  and /* container*/FK =@stockorderfk /*stockorderfk*/
    --and worksorderpk in (/*list of selected pks from grid*/)
 -- select top 10 * from tblWorksOrders
   -- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end  
  
     
     
   BREAK  
  END TRY  
  BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */  
   DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;  
   SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;  
   SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;  
  
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY   
   BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;  
         
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;  
  
            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID  
              
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;  
              
   IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)  
   BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END  
   ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */  
  END CATCH  
  SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1  
 END  
END
GO

		+ ',@userInFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_userInFK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@Debug = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_Debug AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') 
			+ ',@SuppressResultset = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_SuppressResultset AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'')

         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC

					8 = Issue

					11 = Stock code Restriction

			Declare @stackPosition int

					INSERT INTO #tblPalletsRequestingTransfer (PalletPK, Width, Barcode, IsStackable)

					--(pa.PalletEnd - pa.PalletStart) width,

					CASE WHEN pa.CustomerBarcode = '' THEN pa.Barcode ELSE pa.CustomerBarcode END as Barcode,

					FROM @var_Pallets.nodes('//Pallet') as ParamValues(Pallets)
					INNER JOIN tblPallets pa  ON pa.PalletPK = ParamValues.Pallets.value('PalletPK[1]','INT')  
					INNER JOIN tblPalletContent pa_co ON pa.PalletPK = pa_co.PalletFK

					INNER JOIN (SELECT palletTypePK , width as PalletWidth, WidthMargin from tblpalletTypes ) pa_ty

				  SELECT @UnstackedPalletWidth = coalesce(SUM(Width), 0) FROM #tblPalletsRequestingTransfer WHERE IsStackable = 0

				)

			  /* Preliminary check to see if there is space */
			  IF (@TotalPalletWidth < @BayLevelWidth)

					DECLARE @PalletCounter INT

						  -- Clear out Failure Messages

						  TRUNCATE TABLE #tblMovementFailureReasons

						  SET         @FailureMaxCounter      = 4
						  SET         @FailureCounter         = 1

						  SET @PalletCounter = @PalletCounter + 1
						 -- SET @tempLocationFK = @var_LocationFK
						  SELECT @PalletPKTemp=PalletPK, @PalletWidth=Width, @isStackable=IsStackable, @Barcode = barcode 
						  FROM #tblPalletsRequestingTransfer WHERE RowID = @PalletCounter
						  
						  TRUNCATE TABLE #tblBayPosition

						  insert into #tblBayPosition exec spRackingDriveThroughGetNextAvailableBayPosition @BuildingUnitBayFKParam=@var_LocationFK,
						  @PalletFKParam=@PalletPKTemp, @isStackableParam=@isStackable

						  select @bayPosition=BayPosition, @stackPosition=StackPosition, @var_LocationFK=BuildingUnitBayFK from #tblBayPosition

						  /* Check that the returned bay position is actually a valid bay position and not a -1 */
						  IF (@bayPosition = -1) 
						  BEGIN
		print '1a'

								/* Verify that the column is full before returning results about something else */
								--DECLARE @LocationTemp NVARCHAR(25)
								--select @LocationTemp = [Location] FROM dbo.viewRackingLocations vrl WHERE vrl.BuildingUnitBayPK = @tempLocationFK
								--select @LocationTemp = 
								--	case when buRows.Translate = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ then 
								--		buRows.TranslatedRow 
								--	else 
								--		buRows.Row 
								--	end

								--	case when buRows.Translate = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ then 
								--		case when buRows.ReverseTranslate = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ then 
								--			buRows.TranslateColumn - buCols.BuildingUnitColumn

								--		end

								SET @FailureError = 1

						  BEGIN
		print '2a start'
		print @PalletPKTemp
		print '1'
		print @var_LocationFK
		print @bayPosition
		print @stackPosition
		print '2a end'

								INSERT INTO #tblMovementFailureReasons 
								exec spPalletMovementFailureReasons @PalletPK=@PalletPKTemp,@toLocationTypeFK=1,
									@locationFK=@var_LocationFK,@bayPosition=@bayPosition, @stackPosition=@stackPosition

								/* Check pallet for permission issues */
								SET @FailureError = 0
								SET @FailureCounter = 0;
								WHILE (@FailureCounter<@FailureMaxCounter) 
								BEGIN
									  SELECT top 1 @RowCounter = RowId,@RecordFailureType=TestType, @RecordFailurePassed = Passed,

									  IF (@RecordFailurePassed = 0)

									  SET @FailureErrorMessageComposite = @FailureErrorMessageComposite + '<p>' + @RecordFailureType + ' - '+ @RecordFailureReason + '</p>'
									  END

									  SET @FailureCounter = @FailureCounter + 1
								END
						  END
               
						  IF (@FailureError = 1 ) 
						  BEGIN 
		print @FailureErrorMessageComposite
								Insert into #tblResults (PalletPK, Barcode, ErrorNumber, ErrorMessage)  
								values (@PalletPKTemp,@Barcode, 11, @FailureErrorMessageComposite)
		print '3a'
						  END

								print '4a'

									  DECLARE @paramBarcode NVARCHAR(400)

									  --SELECT @paramBarcode, @var_LocationFK,@paramBayPosition,@paramPalletStart,@paramPalletEnd

										print @paramBarcode

											@DestinationEnd=@paramPalletEnd,
											@DestinationStackPosition=@stackPosition,
											@NoSelectPurelyReturns=1,
											@IsThisHandHeld=0
                              
											DECLARE @WOMPK INT
											DECLARE @DBC nvarchar(100)
											select @DBC=Barcode from tblBuildingUnitBays where BuildingUnitBayPK=@paramToLocationFK
											select @WOMPK=WorksOrderMovementPK from tblWorksOrderMovements where PalletFK=@PalletPKTemp 
											and DestinationFK=@paramToLocationFK order by InsertedDate DESC
											select @WOMPK
											select @paramToLocationFK
											select @PalletPKTemp
											select @DBC
											EXEC spMobileWorksOrderMovementComplete @worksOrderMovementFK=@WOMPK,@locationBarcode=@DBC,@userFK=@var_userInFK
                                      
									  BEGIN TRY IF XACT_STATE() = 1 AND @@TRANCOUNT = 1 AND @OpeningTranCount < 1 COMMIT TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH
									                        
									  Insert into #tblResults (PalletPK,Barcode,  ErrorNumber, ErrorMessage) 
									  values (@PalletPKTemp,@Barcode,@WorksOrderResult,N'Everything is fine')

									  DECLARE @errorMSG nvarchar(400)
											Set @errorMSG = CASE @WorksOrderResult 
												  WHEN 1 THEN 'SUCCESS'
												  WHEN 2 THEN 'Pallet aready in this location'
												  WHEN 3 THEN 'Pallet aready in racking'
												  WHEN 4 THEN 'No stock code assigned to this pallet'
												  WHEN 5 THEN 'No pallet content assigned to the pallet'
												  WHEN 6 THEN 'Source location not setup'
												  WHEN 7 THEN 'No works Order Movement'
												  WHEN 8 THEN 'Pallet aready in this '
											END

									  Update #tblResults set ErrorMessage=@errorMSG where PalletPK=@PalletPKTemp

									  IF (@WorksOrderResult>1) 
									  BEGIN
											SET @ErrorOccured = @WorksOrderResult
									  END
								END 
								ELSE 
								BEGIN							
									  INSERT INTO #tblResults (PalletPK, Barcode, ErrorNumber, ErrorMessage) 
									  values (@PalletPKTemp,@Barcode,9,'Unable To Move Pallet')
									  SET @ErrorOccured = 10
								END
						  END
					END

					/*    Check here for errors. If @ErrorOccured = 1 then the transaction must be rolled back.
						  Otherwise it will be committed */
			--        IF (@ErrorOccured = 0) BEGIN
						---- success
			--              COMMIT TRANSACTION MovePalletsToDriveThrough                  
			--        END ELSE BEGIN
						---- failure
			--              ROLLBACK TRANSACTION MovePalletsToDriveThrough                  
			--        END

			  END 
			  ELSE 
			  BEGIN
				
		print '5a'
						INSERT INTO #tblMovementFailureReasons 
						exec spPalletMovementFailureReasons @PalletPK=@PalletPKTemp,@toLocationTypeFK=1,
							@locationFK=@var_LocationFK,@bayPosition=@bayPosition, @stackPosition=@stackPosition

						/* Check pallet for permission issues */
						SET @FailureError = 0
						SET @FailureCounter = 0;
						WHILE (@FailureCounter<@FailureMaxCounter) 
						BEGIN
                              
								SELECT  @RowCounter = RowId,@RecordFailureType=TestType, @RecordFailurePassed = Passed, @RecordFailureReason = Reason 
								from #tblMovementFailureReasons WHERE Passed = 0

								IF (@RecordFailurePassed = 0) 
								BEGIN
									SET @FailureError = 1
                             
									SET @FailureErrorMessageComposite = @FailureErrorMessageComposite + '<p>' + @RecordFailureType + ' - '+ @RecordFailureReason + '</p>'
								END

								delete from #tblMovementFailureReasons where RowID = @RowCounter
                              
								SET @FailureCounter = @FailureCounter + 1
						END
			  END

			  IF (@var_SuppressResultset=0) 
			  BEGIN             
					SELECT * FROM #tblResults
			  END

			  --SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED
			  RETURN @ErrorOccured

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end
			
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END

-- =============================================  
-- Author:      <Author, , Name>  
-- Create Date: <Create Date, , >  
-- Description: reports on stock older than 90 days in store-all >  
-- =============================================  
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spReportAgedStock]  
(  
    -- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here  
@date DateTime,--  
@DivisionFK int  
)  
AS  
BEGIN  
 /* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data; Ensure this proc has a low impact when executed */  
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED; SET DEADLOCK_PRIORITY LOW  
  
    -- Insert statements for procedure here  
 IF @DivisionFK= 439  
	begin
		Select DISTINCT  
			vpc.stockitemcode as [Stock Item Code],  
			--pal.palletpk,  
			--pal.barcode,  
			Description as [Description],  
			vpc.batch as [Batch],   
			EventDate as [Date Pallet Arrived],  
			--vpc.actualunits as [Actual Units],    
			vpc.availableunits as [Available Units],  
			--pal.palletstatusfk as[Status],  
			DATEDIFF(DAY, EventDate, dbo.GetBSTDate()) as[Days In Store-All],  
			siuc.UnitCost   AS [$ Unit Value $],    
			--,siuc.EndDate  
			siuc.UnitCost *vpc.actualunits AS [$ Value $]  
    
		from viewPalletContent vpc  
		inner join tblPalletAudit				pa	on pa.PAlletFK = vpc.PalletFK  AND pa.EventTypeFK = 1  
		inner join tblpalletcontent				pc	on pc.PalletFK = vpc.PalletFK  
		inner join tblpallets					pal on pal.PalletPK = pc.PalletFK  
		inner join tblstockitems				si	on si.stockitempk = vpc.stockitemfk  
		left outer join viewRackingLocations	vr	on vr.BuildingUnitBayPK = pal.LocationFK  
		left outer join tblLoadingBays			lb	on lb.LoadingBayPK = pal.LocationFK  
		left outer join tblSetDownAreas			sa	on sa.SetDownAreaPK = pal.LocationFK  
		inner join tblBuildingUnits				tbu on tbu.BuildingUnitPK = pa.BuildingUnitFK  
		inner join tblbuildings					tb	on tb.BuildingpK = tbu.BuildingfK  
		LEFT OUTER join tblstockitemunitcosts	siuc ON siuc.StockItemFK = pa.StockItemFK  
		Where vpc.DivisionFK = @DivisionFK  
			and EventDate <= @date   
			and pal.isarchived=0  
			and pal.palletstatusfk <> 10 /*not on route*/  
			AND pc.AvailableUnits>0 /*not empty pallet*/  
			AND siuc.EndDate ='1900-01-01 00:00:00.000'  
			AND DATEDIFF(DAY, EventDate, dbo.GetBSTDate())<=@date  
		order by eventdate DESC  
	end
	ELSE  
	begin
		drop table if exists #tmpDivisionStockCodes
		select stockitempk, stockitemcode, Description into #tmpDivisionStockCodes from tblstockitems where divisionfk = @DivisionFK

		drop table if exists #tmpDivisionCurrentpalContents
		select PalletFK, pc.ActualUnits, pc.AvailableUnits, StockItemCode, Description, pc.Batch
		into #tmpDivisionCurrentpalContents 
		from  tblPalletContent pc 
		inner join #tmpDivisionStockCodes s on pc.StockItemFK = s.StockItemPK
		where pc.actualunits > 0 --and p.PalletStatusFK <> 10

		drop table if exists #tmpDivisionCurrentpals
		select PalletPK, PalletStatusFk, p.Barcode, p.CustomerBarcode, p.LocationFK, p.LocationTypeFK, pc.ActualUnits, pc.AvailableUnits, StockItemCode, Description, pc.Batch
		into #tmpDivisionCurrentpals 
		from tblPallets p 
		inner join #tmpDivisionCurrentpalContents pc on pc.PalletFK = p.PalletPK
		where p.IsArchived = 0 --and p.PalletStatusFK <> 10
    
		Select   
			pal.stockitemcode as [Stock Item Code],  
			pal.Description as [Description],  
			pal.batch as [Batch],   
			pa.EventDate as [Date Pallet Arrived],  
			sum(pal.actualunits) as [Actual Units],    
			sum(pal.availableunits) as [Available Units],  
			pal.palletstatusfk as[Status],  
			ps.PalletStatus,
			case when pal.customerbarcode = '' then pal.Barcode else pal.customerbarcode  end as [SSCC],  
			DATEDIFF(DAY, EventDate, dbo.GetBSTDate()) as[Days In Store-All]   
		from #tmpDivisionCurrentpals			pal 
		inner join tblPalletAudit				pa on pa.PAlletFK = pal.PalletPK AND pa.EventTypeFK = 1  
		left outer join viewRackingLocations	vr on vr.BuildingUnitBayPK = pal.LocationFK  
		left outer join tblLoadingBays			lb on lb.LoadingBayPK = pal.LocationFK  and pal.LocationTypeFK = 2
		left outer join tblSetDownAreas			sa on sa.SetDownAreaPK = pal.LocationFK  and pal.LocationTypeFK = 3
		inner join appPalletStatus				ps on pal.PalletStatusFK = ps.PalletStatusPK
		Where EventDate <= @date   
			and ((@DivisionFK = 622 and pal.palletstatusfk <> 10) or (@DivisionFK = 621 and pal.palletstatusfk <> 10) or (@DivisionFK=@DivisionFK))  
		group by pal.stockitemcode, pal.Description, pal.batch, pa.EventDate, pal.palletstatusfk, ps.PalletStatus, pal.Barcode, pal.customerbarcode, DATEDIFF(DAY, EventDate, dbo.GetBSTDate())
		order by eventdate DESC  
	end
end

-- =============================================  
-- Author:      <Author, , Name>  
-- Create Date: <Create Date, , >  
-- Description: reports on stock older than 90 days in store-all >  
-- =============================================  
Create PROCEDURE [dbo].[spReportBestBeforeDeadline]  
(  
    -- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here  
 @DaysToExpired int,   
@DivisionFK int  
)  
AS  
BEGIN  
 /* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data; Ensure this proc has a low impact when executed */  
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED; SET DEADLOCK_PRIORITY LOW  
  
    -- Insert statements for procedure here  
     Drop table if exists #tmpstockitems 

	select * 
	into #tmpstockitems
	from tblStockItems where DivisionFK=@DivisionFK

	
	Drop table if exists #tmppalletcontent 
	Select pc.* 
	into #tmppalletcontent 
	from tblpalletcontent pc
	inner join #tmpstockitems st on st.stockitempk = pc.stockitemfk
	where pc.ActualUnits > 0


  Select   
  si.stockitemcode as [Stock Item Code],  
  pc.batch as [Batch],   
  Description as [Description],  
  pal.customerbarcode as [SSCC],  
  pc.DateOfManufacture AS [Date Of Manufacture],  
  pc.actualunits as [Actual Units],    
  pc.availableunits as [Available Units],  
  pal.palletstatusfk as [Status],  
  pc.bestbefore as[Expiry Date],  
  EventDate as [Date Pallet Arrived],   
  DATEDIFF(day,dbo.GetBSTDate(),pc.bestbefore ) as[Days to Expired]  
 FROM  
  tblpallets pal   
  inner join tblPalletAudit pa on pa.PalletFK = pal.PalletPK AND pa.EventTypeFK = 1  
 inner join #tmppalletcontent pc on pc.PalletFK = pal.PalletPK  
  inner join #tmpstockitems si on si.stockitempk = pc.stockitemfk  
 WHERE   
  pal.IsArchived = 0  
  --AND pal.PalletStatusFK <> 10   
  --AND si.DivisionFK = @DivisionFK  
 -- AND pc.ActualUnits > 0  
  and  DATEDIFF(day, dbo.GetBSTDate(),pc.bestbefore ) <=@DaysToExpired  
 ORDER BY   
  pa.EventDate DESC  
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spReportDanoneAgedStock]
(
    -- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here
@date DateTime,--
@DivisionFK int
)
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data; Ensure this proc has a low impact when executed */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED; SET DEADLOCK_PRIORITY LOW

    -- Insert statements for procedure here
   Select 
    vpc.stockitemcode as [Stock Item Code],
    Description as [Description],
	vpc.batch as [Batch], 
	EventDate as [Date Pallet Arrived],
    vpc.actualunits as [Actual Units],	 
    vpc.availableunits as [Available Units],
	pal.palletstatusfk as[Status],
	 pal.customerbarcode as [SSCC],
	 DATEDIFF(DAY, EventDate, dbo.GetBSTDate()) as[Days In Store-All]

from viewPalletContent vpc
    inner join tblPalletAudit pa on
    pa.PAlletFK = vpc.PalletFK
    AND pa.EventTypeFK = 1
    inner join tblpalletcontent pc on
    pc.PalletFK = vpc.PalletFK
    inner join tblpallets pal on
    pal.PalletPK = pc.PalletFK
    inner join tblstockitems si on
    si.stockitempk = vpc.stockitemfk
    left outer join viewRackingLocations vr on
    vr.BuildingUnitBayPK = pal.LocationFK
    left outer join tblLoadingBays lb on
    lb.LoadingBayPK = pal.LocationFK
    left outer join tblSetDownAreas sa on
    sa.SetDownAreaPK = pal.LocationFK
    inner join tblBuildingUnits tbu on
    tbu.BuildingUnitPK = pa.BuildingUnitFK
    inner join tblbuildings tb on
    tb.BuildingpK = tbu.BuildingfK

Where vpc.DivisionFK = @DivisionFK
  and EventDate <= @date 
  and pal.isarchived=0
  order by eventdate DESC

BEGIN  
 /* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data; Ensure this proc has a low impact when executed */  
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED; SET DEADLOCK_PRIORITY LOW  
  
    -- Insert statements for procedure here  
     Drop table if exists #tmpstockitems 

	select * 
	into #tmpstockitems
	from tblStockItems where DivisionFK=@DivisionFK

	
	Drop table if exists #tmppalletcontent 
	Select pc.* 
	into #tmppalletcontent 
	from tblpalletcontent pc
	inner join #tmpstockitems st on st.stockitempk = pc.stockitemfk
	where pc.ActualUnits > 0


  Select   
  si.stockitemcode as [Stock Item Code],  
  pc.batch as [Batch],   
  Description as [Description],  
  pal.customerbarcode as [SSCC],  
  pc.DateOfManufacture AS [Date Of Manufacture],  
  pc.actualunits as [Actual Units],    
  pc.availableunits as [Available Units],  
  pal.palletstatusfk as [Status],  
  pc.ExpiryDate as[Expiry Date],  
  EventDate as [Date Pallet Arrived],   
  DATEDIFF(day,dbo.GetBSTDate(),pc.expiryDate ) as[Days to Expired]  
  -- YEAR(pc.expiryDate) 
 FROM  
  tblpallets pal   
  inner join tblPalletAudit pa on pa.PalletFK = pal.PalletPK AND pa.EventTypeFK = 1  
 inner join #tmppalletcontent pc on pc.PalletFK = pal.PalletPK  
  inner join #tmpstockitems si on si.stockitempk = pc.stockitemfk  
 WHERE   
  pal.IsArchived = 0  
  --AND pal.PalletStatusFK <> 10   
  --AND si.DivisionFK = @DivisionFK  
 -- AND pc.ActualUnits > 0  
  --and  DATEDIFF(day, dbo.GetBSTDate(),pc.expiryDate ) <=@DaysToExpired 
 and pc.expiryDate BETWEEN GETDATE() AND DATEADD(DAY,30,GETDATE())
  and YEAR(pc.expiryDate) !=1900
 ORDER BY   
  pa.EventDate DESC  
END

 /* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data; Ensure this proc has a low impact when executed */

-- =============================================
-- Author:      <Author, , Name>
-- Create Date: <Create Date, , >
-- Description: reports on stock older than 90 days in store-all >
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spReportGSKAgedStock]
(
    -- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here
@date DateTime,--
@DivisionFK int
)
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data; Ensure this proc has a low impact when executed */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED; SET DEADLOCK_PRIORITY LOW

    -- Insert statements for procedure here
   Select 
    vpc.stockitemcode as [Stock Item Code],
    Description as [Description],
	vpc.batch as [Batch], 
	EventDate as [Date Pallet Arrived],
    vpc.actualunits as [Actual Units],	 
    vpc.availableunits as [Available Units],
	pal.palletstatusfk as[Status],
	 pal.customerbarcode as [SSCC],
	 DATEDIFF(DAY, EventDate, dbo.GetBSTDate()) as[Days In Store-All]

from viewPalletContent vpc
    inner join tblPalletAudit pa on
    pa.PAlletFK = vpc.PalletFK
    AND pa.EventTypeFK = 1
    inner join tblpalletcontent pc on
    pc.PalletFK = vpc.PalletFK
    inner join tblpallets pal on
    pal.PalletPK = pc.PalletFK
    inner join tblstockitems si on
    si.stockitempk = vpc.stockitemfk
    left outer join viewRackingLocations vr on
    vr.BuildingUnitBayPK = pal.LocationFK
    left outer join tblLoadingBays lb on
    lb.LoadingBayPK = pal.LocationFK
    left outer join tblSetDownAreas sa on
    sa.SetDownAreaPK = pal.LocationFK
    inner join tblBuildingUnits tbu on
    tbu.BuildingUnitPK = pa.BuildingUnitFK
    inner join tblbuildings tb on
    tb.BuildingpK = tbu.BuildingfK

Where vpc.DivisionFK = @DivisionFK
  and EventDate <= @date 
  and pal.isarchived=0
  and pal.palletstatusfk<>10
  order by eventdate DESC

END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spReports_StockOrderSealReport]          
(             
 @CustomerFK int = -1,        
    @SealNumber nvarchar(200) = '',           
 @goodsOrderNumber nvarchar(200) = '',      
 @StartDate DateTime ='',      
 @endDate DateTime ='',      
    @Includeused bit = 0,    
 @IncludeDate bit = 0    
)           
AS          
BEGIN          
 /* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data; Ensure this proc has a low impact when executed */          
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED; SET DEADLOCK_PRIORITY LOW          
          
    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT          
 ,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;          
 SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();          
           
   PRINT 'starting'          
 -- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters          
 DECLARE   @var_CustomerFK int, @var_SealNumber nvarchar(200), @var_goodsOrderNumber nvarchar(200),   @var_StartDate DateTime, @var_endDate DateTime  , @var_Includeused bit, @Var_IncludeDate bit    
          
   SET @var_CustomerFK = @CustomerFK;        
   SET @var_SealNumber = @SealNumber;      
 SET @var_goodsOrderNumber = @goodsOrderNumber;      
 SET @var_StartDate = @StartDate;      
 SET @var_endDate =@endDate;      
 SET @var_Includeused = @Includeused    
 SET @Var_IncludeDate = @IncludeDate    
      
 SET @ParameterDetails = ',@CustomerFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_CustomerFK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'')       
    + ',@SealNumber = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_SealNumber AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'')      
 + ',@goodsOrderNumber = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_goodsOrderNumber AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'')      
 + ',@StartDate = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_StartDate AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'')      
 + ',@endDate = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_endDate AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'')      
 + ',@Includeused = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_Includeused AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'')      
 + ',@Var_IncludeDate = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@Var_IncludeDate AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'')      
           
    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL           
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)          
          
    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)          
    --BEGIN          
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC           
          
  SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)          
          
        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)          
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK          
          
        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()          
    --END          
          
          
 SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);          
 SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails          
 ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;          
 INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()          
          
WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3          
BEGIN           
 BEGIN TRY          
             
          
 -- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start          
      --Seal No., Container No., Destination, Stock Out No., signature & date when applied    
    
 IF(@var_SealNumber <> '')       
 BEGIN--SPECIFIC SEAL or partial match - ignore other filters    
  select seal.SealNumber, ss.SealStatus, cout.GoodsOrdernumber, cout.containernumber, C.CustomerName, seal.Comment as AdditionalComments,    
   case when personpk is not null then p.FirstName + ' ' + p.LastName else '' end as AppliedBy,     
   case when personpk is not null then seal.updateddate else '' end as AppliedDate,    
   cout.Address1 + ' ' + cout.Address2 as destination     
  from tblContainerOutSeals seal    
  inner join appSealStatus ss on seal.SealStatusFK = ss.SealStatusPK    
  left join tblCustomers c on seal.CustomerFK = c.CustomerPK    
  left join tblusers u on seal.AppliedBy = u.UserPK    
  left join tblpeople p on u.PersonFK = p.PersonPK    
  left join tblContainerOuts cout on seal.SealNumber = cout.SealNumber      
  where ( seal.SealNumber like '%' + @var_SealNumber + '%') or seal.SealNumber = @var_SealNumber    
 END    
 ELSE IF(@goodsOrderNumber <> '')          
 BEGIN      --SPECIFIC GOODS OUT - ignore other filters    
  select seal.SealNumber, ss.SealStatus, cout.GoodsOrdernumber, cout.containernumber, C.CustomerName, seal.Comment as AdditionalComments,    
   case when personpk is not null then p.FirstName + ' ' + p.LastName else '' end as AppliedBy,     
   case when personpk is not null then seal.updateddate else '' end as AppliedDate,    
   cout.Address1 + ' ' + cout.Address2 as destination    
  from tblContainerOutSeals seal    
  inner join appSealStatus ss on seal.SealStatusFK = ss.SealStatusPK    
  left join tblCustomers c on seal.CustomerFK = c.CustomerPK    
  left join tblusers u on seal.AppliedBy = u.UserPK    
  left join tblpeople p on u.PersonFK = p.PersonPK    
  left join tblContainerOuts cout on seal.SealNumber = cout.SealNumber      
  where GoodsOrderNumber = @goodsOrderNumber    
 END  
 Else if (@var_IncludeDate =1)  
 begin  
 print 'Pritesh1'  
 select seal.SealNumber, ss.SealStatus, cout.GoodsOrdernumber, cout.containernumber, C.CustomerName, seal.Comment as AdditionalComments,    
   case when personpk is not null then p.FirstName + ' ' + p.LastName else '' end as AppliedBy,     
   case when personpk is not null then seal.updateddate else '' end as AppliedDate,    
   cout.Address1 + ' ' + cout.Address2 as destination    
  from tblContainerOuts cout  
  inner join tblContainerOutSeals seal on seal.SealNumber = cout.SealNumber 
  inner join appSealStatus ss on seal.SealStatusFK = ss.SealStatusPK    
  left join tblCustomers c on seal.CustomerFK = c.CustomerPK    
  left join tblusers u on seal.AppliedBy = u.UserPK    
  left join tblpeople p on u.PersonFK = p.PersonPK   
  where  
  (seal.updateddate >= @var_StartDate and seal.updateddate <= @var_endDate)      
 -- (seal.InsertedDate >= @var_StartDate or seal.InsertedDate <= @var_endDate)  
  --(p.inserteddate < @var_StartDate or p.inserteddate > @var_endDate)      
   and  
   (@var_CustomerFK = -1 or @var_CustomerFK = seal.CustomerFK)    
   and ((@var_Includeused = 1 and seal.SealStatusFK = 2) or @var_Includeused = 0)    
 end  
 ELSE    
 BEGIN-- CUSTOMER FILTER   
  print 'Pritesh2'  
     select seal.SealNumber, ss.SealStatus, cout.GoodsOrdernumber, cout.containernumber, C.CustomerName, seal.Comment as AdditionalComments,    
   case when personpk is not null then p.FirstName + ' ' + p.LastName else '' end as AppliedBy,     
   case when personpk is not null then seal.updateddate else '' end as AppliedDate,    
   cout.Address1 + ' ' + cout.Address2 as destination    
  from tblContainerOutSeals seal    
  inner join appSealStatus ss on seal.SealStatusFK = ss.SealStatusPK    
  left join tblCustomers c on seal.CustomerFK = c.CustomerPK    
  left join tblusers u on seal.AppliedBy = u.UserPK    
  left join tblpeople p on u.PersonFK = p.PersonPK    
  left join tblContainerOuts cout on seal.SealNumber = cout.SealNumber   
  where  
	(@var_CustomerFK = -1 or @var_CustomerFK = seal.CustomerFK)    
   and ((@var_Includeused = 1 and seal.SealStatusFK = 2) or @var_Includeused = 0)    
 END    
      
      
   -- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end          
          
             
             
   BREAK          
  END TRY          
  BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */          
   DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;          
   SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;          
   SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;          
          
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY           
   BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;          
                 
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;          
          
            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID          
                      
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;          
                      
   IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)          
   BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END          
   ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */          
  END CATCH          
  SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1          
 END          
END
