CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spReportsActiveClientUserOrderActivity]  
(  
 @NumberOfDays int = 90,  
 @ActiveUsersOnly bit = 1  
)  
AS  
BEGIN  
 /* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data; Ensure this proc has a low impact when executed */  
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED; SET DEADLOCK_PRIORITY LOW  
  
    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT  
 ,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;  
 SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();  
   
  
 declare @var_NumberOfDays int, @var_ActiveUsersOnly bit  
 set @var_NumberOfDays = @NumberOfDays; set @var_ActiveUsersOnly = @var_NumberOfDays  
  
 SET @ParameterDetails = '@NumberOfDays = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_NumberOfDays AS NVARCHAR(100)),'')  
  
    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL   
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)  
  
    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)  
    --BEGIN  
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC   
  
  SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)  
  
        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)  
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK  
  
        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()  
    --END  
  
  
 SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);  
 SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails  
 ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;  
 INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()  
  
 WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3  
 BEGIN   
  BEGIN TRY  
     
  
   -- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start  
  
   --list of client users (user type = 4) that are approved for use   
   --users locked out (approved=false) if they have not logged in over the past 90 days, so they will be excluded from list if never logged in  
   --stored in temp table to use users list for more queries further down  
   drop table if exists #tmpClientUsers  
   select UserPK, FirstName, LastName, CustomerName, CustomerPK, LockoutEnabled, CreateDate, LastLoginDate  
   into #tmpClientUsers  
   from tblusers tu  
   inner join AspNetUsers am on tu.AspNetUserID = am.Id
   --inner join aspnet_Membership am on tu.AspNetUserID = am.UserId  
   inner join tblpeople p on tu.PersonFK = p.PersonPK  
   left join tblcustomers c on customerpk= tu.DistributionCustomerFK  
   where tu.UserTypeFK = 4 and   
    ((@var_ActiveUsersOnly = 1 and (tu.isarchived = 0 and EmailConfirmed = 1))  
    or  
    @var_ActiveUsersOnly = 0)  
    
   --recent orders placed by client users (last 60 days)  
   --in temp table, to use data again in next query below  
   drop table if exists #tmpClientPlacedOrders  
   select FirstName + ' ' + LastName [Name], CustomerName, CustomerPK, GoodsOrderNumber, ContainerOutStatus, co.InsertedDate, CollectionDate, datediff(day, co.InsertedDate, CollectionDate) [Days To Completion]  
   into #tmpClientPlacedOrders  
   from tblcontainerouts co  
   inner join #tmpClientUsers on InsertedBy = UserPK  
   left outer join appContainerOutStatus on ContainerOutStatusFK = ContainerOutStatusPK  
   where containeroutstatusfk > 0 and containeroutstatusfk <> 6 and (datediff(day, co.InsertedDate, getdate()) < @var_NumberOfDays)  
   order by containeroutpk desc  
     
   --orders placed by client  
   select *, 0 as Stockcontroller from #tmpClientPlacedOrders   
   union  
   --orders placed by store-all member of staff for customers who also placed their own  
   select distinct p.FirstName + ' ' + p.LastName [Name], CustomerName, customerpk, co.GoodsOrderNumber, stat.ContainerOutStatus, co.InsertedDate, co.CollectionDate,   
    datediff(day, co.InsertedDate, co.CollectionDate) [Days To Completion], 1 as Stockcontroller  
   from tblcontaineroutlines col  
   inner join tblcontainerouts co on containeroutpk = containeroutfk  
   inner join tbldivisions on divisionpk = divisionfk  
   inner join #tmpClientPlacedOrders on CustomerPK = customerfk  
   left outer join appContainerOutStatus stat on co.ContainerOutStatusFK = ContainerOutStatusPK  
   inner join tblusers tu on col.InsertedBy = tu.UserPK  
   inner join tblpeople p on p.PersonPK = tu.PersonFK  
   where (datediff(day, col.InsertedDate, getdate()) < @var_NumberOfDays)  and UserTypeFK <> 4  
    and containeroutstatusfk > 0 and containeroutstatusfk <> 6  
   order by [name]  
    
   -- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end  
  
     
     
   BREAK  
  END TRY  
  BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */  
   DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;  
   SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;  
   SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;  
  
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY   
   BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;  
         
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;  
  
            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID  
              
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;  
              
   IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)  
   BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END  
   ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */  
  END CATCH  
  SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1  
 END  
END

    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)  
    --BEGIN  
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC   
  
  SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)  
  
        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)  
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK  
  
        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()  
    --END  
  
  
 SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);  
 SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails  
 ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;  
 INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()  
  
 WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3  
 BEGIN   
  BEGIN TRY  
     
  
   -- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start  
    
   --list of client users (user type = 4) that are approved for use   
   --users locked out (approved=false) if they have not logged in over the past 90 days, so they will be excluded from list if never logged in  
   --stored in temp table to use users list for more queries further down  
   drop table if exists #tmpClientUsers  
   select UserPK, FirstName, LastName, CustomerName, CustomerPK, LockoutEnabled, CreateDate, LastLoginDate  
   into #tmpClientUsers  
   from tblusers tu  
   inner join aspnetusers am on tu.AspNetUserID = am.Id
   --inner join aspnet_Membership am on tu.AspNetUserID = am.UserId  
   inner join tblpeople p on tu.PersonFK = p.PersonPK  
   left join tblcustomers c on customerpk= tu.DistributionCustomerFK  
   where tu.UserTypeFK = 4 and tu.isarchived = 0 and EmailConfirmed = 1  
  
   --all client users  
   select cu.*, case when clientaccess.ClientButtonPK is not null then 1 else 0 end as CanPlaceOrders  
   from #tmpClientUsers cu  
   left join (  
    select UserPK, ClientButtonPK  
    from tblUserClientButtons cub  
    inner join #tmpClientUsers cu on cu.userpk = cub.userfk  
    inner join tblClientButtons cb on cub.ClientButtonFK = cb.ClientButtonPK  
    where ClientButtonPK = 2  
   ) clientaccess on cu.UserPK = clientaccess.UserPK  
   order by LastLoginDate desc  
    
   -- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end  
  
     
     
   BREAK  
  END TRY  
  BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */  
   DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;  
   SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;  
   SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;  
  
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY   
   BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;  
         
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;  
  
            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID  
              
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;  
              
   IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)  
   BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END  
   ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */  
  END CATCH  
  SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1  
 END  
END
GO

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spReportsBuildingUnitHistory]
(		
    @BuildingUnitPK INT,
	@RowPK INT = -1,
	@ColumnPK INT = -1,
	@BayPK INT = -1, 
	@DivisionBuildingUnitPK INT = -1,
	@StockItemBuildingUnitPK INT = -1 
)	
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data; Ensure this proc has a low impact when executed */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED; SET DEADLOCK_PRIORITY LOW

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400), @ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX), @ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX) , @ID INT,
			@DeadlockErrorRetries INT, @PEDID INT, @OpeningTranCount INT, @OpeningXactState INT, @EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;
	
	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); 
	SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; 
	SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; 
	SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	DECLARE @var_BuildingUnitPK INT, @var_RowPK INT, @var_ColumnPK INT, @var_BayPK INT, @var_ReportType INT, @var_DivisionBuildingUnitPK INT, @var_StockItemBuildingUnitPK INT;
	SET @var_BuildingUnitPK = @BuildingUnitPK;
	SET @var_RowPK = @RowPK;
	SET @var_ColumnPK = @ColumnPK;
	SET @var_BayPK = @BayPK;
	SET @var_DivisionBuildingUnitPK = @DivisionBuildingUnitPK;
	SET @var_StockItemBuildingUnitPK  = @StockItemBuildingUnitPK;

    --SET @ParameterDetails = '@BuildingUnitPK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_BuildingUnitPK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'');
	SET @ParameterDetails = '@BuildingUnitPK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_BuildingUnitPK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + 
							', @RowPK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_RowPK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + 
							', @ColumnPK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_ColumnPK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'')  +
							', @BayPK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_BayPK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') +
							', @DivisionBuildingUnitPK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_DivisionBuildingUnitPK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') +
							', @StockItemBuildingUnitPK= ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_StockItemBuildingUnitPK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'')

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1), ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400), ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX), EventLogFK INT, HasException BIT)

    IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

		SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK,-1)

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    END

	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY			
		
			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start
			DECLARE @FullBuildingName AS VARCHAR(200)
			DECLARE @BuildingName AS VARCHAR(100)
			DECLARE @BuildingUnit AS VARCHAR(100)

			SET @BuildingUnit = (Select BuildingUnit from tblBuildingUnits Where BuildingUnitPK = @BuildingUnitPK)
			SET @BuildingName = (Select BuildingName from tblBuildings, tblBuildingUnits 
								 Where tblBuildings.BuildingPK = tblBuildingUnits.BuildingFK And tblBuildingUnits.BuildingUnitPK = @BuildingUnitPK)
			SET @FullBuildingName = @BuildingName + ' ' + @BuildingUnit;

			IF (@var_DivisionBuildingUnitPK <> -1)
				BEGIN
					SELECT	@FullBuildingName As BuildingName,
						BuildingUnitAuditEventType As EventType, 
						Audit.Description As EventDescription, 
						case when createdbyuser.PersonName is null then 'System' else createdbyuser.PersonName END as EventUser,  
						Audit.InsertedDate As EventDate, 
						dbo.GetBSTDate() as DateTimeStamp 
					FROM tblBuildingUnitAudit As Audit
						INNER JOIN appBuildingUnitAuditEventTypes As EventTypes  On EventTypes.BuildingUnitAuditEventTypePK = Audit.BuildingUnitAuditTypeEventFK
						INNER JOIN tblBuildingUnits As BuildingUnits On BuildingUnits.BuildingUnitPK = Audit.BuildingUnitFK
						INNER JOIN tblDivisionBuildingUnits As DivisionUnits On DivisionUnits.DivisionBuildingUnitPK = Audit.DivisionBuildingUnitFK
						LEFT OUTER JOIN (Select Users.UserPK, FirstName + ' ' + LastName as PersonName
											From tblPeople As People 
											INNER JOIN tblUsers As Users On Users.PersonFK = People.PersonPK) As CreatedByUser on CreatedByUser.UserPK = Audit.Updatedby
					WHERE Audit.BuildingUnitFK = @var_BuildingUnitPK And 
						  Audit.DivisionBuildingUnitFK = @var_DivisionBuildingUnitPK AND
						(@var_RowPK  = -1 Or (Audit.BuildingUnitRowFK = @var_RowPK)) AND 
						(@var_ColumnPK  = -1 Or (Audit.BuildingUnitColumnFK = @var_ColumnPK)) And 
						(@var_BayPK  = -1 Or (Audit.BuildingUnitBayFK = @var_BayPK))
				END

			ELSE IF (@var_StockItemBuildingUnitPK <> -1)
				BEGIN
					SELECT	@FullBuildingName As BuildingName,
						BuildingUnitAuditEventType As EventType, 
						Audit.Description As EventDescription, 
						case when createdbyuser.PersonName is null then 'System' else createdbyuser.PersonName END as EventUser,  
						Audit.InsertedDate As EventDate, 
						dbo.GetBSTDate() as DateTimeStamp 
					FROM tblBuildingUnitAudit As Audit
						INNER JOIN appBuildingUnitAuditEventTypes As EventTypes  On EventTypes.BuildingUnitAuditEventTypePK = Audit.BuildingUnitAuditTypeEventFK
						INNER JOIN tblBuildingUnits As BuildingUnits On BuildingUnits.BuildingUnitPK = Audit.BuildingUnitFK
						INNER JOIN tblStockItemBuildingUnits As StockItemBuilding On StockItemBuilding.StockItemBuildingUnitPK = Audit.StockItemBuildingUnitFK
						LEFT OUTER JOIN (Select Users.UserPK, FirstName + ' ' + LastName as PersonName
									 From tblPeople As People 
										  INNER JOIN tblUsers As Users On Users.PersonFK = People.PersonPK) As CreatedByUser on CreatedByUser.UserPK = Audit.Updatedby
					WHERE Audit.BuildingUnitFK = @var_BuildingUnitPK And 
						  Audit.StockItemBuildingUnitFK = @var_StockItemBuildingUnitPK AND		
						(@var_RowPK  = -1 Or (Audit.BuildingUnitRowFK = @var_RowPK)) AND 
						(@var_ColumnPK  = -1 Or (Audit.BuildingUnitColumnFK = @var_ColumnPK)) And 
						(@var_BayPK  = -1 Or (Audit.BuildingUnitBayFK = @var_BayPK))
				END

			ELSE 
				BEGIN
					DECLARE @ReportTitle AS VARCHAR(100)
					SET @ReportTitle = @FullBuildingName

					if (@var_RowPK <> -1)
					BEGIN
						SET @ReportTitle = ''
						DECLARE @Row AS VARCHAR(100)
						SET @Row = (Select Row from tblBuildingUnitRows Where BuildingUnitRowPK = @RowPK)
						SET @ReportTitle = @FullBuildingName + ': Row ' + @Row
					END

					if (@var_ColumnPK <> -1)
					BEGIN
						SET @ReportTitle = ''
						DECLARE @ColumnRow AS VARCHAR(100)
						DECLARE @Column AS VARCHAR(100)
						SET @ColumnRow = (Select Row from tblBuildingUnitRows Where BuildingUnitRowPK = @RowPK)
						--SET @Column = (Select BuildingUnitColumnName from tblBuildingUnitColumns Where BuildingUnitColumnPK = @ColumnPK)
						SET @Column = (Select right('0' + cast(BuildingUnitColumnName as nvarchar(10)),2) from tblBuildingUnitColumns Where BuildingUnitColumnPK = @ColumnPK)
						SET @ReportTitle = @FullBuildingName + ': Location ' + @ColumnRow  + @Column 
					END

					if (@var_BayPK <> -1)
					BEGIN
						SET @ReportTitle = ''
						DECLARE @BayLocation AS VARCHAR(100)
						DECLARE @BayRow AS VARCHAR(100)
						DECLARE @BayColumn AS VARCHAR(100)
						DECLARE @Bay AS VARCHAR(100)
						SET @Bay = (Select lower(BayLevel) from tblBuildingUnitBays Where BuildingUnitBayPK = @BayPK)
						--SET @BayColumn = (Select BuildingUnitColumnName from tblBuildingUnitColumns Where BuildingUnitColumnPK = @ColumnPK)
						SET @BayColumn = (Select right('0' + cast(BuildingUnitColumnName as nvarchar(10)),2) from tblBuildingUnitColumns Where BuildingUnitColumnPK = @ColumnPK)
						SET @BayRow = (Select Row from tblBuildingUnitRows Where BuildingUnitRowPK = @RowPK)
						SET @BayLocation = @BayRow + @BayColumn + @Bay
						SET @ReportTitle = @FullBuildingName + ': Bay ' + @BayLocation 
					END

					SELECT	@ReportTitle As BuildingName,
							BuildingUnitAuditEventType As EventType, 
							Audit.Description As EventDescription, 
							case when createdbyuser.PersonName is null then 'System' else createdbyuser.PersonName END as EventUser,  
							Audit.InsertedDate As EventDate, 
							dbo.GetBSTDate() as DateTimeStamp 
					FROM tblBuildingUnitAudit As Audit
							INNER JOIN appBuildingUnitAuditEventTypes As EventTypes  On EventTypes.BuildingUnitAuditEventTypePK = Audit.BuildingUnitAuditTypeEventFK
							INNER JOIN tblBuildingUnits As BuildingUnits On BuildingUnits.BuildingUnitPK = Audit.BuildingUnitFK
							LEFT OUTER JOIN (Select Users.UserPK, FirstName + ' ' + LastName as PersonName
											 From tblPeople As People 
											  INNER JOIN tblUsers As Users On Users.PersonFK = People.PersonPK) As CreatedByUser on CreatedByUser.UserPK = Audit.Updatedby
					WHERE Audit.BuildingUnitFK = @var_BuildingUnitPK And 
							(@var_RowPK  = -1 Or (Audit.BuildingUnitRowFK = @var_RowPK)) And 
							(@var_ColumnPK  = -1 Or (Audit.BuildingUnitColumnFK = @var_ColumnPK)) And 
							(@var_BayPK  = -1 Or (Audit.BuildingUnitBayFK = @var_BayPK))
							--And Rows.BuildingUnitRowPK = @var_RowPK 
							-- AND BuildingUnits.BuildingUnitPK = Rows.BuildingUnitFK
					END
			
			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end

			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END

-- =============================================

-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spReportsBuildingUnitLayout]
(
	@buildingUnitFK int
)	
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data; Ensure this proc has a low impact when executed */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED; SET DEADLOCK_PRIORITY LOW

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT
	,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;
	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	DECLARE @var_buildingUnitFK int
	SET @var_buildingUnitFK = @buildingUnitFK
	SET @ParameterDetails = '@buildingUnitFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_buildingUnitFK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'')

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    --BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

		SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END


	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY
			

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start

			Declare @loadingBays int, @setDownAreas int

			Select * from(

			Select
			'Building Unit: ' + buildings.BuildingName + ' - ' + bus.BuildingUnit BuildingUnit, 

			case when buRows.Translate = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ then
				case when buRows.ReverseTranslate = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ then
					buRows.TranslatedRow + right('0' + cast((buRows.TranslateColumn - buCols.BuildingUnitColumn) as nvarchar(10)),2) 
				else
					buRows.TranslatedRow + right('0' + cast((buCols.BuildingUnitColumn + buRows.TranslateColumn) as nvarchar(10)),2) 
				End
			else 
				buRows.Row + right('0' + cast(buCols.BuildingUnitColumnName as nvarchar(10)),2) 
			End ColumnLocation,

			buCols.Levels,
			buBays.BayLevel,
			buBays.Width,
			buBays.Height

			from 
			(Select * from tblBuildingUnits Where BuildingUnitPK = @buildingUnitFK) bus

			inner join tblBuildings buildings on
			buildings.BuildingPK = bus.BuildingFK

			inner join tblBuildingUnitRows buRows on
			buRows.BuildingUnitFK = bus.BuildingUnitPK

			inner join tblBuildingUnitColumns buCols on
			buCols.BuildingUnitRowFK = buRows.BuildingUnitRowPK

			inner join tblBuildingUnitBays buBays on
			buBays.BuildingUnitColumnFK = buCols.BuildingUnitColumnPK

			where buBays.IsArchived=0
			) subQ

			Order By ColumnLocation, BayLevel

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end

			
			
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spReportsBuildingUnitStockLevel] 
(
	@buildingUnitPK int = -1
)	
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data; Ensure this proc has a low impact when executed */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED; SET DEADLOCK_PRIORITY LOW

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT
	,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;
	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	DECLARE @var_buildingUnitPK int
	SET @var_buildingUnitPK = @buildingUnitPK
	SET @ParameterDetails = '@buildingUnitPK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_buildingUnitPK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'')

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    --BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

		SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END


	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY
			
			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start

			-- Declare the return variable here
			declare @buildingUnitName nvarchar(50);	
			declare @buildingName nvarchar(50);
			DECLARE @percentOccupancy int

			DECLARE @tblBayPalletTypePercents TABLE
			(
			  PalletTypeFK int,
			  PalWidth int,
			  BayWidth int,	  
			  SpacePercent decimal(10,5)
			)
	
			IF(@var_buildingUnitPK <> -1) 
			BEGIN		 
				Declare @bayCount int
	 
				Insert into @tblBayPalletTypePercents 
				Select DISTINCT palletTypes.PalletTypeFK,  palletTypes.Width PalWidth, buBays.Width BayWidth,
				floor(CAST(100 as decimal)/ (CAST(buBays.Width as decimal)/ CAST(palletTypes.Width as decimal)))
				--cast(1.0/floor(buBays.Width/palletTypes.Width) * 100.0 as decimal(18,0)) 
				from tblBuildingUnitBays buBays 
				inner join tblBuildingUnitColumns buCols on
				buCols.BuildingUnitColumnPK = buBays.BuildingUnitColumnFK 
				inner join tblBuildingUnitRows buRows on
				buRows.BuildingUnitRowPK = buCols.BuildingUnitRowFK
 
				inner join (
					Select DISTINCT pallets.PalletTypeFK, palletTypes.Width 
					from tblPallets pallets
					inner join tblPalletTypes palletTypes on
					palletTypes.PalletTypePK = pallets.PalletTypeFK
					inner join tblBuildingUnitBays buBays on
					buBays.BuildingUnitBayPK = pallets.LocationFK
					inner join tblBuildingUnitColumns buCols on
					buCols.BuildingUnitColumnPK = buBays.BuildingUnitColumnFK 
					inner join tblBuildingUnitRows buRows on
					buRows.BuildingUnitRowPK = buCols.BuildingUnitRowFK
					Where buRows.BuildingUnitFK = @var_buildingUnitPK
					AND pallets.IsArchived = 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/ 
					AND pallets.LocationTypeFK = 1 /*In Racking ONLY! - BuildingUnitBays */
				) palletTypes on
				1=1
				Where buBays.IsArchived=0 and buRows.BuildingUnitFK = @var_buildingUnitPK
				AND buBays.Width > 0
		
				--Select * from @tblBayPalletTypePercents
				--where PalletTypeFK = 29
		 
				Select @bayCount = count(*) 
				from tblBuildingUnitBays buBays
				inner join tblBuildingUnitColumns buCols on
				buCols.BuildingUnitColumnPK = buBays.BuildingUnitColumnFK 
				inner join tblBuildingUnitRows buRows on
				buRows.BuildingUnitRowPK = buCols.BuildingUnitRowFK 
				Where buRows.BuildingUnitFK = @var_buildingUnitPK
				AND buBays.Width > 0 and buBays.IsArchived=0

				--Select * from 		@tblBayPalletTypePercents

				Select @percentOccupancy = sum(SpacePercent)/@bayCount
				from tblPallets pallets
				inner join tblBuildingUnitBays buBays on
				buBays.BuildingUnitBayPK = pallets.LocationFK
				inner join tblBuildingUnitColumns buCols on
				buCols.BuildingUnitColumnPK = buBays.BuildingUnitColumnFK 
				inner join tblBuildingUnitRows buRows on
				buRows.BuildingUnitRowPK = buCols.BuildingUnitRowFK
				inner join @tblBayPalletTypePercents palletPercentages on
				palletPercentages.PalletTypeFK = pallets.PalletTypeFK
				AND palletPercentages.BayWidth = buBays.Width
				Where buRows.BuildingUnitFK = @var_buildingUnitPK
				AND pallets.IsArchived = 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/ 
				AND pallets.LocationTypeFK = 1 /*In Racking ONLY! - BuildingUnitBays */
				AND buBays.Width > 0
			
				select @buildingUnitName =(BuildingUnit), @buildingName = (BuildingName)
				from tblBuildingUnits bu
				inner join tblBuildings bil on
				bil.BuildingPK = BuildingFK
				where bu.BuildingUnitPK = @var_buildingUnitPK
			END

			-- Return the result of the function

			select ('Unit Stock Level:  '+(@buildingName) + ' - ' + (@buildingUnitName)) as BuildingUnit,
			(@percentOccupancy) as Percentage, 'Stock Level' as PercentType

			union

			Select ('Unit Stock Level:  '+(@buildingName) + ' - ' + (@buildingUnitName)) as BuildingUnit,
			(100 - @percentOccupancy) as Percentage,'Storage Space' as PercentType   
	 
			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end
						
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spReportsCellBarcodes]

	@buildingUnitBayFKs nvarchar(MAX)
)	
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data; Ensure this proc has a low impact when executed */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED; SET DEADLOCK_PRIORITY LOW

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT
	,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;
	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	DECLARE @var_buildingUnitBayFKs nvarchar(MAX)
	SET @var_buildingUnitBayFKs = @buildingUnitBayFKs
	SET @ParameterDetails = '@buildingUnitBayFKs = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_buildingUnitBayFKs AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'')

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    --BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

		SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END


	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY
			

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start

		--	Declare @cellPrefix nvarchar(50)
		--	Select Top 1 @cellPrefix = BuildingUnitCellBarcodePrefix from appSystem
			Select buBays.Barcode ,
			case when buRows.Translate = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ then
				case when buRows.ReverseTranslate = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ then
					buRows.TranslatedRow + right('0' + cast((buRows.TranslateColumn - buCols.BuildingUnitColumn) as nvarchar(10)),2) + lower(buBays.BayLevel)  
				else
					buRows.TranslatedRow + right('0' + cast((buCols.BuildingUnitColumn + buRows.TranslateColumn) as nvarchar(10)),2) + lower(buBays.BayLevel) 
				End
			else 
				buRows.Row + right('0' + cast(buCols.BuildingUnitColumnName as nvarchar(10)),2) + lower(buBays.BayLevel)
			End as Location
			from tblBuildingUnitBays buBays
			inner join tblBuildingUnitColumns buCols on
			buCols.BuildingUnitColumnPK = buBays.BuildingUnitColumnFK
			inner join tblBuildingUnitRows buRows on
			buRows.BuildingUnitRowPK = buCols.BuildingUnitRowFK
	
			Where ',' + @var_buildingUnitBayFKs + ',' LIKE '%,' + CONVERT(VARCHAR, BuildingUnitBayPK) + ',%'

			Order By Row ASC, BuildingUnitColumn ASC, BayLevel DESC
	
			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end

			
			
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spReportsClientPalletsList]    
(    
 @divisionFKs nvarchar(500),    
 @stockItemFK int = -1,    
 @batch nvarchar(300) = '',    
 @orderByBatch int = -1,    
 @orderByDateReceived int = -1,    
 @batchWildcard bit = 0,    
 @orderByBestBefore int = -1,    
 @FilterBestBeforeDate datetime = '1900/01/01',    
 @ExportingToExcel bit = 0    
)     
AS    
BEGIN    
 /* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data; Ensure this proc has a low impact when executed */    
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED; SET DEADLOCK_PRIORITY LOW    
    
    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT    
 ,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;    
 SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();    
    
 -- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters    
 DECLARE @var_divisionFKs nvarchar(500), @var_stockItemFK int, @var_batch nvarchar(300), @var_orderByBatch int,     
 @var_orderByDateReceived int, @var_batchWildcard bit, @var_orderByBestBefore int, @var_FilterBestBeforeDate datetime, @var_ExportingToExcel bit    
    
 SET @var_divisionFKs = @divisionFKs; SET @var_stockItemFK = @stockItemFK; SET @var_batch = @batch; SET @var_orderByBatch = @orderByBatch    
 SET @var_orderByDateReceived = @orderByDateReceived; SET @var_batchWildcard = @batchWildcard; SET @var_orderByBestBefore = @orderByBestBefore    
 SET @var_FilterBestBeforeDate = @FilterBestBeforeDate; SET @var_ExportingToExcel = ISNULL(@ExportingToExcel,0)    
    
 SET @ParameterDetails = '@divisionFKs = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_divisionFKs AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@stockItemFK = '     
  + ISNULL(CAST(@var_stockItemFK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@batch = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_batch AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'')     
   + ',@orderByBatch = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_orderByBatch AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@orderByDateReceived = '     
    + ISNULL(CAST(@var_orderByDateReceived AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@batchWildcard = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_batchWildcard AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'')     
     + ',@orderByBestBefore = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_orderByBestBefore AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'')     
      + ',@FilterBestBeforeDate = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_FilterBestBeforeDate AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'')    
       + ',@ExportingToExcel = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_ExportingToExcel AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'')    
    
    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL     
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)    
    
    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)    
    --BEGIN    
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC     
    
  SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)    
    
        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)    
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK    
    
        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()    
    --END    
    
 SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);    
 SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails    
 ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;    
 INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()    
    
 WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3    
 BEGIN     
	BEGIN TRY       
    
   -- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start    
    
		DECLARE @for NVARCHAR(100)    
    
		SET @for = ''    
    
		IF(@var_divisionFKs <> '')BEGIN    
		Set @for = @for + (case when len(@for) > 0 then ', ' else '' end) + 'Division: ' + (Select STRING_AGG(DivisionName,',') as DivisionName  from tblDivisions WHERE (',' + @var_divisionFKs +',' LIKE '%,' + CONVERT(VARCHAR, DivisionPK) + ',%'))-- Where DivisionPK = @var_divisionFKs)    
		END       
    
		IF(@var_stockItemFK <> -1)       
		SET @for = @for + (CASE WHEN LEN(@for) > 0 THEN ', ' ELSE '' END) + 'Stock Item: ' + (SELECT StockItemCode FROM tblStockItems WHERE StockItemPK = @var_stockItemFK)    
    
		IF(@var_batch <> '')    
		SET @for = @for + (CASE WHEN LEN(@for) > 0 THEN ', ' ELSE '' END) + 'Batch: ' + @var_batch + CASE WHEN @var_batchWildcard = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ THEN ' *' ELSE '' END    
    
		drop table if exists #tmpdivisions
		select divisionpk, customerfk 
		into #tmpdivisions 
		from tbldivisions 
		WHERE (',' + @var_divisionFKs +',' LIKE '%,' + CONVERT(VARCHAR, DivisionPK) + ',%')    
    
		DECLARE @customerFK INT   
		SELECT TOP 1     
		@customerFK = CustomerFK    
		FROM #tmpdivisions divs  

		DROP TABLE IF exists #tblStockItems        
		SELECT DISTINCT    
			stockItems.StockItemPK,    
			stockItems.StockItemCode,     
			stockItems.[Description],     
			stockItems.EachesTypeFK,    
			stockItems.UnitTypeFK,    
			stockItems.DivisionFK    
		INTO #tblStockItems    
		FROM tblStockItems AS stockItems 
		inner join #tmpdivisions on divisionpk = divisionfk
		where ((StockItemPK = @var_stockItemFK and @var_stockItemFK > 0) OR @var_stockItemFK = -1)
	
		DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #tblPalletContent        
		SELECT     
			PalletFK, StockItemFK, Batch, BestBefore, DateOfManufacture, SpecialStockTypeFK,    
			SUM(ActualUnits) AS ActualUnits, SUM(ActualEaches * ActualUnits) AS ActualEachUnits,    
			SUM(AvailableUnits) AS AvailableUnits, SUM(AvailableEaches * AvailableUnits) AS AvailableEachUnits     
		INTO #tblPalletContent    
		FROM tblPalletContent AS subPc    
		INNER JOIN #tblStockItems AS stockitems ON subPc.stockitemfk = stockitems.StockItemPK    
		WHERE    actualunits > 0 
			and 
			(subPc.Batch LIKE CASE WHEN @var_batch = '' THEN subPc.Batch WHEN @var_batchWildcard = 1 THEN '%' + @var_batch + '%' ELSE @var_batch END) 
			AND 
			((@var_FilterBestBeforeDate <> '1900/01/01' AND subPc.BestBefore < @var_FilterBestBeforeDate) OR @var_FilterBestBeforeDate = '1900/01/01')  
		GROUP BY PalletFK, StockItemFK, Batch, BestBefore, DateOfManufacture, SpecialStockTypeFK    
    
		drop table if exists #tblPallets        
		SELECT DISTINCT    
			p.PalletPK,     
			p.BuildingUnitFK,     
			p.CustomerPalletNumber,     
			p.CustomerBarcode,     
			p.Barcode,     
			p.PalletStatusFK,    
			p.IsArchived    
		INTO #tblPallets    
		FROM tblPallets  p  
		inner join #tblPalletContent pc on pc.palletfk = p.palletpk
		WHERE IsArchived = 0 AND PalletStatusFK <> 10    

		DROP TABLE if exists #PalletAdditionalFields   
		SELECT     
			paf.PalletFK,     
			paf.AdditionalValue1 AS [AdditionalField1],     
			paf.AdditionalValue2 AS [AdditionalField2],     
			paf.AdditionalValue3 AS [AdditionalField3],     
			paf.AdditionalValue4 AS [AdditionalField4],     
			paf.AdditionalValue5 AS [AdditionalField5]    
		INTO #PalletAdditionalFields    
		FROM fnPalletAdditionalFields2() paf
		inner join #tblPallets p on paf.PalletFK = p.palletpk
    
		DROP TABLE if exists #tblPalletAudit    
		SELECT DISTINCT PalletFK, EventDate    
		INTO #tblPalletAudit    
		FROM tblPalletAudit AS pa    
		INNER JOIN #tblPallets AS p ON pa.PalletFK = p.PalletPK    
		WHERE pa.EventTypeFK = 1    
    
		DROP TABLE if exists #viewPalletLocations        
		SELECT DISTINCT  palletLocation.palletPK, palletLocation.[Location]    
		INTO #viewPalletLocations    
		FROM viewPalletLocations AS palletLocation    
		INNER JOIN #tblPallets AS p ON palletLocation.palletPK = p.palletPk    
    
		DROP TABLE if exists #tblstockinlinepallets        
		SELECT DISTINCT  palletfk, stockinlinefk    
		INTO #tblstockinlinepallets    
		FROM tblstockinlinepallets AS slp    
		INNER JOIN #tblPallets AS p on slp.PalletFK = p.PalletPK    
        
		DROP TABLE if exists #tblstockinlines   
		SELECT DISTINCT sil.stockinlinepk, sil.stockinfk    
		INTO #tblstockinlines    
		FROM  #tblstockinlinepallets AS silp       
		INNER JOIN tblstockinlines AS sil ON silp.stockinlinefk = sil.stockinlinepk    
    
		DROP TABLE if exists #tblstockins        
		SELECT DISTINCT si.stockinpk, si.divisionfk, si.containerinfk    
		INTO #tblstockins    
		FROM #tblstockinlines AS sil        
		INNER JOIN tblstockins AS si ON sil.stockinfk = si.stockinpk    
    
		DROP TABLE if exists #tblcontainerins  
		SELECT DISTINCT      
			cIns.containerinpk,     
			cIns.ExternalReference, 
			cIns.Free1,      
			cIns.Free2,      
			cIns.Free3,      
			cIns.Free4,      
			cIns.Free5,    
			cIns.GoodsInNumber,  
			Supp.Supplier  
		INTO #tblcontainerins      
		from #tblstockins AS si           
		INNER JOIN tblcontainerins AS cIns ON si.containerinfk = cIns.containerinpk  
		left join tblsuppliers Supp on Supp.SupplierPK = cIns.Supplierfk  
      
		DROP TABLE if exists #StockInDetails            
		SELECT DISTINCT       
			silp.palletfk,       
			case when cdis.CustomerDocketIdentificationPK is null then   
				CASE WHEN  cIns.ExternalReference <> '' THEN 'External Reference: '  + cIns.ExternalReference ELSE ' ' end    
				else  
				 case cdis.FieldFK when 1 then  
				  case when LEN(cins.Free1) > 0 THEN   
				  cdis.Prefix + ' ' + cins.Free1 END  
				 when 2 then  
				  case WHEN LEN(cins.Free2) > 0 THEN   
				  cdis.Prefix + ' ' + cins.Free2 END   
				 when 3 then  
				  CASE WHEN LEN(cins.Free3) > 0 THEN   
				  cdis.Prefix + ' ' + cins.Free3 END  
				 when 4 then  
				  CASE WHEN LEN(cins.Free4) > 0 THEN   
				  cdis.Prefix + ' ' + cins.Free4 END  
				 end  
				 + ' ' +  
				 case cdis.Field2FK when 1 then  
				  cdis.Prefix2 + ' ' + cins.Free1  
				 when 2 then  
				  cdis.Prefix2 + ' ' + cins.Free2  
				 when 3 then  
				  cdis.Prefix2 + ' ' + cins.Free3  
				 when 4 then  
				  cdis.Prefix2 + ' ' + cins.Free4  
				 else  
				  ''  
				 end  
				End as CustomerReference, cIns.GoodsInNumber,  
			cIns.Supplier  
		INTO #StockInDetails      
		from #tblstockinlinepallets AS silp     
		INNER JOIN #tblstockinlines AS sil ON silp.stockinlinefk = sil.stockinlinepk      
		INNER JOIN #tblstockins AS si ON sil.stockinfk = si.stockinpk      
		INNER JOIN #tblcontainerins AS cIns ON si.containerinfk = cIns.containerinpk      
		INNER JOIN #tmpdivisions AS d  ON si.divisionfk = d.divisionpk      
		LEFT OUTER JOIN tblCustomerDocketIdentifications AS cdis      
		ON cdis.CustomerFK = d.CustomerFK AND cdis.DocketTypeFK = 1 /*ContainerIn*/      
      
		/*get all pending container out details*/      
		DROP TABLE if exists #PendingContainerOuts            
		SELECT palletfk, cOuts.GoodsOrderNumber,      
			case when cdis.CustomerDocketIdentificationPK is null then       
			case when Docketlabel1 <> '' THEN Docketlabel1 + ': ' + DocketValue1 else ''end + ' ' +      
			case when Docketlabel2 <> '' THEN Docketlabel2 + ': ' + DocketValue2  else '' end + ' ' +      
			CASE when Docketlabel3 <> '' THEN Docketlabel3 + ': ' + DocketValue3 else '' end       
			else      
			case cdis.FieldFK when 40 then      
			cdis.Prefix + ' ' + cOuts.DocketValue1      
			when 41 then      
			cdis.Prefix + ' ' + cOuts.DocketValue2      
			when 42 then      
			cdis.Prefix + ' ' + cOuts.DocketValue3      
			end      
			+ ' ' +      
			case cdis.Field2FK when 40 then      
			cdis.Prefix2 + ' ' + cOuts.DocketValue1      
			when 41 then      
			cdis.Prefix2 + ' ' + cOuts.DocketValue2      
			when 42 then      
			cdis.Prefix2 + ' ' + cOuts.DocketValue3      
			else      
			''      
			end      
			End as [ID]     
		INTO #PendingContainerOuts      
		FROM tblcontainerouts cOuts      
		INNER JOIN tblcontaineroutlines tcol ON cOuts.ContainerOutPK = tcol.ContainerOutFK      
		INNER JOIN dbo.tblContainerOutLinePalletContent tcolpc ON tcol.ContainerOutLinePK = tcolpc.ContainerOutLineFK      
		INNER JOIN #tmpdivisions div ON div.divisionpk = tcol.DivisionFK      
		left outer join tblCustomerDocketIdentifications cdis on cdis.CustomerFK = div.CustomerFK AND cdis.DocketTypeFK = 2 /*ContainerOut*/      
		WHERE cOuts.ContainerOutStatusFK < 5 AND palletfk > 0 --AND (',' + @var_divisionFKs +',' LIKE '%,' + CONVERT(VARCHAR, div.divisionPK) + ',%')      
      
		DROP TABLE if exists #results            
		Select    distinct   
			@for AS [For],       
			stockItems.StockItemCode,       
			stockItems.[Description],       
			pc.Batch,       
			pallets.CustomerPalletNumber,       
			palletAudit.EventDate AS [DateReceived],      
			CASE WHEN stockItems.EachesTypeFK <> -1 THEN pc.ActualEachUnits ELSE pc.ActualUnits END AS Actual,      
			CASE WHEN stockItems.EachesTypeFK <> -1 THEN pc.AvailableEachUnits ELSE pc.AvailableUnits END AS Available,      
			CASE WHEN stockItems.EachesTypeFK <> -1 THEN pc.ActualEachUnits - pc.AvailableEachUnits ELSE pc.ActualUnits - pc.AvailableUnits END AS OnOrder,      
			unitTypes.Abbreviation,      
			pAfv.AdditionalField1,      
			pAfv.AdditionalField2,      
			pAfv.AdditionalField3,      
			pAfv.AdditionalField4,      
			pAfv.AdditionalField5,      
			pafs.paf1,      
			pafs.paf2,      
			pafs.paf3,      
			pafs.paf4,      
			pafs.paf5,      
			'Building: ' + buildings.BuildingName + ' - ' + bus.BuildingUnit AS [BuildingUnit],      
			buildings.BuildingName + ' - ' + bus.BuildingUnit + ': Total' AS [BuildingUnitTotal],      
			palletLocation.[Location] AS PalletLocation,      
			CASE WHEN pallets.CustomerBarcode = '' THEN pallets.Barcode ELSE pallets.CustomerBarcode END AS Barcode,      
			pstatus.PalletStatus,       
			pc.BestBefore,       
			pc.DateOfManufacture,      
			CASE WHEN pc.SpecialStockTypeFK > 0 THEN sst.SpecialStockType ELSE '' END AS SpecialStockType,      
			StockInDetails.CustomerReference AS StockInReference, PendingStockOuts.ID AS StockOutReference, StockInDetails.GoodsInNumber, PendingStockOuts.GoodsOrderNumber      
			, StockInDetails.supplier  
		INTO #results      
		from  #tblPallets AS pallets      
		INNER JOIN #tblPalletContent AS pc ON pc.PalletFK = pallets.PalletPK
		LEFT OUTER JOIN appSpecialStockTypes AS sst ON sst.SpecialStockTypePK = pc.SpecialStockTypeFK  
		INNER JOIN #tblStockItems AS stockItems ON stockItems.StockItemPK = pc.StockItemFK            
		LEFT OUTER JOIN tblUnitTypes AS unitTypes ON unitTypes.UnitTypePK = stockItems.UnitTypeFK           
		LEFT OUTER JOIN tblBuildingUnits AS bus ON bus.BuildingUnitPK = pallets.BuildingUnitFK            
		LEFT OUTER JOIN tblBuildings AS buildings ON buildings.BuildingPK = bus.BuildingFK            
		LEFT OUTER JOIN #tblPalletAudit AS palletAudit ON palletAudit.PalletFK = pallets.PalletPK            
		LEFT OUTER JOIN #PalletAdditionalFields AS pAfv ON pAfv.palletFK = pallets.palletPK      
		LEFT OUTER JOIN (      
			Select       
			ISNULL(pafs1.PalletAdditionalField, '') AS paf1,       
			ISNULL(pafs2.PalletAdditionalField, '') AS paf2,       
			ISNULL(pafs3.PalletAdditionalField, '') AS paf3,       
			ISNULL(pafs4.PalletAdditionalField, '') AS paf4,       
			ISNULL(pafs5.PalletAdditionalField, '') AS paf5       
			From       
			tblPalletAdditionalFields AS pafs1      
			LEFT OUTER JOIN tblPalletAdditionalFields AS pafs2 ON pafs2.PalletAdditionalFieldTypeFK = 1 /*Customer*/ AND pafs2.FK = @customerFK AND pafs2.FieldNumber = 2            
			LEFT OUTER JOIN tblPalletAdditionalFields AS pafs3 ON pafs3.PalletAdditionalFieldTypeFK = 1 /*Customer*/ AND pafs3.FK = @customerFK AND pafs3.FieldNumber = 3            
			LEFT OUTER JOIN tblPalletAdditionalFields AS pafs4 on pafs4.PalletAdditionalFieldTypeFK = 1 /*Customer*/ AND pafs4.FK = @customerFK AND pafs4.FieldNumber = 4            
			LEFT OUTER JOIN tblPalletAdditionalFields AS pafs5 on pafs5.PalletAdditionalFieldTypeFK = 1 /*Customer*/ AND pafs5.FK = @customerFK AND pafs5.FieldNumber = 5      
			WHERE pafs1.PalletAdditionalFieldTypeFK = 1 /*Customer*/ AND pafs1.FK = @customerFK AND pafs1.FieldNumber = 1      
		) AS pafs  ON 1=1      
		LEFT OUTER JOIN #viewPalletLocations AS palletLocation ON palletLocation.palletPK = pallets.palletPk      
		INNER JOIN appPalletStatus AS pstatus ON pstatus.PalletStatusPK = pallets.PalletStatusFK      
		INNER JOIN #StockInDetails AS StockInDetails ON StockInDetails.palletfk = pallets.palletpk      
		LEFT JOIN #PendingContainerOuts AS PendingStockOuts ON PendingStockOuts.palletfk = pallets.PalletPK  
  
   IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM tblCustomers WHERE CustomerPK = @customerFK AND CustomerName IS NOT NULL AND CustomerName LIKE '%danone%') AND @var_ExportingToExcel = 1      
   BEGIN      
    SELECT       
     [For],       
     StockItemCode,       
     [Description],       
     Batch,       
     Barcode,      
     PalletStatus,       
     Actual,      
     Available,      
     OnOrder,      
     Abbreviation,      
     PalletLocation,      
     [BuildingUnit],      
     [DateReceived],      
     BestBefore,      
     DateOfManufacture,      
     SpecialStockType,      
     StockInReference,      
     StockOutReference ,  
   supplier  
    FROM      
     #results      
    ORDER BY       
     [BuildingUnit],      
     StockItemCode,      
     CASE WHEN @var_orderByBatch = 1 THEN      
      Batch      
     END ASC,      
     CASE WHEN @var_orderByBatch = 2 THEN      
      Batch      
     END DESC,      
     CASE WHEN @var_orderByDateReceived = 1 THEN      
      [DateReceived]      
     END ASC,      
     CASE WHEN @var_orderByDateReceived = 2 THEN      
      [DateReceived]      
      END DESC,      
     CASE WHEN @var_orderByBestBefore = 1 THEN       
      BestBefore      
     END ASC,      
     CASE WHEN @var_orderByBestBefore = 2 THEN       
      BestBefore      
     END DESC,      
     CASE WHEN @var_orderByBatch = -1 THEN      
      Batch      
     END ASC      
   END    
    else IF (@customerFK = 744 AND @var_ExportingToExcel = 1)    
   BEGIN    
    SELECT     
     [For],     
     StockItemCode,     
     [Description],     
     Batch,     
     Barcode,    
     PalletStatus,     
     Actual,    
     Available,    
     OnOrder,    
     --Abbreviation,    
     PalletLocation,    
     [BuildingUnit],    
     [DateReceived]    
     --BestBefore,    
     --DateOfManufacture,    
    -- SpecialStockType,    
    -- StockInReference,    
    -- StockOutReference    
    FROM    
     #results    
    ORDER BY     
     [BuildingUnit],    
     StockItemCode,    
     CASE WHEN @var_orderByBatch = 1 THEN    
      Batch    
     END ASC,    
     CASE WHEN @var_orderByBatch = 2 THEN    
      Batch    
     END DESC,    
     CASE WHEN @var_orderByDateReceived = 1 THEN    
      [DateReceived]    
     END ASC,    
     CASE WHEN @var_orderByDateReceived = 2 THEN    
      [DateReceived]    
      END DESC,    
     CASE WHEN @var_orderByBestBefore = 1 THEN     
      BestBefore    
     END ASC,    
     CASE WHEN @var_orderByBestBefore = 2 THEN     
      BestBefore    
     END DESC,    
     CASE WHEN @var_orderByBatch = -1 THEN    
      Batch    
     END ASC    
   END    
   ELSE      
   BEGIN      
    SELECT      
     *      
    FROM      
     #results      
    ORDER BY       
     [BuildingUnit],      
     StockItemCode,      
     CASE WHEN @var_orderByBatch = 1 THEN      
      Batch      
     END ASC,      
     CASE WHEN @var_orderByBatch = 2 THEN      
      Batch      
     END DESC,      
     CASE WHEN @var_orderByDateReceived = 1 THEN      
      [DateReceived]      
     END ASC,      
     CASE WHEN @var_orderByDateReceived = 2 THEN      
      [DateReceived]      
      END DESC,      
     CASE WHEN @var_orderByBestBefore = 1 THEN       
      BestBefore      
     END ASC,      
     CASE WHEN @var_orderByBestBefore = 2 THEN       
      BestBefore      
     END DESC,      
CASE WHEN @var_orderByBatch = -1 THEN      
      Batch      
     END ASC      
   END      
      
   -- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end      
            
   BREAK      
  END TRY      
  BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */      
   DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;      
   SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;      
   SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;      
      
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY       
   BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;      
             
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;      
      
            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID      
                  
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;      
                  
   IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)      
   BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END      
   ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */      
  END CATCH      
  SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1      
 END      
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spReportsClientPalletsList_Old]  
(

AS

 ,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;  
 SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();  
  
 -- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters

 @var_orderByDateReceived int, @var_batchWildcard bit, @var_orderByBestBefore int, @var_FilterBestBeforeDate datetime, @var_ExportingToExcel bit  
  
 SET @var_divisionFKs = @divisionFKs; SET @var_stockItemFK = @stockItemFK; SET @var_batch = @batch; SET @var_orderByBatch = @orderByBatch  
 SET @var_orderByDateReceived = @orderByDateReceived; SET @var_batchWildcard = @batchWildcard; SET @var_orderByBestBefore = @orderByBestBefore  
 SET @var_FilterBestBeforeDate = @FilterBestBeforeDate; SET @var_ExportingToExcel = ISNULL(@ExportingToExcel,0)  
  
 SET @ParameterDetails = '@divisionFKs = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_divisionFKs AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@stockItemFK = '   
  + ISNULL(CAST(@var_stockItemFK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@batch = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_batch AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'')   
   + ',@orderByBatch = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_orderByBatch AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@orderByDateReceived = '

     + ',@orderByBestBefore = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_orderByBestBefore AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'')   
      + ',@FilterBestBeforeDate = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_FilterBestBeforeDate AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'')  
       + ',@ExportingToExcel = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_ExportingToExcel AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'')  
  
    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL   
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)  
  
    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)  
    --BEGIN  
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC   
  
  SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)  
  
        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)  
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK  
  
        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()  
    --END  
  
 SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);  
 SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails  
 ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;  
 INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()  
  
 WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3  
 BEGIN   
  BEGIN TRY     
  
   -- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start  
  
   DECLARE @for NVARCHAR(100)  
  
   SET @for = ''  
  
   IF(@var_divisionFKs > -1)BEGIN  
    Set @for = @for + (case when len(@for) > 0 then ', ' else '' end) + 'Division: ' + (Select DivisionName from tblDivisions Where DivisionPK = @var_divisionFKs)  
   END  
  
   IF(@var_stockItemFK <> -1)     
    SET @for = @for + (CASE WHEN LEN(@for) > 0 THEN ', ' ELSE '' END) + 'Stock Item: ' + (SELECT StockItemCode FROM tblStockItems WHERE StockItemPK = @var_stockItemFK)  
  
   IF(@var_batch <> '')  
    SET @for = @for + (CASE WHEN LEN(@for) > 0 THEN ', ' ELSE '' END) + 'Batch: ' + @var_batch + CASE WHEN @var_batchWildcard = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ THEN ' *' ELSE '' END

    DROP TABLE #PalletAdditionalFields
