    AdditionalValue1 AS [AdditionalField1],   
    AdditionalValue2 AS [AdditionalField2],   
    AdditionalValue3 AS [AdditionalField3],   
    AdditionalValue4 AS [AdditionalField4],   
    AdditionalValue5 AS [AdditionalField5]  
   INTO   
    #PalletAdditionalFields  
   FROM   
    fnPalletAdditionalFields2()  
  
   DECLARE @customerFK INT  
  
   SELECT TOP 1   
    @customerFK = CustomerFK  
   FROM   
    tblDivisions divs  
   WHERE   
    (',' + @var_divisionFKs +',' LIKE '%,' + CONVERT(VARCHAR, divs.DivisionPK) + ',%')  
  
   IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#tblPallets') IS NOT NULL  
    DROP TABLE #tblPallets  
  
   SELECT DISTINCT  
    PalletPK,   
    BuildingUnitFK,   
    CustomerPalletNumber,   
    CustomerBarcode,   
    Barcode,   
    PalletStatusFK,  
    IsArchived  
   INTO  
    #tblPallets  
   FROM  
    tblPallets  
   WHERE  
    IsArchived = 0  
    AND PalletStatusFK <> 10  
  
   IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#tblPalletAudit') IS NOT NULL  
    DROP TABLE #tblPalletAudit  
  
   SELECT DISTINCT  
    PalletFK, EventDate  
   INTO   
    #tblPalletAudit  
   FROM   
    tblPalletAudit AS pa  
   INNER JOIN #tblPallets AS p  
    ON pa.PalletFK = p.PalletPK  
   WHERE   
    pa.EventTypeFK = 1  
  
   IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#tblPalletContent') IS NOT NULL  
    DROP TABLE #tblPalletContent  
  
   SELECT   
    PalletFK, StockItemFK, Batch, BestBefore, DateOfManufacture, SpecialStockTypeFK,  
    SUM(ActualUnits) AS ActualUnits, SUM(ActualEaches * ActualUnits) AS ActualEachUnits,  
    SUM(AvailableUnits) AS AvailableUnits, SUM(AvailableEaches * AvailableUnits) AS AvailableEachUnits   
   INTO   
    #tblPalletContent  
   FROM   
    tblPalletContent AS subPc  
   INNER JOIN #tblPallets AS p  
    ON subPc.PalletFK = p.PalletPK  
   WHERE  
    (subPc.StockItemFK = @var_stockItemFK and @var_stockItemFK > 0)  
    OR @var_stockItemFK = -1  
   GROUP BY   
    PalletFK, StockItemFK, Batch, BestBefore, DateOfManufacture, SpecialStockTypeFK  
  
   IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#tblStockItems') IS NOT NULL  
    DROP TABLE #tblStockItems  
  
   SELECT DISTINCT  
    stockItems.StockItemPK,  
    stockItems.StockItemCode,   
    stockItems.[Description],   
    stockItems.EachesTypeFK,  
    stockItems.UnitTypeFK,  
    stockItems.DivisionFK  
   INTO  
    #tblStockItems  
   FROM  
    tblStockItems AS stockItems   
   INNER JOIN #tblPalletContent AS pc  
    ON stockItems.StockItemPK = pc.StockItemFK  
  
   IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#viewPalletLocations') IS NOT NULL  
    DROP TABLE #viewPalletLocations  
  
   SELECT DISTINCT  
    palletLocation.palletPK,  
    palletLocation.[Location]  
   INTO  
    #viewPalletLocations  
   FROM   
    viewPalletLocations AS palletLocation  
   INNER JOIN #tblPallets AS p  
    ON palletLocation.palletPK = p.palletPk  
  
   IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#tblstockinlinepallets') IS NOT NULL  
    DROP TABLE #tblstockinlinepallets  
  
   SELECT DISTINCT  
    palletfk,  
    stockinlinefk  
   INTO  
    #tblstockinlinepallets  
   FROM  
    tblstockinlinepallets AS slp  
   INNER JOIN #tblPallets AS p  
    on slp.PalletFK = p.PalletPK  
      
   IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#tblstockinlines') IS NOT NULL  
    DROP TABLE #tblstockinlines  
  
   SELECT DISTINCT  
    sil.stockinlinepk,  
    sil.stockinfk  
   INTO  
    #tblstockinlines  
   FROM   
    #tblstockinlinepallets AS silp     
   INNER JOIN tblstockinlines AS sil    
    ON silp.stockinlinefk = sil.stockinlinepk  
  
   IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#tblstockins') IS NOT NULL  
    DROP TABLE #tblstockins  
  
   SELECT DISTINCT  
    si.stockinpk,  
    si.divisionfk,  
    si.containerinfk  
   INTO  
    #tblstockins  
   FROM   
    #tblstockinlines AS sil      
   INNER JOIN tblstockins AS si      
    ON sil.stockinfk = si.stockinpk  
  
   IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#tblcontainerins') IS NOT NULL  
    DROP TABLE #tblcontainerins

  SELECT DISTINCT    
    cIns.containerinpk,    
    cIns.Free1,    
    cIns.Free2,    
    cIns.Free3,    
    cIns.Free4,    
    cIns.Free5,  
 cIns.GoodsInNumber,
 Supp.Supplier
   INTO    
    #tblcontainerins    
   from     
    #tblstockins AS si         
   INNER JOIN tblcontainerins AS cIns    
    ON si.containerinfk = cIns.containerinpk
	left join tblsuppliers Supp on Supp.SupplierPK = cIns.Supplierfk
    
   IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#StockInDetails') IS NOT NULL    
    DROP TABLE #StockInDetails    
    
   SELECT DISTINCT     
    silp.palletfk,     
    CASE WHEN cdis.CustomerDocketIdentificationPK = null THEN ''     
    ELSE    
     CASE cdis.FieldFK     
      WHEN 1 THEN    
       cdis.Prefix + ' ' + cIns.Free1    
      WHEN 2 THEN    
       cdis.Prefix + ' ' + cIns.Free2    
      WHEN 3 THEN    
       cdis.Prefix + ' ' + cIns.Free3    
      WHEN 4 THEN    
       cdis.Prefix + ' ' + cIns.Free4    
      WHEN 5 THEN    
       cdis.Prefix + ' ' + cIns.Free5    
      ELSE    
       ''    
      END    
      + ' ' +    
      CASE cdis.Field2FK     
      WHEN 1 THEN    
       cdis.Prefix2 + ' ' + cIns.Free1    
      WHEN 2 THEN    
       cdis.Prefix2 + ' ' + cIns.Free2    
      WHEN 3 THEN    
       cdis.Prefix2 + ' ' + cIns.Free3    
      WHEN 4 THEN    
       cdis.Prefix2 + ' ' + cIns.Free4    
      WHEN 5 THEN    
       cdis.Prefix2 + ' ' + cIns.Free5    
      ELSE    
       ''    
     END    
    END AS CustomerReference, cIns.GoodsInNumber,
	cIns.Supplier
   INTO    
    #StockInDetails    
   from     
    #tblstockinlinepallets AS silp       
   INNER JOIN #tblstockinlines AS sil        
    ON silp.stockinlinefk = sil.stockinlinepk    
   INNER JOIN #tblstockins AS si         
    ON sil.stockinfk = si.stockinpk    
   INNER JOIN #tblcontainerins AS cIns        
    ON si.containerinfk = cIns.containerinpk    
   INNER JOIN tbldivisions AS d    
    ON si.divisionfk = d.divisionpk    
   LEFT OUTER JOIN tblCustomerDocketIdentifications AS cdis    
    ON cdis.CustomerFK = d.CustomerFK     
    AND cdis.DocketTypeFK = 1 /*ContainerIn*/    
    
    /*get all pending container out details*/    
   IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#PendingContainerOuts') IS NOT NULL    
    DROP TABLE #PendingContainerOuts    
    
   SELECT palletfk, cOuts.GoodsOrderNumber,    
    case when cdis.CustomerDocketIdentificationPK is null then     
     case when Docketlabel1 <> '' THEN Docketlabel1 + ': ' + DocketValue1 else ''end + ' ' +    
     case when Docketlabel2 <> '' THEN Docketlabel2 + ': ' + DocketValue2  else '' end + ' ' +    
     CASE when Docketlabel3 <> '' THEN Docketlabel3 + ': ' + DocketValue3 else '' end     
    else    
     case cdis.FieldFK when 40 then    
      cdis.Prefix + ' ' + cOuts.DocketValue1    
     when 41 then    
      cdis.Prefix + ' ' + cOuts.DocketValue2    
     when 42 then    
      cdis.Prefix + ' ' + cOuts.DocketValue3    
     end    
     + ' ' +    
     case cdis.Field2FK when 40 then    
   cdis.Prefix2 + ' ' + cOuts.DocketValue1    
     when 41 then    
      cdis.Prefix2 + ' ' + cOuts.DocketValue2    
     when 42 then    
      cdis.Prefix2 + ' ' + cOuts.DocketValue3    
     else    
      ''    
     end    
    End as [ID]   
   INTO #PendingContainerOuts    
   FROM tblcontainerouts cOuts    
   INNER JOIN tblcontaineroutlines tcol ON cOuts.ContainerOutPK = tcol.ContainerOutFK    
   INNER JOIN dbo.tblContainerOutLinePalletContent tcolpc ON tcol.ContainerOutLinePK = tcolpc.ContainerOutLineFK    
   INNER JOIN tbldivisions div ON div.divisionpk = tcol.DivisionFK    
   left outer join tblCustomerDocketIdentifications cdis on cdis.CustomerFK = div.CustomerFK AND cdis.DocketTypeFK = 2 /*ContainerOut*/    
   WHERE cOuts.ContainerOutStatusFK < 5 AND palletfk > 0 AND (',' + @var_divisionFKs +',' LIKE '%,' + CONVERT(VARCHAR, div.divisionPK) + ',%')    
    
   IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#results') IS NOT NULL    
    DROP TABLE #results    
    
   Select     
    @for AS [For],     
    stockItems.StockItemCode,     
    stockItems.[Description],     
    pc.Batch,     
    pallets.CustomerPalletNumber,     
    palletAudit.EventDate AS [DateReceived],    
    CASE WHEN stockItems.EachesTypeFK <> -1 THEN pc.ActualEachUnits ELSE pc.ActualUnits END AS Actual,    
    CASE WHEN stockItems.EachesTypeFK <> -1 THEN pc.AvailableEachUnits ELSE pc.AvailableUnits END AS Available,    
    CASE WHEN stockItems.EachesTypeFK <> -1 THEN pc.ActualEachUnits - pc.AvailableEachUnits ELSE pc.ActualUnits - pc.AvailableUnits END AS OnOrder,    
    unitTypes.Abbreviation,    
    pAfv.AdditionalField1,    
    pAfv.AdditionalField2,    
    pAfv.AdditionalField3,    
    pAfv.AdditionalField4,    
    pAfv.AdditionalField5,    
    pafs.paf1,    
    pafs.paf2,    
    pafs.paf3,    
    pafs.paf4,    
    pafs.paf5,    
    'Building: ' + buildings.BuildingName + ' - ' + bus.BuildingUnit AS [BuildingUnit],    
    buildings.BuildingName + ' - ' + bus.BuildingUnit + ': Total' AS [BuildingUnitTotal],    
    palletLocation.[Location] AS PalletLocation,    
    CASE WHEN pallets.CustomerBarcode = '' THEN pallets.Barcode ELSE pallets.CustomerBarcode END AS Barcode,    
    pstatus.PalletStatus,     
    pc.BestBefore,     
    pc.DateOfManufacture,    
    CASE WHEN pc.SpecialStockTypeFK > 0 THEN sst.SpecialStockType ELSE '' END AS SpecialStockType,    
    StockInDetails.CustomerReference AS StockInReference, PendingStockOuts.ID AS StockOutReference, StockInDetails.GoodsInNumber, PendingStockOuts.GoodsOrderNumber    
  , StockInDetails.supplier
   INTO    
    #results    
   from     
    #tblPallets AS pallets    
   /*Pallet Content*/    
   INNER JOIN #tblPalletContent AS pc     
    ON pc.PalletFK = pallets.PalletPK    
    
   /*special stock type*/    
   LEFT OUTER JOIN appSpecialStockTypes AS sst     
    ON sst.SpecialStockTypePK = pc.SpecialStockTypeFK    
    
   /*StockItems*/    
   INNER JOIN #tblStockItems AS stockItems     
    ON stockItems.StockItemPK = pc.StockItemFK    
    
   LEFT OUTER JOIN tblUnitTypes AS unitTypes     
    ON unitTypes.UnitTypePK = stockItems.UnitTypeFK    
    
   LEFT OUTER JOIN tblBuildingUnits AS bus     
    ON bus.BuildingUnitPK = pallets.BuildingUnitFK    
    
   LEFT OUTER JOIN tblBuildings AS buildings    
    ON buildings.BuildingPK = bus.BuildingFK    
    
   LEFT OUTER JOIN #tblPalletAudit AS palletAudit     
    ON palletAudit.PalletFK = pallets.PalletPK    
    
   LEFT OUTER JOIN #PalletAdditionalFields AS pAfv     
    ON pAfv.palletFK = pallets.palletPK    
   LEFT OUTER JOIN (    
        Select     
         ISNULL(pafs1.PalletAdditionalField, '') AS paf1,     
         ISNULL(pafs2.PalletAdditionalField, '') AS paf2,     
         ISNULL(pafs3.PalletAdditionalField, '') AS paf3,     
         ISNULL(pafs4.PalletAdditionalField, '') AS paf4,     
         ISNULL(pafs5.PalletAdditionalField, '') AS paf5     
        From     
         tblPalletAdditionalFields AS pafs1    
        LEFT OUTER JOIN tblPalletAdditionalFields AS pafs2    
         ON pafs2.PalletAdditionalFieldTypeFK = 1 /*Customer*/    
         AND pafs2.FK = @customerFK AND pafs2.FieldNumber = 2    
    
        LEFT OUTER JOIN tblPalletAdditionalFields AS pafs3    
         ON pafs3.PalletAdditionalFieldTypeFK = 1 /*Customer*/    
         AND pafs3.FK = @customerFK AND pafs3.FieldNumber = 3    
    
        LEFT OUTER JOIN tblPalletAdditionalFields AS pafs4    
         on pafs4.PalletAdditionalFieldTypeFK = 1 /*Customer*/    
         AND pafs4.FK = @customerFK AND pafs4.FieldNumber = 4    
    
        LEFT OUTER JOIN tblPalletAdditionalFields AS pafs5    
         on pafs5.PalletAdditionalFieldTypeFK = 1 /*Customer*/    
         AND pafs5.FK = @customerFK AND pafs5.FieldNumber = 5    
        WHERE     
         pafs1.PalletAdditionalFieldTypeFK = 1 /*Customer*/    
         AND pafs1.FK = @customerFK AND pafs1.FieldNumber = 1    
       ) AS pafs     
    ON 1=1    
   LEFT OUTER JOIN #viewPalletLocations AS palletLocation    
    ON palletLocation.palletPK = pallets.palletPk    
   INNER JOIN appPalletStatus AS pstatus     
    ON pstatus.PalletStatusPK = pallets.PalletStatusFK    
   INNER JOIN #StockInDetails AS StockInDetails     
    ON StockInDetails.palletfk = pallets.palletpk    
   LEFT JOIN #PendingContainerOuts AS PendingStockOuts     
    ON PendingStockOuts.palletfk = pallets.PalletPK    
   WHERE     
    (',' + @var_divisionFKs +',' LIKE '%,' + CONVERT(VARCHAR, stockItems.DivisionFK) + ',%')    
    AND    
    (pc.StockItemFK = @var_stockItemFK OR @var_stockItemFK = -1)    
    AND    
    pc.Batch LIKE     
     CASE WHEN @var_batch = '' THEN    
      pc.Batch    
     WHEN @var_batchWildcard = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ THEN    
      '%' + @var_batch + '%'    
     ELSE     
      @var_batch    
     END    
    AND pallets.IsArchived = 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/    
    AND pallets.PalletStatusFK <> 10    
    AND (    
      (@var_FilterBestBeforeDate <> '1900/01/01' AND pc.BestBefore < @var_FilterBestBeforeDate)     
      OR @var_FilterBestBeforeDate = '1900/01/01'    
     )   

	  IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM tblCustomers WHERE CustomerPK = @customerFK AND CustomerName IS NOT NULL AND CustomerName LIKE '%danone%') AND @var_ExportingToExcel = 1    
   BEGIN    
    SELECT     
     [For],     
     StockItemCode,     
     [Description],     
     Batch,     
     Barcode,    
     PalletStatus,     
     Actual,    
     Available,    
     OnOrder,    
     Abbreviation,    
     PalletLocation,    
     [BuildingUnit],    
     [DateReceived],    
     BestBefore,    
     DateOfManufacture,    
     SpecialStockType,    
     StockInReference,    
     StockOutReference ,
	  supplier
    FROM    
     #results    
    ORDER BY     
     [BuildingUnit],    
     StockItemCode,    
     CASE WHEN @var_orderByBatch = 1 THEN    
      Batch    
     END ASC,    
     CASE WHEN @var_orderByBatch = 2 THEN    
      Batch    
     END DESC,    
     CASE WHEN @var_orderByDateReceived = 1 THEN    
      [DateReceived]    
     END ASC,    
     CASE WHEN @var_orderByDateReceived = 2 THEN    
      [DateReceived]    
      END DESC,    
     CASE WHEN @var_orderByBestBefore = 1 THEN     
      BestBefore    
     END ASC,    
     CASE WHEN @var_orderByBestBefore = 2 THEN     
      BestBefore    
     END DESC,    
     CASE WHEN @var_orderByBatch = -1 THEN    
      Batch    
     END ASC    
   END  
    else IF (@customerFK = 744 AND @var_ExportingToExcel = 1)  
   BEGIN  
    SELECT   
     [For],   
     StockItemCode,   
     [Description],   
     Batch,   
     Barcode,  
     PalletStatus,   
     Actual,  
     Available,  
     OnOrder,  
     --Abbreviation,  
     PalletLocation,  
     [BuildingUnit]--,  
     --[DateReceived],  
     --BestBefore,  
     --DateOfManufacture,  
    -- SpecialStockType,  
    -- StockInReference,  
    -- StockOutReference  
    FROM  
     #results  
    ORDER BY   
     [BuildingUnit],  
     StockItemCode,  
     CASE WHEN @var_orderByBatch = 1 THEN  
      Batch  
     END ASC,  
     CASE WHEN @var_orderByBatch = 2 THEN  
      Batch  
     END DESC,  
     CASE WHEN @var_orderByDateReceived = 1 THEN  
      [DateReceived]  
     END ASC,  
     CASE WHEN @var_orderByDateReceived = 2 THEN  
      [DateReceived]  
      END DESC,  
     CASE WHEN @var_orderByBestBefore = 1 THEN   
      BestBefore  
     END ASC,  
     CASE WHEN @var_orderByBestBefore = 2 THEN   
      BestBefore  
     END DESC,  
     CASE WHEN @var_orderByBatch = -1 THEN  
      Batch  
     END ASC  
   END  
   ELSE    
   BEGIN    
    SELECT    
     *    
    FROM    
     #results    
    ORDER BY     
     [BuildingUnit],    
     StockItemCode,    
     CASE WHEN @var_orderByBatch = 1 THEN    
      Batch    
     END ASC,    
     CASE WHEN @var_orderByBatch = 2 THEN    
      Batch    
     END DESC,    
     CASE WHEN @var_orderByDateReceived = 1 THEN    
      [DateReceived]    
     END ASC,    
     CASE WHEN @var_orderByDateReceived = 2 THEN    
      [DateReceived]    
      END DESC,    
     CASE WHEN @var_orderByBestBefore = 1 THEN     
      BestBefore    
     END ASC,    
     CASE WHEN @var_orderByBestBefore = 2 THEN     
      BestBefore    
     END DESC,    
CASE WHEN @var_orderByBatch = -1 THEN    
      Batch    
     END ASC    
   END    
    
   -- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end    
          
   BREAK    
  END TRY    
  BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */    
   DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;    
   SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;    
   SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;    
    
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY     
   BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;    
           
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;    
    
            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID    
                
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;    
                
   IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)    
   BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END    
   ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */    
  END CATCH    
  SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1    
 END    
END
GO

-- =============================================  
create PROCEDURE [dbo].[spReportsCompleteAndLoadedContainers]  
(  
    -- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here  
   @Division  nvarchar(50)  ,  
 @fromdate datetime,  
 @todate datetime  
)  
AS  
BEGIN  
 /* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */  
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED  
  
 drop table if exists #tmpdivisions
select divisionpk, divisioncode, DivisionName into #tmpdivisions from tbldivisions where DivisionPK in(@Division) 

 drop table if exists #tmpCompleteContainerOuts  
 select * into #tmpCompleteContainerOuts   
 from tblcontainerouts   
 where containeroutstatusfk=5 and(CONVERT(DATE, CollectionDate) >= @fromdate and CONVERT(DATE, CollectionDate) <= @todate)  

 drop table if exists #tmpcontaineroutlines
 select containeroutlinepk, containeroutfk, stockitemfk, col.free2, DivisionFK into #tmpcontaineroutlines
 from tblcontaineroutlines col 
 inner join #tmpCompleteContainerOuts on containeroutfk = containeroutpk
 inner join #tmpdivisions on divisionpk = divisionfk

 drop table if exists #tmpcolpc
 select containeroutlinepalletcontentpk, containeroutlinefk, palletfk, units into #tmpcolpc from tblContainerOutLinePalletContent inner join #tmpcontaineroutlines on ContainerOutLineFK = ContainerOutLinePK
   
 Select   
  goodsordernumber as [Goods Order Number],  
  divisionname as[Division],  
  cOuts.docketvalue1 as [REF 1],  
  cOuts.docketvalue2 as [REF 2],  
  cOuts.docketvalue3 as [Buyer Ref],   
  CONVERT(DATE, CollectionDate)    as [Delivery Date],  
  CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),CollectionDate,108) [Time],  
  containernumber as [Container Number],   
  sealnumber as [Seal Number],  
  lorrynumber as [Lorry Number],  
  TransportCompany as [Market Destination],  
  ShippingCompany AS [Shipping Company],  
  dt.DeliveryAddressType as[ Delivery Address Type],  
  cOuts.Address1 +', '+  
  cOuts.Address2 +', '+  
  cOuts.Address3 +', '+  
  cOuts.Address4 +', '+  
  cOuts.Address5 AS [Address],  
  count (distinct colpc.palletfk) as[Pallet Count],  
  sum(colpc.units) as [Unit Count],  
  CONVERT(DATE, @todate)   as [ToDate],  
  CONVERT(DATE, @fromdate) as [FromDate],  
  goodsordernumber as [Truck ID],
  CONVERT(DATE, cOuts.InsertedDate) OrderCreatedDate,
  CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),cOuts.InsertedDate,108) OrderCreatedTime
  
 from #tmpCompleteContainerOuts cOuts
  inner join #tmpcontaineroutlines cols on cOuts.ContainerOutPK = cols.ContainerOutFK       
  inner join #tmpcolpc colpc on   cols.ContainerOutLinePK = colpc.ContainerOutLineFK
  inner join  #tmpdivisions divs on  divs.divisionpk = cols.divisionfk  
  LEFT OUTER  join tbltransportcompanies tc on  tc.transportcompanypk = cOuts.transportcompanyfk  
  LEFT OUTER  JOIN tblShippingCompanies sc ON  sc.ShippingCompanyPK=cOuts.ShippingCompanyFK  
  inner join  appdeliveryaddresstypes dt on  dt.DeliveryAddressTypePK=cOuts.deliverytypefk  
   
 group by    
  goodsordernumber,  
  divisionname,  
  cOuts.docketvalue1  ,  
  cOuts.docketvalue2  ,  
  cOuts.docketvalue3 ,   
  CollectionDate  ,  
  containernumber ,   
  sealnumber  ,  
  lorrynumber  ,  
  TransportCompany  ,  
   ShippingCompany,  
  dt.DeliveryAddressType ,  
  cOuts.Address1, cOuts.Address2, cOuts.Address3, cOuts.Address4, cOuts.Address5,  
  cols.free2, cOuts.InsertedDate   
  
 order by CollectionDate asc   
end  
GO

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spReportsCompleteAndLoadedContainers_old]  
(  
    -- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here  
   @Division  nvarchar(50)  ,  
 @fromdate datetime,  
 @todate datetime  
)  
AS  
BEGIN  
 /* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */  
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED  
  
 drop table if exists #tmpCompleteContainerOuts  
 select * into #tmpCompleteContainerOuts   
 from tblcontainerouts   
 where containeroutstatusfk=5 and(CONVERT(DATE, CollectionDate) >= @fromdate and CONVERT(DATE, CollectionDate) <= @todate)  
   
 Select   
  goodsordernumber as [Goods Order Number],  
  divisionname as[Division],  
  cOuts.docketvalue1 as [REF 1],  
  cOuts.docketvalue2 as [REF 2],  
  cOuts.docketvalue3 as [Buyer Ref],   
  CONVERT(DATE, CollectionDate)    as [Delivery Date],  
  CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),CollectionDate,108) [Time],  
  containernumber as [Container Number],   
  sealnumber as [Seal Number],  
  lorrynumber as [Lorry Number],  
  TransportCompany as [Market Destination],  
  ShippingCompany AS [Shipping Company],  
  dt.DeliveryAddressType as[ Delivery Address Type],  
  da.Address1 +', '+  
  da.Address2 +', '+  
  da.Address3 +', '+  
  da.Address4 +', '+  
  da.Address5 AS [Address],  
  count (colpc.palletfk) as[Pallet Count],  
  sum(colpc.units) as [Unit Count],  
  CONVERT(DATE, @todate)   as [ToDate],  
  CONVERT(DATE, @fromdate) as [FromDate],  
  goodsordernumber as [Truck ID],
  CONVERT(DATE, cOuts.InsertedDate) OrderCreatedDate,
  CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),cOuts.InsertedDate,108) OrderCreatedTime
  
 from tblContainerOutLinePalletContent colpc  
  inner join tblContainerOutLines cols on cols.ContainerOutLinePK = colpc.ContainerOutLineFK  
  inner join #tmpCompleteContainerOuts cOuts on cOuts.ContainerOutPK = cols.ContainerOutFK  
  inner join tblPallets pals on pals.PalletPK = colpc.PalletFK  
  inner join tblPAlletContent pc on  pc.PAlletFK = pals.PAlletPK  
  inner join tblstockitems si on  si.stockitempk=cols.stockitemfk  
  LEFT OUTER  join tbltransportcompanies tc on  tc.transportcompanypk = cOuts.transportcompanyfk  
  LEFT OUTER  JOIN tblShippingCompanies sc ON  sc.ShippingCompanyPK=cOuts.ShippingCompanyFK  
  inner join  appdeliveryaddresstypes dt on  dt.DeliveryAddressTypePK=cOuts.deliverytypefk  
  inner join   tbldeliveryAddresses da on  da.deliveryaddresspk=cOuts.deliveryaddressfk  
  inner join  tbldivisions divs on  divs.divisionpk = si.divisionfk  
     
 where  --containeroutstatusfk=5 and   
   si.divisionfk in(@Division)  
   --and cOuts.updateddate>= dateadd(month, -1, dbo.GetBSTDate())  
   --and(CONVERT(DATE, CollectionDate) >= @fromdate and CONVERT(DATE, CollectionDate) <= @todate)  
   
 group by    
  goodsordernumber,  
  divisionname,  
  cOuts.docketvalue1  ,  
  cOuts.docketvalue2  ,  
  cOuts.docketvalue3 ,   
  CollectionDate  ,  
  containernumber ,   
  sealnumber  ,  
  lorrynumber  ,  
  TransportCompany  ,  
   ShippingCompany,  
  dt.DeliveryAddressType ,  
  da.Address1, da.Address2, da.Address3, da.Address4, da.Address5,  
  cols.free2, cOuts.InsertedDate   
  
 order by CollectionDate asc  
end  
GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[spReportsCompleteAndReceivedContainers]    Script Date: 02/11/2026 17:47:27 ******/

-- =============================================
-- Author:      <Author, , Name>
-- Create Date: <Create Date, , >
-- Description: <Description, , >
-- =============================================
create PROCEDURE [dbo].[spReportsCompleteAndReceivedContainers]
(
    -- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here
  	@Division  nvarchar(50) ,
	@fromdate datetime,
	@todate datetime
)
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED

	drop table if exists #tmpCompleteStockIns  
 select sins.stockinpk, sins.ContainerInFK 
 into #tmpCompleteStockIns   
 from tblcontainerins cins  
 inner join tblstockins sins on sins.containerinfk= cins.containerinpk  
 where sins.divisionfk in(@Division )  
   and cins.StockInStatusFK=3  
   and(CONVERT(DATE, Datein) >= @fromdate and CONVERT(DATE, Datein) <= @todate)  
  
 drop table if exists #tmpCompleteContainerIns  
 select cins.ContainerInPk, cins.GoodsInNumber, DateIn, ExternalReference, Free1, Free2, Free3,Free4, SealNumber, ContainerNumber, LorryNumber, SupplierFK, ShippingCompanyFK, TransportCompanyFK into #tmpCompleteContainerIns  
 from #tmpCompleteStockIns sins  
 inner join tblcontainerins cins on sins.containerinfk= cins.containerinpk 
 
 drop table if exists #tmpstockinlines
 select stockinlinepk, stockinfk, stockitemfk, units into #tmpstockinlines from tblstockinlines inner join #tmpCompleteStockIns on stockinfk = stockinpk

 drop table if exists #tmpstockinlinepallets
 select palletfk, stockinlinefk into #tmpstockinlinepallets from tblstockinlinepallets inner join #tmpstockinlines on stockinlinefk = stockinlinepk  

 drop table if exists #tmppallets
 select distinct palletpk into #tmppallets from tblpallets inner join #tmpstockinlinepallets on palletfk=  palletpk
  
 Select   
  cins.goodsinnumber as [Goods In Number],  
  divisionname as[Division] ,  
  CONVERT(DATE, DateIn) AS [Arrival Date],  
  cast(DateIn as time(0)) [Time],  
  su.Supplier AS [Supplier],  
  ttc.TransportCompany AS [Transport Company],  
  tsc.ShippingCompany AS [Shipping Company],  
  tsc.Address1 +', '+  
  tsc.Address2 +', '+  
  tsc.Address3 +', '+  
  tsc.Address4 +', '+  
  tsc.Address5 AS [Address],  
  cins.ExternalReference AS [External Reference],  
  cins.[Free2] AS [Ref 1],  
  cins.[Free4] AS [Ref 2],  
  cins.[SealNumber] AS [Seal Number],  
  cins.[ContainerNumber] AS [Container Number],  
  cins.[LorryNumber] AS [Lorry Number],  
  count(silp.palletfk) AS [Pallet Count],  
  sum(sils.Units) AS [Units],  
  @fromdate AS [FromDate],  
  @todate AS [ToDate],   
  cins.[LorryNumber] AS [Truck ID]  
  
 from #tmpCompleteContainerIns cins   
  inner join #tmpCompleteStockIns sins on sins.containerinfk= cins.containerinpk  
  inner join #tmpstockinlines sils on sils.stockinfk= sins.stockinpk  
  inner join #tmpstockinlinepallets silp on silp.StockInLineFK=sils.stockinlinepk   
  inner join tblPallets pals on pals.PalletPK = silp.PalletFK  
  inner join tblPAlletContent pc on pc.PAlletFK = pals.PAlletPK  
  inner join tblstockitems si on si.stockitempk=sils.stockitemfk  
  inner join  tblsuppliers su on su.SupplierPK=cins.supplierfk  
  inner join  tbldivisions divs on divs.divisionpk = si.divisionfk   
  LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.tblShippingCompanies tsc ON tsc.ShippingCompanyPK =cins.ShippingCompanyFK  
  LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.tblTransportCompanies ttc ON ttc.TransportCompanypk=cins.TransportCompanyFK  
  
 --where si.divisionfk in(@Division )  
 --  and cins.StockInStatusFK=3  
 --  and(CONVERT(DATE, Datein) >= @fromdate and CONVERT(DATE, Datein) <= @todate)  
 GROUP BY   
  cins.goodsinnumber,  
  divisionname,  
  DateIn,  
  DateIn,  
  su.Supplier,  
  ttc.TransportCompany,  
  tsc.ShippingCompany,  
  tsc.Address1, tsc.Address2, tsc.Address3, tsc.Address4, tsc.Address5,  
  cins.ExternalReference, cins.[Free2], cins.[Free4],  
  cins.[SealNumber],  
  cins.[ContainerNumber],  
  cins.[LorryNumber]   
  
 order by cins.DateIn asc  
end

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spReportsCompleteAndReceivedContainers_old]
(
    -- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here
  	@Division  nvarchar(50) ,
	@fromdate datetime,
	@todate datetime
)
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED

	drop table if exists #tmpCompleteStockIns
	select sins.* into #tmpCompleteStockIns 
	from tblcontainerins cins
	inner join tblstockins sins on sins.containerinfk= cins.containerinpk
	where sins.divisionfk in(@Division )
			and cins.StockInStatusFK=3
			and(CONVERT(DATE, Datein) >= @fromdate and CONVERT(DATE, Datein) <= @todate)

	drop table if exists #tmpCompleteContainerIns
	select cins.* into #tmpCompleteContainerIns
	from #tmpCompleteStockIns sins
	inner join tblcontainerins cins on sins.containerinfk= cins.containerinpk

	Select 
		cins.goodsinnumber as [Goods In Number],
		divisionname as[Division] ,
		CONVERT(DATE, DateIn) AS [Arrival Date],
		cast(DateIn as time(0)) [Time],
		su.Supplier AS [Supplier],
		ttc.TransportCompany AS [Transport Company],
		tsc.ShippingCompany AS [Shipping Company],
		tsc.Address1 +', '+
		tsc.Address2 +', '+
		tsc.Address3 +', '+
		tsc.Address4 +', '+
		tsc.Address5 AS [Address],
		cins.ExternalReference AS [External Reference],
		cins.[Free2] AS [Ref 1],
		cins.[Free4] AS [Ref 2],
		cins.[SealNumber] AS [Seal Number],
		cins.[ContainerNumber] AS [Container Number],
		cins.[LorryNumber] AS [Lorry Number],
		count(silp.palletfk) AS [Pallet Count],
		sum(sils.Units) AS [Units],
		@fromdate AS [FromDate],
		@todate AS [ToDate],	
		cins.[LorryNumber] AS [Truck ID]

	from #tmpCompleteContainerIns cins 
		inner join #tmpCompleteStockIns sins on sins.containerinfk= cins.containerinpk
		inner join tblstockinlines sils on sils.stockinfk= sins.stockinpk
		inner join tblstockinlinepallets silp on silp.StockInLineFK=sils.stockinlinepk 
		inner join tblPallets pals on pals.PalletPK = silp.PalletFK
		inner join tblPAlletContent pc on pc.PAlletFK = pals.PAlletPK
		inner join tblstockitems si on si.stockitempk=sils.stockitemfk
		inner join  tblsuppliers su on su.SupplierPK=cins.supplierfk
		inner join  tbldivisions divs on divs.divisionpk = si.divisionfk 
		LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.tblShippingCompanies tsc ON tsc.ShippingCompanyPK =cins.ShippingCompanyFK
		LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.tblTransportCompanies ttc ON ttc.TransportCompanypk=cins.TransportCompanyFK

	--where si.divisionfk in(@Division )
	--		and cins.StockInStatusFK=3
	--		and(CONVERT(DATE, Datein) >= @fromdate and CONVERT(DATE, Datein) <= @todate)
	GROUP BY 
		cins.goodsinnumber,
		divisionname,
		DateIn,
		DateIn,
		su.Supplier,
		ttc.TransportCompany,
		tsc.ShippingCompany,
		tsc.Address1, tsc.Address2, tsc.Address3, tsc.Address4, tsc.Address5,
		cins.ExternalReference, cins.[Free2], cins.[Free4],
		cins.[SealNumber],
		cins.[ContainerNumber],
		cins.[LorryNumber] 

	order by cins.DateIn asc
end

-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spReportsContainerOutLabel]
(
	@stockOrderFK int
)	
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data; Ensure this proc has a low impact when executed */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED; SET DEADLOCK_PRIORITY LOW

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT
	,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;
	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	DECLARE @var_stockOrderFK int
	SET @var_stockOrderFK = @stockOrderFK
	SET @ParameterDetails = '@stockOrderFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_stockOrderFK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'')

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    --BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

		SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END


	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY
			

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start

			Declare @customerReference nvarchar(300)
			Declare @customerReferenceSQL nvarchar(MAX)
			Declare @customerFK int
			Declare @containerOutFK int

				--- to find customer reference-------
			Select Top 1 @customerFK = divs.CustomerFK, @containerOutFK = cols.ContainerOutFK
			from tblStockOrders sos
			inner join tblContainerOutLines cols on
			cols.ContainerOutFK = sos.ContainerOutFK
			inner join tblDivisions divs on
			divs.DivisionPK = cols.DivisionFK
			Where sos.StockOrderPK = @var_stockOrderFK

			Print 'Customer'
			Print @customerFK

			IF(Exists(Select * from tblCustomerDocketIdentifications where CustomerFK = @customerFK and DocketTypeFK = 2/*Order*/))
			BEGIN
				Print 'Tag1'

				IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#tblCustomerReference') IS NOT NULL
					DROP TABLE #tblCustomerReference

				CREATE TABLE #tblCustomerReference(CustomerReference nvarchar(300))

				Select @customerReferenceSQL = 'Insert into #tblCustomerReference Select ''' + 
				cdis.Prefix + ''' + ' +  fields.FieldName + ' from ' + fields.ObjectTable + ' Where ' + 
				fields.PrimaryKeyField + ' = ' + cast(@containerOutFK as nvarchar(50)) 
				from tblCustomerDocketIdentifications cdis 
				inner join appFields fields on
				fields.FieldPK = cdis.FieldFK
				where CustomerFK = @customerFK AND cdis.DocketTypeFK = 2/*out*/

				Print @customerReferenceSQL

				EXEC(@customerReferenceSQL)

				Select @customerReference = (Select Top 1 CustomerReference from #tblCustomerReference)
			END 
			ELSE
				Set @customerReference = ''

			/*------------------------------------------------*/
	
			SELECT  @customerReference as Reference,
			'STACO-' + cast(ContainerOutPK as nvarchar(100)) as ContainerOutPK,
			GoodsOrderNumber,
			ContainerNumber, 
			LorryNumber,
			SealNumber,
			con.Address1 as Destination,
			(Select TransportCompany from tblTransportCompanies where TransportCompanyPK=con.TransportCompanyFK) as [TransportCompany],
			(Select ShippingCompany from tblShippingCompanies where ShippingCompanyPK=con.ShippingCompanyFK) as [ShippingCompany],			
			isnull(LoadingBay,'') as LoadingBay,
			case WHEN noOfPallets IS NULL THEN '0' when noOfPallets = 0 then '0' else cast(noOfPallets as nvarchar(50)) end as Pallets,
			con.Weight
				
			from tblStockOrders so
			inner join tblContainerOuts con on
			con.ContainerOutPK = so.ContainerOutFK
			left outer join tblLoadingBays lbs on
			lbs.LoadingBayPK = so.PickupLoadingBayFK
			
			left outer join(
				select so.ContainerOutFK, count(DISTINCT palletfk) as noOfPallets
				from tblStockOrders so
				inner join tblContainerOutLines cols on
				cols.ContainerOutFK = so.ContainerOutFK 
				inner join tblContainerOutLinePalletContent colpc on
				colpc.ContainerOutLineFK = cols.ContainerOutLinePK
				where so.StockOrderPK = @var_stockOrderFK
				AND colpc.PalletFK > 0 -- AND colpc.Pallets > 0
				Group By so.ContainerOutFK
			)  tblPalCo	on 
			tblPalCo.ContainerOutFK = so.ContainerOutFK
			
			WHERE so.StockOrderPK = @var_stockOrderFK
	
			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end

			
			
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END

-- =============================================

-- =============================================  
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spReportsCreditNote]  
(  
 @creditNoteFK int  
)   
AS  
BEGIN  
 /* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data; Ensure this proc has a low impact when executed */  
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED; SET DEADLOCK_PRIORITY LOW  
  
    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT  
 ,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;  
 SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();  
  
 -- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters  
 DECLARE @var_creditNoteFK int  
 SET @var_creditNoteFK = @creditNoteFK  
 SET @ParameterDetails = '@creditNoteFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_creditNoteFK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'')  
  
    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL   
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)  
  
    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)  
    --BEGIN  
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC   
  
  SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)  
  
        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)  
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK  
  
        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()  
    --END  
  
  
 SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);  
 SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails  
 ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;  
 INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()  
  
 WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3  
 BEGIN   
  BEGIN TRY  
     
  
   -- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start  
  
   Declare @customerFK int  
   Declare @divisionFK int  
   Select @divisionFK = DivisionFK, @customerFK = CustomerFK from tblCreditNotes where CreditNotePK = @var_creditNoteFK  
  
   DECLARE  @NumberTaxRate int  
   SET @NumberTaxRate = (SELECT Count(Distinct(TaxRate))   
          FROM tblCreditNoteLines  
          Where CreditNoteFK = @var_creditNoteFK)  
  
   -- DG @invoiceTypeFK TO BE SCHEDULED_INVOICE. Used when retreiving Last Invoice Date.  
   Declare @invoiceTypeFK int  
   SET @invoiceTypeFK = 3 -- Scheduled Invoice  
  
   Select 'Credit Note' ReportType,  
   --'Credit Note Number: ' + creditNotes.CreditNoteNumber InvoiceNumber,  
   creditNotes.CreditNoteNumber InvoiceNumber,  
   creditNotes.CreditToDate InvoiceToDate,  
   creditNoteLines.CreditNoteLineText ChargeText,  
   creditNotes.Tax,    
   creditNoteLines.TaxRate,  
  
   -- DG Invoicing Release  
   (creditNotes.CreditNoteValue + creditNotes.Tax) as GrandTotal,  
   @NumberTaxRate  as NumberOfTaxRates,  
  
   creditNoteLines.CreditNoteLineValue Charge,  
  
   case when creditNotes.DivisionFK = -1 then customers.CustomerName else divisions.DivisionName end as DivisionName,  
   case when creditNotes.DivisionFK = -1 then customers.Address1 else divisions.Address1 end as Address1,  
   case when creditNotes.DivisionFK = -1 then customers.Address1 else divisions.Address2 end as Address2,  
   case when creditNotes.DivisionFK = -1 then customers.Address3 else divisions.Address3 end as Address3,  
   case when creditNotes.DivisionFK = -1 then customers.Address4 else divisions.Address4 end as Address4,  
   case when creditNotes.DivisionFK = -1 then customers.Address5 else divisions.Address5 end as Address5,  
   invoiceContacts.ContactName AttentionOf,  
   case when creditNotes.DivisionFK = -1 then customers.InvoiceAuthorisationCode else divisions.InvoiceAuthorisationCode end as InvoiceAuthorisationCode,  
   case when creditNotes.DivisionFK = -1 then customers.CustomInvoiceTitle else divisions.CustomInvoiceTitle end as CustomInvoiceTitle,  
   '' as CustomInvoiceValue,  
   system.DocketHeaderLine1,  
   system.DocketHeaderLine2,  
   system.DocketHeaderLine3,  
   system.DocketFooterPart1,  
   system.DocketFooterPart2Line1,  
   system.DocketFooterPart2Line2,  
   system.DocketFooterPart2Line3,  
   system.DocketFooterPart2Line4,  
   currencies.CurrencySymbol,  
   case when creditNotes.DivisionFK = -1 then customers.PaymentTerms else divisions.PaymentTerms end as PaymentTerms,  
   lastInvoice.InvoiceToDate as LastInvoiceDate  
   
   from tblCreditNotes creditNotes  
   inner join tblCreditNoteLines creditNoteLines on  
   creditNoteLines.CreditNoteFK = creditNotes.CreditNotePK  
   left outer join tblDivisions divisions on  
   divisions.DivisionPK = creditNotes.DivisionFK  
   left outer join tblCustomers customers on  
   customers.CustomerPK = creditNotes.CustomerFK  
   left outer join tblContacts invoiceContacts ON   
    (customers.invoicebycustomer = 1 and invoiceContacts.ContactPK = divisions.InvoiceContactFK) OR (customers.invoicebycustomer = 0 and invoiceContacts.ContactPK = customers.InvoiceContactFK)     
   inner join appSystem system on  
   1=1  
   inner join tblCurrencies currencies on  
   currencies.CurrencyPK = system.InvoiceCurrencyFK  
   left outer join (  
    Select Top 1 InvoiceToDate from tblInvoices  
    Where (@divisionFK > 0 and DivisionFK = @divisionFK ) OR CustomerFK = @customerFK  
    AND InvoicePK not in (Select Top 1 InvoicePK   
           From tblInvoices   
           Where ((@divisionFK > 0 and DivisionFK = @divisionFK ) OR CustomerFK = @customerFK) AND   
                 InvoiceTypeFK = @invoiceTypeFK    
           Order By InvoiceToDate Desc)  
    order by InvoiceToDate Desc  
   ) lastInvoice on  
   1=1  
   where creditNotes.CreditNotePK = @var_creditNoteFK  
  
   -- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end  
  
     
     
   BREAK  
  END TRY  
  BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */  
   DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;  
   SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;  
   SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;  
  
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY   
   BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;  
         
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;  
  
            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID  
              
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;  
              
   IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)  
   BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END  
   ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */  
  END CATCH  
  SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1  
 END  
END

-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>

-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spReportsCurrentStockClient]
(
	@divisionFKs nvarchar(500),
	@stockItemFK int = -1,
	@batch nvarchar(300) = ''
)	
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data; Ensure this proc has a low impact when executed */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED; SET DEADLOCK_PRIORITY LOW

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT
	,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;
	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	DECLARE @var_divisionFKs nvarchar(500), @var_stockItemFK int, @var_batch nvarchar(300)

	SET @var_divisionFKs = @divisionFKs; SET @var_stockItemFK = @stockItemFK; SET @var_batch = @batch

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start
			DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #tmpDivisions
			SELECT * into #tmpDivisions from tblDivisions where (',' + @var_divisionFKs +',' LIKE '%,' + CONVERT(VARCHAR, DivisionPK) + ',%')

			into #tblPalletContent
			From #tmpDivisions divs
			inner join tblStockItems sis ON sis.DivisionFK = divs.DivisionPK
			inner join tblUnitTypes unitTypes on unitTypes.UnitTypePK = sis.UnitTypeFK
			inner join tblPalletContent pc ON pc.StockItemFK = sis.StockItemPK AND pc.IsArchived = 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/
			inner join tblPallets pals ON pals.PalletPK = pc.PalletFK AND pals.IsArchived = 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/
			WHERE (@var_stockItemFK = -1 OR @var_stockItemFK = StockItemPK) AND (@var_batch = '' OR @var_batch = Batch) 
			
			DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #tmpOKStock
			Select StockItemFK, Batch, count(*) Pallets, sum(ActualUnits) ActualUnits, sum(AvailableUnits) AvailableUnits 
			INTO #tmpOKStock
			from (
				Select StockItemFK, Batch, PalletPK, sum(ActualUnits) ActualUnits, sum(AvailableUnits) AvailableUnits
				from #tblPalletContent pc
				Where pc.PalletStatusFK <> 10
				Group By StockItemFK, Batch, PalletPK
			) subQ
			Group By StockItemFK, Batch
						
			DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #tmpNotOKStock
			Select StockItemFK, Batch, count(*) Pallets, sum(ActualUnits) ActualUnits, sum(AvailableUnits) AvailableUnits 
			INTO #tmpNotOKStock
			from (
				Select StockItemFK, Batch, PalletPK, sum(ActualUnits) ActualUnits, sum(AvailableUnits) AvailableUnits
				from #tblPalletContent pc
				Where pc.PalletStatusFK <> 1 /*Available*/ AND pc.PalletStatusFK <> 10
				Group By StockItemFK, Batch, PalletPK
			) subQ
			Group By StockItemFK, Batch

			DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #tmpOnRouteStock
			Select StockItemFK, Batch, count(*) Pallets, sum(ActualUnits) ActualUnits, sum(AvailableUnits) AvailableUnits 
			INTO #tmpOnRouteStock
			from (
				Select StockItemFK, Batch, PalletPK, sum(ActualUnits) ActualUnits, sum(AvailableUnits) AvailableUnits
				from #tblPalletContent pc
				Where pc.PalletStatusFK = 10
				Group By StockItemFK, Batch, PalletPK
			) subQ
			Group By StockItemFK, Batch

			DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #tmpBatches
			Select Distinct StockItemFK, Batch, StockItemCode, Abbreviation, DivisionName,ExpiryDate
			INTO #tmpBatches
			from #tblPalletContent
					
			Select DivisionName, StockItemCode, Abbreviation, Batch, Pallets, AvailableUnits, UnitsOnOrder, HeldPallets, EnRoutePallets,ExpiryDate
			from (
				Select DivisionName, bat.StockItemFK, StockItemCode, Abbreviation, bat.Batch
					,sum(isnull(okStock.Pallets, 0)) Pallets 
					,sum(isnull(okStock.AvailableUnits, 0)) AvailableUnits 
					,sum(isnull(okStock.ActualUnits, 0)) - sum(isnull(okStock.AvailableUnits, 0)) UnitsOnOrder
					,sum(isnull(notOkStock.Pallets, 0)) [HeldPallets]
					,sum(isnull(enrouteStock.Pallets, 0)) [EnRoutePallets]
					,ExpiryDate
				from #tmpBatches bat
				left outer join #tmpOKStock okStock on okStock.StockItemFK = bat.StockItemFK AND okStock.Batch = bat.Batch
				left outer join #tmpNotOKStock notOkStock ON notOkStock.StockItemFK = bat.StockItemFK AND notOkStock.Batch = bat.Batch
				left outer join #tmpOnRouteStock enrouteStock ON enrouteStock.StockItemFK = bat.StockItemFK AND enrouteStock.Batch = bat.Batch
				Group By DivisionName, bat.StockItemFK, StockItemCode, bat.Batch, Abbreviation	,ExpiryDate
			)subQ
			Where (Pallets > 0 OR AvailableUnits > 0 OR UnitsOnOrder > 0 OR HeldPallets > 0)			
			Order BY subQ.DivisionName, StockItemCode, batch,ExpiryDate

		--	inner join tblStockItems sis on

		--	inner join tblPalletContent pc on

		--	AND pc.IsArchived = 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/

		--	from (Select * from tblDivisions where (',' + @divisionFKs +',' LIKE '%,' + CONVERT(VARCHAR, DivisionPK) + ',%')) divs
		--	inner join tblStockItems sis on

			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY

			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spReportsCurrentStockLevels]
(
	@divisionFK int,
	@stockItemFK int = -1,
	@batch nvarchar(200) = ''
)	
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data; Ensure this proc has a low impact when executed */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED; SET DEADLOCK_PRIORITY LOW

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT
	,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;
	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	DECLARE @var_divisionFK int, @var_stockItemFK int, @var_batch nvarchar(200)

	SET @var_divisionFK = ISNULL(@divisionFK,-1);
	SET @var_stockItemFK = ISNULL(@stockItemFK,-1); SET @var_batch = ISNULL(@batch,'')

	SET @ParameterDetails = '@divisionFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_divisionFK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@stockItemFK = ' 
		+ ISNULL(CAST(@var_stockItemFK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@batch = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_batch AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'')

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    --BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

		SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END

	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY
			
			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start

			DECLARE @divisionName nvarchar(50)
			DECLARE @divisionCode nvarchar(50)
			Select @divisionName = DivisionName, @divisionCode = divisioncode from tblDivisions Where DivisionPK = @var_divisionFK

			if object_id('tempdb..#AllStock') is not null 
				drop table #AllStock

			SELECT tpc.PalletFK, tpc.StockItemFK, tsi.StockItemCode, tsi.Description as StockDescription, tpc.Batch, 
			Convert(date, tpc.ExpiryDate) ExpiryDate, Convert(date, tpc.DateOfManufacture) DateOfManufacture, Convert(date, tpc.BestBefore) BestBefore, Convert(int, sum(tpc.ActualUnits)) Units
			INTO #AllStock
			FROM dbo.tblPalletContent tpc
			INNER JOIN dbo.tblStockItems tsi ON tpc.StockItemFK = tsi.StockItemPK AND tsi.DivisionFk = @var_divisionFK
			WHERE ((@var_StockItemFK = -1 AND 1=1) OR tpc.StockItemFK = @var_StockItemFK)
				AND ((@var_Batch = '' AND 1=1) OR tpc.Batch LIKE '%' +  @var_Batch + '%')
			GROUP BY tpc.PalletFK, tpc.StockItemFK, StockItemCode, tsi.Description, tpc.Batch, tpc.ExpiryDate, tpc.DateOfManufacture, tpc.BestBefore

			if object_id('tempdb..#bookedInStockDetail') is not null 
				drop table #bookedInStockDetail

			SELECT tsilp.PalletFK, tsil.StockItemFK, tsil.Batch, 
			Convert(date, tsil.ExpiryDate) ExpiryDate, Convert(date, tsil.DateOfManufacture) DateOfManufacture, Convert(date, tsil.BestBefore) BestBefore, Convert(int, SUM(tsil.Units)) Units, tpa.EventDate
			INTO #bookedInStockDetail
			FROM dbo.tblStockInLinePallets tsilp
			INNER JOIN dbo.tblStockInLines tsil ON tsil.StockInLinepK = tsilp.StockInLineFK
			INNER JOIN dbo.tblStockIns tsi ON tsi.StockInPK = tsil.StockInFK AND tsi.StockInStatusFK = 3
			INNER JOIN dbo.tblPalletAudit tpa	ON tsilp.PalletFK = tpa.PalletFK AND tpa.EventTypeFK = 1
			WHERE divisionfk = @var_divisionFK
				and ((@var_StockItemFK = -1 AND 1=1) OR tsil.StockItemFK = @var_StockItemFK)
				AND ((@var_Batch = '' AND 1=1) OR tsil.Batch like '%' +  @var_Batch + '%')
			GROUP BY tsilp.PalletFK, tsil.StockItemFK,  tsil.Batch, tsil.ExpiryDate, tsil.DateOfManufacture, tsil.BestBefore, tpa.EventDate

			if object_id('tempdb..#CurrentStockDetail') is not null 
				drop table #CurrentStockDetail

			SELECT bisd.PalletFK, bisd.StockItemFK, tas.StockItemCode, tas.StockDescription, bisd.Batch, bisd.ExpiryDate, bisd.DateOfManufacture, bisd.BestBefore, tas.Units
			INTO #CurrentStockDetail
			FROM #AllStock tas
			INNER JOIN #bookedInStockDetail bisd ON tas.PalletFK = bisd.PalletFK
			WHERE tas.Units > 0

			if object_id('tempdb..#CurrentStockSummary') is NOT null 
				drop table #CurrentStockSummary

			SELECT StockItemFK, StockItemCode, StockDescription, Batch, ExpiryDate, DateOfManufacture, BestBefore, Units AS PerPallet, count(Units) AS PalletCount, Units*count(Units) AS Units
			INTO #CurrentStockSummary
			FROM #CurrentStockDetail tas
			GROUP BY StockItemFK, StockItemCode, StockDescription, Batch, ExpiryDate, DateOfManufacture, BestBefore, Units

			SELECT @divisionName AS DivisionName, @divisionCode AS DivisionCode, Convert(Date, dbo.GetBSTDate()) AS RunDate, stockItemCode, StockDescription, batch,  
			case when ExpiryDate = '19000101' THEN NULL ELSE ExpiryDate END AS ExpiryDate, 
			case when DateOfManufacture = '19000101' THEN NULL ELSE DateOfManufacture END AS DateOfManufacture, 
			case when BestBefore = '19000101' THEN NULL ELSE BestBefore END AS BestBefore,
			PerPallet, PalletCount, Units
			FROM #CurrentStockSummary

			
			
			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end
						
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END
