 SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails          
 ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;          
 INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()          
          
 WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3          
 BEGIN           
  BEGIN TRY             
          
   -- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start          
          
   DECLARE @customerFK INT           
          
   SELECT TOP 1 @customerFK = CustomerFK FROM tblInvoices WHERE InvoicePK = @var_invoiceFK          
          
   -- This code is required when previewing an existing invoice to find out           
   -- if the Group By Category option was checked when the invoice was created.          
   IF @var_groupByCategory <> 1          
    SELECT @var_groupByCategory = ISNULL(GroupByCategory,0) FROM tblInvoices WHERE invoicePK = @var_invoiceFK          
          
   DECLARE  @NumberTaxRate int          
   SET @NumberTaxRate = (SELECT Count(Distinct(TaxRate))           
          FROM tblInvoiceLines          
          Where InvoiceFK = @var_invoiceFK)          
          
   -- DG TO Distinguish @invoiceType, Scheduled Or InAdvance          
   Declare @invoiceTypeFK int          
   Select @invoiceTypeFK = InvoiceTypeFK from tblInvoices where InvoicePK = @var_invoiceFK        
          
   IF ISNULL(@var_groupByCategory, 0) <> 1          
   BEGIN          
    -- NON-GROUPED INVOICE LINES          
    SELECT           
     'Invoice:' AS ReportType,           
     --'Invoice Number: ' + invoices.InvoiceNumber AS InvoiceNumber,          
     invoices.InvoiceNumber,           
     invoiceLines.InvoiceLinePK,          
     invoices.InvoiceToDate,             
     -- Concatenate Department and NominalCode into ChargeText        
     CONCAT(  
    COALESCE(invoiceLines.ChargeText, ''),  
  
    CASE   
        WHEN invoices.Approved = 0 AND (ISNULL(NULLIF(d.DepartmentName, ''), buildings.BuildingName) IS NOT NULL OR d.DepartmentCode IS NOT NULL) THEN  
            ' ' +   
            COALESCE(NULLIF(d.DepartmentName, ''), buildings.BuildingName, '') +  
            CASE   
                WHEN d.DepartmentCode IS NOT NULL AND d.DepartmentCode <> '' THEN  
                    ' [' + d.DepartmentCode + ']'  
                ELSE ''  
            END  
        ELSE ''  
    END,  
  
    CASE   
        WHEN invoices.Approved = 0 AND (lineType.InvoiceLineType IS NOT NULL OR invoiceLines.NominalCode IS NOT NULL AND invoiceLines.NominalCode <> '') THEN  
            ' ' +   
            COALESCE(lineType.InvoiceLineType, '') +  
            CASE   
                WHEN invoiceLines.NominalCode IS NOT NULL AND invoiceLines.NominalCode <> '' THEN  
                    ' [' + invoiceLines.NominalCode + ']'  
                ELSE ''  
            END  
        ELSE ''  
    END  
) AS ChargeText,  
    
     invoiceLines.ChargeText1,          
     invoiceLines.ChargeText2,          
     REPLACE(invoiceLines.ChargeText3, '@ ', '') AS ChargeText3,          
     invoiceLines.ChargeText4,          
              
     --CASE WHEN vatCodes.VatCodePK = 5 THEN 0 ELSE invoiceLines.Tax END AS Tax,          
     --CASE WHEN vatCodes.VatCodePK = 5 THEN 0 ELSE invoiceLines.TaxRate END AS TaxRate,          
          
     -- DG #Dev-740          
     Case when vatCodes.VatCodePK = 5 then 0 else invoiceLines.TaxRate end as TaxRate,          
     Case when vatCodes.VatCodePK = 5 then 0 else invoices.Tax end as Tax,          
               
     (invoices.Charge + invoices.Tax) as GrandTotal,          
     @NumberTaxRate  as NumberOfTaxRates,          
          
     invoiceLines.Charge,          
     divisions.DivisionName,          
     divisions.DivisionCode,          
     customers.CustomerName,          
     customers.Address1,          
     customers.Address2,          
     customers.Address3,          
     customers.Address4,          
     customers.Address5,          
     invoiceContacts.ContactName AS AttentionOf,          
     customers.InvoiceAuthorisationCode,          
     customers.CustomInvoiceTitle,          
     invoices.CustomInvoiceValue,          
     [system].DocketHeaderLine1,          
     [system].DocketHeaderLine2,          
     [system].DocketHeaderLine3,          
     [system].DocketFooterPart1,          
     [system].DocketFooterPart2Line1,          
     [system].DocketFooterPart2Line2,          
     [system].DocketFooterPart2Line3,          
     [system].DocketFooterPart2Line4,          
     currencies.CurrencySymbol,          
     customers.PaymentTerms,          
     lastInvoice.InvoiceToDate AS LastInvoiceDate,          
     buildings.BuildingName + ' - ' + bu.BuildingUnit AS BuildingUnit,          
          
     CASE           
      WHEN vatCodes.VatCodePK = 5 THEN           
       'False'           
      ELSE           
       'True'           
     END AS [DisplayVATOnInvoice],          
     NULL AS StockItemCategory,          
     0 AS GroupByCategory,          
     NULL AS StockItemCategorySubGroup,          
     NULL AS StockItemCategorySubGroupItemsSort          
           
   FROM tblInvoices AS invoices          
    INNER JOIN tblInvoiceLines AS invoiceLines          
     ON invoiceLines.InvoiceFK = invoices.InvoicePK             
    INNER JOIN appInvoiceLineTypes lineType         
     ON invoiceLines.InvoiceLineTypeFK=lineType.InvoiceLineTypePK        
 LEFT JOIN tblDepartments d         
     ON invoiceLines.DepartmentFK = d.DepartmentPK         
    LEFT OUTER JOIN tblDivisions AS divisions          
     ON divisions.DivisionPK = invoiceLines.DivisionFK          
    INNER JOIN tblCustomers AS customers          
     ON customers.CustomerPK = invoices.CustomerFK          
    LEFT OUTER JOIN tblContacts AS invoiceContacts          
     ON invoiceContacts.ContactPK = customers.InvoiceContactFK          
    INNER JOIN appSystem AS [system]          
     ON 1=1          
    INNER JOIN tblCurrencies AS [currencies]          
     ON currencies.CurrencyPK = [system].InvoiceCurrencyFK          
    LEFT OUTER JOIN (          
         SELECT MAX(InvoiceToDate) AS InvoiceToDate          
         FROM tblInvoices          
         WHERE CustomerFK = @customerFK          
         AND InvoicePK < @var_invoiceFK          
         AND InvoiceTypeFK = @invoiceTypeFK          
          
          
         --SELECT TOP 1 InvoiceToDate FROM tblInvoices          
         --Where CustomerFK = @customerFK          
         --AND InvoicePK not in (SELECT TOP 1 InvoicePK FROM tblInvoices WHERE CustomerFK = @customerFK ORDER BY InvoiceToDate DESC)          
         --ORDER BY InvoiceToDate DESC          
        ) AS lastInvoice          
  ON 1=1          
    LEFT OUTER JOIN tblBuildingUnits AS bu           
     ON invoiceLines.buildingunitfk = bu.buildingunitpk          
    LEFT OUTER JOIN tblBuildings AS buildings           
     ON bu.buildingfk = buildings.buildingpk          
    LEFT OUTER JOIN tblVatCodes AS vatCodes          
     ON invoiceLines.VatCodeFK = vatCodes.VatCodePK            
    WHERE           
     invoices.InvoicePK = @var_invoiceFK          
   END          
   ELSE          
   BEGIN            
   -- GROUPED INVOICE LINES          
    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#tblExtraServices') IS NOT NULL          
     DROP TABLE #tblExtraServices          
               
    SELECT DISTINCT invoiceLines.divisionfk, invoiceLines.ChargeText, extraServices.Reference AS Reference           
    INTO #tblExtraServices          
    FROM tblInvoiceLines AS invoiceLines          
    INNER JOIN tblDivisionExtraServices as divisionExtraServices           
    ON invoiceLines.divisionfk = divisionExtraServices.divisionfk          
    INNER JOIN tblExtraServices as extraServices           
    ON divisionExtraServices.DivisionExtraServicePK = extraServices.DivisionExtraServiceFK          
    AND CHARINDEX(extraServices.Reference, invoiceLines.ChargeText) > 0           
    WHERE invoiceLines.InvoiceFK = @var_invoiceFK            
          
            
    SELECT          
     'Invoice' AS ReportType,           
     --'Invoice Number: ' + invoices.InvoiceNumber AS InvoiceNumber,          
     invoices.InvoiceNumber,          
     invoiceLines.InvoiceLinePK,          
     invoices.InvoiceToDate,         
      -- Concatenate Department and NominalCode into ChargeText        
     CONCAT(  
    COALESCE(invoiceLines.ChargeText, ''),  
  
    CASE   
        WHEN invoices.Approved = 0 AND (ISNULL(NULLIF(d.DepartmentName, ''), buildings.BuildingName) IS NOT NULL OR d.DepartmentCode IS NOT NULL) THEN  
            ' ' +   
            COALESCE(NULLIF(d.DepartmentName, ''), buildings.BuildingName, '') +  
            CASE   
                WHEN d.DepartmentCode IS NOT NULL AND d.DepartmentCode <> '' THEN  
                    ' [' + d.DepartmentCode + ']'  
                ELSE ''  
            END  
        ELSE ''  
    END,  
  
    CASE   
        WHEN invoices.Approved = 0 AND (lineType.InvoiceLineType IS NOT NULL OR invoiceLines.NominalCode IS NOT NULL AND invoiceLines.NominalCode <> '') THEN  
            ' ' +   
            COALESCE(lineType.InvoiceLineType, '') +  
            CASE   
                WHEN invoiceLines.NominalCode IS NOT NULL AND invoiceLines.NominalCode <> '' THEN  
                    ' [' + invoiceLines.NominalCode + ']'  
                ELSE ''  
            END  
        ELSE ''  
    END  
) AS ChargeText,  
     invoiceLines.ChargeText1,  
     invoiceLines.ChargeText2,  
     REPLACE(invoiceLines.ChargeText3, '@ ', '') AS ChargeText3,  
     invoiceLines.ChargeText4,  
        
              
     --CASE WHEN vatCodes.VatCodePK = 5 THEN 0 ELSE invoiceLines.Tax END AS Tax,          
     --CASE WHEN vatCodes.VatCodePK = 5 THEN 0 ELSE invoiceLines.TaxRate END AS TaxRate,          
          
     -- DG #Dev-740          
     Case when vatCodes.VatCodePK = 5 then 0 else invoiceLines.TaxRate end as TaxRate,          
     Case when vatCodes.VatCodePK = 5 then 0 else invoices.Tax end as Tax,          
     --invoices.Charge As TotalCharge,          
               
     (invoices.Charge + invoices.Tax) as GrandTotal,          
     @NumberTaxRate As NumberOfTaxRates,          
     --Count(Distinct(invoiceLines.TaxRate)) As NumberOfTaxRates,          
          
     invoiceLines.Charge,          
     divisions.DivisionName,          
     divisions.DivisionCode,          
     customers.CustomerName,          
     customers.Address1,          
     customers.Address2,          
     customers.Address3,          
     customers.Address4,          
     customers.Address5,          
     invoiceContacts.ContactName AS AttentionOf,          
     customers.InvoiceAuthorisationCode,          
     customers.CustomInvoiceTitle,          
     invoices.CustomInvoiceValue,          
     [system].DocketHeaderLine1,          
     [system].DocketHeaderLine2,          
     [system].DocketHeaderLine3,          
     [system].DocketFooterPart1,          
     [system].DocketFooterPart2Line1,          
     [system].DocketFooterPart2Line2,          
     [system].DocketFooterPart2Line3,          
     [system].DocketFooterPart2Line4,          
     currencies.CurrencySymbol,          
     customers.PaymentTerms,          
     lastInvoice.InvoiceToDate AS LastInvoiceDate,          
     buildings.BuildingName + ' - ' + bu.BuildingUnit AS BuildingUnit,          
          
     CASE           
      WHEN vatCodes.VatCodePK = 5 THEN           
       'False'           
      ELSE           
       'True'           
     END AS [DisplayVATOnInvoice],         
     'Category: ' + MAX(CASE WHEN CHARINDEX(sic.StockItemCategory, invoiceLines.ChargeText) > 0 THEN sic.StockItemCategory ELSE '' END) AS StockItemCategory,          
     1 AS GroupByCategory,          
     CASE           
      WHEN invoiceLines.ChargeText LIKE 'Storage Charges On%' OR invoiceLines.ChargeText LIKE 'Handling In Charges%' OR invoiceLines.ChargeText LIKE 'Handling Out Charges%' OR invoiceLines.ChargeText LIKE 'Retainer%' THEN          
       1          
      ELSE          
       2          
     END AS StockItemCategorySubGroup,          
          
     CASE           
      WHEN invoiceLines.ChargeText LIKE 'Storage Charges On%' THEN          
       1          
      WHEN invoiceLines.ChargeText LIKE 'Handling In Charges%' THEN          
       2          
      WHEN invoiceLines.ChargeText LIKE 'Handling Out Charges%' THEN          
       3          
      ELSE          
       4          
     END AS StockItemCategorySubGroupItemsSort,          
     extraServices.Reference          
    FROM tblInvoices AS invoices          
    INNER JOIN tblInvoiceLines AS invoiceLines          
     ON invoiceLines.InvoiceFK = invoices.InvoicePK         
 INNER JOIN appInvoiceLineTypes lineType         
     ON invoiceLines.InvoiceLineTypeFK=lineType.InvoiceLineTypePK        
 LEFT JOIN tblDepartments d         
     ON invoiceLines.DepartmentFK = d.DepartmentPK         
    LEFT OUTER JOIN tblDivisions AS divisions          
     ON divisions.DivisionPK = invoiceLines.DivisionFK          
    INNER JOIN tblCustomers AS customers          
     ON customers.CustomerPK = invoices.CustomerFK          
    LEFT OUTER JOIN tblContacts AS invoiceContacts          
     ON invoiceContacts.ContactPK = customers.InvoiceContactFK          
    INNER JOIN appSystem AS [system]          
     ON 1=1          
    INNER JOIN tblCurrencies AS [currencies]          
     ON currencies.CurrencyPK = [system].InvoiceCurrencyFK          
    LEFT OUTER JOIN (          
         SELECT MAX(InvoiceToDate) AS InvoiceToDate          
         FROM tblInvoices          
         WHERE CustomerFK = @customerFK          
         AND InvoicePK < @var_invoiceFK          
         AND InvoiceTypeFK = @invoiceTypeFK          
          
         --SELECT TOP 1 InvoiceToDate FROM tblInvoices          
         --tblInvoices          
         --AND InvoicePK not in (SELECT TOP 1 InvoicePK FROM tblInvoices WHERE CustomerFK = @customerFK ORDER BY InvoiceToDate DESC)          
         --ORDER BY InvoiceToDate DESC          
        ) AS lastInvoice          
     ON 1=1          
    LEFT OUTER JOIN tblBuildingUnits AS bu           
     ON invoiceLines.buildingunitfk = bu.buildingunitpk          
    LEFT OUTER JOIN tblBuildings AS buildings           
     ON bu.buildingfk = buildings.buildingpk          
    LEFT OUTER JOIN tblVatCodes AS vatCodes          
     ON invoiceLines.VatCodeFK = vatCodes.VatCodePK          
    LEFT OUTER JOIN tblStockItemCategories AS sic          
     ON customers.customerpk = sic.customerfk          
    LEFT OUTER JOIN #tblExtraServices as extraServices           
     ON invoiceLines.divisionfk = extraServices.divisionfk          
     AND invoiceLines.ChargeText = extraServices.ChargeText             
   WHERE invoices.InvoicePK = @var_invoiceFK            GROUP BY           
     invoices.InvoiceNumber,          
     invoiceLines.InvoiceLinePK,          
     invoices.InvoiceToDate,         
  invoices.Approved,        
  d.DepartmentName,         
  d.DepartmentCode,              
     lineType.InvoiceLineType,        
  invoiceLines.NominalCode,         
     invoiceLines.ChargeText,          
     invoiceLines.ChargeText1,          
     invoiceLines.ChargeText2,          
     invoiceLines.ChargeText3,          
     invoiceLines.ChargeText4,              
     vatCodes.VatCodePK,          
     invoiceLines.Tax,          
     invoiceLines.TaxRate,          
     invoiceLines.Charge,          
     divisions.DivisionName,          
     divisions.DivisionCode,          
     customers.CustomerName,          
     customers.Address1,          
     customers.Address2,          
     customers.Address3,          
     customers.Address4,          
     customers.Address5,          
     invoiceContacts.ContactName,          
     customers.InvoiceAuthorisationCode,          
     customers.CustomInvoiceTitle,          
     invoices.CustomInvoiceValue,          
     [system].DocketHeaderLine1,          
     [system].DocketHeaderLine2,          
     [system].DocketHeaderLine3,          
     [system].DocketFooterPart1,          
     [system].DocketFooterPart2Line1,          
     [system].DocketFooterPart2Line2,          
     [system].DocketFooterPart2Line3,          
     [system].DocketFooterPart2Line4,          
     currencies.CurrencySymbol,          
     customers.PaymentTerms,          
     lastInvoice.InvoiceToDate,          
     buildings.BuildingName + ' - ' + bu.BuildingUnit,          
     extraServices.Reference,          
     --DG #dev740          
     invoices.Tax,          
     invoices.Charge,        
  buildings.BuildingName        
          
    ORDER BY          
     DivisionName ASC,          
     StockItemCategory ASC,          
     StockItemCategorySubGroup ASC,          
     Reference ASC,          
     ChargeText ASC          
   END          
          
   -- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end          
                
   BREAK          
  END TRY          
  BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */          
   DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;          
   SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;          
   SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;          
          
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY           
   BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;          
                 
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;          
          
            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID          
                      
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;          
                      
   IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)          
   BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END          
   ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */          
  END CATCH          
  SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1          
 END          
END

-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spReportsCycleCount]
(
	@cycleCountFK int
)	
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data; Ensure this proc has a low impact when executed */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED; SET DEADLOCK_PRIORITY LOW

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT
	,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;
	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	DECLARE @var_cycleCountFK int
	SET @var_cycleCountFK = @cycleCountFK
	SET @ParameterDetails = '@cycleCountFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_cycleCountFK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'')

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    --BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

		SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END


	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY
			

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start

			Select 
			bus.BuildingUnit,
			ccs.WeekNumber,
			ccs.OfWeeks,
			ccs.InsertedDate [Issue Date],
			isnull(cclps.Location, ccls.Location) Location, 
			isnull(sis.StockItemCode, 'EMPTY') StockItem,
			isnull(sis.Description, 'EMPTY') Description,
			isnull(cclps.Batch, 'EMPTY') Batch,
			case divisions.DivisionTypeFK when 1 then cclps.Quantity when 2 then null end as Quantity
			From tblCycleCounts ccs
			inner join tblBuildingUnits bus on
			bus.BuildingUnitPK = ccs.BuildingUnitFK
			inner join tblCycleCountLocations ccls on
			ccls.CycleCountFK = ccs.CycleCountPK
			left outer join tblCycleCountLocationPallets cclps on
			cclps.CycleCountLocationFK = ccls.CycleCountLocationPK
			left outer join tblStockItems sis on
			sis.StockItemPK = cclps.StockItemFK
			left outer join tblDivisions divisions on
			divisions.DivisionPK = sis.DivisionFK
			Where ccs.CycleCountPK = @var_cycleCountFK
			Order by isnull(cclps.Location, ccls.Location)

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end

			
			
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END
GO

-- =============================================    
-- Author:  <Author,,Name>    
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>    
-- Description: <Description,,>    
-- =============================================    
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spReportsDailyInventoryMovements]    
(    
 @FromDate datetime,    
 @BuildingUnitFK int,    
 @DetailedReport bit    
)     
AS    
BEGIN    
 /* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */    
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED    
    
    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT    
  ,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;    
 SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();    
    
 -- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters    
 DECLARE @FromDate2 datetime    
 DECLARE @ToDate2 datetime  
 DECLARE @BuildingUnitFK2 int    
 DECLARE @DetailedReport2 bit    
     
    
 SET @FromDate2 = @FromDate    
 SET @ToDate2 = DATEADD(dd, DATEDIFF(dd, 0, @FromDate2), 1)  
 SET @BuildingUnitFK2 = @BuildingUnitFK    
 SET @DetailedReport2 = @DetailedReport    
     
    
 SET @ParameterDetails = '@FromDate = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@FromDate2 AS NVARCHAR(20)),'')    
    
    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL     
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)    
    
    IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)    
    BEGIN    
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC     
    
        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)    
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK    
    
        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()    
    END    
    
    
 SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);    
 SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails    
 ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;    
 INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()    
    
 WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3

  -- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start    
    
print 'get locations'  
print CONVERT(varchar, SYSDATETIME(), 121)  
  DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #locations    
  SELECT BuildingUnitBayPK, vbub.BuildingUnitCOlumnFK, BuildingUnitBayLocation, vbub.[Row], vbub.ColumnNo    
  INTO  #locations    
  FROM viewBuildingUnitBays vbub     
  WHERE vbub.buildingunitfk = @BuildingUnitFK2 AND vbub.locationTypeFK =1 and vbub.IsArchived=0

print CONVERT(varchar, SYSDATETIME(), 121)  
  declare @Maxmovementpk int  
  SET @Maxmovementpk = (select top 1 worksordermovementpk from tblworksordermovements order by worksordermovementpk desc)  
print 'get top 25k moves'  
print CONVERT(varchar, SYSDATETIME(), 121)  
  drop table if exists #totalMovements  
  select *  
  into #totalMovements  
  from tblworksordermovements  
  where worksordermovementpk >= (@Maxmovementpk - 25000)  
print 'get first and last moves'  
print CONVERT(varchar, SYSDATETIME(), 121)  
  declare @firstmovementpk int = (select top 1 worksordermovementpk from #totalMovements where inserteddate >= @FromDate2 order by worksordermovementpk asc)    
  declare @lastmovementpk int = (select top 1 worksordermovementpk from #totalMovements where UpdatedDate < DATEADD(dd, DATEDIFF(dd, 0, @FromDate2), 1) order by worksordermovementpk desc)    
print 'get all relevant moves'  
print CONVERT(varchar, SYSDATETIME(), 121)    
  DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #AllMovements    
  select *    
  INTO #AllMovements    
  from #totalMovements wom WITH (NOLOCK)    
  where (wom.worksordermovementpk >= @firstmovementpk and wom.worksordermovementpk <= @lastmovementpk)    
  and exists(    
   select 1 from #locations loc WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE loc.BuildingUnitBayPK = wom.sourcelocationfk AND wom.sourcelocationtypefk = 1    
   UNION    
   select 1 from #locations loc WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE loc.BuildingUnitBayPK = wom.destinationfk AND wom.destinationlocationtypefk = 1    
  )    
print 'get effected locations'  
print CONVERT(varchar, SYSDATETIME(), 121)  
  DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #EffectedLocations    
  SELECT distinct loc.*     
  INTO #EffectedLocations    
  FROM #locations loc    
  WHERE exists(    
   select 1 from #AllMovements wom WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE loc.BuildingUnitBayPK = wom.sourcelocationfk    
   UNION    
   select 1 from #AllMovements wom WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE loc.BuildingUnitBayPK = wom.destinationfk    
  )    
   
  if(@DetailedReport2 = 1)    
  BEGIN    
   DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #MovedPallets    
   select DISTINCT am.Palletfk, stockitemfk, stockitemcode, div.DivisionCode, div.DivisionName    
   INTO #MovedPallets    
   from #AllMovements am    
   INNER JOIN tblpalletcontent pc ON am.palletfk = pc.PalletFK    
   LEFT JOIN tblstockitems s ON pc.stockitemfk = s.stockitempk    
   LEFT JOIN tbldivisions div ON s.divisionfk= div.divisionpk    
   --SELECT * FROM #MovedPallets    
        
   --stock in locations right now    
   DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #currentStock    
   SELECT DISTINCT vrl.BuildingUnitColumnFK AS PK, BuildingUnitBayLocation AS [Location], coalesce(S.stockitemcode, 'Empty') AS stockitemcode, Count(distinct PalletPK) CurrentPallets, div.DivisionCode, div.DivisionName, vrl.[Row], vrl.ColumnNo     
   INTO #currentStock    
   FROM #EffectedLocations vrl    
   inner JOIN viewpalletlocations vpl ON vrl.BuildingUnitColumnFK = vpl.BuildingUnitColumnFK AND locationtypefk = 1    
   left JOIN tblpalletcontent pc ON vpl.palletPk = pc.PalletFK    
   left JOIN tblstockitems s ON pc.stockitemfk = s.stockitempk    
   LEFT JOIN tbldivisions div ON s.divisionfk= div.divisionpk

   ORDER BY  vrl.BuildingUnitColumnFK    
   --SELECT * FROM #currentStock    
       
   --stock moved from locations (for dispatch)    
   DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #MovedStockFromDispatch    
   SELECT DISTINCT el.BuildingUnitColumnFK AS PK, BuildingUnitBayLocation AS [Location], coalesce(stockitemcode, 'Empty') AS stockitemcode, Count(distinct wom.PalletFK) PalletsMovedFrom_Dispatched, el.[Row], el.ColumnNo    
   INTO #MovedStockFromDispatch    
   FROM #EffectedLocations el    
   inner join #AllMovements wom on el.BuildingUnitBayPK = wom.SourceLocationFK    
   inner JOIN #MovedPallets pc ON wom.palletfk = pc.palletfk    
   WHERE wom.DestinationLocationTypeFK = 2    
   GROUP BY el.BuildingUnitColumnFK, BuildingUnitBayLocation, stockitemcode, el.[Row], el.ColumnNo    
   ORDER BY  el.BuildingUnitColumnFK    
    
   --stock moved from locations (for internal movements)    
   DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #MovedStockFromInternal    
   SELECT DISTINCT el.BuildingUnitColumnFK AS PK, BuildingUnitBayLocation AS [Location], coalesce(stockitemcode, 'Empty') AS stockitemcode, Count(distinct wom.PalletFK) PalletsMovedFrom_Internal, el.[Row], el.ColumnNo

   inner JOIN #MovedPallets pc ON wom.palletfk = pc.palletfk    
   WHERE wom.DestinationLocationTypeFK = 1    
   GROUP BY el.BuildingUnitColumnFK, BuildingUnitBayLocation, stockitemcode, el.[Row], el.ColumnNo    
   ORDER BY  el.BuildingUnitColumnFK    
    
   --stock moved to locations (for arrival)    
   DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #MovedStockToArrival    
   SELECT DISTINCT el.BuildingUnitColumnFK AS PK, BuildingUnitBayLocation AS [Location], coalesce(stockitemcode, 'Empty') AS stockitemcode, Count(distinct wom.PalletFK) PalletsMovedTo_Arrival, el.[Row], el.ColumnNo    
   INTO #MovedStockToArrival

   inner join #AllMovements wom on el.BuildingUnitBayPK = wom.DestinationFK    
   inner JOIN #MovedPallets pc ON wom.palletfk = pc.palletfk    
   WHERE wom.SourceLocationTypeFK = 2    
   GROUP BY el.BuildingUnitColumnFK, BuildingUnitBayLocation, stockitemcode, el.[Row], el.ColumnNo    
   ORDER BY  el.BuildingUnitColumnFK    
       
   --stock moved to locations (for internal movements)       
   DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #MovedStockToInternal    
   SELECT DISTINCT el.BuildingUnitColumnFK AS PK, BuildingUnitBayLocation AS [Location], coalesce(stockitemcode, 'Empty') AS stockitemcode, Count(distinct wom.PalletFK) PalletsMovedTo_Internal, el.[Row], el.ColumnNo    
   INTO #MovedStockToInternal    
   FROM #EffectedLocations el    
   inner join #AllMovements wom on el.BuildingUnitBayPK = wom.DestinationFK    
   inner JOIN #MovedPallets pc ON wom.palletfk = pc.palletfk    
   WHERE wom.SourceLocationTypeFK = 1    
   GROUP BY el.BuildingUnitColumnFK, BuildingUnitBayLocation, stockitemcode, el.[Row], el.ColumnNo    
   ORDER BY  el.BuildingUnitColumnFK    
       
   /*SELECT cs.PK, cs.[Location], cs.stockitemcode, cs.DivisionCode, cs.DivisionName,    
    cs.CurrentPallets - isnull(msta.PalletsMovedTo_Arrival, 0) - isnull(msti.PalletsMovedTo_Internal, 0)     
    + isnull(msfd.PalletsMovedFrom_Dispatched,0) + isnull(msfi.PalletsMovedFrom_Internal,0) AS OpeningStock,    
     isnull(msta.PalletsMovedTo_Arrival, 0) as PalletsInForArrival,    
     isnull(msta.PalletsMovedTo_Arrival, 0) + isnull(msti.PalletsMovedTo_Internal, 0) as TotalPalletsIn,    
     isnull(msfd.PalletsMovedFrom_Dispatched, 0) as PalletsOutForDispatch,    
     isnull(msfd.PalletsMovedFrom_Dispatched, 0) + isnull(msfi.PalletsMovedFrom_Internal, 0) as TotalPalletsOut,    
     cs.CurrentPallets AS ClosingStock, dbo.GetBSTDate() AS RunDate    
   FROM #currentStock cs    
   left JOIN #MovedStockFromDispatch msfd ON cs.PK = msfd.PK AND cs.stockitemcode = msfd.stockitemcode    
   left JOIN #MovedStockFromInternal msfi ON cs.PK = msfi.PK AND cs.stockitemcode = msfi.stockitemcode    
   left JOIN #MovedStockToArrival msta ON cs.PK = msta.PK AND cs.stockitemcode = msta.stockitemcode    
   left JOIN #MovedStockToInternal msti ON cs.PK = msti.PK  AND cs.stockitemcode = msti.stockitemcode    
   --ORDER BY cs.[Location]    
   ORDER BY cs.[Row], cs.ColumnNo*/    
    
   SELECT * FROM (    
    SELECT cs.PK, cs.[Location], cs.stockitemcode, cs.DivisionCode, cs.DivisionName,    
     cs.CurrentPallets - isnull(msta.PalletsMovedTo_Arrival, 0) - isnull(msti.PalletsMovedTo_Internal, 0)     
     + isnull(msfd.PalletsMovedFrom_Dispatched,0) + isnull(msfi.PalletsMovedFrom_Internal,0) AS OpeningStock,    
      isnull(msta.PalletsMovedTo_Arrival, 0) as PalletsInForArrival,    
      isnull(msta.PalletsMovedTo_Arrival, 0) + isnull(msti.PalletsMovedTo_Internal, 0) as TotalPalletsIn,    
      isnull(msfd.PalletsMovedFrom_Dispatched, 0) as PalletsOutForDispatch,    
      isnull(msfd.PalletsMovedFrom_Dispatched, 0) + isnull(msfi.PalletsMovedFrom_Internal, 0) as TotalPalletsOut,    
      cs.CurrentPallets AS ClosingStock, dbo.GetBSTDate() AS RunDate    
    FROM #currentStock cs    
    left JOIN #MovedStockFromDispatch msfd ON cs.PK = msfd.PK AND cs.stockitemcode = msfd.stockitemcode    
    left JOIN #MovedStockFromInternal msfi ON cs.PK = msfi.PK AND cs.stockitemcode = msfi.stockitemcode    
    left JOIN #MovedStockToArrival msta ON cs.PK = msta.PK AND cs.stockitemcode = msta.stockitemcode    
    left JOIN #MovedStockToInternal msti ON cs.PK = msti.PK  AND cs.stockitemcode = msti.stockitemcode    
    --ORDER BY cs.[Location]    
    --WHERE cs.Location = '02'    
    --ORDER BY cs.[Row], cs.ColumnNo    
    union    
    SELECT distinct el.BuildingUnitColumnFK as PK, el.BuildingUnitBayLocation AS [Location], msfd.stockitemcode, '' as DivisionCode, '' as DivisionName,    
    isnull(msfd.PalletsMovedFrom_Dispatched,0) + isnull(msfi.PalletsMovedFrom_Internal,0) AS OpeningStock,    
      0 as PalletsInForArrival,    
      0 as TotalPalletsIn,    
      isnull(msfd.PalletsMovedFrom_Dispatched, 0) as PalletsOutForDispatch,    
      isnull(msfd.PalletsMovedFrom_Dispatched, 0) + isnull(msfi.PalletsMovedFrom_Internal, 0) as TotalPalletsOut,    
      0 AS ClosingStock,     
      dbo.GetBSTDate() AS RunDate    
    FROM #EffectedLocations el    
    --LEFT JOIN #currentStock cs ON el.BuildingUnitBayLocation = cs.Location    
    left JOIN #MovedStockFromDispatch msfd ON el.BuildingUnitColumnFK = msfd.PK --AND cs.stockitemcode = msfd.stockitemcode    
    left JOIN #MovedStockFromInternal msfi ON el.BuildingUnitColumnFK = msfi.PK --AND cs.stockitemcode = msfi.stockitemcode    
    --LEFT JOIN #currentStock cs ON el.BuildingUnitBayLocation = cs.Location    
    --ORDER BY cs.[Location]    
    WHERE  ((select count(*) from #currentStock curr  WHERE curr.stockitemcode = msfd.stockitemcode)=0) AND    
    ((select count(*) from #currentStock curr  WHERE curr.stockitemcode = msfi.stockitemcode)=0)    
    AND  isnull(msfd.PalletsMovedFrom_Dispatched,0) + isnull(msfi.PalletsMovedFrom_Internal,0) > 0    
    --ORDER BY cs.[Row], cs.ColumnNo    
   )subq    
   ORDER BY subq.Location    
  END    
  ELSE    
  BEGIN    
print 'get last effected'  
print CONVERT(varchar, SYSDATETIME(), 121)  
  DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #LastEffected    
  ;WITH cte AS    
  (    
   SELECT BuildingUnitColumnFK, wom.InsertedDate, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY BuildingUnitColumnFK ORDER BY wom.InsertedDate DESC) AS rn    
   FROM #EffectedLocations loc    
   INNER JOIN #AllMovements wom WITH (NOLOCK) on loc.BuildingUnitBayPK = wom.sourcelocationfk or loc.BuildingUnitBayPK = wom.destinationfk    
  )    
  SELECT *    
  into #LastEffected    
  FROM cte    
  WHERE rn = 1    
print 'get loading bay pals'  
print CONVERT(varchar, SYSDATETIME(), 121)  
  --drop table if exists #tmpLoadingBayPals  
  --SELECT DISTINCT -1 AS PK, 'Loading Bay' AS [Location], stockitemcode, Count(distinct PalletPK) CurrentPallets, getdate() as LastConfirmedDate, '1' AS [Row], '1' as ColumnNo    
  --into #tmpLoadingBayPals  
  --FROM tblpallets pals    
  --INNER JOIN tblpalletcontent pc ON palletfk = palletpk     
  --INNER JOIN tblstockitems s ON stockitempk = stockitemfk    
  --WHERE pals.buildingunitfk = @BuildingUnitFK2 and pals.IsArchived = 0 AND pals.LocationTypeFK <> 1 AND pc.AvailableUnits > 0    
  --GROUP BY pals.LocationFK, stockitemcode  
  drop table if exists #tmpallloadingbaypals  
  select palletpk, locationfk   
  into #tmpallloadingbaypals  
  from tblpallets  
  WHERE buildingunitfk = @BuildingUnitFK2 and IsArchived = 0 AND LocationTypeFK <> 1  and palletstatusfk <> 10
  
  drop table if exists #tmpLoadingBayPals  
  SELECT DISTINCT -1 AS PK, 'Loading Bay' AS [Location], stockitemcode, Count(distinct PalletPK) CurrentPallets, getdate() as LastConfirmedDate, '1' AS [Row], '1' as ColumnNo    
  into #tmpLoadingBayPals  
  FROM #tmpallloadingbaypals pals    
  INNER JOIN tblpalletcontent pc ON palletfk = palletpk     
  INNER JOIN tblstockitems s ON stockitempk = stockitemfk    
  WHERE pc.AvailableUnits > 0    
  GROUP BY pals.LocationFK, stockitemcode  
print 'get locations summary'  
print CONVERT(varchar, SYSDATETIME(), 121)  
  drop table if exists #tmpBayPals  
  SELECT DISTINCT vrl.BuildingUnitColumnFK AS PK, BuildingUnitBayLocation AS [Location], coalesce(stockitemcode, 'Empty') AS stockitemcode, Count(distinct PalletPK) CurrentPallets, le.InsertedDate as LastConfirmedDate, vrl.[Row], vrl.ColumnNo    
  into #tmpBayPals  
  FROM #EffectedLocations vrl    
  INNER JOIN #LastEffected le ON vrl.BuildingUnitColumnFK = le.BuildingUnitColumnFK    
  left JOIN viewpalletlocations vpl ON vrl.BuildingUnitColumnFK = vpl.BuildingUnitColumnFK AND locationtypefk = 1    
  LEFT JOIN tblpalletcontent pc ON vpl.palletpk = pc.palletfk    
  LEFT JOIN tblstockitems s ON pc.stockitemfk = s.stockitempk    
  GROUP BY vrl.BuildingUnitColumnFK, BuildingUnitBayLocation, stockitemcode, le.InsertedDate, vrl.[Row], vrl.ColumnNo  
print 'get result'  
print CONVERT(varchar, SYSDATETIME(), 121)       
  SELECT * FROM (    
   SELECT * from #tmpBayPals  
   UNION    
   select * from #tmpLoadingBayPals  
  )subq    
  ORDER BY [Row], ColumnNo    
 END    
      
   -- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end    
         
   BREAK    
  END TRY    
  BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */    
   DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;    
   SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;    
   SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;    
    
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY     
   BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;    
           
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;    
    
            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID    
                
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;    
                
   IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)    
   BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END    
   ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */    
  END CATCH    
  SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1    
 END    
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spReportsDailyInventorySummary]    
(    
 @DivisionFK int,    
 @ForExport bit = 0    
)     
AS    
BEGIN    
 /* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data; Ensure this proc has a low impact when executed */    
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED; SET DEADLOCK_PRIORITY LOW    
    
    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT    
 ,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;    
 SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();    
    
 -- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters    
 DECLARE @var_DivisionFK int;    
 DECLARE @var_ForExport bit;    
 SET @var_DivisionFK = @DivisionFK;    
 SET @var_ForExport = @ForExport;    
 SET @ParameterDetails = '@DivisionFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_DivisionFK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'')    
    
    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL     
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)    
    
    IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)    
    BEGIN    
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC     
    
        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)    
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK    
    
        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()    
    END    
    
 SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);    
 SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails    
 ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;    
 INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()    
    
 WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3    
 BEGIN     
  BEGIN TRY    
       
    
   -- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start    
    
   DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #AllStock    
    
   SELECT stockitemcode, stockitempk, count(DISTINCT palletfk) NoPallets, div.DivisionCode, div.DivisionName, dbo.GetBSTDate() AS RunDate    
  , bldg.BuildingName  
   INTO #AllStock    
   FROM tblpalletcontent pc    
   --tblpallets - tblbuildingunits - tblbuildings   
  left join tblpallets pallets on pallets.PalletPk = pc.Palletfk  
  left join tblbuildingunits unit on unit.BuildingUnitPK= pallets.BuildingUnitFK  
  left join tblbuildings bldg on bldg.BuildingPK = unit.BuildingFK  
   INNER JOIN tblstockitems si ON pc.stockitemfk = si.StockItemPK    
   INNER JOIN tbldivisions div ON divisionfk= divisionpk    
   WHERE pc.availableunits > 0 and divisionpk = @var_DivisionFK   and pallets.PalletStatusFK <> 10   
   GROUP BY si.StockItemCode, stockitempk,div.DivisionCode, div.DivisionName  
   ,bldg.BuildingName   
    
    
   if(@var_ForExport = 1)    
   BEGIN    
    SELECT stockitemcode AS [Stock Code], NoPallets [No Pallets], BuildingName     
    FROM (    
     SELECT 0 AS OrderBy, stockitemcode,  cast(NoPallets AS nvarchar(20)) NoPallets, BuildingName    
     FROM #AllStock    
     UNION    
     SELECT 1, '.', '.', '.'    
     UNION    
     SELECT 2, 'Total', cast(sum(NoPallets) AS nvarchar(20)), BuildingName     
     FROM #AllStock  
	 group by BuildingName
    ) sunq    
    ORDER BY OrderBy, BuildingName    
   END    
   else    
   BEGIN    
    SELECT *     
    FROM #AllStock    
    ORDER BY StockItemCode    
   END    
    
   -- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end    
   BREAK    
  END TRY    
  BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */    
   DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;    
   SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;    
   SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;    
    
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY     
   BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;    
           
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;    
    
            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID    
                
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;    
                
   IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)    
   BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END    
   ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */    
  END CATCH    
  SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1    
 END    
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spReportsDailyLocationSummary]

	@BuildingUnitFK int
)	
AS
BEGIN

    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED; SET DEADLOCK_PRIORITY LOW

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT
	,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;
	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

	DECLARE @var_BuildingUnitFK int
	SET @var_BuildingUnitFK = @BuildingUnitFK;
	SET @ParameterDetails = '@BuildingUnitFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_BuildingUnitFK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'')

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    END

	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY
			

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start

			DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #tempColumns
			SELECT DISTINCT BuildingUnitBayLocation as LocationName, vbub.BuildingUnitColumnFK, vbub.BuildingName + ' - ' + vbub.BuildingUnit AS BuildingUnit, vbub.Row, vbub.ColumnNo
			INTO #tempColumns 
			FROM dbo.viewBuildingUnitBays vbub 
			WHERE vbub.locationTypeFK = 1 and buildingunitpk = @var_BuildingUnitFK and vbub.IsArchived=0
			ORDER BY vbub.Row, vbub.ColumnNo

			DECLARE @BuildingName nvarchar(100)
			SET @BuildingName = (SELECT TOP 1 BuildingUnit FROM #tempColumns)

			DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #tempPallets
			SELECT PalletPK, p.locationfk, tbuc.BuildingUnitColumnFK, tbuc.LocationName, tbuc.[Row], tbuc.ColumnNo
			INTO #tempPallets
			FROM #tempColumns tbuc
			INNER JOIN tblbuildingunitbays tbub on tbub.BuildingUnitColumnFK = tbuc.BuildingUnitColumnFK
			inner JOIN tblpallets p ON p.locationfk = tbub.BuildingUnitBayPK AND p.locationtypefk = 1 

			DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #tempcontent
			SELECT LocationFK, BuildingUnitColumnFK, PalletPK, stockitemcode, divisioncode, div.DivisionName
			INTO #tempcontent
			FROM #tempPallets p
			inner JOIN tblpalletcontent pc ON p.palletpk = pc.PalletFK AND pc.AvailableUnits > 0
			inner JOIN tblstockitems s ON s.stockitempk = pc.stockitemfk
			INNER JOIN tbldivisions div ON s.divisionfk = div.DivisionPK
	
			SELECT * from(
				SELECT 'Loading Bay' AS LocationName, stockitemcode, Count(distinct PalletPK) noPallets, divisioncode, DivisionName, @BuildingName AS BuildingUnit, dbo.GetBSTDate() AS RunDate, '' [Row], 0 ColumnNo
				FROM tblpallets pals
				INNER JOIN tblpalletcontent pc ON palletfk = palletpk 
				INNER JOIN tblstockitems s ON stockitempk = stockitemfk			
				INNER JOIN tbldivisions div ON s.divisionfk = div.DivisionPK
				WHERE pals.buildingunitfk = @var_BuildingUnitFK AND pals.LocationTypeFK <> 1 AND pc.AvailableUnits > 0
				GROUP BY pals.LocationFK, stockitemcode, divisioncode, DivisionName
				union
				SELECT cols.LocationName, stockitemcode, count(p.PalletPK) noPallets, divisioncode, DivisionName, BuildingUnit, dbo.GetBSTDate() AS RunDate, cols.[Row], cols.ColumnNo
				FROM #tempColumns cols
				LEFT JOIN #tempcontent p ON cols.BuildingUnitColumnFK = p.BuildingUnitColumnFK
				--WHERE count(p.PalletPK) > 0
				GROUP BY cols.LocationName, stockitemcode, divisioncode, DivisionName, BuildingUnit, cols.[Row], cols.ColumnNo
				--UNION
				
			)subq
			ORDER BY [Row], ColumnNo

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END
GO

/****************************************************************************************
Author      : Archana Singh
Created Date: 21-Jul-2026
Description :
    Retrieves the daily stock in summary report grouped dynamically by:
    - Building or Building Unit
    - Division
    - Supplier Type (Delivery Type)

    The procedure calculates:
    - Total Pallets In
    - Total Dockets In

    Filters can be applied by Building/Building Unit and Report Date.
    Optional grouping fields are included based on the supplied filter flags.



Parameters  :
    @FilterByBuildingUnit - Determines whether filtering is done by Building Unit or Building.
    @BuildingFilter       - Building Unit ID or Building ID based on filter selection.
    @FilterByDivision     - Includes Division Code and Division Name grouping when enabled.
    @FilterByAddressType  - Includes Supplier Type grouping when enabled.
    @ReportDate           - Report date for daily stock in summary.

Notes       :
    - Uses parameterized dynamic SQL to support optional grouping fields.
    - Date filtering uses a range condition to include the complete report day.
    - Replaces the previous C# generated SQL query to improve maintainability,
      performance, and prevent datetime conversion issues.
****************************************************************************************/

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spReportsDailyStockInSummary]
(
    @FilterByBuildingUnit BIT,
    @BuildingFilter INT,
    @FilterByDivision BIT,
    @FilterByAddressType BIT,
    @ReportDate DATETIME
)
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    DECLARE @Fields NVARCHAR(MAX) = '';
    DECLARE @Grouping NVARCHAR(MAX) = '';
    DECLARE @Sorting NVARCHAR(MAX) = '';
    DECLARE @SQL NVARCHAR(MAX);


    -- Building / Building Unit
    IF @FilterByBuildingUnit = 1
    BEGIN
        SET @Fields = @Fields + 'BuildingName + '' - '' + BuildingUnit AS Building,';
        SET @Grouping = @Grouping + 'BuildingName + '' - '' + BuildingUnit,';
    END
    ELSE
    BEGIN
        SET @Fields = @Fields + 'BuildingName AS Building,';
        SET @Grouping = @Grouping + 'BuildingName,';
    END

    SET @Fields = @Fields + 'CAST(ForDate AS DATE) AS ForDate,';
    SET @Sorting = @Sorting + 'Building,';


    -- Division
    IF @FilterByDivision = 1
    BEGIN
        SET @Fields = @Fields + 'DivisionCode,';
        SET @Grouping = @Grouping + 'DivisionCode,';
        SET @Sorting = @Sorting + 'DivisionCode,';

        SET @Fields = @Fields + 'DivisionName,';
        SET @Grouping = @Grouping + 'DivisionName,';
        SET @Sorting = @Sorting + 'DivisionName,';
    END


    -- Supplier Type
    IF @FilterByAddressType = 1
    BEGIN
        SET @Fields = @Fields + 'SupplierType AS [Delivery Type],';
        SET @Grouping = @Grouping + 'SupplierType,';
        SET @Sorting = @Sorting + 'SupplierType,';
    END


    -- Always included
    SET @Fields = @Fields + '
        SUM(PalletsIn) AS [Total Pallets],
        SUM(DocketsIn) AS [Total Dockets]';


    SET @Grouping = @Grouping + 'CAST(ForDate AS DATE)';

    SET @Sorting = @Sorting +
        '[Total Pallets], CAST(ForDate AS DATE) DESC';


    SET @SQL = '
    SELECT 
        ' + @Fields + '

    FROM tblReportsDivisionDailyStockInSummary si

    INNER JOIN tblDivisions d
        ON si.DivisionFK = d.DivisionPK

    INNER JOIN tblCustomers c
        ON d.CustomerFK = c.CustomerPK

    INNER JOIN tblBuildingUnits bu
        ON si.BuildingUnitFK = bu.BuildingUnitPK

    INNER JOIN tblBuildings b
        ON bu.BuildingFK = b.BuildingPK

    INNER JOIN appSupplierTypes st
        ON st.SupplierTypePK = si.SupplierTypeFK

    WHERE si.ForDate >= @ReportDate
      AND si.ForDate < DATEADD(DAY,1,@ReportDate)
    ';


    IF @FilterByBuildingUnit = 1
    BEGIN
        SET @SQL = @SQL +
        ' AND bu.BuildingUnitPK = @BuildingFilter ';
    END
    ELSE
    BEGIN
        SET @SQL = @SQL +
        ' AND b.BuildingPK = @BuildingFilter ';
    END


    SET @SQL = @SQL + '
    GROUP BY ' + @Grouping + '
    ORDER BY ' + @Sorting;


    EXEC sp_executesql
        @SQL,
        N'@ReportDate DATETIME, @BuildingFilter INT',
        @ReportDate,
        @BuildingFilter;

END
GO

/****************************************************************************************
Author      : Archana Singh
Created Date: 21-Jul-2026
Description :
    Retrieves the daily stock level summary report grouped dynamically by:
    - Building or Building Unit
    - Division
    - Pallet Status
    - Pallet Type
    - Location Type

    The procedure calculates:
    - Total Pallets available based on daily stock levels.

    Filters can be applied by Building/Building Unit and Report Date.
    Optional grouping fields are included based on the supplied filter flags.

Parameters  :
    @FilterByBuildingUnit - Determines whether filtering is done by Building Unit or Building.
    @BuildingFilter       - Building Unit ID or Building ID based on filter selection.
    @FilterByDivision     - Includes Division Code and Division Name grouping when enabled.
    @FilterByPalletStatus - Includes Pallet Status grouping when enabled.
    @FilterByPalletType   - Includes Pallet Type grouping when enabled.
    @FilterByLocationType - Includes Location Type grouping when enabled.
    @ReportDate           - Report date for daily stock level summary.

Notes       :
    - Uses parameterized dynamic SQL to support optional grouping fields.
    - Date filtering uses a range condition to include the complete report day.
    - Replaces the previous C# generated SQL query to improve maintainability,
      performance, and prevent datetime conversion issues.
    - Aggregates pallet quantities using SUM(NoPallets).
****************************************************************************************/

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spReportsDailyStockLevels]
(
    @FilterByBuildingUnit BIT,
    @BuildingFilter INT,
    @FilterByDivision BIT,
    @FilterByPalletStatus BIT,
    @FilterByPalletType BIT,
    @FilterByLocationType BIT,
    @ReportDate DATETIME
)
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    DECLARE @Fields NVARCHAR(MAX) = '';
    DECLARE @Grouping NVARCHAR(MAX) = '';
    DECLARE @Sorting NVARCHAR(MAX) = '';

    -- Building / Building Unit
    IF @FilterByBuildingUnit = 1
    BEGIN
        SET @Fields += 'BuildingName + '' - '' + BuildingUnit AS Building,';
        SET @Grouping += 'BuildingName + '' - '' + BuildingUnit,';
    END
    ELSE
    BEGIN
        SET @Fields += 'BuildingName AS Building,';
        SET @Grouping += 'BuildingName,';
    END


    SET @Fields += 'CAST(ForDate AS DATE) AS ForDate,';
    

    SET @Sorting += 'Building,';


    -- Division
    IF @FilterByDivision = 1
    BEGIN
        SET @Fields += 'DivisionCode, DivisionName,';
        SET @Grouping += 'DivisionCode, DivisionName,';
        SET @Sorting += 'DivisionCode, DivisionName,';
    END


    -- Pallet Status
    IF @FilterByPalletStatus = 1
    BEGIN
        SET @Fields += 'PalletStatus,';
        SET @Grouping += 'PalletStatus,';
        SET @Sorting += 'PalletStatus,';
    END


    -- Pallet Type
    IF @FilterByPalletType = 1
    BEGIN
        SET @Fields += 'PT.Grouping AS [Pallet Type],';
        SET @Grouping += 'PT.Grouping,';
        SET @Sorting += 'PT.Grouping,';
    END


    -- Location Type
    IF @FilterByLocationType = 1
    IF @FilterByLocationType = 1
    BEGIN
        SET @Fields = @Fields + 'LocationType,';
        SET @Grouping = @Grouping + 'LocationType,';
        SET @Sorting = @Sorting + 'LocationType,';
    END


    -- Always included
    SET @Fields += 'SUM(NoPallets) AS [Total Pallets]';

    SET @Grouping += 'CAST(ForDate AS DATE)';

    SET @Sorting += '[Total Pallets], CAST(ForDate AS DATE) DESC';


    DECLARE @SQL NVARCHAR(MAX);


    SET @SQL = '
    SELECT 
        ' + @Fields + '
    FROM tblReportsDivisionDailyStockLevels rsl

    INNER JOIN tblDivisions d 
        ON rsl.DivisionFK = d.DivisionPK

    INNER JOIN tblCustomers c 
        ON d.CustomerFK = c.CustomerPK

    INNER JOIN tblBuildingUnits bu 
        ON rsl.BuildingUnitFK = bu.BuildingUnitPK

    INNER JOIN tblBuildings b 
        ON bu.BuildingFK = b.BuildingPK

    INNER JOIN appLocationTypes lt 
        ON rsl.LocationTypeFK = lt.LocationTypePK

    INNER JOIN appPalletStatus ps 
        ON rsl.PalletStatusFK = ps.PalletStatusPK

    INNER JOIN tblPalletTypes PT 
        ON rsl.PalletTypeFK = PT.PalletTypePK

    WHERE 
        rsl.ForDate >= @ReportDate
        AND rsl.ForDate < DATEADD(DAY,1,@ReportDate)
    ';


    IF @FilterByBuildingUnit = 1
        SET @SQL += ' AND bu.BuildingUnitPK = @BuildingFilter ';
    ELSE
        SET @SQL += ' AND b.BuildingPK = @BuildingFilter ';


    SET @SQL += '
    GROUP BY ' + @Grouping + '
    ORDER BY ' + @Sorting;


    EXEC sp_executesql 
        @SQL,
        N'@ReportDate DATETIME, @BuildingFilter INT',
        @ReportDate,
        @BuildingFilter;

END
GO

/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[spReportsDanoneIntegrationFileTimes]    Script Date: 02/11/2026 17:47:27 ******/

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spReportsDanoneIntegrationFileTimes]  
(  
--declare  
 @startDate datetime = null  
 ,@endDate datetime = null  
  
 --select  @startDate = '2019-06-01', @endDate = '2019-11-01'  
)  
AS  
BEGIN  
 declare @varStartDate datetime = @startDate, @varEndDate datetime = @endDate  
   
 set @varEndDate = isnull(@varEndDate, cast(dbo.GetBSTDate() as date))  

 DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX)
 SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID)
 SET @ParameterDetails = '@startDate = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@varStartDate AS NVARCHAR(20)),'') + ',@endDate = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@varEndDate AS NVARCHAR(20)),'')
  
   INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, -1

  
 if (@varStartDate is null)  
 begin  
  if ((select left(datename(dw, @varEndDate), 3)) = 'Mon') set @varStartDate = dateadd(day, -3, @varEndDate)  
  else set @varStartDate = isnull(@varStartDate, dateadd(day, -1, @varEndDate))  
 end  
  
 set @varEndDate = dateadd(day, 1, @varEndDate)  
  
--select @varStartDate as [@varStartDate]  
--select @varEndDate as [@varEndDate]  
  
 SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ UNCOMMITTED; SET DEADLOCK_PRIORITY LOW  
  
 -- 1. Get Danone stock out integration file details for January 2020.  
  
 DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #danoneStockOutIntegrationFileDetails  
  
 SELECT   
  t1.IntegrationFilePK, t1.FilePath, t1.CustomerFK, t1.DivisionFK, t1.FK AS ContainerOutFK, t1.InsertedDate--, t3.DivisionCode, t3.DivisionName  
 INTO   
  #danoneStockOutIntegrationFileDetails  
 FROM   
  dbo.tblIntegrationFiles t1 WITH(NOLOCK)   
 WHERE   
  t1.IntegrationFileTypeFK=23  
  --t1.FilePath LIKE 'c:\ftp\STAWMS\Customers\Outward\747\%.xml'   
  AND t1.FilePath NOT LIKE 'c:\ftp\STAWMS\Customers\Outward\747\ImportFailures\%.xml'   
  AND t1.FK > 0 /*FK = dbo.tblContainerOuts.ContainerOutPK*/  
  AND t1.InsertedDate >= @varStartDate  
  AND t1.InsertedDate < @varEndDate  
  AND t1.DivisionFK IN (630/*Danone RM*/ , 631/*Danone FG*/, 632/*Danone SFG*/)  
  
 UNION  
  
 SELECT   
  t1.IntegrationFileStockOutPK AS IntegrationFilePK, t1.FilePath, t1.CustomerFK, t1.DivisionFK, t1.ContainerOutFK, t1.InsertedDate--, t3.DivisionCode, t3.DivisionName  
 FROM   
  dbo.tblIntegrationFileStockOuts t1 WITH(NOLOCK)   
 WHERE   
  --t1.FilePath LIKE 'c:\ftp\STAWMS\Customers\Outward\747\%.xml'  AND  
  t1.FilePath NOT LIKE 'c:\ftp\STAWMS\Customers\Outward\747\ImportFailures\%.xml'   
  AND t1.ContainerOutFK > 0  
  AND t1.InsertedDate >= @varStartDate  
  AND t1.InsertedDate < @varEndDate  
  AND t1.DivisionFK IN (630/*Danone RM*/ , 631/*Danone FG*/, 632/*Danone SFG*/)  
  
 -- 2. Get assoicated (completed) container out details.  
  
 DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #containerOutDetails  
  
 SELECT DISTINCT   
  t1.ContainerOutPK,  
  t1.ContainerOutTypeFK,  
  t1.ContainerOutStatusFK,  
  t1.GoodsOrderNumber,  
  t1.CollectionDate,  
  t1.InsertedDate,  
  t1.DocketValue1,  
  t1.DocketValue2,  
  t1.ContainerNumber  
 INTO   
  #containerOutDetails  
 FROM   
  dbo.tblContainerOuts t1 WITH(NOLOCK)  
 INNER JOIN #danoneStockOutIntegrationFileDetails t2  
  ON t1.ContainerOutPK = t2.ContainerOutFK  
 WHERE   
  t1.ContainerOutStatusFK = 5 /*Completed*/  
  
 -- 3. Get assoicated (loaded) container out line pallet content details.  
  
 DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #containerOutLinePalletContentDetails  
  
 SELECT DISTINCT   
  t1.ContainerOutLinePalletContentPK,  
  t1.ContainerOutLineFK,  
  t3.ContainerOutPK AS ContainerOutFK,  
  t1.PalletFK,  
  t1.Loaded,  
  t1.CustomerBarcode,  
  t1.PalletContentFK,  
  t2.StockItemFK,  
  t5.StockItemCode  
 INTO   
  #containerOutLinePalletContentDetails  
 FROM   
  dbo.tblContainerOutLinePalletContent t1 WITH(NOLOCK)  
 INNER JOIN dbo.tblContainerOutLines t2 WITH(NOLOCK)  
  ON t1.ContainerOutLineFK = t2.ContainerOutLinePK  
 INNER JOIN #containerOutDetails t3  
  ON t2.ContainerOutFK = t3.ContainerOutPK  
 --INNER JOIN dbo.tblPalletContent t4 WITH(NOLOCK)  
 -- ON t1.PalletContentFK = t4.PalletContentPK  
 INNER JOIN dbo.tblStockItems t5 WITH(NOLOCK)  
  ON t2.StockItemFK = t5.StockItemPK  
 WHERE   
  t1.Loaded = 1  
  
 -- 4. Get associated (completed) container in details.  
  
 drop table if exists #tmpInwardpallets  
 select silp.*   
 into #tmpInwardpallets  
 from tblStockInLinePallets silp  
 inner join #containerOutLinePalletContentDetails colpc ON colpc.PalletFK = silp.PalletFK  
  
 DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #containerInDetails  
  
 SELECT DISTINCT   
  t1.ContainerInPK, t1.StockInStatusFK, t1.DateIn, t1.InsertedDate, t4.PalletFK,   
  t1.ContainerNumber, t1.ExternalReference, t1.Free4, t1.Free2, t1.GoodsInNumber  
 INTO   
  #containerInDetails  
 FROM #tmpInwardpallets t4  
 INNER JOIN dbo.tblStockInLines t3 WITH(NOLOCK) ON t3.StockInLinePK = t4.StockInLineFK  
 INNER JOIN dbo.tblStockIns t2 WITH(NOLOCK) ON t2.StockInPK = t3.StockInFK  
 inner join tblContainerIns t1 WITH(NOLOCK) ON t1.ContainerInPK = t2.ContainerInFK   
  
 --FROM   
 -- dbo.tblContainerIns t1 WITH(NOLOCK)  
 --INNER JOIN dbo.tblStockIns t2 WITH(NOLOCK)  
 -- ON t1.ContainerInPK = t2.ContainerInFK  
 --INNER JOIN dbo.tblStockInLines t3 WITH(NOLOCK)  
 -- ON t2.StockInPK = t3.StockInFK  
 --INNER JOIN dbo.tblStockInLinePallets t4 WITH(NOLOCK)  
 -- ON t3.StockInLinePK = t4.StockInLineFK  
 --INNER JOIN #containerOutLinePalletContentDetails t5  
 -- ON t4.PalletFK = t5.PalletFK  
 --WHERE   
 -- t1.StockInStatusFK = 3 /*Complete*/  
 -- and t2.DivisionFK IN (630/*Danone RM*/ , 631/*Danone FG*/, 632/*Danone SFG*/)  
  
 -- 5. Get the final report results.  
  
 drop table if exists #allstatuschanges   
 select tpsc.*   
 into #allstatuschanges   
 from tblPalletStatusChanges tpsc WITH(NOLOCK)  
 inner join #containerInDetails cid on cid.PalletFK = tpsc.PalletFK   
 where Instruction = 'ReleaseFromQI' or Instruction = 'UpdatePositiveRelease'  
  
 drop table if exists #results  
  
 SELECT  
  t2.CustomerBarcode AS SSCC,  
  t2.StockItemCode AS Material,  
  t3.InsertedDate AS [Reception of Goods InFile],  
  t3.DateIn AS [DateTime Goods In Completed],  
  
  t3.ContainerNumber AS [Goods In Trailer Number],       
  CASE WHEN ISNULL(t3.ExternalReference,'') = '' THEN  t3.Free4 ELSE t3.ExternalReference END AS [Goods In Delivery Number],   
  t3.Free2 AS [Goods In PO Number],  
  
  MIN(t4.InsertedDate) AS [Goods In Quality Release DateTime],  
  t4.Instruction AS [Goods In Quality Release Instruction],  
  
  MIN(t5.InsertedDate) AS [Goods In Update Positive Release DateTime],  
  t5.Instruction AS [Goods In Update Positive Release Instruction],  
  
  t1.InsertedDate AS [Reception of Delivery File],  
  t1.CollectionDate AS [DateTime Shipment Completed],  
    
  t1.ContainerNumber AS [Goods Out Trailer Number],  
  t1.DocketValue1 AS [Goods Out PO Number],  
  t1.DocketValue2 AS [Goods Out Delivery Number],
  t1.GoodsOrderNumber,
  t3.GoodsInNumber
 INTO  
  #results  
 FROM  
  #containerOutDetails t1  
 INNER JOIN #containerOutLinePalletContentDetails t2  
  ON t1.ContainerOutPK = t2.ContainerOutFK  
 INNER JOIN #containerInDetails t3  
  ON t2.PalletFK = t3.PalletFK  
 LEFT OUTER JOIN #allstatuschanges t4  
  ON t3.PalletFK = t4.PalletFK  
  AND t4.Instruction = 'ReleaseFromQI'  
 LEFT OUTER JOIN #allstatuschanges t5  
  ON t3.PalletFK = t5.PalletFK  
  AND t5.Instruction = 'UpdatePositiveRelease'  
 GROUP BY  
  t2.CustomerBarcode,  
  t2.StockItemCode,  
  t3.InsertedDate,  
  t3.DateIn,  
  t4.Instruction,  
  t1.InsertedDate,  
  t1.CollectionDate,  
  t5.Instruction,  
  t3.ContainerNumber, t3.ExternalReference, t3.Free4, t3.Free2,  
  t1.DocketValue1,  
  t1.DocketValue2,  
  t1.ContainerNumber,
  t1.GoodsOrderNumber,
  t3.GoodsInNumber
  
 -- 6. Return the final report results.  
  
 SELECT  
  isnull(SSCC, '') as SSCC  
  ,isnull(Material, '') as Material  
  
  ,case when [Reception of Goods InFile] is null then ''   
  else   
  convert(nvarchar(10), [Reception of Goods InFile], 103) + ' '  + convert(nvarchar(12), [Reception of Goods InFile], 14)   
  end as [Reception of Goods In File]  
  
  ,case when [DateTime Goods In Completed] is null then ''   
  else   
  convert(nvarchar(10), [DateTime Goods In Completed], 103) + ' '  + convert(nvarchar(12), [DateTime Goods In Completed], 14)   
  end as [DateTime Goods In Completed]  
   
  ,isnull([Goods In Trailer Number], '') as [Goods In Trailer Number]  
  ,isnull([Goods In Delivery Number], '') as [Goods In Delivery Number]  
  ,isnull([Goods In PO Number], '') as [Goods In PO Number]   
  
  ,case when [Goods In Quality Release DateTime] is null then ''   
  else   
  convert(nvarchar(10), [Goods In Quality Release DateTime], 103) + ' '  + convert(nvarchar(12), [Goods In Quality Release DateTime], 14)   
  end as [Goods In Quality Release DateTime]  
    
  ,isnull([Goods In Quality Release Instruction], '') as [Goods In Quality Release Instruction]  
  
  ,case when [Goods In Update Positive Release DateTime] is null then ''   
  else   
  convert(nvarchar(10), [Goods In Update Positive Release DateTime], 103) + ' '  + convert(nvarchar(12), [Goods In Update Positive Release DateTime], 14)   
  end as [Goods In Update Positive Release DateTime]  
    
  ,isnull([Goods In Update Positive Release Instruction], '') as [Goods In Update Positive Release Instruction]  
  
  ,case when [Reception of Delivery File] is null then ''   
  else   
  convert(nvarchar(10), [Reception of Delivery File], 103) + ' '  + convert(nvarchar(12), [Reception of Delivery File], 14)   
  end as [Reception of Delivery File]  
   
  ,case when [DateTime Shipment Completed] is null then ''   
  else   
  convert(nvarchar(10), [DateTime Shipment Completed], 103) + ' '  + convert(nvarchar(12), [DateTime Shipment Completed], 14)   
  end as [DateTime Shipment Completed]  
  
  ,isnull([Goods Out Trailer Number], '') as [Goods Out Trailer Number]  
  ,isnull([Goods Out PO Number], '') as [Goods Out PO Number]  
  ,isnull([Goods Out Delivery Number], '') as [Goods Out Delivery Number],
  GoodsOrderNumber, GoodsInNumber
 FROM   
  #results   
 ORDER BY   
  [Reception of Goods InFile] ASC, SSCC ASC, Material ASC  
END
