--sp_helptext spReportsDanoneIntegrationReceptionOfGoodsIn

--exec [spReportsDanoneIntegrationReceptionOfGoodsIn] @startDate = '2021-04-01', @endDate = '2021-04-13'  
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spReportsDanoneIntegrationReceptionOfGoodsIn]  
(  
--declare  
 @startDate datetime = null  
 ,@endDate datetime = null   
)  
AS  
BEGIN  
 declare @varStartDate datetime = @startDate, @varEndDate datetime = @endDate  
 --declare @varStartDate datetime = '2021-04-01', @varEndDate datetime = '2021-04-13'  
  
 set @varEndDate = isnull(@varEndDate, cast(dbo.GetBSTDate() as date))  
  
 if (@varStartDate is null)  
 begin  
  if ((select left(datename(dw, @varEndDate), 3)) = 'Mon') set @varStartDate = dateadd(day, -3, @varEndDate)  
  else set @varStartDate = isnull(@varStartDate, dateadd(day, -1, @varEndDate))  
 end  
  
 set @varEndDate = dateadd(day, 1, @varEndDate)  

 DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX)
 SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID)
 SET @ParameterDetails = '@startDate = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@varStartDate AS NVARCHAR(20)),'') + ',@endDate = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@varEndDate AS NVARCHAR(20)),'')
  
   INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, -1

  
  
 SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ UNCOMMITTED; SET DEADLOCK_PRIORITY LOW  
  
 -- 1. Get Danone stock in integration file details.  
 DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #danoneStockOutIntegrationFileDetails  
  
 SELECT   
  t1.IntegrationFilePK, t1.FilePath, t1.CustomerFK, t1.DivisionFK, t1.FK AS ContainerInFK, t1.InsertedDate--, t3.DivisionCode, t3.DivisionName  
 INTO   
  #danoneStockInIntegrationFileDetails  
 FROM   
  dbo.tblIntegrationFiles t1 WITH(NOLOCK)   
 WHERE   
  t1.IntegrationFileTypeFK=18  
  --t1.FilePath LIKE 'c:\ftp\STAWMS\Customers\Outward\747\%.xml'   
  AND t1.FK > 0 /*FK = ContainerInPK*/  
  AND t1.InsertedDate >= @varStartDate  
  AND t1.InsertedDate < @varEndDate  
  AND t1.DivisionFK IN (630/*Danone RM*/ , 631/*Danone FG*/, 632/*Danone SFG*/)  
  
 -- 2. Get assoicated (not cancelled) container in details.   
 DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #containerInDetails  
 SELECT DISTINCT cins.ContainerInPK, cins.StockInStatusFK, cins.DateIn, cins.InsertedDate, cins.ContainerNumber, cins.ExternalReference, cins.Free4, cins.Free2, cins.SealNumber, cins.GoodsInNumber, sup.Supplier, b.BuildingName + ' - ' + bu.BuildingUnit  as Building   
 INTO #containerInDetails  
 FROM tblContainerIns cins WITH(NOLOCK)   
 inner join #danoneStockInIntegrationFileDetails tif on tif.ContainerInFK = cins.containerinpk  
 inner join tblSuppliers sup on sup.SupplierPK = cins.SupplierFK
 inner join tblBuildingUnits bu on bu.BuildingUnitPK = cins.BuildingUnitFK
 inner join tblBuildings b on b.BuildingPK = bu.BuildingFK
 where cins.StockInStatusFK <> 4 /*all except cancelled stock ins*/  
   
 -- 3. get associated pallets from stock ins  
 DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #tmpInwardpallets  
 select distinct ci.ContainerInPK, ci.StockInStatusFK, ci.DateIn, ci.InsertedDate, silp.PalletFK,   
  ci.ContainerNumber, ci.ExternalReference, ci.Free4, ci.Free2, sil.CustomerBarcode, StockItemCode, ci.SealNumber, ci.GoodsInNumber, ci.Supplier, ci.Building, div.DivisionName
  --containerinfk, stockinfk, stockinlinefk, stockinlinepalletpk, palletfk  
 into #tmpInwardpallets   
 from tblStockInLinePallets silp WITH(NOLOCK)  
 INNER JOIN dbo.tblStockInLines sil WITH(NOLOCK) ON sil.StockInLinePK = silp.StockInLineFK  
 INNER JOIN dbo.tblStockIns si WITH(NOLOCK) ON si.StockInPK = sil.StockInFK  
 inner join tbldivisions div on si.DivisionFK = div.DivisionPK
 inner join #containerInDetails ci on si.ContainerInFK = ci.ContainerInPK  
 INNER JOIN dbo.tblStockItems stock WITH(NOLOCK) ON sil.StockItemFK = stock.StockItemPK  
   
 -- 4. Get assoicated container out line pallet content details.   
 DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #containerOutLineAllPallets  
 SELECT DISTINCT colpc.*  
 INTO #containerOutLineAllPallets   
 FROM dbo.tblContainerOutLinePalletContent colpc WITH(NOLOCK)   
 inner join #tmpInwardpallets tip on colpc.palletfk = tip.PalletFK  
   
 DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #containerOutLinePalletContentDetails  
 select  colpc.ContainerOutLinePalletContentPK,  
  colpc.ContainerOutLineFK,  
  co.ContainerOutPK AS ContainerOutFK,  
  colpc.PalletFK,  
  colpc.Loaded,  
  colpc.CustomerBarcode,  
  colpc.PalletContentFK,  
  col.StockItemFK  
 into #containerOutLinePalletContentDetails  
 FROM #containerOutLineAllPallets colpc  
 INNER JOIN dbo.tblContainerOutLines col WITH(NOLOCK) ON colpc.ContainerOutLineFK = col.ContainerOutLinePK  
 INNER JOIN tblcontainerouts co ON col.ContainerOutFK = co.ContainerOutPK  
  
 -- 5. get associated container out details  
 DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #containerOutDetails  
 SELECT DISTINCT   
  t1.ContainerOutPK,  
  t1.ContainerOutTypeFK,  
  t1.ContainerOutStatusFK,  
  t1.GoodsOrderNumber,  
  t1.CollectionDate,  
  t1.InsertedDate,  
  t1.DocketValue1,  
  t1.DocketValue2,  
  t1.ContainerNumber,  
  t1.SealNumber  
 INTO   
  #containerOutDetails  
 FROM   
  dbo.tblContainerOuts t1 WITH(NOLOCK)  
 INNER JOIN #containerOutLinePalletContentDetails t2  
  ON t1.ContainerOutPK = t2.ContainerOutFK  
 WHERE   
  t1.ContainerOutStatusFK <> 6 /*not cancelled*/   
      
 -- 5. Get the final report results.  
 drop table if exists #allstatuschanges   
 select distinct tpsc.*   
 into #allstatuschanges   
 from tblPalletStatusChanges tpsc WITH(NOLOCK)  
 inner join #tmpInwardpallets cid on cid.PalletFK = tpsc.PalletFK   
 where Instruction = 'ReleaseFromQI' or Instruction = 'UpdatePositiveRelease'  
  
 drop table if exists #results  
  
 SELECT  
  tip.CustomerBarcode AS SSCC,  
  tip.StockItemCode AS Material,  
  tip.InsertedDate AS [Reception of Goods InFile],  
  case when tip.StockInStatusFK <> 3 then null else tip.DateIn end AS [DateTime Goods In Completed],  
  case when tip.StockInStatusFK <> 3 then null else tip.ContainerNumber end AS [Goods In Trailer Number],    
  tip.SealNumber as [Goods In Seal Number],  
  CASE WHEN ISNULL(tip.ExternalReference,'') = '' THEN  tip.Free4 ELSE tip.ExternalReference END AS [Goods In Delivery Number],   
  tip.Free2 AS [Goods In PO Number],  
  MIN(sc1.InsertedDate) AS [Goods In Quality Release DateTime],  
  sc1.Instruction AS [Goods In Quality Release Instruction],  
  MIN(sc2.InsertedDate) AS [Goods In Update Positive Release DateTime],  
  sc2.Instruction AS [Goods In Update Positive Release Instruction],  
  co.InsertedDate AS [Reception of Delivery File],  
  case when co.ContainerOutStatusFK <> 5 then null else co.CollectionDate end AS [DateTime Shipment Completed],    
  co.ContainerNumber AS [Goods Out Trailer Number],  
  co.DocketValue1 AS [Goods Out PO Number],  
  co.DocketValue2 AS [Goods Out Delivery Number],  
  co.SealNumber as [Goods Out Seal Number],
  tip.GoodsInNumber,
  co.GoodsOrderNumber,
  tip.Supplier,
  tip.Building,
  tip.DivisionName
 INTO  
  #results  
 FROM #tmpInwardpallets tip  
 left join #containerOutLinePalletContentDetails colpc on colpc.PalletFK = tip.PalletFK  
 left join #containerOutDetails co on colpc.ContainerOutFK = co.ContainerOutPK  
 LEFT OUTER JOIN #allstatuschanges sc1 ON tip.PalletFK = sc1.PalletFK AND sc1.Instruction = 'ReleaseFromQI'  
 LEFT OUTER JOIN #allstatuschanges sc2 ON tip.PalletFK = sc2.PalletFK AND sc2.Instruction = 'UpdatePositiveRelease'  
 GROUP BY  
  tip.CustomerBarcode,  
  tip.StockItemCode,  
  tip.InsertedDate,  
  tip.DateIn,  
  tip.StockInStatusFK,  
  sc1.Instruction,  
  co.InsertedDate,  
  co.ContainerOutStatusFK,  
  co.CollectionDate,  
  sc2.Instruction,  
  tip.ContainerNumber, tip.SealNumber, tip.ExternalReference, tip.Free4, tip.Free2,  
  co.DocketValue1,  
  co.DocketValue2,  
  co.ContainerNumber,  
  co.SealNumber,
  tip.GoodsInNumber,
  co.GoodsOrderNumber,
  tip.Supplier,
  tip.Building,
  tip.DivisionName
  
 -- 6. Return the final report results.  
 SELECT  
  isnull(SSCC, '') as SSCC,  
  isnull(Material, '') as Material,  
    
  case when [Reception of Goods InFile] is null then ''   
  else   
  convert(nvarchar(10), [Reception of Goods InFile], 103) + ' '  + convert(nvarchar(12), [Reception of Goods InFile], 14)   
  end as [Reception of Goods In File],  
  
  case when [DateTime Goods In Completed] is null then ''   
  else   
  convert(nvarchar(10), [DateTime Goods In Completed], 103) + ' '  + convert(nvarchar(12), [DateTime Goods In Completed], 14)   
  end as [DateTime Goods In Completed]  
   
  ,isnull([Goods In Trailer Number], '') as [Goods In Trailer Number]  
  ,isnull([Goods In Delivery Number], '') as [Goods In Delivery Number]  
  ,isnull([Goods In PO Number], '') as [Goods In PO Number]   
  
  ,case when [Goods In Quality Release DateTime] is null then ''   
  else   
  convert(nvarchar(10), [Goods In Quality Release DateTime], 103) + ' '  + convert(nvarchar(12), [Goods In Quality Release DateTime], 14)   
  end as [Goods In Quality Release DateTime]  
    
  ,isnull([Goods In Quality Release Instruction], '') as [Goods In Quality Release Instruction]  
  
  ,case when [Goods In Update Positive Release DateTime] is null then ''   
  else   
  convert(nvarchar(10), [Goods In Update Positive Release DateTime], 103) + ' '  + convert(nvarchar(12), [Goods In Update Positive Release DateTime], 14)   
  end as [Goods In Update Positive Release DateTime]  
    
  ,isnull([Goods In Update Positive Release Instruction], '') as [Goods In Update Positive Release Instruction]  
  
  ,case when [Reception of Delivery File] is null then ''   
  else   
  convert(nvarchar(10), [Reception of Delivery File], 103) + ' '  + convert(nvarchar(12), [Reception of Delivery File], 14)   
  end as [Reception of Delivery File]  
   
  ,case when [DateTime Shipment Completed] is null then ''   
  else   
  convert(nvarchar(10), [DateTime Shipment Completed], 103) + ' '  + convert(nvarchar(12), [DateTime Shipment Completed], 14)   
  end as [DateTime Shipment Completed]  
  
  ,isnull([Goods Out Trailer Number], '') as [Goods Out Trailer Number]  
  ,isnull([Goods Out PO Number], '') as [Goods Out PO Number]  
  ,isnull([Goods Out Delivery Number], '') as [Goods Out Delivery Number]  ,
  GoodsInNumber,
  GoodsOrderNumber,
  Supplier,
  Building,
  DivisionName
 FROM   
  #results   
 ORDER BY   
  [Reception of Goods InFile] ASC, SSCC ASC, Material ASC  
END

/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[spReportsDistributionCharges]    Script Date: 02/11/2026 17:47:27 ******/

-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spReportsDistributionCharges]
(
	@divisionFK int,
	@dateFrom datetime,
	@dateTo datetime
)	
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data; Ensure this proc has a low impact when executed */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED; SET DEADLOCK_PRIORITY LOW

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT
	,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;
	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	DECLARE @var_divisionFK int, @var_dateFrom datetime, @var_dateTo datetime

	SET @var_divisionFK = @divisionFK; SET @var_dateFrom = @dateFrom; SET @var_dateTo = @dateTo

	SET @ParameterDetails = '@divisionFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_divisionFK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@dateFrom = ' 
		+ ISNULL(CAST(@var_dateFrom AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@dateTo = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_dateTo AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'')

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    --BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

		SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END


	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY
			

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start

	Select divisions.DivisionName, @dateFrom FromDate, @dateTo ToDate, palletAudit.EventDate, GoodsOrderNumber, 
	couts.Address1 + ', ' + couts.Address2 + ', ' + couts.Address3 + ', ' + couts.Address4 + ', ' + couts.Address5 + ', ' + isnull(counties.County, '') Address,
	Units, people.FirstName + ' ' + people.LastName OrderedBy, couts.InsertedDate, couts.Comments, Cartons as Packages, 
	couts.Weight, transport.TransportCompany, couts.TrackingNumber, orderCharge.TotalCharge OrderCharge, isnull(packagingCharge.TotalCharge, 0) PackagingCharge,
	shippingCharge.TotalCharge ShippingCharge, isnull(timedDeliveries.TotalCharge, 0) TimedDelivery, totalCharge.TotalCharge
	From tblContainerOuts couts
	inner join (Select ContainerOutFK, DivisionFK, sum (Units) Units
	from tblContainerOutLines 
	Group By ContainerOutFK, DivisionFK
	)cols on
	cols.ContainerOutFK = cOuts.ContainerOutPK

	inner join tblDivisions divisions on
	divisions.DivisionPK = cols.DivisionFK

	left outer join tblCounties counties on
	counties.CountyPK = couts.CountyFK

	left outer join (
		Select ContainerOutFK,min(ContainerOutLinePK) ContainerOutLineFK
		from tblContainerOutLines cols
		Group by ContainerOutFK
	)col on
	col.ContainerOutFK = cOuts.ContainerOutPK

	left outer join ( 
	select EventFK, MAX(EventDate) EventDate from tblPalletAudit
	Where EventTypeFK = 3 /*Stock Removed*/
	Group By EventFK
	) palletAudit on
	palletAudit.EventFK = col.ContainerOutLineFK
	

	left outer join (Select ContainerOutFK, sum(TotalCharge) TotalCharge 
	from tblContainerOutDistributionCharges
	Group by ContainerOutFK
	) totalCharge on
	totalCharge.ContainerOutFK = cOuts.ContainerOutPK

	left outer join (Select ContainerOutFK, sum(TotalCharge) TotalCharge 
	from tblContainerOutDistributionCharges
	Where DistributionChargeTypeFK = 1/*OrderCharge*/
	Group by ContainerOutFK
	) orderCharge on
	orderCharge.ContainerOutFK = cOuts.ContainerOutPK

	left outer join (Select ContainerOutFK, sum(TotalCharge) TotalCharge 
	from tblContainerOutDistributionCharges
	Where DistributionChargeTypeFK = 2/*Packaging*/
	Group by ContainerOutFK
	) packagingCharge on
	packagingCharge.ContainerOutFK = cOuts.ContainerOutPK

	left outer join (Select ContainerOutFK, sum(TotalCharge) TotalCharge 
	from tblContainerOutDistributionCharges
	Where DistributionChargeTypeFK = 3/*Shipping*/
	Group by ContainerOutFK
	) shippingCharge on
	shippingCharge.ContainerOutFK = cOuts.ContainerOutPK

	left outer join (Select ContainerOutFK, sum(TotalCharge) TotalCharge 
	from tblContainerOutDistributionCharges
	Where DistributionChargeTypeFK = 4/*Timed*/
	Group by ContainerOutFK
	) timedDeliveries on
	timedDeliveries.ContainerOutFK = cOuts.ContainerOutPK

	left outer join ( Select ContainerOutFK, sum(NumberOf) Cartons
	from tblContainerOutDistributionCharges coDCcartons 
	Where DistributionChargeTypeFK = 3 
	Group by ContainerOutFK
	) cartonCount on cartonCount.ContainerOutFK = cOuts.ContainerOutPK

	left outer join tblUsers users on
	users.UserPK = couts.InsertedBy

	left outer join tblPeople people on
	people.PersonPK = users.PersonFK

	left outer join tblTransportCompanies transport on
	transport.TransportCompanyPK = couts.TransportCompanyFK

	
	Where couts.ContainerOutTypeFK = 2 /*Distribution*/
	AND couts.ContainerOutStatusFK = 5 /*Completed*/
	AND cols.DivisionFK = @divisionFK
	AND palletAudit.EventDate >= @dateFrom AND palletAudit.EventDate <= @dateTo

	Order By couts.GoodsOrderNumber

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end

			
			
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spReportsDistributionChargesForExcel]
(
	@divisionFK int,
	@dateFrom datetime,
	@dateTo datetime
)	
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data; Ensure this proc has a low impact when executed */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED; SET DEADLOCK_PRIORITY LOW

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT
	,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;
	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	DECLARE @var_divisionFK int, @var_dateFrom datetime, @var_dateTo datetime

	SET @var_divisionFK = @divisionFK; SET @var_dateFrom = @dateFrom; SET @var_dateTo = @dateTo

	SET @ParameterDetails = '@divisionFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_divisionFK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@dateFrom = ' 
		+ ISNULL(CAST(@var_dateFrom AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@dateTo = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_dateTo AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'')

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    --BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

		SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END


	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY
			

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start

	Select divisions.DivisionName, @dateFrom FromDate, @dateTo ToDate, palletAudit.EventDate, GoodsOrderNumber, 
	couts.Address1, couts.Address2, couts.Address3, couts.Address4, couts.Address5, isnull(counties.County, '') County,
	Units, people.FirstName + ' ' + people.LastName OrderedBy, couts.InsertedDate, couts.Comments, Cartons as Packages, 
	couts.Weight, transport.TransportCompany, couts.TrackingNumber, orderCharge.TotalCharge OrderCharge, isnull(packagingCharge.TotalCharge, 0) PackagingCharge,
	shippingCharge.TotalCharge ShippingCharge, isnull(timedDeliveries.TotalCharge, 0) TimedDelivery, totalCharge.TotalCharge
	From tblContainerOuts couts
	inner join (Select ContainerOutFK, DivisionFK, sum (Units) Units
	from tblContainerOutLines 
	Group By ContainerOutFK, DivisionFK
	)cols on
	cols.ContainerOutFK = cOuts.ContainerOutPK

	inner join tblDivisions divisions on
	divisions.DivisionPK = cols.DivisionFK

	left outer join tblCounties counties on
	counties.CountyPK = couts.CountyFK

	left outer join (
		Select ContainerOutFK,min(ContainerOutLinePK) ContainerOutLineFK
		from tblContainerOutLines cols
		Group by ContainerOutFK
	)col on
	col.ContainerOutFK = cOuts.ContainerOutPK

	left outer join ( 
	select EventFK, MAX(EventDate) EventDate from tblPalletAudit
	Where EventTypeFK = 3 /*Stock Removed*/
	Group By EventFK
	) palletAudit on
	palletAudit.EventFK = col.ContainerOutLineFK

	left outer join (Select ContainerOutFK, sum(TotalCharge) TotalCharge 
	from tblContainerOutDistributionCharges
	Group by ContainerOutFK
	) totalCharge on
	totalCharge.ContainerOutFK = cOuts.ContainerOutPK

	left outer join (Select ContainerOutFK, sum(TotalCharge) TotalCharge 
	from tblContainerOutDistributionCharges
	Where DistributionChargeTypeFK = 1/*OrderCharge*/
	Group by ContainerOutFK
	) orderCharge on
	orderCharge.ContainerOutFK = cOuts.ContainerOutPK

	left outer join (Select ContainerOutFK, sum(TotalCharge) TotalCharge 
	from tblContainerOutDistributionCharges
	Where DistributionChargeTypeFK = 2/*Packaging*/
	Group by ContainerOutFK
	) packagingCharge on
	packagingCharge.ContainerOutFK = cOuts.ContainerOutPK

	left outer join (Select ContainerOutFK, sum(TotalCharge) TotalCharge 
	from tblContainerOutDistributionCharges
	Where DistributionChargeTypeFK = 3/*Shipping*/
	Group by ContainerOutFK
	) shippingCharge on
	shippingCharge.ContainerOutFK = cOuts.ContainerOutPK

	left outer join (Select ContainerOutFK, sum(TotalCharge) TotalCharge 
	from tblContainerOutDistributionCharges
	Where DistributionChargeTypeFK = 4/*Timed*/
	Group by ContainerOutFK
	) timedDeliveries on
	timedDeliveries.ContainerOutFK = cOuts.ContainerOutPK

	left outer join ( Select ContainerOutFK, sum(NumberOf) Cartons
	from tblContainerOutDistributionCharges coDCcartons 
	Where DistributionChargeTypeFK = 3 
	Group by ContainerOutFK
	) cartonCount on cartonCount.ContainerOutFK = cOuts.ContainerOutPK

	left outer join tblUsers users on
	users.UserPK = couts.InsertedBy

	left outer join tblPeople people on
	people.PersonPK = users.PersonFK

	left outer join tblTransportCompanies transport on
	transport.TransportCompanyPK = couts.TransportCompanyFK

	
	Where couts.ContainerOutTypeFK = 2 /*Distribution*/
	AND couts.ContainerOutStatusFK = 5 /*Completed*/
	AND cols.DivisionFK = @divisionFK
	AND palletAudit.EventDate >= @dateFrom AND palletAudit.EventDate <= @dateTo

	Order By couts.GoodsOrderNumber

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end

			
			
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END

 SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();      
      
 -- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters      
 DECLARE @var_divisionFK int--, @var_stockItemFK int, @var_batch nvarchar(200)      
      
 SET @var_divisionFK = ISNULL(@divisionFK,-1);      
      
 SET @ParameterDetails = '@divisionFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_divisionFK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'')

 SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);

 INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()      
      
 WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3      
 BEGIN       
  BEGIN TRY      
         
   -- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start      
   --DECLARE @var_divisionFK int = 446        
 DECLARE @divisionName nvarchar(50)    
 DECLARE @divisionCode nvarchar(50)    
 Select @divisionName = DivisionName, @divisionCode = divisioncode from tblDivisions Where DivisionPK = @var_divisionFK    
       
 drop table if exists #disttmpstocklevels    
 select @divisionName AccountName, @divisionCode AccountCode, s.stockitempk, s.StockItemCode, s.StockItemCodeAlias1 as Title, s.Description, vsl.ActualUnits, vsl.AvailableUnitsExcludingPending    
 into #disttmpstocklevels    
 from viewstocklevels vsl    
 inner join tblstockitems s on vsl.StockItemPK = s.StockItemPK     
 where s.DivisionfK =  @var_divisionFK AND s.IsArchived = 0    
                      
 ;WITH cte AS    
 (    
 SELECT AccountName, AccountCode, StockItemCode, Title, [Description], ActualUnits, AvailableUnitsExcludingPending as AvailableUnits, CAST(si.ArrivalDate AS DATE) ArrivalDate,    
   ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY stockitemcode ORDER BY ArrivalDate DESC) AS rn    
 from #disttmpstocklevels sl    
 inner join tblstockinlines sil on sl.StockItemPK = sil.StockItemFK    
 inner join tblstockins si on sil.StockInFK = si.StockInPK    
 where si.StockInStatusFK = 3    
 )    
 SELECT AccountName, AccountCode, StockItemCode, Title, [Description], ActualUnits, ActualUnits - AvailableUnits as OnOrder, ArrivalDate as LastReceived    
 FROM cte    
 WHERE rn = 1    
 order by stockitemcode    
    
      
   --select * from #disttmpstocklevels      
         
   -- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end

   BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END

        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK      
      
        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()      
    --END      
      
      
 SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);      
 SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails      
 ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;      
 INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()      
      
 WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3      
 BEGIN       
  BEGIN TRY      
   -- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start      
      
    drop table if exists #tmpAllOrders      
   select distinct do.* into #tmpAllOrders       
   from tblDistributionOrders do     
   inner join tblcontainerouts co on do.DistributionOrderPK = co.DistributionOrderFK  
   where OrderStatusFK <> 7 /*returned*/       
 and (@var_OrderStatusFK = -1 or OrderStatusFK = @var_OrderStatusFK)      
    --and OrderDate >= @var_FromDate and OrderDate <= @var_ToDate       
 and CollectionDate >= @var_FromDate and CollectionDate <= @var_ToDate       
      
   drop table if exists #tmpAllOrdersCO      
   select containeroutpk, distributionorderfk, goodsordernumber, DeliveryAddressFK, collectiondate    
   into #tmpAllOrdersCO      
   from tblcontainerouts       
   inner join #tmpAllOrders on DistributionOrderPK = DistributionOrderFK      
      
   Select dOrders.DistributionOrderPK,       
    StockItemCode [Stock Code],       
    s.Description [Stock Description],     
	Case When @var_Excludedetails = 1 then '' else ddm.DistributionDeliveryMethod end as [Delivery Method],      
    couts.GoodsOrderNumber [Stock Out],      
    dOrders.OrderReference [Order Reference],     
 	Case When @var_Excludedetails = 1 then ''  else trim(dda.EmailAddress + '  ' + dda.TelePhoneNumber) end as ContactInfo,    
      -- convert(varchar, dOrders.OrderDate, 103) [Order Date],      
     convert(varchar, couts.CollectionDate, 103) [Order Date],      
  Case When @var_Excludedetails = 1 then '' else convert(varchar, /*doa.EventDate*/ '19000101', 103) end as [Returned Date],      
    cols.Units + cols.UnitsPickedDifference [Units Ordered],      
    cols.Units [Units Fulfilled],      
   Case When @var_Excludedetails = 1 then '' else divisions.DivisionCode + ' : ' + divisions.DivisionName end as [Division],      
    convert(varchar, @var_FromDate, 103) [From Date],          
    convert(varchar, @var_ToDate, 103) [To Date],      
  Case When @var_Excludedetails = 1 then '' else  Person.PrintName end as PrintName ,  
  Case When @var_Excludedetails = 1 then '' else dda.Address1 end as Address1 ,
  dda.Address2,dda.Address3,dda.Address4,dda.Address5  
   From #tmpAllOrders dOrders      
   Inner Join #tmpAllOrdersCO couts on dOrders.DistributionOrderPK = couts.DistributionOrderFK         
   Inner join tblDistributionDeliveryAddresses dda on dda.DistributionDeliveryAddressPK = couts.DeliveryAddressFK    
   Inner Join tblContainerOutLines cols on cols.ContainerOutFK = cOuts.ContainerOutPK      
   Inner Join tblStockItems s on cols.stockitemfk = s.StockItemPK      
   inner join tblDivisions divisions on divisions.DivisionPK = s.DivisionFK      
   Left Join tblDistributionDeliveryMethods ddm on dOrders.DeliveryMethodFK = ddm.DistributionDeliveryMethodPK       
   left join (      
    select firstname + ' ' + lastname as PrintName      
    from tblpeople      
    inner join tblusers on personfk = personpk      
    where userpk = @var_PrintedBy      
   ) Person on 1 = 1      
      
   --inner join tblDistributionOrdersAudit doa on doa.DistributionOrderFK = dOrders.DistributionOrderPK ad doa.DistributionOrderAuditEventTypeFK = /*returned*/      
   Where  divisions.CustomerFK = @var_CustomerFK      
    and (@var_DivisionFK = -1 or divisions.DivisionPK = @var_DivisionFK)            
    --Order By dOrders.OrderDate, dOrders.DistributionOrderPK, couts.GoodsOrderNumber      
   Order By couts.CollectionDate, dOrders.DistributionOrderPK, couts.GoodsOrderNumber      
    
   -- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end      
   BREAK      
  END TRY      
  BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */      
   DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;      
   SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;      
   SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;      
      
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY       
   BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;      
             
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;      
      
            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID      
                  
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;      
                  
   IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)      
   BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END      
   ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */      
  END CATCH      
  SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1      
 END      
END

	,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;

			inner join tblDistributionDeliveryAddresses das on
			das.DistributionDeliveryAddressPK = cOuts.DeliveryAddressFK
			left outer join tblCounties counties on
			counties.CountyPK = das.CountyFK

			where sos.StockOrderPK = @var_stockOrderFK

			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;

			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END

-- =============================================    
-- Author:  <Author,,Name>    
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>    
-- Description: <Description,,>    
-- =============================================    
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spReportsDistributionOrderPickLists]    
(    
 @DistributionOrdersFKs xml,    
 @userFK int = -1
)    
AS    
BEGIN    
 /* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data; Ensure this proc has a low impact when executed */    
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED; SET DEADLOCK_PRIORITY LOW    
    
    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT    
 ,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;    
 SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();    
    
 -- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters    
 DECLARE @var_DistributionOrdersFKs xml, @var_userFK int    
 SET @var_DistributionOrdersFKs = @DistributionOrdersFKs; SET @var_userFK = @userFK;    
    
 SET @ParameterDetails = '@DistributionOrdersFKs = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_DistributionOrdersFKs AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@userFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_userFK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'')     
    
    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL     
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)    
    
    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)    
    --BEGIN    
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC     
    
  IF @ParentEventLogPK IS NULL SET @ParentEventLogPK = -1    
    
        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)    
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK    
    
        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()    
    --END    
    
 SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);    
 SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails    
 ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;    
 INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()    
    
 WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3    
 BEGIN     
  BEGIN TRY       
    
   -- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters    
      
   --get current user    
   Declare @myUser nvarchar(300)    
   Select @myUser = FirstName + ' ' + LastName     
   from tblUsers users     
   inner join tblPeople people on people.PersonPK = users.PersonFK    
   Where UserPK = @var_userFK     

	--selected orders    
   DROP TABLE if exists #SelectedDistributionOrdersPKs    
   select ParamValues.DistributionOrderPK.value('VALUE[1]','INT') as DistributionOrderPK    
   into #SelectedDistributionOrdersPKs    
   from @var_DistributionOrdersFKs.nodes('//FK') as ParamValues(DistributionOrderPK)  

   --get containerout    
   DROP TABLE if exists #tempContainerOut    
   SELECT distinct co.ContainerOutPK, co.Address1     
		+ case when co.Address2 = '' then '' else ', ' + co.Address2 end    
		+ case when co.Address3 = '' then '' else ', ' + co.Address3 end    
		+ case when co.Address4 = '' then '' else ', ' + co.Address4 end    
		+ case when co.Address5 = '' then '' else ', ' + co.Address5 end as DeliveryAddress, 
		DivisionName, CollectionDate, DistributionOrderFK
	INTO #tempContainerOut 
   FROM tblContainerOuts co
   inner join tblcontaineroutlines on ContainerOutPK = ContainerOutFK
   inner join tbldivisions on divisionpk = divisionfk
   inner join #SelectedDistributionOrdersPKs on DistributionOrderFK = DistributionOrderPK
          
   --get stock orders    
   DROP TABLE if exists #tempStockOrders    
   SELECT so.stockorderpk, containeroutfk, ResponsibleBuildingUnitFK INTO #tempStockOrders 
   FROM tblStockOrders so
   inner join #tempContainerOut on ContainerOutPK = ContainerOutFK
       
   --get works orders    
   DROP TABLE if exists #tempWorksOrders    
   SELECT DISTINCT wo.WorksOrderPk, WorksOrderTypeFK, FK, WorksORderOriginFK    
   INTO #tempWorksOrders    
   FROM #tempStockOrders so     
   inner join tblworksorders wo ON so.stockorderpk = wo.FK AND WorksORderOriginFK = 2 AND WorksOrderTypeFK = 3    
        
   --get movements    
   DROP TABLE if exists #tempWorksOrderMovements    
   SELECT woms.WorksOrderMovementPK, WorksOrderFK, DestinationLocationTypeFK, PalletFK, Units, EntirePallet
   INTO #tempWorksOrderMovements    
   FROM #tempWorksOrders wo    
   INNER JOIN dbo.tblWorksOrderMovements woms ON woms.WorksOrderFK = wo.WorksOrderPK    
   WHERE woms.DestinationLocationTypeFK = 2 and woms.IsArchived = 0   
        
   --get pallet / content 
   DROP TABLE if exists #tmpOrderpc  
   SELECT DISTINCT pc.PalletFK, pc.StockItemFK, StockItemCode, s.[Description], UnitTypeFK, p.palletpk, p.BayPosition, p.Barcode    
   INTO #tmpOrderpc    
   FROM #tempWorksOrderMovements AS woms    
   INNER JOIN tblPalletContent AS pc ON woms.PalletFK = pc.PalletFK   
   inner join tblpallets p on pc.palletfk = p.palletpk
   inner join tblstockitems s on s.StockItemPK = pc.StockItemFK
            
	Select DistributionOrderPK, wos.WorksOrderPK,  Units,   case when EntirePallet = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ then 'Pallets' when UnitTypeFK > 0 then 'Units' end as MovementType, 
		pc.StockItemCode,  pc.[Description] AS StockDescription,    
		pc.Barcode, cOuts.CollectionDate,  ddm.DistributionDeliveryMethod as TransportCompany,    
		palLocations.[Row],  palLocations.ColumnNo,  palLocations.Baylevel,  pc.Bayposition,    
		 cOuts.DeliveryAddress, 
		'' AS customerReference,  buildings.BuildingName + ' - ' + bus.BuildingUnit as BuildingUnit, DivisionName,palLocations.[Location] as SourceDest,
		 @myUser as [IssuedBy],    
		dbo.GetBSTDate() as [IssueTime]
 	From tblDistributionOrders do
	inner join tblDistributionDeliveryMethods ddm on ddm.DistributionDeliveryMethodPK = do.DeliveryMethodFK
    inner join #tempContainerOut cOuts on cOuts.distributionOrderFk = do.DistributionOrderPK   
	inner join #tempStockOrders AS sos on cOuts.ContainerOutPK = sos.ContainerOutFK
	inner join tblBuildingUnits AS bus ON bus.BuildingUnitPK = sos.ResponsibleBuildingUnitFK    
    inner join tblBuildings AS buildings ON buildings.BuildingPK = bus.BuildingFK  
	inner join #tempWorksOrders wos on sos.StockOrderPK = wos.FK    
	inner join appWorksOrderTypes AS wots on wots.WorksOrderTypePK = wos.WorksOrderTypeFK    
	inner join #tempWorksOrderMovements AS woms on woms.WorksOrderFK = wos.WorksOrderPK    
	inner join #tmpOrderpc AS pc on pc.PalletFK = woms.PalletFK     
	inner join viewPalletLocations AS palLocations  ON palLocations.palletPk = pc.palletpk
    
   -- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end           
          
   BREAK    
  END TRY    
  BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */    
   DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;    
   SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;    
   SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;    
    
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY     
   BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;    
           
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;    
    
            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID    
                
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;    
                
   IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)    
   BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END    
   ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */    
  END CATCH    
  SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1    
 END    
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spReportsDistributionPickingList]
--(
--	@userFK int
--)	
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data; Ensure this proc has a low impact when executed */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED; SET DEADLOCK_PRIORITY LOW

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT
	,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;
	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	--DECLARE 

	SET @ParameterDetails = ''

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    --BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

		SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END


	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY
			

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start

			Select couts.GoodsOrderNumber, sis.StockItemCode + ', ' + sis.Description as StockItemCode, cast(cOutLinePC.Units as integer) Units,
			case pallets.LocationTypeFK when 1/*Racking*/ then bus.BuildingUnit + ' ' + case when buRows.Translate = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ then buRows.TranslatedRow else buRows.Row end + buCols.BuildingUnitColumnName + lower(buBays.BayLevel) + left('0' + cast(pallets.BayPosition as nvarchar(50)),2) else 'Call Administrator' end as Location,
			das.Address1,
			das.Address2,
			das.Address3,
			das.Address4,
			das.Address5,
			isnull(counties.County, '') County,
			isnull(countries.Country, '') Country,
			couts.Comments
			From tblStockOrders sos
			inner join tblContainerOuts cOuts on
			cOuts.ContainerOutPK = sos.ContainerOutFK
			inner join tblDistributionDeliveryAddresses das on
			das.DistributionDeliveryAddressPK = cOuts.DeliveryAddressFK
			left outer join tblCounties counties on
			counties.CountyPK = das.CountyFK
			left outer join tblCountries countries on
			countries.CountryPK = das.CountryFK
			inner join tblContainerOutLines cOutLines on
			cOutLines.ContainerOutFK = cOuts.ContainerOutPK
			inner join tblContainerOutLinePalletContent cOutLinePC on
			cOutLinePC.ContainerOutLineFK = cOutLines.ContainerOutLinePK	
			inner join tblStockItems sis on
			sis.StockItemPK = cOutLines.StockItemFK	
			inner join tblPalletContent pc on
			pc.PalletContentPK = cOutLinePC.PalletContentFK
			left outer join tblPallets pallets on
			pallets.PalletPK = pc.PalletFK
			left outer join tblBuildingUnitBays buBays on
			buBays.BuildingUnitBayPK = pallets.LocationFK
			AND pallets.LocationTypeFK = 1 /*Racking*/
			left outer join tblBuildingUnitColumns buCols on
			buCols.BuildingUnitColumnPK = buBays.BuildingUnitColumnFK
			left outer join tblBuildingUnitRows buRows on
			buRows.BuildingUnitRowPK = buCols.BuildingUnitRowFK
			left outer join tblBuildingUnits bus on
			bus.BuildingUnitPK = buRows.BuildingUnitFK	
			where cOuts.ContainerOutStatusFK < 5 /*Not Completed or cancelled*/
			AND cOuts.ContainerOutTypeFK = 2 /*Distribution*/
			--sos.ResponsibleUserFK = @userFK
			Order By GoodsOrderNumber

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end

			
			
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spReportsDistributionReturns]  
(  
 @CustomerFK int,  
 @DivisionFK int = -1,  
 @DeliveryType int = -1,  
 @FromDate datetime,  
 @ToDate datetime,  
 @ExportToExcel bit,  
 @PrintedBy int  
)   
AS

 /* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data; Ensure this proc has a low impact when executed */

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT  
 ,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;  
 SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();  
  
 -- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters  
 DECLARE @var_CustomerFK int, @var_DivisionFK int, @var_DeliveryType int, @var_FromDate datetime, @var_ToDate datetime, @var_ExportToExcel bit, @var_PrintedBy int  
  
 SET @var_CustomerFK = @CustomerFK; SET @var_divisionFK = @divisionFK; SET @var_DeliveryType = @DeliveryType; SET @var_FromDate = @FromDate;   
 SET @var_ToDate = @ToDate; SET @var_ExportToExcel = @ExportToExcel; SET @var_PrintedBy = @PrintedBy  
  
 SET @ParameterDetails = '@CustomerFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_CustomerFK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ', @divisionFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_divisionFK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') +   
  '@DeliveryType = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_DeliveryType AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ', @FromDate = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_FromDate AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') +   
  ',@ToDate = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_ToDate AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@ExportToExcel = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_ExportToExcel AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'')  
  + ',@PrintedBy = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_PrintedBy AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'')  
  
    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL   
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)  
  
    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)  
    --BEGIN  
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC   
  
  SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)  
  
        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)  
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK  
  
        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()  
    --END  
  
  
 SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);  
 SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails  
 ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;  
 INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()  
  
 WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3  
 BEGIN   
  BEGIN TRY  
   -- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start  

   drop table if exists #tmpreturnedaudit
   select * into #tmpreturnedaudit
   from tblDistributionOrderAudit
   where DistributionOrderAuditEventTypeFK = 13 and inserteddate >= @var_FromDate  
    and inserteddate <= @var_ToDate
  
   drop table if exists #tmpReturnedOrders  
   select do.* into #tmpReturnedOrders   
   from tblDistributionOrders  do 
   inner join #tmpreturnedaudit ra on do.distributionorderpk = ra.distributionorderfk
   where OrderStatusFK = 7 /*returned*/   
    and (@var_DeliveryType = -1 or DeliveryMethodFK = @var_DeliveryType)  
    --and OrderDate >= @var_FromDate  
    --and OrderDate <= @var_ToDate   
  
   drop table if exists #tmpreturnedCO  
   select containeroutpk, distributionorderfk, goodsordernumber  
   into #tmpreturnedCO  
   from tblcontainerouts   
   inner join #tmpReturnedOrders on DistributionOrderPK = DistributionOrderFK  
  
   Select dOrders.DistributionOrderPK,   
    StockItemCode [Stock Code],   
    s.Description [Stock Description],  
    ddm.DistributionDeliveryMethod [Delivery Method],  
    couts.GoodsOrderNumber [Stock Out],  
    dOrders.OrderReference [Order Reference],  
    convert(varchar, dOrders.OrderDate, 103) [Order Date],  
   
    convert(varchar, doa.InsertedDate, 103) as [Returned Date],  
    cols.Units + cols.UnitsPickedDifference [Units Ordered],  
    cols.Units [Units Fulfilled],  
    divisions.DivisionCode + ' : ' + divisions.DivisionName [Division],  
    convert(varchar, @var_FromDate, 103) [From Date],      
    convert(varchar, @var_ToDate, 103) [To Date],  
    Person.PrintName  
   From #tmpReturnedOrders dOrders  
   Inner Join #tmpreturnedCO couts on dOrders.DistributionOrderPK = couts.DistributionOrderFK  
   Inner Join tblContainerOutLines cols on cols.ContainerOutFK = cOuts.ContainerOutPK  
   Inner Join tblStockItems s on cols.stockitemfk = s.StockItemPK  
   inner join tblDivisions divisions on divisions.DivisionPK = s.DivisionFK  
   Left Join tblDistributionDeliveryMethods ddm on dOrders.DeliveryMethodFK = ddm.DistributionDeliveryMethodPK   
   left join (  
    select firstname + ' ' + lastname as PrintName  
    from tblpeople  
    inner join tblusers on personfk = personpk  
    where userpk = @var_PrintedBy  
   ) Person on 1 = 1  
   inner join #tmpreturnedaudit doa on doa.DistributionOrderFK = dOrders.DistributionOrderPK aNd doa.DistributionOrderAuditEventTypeFK = 13 /*returned*/  
   Where  divisions.CustomerFK = @var_CustomerFK  
    and (@var_DivisionFK = -1 or divisions.DivisionPK = @var_DivisionFK)        
   Order By dOrders.OrderDate, dOrders.DistributionOrderPK, couts.GoodsOrderNumber  
  
   -- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end  
   BREAK  
  END TRY  
  BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */  
   DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;  
   SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;  
   SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;  
  
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY   
   BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;  
         
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;  
  
            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID  
              
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;  
              
   IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)  
   BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END  
   ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */  
  END CATCH  
  SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1  
 END  
END

-- =============================================              
-- Author:  <Author,,Name>              
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>              
-- Description: <Description,,>              
-- =============================================              
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spReportsDistributionWeeklycharges]              
(              
 @CustomerFK int,              
 @DivisionFK int = -1,              
 @FromDate datetime,              
 @ToDate datetime,              
 @PrintedBy int,            
 @ShowDetailedBreakdown bit            
)               
AS              
BEGIN              
 /* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data; Ensure this proc has a low impact when executed */              
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED; SET DEADLOCK_PRIORITY LOW              
              
    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT              
 ,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;              
 SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();              
              
 -- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters              
 DECLARE @var_CustomerFK int, @var_DivisionFK int, @var_FromDate datetime, @var_ToDate datetime, @var_ShowDetailedBreakdown bit, @var_PrintedBy int              
              
 SET @var_CustomerFK = @CustomerFK; SET @var_divisionFK = @divisionFK; SET @var_FromDate = @FromDate;               
 SET @var_ToDate = @ToDate; SET @var_ShowDetailedBreakdown = @ShowDetailedBreakdown; SET @var_PrintedBy = @PrintedBy              
              
 SET @ParameterDetails = '@CustomerFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_CustomerFK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ', @divisionFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_divisionFK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') +               
  ', @FromDate = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_FromDate AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') +               
  ',@ToDate = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_ToDate AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@ShowDetailedBreakdown = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_ShowDetailedBreakdown AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'')              
  + ',@PrintedBy = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_PrintedBy AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'')              
              
    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL               
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)              
              
    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)              
    --BEGIN              
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC               
              
  SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)              
              
        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)              
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK              
              
        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()              
    --END              
                
 SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);              
 SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails              
 ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;              
 INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()              
    
 WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3              
 BEGIN               
  BEGIN TRY              
   -- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start              
              
  drop table if exists #tmpAllDistCharges         
  select DistributionOrderPK, containeroutpk, do.orderdate, codc.distributionchargetypefk, distributionchargefk, totalcharge            
   into #tmpAllDistCharges            
   from tblContainerOutDistributionCharges codc            
   inner join tblcontainerouts co on codc.containeroutfk = co.ContainerOutPK            
   inner join tblDistributionOrders do on do.DistributionOrderPK = co.DistributionOrderFK            
 -- inner join (select containeroutfk, divisionfk from tblcontaineroutlines)            
   where codc.InsertedDate >= @var_FromDate and codc.InsertedDate <= @var_ToDate and do.OrderStatusFK in (4,5,6,7) /*Dispatched / Hubbed / Delivered / Returned*/            
               
   drop table if exists #tmpChargeDetail            
   select distinct dc.*, col.DivisionFK            
   into #tmpChargeDetail            
   from #tmpAllDistCharges dc            
   inner join tblcontaineroutlines col on dc.containeroutpk = col.ContainerOutFK            
   --inner join tbldivisions d on col.DivisionFK = d.DivisionPK            
   left join tblDistributionOrderCharges doc on doc.DistributionOrderChargePK = dc.DistributionChargeFK and dc.DistributionChargeTypeFK = 1            
   left join tblDistributionPackagingTypes dpt on doc.DistributionOrderChargePK = dpt.DistributionPackagingTypePK and dc.DistributionChargeTypeFK = 1            
              
 drop table if exists #tmpChargeSummary            
 select cd.DivisionFK, DistributionChargeType, distributionchargetypefk, sum(totalCharge) TotalCharge            
 into #tmpChargeSummary            
 from #tmpChargeDetail cd             
 inner join appDistributionChargeTypes ct on ct.distributionchargetypepk = cd.distributionchargetypefk            
 group by cd.DivisionFK, DistributionChargeType, distributionchargetypefk            
 -- select * from #tmpChargeSummary             
              
  drop table if exists #tmpDivisionTotalCharge            
  select cs.DivisionFK, sum(cs.totalCharge) TotalCharge            
  into #tmpDivisionTotalCharge            
  from #tmpChargeSummary cs            
  group by cs.DivisionFK            
            
  drop table if exists #tmpDivisionsToInclude            
  select DivisionPK, DivisionCode, DivisionName            
  into #tmpDivisionsToInclude            
  from tblDivisions             
  where AutoGenerateInvoice = 1 and customerfk = @var_CustomerFK            
 and (@var_divisionFK = -1 or DivisionPK = @var_divisionFK)          
         
 drop table if exists #tmpdistextraservices        
 select divisionfk, sum(NumberOf*Charge) as totalCharge        
 into #tmpdistextraservices         
 from tblextraservices es        
 inner join #tmpDivisionsToInclude divs on es.DivisionFK = divs.DivisionPK         
 inner join tblStockOrders so on so.StockOrderPK = es.StockOrderFK
 inner join tblContainerOuts co on so.ContainerOutFK = co.ContainerOutPK
 where es.ExtraServiceDate >= @var_FromDate and es.ExtraServiceDate <= @var_ToDate      and ContainerOutStatusFK=5     
 group by divisionfk        
            
 declare @printuser nvarchar(max)            
 select @printuser = Firstname + ' ' + Lastname             
 from tblpeople             
 inner join tblusers on PersonPK = personfk            
 where userpk = @var_PrintedBy            
              
  select distinct divs.DivisionCode, divs.DivisionName, coalesce(sum(case when escharges.totalCharge is null then 0 else escharges.totalCharge end) + sum(case when cs.totalCharge is null then 0 else cs.totalCharge end), 0) TotalCharge,             
 case when @var_ShowDetailedBreakdown = 1 then sum(csOrder.totalCharge) else 0 end as OrderCharge,             
 case when @var_ShowDetailedBreakdown = 1 then sum(csPack.totalCharge) else 0 end as PackingCharge,             
 case when @var_ShowDetailedBreakdown = 1 then sum(csShip.totalCharge) else 0 end as ShippingCharge,             
 case when @var_ShowDetailedBreakdown = 1 then sum(escharges.totalCharge) else 0 end as ExtraServiceCharge,           
 coalesce(@printuser, 'Automated Report') as PrintedBy, @var_ShowDetailedBreakdown ShowBreakdown,     
 --'Week No ' + cast(DATEPART(week, @var_ToDate) as nvarchar(20)) as WeekNo          
 'Week No ' + cast(dbo.ISOweek(@var_ToDate) as nvarchar(20)) as WeekNo   ,
 cast(@var_FromDate as  Date) FromDate,cast(@var_ToDate as  Date) ToDate
  from #tmpDivisionsToInclude divs            
  left join #tmpDivisionTotalCharge cs on divs.DivisionPK = cs.DivisionFK            
  left join #tmpChargeSummary csOrder on divs.DivisionPK = csOrder.DivisionFK and csOrder.distributionchargetypefk = 1            
  left join #tmpChargeSummary csPack on divs.DivisionPK = cspack.DivisionFK and csPack.distributionchargetypefk = 2            
  left join #tmpChargeSummary csShip on divs.DivisionPK = csShip.DivisionFK and csShip.distributionchargetypefk = 3         
  left join #tmpdistextraservices escharges on divs.DivisionPK = escharges.divisionfk        
  group by divs.DivisionCode, divs.DivisionName            
            
  --select * from appDistributionChargeTypes            
   -- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end              
   BREAK              
  END TRY              
  BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */              
   DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;              
   SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;              
   SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;              
              
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY               
   BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;              
                     
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;              
              
            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID              
                          
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;              
                          
   IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)              
   BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END              
   ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */              
  END CATCH              
  SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1              
 END              
END
