CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spReportsDocketFinder]
(
	@startDate datetime = '', 
	@endDate datetime = '',
	@divisionFK int = -1,
	@stockItemFK int = -1,
	@batch nvarchar(50) = ''
)	
AS
BEGIN	
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data; Ensure this proc has a low impact when executed */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED; SET DEADLOCK_PRIORITY LOW

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT
	,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;
	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	DECLARE @var_startDate datetime, @var_endDate datetime, @var_divisionFK int, @var_stockItemFK int, @var_batch nvarchar(50)

	SET @var_startDate = @startDate; SET @var_endDate = @endDate; SET @var_divisionFK = @divisionFK; SET @var_stockItemFK = @stockItemFK; SET @var_batch = @batch

	SET @ParameterDetails = '@startDate = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_startDate AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@endDate = ' 
		+ ISNULL(CAST(@var_endDate AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@divisionFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_divisionFK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') 
			+ ',@stockItemFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_stockItemFK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@batch = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_batch AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'')

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    --BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

		SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END


	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY
			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start

			DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #TempContainerOuts
			SELECT co.*
			INTO #TempContainerOuts
			FROM tblcontainerouts co 
			--INNER JOIN tblcontaineroutlines col ON co.ContainerOutPK = col.ContainerOutFK
			WHERE co.containeroutstatusfk = 5 
				AND co.CollectionDate >= @var_startDate and co.CollectionDate <= @var_endDate +1

			DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #TempContainerOutLines
			SELECT col.*
			INTO #TempContainerOutLines
			FROM tblcontaineroutlines col
			INNER JOIN #TempContainerOuts co ON co.ContainerOutPK = col.ContainerOutFK
			WHERE col.DivisionFK = @var_divisionFK
				AND (col.stockitemfk = @var_stockItemFK or @var_stockItemFK = -1)
				AND (col.batch = @var_batch or @var_batch = '')
		
			DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #TempContainerOutLinePalletContent
			SELECT ContainerOutLineFK, PalletFK, max(PalletContentFK)PAlletContentFK, CustomerPalletNumber, sum(colpc.Units) Units, sum(colpc.Pallets) Pallets 
			INTO #TempContainerOutLinePalletContent
			FROM tblcontaineroutlinepalletcontent colpc
			INNER JOIN #TempContainerOutLines col ON colpc.ContainerOutLineFK = col.ContainerOutLinePK
			Group By ContainerOutLineFK, PalletFK, CustomerPalletNumber
					
			DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #tempPalAudit
			SELECT 1 as PalletsOut, pa.PalletFK, EventFK
			INTO #tempPalAudit
			from tblPalletAudit pa
			INNER JOIN #TempContainerOutLinePalletContent colpc ON pa.eventfk = colpc.ContainerOutLineFK AND pa.palletfk = colpc.palletfk
			Where EventTypeFK = 2
			Group By EventFK, pa.PalletFK
			
			DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #TempStockIns
			SELECT si.* 
			INTO #TempStockIns
			FROM tblstockins si 
			INNER JOIN tblcontainerins ci ON si.ContainerInFK = ci.ContainerInPK
			WHERE si.stockinstatusfk = 3 
				AND si.DivisionFK =@var_divisionFK 
				AND (ci.DateIn >= @var_startDate and ci.DateIn <= @var_endDate +1)

			DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #TempStockInLines
			SELECT sil.* 
			INTO #TempStockInLines
			FROM tblstockinlines sil
			INNER JOIN #TempStockIns si ON sil.StockInFK = si.stockinpk
			WHERE (sil.stockitemfk = @var_stockItemFK or @var_stockItemFK = -1)
				AND (sil.batch = @var_batch or @var_batch = '')

			DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #TempDivision
			SELECT d.* 
			INTO #TempDivision
			FROM tbldivisions d
			WHERE d.divisionpk = @var_divisionFK

			DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #TempDocketIdentifications
			SELECT cdis.*
			INTO #TempDocketIdentifications
			FROM tblCustomerDocketIdentifications cdis
			INNER JOIN #TempDivision d ON cdis.Customerfk = d.customerfk
		

			select * from (
				select EventType, [Goods In], [Goods Out], Date, StockItemFK, Batch, sum(Pallets) Pallets, StartDate, 
					EndDate, DivisionName, StockItemCode, sum(Units) Units, EventDate, DeliveryAddress   
				from (
					Select 'Out' as EventType, '' as [Goods In], 
						cOuts.GoodsOrderNumber + ' '   +  case when cdis.CustomerDocketIdentificationPK is null then ' ' else
							' ( ' + 
								case cdis.FieldFK when 40 then
										cdis.Prefix + ' ' + cOuts.DocketValue1
								when 41 then
										cdis.Prefix + ' ' + cOuts.DocketValue2
								when 42 then
										cdis.Prefix + ' ' + cOuts.DocketValue3
								end 
								+ ' ' +
								case cdis.Field2FK when 40 then
										cdis.Prefix2 + ' ' + cOuts.DocketValue1
								when 41 then
										cdis.Prefix2 + ' ' + cOuts.DocketValue2
								when 42 then
										cdis.Prefix2 + ' ' + cOuts.DocketValue3
								else
										' '
								end
								+ ' ) ' End as [Goods Out],  
						left(cOuts.CollectionDate,12) Date, cOutLines.StockItemFK, coalesce(pc.Batch, cOutLines.Batch) Batch,
						--case when cOutLines.Pallets = 0 then 
						--	case when palletsOutPA.PalletsOut is null then 0 else count(palletsOutPA.PalletsOut) end 
						--else 
						--	case when colpc.CustomerPalletNumber = '' then 1  else colpc.Pallets end 
						--end Pallets,
						sum(palletsOutPA.PalletsOut) AS Pallets,
						left(@var_startDate,12) as StartDate, left(@var_endDate,12)as EndDate, divisions.DivisionName,case when @var_stockItemFK=-1 then '' else stockItems.StockItemCode end as StockItemCode, 
						sum(colpc.Units) as Units, cOuts.collectionDate as EventDate,
						cOuts.Address1 + ' ' + cOuts.Address2 + ' ' + cOuts.Address3 + ' ' + cOuts.Address4 + ' ' + cOuts.Address5 as DeliveryAddress
				
					from #TempContainerOuts cOuts
					inner join #TempContainerOutLines cOutLines on cOutLines.ContainerOutFK = cOuts.ContainerOutPK
					left outer join #TempContainerOutLinePalletContent colpc on colpc.ContainerOutLineFK = cOutLines.ContainerOutLinePK
					LEFT OUTER JOIN #tempPalAudit palletsOutPA on palletsOutPA.EventFK = cOutLines.ContainerOutLinePK AND palletsOutPA.PalletFK = colpc.PalletFK
					inner join #TempDivision divisions on divisions.DivisionPK = cOutLines.DivisionFK
					inner join tblStockItems stockItems on stockItems.StockItemPK = cOutLines.StockItemFK
					left outer join tblPalletContent pc on pc.PalletContentPK = colpc.PalletContentFK
					left outer join #TempDocketIdentifications cdis on  cdis.CustomerFK = divisions.CustomerFK AND cdis.DocketTypeFK = 2 
					group by cOuts.GoodsOrderNumber, cOuts.CollectionDate, cOutLines.stockitemFK, coalesce(pc.Batch, cOutLines.Batch), 
						divisions.DivisionName, stockItems.StockItemCode, cOutLines.Pallets, palletsOutPA.PalletsOut,  
						colpc.CustomerPalletNumber, colpc.Pallets, cOutLines.Units, cdis.CustomerDocketIdentificationPK, cdis.FieldFK, cdis.Field2FK, cdis.Prefix, cdis.Prefix2,
						cOuts.DocketValue1, cOuts.DocketValue2, cOuts.DocketValue3, cOuts.Address1, cOuts.Address2, cOuts.Address3, cOuts.Address4, cOuts.Address5
					)sub
				group by [Goods Out], Date, stockitemfk, batch, DivisionName, StockItemCode, Eventtype, [Goods In], StartDate, EndDate, EventDate, DeliveryAddress
	
				union	

				select 'In' as EventType, ci.GoodsInNumber + ' '  + CASE WHEN cdis.CustomerDocketIdentificationPK is null THEN '' ELSE
					' ( ' +
						CASE cdis.FieldFK 
							WHEN 1 THEN
								cdis.Prefix + ' ' + ci.Free1
							WHEN 2 THEN
								cdis.Prefix + ' ' + ci.Free2
							WHEN 3 THEN
								cdis.Prefix + ' ' + ci.Free3
							WHEN 4 THEN
								cdis.Prefix + ' ' + ci.Free4
							WHEN 5 THEN
								cdis.Prefix + ' ' + ci.Free5
							ELSE
								''
							END
							+ ' ' +
							CASE cdis.Field2FK 
							WHEN 1 THEN
								cdis.Prefix2 + ' ' + ci.Free1
							WHEN 2 THEN
								cdis.Prefix2 + ' ' + ci.Free2
							WHEN 3 THEN
								cdis.Prefix2 + ' ' + ci.Free3
							WHEN 4 THEN
								cdis.Prefix2 + ' ' + ci.Free4
							WHEN 5 THEN
								cdis.Prefix2 + ' ' + ci.Free5
							ELSE
								''
						END
						+ ' ) ' end  as [Goods In], 
					'' as [Goods Out], left(ci.DateIn,12) Date, sil.StockItemFK, sil.Batch, sum(sil.pallets)/*sum of pallets on matching lines*/ as Pallets, 
					left(@var_startDate,12) as StartDate, left(@var_endDate,12)as EndDate, div.DivisionName as DivisionName,
					case when @var_stockItemFK=-1 then '' else s.StockItemCode end as StockItemCode, sum(LineUnits)/*sum of all unis on matching lines*/ as Units, ci.DateIn as EnventDate, ' ' as DeliveryAddress
				
				from tblcontainerIns ci
				inner join #TempStockIns si on si.containerinfk = ci.containerinpk
				inner join #TempStockInLines sil on sil.stockinfk = si.stockinpk
				inner join (
					select stockinlinepk, pallets * Units as LineUnits 
					from #TempStockInLines
				) sil2 on sil.stockinlinepk = sil2.stockinlinepk /*second join required to get sum of matching lines without grouping by pallet*/
				left join #TempDivision div on div.DivisionPK = si.DivisionFK
				left join tblStockItems s on s.stockitemPK = sil.stockitemfk
				LEFT OUTER JOIN #TempDocketIdentifications AS cdis on cdis.CustomerFK= div.CustomerFK and cdis.DocketTypeFK=1
				group by ci.GoodsInNumber, ci.DateIn, sil.stockitemfk, sil.batch, div.DivisionName, s.StockItemCode,--, sil.pallets, sil.Units
					cdis.CustomerDocketIdentificationPK, cdis.FieldFK, cdis.Field2FK, cdis.Prefix,cdis.Prefix2, ci.Free1, ci.Free2, ci.Free3, ci.Free4, ci.Free5	
		
			) subq
			order by EventType, EventDate
			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end			
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END

-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spReportsDriveThruSummaryReport]
(
	@buildingUnitFK int,
	@stockItemFK int
)	
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data; Ensure this proc has a low impact when executed */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED; SET DEADLOCK_PRIORITY LOW

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT
	,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;
	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	DECLARE @var_buildingUnitFK int, @var_stockItemFK int
	SET @var_buildingUnitFK = @buildingUnitFK; SET @var_stockItemFK = @stockItemFK
	SET @ParameterDetails = '@buildingUnitFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_buildingUnitFK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@stockItemFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_stockItemFK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'')

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    --BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

		SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END


	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY
			

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start

			Declare @for as nvarchar(100)

			Set @for = ''
			IF(@var_buildingUnitFK <> -1) 
			BEGIN
				Set @for = 'Building Unit: ' + (Select BuildingName + ' - ' + BuildingUnit from tblBuildingUnits bus inner join tblBuildings bs 
				on bs.BuildingPK = bus.BuildingFK where BuildingUnitPK = @var_buildingUnitFK)
			END

			IF(@var_stockItemFK <> -1) 
			BEGIN
				Set @for = @for + (case when len(@for) > 0 then ', ' else '' end) + 'Stock Item: ' 
					+ (Select StockItemCode from tblStockItems where StockItemPK = @var_stockItemFK)
			END
	
			Select [For],BuildingUnit,DivisionName,StockItemCode,Location, count(*) Pallets,
			--cast(Actual as nvarchar(100)) + ' ' + isnull(Abbreviation, '') as Actual, cast(Available as nvarchar(100)) + ' ' 
			--+ isnull(Abbreviation, '') as Available, cast(OnOrder as nvarchar(100)) + ' ' + isnull(Abbreviation, '') as OnOrder,
			sum(Actual) Actual, Sum(Available) Available, sum(OnOrder) OnOrder
			from (

			Select @for as [For],
			'Building Unit: ' + buildings.BuildingName + ' - ' + bus.BuildingUnit BuildingUnit, 
			divs.DivisionName,
			stockItems.StockItemCode, 
			case when LocationTypeFK = 1 then 
				case when buRows.Translate = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ then
					case when buRows.ReverseTranslate = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ then
						buRows.TranslatedRow + right('0' + cast((buRows.TranslateColumn - buCols.BuildingUnitColumn) as nvarchar(10)),2) 
							+ case when buRows.RackingTypeFK = 1/*Conventional*/ then lower(buBays.BayLevel) + right('0' + cast(pallets.BayPosition as nvarchar(10)),2) else '' end
					else
						buRows.TranslatedRow + right('0' + cast((buCols.BuildingUnitColumn + buRows.TranslateColumn) as nvarchar(10)),2) 
							+ case when buRows.RackingTypeFK = 1/*Conventional*/ then lower(buBays.BayLevel) + right('0' + cast(pallets.BayPosition as nvarchar(10)),2)  else '' end
					End
				else 
					buRows.Row + right('0' + cast(buCols.BuildingUnitColumnName as nvarchar(10)),2) 
						+ case when buRows.RackingTypeFK = 1/*Conventional*/ then lower(buBays.BayLevel) + right('0' + cast(pallets.BayPosition as nvarchar(10)),2) else '' end
				End
			when LocationTypeFK = 2 then 
				loadingBays.LoadingBay 
			when LocationTypeFK = 3 then
				setDownAreas.SetDownArea
			End as Location,
			case when stockItems.EachesTypeFK <> -1 then pc.ActualEachUnits else pc.ActualUnits End as Actual,
			case when stockItems.EachesTypeFK <> -1 then pc.AvailableEachUnits else pc.AvailableUnits End as Available,
			case when stockItems.EachesTypeFK <> -1 then pc.ActualEachUnits - pc.AvailableEachUnits else pc.ActualUnits - pc.AvailableUnits End as OnOrder,
			LocationTypeFK,
			uts.Abbreviation

			from 
			(Select * 
			from tblPallets 
			where IsArchived = 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/ 
			AND PalletStatusFK <> 10 /*OnRoute*/) pallets

			/*BAYS*/
			left outer join tblBuildingUnitBays buBays on
			buBays.BuildingUnitBayPK = LocationFK
			AND pallets.LocationTypeFK = 1/*Building Unit Bay*/

			left outer join tblBuildingUnitColumns buCols on
			buCols.BuildingUnitColumnPK = buBays.BuildingUnitColumnFK

			left outer join tblBuildingUnitRows buRows on
			buRows.BuildingUnitRowPK = buCols.BuildingUnitRowFK
			/*END OF BAYS*/

			/*LOADING BAYS*/
			left outer join tblLoadingBays loadingBays on
			loadingBays.LoadingBayPK = LocationFK
			AND LocationTypeFK = 2/*LoadingBay*/
			/*END OF LOADING BAYS*/

			/*SET DOWN AREAS*/
			left outer join tblSetDownAreas setDownAreas on
			setDownAreas.SetDownAreaPK = LocationFK
			AND LocationTypeFK = 3/*SetDownArea*/
			/*END OF SET DOWN AREAS*/

			/*Pallet Status*/
			left outer join appPalletStatus ps on
			ps.PalletStatusPK = pallets.PalletStatusFK

			/*Pallet Content*/
			inner join (
				Select PalletFK, StockItemFK, Batch, 
				sum(ActualUnits) ActualUnits, sum(ActualEaches * ActualUnits) ActualEachUnits,
				sum(AvailableUnits) AvailableUnits, sum(AvailableEaches * AvailableUnits) AvailableEachUnits 
				From (Select * from tblPalletContent where IsArchived = 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/) subPc
				inner join tblStockItems sis on
				sis.StockItemPK = subPc.StockItemFK
				Where (sis.EachesTypeFK < 0) OR (sis.EachesTypeFK > 0 AND subPc.EachUnits > 0)
				Group By PalletFK, StockItemFK, Batch
				) pc on
			pc.PalletFK = pallets.PalletPK

			/*StockItems*/
			inner join tblStockItems stockItems on
			stockItems.StockItemPK = pc.StockItemFK

			/*Divisions*/
			inner join tblDivisions divs on
			divs.DivisionPK = stockItems.DivisionFK

			/*Unit Type*/
			left outer join tblUnitTypes uts on
			uts.UnitTypePK = stockItems.UnitTypeFK

			/*PalletTypes*/
			left outer join tblPalletTypes palletTypes on
			palletTypes.PalletTypePK = pallets.PalletTypeFK

			/*BuildingUnits*/
			left outer join tblBuildingUnits bus on
			bus.BuildingUnitPK = buRows.BuildingUnitFK
			OR bus.BuildingUnitPK = loadingBays.BuildingUnitFK
			OR bus.BuildingUnitPK = setDownAreas.BuildingUnitFK

			left outer join tblBuildings buildings on
			buildings.BuildingPK = bus.BuildingFK

			where 
			(bus.BuildingUnitPK = @var_buildingUnitFK OR @var_buildingUnitFK = -1)
			AND
			(pc.StockItemFK = @var_stockItemFK OR @var_stockItemFK = -1)

			) subQ
			Group By [For],LocationTypeFK,BuildingUnit,DivisionName,StockItemCode,Location,
			/*Actual, Available, OnOrder, */Abbreviation
			order by BuildingUnit, LocationTypeFK, Location, StockItemCode
			--case when LocationTypeFK = 1 then buRows.Row + right('0' + cast(buCols.BuildingUnitColumn as nvarchar(10)),2) 
			--+ lower(buBays.BayLevel) + right('0' + cast(pallets.BayPosition as nvarchar(10)),2) when LocationTypeFK = 2 then loadingBays.LoadingBay End

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end

			
			
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END
GO

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spReportsEmployeeActivityWithOtherActivitiesBreakdown] --spReportsEmployeeActivityWithOtherActivitiesBreakdown @startDate = '2019-11-20', @endDate = '2019-11-27', @buildingName = ''
(
	@startDate DATE,
	@endDate DATE,
	@buildingName NVARCHAR(200) = ''

	--select @startDate = '2019-11-20', @endDate = '2019-11-27', @buildingName = 'BV4'
)
AS
BEGIN
	-- SET NOCOUNT ON = Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements.
	-- SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ UNCOMMITTED = In this procedure always reads past   
	-- records and/or records which will not be updated so can read uncommitted which is faster.
	-- SET DEADLOCK_PRIORITY LOW = Ensure this proc has a low impact when executed.
	SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ UNCOMMITTED; SET DEADLOCK_PRIORITY LOW;

	-- Variables
	DECLARE
		@varStartDate DATETIME = CAST(@startDate AS DATETIME),
		@varEndDate DATETIME = DATEADD(DAY, 1, CAST(@endDate AS DATETIME)),
		@varBuildingName NVARCHAR(200) = ISNULL(@buildingName,'')

	IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#otherActivityDetails') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #otherActivityDetails

	-- Get employee other activity details

	SELECT DISTINCT 
		tta.TMSEmployeeActivityPK AS TMSEmployeeActivityFK, 
		tta.EmployeeScannedPalletMovementDetailFK,
		tta.ActivityTime,
		LEFT(tta.ActivityTime,2) AS Hrs, right(left(tta.ActivityTime, 5),2) AS Mins, 
		LEFT(tta.ActivityTime,2)*60 AS HrsToMins,
		LEFT(tta.ActivityTime,2)*60 + right(left(tta.ActivityTime, 5),2) AS TotalMins,	
		tta.EmployeeActivityTypeFK,
		aeat.EmployeeActivityType,
		tesa.JobTitle
	INTO 
		#otherActivityDetails
	FROM 
		dbo.tblEmployeeScannedPalletMovementDetails tesa WITH (NOLOCK)
	INNER JOIN dbo.tblTMSEmployeeActivites tta WITH (NOLOCK)
		ON tesa.EmployeeScannedPalletMovementDetailPK = tta.EmployeeScannedPalletMovementDetailFK
	INNER JOIN dbo.appEmployeeActivityTypes aeat WITH (NOLOCK)
		ON tta.EmployeeActivityTypeFK = aeat.EmployeeActivityTypePK
	WHERE 
		((@varBuildingName <> '' AND tesa.DataForBuilding = @varBuildingName) OR @varBuildingName = '')
		AND tesa.ClockCardDate >= @varStartDate
		AND tesa.ClockCardDate < @varEndDate

	IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#otherActivityTotals') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #otherActivityTotals

	SELECT 
		EmployeeScannedPalletMovementDetailFK, SUM(TotalMins) AS OtherActivityMinutes
	INTO 
		#otherActivityTotals
	FROM 
		#otherActivityDetails
	GROUP BY 
		EmployeeScannedPalletMovementDetailFK

	IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#resultsWithOtherActivities') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #resultsWithOtherActivities

	SELECT DISTINCT
		tesa.*,
		ISNULL(oat.OtherActivityMinutes, 0) AS OtherActivityMinutes,
		(tesa.AllScannedMinutes + ISNULL(oat.OtherActivityMinutes, 0)) AS ActiveMinutes,
		(tesa.TimeWorkedMinutes - (tesa.AllScannedMinutes + ISNULL(oat.OtherActivityMinutes, 0))) AS InactiveMinutes
	INTO 
		#resultsWithOtherActivities
	FROM 
		dbo.tblEmployeeScannedPalletMovementDetails tesa WITH (NOLOCK)
	LEFT OUTER JOIN #otherActivityTotals oat
		ON tesa.EmployeeScannedPalletMovementDetailPK = oat.EmployeeScannedPalletMovementDetailFK
	WHERE 
		((@varBuildingName <> '' AND tesa.DataForBuilding = @varBuildingName) OR @varBuildingName = '')
		AND tesa.ClockCardDate >= @varStartDate
		AND tesa.ClockCardDate < @varEndDate

	-- Get the main details of the final results

	DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #results

	SELECT DISTINCT
		rwoa.EmployeeScannedPalletMovementDetailPK,
		rwoa.DataForBuilding,
		rwoa.ClockCardDate,
		rwoa.JobTitleOrder,		
		rwoa.EmployeeName AS [Employee Name & No],	
		rwoa.JobTitle AS [Role],	
		rwoa.FirstAndLastTMSTimesForUserAndBuilding AS [TMS Times],	
		rwoa.[Shift] AS [Scheduled Hours],		
		rwoa.OvertimeMinutes,	
		rwoa.MovementMinutes,
		rwoa.StockInMinutes,	
		rwoa.StockOutMinutes,
		rwoa.AllScannedMinutes,				
		rwoa.OtherActivityMinutes,	
		rwoa.ActiveMinutes AS AllActiveMinutes,
		CASE WHEN rwoa.FirstAndLastTMSTimesForUserAndBuilding = 'Hover mouse for information' THEN 0 ELSE rwoa.InactiveMinutes END AS InactiveMinutes,
		CAST(0 AS INT) AS [AccidentIncidentMinutes],
		CAST(0 AS INT) AS [AirFreightMinutes],
		CAST(0 AS INT) AS [BreaksMinutes],
		CAST(0 AS INT) AS [ClonmelHeathcareMinutes],
		CAST(0 AS INT) AS [CustomerQueryMinutes],
		CAST(0 AS INT) AS [CustomerVisitSamplingMinutes],
		CAST(0 AS INT) AS [CycleCountingMinutes],
		CAST(0 AS INT) AS [DocStorageMinutes],
		CAST(0 AS INT) AS [FloorSupervisionMinutes],
		CAST(0 AS INT) AS [HAndSMinutes],
		CAST(0 AS INT) AS [HousekeepingMinutes],
		CAST(0 AS INT) AS [HRMinutes],
		CAST(0 AS INT) AS [HSEMinutes],
		CAST(0 AS INT) AS [InternalStoreAllQueryMinutes],
		CAST(0 AS INT) AS [LabellingMinutes],
		CAST(0 AS INT) AS [LooseLoadingLabelledMinutes],
		CAST(0 AS INT) AS [LooseLoadingNoLabelsMinutes],
		CAST(0 AS INT) AS [MeetingsMinutes],
		CAST(0 AS INT) AS [MJChinaMinutes],
		CAST(0 AS INT) AS [MJChinaLooseLoadMinutes],
		CAST(0 AS INT) AS [MJStandardMinutes],
		CAST(0 AS INT) AS [OfficeAdminMinutes],
		CAST(0 AS INT) AS [PalletMovementsMinutes],
		CAST(0 AS INT) AS [PalletReworkMinutes],
		CAST(0 AS INT) AS [ParaLoadingMinutes],
		CAST(0 AS INT) AS [ParaUnloadMinutes],
		CAST(0 AS INT) AS [QualityMinutes],
		CAST(0 AS INT) AS [SalesMinutes],
		CAST(0 AS INT) AS [SecurityMinutes],
		CAST(0 AS INT) AS [SelfStorageMinutes],
		CAST(0 AS INT) AS [ShuntingMinutes],
		CAST(0 AS INT) AS [StockControlMinutes],
		CAST(0 AS INT) AS [NonScannerStockInMinutes],
		CAST(0 AS INT) AS [NonScannerStockOutMinutes],
		CAST(0 AS INT) AS [SupplierVisitMinutes],
		CAST(0 AS INT) AS [TechnicalFaultMinutes],
		CAST(0 AS INT) AS [TippWaterMinutes],
		CAST(0 AS INT) AS [TopUpLoadMinutes],
		CAST(0 AS INT) AS [TopUpLoadLabelMinutes],
		CAST(0 AS INT) AS [TrailerIssueMinutes],
		CAST(0 AS INT) AS [TransportMinutes],

		CAST(0 AS INT) AS [VMSMinutes]

	INTO
		#results
	FROM

-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spReportsExtraServiceSummary]
(
	@startdate datetime,
	@enddate datetime,
	@divisionfk int
)	
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data; Ensure this proc has a low impact when executed */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED; SET DEADLOCK_PRIORITY LOW

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT
	,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;
	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	declare @startdate2 datetime
	declare @enddate2 datetime
	declare @divisionfk2 int
	
	SET @startdate2 = @startdate
	SET @enddate2 = @enddate
	SET @divisionfk2 = @divisionfk
	
	SET @ParameterDetails = '@startdate = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@startdate2 AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'')
		+ ', @enddate = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@enddate2 AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'')
		+ ', @divisionfk = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@divisionfk2 AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'')

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    --BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

		SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END


	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY			

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start			
			drop table if exists #tmpallextraServices
			select es.*, ChargeSubject into #tmpallextraServices 
			from tblExtraServices es 
			inner join tblDivisionExtraServices dess on dess.DivisionExtraServicePK = es.DivisionExtraServiceFK 
			left join appChargeSubjects acs on acs.ChargeSubjectPK = dess.ChargeSubjectFK 
			where  ExtraServiceDate >= @startdate and ExtraServiceDate <= @enddate and es.DivisionFK = @divisionfk
			--select * from #tmpallextraServices

			drop table if exists #tmpstockorders
			select stockorderpk, containeroutfk, ResponsibleBuildingUnitFK into #tmpstockorders from tblstockorders where stockorderpk in (select stockorderfk from #tmpallextraServices)

			select cast(Collectiondate as date) [Date], ess.Reference, ess.Name, ess.NumberOf, ChargeSubject as UoM, ess.Charge, BuildingName,BuildingUnit  
			from tblcontainerouts co
			inner join #tmpstockorders so on containeroutfk = containeroutpk
			inner join #tmpallextraServices ess on stockorderpk = stockorderfk
			inner join tblBuildingUnits bu on ResponsibleBuildingUnitFK = BuildingUnitPK
			inner join tblBuildings b on buildingfk = buildingpk
			where ContainerOutStatusFK = 5
			order by CollectionDate,BuildingName,BuildingUnit
			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end		
			
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END
GO

-- =============================================================================================================
-- Author:      Charlene Gordon
-- Create Date: 13 Jan 2021
-- Description: Returns specific employee activity details for a date range for all buildings in Employee activity WMS.
-- =============================================================================================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spReportsGetEmployeeActivityDetailsForAllBuildings] --spReportsGetEmployeeActivityDetailsForAllBuildings '2020-01-14', '2020-01-15'
(
	@startDate DATE,
	@endDate DATE

	--select @startDate = '2020-01-13', @endDate = '2020-01-14'
)
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ UNCOMMITTED; SET DEADLOCK_PRIORITY LOW

	DECLARE @varStartDate DATE = @startDate, @varEndDate DATE = DATEADD(DAY, 1, @endDate)

	-- 1. Get the required data.

	DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #resultsDataSet

	SELECT DISTINCT
		t1.EmployeeActivityDetailPK,
		t1.DataForBuilding,
		t1.EmployeeName + '(' + t1.EmployeeNumber + ')' AS EmployeeName,
		t1.StockInOutNumber,
		t1.Origin AS DocketType,
		t1.MovementType AS Activity,
		t1.PalletFK,
		CAST(t1.EventDateTime AS DATE) AS EventDate
	INTO
		#resultsDataSet
	FROM
		dbo.tblEmployeeActivityDetails t1
	WHERE
		CAST(t1.EventDateTime AS DATE) >= @varStartDate
		AND CAST(t1.EventDateTime AS DATE) < @varEndDate
		AND t1.RecordType <> 'TMS'
		AND t1.DataForBuilding IN ('BV4', 'BV5', 'Slieverue', 'Kilcohan', 'BV1', 'Dungarvan', 'BV2','Carrick-on-Suir', 'Cork Rd', 'Northern Extension', 'Rosbercon','Six Cross Roads', 'Air1' )

	-- 2. Format/aggregate the data and return it.

	SELECT
		DataForBuilding AS Building,
		--CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), EventDate, 103) AS [Event Date],
		EventDate AS [Event Date],
		EmployeeName AS [Employee Name],
		StockInOutNumber AS [Stock In/Out No],
		DocketType AS [Docket Type],
		COUNT(DISTINCT StockInOutNumber) AS [Docket Count],
		Activity,
		COUNT(DISTINCT PalletFK) AS [Pallets Handled]		
	FROM
		#resultsDataSet
	GROUP BY
		DataForBuilding,
		EventDate,
		EmployeeName,
		StockInOutNumber,
		DocketType,
		Activity		
	ORDER BY 
		DataForBuilding ASC,
		EventDate ASC,
		EmployeeName ASC,
		DocketType ASC,
		Activity ASC
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spReportsGlanbiaHistoricalPreempt]
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    SELECT 
        ActualUnits,
        AvailableUnits,
        palletpk,
        pals.customerbarcode,
        pals.isarchived
    FROM tblpalletcontent pc
    INNER JOIN tblstockitems si ON si.stockitempk = pc.stockitemfk
    INNER JOIN tblpallets pals ON pals.palletpk = pc.palletfk
    WHERE 
        pals.isarchived = 0
        AND (ActualUnits < 0 OR AvailableUnits < 0)
        AND si.divisionfk IN (625, 624)
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spReportsGroupStockInDocket]    
(    
 @stockInPK int,    
 @userFK int,  
 @GroupStockinFk int  
)     
AS    
BEGIN    
 /* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data; Ensure this proc has a low impact when executed */    
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED; SET DEADLOCK_PRIORITY LOW    
    
    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT    
 ,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;    
 SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();    
    
 -- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters    
 DECLARE @var_stockInPK int, @var_userFK int    
 SET @var_stockInPK = @stockInPK; SET @var_userFK = @userFK    
 SET @ParameterDetails = '@stockInPK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_stockInPK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@userFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_userFK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'')    
    
    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL     
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)    
    
    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)    
    --BEGIN    
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC     
    
  SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)    
    
        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)    
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK    
    
        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()    
    --END    
    
    
 SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);    
 SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails    
 ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;    
 INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()    
    
 WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3    
 BEGIN     
  BEGIN TRY    
       
    
   -- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start    
    
   Declare @myExtraField nvarchar(200)    
   Declare @myExtraFields nvarchar(1000)    
   DECLARE ExtraFieldsCursor CURSOR FAST_FORWARD FOR    
   Select ExtraFieldName + ':' + [Value]    
   From tblDocketExtraFieldValues    
   Where DocketTypeFK = 1 AND FK = @var_stockInPK    
    
   --Jamie : get list of names that built the stock In    
   declare @NameString  nvarchar(max)    
   --get first 3 names, or integration from sap    
   SELECT @NameString = Coalesce(@NameString + CHAR(13)+CHAR(10), '') + PersonName from (    
    Select distinct top 3 PersonName from (    
    select FirstName + ' ' + LastName as PersonName    
    from tblPeople people    
    inner join tblUsers users on users.PersonFK = people.PersonPK    
    inner join tblstockinlines sil on sil.insertedby = users.userpk    
    inner join tblstockins si on sil.stockinfk = si.stockinpk    
    where stockinpk = @var_stockInPK      
    union    
    select case when sil.insertedby <= 0 then 'Import Service' else '' end     
    from tblstockins si    
    inner join tblstockinlines sil on sil.stockinfk = si.stockinpk    
    where si.stockinpk = @var_stockInPK and sil.insertedby <= 0)subg    
   ) subq1    
    
   --set extra string when more than 3 names exist    
   select @NameString = @NameString + (case when count(distinct sil.insertedby) > 3 then ' +'     
   + CONVERT(varchar(10), count(distinct sil.insertedby) - 3) else '' end)    
   from tblstockins si    
   inner join tblstockinlines sil on sil.stockinfk = si.stockinpk    
   where stockinpk = @var_stockInPK     
    
   OPEN ExtraFieldsCursor    
      
   FETCH NEXT FROM ExtraFieldsCursor INTO     
   @myExtraField    
    
   Set @myExtraFields = ''    
   WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0    
   BEGIN    
    Set @myExtraFields = @myExtraFields + @myExtraField + char(9) + char(13)    
    FETCH NEXT FROM ExtraFieldsCursor INTO     
    @myExtraField    
   END    
   CLOSE ExtraFieldsCursor     
   DEALLOCATE ExtraFieldsCursor    

   --IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#tmpTotalPallets') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #tmpTotalPallets  
    drop table if exists #tmpTotalPallets

   select cins.StockInGroupFK as groupfk, sum(sins.Pallets) as totalpallets
   into #tmpTotalPallets
   from tblStockIns sils
 inner join tblStockInLines sins on sins.StockInFK=sils.StockInPK
 inner join tblContainerIns cins on cins.ContainerInPK = sils.ContainerInFK
 where cins.StockInGroupFK= @GroupStockinFk
    group by (cins.StockInGroupFK)

   Select case when stockItems.EachesTypeFK > 0 then 1 else 0 end as EachesType,    
   case when sInLines.StockInLinePK = parentSil.StockInLinePK AND sInLines.IsMixedPallet = 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/ then     
   0 else parentSil.StockInLinePK end as MixedStockInLinePK ,    
  -- cast(sIns.GoodsInNumber as nvarchar(50))+ ' V' + cast(cIns.VersionNumber as nvarchar(50)) as [GoodsInNumber],     
     cast(sIns.GoodsInNumber as nvarchar(50))+ ' V' + cast(cIns.VersionNumber as nvarchar(50)) + ' (G- ' + cast(cIns.StockInGroupFK as nvarchar(50)) + ')' as [GoodsInNumber],       
   divisions.DivisionName,     
   divisions.Address1 DivisionAddress1,     
   divisions.Address2 DivisionAddress2,     
   divisions.Address3 DivisionAddress3,     
   divisions.Address4 DivisionAddress4,     
   divisions.Address5 DivisionAddress5,    
   isnull(OutDivision.DivisionName, suppliers.Supplier) Supplier,     
   isnull(OutDivision.Address1, suppliers.Address1) SupplierAddress1,     
   isnull(OutDivision.Address2, suppliers.Address2) SupplierAddress2,     
   isnull(OutDivision.Address3, suppliers.Address3) SupplierAddress3,     
   isnull(OutDivision.Address4, suppliers.Address4) SupplierAddress4,    
   isnull(OutDivision.Address5, suppliers.Address5) SupplierAddress5,    
   cIns.DateIn,     
   stockItems.StockItemCode,    
   left (stockItems.Description,20) as Description,sInLines.Batch,    
    CASE     
     WHEN pss.CustomerBarcode <> '' THEN pss.CustomerBarcode    
     ELSE pss.Barcode    
    END AS Barcode,    
    pss.CustomerPalletNumber,    
    pss.palletpk,    
   sInLines.Pallets - isnull(palletsAbsorbed.PalletAbsorbed, 0) Pallets,     
   sInLines.IsMixedPallet,    
   @myExtraFields as ExtraFields,    
   case when stockItems.EachesTypeFK > 0 then    
    cast(cast((case when sInLines.Pallets = 0 then 1 else sInLines.Pallets end)     
    * sInLines.Eaches * sInLines.EachUnits as decimal(18,3)) as nvarchar(50))    
   else     
    cast(sInLines.Pallets * sInLines.Units as nvarchar(50))    
   End as PalletDetail1,    
   case when stockItems.EachesTypeFK > 0 THEN    
    eachesUnitTypes.Abbrieviation    
   else     
    unitTypes.Abbreviation    
   End as UoM,    
   case when stockItems.EachesTypeFK > 0 then    
    cast(    
    cast(sInLines.Eaches * sInLines.EachUnits as int)    
   as nvarchar(50)    
    )    
   else     
    cast(sInLines.Units as nvarchar(50))    
   End as PalletDetail2,    
   case when stockItems.EachesTypeFK > 0 then    
    cast(cast(sInLines.Eaches as int) as nvarchar(50))    
   else     
    sInLines.ExtraDetails + ' ' + isnull(ssts.SpecialStockType, '')    
   End as PalletDetail3,    
   case when stockItems.EachesTypeFK > 0 then    
    cast(sInLines.EachUnits as nvarchar(50))    
   else     
    ''    
   End as PalletDetail4,    
   case when stockItems.EachesTypeFK > 0 then    
    cast(cast(sInLines.Eaches * sInLines.EachUnits as decimal(18,3)) as nvarchar(50))    
   else     
    ''    
   End as PalletDetail5,    
   case when stockItems.EachesTypeFK > 0 then    
    sInLines.ExtraDetails + ' ' + isnull(ssts.SpecialStockType, '')    
   else     
    ''    
   End as PalletDetail6,    
     
   case when stockItems.EachesTypeFK > 0 then    
    'Total Units'    
   else     
    'Total Units'    
   End as PalletDetail1Header,    
   case when stockItems.EachesTypeFK > 0 then    
    'Units Per Pallet'    
   else     
    'Per Pallet'    
   End as PalletDetail2Header,    
   case when stockItems.EachesTypeFK > 0 then    
    'Eaches PerPallet'    
   else     
    'Extra Details'    
   End as PalletDetail3Header,    
   case when stockItems.EachesTypeFK > 0 then    
    'Units Per Each'    
   else     
    ''    
   End as PalletDetail4Header,    
   case when stockItems.EachesTypeFK > 0 then    
    'Units Per Pallet'    
   else     
    ''    
   End as PalletDetail5Header,    
   case when stockItems.EachesTypeFK > 0 then    
    'ExtraDetails'    
   else     
    ''    
   End as PalletDetail6Header,    
     
   transportCompanies.TransportCompany,     
   cIns.LorryNumber,     
   cIns.ContainerNumber,     
   cIns.SealNumber,    
   system.DocketHeaderLine1,     
   system.DocketHeaderLine2,     
   system.DocketHeaderLine3,     
   system.DocketFooterPart1,    
   system.DocketFooterPart2Line1,     
   system.DocketFooterPart2Line2,     
   system.DocketFooterPart2Line3,     
   system.DocketFooterPart2Line4,    
   case when cIns.InsertedBy = 0 then 'Import Service' else  originator.PersonName end originator, cIns.InsertedDate originatedDate,     
   isnull(checkedBy.PersonName, '') CheckedAndReceivedBy, case when checkedBy.PersonName is null then ''     
   else convert(varchar, sIns.CheckedAndReceivedDate, 103) end as CheckedAndReceivedDate,    
   isnull(ArrivalRecordedBy.PersonName, '') ArrivalRecordedBy, case when ArrivalRecordedBy.PersonName is null then ''     
   else convert(varchar, sIns.ArrivalDate, 103) end as ArrivalRecordedDate,    
   @NameString as BuiltBy, convert(varchar, sInLines.InsertedDate, 103) BuiltByDate,      
   isnull(transfers.stocktransferpk, '-1') transferpk,    
   case when cdis.CustomerDocketIdentificationPK is null then     
     CASE WHEN  cIns.ExternalReference <> '' THEN 'External Reference: '  + cIns.ExternalReference ELSE ' ' end    
     ELSE     
     case cdis.FieldFK     
     when 1 then    
      cdis.Prefix + ' ' + cIns.Free1    
     when 2 then    
      cdis.Prefix + ' ' + cIns.Free2    
     when 3 then    
      cdis.Prefix + ' ' + cIns.Free3    
     when 4 then    
      cdis.Prefix + ' ' + cIns.Free4    
     when 5 then    
      cdis.Prefix + ' ' + cIns.Free5    
     ELSE    
      ''    
     end    
     + ' ' +    
     case cdis.Field2FK     
     when 1 then    
      cdis.Prefix2 + ' ' + cIns.Free1    
     when 2 then    
      cdis.Prefix2 + ' ' + cIns.Free2    
     when 3 then    
      cdis.Prefix2 + ' ' + cIns.Free3    
     when 4 then    
      cdis.Prefix2 + ' ' + cIns.Free4    
     when 5 then    
      cdis.Prefix2 + ' ' + cIns.Free5    
     else    
      ''    
     end
	+ ' ' +
	CASE WHEN  cIns.ExternalReference <> '' THEN 'External Reference: '  + cIns.ExternalReference ELSE ' ' end
    
     End as CustomerReference,    
   case when transfers.stocktransferpk is null then Building.BuildingName + ' - ' + bu.BuildingUnit else 'Internal Transfer' end as BuildingUnit,    
   cast(CASE WHEN custs.RequirePalletNumber = 0 THEN CASE WHEN divisions.RequirePalletNumber = 0 then stockItems.RequirePalletNumber ELSE divisions.RequirePalletNumber END ELSE custs.RequirePalletNumber END AS bit) as  RequirePalletNumber,  
   cIns.StockInGroupFK
   
    , 'Total Pallets ' + cast(tmppallet.totalpallets as nvarchar(50))as totalpallets
        
   from tblStockIns sIns    
   inner join tblContainerIns cIns on    
   cIns.ContainerInPK = sIns.ContainerInFK    
   left outer join tblSuppliers suppliers on    
   suppliers.SupplierPK = cIns.SupplierFK    
   inner join tblDivisions divisions on    
   divisions.DivisionPK = sIns.DivisionFK    
   INNER JOIN tblcustomers custs ON    
    divisions.customerfk = custs.customerpk    
   inner join tblStockInLines sInLines on    
   sInLines.StockInFK = sIns.StockInPK    
   inner join tblStockInLinePallets sInLinePal on    
   sInLinePal.StockInLineFK = sInLines.StockInLinePK    
   inner join tblPallets pss on    
   pss.PalletPK = sInLinePal.PalletFK    
   left outer join    
   (    
    Select min(PalletFK) PalletFK, StockInLineFK from tblStockInLinePallets    
    Group By StockInLineFK     
   ) silp on    
   silp.StockInLineFK = sInLines.StockInLinePK    
   left outer join    
   (    
    Select count(*) PalletAbsorbed, StockInLineFK     
    from tblStockInLinePallets silps    
    inner join tblPalletAudit pa on    
    pa.PalletFK = silps.PalletFK    
    AND EventTypeFK = 16 /*Absorbed*/    
    Group By StockInLineFK     
   ) palletsAbsorbed on    
   palletsAbsorbed.StockInLineFK = sInLines.StockInLinePK    
   left outer join     
   (    
    Select PalletFK, min(StockInLineFK) StockInLinePK from tblStockInLinePallets    
    Group By PalletFK    
   ) parentSil on    
   parentSil.PalletFK = silp.PalletFK    
   inner join tblStockItems stockItems on    
   stockItems.StockItemPK = sInLines.StockItemFK    
   left outer join tblEachesTypes eachesTypes on    
   eachesTypes.EachesTypePK = stockItems.EachesTypeFK    
   left outer join tblEachesUnitTypes eachesUnitTypes on    
   eachesUnitTypes.EachesUnitTypePK = stockItems.EachesUnitTypeFK    
   left outer join tblUnitTypes unitTypes on    
   unitTypes.UnitTypePK = stockItems.UnitTypeFK    
   left outer join tblTransportCompanies transportCompanies on    
   transportCompanies.TransportCompanyPK = cIns.TransportCompanyFK    
   inner join appSystem system on    
   1=1 --only one record in the system.. join it    
   left outer join (    
    Select users.UserPK, FirstName + ' ' + LastName as PersonName    
    from tblPeople people    
    inner join tblUsers users on    
    users.PersonFK = people.PersonPK    
   ) originator on    
   originator.UserPK = cIns.InsertedBy    
   left outer join (    
    Select users.UserPK, FirstName + ' ' + LastName as PersonName    
    from tblPeople people    
    inner join tblUsers users on    
    users.PersonFK = people.PersonPK    
   ) checkedBy on    
   checkedBy.UserPK = sIns.CheckedAndReceivedBy    
   left outer join (    
    Select users.UserPK, FirstName + ' ' + LastName as PersonName    
    from tblPeople people    
    inner join tblUsers users on    
    users.PersonFK = people.PersonPK    
   ) ArrivalRecordedBy on    
   ArrivalRecordedBy.UserPK = sIns.ArrivalRecordedBy    
   left outer join (    
    Select users.UserPK, FirstName + ' ' + LastName as PersonName    
    from tblPeople people    
    inner join tblUsers users on    
    users.PersonFK = people.PersonPK    
   ) LineInsertedBy on    
   LineInsertedBy.UserPK = sInLines.InsertedBy    
   left outer join appSpecialStockTypes ssts on    
   ssts.SpecialStockTypePK = sInLines.SpecialStockTypeFK    
   left join tblstocktransfers transfers on transfers.containerinfk = cIns.containerinpk     
   /*left outer join tblContainerOuts transferContainerOut on transfers.containeroutfk = transferContainerOut.ContainerOutpk    
   left outer join tblContainerOutLines cOutLines on cOutLines.ContainerOutFK = transferContainerOut.ContainerOutPK    
   left outer join tblDivisions OutDivision on OutDivision.DivisionPK = cOutLines.DivisionFK*/    
   left outer join (    
     select OutDivision.DivisionName, OutDivision.Address1, OutDivision.Address2, OutDivision.Address3, OutDivision.Address4,     
     OutDivision.Address5, transferContainerOut.ContainerOutpk     
     from tblContainerOuts transferContainerOut    
     inner join tblContainerOutLines cOutLines on cOutLines.ContainerOutFK = transferContainerOut.ContainerOutPK    
     inner join tblDivisions OutDivision on OutDivision.DivisionPK = cOutLines.DivisionFK    
     group by transferContainerOut.ContainerOutpk, OutDivision.DivisionName, OutDivision.Address1, OutDivision.Address2,     
     OutDivision.Address3, OutDivision.Address4, OutDivision.Address5    
   ) OutDivision on OutDivision.ContainerOutpk = transfers.containeroutfk    
   left outer join tblCustomerDocketIdentifications cdis on cdis.CustomerFK = divisions.CustomerFK AND cdis.DocketTypeFK = 1 /*ContainerIn*/    
   left outer join tblbuildingUnits bu on buildingunitpk = cIns.buildingunitfk    
   left outer join tblbuildings building on bu.buildingfk = building.buildingpk  
   
   left join #tmpTotalPallets tmppallet on cIns.StockInGroupFK=tmppallet.groupfk
   where sIns.StockInPK = @var_stockInPK and cIns.StockInGroupFK=@GroupStockinFk  
    
   Order By stockItems.StockItemCode, sInLines.Batch /*This line will more than likely mess up mixed pallets*/    
    
   -- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end    
    
       
       
   BREAK    
  END TRY    
  BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */    
   DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;    
   SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;    
   SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;      
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY     
   BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;    
           
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;    
    
            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID    
                
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;    
                
   IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)    
   BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END    
   ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */    
  END CATCH    
  SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1    
 END    
END
GO

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spReportsHealthCheckArchivedPalletsWithNoOutEvent]
(
	@int1 int = -1, /*BuildingFK*/
	@int2 int = -1,
	@int3 int = -1,
	@str1 nvarchar(200) = '',
	@str2 nvarchar(200) = '',
	@str3 nvarchar(200) = ''
)	
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data; Ensure this proc has a low impact when executed */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED; SET DEADLOCK_PRIORITY LOW

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT
	,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;
	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	DECLARE @var_int1 int, @var_int2 int, @var_int3 int, @var_str1 nvarchar(200), @var_str2 nvarchar(200), @var_str3 nvarchar(200)

	SET @var_int1 = @int1; SET @var_int2 = @int2; SET @var_int3 = @int3; SET @var_str1 = @str1; SET @var_str2 = @str2; SET @var_str3 = @str3

	SET @ParameterDetails = '@int1 = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_int1 AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@int2 = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_int2 AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') 
		+ ',@int3 = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_int3 AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@str1 = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_str1 AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@str2 = ' 
			+ ISNULL(CAST(@var_str2 AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@str3 = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_str3 AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'')

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    --BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

		SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END


	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY
			

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start

--	USE STAWMS

--
--/****************** DONT CHANGE ANYTHING BELOW HERE *************/
	Select 'PalletPK' PalletFK, 'Barcode' Barcode, '','' , -1 TitleOrder 
	UNION
--	Select * from (
	Select cast(silps.PalletFK as nvarchar(50)), pals.Barcode, '', '', 0 TitleOrder from
	
	(Select * from tblStockIns Where DivisionFK = @int1 AND StockInStatusFK in (2,3)) sins
	inner join tblStockInLines sils on
	sils.StockInFK = sins.StockInPK
	inner join tblStockInLinePallets silps on
	silps.StockInLineFK = sils.StockInLinePK
	inner join tblPallets pals on
	pals.PalletPK = silps.PalletFK
	AND pals.IsArchived = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/
	left outer join tblPalletAudit pa on
	pa.PalletFK = pals.PalletPK
	AND (pa.EventTypeFK = 2/*PalletOut*/ OR pa.EventTypeFK = 16/*TopOff Depleated*/)
	Where pa.PalletFK is null
	
			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end

			
			
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END

-- =============================================  
-- Author:  <Author,,Name>  
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>  
-- Description: Check if any active pallets have duplicate barcodes  
-- =============================================  
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spReportsHealthCheckCustomerInboundsWithoutBarcodes]  
(  
 @int1 int = -1, /*Customer*/  
 @int2 int = -1,/*Division*/  
 @int3 int = -1,  
 @str1 nvarchar(200) = '',  
 @str2 nvarchar(200) = '',  
 @str3 nvarchar(200) = ''  
)   
AS  
BEGIN  
 /* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data; Ensure this proc has a low impact when executed */  
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED; SET DEADLOCK_PRIORITY LOW  
  
    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT  
 ,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;  
 SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();  
  
 -- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters  
 DECLARE @var_int1 int, @var_int2 int, @var_int3 int, @var_str1 nvarchar(200), @var_str2 nvarchar(200), @var_str3 nvarchar(200)  
  
 SET @var_int1 = @int1; SET @var_int2 = @int2; SET @var_int3 = @int3; SET @var_str1 = @str1; SET @var_str2 = @str2; SET @var_str3 = @str3  
  
 SET @ParameterDetails = '@int1 = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_int1 AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@int2 = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_int2 AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'')   
  + ',@int3 = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_int3 AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@str1 = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_str1 AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'')   
   + ',@str2 = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_str2 AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@str3 = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_str3 AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'')  
  
    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL   
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)  
  
    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)

 WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3  
 BEGIN   
  BEGIN TRY  
   -- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start  
  
     Declare @customerfk int = @int1  
     Declare @divisionfk int = @int2  
  
   --/****************** DONT CHANGE ANYTHING BELOW HERE *************/  
   select * from tblStockInLines sil
inner join tblStockIns st on st.StockInPK = sil.StockInFK
inner join tblDivisions div on div.DivisionPK = st.DivisionFK
where div.CustomerFK=@customerfk and (sil.CustomerBarcode is Null or sil.CustomerBarcode='')
  

   --/****************** Procedure Ends *************/
  BREAK  
  END TRY  
  BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */

   SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;  
  
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY   
   BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;  
         
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;  
  
            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID  
              
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;  
              
   IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)  
   BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END  
   ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */  
  END CATCH  
  SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1  
 END
