-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spReportsHealthCheckCustomerPalletOverview]
(
	@int1 int = -1, 
	@int2 int = -1,
	@int3 int = -1,
	@str1 nvarchar(200) = '',
	@str2 nvarchar(200) = '',
	@str3 nvarchar(200) = ''
)	
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data; Ensure this proc has a low impact when executed */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED; SET DEADLOCK_PRIORITY LOW

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT
	,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;
	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	DECLARE @var_int1 int, @var_int2 int, @var_int3 int, @var_str1 nvarchar(200), @var_str2 nvarchar(200), @var_str3 nvarchar(200)

	SET @var_int1 = @int1; SET @var_int2 = @int2; SET @var_int3 = @int3; SET @var_str1 = @str1; SET @var_str2 = @str2; SET @var_str3 = @str3

	SET @ParameterDetails = '@int1 = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_int1 AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@int2 = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_int2 AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') 
		+ ',@int3 = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_int3 AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@str1 = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_str1 AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') 
			+ ',@str2 = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_str2 AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@str3 = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_str3 AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'')

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    --BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

		SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END


	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY
			

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start

			DECLARE @CustomerFK int
			SET @CustomerFK = @int1
						
			--add danone pallets
			DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #AllPallets
			SELECT palletpk,  CASE WHEN p.CustomerBarcode = '' then p.Barcode ELSE p.CustomerBarcode end AS CustomerBarcode, pc.ActualUnits, pc.AvailableUnits, d.DivisionName, p.InsertedDate, p.PalletStatusFK, p.BuildingUnitFK
			INTO #AllPallets
			FROM tblpallets p
			inner join tblpalletcontent pc ON palletfk=  palletpk
			INNER JOIN tblstockitems s ON pc.stockitemfk = s.StockItemPK
			INNER JOIN tbldivisions d ON s.divisionfk = d.divisionpk
			WHERE p.IsArchived = 0 AND d.customerfk in (@CustomerFK)


			--related stock ins
			DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #AllStockIns
			SELECT palletpk, stockinpk, tci.ContainerInPK, sil.StockInLinePK, silp.StockInLinePalletPK, tci.GoodsInNumber, si.ArrivalDate, si.InsertedDate, si.StockInStatusFK AS StockInStatus, tci.StockInStatusFK AS ContainerInStatus
			INTO #AllStockIns
			FROM #AllPallets p
			left JOIN tblstockinlinepallets silp ON palletpk = palletfk
			left JOIN tblstockinlines sil ON stockinlinepk = stockinlinefk
			left JOIN tblstockins si ON stockinpk = stockinfk
			LEFT JOIN dbo.tblContainerIns tci ON containerinpk = containerinfk

			--related stock outs
			DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #AllStockOuts
			SELECT palletpk, tcolpc.ContainerOutLinePalletContentPK, col.ContainerOutLinePK, co.ContainerOutPK, so.StockOrderPK, co.containeroutstatusfk, tcolpc.inserteddate, co.GoodsOrderNumber, co.CollectionDate
			INTO #AllStockOuts
			FROM #AllPallets p
			LEFT JOIN dbo.tblContainerOutLinePalletContent tcolpc ON p.palletpk = tcolpc.palletfk
			LEFT JOIN tblcontaineroutlines col ON tcolpc.ContainerOutLineFK = col.ContainerOutLinePK
			LEFT JOIN tblcontainerouts co ON col.containeroutfk = co.containeroutpk
			LEFT JOIN tblstockorders so ON so.containeroutfk = col.containeroutfk AND so.responsiblebuildingunitfk = p.BuildingUnitFK
			WHERE (co.containeroutpk IS NOT NULL AND co.containeroutstatusfk <> 6) OR co.containeroutpk IS null


			--SELECT * FROM dbo.appStockInStatus asis
			--SELECT * FROM dbo.appPalletStatus aps

			--pallets without a stock in
			DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #palletswithoutastockin
			SELECT 'pallet with no associated StockIn' AS Reason, p.palletpk, p.CustomerBarcode, p.InsertedDate, p.AvailableUnits, p.DivisionName
			INTO #palletswithoutastockin
			FROM #AllStockIns asi 
			INNER JOIN #AllPallets p ON asi.palletpk = p.palletpk
			WHERE asi.stockinpk IS NULL OR asi.ContainerInPK IS NULL
			ORDER BY asi.palletpk

			--pallets who's status is not OnRoute when stockIn is still OnRoute
			DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #palletstatusnotonroute
			SELECT 'pallet status set before arrival' AS Reason, p.palletpk, p.CustomerBarcode, asi.GoodsInNumber, asi.ArrivalDate
			INTO #palletstatusnotonroute
			FROM #AllStockIns asi 
			INNER JOIN #AllPallets p ON asi.palletpk = p.palletpk
			WHERE p.PalletStatusFK <> 10 AND (asi.StockInStatus = 1 OR asi.ContainerInStatus = 1)

			--pallets who's status is on OnRoute when stockIn has arrived / completed
			DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #palletstatusonroute
			SELECT 'pallet status not set after arrival' AS Reason, p.palletpk, p.CustomerBarcode, asi.GoodsInNumber, asi.ArrivalDate
			INTO #palletstatusonroute
			FROM #AllStockIns asi 
			INNER JOIN #AllPallets p ON asi.palletpk = p.palletpk
			WHERE p.PalletStatusFK = 10 AND (asi.StockInStatus <> 1 OR asi.ContainerInStatus <> 1) AND  (asi.ArrivalDate < DATEADD(hour, -3, GETDATE()))

			--pallets on route longer than 1 month
			DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #stockInOnroute
			SELECT DISTINCT 'StockIn onroute since' AS Reason, asi.GoodsInNumber, asi.InsertedDate
			INTO #stockInOnroute
			FROM #AllStockIns asi 
			INNER JOIN #AllPallets p ON asi.palletpk = p.palletpk
			WHERE (asi.StockInStatus = 1 OR asi.ContainerInStatus = 1 or p.PalletStatusFK = 10) AND  CONVERT(date,p.InsertedDate) < DATEADD(month, -1, GETDATE())

			--pallets arrived but stock in not completed today
			DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #stockInNotCompleted
			SELECT DISTINCT 'StockIn arrived but not completed today' AS Reason, asi.GoodsInNumber, asi.ArrivalDate--, asi.StockInStatus, asi.ContainerInStatus
			INTO #stockInNotCompleted
			FROM #AllStockIns asi 
			INNER JOIN #AllPallets p ON asi.palletpk = p.palletpk
			WHERE (asi.StockInStatus <> 3 OR asi.ContainerInStatus <> 3) AND  (CONVERT(date,asi.ArrivalDate) < DATEADD(day, -1, GETDATE()) AND asi.ArrivalDate <> '19000101')
			ORDER BY asi.GoodsInNumber


			--not all units available but pallet not on order
			DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #UnitsNotAvailable
			SELECT 'not all units available but pallet not on order' AS Reason, p.palletpk, customerbarcode, aso.ContainerOutPK , aso.ContainerOutLinePK, aso.ContainerOutLinePalletContentPK, aso.StockOrderPK, aso.containeroutstatusfk, GoodsOrderNumber, aso.InsertedDate
			INTO #UnitsNotAvailable
			FROM #AllPallets p
			LEFT JOIN #AllStockOuts aso ON p.palletpk = aso.palletpk
			WHERE p.ActualUnits <> p.AvailableUnits
			AND (ContainerOutLinePalletContentPK IS NULL OR StockOrderPK IS NULL OR ContainerOutLinePK IS NULL OR ContainerOutPK IS NULL)
			ORDER BY p.palletpk, aso.containeroutstatusfk desc

			--pallet on order more than 7 days
			DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #palsOnOrder
			SELECT 'pallet on order more than 7 days' as Reason, p.palletpk, customerbarcode, aso.ContainerOutPK , aso.ContainerOutLinePK, aso.ContainerOutLinePalletContentPK, aso.StockOrderPK, aso.containeroutstatusfk, GoodsOrderNumber, aso.InsertedDate
			into #palsOnOrder
			FROM #AllPallets p
			LEFT JOIN #AllStockOuts aso ON p.palletpk = aso.palletpk
			WHERE p.ActualUnits <> p.AvailableUnits
			AND aso.InsertedDate < DATEADD(day, -7, GETDATE())
			ORDER BY p.palletpk, aso.containeroutstatusfk desc

			--order complete but pallet not archived
			DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #palNotArchived
			SELECT 'order complete but pallet not archived' AS Reason, p.palletpk, customerbarcode, aso.ContainerOutPK , aso.ContainerOutLinePK, aso.ContainerOutLinePalletContentPK, aso.StockOrderPK, aso.containeroutstatusfk, aso.GoodsOrderNumber, aso.InsertedDate, aso.CollectionDate
			INTO #palNotArchived
			FROM #AllPallets p
			inner JOIN #AllStockOuts aso ON p.palletpk = aso.palletpk and aso.containeroutstatusfk = 5
			LEFT JOIN #AllStockOuts aso1 ON p.palletpk = aso1.palletpk and aso1.containeroutstatusfk NOT IN (5,6)
			WHERE (p.ActualUnits = 0 or p.ActualUnits <> p.AvailableUnits) and aso1.containeroutstatusfk IS NULL
			ORDER BY p.palletpk, aso.containeroutstatusfk desc

			Select 'Reason' as Reason, 'Description' AS [Description], '', '', -1 as TitleOrder 
			UNION
			SELECT Reason, [Description],'', '', 0 as TitleOrder 
			FROM (
				SELECT Reason, 'Pallet '+ CustomerBarcode AS [Description] from #palletswithoutastockin
				union
				SELECT Reason, 'Pallet ' + CustomerBarcode + ' on goods in ' + isnull(GoodsInNumber, '') from #palletstatusnotonroute
				UNION 
				SELECT Reason, 'Pallet ' + CustomerBarcode + ' on goods in ' + isnull(GoodsInNumber, '') from #palletstatusonroute
				UNION 
				SELECT Reason, 'Goods In ' + isnull(GoodsInNumber, '') + ' on route since ' + convert(varchar(25), InsertedDate, 103)   from #stockInOnroute
				UNION
				SELECT Reason, 'Goods In ' + isnull(GoodsInNumber, '') + ' arrived since ' + convert(varchar(25), ArrivalDate, 103) from #stockInNotCompleted
				UNION
				SELECT Reason, 'Issue with available units on Pallet ' + CustomerBarcode from #UnitsNotAvailable
				UNION
				SELECT Reason, 'Pallet ' + CustomerBarcode + ' on stock out ' + isnull(GoodsOrderNumber, '')  from #palsOnOrder
				UNION
				SELECT Reason, 'Pallet ' + CustomerBarcode + ' on stock out ' + isnull(GoodsOrderNumber, '') from #palNotArchived
			)subq
			Order By TitleOrder, Reason
			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end

			
			
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spReportsHealthCheckGoodsInDateMismatch]
(
	@int1 int = -1, 
	@int2 int = -1,
	@int3 int = -1,
	@str1 nvarchar(200) = '',
	@str2 nvarchar(200) = '',
	@str3 nvarchar(200) = ''
)	
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data; Ensure this proc has a low impact when executed */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED; SET DEADLOCK_PRIORITY LOW

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT
	,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;
	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	DECLARE @var_int1 int, @var_int2 int, @var_int3 int, @var_str1 nvarchar(200), @var_str2 nvarchar(200), @var_str3 nvarchar(200)

	SET @var_int1 = @int1; SET @var_int2 = @int2; SET @var_int3 = @int3; SET @var_str1 = @str1; SET @var_str2 = @str2; SET @var_str3 = @str3

	SET @ParameterDetails = '@int1 = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_int1 AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@int2 = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_int2 AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') 
		+ ',@int3 = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_int3 AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@str1 = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_str1 AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') 
			+ ',@str2 = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_str2 AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@str3 = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_str3 AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'')

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    --BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

		SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END


	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY
			

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start

--	USE STAWMS

--
--/****************** DONT CHANGE ANYTHING BELOW HERE *************/
	Select 'GoodsInNumber' GoodsInNumber, 'DateIn' DateIn, 'EventDate' eventdate, 'DivisionName' DivisionName, -1 TitleOrder 
	UNION
	select isnull(GoodsInNumber, 'Unknown') GoodsInNumber, datein 'DateIn',eventdate 'EventDate' ,DivisionName 'DivisionName', 0 TitleOrder from 
	(
--	Select * from (

	select distinct ci.goodsinnumber, si.divisionfk, convert(varchar(10), pa.eventdate, 120) eventdate, convert(varchar(10), ci.datein, 120) datein ,
divisionname from tblpalletaudit pa
	inner join tblstockinlinepallets silp on pa.palletfk = silp.palletfk
	inner join tblstockinlines sil on sil.stockinlinepk = silp.stockinlinefk
	inner join tblstockins si on si.stockinpk = sil.stockinfk
	inner join tblcontainerins ci on ci.containerinpk = si.containerinfk
	inner join tbldivisions div on divisionpk = divisionfk
	where pa.eventtypefk = 1 and convert(varchar(10), ci.datein, 120) <> convert(varchar(10), pa.eventdate, 120) and year(pa.eventdate) = year(getdate()) --  and pa.eventdate > '20160101'


		) EntireSubQ

	Order By TitleOrder, DateIn

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end

			
			
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END

(
	@int1 int = -1, /*BuildingFK*/
	@int2 int = -1,
	@int3 int = -1,
	@str1 nvarchar(200) = '',
	@str2 nvarchar(200) = '',
	@str3 nvarchar(200) = ''
)	
AS
BEGIN

		+ ',@int3 = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_int3 AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@str1 = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_str1 AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@str2 = ' 
			+ ISNULL(CAST(@var_str2 AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@str3 = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_str3 AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'')

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    --BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

		SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END


	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY
			

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start

--	USE STAWMS

  Declare @buildingFK int
  Set @buildingFK = @int1
--Set @buildingUnitFK = 44 /*35 = Unit 5, 45=Unit 8, 46=Unit 6, 40=STA, 43=STC, 48=BV1U1, 49=BV1U3*/
--
--/****************** DONT CHANGE ANYTHING BELOW HERE *************/
	Select 'GoodsInNumber' GoodsInNumber, '', '','' , -1 TitleOrder 
	UNION
	select isnull(GoodsInNumber, 'Unknown') GoodsInNumber, '', '', '', 0 TitleOrder from 
	(
--	Select * from (

		select * from 
	(Select 
           sins.GoodsInNumber as GoodsInNumber   
          -- any stock in that arrived over two days ago 
      from 
		   (Select * from tblContainerIns
				Where StockInStatusFK in (1, 2)) cins --Remove Stockinstatus clause, will still appear
			inner join (select * from  tblStockIns 
							     WHERE  arrivalrecordedby <> -1  
								   AND  stockInStatusFK in (1,2)  
								   AND updatedDate <  DATEADD(day, -2, dbo.GetBSTDate())) sins ON
			  sins.ContainerInFK = cins.ContainerInPK
			inner join tblBuildingUnits bus ON
			  bus.BuildingUnitPK = cins.BuildingUnitFK
			  AND bus.BuildingFK = @buildingFK
			inner join tblDivisions div ON
              div.divisionPk=sins.DivisionFk
            inner join tblStockInLines stL ON 
              StL.StockinFK = sins.StockinPK    -- check there are pallets assigned
            INNER JOIN tblLoadingBays tLbays ON
            tLbays.LoadingBayPK = cins.LoadingBayFK
            left outer join (select * from  tblCustomerDocketIdentifications 
								      WHERE DocketTypeFK = 1) cdis on
	          cdis.CustomerFK = div.CustomerFK) tblstockinsync
            group by goodsInNumber
	union				
		-- all pallets are in racking but goods in not complete
         select sins.GoodsInNumber 
			from  tblContainerIns cins
			inner join tblstockins sins on sins.containerinfk = cins.containerinpk
			inner join tblDivisions div ON
              div.divisionPk=sins.DivisionFk
            inner join tblStockInLines stL ON 
              StL.StockinFK = sins.StockinPK  
			inner join tblstockinlinepallets tspal on tspal.stockinlinefk = stL.stockinlinepk
			left outer join tblCustomerDocketIdentifications cdis on
						  cdis.CustomerFK = div.CustomerFK
			where
			 cins.buildingunitfk in (select tbu.buildingunitpk from tblbuildingunits tbu where tbu.buildingfk =  @buildingFk)
			AND sins.stockInStatusFK in (1,2) 
						AND cins.StockInStatusFK in (1,2)
						and cdis.DocketTypeFK = 1
			and Arrivalrecordedby > 0 and 
			stockinpk not in (
			select stockinpk 
			from  tblContainerIns cins
			inner join tblstockins sins on sins.containerinfk = cins.containerinpk
			inner join tblDivisions div ON
						  div.divisionPk=sins.DivisionFk
						inner join tblStockInLines stL ON 
						  StL.StockinFK = sins.StockinPK  
			inner join tblstockinlinepallets tspal on tspal.stockinlinefk = stL.stockinlinepk
			left outer join tblCustomerDocketIdentifications cdis on
						  cdis.CustomerFK = div.CustomerFK
			inner join tblpallets tpal on tpal.palletpk = tspal.palletfk
			where cins.buildingunitfk in (select tbu.buildingunitpk from tblbuildingunits tbu where tbu.buildingfk =  @buildingFk)
			AND sins.stockInStatusFK in (1,2) 
						AND cins.StockInStatusFK in (1,2)
						and cdis.DocketTypeFK = 1
			and Arrivalrecordedby > 0
			and locationtypefk not in (1)
			)
			group by  sins.GoodsInNumber) EntireSubQ

	Order By TitleOrder

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end

			
			
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */

	END

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    --BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

		SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END


	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY
			

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start

--	USE STAWMS

  Declare @buildingFK int
  Set @buildingFK = @int1
--Set @buildingUnitFK = 44 /*35 = Unit 5, 45=Unit 8, 46=Unit 6, 40=STA, 43=STC, 48=BV1U1, 49=BV1U3*/
--
--/****************** DONT CHANGE ANYTHING BELOW HERE *************/
	Select 'GoodsOrderNumber' GoodsOrderNumber, 'CurrentStatus' CurrentStatus, '','' , -1 TitleOrder 
	UNION
	select isnull(GoodsOrderNumber, 'Unknown') GoodsOrderNumber, CurrentStatus 'CurrentStatus', '', '', 0 TitleOrder from 
	(
--	Select * from (
	select GoodsOrderNumber , 'Shipped' as CurrentStatus
	from tblcontainerouts tCo
	INNER JOIN tblStockOrders tSto on tSto.ContainerOutFK = tCo.ContainerOutPk
	INNER JOIN tblContainerOutLines tCol ON tCol.ContainerOutFK = tCo.ContainerOutPK
	INNER JOIN tblContainerOutLinePalletContent tCoPL ON tCoPl.ContainerOutLineFK = tCol.ContainerOutLinePK
	where containerOutStatusFK not in (5,6)
	and tSto.ResponsibleBuildingUnitFK in (SELECT buildingUnitPK from tblBuildingUnits WHERE buildingFK = @BuildingFK)
	and tCoPl.loaded = 1
	UNION
     --Order was picked over two days ago and still hasnt been shipped
	select cons.goodsordernumber, 'Awaiting Shipment' as CurrentStatus
	from (select containeroutpk, 
				 goodsordernumber ,
				 updateddate
			 from tblcontainerouts 
			where containerOutStatusFK  in (1,2)
			  AND UpdatedDate < DATEADD(day, -2, dbo.GetBSTDate() )) cons 
			inner join tblstockorders stko on cons.containeroutpk = stko.containeroutfk
			inner join tblworksorders wos on wos.fk = stko.stockorderpk
			inner join tblworksordermovements woms on woms.worksorderfk = wos.worksorderpk
			inner join (SELECT palletPK 
						  from tblpallets 
						 WHERE locationTypeFK = 2
						   AND locationFK in (select loadingBayPK
												FROM tblLoadingBays 
												WHERE buildingunitfk in (select buildingunitpk 
																		  From tblBuildingUnits 
																		 where buildingFK = @BuildingFK))
						   AND isArchived = 0) tpal on tpal.palletpk = woms.palletfk
       ) EntireSubQ

	Order By TitleOrder

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end

			
			
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END

 -- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters

 SET @var_int1 = @int1; SET @var_int2 = @int2; SET @var_int3 = @int3; SET @var_str1 = @str1; SET @var_str2 = @str2; SET @var_str3 = @str3  
  
 SET @ParameterDetails = '@int1 = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_int1 AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@int2 = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_int2 AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'')   
  + ',@int3 = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_int3 AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@str1 = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_str1 AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'')   
   + ',@str2 = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_str2 AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@str3 = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_str3 AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'')  
  
    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL   
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)  
  
    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)  
    --BEGIN  
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC   
  
  SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)  
  
        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)  
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK  
  
        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()  
    --END  
  
  
 SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);  
 SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails  
 ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;  
 INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()  
  
 WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3  
 BEGIN   
  BEGIN TRY  
   -- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start  
  
     Declare @customerfk int = @int1  
     Declare @divisionfk int = @int2  
  
   --/****************** DONT CHANGE ANYTHING BELOW HERE *************/  
 
declare @Maxmovementpk int  
  SET @Maxmovementpk = (select top 1 worksordermovementpk from tblworksordermovements order by worksordermovementpk desc)  
print 'get top 25k moves'  
print CONVERT(varchar, SYSDATETIME(), 121)  
  drop table if exists #totalMovements  
  select *  
  into #totalMovements  
  from tblworksordermovements  
  where worksordermovementpk >= (@Maxmovementpk - 25000)  

 -- select * from #totalMovements where HandheldDeviceFK = -1 order by WorksOrderMovementPK asc

select distinct woms.UpdatedBy, COUNT(distinct woms.PalletFK), div.DivisionName, DATEADD(d, -1, getdate()) datetest
from #totalMovements woms
inner join  tblWorksOrders wo on wo.WorksOrderPK = woms.WorksOrderFK
inner join  tblpalletcontent pc on pc.palletfk = woms.palletfk
inner join tblStockItems s on pc.StockItemFK = s.StockItemPK
inner join tblDivisions div on div.DivisionPK = s.DivisionFK
where div.CustomerFK=@customerfk and woms.HandheldDeviceFK = -1 --and woms.UpdatedDate >= DATEADD(d, -1, getdate())
group by woms.UpdatedBy, div.DivisionName
  

   --/****************** Procedure Ends *************/
  BREAK  
  END TRY  
  BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */  
   DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;  
   SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;  
   SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;  
  
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY   
   BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;  
         
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;  
  
            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID  
              
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;  
              
   IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)  
   BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END  
   ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */  
  END CATCH  
  SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1  
 END  
END

	Select 'LoadingBay' LoadingBay ,'GoodsInNumber' GoodsInNumber, 'Barcode' barcode,'' , -1 TitleOrder

	select LoadingBay ,isnull(GoodsInNumber, 'Unknown') GoodsInNumber, barcode, '', 0 TitleOrder from

		SELECT LoadingBay, GoodsInNumber, barcode FROM

				  ,tSiP.palletfk , 
			 case when stPl.palletFK is not null then 'On Pick' else 'Not on Pick' END as PickStatus from

			inner join tblStockinLinePallets tSiP ON tSiP.StockInLineFK = tSiL.StockInLinePK

			INNER JOIN tblLoadingBAys LBay ON LBay.loadingBayPK = tPal.locationFK
			left outer join tblContainerOutLinePalletContent stPl on stPl.palletfk = tSiP.palletfk
			WHERE tSiP.PalletFK in
			(select tPal.palletpk 
			  from tblPAllets tPal
			 where locationTypeFK = 2
				AND locationFK in (select loadingBayPK 
		   							 FROM tblLoadingBays
									WHERE buildingunitfk in (select buildingunitpk 
															   from tblBuildingUnits 
															  where buildingFK = @BuildingFK))
				AND tPal.IsArchived = 0)
				AND stockInSTatusFK  not in (1,2)
		) tblConOnPick
		Where PickStatus = 'Not on Pick'
		group by LoadingBay, GoodsInNumber ,barcode) EntireSubQ

	Order By TitleOrder

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end

			
			
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID

			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END

         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    --BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

		SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END


	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY
			

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start
   
--/****************** DONT CHANGE ANYTHING BELOW HERE *************/
	Select 'GoodsInNumber' GoodsInNumber, 'Barcode' Barcode, 'CustomerBarcode' CustomerBarcode,'',-1 TitleOrder 
	UNION
	select goodsinnumber, p.barcode, p.customerbarcode ,'',  0 TitleOrder 
	from tblpallets p
	inner join tblstockinlinepallets on p.palletpk = palletfk
	inner join tblstockinlines on stockinlinepk = stockinlinefk
	inner join tblstockins on stockinpk = stockinfk
	where p.palletstatusfk = 10 and p.isarchived = 0 and stockinstatusfk <> 1 and p.locationtypefk <> 4

Order By TitleOrder, GoodsInnumber

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end

			
			
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;

			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END

-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>

-- Description:	Check if any active pallets have duplicate barcodes

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spReportsHealthCheckPalletsWithDuplicateBarcodes]
(
	@int1 int = -1, /*Customer*/
	@int2 int = -1,/*Division*/
	@int3 int = -1,
	@str1 nvarchar(200) = '',
	@str2 nvarchar(200) = '',
	@str3 nvarchar(200) = ''
)	
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data; Ensure this proc has a low impact when executed */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED; SET DEADLOCK_PRIORITY LOW

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT
	,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;
	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	DECLARE @var_int1 int, @var_int2 int, @var_int3 int, @var_str1 nvarchar(200), @var_str2 nvarchar(200), @var_str3 nvarchar(200)

	SET @var_int1 = @int1; SET @var_int2 = @int2; SET @var_int3 = @int3; SET @var_str1 = @str1; SET @var_str2 = @str2; SET @var_str3 = @str3

	SET @ParameterDetails = '@int1 = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_int1 AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@int2 = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_int2 AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') 
		+ ',@int3 = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_int3 AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@str1 = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_str1 AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') 
			+ ',@str2 = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_str2 AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@str3 = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_str3 AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'')

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    --BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

		SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END


	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY
			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start

			  Declare @customerfk int = @int1
			  Declare @divisionfk int = @int2

			--/****************** DONT CHANGE ANYTHING BELOW HERE *************/
			
			--get duplicate customer barcodes
			DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #TmpDuplicateCustomerBarcodes
			SELECT CustomerBarcode
			into #TmpDuplicateCustomerBarcodes
			FROM tblpallets
			where isarchived = 0 and PalletStatusFK <> 10 and CustomerBarcode <> ''
			GROUP BY CustomerBarcode
			  HAVING COUNT(CustomerBarcode) > 1

			--get duplicate sta barcodes
			DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #TmpDuplicateSTABarcodes
			SELECT Barcode
			INTO #TmpDuplicateSTABarcodes
			FROM tblpallets
			where isarchived = 0 and PalletStatusFK <> 10 and Barcode <> ''
			GROUP BY Barcode
			  HAVING COUNT(Barcode) > 1

			--get accout / stock / barcode info for all duplicates			
			DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #TmpDuplicates
			select DivisionCode, StockItemCode, p.Customerbarcode as Barcode 
			into #TmpDuplicates
			from tblpallets p 
			inner join #TmpDuplicateCustomerBarcodes tp on p.CustomerBarcode = tp.CustomerBarcode
			inner join tblpalletcontent pc on p.palletpk = pc.palletfk
			inner join tblstockitems s on pc.stockitemfk = s.StockItemPK
			inner join tbldivisions d on d.DivisionPK = s.DivisionFK
			where p.isarchived = 0 and p.PalletStatusFK <> 10 and p.CustomerBarcode <> '' and (@customerfk=-1 or d.CustomerFK = @customerfk) and (@divisionfk=-1 or d.divisionpk = @divisionfk)
			Union
			select DivisionCode, StockItemCode,  p.Barcode
			from tblpallets p 
			inner join #TmpDuplicateSTABarcodes tp on p.Barcode = tp.Barcode
			inner join tblpalletcontent pc on p.palletpk = pc.palletfk
			inner join tblstockitems s on pc.stockitemfk = s.StockItemPK
			inner join tbldivisions d on d.DivisionPK = s.DivisionFK
			where p.isarchived = 0 and PalletStatusFK <> 10 and p.Barcode <> '' and (@customerfk=-1 or d.CustomerFK = @customerfk) and (@divisionfk=-1 or d.divisionpk = @divisionfk)
			
			--return health check result
			Select 'Division Code' DivisionCode, 'Stock Code' StockItemCode, 'Barcode' Barcode, -1 TitleOrder 
			UNION
			select *, 0 as TitleOrder from #TmpDuplicates
			order by TitleOrder, DivisionCode, StockItemCode, Barcode

		BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END

					buRows.TranslatedRow + right('0' + cast((buRows.TranslateColumn - buCols.BuildingUnitColumn) as nvarchar(10)),2) + case when buRows.RackingTypeFK = 1/*Conventional*/ then lower(buBays.BayLevel) /*+ right('0' + cast(pallets.BayPosition as nvarchar(10)),2)*/ else '' end

		LEFT OUTER JOIN tblstockinlinepallets tSPal ON tSPal.PalletFK = tPal.PalletPK
		inner join tblstockinlines Tstk ON tstk.stockinLinePk = tsPal.stockinlinefk
		inner join tblstockins tskin on tskin.stockinpk = tstk.stockinfk
		INNER JOIN tblStockItems tSti on tSti.stockItemPK = stockItemAfterFK
		LEFT OUTER JOIN tblLoadingBays ON loadingBayPK = locationFK
		LEFT OUTER JOIN tblSetDownAreas ON SetDownAreaPK = locationFK
		WHERE comment like '%Hand Held%'  
			AND StockItemCOde NOT IN ('10BC443', '10BC475', '60P104', '20C009')
			AND tSAj.inserteddate > DATEADD(dd, -1, dbo.GetBSTDate()) 
			AND tSAj.inserteddate < dbo.GetBSTDate()
			AND tPal.buildingunitFK = @BuildingUnitFK

	select isnull(Location, 'Unknown') Location, LocationFK, Reason, '', 0 TitleOrder from 
	(
--	Select * from (

	Select subQ.Location, cast(LocationFK as nvarchar(100)) LocationFK, 'BayPosition' as Reason from (

	Select case when buRows.Translate = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ then
		case when buRows.ReverseTranslate = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ then
			buRows.TranslatedRow + right('0' + cast((buRows.TranslateColumn - buCols.BuildingUnitColumn) as nvarchar(10)),2) + case when buRows.RackingTypeFK = 1/*Conventional*/ then lower(buBays.BayLevel) /*+ right('0' + cast(pallets.BayPosition as nvarchar(10)),2)*/ else '' end
		else
			buRows.TranslatedRow + right('0' + cast((buCols.BuildingUnitColumn + buRows.TranslateColumn) as nvarchar(10)),2) + case when buRows.RackingTypeFK = 1/*Conventional*/ then lower(buBays.BayLevel) /*+ right('0' + cast(pallets.BayPosition as nvarchar(10)),2)*/  else '' end
		End
	else 
		buRows.Row + right('0' + cast(buCols.BuildingUnitColumnName as nvarchar(10)),2) + case when buRows.RackingTypeFK = 1/*Conventional*/ then lower(buBays.BayLevel) /*+ right('0' + cast(pallets.BayPosition as nvarchar(10)),2)*/ else '' end
	End as Location,
	count(*) Pallets, sum(pallets.BayPosition) BayPosTotal,
	pallets.LocationFK
	from 
	(Select * from tblPallets
		where IsArchived = 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/
		AND LocationTypeFK = 1 /*In Racking*/
		AND BuildingUnitFK = @buildingUnitFK
		AND LocationFK not in (Select BuildingUnitBayFK from tblStockItemFixedLocations)
	) pallets
	/*BAYS*/
	left outer join tblBuildingUnitBays buBays on
	buBays.BuildingUnitBayPK = pallets.LocationFK

	left outer join tblBuildingUnitColumns buCols on
	buCols.BuildingUnitColumnPK = buBays.BuildingUnitColumnFK

	left outer join tblBuildingUnitRows buRows on
	buRows.BuildingUnitRowPK = buCols.BuildingUnitRowFK

	Group By LocationFK, buRows.Translate,  buRows.ReverseTranslate, buRows.TranslatedRow,
	buRows.TranslateColumn, buCols.BuildingUnitColumn, buRows.RackingTypeFK,
	buBays.BayLevel, buRows.Row, buCols.BuildingUnitColumnName

	) subQ

	left outer join(
		Select 1 as PalletCount, 1 as BayPosCorrectTotal
		UNION
		Select 2, 3
		UNION
		Select 3, 6
		UNION
		Select 4, 10
		UNION
		Select 5, 15
		UNION
		Select 6, 21
		UNION
		Select 7, 28
		UNION
		Select 8, 36
	) BayPosTotalCheck on
	BayPosTotalCheck.PalletCount = subQ.Pallets

	Where BayPosTotal <> BayPosCorrectTotal

	UNION
	Select Location, cast(LocationFK as nvarchar(100)) LocationFK, 'Zero Bay Position' Reason from (
	Select case when buRows.Translate = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ then
		case when buRows.ReverseTranslate = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ then
			buRows.TranslatedRow + right('0' + cast((buRows.TranslateColumn - buCols.BuildingUnitColumn) as nvarchar(10)),2) + case when buRows.RackingTypeFK = 1/*Conventional*/ then lower(buBays.BayLevel) /*+ right('0' + cast(pallets.BayPosition as nvarchar(10)),2)*/ else '' end
		else
			buRows.TranslatedRow + right('0' + cast((buCols.BuildingUnitColumn + buRows.TranslateColumn) as nvarchar(10)),2) + case when buRows.RackingTypeFK = 1/*Conventional*/ then lower(buBays.BayLevel) /*+ right('0' + cast(pallets.BayPosition as nvarchar(10)),2)*/  else '' end
		End
	else 
		buRows.Row + right('0' + cast(buCols.BuildingUnitColumnName as nvarchar(10)),2) + case when buRows.RackingTypeFK = 1/*Conventional*/ then lower(buBays.BayLevel) /*+ right('0' + cast(pallets.BayPosition as nvarchar(10)),2)*/ else '' end
	End as Location,
	pallets.LocationFK
	from 
	(Select * from tblPallets
		Where BuildingUnitFK = @buildingUnitFK 
		AND LocationTypeFK = 1 /*In Racking*/
		AND BayPosition = 0
	) pallets
	/*BAYS*/
	left outer join tblBuildingUnitBays buBays on
	buBays.BuildingUnitBayPK = pallets.LocationFK

	left outer join tblBuildingUnitColumns buCols on
	buCols.BuildingUnitColumnPK = buBays.BuildingUnitColumnFK

	left outer join tblBuildingUnitRows buRows on
	buRows.BuildingUnitRowPK = buCols.BuildingUnitRowFK
	
	)sub5
	UNION /*DriveThrough-Gap At Start*/
	Select isnull(viewBayLocations.BuildingUnitBayLocation, '??') Location, cast(pallets.LocationFK as nvarchar(100)) LocationFK, 'Drive Thru - Gap at start' Reason
	from (Select * from tblPallets) pallets
	/*BAYS*/
	left outer join tblBuildingUnitBays buBays on
	buBays.BuildingUnitBayPK = pallets.LocationFK

	left outer join tblBuildingUnitColumns buCols on
	buCols.BuildingUnitColumnPK = buBays.BuildingUnitColumnFK

	left outer join tblBuildingUnitRows buRows on
	buRows.BuildingUnitRowPK = buCols.BuildingUnitRowFK

	left outer join viewBuildingUnitBays viewBayLocations on
	viewBayLocations.BuildingUnitBayPK = pallets.LocationFK
	Where pallets.LocationTypeFK = 1 /*In Racking*/
	AND pallets.IsArchived = 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/
	AND pallets.StackPosition = 0
	and pallets.BuildingUnitFK = @buildingUnitFK 
	AND pallets.PalletStart > 0
	AND pallets.BayPosition = 1
	AND buRows.RackingTypeFK = 2

	UNION
	Select subQ2.Location, cast(subQ2.LocationFK as nvarchar(100)) LocationFK, 'Overlap' Reason from (
	Select case when buRows.Translate = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ then
			case when buRows.ReverseTranslate = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ then
				buRows.TranslatedRow + right('0' + cast((buRows.TranslateColumn - buCols.BuildingUnitColumn) as nvarchar(10)),2) + case when buRows.RackingTypeFK = 1/*Conventional*/ then lower(buBays.BayLevel) + right('0' + cast(pallets.BayPosition as nvarchar(10)),2) else '' end
			else
				buRows.TranslatedRow + right('0' + cast((buCols.BuildingUnitColumn + buRows.TranslateColumn) as nvarchar(10)),2) + case when buRows.RackingTypeFK = 1/*Conventional*/ then lower(buBays.BayLevel) + right('0' + cast(pallets.BayPosition as nvarchar(10)),2)  else '' end
			End
		else 
			buRows.Row + right('0' + cast(buCols.BuildingUnitColumnName as nvarchar(10)),2) + case when buRows.RackingTypeFK = 1/*Conventional*/ then lower(buBays.BayLevel) + right('0' + cast(pallets.BayPosition as nvarchar(10)),2) else '' end
		End as Location,
		
		pallets.LocationFK,
		pallets.PalletStart,
		pallets.PalletEnd,
		pallets.BayPosition,
		pallets.PalletPK
	from (Select * from tblPallets) pallets
	/*BAYS*/
	left outer join tblBuildingUnitBays buBays on
	buBays.BuildingUnitBayPK = pallets.LocationFK

	left outer join tblBuildingUnitColumns buCols on
	buCols.BuildingUnitColumnPK = buBays.BuildingUnitColumnFK

	left outer join tblBuildingUnitRows buRows on
	buRows.BuildingUnitRowPK = buCols.BuildingUnitRowFK

	/*END OF BAYS*/
	Where pallets.LocationTypeFK = 1 /*In Racking*/
	AND pallets.IsArchived = 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/
	AND pallets.StackPosition = 0
	and pallets.BuildingUnitFK = @buildingUnitFK 
	Group By LocationFK, buRows.Translate, buRows.ReverseTranslate, buRows.TranslatedRow,
	buRows.TranslateColumn, buCols.BuildingUnitColumn, buRows.RackingTypeFK,
	buBays.BayLevel, buRows.Row, buCols.BuildingUnitColumnName, pallets.BayPosition,
	pallets.PalletStart, pallets.PalletEnd, pallets.PalletPK, pallets.StackPosition

	)subQ2

	inner join (

	Select case when buRows.Translate = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ then
			case when buRows.ReverseTranslate = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ then
				buRows.TranslatedRow + right('0' + cast((buRows.TranslateColumn - buCols.BuildingUnitColumn) as nvarchar(10)),2) + case when buRows.RackingTypeFK = 1/*Conventional*/ then lower(buBays.BayLevel) + right('0' + cast(pallets.BayPosition as nvarchar(10)),2) else '' end
			else
				buRows.TranslatedRow + right('0' + cast((buCols.BuildingUnitColumn + buRows.TranslateColumn) as nvarchar(10)),2) + case when buRows.RackingTypeFK = 1/*Conventional*/ then lower(buBays.BayLevel) + right('0' + cast(pallets.BayPosition as nvarchar(10)),2)  else '' end
			End
		else 
			buRows.Row + right('0' + cast(buCols.BuildingUnitColumnName as nvarchar(10)),2) + case when buRows.RackingTypeFK = 1/*Conventional*/ then lower(buBays.BayLevel) + right('0' + cast(pallets.BayPosition as nvarchar(10)),2) else '' end
		End as Location,
		
		pallets.LocationFK,
		pallets.PalletStart,
		pallets.PalletEnd,
		pallets.BayPosition,
		pallets.PalletPK
	from tblPallets pallets
	/*BAYS*/
	left outer join tblBuildingUnitBays buBays on
	buBays.BuildingUnitBayPK = pallets.LocationFK

	left outer join tblBuildingUnitColumns buCols on
	buCols.BuildingUnitColumnPK = buBays.BuildingUnitColumnFK

	left outer join tblBuildingUnitRows buRows on
	buRows.BuildingUnitRowPK = buCols.BuildingUnitRowFK

	/*END OF BAYS*/
	Where pallets.LocationTypeFK = 1 /*In Racking*/
	AND pallets.IsArchived = 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/
	AND pallets.StackPosition = 0
	and pallets.BuildingUnitFK = @buildingUnitFK 
	Group By LocationFK, buRows.Translate, buRows.ReverseTranslate, buRows.TranslatedRow,
	buRows.TranslateColumn, buCols.BuildingUnitColumn, buRows.RackingTypeFK,
	buBays.BayLevel, buRows.Row, buCols.BuildingUnitColumnName, pallets.BayPosition,
	pallets.PalletStart, pallets.PalletEnd, pallets.PalletPK

	) chkSubQ on
	chkSubQ.LocationFK = subQ2.LocationFK
	AND chkSubQ.PalletPK <> subQ2.PalletPK
	AND (
		(subQ2.PalletStart BETWEEN chkSubQ.PalletStart AND chkSubQ.PalletEnd)
		OR
		(subQ2.PalletEnd BETWEEN chkSubQ.PalletStart AND chkSubQ.PalletEnd)
	)
	AND subQ2.PalletStart <> chkSubQ.PalletEnd
	AND subQ2.PalletEnd <> chkSubQ.PalletStart


	) EntireSubQ

	Order By TitleOrder, Location

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end

			
			
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END
GO

				where twoms.worksorderstatusfk in (1,2)
				and (locationtypefk = 1 OR (locationtypeFk = 2 AND tPal.IsArchived = 1))
				and twos.worksorderoriginfk = 1
		)
	) EntireSubQ

	Order By TitleOrder

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spReportsHealthCheckStockInOpenOverOneMonth]
(
	@int1 int = -1,      -- Building FK
	@int2 int = -1,      -- Customer FK
	@int3 int = -1,
	@str1 nvarchar(200) = '',
	@str2 nvarchar(200) = '',
	@str3 nvarchar(200) = ''
)	
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data; Ensure this proc has a low impact when executed */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED; SET DEADLOCK_PRIORITY LOW

	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	DECLARE @var_int1 int, @var_int2 int, @var_int3 int, @var_str1 nvarchar(200), @var_str2 nvarchar(200), @var_str3 nvarchar(200)

	SET @var_int1 = @int1; SET @var_int2 = @int2; SET @var_int3 = @int3; SET @var_str1 = @str1; SET @var_str2 = @str2; SET @var_str3 = @str3

	SET @ParameterDetails = '@int1 = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_int1 AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@int2 = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_int2 AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') 
		+ ',@int3 = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_int3 AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@str1 = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_str1 AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') 
			+ ',@str2 = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_str2 AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@str3 = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_str3 AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'')

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    --BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

		SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END


	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY
			

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start

--
--/****************** DONT CHANGE ANYTHING BELOW HERE *************/

	DECLARE @buildingFK int
	DECLARE @customerFK int
	SET @buildingFK = @int1
	SET @customerFK = @int2
	
	Select 'GoodsInNumber' GoodsInNumber, 'InsertedDate' InsertedDate, 'Location' BuildingUnit, 'Division' DivisionName,'ID' ID, -1 TitleOrder 
	UNION
	select GoodsInNumber  , CONVERT (nvarchar(100), inserteddate) as InsertedDate,BuildingUnit as Location, DivisionName,ID , 0 TitleOrder from 
	(

	select goodsinnumber, divisionName, inserteddate,
--stockItemcode as StockItem, batch, 
ID, 
case when noofPallets = 0 then 0 else count( NoofPallets) end as NoofPallets, buildingUnit from 
(
select tstk.GoodsInNumber , 
divisionName,

(DATENAME(MONTH, tstk.updateddate)+ ' ' + RIGHT('0' + DATENAME(DAY, tstk.updateddate), 2) + ', ' + DATENAME(YEAR, tstk.updateddate)) as InsertedDate ,
	case when cdis.CustomerDocketIdentificationPK = null then 
		'' 
	else
		case cdis.FieldFK 
		when 1 then
			cdis.Prefix + ' ' + cins.Free1
		when 2 then
			cdis.Prefix + ' ' + cins.Free2
		when 3 then
			cdis.Prefix + ' ' + cins.Free3
		when 4 then
			cdis.Prefix + ' ' + cins.Free4
		when 5 then
			cdis.Prefix + ' ' + cins.Free5
		when 64 then
			cdis.Prefix + ' ' + cins.ExternalReference
		ELSE
			''
		END
		+ ' ' +
		case cdis.Field2FK 
		when 1 then
			cdis.Prefix2 + ' ' + cins.Free1
		when 2 then
			cdis.Prefix2 + ' ' + cins.Free2
		when 3 then
			cdis.Prefix2 + ' ' + cins.Free3
		when 4 then
			cdis.Prefix2 + ' ' + cins.Free4
		when 5 then
			cdis.Prefix2 + ' ' + cins.Free5
		when 64 then
			cdis.Prefix2 + ' ' + cins.ExternalReference
		ELSE
			''
		end
	End as ID,

		case when pallets is null then 0 else pallets END as NoOfPallets,
		(buildingName + ' ' + buildingUnit) as BuildingUnit,
		tstk.inserteddate as inserted
		--case when stockItemCode is null then '' else stockItemCode end as stockItemCode,
		--case when batch is null then '' else batch end as batch
		from tblstockIns tstk 
		inner join tblcontainerins cins on cins.containerInPK = tstk.ContainerInFK 
		inner join tblBuildingUnits tbus on tbus.buildingUnitPK = cins.BuildingUnitFK
		inner join tblBuildings tbu on tbu.buildingPK = tbus.BuildingFK
		left outer  join tblDivisions div ON  div.divisionPk=tstk.DivisionFk
		left outer join tblCustomers cus on customerFK = customerPK
		left outer join (select Customerfk , CustomerDocketIdentificationPK, FieldFK , Prefix, Field2FK, Prefix2 from tblCustomerDocketIdentifications where DocketTypeFK = 1) cdis on
					  cdis.CustomerFK = div.CustomerFK
		left outer join tblStockInLines stkIn on stkIn.stockInFK = tstk.stockInPK
		--left Outer Join tblstockItems stk on stk.stockItempk = stkIn.stockItemFK
		Where cins.stockInstatusfk  in (1,2)
		--and	tbu.buildingPK > 0 OR tbu.buildingPK  = @buildingFK 
		and tbu.BuildingPK = case when @buildingFK = -1 then tbu.BuildingPK ELSE @buildingFK END
		and cus.customerPK = CASE WHEN @customerFK = -1 THEN cus.customerPK ELSE @customerFK END
		and tstk.inserteddate < DATEADD(mm, -1, dbo.GetBSTDate()) ) f
		group by goodsinnumber, divisionName, inserteddate, ID, NoofPallets, buildingUnit, inserted
		--order by divisionName , BuildingUnit , inserted
	) EntireSubQ

	Order By TitleOrder,divisionname, inserteddate

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end

			
			
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END

	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start

--	USE STAWMS

Declare @buildingFK int
Set @buildingFK = @int1
--Set @buildingUnitFK = 44 /*35 = Unit 5, 45=Unit 8, 46=Unit 6, 40=STA, 43=STC, 48=BV1U1, 49=BV1U3*/

		inner join tblstockinlines Tstk ON tstk.stockinLinePk = tsPal.stockinlinefk

		where 
		twom.worksorderstatusfk = 1
		and destinationlocationtypefk = 1
		and tbs.buildingpk  = @BuildingFK

		and tskin.stockInStatusFK IN (3,4,5)
		) EntireSubQ

	Order By TitleOrder, Location

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end

		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */

/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[spReportsHistoricalStockLevels]    Script Date: 02/11/2026 17:47:27 ******/
