CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spReportsHistoricalStockLevels]
(
	@customerFK int,
	@divisionFK int = -1,
	@toDate datetime,
	@stockItemFK int = -1,
	@batch nvarchar(200) = ''
)	
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data; Ensure this proc has a low impact when executed */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED; SET DEADLOCK_PRIORITY LOW

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT
	,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;
	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	DECLARE @var_customerFK int, @var_divisionFK int, @var_toDate datetime, @var_stockItemFK int, @var_batch nvarchar(200)

	SET @var_customerFK = ISNULL(@customerFK,0); SET @var_divisionFK = ISNULL(@divisionFK,-1); SET @var_toDate = @toDate
	SET @var_stockItemFK = ISNULL(@stockItemFK,-1); SET @var_batch = ISNULL(@batch,'')

	SET @ParameterDetails = '@customerFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_customerFK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@divisionFK = ' 
		+ ISNULL(CAST(@var_divisionFK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@endDate = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_toDate AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@stockItemFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_stockItemFK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') 
				+ ',@batch = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_batch AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'')

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    --BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

		SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END

	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY
			
			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start
			Declare @customerName nvarchar(200), @divisionName nvarchar(200)
			Select @customerName = CustomerName from tblCustomers Where CustomerPK = @var_customerFK
			Select @divisionName = DivisionName from tblDivisions Where DivisionPK = @var_divisionFK

			if object_id('tempdb..#currentStockLevel') is not null 
				drop table #currentStockLevel	

			Select 
				StockItemFK, Batch, sum(ActualPallets) as ActualPallets, sum(AvailablePallets) as AvailablePallets,
				sum(ActualEaches) as ActualEaches, sum(AvailableEaches) as AvailableEaches, sum(ActualUnits) as ActualUnits,
				sum(AvailableUnits) as AvailableUnits 
			into 
				#currentStockLevel
			from 
				--#viewStockLevels
				dbo.tblStockLevels
			Where 
				(@var_stockItemFK = -1 OR @var_stockItemFK = StockItemFK)
				AND (@var_batch = '' OR @var_batch = Batch)	
			Group By 
				StockItemFK, Batch 

			if object_id('tempdb..#stockBatch') is not null 
				drop table #stockBatch

			select distinct
				pa.StockItemFK,
				pa.Batch,
				pa.EventDate,
				pa.EventFK,
				pa.EventTypeFK,
				pa.PalletFK
			into
				#stockBatch
			from 
				dbo.tblDivisions as divisions
			inner join dbo.tblStockItems as sis 
				on sis.DivisionFK = divisions.DivisionPK
			inner join dbo.tblPalletAudit as pa
				on sis.StockItemPK = pa.StockItemFK
			Where 
				divisions.CustomerFK = @var_customerFK
				AND (@var_divisionFK = -1 OR @var_divisionFK = divisions.DivisionPK)
				AND (@var_stockItemFK = -1 OR @var_stockItemFK = sis.StockItemPK)
				AND (@var_batch = '' OR @var_batch = Batch)										

			if object_id('tempdb..#palletOutsAfterPeriod') is not null 
				drop table #palletOutsAfterPeriod

			Select count(*) as PalletsOut, StockItemFK, Batch 
			into #palletOutsAfterPeriod
			from #stockBatch
			Where EventTypeFK in (2,23)-- = 2 /*PalletRemoved*/
			AND EventDate > @var_toDate 
			Group By StockItemFK, Batch


			if object_id('tempdb..#unitsOutAfterPeriod') is not null 
				drop table #unitsOutAfterPeriod

			Select 
				sum(colpc.Units) as UnitsOut, cols.StockItemFK, cols.Batch 
			Into
				#unitsOutAfterPeriod
			from 
				dbo.tblContainerOutLines as cols
			inner join ( 
							Select ContainerOutLineFK, sum(Units) as Units 
							from dbo.tblContainerOutLinePalletContent
							Group By ContainerOutLineFK
						) as colpc
				on colpc.ContainerOutLineFK = cols.ContainerOutLinePK
			inner join dbo.tblContainerOuts as cOuts
				on cOuts.ContainerOutPK = cols.ContainerOutFK
			inner join (
							Select Distinct EventFK, StockItemFK, Batch
							from #stockBatch
							Where EventTypeFK in (2,3)/*Pallet or StockRemoved*/
							AND EventDate > @var_toDate
						) as [audit]
				on [audit].EventFK = cols.ContainerOutLinePK
				AND [audit].StockItemFK = cols.StockItemFK
				AND [audit].Batch = cols.Batch 
			Where 
				cOuts.ContainerOutStatusFK = 5 /*Complete*/
			Group By
				cols.StockItemFK, cols.Batch

			if object_id('tempdb..#insAfterPeriod') is not null 
				drop table #insAfterPeriod
			
			Select 
				StockItemFK, Batch, sum(PalletsIn) as PalletsIn, sum(UnitsIn) as UnitsIn 
			Into
				#insAfterPeriod
			from 
				(
					Select 
						sils.StockItemFK, sils.Batch, pa.PalletFK, 1 - sum(isnull(audit.PalletsAbsorbed, 0)) as PalletsIn, sum(sils.Units) as UnitsIn
					From 
						dbo.tblStockInLines as sils
					inner join dbo.tblStockIns as sins
						on sins.StockInPK = sils.StockInFK
					inner join dbo.tblContainerIns as cins
						on cins.ContainerInPK = sins.ContainerInFK 
						AND cins.StockInStatusFK = 3 /*Completed*/
					inner join #stockBatch as pa
						on pa.EventTypeFK = 1 /*PalletCreated*/
						AND pa.EventFK = sils.StockInLinePK
						AND pa.StockItemFK = sils.StockItemFK  /* RS Added to fix issue with Coeur 7/12/2017*/
					left outer join (
										Select 
											count(*) as PalletsAbsorbed, pa.PalletFK, StockItemFK, Batch, wos.FK 
										from 
											#stockBatch as pa
										inner join dbo.tblWorksOrders as wos
											on wos.WorksOrderPK = EventFK
										Where 
											EventTypeFK = 16/*Topoff DepleatedPallet - Absorbed*/
											AND EventDate > @var_toDate
										Group By 
											pa.PalletFK, StockItemFK, Batch, wos.FK
									) as [audit]
						on [audit].StockItemFK = sils.StockItemFK
						AND [audit].Batch = sils.Batch
						AND [audit].FK = sins.StockInPK
						AND [audit].PalletFK = pa.PalletFK
					Where 
						cins.DateIn > @ToDate
					Group By 
						sils.StockItemFK, sils.Batch, pa.PalletFK
				) as subQ 
			Group By 
				StockItemFK, Batch

			if object_id('tempdb..#Results') is not null 
				drop table #Results

			Select 
				@customerName as CustomerName, 
				divisions.DivisionName, 
				divisions.DivisionCode,
				@var_toDate EndDate,
				StockItemPK,
				StockItemCode, 
				stockBatch.Batch,
				isnull(ActualPallets, 0) + isnull(palletOutsAfterPeriod.PalletsOut, 0) - isnull(insAfterPeriod.PalletsIn,0) as ClosingTotalPallets,
				isnull(ActualUnits,0) + isnull(unitsOutAfterPeriod.UnitsOut, 0)  - isnull(insAfterPeriod.UnitsIn,0) as ClosingTotalUnits
			Into
				#Results
			FROM dbo.tblDivisions as divisions
			inner join dbo.tblStockItems as sis  on sis.DivisionFK = divisions.DivisionPK
			inner join #stockBatch as stockBatch  on stockBatch.StockItemFK = sis.StockItemPK
			left outer join #currentStockLevel as currentLevel on currentLevel.StockItemFK = stockBatch.StockItemFK AND currentLevel.Batch = stockBatch.Batch
			left outer join #palletOutsAfterPeriod as palletOutsAfterPeriod on palletOutsAfterPeriod.StockItemFK = stockBatch.StockItemFK AND stockBatch.Batch = palletOutsAfterPeriod.Batch
			left outer join #unitsOutAfterPeriod as unitsOutAfterPeriod  on unitsOutAfterPeriod.StockItemFK = stockBatch.StockItemFK  AND unitsOutAfterPeriod.Batch = stockBatch.Batch
			left outer join #insAfterPeriod as insAfterPeriod on insAfterPeriod.StockItemFK = stockBatch.StockItemFK AND insAfterPeriod.Batch = stockBatch.Batch
			Where 
				divisions.CustomerFK = @var_customerFK
				AND (@var_divisionFK = -1 OR @var_divisionFK = divisions.DivisionPK) 

			-- Return the final results to the report.

			Select DISTINCT * 
			From 
				#Results 
			Where 
				(ClosingTotalPallets > 0)
				AND
				(@var_stockItemFK = -1 OR @var_stockItemFK = StockItemPK) 
				AND
				(@var_batch = '' OR @var_batch = Batch)			
			Order By 
				DivisionName ASC /*DivisionCode*/, StockItemCode ASC /*StockItemCode*/, Batch ASC /*Batch*/ -- Note using positions instead of column names due to usage of 'Select Distinct *'.

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end
						
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END

-- =============================================    
-- Author:  <Author,,Name>    
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>    
-- Description: <Description,,>    
-- =============================================    
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spReportsHistoricalStockMovementCustomerSummary]    
(    
 @customerFK int,    
 @divisionFK int = -1,    
 @endDate datetime    
)     
AS    
BEGIN    
 /* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data; Ensure this proc has a low impact when executed */    
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED; SET DEADLOCK_PRIORITY LOW    
    
    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT    
 ,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;    
 SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();    
    
 -- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters    
 DECLARE @var_customerFK int, @var_divisionFK int, @var_stockItemFK int, @var_endDate datetime    
    
 SET @var_customerFK = @customerFK; SET @var_divisionFK = ISNULL(@divisionFK,-1); SET @var_endDate = @endDate    
    
 SET @ParameterDetails = '@customerFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_customerFK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@divisionFK = '     
  + ISNULL(CAST(@var_divisionFK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'')     
  + ',@endDate = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_endDate AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'')    
    
    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL     
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)    
    
    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)    
    --BEGIN    
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC     
    
  SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)    
    
        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)    
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK    
    
        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()    
    --END    
    
 SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);    
 SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails    
 ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;    
 INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()    
    
 WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3    
 BEGIN     
  BEGIN TRY    
       
   -- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start    
    
   DECLARE @var_startDate DATETIME -- Used in Where statement to include all records for the end date    
   set @var_startDate = DATEADD(day,-6,@var_endDate) 
   
   DECLARE @ToDate DATETIME -- Used in Where statement to include all records for the end date  
  
   set @ToDate = @var_endDate  
   set @var_endDate = DATEADD(day,1,@var_endDate)  
    
   --all divisions    
   drop table if exists #tmpDivisionsToInclude    
   select DivisionPK, DivisionCode, DivisionName, CustomerName, customerfk, d.InvoiceMethodFK    
   into #tmpDivisionsToInclude    
   from tblDivisions d    
   inner join tblcustomers on customerfk = customerpk    
   where AutoGenerateInvoice = 1 and customerfk = @var_customerFK    
   and (@var_divisionFK = -1 or DivisionPK = @var_divisionFK)    
    
   --select * from tblinvoicemethods    
       
   drop table if exists #tmpstoragerates    
   select sr.fk, sr.StorageRate     
   into #tmpstoragerates    
   from tblstoragerates sr    
   inner join #tmpDivisionsToInclude on divisionpk = fk and storageratetypefk = 1    
   where customerfk = @var_customerFK    
    
   --all stock codes for customer, or division if we have a filter    
   drop table if exists #tmpAllStockcodes    
   select stockitemcode, stockitempk, DivisionPK    
   into #tmpAllStockcodes    
   from tblstockitems s    
   inner join #tmpDivisionsToInclude d on divisionfk=divisionpk    
       
   --all in / out pallet audit events for list of stock codes and date range    
   drop table if exists #TempPalletAudit    
   select pa.PalletAuditPK, pa.PalletFK, pa.StockItemFK, pa.EventTypeFK, pa.EventFK, pa.EventDate, DivisionPK    
   into #TempPalletAudit    
   from tblpalletaudit as pa    
   inner join #tmpAllStockcodes as s on s.stockitempk = pa.stockitemfk     
   where pa.eventdate >= @var_startDate and eventtypefk in (1,2)    
       
   --current stock item quantities    
   drop table if exists #PalletsUnits       
   select DivisionPK, sum(ActualPallets) ActualPallets, sum(AvailablePallets) AvailablePallets,     
    sum(ActualEaches) ActualEaches, sum(AvailableEaches) AvailableEaches, sum(ActualUnits) ActualUnits,    
    sum(AvailableUnits) AvailableUnits     
   INTO #PalletsUnits    
   from tblStockLevels sl    
   inner join #tmpAllStockcodes ts on sl.StockItemFK = ts.StockItemPK    
   Group By DivisionPK    
         
   --pallets out after      
   drop table if exists #palletOutsAfterPeriod    
   Select  count(*) as PalletsOut, DivisionPK     
   into #palletOutsAfterPeriod    
   from #TempPalletAudit    
   Where EventTypeFK = 2 AND EventDate > @var_endDate     
   Group By DivisionPK    
        
   --pallets in after    
   drop table if exists #insAfterPeriod    
   Select  count(*) as Palletsin, DivisionPK     
   into #insAfterPeriod    
   from #TempPalletAudit    
   Where EventTypeFK = 1 AND EventDate > @var_endDate     
   Group By DivisionPK    
       
   --pallets out from start    
   drop table if exists #palletOutsFromStartOfPeriod    
   Select count(*) as PalletsOut, DivisionPK     
   into #palletOutsFromStartOfPeriod    
   from #TempPalletAudit    
   Where EventTypeFK = 2 AND EventDate >= @var_startDate    
   Group By DivisionPK       
        
   --pallets in from start    
   drop table if exists  #insFromStartOfPeriod     
   Select  count(*) as Palletsin, DivisionPK     
   into #insFromStartOfPeriod    
   from #TempPalletAudit    
   Where EventTypeFK = 1 AND EventDate >= @var_startDate     
   Group By DivisionPK    
       
   Select @var_startDate StartDate, @ToDate EndDate,    
    DivisionCode, DivisionName, CustomerName,    
    isnull(ActualPallets, 0) + isnull(palletOutsFromStartOfPeriod.PalletsOut, 0) - isnull(insFromStartOfPeriod.PalletsIn,0) as OpeningTotalPallets,         
    isnull(ActualPallets, 0) + isnull(palletOutsAfterPeriod.PalletsOut, 0) - isnull(insAfterPeriod.PalletsIn,0) as ClosingTotalPallets,    
    isnull(insFromStartOfPeriod.PalletsIn, 0) - isnull(insAfterPeriod.PalletsIn, 0)as PalletsIn,    
    isnull(palletOutsFromStartOfPeriod.PalletsOut, 0) - isnull(palletOutsAfterPeriod.PalletsOut, 0) as PalletsOut,    
    case when invoicemethodfk = 1 /*1=opening + in*/ then    
     ((isnull(ActualPallets, 0) + isnull(palletOutsFromStartOfPeriod.PalletsOut, 0) - isnull(insFromStartOfPeriod.PalletsIn,0)) + (isnull(insFromStartOfPeriod.PalletsIn, 0) - isnull(insAfterPeriod.PalletsIn, 0))) *  coalesce(sr.StorageRate, 0)    
    else /*2=closing stock*/    
     (isnull(ActualPallets, 0) + isnull(palletOutsAfterPeriod.PalletsOut, 0) - isnull(insAfterPeriod.PalletsIn,0)) *  coalesce(sr.StorageRate, 0)    
    end as Charge    
   from #tmpDivisionsToInclude as divisions    
   left outer join #tmpstoragerates sr on divisions.divisionpk = sr.fk    
   left outer join #PalletsUnits currentPallets on currentPallets.DivisionPK = divisions.DivisionPK    
   left outer join #palletOutsAfterPeriod as palletOutsAfterPeriod on palletOutsAfterPeriod.DivisionPK = divisions.DivisionPK    
   left outer join #insAfterPeriod as insAfterPeriod on insAfterPeriod.DivisionPK = divisions.DivisionPK    
   left outer join #palletOutsFromStartOfPeriod as palletOutsFromStartOfPeriod on palletOutsFromStartOfPeriod.DivisionPK = divisions.DivisionPK    
   left outer join #insFromStartOfPeriod as insFromStartOfPeriod ON insFromStartOfPeriod.DivisionPK = divisions.DivisionPK    
        
   -- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end    
          
   BREAK    
  END TRY    
  BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */    
   DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;    
   SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;    
   SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;    
    
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY     
   BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;    
           
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;    
    
            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID    
                
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;    
                
   IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)    
   BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END    
   ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */    
  END CATCH    
  SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1    
 END    
END 
GO

        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK  
  
        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()  
    --END  
  
 SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);  
 SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails  
 ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;  
 INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()  
  
 WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3

   IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#TempPalletAudit') IS NOT NULL

    on s.stockitempk = pa.stockitemfk   
   inner join tbldivisions as d   
    on d.divisionpk = s.divisionfk  
   where   
    ((@var_divisionFK > 0 and d.divisionpk = @var_divisionFK) or (d.customerfk = @var_customerFK))  
    and pa.eventdate >= @var_startDate  
  
   IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#PalletsUnits') IS NOT NULL

    sum(ActualEaches) ActualEaches, sum(AvailableEaches) AvailableEaches, sum(ActualUnits) ActualUnits,  
    sum(AvailableUnits) AvailableUnits   
   INTO  
    #PalletsUnits  
   from   
    (  
     Select StockItemFK, sum(ActualPallets) ActualPallets, sum(AvailablePallets) AvailablePallets,   
     sum(ActualEaches) ActualEaches, sum(AvailableEaches) AvailableEaches, sum(ActualUnits) ActualUnits,  
     sum(AvailableUnits) AvailableUnits   
     from tblStockLevels  
     where (@var_stockItemFK = -1 OR (@var_stockItemFK = StockItemFK AND @var_stockItemFK > 0))  
     AND MixedContentCount < 2  
     Group By StockItemFK  
  
     union   
  
     Select StockItemFK,   
     sum(ActualPallets) - (MixedContentCount-1) ActualPallets,   
     sum(AvailablePallets) - (MixedContentCount-1) AvailablePallets,    
     sum(ActualEaches) ActualEaches, sum(AvailableEaches) AvailableEaches, sum(ActualUnits) ActualUnits,  
     sum(AvailableUnits) AvailableUnits   
     from tblStockLevels  
     where (@var_stockItemFK = -1 OR (@var_stockItemFK = StockItemFK AND @var_stockItemFK > 0))  
     AND MixedContentCount > 1  
     Group By StockItemFK, MixedContentCount  
  
    ) as subq   
   group by

   IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#regrades') IS NOT NULL  
    DROP TABLE #regrades        
      
   SELECT * INTO #regrades FROM  
   (  
    Select 0 as PalletsIn, 0 as UnitsIn, 0 as PalletsOut, 0 as UnitsOut, -1 as StockItemFK, 0 as LineType  
  
    Union All  
  
    Select   
     sum(PalletsIn) AS PalletsIn, sum(UnitsIn) AS UnitsIn, sum(PalletsOut) AS PalletsOut, sum(UnitsOut) AS UnitsOut, StockItemFK, 1 AS LineType     
    from   
     (  
      Select count(*) PalletsIn, SUM(UnitsAfter) UnitsIn, 0 PalletsOut, 0 UnitsOut, StockItemAfterFK as StockItemFK, 1 LineType  
      From tblStockAdjustments sas  
      Where InsertedDate BETWEEN @var_startDate AND @var_endDate  
      AND StockItemBeforeFK <> StockItemAfterFK  
      Group By StockItemAfterFK  
      Union All  
      Select 0 PalletsIn, 0 UnitsIn, count(*) PalletsOut, SUM(UnitsAfter) UnitsOut, StockItemBeforeFK StockItemFK, 2 LineType  
      From tblStockAdjustments sas  
      Where InsertedDate BETWEEN @var_startDate AND @var_endDate  
      AND StockItemBeforeFK <> StockItemAfterFK  
      Group By StockItemBeforeFK  
     ) as subQ  
    Group By   
     StockItemFK  
   )as subQ2  
   where

   OR  
   (

       AND EventDate > @var_endDate  
       Group By EventFK  
      ) AS [audit]  
    on [audit].EventFK = cols.ContainerOutLinePK  
   Where   
    cOuts.ContainerOutStatusFK = 5 /*Complete*/  
    AND   
    (  
     @var_stockItemFK = -1  
     OR cols.StockItemFK  = @var_stockItemFK

    AND EventDate > @var_endDate   
    and   
    (  
     @var_StockItemFK = -1

    )  
   Group By   
    StockItemFK  
     
   IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#audit') IS NOT NULL  
    DROP TABLE #audit

   into

   from   
    #TempPalletAudit as pa  
   inner join tblWorksOrders as wos  
    on wos.WorksOrderPK = EventFK  
   Where   
    EventTypeFK = 16 /*Topoff DepleatedPallet - Absorbed*/  
    AND EventDate > @var_endDate  
    and   
    (  
     @var_StockItemFK = -1

   IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#insAfterPeriodDetails') IS NOT NULL  
    DROP TABLE #insAfterPeriodDetails  
  
   Select   
    sils.StockItemFK, pa.PalletFK, 1 - sum(isnull([audit].PalletsAbsorbed, 0)) as PalletsIn, sum(sils.Units) as UnitsIn  
   into  
    #insAfterPeriodDetails  
   From   
    tblStockInLines as sils  
   inner join tblStockIns as sins on  
    sins.StockInPK = sils.StockInFK  
   inner join tblContainerIns as cins on  
    cins.ContainerInPK = sins.ContainerInFK  
    AND cins.StockInStatusFK = 3 /*Completed*/  
    --AND cins.StockInStatusFK <> 4 /*Not cancelled*/  
    --AND cins.StockInStatusFK <> 1 /*Not OnRoute*/  
   --inner join #TempPalletAudit as pa on pa.EventTypeFK = 1 /*PalletCreated*/ AND pa.EventFK = sils.StockInLinePK AND pa.StockItemFK = sils.StockItemFK     
   inner join tblstockinlinepallets silp on sils.stockinlinepk = silp.stockinlinefk  
   inner join tblpalletaudit as pa on pa.EventTypeFK = 1 /*PalletCreated*/ AND silp.palletfk = pa.palletfk AND pa.StockItemFK = sils.StockItemFK  
   left outer join #audit as [audit]   
    on [audit].StockItemFK = sils.StockItemFK  
    AND [audit].FK = sins.StockInPK  
    AND [audit].PalletFK = pa.PalletFK  
   Where

     @var_StockItemFK = -1  
     or sils.StockItemFK = @var_StockItemFK

   IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#insAfterPeriod') IS NOT NULL

   -- Drop this table as no longer needed  
   IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#insAfterPeriodDetails') IS NOT NULL  
    DROP TABLE #insAfterPeriodDetails  
      
   IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#palletOutsFromStartOfPeriod') IS NOT NULL  
    DROP TABLE #palletOutsFromStartOfPeriod

   IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#RegradesFromStartDetails') IS NOT NULL  
    DROP TABLE #RegradesFromStartDetails

   into #RegradesFromStartDetails  
   From tblStockAdjustments as sas  
   Where InsertedDate >= @var_startDate   
   AND StockItemBeforeFK <> StockItemAfterFK  
   and  
   (  
    @var_StockItemFK = -1  
    or StockItemAfterFK = @var_StockItemFK  
   )   
   Group By StockItemAfterFK  
  
   insert into #RegradesFromStartDetails  
   Select count(*) as Pallets, SUM(UnitsAfter) as Units, StockItemBeforeFK as StockItemFK, 2 as LineType  
   From tblStockAdjustments as sas  
   Where InsertedDate >= @var_startDate   
   AND StockItemBeforeFK <> StockItemAfterFK  
   and  
   (  
    @var_StockItemFK = -1  
    or StockItemBeforeFK = @var_StockItemFK  
   )   
   Group By StockItemBeforeFK      
      
   IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#RegradesFromStart') IS NOT NULL  
    DROP TABLE #RegradesFromStart  
          
   Select   
    sum(Pallets) as Pallets, sum(Units) as Units, StockItemFK, 1 as LineType   
   into   
    #RegradesFromStart  
   from   
    #RegradesFromStartDetails   
   Group By   
    StockItemFK  
     
   -- Drop table as it's no longer needed  
   IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#RegradesFromStartDetails') IS NOT NULL  
    DROP TABLE #RegradesFromStartDetails        
        
   IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#RegradesAfterPeriod') IS NOT NULL  
    DROP TABLE #RegradesAfterPeriod       
  
   Select   
    sum(Pallets) as Pallets, sum(Units) as Units, StockItemFK, 1 as LineType   
   into  
    #RegradesAfterPeriod  
   from   
   (  
    Select   
     count(*) * -1 as Pallets, SUM(UnitsAfter) * -1 as Units, StockItemAfterFK as StockItemFK, 1 as LineType  
    From   
     tblStockAdjustments as sas  
    Where   
     InsertedDate > @var_endDate   
     AND StockItemBeforeFK <> StockItemAfterFK  
     and  
     (  
      @var_StockItemFK = -1  
      or StockItemAfterFK = @var_StockItemFK  
     )   
    Group By   
     StockItemAfterFK  
      
    Union All  
  
    Select   
     count(*) as Pallets, SUM(UnitsAfter) as Units, StockItemBeforeFK as StockItemFK, 2 as LineType  
    From   
     tblStockAdjustments as sas  
    Where   
     InsertedDate > @var_endDate   
     AND StockItemBeforeFK <> StockItemAfterFK  
     and  
     (  
      @var_StockItemFK = -1  
      or StockItemBeforeFK = @var_StockItemFK  
     )   
    Group By   
     StockItemBeforeFK  
   ) as subQ  
   Group By   
    StockItemFK      
  
   IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#audit2') IS NOT NULL  
    DROP TABLE #audit2   
  
   Select   
    EventFK  
   into   
    #audit2  
   from   
    #TempPalletAudit as pa  
   Where   
    EventTypeFK in (2,3)/*Pallet or StockRemoved*/  
    AND EventDate >= @var_startDate  
    and   
    (  
     @var_StockItemFK = -1  
     or StockItemFK = @var_StockItemFK  
    )  
   Group By   
    EventFK       
      
   IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#unitsOutFromStartOfPeriod') IS NOT NULL  
    DROP TABLE #unitsOutFromStartOfPeriod  
  
   Select   
    sum(colpc.Units) AS UnitsOut, cols.StockItemFK   
   INTO  
    #unitsOutFromStartOfPeriod  
   from   
    tblContainerOutLines AS cols  
   inner join (   
       Select ContainerOutLineFK, sum(Units) AS Units   
       from tblContainerOutLinePalletContent  
       Group By ContainerOutLineFK  
      ) as colpc   
    on colpc.ContainerOutLineFK = cols.ContainerOutLinePK  
   inner join tblContainerOuts as cOuts   
    on cOuts.ContainerOutPK = cols.ContainerOutFK  
   inner join #audit2 AS [audit]   
    on [audit].EventFK = cols.ContainerOutLinePK  
   Where   
    cOuts.ContainerOutStatusFK = 5 /*Complete*/  
    and   
    (  
     @var_StockItemFK = -1  
     or StockItemFK = @var_StockItemFK  
    )  
   Group By   
    StockItemFK           
      
   IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#audit3') IS NOT NULL  
    DROP TABLE #audit3     
      
        Select   
         count(*) as PalletsAbsorbed, pa.PalletFK, StockItemFK, wos.FK   
        into  
         #audit3  
        from   
         #TempPalletAudit as pa  
        inner join tblWorksOrders as wos   
         on wos.WorksOrderPK = EventFK  
        Where   
         EventTypeFK = 16 /*Topoff DepleatedPallet - Absorbed*/  
         AND EventDate >= @var_startDate  
         and   
         (  
          @var_StockItemFK = -1  
          or StockItemFK = @var_StockItemFK  
         )  
        Group By   
         pa.PalletFK, StockItemFK, wos.FK        
       
   IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#insFromStartOfPeriodDetail') IS NOT NULL  
    DROP TABLE #insFromStartOfPeriodDetail   
  
   Select   
    sils.StockItemFK, pa.PalletFK, 1 - sum(isnull([audit].PalletsAbsorbed, 0)) as PalletsIn, sum(sils.Units) as UnitsIn  
   into  
    #insFromStartOfPeriodDetail  
   From   
    tblStockInLines as sils  
   inner join tblStockIns as sins on  
    sins.StockInPK = sils.StockInFK  
   inner join tblContainerIns as cins on  
    cins.ContainerInPK = sins.ContainerInFK   
    AND cins.StockInStatusFK = 3 /*Completed*/  
    --AND cins.StockInStatusFK <> 4 /*Not cancelled*/  
    --AND cins.StockInStatusFK <> 1 /*Not OnRoute*/  
   --inner join #TempPalletAudit as pa on pa.EventTypeFK = 1 /*PalletCreated*/ AND pa.EventFK = sils.StockInLinePK AND pa.StockItemFK = sils.StockItemFK     
   inner join tblstockinlinepallets silp on sils.stockinlinepk = silp.stockinlinefk  
   inner join tblpalletaudit as pa on pa.EventTypeFK = 1 /*PalletCreated*/ AND silp.palletfk = pa.palletfk AND pa.StockItemFK = sils.StockItemFK  
   left outer join #audit3 as [audit]  
    on [audit].StockItemFK = sils.StockItemFK  
    AND [audit].FK = sins.StockInPK  
    AND pa.PalletFK = [audit].PalletFK  
   Where   
    cins.DateIn > @var_startDate  
    and   
    (  
     @var_StockItemFK = -1  
     or sils.StockItemFK = @var_StockItemFK

    sils.StockItemFK, pa.PalletFK  
                
   IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#insFromStartOfPeriod') IS NOT NULL  
    DROP TABLE #insFromStartOfPeriod  
      
   Select   
    StockItemFK, sum(PalletsIn) as PalletsIn, sum(UnitsIn) as UnitsIn   
   into   
    #insFromStartOfPeriod  
   from   
    #insFromStartOfPeriodDetail   
   Group By   
    StockItemFK   
     
   -- Drop table as it's no longer needed  
   IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#insFromStartOfPeriodDetail') IS NOT NULL  
    DROP TABLE #insFromStartOfPeriodDetail        
  
   Declare @customer nvarchar(500), @divisionName nvarchar(200)  
   Set @customer = (Select CustomerName from tblCustomers where CustomerPK = @var_customerFK)  
   Select @divisionName = DivisionName from tblDivisions Where DivisionPK = @var_divisionFK  
  
   IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#historicalReport') IS NOT NULL  
    DROP TABLE #historicalReport  
  
   CREATE TABLE #historicalReport  
   (  
    Customer nvarchar(200),  
    StockItemPK int,  
    StockItemCode nvarchar(200),  
    StockDescription nvarchar(500),  
    OpeningTotalPallets int,  
    OpeningTotalUnits decimal(18,3),  
    ClosingTotalPallets int,  
    ClosingTotalUnits decimal(18,3),  
    PalletsIn int,  
    UnitsIn decimal(18,3),  
    PalletsOut int,  
    UnitsOut decimal(18,3),  
    IsRegrade nvarchar(10)  
   )  
  
   Insert Into #historicalReport  
   select *      
   from  
    (  
     Select   
      case when @divisionName is not null then @divisionName else @customer end Customer,  
      StockItemPK,  
      StockItemCode + case when regrades.LineType = 0 then '' else ' (Regrade)' end as StockItemCode,  
      sis.Description as StockDescription,  
      Case when regrades.LineType = 0 then  
       isnull(ActualPallets, 0) + isnull(palletOutsFromStartOfPeriod.PalletsOut, 0) - isnull(insFromStartOfPeriod.PalletsIn,0) + isnull(regradesFromStart.Pallets, 0)/*Regrades from start has the result of ins and outs- It is a total, you will not see Regr
adesFromStart.PalletsIn*/  
      else 0 end OpeningTotalPallets,  
  
      Case when regrades.LineType = 0 then  
       isnull(ActualUnits,0) + isnull(unitsOutFromStartOfPeriod.UnitsOut, 0)  - isnull(insFromStartOfPeriod.UnitsIn,0) + isnull(regradesFromStart.Units, 0)  
      else 0 end OpeningTotalUnits,  
  
      isnull(ActualPallets, 0) + isnull(palletOutsAfterPeriod.PalletsOut, 0) - isnull(insAfterPeriod.PalletsIn,0) + isnull(regradesAfterPeriod.Pallets, 0) ClosingTotalPallets,  
  
      isnull(ActualUnits,0) + isnull(unitsOutAfterPeriod.UnitsOut, 0)  - isnull(insAfterPeriod.UnitsIn,0) + isnull(regradesAfterPeriod.Units, 0) ClosingTotalUnits,  
  
      Case when regrades.LineType = 0 then  
       isnull(insFromStartOfPeriod.PalletsIn, 0) - isnull(insAfterPeriod.PalletsIn, 0)  
      else case when regrades.PalletsIn > 0 then regrades.PalletsIn else 0 end end PalletsIn,  
  
      Case when regrades.LineType = 0 then  
       isnull(insFromStartOfPeriod.UnitsIn, 0) - isnull(insAfterPeriod.UnitsIn, 0)  
      else case when regrades.UnitsIn > 0 then regrades.UnitsIn else 0 end end UnitsIn,  
  
      Case when regrades.LineType = 0 then  
       isnull(palletOutsFromStartOfPeriod.PalletsOut, 0) - isnull(palletOutsAfterPeriod.PalletsOut, 0)   
      else case when regrades.PalletsOut > 0 then regrades.PalletsOut else 0 end end PalletsOut,  
  
      Case when regrades.LineType = 0 then  
      isnull(unitsOutFromStartOfPeriod.UnitsOut, 0) - isnull(unitsOutAfterPeriod.UnitsOut, 0)   
      else case when regrades.UnitsOut > 0 then regrades.UnitsOut else 0 end end UnitsOut,  
  
      Case when regrades.LineType = 1 then 'R' else '' end IsRegrade  
     from   
      tblStockItems as sis  
     inner join tblDivisions as divisions  
      on divisions.DivisionPK = sis.DivisionFK  
     left outer join #PalletsUnits as currentLevel   
      on currentLevel.StockItemFK = sis.StockItemPK  
     left outer join #palletOutsAfterPeriod as palletOutsAfterPeriod  
      on palletOutsAfterPeriod.StockItemFK = sis.StockItemPK  
     left outer join #unitsOutAfterPeriod AS unitsOutAfterPeriod  
      ON unitsOutAfterPeriod.StockItemFK = sis.StockItemPK  
     left outer join #insAfterPeriod as insAfterPeriod  
      on insAfterPeriod.StockItemFK = sis.StockItemPK  
     left outer join #palletOutsFromStartOfPeriod as palletOutsFromStartOfPeriod  
      on palletOutsFromStartOfPeriod.StockItemFK = sis.StockItemPK  
     inner join #regrades as regrades   
      on regrades.LineType = 0 /*We should always have this line*/  
      OR  
      (  
       regrades.LineType = 1 /*We have regrades*/   
       AND regrades.StockItemFK = sis.StockItemPK  
      )  
     left outer join #RegradesFromStart as RegradesFromStart   
      on RegradesFromStart.StockItemFK = sis.StockItemPK  
     left outer join #RegradesAfterPeriod as RegradesAfterPeriod  
      on RegradesAfterPeriod.StockItemFK = sis.StockItemPK  
     left outer join #unitsOutFromStartOfPeriod as unitsOutFromStartOfPeriod   
      on unitsOutFromStartOfPeriod.StockItemFK = sis.StockItemPK  
     left outer join #insFromStartOfPeriod as insFromStartOfPeriod  
      ON insFromStartOfPeriod.StockItemFK = sis.StockItemPK  
     Where   
      divisions.CustomerFK = @var_customerFK  
      AND (@var_divisionFK = -1 OR (@var_divisionFK = divisions.DivisionPK))  
      AND (@var_stockItemFK = -1 OR (@var_stockItemFK = sis.StockItemPK AND @var_stockItemFK > 0))  
    ) as subQ  
   WHERE  
    (OpeningTotalUnits <> 0 OR OpeningTotalPallets <> 0 OR ClosingTotalPallets <> 0 OR PalletsIn <> 0 OR PalletsOut <> 0)  
  
   Select   
    hR.Customer ,  
    @var_startDate StartDate,  
    @toDate EndDate,  
    hR.StockItemPK,  
    hR.StockItemCode,  
    hR.StockDescription,  
    hR.OpeningTotalPallets,  
    hR.OpeningTotalUnits,  
    Case when regradeCheck.StockItemPK is not null AND hR.IsRegrade = '' then 0 else hR.ClosingTotalPallets end as ClosingTotalPallets,  
    Case when regradeCheck.StockItemPK is not null AND hR.IsRegrade = '' then 0 else hR.ClosingTotalUnits end as ClosingTotalUnits,  
    Case when hR.IsRegrade = 'R' then 0 else hR.PalletsIn end as PalletsIn,  
    Case when hR.IsRegrade = 'R' then 0 else hR.UnitsIn end as UnitsIn,  
    Case when hR.IsRegrade = 'R' then 0 else hR.PalletsOut end as PalletsOut,  
    Case when hR.IsRegrade = 'R' then 0 else hR.UnitsOut end as UnitsOut,  
    Case when hR.IsRegrade = 'R' then hR.PalletsIn else 0 end as RegradePalletsIn,  
    Case when hR.IsRegrade = 'R' then hR.UnitsIn else 0 end as RegradeUnitsIn,  
    Case when hR.IsRegrade = 'R' then hR.PalletsOut else 0 end as RegradePalletsOut,  
    Case when hR.IsRegrade = 'R' then hR.UnitsOut else 0 end as RegradeUnitsOut,  
    Case when regradeCheck.StockItemPK is not null AND hR.IsRegrade = '' then 'RO' else hR.IsRegrade end as IsRegrade   
   from   
    #historicalReport as hR  
   left outer join #historicalReport as regradeCheck on  
    regradeCheck.StockItemPK = hR.StockItemPK  
    AND regradeCheck.IsRegrade = 'R'  
   order by   
    hr.StockItemCode asc  
      
   -- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end  
        
   BREAK  
  END TRY  
  BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */  
   DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;  
   SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;  
   SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;  
  
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY   
   BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;  
         
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;  
  
            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID  
              
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;  
              
   IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)  
   BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END  
   ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */  
  END CATCH  
  SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1  
 END  
END  
GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[spReportsHistoricalStockMovementsForCustomerWithBatch]    Script Date: 02/11/2026 17:47:27 ******/

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spReportsHistoricalStockMovementsForCustomerWithBatch]
(
	@customerFK int,
	@divisionFK int = -1,
	@startDate datetime,
	@endDate datetime,
	@stockItemFK int = -1,
	@batch nvarchar(200) = ''
)	
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data; Ensure this proc has a low impact when executed */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED; SET DEADLOCK_PRIORITY LOW

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT
	,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;
	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	DECLARE @var_customerFK int, @var_divisionFK int, @var_startDate datetime, @var_endDate datetime, @var_stockItemFK int, @var_batch nvarchar(200)

	SET @var_customerFK = ISNULL(@customerFK,0); SET @var_divisionFK = ISNULL(@divisionFK,-1); SET @var_startDate = @startDate; SET @var_endDate = @endDate
	SET @var_stockItemFK = ISNULL(@stockItemFK,-1); SET @var_batch = ISNULL(@batch,'')

	SET @ParameterDetails = '@customerFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_customerFK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@divisionFK = ' 
		+ ISNULL(CAST(@var_divisionFK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@startDate = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_startDate AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') 
			+ ',@endDate = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_endDate AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@stockItemFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_stockItemFK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') 
				+ ',@batch = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_batch AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'')

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    --BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

		SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END

	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY
			
			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start

			Declare @customerName nvarchar(200), @divisionName nvarchar(200)
			Select @customerName = CustomerName from tblCustomers Where CustomerPK = @var_customerFK
			Select @divisionName = DivisionName from tblDivisions Where DivisionPK = @var_divisionFK

			DECLARE @ToDate DATETIME -- Used in Where statement to include all records for the end date
			set @ToDate = DATEADD(day,1,@var_endDate)

			--IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#viewStockLevels') IS NOT NULL
			--	DROP TABLE #viewStockLevels

			--CREATE TABLE #viewStockLevels
			--(
			--	[StockItemFK] INT,
			--	[Batch] NVARCHAR(200),
			--	[SpecialStockTypeFK] INT,
			--	[ActualPallets] INT,
			--	[AvailablePallets] INT,
			--	[ActualEaches] DECIMAL(38,3),
			--	[ActualUnits] DECIMAL(38,3),
			--	[AvailableEaches] DECIMAL(38,3),
			--	[AvailableUnits] DECIMAL(38,3),
			--	[Expr1] BIT,
			--	[Expr2] INT,
			--	[Expr3] DATETIME,
			--	[Expr4] INT,
			--	[Expr5] DATETIME
			--)

			--INSERT INTO #viewStockLevels
			--EXEC dbo.spGetStockLevels @var_stockItemFK, @var_batch

			-- Run the spStockLevelsSync stored procedure if it is not already executing.

			--IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#IsStoredProcedureExecuting') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #IsStoredProcedureExecuting

			--CREATE TABLE #IsStoredProcedureExecuting(Result INT)

			--INSERT INTO #IsStoredProcedureExecuting
			--EXEC dbo.spIsStoredProcedureExecuting 'spStockLevelsSync'
			
			--IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #IsStoredProcedureExecuting WHERE Result = 0) EXEC [dbo].[spStockLevelsSync]

			if object_id('tempdb..#currentStockLevel') is not null 
				drop table #currentStockLevel	

			Select 
				StockItemFK, Batch, sum(ActualPallets) as ActualPallets, sum(AvailablePallets) as AvailablePallets,
				sum(ActualEaches) as ActualEaches, sum(AvailableEaches) as AvailableEaches, sum(ActualUnits) as ActualUnits,
				sum(AvailableUnits) as AvailableUnits 
			into 
				#currentStockLevel
			from 
				--#viewStockLevels
				dbo.tblStockLevels
			Where 
				(@var_stockItemFK = -1 OR @var_stockItemFK = StockItemFK)
				AND (@var_batch = '' OR @var_batch = Batch)	
			Group By 
				StockItemFK, Batch 

			if object_id('tempdb..#stockBatch') is not null 
				drop table #stockBatch

			select distinct
				pa.StockItemFK,
				pa.Batch,
				pa.EventDate,
				pa.EventFK,
				pa.EventTypeFK,
				pa.PalletFK
			into
				#stockBatch
			from 
				dbo.tblDivisions as divisions
			inner join dbo.tblStockItems as sis 
				on sis.DivisionFK = divisions.DivisionPK
			inner join dbo.tblPalletAudit as pa
				on sis.StockItemPK = pa.StockItemFK
			Where 
				divisions.CustomerFK = @var_customerFK
				AND (@var_divisionFK = -1 OR @var_divisionFK = divisions.DivisionPK)
				AND (@var_stockItemFK = -1 OR @var_stockItemFK = sis.StockItemPK)
				AND (@var_batch = '' OR @var_batch = Batch)										

			if object_id('tempdb..#palletOutsAfterPeriod') is not null 
				drop table #palletOutsAfterPeriod

			Select count(*) as PalletsOut, StockItemFK, Batch 
			into #palletOutsAfterPeriod
			from #stockBatch
			Where EventTypeFK in (2,23)-- = 2 /*PalletRemoved*/
			AND EventDate > @ToDate 
			Group By StockItemFK, Batch


			if object_id('tempdb..#unitsOutAfterPeriod') is not null 
				drop table #unitsOutAfterPeriod

			Select 
				sum(colpc.Units) as UnitsOut, cols.StockItemFK, cols.Batch 
			Into
				#unitsOutAfterPeriod
			from 
				dbo.tblContainerOutLines as cols
			inner join ( 
							Select ContainerOutLineFK, sum(Units) as Units 
							from dbo.tblContainerOutLinePalletContent
							Group By ContainerOutLineFK
						) as colpc
				on colpc.ContainerOutLineFK = cols.ContainerOutLinePK
			inner join dbo.tblContainerOuts as cOuts
				on cOuts.ContainerOutPK = cols.ContainerOutFK
			inner join (
							Select Distinct EventFK, StockItemFK, Batch
							from #stockBatch
							Where EventTypeFK in (2,3)/*Pallet or StockRemoved*/
							AND EventDate > @ToDate
						) as [audit]
				on [audit].EventFK = cols.ContainerOutLinePK
				AND [audit].StockItemFK = cols.StockItemFK
				AND [audit].Batch = cols.Batch 
			Where 
				cOuts.ContainerOutStatusFK = 5 /*Complete*/
			Group By
				cols.StockItemFK, cols.Batch

			if object_id('tempdb..#insAfterPeriod') is not null 
				drop table #insAfterPeriod
			
			Select 
				StockItemFK, Batch, sum(PalletsIn) as PalletsIn, sum(UnitsIn) as UnitsIn 
			Into
				#insAfterPeriod
			from 
				(
					Select 
						sils.StockItemFK, sils.Batch, pa.PalletFK, 1 - sum(isnull(audit.PalletsAbsorbed, 0)) as PalletsIn, sum(sils.Units) as UnitsIn
					From 
						dbo.tblStockInLines as sils
					INNER JOIN tblstockinlinepallets silp 
						ON stockinlinefk = stockinlinepk/*Jamie: join to pa on palletfk, not event fk*/
					inner join dbo.tblStockIns as sins
						on sins.StockInPK = sils.StockInFK
					inner join dbo.tblContainerIns as cins
						on cins.ContainerInPK = sins.ContainerInFK 
						AND cins.StockInStatusFK = 3 /*Completed*/
					inner join #stockBatch as pa
						on pa.EventTypeFK = 1 /*PalletCreated*/
						--AND pa.EventFK = sils.StockInLinePK						 
						AND pa.palletfk = silp.palletfk 
						AND pa.StockItemFK = sils.StockItemFK  /* RS Added to fix issue with Coeur 7/12/2017*/
					left outer join (
										Select 
											count(*) as PalletsAbsorbed, pa.PalletFK, StockItemFK, Batch, wos.FK 
										from 
											#stockBatch as pa
										inner join dbo.tblWorksOrders as wos
											on wos.WorksOrderPK = EventFK
										Where 
											EventTypeFK = 16/*Topoff DepleatedPallet - Absorbed*/
											AND EventDate > @ToDate
										Group By 
											pa.PalletFK, StockItemFK, Batch, wos.FK
									) as [audit]
						on [audit].StockItemFK = sils.StockItemFK
						AND [audit].Batch = sils.Batch
						AND [audit].FK = sins.StockInPK
						AND [audit].PalletFK = pa.PalletFK
					Where 
						cins.DateIn > @ToDate
					Group By 
						sils.StockItemFK, sils.Batch, pa.PalletFK
				) as subQ 
			Group By 
				StockItemFK, Batch

			if object_id('tempdb..#palletOutsFromStartOfPeriod') is not null 
				drop table #palletOutsFromStartOfPeriod
			
			Select count(*) as PalletsOut, StockItemFK, Batch 
			into #palletOutsFromStartOfPeriod
			from #stockBatch
			Where EventTypeFK in (2,23)--= 2 /*PalletRemoved*/
			AND EventDate >= @var_startDate 
			Group By StockItemFK, Batch

			if object_id('tempdb..#unitsOutFromStartOfPeriod') is not null 
				drop table #unitsOutFromStartOfPeriod

			Select 
				sum(colpc.Units) as UnitsOut, cols.StockItemFK, cols.Batch 
			Into
				#unitsOutFromStartOfPeriod
			from 
				dbo.tblContainerOutLines as cols
			inner join ( 
							Select ContainerOutLineFK, sum(Units) as Units 
							from dbo.tblContainerOutLinePalletContent
							Group By ContainerOutLineFK
						) as colpc
				on colpc.ContainerOutLineFK = cols.ContainerOutLinePK
			inner join tblContainerOuts as cOuts
				on cOuts.ContainerOutPK = cols.ContainerOutFK
			inner join (
							Select Distinct EventFK, StockItemFK, Batch  
							from #stockBatch
							Where EventTypeFK in (2,3)/*Pallet or StockRemoved*/
							AND EventDate >= @var_startDate
						) as [audit]
				on [audit].EventFK = cols.ContainerOutLinePK
				and [audit].StockItemFK = cols.StockItemFK
				and [audit].Batch = cols.Batch
			Where 
				cOuts.ContainerOutStatusFK = 5 /*Complete*/
			Group By 
				cols.StockItemFK, cols.Batch

			if object_id('tempdb..#insFromStartOfPeriod') is not null 
				drop table #insFromStartOfPeriod

			Select 
				StockItemFK, Batch, sum(PalletsIn) as PalletsIn, sum(UnitsIn) as UnitsIn 
			Into
				#insFromStartOfPeriod
			from 
				(
					Select 
						sils.StockItemFK, sils.Batch, pa.PalletFK, 1 - sum(isnull([audit].PalletsAbsorbed, 0)) as PalletsIn, sum(sils.Units) as UnitsIn
					From 
						dbo.tblStockInLines as sils
					INNER JOIN tblstockinlinepallets silp 
						ON stockinlinefk = stockinlinepk/*Jamie: join to pa on palletfk, not event fk*/
					inner join dbo.tblStockIns as sins
						on sins.StockInPK = sils.StockInFK
					inner join dbo.tblContainerIns as cins
						on cins.ContainerInPK = sins.ContainerInFK
						AND cins.StockInStatusFK = 3 /*Completed*/ 
					inner join #stockBatch as pa
						on pa.EventTypeFK = 1 /*PalletCreated*/
						--AND pa.EventFK = sils.StockInLinePK						 
						AND pa.palletfk = silp.palletfk 
						AND pa.StockItemFK = sils.StockItemFK
					left outer join (
										Select count(*) as PalletsAbsorbed, pa.PalletFK, StockItemFK, Batch, wos.FK 
										from #stockBatch as pa
										inner join dbo.tblWorksOrders as wos
										on wos.WorksOrderPK = EventFK
										Where EventTypeFK = 16/*Topoff DepleatedPallet - Absorbed*/
										AND EventDate >= @var_startDate
										Group By pa.PalletFK, StockItemFK, Batch, wos.FK
									) as [audit]
						on [audit].StockItemFK = sils.StockItemFK
						AND [audit].Batch = sils.Batch
						AND [audit].FK = sins.StockInPK
						AND [audit].PalletFK = pa.PalletFK
					Where 
						cins.DateIn > @var_startDate
					Group By 
						sils.StockItemFK, sils.Batch, pa.PalletFK
				) as subQ 
			Group By 
				StockItemFK, Batch

			DECLARE @varCustomerName NVARCHAR(500) = (Select case when @divisionName is not null then @divisionName else @customerName end)

			if object_id('tempdb..#Results') is not null 
				drop table #Results

			Select 
				@varCustomerName AS Customer,
				@varCustomerName as CustomerName, 
				divisions.DivisionName, 
				divisions.DivisionCode,
				@var_startDate StartDate,
				@var_endDate EndDate,
				StockItemPK,
				StockItemCode, 
				stockBatch.Batch,
				isnull(ActualPallets, 0) + isnull(palletOutsFromStartOfPeriod.PalletsOut, 0) - isnull(insFromStartOfPeriod.PalletsIn,0) as OpeningTotalPallets,
				isnull(ActualUnits,0) + isnull(unitsOutFromStartOfPeriod.UnitsOut, 0)  - isnull(insFromStartOfPeriod.UnitsIn,0) as OpeningTotalUnits,
				isnull(ActualPallets, 0) + isnull(palletOutsAfterPeriod.PalletsOut, 0) - isnull(insAfterPeriod.PalletsIn,0) as ClosingTotalPallets,
				isnull(ActualUnits,0) + isnull(unitsOutAfterPeriod.UnitsOut, 0)  - isnull(insAfterPeriod.UnitsIn,0) as ClosingTotalUnits,
				isnull(insFromStartOfPeriod.PalletsIn, 0) - isnull(insAfterPeriod.PalletsIn, 0) as PalletsIn,
				isnull(insFromStartOfPeriod.UnitsIn, 0) - isnull(insAfterPeriod.UnitsIn, 0) as UnitsIn,
				isnull(palletOutsFromStartOfPeriod.PalletsOut, 0) - isnull(palletOutsAfterPeriod.PalletsOut, 0) as PalletsOut,
				isnull(unitsOutFromStartOfPeriod.UnitsOut, 0) - isnull(unitsOutAfterPeriod.UnitsOut, 0) as UnitsOut
			Into
				#Results
			from 
				dbo.tblDivisions as divisions
			inner join dbo.tblStockItems as sis 
				on sis.DivisionFK = divisions.DivisionPK
			inner join #stockBatch as stockBatch 
				on stockBatch.StockItemFK = sis.StockItemPK
			left outer join #currentStockLevel as currentLevel 
				on currentLevel.StockItemFK = stockBatch.StockItemFK AND currentLevel.Batch = stockBatch.Batch
			left outer join #palletOutsAfterPeriod as palletOutsAfterPeriod
				on palletOutsAfterPeriod.StockItemFK = stockBatch.StockItemFK AND stockBatch.Batch = palletOutsAfterPeriod.Batch
			left outer join #unitsOutAfterPeriod as unitsOutAfterPeriod 
				on unitsOutAfterPeriod.StockItemFK = stockBatch.StockItemFK 
				AND unitsOutAfterPeriod.Batch = stockBatch.Batch
			left outer join #insAfterPeriod as insAfterPeriod
				on insAfterPeriod.StockItemFK = stockBatch.StockItemFK
				AND insAfterPeriod.Batch = stockBatch.Batch
			left outer join #palletOutsFromStartOfPeriod as palletOutsFromStartOfPeriod
				on palletOutsFromStartOfPeriod.StockItemFK = stockBatch.StockItemFK
				AND palletOutsFromStartOfPeriod.Batch = stockBatch.Batch
			left outer join #unitsOutFromStartOfPeriod as unitsOutFromStartOfPeriod
				on unitsOutFromStartOfPeriod.StockItemFK = stockBatch.StockItemFK
				AND unitsOutFromStartOfPeriod.Batch = stockBatch.Batch
			left outer join #insFromStartOfPeriod as insFromStartOfPeriod
				on insFromStartOfPeriod.StockItemFK = stockBatch.StockItemFK
				AND insFromStartOfPeriod.Batch = stockBatch.Batch
			Where 
				divisions.CustomerFK = @var_customerFK
				AND (@var_divisionFK = -1 OR @var_divisionFK = divisions.DivisionPK) 

			-- Return the final results to the report.

			Select Distinct
				* 
			From 
				#Results 
			Where 
				(OpeningTotalUnits <> 0 OR OpeningTotalPallets <> 0 OR ClosingTotalPallets <> 0 OR PalletsIn <> 0 OR PalletsOut <> 0)
				AND
				(@var_stockItemFK = -1 OR @var_stockItemFK = StockItemPK) 
				AND
				(@var_batch = '' OR @var_batch = Batch)			
			Order By 
				3 ASC /*DivisionCode*/, 7 ASC /*StockItemCode*/, 8 ASC /*Batch*/ -- Note using positions instead of column names due to usage of 'Select Distinct *'.

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end
						
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END

-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spReportsHistoricalStockMovementsWithBatch]
(
	@divisionFKs nvarchar(200),
	@startDate datetime,
	@endDate datetime,
	@stockItemFK int = -1,
	@batch nvarchar(200) = ''
)	
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data; Ensure this proc has a low impact when executed */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED; SET DEADLOCK_PRIORITY LOW

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT
	,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;
	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	DECLARE @var_divisionFKs nvarchar(200), @var_startDate datetime, @var_endDate datetime, @var_stockItemFK int, @var_batch nvarchar(200)

	SET @var_divisionFKs = @divisionFKs; SET @var_startDate = @startDate; SET @var_endDate = @endDate; SET @var_stockItemFK = @stockItemFK; SET @var_batch = @batch

	SET @ParameterDetails = '@divisionFKs = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_divisionFKs AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@startDate = ' 
		+ ISNULL(CAST(@var_startDate AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@endDate = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_endDate AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') 
			+ ',@stockItemFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_stockItemFK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@batch = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_batch AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'')

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    --BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

		SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END

	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY
			
			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start

			-- Run the spStockLevelsSync stored procedure if it is not already executing.

			--IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#IsStoredProcedureExecuting') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #IsStoredProcedureExecuting

			--CREATE TABLE #IsStoredProcedureExecuting(Result INT)

			--INSERT INTO #IsStoredProcedureExecuting
			--EXEC dbo.spIsStoredProcedureExecuting 'spStockLevelsSync'
			
			--IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #IsStoredProcedureExecuting WHERE Result = 0) EXEC [dbo].[spStockLevelsSync]

			DECLARE @ToDate DATETIME -- Used in Where statement to include all records for the end date
			set @ToDate = DATEADD(day,1,@var_endDate)

			Select * from (
			Select divisions.DivisionName, 
			divisions.DivisionCode,
			@var_startDate StartDate,
			@var_endDate EndDate,
			StockItemPK,
			StockItemCode, 
			stockBatch.Batch,
			isnull(ActualPallets, 0) + isnull(palletOutsFromStartOfPeriod.PalletsOut, 0) - isnull(insFromStartOfPeriod.PalletsIn,0) as OpeningTotalPallets,
			isnull(ActualUnits,0) + isnull(unitsOutFromStartOfPeriod.UnitsOut, 0)  - isnull(insFromStartOfPeriod.UnitsIn,0) as OpeningTotalUnits,
			isnull(ActualPallets, 0) + isnull(palletOutsAfterPeriod.PalletsOut, 0) - isnull(insAfterPeriod.PalletsIn,0) as ClosingTotalPallets,
			isnull(ActualUnits,0) + isnull(unitsOutAfterPeriod.UnitsOut, 0)  - isnull(insAfterPeriod.UnitsIn,0) as ClosingTotalUnits,
			isnull(insFromStartOfPeriod.PalletsIn, 0) - isnull(insAfterPeriod.PalletsIn, 0) as PalletsIn,
			isnull(insFromStartOfPeriod.UnitsIn, 0) - isnull(insAfterPeriod.UnitsIn, 0) as UnitsIn,
			isnull(palletOutsFromStartOfPeriod.PalletsOut, 0) - isnull(palletOutsAfterPeriod.PalletsOut, 0) as PalletsOut,
			isnull(unitsOutFromStartOfPeriod.UnitsOut, 0) - isnull(unitsOutAfterPeriod.UnitsOut, 0) as UnitsOut
			from tblDivisions as divisions
			inner join tblStockItems as sis on
			sis.DivisionFK = divisions.DivisionPK
			inner join (
				Select StockItemFK, Batch from viewPalletAuditKeyColumns
				Group By StockItemFK, Batch
			) as stockBatch on
			stockBatch.StockItemFK = sis.StockItemPK
			left outer join (
				Select StockItemFK, Batch, sum(ActualPallets) as ActualPallets, sum(AvailablePallets) as AvailablePallets,
				sum(ActualEaches) as ActualEaches, sum(AvailableEaches) as AvailableEaches, sum(ActualUnits) as ActualUnits,
				sum(AvailableUnits) as AvailableUnits from tblStockLevels
				Group By StockItemFK, Batch) as currentLevel on
			currentLevel.StockItemFK = stockBatch.StockItemFK AND currentLevel.Batch = stockBatch.Batch
			left outer join (
				Select count(*) PalletsOut, StockItemFK, Batch from viewPalletAuditKeyColumns
				Where EventTypeFK = 2 /*PalletRemoved*/
				AND EventDate > @ToDate 
				Group By StockItemFK, Batch
			) as palletOutsAfterPeriod on
			palletOutsAfterPeriod.StockItemFK = stockBatch.StockItemFK AND stockBatch.Batch = palletOutsAfterPeriod.Batch

			left outer join (
				Select sum(cols.Units) UnitsOut, cols.StockItemFK, cols.Batch from tblContainerOutLines as cols
				inner join tblContainerOuts as cOuts on
				cOuts.ContainerOutPK = cols.ContainerOutFK
				inner join (
					Select EventFK from viewPalletAuditKeyColumns
					Where EventTypeFK in (2,3)/*Pallet or StockRemoved*/
					AND EventDate > @ToDate
					Group By EventFK
				) as [audit] on
				[audit].EventFK = cols.ContainerOutLinePK
				Where cOuts.ContainerOutStatusFK = 5 /*Complete*/
				Group By StockItemFK, Batch
			) as unitsOutAfterPeriod on
			unitsOutAfterPeriod.StockItemFK = stockBatch.StockItemFK AND unitsOutAfterPeriod.Batch = stockBatch.Batch

			left outer join (
				Select StockItemFK, Batch, sum(PalletsIn) as PalletsIn, sum(UnitsIn) as UnitsIn from (
				Select sils.StockItemFK, sils.Batch, pa.PalletFK, 1 - sum(isnull([audit].PalletsAbsorbed, 0)) PalletsIn, sum(sils.Units) as UnitsIn
				From tblStockInLines as sils
				inner join tblStockIns as sins on
				sins.StockInPK = sils.StockInFK
				inner join tblContainerIns as cins on
				cins.ContainerInPK = sins.ContainerInFK 
				AND cins.StockInStatusFK = 3 /*Completed*/
				--AND cins.StockInStatusFK <> 4 /*Not cancelled*/
				--AND cins.StockInStatusFK <> 1 /*Not OnRoute*/
				/*inner join tblStockInLinePallets silps on
				silps.StockInLineFK = sils.StockInLinePK*/
				inner join viewPalletAuditKeyColumns as pa on
				pa.EventTypeFK = 1 /*PalletCreated*/
				AND pa.EventFK = sils.StockInLinePK
				AND pa.StockItemFK = sils.StockItemFK
				left outer join (
					Select count(*) PalletsAbsorbed, StockItemFK, Batch, wos.FK from viewPalletAuditKeyColumns as pa
					inner join tblWorksOrders as wos on
					wos.WorksOrderPK = EventFK
					Where EventTypeFK = 16/*Topoff DepleatedPallet - Absorbed*/
					AND EventDate > @ToDate
					Group By StockItemFK, Batch, wos.FK
				) as [audit] on
				[audit].StockItemFK = sils.StockItemFK
				AND [audit].Batch = sils.Batch
				AND [audit].FK = sins.StockInPK
				Where cins.DateIn > @ToDate
				Group By sils.StockItemFK, sils.Batch, pa.PalletFK
			) as subQ Group By StockItemFK, Batch) as insAfterPeriod on
			insAfterPeriod.StockItemFK = stockBatch.StockItemFK
			AND insAfterPeriod.Batch = stockBatch.Batch

			left outer join (
				Select count(*) PalletsOut, StockItemFK, Batch from viewPalletAuditKeyColumns
				Where EventTypeFK = 2 /*PalletRemoved*/
				AND EventDate >=@var_startDate 
				Group By StockItemFK, Batch
			) as palletOutsFromStartOfPeriod on
			palletOutsFromStartOfPeriod.StockItemFK = stockBatch.StockItemFK
			AND palletOutsFromStartOfPeriod.Batch = stockBatch.Batch

			left outer join (
				Select sum(cols.Units) UnitsOut, cols.StockItemFK, Batch from tblContainerOutLines as cols
				inner join tblContainerOuts as cOuts on
				cOuts.ContainerOutPK = cols.ContainerOutFK
				inner join (
					Select EventFK from viewPalletAuditKeyColumns
					Where EventTypeFK in (2,3)/*Pallet or StockRemoved*/
					AND EventDate >= @var_startDate
					Group By EventFK
				) as [audit] on
				[audit].EventFK = cols.ContainerOutLinePK
				Where cOuts.ContainerOutStatusFK = 5 /*Complete*/
				Group By StockItemFK, Batch
			) as unitsOutFromStartOfPeriod on
			unitsOutFromStartOfPeriod.StockItemFK = stockBatch.StockItemFK
			AND unitsOutFromStartOfPeriod.Batch = stockBatch.Batch

			left outer join (
				Select StockItemFK, Batch, sum(PalletsIn) as PalletsIn, sum(UnitsIn) as UnitsIn from (
				Select sils.StockItemFK, sils.Batch, pa.PalletFK, 1 - sum(isnull([audit].PalletsAbsorbed, 0)) as PalletsIn, sum(sils.Units) as UnitsIn
				From tblStockInLines as sils
				inner join tblStockIns as sins on
				sins.StockInPK = sils.StockInFK
				inner join tblContainerIns as cins on
				cins.ContainerInPK = sins.ContainerInFK 
				AND cins.StockInStatusFK = 3 /*Completed*/
				--AND cins.StockInStatusFK <> 4 /*Not cancelled*/ 
				--AND cins.StockInStatusFK <> 1 /*Not OnRoute*/
				/*inner join tblStockInLinePallets silps on
				silps.StockInLineFK = sils.StockInLinePK*/
				inner join viewPalletAuditKeyColumns as pa on
				pa.EventTypeFK = 1 /*PalletCreated*/
				AND pa.EventFK = sils.StockInLinePK
				AND pa.StockItemFK = sils.StockItemFK
				left outer join (
					Select count(*) PalletsAbsorbed, StockItemFK, Batch, wos.FK from viewPalletAuditKeyColumns pa
					inner join tblWorksOrders as wos on
					wos.WorksOrderPK = EventFK
					Where EventTypeFK = 16/*Topoff DepleatedPallet - Absorbed*/
					AND EventDate >= @var_startDate
					Group By StockItemFK, Batch, wos.FK
				) as [audit] on
				[audit].StockItemFK = sils.StockItemFK
				AND [audit].Batch = sils.Batch
				AND [audit].FK = sins.StockInPK
				Where cins.DateIn > @var_startDate
				Group By sils.StockItemFK, sils.Batch, pa.PalletFK
			) as subQ Group By StockItemFK, Batch) as insFromStartOfPeriod on
			insFromStartOfPeriod.StockItemFK = stockBatch.StockItemFK
			AND insFromStartOfPeriod.Batch = stockBatch.Batch

			Where (',' + @var_divisionFKs +',' LIKE '%,' + CONVERT(VARCHAR, DivisionPK) + ',%')

			) as subQ
			Where (OpeningTotalUnits <> 0 OR OpeningTotalPallets <> 0 OR ClosingTotalPallets <> 0 OR PalletsIn <> 0 OR PalletsOut <> 0)
			AND (@var_stockItemFK = -1 OR (@var_stockItemFK = StockItemPK and @var_stockItemFK > 0))
			AND (@var_batch = '' OR (@var_batch = Batch and @var_batch <> ''))

			Order By DivisionCode, StockItemCode, Batch

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end
						
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END
GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[spReportsHSEChargesCG]    Script Date: 02/11/2026 17:47:27 ******/
