-- Description: HSE Distributions Charges 
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spReportsHSEChargesCG]

AS
BEGIN
    -- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from
    -- interfering with SELECT statements.
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED; SET DEADLOCK_PRIORITY LOW    

declare @var_FromDate datetime = N'20230101'
declare		@var_ToDate datetime = N'20240101'

 drop table if exists #tmpAllDistCharges         
  select DistributionOrderPK, ContainerOutPK, do.OrderDate [Order Date], codc.DistributionChargeTypeFK, DistributionChargeFK, TotalCharge [Total Charge], do.OrderReference [Order Ref]          
   into #tmpAllDistCharges            
   from tblContainerOutDistributionCharges codc            
   inner join tblcontainerouts co on codc.containeroutfk = co.ContainerOutPK            
   inner join tblDistributionOrders do on do.DistributionOrderPK = co.DistributionOrderFK            
 -- inner join (select containeroutfk, divisionfk from tblcontaineroutlines)            
   where codc.InsertedDate >= @var_FromDate and codc.InsertedDate <= @var_ToDate and do.OrderStatusFK in (4,5,6,7) /*Dispatched / Hubbed / Delivered / Returned*/            
               
   drop table if exists #tmpChargeDetail            
   select distinct dc.*, col.DivisionFK, DistributionChargeType            
   into #tmpChargeDetail            
   from #tmpAllDistCharges dc            
   inner join tblcontaineroutlines col on dc.containeroutpk = col.ContainerOutFK            
   --inner join tbldivisions d on col.DivisionFK = d.DivisionPK            
   left join tblDistributionOrderCharges doc on doc.DistributionOrderChargePK = dc.DistributionChargeFK and dc.DistributionChargeTypeFK = 1            
   left join tblDistributionPackagingTypes dpt on doc.DistributionOrderChargePK = dpt.DistributionPackagingTypePK and dc.DistributionChargeTypeFK = 1  
 inner join appDistributionChargeTypes ct on ct.distributionchargetypepk = distributionchargetypefk        
 
     drop table if exists #tmpDivisionsToInclude            
  select DivisionPK, DivisionCode, DivisionName            
  into #tmpDivisionsToInclude            
  from tblDivisions             
  where AutoGenerateInvoice = 1 and customerfk =609           

 
    drop table if exists #tmpdistextraservices        
 select divisionfk, sum(NumberOf*Charge) as totalCharge        
 into #tmpdistextraservices         
 from tblextraservices es        
 inner join #tmpDivisionsToInclude divs on es.DivisionFK = divs.DivisionPK        
 where es.ExtraServiceDate >= @var_FromDate and es.ExtraServiceDate <= @var_ToDate        
 group by divisionfk        
            

 --drop table if exists #tmpChargeSummary            
 --select cd.DivisionFK, DistributionChargeType, distributionchargetypefk, TotalCharge            
 --into #tmpChargeSummary            
 --from #tmpChargeDetail cd             
 --inner join appDistributionChargeTypes ct on ct.distributionchargetypepk = cd.distributionchargetypefk            
 --group by cd.DivisionFK, DistributionChargeType, distributionchargetypefk    

 select * from #tmpChargeDetail


    
END
GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[spReportsInvoice]    Script Date: 02/11/2026 17:47:27 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
-- exec spReportsInvoice 29514 

      
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spReportsInvoice]        
(        
 @invoiceFK int        
)         
AS        
BEGIN        
 /* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data; Ensure this proc has a low impact when executed */        
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED; SET DEADLOCK_PRIORITY LOW        
        
    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT        
 ,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;        
 SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();        
        
 -- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters        
 DECLARE @var_invoiceFK int        
 SET @var_invoiceFK = @invoiceFK        
 SET @ParameterDetails = '@invoiceFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_invoiceFK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'')        
        
    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL         
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)        
        
 --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)        
 --BEGIN        
  SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC         
        
  SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)        
        
  INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)        
  SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK        
        
  SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()        
 --END        
        
 SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);        
 SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails        
 ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;        
 INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()        
        
 WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3        
 BEGIN         
  BEGIN TRY           
        
   -- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start        
        
   --DECLARE @var_invoiceFK int = 18656        
        
   Declare @divisionFK int        
   Select top 1 @divisionFK = DivisionFK from tblInvoices where InvoicePK = @var_invoiceFK        
        
   DECLARE  @NumberTaxRate int        
   SET @NumberTaxRate = (SELECT Count(Distinct(TaxRate))         
          FROM tblInvoiceLines        
          Where InvoiceFK = @var_invoiceFK)        
           
   -- Req for Recurring Charges In Advance        
   Declare @invoiceTypeFK int        
   Select @invoiceTypeFK = InvoiceTypeFK from tblInvoices where InvoicePK = @var_invoiceFK        
        
   Declare @InvoiceToDate Date        
   Select @InvoiceToDate = InvoiceToDate from tblInvoices where InvoicePK = @var_invoiceFK        
        
   Declare @LastInvoiceDate Date        
   Select TOP(1) @LastInvoiceDate = [InvoiceToDate] from tblInvoices         
   Where DivisionFK = @divisionFK and InvoiceTypeFK = @invoiceTypeFK And @InvoiceToDate > InvoiceToDate        
   Order By InvoiceToDate Desc        
        
   --print 'last invoice'        
   --print @LastInvoiceDate           
   --print 'last invoice'        
         
   Select         
    'Invoice' as ReportType,         
    --'Invoice Number: ' + invoices.InvoiceNumber as InvoiceNumber,        
    invoices.InvoiceNumber,        
    invoiceLines.InvoiceLinePK,        
    invoices.InvoiceToDate,        
       
   -- Concatenate Department and NominalCode into ChargeText         
    CONCAT(
    COALESCE(invoiceLines.ChargeText, ''),

    CASE 
        WHEN invoices.Approved = 0 AND (ISNULL(NULLIF(d.DepartmentName, ''), buildings.BuildingName) IS NOT NULL OR d.DepartmentCode IS NOT NULL) THEN
            ' ' + 
            COALESCE(NULLIF(d.DepartmentName, ''), buildings.BuildingName, '') +
            CASE 
                WHEN d.DepartmentCode IS NOT NULL AND d.DepartmentCode <> '' THEN
                    ' [' + d.DepartmentCode + ']'
                ELSE ''
            END
        ELSE ''
    END,

    CASE 
        WHEN invoices.Approved = 0 AND (lineType.InvoiceLineType IS NOT NULL OR invoiceLines.NominalCode IS NOT NULL AND invoiceLines.NominalCode <> '') THEN
            ' ' + 
            COALESCE(lineType.InvoiceLineType, '') +
            CASE 
                WHEN invoiceLines.NominalCode IS NOT NULL AND invoiceLines.NominalCode <> '' THEN
                    ' [' + invoiceLines.NominalCode + ']'
                ELSE ''
            END
        ELSE ''
    END
) AS ChargeText,
      
    invoiceLines.ChargeText1,        
    invoiceLines.ChargeText2,        
    invoiceLines.ChargeText3,        
    invoiceLines.ChargeText4,        
        
    --Case when vatCodes.VatCodePK = 5 /*or @var_invoiceFK = 488*/ then 0 else invoiceLines.Tax end as Tax,        
    --Case when vatCodes.VatCodePK = 5  /*or @var_invoiceFK = 488*/ then 0 else invoiceLines.TaxRate end as TaxRate,        
        
    -- DG #Dev-740        
    Case when vatCodes.VatCodePK = 5 then 0 else invoiceLines.TaxRate end as TaxRate,        
    Case when vatCodes.VatCodePK = 5 then 0 else invoices.Tax end as Tax,        
            
    --invoices.Charge As TotalCharge,        
    (invoices.Charge + invoices.Tax) as GrandTotal,        
    @NumberTaxRate  as NumberOfTaxRates,        
            
    invoiceLines.Charge,        
    divisions.DivisionName,        
    divisions.Address1,        
    divisions.Address2,        
    divisions.Address3,        
    divisions.Address4,        
    divisions.Address5,        
    invoiceContacts.ContactName AttentionOf,        
    divisions.InvoiceAuthorisationCode,        
    divisions.CustomInvoiceTitle,        
    invoices.CustomInvoiceValue,        
    [system].DocketHeaderLine1,        
    [system].DocketHeaderLine2,        
    [system].DocketHeaderLine3,        
    [system].DocketFooterPart1,        
    [system].DocketFooterPart2Line1,        
    [system].DocketFooterPart2Line2,        
    [system].DocketFooterPart2Line3,        
    [system].DocketFooterPart2Line4,        
    currencies.CurrencySymbol,        
    divisions.PaymentTerms,        
    --lastInvoice.InvoiceToDate as LastInvoiceDate,        
    @LastInvoiceDate  As LastInvoiceDate,        
    buildings.BuildingName + ' - ' + bu.BuildingUnit as BuildingUnit,        
        
    Case         
     when vatCodes.VatCodePK = 5 /*or @var_invoiceFK = 488*/ then         
      'False'         
     else         
      'True'         
    end as [DisplayVATOnInvoice]                         
   from         
    tblInvoices as invoices        
   inner join tblInvoiceLines as invoiceLines        
    on invoiceLines.InvoiceFK = invoices.InvoicePK        
   INNER JOIN appInvoiceLineTypes lineType       
     ON invoiceLines.InvoiceLineTypeFK=lineType.InvoiceLineTypePK      
  LEFT JOIN tblDepartments d       
     ON invoiceLines.DepartmentFK = d.DepartmentPK       
   inner join tblDivisions as divisions        
    on divisions.DivisionPK = invoices.DivisionFK        
   left outer join tblContacts as invoiceContacts        
    on invoiceContacts.ContactPK = divisions.InvoiceContactFK        
    AND invoiceContacts.IsArchived = 0        
   inner join appSystem as [system]        
    on 1=1        
   inner join tblCurrencies as currencies        
    on currencies.CurrencyPK = [system].InvoiceCurrencyFK        
   --left outer join ( Select Top 1 InvoiceToDate from tblInvoices        
   --     Where DivisionFK = @divisionFK        
   --     AND InvoicePK not in (Select Top 1 InvoicePK         
   --            From tblInvoices         
   --            Where DivisionFK = @divisionFK And InvoiceTypeFK = @invoiceTypeFK        
   --            Order By InvoiceToDate Desc)        
   --          order by InvoiceToDate Desc        
   --    ) As lastInvoice        
   -- on 1=1        
   left join tblBuildingUnits as bu         
    on invoiceLines.buildingunitfk = bu.buildingunitpk        
   left join tblBuildings as buildings         
    on bu.buildingfk = buildings.buildingpk        
   left outer join tblVatCodes as vatCodes        
    on invoiceLines.VatCodeFK = vatCodes.VatCodePK        
   where         
    invoices.InvoicePK = @var_invoiceFK        
        
   -- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end        
              
   BREAK        
  END TRY        
  BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */        
   DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;        
   SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;        
   SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;        
        
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY         
   BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;        
               
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;        
        
            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID        
                    
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;        
                    
   IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)        
   BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END        
   ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */        
  END CATCH        
  SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1        
 END        
END

-- =============================================  
-- Author:  <Author,,Name>  
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>  
-- Description: <Description,,>  
-- =============================================  
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spReportsInvoiceCheckList]  
(  
 @CustomerFK int = -1,  
 @StartDate datetime,  
 @EndDate datetime  
)  
AS  
BEGIN  
 /* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data; Ensure this proc has a low impact when executed */  
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED; SET DEADLOCK_PRIORITY LOW  
  
    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT  
 ,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;  
 SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();  
  
 -- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters  
 DECLARE @CustomerFK2 int, @StartDate2 datetime, @EndDate2 datetime  
  
 SET @customerFK2 = @CustomerFK;  
 SET @startDate2 = @StartDate;  
 SET @endDate2 = @EndDate;  
  
 SET @ParameterDetails = '@customerFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@customerFK2 AS NVARCHAR(20)),'') +  
          ',@StartDate = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@startDate2 AS NVARCHAR(30)),'') +   
       ',@EndDate = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@endDate2 AS NVARCHAR(30)),'')  
  
    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL   
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)  
  
    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)  
    --BEGIN  
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC   
  
  SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)  
  
        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)  
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK  
  
        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()  
    --END  
  
  
 SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);  
 SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails  
 ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;  
 INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()  
  
 WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3  
 BEGIN   
  BEGIN TRY  
   -- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start  
    BEGIN  
     Select   
      'Invoice' As [Report Type],  
      invs.InvoiceNumber As [Invoice Number],   
      convert(varchar(50), invs.InvoiceToDate, 106) as [Date],   
      cus.CustomerCode As [Customer Code],  
      cus.CustomerName As [Customer Name],  
      invs.Charge As [Charge],  
      invs.Tax,  
      invs.Tax + invs.Charge as [Total],  
      invs.Approved,  
      invs.Emailed,  
      invs.Exported,  
      invs.QueuedForExport,  
      FORMAT (@startDate2, 'dd-MM-yyyy') As StartDate,  
      FORMAT (@endDate2, 'dd-MM-yyyy') As EndDate  
     From tblInvoices invs  
      left outer join tblDivisions divs on divs.DivisionPK = invs.DivisionFK  
      left outer join tblCustomers cus on cus.CustomerPK = invs.CustomerFK OR cus.CustomerPK = divs.CustomerFK  
     Where  
      --Approved = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/   
      -- AND QueuedForExport = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/  
      --AND Exported = 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/  
    --  AND 
	  invs.InvoiceToDate >= @startDate2  
      AND invs.InvoiceToDate <= @endDate2   
      AND ((cus.CustomerPK = @customerFK2) Or (@customerFK2 = -1))  
     UNION  
     Select  
      'Credit Note' As [Report Type],  
      crdNote.CreditNoteNumber As [Invoice Number],   
      convert(varchar(50), crdNote.CreditToDate, 106) as [Date],   
      cus.CustomerCode As [Customer Code],  
      cus.CustomerName As [Customer Name],  
      crdNote.CreditNoteValue As [Charge],  
      crdNote.Tax,  
      crdNote.Tax + crdNote.CreditNoteValue as [Total],  
      crdNote.Approved,  
      crdNote.Emailed,  
      crdNote.Exported,  
      crdNote.QueuedForExport,  
      FORMAT (@startDate2, 'dd-MM-yyyy') As StartDate,  
      FORMAT (@endDate2, 'dd-MM-yyyy') As EndDateDate  
     From tblCreditNotes crdNote  
      left outer join tblDivisions divs on divs.DivisionPK = crdNote.DivisionFK  
      left outer join tblCustomers cus on cus.CustomerPK = crdNote.CustomerFK OR cus.CustomerPK = divs.CustomerFK  
     Where  
    --  Approved = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/   
      -- AND QueuedForExport = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/  
      --AND Exported = 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/  
      --AND 
	  crdNote.CreditToDate >= @startDate2  
      AND crdNote.CreditToDate <= @endDate2   
      AND ((cus.CustomerPK = @customerFK2) Or (@customerFK2 = -1))  
     Order By CustomerCode, Date Desc  
    END  
   BREAK  
   -- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end  
  END TRY  
  BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */  
   DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;  
   SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;  
   SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;  
  
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY   
   BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;  
         
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;  
  
            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID  
              
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;  
              
   IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)  
   BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END  
   ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */  
  END CATCH  
  SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1  
 END  
END

BEGIN      
 /* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data; Ensure this proc has a low impact when executed */

 ,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;

 SET @var_containerOutPK = @containerOutPK; SET @var_userFK = @userFK

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL     
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)    
    
    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)    
    --BEGIN    
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC     
    
  SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)    
    
        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)    
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

 SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails    
 ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;    
 INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()    
    
 WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3    
 BEGIN     
  BEGIN TRY       
    
   -- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start   
   
 --  declare @var_containerOutPK int = 178395
  -- declare @var_userFK int = 180
    
   DECLARE @DeliveryNumber varchar(max)    
   IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ResultSet') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #ResultSet    
   CREATE TABLE #ResultSet(SelectedValue varchar(max))    
   DECLARE @Param int    
   Select @Param = StockOrderPK from tblStockOrders where ContainerOutFK = @var_containerOutPK    
   INSERT INTO #ResultSet (SelectedValue)    
   EXEC spStockOrderGetDeliveryNumber @Param    
   SELECT @DeliveryNumber = ISNULL(SelectedValue,'') FROM #ResultSet     
    
   declare @_ConsigneeNo varchar(50)    
   declare @ConsigneeNo varchar(50)    
    
   DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #tmpPackingListContainerOut    
   SELECT * INTO #tmpPackingListContainerOut     
   FROM tblcontainerouts     
   WHERE ContainerOutPK=@var_containerOutPK    
    
   DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #tmpPackingListContainerOutLines    
   SELECT col.*     
   INTO #tmpPackingListContainerOutLines     
   FROM tblcontaineroutLines col     
   INNER JOIN #tmpPackingListContainerOut ON containeroutfk = containeroutpk    
    
   select @_ConsigneeNo = ISNULL(CustomerFK,'-1')     
   from tblDeliveryAddresses     
   where DeliveryAddressPK=(    
    select DeliveryAddressFK     
    from #tmpPackingListContainerOut)    
    
   if (@_ConsigneeNo = '-1' )     
   begin    
    select @ConsigneeNo = isnull(CustomerCode,'') from tblCustomers where CustomerPK = @_ConsigneeNo    
   end    
    
    Declare @customerFK int     
         
    Select top 1 @customerFK = CustomerFK from #tmpPackingListContainerOutLines cols inner join tblDivisions divs on divs.DivisionPK = cols.DivisionFK     
      
   IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#palletAdditionalFields') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #palletAdditionalFields    
    
   CREATE TABLE #palletAdditionalFields     
   (      
    PalletFK int,    
    AdditionalField1 nvarchar(300),    
    AdditionalField2 nvarchar(300),    
    AdditionalField3 nvarchar(300),    
    AdditionalField4 nvarchar(300),    
    AdditionalField5 nvarchar(300)    
   )    
    
   Insert into #palletAdditionalFields    
   Select PalletFK, max(paf1)paf1,max(paf2)paf2,max(paf3)paf3,max(paf4)paf4,max(paf5)paf5 from (    
    Select PalletFK,     
    case when pafs1.PalletAdditionalFieldPK is null then '' else pafvs.PalletAdditionalFieldValue end paf1,    
    case when pafs2.PalletAdditionalFieldPK is null then '' else pafvs.PalletAdditionalFieldValue end paf2,    
    case when pafs3.PalletAdditionalFieldPK is null then '' else pafvs.PalletAdditionalFieldValue end paf3,    
    case when pafs4.PalletAdditionalFieldPK is null then '' else pafvs.PalletAdditionalFieldValue end paf4,    
    case when pafs5.PalletAdditionalFieldPK is null then '' else pafvs.PalletAdditionalFieldValue end paf5    
    From tblPalletAdditionalFieldValues pafvs    
    left outer join tblPalletAdditionalFields pafs1 on    
    pafs1.PalletAdditionalFieldPK = pafvs.PalletAdditionalFieldFK    
    AND pafs1.FieldNumber=1    
    
    left outer join tblPalletAdditionalFields pafs2 on    
    pafs2.PalletAdditionalFieldPK = pafvs.PalletAdditionalFieldFK    
    AND pafs2.FieldNumber=2    
    
    left outer join tblPalletAdditionalFields pafs3 on    
    pafs3.PalletAdditionalFieldPK = pafvs.PalletAdditionalFieldFK    
    AND pafs3.FieldNumber=3    
    
    left outer join tblPalletAdditionalFields pafs4 on    
    pafs4.PalletAdditionalFieldPK = pafvs.PalletAdditionalFieldFK    
    AND pafs4.FieldNumber=4    
    
    left outer join tblPalletAdditionalFields pafs5 on    
    pafs5.PalletAdditionalFieldPK = pafvs.PalletAdditionalFieldFK    
    AND pafs5.FieldNumber=5    
   )subQ    
   Group By PalletFK    
    
   DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #tmpPackingListCOLPC

   Group By EventFK, pa.PalletFK    
   declare @TotalUnits int  
   select @TotalUnits =  Sum(Units) from #tmpPackingListCOLPC   
      DECLARE @Comments nvarchar(max)

     SELECT CHAR(10) + Description AS 'data()'       
      FROM tblContainerOutAudit audit  
   inner join tblcontainerouts cout on cout.containeroutpk = audit.ContainerOutFK  
   WHERE audit.IncludeInDocketPrintOut=1 and audit.IsArchived=0 and cout.ContainerOutPK = @var_containerOutPK FOR XML PATH('')       
   ), 2 , 9999)    
    
   select GoodsOrderNumber, InceptionDate, DeliveryDate, CollectionDate, StockItemCode, Batch, Pallets, sum(Eaches)Eaches, cast(sum(Units) as int) Units, TransportCompany,    
   Address1, Address2, Address3, Address4, Address5, County, Country, Parameter1, Parameter2, Parameter3, Parameter4, Parameter5, Parameter6, Parameter7, Parameter8,    
   Parameter9, Parameter10, Parameter11, Parameter12, Parameter13, Parameter14, Parameter15, Parameter16, Parameter17, Parameter18, Parameter19,    
   Parameter20, DivisionName, DivisionAddress1, DivisionAddress2, DivisionAddress3, DivisionAddress4, DivisionAddress5, ContainerNumber, SealNumber, DeliveryNumber,    
   CustomerCode, ConsigneeNo, Description, coutFree1, coutFree2, coutFree3, coutFree4, coutFree5, colsFree1, colsFree2, colsFree3, colsFree4, colsFree5,    
   CommodityCode, SoldToName, SoldToAddress1, SoldToAddress2, SoldToAddress3, SoldToAddress4, SoldToAddress5, UnitCount, UnitWeight, Abbreviation, ProductionDate, Comments, AdditionalField1,    
    @Comments as AuditComments,  
  @TotalUnits as TotalUnits,  
 AdditionalField2, AdditionalField3, AdditionalField4, AdditionalField5, DocketLabel1, DocketValue1, DocketLabel2, DocketValue2, DocketLabel3, DocketValue3, Weight, PackingListGroup, Manufacturer, ManufacturerPartNo, ClientDeliveryType    
   from (    
    
   Select cOuts.GoodsOrderNumber,     
   couts.InsertedDate as InceptionDate,     
   cOuts.DeliveryDate,     
   cOuts.CollectionDate,     
   upper(sis.StockItemCode) StockItemCode,     
   cols.Batch,     
   --case when cols.Pallets > 0 then 1 end Pallets,     
   case when cols.Pallets = 0 then     
    case when palletsOutPA.PalletsOut is null then     
     --/*LJF, have remmed this out as there is no join for this as yet. May have added at some point (Look at spReportsStockOutDocket for join)*/ actualPallets.Pallets    
     0      
    else     
     palletsOutPA.PalletsOut     
    end     
   else     
    1    
   end Pallets,    
   cols.Eaches,     
  (colpc.Units),     
   isnull(TransportCompany, '') TransportCompany,     
   cOuts.Address1 Address1,

   edps.Parameter20,    
   divisions.DivisionName,    
   divisions.Address1 DivisionAddress1,     
   divisions.Address2 DivisionAddress2,     
   divisions.Address3 DivisionAddress3,     
   divisions.Address4 DivisionAddress4,     
   divisions.Address5 DivisionAddress5,    
   cOuts.ContainerNumber,     
   cOuts.SealNumber,    
   @DeliveryNumber as DeliveryNumber,     
   ISNULL(customers.CustomerCode,'') as CustomerCode,     
   @ConsigneeNo as ConsigneeNo,    
   sis.Description,     
   cOuts.Free1 coutFree1,    
   cOuts.Free2 coutFree2,     
   cOuts.Free3 coutFree3,     
   cOuts.Free4 coutFree4,     
   cOuts.Free5 coutFree5,    
   cols.Free1 colsFree1,    
   cols.Free2 colsFree2,    
   cols.Free3 colsFree3,    
   cols.Free4 colsFree4,    
   cols.Free5 colsFree5,    
   cols.Free4 CommodityCode,     
   cOuts.SoldToName,    
   cOuts.SoldToAddress1,     
   cOuts.SoldToAddress2,     
   cOuts.SoldToAddress3,     
   cOuts.SoldToAddress4,     
   cOuts.SoldToAddress5,    
   case when cols.Units = 0 then cast(1 as decimal(18,3)) else cols.Units end  / (case when cols.Free3 = '' then     
   cast(1 as decimal(18,3)) else cols.Free3 end) as UnitCount,    
   Cast(     
     (Cols.Units /     
      (case when cols.Units = 0 then cast(1 as decimal(18,3)) else cols.Units end / (case when cols.Free3 = '' then     
      cast(1 as decimal(18,3)) else cols.Free3 end))    
     )    
    as Decimal(18,3)    
   ) as UnitWeight,    
   ut.Abbreviation,    
   --case pa_co.DateOfManufacture when '1900-01-01 00:00:00.000' then '' when null then '' end as ProductionDate    
   case colpc.DateOfManufacture when '1900-01-01 00:00:00.000' then '' else colpc.DateOfManufacture end as ProductionDate,    
   cOuts.Comments,    
   pafs.AdditionalField1,    
   pafs.AdditionalField2,    
   pafs.AdditionalField3,    
   pafs.AdditionalField4,    
   pafs.AdditionalField5,    
   cOuts.DocketLabel1, cOuts.DocketValue1,    
   cOuts.DocketLabel2, cOuts.DocketValue2,    
   cOuts.DocketLabel3, cOuts.DocketValue3,    
   CAST(cOuts.Weight AS INT) Weight,--, case when pals.customerbarcode <> '' then pals.customerbarcode else pals.barcode end as [PalletBarcode]    
   case when ContainerOutPalletGroupPK is null then 1 else GroupNumber end as PackingListGroup,    
   case when manufacturerpk is null then '' else dbo.propercase(Manufacturer) end as Manufacturer,    
   dbo.propercase(sis.ManufacturerPartNo) ManufacturerPartNo, cdt.ClientDeliveryType    
   /*    
   cOuts.Address1 as DeliveryAddress1, cOuts.Address2 as DeliveryAddress2, cOuts.Address3 as DeliveryAddress3, cOuts.Address4 as DeliveryAddress4, cOuts.Address5 as DeliveryAddress5,    
   ISNULL(countries.Country,'') as DeliveryCountry    
   */    
       
   FROM #tmpPackingListContainerOut cOuts      
    inner join #tmpPackingListContainerOutLines cols ON cols.ContainerOutFK = cOuts.ContainerOutPK         
    inner join tblDivisions divisions on divisions.DivisionPK = cols.DivisionFK      
    inner join tblStockItems sis on sis.StockItemPK = cols.StockItemFK      
    left outer join tblCustomers customers on sis.CustomerFK = customers.CustomerPK    
    left outer join tblCounties counties on counties.CountyPK = cOuts.CountyFK      
    left outer join tblCountries countries on countries.CountryPK = cOuts.CountryFK      
    left outer join tblTransportCompanies transport on transport.TransportCompanyPK = cOuts.TransportCompanyFK      
    left outer join tblExtraDockets eds on  eds.ExtraDocketTypeFK = 3 /*Stock Out Packing List*/  AND eds.CustomerFK = @customerFK      
    left outer join tblExtraDocketParameterSets edps on edps.ExtraDocketFK = eds.ExtraDocketPK     
    inner join tblUnitTypes ut on ut.UnitTypePK = sis.UnitTypeFK     
    left outer join #tmpPackingListCOLPC colpc on colpc.ContainerOutLineFK = cols.ContainerOutLinePK    
    left outer join #tmpPackingListPA palletsOutPA on palletsOutPA.EventFK = cols.ContainerOutLinePK AND palletsOutPA.PalletFK = colpc.PalletFK    
    left outer join #palletAdditionalFields pafs on pafs.PalletFK = colpc.PalletFK    
    left join tblContainerOutPalletGroups cogroups on cogroups.ContainerOutFK = cOuts.ContainerOutPK and colpc.palletfk = cogroups.palletfk    
    left join tblManufacturers mans on sis.ManufacturerFK = mans.ManufacturerPK    
    left join appClientDeliveryTypes cdt on cdt.ClientDeliveryTypePK = cOuts.ClientDeliveryTypeFK    
    Where ContainerOutPK = @var_containerOutPK     
     )subquery    
   group by GoodsOrderNumber, InceptionDate, DeliveryDate, CollectionDate, StockItemCode, Batch, Pallets, TransportCompany,    
   Address1, Address2, Address3, Address4, Address5, County, Country, Parameter1, Parameter2, Parameter3, Parameter4, Parameter5, Parameter6, Parameter7, Parameter8,    
   Parameter9, Parameter10, Parameter11, Parameter12, Parameter13, Parameter14, Parameter15, Parameter16, Parameter17, Parameter18, Parameter19,    
   Parameter20, DivisionName, DivisionAddress1, DivisionAddress2, DivisionAddress3, DivisionAddress4, DivisionAddress5, ContainerNumber, SealNumber, DeliveryNumber,    
   CustomerCode, ConsigneeNo, Description, coutFree1, coutFree2, coutFree3, coutFree4, coutFree5, colsFree1, colsFree2, colsFree3, colsFree4, colsFree5,     
   CommodityCode, SoldToName, SoldToAddress1, SoldToAddress2, SoldToAddress3, SoldToAddress4, SoldToAddress5, UnitCount, UnitWeight, Abbreviation, ProductionDate, Comments, AdditionalField1,    
   AdditionalField2, AdditionalField3, AdditionalField4, AdditionalField5, Weight, DocketLabel1, DocketValue1, DocketLabel2, DocketValue2,DocketLabel3, DocketValue3, PackingListGroup, Manufacturer, ManufacturerPartNo, ClientDeliveryType    
   Order By PackingListGroup, StockItemCode, Batch    
    
   -- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end    
    
       
       
   BREAK    
  END TRY    
  BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */    
   DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;    
   SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;    
   SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;    
    
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY     
   BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;    
           
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;    
    
            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID    
                
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;    
                
   IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)    
   BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END    
   ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */    
  END CATCH    
  SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1    
 END    
END

 Select  colpc.palletcontentfk, colpc.splitpalletcontentfk, colpc.PalletFK,      
    colpc.Units as ActualUnits, colpc.Units * Colpc.eaches as ActualEachUnits, 0 as AvailableUnits, 0 as AvailableEachUnits,     
 co.containeroutstatusfk,    
 --co.GoodsOrderNumber --Pritesh    
    
 colpc.Units , Colpc.eaches,    
 co.goodsordernumber    
     
 --Stuff ((select distinct ', '+ co.GoodsOrderNumber     
 --from #allPals pa     
 -- inner join tblcontaineroutlinepalletcontent colpc ON colpc.palletfk=  pa.palletpk        
 --  inner join tblcontaineroutlines col on colpc.containeroutlinefk = col.containeroutlinepk        
 --  inner join tblcontainerouts co on col.containeroutfk = co.containeroutpk        
     
 --where co.containeroutstatusfk not in  (5,6) and ap.palletfk = pa.palletfk    
 ----group by colpc.PalletFK    
 --   --,co.GoodsOrderNumber    
 --FOR XML PATH(''), TYPE ).value('.', 'NVARCHAR(MAX)')     
 --       ,1,2,'') GoodsOrderNumber    
      
      
      
  INTO #OpenOrderPallets        
   FROM #allPals ap        
   inner join tblcontaineroutlinepalletcontent colpc ON colpc.palletfk=  ap.palletpk        
   inner join tblcontaineroutlines col on colpc.containeroutlinefk = col.containeroutlinepk        
   inner join tblcontainerouts co on col.containeroutfk = co.containeroutpk        
   --inner join tblPalletContent pc on colpc.palletcontentfk = pc.palletcontentpk        
   --inner join tblStockItems sis on sis.StockItemPK = pc.StockItemFK        
   Where --((sis.EachesTypeFK < 0) OR (sis.EachesTypeFK > 0 AND pc.EachUnits > 0))         
   -- pc.IsArchived = 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/ and    
 co.containeroutstatusfk not in  (5,6) --and (pc.palletfk = -1 or colpc.splitpalletcontentfk > 0)        
   group by  ap.PalletPK,colpc.palletcontentfk, colpc.PalletFK,  colpc.Units, Colpc.eaches, colpc.splitpalletcontentfk  ,co.containeroutstatusfk     
    ,co.GoodsOrderNumber    
         
 --select * from #OpenOrderPallets    
 --print '#OpenOrderPallets ok'    
 --print 'starting #OpenOrderForSinglePallets'    
    
	  DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #tmpPalletAudit

	  Select Palletfk , EventDate   into #tmpPalletAudit  
	  from tblPalletAudit pa
	
	  inner join #allpals ap on pa.palletfk = ap.palletpk
	  where EventTypeFK =1

 drop table if exists #tmpgoodsordernumbers    
 select distinct palletfk, stuff((select distinct ', '+ co.GoodsOrderNumber    
   from #OpenOrderPallets co    
   where co.palletfk = oop.palletfk and co.splitpalletcontentfk = -1    
   FOR XML PATH(''), TYPE ).value('.', 'NVARCHAR(MAX)')     
   ,1,2,'')  GoodsOrderNumber    
 into #tmpgoodsordernumbers    
 from #OpenOrderPallets oop    
    
    DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #OpenOrderForSinglePallets    
    select oop.palletcontentfk, oop.palletfk, sum(oop.actualunits) actualunits, sum(oop.actualeachunits) actualeachunits, sum(oop.availableunits) availableunits,    
  sum(availableeachunits)availableeachunits, containeroutstatusfk, sum(units) units, sum(eaches) eaches,    
  case when oop.splitpalletcontentfk > 0 then oop.GoodsOrderNumber else     
  gon.GoodsOrderNumber end GoodsOrderNumber, oop.splitpalletcontentfk    
  into #OpenOrderForSinglePallets    
  from #OpenOrderPallets oop    
  left join #tmpgoodsordernumbers gon on gon.palletfk = oop.palletfk    
  group by oop.palletcontentfk, oop.palletfk, oop.splitpalletcontentfk, oop.containeroutstatusfk, case when oop.splitpalletcontentfk > 0 then oop.GoodsOrderNumber else     
   gon.GoodsOrderNumber end    
       
    
    
-- select * from #OpenOrderForSinglePallets    
    
    
   --content currently on order (split pallet content)        
   DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #OnOrderPallets        
   Select oop.palletcontentfk, oop.splitpalletcontentfk, oop.PalletFK, sis.StockItempK as StockItemFK, pc.Batch, pc.SupplierBatch,        
    oop.Units as ActualUnits, oop.Units * oop.eaches as ActualEachUnits, 0 as AvailableUnits, 0 as AvailableEachUnits, pc.ExpiryDate  , pc.BestBefore ,    
 oop.GoodsOrderNumber --Pritesh    
   INTO #OnOrderPallets        
   FROM #allPals ap        
   inner join #OpenOrderPallets oop ON oop.palletfk=  ap.palletpk        
   --inner join tblcontaineroutlines col on colpc.containeroutlinefk = col.containeroutlinepk        
   --inner join tblcontainerouts co on col.containeroutfk = co.containeroutpk        
   inner join tblPalletContent pc on oop.palletcontentfk = pc.palletcontentpk        
   inner join tblStockItems sis on sis.StockItemPK = pc.StockItemFK        
   Where ((sis.EachesTypeFK < 0) OR (sis.EachesTypeFK > 0 AND pc.EachUnits > 0))         
    and pc.IsArchived = 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/ and oop.containeroutstatusfk not in  (5,6) and (pc.palletfk = -1 or oop.splitpalletcontentfk > 0)        
   group by oop.palletcontentfk, oop.PalletFK, sis.StockItempK, pc.Batch, pc.SupplierBatch, oop.Units, oop.eaches, oop.splitpalletcontentfk, pc.ExpiryDate, pc.BestBefore        
    ,oop.GoodsOrderNumber    
    
 --Select * from #OnOrderPallets    
        
   drop table if exists #tmpPalletSupplier        
   select distinct palletpk, sup.supplierpk, sup.Supplier        
  into #tmpPalletSupplier        
   from #allPals pals        
   inner join tblstockinlinepallets silp on pals.palletpk = silp.palletfk        
   inner join tblstockinlines sil on stockinlinepk = stockinlinefk        
   inner join tblstockins si on stockinfk = stockinpk        
   inner join tblContainerIns ci on containerinpk = containerinfk        
   left join tblsuppliers sup on SupplierPK = ci.SupplierFK        
         
        
   SELECT [For],BuildingUnit,DivisionName,DivisionCode,StockItemCode,Description,Batch,SupplierBatch,Location,PalletType,PalletStatus,        
    sum(Actual) Actual, sum(Available) Available, sum(OnOrder) OnOrder, Barcode, SUBSTRING(CustomerPalletNumber, 0,  11) AS CustomerPalletNumber, @var_PrintByColumn as PrintByColumn, @var_PrintCheckBox as PrintCheckBox, ExpiryDate, BestBefore      
 ,Supplier      
 ,GoodsOrderNumber --Pritesh,  
 ,StockItemCategory
 ,EventDate
   FROM(        
    Select @for as [For],         
     'Building Unit: ' + buildings.BuildingName + ' - ' + bus.BuildingUnit BuildingUnit,         
     divs.DivisionName,divs.DivisionCode,        
     stockItems.StockItemCode,         
     stockItems.Description,         
     pc.Batch,        
     pc.SupplierBatch,        
     palletLocation.Location,        
     palletTypes.PalletType,        
     ps.PalletStatus,        
     case when stockItems.EachesTypeFK <> -1 then pc.ActualEachUnits else pc.ActualUnits End as Actual,        
     case when stockItems.EachesTypeFK <> -1 then pc.AvailableEachUnits else pc.AvailableUnits End as Available,        
     case when stockItems.EachesTypeFK <> -1 then pc.ActualEachUnits - pc.AvailableEachUnits else pc.ActualUnits - pc.AvailableUnits End as OnOrder,        
     case when pallets.CustomerBarcode = '' then pallets.Barcode else pallets.CustomerBarcode end Barcode, pallets.CustomerPalletNumber,        
     palletLocation.LocationTypeFK,        
     uts.Abbreviation,             
     pc.ExpiryDate, pc.BestBefore, -1 as palletcontentfk      
  ,supp.Supplier    
   ,opc.GoodsOrderNumber,--'Pritesh' as GoodsOrderNumber-- --Pritesh   
   stc.StockItemCategory
   ,pa.EventDate
    from #allPals pallets        
    INNER JOIN viewPalletLocations palletLocation ON  palletLocation.palletPK = pallets.palletPk     
 left join #OpenOrderForSinglePallets opc on opc.PalletFK = pallets.PalletPK and opc.SplitPalletContentfk = -1     
    left outer join appPalletStatus ps on ps.PalletStatusPK = pallets.PalletStatusFK        
    inner join #PalletContent pc ON pc.PalletFK = pallets.PalletPK        
    inner join tblStockItems stockItems on stockItems.StockItemPK = pc.StockItemFK        
    inner join tblDivisions divs on divs.DivisionPK = stockItems.DivisionFK        
    left outer join tblUnitTypes uts on uts.UnitTypePK = stockItems.UnitTypeFK        
    left outer join tblPalletTypes palletTypes on palletTypes.PalletTypePK = pallets.PalletTypeFK        
    left outer join tblBuildingUnits bus on bus.BuildingUnitPK = palletLocation.BuildingUnitFK        
    left outer join tblBuildings buildings on buildings.BuildingPK = bus.BuildingFK       
 left join #tmpPalletSupplier supp on supp.palletpk=pc.palletfk      
left join tblstockitemcategories stc on stc.StockItemCategoryPK = stockItems.StockItemCategoryFK  
inner join #tmpPalletAudit pa on pa.PalletFK = pallets.PalletPK
      
    WHERE (@var_buildingUnitBayFKs = '' OR (',' + @var_buildingUnitBayFKs + ',' LIKE '%,' + CONVERT(VARCHAR, pallets.LocationFK) + ',%' AND palletLocation.LocationTypeFK = 1/*Racking Only*/))        
     AND (@var_buildingUnitRowFK = -1 OR (palletLocation.Row = @BuildingUnitRow AND pallets.LocationTypeFK = 1) )         
    UNION all        
        
    SELECT distinct  @for as [For],         
    'Building Unit: ' + buildings.BuildingName + ' - ' + bus.BuildingUnit BuildingUnit,         
    divs.DivisionName, divs.DivisionCode,        
    stockItems.StockItemCode,         
    stockItems.Description,         
    pc.Batch,        
    pc.SupplierBatch,        
    palletLocation.location,        
    palletTypes.PalletType,        
    ps.PalletStatus,        
    case when stockItems.EachesTypeFK <> -1 then pc.ActualEachUnits else pc.ActualUnits End as Actual,        
    case when stockItems.EachesTypeFK <> -1 then pc.AvailableEachUnits else pc.AvailableUnits End as Available,        
    case when stockItems.EachesTypeFK <> -1 then pc.ActualEachUnits - pc.AvailableEachUnits else pc.ActualUnits - pc.AvailableUnits End as OnOrder,        
    case when pallets.CustomerBarcode = '' then pallets.Barcode else pallets.CustomerBarcode end Barcode, pallets.CustomerPalletNumber,        
    pallets.LocationTypeFK,        
    uts.Abbreviation,             
     pc.ExpiryDate, pc.BestBefore, pc.palletcontentfk       
  ,supp.Supplier,    
 pc.GoodsOrderNumber --Pritesh    
   ,stc.StockItemCategory
    ,pa.EventDate
   from #allPals pallets        
    left outer join appPalletStatus ps on ps.PalletStatusPK = pallets.PalletStatusFK        
    /*Pallet content currently on order*/        
    left join #OnOrderPallets pc on pc.PalletFK = pallets.PalletPK      
 --left join #OpenOrderPallets opc on opc.PalletFK = pallets.PalletPK and opc.SplitPalletContentfk = -1     
    left outer join viewPalletLooseLocations palletLocation on ((pc.splitpalletcontentFk > 0 and palletLocation.palletcontentPk = pc.splitpalletcontentFk) or (palletLocation.palletcontentPk = pc.palletcontentfk))        
    inner join tblStockItems stockItems on stockItems.StockItemPK = pc.StockItemFK --AND stockItems.DivisionFK = @var_divisionFK        
    inner join tblDivisions divs on divs.DivisionPK = stockItems.DivisionFK        
    left outer join tblUnitTypes uts on uts.UnitTypePK = stockItems.UnitTypeFK        
    left outer join tblPalletTypes palletTypes on palletTypes.PalletTypePK = pallets.PalletTypeFK        
    left outer join tblBuildingUnits bus on bus.BuildingUnitPK = palletLocation.BuildingUnitFK        
    left outer join tblBuildings buildings on buildings.BuildingPK = bus.BuildingFK        
   left join #tmpPalletSupplier supp on supp.palletpk=pc.palletfk   
   left join tblstockitemcategories stc on stc.StockItemCategoryPK = stockItems.StockItemCategoryFK 
   inner join #tmpPalletAudit pa on pa.PalletFK = pallets.PalletPK
   WHERE (@var_buildingUnitBayFKs = '' OR        
     (',' + @var_buildingUnitBayFKs + ',' LIKE '%,' + CONVERT(VARCHAR, pallets.LocationFK) + ',%' AND palletLocation.LooseLocationTypeFK = 1/*Racking Only*/))        
     AND (@var_buildingUnitRowFK = -1 OR (palletLocation.Row = @BuildingUnitRow AND pallets.LocationTypeFK = 1))        
   )subQ        
   Group By [For],LocationTypeFK,BuildingUnit,DivisionName,DivisionCode,StockItemCode,Description,Batch,SupplierBatch,Location,PalletType,PalletStatus,        
    Barcode, CustomerPalletNumber, Abbreviation, subQ.ExpiryDate, subQ.BestBefore       
 ,Supplier    
 ,GoodsOrderNumber --Pritesh  
,StockItemCategory 
,EventDate
   order by BuildingUnit , LocationTypeFK, Location        
        
        
   -- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end        
        
           
           
   BREAK        
  END TRY        
  BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */        
   DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;        
   SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;        
   SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;        
        
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY         
   BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;        
               
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;        
        
            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID        
                    
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;        
                    
   IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)        
   BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END        
   ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */        
  END CATCH        
  SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1        
 END        
END

    endcol nvarchar (20),      
    fcol nvarchar(20),      
    ecol nvarchar(20)      
    )      
      
    Insert into #col

     case when reversetranslate=1 then Convert ( nvarchar, translatecolumn-Columns) + ' and ' + Convert(nvarchar,(translatecolumn-1)  )      
       when reversetranslate=0 then Convert ( nvarchar, ((translatecolumn)+1) ) + ' and  ' + Convert ( nvarchar, (translatecolumn)+Columns)

   END      
      
   --filter by building unit      
   if(@var_buildingUnitFK > 0)      
   BEGIN      
    DELETE p      
    FROM  #allPals p      
    WHERE p.BuildingUnitFK <> @var_buildingUnitFK      
   END      
      
      
   --filter by stock batch      
   if(@var_stockItemFK <> -1 OR @var_batch <> '')      
   BEGIN      
    PRINT 'we have stock / batch info'      
    DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #allPalContent      
    SELECT * INTO #allPalContent      
    FROM dbo.tblPalletContent tpc      
    WHERE tpc.PalletFK > 0 AND tpc.ActualUnits > 0      
     and ((@var_stockItemFK <> -1 and tpc.StockItemFK = @var_stockItemFK) OR (@var_stockItemFK = -1))      
     AND ((@var_batch <> '' AND tpc.Batch like (case when @var_batchWildcard = 1 then '%' + @var_batch + '%' else @var_batch end)) OR  (@var_batch = ''))      
      
    DELETE p      
    FROM  #allPals p      
    LEFT JOIN #allPalContent pc ON p.palletpk = pc.palletfk      
    WHERE pc.palletcontentpk IS null      
   END      
      
   --filter by division      
   IF(@var_divisionFK <> -1)      
   BEGIN      
    PRINT 'we have a division filter'      
    DELETE p      
    FROM #allPals p      
    INNER JOIN dbo.tblPalletContent tpc ON p.palletpk = tpc.PalletFK      
    INNER JOIN dbo.tblStockItems tsi ON tsi.StockItemPK = tpc.StockItemFK      
    where tsi.divisionfk <> @var_divisionFK      
   END      
      
   --filter by customer      
   IF(@var_CustomerFK <> -1)      
   BEGIN      
    PRINT 'we have customer filter'      
    DELETE p      
    FROM #allPals p      
    INNER JOIN dbo.tblPalletContent tpc ON p.palletpk = tpc.PalletFK      
    INNER JOIN dbo.tblStockItems tsi ON tsi.StockItemPK  = tpc.StockItemFK      
    inner JOIN tbldivisions d ON tsi.divisionfk = d.DivisionPK      
    where d.customerfk <> @var_CustomerFK      
   END      
      
   --filter by stock in      
   IF(@var_goodsInNumber <> '')       
   BEGIN      
    PRINT 'we have a stock in filter'      
    DECLARE @containerInpk int      
    SELECT @containerInpk = containerInpk FROM tblcontainerIns WHERE GoodsInNumber = @var_goodsInNumber       
       
    DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #SIPallets      
    SELECT distinct silps.palletfk      
    INTO #SIPallets      
    from tblStockInLinePallets silps       
    inner join tblStockInLines sils on sils.stockinlinepk = silps.stockinlinefk      
    inner join tblStockIns sins on sins.StockInPK = sils.StockInFK      
    WHERE sins.ContainerInFK = @containerInpk      
      
    DELETE p      
    FROM #allPals p      
    WHERE p.palletpk NOT IN (SELECT * FROM #SIPallets)      
   END      
      
   --filter by stock out      
   if(@var_goodsOrderNumber <> '')      
   BEGIN       
    PRINT 'we have a stock out filter'      
    DECLARE @containeroutpk int      
    SELECT @containeroutpk = containeroutpk FROM tblcontainerouts WHERE dbo.tblcontainerouts.GoodsOrderNumber = @var_goodsOrderNumber       
      
    DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #COPallets      
    SELECT DISTINCT Palletfk       
    INTO #COPallets      
    FROM viewContainerOutPalletList cpl      
    WHERE cpl.ContainerOutPK = @containeroutpk      
     AND ContainerOutStatusFK NOT IN (5,6)/*no pallets to show for cancelled or completed orders*/      
      
    DELETE p      
    FROM #allPals p      
    WHERE p.palletpk NOT IN (SELECT * FROM #COPallets)      
   END      
      
   --content of pallet list      
   DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #PalletContent      
   Select PalletFK, StockItemFK, Batch, SupplierBatch, pc.ExpiryDate, pc.BestBefore,      
    sum(ActualUnits) ActualUnits, sum(ActualEaches * ActualUnits) ActualEachUnits,      
    sum(AvailableUnits) AvailableUnits, sum(AvailableEaches * AvailableUnits) AvailableEachUnits       
   INTO #PalletContent      
   FROM #allPals p      
   INNER JOIN tblPalletContent pc ON p.palletpk = pc.palletfk      
   INNER JOIN tblStockItems sis ON sis.StockItemPK = pc.StockItemFK      
   WHERE pc.IsArchived = 0 AND ((sis.EachesTypeFK < 0) OR (sis.EachesTypeFK > 0 AND pc.EachUnits > 0))      
   Group By PalletFK, StockItemFK, Batch,SupplierBatch, pc.ExpiryDate, pc.BestBefore      
      
   --content currently on order (split pallet content)      
   DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #OnOrderPallets      
   Select colpc.palletcontentfk, colpc.splitpalletcontentfk, colpc.PalletFK, sis.StockItempK as StockItemFK, pc.Batch, pc.SupplierBatch,      
    colpc.Units as ActualUnits, colpc.Units * Colpc.eaches as ActualEachUnits, 0 as AvailableUnits, 0 as AvailableEachUnits, pc.ExpiryDate  , pc.BestBefore      
   INTO #OnOrderPallets      
   FROM #allPals ap      
   INNER join tblcontaineroutlinepalletcontent colpc ON colpc.palletfk=  ap.palletpk      
   inner join tblcontaineroutlines col on colpc.containeroutlinefk = col.containeroutlinepk      
   inner join tblcontainerouts co on col.containeroutfk = co.containeroutpk      
   inner join tblPalletContent pc on colpc.palletcontentfk = pc.palletcontentpk      
   inner join tblStockItems sis on sis.StockItemPK = pc.StockItemFK      
   Where ((sis.EachesTypeFK < 0) OR (sis.EachesTypeFK > 0 AND pc.EachUnits > 0))       
    and pc.IsArchived = 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/ and co.containeroutstatusfk not in  (5,6) and (pc.palletfk = -1 or colpc.splitpalletcontentfk > 0)      
   group by colpc.palletcontentfk, colpc.PalletFK, sis.StockItempK, pc.Batch, pc.SupplierBatch, colpc.Units, Colpc.eaches, colpc.splitpalletcontentfk, pc.ExpiryDate, pc.BestBefore      
      
      
   drop table if exists #tmpPalletSupplier      
   select distinct palletpk, sup.supplierpk, sup.Supplier      
  into #tmpPalletSupplier      
   from #allPals pals      
   inner join tblstockinlinepallets silp on pals.palletpk = silp.palletfk      
   inner join tblstockinlines sil on stockinlinepk = stockinlinefk      
   inner join tblstockins si on stockinfk = stockinpk      
   inner join tblContainerIns ci on containerinpk = containerinfk      
   left join tblsuppliers sup on SupplierPK = ci.SupplierFK      
       
      
   SELECT [For],BuildingUnit,DivisionName,DivisionCode,StockItemCode,Description,Batch,SupplierBatch,Location,PalletType,PalletStatus,      
    sum(Actual) Actual, sum(Available) Available, sum(OnOrder) OnOrder, Barcode, SUBSTRING(CustomerPalletNumber, 0,  11) AS CustomerPalletNumber, @var_PrintByColumn as PrintByColumn, @var_PrintCheckBox as PrintCheckBox, ExpiryDate, BestBefore    
 ,Supplier     
   FROM(      
    Select @for as [For],       
     'Building Unit: ' + buildings.BuildingName + ' - ' + bus.BuildingUnit BuildingUnit,       
     divs.DivisionName,divs.DivisionCode,      
     stockItems.StockItemCode,       
     stockItems.Description,       
     pc.Batch,      
     pc.SupplierBatch,      
     palletLocation.Location,      
     palletTypes.PalletType,      
     ps.PalletStatus,      
     case when stockItems.EachesTypeFK <> -1 then pc.ActualEachUnits else pc.ActualUnits End as Actual,      
     case when stockItems.EachesTypeFK <> -1 then pc.AvailableEachUnits else pc.AvailableUnits End as Available,      
     case when stockItems.EachesTypeFK <> -1 then pc.ActualEachUnits - pc.AvailableEachUnits else pc.ActualUnits - pc.AvailableUnits End as OnOrder,      
     case when pallets.CustomerBarcode = '' then pallets.Barcode else pallets.CustomerBarcode end Barcode, pallets.CustomerPalletNumber,      
     palletLocation.LocationTypeFK,      
     uts.Abbreviation,           
     pc.ExpiryDate, pc.BestBefore, -1 as palletcontentfk    
  ,supp.Supplier    
    from #allPals pallets      
    INNER JOIN viewPalletLocations palletLocation ON  palletLocation.palletPK = pallets.palletPk      
    left outer join appPalletStatus ps on ps.PalletStatusPK = pallets.PalletStatusFK      
    inner join #PalletContent pc ON pc.PalletFK = pallets.PalletPK      
    inner join tblStockItems stockItems on stockItems.StockItemPK = pc.StockItemFK      
    inner join tblDivisions divs on divs.DivisionPK = stockItems.DivisionFK      
    left outer join tblUnitTypes uts on uts.UnitTypePK = stockItems.UnitTypeFK      
    left outer join tblPalletTypes palletTypes on palletTypes.PalletTypePK = pallets.PalletTypeFK      
    left outer join tblBuildingUnits bus on bus.BuildingUnitPK = palletLocation.BuildingUnitFK      
    left outer join tblBuildings buildings on buildings.BuildingPK = bus.BuildingFK     
 left join #tmpPalletSupplier supp on supp.palletpk=pc.palletfk    
    
    WHERE (@var_buildingUnitBayFKs = '' OR (',' + @var_buildingUnitBayFKs + ',' LIKE '%,' + CONVERT(VARCHAR, pallets.LocationFK) + ',%' AND palletLocation.LocationTypeFK = 1/*Racking Only*/))      
     AND (@var_buildingUnitRowFK = -1 OR (palletLocation.Row = @BuildingUnitRow AND pallets.LocationTypeFK = 1) )       
    UNION all      
      
    SELECT distinct  @for as [For],       
    'Building Unit: ' + buildings.BuildingName + ' - ' + bus.BuildingUnit BuildingUnit,       
    divs.DivisionName, divs.DivisionCode,      
    stockItems.StockItemCode,       
    stockItems.Description,       
    pc.Batch,      
    pc.SupplierBatch,      
    palletLocation.location,      
    palletTypes.PalletType,      
    ps.PalletStatus,      
    case when stockItems.EachesTypeFK <> -1 then pc.ActualEachUnits else pc.ActualUnits End as Actual,      
    case when stockItems.EachesTypeFK <> -1 then pc.AvailableEachUnits else pc.AvailableUnits End as Available,      
    case when stockItems.EachesTypeFK <> -1 then pc.ActualEachUnits - pc.AvailableEachUnits else pc.ActualUnits - pc.AvailableUnits End as OnOrder,      
    case when pallets.CustomerBarcode = '' then pallets.Barcode else pallets.CustomerBarcode end Barcode, pallets.CustomerPalletNumber,      
    pallets.LocationTypeFK,      
    uts.Abbreviation,           
     pc.ExpiryDate, pc.BestBefore, pc.palletcontentfk     
  ,supp.Supplier    
    from #allPals pallets      
    left outer join appPalletStatus ps on ps.PalletStatusPK = pallets.PalletStatusFK      
    /*Pallet content currently on order*/      
    left join #OnOrderPallets pc on pc.PalletFK = pallets.PalletPK      
    left outer join viewPalletLooseLocations palletLocation on ((pc.splitpalletcontentFk > 0 and palletLocation.palletcontentPk = pc.splitpalletcontentFk) or (palletLocation.palletcontentPk = pc.palletcontentfk))      
    inner join tblStockItems stockItems on stockItems.StockItemPK = pc.StockItemFK --AND stockItems.DivisionFK = @var_divisionFK      
    inner join tblDivisions divs on divs.DivisionPK = stockItems.DivisionFK      
    left outer join tblUnitTypes uts on uts.UnitTypePK = stockItems.UnitTypeFK      
    left outer join tblPalletTypes palletTypes on palletTypes.PalletTypePK = pallets.PalletTypeFK      
    left outer join tblBuildingUnits bus on bus.BuildingUnitPK = palletLocation.BuildingUnitFK      
    left outer join tblBuildings buildings on buildings.BuildingPK = bus.BuildingFK      
   left join #tmpPalletSupplier supp on supp.palletpk=pc.palletfk    
   WHERE (@var_buildingUnitBayFKs = '' OR      
     (',' + @var_buildingUnitBayFKs + ',' LIKE '%,' + CONVERT(VARCHAR, pallets.LocationFK) + ',%' AND palletLocation.LooseLocationTypeFK = 1/*Racking Only*/))      
     AND (@var_buildingUnitRowFK = -1 OR (palletLocation.Row = @BuildingUnitRow AND pallets.LocationTypeFK = 1))      
   )subQ      
   Group By [For],LocationTypeFK,BuildingUnit,DivisionName,DivisionCode,StockItemCode,Description,Batch,SupplierBatch,Location,PalletType,PalletStatus,      
    Barcode, CustomerPalletNumber, Abbreviation, subQ.ExpiryDate, subQ.BestBefore     
 ,Supplier     
   order by BuildingUnit , LocationTypeFK, Location      
      
      
   -- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end      
      
         
         
   BREAK      
  END TRY      
  BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */      
   DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;      
   SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;      
   SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;      
      
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY       
   BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;      
             
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;      
      
            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID      
                  
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;      
                  
   IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)      
   BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END      
   ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */      
  END CATCH      
  SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1      
 END      
END    
GO

-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Jamie Clerkin>
-- Create date: <20/10/2015>
-- Description:	<Get list of all completed movements between different buildings for a specified division>
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spReportsMovementsBetweenBuildings]
(
	@DivisionPK int
)	
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data; Ensure this proc has a low impact when executed */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED; SET DEADLOCK_PRIORITY LOW

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT
	,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;
	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	DECLARE @var_DivisionPK int
	SET @var_DivisionPK = @DivisionPK
	SET @ParameterDetails = '@DivisionPK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_DivisionPK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'')

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    --BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

		SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END


	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY
			

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start

			select movements.WorksOrderMovementPK, pallets.palletpk, case when pallets.customerbarcode is not null then 
			pallets.customerbarcode else pallets.barcode end as Barcode,
				stock.StockItemCode, stock.Description as StockDescription, pc.Batch, case when movements.Eaches >= 0 then 
				movements.Eaches else movements.Units end as 'Units/Eaches',
				case when sourceRackingBay.buildingName is not null then sourceRackingBay.buildingName 
				else sourceLoadingBay.buildingName end as SourceBuilding,
				case when sourceRackingBay.BuildingUnit is not null then sourceRackingBay.BuildingUnit 
				else sourceLoadingBay.BuildingUnit end as SourceBuildingUnit,
				case when sourceRackingBay.Location is not null then sourceRackingBay.Location 
				else sourceLoadingBay.Location end as SourceLocation,
				case when destinationrackingBay.buildingName is not null then destinationrackingBay.buildingName 
				else destinationLoadingBay.buildingName end as DestinationBuilding,
				case when destinationrackingBay.BuildingUnit is not null then destinationrackingBay.BuildingUnit 
				else destinationLoadingBay.BuildingUnit end as DestinationBuildingUnit,
				case when destinationrackingBay.Location is not null then destinationrackingBay.Location 
				else destinationLoadingBay.Location end as DestinationLocation,
				CONVERT(VARCHAR(50), movements.updateddate, 106)  as Moveddate, convert(char(5), movements.updateddate, 108) [time], 
				case when pep.FirstName is not null then 
				pep.FirstName + ' ' + pep.LastName else 'Unknown' end as MovedBy,-- wotypes.worksordertype, origin.WorksOrderOrigin
				movements.movementdescription, divs.DivisionCode + ' : ' + divs.DivisionName as Division
			from 
				tblworksordermovements movements
			inner join tblworksorders orders on orders.worksorderpk = movements.worksorderfk
			--inner join appworksordertypes wotypes on wotypes.worksordertypepk = orders.worksordertypefk
			--inner join appworksorderorigins origin on origin.worksorderoriginpk = orders.worksorderoriginfk
			inner join tblpallets pallets on pallets.palletpk = movements.palletfk
			inner join tblpalletcontent pc on pc.palletfk = pallets.palletpk
			inner join tblstockitems stock on stock.stockitempk = pc.stockitemfk
			inner join tbldivisions divs on divs.divisionpk = stock.divisionfk
			left join tblusers users on users.userPK = movements.updatedBy
			left join tblpeople pep on pep.personPK = users.personfk
			left join (
				select buildings.buildingName, units.BuildingUnit,  rows.Row +  RIGHT('00'+CAST(cols.BuildingUnitColumn AS VARCHAR(2)),2) 
				+ bays.bayLevel as Location, bays.buildingunitbaypk
				from tblbuildingunitbays bays
				inner join tblbuildingunitcolumns cols on cols.buildingunitcolumnpk = bays.buildingunitcolumnfk
				inner join tblbuildingunitrows rows on rows.buildingunitrowpk = cols.buildingunitrowfk
				inner join tblbuildingunits units on units.buildingunitpk = rows.buildingunitfk
				inner join tblbuildings buildings on buildings.buildingpk = units.buildingfk
				) as sourceRackingBay on sourceRackingBay.buildingunitbaypk = movements.sourcelocationfk
			left join (
				select buildings.buildingName, units.BuildingUnit, bays.Loadingbay as Location, bays.loadingbaypk
				from tblLoadingBays bays
				inner join tblbuildingunits units on units.buildingunitpk = bays.buildingunitfk
				inner join tblbuildings buildings on buildings.buildingpk = units.buildingfk
				) as sourceLoadingBay on sourceLoadingBay.loadingbaypk = movements.sourcelocationfk
			left join (
				select buildings.buildingName, units.BuildingUnit,  rows.Row +  RIGHT('00'+CAST(cols.BuildingUnitColumn AS VARCHAR(2)),2) 
				+ bays.bayLevel as Location, bays.buildingunitbaypk
				from tblbuildingunitbays bays
				inner join tblbuildingunitcolumns cols on cols.buildingunitcolumnpk = bays.buildingunitcolumnfk
				inner join tblbuildingunitrows rows on rows.buildingunitrowpk = cols.buildingunitrowfk
				inner join tblbuildingunits units on units.buildingunitpk = rows.buildingunitfk
				inner join tblbuildings buildings on buildings.buildingpk = units.buildingfk
				) as destinationrackingBay on destinationrackingBay.buildingunitbaypk = movements.destinationfk
			left join (
				select buildings.buildingName, units.BuildingUnit, bays.Loadingbay as Location, bays.loadingbaypk
				from tblLoadingBays bays
				inner join tblbuildingunits units on units.buildingunitpk = bays.buildingunitfk
				inner join tblbuildings buildings on buildings.buildingpk = units.buildingfk
				) as destinationLoadingBay on destinationLoadingBay.loadingbaypk = movements.destinationfk

			where divs.divisionpk = @var_DivisionPK
			and movements.worksorderstatusfk = 3
			and orders.worksorderoriginfk <> 1
			and movements.movementdescription not like '%FROM Container%'
			and (sourceRackingBay.buildingName is not null and (
					(destinationrackingBay.buildingName is not null and destinationrackingBay.buildingname <> sourceRackingBay.buildingName)
					or 
					(destinationLoadingBay.buildingName is not null and destinationLoadingBay.buildingName <> sourceRackingBay.buildingName))
			or (sourceLoadingBay.buildingName is not null and (
					(destinationrackingBay.buildingName is not null and destinationrackingBay.buildingname <> sourceLoadingBay.buildingName)
					or 
					(destinationLoadingBay.buildingName is not null and destinationLoadingBay.buildingName <> sourceLoadingBay.buildingName))))
			order by stock.StockItemCode, pallets.palletpk, movements.updateddate

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end

			
			
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END
GO

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spReportsPalletHistory]  --'754896254178958741','',1,1,1,1  
(      
    @SelectedBarcode nvarchar(50) = '',    
 @SelectedPalletPK nvarchar(50) = '',    
 @IncludeMovements bit = 1,    
 @IncludeAdjustments bit = 1,    
 @IncludePalletStatusChanges bit = 1,    
 @IncludePicks bit = 1    
)     
AS    
BEGIN    
 /* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data; Ensure this proc has a low impact when executed */    
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED; SET DEADLOCK_PRIORITY LOW    
    
    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT    
 ,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;    
 SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();    
    
 -- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters    
 DECLARE @var_SelectedBarcode nvarchar(50), @var_SelectedPalletPK nvarchar(50), @var_IncludeMovements bit, @var_IncludeAdjustments bit,     
 @var_IncludePalletStatusChanges bit, @var_IncludePicks bit    
    
 SET @var_SelectedBarcode = @SelectedBarcode; SET @var_SelectedPalletPK = @SelectedPalletPK; SET @var_IncludeMovements = @IncludeMovements    
 SET @var_IncludeAdjustments = @IncludeAdjustments; SET @var_IncludePalletStatusChanges = @IncludePalletStatusChanges    
 SET @var_IncludePicks = @IncludePicks    
    
 SET @ParameterDetails = '@SelectedBarcode = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_SelectedBarcode AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@SelectedPalletPK = '     
  + ISNULL(CAST(@var_SelectedPalletPK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@IncludeMovements = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_IncludeMovements AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'')     
   + ',@IncludeAdjustments = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_IncludeAdjustments AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@IncludePalletStatusChanges = '     
    + ISNULL(CAST(@var_IncludePalletStatusChanges AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@IncludePicks = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_IncludePicks AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'')    
    
    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL     
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)
