        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)    
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK    
    
        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()    
    --END    
    
 SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);    
 SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails    
 ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;    
 INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()    
    
 WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3

   --------------------------------------------------------------------------------    
   -- Temp table of pallet pk's (can be multiple pallet records with same barcode)    
   --------------------------------------------------------------------------------    
    
   IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#TempPallets') IS NOT NULL    
    DROP TABLE #TempPallets    
    
   Select     
    palletpk, CustomerBarcode, Barcode, CustomerPalletNumber, PalletStatusFK AS CurrentStatus    
   INTO     
    #TempPallets     
   from     
    tblpallets     
   where     
    (    
     (barcode = @var_SelectedBarcode or customerbarcode = @var_SelectedBarcode)     
     AND @var_SelectedBarcode <> ''    
    )    
    OR    
    (    
     palletpk = @var_SelectedPalletPK    
     AND NOT (@var_SelectedBarcode <> '')    
    )    
    
   IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#TempWorksOrderPallets') IS NOT NULL    
    DROP TABLE #TempWorksOrderPallets    
    
   Select     
    wop.*    
   INTO     
    #TempWorksOrderPallets     
   from     
    tblworksorderpallets wop    
    INNER JOIN #TempPallets tp ON wop.PalletFK = tp.palletpk     
    
   IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#TempPalletAudit') IS NOT NULL    
    DROP TABLE #TempPalletAudit    
    
   select     
    PalletAuditPK, PalletFK, StockItemFK, Batch, EventTypeFK, EventFK, EventDate, UpdatedBy, TotalUnits    
   INTO     
    #TempPalletAudit    
   from     
    tblPalletaudit    
   inner join #TempPallets     
    on palletfk = PalletPK    
    
   IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#TempStockItem') IS NOT NULL    
    DROP TABLE #TempStockItem    
    
   create table #TempStockItem    
   (    
    StockItemPK int,    
    StockItemCode nvarchar(500),    
    Description nvarchar(500),    
    DivisionFK int    
   )    
    
   INSERT INTO #TempStockItem    
   select distinct    
    si.StockItemPK, si.StockItemCode, si.[Description], si.DivisionFK       
   from #TempPallets    
   INNER JOIN tblpalletcontent pc ON palletfk = palletpk     
   INNER JOIN tblstockitems AS si ON si.stockitempk = pc.stockitemfk    
    
   INSERT INTO #TempStockItem    
   select distinct    
    si.StockItemPK, si.StockItemCode, si.[Description], si.DivisionFK    
   FROM tblStockItems AS si    
   INNER JOIN #TempPalletAudit AS tpa ON si.stockitempk = tpa.stockitemfk    
   WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM #TempStockItem ts WHERE ts.StockItemPK = si.StockItemPK)    
         
    
   IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#TempDivision') IS NOT NULL    
    DROP TABLE #TempDivision    
    
   select distinct    
    d.DivisionPK, d.CustomerFK

   IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#TempDocketIdentifiers') IS NOT NULL    
    DROP TABLE #TempDocketIdentifiers

   IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#TempMovements') IS NOT NULL

   IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#TempColpc') IS NOT NULL

    left join #TempDivision div on div.DivisionPK = s.DivisionFK    
    LEFT OUTER JOIN #TempDocketIdentifiers AS cdis on cdis.CustomerFK= div.CustomerFK and cdis.DocketTypeFK=1    
    where p.CurrentStatus = 10

    case when p.CustomerBarcode <> '' then p.CustomerBarcode else p.Barcode END AS Barcode,     
    p.CustomerPalletNumber,    
    2 as EventOrder,    
    0 as scanned

   inner join tblstockinlinepallets as silp on silp.palletfk = pa.palletfk      
   inner join tblstockinlines as sil on sil.stockinlinepk = silp.stockinlinefk      
   inner join tblstockins as si on si.stockinpk = sil.stockinfk

'Invalid Location') END

        WHEN sourceLocationTypeFK = 6 THEN    
        lSam.BuildingUnitFK    
        WHEN sourceLocationTypeFK = 8 THEN    
        lFloor.BuildingUnitFK    
      END as BuildingUnitFK,     
      CASE WHEN sourceLocationTypeFK = 1 THEN     
        vbus.BuildingUnitBayLocation    
        WHEN sourceLocationTypeFK = 2 THEN     
        lBay.LoadingBay    
        WHEN sourceLocationTypeFK = 3 THEN    
        lset.SetDownArea    
        WHEN sourceLocationTypeFK = 6 THEN    
        lSam.SampleLocation    
        WHEN sourceLocationTypeFK = 8 THEN    
        lFloor.FloorLocation    
      END as LocationDescription     
     from #TempMovements    
     LEFT OUTER JOIN viewBuildingUnitBays as vbus on vbus.BuildingUnitBayPK = SourcelocationFK and vbus.locationTypeFK = sourceLocationTypeFK    
     LEFT OUTER JOIN tblLoadingBays as lBay ON lBay.loadingBayPK = SourceLocationFK     
     LEFT OUTER JOIN tblSetDownAreas as lSet ON lSEt.SetdownareaPK = SourceLocationFK     
     LEFT OUTER JOIN tblSampleLocations as lSam ON lSam.SampleLocationPK = sourceLocationFK    
     LEFT OUTER JOIN tblFloorLocations as lFloor on lFloor.FloorLocationPK = sourceLocationFK    
    ) as SourceLocation ON SourceLocation.worksordermovementpk = wom.worksordermovementpk    
    LEFT OUTER JOIN (    
     Select  BuildingName + ' - ' + BuildingUnit as Building, BuildingUnitPK     
     FROM tblBuildingUnits     
     INNER JOIN tblBuildings on BuildingPK = BuildingFK) as SourceBuilding    
    ON SourceBuilding.BuildingUnitPK = SourceLocation.BuildingUnitFK

        WHEN DestinationLocationTypeFK = 3 THEN

        WHEN DestinationLocationTypeFK = 8 THEN    
        lFloor.BuildingUnitFK

        vbus.BuildingUnitBayLocation    
        WHEN DestinationLocationTypeFK = 2 THEN     
        lBay.LoadingBay    
        WHEN DestinationLocationTypeFK = 3 THEN    
        lset.SetDownArea    
        WHEN DestinationLocationTypeFK = 6 THEN    
        lSam.SampleLocation    
        WHEN DestinationLocationTypeFK = 8 THEN    
        lFloor.FloorLocation    
      END as LocationDescription     
     from #TempMovements    
     LEFT OUTER JOIN viewBuildingUnitBays as vbus on vbus.BuildingUnitBayPK = DestinationFK and vbus.locationTypeFK = DestinationLocationTypeFK    
     LEFT OUTER JOIN tblLoadingBays as lBay ON lBay.loadingBayPK = DestinationFK     
     LEFT OUTER JOIN tblSetDownAreas as lSet ON lSEt.SetdownareaPK = DestinationFK     
     LEFT OUTER JOIN tblSampleLocations as lSam ON lSam.SampleLocationPK = DestinationFK

    ) as DestinationLocation ON DestinationLocation.worksordermovementpk = wom.worksordermovementpk    
    LEFT OUTER JOIN (    
     Select  BuildingName + ' - ' + BuildingUnit as Building, BuildingUnitPK     
     FROM tblBuildingUnits     
     INNER JOIN tblBuildings on BuildingPK = BuildingFK) as Destinationbuilding    
    ON Destinationbuilding.BuildingUnitPK = DestinationLocation.BuildingUnitFK    
    
    INNER JOIN #TempPallets AS tp    
    ON wom.palletfk = tp.PalletPK    
    
    where @var_IncludeMovements = 1    
    and wom.worksorderstatusfk = 3

      END

     END as description, s.stockitemcode + ' - ' + s.description as StockItem, case when p.CustomerBarcode <> '' then p.CustomerBarcode else p.Barcode END AS Barcode,p.CustomerPalletNumber, 3 as EventOrder,0 as scanned    
    from #TempColpc as colpc    
    inner join tblcontaineroutlines as col on colpc.containeroutlinefk = col.containeroutlinepk    
    inner join tblcontainerouts as co on co.containeroutpk = col.containeroutfk    
    --inner join tblpalletaudit as pa on pa.EventFK = col.containeroutlinepk and pa.EventTypeFK = 3    
    inner join #TempStockItem as s on s.stockitempk = col.stockitemfk    
    left join #TempDivision div on div.DivisionPK = s.DivisionFK    
    LEFT OUTER JOIN #TempDocketIdentifiers AS cdis on cdis.CustomerFK= div.CustomerFK and cdis.DocketTypeFK=2    
    inner join #TempPallets as p on p.palletpk = colpc.palletfk    
    left outer join (    
     Select users.UserPK, FirstName + ' ' + LastName as PersonName    
     from tblPeople as people    
     inner join tblUsers users on users.PersonFK = people.PersonPK) as createdbyuser on createdbyuser.UserPK = co.updatedby     
    where co.containeroutstatusfk = 6     
    and @var_IncludePicks = 1    
   end    
    
   if @var_IncludePicks = 1    
   begin    
    --pallet loaded but not gone    
    INSERT INTO #finalResults     
    (    
     EventType,     
     EventDate,     
     Eventuser,      
     Units,     
     [Description],    
     StockItem,     
     Barcode,     
     CustomerPalletNumber,    
EventOrder,    
     scanned    
    )    
    SELECT distinct case when pa.eventtypefk in(25,27)  then 'Pallet Loaded' else 'Pallet Unloaded' end as EventType,     
     pa.eventdate as EventDate,     
     case when createdbyuser.PersonName is null then 'System' else createdbyuser.PersonName end as Eventuser,     
     convert(nvarchar(255),sum(pa.totalunits)) as Units,     
     case when pa.eventtypefk in(25,27) then'Pallet loaded for Stock Out ' else 'Pallet Unloaded from Stock Out ' end + co.goodsordernumber + 'v' + CONVERT(varchar(10), co.versionnumber) + ' '  + CASE WHEN cdis.CustomerDocketIdentificationPK is null THEN 
 
     
      (case when Docketlabel1 <> '' THEN Docketlabel1 + ': ' + DocketValue1 else ''end + ' ' +    
      case when Docketlabel2 <> '' THEN Docketlabel2 + ': ' + DocketValue2  else '' end + ' ' +    
      case when Docketlabel3 <> '' THEN Docketlabel3 + ': ' + DocketValue3 else '' end )      
      ELSE    
      ' (' +    
       case cdis.FieldFK when 40 then    
              cdis.Prefix + ' ' + co.DocketValue1    
            when 41 then    
              cdis.Prefix + ' ' + co.DocketValue2    
            when 42 then    
              cdis.Prefix + ' ' + co.DocketValue3    
            end     
            + ' ' +    
            case cdis.Field2FK when 40 then    
              cdis.Prefix2 + ' ' + co.DocketValue1    
            when 41 then    
              cdis.Prefix2 + ' ' + co.DocketValue2    
            when 42 then    
              cdis.Prefix2 + ' ' + co.DocketValue3    
            else    
              ' '    
       END    
       + ')'    
     END as Description,    
     s.stockitemcode + ' - ' + s.description as StockItem, case when p.CustomerBarcode <> '' then p.CustomerBarcode else p.Barcode END AS Barcode, p.CustomerPalletNumber, 6 as EventOrder,    
     case when pa.eventtypefk = 27 then 1 else 0 end as scanned    
    from #TempPalletAudit as pa     
    inner join tblcontainerouts as co on co.containeroutpk = pa.eventfk and pa.eventtypefk in (25,26, 27)    
    inner join #TempStockItem as s on s.stockitempk = pa.stockitemfk    
    left join #TempDivision div on div.DivisionPK = s.DivisionFK    
    LEFT OUTER JOIN #TempDocketIdentifiers AS cdis on cdis.CustomerFK= div.CustomerFK and cdis.DocketTypeFK=2    
    inner join #TempPallets as p on p.palletpk = pa.palletfk    
    INNER JOIN #TempColpc AS colpc ON colpc.PalletFk = p.palletpk    
    INNER JOIN tblcontaineroutlines col ON colpc.ContainerOutLineFK = col.ContainerOutLinePK AND col.containeroutfk = co.ContainerOutPK    
    LEFT JOIN #TempMovements wom ON wom.palletfk = p.palletpk AND colpc.ContainerOutLinePalletContentPK = wom.ContainerOutLinePalletContentFK AND ((wom.DestinationLocationTypeFK = 5 AND pa.eventtypefk IN (25,27)) OR (wom.SourceLocationTypeFK=5 AND pa.eventtypefk = 26)) /*AND wom.UpdatedBy = paDetail.UpdatedBy*/ AND pa.EventDate BETWEEN Dateadd(SECOND, -2, wom.updateddate) AND Dateadd(SECOND, 2, wom.updateddate)    
    --LEFT JOIN #TempMovements wom ON wom.palletfk = p.palletpk AND ((wom.DestinationLocationTypeFK = 5 AND pa.eventtypefk IN (25,27)) OR (wom.SourceLocationTypeFK=5 AND pa.eventtypefk = 26)) /*AND wom.UpdatedBy = paDetail.UpdatedBy*/ AND pa.EventDate BETWEEN Dateadd(SECOND, -2, wom.updateddate) AND Dateadd(SECOND, 2, wom.updateddate)    
    left outer join (    
     Select users.UserPK, FirstName + ' ' + LastName as PersonName    
     from tblPeople as people    
     inner join tblUsers as users on users.PersonFK = people.PersonPK    
    ) as createdbyuser on createdbyuser.UserPK = CASE WHEN wom.responsibleuserfk IS NOT NULL AND wom.responsibleuserfk > 0 THEN wom.responsibleuserfk else pa.updatedby  end    
    where @var_IncludePicks = 1    
    group BY case when pa.eventtypefk in(25,27)  then 'Pallet Loaded' else 'Pallet Unloaded' end, pa.eventdate , case when createdbyuser.PersonName is null then 'System' else createdbyuser.PersonName end ,     
    case when pa.eventtypefk in(25,27) then'Pallet loaded for Stock Out ' else 'Pallet Unloaded from Stock Out ' end + co.goodsordernumber + 'v' + CONVERT(varchar(10), co.versionnumber) ,    
    s.stockitemcode + ' - ' + s.description , case when p.CustomerBarcode <> '' then p.CustomerBarcode else p.Barcode END , p.CustomerPalletNumber,    
    case when pa.eventtypefk = 27 then 1 else 0 end, CASE WHEN cdis.CustomerDocketIdentificationPK is null THEN     
     (case when Docketlabel1 <> '' THEN Docketlabel1 + ': ' + DocketValue1 else ''end + ' ' +    
     case when Docketlabel2 <> '' THEN Docketlabel2 + ': ' + DocketValue2  else '' end + ' ' +    
     case when Docketlabel3 <> '' THEN Docketlabel3 + ': ' + DocketValue3 else '' end )      
     ELSE    
     ' (' +    
      case cdis.FieldFK when 40 then    
             cdis.Prefix + ' ' + co.DocketValue1    
           when 41 then    
             cdis.Prefix + ' ' + co.DocketValue2    
           when 42 then    
             cdis.Prefix + ' ' + co.DocketValue3    
           end     
           + ' ' +    
           case cdis.Field2FK when 40 then    
             cdis.Prefix2 + ' ' + co.DocketValue1    
           when 41 then    
             cdis.Prefix2 + ' ' + co.DocketValue2    
           when 42 then    
             cdis.Prefix2 + ' ' + co.DocketValue3    
           else    
             ' '    
      END    
      + ')'    
     END    
   end    
    
   if @var_IncludePicks = 1    
   begin    
    --pallet gone    
    INSERT INTO #finalResults     
    (    
     EventType,     
     EventDate,     
     Eventuser,      
     Units,     
     [Description],    
     StockItem,     
     Barcode,     
     CustomerPalletNumber,    
     EventOrder,    
     scanned    
    )    
    select distinct  case when st.stocktransferpk is null then 'Pallet Gone' else 'Pallet transferred' End as EventType, pa.eventdate as EventDate, case when createdbyuser.PersonName is null then 'System' else createdbyuser.PersonName end as Eventuser, convert(nvarchar(255),colpc.units) as Units,     
    case when st.stocktransferpk is null then 'Pallet gone on ' else 'Pallet transferred to Goods In ' + ciTransferred.goodsinnumber + case when sitp.palletstatusfk is null then '()' else ' in ' + palletstatus + ' status' end  + ' from ' End + 'Stock Out 
  
' + co.goodsordernumber + 'v' + CONVERT(varchar(10), co.versionnumber) + ' '  + CASE WHEN cdis.CustomerDocketIdentificationPK is null THEN     
     (case when Docketlabel1 <> '' THEN Docketlabel1 + ': ' + DocketValue1 else ''end + ' ' +    
     case when Docketlabel2 <> '' THEN Docketlabel2 + ': ' + DocketValue2  else '' end + ' ' +    
     case when Docketlabel3 <> '' THEN Docketlabel3 + ': ' + DocketValue3 else '' end )      
     ELSE    
     ' (' +    
      case cdis.FieldFK when 40 then    
             cdis.Prefix + ' ' + co.DocketValue1    
           when 41 then    
             cdis.Prefix + ' ' + co.DocketValue2    
           when 42 then    
             cdis.Prefix + ' ' + co.DocketValue3    
           end     
           + ' ' +    
           case cdis.Field2FK when 40 then    
             cdis.Prefix2 + ' ' + co.DocketValue1    
           when 41 then    
             cdis.Prefix2 + ' ' + co.DocketValue2    
           when 42 then    
             cdis.Prefix2 + ' ' + co.DocketValue3    
           else    
             ' '    
      END    
      + ')'    
     END as Description,    
    s.stockitemcode + ' - ' + s.description as StockItem, case when p.CustomerBarcode <> '' then p.CustomerBarcode else p.Barcode END AS Barcode, p.CustomerPalletNumber, case when st.stocktransferpk is null then 6 else 1 End as EventOrder,0 as scanned    
    from #TempPalletAudit as pa      
    inner join tblcontaineroutlines as col on pa.eventfk = col.containeroutlinepk    
    inner join #TempColpc as colpc on colpc.containeroutlinefk = col.containeroutlinepk  and pa.palletfk = colpc.palletfk    
    inner join tblcontainerouts as co on co.containeroutpk = col.containeroutfk    
    inner join #TempStockItem as s on s.stockitempk = pa.stockitemfk    
    left join #TempDivision div on div.DivisionPK = s.DivisionFK    
    LEFT OUTER JOIN #TempDocketIdentifiers AS cdis on cdis.CustomerFK= div.CustomerFK and cdis.DocketTypeFK=2    
    inner join #TempPallets as p on p.palletpk = pa.palletfk    
    left outer join tblstocktransfers as st on st.ContainerOutFK = co.ContainerOutPK    
    left outer join tblcontainerins as ciTransferred on st.ContainerInFK = ciTransferred.ContainerInPK    
    left outer join (    
     select stockinpk, containerinfk, stockinlinepk, palletfk, palletstatusfk, palletstatus    
     from tblstockins    
     inner join tblstockinlines on stockinfk = stockinpk    
     inner join tblstockinlinepallets on stockinlinefk = stockinlinepk --and palletfk in (select )    
     inner join #TempPallets on palletfk = palletpk    
     inner join apppalletstatus on palletstatusfk = palletstatuspk    
    )sitp on sitp.containerinfk = ciTransferred.ContainerInPK-- and pa.palletfk = sitp.palletfk    
    left outer join (    
     Select users.UserPK, FirstName + ' ' + LastName as PersonName    
     from tblPeople as people    
     inner join tblUsers as users on users.PersonFK = people.PersonPK    
    ) as createdbyuser on createdbyuser.UserPK = pa.updatedby      
    where pa.EventTypeFK = 2     
    --and @var_IncludePicks = 1    
   end    
    
   if @var_IncludePicks = 1    
   begin    
    --stock gone - only show for partial picks    
    INSERT INTO #finalResults     
    (    
     EventType,     
     EventDate,     
     Eventuser,      
     Units,     
     [Description],    
     StockItem,     
     Barcode,    
     CustomerPalletNumber,     
     EventOrder,    
     scanned    
    )    
    select EventType, EventDate, EventUser, convert(nvarchar(255),sum(Units)) as Units, Description, StockItem, Barcode, CustomerPalletNumber, EventORder, Scanned    
   from (    
    select distinct colpc.containeroutlinepalletcontentpk,  'Stock Gone' as EventType, pa.eventdate as EventDate, case when createdbyuser.PersonName is null then 'System' else createdbyuser.PersonName end as Eventuser, colpc.units as Units, 'Stock Loaded 
  
for Stock Out ' + co.goodsordernumber + 'v' + CONVERT(varchar(10), co.versionnumber) + ' '  + CASE WHEN cdis.CustomerDocketIdentificationPK is null THEN     
     (case when Docketlabel1 <> '' THEN Docketlabel1 + ': ' + DocketValue1 else ''end + ' ' +    
     case when Docketlabel2 <> '' THEN Docketlabel2 + ': ' + DocketValue2  else '' end + ' ' +    
     case when Docketlabel3 <> '' THEN Docketlabel3 + ': ' + DocketValue3 else '' end )      
     ELSE    
     ' (' +    
      case cdis.FieldFK when 40 then    
             cdis.Prefix + ' ' + co.DocketValue1    
           when 41 then    
             cdis.Prefix + ' ' + co.DocketValue2    
           when 42 then    
             cdis.Prefix + ' ' + co.DocketValue3    
           end     
           + ' ' +    
           case cdis.Field2FK when 40 then    
             cdis.Prefix2 + ' ' + co.DocketValue1    
           when 41 then    
             cdis.Prefix2 + ' ' + co.DocketValue2    
           when 42 then    
             cdis.Prefix2 + ' ' + co.DocketValue3    
           else    
             ' '    
      END    
      + ')'    
     END as Description,    
    s.stockitemcode + ' - ' + s.description as StockItem, case when p.CustomerBarcode <> '' then p.CustomerBarcode else p.Barcode END AS Barcode, p.CustomerPalletNumber, 5 as EventOrder,0 as scanned    
     from #TempPalletAudit as pa      
     inner join tblcontaineroutlines as col on pa.eventfk = col.containeroutlinepk    
     inner join #TempColpc as colpc on colpc.containeroutlinefk = col.containeroutlinepk and colpc.palletfk = pa.palletfk    
     inner join tblcontainerouts as co on co.containeroutpk = col.containeroutfk    
     inner join #TempStockItem as s on s.stockitempk = col.stockitemfk    
     left join #TempDivision div on div.DivisionPK = s.DivisionFK    
     LEFT OUTER JOIN #TempDocketIdentifiers AS cdis on cdis.CustomerFK= div.CustomerFK and cdis.DocketTypeFK=2    
   inner join #TempPallets as p on p.palletpk = pa.palletfk    
     left outer join tblstocktransfers as st on st.ContaineroutFK = co.ContaineroutPK    
     left outer join (    
      Select users.UserPK, FirstName + ' ' + LastName as PersonName    
      from tblPeople as people    
      inner join tblUsers as users on users.PersonFK = people.PersonPK    
     ) as createdbyuser on createdbyuser.UserPK = pa.updatedby      
     left outer join (    
      select palletauditpk, palletfk from #TempPalletAudit where eventtypefk = 2    
     ) as PalletGone on PalletGone.palletfk = pa.palletfk    
     where pa.EventTypeFK = 3      
     and st.ContaineroutFK is null     
     and PalletGone.palletauditpk is null) subQ    
     group by EventType, EventDate, EventUser, Description, StockItem, Barcode, CustomerPalletNumber, EventORder, Scanned    
     --and @var_IncludePicks = 1    
   end     
    
   --pallet depleted (top up to another pallet)    
   INSERT INTO #finalResults     
   (    
    EventType,     
    EventDate,     
    Eventuser,      
    Units,     
    [Description],    
    StockItem,     
    Barcode,     
    CustomerPalletNumber,    
    EventOrder,    
    scanned    
   )    
   select 'Pallet Depleted' as EventType, pt.inserteddate as EventDate, createdbyuser.PersonName as Eventuser, convert(nvarchar(255),pt.TopupUnits) as Units,     
   'Pallet ' + case when topallet.CustomerBarcode <> '' then topallet.CustomerBarcode else topallet.Barcode END + ' topped up with ' + CONVERT(varchar(10), pt.TopupUnits)     
   + ' units from pallet ' + case when frompallet.CustomerBarcode <> '' then frompallet.CustomerBarcode else frompallet.Barcode END as Description,     
   s.stockitemcode + ' - ' + s.description as StockItem,     
   case when frompallet.CustomerBarcode <> '' then frompallet.CustomerBarcode else frompallet.Barcode END AS Barcode, frompallet.CustomerPalletNumber, 7 as EventOrder,0 as scanned    
   from #TempPalletAudit as pa     
   inner join tblPalletTopups as pt on pa.palletfk = pt.TopupFromPalletFK and pa.eventfk = pt.worksorderfk    
   inner join tblPalletContent as pc on pc.palletfk = pt.TopupToPalletFK    
   inner join #TempStockItem as s on s.stockitempk = pc.stockitemfk    
   inner join tblpallets as frompallet on frompallet.palletpk = pa.palletfk    
   inner join tblpallets as topallet on topallet.palletpk = pc.palletfk    
   left outer join (    
    Select users.UserPK, FirstName + ' ' + LastName as PersonName    
    from tblPeople as people    
    inner join tblUsers as users on users.PersonFK = people.PersonPK    
   ) as createdbyuser on createdbyuser.UserPK = pa.updatedby    
        
   INNER JOIN #TempPallets as tp    
    ON pa.palletfk = tp.PalletPK    
          
   where pa.EventTypeFK = 24    
    
   --pallet topped up    
   INSERT INTO #finalResults     
   (    
    EventType,     
    EventDate,     
    Eventuser,      
    Units,     
    [Description],    
    StockItem,     
    Barcode,     
    CustomerPalletNumber,     
    EventOrder,    
    scanned    
   )    
   select 'Pallet Topped Up' as EventType, pt.inserteddate as EventDate, createdbyuser.PersonName as Eventuser, convert(nvarchar(255),pt.TopupUnits) as Units,     
   'Pallet ' + case when topallet.CustomerBarcode <> '' then topallet.CustomerBarcode else topallet.Barcode END + ' topped up with ' + CONVERT(varchar(10), pt.TopupUnits)     
   + ' units from pallet ' + case when frompallet.CustomerBarcode <> '' then frompallet.CustomerBarcode else frompallet.Barcode END as Description,     
   s.stockitemcode + ' - ' + s.description as StockItem,     
   case when frompallet.CustomerBarcode <> '' then frompallet.CustomerBarcode else frompallet.Barcode END AS Barcode, frompallet.CustomerPalletNumber, 6 as EventOrder,0 as scanned    
   from #TempPalletAudit as pa     
   inner join tblPalletTopups as pt on pa.palletfk = pt.TopupToPalletFK and pa.eventfk = pt.worksorderfk    
   inner join tblPalletContent as pc on pc.palletfk = pt.TopupToPalletFK    
   inner join #TempStockItem as s on s.stockitempk = pc.stockitemfk    
   inner join tblpallets as frompallet on frompallet.palletpk = pt.TopupFromPalletFK    
   inner join tblpallets as topallet on topallet.palletpk = pc.palletfk    
   left outer join (    
    Select users.UserPK, FirstName + ' ' + LastName as PersonName    
    from tblPeople as people    
    inner join tblUsers as users on users.PersonFK = people.PersonPK    
   ) as createdbyuser on createdbyuser.UserPK = pa.updatedby      
    
   INNER JOIN #TempPallets as tp    
    ON pa.palletfk = tp.PalletPK    
    
   where pa.EventTypeFK = 14    
    
   --pallet topped off    
   INSERT INTO #finalResults     
   (    
    EventType,     
    EventDate,     
    Eventuser,      
    Units,     
    [Description],    
    StockItem,     
    Barcode,    
    CustomerPalletNumber,      
    EventOrder,    
    scanned    
   )    
   select 'Pallet Topped Off' as EventType, pt.inserteddate as EventDate, createdbyuser.PersonName as Eventuser, convert(nvarchar(255),pt.TopupUnits) as Units,     
   'Pallet ' + case when topallet.CustomerBarcode <> '' then topallet.CustomerBarcode else topallet.Barcode END + ' topped up with ' + CONVERT(varchar(10), pt.TopupUnits)     
   + ' units from pallet ' + case when frompallet.CustomerBarcode <> '' then frompallet.CustomerBarcode else frompallet.Barcode END as Description,     
   s.stockitemcode + ' - ' + s.description as StockItem,     
   case when frompallet.CustomerBarcode <> '' then frompallet.CustomerBarcode else frompallet.Barcode END AS Barcode, frompallet.CustomerPalletNumber, 6 as EventOrder,0 as scanned    
   from #TempPalletAudit as pa     
   inner join tblPalletTopups as pt on pa.palletfk = pt.TopupFromPalletFK and pa.eventfk = pt.worksorderfk    
   inner join tblPalletContent as pc on pc.palletfk = pt.TopupToPalletFK    
   inner join #TempStockItem as s on s.stockitempk = pc.stockitemfk    
   inner join tblpallets as frompallet on frompallet.palletpk = pa.palletfk    
   inner join tblpallets as topallet on topallet.palletpk = pc.palletfk    
   left outer join (    
    Select users.UserPK, FirstName + ' ' + LastName as PersonName    
    from tblPeople as people    
    inner join tblUsers as users on users.PersonFK = people.PersonPK    
   ) as createdbyuser on createdbyuser.UserPK = pa.updatedby      
        
   INNER JOIN #TempPallets as tp    
    ON pa.palletfk = tp.PalletPK    
    
   where pa.EventTypeFK = 23    
    
   if @var_IncludeAdjustments = 1    
   begin    
    --stock adjustments    
    INSERT INTO #finalResults     
    (    
     EventType,     
     EventDate,     
     Eventuser,      
     Units,     
     [Description],    
     StockItem,     
     Barcode,     
     CustomerPalletNumber,     
     EventOrder,    
     scanned    
    )    
    select 'Stock Adjusted' as EventType, sa.InsertedDate as EventDate, case when createdbyuser.PersonName is null then 'System' else createdbyuser.PersonName end as Eventuser, convert(nvarchar(255),sa.UnitsAfter) as Units,    
      
    (case when sa.PalletTypeBeforeFK <> sa.PalletTypeAfterFK then    
     'Pallet Type changed from ' + coalesce(PTypeBefore.PalletType, 'unknown') + ' to ' + PTypeAfter.PalletType    
     when sa.UnitsBefore <> sa.UnitsAfter then    
     'Units on pallet changed from ' + CONVERT(varchar(10), sa.UnitsBefore) + ' to ' + CONVERT(varchar(10), sa.UnitsAfter)    
     when sa.EachesBefore <> sa.EachesAfter then    
     'Eaches on pallet changed from ' + CONVERT(varchar(10), sa.EachesBefore) + ' to ' + CONVERT(varchar(10), sa.EachesAfter)    
     when sa.BarcodeBefore <> sa.BarcodeAfter then    
     'Barcode changed from ' + sa.BarcodeBefore + ' to ' + sa.BarcodeAfter    
     when sa.CustomerBarcodeBefore <> sa.CustomerBarcodeAfter then    
     'Customer Barcode changed from ' + sa.CustomerBarcodeBefore + ' to ' + sa.CustomerBarcodeAfter    
     when sa.CustomerPalletNumberBefore <> sa.CustomerPalletNumberAfter then    
     'Customer Pallet Number changed from ' + sa.CustomerPalletNumberBefore + ' to ' + sa.CustomerPalletNumberAfter    
     when sa.BatchBefore <> sa.BatchAfter then    
     'Batch changed from ' + sa.BatchBefore + ' to ' + sa.BatchAfter    
     when sa.StockItemBeforeFK <> sa.StockItemAfterFK then    
     'Stock Item Code changed from ' + stockBefore.StockItemCode + ' to ' + s.StockItemCode    
     when sa.SpecialStockTypeBeforeFK <> sa.SpecialStockTypeAfterFK then    
     'Special Stock Type changed from ' + ISNULL(SSTBefore.SpecialStockType, 'No special type') + ' to ' + ISNULL(SSTAfter.SpecialStockType, 'No special type')    
     when sa.BestBeforeDateBefore <> sa.BestBeforeDateAfter then    
     'Best Before Date changed from ' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(50), sa.BestBeforeDateBefore, 106) + ' to ' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(50), sa.BestBeforeDateAfter, 106) + ' on works order ' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(50),sa.worksorderfk)    
     else 'Unknown Adjustment - contact support for details'    
    End) + case when sa.Queue = 1 then ' (Pending)' else '' end as Description,     
     coalesce(s.stockitemcode, currentdetails.stockitemcode) + ' - ' + coalesce(s.description, currentdetails.Description) as StockItem,     
    case when sa.CustomerBarcodeAfter <> '' then sa.CustomerBarcodeAfter else sa.BarcodeAfter END AS Barcode, p.CustomerPalletNumber, 6 as EventOrder,0 as scanned    
    from #TempPallets as p     
    inner join (    
     select palletfk, stockitemfk, stockitemcode, Description     
     from tblpalletcontent     
     inner join tblstockitems on stockitemfk = stockitempk    
     group by palletfk, stockitemfk, stockitemcode, Description    
    ) as currentdetails on currentdetails.palletfk = p.palletpk    
    inner join tblStockAdjustments as sa on p.palletpk = sa.palletfk    
    left outer join tblstockitems as stockBefore on stockBefore.stockitempk = sa.StockItemBeforeFK    
    left outer join tblstockitems as s on s.stockitempk = sa.StockItemAfterFK    
    inner join tblPalletTypes as PTypeBefore on PTypeBefore.PalletTypePK = sa.PalletTypeBeforeFK    
    inner join tblPalletTypes as PTypeAfter on PTypeAfter.PalletTypePK = sa.PalletTypeAfterFK    
    left outer join appSpecialStockTypes as SSTBefore on SSTBefore.SpecialStockTypePK = sa.SpecialStockTypeBeforeFK    
    left outer join appSpecialStockTypes as SSTAfter on SSTAfter.SpecialStockTypePK = sa.SpecialStockTypeAfterFK    
    left outer join (    
     Select users.UserPK, FirstName + ' ' + LastName as PersonName    
     from tblPeople as people    
     inner join tblUsers as users on users.PersonFK = people.PersonPK    
    ) as createdbyuser on createdbyuser.UserPK = sa.updatedby      
    --where @var_IncludeAdjustments = 1    
   end    
    
   if @var_IncludePalletStatusChanges = 1    
   begin    
    --pallet status changes    
    INSERT INTO #finalResults     
    (    
     EventType,     
     EventDate,     
     Eventuser,      
     Units,     
     [Description],    
     StockItem,     
     Barcode,     
     CustomerPalletNumber,     
     EventOrder,    
     scanned    
    )    
    select 'Status Changed' as EventType, sc.updatedDate as EventDate, case when createdbyuser.PersonName is null then 'System' else createdbyuser.PersonName end as Eventuser, /*convert(nvarchar(255), pc.ActualUnits)*/ 'Full QTY'  as Units,     
    'Pallet Status changed from ' + statusBefore.PalletStatus + ' to ' + statusAfter.PalletStatus + case when sc.instruction = '' then sc.instruction else ' (' + sc.instruction + ')' end + CASE WHEN pscr.PalletStatusChangeReason <> NULL then ' Reason: '  
 
+ pscr.PalletStatusChangeReason else '' END + ' REF: ' + sc.reference as Description,     
    s.stockitemcode + ' - ' + s.description as StockItem,     
    case when p.CustomerBarcode <> '' then p.CustomerBarcode else p.Barcode END AS Barcode, p.CustomerPalletNumber, 6 as EventOrder,0 as scanned    
    from  #TempPallets as p     
    Inner join tblPalletStatusChanges as sc on p.PalletPk = sc.PalletFK    
    Inner join tblpalletContent as pc on pc.PalletFk = sc.PalletFK    
    inner join #TempStockItem as s on s.stockitempk = pc.StockItemFK    
    left outer join appPalletStatusChangeReasons as pscr on sc.PalletStatusChangeReasonFK = pscr.PalletStatusChangeReasonPK    
    inner join appPalletStatus as statusBefore on statusBefore.PalletStatusPK = sc.FromPalletStatusFK    
    inner join appPalletStatus as statusAfter on statusafter.PalletStatusPK = sc.ToPalletStatusFK    
    left outer join (    
     Select users.UserPK, FirstName + ' ' + LastName as PersonName    
     from tblPeople as people    
     inner join tblUsers as users on users.PersonFK = people.PersonPK    
    ) as createdbyuser on createdbyuser.UserPK = sc.updatedby      
    --where @var_IncludePalletStatusChanges = 1    
   end    
       
   if @var_IncludePicks = 1    
   begin    
    -- Pallet removed from Pick    
    INSERT INTO #finalResults     
    (    
     EventType,     
     EventDate,     
     Eventuser,      
     Units,     
     [Description],    
     StockItem,     
     Barcode,     
     CustomerPalletNumber,     
     EventOrder,    
     scanned    
    )    
    select distinct 'Pallet Removed From Pick' as EventType,     
    pa.EventDate as EventDate,     
    case when createdbyuser.PersonName is null then 'System' else createdbyuser.PersonName end as Eventuser,    
    'Full QTY' as Units, 'Pallet Removed - From Stock Out : ' + co.GoodsOrderNumber  as Description,    
    s.stockitemcode + ' - ' + s.description as StockItem, case when p.CustomerBarcode <> '' then p.CustomerBarcode else p.Barcode END AS Barcode, p.CustomerPalletNumber,    
    2 as EventOrder,0 as scanned    
    from #TempPalletAudit as pa      
    inner join #TempPallets as p on palletpk = palletfk     
    inner join tblpalletcontent as pc on pc.palletfk = p.PalletPK    
    inner join tblcontainerouts as co on containeroutpk = eventfk        
    inner join tblstockitems as s on s.stockitempk = pa.stockitemfk      
    left outer join (    
     Select users.UserPK, FirstName + ' ' + LastName as PersonName    
     from tblPeople as people    
     inner join tblUsers as users on users.PersonFK = people.PersonPK) as createdbyuser on createdbyuser.UserPK = pa.updatedby      
    where pa.EventTypeFK = 36      
    
    -- Pallet Added to Pick    
    INSERT INTO #finalResults     
    (    
     EventType,     
     EventDate,     
     Eventuser,      
     Units,     
     [Description],    
     StockItem,     
     Barcode,     
     CustomerPalletNumber,     
     EventOrder,    
     scanned    
    )    
    select distinct 'Pallet Added To Pick' as EventType,     
    pa.EventDate as EventDate,     
    case when createdbyuser.PersonName is null then 'System' else createdbyuser.PersonName end as Eventuser,    
     'Full QTY'  as Units, 'Pallet Added - To Stock Out : ' + co.GoodsOrderNumber     
     + case when pc.Batch <> '' and pc.Batch <> 'NA' then ', Batch: ' + pc.batch  else '' end    
     + case when pc.supplierBatch <> '' and pc.supplierBatch <> 'NA' then ', supplier Batch: ' + pc.supplierBatch  else '' end    
    as Description,     
    s.stockitemcode + ' - ' + s.description as StockItem, case when p.CustomerBarcode <> '' then p.CustomerBarcode else p.Barcode END AS Barcode, p.CustomerPalletNumber,    
    2 as EventOrder,0 as scanned        
    from #TempPalletAudit as pa      
    inner join #TempPallets as p on palletpk = palletfk     
    inner join tblpalletcontent as pc on pc.palletfk = p.PalletPK    
    inner join tblcontainerouts as co on containeroutpk = eventfk        
    inner join tblstockitems as s on s.stockitempk = pa.stockitemfk      
    left outer join (    
     Select users.UserPK, FirstName + ' ' + LastName as PersonName    
     from tblPeople as people    
     inner join tblUsers as users on users.PersonFK = people.PersonPK) createdbyuser on createdbyuser.UserPK = pa.updatedby      
    where pa.EventTypeFK = 35    
       
    -- physical checks    
    INSERT INTO #finalResults     
    (    
     EventType,     
     EventDate,     
     Eventuser,      
     Units,     
     [Description],    
     StockItem,     
     Barcode,     
     EventOrder,    
     scanned    
    )    
    select distinct 'Physical Check' as EventType, WOPR.InsertedDate as EventDate,    
     resultUser.PersonName as EventUser, 'Full QTY' as Units,    
     case when wop.ResponsibleUserFK <> -1 and wop.ResponsibleUserFK <> WOPR.InsertedBy then    
      'Check completed by ' + resultUser.PersonName + ' on behalf of ' + responsiblepalletUser.PersonName    
      when wo.ResponsibleUserFK <> -1 and wo.ResponsibleUserFK <> WOPR.InsertedBy then    
      'Check completed by ' + resultUser.PersonName + ' on behalf of ' + responsibleworkUser.PersonName    
     else 'Check completed by ' + resultUser.PersonName end    
     + ', Result : ' + case when palletaccepted = 1 then 'Pallet Accepted' else 'Pallet Rejected' end as [Description],    
     s.StockItemCode as StockItem, coalesce(p.customerbarcode, p.barcode) as Barcode, 7 as EventOrder,    
     case when wop.ResponsibleUserFK <> -1 and wop.ResponsibleUserFK <> WOPR.InsertedBy then    
      0    
      when wo.ResponsibleUserFK <> -1 and wo.ResponsibleUserFK <> WOPR.InsertedBy then    
      0    
     else 1 end as Scanned    
    FROM TblWorksOrderPalletResult wopr    
    INNER JOIN #TempWorksOrderPallets wop on worksorderpalletfk = worksorderpalletpk    
    left join tblworksorders wo on worksorderfk = worksorderpk    
    inner join #TempPallets p on palletfk = palletpk    
    left outer join (    
     Select users.UserPK, FirstName + ' ' + LastName as PersonName    
     from tblPeople as people    
     inner join tblUsers as users on users.PersonFK = people.PersonPK) resultUser on resultUser.UserPK = wopr.InsertedBy         
    left outer join (    
     Select users.UserPK, FirstName + ' ' + LastName as PersonName    
     from tblPeople as people    
     inner join tblUsers as users on users.PersonFK = people.PersonPK) responsiblepalletUser on responsiblepalletUser.UserPK = wop.ResponsibleUserFK         
    left outer join (    
     Select users.UserPK, FirstName + ' ' + LastName as PersonName    
     from tblPeople as people    
     inner join tblUsers as users on users.PersonFK = people.PersonPK) responsibleworkUser on responsibleworkUser.UserPK = wo.ResponsibleUserFK      
    inner join tblpalletcontent pc on pc.palletfk = p.palletpk    
    inner join tblstockitems s on stockitemfk = stockitempk    
    WHERE wopr.PalletAccepted >= 0--ignore -1 results ... these are for resetting the same check to happen again    
    
    -- relabelling    
    INSERT INTO #finalResults     
    (    
     EventType,     
     EventDate,     
     Eventuser,      
     Units,     
     [Description],    
     StockItem,     
     Barcode,     
     EventOrder,    
     scanned    
    )    
    select distinct 'Pallet relabelled' as EventType, WOP.UpdatedDate as EventDate,    
     resultUser.PersonName as EventUser, 'Full QTY' as Units,    
     case when wop.ResponsibleUserFK <> -1 then    
      'Pallet Relabelling assigned by ' + resultUser.PersonName + ' and completed by ' + responsiblepalletUser.PersonName    
      when wo.ResponsibleUserFK <> -1 then    
      'Pallet Relabelling assigned by ' + resultUser.PersonName + ' and completed by ' + responsibleworkUser.PersonName    
     else 'Pallet Relabelling completed by ' + resultUser.PersonName end as [Description],    
     s.StockItemCode as StockItem, coalesce(p.customerbarcode, p.barcode) as Barcode, 7 as EventOrder,    
     0 as Scanned    
    FROM  #TempWorksOrderPallets wop     
    Inner join tblworksorders wo on worksorderfk = worksorderpk    
    inner join #TempPallets p on palletfk = palletpk    
    left outer join (    
     Select users.UserPK, FirstName + ' ' + LastName as PersonName    
     from tblPeople as people    
     inner join tblUsers as users on users.PersonFK = people.PersonPK) resultUser on resultUser.UserPK = wop.UpdatedBy    
    left outer join (    
     Select users.UserPK, FirstName + ' ' + LastName as PersonName    
     from tblPeople as people    
     inner join tblUsers as users on users.PersonFK = people.PersonPK) responsiblepalletUser on responsiblepalletUser.UserPK = wop.ResponsibleUserFK         
    left outer join (    
     Select users.UserPK, FirstName + ' ' + LastName as PersonName    
     from tblPeople as people    
     inner join tblUsers as users on users.PersonFK = people.PersonPK) responsibleworkUser on responsibleworkUser.UserPK = wo.ResponsibleUserFK      
    inner join tblpalletcontent pc on pc.palletfk = p.palletpk    
    inner join tblstockitems s on stockitemfk = stockitempk    
    WHERE wO.WorksOrderTypeFK = 5--ignore -1 results ... these are for resetting the same check to happen again    
    
   end    
  
  
      ---CYCLECOUNT-----  
  
    INSERT INTO #finalResults     
    (    
     EventType,     
     EventDate,     
     Eventuser,      
     Units,     
     [Description],    
     StockItem,     
     Barcode,     
     CustomerPalletNumber,    
     EventOrder,    
     scanned    
    )    
    select 'Stock Moved' as Eventtype, pa.EventDate as EventDate, case when createdbyuser.PersonName is null then 'System' else createdbyuser.PersonName end as Eventuser, convert(nvarchar(255),wom.units) as Units,     
--    CASE     
--     WHEN wom.sourcelocationtypefk = 4 then 'Pallet Unloaded, batch ' + pa.batch + ' to ' + DestinationBuilding.Building + ': ' + DestinationLocation.LocationDescription    
--     ELSE 'Moved pallet, batch ' + pa.batch + ' from ' + coalesce(SourceBuilding.Building + ': ' + SourceLocation.LocationDescription, 'Invalid Location') + ' to ' +  coalesce(DestinationBuilding.Building + ': ' + DestinationLocation.LocationDescription,   
--'Invalid Location') END    
'CycleCount Movement'  
    as [description],    
    s.stockitemcode + ' - ' + s.description as StockItem, case when p.CustomerBarcode <> '' then p.CustomerBarcode else p.Barcode END AS Barcode, p.CustomerPalletNumber, 4 as EventOrder,     
  1 as scanned    
    from #TempMovements as wom    
    inner join tblworksorders as wo on wo.worksorderpk = wom.worksorderfk    
    inner join #TempPalletAudit as pa on pa.eventfk = wom.worksordermovementpk and pa.eventtypefk =12    
    inner join #TempStockItem as s on s.stockitempk = pa.stockitemfk    
    inner join #TempPallets as p on p.palletpk = pa.palletfk    
    left outer join (    
     Select users.UserPK, FirstName + ' ' + LastName as PersonName    
     from tblPeople people    
     inner join tblUsers as users on users.PersonFK = people.PersonPK    
    ) as createdbyuser ON createdbyuser.UserPK = (CASE WHEN wom.ResponsibleUserFK > 0 THEN wom.ResponsibleUserFK else /*wom*/pa.updatedby end)    
      
     
    INNER JOIN #TempPallets AS tp    
    ON wom.palletfk = tp.PalletPK    
    
    where @var_IncludeMovements = 1    
    and wom.worksorderstatusfk = 3    
       
   ---PalletBarcodeCompareHistory-----
   print 'PalletBarcodeCompareHistory start'
    INSERT INTO #finalResults     
    (    
     EventType,     
     EventDate,     
     Eventuser,      
     Units,     
     [Description],    
     StockItem,     
     Barcode,     
     CustomerPalletNumber,    
     EventOrder,    
     scanned    
    )    
    select 'Barcode Compared' as Eventtype, bch.InsertedDate as EventDate, case when createdbyuser.PersonName is null then 'System' else createdbyuser.PersonName end as Eventuser, convert(nvarchar(255),wom.units) as Units,     
--    CASE     
--     WHEN wom.sourcelocationtypefk = 4 then 'Pallet Unloaded, batch ' + pa.batch + ' to ' + DestinationBuilding.Building + ': ' + DestinationLocation.LocationDescription    
--     ELSE 'Moved pallet, batch ' + pa.batch + ' from ' + coalesce(SourceBuilding.Building + ': ' + SourceLocation.LocationDescription, 'Invalid Location') + ' to ' +  coalesce(DestinationBuilding.Building + ': ' + DestinationLocation.LocationDescription,   
--'Invalid Location') END    
'Barcode Compared'  
    as [description],    
    s.stockitemcode + ' - ' + s.description as StockItem, case when p.CustomerBarcode <> '' then p.CustomerBarcode else p.Barcode END AS Barcode, p.CustomerPalletNumber, 4 as EventOrder,     
  1 as scanned    
    from #TempMovements as wom    
    inner join tblworksorders as wo on wo.worksorderpk = wom.worksorderfk    
    inner join #TempPalletAudit as pa on pa.eventfk = wom.worksordermovementpk --and pa.eventtypefk =12    
    inner join #TempStockItem as s on s.stockitempk = pa.stockitemfk 
	
    inner join #TempPallets as p on p.palletpk = pa.palletfk 
	inner join tblMobstaBarcodecompareHistory bch on  bch.palletfk = p.PalletPK    
    left outer join (    
     Select users.UserPK, FirstName + ' ' + LastName as PersonName    
     from tblPeople people    
     inner join tblUsers as users on users.PersonFK = people.PersonPK    
    ) as createdbyuser ON createdbyuser.UserPK =bch.updatedby-- (CASE WHEN wom.ResponsibleUserFK > 0 THEN wom.ResponsibleUserFK else /*wom*/pa.updatedby end)    
      
     
    INNER JOIN #TempPallets AS tp    
    ON wom.palletfk = tp.PalletPK    
     
    --where @var_IncludeMovements = 1    
    --and wom.worksorderstatusfk = 3    
	 print 'PalletBarcodeCompareHistory end'
   -- ---------------------------------------    
   -- Return the final results to the report    
   -- ---------------------------------------    
    
   --get the last stock code (regrades mean there isnt one unique material so need to  figure out the correct one to use in header    
   DECLARE @materialToUse nvarchar(200)    
   set @materialToUse = (SELECT TOP 1 stockitem FROM #finalResults ORDER BY eventdate desc)    
    
    
   select DISTINCT EventType,convert(datetime, convert(char(19), eventdate, 126)) AS [eventdate],Eventuser,Units,[Description], @materialToUse [StockItem],Barcode,CustomerPalletNumber,EventOrder,scanned from #finalResults     
   order by convert(datetime, convert(char(19), eventdate, 126)),EventOrder    
    
   -- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end    
    
   BREAK    
  END TRY    
  BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */    
   DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;    
   SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;    
   SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;    
    
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY     
   BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;    
           
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;    
    
            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID    
                
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;    
                
   IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)    
   BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END    
   ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */    
  END CATCH    
  SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1    
 END    
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spReportsPGICheck]
@days int  
 
AS
BEGIN
    -- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from
    -- interfering with SELECT statements.
    SET NOCOUNT ON
	 

	 

IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#PGI') IS NOT NULL
 begin
DROP TABLE #PGI
 end
 DECLARE @totalloadsforduration AS decimal

 SELECT * into #PGI from(
	SELECT 
		 ReleaseCheckWatcherPK,	
		 GlanbiaReference,
		 ContaineroutPK, 
		 GoodsOrderNumber,
		 LastPalletLoadedTimeStamp,
		 PGIFileReturnTime,		
		 PGIImportedTime,
		 
		 CASE WHEN    DATEDIFF(Minute, [LastPalletLoadedTimeStamp]  ,[PGIImportedTime]  ) IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE DATEDIFF(Minute, [LastPalletLoadedTimeStamp]  ,[PGIImportedTime]  ) END AS [LastPalletLoaded To PGIImported],
		 CASE WHEN	 DATEDIFF(Minute, [GoodsIssueFileCreated] , [PGIFileReturnTime] ) IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE DATEDIFF(Minute, [GoodsIssueFileCreated] , [PGIFileReturnTime] ) end AS [GoodsIssueFileCreated To PGIFileReturn],
		 CASE WHEN	 DATEDIFF(Minute, [LastPalletLoadedTimeStamp], [GoodsIssueFileCreated]  )IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE  DATEDIFF(Minute, [LastPalletLoadedTimeStamp], [GoodsIssueFileCreated]  )  end AS [LastPalletLoaded To GoodsIssueFileCreated] ,
 		 CASE WHEN	 DATEDIFF(Minute, [PGIFileReturnTime], [PGIImportedTime]   )IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE  DATEDIFF(Minute, [PGIFileReturnTime], [PGIImportedTime]  )  end AS [PGIFileReturnTime To PGIImportedTime] 

 FROM  [dbo].[tblReleaseCheckWatcher]
 WHERE  
	 
   --[LastPalletLoadedTimeStamp]>'2016-01-01 00:01:00.000' 
    LastPalletLoadedTimeStamp> dbo.GetBSTDate()-@days--variable here
   AND DATEDIFF(Minute, [LastPalletLoadedTimeStamp]  ,[PGIImportedTime]  )>=0
 
) AS x

 
set @totalloadsforduration=(SELECT count([ReleaseCheckWatcherPK]) FROM #PGI) 

  IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#PGI2') IS NOT NULL
 begin
DROP TABLE #PGI2
 end
 
 
 

select * into #PGI2 from( 
 
	 SELECT 1 as[OrderIndex],'Last Pallet loaded to  PGI Import'AS [Process Segment],'Less than 30 minutes:'AS [Timescale], avg( [LastPalletLoaded To PGIImported])as[Average Minutes] ,
		(SELECT count([ReleaseCheckWatcherPK]) FROM #PGI)AS [Total Number of Loads Checked],  count([ReleaseCheckWatcherPK])AS [Count],
		cast(((SELECT count([ReleaseCheckWatcherPK]) FROM #PGI  
	     WHERE    [LastPalletLoaded To PGIImported] >=0 and  [LastPalletLoaded To PGIImported] <=30 ) *100/@totalloadsforduration) AS numeric(10,1))  as[%], 
		'Store-All  & Glanbia'as[Processing Party] FROM #PGI  WHERE  [LastPalletLoaded To PGIImported] >=0 and  [LastPalletLoaded To PGIImported] <=30  
	union
	SELECT 2 as[OrderIndex], 'Last Pallet loaded to  PGI Import'AS [Process Segment], 'Greater than 60 minutes: 'AS [Timescale],avg( [LastPalletLoaded To PGIImported])as[Average Minutes],
		(SELECT count([ReleaseCheckWatcherPK]) FROM #PGI)AS [Total Number of Loads Checked],   count([ReleaseCheckWatcherPK])AS [Count],
		cast(((SELECT count([ReleaseCheckWatcherPK]) FROM #PGI  
		  WHERE    [LastPalletLoaded To PGIImported]>60 ) *100/@totalloadsforduration) AS numeric(10,1))as[%],
		 'Store-All & Glanbia' as[Processing Party]FROM #PGI  WHERE [LastPalletLoaded To PGIImported]>60--30-60
	union
	SELECT 3 as[OrderIndex],'Last Pallet loaded to  PGI Import'AS [Process Segment] ,'Between 60 & 30 minutes:'AS [Timescale],avg( [LastPalletLoaded To PGIImported])as[Average Minutes],
		 (SELECT count([ReleaseCheckWatcherPK]) FROM #PGI)AS [Total Number of Loads Checked], count([ReleaseCheckWatcherPK])AS [Count],
		 cast(((SELECT count([ReleaseCheckWatcherPK])FROM #PGI  
		 WHERE  [LastPalletLoaded To PGIImported] > 30 and [LastPalletLoaded To PGIImported] <=60)*100/@totalloadsforduration) AS numeric(10,1)) as[%], 
		 'Store-All & Glanbia'as[Processing Party] FROM #PGI  WHERE [LastPalletLoaded To PGIImported] > 30 and [LastPalletLoaded To PGIImported] <=60 
	union

	SELECT 4 as[OrderIndex],'Last Pallet Loaded to  Goods issue Created' as [Process Segment],'Less than 30 minutes:'AS [Timescale], 
		CASE WHEN avg([LastPalletLoaded To GoodsIssueFileCreated])  is not null then avg([LastPalletLoaded To GoodsIssueFileCreated])else 0 end as[Average Minutes]  ,
		(SELECT count([ReleaseCheckWatcherPK]) FROM #PGI)AS [Total Number of Loads Checked],  count([ReleaseCheckWatcherPK])AS [Count],
		 cast(((SELECT count([ReleaseCheckWatcherPK])AS [Number of Loads] FROM #PGI  WHERE  [LastPalletLoaded To GoodsIssueFileCreated] <30 and [LastPalletLoaded To GoodsIssueFileCreated] >=0)*100/@totalloadsforduration) AS numeric(10,1)) as[%],
		'Store-All'as[Processing Party] FROM #PGI  WHERE [LastPalletLoaded To GoodsIssueFileCreated]<30  AND [LastPalletLoaded To GoodsIssueFileCreated]>=0 
	 union
	SELECT 5 as[OrderIndex],'Last Pallet Loaded to  Goods issue Created'  as [Process Segment], 'Greater than 60 minutes: 'AS [Timescale],
		CASE WHEN avg([LastPalletLoaded To GoodsIssueFileCreated])  is not null then avg([LastPalletLoaded To GoodsIssueFileCreated])else 0 end as[Average Minutes]  ,
		(SELECT count([ReleaseCheckWatcherPK]) FROM #PGI)AS [Total Number of Loads Checked], count([ReleaseCheckWatcherPK]) AS [Count],
		 cast(((SELECT count([ReleaseCheckWatcherPK])AS [Number of Loads] FROM #PGI  WHERE   [LastPalletLoaded To GoodsIssueFileCreated] >60)*100/@totalloadsforduration) AS numeric(10,1)) as[%],
		'Store-All'as[Processing Party] FROM #PGI  WHERE [LastPalletLoaded To GoodsIssueFileCreated]>60 
	 union
	SELECT 6 as[OrderIndex], 'Last Pallet Loaded to  Goods issue Created'  as [Process Segment],'Between 60 & 30 minutes:' AS [Timescale],
		CASE WHEN avg([LastPalletLoaded To GoodsIssueFileCreated])  is not null then avg([LastPalletLoaded To GoodsIssueFileCreated])else 0 end as[Average Minutes]  ,
		(SELECT count([ReleaseCheckWatcherPK]) FROM #PGI)AS [Total Number of Loads Checked],  count([ReleaseCheckWatcherPK])AS [Count],
		 cast(((SELECT count([ReleaseCheckWatcherPK])AS [Number of Loads] FROM #PGI  WHERE  [LastPalletLoaded To GoodsIssueFileCreated] > 30 and [LastPalletLoaded To GoodsIssueFileCreated] <=60)*100/@totalloadsforduration) AS numeric(10,1)) as[%],
		'Store-All' as [Processing Party]FROM #PGI  WHERE [LastPalletLoaded To GoodsIssueFileCreated]>=30 AND [LastPalletLoaded To GoodsIssueFileCreated]<=60
			 
			 
	union
    SELECT 7 as[OrderIndex],'Goods Issue Created to PGI Return' as [Process Segment],'Less than 30 minutes:'AS [Timescale], avg([GoodsIssueFileCreated To PGIFileReturn])as[Average Minutes] ,
		(SELECT count([ReleaseCheckWatcherPK]) FROM #PGI)AS [Total Number of Loads Checked],   count([ReleaseCheckWatcherPK])AS [Count],
		 cast(((SELECT count([ReleaseCheckWatcherPK])AS [Number of Loads] FROM #PGI  WHERE  [GoodsIssueFileCreated To PGIFileReturn] < 30 and [GoodsIssueFileCreated To PGIFileReturn]  >=0)*100/@totalloadsforduration) AS numeric(10,1)) as[%],
		 'Glanbia' as[Processing Party] FROM #PGI  WHERE [GoodsIssueFileCreated To PGIFileReturn]<=30  AND [GoodsIssueFileCreated To PGIFileReturn]>=0 
	union
	SELECT 8 as[OrderIndex],'Goods Issue Created to PGI Return' as [Process Segment], 'Greater than 60 minutes: 'AS [Timescale],avg([GoodsIssueFileCreated To PGIFileReturn])as[Average Minutes],
		(SELECT count([ReleaseCheckWatcherPK]) FROM #PGI)AS [Total Number of Loads Checked],  count([ReleaseCheckWatcherPK]) AS [Count],
		 cast(((SELECT count([ReleaseCheckWatcherPK])AS [Number of Loads] FROM #PGI  WHERE   [GoodsIssueFileCreated To PGIFileReturn]  >60)*100/@totalloadsforduration) AS numeric(10,1)) as[%],
		'Glanbia' as[Processing Party]FROM #PGI  WHERE [GoodsIssueFileCreated To PGIFileReturn]>60 
	union
	SELECT 9 as[OrderIndex],'Goods Issue Created to PGI Return'AS [Process Segment] ,'Between 60 & 30 minutes:'AS [Timescale],avg( [GoodsIssueFileCreated To PGIFileReturn])as[Average Minutes],
		(SELECT count([ReleaseCheckWatcherPK]) FROM #PGI)AS [Total Number of Loads Checked],  count([ReleaseCheckWatcherPK])AS [Count],
		 cast(((SELECT count([ReleaseCheckWatcherPK])AS [Number of Loads] FROM #PGI  WHERE  [GoodsIssueFileCreated To PGIFileReturn] > 30 and [GoodsIssueFileCreated To PGIFileReturn]  <=60)*100/@totalloadsforduration) AS numeric(10,1)) as[%],
		 'Glanbia'as[Processing Party] FROM #PGI  WHERE[GoodsIssueFileCreated To PGIFileReturn] > 30 and [GoodsIssueFileCreated To PGIFileReturn] <=60--60 /* 
		 union 

	SELECT 10 as[OrderIndex],'PGI File ReturnTo PGI Imported' as [Process Segment],'Less than 30 minutes:'AS [Timescale], 
		CASE WHEN avg([PGIFileReturnTime To PGIImportedTime])  is not null then avg([PGIFileReturnTime To PGIImportedTime])else 0 end as[Average Minutes]  ,
		(SELECT count([ReleaseCheckWatcherPK]) FROM #PGI)AS [Total Number of Loads Checked],  count([ReleaseCheckWatcherPK])AS [Count],
		 cast(((SELECT count([ReleaseCheckWatcherPK])AS [Number of Loads] FROM #PGI  WHERE  [PGIFileReturnTime To PGIImportedTime] < 30 and [PGIFileReturnTime To PGIImportedTime]>=0)*100/@totalloadsforduration) AS numeric(10,1)) as[%],
		'Store-All'as[Processing Party] FROM #PGI  WHERE [PGIFileReturnTime To PGIImportedTime]<30  AND [PGIFileReturnTime To PGIImportedTime]>=0 
	 union
	SELECT 11 as[OrderIndex],'PGI File ReturnTo PGI Imported' as [Process Segment], 'Greater than 60 minutes: 'AS [Timescale],
		CASE WHEN avg([PGIFileReturnTime To PGIImportedTime])  is not null then avg([PGIFileReturnTime To PGIImportedTime])else 0 end as[Average Minutes]  ,
		(SELECT count([ReleaseCheckWatcherPK]) FROM #PGI)AS [Total Number of Loads Checked], count([ReleaseCheckWatcherPK]) AS [Count],
		 cast(((SELECT count([ReleaseCheckWatcherPK])AS [Number of Loads] FROM #PGI  WHERE   [PGIFileReturnTime To PGIImportedTime] >60)*100/@totalloadsforduration) AS numeric(10,1)) as[%],
		'Store-All'as[Processing Party] FROM #PGI  WHERE [PGIFileReturnTime To PGIImportedTime]>60 
	 union
	SELECT 12 as[OrderIndex], 'PGI File ReturnTo PGI Imported' as [Process Segment],'Between 60 & 30 minutes:' AS [Timescale],
		CASE WHEN avg([PGIFileReturnTime To PGIImportedTime])  is not null then avg([PGIFileReturnTime To PGIImportedTime])else 0 end as[Average Minutes]  ,
		(SELECT count([ReleaseCheckWatcherPK]) FROM #PGI)AS [Total Number of Loads Checked],  count([ReleaseCheckWatcherPK])AS [Count],
		 cast(((SELECT count([ReleaseCheckWatcherPK])AS [Number of Loads] FROM #PGI  WHERE [PGIFileReturnTime To PGIImportedTime] > 30 and [PGIFileReturnTime To PGIImportedTime] <=60)*100/@totalloadsforduration) AS numeric(10,1)) as[%],
		'Store-All' as [Processing Party]FROM #PGI  WHERE [PGIFileReturnTime To PGIImportedTime]>=30 AND [PGIFileReturnTime To PGIImportedTime]<=60

 

 ) as z



SELECT * FROM #PGI--Data WorkSheet in Excel file 

select 
	[Process Segment] ,
	[Timescale] ,
	[Average Minutes] ,
	[Total Number of Loads Checked] ,
	[Count]  ,
	[%]  ,
	[Processing Party] 
 from #PGI2  --Summary WorkSheet in Excel file 
 
    
  
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spReportsPGITimelogs]
(
	@fromdate datetime, 
	@todate datetime,
	@customerfk int 
)	
AS
BEGIN	
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data; Ensure this proc has a low impact when executed */
    
	drop table if exists #tmptircontainers
	select distinct co.* into #tmptircontainers 
	from tblcontainerouts co 
	inner join tblcontaineroutlines col on containeroutfk = ContainerOutPK 
	inner join tbldivisions d on col.divisionfk = d.divisionpk
	where customerfk = @customerfk and ContainerOutStatusFK = 5 
		and cast(collectiondate as date) >= @fromdate and cast(collectiondate as date) <= @todate

	select distinct GoodsOrderNumber, RequireReleaseCheck, CollectionDate, so.PickLoadedDate, rc.inserteddate as ReleaseCheckDate, DATEDIFF(minute, so.PickLoadedDate, rc.inserteddate) MinsForResponse, DATEDIFF(minute, so.PickLoadedDate, rc.inserteddate) / 10 as NoIntegrationCycles 
	from #tmptircontainers co
	inner join tblstockorders so on co.ContainerOutPK = so.ContainerOutFK
	left join tblContainerOutReleaseChecks rc on rc.ContainerOutFK = co.ContainerOutPK
	order by CollectionDate desc
END

GO

-- =============================================
-- Author:		DeVille
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spReportsPurchaseOrder]
(
	@purchaseOrderPK int
)	
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data; Ensure this proc has a low impact when executed */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED; SET DEADLOCK_PRIORITY LOW

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT
	,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;
	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	DECLARE @var_purchaseOrderPK int
	SET @var_purchaseOrderPK = @purchaseOrderPK
	SET @ParameterDetails = '@purchaseOrderPK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_purchaseOrderPK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'')

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    --BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

		SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END


	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY
			

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start

			Select 
				PurchaseOrderPK, Supplier, DepartmentCode + ' - ' + DepartmentName as [Department], CustomerName, people.FirstName 
				+ ' ' + people.Lastname [EnteredBy], PurchaseOrderStatusFK, LabourDescription, GoodsDescription, OtherDescription, LabourPrice, 
				GoodsPrice, OtherPrice, LabourConfirmedPrice, GoodsConfirmedPrice, OtherConfirmedPrice, PurchaseOrderDate, ExternallyCharged, 
				InvoiceNumber, LabourCompleted, GoodsReceived, OtherCompleted, LabourTimeTaken, GoodsReceivedDocketNumber, TotalCost, 
				StoreAllInvoiceNumber, StoreAllCharge, Comments
			From 
				tblPurchaseOrders pos
			left outer join tblSuppliers sups on
				sups.SupplierPK = pos.SupplierFK

			left outer join tblDepartments deps on
				deps.DepartmentPK = pos.DepartmentFK

			left outer join tblCustomers cus on
				cus.CustomerPK = pos.CustomerFK

			left outer join tblUsers users on
				users.UserPK = pos.UserFK

			left outer join tblPeople people on
				people.PersonPK = users.PersonFK
			where 
				pos.PurchaseOrderPK = @var_purchaseOrderPK
	
			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end

			
			
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END
GO
