	SET @ParameterDetails = '@worksOrderFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_worksOrderFK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@userFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_userFK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'')

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    --BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

		SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END

	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY
			
			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start

			Declare @myUser nvarchar(300)
			Select @myUser = FirstName + ' ' + LastName from tblUsers users 
			inner join tblPeople people on
			people.PersonPK = users.PersonFK
			Where UserPK = @var_userFK 

			DECLARE @FK int, @worksOrderOriginFK int
			Declare @identificationNumber nvarchar(200)

			Select @worksOrderOriginFK = WorksOrderOriginFK, @FK = FK from tblWorksOrders where WorksOrderPK = @var_worksOrderFK

			if(@worksOrderOriginFK = 1)/*StockIn*/ 
			BEGIN
				Select @identificationNumber = cIns.GoodsInNumber from tblContainerIns cIns
				inner join tblStockIns sins on
				sins.ContainerInFK = cIns.ContainerInPK
				Where StockInPK = @FK
			END ELSE IF(@worksOrderOriginFK = 2)/*StockOrder*/ 
			BEGIN
				Select @identificationNumber = cOuts.GoodsOrderNumber from tblContainerOuts cOuts
				inner join tblStockOrders sos on
				sos.ContainerOutFK = cOuts.ContainerOutPK
				Where StockOrderPK = @FK
			END

			IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#tblResultingPallets') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #tblResultingPallets

			CREATE TABLE #tblResultingPallets
			(
				WorkReason nvarchar(500),
				Barcode nvarchar(200),
				PalletContentFK int,
				StockItemCode nvarchar(200),
				Batch nvarchar(200), 
				Quantity decimal(18,3),
				EachType nvarchar(100),
				UnitType nvarchar(100) 
			)

			Declare @palletContentFK int, @sourceBarcode nvarchar(200), @destinationBarcode nvarchar(200), @units decimal(18,3)

			IF(@worksOrderOriginFK = 1) 
			BEGIN
				Insert into #tblResultingPallets
				Select 'Split Pallets', pallets.Barcode, pc.PalletContentPK, sis.StockItemCode, pc.Batch, pc.ActualUnits , 
				isnull(ets.EachesType, ''), isnull(uts.UnitType, '')
				from tblWorksOrderPallets wops
				inner join tblPallets pallets on
				pallets.PalletPK = wops.PalletFK
				inner join tblPalletContent pc on
				pc.PalletFK = pallets.PalletPK
				inner join tblStockItems sis on
				sis.StockItemPK = pc.StockItemFK
				left outer join tblEachesTypes ets on
				ets.EachesTypePK = sis.EachesTypeFK
				left outer join tblUnitTypes uts on
				uts.UnitTypePK = sis.UnitTypeFK
				Where WorksOrderFK = @var_worksOrderFK and pc.PalletContentPK not in (Select PalletContentFK from tblStockInDamages)

				Insert into #tblResultingPallets
				Select 'Damaged Stock', pallets.Barcode, pc.PalletContentPK, sis.StockItemCode, pc.Batch, pc.ActualUnits , 
				isnull(ets.EachesType, ''), isnull(uts.UnitType, '')
				from tblWorksOrderPallets wops
				inner join tblPallets pallets on
				pallets.PalletPK = wops.PalletFK
				inner join tblPalletContent pc on
				pc.PalletFK = pallets.PalletPK
				inner join tblStockItems sis on
				sis.StockItemPK = pc.StockItemFK
				left outer join tblEachesTypes ets on
				ets.EachesTypePK = sis.EachesTypeFK
				left outer join tblUnitTypes uts on
				uts.UnitTypePK = sis.UnitTypeFK
				Where WorksOrderFK = @var_worksOrderFK and pc.PalletContentPK in (Select PalletContentFK from tblStockInDamages)

				DECLARE instructionCursor CURSOR FAST_FORWARD FOR
					Select wopis.PalletContentFK, wopis.DestinationBarcode from tblWorksOrderPallets wops
					inner join tblWorksOrderPalletInstructions wopis on
					wopis.WorksOrderPalletFK = wops.WorksOrderPalletPK
					AND wopis.InstructionTypeFK = 3
					Where WorksOrderFK = @var_worksOrderFK
					order by WorksOrderPalletInstructionPK
				OPEN instructionCursor
				FETCH NEXT FROM instructionCursor INTO @palletContentFK, @sourceBarcode

				WHILE (@@FETCH_STATUS = 0) BEGIN
					update #tblResultingPallets 
					Set Barcode = @sourceBarcode
					Where PalletContentFK = @palletContentFK
				FETCH NEXT FROM instructionCursor INTO @palletContentFK, @sourceBarcode
				END

				CLOSE instructionCursor
				DEALLOCATE instructionCursor

				Select @myUser as IssuedBy, case when @identificationNumber is not null then case when @worksOrderOriginFK = 1 then 
				'GI Number: ' when @worksOrderOriginFK = 2 then 'GO Number: ' end + @identificationNumber else '' end WorkOriginator, * from (
				Select WorkReason, resPallets.Barcode, StockItemCode, Batch, (sum(Quantity) + isnull(remainingPallets.Units, 0)) Units, 
				cast(isnull(remainingPallets.Eaches, 0) + Count(*) as nvarchar(50)) + ' ' + EachType as [Eaches] 
				from #tblResultingPallets resPallets
				left outer join (
					Select PalletPK, pallets.Barcode, Sum(ActualUnits) Units, count(*) Eaches
					from tblPallets pallets
					inner join tblPalletContent pc on
					pc.PalletFK = pallets.PalletPK
					group By PalletPK, pallets.Barcode 
				) remainingPallets on
				remainingPallets.PalletPK not in (Select PalletFK from tblWorksOrderPallets wops 
					inner join tblWorksOrders wos on
					wos.WorksOrderPK = wops.WorksOrderFK
					Where WorksOrderTypeFK = 1/*Split*/)
				AND remainingPallets.Barcode = resPallets.Barcode
				Group By WorkReason, resPallets.Barcode, StockItemCode, Batch, EachType, remainingPallets.Units, remainingPallets.Eaches

				UNION

				Select 'Remaining Pallets' WorkReason, pallets.Barcode, sis.StockItemCode, pc.Batch, pc.ActualUnits Units , 
				cast(pc.Eaches as nvarchar(50)) + ' ' + isnull(ets.EachesType, '')  as [Eaches]/*, isnull(uts.UnitType, '')*/
				from tblStockInLines sils 
				inner join tblStockInLinePallets silps on
				silps.StockInLineFK = sils.StockInLinePK
				inner join tblPallets pallets on
				pallets.PalletPK = silps.PalletFK
				inner join (
					Select PalletFK, StockItemFK, Batch,count(*) Eaches, Sum(ActualUnits)ActualUnits
					from tblPalletContent 
					group By PalletFK, StockItemFK, Batch
				)pc on
				pc.PalletFK = pallets.PalletPK
				inner join tblStockItems sis on
				sis.StockItemPK = pc.StockItemFK
				left outer join tblEachesTypes ets on
				ets.EachesTypePK = sis.EachesTypeFK
				left outer join tblUnitTypes uts on
				uts.UnitTypePK = sis.UnitTypeFK
				Where sils.StockInFK = @FK AND pallets.PalletPK not in 
					(Select PalletFK from tblWorksOrderPallets wops 
					inner join tblWorksOrders wos on
					wos.WorksOrderPK = wops.WorksOrderFK
					Where WorksOrderTypeFK = 1/*Split*/)
					AND pallets.Barcode not in (Select Barcode from #tblResultingPallets)
				Group By pallets.Barcode, StockItemCode, pc.Batch, EachesType, pc.ActualUnits, pc.Eaches
				) subQ

				Order By CASE WorkReason
					  WHEN 'Damaged Stock' THEN 1
					  WHEN 'Split Pallets' THEN 2
					  WHEN 'Remaining Pallets' THEN 3
				   END, StockItemCode ASC, BAtch ASC

			END 
			ELSE IF (@worksOrderOriginFK = 2) 
			BEGIN /*Stock Out*/
				Insert into #tblResultingPallets
				Select 'Split Pallets', pallets.Barcode, pc.PalletContentPK, sis.StockItemCode, pc.Batch, pc.ActualUnits , 
				isnull(ets.EachesType, ''), isnull(uts.UnitType, '')
				from tblWorksOrderPallets wops
				inner join tblPallets pallets on
				pallets.PalletPK = wops.PalletFK
				inner join tblPalletContent pc on
				pc.PalletFK = pallets.PalletPK
				inner join tblStockItems sis on
				sis.StockItemPK = pc.StockItemFK
				left outer join tblEachesTypes ets on
				ets.EachesTypePK = sis.EachesTypeFK
				left outer join tblUnitTypes uts on
				uts.UnitTypePK = sis.UnitTypeFK
				Where WorksOrderFK = @var_worksOrderFK 

				/*ADD THE CREATED PALLETS*/
				DECLARE instructionCursor CURSOR FAST_FORWARD FOR
					Select wopis.PalletContentFK, wopis.DestinationBarcode from tblWorksOrderPallets wops
					inner join tblWorksOrderPalletInstructions wopis on
					wopis.WorksOrderPalletFK = wops.WorksOrderPalletPK
					AND wopis.InstructionTypeFK = 1
					Where WorksOrderFK = @var_worksOrderFK
					order by WorksOrderPalletInstructionPK
				OPEN instructionCursor
				FETCH NEXT FROM instructionCursor INTO @palletContentFK, @destinationBarcode

				WHILE (@@FETCH_STATUS = 0) BEGIN
					Insert into #tblResultingPallets
					Select 'Split Pallets', @destinationBarcode, @palletContentFK, sis.StockItemCode, pc.Batch, 0, 
					isnull(ets.EachesType, ''), isnull(uts.UnitType, '')
					from tblPalletContent pc 
					inner join tblStockItems sis on
					sis.StockItemPK = pc.StockItemFK
					left outer join tblEachesTypes ets on
					ets.EachesTypePK = sis.EachesTypeFK
					left outer join tblUnitTypes uts on
					uts.UnitTypePK = sis.UnitTypeFK
					Where PalletContentPK = @palletContentFK
				FETCH NEXT FROM instructionCursor INTO @palletContentFK, @destinationBarcode
				END

				CLOSE instructionCursor
				DEALLOCATE instructionCursor

				/*UPDATE THE UNITS FROM MOVEMENTS*/
				DECLARE instructionCursor CURSOR FAST_FORWARD FOR
					Select wopis.PalletContentFK, wopis.SourceBarcode, wopis.DestinationBarcode, wopis.Units from tblWorksOrderPallets wops
					inner join tblWorksOrderPalletInstructions wopis on
					wopis.WorksOrderPalletFK = wops.WorksOrderPalletPK
					AND wopis.InstructionTypeFK = 3
					Where WorksOrderFK = @var_worksOrderFK
					order by WorksOrderPalletInstructionPK
				OPEN instructionCursor
				FETCH NEXT FROM instructionCursor INTO @palletContentFK, @sourceBarcode, @destinationBarcode, @units

				WHILE (@@FETCH_STATUS = 0) 
				BEGIN
					--Update Source
					update #tblResultingPallets 
					Set Quantity = Quantity + @units
					Where Barcode = @destinationBarcode

					--Update destination
					update #tblResultingPallets 
					Set Quantity = Quantity - @units
					Where Barcode = @sourceBarcode
				FETCH NEXT FROM instructionCursor INTO @palletContentFK, @sourceBarcode, @destinationBarcode, @units
				END

				CLOSE instructionCursor
				DEALLOCATE instructionCursor

				Select @myUser as IssuedBy, 
				case when @identificationNumber is not null then 'GI Number: ' + @identificationNumber else '' end WorkOriginator, 
				* from (
				Select WorkReason, resPallets.Barcode, StockItemCode, Batch, Quantity as Units, '1 ' + EachType as [Eaches] 
				from #tblResultingPallets resPallets) subQ
			END
	
			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end

			
			
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END
GO

-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spReportsStaCurrentStock]
(
	@customerFK int = -1,
	@divisionFKs nvarchar(50) = '', --'621,622,'
	@stockItemFK int = -1,
	------- optional parameters-------
	@palletStatus bit = 0,
	@expiryDate bit = 0,
	@availableUnits bit = 0,
	@unitsOnOrder bit = 0,
	@heldPallets bit = 0,
	@enroutePallets bit = 0 
)	
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data; Ensure this proc has a low impact when executed */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED; SET DEADLOCK_PRIORITY LOW

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT
	,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;
	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	DECLARE @var_customerFK int, @var_divisionFKs nvarchar(50), @var_stockItemFK int, @var_palletStatus bit, @var_expiryDate bit, 
	@var_availableUnits bit, @var_unitsOnOrder bit, @var_heldPallets bit, @var_enroutePallets bit

	SET @var_customerFK = @customerFK; SET @var_divisionFKs = @divisionFKs; SET @var_stockItemFK = @stockItemFK; SET @var_palletStatus = @palletStatus
	SET @var_expiryDate = @expiryDate; SET @var_availableUnits = @availableUnits; SET @var_unitsOnOrder = @unitsOnOrder; SET @var_heldPallets = @heldPallets
	SET @var_enroutePallets = @enroutePallets

	SET @ParameterDetails = '@customerFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_customerFK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@divisionFKs = ' 
		+ ISNULL(CAST(@var_divisionFKs AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@stockItemFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_stockItemFK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') 
			+ ',@palletStatus = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_palletStatus AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@expiryDate = ' 
				+ ISNULL(CAST(@var_expiryDate AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@availableUnits = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_availableUnits AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') 
					+ ',@unitsOnOrder = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_unitsOnOrder AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@heldPallets = ' 
						+ ISNULL(CAST(@var_heldPallets AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@enroutePallets = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_enroutePallets AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'')

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    --BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

		SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END


	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY
			

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start

	-- Insert statements for procedure here
	DECLARE @for as nvarchar(max)

	SET @for = ''
			
	----check for values in customer and stock item---------------
	IF(@customerFK <> -1) BEGIN
		Set @for = @for + (case when len(@for) > 0 then ', ' else '' end) + 'Customer: ' +
		 (Select CustomerName from tblCustomers where CustomerPK = @customerFK)
	END

	IF(@stockItemFK <> -1) BEGIN
		Set @for = @for + (case when len(@for) > 0 then ', ' else '' end) + 'Stock Item: ' +
		 (Select StockItemCode from tblStockItems where StockItemPK = @stockItemFK)
	END
	-------cursor to list divisions--------------
	-----------------cursor start--------------------------
	DECLARE @myDivisions nvarchar(max)
		SET @myDivisions = ''
	DECLARE @myDivisionsTrim nvarchar(max)
		SET @myDivisionsTrim = ''	
	DECLARE cur_div CURSOR FAST_FORWARD
	FOR 
	SELECT  DivisionName 
		FROM dbo.tblDivisions  
			WHERE (',' + @divisionFKs + ',' LIKE '%,' + convert(nvarchar(max), DivisionPK) + ',%')
			GROUP BY DivisionName
		OPEN cur_div
			 FETCH NEXT FROM cur_div INTO @for 
				WHILE @@Fetch_status = 0
					BEGIN 
						Set @myDivisions = @myDivisions + @for + ', '  
						FETCH NEXT FROM cur_div INTO @for
				END
		CLOSE cur_div
	DEALLOCATE cur_div
	----if statement to remove trailing comma ---------
	IF (@divisionFKs <> '')
		SET @for = (Select reverse(stuff(reverse(@myDivisions), 1, 2, '')))
	------------cursor end----------------------

	-------if statement using select as a string out variables-------------
	DECLARE @palStatusSelected nvarchar(50)
	DECLARE @palStatusGrouped nvarchar(50)
	DECLARE @palStatFK nvarchar(50)
	DECLARE @palStatusTrue nvarchar(100)
	DECLARE @palEnRouteStatus nvarchar(100)
	DECLARE @palHeldStatus nvarchar(100)

	---if palletstatus is selected------
	IF(@palletStatus= 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/) 
	BEGIN
		Select 
		@palStatusSelected = ', left(PalletStatus,12) as PalletStatus', 
		@palStatusGrouped = ', ps.PalletStatus',
		@palStatFK = ', PalletStatusFK', 
		@palStatusTrue = 'AND okStock.PalletStatusFK = pal.PalletStatusFK',
		
		@palEnRouteStatus = 'AND enrouteStock.PalletStatusFK = pal.PalletStatusFK',
		@palHeldStatus = 'AND notOkStock.PalletStatusFK = pal.PalletStatusFK' 
	END ELSE 
	BEGIN
		Select @palStatusSelected = '', @palStatusGrouped = '', 
		@palStatFK = '', @palStatusTrue = '',
		@palEnRouteStatus = '', @palHeldStatus = ''
	END
	----------end if statement-------------

	---------case statements-----------

	DECLARE @expDate nvarchar(100)
	SET @expDate =
	CASE
		WHEN @expiryDate <>  0 THEN ', case when ExpiryDate <> ''01/01/1900'' then left(ExpiryDate,12) else '''' end as Expiry'
		ELSE ''
	END 
	
	DECLARE @availUnits nvarchar(50)
	SET @availUnits =
	CASE
		WHEN @availableUnits <> 0 THEN ', AvailableUnits'
		ELSE ''
	END
	DECLARE @uniOnOrder nvarchar(50)
	SET @uniOnOrder =
	CASE
		WHEN @unitsOnOrder <> 0 THEN ', UnitsOnOrder '
		ELSE ''
	END
	DECLARE @enrPallets nvarchar(50)
	SET @enrPallets =
	CASE
		WHEN @enroutePallets <> 0 THEN ', EnroutePallets '
		ELSE ''
	END
	DECLARE @hePallets nvarchar(50)
	SET @hePallets =
	CASE
		WHEN @heldPallets <> 0 THEN ', HeldPallets '
		ELSE ''
	END
	-----------------end of case statements--------------------

	DECLARE @sqlCommand nvarchar(max)
	set @sqlCommand = rtrim( @sqlCommand )
	DECLARE @selectedList nvarchar(max)
	Declare @groupByList nvarchar(max)

	-------dynamic sql-----------------

	BEGIN
		SET @selectedList = ' ''' + (@for) + ''' as Info  ,
		' + cast(@palletStatus as nvarchar(50)) + ' as ChkPalletStatus,
		' + cast(@expiryDate as nvarchar(50)) + ' as ChkExpiry,
		' + CAST(@availableUnits as nvarchar(50)) + ' as ChkAvailableUnits,
		' + CAST(@unitsOnOrder as nvarchar(50)) + ' as ChkUnitsOnOrder,
		' + CAST(@heldPallets as nvarchar(50)) + ' as ChkHeldPallets,
		' + cast(@enroutePallets as nvarchar(50)) + ' as ChkEnRoutePallets,
		 CustomerName, DivisionName, StockItemCode, 
		left(Description,50) as Description, Batch, Pallets, Abbreviation 
		' + @palStatusSelected + ' ' + @expDate + '
		' + @availUnits + ' ' + @uniOnOrder + ' ' + @enrPallets + ' ' + @hePallets + ''
		SET @groupByList = ' CustomerName, DivisionPK, Abbreviation, sis.Description, 
				DivisionName, StockItemPK, StockItemCode, pc.Batch, okStock.Pallets ' + @palStatusGrouped + ', pc.ExpiryDate,
				okStock.ActualUnits, okStock.AvailableUnits, enRouteStock.Pallets, notOkStock.Pallets '
		SET @sqlCommand = 'SELECT ' + @selectedList + ' 
				FROM(Select CustomerName, DivisionName, StockItemCode, sis.Description,
				  unitTypes.Abbreviation, pc.Batch ' + @palStatusGrouped + ', pc.ExpiryDate, 
				  ISNULL(okStock.Pallets, 0) Pallets, 
				  ISNULL(okStock.AvailableUnits, 0) AvailableUnits,	
				  ISNULL(okStock.ActualUnits, 0) - isnull(okStock.AvailableUnits, 0) UnitsOnOrder,
				  ISNULL(enrouteStock.Pallets, 0) EnroutePallets,
				  ISNULL(notOkStock.Pallets , 0) HeldPallets	
			 
				FROM tblCustomers cus
				inner join tblDivisions divs on
				divs.CustomerFK = cus.CustomerPK
				inner join tblStockItems sis on
				sis.DivisionFK = divs.DivisionPK
				left outer join tblUnitTypes unitTypes on
				unitTypes.UnitTypePK = sis.UnitTypeFK
				inner join (
					Select PalletFK, StockItemFK, Batch, ExpiryDate
					from tblPalletContent pc
					inner join tblPallets pals on
					pals.PalletPK = pc.PalletFK	
					AND pals.IsArchived = 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/
					Group By PalletFK, StockItemFK, Batch, ExpiryDate
				) pc on
				pc.StockItemFK = sis.StockItemPK
				inner join tblPallets pal on
				pal.PalletPK = pc.PalletFK
				left outer join tblPalletTypes pt on
				pt.PalletTypePK = pal.PalletTypeFK
				inner join appPalletStatus ps on
				ps.PalletStatusPK = pal.PalletStatusFK 
				
				left outer join (
					Select StockItemFK, Batch, count(*) Pallets ' + @palStatFK + ', sum(ActualUnits) ActualUnits, sum(AvailableUnits) AvailableUnits from (
						Select StockItemFK, Batch, PalletFK ' + @palStatFK + ' , sum(ActualUnits) ActualUnits, sum(AvailableUnits)AvailableUnits
						from tblPalletContent pc
						inner join tblPallets pallets on
						pallets.PalletPK = pc.PalletFK
						Where pallets.PalletStatusFK <> 10 /*OnRoute*/ 
						AND pallets.IsArchived = 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/
						Group By StockItemFK, Batch ,  PalletFK ' + @palStatFK + ', ActualUnits, AvailableUnits
					) subQ
					Group By StockItemFK, Batch ' + @palStatFK + '
				) okStock on
				okStock.StockItemFK = pc.StockItemFK
				AND okStock.Batch = pc.Batch
				' + @palStatusTrue + '
				
				left outer join (
						Select StockItemFK, Batch, count(*) Pallets' + @palStatFK + ', sum(ActualUnits) ActualUnits, sum(AvailableUnits) AvailableUnits from (
							Select StockItemFK, Batch, PalletFK' + @palStatFK + ', sum(ActualUnits) ActualUnits, sum(AvailableUnits) AvailableUnits
							from tblPalletContent pc
							inner join tblPallets pallets on
							pallets.PalletPK = pc.PalletFK
							Where pallets.PalletStatusFK = 10/*OnRoute*/
							AND pallets.IsArchived = 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/
							Group By StockItemFK, Batch,  PalletFK' + @palStatFK + '
					) subQ
					Group By StockItemFK, Batch' + @palStatFK + ', ActualUnits, AvailableUnits
					) enrouteStock on
					enrouteStock.StockItemFK = pc.StockItemFK
					AND enrouteStock.Batch = pc.Batch
					' + @palEnRouteStatus + '
					
				left outer join (
						Select StockItemFK, Batch, count(*) Pallets' + @palStatFK + ', sum(ActualUnits) ActualUnits, sum(AvailableUnits) AvailableUnits from (
						Select StockItemFK, Batch, PalletFK' + @palStatFK + ', sum(ActualUnits) ActualUnits, sum(AvailableUnits) AvailableUnits
						from tblPalletContent pc
						inner join tblPallets pallets on
						pallets.PalletPK = pc.PalletFK
						Where pallets.PalletStatusFK = 7 /*On Hold*/ 
						AND pallets.IsArchived = 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/
						Group By StockItemFK, Batch,  PalletFK' + @palStatFK + '
					) subQ
					Group By StockItemFK, Batch' + @palStatFK + ', ActualUnits, AvailableUnits
					) notOkStock on
					notOkStock.StockItemFK = pc.StockItemFK
					AND notOkStock.Batch = pc.Batch
					' + @palHeldStatus + '	
				WHERE	(cus.CustomerPK = ' + cast(@customerFK as nvarchar(50)) + ' or ' +
								cast(@customerFK as nvarchar(50)) + ' = -1)
								AND('','' + ''' + @divisionFKs + ''' + '','' LIKE ''%,'' + CONVERT(VARCHAR, sis.DivisionFK) + '',%'' or ''' + @divisionFKs + ''' = '''')
								AND (sis.StockItemPK = ' + cast(@stockItemFK as nvarchar(50)) + ' or ' +
								 cast(@stockItemFK as nvarchar(50)) + ' = -1)
				Group By ' + @groupByList + '
				)subQ
				Order By StockItemCode, Batch, ExpiryDate ASC' 
		PRINT RIGHT(@sqlCommand, 4000);
		PRINT LEFT(@sqlCommand, 4000);		
		--PRINT (@sqlCommand)
		EXEC (@sqlCommand)		 
	END
 
	--------------dynamic sql end------------
	 
			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end

			
			
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END
GO

  END TRY      
  BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */      
   DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;      
   SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;      
   SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;      
      
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY       
   BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;      
             
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;      
      
            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID      
                  
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;      
                  
   IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)      
   BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END      
   ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */      
  END CATCH      
  SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1      
 END      
END

-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spReportsSTAWMSEachBarcodes]
(
	@containerInFK int,
	@stockInFK int,
	@palletFKs nvarchar(1000),
	@buildingUnitBayFKs nvarchar(1000) = ''
)	
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data; Ensure this proc has a low impact when executed */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED; SET DEADLOCK_PRIORITY LOW

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT
	,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;
	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	DECLARE @var_containerInFK int, @var_stockInFK int, @var_palletFKs nvarchar(1000), @var_buildingUnitBayFKs nvarchar(1000)

	SET @var_containerInFK = @containerInFK; SET @var_stockInFK = @stockInFK; SET @var_palletFKs = @palletFKs; SET @var_buildingUnitBayFKs = @buildingUnitBayFKs

	SET @ParameterDetails = '@containerInFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_containerInFK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@stockInFK = ' 
		+ ISNULL(CAST(@var_stockInFK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@palletFKs = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_palletFKs AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@buildingUnitBayFKs = ' 
			+ ISNULL(CAST(@var_buildingUnitBayFKs AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'')

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    --BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

		SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END


	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY
			

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start

		IF(@buildingUnitBayFKs = '') 
		BEGIN
			Declare @goodsInNumber nvarchar(200)
			Select @goodsInNumber = GoodsInNumber from tblContainerIns where ContainerInPK = @containerInFK
		
			Select pc.Barcode, StockItemCode, pc.Batch, 
			case when cast(ExpiryDate as nvarchar(50)) = 'Jan  1 1900 12:00AM' then '' else convert(nvarchar(10),ExpiryDate, 103) End ExpiryDate, 
			case when cast(DateOfManuFacture as nvarchar(50)) = 'Jan  1 1900 12:00AM' then '' else convert(nvarchar(10),DateOfManuFacture, 103) End DateOfManuFacture, 
			case when cast(BestBefore as nvarchar(50)) = 'Jan  1 1900 12:00AM' then '' else convert(nvarchar(10),BestBefore, 103) End BestBefore, 
			case when cast(DateOfReceipt as nvarchar(50)) = 'Jan  1 1900 12:00AM' then pa.EventDate else DateOfReceipt End DateOfReceipt,
			@goodsInNumber as GoodsInNumber,
			ps.CustomerPalletNumber,
			case when sis.ShowQuantityOnEachBarcode = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ then cast(pc.ActualUnits as nvarchar(50)) + ' ' + case when uts.UnitTypePK is not null then uts.Abbreviation when euts.EachesUnitTypePK is not null then euts.Abbrieviation else '' end else '' end Units,
			sis.Description,
			pa.EventDate as DateIn,
			ssts.SpecialStockType + case when pc.SpecialStockTypeFK = 3 /*Consigned*/ then ': ' + conSupps.Supplier else '' end as SpecialStockType,
			divs.BarcodeLogo,
			eachTypes.EachesTypeSingular EachesType
			from tblPallets pallets
			inner join tblPalletContent pc on
			pc.PalletFK = pallets.PalletPK 	
			inner join tblStockItems sis on
			sis.StockItemPK = pc.StockItemFK
			AND sis.BarcodeEaches = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/
			inner join tblDivisions divs on
			divs.DivisionPK = sis.DivisionFK
			left outer join tblEachesTypes eachTypes on
			eachTypes.EachesTypePK = sis.EachesTypeFK
			left outer join tblUnitTypes uts on
			uts.UnitTypePK = sis.UnitTypeFK
			left outer join tblEachesUnitTypes euts on
			euts.EachesUnitTypePK = sis.EachesUnitTypeFK
			left outer join tblPalletStamp ps on
			ps.PalletFK = pallets.PalletPK
			left outer join tblPalletAudit pa on
			pa.PalletFK = pallets.PalletPK
			and EventTypeFK = 1 /*Pallet Created*/
			left outer join appSpecialStockTypes ssts on
			ssts.SpecialStockTypePK = pc.SpecialStockTypeFK
			left outer join (
				Select PalletFK, SpecialStockTypeFK, IntParam1 from tblPalletContentSpecialStockTypes
				Group By PalletFK, SpecialStockTypeFK, IntParam1
			) pcSsts on
			pcSsts.PalletFK = pc.PalletFK

			left outer join tblSuppliers conSupps on
			conSupps.SupplierPK = pcSsts.IntParam1

			LEFT JOIN dbo.fnSplitStringToArray(@palletFKs, ',') palletfilter ON DATALENGTH(@palletFKs) > 0 and palletfilter.element = pallets.palletpk

			Where PalletPK in (case when @var_palletFKs <> '' then palletfilter.element else PalletPK end)
		END 
		ELSE 
		BEGIN
			Select pc.Barcode, StockItemCode, pc.Batch, 
			case when cast(pc.ExpiryDate as nvarchar(50)) = 'Jan  1 1900 12:00AM' then '' else convert(nvarchar(10),pc.ExpiryDate, 103) End ExpiryDate, 
			case when cast(pc.DateOfManuFacture as nvarchar(50)) = 'Jan  1 1900 12:00AM' then '' else convert(nvarchar(10),pc.DateOfManuFacture, 103) End DateOfManuFacture, 
			case when cast(pc.BestBefore as nvarchar(50)) = 'Jan  1 1900 12:00AM' then '' else convert(nvarchar(10),pc.BestBefore, 103) End BestBefore, 
			case when cast(pc.DateOfReceipt as nvarchar(50)) = 'Jan  1 1900 12:00AM' then pa.EventDate else pc.DateOfReceipt End DateOfReceipt,
			cins.GoodsInNumber as GoodsInNumber,
			ps.CustomerPalletNumber,
			case when sis.ShowQuantityOnEachBarcode = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ then cast(pc.ActualUnits as nvarchar(50)) + ' ' + case when uts.UnitTypePK is not null then uts.Abbreviation when euts.EachesUnitTypePK is not null then euts.Abbrieviation else '' end else '' end Units,
			sis.Description,
			pa.EventDate as DateIn,
			ssts.SpecialStockType + case when pc.SpecialStockTypeFK = 3 /*Consigned*/ then ': ' + conSupps.Supplier else '' end as SpecialStockType,
			divs.BarcodeLogo,
			eachTypes.EachesTypeSingular EachesType
			from tblPallets pallets
			inner join tblPalletContent pc on
			pc.PalletFK = pallets.PalletPK 	
			inner join tblStockItems sis on
			sis.StockItemPK = pc.StockItemFK
			AND sis.BarcodeEaches = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/
			inner join tblDivisions divs on
			divs.DivisionPK = sis.DivisionFK
			left outer join tblEachesTypes eachTypes on
			eachTypes.EachesTypePK = sis.EachesTypeFK
			left outer join tblUnitTypes uts on
			uts.UnitTypePK = sis.UnitTypeFK
			left outer join tblEachesUnitTypes euts on
			euts.EachesUnitTypePK = sis.EachesUnitTypeFK
			left outer join tblPalletStamp ps on
			ps.PalletFK = pallets.PalletPK
			left outer join tblPalletAudit pa on
			pa.PalletFK = pallets.PalletPK
			and EventTypeFK = 1 /*Pallet Created*/
			left outer join appSpecialStockTypes ssts on
			ssts.SpecialStockTypePK = pc.SpecialStockTypeFK
			left outer join (
				Select PalletFK, SpecialStockTypeFK, IntParam1 from tblPalletContentSpecialStockTypes
				Group By PalletFK, SpecialStockTypeFK, IntParam1
			) pcSsts on
			pcSsts.PalletFK = pc.PalletFK

			left outer join tblSuppliers conSupps on
			conSupps.SupplierPK = pcSsts.IntParam1

			left outer join tblBuildingUnitBays buBays on
			buBays.BuildingUnitBayPK = pallets.LocationFK
			AND pallets.LocationTypeFK = 1 /*Racking*/
			left outer join tblBuildingUnitColumns buCols on
			buCols.BuildingUnitColumnPK = buBays.BuildingUnitColumnFK

			left outer join tblStockInLinePallets silps on
			silps.PalletFK = pallets.PalletPK

			left outer join tblStockInLines sils on
			sils.StockInLinePK = silps.StockInLineFK

			left outer join tblStockIns sins on
			sins.StockInPK = sils.StockInFK

			left outer join tblContainerIns cins on
			cins.ContainerInPK = sins.ContainerInFK

			Where PalletPK in 
			(Select PalletPK 
			from tblPallets Where LocationTypeFK = 1/*Racking*/ 
			AND (',' + @buildingUnitBayFKs + ',' LIKE '%,' + CONVERT(VARCHAR, LocationFK) + ',%'))

			Order By buCols.BuildingUnitColumn ASC, buBays.BayLevel ASC, pallets.BayPosition ASC
		END
		
			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end

			
			
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spReportsStockDetailReport]
(
	@buildingUnitFK int,
	@CustomerFK int,
	@stockItemFK int,	
	@divisionFKs nvarchar(50) = '',
------- optional parameters-------
	@palletStatus bit = 1,
	@expiryDate bit = 1,
	@heldPallets bit = 1,
	@enroutePallets bit = 1,
	@PrintPalletDetails bit = 1,
	@UnitsOnOrder bit = 1,
	@AvailableUnits bit = 1
)	
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data; Ensure this proc has a low impact when executed */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED; SET DEADLOCK_PRIORITY LOW

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT
	,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;
	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	DECLARE @var_buildingUnitFK int, @var_CustomerFK int, @var_stockItemFK int, @var_divisionFKs nvarchar(50), @var_palletStatus bit, @var_expiryDate bit, 
	@var_heldPallets bit, @var_enroutePallets bit, @var_PrintPalletDetails bit, @var_UnitsOnOrder bit, @var_AvailableUnits bit

	SET @var_buildingUnitFK = @buildingUnitFK; SET @var_CustomerFK = @CustomerFK; SET @var_stockItemFK = @stockItemFK; SET @var_divisionFKs = @divisionFKs
	SET @var_palletStatus = @palletStatus; SET @var_expiryDate = @expiryDate; SET @var_heldPallets = @heldPallets; SET @var_enroutePallets = @enroutePallets
	SET @var_PrintPalletDetails = @PrintPalletDetails; SET @var_UnitsOnOrder = @UnitsOnOrder; SET @var_AvailableUnits = @AvailableUnits

	SET @ParameterDetails = '@buildingUnitFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_buildingUnitFK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@CustomerFK = ' 
		+ ISNULL(CAST(@var_CustomerFK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@stockItemFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_stockItemFK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@divisionFKs = ' 
			+ ISNULL(CAST(@var_divisionFKs AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@palletStatus = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_palletStatus AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@expiryDate = ' 
				+ ISNULL(CAST(@var_expiryDate AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@heldPallets = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_heldPallets AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@enroutePallets = ' 
					+ ISNULL(CAST(@var_enroutePallets AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@PrintPalletDetails = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_PrintPalletDetails AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') 
						+ ',@UnitsOnOrder = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_UnitsOnOrder AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@AvailableUnits = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_AvailableUnits AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'')

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    --BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

		SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END


	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY
			

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start

Declare @for as nvarchar(100)

Set @for = ''
IF(@buildingUnitFK <> -1) BEGIN
	Set @for = 'Building Unit: ' + (Select BuildingName + ' - ' + BuildingUnit from tblBuildingUnits bus inner join tblBuildings bs on bs.BuildingPK = bus.BuildingFK where BuildingUnitPK = @buildingUnitFK)
END
IF (@CustomerFK <> -1) BEGIN
	SET @for = @for + (case when len(@for) > 0 then ', ' else '' end) + 'Customer: ' + (Select CustomerName from tblCustomers WHERE customerPK = @CustomerFK)
END
IF(@stockItemFK <> -1) BEGIN
	Set @for = @for + (case when len(@for) > 0 then ', ' else '' end) + 'Stock Item: ' + (Select StockItemCode from tblStockItems where StockItemPK = @stockItemFK)
END
	
IF(@divisionFKs <> '') 
BEGIN
	Select [For],BuildingUnit,DivisionName,StockItemCode,Description,Batch,Location,PalletType,PalletStatus,
	--cast(Actual as nvarchar(100)) + ' ' + isnull(Abbreviation, '') as Actual, cast(Available as nvarchar(100)) + ' ' + isnull(Abbreviation, '') as Available, cast(OnOrder as nvarchar(100)) + ' ' + isnull(Abbreviation, '') as OnOrder,
	Actual, Available, OnOrder, case when ExpiryDate <> '01/01/1900' then left(ExpiryDate,12) else '' end as ExpiryDate,
	Barcode, CustomerPalletNumber,
	@palletStatus as ChkPalletStatus,
	@expiryDate as ChkExpiry,
	@heldPallets as ChkHeldPallets,
	@enroutePallets as ChkEnRoutePallets,
	@PrintPalletDetails as ChkPrintDetails,
	@UnitsOnOrder as ChkUnitsOnOrder,
	@AvailableUnits as ChkAvailableUnits from (

	Select @for as [For], 
	'Building Unit: ' + buildings.BuildingName + ' - ' + bus.BuildingUnit BuildingUnit, 
	divs.DivisionName,
	stockItems.StockItemCode, 
	stockItems.Description, 
	pc.Batch,
	palletLocation.location,
	palletTypes.PalletType,
	ps.PalletStatus,
	case when stockItems.EachesTypeFK <> -1 then pc.ActualEachUnits else pc.ActualUnits End as Actual,
	case when stockItems.EachesTypeFK <> -1 then pc.AvailableEachUnits else pc.AvailableUnits End as Available,
	case when stockItems.EachesTypeFK <> -1 then pc.ActualEachUnits - pc.AvailableEachUnits else pc.ActualUnits - pc.AvailableUnits End as OnOrder,
	case when pallets.CustomerBarcode = '' then pallets.Barcode else pallets.CustomerBarcode END AS Barcode, CustomerPalletNumber,
	pallets.LocationTypeFK,
	uts.Abbreviation, pc.ExpiryDate

	from 
	(Select * 
	from tblPallets 
	where IsArchived = 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/ 
	AND PalletStatusFK <> 10 /*OnRoute*/ AND LocationTypeFK <> 4/*OnRoute*/) pallets

	left outer join viewPalletLocations palletLocation
	--on pallets.LocationTypeFK = 1/*Building Unit Bay*/
	on palletLocation.palletPk = pallets.palletPk


	/*Pallet Status*/
	left outer join appPalletStatus ps on
	ps.PalletStatusPK = pallets.PalletStatusFK

	/*Pallet Content*/
	inner join (
		Select PalletFK, StockItemFK, Batch, ExpiryDate,
		sum(ActualUnits) ActualUnits, sum(ActualEaches * ActualUnits) ActualEachUnits,
		sum(AvailableUnits) AvailableUnits, sum(AvailableEaches * AvailableUnits) AvailableEachUnits 
		From (Select * from tblPalletContent where IsArchived = 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/) subPc
		inner join tblStockItems sis on
		sis.StockItemPK = subPc.StockItemFK
		Where (sis.EachesTypeFK < 0) OR (sis.EachesTypeFK > 0 AND subPc.EachUnits > 0)
		Group By PalletFK, StockItemFK, Batch, ExpiryDate
		) pc on
	pc.PalletFK = pallets.PalletPK

	/*StockItems*/
	inner join tblStockItems stockItems on
	stockItems.StockItemPK = pc.StockItemFK
	AND stockItems.DivisionFK in (@divisionFKs)

	/*Divisions*/
	inner join tblDivisions divs on
	divs.DivisionPK = stockItems.DivisionFK

	/*Unit Type*/
	left outer join tblUnitTypes uts on
	uts.UnitTypePK = stockItems.UnitTypeFK

	/*PalletTypes*/
	left outer join tblPalletTypes palletTypes on
	palletTypes.PalletTypePK = pallets.PalletTypeFK

	/*BuildingUnits*/
	left outer join tblBuildingUnits bus on
	bus.BuildingUnitPK = palletLocation.BuildingUnitFK

	left outer join tblBuildings buildings on
	buildings.BuildingPK = bus.BuildingFK

	WHERE 
	bus.BuildingUnitPK = case when @buildingUnitFK = -1 then
		 bus.BuildingUnitPK
	else
		@buildingUnitFK
	end
	AND
	pc.StockItemFK = case when @stockItemFK = -1 then
		pc.StockItemFK
	else
		 @stockItemFK
	end	
	AND
	pc.Batch like pc.Batch
	AND
	(
		pallets.Barcode = pallets.Barcode
		OR
		pallets.CustomerBarcode = pallets.CustomerBarcode
	)

	)subQ
	Group By [For],LocationTypeFK,BuildingUnit,DivisionName,StockItemCode,Description,Batch,Location,PalletType,PalletStatus,
	Actual, Available, OnOrder,Barcode,CustomerPalletNumber, Abbreviation, ExpiryDate
	order by BuildingUnit, StockItemCode
END 
ELSE 
BEGIN
	Select [For],BuildingUnit,DivisionName,StockItemCode,Description,Batch,Location,PalletType,PalletStatus,
	--cast(Actual as nvarchar(100)) + ' ' + isnull(Abbreviation, '') as Actual, cast(Available as nvarchar(100)) + ' ' + isnull(Abbreviation, '') as Available, cast(OnOrder as nvarchar(100)) + ' ' + isnull(Abbreviation, '') as OnOrder,
	Actual, Available, OnOrder, case when ExpiryDate <> '01/01/1900' then left(ExpiryDate,12) else '' end as ExpiryDate,
	Barcode, CustomerPalletNumber,
	@palletStatus as ChkPalletStatus,
	@expiryDate as ChkExpiry,
	@heldPallets as ChkHeldPallets,
	@enroutePallets as ChkEnRoutePallets,
	@PrintPalletDetails as ChkPrintDetails,
	@UnitsOnOrder as ChkUnitsOnOrder,
	@AvailableUnits as ChkAvailableUnits--,	EnroutePallets, HeldPallets 
from (

	Select @for as [For], 
	'Building Unit: ' + buildings.BuildingName + ' - ' + bus.BuildingUnit BuildingUnit, 
	divs.DivisionName,
	stockItems.StockItemCode, 
	stockItems.Description, 
	pc.Batch,
	palletLocation.Location,
	palletTypes.PalletType,
	ps.PalletStatus,
	case when stockItems.EachesTypeFK <> -1 then pc.ActualEachUnits else pc.ActualUnits End as Actual,
	case when stockItems.EachesTypeFK <> -1 then pc.AvailableEachUnits else pc.AvailableUnits End as Available,
	case when stockItems.EachesTypeFK <> -1 then pc.ActualEachUnits - pc.AvailableEachUnits else pc.ActualUnits - pc.AvailableUnits End as OnOrder,
	case when pallets.CustomerBarcode = '' then pallets.Barcode else pallets.CustomerBarcode END Barcode, CustomerPalletNumber,
	palletLocation.LocationTypeFK, uts.Abbreviation, pc.ExpiryDate--, 
	--ISNULL(enrouteStock.Pallets, 0) EnroutePallets,
	--ISNULL(notOkStock.Pallets , 0) HeldPallets

	from 
	(Select * 
	from tblPallets 
	where IsArchived = 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/ 
	AND PalletStatusFK <> 10 /*OnRoute*/) pallets

    /*Locations */
	INNER JOIN viewPalletLocations palletLocation ON 
	palletLocation.palletPK = pallets.palletPk

	/*Pallet Status*/
	left outer join appPalletStatus ps on
	ps.PalletStatusPK = pallets.PalletStatusFK

	/*Pallet Content*/
	inner join (
		Select PalletFK, StockItemFK, Batch, ExpiryDate,
		sum(ActualUnits) ActualUnits, sum(ActualEaches * ActualUnits) ActualEachUnits,
		sum(AvailableUnits) AvailableUnits, sum(AvailableEaches * AvailableUnits) AvailableEachUnits 
		From (Select * from tblPalletContent where IsArchived = 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/) subPc
		inner join tblStockItems sis on
		sis.StockItemPK = subPc.StockItemFK
		Where (sis.EachesTypeFK < 0) OR (sis.EachesTypeFK > 0 AND subPc.EachUnits > 0)
		Group By PalletFK, StockItemFK, Batch, ExpiryDate
		) pc on
	pc.PalletFK = pallets.PalletPK

	/*StockItems*/
	inner join tblStockItems stockItems on
	stockItems.StockItemPK = pc.StockItemFK

	/*Divisions*/
	inner join tblDivisions divs on
	divs.DivisionPK = stockItems.DivisionFK

	/*Unit Type*/
	left outer join tblUnitTypes uts on
	uts.UnitTypePK = stockItems.UnitTypeFK

	/*PalletTypes*/
	left outer join tblPalletTypes palletTypes on
	palletTypes.PalletTypePK = pallets.PalletTypeFK

	/*BuildingUnits*/
	left outer join tblBuildingUnits bus on	
	bus.BuildingUnitPK = palletLocation.BuildingUnitFK

	left outer join tblBuildings buildings on
	buildings.BuildingPK = bus.BuildingFK

	/*left outer join (
		Select StockItemFK, Batch, count(*) Pallets, PalletStatusFK, sum(ActualUnits) ActualUnits, sum(AvailableUnits) AvailableUnits from (
			Select StockItemFK, Batch, PalletFK, PalletStatusFK, sum(ActualUnits) ActualUnits, sum(AvailableUnits) AvailableUnits
			from 
			(Select * from tblPallets 
			Where PalletStatusFK = 10/*OnRoute*/
			AND IsArchived = 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/
			)pallets

			inner join tblPalletContent pc on
			pc.PalletFK = pallets.PalletPK
			Group By StockItemFK, Batch,  PalletFK, PalletStatusFK
	) subQ
	Group By StockItemFK, Batch, PalletStatusFK, ActualUnits, AvailableUnits
	) enrouteStock on
	enrouteStock.StockItemFK = pc.StockItemFK
	AND enrouteStock.Batch = pc.Batch
	AND enrouteStock.PalletStatusFK = pallets.PalletStatusFK

	left outer join (
		Select StockItemFK, Batch, count(*) Pallets, sum(ActualUnits) ActualUnits, sum(AvailableUnits) AvailableUnits from (
		Select StockItemFK, Batch, PalletFK, sum(ActualUnits) ActualUnits, sum(AvailableUnits) AvailableUnits

		from 
		(Select * from tblPallets 
			Where PalletStatusFK =  7 /*On Hold*/ 
			AND IsArchived = 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/
			)pallets
		inner join tblPalletContent pc on
		pc.PalletFK = pallets.PalletPK
		
		Group By StockItemFK, Batch,  PalletFK
	) subQ
	Group By StockItemFK, Batch, ActualUnits, AvailableUnits
	) notOkStock on
	notOkStock.StockItemFK = pc.StockItemFK
	AND notOkStock.Batch = pc.Batch*/

	WHERE 
	bus.BuildingUnitPK = case when @buildingUnitFK = -1 then
		 bus.BuildingUnitPK
	else
		@buildingUnitFK
	end
	AND
	divs.customerFK = case WHEN @CustomerFK = -1 THEN
		divs.customerFK
	ELSE
		@CustomerFK
	END
	AND
	pc.StockItemFK = case when @stockItemFK = -1 then
		pc.StockItemFK
	else
		 @stockItemFK
	end
	AND
	pc.Batch like pc.Batch
	AND
	(
		pallets.Barcode = pallets.Barcode
		OR
		pallets.CustomerBarcode = pallets.CustomerBarcode
	)

	)subQ
	Group By [For],LocationTypeFK,BuildingUnit,DivisionName,StockItemCode,Description,Batch,Location,PalletType,PalletStatus,
	Actual, Available, OnOrder,Barcode, CustomerPalletNumber, Abbreviation, ExpiryDate--, EnroutePallets, HeldPallets
	order by buildingunit, StockItemCode
END

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end

			
			
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END

-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spReportsStockInCommercialInvoice]
(
	@stockInPK int
)	
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data; Ensure this proc has a low impact when executed */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED; SET DEADLOCK_PRIORITY LOW

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT
	,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;
	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	DECLARE @var_stockInPK int
	SET @var_stockInPK = @stockInPK
	SET @ParameterDetails = '@stockInPK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_stockInPK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'')

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    --BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

		SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END


	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY
			

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start

			DECLARE StockInLines CURSOR FAST_FORWARD FOR
			Select 
				sis.StockItemCode + ' ' + sis.Description, sils.Batch, sils.IsMixedPallet, sils.Pallets,  sils.Units, 
				case when sis.EachesTypeFK > 0 then 'EA' else 'UNITS' end as UOM, siucs.UnitCost, ccs.CommodityCode, currs.CurrencySymbol,
				sis.DefaultVolumePerEach, volumeUTs.Abbreviation
			from 
				tblStockIns sins 
			inner join tblStockInLines sils on
				sils.StockInFK = sins.StockInPK
			inner join tblStockItems sis on
				sils.StockItemFK = sis.StockItemPK
			left outer join (
				Select subSiucs.StockItemFK, max(subSiucs.StockItemUnitCostPK) as StockItemUnitCostPK
				from tblStockItemUnitCosts subSiucs
				Group By StockItemFK
			) siucsP1 on
				siucsP1.StockItemFK = sis.StockItemPK
			left outer join tblStockItemUnitCosts siucs on
				siucs.StockItemUnitCostPK = siucsP1.StockItemUnitCostPK

			left outer join (
				Select subSiccs.StockItemFK, max(subSiccs.StockItemCommodityCodePK) as StockItemCommodityCodePK
				from tblStockItemCommodityCodes subSiccs
				Group By StockItemFK 
			) siccsP1 on
			siccsP1.StockItemFK = sis.StockItemPK
			left outer join tblStockItemCommodityCodes siccs on
			siccs.StockItemCommodityCodePK = siccsP1.StockItemCommodityCodePK

			left outer join tblCommodityCodes ccs on	
			ccs.CommodityCodePK = siccs.CommodityCodeFK

			left outer join tblCurrencies currs on
			currs.CurrencyPK = siucs.CurrencyFK
			left outer join tblUnitTypes as VolumeUTs on
			volumeUTs.UnitTypePK = sis.VolumeUnitTypeFK
			where sins.StockInPK = @var_stockInPK

			Declare @lastLineMixed bit, @palletCounter int , @entryNumber int
			Set @lastLineMixed = 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/
			Set @palletCounter = 0
			Set @entryNumber = 0
			DECLARE @PackingListLines TABLE
			(
				StockItemCode nvarchar(200),
				Batch nvarchar(200),
				Units decimal(18,3),
				UOM nvarchar(100),
				UnitCost decimal(10,5),
				CommodityCode nvarchar(500),
				LineCostCurrencySymbol nvarchar(10),
				LineCost decimal(18,3),
				LineVolume decimal(18,3),
				LineVolumeType nvarchar(100),
				PalletNumber nvarchar(50),
				EntryNumber int
			)

			Declare @stockItemCode nvarchar(200), @batch nvarchar(200), @isMixedPallet bit, @pallets int, 
			@units decimal(18,3), @UOM nvarchar(100), @unitCost decimal(10,5), @commodityCode nvarchar(500), @unitCostCurrencySymbol nvarchar(10), 
			@defaultVolumePerEach decimal(18,3), @volumeUnitType nvarchar(100)
			OPEN StockInLines
			FETCH NEXT FROM StockInLines INTO @stockItemCode, @batch, @isMixedPallet, @pallets, @units, @UOM, @unitCost, @commodityCode, @unitCostCurrencySymbol, 
			@defaultVolumePerEach, @volumeUnitType 

			WHILE (@@FETCH_STATUS = 0)
			BEGIN
				pRINT 'eNTEREDlOOP'
				IF (@pallets > 1) BEGIN
					Declare @i int
					Set @i = 0
					WHILE (@i <= @pallets - 1) BEGIN
						Set @palletCounter = @palletCounter + 1
						INSERT INTO @PackingListLines
						Select @stockItemCode, @batch, @units, @UOM, @unitCost, @commodityCode, @unitCostCurrencySymbol, (@unitCost * @units), 
						@defaultVolumePerEach * @units, @volumeUnitType, cast(@palletCounter as nvarchar(50)), @entryNumber
						Set @entryNumber = @entryNumber + 1
						Set @i = @i + 1
					END
				END ELSE BEGIN
					IF(@pallets = 1) BEGIN
						Set @palletCounter = @palletCounter + 1
					END 
					INSERT INTO @PackingListLines
					Select @stockItemCode, @batch, @units, @UOM, @unitCost, @commodityCode, @unitCostCurrencySymbol,(@unitCost * @units), 
					@defaultVolumePerEach * @units, @volumeUnitType, cast(@palletCounter as nvarchar(50)), @entryNumber
					IF(@isMixedPallet = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/) BEGIN
						set @lastLineMixed = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/
					END ELSE BEGIN
						set @lastLineMixed = 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/
					END
					Set @entryNumber = @entryNumber + 1
				END
		
			FETCH NEXT FROM StockInLines INTO @stockItemCode, @batch, @isMixedPallet, @pallets, @units, @UOM, @unitCost, @commodityCode, 
			@unitCostCurrencySymbol, @defaultVolumePerEach, @volumeUnitType 
			END

			CLOSE StockInLines
			DEALLOCATE StockInLines

			Declare @divisionFK int, @customerFK int
			Select @divisionFK = DivisionFK, @customerFK = CustomerFK from tblStockIns sins inner join tblDivisions divs 
			on divs.DivisionPK = sins.DivisionFK where StockInPK = @var_stockInPK

			Print 'here1'
			Select StockItemCode,Batch,Units,UOM,UnitCost,CommodityCode,LineCostCurrencySymbol,LineCost,
			skidTotals.LineVolume,LineVolumeType,listLines.PalletNumber,EntryNumber, 
			dplpss.*, cins.DateIn, @palletCounter PalletCount, cins.GoodsInNumber, scs.ShippingCompany 
			from @PackingListLines listLines
			inner join tblStockIns sins on
			sins.StockInPK = @var_stockInPK
			inner join tblContainerIns cins on
			cins.ContainerInPK = sins.ContainerInFK
			left outer join tblShippingCompanies scs on
			scs.ShippingCompanyPK = cins.ShippingCompanyFK
			left outer join tblExtraDockets dpls on
			dpls.CustomerFK = @customerFK AND dpls.ExtraDocketTypeFK = 2 /*StockInPackingList*/
			left outer join tblExtraDocketParameterSets dplpss on
			dplpss.ExtraDocketFK = dpls.ExtraDocketPK
			left outer join (Select sum(LineVolume) LineVolume, PalletNumber 
							from @PackingListLines
							Group By PalletNumber
							) skidTotals on
			skidTotals.PalletNumber = listLines.PalletNumber
			Order by EntryNumber ASC

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end

			
			
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END

   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;  
  
            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID  
              
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;  
              
   IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)  
   BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spReportsStockInDocketDaily]
(
	@stockInPK int,
	@userFK int
)	
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data; Ensure this proc has a low impact when executed */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED; SET DEADLOCK_PRIORITY LOW

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT
	,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;
	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	DECLARE @var_stockInPK int, @var_userFK int
	SET @var_stockInPK = @stockInPK; SET @var_userFK = @userFK
	SET @ParameterDetails = '@stockInPK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_stockInPK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@userFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_userFK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'')

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    BEGIN
            SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

            INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
            SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

            SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    END


	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY
			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start
			
			DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #tempStockIn
			SELECT * INTO #tempStockIn FROM dbo.tblstockIns si WHERE stockInPk = @var_stockInPK

			DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #tempContainerIn
			SELECT ci.* INTO #tempContainerIn FROM dbo.tblContainerins ci INNER JOIN #tempStockIn si ON containerinfk = containerinpk

			DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #tempStockInLines
			SELECT * INTO #tempStockInLines FROM dbo.tblstockInLines sil WHERE stockInFk = @var_stockInPK

			
			DECLARE @noLines int
			SELECT @noLines = count(stockinlinepk) FROM #tempStockInLines

			DECLARE @ReceiptedBy nvarchar(200)
			Select @ReceiptedBy = peeps.FirstName + ' ' + peeps.LastName
			From tblUsers users
			inner join tblPeople peeps on
			peeps.PersonPK = users.PersonFK
			Where users.UserPK = (SELECT insertedby FROM #tempStockIn)
						
			Select cIns.GoodsInNumber, cIns.DateIn, @ReceiptedBy AS ReceiptedBy,
			div.DivisionName, div.Address1 DivisionAddress1, div.Address2 DivisionAddress2, div.Address3 DivisionAddress3, div.Address4 DivisionAddress4, div.Address5 DivisionAddress5,
			suppliers.Supplier AS SupplierName,  suppliers.Address1 SupplierAddress1, 	
			case when tdi.StockInCount >= 0 THEN tdi.StockInCount ELSE @noLines END AS LineNumber, 
			stockItems.StockItemCode, stockItems.Description as Description, 
			 sInLines.Pallets, sInLines.UnitsPerPack, sInLines.Pallets * sInLines.UnitsPerPack AS Units,
			syst.DocketHeaderLine1, 
			syst.DocketHeaderLine2, 
			syst.DocketHeaderLine3, 
			syst.DocketFooterPart1,
			syst.DocketFooterPart2Line1, 
			syst.DocketFooterPart2Line2, 
			syst.DocketFooterPart2Line3, 
			syst.DocketFooterPart2Line4,			
			Building.BuildingName + ' - ' + bu.BuildingUnit  BuildingUnit
				
			from #tempStockIn sIns
			inner join #tempContainerIn cIns ON cIns.ContainerInPK = sIns.ContainerInFK
			left outer join tblSuppliers suppliers on suppliers.SupplierPK = 191 /*how do we make this flexible when docket details are automated?*/
			inner join tblDivisions div on div.DivisionPK = sIns.DivisionFK
			--INNER JOIN tblcustomers custs ON divisions.customerfk = custs.customerpk
			INNER JOIN (
				SELECT stockinfk, free1 AS LineNumber, StockItemfk, Units AS UnitsPerPack, Sum(Pallets) AS Pallets
				FROM #tempStockInLines
				GROUP BY stockinfk, free1, StockItemfk, Units
			)sInLines ON sInLines.stockinfk = sIns.StockInPK
			--inner join #tempStockInLines sInLines on sInLines.StockInFK = sIns.StockInPK			
			inner join tblStockItems stockItems ON stockItems.StockItemPK = sInLines.StockItemFK
			inner join appSystem syst ON 1=1 --only one record in the system.. join it			
			left outer join tblbuildingUnits bu on buildingunitpk = cIns.buildingunitfk
			left outer join tblbuildings building on bu.buildingfk = building.buildingpk
			INNER JOIN dbo.tblDailyInventory tdi ON tdi.StockInFK = sIns.StockInPK
			Order BY cast (LineNumber AS int)

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end

			
			
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END
GO
