-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spReportsStockInPackingList]
(
	@stockInPK int
)	
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data; Ensure this proc has a low impact when executed */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED; SET DEADLOCK_PRIORITY LOW

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT
	,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;
	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	DECLARE @var_stockInPK int
	SET @var_stockInPK = @stockInPK
	SET @ParameterDetails = '@stockInPK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_stockInPK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'')

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    --BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

		SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END


	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY
			

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start

			DECLARE StockInLines CURSOR FAST_FORWARD FOR
			Select sis.StockItemCode, sils.Batch, sils.IsMixedPallet, sils.Pallets,  sils.Units, sils.Eaches, case when sis.EachesTypeFK > 0 then 
			'EA' else 'UNITS' end as UOM, siucs.UnitCost, currs.CurrencySymbol,
			sis.DefaultVolumePerEach, volumeUTs.Abbreviation
			from tblStockIns sins 
			inner join tblStockInLines sils on
			sils.StockInFK = sins.StockInPK
			inner join tblStockItems sis on
			sils.StockItemFK = sis.StockItemPK
			left outer join (
				Select subSiucs.StockItemFK, max(subSiucs.StockItemUnitCostPK) as StockItemUnitCostPK
				from tblStockItemUnitCosts subSiucs
				Group By StockItemFK
			) siucsP1 on
			siucsP1.StockItemFK = sis.StockItemPK
			left outer join tblStockItemUnitCosts siucs on
			siucs.StockItemUnitCostPK = siucsP1.StockItemUnitCostPK
			left outer join tblCurrencies currs on
			currs.CurrencyPK = siucs.CurrencyFK
			left outer join tblUnitTypes as VolumeUTs on
			volumeUTs.UnitTypePK = sis.VolumeUnitTypeFK
			where sins.StockInPK = @var_stockInPK

			Declare @lastLineMixed bit, @palletCounter int , @entryNumber int
			Set @lastLineMixed = 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/
			Set @palletCounter = 0
			Set @entryNumber = 0
			DECLARE @PackingListLines TABLE
			(
				StockItemCode nvarchar(200),
				Batch nvarchar(200),
				Units decimal(18,3),
				UOM nvarchar(100),
				UnitCost decimal(10,5),
				LineCostCurrencySymbol nvarchar(10),
				LineCost decimal(18,3),
				LineVolume decimal(18,3),
				LineVolumeType nvarchar(100),
				PalletNumber nvarchar(50),
				EntryNumber int
			)

			Declare @stockItemCode nvarchar(200), @batch nvarchar(200), @isMixedPallet bit, @pallets int, 
			@units decimal(18,3), @eaches int, @UOM nvarchar(100), @unitCost decimal(10,5), @unitCostCurrencySymbol nvarchar(10), 
			@defaultVolumePerEach decimal(18,3), @volumeUnitType nvarchar(100)
			OPEN StockInLines
			FETCH NEXT FROM StockInLines INTO @stockItemCode, @batch, @isMixedPallet, @pallets, @units, @eaches, @UOM, @unitCost, @unitCostCurrencySymbol, 
			@defaultVolumePerEach, @volumeUnitType 

			WHILE (@@FETCH_STATUS = 0)
			BEGIN
				IF (@pallets > 1) BEGIN
					Declare @i int
					Set @i = 0
					WHILE (@i <= @pallets - 1) BEGIN
						Set @palletCounter = @palletCounter + 1
						INSERT INTO @PackingListLines
						Select @stockItemCode, @batch, @units, @UOM, @unitCost, @unitCostCurrencySymbol, (@unitCost * @units), @defaultVolumePerEach * @eaches, 
						@volumeUnitType, cast(@palletCounter as nvarchar(50)), @entryNumber
						Set @entryNumber = @entryNumber + 1
						Set @i = @i + 1
					END
				END ELSE BEGIN
					IF(@pallets = 1) BEGIN
						Set @palletCounter = @palletCounter + 1
					END 
					INSERT INTO @PackingListLines
					Select @stockItemCode, @batch, @units, @UOM, @unitCost, @unitCostCurrencySymbol,(@unitCost * @units), @defaultVolumePerEach * @eaches, 
					@volumeUnitType, cast(@palletCounter as nvarchar(50)), @entryNumber
					IF(@isMixedPallet = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/) BEGIN
						set @lastLineMixed = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/
					END ELSE BEGIN
						set @lastLineMixed = 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/
					END
					Set @entryNumber = @entryNumber + 1
				END
		
			FETCH NEXT FROM StockInLines INTO @stockItemCode, @batch, @isMixedPallet, @pallets, @units, @eaches, @UOM, @unitCost, @unitCostCurrencySymbol, 
			@defaultVolumePerEach, @volumeUnitType 
			END

			CLOSE StockInLines
			DEALLOCATE StockInLines

			Declare @divisionFK int, @customerFK int
			Select @divisionFK = DivisionFK, @customerFK = CustomerFK from tblStockIns sins inner join tblDivisions divs on divs.DivisionPK = sins.DivisionFK 
			where StockInPK = @var_stockInPK

			Select StockItemCode,Batch,Units,UOM,UnitCost,LineCostCurrencySymbol,LineCost,
			skidTotals.LineVolume,LineVolumeType,listLines.PalletNumber,EntryNumber, 
			dplpss.*, cins.DateIn, @palletCounter PalletCount, cins.ShippedDate, cins.InceptionDate, sins.GoodsInNumber
			from @PackingListLines listLines
			inner join tblStockIns sins on
			sins.StockInPK = @var_stockInPK
			inner join tblContainerIns cins on
			cins.ContainerInPK = sins.ContainerInFK
			left outer join tblExtraDockets dpls on
			dpls.CustomerFK = @customerFK AND dpls.ExtraDocketTypeFK = 1 /*StockInPackingList*/
			left outer join tblExtraDocketParameterSets dplpss on
			dplpss.ExtraDocketFK = dpls.ExtraDocketPK
			left outer join (Select sum(LineVolume) LineVolume, PalletNumber 
							from @PackingListLines
							Group By PalletNumber
							) skidTotals on
			skidTotals.PalletNumber = listLines.PalletNumber
			Order by EntryNumber ASC

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end

			
			
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END
GO

--EXEC dbo.spReportsStockInSummaryForDivision
--    @SelectedDivisions = '319',
--    @GroupByBuilding = 1,
--    @GroupByDivision = 1,
--    @GroupByAddressType = 1,
--    @StartDate = '2019-11-01',
--    @EndDate = '2023-05-26';

/****************************************************************************************
Author      : Archana Singh
Created Date: 21-Jul-2026

Description :
    Retrieves the stock in summary report for selected divisions over a date range.

    The procedure calculates:
    - Total Pallets In
    - Total Dockets In

    Report can be grouped dynamically by:
    - Building
    - Division
    - Supplier Type (Delivery Type)

Parameters  :
    @SelectedDivisions - Comma separated list of Division IDs.
    @GroupByBuilding   - Includes Building grouping when enabled.
    @GroupByDivision   - Includes Division grouping when enabled.
    @GroupByAddressType- Includes Supplier Type grouping when enabled.
    @StartDate         - Report start date.
    @EndDate           - Report end date.

Notes       :
    - Uses dynamic SQL to support optional grouping fields.
    - Maintains the same output order as the original C# query.
    - Uses parameterized dates to prevent datetime conversion issues.
****************************************************************************************/

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spReportsStockInSummaryForDivision]
(
    @SelectedDivisions NVARCHAR(MAX),
    @GroupByBuilding BIT,
    @GroupByDivision BIT,
    @GroupByAddressType BIT,
    @StartDate DATETIME,
    @EndDate DATETIME
)
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    DECLARE @Fields NVARCHAR(MAX) = '';
    DECLARE @Grouping NVARCHAR(MAX) = '';
    DECLARE @Sorting NVARCHAR(MAX) = '';
    DECLARE @SQL NVARCHAR(MAX);


    -- Date always included (same as C#)
    SET @Fields = 'CONVERT(VARCHAR(50), ForDate,106) AS [Date],';

    SET @Sorting = 'ForDate DESC';


    -- Building
    IF @GroupByBuilding = 1
    BEGIN
        SET @Fields = @Fields + 'BuildingName,';
        SET @Grouping = @Grouping + 'BuildingName,';
        SET @Sorting = @Sorting + ',BuildingName';
    END


    -- Division
    IF @GroupByDivision = 1
    BEGIN
        SET @Fields = @Fields + 'DivisionName,';
        SET @Grouping = @Grouping + 'DivisionName,';
        SET @Sorting = @Sorting + ',DivisionName';
    END


    -- Supplier Type
    IF @GroupByAddressType = 1
    BEGIN
        SET @Fields = @Fields + 'SupplierType AS [Delivery Type],';
        SET @Grouping = @Grouping + 'SupplierType,';
        SET @Sorting = @Sorting + ',SupplierType';
    END


    -- Always included
    SET @Fields = @Fields + 
        'SUM(PalletsIn) AS [Total Pallets],
         SUM(DocketsIn) AS [Total Dockets]';


    -- Remove trailing comma before adding date grouping
    IF RIGHT(@Grouping,1) = ','
        SET @Grouping = LEFT(@Grouping,LEN(@Grouping)-1);


    SET @Grouping = 
        CASE 
            WHEN LEN(@Grouping) > 0 
            THEN @Grouping + ',ForDate'
            ELSE 'ForDate'
        END;



    SET @SQL = '

    SELECT ' + @Fields + '

    FROM tblReportsDivisionDailyStockInSummary tds

    INNER JOIN tblDivisions td
        ON tds.DivisionFK = td.DivisionPK

    INNER JOIN tblBuildings tb
        ON tb.BuildingPK = tds.BuildingFK

    INNER JOIN appSupplierTypes ast
        ON ast.SupplierTypePK = tds.SupplierTypeFK


    WHERE tds.ForDate >= @StartDate
      AND tds.ForDate < DATEADD(DAY,1,@EndDate)

      AND tds.DivisionFK IN (' + @SelectedDivisions + ')


    GROUP BY ' + @Grouping + '

    ORDER BY ' + @Sorting;



    EXEC sp_executesql
        @SQL,
        N'@StartDate DATETIME,
          @EndDate DATETIME',
        @StartDate,
        @EndDate;

END
GO

 SET @var_divisionFKs = @divisionFKs; SET @var_stockItemFK = @stockItemFK; 
  
 SET @ParameterDetails = '@divisionFKs = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_divisionFKs AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@stockItemFK = '   
  + ISNULL(CAST(@var_stockItemFK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'')  
  
    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL   
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)  
  
    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)  
    --BEGIN  
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC   
  
  SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)  
  
        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)  
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK  
  
        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

 SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);  
 SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails  
 ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;  
 INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()  
  
 WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3

   DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #tmpDivisions  
   SELECT * into #tmpDivisions from tblDivisions where (',' + @var_divisionFKs +',' LIKE '%,' + CONVERT(VARCHAR, DivisionPK) + ',%')  
     
	select divs.DivisionPK,divs.DivisionName ,sis.StockItemCode,allergenaudit.description as EventDescription, allergenaudit.InsertedDate as EventDate, pep.FirstName + ' ' + pep.LastName as EventRecordedBy
	from #tmpDivisions divs  
	inner join tblStockItems sis ON sis.DivisionFK = divs.DivisionPK  
	inner join tblstockItemAllergenCodes allergen on allergen.StockitemFK=sis.stockitempk
	inner join tblstockItemAllergenCodesAudit allergenaudit ON allergenaudit.StockItemAllergenCodeFK = allergen.StockItemAllergenCodePK  
	inner join tblusers us on us.UserPK = allergenaudit.InsertedBy
	inner join tblPeople pep on us.PersonFK = pep.PersonPK
	where  (@var_stockItemFK = -1 OR @var_stockItemFK = allergen.stockitemfk)
		and allergenaudit.inserteddate >= @FromDate
		and allergenaudit.inserteddate <= @endDate
   -- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end  


   
  
     
     
   BREAK  
  END TRY  
  BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */  
   DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;  
   SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;  
   SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;  
  
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY   
   BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;  
         
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;  
  
            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID  
              
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;  
              
   IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)  
   BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END  
   ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */  
  END CATCH  
  SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1  
 END  
END
GO

-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spReportsStockItemAuditHistory]
(
	@stockItemFK int,
	@dateFrom datetime = '1753-01-01 00:00:00',
	@dateTo datetime = '1753-01-01 00:00:00'
)	
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data; Ensure this proc has a low impact when executed */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED; SET DEADLOCK_PRIORITY LOW

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT
	,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;
	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	DECLARE @var_stockItemFK int, @var_dateFrom datetime, @var_dateTo datetime

	SET @var_stockItemFK = @stockItemFK; SET @var_dateFrom = @dateFrom; SET @var_dateTo = @dateTo

	SET @ParameterDetails = '@stockItemFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_stockItemFK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@dateFrom = ' 
		+ ISNULL(CAST(@var_dateFrom AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@dateTo = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_dateTo AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'')

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    --BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

		SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END


	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY
			

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start

			Select convert(varchar(50), EventDate, 103) as [EventDate],
			EventTypeFK,
			case EventTypeFK when 1 then 'PalletCreated' 
			when 17 then 'Stock Movement'
			when 3 then 'Stock Removed'
			when 2 then 'Pallet Removed'
			else 'Other Event' end EventType,
			case EventTypeFK when 1 then 'Goods In Number ' + cins.GoodsInNumber 
			when 17 then 'Works Order ' + cast(wos.WorksOrderPK as nvarchar(100))
			when 3 then 'Goods Order Number ' + cOuts.GoodsOrderNumber 
			when 2 then 'Goods Order Number ' + cOuts.GoodsOrderNumber 
			else 'Other Event' end EventIdentifier,
			case EventTypeFK when 1 then cast(sils.Units as nvarchar(50)) + ' Units'
			when 17 then case when woms.EntirePallet = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ then '1' else '0' end + ' Pallet ' + cast(woms.Units as nvarchar(50)) + 
				' Units from ' +
				case woms.SourceLocationTypeFK 
					when 2 then 'LoadingBay '  
					when 1 then 
			
					case when sourceBuRows.Translate = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ then
						case when sourceBuRows.ReverseTranslate = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ then
							sourceBuRows.TranslatedRow + right('0' + cast((sourceBuRows.TranslateColumn - sourceBuCols.BuildingUnitColumn) as nvarchar(10)),2) 
							+ lower(sourceBuBays.BayLevel) + right('0' + cast(woms.SourceBayPosition as nvarchar(10)),2) 
						else
							sourceBuRows.TranslatedRow + right('0' + cast((sourceBuCols.BuildingUnitColumn + sourceBuRows.TranslateColumn) as nvarchar(10)),2) 
							+ lower(sourceBuBays.BayLevel) + right('0' + cast(woms.SourceBayPosition as nvarchar(10)),2) 
						End
					else 
						sourceBuRows.Row + right('0' + cast(sourceBuCols.BuildingUnitColumnName as nvarchar(10)),2) + lower(sourceBuBays.BayLevel) + right('0' 
						+ cast(woms.SourceBayPosition as nvarchar(10)),2) 
					End
 
				end
				+ ' into ' + 
				case woms.DestinationLocationTypeFK when 2 then 'LoadingBay ' 
				when 1 then 
			
					case when buRows.Translate = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ then
						case when buRows.ReverseTranslate = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ then
							buRows.TranslatedRow + right('0' + cast((buRows.TranslateColumn - buCols.BuildingUnitColumn) as nvarchar(10)),2) + lower(buBays.BayLevel) 
							+ right('0' + cast(woms.DestinationBayPosition as nvarchar(10)),2) 
						else
							buRows.TranslatedRow + right('0' + cast((buCols.BuildingUnitColumn + buRows.TranslateColumn) as nvarchar(10)),2) + lower(buBays.BayLevel) 
							+ right('0' + cast(woms.DestinationBayPosition as nvarchar(10)),2) 
						End
					else 
						buRows.Row + right('0' + cast(buCols.BuildingUnitColumnName as nvarchar(10)),2) + lower(buBays.BayLevel) + right('0' 
						+ cast(woms.DestinationBayPosition as nvarchar(10)),2) 
					End
 
				end + ' as part of ' + case wos.WorksOrderOriginFK when 1 then 'Stock In ' + womCins.GoodsInNumber when 2 then 'Stock Order ' 
				+ womCouts.GoodsOrderNumber when 3 then 'StockOut' when 10 then 'Manual Movement' end 
			when 3 then cast(cols.Pallets as nvarchar(50)) + ' Pallets ' + cast(cols.Eaches as nvarchar(50)) + ' Eaches ' + cast(cols.Units as nvarchar(50)) + ' Units'
			when 2 then cast(cols.Pallets as nvarchar(50)) + ' Pallets ' + cast(cols.Eaches as nvarchar(50)) + ' Eaches ' + cast(cols.Units as nvarchar(50)) + ' Units'
			else 'Other Event' end EventDescription
	
			from tblPalletAudit pa
			inner join tblStockItems sis on
			sis.StockItemPK = pa.StockItemFK
			left outer join tblContainerOutLines cols on
			cols.ContainerOutLinePK = EventFK
			left outer join tblContainerOuts cOuts on
			cOuts.ContainerOutPK = cols.ContainerOutFK
			left outer join tblWorksOrderMovements woms on
			woms.WorksOrderMovementPK = EventFK
			left outer join tblWorksOrders wos on
			wos.WorksOrderPK = woms.WorksORderFK

			left outer join tblStockIns womSins on
			womSins.StockInPK = wos.FK
			left outer join tblContainerIns womCins on
			womCins.ContainerInPK = womSins.ContainerInFK

			left outer join tblStockOrders sos on
			sos.StockOrderPK = wos.FK
			left outer join tblContainerOuts womCouts on
			womCouts.ContainerOutPK = sos.ContainerOutFK
	
			left outer join tblBuildingUnitBays buBays on
			buBays.BuildingUnitBayPK = DestinationFK
			left outer join tblBuildingUnitColumns buCols on
			buCols.BuildingUnitColumnPK = buBays.BuildingUnitColumnFK
			left outer join tblBuildingUnitRows buRows on
			buRows.BuildingUnitRowPK = buCols.BuildingUnitRowFK

			left outer join tblBuildingUnitBays sourceBuBays on
			sourceBuBays.BuildingUnitBayPK = SourceLocationFK
			left outer join tblBuildingUnitColumns sourceBuCols on
			sourceBuCols.BuildingUnitColumnPK = sourceBuBays.BuildingUnitColumnFK
			left outer join tblBuildingUnitRows sourceBuRows on
			sourceBuRows.BuildingUnitRowPK = sourceBuCols.BuildingUnitRowFK

			left outer join tblStockInLines sils on
			sils.StockInLinePK = EventFK
			left outer join tblStockIns sins on
			sins.StockInPK = sils.StockInFK
			left outer join tblContainerIns cins on
			cins.ContainerInPK = sins.ContainerInFK


			Where pa.StockItemFK = @var_stockItemFK
			Order By /*Convert(nvarchar(50),*/ pa.EventDate/*,  111)*/ ASC
			--case EventTypeFK when 1 then 0 when 17 ASC

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end

			
			
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END
GO

--EXEC dbo.spReportsStockLevelsSummaryForDivision
--    @SelectedDivisions = '319',
--    @StartDate = '2019-11-01',
--    @EndDate = '2026-07-21',
--    @GroupByDivision = 1,
--    @GroupByBuilding = 1;


/****************************************************************************************
Author      : Archana Singh
Created Date: 21-Jul-2026
Description :
    Retrieves the stock level summary report for selected divisions over a date range.

    The procedure calculates:
    - Total Pallets currently in stock.

    Data is combined from:
    - Daily Stock Levels
    - Daily Stock In Summary
    - Daily Stock Out Summary

    Report can be grouped dynamically by:
    - Division
    - Building
Parameters  :
    @SelectedDivisions - Comma separated list of Division IDs.
    @StartDate         - Report start date.
    @EndDate           - Report end date.
    @GroupByDivision   - Includes Division grouping when enabled.
    @GroupByBuilding   - Includes Building grouping when enabled.

Notes       :
    - Uses dynamic SQL to support optional grouping.
    - Uses temporary tables to calculate daily pallet, stock in and stock out data.
    - Date filtering uses parameterized datetime values to avoid conversion errors.
****************************************************************************************/

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spReportsStockLevelsSummaryForDivision]
(
    @SelectedDivisions NVARCHAR(MAX),
    @StartDate DATETIME,
    @EndDate DATETIME,
    @GroupByDivision BIT,
    @GroupByBuilding BIT
)
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;


    DECLARE @Fields NVARCHAR(MAX) = '';
    DECLARE @Grouping NVARCHAR(MAX) = '';
    DECLARE @Sorting NVARCHAR(MAX) = '';
    DECLARE @SQL NVARCHAR(MAX);


    SET @Fields = 
        'CONVERT(VARCHAR(50), tlevels.ForDate,106) AS [Date],';

    SET @Grouping = 'tlevels.ForDate';
    SET @Sorting = 'tlevels.ForDate DESC';


    IF @GroupByDivision = 1
    BEGIN
        SET @Fields = @Fields + 'DivisionName,';
        SET @Grouping = @Grouping + ',DivisionName';
        SET @Sorting = @Sorting + ',DivisionName';
    END


    IF @GroupByBuilding = 1
    BEGIN
        SET @Fields = @Fields + 'BuildingName AS Building,';
        SET @Grouping = @Grouping + ',BuildingName';
        SET @Sorting = @Sorting + ',BuildingName';
    END


    SET @Fields = @Fields +
        'SUM(tlevels.NoPallets) AS [Total Pallets]';



    SET @SQL = '

    IF OBJECT_ID(''TEMPDB..#TempDailyPalletCount'') IS NOT NULL
        DROP TABLE #TempDailyPalletCount;


    ;WITH cte AS
    (
        SELECT *,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER
        (
            PARTITION BY ' +
            CASE WHEN @GroupByBuilding = 1 
                 THEN 'BuildingUnitFK,' ELSE '' END +
            CASE WHEN @GroupByDivision = 1 
                 THEN 'DivisionFK,' ELSE '' END +
            'ForDate
            ORDER BY ForDate DESC
        ) rn

        FROM tblReportsDivisionDailyStockLevels

        WHERE ForDate >= @StartDate
          AND ForDate < DATEADD(DAY,1,@EndDate)
    )

    SELECT 
        ForDate,' +
        CASE WHEN @GroupByBuilding = 1 
             THEN 'BuildingUnitFK,' ELSE '' END +
        CASE WHEN @GroupByDivision = 1 
             THEN 'DivisionFK,' ELSE '' END +
        'PalletsIn,
        PalletsOut

    INTO #TempDailyPalletCount

    FROM cte
    WHERE rn = 1;



    IF OBJECT_ID(''TEMPDB..#TempDailyStockOuts'') IS NOT NULL
        DROP TABLE #TempDailyStockOuts;


    SELECT ' +
        CASE WHEN @GroupByBuilding = 1 
             THEN 'BuildingUnitFK,' ELSE '' END +
        CASE WHEN @GroupByDivision = 1 
             THEN 'DivisionFK,' ELSE '' END +
        '
        SUM(DocketsOut) DocketsOut,
        SUM(PalletsOut) PalletsOut,
        ForDate

    INTO #TempDailyStockOuts

    FROM tblReportsDivisionDailyStockOutSummary

    WHERE ForDate >= @StartDate
      AND ForDate < DATEADD(DAY,1,@EndDate)

      AND DivisionFK IN (' + @SelectedDivisions + ')

    GROUP BY ' +
        CASE WHEN @GroupByBuilding = 1 
             THEN 'BuildingUnitFK,' ELSE '' END +
        CASE WHEN @GroupByDivision = 1 
             THEN 'DivisionFK,' ELSE '' END +
        'ForDate;



    IF OBJECT_ID(''TEMPDB..#TempDailyStockIns'') IS NOT NULL
        DROP TABLE #TempDailyStockIns;


    SELECT ' +
        CASE WHEN @GroupByBuilding = 1 
             THEN 'BuildingUnitFK,' ELSE '' END +
        CASE WHEN @GroupByDivision = 1 
             THEN 'DivisionFK,' ELSE '' END +
        '
        SUM(DocketsIn) DocketsIn,
        SUM(PalletsIn) PalletsIn,
        ForDate

    INTO #TempDailyStockIns

    FROM tblReportsDivisionDailyStockInSummary

    WHERE ForDate >= @StartDate
      AND ForDate < DATEADD(DAY,1,@EndDate)

      AND DivisionFK IN (' + @SelectedDivisions + ')

    GROUP BY ' +
        CASE WHEN @GroupByBuilding = 1 
             THEN 'BuildingUnitFK,' ELSE '' END +
        CASE WHEN @GroupByDivision = 1 
             THEN 'DivisionFK,' ELSE '' END +
        'ForDate;



    SELECT ' + @Fields + '

    FROM tblReportsDivisionDailyStockLevels tlevels

    INNER JOIN #TempDailyPalletCount daily
        ON daily.ForDate = tlevels.ForDate ' +

        CASE WHEN @GroupByDivision = 1
             THEN ' AND daily.DivisionFK = tlevels.DivisionFK '
             ELSE '' END +

        CASE WHEN @GroupByBuilding = 1
             THEN ' AND daily.BuildingUnitFK = tlevels.BuildingUnitFK '
             ELSE '' END +


    ' LEFT JOIN #TempDailyStockOuts tso
        ON tso.ForDate = tlevels.ForDate ' +

        CASE WHEN @GroupByDivision = 1
             THEN ' AND tso.DivisionFK = tlevels.DivisionFK '
             ELSE '' END +

        CASE WHEN @GroupByBuilding = 1
             THEN ' AND tso.BuildingUnitFK = tlevels.BuildingUnitFK '
             ELSE '' END +


    ' LEFT JOIN #TempDailyStockIns tsi
        ON tsi.ForDate = tlevels.ForDate ' +

        CASE WHEN @GroupByDivision = 1
             THEN ' AND tsi.DivisionFK = tlevels.DivisionFK '
             ELSE '' END +

        CASE WHEN @GroupByBuilding = 1
             THEN ' AND tsi.BuildingUnitFK = tlevels.BuildingUnitFK '
             ELSE '' END +


    ' INNER JOIN tblBuildingUnits tbu
        ON tlevels.BuildingUnitFK = tbu.BuildingUnitPK

      INNER JOIN tblBuildings tb
        ON tb.BuildingPK = tbu.BuildingFK

      INNER JOIN tblDivisions td
        ON td.DivisionPK = tlevels.DivisionFK

    WHERE tlevels.DivisionFK IN (' + @SelectedDivisions + ')

      AND tlevels.ForDate >= @StartDate
      AND tlevels.ForDate < DATEADD(DAY,1,@EndDate)

    GROUP BY ' + @Grouping + '
    ORDER BY ' + @Sorting;

    EXEC sp_executesql
        @SQL,
        N'@StartDate DATETIME,
          @EndDate DATETIME',
        @StartDate,
        @EndDate;

END
GO

-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spReportsStockMovementsDaily]
(
	@divisionFKs nvarchar(500),
	@dtFrom datetime,
	@dtTo datetime
)	
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data; Ensure this proc has a low impact when executed */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED; SET DEADLOCK_PRIORITY LOW

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT
	,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;
	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	DECLARE @var_divisionFKs nvarchar(500), @var_dtFrom datetime, @var_dtTo datetime

	SET @var_divisionFKs = @divisionFKs; SET @var_dtFrom = @dtFrom; SET @var_dtTo = @dtTo

	SET @ParameterDetails = '@divisionFKs = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_divisionFKs AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@dtFrom = ' 
		+ ISNULL(CAST(@var_dtFrom AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@dtTo = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_dtTo AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'')

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    BEGIN
            SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

            INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
            SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

            SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    END


	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY
			

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start

			--Declare @divisionFK int, @var_dtFrom datetime, @var_dtTo datetime

			--Select @divisionFK = 617, @var_dtFrom = '09/01/2013', @var_dtTo = '10/26/2013'

			Declare @divisionName as nvarchar(200)
			Select Top 1 @divisionName = DivisionName from tblDivisions WHERE (',' + @var_divisionFKs +',' LIKE '%,' + CONVERT(VARCHAR, DivisionPK) + ',%')

			/******************************************************************************************************************************************/
			--inward
			DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #tmpContainerIns
			SELECT cIns.ContainerInPK, StockInStatusFK, DateIn, goodsinnumber, Free2, Free4,InsertedDate, ContainerNumber
			INTO #tmpContainerIns 
			FROM tblContainerIns cIns 
			Where cIns.StockInStatusFK <> 4 /*Cancelled*/ 
				AND cIns.DateIn BETWEEN @var_dtFrom AND @var_dtTo
			
			DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #tmpStockIns
			SELECT sins.StockInPK, sins.ContainerInFK 
			INTO #tmpStockIns
			FROM tblStockIns sins
			INNER JOIN #tmpContainerIns cIns ON sins.ContainerInFK = cIns.ContainerInPK
			WHERE (',' + @var_divisionFKs +',' LIKE '%,' + CONVERT(VARCHAR, sins.DivisionFK) + ',%')

			DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #tmpStockInLines
			SELECT sils.StockInLinePK, sils.stockinfk, sils.StockItemFK, sils.batch, sils.Pallets, sils.Units 
			INTO #tmpStockInLines  
			from tblstockinlines sils
			inner join #tmpStockIns sins on sils.StockInFK = sins.StockInPK

			DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #tmpPalletAudit
			SELECT count(*) PalletsIn, EventFK 
			INTO #tmpPalletAudit  
			from tblPalletAudit pa
			inner join #tmpStockInLines sils on pa.EventFK = sils.StockInLinePK AND eventtypefk = 1
			Group By EventFK

			/******************************************************************************************************************************************/
			--outward

			DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #tmpContainerOut
			SELECT ContainerOutPK, ContainerOutstatusFK, DocketValue1, DocketValue2, InsertedDate, ContainerNumber, CollectionDate, goodsordernumber
			into #tmpContainerOut
			FROM tblContainerOuts cOuts
			where cOuts.ContainerOutStatusFK <> 6 /*Cancelled*/ AND
			cOuts.CollectionDate BETWEEN @var_dtFrom AND @var_dtTo
			
			DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #tmpContainerOutLines
			SELECT cols.ContainerOutLinePK, cols.ContainerOutFK, cols.StockItemFK, cols.Batch
			INTO #tmpContainerOutLines
			FROM tblContainerOutLines cols
			INNER JOIN #tmpContainerOut cOuts ON cols.ContainerOutFK = cOuts.ContainerOutPK
			WHERE (',' + @var_divisionFKs +',' LIKE '%,' + CONVERT(VARCHAR, cols.DivisionFK) + ',%')

			DROP TABLE IF exists #tmpContainerOutPallets
			SELECT ContainerOutLineFK, Palletfk, Units
			INTO #tmpContainerOutPallets
			FROM tblcontaineroutlinepalletcontent colpc
			INNER JOIN #tmpContainerOutLines cols ON colpc.ContainerOutLineFK = cols.ContainerOutLinePK
			
			/******************************************************************************************************************************************/
			--main query

			Select 
				@divisionName as DivisionName, 
				@var_dtFrom DateFrom,
				@var_dtTo DateTo,		
				CASE WHEN DateProcessed='01-01-1900'then'Pending'ELSE DateProcessed END AS DateProcessed,
				Status, 
				OrderNo,
				Reference,		
				StockItemCode, 
				Description,
				Batch, 
				PalletsIn, 
				QuantityIn,
				PalletsOut,
				QuantityOut,
				[Date Raised],
				CASE WHEN  STATUS <> 'Completed' THEN '' ELSE cast(DATEDIFF( day ,[Date Raised],DateProcessed ) AS nvarchar(10)) END AS [Days to Complete],
				ContainerNumber
			from (
				select 			
				   case when cIns.StockInStatusFK =1 then CONVERT(varchar,  '01-01-1900', 120)    
						when cIns.StockInStatusFK =2 then CONVERT(varchar,  '01-01-1900', 120)  
						when cIns.StockInStatusFK =3 THEN CONVERT(varchar,  cIns.DateIn, 120)
						when cIns.StockInStatusFK =4 then CONVERT(varchar,  '01-01-1900', 120)   
					end as  DateProcessed,				
					cIns.goodsinnumber as[OrderNo],
					'PO/STO:'+cIns.Free2 +'/'+ cIns.Free4 as Reference,
					sis.StockItemCode, 
					sis.Description,
					sils.Batch, 
					isnull(palletsIn.PalletsIn, 0) PalletsIn,
					case when sils.Pallets = 0 then 1 
					else sils.Pallets end * sils.Units as QuantityIn, 
					0 PalletsOut, 0 QuantityOut,
					case when cIns.StockInStatusFK =1 then 'On Route'   
					when cIns.StockInStatusFK =2 then 'PendingRacking' 
					when cIns.StockInStatusFK =3 then 'Completed' 
					when cIns.StockInStatusFK =4 then 'Cancelled' 			
					End as [Status],
					cIns.InsertedDate AS [Date Raised],
					cIns.ContainerNumber
				from #tmpContainerIns cIns 
				inner join #tmpStockIns sins on sins.ContainerInFK = cIns.ContainerInPK
				inner join #tmpStockInLines sils on sils.StockInFK = sins.StockInPK
				inner join tblStockItems sis on sis.StockItemPK = sils.StockItemFK
				left outer JOIN #tmpPalletAudit palletsIn on palletsIn.EventFK = sils.StockInLinePK

			UNION ALL

			SELECT	
				case when cOuts.ContainerOutstatusFK =1 then CONVERT(varchar,  '01-01-1900', 120)    
					when cOuts.ContainerOutstatusFK =2 then CONVERT(varchar,  '01-01-1900', 120)  
					when cOuts.ContainerOutstatusFK =3 then CONVERT(varchar,  '01-01-1900', 120)   
					when cOuts.ContainerOutstatusFK =4 then CONVERT(varchar,  '01-01-1900', 120)   
					when cOuts.ContainerOutstatusFK =5 then CONVERT(varchar,  CollectionDate, 120) 
					when cOuts.ContainerOutstatusFK =6 then CONVERT(varchar, '01-01-1900', 120) 
				END AS DateProcessed,
				goodsordernumber AS [OrderNo],
				'PO/STO:'+docketvalue2+'/'+cOuts.DocketValue1,			
				StockItemCode, 
				sis.Description,
				cols.Batch,
				0 PalletsIn,
				0 QuantityIn, 
				isnull(palletsOut.PalletsOut, 0) as PalletsOut, 
				QuantityOut,
				case when cOuts.ContainerOutstatusFK =1 then 'Pending'   
					when cOuts.ContainerOutstatusFK =2 then 'UserAssigned' 
					when cOuts.ContainerOutstatusFK =3 then 'WorkAssigned' 
					when cOuts.ContainerOutstatusFK =4 then 'WorkCompleted' 
					when cOuts.ContainerOutstatusFK =5 then 'Completed' 
					when cOuts.ContainerOutstatusFK =6 then 'Cancelled' 
				End as [Status] ,
				cOuts.InsertedDate AS [Date Raised],
				ContainerNumber
			from #tmpContainerOut cOuts 
			inner join #tmpContainerOutLines cols ON cols.ContainerOutFK = cOuts.ContainerOutPK
			inner join tblStockItems sis ON sis.StockItemPK = cols.StockItemFK
			left outer join (
				Select count(DISTINCT palletfk) PalletsOut, ContainerOutLineFK 
				from #tmpContainerOutPallets pa
				Group By ContainerOutLineFK
			)palletsOut ON palletsOut.ContainerOutLineFK = cols.ContainerOutLinePK
			inner join (
				Select sum(Units) QuantityOut, ContainerOutLineFK
				from #tmpContainerOutPallets colpc
				Group By ContainerOutLineFK
			) colpc on
			colpc.ContainerOutLineFK = cols.ContainerOutLinePK

			) subQ
			Order By DateProcessed ASC, Reference ASC, StockItemCode ASC, Batch ASC, subQ.PalletsIn, subQ.QuantityIn, subQ.PalletsOut, subQ.QuantityOut

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end

			
			
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END
GO

	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	DECLARE @var_divisionFKs nvarchar(500), @var_dtFrom datetime, @var_dtTo datetime

	SET @var_divisionFKs = @divisionFKs; SET @var_dtFrom = @dtFrom; SET @var_dtTo = @dtTo

	SET @ParameterDetails = '@divisionFKs = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_divisionFKs AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@dtFrom = ' 
		+ ISNULL(CAST(@var_dtFrom AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@dtTo = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_dtTo AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'')

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    --BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

		SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END


	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY
			

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start

			--Declare @divisionFK int, @var_dtFrom datetime, @var_dtTo datetime

			--Select @divisionFK = 617, @var_dtFrom = '09/01/2013', @var_dtTo = '10/26/2013'

			Declare @divisionName as nvarchar(200)
			Select Top 1 @divisionName = DivisionName from tblDivisions where
			(',' + @var_divisionFKs +',' LIKE '%,' + CONVERT(VARCHAR, DivisionPK) + ',%')

			Select @divisionName as DivisionName, @var_dtFrom DateFrom, @var_dtTo DateTo, EventDate, Reference, StockItemCode, Description, Batch, PalletsIn, 
			QuantityIn, PalletsOut, QuantityOut from (
			select cIns.DateIn EventDate, cIns.GoodsInNumber as Reference, sis.StockItemCode, sis.Description, sils.Batch, 
			isnull(palletsIn.PalletsIn, 0) PalletsIn, case when sils.Pallets = 0 then 1 else sils.Pallets end * sils.Units as QuantityIn, 
			0 PalletsOut, 0 QuantityOut
				from tblContainerIns cIns 
				inner join tblStockIns sins on
				sins.ContainerInFK = cIns.ContainerInPK
				inner join tblStockInLines sils on
				sils.StockInFK = sins.StockInPK
				inner join tblStockItems sis on
				sis.StockItemPK = sils.StockItemFK
				left outer join 
				( Select count(*) PalletsIn, EventFK from tblPalletAudit
					Where EventTypeFK = 1
					Group By EventFK
				) palletsIn on
				palletsIn.EventFK = sils.StockInLinePK

				Where cIns.StockInStatusFK <> 4 /*Cancelled*/ AND
				cIns.DateIn BETWEEN @var_dtFrom AND @var_dtTo
				AND (',' + @var_divisionFKs +',' LIKE '%,' + CONVERT(VARCHAR, sis.DivisionFK) + ',%')

			UNION ALL

			Select CollectionDate, GoodsOrderNumber, StockItemCode, sis.Description, cols.Batch, 0 PalletsIn, 0 QuantityIn, 
			isnull(palletsOut.PalletsOut, 0) as PalletsOut, QuantityOut
			from tblContainerOuts cOuts 
			inner join tblContainerOutLines cols on
			cols.ContainerOutFK = cOuts.ContainerOutPK
			inner join tblStockItems sis on
			sis.StockItemPK = cols.StockItemFK
			left outer join (
				Select count(*) PalletsOut, EventFK 
				from tblPalletAudit pa
				Where EventTypeFK = 2
				Group By EventFK
			)palletsOut on
			palletsOut.EventFK = cols.ContainerOutLinePK
			inner join (
				Select sum(Units) QuantityOut, ContainerOutLineFK
				from tblContainerOutLinePalletContent colpc
				Group By ContainerOutLineFK
			) colpc on
			colpc.ContainerOutLineFK = cols.ContainerOutLinePK

			where cOuts.ContainerOutStatusFK <> 6 /*Cancelled*/ AND
			cOuts.CollectionDate BETWEEN @var_dtFrom AND @var_dtTo
				AND (',' + @var_divisionFKs +',' LIKE '%,' + CONVERT(VARCHAR, sis.DivisionFK) + ',%')

			) subQ
			Order By EventDate ASC, Reference ASC, StockItemCode ASC, Batch ASC

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end

			
			
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH

-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spReportsStockOutCosts]
(
	@containerOutFK int,
	@UserFK int
)	
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data; Ensure this proc has a low impact when executed */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED; SET DEADLOCK_PRIORITY LOW

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT
	,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;
	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	DECLARE @var_containerOutFK int
	SET @var_containerOutFK = @containerOutFK
	DECLARE @var_userFK int
	SET @var_userFK = @UserFK
	SET @ParameterDetails = '@containerOutFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_containerOutFK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'')

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    --BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

		SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END


	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY
			

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start
			IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#TempPallets') IS NOT NULL
				DROP TABLE #TempPallets
			SELECT DISTINCT palletfk INTO #TempPallets FROM dbo.viewContainerOutPalletList vcopl WHERE vcopl.ContainerOutPK = @var_containerOutFK

			IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#TempStockInRef') IS NOT NULL
				DROP TABLE #TempStockInRef
			SELECT distinct es.reference, sil.StockItemFK, sil.batch, silp.palletfk
			INTO #TempStockInRef
			FROM tblextraservices es
			INNER JOIN tblstockins si ON es.stockinfk = si.stockinpk
			INNER JOIN tblstockinlines sil ON si.stockinpk = sil.stockinfk
			INNER JOIN tblstockinlinepallets silp ON sil.stockinlinepk = silp.StockInLineFK			
			INNER JOIN dbo.tblDivisionExtraServices tdes ON es.DivisionExtraServiceFK = tdes.DivisionExtraServicePK AND si.DivisionFK = tdes.DivisionFK
			INNER JOIN dbo.tblExtraServiceCodes tesc ON tdes.ExtraServiceCodeFK = tesc.ExtraServiceCodePK AND tesc.Description = 'Inbound SAD'
			INNER JOIN #TempPallets tp ON silp.palletfk = tp.palletfk

			IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#TempStockOutRef') IS NOT NULL
				DROP TABLE #TempStockOutRef
			SELECT distinct es.reference, col.StockItemFK, col.batch 
			INTO #TempStockOutRef
			FROM tblextraservices es
			INNER JOIN tblstockorders so ON es.StockOrderFK = so.StockOrderPK AND so.ContainerOutFK = @var_containerOutFK
			INNER JOIN tblcontainerouts co ON so.containeroutfk = co.ContainerOutPK
			INNER JOIN tblcontaineroutlines col ON col.containeroutfk = co.ContainerOutPK
			INNER JOIN tblDivisionExtraServices tdes ON es.DivisionExtraServiceFK = tdes.DivisionExtraServicePK AND col.DivisionFK = tdes.DivisionFK
			INNER JOIN tblExtraServiceCodes tesc ON tdes.ExtraServiceCodeFK = tesc.ExtraServiceCodePK AND tesc.Description = 'Outbound SAD'			
			
			SELECT coalesce(sif.reference, '') AS InboundSAD, 
				CASE WHEN BatchHeading = '' THEN 'Batch' ELSE BatchHeading END AS BatchHeading, 
				cOuts.CollectionDate DateOut, 
				coalesce(sof.reference, '') AS  OutboundSAD, 
				cOuts.Address1, 
				ccs.CommodityCode, 
				sis.StockItemCode, 
				cols.Batch, 
				isnull(siucs.UnitCost, 0) UnitCost, 
				sum(colpc.Units) Units, 
				isnull(siucs.UnitCost, 0) * sum(colpc.Units) [Total Cost],
				--sum(colpc.eaches) [Boxes], 
				--sum(colpc.eaches) * sis.DefaultVolumePerEach StockVolume, 
				--sum(colpc.eaches) * sis.DefaultVolumePerEach * 0.453592 StockVolumePoundsToKilograms,
				--sum(colpc.eaches) * sis.DefaultVolumePerEach StockVolumeKilograms,
				count(distinct colpc.PalletContentFK) [Boxes], 
				count(distinct colpc.PalletContentFK) * sis.DefaultVolumePerEach StockVolume, 
				count(distinct colpc.PalletContentFK) * sis.DefaultVolumePerEach * 0.453592 StockVolumePoundsToKilograms,
				count(distinct colpc.PalletContentFK) * sis.DefaultVolumePerEach StockVolumeKilograms,
				asys.DocketHeaderLine1, asys.DocketHeaderLine2, asys.DocketHeaderLine3, asys.DocketFooterPart1,
				asys.DocketFooterPart2Line1, asys.DocketFooterPart2Line2, asys.DocketFooterPart2Line3, asys.DocketFooterPart2Line4,
				pep.Firstname + ' ' + pep.LastName AS PrintedBy, dbo.GetBSTDate() AS PrintedDate, cOuts.GoodsOrderNumber
			From tblContainerOuts cOuts
			inner join tblContainerOutLines cols ON cols.ContainerOutFK = cOuts.ContainerOutPK
			inner join tblContainerOutLinePalletContent colpc ON colpc.ContainerOutLineFK = cols.ContainerOutLinePK
			inner join tblStockItems sis ON sis.StockItemPK = cols.StockItemFK
			inner join tblDivisions divs ON divs.DivisionPK = sis.DivisionFK
			LEFT OUTER JOIN (
				SELECT distinct PalletContentFk, UnitCost
				from tblPalletContentUnitCosts pcucs 
				left outer join tblStockItemUnitCosts siucs ON siucs.StockItemUnitCostPK = pcucs.UnitCostFK
			) siucs ON siucs.PalletContentFK = colpc.PalletContentFK
			left outer join tblPalletContentCommodityCodes pcccs ON pcccs.PalletContentFK = colpc.PalletContentFK
			left outer join tblStockItemCommodityCodes siccs ON siccs.StockItemCommodityCodePK = pcccs.StockItemCommodityCodeFK
			left outer join tblCommodityCodes ccs ON ccs.CommodityCodePK = siccs.CommodityCodeFK
			LEFT outer JOIN #TempStockInRef sif ON sif.StockItemFK = cols.StockItemFK AND sif.batch = cols.Batch AND colpc.palletfk = sif.palletfk
			LEFT outer JOIN #TempStockOutRef sof ON sof.StockItemFK = cols.StockItemFK AND sof.batch = cols.Batch
			inner join appSystem asys ON 1=1
			LEFT JOIN tblusers u ON u.userpk = @var_userFK
			LEFT JOIN tblpeople pep ON pep.personpk = u.personfk
			
			Where cOuts.ContainerOutPK = @var_containerOutFK
			Group BY divs.BatchHeading, 
				cOuts.CollectionDate, 
				cOuts.Address1, 
				ccs.CommodityCode, 
				sis.StockItemCode, 
				cols.Batch, 
				siucs.UnitCost, 
				sis.DefaultVolumePerEach, 
				sif.reference, sof.reference,
				asys.DocketHeaderLine1, asys.DocketHeaderLine2, asys.DocketHeaderLine3, asys.DocketFooterPart1,
				asys.DocketFooterPart2Line1, asys.DocketFooterPart2Line2, asys.DocketFooterPart2Line3, asys.DocketFooterPart2Line4, Firstname + ' ' + pep.LastName, cOuts.GoodsOrderNumber
			ORDER BY  sis.StockItemCode, cols.Batch

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end

			
			
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spReportsStockOutDocket]    
(    
 @containerOutPK int,    
 @userFK int    
)     
AS    
BEGIN    
 /* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data; Ensure this proc has a low impact when executed */    
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED; SET DEADLOCK_PRIORITY LOW    
    
    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT    
 ,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;    
 SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();
