 DECLARE @var_containerOutPK int, @var_userFK int    
 SET @var_containerOutPK = @containerOutPK; SET @var_userFK = @userFK    
 SET @ParameterDetails = '@containerOutPK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_containerOutPK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@userFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_userFK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'')    
    
    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL     
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)    
    
    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)    
    --BEGIN    
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC     
    
  SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)    
    
        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)    
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK    
    
        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()    
    --END    
    
 SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);    
 SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails    
 ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;    
 INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()    
    
 WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3    
 BEGIN     
  BEGIN TRY    
       
    
   -- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start    
    
   IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#tempContainerOut') IS NOT NULL     
    DROP TABLE #tempContainerOut    
   SELECT * INTO #tempContainerOut FROM dbo.tblContainerOuts tco WHERE tco.ContainerOutPK = @var_containerOutPK    
          
   IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#tempContainerOutLines') IS NOT NULL     
    DROP TABLE #tempContainerOutLines    
   SELECT * INTO #tempContainerOutLines FROM dbo.tblContainerOutLines tcol WHERE tcol.ContainerOutFK = @var_containerOutPK    
    
   IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#tempContainerOutLinePalletContent') IS NOT NULL     
    DROP TABLE #tempContainerOutLinePalletContent    
   SELECT tcolpc.* INTO #tempContainerOutLinePalletContent FROM dbo.tblContainerOutLinePalletContent tcolpc INNER JOIN #tempContainerOutLines tcol ON tcolpc.ContainerOutLineFK = tcol.ContainerOutLinePK    
          
   IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#tempPallet') IS NOT NULL     
    DROP TABLE #tempPallet    
   SELECT distinct tp.* INTO #tempPallet FROM dbo.tblPallets tp INNER JOIN #tempContainerOutLinePalletContent tcolpc ON tcolpc.PalletFK = tp.PalletPK    
    
   IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#tempPalletContent') IS NOT NULL     
    DROP TABLE #tempPalletContent    
   SELECT distinct tpc.* INTO #tempPalletContent FROM dbo.tblPalletContent tpc INNER JOIN #tempContainerOutLinePalletContent tcolpc ON tcolpc.PalletContentFK = tpc.PalletContentPK    
          
   IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#tempPalletAudit') IS NOT NULL     
    DROP TABLE #tempPalletAudit    
   SELECT distinct pa.* INTO #tempPalletAudit FROM dbo.tblPalletAudit pa INNER JOIN #tempPallet tp ON pa.palletfk = tp.PalletPK WHERE eventtypefk IN (2,3)    
    
   Declare @myExtraField nvarchar(200) = ''    
   Declare @myExtraFields nvarchar(1000) = ''    
    
   --DECLARE ExtraFieldsCursor CURSOR FAST_FORWARD FOR    
   -- Select ExtraFieldName + ':' + [Value]    
   -- select * From tblDocketExtraFieldValues    
   -- Where DocketTypeFK = 2 AND FK = @var_containerOutPK    
    
   --OPEN ExtraFieldsCursor    
    
   --FETCH NEXT FROM ExtraFieldsCursor INTO     
   --@myExtraField    
    
   --Set @myExtraFields = ''    
   --WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0    
   --BEGIN    
   --Set @myExtraFields = @myExtraFields + @myExtraField + char(9) + char(13)    
   --FETCH NEXT FROM ExtraFieldsCursor INTO     
   --@myExtraField    
   --END    
   --CLOSE ExtraFieldsCursor     
   --DEALLOCATE ExtraFieldsCursor    
    
   DECLARE @DeliveryNumber varchar(max)      
    
   IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ResultSet') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #ResultSet    
    
   CREATE TABLE #ResultSet(SelectedValue varchar(max))     
        
   DECLARE @Param int      
   Select @Param = StockOrderPK from tblStockOrders where ContainerOutFK = @var_containerOutPK      
   INSERT INTO #ResultSet (SelectedValue)      
    EXEC spStockOrderGetDeliveryNumber @Param      
   SELECT @DeliveryNumber = ISNULL(SelectedValue,'') FROM #ResultSet    
    
    
   --Jamie : 02/09/2018 : check for docket value if no customer reference exists    
   if(@DeliveryNumber = '')    
   begin    
    SELECT @DeliveryNumber =     
    (case when Docketlabel1 <> '' THEN Docketlabel1 + ': ' + DocketValue1 else ''end + ' ' +    
    case when Docketlabel2 <> '' THEN Docketlabel2 + ': ' + DocketValue2  else '' end + ' ' +    
    case when Docketlabel3 <> '' THEN Docketlabel3 + ': ' + DocketValue3 else '' end )      
    from #tempContainerOut-- where containeroutpk = @var_containerOutPK    
   END    
       
   PRINT 'here'    
   PRINT @DeliveryNumber    
    
   DECLARE @issuedBy nvarchar(200)    
   Select @issuedBy = peeps.FirstName + ' ' + peeps.LastName    
   From tblUsers users    
   inner join tblPeople peeps on    
   peeps.PersonPK = users.PersonFK    
   Where users.UserPK = (    
    Select Top 1 pa.InsertedBy    
    From #tempPalletAudit pa    
    Where pa.eventTypeFK in (2,3)      
    and pa.EventFK in (Select ContainerOutLinePK from #tempContainerOutLines /*Where ContainerOutFK = @var_containerOutPK*/)     
   )    
    
   DECLARE @Comments nvarchar(max)    
   Select @Comments = SUBSTRING(     
   (     
     SELECT ',' + Description AS 'data()'     
      FROM tblContainerOutAudit WHERE IncludeInDocketPrintOut = 1 and IsArchived=0 and containeroutfK = @var_containerOutPK FOR XML PATH('')     
   ), 2 , 9999)     
    
   SELECT cast(cOuts.GoodsOrderNumber as nvarchar(50)) + ' V' + cast(cOuts.VersionNumber as nvarchar(50)) as GoodsOrderNumber,     
    divisions.DivisionName,     
    divisions.Address1 DivisionAddress1,     
    divisions.Address2 DivisionAddress2,     
    divisions.Address3 DivisionAddress3,     
    divisions.Address4 DivisionAddress4,     
    divisions.Address5 DivisionAddress5,    
    shippingCompanies.ShippingCompany,     
    cOuts.DeliveryDate,     
    cOuts.CollectionDate,     
     dbo.propercase(cOuts.Address1) DeliveryAddress1,     
     dbo.propercase(cOuts.Address2) DeliveryAddress2,     
     dbo.propercase(cOuts.Address3) DeliveryAddress3,     
     dbo.propercase(cOuts.Address4) DeliveryAddress4,     
     dbo.propercase(cOuts.Address5) DeliveryAddress5,    
    stockItems.StockItemCode,     
     dbo.propercase(stockItems.Description) [Description],     
    --cOutLines.Batch, --Have removed this as Glanbia dont select batch but still need to see it on docket    
    coalesce(pc.Batch, /*apc.Batch,*/ cOutLines.Batch) Batch,    
    --case when cOutLines.Pallets = 0 then case when palletsOutPA.PalletsOut is null then actualPallets.Pallets else palletsOutPA.PalletsOut end else case when colpc.CustomerPalletNumber = '' then cOutLines.Pallets else colpc.Pallets end end Pallets,    
    --case when cOutLines.Pallets = 0 then case when palletsOutPA.PalletsOut is null then 'A'                              else 'B'                                       end else case when colpc.CustomerPalletNumber = '' then 'C'                          
  
-- else 'D'                   end end PalletOutType,    
    case when cOutLines.Pallets = 0 then     
     case when palletsOutPA.PalletsOut is null then     
      actualPallets.Pallets     
     else     
      palletsOutPA.PalletsOut end     
    else case when colpc.CustomerPalletNumber = '' then     
     1     
    else     
     colpc.Pallets     
    end end Pallets,    
    case when cOutLines.Pallets = 0 then case when palletsOutPA.PalletsOut is null then 'A'                                  
    else 'B'                                       end else case when colpc.CustomerPalletNumber = '' then 'C'                               
    else 'D'                   end end PalletOutType,    
    colpc.Units,    
    transportCompanies.TransportCompany,     
    cOuts.LorryNumber,     
    cOuts.ContainerNumber,     
    cOuts.SealNumber,    
    --cOuts.[weight] as [TareWeight],    
	 (CASE WHEN  cOuts.[weight] < 0 THEN 0.00 ELSE  cOuts.[weight] END ) as  [TareWeight],    
    system.DocketHeaderLine1, system.DocketHeaderLine2, system.DocketHeaderLine3, system.DocketFooterPart1,    
    system.DocketFooterPart2Line1, system.DocketFooterPart2Line2, system.DocketFooterPart2Line3, system.DocketFooterPart2Line4,    
    users.PersonName,    
    isnull(@issuedBy, 'NA') IssuedBy,     
    @myExtraFields as ExtraFields,     
    --cOuts.Comments,    
    @Comments AS Comments,    
    --case when colpc.CustomerPalletNumber <> '' then 'Pallet Number: ' + colpc.CustomerPalletNumber else '' end as ExtraDetails,    
    unitTypes.Abbreviation as UnitType, @DeliveryNumber DeliveryNumber,    
    case when ps.CustomerBarcode = '' then ps.Barcode else ps.CustomerBarcode end Barcode, ps.CustomerPalletNumber,    
    isnull(transfers.stocktransferpk, '-1') transferpk,    
    cast(CASE WHEN custs.RequirePalletNumber = 0 THEN CASE WHEN divisions.RequirePalletNumber = 0 then stockItems.RequirePalletNumber ELSE divisions.RequirePalletNumber END ELSE custs.RequirePalletNumber END AS bit) as  RequirePalletNumber,    
    cast(CASE WHEN custs.RequireBestBefore = 0 THEN CASE WHEN divisions.RequireBestBefore = 0 then stockItems.RequireBestBefore ELSE divisions.RequireBestBefore END ELSE custs.RequireBestBefore END AS bit) as  RequireBestBefore,    
    cast(CASE WHEN custs.RequireManufactureDate = 0 THEN CASE WHEN divisions.RequireManufactureDate = 0 then stockItems.RequireManufactureDate ELSE divisions.RequireManufactureDate END ELSE custs.RequireManufactureDate END AS bit) as  RequireManufactureDate,    
    pc.BestBefore, pc.DateOfManufacture    
    
   from #tempContainerOut cOuts    
   inner join #tempContainerOutLines cOutLines on cOutLines.ContainerOutFK = cOuts.ContainerOutPK    
       
   left outer JOIN (    
    Select ContainerOutLineFK, PalletFK, max(PalletContentFK)PAlletContentFK, CustomerPalletNumber, sum(Units) Units, count(DISTINCT palletfk) Pallets     
    FROM #tempContainerOutLinePalletContent     
    Group By ContainerOutLineFK, PalletFK, CustomerPalletNumber    
   ) colpc ON colpc.ContainerOutLineFK = cOutLines.ContainerOutLinePK    
       
   left outer join (    
    Select 1 PalletsOut, PalletFK, EventFK    
    from #tempPalletAudit     
    Where EventTypeFK = 2    
    Group By EventFK, PalletFK    
   )palletsOutPA ON palletsOutPA.EventFK = cOutLines.ContainerOutLinePK AND palletsOutPA.PalletFK = colpc.PalletFK        
   left outer join (    
    Select ContainerOutLineFK, 1 Pallets, PalletFK     
    from (    
     Select ContainerOutLineFK, WorksOrderFK, woms.PalletFK    
     from tblWorksOrderMovements woms    
     inner join tblWorksOrders wos ON wos.WorksOrderPK = woms.WorksOrderFK AND wos.WorksOrderOriginFK = 2 /*StockOrder*/ AND wos.WorksOrderTypeFK = 3 /*Movement*/    
     inner join #tempContainerOutLinePalletContent colpc ON colpc.ContainerOutLinePalletContentPK = woms.ContainerOutLinePalletContentFK    
     where EntirePallet = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/    
     group by ContainerOutLineFK, WorksOrderFK, woms.PalletFK    
    ) subWomPallets    
    Group By ContainerOutLineFK, PalletFK    
   ) womPallets ON womPallets.ContainerOutLineFK = cOutLines.ContainerOutLinePK AND womPallets.PalletFK = colpc.PalletFK    
    
   left outer join (    
    Select ContainerOutLineFK, 1 Pallets, pallets.PalletPK     
    from #tempPallet pallets    
    inner join (    
     Select PalletFK, sum(ActualUnits) ActualUnits     
     from #tempPalletContent    
     group By PalletFK    
    ) pc ON pc.PalletFK = pallets.PalletPK     
    inner join (    
     Select ContainerOutLineFK, PalletFK     
     from #tempContainerOutLinePalletContent    
     Group By ContainerOutLineFK, PalletFK    
    )colpc on colpc.PalletFK = pallets.PalletPK    
    inner join (    
     Select containeroutlinefk as linefk, PalletFK, sum(colpc.Units) OrderedUnits     
     from #tempContainerOutLinePalletContent colpc    
     inner join #tempContainerOutLines on containeroutlinefk = containeroutlinepk    
     Group By PalletFK, containeroutlinefk    
    )colPallets on colPallets.PalletFK = pallets.PalletPK and linefk = colpc.containeroutlinefk     
    inner join #tempContainerOutLines cols ON cols.ContainerOutLinePK = colpc.ContainerOutLineFK    
    inner join #tempContainerOut cOuts ON cOuts.ContainerOutPK = cols.ContainerOutFK AND cOuts.ContainerOutStatusFK in (1,2,3) /*pending*/    
    where ActualUnits = OrderedUnits    
    Group By ContainerOutLineFK, PalletPK )actualPallets ON actualPallets.ContainerOutLineFK = cOutLines.ContainerOutLinePK AND actualPallets.PalletPK = colpc.PalletFK    
    
   left outer join tblShippingCompanies shippingCompanies ON shippingCompanies.ShippingCompanyPK = cOuts.ShippingCompanyFK    
   inner join tblDivisions divisions ON divisions.DivisionPK = cOutLines.DivisionFK    
   inner join tblCustomers custs on divisions.CustomerFK = custs.CustomerPK    
   inner join tblStockItems stockItems on stockItems.StockItemPK = cOutLines.StockItemFK    
   left outer join tblUnitTypes unitTypes on unitTypes.UnitTypePK = stockItems.UnitTypeFK    
   left outer join tblTransportCompanies transportCompanies on transportCompanies.TransportCompanyPK = cOuts.TransportCompanyFK    
   inner join #tempPallet ps on ps.PalletPk = colpc.PalletFK    
   inner join appSystem system ON 1=1 --only one record in the system.. join it    
   left outer join #tempPalletContent pc ON pc.PalletContentPK = colpc.PalletContentFK    
   --left outer join tblArchivedPalletContent apc ON apc.PalletContentPK = colpc.PalletContentFK    
    
   inner join (    
    Select users.UserPK, FirstName + ' ' + LastName as PersonName    
    from tblPeople people    
    INNER join tblUsers users ON users.PersonFK = people.PersonPK    
   ) users ON users.UserPK = @var_userFK    
    
   left join tblstocktransfers transfers on transfers.containeroutfk = couts.containeroutpk    
       
   where cOuts.ContainerOutPK = @var_containerOutPK    
   Order By StockItemCode, Batch    
    
   -- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end    
   BREAK    
  END TRY    
  BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */    
   DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;    
   SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;    
   SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;    
    
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY     
   BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;    
           
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;    
    
            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID    
                
  IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;    
                
   IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)    
   BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END    
   ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */    
  END CATCH    
  SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1    
 END    
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spReportsStockOutDocketDaily]
(
	@containerOutPK int,
	@userFK int
)	
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data; Ensure this proc has a low impact when executed */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED; SET DEADLOCK_PRIORITY LOW

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT
	,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;
	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	DECLARE @var_containerOutPK int, @var_userFK int
	SET @var_containerOutPK = @containerOutPK; SET @var_userFK = @userFK
	SET @ParameterDetails = '@containerOutPK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_containerOutPK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@userFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_userFK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'')

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    END

	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY
			

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start

			DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #tempContainerOut
			SELECT * INTO #tempContainerOut FROM dbo.tblContainerOuts tco WHERE tco.ContainerOutPK = @var_containerOutPK
						
			DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #tempContainerOutLines
			SELECT * INTO #tempContainerOutLines FROM dbo.tblContainerOutLines tcol WHERE tcol.ContainerOutFK = @var_containerOutPK

			DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #tempContainerOutLinePalletContent
			SELECT tcolpc.* INTO #tempContainerOutLinePalletContent FROM dbo.tblContainerOutLinePalletContent tcolpc INNER JOIN #tempContainerOutLines tcol ON tcolpc.ContainerOutLineFK = tcol.ContainerOutLinePK

			DECLARE @issuedBy nvarchar(200)
			Select @issuedBy = peeps.FirstName + ' ' + peeps.LastName
			From tblUsers users
			inner join tblPeople peeps on
			peeps.PersonPK = users.PersonFK
			Where users.UserPK = (SELECT insertedby FROM #tempContainerOut)
			
			SELECT cOuts.GoodsOrderNumber, cOuts.CollectionDate, isnull(@issuedBy, 'NA') IssuedBy,
				div.DivisionName, div.Address1 DivisionAddress1, div.Address2 DivisionAddress2, div.Address3 DivisionAddress3, div.Address4 DivisionAddress4, div.Address5 DivisionAddress5,				 
				colpc.LineNumber, stockItems.StockItemCode, stockItems.Description, colpc.UnitsPerPack, colpc.Units, colpc.Pallets,	
				syst.DocketHeaderLine1, syst.DocketHeaderLine2, syst.DocketHeaderLine3, syst.DocketFooterPart1, syst.DocketFooterPart2Line1, syst.DocketFooterPart2Line2, syst.DocketFooterPart2Line3, syst.DocketFooterPart2Line4
			from #tempContainerOut cOuts
			
			left outer JOIN (
				Select ContainerOutFK, DivisionFK, stockitemfk, cOutLines.Free1 AS LineNumber, colpc.Units AS UnitsPerPack, sum(colpc.Units) Units, count(DISTINCT palletfk) Pallets 
				FROM #tempContainerOutLinePalletContent colpc 
				inner join #tempContainerOutLines cOutLines on cOutLines.ContainerOutLinePK = colpc.ContainerOutLineFK			
				Group By ContainerOutFK, DivisionFK, stockitemfk, cOutLines.Free1, colpc.Units
			) colpc ON colpc.ContainerOutFK = cOuts.ContainerOutPK			
			inner join tblDivisions div ON div.DivisionPK = colpc.DivisionFK
			inner join tblStockItems stockItems on stockItems.StockItemPK = colpc.StockItemFK
			inner join appSystem syst ON 1=1 --only one record in the system.. join it
			Order By cast(colpc.LineNumber AS int)

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END
GO

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spReportsStockOutDocketDanone]

 @containerOutPK int,  
 @userFK int  
)   
AS  
BEGIN  
 /* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data; Ensure this proc has a low impact when executed */  
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED; SET DEADLOCK_PRIORITY LOW  
  
    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT  
 ,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;  
 SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();  
  
 -- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters  
 DECLARE @var_containerOutPK int, @var_userFK int  
 SET @var_containerOutPK = @containerOutPK; SET @var_userFK = @userFK  
 SET @ParameterDetails = '@containerOutPK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_containerOutPK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@userFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_userFK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'')  
  
    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL   
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)  
  
    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)

        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK  
  
        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()  
    --END  
  
 SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);  
 SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails  
 ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;  
 INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()  
  
 WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3  
 BEGIN

   Select @Param = StockOrderPK from tblStockOrders where ContainerOutFK = @var_containerOutPK  
       
   INSERT INTO #ResultSet (SelectedValue)    
   EXEC spStockOrderGetDeliveryNumber @Param    
  
   SELECT @DeliveryNumber = ISNULL(SelectedValue,'') FROM #ResultSet     
  
   DECLARE @personName nvarchar(200)  
   SELECT  @personName = FirstName + ' ' + LastName  
   from tblPeople people  
   inner join tblUsers users on users.PersonFK = people.PersonPK  
   where users.UserPK = @var_userFK  
  
   Select   
    cast(cOuts.GoodsOrderNumber as nvarchar(50)) + ' V' + cast(cOuts.VersionNumber as nvarchar(50)) as GoodsOrderNumber,   
    divisions.DivisionName,   
    divisions.Address1 DivisionAddress1,   
    divisions.Address2 DivisionAddress2,   
    divisions.Address3 DivisionAddress3,   
    divisions.Address4 DivisionAddress4,   
    divisions.Address5 DivisionAddress5,

    cOuts.Address2 DeliveryAddress2,

      stockItems.Description,

    @personName AS PersonName,   
    '' as ExtraFields,

    cOuts.Free2 as DeliveryType      
  
   from tblContainerOuts cOuts  
   inner join tblContainerOutLines cOutLines ON cOutLines.ContainerOutFK = cOuts.ContainerOutPK  
   inner join tblContainerOutLinePalletContent colpc ON colpc.ContainerOutLineFK = cOutLines.ContainerOutLinePK  
  
   left outer join (  
    Select 1 PalletsOut, PalletFK, EventFK  
    from tblPalletAudit   
    Where EventTypeFK = 2  
    Group By EventFK, PalletFK  
   )palletsOutPA ON palletsOutPA.EventFK = cOutLines.ContainerOutLinePK AND palletsOutPA.PalletFK = colpc.PalletFK  
  
   --left outer join   
   --(  
   -- Select ContainerOutLineFK, 1 Pallets, PalletFK   
   -- from (  
   --  Select ContainerOutLineFK, WorksOrderFK, woms.PalletFK  
   --  from tblWorksOrderMovements woms  
   --  inner join tblWorksOrders wos ON wos.WorksOrderPK = woms.WorksOrderFK AND wos.WorksOrderOriginFK = 2 /*StockOrder*/  AND wos.WorksOrderTypeFK = 3 /*Movement*/  
   --  inner join tblContainerOutLinePalletContent colpc ON colpc.ContainerOutLinePalletContentPK = woms.ContainerOutLinePalletContentFK

   --) womPallets ON womPallets.ContainerOutLineFK = cOutLines.ContainerOutLinePK AND womPallets.PalletFK = colpc.PalletFK  
  
   --left outer join (  
   -- Select ContainerOutLineFK, 1 Pallets, pallets.PalletPK   
   -- from tblPallets pallets  
   -- --inner join (

   inner join tblDivisions divisions ON divisions.DivisionPK = cOutLines.DivisionFK  
   inner join tblStockItems stockItems on stockItems.StockItemPK = cOutLines.StockItemFK  
   left outer join tblUnitTypes unitTypes on unitTypes.UnitTypePK = stockItems.UnitTypeFK  
   left outer join tblTransportCompanies transportCompanies on transportCompanies.TransportCompanyPK = cOuts.TransportCompanyFK  
      inner join tblPallets ps on ps.Palletpk = colpc.PalletFK  
   inner join tblPalletTypes pt on ps.PalletTypeFK = pt.PalletTypePK  
   inner join appSystem system ON 1=1 --only one record in the system.. join it  
   left outer join tblPalletContent pc ON pc.PalletContentPK = colpc.PalletContentFK     
   where cOuts.ContainerOutPK = @var_containerOutPK  
   Order By StockItemCode, Batch  
  
   -- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end  
        
   BREAK  
  END TRY  
  BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */  
   DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;  
   SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;  
   SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;  
  
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY   
   BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;  
         
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;  
  
            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID  
              
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;  
              
   IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)  
   BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END  
   ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */  
  END CATCH  
  SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1  
 END  
END

			DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #tmpPackingListContainerOutLines

			@DeliveryNumber as DeliveryNumber, 
			ISNULL(customers.CustomerCode,'') as CustomerCode, 
			@ConsigneeNo as ConsigneeNo,
			dbo.propercase(sis.Description) [Description], 
			cOuts.Free1 coutFree1,

			cOuts.Free4 coutFree4,

			pafs.AdditionalField2,
			pafs.AdditionalField3,
			pafs.AdditionalField4,
			pafs.AdditionalField5,
			cOuts.DocketLabel1, cOuts.DocketValue1,
			cOuts.DocketLabel2, cOuts.DocketValue2,
			cOuts.DocketLabel3, cOuts.DocketValue3,
			CAST(cOuts.Weight AS INT) Weight,--, case when pals.customerbarcode <> '' then pals.customerbarcode else pals.barcode end as [PalletBarcode]
			case when ContainerOutPalletGroupPK is null then 1 else GroupNumber end as PackingListGroup,
			case when manufacturerpk is null then '' else dbo.propercase(Manufacturer) end as Manufacturer,
			dbo.propercase(sis.ManufacturerPartNo) ManufacturerPartNo, cdt.ClientDeliveryType
			/*
			cOuts.Address1 as DeliveryAddress1, cOuts.Address2 as DeliveryAddress2, cOuts.Address3 as DeliveryAddress3, cOuts.Address4 as DeliveryAddress4, cOuts.Address5 as DeliveryAddress5,
			ISNULL(countries.Country,'') as DeliveryCountry
			*/
   
			FROM #tmpPackingListContainerOut cOuts  
				inner join #tmpPackingListContainerOutLines cols ON cols.ContainerOutFK = cOuts.ContainerOutPK  			
				inner join tblDivisions divisions on divisions.DivisionPK = cols.DivisionFK  
				inner join tblStockItems sis on sis.StockItemPK = cols.StockItemFK  
				left outer join tblCustomers customers on sis.CustomerFK = customers.CustomerPK
				left outer join tblCounties counties on counties.CountyPK = cOuts.CountyFK  
				left outer join tblCountries countries on countries.CountryPK = cOuts.CountryFK  
				left outer join tblTransportCompanies transport on transport.TransportCompanyPK = cOuts.TransportCompanyFK  
				left outer join tblExtraDockets eds on  eds.ExtraDocketTypeFK = 3 /*Stock Out Packing List*/  AND eds.CustomerFK = @customerFK  
				left outer join tblExtraDocketParameterSets edps on edps.ExtraDocketFK = eds.ExtraDocketPK 
				inner join tblUnitTypes ut on ut.UnitTypePK = sis.UnitTypeFK 
				left outer join #tmpPackingListCOLPC colpc on colpc.ContainerOutLineFK = cols.ContainerOutLinePK
				left outer join #tmpPackingListPA palletsOutPA on palletsOutPA.EventFK = cols.ContainerOutLinePK AND palletsOutPA.PalletFK = colpc.PalletFK
				left outer join #palletAdditionalFields pafs on pafs.PalletFK = colpc.PalletFK
				left join tblContainerOutPalletGroups cogroups on cogroups.ContainerOutFK = cOuts.ContainerOutPK and colpc.palletfk = cogroups.palletfk
				left join tblManufacturers mans on sis.ManufacturerFK = mans.ManufacturerPK
				left join appClientDeliveryTypes cdt on cdt.ClientDeliveryTypePK = cOuts.ClientDeliveryTypeFK
				Where ContainerOutPK = @var_containerOutPK 
					)subquery
			group by GoodsOrderNumber, InceptionDate,	DeliveryDate,	CollectionDate,	StockItemCode,	Batch,	Pallets, TransportCompany,
			Address1, Address2,	Address3,	Address4,	Address5,	County,	Country,	Parameter1,	Parameter2,	Parameter3,	Parameter4,	Parameter5,	Parameter6,	Parameter7,	Parameter8,
			Parameter9,	Parameter10,	Parameter11,	Parameter12,	Parameter13,	Parameter14,	Parameter15,	Parameter16,	Parameter17,	Parameter18,	Parameter19,
			Parameter20,	DivisionName,	DivisionAddress1,	DivisionAddress2,	DivisionAddress3,	DivisionAddress4,	DivisionAddress5,	ContainerNumber,	SealNumber,	DeliveryNumber,
			CustomerCode,	ConsigneeNo,	Description,	coutFree1,	coutFree2,	coutFree3,	coutFree4,	coutFree5,	colsFree1,	colsFree2,	colsFree3,	colsFree4,	colsFree5,	
			CommodityCode,	SoldToName,	SoldToAddress1,	SoldToAddress2,	SoldToAddress3,	SoldToAddress4,	SoldToAddress5,	UnitCount,	UnitWeight,	Abbreviation,	ProductionDate,	Comments,	AdditionalField1,
				AdditionalField2,	AdditionalField3,	AdditionalField4,	AdditionalField5,	Weight, DocketLabel1, DocketValue1, DocketLabel2, DocketValue2,DocketLabel3, DocketValue3, PackingListGroup, Manufacturer, ManufacturerPartNo, ClientDeliveryType
			Order By PackingListGroup, StockItemCode, Batch

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end

			
			
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END

/****************************************************************************************
Author      : Archana Singh
Created Date: 21-Jul-2026
Description :
    Retrieves the stock out summary report for selected divisions over a date range.

    The procedure calculates:
    - Total Pallets Out
    - Total Dockets Out

    Report can be grouped dynamically by:
    - Building
    - Division
    - Delivery Address Type

Parameters  :
    @SelectedDivisions - Comma separated list of Division IDs.
    @GroupByBuilding   - Includes Building grouping when enabled.
    @GroupByDivision   - Includes Division grouping when enabled.
    @GroupByAddressType- Includes Delivery Address Type grouping when enabled.
    @StartDate         - Report start date.
    @EndDate           - Report end date.

Notes       :
    - Uses dynamic SQL to support optional grouping fields.
    - Date filtering uses parameters to prevent datetime conversion issues.
    - Replaces the previous C# generated SQL query.
****************************************************************************************/

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spReportsStockOutSummaryForDivision]
(
    @SelectedDivisions NVARCHAR(MAX),
    @GroupByBuilding BIT,
    @GroupByDivision BIT,
    @GroupByAddressType BIT,
    @StartDate DATETIME,
    @EndDate DATETIME
)
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    DECLARE @Fields NVARCHAR(MAX) = '';
    DECLARE @Grouping NVARCHAR(MAX) = '';
    DECLARE @Sorting NVARCHAR(MAX) = '';
    DECLARE @SQL NVARCHAR(MAX);


    -- Date always included
    SET @Fields = 'CONVERT(VARCHAR(50), ForDate,106) AS [Date],';
    SET @Grouping = 'ForDate';
    SET @Sorting = 'ForDate DESC';


    -- Building
    IF @GroupByBuilding = 1
    BEGIN
        SET @Fields = @Fields + 'BuildingName,';
        SET @Grouping = @Grouping + ',BuildingName';
        SET @Sorting = @Sorting + ',BuildingName';
    END


    -- Division
    IF @GroupByDivision = 1
    BEGIN
        SET @Fields = @Fields + 'DivisionName,';
        SET @Grouping = @Grouping + ',DivisionName';
        SET @Sorting = @Sorting + ',DivisionName';
    END


    -- Delivery Address Type
    IF @GroupByAddressType = 1
    BEGIN
        SET @Fields = @Fields + 
            'DeliveryAddressType AS [Delivery Type],';

        SET @Grouping = @Grouping + ',DeliveryAddressType';
        SET @Sorting = @Sorting + ',DeliveryAddressType';
    END


    -- Always included
    SET @Fields = @Fields + 
        'SUM(PalletsOut) AS [Total Pallets],
         SUM(DocketsOut) AS [Total Dockets]';



    SET @SQL = '

    SELECT ' + @Fields + '

    FROM tblReportsDivisionDailyStockOutSummary tds

    INNER JOIN tblDivisions td
        ON tds.DivisionFK = td.DivisionPK

    INNER JOIN tblBuildings tb
        ON tb.BuildingPK = tds.BuildingFK

    INNER JOIN appDeliveryAddressTypes adat
        ON adat.DeliveryAddressTypePK = tds.DeliveryTypeFK


    WHERE tds.ForDate >= @StartDate
      AND tds.ForDate < DATEADD(DAY,1,@EndDate)

      AND tds.DivisionFK IN (' + @SelectedDivisions + ')


    GROUP BY ' + @Grouping + '

    ORDER BY ' + @Sorting;



    EXEC sp_executesql
        @SQL,
        N'@StartDate DATETIME,
          @EndDate DATETIME',
        @StartDate,
        @EndDate;

END
GO

    inner join #tempContainerOut cOuts ON cOuts.ContainerOutPK = cols.ContainerOutFK AND cOuts.ContainerOutStatusFK in (1,2,3) /*pending*/      
    where ActualUnits = OrderedUnits      
    Group By ContainerOutLineFK, PalletPK )actualPallets ON actualPallets.ContainerOutLineFK = cOutLines.ContainerOutLinePK AND actualPallets.PalletPK = colpc.PalletFK      
      
   left outer join tblShippingCompanies shippingCompanies ON shippingCompanies.ShippingCompanyPK = cOuts.ShippingCompanyFK      
   inner join tblDivisions divisions ON divisions.DivisionPK = cOutLines.DivisionFK

  BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */      
   DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;      
   SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;      
   SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;      
      
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY       
   BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;      
             
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;      
      
            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID      
                  
  IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;      
                  
   IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)      
   BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END      
   ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */      
  END CATCH      
  SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1      
 END      
END

AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data; Ensure this proc has a low impact when executed */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED; SET DEADLOCK_PRIORITY LOW

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT
	,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;
	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	DECLARE @var_stockTransferPK int
	SET @var_stockTransferPK = @stockTransferPK
	SET @ParameterDetails = '@stockTransferPK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_stockTransferPK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'')

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END


	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY
			

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start

			select conOut.goodsordernumber, conIn.goodsInNumber, s.stockitemcode, s.Description, st.InsertedDate, st.UpdatedDate as CompleteDate,

			left join tblstockitems s on sti.stockitemfk = s.stockitempk

				from tbldivisions d 
				inner join tblStockIns si on si.divisionfk = d.divisionpk
				inner join tblContainerIns ci on ci.containerinpk = si.containerinfk) 
			conIn on conIn.containerInpk = st.containerinfk 
			inner join (
				select DivisionName, co.goodsordernumber, co.containeroutpk 
				from tbldivisions d 
				inner join tblcontaineroutlines col on col.divisionfk = d.divisionpk 
				inner join tblcontainerouts co on co.containeroutpk = col.containeroutfk) 
			conOut on conOut.containeroutpk = st.containeroutfk
			inner join tblusers u on st.UpdatedBy = u.userpk
			inner join tblpeople p on u.personfk = p.personpk	
			where stocktransferpk = @var_stockTransferPK
			group by s.StockItemCode, s.Description, st.InsertedDate, st.UpdatedDate, conIn.DivisionName, conOut.DivisionName,conOut.goodsOrderNumber, 
			conIn.goodsInNumber, p.firstname, p.lastname

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end

			
			
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END

/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[spReportsTirlanInboundReport]    Script Date: 02/11/2026 17:47:27 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[spReportsTirlanInboundReport]
    @DivisionFK INT = 625,
    @Year INT = 2025,
    @MonthVariance INT = 0
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    -- Temp table: inbound stock for division/year
    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#tirlaninbounds') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #tirlaninbounds;
    SELECT * 
    INTO #tirlaninbounds
    FROM tblstockins 
    WHERE DivisionFK = @DivisionFK
      AND YEAR(InsertedDate) = @Year;

    -- Temp table: pallets per inbound
    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#tirlanpals') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #tirlanpals;
    SELECT COUNT(stockinlinepk) AS NoPallets, stockinpk
    INTO #tirlanpals
    FROM tblstockinlines 
    INNER JOIN #tirlaninbounds 
        ON stockinpk = stockinfk
    GROUP BY stockinpk;

    -- Date parameters
    DECLARE @CurrentMonth INT = MONTH(GETDATE()) - @MonthVariance;
    DECLARE @CurrentYear INT = YEAR(GETDATE());
    DECLARE @ToDate DATETIME = CASE 
                                   WHEN @MonthVariance < 1 
                                   THEN GETDATE() 
                                   ELSE DATEADD(MONTH, DATEDIFF(MONTH, 0, GETDATE()), -@MonthVariance) 
                               END;

    -- Build calendar dates for month
    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#tmpdates') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #tmpdates;

    ;WITH date_range (calc_date) AS (
        SELECT DATEADD(DAY, DATEDIFF(DAY, 0, GETDATE()) 
                         - DATEDIFF(DAY, CAST(@CurrentYear AS NVARCHAR(4)) + '-' +  
                                          CAST(@CurrentMonth AS NVARCHAR(2)) + '-01', GETDATE()), 0)
        UNION ALL 
        SELECT DATEADD(DAY, 1, calc_date)
        FROM date_range
        WHERE DATEADD(DAY, 1, calc_date) <= @ToDate
    )
    SELECT CAST(calc_date AS DATE) AS DayDate
    INTO #tmpdates
    FROM date_range;

    -- All inbounds (created)
    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#tmpallinbounds') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #tmpallinbounds;
    SELECT CAST(InsertedDate AS DATE) AS CreatedDate, 
           COUNT(ti.stockinpk) AS NoInbounds, 
           SUM(NoPallets) AS PalCount
    INTO #tmpallinbounds
    FROM #tirlaninbounds ti
    LEFT JOIN #tirlanpals tp ON ti.stockinpk = tp.stockinpk
    WHERE StockInStatusFK <> 4
    GROUP BY CAST(InsertedDate AS DATE);

    -- Receipted inbounds
    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#tmpreceiptedinbounds') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #tmpreceiptedinbounds;
    SELECT CAST(ArrivalDate AS DATE) AS ReceiptedDate, 
           COUNT(stockinpk) AS NoInbounds
    INTO #tmpreceiptedinbounds
    FROM #tirlaninbounds 
    WHERE StockInStatusFK = 3
    GROUP BY CAST(ArrivalDate AS DATE);

    -- Final daily summary
    SELECT alldates.DayDate, 
           allinbounds.PalCount AS PalletsProduced,
           ISNULL(allinbounds.NoInbounds, 0) AS LoadsProduced,
           ISNULL(receiptedinbounds.NoInbounds, 0) AS LoadsReceipted
    FROM #tmpdates alldates
    LEFT JOIN #tmpallinbounds allinbounds 
        ON alldates.DayDate = allinbounds.CreatedDate
    LEFT JOIN #tmpreceiptedinbounds receiptedinbounds 
        ON alldates.DayDate = receiptedinbounds.ReceiptedDate
    ORDER BY DayDate;

    -- Detailed list of inbounds
    SELECT GoodsInNumber, InsertedDate, ArrivalDate, 
           CASE WHEN StockInStatusFK = 1 THEN 0 
                ELSE DATEDIFF(DAY, InsertedDate, ArrivalDate) END AS InTransit  
    FROM #tirlaninbounds 
    WHERE StockInStatusFK <> 4 
    ORDER BY InsertedDate ASC;

END;
GO

        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END


	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY
			
			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start

			DECLARE @tblLabels TABLE 
			( 
				GoodsOrderNumber nvarchar(200), 
				TrackingNumber nvarchar(200),

				Address2 nvarchar(200),
				Address3 nvarchar(200),

				ReturnAddress3 nvarchar(200),

				ReturnAddress5 nvarchar(200),
				ReturnCounty nvarchar(200),
				ReturnCountry nvarchar(200),
				ReturnTelephoneNumber nvarchar(100)

				@ReturnCounty nvarchar(200),

			Declare @NumberOfConsignments INT
			Declare @ConsignmentNumber INT

				@ReturnCounty,
				@ReturnCountry,
				@ReturnTelephoneNumber)
				set @ConsignmentNumber = @ConsignmentNumber + 1
			END

			Select * from @tblLabels

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end
						
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */

/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[spReportsUptimeLogsIntegrationFilesDetails]    Script Date: 02/11/2026 17:47:27 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spReportsUptimeLogsIntegrationFilesDetails] --spReportsUptimeLogsIntegrationFilesDetails '2020-02-03', '2020-02-09', 'BV1'
(
--declare
	@startDate DATE
	,@endDate DATE
	,@buildingName NVARCHAR(200) = ''

	--select @startDate = '2020-02-03', @endDate = '2020-02-09', @buildingName = 'BV1'
)
AS
BEGIN
	DECLARE @varStartDate DATE = @startDate, @varEndDate DATE = @endDate, @varBuildingName NVARCHAR(200) = ISNULL(@buildingName, '')

	SET @varEndDate = DATEADD(DAY, 1, @varEndDate)

	DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #uptimeLogsIntegrationFiles

	SELECT DISTINCT
		uld.UptimeLogsDetailPK,
		uld.UptimeLogDate,
		uld.BuildingFK,
		vbd.BuildingName,
		ulf.UptimeLogsIntegrationFilePK, ulf.UptimeLogsDetailFK, ulf.UptimeLogsCategoryFK, ulc_ulf.UptimeLogsCategory, ultc.CategoryScreenOrder,
		ulf.NoOfStoreAllIssues, ulf.NoOfCustomerIssues, ulf.NoOfFilesIn, ulf.NoOfFilesOut,
		(ulf.NoOfFilesIn + ulf.NoOfFilesOut) AS TotalNoOfFilesInOut,

		CASE
			WHEN @varBuildingName = 'BV2' THEN

				(CASE 
					WHEN ulf.StockInEmailsTotal < 1 THEN 
						0.00
				ELSE 
					CAST(ROUND(CAST(ulf.NoOfStoreAllIssues AS DECIMAL(18, 2)) / (ulf.StockInEmailsTotal) * 100.00, 2) AS DECIMAL(18, 2))
				END)

			WHEN @varBuildingName <> 'BV2' THEN

				(CASE 
					WHEN ulf.NoOfFilesIn < 1 THEN 
						0.00
				ELSE 
					CAST(ROUND(CAST(ulf.NoOfStoreAllIssues AS DECIMAL(18, 2)) / (ulf.NoOfFilesIn + ulf.NoOfFilesOut) * 100.00, 2) AS DECIMAL(18, 2))
				END)
		END AS AutoCalcStoreAllPercentOfIssues,

		CASE
			WHEN @varBuildingName = 'BV2' THEN

				(CASE 
					WHEN ISNULL(ulf.StockInEmailsTotal, 0) < 1 THEN 
						0.00
					ELSE 
						CAST(ROUND(CAST(ulf.NoOfCustomerIssues AS DECIMAL(18, 2)) / (ulf.StockInEmailsTotal) * 100.00, 2) AS DECIMAL(18, 2))
				END)

			WHEN @varBuildingName <> 'BV2' THEN

				(CASE 
					WHEN ISNULL(ulf.NoOfFilesIn, 0) < 1 THEN 
						0.00
					ELSE 
						CAST(ROUND(CAST(ulf.NoOfCustomerIssues AS DECIMAL(18, 2)) / (ulf.NoOfFilesIn + ulf.NoOfFilesOut) * 100.00, 2) AS DECIMAL(18, 2))
				END)
		END AS AutoCalcCustomerPercentOfIssues,

		StockInEmailsTotal
	INTO
		#uptimeLogsIntegrationFiles
	FROM
		dbo.tblUptimeLogsDetails uld WITH (NOLOCK)
	INNER JOIN dbo.tblUptimeLogsIntegrationFiles ulf WITH (NOLOCK)		
		ON uld.UptimeLogsDetailPK = ulf.UptimeLogsDetailFK
	INNER JOIN dbo.tblUptimeLogsBuildingCategories ultc WITH (NOLOCK)
		ON ulf.UptimeLogsCategoryFK = ultc.UptimeLogsCategoryFK		
	INNER JOIN dbo.appUptimeLogsTables ult WITH (NOLOCK)
		ON ultc.UptimeLogsTableFK = ult.UptimeLogsTablePK
	INNER JOIN dbo.appUptimeLogsCategories ulc_ulf WITH (NOLOCK)
		ON ultc.UptimeLogsCategoryFK = ulc_ulf.UptimeLogsCategoryPK
	LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.viewBuildingDetails vbd
		ON uld.BuildingFK = vbd.BuildingFK
	WHERE		
		uld.UptimeLogDate >= @varStartDate
		AND uld.UptimeLogDate< @varEndDate
		AND uld.IsArchived = 1 /*Confirmed data only*/
		AND ult.UptimeLogsTableName = 'tblUptimeLogsIntegrationFiles'		
		AND 
		(
			@varBuildingName = ''
			OR (@varBuildingName <> '' AND vbd.DepartmentTMS = @varBuildingName)
		)

	SELECT DISTINCT
		t1.UptimeLogDate,
		t1.BuildingName AS BuildingName,
		t1.UptimeLogsCategory AS Category, 
		t1.NoOfStoreAllIssues AS [#StoreAllIssues], 
		t1.NoOfCustomerIssues AS [#CustomerIssues], 
		t1.NoOfFilesIn AS [#FilesIn], 
		t1.NoOfFilesOut AS [#FilesOut], 
		t1.TotalNoOfFilesInOut AS [#FilesInOut],
		CAST(t1.AutoCalcStoreAllPercentOfIssues AS NVARCHAR(50)) + '%' AS [StoreAll%Issues],
		CAST(t1.AutoCalcCustomerPercentOfIssues AS NVARCHAR(50)) + '%' AS [Customer%Issues],
		CAST((t1.AutoCalcStoreAllPercentOfIssues +t1. AutoCalcCustomerPercentOfIssues) AS NVARCHAR(50)) + '%' AS [Total%Issues],			
		t1.StockInEmailsTotal
	FROM
		#uptimeLogsIntegrationFiles t1
	ORDER BY
		t1.UptimeLogDate ASC,
		t1.BuildingName ASC
END
GO

-- Author:		<Jamie Clerkin>
-- Create date: <02/09/2015>
-- Description:	<get audit trial for a container out>
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spReportsUserAccountAudit]
(
	@PersonFK int,
	@PrintedBy int
)
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT
	,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;
	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	DECLARE @PersonFK2 int
	DECLARE @PrintedBy2 int

	SET @PersonFK2 = @PersonFK; 
	SET @PrintedBy2 = @PrintedBy; 

	SET @ParameterDetails = '@PersonFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@PersonFK2 AS NVARCHAR(20)),'') + ', @PrintedBy = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@PrintedBy2 AS NVARCHAR(20)),'')

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    --BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

		SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END

	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY
			
			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start
			

			SELECT PersonPK, pep.FirstName + ' ' + pep.LastName AS PersonName, pep.IsArchived, pep.InsertedDate [UserCreatedDate], pep.EmployeeNumber, pep.JobTitle, 
				aut.UserType, tu.UserName, au.userAuditPK, auet.UserAuditEventType, au.Description AS EventDescription, 
				case when au.UpdatedBy <= 0 then 'System' else loggedUser.PersonName end AS EventRecordedBy, au.InsertedDate AS EventDate, 'Printed by ' + PrintUser.PersonName AS PrintedByUser
			FROM tblpeople pep
			INNER JOIN tblusers tu ON pep.PersonPK = tu.PersonFK
			left JOIN tbluseraudit au ON au.personfk = pep.PersonPK
			left outer join(
				select case when u.userpk > 0 then (p.Firstname + ' ' + p.LastName) else 'System' end as PersonName, 
				u.userpk
				from tblusers as u 
				inner join tblpeople as p 
				on u.personfk = p.personpk
			) as loggedUser on loggedUser.userpk = au.UpdatedBy
			left outer join(
				select case when u.userpk > 0 then (p.Firstname + ' ' + p.LastName) else 'System' end as PersonName, 
				u.userpk
				from tblusers as u 
				inner join tblpeople as p 
				on u.personfk = p.personpk
			) as PrintUser on PrintUser.userpk = @PrintedBy2
			left JOIN dbo.appUserTypes aut ON aut.usertypepk = tu.UserTypeFK
			left JOIN appuserauditeventtypes auet ON auet.UserAuditEventTypePK = au.UserAuditTypeFK
			WHERE pep.PersonPK = @PersonFK2
			ORDER BY au.InsertedDate
				-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end
						
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END
GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[spReportsUserShortcuts]    Script Date: 02/11/2026 17:47:27 ******/

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spReportsUserShortcuts]  
(  
    @UserFK int  
)  
AS  
BEGIN  
    SET NOCOUNT ON; -- Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data.  
    SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED;  
  
    DECLARE   
        @varThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400) = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID),  
        @varExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),  
        @varParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX) = '',  
        @varDeadlockErrorRetries INT = 1,  
        @varProcedureAndErrorDetailsID INT,  
        @EventLogPK INT,  
        @varParentEventLogPK INT,  
        @varSQLTransactionStarted BIT = 0,  
        @varSQLTransactionName NVARCHAR(32) = REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(CAST(@@SPID AS NVARCHAR(50)) + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(50), dbo.GetBSTDate(), 21), ' - ', ''), ' ', ''), ':', ''), '.', ''),  
        @ErrorMessageOut NVARCHAR(MAX),  
        @ErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX),  
        @ErrorSeverity INT;  
  
    -- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters  
    DECLARE   
        @varUserFK INT = @UserFK  
  
    SET @varParameterDetails = '@UserFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@varUserFK AS NVARCHAR(100)), '0');  
  
    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL   
        CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1), ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400), ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX), EventLogFK INT, HasException BIT);  
  
    SELECT TOP 1 @varParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC;  
  
    INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin], [Date], [Server], [Database], [Login], [Application], [ClientHost], [Schema], [ObjectName], [Operation], [State], [CommandText], ParentEventLogFK)  
    SELECT 'Database', dbo.GetBSTDate(), @@SERVERNAME, UPPER(DB_NAME()), -1, '', 'Azure', 'dbo', @varThisProcedureName, 'Exec', 'Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @varThisProcedureName + ' ' + @varParameterDetails, @varParentEventLogPK;  
  
    SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY();  
  
    SELECT @varExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);  
    SET @varExecutionPath = ISNULL(@varExecutionPath, @varThisProcedureName);  
    IF @varExecutionPath = @varThisProcedureName   
        SET @varExecutionPath = @varExecutionPath + ' ' + @varParameterDetails;  
    ELSE   
        SET @varExecutionPath = @varExecutionPath + '\' + @varThisProcedureName + ' ' + @varParameterDetails;  
  
    INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName, ExecutionPath, EventLogFK)   
    SELECT @varThisProcedureName, @varExecutionPath, @EventLogPK;  
    SET @varProcedureAndErrorDetailsID = SCOPE_IDENTITY();  
  
    WHILE @varDeadlockErrorRetries <= 3  
    BEGIN      
        SET @varSQLTransactionName = REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(CAST(@@SPID AS NVARCHAR(50)) + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(50), dbo.GetBSTDate(), 21), ' - ', ''), ' ', ''), ':', ''), '.', '');  
        SET @varSQLTransactionStarted = 0;  
  
        BEGIN TRY      
  
            -- This stored procedure's main code, excluding error handling - start  
  
            SELECT InsertedBy as UserFK, ReportsUserShortcutPK, ShortcutType, ShortcutName, ShortcutContent       
   FROM tblReportsUserShortcuts  
            WHERE InsertedBy = @varUserFK  
                AND IsArchived = 0    
  
            -- This stored procedure's main code, excluding error handling - end              
  
            BREAK;  
        END TRY  
        BEGIN CATCH  
  
            /* Attempt to rollback the SQL transaction if one was started */  
            IF @varSQLTransactionStarted = 1  
            BEGIN  
                BEGIN TRY   
                    ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @varSQLTransactionName   
                END TRY   
                BEGIN CATCH /*Ignore and continue*/   
                END CATCH  
            END  
  
            DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME = dbo.GetBSTDate();  
            SET @ErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();  
            SET @ErrorSeverity = ERROR_SEVERITY();  
            DECLARE @ErrorState INT = ERROR_STATE();  
              
            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1)   
                UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @varProcedureAndErrorDetailsID;  
              
            IF @varProcedureAndErrorDetailsID = 1   
                EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @varParameterDetails, @ErrorDateTime, @varExecutionPath, @ErrorMessageOut = @ErrorMessage OUTPUT;  
              
            IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 /*Deadlock error*/ OR @varDeadlockErrorRetries > 2  
            BEGIN   
                SET @varDeadlockErrorRetries = 100;  
                RAISERROR (@ErrorMessage, @ErrorSeverity, @ErrorState);  
                RETURN;  
            END  
            ELSE   
                WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500'; /* Pause for half a second before retrying after a deadlock error */  
        END CATCH  
  
        SET @varDeadlockErrorRetries = @varDeadlockErrorRetries + 1;  
    END  
END  
GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[spReportsUserStockInMovementsStatsByEventType]    Script Date: 02/11/2026 17:47:27 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spReportsUserStockInMovementsStatsByEventType]
(
	@BuildingFKs NVARCHAR(1000) = '2,11,21,24,30', /* BV2, BV4, BV1, SR1, BV5 */
	@StartDate DATETIME, 
	@EndDate DATETIME, 
	@EventType NVARCHAR(50) = 'Unloaded', /* Other possible value is 'Put Away' */
	@GoodsInNumber NVARCHAR(200) = ''
)
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets FROM interfering with SELECT statements; Read only (committed/saved data only); Ensure this proc has a low impact when executed */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED; SET DEADLOCK_PRIORITY LOW

	DECLARE @varBuildingFKs NVARCHAR(1000) = ISNULL(@BuildingFKs,'-1'),
		@varStartDate DATETIME = @StartDate, 
		@varEndDate DATETIME = @EndDate, 
		@varGoodsInNumber NVARCHAR(200) = ISNULL(@GoodsInNumber,''),
		@varEventType NVARCHAR(50) = ISNULL(@EventType, 'Unloaded')

	SET @varEndDate = DATEADD(DAY, 1, @EndDate)

	IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#BuildingFKs') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #BuildingFKs

	SELECT ISNULL(CAST([name] AS INT),-1) AS BuildingPK 
	INTO #BuildingFKs 
	FROM dbo.SplitString(@varBuildingFKs)

	IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#InitialDetails') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #InitialDetails

	SELECT DISTINCT si.StockInPK, si.ArrivalDate, ci.ContainerInPK, ci.GoodsInNumber, B.BuildingName, BU.BuildingUnit, silp.PalletFK
	INTO #InitialDetails		
	FROM dbo.tblContainerIns AS ci
	INNER JOIN dbo.tblstockins AS si
	ON ci.ContainerInPK = si.ContainerInFK
	INNER JOIN dbo.tblBuildingUnits AS bu
	ON ci.BuildingUnitFK = bu.BuildingUnitPK
	INNER JOIN dbo.tblBuildings AS b
	ON bu.BuildingFK = b.BuildingPK
	INNER JOIN dbo.#BuildingFKs AS BFK
	ON B.BuildingPK = BFK.BuildingPK
	INNER JOIN dbo.tblStockInLines AS sil
	ON si.StockInPK = sil.StockInFK
	INNER JOIN dbo.tblStockInLinePallets AS silp
	ON sil.StockInLinePK = silp.StockInLineFK
	INNER JOIN dbo.tblWorksOrderMovements AS wom
	ON silp.PalletFK = wom.PalletFK
	WHERE si.StockInStatusFK = 3 /* Complete */
	AND si.ArrivalDate >= @varStartDate
	AND si.ArrivalDate < @varEndDate
	AND LEFT(LTRIM(wom.MovementDescription),9) = 'HAND HELD' /* Faster than using LIKE */
	AND (ISNULL(@varGoodsInNumber,'') = '' OR CI.GoodsInNumber = @varGoodsInNumber)

	IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#Details') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #Details

	SELECT DISTINCT t.*, pt.pallettype, p.Barcode
	INTO #Details
	FROM #InitialDetails AS t
	INNER JOIN dbo.tblPallets AS p
	ON t.PalletFK = p.PalletPK
	LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.tblPalletTypes AS PT
	ON P.PalletTypeFK = pt.PalletTypePK

	IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#Details2') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #Details2

	SELECT DISTINCT 
		t.GoodsInNumber, pa.PalletAuditPK,		
		CASE 
			WHEN slt.LocationType = 'OnRouteContainerIn' OR slt.LocationType = 'LoadingBay' THEN 'Unloaded' 
			ELSE 'Put Away'
		END	AS PalletAuditEventType,		 		
		pa.PalletFK AS PalletFK, pa.eventdate AS MovementStartDateTime,
		wom.WorksOrderMovementPK, wom.PalletFK AS MovementPalletFK, wom.UpdatedDate AS MovementEndDateTime,
		CASE WHEN slt.LocationType = 'OnRouteContainerIn' THEN 'Container' ELSE slt.LocationType END AS SourceLocationType, 
		CASE WHEN dlt.LocationType = 'OnRouteContainerIn' THEN 'Container' ELSE dlt.LocationType END AS DestinationLocationType,
		ppl.FirstName + ' ' + ppl.LastName  + ' (' + ISNULL(CAST(u.UserPK AS NVARCHAR(50)),'') + ')' AS UserName,
		t.BuildingUnit, t.Barcode, t.StockInPK, t.PalletType, t.BuildingName,
		c.CustomerCode + ' - ' + c.CustomerName AS Customer, t.ArrivalDate
	INTO
		#Details2
	FROM 
		#Details AS t	
	INNER JOIN dbo.tblPalletAudit AS pa
		ON t.PalletFK = pa.PalletFK
	INNER JOIN dbo.appPalletAuditEventTypes AS paet
		ON pa.EventTypeFK = paet.PalletAuditEventTypePK 
	INNER JOIN dbo.tblWorksOrderMovements AS wom
		ON t.palletfk = wom.PalletFK	
	LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.appLocationTypes AS slt
		ON wom.SourceLocationTypeFK = slt.LocationTypePK
	LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.appLocationTypes AS dlt
		ON wom.DestinationLocationTypeFK = dlt.LocationTypePK
	LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.tblUsers AS u 
		ON wom.UpdatedBy = u.UserPK
	LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.tblPeople AS ppl
		ON u.PersonFK = ppl.PersonPK
	INNER JOIN dbo.tblStockInLines AS sil
		ON t.StockInPK = sil.StockInFK			
	INNER JOIN dbo.tblStockItems AS ski
		ON sil.StockItemFK = ski.StockItemPK
	INNER JOIN dbo.tblDivisions AS d
		ON ski.DivisionFK = d.DivisionPK
	INNER JOIN dbo.tblCustomers AS c
		ON d.CustomerFK = c.CustomerPK
	WHERE 
		pa.eventtypefk = 17 /* Pallet Movement */
		AND CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), pa.EventDate, 103) = CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), t.ArrivalDate, 103) /* dd/MM/yyyy */
		AND CONVERT(NVARCHAR(19), pa.EventDate, 120) = CONVERT(NVARCHAR(19), wom.InsertedDate, 120) /* yyyy-mm-dd hh:mi:ss */
		AND 
		(
			(slt.LocationType IN ('OnRouteContainerIn','LoadingBay') AND @varEventType = 'Unloaded')
			OR
			(slt.LocationType NOT IN ('OnRouteContainerIn','LoadingBay') AND @varEventType = 'Put Away')
		)
		AND LEFT(LTRIM(wom.MovementDescription),9) = 'HAND HELD' /* Faster than using LIKE */

	IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#Results') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #Results

	SELECT DISTINCT 
	ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY BuildingName ASC, BuildingUnit ASC, GoodsInNumber ASC, MovementStartDateTime ASC, PalletFK ASC) AS RowNumber, 
	*, CAST(0 AS BIT) AS MovementStartDateTimeUpdated
	INTO #Results 
	FROM #Details2
	WHERE PalletAuditEventType = @varEventType

	IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#GoodsOrderRowDetails') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #GoodsOrderRowDetails

	SELECT MIN(rownumber) AS MinRowNumber, MAX(rownumber) AS MaxRowNumber, GoodsInNumber, ArrivalDate
	INTO #GoodsOrderRowDetails
	FROM #Results 
	GROUP BY GoodsInNumber, ArrivalDate

	UPDATE t
	SET MovementStartDateTime = t2.ArrivalDate, MovementStartDateTimeUpdated = 1
	FROM #Results AS t
	INNER JOIN dbo.#GoodsOrderRowDetails AS t2
	ON t.RowNumber = t2.MinRowNumber

	DECLARE @varGoodsInNumber2 NVARCHAR(50), @minrownum INT

	WHILE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #Results WHERE MovementStartDateTimeUpdated = 0)
	BEGIN
		SELECT @minrownum = MIN(rownumber) 
		FROM #Results 
		WHERE MovementStartDateTimeUpdated = 0

		SELECT @varGoodsInNumber2 = GoodsInNumber
		FROM #Results
		WHERE rownumber = @minrownum

		UPDATE t
		set t.MovementStartDateTime = t2.MovementEndDateTime, MovementStartDateTimeUpdated = 1
		FROM #Results AS t
		INNER JOIN dbo.#Results AS t2
		ON t.RowNumber = t2.RowNumber + 1
		AND t.GoodsInNumber = t2.GoodsInNumber
		WHERE t.MovementStartDateTimeUpdated = 0			
		AND t.GoodsInNumber = @varGoodsInNumber2
		AND t.RowNumber >= @minrownum
	END

	IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#GoodsOrderMovementDurationAverageDetails') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #GoodsOrderMovementDurationAverageDetails

	SELECT a.GoodsInNumber, b.MinRowNumber, AVG(DATEDIFF(SS, a.MovementStartDateTime, a.MovementEndDateTime)) AS MovementDurationAverage 
	INTO #GoodsOrderMovementDurationAverageDetails
	FROM #Results AS a 
	INNER JOIN dbo.#GoodsOrderRowDetails AS b
	ON a.GoodsInNumber = b.GoodsInNumber
	WHERE a.RowNumber > b.MinRowNumber
	AND a.RowNumber <= b.MaxRowNumber
	GROUP BY a.GoodsInNumber, b.MinRowNumber

	UPDATE a
	set MovementStartDateTime = dateadd(ss, b.MovementDurationAverage * -1, MovementEndDateTime)
	FROM #Results AS a
	INNER JOIN dbo.#GoodsOrderMovementDurationAverageDetails AS b
	ON a.GoodsInNumber = b.GoodsInNumber
	WHERE a.RowNumber = b.MinRowNumber

	SELECT		
		BuildingName AS [Building Name],
		BuildingUnit AS [Building Unit],
		GoodsInNumber AS [Goods In Number],
		ArrivalDate AS [Arrival Date],
		PalletFK,
		Barcode AS [Pallet Barcode],		
		PalletAuditEventType AS [Event Type],
		MovementStartDateTime AS [Movemen Start Date Time],
		SourceLocationType AS [Movement Start Location],
		MovementEndDateTime AS [Movement End Date Time],
		DestinationLocationType AS [Movement End Location],
		CASE WHEN DATEPART(MINUTE,DATEADD(SECOND,DATEDIFF(ss, MovementStartDateTime, MovementEndDateTime),0)) < 10 THEN '0' ELSE '' END + CAST(DATEPART(MINUTE,DATEADD(SECOND,DATEDIFF(ss, MovementStartDateTime, MovementEndDateTime),0)) AS VARCHAR) + ':' + 
		CASE WHEN DATEPART(SECOND,DATEADD(SECOND,DATEDIFF(ss, MovementStartDateTime, MovementEndDateTime),0)) < 10 THEN '0' ELSE '' END + CAST(DATEPART(SECOND,DATEADD(SECOND,DATEDIFF(ss, MovementStartDateTime, MovementEndDateTime),0)) AS VARCHAR) AS [Duration (mm:ss)],
		UserName, 
		PalletType AS [Pallet Type],
		Customer
	FROM 
		#Results
	ORDER BY 
		RowNumber ASC
END
GO

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spReportsWeeklyStockMovementSummary]

 @divisionFK int,      
 @weekEnding datetime

BEGIN
