    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT      
 ,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;      
 SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();      
       
 -- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters      
 DECLARE @var_divisionFK int, @var_weekEnding datetime      
 SET @var_divisionFK = @divisionFK; SET @var_weekEnding = @weekEnding      
 SET @ParameterDetails = '@divisionFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_divisionFK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@weekEnding = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_weekEnding AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'')      
       
    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL       
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)      
      
    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)      
    --BEGIN      
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC       
      
  SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)      
      
        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)      
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK      
      
        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()      
    --END      
       
 SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);      
 SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails      
 ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;      
 INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()      
       
 WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3      
 BEGIN       
  BEGIN TRY         
      
   -- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start      
      
   IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#tblDivisions') IS NOT NULL      
    DROP TABLE #tblDivisions      
      
   SELECT DISTINCT       
   DivisionPK,      
   CustomerFK,      
   DivisionName      
   INTO #tblDivisions      
   FROM tblDivisions      
   WHERE DivisionPK = @var_divisionFK      
      
   Declare @divisionName nvarchar(200)      
      
   Select @divisionName = DivisionName from #tblDivisions      
      
   IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#tmpPalletAudit') IS NOT NULL      
    DROP TABLE #tmpPalletAudit                  
          
   --pallet audit      
   SELECT EventTypeFK, StockItemFK, EventFK, PalletFK, EventDate, BuildingunitFK, DivisionFK      
   INTO #tmpPalletAudit       
   FROM tblPalletAudit AS PA      
   INNER JOIN tblStockItems AS SIS on SIS.StockItemPK = PA.StockItemFK AND DivisionFK = @var_divisionFK      
   WHERE eventTypeFk in (1,2,3,16)      
   and EventDate between dateadd(day, -6, @var_weekEnding) and dateadd(day, 1, @var_weekEnding)      
   --select * from #tmpPalletAudit      
      
   IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#TmpContainerOutLines') IS NOT NULL      
    DROP TABLE #TmpContainerOutLines       
      
   --container out lines      
   SELECT distinct ContainerOutLinePK, ContainerOutFK         INTO #TmpContainerOutLines      
   FROM tblContainerOutLines      
   INNER JOIN tblContainerOuts ON containeroutfk = containeroutpk and ContainerOutStatusFK = 5 /*Complete*/and CollectionDate between dateadd(day, -6, @var_weekEnding) and dateadd(day, 1, @var_weekEnding)      
   WHERE divisionfk = @var_divisionFK      
   --select * from #TmpContainerOutLines      
      
   IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#TmpContainerOuts') IS NOT NULL      
    DROP TABLE #TmpContainerOuts      
      
   --container outs      
   SELECT distinct ContainerOutPK, GoodsOrderNumber, Address1, DocketValue1, DocketValue2, DocketValue3, Docketlabel1, Docketlabel2, Docketlabel3 ,CollectionDate, CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),CollectionDate,108) as OutTime   
   INTO #TmpContainerOuts      
   FROM tblContainerOuts      
   WHERE containeroutPK in (select containeroutfk from #TmpContainerOutLines) and CollectionDate between dateadd(day, -6, @var_weekEnding) and dateadd(day, 1, @var_weekEnding)      
   
   --select * from #TmpContainerOuts      
      
   IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#tblcontaineroutlinepalletcontent') IS NOT NULL      
    DROP TABLE #tblcontaineroutlinepalletcontent      
      
   SELECT DISTINCT      
   containeroutlinepalletcontentpk,      
   Units,      
   containeroutlinefk,      
   palletfk      
   INTO #tblcontaineroutlinepalletcontent      
   FROM #TmpContainerOutLines AS cOLi       
   Inner Join tblcontaineroutlinepalletcontent AS colpc       
   on cOLi.containeroutlinepk = colpc.containeroutlinefk       
      
   IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#tblWorksOrderMovements') IS NOT NULL      
    DROP TABLE #tblWorksOrderMovements      
      
   SELECT DISTINCT woms.ContainerOutLinePalletContentFK, WorksOrderStatusFK, SourcelocationFK, sourceLocationTypeFK      
   INTO #tblWorksOrderMovements      
   FROM #tblContainerOutLinePalletContent AS cOPal       
   INNER JOIN tblWorksOrderMovements AS woms       
   ON woms.ContainerOutLinePalletContentFK = cOPal.ContainerOutLinePalletContentPK      
   WHERE woms.WorksOrderStatusFK NOT IN (5,6)      
      
   IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#tblWorksOrders') IS NOT NULL      
    DROP TABLE #tblWorksOrders      
      
   select distinct      
   wos.WorksOrderPK,      
   wos.FK      
   into #tblWorksOrders      
   from #tmpPalletAudit AS pa      
   inner join tblWorksOrders AS wos       
   on wos.WorksOrderPK = pa.EventFK      
   Where pa.EventTypeFK = 16      
      
   IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#tblStockInLines') IS NOT NULL      
    DROP TABLE #tblStockInLines       
         
   select distinct      
   sils.StockInLinePK,      
   sils.StockInFK,      
   sils.StockItemFK,      
   sils.units,      
   silp.palletfk      
   into #tblStockInLines      
   from #tmpPalletAudit as pa      
   inner join tblstockinlinepallets silp on pa.palletfk = silp.palletfk and pa.eventtypefk = 1      
   inner join tblStockInLines AS sils on sils.StockInLinePK = silp.StockInLineFK            
      
   IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#tblStockItems') IS NOT NULL      
    DROP TABLE #tblStockItems      
      
   SELECT DISTINCT SI.StockItemPK, SI.DivisionFK       
   INTO #tblStockItems      
   from tblStockItems AS SI      
   INNER JOIN #tmpPalletAudit AS PA      
   ON SI.StockItemPK = PA.StockItemFK      
      
   IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#days') IS NOT NULL      
    DROP TABLE #days       
      
   Select      
   Convert(varchar(50), dateadd(day, -6, @var_weekEnding), 111) AS [Date],      
   dateadd(day, -6, @var_weekEnding) AS [DisplayDate],      
   datename(weekday,dateadd(dd,-6,@var_weekEnding)) AS [DayName]
   
   INTO #days      
   UNION      
   Select      
   Convert(varchar(50), dateadd(day, -5, @var_weekEnding), 111) AS [Date],      
   dateadd(day, -5, @var_weekEnding) AS [DisplayDate],      
   datename(weekday,dateadd(dd,-5,@var_weekEnding)) AS [DayName]      
   UNION      
   Select      
   Convert(varchar(50), dateadd(day, -4, @var_weekEnding), 111) AS [Date],      
   dateadd(day, -4, @var_weekEnding) AS [DisplayDate],      
   datename(weekday,dateadd(dd,-4,@var_weekEnding)) AS [DayName]      
   UNION      
   Select      
   Convert(varchar(50), dateadd(day, -3, @var_weekEnding), 111) AS [Date],      
   dateadd(day, -3, @var_weekEnding) AS [DisplayDate],      
   datename(weekday,dateadd(dd,-3,@var_weekEnding)) AS [DayName]      
   UNION      
   Select      
   Convert(varchar(50), dateadd(day, -2, @var_weekEnding), 111) AS [Date],      
   dateadd(day, -2, @var_weekEnding) AS [DisplayDate],      
   datename(weekday,dateadd(dd,-2,@var_weekEnding)) AS [DayName]      
   UNION      
   Select      
   Convert(varchar(50), dateadd(day, -1, @var_weekEnding), 111) AS [Date],      
   dateadd(day, -1, @var_weekEnding) AS [DisplayDate],      
   datename(weekday,dateadd(dd,-1,@var_weekEnding)) AS [DayName]      
   UNION      
   Select      
   Convert(varchar(50), @var_weekEnding, 111) AS [Date],      
   @var_weekEnding AS [DisplayDate],      
   datename(weekday,dateadd(dd,0,@var_weekEnding)) AS [DayName]      
       
   IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#Bunit') IS NOT NULL      
    DROP TABLE #Bunit      
      
   Select DISTINCT      
   CASE WHEN sourceLocationTypeFK = 1 THEN       
   vbus.BuildingUnitFK      
   WHEN sourceLocationTypeFK = 2 THEN       
   lBay.BuildingUnitFK      
   WHEN sourceLocationTypeFK = 3 THEN      
   lset.BuildingUnitFK      
   WHEN sourceLocationTypeFK = 6 THEN      
   lSam.BuildingUnitFK      
   WHEN sourceLocationTypeFK = 8 THEN      
   lFloor.BuildingUnitFK      
   END as BuildingUnitFK,      
   ContainerOutLineFK      
   INTO #Bunit      
   from       
   #TmpContainerOuts AS cOuts      
   INNER JOIN #TmpContainerOutLines AS cOLi       
   on ContainerOutPK  = ContainerOutFK      
   INNER JOIN #tblContainerOutLinePalletContent AS cOPal       
   on ContainerOutLineFK = ContainerOutLinePK       
   INNER JOIN #tblWorksOrderMovements AS woms       
   ON woms.ContainerOutLinePalletContentFK = cOPal.ContainerOutLinePalletContentPK      
   LEFT OUTER JOIN viewBuildingUnitBays AS vbus       
   on vbus.BuildingUnitBayPK = SourcelocationFK       
   LEFT OUTER JOIN tblLoadingBays AS lBay       
   ON lBay.loadingBayPK = SourceLocationFK       
   LEFT OUTER JOIN tblSetDownAreas AS lSet       
   ON lSEt.SetdownareaPK = SourceLocationFK       
   LEFT OUTER JOIN tblSampleLocations AS lSam       
   ON lSam.SampleLocationPK = sourceLocationFK      
   LEFT OUTER JOIN tblFloorLocations AS lFloor       
   on  lFloor.Floorlocationpk = sourceLocationFK      
   where       
   WorksOrderStatusFK not in (5,6)      
      
   IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#buildings') IS NOT NULL      
    DROP TABLE #buildings      
      
   Select distinct      
   BuildingName + ' - ' + BuildingUnit as Building,      
   BuildingUnitPK      
   into #buildings      
   FROM tblBuildingUnits       
   INNER JOIN tblBuildings       
   on BuildingPK = BuildingFK      
      
   IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#BuildingUnitCount') IS NOT NULL      
    DROP TABLE #BuildingUnitCount      
      
   select Count(*) as detailsCount, containerOutFK       
   into #BuildingUnitCount      
   from #TmpContainerOuts      
   INNER JOIN tblStockOrders       
   ON containerOutFK = ContainerOutPK       
   Group by containeroutfk      
      
   IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#palletsOutPA') IS NOT NULL      
    DROP TABLE #palletsOutPA      
         
   Select 1 AS PalletsOut,buildingunitfk, PalletFK, EventFK      
   into #palletsOutPA      
   from #tmpPalletAudit AS PA      
   INNER JOIN #TmpContainerOutLines AS TCOL      
   ON PA.EventFK = TCOL.ContainerOutLinePK      
   Where EventTypeFK = 2      
   Group By buildingunitfk, EventFK, PalletFK      
      
   IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#tblstockorders') IS NOT NULL      
    DROP TABLE #tblstockorders      
      
   SELECT DISTINCT      
   responsibleBuildingUnitFK, containerOutFK      
   INTO #tblstockorders      
   from tblstockorders AS SO      
   INNER JOIN #TmpContainerOuts AS TCO      
   ON SO.containerOutFK = TCO.containeroutPk      
      
   IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#tblStockIns') IS NOT NULL      
    DROP TABLE #tblStockIns      
      
   SELECT DISTINCT      
   sins.StockInPK,      
   sins.ContainerInFK      
   INTO #tblStockIns      
   FROM tblStockIns AS sins      
   INNER JOIN #tblStockInLines AS sils      
   ON sins.StockInPK = sils.StockInFK      
         
   IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#tblContainerIns') IS NOT NULL      
    DROP TABLE #tblContainerIns      
      
   SELECT DISTINCT       
   cIns.ContainerInPK,      
   cIns.SupplierFK,      
   cIns.BuildingUnitFK,      
   cIns.StockInStatusFK,      
   cIns.GoodsInNumber,      
   cIns.Free1,      
   cIns.Free2,      
   cIns.Free3,      
   cIns.Free4,      
   cIns.ExternalReference,      
   CASE WHEN ISNULL(cIns.StockInGroupFK, -1) > 0 THEN 'G-' + CAST(cIns.StockInGroupFK AS NVARCHAR(50)) ELSE '' END AS StockInGroupNumber  
  , CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),DateIn,108) as InTime
   INTO #tblContainerIns      
   FROM tblContainerIns as cIns       
   INNER JOIN #tblStockIns AS sins      
   on  cIns.ContainerInPK = sins.ContainerInFK      
      --select * from #tblContainerIns
   IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#palletsabsorbed') IS NOT NULL      
    DROP TABLE #palletsabsorbed      
                   
   Select count(*) AS pallets, pa.PalletFK, pa.StockItemFK, wos.FK       
   into #palletsabsorbed      
   from #tmpPalletAudit AS pa       
   inner join #tblWorksOrders AS wos       
   on wos.WorksOrderPK = EventFK      
   inner join #tblStockInLines as sils      
   on pa.StockItemFK = sils.StockItemFK      
   inner join #tblStockIns as sins      
   on wos.FK = sins.StockInPK       
   Where EventTypeFK = 16      
   Group By pa.PalletFK, pa.StockItemFK, wos.FK            
      
   IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#cdis') IS NOT NULL      
    DROP TABLE #cdis      
      
   select DISTINCT cdis.Customerfk, cdis.CustomerDocketIdentificationPK, cdis.FieldFK, cdis.Prefix, cdis.Field2FK, cdis.Prefix2       
   into #cdis      
   from tblCustomerDocketIdentifications as cdis      
   inner join #tblDivisions as div      
   on cdis.CustomerFK = div.CustomerFK      
   where DocketTypeFK = 1      
      
   IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#tmpPalletAuditEventTypeFK1') IS NOT NULL      
    DROP TABLE #tmpPalletAuditEventTypeFK1      
      
   Select       
   *       
   INTO #tmpPalletAuditEventTypeFK1      
   from #tmpPalletAudit       
   Where EventTypeFK = 1      
      
   IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#subq') IS NOT NULL      
    DROP TABLE #subq      
      
   select       
    tbus.Building, cIns.GoodsInNumber, suppliers.Supplier AS Party3, sum(sils.units) AS UnitsIn,       
    count(distinct sils.palletfk) - isnull(sum(PalletsAbsorbed.pallets), 0) AS PalletsIn, 1 as DetailsCount, Convert(varchar(50), EventDate ,111) AS EventDate,      
    case when cdis.CustomerDocketIdentificationPK is null then       
     CASE WHEN  cins.ExternalReference <> '' THEN 'External Reference: '  + cins.ExternalReference ELSE ' ' end        
    else      
     coalesce(case cdis.FieldFK when 1 then      
      case when LEN(cins.Free1) > 0 THEN       
      cdis.Prefix + ' ' + cins.Free1 END      
     when 2 then      
      case WHEN LEN(cins.Free2) > 0 THEN       
      cdis.Prefix + ' ' + cins.Free2 END       
     when 3 then      
      CASE WHEN LEN(cins.Free3) > 0 THEN       
      cdis.Prefix + ' ' + cins.Free3 END      
     when 4 then      
      CASE WHEN LEN(cins.Free4) > 0 THEN       
      cdis.Prefix + ' ' + cins.Free4 END      
     end , '')     
     + ' ' +      
     case cdis.Field2FK when 1 then      
      cdis.Prefix2 + ' ' + cins.Free1      
     when 2 then      
      cdis.Prefix2 + ' ' + cins.Free2      
     when 3 then      
      cdis.Prefix2 + ' ' + cins.Free3      
     when 4 then      
      cdis.Prefix2 + ' ' + cins.Free4      
     else      
      ''      
     end      
    End as ID,      
    cIns.StockInGroupNumber   ,
	cIns.InTime
   INTO       
    #subq      
   from       
    #tmpPalletAuditEventTypeFK1 as pa      
   inner join #tblStockItems sis       
    on sis.StockItemPK = pa.StockItemFK       
    AND sis.DivisionFK = @var_divisionFK      
   inner join #tblStockInLines sils       
    on sils.palletfk = pa.palletfk      
   inner join #tblDivisions div       
    ON div.DivisionPK = sis.DivisionFK      
   left outer join #cdis as cdis      
    on cdis.CustomerFK = div.CustomerFK      
   inner join #tblStockIns as sins      
    on  sins.StockInPK = sils.StockInFK      
   inner join #tblContainerIns as cIns       
    on  cIns.ContainerInPK = sins.ContainerInFK      
   left outer join tblSuppliers as suppliers       
    on suppliers.SupplierPK = cIns.SupplierFK      
   left outer join #buildings as tbus       
    on tbus.BuildingUnitPK = cIns.BuildingUnitFK      
   left outer join #palletsabsorbed as palletsabsorbed       
    on palletsabsorbed.StockItemFK = sils.StockItemFK       
    AND palletsabsorbed.FK = sins.StockInPK       
    AND palletsabsorbed.PalletFK = pa.PalletFK      
   WHERE       
    cins.StockInStatusFK not in (1,4)-- <> 1 /*Not OnRoute*/      
   group by       
    tbus.Building, cIns.GoodsInNumber, EventDate, suppliers.Supplier, cdis.FieldFK, cdis.Prefix,       
    cIns.Free1, cIns.Free3, cIns.Free2, cIns.Free4, cdis.Field2FK, cdis.Prefix2, CustomerDocketIdentificationPK, cIns.ExternalReference, cIns.StockInGroupNumber  , cIns.InTime    
      
   IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#palletsIn') IS NOT NULL      
    DROP TABLE #palletsIn      
      
   select       
    Building, GoodsInNumber, Party3, sum(UnitsIn) AS UnitsIn, sum(palletsin) AS PalletsIn, DetailsCount, EventDate, ID, StockInGroupNumber, InTime      
   INTO      
    #palletsIn       
   from       
    #subq AS subq     INNER JOIN #days AS [days]      
    on subq.EventDate = [days].[Date]      
   group by       
    Building, GoodsInNumber, Party3, DetailsCount, EventDate, ID, StockInGroupNumber, InTime      
          

		--  select * from #palletsIn
   IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#pta') IS NOT NULL      
    DROP TABLE #pta           
                   
   select distinct pa.PalletFK, pa.EventFK, pa.EventDate, pa.StockItemFK       
   into #pta      
   from #tmpPalletAudit AS pa       
   inner join #TmpContainerOutLines AS cOutLines      
   on pa.EventFK = cOutLines.ContainerOutLinePK      
   where pa.EventTypeFK = 3      
         
   IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#palAu') IS NOT NULL      
    DROP TABLE #palAu       
      
   Select DISTINCT pa.EventFK, pa.BuildingunitFK, pa.palletfk       
   INTO #palAu      
   FROM #TmpContainerOutLines as cOLi       
   Inner Join #tblcontaineroutlinepalletcontent AS colpc       
   on cOLi.containeroutlinepk = colpc.containeroutlinefk                                         
   INNER JOIN #tmpPalletAudit as pa       
   on pa.EventFK = ContainerOutLinePK       
   and pa.palletfk = colpc.palletfk                  
   Where pa.EventTypeFK = 3        
        
   IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#docketOut') IS NOT NULL      
    DROP TABLE #docketOut      
      
   Select  distinct       
    colpc.containeroutlinepalletcontentpk,       
    colpc.Units,      
    ContainerOutPK,       
    CASE WHEN bEvent.BuildingUnitPK is null THEN BuWoms.Building ELSE bEvent.Building END as Building,      
    CASE WHEN bEvent.BuildingUnitPK is null THEN BuWoms.BuildingUnitPK ELSE bEvent.BuildingUnitPK END as BuildingUnitFK      
   into      
    #docketOut      
   from       
    #TmpContainerOuts as cOuts      
   INNER JOIN #TmpContainerOutLines as cOLi       
    on ContaineroutPK  = ContainerOutFK      
   Inner Join #tblcontaineroutlinepalletcontent AS colpc       
    on cOLi.containeroutlinepk = colpc.containeroutlinefk                                         
   INNER JOIN #palAu as palAu       
    on palAu.EventFK = ContainerOutLinePK       
    and palau.palletfk = colpc.palletfk      
   LEFT OUTER JOIN #buildings as bEvent      
    ON bEvent.BuildingUnitPK = palAu.BuildingUnitFK      
   -- Get the building unitthrough the WorksOrderMovement       
   LEFT OUTER JOIN #Bunit AS Bunit      
    ON Bunit.ContaineroutLineFK = cOLi.containerOutLinePK      
   -- Get The BuildingName and Unit for the WOMS      
   LEFT OUTER JOIN #buildings as buWoms      
    ON buWoms.BuildingUnitPK = Bunit.BuildingUnitFK        
                
   IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#UnitsOut') IS NOT NULL      
    DROP TABLE #UnitsOut       
      
   select sum (Units) as UnitsOut, docketOut.ContainerOutPK, Building, BuildingUnitFK      
   INTO #UnitsOut      
   FROM #docketOut as docketOut      
   inner join #TmpContainerOuts as cOuts       
   ON docketOut.ContainerOutPK = cOuts.ContainerOutPK      
   INNER JOIN #tblStockOrders as stkOr       
   ON stkOr.ContainerOutFK = cOuts.ContainerOutPK       
   AND docketOut.BuildingUnitFK = stkOr.responsibleBuildingUnitFK --zxc      
   group by docketOut.ContainerOutPK , Building, BuildingUnitFK      
         
   IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#palletBuilding') IS NOT NULL      
    DROP TABLE #palletBuilding      
         
   select       
    containerOutPK , sum(palletsOut) as PalletsOut ,      
    case       
     when buildingunitfk = -1 then (select TOP 1       
              responsibleBuildingUnitFK       
             from       
              #tblstockorders       
             where       
              containeroutPk = containerOutFK)       
     ELSE       
      BuildingUnitFK       
    END as buildingUnitFK      
   into      
    #palletBuilding      
   from       
    #TmpContainerOuts              
   inner join #TmpContainerOutLines cOutLines       
    ON cOutLines.ContaineroutFK = ContainerOutPK      
   left outer join #palletsOutPA AS palletsOutPA      
    on palletsOutPA.EventFK = cOutLines.ContainerOutLinePK      
   group by       
    containerOutPK, buildingunitfk       
         
   IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#palletsOut') IS NOT NULL      
    DROP TABLE #palletsOut           
            
   SELECT       
    palletBuilding.containerOutPK , palletBuilding.BuildingUnitFK, sum(palletBuilding.palletsOut) as PalletsOut       
   INTO      
    #palletsOut      
   FROM       
    #palletBuilding as palletBuilding      
   inner join #TmpContainerOuts as cOuts       
    ON palletBuilding.ContainerOutPK = cOuts.ContainerOutPK      
   INNER JOIN #tblStockOrders as stkOr       
    ON stkOr.ContainerOutFK = cOuts.ContainerOutPK       
    AND palletBuilding.BuildingUnitFK = stkOr.responsibleBuildingUnitFK                       
   group by       
    palletBuilding.containeroutPK , BuildingUnitFK       
           
   IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#palletsOut2') IS NOT NULL      
    DROP TABLE #palletsOut2            
          
   select       
    Building ,cOuts.GoodsOrderNumber as GoodsOrderNumber, cOuts.Address1 as Party3, UnitsOut,       
    CASE WHEN PalletsOut is null then 0 ELSE PalletsOut END as PalletsOut, DetailsCount,       
    Convert(varchar(50), pta.EventDate ,111) as EventDate,      
    case when cdis.CustomerDocketIdentificationPK is null then       
     (case when cOuts.Docketlabel1 <> '' THEN cOuts.Docketlabel1 + ': ' + cOuts.DocketValue1 else ''end + ' ' +      
     case when cOuts.Docketlabel2 <> '' THEN cOuts.Docketlabel2 + ': ' + cOuts.DocketValue2  else '' end + ' ' +      
     case when cOuts.Docketlabel3 <> '' THEN cOuts.Docketlabel3 + ': ' + cOuts.DocketValue3 else '' end )       
    else      
     case cdis.FieldFK when 40 then      
      cdis.Prefix + ' ' + cOuts.DocketValue1      
     when 2 then      
      cdis.Prefix + ' ' + cOuts.DocketValue2      
     when 2 then      
      cdis.Prefix + ' ' + cOuts.DocketValue3      
     end      
    End as ID,
	cOuts.OutTime 
   into      
    #palletsOut2      
   from      
    #TmpContainerOutLines AS cOutLines      
   inner join #pta as pta       
    on pta.EventFK = cOutLines.ContainerOutLinePK      
   inner join #TmpContainerOuts as cOuts       
    on cOuts.ContainerOutPK = cOutLines.ContainerOutFK      
   INNER JOIN #tblStockOrders as stkOr       
    ON stkOr.ContainerOutFK = cOuts.ContainerOutPK            
   inner join #tblDivisions as div       
    ON div.DivisionPK = @var_divisionFK      
   inner join #tblStockItems as si       
    on si.StockItemPK = pta.StockItemfK      
   -- Retrieve the Units for Goods Out per buildingUnit      
   LEFT OUTER JOIN #UnitsOut AS UnitsOut      
    ON UnitsOut.ContainerOutPK = cOuts.ContainerOutPK      
    AND UnitsOut.BuildingUnitFK = stkOr.responsibleBuildingUnitFK --zxc      
   -- Retrieve the Pallet Count for Goods Out per buildingUnit      
   LEFT OUTER JOIN #palletsOut As palletsOut       
    ON palletsOut.ContainerOutPK = cOuts.ContainerOutPK      
    AND palletsOut.BuildingUnitFK = stkOr.responsibleBuildingUnitFK               
   -- Count how many building Units the GoodsOrder is spread over      
   LEFT OUTER JOIN #BuildingUnitCount as BuildingUnitCount      
    ON BuildingUnitCount.ContainerOutFK = cOuts.ContainerOutPK      
   left outer join tblCustomerDocketIdentifications cdis       
    on cdis.CustomerFK = div.CustomerFK      
    AND cdis.DocketTypeFK = 2 /*ContainerOut*/      
   group by       
    cOuts.GoodsOrderNumber, Building , cOuts.Address1, EventDate, palletsOut, unitsout, detailsCount, CustomerDocketIdentificationPK, docketvalue1,       
    docketValue2, docketvalue3, Docketlabel1, Docketlabel2,Docketlabel3, FieldFK,Prefix,OutTime       
                       
					   
					--   select * from #palletsOut2
   ------------------------------------------      
   -- Return the final results to the report      
 ------------------------------------------       
      
   Select       
    Building,[days].*, 'Receipts' AS [Type], 'Supplier' AS Party3Type,     
 case when palletsIn.StockInGroupNumber !=''     
 then    
 palletsIn.GoodsInNumber +' ( '+ palletsIn.StockInGroupNumber +' )'    
 else    
 palletsIn.GoodsInNumber     
 end AS [DocketNumber],    
     
 Party3,palletsIn.UnitsIn AS Units,       
    palletsIn.PalletsIn AS PalletsIn, 0 as PalletsOut, DetailsCount, ID, @var_weekEnding AS WeekEnding, @divisionName AS DivisionName, palletsIn.StockInGroupNumber, InTime as DocketTime      
   from       
    #days as [days]      
   left outer join #palletsIn as palletsIn       
    on palletsIn.EventDate = [days].[Date]      
           
   UNION       
            
   Select       
    Building, [days].*, 'Dispatches', 'Consignee' Party3Type, palletsOut.GoodsOrderNumber, Party3,palletsOut.UnitsOut,       
    0 as PalletsIn, palletsOut.PalletsOut as PalletsOut, DetailsCount, ID, @var_weekEnding AS WeekEnding, @divisionName AS DivisionName, '' as StockInGroupNumber, OutTime as DocketTime      
   from       
    #days as [days]      
   left outer join #palletsOut2 AS palletsOut       
    on palletsOut.EventDate = [days].[Date]      
   ORDER BY       
    [Date] ASC, [Type] DESC, DocketNumber ASC      
         
   -- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end      
      
   BREAK      
  END TRY      
  BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */      
   DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;      
   SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;      
   SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;      
      
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY       
   BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;      
             
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;      
      
            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID      
                  
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;      
                  
   IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)      
   BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END      
   ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */      
  END CATCH      
  SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1      
 END      
END

			+ ',@orderByBatch = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_orderByBatch AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@orderByDateReceived = ' 
				+ ISNULL(CAST(@var_orderByDateReceived AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@batchWildcard = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_batchWildcard AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') 
					+ ',@orderByBestBefore = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_orderByBestBefore AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') 
						+ ',@FilterBestBeforeDate = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_FilterBestBeforeDate AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'')
							+ ',@ExportingToExcel = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_ExportingToExcel AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'')

         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    --BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

		SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END

	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start

			DECLARE @for NVARCHAR(100)

			SET @for = ''

			IF(@var_divisionFKs > -1)BEGIN
				Set @for = @for + (case when len(@for) > 0 then ', ' else '' end) + 'Division: ' + (Select DivisionName from tblDivisions Where DivisionPK = @var_divisionFKs)
			END

			IF(@var_stockItemFK <> -1) 		
				SET @for = @for + (CASE WHEN LEN(@for) > 0 THEN ', ' ELSE '' END) + 'Stock Item: ' + (SELECT StockItemCode FROM tblStockItems WHERE StockItemPK = @var_stockItemFK)

			IF(@var_batch <> '')
				SET @for = @for + (CASE WHEN LEN(@for) > 0 THEN ', ' ELSE '' END) + 'Batch: ' + @var_batch + CASE WHEN @var_batchWildcard = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ THEN ' *' ELSE '' END
				/*
			-- Retrieve a list of all the additional Values 
			IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#PalletAdditionalFields') IS NOT NULL
				DROP TABLE #PalletAdditionalFields
	
			SELECT 
				PalletFK, 
				AdditionalValue1 AS [AdditionalField1], 
				AdditionalValue2 AS [AdditionalField2], 
				AdditionalValue3 AS [AdditionalField3], 
				AdditionalValue4 AS [AdditionalField4], 
				AdditionalValue5 AS [AdditionalField5]
			INTO 
				#PalletAdditionalFields
			FROM 
				fnPalletAdditionalFields2()
				*/
			DECLARE @customerFK INT

			SELECT TOP 1 
				@customerFK = CustomerFK
			FROM 
				tblDivisions divs
			WHERE 
				(',' + @var_divisionFKs +',' LIKE '%,' + CONVERT(VARCHAR, divs.DivisionPK) + ',%')

			IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#tblPallets') IS NOT NULL
				DROP TABLE #tblPallets

			SELECT DISTINCT
				PalletPK, 
				BuildingUnitFK, 
				CustomerPalletNumber, 
				CustomerBarcode, 
				Barcode, 
				PalletStatusFK,
				IsArchived
			INTO
				#tblPallets
			FROM
				tblPallets
			WHERE
				IsArchived = 0
				AND PalletStatusFK <> 10

			IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#tblPalletAudit') IS NOT NULL
				DROP TABLE #tblPalletAudit

			SELECT DISTINCT
				PalletFK, EventDate
			INTO 
				#tblPalletAudit
			FROM 
				tblPalletAudit AS pa
			INNER JOIN #tblPallets AS p
				ON pa.PalletFK = p.PalletPK
			WHERE 
				pa.EventTypeFK = 1

			IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#tblPalletContent') IS NOT NULL
				DROP TABLE #tblPalletContent

			SELECT 
				PalletFK, StockItemFK, Batch, BestBefore, DateOfManufacture, SpecialStockTypeFK,
				SUM(ActualUnits) AS ActualUnits, SUM(ActualEaches * ActualUnits) AS ActualEachUnits,
				SUM(AvailableUnits) AS AvailableUnits, SUM(AvailableEaches * AvailableUnits) AS AvailableEachUnits 
			INTO 
				#tblPalletContent
			FROM 
				tblPalletContent AS subPc
			INNER JOIN #tblPallets AS p
				ON subPc.PalletFK = p.PalletPK
			WHERE
				(subPc.StockItemFK = @var_stockItemFK and @var_stockItemFK > 0)
				OR @var_stockItemFK = -1
			GROUP BY 
				PalletFK, StockItemFK, Batch, BestBefore, DateOfManufacture, SpecialStockTypeFK

			IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#tblStockItems') IS NOT NULL
				DROP TABLE #tblStockItems

			SELECT DISTINCT
				stockItems.StockItemPK,
				stockItems.StockItemCode, 
				stockItems.[Description], 
				stockItems.EachesTypeFK,
				stockItems.UnitTypeFK,
				stockItems.DivisionFK
			INTO
				#tblStockItems
			FROM
				tblStockItems AS stockItems 
			INNER JOIN #tblPalletContent AS pc
				ON stockItems.StockItemPK = pc.StockItemFK

			IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#viewPalletLocations') IS NOT NULL
				DROP TABLE #viewPalletLocations

			SELECT DISTINCT
				palletLocation.palletPK,
				palletLocation.[Location]
			INTO
				#viewPalletLocations
			FROM 
				viewPalletLocations AS palletLocation
			INNER JOIN #tblPallets AS p
				ON palletLocation.palletPK = p.palletPk

			IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#tblstockinlinepallets') IS NOT NULL
				DROP TABLE #tblstockinlinepallets

			SELECT DISTINCT
				palletfk,
				stockinlinefk
			INTO
				#tblstockinlinepallets
			FROM
				tblstockinlinepallets AS slp
			INNER JOIN #tblPallets AS p
				on slp.PalletFK = p.PalletPK
				
			IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#tblstockinlines') IS NOT NULL
				DROP TABLE #tblstockinlines

			SELECT DISTINCT
				sil.stockinlinepk,
				sil.stockinfk
			INTO
				#tblstockinlines
			FROM

			INNER JOIN tblstockinlines AS sil		
				ON silp.stockinlinefk = sil.stockinlinepk

			IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#tblstockins') IS NOT NULL
				DROP TABLE #tblstockins

				si.stockinpk,
				si.divisionfk,

			INTO

			FROM

			INNER JOIN tblstockins AS si				
				ON sil.stockinfk = si.stockinpk

			IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#tblcontainerins') IS NOT NULL
				DROP TABLE #tblcontainerins

			SELECT DISTINCT
				cIns.containerinpk,
				cIns.Free1,
				cIns.Free2,
				cIns.Free3,
				cIns.Free4,
				cIns.Free5,
				cIns.ExternalReference
			INTO
				#tblcontainerins
			from 
				#tblstockins AS si					
			INNER JOIN tblcontainerins AS cIns
				ON si.containerinfk = cIns.containerinpk

			IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#StockInDetails') IS NOT NULL
				DROP TABLE #StockInDetails

			SELECT DISTINCT 
				silp.palletfk, 
				case when cdis.CustomerDocketIdentificationPK is null then     
				 CASE WHEN  cIns.ExternalReference <> '' THEN 'External Reference: '  + cIns.ExternalReference ELSE ' ' end      
				else    
				 case cdis.FieldFK when 1 then    
				  case when LEN(cins.Free1) > 0 THEN     
				  cdis.Prefix + ' ' + cins.Free1 END    
				 when 2 then    
				  case WHEN LEN(cins.Free2) > 0 THEN     
				  cdis.Prefix + ' ' + cins.Free2 END     
				 when 3 then    
				  CASE WHEN LEN(cins.Free3) > 0 THEN     
				  cdis.Prefix + ' ' + cins.Free3 END    
				 when 4 then    
				  CASE WHEN LEN(cins.Free4) > 0 THEN     
				  cdis.Prefix + ' ' + cins.Free4 END    
				 end    
				 + ' ' +    
				 case cdis.Field2FK when 1 then    
				  cdis.Prefix2 + ' ' + cins.Free1    
				 when 2 then    
				  cdis.Prefix2 + ' ' + cins.Free2    
				 when 3 then    
				  cdis.Prefix2 + ' ' + cins.Free3    
				 when 4 then    
				  cdis.Prefix2 + ' ' + cins.Free4    
				 else

				 end

			INTO

			from 
				#tblstockinlinepallets AS silp			
			INNER JOIN #tblstockinlines AS sil				
				ON silp.stockinlinefk = sil.stockinlinepk
			INNER JOIN #tblstockins AS si					
				ON sil.stockinfk = si.stockinpk
			INNER JOIN #tblcontainerins AS cIns				
				ON si.containerinfk = cIns.containerinpk
			INNER JOIN tbldivisions AS d
				ON si.divisionfk = d.divisionpk
			LEFT OUTER JOIN tblCustomerDocketIdentifications AS cdis
				ON cdis.CustomerFK = d.CustomerFK 
				AND cdis.DocketTypeFK = 1 /*ContainerIn*/

				/*get all pending container out details*/
			IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#PendingContainerOuts') IS NOT NULL
				DROP TABLE #PendingContainerOuts

			SELECT palletfk, cOuts.GoodsOrderNumber,
				case when cdis.CustomerDocketIdentificationPK is null then 
					case when Docketlabel1 <> '' THEN Docketlabel1 + ': ' + DocketValue1 else ''end + ' ' +
					case when Docketlabel2 <> '' THEN Docketlabel2 + ': ' + DocketValue2  else '' end + ' ' +
					CASE when Docketlabel3 <> '' THEN Docketlabel3 + ': ' + DocketValue3 else '' end	
				else
					case cdis.FieldFK when 40 then
						cdis.Prefix + ' ' + cOuts.DocketValue1
					when 41 then
						cdis.Prefix + ' ' + cOuts.DocketValue2
					when 42 then
						cdis.Prefix + ' ' + cOuts.DocketValue3
					end
					+ ' ' +
					case cdis.Field2FK when 40 then

					when 41 then

					when 42 then

					else

					end
				End as [ID]
			INTO #PendingContainerOuts
			FROM tblcontainerouts cOuts
			INNER JOIN tblcontaineroutlines tcol ON cOuts.ContainerOutPK = tcol.ContainerOutFK
			INNER JOIN dbo.tblContainerOutLinePalletContent tcolpc ON tcol.ContainerOutLinePK = tcolpc.ContainerOutLineFK
			INNER JOIN tbldivisions div ON div.divisionpk = tcol.DivisionFK
			left outer join tblCustomerDocketIdentifications cdis on cdis.CustomerFK = div.CustomerFK AND cdis.DocketTypeFK = 2 /*ContainerOut*/
			WHERE cOuts.ContainerOutStatusFK < 5 AND palletfk > 0 AND (',' + @var_divisionFKs +',' LIKE '%,' + CONVERT(VARCHAR, div.divisionPK) + ',%')

			IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#results') IS NOT NULL
				DROP TABLE #results

			Select distinct
				@for AS [For Division], 
				
				'Building: ' + buildings.BuildingName + ' - ' + bus.BuildingUnit AS [BuildingUnit],
				palletLocation.[Location] AS PalletLocation,
				stockItems.StockItemCode, 
				stockItems.[Description],

			INTO

			/*Pallet Content*/
			INNER JOIN #tblPalletContent AS pc 
				ON pc.PalletFK = pallets.PalletPK

			/*special stock type*/
			LEFT OUTER JOIN appSpecialStockTypes AS sst 
				ON sst.SpecialStockTypePK = pc.SpecialStockTypeFK

			/*StockItems*/
			INNER JOIN #tblStockItems AS stockItems 
				ON stockItems.StockItemPK = pc.StockItemFK

			LEFT OUTER JOIN tblUnitTypes AS unitTypes 
				ON unitTypes.UnitTypePK = stockItems.UnitTypeFK

			LEFT OUTER JOIN tblBuildingUnits AS bus 
				ON bus.BuildingUnitPK = pallets.BuildingUnitFK

			LEFT OUTER JOIN tblBuildings AS buildings
				ON buildings.BuildingPK = bus.BuildingFK

			LEFT OUTER JOIN #tblPalletAudit AS palletAudit 
				ON palletAudit.PalletFK = pallets.PalletPK
 
			LEFT OUTER JOIN #viewPalletLocations AS palletLocation
				ON palletLocation.palletPK = pallets.palletPk
			INNER JOIN appPalletStatus AS pstatus 
				ON pstatus.PalletStatusPK = pallets.PalletStatusFK
			INNER JOIN #StockInDetails AS StockInDetails 
				ON StockInDetails.palletfk = pallets.palletpk
			LEFT JOIN #PendingContainerOuts AS PendingStockOuts 
				ON PendingStockOuts.palletfk = pallets.PalletPK
			WHERE 
				(',' + @var_divisionFKs +',' LIKE '%,' + CONVERT(VARCHAR, stockItems.DivisionFK) + ',%')
				AND
				(pc.StockItemFK = @var_stockItemFK OR @var_stockItemFK = -1)
				AND
				pc.Batch LIKE 
					CASE WHEN @var_batch = '' THEN
						pc.Batch
					WHEN @var_batchWildcard = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ THEN
						'%' + @var_batch + '%'
					ELSE 
						@var_batch
					END
				AND pallets.IsArchived = 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/
				AND pallets.PalletStatusFK <> 10
				AND (
						(@var_FilterBestBeforeDate <> '1900/01/01' AND pc.BestBefore < @var_FilterBestBeforeDate) 
						OR @var_FilterBestBeforeDate = '1900/01/01'
					)

			-- Only limit the dataset for Danone, and only when exporting to Excel.
			IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM tblCustomers WHERE CustomerPK = @customerFK AND CustomerName IS NOT NULL AND CustomerName LIKE '%danone%') AND @var_ExportingToExcel = 1
			BEGIN
				SELECT 
					[For Division], 
						[BuildingUnit],
					StockItemCode, 
					[Description], 
					Batch, 
			barcode,
					PalletStatus, 
					Actual,
					Available,
					OnOrder,
				
					PalletLocation,
				
					[DateReceived]
			
				FROM
					#results
				ORDER BY 
					[BuildingUnit],
					StockItemCode,
					CASE WHEN @var_orderByBatch = 1 THEN
						Batch
					END ASC,
					CASE WHEN @var_orderByBatch = 2 THEN
						Batch
					END DESC,
				 
					CASE WHEN @var_orderByDateReceived = 2 THEN
						[DateReceived]
						END ,
				 
					CASE WHEN @var_orderByBatch = -1 THEN
						Batch
					END ASC
			END
			ELSE
			BEGIN
				SELECT
					*
				FROM
					#results
				ORDER BY 
					[BuildingUnit],
					StockItemCode,
					CASE WHEN @var_orderByBatch = 1 THEN
						Batch
					END ASC,
					CASE WHEN @var_orderByBatch = 2 THEN
						Batch
					END DESC,
					CASE WHEN @var_orderByDateReceived = 1 THEN
						[DateReceived]
					END ASC,
					CASE WHEN @var_orderByDateReceived = 2 THEN
						[DateReceived]
						END DESC,
				 
					CASE WHEN @var_orderByBatch = -1 THEN
						Batch
					END ASC
			END

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end
						
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END


	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY
			

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start

		--	Declare @containerInFK int
		--	Set @containerInFK = (Select ContainerInFK 
		--							from tblStockIns where StockInPK = @stockInFK)

			Declare @worksOrderTypeFK int, @worksOrderOriginFK int, @FK int

			Select @worksOrderTypeFK = WorksOrderTypeFK, 
			@worksOrderOriginFK = WorksOrderOriginFK,
			@FK = FK 
			from tblWorksOrders 
			where WorksOrderPK = @var_worksOrderFK

			if(@worksOrderTypeFK = 3) /*Movement*/
			BEGIN
				Select  wos.WorksOrderPK, 'Movement' WorksOrderType, 
				woms.MovementDescription as [Description]
				from tblWorksOrders wos
				/*MOVEMENT*/
				inner join tblWorksOrderMovements woms on
				woms.WorksOrderFK = wos.WorksOrderPK
				Where wos.WorksOrderPK = @var_worksOrderFK
			END 
			ELSE if (@worksOrderTypeFK = 10)/*TopUp*/
			BEGIN
				/*TOPUP*/
				Declare @divisionTypeFK int

				Select @divisionTypeFK = DivisionTypeFK
				from tblPalletTopups fltps 
				inner join (
					Select PalletFK, StockItemFK
					From tblPalletContent
					Group By PalletFK, StockItemFK
				) pc on
				pc.PalletFK = fltps.TopupFromPalletFK
				inner join tblStockItems sis on
				sis.StockItemPK = pc.StockItemFK
				inner join tblDivisions divs on
				divs.DivisionPK = sis.DivisionFK
				where WorksOrderFK = @var_worksOrderFK

				Select * from (
				Select  wos.WorksOrderPK, 'Topup' WorksOrderType, 
				topups.TopupDescription as Description
				from tblWorksOrders wos		
				left outer join tblPalletTopups topups on
				topups.WorksOrderFK = wos.WorksOrderPK
				left outer join (
					Select PalletFK, sum(ActualUnits) Units
					from tblPalletContent pc
					Group By PalletFK
				)pc on
				pc.PalletFK = topups.TopupFromPalletFK
				Where wos.WorksOrderPK in (
					Select WorksOrderPK 
					from tblWorksOrders 
					where WorksOrderOriginFK = @worksOrderOriginFK
					AND FK = @FK
					AND WorksOrderTypeFK = 10 /*Topup*/
					AND WorksOrderStatusFK in (1,2) 
				)
		
				UNION

				Select wos.WorksOrderPK, wots.WorksOrderType,
				wops.WorkDescription as [Description]
				from tblWorksOrderPallets wops
				inner join tblWorksOrders wos on
				wos.WorksORderPK = wops.WorksOrderFK
				inner join appWorksOrderTypes wots on
				wots.WorksOrderTypePK = wos.WorksOrderTypeFK
				where wos.WorksOrderPK in (
					Select WorksOrderPK 
					from tblWorksOrders 
					where WorksOrderOriginFK = @worksOrderOriginFK
					AND FK = @FK
				)
				AND @divisionTypeFK = 2 /*only show for distribution*/

				UNION

				Select woms.WorksOrderFK, 'Movement' WorksOrderType,
				woms.MovementDescription as [Description]
				from tblWorksOrderMovements woms 
				where woms.WorksOrderFK in (
					Select WorksOrderPK 
					from tblWorksOrders 
					where WorksOrderOriginFK = @worksOrderOriginFK
					AND FK = @FK
				)
				AND @divisionTypeFK = 2 /*only show for distribution*/
				) subQ
				Order By 
					[Description] ASC
			END ELSE if (@worksOrderTypeFK = 1)/*SPLIT*/
			BEGIN
				Select  wos.WorksOrderPK, 'Split' WorksOrderType, 
				wopis.InstructionDescription as [Description]
				from tblWorksOrders wos
				inner join tblWorksOrderPallets wops on
				wops.WorksOrderFK = wos.WorksOrderPK
				inner join tblWorksOrderPalletInstructions wopis on
				wopis.WorksOrderPalletFK = wops.WorksOrderPalletPK
				Where wos.WorksOrderPK = @var_worksOrderFK
			END
			ELSE if (@worksOrderTypeFK = 5)/*relabel*/
			BEGIN
				Select wos.WorksOrderPK, 'Relabelling' WorksOrderType, 'Relabel pallet in ' + vpl.Location + ', Barcode:' + CASE WHEN p.customerbarcode = '' then p.barcode else p.customerbarcode end + CASE WHEN p.customerpalletnumber = '' THEN '' ELSE ', Pallet Number: ' + p.CustomerPalletNumber end +', Batch:' + pc.batch + ', Quantity:' + CONVERT(varchar(10), pc.units) as Description, vpl.Building as BuildingUnit, 
				sa.Description as Reason, @IsClientUser as IsClientUser,
				CreatorUser.Name [RequestedBy], CONVERT(VARCHAR(50), wos.inserteddate, 106) + ' ' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(5), wos.inserteddate, 108) CreatedDate,
				case when wos.worksorderstatusfk <> 1 then ManagedUser.Name else '' end [assignedBy], stat.worksorderstatus,
				case when wos.worksorderstatusfk <> 1 then coalesce(AssignedUser.Name, 'System') else '' end [AssignedTo],  			
				case when wops.worksorderstatusfk = 3 then 1 else 0 end as Completed,
				case when wos.worksorderstatusfk = 3 then CONVERT(VARCHAR(50), wos.updateddate, 106) + ' ' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(5), wos.updateddate, 108) else '' end as CompletedDate, wos.Comments, --wops.Notes,
				case when wos.worksorderoriginfk = 2 then co.goodsordernumber else '' end as GoodsOrderNumber, CreatorUser.userpk, Customer.CustomerName
				from tblWorksOrders wos
				inner join tblWorksOrderPallets wops on wops.WorksOrderFK = wos.WorksOrderPK
				INNER JOIN tblPallets p on wops.palletfk = p.palletpk
				INNER join ( 
					select palletfk, batch, sum(actualunits) Units
					from tblpalletcontent
					group by palletfk, batch
				) pc on pc.palletfk = p.palletpk
				inner join viewpalletLocations vpl on p.palletpk = vpl.palletpk
				left join viewUsers AssignedUser on wos.responsibleuserfk = AssignedUser.userpk
				inner join viewUsers CreatorUser on wos.insertedby = CreatorUser.userpk
				left join (
					select distinct C.CustomerName, UD.UserFK
					from tblCustomers C
					inner join tbldivisions D on c.customerpk = d.customerfk
					inner join tblUserDivisions UD on d.divisionPK = UD.DivisionFK 
				) Customer on Customer.UserFk = CreatorUser.userpk
				inner join viewUsers ManagedUser on wos.updatedby = ManagedUser.userpk
				inner join appWorksorderStatus stat on stat.worksorderstatuspk = wops.worksorderstatusfk
				inner join (
					select worksorderfk, palletfk,
						case when BestBeforeDateBefore <>  BestBeforeDateAfter then 
							'Best Before Date changed from ' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(50), BestBeforeDateBefore, 106)  
							+ ' to ' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(50), BestBeforeDateAfter, 106) END 
						as Description
					from tblstockadjustments
				) sa on sa.worksorderfk = @worksOrderFK and sa.palletfk = p.palletpk
				left join tblstockorders so on so.stockorderpk = wos.fk and wos.worksorderoriginfk = 2
				left join tblcontainerouts co on so.containeroutfk = co.containeroutpk and wos.worksorderoriginfk = 2
				where wos.worksorderpk = @worksOrderFK
			END
			ELSE if (@worksOrderTypeFK in (15,19,20,21,22))/*physical check*/
			BEGIN
				Select CustomerName, wos.WorksOrderPK, co.GoodsOrderNumber, vpl.Building as BuildingUnit, coalesce(lt.LocationType, 'Loading Bay') as [Location],
					CASE WHEN p.customerbarcode = '' then p.barcode else p.customerbarcode end as Barcode, p.customerpalletnumber, StockItemCode, pc.batch,	CONVERT(varchar(10), colpc.units) as Quantity, wops.WorkDescription as Instruction,
					CreatorUser.Name CreatedBy, 
					case when wops.responsibleuserfk <> -1 then WopAssignedUser.Name  else case when wos.worksorderstatusfk <> 1 then WoAssignedUser.Name else '' end end [AssignedTo], wos.Comments
				FROM tblworksorderpallets AS wops
				INNER JOIN tblWorksOrders AS wos ON WorksOrderFk = WorksOrderPK and worksordertypefk in (15,19,20,21,22) /*physical check*/ AND WorksOrderOriginFK = 2 /*stock order*/ AND WorksOrderPk = @var_worksOrderFK
				INNER JOIN tblStockOrders AS so ON wos.FK = so.StockOrderPK --and so.StockOrderPK = 74803
				INNER JOIN tblContainerOuts AS co ON so.containeroutfk = co.Containeroutpk
				INNER JOIN tblContainerOutLines AS col ON so.containeroutfk = col.Containeroutfk
				INNER JOIN tblcontaineroutlinepalletcontent AS colpc ON col.ContainerOutLinePK = colpc.ContainerOutLineFK
				INNER JOIN tblPallets p on colpc.palletfk = p.PalletPK and wops.palletfk = p.palletpk --AND (p.BuildingUnitFK = @var_BuildingUnitFK OR @var_BuildingUnitFK = -1)
				INNER join ( 
					select palletfk, batch, sum(actualunits) Units from tblpalletcontent group by palletfk, batch
				) pc on pc.palletfk = p.palletpk
				INNER JOIN viewpalletLocations vpl on p.palletpk = vpl.palletpk
				INNER JOIN viewUsers CreatorUser on wos.insertedby = CreatorUser.userpk
				left join viewUsers WoAssignedUser on wos.responsibleuserfk = WoAssignedUser.userpk
				left join viewUsers WopAssignedUser on wops.responsibleuserfk = WopAssignedUser.userpk
				OUTER APPLY (
					SELECT TOP 1 worksOrderPalletResultPK, worksorderpalletFK, palletaccepted, UpdatedDate
					FROM tblworksorderpalletresult
					WHERE worksorderpalletFK = wops.WorksOrderPalletPK
					ORDER BY worksOrderPalletResultPK DESC
				) AS wopR	
				INNER JOIN tblstockitems si on stockitemfk = stockitempk
				INNER JOIN tbldivisions d on divisionpk = si.divisionfk
				INNER JOIN tblcustomers c on d.customerfk = c.customerpk
				LEFT JOIN applocationtypes lt on locationtypepk = d.PhysicalCheckStagingAreaTypeFK			
			END

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end

			
			
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END
GO

-- =============================================        
-- Author:  <Author,,Name>        
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>        
-- Description: <Description,,>        
-- =============================================        
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spReportsWorksOrderMovement]        
(        
 @ContainerOutFK int,        
 @userFK int = -1,        
 @WorksOrderMovementFKs xml = NULL        
)        
AS        
BEGIN        
 /* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data; Ensure this proc has a low impact when executed */        
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED; SET DEADLOCK_PRIORITY LOW        
        
    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT        
 ,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;        
 SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();        
        
 -- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters        
 DECLARE @var_ContainerOutFK int, @var_userFK int, @var_WorksOrderMovementFKs xml        
        
 SET @var_ContainerOutFK = @ContainerOutFK; SET @var_userFK = @userFK; SET @var_WorksOrderMovementFKs = @WorksOrderMovementFKs        
        
 SET @ParameterDetails = '@ContainerOutFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_ContainerOutFK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@userFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_userFK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'')         
  + ',@WorksOrderMovementFKs = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_WorksOrderMovementFKs AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'')        
        
    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL         
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)        
        
    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)        
    --BEGIN        
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC         
        
  IF @ParentEventLogPK IS NULL SET @ParentEventLogPK = -1        
        
        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)        
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK        
        
        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()        
    --END        
        
 SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);        
 SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails        
 ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;        
 INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()        
        
 WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3        
 BEGIN         
  BEGIN TRY           
        
   -- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters        
          
   --get current user        
   Declare @myUser nvarchar(300)        
   Select @myUser = FirstName + ' ' + LastName         
   from tblUsers users         
   inner join tblPeople people on people.PersonPK = users.PersonFK        
   Where UserPK = @var_userFK         
              
   --get containerout        
   IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#tempContainerOut') IS NOT NULL        
    DROP TABLE #tempContainerOut        
   SELECT * INTO #tempContainerOut FROM tblContainerOuts WHERE ContainerOutPK = @var_ContainerOutFK        
              
   --get stock orders        
   IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#tempStockOrders') IS NOT NULL        
    DROP TABLE #tempStockOrders        
   SELECT * INTO #tempStockOrders FROM tblStockOrders WHERE ContainerOutFK = @var_ContainerOutFK        
        
   --get lines        
   IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#tempContainerOutLines') IS NOT NULL        
    DROP TABLE #tempContainerOutLines        
   SELECT * INTO #tempContainerOutLines FROM tblContainerOutLines WHERE ContainerOutFK = @var_ContainerOutFK        
           
   --get works orders        
   IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#tempWorksOrders') IS NOT NULL        
    DROP TABLE #tempWorksOrders        
   SELECT DISTINCT wo.*        
   INTO #tempWorksOrders        
   FROM #tempStockOrders so         
   inner join tblworksorders wo ON so.stockorderpk = wo.FK AND WorksORderOriginFK = 2 AND WorksOrderTypeFK = 3        
        
   --get any selected movement filters        
   IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#SelectedMovementPKs') IS NOT NULL        
    DROP TABLE #SelectedMovementPKs        
   select ParamValues.MovementPK.value('VALUE[1]','INT') as MovementPK        
   into #SelectedMovementPKs        
   from @var_WorksOrderMovementFKs.nodes('//FK') as ParamValues(MovementPK)        
        
   --get movements        
   IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#tempWorksOrderMovements') IS NOT NULL        
    DROP TABLE #tempWorksOrderMovements        
   SELECT woms.*        
   INTO #tempWorksOrderMovements        
   FROM #tempWorksOrders wo        
   INNER JOIN dbo.tblWorksOrderMovements woms ON woms.WorksOrderFK = wo.WorksOrderPK        
   WHERE woms.DestinationLocationTypeFK = 2/*loading bay*/        
   AND (@var_WorksOrderMovementFKs IS NULL         
    or woms.worksordermovementpk in (select distinct MovementPK from #SelectedMovementPKs))        
        
   --get customer info        
   IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#tempCustomer') IS NOT NULL        
    DROP TABLE #tempCustomer        
   SELECT TOP 1 cus.*, divisionName + ' - ' + divisionCode as DivisionName, AllowPalletGroupingOnStockOut         
   INTO #tempCustomer        
   FROM #tempContainerOutLines COL        
   inner join tbldivisions on divisionfk = divisionpk        
   inner join tblcustomers cus ON customerfk = customerpk        
        
   --get customer order ref        
   Declare @customerReference nvarchar(300) = ''        
   Declare @customerReferenceSQL nvarchar(MAX)        
   if(Exists(Select * from tblCustomerDocketIdentifications INNER JOIN #tempCustomer ON CustomerFK = customerpk where DocketTypeFK = 2/*Order*/))        
   BEGIN        
    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#tblCustomerReference') IS NOT NULL        
     DROP TABLE #tblCustomerReference        
        
    CREATE TABLE #tblCustomerReference (CustomerReference nvarchar(300))        
        
    Select @customerReferenceSQL = 'Insert into #tblCustomerReference Select ''' + cdis.Prefix + ' '' + ' + fields.FieldName + ' from #tempContainerOut '         
    FROM #tempCustomer cus        
    INNER JOIN tblCustomerDocketIdentifications cdis ON customerfk = customerpk AND DocketTypeFK = 2        
    inner join appFields fields ON fields.FieldPK = cdis.FieldFK        
        
    --PRINT @customerReferenceSQL        
    EXEC(@customerReferenceSQL)        
    Select @customerReference = (Select Top 1 CustomerReference from #tblCustomerReference)        
    --PRINT @customerReference        
   END         
        
   --get distinct content        
   IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#pc') IS NOT NULL        
    DROP TABLE #pc        
        
   SELECT DISTINCT pc.PalletFK, pc.StockItemFK, pc.Batch, pc.SupplierBatch        
   INTO #pc        
   FROM #tempWorksOrderMovements AS woms        
   INNER JOIN tblPalletContent AS pc ON woms.PalletFK = pc.PalletFK        
        
   --get any selected pallet filters        
   --IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#PalletPKs') IS NOT NULL        
   -- DROP TABLE #PalletPKs        
   --select ParamValues.PalletPK.value('VALUE[1]','INT') as PalletPK        
   --into #PalletPKs        
   --from @var_WorksOrderMovementFKs.nodes('//FK') as ParamValues(PalletPK)        
        
   --get comments from audit        
   DECLARE @Comments nvarchar(max)        
   Select @Comments = SUBSTRING(         
   (         
     SELECT ',' + Description AS 'data()'         
      FROM tblContainerOutAudit WHERE dbo.tblContainerOutAudit.IncludeInPickListPrintOut = 1 and dbo.tblContainerOutAudit.IsArchived=0  and containeroutfK = @var_ContainerOutFK FOR XML PATH('')         
   ), 2 , 9999)         
        
        
   IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#results') IS NOT NULL        
    DROP TABLE #results        
        
   Select         
    wos.WorksOrderPK,  Units,  woms.MovementDescription,  woms.EntirePallet,  sis.EachesTypeFK,        
    unitTypes.Abbreviation,  sis.UnitTypeFK,  sis.StockItemCode,
    case 
       when cust.CustomerPK = 609 then case 
       when sis.StockItemCodeAlias1 = '' then sis.Description 
       else sis.StockItemCodeAlias1 end else sis.Description 
       end AS StockDescription,        
    pc.Batch,  pc.SupplierBatch,  pals.CustomerBarcode,  pals.CustomerPalletNumber,  pals.Barcode,         
    cOuts.GoodsOrderNumber,  cOuts.CollectionDate,  cOuts.DeliveryDate,  trans.TransportCompany,        
    palLocations.[Row],  palLocations.ColumnNo,  palLocations.Baylevel,  pals.Bayposition,        
    cOuts.Address1,  cOuts.Address2,  cOuts.Address3,  cOuts.Address4,  cOuts.Address5,  cOuts.CountryFK, cOuts.CountyFK,  country.Country, county.County,        
    @Comments AS Comments,        
    (case when Docketlabel1 <> '' THEN Docketlabel1 + ': ' + DocketValue1 else ''end + ' ' +        
    case when Docketlabel2 <> '' THEN Docketlabel2 + ': ' + DocketValue2  else '' end + ' ' +        
    case when Docketlabel3 <> '' THEN Docketlabel3 + ': ' + DocketValue3 else '' end) AS customerReference,        
    buildings.BuildingName + ' - ' + bus.BuildingUnit as BuildingUnit, cust.CustomerName, cust.DivisionName,        
    case WHEN RespUser.userpk IS NULL THEN ' ' else people.FirstName + ' ' + people.LastName END AS ResponsibleUser,    
   AllowPalletGroupingOnStockOut, DistributionOrderFK ,
  palLocations.Location AS Source,
  palLocations.Location AS Destination,
 CASE
     WHEN EntirePallet = 1 THEN 'Pallets'
     WHEN EachesTypeFK > 0 THEN 'Eaches'
     ELSE 'Units'
 END AS MovementType,
 CASE
     WHEN EntirePallet = 1 THEN 'Pallets from ' + ISNULL(palLocations.Location, 'Unknown location')
     WHEN EachesTypeFK > 0 THEN CAST(COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY woms.PalletFK, sis.StockItemPK, pc.Batch) AS NVARCHAR(50)) + ' * ' + Description + ' from ' + ISNULL(palLocations.Location, 'Unknown location')
     ELSE CAST(woms.Units AS NVARCHAR(50)) + ' ' + ISNULL(unitTypes.Abbreviation, '') + ' from ' + ISNULL(palLocations.Location, 'Unknown location')
 END AS StockCheck
   Into #results         
   From #tempWorksOrders wos        
     left outer join appWorksOrderTypes AS wots on wots.WorksOrderTypePK = wos.WorksOrderTypeFK        
     left outer join #tempWorksOrderMovements AS woms on woms.WorksOrderFK = wos.WorksOrderPK        
     left outer join #pc AS pc on pc.PalletFK = woms.PalletFK         
     left outer join tblPallets AS pals on pals.PalletPK = pc.PalletFK        
     left outer join tblStockItems AS sis on sis.StockItemPK = pc.StockItemFK        
     left outer join tblEachesTypes AS eachesTypes on eachesTypes.EachestypePK = sis.EachesTypeFK        
     left outer join tblUnitTypes AS unitTypes on unitTypes.UnitTypePK = sis.UnitTypeFK        
     left outer join #tempStockOrders AS sos on sos.StockOrderPK = wos.FK        
     left outer join #tempContainerOut cOuts on cOuts.ContainerOutPK = sos.ContainerOutFK        
     left outer join tblTransportCompanies trans on trans.TransportCompanyPK = cOuts.TransportCompanyFK        
     left outer join viewPalletLocations AS palLocations  ON palLocations.palletPk = pals.palletpk        
     left join tblCountries AS country  on cOuts.countryfk = country.countrypk        
     left join tblCounties county  on cOuts.countyfk = county.countypk        
     left outer join tblBuildingUnits AS bus ON bus.BuildingUnitPK = sos.ResponsibleBuildingUnitFK        
     left OUTER join tblBuildings AS buildings ON buildings.BuildingPK = bus.BuildingFK        
     LEFT OUTER JOIN #tempCustomer cust ON 1=1        
     LEFT OUTER JOIN tblUsers RespUser ON RespUser.userpk = woms.ResponsibleUserFK        
     LEFT OUTER JOIN tblPeople people on people.PersonPK = RespUser.PersonFK        
    --Where wos.WorksOrderPK = @var_worksOrderFK        
    --Jamie: updated to work for all works orders on a pick, not just the 1st works order        
    Where         
     woms.isarchived = 0        
  --filter by selected movements only?        
     --and         
     --(        
     -- @var_WorksOrderMovementFKs is null         
     -- or woms.worksordermovementpk in (        
     --          select distinct PalletPK from #PalletPKs        
     --         )        
     --)        
        
   -- ---------------------------------------        
   -- Return the final results to the report        
   -- ---------------------------------------        
        
   DECLARE @numUsers int         
   SELECT @numUsers = count(DISTINCT ResponsibleUser) FROM #results        
        
           
   DECLARE @numBuildings int         
   SELECT @numBuildings = count(DISTINCT BuildingUnit) FROM #results        
        
   Select         
    WorksOrderPK,     
 case when DistributionOrderFK > 0 then BuildingUnit  
 else  
    BuildingUnit + ' (' + cast(DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY BuildingUnit) AS nvarchar(10)) + ' of ' + cast(@numBuildings AS nvarchar(10)) + ')' end as BuildingUnit,           
    CustomerName,        
    DivisionName,        
        
    count(*) * Units As [Total Units],        
        
    --substring (MovementDescription, charindex('FROM', MovementDescription) + 5, charindex('TO -', MovementDescription,         
    --charindex('FROM', MovementDescription)) - (charindex('FROM', MovementDescription) + 8)) as Source,        
        
    --case when EntirePallet = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ then substring(MovementDescription, charindex('Stock', MovementDescription),         
    --charindex('FROM', MovementDescription) - charindex('Stock', MovementDescription)) when EachesTypeFK > 0         
    --then cast(count(*) as nvarchar(50)) + ' * ' + substring(MovementDescription, charindex('Stock', MovementDescription),         
    --charindex('FROM', MovementDescription) - charindex('Stock', MovementDescription)) else cast(Units as nvarchar(50))         
    --+ ' ' + Abbreviation + ' from ' + substring(MovementDescription, charindex('Stock', MovementDescription),         
    --charindex('FROM', MovementDescription) - charindex('Stock', MovementDescription)) end as StockCheck,        
        
    --right(MovementDescription, len(MovementDescription) - charindex('TO', MovementDescription,         
    --charindex('FROM', MovementDescription)) - 4) as Destination,        
        
    
    --case when EntirePallet = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ then 'Pallets' when EachesTypeFK > 0 then 'Eaches'         
    --when UnitTypeFK > 0 then 'Units' end as MovementType,  
    Source,
    Max(StockCheck) as StockCheck,  
    MAX(MovementType) AS MovementType,        
    @myUser as [IssuedBy],        
    dbo.GetBSTDate() as [IssueTime],  --Pritesh      
    StockItemCode,        
    StockDescription,        
    Batch,SupplierBatch,        
        
    case when CustomerBarcode = '' then Barcode else CustomerBarcode end Barcode,        
    CustomerPalletNumber,        
        
    case when GoodsOrderNumber is null then '' else 'Stock Out no. ' + GoodsOrderNumber end as ID,        
        
    CollectionDate,        
    DeliveryDate,        
    TransportCompany,        
    case when @customerReference = '' then customerReference else @customerReference end as CustomerReference,            
    '' as AdditionalField,        
    [Row],         
    COlumnNo as UnitColumn,         
    Baylevel,         
    Bayposition,        
        
    Address1         
     + case when Address2 = '' then '' else ', ' + Address2 end        
     + case when Address3 = '' then '' else ', ' + Address3 end        
     + case when Address4 = '' then '' else ', ' + Address4 end        
     + case when Address5 = '' then '' else ', ' + Address5 end         
     + case when CountryFK < 0 then '' else ', ' + Country end         
     + case when CountyFK < 0 then '' else ', ' + County end           
    as DeliveryAddress,         
        
    Comments , case WHEN ResponsibleUser = '' THEN 'No User Assigned' ELSE ResponsibleUser END + ' (User ' + cast(DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ResponsibleUser desc) AS nvarchar(10)) + ' of ' + cast(@numUsers AS nvarchar(10)) + ')'  AS ResponsibleUser,     
  
   
    'WO-'+cast(WorksOrderPK AS nvarchar(10)) AS WOBarcode, AllowPalletGroupingOnStockOut      
   From         
    #results        
   Group By         
    EntirePallet, [row], ColumnNo, baylevel, bayposition, WorksOrderPK, MovementDescription,Source, Destination, EachesTypeFK,         
    /*EachesTypeSingular,*/ UnitTypeFK, Abbreviation, /*SourceLocationFK,*/ Units, StockItemCode, Batch, SupplierBatch, Barcode,         
    CustomerBarcode, CustomerPalletNumber, GoodsOrderNumber, CollectionDate, DeliveryDate,         
    TransportCompany, Address1, Address2, Address3, Address4, Address5, County, CountyFK,         
    CountryFK, Country, Comments,StockDescription,customerReference, CustomerName, DivisionName, BuildingUnit,ResponsibleUser, AllowPalletGroupingOnStockOut, 
    DistributionOrderFK  
   --Jamie: changedorder by pallet location        
   Order By BuildingUnit,         
    ResponsibleUser,        
    CustomerName,        
    DivisionName,        
    EntirePallet DESC,         
    [IssuedBy] ASC,         
    [row] ASC,         
    --[IssueTime],--pritesh      
    COlumnNo desc,         
    baylevel ASC,         
    bayposition desc,         
    StockItemCode ASC,         
    Batch ASC,        
    SupplierBatch ASC,         
    StockDescription ASC
   -- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end               
              
   BREAK        
  END TRY        
  BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */        
   DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;        
   SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;        
   SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;        
        
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY         
   BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;        
               
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;        
        
            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID        
                    
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;        
                    
   IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)        
   BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END        
   ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */        
  END CATCH        
  SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1        
 END        
END

 SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

  @var_weekNumber INT,     
  @var_year INT,  
 @var_scheduleDeliveryPK INT,       
 @var_newSlotFK INT,      
 @var_schedulePlaceholderFK INT,     
 @var_startTime TIME(0),                  
 @var_endTime TIME(0),            
 @var_scheduleActivityTypeFK INT,  
 @var_comment NVARCHAR(Max),    
 @var_userId INT           
        
 SET @var_buildingFK=@BuildingFK;    
 SET @var_weekNumber=@WeekNumber;      
 SET @var_year=@Year;    
 SET @var_scheduleDeliveryPK= @ScheduleDeliveryPK;            
 SET @var_newSlotFK=@NewSlotFK;      
 SET @var_schedulePlaceholderFK=@SchedulePlaceholderFK;     
  SET @var_startTime=CAST(@StartTime AS TIME(0));         
  SET @var_endTime=CAST(@EndTime AS TIME(0));    
   
 -- Calculate the duration between start and end time  
    DECLARE @var_duration TIME(0);   
    SET @var_duration = DATEADD(SECOND, DATEDIFF(SECOND, @StartTime, @EndTime), '00:00:00');    
            
 SET @var_scheduleActivityTypeFK=@ScheduleActivityTypeFK;  
 SET @var_comment= @Comment;  
 SET @var_userId= @UserId;         
         
          
 SET @ParameterDetails ='@BuildingFK = '+ ISNULL(CAST( @var_buildingFK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'')+  
 ',@WeekNumber = '+ ISNULL(CAST( @var_weekNumber AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'')+  
 ',@Year = '+ ISNULL(CAST( @var_year AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'')+  
 ',@ScheduleDeliveryPK = '+ ISNULL(CAST( @var_scheduleDeliveryPK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'')+

 ',@UserId = '+ ISNULL(CAST(  @var_userId AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'')

         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()          
    --END

 ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;

 WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3          
BEGIN          
  BEGIN TRY    
  Declare @var_updateDate datetime;    
  SET @var_updateDate=dbo.GetBSTDate();      
    
 -- Update delivery duration          
    UPDATE [dbo].[tblScheduleDeliveries]          
    SET StartTime = @var_startTime,          
        EndTime = @var_endTime,

        ScheduleSlotFK=@var_newSlotFK,
