        @BuildingFK = @var_buildingFK,  
        @UserId = @var_userId,  
        @CurrentDate = @var_updateDate,  
        @ScheduleWeekPK = @ScheduleWeekPK OUTPUT;       
  
   -- Final output
       DECLARE @UserType NVARCHAR(100)= dbo.fnGetUserType(@var_userId);     
       DECLARE @IsExternal BIT = CASE WHEN ISNULL(@UserType, '') = 'ExternalTransportUser' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END;
       IF(@IsExternal=1 ) 
       BEGIN       
           SELECT *
           FROM dbo.fnGetScheduleWeekForTransportUser
           (
               @var_buildingFK,
               @var_weekNumber,
               @var_year,
               @var_userId
           )
           ORDER BY ChannelName ASC, DayDate ASC;
       END
       ELSE
       BEGIN
           SELECT *
           FROM dbo.fnGetScheduleWeekForBuildingWithYearAndWeekNumber
           (
               @var_buildingFK,
               @var_weekNumber,
               @var_year,
               @var_userId
           )
           ORDER BY ChannelName ASC, DayDate ASC;
       END;  
                   
  
  BREAK          
  END TRY          
     
  BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */         
   DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;        
   SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;        
   SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;        
        
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY

   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;        
        
            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID        
                    
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;        
                    
   IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)        
   BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END

/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[spSaveEmployeeTMSDetailsRecords]    Script Date: 02/11/2026 17:47:27 ******/

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spSaveEmployeeTMSDetailsRecords]
(
	@employeeScannedPalletMovementDetailPK INT,
	@userFK INT,
	@undoChanges BIT = 0
)
AS
BEGIN		
	IF ISNULL(@employeeScannedPalletMovementDetailPK, -1) < 1 OR ISNULL(@userFK, -1) < 1 GOTO EXIT_PROC
	
	DECLARE 
		@varEmployeeScannedPalletMovementDetailPK int = @employeeScannedPalletMovementDetailPK, 
		@varUserFK INT = @userFK,
		@varTMSEmployeeClockCardDetailFK INT,
		@varRowCount INT, @varRowCount2 INT,
		@varUndoChanges BIT = ISNULL(@undoChanges, 0)
		
	SELECT DISTINCT 
		@varTMSEmployeeClockCardDetailFK = ttct.TMSEmployeeClockCardDetailFK
	FROM 
		dbo.tblTMSEmployeeClockedTimes ttct
	INNER JOIN dbo.tblEmployeeScannedPalletMovementDetails tespmd
		ON ttct.TMSEmployeeClockCardDetailFK = tespmd.TMSEmployeeClockCardDetailPK
	WHERE 
		tespmd.EmployeeScannedPalletMovementDetailPK = @varEmployeeScannedPalletMovementDetailPK

	IF ISNULL(@varTMSEmployeeClockCardDetailFK, -1) < 1 GOTO EXIT_PROC

	DECLARE @transaction NVARCHAR(32) = REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(CAST(@@SPID AS NVARCHAR(50)) + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(50), GETDATE(), 21), ' - ', ''), ' ', ''), ':', ''), '.', '');

	BEGIN TRY		
		BEGIN TRANSACTION @transaction

		IF @varUndoChanges = 0 -- Save changes on the tms details screen.
		BEGIN
			-- Confirm save of newly added records.
			UPDATE dbo.tblTMSEmployeeClockedTimes WITH (ROWLOCK)
			SET
				SavedByWMSUser = 1,
				UpdatedBy = @varUserFK,
				UpdatedDate = dbo.GetBSTDate()
			WHERE 
				TMSEmployeeClockCardDetailFK = @varTMSEmployeeClockCardDetailFK
				AND CreatedByFile = 0
				AND DeletedByWMSUser = 0

			SET @varRowCount = @@ROWCOUNT

			-- Delete records marked for deletion.
			DELETE FROM dbo.tblTMSEmployeeClockedTimes
			WHERE TMSEmployeeClockCardDetailFK = @varTMSEmployeeClockCardDetailFK
			AND CreatedByFile = 0
			AND DeletedByWMSUser = 1

			SET @varRowCount2 = @@ROWCOUNT
		END
		ELSE -- Undo changes on the tms details screen.
		BEGIN
			SET @varRowCount = 0
			SET @varRowCount2 = 0

			-- Reset records marked for deletion.
			UPDATE dbo.tblTMSEmployeeClockedTimes WITH (ROWLOCK)
			SET
				DeletedByWMSUser = 0
			WHERE 
				TMSEmployeeClockCardDetailFK = @varTMSEmployeeClockCardDetailFK
				AND CreatedByFile = 0
				AND DeletedByWMSUser = 1

			-- Delete newly added records.
			DELETE FROM dbo.tblTMSEmployeeClockedTimes
			WHERE TMSEmployeeClockCardDetailFK = @varTMSEmployeeClockCardDetailFK
			AND CreatedByFile = 0
			AND SavedByWMSUser = 0
		END

		COMMIT TRANSACTION @transaction

		IF @varRowCount > 0 OR @varRowCount2 > 0 -- Recreate the main records for the employee linked to @varEmployeeScannedPalletMovementDetailPK.		
			EXEC dbo.spLoadEmployeeScannedPalletMovementDetails @varEmployeeScannedPalletMovementDetailPK
	END TRY
	BEGIN CATCH
		DECLARE @ErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX) = ERROR_MESSAGE(), @ErrorSeverity INT = ERROR_SEVERITY(), @ErrorState INT = ERROR_STATE()

		BEGIN TRY
			ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @transaction
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /*Ignore and continue*/ END CATCH

		RAISERROR (@ErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState)
	END CATCH

EXIT_PROC:

END
GO

-- =============================================  
-- Author:  <Archana Singh>  
-- Create date: <08/09/2025>  
-- Description: <Description,,>  
-- =============================================  
  
  
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spSaveInvoiceEmailSubject]  
    @InvoicePK INT,  
    @CustomEmailSubject NVARCHAR(255)  
AS  
BEGIN      
  /* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */  
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED  
  
    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,  
 @DeadlockErrorRetries INT, @PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT,  
 @startRecord INT = 1,@totalRecords INT, @endRecord INT, @NoResultsFound INT  
  
 SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();  
  
  
 -- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters  
 DECLARE @var_InvoicePK int,  
 @var_CustomEmailSubject NVARCHAR(255);  
 SET @var_InvoicePK = @InvoicePK;  
 SET @var_CustomEmailSubject=@CustomEmailSubject;  
   
 SET @ParameterDetails = '@InvoicePK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_InvoicePK AS NVARCHAR(20)),'')+  
  ',@CustomEmailSubject = ' + ISNULL(@var_CustomEmailSubject,'');  
   
 IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL   
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)  
  
    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)  
    --BEGIN   
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC   
  
        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)  
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK  
  
        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()  
    --END  
  
 SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);  
 SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails  
 ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;  
 INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()  
  
 WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3  
 BEGIN   
  BEGIN TRY  
  
    UPDATE tblInvoices  
    SET CustomEmailSubject = @var_CustomEmailSubject  
    WHERE InvoicePK = @var_InvoicePK  
 BREAK  
  END TRY  
  BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */  
   DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;  
   SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;  
   SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;  
  
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY   
   BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;  
         
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;  
  
            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID  
              
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;  
              
   IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)  
   BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END  
   ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */  
  END CATCH  
  SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1  
 END  
END  
GO

-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Archana Singh>
-- Create date: <19/06/2025>

-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spSchedulerActivities] 
(
	@BuildingFK INT,
	@CurrentDateStr NVARCHAR (20),
	@CurrentTimeStr NVARCHAR (20)
	)
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,
	@DeadlockErrorRetries INT, @PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT,
	@startRecord INT = 1,@totalRecords INT, @endRecord INT, @NoResultsFound INT

	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();


	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	DECLARE @var_BuildingFK int
	DECLARE @var_CurrentDateStr NVARCHAR (20)
	DECLARE @var_CurrentTimeStr NVARCHAR (20)


	SET @var_BuildingFK = ISNULL(@BuildingFK,-1)
	SET @var_CurrentDateStr = ISNULL(@CurrentDateStr,'')
	SET @var_CurrentTimeStr = ISNULL(@CurrentTimeStr,'')
	
	SET @ParameterDetails = '@BuildingFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_BuildingFK AS NVARCHAR(20)),'')
		+ ',@CurrentDateStr = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_CurrentDateStr AS NVARCHAR(20)),'')
		+ ',@CurrentTimeStr = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_CurrentTimeStr AS NVARCHAR(20)),'')

	IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    --BEGIN 
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END

	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY
						
select sa.ScheduleActivityTypeFK, sa.InsertedDate, sd.DayDate, sdel.ScheduleDeliveryPK, sdel.StartTime, sdel.EndTime,
case when sdel.ContainerInFK > 0 then 'Inbound' when sdel.ContainerOutFK > 0 then 'Outbound' else NULL end as DeliveryType,
        case when sdel.ContainerInFK > 0 then ci.GoodsInNumber else co.GoodsOrderNumber end as DocketNumber
        from tblScheduleActivities sa
        inner join tblScheduleDeliveries sdel on sa.ScheduleDeliveryFK = sdel.ScheduleDeliveryPK
        inner join tblScheduleSlots ss on sdel.ScheduleSlotFK = ss.ScheduleSlotPK
        inner join tblscheduleDays sd on ss.ScheduleDayFK = sd.ScheduleDayPK
        left join tblContainerIns ci on sdel.ContainerInFK = ci.ContainerInPK
        left join tblContainerOuts co on sdel.ContainerOutFk = co.ContainerOutPK
        where buildingfk = @var_BuildingFK
        and (sd.DayDate > CAST(@var_currentDateStr as date) or (sd.DayDate = CAST(@var_currentDateStr as date) and sdel.EndTime >= @var_currentTimeStr))
        and sa.IsArchived = 0
        union
        select sa.ScheduleActivityTypeFK, sa.InsertedDate, sd.DayDate, sdel.ScheduleDeliveryPK, sdel.StartTime, sdel.EndTime,
        case when sdel.ContainerInFK > 0 then 'Inbound' when sdel.ContainerOutFK > 0 then 'Outbound' else NULL end as DeliveryType,
        case when sdel.ContainerInFK > 0 then ci.GoodsInNumber else co.GoodsOrderNumber end as DocketNumber
        from tblScheduleActivities sa
        inner join tblScheduleDeliveries sdel on sa.ScheduleDeliveryFK = sdel.ScheduleDeliveryPK
        inner join tblSchedulePlaceholders sph on sdel.ScheduleSlotFK = sph.SchedulePlaceholderPK
        inner join tblscheduleDays sd on sph.ScheduleDayFK = sd.ScheduleDayPK
        left join tblContainerIns ci on sdel.ContainerInFK = ci.ContainerInPK
        left join tblContainerOuts co on sdel.ContainerOutFk = co.ContainerOutPK
        where buildingfk = @var_BuildingFK
        and (sd.DayDate > CAST(@var_currentDateStr as date) or (sd.DayDate = CAST(@var_currentDateStr as date) and sdel.EndTime >= @var_currentTimeStr))
        and sa.IsArchived = 0
        order by sa.InsertedDate asc;
						
	BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END
GO

-- spSchedulerData 1
-- =============================================  
-- Author:  <Archana Singh>  
-- Create date: <13/12/2023>  
-- Description: <Description,,>  
-- =============================================  
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spSchedulerData]   
(  
 @ScheduleWeekFK INT   
 )  
AS  
BEGIN  
 /* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */  
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED  
  
    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,  
 @DeadlockErrorRetries INT, @PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT,  
 @startRecord INT = 1,@totalRecords INT, @endRecord INT, @NoResultsFound INT  
  
 SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();  
  
  
 -- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters  
 DECLARE @var_ScheduleWeekFK int  
  
 SET @var_ScheduleWeekFK = ISNULL(@ScheduleWeekFK,-1)  
  
   
 SET @ParameterDetails = '@ScheduleWeekFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@ScheduleWeekFK AS NVARCHAR(20)),'')  
  
 IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL   
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)  
  
    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)  
    --BEGIN   
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC   
  
        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)  
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK  
  
        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()  
    --END  
  
 SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);  
 SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails  
 ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;  
 INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()  
  
 WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3  
 BEGIN   
  BEGIN TRY  
       SELECT   
         sw.ScheduleWeekPK,  sw.[Name][ScheduleName],  
         sc.ScheduleChannelPK, sc.[Name][ChannelName], sc.ColorCode, sc.FreeMode,    
         sd.ScheduleDayPK, sd.[DayDate],sd.DayNumber, sd.StartTime[DayStart], sd.EndTime[DayEnd],    
         ss.ScheduleSlotPK, -1 SchedulePlaceholderPK, ss.StartTime[SlotStart], ss.EndTime[SlotEnd], ''[PlaceholderTitle], '' PlaceholderColorCode,    
         sdel.ScheduleDeliveryPK, sdel.Description[DeliveryDescription], sdel.StartTime[DeliveryStartTime], sdel.EndTime[DeliveryEndTime], sdel.ActualDuration[DeliveryDuration],    
  case when sdel.ContainerInFK > 0 then 'Inbound' when sdel.ContainerOutFK > 0 then 'Outbound' else NULL end as DeliveryType,    
  case when sdel.ContainerInFK > 0 then sdel.ContainerInFK when sdel.ContainerOutFK > 0 then sdel.ContainerOutFK else -1 end as DeliveryContainerFK,    
  case when sdel.ContainerInFK > 0 then ci.GoodsInNumber else co.GoodsOrderNumber end as DocketNumber,            
  case when sdel.ContainerInFK > 0 then InboundSup.Supplier else '' end as DocketSupplier,     
  case when sdel.ContainerInFK > 0 then d.DivisionCode else d2.DivisionCode end as DocketDivision,     
  case when sdel.ContainerInFK > 0 then Inboundlb.LoadingBay else Outboundlb.LoadingBay end as LoadingBay,     
  case when sdel.ContainerInFK > 0 then cast(ci.datein as Date) else cast(co.CollectionDate as Date) end as DocketDate,    
  -- missing fields for container outs: DivisionCode, LoadingBay, CustomerRef    
  case when sdel.ContainerInFK > 0 then case when cdis.CustomerDocketIdentificationPK is not null then     
  case cdis.FieldFK       
      when 1 then ci.Free1      
      when 2 then ci.Free2      
      when 3 then ci.Free3      
      when 4 then ci.Free4      
      when 5 then ci.Free5      
      ELSE ' ' end      
     + ' '  + case  cdis.Field2FK       
      when 1 then ci.Free1      
      when 2 then ci.Free2      
      when 3 then ci.Free3      
      when 4 then ci.Free4      
      when 5 then ci.Free5      
      else ' ' end      
     + ' '  + case  cdis.Field3FK       
      when 1 then ci.Free1      
      when 2 then ci.Free2      
      when 3 then ci.Free3      
      when 4 then ci.Free4      
      when 5 then ci.Free5      
      else  ' ' end     
   else ' ' end     
      + ' '  +    
      CASE WHEN  ci.ExternalReference <> '' THEN ci.ExternalReference ELSE ' ' end     
  else    
      case when cdis2.CustomerDocketIdentificationPK is null then     
   case when co.Docketlabel1 <> '' THEN     
    co.Docketlabel1 + ': ' + co.DocketValue1 else '' end + ' ' +    
   case when co.Docketlabel2 <> '''' THEN     
    co.Docketlabel2 + ': ' + co.DocketValue2 else '' end + ' ' +    
   case when co.Docketlabel3 <> '' THEN     
    co.Docketlabel3 + ': ' + co.DocketValue3 else '' end + ''     
   else    
   case cdis2.FieldFK when 40 then    
     cdis2.Prefix + ' ' + co.DocketValue1    
   when 41 then    
     cdis2.Prefix + ' ' + co.DocketValue2    
   when 42 then    
     cdis2.Prefix + ' ' + co.DocketValue3    
   end    
   + ' ' +    
   case cdis2.Field2FK when 40 then    
     cdis2.Prefix2 + ' ' + co.DocketValue1    
   when 41 then    
     cdis2.Prefix2 + ' ' + co.DocketValue2    
   when 42 then    
     cdis2.Prefix2 + ' ' + co.DocketValue3    
   else ''    
   end    
  End    
  end as CustomerRef,    
   sdel.IsArchived[DeliveryIsArchived]    
            
  FROM [dbo].[tblBuildings] b     
  LEFT JOIN [dbo].[tblScheduleWeeks] sw ON b.BuildingPK = sw.BuildingFK 
  LEFT JOIN [dbo].[tblScheduleChannels] sc ON sc.ScheduleWeekFK = sw.ScheduleWeekPK   
  LEFT JOIN [dbo].[tblScheduleDays] sd ON sd.ScheduleChannelFK = sc.ScheduleChannelPK  
  LEFT JOIN [dbo].[tblScheduleSlots] ss ON ss.ScheduleDayFK = sd.ScheduleDayPK  
  LEFT JOIN tblScheduleDeliveries sdel ON sdel.ScheduleSlotFK = ss.ScheduleSlotPK    
    
  LEFT JOIN tblContainerIns ci ON sdel.ContainerInFK = ci.ContainerInPK      
  LEFT JOIN tblstockins si ON ci.ContainerInPK = si.ContainerInFK    
  LEFT JOIN tbldivisions d ON si.DivisionFK = d.DivisionPK    
  LEFT JOIN tblSuppliers InboundSup ON ci.SupplierFK = InboundSup.SupplierPK    
  LEFT JOIN tblloadingbays Inboundlb ON ci.LoadingBayFK = Inboundlb.LoadingBayPK    
  LEFT OUTER JOIN tblCustomerDocketIdentifications cdis ON cdis.CustomerFK = d.CustomerFK AND cdis.DocketTypeFK = 1    
    
  LEFT JOIN tblContainerOuts co ON sdel.ContainerOutFk = co.ContainerOutPK    
  -- missing fields for container outs: DivisionCode, LoadingBay, CustomerRef    
  LEFT JOIN tblContainerOutLines col ON col.ContainerOutFK = co.ContainerOutPK    
  LEFT JOIN tblDivisions d2 ON d2.DivisionPK = col.DivisionFK    
  LEFT JOIN tblStockOrders so ON co.ContainerOutPK = so.ContainerOutFK    
  LEFT JOIN tblloadingbays Outboundlb ON so.PickupLoadingBayFK = Outboundlb.LoadingBayPK    
  LEFT OUTER JOIN tblCustomerDocketIdentifications cdis2 ON cdis2.CustomerFK = d2.CustomerFK AND cdis2.DocketTypeFK = 2    
  WHERE sw.ScheduleWeekPK = @var_ScheduleWeekFK  
  AND (sw.IsArchived = 0 OR sw.IsArchived is null) AND (sc.IsArchived = 0 OR sc.IsArchived is null)   
  AND (sd.IsArchived = 0 OR sd.IsArchived is null) AND (ss.IsArchived = 0 OR ss.IsArchived is null)  
  
  UNION   
      
        SELECT sw.ScheduleWeekPK, sw.[Name][ScheduleName],
        sc.ScheduleChannelPK, sc.[Name][ChannelName], sc.ColorCode, sc.FreeMode,    
        sd.ScheduleDayPK, sd.[DayDate],sd.DayNumber, sd.StartTime[DayStart], sd.EndTime[DayEnd],   
        -1 ScheduleSlotPK, sph.SchedulePlaceholderPK, sph.StartTime[SlotStart], sph.EndTime[SlotEnd],    
        case when sph.Title = '' then    
        case when sph.customerfk > 0 then c.CustomerName else s.Supplier end else sph.Title end as PlaceholderTitle, sph.ColorCode as PlaceholderColorCode,    
        sdel.ScheduleDeliveryPK, sdel.Description[DeliveryDescription], sdel.StartTime[DeliveryStartTime], sdel.EndTime[DeliveryEndTime], sdel.ActualDuration[DeliveryDuration],    
        case when sdel.ContainerInFK > 0 then 'Inbound' when sdel.ContainerOutFK > 0 then 'Outbound' else NULL end as DeliveryType,    
        case when sdel.ContainerInFK > 0 then sdel.ContainerInFK when sdel.ContainerOutFK > 0 then sdel.ContainerOutFK else -1 end as DeliveryContainerFK,    
        case when sdel.ContainerInFK > 0 then ci.GoodsInNumber else co.GoodsOrderNumber end as DocketNumber,    
  case when sdel.ContainerInFK > 0 then InboundSup.Supplier else '' end as DocketSupplier,     
  case when sdel.ContainerInFK > 0 then d.DivisionCode else d2.DivisionCode end as DocketDivision,     
  case when sdel.ContainerInFK > 0 then Inboundlb.LoadingBay else Outboundlb.LoadingBay end as LoadingBay,     
  case when sdel.ContainerInFK > 0 then cast(ci.datein as Date) else cast(co.CollectionDate as Date) end as DocketDate,    
  case when sdel.ContainerInFK > 0 then case when cdis.CustomerDocketIdentificationPK is not null then     
   case cdis.FieldFK       
      when 1 then ci.Free1      
      when 2 then ci.Free2      
      when 3 then ci.Free3      
      when 4 then ci.Free4      
      when 5 then ci.Free5      
      ELSE ' ' end      
     + ' '  + case  cdis.Field2FK       
      when 1 then ci.Free1      
      when 2 then ci.Free2      
      when 3 then ci.Free3      
      when 4 then ci.Free4      
      when 5 then ci.Free5      
      else ' ' end      
     + ' '  + case  cdis.Field3FK       
      when 1 then ci.Free1      
      when 2 then ci.Free2      
      when 3 then ci.Free3      
      when 4 then ci.Free4      
      when 5 then ci.Free5      
      else  ' ' end     
   else ' ' end     
      + ' '  +    
      CASE WHEN  ci.ExternalReference <> '' THEN ci.ExternalReference ELSE ' ' end     
  else    
      case when cdis2.CustomerDocketIdentificationPK is null then     
   case when co.Docketlabel1 <> '' THEN     
    co.Docketlabel1 + ': ' + co.DocketValue1 else '' end + ' ' +    
   case when co.Docketlabel2 <> '''' THEN     
    co.Docketlabel2 + ': ' + co.DocketValue2 else '' end + ' ' +    
   case when co.Docketlabel3 <> '' THEN     
    co.Docketlabel3 + ': ' + co.DocketValue3 else '' end + ''     
   else    
   case cdis2.FieldFK when 40 then    
     cdis2.Prefix + ' ' + co.DocketValue1    
   when 41 then    
     cdis2.Prefix + ' ' + co.DocketValue2    
   when 42 then    
     cdis2.Prefix + ' ' + co.DocketValue3    
   end    
   + ' ' +    
   case cdis2.Field2FK when 40 then    
     cdis2.Prefix2 + ' ' + co.DocketValue1    
   when 41 then    
     cdis2.Prefix2 + ' ' + co.DocketValue2    
   when 42 then    
     cdis2.Prefix2 + ' ' + co.DocketValue3    
   else ''    
   end    
  End    
  end as CustomerRef,    
   sdel.IsArchived[DeliveryIsArchived]    
    
  FROM [dbo].[tblBuildings] b 
  LEFT JOIN [dbo].[tblScheduleWeeks] sw ON b.BuildingPK = sw.BuildingFK 
  LEFT JOIN [dbo].[tblScheduleChannels] sc ON sc.ScheduleWeekFK = sw.ScheduleWeekPK   
  LEFT JOIN [dbo].[tblScheduleDays] sd ON sd.ScheduleChannelFK = sc.ScheduleChannelPK    
  LEFT JOIN tblSchedulePlaceholders sph on sph.ScheduleDayFK = sd.ScheduleDayPK   
  LEFT JOIN [dbo].[tblScheduleSlots] ss ON ss.ScheduleDayFK = sd.ScheduleDayPK  
  LEFT JOIN tblScheduleDeliveries sdel ON sdel.ScheduleSlotFK = ss.ScheduleSlotPK    
  LEFT JOIN tblcustomers c on sph.CustomerFK = c.CustomerPK    
  LEFT JOIN tblSuppliers s on sph.SupplierFK = s.SupplierPK               
  LEFT JOIN tblContainerIns ci on sdel.ContainerInFK = ci.ContainerInPK      
  LEFT JOIN tblstockins si on ci.ContainerInPK = si.ContainerInFK    
  LEFT JOIN tbldivisions d on si.DivisionFK = d.DivisionPK    
  LEFT JOIN tblSuppliers InboundSup on ci.SupplierFK = InboundSup.SupplierPK    
  LEFT JOIN tblloadingbays Inboundlb on ci.LoadingBayFK = Inboundlb.LoadingBayPK    
  left outer join tblCustomerDocketIdentifications as cdis on cdis.CustomerFK = d.CustomerFK AND cdis.DocketTypeFK = 1    
    
  LEFT JOIN tblContainerOuts co ON sdel.ContainerOutFk = co.ContainerOutPK    
  -- missing fields for container outs: DivisionCode, LoadingBay, CustomerRef    
  LEFT JOIN tblContainerOutLines col ON col.ContainerOutFK = co.ContainerOutPK    
  LEFT JOIN tblDivisions d2 ON d2.DivisionPK = col.DivisionFK    
  LEFT JOIN tblStockOrders so ON co.ContainerOutPK = so.ContainerOutFK    
  LEFT JOIN tblloadingbays Outboundlb ON so.PickupLoadingBayFK = Outboundlb.LoadingBayPK    
  LEFT OUTER JOIN tblCustomerDocketIdentifications as cdis2 ON cdis2.CustomerFK = d2.CustomerFK AND cdis2.DocketTypeFK = 2    
  WHERE sw.ScheduleWeekPK = @var_ScheduleWeekFK AND (sc.IsArchived = 0 or sc.IsArchived is null) AND (sd.IsArchived = 0 or sd.IsArchived is null) AND (sph.IsArchived = 0 or sph.IsArchived is null)    
  ORDER BY ScheduleWeekPK, ScheduleDayPK, ScheduleChannelPK, ScheduleSlotPK, SchedulePlaceholderPK, ScheduleDeliveryPK    
    
   BREAK  
  END TRY  
  BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */  
   DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;  
   SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;  
   SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;  
  
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY   
   BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;  
         
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;  
  
            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID  
              
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;  
              
   IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)  
   BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END  
   ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */  
  END CATCH  
  SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1  
 END  
END  
GO

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spScrapLocationsSave]
(
	@locationTypeFK int,
	@buildingUnitRowFK int,
	@FKs nvarchar(MAX)
)
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT
 ,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;
	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	DECLARE @var_locationTypeFK int, @var_buildingUnitRowFK int, @var_FKs nvarchar(MAX)

	SET @var_locationTypeFK = @locationTypeFK; SET @var_buildingUnitRowFK = @buildingUnitRowFK; SET @var_FKs = @FKs

	SET @ParameterDetails = '@locationTypeFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_locationTypeFK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@buildingUnitRowFK = ' 
		+ ISNULL(CAST(@var_buildingUnitRowFK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@FKs = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_FKs AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'')

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    --BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

		SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END


	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY
			IF XACT_STATE() = 0 AND @@TRANCOUNT < 1 BEGIN TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start

			Declare @buildingUnitFK int

			IF(@var_locationTypeFK = 1) 
			BEGIN
				Delete busls
				from tblScrapLocations busls
				Where busls.BuildingUnitRowFK = @var_buildingUnitRowFK 
		
				Set @buildingUnitFK = (Select BuildingUnitFK from tblBuildingUnitRows where BuildingUnitRowPK = @var_buildingUnitRowFK)

				insert into tblScrapLocations 
				--values 
				Select 1/*location type- racking*/, @var_buildingUnitRowFK, buBays.BuildingUnitBayPK, 
				0/*cast(0 as bit)*/, 1, dbo.GetBSTDate(), 1, dbo.GetBSTDate()
				from tblBuildingUnitBays buBays
				Where CHARINDEX( ',' + cast(BuildingUnitBayPK as nvarchar(100)) + ',', ',' + @var_FKs + ',' ) > 0
			END 
			--ELSE IF (@var_locationTypeFK = 8/*floor location*/) 
			--BEGIN
			--	print 'todo'
			--END
	
			Select 0

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end

			BEGIN TRY IF XACT_STATE() = 1 AND @@TRANCOUNT = 1 AND @OpeningTranCount < 1 COMMIT TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH
			
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END

-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spSearchAllTables]
(
    @SearchStr nvarchar(100)
)
AS
BEGIN

	-- Copyright ؠ2002 Narayana Vyas Kondreddi. All rights reserved.
	-- Purpose: To search all columns of all tables for a given search string
	-- Written by: Narayana Vyas Kondreddi
	-- Site: http://vyaskn.tripod.com
	-- Tested on: SQL Server 7.0 and SQL Server 2000
	-- Date modified: 28th July 2002 22:50 GMT

	IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#Results') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #Results

	CREATE TABLE #Results(ColumnName nvarchar(370), ColumnValue nvarchar(3630))

	SET NOCOUNT ON

	DECLARE @TableName nvarchar(256), @ColumnName nvarchar(128), @SearchStr2 nvarchar(110)
	SET  @TableName = ''
	SET @SearchStr2 = QUOTENAME('%' + @SearchStr + '%','''')

	WHILE @TableName IS NOT NULL
	BEGIN
		SET @ColumnName = ''
		SET @TableName = 
		(
			SELECT MIN(QUOTENAME(TABLE_SCHEMA) + '.' + QUOTENAME(TABLE_NAME))
			FROM    INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES
			WHERE       TABLE_TYPE = 'BASE TABLE'
				AND QUOTENAME(TABLE_SCHEMA) + '.' + QUOTENAME(TABLE_NAME) > @TableName
				AND OBJECTPROPERTY(
						OBJECT_ID(
							QUOTENAME(TABLE_SCHEMA) + '.' + QUOTENAME(TABLE_NAME)
							 ), 'IsMSShipped'
							   ) = 0
		)

		WHILE (@TableName IS NOT NULL) AND (@ColumnName IS NOT NULL)
		BEGIN
			SET @ColumnName =
			(
				SELECT MIN(QUOTENAME(COLUMN_NAME))
				FROM    INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS
				WHERE       TABLE_SCHEMA    = PARSENAME(@TableName, 2)
					AND TABLE_NAME  = PARSENAME(@TableName, 1)
					AND DATA_TYPE IN ('char', 'varchar', 'nchar', 'nvarchar')
					AND QUOTENAME(COLUMN_NAME) > @ColumnName
			)

			IF @ColumnName IS NOT NULL
			BEGIN
				INSERT INTO #Results
				EXEC
				(
					'SELECT ''' + @TableName + '.' + @ColumnName + ''', LEFT(' + @ColumnName + ', 3630) 
					FROM ' + @TableName + ' WHERE ' + @ColumnName + ' LIKE ' + @SearchStr2
				)
			END
		END 
	END

	SELECT ColumnName, ColumnValue FROM #Results
END
GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[spSearchStringInTable]    Script Date: 02/11/2026 17:47:27 ******/

SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
  
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spSearchStringInTable]
(@SearchString NVARCHAR(MAX),
 @Table_Schema sysname = 'dbo',
 @Table_Name sysname)
 AS
 BEGIN
DECLARE @Columns NVARCHAR(MAX), @Cols NVARCHAR(MAX), @PkColumn NVARCHAR(MAX)
  
-- Get all character columns
SET @Columns = STUFF((SELECT ', ' + QUOTENAME(Column_Name)
 FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS
 WHERE DATA_TYPE IN ('text','ntext','varchar','nvarchar','char','nchar')
 AND TABLE_NAME = @Table_Name AND TABLE_SCHEMA = @Table_Schema
 ORDER BY COLUMN_NAME
 FOR XML PATH('')),1,2,'');
  
IF @Columns IS NULL -- no character columns
   RETURN -1;
  
-- Get columns for select statement - we need to convert all columns to nvarchar(max)
SET @Cols = STUFF((SELECT ', CAST(' + QUOTENAME(Column_Name) + ' AS nvarchar(max)) COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT AS ' + QUOTENAME(Column_Name)
 FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS
 WHERE DATA_TYPE IN ('text','ntext','varchar','nvarchar','char','nchar')
 AND TABLE_NAME = @Table_Name AND TABLE_SCHEMA = @Table_Schema
 ORDER BY COLUMN_NAME
 FOR XML PATH('')),1,2,'');
   
 SET @PkColumn = STUFF((SELECT N' + ''|'' + ' + ' CAST(' + QUOTENAME(CU.COLUMN_NAME) + ' AS nvarchar(max)) COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT '
  
FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLE_CONSTRAINTS AS TC
INNER JOIN
INFORMATION_SCHEMA.KEY_COLUMN_USAGE AS CU
ON TC.CONSTRAINT_TYPE = 'PRIMARY KEY' AND
TC.CONSTRAINT_NAME = CU.CONSTRAINT_NAME
  
 WHERE TC.TABLE_SCHEMA = @Table_Schema AND TC.TABLE_NAME = @Table_Name
 ORDER BY CU.ORDINAL_POSITION
 FOR XML PATH('')),1,9,'');
  
 IF @PkColumn IS NULL
    SELECT @PkColumn = 'CAST(NULL AS nvarchar(max))';
      
 -- set select statement using dynamic UNPIVOT
 DECLARE @SQL NVARCHAR(MAX)
 SET @SQL = 'SELECT *, ' + QUOTENAME(@Table_Schema,'''') + ' AS [Table Schema], ' + QUOTENAME(@Table_Name,'''') + ' AS [Table Name]' +
  ' FROM
  (SELECT '+ @PkColumn + ' AS [PK Column], ' + @Cols + ' FROM ' + QUOTENAME(@Table_Schema) + '.' + QUOTENAME(@Table_Name) +  ' ) src UNPIVOT ([Column Value] for [Column Name] IN (' + @Columns + ')) unpvt
 WHERE [Column Value] LIKE ''%'' + @SearchString + ''%'''
   
 --print @SQL
  
EXECUTE sp_ExecuteSQL @SQL, N'@SearchString nvarchar(max)', @SearchString;
END
GO

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spSelectedGroupStockInGetBatch]                        
(                        
--declare                        
      @StockInGroupFK int                        
     
)                         
AS                        
BEGIN                        
 /* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */                        
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED                        
                        
    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,                        
 @DeadlockErrorRetries INT, @PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT,                        
 @startRecord INT = 1,@totalRecords INT, @endRecord INT, @NoResultsFound INT                        
                        
 SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();                        
                        
 -- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters                        
 DECLARE @var_ContainerinFK int                    
                        
 SET @var_ContainerinFK = (@StockInGroupFK)                        
                   
                        
 SET @ParameterDetails = '@ContainerinFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_ContainerinFK AS NVARCHAR(20)),'')     
     
 IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL                         
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)                        
                        
    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)                        
    --BEGIN                         
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC                         
                        
        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)                        
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK                        
                        
        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()                        
    --END                        
                        
 SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);                        
 SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails                        
 ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;                        
 INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()                        
                        
 WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3                        
 BEGIN                         
  BEGIN TRY                        
                    
   -- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start                        
                          
                        
   drop table if exists #tmpgroupbatches    
   select distinct                   
   case when sils.stockinlinepk is null then                        
   STUFF((SELECT distinct ',' +  cih.Batch  from tblcontainerinheaders cih where cih.Batch !='' and cih.ContainerInFK = si.ContainerInFK FOR XML PATH(''), TYPE).value('.', 'NVARCHAR(MAX)')  ,1,1,'') --'HeaderbatchList',                       
   else        
   
   STUFF((SELECT distinct ',' +  sils.batch  from tblstockinlines sils where sils.batch !='' and si.StockInPK = sils.StockInFK FOR XML PATH(''), TYPE).value('.', 'NVARCHAR(MAX)') ,1,1,'') --'LinesBatchList'                  
   end as [Batches] ,  
     
    case when sils.stockinlinepk is null then                        
   STUFF((SELECT distinct ',' +  s.stockitemcode  from tblcontainerinheaders cih inner join tblstockitems s on cih.stockitemfk = s.stockitempk where cih.ContainerInFK = si.ContainerInFK FOR XML PATH(''), TYPE).value('.', 'NVARCHAR(MAX)')  ,1,1,'')        
      
   else                      
   STUFF((SELECT distinct ',' +  si.StockItemCode  from tblstockitems si where si.Stockitempk=sils.StockItemfK FOR XML PATH(''), TYPE).value('.', 'NVARCHAR(MAX)')  ,1,1,'')                  
   end as [Stock Code]       
      into #tmpgroupbatches    
    
   --into #tmpstockinBatch                   
   FROM tblstockins si                   
   left join tblstockinlines sils on si.StockInPK = sils.StockInFK
   inner join tblContainerIns cin on si.ContainerInFK=cin.ContainerInPK
   where cin.StockInGroupFK = (@StockInGroupFK)     
       
    declare @batches nvarchar(max)  
 declare @stockcodes nvarchar(max)  
   select @batches = coalesce(@batches + ', ', '') + isnull([Batches], 'N/A'),  
   @stockcodes= coalesce(@stockcodes + ', ', '') + isnull([Stock Code], 'N/A')  
   from #tmpgroupbatches    
   select @batches as Batches    
      ,@stockcodes as StockCodes                     
   -- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end                           
                              
   BREAK                        
  END TRY                        
  BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */                        
   DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;                        
   SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;                        
   SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;                        
                        
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY                         
   BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;                        
                               
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;                        
                        
            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID                        
                  
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;                        
                                    
   IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)                        
   BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END                        
   ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */                        
  END CATCH                        
  SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1                        
 END                        
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spSetDownAreaMovePreference]
(
	@direction int, --1=UP, 2=DOWND
	@loadingBaySetDownAreaPK int
)
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT
 ,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;
	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	DECLARE @var_direction int, @var_loadingBaySetDownAreaPK int

	SET @var_direction = @direction; SET @var_loadingBaySetDownAreaPK = @loadingBaySetDownAreaPK

	SET @ParameterDetails = '@direction = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_direction AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@loadingBaySetDownAreaPK = ' 
		+ ISNULL(CAST(@var_loadingBaySetDownAreaPK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'')

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    --BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

		SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END


	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY
			IF XACT_STATE() = 0 AND @@TRANCOUNT < 1 BEGIN TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start

			Declare @currentPreference int
			Declare @newPreference int
			Declare @otherLoadingBaySetDownAreaPK int
			Declare @loadingBayFK int
			Select @currentPreference=Preference, @loadingBayFK=LoadingBayFK From tblLoadingBaySetDownAreas Where LoadingBaySetDownAreaPK = @var_loadingBaySetDownAreaPK


			if @var_direction = 1 --UP
			BEGIN
				if exists(Select Top 1 * from tblLoadingBaySetDownAreas where LoadingBayFK = @loadingBayFK AND Preference < @currentPreference order by Preference desc)
				BEGIN
					Select Top 1 @newPreference=Preference, @otherLoadingBaySetDownAreaPK=LoadingBaySetDownAreaPK from tblLoadingBaySetDownAreas where LoadingBayFK = @loadingBayFK 
					AND Preference < @currentPreference order by Preference desc 
					update tblLoadingBaySetDownAreas WITH (ROWLOCK) Set Preference = @currentPreference where LoadingBaySetDownAreaPK = @otherLoadingBaySetDownAreaPK
					update tblLoadingBaySetDownAreas WITH (ROWLOCK) Set Preference = @newPreference where LoadingBaySetDownAreaPK = @var_loadingBaySetDownAreaPK
				END
			END
			ELSE if @var_direction=2
			BEGIN
				if exists(Select Top 1 * from tblLoadingBaySetDownAreas where LoadingBayFK = @loadingBayFK AND Preference > @currentPreference order by Preference asc)
				BEGIN
					Select Top 1 @newPreference=Preference, @otherLoadingBaySetDownAreaPK=LoadingBaySetDownAreaPK from tblLoadingBaySetDownAreas where LoadingBayFK = @loadingBayFK 
					AND Preference > @currentPreference order by Preference asc 
					update tblLoadingBaySetDownAreas WITH (ROWLOCK) Set Preference = @currentPreference where LoadingBaySetDownAreaPK = @otherLoadingBaySetDownAreaPK
					update tblLoadingBaySetDownAreas WITH (ROWLOCK) Set Preference = @newPreference where LoadingBaySetDownAreaPK = @var_loadingBaySetDownAreaPK
				END
			END
	
			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end

			BEGIN TRY IF XACT_STATE() = 1 AND @@TRANCOUNT = 1 AND @OpeningTranCount < 1 COMMIT TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH
			
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END
GO

-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Jamie>
-- Create date: <20/02/2016>
-- Description:	<get all stock in rules, for stock item / division / customer, or specific to supplier>
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spStockAdjustmentFields]
	@ReceiverFK int,
	@ReceiverTypeFK int,
	@StockAdjustmentFieldType int = -1
AS
BEGIN	
	SET NOCOUNT ON;

	/******** GET CUSTOMER / DIVISION / STOCK ITEM ********/
	declare @CustomerFK int
	declare @DivisionFK int
	declare @stockItemFK int

	if(@ReceiverTypeFK = 3)--STOCK ITEM
	BEGIN
		print 'for stock item'
		set @stockItemFK = @ReceiverFK
		set @DivisionFK = (select divisionfk from tblstockitems where stockitempk = @ReceiverFK)
		set @CustomerFK = (select customerfk from tbldivisions where divisionPk = @DivisionFK)
	END
	ELSE if(@ReceiverTypeFK = 2)--DIVISION
	BEGIN
		print 'for division'
		set @stockItemFK = -1
		set @DivisionFK = @ReceiverFK
		set @CustomerFK = (select customerfk from tbldivisions where divisionPk = @DivisionFK)
	END
	ELSE if(@ReceiverTypeFK = 1)--CUSTOMER
	BEGIN
		print 'for customer'
		set @stockItemFK = -1
		set @DivisionFK = -1
		set @CustomerFK = @ReceiverFK
	END

	IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#AdjustmentFields') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #AdjustmentFields

	/******** DECLARE TEMP TABLE ************/
	CREATE TABLE #AdjustmentFields
	(
		StockAdjustmentFieldPK int,
		StockAdjustmentFieldTypeFK int,
		RequiresPalletRelabelling bit,
		InvoiceCustomerForRelabelling bit,
		ObjectTable nvarchar(500),
		PrimaryKeyField nvarchar(500),
		FieldName nvarchar(100),
		FieldValueTypeFK int
	)

	--stock item fields takes highest priority
	if(@stockItemFK > 0)
	BEGIN
		print 'getting stock item fields'
		insert into #AdjustmentFields
		select saf.StockAdjustmentFieldPK, saf.StockAdjustmentFieldTypeFK, saf.RequiresPalletRelabelling, saf.InvoiceCustomerForRelabelling,
		af.ObjectTable, af.PrimaryKeyField, af.FieldName, af.FieldValueTypeFK
		from tblStockAdjustmentFields saf
		inner join appStockAdjustmentFieldTypes saft on saf.StockAdjustmentFieldTypeFK = saft.StockAdjustmentFieldTypePK
		inner join appfields af on saft.AppFieldFK = af.FieldPK
		where saf.ReceiverTypeFK = 3 and saf.ReceiverFK = @StockItemFK and saf.Enabled = cast(1 as bit)
		and ((@StockAdjustmentFieldType > 0 and saf.StockAdjustmentFieldTypeFK = @StockAdjustmentFieldType) or @StockAdjustmentFieldType = @StockAdjustmentFieldType)
	END

	--division fields next, excluding fields found for stock item
	if(@DivisionFK > 0)
	BEGIN
		print 'getting division fields'
		insert into #AdjustmentFields
		select saf.StockAdjustmentFieldPK, saf.StockAdjustmentFieldTypeFK, saf.RequiresPalletRelabelling, saf.InvoiceCustomerForRelabelling,
		af.ObjectTable, af.PrimaryKeyField, af.FieldName, af.FieldValueTypeFK
		from tblStockAdjustmentFields saf
		inner join appStockAdjustmentFieldTypes saft on saf.StockAdjustmentFieldTypeFK = saft.StockAdjustmentFieldTypePK
		inner join appfields af on saft.AppFieldFK = af.FieldPK
		LEFT JOIN #AdjustmentFields selectedFields on selectedFields.StockAdjustmentFieldTypeFK = saf.StockAdjustmentFieldTypeFK
	WHERE selectedFields.StockAdjustmentFieldPK IS NULL 
		and saf.ReceiverTypeFK = 2 and saf.ReceiverFK = @DivisionFK and saf.Enabled = cast(1 as bit)
		and ((@StockAdjustmentFieldType > 0 and saf.StockAdjustmentFieldTypeFK = @StockAdjustmentFieldType) or @StockAdjustmentFieldType = @StockAdjustmentFieldType)
	END

	
	--customer fields last, excluding fields found for division or stock item
	if(@CustomerFK > 0)
	BEGIN
		print 'getting customer fields'
		insert into #AdjustmentFields
		select saf.StockAdjustmentFieldPK, saf.StockAdjustmentFieldTypeFK, saf.RequiresPalletRelabelling, saf.InvoiceCustomerForRelabelling,
		af.ObjectTable, af.PrimaryKeyField, af.FieldName, af.FieldValueTypeFK
		from tblStockAdjustmentFields saf
		inner join appStockAdjustmentFieldTypes saft on saf.StockAdjustmentFieldTypeFK = saft.StockAdjustmentFieldTypePK
		inner join appfields af on saft.AppFieldFK = af.FieldPK
		LEFT JOIN #AdjustmentFields selectedFields on selectedFields.StockAdjustmentFieldTypeFK = saf.StockAdjustmentFieldTypeFK
	WHERE selectedFields.StockAdjustmentFieldPK IS NULL 
		and saf.ReceiverTypeFK = 1 and saf.ReceiverFK = @CustomerFK and saf.Enabled = cast(1 as bit)
		and ((@StockAdjustmentFieldType > 0 and saf.StockAdjustmentFieldTypeFK = @StockAdjustmentFieldType) or @StockAdjustmentFieldType = @StockAdjustmentFieldType)
	END

	--return all selected fields
	select * from #AdjustmentFields
END
GO

	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);

	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY
			

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start

			Declare @palletStatusFK int

			Select Top 1 @palletStatusFK = PalletStatusFK
			FROM(
			Select Top 1 1 as OrderFlag, StatusFK as PalletStatusFK from tblStockItemBatchStatus
			Where StockItemFK = @var_stockItemFK AND Batch = @var_batch
			UNION ALL
			Select  2 as OrderFlag, FoundPalletDefaultStatusFK as PalletStatusFK from tblDivisions Where DivisionPK = @var_divisionFK
			)subQ
			Order By OrderFlag ASC 

			Select @palletStatusFK

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end

			
			
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;

			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END

		+ ISNULL(CAST(@var_stockInLineFK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@containerOutLineFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_containerOutLineFK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'')

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --BEGIN

		SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END


	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY
			IF XACT_STATE() = 0 AND @@TRANCOUNT < 1 BEGIN TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start

			Declare @worksOrderPK int
	

			insert into dbo.tblWorksOrders
				values(3/*Complete*/, -1 /*ResponsibleUser*/, 11/*WorksOrderOrigin - Discrepency*/,
				@var_stockDiscrepencyFK/*FK - StockInLineDiscrepency*/, 11/*WorksOrderTypeFK - PalletStatusChange*/,
				-1/*WorksOrderRuleTypeFK*/, -1 /*WorksOrderRuleTypeFK*/, 
				0/*cast(0 as bit)*//*IntegrationStage1Flag*/, ('01/01/1900') /*IntegrationStage1FlagDate*/,
				0/*cast(0 as bit)*//*IntegrationStage2Flag*/, ('01/01/1900') /*IntegrationStage2FlagDate*/,
				0/*cast(0 as bit)*//*IntegrationStage3Flag*/, ('01/01/1900') /*IntegrationStage3FlagDate*/,
				0/*cast(0 as bit)*//*IntegrationStage4Flag*/, ('01/01/1900') /*IntegrationStage4FlagDate*/,

				0/*cast(0 as bit)*//*IntegrationStage10Flag*/, ('01/01/1900') /*IntegrationStage10FlagDate*/,
				''/*Free1*/,''/*Free2*/,''/*Free3*/,''/*Free4*/,''/*Free5*/,'WorksOrderFor the Status Change brought about by a discrepency'/*Comments*/,
				0/*cast(0 as bit)*/, 0, dbo.GetBSTDate(), 0, dbo.GetBSTDate(),-1
		
				)

			Set @worksOrderPK = (select SCOPE_IDENTITY())

			if(@var_stockInLineFK = -1 AND @var_containerOutLineFK = -1) 
			BEGIN
				Select @var_stockInLineFK = StockInLineFK, @var_containerOutLineFK = ContainerOutLineFK

			END

			if(@var_stockInLineFK <> -1) 
			BEGIN
				insert into dbo.tblPalletStatusChanges 
				Select PalletFK, '', 0, '', @worksOrderPK /*WorksOrderFK*/, 1/*Was Available*/, 7 /*On Hold*/,
				3/*Integration*/, 0, -1,'Missing pallet has caused this pallet to be temporarily blocked',
				0/*cast(0 as bit)*/, 0, dbo.GetBSTDate(), 0, dbo.GetBSTDate() 
				from dbo.tblStockInLinePallets silps
					Where StockInLineFK = @var_stockInLineFK

				--Set Pallet to On Hold/Blocked
				update dbo.tblPallets WITH (ROWLOCK)
				set PalletStatusFK = 7/*On Hold*/
				Where PalletPK in (
					Select PalletFK from dbo.tblStockInLinePallets silps
					Where StockInLineFK = @var_stockInLineFK)
			END 
			ELSE if(@var_containerOutLineFK <> -1) 
			BEGIN
				insert into dbo.tblPalletStatusChanges 
				Select PalletFK, '', 0, '', @worksOrderPK /*WorksOrderFK*/, 1/*Was Available*/, 7 /*On Hold*/,
				3/*Integration*/, 0, -1,'Missing pallet has caused this pallet to be temporarily blocked',

				from dbo.tblContainerOutLinePalletContent
					Where ContainerOutLineFK = @var_containerOutLineFK		

				--Set Pallet to On Hold/Blocked
				update dbo.tblPallets WITH (ROWLOCK)
				set PalletStatusFK = 7/*On Hold*/
				Where PalletPK in (
					Select PalletFK from dbo.tblContainerOutLinePalletContent
					Where ContainerOutLineFK = @var_containerOutLineFK)
			END

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end

			BEGIN TRY IF XACT_STATE() = 1 AND @@TRANCOUNT = 1 AND @OpeningTranCount < 1 COMMIT TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH
			
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spStockDiscrepencyCreateWorksOrder]
(
	@stockDiscrepencyFK int,
	@stockInLineFK int = -1
)
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT
 ,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;
	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	DECLARE @var_stockDiscrepencyFK int, @var_stockInLineFK int
	SET @var_stockDiscrepencyFK = @stockDiscrepencyFK; SET @var_stockInLineFK = @stockInLineFK
	SET @ParameterDetails = '@stockDiscrepencyFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_stockDiscrepencyFK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@stockInLineFK = ' 
		+ ISNULL(CAST(@var_stockInLineFK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'')

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    --BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

		SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END


	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY
			IF XACT_STATE() = 0 AND @@TRANCOUNT < 1 BEGIN TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start

			Declare @worksOrderPK int
	

			insert into tblWorksOrders
				values(3/*Complete*/, -1 /*ResponsibleUser*/, 11/*WorksOrderOrigin - Discrepency*/,
				@var_stockDiscrepencyFK/*FK - StockInLineDiscrepency*/, 12/*WorksOrderTypeFK - Discrepency*/,
				-1/*WorksOrderRuleTypeFK*/, -1 /*WorksOrderRuleTypeFK*/, 
				0/*cast(0 as bit)*//*IntegrationStage1Flag*/, ('01/01/1900') /*IntegrationStage1FlagDate*/,
				0/*cast(0 as bit)*//*IntegrationStage2Flag*/, ('01/01/1900') /*IntegrationStage2FlagDate*/,
				0/*cast(0 as bit)*//*IntegrationStage3Flag*/, ('01/01/1900') /*IntegrationStage3FlagDate*/,
				0/*cast(0 as bit)*//*IntegrationStage4Flag*/, ('01/01/1900') /*IntegrationStage4FlagDate*/,
				0/*cast(0 as bit)*//*IntegrationStage5Flag*/, ('01/01/1900') /*IntegrationStage5FlagDate*/,
				0/*cast(0 as bit)*//*IntegrationStage6Flag*/, ('01/01/1900') /*IntegrationStage6FlagDate*/,
				0/*cast(0 as bit)*//*IntegrationStage7Flag*/, ('01/01/1900') /*IntegrationStage7FlagDate*/,
				0/*cast(0 as bit)*//*IntegrationStage8Flag*/, ('01/01/1900') /*IntegrationStage8FlagDate*/,
				0/*cast(0 as bit)*//*IntegrationStage9Flag*/, ('01/01/1900') /*IntegrationStage9FlagDate*/,
				0/*cast(0 as bit)*//*IntegrationStage10Flag*/, ('01/01/1900') /*IntegrationStage10FlagDate*/,
				''/*Free1*/,''/*Free2*/,''/*Free3*/,''/*Free4*/,''/*Free5*/,'WorksOrderFor a discrepency'/*Comments*/,
				0/*cast(0 as bit)*/, 0, dbo.GetBSTDate(), 0, dbo.GetBSTDate(), -1
		
				)

			Set @worksOrderPK = (select SCOPE_IDENTITY())

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end

			BEGIN TRY IF XACT_STATE() = 1 AND @@TRANCOUNT = 1 AND @OpeningTranCount < 1 COMMIT TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH
			
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END
