-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spStockInCheckAndSetStatus]
(
	@stockInPK int,
	@completeRegardless int = 0
)
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT
	,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;
	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	DECLARE @var_stockInPK int, @var_completeRegardless int
	SET @var_stockInPK = @stockInPK; SET @var_completeRegardless = @completeRegardless
	SET @ParameterDetails = '@stockInPK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_stockInPK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@completeRegardless = ' 
		+ ISNULL(CAST(@var_completeRegardless AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'')

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    --BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

		SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END

	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY			

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start

			IF((Select StockInStatusFK from tblStockIns where StockInPK = @var_stockInPK) = 1 /*On Route*/) return

			IF((EXISTS(
				SELECT PalletPK
				FROM tblPallets tPal
				INNER JOIN tblStockInLinePallets silps ON tpal.PalletPK = silps.PalletFK
				inner JOIN tblStockInLines sils ON sils.StockInLinePK = silps.StockInLineFK
				WHERE sils.StockInFK = @var_stockInPK
				AND LocationTypeFK NOT IN ( 1, 6) /*Racking or Sample Location*/
				AND tPal.IsArchived = 0
				)
				/* Pallet has not been sent out */
				AND @var_completeRegardless = 0
			)
			OR /*If we are completing regardless (which doesnt really make sense any more but anyway) and there are no pallets 'OnRouteContainerIn' then we can complete*/
			(EXISTS(
				SELECT PalletPK
				FROM tblPallets tPal
				INNER JOIN tblStockInLinePallets silps ON tpal.PalletPK = silps.PalletFK
				inner JOIN tblStockInLines sils ON sils.StockInLinePK = silps.StockInLineFK
				WHERE sils.StockInFK = @var_stockInPK
				AND LocationTypeFK = 4/*OnRoute*/
				AND tPal.IsArchived = 0
				)
				AND @var_completeRegardless = 1
			)) 
			BEGIN
				-- Run the spStockLevelsSync stored procedure if it is not already executing.
				--EXEC spStockLevelsSyncTrigger

				SELECT cast(0 as bit) as Complete 
			END 
			ELSE  
			BEGIN
				Declare @containerInPK int
				Select @containerInPK = ContainerInFK from tblStockIns Where StockInPK = @var_stockInPK

				--This section below updates the stock in to complete when all the pallets are put away
				--This will be done in another part of the system, in the event that there are extra pallets on the 
				IF (EXISTS (select StockInPK from tblStockIns WHERE stockInPK = @var_stockInPK and StockInStatusFK not in (3,4)))
				BEGIN
					IF XACT_STATE() = 0 AND @@TRANCOUNT < 1 BEGIN TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName

					UPDATE tblStockIns WITH (ROWLOCK) set StockInStatusFK = 3 where StockInPK = @var_stockInPK
					-- Check if the Container has any all its stock in complete and if so complete it
					IF(NOT Exists(Select sins.StockInPK from tblStockIns sins Where ContainerInFK = @containerInPK AND sins.StockInStatusFK in (1,2)/*Complete OR Cancelled*/) )
					BEGIN
						UPDATE tblContainerIns WITH (ROWLOCK)
						Set StockInStatusFK = 3 /*Complete*/
						Where ContainerInPK = @containerInPK
					END

					BEGIN TRY IF XACT_STATE() = 1 AND @@TRANCOUNT = 1 AND @OpeningTranCount < 1 COMMIT TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH
				END

				-- Run the spStockLevelsSync stored procedure if it is not already executing.
				EXEC spStockLevelsSyncTrigger

				SELECT cast(1 as bit) as Complete		
			END
			
			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end
			
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END
GO

-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spStockInCheckForDuplicateBarcodes]
(	
	@stockInFK int
)	
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT
 ,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;
	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	DECLARE @stockInFK2 int

	SET @stockInFK2 = @stockInFK

	SET @ParameterDetails = '@stockInFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@stockInFK2 AS NVARCHAR(20)),'')

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    --BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

		SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END


	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY
			

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start

			--get all pallets on stock in

			Drop table if exists #tmpstockinpallets

			select distinct p.palletpk, p.barcode, p.customerbarcode into #tmpstockinpallets
			from tblpallets p
			inner join tblstockinlinepallets silp on p.PalletPK = silp.palletfk
			inner join tblstockinlines sil on sil.StockInLinePK = silp.stockinlinefk
			where sil.StockInFK = @stockInFK2

			--select * from #tmpstockinpallets order by Barcode


			--check all barcodes on the stock in are unique

			declare @StockInPalletsOK bit
			declare @STACheck bit

			If(exists(select palletpk from #tmpstockinpallets where customerbarcode <> ''))
			begin--check customer barcodes
				   SELECT @STACheck = 0, @StockInPalletsOK =( CASE WHEN count(distinct customerbarcode)= count(customerbarcode) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
				   FROM #tmpstockinpallets
			end
			else
			begin--check sta barcodes
				   SELECT @STACheck = 1, @StockInPalletsOK =( CASE WHEN count(distinct barcode)= count(barcode)THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
				   FROM #tmpstockinpallets
			end 

			--select @StockInPalletsOK as PalletsOK, @STACheck as STACheck 

			--check all barcodes on the stock in are not already in stock

			if(@StockInPalletsOK = 0)
			begin--something wrong - get out
				   Select @StockInPalletsOK as Result, 'Barcodes on stock in must be unique' as ErrorMessage
			end
			else
			begin
				declare	@nopalletsonthisstockin int
				declare @nopalletsmatchingbarcodes int
				select @nopalletsonthisstockin = count(PalletPK) from #tmpstockinpallets
				   --check customer barcodes or sta barcodes
				   if(@STACheck = 0)
				   begin
						 select @nopalletsmatchingbarcodes = count(p.palletpk)
						 from tblpallets p
						 inner join #tmpstockinpallets sp on p.CustomerBarcode = sp.CustomerBarcode
						 where PalletStatusFK <> 10 and IsArchived = 0
				   end
				   else
				   begin
						 select @nopalletsmatchingbarcodes = count(p.palletpk)
						 from tblpallets p
						 inner join #tmpstockinpallets sp on p.Barcode = sp.Barcode
						 where PalletStatusFK <> 10 and IsArchived = 0
				   end

				   if(@nopalletsmatchingbarcodes > 0)
				   begin
					Select 0 as Result, 'Pallets with same barcodes already in stock' as ErrorMessage
				   end
				   else
				   begin
					Select 1 as Result, 'No duplicate barcodes' as ErrorMessage
				   end
			end

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end

			
			
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END
GO

-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spStockInCreateHandlingInCharges] 
(
	@stockInPK int
)
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT
 ,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;
	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	DECLARE @var_stockInPK int
	SET @var_stockInPK = @stockInPK
	SET @ParameterDetails = '@stockInPK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_stockInPK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'')

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    --BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

		SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END


	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY			

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start

			DECLARE ChargesCursor CURSOR FOR 
			SELECT sils.StockInLinePK, sils.IsMixedPallet, sils.StockItemFK, isnull(charges.ChargePK, -1), stockItems.HandlingInCharge, 
			stockItems.HandlingInEachesTypeFK, stockItems.HandlingInUnitTypeFK, 
			stockItems.HandlingInEachesNumber, stockItems.HandlingInUnitsNumber,
			stockItems.HandlingInChargeResultingPallets,
			sum(PalletCount.Pallets) Pallets, sum(sils.Pallets * Eaches) Eaches, stockItems.EachesTypeFK, eachesTypes.EachesType, sum(sils.Pallets * Units) Units, 
			stockItems.UnitTypeFK, unitTypes.Abbreviation		
			FROM tblStockInLines sils 
			inner join 
			(Select count(*)  Pallets, StockInLineFK
			from tblStockInLinePallets silps
			Group By StockInLineFK) palletCount
			on
			palletCount.StockInLineFK = sils.StockInLinePK

			inner join tblStockItems stockItems on
			stockItems.StockItemPK = sils.StockItemFK

			left outer join tblCharges charges
			on
			charges.StockInFK = sils.StockInFK
			AND
			charges.StockItemFK = sils.StockItemFK

			left outer join tblEachesTypes eachesTypes on
			eachesTypes.EachesTypePK = stockItems.EachesTypeFK

			left outer join tblUnitTypes unitTypes on
			unitTypes.UnitTypePK = stockItems.UnitTypeFK

			Where sils.StockInFK = @var_stockInPK
			Group by sils.StockInLinePK, sils.IsMixedPallet, sils.StockItemFK, charges.ChargePK, stockItems.HandlingInCharge, 
			stockItems.EachesTypeFK, stockItems.UnitTypeFK,
			stockItems.HandlingInEachesTypeFK, stockItems.HandlingInUnitTypeFK, 
			stockItems.HandlingInEachesNumber, stockItems.HandlingInUnitsNumber,
			stockItems.HandlingInChargeResultingPallets,
			stockItems.EachesTypeFK, stockItems.UnitTypeFK, eachesTypes.EachesType, unitTypes.Abbreviation

			order by sils.StockInLinePK

			Declare @stockInLinePK int, @isMixedPallet bit, @stockItemFK int, @chargePK int, @handlingInCharge decimal(18,3), @handlingInEachesTypeFK int, @handlingInUnitTypeFK int, 
			@handlingInEachesNumber decimal(18,3), @handlingInUnitsNumber decimal(18,3), @handlingInChargeResultingPallets bit,
			@pallets decimal(18,3), @eaches decimal(18,3), @units decimal(18,3), @eachesTypeFK int, @unitTypeFK int, @eachesType nvarchar(200), @unitType nvarchar(200)

			Declare @lastPalletWasMixed bit
			Set @lastPalletWasMixed = 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/

			OPEN ChargesCursor

			FETCH NEXT FROM ChargesCursor INTO 
			@stockInLinePK, @isMixedPallet, @stockItemFK, @chargePK, @handlingInCharge , @handlingInEachesTypeFK , @handlingInUnitTypeFK , 
			@handlingInEachesNumber , @handlingInUnitsNumber , @handlingInChargeResultingPallets ,
			@pallets , @eaches , @eachesTypeFK , @eachesType, @units,  @unitTypeFK, @unitType 

			WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
			BEGIN
				Print 'Started Loop'
				Print @chargePK
				if @chargePK = -1 --If there is no charge
				BEGIN
					if @handlingInChargeResultingPallets = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/
					BEGIN --Check for complete works orders
						Print 'Check 1'
						if not exists(Select * from tblWorksOrders wos
							inner join tblWorksOrderPallets wops
							on
							wops.WorksOrderFK = wos.WorksOrderPK
							inner join tblPallets pallets
							on
							pallets.PalletPK = wops.PalletFK
							Where WorksOrderOriginFK = 1/*StockIn*/
							AND FK = @var_stockInPK
							--tblPallets no longer has the stockItemFK so removed this line for now as I dont think we need it
							--AND pallets.StockItemFK = @stockItemFK
							AND	wos.WorksOrderStatusFK < 3 
							)
						BEGIN --No open works orders so go ahead and make the charges
							Print 'Check 2'
							--Check if this is a mixed pallet, if fi we dont want to charge 2 or more PALLET handling in charges, we only charge for eaches/units charges in this case 
							if(@isMixedPallet = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ AND @lastPalletWasMixed = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ AND @handlingInEachesTypeFK = -1 AND @handlingInUnitTypeFK = -1)
							BEGIN
								Print 'Do nothing, we have a mixed pallet that has already had a pallet charge, and this stock does not charge by eaches/units'
							END
							ELSE
							BEGIN
								Exec spChargesCreateHandlingCharge @var_stockInPK, -1, @stockItemFK, @handlingInCharge, @handlingInEachesTypeFK , 
								@handlingInUnitTypeFK , @handlingInEachesNumber , @handlingInUnitsNumber , 
								@pallets , @eaches , @units, @eachesTypeFK , @unitTypeFK, @eachesType, @unitType

								Set @lastPalletWasMixed = @isMixedPallet
							END
						END
					END
					ELSE
					BEGIN --No charges exist and we are to charge regardless of works orders
						Print 'Check 3'
						--Check if this is a mixed pallet, if fi we dont want to charge 2 or more PALLET handling in charges, we only charge for eaches/units charges in this case 
						if(@isMixedPallet = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ AND @lastPalletWasMixed = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ AND @handlingInEachesTypeFK = -1 AND @handlingInUnitTypeFK = -1)
						BEGIN
							Print 'Do nothing, we have a mixed pallet that has already had a pallet charge, and this stock does not charge by eaches/units'
						END
						ELSE
						BEGIN
							Exec spChargesCreateHandlingCharge @var_stockInPK, -1, @stockItemFK, @handlingInCharge, @handlingInEachesTypeFK , 
							@handlingInUnitTypeFK , @handlingInEachesNumber , @handlingInUnitsNumber , 
							@pallets , @eaches , @units, @eachesTypeFK , @unitTypeFK, @eachesType, @unitType

							Set @lastPalletWasMixed = @isMixedPallet
						END
					END
				END	

				FETCH NEXT FROM ChargesCursor INTO 
				@stockInLinePK, @isMixedPallet, @stockItemFK, @chargePK, @handlingInCharge , @handlingInEachesTypeFK , @handlingInUnitTypeFK , 
				@handlingInEachesNumber , @handlingInUnitsNumber , @handlingInChargeResultingPallets ,
				@pallets , @eaches , @eachesTypeFK , @eachesType, @units,  @unitTypeFK, @unitType 
			END

			CLOSE ChargesCursor 
			DEALLOCATE ChargesCursor
	
			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end

			
			
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END
GO

-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spStockInEsign]
(
	@stockInFK int,
	@userFK int,
	@date datetime
)
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT
 ,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;
	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	DECLARE @var_stockInFK int, @var_userFK int, @var_date datetime
	SET @var_stockInFK = @stockInFK; SET @var_userFK = @userFK; SET @var_date = @date
	SET @ParameterDetails = '@stockInFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_stockInFK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@userFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_userFK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') 
		+ ',@date = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_date AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'')

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    --BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

		SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END


	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY
			IF XACT_STATE() = 0 AND @@TRANCOUNT < 1 BEGIN TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start

			if((Select CheckedAndReceivedBy from tblStockIns where StockInPK = @var_stockInFK) <> -1) 
			BEGIN
				Select '1' --already checked and received !
			END 
			ELSE 
			BEGIN
				update tblStockIns WITH (ROWLOCK)
				set CheckedAndReceivedBy = @var_userFK,
				CheckedAndReceivedDate = @var_date
				where StockInPK = @var_stockInFK
				Select '0'
			END   

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end

			BEGIN TRY IF XACT_STATE() = 1 AND @@TRANCOUNT = 1 AND @OpeningTranCount < 1 COMMIT TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH
			
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END
GO

-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Jamie>
-- Create date: <24/11/2016>
-- Description:	<get all stock in rules, for stock item / division / customer, or specific to supplier>

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spStockInLineCheckAndSetRules]
(
	@StockInLinePK int
)
AS
BEGIN	
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT
	,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;
	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	DECLARE @var_StockInLinePK int
	SET @var_StockInLinePK = @StockInLinePK
	SET @ParameterDetails = '@StockInLinePK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_StockInLinePK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'')

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    --BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

		SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END

	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY
			
			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start

			--trace progress for returning error
			DECLARE @PROGRESS int
			DECLARE @stockItemFK int, @divisionFK int, @customerFK int, @supplierFK int, @batch nvarchar(200), @supplierBatch nvarchar(200), @Units decimal(18, 3), @CustomerBarcode nvarchar(200), @BestBefore datetime, @Expiry datetime
			DECLARE @field nvarchar(500)
			DECLARE @sqlString nvarchar(4000)
			DECLARE @sqlString1 nvarchar(4000)
			DECLARE @sqlString2 nvarchar(4000)
			DECLARE @sqlString3 nvarchar(4000)
			DECLARE @SqlString4 nvarchar(4000)
			DECLARE @SqlString5 nvarchar(4000)

			/******** GET StockItem, Division, Customer ********/
			Select @stockItemFK = sils.StockItemFK, 
			@divisionFK = sins.DivisionFK, 
			@customerFK = divs.CustomerFK,
			@supplierFK = cIns.SupplierFK,
			@batch = sils.Batch,
			@supplierBatch = sils.Batch ,
			@Units = sils.Units,
			@CustomerBarcode = sils.CustomerBarcode,
			@BestBefore = sils.BestBefore,
			@Expiry = sils.ExpiryDate
			From (Select * from tblStockInLines where StockInLinePK = @var_StockInLinePK) sils
			inner join tblStockIns sins on
			sins.StockInPK = sils.StockInFK
			inner join tblDivisions divs on
			divs.DivisionPK = sins.DivisionFK
			inner join tblContainerIns cIns on
			cIns.ContainerInPK = sins.ContainerInFK
	
			--Print @stockItemFK

			IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#RulesToApply') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #RulesToApply

			/******** DECLARE TEMP TABLE ************/
			CREATE TABLE #RulesToApply
			(
				StockInRulePK int,
				StockInRuleTypeFK int,
				ReceiverTypeFK int,
				ReceiverFK int,
				FieldFK int,
				IntegerValue int,
				StringValue nvarchar(50),
				SupplierFK int,
				ValueTypeFK int,
				CopyFromFieldFK int
			)

			---------  supplier rules first, then non-supplier	---------------------------------------------------------------------------------
			--stock item rule for a supplier takes highest priority
			print 'starting'
			insert into #RulesToApply
			select StockInRulePK, StockInRuleTypeFK, ReceiverTypeFK, ReceiverFK, FieldFK, IntegerValue, StringValue, SupplierFK, ap.FieldValueTypeFK, CopyFromFieldFK
			from tblStockInRules
			inner join appfields ap on FieldFK = FieldPK
			where (ReceiverTypeFK = 3 /*stock item*/ and ReceiverFK = @StockItemFK) and SupplierFK = @supplierFK
			print '1'
			--stock item rule not applied to a supplier, and excluding the same rule type found above for suppliers
			insert into #RulesToApply
			select rules.StockInRulePK, rules.StockInRuleTypeFK, rules.ReceiverTypeFK, rules.ReceiverFK, rules.FieldFK, rules.IntegerValue, rules.StringValue, rules.SupplierFK, ap.FieldValueTypeFK, rules.CopyFromFieldFK
			from tblStockInRules rules
			inner join appfields ap on FieldFK = FieldPK
			LEFT JOIN #RulesToApply selectedRules on selectedRules.FieldFK = rules.FieldFK
			WHERE selectedRules.StockInRulePK IS NULL --ignore conflicting rules
				and (rules.ReceiverTypeFK = 3 /*stock item*/ and rules.ReceiverFK = @stockItemFK) and rules.SupplierFK = -1


			--division rule for a supplier is next, excluding rule type if found for stock item
			insert into #RulesToApply
			select rules.StockInRulePK, rules.StockInRuleTypeFK, rules.ReceiverTypeFK, rules.ReceiverFK, rules.FieldFK, rules.IntegerValue, rules.StringValue, rules.SupplierFK, ap.FieldValueTypeFK, rules.CopyFromFieldFK
			from tblStockInRules rules
			inner join appfields ap on FieldFK = FieldPK
			LEFT JOIN #RulesToApply selectedRules on selectedRules.FieldFK = rules.FieldFK
			WHERE selectedRules.StockInRulePK IS NULL --ignore conflicting rules
				and (rules.ReceiverTypeFK = 2 /*division*/ and rules.ReceiverFK = @DivisionFK) and rules.SupplierFK = @supplierFK

			--division rule not applied to a supplier,  and excluding rule types that exist for stock items or division supplier rules
			insert into #RulesToApply
			select rules.StockInRulePK, rules.StockInRuleTypeFK, rules.ReceiverTypeFK, rules.ReceiverFK, rules.FieldFK, rules.IntegerValue, rules.StringValue, rules.SupplierFK, ap.FieldValueTypeFK, rules.CopyFromFieldFK
			from tblStockInRules rules
			inner join appfields ap on FieldFK = FieldPK
			LEFT JOIN #RulesToApply selectedRules on selectedRules.FieldFK = rules.FieldFK
			WHERE selectedRules.StockInRulePK IS NULL --ignore conflicting rules
				and (rules.ReceiverTypeFK = 2 /*division*/ and rules.ReceiverFK = @DivisionFK) and rules.SupplierFK = -1


			--customer rule for a supplier is last, excluding rule type if found for division or stock item
			insert into #RulesToApply
			select rules.StockInRulePK, rules.StockInRuleTypeFK, rules.ReceiverTypeFK, rules.ReceiverFK, rules.FieldFK, rules.IntegerValue, rules.StringValue, rules.SupplierFK, ap.FieldValueTypeFK, rules.CopyFromFieldFK
			from tblStockInRules rules
			inner join appfields ap on FieldFK = FieldPK
			LEFT JOIN #RulesToApply selectedRules on selectedRules.FieldFK = rules.FieldFK
			WHERE selectedRules.StockInRulePK IS NULL --ignore conflicting rules
				and (rules.ReceiverTypeFK = 1 /*customer*/ and rules.ReceiverFK = @CustomerFK) and rules.SupplierFK = @supplierFK
	
			--customer rule not applied to a supplier, and excluding rule types that exist for stock items / divisions, or customer supplier rules)
			insert into #RulesToApply
			select rules.StockInRulePK, rules.StockInRuleTypeFK, rules.ReceiverTypeFK, rules.ReceiverFK, rules.FieldFK, rules.IntegerValue, rules.StringValue, rules.SupplierFK, ap.FieldValueTypeFK, rules.CopyFromFieldFK
			from tblStockInRules rules
			inner join appfields ap on FieldFK = FieldPK
			LEFT JOIN #RulesToApply selectedRules on selectedRules.FieldFK = rules.FieldFK
			WHERE selectedRules.StockInRulePK IS NULL --ignore conflicting rules
				and (rules.ReceiverTypeFK = 1 /*customer*/ and rules.ReceiverFK = @CustomerFK) and rules.SupplierFK = -1

			--Select * from @RulesToApply

			--we now have our rules to apply in a table, loop the rules and set the values
			--Delcare and initialise our counter (return the counter so we know how many rules have been applied
			--and initialise the sqlString to execute
			DECLARE @rulesApplied int
			Set @rulesApplied = 0
			Set @sqlString3 = ''

			DECLARE @StockInRulePK int,
			@StockInRuleTypeFK int,
			@ReceiverTypeFK int,
			@ReceiverFK int,
			@FieldFK int,
			@IntegerValue int,
			@StringValue nvarchar(50),
			@RuleSupplierFK int,
			@FieldValueTypeFK int,
			@CopyFromFieldFK int
			DECLARE rule_cursor CURSOR FOR  
			Select * from #RulesToApply

			OPEN rule_cursor   
			FETCH NEXT FROM rule_cursor INTO @StockInRulePK,
				@StockInRuleTypeFK,
				@ReceiverTypeFK,
				@ReceiverFK,
				@FieldFK,
				@IntegerValue,
				@StringValue,
				@RuleSupplierFK,
				@FieldValueTypeFK,
				@CopyFromFieldFK

				WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 BEGIN 
					Print 'Started Loop'
					--Switch through the relevant fields
		

					IF(((@FieldFK = 14/*batch*/ AND @batch <> '') OR (@FieldFK = 102/*supplier batch*/ AND @supplierBatch <> '') OR (@FieldFK = 13/*units*/)) OR (@FieldFK = 93/*cust barcode*/ AND @CustomerBarcode <> '') OR (@FieldFK = 92))
					BEGIN
						--this could be a select from appFields but there are differences between dev, test and live.. using live values
						Select @field = 
						(
						CASE  @FieldFK
								WHEN 14 THEN 'Batch'
								WHEN 93 THEN 'CustomerBarcode'
								WHEN 102 THEN 'SupplierBatch'
								WHEN 13 THEN 'Units'
								when 92 then 'BestBefore'
						END
						)
						Set @sqlString1 = @field + ' = '
						SET @SqlString4 = (case @FieldValueTypeFK when 5 then ' and '+ @field + ' = ''19000101''' else  ' AND len(' + @field + ') > 0' end)
						Select @sqlString2 = 
						(
						CASE  @StockInRuleTypeFK
								WHEN 1 THEN 'RIGHT(' + @field + ', LEN(' + @field + ') - ' + cast(@integerValue as nvarchar(50)) + ')'
								WHEN 2 THEN 'LEFT(' + @field + ', LEN(' + @field + ') - ' + cast(@integerValue as nvarchar(50)) + ')'
								WHEN 3 THEN 'FLOOR(' + @field + ')'
								WHEN 4 THEN 'CEILING(' + @field + ')'
								when 5 then  (select FieldName from appfields where fieldpk = @CopyFromFieldFK) 
						END
						)

						Set @sqlString3 = @sqlString3 + @sqlString1 + @sqlString2 + ','
						print @SqlString4
						SET @SqlString5 = CONCAT (@SqlString5, @SqlString4)
						print @SqlString5
						Set @rulesApplied = @rulesApplied + 1
					END

					FETCH NEXT FROM rule_cursor INTO @StockInRulePK,
					@StockInRuleTypeFK,
					@ReceiverTypeFK,
					@ReceiverFK,
					@FieldFK,
					@IntegerValue,
					@StringValue,
					@RuleSupplierFK,
					@FieldValueTypeFK,
					@CopyFromFieldFK
				END   
			CLOSE rule_cursor   
			DEALLOCATE rule_cursor
		
			if(@rulesApplied > 0) 
			BEGIN
				Set @sqlString3 = LEFT(@sqlString3, LEN(@sqlString3) - 1)--get rid of last comma
				Set @sqlString = 'UPDATE tblStockInLines WITH (ROWLOCK) SET ' + @sqlString3 + ' WHERE StockInLinePK = ' + cast(@var_StockInLinePK as nvarchar(100)) + @SqlString5
				print @sqlString
				execute sp_executesql @sqlString
			END

			Select @rulesApplied

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end

			
			
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END
GO

-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spStockInLineEdit]
(
	@stockInLineFK int,
	@field nvarchar(100),
	@oldIntValue int = null,
	@newIntValue int = null,
	@oldDecimalValue decimal(18,3) = null,
	@newDecimalValue decimal(18,3) = null,
	@oldStringValue nvarchar(500) = null,
	@newStringValue nvarchar(500) = null,
	@oldBooleanValue bit = null,
	@newBooleanValue bit = null,
	@oldDateValue datetime = null,
	@newDateValue datetime = null
)
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT
 ,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;
	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	DECLARE @var_stockInLineFK int, @var_field nvarchar(100), @var_oldIntValue int, @var_newIntValue int, @var_oldDecimalValue decimal(18,3), 
	@var_newDecimalValue decimal(18,3), @var_oldStringValue nvarchar(500), @var_newStringValue nvarchar(500), @var_oldBooleanValue bit, @var_newBooleanValue bit, 
	@var_oldDateValue datetime, @var_newDateValue datetime

	SET @var_stockInLineFK = @stockInLineFK; SET @var_field = @field; SET @var_oldIntValue = @oldIntValue; SET @var_newIntValue = @newIntValue
	SET @var_oldDecimalValue = @oldDecimalValue; SET @var_newDecimalValue = @newDecimalValue; SET @var_oldStringValue = @oldStringValue
	SET @var_newStringValue = @newStringValue; SET @var_oldBooleanValue = @oldBooleanValue; SET @var_newBooleanValue = @newBooleanValue
	SET @var_oldDateValue = @oldDateValue; SET @var_newDateValue = @newDateValue

	SET @ParameterDetails = '@stockInLineFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_stockInLineFK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@field = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_field AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') 
		+ ',@oldIntValue = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_oldIntValue AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@newIntValue = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_newIntValue AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') 
			+ ',@oldDecimalValue = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_oldDecimalValue AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@newDecimalValue = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_newDecimalValue AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') 
				+ ',@oldStringValue = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_oldStringValue AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@newStringValue = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_newStringValue AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') 
					+ ',@oldBooleanValue = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_oldBooleanValue AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@newBooleanValue = ' 
						+ ISNULL(CAST(@var_newBooleanValue AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@oldDateValue = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_oldDateValue AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') 
							+ ',@newDateValue = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_newDateValue AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'')

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    --BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

		SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END


	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY
			IF XACT_STATE() = 0 AND @@TRANCOUNT < 1 BEGIN TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start

			DECLARE @currentBatch nvarchar(500), @currentSupplierBatch nvarchar(500), @currentStockItemFK int
			Select @currentBatch = Batch, @currentSupplierBatch = SupplierBatch, @currentStockItemFK = StockItemFK from tblStockInLines where StockInLinePK = @var_stockInLineFK

			IF(@var_field = 'Batch')
			BEGIN
				--StockInLines
				update tblStockInLines WITH (ROWLOCK)
				Set Batch = @var_newStringValue
				Where StockInLinePK = @var_stockInLineFK
				--PalletContent
				update tblPalletContent WITH (ROWLOCK) 
				Set Batch = @var_newStringValue
				Where PalletFK in 
					(Select PalletFK from tblStockInLinePallets where StockInLineFK = @var_stockInLineFK)
				AND Batch = @currentBatch
				--PalletAudit
				update tblPalletAudit WITH (ROWLOCK)
				Set Batch = @var_newStringValue
				Where PalletFK in 
					(Select PalletFK from tblStockInLinePallets where StockInLineFK = @var_stockInLineFK)
				AND Batch = @currentBatch
				--Movements
				update tblWorksOrderMovements WITH (ROWLOCK)
				Set MovementDescription = LEFT(MovementDescription, CHARINDEX('Batch', MovementDescription) - 1) + 'Batch ' + @var_newStringValue + RIGHT(MovementDescription, 
				LEN(MovementDescription) - CHARINDEX(', Quantity', MovementDescription))
				Where PalletFK in 
					(Select PalletFK from tblStockInLinePallets where StockInLineFK = @var_stockInLineFK)
				AND WorksOrderStatusFK NOT in (3,4) AND tblWorksOrderMovements.DestinationLocationTypeFK <> 5
			END 
			ELSE IF(@var_field = 'StockItemFK') 
			BEGIN
		
				--Remove Pallet Content ready to be added with the correct Stock Item (we will lose each barcodes unfortunately)
				Delete tblPalletContent Where PalletFK in (Select PalletFK from tblStockInLinePallets where StockInLineFK = @var_stockInLineFK)
				--Remove any SpecialTypes
				Delete tblPalletContentSpecialStockTypes Where PalletFK in (Select PalletFK from tblStockInLinePallets where StockInLineFK = @var_stockInLineFK)
				--Remove any UnitCosts
				Delete tblPalletContentUnitCosts Where PalletFK in (Select PalletFK from tblStockInLinePallets where StockInLineFK = @var_stockInLineFK)
				--Remove any Commodity Codes
				Delete tblPalletContentCommodityCodes Where PalletFK in (Select PalletFK from tblStockInLinePallets where StockInLineFK = @var_stockInLineFK)
				--Remove any VersionedContent
				Delete tblPalletContentVersions Where PalletFK in (Select PalletFK from tblStockInLinePallets where StockInLineFK = @var_stockInLineFK)

				--PalletAudit
				update tblPalletAudit WITH (ROWLOCK)
				Set StockItemFK = @var_newIntValue
				Where PalletFK in 
					(Select PalletFK from tblStockInLinePallets where StockInLineFK = @var_stockInLineFK)
				AND Batch = @currentBatch
				AND StockItemFK = @currentStockItemFK

			END 
			ELSE IF(@var_field = 'ExpiryDate')
			BEGIN
				--StockInLines
				update tblStockInLines WITH (ROWLOCK)
				Set ExpiryDate = @var_newDateValue,
				ExtraDetails = @var_newStringValue
				Where StockInLinePK = @var_stockInLineFK
				--PalletContent
				update tblPalletContent WITH (ROWLOCK) 
				Set ExpiryDate = @var_newDateValue
				Where PalletFK in 
					(Select PalletFK from tblStockInLinePallets where StockInLineFK = @var_stockInLineFK)

			END 
			ELSE IF(@var_field = 'DateOfManufacture' AND @var_newDateValue <> '19000101')
			BEGIN
				/*LJF Have added clause(AND @var_newDateValue <> '19000101') as it may be possible that the manufacture date is calculated and not typed on the screen resulting in 19000101 being sent here and overwriting our dates*/
				--StockInLines
				update tblStockInLines WITH (ROWLOCK)
				Set DateOfManufacture = @var_newDateValue,
				ExtraDetails = @var_newStringValue
				Where StockInLinePK = @var_stockInLineFK
				--PalletContent
				update tblPalletContent WITH (ROWLOCK) 
				Set DateOfManufacture = @var_newDateValue
				Where PalletFK in 
					(Select PalletFK from tblStockInLinePallets where StockInLineFK = @var_stockInLineFK)

			END 
			ELSE IF(@var_field = 'BestBefore')
			BEGIN
				--StockInLines
				update tblStockInLines WITH (ROWLOCK)
				Set BestBefore = @var_newDateValue,
				ExtraDetails = @var_newStringValue
				Where StockInLinePK = @var_stockInLineFK
				--PalletContent
				update tblPalletContent WITH (ROWLOCK) 
				Set BestBefore = @var_newDateValue
				Where PalletFK in 
					(Select PalletFK from tblStockInLinePallets where StockInLineFK = @var_stockInLineFK)

			END 
			ELSE IF(@var_field = 'DateOfReceipt')
			BEGIN
				--StockInLines
				update tblStockInLines WITH (ROWLOCK)
				Set DateOfReceipt = @var_newDateValue,
				ExtraDetails = @var_newStringValue
				Where StockInLinePK = @var_stockInLineFK
				--PalletContent
				update tblPalletContent WITH (ROWLOCK) 
				Set DateOfReceipt = @var_newDateValue
				Where PalletFK in 
					(Select PalletFK from tblStockInLinePallets where StockInLineFK = @var_stockInLineFK)

			END 
			ELSE IF(@var_field = 'SpecialStockTypeFK') 
			BEGIN
				update tblStockInLines WITH (ROWLOCK)
				Set SpecialStockTypeFK = @var_newIntValue
				Where StockInLinePK = @var_stockInLineFK		

				--Remove any SpecialTypes
				Delete tblPalletContentSpecialStockTypes 
				Where PalletFK in 
				(
					Select PalletFK 
					from tblStockInLinePallets silps
					inner join tblPallets pallets on
					pallets.PalletPK = silps.PalletFK
					where StockInLineFK = @var_stockInLineFK
				)
				--Remove any UnitCosts
				Delete tblPalletContentUnitCosts 
				Where PalletFK in 
				(
					Select PalletFK 
					from tblStockInLinePallets silps
					inner join tblPallets pallets on
					pallets.PalletPK = silps.PalletFK
					where StockInLineFK = @var_stockInLineFK
				)

				--UPDATE PALLET CONTENT
				update tblPalletContent WITH (ROWLOCK)
				Set SpecialStockTypeFK = @var_newIntValue
				Where PalletFK in 
				(
					Select PalletFK 
					from tblStockInLinePallets silps
					inner join tblPallets pallets on
					pallets.PalletPK = silps.PalletFK
					where StockInLineFK = @var_stockInLineFK
				)

				--CREATE NEW PALLET CONTENT SPECIAL STOCK TYPES
				IF(@var_newIntValue <> -1) 
				BEGIN
					insert into tblPalletContentSpecialStockTypes
					Select pc.PalletContentPK, pc.PalletFK, @var_newIntValue, 
					-1,-1,0,0,'','', 
					0/*cast(0 as bit)*/, 0, dbo.GetBSTDate(), 0, dbo.GetBSTDate()
					from tblPalletContent pc
					where PalletFK in
					(
						Select PalletFK 
						from tblStockInLinePallets silps
						inner join tblPallets pallets on
						pallets.PalletPK = silps.PalletFK
						where StockInLineFK = @var_stockInLineFK
					)

					--SET PARAMETERS FOR SPECIAL STOCK TYPE
					EXEC [dbo].[spPalletContentSpecialStockTypeSetParameters]
						@stockInLineFK = @var_stockInLineFK,
						@stockItemFK = @currentStockItemFK,
						@specialStockTypeFK = @var_newIntValue

					IF(@var_newIntValue = 1) 
					BEGIN --We may have unit costs
						DECLARE @unitCostFK int
						Select @unitCostFK = isnull(StockItemUnitCostPK, -1) 
						from tblStockItems sis 
						LEFT outer join tblStockItemUnitCosts siucs on 
						siucs.StockItemFK = sis.StockItemPK AND siucs.StartDate = 
							(Select MAX(StartDate) from tblStockItemUnitCosts where StockItemFK = @currentStockItemFK) 
						where sis.StockItemPK = @currentStockItemFK

						IF(@unitCostFK <> -1) 
						BEGIN
							--CREATE NEW PALLET CONTENT UNIT COSTS
							insert into tblPalletContentUnitCosts
							Select pc.PalletContentPK, pc.PalletFK, @unitCostFK, 
							0/*cast(0 as bit)*/, 0, dbo.GetBSTDate(), 0, dbo.GetBSTDate()
							from tblPalletContent pc
							where PalletFK in
							(
								Select PalletFK 
								from tblStockInLinePallets silps
								inner join tblPallets pallets on
								pallets.PalletPK = silps.PalletFK
								where StockInLineFK = @var_stockInLineFK
							)
						END
					END
				END
			END 
			ELSE IF(@var_field = 'Units') 
			BEGIN
				Print 'Hello'

				--Remove any SpecialTypes
				Delete tblPalletContentSpecialStockTypes 
				Where PalletContentFK in 
				(Select PalletContentPK from tblPalletContent pc 
					Where PalletFK in (Select PalletFK from tblStockInLinePallets where StockInLineFK = @var_stockInLineFK)
					AND EachUnits = (Select EachUnits from tblStockInLines where StockInLinePK = @var_stockInLineFK)
				)

				--Remove any UnitCosts
				Delete tblPalletContentUnitCosts 
				Where PalletContentFK in 
				(Select PalletContentPK from tblPalletContent pc 
					Where PalletFK in (Select PalletFK from tblStockInLinePallets where StockInLineFK = @var_stockInLineFK)
					AND EachUnits = (Select EachUnits from tblStockInLines where StockInLinePK = @var_stockInLineFK)
				)

				--Remove any Commodity Codes
				Delete tblPalletContentCommodityCodes 
				Where PalletContentFK in 
				(Select PalletContentPK from tblPalletContent pc 
					Where PalletFK in (Select PalletFK from tblStockInLinePallets where StockInLineFK = @var_stockInLineFK)
					AND EachUnits = (Select EachUnits from tblStockInLines where StockInLinePK = @var_stockInLineFK)
				)

				--Remove any VersionedContent
				Delete tblPalletContentVersions 
				Where PalletContentFK in 
				(Select PalletContentPK from tblPalletContent pc 
					Where PalletFK in (Select PalletFK from tblStockInLinePallets where StockInLineFK = @var_stockInLineFK)
					AND EachUnits = (Select EachUnits from tblStockInLines where StockInLinePK = @var_stockInLineFK)
				)

				--We remove from tblPalletContent Last so as previous deletes will work
				--Remove Pallet Content ready to be added with the correct units (we will lose each barcodes unfortunately)
				Delete tblPalletContent 
				Where PalletFK in 
					(Select PalletFK from tblStockInLinePallets where StockInLineFK = @var_stockInLineFK)
				AND EachUnits = (Select EachUnits from tblStockInLines where StockInLinePK = @var_stockInLineFK)
			END 
			ELSE IF(@var_field = 'CustomerPalletNumber')
			BEGIN
				--StockInLines
				update tblStockInLines WITH (ROWLOCK)
				Set CustomerPalletNumber = @var_newStringValue--, CustomerBarcode = @var_newStringValue
				Where StockInLinePK = @var_stockInLineFK

				UPDATE pallet WITH (ROWLOCK) 
				SET pallet.CustomerPalletNumber = @var_newStringValue--, pallet.CustomerBarcode = @var_newStringValue
				FROM tblPallets pallet
				INNER JOIN tblStockInLinepallets silp on silp.PalletFK = pallet.PalletPK
				INNER JOIN tblStockInLines sil on sil.StockInLinePK = silp.StockInLineFK
				WHERE sil.StockInLinePK = @var_stockInLineFK
			END	ELSE IF(@var_field = 'CustomerBarcode')
			BEGIN
				--StockInLines
				update tblStockInLines WITH (ROWLOCK)
				Set CustomerBarcode = @var_newStringValue
				Where StockInLinePK = @var_stockInLineFK

				UPDATE pallet WITH (ROWLOCK) 
				SET pallet.CustomerBarcode = @var_newStringValue
				FROM tblPallets pallet
				INNER JOIN tblStockInLinepallets silp on silp.PalletFK = pallet.PalletPK
				INNER JOIN tblStockInLines sil on sil.StockInLinePK = silp.StockInLineFK
				WHERE sil.StockInLinePK = @var_stockInLineFK
			END	
			ELSE IF(@var_field = 'SupplierBatch')
			BEGIN
				--StockInLines
				update tblStockInLines WITH (ROWLOCK)
				Set SupplierBatch = @var_newStringValue
				Where StockInLinePK = @var_stockInLineFK
				--PalletContent
				update tblPalletContent WITH (ROWLOCK) 
				Set SupplierBatch = @var_newStringValue
				Where PalletFK in 
					(Select PalletFK from tblStockInLinePallets where StockInLineFK = @var_stockInLineFK)
				AND SupplierBatch = @currentSupplierBatch
			END 
			ELSE IF(@var_field = 'SetDownAreaFK')
			BEGIN
				--StockInLines
				update tblStockInLines WITH (ROWLOCK)
				Set SetDownAreaFK = @var_newIntValue
				Where StockInLinePK = @var_stockInLineFK
			END 
			ELSE IF(@var_field = 'ExtraDetails')
			BEGIN
				--StockInLines
				update tblStockInLines WITH (ROWLOCK)
				Set ExtraDetails = @var_newStringValue
				Where StockInLinePK = @var_stockInLineFK
			END

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end

			BEGIN TRY IF XACT_STATE() = 1 AND @@TRANCOUNT = 1 AND @OpeningTranCount < 1 COMMIT TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH
			
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END
GO

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spStockInLineSummary]
(	
	@stockInLinePK int
)	
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT
 ,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;
	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	DECLARE @stockInLinePK2 int

	SET @stockInLinePK2 = @stockInLinePK

	SET @ParameterDetails = '@stockInLinePK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@stockInLinePK2 AS NVARCHAR(20)),'')

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    BEGIN
            SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

            INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
            SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

            SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    END


	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY
			

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start

			SELECT stockinlinepk AS PK, stockitemcode, PalletStatus, count(PalletPK) NoPallets, CASE WHEN vpl.Location LIKE '%loading%' THEN 'Dispatched' else vpl.Location END AS [Location], sil.Free1 AS LineNumber,  FORMAT (sil.InsertedDate, 'HH : mm') AS InsertedTime, sil.Free2 AS Confirmed
			FROM tblstockinlines sil 
			INNER JOIN tblstockinlinepallets silp ON stockinlinefk = sil.StockInLinePK
			INNER JOIN dbo.viewPalletLocations vpl ON silp.palletfk = vpl.PalletPK AND vpl.LocationTypeFK = 1
			INNER JOIN appPalletStatus ps ON vpl.palletstatusfk = ps.palletstatuspk
			INNER JOIN tblstockitems si ON sil.stockitemfk = si.stockitempk
			WHERE stockinLinePk = @stockInLinePK2
			GROUP BY stockinlinepk, sil.InsertedDate, stockitemcode, PalletStatus, free1, sil.Free2, vpl.Location
			ORDER BY cast(sil.Free1 AS int)

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end

			
			
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spStockInPalletFromBarcode]  
(  
 @StockInFK int,
 @PalletBarcode nvarchar(200) = ''
)  
AS  
BEGIN   
 /* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */  
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED  
  
    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT  
 ,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;  
 SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();  
  
 -- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters  
 DECLARE @var_StockInFK int, @var_PalletBarcode nvarchar(200)  
 SET @var_StockInFK = @StockInFK; SET @var_PalletBarcode = @PalletBarcode; 
 
 SET @ParameterDetails = '@StockInFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_StockInFK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') 
  + ',@PalletBarcode = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_PalletBarcode AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') 
  
    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL   
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)  
  
    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)  
    --BEGIN  
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC   
  
  SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)  
  
        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)  
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK  
  
        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()  
    --END  
  
  
 SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);  
 SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails  
 ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;  
 INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()  
  
 WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3  
 BEGIN   
  BEGIN TRY     
  
   -- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start  
  
	select p.* 
	from tblpallets p
	inner join tblStockInLinePallets silp on p.palletpk = silp.palletfk
	inner join tblstockinlines sil on stockinlinepk = stockinlinefk
	where p.CustomerBarcode = @var_PalletBarcode and sil.stockinfk = @var_StockInFK

   -- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end  
     
   BREAK  
  END TRY  
  BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */  
   DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;  
   SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;  
   SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;  
  
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY   
   BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;  
         
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;  
  
            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID  
              
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;  
              
   IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)  
   BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END  
   ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */  
  END CATCH  
  SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1  
 END  
END

-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spStockInPalletsCheck]
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED

    DECLARE 
		@varThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400) = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID),@varExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@varParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX) = '',@varDeadlockErrorRetries INT = 1
		,@varProcedureAndErrorDetailsID INT,@EventLogPK INT,@varParentEventLogPK INT, @varSQLTransactionStarted BIT = 0
		,@varSQLTransactionName NVARCHAR(32) = REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(CAST(@@SPID AS NVARCHAR(50)) + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(50), dbo.GetBSTDate(), 21), ' - ', ''), ' ', ''), ':', ''), '.', '')

	-- Exit this stored procedure if it is already executing.

	IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#IsStoredProcedureExecuting') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #IsStoredProcedureExecuting

	CREATE TABLE #IsStoredProcedureExecuting(Result BIT)

	INSERT INTO #IsStoredProcedureExecuting EXEC dbo.spIsStoredProcedureExecuting @varThisProcedureName

	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #IsStoredProcedureExecuting WHERE Result = 1) 
	BEGIN
		PRINT 'Exiting stored procedure spStockinStatusCheck as it is already executing'
		RETURN 
	END

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    SELECT TOP 1 @varParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

	SET @varParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@varParentEventLogPK, -1)

    INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
    SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@varThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @varThisProcedureName + ' ' + @varParameterDetails, @varParentEventLogPK

    SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	SELECT @varExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @varExecutionPath = ISNULL(@varExecutionPath,@varThisProcedureName); IF @varExecutionPath = @varThisProcedureName SET @varExecutionPath = @varExecutionPath + ' ' + @varParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @varExecutionPath = @varExecutionPath + '\' + @varThisProcedureName + ' ' + @varParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @varThisProcedureName,@varExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @varProcedureAndErrorDetailsID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @varDeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		SET @varSQLTransactionName = REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(CAST(@@SPID AS NVARCHAR(50)) + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(50), dbo.GetBSTDate(), 21), ' - ', ''), ' ', ''), ':', ''), '.', '')
		SET @varSQLTransactionStarted = 0

		BEGIN TRY	
			DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #tblTempPallets

			SELECT DISTINCT
				p.PalletPK
			INTO
				#tblTempPallets
			FROM 
				dbo.tblPallets as p
			inner join dbo.tblstockinlinepallets on palletfk = palletpk
			inner join dbo.tblstockinlines on stockinlinepk = stockinlinefk
			inner join dbo.tblstockins as si  on stockinfk = si.stockinpk
			WHERE 
				p.IsArchived = 0 
				AND p.StockInStatusFK <> 3
				AND si.stockinstatusfk = 3 

			IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #tblTempPallets) RETURN

			-- Always attempt to begin a transaction before updating, inserting or deleting records in a permanent table
			BEGIN TRANSACTION @varSQLTransactionName

				SET @varSQLTransactionStarted = 1
				
				UPDATE p WITH (ROWLOCK)
				SET p.StockInStatusFK = 3
				FROM dbo.tblPallets p
				INNER JOIN #tblTempPallets tp ON p.PalletPK = tp.PalletPK
				
			-- Always attempt to commit before returning
			COMMIT TRANSACTION @varSQLTransactionName

			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH

			/* Attempt to rollback the SQL transaction if one was started */
			IF @varSQLTransactionStarted = 1
			BEGIN
				BEGIN TRY ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @varSQLTransactionName END TRY BEGIN CATCH /*Ignore and continue*/ END CATCH
			END

			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME = dbo.GetBSTDate(), @ErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX) = ERROR_MESSAGE(), @ErrorSeverity INT = ERROR_SEVERITY(), @ErrorState INT = ERROR_STATE()
            
			IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @varProcedureAndErrorDetailsID
            
            IF @varProcedureAndErrorDetailsID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @varParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@varExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @ErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205/*Deadlock error*/ OR @varDeadlockErrorRetries > 2
			BEGIN 
				SET @varDeadlockErrorRetries = 100
				RAISERROR (@ErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState)
				RETURN 
			END
			ELSE 
				WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH

		SET @varDeadlockErrorRetries = @varDeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END
GO

			-- Always attempt to begin a transaction before updating, inserting or deleting records in a permanent table
			BEGIN TRANSACTION @varSQLTransactionName

				SET @varSQLTransactionStarted = 1
				
				UPDATE p WITH (ROWLOCK)
				SET p.StockInStatusFK = 3
				FROM dbo.tblPallets p
				INNER JOIN #tblTempPallets tp ON p.PalletPK = tp.PalletPK
				
			-- Always attempt to commit before returning
			COMMIT TRANSACTION @varSQLTransactionName

			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH

			/* Attempt to rollback the SQL transaction if one was started */
			IF @varSQLTransactionStarted = 1
			BEGIN
				BEGIN TRY ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @varSQLTransactionName END TRY BEGIN CATCH /*Ignore and continue*/ END CATCH
			END

			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME = dbo.GetBSTDate(), @ErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX) = ERROR_MESSAGE(), @ErrorSeverity INT = ERROR_SEVERITY(), @ErrorState INT = ERROR_STATE()
            
			IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @varProcedureAndErrorDetailsID
            
            IF @varProcedureAndErrorDetailsID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @varParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@varExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @ErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205/*Deadlock error*/ OR @varDeadlockErrorRetries > 2
			BEGIN 
				SET @varDeadlockErrorRetries = 100
				RAISERROR (@ErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState)
				RETURN 
			END
			ELSE 
				WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH

		SET @varDeadlockErrorRetries = @varDeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END
GO
