-- =============================================  
-- Author:        <Author,,Name>  
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>  
-- Description:   <Description,,>  
-- =============================================  
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spStockItemInformation]  
(  
      @stockItemPK int,  
      @containerInPK int = -1,  
      @isDiscrepancy bit = 0  
)  
AS  
BEGIN  
 /* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */  
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED  
  
    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT  
 ,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;  
 SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();  
  
 -- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters  
 DECLARE @var_stockItemPK int, @var_containerInPK int, @var_isDiscrepancy bit  
 SET @var_stockItemPK = @stockItemPK; SET @var_containerInPK = @containerInPK; SET @var_isDiscrepancy = @isDiscrepancy  
 SET @ParameterDetails = '@stockItemPK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_stockItemPK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@containerInPK = '   
  + ISNULL(CAST(@var_containerInPK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@isDiscrepancy = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_isDiscrepancy AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'')  
  
    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL   
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)  
  
    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)  
    --BEGIN  
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC   
  
  SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)  
  
        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)  
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK  
  
        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()  
    --END  
  
  
 SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);  
 SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails  
 ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;  
 INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()  
  
 WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3  
 BEGIN   
  BEGIN TRY  
     
  
   -- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start  
  
   drop table if exists #tmpStockItemLevels  
   Select StockItemFK, sum(AvailableEaches) AvailableEaches, sum(AvailableUnits) AvailableUnits   
   into #tmpStockItemLevels  
   from tblStockLevels   
   where StockItemFK = @var_stockItemPK  
   group by StockItemFK  
  
   drop table if exists #tmpStockItemUnitCosts  
   Select *   
   into #tmpStockItemUnitCosts  
   from (  
                Select siucs.StockItemFK, currs.CurrencySymbol, siucs.UnitCost, siucs.StartDate, RANK() OVER(PARTITION BY StockItemFK ORDER BY StartDate DESC) AS RankNo  
                From tblStockItemUnitCosts siucs  
                inner join tblCurrencies currs on currs.CurrencyPK = siucs.CurrencyFK  
    where StockItemFK = @var_stockItemPK  
            ) subQ   
   Where RankNo = 1  
  
   drop table if exists #tmpStockItemAdditionalFields  
   select PalletAdditionalFields1.*   
   into #tmpStockItemAdditionalFields  
   from tblstockitems s   
   inner join tbldivisions d on s.divisionfk = d.divisionpk  
   inner join tblPalletAdditionalFields PalletAdditionalFields1   
    on (PalletAdditionalFields1.PalletAdditionalFieldTypeFK = 3 /*StockItem*/ AND PalletAdditionalFields1.FK = s.StockItemPK)  
    or (PalletAdditionalFields1.PalletAdditionalFieldTypeFK = 2 /*Division*/ AND PalletAdditionalFields1.FK = d.divisionpk)  
    or (PalletAdditionalFields1.PalletAdditionalFieldTypeFK = 1 /*Customer*/ AND PalletAdditionalFields1.FK = d.CustomerFK)  
   where stockitempk = @var_stockItemPK and PalletAdditionalFields1.Enabled = 1  
     
   --Declare @customerFK int, @divisionFK int, @requireCustomerBarcodeForDiscrepancies bit, @AllowCustomerPalletBarcodeManualEntry bit  
   --Select @customerFK = CustomerFK, @divisionFK = DivisionPK, @requireCustomerBarcodeForDiscrepancies = RequireCustomerBarcodeForDiscrepancies, @AllowCustomerPalletBarcodeManualEntry = AllowCustomerPalletBarcodeManualEntry  
   --from tblDivisions divs   
   --inner join tblCustomers cus on cus.CustomerPK = divs.CustomerFK   
   --where DivisionPK = (  
   -- Select DivisionFK   
   -- from tblStockItems   
   -- where StockItemPK = @var_stockItemPK)  
  
   --Ordered Units is regards to a supplier stock in, we check ContainerInHeaders  
   Declare @orderedUnits decimal(18,3)  
   Select Top 1 @orderedUnits = Units  
   from tblContainerInHeaders cihs  
   Where ContainerInFK = @var_containerInPK  AND StockItemFK = @var_stockItemPK  
  
   --are edits allowed  
   DECLARE @allowEdits bit = cast(1 AS bit)  
   if(@var_containerInPK > 0)  
   begin  
   SELECT @allowEdits = AllowLineEdits FROM tblContainerIns WHERE ContainerInPK = @var_containerInPK  
   end  
  
   Select distinct eachesTypes.EachesType, eachesTypes.EachesTypeSingular, eachesUnitTypes.Abbrieviation as EachesUnitType, unitTypes.Abbreviation UnitType,   
    stockItems.RequireExpiryDate, stockItems.RequireManufactureDate,  
    stockItems.RequireBestBefore, stockItems.RequireDateOfReceipt, CASE WHEN custs.RequirePalletNumber = 0 THEN CASE WHEN divs.RequirePalletNumber = 0 then stockItems.RequirePalletNumber ELSE divs.RequirePalletNumber END ELSE custs.RequirePalletNumber end
 as RequirePalletNumber, stockItems.RequireBatch, stockItems.RequireSupplierBatch,  
    CASE WHEN (@var_isDiscrepancy = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ AND custs.RequireCustomerBarcodeForDiscrepancies = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/) THEN  
       cast(1 as bit)  
    ELSE  
       case when @allowEdits = 1 then divs.AllowCustomerPalletBarcodeManualEntry else cast(0 as bit) end  
    END RequireCustomerBarcode,  
    coalesce(sisPalletAdditionalFields1.PalletAdditionalField, divPalletAdditionalFields1.PalletAdditionalField,   
    cusPalletAdditionalFields1.PalletAdditionalField) PalletAdditionalField1,  
    coalesce(sisPalletAdditionalFields2.PalletAdditionalField, divPalletAdditionalFields2.PalletAdditionalField,   
    cusPalletAdditionalFields2.PalletAdditionalField) PalletAdditionalField2,  
    coalesce(sisPalletAdditionalFields1.PalletAdditionalFieldPK, divPalletAdditionalFields1.PalletAdditionalFieldPK,   
    cusPalletAdditionalFields1.PalletAdditionalFieldPK) PalletAdditionalFieldPK1,  
    coalesce(sisPalletAdditionalFields2.PalletAdditionalFieldPK, divPalletAdditionalFields2.PalletAdditionalFieldPK,   
    cusPalletAdditionalFields2.PalletAdditionalFieldPK) PalletAdditionalFieldPK2,  
    palletTypes.PalletType, palletTypes.PalletTypePK,  
    isnull(sisrs.StockItemWorksorderRulePK, -1) StockItemSplitRulePK,  
    -1 as StockItemGroupRulePK,  
    case when stockItems.HandlingInEachesTypeFK = -1 AND stockItems.HandlingInUnitTypeFK = -1  
    Then stockItems.HandlingInCharge  
    Else -1 End as PalletHandlingInCharge,  
    case when stockLevels.AvailableEaches > 0 then stockLevels.AvailableEaches else 0 End as TotalEaches,  
    case when stockLevels.AvailableUnits > 0 then stockLevels.AvailableUnits else 0 End as TotalUnits,  
    case when DefaultUnitsPerEach > 0 then cast(DefaultUnitsPerEach as nvarchar(100)) else '' end as DefaultUnitsPerEach,  
    InputByEaches,  
    isnull(UnitCost, -1) UnitCost,  
    isnull(CurrencySymbol, '') UnitCostCurrencySymbol,  
    case when SpecialStockTypes.CustomerFK is not null then cast(1 as bit) else cast(0 as bit) end as RequireSpecialStockType,  
    -1 as WarehousingClientDefaultSpecialStockTypeFK,  
    cast(0 as bit) as WarehousingClientReadOnlySpecialStockType,  
    cast(0 as bit) as WarehousingClientHideSpecialStockType,  
    -1 as WarehousingDefaultSpecialStockTypeFK,  
    cast(0 as bit) as WarehousingReadOnlySpecialStockType,  
    cast(0 as bit) as WarehousingHideSpecialStockType,  
    divs.ManualBatchGeneration,  
    case when stockItems.SupplierStockInTolerancesOverride = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ then  
       stockItems.SupplierStockInTolerances   
    else  
       divs.SupplierStockInTolerances  
    end as SupplierStockInTolerances,  
    case when stockItems.SupplierStockInOutOfToleranceMessage = '' then  
       divs.SupplierStockInOutOfToleranceMessage  
    else  
       stockItems.SupplierStockInOutOfToleranceMessage  
    end as SupplierStockInOutOfToleranceMessage,  
    case when stockItems.SupplierStockInTolerancesOverride = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ then  
       stockItems.SupplierStockInToleranceAbove   
    else  
       divs.SupplierStockInToleranceAbove  
    end as SupplierStockInToleranceAbove,  
    case when stockItems.SupplierStockInTolerancesOverride = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ then  
       stockItems.SupplierStockInToleranceBelow   
    else  
       divs.SupplierStockInToleranceBelow  
    end as SupplierStockInToleranceBelow,  
              
    isnull(@orderedUnits, 0) SupplierOrderedUnits,  
    divs.SupplierBatchKeypressJavascript,  
    divs.DivisionPK  
  
   from tblStockItems stockItems   
            inner join tblDivisions divs on divs.DivisionPK = stockItems.DivisionFK  
   INNER JOIN tblcustomers custs ON divs.CustomerFK = custs.customerpk  
            left outer join tblEachesTypes eachesTypes on eachesTypes.EachesTypePK = stockItems.EachesTypeFK  
            left outer join tblEachesUnitTypes eachesUnitTypes on eachesUnitTypes.EachesUnitTypePK = stockItems.EachesUnitTypeFK  
            left outer join tblUnitTypes unitTypes on unitTypes.UnitTypePK = stockItems.UnitTypeFK              
   left outer join #tmpStockItemAdditionalFields sisPalletAdditionalFields1 on sisPalletAdditionalFields1.PalletAdditionalFieldTypeFK = 3 /*StockItem*/ AND sisPalletAdditionalFields1.FK = stockItems.StockItemPK AND sisPalletAdditionalFields1.FieldNumber=1
  
            left outer join #tmpStockItemAdditionalFields sisPalletAdditionalFields2 on sisPalletAdditionalFields2.PalletAdditionalFieldTypeFK = 3 /*StockItem*/ AND sisPalletAdditionalFields2.FK = stockItems.StockItemPK AND sisPalletAdditionalFields2.FieldNumber=2  
            left outer join #tmpStockItemAdditionalFields divPalletAdditionalFields1 on divPalletAdditionalFields1.PalletAdditionalFieldTypeFK = 2 /*Division*/ AND divPalletAdditionalFields1.FK = stockItems.DivisionFK AND divPalletAdditionalFields1.FieldNumber=1  
            left outer join #tmpStockItemAdditionalFields divPalletAdditionalFields2 on divPalletAdditionalFields2.PalletAdditionalFieldTypeFK = 2 /*Division*/ AND divPalletAdditionalFields2.FK = stockItems.DivisionFK AND divPalletAdditionalFields2.FieldNumber=2  
            left outer join #tmpStockItemAdditionalFields cusPalletAdditionalFields1 on cusPalletAdditionalFields1.PalletAdditionalFieldTypeFK = 1 /*Customer*/ AND cusPalletAdditionalFields1.FK = divs.CustomerFK AND cusPalletAdditionalFields1.FieldNumber=1
            left outer join #tmpStockItemAdditionalFields cusPalletAdditionalFields2 on cusPalletAdditionalFields2.PalletAdditionalFieldTypeFK = 1 /*Customer*/ AND cusPalletAdditionalFields2.FK = divs.CustomerFK AND cusPalletAdditionalFields2.FieldNumber=2  
			left outer join tblPalletTypes palletTypes on palletTypes.PalletTypePK = stockItems.DefaultPalletTypeFK  
            left outer join tblstockitemworksorderrules sisrs on sisrs.StockItemFK = stockItems.StockItemPK  
            left outer join #tmpStockItemUnitCosts unitCosts on unitCosts.StockItemFK = stockItems.StockItemPK  
   left outer join tblCustomerSpecialStockTypes SpecialStockTypes on SpecialStockTypes.CustomerFK = custs.CustomerPK      
            left outer join #tmpStockItemLevels stockLevels on stockLevels.StockItemFK = stockItems.StockItemPK  
            where StockItemPK = @var_stockItemPK  
                         
   -- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end  
  
     
     
   BREAK  
  END TRY  
  BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */  
   DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;  
   SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;  
   SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;  
  
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY   
   BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;  
         
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;  
  
            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID  
              
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;  
              
   IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)  
   BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END  
   ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */  
  END CATCH  
  SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1  
 END  
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spStocklevels_GetStockLevelByOrderCode]
   -- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here
    @orderCode nvarchar(200)

AS
BEGIN
    -- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from
    -- interfering with SELECT statements.
    SET NOCOUNT ON
	
    SELECT sl.StockItemFK, sum(sl.ActualUnits) AS stockquantity FROM [dbo].[tblstocklevels] sl
     INNER JOIN [dbo].[tblStockItems] s 
     ON sl.StockItemFK=s.StockItemPK
     WHERE s.StockItemCode='160010'
	 GROUP BY StockItemFK
END

)
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT

	SET @var_stockItemFK = @stockItemFK; SET @var_batch = @batch; SET @var_buildingUnitFK = @buildingUnitFK; SET @var_palletAuditFK = @palletAuditFK

	SET @ParameterDetails = '@stockItemFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_stockItemFK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@batch = ' 
		+ ISNULL(CAST(@var_batch AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@buildingUnitFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_buildingUnitFK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') 
			+ ',@palletAuditFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_palletAuditFK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'')

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END


	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY
			

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start

			Declare @pallets int, @batchPallets int,  @buildingUnitPallets int, @buildingUnitBatchPallets int, @buildingUnitEaches decimal(18,3), 
			@buildingUnitBatchEaches decimal(18,3), @buildingUnitUnits decimal(18,3), @buildingUnitBatchUnits decimal(18,3)

			drop table if exists #tmpBuildingUnitPallets

			select palletpk, stockitemfk, batch, buildingunitfk, ActualEaches,ActualUnits
			into #tmpBuildingUnitPallets
			from tblPallets pallets 
			inner join tblPalletContent pc  on pc.PalletFK = pallets.PalletPK
			where pc.StockItemFK = @var_stockItemFK

			Select @pallets = COALESCE(count(Distinct PalletPK),0) from #tmpBuildingUnitPallets

			Select @batchPallets = COALESCE(count(Distinct PalletPK),0) from #tmpBuildingUnitPallets
			where Batch = @var_batch

			Select @buildingUnitPallets = COALESCE(count(Distinct PalletPK),0) from #tmpBuildingUnitPallets
			where BuildingUnitFK = @var_buildingUnitFK

			Select @buildingUnitBatchPallets = COALESCE(count(Distinct PalletPK),0) from #tmpBuildingUnitPallets
			where Batch = @var_batch AND BuildingUnitFK = @var_buildingUnitFK

			Select @buildingUnitEaches = COALESCE(sum(ActualEaches),0), @buildingUnitUnits = COALESCE(sum(ActualUnits),0)
			From #tmpBuildingUnitPallets
			Where BuildingUnitFK = @var_buildingUnitFK

			Select @buildingUnitBatchEaches = COALESCE(sum(ActualEaches),0), @buildingUnitBatchUnits = COALESCE(sum(ActualUnits),0)
			From #tmpBuildingUnitPallets
			Where Batch = @var_batch AND BuildingUnitFK = @var_buildingUnitFK

			IF @var_palletAuditFK = -1 
			BEGIN
				Select @buildingUnitPallets Pallets, @buildingUnitBatchPallets BatchPallets, case when @buildingUnitEaches < 0 then -1 else @buildingUnitEaches end Eaches, 
				case when @buildingUnitBatchEaches < 0 then -1 else @buildingUnitBatchEaches end BatchEaches, case when @buildingUnitUnits < 0 then -1 
				else @buildingUnitUnits end Units, case when @buildingUnitBatchUnits < 0 then -1 else @buildingUnitBatchUnits end BatchUnits
			END

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end

			
			
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH

-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spStockLevelsForcustomer]
(
	@customerFK int
)	
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT
 ,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;
	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	DECLARE @customerFK2 int

	SET @customerFK2 = @customerFK

	SET @ParameterDetails = '@customerFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@customerFK2 AS NVARCHAR(20)),'')

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    --BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

		SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END


	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY
			

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start

			drop table if exists #tmphsestocks
			select distinct stockitempk, stockitemcode, s.IsArchived, DivisionPK, DivisionCode, CustomerCode, customerPk 
			into #tmphsestocks
			from tblstockitems s
			INNER JOIN dbo.tblDivisions AS d ON d.DivisionPK = s.DivisionFK 
			INNER JOIN  dbo.tblCustomers AS c ON c.CustomerPK = d.CustomerFK 
			where customerpk = @customerfk and s.isarchived=0

			drop table if exists #tmppendingorders
			SELECT DISTINCT dpoi.StockItemFK, SUM(dpoi.Quantity) AS Quantity
			into #tmppendingorders
				 FROM dbo.tblDistributionPendingOrderItems AS dpoi 
				 INNER JOIN dbo.tblDistributionPendingOrders AS dpo 
				 ON dpo.DistributionPendingOrderPK = dpoi.DistributionPendingOrderFK
				 inner join #tmphsestocks s on dpoi.StockItemFK = s.StockItemPK
				 WHERE   (dpo.Imported = 0)
				 GROUP BY dpoi.StockItemFK

			drop table if exists #tmpUnavailable
			SELECT stockitemfk, sum(pc.actualunits) ActualUnits
			into #tmpUnavailable
			   from tblpalletcontent AS pc   
			   inner join tblpallets p on pc.palletfk = p.palletpk
			   inner join #tmphsestocks s on pc.StockItemFK = s.StockItemPK
			   WHERE  p.IsArchived = 0  AND p.stockinstatusfk = 3  and p.PalletStatusFK <> 1 
			   group by stockitemfk



			SELECT s.StockItemCode + (case when s.isarchived = 1 then '_Archived' else '' end) as StockItemCode, s.StockItemPK, COALESCE (sl.Batch, 'NA') AS Batch, 
			s.DivisionCode, s.DivisionPK, s.CustomerCode, s.CustomerPK, 
			COALESCE (SUM(sl.AvailableUnits), 0) AS AvailableUnits, 
			COALESCE (SUM(sl.ActualUnits), 0) AS ActualUnits, 
			--COALESCE (SUM(sl.AvailableUnits) - 
			--CASE WHEN pendingOrders.stockitemfk IS NULL THEN 0
			--ELSE SUM(pendingOrders.Quantity) END, 0) AS AvailableUnitsExcludingPending
			COALESCE (SUM(sl.AvailableUnits) 
				- CASE WHEN pendingOrders.stockitemfk IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE SUM(pendingOrders.Quantity) END, 0) 
				- CASE WHEN unavailableStock.ActualUnits IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE unavailableStock.ActualUnits END 
				AS AvailableUnitsExcludingPending

			FROM #tmphsestocks AS s 
			LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.tblStockLevels AS sl ON sl.StockItemFK = s.StockItemPK 
			--INNER JOIN dbo.tblDivisions AS d ON d.DivisionPK = s.DivisionPK 
			--INNER JOIN  dbo.tblCustomers AS c ON c.CustomerPK = d.CustomerFK 
			LEFT OUTER JOIN #tmppendingorders pendingOrders on pendingOrders.StockItemFK = sl.StockItemFK
			LEFT OUTER JOIN #tmpUnavailable unavailableStock ON unavailableStock.StockItemFK = sl.StockItemFK
			--where CustomerpK=609
			GROUP BY s.StockItemCode, s.isarchived, s.StockItemPK, sl.Batch, pendingOrders.StockItemFK, s.DivisionCode, s.DivisionPK, s.CustomerCode, s.CustomerPK, unavailableStock.ActualUnits
			order by stockitemcode

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end

			
			
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END

 @containerOutFK int = -1  
)  
AS  
BEGIN  
 /* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */  
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED  
  
    DECLARE   
  @varThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400) = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID),@varExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@varParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX) = '',@varDeadlockErrorRetries INT = 1  
  ,@varProcedureAndErrorDetailsID INT,@EventLogPK INT,@varParentEventLogPK INT, @varSQLTransactionStarted BIT = 0  
  ,@varSQLTransactionName NVARCHAR(32) = REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(CAST(@@SPID AS NVARCHAR(50)) + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(50), dbo.GetBSTDate(), 21), ' - ', ''), ' ', ''), ':', ''), '.', '')  
  
 -- Exit this stored procedure if it is already executing.  
  
 IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#IsStoredProcedureExecuting') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #IsStoredProcedureExecuting  
  
 CREATE TABLE #IsStoredProcedureExecuting(Result BIT)  
  
 INSERT INTO #IsStoredProcedureExecuting EXEC dbo.spIsStoredProcedureExecuting @varThisProcedureName  
  
 IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #IsStoredProcedureExecuting WHERE Result = 1)   
 BEGIN  
  PRINT 'Exiting stored procedure spStockLevelsSync as it is already executing'  
  RETURN   
 END  
  
 -- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters  
 DECLARE   
  @varStockItemFK INT = @stockItemFK, @varBatch nvarchar(200) = @batch, @varContainerOutFK INT = @containerOutFK  
  
 SET @varParameterDetails = '@stockItemFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@varStockItemFK AS NVARCHAR(100)),'0') + '@batch = ' + ISNULL(@varBatch,'')   
  + '@containerOutFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@varContainerOutFK AS NVARCHAR(100)),'0')  
  
    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL   
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)  
  
    SELECT TOP 1 @varParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC   
  
    INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)  
    SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@varThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @varThisProcedureName + ' ' + @varParameterDetails, @varParentEventLogPK  
  
    SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()  
  
 SELECT @varExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);  
 SET @varExecutionPath = ISNULL(@varExecutionPath,@varThisProcedureName); IF @varExecutionPath = @varThisProcedureName SET @varExecutionPath = @varExecutionPath + ' ' + @varParameterDetails  
 ELSE SET @varExecutionPath = @varExecutionPath + '\' + @varThisProcedureName + ' ' + @varParameterDetails;  
 INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @varThisProcedureName,@varExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @varProcedureAndErrorDetailsID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()  
  
 WHILE @varDeadlockErrorRetries <= 3  
 BEGIN   
  SET @varSQLTransactionName = REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(CAST(@@SPID AS NVARCHAR(50)) + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(50), dbo.GetBSTDate(), 21), ' - ', ''), ' ', ''), ':', ''), '.', '')  
  SET @varSQLTransactionStarted = 0  
  
  BEGIN TRY   
  
   -- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start  
  
PRINT 'STARTING '  
PRINT (CONVERT( VARCHAR(24), dbo.GetBSTDate(), 121))  
  
   DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #tblTempPallets  
  
   SELECT p.PalletPK  
   INTO #tblTempPallets  
   FROM dbo.tblPallets as p  
   WHERE  p.IsArchived = 0  AND p.stockinstatusfk = 3   
  
PRINT 'PALLET TABLE CREATED'  
PRINT (CONVERT( VARCHAR(24), dbo.GetBSTDate(), 121))  
  
   CREATE INDEX #ndx1 ON #tblTempPallets(PalletPK)  
  
PRINT 'PALLET TABLE INDEX CREATED'  
PRINT (CONVERT( VARCHAR(24), dbo.GetBSTDate(), 121))  
  
   DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #tblAllTempPalletContents  
  
   SELECT pc.PalletContentPK, pc.StockItemFK, pc.Batch, pc.SpecialStockTypeFK, pc.ActualEaches, pc.ActualUnits, pc.AvailableEaches, pc.AvailableUnits,pc.PalletFK   
   INTO #tblAllTempPalletContents  
   FROM dbo.tblPalletContent AS pc  
   WHERE pc.IsArchived = 0  
   AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #tblTempPallets AS p WHERE p.PalletPK = pc.PalletFK)  
  
   UNION  
  
   SELECT pc2.PalletContentPK, pc2.StockItemFK, pc2.Batch, pc2.SpecialStockTypeFK, pc2.ActualEaches, pc2.ActualUnits, pc2.AvailableEaches, pc2.AvailableUnits, pc2.PalletFK
   FROM dbo.tblPalletContent pc2 WHERE pc2.IsArchived = 0 AND pc2.PalletFK = -1 AND actualunits > 0  
  
  
PRINT 'PALLET CONTENT All TABLE CREATED'  
PRINT (CONVERT( VARCHAR(24), dbo.GetBSTDate(), 121))  
  
   CREATE INDEX #ndx2 ON #tblAllTempPalletContents(PalletFK)  
  
   DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #tblTempPalletContent  
  
   SELECT  
    pc.PalletContentPK,  
    pc.StockItemFK,   
    pc.Batch,   
    pc.SpecialStockTypeFK,   
    pc.ActualEaches,   
    pc.ActualUnits,   
    pc.AvailableEaches,   
    pc.AvailableUnits,   
    pc.PalletFK,   
    1 AS MixedContentCount  
   INTO  
    #tblTempPalletContent  
   FROM   
    #tblAllTempPalletContents AS pc   
   WHERE  
    EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #tblTempPallets AS p WHERE p.PalletPK = pc.PalletFK)  
  
PRINT 'PALLET CONTENT TABLE CREATED'  
PRINT (CONVERT( VARCHAR(24), dbo.GetBSTDate(), 121))  
  
   DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #tblStockLevelsNoPalletFKs  
  
   Select   
    StockItemFK, Batch, SpecialStockTypeFK, 0 as ActualPallets, 0 as AvailablePallets, sum(ActualEaches) ActualEaches,   
    sum(ActualUnits) ActualUnits, sum(AvailableEaches) AvailableEaches, sum(AvailableUnits) AvailableUnits, 0 as MixedContentCount  
   INTO   
    #tblStockLevelsNoPalletFKs  
   from   
    #tblAllTempPalletContents   
   Where   
    PalletFK = -1  
   Group By   
    StockItemFK, Batch, SpecialStockTypeFK  
  
PRINT 'NO PALLET STOCK TABLE CREATED'  
PRINT (CONVERT( VARCHAR(24), dbo.GetBSTDate(), 121))  
  
  
   DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #tblStockLevels0  
  
   select *   
   into #tblStockLevels0   
   from #tblStockLevelsNoPalletFKs  
  
   union  
  
   Select   
    StockItemFK, Batch, SpecialStockTypeFK,   
    count(distinct (case when actualunits > 0 then PalletFK end)) as ActualPallets,  
    count(distinct (case when availableunits > 0 then PalletFK end)) as AvailablePallets,  
    sum(ActualEaches) ActualEaches, sum(ActualUnits) ActualUnits, sum(AvailableEaches) AvailableEaches, sum(AvailableUnits) AvailableUnits, MixedContentCount  
   From   
    #tblTempPalletContent  
   Group By   
    StockItemFK, Batch, SpecialStockTypeFK, MixedContentCount  
  
   --DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #tblStockLevels  
  
   --Select   
   -- StockItemFK, Batch, SpecialStockTypeFK, sum(ActualPallets) AS ActualPallets,   
   -- sum(AvailablePallets) AS AvailablePallets,   
   -- case when sum(ActualEaches) < 0 then -1 else sum(ActualEaches) End AS ActualEaches,   
   -- sum(ActualUnits) AS ActualUnits,   
   -- case when sum(AvailableEaches) < 0 then -1 else sum(AvailableEaches) End  AS AvailableEaches,  
   -- sum(AvailableUnits) AS AvailableUnits, case when sum(MixedContentCount) is null then   
   -- 0 else sum(MixedContentCount) end AS MixedContentCount,  
   -- 0 /*bit value*/ AS IsArchived, 1 AS InsertedBy, dbo.GetBSTDate() AS InsertedDate, 1 AS UpdatedBy,   
   -- dbo.GetBSTDate() AS UpdatedDate  
   --into   
   -- #tblStockLevels  
   --From  
   -- #tblStockLevels0 as sq   
   --Group By   
   -- StockItemFK, batch, SpecialStockTypeFK  
  
PRINT 'TEMP STOCK LEVEL TABLE CREATED'  
PRINT (CONVERT( VARCHAR(24), dbo.GetBSTDate(), 121))  
  
   -- Always attempt to begin a transaction before updating, inserting or deleting records in a permanent table  
   BEGIN TRANSACTION @varSQLTransactionName  
  
    SET @varSQLTransactionStarted = 1  
  
    TRUNCATE TABLE dbo.tblStockLevels  
  
    INSERT INTO dbo.tblStockLevels  
    --SELECT * FROM #tblStockLevels  
     Select   
      StockItemFK, Batch, SpecialStockTypeFK, sum(ActualPallets) AS ActualPallets,   
      sum(AvailablePallets) AS AvailablePallets,   
      case when sum(ActualEaches) < 0 then -1 else sum(ActualEaches) End AS ActualEaches,   
      sum(ActualUnits) AS ActualUnits,   
      case when sum(AvailableEaches) < 0 then -1 else sum(AvailableEaches) End  AS AvailableEaches,  
      sum(AvailableUnits) AS AvailableUnits, case when sum(MixedContentCount) is null then   
      0 else sum(MixedContentCount) end AS MixedContentCount,  
      0 /*bit value*/ AS IsArchived, 1 AS InsertedBy, dbo.GetBSTDate() AS InsertedDate, 1 AS UpdatedBy,   
      dbo.GetBSTDate() AS UpdatedDate  
     From  
      #tblStockLevels0 as sq   
     Group By   
      StockItemFK, batch, SpecialStockTypeFK  
      
    --set sync as complete  
    UPDATE dbo.appSystem WITH (ROWLOCK) SET RunStockLevelSync = 0  
  
   -- Always attempt to commit before returning  
   COMMIT TRANSACTION @varSQLTransactionName  
  
PRINT 'STOCK LEVEL TABLE UPDATED'  
PRINT (CONVERT( VARCHAR(24), dbo.GetBSTDate(), 121))  
  
   -- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end     
  
   BREAK  
  END TRY  
  BEGIN CATCH  
  
   /* Attempt to rollback the SQL transaction if one was started */  
   IF @varSQLTransactionStarted = 1  
   BEGIN  
    BEGIN TRY ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @varSQLTransactionName END TRY BEGIN CATCH /*Ignore and continue*/ END CATCH  
   END  
  
   DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME = dbo.GetBSTDate(), @ErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX) = ERROR_MESSAGE(), @ErrorSeverity INT = ERROR_SEVERITY(), @ErrorState INT = ERROR_STATE()  
              
   IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @varProcedureAndErrorDetailsID  
              
            IF @varProcedureAndErrorDetailsID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @varParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@varExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @ErrorMessage OUTPUT;  
              
   IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205/*Deadlock error*/ OR @varDeadlockErrorRetries > 2  
   BEGIN   
    SET @varDeadlockErrorRetries = 100  
    RAISERROR (@ErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState)  
    RETURN   
   END  
   ELSE   
    WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */  
  END CATCH  
  
  SET @varDeadlockErrorRetries = @varDeadlockErrorRetries + 1  
 END  
END  
GO

-- =============================================

-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spStockLevelsSync_Old]
(
	@stockItemFK int = -1,
	@batch nvarchar(200) = '',
	@containerOutFK int = -1
)
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT
	,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;
	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

	-- Exit this stored procedure if it is already executing.

	IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#IsStoredProcedureExecuting') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #IsStoredProcedureExecuting

	CREATE TABLE #IsStoredProcedureExecuting(Result BIT)

	INSERT INTO #IsStoredProcedureExecuting
	EXEC dbo.spIsStoredProcedureExecuting @ThisProcedureName

	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #IsStoredProcedureExecuting WHERE Result = 1) 
	BEGIN
		PRINT 'Exiting stored procedure spStockLevelsSync as it is already executing'
		RETURN 
	END

	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	DECLARE @stockItemFK2 int, @batch2 nvarchar(200), @containerOutFK2 int
	SET @stockItemFK2 = @stockItemFK; SET @batch2 = @batch; SET @containerOutFK2 = @containerOutFK

	SET @ParameterDetails = '@stockItemFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@stockItemFK2 AS NVARCHAR(100)),'0') + '@batch = ' + ISNULL(@batch2,'') 
		+ '@containerOutFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@containerOutFK2 AS NVARCHAR(100)),'0')

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    --BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

		SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END

	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY	

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start

			--this now does the stock levels anew every time
			--may write code to deal with ContainerOutFKs, StockItems and BAtch some time.. doesnt really save that much time right now
PRINT 'STARTING '
PRINT (CONVERT( VARCHAR(24), dbo.GetBSTDate(), 121))

			IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#tblTempPallets') IS NOT NULL
			   DROP TABLE #tblTempPallets

			SELECT DISTINCT
				p.PalletPK--, p.PalletStatusFK 
			INTO
				#tblTempPallets
			FROM 
				dbo.tblPallets as p
			inner join tblstockinlinepallets 
				on palletfk = palletpk
			inner join tblstockinlines 
				on stockinlinepk = stockinlinefk
			inner join tblstockins as si 
				on stockinfk = si.stockinpk
			inner join tblcontainerins as ci 
				on ci.containerinpk = si.containerinfk
			WHERE 
				p.IsArchived = 0 /*bit value*/ --AND p.PalletStatusFK <> 10 --pallet status of 10 (on route) no longer needed because we've checked stock in is completed
				AND ci.stockinstatusfk = 3 
PRINT 'PALLET TABLE CREATED'
PRINT (CONVERT( VARCHAR(24), dbo.GetBSTDate(), 121))
			CREATE INDEX #ndx1 ON #tblTempPallets(PalletPK)
PRINT 'PALLET TABLE INDEX CREATED'
PRINT (CONVERT( VARCHAR(24), dbo.GetBSTDate(), 121))
			IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#tblTempPalletContentPKs') IS NOT NULL
			   DROP TABLE #tblTempPalletContentPKs

			SELECT DISTINCT
				pc.PalletContentPK
			INTO
				#tblTempPalletContentPKs
			FROM 
				dbo.tblPalletContent AS pc
			inner join #tblTempPallets AS p 
				on pc.PalletFK = p.PalletPK
			Where 
				pc.IsArchived = 0 /*bit value*/ 
				AND pc.PalletFK <> -1
				AND (pc.AvailableUnits > 0 OR pc.actualunits > 0)
PRINT 'PALLET CONTENT PK TABLE CREATED'
PRINT (CONVERT( VARCHAR(24), dbo.GetBSTDate(), 121))
			CREATE INDEX #ndx2 ON #tblTempPalletContentPKs(PalletContentPK)
PRINT 'PALLET CONTENT PK TABLE INDEX CREATED'
PRINT (CONVERT( VARCHAR(24), dbo.GetBSTDate(), 121))
			IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#tblTempPalletContent') IS NOT NULL
			   DROP TABLE #tblTempPalletContent

			SELECT DISTINCT
				pc.PalletContentPK,
				pc.StockItemFK, 
				pc.Batch, 
				pc.SpecialStockTypeFK, 
				pc.ActualEaches, 
				pc.ActualUnits, 
				pc.AvailableEaches, 
				pc.AvailableUnits, 
				pc.PalletFK, 
				/*pc1.mixedcount*/ 1 AS MixedContentCount
			INTO
				#tblTempPalletContent
			FROM 
				dbo.tblPalletContent AS pc	
			inner join #tblTempPalletContentPKs as t
				on pc.PalletContentPK = t.PalletContentPK
PRINT 'PALLET CONTENT TABLE CREATED'
PRINT (CONVERT( VARCHAR(24), dbo.GetBSTDate(), 121))

			IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#tblStockLevelsNoPalletFKs') IS NOT NULL
			   DROP TABLE #tblStockLevelsNoPalletFKs

			Select 
				StockItemFK, Batch, SpecialStockTypeFK, 0 as ActualPallets, 0 as AvailablePallets, sum(ActualEaches) ActualEaches, 
				sum(ActualUnits) ActualUnits, sum(AvailableEaches) AvailableEaches, sum(AvailableUnits) AvailableUnits, 0 as MixedContentCount
			INTO 
				#tblStockLevelsNoPalletFKs
			from 
				dbo.tblPalletContent 
			Where 
				PalletFK = -1 AND IsArchived = 0 /*bit value*/
			Group By 
				StockItemFK, Batch, SpecialStockTypeFK
PRINT 'NO PALLET STOCK TABLE CREATED'
PRINT (CONVERT( VARCHAR(24), dbo.GetBSTDate(), 121))
			IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#tblStockLevels') IS NOT NULL
			   DROP TABLE #tblStockLevels

			Select 
				StockItemFK, Batch, SpecialStockTypeFK, sum(ActualPallets) AS ActualPallets, 
				sum(AvailablePallets) AS AvailablePallets, 
				case when sum(ActualEaches) < 0 then -1 else sum(ActualEaches) End AS ActualEaches, 
				sum(ActualUnits) AS ActualUnits, 
				case when sum(AvailableEaches) < 0 then -1 else sum(AvailableEaches) End  AS AvailableEaches,
				sum(AvailableUnits) AS AvailableUnits, case when sum(MixedContentCount) is null then 
				0 else sum(MixedContentCount) end AS MixedContentCount,
				0 /*bit value*/ AS IsArchived, 1 AS InsertedBy, dbo.GetBSTDate() AS InsertedDate, 1 AS UpdatedBy, 
				dbo.GetBSTDate() AS UpdatedDate
			into 
				#tblStockLevels
			From
				( 
					select * from #tblStockLevelsNoPalletFKs

					union

					Select 
						StockItemFK, Batch, SpecialStockTypeFK, 
						count(distinct (case when actualunits > 0 then PalletFK end)) as ActualPallets,
						count(distinct (case when availableunits > 0 then PalletFK end)) as AvailablePallets,
						sum(ActualEaches) ActualEaches, sum(ActualUnits) ActualUnits, sum(AvailableEaches) AvailableEaches, sum(AvailableUnits) AvailableUnits, MixedContentCount
					From 
						#tblTempPalletContent
					Group By 
						StockItemFK, Batch, SpecialStockTypeFK, MixedContentCount
				) as sq	
			Group By 
				StockItemFK, batch, SpecialStockTypeFK
PRINT 'TEMP STOCK LEVEL TABLE CREATED'
PRINT (CONVERT( VARCHAR(24), dbo.GetBSTDate(), 121))
			-- Always attempt to begin a transaction before updating, inserting or deleting records in a permanent table
			IF XACT_STATE() = 0 AND @@TRANCOUNT < 1 BEGIN TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName

				TRUNCATE TABLE dbo.tblStockLevels

				INSERT INTO dbo.tblStockLevels
				SELECT * FROM #tblStockLevels
				
				--set sync as complete
				UPDATE appSystem SET RunStockLevelSync = 0

			-- Always attempt to commit before returning
			BEGIN TRY IF XACT_STATE() = 1 AND @@TRANCOUNT = 1 AND @OpeningTranCount < 1 COMMIT TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH
PRINT 'STOCK LEVEL TABLE UPDATED'
PRINT (CONVERT( VARCHAR(24), dbo.GetBSTDate(), 121))
			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end			

			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END
GO

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spStockLevelsSyncNew]
(
	@stockItemFK int = -1,
	@batch nvarchar(200) = '',
	@containerOutFK int = -1
)
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT
	,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;
	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

	-- Exit this stored procedure if it is already executing.

	IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#IsStoredProcedureExecuting') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #IsStoredProcedureExecuting

	CREATE TABLE #IsStoredProcedureExecuting(Result BIT)

	INSERT INTO #IsStoredProcedureExecuting
	EXEC dbo.spIsStoredProcedureExecuting @ThisProcedureName

	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #IsStoredProcedureExecuting WHERE Result = 1) 
	BEGIN
		PRINT 'Exiting stored procedure spStockLevelsSync as it is already executing'
		RETURN 
	END

	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	DECLARE @stockItemFK2 int, @batch2 nvarchar(200), @containerOutFK2 int
	SET @stockItemFK2 = @stockItemFK; SET @batch2 = @batch; SET @containerOutFK2 = @containerOutFK

	SET @ParameterDetails = '@stockItemFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@stockItemFK2 AS NVARCHAR(100)),'0') + '@batch = ' + ISNULL(@batch2,'') 
		+ '@containerOutFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@containerOutFK2 AS NVARCHAR(100)),'0')

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    END

	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY	

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start

			--this now does the stock levels anew every time
			--may write code to deal with ContainerOutFKs, StockItems and BAtch some time.. doesnt really save that much time right now
PRINT 'STARTING '
PRINT (CONVERT( VARCHAR(24), dbo.GetBSTDate(), 121))

			IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#tblTempPallets') IS NOT NULL
			   DROP TABLE #tblTempPallets

				p.PalletPK--, p.PalletStatusFK 
			INTO

PRINT (CONVERT( VARCHAR(24), dbo.GetBSTDate(), 121))

			IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#tblTempPalletContent') IS NOT NULL

			   DROP TABLE #tblStockLevelsNoPalletFKs

				StockItemFK, Batch, SpecialStockTypeFK, 0 as ActualPallets, 0 as AvailablePallets, sum(ActualEaches) ActualEaches, 
				sum(ActualUnits) ActualUnits, sum(AvailableEaches) AvailableEaches, sum(AvailableUnits) AvailableUnits, 0 as MixedContentCount
			INTO 
				#tblStockLevelsNoPalletFKs
			from 
				#tblAllTempPalletContents 
			Where 
				PalletFK = -1 AND IsArchived = 0 /*bit value*/
			Group By 
				StockItemFK, Batch, SpecialStockTypeFK

PRINT 'NO PALLET STOCK TABLE CREATED'
PRINT (CONVERT( VARCHAR(24), dbo.GetBSTDate(), 121))

			IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#tblStockLevels') IS NOT NULL
			   DROP TABLE #tblStockLevels

			Select 
				StockItemFK, Batch, SpecialStockTypeFK, sum(ActualPallets) AS ActualPallets, 
				sum(AvailablePallets) AS AvailablePallets, 
				case when sum(ActualEaches) < 0 then -1 else sum(ActualEaches) End AS ActualEaches, 
				sum(ActualUnits) AS ActualUnits, 
				case when sum(AvailableEaches) < 0 then -1 else sum(AvailableEaches) End  AS AvailableEaches,
				sum(AvailableUnits) AS AvailableUnits, case when sum(MixedContentCount) is null then 
				0 else sum(MixedContentCount) end AS MixedContentCount,
				0 /*bit value*/ AS IsArchived, 1 AS InsertedBy, dbo.GetBSTDate() AS InsertedDate, 1 AS UpdatedBy, 
				dbo.GetBSTDate() AS UpdatedDate
			into 
				#tblStockLevels
			From
				( 
					select * from #tblStockLevelsNoPalletFKs

					union

					Select 
						StockItemFK, Batch, SpecialStockTypeFK, 
						count(distinct (case when actualunits > 0 then PalletFK end)) as ActualPallets,
						count(distinct (case when availableunits > 0 then PalletFK end)) as AvailablePallets,
						sum(ActualEaches) ActualEaches, sum(ActualUnits) ActualUnits, sum(AvailableEaches) AvailableEaches, sum(AvailableUnits) AvailableUnits, MixedContentCount
					From 
						#tblTempPalletContent
					Group By 
						StockItemFK, Batch, SpecialStockTypeFK, MixedContentCount
				) as sq	
			Group By 
				StockItemFK, batch, SpecialStockTypeFK
PRINT 'TEMP STOCK LEVEL TABLE CREATED'
PRINT (CONVERT( VARCHAR(24), dbo.GetBSTDate(), 121))
			-- Always attempt to begin a transaction before updating, inserting or deleting records in a permanent table
			IF XACT_STATE() = 0 AND @@TRANCOUNT < 1 BEGIN TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName

				TRUNCATE TABLE dbo.tblStockLevels

				INSERT INTO dbo.tblStockLevels
				SELECT * FROM #tblStockLevels
				
				--set sync as complete
				UPDATE appSystem SET RunStockLevelSync = 0

			-- Always attempt to commit before returning
			BEGIN TRY IF XACT_STATE() = 1 AND @@TRANCOUNT = 1 AND @OpeningTranCount < 1 COMMIT TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH
PRINT 'STOCK LEVEL TABLE UPDATED'
PRINT (CONVERT( VARCHAR(24), dbo.GetBSTDate(), 121))
			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end			

			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spStockOrderCheckAllWorkIsComplete]
(
	@stockOrderFK int
)
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT
	,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;
	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	DECLARE @var_stockOrderFK int

	SET @var_stockOrderFK = @stockOrderFK

	SET @ParameterDetails = '@stockOrderFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_stockOrderFK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'')

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    --BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

		SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END

	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY
			
			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start

			/* Check everything has been moved.
			   Note: this code checks for 2 things
					- checks for incomplete works order records (regardless of existing associated works order movement records).
					- checks for no works order records. 
			*/

			IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#TempStockOrder') IS NOT NULL
				DROP TABLE #TempStockOrder
			SELECT * INTO #TempStockOrder FROM dbo.tblStockOrders tso WHERE StockOrderPK = @var_stockOrderFK

			IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#TempContainerOut') IS NOT NULL
				DROP TABLE #TempContainerOut
			SELECT distinct tco.* INTO #TempContainerOut FROM dbo.tblContainerOuts tco INNER JOIN #TempStockOrder tso2 ON tco.ContainerOutPK = tso2.ContainerOutFK
						
			IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#TempContainerOutLines') IS NOT NULL
				DROP TABLE #TempContainerOutLines
			SELECT distinct tcol.* INTO #TempContainerOutLines FROM dbo.tblContainerOutLines tcol INNER JOIN #TempContainerOut tco2 ON tcol.ContainerOutFK = tco2.ContainerOutPK
						
			IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#TempContainerOutLinePalletContent') IS NOT NULL
				DROP TABLE #TempContainerOutLinePalletContent
			SELECT distinct tcolpc.* INTO #TempContainerOutLinePalletContent FROM dbo.tblContainerOutLinePalletContent tcolpc INNER JOIN #TempContainerOutLines tcol ON tcolpc.ContainerOutLineFK = tcol.ContainerOutLinePK
		
			declare @CheckPalletGroupings bit = 0
			select @CheckPalletGroupings = AllowPalletGroupingOnStockOut from tbldivisions inner join #TempContainerOutLines on DivisionFK = DivisionPK

			--check all works order status are complete if all movements are completed
			DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #tmpCheckWorksOrders
				SELECT distinct two.worksorderpk INTO #tmpCheckWorksOrders FROM dbo.tblWorksOrders two WHERE two.FK = @var_stockOrderFK AND two.WorksOrderOriginFK = 2/*StockOrder*/ AND two.WorksOrderTypeFK IN (3,16) AND two.worksorderstatusfk <> 3

			IF (exists(SELECT * FROM #tmpCheckWorksOrders))
			BEGIN
				IF ((Select count(*) from tblWorksOrderMovements wom INNER JOIN #tmpCheckWorksOrders two ON wom.WorksOrderFK = two.worksorderpk Where WorksOrderStatusFK not in (3,4)/*Complete or Cancelled*/) = 0)
				BEGIN  /*All pallet movements are complete, set the works order to complete*/				
					Update wo WITH (ROWLOCK)
					Set WorksOrderStatusFK = 3/*Complete*/
					FROM tblworksorders wo 
					INNER JOIN #tmpCheckWorksOrders two ON wo.WorksOrderPK = two.WorksOrderPK
				END
			END
						
			IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#TempWorksOrders') IS NOT NULL
				DROP TABLE #TempWorksOrders
			SELECT distinct two.* INTO #TempWorksOrders FROM dbo.tblWorksOrders two WHERE two.FK = @var_stockOrderFK AND two.WorksOrderOriginFK = 2/*StockOrder*/

			IF (exists(
					Select * 
					from #TempStockOrder sos
					inner join #TempContainerOut containerOuts ON containerOuts.ContainerOutPK = sos.ContainerOutFK
					inner join #TempContainerOutLines cols ON cols.ContainerOutFK = containerOuts.ContainerOutPK
					inner join #TempContainerOutLinePalletContent colpc ON colpc.ContainerOutLineFK = cols.ContainerOutLinePK
					left outer join #TempWorksOrders wos on wos.WorksOrderTypeFK = 3/*Movement*/ AND wos.FK = @var_stockOrderFK and wos.isarchived = 0
					--left outer join tblWorksOrderMovements woms on
					--woms.WorksOrderFK = wos.WorksOrderPK
					--AND woms.PalletContentFK = colpc.PalletContentFK	
					where StockOrderPK = @var_stockOrderFK 
						AND (
							wos.WorksOrderStatusFK <> 3 /*Incomplete works order records*/ 
							OR wos.WorksOrderStatusFK is NULL /*No works order records*/
						)
					)
				)
			BEGIN
				Print 'There are open, or no, works order movements'
				select cast(0 as bit) as Result, 'There are pending movements (Tab 3)' as Reason
				return
			END

			--check all physical checks are accepted
			if(exists(
				Select * 
				from #TempStockOrder sos
				inner join #TempWorksOrders wos on wos.WorksOrderOriginFK = 2/*StockOrder*/ AND wos.FK = @var_stockOrderFK AND wos.WorksOrderTypeFK in (15,19,20,21,22) --non movement
				inner join tblworksorderpallets wop on WorksOrderFk = WorksOrderPK
				inner join #TempContainerOutLinePalletContent colpc on colpc.palletfk = wop.palletfk
				inner join #TempContainerOutLines col on containeroutlinefk = containeroutlinepk and col.containeroutfk = sos.containeroutfk
				OUTER APPLY (
					SELECT TOP 1 worksOrderPalletResultPK, worksorderpalletFK, palletaccepted, UpdatedDate
					FROM tblworksorderpalletresult
					WHERE worksorderpalletFK = wop.WorksOrderPalletPK
					ORDER BY worksOrderPalletResultPK DESC
				) AS wopR
				Where sos.StockOrderPK = @var_stockOrderFK and (wopR.worksOrderPalletResultPK is null or wopR.palletaccepted < 1)))
			BEGIN
				Print 'There are physical checks not accepted'
				select cast(0 as bit) as Result, 'There are physical checks not accepted' as Reason
				return
			END

			--Check All other works Orders (non movement are complete or cancelled)
			if(exists(
				Select * 
				from #TempStockOrder sos
				inner join #TempWorksOrders wos on wos.WorksOrderOriginFK = 2/*StockOrder*/ AND wos.FK = @var_stockOrderFK  AND wos.WorksOrderTypeFK <> 3 /*non movement*/ AND wos.WorksOrderStatusFK < 3 --not complete(3) or cancelled(4)
				Where sos.StockOrderPK = @var_stockOrderFK
				)
			)
			BEGIN
				Print 'There are open works orders (non movement)'
				select cast(0 as bit) as Result, 'There are open works orders (Tab 4)' as Reason
				return
			END

			--check groupings have been set
			if(@CheckPalletGroupings=1)
			BEGIN

				declare @PalletCount int = (select count(distinct palletfk) from #TempContainerOutLinePalletContent)
				declare @GroupCount int = (select count(distinct palletfk) from tblContainerOutPalletGroups inner join #TempContainerOut on containeroutfk=  ContainerOutPK) 
				if(@PalletCount <> @GroupCount)
				BEGIN
					Print 'Pallet packing list groups not confirmed'
					select cast(0 as bit) as Result, 'Pallet packing list groups not confirmed (Tab 4)' as Reason
					return
				END
			END


			Declare @containerOutPK int, @containerOutTypeFK int
			Select @containerOutPK = ContainerOutFK, @containerOutTypeFK = ContainerOutTypeFK 
			from #TempStockOrder sos 
			inner join #TempContainerOut cOuts on cOuts.ContainerOutPK = sos.ContainerOutFK where StockOrderPK = @var_stockOrderFK

			if(@containerOutTypeFK = 2 /*Distribution*/) 
			BEGIN --You dont have to load distribution orders
				select cast(1 as bit) as Result, '' as Reason
				return
			END		

			if(EXISTS(
				Select *
				from #TempContainerOutLines cols 
				inner join #TempContainerOutLinePalletContent colpc ON colpc.ContainerOutLineFK = cols.ContainerOutLinePK
				where cols.ContainerOutFK = @containerOutPK
					AND colpc.Loaded = 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/
					AND (cols.Pallets > 0 OR cols.Eaches > 0 OR cols.Units > 0)	
				)
			) 
			BEGIN--There is still content that is not loaded
				Print 'There is pallet content that is not loaded'		
				select cast(0 as bit) as Result, 'There is pallet content that is not loaded (Tab 6)' as Reason
				return
			END 
			ELSE 
			BEGIN--All content is loaded
				select cast(1 as bit) as Result, '' as Reason
				return
			END
	
			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end
						
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END
GO

-- =============================================
