CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spStockOrderCheckOrderAmountsAreOK]
(
	@stockItemFK int,
	@batch nvarchar(200),
	@pallets int,
	@units decimal,
	@eaches decimal,
	@palletFK int = -1
)
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT
 ,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;
	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	DECLARE @var_stockItemFK int, @var_batch nvarchar(200), @var_pallets int, @var_units decimal(18,0), @var_eaches decimal(18,0), @var_palletFK int

	SET @var_stockItemFK = @stockItemFK; SET @var_batch = @batch; SET @var_pallets = @pallets; SET @var_units = @units; SET @var_eaches = @eaches; SET @var_palletFK = @palletFK

	SET @ParameterDetails = '@stockItemFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_stockItemFK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@batch = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_batch AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') 
		+ ',@pallets = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_pallets AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@units = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_units AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') 
			+ ',@eaches = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_eaches AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@palletFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_palletFK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'')

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    --BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

		SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END


	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY			

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start

			/*ReturnCode
				0= We are good to go
				> 0 We have a problem, relay the accompanying message
			*/

			Declare @returnCode int, @message nvarchar(1000)
			Select @returnCode = 0, @message = ''

			Declare @checkAgainstSplitEaches int, @checkAgainstSplitPallets int
			Declare @palletIsEaches int
			Declare @divisionFK int, @customerFK int
	
			Select @returnCode = 
				Case when @var_pallets > 0 then
					case when @var_pallets <= AvailablePallets then 0 else 1 end
				when @var_units > 0 then
					case when @var_units <= AvailableUnits then 0 else 1 end
				when @var_eaches > 0 then
					case when @var_eaches <= AvailableEaches then 0 else 1 end
				else
					1
				END,
				@message = 
				Case when @var_pallets > 0 then
					case when @var_pallets <= AvailablePallets then '' else 'There are not enough pallets to fulfil your requirement. There are ' 
					+ cast(AvailablePallets as nvarchar(100)) + ' pallets available' end
				when @var_units > 0 then
					case when @var_units <= AvailableUnits then '' else 'There are not enough units to fulfil your requirement. There are ' 
					+ cast(AvailableUnits as nvarchar(100)) + ' units available' end 
				when @var_eaches > 0 then
					case when @var_eaches <= AvailableEaches then '' else 'There are not enough eaches to fulfil your requirement. There are ' 
					+ cast(AvailableEaches as nvarchar(100)) + ' eaches available' end
				else
					'You have not entered an amount for Pallets, Units or Eaches'
				END
			From tblStockLevels
			Where StockItemFK = @var_stockItemFK AND Batch = @var_batch

			if(@returnCode <> 0) BEGIN
				Select @returnCode ReturnCode, @message ReturnMessage
				RETURN
			END

			if(@var_pallets > 0) BEGIN --If we are checking against pallets, exit now as there will be no splitting
				Select @returnCode ReturnCode, @message ReturnMessage
				RETURN
			END
	
			--Set what we should check for
			Select @checkAgainstSplitEaches = 
				case when sis.AllowSplitEaches = 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/ AND EachesTypeFK > 0 AND AllowSplitPallets = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ then 1
				else 0 end,
			@checkAgainstSplitPallets = 
				case when sis.AllowSplitPallets = 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/ then 1 when sis.AllowSplitPallets = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ then 0 
				when sis.AllowSplitEaches = 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/ AND EachesTypeFK > 0 then 1 else 0 end,
			@customerFK = divisions.CustomerFK, @divisionFK = divisions.DivisionPK,
			@palletIsEaches = case when EachesTypeFK > 0 then 1 else 0 end
			from tblStockItems sis
			inner join tblDivisions divisions on
			divisions.DivisionPK = sis.DivisionFK
			inner join tblCustomers customers on
			customers.CustomerPK = divisions.customerFK
			where StockItemPK = @var_stockItemFK

			Print 'Checks'
			Print @checkAgainstSplitEaches
			Print @checkAgainstSplitPallets

			Declare @runningTotal decimal, @availableUnits decimal, @availableEaches decimal, @split int
			Declare @distinctQuantities int, @currentQuantity decimal, @quantityCounter int, @resetQuantityCounterTo int
			Declare @isDistinctQuantitiesRemaining int
			Declare @possibilitiesExhausted int
			Declare @inTheSameQuantity int
			Declare @resetTo int, @lastReset int, @cursorCounter int, @onRun int, @resetRunningTotal decimal, @sectionResetRunningTotal decimal
			--Specific Each Check variables
			Declare @distinctEachQuantities int, @eachQuantityCounter int, @currentEachQuantity decimal

			Declare @closestLowerQuantity decimal, @closestHigherQuantity decimal

			Declare @receiverTypeFK int, @receiverFK int, @autoPickRuleTypeFK int, @valueFK int
			Declare @sql nvarchar(MAX), @ruleSql nvarchar(MAX), @extraFieldSql nvarchar(MAX)
			Declare @isExplicitDateSearch int
			Declare @date datetime, @currentDate datetime
			Declare @skippedContent int
			Declare @numberOfCursorRows int
	
			IF(@checkAgainstSplitEaches = 1) 
			BEGIN --CHECK AGAINST Each SPLITTING 
				Select @distinctQuantities = count(*) from ( Select Distinct StockItemFK, Batch, AvailableUnits from tblPalletContent
				Where StockItemFK = @var_stockItemFK AND Batch = @var_batch AND AvailableUnits <> 0
				Group By StockItemFK, Batch, AvailableUnits ) subQ

				Select @quantityCounter = 0, @currentQuantity = 0, @resetQuantityCounterTo = 0, @runningTotal = 0
				Set @split = 1  --We assume we are going to have to split the eaches until the code finds a matching totals and sets the flag to say otherwise
				Select @possibilitiesExhausted = 0, @resetTo = 0, @resetRunningTotal = 0 --For Explicit Date Rules Only
				Select @lastReset = 0, @cursorCounter = 0, @onRun = 0
				Select @closestLowerQuantity = 0, @closestHigherQuantity = 0
				Set @sectionResetRunningTotal  = 0
		
				Select @receiverTypeFK = MAX(AutoPickRuleReceiverTypeFK) from tblAutoPickRules aprs 
				Where (AutoPickRuleReceiverTypeFK = 1 AND AutoPickRuleReceiverFK = @customerFK)
				OR (AutoPickRuleReceiverTypeFK = 2 AND AutoPickRuleReceiverFK = @divisionFK)
				OR (AutoPickRuleReceiverTypeFK = 3 AND AutoPickRuleReceiverFK = @var_stockItemFK)

				Set @autoPickRuleTypeFK = 0
				Set @isExplicitDateSearch = 0
				Select @autoPickRuleTypeFK = AutoPickRuleTypeFK, @valueFK = ValueFK
				From tblAutoPickRules
				Where AutoPickRuleReceiverTypeFK = @receiverTypeFK
				AND AutoPickRuleReceiverFK = 
					(case @receiverTypeFK when 1 then @customerFK 
						when 2 then @divisionFK
						when 3 then @var_stockItemFK end)
				AND AutoPickRuleTypeFK in (6,7,8,9) /*DateTypesOnly*/
				AND IsExplicit = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/

				Print 'AutoRuleType'
				Print @autoPickRuleTypeFK
				If(@autoPickRuleTypeFK > 0) Set @isExplicitDateSearch = 1

				Select @ruleSql = 
				case @autoPickRuleTypeFK when 0 then
					' AvailableUnits Desc '
				when 6 then
					' ExpiryDate ' + case @valueFK when 1 then ' ASC ' when 2 then ' DESC ' else ' ASC ' end + ', AvailableUnits Desc '
				when 7 then
					' DateOfManufacture ' + case @valueFK when 1 then ' ASC ' when 2 then ' DESC ' else ' ASC ' end + ', AvailableUnits Desc '
				when 8 then
					' BestBefore ' + case @valueFK when 1 then ' ASC ' when 2 then ' DESC ' else ' ASC ' end + ', AvailableUnits Desc '
				when 9 then
					' DateOfReceipt ' + case @valueFK when 1 then ' ASC ' when 2 then ' DESC ' else ' ASC ' end + ', AvailableUnits Desc '
				else
					' AvailableUnits Desc '
				End,
				@extraFieldSql = 
				case @autoPickRuleTypeFK when 0 then
					' ExpiryDate '
				when 6 then
					' ExpiryDate '
				when 7 then
					' DateOfManufacture '
				when 8 then
					' BestBefore ' 
				when 9 then
					' DateOfReceipt ' 
				else
					' ExpiryDate '
				End

				Print 'here'
				IF(@palletIsEaches = 1) 
				BEGIN
					Print 'PalletIsEaches'
					IF(@var_eaches > 0) 
					BEGIN
						Set @sql = 
						'DECLARE pallet_cursor SCROLL CURSOR FOR
						SELECT count(*) AvailableUnits, ' + @extraFieldSql + '
						FROM tblPalletContent pc
						inner join tblPallets pallets on
						pallets.PalletPK = pc.PalletFK
						Where StockItemFK = ' + cast(@var_stockItemFK as nvarchar(100)) + 
						' AND Batch = ''' + @var_batch + ''' AND pallets.PalletStatusFK = 1'/*Available*/ +
						' Group by PalletPK, ' + @extraFieldSql + 
						' Order By ' + @ruleSql 
						Set @var_units = @var_eaches --I know this is ugly but set the units to the eaches so following code will work as if units
					END 
					ELSE 
					BEGIN
						Set @sql = 
						'DECLARE pallet_cursor SCROLL CURSOR FOR
						SELECT AvailableUnits, ' + @extraFieldSql + '
						FROM tblPalletContent pc
						inner join tblPallets pallets on
						pallets.PalletPK = pc.PalletFK
						Where StockItemFK = ' + cast(@var_stockItemFK as nvarchar(100)) + 
						' AND Batch = ''' + @var_batch + ''' AND pallets.PalletStatusFK = 1'/*Available*/ +
						--' Group by PalletPK, ' + @extraFieldSql + 
						' Order By ' + @ruleSql
					END
				END ELSE BEGIN
					Set @sql = 
					'DECLARE pallet_cursor SCROLL CURSOR FOR
					SELECT AvailableUnits, ' + @extraFieldSql + '
					FROM tblPalletContent pc
					inner join tblPallets pallets on
					pallets.PalletPK = pc.PalletFK
					Where StockItemFK = ' + cast(@var_stockItemFK as nvarchar(100)) + 
					' AND Batch = ''' + @var_batch + ''' AND pallets.PalletStatusFK = 1'/*Available*/ +
					' Order By ' + @ruleSql 
				END

				print @sql
				exec sp_executesql @sql

				OPEN pallet_cursor
				Set @numberOfCursorRows = @@CURSOR_ROWS

				FETCH NEXT FROM pallet_cursor INTO @availableUnits, @date

				WHILE (@possibilitiesExhausted = 0)	
				BEGIN
					set @cursorCounter = @cursorCounter + 1
					PRINT 'RUNNING TOTAL ' + cast(@runningTotal as nvarchar(50))
					IF(@currentQuantity <> @availableUnits AND @isExplicitDateSearch = 0) 
					BEGIN
						Set @currentQuantity = @availableUnits
						Set @quantityCounter = @quantityCounter + 1
						IF(@onRun = 0) 
						BEGIN
							Print 'START/RESET RUN'
							Set @onRun = 1
						END	ELSE IF(@onRun = 1)	
						BEGIN
							Set @onRun = 2
							Set @resetTo = @cursorCounter
							Set @resetQuantityCounterTo = @resetQuantityCounterTo + 1
						END
					END
					IF(@isExplicitDateSearch = 1)
					BEGIN
						Set @currentDate = @date
						IF(@onRun = 0) 
						BEGIN
							Print 'START/RESET RUN'
							Set @onRun = 1
						END	ELSE IF(@onRun = 1)	
						BEGIN
							Set @onRun = 2
							Set @resetTo = @cursorCounter
							Set @resetRunningTotal = @runningTotal
							PRINT 'RESET RUNNING TOTAL'
							Print @resetRunningTotal
						END
					END

					IF(@runningTotal + @availableUnits = @var_units) 
					BEGIN --FOUND A POSSIBLE PICK
						PRINT 'TARGET MATCH AvUnits ' + cast(@availableUnits as nvarchar(50))
						Set @possibilitiesExhausted = 1
						Set @returnCode  = 0
						Set @message = 'OK'
					END	ELSE IF(@runningTotal + @availableUnits < @var_units) 
					BEGIN
						Print 'BUILDING PICK AvUnits ' + cast(@availableUnits as nvarchar(50)) 
						Set @runningTotal = @runningTotal + @availableUnits
						IF(@runningTotal > @closestLowerQuantity) Set @closestLowerQuantity = @runningTotal
						IF(@isExplicitDateSearch = 1) Set @skippedContent = 0	

						FETCH NEXT FROM pallet_cursor --have to fetch again within loop
						INTO @availableUnits, @date
						IF(@isExplicitDateSearch = 1) 
						BEGIN
							IF(@currentDate <> @date) 
							BEGIN
								Print 'MOVED DATE WHILE BUILDING'
								Select @currentDate = @date, @onRun = 0
								Set @resetRunningTotal = @runningTotal
								Set @resetTo = @cursorCounter + 1
								Set @sectionResetRunningTotal = @runningTotal
							END
						END

						IF(@@FETCH_STATUS <> 0 AND @resetQuantityCounterTo + 1 = @distinctQuantities AND @isExplicitDateSearch = 0) 
						BEGIN
							Set @possibilitiesExhausted = 1
							Select @returnCode = 1, @message = 'Your requirement can not be fulfilled with stock available. Closest possible quantities are ' 
							+ cast(@closestLowerQuantity as nvarchar(50)) + ' and ' + cast(@closestHigherQuantity as nvarchar(50))
						END
					END	
					ELSE 
					BEGIN  --BUST
						Print 'BUST AvUnits ' + cast(@availableUnits as nvarchar(50))
						if(@runningTotal + @availableUnits < @closestHigherQuantity OR @closestHigherQuantity = 0) Set @closestHigherQuantity = @runningTotal + @availableUnits
				
						IF(@isExplicitDateSearch = 0) 
						BEGIN
							IF(@quantityCounter >= @distinctQuantities)	
							BEGIN
								print 'NO MORE SMALLER QUANTITIES'
								IF(@lastReset <> @resetTo )	
								BEGIN
									Print 'HAVE TRIED ALL QUANTITIES'
									Set @cursorCounter = @resetTo - 1
									Set @onRun = 0
									Set @currentQuantity = 0
									Set @quantityCounter = @resetQuantityCounterTo
									Set @runningTotal = 0
									FETCH ABSOLUTE @resetTo FROM pallet_cursor --have to fetch again within loop
									INTO @availableUnits, @date
									Set @lastReset = @resetTo
								END	
								ELSE 
								BEGIN
									Print 'Exit2'
									Set @possibilitiesExhausted = 1
									Select @returnCode = 1, @message = 'Your requirement can not be fulfilled with stock available. Closest possible quantities are ' 
									+ cast(@closestLowerQuantity as nvarchar(50)) + ' and ' + cast(@closestHigherQuantity as nvarchar(50))
								END
							END	
							ELSE 
							BEGIN
								print 'May find smaller quantity - Get next Quantity'
								FETCH NEXT FROM pallet_cursor --have to fetch again within loop
								INTO @availableUnits, @date
							END
						END
						ELSE 
						BEGIN	
							print 'May find smaller quantity - Get next Quantity'
							FETCH NEXT FROM pallet_cursor --have to fetch again within loop
							INTO @availableUnits, @date

							IF(@currentDate <> @date) 
							BEGIN --We have bust and the date has changed
								Print 'EXIT 6'
								Set @possibilitiesExhausted = 1
								Select @returnCode = 1, @message = 'Your requirement can not be fulfilled with stock available. Closest possible quantities are ' 
								+ cast(@closestLowerQuantity as nvarchar(50)) + ' and ' + cast(@closestHigherQuantity as nvarchar(50))
							END	
							ELSE 
							BEGIN
								Set @cursorCounter = @resetTo 
								Set @onRun = 0
						
								IF(@@FETCH_STATUS <> 0) 
								BEGIN
									FETCH ABSOLUTE @resetTo FROM pallet_cursor --have to fetch again within loop
									INTO @availableUnits, @date
									Set @lastReset = @resetTo
									Print @resetTo
									FETCH ABSOLUTE @resetTo FROM pallet_cursor --have to fetch again within loop
									INTO @availableUnits, @date
									Set @resetTo = @resetTo + 1
									Set @currentDate = @date
									Set @onRun = 2
									Set @runningTotal = @sectionResetRunningTotal 
									PRINT 'BUST RESET'
									Print @runningTotal
									Print @resetTo

									IF(@numberOfCursorRows = @resetTo) 
									BEGIN
										Set @possibilitiesExhausted = 1
										Select @returnCode = 1, @message = 'Your requirement can not be fulfilled with stock available. Closest possible quantities are ' 
										+ cast(@closestLowerQuantity as nvarchar(50)) + ' and ' + cast(@closestHigherQuantity as nvarchar(50))
									END
								END
							END
							Set @skippedContent = 1
						END
					END

					IF(@inTheSameQuantity = 1) 
					BEGIN
						Print 'SKIP SAME QUANTITY PALLETS'
						WHILE(@currentQuantity = @availableUnits AND @@FETCH_STATUS = 0) 
						BEGIN
							FETCH NEXT FROM pallet_cursor --have to fetch again within loop
							INTO @availableUnits, @date
							Set @cursorCounter = @cursorCounter + 1
						END

						IF(@@FETCH_STATUS <> 0)	
						BEGIN
							Set @possibilitiesExhausted = 1
						END 
						ELSE 
						BEGIN
							Set @runningTotal = 0
							WHILE (@runningTotal < @var_units) 
							BEGIN
								FETCH PRIOR FROM pallet_cursor --have to fetch again within loop
								INTO @availableUnits, @date
								Set @runningTotal = @runningTotal + @availableUnits
								Set @cursorCounter = @cursorCounter - 1
							END
							FETCH NEXT FROM pallet_cursor --have to fetch again within loop
							INTO @availableUnits
							Select @runningTotal = 0, @inTheSameQuantity = 0
						END	
					END
				END
				CLOSE pallet_cursor
				DEALLOCATE pallet_cursor
			END 
			ELSE IF(@checkAgainstSplitPallets = 1) 
			BEGIN --CHECK AGAINST PALLETS SPLITTING (for each pallets also)
				Select @distinctQuantities = count(*) from ( Select Distinct StockItemFK, Batch, AvailableUnits from tblPalletContent
				Where StockItemFK = @var_stockItemFK AND Batch = @var_batch AND AvailableUnits <> 0
				Group By StockItemFK, Batch, AvailableUnits ) subQ

				Select @quantityCounter = 0, @currentQuantity = 0, @resetQuantityCounterTo = 0, @runningTotal = 0
				Set @split = 1  --We assume we are going to have to split the eaches until the code finds a matching totals and sets the flag to say otherwise
				Select @possibilitiesExhausted = 0, @resetTo = 0, @resetRunningTotal = 0 --For Explicit Date Rules Only
				Select @lastReset = 0, @cursorCounter = 0, @onRun = 0
				Select @closestLowerQuantity = 0, @closestHigherQuantity = 0
				Set @sectionResetRunningTotal  = 0
		
				Select @receiverTypeFK = MAX(AutoPickRuleReceiverTypeFK) from tblAutoPickRules aprs 
				Where (AutoPickRuleReceiverTypeFK = 1 AND AutoPickRuleReceiverFK = @customerFK)
				OR (AutoPickRuleReceiverTypeFK = 2 AND AutoPickRuleReceiverFK = @divisionFK)
				OR (AutoPickRuleReceiverTypeFK = 3 AND AutoPickRuleReceiverFK = @var_stockItemFK)

				Set @autoPickRuleTypeFK = 0
				Set @isExplicitDateSearch = 0
				Select @autoPickRuleTypeFK = AutoPickRuleTypeFK, @valueFK = ValueFK
				From tblAutoPickRules
				Where AutoPickRuleReceiverTypeFK = @receiverTypeFK
				AND AutoPickRuleReceiverFK = 
					(case @receiverTypeFK when 1 then @customerFK 
						when 2 then @divisionFK
						when 3 then @var_stockItemFK end)
				AND AutoPickRuleTypeFK in (6,7,8,9) /*DateTypesOnly*/
				AND IsExplicit = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/

				Print 'AutoRuleType'
				Print @autoPickRuleTypeFK
				If(@autoPickRuleTypeFK > 0) Set @isExplicitDateSearch = 1

				Select @ruleSql = 
				case @autoPickRuleTypeFK when 0 then
					' AvailableUnits Desc '
				when 6 then
					' ExpiryDate ' + case @valueFK when 1 then ' ASC ' when 2 then ' DESC ' else ' ASC ' end + ', AvailableUnits Desc '
				when 7 then
					' DateOfManufacture ' + case @valueFK when 1 then ' ASC ' when 2 then ' DESC ' else ' ASC ' end + ', AvailableUnits Desc '
				when 8 then
					' BestBefore ' + case @valueFK when 1 then ' ASC ' when 2 then ' DESC ' else ' ASC ' end + ', AvailableUnits Desc '
				when 9 then
					' DateOfReceipt ' + case @valueFK when 1 then ' ASC ' when 2 then ' DESC ' else ' ASC ' end + ', AvailableUnits Desc '
				else
					' AvailableUnits Desc '
				End,
				@extraFieldSql = 
				case @autoPickRuleTypeFK when 0 then
					' ExpiryDate '
				when 6 then
					' ExpiryDate '
				when 7 then
					' DateOfManufacture '
				when 8 then
					' BestBefore ' 
				when 9 then
					' DateOfReceipt ' 
				else
					' ExpiryDate '
				End

				Print 'here'
				IF(@palletIsEaches = 1) 
				BEGIN
					Print 'PalletIsEaches'
					IF(@var_eaches > 0) 
					BEGIN
						Set @sql = 
						'DECLARE pallet_cursor SCROLL CURSOR FOR
						SELECT count(*) AvailableUnits, ' + @extraFieldSql + '
						FROM tblPalletContent pc
						inner join tblPallets pallets on
						pallets.PalletPK = pc.PalletFK
						Where StockItemFK = ' + cast(@var_stockItemFK as nvarchar(100)) + 
						' AND Batch = ''' + @var_batch + ''' AND pallets.PalletStatusFK = 1'/*Available*/ +
						' Group by PalletPK, ' + @extraFieldSql + 
						' Order By ' + @ruleSql 
						Set @var_units = @var_eaches --I know this is ugly but set the units to the eaches so following code will work as if units
					END 
					ELSE 
					BEGIN
						Set @sql = 
						'DECLARE pallet_cursor SCROLL CURSOR FOR
						SELECT sum(AvailableUnits) AvailableUnits, ' + @extraFieldSql + '
						FROM tblPalletContent pc
						inner join tblPallets pallets on
						pallets.PalletPK = pc.PalletFK
						Where StockItemFK = ' + cast(@var_stockItemFK as nvarchar(100)) + 
						' AND Batch = ''' + @var_batch + ''' AND pallets.PalletStatusFK = 1'/*Available*/ +
						' Group by PalletPK, ' + @extraFieldSql + 
						' Order By ' + @ruleSql
					END
				END 
				ELSE 
				BEGIN
					Set @sql = 
					'DECLARE pallet_cursor SCROLL CURSOR FOR
					SELECT AvailableUnits, ' + @extraFieldSql + '
					FROM tblPalletContent pc
					inner join tblPallets pallets on
					pallets.PalletPK = pc.PalletFK
					Where StockItemFK = ' + cast(@var_stockItemFK as nvarchar(100)) + 
					' AND Batch = ''' + @var_batch + ''' AND pallets.PalletStatusFK = 1'/*Available*/ +
					' Order By ' + @ruleSql 
				END

				print @sql
				exec sp_executesql @sql

				OPEN pallet_cursor
				Set @numberOfCursorRows = @@CURSOR_ROWS

				FETCH NEXT FROM pallet_cursor INTO @availableUnits, @date

				WHILE (@possibilitiesExhausted = 0)	BEGIN
					set @cursorCounter = @cursorCounter + 1
					PRINT 'RUNNING TOTAL ' + cast(@runningTotal as nvarchar(50))
					IF(@currentQuantity <> @availableUnits AND @isExplicitDateSearch = 0) BEGIN
						Set @currentQuantity = @availableUnits
						Set @quantityCounter = @quantityCounter + 1
						IF(@onRun = 0) 
						BEGIN
							Print 'START/RESET RUN'
							Set @onRun = 1
						END	ELSE IF(@onRun = 1)	
						BEGIN
							Set @onRun = 2
							Set @resetTo = @cursorCounter
							Set @resetQuantityCounterTo = @resetQuantityCounterTo + 1
						END
					END
					IF(@isExplicitDateSearch = 1)
					BEGIN
						Set @currentDate = @date
						IF(@onRun = 0) 
						BEGIN
							Print 'START/RESET RUN'
							Set @onRun = 1
						END	ELSE IF(@onRun = 1)	
						BEGIN
							Set @onRun = 2
							Set @resetTo = @cursorCounter
							Set @resetRunningTotal = @runningTotal
							PRINT 'RESET RUNNING TOTAL'
							Print @resetRunningTotal
						END
					END

					IF(@runningTotal + @availableUnits = @var_units) 
					BEGIN --FOUND A POSSIBLE PICK
						PRINT 'TARGET MATCH AvUnits ' + cast(@availableUnits as nvarchar(50))
						Set @possibilitiesExhausted = 1
						Set @returnCode  = 0
						Set @message = 'OK'
					END	ELSE IF(@runningTotal + @availableUnits < @var_units) 
					BEGIN
						Print 'BUILDING PICK AvUnits ' + cast(@availableUnits as nvarchar(50)) 
						Set @runningTotal = @runningTotal + @availableUnits
						IF(@runningTotal > @closestLowerQuantity) Set @closestLowerQuantity = @runningTotal
						IF(@isExplicitDateSearch = 1) Set @skippedContent = 0	

						FETCH NEXT FROM pallet_cursor --have to fetch again within loop
						INTO @availableUnits, @date
						IF(@isExplicitDateSearch = 1) 
						BEGIN
							IF(@currentDate <> @date) 
							BEGIN
								Print 'MOVED DATE WHILE BUILDING'
								Select @currentDate = @date, @onRun = 0
								Set @resetRunningTotal = @runningTotal
								Set @resetTo = @cursorCounter + 1
								Set @sectionResetRunningTotal = @runningTotal
							END
						END
						IF(@@FETCH_STATUS <> 0 AND @resetQuantityCounterTo + 1 = @distinctQuantities AND @isExplicitDateSearch = 0) 
						BEGIN
							Set @possibilitiesExhausted = 1
							Select @returnCode = 1, @message = 'Your requirement can not be fulfilled with stock available. Closest possible quantities are ' 
							+ cast(@closestLowerQuantity as nvarchar(50)) + ' and ' + cast(@closestHigherQuantity as nvarchar(50))
						END
					END	
					ELSE 
					BEGIN  --BUST
						Print 'BUST AvUnits ' + cast(@availableUnits as nvarchar(50))
						if(@runningTotal + @availableUnits < @closestHigherQuantity OR @closestHigherQuantity = 0) Set @closestHigherQuantity = @runningTotal + @availableUnits
				
						IF(@isExplicitDateSearch = 0) 
						BEGIN
							IF(@quantityCounter >= @distinctQuantities)	
							BEGIN
								print 'NO MORE SMALLER QUANTITIES'
								IF(@lastReset <> @resetTo )	
								BEGIN
									Print 'HAVE TRIED ALL QUANTITIES'
									Set @cursorCounter = @resetTo - 1
									Set @onRun = 0
									Set @currentQuantity = 0
									Set @quantityCounter = @resetQuantityCounterTo
									Set @runningTotal = 0
									FETCH ABSOLUTE @resetTo FROM pallet_cursor --have to fetch again within loop
									INTO @availableUnits, @date
									Set @lastReset = @resetTo
								END	
								ELSE 
								BEGIN
									Print 'Exit2'
									Set @possibilitiesExhausted = 1
									Select @returnCode = 1, @message = 'Your requirement can not be fulfilled with stock available. Closest possible quantities are ' 
									+ cast(@closestLowerQuantity as nvarchar(50)) + ' and ' + cast(@closestHigherQuantity as nvarchar(50))
								END
							END	
							ELSE 
							BEGIN
								print 'May find smaller quantity - Get next Quantity'
								FETCH NEXT FROM pallet_cursor --have to fetch again within loop
								INTO @availableUnits, @date
							END
						END
						ELSE 
						BEGIN	
							print 'May find smaller quantity - Get next Quantity'
							FETCH NEXT FROM pallet_cursor --have to fetch again within loop
							INTO @availableUnits, @date

							IF(@currentDate <> @date) 
							BEGIN --We have bust and the date has changed
								Print 'EXIT 6'
								Set @possibilitiesExhausted = 1
								Select @returnCode = 1, @message = 'Your requirement can not be fulfilled with stock available. Closest possible quantities are ' 
								+ cast(@closestLowerQuantity as nvarchar(50)) + ' and ' + cast(@closestHigherQuantity as nvarchar(50))
							END	
							ELSE 
							BEGIN
								Set @cursorCounter = @resetTo 
								Set @onRun = 0
						
								IF(@@FETCH_STATUS <> 0) 
								BEGIN
									FETCH ABSOLUTE @resetTo FROM pallet_cursor --have to fetch again within loop
									INTO @availableUnits, @date
									Set @lastReset = @resetTo
									Print @resetTo
									FETCH ABSOLUTE @resetTo FROM pallet_cursor --have to fetch again within loop
									INTO @availableUnits, @date
									Set @resetTo = @resetTo + 1
									Set @currentDate = @date
									Set @onRun = 2
									Set @runningTotal = @sectionResetRunningTotal 
									PRINT 'BUST RESET'
									Print @runningTotal
									Print @resetTo
									IF(@numberOfCursorRows = @resetTo) 
									BEGIN
										Set @possibilitiesExhausted = 1
										Select @returnCode = 1, @message = 'Your requirement can not be fulfilled with stock available. Closest possible quantities are ' 
										+ cast(@closestLowerQuantity as nvarchar(50)) + ' and ' + cast(@closestHigherQuantity as nvarchar(50))
									END
								END
							END
							Set @skippedContent = 1
						END
					END
					IF(@inTheSameQuantity = 1) 
					BEGIN
						Print 'SKIP SAME QUANTITY PALLETS'
						WHILE(@currentQuantity = @availableUnits AND @@FETCH_STATUS = 0) 
						BEGIN
							FETCH NEXT FROM pallet_cursor --have to fetch again within loop
							INTO @availableUnits, @date
							Set @cursorCounter = @cursorCounter + 1
						END
						IF(@@FETCH_STATUS <> 0)	
						BEGIN
							Set @possibilitiesExhausted = 1
						END 
						ELSE 
						BEGIN
							Set @runningTotal = 0
							WHILE (@runningTotal < @var_units) 
							BEGIN
								FETCH PRIOR FROM pallet_cursor --have to fetch again within loop
								INTO @availableUnits, @date
								Set @runningTotal = @runningTotal + @availableUnits
								Set @cursorCounter = @cursorCounter - 1
							END
							FETCH NEXT FROM pallet_cursor --have to fetch again within loop
							INTO @availableUnits
							Select @runningTotal = 0, @inTheSameQuantity = 0
						END	
					END
				END
				CLOSE pallet_cursor
				DEALLOCATE pallet_cursor
		
			END 
			ELSE IF (@var_palletFK > 0) 
			BEGIN--END CHECK AGAINST PALLETS
			-- PALLET CHECK
				IF(@var_units >= (Select sum(AvailableUnits) from tblPalletContent where PalletFK = @var_palletFK))
				BEGIN
					Set @split = 0
				END
				ELSE
				BEGIN
					Select @distinctEachQuantities = count(*) from tblPalletContent
					Where PalletFK = @var_palletFK AND StockItemFK = @var_stockItemFK AND Batch = @var_batch AND AvailableUnits <> 0
					Group By StockItemFK, Batch, AvailableUnits 

					Set @eachQuantityCounter = 0
					Set @currentEachQuantity = 0
					Set @runningTotal = 0
					Set @split = 1  --We assume we are going to have to split the eaches until the code finds a matching totals and sets the flag to say otherwise
					Set @isDistinctQuantitiesRemaining = 1

					DECLARE each_cursor CURSOR FAST_FORWARD
					FOR
					SELECT AvailableUnits
					FROM tblPalletContent
					Where PalletFK = @var_palletFK AND StockItemFK = @var_stockItemFK
					AND Batch = @var_batch
					Order By AvailableUnits Desc

					OPEN each_cursor

					FETCH NEXT FROM each_cursor INTO @availableUnits

					WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 AND @split = 1 AND @isDistinctQuantitiesRemaining = 1
					BEGIN
						IF(@currentEachQuantity <> @availableUnits)
						BEGIN
							Set @currentEachQuantity = @availableUnits
							Set @eachQuantityCounter = @eachQuantityCounter + 1
						END
						IF(@runningTotal + @availableUnits = @var_units)
						BEGIN --DONE
							set @split = 0
						END
						ELSE IF(@runningTotal + @availableUnits < @var_units)
						BEGIN
							Set @runningTotal = @runningTotal + @availableUnits
						END
						ELSE --BUST
						BEGIN  --So we have bust, if there are no lesser quantities to make our total then exit
							IF(@eachQuantityCounter >= @distinctEachQuantities) Set @isDistinctQuantitiesRemaining = 0
						END
			
						FETCH NEXT FROM each_cursor INTO @availableUnits
					 END
					CLOSE each_cursor
					DEALLOCATE each_cursor
				END
			END	

			Select @returnCode ReturnCode, @message ReturnMessage
			--Select 0 ReturnCode, 'OK' ReturnMessage

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end
						
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END
GO

-- =============================================          
-- Author:  <Author,,Name>          
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>          
-- Description: <Description,,>          
-- =============================================          
CREATE  PROCEDURE [dbo].[spStockOrderEditMovementsTidyUp]          
(          
 @containerOutFK int,       
 @CurrentUser int = -1     
)          
AS          
BEGIN          
 /* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */          
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED          
          
    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT          
 ,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;          
 SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();          
          
 -- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters       
 DECLARE @now DATETIME = dbo.GetBSTDate();      
 DECLARE @var_currentUser INT = @CurrentUser;      
 DECLARE @var_containerOutFK int  = @containerOutFK          
 SET @ParameterDetails = '@containerOutFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_containerOutFK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') +      
  ',@CurrentUser = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_currentUser AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'');      
      
          
    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL           
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)          
          
    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)          
    --BEGIN          
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC           
          
  SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)          
          
        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)          
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK          
          
        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()          
    --END          
          
          
 SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);          
 SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails          
 ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;          
 INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()          
          
 WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3          
 BEGIN           
  BEGIN TRY          
   IF XACT_STATE() = 0 AND @@TRANCOUNT < 1 BEGIN TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName          
          
 -- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start         
       
           --only want movements related to this order, not all movements of effected pallets    

   DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #tmpContainerOutWorksOrders    
   SELECT distinct worksorderPk     
   INTO #tmpContainerOutWorksOrders    
   FROM tblworksorders wo     
   INNER JOIN dbo.tblStockOrders tso ON wo.FK = tso.StockOrderPK    
   WHERE  wo.WorksOrderOriginFK = 2 and containeroutfk = @var_containerOutFK 
   
   drop table if exists #tmpcolpc
   select worksordermovementpk, colpc.palletfk, containeroutfk, colpc.ContainerOutLinePalletContentPK, woms.ContainerOutLinePalletContentFK, colpc.Units
   into #tmpcolpc
   from tblcontaineroutlinepalletcontent colpc    
   INNER JOIN tblcontaineroutlines col ON colpc.ContainerOutLineFK = col.ContainerOutLinePK    
   INNER JOIN tblworksordermovements woms ON colpc.palletfk = woms.PalletFK    
   INNER JOIN #tmpContainerOutWorksOrders wo ON woms.WorksOrderFK = wo.WorksOrderPK    
   WHERE col.containeroutfk = @var_containerOutFK    
    AND colpc.ContainerOutLinePalletContentPK <> woms.ContainerOutLinePalletContentFK    
    
    --pending movements - realign colpc and keep active
   UPDATE woms SET woms.ContainerOutLinePalletContentFK = colpc.ContainerOutLinePalletContentPK, isarchived = (case when destinationlocationtypefk = 5 then 0   else 1 end)
   FROM #tmpcolpc colpc    
   INNER JOIN tblworksordermovements woms ON colpc.palletfk = woms.PalletFK and woms.WorksOrderMovementPK = colpc.WorksOrderMovementPK   
   WHERE woms.WorksOrderStatusFK <> 3     
      AND colpc.ContainerOutLinePalletContentPK <> woms.ContainerOutLinePalletContentFK    

      
    --completed partial pallet movements archive off the orgininal movement
    update woms set isarchived = 1 
    FROM #tmpcolpc colpc  
   INNER JOIN tblworksordermovements woms ON colpc.palletfk = woms.PalletFK and woms.WorksOrderMovementPK = colpc.WorksOrderMovementPK     
   WHERE woms.WorksOrderStatusFK = 3 
    AND woms.DestinationLocationTypeFK <> 5 and SourceLocationTypeFK <> 5
    and woms.EntirePallet = 0
   -- AND col.containeroutfk = @var_containerOutFK    
    AND colpc.ContainerOutLinePalletContentPK <> woms.ContainerOutLinePalletContentFK

    if((select count(*) from #tmpContainerOutWorksOrders) > 0)
    begin
        --completed partial pallet movements - recreate to allow splitting again
        insert into tblWorksOrderMovements  
        select worksOrderFK, 1/*WorksOrderStatus*/, woms.palletFK, woms.palletContentFK, ContainerOutLinePalletContentPK, entirePallet, woms.eaches, colpc.units, sourceLocationTypeFK,   
             sourceLocationFK, sourceBayPosition, sourceStackPosition, woms.DestinationLocationTypeFK, woms.DestinationFK, -1/*BayPosition*/, destinationStackPosition, -1/*Pallet Start*/,   
             -1/*Pallet End*/, movementDescription, 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/, @var_currentUser, dbo.GetBSTDate(), @var_currentUser, dbo.GetBSTDate(),-1, -1, -1 
        FROM #tmpcolpc colpc  
       INNER JOIN tblworksordermovements woms ON colpc.palletfk = woms.PalletFK and woms.WorksOrderMovementPK = colpc.WorksOrderMovementPK     
       WHERE woms.WorksOrderStatusFK = 3 
        AND woms.DestinationLocationTypeFK <> 5 and SourceLocationTypeFK <> 5
        and woms.EntirePallet = 0
       -- AND col.containeroutfk = @var_containerOutFK    
        AND colpc.ContainerOutLinePalletContentPK <> woms.ContainerOutLinePalletContentFK
    end

  
-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end          
         
   BEGIN TRY IF XACT_STATE() = 1 AND @@TRANCOUNT = 1 AND @OpeningTranCount < 1 COMMIT TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH          
             
   BREAK          
  END TRY          
  BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */          
   DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;          
   SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;          
   SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;          
          
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY           
   BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;          
                 
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;          
          
            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID          
                      
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;          
                      
   IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)          
   BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END          
   ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */          
  END CATCH          
  SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1          
 END          
END

-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spStockOrderForWorksOrder]
(
	@WorksOrderPK int
)
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT
 ,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;
	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	DECLARE @var_WorksOrderPK int

	SET @var_WorksOrderPK = @WorksOrderPK

	SET @ParameterDetails = '@WorksOrderPK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_WorksOrderPK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'')

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    --BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

		SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END


	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY
			

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start

			select co.GoodsOrderNumber as Goods_Out_No, 'n/a' as Id, 'n/a' as Division_Name , ContainerOutPk 
			from tblcontainerouts co 
			inner join tblstockorders on containeroutfk = containeroutpk 
			inner join tblworksorders on stockorderpk = fk 
			where worksorderoriginfk = 2 and worksordertypefk = 3 and worksorderpk = @var_WorksOrderPK

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end

			
			
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END
GO

-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spStockOrderGetAvailablePalletContent]
(
	@stockItemFK int,
	@batch nvarchar(200),
	@palletStatusFK int = 1, /*IF A ZERO IS PASSED, IT MEANS TO ALLOW ANY STATUS EXPECT FOR REJECTS(16)
								IF -1 IS PASSED THEN COMBINATION 1 (3 or 7)
								IF -2 IS PASSED THEN COMBINATION 2 (4, 15, 9)
								IF -3 IS PASSED THEN CUSTOM STOCK ITEM DELIVERY STATUS RULES APPLY*/
	@DeliverytypeFK int = 1
)
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT
 ,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;
	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	DECLARE @var_stockItemFK int, @var_batch nvarchar(200), @var_palletStatusFK int, @var_DeliverytypeFK int

	SET @var_stockItemFK = @stockItemFK; SET @var_batch = @batch; SET @var_palletStatusFK = @palletStatusFK; SET @var_DeliverytypeFK = @DeliverytypeFK

	SET @ParameterDetails = '@stockItemFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_stockItemFK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@batch = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_batch AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') 
		+ ',@palletStatusFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_palletStatusFK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'')+ ',@DeliverytypeFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_DeliverytypeFK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'')

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    --BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

		SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END


	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY
			

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start

			IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#TempDeliveryStatus') IS NOT NULL
				DROP TABLE #TempDeliveryStatus

			CREATE TABLE #TempDeliveryStatus 
			(
				StockItemDeliveryStatusPK INT,
				StockItemFK INT,
				DeliveryTypeFK INT,
				PalletStatusFK INT
			)
			IF(@var_palletStatusFK = -3)
			BEGIN
			--load custom delivery type pallet status rules
				INSERT INTO #TempDeliveryStatus 
				Select 
					StockItemDeliveryStatusPK, StockItemFK, DeliveryTypeFK, palletStatusFK
				FROM
					tblStockItemDeliveryStatus
				WHERE
					Isarchived = 0 and StockItemFK = @var_stockItemFK AND DeliveryTypeFK = @var_DeliverytypeFK
			END			

			Declare @allowSplitPallets bit
			Select @allowSplitPallets = AllowSplitPallets from tblStockItems where StockItemPK = @var_stockItemFK

			--We need to send back different quantities for the subset code to figure out what is possible
			if(@allowSplitPallets = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/) 
			BEGIN
				Select PalletContentPK, PalletFK, AvailableUnits
				From tblPalletContent pc
				inner join tblPallets pallets on
				pallets.PalletPK = pc.PalletFK
				Where StockItemFK = @var_stockItemFK
				AND Batch = case when @var_batch = 'NOBATCH' then Batch else @var_batch end
				AND (pallets.PalletStatusFK = @var_palletStatusFK OR (@var_palletStatusFK = 0 AND pallets.PalletStatusFK <> 16/*DONT ALLOW REJECTS*/)) 
				AND AvailableUnits > 0
				AND pallets.IsArchived = 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/
				--AND pallets.LocationTypeFK = 1 /*In Racking*/ --In the future this needs to open up to loading bays also
				Order by PalletFK
			END 
			ELSE 
			BEGIN
				--I know we are sending PalletPK back twice, it has to be this way as the receiving codes expects this
				--However, these PalletCotentPKs and PalletFKs are not used yet so it makes no difference- it just uses the available units
				--In fact I could probably take them out, but I dont have time right now
				Select PalletPK, PalletFK, AvailableUnits
				From tblPallets pals 
				inner join (
					Select PalletFK, StockItemFK, Batch, sum(AvailableUnits) AvailableUnits
					from tblPalletContent
					Group By PalletFK, StockItemFK, Batch
				)pc on
				pc.PalletFK = pals.PalletPK
				Where StockItemFK = @var_stockItemFK
				AND Batch = case when @var_batch = 'NOBATCH' then Batch else @var_batch end
				AND (
					pals.PalletStatusFK = @var_palletStatusFK 
					OR 
					(
						@var_palletStatusFK = 0 AND pals.PalletStatusFK <> 16/*DONT ALLOW REJECTS*/
					)
					OR
					(/*Combination 1*/
						@var_palletStatusFK = -1 AND (pals.PalletStatusFK = 3 OR pals.PalletStatusFK = 7)
					)
					OR
					(/*Combination 2*/
						@var_palletStatusFK = -2 AND (pals.PalletStatusFK IN (4, 15, 9))
					)
					OR
					(
						@var_palletStatusFK = -3 AND (pals.PalletStatusFK IN (SELECT PalletStatusFK FROM #TempDeliveryStatus tds))
					)
				)
				AND AvailableUnits > 0
				AND pals.IsArchived = 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/
				Order By AvailableUnits DESC --jamie : 29/11/2016 : changed from asc to desc, to try and stop 27 pallets being picked when it can be done in less
			END

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end

			
			
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spStockOrderGetAvailablePalletContentByBuildingUnitPickRules]
(
	@PossiblePalletsXML xml, --already have a list of possible pallets, they just need ordered by rules
	@BuildingUnitFK int,
	@stockItemFK int
)
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT
 ,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;
	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	DECLARE @var_PossiblePalletsXML xml, @var_BuildingUnitFK int, @var_stockItemFK int

	SET @var_PossiblePalletsXML = @PossiblePalletsXML; SET @var_BuildingUnitFK = @BuildingUnitFK; SET @var_stockItemFK = @stockItemFK

	SET @ParameterDetails = '@PossiblePalletsXML = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_PossiblePalletsXML AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@BuildingUnitFK = ' 
		+ ISNULL(CAST(@var_BuildingUnitFK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@stockItemFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_stockItemFK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'')

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    --BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

		SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END


	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY
			

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start

				IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#tblTempPalletSelectionTable') IS NOT NULL
					DROP TABLE #tblTempPalletSelectionTable

				----temp table to put all values into before ordering by rules
				--CREATE TABLE #tblTempPalletSelectionTable 
				--(
				--	PalletFK INT,
				--	Batch nvarchar(50),
				--	CustomerPalletNumber nvarchar(300),
				--	CustomerBarcode nvarchar(300), 
				--	AvailableUnits decimal, 
				--	Row nvarchar(50), 
				--	BuildingUnitColumn int, 
				--	PalletLocation nvarchar(50), 
				--	PalletsInRow int,
				--	UnitsInRow decimal,
				--	BayLevel nvarchar(50),
				--	BayPosition int,
				--	MovementDate DateTime
				--)
	
				--insert available stock into temp table
				--INSERT INTO #tblTempPalletSelectionTable 
				Select distinct
					p.PalletPK AS PalletFK, Batch, p.CustomerPalletNumber, p.CustomerBarcode, AvailableUnits, isnull(palletLocation.Row, 'Z') AS Row, 
					isnull(rLocs.BuildingUnitColumn, 1) AS BuildingUnitColumn, palletLocation.[Location] AS PalletLocation, sameRow.PalletsInRow, UnitsInRow, 
					palletLocation.BayLevel, P.BayPosition, isnull(PalletMovements.Updateddate, '19000101') as MovementDate
				INTO
					#tblTempPalletSelectionTable
				FROM 
					@var_PossiblePalletsXML.nodes('//FK') as ParamValues(PalletPK)
				inner join tblPallets p 
					on p.palletpk = ParamValues.PalletPK.value('VALUE[1]','INT')
				LEFT OUTER JOIN ViewRackingLocations rLocs 
					on p.LocationTypeFK = 1 /*Racking Only*/ AND rLocs.BuildingUnitBayPK = p.LocationFK
				inner join viewPalletLocations palletLocation 
					ON palletLocation.palletPK = p.palletPk
				inner join (
					Select PalletFK, StockItemFK, Batch, sum(AvailableUnits) AvailableUnits
					from tblPalletContent
					Group By PalletFK, StockItemFK, Batch
				) AS pc on pc.PalletFK = p.palletpk
				INNER JOIN (
					SELECT count(p.palletpk) PalletsInRow, sum(AvailableUnits) UnitsInRow, palletLocation.[Location] 
					FROM @var_PossiblePalletsXML.nodes('//FK') as ParamValues(PalletPK) 
					inner join tblPallets p on p.palletpk = ParamValues.PalletPK.value('VALUE[1]','INT')
					INNER JOIN (Select PalletFK, StockItemFK, Batch, sum(AvailableUnits) AvailableUnits from tblpalletcontent Group By PalletFK, 
					StockItemFK, Batch) pc on pc.palletfk = p.palletpk
					inner join viewPalletLocations palletLocation ON palletLocation.palletPK = p.palletPk
					WHERE availableunits > 0 --and p.LocationTypeFK = 1
					GROUP BY palletLocation.Location, p.LocationTypeFK
				) AS sameRow on palletLocation.Location = sameRow.Location
				outer apply (
					select top 1 palletFK, UpdatedDate
					from tblworksordermovements
					where palletFK = p.PalletPK
					order by updateddate desc
				) AS PalletMovements

				--get order by clause for building (location rules only)
				DECLARE @OrderByClause NVARCHAR(100)
				exec spAutoPickRuleFactory @StockItemFK=@var_stockItemFK, @BuildingUnitFK=@var_BuildingUnitFK, @Clause=@OrderByClause OUTPUT, @RuleLevelFK = 2
	
				--apply order clause to temp table		
				DECLARE @DynamicSQL NVARCHAR(4000)
				SET @DynamicSQL = 'select * from #tblTempPalletSelectionTable '+@OrderByClause
		
				--execute sql
				--print @DynamicSQL
				exec (@DynamicSQL)

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end

			
			
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END

-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Jamie Clerkin>
-- Create date: <12/12/2016>
-- Description:	<get available content to pick, ordered by stock rules>
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spStockOrderGetAvailablePalletContentByCustomerPickRules]
(
	@stockItemFK int,
	@batch nvarchar(200),
	@SupplierBatch nvarchar(200) = '',
	@BestBefore nvarchar(200) = '',
	@DateOfmanufacture nvarchar(200) = '',
	@DateOfreceipt nvarchar(200) = '',
	@ExpiryDate nvarchar(200) = '',
	@palletStatusFK int = 1, /*IF A ZERO IS PASSED, IT MEANS TO ALLOW ANY STATUS EXPECT FOR REJECTS(16)
								IF -1 IS PASSED THEN COMBINATION 1 (3 or 7)
								IF -2 IS PASSED THEN COMBINATION 2 (4, 15, 9)
								IF -3 IS PASSED THEN CUSTOM STOCK ITEM DELIVERY STATUS RULES APPLY*/
	@DeliverytypeFK int = 1
)
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT
 ,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;
	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	DECLARE @var_stockItemFK int, @var_batch nvarchar(200), @var_palletStatusFK int, @var_DeliverytypeFK int,@var_SupplierBatch nvarchar(200), @var_BestBefore nvarchar(200), @var_DateOfManufacture nvarchar(200), @var_DateOfReceipt nvarchar(200), @var_ExpiryDate nvarchar(200)

	SET @var_stockItemFK = @stockItemFK; SET @var_batch = @batch; SET @var_palletStatusFK = @palletStatusFK; SET @var_DeliverytypeFK = @DeliverytypeFK; SET @var_SupplierBatch = @SupplierBatch; 
	SET @var_BestBefore = @BestBefore; SET @var_DateOfManufacture = @DateOfmanufacture; SET @var_DateOfReceipt = @DateOfReceipt; SET @var_ExpiryDate = @ExpiryDate

	SET @ParameterDetails = '@stockItemFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_stockItemFK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@batch = ' 
		+ ISNULL(CAST(@var_batch AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@palletStatusFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_palletStatusFK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'')
		+ ',@DeliverytypeFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_DeliverytypeFK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'')

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    --BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

		SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END


	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY
			
			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start
			IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#TempDeliveryStatus') IS NOT NULL
				DROP TABLE #TempDeliveryStatus

			CREATE TABLE #TempDeliveryStatus 
			(
				StockItemDeliveryStatusPK INT,
				StockItemFK INT,
				DeliveryTypeFK INT,
				PalletStatusFK INT
			)
			IF(@var_palletStatusFK = -3)
			BEGIN
			--load custom delivery type pallet status rules
				INSERT INTO #TempDeliveryStatus 
				Select 
					StockItemDeliveryStatusPK, StockItemFK, DeliveryTypeFK, palletStatusFK
				FROM
					tblStockItemDeliveryStatus
				WHERE
					Isarchived = 0 and StockItemFK = @var_stockItemFK AND DeliveryTypeFK = @var_DeliverytypeFK
			END			

			IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#tblTempPalletSelectionTable') IS NOT NULL
				DROP TABLE #tblTempPalletSelectionTable

			Select 
				distinct pals.PalletPK AS PalletFK, palletcontentpk, StockItemFK, pc.Batch, pc.ExpiryDate, pc.DateOfManufacture, pc.BestBefore, pc.DateOfReceipt, pals.Inserteddate, 
				pc.AvailableUnits, pals.BuildingUnitFK, 
				BU.BuildingFK, pals.CustomerPalletNumber, pals.CustomerBarcode, pc.SupplierBatch
			INTO
				#tblTempPalletSelectionTable
			From 
				tblPallets AS pals 
			inner join (
							/*Select PalletFK, StockItemFK, Batch, ExpiryDate, DateOfManufacture, BestBefore, DateOfReceipt, 
							sum(AvailableUnits) AvailableUnits
							from tblPalletContent
							Group By PalletFK, StockItemFK, Batch, ExpiryDate, DateOfManufacture, BestBefore, DateOfReceipt*/
							Select PalletFK, palletcontentpk, StockItemFK, Batch, SupplierBatch, ExpiryDate, DateOfManufacture, BestBefore, DateOfReceipt, 
								case when s.eachestypefk > 0 then AvailableUnits else sum(AvailableUnits) end AvailableUnits
							from tblPalletContent
							inner join tblstockitems s on stockitempk = stockitemfk
							Group By PalletFK, PalletContentPK,eachestypefk,AvailableUnits, StockItemFK, Batch, SupplierBatch, ExpiryDate, DateOfManufacture, BestBefore, DateOfReceipt
						) AS pc on pc.PalletFK = pals.PalletPK
			--is stockIn Complete
			inner join (
							select silp.palletfk, si.stockinstatusfk
							from tblstockinlinepallets silp
							inner join tblstockinlines sil on silp.stockinlinefk = sil.stockinlinepk
							inner join tblstockins si on sil.stockinfk = si.stockinpk
						) AS StockInStatus 
				on StockInStatus.PalletFk = pals.PalletPK
			inner join tblbuildingunits bu 
				on bu.buildingunitpk = pals.buildingunitfk
			Where 
				StockItemFK = @var_stockItemFK
			AND StockInStatus.stockinstatusfk = 3--completed stockins
			AND Batch = case when @var_batch = 'NOBATCH' then Batch else @var_batch end
			AND SupplierBatch = case when @var_SupplierBatch = '' then SupplierBatch else @var_SupplierBatch end
			AND convert(nvarchar(10), pc.BestBefore, 103) = case when @var_BestBefore = '' then convert(nvarchar(10), pc.BestBefore, 103) else @var_BestBefore end
			AND convert(nvarchar(10), pc.DateOfmanufacture, 103) = case when @var_DateOfManufacture = '' then convert(nvarchar(10), pc.DateOfmanufacture, 103) else @var_DateOfManufacture end
			AND convert(nvarchar(10), pc.DateOfReceipt, 103) = case when @var_DateOfReceipt = '' then convert(nvarchar(10), pc.DateOfReceipt, 103) else @var_DateOfReceipt end
			AND convert(nvarchar(10), pc.ExpiryDate, 103) = case when @var_ExpiryDate = '' then convert(nvarchar(10), pc.ExpiryDate, 103) else @var_ExpiryDate end
			AND (
				pals.PalletStatusFK = @var_palletStatusFK 
				OR 
				(
					@var_palletStatusFK = 0 AND pals.PalletStatusFK <> 16/*DONT ALLOW REJECTS*/
				)
				OR
				(/*Combination 1*/
					@var_palletStatusFK = -1 AND (pals.PalletStatusFK = 3 OR pals.PalletStatusFK = 7)
				)
				OR
				(/*Combination 2*/
					@var_palletStatusFK = -2 AND (pals.PalletStatusFK IN (4, 15, 9))
				)
				OR
				(
					@var_palletStatusFK = -3 AND (pals.PalletStatusFK IN (SELECT PalletStatusFK FROM #TempDeliveryStatus tds))
				)
			)
			AND AvailableUnits > 0
			AND pals.IsArchived = 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/


			--get 1st building
			DECLARE @BuildingUnitFK INT
			select top 1 @BuildingUnitFK = BuildingUnitFK from #tblTempPalletSelectionTable
		
			--get order by clause for 1st building (stock rules only)
			DECLARE @OrderByClause NVARCHAR(100)
			DECLARE @WhereClause NVARCHAR(500)
			exec spAutoPickRuleFactory @StockItemFK=@var_stockItemFK, @BuildingUnitFK=@BuildingUnitFK, @Clause=@OrderByClause OUTPUT, @RuleLevelFK = 1, @Filter=@WhereClause OUTPUT
	
			--apply order clause to temp table		
			DECLARE @DynamicSQL NVARCHAR(4000)
			--SET @DynamicSQL = 'select * from #tblTempPalletSelectionTable '+@OrderByClause
			SET @DynamicSQL = 'select * from #tblTempPalletSelectionTable '+@WhereClause+' '+@OrderByClause
		
			--execute sql
			print @DynamicSQL
			exec (@DynamicSQL)

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end

			
			
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END
