-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spStockOrderGetExtradockets]
(
	@containerOutFK int
)
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT
 ,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;
	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	DECLARE @var_containerOutFK int
	SET @var_containerOutFK = @containerOutFK
	SET @ParameterDetails = '@containerOutFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_containerOutFK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'')

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    --BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

		SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END


	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY
			
			DECLARE @DivisionFK int
			DECLARE @customerFk int
			DECLARE @IncludeStockOutPackingList bit
			DECLARE @DefaultPackingListReport nvarchar(50) = 'StockOutPackingList.rpx'
			DECLARE @DefaultPackingListProcedure nvarchar(50) = 'spReportsStockOutPackingList'

			--get division
			set @DivisionFK = (SELECT TOP 1 DivisionFK FROM tblcontaineroutlines WHERE containeroutfk = @var_containerOutFK)

			--get customer and rule
			SELECT @customerFk = d.customerFK, @IncludeStockOutPackingList = ShowExtraDocketsOnStockOut
			FROM tblDivisions d
			WHERE divisionPK = @DivisionFK

			--if rule is turned off, get out now
			if(@IncludeStockOutPackingList = 0)
				SELECT @DefaultPackingListReport as ExtraDocketRPX, @DefaultPackingListProcedure as ExtraDocketStoredProcedure, @IncludeStockOutPackingList AS ShowExtraDockets
			ELSE
			BEGIN
				--rule is turned on, fetch list of dockets
				DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #stockOutDockets

				Select ExtraDocketRPX, case when len(ExtraDocketStoredProcedure) > 0 then ExtraDocketStoredProcedure else @DefaultPackingListProcedure end as ExtraDocketStoredProcedure, @IncludeStockOutPackingList AS ShowExtraDockets
				INTO #stockOutDockets
				from tblExtraDockets 
				Where ExtraDocketTypeFK = 3 AND CustomerFK = @customerFk

				IF exists(SELECT * FROM #stockOutDockets)--return list of custom dockets
					SELECT * FROM #stockOutDockets
				ELSE --no custom dockets found, display default docket
					SELECT @DefaultPackingListReport as ExtraDocketRPX, @DefaultPackingListProcedure as ExtraDocketStoredProcedure, @IncludeStockOutPackingList AS ShowExtraDockets
			END
				
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END

 ,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;

	SET @var_StockOrderPK = @StockOrderPK

	SET @ParameterDetails = '@StockOrderPK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_StockOrderPK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'')

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    --BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

		SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END


	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY
			

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start

			SELECT    
				case when cdis.CustomerDocketIdentificationPK = null then 
					'' 
				else
					case cdis.FieldFK when 40 then
						cdis.Prefix + ' ' + contOuts.DocketValue1
					when 2 then
						cdis.Prefix + ' ' + contOuts.DocketValue2
					when 2 then
						cdis.Prefix + ' ' + contOuts.DocketValue3
					end
				End as ID		

			FROM dbo.tblStockOrders stockOrders
				inner join tblContainerOuts contOuts on	contOuts.ContainerOutPK = stockOrders.ContainerOutFK
				left outer join (
					Select ContainerOutFK, MAX(DivisionFK) DivisionFK from tblContainerOutLines
					Group By ContainerOutFK
					)cols on cols.ContainerOutFK = contOuts.ContainerOutPK
				left outer join tblDivisions divs on divs.DivisionPK = cols.DivisionFK
				left outer join tblCustomerDocketIdentifications cdis on cdis.CustomerFK = divs.CustomerFK AND cdis.DocketTypeFK = 2 
			where StockOrderPK  = @var_StockOrderPK

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end

			
			
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END

-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spStockOrderGetWorksOrdersForCompleteMovement]
(
	@worksOrderMovementFK int
)
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT
	,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;
	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	DECLARE @var_worksOrderMovementFK int
	SET @var_worksOrderMovementFK = @worksOrderMovementFK
	SET @ParameterDetails = '@worksOrderMovementFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_worksOrderMovementFK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'')

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    --BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

		SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END

	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY
		
			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start

			IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#tblRules') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #tblRules

			/*Create the temporary table for our rules*/
			CREATE TABLE #tblRules
			(
				PalletFK int,
				WorksOrderTypeFK int,
				WorksOrderRuleTypeFK int,
				WorksOrderRuleFK int,
				WorksOrderSubjectFK int 
			)

			Declare @countryFK int, @divisionFK int, @stockItemFK int, @stockOrderFK int, @palletContentFK int, @palletFK int,
			@containerOutFK int

			Select @countryFK = containerOuts.CountryFK, @divisionFK = stockItems.DivisionFK, @stockItemFK = palletContent.StockItemFK,
			@stockOrderFK = stockOrders.StockOrderPK, @palletContentFK = palletContent.PalletContentPK, @palletFK = palletContent.PalletFK,
			@containerOutFK = stockOrders.ContainerOutFK
			From tblWorksOrderMovements woms
			inner join tblWorksOrders worksOrders on
			worksOrders.WorksOrderPK = woms.WorksOrderFK

			inner join tblStockOrders stockOrders on
			stockOrders.StockOrderPK = worksOrders.FK

			inner join tblContainerOuts containerOuts on
			containerOuts.ContainerOutPK = stockOrders.ContainerOutFK

			inner join tblContainerOutLinePalletContent colpc on
			colpc.ContainerOutLinePalletContentPK = woms.ContainerOutLinePalletContentFK

			inner join tblPalletContent palletContent on
			palletContent.PalletContentPK = colpc.PalletContentFK

			inner join tblStockItems stockItems on
			stockItems.StockItemPK = palletContent.StockItemFK
			where woms.WorksOrderMovementPK = @var_worksOrderMovementFK

			Declare @worksOrderTypeFK int, @worksOrderSubjectFK int

			/********* MANDATORY COUNTRY RULES ******************/
			if(exists(Select * from tblCountryRules Where CountryFK = @countryFK))
			BEGIN --There are country rules for this Container Out
				Declare @divisionWorksOrderCountryRulePK int

				DECLARE mandatoryRulesCursor CURSOR FAST_FORWARD
				FOR
				Select DivisionWorksOrderCountryRulePK, WorksOrderTypeFK, wots.WorksOrderSubjectFK from tblDivisionWorksOrderCountryRules divisionCountryRules
				inner join tblCountryRules countryRules on
				countryRules.CountryRulePK = divisionCountryRules.CountryRuleFK
				inner join appWorksOrderTypes wots on
				countryRules.WorksOrderTypeFK = wots.WorksOrderTypePK
	
				left outer join ( --join work already set so we prevent duplicate work
					Select worksOrders.WorksOrderRuleFK, wops.PalletFK from tblWorksOrders worksOrders
						left outer join tblWorksOrderPallets wops on
						wops.WorksOrderFK = worksOrders.WorksOrderPK
						AND wops.PalletFK = @palletFK
						where WorksOrderOriginFK = 2/*StockOrder*/
						AND worksOrders.FK = @stockOrderFK AND worksOrders.WorksOrderRuleTypeFK = 1/*MandatoryCountryRule*/
				) existingWorksOrders on
				existingWorksOrders.WorksOrderRuleFK = divisionCountryRules.DivisionWorksOrderCountryRulePK
	
				Where countryRules.CountryFK = @countryFK
				AND ((wots.WorksOrderSubjectFK = 1/*Container*/ AND existingWorksOrders.WorksOrderRuleFK is null) 
					OR (wots.WorksOrderSubjectFK <> 1 AND existingWorksOrders.PalletFK is null))
				AND divisionCountryRules.DivisionFK in (Select DivisionFK from tblContainerOutLines where ContainerOutFK = @containerOutFK)

				OPEN mandatoryRulesCursor

				FETCH NEXT FROM mandatoryRulesCursor
				INTO @divisionWorksOrderCountryRulePK, @worksOrderTypeFK, @worksOrderSubjectFK

				WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
				BEGIN
					insert into #tblRules (PalletFK, WorksOrderTypeFK, WorksOrderRuleTypeFK, WorksOrderRuleFK, WorksOrderSubjectFK)
					values(@palletFK, @worksOrderTypeFK, 1/*MandatoryCountryRule*/, @divisionWorksOrderCountryRulePK, @worksOrderSubjectFK)

					FETCH NEXT FROM mandatoryRulesCursor
					INTO @divisionWorksOrderCountryRulePK, @worksOrderTypeFK, @worksOrderSubjectFK
				END

				CLOSE mandatoryRulesCursor
				DEALLOCATE mandatoryRulesCursor
			END
			/********* END OF MANDATORY COUNTRY RULES ******************/	

			/********* DIVISION ONLY COUNTRY RULES ************************/
			if(exists(Select * from tblDivisionOnlyWorksOrderCountryRules Where CountryFK = @countryFK AND DivisionFK = @divisionFK))
			BEGIN --There are country rules for this Container Out
				Declare @divisionOnlyWorksOrderCountryRulePK int
	
				DECLARE divisionOnlyCountryRulesCursor CURSOR FAST_FORWARD
				FOR
				Select DivisionOnlyWorksOrderCountryRulePK, WorksOrderTypeFK, wots.WorksOrderSubjectFK 
				from tblDivisionOnlyWorksOrderCountryRules dowocrs
				inner join appWorksOrderTypes wots on
				dowocrs.WorksOrderTypeFK = wots.WorksOrderTypePK
	
				left outer join ( --join work already set so we prevent duplicate work
					Select worksOrders.WorksOrderRuleFK, wops.PalletFK from tblWorksOrders worksOrders
						inner join tblWorksOrderPallets wops on
						wops.WorksOrderFK = worksOrders.WorksOrderPK
						AND wops.PalletFK = @palletFK
						where WorksOrderOriginFK = 2/*StockOrder*/
						AND worksOrders.FK = @stockOrderFK AND worksOrders.WorksOrderRuleTypeFK = 2/*DivisionOnlyCountryRule*/
				) existingWorksOrders on
				existingWorksOrders.WorksOrderRuleFK = dowocrs.DivisionOnlyWorksOrderCountryRulePK
	
				Where dowocrs.CountryFK = @countryFK AND dowocrs.DivisionFK = @divisionFK
				AND ((wots.WorksOrderSubjectFK = 1/*Container*/ AND existingWorksOrders.WorksOrderRuleFK is null) 
					OR (wots.WorksOrderSubjectFK <> 1 AND existingWorksOrders.PalletFK is null))

				OPEN divisionOnlyCountryRulesCursor

				FETCH NEXT FROM divisionOnlyCountryRulesCursor
				INTO @divisionOnlyWorksOrderCountryRulePK, @worksOrderTypeFK, @worksOrderSubjectFK

				WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
				BEGIN
					insert into #tblRules (PalletFK, WorksOrderTypeFK, WorksOrderRuleTypeFK, WorksOrderRuleFK, WorksOrderSubjectFK)
					values(@palletFK, @worksOrderTypeFK, 2/*DivisionOnlyCountryRule*/, @divisionOnlyWorksOrderCountryRulePK, @worksOrderSubjectFK)

					FETCH NEXT FROM divisionOnlyCountryRulesCursor
					INTO @divisionOnlyWorksOrderCountryRulePK, @worksOrderTypeFK, @worksOrderSubjectFK
				END

				CLOSE divisionOnlyCountryRulesCursor
				DEALLOCATE divisionOnlyCountryRulesCursor
			END
			/********* END OF DIVISION ONLY COUNTRY RULES ******************/

			/********* STOCK ITEM COUNTRY RULES ************************/
			if(exists(Select * from tblStockItemCountryRules Where CountryFK = @countryFK AND StockItemFK = @stockItemFK))
			BEGIN --There are country rules for this Container Out
				Declare @stockItemCountryRulePK int
	
				DECLARE stockItemCountryRulesCursor CURSOR FAST_FORWARD
				FOR
				Select StockItemCountryRulePK, WorksOrderTypeFK, wots.WorksOrderSubjectFK 
				from tblStockItemCountryRules sicrs
				inner join appWorksOrderTypes wots on
				sicrs.WorksOrderTypeFK = wots.WorksOrderTypePK
	
				left outer join ( --join work already set so we prevent duplicate work
					Select worksOrders.WorksOrderRuleFK, wops.PalletFK from tblWorksOrders worksOrders
						inner join tblWorksOrderPallets wops on
						wops.WorksOrderFK = worksOrders.WorksOrderPK
						AND wops.PalletFK = @palletFK
						where WorksOrderOriginFK = 2/*StockOrder*/
						AND worksOrders.FK = @stockOrderFK AND worksOrders.WorksOrderRuleTypeFK = 3/*StockItemCountryRule*/
				) existingWorksOrders on
				existingWorksOrders.WorksOrderRuleFK = sicrs.StockItemCountryRulePK
	
				Where sicrs.CountryFK = @countryFK AND sicrs.StockItemFK = @stockItemFK
				AND ((wots.WorksOrderSubjectFK = 1/*Container*/ AND existingWorksOrders.WorksOrderRuleFK is null) 
					OR (wots.WorksOrderSubjectFK <> 1 AND existingWorksOrders.PalletFK is null))

				OPEN stockItemCountryRulesCursor

				FETCH NEXT FROM stockItemCountryRulesCursor
				INTO @stockItemCountryRulePK, @worksOrderTypeFK, @worksOrderSubjectFK

				WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
				BEGIN
					insert into #tblRules (PalletFK, WorksOrderTypeFK, WorksOrderRuleTypeFK, WorksOrderRuleFK, WorksOrderSubjectFK)
					values(@palletFK, @worksOrderTypeFK, 3/*StockItemCountryRule*/, @stockItemCountryRulePK, @worksOrderSubjectFK)

					FETCH NEXT FROM stockItemCountryRulesCursor
					INTO @stockItemCountryRulePK, @worksOrderTypeFK, @worksOrderSubjectFK
				END

				CLOSE stockItemCountryRulesCursor
				DEALLOCATE stockItemCountryRulesCursor
			END
			/********* END OF STOCK ITEM COUNTRY RULES *****************/

			/********* STOCK ITEM RULES ************************/
			if(exists(Select * from tblStockItemWorksOrderRules Where StockItemFK = @stockItemFK))
			BEGIN --There are stock item rules for this Container Out
				Declare @stockItemWorksOrderRulePK int
	
				DECLARE stockItemRulesCursor CURSOR FAST_FORWARD
				FOR
				Select StockItemWorksOrderRulePK, WorksOrderTypeFK, wots.WorksOrderSubjectFK 
				from tblStockItemWorksOrderRules siwors
				inner join appWorksOrderTypes wots on
				siwors.WorksOrderTypeFK = wots.WorksOrderTypePK
	
				left outer join ( --join work already set so we prevent duplicate work
					Select worksOrders.WorksOrderRuleFK, wops.PalletFK from tblWorksOrders worksOrders
						inner join tblWorksOrderPallets wops on
						wops.WorksOrderFK = worksOrders.WorksOrderPK
						AND wops.PalletFK = @palletFK
						where WorksOrderOriginFK = 2/*StockOrder*/
						AND worksOrders.FK = @stockOrderFK AND worksOrders.WorksOrderRuleTypeFK = 4/*StockItemRule*/
				) existingWorksOrders on
				existingWorksOrders.WorksOrderRuleFK = siwors.StockItemWorksOrderRulePK
	
				Where siwors.StockItemFK = @stockItemFK
				AND ((wots.WorksOrderSubjectFK = 1/*Container*/ AND existingWorksOrders.WorksOrderRuleFK is null) 
					OR (wots.WorksOrderSubjectFK <> 1 AND existingWorksOrders.PalletFK is null))

				OPEN stockItemRulesCursor

				FETCH NEXT FROM stockItemRulesCursor
				INTO @stockItemWorksOrderRulePK, @worksOrderTypeFK, @worksOrderSubjectFK

				WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
				BEGIN
					insert into #tblRules (PalletFK, WorksOrderTypeFK, WorksOrderRuleTypeFK, WorksOrderRuleFK, WorksOrderSubjectFK)
					values(@palletFK, @worksOrderTypeFK, 4/*StockItemRule*/, @stockItemWorksOrderRulePK, @worksOrderSubjectFK)

					FETCH NEXT FROM stockItemRulesCursor
					INTO @stockItemWorksOrderRulePK, @worksOrderTypeFK, @worksOrderSubjectFK
				END

				CLOSE stockItemRulesCursor
				DEALLOCATE stockItemRulesCursor
			END
			/********* END OF STOCK ITEM RULES *****************/

			Select * from #tblRules

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end

			
			
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END

			--set @var_pickXml = '<PickedPallets><Pallet><PalletPK>90745</PalletPK><Units>1728.000</Units></Pallet><Pallet><PalletPK>92628</PalletPK><Units>720.000</Units></Pallet><Pallet><PalletPK>90746</PalletPK><Units>1728.000</Units></Pallet><Pallet><PalletPK>90747</PalletPK><Units>1728.000</Units></Pallet><Pallet><PalletPK>90748</PalletPK><Units>1728.000</Units></Pallet><Pallet><PalletPK>90749</PalletPK><Units>1728.000</Units></Pallet><Pallet><PalletPK>90756</PalletPK><Units>1728.000</Units></Pallet><Pallet><PalletPK>90757</PalletPK><Units>1728.000</Units></Pallet><Pallet><PalletPK>90758</PalletPK><Units>1728.000</Units></Pallet></PickedPallets>'
			--set @var_pickXml = '<PickedPallets><Pallet><PalletPK>90745</PalletPK><Units>1728.000</Units></Pallet><Pallet><PalletPK>90746</PalletPK><Units>1728.000</Units></Pallet><Pallet><PalletPK>90747</PalletPK><Units>1728.000</Units></Pallet><Pallet><PalletPK>90748</PalletPK><Units>1728.000</Units></Pallet><Pallet><PalletPK>90749</PalletPK><Units>1728.000</Units></Pallet><Pallet><PalletPK>90756</PalletPK><Units>1728.000</Units></Pallet><Pallet><PalletPK>90757</PalletPK><Units>1728.000</Units></Pallet><Pallet><PalletPK>90758</PalletPK><Units>1728.000</Units></Pallet><Pallet><PalletPK>90759</PalletPK><Units>1728.000</Units></Pallet><Pallet><PalletPK>91590</PalletPK><Units>1728.000</Units></Pallet><Pallet><PalletPK>92228</PalletPK><Units>1728.000</Units></Pallet><Pallet><PalletPK>92232</PalletPK><Units>1728.000</Units></Pallet><Pallet><PalletPK>92262</PalletPK><Units>1728.000</Units></Pallet><Pallet><PalletPK>92265</PalletPK><Units>1728.000</Units></Pallet><Pallet><PalletPK>92384</PalletPK><Units>1728.000</Units></Pallet><Pallet><PalletPK>92385</PalletPK><Units>1728.000</Units></Pallet><Pallet><PalletPK>92573</PalletPK><Units>1728.000</Units></Pallet><Pallet><PalletPK>92574</PalletPK><Units>1728.000</Units></Pallet><Pallet><PalletPK>92580</PalletPK><Units>1728.000</Units></Pallet><Pallet><PalletPK>92581</PalletPK><Units>1728.000</Units></Pallet></PickedPallets>'

			/* Two building units */
			/*
			SET @var_pickXml = '<PickedPallets>
				<Pallet><PalletPK>76781</PalletPK><Units>543.800</Units></Pallet>
				<Pallet><PalletPK>76789</PalletPK><Units>543.800</Units></Pallet>
				<Pallet><PalletPK>76781</PalletPK><Units>543.800</Units></Pallet>
				<Pallet><PalletPK>76789</PalletPK><Units>543.800</Units></Pallet>
				<Pallet><PalletPK>76781</PalletPK><Units>543.800</Units></Pallet>
				<Pallet><PalletPK>76789</PalletPK><Units>543.800</Units></Pallet>
				<Pallet><PalletPK>76781</PalletPK><Units>543.800</Units></Pallet>
				<Pallet><PalletPK>76789</PalletPK><Units>543.800</Units></Pallet>
				<Pallet><PalletPK>76781</PalletPK><Units>543.800</Units></Pallet>
				<Pallet><PalletPK>76789</PalletPK><Units>543.800</Units></Pallet>
				<Pallet><PalletPK>76781</PalletPK><Units>543.800</Units></Pallet>
				<Pallet><PalletPK>76789</PalletPK><Units>543.800</Units></Pallet>
				<Pallet><PalletPK>76781</PalletPK><Units>543.800</Units></Pallet>
				<Pallet><PalletPK>76789</PalletPK><Units>543.800</Units></Pallet>
				<Pallet><PalletPK>76781</PalletPK><Units>543.800</Units></Pallet>
				<Pallet><PalletPK>76789</PalletPK><Units>543.800</Units></Pallet>
				<Pallet><PalletPK>76781</PalletPK><Units>543.800</Units></Pallet>
				<Pallet><PalletPK>76789</PalletPK><Units>543.800</Units></Pallet>
				<Pallet><PalletPK>76781</PalletPK><Units>543.800</Units></Pallet>
				<Pallet><PalletPK>76789</PalletPK><Units>543.800</Units></Pallet>
				<Pallet><PalletPK>76781</PalletPK><Units>543.800</Units></Pallet>
				<Pallet><PalletPK>76817</PalletPK><Units>543.800</Units></Pallet>
				</PickedPallets>'
			*/			

			/* DEBUG ON */
			/*
			set @var_stockItemFK = 40859
			set @var_batch = 'SA00000678'
			set @var_requiredStatusFK = 1
			*/

		/* Initialization */
			DECLARE @RequestedPallets INT

		  -- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from
			  -- INTerfering with SELECT statements.

			IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#tblPickedPallets') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #tblPickedPallets

			  /******** DECLARE TABLES ************/
			CREATE TABLE #tblPickedPallets 
			(
				PalletPK INT,
				PalletStatusFK INT,
				Units DECIMAL(18,3),
				BuildingUnitFK INT
			)

			IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#tblProposals') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #tblProposals

			CREATE TABLE #tblProposals 
			(
				ProposalPK INT,
				OriginalPalletFK INT,
				ReplacementPalletFK INT,
				OriginalBuildingUnitFK INT,
				ReplacementBuildingUnitFK INT,
				Units DECIMAL(18,3)
			)

			IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#tblProposalSummary') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #tblProposalSummary

			CREATE TABLE #tblProposalSummary 
			(
				ProposalSummaryPK INT,
				BuildingUnitFK INT,
				UnitsFulfillable DECIMAL(18,3),
				BuildingName NVARCHAR(200),
				ProposalVerified INT
			)

			IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#tblCountOverview') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #tblCountOverview

			CREATE TABLE #tblCountOverview 
			(
				SubSumSetPK  INT,
				BuildingCount INT,
				BuildingName NVARCHAR(200)
			)

			/******** GET XML INTO TABLE WITH BUILDINGUNITFK ************/
			INSERT INTO #tblPickedPallets (PalletPK, PalletStatusFK, Units, BuildingUnitFK) 
			SELECT ParamValues.Pallets.value('PalletPK[1]','INT') as PalletPK,
			pals.PalletStatusFK,
			ParamValues.Pallets.value('Units[1]','DECIMAL(18,3)') as Units,
			pals.BuildingUnitFK
			FROM @var_pickXml.nodes('//Pallet') as ParamValues(Pallets)
			INNER JOIN tblPallets pals ON
			pals.PalletPK = ParamValues.Pallets.value('PalletPK[1]','INT')

			/* Initialisation process */
	
			/********* Declare Variables needed for processing ***********/
			DECLARE @PalletsRequired INT
			DECLARE @GlobalSearchResult INT
		
			/* Variables for keeping track of the count in the various tables */
			DECLARE @CountOfBuildingsInXML INT
			DECLARE @CountOfPalletsInOriginalProposal INT
			DECLARE @CountOfPalletsInCurrentProposal INT
			DECLARE @CountOfPalletsInXML INT
			DECLARE @PalletReplacementFK INT


			/**** Initialise processing variables ****/
			SET @GlobalSearchResult  = 0

			/******* Get the number of building units in the current pallet pick *****/
			/* Count the pallets in the XML package */			
			SELECT @CountOfPalletsInXML=count(BuildingUnitFk) from #tblPickedPallets

			/* Count the different buildings */
			SELECT @CountOfBuildingsInXML = COUNT(a.num) FROM (
				SELECT COUNT(BuildingUnitFK) AS num FROM #tblPickedPallets GROUP BY BuildingUnitFK
			) AS a

			SELECT @PalletsRequired=count(*) from #tblPickedPallets
			/*  Get simplified subsum set from: All items from database matching stockitem, batch, status 
				Totals are cross referenced with possible permutations indicated in the resulting table 
				Get summarized content in the @tblCountOverview table
			*/
		
			/* Convenience data neccessary for picking out data correctly and accurately */
			INSERT INTO #tblProposalSummary(ProposalSummaryPK,BuildingUnitFK,UnitsFulfillable,BuildingName) 
			SELECT * FROM fnStockReturnSubSumSet(@var_stockItemFK,@var_batch,@PalletsRequired,@var_requiredStatusFK)
	
			update #tblProposalSummary set ProposalVerified = 0
			INSERT INTO #tblCountOverview ( SubSumSetPK, BuildingCount,BuildingName) 
			SELECT DISTINCT ProposalSummaryPK, COUNT(ProposalSummaryPK) OVER(Partition by ProposalSummaryPK) AS BuildingCount,BuildingName
			FROM #tblProposalSummary GROUP BY ProposalSummaryPK, BuildingName,BuildingUnitFK ORDER BY BuildingCount ASC,ProposalSummaryPK,BuildingName ASC

			/************ CHECK IF WE HAVE MULTIPLE Building Units *************/
			IF ( @CountOfBuildingsInXML> 1 )
			BEGIN
				/***** Iterate through the Business Units that has a count for the given Stock Item *****/
				/* Variables for the outer cursor iteration _PickProposal */
					DECLARE @PalletCount_PickProposal DECIMAL(18,3)
					DECLARE @BuildingUnitFK_PickProposal INT
					DECLARE @ProposalPK_PickProposal INT
					DECLARE @BuildingCount_PickProposal INT
					DECLARE @TempProposalPK INT

				/* Declaration, instantiation and initialising Cursor */
				DECLARE PickProposals CURSOR FAST_FORWARD FOR  
					SELECT ps.BuildingUnitFK, ps.UnitsFulfillable, ps.ProposalSummaryPK,co.BuildingCount
					FROM #tblProposalSummary ps inner join #tblCountOverview co on ps.ProposalSummaryPK = co.SubSumSetPK
					WHERE co.BuildingCount < @CountOfBuildingsInXML 
					ORDER BY co.BuildingCount ASC

				OPEN PickProposals
				FETCH NEXT FROM PickProposals INTO @BuildingUnitFK_PickProposal, @PalletCount_PickProposal,@ProposalPK_PickProposal, @BuildingCount_PickProposal

				/* Iterating through the Building Units that successfully seems to be able to replace pallets in the XML file) **/
				WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0   
				BEGIN   
					/* Variables for the inner cursor iteration  _Iterate */
					DECLARE @PalletPK_Iterate INT
					DECLARE @PalletStatusFK_Iterate INT
					DECLARE @Units_Iterate DECIMAL(18,3)
					DECLARE @BuildingUnitFK_Iterate INT
					DECLARE @ExcludePallets XML
					DECLARE @PickedPallets XML

					DECLARE Iterate CURSOR FAST_FORWARD FOR
					SELECT * FROM #tblPickedPallets
					OPEN Iterate
					FETCH NEXT FROM Iterate INTO @PalletPK_Iterate, @PalletStatusFK_Iterate, @Units_Iterate,@BuildingUnitFK_Iterate
					WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS=0
					BEGIN
							select @ExcludePallets = (select ReplacementPalletFK from #tblProposals where ProposalPK = @ProposalPK_PickProposal for XML RAW ('Pallet'), 
							ROOT ('ExclusionPallets'), ELEMENTS)
							select @PickedPallets  = (select PalletPK from #tblPickedPallets for XML RAW('Pallet'), ROOT ('PickedPallets'), ELEMENTS)
							
							exec spStockOrderPickPopulateOrderByTable @StockItemFK=@var_stockItemFK,@Units=@Units_Iterate,@BuildingUnitFK = @BuildingUnitFK_PickProposal, 
								@Batch=@var_batch, @PalletStatusFK=@PalletStatusFK_Iterate,@ExclusionPallets=@ExcludePallets, @PickedPallets=@PickedPallets,
									@PickedPalletFK=@PalletReplacementFK OUTPUT,@ResultsForBuildingUnitOptimizer=1

							IF (@PalletReplacementFK<>0) BEGIN
								INSERT INTO #tblProposals(ProposalPK,OriginalPalletFK,ReplacementPalletFK,OriginalBuildingUnitFK,ReplacementBuildingUnitFK,Units)
								VALUES (@ProposalPK_PickProposal,@PalletPK_Iterate,@PalletReplacementFK,@BuildingUnitFK_Iterate,@BuildingUnitFK_PickProposal,@Units_Iterate)
							END				
						FETCH NEXT FROM Iterate INTO @PalletPK_Iterate,@PalletStatusFK_Iterate,@Units_Iterate,@BuildingUnitFK_Iterate
					END

					CLOSE Iterate
					DEALLOCATE Iterate

					select @CountOfPalletsInOriginalProposal=sum(Units) from #tblPickedPallets
					select @CountOfPalletsInCurrentProposal=sum(Units) from #tblProposals  where ProposalPK = @ProposalPK_PickProposal

					IF ((@CountOfPalletsInCurrentProposal>=@CountOfPalletsInOriginalProposal)) BEGIN
						Update #tblProposalSummary set ProposalVerified = 1 where ProposalSummaryPK=@ProposalPK_PickProposal
						SET @GlobalSearchResult = 0
					END   

					FETCH NEXT FROM PickProposals INTO @BuildingUnitFK_PickProposal, @PalletCount_PickProposal,@ProposalPK_PickProposal,@BuildingCount_PickProposal
				END
				CLOSE PickProposals
				DEALLOCATE PickProposals
			END
			ELSE 
			BEGIN
				/* The pick sent in as a parameter only has one building then it is poINTless to optimise it */
				SELECT NULL as 'OneBuilding'
				RETURN
			END

			SELECT @GlobalSearchResult=Count(ProposalVerified) FROM #tblProposalSummary WHERE ProposalVerified = 1	
			SELECT TOP 1 @GlobalSearchResult = a.ProposalSummaryPK FROM
			(
				SELECT 
					ps.ProposalSummaryPK as [ProposalSummaryPK],
					count(ps.ProposalSummaryPK)[BuildingCount]
				FROM 
					#tblProposalSummary ps 
				where ps.ProposalVerified = 1
				GROUP BY 
					ps.ProposalSummaryPK,PS.BuildingName
			) a
			ORDER BY 
				a.BuildingCount ASC

			IF (@GlobalSearchResult > 0) 
			BEGIN			
				/* Delete existing pallets in the @tblPickedPallets table */
				DECLARE @RecCount int
				SELECT @RecCount=count(OriginalPalletFK) FROM #tblProposals WHERE ProposalPK = @GlobalSearchResult

				IF (@RecCount > 0) 
				BEGIN
					DELETE FROM #tblPickedPallets WHERE PalletPK in (SELECT OriginalPalletFK FROM #tblProposals WHERE ProposalPK = @GlobalSearchResult)
					INSERT INTO #tblPickedPallets(PalletPK,BuildingUnitFK, Units) (SELECT TOP(@PalletsRequired) ReplacementPalletFK, ReplacementBuildingUnitFK, Units 
					FROM #tblProposals WHERE ProposalPK = @GlobalSearchResult)
		
					SELECT PalletPK as SuggestedPK, PalletPK, Units, '' as CustomerPalletNumber, '' as CustomerBarcode  FROM #tblPickedPallets 
					union 
					SELECT TOP(@PalletsRequired) ReplacementPalletFK as PalletPK, ReplacementPalletFK as SuggestedPK, Units, '' as CustomerPalletNumber, 
					'' as CustomerBarcode FROM #tblProposals WHERE ProposalPK = @GlobalSearchResult
					for XML RAW ('Pallet'), ROOT ('PickedPallets'), ELEMENTS
				END		
				ELSE
				BEGIN
					SELECT NULL	as 'NoResult'
				END

				/* Return the selected pallets in XML format to calling party */
			END
			ELSE /* The stored procedure could not find a replacement for the pick */		
				SELECT NULL as 'No replacement'

			--IF (EXISTS (SELECT * 
			--				FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES 
			--				WHERE TABLE_NAME = '#tblTempPalletSelectionTable'))
			--BEGIN
			--	DROP TABLE #tblTempPalletSelectionTable
			--END

			--SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED
			--RETURN

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end
						
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END
GO

	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY
			
			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start

			/* DEBUG */

			*/
		--	<PalletPK>141947</PalletPK><Units>14976.000</Units></Pallet><Pallet>
			/*
			set @var_pickXml = 	'<PickedPallets>
			<Pallet><PalletPK>141942</PalletPK><Units>14976.000</Units></Pallet>

			set @var_stockItemFK = 52816

			set @var_requiredStatusFK = 1

			--set @var_pickXml = '<PickedPallets><Pallet><PalletPK>90745</PalletPK><Units>1728.000</Units></Pallet><Pallet><PalletPK>92628</PalletPK><Units>720.000</Units></Pallet><Pallet><PalletPK>90746</PalletPK><Units>1728.000</Units></Pallet><Pallet><PalletPK>90747</PalletPK><Units>1728.000</Units></Pallet><Pallet><PalletPK>90748</PalletPK><Units>1728.000</Units></Pallet><Pallet><PalletPK>90749</PalletPK><Units>1728.000</Units></Pallet><Pallet><PalletPK>90756</PalletPK><Units>1728.000</Units></Pallet><Pallet><PalletPK>90757</PalletPK><Units>1728.000</Units></Pallet><Pallet><PalletPK>90758</PalletPK><Units>1728.000</Units></Pallet></PickedPallets>'
			--set @var_pickXml = '<PickedPallets><Pallet><PalletPK>90745</PalletPK><Units>1728.000</Units></Pallet><Pallet><PalletPK>90746</PalletPK><Units>1728.000</Units></Pallet><Pallet><PalletPK>90747</PalletPK><Units>1728.000</Units></Pallet><Pallet><PalletPK>90748</PalletPK><Units>1728.000</Units></Pallet><Pallet><PalletPK>90749</PalletPK><Units>1728.000</Units></Pallet><Pallet><PalletPK>90756</PalletPK><Units>1728.000</Units></Pallet><Pallet><PalletPK>90757</PalletPK><Units>1728.000</Units></Pallet><Pallet><PalletPK>90758</PalletPK><Units>1728.000</Units></Pallet><Pallet><PalletPK>90759</PalletPK><Units>1728.000</Units></Pallet><Pallet><PalletPK>91590</PalletPK><Units>1728.000</Units></Pallet><Pallet><PalletPK>92228</PalletPK><Units>1728.000</Units></Pallet><Pallet><PalletPK>92232</PalletPK><Units>1728.000</Units></Pallet><Pallet><PalletPK>92262</PalletPK><Units>1728.000</Units></Pallet><Pallet><PalletPK>92265</PalletPK><Units>1728.000</Units></Pallet><Pallet><PalletPK>92384</PalletPK><Units>1728.000</Units></Pallet><Pallet><PalletPK>92385</PalletPK><Units>1728.000</Units></Pallet><Pallet><PalletPK>92573</PalletPK><Units>1728.000</Units></Pallet><Pallet><PalletPK>92574</PalletPK><Units>1728.000</Units></Pallet><Pallet><PalletPK>92580</PalletPK><Units>1728.000</Units></Pallet><Pallet><PalletPK>92581</PalletPK><Units>1728.000</Units></Pallet></PickedPallets>'

			/* Two building units */
			/*
			SET @var_pickXml = '<PickedPallets>
				<Pallet><PalletPK>76781</PalletPK><Units>543.800</Units></Pallet>
				<Pallet><PalletPK>76789</PalletPK><Units>543.800</Units></Pallet>
				<Pallet><PalletPK>76781</PalletPK><Units>543.800</Units></Pallet>
				<Pallet><PalletPK>76789</PalletPK><Units>543.800</Units></Pallet>
				<Pallet><PalletPK>76781</PalletPK><Units>543.800</Units></Pallet>
				<Pallet><PalletPK>76789</PalletPK><Units>543.800</Units></Pallet>
				<Pallet><PalletPK>76781</PalletPK><Units>543.800</Units></Pallet>

				<Pallet><PalletPK>76817</PalletPK><Units>543.800</Units></Pallet>
				</PickedPallets>'
			*/			

			/* DEBUG ON */
			/*
			set @var_stockItemFK = 40859
			set @var_batch = 'SA00000678'
			set @var_requiredStatusFK = 1
			*/

		/* Initialization */
			DECLARE @RequestedPallets INT
			DECLARE @alternatePickFound INT

		  -- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from
			  -- INTerfering with SELECT statements.

			  /******** DECLARE TABLES ************/
			DECLARE @tblPickedPallets TABLE 
			(
				PalletPK INT,
				PalletStatusFK INT,
				Units DECIMAL(18,3),
				BuildingUnitFK INT
			)

			DECLARE @tblOrigPickedPallets TABLE 
			(
				PalletPK INT,
				PalletStatusFK INT,
				Units DECIMAL(18,3),
				BuildingUnitFK INT
			)

			DECLARE @tblProposals TABLE 
			(
				ProposalPK INT,
				OriginalPalletFK INT,
				ReplacementPalletFK INT,
				OriginalBuildingUnitFK INT,
				ReplacementBuildingUnitFK INT,
				Units DECIMAL(18,3)
			)

			Declare @tblBuildingUnitTotals TABLE
			(
				BuildingUnitFK INT,
				Units Decimal(18,3)
			)

			/******** GET XML INTO TABLE WITH BUILDINGUNITFK ************/
			INSERT INTO @tblPickedPallets (PalletPK, PalletStatusFK, Units, BuildingUnitFK) 
			SELECT ParamValues.Pallets.value('PalletPK[1]','INT') as PalletPK,
			pals.PalletStatusFK,
			ParamValues.Pallets.value('Units[1]','DECIMAL(18,3)') as Units,
			pals.BuildingUnitFK
			FROM @var_pickXml.nodes('//Pallet') as ParamValues(Pallets)
			INNER JOIN tblPallets pals ON
			pals.PalletPK = ParamValues.Pallets.value('PalletPK[1]','INT')

			/*Make An Original Copy if we need it again*/
			INSERT INTO @tblOrigPickedPallets
			Select * from @tblPickedPallets

			/* Initialisation process */
	
			/********* Declare Variables needed for processing ***********/
			DECLARE @PalletsRequired INT
			DECLARE @unitsRequired decimal(18,3)
			DECLARE @unitsRequiredOutsideOfTarget decimal(18,3)
			DECLARE @GlobalSearchResult INT
			DECLARE @targetBuildingUnitFK INT
		
			/******* Get the number of building units in the current pallet pick *****/
			/* Count the pallets in the XML package */			
			--SELECT @CountOfPalletsInXML=count(BuildingUnitFk) from @tblPickedPallets
			SELECT @unitsRequired=sum(Units) from @tblPickedPallets

			/* Count the different buildings */
			DECLARE @CountOfBuildingsInXML INT
			SELECT @CountOfBuildingsInXML = COUNT(a.num) FROM (
				SELECT COUNT(BuildingUnitFK) AS num FROM @tblPickedPallets GROUP BY BuildingUnitFK
			) AS a

			SELECT @PalletsRequired=count(*) from @tblPickedPallets
	
			IF(@CountOfBuildingsInXML > 1) 
			BEGIN
				--We have multiple buildings in this pick, try something!
				--Find out which building has the most picked and base from that
				INSERT into @tblBuildingUnitTotals
				Select BuildingUnitFK, Sum(Units)
				From @tblPickedPallets GROUP BY BuildingUnitFK

				Select Top 1 @targetBuildingUnitFK = BuildingUnitFK from @tblBuildingUnitTotals
				Order By Units DESC

				--Find out total units in other building units, we will need this to come from our taget bu
				Select @unitsRequiredOutsideOfTarget = sum(Units) 
				from @tblPickedPallets
				WHERE BuildingUnitFK <> @targetBuildingUnitFK

				--Find out if there is enough stock of this material etc in the taget to make the pick
				IF((Select sum(AvailableUnits)
					FROM tblPalletContent pc
					INNER JOIN tblPallets pals on
					pals.PalletPK = pc.PalletFK
					Where StockItemFK = @var_stockItemFK
					AND PalletStatusFK = @var_requiredStatusFK
					AND AvailableUnits > 0
					AND PalletFK NOT IN (Select PalletPK From @tblPickedPallets)) >= @unitsRequiredOutsideOfTarget
				) BEGIN
				/*We have enough in our target bu to make the pick. Find and Assign*/
					Print 'We have enough in our target bu unpicked.. will attempt swap'
					/*Cursor for Pallets outside of our taget bu*/
					DECLARE PalletsToRemove CURSOR FAST_FORWARD FOR  
						SELECT picked.PalletPK
						FROM @tblPickedPallets picked 
						WHERE picked.BuildingUnitFK <> @targetBuildingUnitFK

					DECLARE @palletToRemovePK INT

					OPEN PalletsToRemove
			
					FETCH NEXT FROM PalletsToRemove INTO @palletToRemovePK
					DECLARE @runningUnits Decimal(18,3)--may or may not use this
					WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 BEGIN   
						/*Remove a pallet that is outside of target*/
						Delete  
						From @tblPickedPallets
						Where PalletPK = @palletToRemovePK
						Print 'Deleted PAlletPK ' + cast(@palletToRemovePK as nvarchar(50))
						/*Replace the pallet with that of something in our target bu*/
						INSERT INTO @tblPickedPallets
						Select Top 1 pals.PalletPK, pals.PalletStatusFK, pc.AvailableUnits, pals.BuildingUnitFK
						FROM tblPalletContent pc
						INNER JOIN tblPallets pals on
						pals.PalletPK = pc.PalletFK
						Where StockItemFK = @var_stockItemFK
						AND PalletStatusFK = @var_requiredStatusFK
						AND AvailableUnits > 0
						AND PalletFK NOT IN (Select PalletPK From @tblPickedPallets)

						Print 'Inserted BAck'

						FETCH NEXT FROM PalletsToRemove INTO @palletToRemovePK
					END
					/*We should have a 1 bu pick now (I hope to Jesus)*/

					Select @alternatePickFound = 1
				END 
				ELSE 
					Select @alternatePickFound = 0
		
				IF(@alternatePickFound = 1) 
				BEGIN
					SELECT PalletPK as SuggestedPK, PalletPK, Units, '' as CustomerPalletNumber, '' as CustomerBarcode  FROM @tblPickedPallets 
					for XML RAW ('Pallet'), ROOT ('PickedPallets'), ELEMENTS
				END	
				ELSE 
					SELECT NULL as 'No replacement'
			END 
			ELSE 
				SELECT NULL as 'No replacement'
					
			--SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED
			--RETURN

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end
						
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END
GO

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spStockOrderPickPopulateOrderByTable]
(
	@StockItemFK INT,
	@Units DECIMAL(18,3),
	@BuildingUnitFK INT,
	@Batch NVARCHAR(300),
	@PalletStatusFK INT,
	@ExclusionPallets XML,

	@ResultsForBuildingUnitOptimizer int = 0
)
AS
BEGIN

    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT
	,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;
	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	DECLARE @var_StockItemFK int, @var_Units decimal(18,3), @var_BuildingUnitFK int, @var_Batch nvarchar(300), @var_PalletStatusFK int, @var_ExclusionPallets xml, 
	@var_PickedPallets xml, @var_ResultsForBuildingUnitOptimizer int

	SET @var_StockItemFK = @StockItemFK; SET @var_Units = @Units; SET @var_BuildingUnitFK = @BuildingUnitFK; SET @var_Batch = @Batch 
	SET @var_PalletStatusFK = @PalletStatusFK; SET @var_ExclusionPallets = @ExclusionPallets; SET @var_PickedPallets = @PickedPallets
	SET @var_ResultsForBuildingUnitOptimizer = @ResultsForBuildingUnitOptimizer

	SET @ParameterDetails = '@StockItemFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_StockItemFK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@Units = ' 
		+ ISNULL(CAST(@var_Units AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@BuildingUnitFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_BuildingUnitFK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') 
			+ ',@Batch = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_Batch AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@PalletStatusFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_PalletStatusFK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') 
				+ ',@ExclusionPallets = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_ExclusionPallets AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@PickedPallets = ' 
					+ ISNULL(CAST(@var_PickedPallets AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@ResultsForBuildingUnitOptimizer = ' 
						+ ISNULL(CAST(@var_ResultsForBuildingUnitOptimizer AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'')

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    --BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

		SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END

	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY
			

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start

			/* DEBUGGING STORED PROCEDURE */
			/*		
			DECLARE @var_StockItemFK INT
			DECLARE @var_Units DECIMAL(18,3)
			DECLARE @var_BuildingUnitFK INT
			DECLARE @var_Batch NVARCHAR(300)
			DECLARE @var_PalletStatusFK INT
			DECLARE @var_ExclusionPallets XML
			DECLARE @var_PickedPallets XML
			DECLARE @PickedPalletFK INT 
			DECLARE @var_ResultsForBuildingUnitOptimizer int
	
			SET @var_Batch = ''
			SET @var_StockItemFK = 53632
			SET @var_Units = 3700.000
			SET @var_BuildingUnitFK = 44
			SET @var_PalletStatusFK = 1
			SET @var_ResultsForBuildingUnitOptimizer = 0

	
			SET @var_ExclusionPallets = ''

			SET @var_PickedPallets = '<PickedPallets><Pallet><PalletPK>138544</PalletPK><Units>3700.000</Units></Pallet><Pallet><PalletPK>138552</PalletPK><Units>3700.000</Units></Pallet></PickedPallets>'
			--SET @var_PickedPallets = '<PickedPallets><Pallet><PalletPK>20888</PalletPK></Pallet></PickedPallets>'
			*/
			/* DEBUGGING STORED PROCEDURE END */

			/* DECLARE VARIABLES AND TABLE VARIABLES */
			DECLARE @PalletReplacementFK INT
			DECLARE @DynamicSQL NVARCHAR(4000)
			DECLARE @OrderByClause NVARCHAR(100)

			IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#tblExclusionPallets') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #tblExclusionPallets

			CREATE TABLE #tblExclusionPallets(PalletFK INT)

			/******** GET XML INTO TABLE WITH BUILDINGUNITFK ************/
			INSERT INTO #tblExclusionPallets (PalletFK) 
			SELECT ParamExclusionValues.Pallets.value('ReplacementPalletFK[1]','INT') AS PalletPK
			FROM @var_ExclusionPallets.nodes('//Pallet') AS ParamExclusionValues(Pallets)

			--IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#tblPickedPallets') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #tblPickedPallets

			--CREATE TABLE #tblPickedPallets(PalletFK INT)

			--/******** GET XML INTO TABLE WITH BUILDINGUNITFK ************/
			--INSERT INTO #tblPickedPallets(PalletFK) 
			--SELECT ParamPickedValues.Pallets.value('PalletPK[1]','INT') AS PalletPK
			--FROM @var_PickedPallets.nodes('//Pallet') AS ParamPickedValues(Pallets)

			IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#tblTempPalletSelectionTable') IS NOT NULL
				DROP table #tblTempPalletSelectionTable 

			--IF (EXISTS (SELECT * 
			--				FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES
			--				WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'STAWMS'  
			--				AND TABLE_NAME = '#tblTempPalletSelectionTable'))
			--BEGIN
			--	TRUNCATE TABLE #tblTempPalletSelectionTable
			--END
			--ELSE
			--BEGIN

				--CREATE TABLE #tblTempPalletSelectionTable
				--(PalletFK INT, Batch nvarchar(300),ExpiryDate datetime, DateOfManufacture datetime, BestBefore datetime, DateOfReceipt datetime, InsertedDate datetime, 
				--Row nvarchar(50), BuildingUnitColumn int)

			--END
	
			--IF (@var_ResultsForBuildingUnitOptimizer = 0 ) 
			--BEGIN
				--Print 'TAG1'
				--INSERT INTO #tblTempPalletSelectionTable 
				SELECT 
					pallets.PalletPK AS PalletFK,
					palletContent.Batch,
					palletContent.ExpiryDate,
					palletContent.DateOfManufacture,
					palletContent.BestBefore,
					palletContent.DateOfReceipt,
					palletAudit.InsertedDate,
					isnull(rLocs.[Row], 'Z') AS [Row],
					isnull(rLocs.BuildingUnitColumn, 1) AS BuildingUnitColumn,
					isnull(rLocs.BayLevel, 'A') AS BayLevel,

					-- Cathal OCuirrin 08/12/2017 Start - note: this code is copied from spStockOrderGetAvailablePalletContentByBuildingUnitPickRules
					-- Added because this proc was failing when spAutoPickRuleFactory, run further down, returned these 2 columns in the ORDER BY string'
					sameRow.UnitsInRow,
					PalletMovements.Updateddate as MovementDate,
					pallets.BayPosition
					-- Cathal OCuirrin 08/12/2017 End
				INTO
					#tblTempPalletSelectionTable
				FROM 
					tblPallets pallets 
				LEFT OUTER JOIN ViewRackingLocations rLocs on
				pallets.LocationTypeFK = 1 /*Racking Only*/
				AND rLocs.BuildingUnitBayPK = pallets.LocationFK
				INNER JOIN tblPalletContent palletContent ON pallets.PalletPK = palletContent.PalletFK										
				LEFT JOIN tblPalletAudit palletAudit on pallets.PalletPK = palletAudit.PalletFK and EventTypeFK=1
				INNER JOIN tblStockItems si ON si.StockItemPK = @var_StockItemFK and palletContent.StockItemFK = si.StockItemPK
				INNER JOIN tblDivisions divs ON divs.DivisionPK = si.DivisionFK

				-- Cathal OCuirrin 08/12/2017 Start - note: this code is copied from spStockOrderGetAvailablePalletContentByBuildingUnitPickRules.
				-- I changed the INNER JOINS to LEFT OUTER JOINS and the CROSS APPLY to OUTER APPLY to ensure the new code does not affect the original results.
				left outer join viewPalletLocations palletLocation 
					ON palletLocation.palletPK = pallets.palletPk
				left outer JOIN (
					SELECT count(p.palletpk) PalletsInRow, sum(AvailableUnits) UnitsInRow, palletLocation.[Location] 
					FROM @var_PickedPallets.nodes('//FK') as ParamValues(PalletPK) 
					inner join tblPallets p on p.palletpk = ParamValues.PalletPK.value('VALUE[1]','INT')
					INNER JOIN (Select PalletFK, StockItemFK, Batch, sum(AvailableUnits) AvailableUnits from tblpalletcontent Group By PalletFK, 
					StockItemFK, Batch) pc on pc.palletfk = p.palletpk
					inner join viewPalletLocations palletLocation ON palletLocation.palletPK = p.palletPk
					WHERE availableunits > 0 --and p.LocationTypeFK = 1
					GROUP BY palletLocation.Location, p.LocationTypeFK
				) AS sameRow on palletLocation.Location = sameRow.Location
				outer apply (
					select top 1 palletFK, UpdatedDate
					from tblworksordermovements
					where palletFK = pallets.PalletPK
					order by updateddate desc
				) AS PalletMovements
				-- Cathal OCuirrin 08/12/2017 End
				WHERE 
				(
					(pallets.PalletPK not in (SELECT ISNULL(PalletFK,-1) FROM #tblExclusionPallets) AND @var_ResultsForBuildingUnitOptimizer = 0)
					OR
					(pallets.PalletPK not in (SELECT PalletFK FROM #tblExclusionPallets) AND @var_ResultsForBuildingUnitOptimizer <> 0)
				)
					--LJF Changed the following to allow other pallets to swap
					--LJF Changed this again to look if we need to pick exact as this was messing up GSK picks
					--AND palletContent.AvailableUnits = @var_Units
					--AND palletContent.AvailableUnits between (@var_Units - (@var_Units/100)*10) AND (@var_Units + (@var_Units/100)*10)
					AND (
						(divs.PickTypeFK = 2 /*SIMPLE*/ AND palletContent.AvailableUnits between (@var_Units - (@var_Units/100)*10) AND (@var_Units + (@var_Units/100)*10))
						OR
						(divs.PickTypeFK = 1 /*EXACT*/ AND palletContent.AvailableUnits = @var_Units)
					)
					--AND pallets.BuildingUnitFK = @var_BuildingUnitFK
					AND (palletContent.Batch = @var_Batch or @var_Batch = 'NOBATCH')
					AND palletContent.StockItemFK = @var_StockItemFK
					AND pallets.PalletStatusFK = @var_PalletStatusFK
			--END
			--ELSE
			--BEGIN
			--	--Print 'TAG2'
			--	--INSERT INTO #tblTempPalletSelectionTable 
			--	SELECT pallets.PalletPK AS PalletFK,
			--		palletContent.Batch,

			--		palletContent.BestBefore,

			--		--AND palletContent.AvailableUnits = @var_Units

			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END

					/* Variables for the inner cursor iteration  _Iterate */
					DECLARE @ProposalPK_PickProposal INT

								VALUES (@ProposalPK_PickProposal,@PalletPK_Iterate,@PalletReplacementFK,@Units_Iterate)
							END
					
						END

					END

			--BEGIN

				/* Delete existing pallets in the @tblPickedPallets table */
				IF ((SELECT COUNT(*) from #tblProposals) >0)
				BEGIN
					SELECT ReplacementPalletFK as PalletPK, ReplacementPalletFK as SuggestedPK, Units, '' as CustomerPalletNumber, '' as CustomerBarcode 
					FROM #tblProposals for XML RAW ('Pallet'), ROOT ('PickedPallets'), ELEMENTS

			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH

-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spStockOrderPickSwapPallet] 
(
	@palletPK int,
	@units decimal(17,3),
	@palletStatusFK int,
	@pickedPalletFKs nvarchar(3000),
    @stockItemFK INT,
    @batch NVARCHAR(300),
    @requiredStatusFK INT
)
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT
	,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;
	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	DECLARE @var_palletPK int, @var_units decimal(17,3), @var_palletStatusFK int, @var_pickedPalletFKs nvarchar(3000), @var_stockItemFK int, 
	@var_batch nvarchar(300), @var_requiredStatusFK int

	SET @var_palletPK = @palletPK; SET @var_units = @units; SET @var_palletStatusFK = @palletStatusFK; SET @var_pickedPalletFKs = @pickedPalletFKs
	SET @var_stockItemFK = @stockItemFK; SET @var_batch = @batch; SET @var_requiredStatusFK = @requiredStatusFK

	SET @ParameterDetails = '@palletPK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_palletPK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@units = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_units AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') 
		+ ',@palletStatusFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_palletStatusFK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@pickedPalletFKs = ' 
			+ ISNULL(CAST(@var_pickedPalletFKs AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@stockItemFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_stockItemFK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') 
				+ ',@batch = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_batch AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@requiredStatusFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_requiredStatusFK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'')

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    --BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

		SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END

	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY
			
			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start

			Declare @palletLocationTypeFK int
			Declare @rackingTypeFK int
			--Declare @var_stockItemFK int
			--Declare @var_batch nvarchar(1000)
			Declare @buildingUnitFK int
			Declare @buildingUnitRowPK int
			Declare @buildingUnitColumn int
			Declare @bayLevel nvarchar(5)
			Declare @lastMovementPalletAuditFK int

			Select @palletLocationTypeFK = LocationTypeFK, @buildingUnitFK = buRows.BuildingUnitFK, @buildingUnitRowPK = buCols.BuildingUnitRowFK, 
			@buildingUnitColumn = buCols.BuildingUnitColumn, @bayLevel = buBays.BayLevel, @rackingTypeFK = buRows.RackingTypeFK
			from tblPallets pals 
			left outer join tblBuildingUnitBays buBays on
			buBays.BuildingUnitBayPK = pals.LocationFK
			left outer join tblBuildingUnitColumns buCols on
			buCols.BuildingUnitColumnPK = buBays.BuildingUnitColumnFK
			left outer join tblBuildingUnitRows buRows on
			buRows.BuildingUnitRowPK = buCols.BuildingUnitRowFK
			where PalletPK = @var_palletPK

			Select @lastMovementPalletAuditFK = isnull(MAX(PalletAuditPK), 0) 
			from tblPalletAudit 
			Where PalletFK = @var_palletPK
			AND EventTypeFK = 17

			IF(@palletLocationTypeFK <> 1) 
			BEGIN
				--Our pallet is not in racking, exit
				Select -1 as SuggestedPK,
				-1 PalletPK,
				0 Units,
				'' CustomerPalletNumber,
				'' CustomerBarcode
				return
			END

			IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#tblSwap') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #tblSwap

			CREATE TABLE #tblSwap 
			(
				SuggestedPK int,
				PalletPK int,
				Units decimal(17,3),
				CustomerPalletNumber nvarchar(200),
				CustomerBarcode nvarchar(200)
			)
	
			Select Top 1 @var_stockItemFK = StockItemFK, @var_batch = Batch from tblPalletContent where PalletFK = @var_palletPK

			insert into #tblSwap
			Select Top 1 pals.PalletPK as SuggestedPK,
			pals.PalletPK,
			pc.AvailableUnits,
			pals.CustomerPalletNumber,
			pals.CustomerBarcode
			from tblPallets pals 
			inner join (
				Select PalletFK, StockItemFK, Batch, sum(AvailableUnits) AvailableUnits
				from tblPalletContent 
				Where IsArchived = 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/
				group by PalletFK, StockItemFK, Batch
			) pc on
			pc.PalletFK = pals.PalletPK
			inner join tblBuildingUnitBays buBays on
			buBays.BuildingUnitBayPK = pals.LocationFK
			left outer join tblBuildingUnitColumns buCols on
			buCols.BuildingUnitColumnPK = buBays.BuildingUnitColumnFK
			left outer join (
				Select isnull(MAX(PalletAuditPK), 0) PalletAuditPK, PalletFK
				from tblPalletAudit 
				Where EventTypeFK = 17
				Group By PalletFK
			)lastMovement on
			lastMovement.PalletFK = pals.PalletPK
	
			WHERE pals.IsArchived = 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/ 
			AND pals.BuildingUnitFK = @buildingUnitFK
			AND pals.LocationTypeFK = 1 --We only want to swap racked for racked **swapping for loading bay/SDs will over complicate for now 
			AND pals.PalletStatusFK = @var_palletStatusFK
			AND buCols.BuildingUnitRowFK = @buildingUnitRowPK
			AND pc.StockItemFK = @var_stockItemFK
			AND (pc.Batch = @var_batch or @var_batch='NOBATCH')
			AND pc.AvailableUnits = @var_units
			AND ',' + @var_pickedPalletFKs + ',' NOT LIKE '%,' + CAST(pals.PalletPK AS varchar(100)) + ',%'
			AND pals.PalletPK not in (
				Select PalletFK
				from tblContainerOutLinePalletContent colpc
				inner join tblContainerOutLines cols on
				cols.ContainerOutLinePK = colpc.ContainerOutLineFK
				inner join tblContainerOuts cOuts on
				cOuts.ContainerOutPK = cols.ContainerOutFK
				Where cOuts.ContainerOutStatusFK in (1,2,3,4) --Current
			)
	
			AND ((@rackingTypeFK = 1 AND
					(
						buCols.BuildingUnitColumn > @buildingUnitColumn
						OR
						(
							buCols.BuildingUnitColumn = @buildingUnitColumn AND buBays.BayLevel < @bayLevel
						)
					)
				)
				OR
				(@rackingTypeFK = 2 AND lastMovement.PalletAuditPK > @lastMovementPalletAuditFK)
				)

			Order By 
				case when @rackingTypeFK = 1 then buCols.BuildingUnitColumn --DESC, buBays.BayLevel ASC, pals.BayPosition DESC
				when @rackingTypeFK = 2 then lastMovement.PalletAuditPK --DESC
				END DESC,
				case when @rackingTypeFK = 1 then buBays.BayLevel END ASC,
				case when @rackingTypeFK = 1 then pals.BayPosition END DESC

			IF(EXISTS(Select * from #tblSwap)) 
				Select * from #tblSwap
			ELSE 
				Select -1 as SuggestedPK,-1 PalletPK,0 Units,'' CustomerPalletNumber,'' CustomerBarcode 

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end
						
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END
GO

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;

			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
