-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spStockOutBasket]
(
	@ContainerOutFK int,
	@ContainerOutLineFK int
)
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT
 ,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;
	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	DECLARE @ContainerOutFK2 INT
	DECLARE @ContainerOutLineFK2 INT

	SET @ContainerOutFK2 = @ContainerOutFK
	SET @ContainerOutLineFK2 = @ContainerOutLineFK

	SET @ParameterDetails = '@ContainerOutFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@ContainerOutFK2 AS NVARCHAR(20)),'') + ', @ContainerOutLineFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@ContainerOutLineFK2 AS NVARCHAR(20)),'')

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    --BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

		SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END


	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY			

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start
			drop TABLE IF EXISTS #containerLines
			SELECT col.Free1 as LineNum, col.ContainerOutLinePK, col.containerOutfk, col.InsertedDate
			INTO #containerLines
			FROM tblcontaineroutlines col
			WHERE containeroutfk = @ContainerOutFK2 and (@ContainerOutLineFK2 = -1 or ContaineroutlinePk = @ContainerOutLineFK2)

			drop TABLE IF EXISTS #containerPallets
			SELECT colpc.Units, colpc.PalletFK, colpc.PalletContentFK, LineNum, col.ContainerOutLinePK, col.InsertedDate
			INTO #containerPallets
			FROM tblcontaineroutlinepalletcontent colpc
			INNER JOIN #containerLines col ON colpc.containeroutlinefk = col.containeroutlinepk

			drop TABLE IF EXISTS #pallets
			SELECT sum(colpc.Units) AS Units, colpc.PalletFK, LineNum, colpc.ContainerOutLinePK, colpc.InsertedDate, pc.stockitemfk, pc.batch, CASE WHEN p.customerbarcode = '' THEN p.barcode ELSE p.customerbarcode END AS Barcode, palletstatusfk, CustomerPalletNumber
			INTO #pallets
			FROM #containerPallets colpc 
			INNER JOIN tblpalletcontent pc ON colpc.palletcontentfk = pc.PalletContentPK 
			INNER JOIN tblpallets p ON colpc.palletfk = p.PalletPK 
			GROUP BY colpc.PalletFK, colpc.PalletFK, LineNum, colpc.ContainerOutLinePK, colpc.InsertedDate, pc.stockitemfk, pc.batch, CASE WHEN p.customerbarcode = '' THEN p.barcode ELSE p.customerbarcode END, palletstatusfk,CustomerPalletNumber


			drop TABLE IF EXISTS #locations
			SELECT vpl.PalletPK, Building, location, buildingUnitColumnFK
			INTO #locations
			FROM viewPalletLocations vpl
			INNER JOIN #pallets p ON vpl.PalletPK = p.PalletFK


			SELECT distinct td.DivisionPK, RTRIM(LTRIM(td.DivisionCode + ' - ' + td.DivisionName )) DivisionName, 
				vpl.Building, vpl.location, vpl.buildingUnitColumnFK, 
				s.stockitemcode, colpc.batch, 
				colpc.Barcode, colpc.Units as Quantity, colpc.palletfk AS PalletPK, aps.Alias as PalletStatusAlias, aps.PalletStatus as PalletStatus, 
				colpc.LineNum, colpc.ContainerOutLinePK, colpc.InsertedDate, s.Description, s.ManufacturerPartNo, man.Manufacturer, s.stockitempk, 
				case when sl.AvailableUnits is null then colpc.Units else sl.AvailableUnits + colpc.Units end as MaxUnits,
				CustomerPalletNumber
			FROM #pallets colpc 
			INNER JOIN tblstockitems s ON colpc.stockitemfk = s.stockitempk 
			INNER JOIN dbo.tblDivisions td ON s.DivisionFK = td.DivisionPK 
			INNER JOIN #locations vpl ON vpl.PalletPK = colpc.PalletFK 
			INNER JOIN appPalletStatus aps on colpc.palletstatusfk = aps.palletstatuspk 
			left join tblManufacturers man on s.ManufacturerFK = man.ManufacturerPK
			left join (
				select stockitemfk, batch, sum (AvailableUnits) AvailableUnits
				from tblstocklevels sl
				group by stockitemfk, batch
			)sl on sl.StockItemFK = colpc.StockItemFK and sl.Batch = colpc.Batch
			--GROUP BY  td.DivisionPK, RTRIM(LTRIM(td.DivisionCode + ' - ' + td.DivisionName )), 
			--	vpl.Building,  vpl.location, vpl.buildingUnitColumnFK,
			--	s.stockitemcode, colpc.batch, 
			--	colpc.Barcode, colpc.PalletFK,
			--	aps.Alias, aps.PalletStatus, colpc.LineNum, colpc.ContainerOutLinePK, colpc.InsertedDate

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end			
			
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END

			GROUP BY BuildingName + ' - ' + BuildingUnit, BuildingName, BuildingUnit, BuildingUnitPk, PickupLoadingBayFK, StockOrderPK, BuildingPK
			order by BuildingName + ' - ' + BuildingUnit

	@ContainerOutFK int
)
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED

	 DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT
 ,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;
	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	DECLARE @ContainerOutFK2 INT

	SET @ContainerOutFK2 = @ContainerOutFK

	SET @ParameterDetails = '@ContainerOutFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@ContainerOutFK2 AS NVARCHAR(20)),'')

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    --BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

		SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END


	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY
			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start
			IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#TempWorksOrders') IS NOT NULL
				DROP TABLE #TempWorksOrders
			SELECT * INTO #TempWorksOrders from tblworksorders WHERE worksorderoriginfk = 2 and fk IN (SELECT stockorderpk FROM tblstockorders WHERE dbo.tblstockorders.ContainerOutFK = @ContainerOutFK2)

			--delete incomplete movements
			DELETE twom
			FROM dbo.tblWorksOrderMovements twom
			INNER JOIN #TempWorksOrders wo ON twom.worksorderfk = wo.WorksOrderPK 
			WHERE twom.WorksOrderStatusFK <> 3 

			--delete incomplete work
			DELETE twop
			FROM tblworksorderpallets twop
			INNER JOIN #TempWorksOrders wo ON twop.worksorderfk = wo.WorksOrderPK 
			WHERE twop.WorksOrderStatusFK <> 3 

			--we still have completed movements ... make sure the worksorders are completed
			UPDATE wo
			SET wo.worksorderstatusfk = 3 
			FROM tblworksorders wo
			WHERE worksorderpk IN (SELECT distinct WorksOrderFK FROM tblWorksOrderMovements twom INNER JOIN #TempWorksOrders wo ON twom.worksorderfk = wo.WorksOrderPK) AND wo.WorksOrderStatusFK <> 3

			--no completed movements, remove the works orders too
			DELETE FROM tblworksorders 
			WHERE worksorderpk IN (SELECT wo.WorksOrderPK FROM #TempWorksOrders wo LEFT JOIN tblWorksOrderMovements ON worksorderfk = wo.WorksOrderPK WHERE wo.WorksOrderTypeFK IN (3,16) and WorksOrderMovementPK IS NULL)

			--we still have completed work ... make sure the worksorders are completed
			UPDATE wo
			SET wo.worksorderstatusfk = 3 
			FROM tblworksorders wo
			WHERE worksorderpk IN (SELECT distinct WorksOrderFK FROM tblworksorderpallets twop INNER JOIN #TempWorksOrders ON twop.worksorderfk = WorksOrderPK) AND wo.WorksOrderStatusFK <> 3

			--no completed movements, remove the works orders too
			DELETE FROM tblworksorders 
			WHERE worksorderpk IN (SELECT WorksOrderPK FROM #TempWorksOrders LEFT JOIN tblworksorderpallets ON worksorderfk = WorksOrderPK WHERE WorksOrderTypeFK NOT IN (3,16) and WorksOrderPalletPK IS NULL)

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end			
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END

-- =============================================

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spStockOutExtraServiceChecks]
(
	@DivisionFK int
)	
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT
	,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;
	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	DECLARE @DivisionFK2 nvarchar(100);
	SET @DivisionFK2 = @DivisionFK; 

	SET @ParameterDetails = '@DivisionFK = ' + ISNULL(@DivisionFK2,'') 

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    --BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

		SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END

	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY
		
			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start

			
			declare @enddate datetime = getdate()

			declare @startdate datetime = dateadd(m, -1, @enddate)
			--select * from tbldivisions where customerfk = 745

			print @startdate
			print @enddate

			drop table if exists #tmpcontainerouts
			select distinct co.* into #tmpcontainerouts 
			from tblcontainerouts co
			inner join tblcontaineroutlines col on containeroutfk=  containeroutpk
			where DivisionFK = @DivisionFK2 and ContainerOutStatusFK <> 6 and containeroutstagefk > 1 and CollectionDate >= @startdate and CollectionDate <= @enddate
			--select * from appContainerOutStage
			--select * from appContainerOutStatus
			drop table if exists #tmpcontainerlines
			select ContainerOutFK, ContainerOutLinePK, DivisionFK
			into #tmpcontainerlines
			from tblcontaineroutLines 
			inner join #tmpcontainerouts on ContainerOutPK = containeroutfk

			drop table if exists #tmpcoaudit
			select coa.* into #tmpcoaudit
			from tblContainerOutAudit coa 
			inner join #tmpcontainerouts co on ContainerOutPK = ContainerOutFK
			where coa.IncludeInPickListPrintOut = 1 and coa.IsArchived=0

			drop table if exists #Tmp_PalletCount
			Select tco.ContainerOutFK as ContainerOutPK, count(distinct PalletPK) NoPallets, BuildingUnitFK, BuildingName + ' - ' + BuildingUnit as Building 
			INTO #Tmp_PalletCount
			from #tmpcontainerlines tco 
			inner join tblContainerOutLinePalletContent colpc on ContainerOutlinefK = ContainerOutLinePK
			inner join tblPallets p on colpc.palletfk = p.PalletPK
			inner join tblbuildingunits bu on p.BuildingUnitFK = bu.BuildingUnitPK
			inner join tblbuildings b on buildingfk = buildingpk
			group by tco.ContainerOutFK, p.buildingUnitFK, BuildingName + ' - ' + BuildingUnit

			drop table if exists #tmpextraservices
			 SELECT distinct ExtraServicePK AS PK,       
				 case when ess.StockItemFK = -1 THEN 'All' ELSE StockItemCode end AS [Stock Code],     
				 case when ess.DivisionExtraServiceFK > 0 then tdes.Name + ' - ' + cast(tdes.Charge as nvarchar(50)) + ' per ' + isnull(css.ChargeSubject, '') ELSE 'Adhoc: ' + ess.Name end AS [Description],    
				 ess.NumberOf,    
				 ess.Charge,     
				  --CONVERT(VARCHAR(50), ess.ExtraServiceDate, 106) [Date],    
				 Reference  ,
				 StockOrderFK,  cast(ExtraServiceDate as date) ExtraServiceDate
				 into #tmpextraservices
				FROM dbo.tblExtraServices ess    
				LEFT JOIN tblstockitems si  ON ess.StockItemFK = si.StockItemPK    
				LEFT JOIN dbo.tblDivisionExtraServices tdes ON ess.DivisionExtraServiceFK = tdes.DivisionExtraServicePK    
				left outer join appChargeSubjects css on css.ChargeSubjectPK = tdes.ChargeSubjectFK    
				Where StockOrderFK in (select stockorderpk from tblstockorders inner join #tmpcontainerouts on ContainerOutPK = containeroutfk)    

			select GoodsOrderNumber, cast(CollectionDate as date) CollectionDate, ContainerNumber, SealNumber, weight, DocketValue1 [reference], NoPallets, Building, ContainerOutStage [Status], AuditComments, coalesce(ExtraServiceSummary, '') ExtraServices
			from #tmpcontainerouts co
			inner join appcontaineroutstage costage on costage.containeroutstagePK = co.containeroutstagefk
			inner join #Tmp_PalletCount cop on co.ContainerOutPK = cop.ContainerOutPK
			cross apply (
				 Select SUBSTRING(       
			   (       
				 SELECT ',' + Description AS 'data()'       
				  FROM #tmpcoaudit coa WHERE coa.containeroutfK = co.ContainerOutPK FOR XML PATH('')       
			   ), 2 , 9999)  as AuditComments)  subq  
			cross apply (
				Select SUBSTRING(       
			   (       
				 SELECT ',' + Description + ' (No Of '+ cast(NumberOf as nvarchar(50)) + ' : Charge ' + cast(Charge as nvarchar(50)) + ') ' AS 'data()'       
				  FROM #tmpextraservices es WHERE es.reference = co.DocketValue1 FOR XML PATH('')       
			   ), 2 , 9999)  as ExtraServiceSummary)  subqes   
			order by cast(CollectionDate as date), reference, GoodsOrderNumber ,Building

--select * from #tmpextraservices order by cast(ExtraServiceDate as date), Reference

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end
					
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END
GO

AS

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT
 ,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;
	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

	DECLARE @ContainerOutFK2 INT

	SET @ParameterDetails = '@ContainerOutFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@ContainerOutFK2 AS NVARCHAR(20)),'')

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

		SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)

        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY			

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start

			DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #container

			DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #containerPallets

			INTO #containerPallets

			INNER JOIN tblContainerOutLines tcol ON containeroutlinefk = tcol.ContainerOutLinePK  
			WHERE tcol.ContainerOutFK = @ContainerOutFK2
						
			SELECT distinct palletpk, loaded, pickloaded, LocationTypeFK, LorryNumber, containerNumber, SealNumber, twom.worksorderstatusfk AS movementStatusFK  
			FROM #containerPallets tcolpc  
			INNER JOIN #container tso ON 
				tso.containeroutPk = tcolpc.ContainerOutFK AND tso.ResponsibleBuildingUnitFK = tcolpc.BuildingUnitFK  
			LEFT JOIN dbo.tblWorksOrders two ON 
				two.FK = tso.StockOrderPK AND two.WorksOrderOriginFK = 2 AND two.WorksOrderTypeFK = 3  
			LEFT JOIN dbo.tblWorksOrderMovements twom ON twom.worksorderfk = two.WorksOrderPK  
			WHERE twom.worksorderstatusfk IS NOT null
			ORDER BY pickloaded, loaded, LocationTypeFK, twom.worksorderstatusfk

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end

		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END

/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[spSyncPalletBayPositions]    Script Date: 02/11/2026 17:47:27 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
-- exec spSyncPalletBayPositions @LocationPK=14364   
-- exec spSyncPalletBayPositions @LocationPK=1033  

-- ======================================================================
-- Author:  < Archana >
-- Create date: < 11/12/2025 >
-- Description: Synchronize pallet bay positions for Drive-Through racking.
--              Rebuilds BayPosition, PalletStart and PalletEnd and repairs
--              stack positions when the base pallet of a stack is removed.
-- ======================================================================

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spSyncPalletBayPositions]
    @LocationPK INT
AS
BEGIN      
 /* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */      
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED      
      
    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT      
 ,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;      
 SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();      
      
 -- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters      
 DECLARE @var_locationPK INT, @var_isDriveThrough BIT      
 SET @var_locationPK = @LocationPK;       
 SET @ParameterDetails = '@LocationPK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@LocationPK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)), '');      
      
    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL       
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)      
      
    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)      
    --BEGIN      
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC       
      
  SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)      
      
        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)      
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK      
      
        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()      
    --END      
      
      
 SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);      
 SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails      
 ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;      
 INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()      
      
 WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3      
 BEGIN 
    BEGIN TRY
        /*          
           This procedure is Drive-Through only.  The guard is deliberately
           inside the procedure as well as in the caller so a conventional
           bay can never have PalletStart/PalletEnd.
        */
        IF NOT EXISTS
        (
            SELECT 1
            FROM tblBuildingUnitRows AS buRows
            INNER JOIN tblBuildingUnitColumns AS buCols
                ON buCols.BuildingUnitRowFK = buRows.BuildingUnitRowPK
            INNER JOIN tblBuildingUnitBays AS buBays
                ON buBays.BuildingUnitColumnFK = buCols.BuildingUnitColumnPK
            WHERE buBays.BuildingUnitBayPK = @LocationPK
              AND buRows.RackingTypeFK = 2
              AND buBays.IsArchived = 0
        )
        BEGIN
            RETURN;
        END;

        /* Fixed bays must retain their explicitly configured positions. */
        IF EXISTS
        (
            SELECT 1
            FROM tblStockItemFixedLocations
            WHERE BuildingUnitBayFK = @LocationPK
              AND IsArchived = 0
        )
        BEGIN
            RETURN;
        END;

        IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#TempPallets') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #TempPallets;
        IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#AllPallets') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #AllPallets;
        IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#BasePallets') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #BasePallets;
        IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#FinalPallets') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #FinalPallets;

        CREATE TABLE #TempPallets
        (
            PalletPK INT PRIMARY KEY,
            BayPosition INT,
            StackPosition INT,
            BayLevel NVARCHAR(50),
            Width DECIMAL(18,2),
            Margin DECIMAL(18,2),
            CurrentPalletStart DECIMAL(18,2),
            CurrentPalletEnd DECIMAL(18,2)
        );

        /*
           Load the whole column because BayPosition is a sequence within a
           BayLevel and Drive-Through positions have to be rebuilt together.
        */
        INSERT INTO #TempPallets
        (
            PalletPK,
            BayPosition,
            StackPosition,
            BayLevel,
            Width,
            Margin,
            CurrentPalletStart,
            CurrentPalletEnd
        )
        SELECT
            p.PalletPK,
            ISNULL(p.BayPosition, -1),
            ISNULL(p.StackPosition, 0),
            b.BayLevel,
            pt.Width,
            ISNULL(pt.WidthMargin, 20),
            ISNULL(p.PalletStart, 0),
            ISNULL(p.PalletEnd, 0)
        FROM tblPallets AS p
        INNER JOIN tblBuildingUnitBays AS b ON b.BuildingUnitBayPK = p.LocationFK
        INNER JOIN tblPalletTypes AS pt ON pt.PalletTypePK = p.PalletTypeFK
        WHERE b.BuildingUnitColumnFK =
        (
            SELECT BuildingUnitColumnFK
            FROM tblBuildingUnitBays
            WHERE BuildingUnitBayPK = @LocationPK
              AND IsArchived = 0
        )
          AND p.LocationTypeFK = 1
          AND EXISTS
          (
              SELECT 1
              FROM tblBuildingUnitRows AS buRows
              INNER JOIN tblBuildingUnitColumns AS buCols
                  ON buCols.BuildingUnitRowFK = buRows.BuildingUnitRowPK
              WHERE buCols.BuildingUnitColumnPK = b.BuildingUnitColumnFK
                AND buRows.RackingTypeFK = 2
          );

        IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #TempPallets)
          RETURN;

        /*
           Repair stacks before calculating base pallet positions.
           The old movement code promoted StackPosition = 1 to 0 when the
           base pallet was removed.  Here we make that rule deterministic:
             - if a physical start/end group already has a base (0), keep it;
             - otherwise the first pallet in that group becomes the base;
             - remaining pallets in the group become stack positions 1.          
        */
        ;WITH StackGroups AS
        (
            SELECT
                t.PalletPK,
                t.BayLevel,
                t.CurrentPalletStart,
                t.CurrentPalletEnd,
                t.StackPosition,
                t.BayPosition,
                BasePalletPK = MIN
                (
                    CASE WHEN t.StackPosition = 0 THEN t.PalletPK END
                ) OVER
                (
                    PARTITION BY t.BayLevel,
                                 t.CurrentPalletStart,
                                 t.CurrentPalletEnd
                ),
                HasStack = MAX
                (
                    CASE WHEN t.StackPosition > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
                ) OVER
                (
                    PARTITION BY t.BayLevel,
                                 t.CurrentPalletStart,
                                 t.CurrentPalletEnd
                )
            FROM #TempPallets AS t
        ),
        OrderedGroups AS
        (
            SELECT
                s.PalletPK,
                NewStackPosition =
                    ROW_NUMBER() OVER
                    (
                        PARTITION BY s.BayLevel,
                                     s.CurrentPalletStart,
                                     s.CurrentPalletEnd
                        ORDER BY
                            CASE
                                WHEN s.BasePalletPK IS NOT NULL
                                 AND s.PalletPK = s.BasePalletPK THEN 0
                                ELSE 1
                            END,
                            CASE WHEN s.StackPosition < 0 THEN 0 ELSE s.StackPosition END,
                            s.BayPosition,
                            s.PalletPK
                    ) - 1
            FROM StackGroups AS s
            WHERE s.HasStack = 1
        )
        UPDATE t
        SET t.StackPosition = o.NewStackPosition
        FROM #TempPallets AS t
        INNER JOIN OrderedGroups AS o ON o.PalletPK = t.PalletPK;

        /* Persist only the stack repairs made above. */
        UPDATE p WITH (ROWLOCK)
        SET p.StackPosition = t.StackPosition
        FROM tblPallets AS p
        INNER JOIN #TempPallets AS t ON t.PalletPK = p.PalletPK
        WHERE p.StackPosition <> t.StackPosition;

        CREATE TABLE #AllPallets
        (
            PalletPK INT PRIMARY KEY,
            BayLevel NVARCHAR(50),
            BayPositionOriginal INT,
            StackPosition INT,
            Width DECIMAL(18,2),
            Margin DECIMAL(18,2),
            RNAll INT
        );

        /*
           Rebuild BayPosition from the physical ordering.  A stacked pallet
           still gets its own BayPosition, e.g. base = 1, stack = 2, while
           both pallets receive the same PalletStart/PalletEnd later.
        */
        INSERT INTO #AllPallets
        (
            PalletPK,
            BayLevel,
            BayPositionOriginal,
            StackPosition,
            Width,
            Margin,
            RNAll
        )
        SELECT
            t.PalletPK,
            t.BayLevel,
            t.BayPosition,
            t.StackPosition,
            t.Width,
            t.Margin,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER
            (
                PARTITION BY t.BayLevel
                ORDER BY
                    CASE WHEN t.BayPosition < 0 THEN 2147483647 -- Push unassigned positions to the end of the ordering INT.MAX, positive value
                    ELSE t.BayPosition END,
                    t.PalletPK
            ) AS RNAll
        FROM #TempPallets AS t;

        CREATE TABLE #BasePallets
        (
            PalletPK INT PRIMARY KEY,
            BayLevel NVARCHAR(50),
            BayPositionOriginal INT,
            Width DECIMAL(18,2),
            Margin DECIMAL(18,2),
            RNAll INT,
            RNBase INT,
            PalletStart DECIMAL(18,2) DEFAULT 0,
            PalletEnd DECIMAL(18,2) DEFAULT 0
        );

        INSERT INTO #BasePallets
        (
            PalletPK,
            BayLevel,
            BayPositionOriginal,
            Width,
            Margin,
            RNAll,
            RNBase
        )
        SELECT
            a.PalletPK,
            a.BayLevel,
            a.BayPositionOriginal,
            a.Width,
            a.Margin,
            a.RNAll,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER
            (
                PARTITION BY a.BayLevel
                ORDER BY a.RNAll
            ) AS RNBase
        FROM #AllPallets AS a
        WHERE a.StackPosition = 0;

        /*
           Calculate the physical start/end of each base pallet.  WidthMargin
           is applied on both sides, matching the existing pallet-position.
        */
        UPDATE b
        SET
            b.PalletStart = ISNULL(prev.SumWidth, 0),
            b.PalletEnd = ISNULL(prev.SumWidth, 0) + b.Width + (b.Margin * 2)
        FROM #BasePallets AS b
        OUTER APPLY
        (
            SELECT SUM(b2.Width + (b2.Margin * 2)) AS SumWidth
            FROM #BasePallets AS b2
            WHERE b2.BayLevel = b.BayLevel
              AND b2.RNBase < b.RNBase
        ) AS prev;

        CREATE TABLE #FinalPallets
        (
            PalletPK INT PRIMARY KEY,
            BayLevel NVARCHAR(50),
            FinalPosition INT,
            FinalPalletStart DECIMAL(18,2),
            FinalPalletEnd DECIMAL(18,2),
            FinalStackPosition INT
        );

        /*
           Every stack pallet inherits its base pallet's physical start/end.
           This means removing a pallet from the middle shifts the remaining
           pallets correctly without simply subtracting one pallet width from
           arbitrary rows.
        */
        INSERT INTO #FinalPallets
        (
            PalletPK,
            BayLevel,
            FinalPosition,
            FinalPalletStart,
            FinalPalletEnd,
            FinalStackPosition
        )
        SELECT
            a.PalletPK,
            a.BayLevel,
            a.RNAll,
            COALESCE(bMatch.PalletStart, 0),
            COALESCE(bMatch.PalletEnd, 0),
            a.StackPosition
        FROM #AllPallets AS a
        OUTER APPLY
        (
            SELECT TOP (1)
                b2.PalletStart,
                b2.PalletEnd
            FROM #BasePallets AS b2
            WHERE b2.BayLevel = a.BayLevel
              AND b2.RNAll <= a.RNAll
            ORDER BY b2.RNAll DESC
        ) AS bMatch;

        UPDATE p WITH (ROWLOCK)
        SET
            p.BayPosition = f.FinalPosition,
            p.StackPosition = f.FinalStackPosition,
            p.PalletStart = f.FinalPalletStart,
            p.PalletEnd = f.FinalPalletEnd
        FROM tblPallets AS p
        INNER JOIN #FinalPallets AS f
            ON f.PalletPK = p.PalletPK;

 -- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end       
   BREAK      
  END TRY      
  BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */      
   DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;      
   SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;      
   SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;      
      
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY       
   BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;      
             
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;      
      
            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID      
                  
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;      
                  
   IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)      
   BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END      
   ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */      
  END CATCH      
  SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1      
 END      
END 
GO

-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Clerkin, Jamie>
-- Create date: <07/20/2015>
-- Description:	<Check if any StockOrder worksOrderMovements exist for a pallet associated to the StockIn worksOrderMovementPK, only allow >
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spSysIssueFixNow]
(
	@SystemIssuePK int,
	@SystemIssueTypeFK int
)
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT
 ,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;
	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	DECLARE @var_SystemIssuePK int, @var_SystemIssueTypeFK int
	SET @var_SystemIssuePK = @SystemIssuePK; SET @var_SystemIssueTypeFK = @SystemIssueTypeFK
	SET @ParameterDetails = '@SystemIssuePK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_SystemIssuePK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@SystemIssueTypeFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_SystemIssueTypeFK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'')

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    --BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

		SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END


	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY
			IF XACT_STATE() = 0 AND @@TRANCOUNT < 1 BEGIN TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start

		--BEGIN TRANSACTION [tran1]	
		--BEGIN TRY

			IF @var_SystemIssueTypeFK = 1 
			BEGIN
				--get the pallet to work with
				Declare @palletfk int
				Declare @palletContentfk int
				Declare @splitPalletContentfk int
				Declare @Units int
				Declare @Eaches int

				select @palletfk = colpc.palletfk, @palletContentfk = palletcontentfk, @splitPalletContentfk = splitpalletcontentfk, 
					@Units = units, @Eaches = eaches
					from tblcontaineroutlinepalletcontent colpc
					inner join tblSystemIssues issue on colpc.containeroutlinepalletcontentpk = issue.FreeInt1
					where issue.SystemIssuepk = @var_SystemIssuePK and SystemIssueTypeFK = @var_SystemIssueTypeFK

				--get location pallet left from
				Declare @DefaultLoadingBayFK int
				Declare @ResponsibleBuildingUnitFK int

				select top 1 @DefaultLoadingBayFK = lb.LoadingBayPK, @ResponsibleBuildingUnitFK = lb.BuildingUnitFK
				from tblLoadingBays lb
					inner join tblstockorders so on so.ResponsibleBuildingUnitFK = lb.BuildingUnitFK
					inner join tblcontainerouts co on co.containeroutpk = so.containeroutfk
					inner join tblcontaineroutlines col on col.containeroutfk = co.containeroutpk
					inner join tblcontaineroutlinepalletcontent colpc on colpc.containeroutlinefk = col.containeroutlinepk
					inner join tblSystemIssues issue on colpc.containeroutlinepalletcontentpk = issue.FreeInt1
				where issue.SystemIssuepk = @var_SystemIssuePK and SystemIssueTypeFK = @var_SystemIssueTypeFK			

				--delete pallet audit of pallet leaving
				delete from tblpalletaudit where eventtypefk = 2 and palletfk = @palletfk				

				--unarchive the pallet and update pallet location
				update tblpallets WITH (ROWLOCK) 
				set isarchived = 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/, buildingunitfk = @ResponsibleBuildingUnitFK, LocationTypeFK = 2, LocationFK = @DefaultLoadingBayFK
				where palletpk = @palletfk

				--unarchive split pallet content, set palletfk and put units / eaches back onto content
				update tblpalletcontent WITH (ROWLOCK) 
				set palletfk = @palletfk, LooseLocationTypeFK = -1, LooseLocationFk = -1, ActualEaches = @Eaches, AvailableEaches = @Eaches, 
				ActualUnits = @Units, AvailableUnits = @Units, isArchived = 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/
				where palletcontentpk = @splitPalletContentfk
	
				--set issue as fixed
				update tblSystemIssues WITH (ROWLOCK) set isfixed = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ where SystemIssuePK = @var_SystemIssuePK

				select 1 as 'RESULT'
			END

			--COMMIT TRANSACTION [tran1]	
		--END TRY
		--BEGIN CATCH
		--	ROLLBACK TRANSACTION [tran1]
		--	PRINT ERROR_MESSAGE()
		--	select 0
		--END CATCH

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end

			BEGIN TRY IF XACT_STATE() = 1 AND @@TRANCOUNT = 1 AND @OpeningTranCount < 1 COMMIT TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH
			
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END
GO

	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY
			IF XACT_STATE() = 0 AND @@TRANCOUNT < 1 BEGIN TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start

	Declare @nextGoodsInNumber int
	--BEGIN TRANSACTION myTRAN
		Select Top 1 @nextGoodsInNumber = NextGoodsInNumber from appSystem WITH (ROWLOCK)
		Update appSystem WITH (ROWLOCK)
		Set NextGoodsInNumber = NextGoodsInNumber + 1
	--COMMIT TRANSACTION myTRAN

	Select @nextGoodsInNumber

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end

			BEGIN TRY IF XACT_STATE() = 1 AND @@TRANCOUNT = 1 AND @OpeningTranCount < 1 COMMIT TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH
			
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END

    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED

	BEGIN

			inner join tblStockIns sins on
			sins.ContainerInFK = cins.ContainerInPK
			where StockInPK = @var_fK

			--ContainerInDetail
			Select ContainerInPK, StockInPK, StockItemCode, sils.Units as Quantity, 
			REPLACE ( sils.ExtraDetails , 'CustomerPalletNumber:' , '' ) as CustomerPalletNumber
			from tblContainerIns cins
			inner join tblStockIns sins on
			sins.ContainerInFK = cins.ContainerInPK
			inner join tblStockInLines sils on
			sils.StockInFK = sins.StockInPK 
			inner join tblStockItems sis on 
			sis.StockItemPK = sils.StockItemFK
			inner join tblStockInLinePallets silps on
			silps.StockInLineFK = sils.StockInLinePK
			where StockInPK = @var_fK

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end

			
			
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
