-- ==========================================================================================================================
-- Author:      Cathal OCuirrin
-- Create Date: 16 April 2019
-- Description: Get the clock/work date for the most recent TMS confirmed (i.e. archived) data in a specific TMS department.
-- ==========================================================================================================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spTMSDepartmentGetLastConfirmedDate] -- spGetTMSDepartmentLastConfirmedDate 'BV1', '20190923'
(
--declare
	@tMSDepartmentName NVARCHAR(200),
	@clockCardDate DATE

	--SELECT @tMSDepartmentName = 'BV1', @clockCardDate = '20190923'
)
AS
BEGIN
	DECLARE
		@varTMSDepartmentName NVARCHAR(200) = @tMSDepartmentName,
		@varTMSDepartmentLastConfirmedWorkDate DATETIME,
		@varNextConfirmDate DATE

	SELECT @varTMSDepartmentLastConfirmedWorkDate = MAX(ClockCardDate) 
	FROM dbo.tblEmployeeScannedPalletMovementDetails 
	WHERE DataForBuilding = @varTMSDepartmentName
	AND IsArchived = 1

--SELECT @varTMSDepartmentLastConfirmedWorkDate AS [@varTMSDepartmentLastConfirmedWorkDate]

	IF @varTMSDepartmentLastConfirmedWorkDate IS NULL
	BEGIN
		SELECT @varNextConfirmDate = MIN(ClockCardDate) 
		FROM dbo.tblEmployeeScannedPalletMovementDetails 
		WHERE DataForBuilding = @varTMSDepartmentName

		--SET @varNextConfirmDate = @varTMSDepartmentLastConfirmedWorkDate
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		SELECT @varNextConfirmDate = MIN(ClockCardDate) 
		FROM dbo.tblEmployeeScannedPalletMovementDetails 
		WHERE DataForBuilding = @varTMSDepartmentName
		AND IsArchived = 0
		AND ClockCardDate > @varTMSDepartmentLastConfirmedWorkDate
	END

	DECLARE @CanConfirmData NVARCHAR(5) = 'false'

	IF @varNextConfirmDate = @clockCardDate
		SET @CanConfirmData = 'true'
	ELSE
		SET @CanConfirmData = 'false'

	SELECT ISNULL(CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), @varTMSDepartmentLastConfirmedWorkDate, 103), '') AS TMSDepartmentLastConfirmedDate, 
	ISNULL(CONVERT(NVARCHAR(8), @varTMSDepartmentLastConfirmedWorkDate, 112), '') AS TMSDepartmentLastConfirmedDateYYYYMMDD,
	REPLACE(ISNULL(CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), @varNextConfirmDate, 103), ''),'/','-') AS NextConfirmDateDDMMYYYY,
	ISNULL(CONVERT(NVARCHAR(8), @varNextConfirmDate, 112), '') AS NextConfirmDateYYYYMMDD,
	@CanConfirmData AS CanConfirmData
END
--ec:
GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[spTopupComplete]    Script Date: 02/11/2026 17:47:27 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO









CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spTopupComplete]
(
	@worksOrderPK int,
	@topupAmount decimal(18,3),
	@userFK int = -1
)
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT
	,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;
	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	DECLARE @var_worksOrderPK int, @var_topupAmount decimal(18,3), @var_userFK int

	SET @var_worksOrderPK = @worksOrderPK; SET @var_topupAmount = @topupAmount; SET @var_userFK = @userFK

	SET @ParameterDetails = '@worksOrderPK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_worksOrderPK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@topupAmount = ' 
		+ ISNULL(CAST(@var_topupAmount AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@userFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_userFK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'')

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    --BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

		SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END

	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY
	
			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start

			Declare @sourceActualUnits decimal(18,3)
			Declare @sourceAvailableUnits decimal(18,3)
			Declare @sourcePalletFK int
			Declare @sourcePalletContentFK int
			Declare @sourceBuildingUnitBayFK int
			Declare @sourceBayPosition int
			Declare @sourceStockItemFK int
			Declare @sourceBatch nvarchar(200)
			Declare @destinationPalletFK int
			Declare @destinationPalletContentFK int
			Declare @destinationBuildingUnitBayFK int
			Declare @destinationBayPosition int
			Declare @destinationPalletTypeFK int
			Declare @destinationPalletStart int
			Declare @destinationPalletEnd int
			Declare @destinationBarcode nvarchar(200)
			Declare @destinationActualUnits decimal(18,3)
			Declare @destinationUnits decimal(18,3)
			Declare @destinationStockItemFK int
			Declare @destinationBatch nvarchar(200)

			Declare @palletCreated bit

			Declare @availableTopupAmount decimal(18,3)

			Declare @AllowMixedTopups bit

			--Top up one  pallet, remove from another

			Select @sourcePalletFK = flts.TopupFromPalletFK,
			@sourcePalletContentFK = sourcePc.PalletContentPK,
			@sourceStockItemFK = sourcePc.StockItemFK,
			@sourceBatch = sourcePc.Batch,
			@sourceActualUnits = sourcePc.ActualUnits,
			@sourceAvailableUnits = sourcePc.AvailableUnits,
			@sourceBayPosition = sourcePallets.BayPosition,
			@sourceBuildingUnitBayFK = sourcePallets.LocationFK,
			@destinationPalletFK = isnull(flps.PalletPK, -1),
			@destinationPalletContentFK = isnull(destinationPc.PalletContentPK, -1),
			@destinationActualUnits = isnull(destinationPc.ActualUnits, 0),
			@destinationUnits = isnull(destinationPc.AvailableUnits, -1),
			@destinationStockItemFK = isnull(destinationPc.StockItemFK, -1),
			@destinationBatch = isnull(destinationPc.Batch, ''),
			@destinationBuildingUnitBayFK = sifls.BuildingUnitBayFK,
			@destinationBayPosition = sifls.BayPosition,
			@destinationPalletTypeFK = sifls.PalletTypeFK,
			@destinationPalletStart = sifls.LocationStart,
			@destinationPalletEnd = sifls.LocationEnd,
			@AllowMixedTopups = div.AllowMixedTopups	
			From tblPalletTopups flts
			inner join tblPallets sourcePallets on
			sourcePallets.PalletPK = flts.TopupFromPalletFK
			inner join tblPalletContent sourcePc on
			sourcePc.PalletFK = flts.TopupFromPalletFK
			inner join tblStockItemFixedLocations sifls on
			sifls.StockItemFixedLocationPK = flts.TopupFixedLocationFK
			left outer join tblPallets flps on
			flps.LocationTypeFK = 1 /*Racking*/
			AND flps.LocationFK = sifls.BuildingUnitBayFK
			AND flps.BayPosition = sifls.BayPosition
			left outer join
			(
				Select PalletContentPK, PalletFK,  StockItemFK, Batch,
					sum(ActualUnits) ActualUnits, 
					sum(AvailableUnits) AvailableUnits 
					from tblPalletContent 
					Group By PalletContentPK, PalletFK, StockItemFK, Batch
			) destinationPc on
			destinationPc.PalletFK = isnull(flps.PalletPK, -999)---999 so that it definately doesnt find pallet content if there is no pallet in the fixed location
			inner join tblstockitems si on sourcePc.stockitemfk = si.stockitempk
			inner join tbldivisions div on si.divisionfk = div.divisionpk	
			Where WorksOrderFK = @var_worksOrderPK

			--If a pallet exists check the topup is of the correct stock and batch
			IF(@destinationPalletFK <> -1) 
			BEGIN
				IF(@destinationStockItemFK <> @sourceStockItemFK) 
				BEGIN 
					Select '[{"FailureReason":"Topup Failed: The pallet you are trying to topup is of a different stock item."}]'
					Return
				END

				IF(@destinationBatch <> @sourceBatch and @AllowMixedTopups = 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/) 
				BEGIN
					Select '[{"FailureReason":"Topup Failed: The pallet you are trying to topup is of a different batch."}]'
					Return
				END
			END

			--Check if the Source pallet Still exists
			IF(not EXISTS(Select * from tblPalletContent where PalletFK = @sourcePalletFK)) 
				Select '[{"FailureReason":"Topup Failed: The pallet you are trying to topup from no longer exists."}]'

			IF XACT_STATE() = 0 AND @@TRANCOUNT < 1 BEGIN TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName

			--couldnt move anything, easy finish
			if(@var_topupAmount = 0)
			BEGIN
				update tblPalletTopups WITH (ROWLOCK) 
				Set TopupUnits = 0,
				UpdatedDate = dbo.GetBSTDate()
				Where WorksOrderFK = @var_worksOrderPK

				update tblWorksOrders WITH (ROWLOCK)
				set WorksOrderStatusFK = 3, /*Complete*/
				UpdatedDate = dbo.GetBSTDate()
				Where WorksOrderPK = @var_worksOrderPK
			END
			ELSE
			BEGIN
				update tblPalletTopups WITH (ROWLOCK) 
				Set TopupUnits = @var_topupAmount,
				UpdatedDate = dbo.GetBSTDate()
				Where WorksOrderFK = @var_worksOrderPK

				--Set the available topup amount
				Select @availableTopupAmount = 
					case when @sourceActualUnits = @sourceAvailableUnits then @var_topupAmount
					when @var_topupAmount > @sourceAvailableUnits then @sourceAvailableUnits
					else @var_topupAmount end

				if(@destinationPalletFK = -1) --No pallet/stock exists
				BEGIN 
					IF(@sourceActualUnits = @var_topupAmount) 
					BEGIN
						update tblPallets WITH (ROWLOCK)
						Set LocationTypeFK = 1/*Racking*/,
						LocationFK = @destinationBuildingUnitBayFK, 
						PalletTypeFK = @destinationPalletTypeFK,
						BayPosition = @destinationBayPosition, 
						PalletStart = @destinationPalletStart, 
						PalletEnd = @destinationPalletEnd
						where PalletPK = @sourcePalletFK

						Set @destinationPalletFK = @sourcePalletFK --Set the destination as the source so the rest of the code will follow as before
						Set @palletCreated = 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/ --NO Pallet was created
					END 
					ELSE --We can only move some of the stock so we will need a new pallet
					BEGIN 
						EXEC [spPalletBarcodeGetNext] @destinationBarcode OUTPUT
						Print 'About to insert into pallet'
						Insert into tblPallets
						Select BuildingUnitFK, 1/*Racking*/, @destinationBuildingUnitBayFK, PalletStatusFK, @destinationPalletTypeFK, 
						0/*cast(0 as bit)*/ /*OnRoute*/, 0/*cast(0 as bit)*//*Loaded*/, IsMixedPallet, @destinationBayPosition, @destinationPalletStart, 
						@destinationPalletEnd, StackPosition, DepthPosition, CustomerPalletNumber, @destinationBarcode, CustomerBarcode, IsArchived, InsertedBy, 
						dbo.GetBSTDate(), UpdatedBy, dbo.GetBSTDate(),3/*stock in complete*/
						From tblPallets where PalletPK = @sourcePalletFK

						Set @destinationPalletFK = scope_identity()

						insert into tblPalletContent
						Select @destinationPalletFK, -1/*This is not a loose location*/, -1/*This is not a loose location*/, StockItemFK, SpecialStockTypeFK, 
						Batch, SupplierBatch, EachUnits, ActualEaches, @var_topupAmount, AvailableEaches, @availableTopupAmount, ExpiryDate, DateOfManufacture, 
						BestBefore, DateOfReceipt, Barcode, CustomerBarcode, IsArchived, InsertedBy, dbo.GetBSTDate(), UpdatedBy, dbo.GetBSTDate()
						From tblPalletContent 
						where PalletContentPK = @sourcePalletContentFK

						Set @destinationPalletContentFK = scope_identity()
				
						Set @palletCreated = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ --Pallet was created
					END

					--Update source
					IF(@palletCreated = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ --If we only made a part movement OR we topped up an existing pallet, remove the content (could be all of it)
						OR (@destinationPalletFK > 0 AND @sourceActualUnits > @var_topupAmount)) 
					BEGIN 
						update tblPalletContent WITH (ROWLOCK)
						Set	ActualUnits = ActualUnits - @var_topupAmount,
						AvailableUnits = AvailableUnits - @availableTopupAmount
						Where PalletContentPK = @sourcePalletContentFK
					END
				END
				ELSE
				BEGIN --There is already a pallet/stock there, adjust the units

					--mixed topups keep seperate palletcontent, unmixed topups merge content onto destination
					if(@AllowMixedTopups = 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/ or @sourceBatch = @destinationBatch) 
					BEGIN
						print 'adding source content to destination content - same pallet content'
						--update destination
						update tblPalletContent WITH (ROWLOCK)
						Set ActualUnits = ActualUnits + @var_topupAmount,
						AvailableUnits = AvailableUnits + @availableTopupAmount
						Where PalletContentPK = @destinationPalletContentFK

						--update source
						update tblPalletContent WITH (ROWLOCK)
						Set AvailableUnits = AvailableUnits - @availableTopupAmount,
						ActualUnits = ActualUnits - @var_topupAmount
						Where PalletContentPK = @sourcePalletContentFK				
					END
					ELSE 
					BEGIN
						if(@var_topupAmount <> @sourceActualUnits)
						begin
							print 'adding source content to destination content - new pallet content for partial topup'
							insert into tblPalletContent
							Select @destinationPalletFK, -1/*This is not a loose location*/, -1/*This is not a loose location*/, StockItemFK, 
							SpecialStockTypeFK, Batch, SupplierBatch, EachUnits, ActualEaches, @var_topupAmount, AvailableEaches, @availableTopupAmount, 
							ExpiryDate, DateOfManufacture, BestBefore, DateOfReceipt, Barcode, CustomerBarcode, IsArchived, InsertedBy, dbo.GetBSTDate(), 
							UpdatedBy, dbo.GetBSTDate()
							From tblPalletContent 
							where PalletContentPK = @sourcePalletContentFK

							--update source
							update tblPalletContent WITH (ROWLOCK)
							Set AvailableUnits = AvailableUnits - @availableTopupAmount,
							ActualUnits = ActualUnits - @var_topupAmount
							Where PalletContentPK = @sourcePalletContentFK	
						end
						else 
						begin
							print 'adding source content to destination content - different pallet content'
							--move pallet content onto destination pallet
							update tblPalletContent WITH (ROWLOCK)
							Set palletfk = @destinationPalletFK
							Where PalletContentPK = @sourcePalletContentFK

							--update bay positions if source pallet was in racking
							update tblPallets WITH (ROWLOCK)
							set BayPosition = BayPosition - 1
							Where LocationTypeFK = 1 /*Racking*/
							And LocationFK = @sourceBuildingUnitBayFK
							AND BayPosition > @sourceBayPosition

							--archive sourse pallet
							update tblPallets WITH (ROWLOCK)
							set isarchived = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/, updateddate = dbo.GetBSTDate(), updatedby = @var_userFK
							where PalletPK = @sourcePalletFK

							--make entry in Pallet Audit to show depleation
							Insert into tblPalletAudit
							Select Top 1 PalletFK, BuildingUnitFK, 16/*topped off depleated*/, @var_worksOrderPK, dbo.GetBSTDate(), StockItemFK, Batch, 
							TotalPallets, TotalBatchPallets, TotalEaches, TotalBatchEaches, TotalUnits, TotalBatchUnits, BuildingUnitTotalPallets, 
							BuildingUnitTotalBatchPallets, BuildingUnitTotalEaches, BuildingUnitTotalBatchEaches, BuildingUnitTotalUnits, 
							BuildingUnitTotalBatchUnits, IsArchived, InsertedBy, dbo.GetBSTDate(), UpdatedBy, dbo.GetBSTDate()
							from tblPalletAudit
							Where PalletFK = @sourcePalletFK
							Order by EventDate Desc
						end
					END

					--we have added available stock to a pallet location, therefore any ContainerOutPalletContent will not remove the pallet, set pallets to zero 
					print 'updating containerouts that already have picked source or destination content'
					update tblContainerOutLinePalletContent WITH (ROWLOCK)
					Set Pallets = 0
					Where PalletContentFK = @destinationPalletContentFK or PalletContentFK = @sourcePalletContentFK

					Set @palletCreated = 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/ --No pallet created
				END


				--update orders
				If (@sourceActualUnits <> @sourceAvailableUnits)
				BEGIN --There is stock on order on our source pallet
					--Have we moved enough to cover these orders?
					if((@var_topupAmount/* + @destinationActualUnits*/) >= (
						Select sum(colpc.Units) from tblContainerOuts cOuts
						inner join tblContainerOutLines cols on
						cols.ContainerOutFK = cOuts.ContainerOutPK
						inner join tblContainerOutLinePalletContent colpc on
						colpc.ContainerOutLineFK = cols.ContainerOutLinePK
						Where cOuts.ContainerOutStatusFK < 5 /*Not Completed or Cancelled*/
						AND colpc.PalletContentFK = @sourcePalletContentFK
						)
					)
					BEGIN
						--we have moved enough
						--update all orders
						if(@AllowMixedTopups = 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/ or @sourceBatch = @destinationBatch) 
						BEGIN
							print 'updating order palletpk and content pk to destination content'
							update tblContainerOutLinePalletContent WITH (ROWLOCK)
							Set PalletContentFK = @destinationPalletContentFK, PalletFK = @destinationPalletFK,
							UpdatedDate = dbo.GetBSTDate()
							where ContainerOutLinePalletContentPK in
							(
								Select ContainerOutLinePalletContentPK 
								from tblContainerOuts cOuts
								inner join tblContainerOutLines cols on
								cols.ContainerOutFK = cOuts.ContainerOutPK
								inner join tblContainerOutLinePalletContent colpc on
								colpc.ContainerOutLineFK = cols.ContainerOutLinePK
								Where cOuts.ContainerOutStatusFK < 5 /*Not Completed*/
								AND colpc.PalletContentFK = @sourcePalletContentFK
							)
						END
						ELSE 
						BEGIN --only need to change pallet when source content is mixed
							print 'updating order palletpk, content pk stays same'
							update tblContainerOutLinePalletContent WITH (ROWLOCK)
							Set PalletFK = @destinationPalletFK,
							UpdatedDate = dbo.GetBSTDate()
							where ContainerOutLinePalletContentPK in
							(
								Select ContainerOutLinePalletContentPK 
								from tblContainerOuts cOuts
								inner join tblContainerOutLines cols on
								cols.ContainerOutFK = cOuts.ContainerOutPK
								inner join tblContainerOutLinePalletContent colpc on
								colpc.ContainerOutLineFK = cols.ContainerOutLinePK
								Where cOuts.ContainerOutStatusFK < 5 /*Not Completed*/
								AND colpc.PalletContentFK = @sourcePalletContentFK
							)
						END				
					END
					ELSE
					BEGIN --Most complex finish
						--There are orders on our source pallet
						--There was not enough stock moved to complete all of the order on this pallet
						print 'complex finish'

						IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ContainerOutPalletContent') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #ContainerOutPalletContent

						--Update orders which the topup covers (update earliest roders first)
						CREATE TABLE #ContainerOutPalletContent 
						(
							ContainerOutPalletContentFK int, 
							DeliveryDate Datetime, 
							Units decimal(18,3), 
							UnitsRunningTotal decimal(18,3)
						)

						DECLARE @containerOutPalletContentFK int,
								@deliveryDate datetime,
								@units decimal(18,3),
								@unitsRunningTotal decimal(18,3)

						SET @unitsRunningTotal = 0

						DECLARE rt_cursor CURSOR
						FOR
						SELECT colpc.ContainerOutLinePalletContentPK, 
						cOuts.DeliveryDate, colpc.Units
						FROM tblContainerOuts cOuts
						inner join tblContainerOutLines cols on
						cols.ContainerOutFK = cOuts.ContainerOutPK
						inner join tblContainerOutLinePalletContent colpc on
						colpc.ContainerOutLineFK = cols.ContainerOutLinePK
						Where cOuts.ContainerOutStatusFK < 5 /*Not Completed*/
						AND colpc.PalletContentFK = @sourcePalletContentFK

						OPEN rt_cursor

						FETCH NEXT FROM rt_cursor INTO @containerOutPalletContentFK, @deliveryDate, @units

						WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
						 BEGIN
						  SET @unitsRunningTotal = @unitsRunningTotal + @units
							Print @unitsRunningTotal
						  INSERT into #ContainerOutPalletContent 
						  VALUES (@containerOutPalletContentFK,@deliveryDate, @units, @unitsRunningTotal)
						  FETCH NEXT FROM rt_cursor INTO @containerOutPalletContentFK, @deliveryDate, @units
						 END

						CLOSE rt_cursor
						DEALLOCATE rt_cursor

						--SELECT * FROM #ContainerOutPalletContent ORDER BY DeliveryDate

						update tblContainerOutLinePalletContent WITH (ROWLOCK)
						Set PalletContentFK = @destinationPalletContentFK
						Where ContainerOutLinePalletContentPK in 
						(
							Select ContainerOutPalletContentFK from #ContainerOutPalletContent
							where UnitsRunningTotal <= @var_topupAmount 
						)
					END
				END		

				print 'pallet audit - topup'
				--Pallet Audit
				--Toppedup pallet
				Insert into tblPalletAudit
				Select Top 1 PalletFK, BuildingUnitFK, 14/*topped up*/, @var_worksOrderPK, dbo.GetBSTDate(), StockItemFK, Batch, TotalPallets, 
				TotalBatchPallets, TotalEaches, TotalBatchEaches, TotalUnits, TotalBatchUnits, BuildingUnitTotalPallets, 
				BuildingUnitTotalBatchPallets, BuildingUnitTotalEaches, BuildingUnitTotalBatchEaches, BuildingUnitTotalUnits, 
				BuildingUnitTotalBatchUnits, IsArchived, InsertedBy, dbo.GetBSTDate(), UpdatedBy, dbo.GetBSTDate()
				from tblPalletAudit
				Where PalletFK = @destinationPalletFK
				Order by EventDate Desc

				if(@destinationPalletFK <> @sourcePalletFK) 
				BEGIN
					--ToppedOff Pallet
					print 'pallet audit - topped off'
					Insert into tblPalletAudit
					Select Top 1 PalletFK, BuildingUnitFK, 15/*topped off*/, @var_worksOrderPK, dbo.GetBSTDate(), StockItemFK, Batch, 
					TotalPallets, TotalBatchPallets, TotalEaches, TotalBatchEaches, TotalUnits, TotalBatchUnits, BuildingUnitTotalPallets, 
					BuildingUnitTotalBatchPallets, BuildingUnitTotalEaches, BuildingUnitTotalBatchEaches, BuildingUnitTotalUnits, 
					BuildingUnitTotalBatchUnits, IsArchived, InsertedBy, dbo.GetBSTDate(), UpdatedBy, dbo.GetBSTDate()
					from tblPalletAudit
					Where PalletFK = @sourcePalletFK
					Order by EventDate Desc
				END

				--Clear up depleated pallets
				if((Select ActualUnits from tblPalletContent where PalletContentPK = @sourcePalletContentFK) <= 0)
				BEGIN
					print 'tidy up depleated pallets'
					--insert into tblXDidSomething values('hello')
					--update bay positions
					update tblPallets WITH (ROWLOCK)
					set BayPosition = BayPosition - 1
					Where LocationTypeFK = 1 /*Racking*/
					And LocationFK = @sourceBuildingUnitBayFK
					AND BayPosition > @sourceBayPosition

					--remove pallet content
					Delete tblPalletContent
					Where PalletContentPK = @sourcePalletContentFK
					--remove pallet
					update tblPallets WITH (ROWLOCK)
					set isarchived = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/, updateddate = dbo.GetBSTDate(), updatedby = @var_userFK
					where PalletPK = @sourcePalletFK

					--make entry in Pallet Audit to show depleation
					Insert into tblPalletAudit
					Select Top 1 PalletFK, BuildingUnitFK, 16/*topped off depleated*/, @var_worksOrderPK, dbo.GetBSTDate(), StockItemFK, Batch, 
					TotalPallets, TotalBatchPallets, TotalEaches, TotalBatchEaches, TotalUnits, TotalBatchUnits, BuildingUnitTotalPallets, 
					BuildingUnitTotalBatchPallets, BuildingUnitTotalEaches, BuildingUnitTotalBatchEaches, BuildingUnitTotalUnits, 
					BuildingUnitTotalBatchUnits, IsArchived, InsertedBy, dbo.GetBSTDate(), UpdatedBy, dbo.GetBSTDate()
					from tblPalletAudit
					Where PalletFK = @sourcePalletFK
					Order by EventDate Desc
			
				END

				print 'sync stock levels'

				-- Run the spStockLevelsSync stored procedure if it is not already executing.
				EXEC spStockLevelsSyncTrigger
				--IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#IsStoredProcedureExecuting') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #IsStoredProcedureExecuting

				--CREATE TABLE #IsStoredProcedureExecuting(Result INT)

				--INSERT INTO #IsStoredProcedureExecuting
				--EXEC dbo.spIsStoredProcedureExecuting 'spStockLevelsSync'
			
				--IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #IsStoredProcedureExecuting WHERE Result = 0) EXEC [dbo].[spStockLevelsSync] @stockItemFK = @sourceStockItemFK				
			END
	
			--If this is a topup that has come from a stock in, we have to do stuff with palletizing and movements
			IF((Select WorksOrderOriginFK from tblWorksOrders where WorksOrderPK = @var_worksOrderPK) = 1/*StockIn*/)
			print 'topup from stockin'
			BEGIN
				IF(@sourceActualUnits = @var_topupAmount)
				BEGIN --We moved the whole pallet so we can cancel the palletize worksorder			
					print 'moved whole pallet - cancel the palletize worksorder'
					Delete tblWorksOrders
					Where WorksOrderPK = (Select WorksOrderFK from tblWorksOrderPallets where PalletFK = @sourcePalletFK)
					Delete tblWorksOrderPallets where PalletFK = @sourcePalletFK

					DECLARE @WorksOrderFK int
					SELECT @WorksOrderFK = WoOrMo.WorksOrderFK from tblWorksOrderMovements WoOrMo 
						inner join tblWorksOrders WoOr on WoOrMo.WorksOrderFK=WoOr.WorksOrderPK 
						and WoOr.WorksOrderOriginFK=1 where WoOrMo.PalletFK = @sourcePalletFK
			
					Update tblWorksOrders WITH (ROWLOCK)
					Set WorksOrderStatusFK = 4 /*Cancelled*/
					where WorksOrderPK=@WorksOrderFK

					update tblWorksOrderMovements WITH (ROWLOCK) 
					Set WorksOrderStatusFK = 4/*Cancelled*/ 
					where WorksOrderFK=@WorksOrderFK
				END 
				ELSE
				BEGIN --We assume when the stockIn topup is complete that the stock has been palletized and put away (as per created works orders)
					--If the palletize works order exists, complete it
					print 'stockin topup complete'
					IF(EXISTS(Select * from tblWorksOrders wos 
							inner join tblWorksOrderPallets wops on 
							wops.WorksOrderFK = wos.WorksOrderPK
							where wos.WorksOrderTypeFK = 9 /*Palletize*/
							AND wops.PalletFK = @sourcePalletFK))
					BEGIN  --We have a palletize works order. Complete it.
						print 'We have a palletize works order. Complete it'
						Declare @worksOrderPalletPK int
						Select @worksOrderPalletPK = WorksOrderPalletPK 
							from tblWorksOrders wos 
							inner join tblWorksOrderPallets wops on 
							wops.WorksOrderFK = wos.WorksOrderPK
							where wos.WorksOrderTypeFK = 9 /*Palletize*/
							AND wops.PalletFK = @sourcePalletFK
						Exec spWorksOrderPalletComplete @worksOrderPalletPK, @var_userFK
					END

					IF(EXISTS(Select * from tblWorksOrderMovements where PalletFK = @sourcePalletFK))
					BEGIN
						Declare @worksOrderMovementPK int

						Select @worksOrderMovementPK = WorksOrderMovementPK from tblWorksOrderMovements where PalletFK = @sourcePalletFK

						print 'execute works order movement status change'
						print @worksOrderMovementPK
				
						IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#Tempresult') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #Tempresult
						
						create table #Tempresult( Result int)

						Insert Into #Tempresult exec spWorksOrderMovementStatusChange @worksOrderMovementPK, 3/*Complete*/, @var_userFK
					END
				END
		--		LJF, Have taken this out as it was causing problems and we dont want to autocomplete stockins from topups anymore
		--		Declare @stockInPK int
		--		Select @stockInPK = FK from tblWorksOrders where WorksOrderPK = @var_worksOrderPK
		--		Exec spStockInCheckAndSetStatus @stockInPK
			END

			print 'done'
			Select '0' as result --if we have reached this point everything is ok

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end

			BEGIN TRY IF XACT_STATE() = 1 AND @@TRANCOUNT = 1 AND @OpeningTranCount < 1 COMMIT TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH
			
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spTransportCompanyGetNextTrackingNumber]
(
	@transportCompanyFK int	
)
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT
 ,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;
	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	DECLARE @var_transportCompanyFK int
	SET @var_transportCompanyFK = @transportCompanyFK
	SET @ParameterDetails = '@transportCompanyFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_transportCompanyFK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'')

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    --BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

		SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END


	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY
			IF XACT_STATE() = 0 AND @@TRANCOUNT < 1 BEGIN TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start

			--Each transport can have its own method of getting a tracking number

			Declare @trackingNumber nvarchar(200)
			Declare @prefix nvarchar(200)

			if(@var_transportCompanyFK = 2) --NIGHTLINE
			BEGIN
				SELECT @trackingNumber = cast(NextTrackingNumber as nvarchar(200)),
				@prefix = cast(TrackingNumberPrefix as nvarchar(200))
				from tblTransportCompanies 
				Where TransportCompanyPK = @var_transportCompanyFK

				Update tblTransportCompanies WITH (ROWLOCK) Set NextTrackingNumber = NextTrackingNumber + 1 
				where TransportCompanyPK = @var_transportCompanyFK

				Set @trackingNumber = @prefix + dbo.fnAddNightlineCheckDigit(@trackingNumber)
			END
			ELSE
			BEGIN
				SELECT @trackingNumber = NextTrackingNumber from tblTransportCompanies 
				Where TransportCompanyPK = @var_transportCompanyFK

				Update tblTransportCompanies WITH (ROWLOCK) Set NextTrackingNumber = NextTrackingNumber + 1 
				where TransportCompanyPK = @var_transportCompanyFK
			END
		
			Select @trackingNumber
	
			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end

			BEGIN TRY IF XACT_STATE() = 1 AND @@TRANCOUNT = 1 AND @OpeningTranCount < 1 COMMIT TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH
			
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END

CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[spUpdateCompletedWorksOrders]
(  
    @StockOrderPK INT ,
	@CurrentUser INT
)
AS
BEGIN
    /* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */      
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED      
      
    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT      
 ,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;      
 SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();      
      
 -- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters  
 DECLARE @var_stockOrderPK INT = @StockOrderPK;  
 DECLARE @now DATETIME = dbo.GetBSTDate();  
 DECLARE @var_currentUser INT = @CurrentUser;  
 SET @ParameterDetails = '@StockOrderPK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_stockOrderPK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') +  
  ',@CurrentUser = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_currentUser AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'');  
  
      
    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL       
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)      
      
    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)      
    --BEGIN      
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC       
      
  SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)      
      
        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)      
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK      
      
        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()      
    --END      
      
      
 SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);      
 SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails      
 ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;      
 INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()      
      
 WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3      
 BEGIN       
  BEGIN TRY      
   IF XACT_STATE() = 0 AND @@TRANCOUNT < 1 BEGIN TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName      
      
 -- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start  
    -- Update all WorksOrders for this StockOrder if all movements are complete
    UPDATE wos WITH (ROWLOCK)
    SET WorksOrderStatusFK = 3,  -- 3 = Complete
	UpdatedBy =@var_currentUser,
	UpdatedDate=@now
    FROM dbo.tblWorksOrders AS wos
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT WorksOrderFK, COUNT(*) AS NumOfOpenMovs
        FROM dbo.tblWorksOrderMovements
        WHERE WorksOrderStatusFK NOT IN (3, 4)  -- exclude Complete and Cancelled
        GROUP BY WorksOrderFK
    ) AS woms
        ON woms.WorksOrderFK = wos.WorksOrderPK
    WHERE wos.FK = @var_stockOrderPK
      AND ISNULL(woms.NumOfOpenMovs, 0) = 0;


-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end      
     
   BEGIN TRY IF XACT_STATE() = 1 AND @@TRANCOUNT = 1 AND @OpeningTranCount < 1 COMMIT TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH      
         
   BREAK      
  END TRY      
  BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */      
   DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;      
   SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;      
   SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;      
      
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY       
   BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;      
             
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;      
      
            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID      
                  
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;      
                  
   IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)      
   BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END      
   ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */      
  END CATCH      
  SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1      
 END      
END

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL                   
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)                  
                  
    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)                  
    --BEGIN                  
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC                   
                  
  SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)                  
                  
        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)                  
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK                  
                  
        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()                  
    --END                  
                  
                  
 SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);                  
 SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails                  
 ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;                  
 INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()                  
                  
 WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3                  
BEGIN                  
  BEGIN TRY              
      
  DECLARE @var_updateDate datetime, @activityComments NVARCHAR(MAX);              
  SET @var_updateDate=dbo.GetBSTDate();              
                  
IF(@var_deliveryType='Inbound')                        
 -- Update tblContainerIns                
    UPDATE [dbo].[tblContainerIns]                  
    SET [ContainerNumber]=@var_containerNumber,               
    [SealNumber]=@var_sealNumber,                
     [LorryNumber]=@var_lorryNumber,                
     UpdatedBy=@var_userId,                
     UpdatedDate=@var_updateDate                   
    WHERE ContainerInPK = @var_containerPK;                  
ELSE IF(@var_deliveryType='Outbound')              
  -- Update tblContainerOuts                
    UPDATE [dbo].[tblContainerOuts]                  
    SET [ContainerNumber]=@var_containerNumber,               
        [SealNumber]=@var_sealNumber,                
        [LorryNumber]=@var_lorryNumber,                
        UpdatedBy=@var_userId,                
        UpdatedDate=@var_updateDate                   
       WHERE ContainerOutPK = @var_containerPK;          
        
     SET @activityComments = CONCAT('Updated stock info for ', @var_comment, CHAR(13) + CHAR(10),             
    ', Container Number: ', @ContainerNumber, CHAR(13) + CHAR(10),         
    ', Seal Number: ', @var_sealNumber, CHAR(13) + CHAR(10),         
    ', Lorry Number: ', @var_lorryNumber        
);             
            
  SET @var_schedulePlaceholderFK = (SELECT TOP 1 SchedulePlaceholderFK FROM [dbo].[tblScheduleActivities]              
    WHERE ScheduleDeliveryFK = @var_scheduleDeliveryPK);              
                      
 -- Insert into tblScheduleActivities table                    
    INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblScheduleActivities](BuildingFK,ScheduleActivityTypeFK, SchedulePlaceholderFK, ScheduleDeliveryFK,Comments,IsArchived, InsertedBy, InsertedDate, UpdatedBy,UpdatedDate)                    
    VALUES (@var_buildingFK, 2, @var_schedulePlaceholderFK, @var_scheduleDeliveryPK, @activityComments, 0, @var_userId, @var_updateDate, @var_userId, @var_updateDate);                              
                   
     -- Call spUpdateScheduleWeekAudit      
    DECLARE @ScheduleWeekPK INT;      
    EXEC [dbo].[spUpdateScheduleWeekAudit]      
        @SchedulePlaceholderFK = @var_schedulePlaceholderFK,      
        @ScheduleDeliveryFK = @var_scheduleDeliveryPK,        
        @BuildingFK = @var_buildingFK,      
        @UserId = @var_userId,      
        @CurrentDate = @var_updateDate,      
        @ScheduleWeekPK = @ScheduleWeekPK OUTPUT;          
         
      
       -- Final output
       DECLARE @UserType NVARCHAR(100)= dbo.fnGetUserType(@var_userId);     
       DECLARE @IsExternal BIT = CASE WHEN ISNULL(@UserType, '') = 'ExternalTransportUser' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END;
       IF(@IsExternal=1 ) 
       BEGIN       
           SELECT *
           FROM dbo.fnGetScheduleWeekForTransportUser
           (
               @var_buildingFK,
               @var_weekNumber,
               @var_year,
               @var_userId
           )
           ORDER BY ChannelName ASC, DayDate ASC;
       END
       ELSE
       BEGIN
           SELECT *
           FROM dbo.fnGetScheduleWeekForBuildingWithYearAndWeekNumber
           (
               @var_buildingFK,
               @var_weekNumber,
               @var_year,
               @var_userId
           )
           ORDER BY ChannelName ASC, DayDate ASC;
       END;             
                
  BREAK                  
  END TRY               
                
  BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */                   
   DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;                  
   SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;                  
   SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;                  
                  
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY                   
   BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;                  
                         
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;                  
                  
            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID                  
                              
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;                  
                              
   IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)                  
   BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END                  
   ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */                      
  END CATCH                    
  SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1;                  
END                 
END 
GO

/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[spUpdateScheduleChannelTemplate]    Script Date: 02/11/2026 17:47:27 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
-- =============================================                
-- Author:  <Archana Singh>                
-- Create date: <17/12/2024>                
-- Description: <Description,,>                
-- =============================================   


CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spUpdateScheduleChannelTemplate]
    @ScheduleChannelTemplatePK INT,
    @ScheduleWeekTemplateFK INT,
    @Name NVARCHAR(100),
    @FreeMode BIT,
    @AllowInbound BIT,
    @AllowOutbound BIT,
    @ColorCode NVARCHAR(10),
    @DeliveryCount INT,
    @UserId INT
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED;

    DECLARE 
        @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),
        @ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),
        @DeadlockErrorRetries INT = 1,
        @CurrentDate DATETIME,
        @ErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX),
        @ErrorProcedure NVARCHAR(MAX),
        @ErrorLine NVARCHAR(10),
        @ErrorSeverity NVARCHAR(10),
        @ErrorState NVARCHAR(10),
        @ErrorNumber NVARCHAR(10);

    SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID);
    SET @CurrentDate = dbo.GetBSTDate(); -- Replace dbo.GetBSTDate() with GETDATE() if unavailable

    -- Log parameter details for debugging
    SET @ParameterDetails = 
        '@ScheduleChannelTemplatePK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@ScheduleChannelTemplatePK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)), '') + 
        ',@ScheduleWeekTemplateFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@ScheduleWeekTemplateFK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)), '') +
        ',@Name = ' + ISNULL(@Name, '') + 
        ',@FreeMode = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@FreeMode AS NVARCHAR(MAX)), '') +
        ',@AllowInbound = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@AllowInbound AS NVARCHAR(MAX)), '') +
        ',@AllowOutbound = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@AllowOutbound AS NVARCHAR(MAX)), '') +
        ',@ColorCode = ' + ISNULL(@ColorCode, '') +
        ',@DeliveryCount = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@DeliveryCount AS NVARCHAR(MAX)), '') +
        ',@UserId = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@UserId AS NVARCHAR(MAX)), '');

    WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
    BEGIN
        BEGIN TRY
            BEGIN TRANSACTION;

            -- Check if the record exists
            IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM [dbo].[tblScheduleChannelTemplates] WHERE ScheduleChannelTemplatePK = @ScheduleChannelTemplatePK)
            BEGIN
                -- Update the record
                UPDATE [dbo].[tblScheduleChannelTemplates]
                SET                     
                    [Name] = @Name,
                    [FreeMode] = @FreeMode,
                    [AllowInbound] = @AllowInbound,
                    [AllowOutbound] = @AllowOutbound,
                    [ColorCode] = @ColorCode,
                    [DeliveryCount] = @DeliveryCount,
                    [UpdatedBy] = @UserId,
                    [UpdatedDate] = @CurrentDate
                WHERE 
                    ScheduleChannelTemplatePK = @ScheduleChannelTemplatePK
					AND ScheduleWeekTemplateFK = @ScheduleWeekTemplateFK;

                PRINT 'Record updated successfully.';
            END
            ELSE
            BEGIN
                PRINT 'Record not found.';
            END

            COMMIT TRANSACTION;
            BREAK; -- Exit retry loop on success
        END TRY
        BEGIN CATCH
            -- Capture error details
            SET @ErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();
            SET @ErrorProcedure = ERROR_PROCEDURE();
            SET @ErrorLine = CAST(ERROR_LINE() AS NVARCHAR(10));
            SET @ErrorSeverity = CAST(ERROR_SEVERITY() AS NVARCHAR(10));
            SET @ErrorState = CAST(ERROR_STATE() AS NVARCHAR(10));
            SET @ErrorNumber = CAST(ERROR_NUMBER() AS NVARCHAR(10));

            -- Log the error into tblErrorLog_MobstaAPI
            INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblErrorLog_MobstaAPI] (
                [Message],
                [Type],
                [LogDate],
                [Category],
                [Exception],
                [RequestId],
                [RequestPath],
                [ActionName],
                [TraceId],
                [ErrorMessage],
                [ApplicationName]
            )
            VALUES (
                'Error occurred in stored procedure ' + @ThisProcedureName,
                'Stored Procedure',
                GETDATE(),
                'Database Operation',
                'Procedure: ' + ISNULL(@ErrorProcedure, '') + ', Line: ' + @ErrorLine,
                NULL, -- RequestId (optional)
                NULL, -- RequestPath (optional)
                @ThisProcedureName,
                NULL, -- TraceId (optional)
                'Error Number: ' + @ErrorNumber + ', Severity: ' + @ErrorSeverity + ', State: ' + @ErrorState + ' - ' + @ErrorMessage,
                'MobStaAPI' 
            );

            -- Handle deadlock error (1205)
            IF ERROR_NUMBER() = 1205 AND @DeadlockErrorRetries < 3
            BEGIN
                ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;
                SET @DeadlockErrorRetries += 1;
                WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00.500'; -- Pause for half a second before retry
            END
            ELSE
            BEGIN
                -- Rollback and throw exception for non-recoverable errors
                ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;
                RAISERROR('An error occurred. Please check the error log.', 16, 1);
                RETURN;
            END
        END CATCH
    END
END;
GO

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spUpdateScheduleDayTemplate]
    @ScheduleDayTemplatePK INT,
    @ScheduleChannelTemplateFK INT,
    @DayNumber INT,
    @StartTime TIME(0),
    @EndTime TIME(0),
    @DayDate DATE,
    @MaxDuration TIME(0),
    @UserId INT
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED;

    DECLARE 
        @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),
        @CurrentDate DATETIME,
        @DeadlockErrorRetries INT = 1,
        @ErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX),
        @ErrorProcedure NVARCHAR(MAX),
        @ErrorLine NVARCHAR(10),
        @ErrorSeverity NVARCHAR(10),
        @ErrorState NVARCHAR(10),
        @ErrorNumber NVARCHAR(10);

    SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID);
    SET @CurrentDate = dbo.GetBSTDate(); -- Replace dbo.GetBSTDate() with GETDATE() if unavailable

    WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
    BEGIN
        BEGIN TRY
            BEGIN TRANSACTION;

            -- Check if the record exists before updating
            IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM [dbo].[tblScheduleDayTemplates] WHERE ScheduleDayTemplatePK = @ScheduleDayTemplatePK)
            BEGIN
                -- Update the record
                UPDATE [dbo].[tblScheduleDayTemplates]
                SET 
                    [ScheduleChannelTemplateFK] = @ScheduleChannelTemplateFK,
                    [DayNumber] = @DayNumber,
                    [StartTime] = @StartTime,
                    [EndTime] = @EndTime,
                    [DayDate] = @DayDate,
                    [MaxDuration] = @MaxDuration,
                    [UpdatedBy] = @UserId,
                    [UpdatedDate] = @CurrentDate
                WHERE 
                    [ScheduleDayTemplatePK] = @ScheduleDayTemplatePK;

                PRINT 'Day template updated successfully.';
            END
            ELSE
            BEGIN
                PRINT 'Record not found.';
            END

            COMMIT TRANSACTION;
            BREAK; -- Exit retry loop on success
        END TRY
        BEGIN CATCH
            -- Capture error details
            SET @ErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();
            SET @ErrorProcedure = ERROR_PROCEDURE();
            SET @ErrorLine = CAST(ERROR_LINE() AS NVARCHAR(10));
            SET @ErrorSeverity = CAST(ERROR_SEVERITY() AS NVARCHAR(10));
            SET @ErrorState = CAST(ERROR_STATE() AS NVARCHAR(10));
            SET @ErrorNumber = CAST(ERROR_NUMBER() AS NVARCHAR(10));

            -- Log the error into tblErrorLog_MobstaAPI
            INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblErrorLog_MobstaAPI] (
                [Message],
                [Type],
                [LogDate],
                [Category],
                [Exception],
                [ActionName],
                [ErrorMessage],
                [ApplicationName]
            )
            VALUES (
                'Error occurred in stored procedure ' + @ThisProcedureName,
                'Stored Procedure',
                GETDATE(),
                'Database Operation',
                'Procedure: ' + ISNULL(@ErrorProcedure, '') + ', Line: ' + @ErrorLine,
                @ThisProcedureName,
                'Error Number: ' + @ErrorNumber + ', Severity: ' + @ErrorSeverity + ', State: ' + @ErrorState + ' - ' + @ErrorMessage,
                'MobStaAPI' 
            );

            -- Handle deadlock error (1205)
            IF ERROR_NUMBER() = 1205 AND @DeadlockErrorRetries < 3
            BEGIN
                ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;
                SET @DeadlockErrorRetries += 1;
                WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00.500'; -- Wait 500 ms before retrying
            END
            ELSE
            BEGIN
                -- Rollback transaction for unrecoverable errors
                ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;
                RAISERROR('An error occurred. Please check the error log.', 16, 1);
                RETURN;
            END
        END CATCH
    END
END;

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spUpdateScheduleDeliveryAndPlaceholderDescriptionAndLogToActivity](

 @Description NVARCHAR(250),        
 @ScheduleActivityTypeFK INT,

 )            
AS          
BEGIN            
 /* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */            
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED            
            
    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT            
 ,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;            
 SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

 @var_weekNumber INT,     
 @var_year INT,  
 @var_scheduleDeliveryPK INT,        
 @var_schedulePlaceholderPK INT,      
 @var_description NVARCHAR(1000),      
 @var_scheduleActivityTypeFK INT,    
 @var_comment NVARCHAR(Max),   
 @var_userId INT           
    
 SET @var_buildingFK=@BuildingFK;     
 SET @var_weekNumber=@WeekNumber;      
 SET @var_year=@Year;  
 SET @var_scheduleDeliveryPK= @ScheduleDeliveryPK;          
 SET @var_schedulePlaceholderPK=@SchedulePlaceholderPK;

 ',@SchedulePlaceholderPK = '+ ISNULL(CAST( @var_schedulePlaceholderPK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'')+          
 ',@Description = '+ ISNULL(CAST(  @var_description AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'')+         
 ',@ScheduleActivityTypeFK = '+ ISNULL(CAST(  @var_scheduleActivityTypeFK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'')+

 INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

 -- Check if we are updating ScheduleDelivery Description      
 if(@var_scheduleDeliveryPK > 0)      
 BEGIN      
    UPDATE [dbo].[tblScheduleDeliveries]            
    SET [Description]=@var_description,          
        UpdatedBy=@var_userId,          
        UpdatedDate=@var_updateDate             
    WHERE ScheduleDeliveryPK = @var_scheduleDeliveryPK;          
 END           
      
 -- Check if we are updating SchedulePlaceholder        
    IF @var_schedulePlaceholderPK > 0        
    BEGIN        
        UPDATE [dbo].[tblSchedulePlaceholders]        
        SET [Description] = @Description,        
            UpdatedBy = @UserId,        
            UpdatedDate = @var_updateDate        
        WHERE SchedulePlaceholderPK = @var_schedulePlaceholderPK;        
    END        
      
      -- Prepare new comment        
        IF @ScheduleDeliveryPK > 0        
            SET @var_activityComments = CONCAT('Updated ',@var_comment, CHAR(13) + CHAR(10), ' description as:  "', @Description, '"');        
        ELSE IF @SchedulePlaceholderPK > 0       
            SET @var_activityComments = CONCAT('Updated ',@var_comment, CHAR(13) + CHAR(10), ' description as:  "', @Description, '"');      
        ELSE        
            SET @var_activityComments = '';        
        
        
 -- Insert activity log          
    INSERT INTO dbo.tblScheduleActivities(BuildingFK, ScheduleActivityTypeFK, SchedulePlaceholderFK, ScheduleDeliveryFK, Comments, IsArchived, InsertedBy, InsertedDate, UpdatedBy, UpdatedDate)        
    VALUES(@var_buildingFK, @var_ScheduleActivityTypeFK, @var_schedulePlaceholderPK, @var_scheduleDeliveryPK, @var_activityComments, 0, @var_userId, @var_updateDate, @var_userId, @var_updateDate)       
      
 DECLARE @ScheduleWeekPK INT;  
    EXEC [dbo].[spUpdateScheduleWeekAudit]  
        @SchedulePlaceholderFK = @var_schedulePlaceholderPK,  
        @ScheduleDeliveryFK = @var_scheduleDeliveryPK,    
        @BuildingFK = @var_buildingFK,  
        @UserId = @var_userId,  
        @CurrentDate = @var_updateDate,  
        @ScheduleWeekPK = @ScheduleWeekPK OUTPUT;   
    
    
 -- Final output
        DECLARE @UserType NVARCHAR(100)= dbo.fnGetUserType(@var_userId);     
       DECLARE @IsExternal BIT = CASE WHEN ISNULL(@UserType, '') = 'ExternalTransportUser' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END;
       IF(@IsExternal=1 ) 
       BEGIN       
           SELECT *
           FROM dbo.fnGetScheduleWeekForTransportUser
           (
               @var_buildingFK,
               @var_weekNumber,
               @var_year,
               @var_userId
           )
           ORDER BY ChannelName ASC, DayDate ASC;
       END
       ELSE
       BEGIN
           SELECT *
           FROM dbo.fnGetScheduleWeekForBuildingWithYearAndWeekNumber
           (
               @var_buildingFK,
               @var_weekNumber,
               @var_year,
               @var_userId
           )
           ORDER BY ChannelName ASC, DayDate ASC;
       END;       
             
     
  BREAK            
  END TRY         
          
  BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */          
        
   DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;            
   SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;            
   SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;            
     
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY             
   BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;            
                   
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;            
            
            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID            
                        
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;            
                        
   IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)            
   BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END            
   ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */                
  END CATCH              
  SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1;

-- @BuildingFK =35,      
 --   @WeekNumber=5,

-- =============================================

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spUpdateScheduleDeliveryAndPlaceholderDurationAndLogToActivity](              
 @BuildingFK INT,   
 @WeekNumber INT,     
 @Year INT,     
 @ScheduleDeliveryPK INT,            
 @SchedulePlaceholderPK INT,                
 @StartTime VARCHAR(50),                  
 @EndTime VARCHAR(50),    
 @ScheduleActivityTypeFK INT,  
 @Comment NVARCHAR(Max),  
 @UserId INT        
 )              
AS           
BEGIN            
 /* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */            
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED           
           
   DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT            
 ,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;            
 SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();            
            
DECLARE @var_buildingFK INT,  
 @var_weekNumber INT,     
 @var_year INT,  
 @var_scheduleDeliveryPK INT,      
 @var_schedulePlaceholderPK INT,    
 @var_startTime TIME(0),                    
 @var_endTime TIME(0),      
 @var_scheduleActivityTypeFK INT,  
 @var_comment NVARCHAR(Max),   
 @var_userId INT              
     
 SET @var_buildingFK=@BuildingFK;     
 SET @var_weekNumber=@WeekNumber;      
 SET @var_year=@Year;    
 SET @var_scheduleDeliveryPK= @ScheduleDeliveryPK;        
 SET @var_schedulePlaceholderPK=@SchedulePlaceholderPK;      
 SET @var_startTime=CAST(@StartTime AS TIME(0));         
  SET @var_endTime=CAST(@EndTime AS TIME(0));    
   
 -- Calculate the duration between start and end time  
    DECLARE @var_duration TIME(0);   
    SET @var_duration = DATEADD(SECOND, DATEDIFF(SECOND, @StartTime, @EndTime), '00:00:00');    
              
 SET @var_scheduleActivityTypeFK=@ScheduleActivityTypeFK;     
 SET @var_comment= @Comment;  
 SET @var_userId= @UserId;           
           
            
 SET @ParameterDetails ='@BuildingFK = '+ ISNULL(CAST( @var_buildingFK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'')+    
 ',@WeekNumber = '+  ISNULL(CAST(@var_weekNumber AS NVARCHAR(MAX)), '')+      
 ',@Year = '+  ISNULL(CAST(@var_year AS NVARCHAR(MAX)), '')+      
 ',@ScheduleDeliveryPK = '+ ISNULL(CAST( @var_scheduleDeliveryPK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'')+          
 ',@SchedulePlaceholderPK = '+ ISNULL(CAST( @var_schedulePlaceholderPK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'')+          
 ',@StartTime = '+ ISNULL(CAST( @var_startTime AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'')+            
 ',@EndTime = '+ ISNULL(CAST(  @var_endTime AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'')+            
 ',@Duration = '+ ISNULL(CAST( @var_duration AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'')+            
 ',@ScheduleActivityTypeFK = '+ ISNULL(CAST(  @var_scheduleActivityTypeFK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'')+          
 ',@UserId = '+ ISNULL(CAST(  @var_userId AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'')          
            
    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL             
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)            
     
    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)            
    --BEGIN            
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC             
            
  SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)            
            
        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)            
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK            
            
        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()            
    --END            
            
            
 SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);            
 SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails            
 ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;            
 INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()            
            
 WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3            
BEGIN            
  BEGIN TRY     
  DECLARE @var_activityComments NVARCHAR(MAX);     
  DECLARE @var_updateDate datetime;        
  SET @var_updateDate=dbo.GetBSTDate();        
      
  -- Check if we are updating ScheduleDelivery duration      
 if(@var_scheduleDeliveryPK > 0)      
 BEGIN                
    UPDATE [dbo].[tblScheduleDeliveries]            
    SET StartTime = @var_startTime,            
        EndTime = @var_endTime,        
        ActualDuration=@var_duration,        
        UpdatedBy = @var_userId,            
        UpdatedDate = @var_updateDate               
    WHERE ScheduleDeliveryPK = @var_scheduleDeliveryPK;            
 END          
     
-- Check if we are updating SchedulePlaceholder duration    
  IF @var_schedulePlaceholderPK > 0        
  BEGIN        
        UPDATE [dbo].[tblSchedulePlaceholders]        
        SET StartTime = @var_startTime,            
            EndTime = @var_endTime,        
            ActualDuration=@var_duration,        
            UpdatedBy = @var_userId,            
            UpdatedDate = @var_updateDate       
        WHERE SchedulePlaceholderPK = @var_schedulePlaceholderPK;        
   END     
    
 -- Prepare new comment        
    IF @ScheduleDeliveryPK > 0        
      SET @var_activityComments = CONCAT('Updated ',@var_comment, CHAR(13) + CHAR(10), ' duration: "', @var_duration, CHAR(13) + CHAR(10),  ' with allotted time interval: ', CONVERT(NVARCHAR, @var_startTime, 120), ' - ', CONVERT(NVARCHAR, @var_endTime, 120), '"');    
     ELSE IF @SchedulePlaceholderPK > 0        
       SET @var_activityComments =   CONCAT('Updated ',@var_comment, CHAR(13) + CHAR(10),  ' duration: "', @var_duration, CHAR(13) + CHAR(10),  ' with allotted time interval: ', CONVERT(NVARCHAR, @var_startTime, 120), ' - ', CONVERT(NVARCHAR, @var_endTime, 120), '"');  
      ELSE  
     SET @var_activityComments = '';        
         
        
-- Insert activity log          
    INSERT INTO dbo.tblScheduleActivities(BuildingFK, ScheduleActivityTypeFK, SchedulePlaceholderFK, ScheduleDeliveryFK, Comments, IsArchived, InsertedBy, InsertedDate, UpdatedBy, UpdatedDate)        
     VALUES(@var_buildingFK, @var_ScheduleActivityTypeFK, @var_schedulePlaceholderPK, @var_scheduleDeliveryPK, @var_activityComments, 0, @var_userId, @var_updateDate, @var_userId, @var_updateDate)       
       
  -- Call spUpdateScheduleWeekAudit  
    DECLARE @ScheduleWeekPK INT;  
    EXEC [dbo].[spUpdateScheduleWeekAudit]  
        @SchedulePlaceholderFK = @var_schedulePlaceholderPK,  
        @ScheduleDeliveryFK = @var_scheduleDeliveryPK,    
        @BuildingFK = @var_buildingFK,  
        @UserId = @var_userId,  
        @CurrentDate = @var_updateDate,  
        @ScheduleWeekPK = @ScheduleWeekPK OUTPUT;   
 
 
     -- Final output
        DECLARE @UserType NVARCHAR(100)= dbo.fnGetUserType(@var_userId);     
       DECLARE @IsExternal BIT = CASE WHEN ISNULL(@UserType, '') = 'ExternalTransportUser' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END;
       IF(@IsExternal=1 ) 
       BEGIN       
           SELECT *
           FROM dbo.fnGetScheduleWeekForTransportUser
           (
               @var_buildingFK,
               @var_weekNumber,
               @var_year,
               @var_userId
           )
           ORDER BY ChannelName ASC, DayDate ASC;
       END
       ELSE
       BEGIN
           SELECT *
           FROM dbo.fnGetScheduleWeekForBuildingWithYearAndWeekNumber
           (
               @var_buildingFK,
               @var_weekNumber,
               @var_year,
               @var_userId
           )
           ORDER BY ChannelName ASC, DayDate ASC;
       END;       
   
 BREAK          
 END TRY           
         
 BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */             
   DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;            
   SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;            
   SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;            
            
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY             
   BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;            
                   
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;            
            
            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID            
                        
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;            
                        
   IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)            
   BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END            
   ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */                
  END CATCH              
  SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1;            
END           
END

-- =============================================
