/*
EXEC [dbo].[spUpdateScheduleSlotTemplate]
    @ScheduleSlotTemplatePK = 1, -- The primary key of the schedule slot template to be updated
    @ScheduleDayTemplateFK = 2, -- The FK to an existing ScheduleDayTemplate record
    @StartTime = '09:00:00',
    @EndTime = '10:00:00',
    @IsArchived = 0, -- Set to 0 for active slot
    @UpdatedBy = 663, -- User ID
    @UpdatedDate = GETDATE(),
    @ActualDuration = '01:00:00';
*/


CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spUpdateScheduleSlotTemplate]
    @ScheduleSlotTemplatePK INT,
    @ScheduleDayTemplateFK INT,
    @StartTime TIME(0),
    @EndTime TIME(0),
    @IsArchived BIT,
    @UpdatedBy INT,
    @UpdatedDate DATETIME,
    @ActualDuration TIME(0)
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED;

    DECLARE 
        @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),
        @CurrentDate DATETIME,
        @DeadlockErrorRetries INT = 1,
        @ErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX),
        @ErrorProcedure NVARCHAR(MAX),
        @ErrorLine NVARCHAR(10),
        @ErrorSeverity NVARCHAR(10),
        @ErrorState NVARCHAR(10),
        @ErrorNumber NVARCHAR(10);

    SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID);
    SET @CurrentDate = dbo.GetBSTDate(); -- Replace dbo.GetBSTDate() with GETDATE() if unavailable

    WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
    BEGIN
        BEGIN TRY
            BEGIN TRANSACTION;

            -- Update the schedule slot template record
            UPDATE [dbo].[tblScheduleSlotTemplates]
            SET
                [ScheduleDayTemplateFK] = @ScheduleDayTemplateFK,
                [StartTime] = @StartTime,
                [EndTime] = @EndTime,
                [IsArchived] = @IsArchived,
                [UpdatedBy] = @UpdatedBy,
                [UpdatedDate] = @UpdatedDate,
                [ActualDuration] = @ActualDuration
            WHERE
                [ScheduleSlotTemplatePK] = @ScheduleSlotTemplatePK
                AND [IsArchived] = 0; -- Only update if the record is not archived

            -- Check if the record was successfully updated
            IF @@ROWCOUNT = 0
            BEGIN
                PRINT 'No records updated. Either the record does not exist or is archived.';
            END
            ELSE
            BEGIN
                PRINT 'Record updated successfully.';
            END

            COMMIT TRANSACTION;
            BREAK; -- Exit retry loop on success
        END TRY
        BEGIN CATCH
            -- Capture error details
            SET @ErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();
            SET @ErrorProcedure = ERROR_PROCEDURE();
            SET @ErrorLine = CAST(ERROR_LINE() AS NVARCHAR(10));
            SET @ErrorSeverity = CAST(ERROR_SEVERITY() AS NVARCHAR(10));
            SET @ErrorState = CAST(ERROR_STATE() AS NVARCHAR(10));
            SET @ErrorNumber = CAST(ERROR_NUMBER() AS NVARCHAR(10));

            -- Log the error into tblErrorLog_MobstaAPI
            INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblErrorLog_MobstaAPI] (
                [Message],
                [Type],
                [LogDate],
                [Category],
                [Exception],
                [ActionName],
                [ErrorMessage],
                [ApplicationName]
            )
            VALUES (
                'Error occurred in stored procedure ' + @ThisProcedureName,
                'Stored Procedure',
                GETDATE(),
                'Database Operation',
                'Procedure: ' + ISNULL(@ErrorProcedure, '') + ', Line: ' + @ErrorLine,
                @ThisProcedureName,
                'Error Number: ' + @ErrorNumber + ', Severity: ' + @ErrorSeverity + ', State: ' + @ErrorState + ' - ' + @ErrorMessage,
                'MobStaAPI' 
            );

            -- Handle deadlock error (1205)
            IF ERROR_NUMBER() = 1205 AND @DeadlockErrorRetries < 3
            BEGIN
                ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;
                SET @DeadlockErrorRetries += 1;
                WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00.500'; -- Wait 500 ms before retrying
            END
            ELSE
            BEGIN
                -- Rollback transaction for unrecoverable errors
                ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;
                RAISERROR('An error occurred. Please check the error log.', 16, 1);
                RETURN;
            END
        END CATCH
    END
END;

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spUpdateScheduleWeekAudit]

    @SchedulePlaceholderFK INT = -1,
    @ScheduleDeliveryFK INT = -1,
    @BuildingFK INT,
    @UserId INT,
    @CurrentDate DATETIME,
	@ScheduleWeekPK INT OUTPUT
 )          
AS

 /* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */

   SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED

 ,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;          
 SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();          
          
 -- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters          
          
 DECLARE    
 @var_buildingFK INT,      
 @var_schedulePlaceholderFK INT,      
 @var_scheduleDeliveryFK INT,  
 @var_userId INT,                
 @var_currentDate DateTime;       
        
 SET @var_buildingFK=@BuildingFK;             
 SET @var_schedulePlaceholderFK=@SchedulePlaceholderFK;    
 SET @var_scheduleDeliveryFK= @ScheduleDeliveryFK;       
 SET @var_userId= @UserId;          
 SET @var_currentDate= dbo.GetBSTDate()      

  -- Set default output
SET @ScheduleWeekPK = -1;

 SET @ParameterDetails ='@BuildingFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_buildingFK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') +  
 ',@SchedulePlaceholderFK = '+ ISNULL(CAST( @var_schedulePlaceholderFK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') +        
 ',@ScheduleDeliveryFK = '+ ISNULL(CAST( @var_scheduleDeliveryFK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') +    
 ',@UserId = '+ ISNULL(CAST(  @var_userId AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'')        
          
    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL           
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)          
          
    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)          
    --BEGIN          
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC           
          
  SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)          
          
        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)          
        SELECT 'Database',@var_currentDate,@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK          
          
        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()          
    --END          
          
          
 SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);          
 SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails          
 ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;          
 INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()          
          
 WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3          
BEGIN          
  BEGIN TRY  
        IF (@var_schedulePlaceholderFK > 0)
            BEGIN
			   SELECT TOP 1 @ScheduleWeekPK = sw.ScheduleWeekPK
                FROM dbo.tblSchedulePlaceholders ph
                JOIN dbo.tblScheduleDays sd ON ph.ScheduleDayFK = sd.ScheduleDayPK
                JOIN dbo.tblScheduleChannels sc ON sd.ScheduleChannelFK = sc.ScheduleChannelPK
                JOIN dbo.tblScheduleWeeks sw ON sc.ScheduleWeekFK = sw.ScheduleWeekPK
			    WHERE ph.SchedulePlaceholderPK = @var_schedulePlaceholderFK
                 AND sw.BuildingFK = @var_buildingFK;
             
			  IF @ScheduleWeekPK > 0
                BEGIN
                    UPDATE dbo.tblScheduleWeeks
                    SET UpdatedDate = @var_currentDate,
                    UpdatedBy = @var_userId
                    WHERE ScheduleWeekPK = @ScheduleWeekPK;
                END
		    END
            ELSE IF (@var_scheduleDeliveryFK > 0)
            BEGIN
			  SELECT TOP 1 @ScheduleWeekPK = sw.ScheduleWeekPK
                FROM dbo.tblScheduleDeliveries d
                JOIN dbo.tblScheduleSlots ss ON d.ScheduleSlotFK = ss.ScheduleSlotPK
                JOIN dbo.tblScheduleDays sd ON ss.ScheduleDayFK = sd.ScheduleDayPK
                JOIN dbo.tblScheduleChannels sc ON sd.ScheduleChannelFK = sc.ScheduleChannelPK
                JOIN dbo.tblScheduleWeeks sw ON sc.ScheduleWeekFK = sw.ScheduleWeekPK			   
			    WHERE d.ScheduleDeliveryPK = @var_scheduleDeliveryFK
                  AND sw.BuildingFK = @var_buildingFK;
            
			IF @ScheduleWeekPK > 0
            BEGIN                 
                UPDATE  dbo.tblScheduleWeeks
                SET UpdatedDate = @var_currentDate,
                    UpdatedBy = @var_userId
                    WHERE ScheduleWeekPK = @ScheduleWeekPK;
           END
	    END
   
	BREAK; -- Exit loop if success     
              
  END TRY          
 BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */

   SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;          
   SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;          
          
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY           
   BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;          
                 
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;          
          
            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID          
                      
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;          
                      
   IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)          
   BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END          
   ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */          
  END CATCH          
  SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1          
 END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spUpdateScheduleWeekTemplate]
    @BuildingFK INT,
	@ScheduleWeekTemplatePK INT,    
    @Name NVARCHAR(100),
    @UserId INT  
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;  
    SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED;

    DECLARE 
        @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),
        @ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),
        @ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),
        @DeadlockErrorRetries INT = 1,
        @CurrentDate DATETIME,
        @EventLogPK INT,
        @ParentEventLogPK INT;

    -- Procedure name and current timestamp
    SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID);
    SET @CurrentDate = dbo.GetBSTDate(); -- Replace with GETDATE() if dbo.GetBSTDate() does not exist.

    -- Capture parameters for logging
    SET @ParameterDetails = 
        '@BuildingFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@BuildingFK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)), '') + 
        ',@ScheduleWeekTemplatePK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@ScheduleWeekTemplatePK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)), '') +
        ',@Name = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@Name AS NVARCHAR(MAX)), '') +
        ',@UserId = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@UserId AS NVARCHAR(MAX)), '');

    -- Retry deadlocks up to 3 times
    WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
    BEGIN
        BEGIN TRY
            BEGIN TRANSACTION;

            -- Check if record exists and perform the update
            IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM [dbo].[tblScheduleWeekTemplates] WHERE ScheduleWeekTemplatePK = @ScheduleWeekTemplatePK)
            BEGIN
                UPDATE [dbo].[tblScheduleWeekTemplates]
                SET 
                    [Name] = @Name,
                    [UpdatedBy] = @UserId,
                    [UpdatedDate] = @CurrentDate
                WHERE 
                    ScheduleWeekTemplatePK = @ScheduleWeekTemplatePK
                    AND BuildingFK = @BuildingFK;

                PRINT 'Record updated successfully.';
            END
            ELSE
            BEGIN
                PRINT 'Record not found.';
            END

            COMMIT TRANSACTION;
            BREAK; -- Exit retry loop on success
        END TRY
        BEGIN CATCH
            -- Capture error details
            DECLARE 
                @ErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX) = ERROR_MESSAGE(),
                @ErrorProcedure NVARCHAR(MAX) = ERROR_PROCEDURE(),
                @ErrorLine NVARCHAR(10) = CAST(ERROR_LINE() AS NVARCHAR(10)),
                @ErrorSeverity NVARCHAR(10) = CAST(ERROR_SEVERITY() AS NVARCHAR(10)),
                @ErrorState NVARCHAR(10) = CAST(ERROR_STATE() AS NVARCHAR(10)),
                @ErrorNumber NVARCHAR(10) = CAST(ERROR_NUMBER() AS NVARCHAR(10));

            -- Insert error details into tblErrorLog_MobstaAPI
            INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblErrorLog_MobstaAPI] (
                [Message],
                [Type],
                [LogDate],
                [Category],
                [Exception],
                [RequestId],
                [RequestPath],
                [ActionName],
                [TraceId],
                [ErrorMessage],
                [ApplicationName]
            )
            VALUES (
                'Error occurred in stored procedure ' + @ThisProcedureName,
                'Stored Procedure',
                GETDATE(),
                'Database Operation',
                'Procedure: ' + ISNULL(@ErrorProcedure, '') + ', Line: ' + @ErrorLine,
                NULL, -- RequestId (optional, if applicable)
                NULL, -- RequestPath (optional, if applicable)
                @ThisProcedureName,
                NULL, -- TraceId (optional, if applicable)
                'Error Number: ' + @ErrorNumber + ', Severity: ' + @ErrorSeverity + ', State: ' + @ErrorState + ' - ' + @ErrorMessage,
                'MobStaAPI' 
            );

            -- Handle Deadlock Error (1205)
            IF ERROR_NUMBER() = 1205 AND @DeadlockErrorRetries < 3
            BEGIN
                ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;
                SET @DeadlockErrorRetries += 1;
                WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00.500'; -- Pause for half a second before retry
            END
            ELSE
            BEGIN
                -- Log error and rethrow for non-recoverable errors
                ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;
                RAISERROR('An error occurred. Please check the error log.', 16, 1);
                RETURN;
            END
        END CATCH
    END
END;
GO

-- =====================================================================================================================================================================
-- Author:      Cathal OCuirrin
-- Create Date: 15 October 2019
-- Description: Adds a new/edits an existing tblUptimeLogsCriticalServiceHours table record.
-- Note: This is a child procedure and should be executed, along with the associated parent (and other child procedures), in a SQL transaction by the C# front end code.
-- ======================================================================================================================================================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spUptimeLogsAddEditCriticalServicesRecord]
( 
	@uptimeLogsDetailFK INT,
	@uptimeLogsCategoryFK INT,
	@mondayHours TIME(5), 
	@tuesdayHours TIME(5), 
	@wednesdayHours TIME(5), 
	@thursdayHours TIME(5), 
	@fridayHours TIME(5), 
	@saturdayHours TIME(5), 
	@sundayHours TIME(5),
	@userFK INT,
	@isAddingNewRecord BIT,
	@uptimeLogsCriticalServicePK INT = -1,
	@isArchived BIT = 0
)
AS
BEGIN
	BEGIN TRY
		DECLARE	@varUptimeLogsDetailFK INT = @uptimeLogsDetailFK, 
				@varUptimeLogsCategoryFK INT = @UptimeLogsCategoryFK, 		
				@varMondayHours TIME(5) = @mondayHours, 
				@varTuesdayHours TIME(5) = @tuesdayHours, 
				@varWednesdayHours TIME(5) = @wednesdayHours, 
				@varThursdayHours TIME(5) = @thursdayHours, 
				@varFridayHours TIME(5) = @fridayHours, 
				@varSaturdayHours TIME(5) = @saturdayHours, 
				@varSundayHours TIME(5) = @sundayHours,		
				@varUserFK INT = @userFK, 
				@varIsAddingNewRecord BIT = @isAddingNewRecord,
				@varUptimeLogsCriticalServicePK INT = @uptimeLogsCriticalServicePK,
				@varIsArchived BIT = @isArchived,
				@varCurrentDateTime DATETIME = dbo.GetBSTDate()

		SELECT
			@varMondayHours = CASE WHEN @varMondayHours IS NULL THEN '00:00' ELSE @varMondayHours END
			 
		SELECT
			@varTuesdayHours = CASE WHEN @varTuesdayHours IS NULL THEN '00:00' ELSE @varTuesdayHours END 

		SELECT
			@varWednesdayHours = CASE WHEN @varWednesdayHours IS NULL THEN '00:00' ELSE @varWednesdayHours END 

		SELECT
			@varThursdayHours = CASE WHEN @varThursdayHours IS NULL THEN '00:00' ELSE @varThursdayHours END

		SELECT
			@varFridayHours = CASE WHEN @varFridayHours IS NULL THEN '00:00' ELSE @varFridayHours END

		SELECT
			@varSaturdayHours = CASE WHEN @varSaturdayHours IS NULL THEN '00:00' ELSE @varSaturdayHours END
				
		SELECT 
			@varSundayHours = CASE WHEN @varSundayHours IS NULL THEN '00:00' ELSE @varSundayHours END	

		IF @varIsAddingNewRecord = 1
		BEGIN
			INSERT INTO dbo.tblUptimeLogsCriticalServices
			(
				UptimeLogsDetailFK, UptimeLogsCategoryFK, MondayHours, TuesdayHours, WednesdayHours, ThursdayHours, FridayHours, SaturdayHours, SundayHours,
				IsArchived, InsertedBy, InsertedDate, UpdatedBy, UpdatedDate
			)
			SELECT 
				@varUptimeLogsDetailFK, @varUptimeLogsCategoryFK, @varMondayHours, @varTuesdayHours, @varWednesdayHours, @varThursdayHours, @varFridayHours, @varSaturdayHours, @varSundayHours,
				0, @varUserFK, @varCurrentDateTime, @varUserFK, @varCurrentDateTime
		END
		ELSE
		BEGIN
			UPDATE dbo.tblUptimeLogsCriticalServices WITH (ROWLOCK)
			SET
				UptimeLogsDetailFK = @varUptimeLogsDetailFK, 
				UptimeLogsCategoryFK = @varUptimeLogsCategoryFK, 
				MondayHours = @varMondayHours, 
				TuesdayHours = @varTuesdayHours, 
				WednesdayHours = @varWednesdayHours, 
				ThursdayHours = @varThursdayHours, 
				FridayHours = @varFridayHours, 
				SaturdayHours = @varSaturdayHours, 
				SundayHours = @varSundayHours,
				IsArchived = @varIsArchived, 
				UpdatedBy = @varUserFK, 
				UpdatedDate = @varCurrentDateTime
			WHERE
				UptimeLogsCriticalServicePK = @varUptimeLogsCriticalServicePK
		END
	END TRY 
	BEGIN CATCH
		THROW
	END CATCH
END

-- =====================================================================================================================================================================

( 
	@uptimeLogsDetailFK INT,
	@UptimeLogsCategoryFK INT,
	@noInWarehouse INT,
	@minRequiredInWarehouse INT,
	@noInWarehouseOnMonday INT,
	@noInWarehouseOnTuesday INT,
	@noInWarehouseOnWednesday INT,
	@noInWarehouseOnThursday INT,
	@noInWarehouseOnFriday INT,
	@noInWarehouseOnSaturday INT,
	@noInWarehouseOnSunday INT,
	@userFK INT,
	@isAddingNewRecord BIT,
	@uptimeLogsHardwarePK INT = -1,
	@isArchived BIT = 0

AS
BEGIN
	BEGIN TRY
		DECLARE	@varUptimeLogsDetailFK INT = @uptimeLogsDetailFK,

				@varNoInWarehouse INT = @noInWarehouse,

				@varNoInWarehouseOnMonday INT = @noInWarehouseOnMonday,
				@varNoInWarehouseOnTuesday INT = @noInWarehouseOnTuesday,
				@varNoInWarehouseOnWednesday INT = @noInWarehouseOnWednesday,
				@varNoInWarehouseOnThursday INT = @noInWarehouseOnThursday,
				@varNoInWarehouseOnFriday INT = @noInWarehouseOnFriday,
				@varNoInWarehouseOnSaturday INT = @noInWarehouseOnSaturday,
				@varNoInWarehouseOnSunday INT = @noInWarehouseOnSunday,
				@varUserFK INT = @userFK, 
				@varIsAddingNewRecord BIT = @isAddingNewRecord,
				@varUptimeLogsHardwarePK INT = @uptimeLogsHardwarePK,
				@varIsArchived BIT = @isArchived,
				@varCurrentDateTime DATETIME = dbo.GetBSTDate()

		SELECT
			@varNoInWarehouse = CASE WHEN @varNoInWarehouse IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE @varNoInWarehouse END	
			
		SELECT
			@varMinRequiredInWarehouse = CASE WHEN @varMinRequiredInWarehouse IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE @varMinRequiredInWarehouse END	
			
		SELECT
			@varNoInWarehouseOnMonday = CASE WHEN @varNoInWarehouseOnMonday IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE @varNoInWarehouseOnMonday END	
			
		SELECT
			@varNoInWarehouseOnTuesday = CASE WHEN @varNoInWarehouseOnTuesday IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE @varNoInWarehouseOnTuesday END
			
		SELECT
			@varNoInWarehouseOnWednesday = CASE WHEN @varNoInWarehouseOnWednesday IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE @varNoInWarehouseOnWednesday END
			
		SELECT
			@varNoInWarehouseOnThursday = CASE WHEN @varNoInWarehouseOnThursday IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE @varNoInWarehouseOnThursday END
			
		SELECT
			@varNoInWarehouseOnFriday = CASE WHEN @varNoInWarehouseOnFriday IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE @varNoInWarehouseOnFriday END
			
		SELECT
			@varNoInWarehouseOnSaturday = CASE WHEN @varNoInWarehouseOnSaturday IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE @varNoInWarehouseOnSaturday END
			
		SELECT
			@varNoInWarehouseOnSunday = CASE WHEN @varNoInWarehouseOnSunday IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE @varNoInWarehouseOnSunday END																										

		IF @varIsAddingNewRecord = 1
		BEGIN
			INSERT INTO dbo.tblUptimeLogsHardware
			(
				UptimeLogsDetailFK, UptimeLogsCategoryFK, 
				NoInWarehouse, MinRequiredInWarehouse, NoInWarehouseOnMonday, NoInWarehouseOnTuesday, NoInWarehouseOnWednesday,
				NoInWarehouseOnThursday, NoInWarehouseOnFriday, NoInWarehouseOnSaturday, NoInWarehouseOnSunday,			
				IsArchived, InsertedBy, InsertedDate, UpdatedBy, UpdatedDate

			SELECT

				@varNoInWarehouseOnThursday, @varNoInWarehouseOnFriday, @varNoInWarehouseOnSaturday, @varNoInWarehouseOnSunday,		
				0, @varUserFK, @varCurrentDateTime, @varUserFK, @varCurrentDateTime
			END
		ELSE
		BEGIN
			DECLARE @transaction NVARCHAR(32) = REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(CAST(@@SPID AS NVARCHAR(50)) + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(50), GETDATE(), 21), ' - ', ''), ' ', ''), ':', ''), '.', '');

			BEGIN TRY
				BEGIN TRANSACTION @transaction

				UPDATE dbo.tblUptimeLogsHardware WITH (ROWLOCK)
				SET
					UptimeLogsDetailFK = @varUptimeLogsDetailFK, 
					UptimeLogsCategoryFK = @varUptimeLogsCategoryFK, 
					NoInWarehouse = @varNoInWarehouse, 
					MinRequiredInWarehouse = @varMinRequiredInWarehouse,

					NoInWarehouseOnSunday = @varNoInWarehouseOnSunday,			
					IsArchived = @varIsArchived, 
					UpdatedBy = @varUserFK, 
					UpdatedDate = @varCurrentDateTime
				WHERE
					UptimeLogsHardwarePK = @varUptimeLogsHardwarePK 

				DECLARE @varBuildingFK INT = (SELECT TOP 1 BuildingFK FROM dbo.tblUptimeLogsDetails WHERE UptimeLogsDetailPK = @varUptimeLogsDetailFK)				

				UPDATE dbo.tblUptimeLogsDefaultValues WITH (ROWLOCK)
				SET NoInWarehouse = @varNoInWarehouse,
				MinRequiredInWarehouse = @varMinRequiredInWarehouse
				WHERE BuildingFK = @varBuildingFK
				AND UptimeLogsCategoryFK = @varUptimeLogsCategoryFK			

				COMMIT TRANSACTION @transaction
			END TRY
			BEGIN CATCH
				BEGIN TRY
					ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @transaction
				END TRY
				BEGIN CATCH /*Ignore and continue*/ END CATCH
			END CATCH
		END
	END TRY 
	BEGIN CATCH
		THROW
	END CATCH
END

		IF @varIsAddingNewRecord = 1
		BEGIN
			INSERT INTO dbo.tblUptimeLogsITExternalIssues
			(
				UptimeLogsDetailFK, UptimeLogsCategoryFK,
				NoOfJiraTickets, TimeSpentMinutes, DowntimeMinutes, 
				IsArchived, InsertedBy, InsertedDate, UpdatedBy, UpdatedDate
			)
			SELECT 
				@varUptimeLogsDetailFK, @varUptimeLogsCategoryFK,
				@varNoOfJiraTickets, dbo.fnGetTimeInMinutes(@varTimeSpent), dbo.fnGetTimeInMinutes(@varDowntime), 
				0, @varUserFK, @varCurrentDateTime, @varUserFK, @varCurrentDateTime
		END
		BEGIN
			UPDATE dbo.tblUptimeLogsITExternalIssues WITH (ROWLOCK)
			SET
				UptimeLogsDetailFK = @varUptimeLogsDetailFK, 
				UptimeLogsCategoryFK = @varUptimeLogsCategoryFK,
				NoOfJiraTickets = @varNoOfJiraTickets, 
				TimeSpentMinutes = dbo.fnGetTimeInMinutes(@varTimeSpent), 
				DowntimeMinutes = dbo.fnGetTimeInMinutes(@varDowntime), 
				IsArchived = @varIsArchived, 
				UpdatedBy = @varUserFK, 
				UpdatedDate	= 	@varCurrentDateTime
			WHERE
				UptimeLogsITExternalIssuePK = @varUptimeLogsITExternalIssuesPK
		END
	END TRY 
	BEGIN CATCH
		THROW
	END CATCH
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spUptimeLogsGetBuildingLastConfirmedDate] -- [dbo].[spUptimeLogsGetBuildingLastConfirmedDate] @buildingFK = 1, @uptimeLogDate = '2020-01-13'
(
--declare
	@buildingFK	INT,
	@uptimeLogDate DATE

	--select @buildingFK = 1, @uptimeLogDate = dbo.GetBSTDate()
)
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ UNCOMMITTED; SET DEADLOCK_PRIORITY LOW

	DECLARE
		@varBuildingFK INT = @buildingFK, @varUptimeLogDate DATE = @uptimeLogDate, @varBuildingLastConfirmedDate DATE, @varBuildingNextConfirmedDate DATE, @varIsArchived BIT = 0 

	SELECT 
		@varUptimeLogDate =	CASE 
								WHEN LEFT(DATENAME(dw, @varUptimeLogDate), 3) = 'Tue' THEN DATEADD(DAY, -1, @varUptimeLogDate)
								WHEN LEFT(DATENAME(dw, @varUptimeLogDate), 3) = 'Wed' THEN DATEADD(DAY, -2, @varUptimeLogDate)
								WHEN LEFT(DATENAME(dw, @varUptimeLogDate), 3) = 'Thu' THEN DATEADD(DAY, -3, @varUptimeLogDate)
								WHEN LEFT(DATENAME(dw, @varUptimeLogDate), 3) = 'Fri' THEN DATEADD(DAY, -4, @varUptimeLogDate)
								WHEN LEFT(DATENAME(dw, @varUptimeLogDate), 3) = 'Sat' THEN DATEADD(DAY, -5, @varUptimeLogDate)
								WHEN LEFT(DATENAME(dw, @varUptimeLogDate), 3) = 'Sun' THEN DATEADD(DAY, -6, @varUptimeLogDate)
							ELSE
								@varUptimeLogDate
							END

	SELECT TOP 1 @varIsArchived = IsArchived
	FROM dbo.tblUptimeLogsDetails WITH (NOLOCK) 
	WHERE BuildingFK = @varBuildingFK 
	AND UptimeLogDate = @varUptimeLogDate

	SELECT @varBuildingLastConfirmedDate = MAX(UptimeLogDate)
	FROM dbo.tblUptimeLogsDetails WITH (NOLOCK) 
	WHERE BuildingFK = @varBuildingFK 
	AND IsArchived = 1

	IF @varBuildingLastConfirmedDate IS NULL
	BEGIN
		SELECT @varBuildingNextConfirmedDate = MIN(UptimeLogDate) 
		FROM dbo.tblUptimeLogsDetails 
		WHERE BuildingFK = @varBuildingFK 
	END
	ELSE
		SELECT @varBuildingNextConfirmedDate = DATEADD(DAY, 7, @varBuildingLastConfirmedDate)

	SELECT ISNULL(CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), @varBuildingLastConfirmedDate, 103), '') AS BuildingLastConfirmedDate, 
	ISNULL(CONVERT(NVARCHAR(8), @varBuildingLastConfirmedDate, 112), '') AS BuildingLastConfirmedDateYYYYMMDD,
	REPLACE(ISNULL(CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), @varBuildingNextConfirmedDate, 103), ''),'/','-') AS BuildingNextConfirmDateDDMMYYYY,
	ISNULL(CONVERT(NVARCHAR(8), @varBuildingNextConfirmedDate, 112), '') AS BuildingNextConfirmDateYYYYMMDD,
	@varIsArchived AS SelectedWeekIsConfirmed
END
GO

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spUptimeLogsGetDetailsForBuildingAndDate] -- [dbo].[spUptimeLogsGetDetailsForBuildingAndDate] @buildingFK = 11, @uptimeLogDate = '20191025', @userFK = 287
(
--declare
	@buildingFK	INT,
	@uptimeLogDate DATE,
	@userFK INT  

	--select @buildingFK = 21, @uptimeLogDate = '20191230', @userFK = 287
)
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ UNCOMMITTED; SET DEADLOCK_PRIORITY LOW

	DECLARE
		@varBuildingFK INT = @buildingFK, @varUptimeLogDate DATE = @uptimeLogDate, @varUserFK INT = @userFK, @varUptimeLogsDetailPK INT, @varUptimeLogsCategoryFK INT,
		@varBuildingName NVARCHAR(50)

	SELECT 
		@varUptimeLogDate =	CASE 
								WHEN LEFT(DATENAME(dw, @varUptimeLogDate), 3) = 'Tue' THEN DATEADD(DAY, -1, @varUptimeLogDate)
								WHEN LEFT(DATENAME(dw, @varUptimeLogDate), 3) = 'Wed' THEN DATEADD(DAY, -2, @varUptimeLogDate)
								WHEN LEFT(DATENAME(dw, @varUptimeLogDate), 3) = 'Thu' THEN DATEADD(DAY, -3, @varUptimeLogDate)
								WHEN LEFT(DATENAME(dw, @varUptimeLogDate), 3) = 'Fri' THEN DATEADD(DAY, -4, @varUptimeLogDate)
								WHEN LEFT(DATENAME(dw, @varUptimeLogDate), 3) = 'Sat' THEN DATEADD(DAY, -5, @varUptimeLogDate)
								WHEN LEFT(DATENAME(dw, @varUptimeLogDate), 3) = 'Sun' THEN DATEADD(DAY, -6, @varUptimeLogDate)
							ELSE
								@varUptimeLogDate
							END

	SELECT 
	@varBuildingName = CASE WHEN ISNULL(DepartmentTMS, '') <> '' THEN DepartmentTMS ELSE BuildingName END 
	FROM dbo.tblBuildings WITH (NOLOCK) 
	WHERE BuildingPK = @buildingFK

	DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #UptimeLogsDetails

GET_PK:

	SELECT TOP 1 @varUptimeLogsDetailPK = UptimeLogsDetailPK 
	FROM dbo.tblUptimeLogsDetails uld WITH (NOLOCK) 
	WHERE uld.BuildingFK = @varBuildingFK	
	AND uld.UptimeLogDate = @varUptimeLogDate

	-- Create the main/parent record if one does not exist.
	IF ISNULL(@varUptimeLogsDetailPK, -1) < 1
	BEGIN
		EXEC dbo.spUptimeLogsAddEditDetailsRecord @buildingFK = @varBuildingFK, @uptimeLogDate = @varUptimeLogDate, @userFK = @varUserFK, @isAddingNewRecord = 1
		GOTO GET_PK
	END

	-- Create the UptimeLogsCriticalServices record if one does not exist.
	IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.tblUptimeLogsCriticalServices uldh WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE uldh.UptimeLogsDetailFK = @varUptimeLogsDetailPK) --AND @varBuildingName = 'BV1'
	BEGIN
		DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #uptimeLogsCriticalServicesCategories

		SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY ultc.CategoryScreenOrder ASC) AS RowNumber, 
		ultc.UptimeLogsCategoryFK
		INTO #uptimeLogsCriticalServicesCategories
		FROM dbo.tblUptimeLogsBuildingCategories ultc WITH (NOLOCK)
		INNER JOIN dbo.appUptimeLogsTables ult WITH (NOLOCK)
		ON ultc.UptimeLogsTableFK = ult.UptimeLogsTablePK
		WHERE ult.UptimeLogsTableName = 'tblUptimeLogsCriticalServices'
		AND ultc.BuildingFK = @varBuildingFK

START_CriticalServices_LOOP:

		IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #uptimeLogsCriticalServicesCategories) GOTO EXIT_CriticalServices_LOOP

		SELECT TOP 1 @varUptimeLogsCategoryFK = UptimeLogsCategoryFK from #uptimeLogsCriticalServicesCategories ORDER BY RowNumber ASC
	
		DELETE FROM #uptimeLogsCriticalServicesCategories WHERE UptimeLogsCategoryFK = @varUptimeLogsCategoryFK

		EXEC dbo.spUptimeLogsAddEditCriticalServicesRecord @uptimeLogsDetailFK = @varUptimeLogsDetailPK, @uptimeLogsCategoryFK = @varUptimeLogsCategoryFK, 
																@mondayHours = NULL, @tuesdayHours = NULL, @wednesdayHours = NULL, @thursdayHours = NULL, @fridayHours = NULL, 
																	@saturdayHours = NULL, @sundayHours = NULL, @userFK = @varUserFK, @isAddingNewRecord = 1
		GOTO START_CriticalServices_LOOP

EXIT_CriticalServices_LOOP:

	END	

	-- Create the UptimeLogsHardware record if one does not exist.
	IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.tblUptimeLogsHardware tulh WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE tulh.UptimeLogsDetailFK = @varUptimeLogsDetailPK) --AND @varBuildingName = 'BV1'
	BEGIN		
		DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #UptimeLogsHardwareCategories

		SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY ultc.CategoryScreenOrder ASC) AS RowNumber, 
		ultc.UptimeLogsCategoryFK
		INTO #UptimeLogsHardwareCategories
		FROM dbo.tblUptimeLogsBuildingCategories ultc WITH (NOLOCK)
		INNER JOIN dbo.appUptimeLogsTables ult WITH (NOLOCK)
		ON ultc.UptimeLogsTableFK = ult.UptimeLogsTablePK
		WHERE ult.UptimeLogsTableName = 'tblUptimeLogsHardware'
		AND ultc.BuildingFK = @varBuildingFK

START_HARDWARE_LOOP:

		IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #UptimeLogsHardwareCategories) GOTO EXIT_CriticalServices_LOOP

		SELECT TOP 1 @varUptimeLogsCategoryFK = UptimeLogsCategoryFK from #UptimeLogsHardwareCategories ORDER BY RowNumber ASC
	
		DELETE FROM #UptimeLogsHardwareCategories WHERE UptimeLogsCategoryFK = @varUptimeLogsCategoryFK

		DECLARE @varNoInWarehouse INT = 0, @varMinRequiredInWarehouse INT = 0

		SELECT TOP 1 
		@varNoInWarehouse = t2.NoInWarehouse, 
		@varMinRequiredInWarehouse = t2.MinRequiredInWarehouse 
		FROM dbo.tblUptimeLogsBuildingCategories t1 WITH (NOLOCK) 
		INNER JOIN dbo.tblUptimeLogsDefaultValues t2
		on t1.BuildingFK = t2.BuildingFK
		AND t1.UptimeLogsCategoryFK = t2.UptimeLogsCategoryFK
		WHERE t1.BuildingFK = @varBuildingFK 
		AND t1.UptimeLogsCategoryFK = @varUptimeLogsCategoryFK

		SELECT @varNoInWarehouse = ISNULL(@varNoInWarehouse, 0)
		SELECT @varMinRequiredInWarehouse = ISNULL(@varMinRequiredInWarehouse, 0)

		EXEC dbo.spUptimeLogsAddEditHardwareRecord @uptimeLogsDetailFK = @varUptimeLogsDetailPK, @uptimeLogsCategoryFK = @varUptimeLogsCategoryFK, 
																				@noInWarehouse = @varNoInWarehouse,@minRequiredInWarehouse = @varMinRequiredInWarehouse, @noInWarehouseOnMonday = 0,	
																					@noInWarehouseOnTuesday = 0, @noInWarehouseOnWednesday = 0, @noInWarehouseOnThursday = 0,
																						@noInWarehouseOnFriday = 0, @noInWarehouseOnSaturday = 0, @noInWarehouseOnSunday = 0,	
																							@userFK = @varUserFK, @isAddingNewRecord = 1

		GOTO START_HARDWARE_LOOP

EXIT_HARDWARE_LOOP:

	END

	-- Create the UptimeLogsJiraTickets record if one does not exist.
	IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.tblUptimeLogsJiraTickets uljt WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE uljt.UptimeLogsDetailFK = @varUptimeLogsDetailPK) --AND @varBuildingName = 'BV1'
	BEGIN		
		DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #uptimeLogsJiraTicketsCategories

		SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY ultc.CategoryScreenOrder ASC) AS RowNumber, 
		ultc.UptimeLogsCategoryFK
		INTO #uptimeLogsJiraTicketsCategories
		FROM dbo.tblUptimeLogsBuildingCategories ultc WITH (NOLOCK)
		INNER JOIN dbo.appUptimeLogsTables ult WITH (NOLOCK)
		ON ultc.UptimeLogsTableFK = ult.UptimeLogsTablePK
		WHERE ult.UptimeLogsTableName = 'tblUptimeLogsJiraTickets'
		AND ultc.BuildingFK = @varBuildingFK

START_JIRATICKETS_LOOP:

		IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #uptimeLogsJiraTicketsCategories) GOTO EXIT_JIRATICKETS_LOOP

		SELECT TOP 1 @varUptimeLogsCategoryFK = UptimeLogsCategoryFK from #uptimeLogsJiraTicketsCategories ORDER BY RowNumber ASC
	
		DELETE FROM #uptimeLogsJiraTicketsCategories WHERE UptimeLogsCategoryFK = @varUptimeLogsCategoryFK

		EXEC dbo.spUptimeLogsAddEditJiraTicketsRecord @uptimeLogsDetailFK = @varUptimeLogsDetailPK, @uptimeLogsCategoryFK = @varUptimeLogsCategoryFK, 
														@noOfTicketsCreated = 0, @noOfTicketsResolved = 0, @noOfTicketsOngoingOpen = 0,	@noOfTicketsWaitingOnCustomer = 0, 
															@noOfTicketsWaitingOnVendor = 0, @other = 0, @userFK = @varUserFK, @isAddingNewRecord = 1

		GOTO START_JIRATICKETS_LOOP

EXIT_JIRATICKETS_LOOP:

	END

	-- Create the UptimeLogsIntegrationFiles record if one does not exist.
	IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.tblUptimeLogsIntegrationFiles ulf WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE ulf.UptimeLogsDetailFK = @varUptimeLogsDetailPK) --AND @varBuildingName = 'BV1'
	BEGIN
		DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #uptimeLogsIntegrationFilesCategories

		SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY ultc.CategoryScreenOrder ASC) AS RowNumber, 
		ultc.UptimeLogsCategoryFK
		INTO #uptimeLogsIntegrationFilesCategories
		FROM dbo.tblUptimeLogsBuildingCategories ultc WITH (NOLOCK)
		INNER JOIN dbo.appUptimeLogsTables ult WITH (NOLOCK)
		ON ultc.UptimeLogsTableFK = ult.UptimeLogsTablePK
		WHERE ult.UptimeLogsTableName = 'tblUptimeLogsIntegrationFiles'
		AND ultc.BuildingFK = @varBuildingFK

START_INTEGRATIONFILES_LOOP:

		IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #uptimeLogsIntegrationFilesCategories) GOTO EXIT_INTEGRATIONFILES_LOOP

		SELECT TOP 1 @varUptimeLogsCategoryFK = UptimeLogsCategoryFK from #uptimeLogsIntegrationFilesCategories ORDER BY RowNumber ASC

		DELETE FROM #uptimeLogsIntegrationFilesCategories WHERE UptimeLogsCategoryFK = @varUptimeLogsCategoryFK

		EXEC dbo.spUptimeLogsAddEditIntegrationFilesRecord @uptimeLogsDetailFK = @varUptimeLogsDetailPK, @uptimeLogsCategoryFK = @varUptimeLogsCategoryFK, @noOfStoreAllIssues = 0,
															@noOfCustomerIssues = 0, @noOfFilesIn = 0, @noOfFilesOut = 0, @stockInEmailsTotal = 0,
																@userFK = @varUserFK, @isAddingNewRecord = 1

		GOTO START_INTEGRATIONFILES_LOOP

EXIT_INTEGRATIONFILES_LOOP:

	END	

	-- Create the UptimeLogsPhysicalChecks record if one does not exist.
	IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.tblUptimeLogsPhysicalChecks ulpc WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE ulpc.UptimeLogsDetailFK = @varUptimeLogsDetailPK) --AND @varBuildingName = 'BV1'
	BEGIN
		DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #uptimeLogsPhysicalChecksCategories

		SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY ultc.CategoryScreenOrder ASC) AS RowNumber, 
		ultc.UptimeLogsCategoryFK
		INTO #uptimeLogsPhysicalChecksCategories
		FROM dbo.tblUptimeLogsBuildingCategories ultc WITH (NOLOCK)
		INNER JOIN dbo.appUptimeLogsTables ult WITH (NOLOCK)
		ON ultc.UptimeLogsTableFK = ult.UptimeLogsTablePK
		WHERE ult.UptimeLogsTableName = 'tblUptimeLogsPhysicalChecks'
		AND ultc.BuildingFK = @varBuildingFK

START_PHYSICALCHECKS_LOOP:

		IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #uptimeLogsPhysicalChecksCategories) GOTO EXIT_PHYSICALCHECKS_LOOP

		SELECT TOP 1 @varUptimeLogsCategoryFK = UptimeLogsCategoryFK from #uptimeLogsPhysicalChecksCategories ORDER BY RowNumber ASC

		DELETE FROM #uptimeLogsPhysicalChecksCategories WHERE UptimeLogsCategoryFK = @varUptimeLogsCategoryFK

		EXEC dbo.spUptimeLogsAddEditPhysicalChecksRecord @uptimeLogsDetailFK = @varUptimeLogsDetailPK, @uptimeLogsCategoryFK = @varUptimeLogsCategoryFK, 
			@noOfPalletsAccepted = 0, @noOfPalletsRejected = 0, @noOfPalletsDispatched = 0, @userFK = @varUserFK, @isAddingNewRecord = 1

		GOTO START_PHYSICALCHECKS_LOOP

EXIT_PHYSICALCHECKS_LOOP:

	END	

	-- 1. 

	DECLARE @weekNumber INT = (SELECT CASE WHEN DATEPART(wk, @varUptimeLogDate) > 52 THEN 1 ELSE DATEPART(wk, @varUptimeLogDate) END)

	SELECT 'Data for week no. ' + CAST(@weekNumber AS NVARCHAR(2)) + ' (' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), @varUptimeLogDate, 103) + ' to ' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), DATEADD(DAY, 6, @varUptimeLogDate), 103) + ')' AS [DataForWeek]

	-- 2. Return the UptimeLogsCriticalServices record details.

	DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #UptimeLogsCriticalServices

	SELECT DISTINCT
		uldh.UptimeLogsCriticalServicePK,
		uldh.UptimeLogsDetailFK,
		uldh.UptimeLogsCategoryFK,
		ulc_uldh.UptimeLogsCategory,
		ultc.CategoryScreenOrder,

		CAST(uldh.MondayHours AS NVARCHAR(5)) AS MondayHours,
		CAST(uldh.TuesdayHours AS NVARCHAR(5)) AS TuesdayHours,
		CAST(uldh.WednesdayHours AS NVARCHAR(5)) AS WednesdayHours,
		CAST(uldh.ThursdayHours AS NVARCHAR(5)) AS ThursdayHours,
		CAST(uldh.FridayHours AS NVARCHAR(5)) AS FridayHours,
		CAST(uldh.SaturdayHours AS NVARCHAR(5)) AS SaturdayHours,
		CAST(uldh.SundayHours AS NVARCHAR(5)) AS SundayHours,

		(dbo.fnGetTimeInMinutes(uldh.MondayHours) + dbo.fnGetTimeInMinutes(uldh.TuesdayHours) + dbo.fnGetTimeInMinutes(uldh.WednesdayHours) 
			+ dbo.fnGetTimeInMinutes(uldh.ThursdayHours) + dbo.fnGetTimeInMinutes(uldh.FridayHours) + dbo.fnGetTimeInMinutes(uldh.SaturdayHours) 
				+ dbo.fnGetTimeInMinutes(uldh.SundayHours)) AS TotalMinutes

		--dbo.fnGetHoursAndMinutesTimeFormatForMinutes(
		--												dbo.fnGetTimeInMinutes(uldh.MondayHours) + dbo.fnGetTimeInMinutes(uldh.TuesdayHours) + dbo.fnGetTimeInMinutes(uldh.WednesdayHours) 
		--													+ dbo.fnGetTimeInMinutes(uldh.ThursdayHours) + dbo.fnGetTimeInMinutes(uldh.FridayHours) + dbo.fnGetTimeInMinutes(uldh.SaturdayHours) 
		--														+ dbo.fnGetTimeInMinutes(uldh.SundayHours)
		--											) AS TotalHours
	INTO
		#UptimeLogsCriticalServices
	FROM
		dbo.tblUptimeLogsCriticalServices uldh WITH (NOLOCK)
	INNER JOIN dbo.tblUptimeLogsBuildingCategories ultc WITH (NOLOCK)
		ON uldh.UptimeLogsCategoryFK = ultc.UptimeLogsCategoryFK		
	INNER JOIN dbo.appUptimeLogsTables ult WITH (NOLOCK)
		ON ultc.UptimeLogsTableFK = ult.UptimeLogsTablePK
	INNER JOIN dbo.appUptimeLogsCategories ulc_uldh WITH (NOLOCK)
		ON ultc.UptimeLogsCategoryFK = ulc_uldh.UptimeLogsCategoryPK
	WHERE
		uldh.UptimeLogsDetailFK = @varUptimeLogsDetailPK
		AND ult.UptimeLogsTableName = 'tblUptimeLogsCriticalServices'
		AND ultc.BuildingFK = @varBuildingFK

	SELECT
		*,

		CASE 
			WHEN TotalMinutes = 0 THEN '00:00'
		ELSE
			dbo.fnGetHoursAndMinutesTimeFormatForMinutes(TotalMinutes)
		END AS TotalHours,

		CASE 
			WHEN TotalMinutes = 0 THEN '100.00'
		ELSE
			CAST(CAST(ROUND(100.00 - ((TotalMinutes / 10080/*No. of minutes in a 7 day week*/) * 100.00), 2) AS DECIMAL(15,2)) AS VARCHAR(50)) 
		END + '%' AS PercentageUptime 
	FROM
		#UptimeLogsCriticalServices
	ORDER BY
		UptimeLogsCriticalServicePK ASC,
		CategoryScreenOrder ASC

	-- 3. Return the UptimeLogsHardware record details.

	SELECT DISTINCT
		ulh.UptimeLogsHardwarePK,
		ulh.UptimeLogsDetailFK,
		ulh.UptimeLogsCategoryFK,
		ulc_ulh.UptimeLogsCategory,
		ultc.CategoryScreenOrder,
		ulh.NoInWarehouse,
		ulh.MinRequiredInWarehouse,
		ulh.NoInWarehouseOnMonday,
		ulh.NoInWarehouseOnTuesday,
		ulh.NoInWarehouseOnWednesday,
		ulh.NoInWarehouseOnThursday,
		ulh.NoInWarehouseOnFriday,
		ulh.NoInWarehouseOnSaturday,
		ulh.NoInWarehouseOnSunday,

		CASE
			WHEN MinRequiredInWarehouse < 1 THEN 
				'0.00'
			ELSE
				CAST(CAST((CAST((ulh.NoInWarehouseOnMonday + 
				ulh.NoInWarehouseOnTuesday + 
				ulh.NoInWarehouseOnWednesday + 
				ulh.NoInWarehouseOnThursday + 
				ulh.NoInWarehouseOnFriday + 
				ulh.NoInWarehouseOnSaturday + 
				ulh.NoInWarehouseOnSunday) AS DECIMAL(18,2)) / 7.00) / CAST(ulh.MinRequiredInWarehouse AS DECIMAL(18,2)) * 100.00 AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS NVARCHAR(50))
		END + '%' AS PercentageMinimumAvailable
	FROM 
		dbo.tblUptimeLogsHardware ulh WITH (NOLOCK)
	INNER JOIN dbo.tblUptimeLogsBuildingCategories ultc WITH (NOLOCK)
		ON ulh.UptimeLogsCategoryFK = ultc.UptimeLogsCategoryFK		
	INNER JOIN dbo.appUptimeLogsTables ult WITH (NOLOCK)
		ON ultc.UptimeLogsTableFK = ult.UptimeLogsTablePK
	INNER JOIN dbo.appUptimeLogsCategories ulc_ulh WITH (NOLOCK)
		ON ultc.UptimeLogsCategoryFK = ulc_ulh.UptimeLogsCategoryPK
	WHERE
		ulh.UptimeLogsDetailFK = @varUptimeLogsDetailPK
		AND ult.UptimeLogsTableName = 'tblUptimeLogsHardware'
		AND ultc.BuildingFK = @varBuildingFK
	ORDER BY 
		ulh.UptimeLogsHardwarePK ASC,
		ultc.CategoryScreenOrder ASC

	-- 4. Return the UptimeLogsJiraTickets record details.

	SELECT DISTINCT
		uljt.UptimeLogsJiraTicketPK,
		uljt.UptimeLogsDetailFK,
		uljt.UptimeLogsCategoryFK,
		ulc_uljt.UptimeLogsCategory,
		ultc.CategoryScreenOrder,
		uljt.NoOfTicketsCreated,
		uljt.NoOfTicketsResolved,
		uljt.NoOfTicketsOngoingOpen,
		uljt.NoOfTicketsWaitingOnCustomer,
		uljt.NoOfTicketsWaitingOnVendor,
		uljt.Other
	FROM
		dbo.tblUptimeLogsJiraTickets uljt WITH (NOLOCK)
	INNER JOIN dbo.tblUptimeLogsBuildingCategories ultc WITH (NOLOCK)
		ON uljt.UptimeLogsCategoryFK = ultc.UptimeLogsCategoryFK		
	INNER JOIN dbo.appUptimeLogsTables ult WITH (NOLOCK)
		ON ultc.UptimeLogsTableFK = ult.UptimeLogsTablePK
	INNER JOIN dbo.appUptimeLogsCategories ulc_uljt WITH (NOLOCK)
		ON ultc.UptimeLogsCategoryFK = ulc_uljt.UptimeLogsCategoryPK
	WHERE
		uljt.UptimeLogsDetailFK = @varUptimeLogsDetailPK
		AND ult.UptimeLogsTableName = 'tblUptimeLogsJiraTickets'
		AND ultc.BuildingFK = @varBuildingFK
	ORDER BY
		uljt.UptimeLogsJiraTicketPK ASC,
		ultc.CategoryScreenOrder ASC

	-- 5. Return the UptimeLogsIntegrationFiles record details.

	DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #uptimeLogsIntegrationFiles

	SELECT TOP 1
		ulf.UptimeLogsIntegrationFilePK, ulf.UptimeLogsDetailFK, ulf.UptimeLogsCategoryFK, ulc_ulf.UptimeLogsCategory, ultc.CategoryScreenOrder,
		ulf.NoOfStoreAllIssues, ulf.NoOfCustomerIssues, ulf.NoOfFilesIn, ulf.NoOfFilesOut,
		(ulf.NoOfFilesIn + ulf.NoOfFilesOut) AS TotalNoOfFilesInOut,


		CASE
			WHEN @varBuildingName = 'BV2' THEN

				(CASE 
					WHEN ulf.StockInEmailsTotal < 1 THEN 
						0.00
				ELSE 
					CAST(ROUND(CAST(ulf.NoOfStoreAllIssues AS DECIMAL(18, 2)) / (ulf.StockInEmailsTotal) * 100.00, 2) AS DECIMAL(18, 2))
				END)

			WHEN @varBuildingName <> 'BV2' THEN

				(CASE 
					WHEN ulf.NoOfFilesIn < 1 THEN 
						0.00
				ELSE 
					CAST(ROUND(CAST(ulf.NoOfStoreAllIssues AS DECIMAL(18, 2)) / (ulf.NoOfFilesIn + ulf.NoOfFilesOut) * 100.00, 2) AS DECIMAL(18, 2))
				END)
		END AS AutoCalcStoreAllPercentOfIssues,

		CASE
			WHEN @varBuildingName = 'BV2' THEN

				(CASE 
					WHEN ISNULL(ulf.StockInEmailsTotal, 0) < 1 THEN 
						0.00
					ELSE 
						CAST(ROUND(CAST(ulf.NoOfCustomerIssues AS DECIMAL(18, 2)) / (ulf.StockInEmailsTotal) * 100.00, 2) AS DECIMAL(18, 2))
				END)

			WHEN @varBuildingName <> 'BV2' THEN

				(CASE 
					WHEN ISNULL(ulf.NoOfFilesIn, 0) < 1 THEN 
						0.00
					ELSE 
						CAST(ROUND(CAST(ulf.NoOfCustomerIssues AS DECIMAL(18, 2)) / (ulf.NoOfFilesIn + ulf.NoOfFilesOut) * 100.00, 2) AS DECIMAL(18, 2))
				END)
		END AS AutoCalcCustomerPercentOfIssues,

		StockInEmailsTotal
	INTO
		#uptimeLogsIntegrationFiles
	FROM
		dbo.tblUptimeLogsIntegrationFiles ulf WITH (NOLOCK)		
	INNER JOIN dbo.tblUptimeLogsBuildingCategories ultc WITH (NOLOCK)
		ON ulf.UptimeLogsCategoryFK = ultc.UptimeLogsCategoryFK		
	INNER JOIN dbo.appUptimeLogsTables ult WITH (NOLOCK)
		ON ultc.UptimeLogsTableFK = ult.UptimeLogsTablePK
	INNER JOIN dbo.appUptimeLogsCategories ulc_ulf WITH (NOLOCK)
		ON ultc.UptimeLogsCategoryFK = ulc_ulf.UptimeLogsCategoryPK
	WHERE
		ulf.UptimeLogsDetailFK = @varUptimeLogsDetailPK
		AND ult.UptimeLogsTableName = 'tblUptimeLogsIntegrationFiles'
		AND ultc.BuildingFK = @varBuildingFK

	SELECT 
		UptimeLogsIntegrationFilePK, UptimeLogsDetailFK, UptimeLogsCategoryFK, UptimeLogsCategory, NoOfStoreAllIssues, NoOfCustomerIssues, NoOfFilesIn, NoOfFilesOut, TotalNoOfFilesInOut,
		CAST(AutoCalcStoreAllPercentOfIssues AS NVARCHAR(50)) + '%' AS AutoCalcStoreAllPercentOfIssues,
		CAST(AutoCalcCustomerPercentOfIssues AS NVARCHAR(50)) + '%' AS AutoCalcCustomerPercentOfIssues,
		CAST((AutoCalcStoreAllPercentOfIssues + AutoCalcCustomerPercentOfIssues) AS NVARCHAR(50)) + '%' AS AutoCalcTotalPercentOfIssues,			
		StockInEmailsTotal
	FROM
		#uptimeLogsIntegrationFiles

	-- 6. Return the UptimeLogsPhysicalChecks record details.

	SELECT TOP 1
		ulpc.UptimeLogsPhysicalCheckPK, ulpc.UptimeLogsDetailFK, ulpc.UptimeLogsCategoryFK, ulc_ulpc.UptimeLogsCategory, ultc.CategoryScreenOrder,		
		ulpc.NoOfPalletsAccepted,
		ulpc.NoOfPalletsRejected,
		ulpc.NoOfPalletsDispatched		 
	FROM
		dbo.tblUptimeLogsPhysicalChecks ulpc WITH (NOLOCK)		
	INNER JOIN dbo.tblUptimeLogsBuildingCategories ultc WITH (NOLOCK)
		ON ulpc.UptimeLogsCategoryFK = ultc.UptimeLogsCategoryFK		
	INNER JOIN dbo.appUptimeLogsTables ult WITH (NOLOCK)
		ON ultc.UptimeLogsTableFK = ult.UptimeLogsTablePK
	INNER JOIN dbo.appUptimeLogsCategories ulc_ulpc WITH (NOLOCK)
		ON ultc.UptimeLogsCategoryFK = ulc_ulpc.UptimeLogsCategoryPK
	WHERE
		ulpc.UptimeLogsDetailFK = @varUptimeLogsDetailPK
		AND ult.UptimeLogsTableName = 'tblUptimeLogsPhysicalChecks'
		AND ultc.BuildingFK = @varBuildingFK
	--ORDER BY
	--	CategoryScreenOrder ASC
END
--ec:
GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[spUptimeLogsGetOverallSummaryYTDDetails]    Script Date: 02/11/2026 17:47:27 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spUptimeLogsGetOverallSummaryYTDDetails]
(
--declare
	@year INT
)
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ UNCOMMITTED; SET DEADLOCK_PRIORITY LOW;

	DECLARE
		@varCurrentDate DATE = (SELECT dbo.GetBSTDate()), @varDataStartWeekNumber INT, @varDataStartDate DATE, @varDataEndWeekNumber INT, @varDataEndDate DATE, @varNoOfWeeksOfData INT,
		@varYear INT = ISNULL(@year, -1)

	SET @varCurrentDate = dbo.GetBSTDate()

	SET @varDataEndDate = @varCurrentDate

	-- @varYear = year of selected work date on the Uptime Logs screen.
	-- If @varYear doesn't match the year of the current date work out the last week in selected year. 
	IF @varYear > 0 AND YEAR(@varDataEndDate) <> @varYear 
	BEGIN
		SET @varDataEndDate = CAST(@varYear + 1 AS NVARCHAR(4)) + '-01-01'

		WHILE DATEPART(wk, @varDataEndDate) <> 52 SET @varDataEndDate = DATEADD(WEEK, -1, @varDataEndDate)
	END

	-- Ensure the end date is a Monday.
	WHILE DATENAME(dw, @varDataEndDate) <> 'Monday' SET @varDataEndDate = DATEADD(DAY, -1, @varDataEndDate)

	-- 53 equals week 1 of the next year so need to subtract a week to get week 52 of the selected year.
	IF DATEPART(wk, @varDataEndDate) = 53 SET @varDataEndDate = DATEADD(WEEK, -1, @varDataEndDate)

	SELECT @varDataEndWeekNumber = DATEPART(wk, @varDataEndDate)

	-- Make start date a year less than the end date.
	SET @varDataStartDate = DATEADD(YEAR, -1, @varDataEndDate)

	-- Ensure the start date is a Monday.
	WHILE DATENAME(dw, @varDataStartDate) <> 'Monday' SET @varDataStartDate = DATEADD(DAY, -1, @varDataStartDate)

	-- Keep adding a week to start date until after week 52 (week 53 could be after 52 as well as week 1).
	WHILE DATEPART(wk, @varDataStartDate) NOT IN (1, 53)  SET @varDataStartDate = DATEADD(WEEK, 1, @varDataStartDate)

	SELECT @varDataStartWeekNumber = DATEPART(wk, @varDataStartDate)

	-- 53 equals week 1.
	SELECT @varDataStartWeekNumber = CASE WHEN @varDataStartWeekNumber = 53 THEN 1 ELSE @varDataStartWeekNumber END

	SELECT @varDataStartDate = MIN(UptimeLogDate) from tblUptimeLogsDetails WHERE UptimeLogDate >= @varDataStartDate AND UptimeLogDate <= @varDataEndDate AND IsArchived = 1 /*Confirmed data only*/

	IF @varDataStartDate IS NOT NULL
	BEGIN
		SELECT @varDataStartWeekNumber = CASE WHEN DATEPART(wk, @varDataStartDate) = 53 THEN 1 ELSE DATEPART(wk, @varDataStartDate) END

		SELECT @varDataEndDate = MAX(UptimeLogDate) from tblUptimeLogsDetails WHERE UptimeLogDate >= @varDataStartDate AND UptimeLogDate <= @varDataEndDate AND IsArchived = 1 /*Confirmed data only*/

		SELECT @varDataEndWeekNumber = DATEPART(wk, @varDataEndDate)

		SET @varDataEndDate = DATEADD(DAY, 6, @varDataEndDate)
	END
	ELSE 
	BEGIN
		SET @varDataStartWeekNumber = NULL
		SET @varDataEndDate = NULL	
		SET @varDataEndWeekNumber = NULL
	END

	SELECT @varDataEndWeekNumber = CASE WHEN @varDataEndWeekNumber = 53 THEN 1 ELSE @varDataEndWeekNumber END

	SELECT @varNoOfWeeksOfData = (@varDataEndWeekNumber - @varDataStartWeekNumber) + 1

	DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #uptimeLogsDetails

	SELECT DISTINCT uld.UptimeLogsDetailPK, uld.UptimeLogDate, uld.BuildingFK
	INTO #uptimeLogsDetails
	FROM dbo.tblUptimeLogsDetails uld WITH (NOLOCK) 
	WHERE uld.UptimeLogDate <= @varDataEndDate
	AND uld.UptimeLogDate >= @varDataStartDate
	AND uld.IsArchived = 1 /*Confirmed data only*/

	DECLARE @varDataEndDateMonth INT = (SELECT MONTH(@varDataEndDate))

	-- Get the current year quarter number.

	DECLARE @currentYearQuarter INT = (SELECT	CASE 
													WHEN @varDataEndDateMonth < 4 THEN 1
													WHEN @varDataEndDateMonth > 3 AND @varDataEndDateMonth < 7 THEN 2
													WHEN @varDataEndDateMonth > 6 AND @varDataEndDateMonth < 10 THEN 3
													ELSE 4
												END)

	DECLARE @varStartDateString NVARCHAR(10) = CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), @varDataStartDate, 21), @varEndDateString NVARCHAR(10) = CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), @varDataEndDate, 21)

	SELECT 
		'Data for weeks ' + CAST(@varDataStartWeekNumber AS NVARCHAR(2)) + ' to ' + CAST(@varDataEndWeekNumber AS NVARCHAR(2)) 
			+ ' (' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), @varDataStartDate, 105) + ' to ' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), DATEADD(DAY, 6, @varDataEndDate), 105) + ')' AS [DataForWeek],
		CAST(@varYear AS NVARCHAR(4)) + 'WeekNo' + CAST(@varDataEndWeekNumber AS NVARCHAR(2)) AS [YearDataForWeek],
		'All Buildings' as BuildingName

	-- Critical Services section.

	IF 1 = 1 /*Using this so this section of code can be closed in Ms SQL Server Management Studio*/
	BEGIN
		DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #uptimeLogsCriticalServices;

		SELECT DISTINCT
			uld.BuildingFK,

			CASE 
				WHEN uld.BuildingFK = 1 THEN 'Transport'
				WHEN uld.BuildingFK = 8888 THEN 'IT'
				WHEN uld.BuildingFK = 9999 THEN 'Quality'
				WHEN ISNULL(bldg.DepartmentTMS, '') <> '' THEN bldg.DepartmentTMS
			ELSE bldg.BuildingName 
			END AS BuildingName,
			uldh.UptimeLogsCriticalServicePK,
			uldh.UptimeLogsDetailFK,
			uldh.UptimeLogsCategoryFK,
			ulc_uldh.UptimeLogsCategory,
			ultc.CategoryScreenOrder,
			(dbo.fnGetTimeInMinutes(uldh.MondayHours) + dbo.fnGetTimeInMinutes(uldh.TuesdayHours) + dbo.fnGetTimeInMinutes(uldh.WednesdayHours) 
				+ dbo.fnGetTimeInMinutes(uldh.ThursdayHours) + dbo.fnGetTimeInMinutes(uldh.FridayHours) + dbo.fnGetTimeInMinutes(uldh.SaturdayHours) 
					+ dbo.fnGetTimeInMinutes(uldh.SundayHours)) AS TotalMinutes
		INTO
			#uptimeLogsCriticalServices
		FROM
			dbo.tblUptimeLogsCriticalServices uldh WITH (NOLOCK)
		INNER JOIN dbo.tblUptimeLogsBuildingCategories ultc WITH (NOLOCK)
			ON uldh.UptimeLogsCategoryFK = ultc.UptimeLogsCategoryFK		
		INNER JOIN dbo.appUptimeLogsTables ult WITH (NOLOCK)
			ON ultc.UptimeLogsTableFK = ult.UptimeLogsTablePK
		INNER JOIN dbo.appUptimeLogsCategories ulc_uldh WITH (NOLOCK)
			ON ultc.UptimeLogsCategoryFK = ulc_uldh.UptimeLogsCategoryPK
		INNER JOIN #uptimeLogsDetails uld
			ON uldh.UptimeLogsDetailFK = uld.UptimeLogsDetailPK
			AND ultc.BuildingFK = uld.BuildingFK
		LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.tblBuildings bldg
			ON uld.BuildingFK = bldg.BuildingPK
		WHERE
			ult.UptimeLogsTableName = 'tblUptimeLogsCriticalServices'

		DELETE FROM #uptimeLogsCriticalServices WHERE BuildingName NOT IN ('6 Cross Roads','Six Cross Roads','BV1','BV2','BV3','BV4','BV5','Cork Road','Dungarvan','Kilcohan','Northern Extension','Slieverue');

		UPDATE #uptimeLogsCriticalServices SET BuildingName = 'BV4And5', BuildingFK = 7777
		WHERE BuildingName IN ('BV4', 'BV5')

		DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #uptimeLogsCriticalServices2;

		SELECT
			BuildingFK,
			BuildingName,
			UptimeLogsCategory,
			CategoryScreenOrder,
			SUM(TotalMinutes) AS TotalMinutes
		INTO
			#uptimeLogsCriticalServices2
		FROM
			#uptimeLogsCriticalServices
		GROUP BY
			BuildingFK,
			BuildingName,
			UptimeLogsCategory,
			CategoryScreenOrder		

		DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #criticalServicesResults;

		SELECT		
			BuildingFK,
			BuildingName,
			UptimeLogsCategory AS Category,
			TotalMinutes AS Downtime,

			CASE 
				WHEN TotalMinutes = 0 THEN 100.00
			ELSE
				CAST(ROUND(100.00 - ((CAST(TotalMinutes AS DECIMAL(18, 2)) / (10080.00/*No. of minutes in a 7 day week*/ * CAST(@varNoOfWeeksOfData AS DECIMAL(18,2)))) * 100.00), 2) AS DECIMAL(18,2))
			END AS PercentageUptime
		INTO
			#criticalServicesResults
		FROM
			#uptimeLogsCriticalServices2

		DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #criticalServicesResults2;

		CREATE TABLE #criticalServicesResults2
		(
			Category NVARCHAR(200), 
			SixCrossRoadsDowntime DECIMAL(18,2),
			SixCrossRoadsPercentageUptime DECIMAL(18,2),		
			BV1Downtime DECIMAL(18,2),
			BV1PercentageUptime DECIMAL(18,2),		
			BV2Downtime DECIMAL(18,2),
			BV2PercentageUptime DECIMAL(18,2),		
			BV3Downtime DECIMAL(18,2),
			BV3PercentageUptime DECIMAL(18,2),		
			BV4And5Downtime DECIMAL(18,2),
			BV4And5PercentageUptime DECIMAL(18,2),		
			CorkRoadDowntime DECIMAL(18,2),
			CorkRoadPercentageUptime DECIMAL(18,2),		
			DungarvanDowntime DECIMAL(18,2),
			DungarvanPercentageUptime DECIMAL(18,2),		
			KilcohanDowntime DECIMAL(18,2),
			KilcohanPercentageUptime DECIMAL(18,2),		
			NorthernExtensionDowntime DECIMAL(18,2),
			NorthernExtensionPercentageUptime DECIMAL(18,2),		
			SlieverueDowntime DECIMAL(18,2),
			SlieveruePercentageUptime DECIMAL(18,2)
		)

		INSERT INTO #criticalServicesResults2(Category)
		SELECT DISTINCT Category FROM #criticalServicesResults

		UPDATE t1 SET SixCrossRoadsDowntime = t2.Downtime, SixCrossRoadsPercentageUptime = t2.PercentageUptime
		FROM #criticalServicesResults2 t1 
		INNER JOIN #criticalServicesResults t2 ON t1.Category = t2.Category
		WHERE t2.BuildingName IN ('Six Cross Roads', '6 Cross Roads')

		UPDATE t1 SET BV1Downtime = t2.Downtime, BV1PercentageUptime = t2.PercentageUptime
		FROM #criticalServicesResults2 t1 
		INNER JOIN #criticalServicesResults t2 ON t1.Category = t2.Category
		WHERE t2.BuildingName = 'BV1'

		UPDATE t1 SET BV2Downtime = t2.Downtime, BV2PercentageUptime = t2.PercentageUptime
		FROM #criticalServicesResults2 t1 
		INNER JOIN #criticalServicesResults t2 ON t1.Category = t2.Category
		WHERE t2.BuildingName = 'BV2'

		UPDATE t1 SET BV3Downtime = t2.Downtime, BV3PercentageUptime = t2.PercentageUptime
		FROM #criticalServicesResults2 t1 
		INNER JOIN #criticalServicesResults t2 ON t1.Category = t2.Category
		WHERE t2.BuildingName = 'BV3'

		UPDATE t1 SET BV4And5Downtime = t2.Downtime, BV4And5PercentageUptime = t2.PercentageUptime
		FROM #criticalServicesResults2 t1 
		INNER JOIN #criticalServicesResults t2 ON t1.Category = t2.Category
		WHERE t2.BuildingName = 'BV4And5'

		UPDATE t1 SET CorkRoadDowntime = t2.Downtime, CorkRoadPercentageUptime = t2.PercentageUptime
		FROM #criticalServicesResults2 t1 
		INNER JOIN #criticalServicesResults t2 ON t1.Category = t2.Category
		WHERE t2.BuildingName = 'Cork Road'

		UPDATE t1 SET DungarvanDowntime = t2.Downtime, DungarvanPercentageUptime = t2.PercentageUptime
		FROM #criticalServicesResults2 t1 
		INNER JOIN #criticalServicesResults t2 ON t1.Category = t2.Category
		WHERE t2.BuildingName = 'Dungarvan'

		UPDATE t1 SET KilcohanDowntime = t2.Downtime, KilcohanPercentageUptime = t2.PercentageUptime
		FROM #criticalServicesResults2 t1 
		INNER JOIN #criticalServicesResults t2 ON t1.Category = t2.Category
		WHERE t2.BuildingName = 'Kilcohan'

		UPDATE t1 SET NorthernExtensionDowntime = t2.Downtime, NorthernExtensionPercentageUptime = t2.PercentageUptime
		FROM #criticalServicesResults2 t1 
		INNER JOIN #criticalServicesResults t2 ON t1.Category = t2.Category
		WHERE t2.BuildingName = 'NorthernExtension'

		UPDATE t1 SET SlieverueDowntime = t2.Downtime, SlieveruePercentageUptime = t2.PercentageUptime
		FROM #criticalServicesResults2 t1 
		INNER JOIN #criticalServicesResults t2 ON t1.Category = t2.Category
		WHERE t2.BuildingName = 'Slieverue'

		DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #criticalServicesResults3;

		SELECT 
			(CASE WHEN SixCrossRoadsPercentageUptime IS NOT NULL THEN 1.00 ELSE 0.00 END) 
				+ (CASE WHEN BV1PercentageUptime IS NOT NULL THEN 1.00 ELSE 0.00 END) 
					+ (CASE WHEN BV2PercentageUptime IS NOT NULL THEN 1.00 ELSE 0.00 END)
						+ (CASE WHEN BV3PercentageUptime IS NOT NULL THEN 1.00 ELSE 0.00 END)
							+ (CASE WHEN BV4And5PercentageUptime IS NOT NULL THEN 1.00 ELSE 0.00 END)
								+ (CASE WHEN CorkRoadPercentageUptime IS NOT NULL THEN 1.00 ELSE 0.00 END)
									+ (CASE WHEN DungarvanPercentageUptime IS NOT NULL THEN 1.00 ELSE 0.00 END)
										+ (CASE WHEN KilcohanPercentageUptime IS NOT NULL THEN 1.00 ELSE 0.00 END)
											+ (CASE WHEN NorthernExtensionPercentageUptime IS NOT NULL THEN 1.00 ELSE 0.00 END)
												+ (CASE WHEN SlieveruePercentageUptime IS NOT NULL THEN 1.00 ELSE 0.00 END) AS HorizontalAverageDivider,
			*	
		INTO
			#criticalServicesResults3
		FROM 
			#criticalServicesResults2

		DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #verticalBuildingAverageDividers2;

		SELECT
			SUM((CASE WHEN t2.SixCrossRoadsPercentageUptime IS NOT NULL THEN 1.00 ELSE 0.00 END)) AS SixCrossRoadsVerticalAverageDivider,
			SUM((CASE WHEN t2.BV1PercentageUptime IS NOT NULL THEN 1.00 ELSE 0.00 END)) AS BV1VerticalAverageDivider,
			SUM((CASE WHEN t2.BV2PercentageUptime IS NOT NULL THEN 1.00 ELSE 0.00 END)) AS BV2VerticalAverageDivider,
			SUM((CASE WHEN t2.BV3PercentageUptime IS NOT NULL THEN 1.00 ELSE 0.00 END)) AS BV3VerticalAverageDivider,
			SUM((CASE WHEN t2.BV4And5PercentageUptime IS NOT NULL THEN 1.00 ELSE 0.00 END))  AS BV4And5VerticalAverageDivider,

			SUM((CASE WHEN t2.CorkRoadPercentageUptime IS NOT NULL THEN 1.00 ELSE 0.00 END))  AS CorkRoadVerticalAverageDivider,
			SUM((CASE WHEN t2.DungarvanPercentageUptime IS NOT NULL THEN 1.00 ELSE 0.00 END)) AS DungarvanVerticalAverageDivider,
			SUM((CASE WHEN t2.KilcohanPercentageUptime IS NOT NULL THEN 1.00 ELSE 0.00 END)) AS KilcohanVerticalAverageDivider,

			SUM((CASE WHEN t2.NorthernExtensionPercentageUptime IS NOT NULL THEN 1.00 ELSE 0.00 END)) AS NorthernExtensionVerticalAverageDivider,
			SUM((CASE WHEN t2.SlieveruePercentageUptime IS NOT NULL THEN 1.00 ELSE 0.00 END)) AS SlieverueVerticalAverageDivider
		INTO
			#verticalBuildingAverageDividers2
		FROM 
			#criticalServicesResults3 t2

		UPDATE #verticalBuildingAverageDividers2
		SET 
			SixCrossRoadsVerticalAverageDivider = CASE WHEN SixCrossRoadsVerticalAverageDivider < 1 THEN 1 ELSE SixCrossRoadsVerticalAverageDivider END,
			BV1VerticalAverageDivider = CASE WHEN BV1VerticalAverageDivider < 1 THEN 1 ELSE BV1VerticalAverageDivider END,
			BV2VerticalAverageDivider = CASE WHEN BV2VerticalAverageDivider < 1 THEN 1 ELSE BV2VerticalAverageDivider END,
			BV3VerticalAverageDivider = CASE WHEN BV3VerticalAverageDivider < 1 THEN 1 ELSE BV3VerticalAverageDivider END,
			BV4And5VerticalAverageDivider = CASE WHEN BV4And5VerticalAverageDivider < 1 THEN 1 ELSE BV4And5VerticalAverageDivider END,
			CorkRoadVerticalAverageDivider = CASE WHEN CorkRoadVerticalAverageDivider < 1 THEN 1 ELSE CorkRoadVerticalAverageDivider END,
			DungarvanVerticalAverageDivider = CASE WHEN DungarvanVerticalAverageDivider < 1 THEN 1 ELSE DungarvanVerticalAverageDivider END,
			KilcohanVerticalAverageDivider = CASE WHEN KilcohanVerticalAverageDivider < 1 THEN 1 ELSE KilcohanVerticalAverageDivider END,
			NorthernExtensionVerticalAverageDivider = CASE WHEN NorthernExtensionVerticalAverageDivider < 1 THEN 1 ELSE NorthernExtensionVerticalAverageDivider END,
			SlieverueVerticalAverageDivider = CASE WHEN SlieverueVerticalAverageDivider < 1 THEN 1 ELSE SlieverueVerticalAverageDivider END

		DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #criticalServicesResults4;

		SELECT
			CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS HorizontalAverageDivider,
			Category, SixCrossRoadsPercentageUptime, BV1PercentageUptime, BV2PercentageUptime, BV3PercentageUptime, BV4And5PercentageUptime, CorkRoadPercentageUptime, 
			DungarvanPercentageUptime, KilcohanPercentageUptime, NorthernExtensionPercentageUptime, SlieveruePercentageUptime, 

			CASE WHEN ISNULL(HorizontalAverageDivider, 0.00) <=0  THEN NULL ELSE

			CAST(ROUND(SUM(ISNULL(SixCrossRoadsPercentageUptime, 0.00) + ISNULL(BV1PercentageUptime, 0.00) + ISNULL(BV2PercentageUptime, 0.00) + ISNULL(BV3PercentageUptime, 0.00) 
				+ ISNULL(BV4And5PercentageUptime, 0.00)
				+ ISNULL(CorkRoadPercentageUptime, 0.00) + ISNULL(DungarvanPercentageUptime, 0.00) + ISNULL(KilcohanPercentageUptime, 0.00) + ISNULL(NorthernExtensionPercentageUptime, 0.00) 
					+ ISNULL(SlieveruePercentageUptime, 0.00)) / HorizontalAverageDivider, 2) AS DECIMAL(18,2)) END AS AveragePercentageUptime,

			CAST(0 AS BIT) AS TotalsRow
		INTO
			#criticalServicesResults4
		FROM 
			#criticalServicesResults3
		GROUP BY 
			HorizontalAverageDivider, Category, SixCrossRoadsPercentageUptime, BV1PercentageUptime, BV2PercentageUptime, BV3PercentageUptime, BV4And5PercentageUptime, CorkRoadPercentageUptime, 
			DungarvanPercentageUptime, KilcohanPercentageUptime, NorthernExtensionPercentageUptime, SlieveruePercentageUptime

		INSERT INTO #criticalServicesResults4 
		SELECT CAST(NULL AS INT) AS HorizontalAverageDivider, 'Total', CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL(18,2)), CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL(18,2)), CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL(18,2)), CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL(18,2)), CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL(18,2)), CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL(18,2)), CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL(18,2)), CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL(18,2)), 
					CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL(18,2)), CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL(18,2)), CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL(18,2)), 1

		UPDATE t1
		SET 
			SixCrossRoadsPercentageUptime = (SELECT SUM(SixCrossRoadsPercentageUptime) / (SELECT SixCrossRoadsVerticalAverageDivider FROM #verticalBuildingAverageDividers2) FROM #criticalServicesResults4),
			BV1PercentageUptime = (SELECT SUM(BV1PercentageUptime) / (SELECT BV1VerticalAverageDivider FROM #verticalBuildingAverageDividers2) FROM #criticalServicesResults4),
			BV2PercentageUptime = (SELECT SUM(BV2PercentageUptime) / (SELECT BV2VerticalAverageDivider FROM #verticalBuildingAverageDividers2) FROM #criticalServicesResults4),
			BV3PercentageUptime = (SELECT SUM(BV3PercentageUptime) / (SELECT BV3VerticalAverageDivider FROM #verticalBuildingAverageDividers2) FROM #criticalServicesResults4),
			BV4And5PercentageUptime = (SELECT SUM(BV4And5PercentageUptime) / (SELECT BV4And5VerticalAverageDivider FROM #verticalBuildingAverageDividers2) FROM #criticalServicesResults4),
			CorkRoadPercentageUptime = (SELECT SUM(CorkRoadPercentageUptime) / (SELECT CorkRoadVerticalAverageDivider FROM #verticalBuildingAverageDividers2) FROM #criticalServicesResults4),
			DungarvanPercentageUptime = (SELECT SUM(DungarvanPercentageUptime) / (SELECT DungarvanVerticalAverageDivider FROM #verticalBuildingAverageDividers2) FROM #criticalServicesResults4),
			KilcohanPercentageUptime = (SELECT SUM(KilcohanPercentageUptime) / (SELECT KilcohanVerticalAverageDivider FROM #verticalBuildingAverageDividers2) FROM #criticalServicesResults4),
			NorthernExtensionPercentageUptime = (SELECT SUM(NorthernExtensionPercentageUptime) / (SELECT NorthernExtensionVerticalAverageDivider FROM #verticalBuildingAverageDividers2) FROM #criticalServicesResults4),
			SlieveruePercentageUptime = (SELECT SUM(SlieveruePercentageUptime) / (SELECT SlieverueVerticalAverageDivider FROM #verticalBuildingAverageDividers2) FROM #criticalServicesResults4)
		FROM
			#criticalServicesResults4 t1
		WHERE 
			t1.TotalsRow = 1

		UPDATE t1
		SET HorizontalAverageDivider =	(CASE WHEN SixCrossRoadsPercentageUptime IS NOT NULL THEN 1.00 ELSE 0.00 END) 
											+ (CASE WHEN BV1PercentageUptime IS NOT NULL THEN 1.00 ELSE 0.00 END) 
												+ (CASE WHEN BV2PercentageUptime IS NOT NULL THEN 1.00 ELSE 0.00 END)
													+ (CASE WHEN BV3PercentageUptime IS NOT NULL THEN 1.00 ELSE 0.00 END)
														+ (CASE WHEN BV4And5PercentageUptime IS NOT NULL THEN 1.00 ELSE 0.00 END)
															+ (CASE WHEN CorkRoadPercentageUptime IS NOT NULL THEN 1.00 ELSE 0.00 END)
																+ (CASE WHEN DungarvanPercentageUptime IS NOT NULL THEN 1.00 ELSE 0.00 END)
																	+ (CASE WHEN KilcohanPercentageUptime IS NOT NULL THEN 1.00 ELSE 0.00 END)
																		+ (CASE WHEN NorthernExtensionPercentageUptime IS NOT NULL THEN 1.00 ELSE 0.00 END)
																			+ (CASE WHEN SlieveruePercentageUptime IS NOT NULL THEN 1.00 ELSE 0.00 END)
		FROM
			#criticalServicesResults4 t1
		WHERE 
			t1.TotalsRow = 1

		UPDATE t1
		SET 
			AveragePercentageUptime = (	SELECT CAST(ROUND(SUM(ISNULL(SixCrossRoadsPercentageUptime, 0.00) + ISNULL(BV1PercentageUptime, 0.00) + ISNULL(BV2PercentageUptime, 0.00) + ISNULL(BV3PercentageUptime, 0.00) 
														+ ISNULL(BV4And5PercentageUptime, 0.00) + ISNULL(CorkRoadPercentageUptime, 0.00) + ISNULL(DungarvanPercentageUptime, 0.00) 
															+ ISNULL(KilcohanPercentageUptime, 0.00) + ISNULL(NorthernExtensionPercentageUptime, 0.00) + ISNULL(SlieveruePercentageUptime, 0.00)) / HorizontalAverageDivider, 2) 
																AS DECIMAL(18,2)) 
													FROM #criticalServicesResults4 t2 
													WHERE t2.TotalsRow = 1
													GROUP BY t2.HorizontalAverageDivider	)
		FROM
			#criticalServicesResults4 t1
		WHERE 
			t1.TotalsRow = 1

		DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #finalCriticalServicesResults

		SELECT 
			 t1.Category, 
			 ISNULL(CAST(t1.SixCrossRoadsPercentageUptime AS NVARCHAR(50)), 'N/A') AS SixCrossRoadsPercentageUptime, 
			 ISNULL(CAST(t1.BV1PercentageUptime AS NVARCHAR(50)), 'N/A') AS BV1PercentageUptime,
			 ISNULL(CAST(t1.BV2PercentageUptime AS NVARCHAR(50)), 'N/A') AS BV2PercentageUptime,
			 ISNULL(CAST(t1.BV3PercentageUptime AS NVARCHAR(50)), 'N/A') AS BV3PercentageUptime,
			 ISNULL(CAST(t1.BV4And5PercentageUptime AS NVARCHAR(50)), 'N/A') AS BV4And5PercentageUptime,
			 ISNULL(CAST(t1.CorkRoadPercentageUptime AS NVARCHAR(50)), 'N/A') AS CorkRoadPercentageUptime,
			 ISNULL(CAST(t1.DungarvanPercentageUptime AS NVARCHAR(50)), 'N/A') AS DungarvanPercentageUptime,
			 ISNULL(CAST(t1.KilcohanPercentageUptime AS NVARCHAR(50)), 'N/A') AS KilcohanPercentageUptime, 
			 ISNULL(CAST(t1.NorthernExtensionPercentageUptime AS NVARCHAR(50)), 'N/A') AS NorthernExtensionPercentageUptime,
			 ISNULL(CAST(t1.SlieveruePercentageUptime AS NVARCHAR(50)), 'N/A') AS SlieveruePercentageUptime,
			 ISNULL(CAST(t1.AveragePercentageUptime AS NVARCHAR(50)), 'N/A') AS AveragePercentageUptime,
			 t1.TotalsRow
		INTO
			#finalCriticalServicesResults
		FROM 
			#criticalServicesResults4 t1

		DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #finalCriticalServicesResults2;

		SELECT
			t1.Category, 

			sixCrossRoads.TotalMinutes AS [6+Rds Dwntm],
			CASE WHEN t1.SixCrossRoadsPercentageUptime = 'N/A' THEN SixCrossRoadsPercentageUptime ELSE SixCrossRoadsPercentageUptime + '%' END AS [6+Rds %Uptm], 

			bV1.TotalMinutes AS [BV1 Dwntm],
			CASE WHEN t1.BV1PercentageUptime = 'N/A' THEN BV1PercentageUptime ELSE BV1PercentageUptime + '%' END AS [BV1 %Uptm],

			bV2.TotalMinutes AS [BV2 Dwntm],
			CASE WHEN t1.BV2PercentageUptime = 'N/A' THEN BV2PercentageUptime ELSE BV2PercentageUptime + '%' END AS [BV2 %Uptm],

			bV3.TotalMinutes AS [BV3 Dwntm],
			CASE WHEN t1.BV3PercentageUptime = 'N/A' THEN BV3PercentageUptime ELSE BV3PercentageUptime + '%' END AS [BV3 %Uptm],

			bV4And5.TotalMinutes AS [BV4&5 Dwntm],
			CASE WHEN t1.BV4And5PercentageUptime = 'N/A' THEN BV4And5PercentageUptime ELSE BV4And5PercentageUptime + '%' END AS [BV4&5 %Uptm],

			corkRoad.TotalMinutes AS [CrkRd Dwntm],
			CASE WHEN t1.CorkRoadPercentageUptime = 'N/A' THEN CorkRoadPercentageUptime ELSE CorkRoadPercentageUptime + '%' END AS [CrkRd %Uptm],

			dungarvan.TotalMinutes AS [Dngrvn Dwntm],
			CASE WHEN t1.DungarvanPercentageUptime = 'N/A' THEN DungarvanPercentageUptime ELSE DungarvanPercentageUptime + '%' END AS [Dngrvn %Uptm],

			kilcohan.TotalMinutes AS [Klchn Dwntm],
			CASE WHEN t1.KilcohanPercentageUptime = 'N/A' THEN KilcohanPercentageUptime ELSE KilcohanPercentageUptime + '%' END AS [Klchn %Uptm], 

			northernExtension.TotalMinutes AS [NrthExt Dwntm],
			CASE WHEN t1.NorthernExtensionPercentageUptime = 'N/A' THEN NorthernExtensionPercentageUptime ELSE NorthernExtensionPercentageUptime + '%' END AS [NrthExt %Uptm],

			slieverue.TotalMinutes AS [Slver Dwntm],
			CASE WHEN t1.SlieveruePercentageUptime = 'N/A' THEN SlieveruePercentageUptime ELSE SlieveruePercentageUptime + '%' END AS [Slver %Uptm],

			CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS [Ttl Dwntm],
			CASE WHEN t1.AveragePercentageUptime = 'N/A' THEN AveragePercentageUptime ELSE AveragePercentageUptime + '%' END AS [Avg %Uptm],

			t1.TotalsRow
		INTO
			#finalCriticalServicesResults2
		FROM
			#finalCriticalServicesResults t1
		LEFT OUTER JOIN #uptimeLogsCriticalServices2 sixCrossRoads
			ON t1.Category = sixCrossRoads.UptimeLogsCategory
			AND sixCrossRoads.BuildingName IN ('Six Cross Roads', '6 Cross Roads')

		LEFT OUTER JOIN #uptimeLogsCriticalServices2 bV1
			ON t1.Category = bV1.UptimeLogsCategory
			AND bV1.BuildingName = 'BV1'

		LEFT OUTER JOIN #uptimeLogsCriticalServices2 bV2
			ON t1.Category = bV2.UptimeLogsCategory
			AND bV2.BuildingName = 'BV2'

		LEFT OUTER JOIN #uptimeLogsCriticalServices2 bV3
			ON t1.Category = bV3.UptimeLogsCategory
			AND bV3.BuildingName = 'BV3'

		LEFT OUTER JOIN #uptimeLogsCriticalServices2 bV4And5
			ON t1.Category = bV4And5.UptimeLogsCategory
			AND bV4And5.BuildingName = 'BV4And5'

		LEFT OUTER JOIN #uptimeLogsCriticalServices2 corkRoad
			ON t1.Category = corkRoad.UptimeLogsCategory
			AND corkRoad.BuildingName = 'Cork Road'

		LEFT OUTER JOIN #uptimeLogsCriticalServices2 dungarvan
			ON t1.Category = dungarvan.UptimeLogsCategory
			AND dungarvan.BuildingName = 'Dungarvan'

		LEFT OUTER JOIN #uptimeLogsCriticalServices2 kilcohan
			ON t1.Category = kilcohan.UptimeLogsCategory
			AND kilcohan.BuildingName = 'Kilcohan'

		LEFT OUTER JOIN #uptimeLogsCriticalServices2 northernExtension
			ON t1.Category = northernExtension.UptimeLogsCategory
			AND northernExtension.BuildingName = 'Northern Extension'
		
		LEFT OUTER JOIN #uptimeLogsCriticalServices2 slieverue
			ON t1.Category = slieverue.UptimeLogsCategory
			AND slieverue.BuildingName = 'Slieverue'

		DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #totalsRow;

		SELECT
			'Total' AS Category, SUM([6+Rds Dwntm]) AS [6+Rds Dwntm], SUM([BV1 Dwntm]) AS [BV1 Dwntm], SUM([BV2 Dwntm]) AS [BV2 Dwntm], SUM([BV3 Dwntm]) AS [BV3 Dwntm], SUM([BV4&5 Dwntm]) AS [BV4&5 Dwntm], 
			SUM([CrkRd Dwntm]) AS [CrkRd Dwntm], SUM([Dngrvn Dwntm]) AS [Dngrvn Dwntm], SUM([Klchn Dwntm]) AS [Klchn Dwntm], SUM([NrthExt Dwntm]) AS [NrthExt Dwntm], SUM([Slver Dwntm]) AS [Slver Dwntm]
		INTO
			#totalsRow
		FROM
			#finalCriticalServicesResults2
		WHERE
			TotalsRow = 0

		UPDATE t1
		SET
			[6+Rds Dwntm] = t2.[6+Rds Dwntm],
			[BV1 Dwntm] = t2.[BV1 Dwntm],
			[BV2 Dwntm] = t2.[BV2 Dwntm],
			[BV3 Dwntm] = t2.[BV3 Dwntm],
			[BV4&5 Dwntm] = t2.[BV4&5 Dwntm],
			[CrkRd Dwntm] = t2.[CrkRd Dwntm],
			[Dngrvn Dwntm] = t2.[Dngrvn Dwntm],
			[Klchn Dwntm] = t2.[Klchn Dwntm],
			[NrthExt Dwntm] = t2.[NrthExt Dwntm],
			[Slver Dwntm] = t2.[Slver Dwntm]
		FROM
			#finalCriticalServicesResults2 t1
		INNER JOIN #totalsRow t2
			ON t1.Category = t2.Category
		WHERE
			t1.TotalsRow = 1	

		UPDATE #finalCriticalServicesResults2 
		SET [Ttl Dwntm] = ISNULL([6+Rds Dwntm],0.00) + ISNULL([BV1 Dwntm],0.00) + ISNULL([BV2 Dwntm],0.00) + ISNULL([BV3 Dwntm],0.00) + ISNULL([BV4&5 Dwntm],0.00) + ISNULL([CrkRd Dwntm],0.00) + ISNULL([Dngrvn Dwntm],0.00) + ISNULL([Klchn Dwntm],0.00) 
							+ ISNULL([NrthExt Dwntm],0.00) + ISNULL([Slver Dwntm],0.00)
		WHERE
			TotalsRow = 0

		UPDATE #finalCriticalServicesResults2 
		SET [Ttl Dwntm] = ISNULL([6+Rds Dwntm],0.00) + ISNULL([BV1 Dwntm],0.00) + ISNULL([BV2 Dwntm],0.00) + ISNULL([BV3 Dwntm],0.00) + ISNULL([BV4&5 Dwntm],0.00) + ISNULL([CrkRd Dwntm],0.00) + ISNULL([Dngrvn Dwntm],0.00) + ISNULL([Klchn Dwntm],0.00) 
							+ ISNULL([NrthExt Dwntm],0.00) + ISNULL([Slver Dwntm],0.00)
		WHERE
			TotalsRow = 1

		SELECT 
			t1.Category,
			CASE WHEN ISNULL(CAST(t1.[6+Rds Dwntm] AS NVARCHAR(50)), 'N/A') = 'N/A' THEN 'N/A' ELSE dbo.fnGetHoursAndMinutesTimeFormatForMinutes([6+Rds Dwntm]) END AS [6+Rds Dwntm],
			t1.[6+Rds %Uptm],

			CASE WHEN ISNULL(CAST(t1.[BV1 Dwntm] AS NVARCHAR(50)), 'N/A') = 'N/A' THEN 'N/A' ELSE dbo.fnGetHoursAndMinutesTimeFormatForMinutes([BV1 Dwntm]) END AS [BV1 Dwntm],
			t1.[BV1 %Uptm],

			CASE WHEN ISNULL(CAST(t1.[BV2 Dwntm] AS NVARCHAR(50)), 'N/A') = 'N/A' THEN 'N/A' ELSE dbo.fnGetHoursAndMinutesTimeFormatForMinutes([BV2 Dwntm]) END AS [BV2 Dwntm],
			t1.[BV2 %Uptm],

			CASE WHEN ISNULL(CAST(t1.[BV3 Dwntm] AS NVARCHAR(50)), 'N/A') = 'N/A' THEN 'N/A' ELSE dbo.fnGetHoursAndMinutesTimeFormatForMinutes([BV3 Dwntm]) END AS [BV3 Dwntm],
			t1.[BV3 %Uptm],

			CASE WHEN ISNULL(CAST(t1.[BV4&5 Dwntm] AS NVARCHAR(50)), 'N/A') = 'N/A' THEN 'N/A' ELSE dbo.fnGetHoursAndMinutesTimeFormatForMinutes([BV4&5 Dwntm]) END AS [BV4&5 Dwntm],
			t1.[BV4&5 %Uptm],

			CASE WHEN ISNULL(CAST(t1.[CrkRd Dwntm] AS NVARCHAR(50)), 'N/A') = 'N/A' THEN 'N/A' ELSE dbo.fnGetHoursAndMinutesTimeFormatForMinutes([CrkRd Dwntm]) END AS [CrkRd Dwntm],
			t1.[CrkRd %Uptm],

			CASE WHEN ISNULL(CAST(t1.[Dngrvn Dwntm] AS NVARCHAR(50)), 'N/A') = 'N/A' THEN 'N/A' ELSE dbo.fnGetHoursAndMinutesTimeFormatForMinutes([Dngrvn Dwntm]) END AS [Dngrvn Dwntm],
			t1.[Dngrvn %Uptm],

			CASE WHEN ISNULL(CAST(t1.[Klchn Dwntm] AS NVARCHAR(50)), 'N/A') = 'N/A' THEN 'N/A' ELSE dbo.fnGetHoursAndMinutesTimeFormatForMinutes([Klchn Dwntm]) END AS [Klchn Dwntm],
			t1.[Klchn %Uptm],

			CASE WHEN ISNULL(CAST(t1.[NrthExt Dwntm] AS NVARCHAR(50)), 'N/A') = 'N/A' THEN 'N/A' ELSE dbo.fnGetHoursAndMinutesTimeFormatForMinutes([NrthExt Dwntm]) END AS [NrthExt Dwntm],
			t1.[NrthExt %Uptm],

			CASE WHEN ISNULL(CAST(t1.[Slver Dwntm] AS NVARCHAR(50)), 'N/A') = 'N/A' THEN 'N/A' ELSE dbo.fnGetHoursAndMinutesTimeFormatForMinutes([Slver Dwntm]) END AS [Slver Dwntm],
			t1.[Slver %Uptm],

			CASE WHEN ISNULL(CAST(t1.[Ttl Dwntm] AS NVARCHAR(50)), 'N/A') = 'N/A' THEN 'N/A' ELSE dbo.fnGetHoursAndMinutesTimeFormatForMinutes([Ttl Dwntm]) END AS [Ttl Dwntm],
			t1.[Avg %Uptm]

			--,t1.TotalsRow
		FROM 
			#finalCriticalServicesResults2 t1
		ORDER BY 
			TotalsRow ASC, 
			Category ASC
	END

	-- Hardware section.

	IF 1 = 1 /*Using this so this section of code can be closed in Ms SQL Server Management Studio*/
	BEGIN
		DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #uptimeLogsHardware

		SELECT DISTINCT
			uld.BuildingFK,

			CASE 
				WHEN uld.BuildingFK = 1 THEN 'Transport'
				WHEN uld.BuildingFK = 8888 THEN 'IT'
				WHEN uld.BuildingFK = 9999 THEN 'Quality'
				WHEN ISNULL(bldg.DepartmentTMS, '') <> '' THEN bldg.DepartmentTMS
			ELSE bldg.BuildingName 
			END AS BuildingName,

			ulh.UptimeLogsHardwarePK,
			ulh.UptimeLogsDetailFK,
			uld.UptimeLogDate,
			ulh.UptimeLogsCategoryFK,
			ulc_ulh.UptimeLogsCategory,
			ultc.CategoryScreenOrder,
			ulh.NoInWarehouse,
			ulh.MinRequiredInWarehouse,
			ulh.NoInWarehouseOnMonday,
			ulh.NoInWarehouseOnTuesday,
			ulh.NoInWarehouseOnWednesday,
			ulh.NoInWarehouseOnThursday,
			ulh.NoInWarehouseOnFriday,
			ulh.NoInWarehouseOnSaturday,
			ulh.NoInWarehouseOnSunday
		INTO
			#uptimeLogsHardware
		FROM 
			dbo.tblUptimeLogsHardware ulh WITH (NOLOCK)
		INNER JOIN dbo.tblUptimeLogsBuildingCategories ultc WITH (NOLOCK)
			ON ulh.UptimeLogsCategoryFK = ultc.UptimeLogsCategoryFK
		INNER JOIN dbo.appUptimeLogsTables ult WITH (NOLOCK)
			ON ultc.UptimeLogsTableFK = ult.UptimeLogsTablePK
		INNER JOIN dbo.appUptimeLogsCategories ulc_ulh WITH (NOLOCK)
			ON ultc.UptimeLogsCategoryFK = ulc_ulh.UptimeLogsCategoryPK
		INNER JOIN #uptimeLogsDetails uld
			ON ulh.UptimeLogsDetailFK = uld.UptimeLogsDetailPK
			AND ultc.BuildingFK = uld.BuildingFK
		LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.tblBuildings bldg
			ON uld.BuildingFK = bldg.BuildingPK
		WHERE
			ult.UptimeLogsTableName = 'tblUptimeLogsHardware'
			--AND ultc.BuildingFK = @varBuildingFK

		DELETE FROM #uptimeLogsHardware WHERE BuildingName IN ('IT', 'Transport', 'Quality')

		UPDATE #uptimeLogsHardware SET BuildingName = 'BV4And5', BuildingFK = 7777
		WHERE BuildingName IN ('BV4', 'BV5')

		DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #uptimeLogsHardware2

		SELECT 
			BuildingFK,
			BuildingName,
			CategoryScreenOrder,
			UptimeLogsCategory, 
		
			--CAST(
				CAST(
						(
							(
