								CAST(SUM(NoInWarehouseOnMonday + NoInWarehouseOnTuesday + NoInWarehouseOnWednesday + NoInWarehouseOnThursday + NoInWarehouseOnFriday + NoInWarehouseOnSaturday + NoInWarehouseOnSunday) AS DECIMAL(18,2))
								/ CAST((@varNoOfWeeksOfData * 7) AS DECIMAL(18,2))
							) 

							/ AVG(CAST(MinRequiredInWarehouse AS DECIMAL(18,2))) 

							* 100.00 
						)
						AS DECIMAL(18, 2)
					)
				--AS NVARCHAR(50)) + '%'
				AS AveragePercentageMinimumAvailable,
		
			--CAST(
				CAST(
						(
							(
								CAST(SUM(NoInWarehouseOnMonday + NoInWarehouseOnTuesday + NoInWarehouseOnWednesday + NoInWarehouseOnThursday + NoInWarehouseOnFriday + NoInWarehouseOnSaturday + NoInWarehouseOnSunday) AS DECIMAL(18,2))
								/ CAST((@varNoOfWeeksOfData * 7) AS DECIMAL(18,2))
							) 
						)
						AS DECIMAL(18, 2)
					)
				--AS NVARCHAR(50)) 
				AS AverageWorking,

			CAST(AVG(CAST(MinRequiredInWarehouse AS DECIMAL(18,2))) AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS AverageMinimumNeeded
		INTO
			#uptimeLogsHardware2
		FROM 
			#uptimeLogsHardware
		GROUP BY
			BuildingFK,
			BuildingName,
			CategoryScreenOrder,
			UptimeLogsCategory
	
		DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #hardwareResults

		SELECT DISTINCT 
			BuildingName,
			UptimeLogsCategory AS Category,
			ISNULL(AveragePercentageMinimumAvailable, 0.00) AS PercentageMinAvailable
		INTO
			#hardwareResults
		FROM
			#uptimeLogsHardware2

		DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #hardwareResults2;

		CREATE TABLE #hardwareResults2
		(
			Category NVARCHAR(200), 
			SixCrossRoadsPercentageOfMinimumAvailable DECIMAL(18,2),		
			BV1PercentageOfMinimumAvailable DECIMAL(18,2),
			BV2PercentageOfMinimumAvailable DECIMAL(18,2),
			BV3PercentageOfMinimumAvailable DECIMAL(18,2),
			BV4And5PercentageOfMinimumAvailable DECIMAL(18,2),
			CorkRoadPercentageOfMinimumAvailable DECIMAL(18,2),
			DungarvanPercentageOfMinimumAvailable DECIMAL(18,2),
			KilcohanPercentageOfMinimumAvailable DECIMAL(18,2),
			NorthernExtensionPercentageOfMinimumAvailable DECIMAL(18,2),
			SlieveruePercentageOfMinimumAvailable DECIMAL(18,2)
		)

		INSERT INTO #hardwareResults2(Category)
		SELECT DISTINCT Category FROM #hardwareResults

		UPDATE t1 SET SixCrossRoadsPercentageOfMinimumAvailable = t2.PercentageMinAvailable
		FROM #hardwareResults2 t1 
		INNER JOIN #hardwareResults t2 ON t1.Category = t2.Category
		WHERE t2.BuildingName IN ('Six Cross Roads', '6 Cross Roads')

		UPDATE t1 SET BV1PercentageOfMinimumAvailable = t2.PercentageMinAvailable
		FROM #hardwareResults2 t1 
		INNER JOIN #hardwareResults t2 ON t1.Category = t2.Category
		WHERE t2.BuildingName = 'BV1'

		UPDATE t1 SET BV2PercentageOfMinimumAvailable = t2.PercentageMinAvailable
		FROM #hardwareResults2 t1 
		INNER JOIN #hardwareResults t2 ON t1.Category = t2.Category
		WHERE t2.BuildingName = 'BV2'

		UPDATE t1 SET BV3PercentageOfMinimumAvailable = t2.PercentageMinAvailable
		FROM #hardwareResults2 t1 
		INNER JOIN #hardwareResults t2 ON t1.Category = t2.Category
		WHERE t2.BuildingName = 'BV3'

		UPDATE t1 SET BV4And5PercentageOfMinimumAvailable = t2.PercentageMinAvailable
		FROM #hardwareResults2 t1 
		INNER JOIN #hardwareResults t2 ON t1.Category = t2.Category
		WHERE t2.BuildingName = 'BV4And5'

		UPDATE t1 SET CorkRoadPercentageOfMinimumAvailable = t2.PercentageMinAvailable
		FROM #hardwareResults2 t1 
		INNER JOIN #hardwareResults t2 ON t1.Category = t2.Category
		WHERE t2.BuildingName = 'Cork Road'

		UPDATE t1 SET DungarvanPercentageOfMinimumAvailable = t2.PercentageMinAvailable
		FROM #hardwareResults2 t1 
		INNER JOIN #hardwareResults t2 ON t1.Category = t2.Category
		WHERE t2.BuildingName = 'Dungarvan'

		UPDATE t1 SET KilcohanPercentageOfMinimumAvailable = t2.PercentageMinAvailable
		FROM #hardwareResults2 t1 
		INNER JOIN #hardwareResults t2 ON t1.Category = t2.Category
		WHERE t2.BuildingName = 'Kilcohan'

		UPDATE t1 SET NorthernExtensionPercentageOfMinimumAvailable = t2.PercentageMinAvailable
		FROM #hardwareResults2 t1 
		INNER JOIN #hardwareResults t2 ON t1.Category = t2.Category
		WHERE t2.BuildingName = 'Northern Extension'

		UPDATE t1 SET SlieveruePercentageOfMinimumAvailable = t2.PercentageMinAvailable
		FROM #hardwareResults2 t1 
		INNER JOIN #hardwareResults t2 ON t1.Category = t2.Category
		WHERE t2.BuildingName = 'Slieverue'

		DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #hardwareResults3;

		SELECT 
			(CASE WHEN SixCrossRoadsPercentageOfMinimumAvailable IS NOT NULL THEN 1.00 ELSE 0.00 END) 
				+ (CASE WHEN BV1PercentageOfMinimumAvailable IS NOT NULL THEN 1.00 ELSE 0.00 END) 
					+ (CASE WHEN BV2PercentageOfMinimumAvailable IS NOT NULL THEN 1.00 ELSE 0.00 END)
						+ (CASE WHEN BV3PercentageOfMinimumAvailable IS NOT NULL THEN 1.00 ELSE 0.00 END)
							+ (CASE WHEN BV4And5PercentageOfMinimumAvailable IS NOT NULL THEN 1.00 ELSE 0.00 END)
								+ (CASE WHEN CorkRoadPercentageOfMinimumAvailable IS NOT NULL THEN 1.00 ELSE 0.00 END)
									+ (CASE WHEN DungarvanPercentageOfMinimumAvailable IS NOT NULL THEN 1.00 ELSE 0.00 END)
										+ (CASE WHEN KilcohanPercentageOfMinimumAvailable IS NOT NULL THEN 1.00 ELSE 0.00 END)
											+ (CASE WHEN NorthernExtensionPercentageOfMinimumAvailable IS NOT NULL THEN 1.00 ELSE 0.00 END)
												+ (CASE WHEN SlieveruePercentageOfMinimumAvailable IS NOT NULL THEN 1.00 ELSE 0.00 END) AS HorizontalAverageDivider,
			*	
		INTO
			#hardwareResults3
		FROM 
			#hardwareResults2

		DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #verticalBuildingAverageDividers;

		SELECT
			SUM((CASE WHEN t2.SixCrossRoadsPercentageOfMinimumAvailable IS NOT NULL THEN 1.00 ELSE 0.00 END)) AS SixCrossRoadsVerticalAverageDivider,
			SUM((CASE WHEN t2.BV1PercentageOfMinimumAvailable IS NOT NULL THEN 1.00 ELSE 0.00 END)) AS BV1VerticalAverageDivider,
			SUM((CASE WHEN t2.BV2PercentageOfMinimumAvailable IS NOT NULL THEN 1.00 ELSE 0.00 END)) AS BV2VerticalAverageDivider,
			SUM((CASE WHEN t2.BV3PercentageOfMinimumAvailable IS NOT NULL THEN 1.00 ELSE 0.00 END)) AS BV3VerticalAverageDivider,
			SUM((CASE WHEN t2.BV4And5PercentageOfMinimumAvailable IS NOT NULL THEN 1.00 ELSE 0.00 END))  AS BV4And5VerticalAverageDivider,

			SUM((CASE WHEN t2.CorkRoadPercentageOfMinimumAvailable IS NOT NULL THEN 1.00 ELSE 0.00 END))  AS CorkRoadVerticalAverageDivider,
			SUM((CASE WHEN t2.DungarvanPercentageOfMinimumAvailable IS NOT NULL THEN 1.00 ELSE 0.00 END)) AS DungarvanVerticalAverageDivider,
			SUM((CASE WHEN t2.KilcohanPercentageOfMinimumAvailable IS NOT NULL THEN 1.00 ELSE 0.00 END)) AS KilcohanVerticalAverageDivider,

			SUM((CASE WHEN t2.NorthernExtensionPercentageOfMinimumAvailable IS NOT NULL THEN 1.00 ELSE 0.00 END)) AS NorthernExtensionVerticalAverageDivider,
			SUM((CASE WHEN t2.SlieveruePercentageOfMinimumAvailable IS NOT NULL THEN 1.00 ELSE 0.00 END)) AS SlieverueVerticalAverageDivider
		INTO
			#verticalBuildingAverageDividers
		FROM 
			#hardwareResults3 t2

		UPDATE #verticalBuildingAverageDividers
		SET 
			SixCrossRoadsVerticalAverageDivider = CASE WHEN SixCrossRoadsVerticalAverageDivider < 1 THEN 1 ELSE SixCrossRoadsVerticalAverageDivider END,
			BV1VerticalAverageDivider = CASE WHEN BV1VerticalAverageDivider < 1 THEN 1 ELSE BV1VerticalAverageDivider END,
			BV2VerticalAverageDivider = CASE WHEN BV2VerticalAverageDivider < 1 THEN 1 ELSE BV2VerticalAverageDivider END,
			BV3VerticalAverageDivider = CASE WHEN BV3VerticalAverageDivider < 1 THEN 1 ELSE BV3VerticalAverageDivider END,
			BV4And5VerticalAverageDivider = CASE WHEN BV4And5VerticalAverageDivider < 1 THEN 1 ELSE BV4And5VerticalAverageDivider END,
			CorkRoadVerticalAverageDivider = CASE WHEN CorkRoadVerticalAverageDivider < 1 THEN 1 ELSE CorkRoadVerticalAverageDivider END,
			DungarvanVerticalAverageDivider = CASE WHEN DungarvanVerticalAverageDivider < 1 THEN 1 ELSE DungarvanVerticalAverageDivider END,
			KilcohanVerticalAverageDivider = CASE WHEN KilcohanVerticalAverageDivider < 1 THEN 1 ELSE KilcohanVerticalAverageDivider END,
			NorthernExtensionVerticalAverageDivider = CASE WHEN NorthernExtensionVerticalAverageDivider < 1 THEN 1 ELSE NorthernExtensionVerticalAverageDivider END,
			SlieverueVerticalAverageDivider = CASE WHEN SlieverueVerticalAverageDivider < 1 THEN 1 ELSE SlieverueVerticalAverageDivider END

		DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #hardwareResults4;

		SELECT
			CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS HorizontalAverageDivider,
			Category, SixCrossRoadsPercentageOfMinimumAvailable, BV1PercentageOfMinimumAvailable, BV2PercentageOfMinimumAvailable, BV3PercentageOfMinimumAvailable, BV4And5PercentageOfMinimumAvailable, CorkRoadPercentageOfMinimumAvailable, 
			DungarvanPercentageOfMinimumAvailable, KilcohanPercentageOfMinimumAvailable, NorthernExtensionPercentageOfMinimumAvailable, SlieveruePercentageOfMinimumAvailable, 

			CAST(ROUND(SUM(ISNULL(SixCrossRoadsPercentageOfMinimumAvailable, 0.00) + ISNULL(BV1PercentageOfMinimumAvailable, 0.00) + ISNULL(BV2PercentageOfMinimumAvailable, 0.00) + ISNULL(BV3PercentageOfMinimumAvailable, 0.00) 
				+ ISNULL(BV4And5PercentageOfMinimumAvailable, 0.00)
				+ ISNULL(CorkRoadPercentageOfMinimumAvailable, 0.00) + ISNULL(DungarvanPercentageOfMinimumAvailable, 0.00) + ISNULL(KilcohanPercentageOfMinimumAvailable, 0.00) + ISNULL(NorthernExtensionPercentageOfMinimumAvailable, 0.00) 
					+ ISNULL(SlieveruePercentageOfMinimumAvailable, 0.00)) / HorizontalAverageDivider, 2) AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS AveragePercentageOfMinimumAvailable,

			CAST(0 AS BIT) AS TotalsRow
		INTO
			#hardwareResults4
		FROM 
			#hardwareResults3
		GROUP BY 
			HorizontalAverageDivider, Category, SixCrossRoadsPercentageOfMinimumAvailable, BV1PercentageOfMinimumAvailable, BV2PercentageOfMinimumAvailable, BV3PercentageOfMinimumAvailable, BV4And5PercentageOfMinimumAvailable, CorkRoadPercentageOfMinimumAvailable, 
			DungarvanPercentageOfMinimumAvailable, KilcohanPercentageOfMinimumAvailable, NorthernExtensionPercentageOfMinimumAvailable, SlieveruePercentageOfMinimumAvailable

		INSERT INTO #hardwareResults4 
		SELECT CAST(NULL AS INT) AS HorizontalAverageDivider, 'Total', CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL(18,2)), CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL(18,2)), CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL(18,2)), CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL(18,2)), CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL(18,2)), CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL(18,2)), CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL(18,2)), CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL(18,2)), 
					CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL(18,2)), CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL(18,2)), CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL(18,2)), 1
		
		DECLARE @totalVerticalAverageDivider DECIMAL(18,2) = (	SELECT 
																	SixCrossRoadsVerticalAverageDivider + BV1VerticalAverageDivider + BV2VerticalAverageDivider + BV3VerticalAverageDivider + BV4And5VerticalAverageDivider +
																	CorkRoadVerticalAverageDivider + DungarvanVerticalAverageDivider + KilcohanVerticalAverageDivider + NorthernExtensionVerticalAverageDivider + SlieverueVerticalAverageDivider 
																FROM 
																	#verticalBuildingAverageDividers	)

		UPDATE t1
		SET 
			SixCrossRoadsPercentageOfMinimumAvailable = (SELECT SUM(SixCrossRoadsPercentageOfMinimumAvailable) / (SELECT SixCrossRoadsVerticalAverageDivider FROM #verticalBuildingAverageDividers) FROM #hardwareResults4),
			BV1PercentageOfMinimumAvailable = (SELECT SUM(BV1PercentageOfMinimumAvailable) / (SELECT BV1VerticalAverageDivider FROM #verticalBuildingAverageDividers) FROM #hardwareResults4),
			BV2PercentageOfMinimumAvailable = (SELECT SUM(BV2PercentageOfMinimumAvailable) / (SELECT BV2VerticalAverageDivider FROM #verticalBuildingAverageDividers) FROM #hardwareResults4),
			BV3PercentageOfMinimumAvailable = (SELECT SUM(BV3PercentageOfMinimumAvailable) / (SELECT BV3VerticalAverageDivider FROM #verticalBuildingAverageDividers) FROM #hardwareResults4),
			BV4And5PercentageOfMinimumAvailable = (SELECT SUM(BV4And5PercentageOfMinimumAvailable) / (SELECT BV4And5VerticalAverageDivider FROM #verticalBuildingAverageDividers) FROM #hardwareResults4),
			CorkRoadPercentageOfMinimumAvailable = (SELECT SUM(CorkRoadPercentageOfMinimumAvailable) / (SELECT CorkRoadVerticalAverageDivider FROM #verticalBuildingAverageDividers) FROM #hardwareResults4),
			DungarvanPercentageOfMinimumAvailable = (SELECT SUM(DungarvanPercentageOfMinimumAvailable) / (SELECT DungarvanVerticalAverageDivider FROM #verticalBuildingAverageDividers) FROM #hardwareResults4),
			KilcohanPercentageOfMinimumAvailable = (SELECT SUM(KilcohanPercentageOfMinimumAvailable) / (SELECT KilcohanVerticalAverageDivider FROM #verticalBuildingAverageDividers) FROM #hardwareResults4),
			NorthernExtensionPercentageOfMinimumAvailable = (SELECT SUM(NorthernExtensionPercentageOfMinimumAvailable) / (SELECT NorthernExtensionVerticalAverageDivider FROM #verticalBuildingAverageDividers) FROM #hardwareResults4),
			SlieveruePercentageOfMinimumAvailable = (SELECT SUM(SlieveruePercentageOfMinimumAvailable) / (SELECT SlieverueVerticalAverageDivider FROM #verticalBuildingAverageDividers) FROM #hardwareResults4)
		FROM
			#hardwareResults4 t1
		WHERE 
			t1.TotalsRow = 1

		UPDATE t1
		SET HorizontalAverageDivider =	(CASE WHEN SixCrossRoadsPercentageOfMinimumAvailable IS NOT NULL THEN 1.00 ELSE 0.00 END) 
											+ (CASE WHEN BV1PercentageOfMinimumAvailable IS NOT NULL THEN 1.00 ELSE 0.00 END) 
												+ (CASE WHEN BV2PercentageOfMinimumAvailable IS NOT NULL THEN 1.00 ELSE 0.00 END)
													+ (CASE WHEN BV3PercentageOfMinimumAvailable IS NOT NULL THEN 1.00 ELSE 0.00 END)
														+ (CASE WHEN BV4And5PercentageOfMinimumAvailable IS NOT NULL THEN 1.00 ELSE 0.00 END)
															+ (CASE WHEN CorkRoadPercentageOfMinimumAvailable IS NOT NULL THEN 1.00 ELSE 0.00 END)
																+ (CASE WHEN DungarvanPercentageOfMinimumAvailable IS NOT NULL THEN 1.00 ELSE 0.00 END)
																	+ (CASE WHEN KilcohanPercentageOfMinimumAvailable IS NOT NULL THEN 1.00 ELSE 0.00 END)
																		+ (CASE WHEN NorthernExtensionPercentageOfMinimumAvailable IS NOT NULL THEN 1.00 ELSE 0.00 END)
																			+ (CASE WHEN SlieveruePercentageOfMinimumAvailable IS NOT NULL THEN 1.00 ELSE 0.00 END)
		FROM
			#hardwareResults4 t1
		WHERE 
			t1.TotalsRow = 1

		UPDATE t1
		SET 
			AveragePercentageOfMinimumAvailable = (	SELECT CAST(ROUND(SUM(ISNULL(SixCrossRoadsPercentageOfMinimumAvailable, 0.00) + ISNULL(BV1PercentageOfMinimumAvailable, 0.00) + ISNULL(BV2PercentageOfMinimumAvailable, 0.00) + ISNULL(BV3PercentageOfMinimumAvailable, 0.00) 
														+ ISNULL(BV4And5PercentageOfMinimumAvailable, 0.00) + ISNULL(CorkRoadPercentageOfMinimumAvailable, 0.00) + ISNULL(DungarvanPercentageOfMinimumAvailable, 0.00) 
															+ ISNULL(KilcohanPercentageOfMinimumAvailable, 0.00) + ISNULL(NorthernExtensionPercentageOfMinimumAvailable, 0.00) + ISNULL(SlieveruePercentageOfMinimumAvailable, 0.00)) / HorizontalAverageDivider, 2) 
																AS DECIMAL(18,2)) 
													FROM #hardwareResults4 t2 
													WHERE t2.TotalsRow = 1
													GROUP BY t2.HorizontalAverageDivider	)
		FROM
			#hardwareResults4 t1
		WHERE 
			t1.TotalsRow = 1

		DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #finalHardwareResults

		SELECT 
			 t1.Category, 
			 ISNULL(CAST(t1.SixCrossRoadsPercentageOfMinimumAvailable AS NVARCHAR(50)), 'N/A') AS SixCrossRoadsPercentageOfMinimumAvailable, 
			 ISNULL(CAST(t1.BV1PercentageOfMinimumAvailable AS NVARCHAR(50)), 'N/A') AS BV1PercentageOfMinimumAvailable,
			 ISNULL(CAST(t1.BV2PercentageOfMinimumAvailable AS NVARCHAR(50)), 'N/A') AS BV2PercentageOfMinimumAvailable,
			 ISNULL(CAST(t1.BV3PercentageOfMinimumAvailable AS NVARCHAR(50)), 'N/A') AS BV3PercentageOfMinimumAvailable,
			 ISNULL(CAST(t1.BV4And5PercentageOfMinimumAvailable AS NVARCHAR(50)), 'N/A') AS BV4And5PercentageOfMinimumAvailable,
			 ISNULL(CAST(t1.CorkRoadPercentageOfMinimumAvailable AS NVARCHAR(50)), 'N/A') AS CorkRoadPercentageOfMinimumAvailable,
			 ISNULL(CAST(t1.DungarvanPercentageOfMinimumAvailable AS NVARCHAR(50)), 'N/A') AS DungarvanPercentageOfMinimumAvailable,
			 ISNULL(CAST(t1.KilcohanPercentageOfMinimumAvailable AS NVARCHAR(50)), 'N/A') AS KilcohanPercentageOfMinimumAvailable, 
			 ISNULL(CAST(t1.NorthernExtensionPercentageOfMinimumAvailable AS NVARCHAR(50)), 'N/A') AS NorthernExtensionPercentageOfMinimumAvailable,
			 ISNULL(CAST(t1.SlieveruePercentageOfMinimumAvailable AS NVARCHAR(50)), 'N/A') AS SlieveruePercentageOfMinimumAvailable,
			 ISNULL(CAST(t1.AveragePercentageOfMinimumAvailable AS NVARCHAR(50)), 'N/A') AS AveragePercentageOfMinimumAvailable,
			 t1.TotalsRow
		INTO
			#finalHardwareResults
		FROM 
			#hardwareResults4 t1

		SELECT
			t1.Category, 
			 CASE WHEN t1.SixCrossRoadsPercentageOfMinimumAvailable = 'N/A' THEN SixCrossRoadsPercentageOfMinimumAvailable ELSE SixCrossRoadsPercentageOfMinimumAvailable + '%' END AS [6+Rds %MinAvail], 
			 CASE WHEN t1.BV1PercentageOfMinimumAvailable = 'N/A' THEN BV1PercentageOfMinimumAvailable ELSE BV1PercentageOfMinimumAvailable + '%' END AS [BV1 %MinAvail],
			 CASE WHEN t1.BV2PercentageOfMinimumAvailable = 'N/A' THEN BV2PercentageOfMinimumAvailable ELSE BV2PercentageOfMinimumAvailable + '%' END AS [BV2 %MinAvail],
			 CASE WHEN t1.BV3PercentageOfMinimumAvailable = 'N/A' THEN BV3PercentageOfMinimumAvailable ELSE BV3PercentageOfMinimumAvailable + '%' END AS [BV3 %MinAvail],
			 CASE WHEN t1.BV4And5PercentageOfMinimumAvailable = 'N/A' THEN BV4And5PercentageOfMinimumAvailable ELSE BV4And5PercentageOfMinimumAvailable + '%' END AS [BV4&5 %MinAvail],
			 CASE WHEN t1.CorkRoadPercentageOfMinimumAvailable = 'N/A' THEN CorkRoadPercentageOfMinimumAvailable ELSE CorkRoadPercentageOfMinimumAvailable + '%' END AS [CrkRd %MinAvail],
			 CASE WHEN t1.DungarvanPercentageOfMinimumAvailable = 'N/A' THEN DungarvanPercentageOfMinimumAvailable ELSE DungarvanPercentageOfMinimumAvailable + '%' END AS [Dngrvn %MinAvail],
			 CASE WHEN t1.KilcohanPercentageOfMinimumAvailable = 'N/A' THEN KilcohanPercentageOfMinimumAvailable ELSE KilcohanPercentageOfMinimumAvailable + '%' END AS [Klchn %MinAvail], 
			 CASE WHEN t1.NorthernExtensionPercentageOfMinimumAvailable = 'N/A' THEN NorthernExtensionPercentageOfMinimumAvailable ELSE NorthernExtensionPercentageOfMinimumAvailable + '%' END AS [NrthExt %MinAvail],
			 CASE WHEN t1.SlieveruePercentageOfMinimumAvailable = 'N/A' THEN SlieveruePercentageOfMinimumAvailable ELSE SlieveruePercentageOfMinimumAvailable + '%' END AS [Slver %MinAvail],
			 CASE WHEN t1.AveragePercentageOfMinimumAvailable = 'N/A' THEN AveragePercentageOfMinimumAvailable ELSE AveragePercentageOfMinimumAvailable + '%' END AS [Avg %MinAvail]
			 --,t1.TotalsRow
		FROM
			#finalHardwareResults t1
		ORDER BY 
			TotalsRow ASC, 
			Category ASC
	END

	-- Integration Files section.

	IF 1 = 1 /*Using this so this section of code can be closed in Ms SQL Server Management Studio*/
	BEGIN
		DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #stock

		SELECT 
			CAST('In' AS NVARCHAR(3)) AS StockDirection,
			t1.CustomerFK,
			cust.CustomerCode,
			cust.CustomerName,
			ISNULL(COUNT(DISTINCT t1.IntegrationFilePK), 0) AS NoOfProcessedFiles
		INTO
			#stock
		FROM
			dbo.tblIntegrationFiles t1 WITH (NOLOCK)
		INNER JOIN appIntegrationFileTypes t2 WITH (NOLOCK)
			ON t1.IntegrationFileTypeFK = t2.IntegrationFileTypePK
		INNER JOIN dbo.tblContainerIns t3 WITH (NOLOCK)
			ON t1.FK = t3.ContainerInPK
		INNER JOIN dbo.viewBuildingDetails vbd WITH (NOLOCK)
			ON t3.BuildingUnitFK = vbd.BuildingUnitPK
		INNER JOIN dbo.tblCustomers cust WITH (NOLOCK)
			ON t1.CustomerFK = cust.CustomerPK
		WHERE
			CAST(t1.InsertedDate AS DATE) >= @varDataStartDate
			AND CAST(t1.InsertedDate AS DATE) < @varDataEndDate
			AND t1.FK > 0
			AND t2.IntegrationFileTypeDescription =  'Stock Inward'
		GROUP BY
			t1.CustomerFK,
			cust.CustomerCode,
			cust.CustomerName

		INSERT INTO #stock
		SELECT
			'Out' AS StockDirection,
			t1.CustomerFK,
			cust.CustomerCode,
			cust.CustomerName,
			ISNULL(COUNT(DISTINCT t1.IntegrationFilePK), 0) AS NoOfProcessedFiles
		FROM
			dbo.tblIntegrationFiles t1 WITH (NOLOCK)
		INNER JOIN appIntegrationFileTypes t2 WITH (NOLOCK)
			ON t1.IntegrationFileTypeFK = t2.IntegrationFileTypePK
		INNER JOIN dbo.tblContainerOuts t3 WITH (NOLOCK)
			ON t1.FK = t3.ContainerOutPK
		INNER JOIN dbo.tblStockOrders t4 WITH (NOLOCK)
			ON t3.ContainerOutPK = t4.ContainerOutFK
		INNER JOIN dbo.viewBuildingDetails vbd WITH (NOLOCK)
			ON t4.ResponsibleBuildingUnitFK = vbd.BuildingUnitPK
		INNER JOIN dbo.tblCustomers cust WITH (NOLOCK)
			ON t1.CustomerFK = cust.CustomerPK
		WHERE 
			CAST(t1.InsertedDate AS DATE) >= @varDataStartDate
			AND CAST(t1.InsertedDate AS DATE) < @varDataEndDate
			AND t1.FK > 0
			AND t2.IntegrationFileTypeDescription =  'Stock Outward'
		GROUP BY
			t1.CustomerFK,
			cust.CustomerCode,
			cust.CustomerName

		DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #stockResults

		SELECT StockDirection, 'Danone' AS Customer, SUM(NoOfProcessedFiles) AS NoOfProcessedFiles  
		INTO #stockResults
		FROM #stock 
		WHERE CustomerName like '%danone%'
		GROUP BY StockDirection

		UNION

		SELECT StockDirection, 'Glanbia' AS Customer, SUM(NoOfProcessedFiles) AS NoOfProcessedFiles  
		FROM #stock
		WHERE CustomerName like '%glanbia%'
		GROUP BY StockDirection

		UNION

		SELECT StockDirection, Customer, SUM(NoOfProcessedFiles) AS NoOfProcessedFiles
		FROM
			(
			SELECT StockDirection, 'GSK' AS Customer, SUM(NoOfProcessedFiles) AS NoOfProcessedFiles  
			FROM #stock
			WHERE CustomerName like '%glaxo%smith%kline%'
			GROUP BY StockDirection
			UNION
			SELECT StockDirection, 'GSK' AS Customer, SUM(NoOfProcessedFiles) AS NoOfProcessedFiles  
			FROM #stock
			WHERE CustomerName like '%gsk%'
			GROUP BY StockDirection
			) AS subQuery
		GROUP BY
			StockDirection,
			Customer

		DECLARE
			@varDanoneNoOfProcessedStockInFiles INT, @varDanoneNoOfProcessedStockOutFiles INT, @varGlanbiaNoOfProcessedStockInFiles INT, @varGlanbiaNoOfProcessedStockOutFiles INT, @varGSKNoOfProcessedStockInFiles INT, @varGSKNoOfProcessedStockOutFiles INT;

		SELECT 
			@varDanoneNoOfProcessedStockInFiles = NoOfProcessedFiles
		FROM 
			#stockResults
		WHERE
			StockDirection = 'In' 
			AND Customer = 'Danone'

		SELECT 
			@varDanoneNoOfProcessedStockOutFiles = NoOfProcessedFiles
		FROM 
			#stockResults
		WHERE
			StockDirection = 'Out'
			AND Customer = 'Danone'

		SELECT 
			@varGlanbiaNoOfProcessedStockInFiles = NoOfProcessedFiles
		FROM 
			#stockResults
		WHERE
			StockDirection = 'In' 
			AND Customer = 'Glanbia'

		SELECT 
			@varGlanbiaNoOfProcessedStockOutFiles = NoOfProcessedFiles
		FROM 
			#stockResults
		WHERE
			StockDirection = 'Out'
			AND Customer = 'Glanbia'

		SELECT 
			@varGSKNoOfProcessedStockInFiles = NoOfProcessedFiles
		FROM 
			#stockResults
		WHERE
			StockDirection = 'In' 
			AND Customer = 'GSK'

		SELECT 
			@varGSKNoOfProcessedStockOutFiles = NoOfProcessedFiles
		FROM 
			#stockResults
		WHERE
			StockDirection = 'Out'
			AND Customer = 'GSK'


		-- Get % of issues numbers.

		DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #jiraIntegrationResults;

		CREATE TABLE #jiraIntegrationResults(IssueType NVARCHAR(50), NoOfIntegrationTickets INT, BuildingName NVARCHAR(200), IntegratedCustomer NVARCHAR(200), AutoText NVARCHAR(MAX));

		DECLARE @sqlCommand NVARCHAR(MAX);

		SET @sqlCommand = 'SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ UNCOMMITTED; SET DEADLOCK_PRIORITY LOW;; DECLARE @varStartDate DATETIME = ''' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), @varDataStartDate, 21) + ''', @varEndDate DATETIME; 
SET @varEndDate = ''' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), @varDataEndDate, 21) + '''; drop table if exists #integrationTickets;

select distinct t1.JiraTicketDetailPK into #integrationTickets from dbo.tblJiraTicketDetails t1 inner join dbo.tblJiraCustomFields t2 on t1.JiraTicketDetailPK = t2.JiraTicketDetailFK 
where t1.ProjectName = ''SIT'' and t1.CreatedDateTime >= @varStartDate and t1.CreatedDateTime < @varEndDate and t1.TypeName like ''%integration%'';

insert into #integrationTickets select distinct t1.JiraTicketDetailPK		
from dbo.tblJiraTicketDetails t1 inner join dbo.tblJiraCustomFields t2 on t1.JiraTicketDetailPK = t2.JiraTicketDetailFK where t1.ProjectName = ''SIT'' and t1.CreatedDateTime >= @varStartDate and t1.CreatedDateTime < @varEndDate and t2.CustomFieldName = ''Building''
and exists(select 1 from dbo.tblJiraCustomFields t3 where t3.JiraTicketDetailFK = t2.JiraTicketDetailFK and t3.CustomFieldName = ''Ticket Type'' and t3.CustomFieldValue like ''%Integration%'') 
and not exists(select 1 from #integrationTickets t4 where t4.JiraTicketDetailPK = t1.JiraTicketDetailPK)

if not exists(select 1 from #integrationTickets) goto exit_this_code; drop table if exists #results2;select distinct t1.JiraTicketDetailPK,t2.CustomFieldName,t2.CustomFieldValue into #results2 from dbo.tblJiraTicketDetails t1 inner join dbo.tblJiraCustomFields t2 on t1.JiraTicketDetailPK = t2.JiraTicketDetailFK inner join #integrationTickets t3 
on t1.JiraTicketDetailPK = t3.JiraTicketDetailPK where t2.CustomFieldName IN (''Building'', ''Integrated Customer'', ''Failure Reason'') AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.tblJiraCustomFields t4 WHERE t4.JiraTicketDetailFK = t2.JiraTicketDetailFK 
AND t4.CustomFieldName = ''Building'');if not exists(select 1 from #results2) goto exit_this_code; drop table if exists #results3; create table #results3(JiraTicketDetailPK INT, BuildingName NVARCHAR(200), FailureReason NVARCHAR(200), IntegratedCustomer NVARCHAR(200)); insert into #results3 select distinct JiraTicketDetailPK, '''', '''', '''' from #results2;
update t1 set BuildingName = t2.CustomFieldValue from #results3 t1 inner join #results2 t2 on t1.JiraTicketDetailPK = t2.JiraTicketDetailPK where t2.CustomFieldName = ''Building'';
update t1 set FailureReason = t2.CustomFieldValue from #results3 t1 inner join #results2 t2 on t1.JiraTicketDetailPK = t2.JiraTicketDetailPK where t2.CustomFieldName = ''Failure Reason'';
update t1 set IntegratedCustomer = t2.CustomFieldValue from #results3 t1 inner join #results2 t2 on t1.JiraTicketDetailPK = t2.JiraTicketDetailPK where t2.CustomFieldName = ''Integrated Customer'';
drop table if exists #storeAllTickets; select * into #storeAllTickets from #results3 t1 where exists(select 1 from #results3 t2 where t2.JiraTicketDetailPK = t1.JiraTicketDetailPK and t2.FailureReason in (''Store-all user error'', ''WMS not processing order when sufficient stock is available''))	
drop table if exists #customerTickets; select * into #customerTickets from #results3 t1 where not exists (select 1 from #results3 t2 where t2.JiraTicketDetailPK = t1.JiraTicketDetailPK and t2.FailureReason in (''Store-all user error'', ''WMS not processing order when sufficient stock is available''))
SELECT ''Store-All'' AS IssueType, COUNT(DISTINCT t1.JiraTicketDetailPK) AS NoOfIntegrationTickets, t1.BuildingName, t1.IntegratedCustomer from #storeAllTickets t1 group by t1.BuildingName, t1.IntegratedCustomer 
union SELECT ''Customer'' AS IssueType, COUNT(DISTINCT t1.JiraTicketDetailPK) AS NoOfIntegrationTickets, t1.BuildingName, t1.IntegratedCustomer from #customerTickets t1 group by t1.BuildingName, t1.IntegratedCustomer; exit_this_code:'

		INSERT INTO #jiraIntegrationResults
		EXEC sp_execute_remote N'StawmsReportingDataSource', @sqlCommand;
	
		DECLARE 
			@varDanoneCustomerIssues DECIMAL(18, 2), @varGlanbiaCustomerIssues DECIMAL(18, 2), @varGSKCustomerIssues DECIMAL(18, 2), @varDanoneStoreAllIssues DECIMAL(18, 2), @varGlanbiaStoreAllIssues DECIMAL(18, 2), @varGSKStoreAllIssues DECIMAL(18, 2),
			@varTotalCustomerIssues DECIMAL(18, 2), @varTotalStoreAllIssues DECIMAL(18, 2), @varTotalIssues DECIMAL(18, 2)

		SELECT @varDanoneCustomerIssues = SUM(ISNULL(t1.NoOfIntegrationTickets,0))
		FROM #jiraIntegrationResults t1
		WHERE t1.IssueType = 'Customer'
		AND t1.IntegratedCustomer = 'Danone'

		SELECT @varGlanbiaCustomerIssues = SUM(ISNULL(t1.NoOfIntegrationTickets,0)) 
		FROM #jiraIntegrationResults t1
		WHERE t1.IssueType = 'Customer'
		AND t1.IntegratedCustomer = 'Glanbia'

		SELECT @varGSKCustomerIssues = SUM(ISNULL(t1.NoOfIntegrationTickets,0))
		FROM #jiraIntegrationResults t1
		WHERE t1.IssueType = 'Customer'
		AND t1.IntegratedCustomer = 'GSK'

		SELECT @varDanoneStoreAllIssues = SUM(ISNULL(t1.NoOfIntegrationTickets,0))
		FROM #jiraIntegrationResults t1
		WHERE t1.IssueType = 'Store-All'
		AND t1.IntegratedCustomer = 'Danone'

		SELECT @varGlanbiaStoreAllIssues = SUM(ISNULL(t1.NoOfIntegrationTickets,0)) 
		FROM #jiraIntegrationResults t1
		WHERE t1.IssueType = 'Store-All'
		AND t1.IntegratedCustomer = 'Glanbia'

		SELECT @varGSKStoreAllIssues = SUM(ISNULL(t1.NoOfIntegrationTickets,0))
		FROM #jiraIntegrationResults t1
		WHERE t1.IssueType = 'Store-All'
		AND t1.IntegratedCustomer = 'GSK'

		SET @varTotalCustomerIssues = @varDanoneCustomerIssues + @varGlanbiaCustomerIssues + @varGSKCustomerIssues;
		SET @varTotalStoreAllIssues = @varDanoneStoreAllIssues + @varGlanbiaStoreAllIssues + @varGSKStoreAllIssues;

		SET @varTotalIssues = @varTotalStoreAllIssues + @varTotalCustomerIssues;

		DECLARE @varDanoneCustomerPercentageIssues NVARCHAR(50) = (SELECT CASE WHEN @varTotalIssues < 1 THEN '0.00' ELSE CAST(CAST(ROUND((@varDanoneCustomerIssues / @varTotalIssues) * 100.00, 2) AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS NVARCHAR(50)) + '%' END);
		DECLARE @varGlanbiaCustomerPercentageIssues NVARCHAR(50) = (SELECT CASE WHEN @varTotalIssues < 1 THEN '0.00' ELSE CAST(CAST(ROUND((@varGlanbiaCustomerIssues / @varTotalIssues) * 100.00, 2) AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS NVARCHAR(50)) + '%' END);
		DECLARE @varGSKCustomerPercentageIssues NVARCHAR(50) = (SELECT CASE WHEN @varTotalIssues < 1 THEN '0.00' ELSE CAST(CAST(ROUND((@varGSKCustomerIssues / @varTotalIssues) * 100.00, 2) AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS NVARCHAR(50)) + '%' END);

		DECLARE @varTotalCustomerPercentageIssues NVARCHAR(50) = (SELECT CASE WHEN @varTotalIssues < 1 THEN '0.00' ELSE CAST(CAST(ROUND((@varTotalCustomerIssues / @varTotalIssues) * 100.00, 2) AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS NVARCHAR(50)) + '%' END);

		DECLARE @varDanoneStoreAllPercentageIssues NVARCHAR(50) = (SELECT CASE WHEN @varTotalIssues < 1 THEN '0.00' ELSE CAST(CAST(ROUND((@varDanoneStoreAllIssues / @varTotalIssues) * 100.00, 2) AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS NVARCHAR(50)) + '%' END);
		DECLARE @varGlanbiaStoreAllPercentageIssues NVARCHAR(50) = (SELECT CASE WHEN @varTotalIssues < 1 THEN '0.00' ELSE CAST(CAST(ROUND((@varGlanbiaStoreAllIssues / @varTotalIssues) * 100.00, 2) AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS NVARCHAR(50)) + '%' END);
		DECLARE @varGSKStoreAllPercentageIssues NVARCHAR(50) = (SELECT CASE WHEN @varTotalIssues < 1 THEN '0.00' ELSE CAST(CAST(ROUND((@varGSKStoreAllIssues / @varTotalIssues) * 100.00, 2) AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS NVARCHAR(50)) + '%' END);

		DECLARE @varTotalStoreAllPercentageIssues NVARCHAR(50) = (SELECT CASE WHEN @varTotalIssues < 1 THEN '0.00' ELSE CAST(CAST(ROUND((@varTotalStoreAllIssues / @varTotalIssues) * 100.00, 2) AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS NVARCHAR(50)) + '%' END);

		--SELECT @varDanoneStoreAllPercentageIssues AS [@varDanoneStoreAllPercentageIssues], @varDanoneCustomerPercentageIssues AS[@varDanoneCustomerPercentageIssues]
		--SELECT @varGlanbiaStoreAllPercentageIssues AS [@varGlanbiaStoreAllPercentageIssues], @varGlanbiaCustomerPercentageIssues AS [@varGlanbiaCustomerPercentageIssues]
		--SELECT @varGSKStoreAllPercentageIssues AS [@varGSKStoreAllPercentageIssues], @varGSKCustomerPercentageIssues AS [@varGSKCustomerPercentageIssues]
		--SELECT @varTotalStoreAllPercentageIssues AS [@varTotalStoreAllPercentageIssues], @varTotalCustomerPercentageIssues AS[@varTotalCustomerPercentageIssues]

		SELECT 
			'Danone' AS Category, @varDanoneNoOfProcessedStockInFiles AS [Stock In], @varDanoneNoOfProcessedStockOutFiles AS [Stock Out], @varDanoneNoOfProcessedStockInFiles + @varDanoneNoOfProcessedStockOutFiles AS [Total Files], 
				@varDanoneStoreAllPercentageIssues AS [Store-All % Issues], @varDanoneCustomerPercentageIssues AS [Customer % Issues]--, CAST(0 AS BIT) AS TotalsRow
		UNION
		SELECT
			'Glanbia' AS Category, @varGlanbiaNoOfProcessedStockInFiles AS [Stock In], @varGlanbiaNoOfProcessedStockOutFiles AS [Stock Out], @varGlanbiaNoOfProcessedStockInFiles + @varGlanbiaNoOfProcessedStockOutFiles AS [Total Files],
				@varGlanbiaStoreAllPercentageIssues AS [Store-All % Issues], @varGlanbiaCustomerPercentageIssues AS [Customer % Issues]--, CAST(0 AS BIT) AS TotalsRow
		UNION
		SELECT
			'Gsk' AS Category, @varGSKNoOfProcessedStockInFiles AS [Stock In], @varGSKNoOfProcessedStockOutFiles AS [Stock Out], @varGSKNoOfProcessedStockInFiles + @varGSKNoOfProcessedStockOutFiles AS TotalFiles,
				@varGSKStoreAllPercentageIssues AS [Store-All % Issues], @varGSKCustomerPercentageIssues AS [Customer % Issues]--, CAST(0 AS BIT) AS TotalsRow
		UNION
		SELECT
			'Total' AS Category, @varDanoneNoOfProcessedStockInFiles + @varGlanbiaNoOfProcessedStockInFiles + @varGSKNoOfProcessedStockInFiles AS [Stock In], 
				@varDanoneNoOfProcessedStockOutFiles + @varGlanbiaNoOfProcessedStockOutFiles + @varGSKNoOfProcessedStockOutFiles AS [Stock Out],
					@varDanoneNoOfProcessedStockInFiles + @varDanoneNoOfProcessedStockOutFiles + @varGlanbiaNoOfProcessedStockInFiles + @varGlanbiaNoOfProcessedStockOutFiles + @varGSKNoOfProcessedStockInFiles + @varGSKNoOfProcessedStockOutFiles AS [Total Files], 
						@varTotalStoreAllPercentageIssues AS [Store-All % Issues], @varTotalCustomerPercentageIssues AS [Customer % Issues]--, CAST(1 AS BIT) AS TotalsRow
	END

				)
			)

		INSERT INTO #issuesTotals(IssueType, Category, NoOfTickets)

				)

				)
			)

				OR

					t1.MostRecentStatusWithinDateRange = '' AND t1.CurrentStatusName IN ('To Do')
				)
			)

		SELECT 'Hardware', 'Under investigation', COUNT(DISTINCT t1.JiraTicketDetailPK) AS NoOfTicketsResolved

		(
			OverallSummaryYTDJiraTicketsPK INT IDENTITY(1,1) PRIMARY KEY,

			#resultsJiraTicketDetails t1

		FROM 
			#resultsJiraTicketDetails t1

		FROM 
			#resultsJiraTicketDetails t1

		UPDATE t1
		SET 
			NoOfTicketsWithCustomer = (SELECT TOP 1 NoOfTickets FROM #issuesTotals t2 WHERE t2.IssueType = t1.Category AND t2.Category = 'With Customer')
		FROM 
			#resultsJiraTicketDetails t1

		UPDATE t1
		SET 
			NoOfTicketsWithVendor = (SELECT TOP 1 NoOfTickets FROM #issuesTotals t2 WHERE t2.IssueType = t1.Category AND t2.Category = 'With Vendor')
		FROM 
			#resultsJiraTicketDetails t1

		UPDATE t1
		SET 
			NoOfTicketsOther = (SELECT TOP 1 NoOfTickets FROM #issuesTotals t2 WHERE t2.IssueType = t1.Category AND t2.Category = 'Other')
		FROM 
			#resultsJiraTicketDetails t1

		DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #finalResultsJiraTicketDetails

		SELECT
			OverallSummaryYTDJiraTicketsPK, Category, NoOfTicketsCreated, NoOfTicketsResolved, NoOfTicketsOpen, NoOfTicketsToDo, NoOfTicketsUnderInvestigation, NoOfTicketsWithCustomer, NoOfTicketsWithVendor, NoOfTicketsOther, TotalsRow
		INTO
			#finalResultsJiraTicketDetails
		FROM 
			#resultsJiraTicketDetails
		UNION
		SELECT
			9999 AS OverallSummaryYTDJiraTicketsPK, 
			'Total' AS Category, 
			SUM(ISNULL(NoOfTicketsCreated,0)), 
			SUM(ISNULL(NoOfTicketsResolved,0)), 
			SUM(ISNULL(NoOfTicketsOpen,0)),
			SUM(ISNULL(NoOfTicketsToDo,0)),
			SUM(ISNULL(NoOfTicketsUnderInvestigation,0)),
			SUM(ISNULL(NoOfTicketsWithCustomer,0)),
			SUM(ISNULL(NoOfTicketsWithVendor,0)),
			SUM(ISNULL(NoOfTicketsOther,0)),
			CAST(1 AS BIT) AS TotalsRow
		FROM 
			#resultsJiraTicketDetails	
		
		SELECT 
			Category, NoOfTicketsCreated AS Created, NoOfTicketsOpen AS [Open], NoOfTicketsResolved AS Resolved, NoOfTicketsToDo AS [To Do], NoOfTicketsUnderInvestigation AS [Under Investigation], NoOfTicketsWithCustomer AS [With Customer], 
			NoOfTicketsWithVendor AS [With Vendor], NoOfTicketsOther AS Other--, TotalsRow
		FROM
			#finalResultsJiraTicketDetails
		ORDER
			BY OverallSummaryYTDJiraTicketsPK ASC
	END
ec:

END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spUptimeLogsGetReportDetailsForBuildingAndDate] -- [dbo].[spUptimeLogsGetReportDetailsForBuildingAndDate] @buildingFK = 1, @uptimeLogDate = '20191204', @userFK = 287
(
--declare
	@buildingFK	INT,
	@uptimeLogDate DATE,
	@userFK INT  

	--select @buildingFK = 21, @uptimeLogDate = '20191204', @userFK = 287
)
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ UNCOMMITTED; SET DEADLOCK_PRIORITY LOW

	DECLARE
		@varBuildingFK INT = @buildingFK, @varUptimeLogDate DATE = @uptimeLogDate, @varUserFK INT = @userFK, @varUptimeLogsDetailPK INT, @varUptimeLogsCategoryFK INT,
		@varBuildingName NVARCHAR(50)

	SELECT 
		@varUptimeLogDate =	CASE 
								WHEN LEFT(DATENAME(dw, @varUptimeLogDate), 3) = 'Tue' THEN DATEADD(DAY, -1, @varUptimeLogDate)
								WHEN LEFT(DATENAME(dw, @varUptimeLogDate), 3) = 'Wed' THEN DATEADD(DAY, -2, @varUptimeLogDate)
								WHEN LEFT(DATENAME(dw, @varUptimeLogDate), 3) = 'Thu' THEN DATEADD(DAY, -3, @varUptimeLogDate)
								WHEN LEFT(DATENAME(dw, @varUptimeLogDate), 3) = 'Fri' THEN DATEADD(DAY, -4, @varUptimeLogDate)
								WHEN LEFT(DATENAME(dw, @varUptimeLogDate), 3) = 'Sat' THEN DATEADD(DAY, -5, @varUptimeLogDate)
								WHEN LEFT(DATENAME(dw, @varUptimeLogDate), 3) = 'Sun' THEN DATEADD(DAY, -6, @varUptimeLogDate)
							ELSE
								@varUptimeLogDate
							END

	SELECT @varBuildingName = CASE WHEN ISNULL(DepartmentTMS, '') <> '' THEN DepartmentTMS ELSE BuildingName END
	FROM dbo.tblBuildings WITH (NOLOCK) 
	WHERE BuildingPK = @buildingFK

	IF ISNULL(@varBuildingName, '') = '' AND @buildingFK = 1 SET @varBuildingName = 'Transport'
	ELSE IF ISNULL(@varBuildingName, '') = '' AND @buildingFK = 9999 SET @varBuildingName = 'Quality'		

	DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #UptimeLogsDetails

GET_PK:

	SELECT TOP 1 @varUptimeLogsDetailPK = UptimeLogsDetailPK 
	FROM dbo.tblUptimeLogsDetails uld WITH (NOLOCK) 
	WHERE uld.BuildingFK = @varBuildingFK	
	AND uld.UptimeLogDate = @varUptimeLogDate

	-- Create the main/parent record if one does not exist.
	IF ISNULL(@varUptimeLogsDetailPK, -1) < 1
	BEGIN
		EXEC dbo.spUptimeLogsAddEditDetailsRecord @buildingFK = @varBuildingFK, @uptimeLogDate = @varUptimeLogDate, @userFK = @varUserFK, @isAddingNewRecord = 1
		GOTO GET_PK
	END

	-- Create the UptimeLogsCriticalServices record if one does not exist.
	IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.tblUptimeLogsCriticalServices uldh WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE uldh.UptimeLogsDetailFK = @varUptimeLogsDetailPK) --AND @varBuildingName = 'BV1'
	BEGIN
		DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #uptimeLogsCriticalServicesCategories

		SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY ultc.CategoryScreenOrder ASC) AS RowNumber, 
		ultc.UptimeLogsCategoryFK
		INTO #uptimeLogsCriticalServicesCategories
		FROM dbo.tblUptimeLogsBuildingCategories ultc WITH (NOLOCK)
		INNER JOIN dbo.appUptimeLogsTables ult WITH (NOLOCK)
		ON ultc.UptimeLogsTableFK = ult.UptimeLogsTablePK
		WHERE ult.UptimeLogsTableName = 'tblUptimeLogsCriticalServices'
		AND ultc.BuildingFK = @varBuildingFK

START_CriticalServices_LOOP:

		IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #uptimeLogsCriticalServicesCategories) GOTO EXIT_CriticalServices_LOOP

		SELECT TOP 1 @varUptimeLogsCategoryFK = UptimeLogsCategoryFK from #uptimeLogsCriticalServicesCategories ORDER BY RowNumber ASC
	
		DELETE FROM #uptimeLogsCriticalServicesCategories WHERE UptimeLogsCategoryFK = @varUptimeLogsCategoryFK

		EXEC dbo.spUptimeLogsAddEditCriticalServicesRecord @uptimeLogsDetailFK = @varUptimeLogsDetailPK, @uptimeLogsCategoryFK = @varUptimeLogsCategoryFK, 
																@mondayHours = NULL, @tuesdayHours = NULL, @wednesdayHours = NULL, @thursdayHours = NULL, @fridayHours = NULL, 
																	@saturdayHours = NULL, @sundayHours = NULL, @userFK = @varUserFK, @isAddingNewRecord = 1
		GOTO START_CriticalServices_LOOP

EXIT_CriticalServices_LOOP:

	END	

	-- Create the UptimeLogsHardware record if one does not exist.
	IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.tblUptimeLogsHardware tulh WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE tulh.UptimeLogsDetailFK = @varUptimeLogsDetailPK) --AND @varBuildingName = 'BV1'
	BEGIN		
		DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #UptimeLogsHardwareCategories

		SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY ultc.CategoryScreenOrder ASC) AS RowNumber, 
		ultc.UptimeLogsCategoryFK
		INTO #UptimeLogsHardwareCategories
		FROM dbo.tblUptimeLogsBuildingCategories ultc WITH (NOLOCK)
		INNER JOIN dbo.appUptimeLogsTables ult WITH (NOLOCK)
		ON ultc.UptimeLogsTableFK = ult.UptimeLogsTablePK
		WHERE ult.UptimeLogsTableName = 'tblUptimeLogsHardware'
		AND ultc.BuildingFK = @varBuildingFK

START_HARDWARE_LOOP:

		IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #UptimeLogsHardwareCategories) GOTO EXIT_CriticalServices_LOOP

		SELECT TOP 1 @varUptimeLogsCategoryFK = UptimeLogsCategoryFK from #UptimeLogsHardwareCategories ORDER BY RowNumber ASC
	
		DELETE FROM #UptimeLogsHardwareCategories WHERE UptimeLogsCategoryFK = @varUptimeLogsCategoryFK

		DECLARE @varNoInWarehouse INT = 0, @varMinRequiredInWarehouse INT = 0

		SELECT TOP 1 
		@varNoInWarehouse = t2.NoInWarehouse, 
		@varMinRequiredInWarehouse = t2.MinRequiredInWarehouse 
		FROM dbo.tblUptimeLogsBuildingCategories t1 WITH (NOLOCK) 
		INNER JOIN dbo.tblUptimeLogsDefaultValues t2
		on t1.BuildingFK = t2.BuildingFK
		AND t1.UptimeLogsCategoryFK = t2.UptimeLogsCategoryFK
		WHERE t1.BuildingFK = @varBuildingFK 
		AND t1.UptimeLogsCategoryFK = @varUptimeLogsCategoryFK

		SELECT @varNoInWarehouse = ISNULL(@varNoInWarehouse, 0)
		SELECT @varMinRequiredInWarehouse = ISNULL(@varMinRequiredInWarehouse, 0)

		EXEC dbo.spUptimeLogsAddEditHardwareRecord @uptimeLogsDetailFK = @varUptimeLogsDetailPK, @uptimeLogsCategoryFK = @varUptimeLogsCategoryFK, 
																				@noInWarehouse = @varNoInWarehouse,@minRequiredInWarehouse = @varMinRequiredInWarehouse, @noInWarehouseOnMonday = 0,	
																					@noInWarehouseOnTuesday = 0, @noInWarehouseOnWednesday = 0, @noInWarehouseOnThursday = 0,
																						@noInWarehouseOnFriday = 0, @noInWarehouseOnSaturday = 0, @noInWarehouseOnSunday = 0,	
																							@userFK = @varUserFK, @isAddingNewRecord = 1

		GOTO START_HARDWARE_LOOP

EXIT_HARDWARE_LOOP:

	END

	-- Create the UptimeLogsJiraTickets record if one does not exist.
	IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.tblUptimeLogsJiraTickets uljt WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE uljt.UptimeLogsDetailFK = @varUptimeLogsDetailPK) --AND @varBuildingName = 'BV1'
	BEGIN		
		DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #uptimeLogsJiraTicketsCategories

		SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY ultc.CategoryScreenOrder ASC) AS RowNumber, 
		ultc.UptimeLogsCategoryFK
		INTO #uptimeLogsJiraTicketsCategories
		FROM dbo.tblUptimeLogsBuildingCategories ultc WITH (NOLOCK)
		INNER JOIN dbo.appUptimeLogsTables ult WITH (NOLOCK)
		ON ultc.UptimeLogsTableFK = ult.UptimeLogsTablePK
		WHERE ult.UptimeLogsTableName = 'tblUptimeLogsJiraTickets'
		AND ultc.BuildingFK = @varBuildingFK

START_JIRATICKETS_LOOP:

		IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #uptimeLogsJiraTicketsCategories) GOTO EXIT_JIRATICKETS_LOOP

		SELECT TOP 1 @varUptimeLogsCategoryFK = UptimeLogsCategoryFK from #uptimeLogsJiraTicketsCategories ORDER BY RowNumber ASC
	
		DELETE FROM #uptimeLogsJiraTicketsCategories WHERE UptimeLogsCategoryFK = @varUptimeLogsCategoryFK

		EXEC dbo.spUptimeLogsAddEditJiraTicketsRecord @uptimeLogsDetailFK = @varUptimeLogsDetailPK, @uptimeLogsCategoryFK = @varUptimeLogsCategoryFK, 
														@noOfTicketsCreated = 0, @noOfTicketsResolved = 0, @noOfTicketsOngoingOpen = 0,	@noOfTicketsWaitingOnCustomer = 0, 
															@noOfTicketsWaitingOnVendor = 0, @other = 0, @userFK = @varUserFK, @isAddingNewRecord = 1

		GOTO START_JIRATICKETS_LOOP

EXIT_JIRATICKETS_LOOP:

	END

	-- Create the UptimeLogsIntegrationFiles record if one does not exist.
	IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.tblUptimeLogsIntegrationFiles ulf WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE ulf.UptimeLogsDetailFK = @varUptimeLogsDetailPK) --AND @varBuildingName = 'BV1'
	BEGIN
		DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #uptimeLogsIntegrationFilesCategories

		SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY ultc.CategoryScreenOrder ASC) AS RowNumber, 
		ultc.UptimeLogsCategoryFK
		INTO #uptimeLogsIntegrationFilesCategories
		FROM dbo.tblUptimeLogsBuildingCategories ultc WITH (NOLOCK)
		INNER JOIN dbo.appUptimeLogsTables ult WITH (NOLOCK)
		ON ultc.UptimeLogsTableFK = ult.UptimeLogsTablePK
		WHERE ult.UptimeLogsTableName = 'tblUptimeLogsIntegrationFiles'
		AND ultc.BuildingFK = @varBuildingFK

START_INTEGRATIONFILES_LOOP:

		IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #uptimeLogsIntegrationFilesCategories) GOTO EXIT_INTEGRATIONFILES_LOOP

		SELECT TOP 1 @varUptimeLogsCategoryFK = UptimeLogsCategoryFK from #uptimeLogsIntegrationFilesCategories ORDER BY RowNumber ASC

		DELETE FROM #uptimeLogsIntegrationFilesCategories WHERE UptimeLogsCategoryFK = @varUptimeLogsCategoryFK

		EXEC dbo.spUptimeLogsAddEditIntegrationFilesRecord @uptimeLogsDetailFK = @varUptimeLogsDetailPK, @uptimeLogsCategoryFK = @varUptimeLogsCategoryFK, @noOfStoreAllIssues = 0,
															@noOfCustomerIssues = 0, @noOfFilesIn = 0, @noOfFilesOut = 0, @stockInEmailsTotal = 0,
																@userFK = @varUserFK, @isAddingNewRecord = 1

		GOTO START_INTEGRATIONFILES_LOOP

EXIT_INTEGRATIONFILES_LOOP:

	END	

	-- Create the UptimeLogsPhysicalChecks record if one does not exist.
	IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.tblUptimeLogsPhysicalChecks ulpc WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE ulpc.UptimeLogsDetailFK = @varUptimeLogsDetailPK) --AND @varBuildingName = 'BV1'
	BEGIN
		DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #uptimeLogsPhysicalChecksCategories

		SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY ultc.CategoryScreenOrder ASC) AS RowNumber, 
		ultc.UptimeLogsCategoryFK
		INTO #uptimeLogsPhysicalChecksCategories
		FROM dbo.tblUptimeLogsBuildingCategories ultc WITH (NOLOCK)
		INNER JOIN dbo.appUptimeLogsTables ult WITH (NOLOCK)
		ON ultc.UptimeLogsTableFK = ult.UptimeLogsTablePK
		WHERE ult.UptimeLogsTableName = 'tblUptimeLogsPhysicalChecks'
		AND ultc.BuildingFK = @varBuildingFK

START_PHYSICALCHECKS_LOOP:

		IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #uptimeLogsPhysicalChecksCategories) GOTO EXIT_PHYSICALCHECKS_LOOP

		SELECT TOP 1 @varUptimeLogsCategoryFK = UptimeLogsCategoryFK from #uptimeLogsPhysicalChecksCategories ORDER BY RowNumber ASC

		DELETE FROM #uptimeLogsPhysicalChecksCategories WHERE UptimeLogsCategoryFK = @varUptimeLogsCategoryFK

		EXEC dbo.spUptimeLogsAddEditPhysicalChecksRecord @uptimeLogsDetailFK = @varUptimeLogsDetailPK, @uptimeLogsCategoryFK = @varUptimeLogsCategoryFK, 
			@noOfPalletsAccepted = 0, @noOfPalletsRejected = 0, @noOfPalletsDispatched = 0, @userFK = @varUserFK, @isAddingNewRecord = 1

		GOTO START_PHYSICALCHECKS_LOOP

EXIT_PHYSICALCHECKS_LOOP:

	END	

	-- 1. 

	SELECT 'Data for week no. ' + CAST(DATEPART(wk, @varUptimeLogDate) AS NVARCHAR(2)) + ' (' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), @varUptimeLogDate, 105) + ' to ' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), DATEADD(DAY, 6, @varUptimeLogDate), 105) + ')' AS [DataForWeek],
	CAST(DATEPART(YEAR, @varUptimeLogDate) AS NVARCHAR(4)) + 'WeekNo' + CAST(DATEPART(wk, @varUptimeLogDate) AS NVARCHAR(2)) AS [YearDataForWeek],
	@varBuildingName as BuildingName

	-- 2. Return the UptimeLogsCriticalServices record details.

	DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #UptimeLogsCriticalServices

	SELECT DISTINCT
		uldh.UptimeLogsCriticalServicePK,
		uldh.UptimeLogsDetailFK,
		uldh.UptimeLogsCategoryFK,
		ulc_uldh.UptimeLogsCategory,
		ultc.CategoryScreenOrder,

		CAST(uldh.MondayHours AS NVARCHAR(5)) AS MondayHours,
		CAST(uldh.TuesdayHours AS NVARCHAR(5)) AS TuesdayHours,
		CAST(uldh.WednesdayHours AS NVARCHAR(5)) AS WednesdayHours,
		CAST(uldh.ThursdayHours AS NVARCHAR(5)) AS ThursdayHours,
		CAST(uldh.FridayHours AS NVARCHAR(5)) AS FridayHours,
		CAST(uldh.SaturdayHours AS NVARCHAR(5)) AS SaturdayHours,
		CAST(uldh.SundayHours AS NVARCHAR(5)) AS SundayHours,

		dbo.fnGetHoursAndMinutesTimeFormatForMinutes(
														dbo.fnGetTimeInMinutes(uldh.MondayHours) + dbo.fnGetTimeInMinutes(uldh.TuesdayHours) + dbo.fnGetTimeInMinutes(uldh.WednesdayHours) 
															+ dbo.fnGetTimeInMinutes(uldh.ThursdayHours) + dbo.fnGetTimeInMinutes(uldh.FridayHours) + dbo.fnGetTimeInMinutes(uldh.SaturdayHours) 
																+ dbo.fnGetTimeInMinutes(uldh.SundayHours)
													) AS TotalHours
	INTO
		#UptimeLogsCriticalServices
	FROM
		dbo.tblUptimeLogsCriticalServices uldh WITH (NOLOCK)
	INNER JOIN dbo.tblUptimeLogsBuildingCategories ultc WITH (NOLOCK)
		ON uldh.UptimeLogsCategoryFK = ultc.UptimeLogsCategoryFK		
	INNER JOIN dbo.appUptimeLogsTables ult WITH (NOLOCK)
		ON ultc.UptimeLogsTableFK = ult.UptimeLogsTablePK
	INNER JOIN dbo.appUptimeLogsCategories ulc_uldh WITH (NOLOCK)
		ON ultc.UptimeLogsCategoryFK = ulc_uldh.UptimeLogsCategoryPK
	WHERE
		uldh.UptimeLogsDetailFK = @varUptimeLogsDetailPK
		AND ult.UptimeLogsTableName = 'tblUptimeLogsCriticalServices'
		AND ultc.BuildingFK = @varBuildingFK

	SELECT
		UptimeLogsCategory AS Category,
		MondayHours AS [MonHrs],
		TuesdayHours AS [TueHrs],
		WednesdayHours AS [WedHrs],
		ThursdayHours AS [ThuHrs],
		FridayHours AS [FriHrs],
		SaturdayHours AS [SatHrs],
		SundayHours AS [SunHrs],
		TotalHours AS [TotHrs],
		CASE 
			WHEN TotalHours = '00:00' THEN '100'
		ELSE
			CAST(CAST(ROUND(100.00 - ((CAST(dbo.fnGetTimeInMinutes(TotalHours) AS DECIMAL(15, 2)) / 10080/*No. of minutes in a 7 day week*/) * 100.00), 2) AS DECIMAL(15,2)) AS VARCHAR(50)) 
		END + '%' AS [%Uptime] 
	FROM
		#UptimeLogsCriticalServices
	ORDER BY
		UptimeLogsCriticalServicePK ASC,
		CategoryScreenOrder ASC

	-- 3. Return the UptimeLogsHardware record details.

	DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #UptimeLogsHardware

	SELECT DISTINCT
		ulh.UptimeLogsHardwarePK,
		ulh.UptimeLogsDetailFK,
		ulh.UptimeLogsCategoryFK,
		ulc_ulh.UptimeLogsCategory,
		ultc.CategoryScreenOrder,
		ulh.NoInWarehouse,
		ulh.MinRequiredInWarehouse,
		ulh.NoInWarehouseOnMonday,
		ulh.NoInWarehouseOnTuesday,
		ulh.NoInWarehouseOnWednesday,
		ulh.NoInWarehouseOnThursday,
		ulh.NoInWarehouseOnFriday,
		ulh.NoInWarehouseOnSaturday,
		ulh.NoInWarehouseOnSunday,

		CASE
			WHEN MinRequiredInWarehouse < 1 THEN 
				'0.00'
			ELSE
				CAST(CAST((CAST((ulh.NoInWarehouseOnMonday + 
				ulh.NoInWarehouseOnTuesday + 
				ulh.NoInWarehouseOnWednesday + 
				ulh.NoInWarehouseOnThursday + 
				ulh.NoInWarehouseOnFriday + 
				ulh.NoInWarehouseOnSaturday + 
				ulh.NoInWarehouseOnSunday) AS DECIMAL(18,2)) / 7.00) / CAST(ulh.MinRequiredInWarehouse AS DECIMAL(18,2)) * 100.00 AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS NVARCHAR(50))
		END + '%' AS PercentageMinimumAvailable
	INTO
		#UptimeLogsHardware
	FROM 
		dbo.tblUptimeLogsHardware ulh WITH (NOLOCK)
	INNER JOIN dbo.tblUptimeLogsBuildingCategories ultc WITH (NOLOCK)
		ON ulh.UptimeLogsCategoryFK = ultc.UptimeLogsCategoryFK		
	INNER JOIN dbo.appUptimeLogsTables ult WITH (NOLOCK)
		ON ultc.UptimeLogsTableFK = ult.UptimeLogsTablePK
	INNER JOIN dbo.appUptimeLogsCategories ulc_ulh WITH (NOLOCK)
		ON ultc.UptimeLogsCategoryFK = ulc_ulh.UptimeLogsCategoryPK
	WHERE
		ulh.UptimeLogsDetailFK = @varUptimeLogsDetailPK
		AND ult.UptimeLogsTableName = 'tblUptimeLogsHardware'
		AND ultc.BuildingFK = @varBuildingFK

	SELECT
		UptimeLogsCategory AS Category,
		NoInWarehouse AS [#InWarehse],
		MinRequiredInWarehouse AS [MinNeededInWarehse],
		NoInWarehouseOnMonday AS [#Mon],
		NoInWarehouseOnTuesday AS [#Tue],
		NoInWarehouseOnWednesday AS [#Wed],
		NoInWarehouseOnThursday AS [#Thu],
		NoInWarehouseOnFriday AS [#Fri],
		NoInWarehouseOnSaturday AS [#Sat],
		NoInWarehouseOnSunday AS [#Sun],
		CASE
			WHEN MinRequiredInWarehouse < 1 THEN 
				'0.00'
			ELSE
				CAST(CAST((CAST((NoInWarehouseOnMonday + 
				NoInWarehouseOnTuesday + 
				NoInWarehouseOnWednesday + 
				NoInWarehouseOnThursday + 
				NoInWarehouseOnFriday + 
				NoInWarehouseOnSaturday + 
				NoInWarehouseOnSunday) AS DECIMAL(18,2)) / 7.00) / CAST(MinRequiredInWarehouse AS DECIMAL(18,2)) * 100.00 AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS NVARCHAR(50))
		END + '%' AS [%MinAvail]
	FROM
		#UptimeLogsHardware
	ORDER BY 
		UptimeLogsHardwarePK ASC,
		CategoryScreenOrder ASC

	-- 4. Return the UptimeLogsJiraTickets record details.

	DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #UptimeLogsJiraTickets

	SELECT DISTINCT
		uljt.UptimeLogsJiraTicketPK,
		uljt.UptimeLogsDetailFK,
		uljt.UptimeLogsCategoryFK,
		ulc_uljt.UptimeLogsCategory,
		ultc.CategoryScreenOrder,
		uljt.NoOfTicketsCreated,
		uljt.NoOfTicketsResolved,
		uljt.NoOfTicketsOngoingOpen,
		uljt.NoOfTicketsWaitingOnCustomer,
		uljt.NoOfTicketsWaitingOnVendor,
		uljt.Other
	INTO
		#UptimeLogsJiraTickets
	FROM
		dbo.tblUptimeLogsJiraTickets uljt WITH (NOLOCK)
	INNER JOIN dbo.tblUptimeLogsBuildingCategories ultc WITH (NOLOCK)
		ON uljt.UptimeLogsCategoryFK = ultc.UptimeLogsCategoryFK		
	INNER JOIN dbo.appUptimeLogsTables ult WITH (NOLOCK)
		ON ultc.UptimeLogsTableFK = ult.UptimeLogsTablePK
	INNER JOIN dbo.appUptimeLogsCategories ulc_uljt WITH (NOLOCK)
		ON ultc.UptimeLogsCategoryFK = ulc_uljt.UptimeLogsCategoryPK
	WHERE
		uljt.UptimeLogsDetailFK = @varUptimeLogsDetailPK
		AND ult.UptimeLogsTableName = 'tblUptimeLogsJiraTickets'
		AND ultc.BuildingFK = @varBuildingFK

	SELECT
		UptimeLogsCategory AS Category,
		NoOfTicketsCreated AS [#TktsCreated],
		NoOfTicketsResolved AS [#TktsResolved],
		NoOfTicketsOngoingOpen AS [#TktsOngoingOpen],
		NoOfTicketsWaitingOnCustomer AS [#TktsWaitOnCust],
		NoOfTicketsWaitingOnVendor AS [#TktsWaitOnVend],
		Other
	FROM
		#UptimeLogsJiraTickets
	ORDER BY
		UptimeLogsJiraTicketPK ASC,
		CategoryScreenOrder ASC

	-- 5. Return the UptimeLogsIntegrationFiles record details.

	DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #uptimeLogsIntegrationFiles

	SELECT TOP 1
		ulf.UptimeLogsIntegrationFilePK, ulf.UptimeLogsDetailFK, ulf.UptimeLogsCategoryFK, ulc_ulf.UptimeLogsCategory, ultc.CategoryScreenOrder,
		ulf.NoOfStoreAllIssues, ulf.NoOfCustomerIssues, ulf.NoOfFilesIn, ulf.NoOfFilesOut,
		(ulf.NoOfFilesIn + ulf.NoOfFilesOut) AS TotalNoOfFilesInOut,


		CASE
			WHEN @varBuildingName = 'BV2' THEN

				(CASE 
					WHEN ulf.StockInEmailsTotal < 1 THEN 
						0.00
				ELSE 
					CAST(ROUND(CAST(ulf.NoOfStoreAllIssues AS DECIMAL(18, 2)) / (ulf.StockInEmailsTotal) * 100.00, 2) AS DECIMAL(18, 2))
				END)

			WHEN @varBuildingName <> 'BV2' THEN

				(CASE 
					WHEN ulf.NoOfFilesIn < 1 THEN 
						0.00
				ELSE 
					CAST(ROUND(CAST(ulf.NoOfStoreAllIssues AS DECIMAL(18, 2)) / (ulf.NoOfFilesIn + ulf.NoOfFilesOut) * 100.00, 2) AS DECIMAL(18, 2))
				END)
		END AS AutoCalcStoreAllPercentOfIssues,

		CASE
			WHEN @varBuildingName = 'BV2' THEN

				(CASE 
					WHEN ISNULL(ulf.StockInEmailsTotal, 0) < 1 THEN 
						0.00
					ELSE 
						CAST(ROUND(CAST(ulf.NoOfCustomerIssues AS DECIMAL(18, 2)) / (ulf.StockInEmailsTotal) * 100.00, 2) AS DECIMAL(18, 2))
				END)

			WHEN @varBuildingName <> 'BV2' THEN

				(CASE 
					WHEN ISNULL(ulf.NoOfFilesIn, 0) < 1 THEN 
						0.00
					ELSE 
						CAST(ROUND(CAST(ulf.NoOfCustomerIssues AS DECIMAL(18, 2)) / (ulf.NoOfFilesIn + ulf.NoOfFilesOut) * 100.00, 2) AS DECIMAL(18, 2))
				END)
		END AS AutoCalcCustomerPercentOfIssues,

		StockInEmailsTotal
	INTO
		#uptimeLogsIntegrationFiles
	FROM
		dbo.tblUptimeLogsIntegrationFiles ulf WITH (NOLOCK)		
	INNER JOIN dbo.tblUptimeLogsBuildingCategories ultc WITH (NOLOCK)
		ON ulf.UptimeLogsCategoryFK = ultc.UptimeLogsCategoryFK		
	INNER JOIN dbo.appUptimeLogsTables ult WITH (NOLOCK)
		ON ultc.UptimeLogsTableFK = ult.UptimeLogsTablePK
	INNER JOIN dbo.appUptimeLogsCategories ulc_ulf WITH (NOLOCK)
		ON ultc.UptimeLogsCategoryFK = ulc_ulf.UptimeLogsCategoryPK
	WHERE
		ulf.UptimeLogsDetailFK = @varUptimeLogsDetailPK
		AND ult.UptimeLogsTableName = 'tblUptimeLogsIntegrationFiles'
		AND ultc.BuildingFK = @varBuildingFK

	SELECT 
		UptimeLogsCategory AS Category, 
		NoOfStoreAllIssues AS [#StoreAllIssues], 
		NoOfCustomerIssues AS [#CustomerIssues], 
		NoOfFilesIn AS [#FilesIn], 
		NoOfFilesOut AS [#FilesOut], 
		TotalNoOfFilesInOut AS [#FilesInOut],
		CAST(AutoCalcStoreAllPercentOfIssues AS NVARCHAR(50)) + '%' AS [StoreAll%Issues],
		CAST(AutoCalcCustomerPercentOfIssues AS NVARCHAR(50)) + '%' AS [Customer%Issues],
		CAST((AutoCalcStoreAllPercentOfIssues + AutoCalcCustomerPercentOfIssues) AS NVARCHAR(50)) + '%' AS [Total%Issues],			
		StockInEmailsTotal
	FROM
		#uptimeLogsIntegrationFiles

	-- 6. Return the UptimeLogsPhysicalChecks record details.

	SELECT TOP 1
		ulc_ulpc.UptimeLogsCategory AS Category,
		ulpc.NoOfPalletsAccepted AS [#PalletsAccepted],
		ulpc.NoOfPalletsRejected AS [#PalletsRejected],
		ulpc.NoOfPalletsDispatched AS [#PalletsDispatched]	 
	FROM
		dbo.tblUptimeLogsPhysicalChecks ulpc WITH (NOLOCK)		
	INNER JOIN dbo.tblUptimeLogsBuildingCategories ultc WITH (NOLOCK)
		ON ulpc.UptimeLogsCategoryFK = ultc.UptimeLogsCategoryFK		
	INNER JOIN dbo.appUptimeLogsTables ult WITH (NOLOCK)
		ON ultc.UptimeLogsTableFK = ult.UptimeLogsTablePK
	INNER JOIN dbo.appUptimeLogsCategories ulc_ulpc WITH (NOLOCK)
		ON ultc.UptimeLogsCategoryFK = ulc_ulpc.UptimeLogsCategoryPK
	WHERE
		ulpc.UptimeLogsDetailFK = @varUptimeLogsDetailPK
		AND ult.UptimeLogsTableName = 'tblUptimeLogsPhysicalChecks'
		AND ultc.BuildingFK = @varBuildingFK
END
--ec:
GO

-- ================================================================
-- Author:      Cathal OCuirrin
-- Create Date: 20 Mar 2020
-- Description: Used to supply data to the Uptime Logs YTD screen.
-- ================================================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spUptimeLogsGetReportYTDDetailsForITBuilding] -- [dbo].[spUptimeLogsGetReportYTDDetailsForITBuilding] @year = 2020
(
--declare
	@year INT

	--select @year = 2020
)
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ UNCOMMITTED; SET DEADLOCK_PRIORITY LOW

	DECLARE
		@varBuildingFK INT = 8888, @varBuildingName NVARCHAR(50) = 'IT', @varCurrentDate DATE = (SELECT dbo.GetBSTDate()), @varDataStartWeekNumber INT, @varDataStartDate DATE, @varDataEndWeekNumber INT, @varDataEndDate DATE, @varNoOfWeeksOfData INT,
		@varYear INT = ISNULL(@year, -1)

	DECLARE
		@varUptimeLogsCategoryFK INT, @varDanoneNoOfProcessedStockInFiles INT, @varDanoneNoOfProcessedStockOutFiles INT, @varDanoneTotalNoOfProcessedFiles INT,
		@varGlanbiaNoOfProcessedStockInFiles INT, @varGlanbiaNoOfProcessedStockOutFiles INT, @varGlanbiaTotalNoOfProcessedFiles INT,
		@varGSKNoOfProcessedStockInFiles INT, @varGSKNoOfProcessedStockOutFiles INT, @varGSKTotalNoOfProcessedFiles INT

	SET @varCurrentDate = dbo.GetBSTDate()

	SET @varDataEndDate = @varCurrentDate

	-- @varYear = year of selected work date on the Uptime Logs screen.
	-- If @varYear doesn't match the year of the current date work out the last week in selected year. 
	IF @varYear > 0 AND YEAR(@varDataEndDate) <> @varYear 
	BEGIN
		SET @varDataEndDate = CAST(@varYear + 1 AS NVARCHAR(4)) + '-01-01'

		WHILE DATEPART(wk, @varDataEndDate) <> 52 SET @varDataEndDate = DATEADD(WEEK, -1, @varDataEndDate)
	END

	-- Ensure the end date is a Monday.
	WHILE DATENAME(dw, @varDataEndDate) <> 'Monday' SET @varDataEndDate = DATEADD(DAY, -1, @varDataEndDate)

	-- 53 equals week 1 of the next year so need to subtract a week to get week 52 of the selected year.
	IF DATEPART(wk, @varDataEndDate) = 53 SET @varDataEndDate = DATEADD(WEEK, -1, @varDataEndDate)

	SELECT @varDataEndWeekNumber = DATEPART(wk, @varDataEndDate)

	-- Make start date a year less than the end date.
	SET @varDataStartDate = DATEADD(YEAR, -1, @varDataEndDate)

	-- Ensure the start date is a Monday.
	WHILE DATENAME(dw, @varDataStartDate) <> 'Monday' SET @varDataStartDate = DATEADD(DAY, -1, @varDataStartDate)

	-- Keep adding a week to start date until after week 52 (week 53 could be after 52 as well as week 1).
	WHILE DATEPART(wk, @varDataStartDate) NOT IN (1, 53)  SET @varDataStartDate = DATEADD(WEEK, 1, @varDataStartDate)

	SELECT @varDataStartWeekNumber = DATEPART(wk, @varDataStartDate)

	-- 53 equals week 1.
	SELECT @varDataStartWeekNumber = CASE WHEN @varDataStartWeekNumber = 53 THEN 1 ELSE @varDataStartWeekNumber END

	SELECT @varDataStartDate = MIN(UptimeLogDate) from tblUptimeLogsDetails WHERE UptimeLogDate >= @varDataStartDate AND UptimeLogDate <= @varDataEndDate AND IsArchived = 1 /*Confirmed data only*/

	IF @varDataStartDate IS NOT NULL
	BEGIN
		SELECT @varDataStartWeekNumber = CASE WHEN DATEPART(wk, @varDataStartDate) = 53 THEN 1 ELSE DATEPART(wk, @varDataStartDate) END

		SELECT @varDataEndDate = MAX(UptimeLogDate) from tblUptimeLogsDetails WHERE UptimeLogDate >= @varDataStartDate AND UptimeLogDate <= @varDataEndDate AND IsArchived = 1 /*Confirmed data only*/

		SELECT @varDataEndWeekNumber = DATEPART(wk, @varDataEndDate)

		SET @varDataEndDate = DATEADD(DAY, 6, @varDataEndDate)
	END
	ELSE 
	BEGIN
		SET @varDataStartWeekNumber = NULL
		SET @varDataEndDate = NULL	
		SET @varDataEndWeekNumber = NULL
	END

	SELECT @varDataEndWeekNumber = CASE WHEN @varDataEndWeekNumber = 53 THEN 1 ELSE @varDataEndWeekNumber END

	SELECT @varNoOfWeeksOfData = (@varDataEndWeekNumber - @varDataStartWeekNumber) + 1

	DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #uptimeLogsDetails

	SELECT DISTINCT UptimeLogsDetailPK, uld.UptimeLogDate
	INTO #uptimeLogsDetails
	FROM dbo.tblUptimeLogsDetails uld WITH (NOLOCK) 
	WHERE uld.BuildingFK = @varBuildingFK	
	AND uld.UptimeLogDate <= @varDataEndDate
	AND uld.UptimeLogDate >= @varDataStartDate
	AND uld.IsArchived = 1 /*Confirmed data only*/

	-- 1. Get the week number details.
	
	DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #results1

	CREATE TABLE #results1
	(
		DataForWeek NVARCHAR(200),
		YearDataForWeek NVARCHAR(50),
		BuildingName NVARCHAR(50)
	)

	-- 1. Return screen header text.

	IF @varDataStartDate IS NOT NULL
	BEGIN
		INSERT INTO #results1
		SELECT 'YTD data for week no. ' + CAST(@varDataStartWeekNumber AS NVARCHAR(2)) + ' to week no. ' + CAST(@varDataEndWeekNumber AS NVARCHAR(2)) + ' (' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), @varDataStartDate, 103) + ' to ' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), @varDataEndDate, 103) + ')' AS [DataForWeek],
		'AsOf' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), dbo.GetBSTDate(), 23) AS [YearDataForWeek],
		@varBuildingName as BuildingName
	END

	SELECT * FROM #results1

	-- 7A. Return the UptimeLogsITStoreAllTickets record details.

	DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #uptimeLogsITStoreAllTickets

	SELECT DISTINCT
		t1.UptimeLogsITStoreAllTicketPK, 
		-1 AS UptimeLogsDetailFK, --t1.UptimeLogsDetailFK, 
		t1.UptimeLogsCategoryFK, 
		ulc.UptimeLogsCategory, 
		ulbc.CategoryScreenOrder,
		t1.NoOfTickets,
		t1.TimeSpentMinutes,
		t1.NoOfOpenToDoTickets,
		t1.NoOfInvestigationReferredTickets,
		t1.NoOfResolvedClosedTickets,
		t1.NoOfWaitingForCustomerTickets,
		CAST(0 AS BIT) AS TotalsRow
	INTO
		#uptimeLogsITStoreAllTickets
	FROM
		dbo.tblUptimeLogsITStoreAllTickets t1 WITH (NOLOCK)
	INNER JOIN dbo.tblUptimeLogsBuildingCategories ulbc WITH (NOLOCK)
		ON t1.UptimeLogsCategoryFK = ulbc.UptimeLogsCategoryFK		
	INNER JOIN dbo.appUptimeLogsTables ult WITH (NOLOCK)
		ON ulbc.UptimeLogsTableFK = ult.UptimeLogsTablePK
	INNER JOIN dbo.appUptimeLogsCategories ulc WITH (NOLOCK)
		ON ulbc.UptimeLogsCategoryFK = ulc.UptimeLogsCategoryPK
	INNER JOIN #uptimeLogsDetails tmp1
		ON t1.UptimeLogsDetailFK = tmp1.UptimeLogsDetailPK
	WHERE
		ult.UptimeLogsTableName = 'tblUptimeLogsITStoreAllTickets'
		AND ulbc.BuildingFK = @varBuildingFK

	DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #uptimeLogsITStoreAllTicketsIncludingTotals

	SELECT
		-1 AS UptimeLogsITStoreAllTicketPK, --t1.UptimeLogsITStoreAllTicketPK, 
		t1.UptimeLogsDetailFK, 
		t1.UptimeLogsCategoryFK, 
		t1.UptimeLogsCategory, 
		t1.CategoryScreenOrder,
		SUM(ISNULL(t1.NoOfTickets,0)) AS NoOfTickets,
		SUM(ISNULL(t1.TimeSpentMinutes,0)) AS TimeSpentMinutes,

		CASE 
			WHEN SUM(ISNULL(t1.TimeSpentMinutes,0)) < 1 THEN CAST(0.00 AS DECIMAL(18,2))
			ELSE ROUND(CAST(CAST(SUM(ISNULL(t1.TimeSpentMinutes,0)) AS DECIMAL(18, 2)) / CAST(SUM(ISNULL(t1.NoOfTickets,0)) AS DECIMAL(18, 2)) AS DECIMAL(18,2)), 0) 
		END AS AvgTimeToResolveTickets,

		SUM(ISNULL(t1.NoOfOpenToDoTickets,0)) AS NoOfOpenToDoTickets,
		SUM(ISNULL(t1.NoOfInvestigationReferredTickets,0)) AS NoOfInvestigationReferredTickets,
		SUM(ISNULL(t1.NoOfResolvedClosedTickets,0)) AS NoOfResolvedClosedTickets,
		SUM(ISNULL(t1.NoOfWaitingForCustomerTickets,0)) AS NoOfWaitingForCustomerTickets,

		CASE
			WHEN SUM(ISNULL(t1.NoOfTickets,0)) < 1 THEN 
				'0.00'
			ELSE
				CAST(ROUND(CAST(
						((CAST(SUM(ISNULL(t1.NoOfResolvedClosedTickets,0)) AS DECIMAL(18,2)) / CAST(SUM(ISNULL(t1.NoOfTickets,0)) AS DECIMAL(18,2))) * 100.00)
						AS DECIMAL(18,2)),2) AS NVARCHAR(50))
		END + '%' AS ResolvedPercentage,

		CAST(0 AS BIT) AS TotalsRow
	INTO
		#uptimeLogsITStoreAllTicketsIncludingTotals
	FROM
		#uptimeLogsITStoreAllTickets t1
	GROUP BY
		t1.UptimeLogsDetailFK, 
		t1.UptimeLogsCategoryFK, 
		t1.UptimeLogsCategory, 
		t1.CategoryScreenOrder

	UNION

	SELECT 
		-1 AS UptimeLogsITStoreAllTicketPK,
		t1.UptimeLogsDetailFK,
		-1 AS UptimeLogsCategoryFK,
		'Total' AS UptimeLogsCategory,
		999999999 AS CategoryScreenOrder,
		SUM(ISNULL(t1.NoOfTickets,0)) AS NoOfTickets,
		SUM(ISNULL(t1.TimeSpentMinutes,0)) AS TimeSpentMinutes,

		CASE 
			WHEN SUM(ISNULL(t1.TimeSpentMinutes,0)) < 1 THEN CAST(0.00 AS DECIMAL(18,2))
			ELSE ROUND(CAST(CAST(SUM(ISNULL(t1.TimeSpentMinutes,0)) AS DECIMAL(18, 2)) / CAST(SUM(ISNULL(t1.NoOfTickets,0)) AS DECIMAL(18, 2)) AS DECIMAL(18,2)), 2) 
			END
		AS AvgTimeToResolveTickets,

		SUM(ISNULL(t1.NoOfOpenToDoTickets,0)) AS NoOfOpenToDoTickets,
		SUM(ISNULL(t1.NoOfInvestigationReferredTickets,0)) AS NoOfInvestigationReferredTickets,
		SUM(ISNULL(t1.NoOfResolvedClosedTickets,0)) AS NoOfResolvedClosedTickets,
		SUM(ISNULL(t1.NoOfWaitingForCustomerTickets,0)) AS NoOfWaitingForCustomerTickets,

		CASE
			WHEN SUM(ISNULL(t1.NoOfTickets,0)) < 1 THEN 
				'0.00'
			ELSE
				CAST(ROUND(CAST(
						((CAST(SUM(ISNULL(t1.NoOfResolvedClosedTickets,0)) AS DECIMAL(18,2)) / CAST(SUM(ISNULL(t1.NoOfTickets,0)) AS DECIMAL(18,2))) * 100.00)
						AS DECIMAL(18,2)),2) AS NVARCHAR(50))
		END + '%' AS ResolvedPercentage,

		CAST(1 AS BIT) AS TotalsRow
	FROM
		#uptimeLogsITStoreAllTickets t1
	GROUP BY
		t1.UptimeLogsDetailFK

	SELECT 
		--t1.UptimeLogsITStoreAllTicketPK, 
		--t1.UptimeLogsDetailFK, 
		--t1.UptimeLogsCategoryFK, 
		t1.UptimeLogsCategory AS Category, 
		--t1.CategoryScreenOrder,
		t1.NoOfTickets AS [No. of Tickets],
		dbo.fnGetHoursAndMinutesTimeFormatForMinutes(t1.TimeSpentMinutes) AS [Time Spent],
		dbo.fnGetHoursAndMinutesTimeFormatForMinutes(t1.AvgTimeToResolveTickets) AS [Avg Resolve Time],
		t1.NoOfOpenToDoTickets AS [Open/To do],
		t1.NoOfInvestigationReferredTickets AS [Investigation/Referred],
		t1.NoOfResolvedClosedTickets AS [Resolved/Closed],
		t1.NoOfWaitingForCustomerTickets AS [With Customer],
		t1.ResolvedPercentage AS [Resolved %]
		--t1.TotalsRow
	FROM 
		#uptimeLogsITStoreAllTicketsIncludingTotals t1
	ORDER BY
		CategoryScreenOrder ASC

	-- 7B. Return the Customer Integration Files record details.

	DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #stock

	SELECT 
		CAST('In' AS NVARCHAR(3)) AS StockDirection,
		t1.CustomerFK,
		cust.CustomerCode,
		cust.CustomerName,
		ISNULL(COUNT(DISTINCT t1.IntegrationFilePK), 0) AS NoOfProcessedFiles
	INTO
		#stock
	FROM
		dbo.tblIntegrationFiles t1 WITH (NOLOCK)
	INNER JOIN appIntegrationFileTypes t2 WITH (NOLOCK)
		ON t1.IntegrationFileTypeFK = t2.IntegrationFileTypePK
	INNER JOIN dbo.tblContainerIns t3 WITH (NOLOCK)
		ON t1.FK = t3.ContainerInPK
	INNER JOIN dbo.viewBuildingDetails vbd WITH (NOLOCK)
		ON t3.BuildingUnitFK = vbd.BuildingUnitPK
	INNER JOIN dbo.tblCustomers cust WITH (NOLOCK)
		ON t1.CustomerFK = cust.CustomerPK
	WHERE
		CAST(t1.InsertedDate AS DATE) >= @varDataStartDate
		AND CAST(t1.InsertedDate AS DATE) < DATEADD(DAY, 1, @varDataEndDate)
		AND t1.FK > 0
		AND t2.IntegrationFileTypeDescription =  'Stock Inward'
	GROUP BY
		t1.CustomerFK,
		cust.CustomerCode,
		cust.CustomerName

	INSERT INTO #stock
	SELECT
		'Out' AS StockDirection,
		t1.CustomerFK,
		cust.CustomerCode,
		cust.CustomerName,
		ISNULL(COUNT(DISTINCT t1.IntegrationFilePK), 0) AS NoOfProcessedFiles
	FROM
		dbo.tblIntegrationFiles t1 WITH (NOLOCK)
	INNER JOIN appIntegrationFileTypes t2 WITH (NOLOCK)
		ON t1.IntegrationFileTypeFK = t2.IntegrationFileTypePK
	INNER JOIN dbo.tblContainerOuts t3 WITH (NOLOCK)
		ON t1.FK = t3.ContainerOutPK
	INNER JOIN dbo.tblStockOrders t4 WITH (NOLOCK)
		ON t3.ContainerOutPK = t4.ContainerOutFK
	INNER JOIN dbo.viewBuildingDetails vbd WITH (NOLOCK)
		ON t4.ResponsibleBuildingUnitFK = vbd.BuildingUnitPK
	INNER JOIN dbo.tblCustomers cust WITH (NOLOCK)
		ON t1.CustomerFK = cust.CustomerPK
	WHERE 
		CAST(t1.InsertedDate AS DATE) >= @varDataStartDate
		AND CAST(t1.InsertedDate AS DATE) < DATEADD(DAY, 1, @varDataEndDate)
		AND t1.FK > 0
		AND t2.IntegrationFileTypeDescription =  'Stock Outward'
	GROUP BY
		t1.CustomerFK,
		cust.CustomerCode,
		cust.CustomerName

	DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #stockResults

	SELECT StockDirection, 'Danone' AS Customer, SUM(NoOfProcessedFiles) AS NoOfProcessedFiles  
	INTO #stockResults
	FROM #stock 
	WHERE CustomerName like '%danone%'
	GROUP BY StockDirection

	UNION

	SELECT StockDirection, 'Glanbia' AS Customer, SUM(NoOfProcessedFiles) AS NoOfProcessedFiles  
	FROM #stock
	WHERE CustomerName like '%glanbia%'
	GROUP BY StockDirection

	UNION

	SELECT StockDirection, Customer, SUM(NoOfProcessedFiles) AS NoOfProcessedFiles
	FROM
		(
		SELECT StockDirection, 'GSK' AS Customer, SUM(NoOfProcessedFiles) AS NoOfProcessedFiles  
		FROM #stock
		WHERE CustomerName like '%glaxo%smith%kline%'
		GROUP BY StockDirection
		UNION
		SELECT StockDirection, 'GSK' AS Customer, SUM(NoOfProcessedFiles) AS NoOfProcessedFiles  
		FROM #stock
		WHERE CustomerName like '%gsk%'
		GROUP BY StockDirection
		) AS subQuery
	GROUP BY
		StockDirection,
		Customer

	SELECT 
		@varDanoneNoOfProcessedStockInFiles = NoOfProcessedFiles
	FROM 
		#stockResults
	WHERE
		StockDirection = 'In' 
		AND Customer = 'Danone'

	SELECT 
		@varDanoneNoOfProcessedStockOutFiles = NoOfProcessedFiles
	FROM 
		#stockResults
	WHERE
		StockDirection = 'Out'
		AND Customer = 'Danone'

	SELECT 
		@varGlanbiaNoOfProcessedStockInFiles = NoOfProcessedFiles
	FROM 
		#stockResults
	WHERE
		StockDirection = 'In' 
		AND Customer = 'Glanbia'

	SELECT 
		@varGlanbiaNoOfProcessedStockOutFiles = NoOfProcessedFiles
	FROM 
		#stockResults
	WHERE
		StockDirection = 'Out'
		AND Customer = 'Glanbia'

	SELECT 
		@varGSKNoOfProcessedStockInFiles = NoOfProcessedFiles
	FROM 
		#stockResults
	WHERE
		StockDirection = 'In' 
		AND Customer = 'GSK'

	SELECT 
		@varGSKNoOfProcessedStockOutFiles = NoOfProcessedFiles
	FROM 
		#stockResults
	WHERE
		StockDirection = 'Out'
		AND Customer = 'GSK'

	DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #finalCustomerIntegrationFilesResults

	SELECT 
		1 AS PK,
		'Stock In' AS UptimeLogsCategory,
		@varDanoneNoOfProcessedStockInFiles AS [DanoneNoOfProcessedFiles],
		@varGlanbiaNoOfProcessedStockInFiles AS [GlanbiaNoOfProcessedFiles],
		@varGSKNoOfProcessedStockInFiles AS [GSKNoOfProcessedFiles],
		@varDanoneNoOfProcessedStockInFiles + @varGlanbiaNoOfProcessedStockInFiles + @varGSKNoOfProcessedStockInFiles AS TotalNoOfProcessedFiles,
		CAST(0 AS BIT) AS TotalsRow		 
	INTO
		#finalCustomerIntegrationFilesResults
	UNION
	SELECT 
		2 AS PK,
		'Stock Out' AS UptimeLogsCategory,
		@varDanoneNoOfProcessedStockOutFiles AS [DanoneNoOfProcessedFiles],
		@varGlanbiaNoOfProcessedStockOutFiles AS [GlanbiaNoOfProcessedFiles],
		@varGSKNoOfProcessedStockOutFiles AS [GSKNoOfProcessedFiles],
		@varDanoneNoOfProcessedStockOutFiles + @varGlanbiaNoOfProcessedStockOutFiles + @varGSKNoOfProcessedStockOutFiles AS TotalNoOfProcessedFiles,
		CAST(0 AS BIT) AS TotalsRow
	UNION
	SELECT 
		3 AS PK,
		'Total' AS UptimeLogsCategory,
		@varDanoneNoOfProcessedStockInFiles + @varDanoneNoOfProcessedStockOutFiles AS [DanoneNoOfProcessedFiles],
		@varGlanbiaNoOfProcessedStockInFiles + @varGlanbiaNoOfProcessedStockOutFiles AS [GlanbiaNoOfProcessedFiles],
		@varGSKNoOfProcessedStockInFiles + @varGSKNoOfProcessedStockOutFiles AS [GSKNoOfProcessedFiles],
		@varDanoneNoOfProcessedStockInFiles + @varDanoneNoOfProcessedStockOutFiles
			+ @varGlanbiaNoOfProcessedStockInFiles + @varGlanbiaNoOfProcessedStockOutFiles
				+ @varGSKNoOfProcessedStockInFiles + @varGSKNoOfProcessedStockOutFiles AS [TotalNoOfProcessedFiles],
		CAST(1 AS BIT) AS TotalsRow

	SELECT 
		UptimeLogsCategory AS Category,
		[DanoneNoOfProcessedFiles] AS Danone,
		[GlanbiaNoOfProcessedFiles] AS Glanbia,
		[GSKNoOfProcessedFiles] AS GSK,
		[TotalNoOfProcessedFiles] AS Total
	FROM 
		#finalCustomerIntegrationFilesResults 
	ORDER BY 
		PK ASC

	-- 7C. Return the UptimeLogsITCustomerTickets record details.

	DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #uptimeLogsITCustomerTickets

	SELECT DISTINCT

	INNER JOIN dbo.appUptimeLogsCategories ulc WITH (NOLOCK)
		ON ulbc.UptimeLogsCategoryFK = ulc.UptimeLogsCategoryPK
	INNER JOIN #uptimeLogsDetails tmp1
		ON t1.UptimeLogsDetailFK = tmp1.UptimeLogsDetailPK
	WHERE
		ult.UptimeLogsTableName = 'tblUptimeLogsITCustomerTickets'
		AND ulbc.BuildingFK = @varBuildingFK

	DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #uptimeLogsITCustomerTicketsFinalResults

	SELECT
		-1 AS UptimeLogsITCustomerTicketPK, 
		UptimeLogsDetailFK, 
		UptimeLogsCategoryFK, 
		UptimeLogsCategory, 
		CategoryScreenOrder,			
		SUM(ISNULL(NoOfDanoneTickets,0)) AS NoOfDanoneTickets,
		SUM(ISNULL(NoOfGlanbiaTickets,0)) AS NoOfGlanbiaTickets,
		SUM(ISNULL(NoOfGSKTickets,0)) AS NoOfGSKTickets,
		SUM(ISNULL(TimeSpentMinutes,0)) AS TimeSpentMinutes,
		SUM(ISNULL(NoOfOpenToDoTickets,0)) AS NoOfOpenToDoTickets,
		SUM(ISNULL(NoOfResolvedClosedTickets,0)) AS NoOfResolvedClosedTickets,
		SUM(ISNULL(NoOfDanoneTickets,0)) + SUM(ISNULL(NoOfGlanbiaTickets,0)) + SUM(ISNULL(NoOfGSKTickets,0)) AS TotalTickets,
		CAST(0 AS BIT) AS TotalsRow
	INTO
		#uptimeLogsITCustomerTicketsFinalResults
	FROM
		#uptimeLogsITCustomerTickets
	GROUP BY
		UptimeLogsDetailFK, 
		UptimeLogsCategoryFK, 
		UptimeLogsCategory, 
		CategoryScreenOrder
	--UNION
	--SELECT		
	--	-1 AS UptimeLogsITCustomerTicketPK, 
	--	t1.UptimeLogsDetailFK, 
	--	-1 AS UptimeLogsCategoryFK, 
	--	'Total' AS UptimeLogsCategory, 
	--	999999999 AS CategoryScreenOrder,

	--	SUM(NoOfDanoneTickets) AS NoOfDanoneTickets,
	--	SUM(NoOfGlanbiaTickets) AS NoOfGlanbiaTickets,
	--	SUM(NoOfGSKTickets) AS NoOfGSKTickets,
	--	SUM(TimeSpentMinutes) AS TimeSpentMinutes,
	--	SUM(NoOfOpenToDoTickets) AS NoOfOpenToDoTickets,
	--	SUM(NoOfResolvedClosedTickets) AS NoOfResolvedClosedTickets,
	--	SUM(NoOfDanoneTickets) + SUM(NoOfGlanbiaTickets) + SUM(NoOfGSKTickets) AS TotalTickets,
	--	CAST(1 AS BIT) AS TotalsRow
	--FROM
	--	#uptimeLogsITCustomerTickets t1
	--GROUP BY
	--	t1.UptimeLogsDetailFK

	SELECT
		--UptimeLogsITCustomerTicketPK, 
		--UptimeLogsDetailFK, 
		--UptimeLogsCategoryFK, 
		UptimeLogsCategory AS Category, 
		--CategoryScreenOrder,
		NoOfDanoneTickets AS Danone,
		NoOfGlanbiaTickets AS Glanbia,
		NoOfGSKTickets AS GSK,
		TotalTickets AS Total,
		dbo.fnGetHoursAndMinutesTimeFormatForMinutes(TimeSpentMinutes) AS [Time Spent],
		NoOfOpenToDoTickets AS [Open],
		NoOfResolvedClosedTickets AS Resolved		
		--TotalsRow		
	FROM
		#uptimeLogsITCustomerTicketsFinalResults
	ORDER BY
		CategoryScreenOrder ASC

	-- 7C. Return the UptimeLogsITExternalIssues record details.

	DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #uptimeLogsITExternalIssues

	SELECT DISTINCT
		t1.UptimeLogsITExternalIssuePK, 
		-1 AS UptimeLogsDetailFK, --t1.UptimeLogsDetailFK, 
		t1.UptimeLogsCategoryFK, 
		ulc.UptimeLogsCategory, 
		ulbc.CategoryScreenOrder,	
		t1.NoOfJiraTickets,
		t1.TimeSpentMinutes,
		t1.DowntimeMinutes
	INTO
		#uptimeLogsITExternalIssues
	FROM
		dbo.tblUptimeLogsITExternalIssues t1 WITH (NOLOCK)
	INNER JOIN dbo.tblUptimeLogsBuildingCategories ulbc WITH (NOLOCK)
		ON t1.UptimeLogsCategoryFK = ulbc.UptimeLogsCategoryFK		
	INNER JOIN dbo.appUptimeLogsTables ult WITH (NOLOCK)
		ON ulbc.UptimeLogsTableFK = ult.UptimeLogsTablePK
	INNER JOIN dbo.appUptimeLogsCategories ulc WITH (NOLOCK)
		ON ulbc.UptimeLogsCategoryFK = ulc.UptimeLogsCategoryPK
	INNER JOIN #uptimeLogsDetails tmp1
		ON t1.UptimeLogsDetailFK = tmp1.UptimeLogsDetailPK
	WHERE
		ult.UptimeLogsTableName = 'tblUptimeLogsITExternalIssues'
		AND ulbc.BuildingFK = @varBuildingFK

	DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #uptimeLogsITExternalIssuesFinalResults

	DECLARE @weekInMinutes DECIMAL(18,2) = 10080.00/*No. of minutes in a 7 day week*/--ZXC

	SET @weekInMinutes = @weekInMinutes * @varNoOfWeeksOfData

	SELECT 
		-1 AS UptimeLogsITExternalIssuePK, --t1.UptimeLogsITExternalIssuePK, 
		t1.UptimeLogsDetailFK, 
		t1.UptimeLogsCategoryFK, 
		t1.UptimeLogsCategory, 
		t1.CategoryScreenOrder,		
		SUM(ISNULL(t1.NoOfJiraTickets,0)) AS NoOfJiraTickets,
		SUM(ISNULL(t1.TimeSpentMinutes,0)) AS TimeSpentMinutes,
		SUM(ISNULL(t1.DowntimeMinutes,0)) AS DowntimeMinutes,
		CAST(CAST(ROUND((((@weekInMinutes - SUM(ISNULL(t1.DowntimeMinutes,0))) / @weekInMinutes) * 100.00), 2) AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS NVARCHAR(50)) + '%' AS PercentageUptime,
		CAST(0 AS BIT) AS TotalsRow
	INTO
		#uptimeLogsITExternalIssuesFinalResults
	FROM
		#uptimeLogsITExternalIssues t1
	GROUP BY
		t1.UptimeLogsDetailFK, 
		t1.UptimeLogsCategoryFK, 
		t1.UptimeLogsCategory, 
		t1.CategoryScreenOrder
	UNION
	SELECT 
		-1 AS UptimeLogsITExternalIssuePK, 
		t1.UptimeLogsDetailFK, 
		-1 AS UptimeLogsCategoryFK, 
		'Total' AS UptimeLogsCategory, 
		999999999 AS CategoryScreenOrder,	
		SUM(t1.NoOfJiraTickets) AS NoOfJiraTickets,
		SUM(t1.TimeSpentMinutes) AS TimeSpentMinutes,
		SUM(t1.DowntimeMinutes) AS DowntimeMinutes,
		CAST(CAST(ROUND((((@weekInMinutes - SUM(ISNULL(t1.DowntimeMinutes,0))) / @weekInMinutes) * 100.00), 2) AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS NVARCHAR(50)) + '%' AS PercentageUptime, 
		CAST(1 AS BIT) AS TotalsRow
	FROM
		#uptimeLogsITExternalIssues t1
	GROUP BY
		t1.UptimeLogsDetailFK

	SELECT
		--t1.UptimeLogsITExternalIssuePK, 
		--t1.UptimeLogsDetailFK, 
		--t1.UptimeLogsCategoryFK, 
		t1.UptimeLogsCategory AS Category, 
		--t1.CategoryScreenOrder,	
		t1.NoOfJiraTickets AS [No. of Tickets],
		dbo.fnGetHoursAndMinutesTimeFormatForMinutes(t1.TimeSpentMinutes) AS [Time Spent],
		dbo.fnGetHoursAndMinutesTimeFormatForMinutes(t1.DowntimeMinutes) AS Downtime,
		t1.PercentageUptime AS [Uptime %]
		--t1.TotalsRow
	FROM
		#uptimeLogsITExternalIssuesFinalResults t1
	ORDER BY
		t1.CategoryScreenOrder ASC
END
--ec:
