-- ================================================================
-- Author:      Cathal OCuirrin
-- Create Date: 22 Jan 2020
-- Description: Used to supply data to the Uptime Logs YTD screen.
-- ================================================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spUptimeLogsGetYTDDetailsForBuilding] -- [dbo].[spUptimeLogsGetYTDDetailsForBuilding] @buildingFK = 30 /*BV5 for hardware data test*/, @year = 2019
(
--declare
	@buildingFK	INT,
	@year INT

	--select @buildingFK = 36 /*CR1 for critical services data test*/
	--select @buildingFK = 21 /*BV1*/, @year = 2019
)
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ UNCOMMITTED; SET DEADLOCK_PRIORITY LOW

	DECLARE
		@varBuildingFK INT = @buildingFK, @varBuildingName NVARCHAR(50), @varCurrentDate DATE = (SELECT dbo.GetBSTDate()), @varDataStartWeekNumber INT, @varDataStartDate DATE, @varDataEndWeekNumber INT, @varDataEndDate DATE, @varNoOfWeeksOfData INT,
		@varYear INT = ISNULL(@year, -1)

	SET @varCurrentDate = dbo.GetBSTDate()

	SET @varDataEndDate = @varCurrentDate

	-- @varYear = year of selected work date on the Uptime Logs screen.
	-- If @varYear doesn't match the year of the current date work out the last week in selected year. 
	IF @varYear > 0 AND YEAR(@varDataEndDate) <> @varYear 
	BEGIN
		SET @varDataEndDate = CAST(@varYear + 1 AS NVARCHAR(4)) + '-01-01'

		WHILE DATEPART(wk, @varDataEndDate) <> 52 SET @varDataEndDate = DATEADD(WEEK, -1, @varDataEndDate)
	END

	-- Ensure the end date is a Monday.
	WHILE DATENAME(dw, @varDataEndDate) <> 'Monday' SET @varDataEndDate = DATEADD(DAY, -1, @varDataEndDate)

	-- 53 equals week 1 of the next year so need to subtract a week to get week 52 of the selected year.
	IF DATEPART(wk, @varDataEndDate) = 53 SET @varDataEndDate = DATEADD(WEEK, -1, @varDataEndDate)

	SELECT @varDataEndWeekNumber = DATEPART(wk, @varDataEndDate)

	-- Make start date a year less than the end date.
	SET @varDataStartDate = DATEADD(YEAR, -1, @varDataEndDate)

	-- Ensure the start date is a Monday.
	WHILE DATENAME(dw, @varDataStartDate) <> 'Monday' SET @varDataStartDate = DATEADD(DAY, -1, @varDataStartDate)

	-- Keep adding a week to start date until after week 52 (week 53 could be after 52 as well as week 1).
	WHILE DATEPART(wk, @varDataStartDate) NOT IN (1, 53)  SET @varDataStartDate = DATEADD(WEEK, 1, @varDataStartDate)

	SELECT @varDataStartWeekNumber = DATEPART(wk, @varDataStartDate)

	-- 53 equals week 1.
	SELECT @varDataStartWeekNumber = CASE WHEN @varDataStartWeekNumber = 53 THEN 1 ELSE @varDataStartWeekNumber END

--select @varCurrentDate as [@varCurrentDate]
--select @varDataStartDate as [1 @varDataStartDate]
--SELECT @varDataStartWeekNumber AS [1 StartDateWeekNumber]

--select @varDataEndDate as [1 @varDataEndDate]
--SELECT @varDataEndWeekNumber AS [1 EndDateWeekNumber]

	SELECT @varDataStartDate = MIN(UptimeLogDate) from tblUptimeLogsDetails WHERE UptimeLogDate >= @varDataStartDate AND UptimeLogDate <= @varDataEndDate AND IsArchived = 1 /*Confirmed data only*/

	IF @varDataStartDate IS NOT NULL
	BEGIN
		SELECT @varDataStartWeekNumber = CASE WHEN DATEPART(wk, @varDataStartDate) = 53 THEN 1 ELSE DATEPART(wk, @varDataStartDate) END

		SELECT @varDataEndDate = MAX(UptimeLogDate) from tblUptimeLogsDetails WHERE UptimeLogDate >= @varDataStartDate AND UptimeLogDate <= @varDataEndDate AND IsArchived = 1 /*Confirmed data only*/

		SELECT @varDataEndWeekNumber = DATEPART(wk, @varDataEndDate)

		SET @varDataEndDate = DATEADD(DAY, 6, @varDataEndDate)
	END
	ELSE 
	BEGIN
		SET @varDataStartWeekNumber = NULL
		SET @varDataEndDate = NULL	
		SET @varDataEndWeekNumber = NULL
	END

	SELECT @varDataEndWeekNumber = CASE WHEN @varDataEndWeekNumber = 53 THEN 1 ELSE @varDataEndWeekNumber END

	SELECT @varNoOfWeeksOfData = (@varDataEndWeekNumber - @varDataStartWeekNumber) + 1

--select @varDataStartDate as [2 @varDataStartDate]
--SELECT @varDataStartWeekNumber AS [2 StartDateWeekNumber]
--select @varDataEndDate as [2 @varDataEndDate]
--SELECT @varDataEndWeekNumber AS [2 EndDateWeekNumber]	
--select @varNoOfWeeksOfData as [@varNoOfWeeksOfData]

--GOTO ec

	SELECT @varBuildingName = BuildingName 
	FROM dbo.tblBuildings WITH (NOLOCK) 
	WHERE BuildingPK = @buildingFK

	DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #uptimeLogsDetails

	SELECT DISTINCT UptimeLogsDetailPK, uld.UptimeLogDate
	INTO #uptimeLogsDetails
	FROM dbo.tblUptimeLogsDetails uld WITH (NOLOCK) 
	WHERE uld.BuildingFK = @varBuildingFK	
	AND uld.UptimeLogDate <= @varDataEndDate
	AND uld.UptimeLogDate >= @varDataStartDate
	AND uld.IsArchived = 1 /*Confirmed data only*/

	-- 1. Get the week number details.
	
	DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #results1

	CREATE TABLE #results1
	(
		DataForWeek NVARCHAR(200),
		YearDataForWeek NVARCHAR(50),
		BuildingName NVARCHAR(50)
	)

	IF @varDataStartDate IS NOT NULL
	BEGIN
		INSERT INTO #results1
		SELECT 'YTD data for week no. ' + CAST(@varDataStartWeekNumber AS NVARCHAR(2)) + ' to week no. ' + CAST(@varDataEndWeekNumber AS NVARCHAR(2)) + ' (' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), @varDataStartDate, 103) + ' to ' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), @varDataEndDate, 103) + ')' AS [DataForWeek],
		'AsOf' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), dbo.GetBSTDate(), 23) AS [YearDataForWeek],
		@varBuildingName as BuildingName
	END

	SELECT * FROM #results1

	DECLARE @varDataEndDateMonth INT = (SELECT MONTH(@varDataEndDate))

--select @varDataEndDateMonth as [@varDataEndDateMonth]

	-- 1a. Get the current year quarter number.

	DECLARE @currentYearQuarter INT = (SELECT	CASE 
													WHEN @varDataEndDateMonth < 4 THEN 1
													WHEN @varDataEndDateMonth > 3 AND @varDataEndDateMonth < 7 THEN 2
													WHEN @varDataEndDateMonth > 6 AND @varDataEndDateMonth < 10 THEN 3
													ELSE 4
												END)

--select @currentYearQuarter as [@currentYearQuarter]

	-- 2. Return the UptimeLogsCriticalServices record details.

	DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #UptimeLogsCriticalServices

	SELECT DISTINCT
		uldh.UptimeLogsCriticalServicePK,
		uldh.UptimeLogsDetailFK,
		uldh.UptimeLogsCategoryFK,
		ulc_uldh.UptimeLogsCategory,
		ultc.CategoryScreenOrder,
		(dbo.fnGetTimeInMinutes(uldh.MondayHours) + dbo.fnGetTimeInMinutes(uldh.TuesdayHours) + dbo.fnGetTimeInMinutes(uldh.WednesdayHours) 
			+ dbo.fnGetTimeInMinutes(uldh.ThursdayHours) + dbo.fnGetTimeInMinutes(uldh.FridayHours) + dbo.fnGetTimeInMinutes(uldh.SaturdayHours) 
				+ dbo.fnGetTimeInMinutes(uldh.SundayHours)) AS TotalMinutes
	INTO
		#UptimeLogsCriticalServices
	FROM
		dbo.tblUptimeLogsCriticalServices uldh WITH (NOLOCK)
	INNER JOIN dbo.tblUptimeLogsBuildingCategories ultc WITH (NOLOCK)
		ON uldh.UptimeLogsCategoryFK = ultc.UptimeLogsCategoryFK		
	INNER JOIN dbo.appUptimeLogsTables ult WITH (NOLOCK)
		ON ultc.UptimeLogsTableFK = ult.UptimeLogsTablePK
	INNER JOIN dbo.appUptimeLogsCategories ulc_uldh WITH (NOLOCK)
		ON ultc.UptimeLogsCategoryFK = ulc_uldh.UptimeLogsCategoryPK
	INNER JOIN #uptimeLogsDetails uld WITH (NOLOCK)
		ON uldh.UptimeLogsDetailFK = uld.UptimeLogsDetailPK
	WHERE
		ult.UptimeLogsTableName = 'tblUptimeLogsCriticalServices'
		AND ultc.BuildingFK = @varBuildingFK

	DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #UptimeLogsCriticalServices2

	SELECT
		UptimeLogsCategory,
		CategoryScreenOrder,
		SUM(TotalMinutes) AS TotalMinutes
	INTO
		#UptimeLogsCriticalServices2
	FROM
		#UptimeLogsCriticalServices
	GROUP BY
		UptimeLogsCategory,
		CategoryScreenOrder		

	SELECT
		UptimeLogsCategory AS Category,
		CASE 
			WHEN TotalMinutes = 0 THEN '00:00'
		ELSE
			dbo.fnGetHoursAndMinutesTimeFormatForMinutes(TotalMinutes)
		END AS Downtime,

		CASE 
			WHEN TotalMinutes = 0 THEN '100.00'
		ELSE
			CAST(CAST(ROUND(100.00 - ((CAST(TotalMinutes AS DECIMAL(18, 2)) / (10080.00/*No. of minutes in a 7 day week*/ * CAST(@varNoOfWeeksOfData AS DECIMAL(18,2)))) * 100.00), 2) AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS VARCHAR(50)) 
		END + '%' AS [% Uptime] 
	FROM
		#UptimeLogsCriticalServices2
	ORDER BY
		CategoryScreenOrder ASC,
		UptimeLogsCategory ASC

	-- 3. Return the UptimeLogsHardware record details.

	DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #uptimeLogsHardware

	SELECT DISTINCT
		ulh.UptimeLogsHardwarePK,
		ulh.UptimeLogsDetailFK,
		uld.UptimeLogDate,
		ulh.UptimeLogsCategoryFK,
		ulc_ulh.UptimeLogsCategory,
		ultc.CategoryScreenOrder,
		ulh.NoInWarehouse,
		ulh.MinRequiredInWarehouse,
		ulh.NoInWarehouseOnMonday,
		ulh.NoInWarehouseOnTuesday,
		ulh.NoInWarehouseOnWednesday,
		ulh.NoInWarehouseOnThursday,
		ulh.NoInWarehouseOnFriday,
		ulh.NoInWarehouseOnSaturday,
		ulh.NoInWarehouseOnSunday
	INTO
		#uptimeLogsHardware
	FROM 
		dbo.tblUptimeLogsHardware ulh WITH (NOLOCK)
	INNER JOIN dbo.tblUptimeLogsBuildingCategories ultc WITH (NOLOCK)
		ON ulh.UptimeLogsCategoryFK = ultc.UptimeLogsCategoryFK		
	INNER JOIN dbo.appUptimeLogsTables ult WITH (NOLOCK)
		ON ultc.UptimeLogsTableFK = ult.UptimeLogsTablePK
	INNER JOIN dbo.appUptimeLogsCategories ulc_ulh WITH (NOLOCK)
		ON ultc.UptimeLogsCategoryFK = ulc_ulh.UptimeLogsCategoryPK
	INNER JOIN #uptimeLogsDetails uld
		ON ulh.UptimeLogsDetailFK = uld.UptimeLogsDetailPK
	WHERE
		ult.UptimeLogsTableName = 'tblUptimeLogsHardware'
		AND ultc.BuildingFK = @varBuildingFK

	DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #uptimeLogsHardware2

	SELECT 
		CategoryScreenOrder,
		UptimeLogsCategory, 
		
		--CAST(
			CAST(
					(
						(
							CAST(SUM(NoInWarehouseOnMonday + NoInWarehouseOnTuesday + NoInWarehouseOnWednesday + NoInWarehouseOnThursday + NoInWarehouseOnFriday + NoInWarehouseOnSaturday + NoInWarehouseOnSunday) AS DECIMAL(18,2))
							/ CAST((@varNoOfWeeksOfData * 7) AS DECIMAL(18,2))
						) 

						/ AVG(CAST(MinRequiredInWarehouse AS DECIMAL(18,2))) 

						* 100.00 
					)
					AS DECIMAL(18, 2)
				)
			--AS NVARCHAR(50)) + '%'
			AS AveragePercentageMinimumAvailable,
		
		--CAST(
			CAST(
					(
						(
							CAST(SUM(NoInWarehouseOnMonday + NoInWarehouseOnTuesday + NoInWarehouseOnWednesday + NoInWarehouseOnThursday + NoInWarehouseOnFriday + NoInWarehouseOnSaturday + NoInWarehouseOnSunday) AS DECIMAL(18,2))
							/ CAST((@varNoOfWeeksOfData * 7) AS DECIMAL(18,2))
						) 
					)
					AS DECIMAL(18, 2)
				)
			--AS NVARCHAR(50)) 
			AS AverageWorking,

		CAST(AVG(CAST(MinRequiredInWarehouse AS DECIMAL(18,2))) AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS AverageMinimumNeeded
	INTO
		#uptimeLogsHardware2
	FROM 
		#uptimeLogsHardware
	GROUP BY
		CategoryScreenOrder,
		UptimeLogsCategory

	SELECT
		UptimeLogsCategory AS Category,
		CAST(ISNULL(AveragePercentageMinimumAvailable, 0.00) AS NVARCHAR(50)) + '%' AS [% of Min Available],
		AverageMinimumNeeded AS [Minimum Needed],
		AverageWorking AS [Working]
	FROM
		#uptimeLogsHardware2
	ORDER BY
		CategoryScreenOrder ASC

	-- 4. Return the UptimeLogsJiraTickets record details.

	DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #uptimeLogsJiraTickets

	SELECT DISTINCT
		uljt.UptimeLogsJiraTicketPK,
		uljt.UptimeLogsDetailFK,
		uljt.UptimeLogsCategoryFK,
		ulc_uljt.UptimeLogsCategory,
		ultc.CategoryScreenOrder,
		uljt.NoOfTicketsCreated,
		uljt.NoOfTicketsResolved,
		uljt.NoOfTicketsOngoingOpen,
		uljt.NoOfTicketsWaitingOnCustomer,
		uljt.NoOfTicketsWaitingOnVendor,
		uljt.Other
	INTO
		#uptimeLogsJiraTickets
	FROM
		dbo.tblUptimeLogsJiraTickets uljt WITH (NOLOCK)
	INNER JOIN dbo.tblUptimeLogsBuildingCategories ultc WITH (NOLOCK)
		ON uljt.UptimeLogsCategoryFK = ultc.UptimeLogsCategoryFK		
	INNER JOIN dbo.appUptimeLogsTables ult WITH (NOLOCK)
		ON ultc.UptimeLogsTableFK = ult.UptimeLogsTablePK
	INNER JOIN dbo.appUptimeLogsCategories ulc_uljt WITH (NOLOCK)
		ON ultc.UptimeLogsCategoryFK = ulc_uljt.UptimeLogsCategoryPK
	INNER JOIN #uptimeLogsDetails uld
		ON uljt.UptimeLogsDetailFK = uld.UptimeLogsDetailPK
	WHERE
		ult.UptimeLogsTableName = 'tblUptimeLogsJiraTickets'
		AND ultc.BuildingFK = @varBuildingFK

	SELECT 
		UptimeLogsCategory AS Category,
		SUM(NoOfTicketsCreated) AS Created,
		SUM(NoOfTicketsResolved) AS Resolved,
		SUM(NoOfTicketsOngoingOpen) AS [Ongoing Open],
		SUM(NoOfTicketsWaitingOnCustomer) AS [With Customer],
		SUM(NoOfTicketsWaitingOnVendor) AS [With Vendor],
		SUM(Other) AS Other
	FROM 
		#uptimeLogsJiraTickets
	GROUP BY
		CategoryScreenOrder,
		UptimeLogsCategory
	ORDER BY 
		CategoryScreenOrder ASC

	-- 5. Return the UptimeLogsIntegrationFiles record details.

	DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #uptimeLogsIntegrationFiles0

	SELECT DISTINCT
		ulf.UptimeLogsIntegrationFilePK, ulf.UptimeLogsDetailFK, ulf.UptimeLogsCategoryFK, ulc_ulf.UptimeLogsCategory, ultc.CategoryScreenOrder,
		ulf.NoOfStoreAllIssues, ulf.NoOfCustomerIssues, ulf.NoOfFilesIn, ulf.NoOfFilesOut, StockInEmailsTotal
	INTO
		#uptimeLogsIntegrationFiles0
	FROM
		dbo.tblUptimeLogsIntegrationFiles ulf WITH (NOLOCK)		
	INNER JOIN dbo.tblUptimeLogsBuildingCategories ultc WITH (NOLOCK)
		ON ulf.UptimeLogsCategoryFK = ultc.UptimeLogsCategoryFK		
	INNER JOIN dbo.appUptimeLogsTables ult WITH (NOLOCK)
		ON ultc.UptimeLogsTableFK = ult.UptimeLogsTablePK
	INNER JOIN dbo.appUptimeLogsCategories ulc_ulf WITH (NOLOCK)
		ON ultc.UptimeLogsCategoryFK = ulc_ulf.UptimeLogsCategoryPK
	INNER JOIN #uptimeLogsDetails uld
		ON ulf.UptimeLogsDetailFK = uld.UptimeLogsDetailPK
	WHERE
		ult.UptimeLogsTableName = 'tblUptimeLogsIntegrationFiles'
		AND ultc.BuildingFK = @varBuildingFK

	DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #uptimeLogsIntegrationFiles1

	SELECT 
		CategoryScreenOrder,
		UptimeLogsCategory,
		SUM(NoOfStoreAllIssues) AS NoOfStoreAllIssues, SUM(NoOfCustomerIssues) AS NoOfCustomerIssues, SUM(NoOfFilesIn) AS NoOfFilesIn, SUM(NoOfFilesOut) AS NoOfFilesOut, SUM(StockInEmailsTotal) AS StockInEmailsTotal
	INTO
		#uptimeLogsIntegrationFiles1
	FROM
		#uptimeLogsIntegrationFiles0
	GROUP BY
		CategoryScreenOrder,
		UptimeLogsCategory

	DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #uptimeLogsIntegrationFiles

	SELECT DISTINCT
		ulf.CategoryScreenOrder,
		ulf.UptimeLogsCategory, 
		ulf.NoOfStoreAllIssues, 
		ulf.NoOfCustomerIssues, 
		ulf.NoOfFilesIn, 
		ulf.NoOfFilesOut,
		(ulf.NoOfFilesIn + ulf.NoOfFilesOut) AS TotalNoOfFilesInOut,

		CASE
			WHEN @varBuildingName = 'BV2' THEN

				(CASE 
					WHEN ulf.StockInEmailsTotal < 1 THEN 
						0.00
				ELSE 
					CAST(ROUND(CAST(ulf.NoOfStoreAllIssues AS DECIMAL(18, 2)) / (ulf.StockInEmailsTotal) * 100.00, 2) AS DECIMAL(18, 2))
				END)

			WHEN @varBuildingName <> 'BV2' THEN

				(CASE 
					WHEN ulf.NoOfFilesIn < 1 THEN 
						0.00
				ELSE 
					CAST(ROUND(CAST(ulf.NoOfStoreAllIssues AS DECIMAL(18, 2)) / (ulf.NoOfFilesIn + ulf.NoOfFilesOut) * 100.00, 2) AS DECIMAL(18, 2))
				END)
		END AS AutoCalcStoreAllPercentOfIssues,

		CASE
			WHEN @varBuildingName = 'BV2' THEN

				(CASE 
					WHEN ISNULL(ulf.StockInEmailsTotal, 0) < 1 THEN 
						0.00
					ELSE 
						CAST(ROUND(CAST(ulf.NoOfCustomerIssues AS DECIMAL(18, 2)) / (ulf.StockInEmailsTotal) * 100.00, 2) AS DECIMAL(18, 2))
				END)

			WHEN @varBuildingName <> 'BV2' THEN

				(CASE 
					WHEN ISNULL(ulf.NoOfFilesIn, 0) < 1 THEN 
						0.00
					ELSE 
						CAST(ROUND(CAST(ulf.NoOfCustomerIssues AS DECIMAL(18, 2)) / (ulf.NoOfFilesIn + ulf.NoOfFilesOut) * 100.00, 2) AS DECIMAL(18, 2))
				END)
		END AS AutoCalcCustomerPercentOfIssues,

		StockInEmailsTotal
	INTO
		#uptimeLogsIntegrationFiles 
	FROM
		#uptimeLogsIntegrationFiles1 ulf

	SELECT 
		UptimeLogsCategory AS Category, 
		NoOfStoreAllIssues AS [Store-All Issues], 
		NoOfCustomerIssues AS [Customer Issues], 
		NoOfFilesIn AS [Stock In], 
		NoOfFilesOut AS [Stock Out], 
		TotalNoOfFilesInOut AS Total,
		CAST(AutoCalcStoreAllPercentOfIssues AS NVARCHAR(50)) + '%' AS [Store-All % of Issues],
		CAST(AutoCalcCustomerPercentOfIssues AS NVARCHAR(50)) + '%' AS [Customer % of Issues],
		CAST((AutoCalcStoreAllPercentOfIssues + AutoCalcCustomerPercentOfIssues) AS NVARCHAR(50)) + '%' AS [Total % of Issues],			
		StockInEmailsTotal AS [Stock In Emails Total]
	FROM
		#uptimeLogsIntegrationFiles
	ORDER BY
		UptimeLogsCategory ASC

	-- 6. Return the UptimeLogsPhysicalChecks record details.

	DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #uptimeLogsPhysicalChecks

	SELECT DISTINCT 
		ulpc.UptimeLogsPhysicalCheckPK, ulpc.UptimeLogsDetailFK, ulpc.UptimeLogsCategoryFK, ulc_ulpc.UptimeLogsCategory, ultc.CategoryScreenOrder,		
		ulpc.NoOfPalletsAccepted,
		ulpc.NoOfPalletsRejected,
		ulpc.NoOfPalletsDispatched	
	INTO
		#uptimeLogsPhysicalChecks
	FROM
		dbo.tblUptimeLogsPhysicalChecks ulpc WITH (NOLOCK)		
	INNER JOIN dbo.tblUptimeLogsBuildingCategories ultc WITH (NOLOCK)
		ON ulpc.UptimeLogsCategoryFK = ultc.UptimeLogsCategoryFK		
	INNER JOIN dbo.appUptimeLogsTables ult WITH (NOLOCK)
		ON ultc.UptimeLogsTableFK = ult.UptimeLogsTablePK
	INNER JOIN dbo.appUptimeLogsCategories ulc_ulpc WITH (NOLOCK)
		ON ultc.UptimeLogsCategoryFK = ulc_ulpc.UptimeLogsCategoryPK
	INNER JOIN #uptimeLogsDetails uld
		ON ulpc.UptimeLogsDetailFK = uld.UptimeLogsDetailPK
	WHERE
		ult.UptimeLogsTableName = 'tblUptimeLogsPhysicalChecks'
		AND ultc.BuildingFK = @varBuildingFK

	SELECT
		UptimeLogsCategory AS Category,
		SUM(NoOfPalletsAccepted) AS [Pallets Accepted],
		SUM(NoOfPalletsRejected) AS [Pallets Rejected],
		SUM(NoOfPalletsDispatched) AS [Pallets Dispatched]
	FROM
		#uptimeLogsPhysicalChecks
	GROUP BY
		CategoryScreenOrder,
		UptimeLogsCategory
	ORDER BY
		CategoryScreenOrder ASC
END

-- ================================================================
-- Author:      Cathal OCuirrin
-- Create Date: 20 Mar 2020
-- Description: Used to supply data to the Uptime Logs YTD screen.
-- ================================================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spUptimeLogsGetYTDDetailsForITBuilding] -- [dbo].[spUptimeLogsGetYTDDetailsForITBuilding] @year = 2020
(
--declare
	@year INT

	--select @year = 2020
)
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ UNCOMMITTED; SET DEADLOCK_PRIORITY LOW

	DECLARE
		@varBuildingFK INT = 8888, @varBuildingName NVARCHAR(50) = 'IT', @varCurrentDate DATE = (SELECT dbo.GetBSTDate()), @varDataStartWeekNumber INT, @varDataStartDate DATE, @varDataEndWeekNumber INT, @varDataEndDate DATE, @varNoOfWeeksOfData INT,
		@varYear INT = ISNULL(@year, -1)

	DECLARE
		@varUptimeLogsCategoryFK INT, @varDanoneNoOfProcessedStockInFiles INT, @varDanoneNoOfProcessedStockOutFiles INT, @varDanoneTotalNoOfProcessedFiles INT,
		@varGlanbiaNoOfProcessedStockInFiles INT, @varGlanbiaNoOfProcessedStockOutFiles INT, @varGlanbiaTotalNoOfProcessedFiles INT,
		@varGSKNoOfProcessedStockInFiles INT, @varGSKNoOfProcessedStockOutFiles INT, @varGSKTotalNoOfProcessedFiles INT

	SET @varCurrentDate = dbo.GetBSTDate()

	SET @varDataEndDate = @varCurrentDate

	-- @varYear = year of selected work date on the Uptime Logs screen.
	-- If @varYear doesn't match the year of the current date work out the last week in selected year. 
	IF @varYear > 0 AND YEAR(@varDataEndDate) <> @varYear 
	BEGIN
		SET @varDataEndDate = CAST(@varYear + 1 AS NVARCHAR(4)) + '-01-01'

		WHILE DATEPART(wk, @varDataEndDate) <> 52 SET @varDataEndDate = DATEADD(WEEK, -1, @varDataEndDate)
	END

	-- Ensure the end date is a Monday.
	WHILE DATENAME(dw, @varDataEndDate) <> 'Monday' SET @varDataEndDate = DATEADD(DAY, -1, @varDataEndDate)

	-- 53 equals week 1 of the next year so need to subtract a week to get week 52 of the selected year.
	IF DATEPART(wk, @varDataEndDate) = 53 SET @varDataEndDate = DATEADD(WEEK, -1, @varDataEndDate)

	SELECT @varDataEndWeekNumber = DATEPART(wk, @varDataEndDate)

	-- Make start date a year less than the end date.
	SET @varDataStartDate = DATEADD(YEAR, -1, @varDataEndDate)

	-- Ensure the start date is a Monday.
	WHILE DATENAME(dw, @varDataStartDate) <> 'Monday' SET @varDataStartDate = DATEADD(DAY, -1, @varDataStartDate)

	-- Keep adding a week to start date until after week 52 (week 53 could be after 52 as well as week 1).
	WHILE DATEPART(wk, @varDataStartDate) NOT IN (1, 53)  SET @varDataStartDate = DATEADD(WEEK, 1, @varDataStartDate)

	SELECT @varDataStartWeekNumber = DATEPART(wk, @varDataStartDate)

	-- 53 equals week 1.
	SELECT @varDataStartWeekNumber = CASE WHEN @varDataStartWeekNumber = 53 THEN 1 ELSE @varDataStartWeekNumber END

	SELECT @varDataStartDate = MIN(UptimeLogDate) from tblUptimeLogsDetails WHERE UptimeLogDate >= @varDataStartDate AND UptimeLogDate <= @varDataEndDate AND IsArchived = 1 /*Confirmed data only*/

	IF @varDataStartDate IS NOT NULL
	BEGIN
		SELECT @varDataStartWeekNumber = CASE WHEN DATEPART(wk, @varDataStartDate) = 53 THEN 1 ELSE DATEPART(wk, @varDataStartDate) END

		SELECT @varDataEndDate = MAX(UptimeLogDate) from tblUptimeLogsDetails WHERE UptimeLogDate >= @varDataStartDate AND UptimeLogDate <= @varDataEndDate AND IsArchived = 1 /*Confirmed data only*/

		SELECT @varDataEndWeekNumber = DATEPART(wk, @varDataEndDate)

		SET @varDataEndDate = DATEADD(DAY, 6, @varDataEndDate)
	END
	ELSE 
	BEGIN
		SET @varDataStartWeekNumber = NULL
		SET @varDataEndDate = NULL	
		SET @varDataEndWeekNumber = NULL
	END

	SELECT @varDataEndWeekNumber = CASE WHEN @varDataEndWeekNumber = 53 THEN 1 ELSE @varDataEndWeekNumber END

	SELECT @varNoOfWeeksOfData = (@varDataEndWeekNumber - @varDataStartWeekNumber) + 1

	DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #uptimeLogsDetails

	SELECT DISTINCT UptimeLogsDetailPK, uld.UptimeLogDate
	INTO #uptimeLogsDetails
	FROM dbo.tblUptimeLogsDetails uld WITH (NOLOCK) 
	WHERE uld.BuildingFK = @varBuildingFK	
	AND uld.UptimeLogDate <= @varDataEndDate
	AND uld.UptimeLogDate >= @varDataStartDate
	AND uld.IsArchived = 1 /*Confirmed data only*/

	-- 1. Get the week number details.
	
	DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #results1

	CREATE TABLE #results1
	(
		DataForWeek NVARCHAR(200),
		YearDataForWeek NVARCHAR(50),
		BuildingName NVARCHAR(50)
	)

	-- 1. Return screen header text.

	IF @varDataStartDate IS NOT NULL
	BEGIN
		INSERT INTO #results1
		SELECT 'YTD data for week no. ' + CAST(@varDataStartWeekNumber AS NVARCHAR(2)) + ' to week no. ' + CAST(@varDataEndWeekNumber AS NVARCHAR(2)) + ' (' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), @varDataStartDate, 103) + ' to ' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), @varDataEndDate, 103) + ')' AS [DataForWeek],
		'AsOf' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), dbo.GetBSTDate(), 23) AS [YearDataForWeek],
		@varBuildingName as BuildingName
	END

	SELECT * FROM #results1

	-- 7A. Return the UptimeLogsITStoreAllTickets record details.

	DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #uptimeLogsITStoreAllTickets

	SELECT DISTINCT
		t1.UptimeLogsITStoreAllTicketPK, 
		-1 AS UptimeLogsDetailFK, --t1.UptimeLogsDetailFK, 
		t1.UptimeLogsCategoryFK, 
		ulc.UptimeLogsCategory, 
		ulbc.CategoryScreenOrder,
		t1.NoOfTickets,
		t1.TimeSpentMinutes,
		t1.NoOfOpenToDoTickets,
		t1.NoOfInvestigationReferredTickets,
		t1.NoOfResolvedClosedTickets,
		t1.NoOfWaitingForCustomerTickets,
		CAST(0 AS BIT) AS TotalsRow
	INTO
		#uptimeLogsITStoreAllTickets
	FROM
		dbo.tblUptimeLogsITStoreAllTickets t1 WITH (NOLOCK)
	INNER JOIN dbo.tblUptimeLogsBuildingCategories ulbc WITH (NOLOCK)
		ON t1.UptimeLogsCategoryFK = ulbc.UptimeLogsCategoryFK		
	INNER JOIN dbo.appUptimeLogsTables ult WITH (NOLOCK)
		ON ulbc.UptimeLogsTableFK = ult.UptimeLogsTablePK
	INNER JOIN dbo.appUptimeLogsCategories ulc WITH (NOLOCK)
		ON ulbc.UptimeLogsCategoryFK = ulc.UptimeLogsCategoryPK
	INNER JOIN #uptimeLogsDetails tmp1
		ON t1.UptimeLogsDetailFK = tmp1.UptimeLogsDetailPK
	WHERE
		ult.UptimeLogsTableName = 'tblUptimeLogsITStoreAllTickets'
		AND ulbc.BuildingFK = @varBuildingFK

	DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #uptimeLogsITStoreAllTicketsIncludingTotals

	SELECT
		-1 AS UptimeLogsITStoreAllTicketPK, --t1.UptimeLogsITStoreAllTicketPK, 
		t1.UptimeLogsDetailFK, 
		t1.UptimeLogsCategoryFK, 
		t1.UptimeLogsCategory, 
		t1.CategoryScreenOrder,
		SUM(ISNULL(t1.NoOfTickets,0)) AS NoOfTickets,
		SUM(ISNULL(t1.TimeSpentMinutes,0)) AS TimeSpentMinutes,

		CASE 
			WHEN SUM(ISNULL(t1.TimeSpentMinutes,0)) < 1 THEN CAST(0.00 AS DECIMAL(18,2))
			ELSE ROUND(CAST(CAST(SUM(ISNULL(t1.TimeSpentMinutes,0)) AS DECIMAL(18, 2)) / CAST(SUM(ISNULL(t1.NoOfTickets,0)) AS DECIMAL(18, 2)) AS DECIMAL(18,2)), 0) 
		END AS AvgTimeToResolveTickets,

		SUM(ISNULL(t1.NoOfOpenToDoTickets,0)) AS NoOfOpenToDoTickets,
		SUM(ISNULL(t1.NoOfInvestigationReferredTickets,0)) AS NoOfInvestigationReferredTickets,
		SUM(ISNULL(t1.NoOfResolvedClosedTickets,0)) AS NoOfResolvedClosedTickets,
		SUM(ISNULL(t1.NoOfWaitingForCustomerTickets,0)) AS NoOfWaitingForCustomerTickets,

		CASE
			WHEN SUM(ISNULL(t1.NoOfTickets,0)) < 1 THEN 
				'0.00'
			ELSE
				CAST(ROUND(CAST(
						((CAST(SUM(ISNULL(t1.NoOfResolvedClosedTickets,0)) AS DECIMAL(18,2)) / CAST(SUM(ISNULL(t1.NoOfTickets,0)) AS DECIMAL(18,2))) * 100.00)
						AS DECIMAL(18,2)),2) AS NVARCHAR(50))
		END + '%' AS ResolvedPercentage,

		CAST(0 AS BIT) AS TotalsRow
	INTO
		#uptimeLogsITStoreAllTicketsIncludingTotals
	FROM
		#uptimeLogsITStoreAllTickets t1
	GROUP BY
		t1.UptimeLogsDetailFK, 
		t1.UptimeLogsCategoryFK, 
		t1.UptimeLogsCategory, 
		t1.CategoryScreenOrder

	UNION

	SELECT 
		-1 AS UptimeLogsITStoreAllTicketPK,
		t1.UptimeLogsDetailFK,
		-1 AS UptimeLogsCategoryFK,
		'Total' AS UptimeLogsCategory,
		999999999 AS CategoryScreenOrder,
		SUM(ISNULL(t1.NoOfTickets,0)) AS NoOfTickets,
		SUM(ISNULL(t1.TimeSpentMinutes,0)) AS TimeSpentMinutes,

		CASE 
			WHEN SUM(ISNULL(t1.TimeSpentMinutes,0)) < 1 THEN CAST(0.00 AS DECIMAL(18,2))
			ELSE ROUND(CAST(CAST(SUM(ISNULL(t1.TimeSpentMinutes,0)) AS DECIMAL(18, 2)) / CAST(SUM(ISNULL(t1.NoOfTickets,0)) AS DECIMAL(18, 2)) AS DECIMAL(18,2)), 2) 
			END
		AS AvgTimeToResolveTickets,

		SUM(ISNULL(t1.NoOfOpenToDoTickets,0)) AS NoOfOpenToDoTickets,
		SUM(ISNULL(t1.NoOfInvestigationReferredTickets,0)) AS NoOfInvestigationReferredTickets,
		SUM(ISNULL(t1.NoOfResolvedClosedTickets,0)) AS NoOfResolvedClosedTickets,
		SUM(ISNULL(t1.NoOfWaitingForCustomerTickets,0)) AS NoOfWaitingForCustomerTickets,

		CASE
			WHEN SUM(ISNULL(t1.NoOfTickets,0)) < 1 THEN 
				'0.00'
			ELSE
				CAST(ROUND(CAST(
						((CAST(SUM(ISNULL(t1.NoOfResolvedClosedTickets,0)) AS DECIMAL(18,2)) / CAST(SUM(ISNULL(t1.NoOfTickets,0)) AS DECIMAL(18,2))) * 100.00)
						AS DECIMAL(18,2)),2) AS NVARCHAR(50))
		END + '%' AS ResolvedPercentage,

		CAST(1 AS BIT) AS TotalsRow
	FROM
		#uptimeLogsITStoreAllTickets t1
	GROUP BY
		t1.UptimeLogsDetailFK

	SELECT 
		t1.UptimeLogsITStoreAllTicketPK, 
		t1.UptimeLogsDetailFK, 
		t1.UptimeLogsCategoryFK, 
		t1.UptimeLogsCategory, 
		t1.CategoryScreenOrder,
		t1.NoOfTickets,
		dbo.fnGetHoursAndMinutesTimeFormatForMinutes(t1.TimeSpentMinutes) AS TimeSpent,
		dbo.fnGetHoursAndMinutesTimeFormatForMinutes(t1.AvgTimeToResolveTickets) AS AvgTimeToResolveTickets,
		t1.NoOfOpenToDoTickets,
		t1.NoOfInvestigationReferredTickets,
		t1.NoOfResolvedClosedTickets,
		t1.NoOfWaitingForCustomerTickets,
		t1.ResolvedPercentage,
		t1.TotalsRow
	FROM 
		#uptimeLogsITStoreAllTicketsIncludingTotals t1
	ORDER BY
		CategoryScreenOrder ASC

	-- 7B. Return the Customer Integration Files record details.

	DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #stock

	SELECT 
		CAST('In' AS NVARCHAR(3)) AS StockDirection,
		t1.CustomerFK,
		cust.CustomerCode,
		cust.CustomerName,
		ISNULL(COUNT(DISTINCT t1.IntegrationFilePK), 0) AS NoOfProcessedFiles
	INTO
		#stock
	FROM
		dbo.tblIntegrationFiles t1 WITH (NOLOCK)
	INNER JOIN appIntegrationFileTypes t2 WITH (NOLOCK)
		ON t1.IntegrationFileTypeFK = t2.IntegrationFileTypePK
	INNER JOIN dbo.tblContainerIns t3 WITH (NOLOCK)
		ON t1.FK = t3.ContainerInPK
	INNER JOIN dbo.viewBuildingDetails vbd WITH (NOLOCK)
		ON t3.BuildingUnitFK = vbd.BuildingUnitPK
	INNER JOIN dbo.tblCustomers cust WITH (NOLOCK)
		ON t1.CustomerFK = cust.CustomerPK
	WHERE
		CAST(t1.InsertedDate AS DATE) >= @varDataStartDate
		AND CAST(t1.InsertedDate AS DATE) < DATEADD(DAY, 1, @varDataEndDate)
		AND t1.FK > 0
		AND t2.IntegrationFileTypeDescription =  'Stock Inward'
	GROUP BY
		t1.CustomerFK,
		cust.CustomerCode,
		cust.CustomerName

	INSERT INTO #stock
	SELECT
		'Out' AS StockDirection,
		t1.CustomerFK,
		cust.CustomerCode,
		cust.CustomerName,
		ISNULL(COUNT(DISTINCT t1.IntegrationFilePK), 0) AS NoOfProcessedFiles
	FROM
		dbo.tblIntegrationFiles t1 WITH (NOLOCK)
	INNER JOIN appIntegrationFileTypes t2 WITH (NOLOCK)
		ON t1.IntegrationFileTypeFK = t2.IntegrationFileTypePK
	INNER JOIN dbo.tblContainerOuts t3 WITH (NOLOCK)
		ON t1.FK = t3.ContainerOutPK
	INNER JOIN dbo.tblStockOrders t4 WITH (NOLOCK)
		ON t3.ContainerOutPK = t4.ContainerOutFK
	INNER JOIN dbo.viewBuildingDetails vbd WITH (NOLOCK)
		ON t4.ResponsibleBuildingUnitFK = vbd.BuildingUnitPK
	INNER JOIN dbo.tblCustomers cust WITH (NOLOCK)
		ON t1.CustomerFK = cust.CustomerPK
	WHERE 
		CAST(t1.InsertedDate AS DATE) >= @varDataStartDate
		AND CAST(t1.InsertedDate AS DATE) < DATEADD(DAY, 1, @varDataEndDate)
		AND t1.FK > 0
		AND t2.IntegrationFileTypeDescription =  'Stock Outward'
	GROUP BY
		t1.CustomerFK,
		cust.CustomerCode,
		cust.CustomerName

	DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #stockResults

	SELECT StockDirection, 'Danone' AS Customer, SUM(NoOfProcessedFiles) AS NoOfProcessedFiles  
	INTO #stockResults
	FROM #stock 
	WHERE CustomerName like '%danone%'
	GROUP BY StockDirection

	UNION

	SELECT StockDirection, 'Glanbia' AS Customer, SUM(NoOfProcessedFiles) AS NoOfProcessedFiles  
	FROM #stock
	WHERE CustomerName like '%glanbia%'
	GROUP BY StockDirection

	UNION

	SELECT StockDirection, Customer, SUM(NoOfProcessedFiles) AS NoOfProcessedFiles
	FROM
		(
		SELECT StockDirection, 'GSK' AS Customer, SUM(NoOfProcessedFiles) AS NoOfProcessedFiles  
		FROM #stock
		WHERE CustomerName like '%glaxo%smith%kline%'
		GROUP BY StockDirection
		UNION
		SELECT StockDirection, 'GSK' AS Customer, SUM(NoOfProcessedFiles) AS NoOfProcessedFiles  
		FROM #stock
		WHERE CustomerName like '%gsk%'
		GROUP BY StockDirection
		) AS subQuery
	GROUP BY
		StockDirection,
		Customer

	SELECT 
		@varDanoneNoOfProcessedStockInFiles = NoOfProcessedFiles
	FROM 
		#stockResults
	WHERE
		StockDirection = 'In' 
		AND Customer = 'Danone'

	SELECT 
		@varDanoneNoOfProcessedStockOutFiles = NoOfProcessedFiles
	FROM 
		#stockResults
	WHERE
		StockDirection = 'Out'
		AND Customer = 'Danone'

	SELECT 
		@varGlanbiaNoOfProcessedStockInFiles = NoOfProcessedFiles
	FROM 
		#stockResults
	WHERE
		StockDirection = 'In' 
		AND Customer = 'Glanbia'

	SELECT 
		@varGlanbiaNoOfProcessedStockOutFiles = NoOfProcessedFiles
	FROM 
		#stockResults
	WHERE
		StockDirection = 'Out'
		AND Customer = 'Glanbia'

	SELECT 
		@varGSKNoOfProcessedStockInFiles = NoOfProcessedFiles
	FROM 
		#stockResults
	WHERE
		StockDirection = 'In' 
		AND Customer = 'GSK'

	SELECT 
		@varGSKNoOfProcessedStockOutFiles = NoOfProcessedFiles
	FROM 
		#stockResults
	WHERE
		StockDirection = 'Out'
		AND Customer = 'GSK'

	DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #finalCustomerIntegrationFilesResults

	SELECT 
		1 AS PK,
		'Stock In' AS UptimeLogsCategory,
		@varDanoneNoOfProcessedStockInFiles AS [DanoneNoOfProcessedFiles],
		@varGlanbiaNoOfProcessedStockInFiles AS [GlanbiaNoOfProcessedFiles],
		@varGSKNoOfProcessedStockInFiles AS [GSKNoOfProcessedFiles],
		@varDanoneNoOfProcessedStockInFiles + @varGlanbiaNoOfProcessedStockInFiles + @varGSKNoOfProcessedStockInFiles AS TotalNoOfProcessedFiles,
		CAST(0 AS BIT) AS TotalsRow		 
	INTO
		#finalCustomerIntegrationFilesResults
	UNION
	SELECT 
		2 AS PK,
		'Stock Out' AS UptimeLogsCategory,
		@varDanoneNoOfProcessedStockOutFiles AS [DanoneNoOfProcessedFiles],
		@varGlanbiaNoOfProcessedStockOutFiles AS [GlanbiaNoOfProcessedFiles],
		@varGSKNoOfProcessedStockOutFiles AS [GSKNoOfProcessedFiles],
		@varDanoneNoOfProcessedStockOutFiles + @varGlanbiaNoOfProcessedStockOutFiles + @varGSKNoOfProcessedStockOutFiles AS TotalNoOfProcessedFiles,
		CAST(0 AS BIT) AS TotalsRow
	UNION
	SELECT 
		3 AS PK,
		'Total' AS UptimeLogsCategory,
		@varDanoneNoOfProcessedStockInFiles + @varDanoneNoOfProcessedStockOutFiles AS [DanoneNoOfProcessedFiles],
		@varGlanbiaNoOfProcessedStockInFiles + @varGlanbiaNoOfProcessedStockOutFiles AS [GlanbiaNoOfProcessedFiles],
		@varGSKNoOfProcessedStockInFiles + @varGSKNoOfProcessedStockOutFiles AS [GSKNoOfProcessedFiles],
		@varDanoneNoOfProcessedStockInFiles + @varDanoneNoOfProcessedStockOutFiles
			+ @varGlanbiaNoOfProcessedStockInFiles + @varGlanbiaNoOfProcessedStockOutFiles
				+ @varGSKNoOfProcessedStockInFiles + @varGSKNoOfProcessedStockOutFiles AS [TotalNoOfProcessedFiles],
		CAST(1 AS BIT) AS TotalsRow

	SELECT 
		* 
	FROM 
		#finalCustomerIntegrationFilesResults 
	ORDER BY 
		PK ASC

	-- 7C. Return the UptimeLogsITCustomerTickets record details.

	DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #uptimeLogsITCustomerTickets

	SELECT DISTINCT
		t1.UptimeLogsITCustomerTicketPK, 
		-1 AS UptimeLogsDetailFK, --t1.UptimeLogsDetailFK,
		t1.UptimeLogsCategoryFK, 
		ulc.UptimeLogsCategory,

	INTO

	FROM

	INNER JOIN dbo.tblUptimeLogsBuildingCategories ulbc WITH (NOLOCK)
		ON t1.UptimeLogsCategoryFK = ulbc.UptimeLogsCategoryFK		
	INNER JOIN dbo.appUptimeLogsTables ult WITH (NOLOCK)
		ON ulbc.UptimeLogsTableFK = ult.UptimeLogsTablePK
	INNER JOIN dbo.appUptimeLogsCategories ulc WITH (NOLOCK)
		ON ulbc.UptimeLogsCategoryFK = ulc.UptimeLogsCategoryPK
	INNER JOIN #uptimeLogsDetails tmp1
		ON t1.UptimeLogsDetailFK = tmp1.UptimeLogsDetailPK
	WHERE
		ult.UptimeLogsTableName = 'tblUptimeLogsITCustomerTickets'
		AND ulbc.BuildingFK = @varBuildingFK

	DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #uptimeLogsITCustomerTicketsFinalResults

	SELECT
		-1 AS UptimeLogsITCustomerTicketPK, 
		UptimeLogsDetailFK, 
		UptimeLogsCategoryFK, 
		UptimeLogsCategory, 
		CategoryScreenOrder,			
		SUM(ISNULL(NoOfDanoneTickets,0)) AS NoOfDanoneTickets,
		SUM(ISNULL(NoOfGlanbiaTickets,0)) AS NoOfGlanbiaTickets,
		SUM(ISNULL(NoOfGSKTickets,0)) AS NoOfGSKTickets,
		SUM(ISNULL(TimeSpentMinutes,0)) AS TimeSpentMinutes,
		SUM(ISNULL(NoOfOpenToDoTickets,0)) AS NoOfOpenToDoTickets,
		SUM(ISNULL(NoOfResolvedClosedTickets,0)) AS NoOfResolvedClosedTickets,
		SUM(ISNULL(NoOfDanoneTickets,0)) + SUM(ISNULL(NoOfGlanbiaTickets,0)) + SUM(ISNULL(NoOfGSKTickets,0)) AS TotalTickets,
		CAST(0 AS BIT) AS TotalsRow
	INTO
		#uptimeLogsITCustomerTicketsFinalResults
	FROM
		#uptimeLogsITCustomerTickets
	GROUP BY
		UptimeLogsDetailFK, 
		UptimeLogsCategoryFK, 
		UptimeLogsCategory, 
		CategoryScreenOrder
	UNION
	SELECT		
		-1 AS UptimeLogsITCustomerTicketPK, 
		t1.UptimeLogsDetailFK, 
		-1 AS UptimeLogsCategoryFK, 
		'Total' AS UptimeLogsCategory, 
		999999999 AS CategoryScreenOrder,

		SUM(NoOfDanoneTickets) AS NoOfDanoneTickets,
		SUM(NoOfGlanbiaTickets) AS NoOfGlanbiaTickets,
		SUM(NoOfGSKTickets) AS NoOfGSKTickets,
		SUM(TimeSpentMinutes) AS TimeSpentMinutes,
		SUM(NoOfOpenToDoTickets) AS NoOfOpenToDoTickets,
		SUM(NoOfResolvedClosedTickets) AS NoOfResolvedClosedTickets,
		SUM(NoOfDanoneTickets) + SUM(NoOfGlanbiaTickets) + SUM(NoOfGSKTickets) AS TotalTickets,
		CAST(1 AS BIT) AS TotalsRow
	FROM
		#uptimeLogsITCustomerTickets t1
	GROUP BY
		t1.UptimeLogsDetailFK

	SELECT
		UptimeLogsITCustomerTicketPK, 
		UptimeLogsDetailFK, 
		UptimeLogsCategoryFK, 
		UptimeLogsCategory, 
		CategoryScreenOrder,
		NoOfDanoneTickets,
		NoOfGlanbiaTickets,
		NoOfGSKTickets,
		dbo.fnGetHoursAndMinutesTimeFormatForMinutes(TimeSpentMinutes) AS TimeSpent,
		NoOfOpenToDoTickets,
		NoOfResolvedClosedTickets,
		TotalTickets,
		TotalsRow		
	FROM
		#uptimeLogsITCustomerTicketsFinalResults
	ORDER BY
		CategoryScreenOrder ASC

	-- 7C. Return the UptimeLogsITExternalIssues record details.

	DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #uptimeLogsITExternalIssues

	SELECT DISTINCT
		t1.UptimeLogsITExternalIssuePK, 
		-1 AS UptimeLogsDetailFK, --t1.UptimeLogsDetailFK, 
		t1.UptimeLogsCategoryFK, 
		ulc.UptimeLogsCategory, 
		ulbc.CategoryScreenOrder,	
		t1.NoOfJiraTickets,
		t1.TimeSpentMinutes,
		t1.DowntimeMinutes
	INTO
		#uptimeLogsITExternalIssues
	FROM
		dbo.tblUptimeLogsITExternalIssues t1 WITH (NOLOCK)
	INNER JOIN dbo.tblUptimeLogsBuildingCategories ulbc WITH (NOLOCK)
		ON t1.UptimeLogsCategoryFK = ulbc.UptimeLogsCategoryFK		
	INNER JOIN dbo.appUptimeLogsTables ult WITH (NOLOCK)
		ON ulbc.UptimeLogsTableFK = ult.UptimeLogsTablePK
	INNER JOIN dbo.appUptimeLogsCategories ulc WITH (NOLOCK)
		ON ulbc.UptimeLogsCategoryFK = ulc.UptimeLogsCategoryPK
	INNER JOIN #uptimeLogsDetails tmp1
		ON t1.UptimeLogsDetailFK = tmp1.UptimeLogsDetailPK
	WHERE
		ult.UptimeLogsTableName = 'tblUptimeLogsITExternalIssues'
		AND ulbc.BuildingFK = @varBuildingFK

	DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #uptimeLogsITExternalIssuesFinalResults

	DECLARE @weekInMinutes DECIMAL(18,2) = 10080.00/*No. of minutes in a 7 day week*/--ZXC

	SET @weekInMinutes = @weekInMinutes * @varNoOfWeeksOfData

	SELECT 
		-1 AS UptimeLogsITExternalIssuePK, --t1.UptimeLogsITExternalIssuePK, 
		t1.UptimeLogsDetailFK, 
		t1.UptimeLogsCategoryFK, 
		t1.UptimeLogsCategory, 
		t1.CategoryScreenOrder,		
		SUM(ISNULL(t1.NoOfJiraTickets,0)) AS NoOfJiraTickets,
		SUM(ISNULL(t1.TimeSpentMinutes,0)) AS TimeSpentMinutes,
		SUM(ISNULL(t1.DowntimeMinutes,0)) AS DowntimeMinutes,
		CAST(CAST(ROUND((((@weekInMinutes - SUM(ISNULL(t1.DowntimeMinutes,0))) / @weekInMinutes) * 100.00), 2) AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS NVARCHAR(50)) + '%' AS PercentageUptime,
		CAST(0 AS BIT) AS TotalsRow
	INTO
		#uptimeLogsITExternalIssuesFinalResults
	FROM
		#uptimeLogsITExternalIssues t1
	GROUP BY
		t1.UptimeLogsDetailFK, 
		t1.UptimeLogsCategoryFK, 
		t1.UptimeLogsCategory, 
		t1.CategoryScreenOrder
	UNION
	SELECT 
		-1 AS UptimeLogsITExternalIssuePK, 
		t1.UptimeLogsDetailFK, 
		-1 AS UptimeLogsCategoryFK, 
		'Total' AS UptimeLogsCategory, 
		999999999 AS CategoryScreenOrder,	
		SUM(t1.NoOfJiraTickets) AS NoOfJiraTickets,
		SUM(t1.TimeSpentMinutes) AS TimeSpentMinutes,
		SUM(t1.DowntimeMinutes) AS DowntimeMinutes,
		CAST(CAST(ROUND((((@weekInMinutes - SUM(ISNULL(t1.DowntimeMinutes,0))) / @weekInMinutes) * 100.00), 2) AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS NVARCHAR(50)) + '%' AS PercentageUptime, 
		CAST(1 AS BIT) AS TotalsRow
	FROM
		#uptimeLogsITExternalIssues t1
	GROUP BY
		t1.UptimeLogsDetailFK

	SELECT
		t1.UptimeLogsITExternalIssuePK, 
		t1.UptimeLogsDetailFK, 
		t1.UptimeLogsCategoryFK, 
		t1.UptimeLogsCategory, 
		t1.CategoryScreenOrder,	
		t1.NoOfJiraTickets,
		dbo.fnGetHoursAndMinutesTimeFormatForMinutes(t1.TimeSpentMinutes) AS TimeSpent,
		dbo.fnGetHoursAndMinutesTimeFormatForMinutes(t1.DowntimeMinutes) AS Downtime,
		t1.PercentageUptime,
		t1.TotalsRow
	FROM
		#uptimeLogsITExternalIssuesFinalResults t1
	ORDER BY
		t1.CategoryScreenOrder ASC
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spUptimeLogsUpdateIntegrationFilesRecord]
(
	@uptimeLogDate DATE,
	@buildingFK INT
)
AS
BEGIN
	DECLARE @varBuildingFK INT = @buildingFK, @varUptimeLogDate DATE = @uptimeLogDate, @varNoOfStockInFiles INT, @varNoOfStockOutFiles INT

	SELECT 
		@varUptimeLogDate =	CASE 
								WHEN LEFT(DATENAME(dw, @varUptimeLogDate), 3) = 'Tue' THEN DATEADD(DAY, -1, @varUptimeLogDate)
								WHEN LEFT(DATENAME(dw, @varUptimeLogDate), 3) = 'Wed' THEN DATEADD(DAY, -2, @varUptimeLogDate)
								WHEN LEFT(DATENAME(dw, @varUptimeLogDate), 3) = 'Thu' THEN DATEADD(DAY, -3, @varUptimeLogDate)
								WHEN LEFT(DATENAME(dw, @varUptimeLogDate), 3) = 'Fri' THEN DATEADD(DAY, -4, @varUptimeLogDate)
								WHEN LEFT(DATENAME(dw, @varUptimeLogDate), 3) = 'Sat' THEN DATEADD(DAY, -5, @varUptimeLogDate)
								WHEN LEFT(DATENAME(dw, @varUptimeLogDate), 3) = 'Sun' THEN DATEADD(DAY, -6, @varUptimeLogDate)
							ELSE
								@varUptimeLogDate
							END

	SELECT 
		@varNoOfStockInFiles = ISNULL(COUNT(DISTINCT t1.IntegrationFilePK), 0)
	FROM
		dbo.tblIntegrationFiles t1 WITH (NOLOCK)
	INNER JOIN appIntegrationFileTypes t2 WITH (NOLOCK)
		ON t1.IntegrationFileTypeFK = t2.IntegrationFileTypePK
	INNER JOIN dbo.tblContainerIns t3 WITH (NOLOCK)
		ON t1.FK = t3.ContainerInPK
	INNER JOIN dbo.viewBuildingDetails vbd WITH (NOLOCK)
		ON t3.BuildingUnitFK = vbd.BuildingUnitPK
	WHERE
		CAST(t1.InsertedDate AS DATE) >= @varUptimeLogDate
		AND CAST(t1.InsertedDate AS DATE) <= DATEADD(DAY, 6, @varUptimeLogDate)
		AND t1.FK > 0
		AND t2.IntegrationFileTypeDescription =  'Stock Inward'
		AND vbd.BuildingPK = @varBuildingFK
	
	SELECT
		@varNoOfStockOutFiles = ISNULL(COUNT(DISTINCT t1.IntegrationFilePK), 0)
	FROM
		dbo.tblIntegrationFiles t1 WITH (NOLOCK)
	INNER JOIN appIntegrationFileTypes t2 WITH (NOLOCK)
		ON t1.IntegrationFileTypeFK = t2.IntegrationFileTypePK
	INNER JOIN dbo.tblContainerOuts t3 WITH (NOLOCK)
		ON t1.FK = t3.ContainerOutPK
	INNER JOIN dbo.tblStockOrders t4 WITH (NOLOCK)
		ON t3.ContainerOutPK = t4.ContainerOutFK
	INNER JOIN dbo.viewBuildingDetails vbd WITH (NOLOCK)
		ON t4.ResponsibleBuildingUnitFK = vbd.BuildingUnitPK
	WHERE 
		CAST(t1.InsertedDate AS DATE) >= @varUptimeLogDate
		AND CAST(t1.InsertedDate AS DATE) <= DATEADD(DAY, 6, @varUptimeLogDate)
		AND t1.FK > 0
		AND t2.IntegrationFileTypeDescription =  'Stock Outward'
		AND vbd.BuildingPK = @varBuildingFK

	SELECT @varNoOfStockInFiles = ISNULL(@varNoOfStockInFiles, 0), @varNoOfStockOutFiles = ISNULL(@varNoOfStockOutFiles, 0)

	UPDATE t1 WITH (ROWLOCK)
	SET 
		NoOfFilesIn = @varNoOfStockInFiles,
		NoOfFilesOut = @varNoOfStockOutFiles,
		UpdatedBy = 0,
		UpdatedDate = dbo.GetBSTDate()
	FROM 
		dbo.tblUptimeLogsIntegrationFiles t1
	INNER JOIN dbo.tblUptimeLogsDetails t2
		ON t1.UptimeLogsDetailFK = t2.UptimeLogsDetailPK
	WHERE 
		t2.UptimeLogDate = @varUptimeLogDate
		AND t2.BuildingFK = @varBuildingFK
		--AND t1.NoOfFilesIn = 0
		--AND t1.NoOfFilesOut = 0	
END
GO

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spUptimeLogsUpdateITCustomerTickets]
(
--declare
	@uptimeLogDate DATE

	/*select max(buildingpk) from dbo.tblBuildings where DepartmentTMS = 'Kilcohan'*/

	--select @uptimeLogDate = '2020-03-02'
)
AS
BEGIN
	IF @uptimeLogDate IS NULL RETURN;

	DECLARE 
		@varUptimeLogDate DATE = @uptimeLogDate, @varNoOfStockInFiles INT, @varNoOfStockOutFiles INT,
		@varStartDateString NVARCHAR(10), @varCustomerIssues INT = 0, @varStoreAllIssues INT = 0, @varIntegratedCustomerName NVARCHAR(200) = '',
		@varBuildingName NVARCHAR(200), @sqlCommand nvarchar(max);	

	SELECT 
		@varUptimeLogDate =	CASE 
								WHEN LEFT(DATENAME(dw, @varUptimeLogDate), 3) = 'Tue' THEN DATEADD(DAY, -1, @varUptimeLogDate)
								WHEN LEFT(DATENAME(dw, @varUptimeLogDate), 3) = 'Wed' THEN DATEADD(DAY, -2, @varUptimeLogDate)
								WHEN LEFT(DATENAME(dw, @varUptimeLogDate), 3) = 'Thu' THEN DATEADD(DAY, -3, @varUptimeLogDate)
								WHEN LEFT(DATENAME(dw, @varUptimeLogDate), 3) = 'Fri' THEN DATEADD(DAY, -4, @varUptimeLogDate)
								WHEN LEFT(DATENAME(dw, @varUptimeLogDate), 3) = 'Sat' THEN DATEADD(DAY, -5, @varUptimeLogDate)
								WHEN LEFT(DATENAME(dw, @varUptimeLogDate), 3) = 'Sun' THEN DATEADD(DAY, -6, @varUptimeLogDate)
							ELSE
								@varUptimeLogDate
							END;

	SET @varStartDateString = CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), @varUptimeLogDate, 21);

	-- 1. Add the issues numbers.

	DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #jiraTicketDetails;

	CREATE TABLE #jiraTicketDetails
	(			
		StartDate DATE,
		EndDate DATE,
		JiraTicketDetailPK INT,
		TypeName NVARCHAR(50),
		CreatedDateTime	DATETIME,
		KeyCode	NVARCHAR(50),
		ResolutionDateTime DATETIME,
		CurrentStatusName NVARCHAR(50),
		MostRecentStatusWithinDateRange NVARCHAR(50),
		BuildingName VARCHAR(200),
		TicketTypeName NVARCHAR(50),
		TicketTypeValue NVARCHAR(50),
		IntegratedCustomerName NVARCHAR(200),
		TimeSpentInMinutesWithinDateRange INT,
		FailureReason NVARCHAR(200),
		DataSource NVARCHAR(MAX)
	);

	SET @sqlCommand = 'EXEC dbo.spGetJiraTicketDetailsForDateRange ''' + @varStartDateString + '''';

	INSERT INTO #jiraTicketDetails
	EXEC sp_execute_remote N'StawmsReportingDataSource', @sqlCommand;

	IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #jiraTicketDetails) GOTO EXIT_PROC;

	DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #allCustomerIntegrationTicketDetails

	SELECT * INTO #allCustomerIntegrationTicketDetails FROM #jiraTicketDetails WHERE TypeName = 'Integration' OR TicketTypeName = 'Integration'

	DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #integrationTicketDetailsRootCauseCustomerIssue

	SELECT * INTO #integrationTicketDetailsRootCauseCustomerIssue FROM #allCustomerIntegrationTicketDetails WHERE FailureReason NOT IN ('Store-all user error', 'WMS not processing order when sufficient stock is available')

	-- Integration Issues Ticket section

	DECLARE 
		@varDanoneNoOfIntegrationIssueTickets INT = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM #allCustomerIntegrationTicketDetails WHERE IntegratedCustomerName = 'Danone' ),
		@varGlanbiaNoOfIntegrationIssueTickets INT = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM #allCustomerIntegrationTicketDetails WHERE IntegratedCustomerName = 'Glanbia'),
		@varGSKNoOfIntegrationIssueTickets INT = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM #allCustomerIntegrationTicketDetails WHERE IntegratedCustomerName = 'GSK' ),
		@varIntegrationIssueTicketsTimeSpent INT = (SELECT SUM(ISNULL(TimeSpentInMinutesWithinDateRange,0)) FROM #allCustomerIntegrationTicketDetails WHERE IntegratedCustomerName IN ('Danone', 'Glanbia', 'GSK')),
		@varIntegrationOpenIssueTickets INT = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM #allCustomerIntegrationTicketDetails WHERE MostRecentStatusWithinDateRange NOT IN ('Closed', 'Resolved')),
		@varIntegrationClosedIssueTickets INT = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM #allCustomerIntegrationTicketDetails WHERE MostRecentStatusWithinDateRange IN ('Closed', 'Resolved')),

		@varDanoneNoOfIntegrationIssueTicketsRootCauseCustomerIssue INT = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM #integrationTicketDetailsRootCauseCustomerIssue WHERE IntegratedCustomerName = 'Danone' ),
		@varGlanbiaNoOfIntegrationIssueTicketsRootCauseCustomerIssue INT = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM #integrationTicketDetailsRootCauseCustomerIssue WHERE IntegratedCustomerName = 'Glanbia'),
		@varGSKNoOfIntegrationIssueTicketsRootCauseCustomerIssue INT = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM #integrationTicketDetailsRootCauseCustomerIssue WHERE IntegratedCustomerName = 'GSK' ),
		@varIntegrationIssueTicketsTimeSpentRootCauseCustomerIssue INT = (SELECT SUM(ISNULL(TimeSpentInMinutesWithinDateRange,0)) FROM #integrationTicketDetailsRootCauseCustomerIssue WHERE IntegratedCustomerName IN ('Danone', 'Glanbia', 'GSK')),
		@varIntegrationOpenIssueTicketsRootCauseCustomerIssue INT = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM #integrationTicketDetailsRootCauseCustomerIssue WHERE MostRecentStatusWithinDateRange NOT IN ('Closed', 'Resolved')),
		@varIntegrationClosedIssueTicketsRootCauseCustomerIssue INT = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM #integrationTicketDetailsRootCauseCustomerIssue WHERE MostRecentStatusWithinDateRange IN ('Closed', 'Resolved'))

	UPDATE t1
	SET 
		NoOfDanoneTickets = @varDanoneNoOfIntegrationIssueTickets,
		NoOfGlanbiaTickets = @varGlanbiaNoOfIntegrationIssueTickets,
		NoOfGSKTickets = @varGSKNoOfIntegrationIssueTickets,
		TimeSpentMinutes = @varIntegrationIssueTicketsTimeSpent,
		NoOfOpenToDoTickets = @varIntegrationOpenIssueTickets,
		NoOfResolvedClosedTickets = @varIntegrationClosedIssueTickets
	FROM 
		dbo.tblUptimeLogsITCustomerTickets t1
	INNER JOIN dbo.tblUptimeLogsDetails t2
		ON t1.UptimeLogsDetailFK = t2.UptimeLogsDetailPK
	INNER JOIN dbo.appUptimeLogsCategories t3
		ON t1.UptimeLogsCategoryFK = t3.UptimeLogsCategoryPK
	WHERE 
		t2.BuildingFK = 8888/*IT*/
		AND t2.UptimeLogDate = @varUptimeLogDate
		AND t3.UptimeLogsCategory = 'Integration Issue Tickets'

	UPDATE t1
	SET 
		NoOfDanoneTickets = @varDanoneNoOfIntegrationIssueTicketsRootCauseCustomerIssue,
		NoOfGlanbiaTickets = @varGlanbiaNoOfIntegrationIssueTicketsRootCauseCustomerIssue,
		NoOfGSKTickets = @varGSKNoOfIntegrationIssueTicketsRootCauseCustomerIssue,
		TimeSpentMinutes = @varIntegrationIssueTicketsTimeSpentRootCauseCustomerIssue,
		NoOfOpenToDoTickets = @varIntegrationOpenIssueTicketsRootCauseCustomerIssue,
		NoOfResolvedClosedTickets = @varIntegrationClosedIssueTicketsRootCauseCustomerIssue
	FROM 
		dbo.tblUptimeLogsITCustomerTickets t1
	INNER JOIN dbo.tblUptimeLogsDetails t2
		ON t1.UptimeLogsDetailFK = t2.UptimeLogsDetailPK
	INNER JOIN dbo.appUptimeLogsCategories t3
		ON t1.UptimeLogsCategoryFK = t3.UptimeLogsCategoryPK
	WHERE 
		t2.BuildingFK = 8888/*IT*/
		AND t2.UptimeLogDate = @varUptimeLogDate
		AND t3.UptimeLogsCategory = 'Customer Request Tickets'
	
	--SELECT
	--	DISTINCT t3.UptimeLogsCategory, t1.*
	--FROM 
	--	dbo.tblUptimeLogsITCustomerTickets t1
	--INNER JOIN dbo.tblUptimeLogsDetails t2
	--	ON t1.UptimeLogsDetailFK = t2.UptimeLogsDetailPK
	--INNER JOIN dbo.appUptimeLogsCategories t3
	--	ON t1.UptimeLogsCategoryFK = t3.UptimeLogsCategoryPK
	--WHERE 
	--	t2.BuildingFK = 8888/*IT*/
	--	AND t2.UptimeLogDate = @varUptimeLogDate
	
	EXIT_PROC:

END
GO

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spUptimeLogsUpdatePhysicalChecksRecord] --[dbo].[spUptimeLogsUpdatePhysicalChecksRecord] '2020-01-22', 11 /*BV4*/ --30 /*BV5*/
(
--declare
	@uptimeLogDate DATE,
	@buildingFK INT

	--select @collectionDate = '2020-01-22', @buildingFK = 11 /*BV4*/ --30 /*BV5*/
)
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ UNCOMMITTED; SET DEADLOCK_PRIORITY LOW

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT
	,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;

	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	DECLARE @varUptimeLogDate DATE, @varBuildingFK int

	SET @varUptimeLogDate = @uptimeLogDate
	SET @varBuildingFK = @buildingFK

	SET @ParameterDetails = '@uptimeLogDate = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@varUptimeLogDate AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ', @buildingFK = '+ ISNULL(CAST(@varBuildingFK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'')

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    --BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

		SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END

	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY		
			SELECT 
				@varUptimeLogDate =	CASE 
										WHEN LEFT(DATENAME(dw, @varUptimeLogDate), 3) = 'Tue' THEN DATEADD(DAY, -1, @varUptimeLogDate)
										WHEN LEFT(DATENAME(dw, @varUptimeLogDate), 3) = 'Wed' THEN DATEADD(DAY, -2, @varUptimeLogDate)
										WHEN LEFT(DATENAME(dw, @varUptimeLogDate), 3) = 'Thu' THEN DATEADD(DAY, -3, @varUptimeLogDate)
										WHEN LEFT(DATENAME(dw, @varUptimeLogDate), 3) = 'Fri' THEN DATEADD(DAY, -4, @varUptimeLogDate)
										WHEN LEFT(DATENAME(dw, @varUptimeLogDate), 3) = 'Sat' THEN DATEADD(DAY, -5, @varUptimeLogDate)
										WHEN LEFT(DATENAME(dw, @varUptimeLogDate), 3) = 'Sun' THEN DATEADD(DAY, -6, @varUptimeLogDate)
									ELSE
										@varUptimeLogDate
									END		

			DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #divisions

			SELECT DISTINCT BuildingPK, BuildingName, BuildingUnitPK, BuildingUnit, DivisionFK, DivisionCode, DivisionName,
			[15] as RequirePhysicalCheckDuringMarketStockOrder,[19] as RequirePhysicalCheckDuringScrappageStockOrder,[20] as RequirePhysicalCheckDuringSamplingStockOrder,
			[21] as RequirePhysicalCheckDuringDiscrepencyStockOrder,[22] as RequirePhysicalCheckDuringFactoryStockOrder
			INTO #divisions
			FROM  
			(
				select WorkOrderTypeFK, vbd.BuildingPK, vbd.BuildingName, vbd.BuildingUnitPK, vbd.BuildingUnit, dbu.DivisionFK, div.DivisionCode, div.DivisionName, DivisionWorksOrderPK  
				FROM dbo.viewBuildingDetails vbd
				INNER JOIN dbo.tblDivisionBuildingUnits dbu ON vbd.BuildingUnitPK = dbu.BuildingUnitFK
				INNER JOIN dbo.tblDivisions div ON dbu.DivisionFK = div.DivisionPK
				INNER JOIN tblDivisionWorksOrders DWO ON DIV.DivisionPK = DWO.DIVISIONFK AND WorkOrderTypeFK IN (15,19,20,21,22)
				WHERE vbd.BuildingPK = @varBuildingFK and dwo.IsArchived = 0
			) AS SourceTable  
			PIVOT  
			(  
				count(DivisionWorksOrderPK)
				FOR WorkOrderTypeFK IN ([15],[19],[20],[21],[22])  
			) AS PivotTable;
			
			-- This stored procedures main code, excluding error handling - start

			IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#TempPhysicalChecks') IS NOT NULL
				DROP TABLE #TempPhysicalChecks
	
			SELECT palletFk, worksorderpk, worksorderpalletpk, worksorderpalletresultpk, PalletAccepted, twopr.InsertedDate AS PalletAcceptedDate, tp.PersonPK, tp.FirstName + ' ' + tp.LastName AS PalletAcceptedBy, so.ContainerOutFK AS OrderLink
			INTO #TempPhysicalChecks 
			FROM dbo.tblWorksOrderPalletResult twopr
			INNER JOIN dbo.tblWorksOrderPallets twop ON worksorderpalletpk = twopr.WorksOrderPalletFK
			INNER JOIN tblworksorders wo ON worksorderfk = worksorderpk
			INNER JOIN tblusers tu ON twopr.InsertedBy = tu.UserPK
			INNER JOIN dbo.tblPeople tp ON tp.PersonPK = tu.PersonFK
			INNER JOIN tblstockorders so ON so.stockorderpk = wo.FK

			IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#TempAllResults') IS NOT NULL
				DROP TABLE #TempAllResults

			SELECT distinct CollectionDate, goodsordernumber, CASE WHEN tst.StockTransferPK IS NOT NULL then 'Stock Transfer : ' ELSE '' END + containeroutstatus AS Status, si.StockItemCode, tcol.Batch, 
				CASE WHEN tp.CustomerBarcode = '' THEN tp.barcode ELSE tp.CustomerBarcode END AS Barcode, PalletAccepted, PalletAcceptedDate, coalesce(pa.eventdate, CollectionDate) AS PalletLoadeddate, tpc.PalletAcceptedBy, tpc.PersonPK AS CheckBy, adat.DeliveryAddressType, si.DivisionFK
			INTO #TempAllResults
			FROM dbo.tblContainerOutLinePalletContent tcolpc
			INNER JOIN tblpallets tp ON tcolpc.palletfk = palletpk --AND palletpk = @palletfk
			INNER JOIN dbo.tblContainerOutLines tcol ON containeroutlinefk = containeroutlinepk
			INNER JOIN tblstockitems si ON stockitempk = stockitemfk
			INNER JOIN tblcontainerouts tco ON containeroutfk = containeroutpk
			INNER JOIN dbo.appDeliveryAddressTypes adat ON tco.DeliveryTypeFK = adat.DeliveryAddressTypePK
			INNER JOIN tblstockorders so ON so.containeroutfk = containeroutpk AND tp.BuildingUnitFK = so.ResponsibleBuildingUnitFK
			LEFT JOIN dbo.tblStockTransfers tst ON tst.ContainerOutFK = tco.ContainerOutPK
			INNER JOIN dbo.appContainerOutStatus tcos ON tco.ContainerOutStatusFK = tcos.ContainerOutStatusPK
			INNER JOIN #divisions div ON tcol.divisionfk = div.DivisionFK
			LEFT JOIN #TempPhysicalChecks tpc ON tcolpc.PalletFK = tpc.palletFk AND tpc.OrderLink = tcol.ContainerOutFK
			outer APPLY(SELECT TOP 1 * from tblpalletaudit pa where pa.palletfk= tp.PalletPK AND eventtypefk IN (25,27) AND eventfk = tco.ContainerOutPK)pa
			WHERE /*tcol.divisionfk IN (SELECT divisionpk FROM tbldivisions WHERE dbo.tbldivisions.RequirePhysicalCheckDuringStockOrder = 1) */
				(
					(tco.DeliveryTypeFK = 1 and div.RequirePhysicalCheckDuringMarketStockOrder = 1) 
					or (tco.DeliveryTypeFK = 2 and div.RequirePhysicalCheckDuringFactoryStockOrder = 1)
					or (tco.DeliveryTypeFK = 3 and div.RequirePhysicalCheckDuringScrappageStockOrder = 1)
					or (tco.DeliveryTypeFK = 4 and div.RequirePhysicalCheckDuringSamplingStockOrder = 1) 
					or (tco.DeliveryTypeFK = 5 and div.RequirePhysicalCheckDuringDiscrepencyStockOrder = 1) 
				)
				AND CAST(CollectionDate AS DATE) >= @varUptimeLogDate
				AND CAST(CollectionDate AS DATE) < DATEADD(DAY, 7, @varUptimeLogDate)
				AND tco.ContainerOutStatusFK IN (5,6) 
				AND tp.BuildingUnitFK = div.BuildingUnitPK 
				AND (
					(tco.ContainerOutStatusFK = 6 AND tpc.PalletAccepted IS NOT null)--order cancelled but check completed
					OR
					(tco.ContainerOutStatusFK = 5 AND tpc.PalletAccepted IS NOT null) --order completed and check completed
					OR
					(tco.ContainerOutStatusFK = 5 AND tpc.PalletAccepted IS null) -- order completed but check not completed
				)
			
			DECLARE @varPalletsAccepted INT, @varPalletsRejected INT, @varPalletsDispatched INT

			SELECT @varPalletsAccepted = COUNT(DISTINCT Barcode)
			FROM #TempAllResults 
			WHERE PalletAccepted = 1

			SELECT @varPalletsRejected = COUNT(DISTINCT Barcode)
			FROM #TempAllResults 
			WHERE PalletAccepted <> 1

			SELECT @varPalletsDispatched = COUNT(DISTINCT Barcode)
			FROM #TempAllResults 
			WHERE CAST(PalletLoadeddate AS DATE) >= @varUptimeLogDate
			AND CAST(PalletLoadeddate AS DATE) < DATEADD(DAY, 7, @varUptimeLogDate)

			SELECT @varPalletsAccepted = ISNULL(@varPalletsAccepted, 0), @varPalletsRejected = ISNULL(@varPalletsRejected, 0), @varPalletsDispatched = ISNULL(@varPalletsDispatched, 0)

			UPDATE t1 WITH (ROWLOCK)
			SET NoOfPalletsAccepted = @varPalletsAccepted,
			NoOfPalletsRejected = @varPalletsRejected,
			NoOfPalletsDispatched = @varPalletsDispatched,
			UpdatedBy = 0,
			UpdatedDate = dbo.GetBSTDate()
			FROM dbo.tblUptimeLogsPhysicalChecks t1
			INNER JOIN dbo.tblUptimeLogsDetails t2
			ON t1.UptimeLogsDetailFK = t2.UptimeLogsDetailPK
			WHERE t2.UptimeLogDate = @varUptimeLogDate
			AND t2.BuildingFK = @varBuildingFK
			--AND t1.NoOfPalletsAccepted = 0
			--AND t1.NoOfPalletsDispatched = 0
			--AND t1.NoOfPalletsRejected = 0

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end
						
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */	
			--SELECT ERROR_MESSAGE() AS [ERR MSG]
			--SELECT ERROR_LINE() AS [ERR LINE]

			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END
GO

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spUserBuildingUnits]  
(  
 @userFK int  
)  
AS  
BEGIN  
 /* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */  
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED  
  
    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT  
 ,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;  
 SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();  
  
 -- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters  
 DECLARE @var_userFK int  
 SET @var_userFK = @userFK  
 SET @ParameterDetails = '@userFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_userFK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'')  
  
    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL   
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)  
  
    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)  
    --BEGIN  
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC   
  
  SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)  
  
        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)  
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK  
  
        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()  
    --END  
  
  
 SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);  
 SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails  
 ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;  
 INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()  
  
 WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3  
 BEGIN   
  BEGIN TRY  
     
  
   -- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start  
  
   SELECT   
    BuildingUnitPK,  
    UserBuildingUnitPK,   
    case when uBus.UserBuildingUnitPK is null then cast(0 as bit) else cast(1 as bit) end as IsChecked,  
    buildings.BuildingName + ' - ' + bus.BuildingUnit as BuildingUnit   
   FROM           
    dbo.tblBuildingUnits AS bus  
   inner join tblBuildings AS buildings  
    on buildings.BuildingPK = bus.BuildingFK  
   left outer join tblUserBuildingUnits AS uBus  
    on uBus.BuildingUnitFK = bus.BuildingUnitPK  
    AND uBus.UserFK = @var_userFK  
   where bus.isarchived = 0  
   Order By   
    buildings.BuildingName + ' - ' + bus.BuildingUnit  
  
   -- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end  
  
     
     
   BREAK  
  END TRY  
  BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */  
   DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;  
   SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;  
   SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;  
  
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY   
   BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;  
         
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;  
  
            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID  
              
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;  
              
   IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)  
   BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END  
   ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */  
  END CATCH  
  SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1  
 END  
END

-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spUserDivisions]
(
	@userFK int,
	@customerFK int
)
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT
 ,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;
	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	DECLARE @var_userFK int, @var_customerFK int
	SET @var_userFK = @userFK; SET @var_customerFK = @customerFK
	SET @ParameterDetails = '@userFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_userFK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@customerFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_customerFK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'')

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    --BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

		SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END


	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY
			
			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start

			if @var_customerFK = -1 return

			SELECT 
				DivisionPK,
				UserDivisionPK, 
				case when uDDs.UserDivisionPK is null then cast(0 as bit) else cast(1 as bit) end as IsChecked,
				divisions.DivisionName	
			FROM         
				dbo.tblDivisions divisions
			left outer join tblUserDivisions uDDs
				ON uDDs.DivisionFK = divisions.DivisionPK
				AND uDDs.UserFK = @var_userFK
			Where 
				divisions.CustomerFK = @var_customerFK and divisions.IsArchived = 0
			Order By 
				divisions.DivisionName

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end
						
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END
GO

   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;    
    
            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID    
                
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;    
                
   IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)    
   BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END    
   ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */    
  END CATCH    
  SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1    
 END    
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spUserNavigationHistory]
(
	@StartDate datetime,
	@EndDate datetime
)	
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT
	,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;
	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	DECLARE @StartDate2 datetime, @EndDate2 datetime
	SET @StartDate2 = @StartDate; SET @EndDate2 = @EndDate;

	SET @ParameterDetails = '@StartDate = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@StartDate2 AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@EndDate = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@EndDate2 AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'')

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    --BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

		SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END

	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY
		
		--PRINT @StartDate2
		--PRINT @EndDate2
			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start
			SELECT
			CASE WHEN URL = '/STAContainer.aspx' THEN
				 REPLACE(SUBSTRING(QueryString,0,CHARINDEX('&',QueryString,0)), 'control=', '/')
			ELSE URL END AS URL, 
			CASE WHEN URL = '/STAContainer.aspx' THEN
				SUBSTRING(QueryString,CHARINDEX('&',QueryString,0)+1,LEN(QueryString))
			ELSE QueryString END AS QueryString, 
			pep.FirstName + ' ' + pep.LastName AS [User], ph.InsertedDate
			FROM tblpagehits ph
			LEFT JOIN tblusers urs ON ph.insertedby = urs.UserPK
			LEFT JOIN tblpeople pep ON urs.PersonFK = pep.PersonPK
			WHERE ph.inserteddate >= @StartDate2 AND ph.inserteddate <= @EndDate2
			ORDER BY ph.PageHitPK
			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end
					
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END
