CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spUserSessionInfo]  
(  
 @UserPK int  
)  
AS  
BEGIN  
 /* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */  
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED  
  
    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT  
 ,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;  
 SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();  
  
 -- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters  
 DECLARE @var_UserPK int  
 SET @var_UserPK = @UserPK  
 SET @ParameterDetails = '@UserPK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_UserPK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'')  
  
    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL   
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)  
  
    IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)  
    BEGIN  
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC   
  
        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)  
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK  
  
        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()  
    END  
  
 SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);  
 SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails  
 ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;  
 INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()  
  
 WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3  
 BEGIN   
  BEGIN TRY     
  
   -- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start  
  
   IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#Roles') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #Roles  
  
   CREATE TABLE #Roles(UserId uniqueidentifier, RoleName NVARCHAR(256), appRole Int, UsersName NVARCHAR(256))  
  
   Insert Into #Roles (UserId,RoleName, appRole, UsersName)   
   select membership.Id, rol.Name ,  
   case   
     when rol.Name = 'Administrator' then 1  
     when rol.Name ='Invoicing' then 16  
     when rol.Name ='Manager' then 32  
     when rol.Name ='StockController' then 256  
     when rol.Name ='WarehousingClientUser' then 512  
     when rol.Name ='DailyInventoryManagement' then 2048  
   end as appRole,  
   tp.FirstName AS UsersName     
   from tblusers users 
   inner join aspnetusers membership on users.AspNetUserID = membership.Id
   inner join AspNetUserRoles uir on uir.UserId = membership.Id
   inner join AspNetRoles rol on rol.Id = uir.RoleId
   --inner join [dbo].[aspnet_Membership] membership   on users.AspNetUserID=membership.userId  
   --inner join  [dbo].[aspnet_UsersInRoles] uir ON  uir.UserId=membership.userId  
   --inner join [dbo].[aspnet_Roles] rol ON   rol.RoleId= uir.RoleId  
   INNER JOIN dbo.tblPeople tp ON tp.PersonPK = users.PersonFK  
   where userpk = @var_UserPK  
   
    SELECT HelpDeskUrl, ManualUrl,EnableHelpDeskURL,EnableManualURL,  
   (Select sum(appRole) from #Roles)as RoleSecurityMask, (SELECT top 1 UsersName FROM #Roles) AS UsersName  
   from appSystem   
  
   -- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end  
        
   BREAK  
  END TRY  
  BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */  
   DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;  
   SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;  
   SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;  
  
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY   
   BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;  
         
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;  
  
            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID  
              
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;  
              
   IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)  
   BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END  
   ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */  
  END CATCH  
  SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1  
 END  
END

-- =========================================================================================================================
-- Author:      Cathal OCuirrin
-- Create Date: 30 July 2018
-- Description: Returns 1 or 0 (true or false) depending if the Container Out was created by a file (Integration Importer).
-- =========================================================================================================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spWasContainerOutCreatedByFile]
(
	@ContainerOutFK INT = -1
)
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT
	,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;
	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	DECLARE @var_ContainerOutFK INT = ISNULL(@ContainerOutFK, -1)

	SET @ParameterDetails = '@ContainerOutFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_ContainerOutFK AS NVARCHAR(100)),'')

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    --BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

		SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END

	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY	

			-- This stored procedures main code, excluding error handling - start	

			IF @var_ContainerOutFK < 1
			BEGIN
				SELECT 0 AS ContainerOutCreatedByFile
				RETURN
			END

			DECLARE @DivisionFK INT = -1, @DocketValue1 NVARCHAR(200) = ''

			SELECT TOP 1 @DivisionFK = col.DivisionFK, @DocketValue1 = co.DocketValue1 
			FROM tblContainerOuts AS co
			INNER JOIN tblContainerOutLines AS col
			ON co.ContainerOutPK = col.ContainerOutFK
			WHERE co.ContainerOutPK = @var_ContainerOutFK

			IF ISNULL(@DocketValue1,'') = ''
			BEGIN
				SELECT 0 AS ContainerOutCreatedByFile
				RETURN
			END

			IF EXISTS(		SELECT 1 FROM dbo.tblContainerOuts AS co
							INNER JOIN dbo.tblIntegrationFileStockOuts AS IFSO
							ON co.ContainerOutPK = IFSO.ContainerOutFK
							WHERE co.ContainerOutPK = @var_ContainerOutFK 
							AND co.InsertedBy < 1
						)
			BEGIN
				SELECT 1 AS ContainerOutCreatedByFile
				RETURN
			END

			SELECT 0 AS ContainerOutCreatedByFile

			-- This stored procedures main code, excluding error handling - end

			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END
GO

-- =============================================
-- Author:      <Author, , Name>
-- Create Date: <09/04/2024 >
-- Description: <Query on pallet locations placed in a warehouse at a time >
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE  [dbo].[spWOMLocationsCG]


AS
BEGIN
    -- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from
    -- interfering with SELECT statements.
    SET NOCOUNT ON

		--only take stock ins / outs from this date onwards
		declare @startdate nvarchar(50) = '20221231'

		--only take movements from this pk onwards
		declare @firstMovement int = 12507500

		 drop table if exists #tmpkilmovements-- #tmpallmovements
		select * into #tmpkilmovements from tblWorksOrderMovements where worksordermovementpk > @firstMovement /*this is as close to 1st Jan 2023 as I could find*/

		--only use this if we are testing one days worth
		 --drop table if exists #tmpkilmovements
		--select * into #tmpkilmovements from #tmpallmovements where cast(Updateddate as date) = '20231107'

		drop table if exists #alllocations
		select * into #alllocations from viewBuildingUnitBays

		--get stock in works orders
		drop table if exists #tmpstockinworksorders
		select distinct wo.worksorderpk, worksorderoriginfk, worksordertypefk, FK
		into #tmpstockinworksorders
		from tblworksorders wo
		inner join #tmpkilmovements wom on wo.worksorderpk = wom.worksorderfk
		where worksorderoriginfk = 1 and worksordertypefk = 3

		--get stock out works orders
		drop table if exists #tmpstockOutworksorders
		select distinct wo.worksorderpk, worksorderoriginfk, worksordertypefk, FK, palletfk, ContainerOutLinePalletContentFK
		into #tmpstockOutworksorders
		from tblworksorders wo
		inner join #tmpkilmovements wom on wo.worksorderpk = wom.worksorderfk
		where worksorderoriginfk = 2 and worksordertypefk in(3,16)

		--get all stock ins from stock in worksorders
		drop table if exists #tmpstockins
		select distinct stockinpk, ContainerInFK, GoodsInNumber, ArrivalDate, 1 as worksorderoriginfk, 3 as worksordertypefk, -1 as WorksOrderPK, 'Building               Name' as Building, 'Building              Unit' as BuildingUnit
		into #tmpstockins
		from tblstockins si
		where cast(ArrivalDate as date) > @startdate

		--update stock in location
		update si
		set Building = b.BuildingName, BuildingUnit = bu.BuildingUnit
		from #tmpstockins si
		inner join tblcontainerins ci on containerinpk = containerinfk
		inner join tblBuildingUnits bu on ci.BuildingUnitFK = bu.BuildingUnitPK
		inner join tblbuildings b on BuildingPK = BuildingFK

		--link stock ins to works orders
		update si
		set WorksOrderPK = siw.WorksOrderPK
		from #tmpstockins si
		inner join #tmpstockinworksorders siw on si.stockinpk = siw.FK
				
		--get all stock outs from stock in worksorders
		drop table if exists #tmpcontainerouts
		select distinct co.containeroutpk, collectiondate, GoodsOrderNumber ,worksorderoriginfk, worksordertypefk, WorksOrderPK
		into #tmpcontainerouts
		from tblcontainerouts co
		inner join tblstockorders so on co.ContainerOutPK = so.ContainerOutFK
		inner join #tmpstockOutworksorders siw on so.StockOrderPK = siw.FK
		union
		select distinct co.containeroutpk, collectiondate, GoodsOrderNumber ,worksorderoriginfk, worksordertypefk, WorksOrderPK
		from tblcontainerouts co
		inner join tblcontaineroutlines col on containeroutpk= containeroutfk
		inner join tblContainerOutLinePalletContent colpc on ContainerOutLinePK = ContainerOutLineFK
		--inner join #tmpkilmovements moves on colpc.ContainerOutLinePalletContentPK = moves.ContainerOutLinePalletContentFK
		inner join #tmpstockOutworksorders moves on colpc.ContainerOutLinePalletContentPK = moves.ContainerOutLinePalletContentFK and colpc.palletfk = moves.palletfk

		--get stockinpallets
		drop table if exists #tmpstockinpallets
		select distinct StockInPK, GoodsInNumber, PalletFK, ArrivalDate,worksorderoriginfk, worksordertypefk, WorksOrderPK, Building, BuildingUnit
		into #tmpstockinpallets
		from #tmpstockins
		inner join tblstockinlines on stockinpk=  stockinfk
		inner join tblStockInLinePallets on stockinlinefk = stockinlinepk

		--get stock out pallets
		drop table if exists #tmpstockoutpallets
		select distinct ContainerOutPK, GoodsOrderNumber, collectiondate, PalletFK,worksorderoriginfk, worksordertypefk, WorksOrderPK
		into #tmpstockoutpallets
		from #tmpcontainerouts
		inner join tblcontaineroutlines on containeroutpk = containeroutfk
		inner join tblContainerOutLinePalletContent on containeroutlinefk = containeroutlinepk

		--update stockinpallet to find correct worksorder
		update sip
		set sip.WorksOrderPK = woms.WorksOrderFK
		from #tmpstockinpallets sip
		inner join #tmpkilmovements woms on sip.PalletFK = woms.PalletFK and sip.worksorderoriginfk = 1 and (woms.WorksOrderFK = sip.WorksOrderPK OR (sip.WorksOrderPK = -1 AND (cast(ArrivalDate as date) = cast(woms.updateddate AS DATE))))
		where sip.WorksOrderPK = -1

		drop table if exists #tmplocationtypes
		select LocationTypePK, LocationType into #tmplocationtypes from appLocationTypes

		--out off location
		drop table if exists #tmpresults
		select worksordermovementpk, u.UserName, woms.MovementDescription, tp.CustomerBarcode, woms.PalletFK, woms.UpdatedBy, woms.UpdatedDate, 
		coalesce(vw.BuildingName, sip.Building) as BuildingName, coalesce(vw.BuildingUnit, sip.buildingunit) as BuildingUnit, HandheldDeviceFK, WarehouseMachineFK, 
		case when woms.SourceLocationTypeFK in(4,5) then 'Container' else vw.BuildingUnitBayLocation end as FromLocation, 
		case when DestinationLocationTypeFK in(4,5) then 'Container' else  vwto.BuildingUnitBayLocation end as ToLocation,
		case when woms.SourceLocationTypeFK in(4,5) then 'Container' else lt.LocationType end as FromLocationType, 
		case when DestinationLocationTypeFK=5 then 'Container' else ltto.LocationType end as ToLocationType, 'Out Of' as Direction, 
		GoodsOrderNumber, 
		case when sop.GoodsOrderNumber <> null then '' else GoodsInNumber end as GoodsInNumber
		--select count(distinct GoodsInNumber) 
		into #tmpresults
		from #tmpkilmovements woms 
		left join #alllocations vw on woms.SourceLocationTypeFK = vw.locationTypeFK and woms.SourceLocationFK = vw.BuildingUnitBayPK
		left join #alllocations vwTo on woms.DestinationLocationTypeFK = vwTo.locationTypeFK and woms.DestinationFK = vwto.BuildingUnitBayPK
		inner join tblUsers u on woms.UpdatedBy = u.userpk
		inner join tblPallets tp on woms.PalletFK = tp.PalletPK
		left join #tmplocationtypes lt on lt.LocationTypePK = vw.locationTypeFK
		left join #tmplocationtypes ltto on ltto.LocationTypePK = vwTo.locationTypeFK
		left join #tmpstockoutpallets sop on sop.PalletFK = woms.PalletFK and sop.worksorderoriginfk = 2 and woms.WorksOrderFK = sop.WorksOrderPK
		left join #tmpstockinpallets sip  on sip.PalletFK = woms.PalletFK and sip.worksorderoriginfk = 1 and woms.WorksOrderFK = sip.WorksOrderPK-- (woms.WorksOrderFK = sip.WorksOrderPK OR (sip.WorksOrderPK = -1 AND (cast(ArrivalDate as date) = cast(woms.updateddate AS DATE))))
		where ((vw.BuildingUnitBayPK is null and (sip.Building = 'BV4' or sip.Building = 'BV5')) or (  vw.BuildingName = 'BV4' or vw.BuildingName = 'BV5')) and 
		((SourceLocationFK <> DestinationFK and SourceLocationTypeFK = DestinationLocationTypeFK) or SourceLocationTypeFK <> DestinationLocationTypeFK)
		--and CustomerBarcode = '353971424306124554'
		--order by goodsordernumber, goodsinnumber, woms.UpdatedDate
		union
		--into location 
		select distinct worksordermovementpk, u.UserName, woms.MovementDescription, tp.CustomerBarcode, woms.PalletFK, woms.UpdatedBy, woms.UpdatedDate, 
		coalesce(vw.BuildingName, sip.Building) as BuildingName, coalesce(vw.BuildingUnit, sip.buildingunit) as BuildingUnit, HandheldDeviceFK, WarehouseMachineFK, 
		case when woms.SourceLocationTypeFK in(4,5) then 'Container' else vw.BuildingUnitBayLocation end as FromLocation, 
		case when DestinationLocationTypeFK in(4,5) then 'Container' else  vwto.BuildingUnitBayLocation end as ToLocation,
		case when woms.SourceLocationTypeFK in(4,5) then 'Container' else lt.LocationType end as FromLocationType, 
		case when DestinationLocationTypeFK=5 then 'Container' else  ltto.LocationType end as ToLocationType, 'In to' as Direction,
		GoodsOrderNumber, 
		case when sop.GoodsOrderNumber <> null then '' else GoodsInNumber end as GoodsInNumber
		--into #tmpresults
		from #tmpkilmovements woms 
		left join #alllocations vw on woms.DestinationLocationTypeFK = vw.locationTypeFK and woms.DestinationFK = vw.BuildingUnitBayPK
		left join #alllocations vwTo on woms.SourceLocationTypeFK = vwTo.locationTypeFK and woms.SourceLocationFK = vwTo.BuildingUnitBayPK
		inner join tblUsers u on woms.UpdatedBy = u.userpk
		inner join tblPallets tp on woms.PalletFK = tp.PalletPK
		left join appLocationTypes lt on lt.LocationTypePK = vw.locationTypeFK
		left join appLocationTypes ltto on ltto.LocationTypePK = vwTo.locationTypeFK
		left join #tmpstockoutpallets sop on sop.PalletFK = woms.PalletFK and sop.worksorderoriginfk = 2 and woms.WorksOrderFK = sop.WorksOrderPK
		left join #tmpstockinpallets sip  on sip.PalletFK = woms.PalletFK and sip.worksorderoriginfk = 1 and woms.WorksOrderFK = sip.WorksOrderPK-- (woms.WorksOrderFK = sip.WorksOrderPK OR (sip.WorksOrderPK = -1 AND (cast(ArrivalDate as date) = cast(woms.updateddate AS DATE))))
		where ((vw.BuildingUnitBayPK is null and (sip.Building = 'BV4' or sip.Building = 'BV5')) or (  vw.BuildingName = 'BV4' or vw.BuildingName = 'BV5')) and 
		((SourceLocationFK <> DestinationFK and SourceLocationTypeFK = DestinationLocationTypeFK) or SourceLocationTypeFK <> DestinationLocationTypeFK)
		--order by woms.UpdatedDate
			--SELECT <@Param1, sysname, @p1>, <@Param2, sysname, @p2>

		--return all
		select * from #tmpresults
END
GO

-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spWorksOrderCancel]
(
	@worksOrderFK int
)
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT
 ,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;
	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	DECLARE @worksOrderFK2 INT
	SET @worksOrderFK2 = @worksOrderFK

	SET @ParameterDetails = '@worksOrderFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@worksOrderFK2 AS NVARCHAR(20)),'')

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    --BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

		SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END


	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY
			IF XACT_STATE() = 0 AND @@TRANCOUNT < 1 BEGIN TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start

			Declare @worksOrderTypeFK int, @worksOrderStatusFK int
			Select @worksOrderTypeFK = WorksOrderTypeFK, @worksOrderStatusFK = WorksOrderStatusFK from tblWorksOrders
			where WorksOrderPK = @worksOrderFK2
	
			if(@worksOrderStatusFK = 3) /*Complete*/ 
			BEGIN
				Select 1 /*This indicates a problem to the caller*/
			END 
			ELSE 
			BEGIN
				/*MOVEMENT*/
				if @worksOrderTypeFK = 3 
				BEGIN
					/*Delete Works Order*/
					IF(EXISTS(SELECT * FROM tblWorksOrderMovements where worksorderfk = @worksOrderFK2))
					BEGIN 
						Select 1 /*indicates problem*/ 
					END
					ELSE
					BEGIN
						Delete tblWorksOrders where WorksOrderPK = @worksOrderFK2
						Select 0 /*indicates success*/
					END
				END 
				ELSE if @worksOrderTypeFK = 1 
				BEGIN
					/*Split*/
					/*Delete works Order pallet instructions*/
					Delete tblWorksOrderPalletInstructions
					Where WorksOrderPalletFK in (Select WorksOrderPalletPK from tblWorksOrderPAllets where WorksORderFK = @worksOrderFK2)

					/*Delete works order pallets*/
					Delete tblWorksOrderPallets where WorksOrderFK = @worksOrderFK2

					/*Delete Works Order*/
					Delete tblWorksOrders where WorksORderPK = @worksOrderFK2
					Select 0 /*indicates success*/
				END 
				ELSE if @worksOrderTypeFK = 9 
				BEGIN
					/*Palletize*/
					/*Delete works Order pallet instructions*/
					Delete tblWorksOrderPalletInstructions
					Where WorksOrderPalletFK in (Select WorksOrderPalletPK from tblWorksOrderPAllets where WorksORderFK = @worksOrderFK2)

					/*Delete works order pallets*/
					Delete tblWorksOrderPallets where WorksOrderFK = @worksOrderFK2

					/*Delete Works Order*/
					Delete tblWorksOrders where WorksORderPK = @worksOrderFK2
					Select 0 /*indicates success*/
				END
			END /*End Main Loop*/
	
			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end

			BEGIN TRY IF XACT_STATE() = 1 AND @@TRANCOUNT = 1 AND @OpeningTranCount < 1 COMMIT TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH
			
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END
GO

-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spWorksOrderChangeStatus]
(
	@worksOrderPK int,
	@worksOrderStatusFK int
)
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT
 ,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;
	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	DECLARE @worksOrderPK2 int, @worksOrderStatusFK2 int
	SET @worksOrderPK2 = @worksOrderPK; SET @worksOrderStatusFK2 = @worksOrderStatusFK

	SET @ParameterDetails = '@worksOrderPK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@worksOrderPK2 AS NVARCHAR(20)),'') + ',@worksOrderStatusFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@worksOrderStatusFK2 AS NVARCHAR(20)),'')

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    --BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

		SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END


	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY
			IF XACT_STATE() = 0 AND @@TRANCOUNT < 1 BEGIN TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start

			Declare @worksOrderTypeFK int

			Select @worksOrderTypeFK = WorksOrderTypeFK from tblWorksOrders
			where WorksOrderPK = @worksOrderPK2
	
			/*MOVEMENT*/
			if @worksOrderTypeFK = 3
			BEGIN
				update tblWorksOrderMovements WITH (ROWLOCK)
				set WorksOrderStatusFK = @worksOrderStatusFK2
				Where WorksOrderFK = @worksOrderPK2
			END
			/*Palletize or relabel*/
			ELSE if @worksOrderTypeFK = 9 or @worksOrderTypeFK = 5
			BEGIN
				update tblWorksOrderPallets WITH (ROWLOCK)
				set WorksOrderStatusFK = @worksOrderStatusFK2
				Where WorksOrderFK = @worksOrderPK2
			END
			/*Topups do not have there own status*/
	
			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end

			BEGIN TRY IF XACT_STATE() = 1 AND @@TRANCOUNT = 1 AND @OpeningTranCount < 1 COMMIT TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH
			
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END

-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spWorksOrderComplete]
(
	@worksOrderFK int
)
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT
 ,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;
	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	DECLARE @worksOrderFK2 INT
	SET @worksOrderFK2 = @worksOrderFK

	SET @ParameterDetails = '@worksOrderFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@worksOrderFK2 AS NVARCHAR(20)),'')

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    --BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

		SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END


	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY			

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start	

			--BEGIN TRANSACTION CompleteWorksOrder;

			Declare @worksOrderOriginFK int, @FK int, @worksOrderTypeFK int, @worksOrderRuleTypeFK int,
			@worksOrderRuleFK int

			Select @worksOrderOriginFK = WorksOrderOriginFK, @FK = FK, @worksOrderTypeFK = WorksOrderTypeFK,
			@worksOrderRuleTypeFK = WorksOrderRuleTypeFK, @worksOrderRuleFK = WorksOrderRuleFK
			From tblWorksOrders
			Where WorksOrderPK = @worksOrderFK2
	
			IF XACT_STATE() = 0 AND @@TRANCOUNT < 1 BEGIN TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName

				update tblWorksOrderPallets WITH (ROWLOCK)
				Set WorksOrderStatusFK = 3 /*Complete*/
				Where WorksOrderFK = @worksOrderFK2

				update tblWorksOrders WITH (ROWLOCK)
				Set WorksOrderStatusFK = 3 /*Complete*/
				Where WorksOrderPK = @worksOrderFK2

			BEGIN TRY IF XACT_STATE() = 1 AND @@TRANCOUNT = 1 AND @OpeningTranCount < 1 COMMIT TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH

			--Charge now that the work is complete
			--Jamie : removed charge call - these not used for invoicing	
			--Exec spWorksOrderCreateCharge @worksOrderFK2, @worksOrderOriginFK, @FK, @worksOrderTypeFK, -1, @worksOrderRuleTypeFK, @worksORderRuleFK

			--IF @@ERROR <> 0
			--BEGIN
			--	-- Rollback the transaction
			--	ROLLBACK TRANSACTION CompleteWorksOrder

			--	-- Raise an error and return
		
			--	Select 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/
			--	Return
			--END
			--COMMIT TRANSACTION CompleteWorksOrder

			Select cast(1 as bit)
			--Return

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end			
			
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END
GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[spWorksOrderCompleteIfAssigned]    Script Date: 02/11/2026 17:47:27 ******/

SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spWorksOrderCompleteIfAssigned]  
 -- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here  
 @worksOrderFK int = -1,  
 @worksOrderPalletFK int = -1,  
 @UserFK int,
 @Scanned bit = 0
AS  
BEGIN  
 BEGIN TRANSACTION CompleteWorksOrder;  
 SET NOCOUNT ON;  
  
 Declare @worksOrderOriginFK int, @FK int, @worksOrderTypeFK int, @worksOrderRuleTypeFK int,  
 @worksOrderRuleFK int, @ResponsibleUserFK int, @result int  
  
 if(@Scanned = 1)
 begin
	set @ResponsibleUserFK = @UserFK
 end
 else
 begin
	 IF(@worksOrderFK > 0)  
	  BEGIN  
	   Select @ResponsibleUserFK = ResponsibleUserFK  
	   From tblWorksOrders  
	   Where WorksOrderPK = @worksOrderFK  
	  END  
	 ELSE  
	  BEGIN  
	   Select @ResponsibleUserFK = CASE WHEN wos.ResponsibleUserFK < 1 THEN wops.ResponsibleUserFK ELSE wos.ResponsibleUserFK end  
	   From tblWorksOrders wos  
	   inner join tblworksorderpallets wops on wos.worksorderpk = wops.worksorderfk  
	   Where wops.WorksOrderpalletPK = @worksOrderPalletFK  
	  END   
  end
  
 IF(@ResponsibleUserFK > 0)  
 BEGIN  
  print 'assigned'  
  IF(@worksOrderFK > 0)  
  BEGIN  
   Select @worksOrderOriginFK = WorksOrderOriginFK, @FK = FK, @worksOrderTypeFK = WorksOrderTypeFK,  
   @worksOrderRuleTypeFK = WorksOrderRuleTypeFK, @worksOrderRuleFK = WorksOrderRuleFK, @ResponsibleUserFK = ResponsibleUserFK  
   From tblWorksOrders  
   Where WorksOrderPK = @worksOrderFK  
  
   if(@worksOrderTypeFK = 17)--racking check  
   begin  
   print 'nothing to do here'  
    --update tblWorksOrderLocations WITH (ROWLOCK)  
    --Set WorksOrderStatusFK = 3 /*Complete*/, UpdatedBy = @UserFK, updatedDate = dbo.GetBSTDate()  
    --WHERE WorksOrderFK = @worksOrderFK  
   END  
   else  
   begin  
    update tblWorksOrderPallets WITH (ROWLOCK)  
    Set WorksOrderStatusFK = 3 /*Complete*/, UpdatedBy = @UserFK, updatedDate = dbo.GetBSTDate(), ResponsibleUserFK=@ResponsibleUserFK  
    WHERE WorksOrderFK = @worksOrderFK  
   end  
   update tblWorksOrders WITH (ROWLOCK)  
   Set WorksOrderStatusFK = 3 /*Complete*/, UpdatedBy = @UserFK, updatedDate = dbo.GetBSTDate() , ResponsibleUserFK=@ResponsibleUserFK 
   Where WorksOrderPK = @worksOrderFK  
  
   set @result = 1  
  END  
  ELSE  
  BEGIN  
   Select @worksOrderFK = wos.WorksOrderPK, @worksOrderOriginFK = wos.WorksOrderOriginFK, @FK = wos.FK, @worksOrderTypeFK = wos.WorksOrderTypeFK,  
   @worksOrderRuleTypeFK = wos.WorksOrderRuleTypeFK, @worksOrderRuleFK = wos.WorksOrderRuleFK  
   From tblWorksOrders wos  
   inner join tblworksorderpallets wops on wos.worksorderpk = wops.worksorderfk  
   Where wops.WorksOrderpalletPK = @worksOrderPalletFK  
  
   update tblWorksOrderPallets WITH (ROWLOCK)  
   Set WorksOrderStatusFK = 3 /*Complete*/, UpdatedBy = @UserFK, updatedDate = dbo.GetBSTDate()  , ResponsibleUserFK=@ResponsibleUserFK
   Where WorksOrderPalletPK = @worksOrderPalletFK  
  
   if((select count(worksorderpalletpk) from tblworksorderpallets where worksorderfk = @worksOrderFK and WorksOrderStatusFK in (1,2)) < 1)  
   BEGIN  
    update tblWorksOrders WITH (ROWLOCK)  
    Set WorksOrderStatusFK = 3 /*Complete*/, UpdatedBy = @UserFK, updatedDate = dbo.GetBSTDate()  , ResponsibleUserFK=@ResponsibleUserFK
    Where WorksOrderPK = @worksOrderFK  
  
   END  
   set @result = 1  
  END  
 END  
 else  
  set @result = 0  
   
  
 IF @@ERROR <> 0  
 BEGIN  
  -- Rollback the transaction  
  ROLLBACK TRANSACTION CompleteWorksOrder  
  
  -- Raise an error and return  
    
  Select Cast(0 as bit)  
  Return  
 END  
 COMMIT TRANSACTION CompleteWorksOrder  
 Select Cast(@result as bit)  
 Return  
END
GO

-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spWorksOrderCreateCharge]
(
	@worksOrderPK int, @worksOrderOriginPK int, @FK int, @worksOrderTypePK int, 
	@stockItemPK int, @worksOrderRuleTypeFK int = -1, @worksOrderRuleFK int = -1
)
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT
 ,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;
	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	DECLARE @worksOrderPK2 int, @worksOrderOriginPK2 int, @FK2 int, @worksOrderTypePK2 int, @stockItemPK2 int, @worksOrderRuleTypeFK2 int, @worksOrderRuleFK2 int
	SET @worksOrderPK2 = @worksOrderPK; SET @worksOrderOriginPK2 = @worksOrderOriginPK; SET @FK2 = @FK; SET @worksOrderTypePK2 = @worksOrderTypePK
	SET @stockItemPK2 = @stockItemPK; SET @worksOrderRuleTypeFK2 = @worksOrderRuleTypeFK; SET @worksOrderRuleFK2 = @worksOrderRuleFK

	SET @ParameterDetails = '@worksOrderPK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@worksOrderPK2 AS NVARCHAR(20)),'') + ',@worksOrderOriginPK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@worksOrderOriginPK2 AS NVARCHAR(20)),'')
		+ ',@FK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@FK2 AS NVARCHAR(20)),'') + ',@worksOrderTypePK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@worksOrderTypePK2 AS NVARCHAR(20)),'')
			+ ',@stockItemPK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@stockItemPK2 AS NVARCHAR(20)),'') + ',@worksOrderRuleTypeFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@worksOrderRuleTypeFK2 AS NVARCHAR(20)),'')
				+ ',@worksOrderRuleFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@worksOrderRuleFK2 AS NVARCHAR(20)),'')

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    --BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

		SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END


	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY			

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start

			Declare @workCharge decimal(18,3), @chargeEachesTypeFK int, @chargeUnitTypeFK int, 
			@chargeEachesNumber decimal(18,3), @chargeUnitsNumber decimal(18,3), @chargeResultingPallets bit,
			@pallets decimal(18,3), @eaches decimal(18,3), @units decimal(18,3), @eachesTypeFK int, @unitTypeFK int,
			@description nvarchar(1000), @eachesType nvarchar(200), @unitType nvarchar(200), @divisionFK int

			if @worksOrderTypePK2 = 1 /*Split*/
			BEGIN
				Print 'Check 1'
				Select @workCharge = Charge, @chargeEachesTypeFK = ChargeEachesTypeFK,
				@chargeUnitTypeFK = ChargeUnitTypeFK, @chargeEachesNumber = ChargeEachesNumber,
				@chargeUnitsNumber = ChargeUnitsNumber, @chargeResultingPallets = ChargeResultingPallets,
				@eachesType = eachesTypes.EachesType, @unitType = unitTypes.Abbreviation, @divisionFK = stockItems.DivisionFK
				from tblStockItemSplitRules sisrs
				inner join tblStockItems stockItems on
				stockItems.StockItemPK = sisrs.StockItemFK
				left outer join tblEachesTypes eachesTypes on
				eachesTypes.EachesTypePK = sisrs.ChargeEachesTypeFK
				left outer join tblUnitTypes unitTypes on
				unitTypes.UnitTypePK = sisrs.ChargeUnitTypeFK
				Where StockItemFK = @stockItemPK2

				if (@workCharge = 0) return --Zero charge dont bother writing any charge to database

				if (@chargeEachesTypeFK > 0)
				BEGIN --Eaches
					Print 'Check 2'
					Set @eaches = (Select sum(ActualEaches) from tblPallets pallets
									inner join tblWorksOrderPallets wops on
									wops.PalletFK = pallets.PalletPK
									inner join tblPalletContent palletContent on
									palletContent.PalletFK = pallets.PalletPK
									where wops.WorksOrderFK = @worksOrderPK2
									AND palletContent.StockItemFK = @stockItemPK2)

					Set @eaches = @eaches + (Select sum(ActualEaches) from tblWorksOrderPallets wops
							inner join tblWorksOrderPalletInstructions wopis on
							wopis.WorksOrderPalletFK = wops.WorksOrderPalletPK
							AND wopis.InstructionTypeFK = 1
					
							inner join tblPallets pallets on
							pallets.Barcode = wopis.DestinationBarcode
							inner join tblPalletContent palletContent on
							palletContent.PalletFK = pallets.PalletPK
							where wops.WorksOrderFK = @worksOrderPK2)

					Set @workCharge = (@eaches / @chargeEachesNumber) * @workCharge
					Set @description = 'Split ' + cast(@eaches as nvarchar(50)) + ' ' + @eachesType
				END
				ELSE IF (@chargeUnitTypeFK > 0)
				BEGIN --Units
					Print 'Check 3'
					Set @units = (Select sum(ActualUnits) from tblPallets pallets
									inner join tblWorksOrderPallets wops on
									wops.PalletFK = pallets.PalletPK
									inner join tblPalletContent palletContent on
									palletContent.PalletFK = pallets.PalletPK
									where wops.WorksOrderFK = @worksOrderPK2
									AND palletContent.StockItemFK = @stockItemPK2)

					Set @units = @units + (Select sum(ActualUnits) from tblWorksOrderPallets wops
							inner join tblWorksOrderPalletInstructions wopis on
							wopis.WorksOrderPalletFK = wops.WorksOrderPalletPK
							AND wopis.InstructionTypeFK = 1
					
							inner join tblPallets pallets on
							pallets.Barcode = wopis.DestinationBarcode
							inner join tblPalletContent palletContent on
							palletContent.PalletFK = pallets.PalletPK
							where wops.WorksOrderFK = @worksOrderPK2)
					Print @units
					Set @workCharge = (@units / @chargeUnitsNumber) * @workCharge
					Set @description = 'Split ' + cast(@units as nvarchar(50)) + ' ' + @unitType
				END
				ELSE
				BEGIN --Pallets
					Print 'Check 4'
					--Set the number of pallets from the works order** bear in mind this number may be different than
					--what the number of pallets that started out before work commenced (splitting/grouping)
					Set @pallets = (Select count(*) from tblPallets pallets
									inner join tblWorksOrderPallets wops on
									wops.PalletFK = pallets.PalletPK
									inner join tblPalletContent palletContent on
									palletContent.PalletFK = pallets.PalletPK
									where wops.WorksOrderFK = @worksOrderPK2
									AND palletContent.StockItemFK = @stockItemPK2)
					Print @pallets
					IF (@chargeResultingPallets = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/) --if we are charging the resulting number of pallets we need to adjust the numbers as work may have created or retired pallets changing the number pallets to charge
					BEGIN
						Print 'Check 5'
						Set @pallets = @pallets + 
						(Select sum(CountChange) from 
						(Select case when wopis.InstructionTypeFK = 1 then 1 else -1 End as CountChange 
						from tblWorksOrderPalletInstructions wopis
						inner join tblWorksOrderPallets wops on
						wops.WorksOrderPalletPK = wopis.WorksOrderPalletFK
						Where wops.WorksOrderFK = @worksOrderPK2
						AND wopis.InstructionTypeFK in (1,2))subQ)

						Print @pallets
					END

					Set @workCharge = @pallets * @workCharge
					Set @description = 'Split ' + cast(@pallets as nvarchar(50)) + ' Pallets'
				END

				insert into tblCharges
				values (@worksOrderPK2, -1, -1, @divisionFK, @stockItemPK2, @workCharge, @description, 
				0/*cast(0 as bit)*/, 1, dbo.GetBSTDate(), 1, dbo.GetBSTDate())
		
			END
			ELSE IF @worksOrderTypePK2 = 2 /*Group*/
			BEGIN
				Select @workCharge = Charge, @chargeEachesTypeFK = ChargeEachesTypeFK,
				@chargeUnitTypeFK = ChargeUnitTypeFK, @chargeEachesNumber = ChargeEachesNumber,
				@chargeUnitsNumber = ChargeUnitsNumber, @chargeResultingPallets = ChargeResultingPallets,
				@eachesType = eachesTypes.EachesType, @unitType = unitTypes.Abbreviation, @divisionFK = stockItems.DivisionFK
				from tblStockItemGroupRules sigrs
				inner join tblStockItems stockItems on
				stockItems.StockItemPK = sigrs.StockItemFK
				left outer join tblEachesTypes eachesTypes on
				eachesTypes.EachesTypePK = sigrs.ChargeEachesTypeFK
				left outer join tblUnitTypes unitTypes on
				unitTypes.UnitTypePK = sigrs.ChargeUnitTypeFK
				Where StockItemFK = @stockItemPK2

				if (@workCharge = 0) return --Zero charge dont bother writing any charge to database

				if (@chargeEachesTypeFK > 0)
				BEGIN --Eaches
					Set @eaches = (Select sum(ActualEaches) from tblPallets pallets
									inner join tblWorksOrderPallets wops on
									wops.PalletFK = pallets.PalletPK
									inner join tblPalletContent palletContent on
									palletContent.PalletFK = pallets.PalletPK
									where wops.WorksOrderFK = @worksOrderPK2
									AND palletContent.StockItemFK = @stockItemPK2)

					Set @workCharge = (@eaches / @chargeEachesNumber) * @workCharge
					Set @description = 'Grouped ' + cast(@eaches as nvarchar(50)) + ' ' + @eachesType
				END
				ELSE IF (@chargeUnitTypeFK > 0)
				BEGIN --Units
					Set @units = (Select sum(ActualUnits) from tblPallets pallets
									inner join tblWorksOrderPallets wops on
									wops.PalletFK = pallets.PalletPK
									inner join tblPalletContent palletContent on
									palletContent.PalletFK = pallets.PalletPK
									where wops.WorksOrderFK = @worksOrderPK2
									AND palletContent.StockItemFK = @stockItemPK2)

					Set @workCharge = (@units / @chargeUnitsNumber) * @workCharge
					Set @description = 'Grouped ' + cast(@units as nvarchar(50)) + ' ' + @unitType
				END
				ELSE
				BEGIN --Pallets
					--Set the number of pallets from the works order** bear in mind this number may be different than
					--what the number of pallets that started out before work commenced (splitting/grouping)
					Set @pallets = (Select count(*) from tblPallets pallets
									inner join tblWorksOrderPallets wops on
									wops.PalletFK = pallets.PalletPK
									inner join tblPalletContent palletContent on
									palletContent.PalletFK = pallets.PalletPK
									where wops.WorksOrderFK = @worksOrderPK2
									AND palletContent.StockItemFK = @stockItemPK2)
					IF (@chargeResultingPallets = 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/) --if we are charging the original number of pallets we need to adjust the numbers as work may have created or retired pallets changing the number pallets to charge
					BEGIN
						Set @pallets = @pallets + 
						(Select sum(CountChange) from (Select case when wopis.InstructionTypeFK = 1 then -1 else 1 End as CountChange from tblWorksOrderPalletInstructions wopis
						inner join tblWorksOrderPallets wops on
						wops.WorksOrderPalletPK = wopis.WorksOrderPalletFK
						Where wops.WorksOrderFK = @worksOrderPK2
						AND wopis.InstructionTypeFK in (1,2))subQ)
					END

					Set @workCharge = @pallets * @workCharge
					Set @description = 'Grouped ' + cast(@pallets as nvarchar(50)) + ' Pallets'
				END

				IF XACT_STATE() = 0 AND @@TRANCOUNT < 1 BEGIN TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName

					insert into tblCharges
					values (@worksOrderPK2, -1, -1, @divisionFK, @stockItemPK2, @workCharge, @description, 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/, 1, dbo.GetBSTDate(), 1, dbo.GetBSTDate())

				BEGIN TRY IF XACT_STATE() = 1 AND @@TRANCOUNT = 1 AND @OpeningTranCount < 1 COMMIT TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH
			END
			ELSE IF @worksOrderRuleTypeFK2 <> -1 AND @worksOrderOriginPK2 = 2/*StockOrder*/ --This works order is based on Stock Order Rules
			BEGIN
				Declare @containerOutFK int
				Declare @worksOrderSubjectFK int
				Declare @chargeSubjectFK int

				Select @containerOutFK = ContainerOutFK
				From tblStockOrders Where StockOrderPK = @FK2 --We know this is a StockOrder
		
				/********** MandatoryCountryRule **********/
				if @worksOrderRuleTypeFK2 = 1 
				BEGIN
					Select @worksOrderSubjectFK = WorksOrderSubjectFK,
						@description = wots.WorksOrderTypeDescription,
						@chargeSubjectFK = ChargeSubjectFK,
						@workCharge = Charge, @chargeEachesTypeFK = ChargeEachesTypeFK,
						@chargeUnitTypeFK = ChargeUnitTypeFK, @chargeEachesNumber = ChargeEachesNumber,
						@chargeUnitsNumber = ChargeUnitsNumber,
						@divisionFK = dwocrs.DivisionFK
					From tblDivisionWorksOrderCountryRules dwocrs
					inner join tblCountryRules countryRules on
					countryRules.CountryRulePK = dwocrs.CountryRuleFK
					inner join appWorksOrderTypes wots on
					wots.WorksOrderTypePK = countryRules.WorksOrderTypeFK
					Where dwocrs.DivisionWorksOrderCountryRulePK = @worksOrderRuleFK2				
				END

				/********** DivisionCountryRule **********/
				if @worksOrderRuleTypeFK2 = 2 
				BEGIN
					Select @worksOrderSubjectFK = WorksOrderSubjectFK,
						@description = wots.WorksOrderTypeDescription,
						@chargeSubjectFK = dowocrs.ChargeSubjectFK,
						@workCharge = dowocrs.Charge, @chargeEachesTypeFK = dowocrs.ChargeEachesTypeFK,
						@chargeUnitTypeFK = dowocrs.ChargeUnitTypeFK, @chargeEachesNumber = dowocrs.ChargeEachesNumber,
						@chargeUnitsNumber = dowocrs.ChargeUnitsNumber,
						@divisionFK = dowocrs.DivisionFK
					From tblDivisionOnlyWorksOrderCountryRules dowocrs
					inner join appWorksOrderTypes wots on
					wots.WorksOrderTypePK = dowocrs.WorksOrderTypeFK
					Where dowocrs.DivisionOnlyWorksOrderCountryRulePK = @worksOrderRuleFK2
				END

				/********** StockItemCountryRule **********/
				if @worksOrderRuleTypeFK2 = 3 
				BEGIN
					Select @worksOrderSubjectFK = WorksOrderSubjectFK, 
						@description = wots.WorksOrderTypeDescription,
						@chargeSubjectFK = sicrs.ChargeSubjectFK,
						@workCharge = sicrs.Charge, @chargeEachesTypeFK = sicrs.ChargeEachesTypeFK,
						@chargeUnitTypeFK = sicrs.ChargeUnitTypeFK, @chargeEachesNumber = sicrs.ChargeEachesNumber,
						@chargeUnitsNumber = sicrs.ChargeUnitsNumber,
						@divisionFK = stockItems.DivisionFK
					From tblStockItemCountryRules sicrs
					inner join appWorksOrderTypes wots on
					wots.WorksOrderTypePK = sicrs.WorksOrderTypeFK
					inner join tblStockItems stockItems on
					stockItems.StockItemPK = sicrs.StockItemFK
					Where sicrs.StockItemCountryRulePK = @worksOrderRuleFK2
				END

				/********** StockItemRule **********/
				if @worksOrderRuleTypeFK2 = 4 
				BEGIN
					Select @worksOrderSubjectFK = WorksOrderSubjectFK, 
						@description = wots.WorksOrderTypeDescription,
						@chargeSubjectFK = siwors.ChargeSubjectFK,
						@workCharge = siwors.Charge, @chargeEachesTypeFK = siwors.ChargeEachesTypeFK,
						@chargeUnitTypeFK = siwors.ChargeUnitTypeFK, @chargeEachesNumber = siwors.ChargeEachesNumber,
						@chargeUnitsNumber = siwors.ChargeUnitsNumber,
						@divisionFK = stockItems.DivisionFK
					From tblStockItemWorksOrderRules siwors
					inner join appWorksOrderTypes wots on
					wots.WorksOrderTypePK = siwors.WorksOrderTypeFK
					inner join tblStockItems stockItems on
					stockItems.StockItemPK = siwors.StockItemFK
					Where siwors.StockItemWorksOrderRulePK = @worksOrderRuleFK2
				END

				/***** CHARGE CALCULATION SECTION ********/
				if @chargeSubjectFK = 1 /*Container*/
				BEGIN
					--We dont need to do anything here (multiplying out etc)
					Set @workCharge = @workCharge --to keep the if statement happy
				END 
				ELSE IF @chargeSubjectFK = 2 /*Pallet*/
				BEGIN
					if @worksOrderSubjectFK = 1 /*Container*/
					BEGIN
						Select @workCharge = sum(colpc.Pallets) * @workCharge from tblStockOrders sos
						inner join tblContainerOutLines cols on
						cols.ContainerOutFK = sos.ContainerOutFK
						inner join tblContainerOutLinePalletContent colpc on
						colpc.ContainerOutLineFK = cols.ContainerOutLinePK
						Where sos.StockOrderPK = @FK2 AND cols.DivisionFK = @divisionFK
					END ELSE
					BEGIN
						Select @workCharge = count(wops.PalletFK) * @workCharge from tblWorksOrderPallets wops
						Where wops.WorksOrderFK = @worksOrderPK2
					END
				END
				ELSE IF @chargeSubjectFK = 3 /*Eaches*/
				BEGIN
					if @worksOrderSubjectFK = 1 /*Container*/
					BEGIN
						Select @workCharge = sum(colpc.Eaches) * @workCharge from tblStockOrders sos
						inner join tblContainerOutLines cols on
						cols.ContainerOutFK = sos.ContainerOutFK
						inner join tblContainerOutLinePalletContent colpc on
						colpc.ContainerOutLineFK = cols.ContainerOutLinePK
						Where sos.StockOrderPK = @FK2 AND cols.DivisionFK = @divisionFK
					END ELSE
					BEGIN
						Select @workCharge = (sum(palletContent.ActualEaches)/@chargeEachesNumber) * @workCharge from tblWorksOrderPallets wops 
						inner join tblPalletContent palletContent on
						palletContent.PalletFK = wops.PalletFK
						Where wops.WorksOrderFK = @worksOrderPK2
					END
				END
				ELSE IF @chargeSubjectFK = 4 /*Units*/
				BEGIN
					if @worksOrderSubjectFK = 1 /*Container*/
					BEGIN
						Select @workCharge = sum(colpc.Units) * @workCharge from tblStockOrders sos
						inner join tblContainerOutLines cols on
						cols.ContainerOutFK = sos.ContainerOutFK
						inner join tblContainerOutLinePalletContent colpc on
						colpc.ContainerOutLineFK = cols.ContainerOutLinePK
						Where sos.StockOrderPK = @FK2 AND cols.DivisionFK = @divisionFK
					END ELSE
					BEGIN
						Select @workCharge = (sum(palletContent.ActualUnits)/@chargeUnitsNumber) * @workCharge from tblWorksOrderPallets wops  
						inner join tblPalletContent palletContent on
						palletContent.PalletFK = wops.PalletFK
						Where wops.WorksOrderFK = @worksOrderPK2
					END
				END

				IF XACT_STATE() = 0 AND @@TRANCOUNT < 1 BEGIN TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName

					insert into tblCharges
					values (@worksOrderPK2, -1, @FK2, @divisionFK, @stockItemPK2, @workCharge, @description, 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/, 1, dbo.GetBSTDate(), 1, dbo.GetBSTDate())

				BEGIN TRY IF XACT_STATE() = 1 AND @@TRANCOUNT = 1 AND @OpeningTranCount < 1 COMMIT TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH
			END
    
			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end
			
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END
GO

      PRINT 'looping @WorksOrderPalletPK, @WorksOrderFK, @ThisPalletFK, @WorksOrderStatusFK, @WorksOrderTypeFK, @FK'  
      PRINT @WorksOrderPalletPK  
      PRINT @WorksOrderFK  
      PRINT @ThisPalletFK  
      PRINT @WorksOrderStatusFK  
      PRINT @WorksOrderTypeFK  
      PRINT @FK  
      --check if new building already has matching works order type  
      DECLARE @NewWorksOrderFK int = -1  
      PRINT 'checking for existing worksorder of same type'  
      if( @NewBuilding = 0)  
       SELECT @NewWorksOrderFK = tbw.WorksOrderPK FROM #tmpBuildingWorks tbw WHERE WorksOrderTypeFK = @WorksOrderTypeFK  
  
      if(@NewWorksOrderFK < 1)  
      BEGIN  
      PRINT 'no existing works order, insert new record'  
       --insert new works order for building  
       INSERT INTO tblWorksOrders   
        VALUES (1,-1,2,@NewStockOrderFK,@WorksOrderTypeFK,-1,-1,0,'01/01/1900',0,'01/01/1900',0,'01/01/1900',0,'01/01/1900',0,'01/01/1900',0,'01/01/1900',0,'01/01/1900',0,'01/01/1900',0,'01/01/1900',0,'01/01/1900',  
         '','','','','','',0,@CurrentUserFK2,@CurrentDateTime,@CurrentUserFK2,@CurrentDateTime, @NewBuildingUnitFK2)  
       set @NewWorksOrderFK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()  
       PRINT dbo.GetBSTDate()  
      END  
      PRINT @NewWorksOrderFK  
  
      if(@WorksOrderTypeFK in (15,19,20,21,22))--physical check  
      BEGIN  
       --check if this physical check is complete or not, needs done again after moving building if already complete  
       if(exists(SELECT * FROM dbo.tblWorksOrderPalletResult WHERE WorksOrderPalletFK = @WorksOrderPalletPK))  
       BEGIN  
        PRINT 'new wop needed since previous completed'  
        --duplicate works order pallet for new building  
        insert into tblworksorderpallets    
        select @NewWorksOrderFK, @ThisPalletFK,1,WorkDescription,WorkParameterInt1,WorkParameterInt2,WorkParameterInt3, wop.IsArchived, @CurrentUserFK2,@CurrentDateTime,@CurrentUserFK2,@CurrentDateTime, -1  
        FROM tblWorksOrderPallets wop  
        where worksOrderPalletPK = @WorksOrderPalletPK          
        PRINT dbo.GetBSTDate()  
       END  
       ELSE  
       BEGIN  
        PRINT 'update wo'  
        --update works order pallet for new building  
        UPDATE wop set wop.worksorderfk = @NewWorksOrderFK from tblworksorderpallets wop WHERE WorksOrderPalletPK = @WorksOrderPalletPK  
        PRINT dbo.GetBSTDate()  
  
        IF((SELECT count(*) FROM tblworksorderpallets WHERE worksorderfk = @WorksOrderFK AND worksorderstatusfk < 3) = 0)  
        BEGIN   
         update tblworksorders set worksorderstatusfk = 3, tblworksorders.UpdatedBy = @CurrentUserFK2, updateddate = dbo.GetBSTDate() WHERE worksorderPk = @WorksOrderFK  
        END  
       END  
      END  
      ELSE  
      BEGIN  
       PRINT 'update wo'  
       -- all other types of work only need completed once  
       UPDATE wop set wop.worksorderfk = @NewWorksOrderFK from tblworksorderpallets wop WHERE WorksOrderPalletPK = @WorksOrderPalletPK  
       PRINT dbo.GetBSTDate()  
      END  
  
      PRINT 'delete orphaned works orders'  
      --check is the any orphaned works orders left behind  
      if(not exists(SELECT* FROM tblworksorderpallets WHERE worksorderfk = @WorksOrderFK))  
       DELETE FROM tblworksorders WHERE worksorderpk = @WorksOrderFK  
      PRINT dbo.GetBSTDate()  
  
      FETCH NEXT FROM WorksOrderCursor INTO @WorksOrderPalletPK, @WorksOrderFK, @ThisPalletFK, @WorksOrderStatusFK, @WorksOrderTypeFK, @FK  
     END  
     CLOSE WorksOrderCursor  
     DEALLOCATE WorksOrderCursor  
    END  
  
    DELETE FROM tblstockorders   
    WHERE containeroutfk = @ContaineroutFK AND ResponsibleBuildingUnitFK NOT IN (  
     SELECT DISTINCT p.buildingunitfk   
     FROM viewContainerOutPalletList   
     INNER JOIN tblpallets p ON palletfk = palletpk  
     WHERE containeroutpk = @ContaineroutFK)  
      
   -- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end  
  
   BEGIN TRY IF XACT_STATE() = 1 AND @@TRANCOUNT = 1 AND @OpeningTranCount < 1 COMMIT TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH    
     
   --DECLARE @RuntimeInSecondsText NVARCHAR(100) = (SELECT CAST( (SELECT ABS(DATEDIFF(MS, [Date], dbo.GetBSTDate()))) AS NVARCHAR(100)) FROM [dbo].[tblEventLog] WHERE EventLogPK = @EventLogPK)  
  
   ---- Record how long it took to run/execute this stored procedure.  
   --UPDATE [dbo].[tblEventLog] WITH (ROWLOCK)  
   --SET [State] = [State] + ', Runtime (Milliseconds) ' + @RuntimeInSecondsText  
   --WHERE EventLogPK = @EventLogPK AND @EventLogPK > 0  
  
   BREAK  
  END TRY  
  BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */  
   DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;  
   SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;  
   SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;  
  
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY   
   BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;  
         
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;  
  
            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID  
              
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;  
              
   IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)  
   BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END  
   ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */  
  END CATCH  
  SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1  
 END  
END

-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spWorksOrderMovementCanComplete]
(
	@worksOrderMovementPK int
)
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT
 ,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;
	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	DECLARE @worksOrderMovementPK2 INT
	SET @worksOrderMovementPK2 = @worksOrderMovementPK

	SET @ParameterDetails = '@worksOrderMovementPK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@worksOrderMovementPK2 AS NVARCHAR(20)),'')

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    --BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

		SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END


	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY
			

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start

			DECLARE @count INT;

			select @count = count(worksorderpk) from tblworksorders
			inner join tblworksordermovements on worksorderpk = worksorderfk
			where tblworksordermovements.palletfk = (select palletfk from tblWorksOrderMovements where worksordermovementpk = @worksOrderMovementPK2) 
			and tblworksorders.worksorderoriginfk = 2 
			and tblworksorders.isarchived = 0
			and tblworksorderMovements.entirepallet = 1
			and tblWorksOrders.WorksOrderStatusFK not in (4) -- cancelled
			--and tblworksorders.worksorderstatusfk not in (3,4)

			if @count = 0
			begin
				SELECT cast(1 as bit) as Complete	
			end 
			else
				SELECT cast(0 as bit) as Complete	

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end

			
			
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END
