CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spWorksOrderMovementChangeDestination]
(
	@ContainerOutFK int,
	@DestinationTypeFK int,
	@DestinationFK int,
	@UserFK int
)
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT
	,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;

	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	DECLARE @ContainerOutFK2 int,
	@DestinationTypeFK2 int,
	@DestinationFK2 int,
	@UserFK2 int

	SET @ContainerOutFK2 = @ContainerOutFK; SET @DestinationTypeFK2 = @DestinationTypeFK; 
	SET @DestinationFK2 = @DestinationFK; SET @UserFK2 = @UserFK; 

	SET @ParameterDetails = '@ContainerOutFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@ContainerOutFK2 AS NVARCHAR(100)),'0') + ',@DestinationTypeFK = ' + @DestinationTypeFK2
	+ ',@DestinationFK = ' + @DestinationFK2 + ',@UserFK = ' + @UserFK2

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    --BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

		SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK,-1)

		-- Record proc start time.
        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END

	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY			

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start
		
			Declare @ReturnableError int
			SET @ReturnableError = 0 

			BEGIN TRY
				IF XACT_STATE() = 0 AND @@TRANCOUNT < 1 BEGIN TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName


				UPDATE woms
				SET woms.DestinationFK = @DestinationFK2, woms.UpdatedBy = @UserFK2
				FROM tblworksordermovements woms 
				INNER JOIN tblcontaineroutlinepalletcontent colpc ON colpc.palletfk = woms.palletfk
				INNER JOIN tblcontaineroutlines col ON colpc.containeroutlinefk = col.containeroutlinepk AND col.containeroutfk = @ContainerOutFK2
				WHERE woms.WorksOrderStatusFK IN (1,2) AND woms.DestinationLocationTypeFK = @DestinationTypeFK2

				BEGIN TRY IF XACT_STATE() = 1 AND @@TRANCOUNT = 1 AND @OpeningTranCount < 1 COMMIT TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH
			END TRY
			BEGIN CATCH
				BEGIN TRY IF @@TRANCOUNT = 1 AND @OpeningTranCount < 1 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH
				--ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName
				set @ReturnableError = 	ERROR_NUMBER()
			END CATCH

			DECLARE @RuntimeInSecondsText NVARCHAR(100) = (SELECT CAST( (SELECT ABS(DATEDIFF(ss, [Date], dbo.GetBSTDate()))) AS NVARCHAR(100)) FROM [dbo].[tblEventLog] WHERE EventLogPK = @EventLogPK)

			-- Record how long it took to run/execute this stored procedure.
			UPDATE [dbo].[tblEventLog] WITH (ROWLOCK)
			SET [State] = [State] + ', Runtime (Seconds) ' + @RuntimeInSecondsText
			WHERE EventLogPK = @EventLogPK AND @EventLogPK > 0

			SELECT @ReturnableError as ReturnValue

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end
			
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spWorksOrderMovementCheckUnfinishedMovements]
(
	@PalletFK int,
	@LocationFK int
)
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT
 ,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;
	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	DECLARE @PalletFK2 int, @LocationFK2 int
	SET @PalletFK2 = @PalletFK; SET @LocationFK2 = @LocationFK

	SET @ParameterDetails = '@PalletFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@PalletFK2 AS NVARCHAR(20)),'') + ',@LocationFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@LocationFK2 AS NVARCHAR(20)),'')

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    --BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

		SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END


	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY
			

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start

			select top 1
				woMovements.WorksOrderMovementPK,
				woMovements.WorksOrderFK,
				woMovements.DestinationLocationTypeFK,
				woMovements.DestinationFK,
				woMovements.DestinationBayPosition,
				woMovements.DestinationStackPosition,
				woMovements.DestinationPalletStart,
				woMovements.DestinationPalletEnd,
				woMovements.MovementDescription,
				woMovements.PalletFK,
				'0' as ForHandHeld,
				woMovements.UpdatedDate
			from
				tblWorksOrders wOrders
				inner join tblWorksOrderMovements woMovements on woMovements.WorksOrderFK = wOrders.WorksOrderPK
			where
				woMovements.WorksOrderStatusFK in (1,2)
			and
				woMovements.MovementDescription like '%'
			and
				wOrders.WorksOrderOriginFK in (1,10)
			and
				woMovements.DestinationLocationTypeFK in (1,3)
			and 
				(woMovements.DestinationFK = @LocationFK2 or @LocationFK2 =-1)
			and
				woMovements.PalletFK = @PalletFK2

			union 

			select top 1
				woMovements.WorksOrderMovementPK,
				woMovements.WorksOrderFK,
				woMovements.DestinationLocationTypeFK,
				woMovements.DestinationFK,
				woMovements.DestinationBayPosition,
				woMovements.DestinationStackPosition,
				woMovements.DestinationPalletStart,
				woMovements.DestinationPalletEnd,
				woMovements.MovementDescription,
				woMovements.PalletFK,
				'1' as ForHandHeld,
				woMovements.UpdatedDate
			from
				tblWorksOrders wOrders
				inner join tblWorksOrderMovements woMovements on woMovements.WorksOrderFK = wOrders.WorksOrderPK
			where
				woMovements.WorksOrderStatusFK in (1,2)
			and
				woMovements.MovementDescription like 'HAND HELD%'
			and
				wOrders.WorksOrderOriginFK in (1,10)
			and
				woMovements.DestinationLocationTypeFK in (1,3)
			and 
				(woMovements.DestinationFK = @LocationFK2 or @LocationFK2 =-1)
			and
				woMovements.PalletFK = @PalletFK2

				order by woMovements.UpdatedDate DESC

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end

			
			
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END

	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	DECLARE @buildingUnitFK2 int, @containerOutLineFK2 int, @worksOrderFK2 int, @loadingWorksOrderFK2 int, @destinationLocationTypeFK2 int, @destinationLocationFK2 int, @currentUserFK2 int
	SET @buildingUnitFK2 = @buildingUnitFK; SET @containerOutLineFK2 = @containerOutLineFK; SET @worksOrderFK2 = @worksOrderFK; SET @loadingWorksOrderFK2 = @loadingWorksOrderFK; 
	SET @destinationLocationTypeFK2 = @destinationLocationTypeFK; SET @destinationLocationFK2 = @destinationLocationFK; SET @currentUserFK2 = @currentUserFK

	SET @ParameterDetails = '@buildingUnitFK = ' + CAST(@buildingUnitFK2 AS NVARCHAR(20)) + ',@containerOutLineFK = ' + CAST(@containerOutLineFK2 AS NVARCHAR(20))
		+ ',@worksOrderFK = ' + CAST(@worksOrderFK2 AS NVARCHAR(20))+ ',@loadingWorksOrderFK = ' + CAST(@loadingWorksOrderFK2 AS NVARCHAR(20)) + ',@destinationLocationTypeFK = ' + CAST(@destinationLocationTypeFK2 AS NVARCHAR(20))
			+ ',@destinationLocationFK = ' + CAST(@destinationLocationFK2 AS NVARCHAR(20)) + ',@currentUserFK = ' + CAST(@currentUserFK2 AS NVARCHAR(20))

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    --BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

		SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK,-1)

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
			SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END

	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY			

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start

			Declare @createdMovement bit
			Declare @containerOutPK int
			Declare @buildingUnit nvarchar(500)

			Set @buildingUnit = (Select BuildingUnit from tblBuildingUnits where BuildingUnitPK = @buildingUnitFK2)
			Set @createdMovement = 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/--Will return false unless set to true. Only for creating movements, not for bringing archived movements back
			Select @containerOutPK = ContainerOutFK from tblContainerOutLines where ContainerOutLinePK = @containerOutLineFK2 --we will need this later to find stock orders
	
			--get stock order fk of this works order
			DECLARE @thisStockOrderFK int
			SELECT @thisStockOrderFK = FK FROM tblworksorders WHERE worksorderpk = @worksOrderFK2
			--SELECT @thisStockOrderFK AS thisStockOrderFK
			--Find All the pallets and pallet content we have movements for and populate temprary table
			DECLARE @tblExistingMovements TABLE 
			( 
				PalletFK int,
				PalletContentFK int,
				EntirePallet bit,
				FK int,
				MovementUnits decimal(18, 3)
			)

			INSERT into @tblExistingMovements
			Select woms.PalletFK, woms.PalletContentFK, woms.EntirePallet, wos.FK, woms.Units from 
			(
				Select * from tblWorksOrders 
				Where WorksOrderOriginFK = 2/*StockOrder*/ 
				AND FK IN (Select StockOrderPK from tblStockOrders Where ContainerOutFK = @containerOutPK)
				--AND FK <> @thisStockOrderFK
			) wos 
			inner join tblWorksOrderMovements woms on woms.WorksOrderFK = wos.WorksOrderPK 
			inner join tblContainerOutLinePalletContent colpc on woms.ContainerOutLinePalletContentFK = colpc.ContainerOutLinePalletContentPK 
			--SELECT * FROM @tblExistingMovements
			--KGs, Units etc...
			Declare @stockMovementType nvarchar(300), @stockMovementTypeSingular nvarchar(300), /*@bundlesOf decimal(18,3),*/ @stockIsEaches int
			Select @stockMovementType = case when eachesTypes.EachesTypePK is null then unitTypes.Abbreviation else eachesTypes.EachesType End,
				@stockMovementTypeSingular = case when eachesTypes.EachesTypePK is null then unitTypes.Abbreviation else eachesTypes.EachesTypeSingular End,
				/*@bundlesOf = stockItems.BundlesOf,*/ @stockIsEaches = case when EachesTypeFK > 0 then 1 else 0 end
			from tblContainerOutLines cols
			inner join tblStockItems stockItems on stockItems.StockItemPK = cols.StockItemFK
			left outer join tblEachesTypes eachesTypes ON eachesTypes.EachesTypePK = stockItems.EachesTypeFK
			left outer join tblUnitTypes unitTypes ON unitTypes.UnitTypePK = stockItems.UnitTypeFK 
			Where cols.ContainerOutLinePK = @containerOutLineFK2	

			--Get all the different pallet content for the order (for passed building unit and line) and create movements for them
			IF(@stockIsEaches = 1) 
			BEGIN
				DECLARE palletContentCursor CURSOR FOR 
				Select case when palletOnOrder.palletfk is null then 0 else palletOnOrder.EntirePallet end as EntirePallet, colpc.Eaches,  case when palletOnOrder.EntirePallet = 1 then palletOnOrder.TotalOrderedUnits else colpc.Units end Units, 
					colpc.PalletContentFK, pallets.PalletPK, case when pallets.CustomerBarcode = '' then pallets.barcode else pallets.CustomerBarcode end Barcode, pallets.CustomerPalletNumber, pallets.LocationTypeFK, pallets.LocationFK, RackingTypeFK, 
					case when RackingTypeFK = 1 then pallets.BayPosition else -1 End as SourceBayPosition, case when RackingTypeFK = 1 then pallets.StackPosition else -1 End as SourceStackPosition, BayLevel, location as SourceLocation,
					colpc.ContainerOutLinePalletContentPK, sis.StockItemCode, palletContent.Batch, case when palletOnOrder.EntirePallet = 1 then palletOnOrder.ActualUnits else palletContent.ActualUnits end as ActualUnits, 
					eachUnitTypes.Abbreviation, sis.RequireExpiryDate, sis.RequireManufactureDate, sis.RequireBestBefore, sis.RequireDateOfReceipt, palletContent.ExpiryDate, palletContent.DateOfManufacture, palletContent.BestBefore, palletContent.DateOfReceipt  
				From tblContainerOutLinePalletContent colpc
				inner join tblPalletContent palletContent ON palletContent.PalletContentPK = colpc.PalletContentFK
				inner join tblStockItems sis ON sis.StockItemPK = palletContent.StockItemFK
				left outer join tblUnitTypes eachUnitTypes ON eachUnitTypes.UnitTypePK = sis.EachesUnitTypeFK
				inner join tblPallets pallets ON pallets.PalletPK = colpc.PalletFK 		
				left outer join viewPalletLocations palletLocations ON palletLocations.palletPK = pallets.palletPK
				left join (
					Select subQ.PalletFK, case when ActualUnits = onOrder.TotalOrderedUnits then 1 else 0 end as EntirePallet, ActualUnits, onOrder.TotalOrderedUnits
					From (
						Select pc.PalletFK, sum(ActualUnits) ActualUnits 
						from tblPalletContent pc
						Group By pc.PalletFK
					) subQ
					inner join (
						Select pc2.PalletFK, sum(colpc2.Units) TotalOrderedUnits
						from tblContainerOutLinePalletContent colpc2
						inner join tblPalletContent pc2 on pc2.PalletContentPK = colpc2.PalletContentFK
						inner join tblPallets pallets2 on pallets2.PalletPK = pc2.PalletFK
						inner join tblContainerOutLines cols2 on cols2.ContainerOutLinePK = colpc2.ContaineroutLineFK
						inner join tblContainerOuts cOuts on cOuts.ContainerOutPK = cols2.ContainerOutFK
						Where ContainerOutStatusFK < 5 /*Ignore completed outs*/						
						AND cols2.ContainerOutLinePK = @containerOutLineFK2
						Group By pc2.PalletFK
					) onOrder on onOrder.PalletFK = subQ.PalletFK			
				) palletOnOrder on palletOnOrder.PalletFK = pallets.PalletPK
				Where colpc.ContainerOutLineFK = @containerOutLineFK2 AND @buildingUnitFK2 = palletLocations.BuildingUnitFK
		
				DECLARE @entirePalletsOnOrder TABLE 
				( 
					PalletPK int 
				)

			END 
			ELSE 
			BEGIN
				DECLARE palletContentCursor CURSOR FOR 
				Select palletOnOrder.EntirePallet, colpc.Eaches, colpc.Units, colpc.PalletContentFK, pallets.PalletPK, case when pallets.CustomerBarcode = '' then pallets.barcode else pallets.CustomerBarcode end Barcode, 
					pallets.CustomerPalletNumber, pallets.LocationTypeFK, pallets.LocationFK, palletLocation.RackingTypeFK, case when palletLocation.RackingTypeFK = 1 then pallets.BayPosition else -1 End as SourceBayPosition,
					case when palletLocation.RackingTypeFK = 1 then pallets.StackPosition else -1 End as SourceStackPosition, palletLocation.BayLevel, @BuildingUnit + ' ' + palletLocation.Location as SourceLocation,
					colpc.ContainerOutLinePalletContentPK, sis.StockItemCode, palletContent.Batch, palletContent.ActualUnits, CASE WHEN euts.Abbrieviation IS NULL THEN unitTypes.Abbreviation ELSE euts.Abbrieviation END UnitType,
					sis.RequireExpiryDate, sis.RequireManufactureDate, sis.RequireBestBefore, sis.RequireDateOfReceipt, palletContent.ExpiryDate, palletContent.DateOfManufacture, palletContent.BestBefore, palletContent.DateOfReceipt  
				From tblContainerOutLinePalletContent colpc 
				inner join tblPalletContent palletContent ON palletContent.PalletContentPK = colpc.PalletContentFK
				inner join tblStockItems sis ON sis.StockItemPK = palletContent.StockItemFK
				left outer join tblUnitTypes unitTypes ON unitTypes.UnitTypePK = sis.UnitTypeFK
				left OUTER JOIN tblEachesUnitTypes euts ON euts.EachesUnitTypePK = sis.EachesUnitTypeFK
				inner join tblPallets pallets ON pallets.PalletPK = palletContent.PalletFK
				LEFT OUTER JOIN viewPalletLocations palletLocation ON palletLocation.PalletPK = pallets.PalletPK
				inner join (
					Select subQ.PalletFK, case when ActualUnits = onOrder.TotalOrderedUnits then 1 else 0 end as EntirePallet, ActualUnits
					From (
						Select pc.PalletFK, sum(ActualUnits) ActualUnits 
						from tblPalletContent pc
						Group By pc.PalletFK
					) subQ
					inner join (
						Select pc2.PalletFK, sum(colpc2.Units) TotalOrderedUnits
						from tblContainerOutLinePalletContent colpc2
						inner join tblPalletContent pc2 on pc2.PalletContentPK = colpc2.PalletContentFK
						inner join tblPallets pallets2 on pallets2.PalletPK = pc2.PalletFK
						inner join tblContainerOutLines cols2 on cols2.ContainerOutLinePK = colpc2.ContaineroutLineFK
						inner join tblContainerOuts cOuts on cOuts.ContainerOutPK = cols2.ContainerOutFK
						Where ContainerOutStatusFK < 5 /*Ignore completed outs*/
						AND cols2.ContainerOutLinePK = @containerOutLineFK2
						Group By pc2.PalletFK
					) onOrder on onOrder.PalletFK = subQ.PalletFK			
				) palletOnOrder on palletOnOrder.PalletFK = pallets.PalletPK
				Where colpc.ContainerOutLineFK = @containerOutLineFK2 AND @buildingUnitFK2 = palletLocation.BuildingUnitFK
			END
	
		/******************************************************************************************************************************************************************************************/
			OPEN palletContentCursor
				Declare @entirePallet bit, @eaches decimal(18,3), @units decimal(18,3), @palletContentFK int, @palletFK int, @barcode nvarchar(500), @customerPalletNumber nvarchar(500),
				@sourceLocationTypeFK int, @sourceLocationFK int, @rackingTypeFK int, @sourceBayPosition int, @sourceStackPosition int, @destinationStackPosition int, @sourceBayLevel nvarchar(10),
				@sourceLocation nvarchar(500), @containerOutLinePalletContentFK int, @stockItemCode nvarchar(200), 
				@batch nvarchar(200), @sourceUnits decimal(18,3), @unitType nvarchar(20),
				@requireExpiryDate bit, @requireManufactureDate bit, @requireBestBefore bit, @requireDateOfReceipt bit,
				@expiryDate datetime, @manufactureDate datetime, @bestBefore datetime, @dateOfReceipt datetime
				--SELECT @palletFK AS TestingPalletFK
				Set @destinationStackPosition = 0 --This is setting up movements for a stock order (moving to setdown or loading bay) so Stack level is Zero (on ground)

				Declare @movementDescription nvarchar(2000)
				Declare @destinationLocation nvarchar(500)

				Select @destinationLocation = @buildingUnit + ' ' + case @destinationLocationTypeFK2 when 2 then loadingBays.LoadingBay when 3 then setDownAreas.SetDownArea WHEN 6 then sampleLocation  when 8 then floorLocation End
				From appLocationTypes locationTypes
				left outer join tblLoadingBays loadingBays ON loadingBays.LoadingBayPK = @destinationLocationFK2
				left outer join tblSetDownAreas setDownAreas ON setDownAreas.SetDownAreaPK = @destinationLocationFK2	
				left outer join tblSampleLocations sampleLocations ON sampleLocations.sampleLocationPk = @destinationLocationFK2
				left outer join tblFloorLocations floorLocations ON floorLocations.floorlocationPK = @destinationLocationFK2 
				where locationTypes.LocationTypePK = @destinationLocationTypeFK2

				Declare @stockMovement nvarchar(500)
	
				FETCH NEXT FROM palletContentCursor INTO 
					@entirePallet, @eaches, @units, @palletContentFK, @palletFK, @barcode, @customerPalletNumber, @sourceLocationTypeFK, 
					@sourceLocationFK, @rackingTypeFK, @sourceBayPosition, @sourceStackPosition, @sourceBayLevel, @sourceLocation, @containerOutLinePalletContentFK,
					@stockItemCode, @batch, @sourceUnits, @unitType,
					@requireExpiryDate, @requireManufactureDate, @requireBestBefore, @requireDateOfReceipt,
					@expiryDate, @manufactureDate, @bestBefore, @dateOfReceipt

					IF XACT_STATE() = 0 AND @@TRANCOUNT < 1 BEGIN TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName

					WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 
					BEGIN
					--SELECT @palletFK AS TestingPalletFK2
						--Check if we need to make a new movement or bring an existing one back(change is archived) or do nothing (unarchived movement exists)
						IF(NOT EXISTS(Select * from @tblExistingMovements Where PalletFK = @palletFK and ((EntirePallet = 1) or (EntirePallet = 0 and PalletContentFK = @palletContentFK)) AND [@tblExistingMovements].FK = @thisStockOrderFK AND MovementUnits = @units)) 
						BEGIN
							--Not movement exists at all, create it
							if(@entirePallet = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/)
							BEGIN
								IF(@stockIsEaches = 1) 
								BEGIN
								PRINT 'in here 1'
								--SELECT @stockItemCode, @batch, @unitType, @requireExpiryDate, @requireManufactureDate, @requireBestBefore, @requireDateOfReceipt, @sourceLocation, @destinationLocation
									Set @movementDescription = 'Move Pallet, Stock ' + @stockItemCode + ', Batch ' + @batch + ', Quantity ' + cast(@units as nvarchar(50)) + ' ' + @unitType 
										+ case when @customerPalletNumber = '' then ', Barcode ' + @barcode else ', Customer Barcode ' + @customerPalletNumber end 
											+ case when @requireExpiryDate = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ then ', ExpiryDate ' + convert(nvarchar(50),@expiryDate,103) else '' end 
												+ case when @requireManufactureDate = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ then ', ManufactureDate ' + convert(nvarchar(50),@manufactureDate,103) else '' end 
													+ case when @requireBestBefore = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ then ', BestBefore ' + convert(nvarchar(50),@bestBefore,103) else '' end 
														+ case when @requireDateOfReceipt = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ then ', DateOfReceipt ' + convert(nvarchar(50),@dateOfReceipt,103) else '' end 
															+ ' FROM ' + @sourceLocation + ' - TO - ' + @destinationLocation		
				
								END 
								ELSE 
								BEGIN
								
								PRINT 'in here 2'
									Set @movementDescription = 'Move Pallet, Stock ' + @stockItemCode + ', Batch ' + @batch + ', Quantity ' + cast(@units as nvarchar(50)) + ' ' + @unitType 
										+ case when @customerPalletNumber = '' then ', Barcode ' + @barcode else ', Customer Barcode ' + @customerPalletNumber end 
											+ case when @requireExpiryDate = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ then ', ExpiryDate ' + convert(nvarchar(50),@expiryDate,103) else '' end 
												+ case when @requireManufactureDate = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ then ', ManufactureDate ' + convert(nvarchar(50),@manufactureDate,103) else '' end 
													+ case when @requireBestBefore = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ then ', BestBefore ' + convert(nvarchar(50),@bestBefore,103) else '' end 
														+ case when @requireDateOfReceipt = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ then ', DateOfReceipt ' + convert(nvarchar(50),@dateOfReceipt,103) else '' end 
															+ ' FROM ' + @sourceLocation + ' - TO - ' + @destinationLocation
								END
							END 
							ELSE 
							BEGIN
								IF(@stockIsEaches = 1) 
								BEGIN
								print 'is eaches'
									print @sourceUnits
									print @units
									IF (@sourceUnits % @units = 0) 
									BEGIN
									print '% = 0'
										Set @stockMovement = cast(@sourceUnits/@units as numeric(10,0))
										IF(@stockMovement = 1) Set @stockMovementType = @stockMovementtypeSingular
									END 
									ELSE 					
										Set @stockMovement = @units
								END 
								ELSE 
								BEGIN
									Set @stockMovement = (Select case when @eaches > 0 then @eaches else @units end)
								END
								--If @bundlesOf > 0 --if we have bundles set, deal with it
								--BEGIN
								--	Set @stockMovement = cast(FLOOR(cast(@stockMovement as decimal(18,3)) / @bundlesOf) as nvarchar(500)) + ' Bundles plus ' 
								--		+ cast(cast(@stockMovement as decimal(18,3)) % @bundlesOf as nvarchar(500)) + ' ' + @stockMovementType 
								--			+ ' (' + @stockMovement + ' ' + @stockMovementType + ')'
								--END
								--ELSE BEGIN
									Set @stockMovement = @stockMovement + ' ' + @stockMovementType
								--END

								PRINT 'in here 3'
								Set @movementDescription = 'Move ' + cast(@stockMovement as nvarchar(50)) + ', Stock ' + @stockItemCode + ', Batch ' + @batch + ', Quantity ' 
									+ cast(@sourceUnits as nvarchar(50)) + ' ' + @unitType + ', Barcode ' + @barcode + case when @requireExpiryDate = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ then ', ExpiryDate ' 
										+ convert(nvarchar(50),@expiryDate,103) else '' end + case when @requireManufactureDate = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ then ', ManufactureDate ' 
											+ convert(nvarchar(50),@manufactureDate,103) else '' end + case when @requireBestBefore = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ then ', BestBefore ' 
												+ convert(nvarchar(50),@bestBefore,103) else '' end + case when @requireDateOfReceipt = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ then ', DateOfReceipt ' 
													+ convert(nvarchar(50),@dateOfReceipt,103) else '' end + ' FROM ' + @sourceLocation + ' - TO - ' + @destinationLocation
							END

							IF(@stockIsEaches > 0) 
							BEGIN
								IF(NOT EXISTS(Select * from @entirePalletsOnOrder where PalletPK = @palletFK)) 
								BEGIN
									insert into tblWorksOrderMovements
									values (@worksOrderFK2, 1/*WorksOrderStatus*/, @palletFK, case when @entirePallet = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ then -1 else @palletContentFK end,
										@containerOutLinePalletContentFK, @entirePallet, @eaches, @units, @sourceLocationTypeFK, @sourceLocationFK, @sourceBayPosition, @sourceStackPosition,
										@destinationLocationTypeFK2, @destinationLocationFK2, -1/*BayPosition*/, @destinationStackPosition, -1/*Pallet Start*/, -1/*Pallet End*/,	@movementDescription,
										0/*cast(0 as bit)*/, @currentUserFK2, dbo.GetBSTDate(), @currentUserFK2, dbo.GetBSTDate(),-1, -1, -1)

									--add second record, for loading
									if(@loadingWorksOrderFK2 > 0)
									begin
										insert into tblWorksOrderMovements
										values (@loadingWorksOrderFK2, 1/*WorksOrderStatus*/, @palletFK, case when @entirePallet = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ then -1 else @palletContentFK end,
											@containerOutLinePalletContentFK, @entirePallet, @eaches, @units, @destinationLocationTypeFK2, @destinationLocationFK2, -1, -1,
											5, @containerOutPK/*containerout as destination*/, -1/*BayPosition*/, -1, -1/*Pallet Start*/, -1/*Pallet End*/,	'Load stock on container',
											0/*cast(0 as bit)*/, @currentUserFK2, dbo.GetBSTDate(), @currentUserFK2, dbo.GetBSTDate(),-1, -1, -1)
									END

									IF(@entirePallet = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/) Insert into @entirePalletsOnOrder values (@palletFK)
									--Add this movement to the temporary table
									INSERT INTO @tblExistingMovements Select @palletFK, @palletContentFK, @entirePallet, -1, @units
								END
							END 
							ELSE 
							BEGIN
								insert into tblWorksOrderMovements
								values (@worksOrderFK2, 1/*WorksOrderStatus*/, @palletFK, @palletContentFK, @containerOutLinePalletContentFK, @entirePallet, @eaches, @units, @sourceLocationTypeFK, 
									@sourceLocationFK, @sourceBayPosition, @sourceStackPosition, @destinationLocationTypeFK2, @destinationLocationFK2, -1/*BayPosition*/, @destinationStackPosition, -1/*Pallet Start*/, 
									-1/*Pallet End*/,	@movementDescription, 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/, @currentUserFK2, dbo.GetBSTDate(), @currentUserFK2, dbo.GetBSTDate(),-1, -1, -1)

								if(@loadingWorksOrderFK2 > 0)
								begin
									--add second record, for loading
									insert into tblWorksOrderMovements
									values (@loadingWorksOrderFK2, 1/*WorksOrderStatus*/, @palletFK, @palletContentFK, @containerOutLinePalletContentFK, @entirePallet, @eaches, @units, @destinationLocationTypeFK2, 
										@destinationLocationFK2, -1, -1, 5, @containerOutPK, -1/*BayPosition*/, -1, -1/*Pallet Start*/, 
										-1/*Pallet End*/, 'Load stock on container', 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/, @currentUserFK2, dbo.GetBSTDate(), @currentUserFK2, dbo.GetBSTDate(),-1, -1, -1)
								end
								--Add this movement to the temporary table
								INSERT INTO @tblExistingMovements Select @palletFK, @palletContentFK, @entirePallet, -1, @units
							END
							Select @createdMovement = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/
						END 
						ELSE IF(EXISTS(Select * from (Select * from tblWorksOrders Where WorksOrderOriginFK = 2/*StockOrder*/ AND FK IN (Select StockOrderPK from tblStockOrders 
							Where ContainerOutFK = @containerOutPK)) wos inner join tblWorksOrderMovements woms on woms.WorksOrderFK = wos.WorksOrderPK 
							inner join tblcontaineroutlinepalletcontent colpc on woms.containeroutlinepalletcontentfk = colpc.containeroutlinepalletcontentpk 
							WHERE woms.IsArchived = 1 AND (woms.PalletFK = @palletFK or woms.palletcontentFk = @palletcontentFK))) 
						BEGIN-- We have an existing movement for this pallet that has been archived, bring this back (unarchive)
							-- 'About to update tblWorksOrders'
							UPDATE WOM WITH (ROWLOCK)
							SET WOM.IsArchived = 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/
							--SELECT WOM.WorksOrderMovementPK
							FROM tblWorksOrderMovements WOM
							INNER JOIN tblWorksOrders WO ON WO.WorksOrderPK = WOM.WorksOrderFK
							INNER JOIN tblStockOrders SO ON SO.StockOrderPK = WO.FK AND WO.WorksOrderOriginFK = 2 and SO.ContainerOutFK = @containerOutPK
							INNER JOIN tblContainerOutLinePalletContent COLPC ON WOM.ContainerOutLinePalletContentFK = COLPC.ContainerOutLinePalletContentPK
							where WOM.IsArchived = 1 AND (WOM.PalletFK = @palletFK or WOM.palletcontentFk = @palletcontentFK)

							drop table if exists #tmpthispalmovements
							select * into #tmpthispalmovements from tblWorksOrderMovements where PalletFK = @palletFK 
							union 
							select * from tblWorksOrderMovements where palletcontentFk = @palletcontentFK

							UPDATE WO WITH (ROWLOCK)
							SET WO.IsArchived = 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/, WO.WorksOrderStatusFK = CASE WHEN OpenMovements.NumberOfMovements is null THEN 3 ELSE WO.WorksOrderStatusFK END
							--SELECT WO.WorksOrderPK, CASE when OpenMovements.NumberOfMovements is null then 0 else OpenMovements.NumberOfMovements end as OpenMovements
							FROM tblWorksOrders WO
							INNER JOIN tblStockOrders SO ON SO.StockOrderPK = WO.FK AND WO.WorksOrderOriginFK = 2
							INNER JOIN #tmpthispalmovements WOMS ON WO.WorksOrderPK = WOMS.WorksOrderFK
							INNER JOIN tblContainerOutLinePalletContent COLPC ON WOMS.ContainerOutLinePalletContentFK = COLPC.ContainerOutLinePalletContentPK
							LEFT JOIN (SELECT COUNT(worksordermovementpk)NumberOfMovements, WorksOrderFK from #tmpthispalmovements where WorksOrderStatusFK <> 3 AND IsArchived = 0 
							GROUP BY WorksOrderFK) OpenMovements ON WO.WorksOrderPK = OpenMovements.WorksOrderFK
							where WOMS.IsArchived = 0 AND (WOMS.PalletFK = @palletFK or WOMS.palletcontentFk = @palletcontentFK)		
						END --END of existing movements check existing movements check

					FETCH NEXT FROM palletContentCursor INTO 
					@entirePallet, @eaches, @units, @palletContentFK, @palletFK, @barcode, @customerPalletNumber, @sourceLocationTypeFK, 
					@sourceLocationFK, @rackingTypeFK, @sourceBayPosition, @sourceStackPosition, @sourceBayLevel, @sourceLocation, @containerOutLinePalletContentFK,
					@stockItemCode, @batch, @sourceUnits, @unitType,
					@requireExpiryDate, @requireManufactureDate, @requireBestBefore, @requireDateOfReceipt,
					@expiryDate, @manufactureDate, @bestBefore, @dateOfReceipt
			END

			BEGIN TRY IF XACT_STATE() = 1 AND @@TRANCOUNT = 1 AND @OpeningTranCount < 1 COMMIT TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH

			CLOSE palletContentCursor
			DEALLOCATE palletContentCursor 
	
			--DECLARE @RuntimeInSecondsText NVARCHAR(100) = (SELECT CAST( (SELECT ABS(DATEDIFF(ss, [Date], dbo.GetBSTDate()))) AS NVARCHAR(100)) FROM [dbo].[tblEventLog] WHERE EventLogPK = @EventLogPK)

			---- Record how long it took to run/execute this stored procedure.
			--UPDATE [dbo].[tblEventLog] WITH (ROWLOCK)
			--SET [State] = [State] + ', Runtime (Seconds) ' + @RuntimeInSecondsText
			--WHERE EventLogPK = @EventLogPK AND @EventLogPK > 0

			Select @createdMovement 
    
			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end
			
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */

			IF CURSOR_STATUS('global','palletContentCursor') >= -1
			 BEGIN
			  IF CURSOR_STATUS('global','palletContentCursor') > -1
			   BEGIN
				CLOSE palletContentCursor
			   END
			 DEALLOCATE palletContentCursor
			END

			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END
GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[spWorksOrderMovementCreateLineForStockOrder_Optimized_Merge]    Script Date: 02/11/2026 17:47:27 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
 CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spWorksOrderMovementCreateLineForStockOrder_Optimized_Merge]  
(
    @buildingUnitFK INT,
    @containerOutLineFK INT,
    @worksOrderFK INT,
    @loadingWorksOrderFK INT = -1,
    @destinationLocationTypeFK INT,
    @destinationLocationFK INT,
    @currentUserFK INT
)
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON; 
    SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED;

    DECLARE 
        @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400) = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID),
        @ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),
        @ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),
        @EventLogPK INT,
        @ParentEventLogPK INT,
        @DeadlockErrorRetries INT = 1,
        @OpeningTranCount INT = @@TRANCOUNT,
        @OpeningXactState INT = XACT_STATE();
		 
    DECLARE 
        @buildingUnitFK2 INT = @buildingUnitFK,
        @containerOutLineFK2 INT = @containerOutLineFK,
        @worksOrderFK2 INT = @worksOrderFK,
        @loadingWorksOrderFK2 INT = @loadingWorksOrderFK,
        @destinationLocationTypeFK2 INT = @destinationLocationTypeFK,
        @destinationLocationFK2 INT = @destinationLocationFK,
        @currentUserFK2 INT = @currentUserFK;
		    
    SET @ParameterDetails = 
        '@buildingUnitFK=' + CAST(@buildingUnitFK2 AS NVARCHAR(20)) +
        ', @containerOutLineFK=' + CAST(@containerOutLineFK2 AS NVARCHAR(20)) +
        ', @worksOrderFK=' + CAST(@worksOrderFK2 AS NVARCHAR(20)) +
        ', @loadingWorksOrderFK=' + CAST(@loadingWorksOrderFK2 AS NVARCHAR(20)) +
        ', @destinationLocationTypeFK=' + CAST(@destinationLocationTypeFK2 AS NVARCHAR(20)) +
        ', @destinationLocationFK=' + CAST(@destinationLocationFK2 AS NVARCHAR(20)) +
        ', @currentUserFK=' + CAST(@currentUserFK2 AS NVARCHAR(20));

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL
        CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(
            [ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),
            ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),
            ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),
            EventLogFK INT,
            HasException BIT
        );

    SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC;
    SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK,-1);

    INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)  
    SELECT 'Database', dbo.GetBSTDate(), @@SERVERNAME, UPPER(DB_NAME()), -1, '', 'Azure', 'dbo', @ThisProcedureName, 'Exec', 'Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK;

    SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY();

    SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath 
    FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails 
    WHERE [ID] = (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);

    SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName) + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;

    INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName, ExecutionPath, EventLogFK)
    VALUES (@ThisProcedureName, @ExecutionPath, @EventLogPK);

    WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
    BEGIN
        BEGIN TRY
          
            -- ContainerOutPK and building unit text         
            DECLARE @containerOutPK INT;
            SELECT @containerOutPK = ContainerOutFK
            FROM dbo.tblContainerOutLines
            WHERE ContainerOutLinePK = @containerOutLineFK2;

            DECLARE @buildingUnit NVARCHAR(500);
            SELECT @buildingUnit = ISNULL(BuildingUnit,'')
            FROM dbo.tblBuildingUnits
            WHERE BuildingUnitPK = @buildingUnitFK2;
			
            -- Table variable for pallet content           
            DECLARE @PalletContent TABLE
            (
                ContainerOutLinePalletContentPK INT PRIMARY KEY,
                PalletFK INT,
                PalletContentFK INT,
                Eaches DECIMAL(18,3),
                Units DECIMAL(18,3),
                EntirePallet BIT,
                SourceLocationTypeFK INT,
                SourceLocationFK INT,
                UnitType NVARCHAR(50),
                StockItemCode NVARCHAR(200),
                Batch NVARCHAR(200),
                Barcode NVARCHAR(500),
                CustomerPalletNumber NVARCHAR(500),
                RequireExpiryDate BIT,
                RequireManufactureDate BIT,
                RequireBestBefore BIT,
                RequireDateOfReceipt BIT,
                ExpiryDate DATETIME,
                DateOfManufacture DATETIME,
                BestBefore DATETIME,
                DateOfReceipt DATETIME,
                SourceLocation NVARCHAR(500)
            );
          
		   DECLARE @DestinationLocation NVARCHAR(500);
           SELECT TOP 1 @DestinationLocation = @buildingUnit + ' ' + ISNULL(LocationName,'Unknown')
           FROM 
           (
               SELECT 2 AS LocationTypeFK, LoadingBayPK AS LocationFK, LoadingBay AS LocationName FROM dbo.tblLoadingBays
               UNION ALL
               SELECT 3, SetDownAreaPK, SetDownArea FROM dbo.tblSetDownAreas
               UNION ALL
               SELECT 6, SampleLocationPK, SampleLocation FROM dbo.tblSampleLocations
               UNION ALL
               SELECT 8, FloorLocationPK, FloorLocation FROM dbo.tblFloorLocations
           ) AS LocationLookup
           WHERE LocationTypeFK = @destinationLocationTypeFK2
             AND LocationFK = @destinationLocationFK2;

            -- Precompute Locations and Pallet totals         
            ;WITH LocationLookup AS
            (
                SELECT 2 AS LocationTypeFK, LoadingBayPK AS LocationFK, LoadingBay AS LocationName FROM dbo.tblLoadingBays
                UNION ALL
                SELECT 3, SetDownAreaPK, SetDownArea FROM dbo.tblSetDownAreas
                UNION ALL
                SELECT 6, SampleLocationPK, SampleLocation FROM dbo.tblSampleLocations
                UNION ALL
                SELECT 8, FloorLocationPK, FloorLocation FROM dbo.tblFloorLocations
            ),           
            PalletTotals AS
            (
                SELECT PalletFK, SUM(ActualUnits) AS TotalActualUnits
                FROM dbo.tblPalletContent
                GROUP BY PalletFK
            ),
            OrderedTotals AS
            (
                SELECT colpc2.PalletFK, SUM(colpc2.Units) AS TotalOrderedUnits
                FROM dbo.tblContainerOutLinePalletContent colpc2
                INNER JOIN dbo.tblContainerOutLines col2
                    ON col2.ContainerOutLinePK = colpc2.ContainerOutLineFK
                WHERE col2.ContainerOutLinePK = @containerOutLineFK2
                GROUP BY colpc2.PalletFK
            )
            INSERT INTO @PalletContent
            SELECT
                colpc.ContainerOutLinePalletContentPK,
                colpc.PalletFK,
                colpc.PalletContentFK,
                colpc.Eaches,
                colpc.Units,
                CASE WHEN pt.TotalActualUnits = ot.TotalOrderedUnits THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS EntirePallet,
                pl.LocationTypeFK,
                pl.LocationFK,
                COALESCE(euts.Abbrieviation, ut.Abbreviation,'') AS UnitType,
                sis.StockItemCode,
                pc.Batch,
                CASE WHEN ISNULL(pl.CustomerBarcode,'') = '' THEN pl.Barcode ELSE pl.CustomerBarcode END AS Barcode,
                ISNULL(pl.CustomerPalletNumber,'') AS CustomerPalletNumber,
                ISNULL(sis.RequireExpiryDate,0),
                ISNULL(sis.RequireManufactureDate,0),
                ISNULL(sis.RequireBestBefore,0),
                ISNULL(sis.RequireDateOfReceipt,0),
                pc.ExpiryDate,
                pc.DateOfManufacture,
                pc.BestBefore,
                pc.DateOfReceipt,
                @buildingUnit + ' ' + ISNULL(ll.LocationName,'') AS SourceLocation
            FROM dbo.tblContainerOutLinePalletContent colpc
            INNER JOIN dbo.tblContainerOutLines col ON col.ContainerOutLinePK = colpc.ContainerOutLineFK
            INNER JOIN dbo.tblPalletContent pc ON pc.PalletContentPK = colpc.PalletContentFK
            INNER JOIN dbo.tblPallets pl ON pl.PalletPK = colpc.PalletFK
            INNER JOIN dbo.tblStockItems sis ON sis.StockItemPK = pc.StockItemFK
            LEFT JOIN dbo.tblEachesUnitTypes euts ON euts.EachesUnitTypePK = sis.EachesUnitTypeFK
            LEFT JOIN dbo.tblUnitTypes ut ON ut.UnitTypePK = sis.UnitTypeFK
            LEFT JOIN PalletTotals pt ON pt.PalletFK = pl.PalletPK
            LEFT JOIN OrderedTotals ot ON ot.PalletFK = pl.PalletPK
            LEFT JOIN LocationLookup ll ON ll.LocationTypeFK = pl.LocationTypeFK AND ll.LocationFK = pl.LocationFK
            WHERE col.ContainerOutFK = @containerOutPK
              AND pl.BuildingUnitFK = @buildingUnitFK2;

            IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM @PalletContent) RETURN;

            -- Table variable for source movements       
            DECLARE @SourceMovements TABLE
            (
                ContainerOutLinePalletContentPK INT PRIMARY KEY,
                WorksOrderFK INT,
                PalletFK INT,
                PalletContentFK INT,
                EntirePallet BIT,
                Eaches DECIMAL(18,3),
                Units DECIMAL(18,3),
                SourceLocationTypeFK INT,
                SourceLocationFK INT,
                DestinationLocationTypeFK INT,
                DestinationFK INT,
                MovementDescription NVARCHAR(2000),
                ContainerOutPK INT
            );

            INSERT INTO @SourceMovements
            SELECT
                p.ContainerOutLinePalletContentPK,
                @worksOrderFK2,
                p.PalletFK,
                CASE WHEN p.EntirePallet=1 THEN -1 ELSE p.PalletContentFK END,
                p.EntirePallet,
                p.Eaches,
                p.Units,
                p.SourceLocationTypeFK,
                p.SourceLocationFK,
                @destinationLocationTypeFK2,
                @destinationLocationFK2,
                'Move ' +
                CASE WHEN p.EntirePallet=1 THEN 'Pallet, ' ELSE '' END +
                'Stock ' + ISNULL(p.StockItemCode,'') +
                CASE WHEN ISNULL(p.Batch,'')<>'' THEN ', Batch ' + p.Batch ELSE '' END +
                ', Quantity ' + CAST(p.Units AS NVARCHAR(50)) + ' ' + ISNULL(p.UnitType,'') +
                CASE WHEN ISNULL(p.CustomerPalletNumber,'')='' THEN ', Barcode ' + p.Barcode ELSE ', Customer Barcode ' + p.CustomerPalletNumber END +
                CASE WHEN p.RequireExpiryDate=1 THEN ', ExpiryDate ' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(50),p.ExpiryDate,103) ELSE '' END +
                CASE WHEN p.RequireManufactureDate=1 THEN ', ManufactureDate ' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(50),p.DateOfManufacture,103) ELSE '' END +
                CASE WHEN p.RequireBestBefore=1 THEN ', BestBefore ' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(50),p.BestBefore,103) ELSE '' END +
                CASE WHEN p.RequireDateOfReceipt=1 THEN ', DateOfReceipt ' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(50),p.DateOfReceipt,103) ELSE '' END +
                ' FROM ' + ISNULL(p.SourceLocation,'') + ' TO ' +
               ISNULL(@DestinationLocation,'') AS MovementDescription,
                @containerOutPK
            FROM @PalletContent p;

            -- MERGE into tblWorksOrderMovements
            MERGE dbo.tblWorksOrderMovements AS target
            USING @SourceMovements AS src
                ON target.WorksOrderFK = src.WorksOrderFK
                   AND target.PalletFK = src.PalletFK
                   AND ISNULL(target.PalletContentFK,-1) = ISNULL(src.PalletContentFK,-1)
                   AND ISNULL(target.ContainerOutLinePalletContentFK,-1) = ISNULL(src.ContainerOutLinePalletContentPK,-1)
                   AND ISNULL(target.EntirePallet,0) = ISNULL(src.EntirePallet,0)
            WHEN MATCHED AND (target.IsArchived = 1 
                OR ISNULL(target.Units,0) <> ISNULL(src.Units,0)
                OR ISNULL(target.Eaches,0) <> ISNULL(src.Eaches,0)
                OR ISNULL(target.MovementDescription,'') <> ISNULL(src.MovementDescription,''))
                THEN UPDATE SET
                    target.Units = src.Units,
                    target.Eaches = src.Eaches,
                    target.EntirePallet = src.EntirePallet,
                    target.SourceLocationTypeFK = src.SourceLocationTypeFK,
                    target.SourceLocationFK = src.SourceLocationFK,
                    target.DestinationLocationTypeFK = src.DestinationLocationTypeFK,
                    target.DestinationFK = src.DestinationFK,                
                   target.MovementDescription = src.MovementDescription,
                    target.UpdatedBy = @currentUserFK2,
                    target.UpdatedDate = dbo.GetBSTDate(),
                    target.WorksOrderStatusFK = 1,
                    target.IsArchived = 0
            WHEN NOT MATCHED BY TARGET
                THEN INSERT (
                    WorksOrderFK, WorksOrderStatusFK, PalletFK, PalletContentFK, ContainerOutLinePalletContentFK,
                    EntirePallet, Eaches, Units,
                    SourceLocationTypeFK, SourceLocationFK, SourceBayPosition, SourceStackPosition,
                    DestinationLocationTypeFK, DestinationFK, DestinationBayPosition, DestinationStackPosition,
                    DestinationPalletStart, DestinationPalletEnd,
                    MovementDescription, IsArchived,
                    InsertedBy, InsertedDate, UpdatedBy, UpdatedDate,
                    ResponsibleUserFK, HandheldDeviceFK, WarehouseMachineFK
                )
                VALUES (
                    src.WorksOrderFK, 1, src.PalletFK, src.PalletContentFK, src.ContainerOutLinePalletContentPK,
                    src.EntirePallet, src.Eaches, src.Units,
                    src.SourceLocationTypeFK, src.SourceLocationFK, 0, 0,   
                    src.DestinationLocationTypeFK, src.DestinationFK, 0, 0, 
                    0, 0,                                                
                    src.MovementDescription, 0,                         
                    @currentUserFK2, dbo.GetBSTDate(), @currentUserFK2, dbo.GetBSTDate(),
                    -1, -1, -1                                           
                );

            -- Loading movements (if loadingWorksOrderFK provided)
            IF @loadingWorksOrderFK2 > 0
            BEGIN
                INSERT INTO dbo.tblWorksOrderMovements
                (
                    WorksOrderFK, WorksOrderStatusFK, PalletFK, PalletContentFK, ContainerOutLinePalletContentFK,
                    EntirePallet, Eaches, Units, SourceLocationTypeFK, SourceLocationFK, SourceBayPosition, SourceStackPosition,
                    DestinationLocationTypeFK, DestinationFK, DestinationBayPosition, DestinationStackPosition,
                    DestinationPalletStart, DestinationPalletEnd,
                    MovementDescription, IsArchived,
                    InsertedBy, InsertedDate, UpdatedBy, UpdatedDate,
                    ResponsibleUserFK, HandheldDeviceFK, WarehouseMachineFK
                )
                SELECT
                    @loadingWorksOrderFK2, 1,
                    sm.PalletFK, sm.PalletContentFK, sm.ContainerOutLinePalletContentPK, 
                    sm.EntirePallet, sm.Eaches, sm.Units,  
                    sm.DestinationLocationTypeFK, sm.DestinationFK, 0, 0,  
                    5, @containerOutPK, 0, 0,  
                    0, 0, 
                    'Load stock on container', 0,  
                    @currentUserFK2, dbo.GetBSTDate(), @currentUserFK2, dbo.GetBSTDate(),  
                    -1, -1, -1  
                FROM @SourceMovements sm
                WHERE NOT EXISTS
                (
                    SELECT 1
                    FROM dbo.tblWorksOrderMovements w
                    WHERE w.WorksOrderFK = @loadingWorksOrderFK2
                      AND w.PalletFK = sm.PalletFK
                      AND ISNULL(w.PalletContentFK,-1) = ISNULL(sm.PalletContentFK,-1)
                      AND ISNULL(w.ContainerOutLinePalletContentFK,-1) = ISNULL(sm.ContainerOutLinePalletContentPK,-1)
                      AND ISNULL(w.EntirePallet,0) = ISNULL(sm.EntirePallet,0)
                );
            END

            BREAK; -- exit retry loop on success

        END TRY
        BEGIN CATCH
            DECLARE
                @ErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX) = ERROR_MESSAGE(),
                @ErrorSeverity INT = ERROR_SEVERITY(),
                @ErrorState INT = ERROR_STATE(),
                @XactState INT = XACT_STATE(),
                @TranCount INT = @@TRANCOUNT,
                @FullRollbackDone BIT = 0,
                @ErrorDateTime DATETIME = dbo.GetBSTDate();

            IF @XactState = -1
            BEGIN
                ROLLBACK;
                SET @FullRollbackDone = 1;
            END
            ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0
            BEGIN
                ROLLBACK;
            END

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1)
                UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);

            IF (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails) = 1
                EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails, @ErrorDateTime, @ExecutionPath, @ErrorMessageOut = @ErrorMessage OUTPUT;

            IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollbackDone = 1)
            BEGIN
                RAISERROR(@ErrorMessage, @ErrorSeverity, @ErrorState);
                RETURN;
            END
            ELSE
                WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:01';

        END CATCH;

        SET @DeadlockErrorRetries += 1;
    END
END;
GO

-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Geir Lie>
-- Create date: <09/03/2015>
-- Description:	<Change existing Work Order Movements>
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spWorksOrderMovementDataChange]
(
	@WorksOrderMovementPK int,
	@DestinationFK int,
	@DestinationBayPosition int,
	@DestinationStackPosition int,
	@DestinationPalletStart int,
	@DestinationPalletEnd int,
	@Description nvarchar(max),
	@UserFK int,
	@FinishMovement int = -1
)
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT
	,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;

	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	DECLARE @WorksOrderMovementPK2 int,
	@DestinationFK2 int,
	@DestinationBayPosition2 int,
	@DestinationStackPosition2 int,
	@DestinationPalletStart2 int,
	@DestinationPalletEnd2 int,
	@Description2 nvarchar(max),
	@UserFK2 int,
	@FinishMovement2 int

	SET @WorksOrderMovementPK2 = @WorksOrderMovementPK; SET @DestinationFK2 = @DestinationFK; SET @DestinationBayPosition2 = @DestinationBayPosition
	SET @DestinationStackPosition2 = @DestinationStackPosition; SET @DestinationPalletStart2 = @DestinationPalletStart; SET @DestinationPalletEnd2 = @DestinationPalletEnd
	SET @Description2 = @Description; SET @UserFK2 = @UserFK; SET @FinishMovement2 = @FinishMovement

	SET @ParameterDetails = '@WorksOrderMovementPK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@WorksOrderMovementPK2 AS NVARCHAR(100)),'0') + ',@DestinationFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@DestinationFK2 AS NVARCHAR(100)),'0')
	+ ',@DestinationBayPosition = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@DestinationBayPosition2 AS NVARCHAR(100)),'0') + ',@DestinationStackPosition = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@DestinationStackPosition2 AS NVARCHAR(100)),'0')
	+ ',@DestinationPalletStart = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@DestinationPalletStart2 AS NVARCHAR(100)),'0') + ',@DestinationPalletEnd = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@DestinationPalletEnd2 AS NVARCHAR(100)),'0')
	+ ',@Description = ' + ISNULL(@Description2,'') + ',@UserFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@UserFK2 AS NVARCHAR(100)),'0') + ',@FinishMovement = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@FinishMovement2 AS NVARCHAR(100)),'0')

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    --BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

		SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK,-1)

		-- Record proc start time.
        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END

	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY			

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start
		
			Declare @ReturnableError int
			SET @ReturnableError = 0 

			BEGIN TRY
				IF XACT_STATE() = 0 AND @@TRANCOUNT < 1 BEGIN TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName

				if (@FinishMovement <> -1 ) 
				begin
					Update tblWorksOrderMovements WITH (ROWLOCK) 
					set DestinationFK = @DestinationFK2,  
						DestinationBayPosition=@DestinationBayPosition2,
						DestinationStackPosition = @DestinationStackPosition2, 
						DestinationPalletStart = @DestinationPalletStart2, 
						DestinationPalletEnd =@DestinationPalletEnd2,
						MovementDescription = @Description2
					where WorksOrderMovementPK = @WorksOrderMovementPK2

					exec spWorksOrderMovementStatusChange @WorksOrderMovementPK2, 3, @UserFK2
				end
				else
				begin
					Update tblWorksOrderMovements WITH (ROWLOCK) 
					set DestinationFK = @DestinationFK2,  
						DestinationBayPosition=@DestinationBayPosition2,
						DestinationStackPosition = @DestinationStackPosition2, 
						DestinationPalletStart = @DestinationPalletStart2, 
						DestinationPalletEnd =@DestinationPalletEnd2,
						MovementDescription = @Description2
					where WorksOrderMovementPK = @WorksOrderMovementPK2
				end

				BEGIN TRY IF XACT_STATE() = 1 AND @@TRANCOUNT = 1 AND @OpeningTranCount < 1 COMMIT TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH
			END TRY
			BEGIN CATCH
				BEGIN TRY IF @@TRANCOUNT = 1 AND @OpeningTranCount < 1 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH
				--ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName
				set @ReturnableError = 	ERROR_NUMBER()
			END CATCH

			DECLARE @RuntimeInSecondsText NVARCHAR(100) = (SELECT CAST( (SELECT ABS(DATEDIFF(ss, [Date], dbo.GetBSTDate()))) AS NVARCHAR(100)) FROM [dbo].[tblEventLog] WHERE EventLogPK = @EventLogPK)

			-- Record how long it took to run/execute this stored procedure.
			UPDATE [dbo].[tblEventLog] WITH (ROWLOCK)
			SET [State] = [State] + ', Runtime (Seconds) ' + @RuntimeInSecondsText
			WHERE EventLogPK = @EventLogPK AND @EventLogPK > 0

			SELECT @ReturnableError as ReturnValue

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end
			
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END
GO

      0 /*bit value*/, @currentUserFK2, dbo.GetBSTDate(), @currentUserFK2, dbo.GetBSTDate())

     BEGIN

   COMPLETEMOVEMENT:

 BEGIN   /*All pallet movements are complete, set the works order to complete*/

   SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;      
      
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY

   BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END      
   ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */      
  END CATCH

-- Author:		<Clerkin, Jamie>
-- Create date: <07/20/2015>
-- Description:	<get StockIn movements to complete if a stock out is completed for the same pallet>
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spWorksOrderMovementsToCancel]
(
	@StockOrderFK int
)
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT
 ,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;
	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	DECLARE @StockOrderFK2 INT
	SET @StockOrderFK2 = @StockOrderFK

	SET @ParameterDetails = '@StockOrderFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@StockOrderFK2 AS NVARCHAR(20)),'')

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    --BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

		SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END


	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY
			

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start

			select wom.worksordermovementpk, stk.stockInPK, wo.worksorderpk
			from tblworksordermovements wom
			inner join tblworksorders wo on wo.worksorderpk = wom.worksorderfk
			inner join tblStockIns stk on stk.stockInPK = wo.FK
			where palletfk in (
			select palletfk
			from tblworksordermovements
			inner join tblworksorders wo on wo.worksorderpk = tblworksordermovements.worksorderfk
			where wo.fk = @StockOrderFK2)
			and wo.worksorderoriginfk = 1  and wo.worksorderstatusfk = 1
			and wo.isarchived = 0

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end

			
			
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END
GO

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spWorksOrderMovementsUnassignedForStockOut]
(
	@containerOutPK int
)
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT
 ,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;
	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	DECLARE @containerOutPK2 INT
	SET @containerOutPK2 = @containerOutPK

	SET @ParameterDetails = '@containerOutPK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@containerOutPK2 AS NVARCHAR(20)),'')

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    --BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

		SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END


	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY
			

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start

			drop table if exists #tmpcolpc
			select containeroutlinepalletcontentpk, palletfk
			into #tmpcolpc
			from tblContainerOutLinePalletContent colpc 
			inner join tblContainerOutLines col on ContainerOutLinePK = ContainerOutLineFK 
			where containeroutfk = @containerOutPK2

			select distinct woms.WorksOrderMovementPK 
			from #tmpcolpc colpc
			inner join tblworksordermovements woms on colpc.ContainerOutLinePalletContentPK = woms.ContainerOutLinePalletContentFK and colpc.palletfk = woms.palletfk
			where ResponsibleUserFK < 1 

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end

			
			
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END
