CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spWorksOrderPalletComplete]
(
	@worksOrderPalletPK int,
	@currentUserFK int
)
AS
BEGIN
    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT
	,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;
	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	DECLARE @worksOrderPalletPK2 INT, @currentUserFK2 INT
	SET @worksOrderPalletPK2 = @worksOrderPalletPK; SET @currentUserFK2 = @currentUserFK

	SET @ParameterDetails = '@worksOrderPalletPK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@worksOrderPalletPK2 AS NVARCHAR(20)),'') + ',@currentUserFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@currentUserFK2 AS NVARCHAR(20)),'')

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    --BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

		SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END

	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start

			Declare @worksOrderPK int 
			Declare @worksOrderTypeFK int
			Declare @worksOrderOriginFK int
			Declare @FK int
			Declare @worksOrderPalletStatusFK int
			Declare @palletFK int
			Declare @palletTypeFK int
			Declare @locationTypeFK int
			Declare @locationFK int
			Declare @stockItemFK int
			Declare @actualEaches decimal
			Declare @actualUnits decimal
			Declare @batch nvarchar(200)
			Declare @supplierBatch nvarchar(200)
			Declare @eachUnits decimal
			Declare @expiraryDate datetime
			Declare @dateOfManufacture datetime
			Declare @bestBefore datetime
			Declare @dateOfReceipt datetime
			Declare @palletContentBarcode nvarchar(200)
			Declare @palletContentCustomerBarcode nvarchar(200)
			Declare @specialStockTypeFK int
			Declare @splitToPalletTypeFK int
			Declare @stockInLineFK int
			Declare @containerOutLineFK int
			Declare @containerOutFK int

			Declare @workParameterInt1 int
			Declare @workParameterInt2 int
			Declare @workParameterInt3 int

			Declare @palletPosition int
			Declare @palletCount int

			Declare @totalEaches decimal
			Declare @totalBatchEaches decimal
			Declare @buildingUnitTotalEaches decimal
			Declare @buildingUnitTotalBatchEaches decimal
			Declare @totalUnits decimal
			Declare @totalBatchUnits decimal
			Declare @buildingUnitTotalUnits decimal
			Declare @buildingUnitTotalBatchUnits decimal
			Declare @totalPallets int
			Declare @totalBatchPallets int
			Declare @buildingUnitTotalPallets int
			Declare @buildingUnitTotalBatchPallets int

			Declare @newPalletPK int
			Declare @newPalletContentPK int
			Declare @buildingUnitFK int

			DECLARE @palletAuditFK INT

			Select  
				@buildingUnitFK = pallets.BuildingUnitFK,
				@worksOrderTypeFK = WorksOrderTypeFK, 
				@worksOrderOriginFK = WorksOrderOriginFK,
				@FK = wos.FK,
				@worksOrderPalletStatusFK = wops.WorksOrderStatusFK,
				@worksOrderPK = WorksOrderPK,
				@palletFK = PalletPK,
				@palletTypeFK = PalletTypeFK,
				@locationTypeFK = LocationTypeFK,
				@locationFK = LocationFK,
				@workParameterInt1 = wops.WorkParameterInt1,
				@workParameterInt2 = wops.WorkParameterInt2,
				@workParameterInt3 = wops.WorkParameterInt3,
				@splitToPalletTypeFK = pallets.palletTypeFK
			FROM 
				(Select * from tblWorksOrderPallets Where WorksOrderPalletPK = @worksOrderPalletPK2) AS wops
			inner join tblWorksOrders AS wos on
				wos.WorksOrderPK = wops.WorksOrderFK
			inner join tblPallets AS pallets on
				pallets.PalletPK = wops.PalletFK
		
			--if complete or cancelled return
			if @worksOrderPalletStatusFK in (3,4)
			BEGIN
				Select Cast(1 as bit)
				Return
			END

			IF XACT_STATE() = 0 AND @@TRANCOUNT < 1 BEGIN TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName

			/*** SPLIT OR GROUP ***/
			If (@worksOrderTypeFK = 1 /*SPLIT*/ OR @worksOrderTypeFK = 2 /*GROUP*/)
			BEGIN
				print 'split found'
				
				DECLARE instructionCursor CURSOR LOCAL FOR 
					SELECT
						PalletContentFK, EntirePalletContent, InstructionTypeFK, SourceBarcode, DestinationBarcode, DestinationCustomerBArcode, Eaches,Units
					FROM 
						tblWorksOrderPalletInstructions  
					Where 
						WorksOrderPalletFK = @worksOrderPalletPK2
					Order by 
						WorksOrderPalletInstructionPK asc
						print 'cursor populated'
				OPEN instructionCursor

				print 'started cursor'

				Declare @palletContentFK int, @entirePalletContent bit, @instructionTypeFK int, @sourceBarcode nvarchar(200), @destinationBarcode nvarchar(200), 
				@destinationCustomerBarcode nvarchar(200),@eaches decimal(18,3), @units decimal(18,3), @eachTypeFK int

				FETCH NEXT FROM instructionCursor 
				INTO @palletContentFK, @entirePalletContent, @instructionTypeFK, @sourceBarcode, @destinationBarcode, @destinationCustomerBarcode, @eaches, @units

				WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
				BEGIN
					--reset stock item each time
					set @stockItemFK = -1;
					Select
						@stockItemFK = palletContent.StockItemFK,
						@batch = palletContent.Batch,
						@supplierBatch = palletContent.SupplierBatch,
						@eachUnits = palletContent.EachUnits,
						@actualEaches = palletContent.ActualEaches,
						@actualUnits = palletContent.ActualUnits,
						@expiraryDate = palletContent.ExpiryDate,
						@dateOfManufacture = palletContent.DateOfManufacture,
						@bestBefore = palletContent.BestBefore,
						@dateOfReceipt = palletContent.DateOfReceipt,
						@palletContentBarcode = palletContent.Barcode,
						@palletContentCustomerBarcode = palletContent.CustomerBarcode,
						@specialStockTypeFK = palletContent.SpecialStockTypeFK,
						--@splitToPalletTypeFK = splitRules.SplitToPalletTypeFK,
						@stockInLineFK = sils.StockInLinePK,
						@containerOutLineFK = cols.ContainerOutLinePK,						
						@containerOutFK = cols.ContainerOutFK,
						@totalPallets = isnull(stockLevels.Pallets,0), 
						@totalBatchPallets = isnull(batchStockLevels.ActualPallets,0), 
						@buildingUnitTotalPallets = isnull(buildingUnitStockLevels.Pallets,0), 
						@buildingUnitTotalBatchPallets = isnull(buildingUnitBatchStockLevels.Pallets,0), 
						@totalEaches = isnull(stockLevels.Eaches, 0), 
						@totalBatchEaches = isnull(batchStockLevels.ActualEaches, 0),
						@buildingUnitTotalEaches = isnull(buildingUnitStockLevels.Eaches, 0),
						@buildingUnitTotalBatchEaches = isnull(buildingUnitBatchStockLevels.Eaches, 0),
						@totalUnits = isnull(stockLevels.Units,0), 
						@totalBatchUnits = isnull(batchStockLevels.ActualUnits, 0),
						@buildingUnitTotalUnits = isnull(buildingUnitStockLevels.Units, 0),
						@buildingUnitTotalBatchUnits = isnull(buildingUnitBatchStockLevels.Units, 0),
						@eachTypeFK = sis.EachesTypeFK 			
					from 
						(Select * from tblPalletContent where PalletContentPK = @palletContentFK) palletContent
					left outer JOIN tblStockItems as sis ON
						sis.StockItemPK = palletContent.StockItemFK 
					--left outer join tblStockItemSplitRules as splitRules on
						--splitRules.StockItemFK = palletContent.StockItemFK
					left outer join tblStockItemGroupRules as groupRules on
						groupRules.StockItemFK = palletContent.StockItemFK
					left outer join tblStockInLines as sils on
						sils.StockInFK = @FK
						AND sils.StockItemFK = palletContent.StockItemFK
						AND sils.Batch = palletContent.Batch
						AND @worksOrderOriginFK = 1 /*StockIn*/
					left outer join tblStockOrders as sos on
						sos.StockOrderPK = @FK
						AND @worksOrderOriginFK = 2 /*StockOut*/
					left outer join tblContainerOutLines as cols on
						cols.ContainerOutFK = sos.ContainerOutFK
						AND cols.StockItemFK = palletContent.StockItemFK
						AND cols.Batch = palletContent.Batch
					left outer join tblStockLevels as batchStockLevels on
						batchStockLevels.StockItemFK = palletContent.StockItemFK
						AND batchStockLevels.Batch = palletContent.Batch
					left outer join (
						Select StockItemFK, sum(ActualPallets) Pallets, sum(ActualEaches) Eaches, sum(ActualUnits) Units
						from tblStockLevels group by StockItemFK) as stockLevels on
						stockLevels.StockItemFK = palletContent.StockItemFK
					left outer join
					(
						Select pc.StockItemFK, pallets.BuildingUnitFK, 
						count(Distinct PalletFK) Pallets, sum(ActualEaches) Eaches, sum(ActualUnits) Units
						From tblPallets as pallets
						inner join tblPalletContent as pc on
						pc.PalletFK = pallets.PalletPK
						AND (ActualEaches > 0 or ActualUnits > 0)
						group by StockItemFK, BuildingUnitFK
					) as buildingUnitStockLevels on
					buildingUnitStockLevels.StockItemFK = palletContent.StockItemFK
					AND buildingUnitStockLevels.BuildingUnitFK = @buildingUnitFK
					left outer join
					(
						Select pc.StockItemFK, pallets.BuildingUnitFK, pc.Batch, 
						count(Distinct PalletFK) Pallets, sum(ActualEaches) Eaches, sum(ActualUnits) Units
						From tblPallets as pallets
						inner join tblPalletContent as pc on
						pc.PalletFK = pallets.PalletPK
						AND (ActualEaches > 0 or ActualUnits > 0)
						group by StockItemFK, BuildingUnitFK, Batch
					) as buildingUnitBatchStockLevels on
					buildingUnitBatchStockLevels.StockItemFK = palletContent.StockItemFK
					AND buildingUnitBatchStockLevels.BuildingUnitFK = @buildingUnitFK
					AND buildingUnitBatchStockLevels.Batch = palletContent.Batch

					PRINT 'fetching all info : stock item'
					PRINT @stockItemFK
					PRINT @batch

					if @instructionTypeFK = 1 /*Create Pallet*/
					BEGIN
						print 'newpallet: check if new pallet exists'

						if not exists(Select * from tblPallets Where Barcode = @destinationBarcode)
						BEGIN
							DECLARE @palletStatusFK int

							Set @palletStatusFK = 1
							Select @palletStatusFK = PalletStatusFK from tblStockInDamages where PalletContentFK = @palletContentFK

							Print 'newpallet: About to insert tblPallets'

							insert into tblPallets values
							(@buildingUnitFK, @locationTypeFK, @locationFK, @palletStatusFK,@splitToPalletTypeFK, 
							0/*cast(0 as bit)*/ /*OnRoute*/, 0/*cast(0 as bit)*//*Loaded*/, 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/, 
							0,0,0,0,0/*depth position*/,
							'', @destinationBarcode, @destinationCustomerBarcode,
							0/*cast(0 as bit)*/, 1, dbo.getBSTDate(), 1, dbo.getBSTDate(), 3/*stock in complete*/) 

							Print 'newpallet: Finished insert tblPallets'

							Select @newPalletPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
					
							if @worksOrderOriginFK = 1 /* Stock In */
							BEGIN
								/*PALLET AUDIT*/
								print 'newpallet: adding pallet audit record for new pallet'

								insert into tblPalletAudit values
								(@newPalletPK, @buildingUnitFK, 1/*PalletCreated*/, @worksOrderPK, dbo.getBSTDate(), @stockItemFK, 
								@batch, @totalPallets, @totalBatchPallets, @totalEaches, @totalBatchEaches,
								@totalUnits, @totalBatchUnits, @buildingUnitTotalPallets, @buildingUnitTotalBatchPallets,
								@buildingUnitTotalEaches, @buildingUnitTotalBatchEaches, @buildingUnitTotalUnits, @buildingUnitTotalBatchUnits,
								0/*cast(0 as bit)*/, 1,dbo.getBSTDate(), 1, dbo.getBSTDate()) 
								/*END OF PALLET AUDIT*/

								/***** Add the pallets to the StockInLinePallets - so the StockInLine may differ to the StockInLinePallets, in which case it would
								be an indication of works orders that have been completed that have changed the number of pallets (splitting/grouping) *****/
					
								print 'newpallet: adding new pallet to stock in'
								insert Into tblStockInLinePallets values
								(@stockInLineFK, @newPalletPK,
								0/*cast(0 as bit)*/, 1, dbo.getBSTDate(), 1, dbo.getBSTDate()) 

								--check stock in status and set against pallet if not complete
								declare @stockinstatus int = (select distinct stockinstatusfk from tblstockins inner join tblstockinlines on stockinfk = stockinpk where StockInLinePK = @stockInLineFK)
								if(@stockinstatus <> 3)
								begin
									update tblpallets set StockInStatusFK = -1 where palletpk = @newPalletPK
								end
							END
							else if @worksOrderOriginFK = 2 /* Stock out */
							begin
								if not exists(Select * from tblPalletaudit Where palletfk = @newPalletPK and eventtypefk = 28 /*PalletCreatedForSplitting*/)
								begin
									print 'newpallet: adding pallet audit record for new pallet created for splitting'
									insert into tblPalletAudit values
										(@newPalletPK, @buildingUnitFK, 28/*PalletCreatedForSplitting*/, @worksOrderPK, dbo.getBSTDate(), @stockItemFK, 
										@batch, @totalPallets, @totalBatchPallets, @totalEaches, @totalBatchEaches,
										@totalUnits, @totalBatchUnits, @buildingUnitTotalPallets, @buildingUnitTotalBatchPallets,
										@buildingUnitTotalEaches, @buildingUnitTotalBatchEaches, @buildingUnitTotalUnits, @buildingUnitTotalBatchUnits,
										0/*cast(0 as bit)*/, @currentUserFK2, dbo.getBSTDate(), @currentUserFK2, dbo.getBSTDate()) 
								end
							end
						END
					END
					ELSE IF @instructionTypeFK = 2 /*Retire Pallet*/
					BEGIN
						Delete tblPallets Where Barcode = @destinationBarcode

						--We have removed a pallet, Call Proc to see if it has cleared the StockIn=set StockIn To Complete
						if (Select count(*) 
							from tblStockIns AS sins
							inner join tblStockInLines AS sils on sils.StockInFK = sins.StockInPK
							inner join tblStockInLinePallets AS silps on silps.StockInLineFK = sils.StockInLinePK
							inner join tblPallets AS pallets on pallets.PalletPK = silps.PalletFK
							Where sins.StockInPK = @FK
						) = 0
						BEGIN
							update tblStockIns WITH (ROWLOCK) 
							Set StockInStatusFK = 3 /*Complete*/
							Where StockInPK = @FK

							Declare @containerInPK int
							SELECT @containerInPK = ContainerInFK from tblStockIns Where StockInPK = @FK

							if(Select count(*) from tblStockIns AS sins Where ContainerInFK = @containerInPK AND sins.StockInStatusFK not in (3,4)/*Complete OR Cancelled*/) = 0
								update tblContainerIns WITH (ROWLOCK) Set StockInStatusFK = 3 /*Complete*/ Where ContainerInPK = @containerInPK
						END

						/***** Remove pallets from the StockInLinePallets - so the StockInLine may differ to the StockInLinePallets, in which case it would
						 be an indication of works orders that have been completed that have changed the number of pallets (splitting/grouping) *****/

						if @worksOrderOriginFK = 1 /* Stock In */	
							Delete tblStockInLinePallets Where PalletFK = @palletFK
					END
					ELSE IF @instructionTypeFK = 3 /*MoveStock*/
					BEGIN
						print 'moveStock: check if new pallet exists' 

						if not exists(Select * from tblPallets Where Barcode = @destinationBarcode)
						BEGIN
							print 'moveStock: no new pallet - adding now'

							Set @palletStatusFK = 1
							Select @palletStatusFK = PalletStatusFK from tblStockInDamages where PalletContentFK = @palletContentFK

							insert into tblPallets values
							(@buildingUnitFK, @locationTypeFK, @locationFK, @palletStatusFK, @splitToPalletTypeFK,
							0/*cast(0 as bit)*/ /*OnRoute*/, 0/*cast(0 as bit)*//*Loaded*/,  0/*cast(0 as bit)*/, 
							0,0,0,0,0/*depth position*/,
							'', @destinationBarcode, @destinationCustomerBarcode,
							0/*cast(0 as bit)*/, 1, dbo.getBSTDate(), 1, dbo.getBSTDate(), 3/*stock in complete*/)
							 
							print 'moveStock: new pallet added'
							Select @newPalletPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
					
							if @worksOrderOriginFK = 1 /* Stock In */
							BEGIN
								/*PALLET AUDIT*/
								print 'moveStock: adding pallet audit record for new pallet'

								insert into tblPalletAudit values
								(@newPalletPK, @buildingUnitFK, 1/*PalletCreated*/, @worksOrderPK, dbo.getBSTDate(), @stockItemFK, 
								@batch, @totalPallets, @totalBatchPallets, @totalEaches, @totalBatchEaches,
								@totalUnits, @totalBatchUnits, @buildingUnitTotalPallets, @buildingUnitTotalBatchPallets,
								@buildingUnitTotalEaches, @buildingUnitTotalBatchEaches, @buildingUnitTotalUnits, @buildingUnitTotalBatchUnits,
								0/*cast(0 as bit)*/, 1, dbo.getBSTDate(), 1, dbo.getBSTDate()) 
								/*END OF PALLET AUDIT*/

								/***** Add the pallets to the StockInLinePallets - so the StockInLine may differ to the StockInLinePallets, in which case it would
								be an indication of works orders that have been completed that have changed the number of pallets (splitting/grouping) *****/
					
								print 'moveStock: adding new pallet to stock in'

								insert Into tblStockInLinePallets values
								(@stockInLineFK, @newPalletPK,
								0/*cast(0 as bit)*/, 1, dbo.getBSTDate(), 1, dbo.getBSTDate()) 

								--check stock in status and set against pallet if not complete
								declare @stockinstatusfk int = (select distinct stockinstatusfk from tblstockins inner join tblstockinlines on stockinfk = stockinpk where StockInLinePK = @stockInLineFK)
								if(@stockinstatusfk <> 3)
								begin
									update tblpallets set StockInStatusFK = -1 where palletpk = @newPalletPK
								end
							END
							if @worksOrderOriginFK = 2 /* Stock Order (palet split for air freight) */
							BEGIN
								/*PALLET AUDIT*/
								print 'moveStock: adding pallet audit record for pallet added for repacking (air freight)'

								insert into tblPalletAudit values
								(@newPalletPK, @buildingUnitFK, 28/*PalletAddedForRepack*/, @worksOrderPK, dbo.getBSTDate(), @stockItemFK, 
								@batch, @totalPallets, @totalBatchPallets, @totalEaches, @totalBatchEaches,
								@totalUnits, @totalBatchUnits, @buildingUnitTotalPallets, @buildingUnitTotalBatchPallets,
								@buildingUnitTotalEaches, @buildingUnitTotalBatchEaches, @buildingUnitTotalUnits, @buildingUnitTotalBatchUnits,
								0/*cast(0 as bit)*/, 1, dbo.getBSTDate(), 1, dbo.getBSTDate()) 
								/*END OF PALLET AUDIT*/

								/***** Add the pallets to the StockInLinePallets - so the StockInLine may differ to the StockInLinePallets, in which case it would
								be an indication of works orders that have been completed that have changed the number of pallets (splitting/grouping) *****/
					
								--print 'moveStock: adding new pallet to stock in'

								--insert Into tblStockInLinePallets values
								--(@stockInLineFK, @newPalletPK,
								--0/*cast(0 as bit)*/, 1, dbo.getBSTDate(), 1, dbo.getBSTDate()) 
							END
						END

						print 'moveStock: select new pallet'

						Select @newPalletPK = PalletPK from tblPallets Where Barcode = @destinationBarcode

						Declare @newWorksOrderMovementPK int

						if(@entirePalletContent = 1 /*cast(1 as bit)*/)
						BEGIN --EACHES OR ALL OF THE UNITS ARE BEING MOVED
							print  'moving all eaches / units'

							If (Select count(*) from tblPalletContent where PalletFK = (Select PalletFK from tblPalletContent where PalletContentPK = @palletContentFK) AND StockItemFK = @stockItemFK AND Batch = @batch) = 1
							BEGIN --We are about to move all of this StockItem/Batch from this pallet.. We should store the StockInLine for deletion later
								print 'moving all of pallet'
								Delete tblStockInLinePallets Where StockInLineFK = @stockInLineFK AND PalletFK = (Select PalletFK from tblPalletContent where PalletContentPK = @palletContentFK)
							END

							print 'updating pallet content with new pallet fk'

							update tblPalletContent WITH (ROWLOCK) Set 
							PalletFK = @newPalletPK
							Where PalletContentPK = @palletContentFK

							if exists(Select * from tblPalletContentUnitCosts Where PalletContentFK = @palletContentFK)
							BEGIN
								update tblPalletContentUnitCosts WITH (ROWLOCK) Set
								PalletFK = @newPalletPK
								where PalletContentFK = @palletContentFK
							END

							if exists(Select * from tblPalletContentCommodityCodes Where PalletContentFK = @palletContentFK)
							BEGIN
								update tblPalletContentCommodityCodes WITH (ROWLOCK) Set
								PalletFK = @newPalletPK
								where PalletContentFK = @palletContentFK
							END

							if exists(Select * from tblPalletContentVersions Where PalletContentFK = @palletContentFK)
							BEGIN
								update tblPalletContentVersions WITH (ROWLOCK) Set
								PalletFK = @newPalletPK
								where PalletContentFK = @palletContentFK
							END
					
							--Add to the container out pallet content if stock out
							if @worksOrderOriginFK = 2 /* Stock Out */
							BEGIN						
								UPDATE tblContainerOutLinePalletContent WITH (ROWLOCK)
								SET PalletFK = @newPalletPK, updatedby = @currentUserFK2
								Where PalletContentFK = @palletContentFK
								AND ContainerOutLineFK = @containerOutLineFK
						
								--This is an order, we need movements to loading bays for all pallets (including newly created pallets from repack
								--Check if we already have a movement for the pallet we have moved stock to..
								--if a movement exists for the order/pallet we have taken from, we can just duplicate it, set it for the new pallet to loading bay/loading bay, as complete
								--this will then show up in the stock out process screen and we can set to "loaded"
						
								if(NOT EXISTS(Select * from tblWorksOrderMovements woms inner join tblWorksOrders AS wos on wos.WorksOrderPK = woms.WorksOrderFK where woms.PalletFK = @newPalletPK AND wos.WorksOrderOriginFK = 2 /* Stock Out */ AND wos.FK = @FK AND woms.DestinationLocationTypeFK = 2/*LoadingBay*/)) 
								BEGIN
									if(EXISTS(Select * from tblWorksOrderMovements woms inner join tblWorksOrders AS wos on wos.WorksOrderPK = woms.WorksOrderFK where woms.PalletFK = @palletFK AND wos.WorksOrderOriginFK = 2 /* Stock Out */ AND wos.FK = @FK AND woms.DestinationLocationTypeFK = 2/*LoadingBay*/))
									BEGIN
										--We have an existing pallet movement for a pallet we have taken from
										--and there is no movement for our new pallet, create the completed movement
										insert into tblWorksOrderMovements
										Select top 1 woms.WorksOrderFK,woms.WorksOrderStatusFK,PalletFK, PalletContentFK, ContainerOutLinePalletContentFK,
										EntirePallet,Eaches,Units,SourceLocationTypeFK,SourceLocationFK,SourceBayPosition,
										SourceStackPosition,DestinationLocationTypeFK,DestinationFK,DestinationBayPosition,
										DestinationStackPosition,DestinationPalletStart,DestinationPalletEnd,MovementDescription,
										woms.IsArchived,woms.InsertedBy,woms.InsertedDate,woms.UpdatedBy,woms.UpdatedDate, woms.ResponsibleUserFK, woms.HandheldDeviceFK, woms.WarehouseMachineFK
										from tblWorksOrderMovements AS woms 
										inner join tblWorksOrders AS wos on 
										wos.WorksOrderPK = woms.WorksOrderFK 
										where woms.PalletFK = @palletFK 
										AND wos.WorksOrderOriginFK = 2 /* Stock Out */ 
										AND woms.DestinationLocationTypeFK = 2/*loading bay*/
										AND wos.FK = @FK

										Select @newWorksOrderMovementPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

										update tblWorksOrderMovements WITH (ROWLOCK) 
										Set PalletFK = @newPalletPK,
										SourceLocationTypeFK = DestinationLocationTypeFK,
										SourceLocationFK = DestinationFK,
										DestinationBayPosition = -1,
										WorksOrderStatusFK = 3 /*Complete*/,
										Units = @actualUnits
										Where WorksOrderMovementPK = @newWorksOrderMovementPK

										DECLARE @loadingFK int
										SELECT  @loadingFK = worksorderpk FROM tblworksorders WHERE FK = @FK AND worksordertypefk = 16 AND WorksOrderOriginFK = 2

										--add second movement for loading
										insert into tblWorksOrderMovements
										Select  @loadingFK,1,PalletFK, PalletContentFK, ContainerOutLinePalletContentFK,
											EntirePallet,Eaches,Units,DestinationLocationTypeFK,DestinationFK,DestinationBayPosition,
											DestinationStackPosition,5,@containerOutFK,-1,
											DestinationStackPosition,-1,-1,'Load stock on container',
											woms.IsArchived,woms.InsertedBy,woms.InsertedDate,woms.UpdatedBy,woms.UpdatedDate, woms.ResponsibleUserFK, woms.HandheldDeviceFK, woms.WarehouseMachineFK
										from tblWorksOrderMovements AS woms 
										WHERE WorksOrderMovementPK = @newWorksOrderMovementPK
									END
								END
							END
						END 
						ELSE 
						BEGIN
							print 'moving partial eaches / units'

							IF(@eachTypeFK > 0) 
							BEGIN
								insert into tblPalletContent values
								(@newPalletPK, -1/*LooseLocationType*/, -1/*LooseLocationFK*/, @stockItemFK, @specialStockTypeFK, @batch, @supplierBatch, -1, @eaches,@units,@eaches,@units,
								@expiraryDate, @dateOfManufacture, @bestBefore, @dateOfReceipt, @palletContentBarcode, @palletContentCustomerBarcode,
								0/*cast(0 as bit)*/, 1, dbo.getBSTDate(), 1, dbo.getBSTDate())
		
								Select @newPalletContentPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
							END 
							ELSE 
							BEGIN
								IF(NOT EXISTS(SELECT * from tblPalletContent where PalletFK = @newPalletPK)) 
								BEGIN
									insert into tblPalletContent values
									(@newPalletPK, -1/*LooseLocationType*/, -1/*LooseLocationFK*/, @stockItemFK, @specialStockTypeFK, @batch, @supplierBatch, -1, @eaches,@units,@eaches,@units,
									@expiraryDate, @dateOfManufacture, @bestBefore, @dateOfReceipt, @palletContentBarcode, @palletContentCustomerBarcode,
									0/*cast(0 as bit)*/, 1, dbo.getBSTDate(), 1, dbo.getBSTDate())
			
									Select @newPalletContentPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
								END 
								ELSE 
								BEGIN
									--There is content already on our pallet so just update it
									update tblPalletContent WITH (ROWLOCK)
									SET ActualUnits = ActualUnits + @units,
									AvailableUnits = AvailableUnits + @units
									Where PalletFK = @newPalletPK
							
									Select @newPalletContentPK =PalletContentPK from tblPalletContent Where PalletFK = @newPalletPK
								END
							END

							--Add to the container out pallet content if stock out
							if @worksOrderOriginFK = 2 /* Stock Out */
							BEGIN
								Declare @containerOutLinePalletContentPK int

								IF(EXISTS(SELECT * FROM tblContainerOutLinePalletContent Where PalletContentFK = @newPalletContentPK AND ContainerOutLineFK = @containerOutLineFK)) 
								BEGIN
									UPDATE tblContainerOutLinePalletContent WITH (ROWLOCK)
									SET Units = Units + @units, updatedby = @currentUserFK2
									Where PalletContentFK = @newPalletContentPK
									AND ContainerOutLineFK = @containerOutLineFK
								END 
								ELSE 
								BEGIN
									insert into tblContainerOutLinePalletContent values
									(
										@containerOutLineFK, @newPalletPK, 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/ /*Loaded*/, ''/*CustomerPalletNumber*/, @destinationCustomerBarcode,
										@newPalletContentPK, -1, 0, @units, 1 /*This newly created pallet is going out*/,
										0/*cast(0 as bit)*/, @currentUserFK2, dbo.getBSTDate(), @currentUserFK2, dbo.getBSTDate()
									)
									Set @containerOutLinePalletContentPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
								END

								--Update the container out line pallet content from where we have taken stock
								update tblContainerOutLinePalletContent WITH (ROWLOCK) 
								Set Units = Units - @units, updatedby = @currentUserFK2
								Where ContainerOutLineFK = @containerOutLineFK
								AND PalletContentFK = @palletContentFK 

								--Update the availability of the newly created/moved pallet content
								Update tblPalletContent WITH (ROWLOCK)
								SET AvailableUnits = AvailableUnits - @units 
								Where PalletContentPK = @newPalletContentPK 

								--Update the Pallet Content that we moved from
								update tblPalletContent WITH (ROWLOCK) Set 
								ActualUnits = ActualUnits - @units
								Where PalletContentPK = @palletContentFK

								--add topup records for pallet moved from and too

								print 'newpallet: adding pallet audit record for new pallet created for splitting'
								insert into tblPalletAudit values
									(@newPalletPK, @buildingUnitFK, 14/*pallettoppedup*/, @worksOrderPK, dbo.getBSTDate(), @stockItemFK, 
									@batch, @totalPallets, @totalBatchPallets, @totalEaches, @totalBatchEaches,
									@totalUnits, @totalBatchUnits, @buildingUnitTotalPallets, @buildingUnitTotalBatchPallets,
									@buildingUnitTotalEaches, @buildingUnitTotalBatchEaches, @buildingUnitTotalUnits, @buildingUnitTotalBatchUnits,
									0/*cast(0 as bit)*/, @currentUserFK2, dbo.getBSTDate(), @currentUserFK2, dbo.getBSTDate()) 

								print 'newpallet: adding pallet audit record for new pallet created for splitting'
								insert into tblPalletAudit values
									(@palletFK, @buildingUnitFK, 24/*pallettoppedof*/, @worksOrderPK, dbo.getBSTDate(), @stockItemFK, 
									@batch, @totalPallets, @totalBatchPallets, @totalEaches, @totalBatchEaches,
									@totalUnits, @totalBatchUnits, @buildingUnitTotalPallets, @buildingUnitTotalBatchPallets,
									@buildingUnitTotalEaches, @buildingUnitTotalBatchEaches, @buildingUnitTotalUnits, @buildingUnitTotalBatchUnits,
									0/*cast(0 as bit)*/, @currentUserFK2, dbo.getBSTDate(), @currentUserFK2, dbo.getBSTDate()) 

								print 'adding topup record'
								print 'from pallet ' + CAST(@palletFK AS varchar(50))
								print 'to pallet ' + CAST(@newPalletPK AS varchar(50))
								insert into tblPalletTopups
								select worksorderfk, -1 /*no fixed location*/, @palletFK/*from pallet*/, @newPalletPK/*to pallet*/, 'Topup Pallet PK ' + CAST(@newPalletPK AS varchar(50)) + ', stock '+ CAST(@stockItemFK AS varchar(50))  +', Batch ' + CAST(@batch AS varchar(50))  +', from Pallet PK ' + CAST(@palletFK AS varchar(50)) /*description*/, @units/*units*/, 0/*entirepallet*/, 0/*archived*/, @currentUserFK2, dbo.getBSTDate(), @currentUserFK2, dbo.getBSTDate()
								from tblworksorderpallets
								where worksorderpalletpk = @worksOrderPalletPK2

								--This is an order, we need movements to loading bays for all pallets (including newly created pallets from repack
								--Check if we already have a movement for the pallet we have moved stock to..
								--if a movement exists for the order/pallet we have taken from, we can just duplicate it, set it for the new pallet to loading bay/loading bay, as complete
								--this will then show up in the stock out process screen and we can set to "loaded"
						
								if(NOT EXISTS(Select * from tblWorksOrderMovements woms inner join tblWorksOrders AS wos on wos.WorksOrderPK = woms.WorksOrderFK where woms.PalletFK = @newPalletPK AND wos.WorksOrderOriginFK = 2 /* Stock Out */ AND wos.FK = @FK AND woms.DestinationLocationTypeFK = 2/*LoadingBay*/)) BEGIN
									if(EXISTS(Select * from tblWorksOrderMovements woms inner join tblWorksOrders AS wos on wos.WorksOrderPK = woms.WorksOrderFK where woms.PalletFK = @palletFK AND wos.WorksOrderOriginFK = 2 /* Stock Out */ AND wos.FK = @FK AND woms.DestinationLocationTypeFK = 2/*LoadingBay*/))BEGIN
										--We have an existing pallet movement for a pallet we have taken from
										--and there is no movement for our new pallet, create the completed movement
										insert into tblWorksOrderMovements
										Select top 1 woms.WorksOrderFK,woms.WorksOrderStatusFK,PalletFK, PalletContentFK, ISNULL(ContainerOutLinePalletContentFK, -1),
										EntirePallet,Eaches,Units,SourceLocationTypeFK,SourceLocationFK,SourceBayPosition,
										SourceStackPosition,DestinationLocationTypeFK,DestinationFK,DestinationBayPosition,
										DestinationStackPosition,DestinationPalletStart,DestinationPalletEnd,MovementDescription,
										woms.IsArchived,woms.InsertedBy,woms.InsertedDate,woms.UpdatedBy,woms.UpdatedDate,woms.ResponsibleUserFK, woms.HandheldDeviceFK, woms.WarehouseMachineFK
										from tblWorksOrderMovements AS woms 
										inner join tblWorksOrders AS wos on 
										wos.WorksOrderPK = woms.WorksOrderFK 
										where woms.PalletFK = @palletFK 
										AND wos.WorksOrderOriginFK = 2 /* Stock Out */ 
										AND woms.DestinationLocationTypeFK = 2/*loading bay*/
										AND wos.FK = @FK

										Select @newWorksOrderMovementPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

										update tblWorksOrderMovements WITH (ROWLOCK) 
										Set PalletFK = @newPalletPK,
										PalletContentFK = @newPalletContentPK,
										ContainerOutLinePalletContentFK = ISNULL(@containerOutLinePalletContentPK, -1),
										SourceLocationTypeFK = DestinationLocationTypeFK,
										SourceLocationFK = DestinationFK,
										DestinationBayPosition = -1,
										WorksOrderStatusFK = 3 /*Complete*/,
										Units = @actualUnits
										Where WorksOrderMovementPK = @newWorksOrderMovementPK

										DECLARE @loadingFK1 int
										SELECT  @loadingFK1 = worksorderpk FROM tblworksorders WHERE FK = @FK AND worksordertypefk = 16 AND WorksOrderOriginFK = 2

										--add second movement for loading
										insert into tblWorksOrderMovements
										Select  @loadingFK1,1,PalletFK, PalletContentFK, ContainerOutLinePalletContentFK,
											EntirePallet,Eaches,Units,DestinationLocationTypeFK,DestinationFK,DestinationBayPosition,
											DestinationStackPosition,5,@containerOutFK,-1,
											DestinationStackPosition,-1,-1,'Load stock on container',
											woms.IsArchived,woms.InsertedBy,woms.InsertedDate,woms.UpdatedBy,woms.UpdatedDate, woms.ResponsibleUserFK, woms.HandheldDeviceFK, woms.WarehouseMachineFK
										from tblWorksOrderMovements AS woms 
										WHERE WorksOrderMovementPK = @newWorksOrderMovementPK
									END
								END
							END 
							ELSE 
							BEGIN
								--Update the Pallet Content that we moved from, also adjusting the availabel units as this is not an order repack
								update tblPalletContent WITH (ROWLOCK) Set 
								ActualUnits = ActualUnits - @units,
								AvailableUnits = AvailableUnits - @units
								Where PalletContentPK = @palletContentFK
							END

							insert into tblPalletAdditionalFieldValues
							(PalletAdditionalFieldFK, PalletContentFK, PalletAdditionalFieldValue,
							IsArchived, InsertedBy, InsertedDate, UpdatedBy, UpdatedDate)
							Select PalletAdditionalFieldFK, @newPalletContentPK, PalletAdditionalFieldValue,
							0/*cast(0 as bit)*/, 1, dbo.getBSTDate(), 1, dbo.getBSTDate()
							From tblPalletAdditionalFieldValues AS pafvs 
							inner join tblPalletContent AS palletContent on
							palletContent.PalletContentPK = pafvs.PalletContentFK
							Where palletContent.PalletContentPK = @palletContentFK

							if exists(Select * from tblPalletContentUnitCosts Where PalletContentFK = @palletContentFK)
							BEGIN
								insert into tblPalletContentUnitCosts 
								select @newPalletContentPK, @newPalletPK, UnitCostFK,
								0/*cast(0 as bit)*/, 1, dbo.getBSTDate(), 1, dbo.getBSTDate()
								from tblPalletContentUnitCosts where PalletContentFK = @palletContentFK
							END

							if exists(Select * from tblPalletContentCommodityCodes Where PalletContentFK = @palletContentFK)
							BEGIN
								insert into tblPalletContentCommodityCodes 
								select @newPalletContentPK, @newPalletPK, StockItemCommodityCodeFK,
								0/*cast(0 as bit)*/, 1, dbo.getBSTDate(), 1, dbo.getBSTDate()
								from tblPalletContentCommodityCodes where PalletContentFK = @palletContentFK
							END

							if exists(Select * from tblPalletContentVersions Where PalletContentFK = @palletContentFK)
							BEGIN
								insert into tblPalletContentVersions 
								select @newPalletContentPK, @newPalletPK, StockItemVersionFK,
								0/*cast(0 as bit)*/, 1, dbo.getBSTDate(), 1, dbo.getBSTDate()
								from tblPalletContentVersions where PalletContentFK = @palletContentFK
							END											
						END 
					END

					FETCH NEXT FROM instructionCursor 
					INTO @palletContentFK, @entirePalletContent, @instructionTypeFK, @sourceBarcode, @destinationBarcode, @destinationCustomerBarcode, @eaches, @units
				END

				CLOSE instructionCursor 
				DEALLOCATE instructionCursor 

					print 'sync stock levels'

				-- Run the spStockLevelsSync stored procedure if it is not already executing.

				EXEC spStockLevelsSyncTrigger
				--IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#IsStoredProcedureExecuting') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #IsStoredProcedureExecuting

				--CREATE TABLE #IsStoredProcedureExecuting(Result INT)

				--INSERT INTO #IsStoredProcedureExecuting
				--EXEC dbo.spIsStoredProcedureExecuting 'spStockLevelsSync'
			
				--IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #IsStoredProcedureExecuting WHERE Result = 0) EXEC [dbo].[spStockLevelsSync]

				print 'set original pallet as not mixed'

				--We have split it out.. this pallet is no longer mixed
				update tblPallets WITH (ROWLOCK)
				set IsMixedPallet = cast(0 as bit)
				Where PalletPK = @palletFK				
			END 
			/******  END OF SPLIT/GROUP CODE ******/
			ELSE 
			/******* PALLETIZE ******/
			IF(@worksOrderTypeFK=9/*Palletize*/)
			BEGIN
				update tblPallets WITH (ROWLOCK)
				Set PalletTypeFK = @workParameterInt1 /*New Pallet Type*/
				Where PalletPK = @palletFK	

				--add to pallet audit to show pallet type change
				insert into tblPalletAudit (PalletFK, BuildingUnitFK, EventTypeFK, EventFK, EventDate, 
				StockItemFK, Batch,
				TotalPallets, TotalBatchPallets, TotalEaches, TotalBatchEaches, TotalUnits, TotalBatchUnits,
				BuildingUnitTotalPallets, BuildingUnitTotalBatchPallets, 
				BuildingUnitTotalEaches, BuildingUnitTotalBatchEaches,
				BuildingUnitTotalUnits, BuildingUnitTotalBatchUnits,
				IsArchived, InsertedBy, InsertedDate, UpdatedBy, UpdatedDate)
				Select @palletFK, @buildingUnitFK, 11/*Palletized*/, @worksOrderPK, dbo.getBSTDate(),
				@stockItemFK, @batch,
				isnull(stockLevels.Pallets,0), isnull(batchStockLevels.ActualPallets,0), 
				isnull(stockLevels.Eaches, 0), isnull(batchStockLevels.ActualEaches, 0),
				isnull(stockLevels.Units,0), isnull(batchStockLevels.ActualUnits, 0),
				-1,-1,-1,-1,-1,-1,--These are the building unit levels.. we will run an sp to update these
				0/*cast(0 as bit)*/, @currentUserFK2, dbo.getBSTDate(), @currentUserFK2, dbo.getBSTDate()  
				from tblStockLevels AS batchStockLevels 
				left outer join (
					Select StockItemFK, sum(ActualPallets) Pallets, sum(ActualEaches) Eaches, sum(ActualUnits) Units
					from tblStockLevels group by StockItemFK) AS stockLevels on
					stockLevels.StockItemFK = batchStockLevels.StockItemFK
				where
				batchStockLevels.StockItemFK = @stockItemFK
				AND batchStockLevels.Batch = @batch

				SET @palletAuditFK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

				EXEC spStockLevelsByStockItemBatchBuildingUnit @stockItemFK, @batch, @buildingUnitFK, @palletAuditFK
			END
			/****** END OF PALLETIZE CODE *****/

			-- Change the status of the Works Order Pallet to complete
			update tblWorksOrderPallets WITH (ROWLOCK) Set WorksOrderStatusFK = 3
			Where WorksOrderPalletPK = @worksOrderPalletPK2
			AND WorksOrderStatusFK <> 3

			--Check and set status for the Works Order
			if not exists(Select * from tblWorksOrderPallets 
				Where WorksOrderFK = @worksOrderPK
				AND WorksOrderStatusFK in (1,2,5)/*Not Completed or cancelled*/)
			BEGIN
				update tblWorksOrders WITH (ROWLOCK)
				Set WorksOrderStatusFK = 3/*Complete*/
				Where WorksOrderPK = @worksOrderPK

				----Charge now that the work is complete
				--PRINT 'exec spWorksOrderCreateCharge'
				--PRINT @worksOrderPK
				--PRINT @worksOrderOriginFK
				--PRINT @FK
				--PRINT @worksOrderTypeFK
				--PRINT 'stock item'
				--PRINT @stockItemFK
				----only apply charge if anything was actually done
				--IF(@stockItemFK > 0)
				--BEGIN
				--	Exec spWorksOrderCreateCharge @worksOrderPK, @worksOrderOriginFK, @FK, @worksOrderTypeFK, @stockItemFK
				--END
			END

			BEGIN TRY IF XACT_STATE() = 1 AND @@TRANCOUNT = 1 AND @OpeningTranCount < 1 COMMIT TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH

			Select Cast(1 as bit)
			Return
						
			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end			
			
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END
GO

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spWorksOrderPalletCreateInstructions]
(
	@worksOrderPalletPK int,
	@decParameter1 decimal(18,3) = -1,
	@decParameter2 decimal(18,3) = -1,
	@decParameter3 decimal(18,3) = -1,

	@strParameter2 nvarchar(200) = '',
	@strParameter3 nvarchar(200) = ''

/****  PARAMETERS *****
SPLIT
decParameter1 = remainder (remainder of previous split(s)
decParameter2 = iteration of pallet within works order
strParameter1 = barcode of pallet with remaining stock from previous splits
*These remainders will always be below the set splitTo/capacity amount

GROUP
decParameter1 = units/eaches of the last pallet (which could have been grouped)
strParameter1 = barcode of last pallet (this is the pallet that will move and be retired if the units are of the correct quantity)
***********************/
)

		+ ',@decParameter2 = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@decParameter2_2 AS NVARCHAR(20)),'') + ',@decParameter3 = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@decParameter3_2 AS NVARCHAR(20)),'')
			+ ',@strParameter1 = ' + ISNULL(@strParameter1_2,'') + ',@strParameter2 = ' + ISNULL(@strParameter2_2,'') + ',@strParameter3 = ' + ISNULL(@strParameter3_2,'')

					END
				END --End of while loop

				CLOSE eachCursor
				DEALLOCATE eachCursor
		
				if (@lineStock = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/)
				BEGIN
					insert into tblWorksOrderPalletInstructions values
					(@worksOrderPalletPK2, -1/*PalletContent*/, 1/*cast(1 as bit)*//*Entire Pallet*/, 6/*LineStock*/, @palletBarcode, @palletBarcode, 0,0, '^^^ Line pallet stock with barcode '

				BEGIN

							insert into tblWorksOrderPalletInstructions values

								case when @palletAmountType = 'Eaches' then @decParameter1_2 else 0 End , case when @palletAmountType = 'Units' then @decParameter1_2 else 0 End, '>>> Move ' 
									+ cast(@decParameter1_2 as nvarchar(50)) + ' ' + cast(@palletAmountTypeName as nvarchar(50)) + ' from pallet barcode ' + @strParameter1_2 
										+ ' to pallet with barcode ' + @palletBarcode, 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/, 1, dbo.GetBSTDate(), 1, dbo.GetBSTDate(),'','') 
		
							if (@lineStock = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/)
							BEGIN
								insert into tblWorksOrderPalletInstructions values
								(@worksOrderPalletPK2, -1/*PalletContent*/, 1/*cast(1 as bit)*//*Entire Pallet*/, 6/*LineStock*/, @palletBarcode, @palletBarcode, 0,0, 
									'^^^ Line pallet stock with barcode ' + @palletBarcode, 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/, 1, dbo.GetBSTDate(), 1, dbo.GetBSTDate(),'','') 
							END

							if (@wrap = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/)
							BEGIN
								insert into tblWorksOrderPalletInstructions values
								(@worksOrderPalletPK2, -1/*PalletContent*/, 1/*cast(1 as bit)*//*Entire Pallet*/, 4/*Wrap*/, @palletBarcode, @palletBarcode, 0,0, 
									'OOO Wrap pallet with barcode ' + @palletBarcode, 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/, 1, dbo.GetBSTDate(), 1, dbo.GetBSTDate(),'','') 
							END

							Delete tblWorksOrderPalletInstructions 
							Where DestinationBarcode = @strParameter1_2
							AND InstructionTypeFK in (4, 6)

							insert into tblWorksOrderPalletInstructions values
							(@worksOrderPalletPK2, -1/*PalletContent*/, 1/*cast(1 as bit)*//*Entire Pallet*/, 2/*RetirePallet*/, @palletBarcode, @strParameter1_2, 0,0, 
								'XXX Retire pallet with barcode ' + @strParameter1_2, 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/, 1, dbo.GetBSTDate(), 1, dbo.GetBSTDate(),'','') 

							Select (@decParameter1_2 + @palletAmount) as decParameter1, @palletBarcode as strParameter1
						END
						ELSE
						BEGIN
							insert into tblWorksOrderPalletInstructions values
							(@worksOrderPalletPK2, -1/*PalletContent*/, 1/*cast(1 as bit)*//*Entire Pallet*/, 3/*MoveStock*/, @palletBarcode, @strParameter1_2, 
								case when @palletAmountType = 'Eaches' then @palletAmount else 0 End , case when @palletAmountType = 'Units' then @palletAmount else 0 End, 
									'>>> Move ' + cast(@palletAmount as nvarchar(50)) + ' ' + cast(@palletAmountTypeName as nvarchar(50)) + ' from pallet barcode ' + @palletBarcode 
										+ ' to pallet with barcode ' + @strParameter1_2, 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/, 1, dbo.GetBSTDate(), 1, dbo.GetBSTDate(),'','')

							/***** Delete any Line Stock and Wrap instructions as we are reissuing these instructions after moving stock again *****/
							Delete tblWorksOrderPalletInstructions 
							Where DestinationBarcode = @strParameter1_2
							AND InstructionTypeFK in (4, 6)

							if (@lineStock = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/)
							BEGIN
								insert into tblWorksOrderPalletInstructions values
								(@worksOrderPalletPK2, -1/*PalletContent*/, 1/*cast(1 as bit)*//*Entire Pallet*/, 6/*LineStock*/, @strParameter1_2, @strParameter1_2, 0,0, 
									'^^^ Line pallet stock with barcode ' + @strParameter1_2, 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/, 1, dbo.GetBSTDate(), 1, dbo.GetBSTDate(),'','') 
							END

							if (@wrap = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/)
							BEGIN
								insert into tblWorksOrderPalletInstructions values
								(@worksOrderPalletPK2, -1/*PalletContent*/, 1/*cast(1 as bit)*//*Entire Pallet*/, 4/*Wrap*/, @strParameter1_2, @strParameter1_2, 0,0, 
									'OOO Wrap pallet with barcode ' + @strParameter1_2, 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/, 1, dbo.GetBSTDate(), 1, dbo.GetBSTDate(),'','') 
							END

							insert into tblWorksOrderPalletInstructions values
							(@worksOrderPalletPK2, -1/*PalletContent*/, 1/*cast(1 as bit)*//*Entire Pallet*/, 2/*RetirePallet*/, @strParameter1_2, @palletBarcode, 0,0, 
								'XXX Retire pallet with barcode ' + @palletBarcode, 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/, 1, dbo.GetBSTDate(), 1, dbo.GetBSTDate(),'','') 

							Select (@decParameter1_2 + @palletAmount) as decParameter1, @strParameter1_2 as strParameter1
						END								
					END
					ELSE
					BEGIN
						Select @palletAmount as decParameter1, @palletBarcode as strParameter1
					END
				END
			END
			--ROLLBACK TRAN Test

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end

			BEGIN TRY IF XACT_STATE() = 1 AND @@TRANCOUNT = 1 AND @OpeningTranCount < 1 COMMIT TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH
			
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END
GO

	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	DECLARE @divisionFK2 INT
	SET @divisionFK2 = @divisionFK

	SET @ParameterDetails = '@divisionFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@divisionFK2 AS NVARCHAR(20)),'')

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END


	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY
			

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start

				INNER JOIN tblstockitems s ON pc.stockitemfk = s.stockitempk
				WHERE s.DivisionFK = @divisionFK2 and pc.PalletFK > 0
			
				if((SELECT count(palletcontentpk) FROM #tempPalletContent) = 0)
				BEGIN--return blank
					SELECT palletcontentpk AS WorksOrderPK FROM #tempPalletContent
				END
				ELSE
				BEGIN			
					DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #tempFilteredWorksOrders
					SELECT wo.* 
					into #tempFilteredWorksOrders
					FROM tblworksorders wo
					inner join  #tempStatusChanges psc ON WorksOrderFK = WorksOrderPK
					WHERE wo.insertedby > 0 AND WorksOrderStatusFK = 3 AND WorksOrderTypeFK = 11 AND IntegrationStage1Flag = 0
											
					Select WorksOrderPK 
					from #tempFilteredWorksOrders wos
					inner join #tempStatusChanges pscs ON pscs.WorksOrderFK = wos.WorksOrderPK
					inner join #tempPalletContent pc ON pc.PalletFk = pscs.PalletFK
					Group By wos.WorksOrderPK

			Select WorksOrderPK

			inner join tblPallets pals ON pals.PalletPK = pscs.PalletFK

			--inner join tblPalletcontent pc ON pc.PalletFk = pals.PalletPK
			--inner join tblStockItems sis ON sis.StockItemPK = pc.StockItemFK
			--Where WorksOrderStatusFK = 3 /*Completed*/
			--AND WorksOrderTypeFK = 11 /*Status Change*/
			--AND IntegrationStage1Flag = 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/ --Interfcae message not sent
			--AND sis.DivisionFK = @divisionFK2
			--Group By WorksORderPK
			*/
			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end

			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spWorksOrderPhysicalChecksTidyUp]

 @StockOrderPK int  
)  
AS  
BEGIN  
    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT  
 ,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;  
 SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();  
  
 -- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters  
 DECLARE @StockOrderPK2 INT  
 SET @StockOrderPK2 = @StockOrderPK  
  
 SET @ParameterDetails = '@StockOrderPK2 = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@StockOrderPK2 AS NVARCHAR(20)),'')  
  
    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL   
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)  
  
    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)  
    --BEGIN  
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC   
  
  SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)  
  
        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)  
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK  
  
        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()  
    --END  
  
 SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);  
 SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails  
 ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;  
 INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()  
  
 WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3  
 BEGIN   
  BEGIN TRY  
  
   -- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start  
  
   IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#TempUnrequiredWorksOrders') IS NOT NULL  
    DROP TABLE #TempUnrequiredWorksOrders  
  
   IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#TempPalletOrderDetails') IS NOT NULL  
    DROP TABLE #TempPalletOrderDetails  
  
   select palletfk, containeroutlinepalletcontentpk, containeroutlinepk, containeroutpk, stockorderpk  
   into #TempPalletOrderDetails  
   from tblStockOrders so  
   inner join viewContainerOutPalletList vcop on vcop.ContainerOutPK = so.ContainerOutFK  
   --INNER JOIN tblContainerOuts as co on so.containeroutfk = co.containeroutpk  
   --INNER JOIN tblContainerOutLines AS col ON co.containeroutpk = col.Containeroutfk  
   --INNER JOIN tblcontaineroutlinepalletcontent AS colpc ON col.ContainerOutLinePK = colpc.ContainerOutLineFK  
   --INNER JOIN dbo.tblPallets tp ON tp.PalletPK = colpc.PalletFK  
   WHERE so.StockOrderPK = @StockOrderPK2 AND so.ResponsibleBuildingUnitFK = vcop.BuildingUnitFK  
     
   select distinct worksorderpk, worksorderpalletpk, wop.WorksOrderStatusFK  
   into #TempUnrequiredWorksOrders  
   from tblworksorderpallets AS wop  
   INNER JOIN tblWorksOrders AS wo ON WorksOrderFk = WorksOrderPK and worksordertypefk in (15,19,20,21,22) /*physical check*/ AND WorksOrderOriginFK = 2 /*stock order*/ and FK = @StockOrderPK2  
   LEFT JOIN #TempPalletOrderDetails AS palletsonorder ON  wop.palletfk = palletsonorder.palletfk  
   where palletsonorder.palletfk is null and wop.worksorderstatusfk <> 3  
  
   --select * from #TempUnrequiredWorksOrders  
        
   delete wop  
   from tblworksorderpallets wop  
   inner join #TempUnrequiredWorksOrders two on  wop.worksorderpalletpk  = two.worksorderpalletpk  
   where two.WorksOrderStatusFK in (1,2)--only delete wop where work was not completed

   update wop set worksorderfk = -1 
   from tblworksorderpallets wop  
   inner join #TempUnrequiredWorksOrders two on  wop.worksorderpalletpk  = two.worksorderpalletpk  
   where two.WorksOrderStatusFK in (3,5)--completed / standby can't be deleted, so remove association to stock out

  
   delete wo  
   from tblworksorders wo  
   inner join #TempUnrequiredWorksOrders two on  wo.worksorderpk  = two.worksorderpk  
   left join tblworksorderpallets wop on wop.worksorderfk = wo.worksorderpk  
   where wop.worksorderpalletpk is null  
  
   --update wo  
   --set FK = -1, wo.comments = Concat(wo.comments, ' Pallet ' + coalesce(p.customerbarcode, p.barcode, '')  + ' removed from order ' + co.goodsordernumber + ' after physical check was carried out.')  
   --FROM tblworksorderpallets AS wop  
   --INNER JOIN tblWorksOrders AS wo ON WorksOrderFk = WorksOrderPK and worksordertypefk = 15 /*physical check*/ AND WorksOrderOriginFK = 2 /*stock order*/ and FK = @StockOrderPK2  
   --INNER JOIN tblStockOrders AS so ON wo.FK = so.StockOrderPK  
   --INNER JOIN tblContainerOuts as co on co.containeroutpk = so.containeroutfk  
   --INNER JOIN tblContainerOutLines AS col ON so.containeroutfk = col.Containeroutfk  
   --LEFT JOIN tblcontaineroutlinepalletcontent AS colpc ON col.ContainerOutLinePK = colpc.ContainerOutLineFK and wop.palletfk = colpc.palletfk  
   --left join tblpallets p on wop.palletfk = palletpk  
   --where colpc.palletfk is null and wop.worksorderstatusfk = 3  
        
   -- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end     
     
   BREAK  
  END TRY  
  BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */  
   DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;  
   SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;  
   SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;  
  
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY   
   BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;  
         
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;  
  
            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID  
              
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;  
              
   IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)  
   BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END  
   ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */  
  END CATCH  
  SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1  
 END  
END

 BEGIN   
  BEGIN TRY  
  
   -- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start  
  
   IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#TempUnrequiredWorksOrders') IS NOT NULL  
    DROP TABLE #TempUnrequiredWorksOrders  
  
   IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#TempPalletOrderDetails') IS NOT NULL  
    DROP TABLE #TempPalletOrderDetails  
  
   select palletfk, containeroutlinepalletcontentpk, containeroutlinepk, containeroutpk, stockorderpk  
   into #TempPalletOrderDetails  
   from tblStockOrders so  
   inner join viewContainerOutPalletList vcop on vcop.ContainerOutPK = so.ContainerOutFK  
   --INNER JOIN tblContainerOuts as co on so.containeroutfk = co.containeroutpk  
   --INNER JOIN tblContainerOutLines AS col ON co.containeroutpk = col.Containeroutfk  
   --INNER JOIN tblcontaineroutlinepalletcontent AS colpc ON col.ContainerOutLinePK = colpc.ContainerOutLineFK  
   --INNER JOIN dbo.tblPallets tp ON tp.PalletPK = colpc.PalletFK  
   WHERE so.StockOrderPK = @StockOrderPK2 AND so.ResponsibleBuildingUnitFK = vcop.BuildingUnitFK  
     
   select distinct worksorderpk, worksorderpalletpk  
   into #TempUnrequiredWorksOrders  
   from tblworksorderpallets AS wop  
   INNER JOIN tblWorksOrders AS wo ON WorksOrderFk = WorksOrderPK --and worksordertypefk in (15,19,20,21,22) /*physical check*/
   AND WorksOrderOriginFK = 2 /*stock order*/ and FK = @StockOrderPK2  
   LEFT JOIN #TempPalletOrderDetails AS palletsonorder ON  wop.palletfk = palletsonorder.palletfk  
   where palletsonorder.palletfk is null ---and wop.worksorderstatusfk <> 3  
  
   --select * from #TempUnrequiredWorksOrders  
        
   delete wop  
   from tblworksorderpallets wop  
   inner join #TempUnrequiredWorksOrders two on  wop.worksorderpalletpk  = two.worksorderpalletpk  
  
   delete wo  
   from tblworksorders wo  
   inner join #TempUnrequiredWorksOrders two on  wo.worksorderpk  = two.worksorderpk  
   left join tblworksorderpallets wop on wop.worksorderfk = wo.worksorderpk  
   where wop.worksorderpalletpk is null  
  
   --update wo  
   --set FK = -1, wo.comments = Concat(wo.comments, ' Pallet ' + coalesce(p.customerbarcode, p.barcode, '')  + ' removed from order ' + co.goodsordernumber + ' after physical check was carried out.')  
   --FROM tblworksorderpallets AS wop  
   --INNER JOIN tblWorksOrders AS wo ON WorksOrderFk = WorksOrderPK and worksordertypefk = 15 /*physical check*/ AND WorksOrderOriginFK = 2 /*stock order*/ and FK = @StockOrderPK2  
   --INNER JOIN tblStockOrders AS so ON wo.FK = so.StockOrderPK  
   --INNER JOIN tblContainerOuts as co on co.containeroutpk = so.containeroutfk  
   --INNER JOIN tblContainerOutLines AS col ON so.containeroutfk = col.Containeroutfk  
   --LEFT JOIN tblcontaineroutlinepalletcontent AS colpc ON col.ContainerOutLinePK = colpc.ContainerOutLineFK and wop.palletfk = colpc.palletfk  
   --left join tblpallets p on wop.palletfk = palletpk  
   --where colpc.palletfk is null and wop.worksorderstatusfk = 3  
        
   -- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end     
     
   BREAK  
  END TRY  
  BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */  
   DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;  
   SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;  
   SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;  
  
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY   
   BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;  
         
   BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;  
  
            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID  
              
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;  
              
   IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)  
   BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END  
   ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */  
  END CATCH  
  SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1  
 END  
END

-- =============================================

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[spXmlInDiv616]
(
	@fK int
)
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT
 ,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;
	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	DECLARE @var_fK int
	SET @var_fK = @fK
	SET @ParameterDetails = '@fK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_fK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'')

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    --BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

		SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END


	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY
			

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start

			--ContainerIn
			Select ContainerNumber, ContainerInPK, StockInPK, DateIn from tblContainerIns cins 
			inner join tblStockIns sins on
			sins.ContainerInFK = cins.ContainerInPK
			where StockInPK = @var_fK

			--ContainerInDetail
			Select ContainerInPK, StockInPK, StockItemCode, sils.Units as Quantity, REPLACE ( sils.ExtraDetails , 'CustomerPalletNumber:' , '' ) as CustomerPalletNumber
			from tblContainerIns cins
			inner join tblStockIns sins on
			sins.ContainerInFK = cins.ContainerInPK
			inner join tblStockInLines sils on
			sils.StockInFK = sins.StockInPK 
			inner join tblStockItems sis on 
			sis.StockItemPK = sils.StockItemFK
			inner join tblStockInLinePallets silps on
			silps.StockInLineFK = sils.StockInLinePK
			where StockInPK = @var_fK

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end

			
			
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END

-- Description:	<Export Size Details of Bays in specified building unit>
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[STA_BuildingUnitBayDetails]
(
	@buildingUnitFK int
)
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data; Ensure this proc has a low impact when executed */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED; SET DEADLOCK_PRIORITY LOW

    select bu.BuildingUnit, vrl.Location, vrl.Row, vrl.BuildingUnitColumn [Column], vrl.Baylevel [Level], bub.Width, bub.Height, bub.MinimumDepth, bub.MaximumDepth, bub.barcode
	from viewRackingLocations vrl
	inner join tblbuildingUnitBays bub on vrl.buildingunitbaypk = bub.buildingunitbaypk
	inner join tblbuildingunits bu on vrl.buildingunitfk = bu.buildingunitpk
	where vrl.buildingunitfk = @buildingUnitFK
	order by vrl.Location
END

-- ================================================================
-- Author:      Cathal OCuirrin
-- Create Date: 08 November 2019
-- Description: Return all records in the database for a palletfk.
-- ================================================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[STA_CoeurPalletAuditIssueOnStockIn]
(
	@StockInFK INT
)
AS
BEGIN
	DECLARE @StockInFK2 INT = @StockInFK

	SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ UNCOMMITTED; SET DEADLOCK_PRIORITY LOW

	SELECT distinct sil.stockinlinepk, pa.eventfk, sil.stockitemfk [LineStock], pa.stockitemfk [AuditStock], pc.stockitemfk, sil.batch [LineBatch], pa.batch [AuditBatch], pc.batch, pa.PalletAuditPK, pa.palletfk
	FROM tblstockinlines sil
	INNER JOIN tblstockinlinepallets silp ON sil.stockinlinepk = silp.StockInLineFK
	left JOIN tblpalletcontent pc ON silp.palletfk = pc.palletfk
	left JOIN tblpalletaudit pa ON silp.palletfk = pa.palletfk and pa.eventtypefk = 1
	WHERE stockinfk= @StockInFK2 and(sil.stockinlinepk <> pa.eventfk OR sil.stockitemfk <> pa.stockitemfk OR sil.batch <> pa.batch)
END

			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END
GO

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[STA_CustomDeliveryPalletStatusReport]
AS
BEGIN
	SELECT DivisionCode, stockitemcode, dat.DeliveryAddressType, aps.PalletStatus, tsids.InsertedDate, tp.FirstName + ' ' + tp.LastName as [InsertedBy]
	FROM dbo.tblStockItemDeliveryStatus tsids
	INNER JOIN dbo.appPalletStatus aps ON tsids.PalletStatusFK = aps.PalletStatusPK
	INNER JOIN tblstockitems ts ON stockitemfk = stockitempk
	INNER JOIN tblusers tu ON tsids.insertedby = tu.UserPK
	INNER JOIN tblpeople tp ON tu.personfk = tp.PersonPK
	INNER JOIN tbldivisions  td ON td.divisionpk = ts.divisionfk
	inner join appDeliveryAddressTypes dat on dat.DeliveryAddressTypePK = tsids.DeliveryTypeFK
	ORDER BY stockitemcode, tsids.InsertedDate
END

-- =============================================
-- Author:      <Author, , Name>
-- Create Date: <Create Date, , >
-- Description: <Description, , >
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE[dbo].[STA_DocketInSummaryForDateRange]
(
	@startDate date,	
	@endDate date
)	
AS
BEGIN

    SET NOCOUNT ON

	--declare @startDate date = '20200101'	
	--declare @endDate date  = '21210101'
	declare @firstauditpk int = (select top 1 palletauditpk from tblpalletaudit where eventdate >= @startdate order by eventdate asc)
	declare @lastauditpk int = (select top 1 palletauditpk from tblpalletaudit where eventdate < DATEADD(dd, DATEDIFF(dd, 0, @enddate), 1) order by eventdate desc)
	
	drop table if exists #tmppalletaudittwenty
	select * 
	into #tmppalletaudittwenty
	from tblpalletaudit where PalletAuditPK >= @firstauditpk and palletauditpk <= @lastauditpk and eventtypefk = 1

	--remove any that are not for current year (previous query is only a rough starting point, and also includes up until today)	
	delete from #tmppalletaudittwenty where eventdate < @startDate
	delete from #tmppalletaudittwenty where eventdate > @endDate

	--link remaining pallet audit events to the container it came in on, check it is a completed container (status=3)
	drop table if exists #tmpstockinpalletstwenty
	select distinct ci.ContainerInPK, ci.GoodsInNumber, ci.DateIn, tpa.PalletFK, DivisionCode, DivisionName, CustomerCode, CustomerName, BuildingName + ' - ' + BuildingUnit as Building
	into #tmpstockinpalletstwenty
	from #tmppalletaudittwenty tpa
	inner join tblstockinlinepallets silp on tpa.PalletFK = silp.PalletFK
	inner join tblstockinlines sil on silp.StockInLineFK = sil.StockInLinePK and sil.StockInLinePK = tpa.EventFK
	inner join tblstockins si on si.StockInPK = sil.StockInFK
	inner join tblcontainerins ci on ci.ContainerInPK = si.ContainerInFK
	inner join tbldivisions d on d.DivisionPK = si.DivisionFK
	inner join tblCustomers c on c.customerpk = d.CustomerFK
	inner join tblBuildingUnits bu on bu.BuildingUnitPK = ci.BuildingUnitFK
	inner join tblBuildings b on bu.buildingfk = b.BuildingPK
	where ci.StockInStatusFK=3 or si.StockInStatusFK=3
		
	--detailed list of dockets
	select GoodsInNumber, tco.DateIn, count(palletfk) pals, DivisionCode, DivisionName, CustomerCode, CustomerName, Building, case when tst.StockTransferPK is null then cast(0 as bit) else cast(1 as bit) end as TransferIn
	from #tmpstockinpalletstwenty tco
	left join tblStockTransfers tst on tst.ContainerInFK = tco.ContainerInPK
	--where tst.StockTransferPK is null
	group by GoodsInNumber, tco.DateIn, DivisionCode, DivisionName, CustomerCode, CustomerName, Building, StockTransferPK
	order by Building, CustomerCode, DivisionCode, DateIn

END
GO
