-- ================================================================================================================
-- Author:		Jamie Clerkin Charlene Gordon
-- Create date: 31 03 2022
-- Description:	Returns a list of the lines of code in all of the stored procedures and functions in the database.
-- ================================================================================================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[STA_GetGlanbiaTransfers]
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data; Ensure this proc has a low impact when executed */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED; SET DEADLOCK_PRIORITY LOW
	

drop table if exists #tmptransfersout


--get glanbia transfers
select distinct stocktransferpk, st.ContainerInFK, CollectionDate
into #tmptransfersout
from tblstocktransfers st
inner join tblcontainerouts co on co.ContainerOutPK = st.ContainerOutFK
inner join tblcontaineroutlines col on col.containeroutfk = co.ContainerOutPK
where DivisionFK in (624, 625) and ContainerOutStatusFK = 5 and year(CollectionDate) >= 2021

--get transfered stock in
drop table if exists #tmptransferredpallets
select distinct si.ArrivalDate, si.GoodsInNumber, PalletFK, DivisionName
into #tmptransferredpallets
from #tmptransfersout st
inner join tblstockins si on si.ContainerInFK = st.ContainerInFK
inner join tblstockinlines sil on stockinfk = stockinpk
inner join tblstockinlinepallets silp on stockinlinefk = stockinlinepk
inner join tbldivisions d on si.DivisionFK = DivisionPK


--get all glanbia stock outs
drop table if exists #tmpallglanbiaOuts
select distinct ContainerOutPK, StockItemFK, CollectionDate, DocketValue1, SUBSTRING(DocketValue1, PATINDEX('%[^0]%', DocketValue1+'.'), LEN(DocketValue1)) transferreference, ContainerOutStatusFK
into #tmpallglanbiaOuts
from tblContainerOutLines col 
inner join tblContainerOuts co on ContainerOutPK = ContainerOutFK
where DivisionFK in (624,625) and year(CollectionDate) >= 2021 and ContainerOutStatusFK = 5 and co.InsertedBy = 0

--select * from #tmpallglanbiaOuts where transferreference like '82%'

drop table if exists #tmpornuaIns
select containerinpk, ci.DateIn, SUBSTRING(ci.ExternalReference, PATINDEX('%[^0]%', ci.ExternalReference+'.'), LEN(ci.ExternalReference)) transferreference, ci.StockInStatusFK
into #tmpornuaIns
from tblStockIns si 
inner join tblContainerIns ci on ci.ContainerInPK = si.ContainerInFK
where year(ArrivalDate) >= 2021 and DivisionFK = 129 and si.StockInStatusFK = 3

--select * from #tmpornuaIns where transferreference like '82%'

select p.Barcode, p.CustomerBarcode, GoodsInNumber, DivisionName, ArrivalDate, pa.EventDate, p.BuildingUnitFK 
from #tmpallglanbiaOuts gouts 
inner join #tmpornuaIns oins on gouts.transferreference = oins.transferreference 
inner join tblstockins si on si.ContainerInFK = oins.ContainerInPK
inner join tblstockinlines sil on stockinfk = stockinpk
inner join tblstockinlinepallets silp on stockinlinefk = stockinlinepk
inner join tblPallets p on silp.PalletFK = p.PalletPK
inner join tbldivisions d on si.DivisionFK = DivisionPK
left join tblPalletAudit pa on pa.palletfk = p.palletpk and pa.EventTypeFK = 2
where gouts.transferreference <> '' 
--order by gouts.CollectionDate, ContainerOutStatusFK

union

select p.Barcode, p.CustomerBarcode, GoodsInNumber, DivisionName, tp.ArrivalDate, pa.EventDate, p.BuildingUnitFK 
from tblpallets p
inner join #tmptransferredpallets tp on p.palletpk = tp.palletfk
left join tblPalletAudit pa on pa.palletfk = p.palletpk and pa.EventTypeFK = 2
order by ArrivalDate, pa.EventDate


	
END
GO

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[STA_GetInvoiceDetails]
(
	@InvoiceNumber NVARCHAR(200) = ''
)
AS
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data; Ensure this proc has a low impact when executed */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED; SET DEADLOCK_PRIORITY LOW

	DECLARE @var_InvoiceNumber NVARCHAR(200) = ISNULL(@InvoiceNumber,'')

	IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#InvoiceDetails') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #InvoiceDetails

	SELECT 'tblInvoices' AS [FromTable], * 
	INTO #InvoiceDetails
	FROM tblInvoices
	WHERE InvoiceNumber = @InvoiceNumber

	SELECT * FROM #InvoiceDetails

	SELECT 'tblInvoiceLines' AS [FromTable], IL.* 
	FROM tblInvoiceLines AS IL
	INNER JOIN  #InvoiceDetails AS ID
	ON IL.InvoiceFK = ID.InvoicePK
	ORDER BY InvoiceLinePK ASC

GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[STA_GetLinesOfCodeInFunctionsAndStoredProcedures]    Script Date: 02/11/2026 17:47:28 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO



-- ================================================================================================================
-- Author:		Cathal OCuirrin
-- Create date: 05 July 2018
-- Description:	Returns a list of the lines of code in all of the stored procedures and functions in the database.
-- ================================================================================================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[STA_GetLinesOfCodeInFunctionsAndStoredProcedures]
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data; Ensure this proc has a low impact when executed */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED; SET DEADLOCK_PRIORITY LOW

	IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#Results') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #Results

    SELECT 
		SO.[Name], 
		(LEN(SC.[text]) - LEN(REPLACE(SC.[text], CHAR(10), ''))) AS LinesOfCode,
		CASE 
			WHEN SO.xtype = 'P' THEN 
				'Stored Procedure'
			WHEN SO.xtype IN ('FN', 'IF', 'TF') THEN 
				'Function'
		END AS ObjectType
	INTO
		#Results
    FROM 
		sysobjects AS SO
    INNER JOIN syscomments AS SC
		ON SC.Id = SO.Id
    WHERE 
		SO.Xtype IN ('P', 'FN', 'IF', 'TF')
		AND SO.Category = 0
		AND SO.[Name] NOT IN 
			('fn_diagramobjects', 'sp_alterdiagram', 'sp_creatediagram', 'sp_dropdiagram', 'sp_helpdiagramdefinition', 'sp_helpdiagrams', 'sp_renamediagram', 'sp_upgraddiagrams', 'sysdiagrams')

	-- Return the final re

	SELECT 
		[Name], 
		SUM(LinesOfCode) - 1 AS [Lines of Code], 
		ObjectType AS [Object Type]
	FROM
		#Results
	GROUP BY 
		[Name], ObjectType
	ORDER BY 
		[Lines of Code] DESC,
		[Name] ASC
END
GO

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[STA_GetListOfTMSEmployeesWithOddNumberOfClockings]
AS
BEGIN
	IF object_id('tempdb..#t') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #t

	SELECT ttccd.TMSEmployeeClockCardDetailPK, ttccd.ClockCardDate, ttccd.ClockCardTimes, 
	LTRIM(RTRIM(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(ttccd.ClockCardTimes, 'I',''), 'O',''),'  ', ' '),'  ', ' '))) AS ClockCardTimes2
	INTO #t 
	FROM dbo.tblTMSEmployeeClockCardDetails ttccd

	IF object_id('tempdb..#t2') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #t2

	SELECT *, replace(ClockCardTimes2, ' ','') as ClockCardTimes3, replace(replace(ClockCardTimes2, ':',''),' ','') AS ClockCardTimes4
	INTO #t2 
	FROM #t
	WHERE isnumeric(replace(replace(ClockCardTimes2, ':',''),' ','')) = 1

	IF object_id('tempdb..#t') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #t

	IF object_id('tempdb..#t3') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #t3

	SELECT *, len(ClockCardTimes2) - len(ClockCardTimes3) AS NoOfSpaces 
	INTO #t3 
	FROM #t2

	IF object_id('tempdb..#t2') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #t2

	SELECT distinct Department, ClockCardDate, EmployeeNumber, ttccd.EmployeeName, ttccd.ClockCardTimes 
	FROM dbo.tblTMSEmployeeClockCardDetails ttccd WHERE ttccd.TMSEmployeeClockCardDetailPK IN (
	SELECT TMSEmployeeClockCardDetailPK FROM #t3 WHERE noofspaces % 2 = 0 AND ClockCardDate >= '20190401'
	)
	ORDER BY Department ASC, ttccd.ClockCardDate ASC, ttccd.EmployeeNumber ASC

	IF object_id('tempdb..#t3') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #t3
END
GO

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[STA_GetPalletAndStockLevelDetailsByBatch]
(
	@Batch NVARCHAR(200) = ''
)
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data; Ensure this proc has a low impact when executed */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED; SET DEADLOCK_PRIORITY LOW

	DECLARE @var_Batch NVARCHAR(200) = ISNULL(@Batch, '')

	SELECT 'tblPalletContent' AS 'FromTable', * 
	FROM dbo.tblPalletContent
	WHERE PalletFK IN (
							SELECT DISTINCT palletfk 
							FROM dbo.tblPalletAudit 
							WHERE StockItemFK IN (SELECT StockItemFK FROM dbo.tblStockLevels WHERE batch = @var_Batch) 
							AND batch = @var_Batch
						)

	SELECT 'tblStockLevels' AS 'FromTable', * 
	FROM dbo.tblStockLevels 
	WHERE batch = @var_Batch
END
GO

-- ================================================================
-- Author:      Cathal OCuirrin

-- Description: Return all records in the database for a palletfk.

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[STA_GetPalletDetails]

BEGIN

	DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #ArchivedPalletContent; 

	SELECT DISTINCT 'tblArchivedPalletContent' AS FromTable, t1.* INTO #ArchivedPalletContent FROM dbo.tblArchivedPalletContent t1 WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE t1.PalletFK = @varPalletFK;

	DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #ContainerOutLinePalletContent; 

	SELECT DISTINCT 'tblContainerOutLinePalletContent' AS FromTable, t1.* INTO #ContainerOutLinePalletContent FROM dbo.tblContainerOutLinePalletContent t1 WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE t1.PalletFK = @varPalletFK;

	SELECT DISTINCT 'tblContainerOutPalletToBeLocated' AS FromTable, t1.* INTO #ContainerOutPalletToBeLocated FROM dbo.tblContainerOutPalletToBeLocated t1 WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE t1.PalletFK = @varPalletFK;

	DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #DivisionStockOrderLinePallets;

	DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #OnRouteContainerOutPallets;

	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #ArchivedPallets) SELECT * FROM #ArchivedPallets ORDER BY 2 ASC

	DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #Pallets;

	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #Pallets) SELECT * FROM #Pallets ORDER BY 2 ASC

	DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #PalletAdditionalFieldValues; 

	SELECT DISTINCT 'tblPalletAdditionalFieldValues' AS FromTable, t1.* INTO #PalletAdditionalFieldValues FROM dbo.tblPalletAdditionalFieldValues t1 WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE t1.PalletFK = @varPalletFK; 
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #PalletAdditionalFieldValues) SELECT * FROM #PalletAdditionalFieldValues ORDER BY 2 ASC

	DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #PalletAudit; 

	SELECT DISTINCT 'tblPalletAudit' AS FromTable, paet.PalletAuditEventType, t1.* 
	INTO #PalletAudit

	inner join dbo.appPalletAuditEventTypes paet with (nolock)
	on t1.EventTypeFK = paet.PalletAuditEventTypePK
	WHERE t1.PalletFK = @varPalletFK; 

	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #PalletAudit) SELECT * FROM #PalletAudit ORDER BY 3 ASC

	DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #PalletContent; 

	SELECT DISTINCT 'tblPalletContent' AS FromTable, t1.* INTO #PalletContent FROM dbo.tblPalletContent t1 WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE t1.PalletFK = @varPalletFK; 
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #PalletContent) SELECT * FROM #PalletContent ORDER BY 2 ASC

	DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #PalletContentCommodityCodes; 

	SELECT DISTINCT 'tblPalletContentCommodityCodes' AS FromTable, t1.* INTO #PalletContentCommodityCodes FROM dbo.tblPalletContentCommodityCodes t1 WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE t1.PalletFK = @varPalletFK; 
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #PalletContentCommodityCodes) SELECT * FROM #PalletContentCommodityCodes ORDER BY 2 ASC

	DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #PalletContentSpecialStockTypes; 

	SELECT DISTINCT 'tblPalletContentSpecialStockTypes' AS FromTable, t1.* INTO #PalletContentSpecialStockTypes FROM dbo.tblPalletContentSpecialStockTypes t1 WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE t1.PalletFK = @varPalletFK; 
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #PalletContentSpecialStockTypes) SELECT * FROM #PalletContentSpecialStockTypes ORDER BY 2 ASC

	DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #PalletContentUnitCosts; 

	SELECT DISTINCT 'tblPalletContentUnitCosts' AS FromTable, t1.* INTO #PalletContentUnitCosts FROM dbo.tblPalletContentUnitCosts t1 WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE t1.PalletFK = @varPalletFK; 
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #PalletContentUnitCosts) SELECT * FROM #PalletContentUnitCosts ORDER BY 2 ASC

	DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #PalletContentVersions; 

	SELECT DISTINCT 'tblPalletContentVersions' AS FromTable, t1.* INTO #PalletContentVersions FROM dbo.tblPalletContentVersions t1 WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE t1.PalletFK = @varPalletFK; 
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #PalletContentVersions) SELECT * FROM #PalletContentVersions ORDER BY 2 ASC

	DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #PalletLocks; 

	SELECT DISTINCT 'tblPalletLocks' AS FromTable, t1.* INTO #PalletLocks FROM dbo.tblPalletLocks t1 WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE t1.PalletFK = @varPalletFK; 
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #PalletLocks) SELECT * FROM #PalletLocks ORDER BY 2 ASC

	DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #PalletsLegacy; 

	SELECT DISTINCT 'tblPalletsLegacy' AS FromTable, t1.* INTO #PalletsLegacy FROM dbo.tblPalletsLegacy t1 WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE t1.PalletFK = @varPalletFK; 
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #PalletsLegacy) SELECT * FROM #PalletsLegacy ORDER BY 2 ASC

	DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #PalletStamp; 

	SELECT DISTINCT 'tblPalletStamp' AS FromTable, t1.* INTO #PalletStamp FROM dbo.tblPalletStamp t1 WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE t1.PalletFK = @varPalletFK; 
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #PalletStamp) SELECT * FROM #PalletStamp ORDER BY 2 ASC

	DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #PalletStatusChanges;

	SELECT DISTINCT 'tblPalletStatusChanges' AS FromTable, t1.* INTO #PalletStatusChanges FROM dbo.tblPalletStatusChanges t1 WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE t1.PalletFK = @varPalletFK; 
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #PalletStatusChanges) SELECT * FROM #PalletStatusChanges ORDER BY 2 ASC

	DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #PalletTopups; 

	SELECT DISTINCT 'tblPalletTopups' AS FromTable, t1.* INTO #PalletTopups FROM dbo.tblPalletTopups t1 WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE t1.TopupFromPalletFK = @varPalletFK OR t1.TopupToPalletFK = @varPalletFK
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #PalletTopups) SELECT * FROM #PalletTopups ORDER BY 2 ASC

	DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #StockAdjustments;

	SELECT DISTINCT 'tblStockAdjustments' AS FromTable, t1.* INTO #StockAdjustments FROM dbo.tblStockAdjustments t1 WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE t1.PalletFK = @varPalletFK;

	DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #StockInDamages; 

	SELECT DISTINCT 'tblStockInDamages' AS FromTable, t1.* INTO #StockInDamages FROM dbo.tblStockInDamages t1 WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE t1.PalletFK = @varPalletFK;

/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[STA_GetSQLTransactionDetails]    Script Date: 02/11/2026 17:47:28 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[STA_GetSQLTransactionDetails]
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ UNCOMMITTED; SET DEADLOCK_PRIORITY LOW

	select 
		transaction_id, name, transaction_begin_time
		 ,case transaction_type 
			when 1 then '1 = Read/write transaction'
			when 2 then '2 = Read-only transaction'
			when 3 then '3 = System transaction'
			when 4 then '4 = Distributed transaction'
		end as transaction_type 
		,case transaction_state 
			when 0 then '0 = The transaction has not been completely initialized yet'
			when 1 then '1 = The transaction has been initialized but has not started'
			when 2 then '2 = The transaction is active'
			when 3 then '3 = The transaction has ended. This is used for read-only transactions'
			when 4 then '4 = The commit process has been initiated on the distributed transaction'
			when 5 then '5 = The transaction is in a prepared state and waiting resolution'
			when 6 then '6 = The transaction has been committed'
			when 7 then '7 = The transaction is being rolled back'
			when 8 then '8 = The transaction has been rolled back'
		end as transaction_state
		,case dtc_state 
			when 1 then '1 = ACTIVE'
			when 2 then '2 = PREPARED'
			when 3 then '3 = COMMITTED'
			when 4 then '4 = ABORTED'
			when 5 then '5 = RECOVERED'
		end as dtc_state 
		,transaction_status, transaction_status2,dtc_status, dtc_isolation_level, filestream_transaction_id
	from 
		sys.dm_tran_active_transactions
END
GO

-- ============================================================================================================
-- Author:      Cathal OCuirrin
-- Create Date: 07 April 2020
-- Description: Returns the number of rows in a table, and the size of the table, for a particular date range.
-- ============================================================================================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[STA_GetStawmsTableRowsAndSizeForDateRange]
(
--declare
	@startDate DATE, 
	@endDate DATE,
	@tableName NVARCHAR(200)

	--select @startDate = '2019-01-01', @endDate = '2019-12-31', @tableName = 'tblEventLog';
)
AS
BEGIN
	IF @startDate IS NULL OR @endDate IS NULL OR ISNULL(@tableName, '') = '' 
	BEGIN
		SELECT '@startDate is null and/or @endDate is null and/or @tableName is blank or null.' AS Issue;
		RETURN;
	END

	SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ UNCOMMITTED; SET DEADLOCK_PRIORITY LOW;

	DECLARE 
		@varStartDate DATE = @startDate, @varEndDate DATE = @endDate, @varTableName NVARCHAR(200) = @tableName, @varDateColumnName NVARCHAR(200) = 'InsertedDate',
		@varStartDateString NVARCHAR(10) = CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), @startDate, 21) , @varEndDateString NVARCHAR(10) = CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), @endDate, 21);

	IF @varTableName = 'tblEventLog' SET @varDateColumnName = '[Date]';

	DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #tableStats;

	CREATE TABLE #tableStats
	(
		TableName NVARCHAR(200),SchemaName NVARCHAR(50),RowCounts INT,
		TotalSpaceKB DECIMAL(18,2),TotalSpaceMB DECIMAL(18,2),UsedSpaceKB DECIMAL(18,2),
		UsedSpaceMB DECIMAL(18,2), UnusedSpaceKB DECIMAL(18,2),UnusedSpaceMB DECIMAL(18,2)
	);

	INSERT INTO #tableStats EXEC dbo.STA_GetTableStats;

	DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #results;

	SELECT 
		t1.TableName, t1.UsedSpaceMB, (t1.UsedSpaceMB / 1000.00) AS UsedSpaceGB, 
		t1.RowCounts AS [RowCount], 

		CASE WHEN t1.RowCounts < 1 THEN 0.00
		ELSE t1.UsedSpaceMB / CAST(t1.RowCounts AS DECIMAL(18,2)) 
		END AS RowSizeMB
	INTO
		#results
	FROM
		#tableStats t1 
	WHERE 
		t1.TableName = 'tblEventLog'

	DECLARE @RowSizeMB NVARCHAR(50) = (SELECT CAST(ROUND(RowSizeMB, 5) AS NVARCHAR(50)) FROM #results);

	IF ISNULL(@RowSizeMB, '') = '' SET @RowSizeMB = '0.00';

	DECLARE @varSQLCommand NVARCHAR(MAX) = '
		SELECT @@ServerName AS ServerName, DB_NAME() AS DatabaseName,
		''' + @varTableName + ''' AS TableName, ''' + @varStartDateString + ''' AS StartDate,
		''' + @varEndDateString + ''' AS EndDate, COUNT(*) AS NoOfRows, 
		CAST(ROUND(CAST(COUNT(*) AS DECIMAL(18,2)) * ' + @RowSizeMB + ', 2) AS DECIMAL(18, 2)) AS TableSizeMB,
		CAST(ROUND(CAST(COUNT(*) AS DECIMAL(18,2)) * ' + @RowSizeMB + ' / 1000.00, 2) AS DECIMAL(18, 2)) AS TableSizeGB
		FROM dbo.' + @varTableName + ' t1 WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE t1.' + @varDateColumnName + ' >=''' + @varStartDateString + ''' AND t1.[Date] < DATEADD(DAY, 1, ''' + @varEndDateString + ''')';

	EXEC(@varSQLCommand);

EC:

END
GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[STA_GetStockInDetails]    Script Date: 02/11/2026 17:47:28 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON

-- ===============================================================================================
-- Author:      Cathal OCuirrin
-- Create Date: 18 July 2018
-- Description: Returns stockin, stockinline, stockinlinepallet, pallet, palletcontent 
-- and stockitem details for a goods in number.
-- ===============================================================================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[STA_GetStockInDetails]
(
--declare
	@GoodsInNumber NVARCHAR(50) = '-1'
)
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data; Ensure this proc has a low impact when executed */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED; SET DEADLOCK_PRIORITY LOW

	DECLARE @var_GoodsInNumber NVARCHAR(50) = ISNULL(@GoodsInNumber,'')
	
	IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#StockIns') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #StockIns

	SELECT DISTINCT 'tblStockIns' AS FromTable, SIS.StockInStatus, SI.* 
	INTO #StockIns
	FROM dbo.tblStockIns AS SI WITH (NOLOCK)
	INNER JOIN dbo.appStockInStatus AS SIS WITH (NOLOCK)
	ON SI.StockInStatusFK = SIS.StockInStatusPK
	WHERE SI.GoodsInNumber LIKE '%' + @var_GoodsInNumber + '%'

	IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ContainerIns') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #ContainerIns

	SELECT DISTINCT 'tblContainerIns' AS FromTable, SIS.StockInStatus, CI.* 
	INTO #ContainerIns
	FROM dbo.tblContainerIns AS CI WITH (NOLOCK)
	INNER JOIN #StockIns SI
	ON CI.ContainerInPK = si.ContainerInFK
	INNER JOIN dbo.appStockInStatus AS SIS WITH (NOLOCK)
	ON CI.StockInStatusFK = SIS.StockInStatusPK

	IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#StockInLines') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #StockInLines

	SELECT DISTINCT 'tblStockInLines' AS FromTable, PS.PalletStatus, SIL.* 
	INTO #StockInLines
	FROM dbo.tblStockInLines AS SIL WITH (NOLOCK) 
	INNER JOIN dbo.appPalletStatus AS PS WITH (NOLOCK)
	ON SIL.PalletStatusFK = PS.PalletStatusPK
	INNER JOIN #StockIns AS SI
	ON SIL.StockInFK = SI.StockInPK

	IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#StockInLinePallets') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #StockInLinePallets

	SELECT DISTINCT 'tblStockInLinePallets' AS FromTable, SILP.* 
	INTO #StockInLinePallets 
	FROM dbo.tblStockInLinePallets AS SILP WITH (NOLOCK) 
	INNER JOIN #StockInLines AS SIL
	ON SILP.StockInLineFK = SIL.StockInLinePK

	IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#Pallets') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #Pallets

	SELECT DISTINCT 'tblPallets' AS FromTable, PLT.* 
	INTO #Pallets 
	FROM dbo.tblPallets AS PLT WITH (NOLOCK)
	INNER JOIN #StockInLinePallets AS SILP
	ON PLT.PalletPK = SILP.PalletFK

	IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#PalletContent') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #PalletContent

	SELECT DISTINCT 'tblPalletContent' AS FromTable, PC.*
	INTO #PalletContent
	FROM dbo.tblPalletContent AS PC
	INNER JOIN #Pallets AS PLT
	ON PC.PalletFK = PLT.PalletPK

	IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#StockItems') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #StockItems

	SELECT DISTINCT 'tblStockItems' AS FromTable, SI.*
	INTO #StockItems
	FROM dbo.tblStockItems AS SI WITH (NOLOCK)
	INNER JOIN #PalletContent AS PC
	ON SI.StockItemPK = PC.StockItemFK

	IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#WorksOrders') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #WorksOrders

	SELECT DISTINCT 'tblWorksOrders' AS FromTable, WOT.WorksOrderType, WOS.WorksOrderStatus, WO.*
	INTO #WorksOrders
	FROM #StockIns SI
	INNER JOIN dbo.tblWorksOrders WO WITH (NOLOCK)
	ON SI.StockInPK = WO.FK
	AND WO.WorksOrderOriginFK = 1 /*StockIn*/
	LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.appWorksOrderStatus WOS WITH (NOLOCK)
	ON WO.WorksOrderStatusFK = WOS.WorksOrderStatusPK
	LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.appWorksOrderTypes WOT WITH (NOLOCK)
	ON WO.WorksOrderTypeFK = WOT.WorksOrderTypePK

	IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#WorksOrderMovements') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #WorksOrderMovements

	SELECT DISTINCT 'tblWorksOrderMovements' AS FromTable,
	WOS.WorksOrderStatus, 
	CASE WHEN WOM.MovementDescription LIKE '%hand%held%' THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS Scanned,
	sourceLocationType.LocationType AS [FromLocationType],
	destinationLocationType.LocationType AS [ToLocationType],	
	WOM.*
	INTO #WorksOrderMovements
	FROM #WorksOrders WO
	INNER JOIN dbo.tblWorksOrderMovements WOM WITH (NOLOCK)
	ON WO.WorksOrderPK = WOM.WorksOrderFK
	LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.appLocationTypes sourceLocationType WITH (NOLOCK)
	ON WOM.SourceLocationTypeFK = sourceLocationType.LocationTypePK
	LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.appLocationTypes destinationLocationType WITH (NOLOCK)
	ON WOM.DestinationLocationTypeFK = destinationLocationType.LocationTypePK
	LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.appWorksOrderStatus WOS WITH (NOLOCK)
	ON WOM.WorksOrderStatusFK = WOS.WorksOrderStatusPK

	SELECT * FROM #StockIns ORDER BY 3 ASC
	SELECT * FROM #StockInLines ORDER BY 3 ASC
	SELECT * FROM #StockInLinePallets ORDER BY 2 ASC
	SELECT * FROM #ContainerIns ORDER BY 3 ASC
	SELECT * FROM #Pallets ORDER BY 2 ASC
	SELECT * FROM #PalletContent ORDER BY 2 ASC
	SELECT * FROM #StockItems ORDER BY 2 ASC
	SELECT * FROM #WorksOrders ORDER BY 4 ASC
	SELECT * FROM #WorksOrderMovements ORDER BY 6 ASC

	SELECT DISTINCT 'tblPalletAudit' AS FromTable, 
	paet.PalletAuditEventType AS EventType,
	PA.* 
	FROM dbo.tblPalletAudit PA WITH (NOLOCK)
	INNER JOIN #Pallets PLT
	ON PA.PalletFK = PLT.PalletPK
	LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.appPalletAuditEventTypes paet WITH (NOLOCK)
	ON PA.EventTypeFK = paet.PalletAuditEventTypePK
	ORDER BY 3 ASC
END
GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[STA_GetStockInDetailsIncludingPalletHistory]    Script Date: 02/11/2026 17:47:28 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO



-- ===============================================================================================================
-- Author:      Cathal OCuirrin
-- Create Date: 14 August 2018
-- Description: Returns stockin, stockinline, stockinlinepallet and pallet history details for a goods in number.
-- ===============================================================================================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[STA_GetStockInDetailsIncludingPalletHistory]
(
	@GoodsInNumber NVARCHAR(50)
)
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data; Ensure this proc has a low impact when executed */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED; SET DEADLOCK_PRIORITY LOW

	DECLARE @var_GoodsInNumber NVARCHAR(50) = ISNULL(@GoodsInNumber,'')

	DECLARE @SelectedBarcode nvarchar(50) = '',
	@SelectedPalletPK nvarchar(MAX) = '',
	@IncludeMovements bit = 1,
	@IncludeAdjustments bit = 1,
	@IncludePalletStatusChanges bit = 1,
	@IncludePicks bit = 1

	DECLARE @var_SelectedBarcode nvarchar(50), @var_SelectedPalletPK nvarchar(MAX), @var_IncludeMovements bit, @var_IncludeAdjustments bit, 
	@var_IncludePalletStatusChanges bit, @var_IncludePicks bit

	SET @var_SelectedBarcode = @SelectedBarcode; SET @var_SelectedPalletPK = @SelectedPalletPK; SET @var_IncludeMovements = @IncludeMovements
	SET @var_IncludeAdjustments = @IncludeAdjustments; SET @var_IncludePalletStatusChanges = @IncludePalletStatusChanges
	SET @var_IncludePicks = @IncludePicks	

	IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#tblStockIns') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #tblStockIns

	SELECT 'tblStockIns' AS 'FromTable', * INTO #tblStockIns FROM dbo.tblStockIns WHERE GoodsInNumber LIKE '%' + @var_GoodsInNumber + '%'

	IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#tblStockInLines') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #tblStockInLines

	SELECT 'tblStockInLines' AS 'FromTable', * INTO #tblStockInLines FROM dbo.tblStockInLines WHERE StockInFK IN (SELECT StockInPK FROM #tblStockIns)

	IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#tblStockInLinePallets') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #tblStockInLinePallets

	SELECT 'tblStockInLinePallets' AS 'FromTable', * INTO #tblStockInLinePallets FROM dbo.tblStockInLinePallets WHERE StockInLineFK IN (SELECT StockInLinePK FROM #tblStockInLines)

	--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	-- Temp table of pallet pk's (can be multiple pallet records with same barcode)
	--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

	IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#TempPallets') IS NOT NULL
		DROP TABLE #TempPallets

	Select 
		palletpk, CustomerBarcode, Barcode 
	INTO 
		#TempPallets 
	from 
		tblpallets 
	where 
		(
			(barcode = @var_SelectedBarcode or customerbarcode = @var_SelectedBarcode) 
			AND @var_SelectedBarcode <> ''
		)
		OR
		(
			palletpk IN (SELECT DISTINCT palletFK FROM #tblStockInLinePallets)
			AND NOT (@var_SelectedBarcode <> '')
		)

	IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#TempPalletAudit') IS NOT NULL
		DROP TABLE #TempPalletAudit

	select 
		PalletAuditPK, PalletFK, StockItemFK, Batch, EventTypeFK, EventFK, EventDate, UpdatedBy 
	INTO 
		#TempPalletAudit
	from 
		tblPalletaudit
	inner join #TempPallets 
		on palletfk = PalletPK

	IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#TempStockItem') IS NOT NULL
		DROP TABLE #TempStockItem

	select distinct
		si.StockItemPK, si.StockItemCode, si.[Description]
	INTO
		#TempStockItem 
	from 
		tblStockItems AS si
	INNER JOIN #TempPalletAudit AS tpa
		ON si.stockitempk = tpa.stockitemfk

	IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#TempMovements') IS NOT NULL
		DROP TABLE #TempMovements

	select 
		WorksOrderMovementPK, WorksOrderFK, WorksOrderStatusFK, palletFK, Units, SourceLocationTypeFK, 
		SourcelocationFK, DestinationLocationTypeFK, DestinationFK, MovementDescription, UpdatedBy
	INTO
		#TempMovements
	from 
		tblWorksOrderMovements as wom
	inner join #TempPallets 
		on PalletFk = PalletPK

	IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#TempColpc') IS NOT NULL
		DROP TABLE #TempColpc

	select 
		ContainerOutLinePalletContentPK,  ContainerOutLineFK, PalletFk, Units, Inserteddate, UpdatedBy
	INTO 
		#TempColpc
	from 
		tblcontaineroutlinepalletcontent
	inner join #TempPallets 
		on PalletFk = PalletPK



	IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#finalResults') IS NOT NULL
		DROP TABLE #finalResults

	CREATE TABLE #finalResults
	(
		EventType NVARCHAR(100), 
		EventDate DATETIME, 
		Eventuser NVARCHAR(100),  
		Units NVARCHAR(255), 
		[Description] NVARCHAR(1000),
		StockItem NVARCHAR(500), 
		Barcode NVARCHAR(100), 
		EventOrder SMALLINT,
		scanned BIT
	)

	-- --------------
	-- Main Queries
	-- --------------

	--Pallet arrived
	INSERT INTO #finalResults 
	(
		EventType, 
		EventDate, 
		Eventuser,  
		Units, 
		[Description],
		StockItem, 
		Barcode, 
		EventOrder,
		scanned
	)
	select distinct 
		'Pallet Arrived' as EventType, 
		pa.EventDate as EventDate, 
		case when createdbyuser.PersonName is null then 'System' else createdbyuser.PersonName end as Eventuser,  
		convert(nvarchar(255),sil.units) as Units, 
		'Pallet Arrived - Goods In Number: ' + si.GoodsInNumber  as [Description],
		s.stockitemcode + ' - ' + s.description as StockItem, 
		case when p.CustomerBarcode <> '' then p.CustomerBarcode else p.Barcode END AS Barcode, 
		2 as EventOrder,
		0 as scanned
	from 
		#TempPalletAudit as pa  
	inner join tblstockinlinepallets as silp on silp.palletfk = pa.palletfk  
	inner join tblstockinlines as sil on sil.stockinlinepk = silp.stockinlinefk  
	inner join tblstockins as si on si.stockinpk = sil.stockinfk
	inner join #TempStockItem as s on s.stockitempk = pa.stockitemfk
	inner join #TempPallets as p on p.palletpk = pa.palletfk
	-- Use NOT EXISTS instead of joining a table to check if it's FK is null.
	--left outer join tblstocktransfers as st on st.ContainerinFK = si.ContainerinFK
	left outer join (
		Select users.UserPK, FirstName + ' ' + LastName as PersonName
		from tblPeople as people
		inner join tblUsers as users on users.PersonFK = people.PersonPK) as createdbyuser on createdbyuser.UserPK = pa.updatedby  
	where pa.EventTypeFK = 1 
	and not exists -- Use NOT EXISTS instead of joining a table to check if it's FK is null. 
	(
		select * from tblstocktransfers as st
		where si.ContainerinFK = st.ContainerinFK
	) --st.ContainerinFK is null

	if @var_IncludeMovements = 1
	begin
		--Pallet movements
		INSERT INTO #finalResults 
		(
			EventType, 
			EventDate, 
			Eventuser,  
			Units, 
			[Description],
			StockItem, 
			Barcode, 
			EventOrder,
			scanned
		)
		select 'Stock Moved' as Eventtype, pa.EventDate as EventDate, case when createdbyuser.PersonName is null then 'System' else createdbyuser.PersonName end as Eventuser, convert(nvarchar(255),wom.units) as Units, 
		CASE 
			WHEN wom.sourcelocationtypefk = 4 then 'Pallet Unloaded, batch ' + pa.batch + ' to ' + DestinationBuilding.Building + ': ' + DestinationLocation.LocationDescription
			ELSE 'Moved pallet, batch ' + pa.batch + ' from ' + SourceBuilding.Building + ': ' + SourceLocation.LocationDescription + ' to ' + DestinationBuilding.Building + ': ' + DestinationLocation.LocationDescription END
		as [description],
		s.stockitemcode + ' - ' + s.description as StockItem, case when p.CustomerBarcode <> '' then p.CustomerBarcode else p.Barcode END AS Barcode, 4 as EventOrder, 
		case when wom.movementdescription like '%HAND HELD%' then 1 else 0 end as scanned
		from #TempMovements as wom
		inner join tblworksorders as wo on wo.worksorderpk = wom.worksorderfk
		inner join #TempPalletAudit as pa on pa.eventfk = wom.worksordermovementpk and pa.eventtypefk = 17
		inner join #TempStockItem as s on s.stockitempk = pa.stockitemfk
		inner join #TempPallets as p on p.palletpk = pa.palletfk
		left outer join (
			Select users.UserPK, FirstName + ' ' + LastName as PersonName
			from tblPeople people
			inner join tblUsers as users on users.PersonFK = people.PersonPK
		) as createdbyuser on createdbyuser.UserPK = wom.updatedby 
		
		--source location
		LEFT OUTER JOIN (-- Find the building Unit
			Select  worksordermovementpk,
				CASE WHEN sourceLocationTypeFK = 1 THEN 
						vbus.BuildingUnitFK
						WHEN sourceLocationTypeFK = 2 THEN 
						lBay.BuildingUnitFK
						WHEN sourceLocationTypeFK = 3 THEN
						lset.BuildingUnitFK
						WHEN sourceLocationTypeFK = 6 THEN
						lSam.BuildingUnitFK
						WHEN sourceLocationTypeFK = 8 THEN
						lFloor.BuildingUnitFK
				END as BuildingUnitFK, 
				CASE WHEN sourceLocationTypeFK = 1 THEN 
						vbus.BuildingUnitBayLocation
						WHEN sourceLocationTypeFK = 2 THEN 
						lBay.LoadingBay
						WHEN sourceLocationTypeFK = 3 THEN
						lset.SetDownArea
						WHEN sourceLocationTypeFK = 6 THEN
						lSam.SampleLocation
						WHEN sourceLocationTypeFK = 8 THEN
						lFloor.FloorLocation
				END as LocationDescription 
			from #TempMovements
			LEFT OUTER JOIN viewBuildingUnitBays as vbus on vbus.BuildingUnitBayPK = SourcelocationFK 
			LEFT OUTER JOIN tblLoadingBays as lBay ON lBay.loadingBayPK = SourceLocationFK 
			LEFT OUTER JOIN tblSetDownAreas as lSet ON lSEt.SetdownareaPK = SourceLocationFK 
			LEFT OUTER JOIN tblSampleLocations as lSam ON lSam.SampleLocationPK = sourceLocationFK
			LEFT OUTER JOIN tblFloorLocations as lFloor on lFloor.FloorLocationPK = sourceLocationFK
		) as SourceLocation ON SourceLocation.worksordermovementpk = wom.worksordermovementpk
		LEFT OUTER JOIN (
			Select  BuildingName + ' - ' + BuildingUnit as Building, BuildingUnitPK 
			FROM tblBuildingUnits 
			INNER JOIN tblBuildings on BuildingPK = BuildingFK) as SourceBuilding
		ON SourceBuilding.BuildingUnitPK = SourceLocation.BuildingUnitFK

		--destination location
		LEFT OUTER JOIN (-- Find the building Unit
			Select  worksordermovementpk,
				CASE WHEN DestinationLocationTypeFK = 1 THEN 
						vbus.BuildingUnitFK
						WHEN DestinationLocationTypeFK = 2 THEN 
						lBay.BuildingUnitFK
						WHEN DestinationLocationTypeFK = 3 THEN
						lset.BuildingUnitFK
						WHEN DestinationLocationTypeFK = 6 THEN
						lSam.BuildingUnitFK
						WHEN DestinationLocationTypeFK = 8 THEN
						lFloor.BuildingUnitFK
				END as BuildingUnitFK, 
				CASE WHEN DestinationLocationTypeFK = 1 THEN 
						vbus.BuildingUnitBayLocation
						WHEN DestinationLocationTypeFK = 2 THEN 
						lBay.LoadingBay
						WHEN DestinationLocationTypeFK = 3 THEN
						lset.SetDownArea
						WHEN DestinationLocationTypeFK = 6 THEN
						lSam.SampleLocation
						WHEN DestinationLocationTypeFK = 8 THEN
						lFloor.FloorLocation
				END as LocationDescription 
			from #TempMovements
			LEFT OUTER JOIN viewBuildingUnitBays as vbus on vbus.BuildingUnitBayPK = DestinationFK 
			LEFT OUTER JOIN tblLoadingBays as lBay ON lBay.loadingBayPK = DestinationFK 
			LEFT OUTER JOIN tblSetDownAreas as lSet ON lSEt.SetdownareaPK = DestinationFK 
			LEFT OUTER JOIN tblSampleLocations as lSam ON lSam.SampleLocationPK = DestinationFK
			LEFT OUTER JOIN tblFloorLocations as lFloor on lFloor.FloorLocationPK = DestinationFK
		) as DestinationLocation ON DestinationLocation.worksordermovementpk = wom.worksordermovementpk
		LEFT OUTER JOIN (
			Select  BuildingName + ' - ' + BuildingUnit as Building, BuildingUnitPK 
			FROM tblBuildingUnits 
			INNER JOIN tblBuildings on BuildingPK = BuildingFK) as Destinationbuilding
		ON Destinationbuilding.BuildingUnitPK = DestinationLocation.BuildingUnitFK

		INNER JOIN #TempPallets AS tp
		ON wom.palletfk = tp.PalletPK

		where @var_IncludeMovements = 1
		and wom.worksorderstatusfk = 3
	end

	if @var_IncludePicks = 1
	begin
		--stock picked
		INSERT INTO #finalResults 
		(
			EventType, 
			EventDate, 
			Eventuser,  
			Units, 
			[Description],
			StockItem, 
			Barcode, 
			EventOrder,
			scanned
		)
		select  'Stock Picked' as EventType, colpc.inserteddate as EventDate, case when createdbyuser.PersonName is null then 'System' else createdbyuser.PersonName end as Eventuser, convert(nvarchar(255),sum(colpc.units)) as Units,
		'Stock Picked - Goods Order Number : ' + co.goodsordernumber + 'v' + CONVERT(varchar(10), co.versionnumber) as description, s.stockitemcode + ' - ' + s.description as StockItem, case when p.CustomerBarcode <> '' then p.CustomerBarcode else p.Barcode END AS Barcode, 3 as EventOrder,0 as scanned
		from #TempColpc as colpc
		inner join tblcontaineroutlines as col on colpc.containeroutlinefk = col.containeroutlinepk
		inner join tblcontainerouts as co on co.containeroutpk = col.containeroutfk
		--inner join tblpalletaudit as pa on pa.EventFK = col.containeroutlinepk and pa.EventTypeFK = 3
		inner join #TempStockItem as s on s.stockitempk = col.stockitemfk
		inner join #TempPallets as p on p.palletpk = colpc.palletfk
		left outer join (
			Select users.UserPK, FirstName + ' ' + LastName as PersonName
			from tblPeople as people
			inner join tblUsers as users on users.PersonFK = people.PersonPK) as createdbyuser on createdbyuser.UserPK = colpc.updatedby 
		where @var_IncludePicks = 1
		group by colpc.inserteddate, case when createdbyuser.PersonName is null then 'System' else createdbyuser.PersonName end,
		'Stock Picked - Goods Order Number : ' + co.goodsordernumber + 'v' + CONVERT(varchar(10), co.versionnumber),s.stockitemcode + ' - ' + s.description,
		case when p.CustomerBarcode <> '' then p.CustomerBarcode else p.Barcode END
	end

	if @var_IncludePicks = 1
	begin
		--stock pick cancelled
		INSERT INTO #finalResults 
		(
			EventType, 
			EventDate, 
			Eventuser,  
			Units, 
			[Description],
			StockItem, 
			Barcode, 
			EventOrder,
			scanned
		)
		select distinct 'Picked cancelled' as EventType, co.updateddate as EventDate, case when createdbyuser.PersonName is null then 'System' else createdbyuser.PersonName end as Eventuser, convert(nvarchar(255),colpc.units) as Units,
		'Pick cancelled for this Stock, Goods Order Number : ' + co.goodsordernumber + 'v' + CONVERT(varchar(10), co.versionnumber) as description, s.stockitemcode + ' - ' + s.description as StockItem, case when p.CustomerBarcode <> '' then p.CustomerBarcode else p.Barcode END AS Barcode, 3 as EventOrder,0 as scanned
		from #TempColpc as colpc
		inner join tblcontaineroutlines as col on colpc.containeroutlinefk = col.containeroutlinepk
		inner join tblcontainerouts as co on co.containeroutpk = col.containeroutfk
		--inner join tblpalletaudit as pa on pa.EventFK = col.containeroutlinepk and pa.EventTypeFK = 3
		inner join #TempStockItem as s on s.stockitempk = col.stockitemfk
		inner join #TempPallets as p on p.palletpk = colpc.palletfk
		left outer join (
			Select users.UserPK, FirstName + ' ' + LastName as PersonName
			from tblPeople as people
			inner join tblUsers users on users.PersonFK = people.PersonPK) as createdbyuser on createdbyuser.UserPK = co.updatedby 
		where co.containeroutstatusfk = 6 
		and @var_IncludePicks = 1
	end

	if @var_IncludePicks = 1
	begin
		--pallet loaded but not gone
		INSERT INTO #finalResults 
		(
			EventType, 
			EventDate, 
			Eventuser,  
			Units, 
			[Description],
			StockItem, 
			Barcode, 
			EventOrder,
			scanned
		)
		select  case when pa.eventtypefk in(25,27)  then 'Pallet Loaded' else 'Pallet Unloaded' end as EventType, pa.eventdate as EventDate, case when createdbyuser.PersonName is null then 'System' else createdbyuser.PersonName end as Eventuser, convert(nvarchar(255),sum(paDetail.totalunits)) as Units, 
		case when pa.eventtypefk in(25,27) then'Pallet loaded for Goods Order ' else 'Pallet Unloaded from Goods Order ' end + co.goodsordernumber + 'v' + CONVERT(varchar(10), co.versionnumber) as Description,
		s.stockitemcode + ' - ' + s.description as StockItem, case when p.CustomerBarcode <> '' then p.CustomerBarcode else p.Barcode END AS Barcode, 6 as EventOrder,
		case when pa.eventtypefk = 27 then 1 else 0 end as scanned
		from #TempPalletAudit as pa 
		inner join tblpalletaudit as paDetail on pa.PalletAuditPK = paDetail.PalletAuditPK
		inner join tblcontainerouts as co on co.containeroutpk = pa.eventfk and pa.eventtypefk in (25,26, 27)
		inner join #TempStockItem as s on s.stockitempk = pa.stockitemfk
		inner join #TempPallets as p on p.palletpk = pa.palletfk
		left outer join (
			Select users.UserPK, FirstName + ' ' + LastName as PersonName
			from tblPeople as people
			inner join tblUsers as users on users.PersonFK = people.PersonPK
		) as createdbyuser on createdbyuser.UserPK = pa.updatedby  
		where @var_IncludePicks = 1
		group by case when pa.eventtypefk in(25,27)  then 'Pallet Loaded' else 'Pallet Unloaded' end, pa.eventdate , case when createdbyuser.PersonName is null then 'System' else createdbyuser.PersonName end , 
		case when pa.eventtypefk in(25,27) then'Pallet loaded for Goods Order ' else 'Pallet Unloaded from Goods Order ' end + co.goodsordernumber + 'v' + CONVERT(varchar(10), co.versionnumber) ,
		s.stockitemcode + ' - ' + s.description , case when p.CustomerBarcode <> '' then p.CustomerBarcode else p.Barcode END ,
		case when pa.eventtypefk = 27 then 1 else 0 end 
	end

	if @var_IncludePicks = 1
	begin
		--pallet gone
		INSERT INTO #finalResults 
		(
			EventType, 
			EventDate, 
			Eventuser,  
			Units, 
			[Description],
			StockItem, 
			Barcode, 
			EventOrder,
			scanned
		)
		select distinct  case when st.stocktransferpk is null then 'Pallet Gone' else 'Pallet transferred' End as EventType, pa.eventdate as EventDate, case when createdbyuser.PersonName is null then 'System' else createdbyuser.PersonName end as Eventuser, convert(nvarchar(255),colpc.units) as Units, 
		case when st.stocktransferpk is null then 'Pallet gone on ' else 'Pallet transferred to Goods In ' + ciTransferred.goodsinnumber  + ' from ' End + 'Goods Order ' + co.goodsordernumber + 'v' + CONVERT(varchar(10), co.versionnumber) as Description,
		s.stockitemcode + ' - ' + s.description as StockItem, case when p.CustomerBarcode <> '' then p.CustomerBarcode else p.Barcode END AS Barcode, case when st.stocktransferpk is null then 6 else 1 End as EventOrder,0 as scanned
		from #TempPalletAudit as pa  
		inner join tblcontaineroutlines as col on pa.eventfk = col.containeroutlinepk
		inner join #TempColpc as colpc on colpc.containeroutlinefk = col.containeroutlinepk  and pa.palletfk = colpc.palletfk
		inner join tblcontainerouts as co on co.containeroutpk = col.containeroutfk
		inner join #TempStockItem as s on s.stockitempk = pa.stockitemfk
		inner join #TempPallets as p on p.palletpk = pa.palletfk
		left outer join tblstocktransfers as st on st.ContainerOutFK = co.ContainerOutPK
		left outer join tblcontainerins as ciTransferred on st.ContainerInFK = ciTransferred.ContainerInPK
		left outer join (
			Select users.UserPK, FirstName + ' ' + LastName as PersonName
			from tblPeople as people
			inner join tblUsers as users on users.PersonFK = people.PersonPK
		) as createdbyuser on createdbyuser.UserPK = pa.updatedby  
		where pa.EventTypeFK = 2 
		--and @var_IncludePicks = 1
	end

	if @var_IncludePicks = 1
	begin
		--stock gone - only show for partial picks
		INSERT INTO #finalResults 
		(
			EventType, 
			EventDate, 
			Eventuser,  
			Units, 
			[Description],
			StockItem, 
			Barcode, 
			EventOrder,
			scanned
		)
		select EventType, EventDate, EventUser, convert(nvarchar(255),sum(Units)) as Units, Description, StockItem, Barcode, EventORder, Scanned
	from (
		select distinct colpc.containeroutlinepalletcontentpk,  'Stock Gone' as EventType, pa.eventdate as EventDate, case when createdbyuser.PersonName is null then 'System' else createdbyuser.PersonName end as Eventuser, colpc.units as Units, 'Stock Loaded for Goods Order ' + co.goodsordernumber + 'v' + CONVERT(varchar(10), co.versionnumber) as Description,
		s.stockitemcode + ' - ' + s.description as StockItem, case when p.CustomerBarcode <> '' then p.CustomerBarcode else p.Barcode END AS Barcode, 5 as EventOrder,0 as scanned
			from #TempPalletAudit as pa  
			inner join tblcontaineroutlines as col on pa.eventfk = col.containeroutlinepk
			inner join #TempColpc as colpc on colpc.containeroutlinefk = col.containeroutlinepk and colpc.palletfk = pa.palletfk
			inner join tblcontainerouts as co on co.containeroutpk = col.containeroutfk
			inner join #TempStockItem as s on s.stockitempk = pa.stockitemfk
			inner join #TempPallets as p on p.palletpk = pa.palletfk
			left outer join tblstocktransfers as st on st.ContaineroutFK = co.ContaineroutPK
			left outer join (
				Select users.UserPK, FirstName + ' ' + LastName as PersonName
				from tblPeople as people
				inner join tblUsers as users on users.PersonFK = people.PersonPK
			) as createdbyuser on createdbyuser.UserPK = pa.updatedby  
			left outer join (
				select palletauditpk, palletfk from #TempPalletAudit where eventtypefk = 2
			) as PalletGone on PalletGone.palletfk = pa.palletfk
			where pa.EventTypeFK = 3  
			and st.ContaineroutFK is null 
			and PalletGone.palletauditpk is null) subQ
			group by EventType, EventDate, EventUser, Description, StockItem, Barcode, EventORder, Scanned
			--and @var_IncludePicks = 1
	end 

	--pallet depleted (top up to another pallet)
	INSERT INTO #finalResults 
	(
		EventType, 
		EventDate, 
		Eventuser,  
		Units, 
		[Description],
		StockItem, 
		Barcode, 
		EventOrder,
		scanned
	)
	select 'Pallet Depleted' as EventType, pt.inserteddate as EventDate, createdbyuser.PersonName as Eventuser, convert(nvarchar(255),pt.TopupUnits) as Units, 
	'Pallet ' + case when topallet.CustomerBarcode <> '' then topallet.CustomerBarcode else topallet.Barcode END + ' topped up with ' + CONVERT(varchar(10), pt.TopupUnits) 
	+ ' units from pallet ' + case when frompallet.CustomerBarcode <> '' then frompallet.CustomerBarcode else frompallet.Barcode END as Description, 
	s.stockitemcode + ' - ' + s.description as StockItem, 
	case when frompallet.CustomerBarcode <> '' then frompallet.CustomerBarcode else frompallet.Barcode END AS Barcode, 7 as EventOrder,0 as scanned
	from #TempPalletAudit as pa 
	inner join tblPalletTopups as pt on pa.palletfk = pt.TopupFromPalletFK and pa.eventfk = pt.worksorderfk
	inner join tblPalletContent as pc on pc.palletfk = pt.TopupToPalletFK
	inner join #TempStockItem as s on s.stockitempk = pc.stockitemfk
	inner join tblpallets as frompallet on frompallet.palletpk = pa.palletfk
	inner join tblpallets as topallet on topallet.palletpk = pc.palletfk
	left outer join (
		Select users.UserPK, FirstName + ' ' + LastName as PersonName
		from tblPeople as people
		inner join tblUsers as users on users.PersonFK = people.PersonPK
	) as createdbyuser on createdbyuser.UserPK = pa.updatedby
				
	INNER JOIN #TempPallets as tp
		ON pa.palletfk = tp.PalletPK
				  
	where pa.EventTypeFK = 24

	--pallet topped up
	INSERT INTO #finalResults 
	(
		EventType, 
		EventDate, 
		Eventuser,  
		Units, 
		[Description],
		StockItem, 
		Barcode, 
		EventOrder,
		scanned
	)
	select 'Pallet Topped Up' as EventType, pt.inserteddate as EventDate, createdbyuser.PersonName as Eventuser, convert(nvarchar(255),pt.TopupUnits) as Units, 
	'Pallet ' + case when topallet.CustomerBarcode <> '' then topallet.CustomerBarcode else topallet.Barcode END + ' topped up with ' + CONVERT(varchar(10), pt.TopupUnits) 
	+ ' units from pallet ' + case when frompallet.CustomerBarcode <> '' then frompallet.CustomerBarcode else frompallet.Barcode END as Description, 
	s.stockitemcode + ' - ' + s.description as StockItem, 
	case when frompallet.CustomerBarcode <> '' then frompallet.CustomerBarcode else frompallet.Barcode END AS Barcode, 6 as EventOrder,0 as scanned
	from #TempPalletAudit as pa 
	inner join tblPalletTopups as pt on pa.palletfk = pt.TopupToPalletFK and pa.eventfk = pt.worksorderfk
	inner join tblPalletContent as pc on pc.palletfk = pt.TopupToPalletFK
	inner join #TempStockItem as s on s.stockitempk = pc.stockitemfk
	inner join tblpallets as frompallet on frompallet.palletpk = pt.TopupFromPalletFK
	inner join tblpallets as topallet on topallet.palletpk = pc.palletfk
	left outer join (
		Select users.UserPK, FirstName + ' ' + LastName as PersonName
		from tblPeople as people
		inner join tblUsers as users on users.PersonFK = people.PersonPK
	) as createdbyuser on createdbyuser.UserPK = pa.updatedby  

	INNER JOIN #TempPallets as tp
		ON pa.palletfk = tp.PalletPK

	where pa.EventTypeFK = 14

	--pallet topped off
	INSERT INTO #finalResults 
	(
		EventType, 
		EventDate, 
		Eventuser,  
		Units, 
		[Description],
		StockItem, 
		Barcode, 
		EventOrder,
		scanned
	)
	select 'Pallet Topped Off' as EventType, pt.inserteddate as EventDate, createdbyuser.PersonName as Eventuser, convert(nvarchar(255),pt.TopupUnits) as Units, 
	'Pallet ' + case when topallet.CustomerBarcode <> '' then topallet.CustomerBarcode else topallet.Barcode END + ' topped up with ' + CONVERT(varchar(10), pt.TopupUnits) 
	+ ' units from pallet ' + case when frompallet.CustomerBarcode <> '' then frompallet.CustomerBarcode else frompallet.Barcode END as Description, 
	s.stockitemcode + ' - ' + s.description as StockItem, 
	case when frompallet.CustomerBarcode <> '' then frompallet.CustomerBarcode else frompallet.Barcode END AS Barcode, 6 as EventOrder,0 as scanned
	from #TempPalletAudit as pa 
	inner join tblPalletTopups as pt on pa.palletfk = pt.TopupFromPalletFK and pa.eventfk = pt.worksorderfk
	inner join tblPalletContent as pc on pc.palletfk = pt.TopupToPalletFK
	inner join #TempStockItem as s on s.stockitempk = pc.stockitemfk
	inner join tblpallets as frompallet on frompallet.palletpk = pa.palletfk
	inner join tblpallets as topallet on topallet.palletpk = pc.palletfk
	left outer join (
		Select users.UserPK, FirstName + ' ' + LastName as PersonName
		from tblPeople as people
		inner join tblUsers as users on users.PersonFK = people.PersonPK
	) as createdbyuser on createdbyuser.UserPK = pa.updatedby  
				
	INNER JOIN #TempPallets as tp
		ON pa.palletfk = tp.PalletPK

	where pa.EventTypeFK = 23

	if @var_IncludeAdjustments = 1
	begin
		--stock adjustments
		INSERT INTO #finalResults 
		(
			EventType, 
			EventDate, 
			Eventuser,  
			Units, 
			[Description],
			StockItem, 
			Barcode, 
			EventOrder,
			scanned
		)
		select 'Stock Adjusted' as EventType, sa.InsertedDate as EventDate, createdbyuser.PersonName as Eventuser, convert(nvarchar(255),sa.UnitsAfter) as Units,
		
		(case when sa.PalletTypeBeforeFK <> sa.PalletTypeAfterFK then
			'Pallet Type changed from ' + coalesce(PTypeBefore.PalletType, 'unknown') + ' to ' + PTypeAfter.PalletType
			when sa.UnitsBefore <> sa.UnitsAfter then
			'Units on pallet changed from ' + CONVERT(varchar(10), sa.UnitsBefore) + ' to ' + CONVERT(varchar(10), sa.UnitsAfter)
			when sa.EachesBefore <> sa.EachesAfter then
			'Eaches on pallet changed from ' + CONVERT(varchar(10), sa.EachesBefore) + ' to ' + CONVERT(varchar(10), sa.EachesAfter)
			when sa.BarcodeBefore <> sa.BarcodeAfter then
			'Barcode changed from ' + sa.BarcodeBefore + ' to ' + sa.BarcodeAfter
			when sa.CustomerBarcodeBefore <> sa.CustomerBarcodeAfter then
			'Customer Barcode changed from ' + sa.CustomerBarcodeBefore + ' to ' + sa.CustomerBarcodeAfter
			when sa.CustomerPalletNumberBefore <> sa.CustomerPalletNumberAfter then
			'Customer Pallet Number changed from ' + sa.CustomerPalletNumberBefore + ' to ' + sa.CustomerPalletNumberAfter
			when sa.BatchBefore <> sa.BatchAfter then
			'Batch changed from ' + sa.BatchBefore + ' to ' + sa.BatchAfter
			when sa.StockItemBeforeFK <> sa.StockItemAfterFK then
			'Stock Item Code changed from ' + stockBefore.StockItemCode + ' to ' + s.StockItemCode
			when sa.SpecialStockTypeBeforeFK <> sa.SpecialStockTypeAfterFK then
			'Special Stock Type changed from ' + ISNULL(SSTBefore.SpecialStockType, 'No special type') + ' to ' + ISNULL(SSTAfter.SpecialStockType, 'No special type')
			when sa.BestBeforeDateBefore <> sa.BestBeforeDateAfter then
			'Best Before Date changed from ' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(50), sa.BestBeforeDateBefore, 106) + ' to ' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(50), sa.BestBeforeDateAfter, 106) + ' on works order ' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(50),sa.worksorderfk)
			else 'Unknown Adjustment - contact support for details'
		End) + case when sa.Queue = 1 then ' (Pending)' else '' end as Description, 
			coalesce(s.stockitemcode, currentdetails.stockitemcode) + ' - ' + coalesce(s.description, currentdetails.Description) as StockItem, 
		case when sa.CustomerBarcodeAfter <> '' then sa.CustomerBarcodeAfter else sa.BarcodeAfter END AS Barcode, 6 as EventOrder,0 as scanned
		from #TempPallets as p 
		inner join (
			select palletfk, stockitemfk, stockitemcode, Description 
			from tblpalletcontent 
			inner join tblstockitems on stockitemfk = stockitempk
			group by palletfk, stockitemfk, stockitemcode, Description
		) as currentdetails on currentdetails.palletfk = p.palletpk
		inner join tblStockAdjustments as sa on p.palletpk = sa.palletfk
		left outer join tblstockitems as stockBefore on stockBefore.stockitempk = sa.StockItemBeforeFK
		left outer join #TempStockItem as s on s.stockitempk = sa.StockItemAfterFK
		inner join tblPalletTypes as PTypeBefore on PTypeBefore.PalletTypePK = sa.PalletTypeBeforeFK
		inner join tblPalletTypes as PTypeAfter on PTypeAfter.PalletTypePK = sa.PalletTypeAfterFK
		left outer join appSpecialStockTypes as SSTBefore on SSTBefore.SpecialStockTypePK = sa.SpecialStockTypeBeforeFK
		left outer join appSpecialStockTypes as SSTAfter on SSTAfter.SpecialStockTypePK = sa.SpecialStockTypeAfterFK
		left outer join (
			Select users.UserPK, FirstName + ' ' + LastName as PersonName
			from tblPeople as people
			inner join tblUsers as users on users.PersonFK = people.PersonPK
		) as createdbyuser on createdbyuser.UserPK = sa.updatedby  
		--where @var_IncludeAdjustments = 1
	end

	if @var_IncludePalletStatusChanges = 1
	begin
		--pallet status changes
		INSERT INTO #finalResults 
		(
			EventType, 
			EventDate, 
			Eventuser,  
			Units, 
			[Description],
			StockItem, 
			Barcode, 
			EventOrder,
			scanned
		)
		select 'Status Changed' as EventType, sc.updatedDate as EventDate, case when createdbyuser.PersonName is null then 'System' else createdbyuser.PersonName end as Eventuser, /*convert(nvarchar(255), pc.ActualUnits)*/ 'Full QTY'  as Units, 
		'Pallet Status changed from ' + statusBefore.PalletStatus + ' to ' + statusAfter.PalletStatus + case when sc.instruction = '' then sc.instruction else ' (' + sc.instruction + ')' end + CASE WHEN pscr.PalletStatusChangeReason <> NULL then ' Reason: ' + pscr.PalletStatusChangeReason else '' END + ' REF: ' + sc.reference as Description, 
		s.stockitemcode + ' - ' + s.description as StockItem, 
		case when p.CustomerBarcode <> '' then p.CustomerBarcode else p.Barcode END AS Barcode, 6 as EventOrder,0 as scanned
		from  #TempPallets as p 
		Inner join tblPalletStatusChanges as sc on p.PalletPk = sc.PalletFK
		Inner join tblpalletContent as pc on pc.PalletFk = sc.PalletFK
		inner join #TempStockItem as s on s.stockitempk = pc.StockItemFK
		left outer join appPalletStatusChangeReasons as pscr on sc.PalletStatusChangeReasonFK = pscr.PalletStatusChangeReasonPK
		inner join appPalletStatus as statusBefore on statusBefore.PalletStatusPK = sc.FromPalletStatusFK
		inner join appPalletStatus as statusAfter on statusafter.PalletStatusPK = sc.ToPalletStatusFK
		left outer join (
			Select users.UserPK, FirstName + ' ' + LastName as PersonName
			from tblPeople as people
			inner join tblUsers as users on users.PersonFK = people.PersonPK
		) as createdbyuser on createdbyuser.UserPK = sc.updatedby  
		--where @var_IncludePalletStatusChanges = 1
	end
			
	-- Pallet removed from Pick
	INSERT INTO #finalResults 
	(
		EventType, 
		EventDate, 
		Eventuser,  
		Units, 
		[Description],
		StockItem, 
		Barcode, 
		EventOrder,
		scanned
	)
	select distinct 'Pallet Removed From Pick' as EventType, 
    pa.EventDate as EventDate, 
	case when createdbyuser.PersonName is null then 'System' else createdbyuser.PersonName end as Eventuser,
	'Full QTY' as Units, 'Pallet Removed - From Goods Order : ' + co.GoodsOrderNumber  as Description,
	s.stockitemcode + ' - ' + s.description as StockItem, case when p.CustomerBarcode <> '' then p.CustomerBarcode else p.Barcode END AS Barcode, 
	2 as EventOrder,1 as scanned
	from #TempPalletAudit as pa  
	inner join tblpallets as p on palletpk = palletfk 
	inner join tblpalletcontent as pc on pc.palletfk = p.PalletPK
	inner join tblcontainerouts as co on containeroutpk = eventfk 			
	inner join tblstockitems as s on s.stockitempk = pa.stockitemfk 	
	left outer join (
		Select users.UserPK, FirstName + ' ' + LastName as PersonName
		from tblPeople as people
		inner join tblUsers as users on users.PersonFK = people.PersonPK) as createdbyuser on createdbyuser.UserPK = pa.updatedby  
	where pa.EventTypeFK = 28 	

	-- Pallet Added to Pick
	INSERT INTO #finalResults 
	(
		EventType, 
		EventDate, 
		Eventuser,  
		Units, 
		[Description],
		StockItem, 
		Barcode, 
		EventOrder,
		scanned
	)
	select distinct 'Pallet Added To Pick' as EventType, 
    pa.EventDate as EventDate, 
	case when createdbyuser.PersonName is null then 'System' else createdbyuser.PersonName end as Eventuser,
	convert(nvarchar(255),pc.Units) as Units, 'Pallet Added - To Goods Order : ' + co.GoodsOrderNumber  as Description,
	s.stockitemcode + ' - ' + s.description as StockItem, case when p.CustomerBarcode <> '' then p.CustomerBarcode else p.Barcode END AS Barcode, 
	2 as EventOrder,1 as scanned				
	from #TempColpc as pc
	inner join tblpallets as p on palletpk = pc.palletfk 
	inner join #TempPalletAudit as pa on pa.palletfk = palletpk 
	inner join tblcontainerouts as co on containeroutpk = eventfk 		
	inner join tblstockitems as s on s.stockitempk = pa.stockitemfk 	
	left outer join (
		Select users.UserPK, FirstName + ' ' + LastName as PersonName
		from tblPeople as people
		inner join tblUsers as users on users.PersonFK = people.PersonPK) createdbyuser on createdbyuser.UserPK = pa.updatedby  
	where pa.EventTypeFK = 29

	-- ---------------------------------------
	-- Return the final results to the report
	-- ---------------------------------------

	SELECT 'spReportsPalletHistory' AS 'FromTable', * from #finalResults order by eventdate asc,EventOrder asc

	SELECT * FROM #tblStockIns ORDER BY 2 ASC
	SELECT * FROM #tblStockInLines ORDER BY 2 ASC
	SELECT * FROM #tblStockInLinePallets ORDER BY 2 ASC
END
GO

-- ==============================================================================================================
-- Author:      Cathal OCuirrin
-- Create Date: 27 June 2019
-- Description: Returns all pallet audit and workordermovement record details combined and ordered by eventdate.
-- ==============================================================================================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[STA_GetStockInPalletAuditAndWorksOrderMovementDetails] --STA_GetStockInPalletAuditAndWorksOrderMovementDetails '2078230'
(
	@GoodsInNumber NVARCHAR(50)
)
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ UNCOMMITTED; SET DEADLOCK_PRIORITY LOW

	DECLARE @varGoodsInNumber NVARCHAR(50) = @GoodsInNumber

	-- 1. Get the Goods In Works Order Details.

	IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#GoodsInWorksOrderDetails') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #GoodsInWorksOrderDetails

	SELECT DISTINCT 
		ci.GoodsInNumber, 				
		'WorksOrderMovement' AS RecordType,
		--wo.WorksOrderPK, 
		wom.WorksOrderMovementPK AS PK, 
		woo.WorksOrderOrigin AS Origin,
		wot.WorksOrderType AS EventType,									
		wom.PalletFK, 
		plt.Barcode AS PalletBarcode,
		plt.CustomerBarcode AS PalletCustomerBarcode,				
		wom.UpdatedBy AS UserFK, 
		CAST(vud.EmployeeNumber AS NVARCHAR(50)) AS [EmployeeNumber],
		vud.EmployeeName AS [EmployeeName], 
		wom.UpdatedDate AS EventDateTime, 
		sourceLocationType.LocationType AS [FromLocationType],
		destinationLocationType.LocationType AS [ToLocationType],
		CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(200)) AS BuildingName,
		CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(50)) AS BuildingUnit, 
		CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(200)) AS Batch,
		CASE WHEN wom.MovementDescription LIKE '%hand%held%' THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS Scanned
	INTO 
		#GoodsInWorksOrderDetails
	FROM 
		dbo.tblWorksOrders wo				
	INNER JOIN dbo.tblWorksOrderMovements wom
		ON wo.WorksOrderPK = wom.WorksOrderFK
	INNER JOIN dbo.tblstockins si
		ON wo.FK = si.StockInPK
		AND wo.WorksOrderOriginFK = 1 /*StockIn*/
	INNER JOIN dbo.tblContainerIns ci
		ON si.ContainerInFK = ci.ContainerInPK
	LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.appWorksOrderOrigins woo
		ON wo.WorksOrderOriginFK = woo.WorksOrderOriginPK
	LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.appWorksOrderTypes wot
		ON wo.WorksOrderTypeFK = wot.WorksOrderTypePK
	LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.viewUserDetails vud
		ON wom.UpdatedBy = vud.UserPK
	LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.appLocationTypes sourceLocationType
		ON wom.SourceLocationTypeFK = sourceLocationType.LocationTypePK
	LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.appLocationTypes destinationLocationType
		ON wom.DestinationLocationTypeFK = destinationLocationType.LocationTypePK
	LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.tblPallets plt
		ON wom.PalletFK = plt.PalletPK
	WHERE 
		ci.GoodsInNumber = @varGoodsInNumber

	-- 2. Get the related Pallet Audit Details and return combine both sets of data and return.

	SELECT 
		* 
	FROM 
		#GoodsInWorksOrderDetails
	UNION
	SELECT DISTINCT 
		@GoodsInNumber AS GoodsInNumber, 
		'PalletAudit' AS RecordType,
		pa.PalletAuditPK AS PK, 
		NULL AS Origin, 
		paet.PalletAuditEventType AS EventType,
		pa.PalletFK,
		plt.Barcode AS PalletBarcode,
		plt.CustomerBarcode AS PalletCustomerBarcode,
		pa.InsertedBy AS UserFK,
		CAST(vud.EmployeeNumber AS NVARCHAR(50)) AS [EmployeeNumber],
		vud.EmployeeName AS [EmployeeName],	
		pa.EventDate AS EventDateTime,		
		NULL AS [FromLocationType],
		NULL AS [ToLocationType],
		bld.BuildingName, 
		bu.BuildingUnit, 
		pa.Batch,
		'Unknown' AS Scanned
	FROM 
		dbo.tblPalletAudit pa
	INNER JOIN #GoodsInWorksOrderDetails t1
		ON t1.PalletFK = pa.PalletFK
		AND CAST(t1.EventDateTime AS DATE) = CAST(pa.InsertedDate AS Date)
	LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.appPalletAuditEventTypes paet
		ON pa.EventTypeFK = paet.PalletAuditEventTypePK
	LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.tblBuildingUnits bu
		ON pa.BuildingUnitFK = bu.BuildingUnitPK
	LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.tblBuildings bld
		ON bu.BuildingFK = bld.BuildingPK
	LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.viewUserDetails vud
		ON pa.InsertedBy = vud.UserPK
	LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.tblPallets plt
		ON pa.PalletFK = plt.PalletPK
	ORDER BY 
		EventDateTime ASC
END
GO

-- ======================================================================================================================================================
-- Author:      Cathal OCuirrin
-- Create Date: 18 July 2018
-- Description: Returns stockorder, containerout, containeroutline, containeroutlinelinepallet, worksordermovement, worksorder, palletaudit, pallets,
-- palletcontent, stockdiscrepencypallet, integrationfilestockout and integrationfilestockoutline details for a goods/stock out/order number.
-- ======================================================================================================================================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[STA_GetStockOutDetails] -- STA_GetStockOutDetails '386323'
(
	@goodsOrderNumber INT = -1
)
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data; Ensure this proc has a low impact when executed */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED; SET DEADLOCK_PRIORITY LOW

	DECLARE @var_GoodsOrderNumber INT, @var_ContainerOutPK INT

	SET @var_GoodsOrderNumber = ISNULL(@goodsOrderNumber,-1)

	IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ContainerOuts') IS NOT NULL
		DROP TABLE #ContainerOuts

	SELECT * INTO #ContainerOuts 
	FROM dbo.tblContainerOuts 
	WHERE GoodsOrderNumber = @var_GoodsOrderNumber	

	SELECT @var_ContainerOutPK = ContainerOutPK 
	FROM #ContainerOuts

	IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#StockOrders') IS NOT NULL
		DROP TABLE #StockOrders

	SELECT 'tblStockOrders' AS [FromTable], SOS.StockOrderStatus, SO.* 
	INTO #StockOrders
	FROM dbo.tblStockOrders AS SO 
	INNER JOIN dbo.appStockOrderStatus AS SOS
	ON SO.StockOrderStatusFK = SOS.StockOrderStatusFK
	WHERE SO.ContainerOutFK = @var_ContainerOutPK

	SELECT * FROM #StockOrders
	ORDER BY 3 ASC

	SELECT 'tblContainerOuts' AS [FromTable], [COS].ContainerOutStatus, CO.* 
	FROM #ContainerOuts AS CO
	INNER JOIN dbo.appContainerOutStatus AS [COS]
	ON CO.ContainerOutStatusFK = [COS].ContainerOutStatusPK 
	ORDER BY 3 ASC

	IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ContainerOutLines') IS NOT NULL
		DROP TABLE #ContainerOutLines

	SELECT COL.* INTO #ContainerOutLines 
	FROM dbo.tblContainerOutLines AS COL 
	WHERE COL.ContainerOutFK = @var_ContainerOutPK

	SELECT 'tblContainerOutLines' AS [FromTable], * 
	FROM #ContainerOutLines
	ORDER BY 2 ASC

	IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ContainerOutLinePalletContent') IS NOT NULL
		DROP TABLE #ContainerOutLinePalletContent

	SELECT COLPC.* INTO #ContainerOutLinePalletContent
	FROM dbo.tblContainerOutLinePalletContent AS COLPC
	INNER JOIN #ContainerOutLines AS COL 
	ON COLPC.ContainerOutLineFK = COL.ContainerOutLinePK

	SELECT 'tblContainerOutLinePalletContent' AS [FromTable], * 
	FROM #ContainerOutLinePalletContent
	ORDER BY 2 ASC

	IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#WorksOrders') IS NOT NULL
		DROP TABLE #WorksOrders

	SELECT DISTINCT 'tblWorksOrders' AS [FromTable], WOS.WorksOrderStatus, WO.*
	INTO #WorksOrders
	FROM dbo.tblWorksOrders AS WO
	INNER JOIN #StockOrders SO
	ON wo.FK = so.StockOrderPK
	AND wo.WorksOrderOriginFK IN (2,3) /*StockOrder,StockOut*/
	INNER JOIN dbo.appWorksOrderStatus AS WOS
	ON WO.WorksOrderStatusFK = WOS.WorksOrderStatusPK 

	SELECT * FROM #WorksOrders ORDER BY 3 ASC

	IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#WorksOrderMovements') IS NOT NULL
		DROP TABLE #WorksOrderMovements

	SELECT DISTINCT 'tblWorksOrderMovements' AS FromTable, 
	CASE WHEN WOM.MovementDescription LIKE '%hand%held%' THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS Scanned,
	WOS.WorksOrderStatus, WOM.*
	INTO #WorksOrderMovements 
	FROM dbo.tblWorksOrderMovements AS WOM 
	INNER JOIN #WorksOrders AS WO 
	ON WOM.WorksOrderFK = WO.WorksOrderPK
	INNER JOIN dbo.appWorksOrderStatus AS WOS
	ON WOM.WorksOrderStatusFK = WOS.WorksOrderStatusPK
	UNION
	SELECT DISTINCT 'tblWorksOrderMovements' AS FromTable, 
	CASE WHEN WOM.MovementDescription LIKE '%hand%held%' THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS Scanned,
	WOS.WorksOrderStatus, WOM.* 
	FROM dbo.tblWorksOrderMovements AS WOM 
	INNER JOIN #ContainerOutLinePalletContent AS COLPC 
	ON WOM.ContainerOutLinePalletContentFK = COLPC.ContainerOutLinePalletContentPK
	INNER JOIN dbo.appWorksOrderStatus AS WOS
	ON WOM.WorksOrderStatusFK = WOS.WorksOrderStatusPK

	SELECT DISTINCT * FROM #WorksOrderMovements ORDER BY 4 ASC

	IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#Pallets') IS NOT NULL
		DROP TABLE #Pallets

	SELECT DISTINCT 'tblPallets' AS [FromTable], PLT.* 
	INTO #Pallets
	FROM dbo.tblPallets AS PLT
	INNER JOIN #ContainerOutLinePalletContent AS COLPC
	ON PLT.PalletPK = COLPC.PalletFK
	UNION
	SELECT DISTINCT 'tblPallets' AS [FromTable], PLT.* 
	FROM dbo.tblPallets AS PLT
	INNER JOIN #WorksOrderMovements AS WOM
	ON PLT.PalletPK = WOM.PalletFK

	SELECT DISTINCT *  FROM #Pallets ORDER BY 2 ASC

	SELECT DISTINCT 'tblPalletContent' AS [FromTable], PC.* 
	FROM #Pallets AS P
	INNER JOIN dbo.tblPalletContent AS PC
	ON P.PalletPK = PC.PalletFK
	ORDER BY 2 ASC

	SELECT DISTINCT 'tblPalletAudit' AS [FromTable], PAET.PalletAuditEventType, PA.* 
	FROM #Pallets AS P
	INNER JOIN dbo.tblPalletAudit AS PA
	ON P.PalletPK = PA.PalletFK
	INNER JOIN dbo.appPalletAuditEventTypes AS PAET
	ON PA.EventTypeFK = PAET.PalletAuditEventTypePK
	ORDER BY 3 ASC

	SELECT DISTINCT 'tblStockDiscrepencyPallets' AS [FromTable], SDP.* 
	FROM dbo.tblStockDiscrepencyPallets AS SDP 
	INNER JOIN #WorksOrderMovements AS WOM 
	ON SDP.PalletFK = WOM.PalletFK
	ORDER BY 2 ASC

	SELECT 'tblIntegrationFileStockOuts' AS [FromTable], * 
	FROM dbo.tblIntegrationFileStockOuts
	WHERE ContainerOutFK = @var_ContainerOutPK
	ORDER BY 2 ASC

	SELECT 'tblIntegrationFileStockOutLines' AS [FromTable], ISOFDL.* 
	FROM dbo.tblIntegrationFileStockOuts AS ISOFD
	INNER JOIN dbo.tblIntegrationFileStockOutLines AS ISOFDL
	ON ISOFD.IntegrationFileStockOutPK = ISOFDL.IntegrationFileStockOutFK
	INNER JOIN #ContainerOuts AS CO
	ON ISOFD.ContainerOutFK = CO.ContainerOutPK
	ORDER BY 2 ASC
END
GO

-- ==============================================================================================================
-- Author:      Cathal OCuirrin
-- Create Date: 27 June 2019
-- Description: Returns all pallet audit and workordermovement record details combined and ordered by eventdate.
-- ==============================================================================================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[STA_GetStockOutPalletAuditAndWorksOrderMovementDetails] --STA_GetStockOutPalletAuditAndWorksOrderMovementDetails '385025'
(
	@GoodsOrderNumber NVARCHAR(50)
)
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ UNCOMMITTED; SET DEADLOCK_PRIORITY LOW

	DECLARE @varGoodsOrderNumber NVARCHAR(50) = @GoodsOrderNumber

	-- 1. Get the Goods Order Works Order Details.

	IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#GoodsInWorksOrderDetails') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #GoodsInWorksOrderDetails

	SELECT DISTINCT 
		co.GoodsOrderNumber, 				
		'WorksOrderMovement' AS RecordType,
		--wo.WorksOrderPK, 
		wom.WorksOrderMovementPK AS PK, 
		woo.WorksOrderOrigin AS Origin,
		wot.WorksOrderType AS EventType,									
		wom.PalletFK, 
		plt.Barcode AS PalletBarcode,
		plt.CustomerBarcode AS PalletCustomerBarcode,				
		wom.UpdatedBy AS UserFK, 
		CAST(vud.EmployeeNumber AS NVARCHAR(50)) AS [EmployeeNumber],
		vud.EmployeeName AS [EmployeeName], 
		wom.UpdatedDate AS EventDateTime, 
		sourceLocationType.LocationType AS [FromLocationType],
		destinationLocationType.LocationType AS [ToLocationType],
		CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(200)) AS BuildingName,
		CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(50)) AS BuildingUnit, 
		CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(200)) AS Batch,
		CASE WHEN wom.MovementDescription LIKE '%hand%held%' THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS Scanned
	INTO 
		#GoodsInWorksOrderDetails
	FROM 
		dbo.tblWorksOrders wo				
	INNER JOIN dbo.tblWorksOrderMovements wom
		ON wo.WorksOrderPK = wom.WorksOrderFK
	INNER JOIN dbo.tblStockOrders so
		ON wo.FK = so.StockOrderPK
		AND wo.WorksOrderOriginFK = 2 /*StockOrder*/
	INNER JOIN dbo.tblContainerOuts co
		ON so.ContainerOutFK = co.ContainerOutPK
	LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.appWorksOrderOrigins woo
		ON wo.WorksOrderOriginFK = woo.WorksOrderOriginPK
	LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.appWorksOrderTypes wot
		ON wo.WorksOrderTypeFK = wot.WorksOrderTypePK
	LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.viewUserDetails vud
		ON wom.UpdatedBy = vud.UserPK
	LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.appLocationTypes sourceLocationType
		ON wom.SourceLocationTypeFK = sourceLocationType.LocationTypePK
	LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.appLocationTypes destinationLocationType
		ON wom.DestinationLocationTypeFK = destinationLocationType.LocationTypePK
	LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.tblPallets plt
		ON wom.PalletFK = plt.PalletPK
	WHERE 
		co.GoodsOrderNumber = @varGoodsOrderNumber

	-- 2. Get the related Pallet Audit Details and return combine both sets of data and return.

	SELECT 
		* 
	FROM 
		#GoodsInWorksOrderDetails
	UNION
	SELECT DISTINCT 
		@GoodsOrderNumber AS GoodsOrderNumber, 
		'PalletAudit' AS RecordType,
		pa.PalletAuditPK AS PK, 
		NULL AS Origin, 
		paet.PalletAuditEventType AS EventType,
		pa.PalletFK,
		plt.Barcode AS PalletBarcode,
		plt.CustomerBarcode AS PalletCustomerBarcode,
		pa.InsertedBy AS UserFK,
		CAST(vud.EmployeeNumber AS NVARCHAR(50)) AS [EmployeeNumber],
		vud.EmployeeName AS [EmployeeName],	
		pa.EventDate AS EventDateTime,		
		NULL AS [FromLocationType],
		NULL AS [ToLocationType],
		bld.BuildingName, 
		bu.BuildingUnit, 
		pa.Batch,
		'Unknown' AS Scanned
	FROM 
		dbo.tblPalletAudit pa
	INNER JOIN #GoodsInWorksOrderDetails t1
		ON t1.PalletFK = pa.PalletFK
		AND CAST(t1.EventDateTime AS DATE) = CAST(pa.InsertedDate AS Date)
	LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.appPalletAuditEventTypes paet
		ON pa.EventTypeFK = paet.PalletAuditEventTypePK
	LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.tblBuildingUnits bu
		ON pa.BuildingUnitFK = bu.BuildingUnitPK
	LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.tblBuildings bld
		ON bu.BuildingFK = bld.BuildingPK
	LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.viewUserDetails vud
		ON pa.InsertedBy = vud.UserPK
	LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.tblPallets plt
		ON pa.PalletFK = plt.PalletPK
	ORDER BY 
		EventDateTime ASC
END
GO

-- ==================================================================================
-- Author:      Cathal OCuirin
-- Create Date: 31 Oct 2018
-- Description: Returns usage stats for all stored procedures in the STAMS database.
-- ==================================================================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[STA_GetStoredProcedureUsageStats]
AS
    /* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Read data of any status without locking; Ensure this proc has a low impact when executed */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ UNCOMMITTED; SET DEADLOCK_PRIORITY LOW

	IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#Results') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #Results

	SELECT DISTINCT		
		db_name(st.dbid) AS [Database],
		object_name(st.objectid) AS [Stored Procedure],
		p.usecounts AS [Times Run],
		'Directly' AS [SP Executed]
	INTO
		#Results
	FROM 
		sys.dm_exec_cached_plans AS p
	CROSS APPLY sys.dm_exec_sql_text(p.plan_handle) AS st
	WHERE 
		p.objtype = 'proc'
		AND st.dbid = db_id('STAWMS')

	UNION

	SELECT 
		db_name() AS [Database],
		StoredProcedureName AS [Stored Procedure],
		TimesRun AS [Times Run],
		'Via spAppExecuteSQLCode' AS [SP Executed]		
	FROM 
		dbo.tblAppExecuteSQLCodeStoredProcedureStats
	--ORDER BY 
	--	[Times Run] DESC

	SELECT
		[Database],
		[Stored Procedure],
		[Times Run],
		MAX([SP Executed]) AS [SP Executed]
	FROM
		#Results
	GROUP BY
		[Database],
		[Stored Procedure],
		[Times Run]
	ORDER BY
		[Times Run] DESC
GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[STA_GetTableStats]    Script Date: 02/11/2026 17:47:28 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[STA_GetTableStats]
AS
BEGIN
	SELECT 
		t.NAME AS TableName,
		s.Name AS SchemaName,
		p.rows AS RowCounts,
		SUM(a.total_pages) * 8 AS TotalSpaceKB, 
		CAST(ROUND(((SUM(a.total_pages) * 8) / 1024.00), 2) AS NUMERIC(36, 2)) AS TotalSpaceMB,
		SUM(a.used_pages) * 8 AS UsedSpaceKB, 
		CAST(ROUND(((SUM(a.used_pages) * 8) / 1024.00), 2) AS NUMERIC(36, 2)) AS UsedSpaceMB, 
		(SUM(a.total_pages) - SUM(a.used_pages)) * 8 AS UnusedSpaceKB,
		CAST(ROUND(((SUM(a.total_pages) - SUM(a.used_pages)) * 8) / 1024.00, 2) AS NUMERIC(36, 2)) AS UnusedSpaceMB
	FROM 
		sys.tables t
	INNER JOIN      
		sys.indexes i ON t.OBJECT_ID = i.object_id
	INNER JOIN 
		sys.partitions p ON i.object_id = p.OBJECT_ID AND i.index_id = p.index_id
	INNER JOIN 
		sys.allocation_units a ON p.partition_id = a.container_id
	LEFT OUTER JOIN 
		sys.schemas s ON t.schema_id = s.schema_id
	WHERE 
		t.NAME NOT LIKE 'dt%' 
		AND t.is_ms_shipped = 0
		AND i.OBJECT_ID > 255 
	GROUP BY 
		t.Name, s.Name, p.Rows
	ORDER BY 
		p.rows desc	
END
GO

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[STA_GetWarehousingSalesDetail]
(
	@startdate datetime,	
	@enddate datetime
)
AS
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data; Ensure this proc has a low impact when executed */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED; SET DEADLOCK_PRIORITY LOW

	IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#InvoiceDetails') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #InvoiceDetails

	SELECT LTRIM(RTRIM(cust.CustomerName)) [Customer], 
		LTRIM(RTRIM(customercode)) [CustomerCode], 
		LTRIM(RTRIM(inv.InvoiceNumber)) [InvoiceNumber], 
		inv.InvoicePK, 
		til.BuildingUnitFK,
		FORMAT (inv.InvoiceToDate, 'dd/MM/yyyy ') [InvoiceDate], 
		inv.InvoiceToDate as [RawInvoiceDate],
		LTRIM(RTRIM(til.ChargeText)) [Description], 
		LTRIM(RTRIM(til.ChargeText1)) Amount, 
		LTRIM(RTRIM(til.ChargeText2)) [AmountDescription], 
		LTRIM(RTRIM(replace(replace(til.ChargeText3, '@', ''), '€', '') )) [Rate], 
		til.Charge [LineTotal], 
		--til.TaxRate [Tax Rate], 
		--til.Tax [TaxAmount],
		inv.Approved, inv.Exported
	INTO #InvoiceDetails
	FROM tblinvoices inv 
	INNER JOIN dbo.tblInvoiceLines til ON inv.invoicePK = til.InvoiceFK
	LEFT JOIN tbldivisions divs ON inv.divisionfk = divs.DivisionPK AND inv.divisionfk > 0
	inner JOIN tblcustomers cust ON (inv.divisionfk > 0 AND divs.customerfk = cust.customerpk) OR (inv.customerfk = cust.CustomerPK AND inv.customerfk > 0)
	--WHERE year(inv.InvoiceToDate) = 2020 AND month(inv.InvoiceToDate) IN (1,2) --AND inv.Approved=0 AND inv.Exported = 0
	WHERE inv.Approved=1 and inv.InvoiceToDate >= @startdate and inv.InvoiceToDate <= @enddate
	
	
	SELECT * FROM #InvoiceDetails
	ORDER BY [RawInvoiceDate], InvoiceNumber, CustomerCode
	SELECT sum([LineTotal]) FROM #InvoiceDetails
GO
