CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[STA_HSEOUTS] -- STA_MichaelsSupplierReport '20190401', '20190531', 'Glanbia Plant'
(
	@FromDate datetime,
	@ToDate datetime
)
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data; Ensure this proc has a low impact when executed */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED; SET DEADLOCK_PRIORITY LOW

	
declare @CustomerFK int = 609

 -- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters  
 DECLARE @var_CustomerFK int, @var_FromDate datetime, @var_ToDate datetime
  
 SET @var_CustomerFK = @CustomerFK; SET @var_FromDate = @FromDate; SET @var_ToDate = @ToDate; 

 --get all divisions for customer
 drop table if exists #tmpAllDivisions
 select divisionpk, DivisionCode into #tmpAllDivisions from tbldivisions where customerfk = @var_CustomerFK

 --get all container out lines for all divisions
 drop table if exists #tmpAllLines
 select * into #tmpAllLines from tblContainerOutLines inner join #tmpAllDivisions on DivisionFK = DivisionPK

 --get all orders for date range
 drop table if exists #tmpAllorders
   Select 
    divisions.DivisionCode,   
    StockItemCode,    
    cols.Units, 
	GoodsOrderNumber,
	containeroutpk,
	ContainerOutLinePK,
	CollectionDate,
	couts.Address1
	, couts.InsertedDate as OrderedDate,
	coalesce(do.OrderReference,'') as HSEOrderRef
	into #tmpAllorders
   From tblcontainerouts couts      
   Inner Join #tmpAllLines cols on cols.ContainerOutFK = cOuts.ContainerOutPK  
   Inner Join tblStockItems s on cols.stockitemfk = s.StockItemPK  
   inner join #tmpAllDivisions divisions on divisions.DivisionPK = s.DivisionFK 
   left join tblDistributionOrders do on couts.DistributionOrderFK = do.DistributionOrderPK
   Where  ContainerOutStatusFK = 5  and CollectionDate >= @var_FromDate and CollectionDate <= @var_ToDate
   
   --get all pallets on these orders
   --drop table if exists #allcolpcpallets
   --select distinct containeroutlinepalletcontentpk, containeroutlinefk, palletfk
   --into #allcolpcpallets
   --from tblcontaineroutlinepalletcontent colpc
   --inner join #tmpAllorders on containeroutlinefk = ContainerOutLinePK   

   --get pallet arrival date from audit
	--drop table if exists #allpallets
 --  select pa.palletfk, eventdate into #allpallets
	--from tblpalletaudit pa 
	--inner join #allcolpcpallets colpc on colpc.palletfk = pa.palletfk
 --  where eventtypefk = 1

   --combine all for results
   select distinct DivisionCode [Department], StockItemCode [Stock Code], cast(CollectionDate as date) as DateOut, cast(OrderedDate as date) as OrderedDate, Units [Units Fulfilled], GoodsOrderNumber, Address1 as [Customer Name], HSEOrderRef
   from #tmpAllorders co
   --inner join #allcolpcpallets colpc  on containeroutlinefk = ContainerOutLinePK   
   --inner join #allpallets pa on colpc.palletfk = pa.palletfk
   Order By DateOut, GoodsOrderNumber, DivisionCode, StockItemCode  

END

/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[STA_IntegrationFileStockOutLineTempFix]    Script Date: 02/11/2026 17:47:28 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[STA_IntegrationFileStockOutLineTempFix]
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data; Ensure this proc has a low impact when executed */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED; SET DEADLOCK_PRIORITY LOW

	IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#MatchingRecords') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #MatchingRecords

	SELECT 
		IFSOL.IntegrationFileStockOutLinePK, IFSOL.ContainerOutLineFK AS IFSOL_ContainerOutLineFK, IFSOL.QuantityOrdered, IFSOL.StockItemCode AS IFSOL_StockItemCode, IFSOL.FileBatch, IFSOL.STAWMSPalletStatusFK, COL.ContainerOutLinePK AS COL_ContainerOutLinePK, SUM(ISNULL(COLPC.Units,0)) AS COL_QuantityPicked, SO.StockItemCode AS COL_StockItemCode, COL.Batch AS COL_Batch, ISNULL(P.PalletStatusFK, -1) AS COL_PalletStatusFK
	INTO
		#MatchingRecords
    FROM 
		dbo.tblIntegrationFileStockOutLines AS IFSOL
	INNER JOIN dbo.tblContainerOutLines AS COL
		ON IFSOL.ContainerOutLineFK = COL.ContainerOutLinePK
    LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.tblContainerOutLinePalletContent AS COLPC 
		ON COL.ContainerOutLinePK = COLPC.ContainerOutLineFK 
    LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.tblPallets AS P 
		ON COLPC.palletfk = P.palletpk
    LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.tblStockItems AS SO 
		ON COL.StockItemFK = SO.StockItemPK 
		AND COL.DivisionFK = SO.DivisionFK
    LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.appPalletStatus AS PS 
		ON P.PalletStatusFK = PS.PalletStatusPK
    WHERE 
		ISNULL(IFSOL.FileBatch,'') NOT IN ('','NOBATCH')
		AND IFSOL.PickIsOk = 0
    GROUP BY 
		IFSOL.IntegrationFileStockOutLinePK, IFSOL.ContainerOutLineFK, IFSOL.QuantityOrdered, IFSOL.StockItemCode, IFSOL.FileBatch, IFSOL.STAWMSPalletStatusFK, COL.ContainerOutLinePK, SO.StockItemCode, COL.Batch, P.PalletStatusFK
	HAVING 
		SUM(ISNULL(COLPC.Units,0)) = IFSOL.QuantityOrdered 
		AND SO.StockItemCode = IFSOL.StockItemCode 
		AND COL.batch = IFSOL.FileBatch
		AND ISNULL(P.PalletStatusFK, -1) = IFSOL.STAWMSPalletStatusFK

	IF (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM #MatchingRecords) < 1 RETURN

	BEGIN TRANSACTION

		UPDATE a WITH (ROWLOCK)
		SET a.PickIsOk = 1,
		a.COLBatch = t.COL_Batch,
		a.COLPalletStatusFK = t.COL_PalletStatusFK,
		a.COLQuantityPicked = t.COL_QuantityPicked,
		a.COLStockItemCode = t.COL_StockItemCode
		FROM dbo.tblIntegrationFileStockOutLines AS A
		INNER JOIN #MatchingRecords as t
		on A.IntegrationFileStockOutLinePK = T.IntegrationFileStockOutLinePK
		WHERE A.PickIsOk = 0

	COMMIT TRANSACTION
END
GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[STA_MaintainErrorAndEventLogTablesInDevAndTestDbs]    Script Date: 02/11/2026 17:47:28 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO




-- ===========================================================================================================================================
-- Author:      Cathal OCuirrin
-- Create Date: 09 July 2018
-- Description: Deletes records over a month old from the tblErrorLog & tblEventLog tables when connected to the STAWMS dev or test database.
-- ===========================================================================================================================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[STA_MaintainErrorAndEventLogTablesInDevAndTestDbs]
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data; Ensure this proc has a low impact when executed */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED; SET DEADLOCK_PRIORITY LOW

	-- This ensures the deletes and table cleans are only done in the development and test databases.
	IF (SELECT CASE WHEN @@SERVERNAME = 'store-all-production' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS [OnProductionServer]) = 1 RETURN 

	DECLARE @DatabaseName NVARCHAR(200) = DB_Name();

	-- This ensures only data over a month old gets deleted and the deletion and table clean can only happen once a day.
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM [dbo].[tblEventLog] WHERE CAST(CONVERT(NVARCHAR(24), [Date], 112) AS DATETIME) <  DATEADD(MONTH, -1, CAST(CONVERT(NVARCHAR(24), dbo.GetBSTDate(), 112) AS DATETIME)))
	BEGIN
		DELETE FROM [dbo].[tblEventLog] WHERE CAST(CONVERT(NVARCHAR(24), [Date], 112) AS DATETIME) <  DATEADD(MONTH, -1, CAST(CONVERT(NVARCHAR(24), dbo.GetBSTDate(), 112) AS DATETIME))
		DBCC CLEANTABLE (@DatabaseName,'dbo.tblEventLog', 0) WITH NO_INFOMSGS;
	END
	
	-- This ensures only data over a month old gets deleted and the deletion and table clean can only happen once a day.
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM [dbo].[tblErrorLog] WHERE CAST(CONVERT(NVARCHAR(24), [InsertedDate], 112) AS DATETIME) <  DATEADD(MONTH, -1, CAST(CONVERT(NVARCHAR(24), dbo.GetBSTDate(), 112) AS DATETIME)))
	BEGIN
		DELETE FROM [dbo].[tblErrorLog] WHERE CAST(CONVERT(NVARCHAR(24), [InsertedDate], 112) AS DATETIME) <  DATEADD(MONTH, -1, CAST(CONVERT(NVARCHAR(24), dbo.GetBSTDate(), 112) AS DATETIME))
		DBCC CLEANTABLE (@DatabaseName,'dbo.tblErrorLog', 0) WITH NO_INFOMSGS
	END
END
GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[STA_MichaelsSupplierReport]    Script Date: 02/11/2026 17:47:28 ******/

GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[STA_MichaelsSupplierReport] -- STA_MichaelsSupplierReport '20190401', '20190531', 'Glanbia Plant'
(
	@StartDate DATETIME,
	@EndDate DATETIME,
	@SupplierName NVARCHAR(200) = 'Glanbia Plant'
)
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data; Ensure this proc has a low impact when executed */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED; SET DEADLOCK_PRIORITY LOW

	DECLARE @varStartDate DATETIME = @StartDate, @varEndDate DATETIME = DATEADD(DAY, 1, @EndDate), @varSupplierName NVARCHAR(200) = @SupplierName

	SELECT DISTINCT 
		bld.BuildingName + ' - ' + bu.BuildingUnit AS Warehouse, 
		ci.DateIn AS [Date], 
		ci.GoodsInNumber AS [Goods Order No.], 
		sup.Supplier AS Supplier, 
		ci.Free1 AS [Supplier Ref.]
	FROM 
		dbo.tblContainerIns ci WITH (NOLOCK)
	INNER JOIN dbo.tblBuildingUnits bu WITH (NOLOCK)
		ON ci.BuildingUnitFK = bu.BuildingUnitPK
	INNER JOIN dbo.tblBuildings bld WITH (NOLOCK)
		ON bu.BuildingFK = bld.BuildingPK
	LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.tblSuppliers sup WITH (NOLOCK)
		ON ci.SupplierFK = sup.SupplierPK
	WHERE 
		ci.StockInStatusFK = 3 /*Complete*/
		AND ci.DateIn >= @varStartDate 
		AND cI.DateIn < @varEndDate
		AND sup.Supplier = @varSupplierName
	ORDER BY 
		Warehouse ASC, 
		ci.DateIn ASC, 
		ci.GoodsInNumber ASC
END

-- =============================================
-- Author:      <Author, , Name>
-- Create Date: <Create Date, , >
-- Description: <Description, , >
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE  [dbo].[STA_RackingLabelCheckWF] 
(
    -- Add the parameters for the stored procedure here
    @buildingunit int, 
	@var_buildingUnitBayFKs nvarchar(1000) = ''
)
AS
BEGIN
    -- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from
    -- interfering with SELECT statements.
    SET NOCOUNT ON

    -- Insert statements for procedure here

drop table if exists #tmpresults
Select location, barcode, BuildingUnitColumn, BayLevel , Row
into #tmpresults
from (
	Select case when buRows.Translate = cast(1 as bit) then
		case when buRows.ReverseTranslate = cast(1 as bit) then
			buRows.TranslatedRow + right('0' + cast((buRows.TranslateColumn - buCols.BuildingUnitColumn) as nvarchar(10)),2) + case when buRows.RackingTypeFK = 1/*Conventional*/ then lower(buBays.BayLevel) /*+ right('0' + cast(pallets.BayPosition as nvarchar(10)),2)*/ else '' end
		else
			buRows.TranslatedRow + right('0' + cast((buCols.BuildingUnitColumn + buRows.TranslateColumn) as nvarchar(10)),2) + case when buRows.RackingTypeFK = 1/*Conventional*/ then lower(buBays.BayLevel) /*+ right('0' + cast(pallets.BayPosition as nvarchar(10)),2)*/  else '' end
		End
	else 
		buRows.Row + right('0' + cast(buCols.BuildingUnitColumnName as nvarchar(10)),2) + case when buRows.RackingTypeFK = 1/*Conventional*/ then lower(buBays.BayLevel) /*+ right('0' + cast(pallets.BayPosition as nvarchar(10)),2)*/ else '' end end as Location,
	barcode, buildingunitbaypk,
	baylevel, buildingunitcolumn, row , buBays.InsertedDate
	from tblBuildingUnitBays buBays
	inner join tblBuildingUnitColumns buCols on buCols.BuildingUnitColumnPK = buBays.BuildingUnitColumnFK
	inner join tblBuildingUnitRows buRows on buRows.BuildingUnitRowPK = buCols.BuildingUnitRowFK
	where buRows.BuildingUnitFK = @buildingunit
	 --and width > 0 
	--and baylevel     in ('a' ) 
	 --and Row= 'i' 
	 --and buildingunitcolumn = 13
	and (@var_buildingUnitBayFKs = '' or  (',' + @var_buildingUnitBayFKs + ',' LIKE '%,' + CONVERT(VARCHAR, buildingunitbaypk) + ',%'))
--	and buildingunitbaypk in (5526,5527,5533,5534)
)subQ
order by  row , buildingunitcolumn, baylevel

--if((select count(BayLevel) from  #tmpresults where BayLevel in ('A','B')) = 0)
--begin--not a/b locations
	select distinct r1.BuildingUnitColumn, r1.Location as ALocation, r1.Barcode as ABarcode, r1.Row
	from #tmpresults r1
--end 
--else
--begin--a/b locations
--	select distinct r1.BuildingUnitColumn, ra.Location as ALocation, ra.Barcode as ABarcode, rb.Location as BLocation, rb.Barcode as BBarcode, r1.Row
--	from #tmpresults r1
--	inner join #tmpresults ra on ra.BuildingUnitColumn = r1.BuildingUnitColumn and ra.Row = r1.Row and ra.BayLevel = 'A'
--	inner join #tmpresults rb on rb.BuildingUnitColumn = r1.BuildingUnitColumn and rb.Row = r1.Row and rb.BayLevel = 'B'
--	order by  row , buildingunitcolumn
--end          
END

-- =============================================================
-- Author:		Cathal OCuirrin
-- Create date: 05 Apr 2018
-- Description:	Returns material master details for a customer.
-- =============================================================

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[STA_ReportsCustomerMaterialMaster]
(		
	@CustomerName NVARCHAR(500)
)	
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data; Ensure this proc has a low impact when executed */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED; SET DEADLOCK_PRIORITY LOW

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT
	,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;
	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	DECLARE @var_CustomerName NVARCHAR(500)

	SET @var_CustomerName = @CustomerName

	SET @ParameterDetails = '@CustomerName = ' + ISNULL(@var_CustomerName,'')

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

	SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)

    INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
    SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

    SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY			

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start

			SELECT DISTINCT 
				d.DivisionCode AS 'Division Code', 
				d.DivisionName AS 'Division Name', 
				si.StockItemCode AS '(Stock) Item Code', 
				si.[description] AS '(Stock) Item Description',
				ut.unittype AS UOM,
				ISNULL(et.EachesType,'') AS 'Pack Type',
				pt.PalletType AS 'Pallet Type Code',
				pt.[Description] AS 'Pallet Type Description',
				CASE WHEN si.IsStackable = 0 THEN 'No' ELSE 'Yes' END AS 'Stackable'
			FROM 
				tblStockItems AS si
			INNER JOIN tbldivisions AS d
				ON si.divisionfk = d.divisionpk
			INNER JOIN tblcustomers AS c
				ON d.customerfk = c.customerpk
			LEFT OUTER JOIN tblUnitTypes AS ut
				ON si.unittypefk = ut.unittypepk
			LEFT OUTER JOIN [dbo].[tblEachesTypes] AS et
				ON si.eachestypefk = et.eachestypepk
			LEFT OUTER JOIN [dbo].[tblPalletTypes] AS pt
				ON si.defaultpallettypefk = pt.pallettypepk
			WHERE 
				c.customername LIKE '%' + @var_CustomerName + '%'

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - END			
						
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END

/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[STA_ReportsCustomerPalletsInOutHistory]    Script Date: 02/11/2026 17:47:28 ******/

-- ==================================================================================================
-- Author:		Cathal OCuirrin
-- Create date: 05 Apr 2018
-- Description:	Returns all pallets in and out history for a customer within a specified date range.
-- ==================================================================================================

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[STA_ReportsCustomerPalletsInOutHistory]
(		
	@CustomerName NVARCHAR(500),
	@StartDate DATETIME,
	@EndDate DATETIME
)	
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data; Ensure this proc has a low impact when executed */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED; SET DEADLOCK_PRIORITY LOW

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT
	,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;
	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	DECLARE @var_CustomerName NVARCHAR(500), @var_StartDate DATETIME, @var_EndDate DATETIME

	SET @var_CustomerName = @CustomerName; SET @var_StartDate = @StartDate; SET @var_EndDate = @EndDate

	SET @ParameterDetails = '@CustomerName = ' + ISNULL(@var_CustomerName,'') + ', @StartDate = ' + CAST(@var_StartDate AS NVARCHAR(50)) 
		+ ', @EndDate = ' + CAST(@var_EndDate AS NVARCHAR(50))

	IF @var_EndDate IS NOT NULL SET @var_EndDate = DATEADD(DAY,1,@var_EndDate)

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

	SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)

    INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
    SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

    SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY			

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start

			IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#TempPalletAudit') IS NOT NULL
				DROP TABLE #TempPalletAudit

			SELECT 
				pa.PalletAuditPK, pa.PalletFK, pa.StockItemFK, pa.Batch, pa.EventTypeFK, 
				pa.EventFK, pa.EventDate, pa.UpdatedBy, b.BuildingName
			INTO 
				#TempPalletAudit
			FROM 
				tblPalletaudit AS pa
			INNER JOIN tblStockItems AS si
				ON pa.StockItemFK = si.StockItemPK
			INNER JOIN tbldivisions AS d 
				ON si.divisionfk = d.divisionpk
			INNER JOIN tblcustomers AS c
				ON d.customerfk = c.customerpk
			INNER JOIN tblBuildingUnits AS bu
				ON pa.BuildingUnitFK = bu.BuildingUnitPK
			INNER JOIN tblBuildings AS b
				ON bu.buildingfk = b.buildingpk
			WHERE
				c.customername LIKE '%' + @var_CustomerName + '%'
				AND pa.EventDate >= @var_StartDate
				AND pa.EventDate < @var_EndDate

			IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#TempPallets') IS NOT NULL
				DROP TABLE #TempPallets
 
			SELECT 
				palletpk, CustomerBarcode, Barcode 
			INTO 
				#TempPallets 
			FROM 
				tblpallets AS P
			INNER JOIN #TempPalletAudit AS tpa
				ON p.palletpk = tpa.palletfk

			IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#TempStockItem') IS NOT NULL
				DROP TABLE #TempStockItem

			SELECT 
				si.StockItemPK, si.StockItemCode, si.[Description], si.divisionfk
			INTO
				#TempStockItem
			FROM 
				tblStockItems AS si
			INNER JOIN #TempPalletAudit AS tpa
				ON si.stockitempk = tpa.stockitemfk

			IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#TempColpc') IS NOT NULL
				DROP TABLE #TempColpc

			SELECT 
				ContainerOutLinePalletContentPK,  ContainerOutLineFK, PalletFk, Units, Inserteddate, UpdatedBy
			INTO 
				#TempColpc
			FROM 
				tblcontaineroutlinepalletcontent
			INNER JOIN #TempPallets 
				ON PalletFk = PalletPK

			IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#finalresults') IS NOT NULL
				DROP TABLE #finalresults

			-- --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
			-- Note: Creating the table here, instead of using INTO <tablename>, to prevent the string truncated error 
			-- which happens with the following INSERT INTO statements if INTO <tablename> is used.
			-- --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

			CREATE TABLE #finalresults
			(
				EventType NVARCHAR(1000),
				EventDate DATETIME,
				Eventuser NVARCHAR(1000),
				Units DECIMAL(18,3),
				[Event Description] NVARCHAR(1000),
				StockItemCode NVARCHAR(1000),
				StockItemDescription  NVARCHAR(1000),
				Barcode NVARCHAR(1000),
				EventOrder INT,
				DivisionCode NVARCHAR(1000),
				DivisionName NVARCHAR(1000),
				BuildingName NVARCHAR(1000),
				palletfk INT,
				Batch NVARCHAR(1000)
			)

			------------------
			-- Get pallets in
			------------------
			 
			INSERT INTO #finalresults
			SELECT DISTINCT 
				'Pallet Arrived' AS EventType, 
				pa.EventDate AS EventDate, 
				CASE WHEN createdbyuser.PersonName IS NULL THEN 'System' ELSE createdbyuser.PersonName END AS Eventuser,  
				sil.units AS Units, 
				'Pallet Arrived - Goods In Number: ' + si.GoodsInNumber AS [Description],
				s.stockitemcode,
				s.[description],
				CASE WHEN p.CustomerBarcode <> '' THEN p.CustomerBarcode ELSE p.Barcode END AS Barcode, 
				1 AS EventOrder,
				d.divisioncode,
				d.divisionname,
				pa.BuildingName,
				pa.palletfk,
				pa.Batch
			FROM 
				#TempPalletAudit AS pa  
			INNER JOIN tblstockinlinepallets AS silp 
				ON silp.palletfk = pa.palletfk  
			INNER JOIN tblstockinlines AS sil 
				ON sil.stockinlinepk = silp.stockinlinefk  
			INNER JOIN tblstockins AS si 
				ON si.stockinpk = sil.stockinfk
			INNER JOIN #TempStockItem AS s 
				ON s.stockitempk = pa.stockitemfk
			INNER JOIN #TempPallets AS p 
				ON p.palletpk = pa.palletfk
			LEFT OUTER JOIN (
								SELECT users.UserPK, FirstName + ' ' + LastName AS PersonName
								FROM tblPeople AS people
								INNER JOIN tblUsers AS users 
								ON users.PersonFK = people.PersonPK
							) AS createdbyuser 
				ON createdbyuser.UserPK = pa.updatedby
			INNER JOIN tblDivisions AS d
				ON s.divisionfk = d.divisionpk
			WHERE 
				pa.EventTypeFK = 1 
				AND NOT EXISTS -- Pallets out only, no transferred pallets.
				(
					SELECT * FROM tblstocktransfers AS st
					WHERE si.ContainerinFK = st.ContainerinFK
				)

			-------------------
			-- Get pallets out
			-------------------

			INSERT INTO #finalresults
			SELECT DISTINCT  
				'Pallet Gone' AS EventType, 
				pa.eventdate AS EventDate, 
				CASE WHEN createdbyuser.PersonName IS NULL THEN 'System' ELSE createdbyuser.PersonName END AS Eventuser, 
				colpc.units AS Units, 
				'Pallet gone ON Goods Order ' + co.goodsordernumber + 'v' + CONVERT(varchar(10), co.versionnumber) AS [Description],
				s.stockitemcode,
				s.[description], 
				CASE WHEN p.CustomerBarcode <> '' THEN p.CustomerBarcode ELSE p.Barcode END AS Barcode, 
				2 AS EventOrder,
				d.divisioncode,
				d.divisionname,
				pa.BuildingName,
				pa.palletfk,
				pa.Batch
			FROM 
				#TempPalletAudit AS pa  
			INNER JOIN tblcontaineroutlines AS col 
				ON pa.eventfk = col.containeroutlinepk
			INNER JOIN #TempColpc AS colpc 
				ON colpc.containeroutlinefk = col.containeroutlinepk  
				AND pa.palletfk = colpc.palletfk
			INNER JOIN tblcontainerouts AS co 
				ON co.containeroutpk = col.containeroutfk
			INNER JOIN #TempStockItem AS s 
				ON s.stockitempk = pa.stockitemfk
			INNER JOIN #TempPallets AS p 
				ON p.palletpk = pa.palletfk
			LEFT OUTER JOIN (
								SELECT users.UserPK, FirstName + ' ' + LastName AS PersonName
								FROM tblPeople AS people
								INNER JOIN tblUsers AS users 
								ON users.PersonFK = people.PersonPK
							) AS createdbyuser 
				ON createdbyuser.UserPK = pa.updatedby  
			INNER JOIN tblDivisions AS d
				ON s.divisionfk = d.divisionpk
			WHERE 
				pa.EventTypeFK = 2
				AND NOT EXISTS -- Pallets out only, no transferred pallets.
				(
					SELECT * FROM tblstocktransfers AS st
					WHERE co.ContainerOutPK = st.ContainerOutFK
				)

			-- -------------------------
			-- Return the final results
			-- -------------------------

			-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
			-- Note: Since this is not (currently) associated with a report any front end application,
			-- there is no order specified as the results are intended to be copied into Excel where the
			-- data can be sorted in any way that's required. However the sort order (and columns returned)
			-- can obviously be changed in this stored procedure in future if needs be.
			-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

			SELECT
				DivisionCode,
				DivisionName,
				StockItemCode AS '(Stock) Item Code',
				StockItemDescription AS '(Stock) Item Description',
				CASE WHEN EventType = 'Pallet Arrived' THEN 'In' ELSE 'Out' END AS 'Event Type',
				EventDate AS 'Event/Transaction Date',
				[Event Description], 
				SUM(Units) AS 'Trans Quantity',
				COUNT(PalletFK) AS 'Number of Pallets',
				Barcode AS 'SSCC/Customer Barcode',
				Batch,
				BuildingName AS 'WH name/Designation'
			FROM 
				#finalresults
			GROUP BY 
				DivisionCode,
				DivisionName,
				StockItemCode,
				StockItemDescription,
				EventType,
				EventDate,
				[Event Description], 
				Barcode,
				Batch,
				BuildingName

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - END			
						
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END

-- =============================================
-- Author:      <Charlene Gordon>
-- Create Date: <06/09/2023 >
-- Description: <Scanning Data>
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[STA_ScanningData]
(		
	@StartDate DATETIME,
	@EndDate DATETIME
)
AS

BEGIN
     SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED; SET DEADLOCK_PRIORITY LOW

select distinct WorksOrderType, UserName, ActivityDate, sum(minsActive) minsActive, docketno, Building, Person, startdate--, PalletFK
from (
    select WorksOrderType, username, cast(wout.startdate as date) ActivityDate, wout.startdate, wout.enddate,-- wom.palletfk,
	case when datediff(minute, wout.startdate, wout.enddate) = 0 then 1 else datediff(minute, wout.startdate, wout.enddate) end MinsActive,
        case when wo.WorksOrderTypeFK in (35,36) then ci.GoodsInNumber when wo.WorksOrderTypeFK in (31,32) 
		then 'G-' +cast(sig.StockInGroupPK as nvarchar(50)) 
		when wo.WorksOrderTypeFK = 37 
		then co.GoodsOrderNumber else '' end as DocketNo,
        b.BuildingName + '  ' + bu.BuildingUnit as Building, p.firstName + ' ' + P.LastName as Person
    from tblworksorders wo
    left join appWorksOrderTypes wot on wo.WorksOrderTypeFK = wot.WorksOrderTypePK
    inner join tblWorksOrderUsers wou on wo.worksorderpk = wou.worksorderfk
    inner join tblWorksOrderUserTime wout on wou.WorksOrderUserspk = wout.WorksOrderUsersFk
    left outer join tblcontainerins ci on ci.ContainerInPK = wo.fk and wo.WorksOrderTypeFK in (35,36)
    left outer join tblStockInGroups sig on sig.StockInGroupPK = wo.fk and wo.WorksOrderTypeFK in (31,32)
    left outer join tblcontainerouts co on co.ContainerOutPK = wo.fk and wo.WorksOrderTypeFK = 37
    inner join tblusers u on wou.userfk = u.userpk
    left join tblbuildingunits bu on wo.BuildingUnitFK = bu.BuildingUnitPK
    inner join tblbuildings b on bu.BuildingFK = b.BuildingPK
	Inner Join tblpeople p on u.PersonFK = p.PersonPK
	--left join tblWorksOrderMovements wom on wo.WorksOrderPK = wom.WorksOrderFK
    where wout.InsertedDate >= @StartDate and wout.InsertedDate <= @EndDate
--    order by startdate asc
)subq
group by WorksOrderType, username, ActivityDate, docketno, Building, Person, StartDate--, PalletFK
order by Building, ActivityDate, username
   
END

BEGIN

select distinct ActivityDate, sum(minsActive) minsActive, Building, count(distinct Person) NoPeople
from (
    select WorksOrderType, username, cast(wout.startdate as date) ActivityDate, wout.startdate, wout.enddate,-- wom.palletfk,
	case when datediff(minute, wout.startdate, wout.enddate) = 0 then 1 else datediff(minute, wout.startdate, wout.enddate) end MinsActive,
        case when wo.WorksOrderTypeFK in (35,36) then ci.GoodsInNumber when wo.WorksOrderTypeFK in (31,32) 
		then 'G-' +cast(sig.StockInGroupPK as nvarchar(50)) 
		when wo.WorksOrderTypeFK = 37 
		then co.GoodsOrderNumber else '' end as DocketNo,
        b.BuildingName + '  ' + bu.BuildingUnit as Building, p.firstName + ' ' + P.LastName as Person
    from tblworksorders wo
    left join appWorksOrderTypes wot on wo.WorksOrderTypeFK = wot.WorksOrderTypePK
    inner join tblWorksOrderUsers wou on wo.worksorderpk = wou.worksorderfk
    inner join tblWorksOrderUserTime wout on wou.WorksOrderUserspk = wout.WorksOrderUsersFk

    left outer join tblStockInGroups sig on sig.StockInGroupPK = wo.fk and wo.WorksOrderTypeFK in (31,32)

group by ActivityDate, Building

SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO







CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[STA_SearchAllDataForText]
(
    @SearchStr nvarchar(100)
)
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements and only read data, do not lock in anyway */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ UNCOMMITTED; SET DEADLOCK_PRIORITY LOW

    CREATE TABLE #Results (ColumnName nvarchar(370), ColumnValue nvarchar(3630))

    SET NOCOUNT ON

    DECLARE @TableName nvarchar(256), @ColumnName nvarchar(128), @SearchStr2 nvarchar(110)
    SET  @TableName = ''
    SET @SearchStr2 = QUOTENAME('%' + @SearchStr + '%','''')

    WHILE @TableName IS NOT NULL

    BEGIN
        SET @ColumnName = ''
        SET @TableName = 
        (
            SELECT MIN(QUOTENAME(TABLE_SCHEMA) + '.' + QUOTENAME(TABLE_NAME))
            FROM     INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES
            WHERE         TABLE_TYPE = 'BASE TABLE'
                AND    QUOTENAME(TABLE_SCHEMA) + '.' + QUOTENAME(TABLE_NAME) > @TableName
                AND    OBJECTPROPERTY(
                        OBJECT_ID(
                            QUOTENAME(TABLE_SCHEMA) + '.' + QUOTENAME(TABLE_NAME)
                             ), 'IsMSShipped'
                               ) = 0
        )

        WHILE (@TableName IS NOT NULL) AND (@ColumnName IS NOT NULL)

        BEGIN
            SET @ColumnName =
            (
                SELECT MIN(QUOTENAME(COLUMN_NAME))
                FROM     INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS
                WHERE         TABLE_SCHEMA    = PARSENAME(@TableName, 2)
                    AND    TABLE_NAME    = PARSENAME(@TableName, 1)
                    AND    DATA_TYPE IN ('char', 'varchar', 'nchar', 'nvarchar', 'int', 'decimal')
                    AND    QUOTENAME(COLUMN_NAME) > @ColumnName
            )

            IF @ColumnName IS NOT NULL
            BEGIN
                INSERT INTO #Results
                EXEC
                (
                    'SELECT ''' + @TableName + '.' + @ColumnName + ''', LEFT(' + @ColumnName + ', 3630) 
                    FROM ' + @TableName + ' WITH (NOLOCK) ' +
                    ' WHERE ' + @ColumnName + ' LIKE ' + @SearchStr2
                )
            END
        END    
    END

    SELECT DISTINCT ColumnName, ColumnValue FROM #Results ORDER BY ColumnName, ColumnValue
END
GO

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[STA_SIT2383_DuplicateDataFix]
AS
BEGIN
	-- ==========================================================================================================================================
	-- STOCK IN SECTION
	-- ==========================================================================================================================================

	--select * into dbo.tblReportsDivisionDailyStockInSummary_CATHALBACKUP_20200722 from dbo.tblReportsDivisionDailyStockInSummary with (nolock)

	drop table if exists #stockInResults

	select
		count(distinct DailyStockInSummaryPK) as PKCount, BuildingUnitFK, BuildingFK, DivisionFK, SupplierTypeFK, DocketsIn, PalletsIn,	ForDate
	into
		#stockInResults
	from 
		dbo.tblReportsDivisionDailyStockInSummary t1 with (nolock)
	group by
		BuildingUnitFK, BuildingFK, DivisionFK, SupplierTypeFK, DocketsIn, PalletsIn, ForDate
	having 
		count(distinct DailyStockInSummaryPK) > 1

	--select * from #stockInResults order by 8 asc, 2 asc, 3 asc, 4 asc, 5 asc

	drop table if exists #stockInResults2

	select
		t1.DailyStockInSummaryPK, t1.BuildingUnitFK, t1.BuildingFK, t1.DivisionFK, t1.SupplierTypeFK, t1.DocketsIn, t1.PalletsIn, t1.ForDate
	into
		#stockInResults2
	from 
		dbo.tblReportsDivisionDailyStockInSummary t1 with (nolock)
	inner join #stockInResults t2
		on t1.BuildingUnitFK = t2.BuildingUnitFK
		and t1.BuildingFK = t2.BuildingFK
		and t1.DivisionFK = t2.DivisionFK
		and t1.SupplierTypeFK = t2.SupplierTypeFK
		and t1.DocketsIn = t2.DocketsIn
		and t1.PalletsIn = t2.PalletsIn
		and t1.ForDate = t2.ForDate

	--select * from #stockInResults2 order by 8 asc, 2 asc, 3 asc, 4 asc, 5 asc

	drop table if exists #stockInResults3

	select
		min(t1.DailyStockInSummaryPK) as MinDailyStockInSummaryPK, t1.BuildingUnitFK, t1.BuildingFK, t1.DivisionFK, t1.SupplierTypeFK, t1.DocketsIn, t1.PalletsIn, t1.ForDate
	into
		#stockInResults3
	from
		#stockInResults2 t1
	group by		
		BuildingUnitFK, BuildingFK, DivisionFK, SupplierTypeFK, DocketsIn, PalletsIn, ForDate

	--select * from #stockInResults3 order by 8 asc, 2 asc, 3 asc, 4 asc, 5 asc

	begin try
		begin transaction zzssddffyyoo

			delete t1
			from dbo.tblReportsDivisionDailyStockInSummary t1
			inner join #stockInResults3 t2
			on t1.DailyStockInSummaryPK = t2.MinDailyStockInSummaryPK

		commit transaction zzssddffyyoo
	end try
	begin catch

		print error_message()
		select error_message() as err_msg
		rollback transaction zzssddffyyoo

	end catch

	select
		count(distinct DailyStockInSummaryPK) as DailyStockInSummaryPKCount, BuildingUnitFK, BuildingFK, DivisionFK, SupplierTypeFK, DocketsIn, PalletsIn,	ForDate
	from 
		dbo.tblReportsDivisionDailyStockInSummary t1 with (nolock)
	group by
		BuildingUnitFK, BuildingFK, DivisionFK, SupplierTypeFK, DocketsIn, PalletsIn, ForDate
	having 
		count(distinct DailyStockInSummaryPK) > 1

	-- ==========================================================================================================================================
	-- STOCK OUT SECTION
	-- ==========================================================================================================================================

	--select * into dbo.tblReportsDivisionDailyStockOutSummary_CATHALBACKUP_20200722 from dbo.tblReportsDivisionDailyStockOutSummary with (nolock)

	drop table if exists #stockOutResults

	select
		count(distinct DailyStockOutSummaryPK) as PKCount, BuildingUnitFK, BuildingFK, DivisionFK, DeliveryTypeFK, DocketsOut, PalletsOut,	ForDate
	into
		#stockOutResults
	from 
		dbo.tblReportsDivisionDailyStockOutSummary t1 with (nolock)
	group by
		BuildingUnitFK, BuildingFK, DivisionFK, DeliveryTypeFK, DocketsOut, PalletsOut, ForDate
	having 
		count(distinct DailyStockOutSummaryPK) > 1

	--select * from #stockOutResults order by 8 asc, 2 asc, 3 asc, 4 asc, 5 asc

	drop table if exists #stockOutResults2

	select
		t1.DailyStockOutSummaryPK, t1.BuildingUnitFK, t1.BuildingFK, t1.DivisionFK, t1.DeliveryTypeFK, t1.DocketsOut, t1.PalletsOut, t1.ForDate
	into
		#stockOutResults2
	from 
		dbo.tblReportsDivisionDailyStockOutSummary t1 with (nolock)
	inner join #stockOutResults t2
		on t1.BuildingUnitFK = t2.BuildingUnitFK
		and t1.BuildingFK = t2.BuildingFK
		and t1.DivisionFK = t2.DivisionFK
		and t1.DeliveryTypeFK = t2.DeliveryTypeFK
		and t1.DocketsOut = t2.DocketsOut
		and t1.PalletsOut = t2.PalletsOut
		and t1.ForDate = t2.ForDate

	--select * from #stockOutResults2 order by 8 asc, 2 asc, 3 asc, 4 asc, 5 asc

	drop table if exists #stockOutResults3

	select
		min(t1.DailyStockOutSummaryPK) as MinDailyStockOutSummaryPK, t1.BuildingUnitFK, t1.BuildingFK, t1.DivisionFK, t1.DeliveryTypeFK, t1.DocketsOut, t1.PalletsOut, t1.ForDate
	into
		#stockOutResults3
	from
		#stockOutResults2 t1
	group by		
		BuildingUnitFK, BuildingFK, DivisionFK, DeliveryTypeFK, DocketsOut, PalletsOut, ForDate

	--select * from #stockOutResults3 order by 8 asc, 2 asc, 3 asc, 4 asc, 5 asc

	begin try
		begin transaction zzssddffyyooppkk

			delete t1
			from dbo.tblReportsDivisionDailyStockOutSummary t1
			inner join #stockOutResults3 t2
			on t1.DailyStockOutSummaryPK = t2.MinDailyStockOutSummaryPK

		commit transaction zzssddffyyooppkk
	end try
	begin catch

		print error_message()
		select error_message() as err_msg
		rollback transaction zzssddffyyooppkk

	end catch

	select
		count(distinct DailyStockOutSummaryPK) as DailyStockOutSummaryPKCount, BuildingUnitFK, BuildingFK, DivisionFK, DeliveryTypeFK, DocketsOut, PalletsOut,	ForDate
	from 
		dbo.tblReportsDivisionDailyStockOutSummary t1 with (nolock)
	group by
		BuildingUnitFK, BuildingFK, DivisionFK, DeliveryTypeFK, DocketsOut, PalletsOut, ForDate
	having 
		count(distinct DailyStockOutSummaryPK) > 1

	-- ==========================================================================================================================================
	-- STOCK LEVELS SECTION
	-- ==========================================================================================================================================

	--select * into dbo.tblReportsDivisionDailyStockLevels_CATHALBACKUP_20200722 from dbo.tblReportsDivisionDailyStockLevels with (nolock)

	drop table if exists #stockLevelsResults

	select
		count(distinct DailyStockLevelPK) as PKCount, BuildingUnitFK, DivisionFK, PalletStatusFK, PalletTypeFK,	LocationTypeFK,	NoPallets, ForDate,	PalletsIn, PalletsOut
	into
		#stockLevelsResults
	from 
		dbo.tblReportsDivisionDailyStockLevels t1 with (nolock)
	group by
		BuildingUnitFK,	DivisionFK,	PalletStatusFK,	PalletTypeFK,	LocationTypeFK,	NoPallets,	ForDate,	PalletsIn,	PalletsOut
	having 
		count(distinct DailyStockLevelPK) > 1

	--select * from #stockLevelsResults order by 8 asc, 2 asc, 3 asc, 4 asc, 5 asc, 6 asc

	drop table if exists #stockLevelsResults2

	select
		t1.DailyStockLevelPK, t1.BuildingUnitFK, t1.DivisionFK,	t1.PalletStatusFK, t1.PalletTypeFK, t1.LocationTypeFK, t1.NoPallets, t1.ForDate, t1.PalletsIn, t1.PalletsOut
	into
		#stockLevelsResults2
	from 
		dbo.tblReportsDivisionDailyStockLevels t1 with (nolock)
	inner join #stockLevelsResults t2
		on t1.BuildingUnitFK = t2.BuildingUnitFK
		and t1.DivisionFK = t2.DivisionFK
		and t1.PalletStatusFK = t2.PalletStatusFK
		and t1.PalletTypeFK = t2.PalletTypeFK
		and t1.LocationTypeFK = t2.LocationTypeFK
		and t1.NoPallets = t2.NoPallets
		and t1.ForDate = t2.ForDate
		and t1.PalletsIn = t2.PalletsIn
		and t1.PalletsOut = t2.PalletsOut

	--select * from #stockLevelsResults2 order by 8 asc, 2 asc, 3 asc, 4 asc, 5 asc, 6 asc

	drop table if exists #stockLevelsResults3

	select
		min(t1.DailyStockLevelPK) as MinDailyStockLevelPK, t1.BuildingUnitFK, t1.DivisionFK, t1.PalletStatusFK, t1.PalletTypeFK, t1.LocationTypeFK, t1.NoPallets, t1.ForDate, t1.PalletsIn, t1.PalletsOut
	into
		#stockLevelsResults3
	from
		#stockLevelsResults2 t1
	group by		
		t1.BuildingUnitFK, t1.DivisionFK, t1.PalletStatusFK, t1.PalletTypeFK, t1.LocationTypeFK, t1.NoPallets, t1.ForDate, t1.PalletsIn, t1.PalletsOut

	--select * from #stockLevelsResults3 order by 8 asc, 2 asc, 3 asc, 4 asc, 5 asc, 6 asc

	begin try
		begin transaction aaddggjjllqqvv

			delete t1
			from dbo.tblReportsDivisionDailyStockLevels t1
			inner join #stockLevelsResults3 t2
			on t1.DailyStockLevelPK = t2.MinDailyStockLevelPK

		commit transaction aaddggjjllqqvv
	end try
	begin catch

		print error_message()
		select error_message() as err_msg
		rollback transaction aaddggjjllqqvv

	end catch

	select
		count(distinct t1.DailyStockLevelPK) as DailyStockLevelPKCount, t1.BuildingUnitFK, t1.DivisionFK, t1.PalletStatusFK, t1.PalletTypeFK, t1.LocationTypeFK, t1.NoPallets, t1.ForDate, t1.PalletsIn, t1.PalletsOut
	from 
		dbo.tblReportsDivisionDailyStockLevels t1 with (nolock)
	group by
		t1.BuildingUnitFK, t1.DivisionFK, t1.PalletStatusFK, t1.PalletTypeFK, t1.LocationTypeFK, t1.NoPallets, t1.ForDate, t1.PalletsIn, t1.PalletsOut
	having 
		count(distinct t1.DailyStockLevelPK) > 1

END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[STA_StockInYearToDate] -- STA_MichaelsSupplierReport '20190401', '20190531', 'Glanbia Plant'
(
	@StartDate DATETIME
)
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data; Ensure this proc has a low impact when executed */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED; SET DEADLOCK_PRIORITY LOW

	
		DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #allstockins
		SELECT * into #allstockins FROM tblstockins WHERE dbo.tblstockins.DivisionFK IN (624,625) AND inserteddate >= @StartDate

		DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #allcontainers
		SELECT distinct ci.* INTO #allcontainers FROM tblcontainerins ci INNER JOIN #allstockins ON containerinfk = containerinpk

		DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #allstockinlines
		SELECT sil.* into #allstockinlines FROM tblstockinlines sil INNER JOIN #allstockins ON stockinfk = stockinpk 

		DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #allstockinlinePallets
		SELECT silp.* into #allstockinlinePallets FROM tblstockinlinepallets silp INNER JOIN #allstockinlines ON stockinlinefk = stockinlinepk 

		DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #StockInPallets
		SELECT distinct stockinfk, count(distinct palletfk) NoPallets 
		INTO #StockInPallets 
		FROM #allstockinlines sil
		INNER JOIN #allstockinlinePallets silp ON stockinlinefk = stockinlinepk
		GROUP BY stockinfk


		SELECT DivisionName, bld.BuildingName, day(si.ArrivalDate) AS [Day], Month(si.ArrivalDate) AS [Month], year(si.ArrivalDate) AS [Year], 
			 convert(varchar, si.ArrivalDate, 103) ArrivalDate, ci.Free1 AS [Reference], ci.GoodsInNumber, convert(varchar, si.InsertedDate, 103) InsertedDate, case when sip.NoPallets IS NULL THEN 'Pending Headers' ELSE cast(sip.NoPallets AS nvarchar (20)) end as [No Pallets], datediff(d,si.ArrivalDate, si.inserteddate) [Days Between]
		--ci.ContainerInPK, ci.GoodsInNumber, sip.NoPallets
		FROM #allstockins si
		LEFT JOIN #StockInPallets sip ON si.stockinpk = sip.stockinfk
		inner JOIN #allcontainers ci ON si.containerinfk = ci.containerinpk
		INNER JOIN dbo.tblBuildingUnits bu WITH (NOLOCK) ON ci.BuildingUnitFK = bu.BuildingUnitPK
		INNER JOIN dbo.tblBuildings bld WITH (NOLOCK) ON bu.BuildingFK = bld.BuildingPK
		INNER JOIN tbldivisions d ON d.divisionpk = si.DivisionFK
		WHERE si.StockInStatusFK IN (2,3)-- sip.stockinfk IS null
		ORDER BY si.ArrivalDate

		--SELECT * FROM dbo.appStockInStatus asis

END

GO

-- ======================================================================================================================================================
-- Author:      Cathal OCuirrin
-- Create Date: 18 July 2018
-- Description: Returns stockorder, containerout, containeroutline, containeroutlinelinepallet, worksordermovement, worksorder, palletaudit, pallets,
-- palletcontent, stockdiscrepencypallet, integrationfilestockout and integrationfilestockoutline details for a goods/stock out/order number.
-- ======================================================================================================================================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[STA_TableSizes] -- STA_GetStockOutDetails '386323'
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data; Ensure this proc has a low impact when executed */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED; SET DEADLOCK_PRIORITY LOW

	SELECT 
		t.NAME AS TableName,
		p.rows,
		CAST(ROUND(((SUM(a.total_pages) * 8) / 1024.00), 2) AS NUMERIC(36, 2)) AS TotalSpaceMB,
		CAST(ROUND(((SUM(a.used_pages) * 8) / 1024.00), 2) AS NUMERIC(36, 2)) AS UsedSpaceMB, 
		CAST(ROUND(((SUM(a.total_pages) - SUM(a.used_pages)) * 8) / 1024.00, 2) AS NUMERIC(36, 2)) AS UnusedSpaceMB
	FROM 
		sys.tables t
	INNER JOIN      
		sys.indexes i ON t.OBJECT_ID = i.object_id
	INNER JOIN 
		sys.partitions p ON i.object_id = p.OBJECT_ID AND i.index_id = p.index_id
	INNER JOIN 
		sys.allocation_units a ON p.partition_id = a.container_id
	LEFT OUTER JOIN 
		sys.schemas s ON t.schema_id = s.schema_id
	WHERE 
		t.NAME NOT LIKE 'dt%' 
		AND t.is_ms_shipped = 0
		AND i.OBJECT_ID > 255 
	GROUP BY 
		t.Name, s.Name, p.Rows
	ORDER BY 
		TotalSpaceMB desc, t.Name
END


GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[STA_UnconfirmUpTimeLogsData]    Script Date: 02/11/2026 17:47:28 ******/

SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON

-- =============================================
-- Author:      Cathal O Cuirrin
-- Create Date: 02 September 2020
-- Description: Unconfirms Uptime Logs data.
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[STA_UnconfirmUpTimeLogsData]
(
--declare /* for testing */
	@buildingName nvarchar(300),
	@uptimeLogDate date

	--select @buildingName = 'Six Cross Roads', @uptimeLogDate = '2020-08-31' /* for testing */
)
AS
BEGIN
	/*
	Following results from dbo.spGetUserBuildings as of 02 September 2020.

	BuildingPK	BuildingName
	21			BV1
	2			BV2
	50			BV3
	11			BV4
	30			BV5
	48			Carrick-on-Suir
	36			Cork Road
	38			Dungarvan
	8888		IT
	8			Kilcohan
	25			Northern Extension
	9999		Quality
	22			Six Cross Roads
	24			Slieverue
	1			Transport
	*/

	declare @varBuildingName nvarchar(300) = @buildingName, @varUptimeLogDate date = @uptimeLogDate, @varBuildingFK int = -1

	set @varBuildingFK = (select
							case
								when @varBuildingName = 'bv1' then 21
								when @varBuildingName = 'bv2' then 2
								when @varBuildingName = 'bv3' then 50
								when @varBuildingName = 'bv4' then 11
								when @varBuildingName = 'bv5' then 30
								when @varBuildingName = 'Carrick-on-Suir' then 48
								when @varBuildingName = 'Cork Road' then 36
								when @varBuildingName = 'Dungarvan' then 38
								when @varBuildingName = 'IT' then 8888
								when @varBuildingName = 'Kilcohan' then 8
								when @varBuildingName = 'Northern Extension' then 25
								when @varBuildingName = 'Quality' then 9999
								when @varBuildingName = 'Six Cross Roads' then 22
								when @varBuildingName = 'Slieverue' then 24
								when @varBuildingName = 'Transport' then 1
								else -1
							end)

	declare @varIsArchived bit 

	select @varIsArchived = IsArchived 
	from dbo.tblUptimeLogsDetails with (nolock)
	where BuildingFK = @varBuildingFK
	and UptimeLogDate = @varUptimeLogDate

	if @varIsArchived is null
	begin
		select 'Record not found, ensure building name and date are correct.' as [Result]
		return
	end
	else if @varIsArchived = 0
	begin
		select 'Record not confirmed, can''t unconfirm.' as [Result]
		return
	end

	declare @transaction nvarchar(32) = replace(replace(replace(replace(cast(@@spid as nvarchar(50)) + convert(nvarchar(50), dbo.GetBSTDate(), 21), ' - ', ''), ' ', ''), ':', ''), '.', '');

	declare @rowCount int

	begin try
		begin transaction @transaction

			update dbo.tblUptimeLogsDetails with (rowlock)
			set IsArchived = 0
			where BuildingFK = @varBuildingFK
			and UptimeLogDate = @varUptimeLogDate

			set @rowCount = @@rowcount

		commit transaction @transaction

		if @rowCount < 1
			select 'Record not found, ensure building name and date are correct.' as [Result]
		else 
			select 'Record unconfirmed.' as [Result]
	end try
	begin catch
		select error_message() as [Result]

		begin try rollback transaction @transaction end try begin catch /* ignore and continue*/ end catch
	end catch
END
GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[STA_UpdateStockInUnitsValue]    Script Date: 02/11/2026 17:47:28 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[STA_UpdateStockInUnitsValue]
(
	 @GoodsInNumber NVARCHAR(50) = '',
	 @NewUnitsValue DECIMAL(18,3) -- Not optional 
)
AS
BEGIN
	DECLARE @var_GoodsInNumber NVARCHAR(50) = ISNULL(@GoodsInNumber, ''), @var_NewUnitsValue DECIMAL(18,3) = @NewUnitsValue
	
	IF LTRIM(@var_GoodsInNumber) = '' RETURN

	IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#tblStockIns') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #tblStockIns

	SELECT * INTO #tblStockIns FROM dbo.tblStockIns WHERE GoodsInNumber LIKE '%' + @var_GoodsInNumber + '%'

	IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#tblStockInLines') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #tblStockInLines

	SELECT * INTO #tblStockInLines FROM dbo.tblStockInLines WHERE StockInFK IN (SELECT StockInPK FROM #tblStockIns)

	IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#tblStockInLinePallets') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #tblStockInLinePallets

	SELECT * INTO #tblStockInLinePallets FROM dbo.tblStockInLinePallets WHERE StockInLineFK IN (SELECT StockInLinePK FROM #tblStockInLines)

	BEGIN TRANSACTION

		UPDATE dbo.tblStockInLines WITH (ROWLOCK)
		SET 
			Units = @NewUnitsValue
		WHERE 
			StockInLinePK IN (SELECT StockInLinePK FROM #tblStockInLines)

		UPDATE tblPalletContent WITH (ROWLOCK)
		SET 
			ActualUnits = @NewUnitsValue,
			AvailableUnits = @NewUnitsValue
		WHERE 
			PalletFK IN (SELECT PalletFK FROM #tblStockInLinePallets)

	COMMIT TRANSACTION
END
GO
