CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[TMP_AddEmployeeActivityDetailsForDateAndBuilding]
( 
	@EventDate DATE, @buildingName NVARCHAR(200)
)
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ UNCOMMITTED; SET DEADLOCK_PRIORITY LOW

	DECLARE @varStoredProcedureName NVARCHAR(500) = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID)

	BEGIN TRY
		DELETE FROM dbo.tblStoredProcedureLogging WHERE StoredProcedureName = @varStoredProcedureName

		INSERT INTO dbo.tblStoredProcedureLogging SELECT @varStoredProcedureName, 'Proc execution started', dbo.GetBSTDate()

		DECLARE 
			@varStartDate DATE = @EventDate, @varEndDate DATE = DATEADD(DAY, 1, @EventDate), @varBuildingName NVARCHAR(200) = @BuildingName,
			@varErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @varErrorSeverity INT, @varErrorState INT, @varRowCount INT

		INSERT INTO dbo.tblStoredProcedureLogging SELECT @varStoredProcedureName, '@varStartDate = ' + ISNULL(CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), @varStartDate, 23), ''), dbo.GetBSTDate()
		INSERT INTO dbo.tblStoredProcedureLogging SELECT @varStoredProcedureName, '@varEndDate = ' + ISNULL(CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), @varEndDate, 23), ''), dbo.GetBSTDate()
		INSERT INTO dbo.tblStoredProcedureLogging SELECT @varStoredProcedureName, '@varBuildingName = ' + ISNULL(@varBuildingName, ''), dbo.GetBSTDate()

		-- Get all scanner works order movement records for the seleced date and selected building.
	
		DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #WorksOrderMovementDetails0

		SELECT DISTINCT
			wom.*,
			vbd_dest.DepartmentTMS
		INTO 
			#WorksOrderMovementDetails0
		FROM 
			dbo.tblWorksOrderMovements wom WITH (NOLOCK)
		INNER JOIN dbo.viewBuildingUnitBays vbub_dest WITH (NOLOCK)
			ON wom.DestinationLocationTypeFK = vbub_dest.LocationTypeFK
			AND wom.DestinationFK = vbub_dest.BuildingUnitBayPK
		INNER JOIN dbo.viewBuildingDetails vbd_dest WITH (NOLOCK)
			ON vbub_dest.BuildingUnitFK = vbd_dest.BuildingUnitPK
		WHERE 
			wom.UpdatedDate >= @varStartDate
			AND wom.UpdatedDate < @varEndDate
			AND wom.MovementDescription LIKE '%hand%held%'
			AND vbd_dest.DepartmentTMS = @varBuildingName

		DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #WorksOrders

		SELECT DISTINCT wo.* 
		INTO #WorksOrders
		FROM dbo.tblWorksOrders wo WITH (NOLOCK)
		INNER JOIN #WorksOrderMovementDetails0 wom
		ON wo.WorksOrderPK = wom.WorksOrderFK

		-- Get all scanner pallet audit records, created by scanner, for the selected date and building.

		DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #PalletAuditDetailsForSelectedDateAndBuilding

		-- Add pallet loaded scanned records created by a scanner (obviously).
	
		SELECT DISTINCT
		vbd.DepartmentTMS,
		pa.PalletAuditPK,
		pa.PalletFK,
		pa.BuildingUnitFK,
		pa.EventTypeFK,
		pa.EventFK,
		pa.InsertedBy,
		pa.InsertedDate,
		pa.StockItemFK,
		si.StockItemCode,
		si.[Description] AS StockItemName,
		si.DivisionFK,
		div.DivisionCode,
		div.DivisionName,
		div.CustomerFK,
		cus.CustomerCode,
		cus.CustomerName
		INTO #PalletAuditDetailsForSelectedDateAndBuilding
		FROM dbo.tblPalletAudit pa WITH (NOLOCK)
		INNER JOIN dbo.viewBuildingDetails vbd WITH (NOLOCK)
		ON pa.BuildingUnitFK = vbd.BuildingUnitPK
		LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.tblStockItems si WITH (NOLOCK)
		ON pa.StockItemFK = si.StockItemPK
		LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.tblDivisions div WITH (NOLOCK)
		ON si.DivisionFK = div.DivisionPK
		LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.tblCustomers cus WITH (NOLOCK)
		ON div.CustomerFK = cus.CustomerPK
		WHERE pa.InsertedDate >= @varStartDate 
		AND pa.InsertedDate < @varEndDate
		AND pa.EventTypeFK IN (27 /*Pallet Loaded Scanned*/, 37 /*Pallet Created Via Scanning*/)
		AND vbd.DepartmentTMS = @varBuildingName

		-- Add pallet movement records linked to works order movement records by palletfk and userfk

		INSERT INTO #PalletAuditDetailsForSelectedDateAndBuilding
		SELECT DISTINCT
		vbd.DepartmentTMS,
		pa.PalletAuditPK,
		pa.PalletFK,
		pa.BuildingUnitFK,
		pa.EventTypeFK,
		pa.EventFK,
		pa.InsertedBy,
		pa.InsertedDate,
		pa.StockItemFK,
		si.StockItemCode,
		si.[Description] AS StockItemName,
		si.DivisionFK,
		div.DivisionCode,
		div.DivisionName,
		div.CustomerFK,
		cus.CustomerCode,
		cus.CustomerName	
		FROM dbo.tblPalletAudit pa WITH (NOLOCK)
		INNER JOIN #WorksOrderMovementDetails0 wom
		ON pa.PalletFK = wom.PalletFK
		AND pa.InsertedBy = wom.UpdatedBy
		LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.viewBuildingDetails vbd WITH (NOLOCK)
		ON pa.BuildingUnitFK = vbd.BuildingUnitPK
		LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.tblStockItems si WITH (NOLOCK)
		ON pa.StockItemFK = si.StockItemPK
		LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.tblDivisions div WITH (NOLOCK)
		ON si.DivisionFK = div.DivisionPK
		LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.tblCustomers cus WITH (NOLOCK)
		ON div.CustomerFK = cus.CustomerPK
		WHERE pa.InsertedDate >= @varStartDate 
		AND pa.InsertedDate < @varEndDate
		AND pa.EventTypeFK = 17 /*Pallet Movement*/

		-- Ensure all pallet audit records have a BuildingUnitFK value that links to the selected building.
		-- This is required as a work-around for an existing bug (as of 27 Aug 2019) which will be fixed later by Jamie.

		DECLARE @BuildingUnitFK INT = (SELECT MAX(BuildingUnitPK) FROM dbo.viewBuildingDetails WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE DepartmentTMS = @varBuildingName)

		UPDATE pa
		SET BuildingUnitFK = @BuildingUnitFK
		FROM #PalletAuditDetailsForSelectedDateAndBuilding pa
		INNER JOIN dbo.viewBuildingDetails vbd WITH (NOLOCK)
		ON pa.BuildingUnitFK = vbd.BuildingUnitPK
		WHERE vbd.DepartmentTMS <> @varBuildingName	

		-- Get warehousing user details.

		DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #warehouseUserDetails

		SELECT DISTINCT
		UserPK,	PersonFK, UserTypeFK, DistributionCustomerFK, AspNetUserID, MobAspNetUserID, UserName, U_IsArchived, U_InsertedBy, U_InsertedDate, U_UpdatedBy, U_UpdatedDate, 
		PersonPK, FirstName,	LastName, EmployeeName,	P_IsArchived, P_InsertedBy,	P_InsertedDate,	P_UpdatedBy, P_UpdatedDate, EmployeeNumber,	JobTitle	
		INTO #warehouseUserDetails 
		FROM dbo.viewUserDetails WITH (NOLOCK) 
		WHERE UserTypeFK = 1 /*Warehousing*/

		-- Get expanded pallet audit details for the selected date and building.

		DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #PalletAuditUserBuildingDetails

		SELECT DISTINCT 
		CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(50)) AS StockInOutNumber, 
		'PalletAudit' AS RecordType, 
		pa.PalletAuditPK AS PK, 	
		CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(50)) as Origin, 
		paet.PalletAuditEventType AS EventType, 
		pa.PalletFK, 
		pa.InsertedBy AS UserFK,
		vud.EmployeeName AS [EmployeeName],
		vud.EmployeeNumber AS [EmployeeNumber],
		pa.InsertedDate AS EventDateTime, 
		CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(50)) AS FromLocationType,
		CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(50)) AS ToLocationType,
		pa.EventFK,
		pa.EventTypeFK,
		CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(50)) AS MovementType,
		vbd.DepartmentTMS,
		pa.StockItemFK,
		pa.StockItemCode,
		pa.StockItemName,
		pa.DivisionFK,
		pa.DivisionCode,
		pa.DivisionName,
		pa.CustomerFK,
		pa.CustomerCode,
		pa.CustomerName
		INTO #PalletAuditUserBuildingDetails
		FROM #PalletAuditDetailsForSelectedDateAndBuilding pa 
		LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.viewBuildingDetails vbd WITH (NOLOCK)
		ON pa.BuildingUnitFK = vbd.BuildingUnitPK
		LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.appPalletAuditEventTypes paet WITH (NOLOCK)
		ON pa.EventTypeFK = paet.PalletAuditEventTypePK
		LEFT OUTER JOIN #warehouseUserDetails vud
		ON pa.InsertedBy = vud.UserPK

		-- Delete this as no longer needed.
		DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #PalletAuditDetailsForSelectedDateAndBuilding

		-- Get expanded works order details for the selected date and building.

		DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #WorksOrderMovementDetails

		SELECT DISTINCT 
		CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(50)) AS StockInOutNumber, 
		'WorksOrderMovement' AS RecordType, 
		wom.WorksOrderMovementPK AS PK, 
		CASE WHEN woo.WorksOrderOrigin = 'Movement' THEN 'Pallet Movement' ELSE woo.WorksOrderOrigin END AS Origin, 
		CASE WHEN wot.WorksOrderType = 'Movement' THEN 'Pallet Movement' ELSE wot.WorksOrderType END AS EventType,
		wom.PalletFK, 
		wom.UpdatedBy AS UserFK,
		vud.EmployeeName AS [EmployeeName],
		vud.EmployeeNumber AS [EmployeeNumber],
		wom.UpdatedDate AS EventDateTime, 
		slt.LocationType AS FromLocationType, 
		dlt.LocationType AS ToLocationType,
		CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(50)) AS MovementType,
		wo.WorksOrderPK AS WorksOrderFK,
		wom.DepartmentTMS,
		-1 as StockItemFK,
		CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(50)) AS StockItemCode,
		CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(200)) AS StockItemName,
		-1 AS DivisionFK,
		CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(50)) AS DivisionCode,
		CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(200)) AS DivisionName,
		-1 AS CustomerFK,
		CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(50)) AS CustomerCode,
		CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(200)) AS CustomerName
		INTO #WorksOrderMovementDetails
		FROM #WorksOrderMovementDetails0 wom
		LEFT OUTER JOIN #WorksOrders wo
		ON wom.WorksOrderFK = wo.WorksOrderPK
		LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.appWorksOrderTypes wot WITH (NOLOCK)
		ON wo.WorksOrderTypeFK = wot.WorksOrderTypePK
		LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.appWorksOrderOrigins woo WITH (NOLOCK)
		ON wo.WorksOrderOriginFK = woo.WorksOrderOriginPK
		LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.appLocationTypes slt WITH (NOLOCK)
		ON wom.SourceLocationTypeFK = slt.LocationTypePK
		LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.appLocationTypes dlt WITH (NOLOCK)
		ON wom.DestinationLocationTypeFK = dlt.LocationTypePK
		LEFT OUTER JOIN #warehouseUserDetails vud
		ON wom.UpdatedBy = vud.UserPK		

		-- Set works order movement missing values.

		UPDATE womd
		SET 
			StockInOutNumber = co.GoodsOrderNumber
		FROM 
			#WorksOrderMovementDetails womd
		INNER JOIN #WorksOrders wo
			ON womd.WorksOrderFK = wo.WorksOrderPK
		INNER JOIN dbo.tblStockOrders so WITH (NOLOCK)
			ON wo.FK = so.StockOrderPK
			AND wo.WorksOrderOriginFK IN (2/*StockOrder*/, 3/*StockOut*/)
		INNER JOIN dbo.tblContainerOuts co WITH (NOLOCK)
			ON so.ContainerOutFK = co.ContainerOutPK
		INNER JOIN dbo.tblContainerOutLines col WITH (NOLOCK)
			ON co.ContainerOutPK = col.ContainerOutFK
		WHERE
			womd.Origin = 'StockOrder'

		UPDATE womd
		SET 
			StockInOutNumber = co.GoodsOrderNumber
		FROM 
			#WorksOrderMovementDetails womd
		INNER JOIN dbo.tblContainerOutLinePalletContent colpc WITH (NOLOCK)
			ON womd.PalletFK = colpc.PalletFK
		INNER JOIN dbo.tblContainerOutLines col WITH (NOLOCK)
			ON colpc.ContainerOutLineFK = col.ContainerOutLinePK
		INNER JOIN dbo.tblContainerOuts co WITH (NOLOCK)
			ON col.ContainerOutFK = co.ContainerOutPK
		WHERE
			womd.Origin = 'StockOrder'
			AND womd.StockInOutNumber = ''

		UPDATE womd
		SET 
			StockInOutNumber = ci.GoodsInNumber
		FROM 
			#WorksOrderMovementDetails womd
		INNER JOIN #WorksOrders wo
			ON womd.WorksOrderFK = wo.WorksOrderPK
		INNER JOIN dbo.tblStockIns si WITH (NOLOCK)
			ON wo.FK = si.StockInPK
			AND wo.WorksOrderOriginFK = 1 /*StockIn*/
		INNER JOIN dbo.tblContainerIns ci WITH (NOLOCK)
			ON si.ContainerInFK = ci.ContainerInPK
		WHERE
			womd.Origin =  'StockIn'

		UPDATE womd
		SET 
			StockInOutNumber = ci.GoodsInNumber
		FROM 
			#WorksOrderMovementDetails womd
		INNER JOIN dbo.tblStockInLinePallets silp WITH (NOLOCK)
			ON womd.PalletFK = silp.PalletFK
		INNER JOIN dbo.tblStockInLines sil WITH (NOLOCK)
			ON silp.StockInLineFK = sil.StockInLinePK
		INNER JOIN dbo.tblStockIns si WITH (NOLOCK)
			ON sil.StockInFK= si.StockInPK
		INNER JOIN dbo.tblContainerIns ci WITH (NOLOCK)
			ON si.ContainerInFK = ci.ContainerInPK
		WHERE
			womd.Origin =  'StockIn'
			AND womd.StockInOutNumber = ''

		UPDATE #WorksOrderMovementDetails 
		SET MovementType =	CASE
								WHEN Origin = 'Pallet Movement' AND FromLocationType = 'BuildingUnitBay' AND ToLocationType = 'BuildingUnitBay' THEN 'Movement'
								WHEN Origin = 'Pallet Movement' AND FromLocationType = 'BuildingUnitBay' AND ToLocationType = 'FloorLocation' THEN 'Movement'
								WHEN Origin = 'Pallet Movement' AND FromLocationType = 'BuildingUnitBay' AND ToLocationType = 'LoadingBay' THEN 'Movement'
								WHEN Origin = 'Pallet Movement' AND FromLocationType = 'BuildingUnitBay' AND ToLocationType = 'SampleLocation' THEN 'Movement'
								WHEN Origin = 'Pallet Movement' AND FromLocationType = 'BuildingUnitBay' AND ToLocationType = 'SetDownArea' THEN 'Movement'
								WHEN Origin = 'Pallet Movement' AND FromLocationType = 'FloorLocation' AND ToLocationType = 'BuildingUnitBay' THEN 'Putaway'
								WHEN Origin = 'Pallet Movement' AND FromLocationType = 'FloorLocation' AND ToLocationType = 'FloorLocation' THEN 'Movement'
								WHEN Origin = 'Pallet Movement' AND FromLocationType = 'FloorLocation' AND ToLocationType = 'SetDownArea' THEN 'Movement'
								WHEN Origin = 'Pallet Movement' AND FromLocationType = 'LoadingBay' AND ToLocationType = 'BuildingUnitBay' THEN 'Putaway'
								WHEN Origin = 'Pallet Movement' AND FromLocationType = 'LoadingBay' AND ToLocationType = 'FloorLocation' THEN 'Movement'
								WHEN Origin = 'Pallet Movement' AND FromLocationType = 'LoadingBay' AND ToLocationType = 'LoadingBay' THEN 'Movement'
								WHEN Origin = 'Pallet Movement' AND FromLocationType = 'LoadingBay' AND ToLocationType = 'SampleLocation' THEN 'Movement'
								WHEN Origin = 'Pallet Movement' AND FromLocationType = 'LoadingBay' AND ToLocationType = 'SetDownArea' THEN 'Movement'
								WHEN Origin = 'Pallet Movement' AND FromLocationType = 'OnRouteContainerIn' AND ToLocationType = 'BuildingUnitBay' THEN 'Putaway'
								WHEN Origin = 'Pallet Movement' AND FromLocationType = 'SampleLocation' AND ToLocationType = 'BuildingUnitBay' THEN 'Putaway'
								WHEN Origin = 'Pallet Movement' AND FromLocationType = 'SampleLocation' AND ToLocationType = 'LoadingBay' THEN 'Movement'
								WHEN Origin = 'Pallet Movement' AND FromLocationType = 'SampleLocation' AND ToLocationType = 'SetDownArea' THEN 'Movement'
								WHEN Origin = 'Pallet Movement' AND FromLocationType = 'SetDownArea' AND ToLocationType = 'BuildingUnitBay' THEN 'Putaway'
								WHEN Origin = 'Pallet Movement' AND FromLocationType = 'SetDownArea' AND ToLocationType = 'FloorLocation' THEN 'Movement'
								WHEN Origin = 'Pallet Movement' AND FromLocationType = 'SetDownArea' AND ToLocationType = 'LoadingBay' THEN 'Movement'
								WHEN Origin = 'Pallet Movement' AND FromLocationType = 'SetDownArea' AND ToLocationType = 'SampleLocation' THEN 'Movement'
								WHEN Origin = 'Pallet Movement' AND FromLocationType = 'SetDownArea' AND ToLocationType = 'SetDownArea' THEN 'Movement'
								WHEN Origin = 'StockIn' AND FromLocationType = 'BuildingUnitBay' AND ToLocationType = 'BuildingUnitBay' THEN 'Movement'
								WHEN Origin = 'StockIn' AND FromLocationType = 'BuildingUnitBay' AND ToLocationType = 'SetDownArea' THEN 'Movement'
								WHEN Origin = 'StockIn' AND FromLocationType = 'LoadingBay' AND ToLocationType = 'BuildingUnitBay' THEN 'Putaway'
								WHEN Origin = 'StockIn' AND FromLocationType = 'LoadingBay' AND ToLocationType = 'LoadingBay' THEN 'Movement'
								WHEN Origin = 'StockIn' AND FromLocationType = 'LoadingBay' AND ToLocationType = 'MovementLocation' THEN 'Movement'
								WHEN Origin = 'StockIn' AND FromLocationType = 'LoadingBay' AND ToLocationType = 'SampleLocation' THEN 'Putaway'
								WHEN Origin = 'StockIn' AND FromLocationType = 'LoadingBay' AND ToLocationType = 'SetDownArea' THEN 'Movement'
								WHEN Origin = 'StockIn' AND FromLocationType = 'MovementLocation' AND ToLocationType = 'BuildingUnitBay' THEN 'Putaway'
								WHEN Origin = 'StockIn' AND FromLocationType = 'MovementLocation' AND ToLocationType = 'MovementLocation' THEN 'Movement'
								WHEN Origin = 'StockIn' AND FromLocationType = 'MovementLocation' AND ToLocationType = 'SetDownArea' THEN 'Movement'
								WHEN Origin = 'StockIn' AND FromLocationType = 'OnRouteContainerIn' AND ToLocationType = 'BuildingUnitBay' THEN 'Putaway'
								WHEN Origin = 'StockIn' AND FromLocationType = 'OnRouteContainerIn' AND ToLocationType = 'LoadingBay' THEN 'Unloaded'
								WHEN Origin = 'StockIn' AND FromLocationType = 'OnRouteContainerIn' AND ToLocationType = 'MovementLocation' THEN 'Unloaded'
								WHEN Origin = 'StockIn' AND FromLocationType = 'OnRouteContainerIn' AND ToLocationType = 'SetDownArea' THEN 'Unloaded'

								WHEN Origin = 'StockIn' AND FromLocationType = 'OnRouteContainerIn' AND ToLocationType = 'FloorLocation' THEN 'Unloaded' --NEW

								WHEN Origin = 'StockIn' AND FromLocationType = 'SampleLocation' AND ToLocationType = 'BuildingUnitBay' THEN 'Putaway'
								WHEN Origin = 'StockIn' AND FromLocationType = 'SampleLocation' AND ToLocationType = 'SetDownArea' THEN 'Movement'
								WHEN Origin = 'StockIn' AND FromLocationType = 'SetDownArea' AND ToLocationType = 'BuildingUnitBay' THEN 'Putaway'
								WHEN Origin = 'StockIn' AND FromLocationType = 'SetDownArea' AND ToLocationType = 'LoadingBay' THEN 'Movement'
								WHEN Origin = 'StockIn' AND FromLocationType = 'SetDownArea' AND ToLocationType = 'MovementLocation' THEN 'Movement'
								WHEN Origin = 'StockIn' AND FromLocationType = 'SetDownArea' AND ToLocationType = 'SampleLocation' THEN 'Putaway'
								WHEN Origin = 'StockIn' AND FromLocationType = 'SetDownArea' AND ToLocationType = 'SetDownArea' THEN 'Movement'

								WHEN Origin = 'StockIn' AND FromLocationType = 'FloorLocation' AND ToLocationType = 'BuildingUnitBay' THEN 'Putaway' --NEW
								WHEN Origin = 'StockIn' AND FromLocationType = 'LoadingBay' AND ToLocationType = 'FloorLocation' THEN 'Movement' --NEW
								WHEN Origin = 'StockIn' AND FromLocationType = 'FloorLocation' AND ToLocationType = 'FloorLocation' THEN 'Movement' --NEW
								WHEN Origin = 'StockIn' AND FromLocationType = 'SetDownArea' AND ToLocationType = 'FloorLocation' THEN 'Movement' --NEW

								WHEN Origin = 'StockOrder' AND FromLocationType = 'BuildingUnitBay' AND ToLocationType = 'BuildingUnitBay' THEN 'Movement'
								WHEN Origin = 'StockOrder' AND FromLocationType = 'BuildingUnitBay' AND ToLocationType = 'FloorLocation' THEN 'Picked'
								WHEN Origin = 'StockOrder' AND FromLocationType = 'BuildingUnitBay' AND ToLocationType = 'LoadingBay' THEN 'Loaded'
								WHEN Origin = 'StockOrder' AND FromLocationType = 'BuildingUnitBay' AND ToLocationType = 'SetDownArea' THEN 'Picked'
								WHEN Origin = 'StockOrder' AND FromLocationType = 'FloorLocation' AND ToLocationType = 'FloorLocation' THEN 'Movement'
								WHEN Origin = 'StockOrder' AND FromLocationType = 'FloorLocation' AND ToLocationType = 'LoadingBay' THEN 'Loaded'
								WHEN Origin = 'StockOrder' AND FromLocationType = 'FloorLocation' AND ToLocationType = 'SetDownArea' THEN 'Movement'
								WHEN Origin = 'StockOrder' AND FromLocationType = 'LoadingBay' AND ToLocationType = 'FloorLocation' THEN 'Movement'
								WHEN Origin = 'StockOrder' AND FromLocationType = 'LoadingBay' AND ToLocationType = 'LoadingBay' THEN 'Loaded'
								WHEN Origin = 'StockOrder' AND FromLocationType = 'LoadingBay' AND ToLocationType = 'SampleLocation' THEN 'Movement'
								WHEN Origin = 'StockOrder' AND FromLocationType = 'LoadingBay' AND ToLocationType = 'SetDownArea' THEN 'Movement'
								WHEN Origin = 'StockOrder' AND FromLocationType = 'OnRouteContainerOut' AND ToLocationType = 'LoadingBay' THEN 'Movement'
								WHEN Origin = 'StockOrder' AND FromLocationType = 'SampleLocation' AND ToLocationType = 'LoadingBay' THEN 'Loaded'
								WHEN Origin = 'StockOrder' AND FromLocationType = 'SetDownArea' AND ToLocationType = 'FloorLocation' THEN 'Movement'
								WHEN Origin = 'StockOrder' AND FromLocationType = 'SetDownArea' AND ToLocationType = 'LoadingBay' THEN 'Loaded'
								WHEN Origin = 'StockOrder' AND FromLocationType = 'SetDownArea' AND ToLocationType = 'SetDownArea' THEN 'Movement'
								ELSE 'Movement'
							END
		WHERE Origin IN ('Pallet Movement', 'StockIn', 'StockOrder')

		UPDATE pad
		SET 
			Origin = 'StockOrder',
			StockInOutNumber = co.GoodsOrderNumber,
			MovementType= 'Loaded'
		FROM 
			#PalletAuditUserBuildingDetails pad
		INNER JOIN dbo.tblContainerOuts co WITH (NOLOCK)
			ON Pad.EventFK = co.ContainerOutPK
		WHERE
			pad.EventTypeFK = 27/*Pallet Loaded Scanned*/

		UPDATE pad
		SET 
			Origin = 'StockIn',
			StockInOutNumber = ci.GoodsInNumber,
			MovementType= 'Unloaded'
		FROM 
			#PalletAuditUserBuildingDetails pad
		INNER JOIN dbo.tblStockIns si WITH (NOLOCK)
			ON pad.EventFK = si.StockInPK
		INNER JOIN dbo.tblContainerIns ci
			ON si.ContainerInFK = ci.ContainerInPK
		WHERE
			pad.EventTypeFK = 37 /*Pallet Created Via Scanning*/

	--select * from #PalletAuditUserBuildingDetails where EventTypeFK = 37 /*Pallet Created Via Scanning*/
	--goto ec

		UPDATE pad
		SET 
			Origin = womd.Origin,
			StockInOutNumber = womd.StockInOutNumber,
			MovementType = womd.MovementType
		FROM 
			#PalletAuditUserBuildingDetails pad
		INNER JOIN #WorksOrderMovementDetails womd
			ON pad.PalletFK = womd.PalletFK
			AND pad.EventFK = womd.PK	-- Pallet Audit EventFK = WorksOrderMovement.WorksOrderMovementPK
		WHERE
			pad.EventTypeFK  = 17/*Pallet Movement*/


		UPDATE womd
		SET 
			StockItemFK = pad.StockItemFK,
			StockItemCode = pad.StockItemCode,
			StockItemName = pad.StockItemName,
			DivisionFK = pad.DivisionFK,
			DivisionCode = pad.DivisionCode,
			DivisionName = pad.DivisionName,
			CustomerFK = pad.CustomerFK,
			CustomerCode = pad.CustomerCode,
			CustomerName = pad.CustomerName
		FROM 
			#PalletAuditUserBuildingDetails pad
		INNER JOIN #WorksOrderMovementDetails womd
			ON pad.PalletFK = womd.PalletFK
			AND pad.EventFK = womd.PK	-- Pallet Audit EventFK = WorksOrderMovement.WorksOrderMovementPK
		WHERE
			pad.EventTypeFK  = 17/*Pallet Movement*/

		UPDATE #PalletAuditUserBuildingDetails 
		SET Origin = 'Pallet Movement', 
		MovementType = 'Movement' 
		WHERE Origin = '' 
		AND StockInOutNumber = ''

		DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #PalletAuditWorksOrderMovmentDetails

		SELECT	
			StockInOutNumber, RecordType, PK, Origin, EventType,	PalletFK, UserFK, EmployeeName,	EmployeeNumber, EventDateTime, FromLocationType, ToLocationType, MovementType, DepartmentTMS,
			StockItemFK, StockItemCode, StockItemName, DivisionFK, DivisionCode, DivisionName, CustomerFK, CustomerCode, CustomerName
		INTO 
			#PalletAuditWorksOrderMovmentDetails 
		FROM 
			#PalletAuditUserBuildingDetails
		UNION
		SELECT 
			StockInOutNumber, RecordType, PK, Origin, EventType,	PalletFK, UserFK, EmployeeName,	EmployeeNumber, EventDateTime, FromLocationType, ToLocationType, MovementType, DepartmentTMS,
			StockItemFK, StockItemCode, StockItemName, DivisionFK, DivisionCode, DivisionName, CustomerFK, CustomerCode, CustomerName
		FROM 
			#WorksOrderMovementDetails wom
		WHERE 
			wom.EventDateTime >= @varStartDate
			AND wom.EventDateTime < @varEndDate

		UPDATE #PalletAuditWorksOrderMovmentDetails SET Origin = 'StockOut' WHERE Origin = 'StockOrder'

		DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #TMSEmployeeClockCardDetails

		SELECT * INTO #TMSEmployeeClockCardDetails 
		FROM dbo.tblTMSEmployeeClockCardDetails WITH (NOLOCK)
		WHERE ClockCardDate = @varStartDate

		DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #TMSEmployeeClockedTimes

		SELECT DISTINCT t1.* 
		INTO #TMSEmployeeClockedTimes
		FROM dbo.tblTMSEmployeeClockedTimes t1 WITH (NOLOCK)
		INNER JOIN #TMSEmployeeClockCardDetails t2
		ON t1.TMSEmployeeClockCardDetailFK = t2.TMSEmployeeClockCardDetailPK
		INNER JOIN #warehouseUserDetails vud
		ON ((CAST(t2.EmployeeNumber AS INT) = vud.EmployeeNumber AND vud.EmployeeNumber > 0)
		OR (t2.EmployeeName = vud.EmployeeName AND vud.EmployeeNumber < 1))
		WHERE 
			t2.ClockCardDate = @varStartDate
			AND
			(
				EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dbo.tblTMSEmployeeClockedTimes t3 WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE t3.TMSEmployeeClockCardDetailFK = t1.TMSEmployeeClockCardDetailFK AND t3.Department = @varBuildingName)
				OR			
				EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #PalletAuditUserBuildingDetails t2 WHERE t2.UserFK = vud.UserPK)
			)

		-- Delete this as no longer needed.
		DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #warehouseUserDetails

		DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #userDetails

		SELECT DISTINCT
			vud.UserPK,	vud.PersonFK, vud.UserTypeFK, vud.DistributionCustomerFK, vud.AspNetUserID, vud.MobAspNetUserID, vud.UserName, vud.U_IsArchived, vud.U_InsertedBy, vud.U_InsertedDate, vud.U_UpdatedBy, vud.U_UpdatedDate, 
			vud.PersonPK, vud.FirstName, vud.LastName, vud.EmployeeName, vud.P_IsArchived, vud.P_InsertedBy, vud.P_InsertedDate, vud.P_UpdatedBy, vud.P_UpdatedDate, vud.EmployeeNumber, vud.JobTitle
		INTO
			#userDetails
		FROM 
			#TMSEmployeeClockCardDetails ttccd
		INNER JOIN #TMSEmployeeClockedTimes ttct
			ON ttccd.TMSEmployeeClockCardDetailPK = ttct.TMSEmployeeClockCardDetailFK
		INNER JOIN dbo.viewUserDetails vud WITH (NOLOCK)
			ON ((CAST(ttccd.EmployeeNumber AS INT) = vud.EmployeeNumber AND vud.EmployeeNumber > 0)
			OR (ttccd.EmployeeName = vud.EmployeeName AND vud.EmployeeNumber < 1))
			AND vud.UserTypeFK = 1 /*Warehousing*/
		WHERE 
			ttccd.ClockCardDate = @varStartDate
			AND (ttct.Department = @varBuildingName OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #PalletAuditUserBuildingDetails t2 WHERE t2.UserFK = vud.UserPK))

		-- Get employee tms records matching on employee name, date, and clock time department. 

		DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #TMSDetails0

		SELECT DISTINCT
			ttccd.TMSEmployeeClockCardDetailPK,
			ttccd.EmployeeName,
			CAST(ttccd.EmployeeNumber AS INT) AS EmployeeNumber,
			vud.UserPK AS UserFK,
			CAST(0 AS BIT) AS UserFKinPalletAuditData
		INTO 
			#TMSDetails0
		FROM 
			#TMSEmployeeClockCardDetails ttccd
		INNER JOIN #TMSEmployeeClockedTimes ttct
			ON ttccd.TMSEmployeeClockCardDetailPK = ttct.TMSEmployeeClockCardDetailFK
		INNER JOIN #userDetails vud
			ON ((CAST(ttccd.EmployeeNumber AS INT) = vud.EmployeeNumber AND vud.EmployeeNumber > 0)
			OR (ttccd.EmployeeName = vud.EmployeeName AND vud.EmployeeNumber < 1))
			AND vud.UserTypeFK = 1 /*Warehousing*/
		WHERE 
			ttccd.ClockCardDate = @varStartDate
			AND (ttct.Department = @varBuildingName OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #PalletAuditUserBuildingDetails t2 WHERE t2.UserFK = vud.UserPK))

		UPDATE t1
		SET UserFKinPalletAuditData = 1
		FROM #TMSDetails0 t1
		INNER JOIN #PalletAuditUserBuildingDetails t2
		ON t1.UserFK = t2.UserFK

		-- Delete this as no longer needed.
		DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #PalletAuditUserBuildingDetails

		-- Add the employee tms records into a new temporary table with user details.

		DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #TMSDetails1

		SELECT distinct vud.U_InsertedDate, vud.U_UpdatedDate, t1.*
		INTO #TMSDetails1
		FROM #TMSDetails0 t1
		INNER JOIN #userDetails vud
		ON t1.UserFK = vud.UserPK
		AND vud.UserTypeFK = 1 /*Warehousing*/

		-- Get duplicate employee names with more than one userfk, i.e. an employee has more than 1 user record.

		DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #employeesWithMultipleUserRecords0

		SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT UserFK) AS NoOfUserFKs, EmployeeName
		INTO #employeesWithMultipleUserRecords0
		FROM #TMSDetails1
		GROUP BY EmployeeName
		HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT UserFK) > 1

		-- Get employee tms records where the employee has more than 1 userfk.

		DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #employeesWithMultipleUserRecords1

		SELECT DISTINCT t1.* 
		INTO #employeesWithMultipleUserRecords1
		FROM #TMSDetails1 t1 
		INNER JOIN #employeesWithMultipleUserRecords0 t2
		ON t1.EmployeeName = t2.EmployeeName

		-- Remove records where userfk not in pallet audit data but it's employee name has another userfk in the pallet audit data.

		DELETE t1
		FROM #employeesWithMultipleUserRecords1 t1
		WHERE t1.UserFKinPalletAuditData = 0
		AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #employeesWithMultipleUserRecords1 t2 WHERE t2.EmployeeName = t1.EmployeeName AND t2.UserFKinPalletAuditData = 1)

		-- Get the correct user based on the closest user inserted date to the parameter @varStartDate value.

		DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #employeesWithMultipleUserRecords2

		SELECT MAX(t1.U_InsertedDate) AS UserInsertedDate, t1.EmployeeName
		INTO #employeesWithMultipleUserRecords2
		FROM #employeesWithMultipleUserRecords1 t1
		WHERE t1.U_InsertedDate < @varStartDate
		GROUP BY t1.EmployeeName

		-- Remove the "incorrect" user records from the duplicates temporary table.

		DELETE t1
		FROM #employeesWithMultipleUserRecords1 t1
		INNER JOIN #employeesWithMultipleUserRecords2 t2
		ON t1.EmployeeName = t2.EmployeeName
		WHERE T1.U_InsertedDate <> t2.UserInsertedDate

		-- Remove the "incorrect" user records from the main tms temporary table.

		DELETE t1
		FROM #TMSDetails1 t1
		INNER JOIN #employeesWithMultipleUserRecords1 t2
		ON t1.EmployeeName = t2.EmployeeName
		WHERE t1.UserFK <> t2.UserFK

		-- Get TMS correction records, i.e. records created by managers to add missing clock times for employees.

		DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #tMSCorrectionRecords

		SELECT DISTINCT 
		ttccd.TMSEmployeeClockCardDetailPK, ttccd.EmployeeNumber, ttccd.ClockCardDate, ttccd.ClockCardTimes, ttccd.[Shift], tct.TMSEmployeeClockedTimePK, tct.ClockedTime
		INTO #tMSCorrectionRecords
		FROM #TMSDetails1 t1
		INNER JOIN #TMSEmployeeClockCardDetails ttccd
		ON t1.TMSEmployeeClockCardDetailPK = ttccd.TMSEmployeeClockCardDetailPK
		LEFT OUTER JOIN #TMSEmployeeClockedTimes tct
		ON ttccd.TMSEmployeeClockCardDetailPK = tct.TMSEmployeeClockCardDetailFK
		WHERE LEN(LTRIM(RTRIM(ClockCardTimes))) = 5 /*Only 1 clock time*/
		AND CHARINDEX(':', ClockCardTimes) > 0 /*Has at least one valid clock time*/
		AND CHARINDEX(':', [Shift]) > 0 /*Has at least one valid clock time*/
		AND CHARINDEX(' - ', [Shift]) > 0 /*Indicates another clock time is present. Generally be 1 minute apart*/
		AND EXISTS( /*Has a linked main record which is missing at least one clock time*/
					SELECT 1 FROM #TMSEmployeeClockCardDetails t2 
					WHERE t2.EmployeeNumber = ttccd.EmployeeNumber 
					AND t2.ClockCardDate = ttccd.ClockCardDate 
					AND t2.ClockCardTimes <> ttccd.ClockCardTimes
					)

		-- Remove the correction records for the tms records.
		DELETE t1
		FROM #TMSEmployeeClockCardDetails t1
		INNER JOIN #tMSCorrectionRecords t2
		ON t1.TMSEmployeeClockCardDetailPK = t2.TMSEmployeeClockCardDetailPK

		-- Remove the correction records from the selected tms records.
		DELETE t1
		FROM #TMSDetails1 t1
		INNER JOIN #tMSCorrectionRecords t2
		ON t1.TMSEmployeeClockCardDetailPK = t2.TMSEmployeeClockCardDetailPK

		-- Update the correction records foreign key values to the main records primary key values.
		UPDATE tct
		SET tct.TMSEmployeeClockCardDetailFK = t3.TMSEmployeeClockCardDetailPK
		FROM #TMSEmployeeClockedTimes tct
		INNER JOIN #tMSCorrectionRecords t2
		ON tct.TMSEmployeeClockCardDetailFK = t2.TMSEmployeeClockCardDetailPK
		INNER JOIN #TMSDetails1 t3
		ON t2.EmployeeNumber = t3.EmployeeNumber

		-- Update the corrected main records to include the missing tms time(s) and in the correct order.

		UPDATE tccd
		SET ClockCardTimes = STUFF
		(
			(
				SELECT ' ' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),tct.ClockedTime, 108)
				FROM #TMSDetails1 As T2
				INNER JOIN #TMSEmployeeClockedTimes tct
				ON t1.TMSEmployeeClockCardDetailPK = tct.TMSEmployeeClockCardDetailFK
				WHERE t2.EmployeeNumber = t1.EmployeeNumber
				ORDER BY CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),tct.ClockedTime, 108) ASC
				FOR XML PATH (''), TYPE
			).value('.', 'varchar(max)')
		, 1, 1, '')
		FROM #TMSDetails1 As T1
		INNER JOIN #TMSEmployeeClockCardDetails tccd
		ON T1.TMSEmployeeClockCardDetailPK = tccd.TMSEmployeeClockCardDetailPK
		INNER JOIN #tMSCorrectionRecords t2
		ON t1.EmployeeNumber = t2.EmployeeNumber

		DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #TMSDetails2

		SELECT DISTINCT
			ttccd.TMSEmployeeClockCardDetailPK,
			ttct.TMSEmployeeClockedTimePK,
			ttct.Department,
			ttccd.EmployeeNumber,
			ttccd.EmployeeName,	
			CAST( CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), CAST(ttccd.ClockCardDate AS DATETIME), 21) + ' ' + LEFT(ttct.ClockedTime, 5) + ':00.000' AS DATETIME) AS EventDateTime,
			vud.UserPK AS UserFK,
			vud.U_InsertedDate AS UserInsertedDate,

			REPLACE(ttccd.[Shift], ' ','') AS [Shift],
			(SELECT [dbo].[fnGetDurationInMinutesBetweenTMSShiftStartAndEndTimes](ttccd.[Shift])) AS ShiftDurationInMinutes,
			CAST(0 AS INT) AS TimeWorkedMinutes,
			CASE WHEN ttccd.AbsenceCodes LIKE '%BHOL%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS IsBankHoliday,

			((LEFT(ttccd.Overtime,2) * 60) + RIGHT(LEFT(ttccd.Overtime, 5),2))
			+
			((LEFT(ttccd.OT1_20Percent,2) * 60) + RIGHT(LEFT(ttccd.OT1_20Percent, 5),2))
			+
			((LEFT(ttccd.OT2_20Percent,2) * 60) + RIGHT(LEFT(ttccd.OT2_20Percent, 5),2))
			+
			((LEFT(ttccd.OT1_25Percent,2) * 60) + RIGHT(LEFT(ttccd.OT1_25Percent, 5),2))
			+
			((LEFT(ttccd.OT2_25Percent,2) * 60) + RIGHT(LEFT(ttccd.OT2_25Percent, 5),2))

			AS OvertimeMinutes,
			CASE 
				WHEN ttccd.AbsenceCodes = 'E' THEN 'early'
				WHEN ttccd.AbsenceCodes = 'L' THEN 'late'
				WHEN ttccd.AbsenceCodes = 'NWD' THEN 'off today'
				WHEN ttccd.AbsenceCodes = 'H' THEN 'holiday'
				WHEN ttccd.AbsenceCodes = 'TR' THEN 'training'
				WHEN ttccd.AbsenceCodes = 'BHOL' THEN 'bank holiday'
				ELSE ttccd.AbsenceCodes
			END AS AbsenceCodes,
			ttccd.ClockCardTimes
		INTO
			#TMSDetails2
		FROM 
			#TMSDetails1 t1
		INNER JOIN #TMSEmployeeClockCardDetails ttccd
			ON t1.TMSEmployeeClockCardDetailPK = ttccd.TMSEmployeeClockCardDetailPK
		INNER JOIN #TMSEmployeeClockedTimes ttct
			ON ttccd.TMSEmployeeClockCardDetailPK = ttct.TMSEmployeeClockCardDetailFK
		INNER JOIN #userDetails vud
			ON t1.UserFK = vud.UserPK
			AND vud.UserTypeFK = 1 /*Warehousing*/

		DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #TMSDetailsFinal

		SELECT DISTINCT
			*,
			CASE
				WHEN CAST(ShiftDurationInMinutes AS DECIMAL(18,2)) / 60.00 IN (7, 8) THEN 30
				WHEN CAST(ShiftDurationInMinutes AS DECIMAL(18,2)) / 60.00 IN (7.5, 8.5, 9) THEN 45
				WHEN CAST(ShiftDurationInMinutes AS DECIMAL(18,2)) / 60.00 = 12 THEN 60
				ELSE 15 /*Under 6 hours*/
			END AS ShiftBreakTimesInMinutes,
			CAST(0 AS INT) AS ShiftDurationLessBreaksMinutes
		INTO 
			#TMSDetailsFinal 
		FROM 
			#TMSDetails2

	--zxc

		UPDATE #TMSDetailsFinal
		SET 
			ShiftDurationLessBreaksMinutes = ISNULL(ShiftDurationInMinutes,0)

		DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #tMSFirstAndLastClockCardTimes

		SELECT TMSEmployeeClockCardDetailPK, Department AS BuildingName, UserFK AS UserFK, EmployeeName,
		MIN(CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),EventDateTime, 108)) AS [1stClockCardTime], MAX(CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),EventDateTime, 108)) AS [LastClockCardTime]
		INTO #tMSFirstAndLastClockCardTimes
		FROM #TMSDetailsFinal 
		WHERE Department = @varBuildingName
		GROUP BY TMSEmployeeClockCardDetailPK, Department, UserFK, EmployeeName

		DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #tMSTimesForUserAndBuilding

		SELECT UserFK AS UserFK, Department AS BuildingName, TMSTimesForUserAndBuilding = STUFF
		(
			(
				SELECT ' ' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),EventDateTime, 108)
				FROM #TMSDetailsFinal As T2
				WHERE t2.UserFK = t1.UserFK
				AND t2.Department = t1.Department
				ORDER BY CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),EventDateTime, 108)
				FOR XML PATH (''), TYPE
			).value('.', 'varchar(max)')
		, 1, 1, '')
		INTO #tMSTimesForUserAndBuilding
		FROM #TMSDetailsFinal As T1
		WHERE Department = @varBuildingName
		GROUP BY UserFK, Department

		DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #tMSTimesForUser0

		SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY UserFK ASC, ClockedTime ASC) AS RowNumber, * 
		INTO #tMSTimesForUser0
		FROM
		(SELECT DISTINCT 
		t1.TMSEmployeeClockedTimePK,
		t1.UserFK,
		ttct.Department AS BuildingName,
		ttct.ClockedTime,
		CAST(0 AS BIT) AS IsMissingClockTimes	
		FROM #TMSDetailsFinal T1
		INNER JOIN #TMSEmployeeClockedTimes ttct
		ON t1.TMSEmployeeClockedTimePK = ttct.TMSEmployeeClockedTimePK) subQ

		DECLARE @rowNumber INT, @userFK INT, @tMSBuildingName NVARCHAR(200), @previousRowNumber INT, @previousUserFK INT, @previousTMSBuildingName NVARCHAR(200)

		DECLARE @userTMSCursor AS CURSOR

		SET @userTMSCursor = CURSOR FAST_FORWARD FOR SELECT DISTINCT UserFK FROM #tMSTimesForUser0 ORDER BY 1 /*RowNumber*/ ASC 
 
		OPEN @userTMSCursor;

		FETCH NEXT FROM @userTMSCursor INTO @UserFK

		WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
		BEGIN		
			DECLARE @timesCursor AS CURSOR

			SET @timesCursor = CURSOR FAST_FORWARD FOR	SELECT DISTINCT 
															ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY RowNumber ASC) AS RowNumber, BuildingName 
														FROM 
															#tMSTimesForUser0 
														WHERE 
															UserFK = @UserFK
 
			OPEN @timesCursor;

			FETCH NEXT FROM @timesCursor INTO @RowNumber, @tMSBuildingName

			WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
			BEGIN		
				IF @previousTMSBuildingName <> @tMSBuildingName AND @rowNumber % 2 = 0 /*Even number*/
					UPDATE #tMSTimesForUser0 SET IsMissingClockTimes = 1 WHERE UserFK = @UserFK AND IsMissingClockTimes = 0

				SELECT @previousRowNumber = @rowNumber, @previousTMSBuildingName = @tMSBuildingName

				FETCH NEXT FROM @timesCursor INTO @RowNumber, @tMSBuildingName
			END

			CLOSE @timesCursor
			DEALLOCATE @timesCursor

			FETCH NEXT FROM @userTMSCursor INTO @UserFK
		END

		CLOSE @userTMSCursor
		DEALLOCATE @userTMSCursor

		DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #tMSTimesForUser

		SELECT UserFK, TMSTimesForUser = STUFF
		(
			(
				SELECT ' ' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),t2.ClockedTime, 108)
				FROM #tMSTimesForUser0 As T2
				WHERE t2.UserFK = t1.UserFK
				ORDER BY CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),t2.ClockedTime, 108)
				FOR XML PATH (''), TYPE
			).value('.', 'varchar(max)')
		, 1, 1, '')
		INTO #tMSTimesForUser
		FROM #tMSTimesForUser0 As T1
		GROUP BY UserFK

		DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #tMSTimesWithBuildingsForUser

		SELECT 
		t1.UserFK, AllTMSTimesWithBuildingsForUser = STUFF
		(
			(
				SELECT ' ' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),t2.ClockedTime, 108) + '(' + BuildingName + ')'
				FROM #tMSTimesForUser0 As T2
				WHERE t2.UserFK = t1.UserFK
				ORDER BY CONVERT(VARCHAR(5),t2.ClockedTime, 108)
				FOR XML PATH (''), TYPE
			).value('.', 'varchar(max)')
		, 1, 1, ''), t2.AbsenceCodes
		INTO #tMSTimesWithBuildingsForUser
		FROM #tMSTimesForUser0 As T1
		INNER JOIN #TMSDetailsFinal t2
		ON t1.UserFK = t2.UserFK
		GROUP BY t1.UserFK, t2.AbsenceCodes

		IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #TMSDetailsFinal) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #PalletAuditWorksOrderMovmentDetails)
		BEGIN
			INSERT INTO #TMSDetailsFinal
			SELECT DISTINCT
			-1 AS TMSEmployeeClockCardDetailPK, 
			-1 AS TMSEmployeeClockedTimePK,
			t1.DepartmentTMS as Department,
			t1.EmployeeNumber,
			t1.EmployeeName,	
			@varStartDate AS EventDateTime,
			t1.UserFK,	
			usr.InsertedDate AS UserInsertedDate,	
			'' AS [Shift],	
			0 AS ShiftDurationInMinutes,
			0 AS TimeWorkedMinutes,	
			0 AS IsBankHoliday,	
			0 AS OvertimeMinutes,
			'' AS AbsenceCodes,	
			'' AS ClockCardTimes,
			0 AS ShiftBreakTimesInMinutes,	
			0 AS ShiftDurationLessBreaksMinutes
			FROM #PalletAuditWorksOrderMovmentDetails t1
			LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.tblUsers usr
			ON t1.UserFK = usr.UserPK
		END

		DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #PalletAuditWorksOrderMovmentTMSDetails0

		select 
		CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(50)) as StockInOutNumber, 
		'TMS' as RecordType, 
		TMSEmployeeClockCardDetailPK AS PK, 
		'TMS' as Origin, 
		'TMS' as EventType, 
		NULL as PalletFK, 
		UserFK, 
		EmployeeName,	
		EmployeeNumber,
		EventDateTime, 
		'n/a' as FromLocationType, 
		'n/a' as ToLocationType,
		'n/a' AS MovementType,
		Department AS DepartmentTMS,
		-1 AS StockItemFK, 
		CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(50)) AS StockItemCode, 
		CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(200)) AS StockItemName, 
		-1 AS DivisionFK, 
		CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(50)) AS DivisionCode, 
		CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(200)) AS DivisionName, 
		-1 AS CustomerFK, 
		CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(50)) AS CustomerCode, 
		CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(200)) AS CustomerName,
		Department AS TMSMachineBuilding
		into #PalletAuditWorksOrderMovmentTMSDetails0
		from #TMSDetailsFinal

		union

		select *, 'n/a' AS TMSMachineBuilding from #PalletAuditWorksOrderMovmentDetails

		DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #PalletAuditWorksOrderMovmentTMSDetails1

		SELECT 
		ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY UserFK ASC, EventDateTime ASC) AS RowNumber,
		* 
		INTO #PalletAuditWorksOrderMovmentTMSDetails1 
		FROM #PalletAuditWorksOrderMovmentTMSDetails0 

		-- Delete this as no longer needed.
		DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #PalletAuditWorksOrderMovmentTMSDetails0

		DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #results

		-- This is required to ensure the temporary table is created as it may not be in the user loop below.
		SELECT TOP 1 
		RowNumber,
		StockInOutNumber, RecordType, PK, Origin, EventType, PalletFK, UserFK, EmployeeName, EmployeeNumber, EventDateTime, 		
		FromLocationType, ToLocationType, MovementType, TMSMachineBuilding,
		CAST(NULL AS DATETIME) AS OriginalStartDateTime,
		CAST(NULL AS DATETIME) AS StartDateTime,
		CAST(NULL AS DATETIME) AS EndDateTime,
		CAST(0 AS INT) AS OriginalDurationInSeconds,
		CAST(0 AS INT) AS DurationInSeconds,
		CAST(0 AS BIT ) AS OriginalDurationIsGreaterThanLimit,
		CAST(0 AS BIT) AS IsStartOfNewTask,
		StockItemFK,
		StockItemCode,
		StockItemName,
		DivisionFK,
		DivisionCode,
		DivisionName,
		CustomerFK,
		CustomerCode,
		CustomerName
		INTO #results 
		FROM #PalletAuditWorksOrderMovmentTMSDetails1

		TRUNCATE TABLE #results

		DECLARE @selectedUser INT, @rowNumber2 INT

	GET_USER_LOOP:

		SELECT TOP 1 @selectedUser = UserFK, @rowNumber2 = RowNumber FROM #PalletAuditWorksOrderMovmentTMSDetails1 ORDER BY RowNumber ASC

		IF @selectedUser IS NULL GOTO EXIT_GET_USER_LOOP

		DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #temp

		SELECT DISTINCT 
		ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY EventDateTime ASC) AS RowNumber,
		RowNumber AS RowNumber2,
		StockInOutNumber, RecordType, PK, Origin, EventType, PalletFK, UserFK, EmployeeName, EmployeeNumber, 
		EventDateTime,
		CAST(NULL AS DATETIME) AS OriginalStartDateTime,
		cast(NULL AS datetime) AS StartDateTime,
		EventDateTime AS EndDateTime,
		FromLocationType, ToLocationType, MovementType, TMSMachineBuilding, CAST(0 AS BIT ) AS OriginalDurationIsGreaterThanLimit,
		CAST(0 AS BIT) AS IsStartOfNewTask,
		StockItemFK,
		StockItemCode,
		StockItemName,
		DivisionFK,
		DivisionCode,
		DivisionName,
		CustomerFK,
		CustomerCode,
		CustomerName
		INTO #temp
		FROM #PalletAuditWorksOrderMovmentTMSDetails1 
		WHERE UserFK = @selectedUser

		UPDATE currentRec
		SET StartDateTime = CASE WHEN prevRec.RecordType <> 'TMS' AND currentRec.RecordType <> 'TMS' THEN prevRec.EndDateTime END
		from #temp currentRec
		INNER JOIN #temp prevRec
		ON prevRec.RowNumber = currentRec.RowNumber - 1

		UPDATE #temp
		SET StartDateTime = EndDateTime
		WHERE StartDateTime IS NULL

		UPDATE #temp
		SET OriginalStartDateTime = StartDateTime

		UPDATE #temp
		SET OriginalDurationIsGreaterThanLimit = 1
		WHERE datediff(second, StartDateTime, EndDateTime) > 600 /* 600 seconds, i.e. 10 minutes*/

		INSERT INTO #results
		SELECT
		RowNumber2 AS RowNumber,
		StockInOutNumber, RecordType, PK, Origin, EventType, PalletFK, UserFK, EmployeeName, EmployeeNumber, EventDateTime, 		
		FromLocationType, ToLocationType, MovementType, TMSMachineBuilding, OriginalStartDateTime, StartDateTime, EndDateTime, 
		CAST(ROUND(CAST(ISNULL(DATEDIFF(MILLISECOND, OriginalStartDateTime, EndDateTime), 0) AS DECIMAL(18,2)) / 1000.00, 0) AS INT) AS OriginalDurationInSeconds,
		CAST(ROUND(CAST(ISNULL(DATEDIFF(MILLISECOND, StartDateTime, EndDateTime), 0) AS DECIMAL(18,2)) / 1000.00, 0) AS INT) AS DurationInSeconds, 
		OriginalDurationIsGreaterThanLimit,
		IsStartOfNewTask,
		StockItemFK,
		StockItemCode,
		StockItemName,
		DivisionFK,
		DivisionCode,
		DivisionName,
		CustomerFK,
		CustomerCode,
		CustomerName
		FROM #temp

		DELETE FROM #PalletAuditWorksOrderMovmentTMSDetails1 WHERE UserFK = @selectedUser

		SET @selectedUser = NULL

		GOTO GET_USER_LOOP

	EXIT_GET_USER_LOOP:

		-- Delete this as no longer needed.
		DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #PalletAuditWorksOrderMovmentTMSDetails1

		DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #results2

		SELECT * INTO #results2 FROM #results

	GET_USER_LOOP2:

		SELECT TOP 1 @selectedUser = UserFK FROM #results2 ORDER BY RowNumber ASC

		IF @selectedUser IS NULL GOTO EXIT_GET_USER_LOOP2

		DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #temp2	

		SELECT DISTINCT 
		ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY EventDateTime ASC) AS RowNumber,
		RowNumber AS RowNumber2,
		StockInOutNumber,
		StartDateTime,
		EndDateTime,
		OriginalDurationIsGreaterThanLimit,
		IsStartOfNewTask,
		StockItemFK,
		StockItemCode,
		StockItemName,
		DivisionFK,
		DivisionCode,
		DivisionName,
		CustomerFK,
		CustomerCode,
		CustomerName
		INTO #temp2
		FROM #results2 
		WHERE UserFK = @selectedUser

		UPDATE currentRec
		SET StartDateTime = currentRec.EndDateTime,
		IsStartOfNewTask = 1
		FROM #temp2 currentRec
		INNER JOIN #temp2 prevRec
		ON prevRec.RowNumber = currentRec.RowNumber - 1
		WHERE currentRec.OriginalDurationIsGreaterThanLimit = 1	
		AND currentRec.StockInOutNumber <> prevRec.StockInOutNumber

		DELETE FROM #temp2 WHERE OriginalDurationIsGreaterThanLimit = 0

		DELETE FROM #temp2 WHERE StartDateTime <> EndDateTime

		UPDATE r1
		SET StartDateTime = r2.EndDateTime,
		DurationInSeconds = 0,
		IsStartOfNewTask = r2.IsStartOfNewTask
		FROM #results r1
		INNER JOIN #temp2 r2
		ON r1.RowNumber = r2.RowNumber2

		DELETE FROM #results2 WHERE UserFK = @selectedUser

		SET @selectedUser = NULL

		GOTO GET_USER_LOOP2

	EXIT_GET_USER_LOOP2:

		INSERT INTO dbo.tblStoredProcedureLogging SELECT @varStoredProcedureName, 'DELETE FROM dbo.tblEmployeeActivityDetailsTmp started', dbo.GetBSTDate()

		DELETE t1
		FROM dbo.tblEmployeeActivityDetailsTmp t1
		WHERE CAST(t1.EventDateTime AS DATE) = @varStartDate
		AND t1.DataForBuilding = @varBuildingName

		SET @varRowCount = @@ROWCOUNT

		INSERT INTO dbo.tblStoredProcedureLogging SELECT @varStoredProcedureName, CAST(@varRowCount AS NVARCHAR(50)) + ' rows deleted from dbo.tblEmployeeActivityDetailsTmp', dbo.GetBSTDate()

		DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #employeeActivityDetails

		CREATE TABLE #employeeActivityDetails
		(
			StockInOutNumber NVARCHAR(50),	
			RecordType NVARCHAR(50),	
			PK INT,	
			Origin NVARCHAR(50),	
			EventType NVARCHAR(50),	
			PalletFK INT,	
			UserFK INT,	
			EmployeeName NVARCHAR(200),	
			EmployeeNumber NVARCHAR(50),
			EventDateTime DATETIME,	
			FromLocationType NVARCHAR(50),	
			ToLocationType NVARCHAR(50),
			MovementType NVARCHAR(50),	
			TMSMachineBuilding NVARCHAR(50),	
			OriginalStartDateTime DATETIME,	
			StartDateTime DATETIME,	
			EndDateTime	DATETIME,
			OriginalDurationInSeconds INT,
			DurationInSeconds INT,
			OriginalDurationIsGreaterThanLimit BIT,
			IsStartOfNewTask BIT,
			StockItemFK	INT,	
			DivisionFK INT,	
			CustomerFK INT,
			--[IsArchived] [bit] NOT NULL,
			--[InsertedBy] [int] NOT NULL,
			--[InsertedDate] [datetime] NOT NULL,
			--[UpdatedBy] [int] NOT NULL,
			--[UpdatedDate] [datetime] NOT NULL,
			DataForBuilding NVARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
			[JobTitle] NVARCHAR(200)
		)

		INSERT INTO #employeeActivityDetails
		SELECT DISTINCT
			r1.StockInOutNumber,	
			r1.RecordType,	
			r1.PK,	
			r1.Origin,	
			r1.EventType,	
			r1.PalletFK,	
			r1.UserFK,					
			CASE WHEN ISNULL(tms.EmployeeName, '') <> '' THEN tms.EmployeeName ELSE r1.EmployeeName END AS EmployeeName,
			r1.EmployeeNumber,
			r1.EventDateTime,	
			r1.FromLocationType,	
			r1.ToLocationType,
			r1.MovementType,	
			r1.TMSMachineBuilding,	
			r1.OriginalStartDateTime,	
			r1.StartDateTime,	
			r1.EndDateTime,
			r1.OriginalDurationInSeconds,
			r1.DurationInSeconds,
			r1.OriginalDurationIsGreaterThanLimit,
			r1.IsStartOfNewTask,
			r1.StockItemFK,	
			r1.DivisionFK,	
			r1.CustomerFK,
			--0/*IsArchived*/,
			--0/*InsertedBy*/,
			--dbo.GetBSTDate()/*InsertedDate*/,
			--0/*UpdatedBy*/,
			--dbo.GetBSTDate()/*UpdatedDate*/,
			@varBuildingName,
			PPL.JobTitle
		FROM 
			#results r1
		INNER JOIN dbo.tblUsers usr WITH (NOLOCK)
			ON r1.UserFK = usr.UserPK
		INNER JOIN dbo.tblPeople ppl WITH (NOLOCK)
			ON usr.PersonFK = ppl.PersonPK
		LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.tblTMSEmployeeClockCardDetails tms
			ON ppl.EmployeeNumber = CAST(tms.EmployeeNumber AS INT)
			AND CAST(tms.EmployeeNumber AS INT) > 0
		WHERE
			r1.EventDateTime <> @varStartDate -- ignore dummy records (search for "IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #TMSDetailsFinal) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM #PalletAuditWorksOrderMovmentDetails)" above.

		DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #employeeActivityDetailsScanning

		SELECT
			UserFK,
			ISNULL(Sum(ISNULL(DurationInSeconds,0)),0) AS TotalDurationInSeconds
		INTO
			#employeeActivityDetailsScanning
		FROM
			#employeeActivityDetails
		WHERE
			RecordType <> 'TMS'
		GROUP BY
			UserFK

		DELETE t1
		FROM #employeeActivityDetails t1
		INNER JOIN #employeeActivityDetailsScanning t2
		ON t1.UserFK = t2.UserFK
		WHERE
		(
			t1.JobTitle LIKE '%Admin%'
			OR t1.JobTitle LIKE '%Driver%'
			OR t1.JobTitle LIKE 'IT%'
			OR t1.JobTitle LIKE '%Mechanic%'
			OR t1.JobTitle LIKE '%Quality%'
			OR t1.JobTitle LIKE '%Manager%'
		)
		AND t2.TotalDurationInSeconds < 1

		DECLARE @varCurrentDateTime DATETIME = dbo.GetBSTDate()

		INSERT INTO dbo.tblStoredProcedureLogging SELECT @varStoredProcedureName, 'INSERT INTO dbo.tblEmployeeActivityDetailsTmp started', dbo.GetBSTDate()

		INSERT INTO dbo.tblEmployeeActivityDetailsTmp
		(
			StockInOutNumber,	
			RecordType,	
			PK,	
			Origin,	
			EventType,	
			PalletFK,	
			UserFK,	
			EmployeeName,	
			EmployeeNumber,
			EventDateTime,	
			FromLocationType,	
			ToLocationType,
			MovementType,	
			TMSMachineBuilding,	
			OriginalStartDateTime,	
			StartDateTime,	
			EndDateTime,
			OriginalDurationInSeconds,
			DurationInSeconds,
			OriginalDurationIsGreaterThanLimit,
			IsStartOfNewTask,
			StockItemFK,	
			DivisionFK,	
			CustomerFK,
			IsArchived,
			InsertedBy,
			InsertedDate,
			UpdatedBy,
			UpdatedDate,
			DataForBuilding
		)
		SELECT DISTINCT
			StockInOutNumber,	
			RecordType,	
			PK,	
			Origin,	
			EventType,	
			PalletFK,	
			UserFK,	
			EmployeeName,	
			EmployeeNumber,
			EventDateTime,	
			FromLocationType,	
			ToLocationType,
			MovementType,	
			TMSMachineBuilding,	
			OriginalStartDateTime,	
			StartDateTime,	
			EndDateTime,
			OriginalDurationInSeconds,
			DurationInSeconds,
			OriginalDurationIsGreaterThanLimit,
			IsStartOfNewTask,
			StockItemFK,	
			DivisionFK,	
			CustomerFK,
			--IsArchived,
			--InsertedBy,
			--InsertedDate,
			--UpdatedBy,
			--UpdatedDate,
			0/*IsArchived*/,
			0/*InsertedBy*/,
			@varCurrentDateTime/*InsertedDate*/,
			0/*UpdatedBy*/,
			@varCurrentDateTime/*UpdatedDate*/,
			DataForBuilding
		FROM
			#employeeActivityDetails

		SET @varRowCount = @@ROWCOUNT

		INSERT INTO dbo.tblStoredProcedureLogging SELECT @varStoredProcedureName, CAST(@varRowCount AS NVARCHAR(50)) + ' rows inserted into dbo.tblEmployeeActivityDetailsTmp', dbo.GetBSTDate()

		INSERT INTO dbo.tblStoredProcedureLogging SELECT @varStoredProcedureName, 'Proc execution completed', dbo.GetBSTDate()
	END TRY
	BEGIN CATCH
		SELECT @varErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE(), @varErrorSeverity = ERROR_SEVERITY(), @varErrorState = ERROR_STATE()

		INSERT INTO dbo.tblStoredProcedureLogging SELECT @varStoredProcedureName, 'ERROR MESSAGE - ' + @varErrorMessage, dbo.GetBSTDate()

		RAISERROR (@varErrorMessage,@varErrorSeverity,@varErrorState)
	END CATCH
END

-- ============================================================
-- 1. usp_GetBuildings
--    Returns all active buildings for the Building dropdown.
-- ============================================================
CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[usp_GetBuildings]
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    SELECT
        Buildingpk      AS [BuildingID],
        BuildingName
    FROM
        tblBuildings
    WHERE
        isarchived = 0
    ORDER BY
        BuildingName;
END

-- ============================================================
-- 2. usp_GetBuildingUnits
--    Returns all active building units for a given building.
--    @BuildingFK  INT  — the BuildingID from usp_GetBuildings
-- ============================================================
CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[usp_GetBuildingUnits]
    @BuildingFK INT
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    SELECT
        BuildingUnitpk  AS [BuildingUnitID],
        BuildingUnit    AS [BuildingUnitName],
        BuildingUnitPK  AS [BuildingUnitFK]
    FROM
        tblBuildingUnits
    WHERE
        isarchived  = 0
        AND BuildingFK = @BuildingFK
    ORDER BY
        BuildingUnitName;
END

/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[usp_GetDriveThruRacking]    Script Date: 02/11/2026 17:47:28 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
-- ============================================================
-- 4. usp_GetRacking
--    Returns all active non-A/B racking locations for a unit.
--    @BuildingUnitFK  INT
-- ============================================================
create   PROCEDURE [dbo].[usp_GetDriveThruRacking]
    @BuildingUnitFK INT
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    SELECT
        Location,
        Barcode,
        BayLevel,
        Row
    FROM
    (
        SELECT
            CASE
                WHEN buRows.Translate = CAST(1 AS BIT) THEN
                    CASE
                        WHEN buRows.ReverseTranslate = CAST(1 AS BIT) THEN
                            buRows.TranslatedRow
                            + RIGHT('0' + CAST((buRows.TranslateColumn - buCols.BuildingUnitColumn) AS NVARCHAR(10)), 2)
                            + CASE WHEN buRows.RackingTypeFK = 1 THEN LOWER(buBays.BayLevel) ELSE '' END
                        ELSE
                            buRows.TranslatedRow
                            + RIGHT('0' + CAST((buCols.BuildingUnitColumn + buRows.TranslateColumn) AS NVARCHAR(10)), 2)
                            + CASE WHEN buRows.RackingTypeFK = 1 THEN LOWER(buBays.BayLevel) ELSE '' END
                    END
                ELSE
                    buRows.Row
                    + RIGHT('0' + CAST(buCols.BuildingUnitColumnName AS NVARCHAR(10)), 2)
                    + CASE WHEN buRows.RackingTypeFK = 1 THEN LOWER(buBays.BayLevel) ELSE '' END
            END                         AS Location,
            buBays.Barcode,
            buBays.BuildingUnitBayPK,
            buBays.BayLevel,
            buCols.BuildingUnitColumn,
            buRows.Row,
            buBays.InsertedDate
        FROM
            tblBuildingUnitBays  buBays
            INNER JOIN tblBuildingUnitColumns buCols
                ON buCols.BuildingUnitColumnPK = buBays.BuildingUnitColumnFK
            INNER JOIN tblBuildingUnitRows buRows
                ON buRows.BuildingUnitRowPK = buCols.BuildingUnitRowFK
        WHERE
            buRows.BuildingUnitFK = @BuildingUnitFK
            AND buBays.isarchived  = 0
            AND buBays.BayLevel    IN ('a' )
    ) subQ
    ORDER BY
        BayLevel,
        Row,
        BuildingUnitColumn;
END

-- ============================================================
-- 4. usp_GetRacking
--    Returns all active non-A/B racking locations for a unit.
--    @BuildingUnitFK  INT
-- ============================================================
CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[usp_GetRacking]
    @BuildingUnitFK INT
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    SELECT
        Location,
        Barcode,
        BayLevel,
        Row
    FROM
    (
        SELECT
            CASE
                WHEN buRows.Translate = CAST(1 AS BIT) THEN
                    CASE
                        WHEN buRows.ReverseTranslate = CAST(1 AS BIT) THEN
                            buRows.TranslatedRow
                            + RIGHT('0' + CAST((buRows.TranslateColumn - buCols.BuildingUnitColumn) AS NVARCHAR(10)), 2)
                            + CASE WHEN buRows.RackingTypeFK = 1 THEN LOWER(buBays.BayLevel) ELSE '' END
                        ELSE
                            buRows.TranslatedRow
                            + RIGHT('0' + CAST((buCols.BuildingUnitColumn + buRows.TranslateColumn) AS NVARCHAR(10)), 2)
                            + CASE WHEN buRows.RackingTypeFK = 1 THEN LOWER(buBays.BayLevel) ELSE '' END
                    END
                ELSE
                    buRows.Row
                    + RIGHT('0' + CAST(buCols.BuildingUnitColumnName AS NVARCHAR(10)), 2)
                    + CASE WHEN buRows.RackingTypeFK = 1 THEN LOWER(buBays.BayLevel) ELSE '' END
            END                         AS Location,
            buBays.Barcode,
            buBays.BuildingUnitBayPK,
            buBays.BayLevel,
            buCols.BuildingUnitColumn,
            buRows.Row,
            buBays.InsertedDate
        FROM
            tblBuildingUnitBays  buBays
            INNER JOIN tblBuildingUnitColumns buCols
                ON buCols.BuildingUnitColumnPK = buBays.BuildingUnitColumnFK
            INNER JOIN tblBuildingUnitRows buRows
                ON buRows.BuildingUnitRowPK = buCols.BuildingUnitRowFK
        WHERE
            buRows.BuildingUnitFK = @BuildingUnitFK
            AND buBays.isarchived  = 0
            AND buBays.BayLevel   NOT IN ('a', 'b')
    ) subQ
    ORDER BY
     location,
      row  
END

/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[usp_GetRackingAB]    Script Date: 02/11/2026 17:47:28 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO

-- ============================================================
-- 5. usp_GetRackingAB
--    Returns A+B conventional racking, pairing each A bay with
--    its corresponding B bay on a single row.
--    Result columns: LocationA, BarcodeA, LocationB, BarcodeB
--    @BuildingUnitFK  INT
-- ============================================================
CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[usp_GetRackingAB]
    @BuildingUnitFK INT
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    -- Build the full A+B location set into a temp table
    DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #AllBays;

    SELECT
        CASE
            WHEN buRows.Translate = CAST(1 AS BIT) THEN
                CASE
                    WHEN buRows.ReverseTranslate = CAST(1 AS BIT) THEN
                        buRows.TranslatedRow
                        + RIGHT('0' + CAST((buRows.TranslateColumn - buCols.BuildingUnitColumn) AS NVARCHAR(10)), 2)
                        + CASE WHEN buRows.RackingTypeFK = 1 THEN LOWER(buBays.BayLevel) ELSE '' END
                    ELSE
                        buRows.TranslatedRow
                        + RIGHT('0' + CAST((buCols.BuildingUnitColumn + buRows.TranslateColumn) AS NVARCHAR(10)), 2)
                        + CASE WHEN buRows.RackingTypeFK = 1 THEN LOWER(buBays.BayLevel) ELSE '' END
                END
            ELSE
                buRows.Row
                + RIGHT('0' + CAST(buCols.BuildingUnitColumnName AS NVARCHAR(10)), 2)
                + CASE WHEN buRows.RackingTypeFK = 1 THEN LOWER(buBays.BayLevel) ELSE '' END
        END                             AS Location,
        buBays.Barcode,
        buBays.BuildingUnitBayPK,
        buBays.BayLevel,
        buCols.BuildingUnitColumn,
        buRows.Row,
        buCols.BuildingUnitColumnPK
    INTO #AllBays
    FROM
        tblBuildingUnitBays  buBays
        INNER JOIN tblBuildingUnitColumns buCols
            ON buCols.BuildingUnitColumnPK = buBays.BuildingUnitColumnFK
        INNER JOIN tblBuildingUnitRows buRows
            ON buRows.BuildingUnitRowPK = buCols.BuildingUnitRowFK
    WHERE
        buRows.BuildingUnitFK = @BuildingUnitFK
        AND buBays.Width      > 0
        AND buBays.BayLevel   IN ('a', 'b')
        AND buBays.isarchived  = 0;

    -- Pivot: start with Level A rows, then join Level B
    DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #Paired;

    SELECT
        [Location]                      AS LocationA,
        Barcode                         AS BarcodeA,
        CAST(NULL AS NVARCHAR(50))      AS LocationB,
        CAST(NULL AS NVARCHAR(50))      AS BarcodeB
    INTO #Paired
    FROM #AllBays
    WHERE RIGHT([Location], 1) = 'a';

    UPDATE p
    SET
        p.LocationB = b.[Location],
        p.BarcodeB  = b.Barcode
    FROM #Paired p
    INNER JOIN #AllBays b
        ON LEFT(p.LocationA, LEN(p.LocationA) - 1) = LEFT(b.Location, LEN(b.Location) - 1)
    WHERE RIGHT(b.[Location], 1) = 'b';

    SELECT LocationA, BarcodeA, LocationB, BarcodeB
    FROM   #Paired;
END

GO

-- ============================================================

--    @BuildingUnitFK  INT
-- ============================================================
CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[usp_GetSetdownAreas]
    @BuildingUnitFK INT
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    SELECT
        SetdownArea,
        Barcode
    FROM
        tblSetdownAreas
    WHERE
        BuildingUnitFK = @BuildingUnitFK
        AND isarchived  = 0;
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[ZZZ_Obsolete_spAutoCompleteDistributionCountries]
(
	@q nvarchar(100) = '',
	@PK int = -1,
	@distributionCustomerFK int = -1
)	
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT
 ,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;
	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	DECLARE @q2 nvarchar(100), @PK2 int, @distributionCustomerFK2 int
	SET @q2 = @q; SET @PK2 = @PK; SET @distributionCustomerFK2 = @distributionCustomerFK

	SET @ParameterDetails = '@q = ' + ISNULL(@q2,'') + ',@PK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@PK2 AS NVARCHAR(100)),'')
		+ ',@distributionCustomerFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@distributionCustomerFK2 AS NVARCHAR(100)),'')

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    --BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

		SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END


	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY
			

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start

			IF(@PK2 = -1)
			BEGIN
				Select Top 10 countries.CountryPK, Country as SearchField
				from tblcountries countries 
				where Country like @q2 + '%'
				AND CountryPK in 
				(Select CountryFK from tblCustomerDistributionCountries
				Where CustomerFK = @distributionCustomerFK2)          
			END
			ELSE
			BEGIN
				Select countries.CountryPK, Country as SearchField
				from tblCountries countries 
				where CountryPK = @PK2
			END

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end

			
			
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[ZZZ_Obsolete_spBuildingUnitBayGetFreeBayPosition]
(
	@buildingUnitBayPK int,
	@palletPK int
)
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT
 ,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;
	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	DECLARE @buildingUnitBayPK2 int, @palletPK2 int
	SET @buildingUnitBayPK2 = @buildingUnitBayPK; SET @palletPK2 = @palletPK

	SET @ParameterDetails = '@buildingUnitBayPK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@buildingUnitBayPK2 AS NVARCHAR(100)),'') + '@palletPK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@palletPK2 AS NVARCHAR(100)),'')

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    --BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

		SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END


	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY
			

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start

			Declare @width int

			Select 
				@width = palletTypes.Width + (WidthMargin * 2)
			From tblPallets pallets
			inner join (
				Select PalletFK, StockItemFK from tblPalletContent
				Group By PalletFK, StockItemFK
			) pc on
				pc.PalletFK = pallets.PalletPK
			inner join tblStockItems stockItems on
				stockItems.StockItemPK = pc.StockItemFK
			inner join tblPalletTypes palletTypes on
				palletTypes.PalletTypePK = pallets.PalletTypeFK
			Where 
				PalletPK = @palletPK2

			--	Select @width = Width + (@widthMargin * 2), @depth = Depth + (@depthMargin * 2) from tblPalletTypes
			--	Where PalletTypePK = @palletTypePK

			Select --BuildingUnit,
			--		Row,
			--		BuildingUnitColumn,
			--		BayLevel,
					case when GapBetweenPalletsBayPosition is not null then GapBetweenPalletsBayPosition 
					when EndBayPosition is not null then EndBayPosition
					when StartBayPosition is not null then StartBayPosition
					when EntireEmptyGap is not null then 1
					END as BayPosition
			--		case when GapBetweenPalletsBayPosition is not null then GapBetweenPalletsPalletStart 
			--		when EndBayPosition is not null then EndBayPalletStart
			--		when StartBayPosition is not null then 0
			--		when EntireEmptyGap is not null then 0
			--		END as PalletStart,
			--		case when GapBetweenPalletsBayPosition is not null then GapBetweenPalletsPalletStart + ' + cast(@width as nvarchar(100)) + '
			--		when EndBayPosition is not null then EndBayPalletStart + ' + cast(@width as nvarchar(100)) + '
			--		when StartBayPosition is not null then ' + cast(@width as nvarchar(100)) + ' 
			--		when EntireEmptyGap is not null then ' + cast(@width as nvarchar(100)) + ' 
			--		END as PalletEnd,
			--		LocationFK
				 
							  FROM (

					Select Distinct * from (

			Select (gapRight.PalletStart - pallets.PalletEnd) as GapBetweenPallets,
			case isnull(gapRight.PalletStart,0) when 0 then null else pallets.BayPosition + 1 END as GapBetweenPalletsBayPosition,
			case isnull(gapRight.PalletStart,0) when 0 then null else pallets.PalletEnd END as GapBetweenPalletsPalletStart,
			(buBays.Width - lastPallet.PalletEnd) as GapToEndOfBay,
			case isnull(lastPallet.PalletEnd, 0) when 0 then null else lastPallet.BayPosition + 1 END as EndBayPosition,
			case isnull(lastPallet.PalletEnd, 0) when 0 then null else lastPallet.PalletEnd END as EndBayPalletStart,
			(firstPallet.PalletStart) as GapToStartOfBay,
			case isnull(firstPallet.PalletStart, 0) when 0 then null else 1 END as StartBayPosition, NULL as EntireEmptyGap,
			buBays.Width, buBays.MaximumDepth, buBays.MinimumDepth, buBays.Height, bus.BuildingUnit, buRows.Row, buColumns.BuildingUnitColumn, buBays.BayLevel, pallets.LocationFK 
			from tblPallets pallets
			inner join tblBuildingUnitBays buBays on
			buBays.BuildingUnitBayPK = pallets.LocationFK

			left outer join tblPallets gapRight on
			gapRight.LocationTypeFK = 1
			AND gapRight.StackPosition = 0
			AND gapRight.LocationFK = pallets.LocationFK
			AND gapRight.BayPosition = pallets.BayPosition + 1 
			AND gapRight.PalletStart <> pallets.PalletEnd
			AND gapRight.IsArchived = 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/

			left outer join (Select Max(BayPosition) BayPosition, LocationTypeFK, LocationFK, StackPosition, Max(PalletEnd) as PalletEnd 
							from tblPallets 
							Where IsArchived = 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/
								Group By LocationTypeFK, LocationFK, StackPosition) lastPallet on
			lastPallet.LocationTypeFK = 1
			AND lastPallet.StackPosition = 0
			AND lastPallet.LocationFK = pallets.LocationFK
			AND lastPallet.PalletEnd <> buBays.Width

			left outer join (Select Min(BayPosition) BayPosition, LocationTypeFK, LocationFK, StackPosition, Min(PalletStart) as PalletStart 
							from tblPallets 
							Where IsArchived = 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/
								Group By LocationTypeFK, LocationFK, StackPosition) firstPallet on
			firstPallet.LocationTypeFK = 1
			AND firstPallet.StackPosition = 0
			AND firstPallet.PalletStart <> 0
			AND firstPallet.LocationFK = pallets.LocationFK

			/***** INNER JOIN LOCATION INFORMATION *****/
			Inner join tblBuildingUnitColumns buColumns on
			buColumns.BuildingUnitColumnPK = buBays.BuildingUnitColumnFK

			Inner join tblBuildingUnitRows buRows on
			buRows.BuildingUnitRowPK = buColumns.BuildingUnitRowFK

			Inner join tblBuildingUnits bus on
			bus.BuildingUnitPK = buRows.BuildingUnitFK

			Where pallets.LocationTypeFK = 1 --BuildingUnitBay
			AND pallets.StackPosition = 0
			AND pallets.LocationFK = @buildingUnitBayPK2
			AND pallets.IsArchived = 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/

			) subQ


			UNION --UNION All the empty Bays

			Select NULL/*Gap BetweenPallets*/, NULL /*BayPosition*/, NULL /*PalletStart*/, NULL/*GapToEndOfBay*/, NULL/*Bayposition*/, NULL /*PalletStart*/,
			NULL/*GapToStartOfBay*/, NULL/*HayPosition*/, buBays.Width as EntireEmptyGap,
			buBays.Width, buBays.MaximumDepth, buBays.MinimumDepth, buBays.Height, bus.BuildingUnit, buRows.Row, buColumns.BuildingUnitColumn, buBays.BayLevel, buBays.BuildingUnitBayPK 
			from tblBuildingUnitBays buBays

			Inner join tblBuildingUnitColumns buColumns on
			buColumns.BuildingUnitColumnPK = buBays.BuildingUnitColumnFK

			Inner join tblBuildingUnitRows buRows on
			buRows.BuildingUnitRowPK = buColumns.BuildingUnitRowFK

			Inner join tblBuildingUnits bus on
			bus.BuildingUnitPK = buRows.BuildingUnitFK

			left outer join tblPallets pallets on
			pallets.LocationFK = buBays.BuildingUnitBayPK
			AND pallets.LocationTypeFK = 1/*BuildingUnitBay-*/
			AND pallets.IsArchived = 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/

			where pallets.PalletPK is null
				AND buBays.BuildingUnitBayPK = @buildingUnitBayPK2
			)mainQuery

			Where
				(GapBetweenPallets >= @width
									OR GapToEndOfBay >= @width
									OR GapToStartOfBay >= @width
									OR EntireEmptyGap >= @width)
		          
			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end

			
			
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END
GO

-- =============================================
