-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[ZZZ_Obsolete_spBuildingUnitForStockItem]
(
	@divisionFK int,
	@stockItemFK int
)
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT
 ,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;
	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	DECLARE @divisionFK2 int, @stockItemFK2 int
	SET @divisionFK2 = @divisionFK; SET @stockItemFK2 = @stockItemFK

	SET @ParameterDetails = '@divisionFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@divisionFK2 AS NVARCHAR(100)),'') + ',@stockItemFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@stockItemFK2 AS NVARCHAR(100)),'')

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    --BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

		SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END


	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY
			

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start

			IF(EXISTS(
						Select Top 1 BuildingUnitFK
						from tblPallets pals
						inner join (
							Select StockItemFK, PalletFK
							from tblPalletContent pc
							Group By StockItemFK, PalletFK
						)pc on
						pc.PalletFK = pals.PalletPK
						Where pals.IsArchived = 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/
						AND pc.StockItemFK = @stockItemFK2)
						) 
			BEGIN
				--Select based on content
				Select Top 1 pals.BuildingUnitFK, lbs.LoadingBayPK
				from tblPallets pals
				inner join (
					Select StockItemFK, PalletFK
					from tblPalletContent pc
					Group By StockItemFK, PalletFK
				)pc on
				pc.PalletFK = pals.PalletPK
				inner join (
					Select MAX(LoadingBayPK) LoadingBayPK, BuildingUnitFK
					from tblLoadingBays
					Group By BuildingUnitFK
				) lbs on
				lbs.BuildingUnitFK = pals.BuildingUnitFK
				Where pals.IsArchived = 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/
				AND pc.StockItemFK = @stockItemFK2
			END 
			ELSE 
			BEGIN
				Select Top 1 BuildingUnitFK, LoadingBayFK from (
				Select DISTINCT COALESCE(sibus.BuildingUnitFK, dbus.BuildingUnitFK) AS BuildingUnitFK,
				COALESCE(silbs.LoadingBayFK, dlbs.LoadingBayFK) LoadingBayFK from tblStockItems sis
				left outer join tblDivisionBuildingUnits dbus on
				dbus.DivisionFK = sis.DivisionFK
				left outer join (
					Select BuildingUnitFK, max(LoadingBayPK) LoadingBayFK
					from tblLoadingBays
					Group By BuildingUnitFK
				) dlbs on
				dlbs.BuildingUnitFK = dbus.BuildingUnitFK
				left outer join tblStockItemBuildingUnits sibus on
				sibus.StockItemFK = sis.StockItemPK
				left outer join (
					Select BuildingUnitFK, max(LoadingBayPK) LoadingBayFK
					from tblLoadingBays
					Group By BuildingUnitFK
				) silbs on
				silbs.BuildingUnitFK = sibus.BuildingUnitFK
				Where sis.DivisionFK = @divisionFK2 
				AND sis.StockItemPK = @stockItemFK2
				) subQ
			END
			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end

			
			
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END

-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[ZZZ_Obsolete_spBuildingUnitForStockItemCodes]
(
	@divisionFK int,
	@stockItemCodes nvarchar(max)
)
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT
 ,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;
	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	DECLARE @divisionFK2 int, @stockItemCodes2 nvarchar(max)
	SET @divisionFK2 = @divisionFK; SET @stockItemCodes2 = @stockItemCodes

	SET @ParameterDetails = '@divisionFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@divisionFK2 AS NVARCHAR(100)),'') + ',@stockItemCodes = ' + ISNULL(@stockItemCodes2,'')

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    --BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

		SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END



	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY
			

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start

			DECLARE @stockBuildingUnits TABLE
			(
				BuildingUnitFK int,
				RuleType nvarchar(50)
			)

			INSERT into @stockBuildingUnits
			Select  
			case when sibus.StockItemFK is null then dbus.BuildingUnitFK else sibus.BuildingUnitFK end BuildingUnitFK ,
			case when sibus.StockItemFK is null then 'Division' else 'StockItem' end RuleType 
			FROM
			(Select StockItemPK, StockItemCode from tblStockItems where DivisionFK = @divisionFK2 and IsArchived = 0) sis
			LEFT OUTER join tblStockItemBuildingUnits sibus on
			sibus.StockItemFK = sis.StockItemPK 
			INNER JOIN tblDivisionBuildingUnits dbus on
			dbus.DivisionFK = @divisionFK2
			--AND IsDefault=1/*cast(1 as bit)*/
			Where CHARINDEX('''' + StockItemCode + '''', @stockItemCodes2) > 0

			IF((Select count(*) from (Select Distinct BuildingUnitFK from @stockBuildingUnits) subQ) = 1) 
			BEGIN
				--Only one building unit, easy
				Print 'A1 - Only building unit listed, easy'

				Select Top 1 sBUs.BuildingUnitFK, LoadingBayPK LoadingBayFK
				From @stockBuildingUnits sBUs 
				INNER JOIN tblLoadingBays lBays on
				lBays.BuildingUnitFK = sBUs.BuildingUnitFK
			END 
			ELSE 
			BEGIN
				--we have more than one building unit, check if one of them uses the division BU, if an item does then we have to go with the Division BU
				IF (EXISTS(Select * from @stockBuildingUnits Where RuleType = 'Division')) 
				BEGIN
					--OK, we have a division rule which takes precedent
					Print 'B1 - Multiple BUs but we have a division rule'

					Select Top 1 BuildingUnitFK, DefaultLoadingBayFK LoadingBayFK
					from tblDivisionBuildingUnits
					Where DivisionFK = @divisionFK2
					Order By IsDefault desc
				END 
				ELSE 
				BEGIN
					--So we have more than one BU listed and no division BUs, select the BU with the most entries
					Print 'C1 - No Division BUs picked the most common StockItem BU'

					Select Top 1 subQ.BuildingUnitFK, LoadingBayPK LoadingBayFK
					From
					(
						Select BuildingUnitFK, count(*) Entries
						From @stockBuildingUnits
						Group By BuildingUnitFK
					) subQ
					INNER JOIN tblLoadingBays lBays on
					lBays.BuildingUnitFK = subQ.BuildingUnitFK
					Order By Entries DESC, BuildingUnitFK
				END
			END

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end

			
			
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END
GO

-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Clerkin, Jamie>
-- Create date: <07/30/2015>
-- Description:	<Delete a building unit row, and also its child columns and cells>
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[ZZZ_Obsolete_spBuildingUnitRowDelete]
(
	@BuildingUnitRowPK int
)
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT
 ,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;
	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	DECLARE @BuildingUnitRowPK2 INT

	SET @BuildingUnitRowPK2 = @BuildingUnitRowPK

	SET @ParameterDetails = '@BuildingUnitRowPK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@BuildingUnitRowPK2 AS NVARCHAR(20)),'')

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    --BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

		SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END


	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY
			IF XACT_STATE() = 0 AND @@TRANCOUNT < 1 BEGIN TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start

			DELETE bub FROM tblbuildingunitbays bub
			INNER JOIN tblbuildingunitcolumns buc ON buc.buildingunitcolumnpk = bub.buildingunitcolumnfk
			WHERE buc.buildingunitrowfk = @BuildingUnitRowPK2

			DELETE FROM tblbuildingunitcolumns WHERE buildingunitrowfk = @BuildingUnitRowPK2
	
			DELETE FROM tblbuildingunitrows WHERE buildingunitrowpk = @BuildingUnitRowPK2

			SELECT cast(1 as bit) as Complete /*indicates success*/

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end

			BEGIN TRY IF XACT_STATE() = 1 AND @@TRANCOUNT = 1 AND @OpeningTranCount < 1 COMMIT TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH
			
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END
GO

-- =============================================  
-- Author:  <Author,,Name>  -- Create date: <Create Date,,>  
-- Description: <Description,,>  
-- =============================================  
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[ZZZ_Obsolete_spDistributionGetPalletContent]
(   
	@stockItemFK int,   
	@requiredUnits decimal(18,3) 
)
AS  
BEGIN
  
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT
 ,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;
	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	DECLARE @stockItemFK2 int, @requiredUnits2 decimal(18,3)

	SET @stockItemFK2 = @stockItemFK; SET @requiredUnits2 = @requiredUnits

	SET @ParameterDetails = '@stockItemFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@stockItemFK2 AS NVARCHAR(20)),'') + '@requiredUnits = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@requiredUnits2 AS NVARCHAR(30)),'')

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    --BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

		SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END


	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY
			

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start     

			IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#tblDistributionPalletContent') IS NOT NULL
				DROP TABLE #tblDistributionPalletContent 

			CREATE TABLE #tblDistributionPalletContent
			(
				ResponsibleBuildingUnitFK int, 
				DivisionFK int, 
				Batch nvarchar(200), 
				PalletContentFK int, 
				Pallets int, 
				Quantity decimal(18,3), 
				BatchQuantity decimal(18,3)
			)   

			Declare @responsibleBuildingUnitFK int,
			 @divisionFK int, 
			@batch nvarchar(200), 
			@palletContentFK int, 
			@eaches decimal(18,3),
			 @units decimal(18,3)        

			DECLARE distributionPalletContent CURSOR FAST_FORWARD   FOR     
				Select case when pallets.LocationTypeFK = 1/*RackBay*/ then buRows.BuildingUnitFK when pallets.LocationTypeFK = 2/*LoadingBay*/then 
				loadingBays.BuildingUnitFK when pallets.LocationTypeFK = 3/*SetDownArea*/ then setDownAreas.BuildingUnitFK end ResponsibleBuildingUnitFK,   
				stockItems.DivisionFK, 
				palletContent.Batch, 
				palletContent.PalletContentPK, 
				case when palletContent.AvailableEaches > 0 then 
					palletContent.AvailableEaches 
				else 
					palletContent.AvailableUnits end AvailableUnits   

				from tblStockItems stockItems   
				inner join tblPalletContent palletContent on palletContent.StockItemFK = stockItems.StockItemPK AND palletContent.IsArchived = 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/
				left outer join (    
					select PalletPK, case when woms.DestinationFK is not null then woms.DestinationFK else subPallets.LocationFK end as LocationFK, 
					case when woms.DestinationBayPosition is not null then woms.DestinationBayPosition else subPallets.BayPosition end as BayPosition, 
					case when woms.DestinationLocationTypeFK is not null then woms.DestinationLocationTypeFK else subPallets.LocationTypeFK end as LocationTypeFK 
					from tblPallets subPallets   
					left outer join tblWorksOrderMovements woms on   woms.PalletFK = subPallets.PalletPK AND woms.WorksOrderStatusFK <> 3/*Not completed*/ AND subPallets.IsArchived = 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/
				) pallets on pallets.PalletPK = palletContent.PalletFK  
				
				left outer join tblBuildingUnitBays buBays on    pallets.LocationTypeFK = 1 /*BuildingUnitBay*/   AND buBays.BuildingUnitBayPK = pallets.LocationFK   
				left outer join tblBuildingUnitColumns buCols on    buCols.BuildingUnitColumnPK = buBays.BuildingUnitColumnFK   
				left outer join tblBuildingUnitRows buRows on    buRows.BuildingUnitRowPK = buCols.BuildingUnitRowFK   
				left outer join tblLoadingBays loadingBays on    pallets.LocationTypeFK = 2/*LoadingBays*/    AND loadingBays.LoadingBayPK = pallets.LocationFK   
				left outer join tblSetDownAreas setDownAreas on    pallets.LocationTypeFK = 3/*SetDownAreas*/ AND setDownAreas.SetDownAreaPK = pallets.LocationFK   

				where stockItems.StockItemPK = @stockItemFK2   
				AND (palletContent.AvailableEaches > 0 OR palletContent.AvailableUnits > 0)   

				ORDER BY      (Case when buBays.BayLevel = 'a' then '0'     
								when buBays.BayLevel = 'b' then '1'    
								when buBays.BayLevel = 'c' then '2'      
								when buBays.BayLevel is null then '99' else buBays.BayLevel End) Asc,     
								buCols.BuildingUnitColumn Desc, 
								pallets.BayPosition Desc, buRows.RowNumber     

			OPEN distributionPalletContent     
			FETCH NEXT FROM distributionPalletContent   
				INTO @responsibleBuildingUnitFK, @divisionFK, @batch, @palletContentFK, @units     

			Declare @orderUnits decimal(18,3), @pallets int
			   
			WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 AND @requiredUnits2 > 0   
			BEGIN    
				if(@requiredUnits2 >=@units)    
				BEGIN     
					Set @orderUnits = @units     
					Set @requiredUnits2 = @requiredUnits2 - @units     
					Set @pallets = 1    
				END 
				ELSE 
				BEGIN
					Set @orderUnits = @requiredUnits2     
					Set @pallets = 0     
					Set @requiredUnits2 = 0    
				END   

				insert into #tblDistributionPalletContent    
				values(@responsibleBuildingUnitFK, @divisionFK, @batch, @palletContentFK, @pallets, @orderUnits, -1)      

				FETCH NEXT FROM distributionPalletContent    
				INTO @responsibleBuildingUnitFK, @divisionFK, @batch, @palletContentFK, @units   
			END 
			    
			CLOSE distributionPalletContent   
			DEALLOCATE distributionPalletContent     

			update dpc WITH (ROWLOCK)   
			set dpc.BatchQuantity = dpcSummed.SummedQuantity   
			from #tblDistributionPalletContent dpc   
			inner join (    
				Select Batch, sum(quantity) SummedQuantity   from #tblDistributionPalletContent
				Group By Batch
			) dpcSummed on   
			dpc.Batch = dpcSummed.Batch     

			Select * from #tblDistributionPalletContent Order by Batch  --END        

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end

			
			
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END
GO

-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[ZZZ_Obsolete_spFixedLocationsGetRefillPallet]
(
	-- this fixed location is empty
	@fixedLocationFK int,
	--if a location is to be replenished then it should be topped up else a movement will be made
	@isReplenished bit
)
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT
 ,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;
	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	DECLARE @fixedLocationFK2 int, @isReplenished2 bit

	SET @fixedLocationFK2 = @fixedLocationFK; SET @isReplenished2 = @isReplenished

	SET @ParameterDetails = '@fixedLocationFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@fixedLocationFK2 AS NVARCHAR(20)),'') + ',@isReplenished = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@isReplenished2 AS NVARCHAR(20)),'') 

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    --BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

		SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END


	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY
			

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start

			if @isReplenished2 = 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/
			BEGIN
				Select isnull(subQ.PalletPK, -1) AS PalletPK, cast(0 as bit) AS Topup, StockItemCode, Batch, ActualUnits
				From (Select 1 as OneRecord) scalarRecord
				left outer join (
				Select Top 1 PalletPK, sis.StockItemCode, pc.Batch, pc.ActualUnits from tblStockItemFixedLocations sifls
				inner join tblPalletContent pc on
				pc.StockItemFK = sifls.StockItemFK
				inner join tblStockItems sis on
				sis.StockItemPK = pc.StockItemFK
				inner join tblPallets pallets on
				pallets.PalletPK = pc.PalletFK
				AND pallets.LocationTypeFK = 1/*Racking*/

				inner join tblPalletTypes palletTypes on
				palletTypes.PalletTypePK = pallets.PalletTypeFK

				inner join tblBuildingUnitBays siflsbuBays on
				siflsbuBays.BuildingUnitBayPK = sifls.BuildingUnitBayFK
				inner join tblBuildingUnitColumns siflsbuCols on
				siflsbuCols.BuildingUnitColumnPK = siflsbuBays.BuildingUnitColumnFK
				inner join tblBuildingUnitRows siflsbuRows on
				siflsbuRows.BuildingUnitRowPK = siflsbuCols.BuildingUnitRowFK

				inner join tblBuildingUnitBays palletbuBays on
				palletbuBays.BuildingUnitBayPK = pallets.LocationFK
				inner join tblBuildingUnitColumns palletbuCols on
				palletbuCols.BuildingUnitColumnPK = palletbuBays.BuildingUnitColumnFK
				inner join tblBuildingUnitRows palletbuRows on
				palletbuRows.BuildingUnitRowPK = palletbuCols.BuildingUnitRowFK

				left outer join tblWorksOrderMovements woms on
				woms.PalletFK = pallets.PalletPK
				AND woms.WorksOrderStatusFK <> 3 /*Not Completed*/

				where sifls.StockItemFixedLocationPK = @fixedLocationFK2
				AND siflsbuRows.BuildingUnitFK = palletbuRows.BuildingUnitFK
				AND (sifls.LocationEnd - sifls.LocationStart) >= palletTypes.Width --make sure will fit
				AND woms.WorksOrderMovementPK is null
				AND (palletbuBays.BuildingUnitBayPK not in (Select BuildingUnitBayFK from tblStockItemFixedLocations)
					OR palletbuBays.BayLevel > siflsbuBays.BayLevel)

				Order by
					(Case when palletbuBays.BayLevel = 'a' then 2
							when palletbuBays.BayLevel = 'b' then 1
							when palletbuBays.BayLevel = 'c' then 0
							when palletbuBays.BayLevel is null then 99 else palletbuBays.BayLevel End) Asc,
						palletbuCols.BuildingUnitColumn Desc, pallets.BayPosition Desc, palletbuRows.RowNumber
				) as subQ on 1=1
			END
			ELSE
			BEGIN
				Select isnull(subQ.PalletPK, -1) PalletPK, 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ as Topup, StockItemCode, Batch, ActualUnits
				From (Select 1 as OneRecord) scalarRecord
				left outer join (
				Select Top 1 PalletPK, sis.StockItemCode, pc.Batch, pc.ActualUnits from tblStockItemFixedLocations sifls
				inner join tblPalletContent pc on
				pc.StockItemFK = sifls.StockItemFK
				inner join tblStockItems sis on
				sis.StockItemPK = pc.StockItemFK
				inner join tblPallets pallets on
				pallets.PalletPK = pc.PalletFK
				AND pallets.LocationTypeFK = 1/*Racking*/

				inner join tblPalletTypes palletTypes on
				palletTypes.PalletTypePK = pallets.PalletTypeFK

				inner join tblBuildingUnitBays siflsbuBays on
				siflsbuBays.BuildingUnitBayPK = sifls.BuildingUnitBayFK
				inner join tblBuildingUnitColumns siflsbuCols on
				siflsbuCols.BuildingUnitColumnPK = siflsbuBays.BuildingUnitColumnFK
				inner join tblBuildingUnitRows siflsbuRows on
				siflsbuRows.BuildingUnitRowPK = siflsbuCols.BuildingUnitRowFK

				inner join tblBuildingUnitBays palletbuBays on
				palletbuBays.BuildingUnitBayPK = pallets.LocationFK
				inner join tblBuildingUnitColumns palletbuCols on
				palletbuCols.BuildingUnitColumnPK = palletbuBays.BuildingUnitColumnFK
				inner join tblBuildingUnitRows palletbuRows on
				palletbuRows.BuildingUnitRowPK = palletbuCols.BuildingUnitRowFK

				left outer join tblWorksOrderMovements woms on
				woms.PalletFK = pallets.PalletPK
				AND woms.WorksOrderStatusFK <> 3 /*Not Completed*/

				where sifls.StockItemFixedLocationPK = @fixedLocationFK2
				AND siflsbuRows.BuildingUnitFK = palletbuRows.BuildingUnitFK
				AND woms.WorksOrderMovementPK is null
				AND (palletbuBays.BuildingUnitBayPK not in (Select BuildingUnitBayFK from tblStockItemFixedLocations)
					OR palletbuBays.BayLevel > siflsbuBays.BayLevel)

				Order by
					pc.ActualUnits Asc
				) as subQ on 1=1
			END

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end

			
			
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END

-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,,Name>
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	<Description,,>
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[ZZZ_Obsolete_spFixedLocationsWillBeEmptyFromContainerOut]
(
	@containerOutFK int
)
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT
 ,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;
	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	DECLARE @containerOutFK2 int

	SET @containerOutFK2 = @containerOutFK

	SET @ParameterDetails = '@containerOutFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@containerOutFK2 AS NVARCHAR(20)),'')

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    --BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

		SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END


	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY
			

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start

			Select fromPallets.PalletPK, sifls.StockItemFixedLocationPK, sis.StockItemCode, pc.StockItemFK, pc.Batch,
			case when fromBuRows.Translate = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ then
				case when fromBuRows.ReverseTranslate = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ then
					fromBuRows.TranslatedRow + right('0' + cast((fromBuRows.TranslateColumn - fromBuCols.BuildingUnitColumn) as nvarchar(10)),2) 
					+ lower(fromBuBays.BayLevel) + right('0' + cast(nonFixedLocationStock.BayPosition as nvarchar(50)), 2)
				else
					fromBuRows.TranslatedRow + right('0' + cast((fromBuCols.BuildingUnitColumn + fromBuRows.TranslateColumn) as nvarchar(10)),2) 
					+ lower(fromBuBays.BayLevel) + right('0' + cast(nonFixedLocationStock.BayPosition as nvarchar(50)), 2)
				End
			else
				fromBuRows.Row + right('0' + cast(fromBuCols.BuildingUnitColumnName as nvarchar(50)), 2) + lower(fromBuBays.BayLevel) + right('0' 
				+ cast(nonFixedLocationStock.BayPosition as nvarchar(50)), 2)
			End as FromTextLocation,
			case when toBuRows.Translate = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ then
				case when fromBuRows.ReverseTranslate = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ then
					toBuRows.TranslatedRow + right('0' + cast((toBuRows.TranslateColumn - toBuCols.BuildingUnitColumn) as nvarchar(10)),2) 
					+ lower(toBuBays.BayLevel) + right('0' + cast(pallets.BayPosition as nvarchar(50)), 2)
				else
					toBuRows.TranslatedRow + right('0' + cast((toBuCols.BuildingUnitColumn + toBuRows.TranslateColumn) as nvarchar(10)),2) 
					+ lower(toBuBays.BayLevel) + right('0' + cast(pallets.BayPosition as nvarchar(50)), 2)
				End
			else
				toBuRows.Row + right('0' + cast(toBuCols.BuildingUnitColumnName as nvarchar(50)), 2) + lower(toBuBays.BayLevel) + right('0' 
				+ cast(pallets.BayPosition as nvarchar(50)), 2)
			End  as ToTextLocation
			from tblContainerOuts cOuts
			inner join tblContainerOutLines cols on
			cols.ContainerOutFK = cOuts.ContainerOutPK
			inner join tblContainerOutLinePalletContent colpc on
			colpc.ContainerOutLineFK = cols.ContainerOutLinePK
			inner join tblPalletContent pc on
			pc.PalletContentPK = colpc.PalletContentFK
			inner join tblStockItems sis on
			sis.StockItemPK = pc.StockItemFK
			inner join tblPallets pallets on
			pallets.PalletPK = pc.PalletFK
			AND pallets.LocationTypeFK = 1/*Racking*/
			inner join tblStockItemFixedLocations sifls on
			sifls.BuildingUnitBayFK = pallets.LocationFK
			AND sifls.BayPosition = pallets.BayPosition
			inner join
			(
				Select pc.StockItemFK, LocationFK, BayLevel, BayPosition, AvailableUnits,
				RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pc.StockItemFK ORDER BY BuildingUnitColumnName Desc, BayLevel DESC, BayPosition DESC) AS Position
				from tblPallets pallets
				inner join tblBuildingUnitBays buBays on
				buBays.BuildingUnitBayPK = pallets.LocationFK
				inner join tblBuildingUnitColumns buCols on
				buCols.BuildingUnitColumnPK = buBays.BuildingUnitColumnFK
				inner join tblPalletContent pc on
				pc.PalletFK = pallets.PalletPK
				Where LocationTypeFK = 1 /*Racking*/
				AND pallets.LocationFK not in (Select BuildingUnitBayFK from tblStockItemFixedLocations)
			) nonFixedLocationStock on
			nonFixedLocationStock.StockItemFK = pc.StockItemFK
			AND nonFixedLocationStock.Position = 1
			--toTextLocation
			inner join tblBuildingUnitBays toBuBays on
			toBuBays.BuildingUnitBayPK = pallets.LocationFK
			inner join tblBuildingUnitColumns toBuCols on
			toBuCols.BuildingUnitColumnPK = toBuBays.BuildingUnitColumnFK
			inner join tblBuildingUnitRows toBuRows on
			toBuRows.BuildingUnitRowPK = toBuCols.BuildingUnitRowFK
			--fromTextLocation
			inner join tblBuildingUnitBays fromBuBays on
			fromBuBays.BuildingUnitBayPK = nonFixedLocationStock.LocationFK
			inner join tblBuildingUnitColumns fromBuCols on
			fromBuCols.BuildingUnitColumnPK = fromBuBays.BuildingUnitColumnFK
			inner join tblBuildingUnitRows fromBuRows on
			fromBuRows.BuildingUnitRowPK = fromBuCols.BuildingUnitRowFK
			inner join tblPallets fromPallets on
			fromPallets.LocationTypeFK = 1/*Racking*/
			AND fromPallets.LocationFK = nonFixedLocationStock.LocationFK
			AND fromPallets.BayPosition = nonFixedLocationStock.BayPosition

			where ContainerOutPK = @containerOutFK2
			AND pc.AvailableUnits <= 0
			AND sifls.StockItemFixedLocationPK NOT IN(
				Select TopupFixedLocationFK 
				from tblPalletTopups flts 
				inner join tblWorksOrders wos on 
				wos.WorksOrderPK = flts.WorksOrderFK
				AND wos.WorksOrderStatusFK NOT IN (3,4)
			)

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end

			
			
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END
GO

GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[ZZZ_Obsolete_spGetContainerOutLineDetailsForIntegrationStockOrderFileDetailLine]	
(
	@ContainerOutLineFK INT
)
AS
	DECLARE @var_ContainerOutLineFK INT = @ContainerOutLineFK
	
	SELECT 
		StockItemFK, 
		Batch, 
		(Units + UnitsPickedDifference) AS QuantityOrdered,
		CASE 
			WHEN UnitsPickedDifference <> 0 THEN 
				0 
			ELSE 
				1 
		END AS QuantityPickedIsOk 
	FROM
		dbo.tblContainerOutLines 
	WHERE
		ContainerOutLinePK = @var_ContainerOutLineFK
GO

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[ZZZ_Obsolete_spGetManagerBuildingOnDate]

BEGIN

	SELECT DISTINCT /*TOP 1*/ B.BuildingPK, b.BuildingName 
	FROM dbo.tblBuildings AS b 
	INNER JOIN dbo.tblBuildingUnits AS bu
	ON b.buildingpk = bu.BuildingFK
	INNER JOIN dbo.tblUserBuildingUnits AS ubu
	ON BU.BuildingUnitPK = ubu.BuildingUnitFK
	INNER JOIN dbo.tblUsers AS USR
	ON UBU.UserFK = USR.UserPK
	--INNER JOIN dbo.tblPeople AS PPL
	--ON USR.PersonFK = PPL.PersonPK
	--INNER JOIN dbo.tblTMSEmployeeClockCardDetails AS CCD
	--ON PPL.EmployeeNumber = CCD.EmployeeNumber
	--AND CCD.Department = b.BuildingName
	WHERE --CCD.ClockCardDate = @WorkDate
	--AND 
	ubu.UserFK = @varUserPK AND bu.IsArchived = 0  
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[ZZZ_Obsolete_spGetStockLevels]
(
	@stockItemFK int = -1,
	@batch nvarchar(200) = ''
)	
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets FROM interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT
	,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;
	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	DECLARE @var_stockItemFK int, @var_batch nvarchar(200)

	SET @var_stockItemFK = ISNULL(@stockItemFK,-1); SET @var_batch = ISNULL(@batch,'')

	SET @ParameterDetails = '@stockItemFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_stockItemFK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@batch = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_batch AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'')

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    --BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

		SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END

	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY
			
			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start

			-- Run the spStockLevelsSync stored procedure if it is not already executing.

			IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#IsStoredProcedureExecuting') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #IsStoredProcedureExecuting

			CREATE TABLE #IsStoredProcedureExecuting(Result INT)

			INSERT INTO #IsStoredProcedureExecuting
			EXEC dbo.spIsStoredProcedureExecuting 'spStockLevelsSync'
			
			IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #IsStoredProcedureExecuting WHERE Result = 0) EXEC [dbo].[spStockLevelsSync]

			-- Cathal OCuirrin 26 Sep 2017 optimised version of viewStockLevels, and with parameters.

			IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#PalletContent1') IS NOT NULL
				DROP TABLE #PalletContent1

			SELECT     
				StockItemFK, Batch, SpecialStockTypeFK, 0 AS ActualPallets, 0 AS AvailablePallets, SUM(ActualEaches) AS ActualEaches, SUM(ActualUnits) AS ActualUnits, 
				SUM(AvailableEaches) AS AvailableEaches, SUM(AvailableUnits) AS AvailableUnits
			INTO
				#PalletContent1
			FROM          
				dbo.tblPalletContent 
			WHERE      
				PalletFK = - 1
				AND IsArchived = 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/
				AND (@var_stockItemFK = -1 OR StockItemFK = @var_stockItemFK)
				AND (@var_batch = '' OR Batch = @var_batch)
			GROUP BY 
				StockItemFK, Batch, SpecialStockTypeFK

			IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#tblPalletContentUnitsGreaterThanZero') IS NOT NULL
				DROP TABLE #tblPalletContentUnitsGreaterThanZero

			SELECT DISTINCT 
				p.PalletPK, pc.PalletContentPK, pc.StockItemFK, pc.Batch, pc.SpecialStockTypeFK, pc.ActualUnits, pc.AvailableUnits, pc.ActualEaches, pc.AvailableEaches
			INTO
				#tblPalletContentUnitsGreaterThanZero
			FROM          
				dbo.tblPalletContent AS pc  
			INNER JOIN dbo.tblPallets AS p  
				ON p.PalletPK = pc.PalletFK 			
			inner join dbo.tblstockinlinepallets as silp 
				on p.PalletPK = silp.PalletFK 
			inner join dbo.tblstockinlines as sil 
				on sil.stockinlinepk = silp.stockinlinefk
			inner join dbo.tblstockins as si 
				on sil.stockinfk = si.stockinpk
			inner join dbo.tblcontainerins as ci 
				on ci.containerinpk = si.containerinfk 				
			WHERE      
				pc.PalletFK <> - 1 
				AND pc.IsArchived = 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/
				AND p.IsArchived = 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/
				and ci.stockinstatusfk = 3 /*Completed*/
				and (pc.ActualUnits > 0 or pc.AvailableUnits > 0)

			CREATE INDEX #ndx1 ON #tblPalletContentUnitsGreaterThanZero(PalletPK)

			IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#PalletContent2') IS NOT NULL
				DROP TABLE #PalletContent2

			SELECT     
				COUNT(DISTINCT pc.PalletPK) AS Pallets, pc.StockItemFK, pc.Batch, pc.SpecialStockTypeFK
			INTO
				#PalletContent2
			FROM          
				#tblPalletContentUnitsGreaterThanZero as pc
			WHERE      
				pc.ActualUnits > 0 
				AND (@var_stockItemFK = -1 OR pc.StockItemFK = @var_stockItemFK)
				AND (@var_batch = '' OR pc.Batch = @var_batch)
			GROUP BY 
				pc.StockItemFK, pc.Batch, pc.SpecialStockTypeFK

			IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#PalletContent3') IS NOT NULL
				DROP TABLE #PalletContent3

			SELECT     
				COUNT(DISTINCT pc.PalletPK) AS Pallets, pc.StockItemFK, pc.Batch, pc.SpecialStockTypeFK
			INTO
				#PalletContent3
			FROM
				#tblPalletContentUnitsGreaterThanZero as pc 
			WHERE      
				pc.AvailableUnits > 0 
				AND (@var_stockItemFK = -1 OR pc.StockItemFK = @var_stockItemFK)
				AND (@var_batch = '' OR pc.Batch = @var_batch)
			GROUP BY 
				pc.StockItemFK, pc.Batch, pc.SpecialStockTypeFK

			IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#PalletContent4') IS NOT NULL
				DROP TABLE #PalletContent4

			SELECT     
				pc.StockItemFK, pc.Batch, pc.SpecialStockTypeFK, ISNULL(palletCount.Pallets, 0) AS ActualPallets, ISNULL(availablePalletCount.Pallets, 0) 
				AS AvailablePallets, SUM(pc.ActualEaches) AS ActualEaches, SUM(pc.ActualUnits) AS ActualUnits, SUM(pc.AvailableEaches) AS AvailableEaches, 
				SUM(pc.AvailableUnits) AS AvailableUnits
			INTO
				#PalletContent4
			FROM         
				#tblPalletContentUnitsGreaterThanZero AS pc 
			INNER JOIN #PalletContent2 AS palletCount 
				ON palletCount.StockItemFK = pc.StockItemFK 
				AND palletCount.Batch = pc.Batch 
				AND palletCount.SpecialStockTypeFK = pc.SpecialStockTypeFK 
			LEFT OUTER JOIN #PalletContent3 AS availablePalletCount 
				ON availablePalletCount.StockItemFK = pc.StockItemFK 
				AND availablePalletCount.Batch = pc.Batch 
				AND availablePalletCount.SpecialStockTypeFK = pc.SpecialStockTypeFK 
			WHERE     
				(@var_stockItemFK = -1 OR pc.StockItemFK = @var_stockItemFK)
				AND (@var_batch = '' OR pc.Batch = @var_batch)
			GROUP BY 
				pc.StockItemFK, pc.Batch, pc.SpecialStockTypeFK, palletCount.Pallets, availablePalletCount.Pallets
			
			IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#PalletContent5') IS NOT NULL
				DROP TABLE #PalletContent5

			SELECT 
				x.*
			INTO
				#PalletContent5 
			FROM 
				(
					SELECT * FROM #PalletContent1
					UNION
					SELECT * FROM #PalletContent4
				) AS x

			-- Get the final results 

			IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#StockLevelResults') IS NOT NULL
				DROP TABLE #StockLevelResults

			SELECT     
				StockItemFK, 
				Batch, 
				SpecialStockTypeFK, 

				SUM(ActualPallets) AS ActualPallets, 
				SUM(AvailablePallets) AS AvailablePallets, 

				CASE 
					WHEN SUM(ActualEaches) < 0 THEN 
						- 1 
					ELSE 
						SUM(ActualEaches) 
				END AS ActualEaches,
		 
				SUM(ActualUnits) AS ActualUnits,
		 
				CASE 
					WHEN SUM(AvailableEaches) < 0 THEN 
						- 1 
					ELSE 
						SUM(AvailableEaches) 
				END AS AvailableEaches, 
		
				SUM(AvailableUnits) AS AvailableUnits, 
				CAST(0 AS bit) AS Expr1, 
				1 AS Expr2, dbo.GetBSTDate() AS Expr3, 
				1 AS Expr4, dbo.GetBSTDate() AS Expr5
			INTO
				#StockLevelResults
			FROM         
				#PalletContent5
			GROUP BY 
				StockItemFK, Batch, SpecialStockTypeFK

			-- Return the final results

			SELECT
				StockItemFK, 
				Batch, 
				SpecialStockTypeFK, 
				ActualPallets, 
				AvailablePallets, 
				ActualEaches,		 
				ActualUnits,		 
				AvailableEaches, 		
				AvailableUnits, 
				Expr1, 
				Expr2, 
				Expr3, 
				Expr4, 
				Expr5		
			FROM 
				#StockLevelResults

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end	

			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END

-- ====================================================================
-- Author:      Cathal OCuirrin
-- Create Date: 15 October 2019
-- Description: Returns a list of building names a user has access to.
-- ====================================================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[ZZZ_Obsolete_spGetUserBuildings2] -- spGetUserBuildings 287
(
	@userFK INT
)
AS
BEGIN
	DECLARE @varUserFK INT = @userFK

	DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #results

	SELECT DISTINCT
		b.BuildingPK AS BuildingPK, 

		--CASE WHEN ISNULL(b.DepartmentTMS, '') <> '' THEN b.DepartmentTMS ELSE b.BuildingName END AS BuildingName

		CASE 
			WHEN b.BuildingName = '6CR1' THEN 'Six Cross Roads'
			WHEN ISNULL(b.DepartmentTMS, '') = '' THEN b.BuildingName
			ELSE b.DepartmentTMS
		END AS BuildingName
	INTO
		#results
	FROM 
		dbo.tblBuildings AS b 
	INNER JOIN dbo.tblBuildingUnits AS bu
		ON b.buildingpk = bu.BuildingFK
	INNER JOIN dbo.tblUserBuildingUnits AS ubu
		ON BU.BuildingUnitPK = ubu.BuildingUnitFK
	INNER JOIN dbo.tblUsers AS USR
		ON UBU.UserFK = USR.UserPK
	WHERE 
		ubu.UserFK = @varUserFK
		AND bu.IsArchived = 0  
		AND b.BuildingName IN ('BV1', 'BV2', 'BV4', 'BV5', '6CR1', 'CR1', 'Dun1', 'KIL1', 'KIL2', 'NEX1', 'SR1', 'BV3', 'CAR1','Air')
		AND b.BuildingName NOT IN ('6CR11C')
	UNION
	SELECT 1 AS BuildingPK, 'Transport' AS BuildingName
	UNION
	SELECT 9999 AS BuildingPK, 'Quality' AS BuildingName
	UNION
	SELECT 8888 AS BuildingPK, 'IT' AS BuildingName

	SELECT
		MAX(BuildingPK) AS BuildingPK,
		BuildingName
	FROM
		#results
	GROUP BY
		BuildingName
	ORDER BY 
		BuildingName ASC
END
GO

						containerIns.GoodsInNumber as [Stock In],

						buildings.BuildingName + '' - '' + buildingUnits.BuildingUnit as [Building Unit],ContainerNumber,'
								
					IF @var_isAll = 0
					begin
						set @NoResults = @NoResults + ' '+ '
						case 
						when containerIns.IsBeingBuilt = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ and containerins.headersonly = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ then ''Building'' 
						when containerIns.HeadersOnly = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ then ''Headers'' else ''Ready'' 
						end AS LineStatus, 
						Suppliers.Supplier as ''Suppliers'', 
						'+' '

					end	
						 
					set @NoResults = @NoResults + ' ' + 'status.StockInStatus,
						custs.CustomerName as ''Customer Name'',
						CASE 
							when cdis.CustomerDocketIdentificationPK is null then 
							CASE WHEN  containerIns.ExternalReference <> '''' THEN ''External Reference: ''  + containerIns.ExternalReference ELSE '' '' end   
						else
							CASE 
								cdis.FieldFK 
							when 1 then
								cdis.Prefix + '' '' + containerIns.Free1
							when 2 then
								cdis.Prefix + '' '' + containerIns.Free2
							when 3 then
								cdis.Prefix + '' '' + containerIns.Free3
							when 4 then
								cdis.Prefix + '' '' + containerIns.Free4
							when 5 then
								cdis.Prefix + '' '' + containerIns.Free5
							ELSE
								''''
							end
						+ 
							'' '' 
							+
							CASE
								cdis.Field2FK 
							when 1 then
								cdis.Prefix2 + '' '' + containerIns.Free1
							when 2 then
								cdis.Prefix2 + '' '' + containerIns.Free2
							when 3 then
								cdis.Prefix2 + '' '' + containerIns.Free3
							when 4 then
								cdis.Prefix2 + '' '' + containerIns.Free4
							when 5 then
								cdis.Prefix2 + '' '' + containerIns.Free5
							else 
								''''
							end
						+ 
							'' '' 
							+
							CASE
								cdis.Field3FK 
							when 1 then
								cdis.Prefix3 + '' '' + containerIns.Free1
							when 2 then
								cdis.Prefix3 + '' '' + containerIns.Free2
							when 3 then
								cdis.Prefix3 + '' '' + containerIns.Free3
							when 4 then
								cdis.Prefix3 + '' '' + containerIns.Free4
							when 5 then
								cdis.Prefix3 + '' '' + containerIns.Free5
							else 
								''''
							end
						End as Reference '

					IF @var_isAll = 0
					BEGIN
						set @NoResults = @NoResults + ', case when sins.ArrivalRecordedBy > 0 
												then ''$imgArrived.png''    
											end as [$NoSearch%Arrived] '
					END

					SET @NoResults = @NoResults +'  '+'	
					FROM 
						dbo.tblContainerIns as containerIns
					inner join tblBuildingUnits as buildingUnits
						on buildingUnits.BuildingUnitPK = containerIns.BuildingUnitFK	
					inner join (
									select UserFK, BuildingUnitFK  from tblUserBuildingUnits group by userfk, BuildingUnitFK
								) as uBus 
						on uBus.BuildingUnitFK = buildingUnits.BuildingUnitPK 
						AND uBus.UserFK = ' + CAST(@var_userFK AS NVARCHAR(20)) + ' ' + '
					inner join tblBuildings as buildings 
						on buildings.BuildingPK = buildingUnits.BuildingFK
					left outer join tblSuppliers as Suppliers
						on Suppliers.SupplierPK = containerIns.SupplierFK
					left outer join tblTransportCompanies as transportCompanies
						on transportCompanies.TransportCompanyPK = containerIns.TransportCompanyFK  
					left outer join tblLoadingBays as loadingBays
						on loadingBays.LoadingBayPK = containerIns.LoadingBayFK  
					inner join appStockInStatus as [status]
						on status.StockInStatusPK = containerIns.StockInStatusFK
					inner join (
									Select ContainerInFK, MAX(DivisionFK) DivisionFK,ArrivalRecordedBy
									from tblStockIns
									Group By ContainerInFK,ArrivalRecordedBy
								) sins 
						on sins.ContainerInFK = containerIns.ContainerInPK

					inner join tblDivisions as divs 
						on divs.DivisionPK = sins.DivisionFK
					inner join tblCustomers as custs 
						on custs.CustomerPK = divs.CustomerFK
					left outer join tblCustomerDocketIdentifications as cdis 
						on cdis.CustomerFK = divs.CustomerFK
						AND cdis.DocketTypeFK = 1 /*ContainerIn*/ 
					inner join #StockIns AS si
					ON ContainerIns.ContainerInPK = si.ContainerInPK
					WHERE
							si.rec_num = -1'

					EXEC(@NoResults)
					Print 'No results Executed'
		END
			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end			
						
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END
GO

        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC

    --END


	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);

	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY
			

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start

			SELECT

			else 
				case when cOuts.ContainerOutTypeFK = 1 then '$ddl%val=' + cast(divBus.DefaultLoadingBayFK as nvarchar(50)) + '%Location'
				when cOuts.ContainerOutTypeFK = 2 then '$ddl%val=' + cast(divBus.DefaultDistributionLoadingBayFK as nvarchar(50)) + '%Location'
				else '$ddlLocation' 
				End

			inner join tblContainerOutLinePalletContent colpc on
			colpc.ContainerOutLineFK = cols.ContainerOutLinePK

			inner join tblStockItems stockItems on
			stockItems.StockItemPK = cols.StockItemFK

			left outer join tblPalletContent palletContent on

			pallets.PalletPK = palletContent.PalletFK

			left OUTER JOIN viewPalletLocations palletLocation ON 
			palletLocation.palletPK = Pallets.palletPk
		--	left outer join tblBuildingUnitBays buBays on

		--
		--	left outer join tblBuildingUnitColumns buCols on
		--	buCols.BuildingUnitColumnPK = buBays.BuildingUnitColumnFK

		--	buRows.BuildingUnitRowPK = buCols.BuildingUnitRowFK

		--	loadingBays.LoadingBayPK = pallets.LocationFK
		--
		--	left outer join tblSetDownAreas setDownAreas on
		--	setDownAreas.SetDownAreaPK = pallets.LocationFK
		--
		--	left OUTER JOIN tblSampleLocations sampleLocation ON
		--	sampleLocation.SampleLocationPk = pallets.LocationFK

			left outer join tblDivisionBuildingUnits divBus on
			divBus.BuildingUnitFK = @buildingUnitFK2
			AND divBus.DivisionFK = stockItems.DivisionFK

			where (
		--       (@buildingUnitFK2=CASE pallets.LocationTypeFK 
		--		WHEN 1 THEN buRows.BuildingUnitFK
		--		WHEN 2 THEN loadingBays.BuildingUnitFK
		--		WHEN 3 THEN setDownAreas.BuildingUnitFK 
		--		WHEN 6 THEN sampleLocation.BuildingUnitFK END
				palletLocation.BuildingUnitFK = @BuildingUnitFK2
			OR
				(palletContent.LooseLocationTypeFK = 2 /*LoadingBay*/
				AND palletContent.LooseLocationFK in (Select LoadingBayPK from tblLoadingBays where BuildingUnitFK = @buildingUnitFK2)
				)
			OR palletContent.PalletContentPK is null
			)
			AND cols.ContainerOutFK = @containerOutFK2

			group by ContainerOutLinePK, stockItems.StockItemCode, cols.IsArchived, cols.Batch, divBus.DivisionBuildingUnitPK, divBus.DefaultLoadingBayFK, 
			divBus.DefaultDistributionLoadingBayFK, cOuts.ContainerOutTypeFK

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end

		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */

			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[ZZZ_Obsolete_spGvContainerOutsAll_oLD]
(
	@userFK INT,
	@PageNumber INT = 0, --i.e. page number 1
	@MaxRowsPerPage INT = 20,
	@Search NVARCHAR (MAX) = NULL,
	@SortOrder NVARCHAR (4) = 'DESC',
	@SortField NVARCHAR (20) = 'GoodsOrderNumber',
	@IsAll INT = 0
)	
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED

	DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,
		@DeadlockErrorRetries INT, @PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT

	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; 
	SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	DECLARE @var_userFK int, @var_PageNumber int, @var_MaxRowsPerPage int, @var_Search nvarchar(MAX), @var_SortOrder NVARCHAR (4), 
		@var_SortField NVARCHAR(20), @var_isAll INT =0, @NoResultsFound INT = 0 

	SET @var_userFK = ISNULL(@userFK,-1)
	SET @var_PageNumber = @PageNumber +1
	SET @var_MaxRowsPerPage = @MaxRowsPerPage
	SET @var_Search = ISNULL(@Search,'')
	SET	@var_SortOrder = ISNULL(@SortOrder,'DESC')
	SET @var_SortField = ISNULL(@SortField,'GoodsOrderNumber')
	SET @var_isAll = ISNULL(@IsAll,0)

	SELECT @var_SortField = CASE WHEN @var_SortField <> 'CollectionDate' THEN @var_SortField ELSE 'CollectionDate2' END
	SELECT @var_SortField = CASE WHEN @var_SortField <> 'DeliveryDate' THEN @var_SortField ELSE 'DeliveryDate2' END
	SELECT @var_SortField = CASE WHEN @var_SortField <> '$NoSearch%Notes' THEN @var_SortField ELSE 'Notes' END
  
	IF @IsAll = 0
	BEGIN
		SELECT @var_Search = REPLACE (@var_Search, 'SearchField1', 'CAST(GoodsOrderNumber AS NVARCHAR(50))')
		SELECT @var_Search = REPLACE (@var_Search, 'SearchField2', '[Building Unit]')
		SELECT @var_Search = REPLACE (@var_Search, 'SearchField3', '[Customer Name]')
		SELECT @var_Search = REPLACE (@var_Search, 'SearchField4', 'Address1')
		SELECT @var_Search = REPLACE (@var_Search, 'SearchField5', 'CollectionDate')
		SELECT @var_Search = REPLACE (@var_Search, 'SearchField6', 'DeliveryDate')
		SELECT @var_Search = REPLACE (@var_Search, 'SearchField7', 'TransportCompany')
		SELECT @var_Search = REPLACE (@var_Search, 'SearchField8', 'ID')
		SELECT @var_Search = REPLACE (@var_Search, 'SearchField9', '[Status]')
	END

	IF @IsAll = 1
	BEGIN
		SELECT @var_Search = REPLACE (@var_Search, 'SearchField1', 'CAST(GoodsOrderNumber AS NVARCHAR(50))')
		SELECT @var_Search = REPLACE (@var_Search, 'SearchField2', '[Building Unit]')
		SELECT @var_Search = REPLACE (@var_Search, 'SearchField3', '[Customer Name]')
		SELECT @var_Search = REPLACE (@var_Search, 'SearchField4', 'Address1')
		SELECT @var_Search = REPLACE (@var_Search, 'SearchField5', 'CollectionDate')
		SELECT @var_Search = REPLACE (@var_Search, 'SearchField6', 'DivisionName')
		SELECT @var_Search = REPLACE (@var_Search, 'SearchField7', '[Container Number]')
		SELECT @var_Search = REPLACE (@var_Search, 'SearchField8', 'ID')
		SELECT @var_Search = REPLACE (@var_Search, 'SearchField9', '[Status]')
	END
	

	SET @ParameterDetails = '@userFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_userFK AS NVARCHAR(20)),'') 
		+ ',@PageNumber = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_PageNumber AS NVARCHAR(20)),'')
			+ ',@MaxRowsPerPage = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_MaxRowsPerPage AS NVARCHAR(20)),'') 
				+ ',@Search = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_Search AS NVARCHAR(20)),'')
					+ ',@SortField = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_SortField AS NVARCHAR(20)),'') 
						+ ',@SortOrder = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_SortOrder AS NVARCHAR(4)),'')
  
	DECLARE @SQLInsertIntoTable NVARCHAR(MAX), @SQLSelect NVARCHAR(MAX), @SQLFromPart1 NVARCHAR(MAX), @SQLFromPart2 NVARCHAR(MAX),
		@SQLFromCombined NVARCHAR(MAX), @SQLWhere NVARCHAR(MAX), @SQLOrderBy NVARCHAR(MAX), @currentSearchKeyword NVARCHAR(MAX), 
			@IsSearching BIT = 0, @RowNumber INT = 1, @TableAliasName NVARCHAR(50), @StartRow INT = 1, @EndRow INT = 20, @totalRecords INT

	IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
		CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

	--IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
	--BEGIN 
		SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

		INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
		SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

		SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
	--END

	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY

			IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#tmpStockOrders') IS NOT NULL
				DROP TABLE #tmpStockOrders
			SELECT * INTO #tmpStockOrders FROM tblstockorders WHERE stockorderpk > 65420 

			IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#tmpContainerOuts') IS NOT NULL
				DROP TABLE #tmpContainerOuts
			SELECT * INTO #tmpContainerOuts FROM tblcontainerouts WHERE containeroutpk > 51650

			SELECT @IsSearching = CASE WHEN ISNULL(@var_Search, '') = '' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END

			IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#SearchWords') IS NOT NULL
				DROP TABLE #SearchWords

			CREATE TABLE #SearchWords
			(
				RowNumber INT IDENTITY (1,1),
				Search NVARCHAR(MAX),
				SearchCompleted BIT
			)

			IF @IsAll = 0
			BEGIN
			 IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#Tmp_Orders ') IS NOT NULL       
				DROP TABLE #Tmp_Orders 					-- create temp table to hold all the movements on the pick
			 IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#Tmp_StockOutStatus ') IS NOT NULL       
				DROP TABLE #Tmp_StockOutStatus 					-- create temp table to hold all the movements on the pick
	
				SELECT  Distinct 
				orders.stockOrderPk, 
				orders.PickLoaded, 
				orders.PickCompleted,
				orders.IsArchived [Archived], 
				orders.ResponsibleBuildingUnitFK, 
				contOuts.*,BuildingName + ' - ' + bus.BuildingUnit as [Building Unit]
				INTO #Tmp_Orders 
				from #tmpStockOrders orders
				INNER JOIN #tmpContainerOuts contOuts on contOuts.ContainerOutPK = orders.ContainerOutFK
   			    inner join (select * from tblUserBuildingUnits  where userfk = @userFK) ubu on orders.ResponsibleBuildingUnitFK = ubu.BuildingUnitFK 
				inner join tblBuildingUnits bus on bus.buildingunitpk = orders.ResponsibleBuildingUnitFK
				inner join tblbuildings bu on bu.BuildingPK = bus.buildingfk
				Where ContainerOutStatusFK = 1 /*Pending*/ OR ContainerOutStatusFK = 2 /*User Assigned*/

				
				-- Retrieves the status of the pick
				select row_number() over (partition by stockorderpk order by stockorderpk desc) as pkval, stockorderpk ,
				 case  
				 when Orders.PickLoaded = 1 then 'Pick Loaded'
				 when Orders.PickCompleted = 1 then 'Pick Finished' 				
				 WHEN MAX(ISNULL(woms.worksorderstatusfk, -1)) = 3 THEN 'Pick Started'
				 WHEN MAX(ISNULL(woms.worksorderstatusfk, -1)) = 1 THEN 'Pick Issued'
			     when Orders.CollectionDate <> '1900-01-01 00:00:00.000' then 'Collection Scheduled'
				 when Orders.CollectionDate = '1900-01-01 00:00:00.000' then 'New Order'End as 'PickStatus'
				 INTO #Tmp_StockOutStatus
				FROM #Tmp_Orders orders--all inward works orders
			    left outer join tblworksorders wo on wo.worksorderOriginFK =  2 /*outward movements*/ and wo.fk =  Orders.stockorderpk
			    left outer join tblworksordermovements woms on woms.isarchived = 0 and woms.worksorderfk = wo.worksorderpk
				group by StockOrderPK, WorksOrderFK, PickLoaded, CollectionDate, PickCompleted
			END				

			IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#Results') IS NOT NULL
				DROP TABLE #Results

			CREATE TABLE #Results
			(
				RowNumber INT IDENTITY(1,1),
				PK INT,
				ImagePath NVARCHAR (MAX), 
				IsFiltered INT, 
				IsArchived INT, 
				totalRecords INT,
				GoodsOrderNumber INT, 
				[Building Unit] NVARCHAR(MAX), 
				[Customer Name] NVARCHAR(MAX),
				Address1 NVARCHAR(MAX),
				CollectionDate NVARCHAR(max),
				DeliveryDate DATETIME,
				TransPortCompany NVARCHAR (50),
				ID NVARCHAR(MAX),
				[Status] NVARCHAR(MAX),
				Notes NVARCHAR(MAX),
				DivisionName NVARCHAR(MAX), 
				[Container Number] Nvarchar(max),
				CurrentDataSet BIT,
				CollectionDate2 DATETIME,
				DeliveryDate2 DATETIME
			)

			SET @SQLInsertIntoTable = 'INSERT INTO #Results
										(
											PK, 
											ImagePath, 
											IsFiltered,
											IsArchived,

			BREAK

			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
