			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY

			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END

-- =============================================

-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[ZZZ_Obsolete_spGvCurrentDistributionOrders]
(
	@customerFK int,
	@userFK int
)	
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT
 ,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;
	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	DECLARE @customerFK2 int, @userFK2 int

	SET @customerFK2 = @customerFK; SET @userFK2 = @userFK

	SET @ParameterDetails = '@customerFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@customerFK2 AS NVARCHAR(20)),'') + ',@userFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@userFK2 AS NVARCHAR(20)),'')

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    --BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

		SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END


	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY
			

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start

			SELECT Distinct     StockOrderPK AS PK, '/images/StockOrder.png' AS ImagePath, cast(0 as bit) AS IsFiltered, stockOrders.IsArchived, 
			cast(contOuts.GoodsOrderNumber as int) [Goods Order Number], case when coss.ContainerOutStatus = 'Completed' then 'Dispatched' 
			else coss.ContainerOutStatus End as Status,
			case when TrackingNumber <> '' then '$lnk%url=www.nightline-delivers.com/SmartShip.Online/Tracking/Actions/Default?TrackingNumbers=' 
			+ TrackingNumber + '%txt=Tracking' else 'No Tracking' End Tracking,
			convert(varchar, contOuts.DeliveryDate, 103) DeliveryDate,  
			contOuts.Address1 as [Name], contOuts.Address2 as [Address1], contOuts.Address3 as [Address2], contOuts.Comments,
			case when (cop.ContainerOutPickedPK is null AND contOuts.ContainerOutStatusFK < 5 /*not complete or cancelled*/) 
			then '$llnk%url=/StockInOutEdits/DistributionStockOrderEditPage.aspx?FK=' + cast(contOuts.ContainerOutPK as nvarchar(50)) 
			+ '%txt=Edit' else '' end as [Edit]
		
			FROM dbo.tblStockOrders stockOrders

			inner join tblContainerOuts contOuts on
			contOuts.ContainerOutPK = stockOrders.ContainerOutFK

			inner join tblContainerOutLines contOutLines on
			contOutLines.ContainerOutFK = contOuts.ContainerOutPK 

			inner join tblDivisions divisions on
			divisions.DivisionPK = contOutLines.DivisionFK

			inner join tblStockItems stockItems on
			stockItems.StockItemPK = contOutLines.StockItemFK

			inner join appContainerOutStatus coss on
			coss.ContainerOutStatusPK = contOuts.ContainerOutStatusFK

			left outer join tblContainerOutPicked cop on
			cop.ContainerOutFK = contOuts.ContainerOutPK

			Where ((StockOrderStatusFK <> 5 /*Complete*/ OR StockOrderStatusFK <> 6 /*Cancelled*/)
			AND contOuts.InsertedBy = @userFK2
			AND divisions.CustomerFK = @customerFK2)
			OR
			(contOuts.InsertedBy = @userFK2
			AND divisions.CustomerFK = @customerFK2
			AND contOuts.InsertedDate > DATEADD(m,-1,dbo.GetBSTDate()))
		--	Group by StockOrderPK, stockOrders.IsArchived, contOuts.GoodsOrderNumber, coss.ContainerOutStatus,
		--	contOuts.CollectionDate, stockItems.StockItemCode, 
		--	contOuts.Address1, contOuts.Address2, contOuts.Address3
			order by cast(GoodsOrderNumber as int) desc  
	   
			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end

			
			
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END

(
	@BuildingUnitFK int
)	
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT
 ,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;

	SET @BuildingUnitFK2 = @BuildingUnitFK

	SET @ParameterDetails = '@BuildingUnitFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@BuildingUnitFK2 AS NVARCHAR(20)),'')

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    --BEGIN

		SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END


	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY
			

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start
	   
			SELECT distinct pallets.PalletPK AS PK, '/images/Pallet.png' AS ImagePath, pallets.IsArchived, cast(0 as bit) AS IsFiltered, 
			sis.StockItemCode, pc.Batch, Location, PalletType, d.divisionName as Division, c.customername as Customer, /*ActualUnits, AvailableUnits,*/
			case when pallets.CustomerBarcode = '' then pallets.Barcode else pallets.CustomerBarcode end as Barcode			
			FROM tblPallets pallets
			left outer join tblPalletTypes palletTypes on palletTypes.PalletTypePK = pallets.PalletTypeFK
			inner join (Select PalletFK, StockItemFK, Batch, sum(ActualUnits) ActualUnits, sum(AvailableUnits) AvailableUnits
			from tblPalletContent
			Group By PalletFK, StockItemFK, Batch) pc on pc.PalletFK = pallets.PalletPK
			inner join tblStockItems sis on sis.StockItemPK = pc.StockItemFK
			inner join viewpalletLocations palletLocation on palletlocation.PalletPK = pallets.palletPk
			inner join tbldivisions d on sis.divisionfk = d.divisionpk
			inner join tblcustomers c on d.customerfk = c.customerpk
			left join tblscraplocations sl on pallets.locationfk = sl.locationfk
			left join (select m.worksordermovementpk, m.palletfk from tblworksordermovements m
			inner join tblscraplocations s on s.locationfk = m.destinationfk
			where s.locationfk is not null and m.worksorderstatusfk not in (3,4)) moves on moves.palletfk = pallets.PalletPK

			Where pallets.IsArchived = 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/
			AND pallets.PalletStatusFK = 16 /*rejected*/
			AND pallets.locationTypeFK = 1 /*racking*/
			AND palletLocation.buildingunitfk = @BuildingUnitFK2 /*only pallets in this building*/
			and sl.locationfk is null /*dont show pallets already in scrap location*/
			and (moves.palletfk is null)

			Order by Location ASC, StockItemCode ASC, Batch ASC, Barcode ASC

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end

			
			
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[ZZZ_Obsolete_spGvScheduleEntries]
(@date datetime)	
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT
 ,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;
	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	DECLARE @date2 datetime

	SET @date2 = @date

	SET @ParameterDetails = '@date = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@date2 AS NVARCHAR(30)),'')

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    --BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

		SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END


	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY
			 
			SELECT ScheduleEntryPK AS PK, '/images/scheduleEntry.png' AS ImagePath, ses.IsArchived, cast(0 as bit) AS IsFiltered, 
			BuildingName + ' - ' + BuildingUnit as [Building Unit], ScheduledDateTime as [Date], 
			case when ContainerInPK is not null then 'Goods In Number: ' + GoodsInNumber when ContainerOutPK is not null then 
			'Goods Out Number: ' + GoodsOrderNumber end as Task, Duration
			FROM         dbo.tblScheduleEntries ses
			inner join tblBuildingUnits bus on
			bus.BuildingUnitPK = ses.BuildingUnitFK
			inner join tblBuildings buildings on
			buildings.BuildingPK = bus.BuildingFK
			left outer join tblContainerIns cins on
			cins.ContainerInPK = ses.ContainerInFK
			left outer join tblContainerOuts couts on
			couts.ContainerOutPK = ses.ContainerOutFK
			where ses.ScheduledDateTime >= @date2 AND ses.ScheduledDateTime <= DATEADD(day,1,@date2)

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end
		BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END

BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */

					Set @palletAdditionalFieldCounter = @palletAdditionalFieldCounter + 1
					Set @PalletAdditionalFieldsSQL = @PalletAdditionalFieldsSQL + ' ,pafvs' + cast(@palletAdditionalFieldCounter as nvarchar (10)) 
					+ '.PalletAdditionalFieldValue as [' + @palletAdditionalField + '] '
					Set @PalletAdditionalFieldsforGroupSQL = @PalletAdditionalFieldsforGroupSQL + ' ,pafvs' + cast(@palletAdditionalFieldCounter as nvarchar (10)) 
					+ '.PalletAdditionalFieldValue '

					Set @PalletAdditionalFieldJoinsSQL = @PalletAdditionalFieldJoinsSQL + ' left outer join tblPalletAdditionalFieldValues pafvs' 
					+ cast (@palletAdditionalFieldCounter as nvarchar(10 )) + ' on '
					Set @PalletAdditionalFieldJoinsSQL = @PalletAdditionalFieldJoinsSQL + 'pafvs' + cast(@palletAdditionalFieldCounter as nvarchar (10)) 
					+ '.PalletContentFK = palletContent.PalletContentPK '

					FETCH NEXT FROM additionalPalletFields INTO
				@palletAdditionalFieldPK ,
				@palletAdditionalField
             END

             CLOSE additionalPalletFields
             DEALLOCATE additionalPalletFields
                        
             Select @eachesUnitTypeFK = sis.EachesUnitTypeFK ,
                        @requirePalletNumber = CASE WHEN custs.RequirePalletNumber = 0 THEN CASE WHEN divs.RequirePalletNumber = 0 then sis.RequirePalletNumber ELSE divs.RequirePalletNumber END ELSE custs.RequirePalletNumber end,
                        @requireExpiryDate = sis. RequireExpiryDate,
                        @requireManufactureDate = sis. RequireManufactureDate,
                        @requireBestBefore = sis. RequireBestBefore,
                        @requireDateOfReceipt = sis. RequireDateOfReceipt,
                        @unitType = isnull (unitTypes. Abbreviation, 'Units'),
                        @eachUnitType = isnull (eachUnitTypes. Abbreviation, 'Units')
             from tblStockItems sis
			 INNER JOIN tbldivisions divs ON 
				sis.DivisionFK = divs.DivisionPK
			INNER JOIN tblcustomers custs ON
				divs.CustomerFK = custs.customerpk
             left outer join tblUnitTypes unitTypes on
            unitTypes .UnitTypePK = sis.UnitTypeFK
             left outer join tblUnitTypes eachUnitTypes on
            eachUnitTypes .UnitTypePK = sis.EachesUnitTypeFK
             where StockItemPK = @var_stockItemFK

             if(@eachesUnitTypeFK = - 1) 
			 BEGIN
                         Set @UnitsEachesSQL = 'sum(palletContent.ActualUnits) as [Actual ' + @unitType + '], sum(palletContent.AvailableUnits) as [Available ' + @unitType +']'
                         Set @unitTypeForSum = @unitType
             END      
			 ELSE 
			 BEGIN
                         Set @UnitsEachesSQL = 'sum(palletContent.ActualUnits) as [Actual ' + @eachUnitType + '], sum(palletContent.AvailableUnits) as [Available ' + @eachUnitType +']'
                         Set @unitTypeForSum = @eachUnitType
             END

             Set @RequiredFieldsSQL = ''
             Set @RequiredFieldsForGroupSQL = ''
             if(@requirePalletNumber = cast (1 as bit)) 
			 BEGIN
                         Set @RequiredFieldsSQL = ',pallets.CustomerPalletNumber'
                         Set @RequiredFieldsForGroupSQL = ',pallets.CustomerPalletNumber'
             END
             if(@requireExpiryDate = cast (1 as bit)) 
			 BEGIN
                         Set @RequiredFieldsSQL = @RequiredFieldsSQL + ',convert(varchar, palletContent.ExpiryDate, 103) ExpiryDate'
                         Set @RequiredFieldsForGroupSQL = @RequiredFieldsForGroupSQL + ', palletContent.ExpiryDate'
             END
             if(@requireManufactureDate = cast (1 as bit)) 
			 BEGIN
                         Set @RequiredFieldsSQL = @RequiredFieldsSQL + ',convert(varchar, palletContent.DateOfManufacture, 103) [Manufacture Date]'
                         Set @RequiredFieldsForGroupSQL = @RequiredFieldsForGroupSQL + ', palletContent.DateOfManufacture'
             END
             if(@requireBestBefore = cast (1 as bit)) 
			 BEGIN
                         Set @RequiredFieldsSQL = @RequiredFieldsSQL + ',convert(varchar, palletContent.BestBefore, 103) [Best Before]'
                         Set @RequiredFieldsForGroupSQL = @RequiredFieldsForGroupSQL + ', palletContent.BestBefore'
             END
             if(@requireDateOfReceipt = cast (1 as bit)) 
			 BEGIN
                         Set @RequiredFieldsSQL = @RequiredFieldsSQL + ',convert(varchar, palletContent.DateOfReceipt, 103) [Date Of Receipt]'
                         Set @RequiredFieldsForGroupSQL = @RequiredFieldsForGroupSQL + ', palletContent.DateOfReceipt'
             END

			 declare @var_deliveryTypeFK int = 1 --default to market so only available pallets
			 --check delivery type if we know the stock order (editing)
			if(@var_containerOutFK > 0) begin
				SELECT @var_deliveryTypeFK = DeliveryTypeFK FROM tblcontainerouts WHERE containeroutpk = @var_containerOutFK
			end
			else
			begin
				--or check delivery type depending on address (first time picking)
				SELECT @var_deliveryTypeFK = DeliveryAddressTypeFK FROM tblDeliveryAddresses where deliveryAddressPK = @var_DeliveryAddressFK
			END

			


--         Select PK, ''/images/Pallet.png'' AS ImagePath, IsArchived, IsFiltered, Location, sum(Actual' + @unitTypeForSum + ') as Actual' + @unitTypeForSum +
--         ', sum(Available' + @unitTypeForSum + ') as Available' + @unitTypeForSum + '
             Set @sql = '
             DECLARE @var_deliveryTypeFK int; '+  
			 'SET @var_deliveryTypeFK = '+cast(@var_deliveryTypeFK as varchar(1)) +';'+

			 '--get custom pallet status allowed to this address type
			IF OBJECT_ID(''TEMPDB..#TempDeliveryStatus'') IS NOT NULL
			DROP TABLE #TempDeliveryStatus

			--load custom delivery type pallet status rules 
			SELECT				 
				StockItemDeliveryStatusPK, StockItemFK, DeliveryTypeFK, palletStatusFK
			INTO
				#TempDeliveryStatus 
			FROM
				tblStockItemDeliveryStatus
			WHERE
				Isarchived = 0 and StockItemFK = ' + cast(@var_stockItemFK as nvarchar (100)) + ' AND DeliveryTypeFK = @var_deliveryTypeFK

             SELECT pallets.PalletPK AS PK, ''/images/Pallet.png'' AS ImagePath, palletContent.IsArchived, 0 AS IsFiltered,'
           -- case LocationTypeFK when 1 then bayBus.BuildingUnit + '' '' + case when buRows.Translate = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ then buRows.TranslatedRow else buRows.Row End + right(''0'' + cast(case when buRows.Translate = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ then case when buRows.ReverseTranslate = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ then buRows.TranslateColumn - buCols.BuildingUnitColumn else buCols.BuildingUnitColumn + buRows.TranslateColumn end  else buCols.BuildingUnitColumn end as nvarchar(50)),2) + lower(buBays.BayLevel) + right(''0'' + cast(pallets.BayPosition as nvarchar(50)),2) when 2 then loadingBayBus.BuildingUnit + '' '' + loadingBays.LoadingBay when 3 then setDownAreaBus.BuildingUnit + '' '' + setDownAreas.SetDownArea else ''unknown location'' end as Location,'
			 + ' building + '' '' + location as Location,'
             + @UnitsEachesSQL + @RequiredFieldsSQL + @PalletAdditionalFieldsSQL +
             ', case when cast(DateOfReceipt as nvarchar(50)) = ''Jan  1 1900 12:00AM'' then convert(varchar, pa.EventDate, 103) else convert(varchar, DateOfReceipt, 103) End Received, PalletStatus as [Status]
             FROM dbo.tblPallets pallets
			 inner join apppalletstatus on pallets.palletstatusfk = palletstatuspk 
             inner join tblPalletContent palletContent on palletContent.PalletFK = pallets.PalletPK
             left outer join tblPalletAudit pa on pa.PalletFK = pallets.PalletPK AND EventTypeFK = 1 /*Pallet Created*/
             inner join tblStockItems stockItems on stockItems.StockItemPK = palletContent.StockItemFK
			 left outer join viewpalletLocations palletLocation on  palletLocation.palletpk = pallets.palletpk
			 left outer join tblSamplingStations samplingStations on samplingStations.SamplingStationPK = pallets.LocationFK
             left outer join ( 
				Select PalletContentFK, colpc.Units, pals.PalletStatusFK
				From tblContainerOutLinePalletContent colpc'
			set @sql2 = '
				inner join tblPallets pals on pals.PalletPK = colpc.PalletFK 
				Inner join tblContainerOutLines cols on cols.ContainerOutLinePK = colpc.ContainerOutLineFK			
				Where ContainerOutFK = ' + cast(@var_containerOutFK as nvarchar (50)) + 
			')orderedContent on orderedContent.PalletContentFK = palletContent.PalletContentPK 
			LEFT JOIN (SELECT count(StockItemDeliveryStatusPK) DeliveryStatusCount from #TempDeliveryStatus) ds ON 1=1'
             + @PalletAdditionalFieldJoinsSQL + 
             ' where palletContent.StockItemFK = ' + cast(@var_stockItemFK as nvarchar (100)) + ' AND palletContent.Batch = ''' + @var_batch + '''
            AND (palletContent.AvailableEaches > 0 OR palletContent.AvailableUnits > 0 OR orderedContent.PalletContentFK is not null)
			 AND ((DeliveryStatusCount > 0 AND pallets.PalletStatusFK IN (SELECT PalletStatusFK from #TempDeliveryStatus)) 
				OR	((DeliveryStatusCount = 0) and		 
			 (@var_deliveryTypeFK = 1 /*market*/ and pallets.PalletStatusFK = 1/*Available*/)
				or
				(@var_deliveryTypeFK in (2,4,5) /*factory or system*/ and pallets.PalletStatusFK <> 10/*anything but on route*/)
				or
				(@var_deliveryTypeFK = 3 /*scrappage*/ and pallets.PalletStatusFK not in (10, 1)/*anything but available or on route*/)
			))
            Group By pallets.PalletPK, palletContent.IsArchived, DateOfReceipt, pa.EventDate, pallets.LocationTypeFK,Building,Row,columnNo, baylevel, location, PalletStatus, pallets.BayPosition ' + @RequiredFieldsForGroupSQL + @PalletAdditionalFieldsforGroupSQL + ' Order By Row ASC, ColumnNo DESC, BayLevel ASC, pallets.BayPosition DESC'
             
			SET @fullSQL = CAST (@sql AS nvarchar(MAX)) + CAST (@sql2 AS nvarchar(MAX))
			Print @fullsql
			--PRINT @sql
			--PRINT @sql2
			EXEC sp_executesql @fullsql
            
			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end

			
			
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END
GO

-- =============================================
-- Author:		Rachael Sherry
-- Create date: 15/8/2014
-- Description:	Returns a list of all the Bays assigned to a Row 
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[ZZZ_Obsolete_spMobileCycleCountBuildingUnitBays]
(
	@CycleCountRowFK int
)	
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT
 ,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;
	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	DECLARE @var_CycleCountRowFK int
	SET @var_CycleCountRowFK = @CycleCountRowFK
	SET @ParameterDetails = '@CycleCountRowFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_CycleCountRowFK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'')

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    --BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

		SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END


	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY
			

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start

			 -- Now we have a row we can get a list of all the locations in that row
			   -- sorting the following way 
			   -- A01a - A15a
			   -- A15b - A01b
			   -- A01c - A15c
			   -- Get the row and location information
     
			   SELECT tCcB.CycleCountBuildingUnitBayPK,
					  BuildingUnitBayPK , 
					  BuildingUnitColumn, 
					  baylevel ,
					  tCcb.CycleCountStatusFK as Status,
					  barcode,
					  tBub.width,
					  case when tBuR.Translate = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ 
						   then tBuR.TranslatedRow 
					  else tBuR.Row 
					  end 
					  + right('0' + 
					  cast(case when tBuR.Translate = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ 
								then 
								case when tBuR.ReverseTranslate = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/
									 then tBuR.TranslateColumn - tBuC.BuildingUnitColumn 
								else tBuC.BuildingUnitColumn + tBuR.TranslateColumn 
								end 
						   else tBuC.BuildingUnitColumn 
						   end 
					  as nvarchar(10)),2) 
					  + lower(tBub.BayLevel) Location,
					   aCcS.CycleCountStatus as Statustext,
					   CASE WHEN tBub.BayLevel IN ('A','C','E','G','I','K','M','O')
							THEN 1
					   ELSE 0 END as StartAtFirst,
					   width             
			   FROM		    tblCycleCountBuildingUnitBays tCcB 
			   INNER JOIN   tblBuildingUnitBays tBub ON
							tBub.BuildingUnitBayPK = tCcB.BuildingUnitBayFK
			   INNER JOIN   tblBuildingUnitColumns tBuc
			   ON           tBub.BuildingUnitColumnFK = tBuc.BuildingUnitColumnPK
			   INNER JOIN   tblBuildingUnitRows tBuR
			   ON           tBuR.BuildingUnitRowPK = tBuC.BuildingUnitRowFK
			   INNER JOIN   appCycleCountStatus aCcS
			   ON			aCcS.CycleCountStatusPK = tCcB.CycleCountStatusFK
			   WHERE        tCcb.CycleCountRowFK =  @var_CycleCountRowFK
				 AND        tBub.width > 0           
			   Order by baylevel asc, 
					 case when baylevel IN ('A','C','E','G','I','K','M','O') then 
						  BuildingUnitColumn   END asc  ,
					 CASE WHEN baylevel NOT IN ('A','C','E','G','I','K','M','O')  THEN BuildingUnitColumn   END desc
 
			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end

			
			
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END

-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Rachael Sherry>

-- Description:	<Get a list of the pallets in the bay>
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[ZZZ_Obsolete_spMobileCycleCountBuildingUnitsPallets] 
(
	@locationFK int,
    @CycleCountBuildingUnitBayFK int
)	
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT
 ,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;
	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	DECLARE @var_locationFK int, @var_CycleCountBuildingUnitBayFK int
	SET @var_locationFK = @locationFK; SET @var_CycleCountBuildingUnitBayFK = @CycleCountBuildingUnitBayFK
	SET @ParameterDetails = '@locationFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_locationFK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@CycleCountBuildingUnitBayFK = ' 
		+ ISNULL(CAST(@var_CycleCountBuildingUnitBayFK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'')

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    --BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

		SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END


	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY
			IF XACT_STATE() = 0 AND @@TRANCOUNT < 1 BEGIN TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start

			   -- Set the location to active
			  UPDATE tblCycleCountBuildingUnitBays WITH (ROWLOCK)
				 SET CycleCountStatusFK = 3
			   WHERE CycleCountBuildingUnitBayPK = @var_CycleCountBuildingUnitBayFK

			  -- Set the Row to active 
			  UPDATE tblCycleCountRows WITH (ROWLOCK) 
				 SET CycleCountStatusFK = 3
			   WHERE CycleCountRowPK IN 
				 (SELECT CycleCountRowPK
					FROM tblCycleCountRows tCcR 
					INNER JOIN tblCycleCountBuildingUnitBays tCub ON 
							   tCub.CycleCountRowFK = tCcR.CycleCountRowPK
						WHERE tCub.CycleCountBuildingUnitBayPK = @var_CycleCountBuildingUnitBayFK)

			  --set the CycleCount to active
			  UPDATE tblCycleCounts WITH (ROWLOCK) 
				 SET CycleCountStatusFK = 3
			   WHERE CycleCountPK IN 
				 (SELECT CycleCountPK
					FROM  tblCycleCounts tCc 
					INNER JOIN tblCycleCountRows tCcR ON 
						  tCcR.CycleCountFK = tCc.CycleCOuntPK
					INNER JOIN tblCycleCountBuildingUnitBays tCub ON 
							   tCub.CycleCountRowFK = tCcR.CycleCountRowPK
						WHERE tCub.CycleCountBuildingUnitBayPK = @var_CycleCountBuildingUnitBayFK)

			  SELECT palletPk ,
				   bayposition,
				   palletStart,
				   palletEnd,
				   StackPosition,
				   CASE WHEN tPal.customerBarcode IS NULL THEN tPal.barcode  
						WHEN tPal.customerBarcode = '' THEN tPAl.barcode
						ELSE tPal.CustomerBarcode
				   END AS barcode,
				   tSti.StockItemCode,
				   tPaC.Batch,
				   tPalT.Width,
			baylevel, tPal.CustomerPalletNumber
        
			  FROM       tblPallets tPal
			  INNER JOIN tblPalletContent tPaC ON 
						 tPaC.PalletFK = tPal.PalletPK
			  INNER JOIN tblStockItems tSti ON 
						 tSti.StockItemPK = tPaC.StockItemFK
			  INNER JOIN tblPalletTypes tPalT ON 
			  tPalT.PalletTypePK = tPal.PalletTypeFK
			inner join tblbuildingunitbays tbub on tbub.buildingunitbaypk = tpal.locationfk
			  WHERE LocationFK = @var_locationFK    
				AND tPal.IsArchived = 0 
			  order by  case when baylevel in ('b', 'd', 'f', 'h', 'j', 'l', 'n') then bayposition end desc ,
						case     when baylevel in ('a', 'c', 'e','g','i','k','m','o') then bayposition end
			--order by bayposition desc

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end

			BEGIN TRY IF XACT_STATE() = 1 AND @@TRANCOUNT = 1 AND @OpeningTranCount < 1 COMMIT TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH
			
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END

-- =============================================
-- Author:		Rachael Sherry
-- Create date: 21/8/2014
-- Description:	Complete the Cycle Count - Location, Row and Cycle Count
-- Return Status 1 = Cell Complete
-- Return Status 2 = Row Complete
-- Return Status 3 = Cycle Count Complete
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[ZZZ_Obsolete_spMobileCycleCountComplete]
(
	@CycleCountBuildingUnitBayFK  int,
    @USerFK int
)	
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT
 ,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;
	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	DECLARE @CycleCountBuildingUnitBayFK2 int, @USerFK2 int

	SET @ParameterDetails = '@CycleCountBuildingUnitBayFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@CycleCountBuildingUnitBayFK2 AS NVARCHAR(20)),'')
		+ ',@USerFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@USerFK2 AS NVARCHAR(20)),'')

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    --BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

		SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END


	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY
			IF XACT_STATE() = 0 AND @@TRANCOUNT < 1 BEGIN TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start

			DECLARE @CycleCountRowFK int
			DECLARE @CycleCountFK int

			--IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#tmpReturn') IS NOT NULL
			--	DROP TABLE #tmpReturn

			--create table #tmpReturn(ReturnStatus int)

			-- complete cycle count cell
			UPDATE tblCycleCountBuildingUnitBays WITH (ROWLOCK) 
			SET CycleCountStatusFK = 4,
				UpdatedBy = @UserFK2,
				UpdatedDate = dbo.GetBSTDate()
			WHERE CycleCountBuildingUnitBayPK = @CycleCountBuildingUnitBayFK2
  
			SELECT @CycleCountFK = CycleCountFK,
					@CycleCountRowFK = CycleCountRowFK
			FROM  tblCycleCountRows tCR 
			INNER JOIN tblCycleCountBuildingUnitBays tCB ON 
				tCB.CycleCountRowFK = tCR.CycleCountRowPK
			WHERE CycleCountBuildingUnitBayPK = @CycleCountBuildingUnitBayFK2

			-- check if its the last cell in the row
			IF  NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM tblCycleCountBuildingUnitBays 
							WHERE CycleCountStatusFK  IN (1,2,3)
							  AND CycleCountRowFK =  @CycleCountRowFK)
			BEGIN
			-- UPDATE the row to complete
				UPDATE tblCycleCountRows WITH (ROWLOCK)
				SET CycleCountStatusFK = 4,
					UpdatedBy = @UserFK2,
					UpdatedDate = dbo.GetBSTDate()
				WHERE CycleCountRowPK = @CycleCountRowFK
			END
			ELSE
			BEGIN
				BEGIN TRY IF XACT_STATE() = 1 AND @@TRANCOUNT = 1 AND @OpeningTranCount < 1 COMMIT TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH

				SELECT 1 as ReturnStatus
				RETURN
			END
			-- Check if all the rows are complete

			IF  NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM tblCycleCountRows 
							WHERE CycleCountStatusFK  IN (1,2,3)
							  AND CycleCountFK =  @CycleCountFK)
			BEGIN
				-- UPDATE the row to complete
				UPDATE tblCycleCounts WITH (ROWLOCK)
				SET CycleCountStatusFK = 4,
					UpdatedBy = @UserFK2,
					UpdatedDate = dbo.GetBSTDate()
				WHERE CycleCountPK = @CycleCountFK
			END
			ELSE     
			BEGIN
				BEGIN TRY IF XACT_STATE() = 1 AND @@TRANCOUNT = 1 AND @OpeningTranCount < 1 COMMIT TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH

				SELECT 2 as ReturnStatus
				RETURN
			END

			BEGIN TRY IF XACT_STATE() = 1 AND @@TRANCOUNT = 1 AND @OpeningTranCount < 1 COMMIT TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH

			SELECT 3 as ReturnStatus
			RETURN 

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end
			
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END
GO

-- =============================================

-- Description:	<Returns a list of the Rows that are Pending and Active>
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[ZZZ_Obsolete_spMobileCycleCountRowSelection]
(
	@CycleCountFK INT
)	
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT
 ,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;
	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	DECLARE @var_CycleCountFK int
	SET @var_CycleCountFK = @CycleCountFK
	SET @ParameterDetails = '@CycleCountFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_CycleCountFK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'')

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    --BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

		SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END


	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY
			

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start

			-- get all the rows from the cyclecountrow table that are pending or active 
			SELECT CASE WHEN translate  = 1
							THEN TranslatedRow 
						ELSE ROW 
				   END AS ROW, 
				   tCcR.BuildingUnitRowFK, 
				   tCcR.CycleCountStatusFK,
				   tCcR.CycleCountRowPK
			 FROM  tblCycleCountRows tCcR
				   INNER JOIN tblBuildingUnitRows tBuR 
				   ON tBuR.BuildingUnitRowPK = tCcR.BuildingUnitRowFK
			 WHERE tCcR.CycleCountFK = @var_CycleCountFK
				   AND tCcR.CycleCountStatusFK IN (2,3)
			 ORDER BY (CASE WHEN translate  = 1
							THEN TranslatedRow 
							ELSE ROW END) 

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end

			
			
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END

    @UserFK int

AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT
 ,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;
	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	DECLARE @var_CycleCountRowFK int, @var_UserFK int
	SET @var_CycleCountRowFK = @CycleCountRowFK; SET @var_UserFK = @UserFK
	SET @ParameterDetails = '@CycleCountRowFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_CycleCountRowFK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@UserFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_UserFK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'')

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    --BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

		SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END


	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	BEGIN

			IF XACT_STATE() = 0 AND @@TRANCOUNT < 1 BEGIN TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start

			-- change each cell that is not complete to Skipped
			UPDATE tblCycleCountBuildingUnitBays WITH (ROWLOCK) 
			SET CycleCountStatusFK = 6 ,
				UpdatedBy = @var_UserFK,
				UpdatedDate = dbo.GetBSTDate()
			  WHERE CycleCountRowFK = @var_CycleCountRowFK
				AND CycleCountStatusFK IN (1,2,3)  

			-- going to set this row to skipped and all the bays that are not complete.
			UPDATE tblCycleCountRows WITH (ROWLOCK) 
			SET CycleCountStatusFK = 6,
				UpdatedBy = @var_UserFK,
				UpdatedDate = dbo.GetBSTDate()
			WHERE CycleCountRowPK = @var_CycleCountRowFK

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end

			BEGIN TRY IF XACT_STATE() = 1 AND @@TRANCOUNT = 1 AND @OpeningTranCount < 1 COMMIT TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH

	@BuildingFK int
)	
AS
BEGIN

    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT

			GROUP BY tCC.CycleCountPK, BuildingUnit

			BREAK

-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Author,Rachael Sherry>
-- Create date: <Create Date,20/02/2014>
-- Description:	<Checks if there are any stackable positions in racking for a pallet>
-- =============================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[ZZZ_Obsolete_spMobileManualDoubleStackingPlacement]
(
	@locationBarcode nvarchar(20),
    @PalletBarcode nvarchar (20),
    @userInFK int
)	
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT
 ,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;
	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	DECLARE @var_locationBarcode nvarchar(20), @var_PalletBarcode nvarchar(20), @var_userInFK int
	SET @var_locationBarcode = @locationBarcode; SET @var_PalletBarcode = @PalletBarcode; SET @var_userInFK = @userInFK
	SET @ParameterDetails = '@locationBarcode = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_locationBarcode AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@PalletBarcode = ' 
		+ ISNULL(CAST(@var_PalletBarcode AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@userInFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_userInFK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'')

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    --BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

		SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END


	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY
			

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start

			DECLARE @PalletPK int
			DECLARE @LocationFK int
			DECLARE @LocationText nvarchar(50)
			DECLARE @PalletTotalWidth int
			DECLARE @LeftToRight      bit
			DECLARE @BayWidth         int
			
			-- Get the Building Details
			SELECT @LocationFK = LocationFK,
				@LocationText = location,
				@LeftToRight = LocateFromLeft,
				@BayWidth = width
			FROM dbo.fnMobileGetBuildingUnitBayDetails(@var_locationBarcode)  

			IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#tmpPallets') IS NOT NULL
				DROP TABLE #tmpPallets			
			SELECT * INTO #tmpPallets FROM tblpallets WHERE (barcode = @var_PalletBarcode OR CustomerBarcode = @var_PalletBarcode) OR locationFK = @LocationFK

			-- Get the palletPK
			SELECT @PalletPK = PalletPK from #tmpPallets Where barcode = @var_PalletBarcode OR CustomerBarcode = @var_PalletBarcode

			SELECT @PalletTotalWidth =  dbo.fnMobileGetPalletWidth(@palletPK)
    
		 -- Current Pallets in the cell that have the same stock and batch as the current pallet
			select  bayposition, 
					PalletStart,
					@PalletTotalWidth as PalletWidth, 
					(@LocationText + right('0' + cast(bayposition as nvarchar),2)) as LocationText ,
					PalletFK = @PalletPK,
					@LeftToRight as LeftToRight, 
					@BayWidth as BayWidth                 
				FROM  
					-- get the stock and batch of the current pallet 
					(select DISTINCT palletpk , tSti.StockItemPK, batch ,  tPalt.width from #tmpPallets tPal
						INNER JOIN tblStockInLinePallets tSPal ON tPal.PalletPK = tsPal.PalletFK
						INNER JOIN tblStockInLines tSlin ON tSlin.StockInLinePK =tsPal.StockInLineFK
						INNER JOIN tblStockItems tSti ON  tSti.StockItemPK = tSlin.StockItemFK
						INNER JOIN tblPalletTypes tPalt ON tPalt.PalletTypePK = tPal.PalletTypeFK
						WHERE tPal.PalletPK = @PalletPK) as tblCurPal
						inner join 
							-- get the bay position of all the pallets on the bottom level of the cell 
							-- with the same stock and batch and is not smaller than the current pallet
							(select DISTINCT palletpk , tSti.StockItemPK, batch, bayposition, tPalt.width,tPal.PalletStart, tPal.PalletEnd from #tmpPallets tPal
								   INNER JOIN tblStockInLinePallets tSPal ON tPal.PalletPK = tsPal.PalletFK
								   INNER JOIN tblStockInLines tSlin ON tSlin.StockInLinePK =tsPal.StockInLineFK
								   INNER JOIN tblStockItems tSti ON  tSti.StockItemPK = tSlin.StockItemFK
								   INNER JOIN tblPalletTypes tPalt ON tPalt.PalletTypePK = tPal.PalletTypeFK
								   WHERE tPal.locationFK =  @LocationFK
							and tPal.stackPosition = 0) tblPalInBay
							ON tblCurPal.StockItemPK = tblPalInBay.StockItemPK 
							ANd tblCurPal.Batch = tblPalInBay.batch
							AND tblCurPal.Width <= tblPalInBay.width
							-- check there are no pallets stacked in that position
							AND tblPalInBay.BayPosition NOT IN (SELECT bayposition from #tmpPallets WHERE locationFK = @locationFK AND StackPosition = 1)

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end

			
			
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END

			IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#tmpReturn') IS NOT NULL        -- Delete  the temporary table if it already exists
				DROP TABLE #tmpReturn

			create table #tmpReturn( PalletStart  int,   -- Where the pallet will start in the bay
										PalletEnd    int,   -- Where the pallet will end in the bay
										BayPosition  int,   -- Where in the bay the pallet will be placed
										ReturnStatus int,   -- This will hold the return status for the stored procedure
										locationFK   int,   -- The new locationFK 
										locationTypeFK int, -- The location Type
										locationText nvarchar(50), -- the location that is displayed on the hand held
										PalletFK     int,   -- The Pallet Key
										Barcode      nvarchar(50), -- The location barcode for drivethrough
										StackPosition  int )  -- If the Pallet Scanned is stackable
															-- 1 For Set Down Area
															-- 2 for Successful Position found
															-- 3 Cell full
															-- 4 Wrong Barcode Scanned - not SetDown or Cell
															-- 5 Error
															-- 6 Works Order Movement already exists for this cell and pallet - no need to find a new location
															-- 7 Drive through racking
															-- 8 Stock Item not setup
															-- 9 Pallet is not current on the system / archived or does not exist   
															-- 10 Pallet  is on a pick
															-- 11 Pallet Type Does not exist
			-- Retrieve the Prefixes from the system
			Select @setDownPrefix = SetDownAreaBarcodePrefix, 
					@cellPrefix = BuildingUnitCellBarcodePrefix,
					@loadingbayprefix = LoadingBayBarcodePrefix
					From appSystem where SystemPK = 1
   
			-- Get the pallet width plus the margins from the pallet width function
			SELECT @PalletPK = PalletPK from tblPallets Where (barcode = @PalletBarcode OR CustomerBarcode = @PalletBarcode) AND IsArchived = 0

			-- check if the pallet exists
			if (@PalletPK is null) 
			BEGIN 
				Select 9 as returnStatus
				RETURN
			END

			--		@errorMessage = 'Manual Placement - Pallet ' + @PalletBarcode + '  Location  ' + @locationBarcode + ' Pallet Exists  : ' 
			--        EXEC [dbo].[spMobileWriteToLogFile] @errorNo,@errorMessage ,@Procedure

			IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT palletType from tblPalletTypes tPaT 
										INNER JOIN tblPallets tpaL ON tPaT.pallettypePK = tpaL.palletTypeFK 
										WHERE palletPK = @PalletPK)
			BEGIN 
				SELECT 11 as returnStatus
				RETURN
			END

			--	   	SELECT @errorNo = 3,
			--		@errorMessage = 'Manual Placement - Pallet ' + @PalletBarcode + '  Location  ' + @locationBarcode + ' Pallet Type Exists '
			--        EXEC [dbo].[spMobileWriteToLogFile] @errorNo,@errorMessage ,@Procedure

			--	   	SELECT @errorNo = 4,

			--        EXEC [dbo].[spMobileWriteToLogFile] @errorNo,@errorMessage ,@Procedure

				INNER JOIN tblContainerOuts tCo on tCo.containerOutPK = coL.containerOutFK

				tColP.palletFK  = @PalletPK
				AND tCo.ContainerOutStatusFK not in (5,6))

						AND tCo.ContainerOutStatusFK not in (5,6)

		--		@errorMessage = 'Manual Placement - Pallet ' + @PalletBarcode + '  Location  ' + @locationBarcode + ' Pallet is on a pick '
		--        EXEC [dbo].[spMobileWriteToLogFile] @errorNo,@errorMessage ,@Procedure 
				RETURN
			END

			select @IsStackable =  tStoi.IsStackable
			--	 ,
			--   @StockInLinesPK = tSlin.StockInLinePK
			from tblPallets tPal
			inner join tblPalletContent tPaco on tPaco.PalletFK = tPal.PalletPK
			inner join tblStockItems tStoi on tPaco.StockItemFK = tStoi.StockItemPK
			WHERE  tPal.palletPk = @PalletPK
				AND tPal.IsMixedPallet = 0

			print 'stackable'  
			print @Isstackable

				select @IsStackable =  tSti.IsStackable ,
					   @StockInLinesPK = tSlin.StockInLinePK

					INNER JOIN tblStockInLinePallets tSPal ON tPal.PalletPK = tsPal.PalletFK

					WHERE tPal.PalletPK = @PalletPK

				if (@StockItemFK is null)
				BEGIN 
					SELECT 8 as returnstatus
					RETURN
				END
				 */

			--		@errorMessage = 'Manual Placement - Pallet ' + @PalletBarcode + '  Location  ' + @locationBarcode + ' Stock Item ' + CONVERT(nvarchar(10),@StockItemFK)
			--        EXEC [dbo].[spMobileWriteToLogFile] @errorNo,@errorMessage ,@Procedure 
			-- check if barcode scanned is a cell , a loading bay or a setdown area
			IF(@setDownPrefix = SUBSTRING(@locationBarcode, 1, len(@setDownPrefix))) 
			BEGIN
				print '3is return'
				SELECT 1 AS returnstatus,            
						3 AS locationTypeFK,
					SetDownAreaPK as locationFK,
					@PalletPK as PalletPK
					from tblSetDownAreas where Barcode = @locationBarcode 
		--		SELECT @errorNo = 6,
		--		@errorMessage = 'Manual Placement - Pallet ' + @PalletBarcode + '  Location  ' + @locationBarcode + ' SetDown Area ' + CONVERT(nvarchar(10),@StockItemFK)
		--        EXEC [dbo].[spMobileWriteToLogFile] @errorNo,@errorMessage ,@Procedure 
				RETURN
			END

			   IF(@loadingBayPrefix = SUBSTRING(@locationBarcode, 1, len(@loadingBayPrefix))) 
			   BEGIN
       
				  SELECT 1 AS returnstatus,	
						 2 AS locationTypeFK,
						LoadingBayPK as locationFK,

			--		@errorMessage = 'Manual Placement - Pallet ' + @PalletBarcode + '  Location  ' + @locationBarcode + ' Loading Bay ' + CONVERT(nvarchar(10),@StockItemFK)

				  RETURN
			   END
			   ELSE IF (@cellprefix = SUBSTRING(@LocationBarcode, 1, len(@cellprefix)))
			   BEGIN
					-- A cell
  
						-- Get the locationFK , leftToRight and Baywidth from the BuildingUnitBay table  
						-- get building Unit details
			print '6'
						SELECT @ColumnFK = ColumnFK ,
							   @LocationFK = LocationFK,

							   @LeftToRight = LocateFromLeft,
							   @BayWidth = width,
							   @RackingType = rackingType
							FROM dbo.fnMobileGetBuildingUnitBayDetails(@locationBarcode)        
						-- check if a Works Order Movement already exists for this cell and pallet, if it does we will use this 
						if  EXISTS( select WorksOrderMovementPK from tblworksordermovements WHERE PalletFK = @PalletPK AND DestinationFK = @LocationFK AND worksOrderStatusFK  IN (1,2))
						BEGIN
						   SELECT  6 AS ReturnStatus
			--	          SELECT @errorNo = 6,
			--					@errorMessage = 'Manual Placement - Pallet ' + @PalletBarcode + '  Location  ' + @locationBarcode + ' Works Order Movement Exists ' + CONVERT(nvarchar(10),@StockItemFK)
			--					EXEC [dbo].[spMobileWriteToLogFile] @errorNo,@errorMessage ,@Procedure 
						   RETURN
						END
						ELSE
						BEGIN
			--	          SELECT @errorNo = 7,
			--					@errorMessage = 'Manual Placement - Pallet ' + @PalletBarcode + '  Location  ' + @locationBarcode + 'Works Order Movement Does not exist ' + CONVERT(nvarchar(10),@StockItemFK)
			--					EXEC [dbo].[spMobileWriteToLogFile] @errorNo,@errorMessage ,@Procedure 
						-- if Racking type is 1 (conventional)
						 if (@RackingType = 1) 
						BEGIN
							-- get the actual width of the pallets in the cell
			--					SELECT @errorNo = 8,
			--					@errorMessage = 'Manual Placement - Pallet ' + @PalletBarcode + '  Location  ' + @locationBarcode + ' Conventional Racking ' + CONVERT(nvarchar(10),@StockItemFK)
			--					EXEC [dbo].[spMobileWriteToLogFile] @errorNo,@errorMessage ,@Procedure 
     						-- check if there is any room
							-- Get the Total width of all pallets assigned to the cell + the obstructions to see if there is any room for the current pallet
							   SELECT @AcutalPalletWidthInCell = SUM(palletend - palletStart)
								FROM tblPallets tPal where locationFK = @LocationFK 
																	and tPal.IsArchived = 0
																	and tPal.loaded = 0

			--					@errorMessage = 'Manual Placement - Pallet ' + @PalletBarcode + '  Location  ' + @locationBarcode + ' Actual Pallet Width ' + CONVERT(nvarchar(10),@AcutalPalletWidthInCell)
			--					EXEC [dbo].[spMobileWriteToLogFile] @errorNo,@errorMessage ,@Procedure 

							  SELECT @FreeSpace =  tBub.width - sum (palletend - palletStart) 
									  from 
										(
											SELECT palletEnd ,palletStart , locationFK from tblPallets tPal 
															  where locationFK = @LocationFK 
																and tPal.IsArchived = 0
																and tPal.loaded = 0
											Union
											SELECT  DestinationPalletEnd , DestinationPalletStart, destinationFK   from tblworksOrderMovements Woms 
															  where destinationFK = @LocationFK  and 
																	woms.WorksOrderStatusFK < 3 /*Not complete or cancelled*/ 
											--Union 
											--SELECT ObstructionEnd , ObstructionStart , buildingUnitBayFK as palletFK from tblBuildingUnitBayObstructions 
															--  where buildingUnitBayFK = @LocationFK 
										) as tblPositions 
										inner join
										tblBuildingUnitBays tBub on  buildingUnitBayPK = locationFK
										group by tBub.width
			--					SELECT @errorNo = 10,
			--					@errorMessage = 'Manual Placement - Pallet ' + @PalletBarcode + '  Location  ' + @locationBarcode + ' free space ' + CONVERT(nvarchar(10),@FreeSpace)
			--					EXEC [dbo].[spMobileWriteToLogFile] @errorNo,@errorMessage ,@Procedure 

							  if (@IsStackable = 1)
								 -- check if there is a space on top
							  BEGIN
			print 'isstackable'
			print @locationfk
			--					SELECT @errorNo = 11,
			--					@errorMessage = 'Manual Placement - Pallet ' + @PalletBarcode + '  Location  ' + @locationBarcode + ' Stackable Pallet '
			--					EXEC [dbo].[spMobileWriteToLogFile] @errorNo,@errorMessage ,@Procedure 					
								if EXISTS (select * FROM						             
									(SELECT 2 as returnstatus,
										   tblpallist.PalletStart,
										   tblpallist.bottomwith as PalletWidth,
										   bayposition + 1 as bayposition,
										   @LocationFK as LocationFK,
										   @LeftToRight as LeftToRight, 
										   @BayWidth as BayWidth ,
										   @LocationText  as locationText ,
										   PalletFK = @PalletPK,
										   1 as StackPosition
						       
						       
											FROM (	select * FROM 
									
												(select tpal.PalletPK,
													   tpal.BayPosition , 
													   tpal.palletstart ,
													   (palletend - palletstart) as bottomwith 
												  FROM tblPallets  tpal
												  INNER JOIN tblPalletContent tPalcon ON tPalcon.PalletFK = tpal.PalletPK

													AND StackPosition = 0

													--AND tPalcon.Batch = @batch
													AND tpal.isarchived = 0
													and tPal.loaded = 0) tblbase

													Where LocationFK = @LocationFK
													  AND StackPosition = 1
													 -- AND tPalcon.StockItemFK = @StockItemFK
													  AND tpal.isarchived = 0
													  and tPal.loaded = 0
													  --AND tPalcon.Batch = @batch
													 ) tblStack ON tblbase.PalletStart = tblStack.stackstart
										  ) tblpallist
										  where stackpal IS NULL
											AND tblpallist.bottomwith = @PalletTotalWidth) tblStackpos
										  inner JOIN 
										  --  join with the current pallet if it is stackable
										  (	select   tSti.IsStackable ,tPal.PalletPK
											  from tblPallets tPal
											  INNER JOIN tblStockInLinePallets tSPal ON tPal.PalletPK = tsPal.PalletFK
											  INNER JOIN tblStockInLines tSlin ON tSPal.StockInLineFK = tSlin.StockInLinePK
											  INNER JOIN tblStockItems tSti ON tSti.StockItemPK = tSlin.StockItemFK

												AND tPal.IsMixedPallet = 0
												AND tpal.isarchived = 0
												and tPal.loaded = 0
										   ) tblStackable
										   ON    tblStackable.PalletPK = tblStackpos.PalletFK
										   WHERE tblStackable.IsStackable = 1
										)
									SET @StackPositionExists = 1

								END
			print '8'		  set @StackPositionExists=1
							  print 'FreeSpace'	  
							  PRINT @FreeSpace
							  if @FreeSpace  is null   -- the cell is currently empty
							  BEGIN

								  RETURN

								-- check if the pallet can be stacked

								print @ISStackable
								print 'StackPositionExists'
								print @StackPositionExists
						
								if (@ISStackable = 1 AND @StackPositionExists = 1)
								BEGIN
								  -- check if there is space on the bottom first or if it is an assigned pallet

										IF exists 		(select tpal.PalletPK,

			--					EXEC [dbo].[spMobileWriteToLogFile] @errorNo,@errorMessage ,@Procedure

											(SELECT 2 as returnstatus,

																--AND tPalcon.StockItemFK = @StockItemFK
																AND tpal.isarchived = 0
																and tPal.loaded = 0
