														  ) tblbase
														  left outer join
														  (select tpal.PalletPK as stackpal, 
				   												  tpal.BayPosition as stackpos, 
																  tpal.PalletStart as stackstart
															 FROM tblPallets  tpal
															  INNER JOIN tblPalletContent tPalcon ON tPalcon.PalletFK = tpal.PalletPK
																Where LocationFK = @LocationFK
																  --AND StackPosition = 1
																  --AND tPalcon.StockItemFK = @StockItemFK
																  AND tpal.isarchived = 0
																  AND tPal.loaded = 0
																-- AND tPalcon.Batch = @batch
															 ) tblStack ON tblbase.PalletStart = tblStack.stackstart

												  )tblStackPos
													--where stackpal IS NULL
													--AND tblpallist.bottomwith >= @PalletTotalWidth) tblStackpos
									  
													inner JOIN

												  (	select   1 as IsStackable/*tSti.IsStackable*/ ,tPal.PalletPK
													  from tblPallets tPal
													  INNER JOIN tblStockInLinePallets tSPal ON tPal.PalletPK = tsPal.PalletFK
													  INNER JOIN tblStockInLines tSlin ON tSPal.StockInLineFK = tSlin.StockInLinePK
													  INNER JOIN tblStockItems tSti ON tSti.StockItemPK = tSlin.StockItemFK
													  WHERE  tPal.palletPk = @PalletPK
														AND tPal.IsMixedPallet = 0
														AND tpal.isarchived = 0
														AND tPal.loaded = 0
												   ) tblStackable
													ON    tblStackable.PalletPK = tblStackpos.PalletFK
													WHERE tblStackable.IsStackable = 1
												END
											END
											ELSE
											SELECT 3   AS returnstatus,
													   @IsStackable AS IsStackable
											 print 'its here'

							  ELSE IF (@FreeSpace >= @PalletTotalWidth)  -- There is space

			--					EXEC [dbo].[spMobileWriteToLogFile] @errorNo,@errorMessage ,@Procedure 

							   SELECT @GapAtStart = case when (palletstart- @PalletTotalWidth >= 0) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END   FROM
								 (SELECT top 1* from (select palletEnd ,palletStart , locationFK, bayposition from tblPallets tPal 
											WHERE locationFK = @locationFK AND tpal.isarchived = 0 AND  tPal.loaded = 0 
											Union
											SELECT  DestinationPalletEnd , DestinationPalletStart, destinationFK ,destinationBayPosition  from tblworksOrderMovements Woms where

																   buildingUnitBayFK = @locationFK

			print '10'
								 if @GapATStart = 1
									BEGIN
			--							SELECT @errorNo = 17,
			--							@errorMessage = 'Manual Placement - Pallet ' + @PalletBarcode + '  Location  ' + @locationBarcode + ' Gap at Start ' 
			--							EXEC [dbo].[spMobileWriteToLogFile] @errorNo,@errorMessage ,@Procedure 

										-- check if the current pallet is stackable
										if (@IsStackable = 1)
										BEGIN
			--								SELECT @errorNo = 18,
			--								@errorMessage = 'Manual Placement - Pallet ' + @PalletBarcode + '  Location  ' + @locationBarcode + ' gap at start & stackable '
			--								EXEC [dbo].[spMobileWriteToLogFile] @errorNo,@errorMessage ,@Procedure 
											-- the pallet will fit in the first position
											SELECT 2 AS returnstatus, 
												0 AS PalletStart , 
												@PalletTotalWidth as PalletWidth,
												01 AS BayPosition,
												@LocationFK as LocationFK,
                   								@LeftToRight as LeftToRight, 
												@BayWidth as BayWidth ,
												@LocationText  as locationText ,
												PalletFK = @PalletPK,
												0 as StackPosition
											 -- Join the available spaces with stack positions
											UNION
											  select returnstatus,
													 palletstart,
													 palletwidth,
													 bayposition,
													 locationfk,
													 lefttoright,
													 Baywidth,
													 LocationText,
													 PalletFK,
													 StackPosition FROM
												   (SELECT * from 
														(SELECT 2 as returnstatus,
															   tblpallist.PalletStart,
															   tblpallist.bottomwith as PalletWidth,
															   bayposition + 1 as bayposition,
															   @LocationFK as LocationFK,
															   @LeftToRight as LeftToRight, 
															   @BayWidth as BayWidth ,
															   @LocationText  as locationText ,
															   PalletFK = @PalletPK,
															   1 as StackPosition
											       
											       
																FROM (	select * FROM 
																	-- check if they are the same stock and batch 
																	(select tpal.PalletPK,
																		   tpal.BayPosition , 
																		   tpal.palletstart ,
																		   (palletend - palletstart) as bottomwith 
																	  FROM tblPallets  tpal
																	  INNER JOIN tblPalletContent tPalcon
																	  ON tPalcon.PalletFK = tpal.PalletPK
																	  Where LocationFK = @LocationFK
																		AND StackPosition = 0
																		--AND tPalcon.StockItemFK = @StockItemFK
																		AND tpal.isarchived = 0
																		AND tPal.loaded = 0
																		--AND tPalcon.Batch = @batch
																		  ) tblbase
																	  left outer join
																	  (select tpal.PalletPK as stackpal, 
				   															  tpal.BayPosition as stackpos, 
																			  tpal.PalletStart as stackstart
																		 FROM tblPallets  tpal
																		  INNER JOIN tblPalletContent tPalcon
																			ON tPalcon.PalletFK = tpal.PalletPK
																			Where LocationFK = @LocationFK
																			  AND StackPosition = 1
																			  --AND tPalcon.StockItemFK = @StockItemFK
																			  AND tpal.isarchived = 0
																			  AND tPal.loaded = 0
																			  --AND tPalcon.Batch = @batch
																				) tblStack ON tblbase.PalletStart = tblStack.stackstart
															  ) tblpallist
															  where stackpal IS NULL
																AND tblpallist.bottomwith = @PalletTotalWidth) tblStackpos
															  inner JOIN 
															  --  join with the current pallet if it is stackable
															  (	select   tSti.IsStackable ,tPal.PalletPK
																  from tblPallets tPal
																  INNER JOIN tblStockInLinePallets tSPal ON tPal.PalletPK = tsPal.PalletFK
																  INNER JOIN tblStockInLines tSlin ON tSPal.StockInLineFK = tSlin.StockInLinePK
																  INNER JOIN tblStockItems tSti ON tSti.StockItemPK = tSlin.StockItemFK
																  WHERE  tPal.palletPk = @PalletPK
																	AND tPal.IsMixedPallet = 0
																	AND tpal.isarchived = 0
																	AND tPal.loaded = 0
															   ) tblStackable
															   ON    tblStackable.PalletPK = tblStackpos.PalletFK
															   WHERE tblStackable.IsStackable =	1
															) tblSpaceAvail	
												RETURN
										  END -- IsStackable = 1
										  ELSE
											BEGIN
												-- Only show space on the base 
											-- the pallet will fit in the first position
			--print'f'							SELECT @errorNo = 19,
			--										@errorMessage = 'Manual Placement - Pallet ' + @PalletBarcode + '  Location  ' + @locationBarcode + ' position at start  ' + CONVERT(nvarchar(10),@FreeSpace)
			--										EXEC [dbo].[spMobileWriteToLogFile] @errorNo,@errorMessage ,@Procedure 
												SELECT 2 AS returnstatus, 
													0 AS PalletStart , 
													@PalletTotalWidth as PalletWidth,
													01 AS BayPosition,
													@LocationFK as LocationFK,
                   									@LeftToRight as LeftToRight, 
													@BayWidth as BayWidth ,
													@LocationText  as locationText ,
													PalletFK = @PalletPK,
													0 as StackPosition
												RETURN
											END
										 END -- if gap at the start
								-- End of the Check if there is a gap at the start
								  ELSE
									BEGIN
									-- check if the pallet will fit in another location
			--								SELECT @errorNo = 20,
			--								@errorMessage = 'Manual Placement - Pallet ' + @PalletBarcode + '  Location  ' + @locationBarcode + ' more stackable positions ' + CONVERT(nvarchar(10),@FreeSpace)
			--								EXEC [dbo].[spMobileWriteToLogFile] @errorNo,@errorMessage ,@Procedure 

										   SELECT  @SpaceAvailable = SpaceAvailable,
											 @PalletStart = PalletEnd,
											 @BayPosition = BayPosition + 1
										   FROM 
												(select palletStart, palletEnd  , locationFK, tblPalletList.bayposition, 
												 -- check if there is a gap
													 case when NextPalletStart is not null then
															  CASE WHEN (NextPalletStart - palletEnd) >= @PalletTotalWidth then  1 END
														   else
															  -- check if there is space from hte last pallet to the end of the cell
															  CASE WHEN (@BayWidth - palletEnd) >= @PalletTotalWidth then 1 else 0 END
														   end as SpaceAvailable 
												from (select palletStart, palletEnd  , locationFK, bayposition from tblPallets tPal 
																					where locationFK = @locationFK AND tpal.isarchived = 0 	AND tPal.loaded = 0 Union
																					SELECT  DestinationPalletStart,DestinationPalletEnd , destinationFK ,destinationBayPosition  from tblworksOrderMovements Woms where 
																										  destinationFK = @locationFK  and 
																										  woms.WorksOrderStatusFK < 3 /*Not complete or cancelled*/ 
																					Union 
																					SELECT ObstructionStart ,ObstructionEnd ,  buildingUnitBayFK, 0 as palletFK from tblBuildingUnitBayObstructions where 
																										   buildingUnitBayFK = @locationFK
												) as tblPalletList
												left outer join
												 (select palletstart as NextPalletStart, bayposition  from (select palletStart, palletEnd  , locationFK, bayposition from tblPallets tPal 
																					WHERE locationFK = @locationFK AND tpal.isarchived = 0 AND tPal.loaded = 0
																					UNION
																					SELECT  DestinationPalletStart, DestinationPalletEnd ,  destinationFK ,destinationBayPosition  from tblworksOrderMovements Woms where 
																										  destinationFK = @locationFK  and 
																										  woms.WorksOrderStatusFK < 3 /*Not complete or cancelled*/ 
																					Union 
																					SELECT ObstructionStart ,ObstructionEnd ,  buildingUnitBayFK, 0 as palletFK from tblBuildingUnitBayObstructions where 
																										   buildingUnitBayFK = @locationFK
												)  tblpallist) tblNextStart ON tblNextStart.bayposition = (tblPalletList.bayposition + 1)
												) tblSpaceAvailable  where SpaceAvailable = 1 order by palletEnd desc
						
											-- Check if there is space and return status of 2 if there is otherwise return status 3
											IF @SpaceAvailable is null 
											BEGIN
			--									SELECT @errorNo = 21,
			--									@errorMessage = 'Manual Placement - location full ' 
			--									EXEC [dbo].[spMobileWriteToLogFile] @errorNo,@errorMessage ,@Procedure 
                                    
												if (@IsStackable = 1)
												BEGIN
												   -- check if there are stacked spaces available
													-- Join the available spaces with stack positions
			--											SELECT @errorNo = 22,
			--											@errorMessage = 'Manual Placement - Pallet ' + @PalletBarcode + '  Location  ' + @locationBarcode + ' location full - stackable pallet '
			--											EXEC [dbo].[spMobileWriteToLogFile] @errorNo,@errorMessage ,@Procedure 
														SELECT 2 as returnstatus,
															 tblpallist.PalletStart,
															 tblpallist.bottomwith as PalletWidth,
															 bayposition + 1 as bayposition,
															 @LocationFK as LocationFK,
															 @LeftToRight as LeftToRight, 
															 @BayWidth as BayWidth ,
															 @LocationText  as locationText ,
															 PalletFK = @PalletPK,
															 1 as StackPosition
															 FROM (
																	select * FROM (
																	-- check if they are the same stock and batch 
																	select tpal.PalletPK, tpal.BayPosition , tpal.palletstart 
																	, (palletend - palletstart) as bottomwith FROM tblPallets  tpal
																	INNER JOIN tblPalletContent tPalcon
																	ON tPalcon.PalletFK = tpal.PalletPK
																	Where LocationFK = @LocationFK
																	AND StackPosition = 0
																	--AND tPalcon.StockItemFK = @StockItemFK
																	AND tpal.isarchived = 0
																	AND tPal.loaded = 0
																	--AND tPalcon.Batch = @batch
																	  ) tblbase
																	left outer join
																	(select tpal.PalletPK as stackpal, 
																			tpal.BayPosition as stackpos, 
																			tpal.PalletStart as stackstart
																	   FROM tblPallets  tpal
																	INNER JOIN tblPalletContent tPalcon
																	ON tPalcon.PalletFK = tpal.PalletPK
																	Where LocationFK = @LocationFK
																	AND StackPosition = 1
																	AND tpal.isarchived = 0
																	--AND tPalcon.StockItemFK = @StockItemFK
																	AND tPal.loaded = 0													
																	--AND tPalcon.Batch = @batch
																	) tblStack ON tblbase.PalletStart = tblStack.stackstart
																	) tblpallist
															  where stackpal IS NULL
															  AND tblpallist.bottomwith = @PalletTotalWidth
											  END
											  ELSE
												SELECT 3 AS returnstatus,
												   0 AS IsStackable
												 print 'or is it here'
												RETURN
											END
									   ELSE
										BEGIN
			--									SELECT @errorNo = 23,
			--									@errorMessage = 'Manual Placement - more stackable positions ' + CONVERT(nvarchar(10),@FreeSpace)
			--									EXEC [dbo].[spMobileWriteToLogFile] @errorNo,@errorMessage ,@Procedure 
												IF (@IsStackable = 1)
												BEGIN
			print 'h'
													SELECT 2 AS returnstatus, 
														@PalletStart AS PalletStart , 
														@PalletTotalWidth as PalletWidth,
														@BayPosition AS BayPosition,
														@LocationFK as LocationFK,
                   										@LeftToRight as LeftToRight, 
														@BayWidth as BayWidth ,
														@LocationText  as locationText ,
														PalletFK = @PalletPK,
														0 as StackPosition
													  -- Join the available spaces with stack positions
													UNION
													SELECT 2 as returnstatus,
														 tblpallist.PalletStart,
														 tblpallist.bottomwith as PalletWidth,
														 bayposition + 1 as bayposition,
														 @LocationFK as LocationFK,
														 @LeftToRight as LeftToRight, 
														 @BayWidth as BayWidth ,
														 @LocationText  as locationText ,
														 PalletFK = @PalletPK,
														 1 as StackPosition
														 FROM (
																select * FROM (
																-- check if they are the same stock and batch 
																select tpal.PalletPK, tpal.BayPosition , tpal.palletstart 
																, (palletend - palletstart) as bottomwith FROM tblPallets  tpal
																INNER JOIN tblPalletContent tPalcon
																ON tPalcon.PalletFK = tpal.PalletPK
																Where LocationFK = @LocationFK
																AND StackPosition = 0
																--AND tPalcon.StockItemFK = @StockItemFK
																AND tpal.isarchived = 0
																AND tPal.loaded = 0
																--AND tPalcon.Batch = @batch
																) tblbase
																left outer join
																(select tpal.PalletPK as stackpal, 
																		tpal.BayPosition as stackpos, 
																		tpal.PalletStart as stackstart
																   FROM tblPallets  tpal
																INNER JOIN tblPalletContent tPalcon
																ON tPalcon.PalletFK = tpal.PalletPK
																Where LocationFK = @LocationFK
																AND StackPosition = 1
																--AND tPalcon.StockItemFK = @StockItemFK
																AND tpal.isarchived = 0
																AND tPal.loaded = 0
																--AND tPalcon.Batch = @batch
																   ) tblStack ON
																tblbase.PalletStart = tblStack.stackstart
																) tblpallist
														  where stackpal IS NULL
														  AND tblpallist.bottomwith = @PalletTotalWidth
														RETURN
												END
												ELSE
			--									SELECT @errorNo = 24,
			--									@errorMessage = 'Manual Placement - Pallet ' + @PalletBarcode + '  Location  ' + @locationBarcode + ' space at the start  ' 
			--									EXEC [dbo].[spMobileWriteToLogFile] @errorNo,@errorMessage ,@Procedure 
													SELECT 2 AS returnstatus, 
														@PalletStart AS PalletStart , 
														@PalletTotalWidth as PalletWidth,
														@BayPosition AS BayPosition,
														@LocationFK as LocationFK,
                   										@LeftToRight as LeftToRight, 
														@BayWidth as BayWidth ,
														@LocationText  as locationText ,
														PalletFK = @PalletPK,
														0 as StackPosition
											  RETURN
											END  -- if space available
										END  -- gap at the start
									-- check if the pallet will fit in another location
							END  -- there is a space
						END -- of conventional
						ELSE
						BEGIN
							-- check for drivethrough
							-- check if the column is empty 
							-- generates a list of the current pallets and then assigns pallets to the location
			--									SELECT @errorNo = 25,
			--									@errorMessage = 'Manual Placement - Pallet ' + @PalletBarcode + '  Location  ' + @locationBarcode + ' drive Trhough ' + CONVERT(nvarchar(10),@FreeSpace)
			--									EXEC [dbo].[spMobileWriteToLogFile] @errorNo,@errorMessage ,@Procedure 
							If (NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM (
									SELECT  palletpk, palletend , locationfk , bayposition 
											from tblpallets  
											WHERE  locationFK IN (SELECT BuildingUnitBayPK 
																	FROM tblBuildingUnitBays 
																	WHERE BuildingUnitColumnFK = @ColumnFK)
									UNION
									SELECT	 PalletFK as palletPK, destinationpalletend, destinationFK, destinationBayPosition 
											from tblWorksOrderMovements 
											WHERE destinationFK IN (SELECT BuildingUnitBayPK 
																	FROM tblBuildingUnitBays 
																	WHERE BuildingUnitColumnFK = @ColumnFK)
									) as tblPalletsInColumn ))
									BEGIN
										-- No Pallets assigned to this Column so select the top level and the first position
			--				                   SELECT @errorNo = 26,
			--									@errorMessage = 'Manual Placement - Pallet ' + @PalletBarcode + '  Location  ' + @locationBarcode + ' empty column  ' + CONVERT(nvarchar(10),@FreeSpace)
			--									EXEC [dbo].[spMobileWriteToLogFile] @errorNo,@errorMessage ,@Procedure 
											SELECT 7 AS returnstatus, 
														0 AS PalletStart , 
														@PalletTotalWidth as PalletWidth,
														01 AS BayPosition,
														(select TOP 1 buildingUnitBayPK 
																FROM tblBuildingUnitBays 
																WHERE BuildingUnitColumnFK = @ColumnFK
																ORDER BY BayLevel desc) as LocationFK,
                   										@LeftToRight as LeftToRight, 
														@BayWidth as BayWidth ,
														@LocationText as locationText ,
														PalletFK = @PalletPK,
														(select TOP 1 barcode
																FROM tblBuildingUnitBays 
																WHERE BuildingUnitColumnFK = @ColumnFK
																ORDER BY BayLevel desc) as Barcode
														RETURN
									END 
									ELSE
									BEGIN
										  -- check if the Column is full
										  if (not exists (		select top 1 * from (
												select tbubs.buildingunitbaypk, tbubs.baylevel, totalspacefilled, 
												case when spaceleft is null then 1 else spaceleft end as spaceleft
												from tblbuildingunitbays tbubs
												left outer join (
												select tblTotalSpaceFilled.baylevel, totalspacefilled , tbub.buildingunitbaypk ,
												(width - (totalspacefilled + @palletTotalWidth)) as spaceavail,
												case when (width - (totalspacefilled + @palletTotalWidth)) >= 0 
													then 1 
												When (width - (totalspacefilled + @palletTotalWidth)) is null
													then 1
												else 0 
												end as spaceleft 
												 from tblbuildingunitbays tbub inner join
												(select  baylevel,buildingunitbaypk,  sum(palletwidth) as totalSpaceFilled from tblbuildingunitbays 
												inner join 
												(select palletpk, (palletend-palletstart) as palletwidth , locationfk , bayposition from tblpallets where isarchived = 0 AND loaded = 0) tblpallets 
												on locationfk = buildingunitbayPK 
													  where buildingUnitColumnFK in
													  (select buildingunitcolumnfk from tblbuildingunitbays where barcode = @LocationBarcode)
									  
												   group by baylevel, buildingunitbaypk ) tblTotalSpaceFilled on
													tbub.buildingunitbaypk = tblTotalSpaceFilled.buildingunitbaypk ) tblspaceleftincell
													on tbubs.buildingunitbaypk = tblspaceleftincell.buildingunitbaypk
													  where buildingUnitColumnFK in
													  (select buildingunitcolumnfk from tblbuildingunitbays where barcode = @LocationBarcode) ) tblspacesfree where spaceleft  = 1 order by baylevel desc))
											BEGIN
												-- column is full
												SELECT 3 AS returnstatus
												RETURN
											END
											else
											BEGIN
												-- get a location in the column
											   select @locationFK = buildingunitbaypk
												FROM
													(SELECT top 1 * from (
														select tbubs.buildingunitbaypk,
															   tbubs.baylevel, 
															   totalspacefilled, 
															   case when spaceleft is null then 1 else spaceleft end as spaceleft
														from tblbuildingunitbays tbubs
														left outer join (
															select tblTotalSpaceFilled.baylevel, 
																   totalspacefilled ,	
																   tbub.buildingunitbaypk ,
																   (width - (totalspacefilled + @palletTotalWidth)) as spaceavail,
																	case when 
																		(width - (totalspacefilled + @palletTotalWidth)) >= 0 
																			then 1 
																		When (width - (totalspacefilled + @palletTotalWidth)) is null
																			then 1
																		else 0 
																		end as spaceleft 
															from tblbuildingunitbays tbub inner join
															(select  baylevel,buildingunitbaypk,  
																	sum(palletwidth) as totalSpaceFilled from tblbuildingunitbays 
															inner join 
															(select palletpk, (palletend-palletstart) as palletwidth , locationfk , bayposition from tblpallets where isarchived = 0 AND loaded = 0) tblpallets 
															  on locationfk = buildingunitbayPK 
															  where buildingUnitColumnFK in
																 (select buildingunitcolumnfk from tblbuildingunitbays where barcode = @LocationBarcode)
															  group by baylevel, buildingunitbaypk ) tblTotalSpaceFilled 
															  on tbub.buildingunitbaypk = tblTotalSpaceFilled.buildingunitbaypk ) tblspaceleftincell
															  on tbubs.buildingunitbaypk = tblspaceleftincell.buildingunitbaypk
															  where buildingUnitColumnFK in
																(select buildingunitcolumnfk from tblbuildingunitbays where barcode = @LocationBarcode) ) tblspacesfree where spaceleft  = 1 order by baylevel desc) tblFreeLevel
													
															SELECT 7 as returnStatus,
																 case when BayPosition IS NULL THEN 0 
																	ELSE PalletEnd 
															   END as palletStart, 
															   @PalletTotalWidth as PalletWidth,  
															   case when BayPosition is null then 1 else(BayPosition + 1) end
																  as BayPosition,
															   @LocationText as locationText,
															   @LocationFK as LocationFK,
                   											   @LeftToRight as LeftToRight, 
															   @BayWidth as BayWidth ,
															   PalletFK = @PalletPK ,
															Barcode = tbuB.barcode	      
															FROM
															tblBuildingunitbays tbuB 
															left outer join 
															(SELECT top 1 * from (select palletEnd ,palletStart , locationFK, BayPosition 
																	from tblPallets tPal 
																	where locationFK = @locationFK  
																	AND tPal.IsArchived = 0
																	AND tPal.loaded = 0
																	Union
															  SELECT  DestinationPalletStart, DestinationPalletEnd ,  destinationFK , destinationBayPosition  
																	from tblworksOrderMovements Woms 
																	where destinationFK = @locationFK  and 
																		  woms.WorksOrderStatusFK < 3 /*Not complete or cancelled*/ 												 
															)tbllastBayPosition order by palletend desc) tblBayPosition
															ON tbuB.BuildingUnitBayPK = tblBayPosition.locationFK 
															WHERE tbuB.BuildingUnitBayPK = @locationFK
														RETURN
			  								  END -- end of get location
										  END -- not empty
								END -- check for drive through
					END
			   END
			   ELSE
			   BEGIN
					-- Not a Set Down area or a Cell
					SELECT 4 AS returnstatus
					RETURN
			   END

			-- if there is no return status assigned then there is a problem
			 SELECT 5 as returnstatus
                    
			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end
						
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END

							+ ISNULL(CAST(@var_previousFirstBuildingUnitRow AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@previousLastBuildingUnitRow = ' 
								+ ISNULL(CAST(@var_previousLastBuildingUnitRow AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'')

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    --BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

		SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END


	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY
			

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start

			Declare @restrictSql nvarchar(MAX)
			Declare @sql nvarchar(MAX)
			Declare @thisLineSql nvarchar(MAX)
			Set @sql = '' --initialize
			Set @thisLineSql = '' --initialize

			Declare @prohibitTopLevelRacking as bit
			Declare @unstable3 as bit
			Declare @unstable2 as bit
			Declare @unstable1 as bit
			Declare @widthMargin int
			Declare @depthMargin int
			Declare @width int
			Declare @depth int
			Declare @height int
			Declare @defaultUnits decimal(18,3)
			Declare @systemStandardPalletHeight int
			Declare @overrideBuildingUnitRules bit
			Declare @stockDisperseBatch bit
			Declare @keepBatchTogetherLevel1 bit
			Declare @keepBatchTogetherLevel2 bit
			Declare @keepBatchTogetherLevel3 bit
			Declare @keepBatchTogetherLevel4 bit
			Declare @divisionFK int
			Declare @restrictStockWeight bit

			Declare @disperseBatch bit

			Declare @buildingUnit nvarchar(200)
			Declare @buildingUnitDisperseBatch bit

			Declare @autoRackingTypeFK int, @buildingUnitRows int

			Declare @originalNumberOfLocations int
	
			Declare @numberOfRows int
			Declare @currentRow int
			Declare @startColumn int --start column for run of location
			Select @numberOfRows = count(*) from tblBuildingUnitRows where BuildingUnitFK = @var_buildingUnitPK

		--  The following If has been removed
		--	as the rule for mixed pallets is they have to be the same stock and batch- only the each conent is mixed, so no need for different code
		--	if(@var_palletPK = -1) --no mixed pallet
		--	BEGIN
			Select @prohibitTopLevelRacking = ProhibitTopLevelRacking,
			@unstable3 = Unstable3,
			@unstable2 = Unstable2,
			@unstable1 = Unstable1,
			@widthMargin = WidthMargin,
			@depthMargin = DepthMargin,
			@overrideBuildingUnitRules = OverrideBuildingUnitRules,
			@stockDisperseBatch = DisperseBatch,
			@keepBatchTogetherLevel1 = KeepBatchTogetherLevel1,
			@keepBatchTogetherLevel2 = KeepBatchTogetherLevel2,
			@keepBatchTogetherLevel3 = KeepBatchTogetherLevel3,
			@keepBatchTogetherLevel4 = KeepBatchTogetherLevel4,
			@divisionFK = DivisionFK,
			@restrictStockWeight = case when UnitTypeFK in (2/*KGs*/) then 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ else 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/ End
			From tblStockItems stockItems
			Where StockItemPK = @var_stockItemPK

			--Get the height is available
				if(EXISTS(Select * from tblStockItemHeights where StockItemFK = @var_stockItemPK)) --if we have some height records
				BEGIN
					Select Top 1 @height = Height from tblStockItemHeights
					Where StockItemFK = @var_stockItemPK AND Units >= @var_units
					Order By Units ASC
				END 
				ELSE 
				BEGIN
					Set @height = 0
				END
		--	END
		--	ELSE
		--	BEGIN
		--		Select 
		--		@prohibitTopLevelRacking = case when sum(cast(ProhibitTopLevelRacking as int)) > 0
		--		then 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/ else 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ End,
		--		@unstable3 = case when sum(cast(Unstable3 as int)) > 0
		--		then 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/ else 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ End,
		--		@unstable2 = case when sum(cast(Unstable2 as int)) > 0
		--		then 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/ else 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ End,
		--		@unstable1 = case when sum(cast(Unstable1 as int)) > 0
		--		then 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/ else 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ End,
		--		@widthMargin = Max(WidthMargin),
		--		@depthMargin = Max(DepthMargin),
		--		@height = Max(DefaultHeight),
		--		@overrideBuildingUnitRules = case when sum(cast(OverrideBuildingUnitRules as int)) > 0
		--		then 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/ else 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ End,
		--		@stockDisperseBatch = case when sum(cast(OverrideBuildingUnitRules as int)) = count(*)
		--		then 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ else 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/ End,
		--		@keepBatchTogetherLevel1 = case when sum(cast(KeepBatchTogetherLevel1 as int)) = count(*)
		--		then 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ else 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/ End,
		--		@keepBatchTogetherLevel2 = case when sum(cast(KeepBatchTogetherLevel2 as int)) = count(*)
		--		then 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ else 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/ End,
		--		@keepBatchTogetherLevel3 = case when sum(cast(KeepBatchTogetherLevel3 as int)) = count(*)
		--		then 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ else 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/ End,
		--		@keepBatchTogetherLevel4 = case when sum(cast(KeepBatchTogetherLevel4 as int)) = count(*)
		--		then 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ else 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/ End
		--		From tblPallets pallets
		--		inner join tblPalletContent palletContent
		--		on palletContent.PalletFK = pallets.PalletPK
		--		inner join tblStockItems stockItems
		--		on stockItems.StockItemPK = palletContent.StockItemFK
		--		
		--		Where PalletPK = @var_palletPK
		--	END
		--  /*TESTING*/
		--	Print @prohibitTopLevelRacking
		--	Print @unstable3
		--	Print @unstable2
		--	Print @unstable1
		--	Print @depthMargin
		--	Print @height
		--	Print @overrideBuildingUnitRules

			Select @width = Width + (@widthMargin * 2), @depth = Depth + (@depthMargin * 2) from tblPalletTypes
			Where PalletTypePK = @var_palletTypePK

			print 'width ' + cast(@width as nvarchar(50))
			print 'depth ' + cast(@depth as nvarchar(50))

			Select @autoRackingTypeFK = AutomatedRackingTypeFK, @buildingUnitDisperseBatch = DisperseBatch, @buildingUnitRows = Count(*), @buildingUnit = BuildingUnit 
			from tblBuildingUnits bus
			Inner join tblBuildingUnitRows buRows
			on
			buRows.BuildingUnitFK = bus.BuildingUnitPK
			AND buRows.RackingtypeFK = bus.AutomatedRackingTypeFK
			where BuildingUnitPK = @var_buildingUnitPK
			Group By AutomatedRackingTypeFK, DisperseBatch, BuildingUnit

		
			DECLARE BayCursor CURSOR FAST_FORWARD FOR 
			Select Distinct BuildingUnitBayPK, MaximumBayWeight, BayWeight, Row, RowNumber, 
			Translate, TranslatedRow, ReverseTranslate, TranslateColumn,
			subQ.BuildingUnitColumn, BuildingUnitColumnName, MaximumColumnWeight, ColumnWeight, BayLevel, GapBetweenPallets, GapBetweenPalletsBayPosition, 
			GapBetweenPalletsPalletStart, 
			GapToEndOfBay, EndBayPosition, EndBayPalletStart, 
			GapToStartOfBay, StartBayPosition, StartBayPalletStart, 
			GapWholeBay, WholeBayPosition, WholeBayPalletStart, 
			Height as LocationOrder from (
			Select buBays.BuildingUnitBayPK,
				buBays.MaximumWeight as MaximumBayWeight,
				isnull(bayWeight.BayWeight, 0) BayWeight, 
				buRows.Row,
				buRows.RowNumber,
				buRows.Translate,
				buRows.TranslatedRow,
				buRows.ReverseTranslate,
				buRows.TranslateColumn,
				buCols.BuildingUnitColumn,
				buCols.BuildingUnitColumnName,
				buCols.MaximumWeight as MaximumColumnWeight,
				isnull(columnWeight.ColumnWeight, 0) ColumnWeight,
				buBays.BayLevel,
				buBays.Width,
				buBays.MinimumDepth,
				buBays.MaximumDepth,
				buBays.Height,
				pallets.PalletPK, 
				pallets.PalletStart, 
				pallets.PalletEnd,
				pallets.BayPosition, 
				isnull(gapRight.PalletStart - pallets.PalletEnd,0) as GapBetweenPallets, 
				case isnull(gapRight.PalletStart,0) when 0 then null else pallets.BayPosition + 1 END as GapBetweenPalletsBayPosition,
				case isnull(gapRight.PalletStart,0) when 0 then null else pallets.PalletEnd END as GapBetweenPalletsPalletStart,
				case when pallets.BayPosition = lastPallet.BayPosition then (buBays.Width - lastPallet.PalletEnd) else 0 End as GapToEndOfBay, /*Only Show this for last pallet*/
				case isnull(lastPallet.PalletEnd, 0) when 0 then null else lastPallet.BayPosition + 1 END as EndBayPosition,
				case isnull(lastPallet.PalletEnd, 0) when 0 then null else lastPallet.PalletEnd END as EndBayPalletStart,
				case when pallets.BayPosition = firstPallet.BayPosition then firstPallet.PalletStart else 0 End as GapToStartOfBay,
				case isnull(firstPallet.PalletStart, 0) when 0 then null else 1 END as StartBayPosition,
				0 as StartBayPalletStart,
				case isnull(pallets.PalletPK,0) when 0 then buBays.Width else 0 End as GapWholeBay,
				case isnull(pallets.PalletPK, 0) when 0 then 1 else 0 END as WholeBayPosition,
				0 as WholeBayPalletStart
			from tblBuildingUnitBays buBays
			inner join tblBuildingUnitColumns buCols on
			buCols.BuildingUnitColumnPK = buBays.BuildingUnitColumnFK
			inner join tblBuildingUnitRows buRows on
			buRows.BuildingUnitRowPK = buCols.BuildingUnitRowFK
	
			left outer join (
				Select buBays.BuildingUnitColumnFK, sum(isnull(ActualUnits, 0)) ColumnWeight
				from tblPallets pallets
				inner join tblPalletContent pc on
				pc.PalletFK = pallets.PalletPK
				inner join tblStockItems sis on
				sis.StockItemPK = pc.StockItemFK
				inner join tblBuildingUnitBays buBays on
				buBays.BuildingUnitBayPK = pallets.LocationFK
				where pallets.BuildingUnitFK = @var_buildingUnitPK AND sis.UnitTypeFK = 2 /*Kilograms*/
				AND buBays.BayLevel <> 'A' /*Dont add ground sitting pallets to the weight!*/
				group by buBays.BuildingUnitColumnFK
			) columnWeight on
			buCols.BuildingUnitColumnPK = columnWeight.BuildingUnitColumnFK

			left outer join (
				Select buBays.BuildingUnitBayPK, sum(isnull(ActualUnits, 0)) BayWeight
				from tblPallets pallets
				inner join tblPalletContent pc on
				pc.PalletFK = pallets.PalletPK
				inner join tblStockItems sis on
				sis.StockItemPK = pc.StockItemFK
				inner join tblBuildingUnitBays buBays on
				buBays.BuildingUnitBayPK = pallets.LocationFK
				where pallets.BuildingUnitFK = @var_buildingUnitPK AND sis.UnitTypeFK = 2 /*Kilograms*/
				AND buBays.BayLevel <> 'A'
				group by buBays.BuildingUnitBayPK
			) bayWeight on
			buBays.BuildingUnitBayPK = bayWeight.BuildingUnitBayPK

			left outer join (
				Select PalletPK, LocationTypeFK, LocationFK, PalletTypeFK, BayPosition, PalletStart, PalletEnd, StackPosition
				From tblPallets 
				Union
				Select PalletFK, DestinationLocationTypeFK, DestinationFK, palletsUnion.PalletTypeFK, DestinationBayPosition, DestinationPalletStart, 
				DestinationPalletEnd, 0 as StackPosition
				From tblWorksOrderMovements woms
					inner join tblPallets palletsUnion on
					palletsUnion.PalletPK = woms.PalletFK
					Where woms.WorksOrderStatusFK < 3 /*Not complete or cancelled*/
				) pallets on
				pallets.LocationTypeFK = 1
				AND pallets.StackPosition <= 0
				AND pallets.LocationFK = buBays.BuildingUnitBayPK

			left outer join (
				Select PalletPK, LocationTypeFK, LocationFK, PalletTypeFK, BayPosition, PalletStart, PalletEnd, StackPosition
				From tblPallets 
				Union
				Select PalletFK, DestinationLocationTypeFK, DestinationFK, palletsUnion.PalletTypeFK, DestinationBayPosition, DestinationPalletStart, 
				DestinationPalletEnd, 0 as StackPosition
				From tblWorksOrderMovements woms
					inner join tblPallets palletsUnion on
					palletsUnion.PalletPK = woms.PalletFK
					Where woms.WorksOrderStatusFK < 3 /*Not complete or cancelled*/
				) gapRight on
				gapRight.LocationTypeFK = 1
				AND gapRight.StackPosition <= 0
				AND gapRight.LocationFK = pallets.LocationFK
				AND gapRight.PalletStart = (Select Top 1 PalletStart From (Select PalletStart, LocationFK From tblPallets union Select DestinationPalletStart, 
				DestinationFK from tblWorksOrderMovements where WorksOrderStatusFK < 3)subQNoName where LocationFK = pallets.LocationFK 
				AND PalletStart >= pallets.PalletEnd order by PalletStart ASC)
				AND gapRight.PalletStart <> pallets.PalletEnd

			left outer join (Select Max(BayPosition) BayPosition, LocationTypeFK, LocationFK, StackPosition, Max(PalletEnd) as PalletEnd
			from (
				Select PalletPK, LocationTypeFK, LocationFK, PalletTypeFK, BayPosition, PalletStart, PalletEnd, StackPosition
				From tblPallets 
				Union
				Select PalletFK, DestinationLocationTypeFK, DestinationFK, palletsUnion.PalletTypeFK, DestinationBayPosition, DestinationPalletStart, 
				DestinationPalletEnd, 0 as StackPosition
				From tblWorksOrderMovements woms
					inner join tblPallets palletsUnion on
					palletsUnion.PalletPK = woms.PalletFK
					Where woms.WorksOrderStatusFK < 3 /*Not complete or cancelled*/
				) subQLastPallets
					Group By LocationTypeFK, LocationFK, StackPosition) lastPallet on
				lastPallet.LocationTypeFK = 1
				AND lastPallet.StackPosition <= 0
				AND lastPallet.LocationFK = pallets.LocationFK
				AND lastPallet.PalletEnd <> buBays.Width

			left outer join (Select Min(BayPosition) BayPosition, LocationTypeFK, LocationFK, StackPosition, Min(PalletStart) as PalletStart 
				from (
				Select PalletPK, LocationTypeFK, LocationFK, PalletTypeFK, BayPosition, PalletStart, PalletEnd, StackPosition
				From tblPallets 
				Union
				Select PalletFK, DestinationLocationTypeFK, DestinationFK, palletsUnion.PalletTypeFK, DestinationBayPosition, DestinationPalletStart, 
				DestinationPalletEnd, 0 as StackPosition
				From tblWorksOrderMovements woms
					inner join tblPallets palletsUnion on
					palletsUnion.PalletPK = woms.PalletFK
					Where woms.WorksOrderStatusFK < 3 /*Not complete or cancelled*/
				) subQfirstPallet 
					Group By LocationTypeFK, LocationFK, StackPosition) firstPallet on
				firstPallet.LocationTypeFK = 1
				AND firstPallet.StackPosition <= 0
				AND firstPallet.PalletStart <> 0
				AND firstPallet.LocationFK = pallets.LocationFK

			Where buRows.BuildingUnitFK = @var_buildingUnitPK
			AND buRows.RackingTypeFK = @autoRackingTypeFK
			AND ASCII(buBays.BayLevel) - 64 < /*Not Top Level*/
				Case when @prohibitTopLevelRacking = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ Then buCols.Levels Else 99999 End
			AND ASCII(buBays.BayLevel) <= 
				Case when @unstable1 = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ Then 67 /*Less than or equal to Level C*/
				Else 99999 End
			AND ASCII(buBays.BayLevel) <= 
				Case when @unstable2 = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ Then 66 /*Less than or equal to Level B*/
				Else 99999 End
			AND ASCII(buBays.BayLevel) <= 
				Case when @unstable3 = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ Then 65 /*Level A Only*/
				Else 99999 End

			) subQ

			Where /*Check for this divisions assigned bays*/
					(BuildingUnitBayPK in 
					(Select dbuBays.BuildingUnitBayFK from tblDivisionBuildingUnitBays dbuBays
					 Where DivisionFK = @divisionFK AND dbuBays.BuildingUnitFK = @var_buildingUnitPK))

				  /*Check this bay is not assigned to any other division*/
				AND BuildingUnitBayPK not in 
					(Select dbuBays.BuildingUnitBayFK from tblDivisionBuildingUnitBays dbuBays
						Where DivisionFK <> @divisionFK AND dbuBays.BuildingUnitFK = @var_buildingUnitPK)
				AND (GapBetweenPallets >=@width
				OR GapToEndOfBay >= @width
				OR GapToStartOfBay >= @width
				OR GapWholeBay >= @width)
			AND (MaximumDepth >= @depth /*Maximum Depth*/
			AND MinimumDepth <= @depth) /*Minimum Depth*/
			AND Height >= @height
			AND (BayWeight < MaximumBayWeight OR MaximumBayWeight = 0)
			AND (ColumnWeight < MaximumColumnWeight OR MaximumColumnWeight = 0)

			ORDER BY
				Row ASC, BuildingUnitColumn DESC, BayLevel ASC

			Declare @buildingUnitBayPK int, @maximumBayWeight decimal(18,3), @bayWeight decimal(18,3),
			@buildingUnitRow nvarchar(10), @buildingUnitRowNumber int, 
			@translateRow bit, @translatedRow nvarchar(50), @reverseTranslate bit, @translateColumn int,
			@buildingUnitColumn int, @buildingUnitColumnName nvarchar(50), @maximumColumnWeight decimal(18,3), @columnWeight decimal(18,3), @buildingUnitBayLevel nvarchar(10), 
			@gapBetweenPallets int, @gapBetweenPalletsBayPosition int, @gapBetweenPalletsPalletStart int, 
			@gapToEndOfBay int, @endBayPosition int, @endBayPalletStart int, 
			@gapToStartOfBay int, @startBayPosition int, @startBayPalletStart int, 
			@gapWholeBay int, @wholeBayPosition int, @wholeBayPalletStart int, 
			@locationOrder int

			Declare @previousBuildingUnitColumn int -- for keeping batches together
			Declare @previousBuildingUnitColumnForWeight int
			Declare @previousBuildingUnitBayPK int
			Declare @runningColumnWeight decimal(18,3), @runningBayWeight decimal(18,3)

			OPEN BayCursor
		
			FETCH NEXT FROM BayCursor INTO 
			@buildingUnitBayPK, @maximumBayWeight, @bayWeight,
			@buildingUnitRow, @buildingUnitRowNumber, 
			@translateRow, @translatedRow, @reverseTranslate, @translateColumn,
			@buildingUnitColumn, @buildingUnitColumnName, @maximumColumnWeight, @columnWeight, @buildingUnitBayLevel, 
			@gapBetweenPallets, @gapBetweenPalletsBayPosition, @gapBetweenPalletsPalletStart, 
			@gapToEndOfBay, @endBayPosition, @endBayPalletStart, 
			@gapToStartOfBay, @startBayPosition, @startBayPalletStart, 
			@gapWholeBay, @wholeBayPosition, @wholeBayPalletStart, 
			@locationOrder

			Declare @availableSpace bit
			Declare @availableGap int
			Declare @bayPosition int
			Declare @palletStart int
			Declare @gapType as nvarchar(50)/* whole, between, start, end*/
			Declare @firstRun int
			Set @firstRun = 1
			Set @availableSpace = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/
			--Print @@FETCH_STATUS
			Set @originalNumberOfLocations = @var_numberOfLocations
			Set @previousBuildingUnitColumn = -1
			Set @previousBuildingUnitColumnForWeight = -1
			Set @previousBuildingUnitBayPK = -1
	
			Set @currentRow = -1

			DECLARE @myLocations TABLE 
			( 
				RowNumber INT, 
				RowLetter nvarchar(50),
				ColumnNumber INT,
				Sql text 
			)
	
			WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 AND @var_numberOfLocations > 0
			BEGIN
				Print 'Began Loop'
				if (@currentRow = -1) Set @currentRow = @buildingUnitRowNumber
				--if the row has moved on and we still have pallets to locate, we must reset as we dont want a run of stock/batch in different rows
				if (@buildingUnitRowNumber > @currentRow)
				BEGIN
					Select @sql = '', @var_numberOfLocations = @originalNumberOfLocations, @currentRow = @buildingUnitRowNumber, @firstRun = 1
				END
				if (@currentRow > @buildingUnitRowNumber) 
				BEGIN
					goto Skip --if we are looking for a different row, skip
				END
				ELSE
				BEGIN --we have moved on to the row we were looking for or the row has moved past the row we were looking for (either no gaps or row is not assigned to division), so set the row
					Set @currentRow = @buildingUnitRowNumber
				END
			
				Print isnull(@gapWholeBay, -1)
				Print isnull(@gapBetweenPalletsPalletStart, -1)
				Print isnull(@gapBetweenPallets, -1)
				Print isnull(@gapToStartOfBay, -1)
				Print isnull(@endBayPalletStart, -1)
				Print isnull(@gapToEndOfBay, -1)

				Set @availableSpace = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ 
		
				IF (@gapWholeBay > 0)
				BEGIN
					Set @bayPosition = 1
					Set @palletStart = 0
					Set @availableGap = @gapWholeBay
					Set @gapType = 'whole'
				END
				ELSE IF @gapBetweenPallets >= @width
				BEGIN
					Set @bayPosition = @gapBetweenPalletsBayPosition
					Set @palletStart = @gapBetweenPalletsPalletStart
					Set @availableGap = @gapBetweenPallets
					Set @gapType = 'between'
				END
				ELSE IF (@gapToStartOfBay >= @width)
				BEGIN
					Set @bayPosition = @startBayPosition
					Set @palletStart = 0
					Set @availableGap = @gapToStartOfBay
					Set @gapType = 'start'
				END
				ELSE IF (@gapToEndOfBay >= @width)
				BEGIN
					Set @bayPosition = @endBayPosition
					Set @palletStart = @endBayPalletStart
					Set @availableGap = @gapToEndOfBay
					Set @gapType = 'end'
				END
		
		
				WHILE @availableSpace = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ AND @var_numberOfLocations > 0
				BEGIN
		--			Print 'Began 2nd Loop'
		--			Print @buildingUnitRow
					--******* WEIGHT CODE ************
					IF(@restrictStockWeight = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ AND @maximumColumnWeight > 0 AND @buildingUnitBayLevel <> 'A')
					BEGIN
						Print 'weight1'
						IF(@previousBuildingUnitColumnForWeight <> @buildingUnitColumn)
						BEGIN
							Set @runningColumnWeight = @var_units
						END ELSE
						BEGIN
							Set @runningColumnWeight = @runningColumnWeight + @var_units
						END
						Set @previousBuildingUnitColumnForWeight = @buildingUnitColumn
						if(@previousBuildingUnitBayPK <> @buildingUnitBayPK)
						BEGIN
							Set @runningBayWeight = @var_units
						END ELSE
						BEGIN
							Set @runningBayWeight = @runningBayWeight + @var_units
						END
						Set @previousBuildingUnitBayPK = @buildingUnitBayPK
						--If the current located weight + what we have added already + what we want to add is greater than the limit, skip the location
						IF((@columnWeight + @runningColumnWeight) > @maximumColumnWeight
							OR
							(@bayWeight + @runningBayWeight) > @maximumBayWeight)
						BEGIN
							print 'weight too much!'
							goto Skip --we have gone over the weight limit for this column or bay, skip it
						END
					END
					--****** END OF WEIGHT CODE ************
		--			Print 'Column Weight ' + cast(@columnWeight as nvarchar(50))
		--			Print 'Running Column Weight ' + cast(@runningColumnWeight as nvarchar(50))
			
					if @firstRun = 0 
					BEGIN
						Set @sql = @sql + ' UNION ALL '
					END
					ELSE
					BEGIN
						Set @startColumn = @buildingUnitColumn
					END
					Set @thisLineSql = ' Select ''' + @buildingUnit + ''' BuildingUnit,''' + case when @translateRow = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ then @translatedRow 
					else @buildingUnitRow end + ''' Row,''' + case when @translateRow = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ then 
					case when @reverseTranslate = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ then cast(@translateColumn - @buildingUnitColumn as nvarchar(10)) 
					else cast(@buildingUnitColumn + @translateColumn as nvarchar(10)) end else cast(@buildingUnitColumn as nvarchar(10)) end 
					+ ''' BuildingUnitColumn,''' + case when @translateRow = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ then case when @reverseTranslate = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/ then 
					cast(@translateColumn - @buildingUnitColumn as nvarchar(10)) else cast(@buildingUnitColumn + @translateColumn as nvarchar(10)) end 
					else cast(@buildingUnitColumn as nvarchar(10)) end + ''' BuildingUnitColumnName,''' + @buildingUnitBayLevel + ''' BayLevel,' 
					+ cast(@bayPosition as nvarchar(50))	+ ' BayPosition,' + cast(@palletStart as nvarchar(50)) + ' PalletStart,' 
					+ cast((@palletStart + @width) as nvarchar(50)) + ' PalletEnd,' + cast(@buildingUnitBayPK as nvarchar(100)) + ' LocationFK'	
					Set @sql = @sql	+ @thisLineSql
					--Print @sql
			
					Set @availableGap = @availableGap - @width
					if (@availableGap < @width) 
					BEGIN
						IF (@gapType = 'whole')
							Set @availableSpace = 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/				
						ELSE IF (@gapType = 'between')
						BEGIN
							IF (@gapToStartOfBay >= @width)
							BEGIN
								Set @bayPosition = @startBayPosition
								Set @palletStart = 0
								Set @availableGap = @gapToStartOfBay
								Set @gapType = 'start'
							END
							ELSE IF (@gapToEndOfBay >= @width)
							BEGIN
								Set @bayPosition = @endBayPosition
								Set @palletStart = @endBayPalletStart
								Set @availableGap = @gapToEndOfBay
								Set @gapType = 'end'
							END
							ELSE Set @availableSpace = 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/	
						END
						ELSE IF (@gapType = 'start')
						BEGIN
							IF (@gapToEndOfBay >= @width)
							BEGIN
								Set @bayPosition = @endBayPosition
								Set @palletStart = @endBayPalletStart
								Set @availableGap = @gapToEndOfBay
								Set @gapType = 'end'
							END
							ELSE Set @availableSpace = 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/	
						END
						ELSE IF (@gapType = 'end')
						BEGIN
							Set @availableSpace = 0/*cast(0 as bit)*/	
						END
			
					END
					ELSE
					BEGIN
						Set @bayPosition = @bayPosition + 1
						Set @palletStart = @palletStart + @width
					END

			
					Set @var_numberOfLocations = @var_numberOfLocations - 1
					Set @firstRun = 0

					/*KEEP BATCH TOGETHER**************/
					if(@overrideBuildingUnitRules = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/)
					BEGIN
						/*Keep batch in one or more adjoining columns*/
						if(@keepBatchTogetherLevel2 = 1/*cast(1 as bit)*/)
						BEGIN
							if(@previousBuildingUnitColumn = -1)
							BEGIN
								Set @previousBuildingUnitColumn = @buildingUnitColumn
							END
							ELSE
							BEGIN 
								/* This next 'if' statement is complex */
								/* Explanation*/
								/* If we have skipped a column since the last location 
									AND we have also moved more than one column from
									the columns used for a previous batch location
									AND we havent moved just one column since we were last here then
									we need to start again*/
								if(
									((ABS(@previousBuildingUnitColumn - @buildingUnitColumn) > 1 
									AND @var_previousFirstBuildingUnitColumn = -1)
							
									OR 
										(
										(@var_previousFirstBuildingUnitColumn > 0) AND
										((@buildingUnitColumn > (@var_previousFirstBuildingUnitColumn + 1)
										OR
										(@buildingUnitColumn < (@var_previousLastBuildingUnitColumn - 1)))
										)
									))
									AND ABS(@previousBuildingUnitColumn - @buildingUnitColumn) <> 1
								)
								BEGIN /*If selection has jumped a column, reset and start again*/
									Print 'Starting Again'
									Select @previousBuildingUnitColumn = @buildingUnitColumn,
									@var_numberOfLocations = @originalNumberOfLocations - 1,
									@firstRun = 0,
									@sql = @thisLineSql,
									@startColumn = @buildingUnitColumn
								END
							END
						END
					END
				END

				If (@var_numberOfLocations = 0)
				BEGIN
					Insert into @myLocations
					values (@buildingUnitRowNumber, 
						@buildingUnitRow,
						@startColumn,
						@sql) 
					If (@currentRow < @numberOfRows AND @var_previousLastBuildingUnitRow <> @buildingUnitRow) 
					BEGIN
						Set @currentRow = @currentRow + 1
						Set @var_numberOfLocations = @originalNumberOfLocations
						Set @firstRun = 1
						Set @sql = ''
					END
				END
		
		Skip:
				FETCH NEXT FROM BayCursor INTO 
				@buildingUnitBayPK, @maximumBayWeight, @bayWeight,
				@buildingUnitRow, @buildingUnitRowNumber,
				@translateRow, @translatedRow, @reverseTranslate, @translateColumn,
				@buildingUnitColumn, @buildingUnitColumnName, @maximumColumnWeight, @columnWeight, @buildingUnitBayLevel, 
				@gapBetweenPallets, @gapBetweenPalletsBayPosition, @gapBetweenPalletsPalletStart, 
				@gapToEndOfBay, @endBayPosition, @endBayPalletStart, 
				@gapToStartOfBay, @startBayPosition, @startBayPalletStart, 
				@gapWholeBay, @wholeBayPosition, @wholeBayPalletStart,
				@locationOrder
			END
			CLOSE BayCursor 
			DEALLOCATE BayCursor 
	
	
			Print 'here'
			Set @sql = ''
			IF (@var_previousLastBuildingUnitRow <> '')
			BEGIN
				Select @sql = Sql from @myLocations where RowLetter = @var_previousLastBuildingUnitRow
			END 
	
			IF(@sql = '') --if we had no previous row OR there was no available locations for the previous row, do regular selection
			BEGIN
				Select Top 1 @sql = Sql from @myLocations
				Order by ColumnNumber Desc, RowNumber Asc
			END
			--Print @sql
			--Print(len(@sql))
			Exec(@sql)
			--Select * from @myLocations
	
			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end

			
			
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END
GO

			Declare @overrideBuildingUnitRules bit
			Declare @stockDisperseBatch bit
			Declare @keepBatchTogetherLevel1 bit
			Declare @keepBatchTogetherLevel2 bit
			Declare @keepBatchTogetherLevel3 bit
			Declare @keepBatchTogetherLevel4 bit
			Declare @divisionFK int, @customerFK int

			--Declare @stockItemBuildingUnitBays int

			Declare @buildingUnit nvarchar(200)
			Declare @buildingUnitDisperseBatch bit

			Declare /*@autoRackingTypeFK int,*/ @buildingUnitRows int

			/*Select @stockItemBuildingUnitBays = count(*) from tblStockItemBuildingUnitBays sibuBays
						Where StockItemFK = @stockItemPK2 AND sibuBays.BuildingUnitFK = @buildingUnitPK2*/
		--	Print 'SIBUBS'
		--	Print @stockItemBuildingUnitBays

		--  The following If has been removed
		--	as the rule for mixed pallets is they have to be the same stock and batch- only the each conent is mixed, so no need for different code
		--	if(@palletPK2 = -1) --no mixed pallet
		--	BEGIN

			Select @prohibitTopLevelRacking = ProhibitTopLevelRacking,
			@allowFloorStorage = AllowFloorStorage,
			@levelC_Above = LevelC_Above,
			@unstable3 = Unstable3,
			@unstable2 = Unstable2,
			@unstable1 = Unstable1,
			@isStackable = IsStackable,
			@isDepthStackable = IsDepthStackable,
			@customWidth = CustomWidth,
			@customDepth = CustomDepth,
			@widthMargin = WidthMargin,
			@depthMargin = DepthMargin,
			@overrideBuildingUnitRules = OverrideBuildingUnitRules,
			@stockDisperseBatch = DisperseBatch,
			@keepBatchTogetherLevel1 = KeepBatchTogetherLevel1,
			@keepBatchTogetherLevel2 = KeepBatchTogetherLevel2,
			@keepBatchTogetherLevel3 = KeepBatchTogetherLevel3,
			@keepBatchTogetherLevel4 = KeepBatchTogetherLevel4,
			@divisionFK = DivisionFK,
			@customerFK = divs.CustomerFK,
			@restrictStockWeight = case when UnitTypeFK in (2/*KGs*/) then 1 /*bit value*/ else 0 /*bit value*/ End
			From tblStockItems AS stockItems
			inner join tblDivisions AS divs on
			divs.DivisionPK = stockItems.DivisionFK
			Where StockItemPK = @stockItemPK2

			Select top 1 @heightMargin = GeneralHeightMargin, @widthMargin = (@widthMargin + GeneralWidthMargin), @depthMargin = (@depthMargin + GeneralDepthMargin)
			from appSystem

			Set @height = 0

			--Get the height is available
			if(EXISTS(Select * from tblStockItemLayerHeights where StockItemFK = @stockItemPK2)) 
			BEGIN
				--We have a layer summary, calculate height
				Declare @layerUnits decimal(18,3), @layerHeight int

				Select Top 1 @layerUnits = LayerUnits, @layerHeight = LayerHeight
				from tblStockItemLayerHeights where StockItemFK = @stockItemPK2

				Set @height = (CEILING(@units2 / @layerUnits) * @layerHeight) + (Select Top 1 StandardPalletHeight From appSystem) + @heightMargin
			END

			if(EXISTS(Select * from tblStockItemHeights where StockItemFK = @stockItemPK2)) 
				--We have height records.. note this will over write any heights calculated previously as these records are more exact
				Select Top 1 @height = Height + @heightMargin from tblStockItemHeights Where StockItemFK = @stockItemPK2 AND Units >= @units2 Order By Units ASC

			Print 'Width Margin ' + cast(@widthMargin as nvarchar(300))
			Print 'Depth Margin ' + cast(@depthMargin as nvarchar(300))
			Print 'Height Margin ' + cast(@depthMargin as nvarchar(300))
			Print 'Height ' + cast(@height as nvarchar(300))

			Select Top 1 @orderBy1 = cast(AutoPlaceRuleType as nvarchar(300)) + cast(ValueFK as nvarchar(300))
			From tblAutoPlaceRules AS aprs
			inner join tblAutoPlaceRuleTypes AS aprts on
