			Where (RuleReceiverTypeFK = 1 /*Customer*/ AND AutoPlaceRuleReceiverFK = @customerFK AND RuleOrder = 2)
			OR (RuleReceiverTypeFK = 2 /*Division*/ AND AutoPlaceRuleReceiverFK = @divisionFK AND RuleOrder = 2)
			OR (RuleReceiverTypeFK = 3 /*Stock*/ AND AutoPlaceRuleReceiverFK = @stockItemPK2 AND RuleOrder = 2)
			Order By RuleReceiverTypeFK DESC

			Select Top 1 @orderBy3 = cast(AutoPlaceRuleType as nvarchar(300)) + cast(ValueFK as nvarchar(300))
			From tblAutoPlaceRules AS aprs
			inner join tblAutoPlaceRuleTypes AS aprts on
			aprts.AutoPlaceRuleTypePK = aprs.AutoPlaceRuleTypeFK
			Where (RuleReceiverTypeFK = 1 /*Customer*/ AND AutoPlaceRuleReceiverFK = @customerFK AND RuleOrder = 3)
			OR (RuleReceiverTypeFK = 2 /*Division*/ AND AutoPlaceRuleReceiverFK = @divisionFK AND RuleOrder = 3)
			OR (RuleReceiverTypeFK = 3 /*Stock*/ AND AutoPlaceRuleReceiverFK = @stockItemPK2 AND RuleOrder = 3)
			Order By RuleReceiverTypeFK DESC

			Select Top 1 @orderBy4 = cast(AutoPlaceRuleType as nvarchar(300)) + cast(ValueFK as nvarchar(300))
			From tblAutoPlaceRules AS aprs
			inner join tblAutoPlaceRuleTypes AS aprts on
			aprts.AutoPlaceRuleTypePK = aprs.AutoPlaceRuleTypeFK
			Where (RuleReceiverTypeFK = 1 /*Customer*/ AND AutoPlaceRuleReceiverFK = @customerFK AND RuleOrder = 4)
			OR (RuleReceiverTypeFK = 2 /*Division*/ AND AutoPlaceRuleReceiverFK = @divisionFK AND RuleOrder = 4)
			OR (RuleReceiverTypeFK = 3 /*Stock*/ AND AutoPlaceRuleReceiverFK = @stockItemPK2 AND RuleOrder = 4)
			Order By RuleReceiverTypeFK DESC

			if(@customWidth > 0 AND @customDepth > 0) 
				Select @width = @customWidth + (@widthMargin * 2), @depth = @customDepth + (@depthMargin * 2)
			ELSE 
				Select @width = Width + (@widthMargin * 2), @depth = Depth + (@depthMargin * 2) from tblPalletTypes
				Where PalletTypePK = @palletTypePK2

			print 'Above C ' + cast(@levelC_Above as nvarchar(50))
			print 'FloorStorage ' + cast(@allowFloorStorage as nvarchar(50))
			print 'unstable1 ' + cast(@unstable1 as nvarchar(50))
			print 'unstable2 ' + cast(@unstable2 as nvarchar(50))
			print 'unstable3 ' + cast(@unstable3 as nvarchar(50))
			print 'prohibit top level ' + cast(@prohibitTopLevelRacking as nvarchar(50))
			print 'stackable ' + cast(@isStackable as nvarchar(50))
			print 'depth stackable ' + cast(@isDepthStackable as nvarchar(50))
			print 'orderBy1 ' + cast(@orderBy1 as nvarchar(50))
			print 'orderBy4 ' + cast(@orderBy2 as nvarchar(50))
			print 'orderBy3 ' + cast(@orderBy3 as nvarchar(50))
			print 'orderBy4 ' + cast(@orderBy4 as nvarchar(50))

			print 'width ' + cast(@width as nvarchar(50))
			print 'depth ' + cast(@depth as nvarchar(50))

			Select /*@autoRackingTypeFK = AutomatedRackingTypeFK,*/ @buildingUnitDisperseBatch = DisperseBatch, @buildingUnitRows = Count(*), @buildingUnit = BuildingUnit 
			from tblBuildingUnits AS bus
			Inner join tblBuildingUnitRows AS buRows
			on
			buRows.BuildingUnitFK = bus.BuildingUnitPK
			AND buRows.RackingtypeFK = bus.AutomatedRackingTypeFK
			where BuildingUnitPK = @buildingUnitPK2
			Group By AutomatedRackingTypeFK, DisperseBatch, BuildingUnit

			--print 'racking type ' + cast(@autoRackingTypeFK as nvarchar(50))
			print 'Disperse batch ' + cast(@buildingUnitDisperseBatch as nvarchar(50))
			print 'Row count ' + cast(@buildingUnitRows as nvarchar(50))
			print 'Building unit ' + cast(@buildingUnit as nvarchar(50))
		
			DECLARE BayCursor CURSOR FAST_FORWARD FOR 
			SELECT * FROM (
			Select Distinct BuildingUnitBayPK, MaximumBayWeight, BayWeight, RackingTypeFK, Row, RowNumber, 
			Translate, TranslatedRow, ReverseTranslate, TranslateColumn,
			subQ.BuildingUnitColumn, BuildingUnitColumnName, MaximumColumnWeight, ColumnWeight, BayLevel, 
			GapBetweenPallets, GapBetweenPalletsBayPosition, GapBetweenPalletsPalletStart, 
			GapToEndOfBay, EndBayPosition, EndBayPalletStart, 
			GapToStartOfBay, StartBayPosition, StartBayPalletStart, 
			GapWholeBay, WholeBayPosition, WholeBayPalletStart, 
			Height as LocationOrder, PalletStart, StockItemContentFound, StackedContentFound/*,
			StockItemBuildingUnitBayPK, IsStockItemLocationExclusive*/ from (
			Select buBays.BuildingUnitBayPK,
				buBays.MaximumWeight as MaximumBayWeight,
				isnull(bayWeight.BayWeight, 0) BayWeight,
				buRows.RackingTypeFK, 
				buRows.Row,
				buRows.RowNumber,
				buRows.Translate,
				buRows.TranslatedRow,
				buRows.ReverseTranslate,
				buRows.TranslateColumn,
				buCols.BuildingUnitColumn,
				buCols.BuildingUnitColumnName,
				buCols.MaximumWeight as MaximumColumnWeight,
				isnull(columnWeight.ColumnWeight, 0) ColumnWeight,
				buBays.BayLevel,
				buBays.Width,
				buBays.MinimumDepth,
				buBays.MaximumDepth,
				buBays.Height,
				pallets.PalletPK, 
				pallets.PalletStart, 
				pallets.PalletEnd,
				pallets.BayPosition, 
				isnull(gapRight.PalletStart - pallets.PalletEnd,0) as GapBetweenPallets, 
				case isnull(gapRight.PalletStart,0) when 0 then null else pallets.BayPosition + 1 END as GapBetweenPalletsBayPosition,
				case isnull(gapRight.PalletStart,0) when 0 then null else pallets.PalletEnd END as GapBetweenPalletsPalletStart,
				case when pallets.BayPosition = lastPallet.BayPosition then (buBays.Width - lastPallet.PalletEnd) else 0 End as GapToEndOfBay, /*Only Show this for last pallet*/
				case isnull(lastPallet.PalletEnd, 0) when 0 then null else lastPallet.BayPosition + 1 END as EndBayPosition,
				case isnull(lastPallet.PalletEnd, 0) when 0 then null else lastPallet.PalletEnd END as EndBayPalletStart,
				case when pallets.BayPosition = firstPallet.BayPosition then firstPallet.PalletStart else 0 End as GapToStartOfBay,
				case isnull(firstPallet.PalletStart, 0) when 0 then null else 1 END as StartBayPosition,
				0 as StartBayPalletStart,
				case isnull(pallets.PalletPK,0) when 0 then buBays.Width else 0 End as GapWholeBay,
				case isnull(pallets.PalletPK, 0) when 0 then 1 else 0 END as WholeBayPosition,
				0 as WholeBayPalletStart,
				HasSameStockItem.StockItemContentFound,
				HasStackedStock.StackedContentFound/*,
				sibubs.StockItemBuildingUnitBayPK, sibubs.IsExclusive as IsStockItemLocationExclusive*/
			from (Select BuildingUnitBayPK, BuildingUnitColumnFK, BayLevel, 
					case	when @isStackable = 1 /*bit value*/ then (floor(Width/@width)*@width) * floor(Height/@height) 
							when @isDepthStackable = 1 /*bit value*/ then (floor(Width/@width)*@width) * floor(Height/@height) * floor(MaximumDepth/@depth) 
					else 
						Width 
					End as Width , MaximumDepth, MinimumDepth, Height, MaximumWeight, Barcode from tblBuildingUnitBays) AS buBays
			inner join tblBuildingUnitColumns AS buCols on
			buCols.BuildingUnitColumnPK = buBays.BuildingUnitColumnFK
			inner join tblBuildingUnitRows AS buRows on
			buRows.BuildingUnitRowPK = buCols.BuildingUnitRowFK
			inner join tblscrapLocations AS sLoc on sLoc.LocationFK = buBays.buildingunitbaypk
	
			left outer join (
				Select buBays.BuildingUnitColumnFK, sum(isnull(ActualUnits, 0)) ColumnWeight
				from (Select * from tblPallets where IsArchived = 0 /*bit value*/) AS pallets
				inner join tblPalletContent AS pc on
				pc.PalletFK = pallets.PalletPK
				inner join tblStockItems AS sis on
				sis.StockItemPK = pc.StockItemFK
				inner join tblBuildingUnitBays AS buBays on
				buBays.BuildingUnitBayPK = pallets.LocationFK
				where pallets.BuildingUnitFK = @buildingUnitPK2 AND sis.UnitTypeFK = 2 /*Kilograms*/
				AND buBays.BayLevel <> 'A' /*Dont add ground sitting pallets to the weight!*/
				group by buBays.BuildingUnitColumnFK
			) columnWeight on
			buCols.BuildingUnitColumnPK = columnWeight.BuildingUnitColumnFK

			left outer join (
				Select buBays.BuildingUnitBayPK, sum(isnull(ActualUnits, 0)) BayWeight
				from (Select * from tblPallets where IsArchived = 0 /*bit value*/)  AS pallets
				inner join tblPalletContent AS pc on
				pc.PalletFK = pallets.PalletPK
				inner join tblStockItems AS sis on
				sis.StockItemPK = pc.StockItemFK
				inner join tblBuildingUnitBays AS buBays on
				buBays.BuildingUnitBayPK = pallets.LocationFK
				where pallets.BuildingUnitFK = @buildingUnitPK2 AND sis.UnitTypeFK = 2 /*Kilograms*/
				AND buBays.BayLevel <> 'A'
				group by buBays.BuildingUnitBayPK
			) bayWeight on
			buBays.BuildingUnitBayPK = bayWeight.BuildingUnitBayPK

			/*left outer join tblStockItemBuildingUnitBays sibubs on
			sibubs.BuildingUnitBayFK = buBays.BuildingUnitBayPK
			AND sibubs.StockItemFK = @stockItemPK2*/

			/*left outer join tblDivisionBuildingUnitBays dbubs on
			dbubs.BuildingUnitBayFK = buBays.BuildingUnitBayPK
			AND dbubs.DivisionFK = @divisionFK	*/

			left outer join (
				Select BuildingUnitBayPK, sum(PalletContent) StockItemContentFound  from (
					Select BuildingUnitBayPK, case when pc.PalletContentPK IS NULL then 0 else 1 End as PalletContent
						from tblBuildingUnitBays AS buBays
						left outer join tblPallets AS pallets on
						pallets.LocationFK = buBays.BuildingUnitBayPK
						AND pallets.LocationTypeFK = 1/*Racking*/
						AND pallets.IsArchived = 0 /*bit value*/
						left outer join tblPalletContent AS pc on
						pc.PalletFK = pallets.PalletPK
						AND pc.StockItemFK = @stockItemPK2 AND pc.Batch = @batch2
				) subQ Group By BuildingUnitBayPK
			) HasSameStockItem on
			HasSameStockItem.BuildingUnitBayPK = buBays.BuildingUnitBayPK

			left outer join (
				Select BuildingUnitBayPK, sum(StackedContent) StackedContentFound  from (
					Select BuildingUnitBayPK, case when sis.StockItemPK IS NULL then 0 else 1 End as StackedContent
						from tblBuildingUnitBays AS buBays
						left outer join tblPallets AS pallets on
						pallets.LocationFK = buBays.BuildingUnitBayPK
						AND pallets.LocationTypeFK = 1/*Racking*/
						AND pallets.IsArchived = 0 /*bit value*/
						left outer join tblPalletContent AS pc on
						pc.PalletFK = pallets.PalletPK
						left outer join tblStockItems AS sis on
						sis.StockItemPK = pc.StockItemFK
						AND (IsStackable = 1 /*bit value*/ OR IsDepthStackable = 1 /*bit value*/) 
				) subQ Group By BuildingUnitBayPK
			) HasStackedStock on
			HasStackedStock.BuildingUnitBayPK = buBays.BuildingUnitBayPK

			left outer join (
				Select plts.PalletPK, LocationTypeFK, LocationFK, PalletTypeFK, BayPosition + isnull(locationMovements.NumberOfMovements, 0) as BayPosition, 
				PalletStart, PalletEnd, StackPosition
				From (Select * from tblPallets where IsArchived = 0) plts
				left outer join (
					Select PalletPK, count(*) NumberOfMovements from tblPallets AS subPallets1
					inner join tblWorksOrderMovements AS subWoms1 on
					subWoms1.WorksOrderStatusFK < 3 /*Not complete or cancelled*/
					AND subWoms1.DestinationLocationTypeFK = 1/*Racking*/
					AND subWoms1.DestinationFK = subPallets1.LocationFK
					AND subWoms1.DestinationPalletEnd <= subPallets1.PalletStart
					Group By PalletPK
				)locationMovements on
				locationMovements.PalletPK = plts.PalletPK

				Union
				Select PalletFK, DestinationLocationTypeFK, DestinationFK, palletsUnion.PalletTypeFK, DestinationBayPosition, DestinationPalletStart, DestinationPalletEnd, 0 as StackPosition
				From tblWorksOrderMovements AS woms
					inner join tblPallets AS palletsUnion on
					palletsUnion.PalletPK = woms.PalletFK
					AND palletsUnion.IsArchived = 0
					Where woms.WorksOrderStatusFK < 3 /*Not complete or cancelled*/
				Union
				Select -1, 1 /*LocationType*/, BuildingUnitBayFK, -1, isnull(max(BayPosition), 0), /*The obstructions have to be mirrored !!*/
				case when buRows.LocateFromLeft = 1 /*bit value*/ then ObstructionStart else buBays.Width - ObstructionEnd End as ObstructionStart, 
				case when buRows.LocateFromLeft = 1 /*bit value*/ then ObstructionEnd else buBays.Width - ObstructionStart end as ObstructionEnd, 0 /*Stack Position*/
				from tblBuildingUnitBayObstructions AS bubos
				inner join tblBuildingUnitBays AS buBays on
				buBays.BuildingUnitBayPK = bubos.BuildingUnitBayFK
				inner join tblBuildingUnitColumns AS buCols on
				buCols.BuildingUnitColumnPK = buBays.BuildingUnitColumnFK
				inner join tblBuildingUnitRows AS buRows on
				buRows.BuildingUnitRowPK = buCols.BuildingUnitRowFK
				left outer join 
					(
						Select LocationFK, BayPosition, PalletStart, PalletEnd
						From (Select * from tblPallets where IsArchived = 0) pallets 
						Union
						Select DestinationFK, DestinationBayPosition, DestinationPalletStart, DestinationPalletEnd
						From tblWorksOrderMovements AS woms
							inner join tblPallets AS palletsUnion on
							palletsUnion.PalletPK = woms.PalletFK
							AND palletsUnion.IsArchived = 0
							Where woms.WorksOrderStatusFK < 3 /*Not complete or cancelled*/ 
					) bayPosition on
					bayPosition.LocationFK = bubos.BuildingUnitBayFK
					AND bayPosition.PalletEnd <= case when buRows.LocateFromLeft = 1 /*bit value*/ then ObstructionStart else buBays.Width - ObstructionEnd End
					Group By BuildingUnitBayFK, LocateFromLeft, buBays.Width, ObstructionStart, ObstructionEnd
			) pallets on
			pallets.LocationTypeFK = 1
			AND pallets.StackPosition <= 0
			AND pallets.LocationFK = buBays.BuildingUnitBayPK

			left outer join (
				Select PalletPK, LocationTypeFK, LocationFK, PalletTypeFK, BayPosition, PalletStart, PalletEnd, StackPosition
				From (Select * from tblPallets where IsArchived = 0) pallets 
				Union
				Select PalletFK, DestinationLocationTypeFK, DestinationFK, palletsUnion.PalletTypeFK, DestinationBayPosition, DestinationPalletStart, DestinationPalletEnd, 0 as StackPosition
				From tblWorksOrderMovements AS woms
					inner join tblPallets AS palletsUnion on
					palletsUnion.PalletPK = woms.PalletFK
					AND palletsUnion.IsArchived = 0
					Where woms.WorksOrderStatusFK < 3 /*Not complete or cancelled*/
				Union
				Select -1, 1 /*LocationType*/, BuildingUnitBayFK, -1, isnull(max(BayPosition), 0), 
				case when buRows.LocateFromLeft = 1 /*bit value*/ then ObstructionStart else buBays.Width - ObstructionEnd End as ObstructionStart, 
				case when buRows.LocateFromLeft = 1 /*bit value*/ then ObstructionEnd else buBays.Width - ObstructionStart end as ObstructionEnd, 0 /*Stack Position*/
				from tblBuildingUnitBayObstructions AS bubos
				inner join (
					/*Had to augment Width to allow for Stacking*/
					Select BuildingUnitBayPK, BuildingUnitColumnFK, BayLevel, 
					Width + (cast(@isDepthStackable as int) * (Width * floor(MaximumDepth/@depth) * floor(Height/@height))) as Width, 
					MaximumDepth, MinimumDepth, Height, MaximumWeight  from tblBuildingUnitBays
				) AS buBays on
				buBays.BuildingUnitBayPK = bubos.BuildingUnitBayFK
				inner join tblBuildingUnitColumns AS buCols on
				buCols.BuildingUnitColumnPK = buBays.BuildingUnitColumnFK
				inner join tblBuildingUnitRows AS buRows on
				buRows.BuildingUnitRowPK = buCols.BuildingUnitRowFK
				left outer join 
					(
						Select LocationFK, BayPosition, PalletStart, PalletEnd
						From (Select * from tblPallets where IsArchived = 0) pallets  
						Union
						Select DestinationFK, DestinationBayPosition, DestinationPalletStart, DestinationPalletEnd
						From tblWorksOrderMovements AS woms
							inner join tblPallets AS palletsUnion on
							palletsUnion.PalletPK = woms.PalletFK
							AND palletsUnion.IsArchived = 0
							Where woms.WorksOrderStatusFK < 3 /*Not complete or cancelled*/ 
					) bayPosition on
					bayPosition.LocationFK = bubos.BuildingUnitBayFK
					AND bayPosition.PalletEnd <= case when buRows.LocateFromLeft = 1 /*bit value*/ then ObstructionStart else buBays.Width - ObstructionEnd End
					Group By BuildingUnitBayFK, LocateFromLeft, buBays.Width, ObstructionStart, ObstructionEnd
			) AS gapRight on
			gapRight.LocationTypeFK = 1
			AND gapRight.StackPosition <= 0
			AND gapRight.LocationFK = pallets.LocationFK
			AND gapRight.PalletStart = (Select Top 1 PalletStart From (Select PalletStart, LocationFK From tblPallets union Select DestinationPalletStart, DestinationFK 
			from tblWorksOrderMovements where WorksOrderStatusFK < 3 union Select ObstructionStart, BuildingUnitBayFK from tblBuildingUnitBayObstructions)subQNoName 
			where LocationFK = pallets.LocationFK AND PalletStart >= pallets.PalletEnd order by PalletStart ASC)
			AND gapRight.PalletStart <> pallets.PalletEnd

			left outer join (Select count(*) BayPosition, LocationTypeFK, LocationFK, case when StackPosition <= 0 then 0 else StackPosition end as StackPosition, 
			case when Max(ObstructionEnd) > Max(PalletEnd) then Max(isnull(ObstructionEnd, 0)) else Max(PalletEnd) end as PalletEnd
			from (
				Select PalletPK, LocationTypeFK, LocationFK, PalletTypeFK, BayPosition, PalletStart, PalletEnd, StackPosition
				From (Select * from tblPallets  where IsArchived = 0) pallets  
				Union
				Select PalletFK, DestinationLocationTypeFK, DestinationFK, palletsUnion.PalletTypeFK, DestinationBayPosition, DestinationPalletStart, DestinationPalletEnd, 0 as StackPosition
				From tblWorksOrderMovements AS woms
					inner join tblPallets AS palletsUnion  on
					palletsUnion.PalletPK = woms.PalletFK
					AND palletsUnion.IsArchived = 0
					Where woms.WorksOrderStatusFK < 3 /*Not complete or cancelled*/
				) AS subQLastPallets
				left outer join (--this join gets obstructions after the last pallet, this change has come about as a cell with movements was not calculating the last bay position correctly, it needed a count instead of max- because of this, obstructions need to be done differently
					Select BuildingUnitBayFK, 
					Max(case when buRows.LocateFromLeft = 1 /*bit value*/ then ObstructionStart else buBays.Width - ObstructionEnd end) as ObstructionStart, 
					Max(case when buRows.LocateFromLeft = 1 /*bit value*/ then ObstructionEnd else buBays.Width - ObstructionStart end) as ObstructionEnd
					from tblBuildingUnitBayObstructions AS bubos
					inner join tblBuildingUnitBays AS buBays on
					buBays.BuildingUnitBayPK = bubos.BuildingUnitBayFK
					inner join tblBuildingUnitColumns AS buCols on
					buCols.BuildingUnitColumnPK = buBays.BuildingUnitColumnFK
					inner join tblBuildingUnitRows AS buRows on
					buRows.BuildingUnitRowPK = buCols.BuildingUnitRowFK
					Group By BuildingUnitBayFK
				) AS lastObstruction on
				lastObstruction.BuildingUnitBayFK = subQLastPallets.LocationFK
				AND subQLastPallets.PalletEnd <= lastObstruction.ObstructionStart
				AND subQLastPallets.PalletEnd + @width > lastObstruction.ObstructionStart
				Group By LocationTypeFK, LocationFK, case when StackPosition <= 0 then 0 else StackPosition end) lastPallet on
			lastPallet.LocationTypeFK = 1
			AND lastPallet.StackPosition <= 0
			AND lastPallet.LocationFK = pallets.LocationFK
			AND lastPallet.PalletEnd <> buBays.Width

			left outer join (Select Min(BayPosition) BayPosition, LocationTypeFK, LocationFK, StackPosition, Min(PalletStart) as PalletStart 
				from (
				Select PalletPK, LocationTypeFK, LocationFK, PalletTypeFK, BayPosition, PalletStart, PalletEnd, StackPosition
				From (Select * from tblPallets  where IsArchived = 0) pallets  
				Union
				Select PalletFK, DestinationLocationTypeFK, DestinationFK, palletsUnion.PalletTypeFK, DestinationBayPosition, DestinationPalletStart, DestinationPalletEnd, 0 as StackPosition
				From tblWorksOrderMovements AS woms
					inner join tblPallets AS palletsUnion  on
					palletsUnion.PalletPK = woms.PalletFK
					AND palletsUnion.IsArchived = 0
					Where woms.WorksOrderStatusFK < 3 /*Not complete or cancelled*/
				Union
				Select -1, 1 /*LocationType*/, BuildingUnitBayFK, -1, isnull(max(BayPosition), 0), 
				case when buRows.LocateFromLeft = 1 /*bit value*/ then ObstructionStart else buBays.Width - ObstructionEnd End as ObstructionStart, 
				case when buRows.LocateFromLeft = 1 /*bit value*/ then ObstructionEnd else buBays.Width - ObstructionStart end as ObstructionEnd, 0 /*Stack Position*/
				from tblBuildingUnitBayObstructions AS bubos
				inner join tblBuildingUnitBays AS buBays on
				buBays.BuildingUnitBayPK = bubos.BuildingUnitBayFK
				inner join tblBuildingUnitColumns AS buCols on
				buCols.BuildingUnitColumnPK = buBays.BuildingUnitColumnFK
				inner join tblBuildingUnitRows AS buRows on
				buRows.BuildingUnitRowPK = buCols.BuildingUnitRowFK
				left outer join 
					(
						Select LocationFK, BayPosition, PalletStart, PalletEnd
						From (Select * from tblPallets  where IsArchived = 0) pallets 
						Union
						Select DestinationFK, DestinationBayPosition, DestinationPalletStart, DestinationPalletEnd
						From tblWorksOrderMovements AS woms
							inner join tblPallets AS palletsUnion  on
							palletsUnion.PalletPK = woms.PalletFK
							AND palletsUnion.IsArchived = 0
							Where woms.WorksOrderStatusFK < 3 /*Not complete or cancelled*/ 
					) bayPosition on
					bayPosition.LocationFK = bubos.BuildingUnitBayFK
					AND bayPosition.PalletEnd <= case when buRows.LocateFromLeft = 1 /*bit value*/ then ObstructionStart else buBays.Width - ObstructionEnd End
					Group By BuildingUnitBayFK, LocateFromLeft, buBays.Width, ObstructionStart, ObstructionEnd
			) subQfirstPallet 
				Group By LocationTypeFK, LocationFK, StackPosition) firstPallet on
			firstPallet.LocationTypeFK = 1
			AND firstPallet.StackPosition <= 0
			AND firstPallet.PalletStart <> 0
			AND firstPallet.LocationFK = pallets.LocationFK

			Where buRows.BuildingUnitFK = @buildingUnitPK2
			/*AND buRows.RackingTypeFK = @autoRackingTypeFK*/
			AND ASCII(buBays.BayLevel) - 64 < /*Not Top Level*/
				Case when @prohibitTopLevelRacking = 1 /*bit value*/ Then buCols.Levels Else 99999 End
			AND ASCII(buBays.BayLevel) <= 
				Case when @unstable1 = 1 /*bit value*/ Then 67 /*Less than or equal to Level C*/
				Else 99999 End
			AND ASCII(buBays.BayLevel) <= 
				Case when @unstable2 = 1 /*bit value*/ Then 66 /*Less than or equal to Level B*/
				Else 99999 End
			AND ASCII(buBays.BayLevel) <= 
				Case when @unstable3 = 1 /*bit value*/ Then 65 /*Level A Only*/
				Else 99999 End
			AND ASCII(buBays.BayLevel) >= 
				Case when @levelC_Above = 1 /*bit value*/ Then 67 /*Greater than or equal to Level C*/
				Else 0 End
			AND ASCII(buBays.BayLevel) > 
				Case when @allowFloorStorage = 0 /*bit value*/ Then 65 /*Not on the floor/ Greater than A*/
				Else 0 End
			) subQ

			Where /*Check for this divisions assigned bays*/
					/*(	
						BuildingUnitBayPK in 
						(Select sibuBays.BuildingUnitBayFK from tblStockItemBuildingUnitBays sibuBays
						Where StockItemFK = @stockItemPK2 AND sibuBays.BuildingUnitFK = @buildingUnitPK2)
						OR
						(BuildingUnitBayPK in 
						(Select dbuBays.BuildingUnitBayFK from tblDivisionBuildingUnitBays dbuBays
						Where DivisionFK = @divisionFK AND dbuBays.BuildingUnitFK = @buildingUnitPK2) AND @stockItemBuildingUnitBays = 0)
						OR 
						((0 = (Select count(*) from tblDivisionBuildingUnitBays
						Where DivisionFK = @divisionFK AND BuildingUnitFK = @buildingUnitPK2)) AND @stockItemBuildingUnitBays = 0)
					)*/
				  /*Check this bay is not assigned to any other division*/
				/*AND BuildingUnitBayPK not in 
					(Select dbuBays.BuildingUnitBayFK from tblDivisionBuildingUnitBays dbuBays
						Where DivisionFK <> @divisionFK AND dbuBays.BuildingUnitFK = @buildingUnitPK2 AND dbuBays.IsExclusive = 1 /*bit value*/)*/
				/*Check this bay is not assigned to any other stock item*/
				/*AND BuildingUnitBayPK not in 
					(Select sibuBays.BuildingUnitBayFK from tblStockItemBuildingUnitBays sibuBays
						Where StockItemFK <> @stockItemPK2 AND sibuBays.BuildingUnitFK = @buildingUnitPK2 AND sibuBays.IsExclusive = 1 /*bit value*/)*/
				/*Check if we are assigning and alternate location and that we havent tried this location already*/
				/*AND*/ (@worksOrderMovementFK2 = -1 OR (BuildingUnitBayPK not in (Select BuildingUnitBayFK from tblWorksOrderMovementFailures 
				Where WorksOrderMovementFK = @worksOrderMovementFK2)))
				/*Gap Checks*/
				AND (GapBetweenPallets >=@width
				OR GapToEndOfBay >= @width
				OR GapToStartOfBay >= @width
				OR GapWholeBay >= @width)
			AND (MaximumDepth >= @depth /*Maximum Depth*/
			AND ((@isStackable = 0 /*bit value*/ AND @isDepthStackable = 0 /*bit value*/ AND MinimumDepth <= @depth) 
			OR ((@isStackable = 1 /*bit value*/ OR @isDepthStackable = 1 /*bit value*/) AND MinimumDepth = 0) )) /*Minimum Depth*/
			AND Height >= @height
			AND (BayWeight < MaximumBayWeight OR MaximumBayWeight = 0)
			AND (ColumnWeight < MaximumColumnWeight OR MaximumColumnWeight = 0)
			AND ((@isStackable = 0 /*bit value*/ and @isDepthStackable = 0 /*bit value*/ AND StackedContentFound = 0)
				OR
				(@isStackable = 1 /*bit value*/ OR @isDepthStackable = 1 /*bit value*/)
			)
			) mySUBQ
			ORDER BY
				--order by preferred location type 1st
				CASE WHEN @PreferredRackingType2 = 1 THEN rackingtypefk END ASC,
				CASE WHEN @PreferredRackingType2 = 2 THEN rackingtypefk END DESC,
				--CHECK EXCLUSIVE STOCK LOCATIONS
				--CASE WHEN StockItemBuildingUnitBayPK is null then 0 else case when IsStockItemLocationExclusive = 0 /*bit value*/ then 2 else 3 end end DESC,
				--CHECK STACKING
				CASE WHEN @isStackable = 1 OR @isDepthStackable = 1 THEN StockItemContentFound END DESC,
				--CLAUSE 1
				CASE WHEN @orderBy1 = 'Row Priority1' THEN Row END ASC,
				CASE WHEN @orderBy1 = 'Row Priority2' THEN Row END DESC,
				CASE WHEN @orderBy1 = 'Column Priority1' THEN BuildingUnitColumn END ASC,
				CASE WHEN @orderBy1 = 'Column Priority2' THEN BuildingUnitColumn END DESC,
				CASE WHEN @orderBy1 = 'Level Priority1' THEN BayLevel END DESC,
				CASE WHEN @orderBy1 = 'Level Priority2' THEN BayLevel END ASC,
				CASE WHEN @orderBy1 = 'Efficient Use Of Height-1' THEN LocationOrder END ASC,
				--CLAUSE 2
				CASE WHEN @orderBy2 = 'Row Priority1' THEN Row END ASC,
				CASE WHEN @orderBy2 = 'Row Priority2' THEN Row END DESC,
				CASE WHEN @orderBy2 = 'Column Priority1' THEN BuildingUnitColumn END ASC,
				CASE WHEN @orderBy2 = 'Column Priority2' THEN BuildingUnitColumn END DESC,
				CASE WHEN @orderBy2 = 'Level Priority1' THEN BayLevel END DESC,
				CASE WHEN @orderBy2 = 'Level Priority2' THEN BayLevel END ASC,
				CASE WHEN @orderBy2 = 'Efficient Use Of Height-1' THEN LocationOrder END ASC,
				--CHECK IF DRIVE THRU
				CASE WHEN RackingTypeFK = 2 /*DRIVETHRU*/ THEN BayLevel END DESC,
				--CLAUSE 3
				CASE WHEN @orderBy3 = 'Row Priority1' THEN Row END ASC,
				CASE WHEN @orderBy3 = 'Row Priority2' THEN Row END DESC,
				CASE WHEN @orderBy3 = 'Column Priority1' THEN BuildingUnitColumn END ASC,
				CASE WHEN @orderBy3 = 'Column Priority2' THEN BuildingUnitColumn END DESC,
				CASE WHEN @orderBy3 = 'Level Priority1' THEN BayLevel END DESC,
				CASE WHEN @orderBy3 = 'Level Priority2' THEN BayLevel END ASC,
				CASE WHEN @orderBy3 = 'Efficient Use Of Height-1' THEN LocationOrder END ASC,
				--CLAUSE 4
				CASE WHEN @orderBy4 = 'Row Priority1' THEN Row END ASC,
				CASE WHEN @orderBy4 = 'Row Priority2' THEN Row END DESC,
				CASE WHEN @orderBy4 = 'Column Priority1' THEN BuildingUnitColumn END ASC,
				CASE WHEN @orderBy4 = 'Column Priority2' THEN BuildingUnitColumn END DESC,
				CASE WHEN @orderBy4 = 'Level Priority1' THEN BayLevel END DESC,
				CASE WHEN @orderBy4 = 'Level Priority2' THEN BayLevel END ASC,
				CASE WHEN @orderBy4 = 'Efficient Use Of Height-1' THEN LocationOrder END ASC,
				PalletStart ASC --This makes sure we look at gaps from left to right
		
				--LocationOrder ASC, BuildingUnitColumn DESC, Row DESC, BayLevel ASC

			Declare @buildingUnitBayPK int, @maximumBayWeight decimal(18,3), @bayWeight decimal(18,3),
			@rackingTypeFK int, @buildingUnitRow nvarchar(10), @buildingUnitRowNumber int, 
			@translateRow bit, @translatedRow nvarchar(50), @reverseTranslate bit, @translateColumn int,
			@buildingUnitColumn int, @buildingUnitColumnName nvarchar(50), @maximumColumnWeight decimal(18,3), @columnWeight decimal(18,3), @buildingUnitBayLevel nvarchar(10), 
			@gapBetweenPallets int, @gapBetweenPalletsBayPosition int, @gapBetweenPalletsPalletStart int, 
			@gapToEndOfBay int, @endBayPosition int, @endBayPalletStart int, 
			@gapToStartOfBay int, @startBayPosition int, @startBayPalletStart int, 
			@gapWholeBay int, @wholeBayPosition int, @wholeBayPalletStart int, 
			@locationOrder int, @palletStartCur int, @stockItemContentFound int, @stackedContentFound int/*,
			@stockItemBuildingUnitBayPK int, @isStockItemLocationExclusive bit*/

			Declare @previousBuildingUnitColumn int -- for keeping batches together
			Declare @previousBuildingUnitColumnForWeight int
			Declare @previousBuildingUnitBayPK int
			Declare @runningColumnWeight decimal(18,3), @runningBayWeight decimal(18,3)

			OPEN BayCursor
		
			FETCH NEXT FROM BayCursor INTO 
			@buildingUnitBayPK, @maximumBayWeight, @bayWeight,
			@rackingTypeFK, @buildingUnitRow, @buildingUnitRowNumber, 
			@translateRow, @translatedRow, @reverseTranslate, @translateColumn,
			@buildingUnitColumn, @buildingUnitColumnName, @maximumColumnWeight, @columnWeight, @buildingUnitBayLevel, 
			@gapBetweenPallets, @gapBetweenPalletsBayPosition, @gapBetweenPalletsPalletStart, 
			@gapToEndOfBay, @endBayPosition, @endBayPalletStart, 
			@gapToStartOfBay, @startBayPosition, @startBayPalletStart, 
			@gapWholeBay, @wholeBayPosition, @wholeBayPalletStart, 
			@locationOrder, @palletStartCur, @stockItemContentFound, @stackedContentFound/*,
			@stockItemBuildingUnitBayPK, @isStockItemLocationExclusive*/

			Declare @availableSpace bit
			Declare @availableGap int
			Declare @bayPosition int
			Declare @palletStart int
			Declare @gapType as nvarchar(50)/* whole, between, start, end*/
			Declare @firstRun int

			Set @firstRun = 1
			Set @availableSpace = 1 /*bit value*/
			--Print @@FETCH_STATUS
			Set @originalNumberOfLocations = @numberOfLocations2
			Set @previousBuildingUnitColumn = -1
			Set @previousBuildingUnitColumnForWeight = -1
			Set @previousBuildingUnitBayPK = -1
	
			Set @currentRow = -1

			DECLARE @myLocationBayPositions TABLE
			(
				LocationFK INT,
				BayPosition INT,
				PalletStart INT
			)

			DECLARE @myLocations TABLE 
			( 
				RowNumber INT, 
				RowLetter nvarchar(50),
				ColumnNumber INT,
				Sql text 
			)

			print 'building Unit Bay PK' 
			print cast(@buildingUnitBayPK as nvarchar(50))
			print 'num locations ' + cast(@numberOfLocations2 as nvarchar(50))
			Print 'fetch status ' + cast(@@FETCH_STATUS as nvarchar(50))

			WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 AND @numberOfLocations2 > 0
			BEGIN
				Print 'Began Loop'
				Print 'LocationHeight ' + cast(@locationOrder as nvarchar(50))

				if (@currentRow = -1) 
					Set @currentRow = @buildingUnitRowNumber

				--if the row has moved on and we still have pallets to locate, we must reset as we dont want a run of stock/batch in different rows
				if (@keepBatchTogetherLevel3 = 1 /*bit value*/ AND @buildingUnitRowNumber > @currentRow)
					Select @sql = '', @numberOfLocations2 = @originalNumberOfLocations, @currentRow = @buildingUnitRowNumber, @firstRun = 1				

		--		Took this section out.. locations may skip rows to adhere to rules!
		--		if (@currentRow > @buildingUnitRowNumber) 
		--		BEGIN
		--			Print 'Row Business 1'
		--			goto Skip --if we are looking for a different row, skip
		--		END
		--		ELSE
		--		BEGIN --we have moved on to the row we were looking for or the row has moved past the row we were looking for (either no gaps or row is not assigned to division), so set the row
		--			Print 'Row Business 2'
		--			Set @currentRow = @buildingUnitRowNumber
		--		END
			
				Print isnull(@gapWholeBay, -1)
				Print isnull(@gapBetweenPalletsPalletStart, -1)
				Print isnull(@gapBetweenPallets, -1)
				Print isnull(@gapToStartOfBay, -1)
				Print isnull(@endBayPalletStart, -1)
				Print isnull(@gapToEndOfBay, -1)

				Set @availableSpace = 1 /*bit value*/ 
		
				IF (@gapWholeBay > 0) 
				BEGIN
					Print 'Whole Bay'

					Set @bayPosition = 1
					Set @palletStart = 0
					Set @availableGap = @gapWholeBay
					Set @gapType = 'whole'
				END	
				ELSE IF (@gapToStartOfBay >= @width) 
				BEGIN
					Print 'Start of bay'

					--If stacking only allow the same stock and batch in the cell. Nothing else will get into this cell
					IF((@isStackable = 1 /*bit value*/ OR @isDepthStackable = 1 /*bit value*/) AND @stockItemContentFound = 0) 
						SET @availableSpace = 0 /*bit value*/

					Set @bayPosition = @startBayPosition
					Set @palletStart = 0
					Set @availableGap = @gapToStartOfBay
					Set @gapType = 'start'
					Set @endBayPosition = @endBayPosition + 1
					Set @gapBetweenPalletsBayPosition = @gapBetweenPalletsBayPosition + 1

					Print 'Incremented between and end bay positions'
					Print @endBayPosition
				END 
				ELSE IF @gapBetweenPallets >= @width 
				BEGIN
					Print 'Between'

					--If stacking only allow the same stock and batch in the cell. Nothing else will get into this cell
					IF((@isStackable = 1 /*bit value*/ OR @isDepthStackable = 1 /*bit value*/) AND @stockItemContentFound = 0)
						SET @availableSpace = 0 /*bit value*/

					Set @bayPosition = @gapBetweenPalletsBayPosition
					Set @palletStart = @gapBetweenPalletsPalletStart
					Set @availableGap = @gapBetweenPallets
					Set @gapType = 'between'

					Print 'Bay Position ' + cast(@bayPosition as nvarchar(50))
					Print 'PalletStart ' + cast(@gapBetweenPalletsPalletStart as nvarchar(50))
					Print 'Gap width ' + cast(@gapBetweenPallets as nvarchar(50))
				END	
				ELSE IF (@gapToEndOfBay >= @width) 
				BEGIN
					Print 'End of Bay'

					--If stacking only allow the same stock and batch in the cell. Nothing else will get into this cell
					IF((@isStackable = 1 /*bit value*/ OR @isDepthStackable = 1 /*bit value*/) AND @stockItemContentFound = 0) 
						SET @availableSpace = 0 /*bit value*/ 

					Set @bayPosition = @endBayPosition
					Set @palletStart = @endBayPalletStart
					Set @availableGap = @gapToEndOfBay
					Set @gapType = 'end'
				END
				
				WHILE @availableSpace = 1 /*bit value*/ AND @numberOfLocations2 > 0
				BEGIN
					Print 'Began 2nd Loop'

		--			Print @buildingUnitRow
					--******* WEIGHT CODE ************
					IF(@restrictStockWeight = 1 /*bit value*/ AND @maximumColumnWeight > 0 AND @buildingUnitBayLevel <> 'A')
					BEGIN
						Print 'weight1'

						IF(@previousBuildingUnitColumnForWeight <> @buildingUnitColumn)	
							Set @runningColumnWeight = @units2
						ELSE 
							Set @runningColumnWeight = @runningColumnWeight + @units2

						Set @previousBuildingUnitColumnForWeight = @buildingUnitColumn

						if(@previousBuildingUnitBayPK <> @buildingUnitBayPK)
							Set @runningBayWeight = @units2
						ELSE
							Set @runningBayWeight = @runningBayWeight + @units2

						Set @previousBuildingUnitBayPK = @buildingUnitBayPK

						--If the current located weight + what we have added already + what we want to add is greater than the limit, skip the location
						IF((@columnWeight + @runningColumnWeight) > @maximumColumnWeight
							OR
							(@bayWeight + @runningBayWeight) > @maximumBayWeight)
						BEGIN
							print 'weight too much!'
							goto Skip --we have gone over the weight limit for this column or bay, skip it
						END
					END
					--****** END OF WEIGHT CODE ************
		--			Print 'Column Weight ' + cast(@columnWeight as nvarchar(50))
		--			Print 'Running Column Weight ' + cast(@runningColumnWeight as nvarchar(50))
						
					--Check for duplicates
					IF(EXISTS(Select * from @myLocationBayPositions where LocationFK = @buildingUnitBayPK AND PalletStart = @palletStart)) 
					BEGIN
						Set @availableSpace = 0 /*bit value*/
						goto skipLocation --this location has come into a duplicate pallet location so just skip out of the location
					END 
					ELSE 
					BEGIN
						if @firstRun = 0 
							Set @sql = @sql + ' UNION ALL '	
						ELSE 
							Set @startColumn = @buildingUnitColumn

						IF(EXISTS(Select * from @myLocationBayPositions where LocationFK = @buildingUnitBayPK AND BayPosition = @bayPosition)) 
						BEGIN
							IF((Select PalletStart from @myLocationBayPositions where LocationFK = @buildingUnitBayPK AND BayPosition = @bayPosition) < @palletStart) 
								Set @bayPosition = @bayPosition + 1
						END

						--New Code to deal with already positioned pallets between this placing pallets
		--				IF(EXISTS(Select * from @myLocationBayPositions where LocationFK = @buildingUnitBayPK AND BayPosition < @bayPosition)) BEGIN
		--					IF((Select Top 1 PalletStart from @myLocationBayPositions where LocationFK = @buildingUnitBayPK AND BayPosition < @bayPosition Order By PalletStart DESC) <> (@palletStart + @width)) BEGIN
		--						Set @bayPosition = @bayPosition + (Select count(*) from @myLocationBayPositions where LocationFK = @buildingUnitBayPK AND BayPosition < @bayPosition)
		--					END 
		--				END				

						--Select @tmpBayPositionAdjust = count(*) from @myLocationBayPositions where DestinationFK=@buildingUnitBayPK AND DestinationBayPosition < @bayPosition)
						Set @thisLineSql = ' Select ''' + @buildingUnit + ''' BuildingUnit,''' 
							+ case when @translateRow = 1 /*bit value*/ then @translatedRow else @buildingUnitRow end + ''' Row,''' 
								+ case when @translateRow = 1 /*bit value*/ then case when @reverseTranslate = 1 /*bit value*/ 
									then cast(@translateColumn - @buildingUnitColumn as nvarchar(10)) else cast(@buildingUnitColumn + @translateColumn as nvarchar(10)) 
										end else cast(@buildingUnitColumn as nvarchar(10)) end + ''' BuildingUnitColumn,''' 
											+ case when @translateRow = 1 /*bit value*/ then case when @reverseTranslate = 1 /*bit value*/ 
												then cast(@translateColumn - @buildingUnitColumn as nvarchar(10)) else cast(@buildingUnitColumn + @translateColumn as nvarchar(10)) 
													end else cast(@buildingUnitColumn as nvarchar(10)) end + ''' BuildingUnitColumnName,''' + @buildingUnitBayLevel + ''' BayLevel,' 
														+ cast(@bayPosition as nvarchar(50))	+ ' BayPosition,' + cast(@palletStart as nvarchar(50)) + ' PalletStart,' 
															+ cast((@palletStart + @width) as nvarchar(50)) + ' PalletEnd,' + cast(@buildingUnitBayPK as nvarchar(100)) + ' LocationFK'	

						Insert into @myLocationBayPositions values (@buildingUnitBayPK, @bayPosition, @palletStart)
					END

					--Print 'Boom'
					Set @sql = @sql	+ @thisLineSql
					Print @thisLineSql
			
					Set @availableGap = @availableGap - @width

					if (@availableGap < @width) 
					BEGIN
						IF (@gapType = 'whole')
							Set @availableSpace = 0 /*bit value*/
						ELSE IF (@gapType = 'start') 
						BEGIN
							IF @gapBetweenPallets >= @width 
							BEGIN
								Print 'Between'
								Set @bayPosition = @gapBetweenPalletsBayPosition
								Set @palletStart = @gapBetweenPalletsPalletStart
								Set @availableGap = @gapBetweenPallets
								Set @gapType = 'between'
							END 
							ELSE IF (@gapToEndOfBay >= @width) 
							BEGIN
								Print 'Gap to end 2'
								Set @bayPosition = @endBayPosition
								Set @palletStart = @endBayPalletStart
								Set @availableGap = @gapToEndOfBay
								Set @gapType = 'end'
							END 
							ELSE 
							BEGIN
								Print 'end 1'
								Set @availableSpace = 0 /*bit value*/	
							END
						END	ELSE IF (@gapType = 'between') 
						BEGIN
							IF (@gapToEndOfBay >= @width) 
							BEGIN
								Print 'Gap to end 3'
								Set @bayPosition = @endBayPosition
								Set @palletStart = @endBayPalletStart
								Set @availableGap = @gapToEndOfBay
								Set @gapType = 'end'
								Print @bayPosition
							END	
							ELSE 
							BEGIN
								Print 'end 2'
								Set @availableSpace = 0 /*bit value*/	
							END
						END	
						ELSE IF (@gapType = 'end') 
						BEGIN
							Print 'end 3'
							Set @availableSpace = 0 /*bit value*/	
						END				
					END
					ELSE
					BEGIN
						Print 'Increment Bayposition'
						Set @bayPosition = @bayPosition + 1
						Set @endBayPosition = @endBayPosition + 1
						Set @palletStart = @palletStart + @width
						Print @bayPosition
					END
			
					Set @numberOfLocations2 = @numberOfLocations2 - 1

			skipLocation:

					Set @firstRun = 0

					/*KEEP BATCH TOGETHER**************/
					if(@overrideBuildingUnitRules = 1 /*bit value*/)
					BEGIN
						Print 'Overriding BuildingUnitRules'

						/*Keep batch in one or more adjoining columns*/
						if(@keepBatchTogetherLevel2 = 1 /*bit value*/)
						BEGIN
							Print 'Batch1'

							if(@previousBuildingUnitColumn = -1)
								Set @previousBuildingUnitColumn = @buildingUnitColumn
							ELSE
							BEGIN 
								/* This next 'if' statement is complex */
								/* Explanation*/
								/* If we have skipped a column since the last location 
									AND we have also moved more than one column from
									the columns used for a previous batch location
									AND we havent moved just one column since we were last here then
									we need to start again*/
								if(
									((ABS(@previousBuildingUnitColumn - @buildingUnitColumn) > 1 
									AND @previousFirstBuildingUnitColumn2 = -1)
							
									OR 
										(
										(@previousFirstBuildingUnitColumn2 > 0) AND
										((@buildingUnitColumn > (@previousFirstBuildingUnitColumn2 + 1)
										OR
										(@buildingUnitColumn < (@previousLastBuildingUnitColumn2 - 1)))
										)
									))
									AND ABS(@previousBuildingUnitColumn - @buildingUnitColumn) <> 1
								)
								BEGIN /*If selection has jumped a column, reset and start again*/
									Print 'Starting Again'

									Select @previousBuildingUnitColumn = @buildingUnitColumn,
										@numberOfLocations2 = @originalNumberOfLocations - 1,
										@firstRun = 0,
										@sql = @thisLineSql,
										@startColumn = @buildingUnitColumn
								END
							END
						END
					END
				END
	
				Print 'num locations ' + cast(@numberOfLocations2 as nvarchar(50))

				If (@numberOfLocations2 = 0)
				BEGIN
					Print 'Inserting into myLocation'

					Insert into @myLocations
					values (@buildingUnitRowNumber, @buildingUnitRow, @startColumn, @sql) 

					If (@keepBatchTogetherLevel3 = 1 /*bit value*/ AND @currentRow < @numberOfRows AND @previousLastBuildingUnitRow2 <> @buildingUnitRow) 
					BEGIN
						Print 'Oh dear'
						Set @currentRow = @currentRow + 1
						Set @numberOfLocations2 = @originalNumberOfLocations
						Set @firstRun = 1
						Set @sql = ''
					END
				END
		
			Skip:

				FETCH NEXT FROM BayCursor INTO 
				@buildingUnitBayPK, @maximumBayWeight, @bayWeight,
				@rackingTypeFK, @buildingUnitRow, @buildingUnitRowNumber,
				@translateRow, @translatedRow, @reverseTranslate, @translateColumn,
				@buildingUnitColumn, @buildingUnitColumnName, @maximumColumnWeight, @columnWeight, @buildingUnitBayLevel, 
				@gapBetweenPallets, @gapBetweenPalletsBayPosition, @gapBetweenPalletsPalletStart, 
				@gapToEndOfBay, @endBayPosition, @endBayPalletStart, 
				@gapToStartOfBay, @startBayPosition, @startBayPalletStart, 
				@gapWholeBay, @wholeBayPosition, @wholeBayPalletStart,
				@locationOrder, @palletStartCur, @stockItemContentFound, @stackedContentFound/*,
				@stockItemBuildingUnitBayPK, @isStockItemLocationExclusive*/
			END

			CLOSE BayCursor 
			DEALLOCATE BayCursor 
	
			Print 'here'

			Set @sql = ''

			IF (@previousLastBuildingUnitRow2 <> '')
			BEGIN
				Print 'here!'
				--Print @previousLastBuildingUnitRow2
				Select @sql = Sql from @myLocations where RowLetter = @previousLastBuildingUnitRow2
				print 'sql ' + cast(@sql as nvarchar(500))	
			END 
	
			IF(@sql = '') --if we had no previous row OR there was no available locations for the previous row, do regular selection
				Select Top 1 @sql = Sql from @myLocations

			--Print @sql
			--Print(len(@sql))
			Exec(@sql)

			--Select * from @myLocations
	
			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end

			
			
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END
GO

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[ZZZ_Obsolete_spReportsDailyInventoryMovements1]
(
	@FromDate datetime,
	@BuildingUnitFK int,
	@DetailedReport bit
)	
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT
 ,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;
	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	DECLARE @FromDate2 datetime
	DECLARE @BuildingUnitFK2 int
	DECLARE @DetailedReport2 bit
	

	SET @FromDate2 = @FromDate
	SET @BuildingUnitFK2 = @BuildingUnitFK
	SET @DetailedReport2 = @DetailedReport
	

	SET @ParameterDetails = '@FromDate = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@FromDate2 AS NVARCHAR(20)),'')

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    BEGIN
            SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

            INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
            SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

            SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    END


	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY
			

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start

			DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #locations
			SELECT BuildingUnitBayPK, vbub.BuildingUnitCOlumnFK, BuildingUnitBayLocation, vbub.[Row], vbub.ColumnNo
			INTO  #locations
			FROM viewBuildingUnitBays vbub 
			WHERE vbub.buildingunitfk = @BuildingUnitFK2 AND vbub.locationTypeFK =1 and vbub.IsArchived=0

			PRINT @FromDate2
			PRINT DATEADD(dd, DATEDIFF(dd, 0, @FromDate2), 1)

			/*DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #AllMovements
			 select *
			 INTO #AllMovements
			 from dbo.tblWorksOrderMovements wom WITH (NOLOCK)
			 where wom.UpdatedDate >= @FromDate2 and wom.UpdatedDate < DATEADD(dd, DATEDIFF(dd, 0, @FromDate2), 1)
			 and exists(
				select 1 from #locations loc WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE loc.BuildingUnitBayPK = wom.sourcelocationfk AND wom.sourcelocationtypefk = 1
				UNION
				select 1 from #locations loc WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE loc.BuildingUnitBayPK = wom.destinationfk AND wom.destinationlocationtypefk = 1
				)
			ORDER BY wom.WorksOrderMovementPK ASC*/
			--SELECT * FROM #AllMovements

			
			declare @firstmovementpk int = (select top 1 worksordermovementpk from tblworksordermovements where inserteddate >= @FromDate2 order by worksordermovementpk asc)
			declare @lastmovementpk int = (select top 1 worksordermovementpk from tblworksordermovements where UpdatedDate < DATEADD(dd, DATEDIFF(dd, 0, @FromDate2), 1) order by worksordermovementpk desc)
			--select @firstmovementpk, @lastmovementpk
			DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #AllMovements
			 select *
			 INTO #AllMovements
			 from dbo.tblWorksOrderMovements wom WITH (NOLOCK)
			 where (wom.worksordermovementpk >= @firstmovementpk and wom.worksordermovementpk <= @lastmovementpk)
			 and exists(
				select 1 from #locations loc WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE loc.BuildingUnitBayPK = wom.sourcelocationfk AND wom.sourcelocationtypefk = 1
				UNION
				select 1 from #locations loc WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE loc.BuildingUnitBayPK = wom.destinationfk AND wom.destinationlocationtypefk = 1
				)
			

			DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #EffectedLocations
			SELECT distinct loc.* 
			INTO #EffectedLocations
			FROM #locations loc
			WHERE exists(
				select 1 from #AllMovements wom WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE loc.BuildingUnitBayPK = wom.sourcelocationfk
				UNION
				select 1 from #AllMovements wom WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE loc.BuildingUnitBayPK = wom.destinationfk
				)
			--	SELECT * FROM #EffectedLocations

			if(@DetailedReport2 = 1)
			BEGIN
				DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #MovedPallets
				select DISTINCT am.Palletfk, stockitemfk, stockitemcode, div.DivisionCode, div.DivisionName
				INTO #MovedPallets
				from #AllMovements am
				INNER JOIN tblpalletcontent pc ON am.palletfk = pc.PalletFK
				LEFT JOIN tblstockitems s ON pc.stockitemfk = s.stockitempk
				LEFT JOIN tbldivisions div ON s.divisionfk= div.divisionpk
				--SELECT * FROM #MovedPallets
				
				--stock in locations right now
				DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #currentStock
				SELECT DISTINCT vrl.BuildingUnitColumnFK AS PK, BuildingUnitBayLocation AS [Location], coalesce(S.stockitemcode, 'Empty') AS stockitemcode, Count(distinct PalletPK) CurrentPallets, div.DivisionCode, div.DivisionName, vrl.[Row], vrl.ColumnNo 
				INTO #currentStock
				FROM #EffectedLocations vrl
				inner JOIN viewpalletlocations vpl ON vrl.BuildingUnitColumnFK = vpl.BuildingUnitColumnFK AND locationtypefk = 1
				left JOIN tblpalletcontent pc ON vpl.palletPk = pc.PalletFK
				left JOIN tblstockitems s ON pc.stockitemfk = s.stockitempk
				LEFT JOIN tbldivisions div ON s.divisionfk= div.divisionpk
				GROUP BY vrl.BuildingUnitColumnFK, BuildingUnitBayLocation, s.stockitemcode,div.DivisionCode, div.DivisionName, vrl.[Row], vrl.ColumnNo
				ORDER BY  vrl.BuildingUnitColumnFK
				--SELECT * FROM #currentStock
			
				--stock moved from locations (for dispatch)
				DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #MovedStockFromDispatch
				SELECT DISTINCT el.BuildingUnitColumnFK AS PK, BuildingUnitBayLocation AS [Location], coalesce(stockitemcode, 'Empty') AS stockitemcode, Count(distinct wom.PalletFK) PalletsMovedFrom_Dispatched, el.[Row], el.ColumnNo
				INTO #MovedStockFromDispatch
				FROM #EffectedLocations el
				inner join #AllMovements wom on el.BuildingUnitBayPK = wom.SourceLocationFK
				inner JOIN #MovedPallets pc ON wom.palletfk = pc.palletfk
				WHERE wom.DestinationLocationTypeFK = 2
				GROUP BY el.BuildingUnitColumnFK, BuildingUnitBayLocation, stockitemcode, el.[Row], el.ColumnNo
				ORDER BY  el.BuildingUnitColumnFK

				--stock moved from locations (for internal movements)
				DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #MovedStockFromInternal
				SELECT DISTINCT el.BuildingUnitColumnFK AS PK, BuildingUnitBayLocation AS [Location], coalesce(stockitemcode, 'Empty') AS stockitemcode, Count(distinct wom.PalletFK) PalletsMovedFrom_Internal, el.[Row], el.ColumnNo
				INTO #MovedStockFromInternal
				FROM #EffectedLocations el
				inner join #AllMovements wom on el.BuildingUnitBayPK = wom.SourceLocationFK
				inner JOIN #MovedPallets pc ON wom.palletfk = pc.palletfk
				WHERE wom.DestinationLocationTypeFK = 1
				GROUP BY el.BuildingUnitColumnFK, BuildingUnitBayLocation, stockitemcode, el.[Row], el.ColumnNo
				ORDER BY  el.BuildingUnitColumnFK

				--stock moved to locations (for arrival)
				DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #MovedStockToArrival
				SELECT DISTINCT el.BuildingUnitColumnFK AS PK, BuildingUnitBayLocation AS [Location], coalesce(stockitemcode, 'Empty') AS stockitemcode, Count(distinct wom.PalletFK) PalletsMovedTo_Arrival, el.[Row], el.ColumnNo
				INTO #MovedStockToArrival
				FROM #EffectedLocations el
				inner join #AllMovements wom on el.BuildingUnitBayPK = wom.DestinationFK
				inner JOIN #MovedPallets pc ON wom.palletfk = pc.palletfk
				WHERE wom.SourceLocationTypeFK = 2
				GROUP BY el.BuildingUnitColumnFK, BuildingUnitBayLocation, stockitemcode, el.[Row], el.ColumnNo
				ORDER BY  el.BuildingUnitColumnFK
			
				--stock moved to locations (for internal movements)			
				DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #MovedStockToInternal
				SELECT DISTINCT el.BuildingUnitColumnFK AS PK, BuildingUnitBayLocation AS [Location], coalesce(stockitemcode, 'Empty') AS stockitemcode, Count(distinct wom.PalletFK) PalletsMovedTo_Internal, el.[Row], el.ColumnNo
				INTO #MovedStockToInternal
				FROM #EffectedLocations el
				inner join #AllMovements wom on el.BuildingUnitBayPK = wom.DestinationFK
				inner JOIN #MovedPallets pc ON wom.palletfk = pc.palletfk
				WHERE wom.SourceLocationTypeFK = 1
				GROUP BY el.BuildingUnitColumnFK, BuildingUnitBayLocation, stockitemcode, el.[Row], el.ColumnNo
				ORDER BY  el.BuildingUnitColumnFK
			
				/*SELECT cs.PK, cs.[Location], cs.stockitemcode, cs.DivisionCode, cs.DivisionName,
					cs.CurrentPallets - isnull(msta.PalletsMovedTo_Arrival, 0) - isnull(msti.PalletsMovedTo_Internal, 0) 
					+ isnull(msfd.PalletsMovedFrom_Dispatched,0) + isnull(msfi.PalletsMovedFrom_Internal,0) AS OpeningStock,
					 isnull(msta.PalletsMovedTo_Arrival, 0) as PalletsInForArrival,
					 isnull(msta.PalletsMovedTo_Arrival, 0) + isnull(msti.PalletsMovedTo_Internal, 0) as TotalPalletsIn,
					 isnull(msfd.PalletsMovedFrom_Dispatched, 0) as PalletsOutForDispatch,
					 isnull(msfd.PalletsMovedFrom_Dispatched, 0) + isnull(msfi.PalletsMovedFrom_Internal, 0) as TotalPalletsOut,
					 cs.CurrentPallets AS ClosingStock, dbo.GetBSTDate() AS RunDate
				FROM #currentStock cs
				left JOIN #MovedStockFromDispatch msfd ON cs.PK = msfd.PK AND cs.stockitemcode = msfd.stockitemcode
				left JOIN #MovedStockFromInternal msfi ON cs.PK = msfi.PK AND cs.stockitemcode = msfi.stockitemcode
				left JOIN #MovedStockToArrival msta ON cs.PK = msta.PK AND cs.stockitemcode = msta.stockitemcode
				left JOIN #MovedStockToInternal msti ON cs.PK = msti.PK  AND cs.stockitemcode = msti.stockitemcode
				--ORDER BY cs.[Location]
				ORDER BY cs.[Row], cs.ColumnNo*/

				SELECT * FROM (
					SELECT cs.PK, cs.[Location], cs.stockitemcode, cs.DivisionCode, cs.DivisionName,
						cs.CurrentPallets - isnull(msta.PalletsMovedTo_Arrival, 0) - isnull(msti.PalletsMovedTo_Internal, 0) 
						+ isnull(msfd.PalletsMovedFrom_Dispatched,0) + isnull(msfi.PalletsMovedFrom_Internal,0) AS OpeningStock,
						 isnull(msta.PalletsMovedTo_Arrival, 0) as PalletsInForArrival,
						 isnull(msta.PalletsMovedTo_Arrival, 0) + isnull(msti.PalletsMovedTo_Internal, 0) as TotalPalletsIn,
						 isnull(msfd.PalletsMovedFrom_Dispatched, 0) as PalletsOutForDispatch,
						 isnull(msfd.PalletsMovedFrom_Dispatched, 0) + isnull(msfi.PalletsMovedFrom_Internal, 0) as TotalPalletsOut,
						 cs.CurrentPallets AS ClosingStock, dbo.GetBSTDate() AS RunDate
					FROM #currentStock cs
					left JOIN #MovedStockFromDispatch msfd ON cs.PK = msfd.PK AND cs.stockitemcode = msfd.stockitemcode
					left JOIN #MovedStockFromInternal msfi ON cs.PK = msfi.PK AND cs.stockitemcode = msfi.stockitemcode
					left JOIN #MovedStockToArrival msta ON cs.PK = msta.PK AND cs.stockitemcode = msta.stockitemcode
					left JOIN #MovedStockToInternal msti ON cs.PK = msti.PK  AND cs.stockitemcode = msti.stockitemcode
					--ORDER BY cs.[Location]
					--WHERE cs.Location = '02'
					--ORDER BY cs.[Row], cs.ColumnNo
					union
					SELECT distinct el.BuildingUnitColumnFK as PK, el.BuildingUnitBayLocation AS [Location], msfd.stockitemcode, '' as DivisionCode, '' as DivisionName,
						  isnull(msfd.PalletsMovedFrom_Dispatched,0) + isnull(msfi.PalletsMovedFrom_Internal,0) AS OpeningStock,
						 0 as PalletsInForArrival,
						 0 as TotalPalletsIn,
						 isnull(msfd.PalletsMovedFrom_Dispatched, 0) as PalletsOutForDispatch,
						 isnull(msfd.PalletsMovedFrom_Dispatched, 0) + isnull(msfi.PalletsMovedFrom_Internal, 0) as TotalPalletsOut,
						 0 AS ClosingStock, 
						 dbo.GetBSTDate() AS RunDate
					FROM #EffectedLocations el
					--LEFT JOIN #currentStock cs ON el.BuildingUnitBayLocation = cs.Location
					left JOIN #MovedStockFromDispatch msfd ON el.BuildingUnitColumnFK = msfd.PK --AND cs.stockitemcode = msfd.stockitemcode
					left JOIN #MovedStockFromInternal msfi ON el.BuildingUnitColumnFK = msfi.PK --AND cs.stockitemcode = msfi.stockitemcode
					--LEFT JOIN #currentStock cs ON el.BuildingUnitBayLocation = cs.Location
					--ORDER BY cs.[Location]
					WHERE  ((select count(*) from #currentStock curr  WHERE curr.stockitemcode = msfd.stockitemcode)=0) AND
					((select count(*) from #currentStock curr  WHERE curr.stockitemcode = msfi.stockitemcode)=0)
					AND  isnull(msfd.PalletsMovedFrom_Dispatched,0) + isnull(msfi.PalletsMovedFrom_Internal,0) > 0
					--ORDER BY cs.[Row], cs.ColumnNo
				)subq
				ORDER BY subq.Location
			END
			ELSE
			BEGIN
			PRINT 'summary only'
				DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #LastEffected
				;WITH cte AS
				(
					SELECT BuildingUnitColumnFK, wom.InsertedDate, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY BuildingUnitColumnFK ORDER BY wom.InsertedDate DESC) AS rn
					FROM #EffectedLocations loc
					INNER JOIN #AllMovements wom WITH (NOLOCK) on loc.BuildingUnitBayPK = wom.sourcelocationfk or loc.BuildingUnitBayPK = wom.destinationfk
				)
				SELECT *
				into #LastEffected
				FROM cte
				WHERE rn = 1
			
			SELECT * FROM (
				SELECT DISTINCT vrl.BuildingUnitColumnFK AS PK, BuildingUnitBayLocation AS [Location], coalesce(stockitemcode, 'Empty') AS stockitemcode, Count(distinct PalletPK) CurrentPallets, le.InsertedDate as LastConfirmedDate, vrl.[Row], vrl.ColumnNo
				FROM #EffectedLocations vrl
				INNER JOIN #LastEffected le ON vrl.BuildingUnitColumnFK = le.BuildingUnitColumnFK
				left JOIN viewpalletlocations vpl ON vrl.BuildingUnitColumnFK = vpl.BuildingUnitColumnFK AND locationtypefk = 1
				LEFT JOIN tblpalletcontent pc ON vpl.palletpk = pc.palletfk
				LEFT JOIN tblstockitems s ON pc.stockitemfk = s.stockitempk
				GROUP BY vrl.BuildingUnitColumnFK, BuildingUnitBayLocation, stockitemcode, le.InsertedDate, vrl.[Row], vrl.ColumnNo
				--ORDER BY  vrl.BuildingUnitColumnFK
				UNION
				SELECT DISTINCT -1 AS PK, 'Loading Bay' AS [Location], stockitemcode, Count(distinct PalletPK) CurrentPallets, getdate() as LastConfirmedDate, '1' AS [Row], '1' as ColumnNo
				--UPDATE pc SET pc.AvailableUnits = actualunits
				FROM tblpallets pals
				INNER JOIN tblpalletcontent pc ON palletfk = palletpk 
				INNER JOIN tblstockitems s ON stockitempk = stockitemfk
				WHERE pals.buildingunitfk = @BuildingUnitFK2 AND pals.LocationTypeFK <> 1 AND pc.AvailableUnits > 0
				GROUP BY pals.LocationFK, stockitemcode
				)subq
				ORDER BY [Row], ColumnNo
			END
		
			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end

			
			
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END

	@buildingUnitFK int = -1,
	@divisionBuildingUnitFK int = -1

AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT
 ,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;
	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	DECLARE @var_buildingUnitFK int, @var_divisionBuildingUnitFK int
	SET @var_buildingUnitFK = @buildingUnitFK; SET @var_divisionBuildingUnitFK = @divisionBuildingUnitFK
	SET @ParameterDetails = '@buildingUnitFK = ' + ISNULL(CAST(@var_buildingUnitFK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'') + ',@divisionBuildingUnitFK = ' 
		+ ISNULL(CAST(@var_divisionBuildingUnitFK AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),'')

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    --BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

		SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END


	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY
			

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start

			DECLARE @tblBayPalletTypePercents TABLE
			(
			  PalletTypeFK int,
			  BayWidth int,
			  SpacePercent decimal(10,5)
			)
	
			IF(@var_divisionBuildingUnitFK <> -1) 
			BEGIN
				Declare @divisionFK int
				Declare @bayCount int
				Select @divisionFK = DivisionFK, @var_buildingUnitFK = BuildingUnitFK 
				from tblDivisionBuildingUnits where DivisionBuildingUnitPK = @var_divisionBuildingUnitFK

				Insert into @tblBayPalletTypePercents 
				Select DISTINCT palletTypes.PalletTypeFK, buBays.Width BayWidth, cast(1.0/floor(buBays.Width/palletTypes.Width) * 100.0 as decimal(18,3)) 
				from tblDivisionBuildingUnitBays dbuBays 
				inner join tblBuildingUnitBays buBays on
				buBays.BuildingUnitBayPK = dbuBays.BuildingUnitBayFK
				inner join (
					Select DISTINCT pallets.PalletTypeFK, palletTypes.Width from tblPallets pallets
					inner join tblPalletTypes palletTypes on
					palletTypes.PalletTypePK = pallets.PalletTypeFK
					inner join tblDivisionBuildingUnitBays dbuBays on
					dbuBays.DivisionFK = @divisionFK AND
					dbuBays.BuildingUnitFK = @var_buildingUnitFK AND
					dbuBays.BuildingUnitBayFK = pallets.LocationFK
					Where pallets.LocationTypeFK = 1 /*In Racking ONLY! - BuildingUnitBays */
				) palletTypes on
				1=1
				Where dbuBays.DivisionFK = @divisionFK AND dbuBays.BuildingUnitFK = @var_buildingUnitFK
		 
				Select @bayCount = count(*) 
				from tblDivisionBuildingUnitBays dbuBays 
				inner join tblBuildingUnitBays buBays on
				buBays.BuildingUnitBayPK = dbuBays.BuildingUnitBayFK
				Where dbuBays.DivisionFK = @divisionFK AND dbuBays.BuildingUnitFK = @var_buildingUnitFK

				--Select * from 		@tblBayPalletTypePercents

				Select sum(SpacePercent)/@bayCount OccupancyPercentage
				from tblPallets pallets
				inner join tblDivisionBuildingUnitBays dbuBays on
				dbuBays.DivisionFK = @divisionFK AND
				dbuBays.BuildingUnitFK = @var_buildingUnitFK AND
				dbuBays.BuildingUnitBayFK = pallets.LocationFK
				inner join tblBuildingUnitBays buBays on
				buBays.BuildingUnitBayPK = pallets.LocationFK
				inner join @tblBayPalletTypePercents palletPercentages on
				palletPercentages.PalletTypeFK = pallets.PalletTypeFK
				AND palletPercentages.BayWidth = buBays.Width
				Where pallets.LocationTypeFK = 1 /*In Racking ONLY! - BuildingUnitBays */
		
				--Select @bayCount
			END

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end

			
			
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[ZZZ_Obsolete_spWorksOrderLocationsPendingWork]
(
	@ScannedLocation nvarchar(10)
)
AS
BEGIN
	/* Prevent extra result sets from interfering with SELECT statements; Only read committed/saved data. */
    SET NOCOUNT ON; SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED

    DECLARE @ThisProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),@ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),@ParameterDetails NVARCHAR(MAX),@ID INT,@DeadlockErrorRetries INT
 ,@PEDID INT,@OpeningTranCount INT,@OpeningXactState INT,@EventLogPK INT,@ParentEventLogPK INT;
	SELECT @ThisProcedureName = OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID); SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 1; SET @OpeningTranCount = @@TRANCOUNT; SET @OpeningXactState = XACT_STATE();

	-- Optimise performance by using variables instead of parameters
	DECLARE @ScannedLocation2 nvarchar(10)
	SET @ScannedLocation2 = @ScannedLocation

	SET @ParameterDetails = '@ScannedLocation = ' + ISNULL(@ScannedLocation2 ,'')

    IF OBJECT_ID('TEMPDB..#ProcedureAndErrorDetails') IS NULL 
         CREATE TABLE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails([ID] INT IDENTITY(1,1),ProcedureName NVARCHAR(400),ExecutionPath NVARCHAR(MAX),EventLogFK INT,HasException BIT)

    --IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails)
    --BEGIN
        SELECT TOP 1 @ParentEventLogPK = EventLogFK FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails ORDER BY [ID] DESC 

		SET @ParentEventLogPK = ISNULL(@ParentEventLogPK, -1)

        INSERT INTO [dbo].[tblEventLog]([EventOrigin],[Date],[Server],[Database],[Login],[Application],[ClientHost],[Schema],[ObjectName],[Operation],[State],[CommandText],ParentEventLogFK)
        SELECT 'Database',dbo.GetBSTDate(),@@SERVERNAME,UPPER(DB_NAME()),-1,'','Azure','dbo',@ThisProcedureName,'Exec','Success', 'EXEC dbo.' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails, @ParentEventLogPK

        SET @EventLogPK = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
    --END


	SELECT @ExecutionPath = ExecutionPath FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE [ID] IN (SELECT MAX([ID]) FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails);
	SET @ExecutionPath = ISNULL(@ExecutionPath,@ThisProcedureName); IF @ExecutionPath = @ThisProcedureName SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + ' ' + @ParameterDetails
	ELSE SET @ExecutionPath = @ExecutionPath + '\' + @ThisProcedureName + ' ' + @ParameterDetails;
	INSERT INTO #ProcedureAndErrorDetails(ProcedureName,ExecutionPath,EventLogFK) SELECT @ThisProcedureName,@ExecutionPath,@EventLogPK; SET @PEDID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()

	WHILE @DeadlockErrorRetries <= 3
	BEGIN	
		BEGIN TRY			

			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - start				
			SELECT top 1 worksorderpk 
			FROM tblworksorders wo
			INNER JOIN tblworksorderLocations wol ON wol.worksorderfk = wo.WorksOrderPK
			INNER JOIN dbo.viewBuildingUnitBays vbub ON wol.locationtypefk = vbub.locationTypeFK AND wol.locationfk = vbub.BuildingUnitBayPK
			WHERE wol.worksorderstatusfk <> 3 AND barcode = @ScannedLocation2
			ORDER BY wo.inserteddate asc
			-- This stored procedures main code,excluding error handling - end			
			
			BREAK
		END TRY
		BEGIN CATCH /* Error 1205 is a deadlock error */
			DECLARE @ErrorDateTime DATETIME, @CatchErrorMessage NVARCHAR(MAX), @ErrorSeverity INT, @ErrorState INT, @XactState INT, @TranCount INT,@FullRollBackDone BIT;
			SET @CatchErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();SET @ErrorDateTime=dbo.GetBSTDate();SET @ErrorSeverity=ERROR_SEVERITY();SET @ErrorState=ERROR_STATE(); SET @FullRollBackDone = 0;
			SET @XactState = XACT_STATE(); SET @TranCount = @@TRANCOUNT;

			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END ELSE IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION @ThisProcedureName END TRY 
			BEGIN CATCH BEGIN TRY IF @XactState > 0 OR @TranCount > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK; SET @FullRollBackDone = 1 END END TRY BEGIN CATCH /* Ignore & continue */ END CATCH END CATCH;
       
			BEGIN TRY IF @XactState = -1 ROLLBACK END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH;

            IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WHERE HasException = 1) UPDATE #ProcedureAndErrorDetails WITH (ROWLOCK) SET HasException = 1 WHERE [ID] = @PEDID
            
            IF @PEDID = 1 EXEC dbo.spErrorHandler @ParameterDetails,@ErrorDateTime,@ExecutionPath,@ErrorMessageOut = @CatchErrorMessage OUTPUT;
            
			IF ERROR_NUMBER() <> 1205 OR @DeadlockErrorRetries > 2 OR ((@OpeningTranCount > 0 OR @OpeningXactState > 0) AND @FullRollBackDone = 1)
			BEGIN SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = 100; RAISERROR (@CatchErrorMessage,@ErrorSeverity,@ErrorState); RETURN END
			ELSE WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00:500' /* Pause for half a second before retrying after deadlock error */
		END CATCH
		SET @DeadlockErrorRetries = @DeadlockErrorRetries + 1
	END
END
GO
EXEC sys.sp_addextendedproperty @name=N'MS_Description', @value=N'Row adjustment - To accomodate building shape' , @level0type=N'SCHEMA',@level0name=N'dbo', @level1type=N'TABLE',@level1name=N'tblBuildingUnitRows', @level2type=N'COLUMN',@level2name=N'RowOffset'
GO
